items.description: ” 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐓𝐚𝐢𝐰𝐚𝐧 𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐅𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐢𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐨𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐓𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐂𝐃𝐈𝐂 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐁𝐚𝐧𝐤 𝐨𝐟 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩” The Diplomatic Mission of the Republic of Somaliland in Taiwan welcomed Dr. Tien-Mu Thomas Huang, Chairman of Taiwan’s Central Deposit Insurance Corporation (CDIC), and his delegation for a high-level meeting focused on strengthening financial cooperation between Somaliland and Taiwan. Chairman Huang was accompanied by Ms. Annie Cheng, President; Ms. Yvonne Y. Fan, Executive Vice President; and Ms. Margaret Chuang, Director of the International Relations & Research Office. The meeting follows the recent signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between CDIC and the Bank of Somaliland, establishing a formal framework for closer cooperation, knowledge and experience sharing, and continued engagement in the areas of deposit insurance, depositor protection, and financial stability. During the meeting, both sides held productive and wide-ranging discussions on matters of mutual interest and explored opportunities to further deepen institutional cooperation. The Somaliland Diplomatic Mission expressed its appreciation to Chairman Huang and his delegation for their visit and kind words, emphasizing the importance Somaliland places on its growing relationship with CDIC. The two sides also expressed their commitment to building a strong, lasting, and increasingly substantive partnership, alongside continued engagement between CDIC and the Bank of Somaliland. The expanding cooperation in the financial sector represents another important dimension of the broader and steadily deepening relationship between the Republic of Somaliland and Taiwan (ROC). #Somaliland #Taiwan #CDIC #BankofSomaliland #FinancialCooperation

items.title: Interview with the President of Somaliland:The president hopes this will bring international recognition for the would-be state
items.description: Somaliland wants to help secure the Red Sea   The president hopes this will bring international recognition for the would-be state Irro, man on a mission Photograph: Getty Images Aug 20th 2026 | Nairobi | 4 min read Listen to this story A bdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi is an ambitious man. In December 2024 the 70-year-old former diplomat (pictured), who is better known as Irro, was sworn in as president of Somaliland, a breakaway republic that declared independence from Somalia in 1991. Last year he was the would-be country’s leader when Somaliland was formally recognised by Israel, the first nation to do so. “The world has been ignoring Somaliland for 35 years,” Irro tells The Economist . He wants outsiders to take a closer look. Map: The Economist Irro’s pitch centres on the Red Sea. The trade route has been a mess of late, with shipping menaced by the Houthis, an Iran-backed militia that rules much of Yemen. Speaking this month during a visit to Nairobi, Kenya’s capital, Irro says Somaliland can help secure the strategic waterway by offering military bases to global powers along its coastline. Once trade can flow unmolested again, he wants Somaliland’s main port at Berbera to be the primary gateway to the markets of the Horn of Africa. “Our message is that we are a responsible partner” in security and trade, says Irro. He suggests that Somaliland could, in effect, be the new Djibouti. That tiny port-state rakes in some $125m a year by renting out slices of its coastline to foreign armies. America, China and France (among others) have bases there. It also earns many multiples of that amount in annual port fees paid by landlocked Ethiopia, which depends on Djibouti for most of its international trade. Irro wants a slice of both Djiboutian cakes. He is trying to persuade Ethiopia to use Berbera, where the United Arab Emirates ( UAE ) has built a new harbour, as its main outlet to the sea. He also wants to entice America to set up a military base there. That would give America more options if it chooses to resume its war against the Houthis, whom it bombed intensively last year. Access to military facilities around Berbera is widely believed to have been part of the deal Israel struck with Irro when it recognised Somaliland in December. Some reports suggest that America and Israel may already be developing a military presence at Berbera, with covert support from the UAE , which operates an existing base there. Irro denies such reports. “There is no Israeli or American presence yet,” he says. But the UAE has another base at the port of Bosaso in Puntland, a neighbouring semi-autonomous province of Somalia, where unconfirmed reports suggest Israel is also embedded. As competition for military properties on the Red Sea heats up, Irro says he would be willing to offer both Israel and America bases at Berbera “if they are interested”. Next month Irro will visit Washington, where he hopes to have a tête-à-tête with Donald Trump. Were that to happen, he would become the first president of Somaliland to meet directly with an American counterpart. “We expect the recognition of the United States some time in the future,” says Irro, adding that Somaliland anticipates recognition from at least one more country “before the end of the year”. Irro’s ambitions are ruffling regional feathers. Djibouti is irked by Somaliland’s desire to barge in. Irro hints that his northern neighbour is trying to “destabilise” his country, presumably by supporting hostile militias on the border. Relations with Somalia are even more strained. Mr Irro claims Somalia, which considers Somaliland a renegade province, has plans to mobilise troops along the southern frontier. “This is not a peace recipe,” he adds. It does not help that Israel and Turkey, a patron of Somalia, are increasingly hostile to each other. Turkey has long been trying to mediate between Somalia and Somaliland, yet numerous rounds of talks in Ankara and Istanbul have failed. “Next time they can happen in Tel Aviv,” chortles Irro, who seems unbothered by the prospect of a proxy war. Yet America may well be reluctant to stir the pot by recognising Somaliland. The Houthis, meanwhile, have threatened to attack any Israeli military installation in the statelet. An American base there could become a target, too. That would shatter the reputation for peace and stability on which Somaliland has long built its case for international recognition. But “there is nothing free in the world,” says Irro. He seems willing to pay a price to put his country on the map—the question is, how high? ■ Source Economist

items.title: Madaxweynaha  Somaliland oo socdaal rasmi ah ku tagi doona dalka Maraykanka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Md. Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa la filayaa inuu bisha soo socota ee September 2026 uu safar shaqo ku tago dalka Maraykanka. Wargeyska The Economist oo waraysi la yeeshay Madaxweyne Cirro ayaa sheegay in Madaxweynaha Somaliland uu rajaynayo inuu kulan fool-ka-fool ah la yeesho Donald Trump oo ah Madaxweynaha Maraykanka. Waxaanu Wargeysku intaas ku daray in haddii kulankaasi dhaco wuxuu Madaxweyne Cirro noqon doonaa madaxweynihii ugu horreeyey ee Somaliland ee si toos ah ula kulma Nadaxweyne Maraykan ah. “Waxaan filaynaa in Maraykanku mustaqbalka aqoonsado Somaliland,” ayuu yidhi Madaxweyne Cirro, isagoo intaas ku daray inay Somaliland filayso in ugu yaraan hal dal oo kale aqoonsado “ka hor dhammaadka sannadkan 2026. Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa waraysigan si kaftan ah ugu sheegay in wadahadalka Somaliland iyo Soomaaliya ay marka xiga ka qabsoomi doonaan Tel Aviv oo Israa’iil ah. Hadalkan Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa sida wargeysku sheegay ah kaftan xambaarsan fariin siyaasadeed. Hadalkan Madaxweyne Cirro ayaa daba socda wada-xaajoodyadii fashilmay ee Turkigu hore ugu qabtay Somaliland iyo Soomaaliya.

items.title: Fiqi ma wuxuu isku beddelay afhayeenka dowladda – aaway shaqadii gaashaandhigga?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa muddooyinkii dambe si joogto ah uga falcelinayay hadallada kasoo baxaya mucaaradka iyo siyaasiyiinta dhaliila dowladda. Wasiirka ayaa si joogta ah u weerarayay mucaaradka, taasoo dhalisay in la is weydiiyo: Fiqi ma wuxuu dhab ahaan isu arkayaa afhayeenka siyaasadeed ee dowladda? Arrintan ayaa si gaar ah u muuqata marka la eego qoraallada uu wasiirku ku daabaco baraha bulshada. Halkii uu xoogga saari lahaa shaqada wasaaradda uu hoggaamiyo iyo warbixinnada la xiriira amniga dalka. Wasiir Fiqi wuxuu marar badan si toos ah ugu jawaabaa dadka dhaliila dowladda, isaga oo difaacaya waxqabadka maamulka iyo siyaasadaha Villa Soomaaliya. Qoraalkiisii ugu dambeeyay uu ku daabaco barahiisa bulshada wuxuu ku weeraray siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, oo ku sifeeyay “adeegayaal shisheeye”, oo u kireysan cadowga, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Fiqi wuxuu sheegay in sumcadda Soomaaliya ay maalinba maalinta ka dambeysa kor u kacayso, duniduna ay kusoo qulquleyso dalka, halka uu dhaliilay kuwa uu ku tilmaamay inay dalal kale u kiraysan yihiin oo shacabka u sheegaya in Soomaaliya aysan xor ahayn ama Al-Shabaab qabsanayso. Wasiir amni oo galay doorka doodda siyaasadeed Dooddu ma aha in wasiirku xaq u lahayn inuu difaaco dowladda uu ka tirsan yahay. Wasiir kasta wuxuu leeyahay xaq iyo waajib uu kaga hadlo siyaasadda dowladda, gaar ahaan marka uu ka hadlayo arrimaha hoos yimaada wasaaraddiisa. Laakiin marka jawaab-celinta siyaasadeed ay noqoto hawl joogto ah waxaa soo baxaya su’aasha ah halka uu ku dhammaanayo doorka wasiirka, halka uu ka bilaabanayo doorka afhayeenka dowladda. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga waxaa horyaalla mas’uuliyad culus oo amni. Ciidamada xoogga dalka, dagaalka Al-Shabaab, dhismaha awoodda ciidamada, xaaladda goobaha dagaalka iyo xiriirka milatari ee Soomaaliya iyo dalalka taageera ayaa ah arrimo u baahan feejignaan iyo waqti badan. Sidaas darteed, marka wasiirka difaacu si joogto ah uga dhex muuqdo doodaha siyaasadeed ee mucaaradka, waxaa macquul ah in shacabka iyo siyaasiyiintu is weydiiyaan haddii waqtiga iyo awoodda wasiirka ay si ku filan ugu baxayaan shaqada amniga, mise qayb ka mid ah shaqadiisa ayaa isu beddeshay la-dagaallanka hadallada siyaasadeed. Dhanka kale, su’aashu ma aha oo keliya waxa wasiirku yiri, balse waa haddii qaabka uu uga jawaabayo mucaaradka uu dhab ahaan u adeegayo danaha dowladda. Siyaasadda casriga ah, jawaab kasta waxay leedahay kharash iyo faa’iido, waxaana muhiim ah in la ogaado goorta la jawaabayo iyo goorta aamusnaantu ka waxtar badan tahay. Maxaa laga filayaa Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga? Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga waxaa laga filayaa inuu shacabka siiyo xog ku saabsan xaaladda amniga, horumarka ciidamada, caqabadaha dagaalka iyo qorshaha lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidanka. Waxa kale oo laga doonayaa inuu si cad uga hadlo waxa dowladda ka qabatay goobaha ay ciidamada ku sugan yihiin iyo meelaha ay wali ka jiraan caqabado. Taasi macnaheedu ma aha in Fiqi uusan ka hadli karin siyaasadda. Hase yeeshee, haddii hadallada siyaasadeed ee uu kaga jawaabayo mucaaradka ay ka bataan warbixinnada la xiriira shaqada wasaaradda, waxaa dhaawacmi karta kala sarreynta mudnaanta. Wasiir awood leh wuxuu dowladda u difaaci karaa si ka waxtar badan marka uu soo bandhigo natiijooyin la cabbiri karo. Tusaale ahaan, haddii dowladda ay horumar ka sameyso dagaalka Al-Shabaab, waxaa ka xoog badan in shacabka loo sheego waxa laga qabtay goobaha dagaalka, halkii lagu mashquuli lahaa in siyaasiga mucaaradka ah loogu jawaabo hadal kale. Dowladda oo u baahan fariin mideysan Dhanka kale, waxaa la fahmi karaa sababta Fiqi iyo mas’uuliyiin kale ay uga falcelinayaan hadallada mucaaradka. Soomaaliya waxay ku jirtaa marxalad siyaasadeed oo aad u xasaasi ah, gaar ahaan doodaha ku saabsan doorashooyinka, dastuurka, amniga iyo xiriirka dowladda federaalka iyo maamul-goboleedyada. Xukuumad kasta waxay u baahan tahay inay yeelato awood ay ku difaacdo siyaasaddeeda. Laakiin difaacaas wuxuu noqdaa mid waxtar badan marka ay jiraan shaqsiyaad si rasmi ah loogu igmaday xiriirka warbaahinta iyo sharaxaadda siyaasadaha dowladda. Haddii wasiir kasta uu noqdo afhayeen u gaar ah oo maalin kasta ka jawaaba mucaaradka, waxaa dhalan karta fariimo kala duwan iyo dood aan lahayn xarun keliya oo laga maamulo. Taasi waxay mararka qaar adkeyn kartaa halkii ay ka fududeyn lahayd isgaarsiinta dowladda. Si kastaba, xukuumad kasta waxaa ugu dambeyn lagu qiimeeyaa waxqabadka ay sheeganeyso ee laguma qiimeeyo sida wanaagsan ee ay uga jawaabto dhaliisheeda. Haddii dowladda ay leedahay waxqabad muuqda, shaqadaas ayaa lafteedu noqon karta jawaabta ugu xooggan ee mucaaradka. Haddii amniga hagaago, dhaqaalaha kobco, adeegyada dowladda kordhaan, hay’adaha dowladdu shaqeeyaan, doorasho la isku raacsan yahayna qabsoonto, doodda mucaaradka waxay si dabiici ah u lumin kartaa qayb ka mid ah awooddeeda. Taasi waa “jawaabta” ugu adag ee siyaasadeed. Doorashada qof iyo cod Inta badan wasiir Fiqi wuxuu qoraalladiisa ugu difaacaya hanaanka lagu muransan yahay ee doorasho qof iyo cod, isagoo marwalba sheega in mucaaradku ku qasban yahay aqbalka hanaankan doorasho. Haddii dowladda ay dhab ka tahay doorasho qof iyo cod, doodda ugu weyn waa in la helo hannaan siyaasadeed oo la isku raacsan yahay, xeerar cad, hay’ad doorasho oo lagu kalsoon yahay iyo jawi amni oo u saamaxaya shacabka inay codkooda dhiibtaan. Mucaaradka oo lagu tilmaamo “calaacalayaal” ma xallinayso khilaafka doorashada. Sidoo kale dowladda oo si joogto ah uga jawaabta dhaliisha mucaaradka ma dhiseyso kalsooni siyaasadeed. Waxa wax ka beddeli kara xaaladda waa heshiis siyaasadeed iyo nidaam doorasho oo dhinacyadu si dhab ah ugu wada qanci karaan. Isku soo wada duubo, Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay wasiir gaashaandhig oo si adag uga shaqeeya dhismaha ciidamada iyo sugidda amniga, halka dowladda ay u baahan tahay afhayeen iyo hannaan isgaarsiineed oo si nidaamsan uga jawaaba dagaalka siyaasadeed. Fiqi wuxuu sheegay in sumcadda Soomaaliya ay maalinba maalinta ka dambeysa kor u kacayso, duniduna ay kusoo qulquleyso dalka, halka uu dhaliilay kuwa uu ku tilmaamay inay dalal kale u kiraysan yihiin oo shacabka u sheegaya in Soomaaliya aysan xor ahayn ama Al-Shabaab qabsanayso. Wasiir amni oo galay doorka doodda siyaasadeed Dooddu ma aha in wasiirku xaq u lahayn inuu difaaco dowladda uu ka tirsan yahay. Wasiir kasta wuxuu leeyahay xaq iyo waajib uu kaga hadlo siyaasadda dowladda, gaar ahaan marka uu ka hadlayo arrimaha hoos yimaada wasaaraddiisa. Laakiin marka jawaab-celinta siyaasadeed ay noqoto hawl joogto ah waxaa soo baxaya su’aasha ah halka uu ku dhammaanayo doorka wasiirka, halka uu ka bilaabanayo doorka afhayeenka dowladda. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga waxaa horyaalla mas’uuliyad culus oo amni. Ciidamada xoogga dalka, dagaalka Al-Shabaab, dhismaha awoodda ciidamada, xaaladda goobaha dagaalka iyo xiriirka milatari ee Soomaaliya iyo dalalka taageera ayaa ah arrimo u baahan feejignaan iyo waqti badan. Sidaas darteed, marka wasiirka difaacu si joogto ah uga dhex muuqdo doodaha siyaasadeed ee mucaaradka, waxaa macquul ah in shacabka iyo siyaasiyiintu is weydiiyaan haddii waqtiga iyo awoodda wasiirka ay si ku filan ugu baxayaan shaqada amniga, mise qayb ka mid ah shaqadiisa ayaa isu beddeshay la-dagaallanka hadallada siyaasadeed. Dhanka kale, su’aashu ma aha oo keliya waxa wasiirku yiri, balse waa haddii qaabka uu uga jawaabayo mucaaradka uu dhab ahaan u adeegayo danaha dowladda. Siyaasadda casriga ah, jawaab kasta waxay leedahay kharash iyo faa’iido, waxaana muhiim ah in la ogaado goorta la jawaabayo iyo goorta aamusnaantu ka waxtar badan tahay. Maxaa laga filayaa Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga? Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga waxaa laga filayaa inuu shacabka siiyo xog ku saabsan xaaladda amniga, horumarka ciidamada, caqabadaha dagaalka iyo qorshaha lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidanka. Waxa kale oo laga doonayaa inuu si cad uga hadlo waxa dowladda ka qabatay goobaha ay ciidamada ku sugan yihiin iyo meelaha ay wali ka jiraan caqabado. Taasi macnaheedu ma aha in Fiqi uusan ka hadli karin siyaasadda. Hase yeeshee, haddii hadallada siyaasadeed ee uu kaga jawaabayo mucaaradka ay ka bataan warbixinnada la xiriira shaqada wasaaradda, waxaa dhaawacmi karta kala sarreynta mudnaanta. Wasiir awood leh wuxuu dowladda u difaaci karaa si ka waxtar badan marka uu soo bandhigo natiijooyin la cabbiri karo. Tusaale ahaan, haddii dowladda ay horumar ka sameyso dagaalka Al-Shabaab, waxaa ka xoog badan in shacabka loo sheego waxa laga qabtay goobaha dagaalka, halkii lagu mashquuli lahaa in siyaasiga mucaaradka ah loogu jawaabo hadal kale. Dowladda oo u baahan fariin mideysan Dhanka kale, waxaa la fahmi karaa sababta Fiqi iyo mas’uuliyiin kale ay uga falcelinayaan hadallada mucaaradka. Soomaaliya waxay ku jirtaa marxalad siyaasadeed oo aad u xasaasi ah, gaar ahaan doodaha ku saabsan doorashooyinka, dastuurka, amniga iyo xiriirka dowladda federaalka iyo maamul-goboleedyada. Xukuumad kasta waxay u baahan tahay inay yeelato awood ay ku difaacdo siyaasaddeeda. Laakiin difaacaas wuxuu noqdaa mid waxtar badan marka ay jiraan shaqsiyaad si rasmi ah loogu igmaday xiriirka warbaahinta iyo sharaxaadda siyaasadaha dowladda. Haddii wasiir kasta uu noqdo afhayeen u gaar ah oo maalin kasta ka jawaaba mucaaradka, waxaa dhalan karta fariimo kala duwan iyo dood aan lahayn xarun keliya oo laga maamulo. Taasi waxay mararka qaar adkeyn kartaa halkii ay ka fududeyn lahayd isgaarsiinta dowladda. Si kastaba, xukuumad kasta waxaa ugu dambeyn lagu qiimeeyaa waxqabadka ay sheeganeyso ee laguma qiimeeyo sida wanaagsan ee ay uga jawaabto dhaliisheeda. Haddii dowladda ay leedahay waxqabad muuqda, shaqadaas ayaa lafteedu noqon karta jawaabta ugu xooggan ee mucaaradka. Haddii amniga hagaago, dhaqaalaha kobco, adeegyada dowladda kordhaan, hay’adaha dowladdu shaqeeyaan, doorasho la isku raacsan yahayna qabsoonto, doodda mucaaradka waxay si dabiici ah u lumin kartaa qayb ka mid ah awooddeeda. Taasi waa “jawaabta” ugu adag ee siyaasadeed. Doorashada qof iyo cod Inta badan wasiir Fiqi wuxuu qoraalladiisa ugu difaacaya hanaanka lagu muransan yahay ee doorasho qof iyo cod, isagoo marwalba sheega in mucaaradku ku qasban yahay aqbalka hanaankan doorasho. Haddii dowladda ay dhab ka tahay doorasho qof iyo cod, doodda ugu weyn waa in la helo hannaan siyaasadeed oo la isku raacsan yahay, xeerar cad, hay’ad doorasho oo lagu kalsoon yahay iyo jawi amni oo u saamaxaya shacabka inay codkooda dhiibtaan. Mucaaradka oo lagu tilmaamo “calaacalayaal” ma xallinayso khilaafka doorashada. Sidoo kale dowladda oo si joogto ah uga jawaabta dhaliisha mucaaradka ma dhiseyso kalsooni siyaasadeed. Waxa wax ka beddeli kara xaaladda waa heshiis siyaasadeed iyo nidaam doorasho oo dhinacyadu si dhab ah ugu wada qanci karaan. Isku soo wada duubo, Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay wasiir gaashaandhig oo si adag uga shaqeeya dhismaha ciidamada iyo sugidda amniga, halka dowladda ay u baahan tahay afhayeen iyo hannaan isgaarsiineed oo si nidaamsan uga jawaaba dagaalka siyaasadeed. items.title: Somalia Mourns After Brothers and a Child Die in Separate Incidents
items.description: Badhan/Hargeisa (WDN) — Somalia has been shaken by two deeply tragic incidents in which members of the same families lost their lives in separate parts of the country, highlighting once again the devastating consequences that can follow when family disputes, land conflicts and personal crises descend into violence. In the Bari region, in Ceeldaahir, a small town near Badhan, along the road leading to the port city of Bosaso. a man reportedly killed his own brother on Wednesday following a dispute over land ownership or its use. Preliminary reports indicate that the two brothers had been involved in a disagreement over a piece of land before the dispute escalated into physical violence, ultimately ending in a death that has left the local community shocked and grieving. The identities of the two brothers and the precise circumstances surrounding the killing have not yet been officially released. Details concerning the suspect’s current status are also unclear. For residents of Ceeldaahir, the incident has brought profound sadness, particularly because the victim and alleged perpetrator were members of the same family. The tragedy is a painful reminder of how disputes over land—a source of growing tension in many Somali communities—can escalate from disagreements into irreversible violence. Another Family Tragedy in Hargeisa The incident in Ceeldaahir came only hours after another disturbing death was reported in Hargeisa, where a father was allegedly involved in the killing of his nine-year-old son. According to reports, the child was fatally struck with a stone during an incident that has shocked the local community. Somaliland police were reportedly able to apprehend the father following the incident. Some reports have suggested that the man may have been suffering from a mental health condition, although this has not been independently confirmed and should not be treated as an established explanation for the tragedy. Whatever the circumstances, the death of a nine-year-old child at the hands of his own father has generated widespread sorrow and disbelief. A child who should have been protected by his family instead became the victim of an unimaginable act of violence. A Sobering Reminder: Two Lives Lost, Two Communities Grieving The two incidents occurred in different places and appear to have had very different circumstances. Yet they share one heartbreaking feature: people from the same families turning against one another with fatal consequences. In Ceeldaahir, a dispute over land reportedly ended with one brother killing another. In Hargeisa, a young child lost his life in an incident involving his father. Both cases remain subject to further investigation, and many details have yet to be officially confirmed. But together, they raise difficult questions about how Somali communities respond to disputes, family tensions and vulnerable individuals facing personal or psychological crises. Land disputes are among the most persistent sources of conflict in Somalia. Where formal documentation, trusted dispute-resolution mechanisms and accessible courts are weak, disagreements over ownership and boundaries can easily become personal and, in extreme cases, violent. Traditional elders, religious leaders and judicial institutions can play an important role in preventing such disputes from reaching that point. The Hargeisa tragedy raises another equally important issue: the need for families and communities to recognize and respond to serious mental-health problems before they develop into situations that could place vulnerable people, particularly children, at risk. For the families involved, these are not political stories or statistics. They are personal tragedies. One family is mourning a brother who reportedly died following a dispute over land. Another is mourning a nine-year-old child whose life ended in circumstances that have left an entire community searching for answers. May Allah have mercy on those who lost their lives and give their families strength and patience. The tragedies should also serve as a warning that disputes that appear manageable can become catastrophic when dialogue breaks down, when anger replaces restraint, or when vulnerable people do not receive the protection they need. No piece of land is worth a human life. And no family should have to bury its own because a disagreement was allowed to become violence. items.title: Digniin cusub oo laga soo saaray culeyska AUSSOM iyo fursadda Al-Shabaab
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Saraakiil iyo diblomaasiyiin reer Galbeed ah ayaa ka digaya in haddii aan la helin ilo dhaqaale oo kale ay adkaan karto in ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya ay sii joogaan saldhigyada ku yaalla deegaanada fogfog, taasoo abuuri karta firaaq amni oo ay Al-Shabaab ka faa’iidaysato. Digniintan ayaa timid xilli Mareykanka uu qorsheynayo inuu joojiyo maalgelinta xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee taageera howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, UNSOS, kaas oo door muhiim ah ka qaata howlaha saadka ee ciidamada AUSSOM. UNSOS ayaa ciidamada howl-galka siiya adeegyo muhiim ah oo ay ka mid yihiin shidaal, raashin, biyo, gaadiid iyo adeegyo caafimaad, kuwaas oo muhiim u ah in ciidamada ay si joogto ah uga howlgalayaan goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin. Saraakiil iyo khubaro amni ayaa aaminsan in hoos u dhac ku yimaada adeegyadaas uu si gaar ah u saameyn karo saldhigyada ku yaalla meelaha ka fog xarumaha waaweyn, halkaas oo helitaanka sahayda iyo adeegyada kale uu durba yahay caqabad. Ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee ku howlgala AUSSOM ayaa door muhiim ah ka qaata taageerada ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo haynta deegaanada laga saaro Al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan goobaha ay ciidamada Soomaaliyeed weli u baahan yihiin taageero dheeraad ah. Hase yeeshee, khubarada ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada Soomaaliya aysan weli awood buuxda u yeelan inay si madax-bannaan u fuliyaan hawlgallo ballaaran, isla markaana muddo dheer ku sii hayaan dhulka ay dib uga qabsadaan Al-Shabaab. Sida laga soo xigtay warbixino laga qoray xaaladda amni ee dalka, Al-Shabaab ayaa horey uga faa’iidaysatay meelaha ay ciidamada Midowga Afrika ama ciidamada dowladda ka baxeen, iyadoo mararka qaar dib ula wareegtay deegaano horay looga saaray. Arrintan ayaa sare u qaadaysa walaaca laga qabo in bixitaan ama hoos u dhac ku yimaada awoodda AUSSOM uu kooxda Al-Shabaab u abuuro fursad ay ku kordhiso weerarradeeda, gaar ahaan deegaanada aan weli laga dhisin awood amni oo joogto ah. Saraakiil Soomaali ah iyo kuwo reer Galbeed ah ayaa sidaas darteed aaminsan in taageerada saadka ay tahay qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah awoodda howlgalka, isla markaana maalgelin la’aantu ay wiiqi karto joogitaanka ciidamada meelaha fogfog. UNSOS ayaa hadda taageerta ku dhowaad 12,000 oo ka tirsan ciidamada howlgalka, iyadoo adeegyada ay bixiso ay si toos ah ugu xiran yihiin awoodda ciidamada AUSSOM ay ugu shaqeeyaan saldhigyada iyo goobaha ay gacanta ku hayaan. Haddii aan la helin maalgelin beddel ah ka hor inta uusan dhaqan-gelin go’aanka Mareykanka, khubarada ayaa ka digaya in howlgalka uu wajihi karo caqabado waaweyn, xilli dagaalka Al-Shabaab uu weli ka socdo qeybo badan oo Soomaaliya ah. Walaaca ayaa sidoo kale taabanaya qorshaha dowladda Soomaaliya ee ah in si tartiib ah mas’uuliyadda amniga loogu wareejiyo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo AUSSOM loogu talagalay inay taageerto kala-guurkaas, ilaa ciidamada dalka ay awood buuxda u yeeshaan sugidda amniga. Maalgelin la’aanta ayaa sidaas darteed noqon karta caqabad hor leh oo ku timaadda qorshaha kala-guurka amni, iyadoo Midowga Afrika iyo dalalka taageera Soomaaliya ay wajahaan baahida loo qabo in la helo dhaqaale lagu sii wado howlgalka. Dhawaan ayay ahayd markii ciidamada Itoobiya ee qeybta ka ah howlgalka AUSSOM ay ka baxeen degmada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Baay, tallaabadaas oo dhalisay walaac xooggan oo ku saabsan xaaladda amni ee degmada iyo suuragalnimada in Al-Shabaab ay dib ugu soo laabato. Dadka ku nool Buurhakaba ayaa walaac ka muujiyay bixitaanka ciidamada Itoobiya, iyadoo xaaladdan ay tusaale u tahay caqabadaha ka dhalan kara haddii ciidamada AUSSOM ay ka baxaan deegaano aysan weli ciidamada Soomaaliyeed awood buuxda ugu filnayn inay si madax-bannaan u sugaan amnigooda. Sidaas darteed, khubaradu waxay ku adkeysanayaan in qorshe cad oo maalgelin iyo kala-guur amni ah loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado firaaq amni oo ay Al-Shabaab ka faa’iidaysato. items.title: Xogta wada-hadallo xasaasi ah oo dhexmaray Golaha Mustaqbalka iyo Farmaajo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa wada-hadallo la yeeshay madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo, iyagoo doonaya in la mideeyo awoodda mucaaradka si ay door weyn uga yeeshaan hannaanka doorashada federaalka. Wada-hadalladan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallo siyaasadeed oo lagu doonayo in mucaaradka Soomaaliyeed ay yeeshaan mowqif mideysan, gaar ahaan cidda noqonaysa xubnaha ugu badan ee Guddiga Jihaynta Doorashada Federaalka. Arrintan ayaa soo baxday kaddib dhex-dhexaadin ay sameeyeen dhinacyada beesha caalamka, taas oo la sheegay inay isku soo dhoweysay dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay isku afgarteen mabda’a ah in dalka loo jihayno doorasho toos ah. Sida xogaha la helayo ay tilmaamayaan, waxaa hadda la isla oggol yahay in doorashada soo socota lagu qabto nidaam toos ah, iyadoo sidoo kale la doonayo in dalka uu yeesho hal guddi oo maamula doorashada, taasoo meesha ka saaraysa guddiyo kala duwan oo dhinacyadu ku murmaan. Hase yeeshee, heshiiska guud ayaa weli waxaa hortaagan laba qodob oo muhiim ah, kuwaas oo kala ah cidda yeelanaysa awoodda ugu badan ee Guddiga Jihaynta Doorashada iyo waqtiga rasmiga ah ee la qabanayo doorashada federaalka. Villa Soomaaliya ayaa la sheegay inay beesha caalamka u gudbisay mowqif ah in xisbiyada ay hoggaamiyaan madaxweynihii hore Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo iyo ra’iisul wasaarihii hore Cumar Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke ay dhankeeda yihiin, sidaas darteedna ay xaq u leedahay inay hesho aqlabiyadda xubnaha Guddiga Jihaynta Doorashada. Mowqifkaas ayaa dhaliyay inuu Golaha Mustaqbalka dib ula xiriiro siyaasiyiin ay hore uga soo horjeedeen, gaar ahaan Farmaajo iyo Cumar Cabdirashiid, iyadoo hadafka ugu weyn uu yahay in la mideeyo awoodda mucaaradka iyo saamaynta ay ku yeelan karaan guddiga doorashada. Dhinaca kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa ku adkeysanaya in la dhammeystiro muddada dheeriga ah ee uu siinayo dastuurka cusub, taasoo dowladda u aragto inay qeyb ka tahay qorshaha siyaasadeed iyo dastuuriga ah ee dalka. Mucaaradka ayaa iyagu doonaya in doorashada la qabto ka hor bilowga sanadka 2027, iyagoo ka digaya in muddo dheeri ah loo sameeyo hay’adaha dowladda iyadoo aan la gaarin heshiis siyaasadeed oo ay dhinacyada oo dhan ku wada qanacsan yihiin. Khilaafka waqtiga doorashada iyo awoodda Guddiga Jihaynta Doorashada ayaa sidaas darteed weli ah caqabadda ugu weyn ee hortaagan heshiis siyaasadeed oo dhameystiran, iyadoo dadaallada beesha caalamka iyo wada-hadallada dhinacyadu ay socdaan si loo helo hannaan ay dhinacyadu si wadajir ah ugu wada qanacsan yihiin. items.title: Somali Federal Lawmaker Vows to Follow the Will of the Somaliland People Over Somali Unity
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — A senior Somali opposition politician representing Somaliland in the Federal Parliament has openly declared that he will support whatever political future the people of Somaliland choose, injecting a striking new dimension into Somalia’s increasingly contentious debate over national unity, federalism and Somaliland’s long-standing demand for independence. MP Kooshin, who represents Somaliland in the House of the People and is also associated with the opposition-led Future Council, made the remarks in an interview with Shabeelle TV. Asked directly about his position on Somaliland’s aspirations and the question of independence, Kooshin gave an unusually straightforward answer. “I want what my people want. I am there to represent them.” Pressed further by the interviewer about whether he supported the wishes of the people of Somaliland, Kooshin reiterated his position: “Whatever they want, I want.” The statement is significant because it comes from a sitting member of Somalia’s Federal Parliament—a national institution whose constitutional mandate is based on representing the Somali people and preserving the country’s federal political order. Kooshin’s remarks therefore raise a fundamental question: what happens when the political preferences of a parliamentarian’s constituents collide with the constitutional position of the state he serves? A Parliamentarian Caught Between Two Political Realities The comments expose one of the most complicated realities of Somalia’s political system. Somaliland has governed itself separately from Mogadishu since declaring its independence in 1991. While the Federal Government of Somalia continues to regard Somaliland as part of the Somali Republic, Somaliland’s authorities maintain that the territory is an independent state and have pursued international recognition for decades. Yet Somaliland-origin politicians continue to occupy positions within Somalia’s federal institutions. Kooshin’s statement brings that contradiction into unusually sharp focus. His message appears to be that his primary political obligation is to the wishes of the people he represents, even when those wishes may diverge fundamentally from national unity. That is a politically consequential distinction. It suggests that representation, identity and political loyalty in Somalia’s federal institutions cannot always be reduced to a simple question of whether a politician supports the central government’s position. Kooshin’s remarks come at a moment when Somalia’s political landscape is already experiencing intense debate over the future structure of the state. The Federal Government and opposition groups remain deeply divided over constitutional reforms, elections, federalism and the distribution of political authority between Mogadishu and the Federal Member States. At the same time, relations between Mogadishu and Somaliland remain among the most sensitive political issues in the Horn of Africa. The dispute is no longer confined to diplomatic statements between Hargeisa and Mogadishu. It increasingly intersects with Somalia’s internal political competition, particularly as politicians from different regions attempt to balance national institutions with the interests of the communities they represent. Kooshin’s remarks illustrate that tension in unusually direct terms. At the heart of Kooshin’s argument is a principle familiar to democratic politics: elected representatives are expected to reflect the interests and political aspirations of their constituents. But Somalia’s political circumstances make that principle particularly complicated. If the majority of people represented by a parliamentarian support Somaliland’s independence, can that representative be expected to advocate for a unified Somali state? Conversely, if a parliamentarian believes that national unity is constitutionally fundamental, how should that representative respond if constituents demand a different political future? These questions have no easy answers. They go directly to the unresolved constitutional and political relationship between Somalia and Somaliland. Government dysfunction and eroding Somali unity For supporters of Somali unity, Kooshin’s statement may be viewed as deeply troubling. They could argue that members of the Federal Parliament should defend the constitutional integrity and territorial unity of Somalia regardless of regional political preferences. For others, however, his position could be interpreted differently—as an acknowledgment that political legitimacy ultimately depends on the consent and aspirations of the people being represented. That distinction is particularly important in a country where political disputes have repeatedly emerged because national institutions and regional political interests have moved in different directions. The statement may therefore deserve attention not simply as another opposition criticism of the Federal Government, but as a window into the deeper structural challenges confronting Somalia’s federal experiment. Somalia’s unity debate cannot ultimately be resolved through political declarations alone. Nor can the relationship between Mogadishu and Somaliland be settled simply by insisting that one side is right and the other must submit. The underlying political question remains unresolved: Can Somalia construct a federal system in which regional identities, local political aspirations and national institutions can coexist without continually producing constitutional crises? Kooshin’s remarks suggest just how difficult that challenge remains. A politician sitting in Somalia’s national parliament is publicly saying that his political position will follow the wishes of the people of Somaliland. That statement may be uncomfortable for advocates of a centralized conception of Somali unity. But it also forces a broader conversation about what representation actually means in a divided and politically contested state. For Somalia, the issue is ultimately larger than one parliamentarian. It is about whether national unity is sustained primarily by constitutional declarations—or by a political settlement in which citizens across the country’s disputed and autonomous regions genuinely believe their voices, identities and aspirations have a place. Until that question is answered, Somalia’s debate over unity, federalism and Somaliland’s future will remain one of the defining political struggles shaping the country’s next chapter. items.title: Syria Refuses to Remove Newly Discovered Nuclear Materials as Questions Over Assad-Era Program Resurface
items.description: Damascus (WDN) — Syria’s new government has rejected calls to remove nuclear materials recently discovered at a previously undisclosed site, saying the material will remain under Syrian control while allowing international inspectors to examine and verify its condition. The decision has reignited scrutiny of Syria’s controversial nuclear history and raised fresh questions about what remains of the secretive nuclear activities allegedly pursued during the rule of former President Bashar al-Assad. Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shibani said the government would retain custody of the material inside Syria and insisted that it does not currently pose a threat to the population or environment. At the same time, Damascus has indicated that it is prepared to cooperate with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and allow international monitoring of the material. Al-Shibani also argued that Syria retains the right to use nuclear materials for peaceful and civilian purposes, provided such activities remain subject to international safeguards and IAEA oversight. The position reflects a delicate balancing act by Syria’s new authorities: demonstrating cooperation with international nuclear inspectors while simultaneously asserting national sovereignty over material that could shed light on one of the most controversial chapters of the country’s recent history. A Discovery with a Troubling History The significance of the discovery lies largely in Syria’s past. During Bashar al-Assad’s presidency, Syria faced longstanding international allegations that it had pursued undeclared nuclear activities. Those suspicions intensified after Israel destroyed a facility in Deir al-Zour in 2007, in an airstrike that Israeli and other intelligence assessments said had targeted a covert nuclear reactor. The facility was widely suspected of having been constructed with assistance from North Korea, although Damascus denied operating a clandestine nuclear weapons program. The destruction of the Deir al-Zour site left major unanswered questions about the extent of Syria’s nuclear activities, the origin of related materials and whether other undeclared facilities existed elsewhere in the country. Those questions have now acquired renewed importance. IAEA Returns to Syria The IAEA has confirmed access to the newly identified location as part of a broader effort to investigate Syria’s historical nuclear activities and determine the origin and purpose of nuclear-related materials discovered there. IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi has said inspectors encountered a substantial quantity of nuclear material at a previously undisclosed Syrian site, describing the amount in terms of tons. The scale of the discovery makes verification particularly important. Inspectors will need to establish precisely what the material is, where it came from, how it was stored, whether it was previously declared to international authorities and what it was intended to be used for. Those questions could ultimately determine whether the discovery represents remnants of legitimate civilian activity, material associated with Syria’s former nuclear program, or evidence of activities that were never fully disclosed. For now, there is insufficient publicly available evidence to draw a definitive conclusion. The Syrian government’s position appears carefully calculated. Damascus does not want the material transferred out of the country, but neither does it appear to be rejecting international scrutiny. Instead, the government says it will retain control while allowing the IAEA to inspect and verify the material. That approach could allow Syria to demonstrate cooperation with the international community without surrendering control over potentially valuable nuclear resources. Al-Shibani has emphasized that the materials are not currently considered dangerous and that Syria is willing to place their handling under international safeguards. The government also insists that Syria has the sovereign right to pursue peaceful nuclear activities in the future. That position is likely to attract close international attention. Security Concerns Go Beyond the Nuclear Material The discovery is significant not only because of what the material may reveal about Syria’s past, but also because of the country’s current security environment. Syria remains politically fragile, while its relationship with Israel continues to be highly sensitive. Israel has historically viewed any Syrian military or nuclear capability with particular concern, especially given the two countries’ longstanding conflict and the broader regional rivalry involving Iran and other actors. The timing of the nuclear discovery is therefore particularly consequential. On 18 August 2026, Israel also carried out strikes on the Abu al-Duhur military base in northwestern Syria, an action the United States criticized as an unnecessary escalation that did little to advance regional stability. Reports of previously undisclosed nuclear materials inside Syria inevitably carry an additional security dimension. Any uncertainty surrounding the material’s origin, purpose or intended use could become a source of concern for Israel and other regional governments. What Happened During the Assad Era? Perhaps the most important question is also the most difficult to answer. Where did the material come from? The second question follows immediately: What was it intended for? And behind both lies the larger historical question: How much of Syria’s nuclear activities during the Assad era has actually been uncovered and disclosed? The IAEA’s renewed investigation could provide some of the answers. Syria is not publicly known to possess an operational nuclear weapons stockpile, and there is no established evidence that Damascus maintained a functioning nuclear arsenal. But the history of undeclared nuclear-related activities has ensured that international investigators remain skeptical of incomplete explanations. The discovery of a large quantity of nuclear material at a previously undisclosed site therefore makes full verification essential. A Test for Syria’s New Government For Syria’s new leadership, the issue represents an important test. Damascus has an opportunity to demonstrate that it is prepared to cooperate transparently with international institutions and address unresolved questions inherited from the Assad era. At the same time, the government clearly wants to avoid allowing the discovery to become an argument for foreign intervention or a challenge to Syrian sovereignty. Its current position attempts to strike that balance: the material will remain in Syria, the Syrian government will retain responsibility for it, and the IAEA will be allowed to inspect and verify it. Whether that formula will satisfy the international community remains uncertain. Ultimately, the credibility of Syria’s position will depend not on political assurances but on what international inspectors discover. If the material proves to be benign civilian material that can be fully accounted for, the controversy may gradually subside. If investigators uncover links to previously undeclared nuclear activities, however, the discovery could reopen one of the most sensitive chapters of Syria’s modern history. For now, the mystery remains. The material is there. The IAEA has access. And the most consequential questions—where it came from, why it was stored there and what it was originally intended for—remain unanswered. The investigation may determine not only what Syria inherited from the Assad era, but also how much of that legacy the new government is prepared to confront in full view of the world. items.title: Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo taageero dheeraad ah siineysa Aadan Madoobe
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka ayaa taageero hor leh siineysa Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe), tani oo lagu adkeynayo amniga iyo difaaca Magaalada Baydhabo. Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa asal ahaan taageero siyaasadeed iyo mid amni la garab joogtay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, laakiin waxa uu markan codsanaya kaalmo dheeraad, si loo xoojiyo xasilloonida iyo difaaca Baydhabo, xilli uu maamulkiisu wajahayo xiisado siyaasadeed iyo militari oo uga imanaya taageereyaasha Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen), iyadoona labada dhinac aad mooddo inay ku loolamayaan gacan ku haynta magaaladaasi. Aadan Maxamed Nuur oo maalmahaanba booqasho ku joogay Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa Arbacadii la kulmay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isagoo warbixin ka siiyay xaaladda guud ee deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed. Ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegaya in Aadan Madoobe uu Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka weydiistay in loo soo diro Saraakiil khibrad leh oo ka caawiya howlaha sugidda amniga iyo in wixii ciidamo ah ee laga maarmi karo in la keeno magaalada, isla-markaana uu Madaxweynuhu ka aqbalay codsigaas. Aadan Madoobe ayaa xalay Caasimadda Muqdisho kula kulmay Xildhibaanada Labada Aqal ee deegaan doorashadoodu tahay Koonfur Galbeed, waxaana sidoo kale kulanka ka qaybgalay Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), Gudoomiye Kuxigeenka 2aad ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow iyo Raysal Wasaare Kuxigeenka 2aad ee Xukuumadda Federaalka, Jibriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji Cabdi. “Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xaaladda guud ee ka jirta deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, horumarinta iyo xoojinta dowladnimada. Waxaa kulanka diiradda lagu saaray, sidii si wadajir ah looga shaqayn lahaa horumarka, amniga, xasilloonida iyo danta guud ee shacabka Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo la xoojinayo wada-shaqaynta iyo isku-duubnida masuuliyiinta iyo siyaasiyiinta ka soo jeeda deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed. Aadan Madoobe oo afartii sano ee u dambeysay ku magacawnaa Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Somaliya ayaa 10-kii bishii June loo doortay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Aadan Madoobe ayaa Muqdisho ka wada shirar siyaasadeed, oo uu ku xaqiijinayo taageero uu salka ugu dhigo maamulka uu hoggaamiyo. Villa Somalia ayaa weli si dhow ula shaqeynaysa maamulkiisa cusub, si looga horleexiyo caqabadaha horgudban.

items.title: Wasaarada A/Dibadda oo si weyn loogu dhalleeceeyay arrin ay maanta sameysay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa soo saartay war-saxaafadeed ay ku sheegtay inay si weyn uga xun tahay burbur ka dhacay goob macdanta dahabka laga qodo oo ku taalla tuulada Zamboye ee galbeedka Jamhuuriyadda Afrikada Dhexe. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in burburkaasi ay ku dhinteen in ka badan boqol qof, halka dad kalena weli la la’yahay. Wasaaradda ayaa iyadoo ku hadlaysa magaca dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, tacsi tiiraanyo leh u dirtay dowladda iyo shacabka Jamhuuriyadda Afrikada Dhexe, gaar ahaan qoysaska ay ka geeriyoodeen qaar ka mid ah eheladooda. “Iyadoo labada dal ay yihiin xubno ka wada tirsan Midowga Afrika, dowladda Soomaaliya waxay garab taagan tahay Jamhuuriyadda Afrikada Dhexe xilligan adag ee murugada leh, waxayna u muujinaysaa garab-istaag dadka ku dhaawacmay iyo dhammaan kuwa ku hawlan gurmadka socda,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka wasaaradda. Intaas kaddib, war-saxaafadeedka ayaa la kulmay dhaleeceyn xooggan oo uga timid qaar ka mid ah bulshada Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo dowladda ku canaantay sida ay uga tacsiyeyn dhibaatooyinka gudaheeda ee sababa dhimashada. Inkastoo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ay dowladda Soomaaliya u qaabilsan tahay xiriirrada dibadda, haddana shacabka ayaa si aan caadi ahayn uga falceliyay tallaabadan, iyagoo su’aalo ka keenay mudnaanta ay dowladdu siisay tacsi loo diray dal shisheeye xilli dalka gudihiisa ay ka dhacayaan dhacdooyin sababa dhimashada dad Soomaaliyeed. Falcelinta shacabka ayaa si weyn ugu baaqday in dowladda ay sidoo kale si la mid ah uga hadasho, uga tacsiyeeyso, ugana damqato dhibaatooyinka iyo khasaaraha ka dhaca gudaha Soomaaliya. Cabdullaahi Cabdicasiis ayaa yiri: “Dadka Soomaaliyeed ee meelwalba ku dhibaataysan maad ka hadashaan ama ka tacsiyeysan intaydan Central Africa isku qaadin.” “Dilka dhalinyarada reer Koonfur Afrika wax ka hadlaayo ma aragteen,” ayuu yiri Maxamed Aamiin Garaad oo kamid ah dadka ka falceliyay war-saxaafadeedka wasaaradda oo lasoo dhigay barteeda Facebook. Mahad Jakarta: “Wasaaradii tacsiyo iyo hambalyeyn miyey u sameysan tahay waa yaabe. War kuwaan miyeynan xilkas ahayn, miyaanan lala xisaabtameyn.” Maxamed Jiinow Xasan ayaa isna waxa uu yiri: “Kuwa Turkiga uu Puntland ku layaay tacsi uma bahno miyaa, Afrikantaas ayaa ka naxsan tihiin.” Si kastaba, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa waxay u aragtaa tacsi u dirista dalalka ay Soomaaliya xiriirka la leedahay inay ka mid tahay waajibaadka diblomaasiyadeed, maadaama Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Afrikada Dhexe ay labaduba xubin ka yihiin Midowga Afrika, ayna leeyihiin xiriir rasmi ah. The post Wasaarada A/Dibadda oo si weyn loogu dhalleeceeyay arrin ay maanta sameysay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: A fuel Tanker Seized in the Gulf of Aden
items.description: Mogadishu ( WDN) — A fuel tanker has reportedly been seized in the Gulf of Aden after six-armed men boarded the vessel and took control of its movement, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), raising fresh concerns over maritime security along one of the world’s most strategically important shipping routes. UKMTO said the incident occurred approximately 136 nautical miles east of Al Mukalla, Yemen, after the tanker reported an emergency situation when an unauthorized boat approached the vessel. In an updated advisory, UKMTO said six-armed individuals subsequently boarded the tanker and took control of the ship, directing it toward the Somali coast. Authorities are investigating the incident. The identity of the vessel has not yet been disclosed. Its name, flag, cargo and the precise condition of its crew remain unknown. A New Maritime Security Concern The incident is particularly significant because the Gulf of Aden is a critical maritime corridor linking the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean. Thousands of commercial vessels pass through the region each year, making the security of the waterway vital to international trade and energy supplies. The reported seizure also comes amid renewed concerns over piracy and armed attacks in waters off Somalia and Yemen. Maritime security organizations have recorded a series of recent incidents involving commercial vessels in the wider region, suggesting that the threat to shipping has not disappeared despite years of international naval patrols and counter-piracy operations. A recent UKMTO update indicated that four commercial vessels remain in the hands of hijacking groups, including MT Honour 25, MV Sward, MT Eureka and MT Asana. The latest incident therefore adds to an increasingly troubling maritime-security picture along the Somali coast and the Gulf of Aden. One important detail remains unresolved. UKMTO has not identified the attackers as Somali pirates. The agency has described them only as six-armed men who boarded and took control of the vessel. Their nationality, affiliation and motives have not been officially established. That distinction is important. Although the waters around Somalia have experienced a resurgence of piracy, it would be premature to attribute this particular incident to Somali pirates without confirmation from maritime authorities or other reliable sources. The attackers could potentially be linked to piracy networks, criminal groups or another armed organization operating in the region. At this stage, however, there is insufficient information to determine who they are or what they intend to do with the vessel. The Somalia Connection The reported decision to steer the tanker toward Somalia is nevertheless likely to attract considerable attention. Somalia’s long coastline has historically provided opportunities for pirate groups to hide hijacked vessels and hold crews while negotiating ransom demands. Recent incidents involving vessels seized in the region have revived concerns that criminal networks may once again be attempting to exploit gaps in maritime security. The reported movement of the tanker toward Somalia could therefore become a critical element of the investigation. Authorities will need to establish whether the vessel is being taken toward a known piracy area, whether the attackers intend to demand a ransom, and whether the incident is connected to other recent hijackings. For shipping companies, the incident represents another reminder that maritime security risks remain unpredictable. The Gulf of Aden has already been affected by multiple security threats in recent years, including piracy, attacks on commercial shipping and wider regional instability. The latest seizure demonstrates how quickly a vessel can move from a routine commercial voyage to a potentially dangerous hostage situation. Until the identities and intentions of the armed men are established, maritime authorities are likely to urge commercial operators to maintain heightened vigilance, particularly when operating near the Somali coastline and other areas considered vulnerable to armed boarding attempts. For now, the most important questions remain unanswered: Who are the six-armed men? Why did they seize the tanker? Where are they taking it—and what will happen to the crew? The answers could determine whether this was an isolated criminal incident or another indication of a broader resurgence of maritime insecurity in the waters surrounding Somalia and the Gulf of Aden. Intaas kadib, Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdulle (Jaabiri) ayaa guddoomiyaha iyo xubnaha kale ee guddiga la wadaagay warbixin ku saabsan hindise-sharciyeedyada horyaalla guddiyada golaha. Xoghayaha ayaa sidoo kale ka warbixiyay hindise-sharciyeedyadii soo maray akhrinnada kala duwan, iyadoo guddoomiyeyaasha guddiyada laga dhageystay warbixinno ku saabsan shuruucda ay gacanta ku hayaan iyo marxaladaha ay marayaan. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu eegay jadwalka loo qorsheeyay in hindise-sharciyeedyada iyo shuruucda ay guddiyadu gacanta ku hayaan loo horgeeyo kulamada Golaha Shacabka, si loo sii ambaqaado howlaha sharci-dejinta. Guddoomiye Jaamac oo kulanka soo xiray ayaa xubnaha Guddiga Joogtada ah kula dardaarmay inay ka shaqeeyaan midnimada iyo wadajirka golaha, si uu u guto waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah, isagoo ballanqaaday in golaha uu ku hoggaamin doono si waafaqsan xeer-hoosaadka iyo shuruucda u degsan. items.title: Somalia ex- FM Accuses  Turkey  Of Massacre
items.description: Somalia’s former Foreign Minister Abdisaed Muse Ali is accusing Turkey of carrying out a “massacre” after a reported drone strike near Garmaal in Puntland killed four Somali men. Initial local reports described the dead as suspected pirates linked to the hijacking of the cargo vessel Lutuf. But that account is now being challenged by residents, who say the four were innocent fishermen with no connection to piracy. Puntland authorities have yet to publicly clarify who the men were, while Turkey has not acknowledged carrying out the strike or responded to the civilian-casualty accusations. Ali accused Ankara of injecting “brutal aggression” into Somali politics and also blasted Puntland’s leadership for remaining over the deaths. Source: Somali Guardian

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Dayniile oo ku guuleystay abaal-marinta Somali Leadership Awards 2026
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Degmada Dayniile, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Macallin Xuseen, ayaa ku guuleystay Somali Leadership Awards 2026 – Special Leadership Award (SLA Winner 2026), taas oo lagu maamuusay hoggaamintiisa, dadaallada horumarineed iyo adeegyada uu u fidiyo bulshada degmada. Abaalmarintan ayaa loo arkaa aqoonsi loo sameeyay dadaallada maamulka Degmada Dayniile ee dhinacyada horumarinta deegaanka, bilicda degmada, nadaafadda, amniga iyo xoojinta adeegyada bulshada. Guusha Guddoomiyaha ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Degmada Dayniile ay ka socdaan dadaallo lagu horumarinayo bilicda iyo adeegyada aasaasiga ah, iyadoo maamulka degmada uu xoogga saarayo sidii shacabka loogu abuuri lahaa deegaan ammaan ah, nadiif ah oo leh adeegyo muhiim u ah bulshada. Guddoomiyaha Degmada Dayniile ayaa sheegay in abaalmarinta uusan u arkin mid isaga ku kooban, balse ay tahay guul ay wada leeyihiin shacabka degmada, kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay door muhiim ah ka qaataan dadaallada horumarineed. “Guushan waxay ii tahay sharaf weyn, balse waxaan u arkaa inay tahay guul u soo hoyatay Degmada Dayniile iyo shacabkeeda. Waxaan sii wadi doonnaa dadaalka, hoggaanka hufan iyo adeegga shacabka, si aan u gaarno horumar iyo guulo ka waaweyn kuwa maanta,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiyaha. Mid ka mid ah meelaha maamulka Degmada Dayniile uu mudnaanta siinayo ayaa ah nadaafadda iyo bilicda deegaanka, kuwaas oo muhiim u ah caafimaadka bulshada iyo muuqaalka caasimadda Muqdisho. Dadaallada maamulka ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa wacyigelinta bulshada, hagaajinta goobaha dadweynaha, nadaafadda waddooyinka iyo suuqyada, iyo ka hortagga qashinka lagu daadiyo goobaha aan loogu talagelin. Maamulka ayaa sidoo kale xoogga saaraya sidii bulshada loogu dhiirrigelin lahaa inay si toos ah uga qaybqaataan ilaalinta deegaanka ay ku nool yihiin. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda amniga shacabka, isaga oo tilmaamay in amni la’aan aysan suurtagal noqon karin in la gaaro horumar waara. Degmooyinka caasimadda Muqdisho ayaa door muhiim ah ku leh xasilloonida magaalada, waxaana muhiim ah in maamulka hoose, hay’adaha amniga iyo bulshada ay si dhow uga wada shaqeeyaan sugidda amniga iyo xal u helidda caqabadaha ka jira deegaanka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa xusay in wada-shaqeynta shacabka iyo laamaha amniga ay muhiim u tahay dhismaha deegaan nabdoon oo ay bulshadu si wanaagsan ugu noolaan karto. Maamulka Degmada Dayniile ayaa aaminsan in horumar waara aan lagu gaari karin dadaal dowladeed oo keliya, balse uu u baahan yahay iskaashi dhex mara maamulka, shacabka, ganacsatada, dhalinyarada iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Abaalmarinta la guddoonsiiyay Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidaas darteed loo arki karaa dhiirrigelin ku wajahan sii wadidda dadaallada lagu horumarinayo adeegyada bulshada iyo deegaanka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in guusha uu helay ay si weyn ugu xiran tahay taageerada iyo ka qaybqaadashada shacabka Dayniile. Abaalmarinta Somali Leadership Awards 2026 – Special Leadership Award ayaa noqonaysa dhiirrigelin cusub oo ku aaddan shaqada maamulka Degmada Dayniile, iyadoo Guddoomiyuhu caddeeyay in aqoonsigan uusan noqon doonin meel lagu soo afjaro dadaallada, balse uu noqon doono sabab loo sii xoojiyo adeegga shacabka. Waxa uu ballanqaaday in maamulka degmada uu sii wadi doono dadaallada ku aaddan amniga, nadaafadda, bilicda, adeegyada bulshada, midnimada iyo horumarka degmada. Guushan ayaa sidoo kale iftiiminaysa doorka muhiimka ah ee hoggaanka degmooyinku ku leeyihiin horumarinta magaalooyinka iyo adeegyada maalinlaha ah ee shacabka. Iyadoo Degmada Dayniile ay wajahdo baahiyo iyo caqabado dhinacyada adeegyada aasaasiga ah, nadaafadda, amniga iyo kaabayaasha bulshada, ayaa laga sugayaa in aqoonsigan cusub loo beddelo dadaallo dheeraad ah oo si toos ah uga faa’iideeya shacabka. Guusha Guddoomiyaha Degmada Dayniile ee Somali Leadership Awards 2026 ayaa sidaas ku noqotay bog cusub oo dhiirrigelin u ah maamulka iyo shacabka degmada, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo in guusha abaalmarinta laga dhigo mid horseedda waxqabad iyo horumar muuqda. items.title: Madaxweynaha oo waftiyo u diray  bariga dalka  oo u kuur galaaya xaalada
items.description: Wefti uu hoggaamijayo Wasiirka Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Khadar Xuseen Cabdi oo ay weheliyaan Agaasimayaal Guud, Guddoomiyeyaal iyo masuuliyiin kala duwan, ayaa safar shaqo ku jooga magaalada Burco ee xarunta Gobolka Together. Wasiirka iyo weftigiisa, waxay xalay kulan la qaateen qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada Togdheer, kuwaasi oo iska xog-waraystay xaaladaha Gobolka Togdheer. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada ayaa ka qaybgelaya xafladda qallin-jabinta Jaamacadda Burco oo ay maanta ku beegan tahay qallin-jabinteedu. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada JSL Khadar Xuseen Cabdi, ayaa la filayaa inuu gelinka dambe ee maanta safar ugu baxo magaalada Oodweyne ee xarunta Gobolka Daad-madheedh. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada iyo weftiga la socda, ayaa la filayaa inay mashaariic cusub ka dhagax-dhigaan Gobolka Daad-madheedh, isla markaana ay shirar la qaataan hal-doorka bulshada reer Daad-madheedh. Geesta kale, wefti ka socda Xukuumadda JSL ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyey ku sugnaa Gobolka Sanaag, waxayna shirar la qaateen qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada Gobolka Sanaag. Weftiyadan ka socda Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee ku sugan Gobolada Bariga, ayaa qayb ka ah dedaalada ay Xukuumadda Madaxweyne Cirro ugu jirto horumarka dalka iyo sidii bulshada looga xog-waraysan lahaa baahiyaha degaannada ay ku nool yihiin.

items.title: Iiraan oo dil toogasho ah ku fulisay nin ajnabi ah oo lagu helay…
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Iiraan ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay fulisay xukun dil ah oo lagu riday nin ay ku sheegtay muwaadin ajnabi ah, kaas oo lagu eedeeyay inuu door ku lahaa dibadbaxyo rabshado wata oo bishii Janaayo ka dhacay magaalada Isfahan. Ninka la dilay ayaa lagu magacaabi jiray Ghaem Hosseini oo sidoo kale loo yaqaanay “Arian”, waxaana dowladda Iiraan ay ku eedeysay inuu ku lug lahaa falal ay ku sheegtay inay khatar ku yihiin amniga qaranka iyo nabadgelyada guud. Hay’adda wararka Tasnim oo xiriir dhow la leh dowladda Iiraan ayaa sheegtay in Hosseini lagu helay dambiyo la xiriira rabshadihii ka dhacay magaalada Isfahan, iyadoo garsoorka dalka uu sheegay in ninkaasi ahaa “muwaadin ajnabi ah”, balse lama shaacin dalkii uu u dhashay. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinnada rasmiga ah, dacwadda lagu soo oogay Hosseini waxay la xiriirtay “ku lug lahaanshaha dembiga ka dhacay Fagaaraha Alikhani ee Isfahan”, halkaas oo ay ka dhaceen dibadbaxyo iyo iska horimaadyo u dhexeeyay dibadbaxayaasha iyo ciidamada ammaanka. Eedaha loo jeediyay waxaa sidoo kale ka mid ahaa hub la bixid iyo cabsi gelin, abuurista amni-darro guud iyo mid baahsan iyo falal ay dowladda ku tilmaantay kuwo ka dhan ah badqabka jireed ee dadka iyo amniga qaranka. Ghaem Hosseini ayaa sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta dowladda, lagu eedeeyay inuu door ku lahaa dilka afar askari oo ka tirsanaa ciidamada booliska Iiraan. Wakaaladda wararka Mizan ayaa xustay in intii uu socday baaritaanka uu qirtay inuu joogay mudaaharaadyadii ka dhacay Fagaaraha Alikhani, isla markaana uu watay hub. Xukunka dilka ah ayaa la fuliyay kaddib markii kiiska Hosseini uu soo maray nidaamka maxkamadaha Iiraan. Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka ayaa dib u eegtay kiiska kaddib markii racfaan laga qaatay xukunka, balse ugu dambeyn waxay ansixisay go’aankii maxkamadda hoose. Hosseini ma ahayn qofka keliya ee kiiskan lala xiriiriyay. Warbaahinta dowladda ayaa sheegtay in Abolfazl Sepahi, Amir Hossein Safari, Erfan Esfandiari iyo Gol Mohammad Mohammadi horay loogu fuliyay xukuno dil ah oo la xiriira isla kiiska. Sidoo kale, Shervin Bagherian, Amir Hossein Maleki iyo Alireza Sepahi ayaa lagu helay dambiyo la xiriira dhacdooyinkii ka dhacay Fagaaraha Alikhani, sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta dowladda. Dowladda Iiraan ayaa dhacdooyinkaas ku tilmaantay falal rabshado wata oo khatar ku ahaa amniga, halka dhinacyada kale ay muddo dheer dhaliil ka muujinayeen sida dowladda Iiraan ula dhaqanto dadka lagu soo eedeeyo inay ku lug leeyihiin dibadbaxyada. Fulinta xukunka Ghaem Hosseini ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli si weyn loo kordhiyay fulinta xukunnada dilka ah ee Iiraan, gaar ahaan kaddib markii uu billowday dagaalka u dhexeeya Iiraan, Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil 28-kii Febraayo. Garsoorka Iiraan ayaa tan iyo markaas xukunno dil ah ku fuliyay tobannaan qof oo lagu soo oogay eedo kala duwan, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin basaasnimo iyo la-shaqeynta Mareykanka ama Israa’iil. Waxaa sidoo kale xukunno dil ah lagu fuliyay qaar ka mid ah dadka lagu xiray dibadbaxyadii ka dhacay qeybo badan oo dalka ah bishii December, iyadoo dowladda ay sheegtay in dadkaasi ku lug lahaayeen falal amni-darro iyo rabshado. Xukunka lagu fuliyay Ghaem Hosseini ayaa mar kale soo jiitay dareenka ku aaddan sida Iiraan ula macaamisho dadka lagu eedeeyo dambiyada amniga qaranka, gaar ahaan kuwa lala xiriiriyo dibadbaxyada. Dowladda ayaa ku adkeysanaysa in kiisaska noocan ah loo maray hannaan maxkamadeed, halka dhaleeceeyayaashu ay walaac ka muujiyaan adeegsiga xukunka dilka ee kiisaska siyaasadeed iyo kuwa la xiriira mudaharaadyada. Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka ayaa dib u eegtay kiiska kaddib markii racfaan laga qaatay xukunka, balse ugu dambeyn waxay ansixisay go’aankii maxkamadda hoose. Hosseini ma ahayn qofka keliya ee kiiskan lala xiriiriyay. Warbaahinta dowladda ayaa sheegtay in Abolfazl Sepahi, Amir Hossein Safari, Erfan Esfandiari iyo Gol Mohammad Mohammadi horay loogu fuliyay xukuno dil ah oo la xiriira isla kiiska. Sidoo kale, Shervin Bagherian, Amir Hossein Maleki iyo Alireza Sepahi ayaa lagu helay dambiyo la xiriira dhacdooyinkii ka dhacay Fagaaraha Alikhani, sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta dowladda. Dowladda Iiraan ayaa dhacdooyinkaas ku tilmaantay falal rabshado wata oo khatar ku ahaa amniga, halka dhinacyada kale ay muddo dheer dhaliil ka muujinayeen sida dowladda Iiraan ula dhaqanto dadka lagu soo eedeeyo inay ku lug leeyihiin dibadbaxyada. Fulinta xukunka Ghaem Hosseini ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli si weyn loo kordhiyay fulinta xukunnada dilka ah ee Iiraan, gaar ahaan kaddib markii uu billowday dagaalka u dhexeeya Iiraan, Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil 28-kii Febraayo. Garsoorka Iiraan ayaa tan iyo markaas xukunno dil ah ku fuliyay tobannaan qof oo lagu soo oogay eedo kala duwan, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin basaasnimo iyo la-shaqeynta Mareykanka ama Israa’iil. Waxaa sidoo kale xukunno dil ah lagu fuliyay qaar ka mid ah dadka lagu xiray dibadbaxyadii ka dhacay qeybo badan oo dalka ah bishii December, iyadoo dowladda ay sheegtay in dadkaasi ku lug lahaayeen falal amni-darro iyo rabshado. Xukunka lagu fuliyay Ghaem Hosseini ayaa mar kale soo jiitay dareenka ku aaddan sida Iiraan ula macaamisho dadka lagu eedeeyo dambiyada amniga qaranka, gaar ahaan kuwa lala xiriiriyo dibadbaxyada. Dowladda ayaa ku adkeysanaysa in kiisaska noocan ah loo maray hannaan maxkamadeed, halka dhaleeceeyayaashu ay walaac ka muujiyaan adeegsiga xukunka dilka ee kiisaska siyaasadeed iyo kuwa la xiriira mudaharaadyada. items.title: Dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya oo 3.1% Kordhay
items.description: Muqdisho, 20 Agoosto 2026 — Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa kulankoodii toddobaadlaha ahaa ku yeeshay Muqdisho, iyadoo kulanka lagu soo bandhigay warbixinno la xiriira dhaqaalaha, amniga iyo difaaca dalka. Kulanka oo uu shir-guddoomiyay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa si gaar ah looga dhageystay Wasaaradda Maaliyadda warbixin ku saabsan xisaab-xirka sanadeedka 2025, horumarinta dhaqaalaha, kordhinta canshuuraha gudaha iyo dib-u-habaynta nidaamka maaliyadeed ee dowladda. Warbixinta Wasaaradda Maaliyadda ayaa lagu sheegay in dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya uu kordhay 3.1 boqolkiiba, iyadoo kobacaas lagu cabbiray halbeegga wax-soo-saarka guud ee dalka (GDP). Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa sheegay in muhiimad gaar ah ay leedahay in Soomaaliya gaarto isku-filnaansho dhaqaale, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo kordhinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha, ka faa’iidaysiga khayraadka dalka, kobcinta dakhliga gudaha iyo dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leeyihiin daah-furnaanta maaliyadeed, isla-xisaabtanka iyo ilaalinta hantida dowladda. Dhanka kale, Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa ammaanay Wasaaradda Maaliyadda, kaddib qiimeyn uu sameeyay Xafiiska Hanti-dhowrka Guud oo, sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, Wasaaradda siiyay qiimeynta “Aragti Nadiif ah”, taas oo lagu tilmaamay heerka ugu sarreeya ee qiimeynta hufnaanta maaliyadeed. Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa sidoo kale lagu wargeliyay xaaladda amniga dalka iyo howlgalladii ugu dambeeyay ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, iyadoo dowladda sheegtay in ciidamada ay horumar ka sameeyeen goobaha dagaalka isla markaana ay khasaarooyin gaarsiiyeen kooxda Al-Shabaab. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa ugu dambeyn sheegay in dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya uu si tartiib ah uga soo kabanayo caqabadihii hore, isagoo xusay in dowladda ay hiigsanayso in dalka uu mustaqbalka gaaro isku-filnaansho dhaqaale oo yareeya ku-tiirsanaanta kaalmada dibadda.

items.title: Maxay ka dhigan tahay in Xasan Sheekh uu aqoonsiga ka guddoomo safiirro aan….?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa shalay waraaqaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay toddobo safiir , kuwaas oo intooda badan aan safaarado ku lahayn Muqdisho, balse Soomaaliya uga wakiil ah safaaradahooda ku yaalla dalal kale oo gobolka ah. Marka hore, tani waxay u muuqan kartaa arrin diblomaasiyadeed oo caadi ah, balse marka si dhow loo eego waxay xambaarsan tahay fariin ka weyn xafladda waraaqaha aqoonsiga. Dal marka uu safiir u magacaabo Soomaaliya, xitaa haddii safiirkaasi uusan Muqdisho deggenayn, wuxuu si rasmi ah u muujinayaa in uu aqoonsan yahay muhiimadda xiriirka uu la leeyahay dowladda Soomaaliya. Safiir aan deggenayn muxuu yahay? Safiirrada shalay waraaqaha aqoonsiga looga guddoomay Villa Soomaaliya intooda badan waa safiirro aan Soomaaliya deggenayn, kuwaas oo diblomaasiyadda loogu yeero “non-resident ambassadors” . Waxay Soomaaliya uga shaqeeyaan safaarad ku taalla dal kale, iyadoo ay xilalkooda ku jiraan dhowr dal. Tusaale ahaan, safiirka Brazil u fadhiya Kenya, João Alfredo dos Anjos Junior ayaa sidoo kale loo aqoonsan yahay Soomaaliya iyo dalal kale. Sidoo kale, safiirka Hindiya ee Kenya, Dr. Adarsh Swaika ayaa Soomaaliya loo magacaabay, halka safiirka Mali uu fadhigiisu yahay Itoobiya, haddana uu Soomaaliya ka yahay wakiil diblomaasiyadeed. Qaabkan wuxuu dalalka u fududeeyaa inay xiriir rasmi ah la yeeshaan Soomaaliya, iyagoo aan kharashka iyo mas’uuliyadda ku bixin furitaanka safaarad joogto ah. Sidaas darteed, aqoonsiga safiirku waa tallaabo diblomaasiyadeed oo rasmi ah, balse ma laha isla heerka joogitaanka maalinlaha ah ee safaarad Muqdisho ku taalla. Maxay tani uga dhigan tahay Soomaaliya? Dhinaca Soomaaliya, magacaabista safiirrada noocan ah waxay ka dhigan tahay in Muqdisho ay sii haysato xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo firfircoon oo ay la leedahay dalal ku kala yaalla qaarado kala duwan, inkastoo aysan dalalkaasi Muqdisho ku lahayn joogitaan rasmi ah. Inkastoo arrintan laga fahmi karo in dalalkaasi aysan doonayn inay Soomaaliya ka maqnaadaan marka laga hadlayo arrimaha siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha, amniga iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah, haddana waxay sidoo kale muujinaysaa heerka muhiimad ee Soomaaliya ay u leedahay dalalkaasi. Xitaa haddii safiirkoodu Nairobi, Addis Ababa ama Jabuuti ka shaqeeyo, dowladda Soomaaliya ugu yaraan waxay weli leedahay marin rasmi ah oo ay kula xiriirto dowladahaas. Si kastaba, waxaa muhiim ah in aan la isku khaldin aqoonsiga safiir aan deggenayn iyo furitaanka safaarad. Labaduba waa xiriir diblomaasiyadeed, laakiin heerka joogitaanka iyo awoodda ay ku leeyihiin Muqdisho way kala duwan yihiin. Aljeeriya oo ka duwan lixda dal ee kale Arrinta ugu muuqata ee liiskan ku jirta waa safiirka Aljeeriya, Mohamed Alim. Sababtu waa in Aljeeriya ay waddo dib-u-furista safaaraddeeda Muqdisho, taasoo ka dhigaysa xaaladdeeda mid ka duwan tan safiirrada kale ee waraaqaha aqoonsiga laga guddoomay. Haddii safaaradda Aljeeriya dib uga howlgasho Muqdisho, xiriirka labada dal wuxuu yeelan karaa joogitaan diblomaasiyadeed oo toos ah. Taasi waxay fududeyn kartaa in labada dowladood ay si joogto ah uga wada shaqeeyaan arrimaha siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha, waxbarashada iyo amniga. Dib-u-furista safaaraddu waxay sidoo kale leedahay qiime siyaasadeed. Safaarad joogto ah waxay dal u oggolaanaysaa inuu si dhow ula socdo xaaladda dalka uu xiriirka la leeyahay, isla markaana uu si degdeg ah uga jawaabo isbeddellada siyaasadeed iyo arrimaha quseeya muwaadiniintiisa. Sababta dalalku safaaradaha ugu hayn waayaan Muqdisho Su’aasha kale ee muhiimka ahi waa sababta toddobada safiir ee la aqoonsaday ay intooda badan uga shaqeynayaan dalal kale. Arrintan waxaa saameyn kara dhowr arrimood oo ay ka mid yihiin kharashka hawlgalka safaarad, baaxadda xiriirka labada dal iyo qiimeynta xaaladda amni. Dalalka qaar waxay door bidaan inay hal safaarad oo gobolka ku taalla ka maamulaan dhowr dal. Kenya iyo Itoobiya ayaa labaduba noqday xarumo muhiim u ah diblomaasiyadda gobolka, waxaana safiirro badan oo u fadhiya dalalkaas loo aqoonsadaa Soomaaliya. Tani macnaheedu ma aha in dalalkaasi aysan dan ka lahayn Soomaaliya. Mararka qaar waxay ka tarjumaysaa habka ay dowladdu u maamusho kheyraadkeeda diblomaasiyadeed iyo sida ay u kala mudnaanta siiso dalalka ay xiriirka la leedahay. Maxaa ka dhalan kara joogitaanka diblomaasiyadeed? Safiir aan Muqdisho deggenayn wuxuu awood u leeyahay inuu si rasmi ah u metelo dalkiisa, balse joogitaan la’aanta magaalada waxay xaddidi kartaa xiriirka joogtada ah ee maalinlaha ah. Safaarad joogto ah waxay si toos ah ula falgeli kartaa wasaaradaha, hay’adaha dowladda, ganacsatada iyo bulshada rayidka ah. Tani waxay Soomaaliya ka dhigaysaa inay dan gaar ah ka yeelato soo jiidashada dalal badan oo doonaya inay safaarado ka furtaan Muqdisho. Haddii xaaladda amni iyo tan dhaqaale ay sii hagaagaan, waxaa suuragal ah in qaar ka mid ah safaaradaha ku shaqeeya qaabka aan deggenayn ay mustaqbalka dib ugu soo laabtaan Muqdisho. Arrintaas ayaa muhiim u noqon karta Soomaaliya, maadaama safaaraduhu aysan ahayn oo keliya xafiisyo siyaasadeed. Waxay sidoo kale noqdaan xarumo fududeeya ganacsiga, maalgashiga, deeqaha, waxbarashada iyo xiriirka shacabka. Si kastaba, in toddobo safiir hal mar waraaqahooda aqoonsiga looga guddoomo Muqdisho waxay sidoo kale muujinaysaa in caasimadda Soomaaliya ay weli tahay xarunta rasmiga ah ee xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee dalka. Xitaa safiirrada aan dalka deggenayn waxaa waajib ku ah inay aqoonsigooda u gudbiyaan madaxda dowladda Soomaaliya. Tani waxay muhiim u tahay muuqaalka dowladda federaalka ee caalamka. Safiirku marka uu waraaqaha aqoonsiga u gudbinayo Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya wuxuu si rasmi ah ula macaamilayaa dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, dowladda Soomaaliya waa inay fursaddan uga faa’iideysataa xiriirro wax-ku-ool ah oo ka baxsan xafladaha diblomaasiyadda. Waraaqaha aqoonsigu waa bilow, halka qiimaha dhabta ah ee xiriirku uu ku xirnaan doono waxa labada dhinac ka qabtaan kadib. Xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo loo baahan yahay in la dhaqaajiyo Brazil, Hindiya, Mali, Myanmar, Nigeria iyo Pakistan waa dalal leh awood, khibrad iyo xiriirro caalami ah oo Soomaaliya wax uga tari kara dhinacyo kala duwan. Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay inay xiriirradaas u beddesho iskaashi la taaban karo. Hindiya waxay leedahay khibrad dhinacyada waxbarashada, caafimaadka, tiknoolajiyadda iyo ganacsiga. Brazil waxay Soomaaliya la yeelan kartaa iskaashi ku saabsan beeraha, wax-soo-saarka iyo khibradaha horumarineed. Pakistan-na waxay horey uga muuqataa dhinaca iskaashiga difaaca iyo tababarka ciidamada. Sidoo kale, Nigeria, Mali iyo Myanmar waxay noqon karaan dhinacyo Soomaaliya kala shaqeyn kara arrimo kala duwan oo ku xiran danaha labada dal. Sidaas darteed, safiirro badan oo loo aqoonsado Soomaaliya waxay noqon karaan fursad diblomaasiyadeed oo la adeegsan karo, haddii dowladda ay si qorsheysan u dhaqaajiso xiriirradaas. Ugu dambeyn, in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu waraaqaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay safiirro aan badankood Soomaaliya ku lahayn safaarado joogto ah waxay muujinaysaa laba xaqiiqo. Midda koowaad waa in Soomaaliya weli leedahay xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo ballaaran; tan labaadna waa in joogitaanka diblomaasiyadeed ee Muqdisho uusan weli la jaanqaadin tirada xiriirrada rasmiga ah ee dalka. Aljeeriya oo waddo dib-u-furista safaaraddeeda waxay noqon kartaa tusaale muujinaya jihada mustaqbalka. Haddii amniga, siyaasadda iyo jawiga maalgashiga ay sii hagaagaan, dalal kale ayaa laga yaabaa inay dib u qiimeeyaan joogitaankooda Muqdisho. Sidaas darteed, xafladda shalay ma ahayn oo keliya in Madaxweynaha loo gudbiyo waraaqo aqoonsi, waxay ahayd sawir muujinaya sida Soomaaliya loogu soo laabanayo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee gobolka iyo dunida, iyadoo weli ay taagan tahay su’aasha ah goorta safiirrada badan ee la aqoonsaday ay Muqdisho ka dhigan doonaan xarunta joogtada ah ee shaqadooda. Haddii xiriirradaas loo beddelo safaarado, maalgashi iyo iskaashi muuqda, Soomaaliya waxay ka faa’iideysan kartaa furitaanka cusub ee diblomaasiyadeed ee hadda muuqda.
