Dalalka qaar waxay door bidaan inay hal safaarad oo gobolka ku taalla ka maamulaan dhowr dal. Kenya iyo Itoobiya ayaa labaduba noqday xarumo muhiim u ah diblomaasiyadda gobolka, waxaana safiirro badan oo u fadhiya dalalkaas loo aqoonsadaa Soomaaliya. Tani macnaheedu ma aha in dalalkaasi aysan dan ka lahayn Soomaaliya. Mararka qaar waxay ka tarjumaysaa habka ay dowladdu u maamusho kheyraadkeeda diblomaasiyadeed iyo sida ay u kala mudnaanta siiso dalalka ay xiriirka la leedahay. Maxaa ka dhalan kara joogitaanka diblomaasiyadeed? Safiir aan Muqdisho deggenayn wuxuu awood u leeyahay inuu si rasmi ah u metelo dalkiisa, balse joogitaan la’aanta magaalada waxay xaddidi kartaa xiriirka joogtada ah ee maalinlaha ah. Safaarad joogto ah waxay si toos ah ula falgeli kartaa wasaaradaha, hay’adaha dowladda, ganacsatada iyo bulshada rayidka ah. Tani waxay Soomaaliya ka dhigaysaa inay dan gaar ah ka yeelato soo jiidashada dalal badan oo doonaya inay safaarado ka furtaan Muqdisho. Haddii xaaladda amni iyo tan dhaqaale ay sii hagaagaan, waxaa suuragal ah in qaar ka mid ah safaaradaha ku shaqeeya qaabka aan deggenayn ay mustaqbalka dib ugu soo laabtaan Muqdisho. Arrintaas ayaa muhiim u noqon karta Soomaaliya, maadaama safaaraduhu aysan ahayn oo keliya xafiisyo siyaasadeed. Waxay sidoo kale noqdaan xarumo fududeeya ganacsiga, maalgashiga, deeqaha, waxbarashada iyo xiriirka shacabka. Si kastaba, in toddobo safiir hal mar waraaqahooda aqoonsiga looga guddoomo Muqdisho waxay sidoo kale muujinaysaa in caasimadda Soomaaliya ay weli tahay xarunta rasmiga ah ee xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee dalka. Xitaa safiirrada aan dalka deggenayn waxaa waajib ku ah inay aqoonsigooda u gudbiyaan madaxda dowladda Soomaaliya. Tani waxay muhiim u tahay muuqaalka dowladda federaalka ee caalamka. Safiirku marka uu waraaqaha aqoonsiga u gudbinayo Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya wuxuu si rasmi ah ula macaamilayaa dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, dowladda Soomaaliya waa inay fursaddan uga faa’iideysataa xiriirro wax-ku-ool ah oo ka baxsan xafladaha diblomaasiyadda. Waraaqaha aqoonsigu waa bilow, halka qiimaha dhabta ah ee xiriirku uu ku xirnaan doono waxa labada dhinac ka qabtaan kadib. Xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo loo baahan yahay in la dhaqaajiyo Brazil, Hindiya, Mali, Myanmar, Nigeria iyo Pakistan waa dalal leh awood, khibrad iyo xiriirro caalami ah oo Soomaaliya wax uga tari kara dhinacyo kala duwan. Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay inay xiriirradaas u beddesho iskaashi la taaban karo. Hindiya waxay leedahay khibrad dhinacyada waxbarashada, caafimaadka, tiknoolajiyadda iyo ganacsiga. Brazil waxay Soomaaliya la yeelan kartaa iskaashi ku saabsan beeraha, wax-soo-saarka iyo khibradaha horumarineed. Pakistan-na waxay horey uga muuqataa dhinaca iskaashiga difaaca iyo tababarka ciidamada. Sidoo kale, Nigeria, Mali iyo Myanmar waxay noqon karaan dhinacyo Soomaaliya kala shaqeyn kara arrimo kala duwan oo ku xiran danaha labada dal. Sidaas darteed, safiirro badan oo loo aqoonsado Soomaaliya waxay noqon karaan fursad diblomaasiyadeed oo la adeegsan karo, haddii dowladda ay si qorsheysan u dhaqaajiso xiriirradaas. Ugu dambeyn, in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu waraaqaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay safiirro aan badankood Soomaaliya ku lahayn safaarado joogto ah waxay muujinaysaa laba xaqiiqo. Midda koowaad waa in Soomaaliya weli leedahay xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo ballaaran; tan labaadna waa in joogitaanka diblomaasiyadeed ee Muqdisho uusan weli la jaanqaadin tirada xiriirrada rasmiga ah ee dalka. Aljeeriya oo waddo dib-u-furista safaaraddeeda waxay noqon kartaa tusaale muujinaya jihada mustaqbalka. Haddii amniga, siyaasadda iyo jawiga maalgashiga ay sii hagaagaan, dalal kale ayaa laga yaabaa inay dib u qiimeeyaan joogitaankooda Muqdisho. Sidaas darteed, xafladda shalay ma ahayn oo keliya in Madaxweynaha loo gudbiyo waraaqo aqoonsi, waxay ahayd sawir muujinaya sida Soomaaliya loogu soo laabanayo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee gobolka iyo dunida, iyadoo weli ay taagan tahay su’aasha ah goorta safiirrada badan ee la aqoonsaday ay Muqdisho ka dhigan doonaan xarunta joogtada ah ee shaqadooda. Haddii xiriirradaas loo beddelo safaarado, maalgashi iyo iskaashi muuqda, Soomaaliya waxay ka faa’iideysan kartaa furitaanka cusub ee diblomaasiyadeed ee hadda muuqda. items.title: From Forest to Fuel: The Environmental Cost of Somalia’s Charcoal Trade
items.description: By Abdiqani Haji Abdi Somalia’s charcoal trade remains a major driver of deforestation and environmental degradation, as large numbers of trees are cut to meet domestic and commercial demand for charcoal. The destruction of forests is accelerating land degradation, increasing vulnerability to drought and climate shocks, and undermining the livelihoods of communities that depend on healthy ecosystems. Despite efforts to curb the trade, weak enforcement and continued demand have allowed the charcoal economy to persist, raising urgent questions about how Somalia can balance energy needs with the protection of its rapidly diminishing natural resources. Several vehicles transporting charcoal have reportedly been set on fire recently near the settlement of Warmaxan along the road linking Wanlaweyn and Afgooye, highlighting a growing and increasingly dangerous struggle over Somalia’s charcoal trade and the rapid destruction of the country’s remaining forests. The incident comes amid mounting concern over the large-scale cutting of trees across parts of Lower Shabelle, where charcoal producers and timber traders are reportedly clearing forests at an accelerating rate. Trees are being cut not only to produce charcoal but also to supply construction timber to markets in Mogadishu and elsewhere. Local sources say the trade has become increasingly organized, with trees felled in large quantities before the wood is divided between charcoal production and construction materials. What was once a small-scale survival activity has increasingly evolved into a lucrative commercial enterprise—with potentially devastating consequences for Somalia’s already fragile environment. A Forest Crisis Hiding in Plain Sight Somalia has suffered decades of environmental degradation caused by drought, desertification, conflict, displacement and weak natural-resource management. Charcoal trade The country’s forests and rangelands are not merely sources of fuel and timber. They provide protection against soil erosion, support livestock production, help retain moisture and contribute to the ecological balance on which rural communities depend. Yet across parts of Lower Shabelle, residents say trees are disappearing at an alarming rate. Every truckload of charcoal represents more than a commercial commodity. Behind it are trees that may have taken years to grow but can be destroyed within minutes. The consequences are long-term. Deforestation can accelerate soil degradation, reduce pasture, increase exposure to drought and contribute to the loss of agricultural productivity. For communities already struggling with climate shocks and insecurity, environmental destruction can further undermine livelihoods. Who Is Benefiting? The charcoal trade has also generated serious allegations of corruption and political protection. Residents, environmental activists and other observers have repeatedly alleged that individuals with connections to influential Federal Government officials are involved in, or benefit financially from, the charcoal and timber business. Some of these allegations have circulated extensively on Somali social media, where individuals and networks alleged to be connected to the trade have been publicly identified. However, claims of direct involvement by senior government officials require independent investigation and documentary evidence before they can be treated as established facts. The persistence of such allegations nevertheless raises a fundamental question: How can a large and visible trade continue along major transportation routes without some degree of protection, tolerance or corruption within the enforcement system? That question deserves a serious answer from the authorities. Many are also asking – where are the environmental institutions? The apparent weakness of environmental enforcement is particularly troubling because Somalia has government institutions whose responsibilities include protecting forests, rangelands, agriculture and natural resources. Yet residents in affected areas say they rarely see effective government intervention against large-scale tree cutting. The ministries responsible for livestock, forestry, rangelands and agriculture have an important role in protecting Somalia’s natural environment. But without adequate resources, personnel, monitoring systems and political authority, environmental laws can exist largely on paper. That creates a dangerous vacuum. And wherever state institutions fail to enforce the law, someone else eventually fills the space. Al-Shabaab Steps into the Vacuum Al-Shabaab, which maintains significant influence in parts of Lower Shabelle, has increasingly targeted charcoal production and transportation. The group has attacked charcoal trucks and burned vehicles involved in the trade, presenting its campaign as an effort to stop environmental destruction. The irony is difficult to ignore. An armed organization that rejects the authority of the Somali state has effectively positioned itself as an enforcer of environmental rules in areas where legitimate government institutions have struggled to do so. But Al-Shabaab’s methods are hardly an environmental solution. Destroying vehicles, threatening traders and using violence to impose regulations cannot substitute for functioning environmental governance. At the same time, the group’s ability to intervene demonstrates how profoundly the absence of effective state institutions has distorted the relationship between security, commerce and natural-resource management. The lesson is stark: when government disappears from the enforcement landscape, armed groups can impose their own rules. The Checkpoint Question The movement of charcoal toward Mogadishu also raises questions about the security checkpoints along the Afgooye corridor. Sources familiar with the trade allege that charcoal trucks are allowed to pass through checkpoints after making payments to security personnel. Such practices would suggest that corruption is helping sustain a trade that is environmentally destructive and potentially subject to government restrictions. The issue deserves investigation. The Afgooye–Wanlaweyn corridor is an important transportation route connecting communities in Lower Shabelle with Mogadishu. If large numbers of charcoal and timber trucks are moving along these roads, it is reasonable to ask how they are passing through security and administrative controls. Who authorizes them? Who inspects their cargo? Who collects the money? And where does that money ultimately go? These questions cannot simply be dismissed as political accusations. They concern the protection of Somalia’s natural resources and the integrity of public institutions. Burning Trucks Are a Symptom, Not a Solution- The destruction of charcoal trucks may stop individual shipments, but it does not solve the underlying problem. The people cutting trees are responding to economic incentives. The traders are responding to demand. The transporters are responding to profit. And communities facing poverty may have few alternatives to participating in the charcoal economy. That means the solution cannot depend solely on military action or the destruction of vehicles. Somalia needs a broader strategy combining environmental enforcement, alternative livelihoods, sustainable energy options, community-based forest management and stronger regulation of commercial timber and charcoal markets. Without those measures, the cycle will continue. A National Crisis Demanding Accountability The Federal Government’s silence over the latest incident is increasingly difficult to overlook. The authorities have yet to provide a comprehensive public explanation regarding the burning of the charcoal vehicles near Warmaxan, the allegations surrounding corruption in the trade, or the broader destruction of forests in Lower Shabelle. If the government genuinely intends to protect Somalia’s environment, it must demonstrate that commitment through action. That means investigating credible allegations of corruption, strengthening environmental agencies, monitoring transportation corridors, prosecuting illegal deforestation and ensuring that local communities have alternatives to environmentally destructive livelihoods. It also means confronting those who profit from the destruction of Somalia’s natural resources—regardless of their political connections. The burning trucks near Warmaxan may appear at first glance to be another security incident on a dangerous road. But the smoke rising from those vehicles represents something much larger. It is the smoke of a country watching its forests disappear while the institutions responsible for protecting them struggle to enforce even the most basic environmental rules. Somalia cannot afford to lose its forests while simultaneously losing the institutional capacity required to protect them. The charcoal trade is therefore not merely an environmental issue. It is a question of governance, corruption, security, poverty and the future survival of communities already living on the front lines of climate change . If the state does not act, Somalia risks reaching a point where there will be fewer forests left to protect—and fewer institutions capable of protecting them. items.title: Shir looga hadlay xaaladda amni ee dalka oo Muqdisho lagu qabtay
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, ayaa shir guddoomiyay kulanka toddobaadlaha ah ee hoggaannada, qaybaha iyo fadhiyada madaxa-bannaan ee Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda amniga guud ee dalka, iyadoo saraakiisha ka qeybgalay ay warbixinno ka bixiyeen hawlgalladii amni ee ciidamada Boolisku qeybta ka ahaayeen. Saraakiishu waxay si gaar ah uga warbixiyeen guulihii laga gaaray howlgalkii lagu soo afjaray weerarkii ay K maleeshiyaad ay isbahaysteen ku qaadeen magaalada Baydhabo, kaas oo lagu sheegay inay doonayeen inay khalkhal geliyaan amniga ka jira Koonfur Galbeed. Taliyaha Booliska, Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, ayaa sidoo kale Hoggaanka Baarista Dambiyada (CID) iyo Qeybta Guud ee Gobolka Banaadir faray inay dardargeliyaan dadaallada looga hortagayo falalka ka hor imanaya anshaxa iyo dhaqanka suuban, gaar ahaan kuwa ay mararka qaar ku kacaan dhalinyaradu. Taliyaha ayaa bulshada ku bogaadiyey wada-shaqeynta ay la leeyihiin laamaha amniga iyo sida ay ula wadaagaan xogaha la xiriira falalka amni-darrada iyo kuwa bulshada waxyeellada u leh. Kulanka ayaa kusoo dhammaaday iyadoo hoggaanka Boolisku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta amniga, la-dagaallanka falalka dembiyada iyo sii wadista wada-shaqeynta shacabka iyo laamaha amniga.

items.title: Koox hubeysan oo markab xamuul ah u soo afduubatay dhanka Soomaaliya
items.description: Koox hubeysan ayaa la wareegtay markab xamuul ah oo marayay Gacanka Cadmeed, waxaana markabka loo leexiyay dhanka Soomaaliya, sida ay xaqiijisay Hay’adda Hawlgallada Ganacsiga Badda ee UK (UKMTO). UKMTO ayaa sheegtay in markabku uu ku sugnaa qiyaastii 136 mayl-badeed oo bari ka xigta magaalada Al-Mukalla ee Yemen, xilli uu galbeed ugu safrayay Gacanka Cadmeed. Markabka ayaa markii hore diray fariin degdeg ah kadib markii ay u soo dhawaatay doon aan la aqoonsan. Warbixin dambe oo ay soo saartay UKMTO ayaa xaqiijisay in lix qof oo hubeysan ay fuuleen markabka, gacantana ku dhigeen, kadibna ay beddeleen jihadii uu ku socday, iyagoo u leexiyay dhanka Soomaaliya. Hay’adaha ammaanka ayaa haatan baaraya dhacdada. Ilaa hadda lama shaacin magaca markabka, jinsiyadda shaqaalaha saaran ama xaaladdooda, sidoo kalena ma jirto koox si rasmi ah u sheegatay mas’uuliyadda dhacdadan. UKMTO waxay maraakiibta kale ee ku safraya aagga uga digtay inay taxaddar dheeraad ah muujiyaan oo ay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaq kasta oo shaki leh. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli ay dib u soo xoogeysanayaan weerarrada burcad-badeedda ee xeebaha Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. 17-kii Agoosto, markabkii xamuulka ahaa ee Lutuf ayaa lagu qabsaday meel u dhow xeebaha Soomaaliya, kadib markii siddeed qof oo hubeysan ay la wareegeen. Dhacdadii maanta waxay sare u qaadaysaa walaaca laga qabo amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara Gacanka Cadmeed, gaar ahaan xilli gobolka uu wajahayo xiisado amni oo ka dhashay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta Yemen iyo khilaafaadka ka taagan Bariga Dhexe. Ilaa hadda, lama xaqiijin in kooxda markabka qabsatay ay yihiin burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ama koox kale. Baaritaanka hay’adaha amniga ayaa socda.

items.title: Somalia ex-FM accuses Turkey of Puntland ‘massacre’
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s former Foreign Affairs Minister, Abdisaed Muse Ali, accused Turkey on Thursday of carrying out a “massacre” of Somali nationals on Puntland’s coast, escalating a row over a drone strike that killed four suspected pirates near Garmaal, in the northeastern region’s Nugaal area. “The massacre of Somali citizens on Puntland’s coast is a brutal act of aggression that the Turkish government has injected into Somalia’s politics,” Ali said in a post on X. He reserved further criticism for Puntland’s own leadership, saying regional authorities had failed to publicly address the deaths in Garmaal. “What troubles me even more is that Puntland’s current leadership sits in office yet has never once spoken about the youth massacred in Garmaal,” he added. Daily Somalia and other local outlets reported on Tuesday that the four dead men were suspected pirates believed to have taken part in the hijacking of the cargo vessel Lutuf a day earlier, and had taken a small boat toward the shore to gather supplies when they were struck. That account has since been challenged. Residents in the area now say the four were innocent fishermen killed in cold blood, with no connection to the Lutuf hijacking or any act of piracy. Puntland’s regional administration has issued no official statement either confirming the men’s involvement in piracy or clarifying whether those killed were civilians, leaving the competing accounts unresolved. Turkey has not responded to the accusation that it carried out the strike or that it killed civilians. Ankara has a longstanding practice of not publicly discussing its airstrikes in Somalia and has never claimed responsibility for individual strikes, maintaining silence even in cases where its drones are reported to have killed dozens of civilians. Anger over civilian casualties from Turkish airstrikes has been building in Somalia. Days before the Garmaal strike, footage circulated on social media showing residents burning a Turkish flag in protest, accusing Ankara’s strikes of killing livestock and rural herders in Southwest State. Turkey has not responded to that incident either, continuing a pattern of silence on strikes local communities describe as deadly. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Masar oo Itoobiya Digniin Adag Ka Soo Saartay Biyo-xireennada Nile
items.description: Qaahira (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Masar ayaa digniin adag ka soo saartay qorshayaasha Itoobiya ay ku dhisayso biyo-xireenno dheeraad ah oo laga sameeyo Webiga Nile, gaar ahaan qaybta Buluugga ah ee Nile. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar, Badr Abdelatty, ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu uu difaacan doono xuquuqdiisa biyaha Nile, isla markaana uusan oggolaan doonin tallaabooyin uu sheegay inay halis gelin karaan saamiga biyaha ee Masar. Masar iyo Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer isku khilaafsanaa Biyo-xireenka Weyn ee Renaissance-ka Itoobiya (GERD), oo Itoobiya ay ka dhistay Webiga Buluugga ah ee Nile. Qaahira ayaa horey uga soo saartay digniino iyo walaac ku saabsan biyo-xireenka, iyadoo ku doodaysa in mashruucu saameyn ku yeelan karo biyaha ay Masar ku tiirsan tahay. Itoobiya dhankeeda waxay sheegtay in biyo-xireenku muhiim u yahay koronto-soo-saarka iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha dalka, isla markaana uusan loogu talagelin in lagu waxyeelleeyo dalalka hoose ee Webiga Nile. Xiisadda cusub ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo Masar iyo Itoobiya ay weli isku khilaafsan yihiin habka loo maareynayo biyaha Nile iyo biyo-xireennada Itoobiya, taasoo arrinta ka dhigaysa mid xasaasi ah oo saameyn ku leh xiriirka labada dal. items.title: DEG-DEG: Doorashada Hirshabeelle oo Dib u Dhacday
items.description: Jowhar (Raxanreeb Online): Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (GMDQS) ayaa ku dhawaaqay in dib loo dhigay doorashada Golaha Wakiillada Hirshabeelle, taas oo markii hore qorshuhu ahaa in la qabto 20-ka Agoosto 2026. Sida ku cad warqad uu guddigu soo saaray 19-ka Agoosto 2026, dib-u-dhaca ayaa yimid kaddib markii guddigu qiimeeyay xaaladda diyaar-garowga doorashada iyo arrimaha la xiriira hirgelinta doorashooyinka. Guddigu wuxuu sheegay in dib-u-dhaca ay sabab u yihiin qodobo ay kamid yihiin: Diyaargarowga cod-bixiyeyaasha oo weli ka socda afar degmo oo ka tirsan Gobolka Hiiraan. In loo baahan yahay waqti dheeraad ah oo lagu wacyigeliyo laguna tababaro qaybaha kala duwan ee doorashada. In loo baahan yahay waqti dheeraad ah oo lagu soo gudbiyo liisaska musharraxiinta doorashada. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in dhammaan daneeyayaasha doorashooyinka Hirshabeelle ay heli doonaan waqti dheeraad ah si loo dhammeystiro howlaha ka harsan doorashada. Ilaa hadda guddigu ma shaacin taariikh cusub oo rasmi ah oo loo asteeyay qabashada doorashada Golaha Wakiillada Hirshabeelle. items.title: Howlgal culus oo maanta ka dhacay duleedka Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Amniga Dowlad-Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa faah-faahin dheeraad ah ka bixisay howlgal qorsheysan oo xalay ciidamada ammaanka ay ka fuliyeen duleedka magaalada Baydhaba, kaas oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday xarumo ay halkaasi ku lahaayeen kooxaha Khawaarijta. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda ayaa lagu sheegay in howlgalka oo dhacay abaare 10:00 habeenimo laga fuliyay deegaan qiyaastii 30 KM u jiea magaalada Baydhaba, iyadoo la beegsaday saddex xarumood oo ay Khawaarijtu ku lahaayeen halkaasi. Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in ciidamada ay adeegsadeen madaafiic iyo hub culus, lagun burburiyey xarumo ay ku sugnaayeen Khawaarijta. Ugu yaraan 18 xubnood oo ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab ayaa lagu dilay howlgalka, halka tiro kalena lagu dhaawacay, sida ay shaacisay Wasaaradda Amniga Koonfur Galbeed. Xaaladda guud ee Koonfur Galbeed ayaa indhowaanahan kacsanayd, iyadoo isbeddalkii ka dhacay Baydhaba uu sababay isku dhacyo hubeysan oo u dhexeeyo maamulka cusub ee uu hoggaamiyo Sheekh Aadan Madoobe iyo maamulkii hore ee uu horkacayay Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo hadda ciidamadiisa ay joogaan banaanka magaalada. Howlgalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Baydhaba iyo deegaannada ku dhow dhow ay muhiimad gaar ah u leeyihiin dhinaca amniga, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka ay wadaan dadaallo lagu xaqiijinayo amniga magaalada iyo deegaanada ku hareeraysan. Ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale sii wada howlgallo lagu xaqiijinayo amniga guud ee magaalada, si looga hortago in kooxaha ku sugan bannaanka magaalada ay dib usoo weeraraan xarumaha ciidamada iyo kuwa dowladda ee ku taalla halkaas. Howlgallada haatan ka socda duleedka Baydhaba ayaa qayb ka ah qorshayaasha lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo ka hortagga falalka ay kooxaha Khawaarijtu ka geysan karaan deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed. The post Howlgal culus oo maanta ka dhacay duleedka Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Dowladda Pakistan ayaa sii wada wada-hadallada ku saabsan iskaashiga difaaca, heshiisyada milatari iyo kordhinta awoodda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga XFS, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Safiirka Pakistan u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Marwo Aqsa Nawaz, iyadoo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga difaaca ee labada dal. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadlay hirgelinta is-afgaradyada labada dhinac iyo dardargelinta wada-shaqeynta ku saabsan tababarka, tayeynta iyo dhismaha awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Labada dhinac ayaa si gaar ah uga wada hadlay horumarinta Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo sidoo kale la isla eegay ballaarinta iskaashiga amniga iyo la-dagaallanka argagixisada, iyadoo lagu saleynayo danaha wadajirka ah iyo is-ixtiraamka labada dal. Kulanka waxaa goob joog ka ahaa Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji, iyo U-qeybsanaha Arrimaha Difaaca ee Safaaradda Pakistan, Korneyl Maxamed Inam Khattak. Wada-hadalladan ayaa muujinaya in Soomaaliya ay raadineyso in ay sii xoojiso awoodda iyo tayada Ciidanka Cirka, iyadoo Pakistan ay kamid tahay dalalka ay Soomaaliya kala shaqeynayso dhinacyada tababarka, qalabaynta iyo dhismaha awoodda ciidanka. items.title: Guddiga Joogtada Golaha Shacabka oo Ka Shiray Howlaha Sharci-dejinta
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Guddiga Joogtada ah ee Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa kulankooda toddobaadlaha ah ku yeeshay xarunta Guddoonka iyo Guddiyada ee Villa Hargeysa. Kulanka waxaa shir guddoominayay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), oo uu weheliyo Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow. Guddoomiye Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa xubnaha Guddiga warbixin ka siiyay shir uu la yeeshay Guddi Xildhibaano ah oo wakiil ka ah Xildhibaanada Mucaaradka, isagoo sidoo kale la wadaagay dhambaaladii hambalyada ee uu ka helay guddoomiyeyaasha baarlamaanada dalalka caalamka, hay’adaha iyo ururrada caalamiga ah. Intaas kaddib, Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdulle (Jaabiri), ayaa Guddoomiyaha iyo xubnaha Guddiga la wadaagay warbixin ku saabsan hindise-sharciyeedyada horyaalla guddiyada Golaha iyo marxaladaha kala duwan ee ay marayaan. Sidoo kale, guddoomiyeyaasha guddiyada ayaa laga dhageystay warbixinno ku saabsan shuruucda ay gacanta ku hayaan, heerka ay marayaan iyo waqtiga la qorsheynayo in loo gudbiyo kulamada Golaha Shacabka. Ugu dambeyn, Guddoomiye Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa xubnaha Guddiga Joogtada ah kula dardaarmay inay ka shaqeeyaan midnimada iyo wadajirka Golaha Shacabka, si uu Goluhu u guto waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale ballanqaaday in hoggaanka Golaha uu ku shaqeyn doono si waafaqsan xeer-hoosaadka iyo shuruucda kale ee u degsan Golaha Shacabka. items.title: DEGDEG: Madaxa Sirdoonka Ecuador iyo 6 Qof oo Kale oo Ku Dhintay Shil Diyaaradeed oo Kenya Ka Dhacay+SAWIRO
items.description: Kenya (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxa Xarunta Sirdoonka Qaranka Ecuador, Michele Sensi-Contugi Ycaza, ayaa ku geeriyooday shil diyaaradeed oo ka dhacay gobolka Samburu ee waqooyiga Kenya. Shilka ayaa dhacay 19-kii Agoosto 2026, kaddib markii diyaarad nooca helicopter-ka ah ay ku burburtay deegaanka u dhow Mount Ololokwe, xilli ay ku guda jirtay safar dalxiis. Wararka la xaqiijiyay ayaa sheegaya in diyaaradda ay saarnaayeen 7 qof, oo ay ku jiraan lix rakaab ah iyo duuliyihii. Dhammaantood ayaa ku geeriyooday shilka. Michele Sensi-Contugi, oo ahaa madaxa sirdoonka Ecuador, ayaa safarka ku weheliyay xaaskiisa Stephany Hollihan, iyadoo sidoo kale diyaaradda saarnaayeen muwaadiniin Mareykan ah. Diyaaradda ayaa ahayd Eurocopter EC130 B4, waxaana maamuleysay shirkadda Lady Lori Helicopters. Waxay ka duushay deegaanka Loisaba, iyadoo ku wajahneyd aagga webiga Ewaso Nyiro markii shilku dhacay. Sababta rasmiga ah ee keentay shilka weli lama xaqiijin, waxaana socda baaritaan ay wadaan hay’adaha duulista iyo ammaanka Kenya. items.title: Successful Somalia drought response protects livelihoods and food sources for pastoral families
items.description: Successful Somalia drought response protects livelihoods and food sources for pastoral families On World Humanitarian Day (19 Aug) we celebrate together with Abdisalan Salah, a pastoralist and a beneficiary of the FAO’s recent drought response project that successfully protected livelihoods for pastoral families. May 2026. Erigavo, Sanaag. Camels, the most prized livestock among Somali pastoralists, become increasingly vulnerable to disease during droughts as dwindling pasture weakens their bodies and immunity. In Somaliland’s eastern Sanaag region, livestock represent livelihood, food, and financial security for pastoral families. For 42-year-old Abdisalan Salah, the drought sweeping across the country since 2025 has put all three at risk. “My family consists of eight people, and our livelihood depends entirely on livestock,” Abdisalan says. Like many pastoralists in the area, he keeps a mixed herd of camels, cattle, goats, and sheep; but when consecutive rainy seasons failed to deliver adequate rainfall, life became increasingly difficult. “The drought has had a serious impact on our household,” he recalls. “Meat and milk production have both declined, putting our family’s livelihood into crisis.” Equally damaging effects have been felt throughout Abdisalan’s community as water sources have dried up, grazing land has shrunk, and livestock has become weakened from hunger and thirst. As animals gather around the few remaining areas with pasture and water, the risk of disease increases. “We did not receive enough rainfall during either the Deyr or the Gu seasons,” says Abdisalan. “Rain fell only in isolated areas, causing people and livestock to gather there. As a result, diseases were more likely to spread.” The worsening conditions forced some families to leave in search of better livestock grazing. Abdisalan was among them. “At one point, I moved about 20 kilometres away,” he says. The journey offered little relief. His animals continued to lose weight, milk production stopped for some, and disease rates intensified. “Some animals became thin and weak, some fell sick, and others died,” he says. “Because they suffered from hunger, their immune systems weakened, making them more vulnerable to disease. May 2026. Erigavo, Sanaag. Abdillahi Abdi Eid and his team of Ministry of Livestock veterinarians treat animals suffering from parasites, malnutrition, injuries, and pneumonia in this campaign. ©FAO/Abdillahi Hassan Jama But as the crisis peaked, support arrived thanks to a partnership between FAO and the Somaliland Ministry of Livestock and Rural Development (MoLRD), with funding from the United Nations Central Emergency Response Fund. Over six weeks, veterinary teams treated nearly 230,000 animals belonging to nearly 3,000 households in Erigabo district. “At first, we could not tell whether the animals were simply suffering from the effects of the drought or whether they were sick,” Abdisalan explains. “But the results were quickly visible after they received treatment. “We have observed a significant improvement in the overall health and productivity of our animals. “Consequently, milk production has increased, enhancing household food security and nutrition. This has contributed to better health and well-being for our families while also strengthening our livelihoods through improved livestock performance.” May 2026. Erigabo, Sanaag. A veterinarian from Somaliland’s Ministry of Livestock and Rural Development injects a sick goat. Before administering treatment, veterinarians interview livestock owners and examine animals to assess their health needs. ©FAO/Abdillahi Hassan Jama. Abdisalan’s family borrowed money to keep them afloat during this exacting period before receiving cash assistance from FAO alongside the veterinary assistance they received. “We are very grateful to FAO for this support,” he says. “They came to us during a very difficult time and provided cash assistance when we needed it most.” The family has now been able to meet urgent needs but also to protect their future. “We used it to buy water and food, repay some family debts, and pay school fees,” Abdisalan said. Today, conditions remain challenging, but there are signs of recovery. Recent rainfall has brought renewed optimism, and communities are taking steps to prepare for future droughts. “We are producing and storing hay and other animal fodder for future use,” says Abdisalan. “We are also planning to build water catchments so we can harvest and store rainwater during the rainy season.” These efforts, combined with continued support and improved livestock health, are helping families rebuild their resilience. Standing beside his recovering herd, Abdisalan reflects on the difficult months behind him and the hopes he now holds for the future. “We are optimistic,” he says. “We have received some rainfall. Although it has not been much, it gives us hope. Our hopes for the future are high.” May 2026. Abdisalan Salah at his sheep’s enclosure in Erigavo district in Sanaag which is renowned as Somaliland’s leading sheep-producing region. ©FAO/Abdillahi Hassan Jama

Recent rainfall has brought renewed optimism, and communities are taking steps to prepare for future droughts. “We are producing and storing hay and other animal fodder for future use,” says Abdisalan. “We are also planning to build water catchments so we can harvest and store rainwater during the rainy season.” These efforts, combined with continued support and improved livestock health, are helping families rebuild their resilience. Standing beside his recovering herd, Abdisalan reflects on the difficult months behind him and the hopes he now holds for the future. “We are optimistic,” he says. “We have received some rainfall. Although it has not been much, it gives us hope. Our hopes for the future are high.” May 2026. Abdisalan Salah at his sheep’s enclosure in Erigavo district in Sanaag which is renowned as Somaliland’s leading sheep-producing region. ©FAO/Abdillahi Hassan Jama

items.title: Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada oo maanta lagu soo bandhigay in is-beddel weyn uu ku yimid…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Soomaaliya oo maanta yeeshay kulankoodii toddobaadlaha ahaa, ayaa lagu soo bandhigay warbixinno kala duwan oo la xiriira dhaqaalaha, amniga iyo difaaca dalka, iyadoo uu guddoomiyay Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre. Inta uu socday kulanka Golaha ayaa waxaa lagu soo bandhigay warbixin ku saabsan amniga dalka , taas oo muujisay isbeddel togan oo laga sameeyay sugidda amniga iyo howlgalladii ugu dambeeyay ee ay fuliyeen ciidamada qalabka sida ee Qaranka Soomaaliyeed, kuwaasi oo horumar la taaban karo ka sameeyay goobaha la dagaalka, isla markaana jab xooggan gaarsiiyey Khawaarijta. Sidoo kale, Golaha ayaa warbixin dhammaystiran ka dhagaystay Wasaaradda Maaliyadda, taasi oo ku saabsan Xisaab-xirka sanadeedka 2025, iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha dalka, canshuuraha gudaha iyo dib-u-habeynta Maaliyadeed ee dowladda Soomaaliya. Warbixinta wasaaradda ayaa lagu sheegay in uu kordhay dhaqaalaha dalka boqolkiiba 3.1% gaar ahaan hal-beegga GDP-ga ee lagu qiyaaso dakhliga guud ee dalka soo gala. Intaas kadib Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza oo warbixinta kadib golaha hadal kooban u jeediyay ayaa sheegay sida ay muhiim u tahay in dadka Soomaaliyeed ay gaaraan isku filnaansho dhaqaale, ka faa’ideysiga wax-soo-saarka dalka, khayraadka kale, kordhinta dakhli-uruurinta gudaha, dhiirrgalinta maalgashiga, xoojiyo daah-furnaanta dhaqaale iyo isla-xisaabtanka, iyo waliba beekhaaminta raasumaalka. Xamza ayaa sidoo kale Wasaaradda ku ammaanay qiimeyntii uu ku sameeyay Xafiiska Hanti-Dhawrka Guud oo markii ugu horreeysay maamulka maaliyadda dowladda siisay qiimeynta lagu magacaabo Aragti Nadiif ah oo ah tan ugu sarreysa oo ka tarjumeysa hufnaan. Ugu dambeyn, Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa xusay in arrimaha dhaqaalaha dalka uu si weyn uga soo kabanayo isla markaana uu gaari doono isku filnaan dhaqaale oo lagaga maarmi doono kaalmo shisheeye, taasi oo tarjumaysa adkeysiga bulshada Soomaliyeed. items.title: Taliye sare iyo ciidankiisa oo ka goostay Somaliland kuna biiray maamulka Waqooyi Bari
items.description: Ceerigaabo (Caasimada Online) – Sarkaal sare oo ka tirsanaa ciidamada Somaliland ayaa Arbacadii isaga baxay ciidanka maamulkaas, isaga oo ku biiray ciidamada Dowlad-goboleedka Waqooyi Bari ee Soomaaliya, xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo loollanka loogu jiro gacan-ku-haynta deegaanno ka tirsan gobolka Sanaag. Gaashaanle Sare Cali Axmed Ismaaciil, oo loo yaqaan Ashkato, kana ahaa taliyaha ciidamada Somaliland ee deegaanka Yubbe, ayaa isaga iyo askar la socotay gaaray degmada Fiqi-Fuliye, halkaas oo lagu soo dhaweeyay xarunta Taliska Qeybta 12-aad ee ciidamada Daraawiishta Waqooyi Bari. Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan maamulka Waqooyi Bari ayaa xaqiijiyay ku biirista sarkaalkan, iyaga oo sheegay inuu horey ula soo xiriiray mas’uuliyiin iyo wasiirro ka tirsan maamulka, kahor inta uusan go’aansan inuu ka baxo ciidamada Somaliland. Cali Ashkato oo ka hadlay sababta keentay go’aankiisa ayaa sheegay inuu tixgeliyay aragtida bulshada uu kasoo jeedo iyo mowqifka ay dhawaan qaateen madax-dhaqameedka deegaankiisa, kuwaas oo taageero u muujiyay maamulka Waqooyi Bari. Waxa uu sheegay in wada-hadallo uu la yeeshay mas’uuliyiinta maamulka ay ugu dambeyn horseedeen inuu si rasmi ah ugu biiro ciidamada Daraawiishta. Xog aan helnay ayaa sheegeysa in sarkaalka uu Fiqi-Fuliye la gaaray gaari ciidan oo qori culus ku rakiban yahay iyo ku dhowaad 10 askari oo ku hubeysan hubka fudud, hase yeeshee xogtaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Goosashada Ashkato ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli gobolka Sanaag uu noqday mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu waaweyn ee uu ka socdo loollanka siyaasadeed iyo midka ciidan ee u dhexeeya Somaliland iyo maamulka cusub ee Waqooyi Bari. Maamulka Waqooyi Bari ayaa ka dhashay maamulkii SSC-Khaatumo, oo awooddeeda siyaasadeed iyo ciidan si weyn u korortay kadib dagaalkii Laascaanood ee 2023, kaas oo ciidamada Somaliland looga saaray magaalada Laascaanood iyo inta badan bariga gobolka Sool. Bishii July 2025, shir ka dhacay Laascaanood ayaa lagu ansixiyay dastuur cusub, waxaana SSC-Khaatumo loo beddelay magaca Dowlad-goboleedka Waqooyi Bari, oo sheegtay inay ka kooban tahay Sool, Sanaag iyo Cayn. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa taageertay dhismaha maamulka cusub oo markii dambe lagu daray nidaamka federaalka dalka. Somaliland ayaa si adag uga hortimid dhismaha Waqooyi Bari, iyadoo ku adkeysanaysa in Sool iyo Sanaag ay qayb ka yihiin dhulkii maxmiyaddii hore ee British Somaliland oo ay sheegato inay xuduudihiisa la soo noqotay markii ay 1991 ku dhawaaqday inay ka go’day Soomaaliya. Muranka Sanaag ayaa sidoo kale ka adag kan Sool, maadaama gobolka ay muddo dheer ku loollamayeen Somaliland iyo Puntland, halka Waqooyi Bari uu hadda noqday dhinac kale oo sheeganaya gobolka. Somaliland waxay gacanta ku haysaa qeybo ka mid ah Ceerigaabo iyo deegaanno kale oo ka tirsan Sanaag, halka Puntland ay maamusho qaybo badan oo bari ka xiga gobolka. Waqooyi Bari, oo sheegta Sanaag oo dhan, ayaa dhankeeda wadday dadaallo ay taageero uga raadineyso bulshada, siyaasiyiinta iyo madax-dhaqameedka gobolka. Yubbe, oo Ashkato taliye uga ahaa ciidamada Somaliland, ayaa lafteedu muddo dheer ka mid ahayd goobaha lagu muransan yahay ee Sanaag, waxaana sannadihii lasoo dhaafay deegaanka iyo hareerihiisa ka dhacay dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan iyo isku dhacyo la xiriira loollanka Somaliland iyo Puntland. Soo bixitaanka Waqooyi Bari ayaa hadda beddelay qaabkii hore ee loollankaas, iyadoo maamulka fadhigiisu yahay Laascaanood uu isku dayayo inuu saameyntiisa ka ballaariyo Sool una gudbiyo Sanaag. Sidaas darteed, inkasta oo tirada ciidamada la socday Ashkato ay kooban tahay, haddana goosashadiisa ayaa leh miisaan siyaasadeed, gaar ahaan maadaama uu ahaa taliye Somaliland u qaabilsanaa deegaan ku yaalla mid ka mid ah aagagga sida weyn loogu loollamayo Sanaag. Tallaabadan ayaa sidoo kale kusoo beegmeysa xilli dhinacyada ku tartamaya Sanaag ay si weyn xoogga u saarayaan kasbashada madax-dhaqameedka, saraakiisha ciidamada iyo bulshada deegaanka, kuwaas oo mowqifyadoodu door weyn ka ciyaari kara jihada uu mustaqbalka u maro loollanka gobolka. items.title: Sidee looga fal-celiyay dib u dhaca doorashada HirShabelle?
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Fal-celin aan caadi ahayn ayaa ka dhalatay dib u dhaca ku yimid jadwalka doorashada Maamul-goboleedka HirShabelle, kadib markii uu guddiga doorashooyinka shaaciyay in muddo kooban dib loo dhigay waqtiga doorashada. Guddiga ayaa ku wargeliyay dhammaan daneeyayaasha doorashada iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed in doorashada isku-sidkan ee Golaha Wakiillada iyo Golayaasha Deegaanka ee Dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle lagu sameeyay dib-u-dhac kooban, si loo dhammaystiro hawlaha muhiimka u ah doorashooyinkaas oo markii hore loo qorsheeyay inay qabsoomaan 20-ka bishan August ee 2026. Warqad kasoo baxday Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa lagu shaaciyay sababaha dib loogu dhigay doorashada HirShabelle, iyada oo lagu soo koobay saddex qodob oo xasaasi ah, kuwaas oo kala ah;- 1. Diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyeyaasha oo weli ka socota afar degmo oo ka tirsan Gobolka Hiiraan. 2. In urrurada siyaasadda loo baahan yahay in la siiyo fursad ay taageerayaashooda ku abaabulaan, si ay si wax-ku-ool ah uga qayb galaan hawlaha doorashooyinka. 3. In urrurada siyaasadda fursad loo siiyo soo gudbinta liisaska musharraxiinta doorashada. Haddaba sidee looga fal-celiyay dib u dhaca doorashada HirShabelle?. Yuusuf Jimcaale: “Horay ayaa u sheegay in doorashada golaha deegaanka iyo golaha wakiilada HirShabelle waqtiga aad qabateen aysan ku dhacaynin”. Aways Yare: “Aaway doorashadii Galmudug ee guddoonka Baarlamaanka iyo tii Madaxtooyadii, tan HirShabelle hanoo dambeysee*. Maxamuud Goode: “War been baad sheegeysiin wax diiwaangelin ah oo socoto ma jirto”. Cabdicasiis Guure: “Degmooyinka aadka loogu diyaar garoobayo jadwalkan adib u dhigay waxaa ka mid ah degmooyinka Farlibaax iyo Beledweyne oo shacabka ku nool ay haatan fahmeen una soo wada jeesteen inay kaararka doorashada wada qaataan”. Cumar Bayle: “Qof aan miyir qabin miyaa waxaan soo qoray? halkee doorasho joogtaa timirtii horaa dab loo waayay maqli jiray”. Cabdiwahaab Faragaab: “Maxaad dib ugu dhigaysaan awalba kululeysadiina wadateene maa one day is dhaafisaan!”. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan oo tallaabo cusub u qaaday iskaashiga difaaca + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Soomaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa Arbacadii kulan gaar ah la yeeshay Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Pakistan u fadhiya magaalada Muqdisho, Marwo Aqsa Nawaz, isaga oo kala hadlay arrimo ku aadan xoojinta xiriirka labada dal. Fiqi iyo Marwo Aqsa Nawaz ayaa kulankooda si gaar ah diiradda ugu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, hirgelinta Is-afgaradka labada dal, iyo sidii loo dardargelin lahaa wada-shaqeynta dhinacyada tababarka, tayeynta iyo dhismaha awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa ka wada-hadlay horumarinta Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed iyo ballaarinta iskaashiga amniga iyo la-dagaallanka argagixisada, iyadoo lagu saleynayo danaha wadajirka ah iyo is-ixtiraamka labada dal. Kulanka ayaa daba socda heshiis cusub oo dhanka iskaashiga difaaca ah oo ay labada dowladood wada galeen horraantii bishaan, kaas oo ay wada saxiixeen Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, oo booqasho rasmi ah ku tegay magaalada Islamabad, halka Pakistan uu u saxiixay Wasiirka Difaaca, Mudane Khawaja Muhammad Asif. Heshiiskaas ayaa ah mid lagu xoojinayo wada shaqeynta dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, iyada oo sidoo kale lagu horumarinayo awoodda ciidamada. Is-afgaradkan ayaa dhigaya in labada dhinac ay iska kaashadaan la-dagaallanka argagixisada, tababarrada ciidamada, is-weydaarsiga khibradaha, aqoonta milatari, kobcinta awoodaha difaaca iyo xoojinta wada-shaqeynta amniga. Waxaa kale oo uu saxiixa is-afgaradka muujiyay sida ay Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan uga go’an tahay xoojinta xiriirkooda istaraatiijiyadeed iyo ballaarinta iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, isagoo saldhig u noqonaya wada-shaqeyn wax ku ool ah oo u adeegta danaha labada dhinac. Si kastaba, Dowladda Federaalka ayaa horay sidaan oo kale heshiisyo difaac ula soo gashay dalalka Turkiga, Masar iyo waddamo kale oo saaxib la ah Soomaaliya. items.title: Heavy Night Operation Destroys Al-Shabaab Weapons Stockpiles in Bay Region
items.description: BAIDOA— Regional authorities in South West State announced that security forces conducted a targeted operation and airstrike against Al-Shabaab strongholds on the outskirts of Baidoa, located in the Bay region. According to an official statement issued by the South West State Ministry of Security, local security forces executed the planned operation at approximately 10:00 PM. The strike targeted three key facilities utilized by the insurgent group, situated roughly 30 kilometers outside the regional capital. The ministry confirmed that the operation resulted in the deaths of 18 Al-Shabaab members, with numerous others wounded. The primary objective was the dismantling of strategic bases, which led to the destruction of significant stockpiles of weaponry and military equipment housed at the sites. “We are sharing with the people of Baidoa the severe blow dealt to the Al-Shabaab militia overnight,” the Ministry of Security said in a statement. Officials added that security forces remain on high alert and are continuing operations across the surrounding areas to secure the territory and prevent any attempts by the group to regain a foothold in the targeted locations. items.title: Ugu yaraan 7 qof oo ku Geeriyooday shil diyaaradeed oo ka dhacay Kenya
items.description: Ugu yaraan 7 qof ayaa ku dhintay shil diyaaradeed oo ka dhacay waqooyiga Kenya, kadib markii helicopter dalxiis ah uu ku burburay deegaanka Samburu County , iyadoo dhammaan dadkii saarnaa ay dhinteen. Shilka ayaa dhacay xilli helicopter-ku uu ku guda jiray safar dalxiis oo ku wajahnaa deegaanka Loisaba Conservancy , oo ka mid ah goobaha caanka ku ah safari-ga iyo duurjoogta Kenya. Sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiinta Kenya, helicopter-ka oo ahaa nooca Eurocopter EC130 B4 , ayaa xilliga shilka ka duulay Loisaba isagoo ku sii jeeday dhanka deegaanka Ewaso Nyiro ee Samburu County. Diyaaradda ayaa dhacday abaare 9:13 subaxnimo , iyadoo saarnaayeen lix rakaab ah iyo hal duuliye, waxaana la xaqiijiyay in aysan jirin cid ka badbaadday. Dadka ku dhintay shilka waxaa ku jiray Michele Sensi-Contugi , oo ahaa madaxa Xarunta Sirdoonka Qaranka Ecuador, iyo xaaskiisa Stephany Hollihan , oo iyaduna haysatay dhalashada Mareykanka iyo Ecuador. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in shan muwaadiniin Mareykan ah ay ka mid ahaayeen toddobada qof ee ku dhintay shilka. Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Kenya ayaa sheegtay inay xiriir la leedahay mas’uuliyiinta dalkaas, isla markaana ay bixinayso taageerada qunsuliyadeed ee loo baahan yahay qoysaska dhibbanayaasha. Dhibbanayaasha waxaa sidoo kale ka mid ahaa José Alberto Suárez , oo ahaa masuul sare oo ka tirsanaa shabakadda telefishinka Telemundo ee Mareykanka, iyo Roger Duarte , oo ahaa ganacsade ka soo jeeday Miami. Shilku wuxuu ka dhacay dhul buuraley ah oo adag, meel u dhow Mount Ololokwe , taasoo caqabad ku noqotay howlaha gurmadka iyo soo kabashada meydadka. Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa sheegtay in dadaallada lagu gaarayo goobta shilka ay adkeeyeen dhulka qallafsan iyo dab ka kacay goobta , inkastoo kooxaha gurmadka ay bilaabeen howlaha baaritaanka iyo soo kabashada. Hay’adaha duulista Kenya iyo mas’uuliyiinta kale ee ay khusayso ayaa bilaabay baaritaan lagu ogaanayo waxa sababay burburka helicopter-ka iyo xaaladdii diyaaradda ka hor inta aysan dhicin. Shirkadda dalxiiska ee &Beyond , oo martideeda ay ka mid ahaayeen dadkii saarnaa helicopter-ka, ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in sababta shilka aan weli la go’aamin.

items.title: Doorashada HirShabelle oo dib u dhac uu ku yimid + Sababta
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa waxaa muddo kooban dib loogu dhigay doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee Dowlad-goboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee HirShabelle. Guddiga ayaa isaga oo gudanaya waajibaadkiisa shaqo ayaa ku wargeliyay dhammaan daneeyayaasha doorashada iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed in doorashada isku-sidkan ee Golaha Wakiillada iyo Golayaasha Deegaanka ee Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle lagu sameeyay dib-u-dhac kooban, si loo dhammeystiro hawlaha muhiimka u ah doorashooyinkaas oo markii hore loo qorsheeyay inay qabsoomaan 20-ka bishan August ee 2026. Warqadda kasoo baxday Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa lagu shaaciyay sababaha dib loogu dhigay doorashada HirShabelle, iyada oo lagu soo koobay saddex qodob oo xasaasi ah, kuwaas oo kala ah;- 1. Diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyeyaasha oo weli ka socota afar degmo oo ka tirsan Gobolka Hiiraan. 2. In urrurada siyaasadda loo baahan yahay in la siiyo fursad ay taageerayaashooda ku abaabulaan, si ay si wax-ku-ool ah uga qayb galaan hawlaha doorashooyinka. 3. In urrurada siyaasadda fursad loo siiyo soo gudbinta liisaska musharraxiinta doorashada. Sidoo kale, warsaxaafadeedka ayaa lagu sheegay in Guddiga Doorashooyinka uu laba todobaad gudahood ku shaacin doono jadwalka cusub, kaas oo lagu caddeyn doono xilliga rasmiga ah ee ay qabsoomeyso doorashadu. “Sidaa darteed, Guddigu waxa uu ku wargelinayaa dhammaan daneeyayaasha doorashada isku-sidkan ee Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle in muddo laba todobaad gudahood ah uu ku shaacin doono jadwalka doorashada iyo xilliga ay qabsoomayso,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri bayaanka. Doorashada HirShabelle oo si weyn isha loogu hayo ayaa waxaa weli ka taagan dood culus, iyada oo ay mar kale soo laba kacleysay tabashada reer Hiiraan oo doonaya kursiga ugu sarreeya maamulka, halka Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe iyo kooxdiisa oo ku xiran Villa Somalia ay mar kale u ololeynayaan soo laabasho, si ay usii hoggaamiyaan Dowlad-goboleedka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa laga war sugayaa halka uu ku dambeyn doono loollanka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya dhinacyada isku haya hoggaanka iyo mustaqbalka HirShabeelle. items.title: Iiraan oo Mareykanka ku eedeysay argagixisanimo dhaqaale
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan ayaa si adag uga hadlay siyaasadda dhaqaale ee Mareykanka, isagoo ku eedeeyay Washington inay waddo tallaabooyin uu ku tilmaamay argagixiso dhaqaale, kuwaas oo sida uu sheegay khatar ku ah dhaqaalaha caalamka iyo madaxbannaanida dalalka. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in cadaadiska dhaqaale ee Mareykanka uusan saameyn ku yeelanayn oo keliya Iran, balse uu halis ku yahay nidaamka dhaqaalaha caalamka iyo awoodda dowladuhu u leeyihiin inay si madax-bannaan u maamulaan arrimahooda dhaqaale. Wuxuu sidoo kale dhaliilay sii wadista siyaasadaha uu ku tilmaamay kuwo fashilmay, isagoo sheegay in ku adkeysiga waddadaas ay horseedi karto guuldarrooyin hor leh isla markaana ay sii kordhin karto caro ka dhalata shacabka Iiraan. Dhanka kale, wasiirku wuxuu sheegay in waxa loogu yeero “Maalinta Guusha Dhaqaale” aysan ahayn guul dhab ah, balse uu ku tilmaamay isku day lagu doonayo in shacabka iyo caalamkaba looga jeediyo dareenka dhibaatooyinka gudaha ee ka jira Mareykanka. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiisadda Iiraan iyo Mareykanka ay weli aad u sarrayso, iyadoo cunaqabateynaha iyo cadaadiska dhaqaale ay muddo dheer qeyb ka ahaayeen khilaafka u dhexeeya labada dowladood.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan oo ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Safiirka Pakistan u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Aqsa Nawaz, iyadoo kulanka diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga difaaca iyo amniga ee labada dal. Kulanka ayaa si gaar ah looga hadlay sidii loo dardargelin lahaa hirgelinta is-afgaradyada labada dhinac, iyadoo xoogga la saaray iskaashiga dhinacyada tababarka, tayeynta iyo dhismaha awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa ka wada hadlay horumarinta Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed iyo sidii loo ballaarin lahaa wada-shaqeynta amniga, gaar ahaan la-dagaallanka argagixisada, iyadoo la tixgelinayo danaha wadajirka ah iyo ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida labada dal. Kulanka ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada Soomaaliya ay ku xoojinayso iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka saaxiibka ah ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, iyadoo la doonayo in la kordhiyo tababarka iyo tayeynta ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo waraaqaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay toddobo safiir oo cusub
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ka guddoomay waraaqaha aqoonsiga toddobo safiir oo cusub oo dalalkooda u soo magacaabeen Soomaaliya, iyadoo tallaabadan ay qeyb ka tahay dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya iyo dalalka caalamka. Safiirrada cusub ayaa ka kala socday Aljeeriya, Brazil, Hindiya, Mali, Myanmar, Nigeria iyo Pakistan, waxayna kala yihiin Mohamed Alim oo ah safiirka Aljeeriya, Joao Alfredo Dos Anjos oo matalaya Brazil, Dr. Adarsh Swaika oo ah safiirka Hindiya, Dr. Madou Diallo oo ka socda Mali, Aung Min Oo oo matalaya Myanmar, Danlami Ibrahim oo ah safiirka Nigeria iyo Aqsa Nawaz oo ah safiirka Pakistan. Intii ay munaasabadda ka socotay xarunta Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya, safiirradu waxay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uga warbixiyeen qorshayaashooda iyo mudnaanta ay siinayaan xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga dalalkooda iyo Soomaaliya. Madaxweynaha ayaa dhankiisa ku boorriyay safiirrada cusub inay muddada ay xilalka hayaan ka shaqeeyaan sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa xiriirka labada dhinac, gaar ahaan dhinacyada siyaasadda, ganacsiga, maalgashiga, horumarinta, amniga iyo arrimaha bulshada. Safiirrada ayaa sidoo kale Madaxweynaha soo gaarsiiyay farriimo iyo salaan ay uga sideen madaxda dalalkooda, iyagoo caddeeyay sida ay uga go’an tahay dowladahooda in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka laba geesoodka ah iyo iskaashiga ay la leeyihiin Soomaaliya. Munaasabadda ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu ballaarinayo xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee ay la leedahay dalalka Afrika, Aasiya iyo Koonfurta Ameerika. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale dooneysa inay xiriirrada caalamiga ah u beddesho iskaashi wax-ku-ool ah oo horseeda ganacsi, maalgashi, amni iyo horumar.

items.title: Haweeney 84 jir ah oo si mucjiso ah looga badbaadiyay burburka dhul gariir saddex maalmood ka hor ka dhacay Indonesia
items.description: Haweeney 84 jir ah oo curyaan ah ayaa si mucjiso ah nolol loogu helay iyadoo ku hoos jirta burburka gurigeeda, saddex maalmood kaddib dhulgariir xooggan oo ku dhuftay jasiiradda Flores iyo deegaannada ku dhow. Haweeneyda oo lagu magacaabo Paulina Pobi ayaa ku noolayd jasiirad yar oo waqooyiga ka xigta Flores, gurigeeda oo ka mid ahaa boqollaal dhisme oo ku dumay dhulgariirka, ayaa waxaa hoostiisa ku aasnayd haweeneyda kadib markii ay soo dumeen darbiyada bamboo-ga ah. Qoyskeeda ayaa markii hore u maleynayay in Paulina la badbaadiyay oo loo qaaday goob dadka barakacay lagu ururiyay, hase yeeshee, markii ay dib ugu laabteen guriga, waxay heleen iyadoo weli ku hoos jirta burburka. Mas’uul maxalli ah oo lagu magacaabo Rudolfus Riba ayaa sheegay in maadaama haweeneydu ay curyaan ahayd oo aysan awoodin inay dhaqaaqdo ama hadasho, ay qaadatay ilaa maalintii afaraad in qoyskeedu ay helaan. Riba ayaa sheegay in xaaladdeedu ay wanaagsan tahay, iyadoo aan wax dhaawac ah soo gaarin, balse ay xoogaa tabar-darnayd maadaama aysan wax cunin ama cabin muddo dhowr maalmood ah. Qoyskeeda ayaa dhacdada ku tilmaamay wax u eg mucjiso. Dhulgariirka oo cabbirkiisu ahaa 7.7 magnitude ayaa sababay dhimashada ugu yaraan 73 qof, halka in ka badan 900 qof ay ku dhaawacmeen. Ku dhowaad 60,000 qof ayaa sidoo kale ka barakacay guryahooda, sida ay sheegtay hay’adda maareynta musiibooyinka Indonesia ee BNPB. Hay’adda cilmiga dhulka iyo saadaasha Indonesia ee BMKG ayaa sheegtay in tan iyo markii dhulgariirku dhacay la diiwaangeliyay in ka badan 3,000 dhulgariir oo daba socda, kuwaas oo ugu yaraan 86 ka mid ah ay ahaayeen kuwo ay dadka deegaanka dareemi karaan. Dhanka kale, dowladda Indonesia ayaa sheegtay in tan iyo Sabtidii la gaarsiiyay dadka ay musiibadu saameysay ku dhowaad 400 tan oo gargaar ah, oo isugu jira cunto, biyo iyo dawooyin. Indonesia ayaa ka mid ah dalalka dunida sida joogtada ah ula kulma dhulgariirrada, maadaama ay ku taallo waxa loo yaqaan “Pacific Ring of Fire”, oo ah dhul ay ku badan yihiin dhaqdhaqaaqyada dhulka iyo foolkaanayaasha, kuna fidsan Japan, Koonfur-bari Aasiya iyo qaybo badan oo Badweynta Baasifigga ah.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ka qeyb gashay Shirweynaha 7-aad ee Warbaahinta Afrika iyo Shiinaha
items.description: Wasiirka Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulfataax Qaasim Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada Beijing uga qeyb galay furitaanka rasmiga ah ee Shirweynaha 7-aad ee Iskaashiga Warbaahinta Afrika iyo Shiinaha. Shirweynaha waxaa ka qeyb galaya wasiirrada warfaafinta, madaxda hay’adaha warbaahinta iyo mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka kala socda dalalka Afrika iyo Shiinaha, iyadoo looga hadlayo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada warbaahinta iyo is-dhaafsiga khibradaha. Ajandaha shirweynaha ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saarayaa casriyeynta hay’adaha warbaahinta, adeegsiga tiknoolajiyadda cusub, horumarinta xirfadaha shaqaalaha warbaahinta iyo is-weydaarsiga aqoonta iyo khibradaha. Wasiir Cabdulfataax Qaasim Maxamuud ayaa lagu wadaa inuu shirweynaha ka jeediyo khudbad uu kaga hadlayo horumarka warbaahinta gobolka, muhiimadda xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha ee dhinaca warbaahinta iyo dadaallada lagu horumarinayo awoodda hay’adaha warbaahinta Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, inta uu ku sugan yahay magaalada Beijing, Wasiirka ayaa kulammo la yeelanaya mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Shiinaha iyo qaar ka mid ah wasiirrada warfaafinta ee dalalka Afrika ee ka qeyb galaya shirweynaha. Kulamadaasi ayaa lagu wadaa in looga hadlo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa wada-shaqeynta, tababarrada, horumarinta tiknoolajiyadda warbaahinta iyo is-dhaafsiga khibradaha u dhexeeya Soomaaliya, Shiinaha iyo dalalka kale ee Afrika. Shirweynaha Afrika iyo Shiinaha ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu kobcinayo xiriirka labada dhinac, gaar ahaan doorka warbaahinta ee horumarinta xiriirka, is-fahamka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Afrika iyo Shiinaha.

items.title: Sacuudiga oo billaabay arrin sii xumeyneysa xiisadda kala dhaxeysa Imaaraadka Carabta
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sare u qaaday hubinta iyo kormeerka lagu sameynayo lacagaha laga diro boqortooyada ee ku wajahan Imaaraadka Carabta, tallaabo muujinaysa in khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale ee labada dal uu galay heer cusub. Sida ay ku warrantay wakaaladda Reuters, bankiyada Sacuudiga ayaa hadda lacagaha loo dirayo Imaaraadka marinaya baaritaanno dheeraad ah oo dhinaca shuruucda iyo la-dagaallanka dambiyada maaliyadeed ah, kuwaas oo sida caadiga ah lagu dabaqo waddamada loo arko inay khatar sare ka leeyihiin dhaqdhaqaaqyada lacagaha sharci-darrada ah. Saddex qof oo arrintan si toos ah xog-ogaal ugu ah ayaa Reuters u sheegay in tallaabooyinkan, oo aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin, ay Imaaraadka geliyeen liiska in ka badan lix waddan oo gobolka ku yaalla oo hay’adaha Sacuudigu u arkaan kuwo u baahan hubin maaliyadeed oo dheeraad ah. Ganacsato dhowr ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay la kulmeen dhibaatooyin markii ay isku dayeen inay lacag u diraan Imaaraadka, iyadoo wareejinno lacageed oo ku baxayey lacago kala duwan ay bangiyada Sacuudigu dib u dhigeen ama dib ugu celiyeen dirayaasha iyada oo aan loo sheegin sabab cad. Bangiga Dhexe ee Sacuudiga ayaa Reuters u sheegay in aysan jirin “xayiraado toos ah oo lagu soo rogay waddamo gaar ah”, halka mas’uul ka tirsan dowladda Imaaraadka uu sheegay in Wasaaradda Dhaqaalaha ee dalkaasi aysan helin cabashooyin uga yimid shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay oo la xiriira dib-u-dhac aan caadi ahayn oo ku yimid wareejinta lacagaha labada dal. Hase yeeshee, warbixinta Reuters ayaa sii xoojineysa walaaca muddooyinkii dambe ka jiray ganacsatada iyo maalgashadayaasha gobolka ee ku saabsan in khilaafka u dhexeeya Riyadh iyo Abu Dhabi uu hadda si toos ah u saameynayo xiriirka ganacsi. Bishii hore, Financial Times ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in lacagaha ay bankiyada Sacuudiga u dirayaan akoonnada ku yaalla Imaaraadka, gaar ahaan kuwa shirkadaha iyo shaqsiyaadka ku leh Dubai, dib loo celinayey ama la hakinayey tan iyo bishii May. Maamule reer galbeed ah oo ka tirsan shirkad caafimaad oo fadhigeedu yahay Dubai ayaa FT u sheegay in dhowr lacagood oo ay u soo dirtay shirkad muddo dheer macaamil kala dhexeyn jiray oo Sacuudiga ku taalla ay bangiyada Sacuudigu xannibeen kadibna dib u celiyeen. Khilaaf meelo badan gaaray Sacuudiga iyo Imaaraadka ayaa muddo dheer ahaa laba saaxiib oo aad isugu dhow, waxaana ay iska kaashadeen arrimo badan oo siyaasadeed, amni iyo dhaqaale oo gobolka Khaliijka ah. Hase yeeshee, sannadihii ugu dambeeyay waxaa soo ifbaxayay khilaafyo sii kordhaya oo ku saabsan Yemen, siyaasadda shidaalka, saameynta gobolka iyo xiriirka ay la leeyihiin quwadaha caalamka. Xiisadda ayaa si weyn u soo shaac baxday bishii December, markii Sacuudi Carabiya ay duqeyn cirka ah ku bartilmaameedsatay shixnad qalab militari oo Imaaraadku u waday Golaha Kumeel-gaarka Koonfurta Yemen (STC), oo ah urur gooni-u-goosad ah oo Abu Dhabi taageero. Dhacdadaas kadib, taageerayaasha labada dowladood ee baraha bulshada, falanqeeyayaasha iyo qaar ka mid ah warbaahinta ayaa galay dagaal afka ah oo aan hore loogu baran xiriirka labada dal. Bishii March, Imaaraadka ayaa xannibay akoonnada X ee telefishinka Al-Arabiya ee Sacuudiga, taas oo noqotay calaamad kale oo muujisay sida khilaafka labada dhinac uu uga gudbay kulamada qarsoodiga ah una soo baxay fagaaraha dadweynaha. Kala duwanaanshahooda ayaa sidoo kale muuqday intii uu socday dagaalka Iran. Imaaraadka ayaa qaatay mowqif aad u adag oo ku wajahan Tehran, iyadoo warbixinno la daabacay ay sheegeen inuu si firfircoon uga qeyb qaatay howlgalada militari ee ka dhanka ahaa Iran. Sacuudiga, dhankiisa, wuxuu qaaday siyaasad dheellitiran, isagoo cambaareeyay weerarrada Iran ay ku qaaday waddamada Khaliijka, isla markaana u oggolaaday Mareykanka inuu adeegsado saldhigga King Fahd ee magaalada Taif, balse dhinaca kale ku cadaadiyay in xal diblomaasiyadeed laga gaaro dagaalka, isaga oo wadahadallo la xiriira arrintaas u marayay Pakistan. Loollanka saliidda oo xoogeystay Khilaafka labada dal ayaa sidoo kale si weyn uga dhex muuqday suuqa tamarta. Bishii May, Imaaraadka ayaa ka baxay Ururka Dalalka Dhoofiya Shidaalka ee OPEC kadib ku dhowaad 60 sano oo uu xubin ka ahaa ururka ay Sacuudi Carabiya hoggaamiso. Abu Dhabi ayaa kadib sare u qaaday wax-soo-saarkeeda shidaalka, tallaabo sii kordhisay tartanka dhaqaale ee labada waddan. Sacuudiga iyo Imaaraadka ayaa sidoo kale sannadihii dambe ku tartamayay sidii mid kasta uu xarun ganacsi iyo maalgashi ugu noqon lahaa gobolka, iyadoo Riyadh ay shirkadaha caalamiga ah ku cadaadineysay inay xarumahooda gobolka u soo wareejiyaan Sacuudiga si ay u helaan qandaraasyada dowladda. Dubai ayaa muddo dheer ahayd xarunta ugu weyn ee ganacsiga iyo maaliyadda Bariga Dhexe, balse Sacuudiga ayaa hadda isku dayaya inuu qayb weyn ka helo maalgelinta iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee gobolka. Middle East Eye ayaa bishii July xaaladda labada dal ku tilmaantay “dagaal dhaqaale oo daal badan”, iyadoo sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah madaxda shirkadaha ay bilaabeen inay diyaarsadaan qorshayaal kale oo ganacsi haddii xiriirka Riyadh iyo Abu Dhabi uu kasii xumaado. Adkeynta cusub ee lagu sameeyay wareejinta lacagaha ayaa sidaas darteed noqon karta mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinka ugu muuqda ee muujinaya in khilaafkii siyaasadeed ee labada quwadood ee Khaliijka uu hadda si tartiib ah ugu sii gudbayo ganacsiga, bangiyada iyo dhaqaalaha. items.fullContent: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sare u qaaday hubinta iyo kormeerka lagu sameynayo lacagaha laga diro boqortooyada ee ku wajahan Imaaraadka Carabta, tallaabo muujinaysa in khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale ee labada dal uu galay heer cusub. Sida ay ku warrantay wakaaladda Reuters, bankiyada Sacuudiga ayaa hadda lacagaha loo dirayo Imaaraadka marinaya baaritaanno dheeraad ah oo dhinaca shuruucda iyo la-dagaallanka dambiyada maaliyadeed ah, kuwaas oo sida caadiga ah lagu dabaqo waddamada loo arko inay khatar sare ka leeyihiin dhaqdhaqaaqyada lacagaha sharci-darrada ah. Saddex qof oo arrintan si toos ah xog-ogaal ugu ah ayaa Reuters u sheegay in tallaabooyinkan, oo aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin, ay Imaaraadka geliyeen liiska in ka badan lix waddan oo gobolka ku yaalla oo hay’adaha Sacuudigu u arkaan kuwo u baahan hubin maaliyadeed oo dheeraad ah. Ganacsato dhowr ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay la kulmeen dhibaatooyin markii ay isku dayeen inay lacag u diraan Imaaraadka, iyadoo wareejinno lacageed oo ku baxayey lacago kala duwan ay bangiyada Sacuudigu dib u dhigeen ama dib ugu celiyeen dirayaasha iyada oo aan loo sheegin sabab cad. Bangiga Dhexe ee Sacuudiga ayaa Reuters u sheegay in aysan jirin “xayiraado toos ah oo lagu soo rogay waddamo gaar ah”, halka mas’uul ka tirsan dowladda Imaaraadka uu sheegay in Wasaaradda Dhaqaalaha ee dalkaasi aysan helin cabashooyin uga yimid shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay oo la xiriira dib-u-dhac aan caadi ahayn oo ku yimid wareejinta lacagaha labada dal. Hase yeeshee, warbixinta Reuters ayaa sii xoojineysa walaaca muddooyinkii dambe ka jiray ganacsatada iyo maalgashadayaasha gobolka ee ku saabsan in khilaafka u dhexeeya Riyadh iyo Abu Dhabi uu hadda si toos ah u saameynayo xiriirka ganacsi. Bishii hore, Financial Times ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in lacagaha ay bankiyada Sacuudiga u dirayaan akoonnada ku yaalla Imaaraadka, gaar ahaan kuwa shirkadaha iyo shaqsiyaadka ku leh Dubai, dib loo celinayey ama la hakinayey tan iyo bishii May. Maamule reer galbeed ah oo ka tirsan shirkad caafimaad oo fadhigeedu yahay Dubai ayaa FT u sheegay in dhowr lacagood oo ay u soo dirtay shirkad muddo dheer macaamil kala dhexeyn jiray oo Sacuudiga ku taalla ay bangiyada Sacuudigu xannibeen kadibna dib u celiyeen. Khilaaf meelo badan gaaray Sacuudiga iyo Imaaraadka ayaa muddo dheer ahaa laba saaxiib oo aad isugu dhow, waxaana ay iska kaashadeen arrimo badan oo siyaasadeed, amni iyo dhaqaale oo gobolka Khaliijka ah. Hase yeeshee, sannadihii ugu dambeeyay waxaa soo ifbaxayay khilaafyo sii kordhaya oo ku saabsan Yemen, siyaasadda shidaalka, saameynta gobolka iyo xiriirka ay la leeyihiin quwadaha caalamka. Xiisadda ayaa si weyn u soo shaac baxday bishii December, markii Sacuudi Carabiya ay duqeyn cirka ah ku bartilmaameedsatay shixnad qalab militari oo Imaaraadku u waday Golaha Kumeel-gaarka Koonfurta Yemen (STC), oo ah urur gooni-u-goosad ah oo Abu Dhabi taageero. Dhacdadaas kadib, taageerayaasha labada dowladood ee baraha bulshada, falanqeeyayaasha iyo qaar ka mid ah warbaahinta ayaa galay dagaal afka ah oo aan hore loogu baran xiriirka labada dal. Bishii March, Imaaraadka ayaa xannibay akoonnada X ee telefishinka Al-Arabiya ee Sacuudiga, taas oo noqotay calaamad kale oo muujisay sida khilaafka labada dhinac uu uga gudbay kulamada qarsoodiga ah una soo baxay fagaaraha dadweynaha. Kala duwanaanshahooda ayaa sidoo kale muuqday intii uu socday dagaalka Iran. Imaaraadka ayaa qaatay mowqif aad u adag oo ku wajahan Tehran, iyadoo warbixinno la daabacay ay sheegeen inuu si firfircoon uga qeyb qaatay howlgalada militari ee ka dhanka ahaa Iran. Sacuudiga, dhankiisa, wuxuu qaaday siyaasad dheellitiran, isagoo cambaareeyay weerarrada Iran ay ku qaaday waddamada Khaliijka, isla markaana u oggolaaday Mareykanka inuu adeegsado saldhigga King Fahd ee magaalada Taif, balse dhinaca kale ku cadaadiyay in xal diblomaasiyadeed laga gaaro dagaalka, isaga oo wadahadallo la xiriira arrintaas u marayay Pakistan. Loollanka saliidda oo xoogeystay Khilaafka labada dal ayaa sidoo kale si weyn uga dhex muuqday suuqa tamarta. Bishii May, Imaaraadka ayaa ka baxay Ururka Dalalka Dhoofiya Shidaalka ee OPEC kadib ku dhowaad 60 sano oo uu xubin ka ahaa ururka ay Sacuudi Carabiya hoggaamiso. Abu Dhabi ayaa kadib sare u qaaday wax-soo-saarkeeda shidaalka, tallaabo sii kordhisay tartanka dhaqaale ee labada waddan. Sacuudiga iyo Imaaraadka ayaa sidoo kale sannadihii dambe ku tartamayay sidii mid kasta uu xarun ganacsi iyo maalgashi ugu noqon lahaa gobolka, iyadoo Riyadh ay shirkadaha caalamiga ah ku cadaadineysay inay xarumahooda gobolka u soo wareejiyaan Sacuudiga si ay u helaan qandaraasyada dowladda. Dubai ayaa muddo dheer ahayd xarunta ugu weyn ee ganacsiga iyo maaliyadda Bariga Dhexe, balse Sacuudiga ayaa hadda isku dayaya inuu qayb weyn ka helo maalgelinta iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee gobolka. Middle East Eye ayaa bishii July xaaladda labada dal ku tilmaantay “dagaal dhaqaale oo daal badan”, iyadoo sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah madaxda shirkadaha ay bilaabeen inay diyaarsadaan qorshayaal kale oo ganacsi haddii xiriirka Riyadh iyo Abu Dhabi uu kasii xumaado. Adkeynta cusub ee lagu sameeyay wareejinta lacagaha ayaa sidaas darteed noqon karta mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinka ugu muuqda ee muujinaya in khilaafkii siyaasadeed ee labada quwadood ee Khaliijka uu hadda si tartiib ah ugu sii gudbayo ganacsiga, bangiyada iyo dhaqaalaha. items.title: Lubnaan oo Suuriya u gacan geliyay Jeneraal hore oo ka tirsanaa ciidankii Bashaar Al-Asad
items.description: Dowladda Lubnaan ayaa mas’uuliyiinta Suuriya ku wareejisay Jeneraal hore oo sare uga tirsanaa ciidankii dowladdii Bashaar Al-Asad, kaas oo wajahaya eedeymo la xiriira dil, jirdil iyo dambiyo kale oo culus. Jeneraalka la wareejiyay ayaa lagu magacaabaa Cadel Ciise (Adel Issa) , oo 67 jir ah. Wuxuu horey u ahaa taliyihii Qaybta 17-aad ee ciidanka Suuriya, waxaana markii dambe loo magacaabay hoggaaminta ciidamada dhulka ee gobolka Deir ez-Zur. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Suuriya ayaa xaqiijisay in Ciise lagu wareejiyay gacanta dowladda Suuriya, iyadoo sheegtay in amar qabasho oo kasoo baxay Suuriya uu ku eedeynayo dambiyo ay ka mid yihiin dil ula kac ah, fududeynta dembi culus, dilka in ka badan laba qof, jirdil sababay dhimasho iyo falal lagu hurinayay dagaal sokeeye iyo colaado kooxeed. Kiiska Jeneraalka ayaa loo gudbin doonaa garsoore baaritaan oo ku sugan Dimishiq, kaas oo go’aamin kara in dacwadda loo gudbiyo maxkamad dembiyeed si loo qaado maxkamadeyn rasmi ah. Wararka ay soo xigatay Reuters ayaa sheegaya in Cadel Ciise uu beeniyay dhammaan eedeymaha loo jeediyay. Waxaa la xiray 8-dii Agoosto , kaddib markii uu tegay safaaradda Suuriya ee magaalada Beyruut si uu uga shaqeysto arrimo la xiriira waraaqihiisa. Mas’uuliyiinta safaaradda ayaa markii ay ogaadeen inuu yahay qof ay Suuriya dooneyso, waxay arrinta u gudbiyeen xafiiska xeer-ilaalinta Lubnaan, waxaana halkaas ka dib lagu qabtay. Wareejinta Jeneraal Ciise ayaa noqoneysa markii ugu horreysay ee Lubnaan ay Suuriya ku wareejiso sarkaal militari oo hore uga tirsanaa nidaamkii Bashaar Al-Asad tan iyo markii xukuumaddii Al-Asad ay burburtay dhammaadkii 2024. Dowladda cusub ee Suuriya, oo uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Axmed Al-Sharaa , ayaa muddooyinkii dambe cadaadis ku saareysay Lubnaan inay tallaabo ka qaaddo saraakiishii hore ee militariga iyo amniga ee u qaxay dalkaas kaddib burburkii nidaamkii Al-Asad. Bishii Janaayo, mas’uuliyiinta Suuriya ayaa saraakiisha amniga Lubnaan u gudbiyay liis ay ku jiraan in ka badan 200 oo sarkaal oo sare oo ka tirsanaa dowladdii hore , kuwaas oo Damascus ay dooneyso in loo soo qabto. Dhanka kale, maxkamad ku taalla Dimishiq ayaa horraantii bishan xukun dil ah, isagoo maqan, ku ridday Bashaar Al-Asad, iyadoo lagu soo oogay eedeymo ay ka mid yihiin dil, xarig sharci-darro ah iyo jirdil. Al-Asad ayaa hadda ku nool magaalada Moscow.

items.title: Israel Arms Somaliland
Soomaali kiis xasaasi ah loogu maxkamadeynayo UK
items.description: London (Caasimada Online) – Maxkamad ku taalla dalka Ingiriiska ayaa dambi ku heshay nin Soomaali ah oo u safray Soomaaliya isaga oo doonayay inuu ku biiro kooxda Daacish, balse ku guuldarreystay inuu gaaro goobaha ay kooxdaasi kaga sugan tahay Puntland. Mohamed Mohamoud, oo 22 jir ah, deggenaa magaalada Bristol, ayaa lagu helay inuu diyaarinayay falal argagixiso, kaddib maxkamadeyn ka dhacday Winchester Crown Court. Mohamoud ayaa inkiray eedda ah inuu diyaarinayay falal argagixiso, balse wuxuu qirtay inuu isku dayay inuu ku biiro Daacish. Xeer-ilaaliyeyaasha ayaa maxkamadda u sheegay in Mohamoud uu Soomaaliya u safray bishii Janaayo 2025, isaga oo doonayay inuu gaaro dagaalyahannada Daacish ee ku sugan dhulka buuraleyda ah ee Puntland, gaar ahaan deegaannada ku dhow magaalada Boosaaso. Naomi Parsons oo kiiska ku mataleysay xeer-ilaalinta ayaa sheegtay in Mohamoud uu xagjir noqday intii uu ku noolaa Britain, isla markaana uu qaatay fikradaha kooxda Daacish. Waxay sheegtay in ujeeddadiisu aysan ku koobneyn oo keliya inuu kooxda ku biiro, balse uu sidoo kale doonayay inuu dagaallamo oo uu naftiisa u huro kooxda. “Wuxuu lahaa rabitaan xooggan oo ah inuu Soomaaliya ku laabto, kuna biiro Daacish iyo dagaalyahannada ka howlgala buuraha ku dhow Boosaaso, waqooyiga Puntland,” ayay maxkamadda u sheegtay Parsons. Sida ay xeer-ilaalintu sheegtay, Mohamoud ayaa marka hore isku dayay inuu helo xiriir u fududeeya ku biirista kooxda, balse markii uu ku guuldarreystay ayuu haddana goostay inuu Soomaaliya u safro, isaga oo 30-kii Janaayo 2025 ka duulay Britain. Maxkamadda ayaa sidoo kale loo sheegay inuu la xiriiray barnaamij sirdoon macmal ah oo ay adeegsadaan xubno la sheegay inay Daacish u qaabilsan yihiin kala saarista iyo qiimeynta dadka doonaya inay kooxda ku biiraan. Inkasta oo Mohamoud uu haystay tikidh soo-noqosho oo ku beegnaa 3-dii Maarso, xeer-ilaalintu waxay sheegtay in fariimo ay heleen baarayaashu ay muujinayeen inuusan markii hore qorsheyneyn inuu Britain dib ugu laabto. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu ugu dambeyn ku guuldarreystay inuu gaaro kooxda, arrintaas oo xeer-ilaalintu ku xiriirisay howlgallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada ee xilligaas ka socday Soomaaliya. Puntland ayaa muddadaas wadday howlgallo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah Daacish, gaar ahaan buuraha Calmiskaad ee gobolka Bari, halkaas oo kooxda ay saldhigyo ku lahayd. Mohamoud ayaa Britain dib ugu laabtay 3-dii Maarso 2025. Xeer-ilaalintu waxay sheegtay inuu xitaa markii uu dib ugu noqday Britain sii waday xiriirkii uu la lahaa dadkii uu doonayay inay ka caawiyaan ku biirista Daacish. Fariin loo soo bandhigay maxkamadda ayuu ku sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu Soomaaliya dib ugu laabto marka loogu yeero. Mohamoud oo isaguna maxkamadda ka hor hadlay ayaa sheegay inuu Soomaaliya ku dhashay, balse waalidkiis ay kala tageen markii uu saddex jir ahaa, kaddibna isaga iyo walaalkiis ka yar ay la noolaadeen hooyadood labaad oo ku sugneyd Imaaraadka Carabta. Wuxuu sheegay inuu muddo u kala noolaa Soomaaliya iyo Imaaraadka, ka hor inta uusan 2020, isaga oo 16 ama 17 jir ah, u guurin Bristol si uu ula noolaado hooyadiis. Mohamoud ayaa sheegay inuu kulliyad ka bartay Ingiriisiga, xisaabta iyo cunto-karinta, isla markaana uusan markii hore si weyn ugu xirneyn arrimaha diinta. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu maxkamadda u sheegay inuu markii dambe bilaabay daawashada muuqaallo diimeed oo lagu baahiyo YouTube, gaar ahaan kanaal lagu magacaabo BlackBeardGuy. Wuxuu sheegay in muuqaallo “xagjir ah” oo uu ka daawaday YouTube iyo TikTok ay kordhiyeen xiisihiisa diinta iyo fikirka ah inuu ku biiro Daacish. Xeer-beegtida Winchester Crown Court ayaa ugu dambeyn ku heshay dambiga ah diyaarinta falal argagixiso. Xukunka lagu ridayo Mohamoud ayaa la filayaa in maxkamaddu ku dhawaaqdo marxaladda xigta ee kiiska. The post Soomaali kiis xasaasi ah loogu maxkamadeynayo UK appeared first on Caasimada Online .
