items.description: Somalia and Türkiye have marked 15 years of partnership and friendship, with Somali Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre praising Ankara's support and calling for deeper economic and political ties between the two countries.

items.title: Ganacsiga malabka oo bog cusub oo nololeed u furay danyar ku nool Shabeellaha hoose
items.description: (ERGO) – Ku dhawaad 80 dhallinyaro oo ku nool magaalada Marka ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose ayaa fursad shaqo abuur oo guulaystay ka helay ka ganacsiga malabka shinnida oo ay billaabeen lixdii bil ee la soo dhaafay. Abuukar Dhayib Nuux oo ah curadka qoys sideed qof ka kooban wuxuu subaxdii ilaa gabbal-dhicii lug ku soo maraa xaafadaha magaalada isaga oo gacmaha ku wata caagado uu ka buuxdo malab leh cabbiro kala duwan. Wuxuu shaqadan qabtaa xilli ay dad ka harsanayaan fallaaraha caddeeda. Wuxuu albaabada u garaacaa guryaha isaga oo raadinaya cid ka gadata. Waxaa u dheer inuu tago goobaha ganacsiyada iyo barkulannada bulshada. Shaqadan ayaa u suuragelisay isku filnaan. Ninkan ayaa tilmaamay in hawshan ay u noqotay il dhaqaale oo isaga iyo qoyskiisa ay kaga baxeen nolol xumo ay la halgamayeen. Wuxuu xusay inuu awood u yeeshay maaraynta baahiyaha aasaasiga ah. “Shaqadan waxay iga fududeysay culeysyo badan; kirada guriga inaan iska bixiyo, layrka inaan bixiyo, daawada aabbahay oo xanuunsan inaan iibsado, iyo walaalahay oo aabbahay iskuulka ka bixin jiray inaan hadda anigu ka bixiyo, iyagoo dhigta dugsi dhexe.” Ninkan ayaa sheegay inay shaqadan ka caawisay saddex walaalihii ah bishii  juun inuu ka diiwaan galiyay iskuulka  Alnuur,  isaga bille uga bixiya  $18 wadartooda. Abuukar ayaa Radio Ergo u sheegay in shaqadan uu billaabay bishii Febraayo ee sanadkan, markii uu aabbihii  oo reerka u xoogsi tagi jiray uu la dhul-dhacay  cudurka qallalalka oo uu ku sheegay dhakhtar loo geeyay. Wuxuu tilmaamay inay muteen nolol adag markii uu sariir-yaal noqday maaddaama uu ahaa qofka keliya reerka u dhaqdhaqaaqa. Wuxuu isku hawlay sidii uu masuuliyadda walaalihii iyo hooyadii ula wareegi lahaa. Ninkan ayaa intaas ku daray inuu ka ganacsiga malabka ku dhiirraday markii uu helay $150 oo dayn ah. Wuxuu xusay inuu maanta yeeshay macaamiil badan, isaga oo ku qiimeeyay ganacsigiisa hanti u dhiganta $1,400. Abuukar ayaa shaqadan maalin kasta ka hela dakhli gaaraya $10. Wuxuu tilmaamay in dhaqaalaha soo gala marka laga tago biilka inuu u suuragalisay inuu dib u galo jaamacadda uu qarashkeeda horey u bixin waayay. Hadda wuxuu dhigtaa simistarka 3aad. “Shaqadan ka hor culeysyo badan ayaa i haystay. Jaamacad ayaan dhiganayay, laakiin markii aabbahay xanuunsaday lacagtii waxbarashada waa la waayay, waxaana joojiyay semesterkii labaad.” “Hadda markii ay shaqadu ii hagaagtay dib ayaan ugu laabtay waxbarashadii jaamacadda. Alxamdulillaah, shaqadan wax badan ayay ka beddeshay nolosheennii hore.” Ninkan ayaa xusay in halkii litir ee malabka ah uu ku iibiyo $16, balse dadka uu uga iibiyo hab shub-shub ah, iyadoo qof kasta laga iibiyo inta uu awoodo. Abuukar ayaa tilmaamay in malabka uu iibiyo uu uga yimaado deegaanno hoostaga magaalada Marka, halkaas oo shinida lagu dhaqdo. Wuxuu xusay in qorshihiisa xiga uu yahay inuu sameysto goob lagu xanaaneeyo shinida. “Waxaan ku hamiyayaa inaan noqdo ganacsade weyn. Hadda waxaan ahay ganacsade yar, balse waxaan jeclahay inaan sameysto xero lagu dhaqdo shinida oo aan kamid noqdo dadka soo saara malabka hamigaas ayaan leeyahay.” Qoyska Abuukar oo weligood ka soo mid ahaa danyarta magaalada ayay shaqadan u noqotay mid u furmay bog cusub oo nololeed. Ninkan ayaa sheegay inuu ku hamminayo inuu qoyskiisa iyo naftiisa uu horumar ka gaarsiiyo ganacsigan. Dadka faa’iidada dhaqaale ka sameeya ka ganacsiga malabka waxaa ka mid ah Liibaan Haashim Nuune. Wuxuu sheegay in shaqadan ay u suuragelisay qoyskiisa oo ka kooban toddobo qof inay helaan cunno saddex waqti ah. Liibaan ayaa tilmaamay in shaqadan ay u fududeysay shan walaalihii ah inay helaan waxbarasho, isagoo bishii ka bixiya isku darkooda $25. Wuxuu xusay in ganacsiga malabka uu ku bilaabay $100 oo uu soo amaahday, isla markaana maanta uu ka sameeyo dakhli wanaagsan. Wuxuu iska guday deyntii uu ku bilaabay. Wuxuu ku qiimeeyay ganacsigiisa maanta qiimo dhan $1,650. Ninkan ayaa xusay inuu ganacsigan soo waday tan iyo bishii April ee sanadkan, xilligaas oo uu la wareegay mas’uuliyadda qoyskiisa, markii walaalkiis oo curadka reerka ahaa uu tahriib u baxay, kaas oo uu tilmaamay inaan ilaa hadda meelna lagu ogeyn. “Aabbe hadda ma joogo, wuu naga dhintay. Wiil aniga iga weyn ayaa xaafadda hayay, isagana wuu tahriibay. Shan carruur ah iyo hooyadood ayaa xaafadda jooga. Aniga ayaa hadda walaalkood weyn ah, Ilaah ka sokow aniga ayaa wax la iga sugaa.” Liibaan ayaa sheegay in  maalintii ugu horreysay ee uu faa’iido ka helay ganacsigiisa uu dareemay farxad aad u weyn iyo kalsooni ah inuu keligii meell iska soo saari karo, taas oo ku dhiirrigelisay inuu sii wado. Wuxuu sheegay in ka hor inta uusan bilaabin shaqadan uu talo iyo xog ka uruuriyay dhalinyaro hore uga shaqeynaysay, kuwaas oo u tilmaamay in laga heli karo dhaqaale daboola nolol maalmeedka. Liibaan ayaa sheegay in malabka uu ka keeno deegaanka Siinaay ee duleedka magaalada Marka u jira qiyaastii 18 km. Wuxuu xusay in markii hore qoyskoodu ay ku noolaayeen guri burbursan oo hal qol ka koobnaa kaasi oo ay si ku meel gaar ah u deganaayeen, balse maanta ay deggan yihiin guri kiro ah oo laba qol ka kooban, oo uu bishii ka dhiibo $30. Ninkan ayaa sheegay in ganacsiga malabka uu leeyahay caqabado, gaar ahaan macaamiisha qaarkood oo mararka qaar deyn ku qaata, kuwaas oo uu xusay inay ku dhibaan lacag, taas oo shaqadiisa sii socoshadeeda dhib ku ah, maaddaama uu isku celceliyo faa’iidada iyo lafaha. Liibaan wuxuu fariin u diray dhallinyarada ay shaqo la’aantu hayso, isagoo ku boorriyay inaysan liidin shaqooyinka yaryar, maaddaama ay noqon karaan jidka lagu gaaro horumar dhaqaale. “Dhalinyarada waxaan leeyahay shaqooyinka yaryar yaanay yasin ee ha galaan, maxaa yeelay shaqooyinka yaryar hadhow way koraan. Qofka maanta ganacsigiisu yar yahay berri wuxuu noqon karaa ganacsade meel fog gaaray.” Qoyska liibaan shaqadan uu maanta ku jiro waxay u noqotay wado ay kaga baxeen nolol xumo heysatay sannado badan, wuxuu tilmaamay in ganacsigan wareejinta ah uu qorsheynayo inuu ka guuro isla markaana uu iibsado xarun loogu soo hagaago  oo magaalada dhexdeeda ah. Dhanka kale, Maxamed Xuseen Maxamed oo ah guddoomiyaha guddi ay ku mideysanyihiin dadka ka ganacsada malabka ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay inay sii kordhayaan tirada da’yarta  shaqo  abuurka ka sameysanaya ganacsigan ee degmada ku nool. Wuxuu xusay in malabka caqabadaha la soo gudboonaada ay ugu weyntahay xilliga uu suuqa ka yaraado taas oo ay ugu wacan tahay xilli roobaadka marka la gaaro oo ay adkaato in la helo noocyada la jecel yahay ee laga keeno miyiga fog. “Malabka cad badanaa wuxuu nooga yimaadaa Tiyeeglow, Beydhaba, Bay iyo Bakool dhulkaas ayuu nooga yimaadaa. Malabka gaduudka isna waxaa laga helaa Sh.Hoose iyo Hiiraan, maaddaama dhulkii fogyahay waddooyinkiina  raf yihiin caqabadaas ku qabnaa.” Shaqooyinka yaryar ee ay samaynstaan dhallinyarada ayaa qeyb ka qaadan kara bilidda hab nololkooda iyo kan qoysaskooda balse waxay u baahan yihiin taageero dhaqaale iyo in lagu kabo talooyin iyo aqoon kor u qaada kartidooda ganacsiga. items.title: Qaraxyo argagax ku abuuray shacabka oo laga maqlay Baydhabo
items.description: Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa waxaa xalay abaare 10:00pm laga maqlay illaa saddex qarax oo ahaa hoobiyeyaal. Militariga Itoobiya ee qaybta ka ah Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ayaa hoobiyeyaasha ka riday xeradooda oo ku dhex taal Madaxtooyada Baydhabo. Jugta hoobiyeyaashan ayaa argagax geliyay dadka deegaanka, ka hor inta aan la ogaan inay ahaayeen hoobiyeyaal laga tuuray Madaxtooyada, iyadoo dadku ay muddo ku jahwareersanaayeen, waxa ay yihiin qaraxyadaasi oo laga maqlay magaalada oo dhan. Saraakiisha Taliska Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa kuu sheegaya in hoobiyeyaasha lagu garaacay goob ku taala duleedka waqooyi bari ee magaalada, isla-markaana ay ku sugnaayeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dadka reer Baydhabo ayaa noqday kuwo ay dhegta u taagan tahay, wixii ka dambeeyay dagaalkii ay dadka badani ku dhinteen ee Isniintii ka dhacay magaaladaasi. Ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) oo lagu eedeeyay inay garabsanayaan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ayaa hadaf ka dhiganaya magaaladan, maadaama ay ogyihiin inuu maamulku ku shaqeeyo, isla-markaana ay ku yaallaan Xarumaha Madaxtooyada iyo Baarlamaanka. Baydhabo waa magaalada ugu weyn, uguna dadka badan Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ee Somaliya. Inkastoo xaaladda magaalada ay tahay mid degan, haddana dareenka dadka ayaa ah mid weli kacsan, iyaga oo ka cabsi qaba dagaal kale.

items.title: Somaliland and the Red Sea Corridor
items.description: Major (Ret) Andrew Fox The United Kingdom should recognise Somaliland as an independent state, a recommendation that would have been easier to avoid a few years ago, when London could still treat Somaliland as a useful but unresolved anomaly. Such a position is harder to sustain now. Israel’s recognition of Somaliland in December 2025 ended the fiction that the status quo is frozen. The question for the UK is no longer whether recognition will ever become a live policy issue. It is a question of whether Britain will shape that debate or allow others to define it for narrower regional purposes. READ OUR REPORT

items.title: Home schooling in Hargeisa expands opportunity for education
items.description: For 23-year-old Asma Ismail Ahmed, teaching is no longer confined to the classroom. Every afternoon, she goes from home to home in Hargeisa, teaching children and adults who were unable to attend school because of financial constraints or limited access to schools. Asma began the service in May as part of a group of eight young teachers, visiting densely populated neighbourhoods across the city where there are few schools. The work provides her with a source of income and enables those who otherwise miss out to get educated. Each family pays between $5 and $10 a month, depending on what they can afford. “We first explain to the parents what we teach and the lessons we can help their children with. We also show them how we teach and give them a short trial period so they can see the changes and progress their children are making. Once a family is satisfied with the way we teach, they then help us connect with other families,” Asma explained. Her interest in teaching began when she was in middle school. Teaching now earns her between $150 and $200 a month that supports her family of six, who have also faced their own hardship. Asma became the main provider for the household after her father, who worked as a house painter, lost his job with a company in February. After several difficult months during which the family struggled to afford food, she began taking on the teaching work. She is now able to cover household food costs and contribute to the education of her younger siblings. “Financial hardship was the main reason I took this step. At the same time, we knew this service would benefit the community because many families cannot afford to send all their children to expensive schools. So this work helps both us and the community,” she said. Demand for the service is growing as more families learn about it through the teachers’ door-to-door outreach. “We try to teach each person according to their level of knowledge and what suits them. For a young child, we make the lessons simple and interesting, and we encourage them with kind words and praise,” she said. “For adults, we show them that education has no age limit and that learning can help them in their daily lives.” A committee oversees the programme with nearly 200 young teachers, organised into different groups, now earning an income through home-based teaching. Most are recent secondary school graduates, like Nuura Ali Ahmed, 20, who joined the programme after completing secondary school at Sheikh Ali Ibrahim School this year. She teaches in more than 40 homes across Hargeisa, mornings and afternoons, earning $200 to $300 a month. She said continued engagement and explanation of the programme eventually convinced more families to enrol their children. Each household typically has at least three learners, including children and adults. Malyuun Omar Hussein, a parent, has enrolled her seven children, the youngest aged five. She bought a blackboard and other learning materials for the lessons held at home and pays $5 a month, about a quarter of what it would cost to send the children to school. “My children are now students. They have been receiving lessons for two months,” she said. “They charge us a small and affordable fee to teach the children. It has benefited us, and the children understand the lessons well.” Malyuun said she was considering giving up on the children’s educations because school fees of around $6 per child were difficult for the family to afford. Her husband, whose work is irregular, is the main source of household income. The children are studying mathematics, Somali language, social studies and other basic lessons at home. Seeing their progress has encouraged Malyuun to consider joining the lessons herself. Ergo

items.title: Turkish Warship Reportedly Strikes Men Returning from Hijacked Lutuf
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — A dramatic and potentially dangerous escalation has reportedly unfolded along Somalia’s southern coastline after a Drones off a Turkish naval vessel positioned near the hijacked cargo ship Lutuf allegedly opened fire on a group of men returning from the vessel, killing four and injuring two others. According to information obtained by WardheerNews, the six men had traveled to the Lutuf aboard a small boat, reportedly providing services or supplies to the vessel while it remained under the control of Somali pirates. The men were reportedly attacked after returning to the shoreline. Sources say the strike occurred shortly after the group reached the coast and was carried out by a Turkish warship operating near the location of the hijacked Lutuf. Four of the six men were reportedly killed, while the remaining two sustained injuries. The circumstances surrounding the incident remain unclear, and there has been no official statement from the Turkish government, the Somali Federal Government or Puntland authorities confirming that a Turkish vessel carried out the strike. The reported attack, if confirmed, would represent a remarkable escalation in Turkey’s involvement in the unfolding Lutuf piracy crisis. A Naval Response Takes a Dramatic Turn The Lutuf was seized by Somali pirates earlier this week after being intercepted off Somalia’s southern coast. The pirates reportedly used another vessel, the Sward, which had previously come under their control, to facilitate the operation. The situation has now developed into a much larger maritime standoff. According to information available to WardheerNews, three vessels—the Lutuf, Sward and Asana—are currently being held in the Garmaal area, where the pirates are reportedly maintaining control over the ships while demanding ransom payments. The presence of Turkish naval forces near the hijacked vessels has added an entirely new dimension to the crisis. Rather than simply being a conventional piracy incident, the confrontation now appears to involve a powerful foreign naval force operating close to vessels controlled by armed pirates along Somalia’s coastline. The reported deaths of four men have intensified concerns over what is happening around the hijacked vessels. According to sources, the six men were traveling in a small boat and had approached the Lutuf to provide services to those aboard the vessel. After completing their task, they reportedly returned toward the shoreline. It was during or shortly after their return that they came under attack. The exact circumstances remain unknown. Were they mistaken for pirates? Was the vessel they were using considered a threat? Did the Turkish warship have intelligence indicating that armed individuals were operating from the shoreline? Or was the incident connected to an attempt to prevent supplies or assistance from reaching the hijacked ship? Those questions remain unanswered. The involvement of the Sward may also be critical to understanding the latest development. Sources indicate that the pirates who seized the Lutuf had previously taken control of the Sward and subsequently used it in the operation against the cargo vessel. The two vessels are now reportedly being held in the same coastal area, alongside the Asana. The pirates have reportedly demanded ransom payments for the release of the vessels and their crews. This means that the Turkish naval presence may now be aimed not simply at monitoring the Lutuf, but at disrupting the pirates’ wider maritime network and preventing the hijacked vessels from being moved or resupplied. Why Has Turkey Become So Involved? The reported strike also raises the central question surrounding the Lutuf crisis: why is Turkey taking such an unusually aggressive interest in this particular vessel? As previously reported, there are indications that the Lutuf could be carrying cargo connected to Turkish commercial, construction or strategic activities in Somalia. Those reports have not been independently verified. But if the vessel is carrying Turkish-owned or strategically sensitive equipment, Ankara may regard its recovery as a matter extending beyond ordinary commercial piracy. Turkey already maintains a significant military and security relationship with Somalia and has invested heavily in the country’s infrastructure, maritime security and defense institutions. The reported presence of Turkish warships near the Lutuf therefore represents a potentially important demonstration of Ankara’s willingness to protect its interests along Somalia’s coastline. Silence From Authorities Perhaps most striking is the absence of an official explanation. No government has publicly accepted responsibility for the reported strike. WardheerNews attempted to obtain information from Puntland officials regarding the incident but was unable to reach officials capable of providing an immediate response. The lack of official information has left residents and observers attempting to reconstruct events from fragmentary reports emerging from the coastline. That uncertainty is particularly troubling given the reported loss of life. If a foreign naval vessel did carry out the strike, the incident would raise serious questions about the rules of engagement being applied in Somali territorial waters, the intelligence behind the operation and the status of civilians or service providers operating near hijacked vessels. The Lutuf crisis has already demonstrated that Somali piracy, despite years of international efforts to suppress it, has not disappeared entirely. But the reported Garmaal strike suggests something potentially more serious: the return of piracy could now be drawing a direct military response from one of Somalia’s most powerful foreign security partners. Three vessels remain reportedly under pirate control. Ransom demands remain unresolved. And four people are now reportedly dead following an incident whose circumstances have yet to be publicly explained. For Somalia, the stakes are no longer limited to the safe release of hijacked ships. The country is now facing questions about foreign military operations along its coastline, the protection of civilian lives, the authority of local administrations and the increasingly complex security interests surrounding its strategic waters. Until Ankara, Mogadishu or Puntland provides a clear account of what happened at Garmaal, one disturbing question will remain at the center of the crisis: What exactly happened when those six men came ashore—and why did a Turkish warship reportedly open fire? items.title: Hassan Sheikh Says Somalia Is Ready to Take Full Security Responsibility as Foreign Forces Prepare to Leave
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has declared that the time has come for Somalia’s armed forces to assume full responsibility for the country’s security as international troops gradually reduce their presence, presenting the graduation of thousands of newly trained soldiers as evidence of growing national military capacity. The President made the remarks during a graduation ceremony at the Xananbuure military training center in Galgaduud, where thousands of soldiers who had undergone nearly a year of training graduated. The Federal Government described the graduating class as the largest single group of Somali troops trained inside the country at this level since the collapse of Somalia’s central government in 1991. Addressing the recruits, Hassan Sheikh urged them to uphold military discipline, protect national unity and defend Somalia’s sovereignty. “Our time has come. It is time for us to assume responsibility,” the President said. The declaration comes at a critical moment for Somalia’s security transition. The future of the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) remains uncertain, while the mission’s current United Nations authorization is due to expire at the end of December 2026. Somalia is therefore under increasing pressure to demonstrate that its own security institutions can assume responsibilities previously carried by international forces. The Reality Beyond the Graduation Ceremony The graduation represents an important development for Somalia’s military institutions, but the reality on the ground remains considerably more complicated. Training thousands of soldiers is one thing. Deploying them effectively, supplying them, maintaining discipline, protecting their bases, coordinating intelligence and ensuring that they can hold territory after military operations is another. Somalia continues to face a determined Al-Shabaab insurgency capable of conducting complex attacks, exploiting weaknesses in government-controlled areas and maintaining influence across parts of the countryside. The central challenge is therefore not simply whether Somalia can produce more soldiers. It is whether the state can build a military institution capable of sustaining operations over time. Previous military campaigns have demonstrated that government forces can capture territory but have sometimes struggled to consolidate those gains once frontline units move forward or international support is reduced. That makes logistics, command and control, intelligence, local cooperation and post-operation governance just as important as battlefield strength. The Xananbuure graduates are expected to play an important role in security operations across central Somalia, where government forces and local partners continue to confront Al-Shabaab. Their deployment will provide an early test of whether Somalia’s expanding military training programs are translating into sustainable operational capability. The government has increasingly emphasized the development of a larger, more professional national army as international forces gradually reduce their role. But the transition carries considerable risks. If newly trained forces are deployed without adequate logistical support, reliable command structures and sufficient intelligence, increased troop numbers alone may not produce the desired security gains. Conversely, if the government succeeds in combining the new recruits with experienced commanders, effective intelligence networks, community cooperation and sustained financial support, the expanded force could represent an important step toward genuine security self-reliance. The Moment of Truth President Hassan Sheikh’s message at Xananbuure reflects an important national aspiration: Somalia wants to become responsible for its own security rather than remain indefinitely dependent on foreign forces. But that ambition will ultimately be judged not at graduation ceremonies, but on the roads, in rural communities and on the front lines. The real test will be whether these soldiers can protect civilians, hold territory, prevent Al-Shabaab from returning to areas cleared by government forces and maintain security after international troops withdraw. For Somalia, the countdown has effectively begun. With international military support facing an uncertain future, the country has less time to transform newly trained soldiers into a professional, sustainable and nationally trusted security force. The graduation at Xananbuure may therefore be more than a ceremony. It may be an early measure of whether Somalia is genuinely ready to stand on its own—or whether the transition from international security assistance to national responsibility will prove more difficult than political speeches suggest. items.title: Jaamac oo digniin culus u diray xildhibaannada, kuna dhawaaqay tallaabo uu qaadayo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa digniin adag u diray xildhibaannada sida joogtada ah uga maqnaada fadhiyada golaha. Guddoomiyaha cusub ayaa sheegay in si buuxda loo dhaqan-gelin doono xeer-hoosaadka baarlamaanka, isagoo si cad u sheegay in aan la aqbali doonin hab-dhaqanka xildhibaannada qaarkood, kuwaas oo kulanka yimaada, is xaadiriya, kaddibna isaga baxa hoolka fadhiga, taasoo uu sheegay inay saameyn ku yeelatay shaqada iyo howlaha Golaha Shacabka. “Xildhibaannada sabab la’aanta uga maqan kulamada Golaha xeer-hoosaadka ayaa lala tiigsan doonaa. Mana la aqbali doono xildhibaan inta uu yimaado, is xaadiriya, kaddibna iska baxa,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiye Jaamac. Digniinta Guddoomiyaha ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli ay soo noq-noqdeen cabashooyinka la xiriira xaadiritaanka xildhibaannada iyo dib u dhaca ku yimaada fadhiyada Golaha Shacabka, kuwaas oo mararka qaar furmi waaya waqtigii loo qorsheeyay. Jaamac ayaa sheegay in maalmahan qaar ka mid ah fadhiyada Golaha ay ku furmeen tiro ku dhow 140 xildhibaan, halka tirada guud ee Golaha Shacabka ay tahay 275 xildhibaan. Tiradan ayaa ka dhigan in xildhibaanno badan aysan si joogto ah uga qeybgelin kulamada, taasoo caqabad ku noqon karta shaqada Golaha iyo ansixinta qodobbada u baahan kooram sharci ah. Sida uu dhigayo xeerka baarlamaanka, fadhiyada Golaha Shacabka waxay u baahan yihiin kooram sharci ah, si doodaha, akhrinta iyo ansixinta sharciyada iyo go’aannada kale ay u noqdaan kuwo waafaqsan nidaamka baarlamaanka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa xildhibaannada ku boorriyay inay si buuxda uga qeyb qaataan shaqada golaha, isagoo xusay in baarlamaanka looga baahan yahay inuu guto waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah ee la xiriira sharci dejinta iyo matalaadda shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in la diyaariyay xeerar lagu nidaaminayo xaadiritaanka, maqnaanshaha iyo anshaxa xildhibaannada, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu hagaajiyo habsami u socodka shaqada Golaha Shacabka. “Waxaa saacaddaan laga bilaabo farayaa xoghayaha inuu digniinta u gudbiyo qof walba oo aan imaan waqtiga xeer-hoosaadku oggol yahay,” ayuu yiri Jaamac. Si kastaba, Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in la tixgelin doono duruufaha bani’aadamnimada ee xildhibaannada, isagoo tilmaamay in qofka qaba xaalad caafimaad, safar ama sabab kale oo la aqbali karo uu heli karo fasax. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay in xildhibaan aan haysan fasax rasmi ah oo ka maqnaada fadhiyada ama dib uga soo xaadira waqtigii loo asteeyay uu wajihi doono digniin iyo tallaabo waafaqsan xeer-hoosaadka golaha. Tallaabadan ayaa imaaneysa xilli Golaha Shacabka ay horyaallaan arrimo siyaasadeed iyo sharciyeed oo muhiim ah, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin sharciyada la xiriira doorashooyinka, amniga iyo dib u habeynta hay’adaha dowladda. Sidoo kale, Golaha ayaa la filayaa inuu ka shaqeeyo ajandayaal kale oo masiiri ah oo u baahan ka qeybgal buuxa oo ay sameeyaan xildhibaannada, maadaama go’aannada qaarkood ay saameyn ku yeelan karaan jihada siyaasadeed iyo dowladnimo ee dalka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa ugu dambeyn ku adkeeyay xildhibaannada inay si joogto ah uga qeybqaataan kulamada holaha, si baarlamaanka uu u guto waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah, isla markaana uu si hufan ugu shaqeeyo matalaadda shacabka. Tiradan ayaa ka dhigan in xildhibaanno badan aysan si joogto ah uga qeybgelin kulamada, taasoo caqabad ku noqon karta shaqada Golaha iyo ansixinta qodobbada u baahan kooram sharci ah. Sida uu dhigayo xeerka baarlamaanka, fadhiyada Golaha Shacabka waxay u baahan yihiin kooram sharci ah, si doodaha, akhrinta iyo ansixinta sharciyada iyo go’aannada kale ay u noqdaan kuwo waafaqsan nidaamka baarlamaanka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa xildhibaannada ku boorriyay inay si buuxda uga qeyb qaataan shaqada golaha, isagoo xusay in baarlamaanka looga baahan yahay inuu guto waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah ee la xiriira sharci dejinta iyo matalaadda shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in la diyaariyay xeerar lagu nidaaminayo xaadiritaanka, maqnaanshaha iyo anshaxa xildhibaannada, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu hagaajiyo habsami u socodka shaqada Golaha Shacabka. “Waxaa saacaddaan laga bilaabo farayaa xoghayaha inuu digniinta u gudbiyo qof walba oo aan imaan waqtiga xeer-hoosaadku oggol yahay,” ayuu yiri Jaamac. Si kastaba, Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in la tixgelin doono duruufaha bani’aadamnimada ee xildhibaannada, isagoo tilmaamay in qofka qaba xaalad caafimaad, safar ama sabab kale oo la aqbali karo uu heli karo fasax. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay in xildhibaan aan haysan fasax rasmi ah oo ka maqnaada fadhiyada ama dib uga soo xaadira waqtigii loo asteeyay uu wajihi doono digniin iyo tallaabo waafaqsan xeer-hoosaadka golaha. Tallaabadan ayaa imaaneysa xilli Golaha Shacabka ay horyaallaan arrimo siyaasadeed iyo sharciyeed oo muhiim ah, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin sharciyada la xiriira doorashooyinka, amniga iyo dib u habeynta hay’adaha dowladda. Sidoo kale, Golaha ayaa la filayaa inuu ka shaqeeyo ajandayaal kale oo masiiri ah oo u baahan ka qeybgal buuxa oo ay sameeyaan xildhibaannada, maadaama go’aannada qaarkood ay saameyn ku yeelan karaan jihada siyaasadeed iyo dowladnimo ee dalka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa ugu dambeyn ku adkeeyay xildhibaannada inay si joogto ah uga qeybqaataan kulamada holaha, si baarlamaanka uu u guto waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah, isla markaana uu si hufan ugu shaqeeyo matalaadda shacabka. items.title: Somaliland Officer Defects to North Eastern State with Soldiers and Military Vehicle in Rare Public Break
items.description: Sanaag (WDN) — In a striking and highly unusual development, a senior military officer serving with Somaliland’s security forces has publicly announced his defection before leaving his post and crossing into the neighboring North Eastern State, taking with him a military vehicle and a small contingent of soldiers. The officer, identified as Colonel Ali Ashkato, reportedly left his position in Yubbe, in Sanaag region, accompanied by around 10 soldiers and a military vehicle, before safely reaching territory administered by North Eastern State. What makes the development particularly notable is not simply the defection itself, but the manner in which it unfolded. Sinior Somaliland soldiers defects Northeast State Rather than quietly abandoning his post, Colonel Ashkato reportedly announced his decision publicly while still in Yubbe, declaring that he was leaving Somaliland’s security forces before subsequently departing the area with the troops under his command. The move represents an unusually open break with the security establishment in Somaliland and could carry political significance beyond the relatively small number of personnel involved. Colonel Ashkato and his soldiers were reportedly received in the Fiqi-Fuliye area, where officials from North Eastern State welcomed the defecting officer and his unit. The reception included the North Eastern State’s Minister of Interior and senior security officials, who formally welcomed the colonel and the soldiers accompanying him. Images and reports of the reception have attracted attention because the officer arrived not as an individual seeking refuge, but as a commander accompanied by armed personnel and a military vehicle. For North Eastern State authorities, the development provides an opportunity to demonstrate that Somaliland’s military presence in parts of Sanaag remains vulnerable to defections, particularly among communities with strong political and traditional ties to the wider Somali federal system. For Somaliland, however, the defection could raise questions about morale, command cohesion and the loyalty of forces stationed in contested or politically sensitive areas. A Symbolic Defection The significance of the incident extends beyond the number of soldiers involved. Sanaag remains one of the most politically contested areas in northern Somalia, with competing territorial and administrative claims involving Somaliland, Puntland and the newly established North Eastern State. Against that backdrop, the decision of a Somaliland military officer to openly cross into territory controlled by a rival administration carries considerable symbolic weight. The fact that Colonel Ashkato reportedly made his decision publicly before departing also makes the episode unusual. Military defections are often conducted quietly because officers and soldiers fear retaliation, detention or reprisals. In this case, the officer appears to have deliberately transformed his departure into a public political statement. Colonel Ashkato is reportedly from the Warsangeli community, specifically the Nuux Cumar, Jibriil Axmed and Reer Fiqi lineage. His background adds another layer to the political significance of the move because the Warsangeli community has historically maintained strong social and political connections across Sanaag and the broader Puntland and North Eastern regions. However, the defection should not automatically be interpreted as evidence of a broader communal shift. Individual military defections can reflect a combination of political, professional, security and personal considerations, and the motivations behind Colonel Ashkato’s decision have not been independently established. A Warning Sign for Somaliland? For North Eastern State, the arrival of the colonel and his troops is likely to be portrayed as evidence of growing confidence and influence in areas where competing authorities have long contested political control. For Somaliland, the episode presents a more uncomfortable picture. A military officer publicly declaring his departure, taking personnel and equipment with him, and then receiving an official welcome from a neighboring administration inevitably raises questions about the effectiveness of Somaliland’s command structures in contested territories. Whether the incident remains an isolated defection or becomes the beginning of a wider movement among security personnel remains unclear. But one thing is certain: Colonel Ali Ashkato did not simply leave. He announced his departure, crossed the political divide with his men and military vehicle, and was publicly received on the other side. In the highly contested political landscape of northern Somalia, that makes this small military defection a development with potentially much larger political implications. items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo diiday in la adeegsado wararka garabka Laftagareen
items.description: Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa bahda Saxaafadda ka dalbatay inay ka hortagto faafinta wararka kuwa hurinaya qalalaasaha amni iyo fekerka xagjirnimada. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Koonfur Galbeed, Nuur Siidow Baaba oo maanta Wariyeyaasha kula hadlayay Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa sheegay in aanay Saxaafaddu soo xigan karin wararka kuwa doonaya sida uu yiri inay abuuraan qalalaase amni iyo fekerka xagjirka ah. “Waxaan rabnaa inaan si gaar ah dardaaran guud u siino bahda Saxaafadda in aanay soo xigan karin kuwa doonaya inay abuuraan qalalaase amni iyo fekerka xagjirka ah inaanay soo xigan hadalkooda.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale shacabka ugu baaqay inay is dejiyaan, isla-markaana ay ka fogaadaan wararka aan la xaqiijin iyo xogaha loo adeegsado buu yiri in lagu abuuro cabsi iyo kala shaki. “Waxaan shacabka ugu baaqaynaa inay is dejiyaan, kana fogaadaan wararka aan la xaqiijin iyo xogaha loo adeegsado in lagu abuuro cabsi iyo kala shaki.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka. Mar uu Wasiir Baaba ka hadlayay, waxa xilligan xasaasiga ah loo baahan yahay ayaa yiri “Xilliyadan adag waxaa muhiim ah in bulshadu ay is garab-taagto nabadda, dowladnimada iyo hay’adaha sharciga ah, isla-markaana ay xogta saxda ah ka qaadato ilo rasmi ah.” Cabsi dhinaca amniga ah ayaa soo food-saartay shacabka ku dhaqan Magaalada Baydhabo, taas oo ka dhalatay weerarkii ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen ay Isniintii ku soo qaadeen magaaladaasi. Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa dagaal culus bartamaha magaalada kula galay taageereyaasha Laftagareen. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab oo is garabsanaya ay soo weerareen magaalada, inkastoo Laftagareen uu warkaasi beeniyay. “Dhammaan wararka sheegaya in Ciidanka Daraawiishta lagu tilmaamo koox xagjir ah waa warar marin habaabin ah oo been ah, kuwaas oo qiil loogu raadinayo in Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhamaaday Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu si sharci darro ah u isticmaalo qalabka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.” Ayuu Laftagareen ku sheegay qoraal uu habeenkii Isniinta soo saaray. Laftagareen ayaa sheegay in weerarka ay gaysteen Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ee isaga la safan, isla-markaana uu ahaa hawlgal uu sheegay in magaalada looga sifeynayay, waxa uu ku sheegay ciidamada sida gardarrada ah ugu soo duulay. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa 30-kii bishii March la wareegay amniga Baydhabo, taasoo keentay in Laftagareen uu ku dhawaaqo inuu xilka iska casilay, ka dib markii isla maalintaasi uu diyaarad ka raacay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud ee Baydhabo. Hase yeeshee tallaabada meesha looga saaray maamulkiisii ayaa sababtay inay magaaladu gasho xaalad hubanti la’aan amni ah, waana marxalad ka duwan muddadii uu Laftagareen maamulka hoggaaminayay.

items.title: Shirkii Golaha Wasiirrada Somaliland Iyo wixii lagaga wada hadlay
items.description: Fadhigii 72-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland oo uu Shir-guddoominayey Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), oo uu wehelinayo Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi ayaa maanta ka qabsoomay Qasriga Madaxtooyada JSL. Qodobbada lagaga wada hadlay Fadhiga 72-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada Jammhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa ka mid ahaa: 𝟏. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐞𝐞 𝐀𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka, Mudane Cabdalle Maxamed Carab ayaa Golaha siiyey warbixin la xidhiidha xaaladda guud ee amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka, isaga oo sheegay in ammaanka guud ee dhammaan Gobollada dalka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland uu yahay mid sugan, isla markaana aanay jirin wax qalalaase ama xasilooni darro ah nooc kasta oo ay tahayba, marka laga reebo fal dambiyeedyada maalinlaha ah ee ka dhex dhaca bulshada. 𝟐. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐃𝐡𝐚𝐪𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha JSL, Mudane Cabdilaahi Xasan Aadan ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey xaaladda guud ee dhaqaalaha dalka. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in maanta oo ay taariikhdu tahay 19.08.2026-ka si rasmi ah loo daah-furay Xeerka Maamulka Maaliyadda Qaranka, Xeer Lr.75, kaasi oo kaabis iyo wax-ka-beddel lagu sameeyey. Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in Xeerka Maamulka Maaliyaddu uu muhiim u yahay xoojinta nidaamka maamulka iyo maaraynta hantida ummadda, maadaama uu Xeerkani saldhig u yahay nidaam maaliyadeed oo dawli ah oo sharci ah, hufan, isla markaana leh isla-xisaabtan iyo daah-furnaan maaliyadeed. Dhinaca kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha la wadaagay in Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaaluhu ay diyaarisay nidaam cusub oo electronic ah oo loogu talagalay casriyeynta iyo midaynta maamulka iyo hab-raacyada Dukumentiyada qiimaha lacageed leh ee ay bixiyaan Wasaaraha iyo Hay’adaha Dawladdu, sida: Liisamada (Licenses), Ruqsadaha (Permits) iyo Shahaadooyinka (Certificates). Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha la wadaagay diyaarinta Miisaaniyadda Qaranka ee 2027-ka, in Wasaaradaha iyo Hay’adaha Dawladda loo diray Wareegtada diyaarinta iyo soo gudbinta Miisaaniyadda. Ugu dambayn, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha Wasiirrada la wadaagay booqasho hawleed uu ku tagay Berbera, si uu ugu kuurgalo hab-sami-u-socodka hawlaha iyo adeegyada Dekedda Berbera, isaga oo kulammo is-daba-joog ah (28.07 ilaa 08.08.2026-ka) la yeeshay Hay’adda Maamulka Dekedaha Somaliland, DP World, Rugta Ganacsiga iyo daneeyeyaasha Dekedda Berbera, kulamadaasi oo diiradda lagu saaray caqabadaha ka jira xagga dejinta iyo rogista badeecadaha saaran Doonyaha iyo Maraakiibta. 𝟑. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐈𝐬𝐛𝐞𝐝𝐝𝐞𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐐𝐢𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐒𝐡𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 Wasiirka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Dalxiiska JSL, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Xasan Nuur ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada uga xog-warramay xaaladda iyo isbeddelka qiimaha shidaalka dalka. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in qiimaha baatroolku uu kor u kacay, halka qiimaha naaftada aanu isbeddelin, taasoo daruuri u ah nolosha bulshada, sida wax-soo-saarka Warshadaha, gaadiidka dadweynaha, gaadiidka qaada Xamuulka iwm. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha u sheegay in korodhka qiimaha baatroolka uu ku xidhan yahay kaydkii dalka yaallay oo yaraaday iyo baahida loo qabo in si masuuliyad leh loo maareeyo kaydka haatan jira, inta laga sugayo shidaal cusub oo soo socda. Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in Wasaaraddu ay si joogto ah ula socoto xaaladda, wadashaqayn dhawna la leedahay ganacsatada Shidaalka iyo Kaalmaha Shidaalka, iyada oo la isla qaatay in si taxaddir leh loo maareeyo kaydka jira, si loo xaqiijiyo joogtaynta adeegga, isla markaana laga hortago gabaabsi xagga Shidaalka ah, iyada oo mudnaan gaar ah la siinayo xasilloonida suuqa iyo ilaalinta danaha bulshada JSL. Dhanka naaftada, Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in uu dalka yaallo kayd ku filan muddada dhow, isla markaana la filayo in shidaal cusub soo gaadho dalka toddobaadka soo socda. 𝟒. 𝐌𝐮𝐬𝐡𝐤𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐭𝐚 𝐚𝐚𝐧 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐧 𝐃𝐚𝐫𝐲𝐞𝐞𝐥 𝐖𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐬𝐢𝐢 𝐛𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐲𝐬𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐬𝐚𝐚𝐦𝐚𝐲𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐚𝐲 𝐤𝐮 𝐥𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐚𝐡𝐚𝐲 𝐛𝐮𝐥𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐝𝐚: Wasiirka Shaqada, Arrimaha Bulshada iyo Qoyska JSL, Marwo Milgo Maxamed Cilmi (Milgo Sanbalooshe) iyo Wasiirka Diinta iyo Awqaafta, Mudane Sheekh Cabdullaahi-Baashe Daahir Jaamac ayaa si qoto dheer uga hadlay mushkiladda sii kordhaysa ee la xidhiidha carruurta aan helin Daryeel Waalid, iyaga oo muujiyey dareen iyo walaac ku aaddan masiirka nololeed iyo mustaqbalka ubadkan iyo saamaynta ay arrintani ku yeelan karto qaab-nololeedka bulshada. Labada Wasiir waxa ay carrabka ku adkeeyeen in arrintani tahay masuuliyad wadareed, loona baahan yahay in Qaran ahaan, Caqiido ahaan iyo Sharci ahaanba wax laga qabto, bulshadana arrintan si dhab ah looga wacyigeliyo. Labada Wasiir waxa ay ku baaqeen in la xoojiyo ilaalinta carruurta aan helin Daryeelka Waalidka, la joogteeyo tallaabooyinka lagaga hortagayo arrimahan, si ay ubadkani u helaan daryeel nololeed, mustaqbal iyo masuuliyad Qaran oo ay mudan yihiin. 𝟓. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐊𝐨𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐦𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐁𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐠𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐚𝐡𝐚𝐚𝐧 𝐝𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚, 𝐜𝐚𝐪𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐣𝐢𝐫𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐱𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Tamarta iyo Macdanta JSL, Mudane Axmed Jaamac Barre ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey xaaladda korontada dalka, gaar ahaan magaalada Berbera, caqabadaha jira iyo xalalka loo baahan yahay. Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in koronto joogto ah oo la isku hallayn karo ay muhiim u tahay horumarka dalka, gaar ahaan magaalada Berbera oo ah magaalo xeebeed leh cimilo aad u kulul, korontaduna ay tahay mudnaanta koowaad ee nolosha bulshada, Berbera oo ah xarun dhaqaale iyo ganacsi oo muhiim ah dalka. Waxa uu tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la helo xalal waara iyo maalgelinta koronto joogto ah, la awoodi karo oo la isku hallayn karo, si loo daboolo baahida sii kordhaysa ee bulshada iyo koboca dhaqaalaha dalka.
items.fullContent: Fadhigii 72-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland oo uu Shir-guddoominayey Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), oo uu wehelinayo Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi ayaa maanta ka qabsoomay Qasriga Madaxtooyada JSL. Qodobbada lagaga wada hadlay Fadhiga 72-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada Jammhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa ka mid ahaa: 𝟏. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in maanta oo ay taariikhdu tahay 19.08.2026-ka si rasmi ah loo daah-furay Xeerka Maamulka Maaliyadda Qaranka, Xeer Lr.75, kaasi oo kaabis iyo wax-ka-beddel lagu sameeyey. Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in Xeerka Maamulka Maaliyaddu uu muhiim u yahay xoojinta nidaamka maamulka iyo maaraynta hantida ummadda, maadaama uu Xeerkani saldhig u yahay nidaam maaliyadeed oo dawli ah oo sharci ah, hufan, isla markaana leh isla-xisaabtan iyo daah-furnaan maaliyadeed. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in qiimaha baatroolku uu kor u kacay, halka qiimaha naaftada aanu isbeddelin, taasoo daruuri u ah nolosha bulshada, sida wax-soo-saarka Warshadaha, gaadiidka dadweynaha, gaadiidka qaada Xamuulka iwm. Dhanka naaftada, Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in uu dalka yaallo kayd ku filan muddada dhow, isla markaana la filayo in shidaal cusub soo gaadho dalka toddobaadka soo socda. 𝟒. items.title: Somalia’s Opposition Warns of Deepening Crisis
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s political crisis took an increasingly alarming turn this week as senior opposition leaders delivered some of their strongest criticism yet of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, accusing his administration of deepening insecurity, displacing vulnerable communities and failing to address the country’s worsening humanitarian and political challenges. Speaking at separate press conferences in Mogadishu, leaders of the opposition-led Future Council expressed growing frustration and warned that Somalia is being pushed toward a dangerous political and humanitarian crossroads. Former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire, one of the leading figures in the opposition coalition, expressed deep pessimism over the direction of the country under President Hassan Sheikh, whose constitutional mandate the opposition maintains has expired. Khaire warned that Somalia could be moving toward a serious humanitarian crisis, arguing that government policies in Mogadishu have contributed to widespread displacement and destruction of homes. “What Hassan is doing in Mogadishu poses a threat to the unity of the country,” Khaire said, alleging that government actions had displaced hundreds of thousands of families and resulted in the destruction of approximately 150,000 sites. The figures cited by Khaire could not be independently verified, and the Federal Government has not publicly endorsed them. Nevertheless, his remarks highlight the increasingly bitter political dispute surrounding land, displacement and urban redevelopment in Mogadishu. A Government Accused of Turning Against Its Own Citizens Khaire argued that the fundamental responsibility of a government is to protect its citizens and territory—not to make vulnerable communities the victims of political and administrative decisions. He contrasted the government’s responsibilities toward Somalia’s borders with what he described as its treatment of people living in those border areas and within the capital. His broader argument was that legitimate political authority derives from citizens coming together to establish institutions, define territory, protect their rights and govern through agreed laws. Instead, he accused the Federal Government of failing to adequately protect Somalia’s territorial boundaries while simultaneously taking actions that, in his view, harm citizens living within them. The accusation goes to the heart of Somalia’s wider political crisis: what does government authority mean if citizens increasingly experience the state as a source of insecurity rather than protection? Former President Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, another prominent Future Council leader, delivered an equally forceful message during a separate press conference in Mogadishu. Sharif argued that Somalia’s political situation has reached a point at which opposition leaders can no longer simply observe events without taking action. “We cannot continue sitting and watching. We must take action because responsibility has collapsed with those entrusted with leadership,” Sharif said. At the same time, however, the former president called on Hassan Sheikh to return to the negotiating table and seek a political settlement. “You have done what you could do. Save the country and return to the negotiating table,” Sharif said. His appeal reflects the central dilemma facing Somalia’s opposition: whether to continue pursuing negotiations with the Federal Government or move toward more confrontational political action. Land, Displacement and the Human Cost Sharif also accused the Hassan Sheikh administration of forcing residents in Mogadishu from their homes, alleging that some communities had effectively been given a choice between surrendering their properties or facing displacement. The allegations come amid continuing controversy over land ownership, public property, urban redevelopment and the displacement of low-income communities in Mogadishu. For families who have lived in parts of the capital for decades, the issue is not merely political. It is existential. A house is often a family’s largest—and sometimes only—asset. Losing it can mean losing access to schools, employment, social networks and the community structures that provide informal protection and support. This is why allegations of forced displacement have become particularly politically sensitive. The opposition’s accusations extend beyond individual allegations of land seizures or displacement. They reflect a much broader argument that Somalia’s institutions are failing to provide the political consensus and protection expected from a functioning state. The country is simultaneously confronting an Al-Shabaab insurgency, economic pressures, displacement, political polarization and an unresolved dispute over the constitutional and electoral order. Against this backdrop, accusations that government policies are contributing to displacement or social instability carry particularly serious implications. The Federal Government has yet to provide a comprehensive response to the latest allegations cited by the opposition. For President Hassan Sheikh, the challenge is therefore no longer simply defending individual government policies. It is restoring public confidence in the state’s intentions and demonstrating that political authority can coexist with accountability, dialogue and protection of citizens’ rights. The Road Ahead The opposition’s message is increasingly clear: Somalia cannot remain indefinitely trapped between political confrontation and institutional uncertainty. Sharif’s call for Hassan Sheikh to return to dialogue suggests that a negotiated settlement remains possible. But the language used by the opposition also indicates that patience is wearing thin. Whether the government chooses confrontation, continued political maneuvering or renewed negotiations could determine the next chapter of Somalia’s political crisis. For ordinary Somalis, however, the debate is ultimately less about political personalities than about survival. They want security. They want homes that cannot be taken from them without due process. They want functioning institutions. And they want leaders who recognize that political power is temporary, while the consequences of government decisions can last for generations. That may be the most important message emerging from the opposition’s latest warnings: Somalia’s political crisis is no longer confined to Parliament, Villa Somalia or opposition meetings. Increasingly, its consequences are being felt in the homes and livelihoods of ordinary citizens. WardheerNews The post Somalia’s Opposition Warns of Deepening Crisis appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Duq magaalo oo Mexico ah oo “guursaday” yaxaas si loo raadiyo barwaaqo
items.description: MEXICO — Inta badan aroosyadu waxay ku dhammaadaan laba qof oo is dhaarsada, balse magaalo yar oo ku taalla koonfurta Mexico ayaa sanad kasta martigelisa xaflad ka duwan kuwa kale. San Pedro Huamelula ee gobolka Oaxaca, duqa magaalada ayaa xaflad dhaqameed ku “guursada” yaxaas-dumar, iyadoo dadka deegaanka ay rumeysan yihiin in munaasabaddan ay kaalin ka qaadato keensashada barwaaqo, roob iyo wax-soo-saar wanaagsan. Xafladda sanadkan oo dhacday 30-kii Juun ayaa duqa magaalada Daniel Gutierrez lagu arkay isagoo ka qeybgalaya munaasabadda, halka yaxaaska loo diyaariyey sida aroosad, laguna labisay dhar cad oo aroos. Dadka deegaanka ayaa yaxaaska u bixiyay magaca Miguelana Estela del Mar Zavaleta Ramirez , waxaana sidoo kale loogu yeeraa “Princess Girl”. Munaasabadda ayaa ka bilaabata in yaxaaska lagu dhex maro magaalada, iyadoo dadka ay la socdaan muusig, ciyaaro iyo dhar dhaqameed. Ugu dambeyn waxaa la gaarsiiyaa goobta xafladda, halkaas oo lagu sameeyo guurka astaanta ah. Xitaa waxaa dhacda in duqu uu yaxaaska dhunkado, taasoo noqota qaybta ugu caansan ee xafladda, isla markaana sanad kasta sawirradeedu ay gaaraan warbaahinta caalamka. Maxaa ka dambeeya guurka aan caadiga ahayn? items.title: Maxay yihiin 7 safiir ee Xasan Sheekh maanta ka guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta xarunta Madaxtooyada Qaranka warqadaha aqoonsiga danjirenimo kaga guddoomay safiirro cusub oo ka socda toddobo dal. Safiirrada cusub ee Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyaddu ka guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga ayaa kala ah: Danjire Mohamed Alim – Aljeeriya Danjire Joao Alfredo Dos Anjos – Brazil Danjire Dr. Adarsh Swaika – Hindiya Danjire Dr. Madou Diallo – Mali Danjire Aung Min Oo – Myanmar Danjire Danlami Ibrahim – Nigeria Danjire Aqsa Nawaz – Pakistan Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Danjireyaasha cusub ka dhageystay warbixinno ku saabsan qorshayaashooda iyo mudnaanta ay siinayaan xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo dalalka ay matalaan. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray fursadaha lagu horumarin karo xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo toddobada dal, iyadoo la xoojinayo iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan ee labada dhinac. Madaxweynaha ayaa safiirrada cusub u rajeeyay inay muddada ay xilalkooda hayaan kaalin wanaagsan ka qaataan xoojinta xiriirka saaxiibtinimo ee Soomaaliya iyo dalalkooda. Xasan Sheekh ayaa si gaar ah u xusay muhiimadda iskaashiga dhinacyada siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha, horumarinta, amniga iyo arrimaha bulshada, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ah xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo dalalka caalamka. Safiirrada cusub ayaa dhankooda Madaxweynaha soo gaarsiiyay farriimo iyo salaan ay ka sideen madaxda dalalkooda, iyagoo muujiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay ka shaqeynta horumarinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga kala dhexeeya Soomaaliya. The post Maxay yihiin 7 safiir ee Xasan Sheekh maanta ka guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga? + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Rebalancing Ethiopia’s Federal Order: Multinational Federalism, Self-Government, Equal Citizenship, and Shared Prosperity
items.description: By Faisal Omer; Former parliament member of Somali region Abstract Since 1991, Ethiopia has transformed from a highly centralized state into a federal order that constitutionally recognized the rights of the country’s “nations, nationalities, and peoples.” The 1995 Constitution established extensive regional self-government, collective rights, and self-determination while seeking to preserve national unity. Although this settlement addressed some important historical grievances concerning political recognition, cultural identity, territorial governance, and autonomy, more than three decades of experience have revealed persistent challenges, including ethnic polarization, territorial disputes, minority protection, fiscal dependence, uneven development, weak intergovernmental coordination, resource competition, and tensions between collective identity and equal citizenship. This article argues that these challenges reflect not the inherent failure of federalism, but an enduring imbalance between self-rule and shared rule. Ethiopia’s most viable constitutional trajectory therefore lies neither in centralized homogenization nor in preserving an unreformed federal order, but in developing a rebalanced multinational federation that combines meaningful regional self-government with equal citizenship, effective shared institutions, enforceable minority protections, equitable fiscal arrangements, cooperative intergovernmental relations, and inclusive national political participation. Drawing on scholarship on multinational federalism, territorial autonomy, consociationalism, self-determination, decentralization, and conflict management, as well as comparative experiences from India, Canada, Belgium, Switzerland, and Nigeria, the article develops an institutional framework for this rebalancing. It treats collective rights and individual citizenship as complementary principles: regional autonomy should protect identity and self-government without producing exclusion, while common citizenship should strengthen national solidarity without requiring cultural or political homogenization. Fiscal federalism and natural-resource governance are central to this framework. Although the 1995 Constitution contains important provisions concerning natural-resources, these provisions do not establish a sufficiently detailed, predictable, transparent, and constitutionally protected framework for sharing the benefits of natural-resource development among the federal government, producing regions, and affected communities. This gap is becoming increasingly significant as Ethiopia expands oil, natural-gas, mining, and related industrial activities. The article concludes that Ethiopia’s constitutional future should pursue integration without assimilation, autonomy without isolation, and national solidarity without central domination. A rebalanced multinational federation can provide a framework in which diversity, regional self-government, and equal citizenship reinforce one another, transforming Ethiopia’s pluralism from a source of zero-sum competition into a foundation for democratic stability and shared prosperity. 1. Introduction Few constitutional questions have been more consequential for modern Ethiopia than how to reconcile political unity with deep linguistic, cultural, historical, religious, and territorial diversity. The central challenge is not diversity itself, but the institutional framework through which diverse communities are recognized, represented, and governed. Historically, Ethiopian state-building relied heavily on centralized authority. While this promoted administrative integration and state consolidation, it also generated persistent grievances concerning political inclusion, cultural recognition, territorial governance, and access to political and economic power. The 1991 political transition and the adoption of the 1995 Constitution marked a fundamental departure from this model. By constitutionally recognizing the rights of Ethiopia’s “nations, nationalities, and peoples,” the Constitution established a federal system centered on regional self-government and collective rights. Article 39 recognizes self-determination and self-government, while Article 40 establishes important principles concerning land and natural resources. Federalism thus became not merely an instrument of administrative decentralization, but a constitutional response to Ethiopia’s longstanding national question. Often described as ethnic or ethnonational federalism (Turton 2006; Vaughan 2003), the system has produced important achievements, including greater regional and local self-government, recognition of linguistic and cultural identities, broader political representation, and improvements in aspects of public-service delivery (Faguet, Khan, and Kanth 2021). At the same time, it has faced persistent challenges, including ethnic polarization, territorial disputes, competition over political power and resources, minority insecurity, uneven development, and tensions between regional and federal authorities. A central paradox has therefore emerged: a constitutional system designed to accommodate diversity has sometimes operated through political institutions and practices that intensify identity-based competition . During the EPRDF period, this tension was reinforced by the coexistence of constitutionally defined regional autonomy and a highly centralized party structure. As a result, formal self-government did not always translate into effective political autonomy. The weakening of the EPRDF system subsequently exposed institutional tensions that had previously been managed through party discipline rather than fully developed federal mechanisms. The post-2018 period has consequently demonstrated both the potential and the vulnerability of Ethiopia’s federal settlement. The fundamental constitutional question is therefore not simply whether federalism should be retained or abolished, but how Ethiopia can preserve meaningful self-government while building a political community in which all citizens enjoy equal constitutional membership. This article advances multinational federalism as a framework for addressing this challenge. It argues that Ethiopia need not choose between collective identity and national citizenship. Instead, its constitutional order should enable regional and cultural identities to coexist with, and contribute to, an inclusive Ethiopian citizenship. The article advances four principal arguments. First, Ethiopia’s central institutional challenge is an imbalance between self-rule and shared rule. Second, collective rights and individual citizenship should be understood as complementary rather than competing principles. Third, sustainable federal accommodation requires institutions extending beyond territorial autonomy, including minority protection, fiscal equalization, structured intergovernmental cooperation, equitable natural-resource governance, and inclusive national institutions. Fourth, the current period of political and constitutional deliberation provides an opportunity to refine the federal order without abandoning the significant achievements of the post-1991 constitutional settlement. Methodologically, the article adopts a conceptual and comparative approach, drawing on constitutional provisions, federalism scholarship, comparative experiences, institutional documents, and empirical research on decentralization, fiscal federalism, political inclusion, natural-resource governance, and regional development. It uses these materials to develop an institutional framework for rebalancing Ethiopia’s federation around three mutually reinforcing objectives: meaningful self-government, equal citizenship, and shared national prosperity. items.title: DFS oo Booliis Geysay Ceeldheer, Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo Furimaha Loo Dirayo
items.description: Ceeldheer (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ciidamo Booliis ah geysay degmada Ceeldheer ee gobolka Galgaduud, dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, kuwaas oo la wareegaya mas’uuliyadda sugidda amniga degmada. Ciidamada Booliiska ayaa lagu soo dhaweeyay degmada Ceeldheer, iyadoo la sheegay in loo xilsaaray howlgallada amniga iyo ilaalinta kala dambeynta. Tallaabadan ayaa qeyb ka ah qorshe lagu xoojinayo amniga deegaanada ay Dowladda Federaalka iyo ciidamada dowladda dib ula wareegeen. Sida ay sheegeen ilo kala duwan, Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale waddo qorshe lagu gaarsiinayo ciidamo Booliis ah degmooyin kale oo dhawaan laga saaray gacanta Al-Shabaab, iyadoo saldhigyo Booliis oo ku yaalla deegaanadaas dib loo dayactiray ama loo diyaariyay in ciidamadaasi ka howlgalaan. Qorshahan ayaa ujeeddadiisu tahay in Ciidanka Booliiska ay qaataan mas’uuliyadda amniga magaalooyinka iyo degmooyinka, halka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka loo qorsheynayo in xoogga lagu saaro furimaha hore iyo howlgalada milatari ee ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Tallaabadan ayaa sidoo kale qeyb ka noqon karta qorshaha Dowladda Federaalka ee kala saaraya waajibaadka ciidanka milatariga iyo booliiska, si ciidamada Xoogga Dalka ay u dardargeliyaan howlgalada ka socda furimaha dagaalka, halka Booliisku ay diiradda saaraan sugidda amniga iyo kala dambeynta gudaha degmooyinka. items.title: Haweeney Ruush ah oo 27 jeer uur qaaday, 69 carruur ah dhashay
items.description: Taariikhda waxaa ku xusan haweeney Ruush ah oo la sheegay inay 27 jeer uurtay, waxayna dhashay 69 carruur ah, taasoo ka dhigaysa tirada ugu badan ee carruurta ay hal haweeney dhasho taariikhda la duubay. Haweeneydan oo la aqoonsaday Valentina Vassilyeva, oo ahayd xaaskii ugu horreysay ee nin beeraley ah oo Ruush ah, ayaa waxay dhashay 16 laban-laab, 7 saddex-laab, iyo 4 afar-laab, kuwaas oo isku dara 69 carruur ah oo ka soo baxay 27 uur oo keliya. Waxay ahayd qarnigii 18-aad, waqti ka hor dhallaanka casriga ah, cisbitaalada ama daryeelka uurka ee maanta la heli karo. Guinness World Records ayaa weli ku qoran kiiskan sida tirada ugu badan ee carruurta ay hal haweeney dhasho. Inkastoo taariikhdu ay tahay mid qarni yaal leh, taariikhyahanadu ma xaqiijin karaan faahfaahin kasta si waafaqsan heerarka casriga ah. Laakiin haddii diiwaannada ay saxan yihiin, tirooyinku way adag tahay in la fahmo: 27 uur, 69 carruur ah, iyo in ku dhowaad dhammaan dhalmada ay ku jireen in ka badan hal ilmo. Dhalmada Valentina Vassilyeva waxay ahayd mid aan caadi ahayn, maadaama ay si joogto ah u dhashay laban-laab, saddex-laab iyo afar-laab, waxayna noqotay mid ka mid ah xaaladaha ugu cajiibsan taariikhda. Inkastoo aan la garanayn sida ay uga badbaaday dhalmo kasta, waxay noqotay astaan loogu talagalay carruurta badan ee taariikhda. The post Haweeney Ruush ah oo 27 jeer uur qaaday, 69 carruur ah dhashay first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: DF oo ciidan cusub geysay Ceeldheer iyo ujeedka ka dambeeya
items.description: Ceeldheer (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ciidamo ka tirsan booliska Soomaaliyeed geysay degmada Ceeldheer ee gobolka Galgaduud ee dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Ciidamada booliska ayaa halkaas loo geeyay si ay ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga degmada oo ay horay u hayeen ciidamada xoogga dalka. Ciidamadan oo soo dhaweyn loogu sameeyay degmada ayaa waxaa la sheegay in loo xil saaray sugidda amniga iyo ilaalinta xarumaha muhiimka ah, iyadoo tallaabadan qeyb ka tahay qorshe lagu xoojinayo nabadgelyada deegaanka. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, Dowladda Federaalka ayaa qorsheynaysa in ciidamo boolis ah la geeyo degmooyin dhowaan laga saaray gacanta Al-Shabaab, iyadoo dib u habeyn lagu sameeyay saldhigyada iyo goobaha ay ciidamadaasi ka howlgalayaan. Qorshahan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada dowladda ay ku doonayso in ciidamada booliska ay si weyn uga qeyb qaataan sugidda amniga deegaanada laga xoreeyay Al-Shabaab, halka ciidamada militariga loo diyaarinayo howlo kale oo la xiriira dagaalka. Dowladda ayaa qorsheyneysa in ciidamada xoogga dalka loo wareejiyo furimaha hore ee dagaalka, si ay u dardargeliyaan howl-gallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo howl-gallada lagu doonayo in lagu xoojiyo ammaanka deegaanada ku dhow goobaha dagaalka. Tallaabadan ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmeysa xilli ciidamada qalabka sida ee Soomaaliya ay muddooyinkii dambe u diyaar garoobayeen inay si buuxda ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka, iyadoo ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee howl-galka AUSSOM ay qorsheynayaan inay yareeyaan ama soo afjaraan joogitaankooda. Si kastaba, Ceeldheer ayaa ka mid ah degmooyinka Galmudug ee muddooyinkii dambe ay ciidamada dowladdaiyo kuwa deegaanka ay ka wadeen dadaallo lagu xoojinayo amniga, waxaana la filayaa in keenista booliska ay sare u qaaddo awoodda maamulka iyo sugidda amniga degmada. The post DF oo ciidan cusub geysay Ceeldheer iyo ujeedka ka dambeeya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Deni oo Kulan La Qaatay Bulshada Gobolka Mudug+SAWIRO
items.description: Mudug (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweynaha Dowladda Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa maanta kulan qado iyo is-xogwareysi ah la qaatay qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada Gobolka Mudug. Kulanka waxaa ka qeybgalay xubno ka tirsan Goleyaasha Dowladda Puntland, mas’uuliyiinta gobolka iyo degmada, iyo saraakiisha ciidamada kala duwan ee Puntland ee ku sugan Gobolka Mudug. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xaaladda guud ee Gobolka Mudug, gaar ahaan amniga, arrimaha bulshada iyo mashaariicda horumarineed ee ka socda magaalada Gaalkacyo iyo guud ahaan degmooyinka gobolka. Madaxweyne Deni ayaa sidoo kale dhageystay warbixinno iyo aragtiyo ku saabsan xaaladda bulshada iyo baahiyaha ka jira gobolka, iyadoo kulanka lagu xoojinayay wada-shaqeynta dowladda, bulshada iyo hay’adaha amniga. The post Deni oo Kulan La Qaatay Bulshada Gobolka Mudug+SAWIRO appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo waraaqaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay Safiiro cusub (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta waraaqaha aqoonsiga ee safiirnimo ka guddoomay toddobo Safiir, ka dib markii siyaabooyin kala duwan uu ugu qaabilay Xarunta Madaxtooyada Qaranka ee Magaalada Muqdisho. Madaxweynaha ayaa munaasabad lagu qabtay Villa Somalia waraaqaha kaga guddoomay Safiiradan, oo mid ka mid ah ay haweeney tahay. Safiiradan ayaa kala ah:- 1-Danjire Mohamed Alim – Aljeeriya 2-Danjire Joao Alfredo Dos Anjos – Brazil 3-Danjire Dr. Adarsh Swaika – Hindiya 4-Danjire Dr. Madou Diallo – Mali 5-Danjire Aung Min Oo – Myanmar 6-Danjire Danlami Ibrahim – Nigeria 7-Danjire Aqsa Nawaz – Pakistan Aqsa Nawaz oo ah haweeneyda keliya ee ka dhex muuqatay Safiirada uu Madaxweynuhu qaabilay ayaa hadda ahayd Safiirka Pakistan ee Jabuuti. Haweeneydan ayaa waxay kaloo soo noqotay Qunsulka Guud ee Pakistan ee Magaalada Milan ee dalkaasi Talyaaniga, intii u dhexeysay May 2022 iyo August 2025. Bishii September ee sanadkii hore ayay Islamabad u soo magacawday inay noqoto Safiirka Pakistan ee Jabuuti. “Madaxweynaha ayaa Danjireyaasha ka dhageystay warbixinno ku saabsan qorsheyaashooda iyo mudnaantooda ku aaddan xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ka dhexeeya Somaliya iyo dalalka ay matalaan.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Xafiiska Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Dhankooda, Safiirada cusub ayaa Madaxweynaha soo gaarsiiyay farriimo iyo salaan ay ka sideen madaxda dalalkooda, iyaga oo muujiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay ka shaqeynta horumarinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Somaliya iyo dalalka ay matalaan.” Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Safiiradan u rajeeyay in muddada ay xilalkooda hayaan ay kaalin wanaagsan ka qaataan xoojinta xiriirka saaxiibtinimo ee Somaliya iyo dalalkooda, sida lagu sheegay warka.

items.title: Al-Shabaab Torches Convoy After Extortion Ring Bust
items.description: Al-Shabaab operatives set fire to six freight trucks carrying charcoal from the Lower Shabelle and Hiran regions on Wednesday as the convoy was traveling toward the capital, Mogadishu. Photographs obtained from the area depict the commercial vehicles engulfed in flames along the road connecting Wanlaweyn and Afgooye in the Lower Shabelle region. A transport driver interviewed by Raxanreeb stated that armed militants ambushed the vehicles along the primary transit corridor between Wanlaweyn and Afgooye. The driver, who spoke on the condition of anonymity due to security concerns, reported that the trucks were destroyed by members of Al-Shabaab’s Hisbah unit operating at local checkpoints. He noted that the destroyed vehicles belonged to members of the Gaaljecel, Habar Gidir, and Murusade clans. According to sources cited by Raxanreeb, Al-Shabaab had routinely extracted tax payments from charcoal transporters using an intermediary drivers’ committee to process the collections. However, operational conditions shifted last week after the U.S.-backed Danab Special Forces apprehended two key members of that committee, identified as Ahmed Somali and Osman Jawjawley. The post Al-Shabaab Torches Convoy After Extortion Ring Bust appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Secretary Rubio’s Call with UAE National Security Advisor Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan
items.description: Secretary Rubio’s Call with UAE National Security Advisor Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan Office of the Spokesperson The below is attributable to Spokesperson Tommy Pigott: Secretary of State Marco Rubio spoke today with UAE National Security Advisor Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan. The two discussed a number of regional security issues, including Lebanon, as well as continued U.S.-UAE coordination to hold Iran and its terrorist proxies accountable for ongoing attacks. Secretary Rubio underscored the importance of freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye: Xiriir 15 Sano Jirsaday oo Xadhko Adag Yeeshay
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa ka qeybgalay munaasabad lagu xusayay 15 sano oo kasoo wareegtay markii uu si weyn u xoogaystay xiriirka iyo iskaashiga diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye. Xiriirka labada dal wuxuu galay marxalad cusub sanadkii 2011, xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahaysay abaar ba’an iyo xaalad bani’aadantinimo oo aad u adag. Türkiye ayaa xilligaas si weyn uga qeyb qaadatay dadaallada gurmadka iyo taageerada shacabka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo booqashadii uu Madaxweynaha Türkiye Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ku yimid Muqdisho ay noqotay dhacdo taariikhi ah oo muujisay heerka uu xiriirku gaaray. Tan iyo 2011, xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye wuxuu ka gudbay kaalmo bani’aadantinimo oo keliya, wuxuuna isu beddelay iskaashi ballaaran oo dhinacyo badan leh, oo ay kamid yihiin amniga, difaaca, waxbarashada, caafimaadka, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga, maalgashiga iyo horumarinta hay’adaha dowladda. Türkiye ayaa sidoo kale door muuqda ku leh tababarka iyo tayeynta ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo magaalada Muqdisho ay ku taallo Akadeemiyadda TURKSOM, oo lagu tababaro ciidamada Soomaaliya. Dhanka dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga, labada dal ayaa sannadihii lasoo dhaafay ballaariyay xiriirkooda, iyadoo shirkado iyo hay’ado Turkish ah ay ka qeyb qaateen mashaariic kala duwan oo Soomaaliya laga hirgeliyay. Munaasabadda ayaa sidoo kale lagu muujiyay in xiriirka labada dal uusan ku koobnayn oo keliya iskaashi dowladeed, balse uu ku saleysan yahay xiriir taariikhi ah, walaaltinimo iyo xiriir dad iyo dad ah oo sii xoogeysanayay tan iyo 2011. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa munaasabadda ka sheegay muhiimadda ay Soomaaliya u leedahay sii xoojinta xiriirka Türkiye, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan in iskaashigooda loo gudbiyo marxalad cusub oo ku dhisan danaha labada dal, horumar, amni iyo iskaashi waara. 15-ka sano ee lasoo dhaafay ayaa sidaas darteed noqday xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye uu si weyn isu beddelay, laga soo bilaabo gurmadkii bani’aadantinimo ee 2011 ilaa iskaashi istiraatiiji ah oo maanta taabanaya dhinacyo badan oo nolosha iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliya ah. The post Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye: Xiriir 15 Sano Jirsaday oo Xadhko Adag Yeeshay appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa munaasabadda ka sheegay muhiimadda ay Soomaaliya u leedahay sii xoojinta xiriirka Türkiye, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan in iskaashigooda loo gudbiyo marxalad cusub oo ku dhisan danaha labada dal, horumar, amni iyo iskaashi waara. 15-ka sano ee lasoo dhaafay ayaa sidaas darteed noqday xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye uu si weyn isu beddelay, laga soo bilaabo gurmadkii bani’aadantinimo ee 2011 ilaa iskaashi istiraatiiji ah oo maanta taabanaya dhinacyo badan oo nolosha iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliya ah.
