items.title: The Economist: “Muqdisho oo ka baxaysa sumcaddii xumayd ee ahayd magaalada ugu halista badan!”
items.description: Muddo dheer, magaca Muqdisho wuxuu warbaahinta caalamka uga dhex muuqday qaraxyo, weerarro hubaysan iyo waddooyin cabsi darteed u xirma marka habeenku soo dhaco. Haatan, muuqaal kale ayaa soo baxaya, maqaaxiyo saqda dhexe ka dib furan, waddooyin ciriiri noqday iyo dhismayaal dhaadheer oo si xawli ah uga dhex baxaya magaalada. Wargeyska The Economist ayaa qiimayn uu 13kii Agoosto daabacay ku sheegay in Muqdisho aanay mar dambe mutaysan “sumcadda dilka” ee muddada dheer la xiriirtay. Dooddiisu waxay ku salaysan tahay hoosudhac weyn oo ku yimid weerarrada al‑Shabaab ee caasimadda, 144 weerar oo la diiwaangeliyey rubucii saddexaad ee 2022 ayaa noqday shan weerar rubucii labaad ee 2026. Marka tiro ahaan loo eego, waa hoosudhac ka badan 96%. Waa isbeddel aan la fududaysan karin, gaar ahaan magaalo ay sannado yar ka hor dadka deggani ku noolaan jireen su’aasha ah halka uu weerarka xiga ka dhici doono ee aanay su’aashu ahayn in weerar dhici doono iyo in kale. Hasayeeshee, tiradaasi waxay dhalinaysaa laba su’aalood oo kala duwan: maxaa Muqdisho ka beddelay, hoosudhaca weerarraduna ma caddaynayaa in al‑Shabaab la wiiqay? Amni laga dareemayo nolosha maalinlaha ah Isbeddelka Muqdisho kuma koobna xogta hay’adaha amniga. Waxaa laga dheehan karaa habeenkii magaalada, dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsiga iyo dhismayaasha cusub. Maqaaxiyo iyo hudheello ayaa shaqeeya ilaa saacadaha dambe; waddooyinka qaarna waxaa habeenkii buuxiya dhallinyaro, qoysas iyo ganacsato. Dhanka kale, dhismaha dabaqyada dhaadheer iyo xarumaha ganacsigu wuxuu muujinayaa in maalgeliyayaal Soomaaliyeed ay mustaqbalka magaalada ku dhiirranayaan. Mid ka mid ah tusaalooyinka ay The Economist xustay waa Dahab Tower, oo ah dhisme 26 dabaq ah, looguna talagalay guryo, suuq, goob jimicsi iyo masjid. Dhismaha noocan ahi ma aha oo keliya isbeddelka muuqaalka magaalada; wuxuu sidoo kale tilmaamayaa in ganacsatadu hantidooda ku maalgelinayaan qorshayaal muddo dheer jira. Kobocaas waxaa garab socda magaaloobid aad u xawli badan. Bangiga Adduunku wuxuu sheegay in 54% dadka Soomaaliya ay hadda ku nool yihiin magaalooyinka, kuwaas oo sannadkii ku fidaya qiyaastii 4.3% heer ka sarreeya celceliska Afrika. Kobocani wuxuu magaalada siinayaa dhaqdhaqaaq dhaqaale, laakiin wuxuu sidoo kale culays saarayaa waddooyinka, guryaha, nadaafadda iyo adeegyada kale ee dadweynaha. Maxaa weerarrada dhimay? Qiimaynta The Economist waxay isbeddelka qayb ahaan la xiriirisay iskudarka sirdoon xoogaystay, kaamirooyinka ammaanka, diiwaangelinta elektaroonigga ah ee gaadiidka iyo ciidamo sirdoon oo lagu baahiyey magaalada. Kaamirooyinka qarsoon ee CCTV ayaa lagu xiray waddooyinka iyo meherado badan, iyada oo la doonayo in lagula socdo dhaqdhaqaaqa gaadiidka iyo dadka looga shakiyo weerarrada. Diiwaangelinta gaadiidka iyo adkaynta kontaroolladuna waxay sii yarayn karaan fursadda gaari qarax siday si fudud ugu gudbi karo bartamaha magaalada. Taageerada Turkiga ayaa iyaduna qayb ka ah sawirka. Turkigu wuxuu Soomaaliya ka taageeraa tababarka ciidamada, dhismaha awoodda sirdoonka iyo qalabaynta hay’adaha ammaanka. Sannadkii 2017 ayuu Muqdisho ka furay xaruntiisa tababarka ciidan ee ugu weyn meel ka baxsan dalkiisa, halka shirkado Turki ahi ay maamulaan dekedda iyo garoonka diyaaradaha Muqdisho. Sida uu qoray The Economist, diblomaasi reer Galbeed ah oo Muqdisho jooga ayaa Turkiga ku ammaanay qayb weyn oo ka mid ah horumarka amniga. Hase yeeshee, horumarku kuma koobna taageero shisheeye: waxaa jira waaya-aragnimo ay hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed ka kororsadeen qaababka ay al‑Shabaab dadka, qaraxyada iyo hubka magaalada ku soo geliso. In Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu 1dii Luulyo munaasabad dadweyne kaga qaybgalay isgoys hore weerarro loogu bartilmaameedsaday ayaa iyaduna noqotay astaan siyaasadeed oo muujinaysa kalsoonida ay dawladdu ka qabto xaaladda caasimadda. Tirada yar ma la macne tahay koox daciiftay? Halkan ayaa taxaddarku ka bilaabmayaa. Hoosudhaca weerarrada Muqdisho si toos ah ugama dhigna in awoodda Al‑Shabaab guud ahaan burburtay. Kooxdu weli waxay degaanno iyo marinno sahay ku leedahay miyiga koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya, waxayna awood u leedahay inay weerarro waaweyn ku qaaddo saldhigyada ciidamada iyo magaalooyinka ka baxsan caasimadda. Falanqeeyayaal ay soo xigatay The Economist ayaa sheegaya in yaraanta weerarradu ka dhalan karto beddelka xeeladaha kooxda, ee aanay khasab ahaan ka dhalan tabardarrideeda. Urur hubaysan wuxuu go’aansan karaa inuu weerarrada magaalo muddo yareeyo, inta uu awooddiisa ku ururinayo furimaha dagaalka, dib isu abaabulayo ama sugayo fursad siyaasadeed iyo amni. Xogta ACLED waxay hore u muujisay in al‑Shabaab ay marka ay cadaadis kala kulanto meel ka mid ah dalka u wareejin karto hawlaheeda degaanno kale. Sidaas awgeed, amniga Muqdisho waa in lagu qiimeeyaa waxa magaalada gudaheeda ka dhacaya iyo awoodda kooxda ee dalka intiisa kale labadaba. Waxaa kale oo xusid mudan in hirgelinta kaamirooyinka ammaanku aanay ku iman kharash la’aan. ACLED waxay 2024 diiwaangelisay weerarro iyo dilal loo geystay dad rayid ah oo Al‑Shabaab ku eedaysay inay kaamirooyinka CCTV-ga ku rakibeen meheradahooda. Taasi waxay muujinaysaa in tallaabooyinka amnigu mararka qaarkood ganacsatada iyo shaqaalaha u abuureen halis ay kooxdu si gaar ah ugu bartilmaameedsato. Guul muuqata oo u baahan in la joogteeyo Qiimaynta cusub ee Muqdisho waxay saxaysaa sawir caalami ah oo marar badan magaalada ku koobay qarax iyo burbur. Caasimaddu maanta ma aha magaaladii 2010, 2017 ama xitaa 2022. Hoosudhaca weerarrada, soo kabashada nolosha habeennimo iyo maalgashiga dhismuhu waa horumar dhab ah oo ay dadka Muqdisho nololmaalmeedkooda ka dareemayaan. Laakiin sumcaddu mararka qaarkood si ka dheereeya ayay isu beddeshaa xaqiiqada, mararka qaarkoodna way ka gaabisaa. Cinwaanka The Economist wuxuu Muqdisho siinayaa aqoonsi ay muddo sugaysay, hasayeeshee joogtaynta isbeddelku waxay ku xirnaan doontaa in horumarka amniga laga dhigo mid hay’adeed—oo aan ku tiirsanayn oo keliya kontaroollo, kaamirooyin iyo feejignaan ku meelgaar ah. Muqdisho waxay ka sii baxaysaa sumcaddii magaalo dhimasho; welise waxaa taagan hawsha ka adag: in ammaanka caasimadda loo beddelo nabad waarta oo gaarta dalka intiisa kale.

Taliyaha cusub ayaa ah sarkaal ka tirsan ciidamada militariga Dowladda Federaalka Itoobiya, balse hadda loo magacaabay inuu hoggaamiyo Booliiska Gobolka Amxaarada. items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa ka hadlay qorshaha dowladda ee xakamaynta hubka lagu haysto magaalooyinka dalka, isagoo sheegay in aan la aqbali karin in hub lagu dhex haysto magaalooyinka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in ciidamada dowladda ay yihiin kuwa xaqa u leh inay hub qaataan, halka dadka aan ka tirsanayn hay’adaha dowladda laga doonayo inay hubka dhigaan oo ay u hoggaansamaan shuruucda dalka. Xasan Sheekh ayaa tilmaamay in dowladda ay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin lagu xakameynayo hubka sida gaarka ah loogu haysto magaalooyinka, isagoo sheegay inay iman doonto maalin ay dowladdu gacanta ku dhigi doonto hubka ay dadka qaar ku haystaan guryahooda. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli siyaasiyiin iyo xubno mucaaradka ka tirsan ay walaac xooggan ka muujinayaan qorshaha dowladda ee ku aaddan xakamaynta hubka, iyagoo qaba in hubku muhiim u yahay amnigooda gaarka ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dowladda aysan weli awood buuxda u lahayn inay hubka kala wareegto dhammaan dadka ku haysta guryahooda, inkastoo uu rajo ka muujiyay in arrintaas la gaari doono. “Shabaab waan dilaynaa oo waan is dirirsanahay, Daacish-na waan la dagaalamaynaa. Ninkii qori usoo qaata ee raba inuu dadka dilo waan la diriraynaa. Qofku fikirkiisa xor ayuu u yahay 100%, dastuurkuna wuu tilmaamayaa, laakiin qoryo hala isku soo qaato meel ay ku qoran tahay ma jirto,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay inay jiraan mas’uuliyiin laga dhaadhicin la’yahay in waddanku ammaan yahay, isagoo ku adkeystay in xaaladda amni ee caasimaddu ay wax badan iska beddeshay. Mucaaradka dowladda ayaa horey uga digay qorshahan, iyagoo ku dooday in hubka ay u haystaan is-difaac, isla markaana haddii ay hubka dhigaan ay noqon karaan bartilmaameed sahlan oo ay kooxaha argagixisada, gaar ahaan Al-Shabaab, weerari karaan. items.title: Israel oo joojisay heshiisiyad hubka ay la lahayd Qatar
items.description: Israa’iil waxay joojisay heshiisyada hubka ee ay la lahayd Qatar; go’aanku wuxuu khuseeyaa heshiisyo shan sano ah. Sidaasi waxa lagu baahiyay I24 – gaar ahaan boga ay ku leeyihiin barta X. Wadamada Carabta badidooda ayaa xidhiidh ganacsi la leh dawlada Israel kuwaasi oo ay ugu horeryaan dalalka Masar,Saudi Arabia, Qatar iyo kuwo kalaba. Waxa nasiib daro ah in dalalkaasi ay Somaliland ku colaadiyaan xidhiidhka saxiibtinimo ee ay dhawaan yeesheen labada dal ee Somaliland iyo Israel. Xidhiidhkaasi oo ah mid qoto dheer oo waligii jiri doona waxana haboon in dhamaan dalalka Carabta iyo Turkugba ay raacaan wadada ay ay qaaday Israel ee ahaa in Somaliland mar kale loo aqoonsado dal madax banaan.

items.title: War naxdin leh oo kasoo kordhay dagaalkii Baydhaba + Video
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Macluumaad dheeraad ah ayaa kasoo baxaya khasaaraha ka dhashay dagaalkii maalin ka hor ka dhacay gudaha magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay, kaas oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Khasaaraha ayaa haatan sii kordhaya, iyadoo ay isa soo tarayaan warbixinada ka imaanaya magaalada Baydhaba, halkaas oo laga dareemayo saameynta dagaalkii Isniintii lasoo dhaafay ka dhacay magaaladaasi. Telefishinka Universal oo booqday goobihii lagu dagaalamay aya tegay xero barakacayaal ah oo ku taalla magaalada, taas oo uu saameeyay gaari qarax ah oo la sheegay inuu halkaasi ku qarxay, waxaana ku dhintay 6 qof oo shacab ah. Dadka ku dhintay qaraxa waxaa ka mid ahaa hooyo korinaysay carruur agoon ah oo lagu magacaabi jiray Mayrow Cabdullaahi Uudey iyo laba carruur ah oo ay dhashay, kadib markii qaraxu ku haleelay gurigooda oo cowshado ka sameysnaa. Qaar kamid ah dadka deegaanka oo maanta aasay dadkii ku geeriyooday musiibadaasi ayaa la hadlay Universal TV, iyagoo sheegay inay aad uga argagaxeen dhibaatada ka dhacday halkaasi. “Meeshaan waxaa nooga dhintay lix qof, waxaana ku jiray hooyo iyo laba carruur ah oo ay dhashay,” ayay tiri haweeney kamid ah dadka deegaanka. Sidoo kale Maxamed Aadan Maxamed oo kamid dadka ku nool kaamka ay mashaqadu ka dhacday ayaa ka sheekeeyay sida ay wax u dhaceen. “Gaariga qaraxa watay oo nimanka kor ay la yimaadeen ayaa dhibaatadan na gaarsiiyay, waxaana nagu dhacay guri la’aan iyo ilmo la’aan”. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo soo bandhigtay warbixin xasaasi ah oo ku aadan dagaalkii ka dhacday Baydhaba ayaa sheegtay inay ka qayb-qaateen maeeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, waxaana ay baahisay baahisay sawirro laga soo qaaday goobta oo ay kusoo bandhigtay illaa 4 caddeymood oo waa wayn, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan gaadiid qaraxyo ka buuxaan oo la adeegsaday iyo naftood-haligayaal ka tirsan Khawaarijta oo la sheegay inay is qarxiyeen. The post War naxdin leh oo kasoo kordhay dagaalkii Baydhaba + Video appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xukuumadda Soomaaliya oo bogaadisay xiriirka kala dhaxeeya Turkiga
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa ka qayb-galay munaasabad lagu xusayey xiriika ku salaysan iskaashi diblumaasiyadeed iyo walaaltinnimo ee ka dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda aan walaalaha nahay ee Türkiye, kaasi oo 15 sano ay ka soo wareegtay markii dib-loo sii xoojiyey. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, ayaa sheegay in Shan iyo Tobban sano ka hor uu dalkeennu ku jiray mid ka mid ah marxaladihii ugu adkaa ee taariikh deenna, xilligaasi oo dalka ay ka jireen abaaro, macaluul iyo amni-darro ba’an, balse 19 Agoosto 2011, Ra’iisul Wasaarihii xilligaas ee dalka Turkiga Mudane Recep Tayyip Erdoğan uu qaatay go’aan adag, isla markaana uu booqasho taariikhi ah oo xambaarsan farriin cad oo ah in aysan dadka Soomaaliyeed kaligood ahayn ku yimid caasimadda Muqdisho. “Soomaaliya waxa ay farriintaasi u furtay bog cusub, muddo kooban kadib waxa uu xiriirkaasi isku beddelay iskaashi, istaraatiiji ah oo dhinacyo badan taabanaya, sida Waxbarashada, Caafimaadka, Kaabeyaasha Dhaqaalaha, Amniga iyo Ganacsiga. 15-sano kadib, xiiirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga waxa uu astaan u yahay saaxiibtinnimo dhab ah, iskaashi xooggan iyada oo walaalaha Turkiga ay xilliyada adag garab u yihiin shacabka iyo dowladda Soomaaliyeed”. Ayuu yiri Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa tilmaamay in maalgelinnada ugu saameynta badan oo ay dowladda Türkiye ku samaysay Soomaaliya ay tahay maalgalinta dadka, iyada oo Kumannaan arday Soomaaliyeed ay wax-kusoo barteen Turkiga, waxa ayna dalka kusoo laabteen iyaga oo dhakhaatiir, Enjineerro, macallimiin iyo aqoonyahanno ah. Mudane Xamsa, ayaa xusay in dalkeennu uu ku yaallo goob juqraafiyeed oo istaraatiiji ah ayna leedahay mid ka mid ah xeebaha ugu dheer qaaradda Afrika, bulsho dhallinyaro u badan, Kalluun, dhul-beereed baaxad weyn elh iyo fursado kale oo dhinaca tamarta looga faa’iideysan karo, waxa uuna xusay in ay dowladdu diyaarisay qorshayaal fursadahaas loogu bedelayo wax-soo-saar, shaqo abuur iyo ganacsi, taasi oo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga u bedelaysa iskaashi dhaliya barwaaqo sooran.

items.title: Baydhabo oo lagu soo bandhigay maxaabiis laga qabtay kooxihii weerarka soo qaaday
items.description: Laamaha amniga ayaa maanta maxaabiistan ku soo bandhigay Xarunta Taliska Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Baay ee Magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoona uu maamulku sheegay in lagu qabtay dagaalkii Isniintii ka dhacay magaaladaasi. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Koonfur Galbeed, Nuur Siidow Baaba ayaa Warbaahinta u akhriyay warsaxaafadeed uu maamulku ka soo saaray weerarkii ay maalin ka hor magaalada ku soo qaadeen ciidamada taageersan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in hawlgalo ay ciidamada ammaanka isla maalintaasi ka sameeyeen magaalada ay ku soo qabqabteen xubno ka tirsan buu yiri qolyihii Khawaarijta iyo Khawaarij kalkaalka, oo uu ula jeedo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab iyo ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen. “Ciidamada amniga ayaa hawlgaladii 17-kii bishan August ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo ku soo qabqabtay xubno ka tirsan qolyihii Khawaarijta iyo Khawaarij kalkaalka, hubkoodii iyo sida aad aragteen gaari loogu talagalay in lagu dhibaateeyo guud ahaan shacbiga Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan reer Koonfur Galbeed.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka. Wasiirka ayaa tilmaamay in xubnaha la hayo la horgayn doono sharciga, iyadoo la ilaalinayo xuquuqdooda. “Dadka la qabtay waxaa la marin doonnaa habraacyadii sharciga ahaa, iyadoo si buuxda loo dhowrayo xuquuqdooda, lana marin doono shuruucda dalka.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka Warfaafinta Koonfur Galbeed. Wasiirka oo sii hadlayay ayaa wada hadal ugu baaqay garabka Laftagareen, waxaana uu yiri “Kuwa doonaya inay wiiqaan dowladnimada reer Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya, qalalaasana ka dhex abuuraan bulshada dhexdeeda ama shacabka u horseedaan cabsi iyo amni darro, waxaan leenahay dalku ma lahan waddo kale oo mustaqbal lagu gaari karo, marka laga reebo nabadda, wada hadal iyo dowladnimo. Khilaaf kasta oo jira waxaa lagu xalin karaa miiska wada hadalka, balse laguma xalin karo hub uruursi, rabshad, cabsi gelin iyo iska horimaad. Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya cidna dagaal lama dooneyso, cidna cadaawad gaar ah uma hayso, laakiin dowladda waxaa saaran waajib aan laga tanaasuli karin, oo ah ilaalinta nolosha shacabka reer Koonfur Galbeed, hantidooda, amnigooda iyo sharciga dalka.” Wasiir Baaba ayaa intaasi ku daray “Dowladdu waxay diyaar u tahay inay soo dhaweyso wada hadal kasta oo dhab ah oo lagu doonayo nabad iyo xal waara, balse wada hadalku waa inuu ku dhisnaadaa ixtiraamka sharciga, ilaalinta shacabka iyo aqoonsiga hay’adaha dowladda. Cid kasta oo nabadda dooraneysa albaabka wada hadalka waa uu furan yahay. Cid kasta oo sharciga jebiineysa waxaa lagu la xisaabtami doonnaa sharciga. Cid kasta oo shacabka cabsi gelineysa, dowladdu waxay gudan doontaa waajibaadkeeda dastuuriga ah, ee ah ilaalinta shacabka iyo amnigooda.” Baaba ayaa Warbaahinta ka soo muuqday, iyadoo ay garbihiisa taagnaayeen Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur Galbeed, Isaaq Maxamed Isaaq (Koosaar) iyo Taliyaha Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Baay, Korneyl Mukhtaar Maxamed Dugudow. Maxaabiistan oo 53 nin gaarayay ayaa markii dambe lagu celiyay goobtii lagu hayay.

Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in hawlgalo ay ciidamada ammaanka isla maalintaasi ka sameeyeen magaalada ay ku soo qabqabteen xubno ka tirsan buu yiri qolyihii Khawaarijta iyo Khawaarij kalkaalka, oo uu ula jeedo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab iyo ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen. “Ciidamada amniga ayaa hawlgaladii 17-kii bishan August ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo ku soo qabqabtay xubno ka tirsan qolyihii Khawaarijta iyo Khawaarij kalkaalka, hubkoodii iyo sida aad aragteen gaari loogu talagalay in lagu dhibaateeyo guud ahaan shacbiga Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan reer Koonfur Galbeed.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka. Wasiirka ayaa tilmaamay in xubnaha la hayo la horgayn doono sharciga, iyadoo la ilaalinayo xuquuqdooda. “Dadka la qabtay waxaa la marin doonnaa habraacyadii sharciga ahaa, iyadoo si buuxda loo dhowrayo xuquuqdooda, lana marin doono shuruucda dalka.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka Warfaafinta Koonfur Galbeed. Wasiirka oo sii hadlayay ayaa wada hadal ugu baaqay garabka Laftagareen, waxaana uu yiri “Kuwa doonaya inay wiiqaan dowladnimada reer Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya, qalalaasana ka dhex abuuraan bulshada dhexdeeda ama shacabka u horseedaan cabsi iyo amni darro, waxaan leenahay dalku ma lahan waddo kale oo mustaqbal lagu gaari karo, marka laga reebo nabadda, wada hadal iyo dowladnimo. Khilaaf kasta oo jira waxaa lagu xalin karaa miiska wada hadalka, balse laguma xalin karo hub uruursi, rabshad, cabsi gelin iyo iska horimaad. Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya cidna dagaal lama dooneyso, cidna cadaawad gaar ah uma hayso, laakiin dowladda waxaa saaran waajib aan laga tanaasuli karin, oo ah ilaalinta nolosha shacabka reer Koonfur Galbeed, hantidooda, amnigooda iyo sharciga dalka.” Wasiir Baaba ayaa intaasi ku daray “Dowladdu waxay diyaar u tahay inay soo dhaweyso wada hadal kasta oo dhab ah oo lagu doonayo nabad iyo xal waara, balse wada hadalku waa inuu ku dhisnaadaa ixtiraamka sharciga, ilaalinta shacabka iyo aqoonsiga hay’adaha dowladda. Cid kasta oo nabadda dooraneysa albaabka wada hadalka waa uu furan yahay. Cid kasta oo sharciga jebiineysa waxaa lagu la xisaabtami doonnaa sharciga. Cid kasta oo shacabka cabsi gelineysa, dowladdu waxay gudan doontaa waajibaadkeeda dastuuriga ah, ee ah ilaalinta shacabka iyo amnigooda.” Baaba ayaa Warbaahinta ka soo muuqday, iyadoo ay garbihiisa taagnaayeen Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur Galbeed, Isaaq Maxamed Isaaq (Koosaar) iyo Taliyaha Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Baay, Korneyl Mukhtaar Maxamed Dugudow. Maxaabiistan oo 53 nin gaarayay ayaa markii dambe lagu celiyay goobtii lagu hayay.

items.title: Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga oo 15 sano jirsaday iyo ra’iisul wasaare Xamza oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xiriirka dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye ayaa haatan 15 sanno jirsaday, iyadoo maanta si weyn looga xusay Muqdisho, si loo sii xoojiyo xiriirka labada dhinac oo ku saabsan siyaasadda,difaaca, dhaqaalaha, caafimaadka, waxbarashada iyo arrimaha bani’aadannimada. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa ka qayb-galay munaasabadda xuska xiriika ku salaysan iskaashi diblumaasiyadeed iyo walaaltinnimo ee ka dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Türkiye, kaasi oo 15 sanno ay ka soo wareegtay markii dib-loo sii xoojiyey. Xamza ayaa sheegay in shan iyo tobban sano ka hor uu dalkeennu ku jiray mid ka mid ah marxaladihii ugu adkaa ee taariikhdeenna, xilligaasi oo dalka ay ka jireen abaaro, macaluul iyo amni-darro ba’an, balse 19 Agoosto 2011, Ra’iisul Wasaarihii xilligaas ee dalka Turkiga Mudane Recep Tayyip Erdoğan uu qaatay go’aan adag, isla markaana uu booqasho taariikhi ah oo xambaarsan farriin cad oo ah in aysan dadka Soomaaliyeed kaligood ahayn ku yimid caasimadda Muqdisho. Sidoo kale, Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu ayaa xusay in 15 sano kadib, xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Ankara uu isu beddelay iskaashi xooggan oo astaan u ah saaxiibtinimo dhab ah iyo iskaashi istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah labad dal. “Soomaaliya waxa ay farriintaasi u furtay bog cusub, muddo kooban kadib waxa uu xiriirkaasi isku beddelay iskaashi, istaraatiiji ah oo dhinacyo badan taabanaya, sida Waxbarashada, Caafimaadka, Kaabeyaasha Dhaqaalaha, Amniga iyo Ganacsiga. 15-sano kadib, xiiirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga waxa uu astaan u yahay saaxiibtinnimo dhab ah, iskaashi xooggan iyada oo walaalaha Turkiga ay xilliyada adag garab u yihiin shacabka iyo dowladda Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul wasaaruhu Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in maalgelinnada ugu saameynta badan oo ay dowladda Türkiye ku samaysay Soomaaliya ay tahay maalgalinta dadka, iyada oo Kumannaan arday Soomaaliyeed ay wax-kusoo barteen Turkiga, waxa ayna dalka kusoo laabteen iyaga oo dhakhaatiir, Enjineerro, macallimiin iyo aqoonyahanno ah. Mudane Xamz Cabdi Barre, ayaa tilmaamay in dalkeennu uu ku yaallo goob juqraafiyeed oo istaraatiiji ah ayna leedahay mid ka mid ah xeebaha ugu dheer qaaradda Afrika, bulsho dhallinyaro u badan, Kalluun, dhul-beereed baaxad weyn elh iyo fursado kale oo dhinaca tamarta looga faa’iideysan karo, waxa uuna xusay in ay dowladdu diyaarisay qorshayaal fursadahaas loogu bedelayo wax-soo-saar, shaqo abuur iyo ganacsi, taasi oo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga u bedelaysa iskaashi dhaliya barwaaqo sooran. Si kastaba, Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay si weyn u ballaartay, iyadoo labada dal ay yeesheen iskaashi dhow, gaar ahaan dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga, dhaqaalaha, horumarinta iyo arrimaha bani’aadannimada ah. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale door muhiim ah ka qaatay taageerada Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhismaha iyo tababarka ciidamada. The post Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga oo 15 sano jirsaday iyo ra’iisul wasaare Xamza oo… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ceeldaahir iyo Hargeysa: Dhacdooyin Naxdin Leh oo Soo Kordhaya
items.description: Bari/Hargeysa (Raxanreeb Online): Magaalada Ceeldaahir ee gobolka Bari ayaa maanta laga soo sheegay dhacdo naxdin leh, kaddib markii nin lagu soo warramay inuu dilay walaalkiis, iyadoo la sheegay in muran ka dhashay dhul uu sababay falka. Dhanka kale, magaalada Hargeysa waxaa xalay ka dhacday dhacdo kale oo naxdin leh, iyadoo sida la sheegay oday uu dilay ilmihiisa. Labadan dhacdo ayaa walaac ka abuuraya bulshada, iyadoo ay soo badanayaan falalka rabshadaha ah ee ka dhasha khilaafaadka qoysaska, dhulka iyo arrimo kale oo bulshada dhexdeeda ah. Dhacdooyinka noocan ah ayaa mar kale muujinaya muhiimadda ay leedahay in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo hannaan sharci, si looga hortago in muran uu isu beddelo falal waxyeello leh. items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo Digniin Ka Soo Saaray Xildhibaanada Ka Maqan Fadhiyada
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), oo uu wehliyo Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow, ayaa shir guddoomiyey kulanka 4-aad ee Kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Golaha Shacabka. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa sheegay in xildhibaanada sabab la’aan uga maqnaada fadhiyada Golaha lala tiigsan doono xeer-hoosaadka Golaha, isagoo sidoo kale sheegay inaan la aqbali doonin xildhibaanada is xaadariya balse kulanka isaga baxa. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu dhaariyey Wasiir Ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, Mudane Cusmaan Maxamed Cabdi. Kulanka oo ku furmay kooram dhan 140 xildhibaan ayaa Golaha Shacabka lagu marsiiyey akhrinta koowaad Borotokoollada Dheeraadka ah ee kaabaya Afarta Axdi ee Geneva ee 1949-kii, kuwaas oo ay soo gudbisay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah. Sidoo kale, Xildhibaanadu waxay akhrinta labaad marsiiyeen Hindise Sharciyeedka Wax-ka-beddelka Qaybta 6-aad ee Sharciga Iibka Qaranka. Ugu dambeyn, Guddoomiye Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa xildhibaanada kula dardaarmay inay xoogga saaraan gudashada waajibaadka ay shacabka Soomaaliyeed u igmadeen. Xildhibaanada ayaa sidoo kale loo qeybiyey Heshiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Sharciga Badaha (UNCLOS) ee ku saabsan ilaalinta iyo isticmaalka waara ee kala-duwanaanshaha noolaha badda ee aagagga ka baxsan awoodda qaranka, oo loo yaqaan BBNJ Agreement. items.title: Xildhibaan Kooshin: “Waxaan Rabaa Waxa Dadkayga Somaliland Ay Rabaan”
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Xildhibaan Kooshin, oo Somaliland ku metela Golaha Shacabka Federaalka Soomaaliya, ayaa sheegay inuu taageersan yahay rabitaanka dadka uu metelo, isagoo sheegay inuu aaminsan yahay in Soomaaliya ay kala tagtay xilligii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye oo Xusaya 15 Sano oo Iskaashi ah+SAWIRO
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre, ayaa furay munaasabad lagu xusayay 15 sano oo iskaashi iyo xiriir dhow ah oo u dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Türkiye. Xiriirka labada dal ayaa si weyn u xoogeystay kaddib taageeradii Türkiye ay Soomaaliya siisay xilligii abaartii 2011, waxaana tan iyo xilligaas uu noqday mid kamid ah iskaashiyada ugu muhiimsan ee Soomaaliya la leedahay dalalka caalamka. Munaasabadda waxaa sidoo kale ka qeyb galay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah, Cabdisalaam Cabdi Cali, Wasiirka Batroolka iyo Kheyraadka Macdanta, Dahir Shire Maxamed, Wasiirka Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka, Xasan Macallin, iyo Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Federaalka, Cali Yuusuf Xoosh. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah, Cabdisalaam Cabdi Cali, ayaa xaqiijiyay sida ay Soomaaliya uga go’an tahay xoojinta iyo sii qotomeynta xiriirka ay la leedahay Türkiye, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ballanqaadeen in iskaashiga loo gudbiyo marxalad cusub. Munaasabadda ayaa lagu xusay 15 sano oo iskaashi, taageero iyo guulo wadajir ah, iyadoo la adkeeyay in xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye uu sii ahaan doono mid ku dhisan iskaashi, taageero iyo dano labada dhinac ah. The post Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye oo Xusaya 15 Sano oo Iskaashi ah+SAWIRO appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Daawo: Aabe wiilkiisa si arxan darro ah ugu dilay Hargeysa
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa kasoo baxaya dhacdo argagax leh oo xalay ka dhacday degmada Maxamed Mooge ee magaalada Hargeysa, kadib markii Aabe uu si arxan darro ah halkaasi ugu dilay wiilkiisa oo 10 sano jir ahaa. Qaar kamid ah dadka deegaanka oo la hadlay MM Soomaali TV ayaa ka warbixiyay sida ay wax u dhaceen, iyagoo sheegay inay aad uga argagaxeen falka naxdinta leh ee ka dhacay xaafaddooda. Hooyo Farax oo goobjoog u ahayd dhacdada ayaa sheegtay in wiilka oo lagu magacaabo Cali, uu ku soo daahay masjidka, waxayna tilmaantay in markii uu guriga yimid uu Aabihii, oo aad u caraysnaa gacanta ku dhigay, kadibna uu dhagax ku dilay canugga yar. “Wiilka wuu qabtay wuxuu geliyay labadiisa lugood dhexdooda, kadibna jilbaha ayuu ka saaray xabadka wuxuu watay dhagax oo uu saddex jeer wajiga kaga dhuftay anigu waxay indhaheygu qabteen isaga oo canuga jiidayo wuxuuna dhigay waddada isaga oo saaray dhagax wayn markiiba inankii maskaxda iyo dhulka ayaa isku dhagay,” ayay tiri Hooyo Farax oo kamid ahayd dadka dariska ah. Sidoo kale, oday kamid ah dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in Aabaha uu xanuunsanaa, isagoo intaa ku daray in dadka deegaanka ay isugu soo baxeen goobta uu dilku ka dhacay, kadib markii ay ka argagaxeen dhacdada naxdinta leh ee loo geystay wiilka yar. “Meeshaan waxaa ka dhacay arrin murugo leh Aabe wiilkiisii oo 10 jir ah ku dilay, welibasi arxan darro ah, waxaana la yiri waalidkaas waa xanuunsanayay,” ayuu isna yiri odey kamid ah dadka deegaanka. Dhinaca kale, waxaa goobta gaaray ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa ammaanka Somaliland, kuwaas oo la wareegay kiiska, isla markaana bilaabay baaritaan ku aaddan dhacdadaasi oo hadal-heyn xooggan ka dhalisay warbaahinta iyo baraha bulshada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dhacdadan ayaa si weyn looga hadal hayaa warbaahinta iyo baraha bulshada Soomaalida, iyadoo si weyn loo sugayo natiijada baaritaanka ay wadaan ciidamada Booliska Maamulka Somaliland. The post Daawo: Aabe wiilkiisa si arxan darro ah ugu dilay Hargeysa appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: NISA Confirms Airstrike on Al-Shabaab Gathering in Middle Shabelle
items.description: MOGADISHU— Somalia’s National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA) has confirmed that an airstrike was carried out in the Fiidow area of Middle Shabelle region, targeting a location where suspected Al-Shabaab members were reportedly holding a meeting. In a statement issued following the operation, NISA said the strike caused casualties among those targeted, but the agency did not provide an official figure for the number of militants killed or wounded. According to NISA, the operation was conducted in coordination with Somalia’s international security partners, who continue to support the Federal Government in aerial operations against Al-Shabaab. Somali security forces are responsible for gathering and providing intelligence on suspected militant positions, which is then used to identify and assess potential targets. Post-strike assessments are subsequently conducted to determine the scale of casualties and damage resulting from such operations. The United States and Türkiye are among Somalia’s international partners providing military and security support, including assistance with aerial operations targeting Al-Shabaab positions. The latest strike comes as Somali security forces, backed by international partners, continue operations aimed at disrupting Al-Shabaab’s command structures, movements and operational capabilities across Middle Shabelle and other parts of the country. The post NISA Confirms Airstrike on Al-Shabaab Gathering in Middle Shabelle appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Caddeymo xasaasi ah oo la helay kadib dagaalkii Baydhaba + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Warbixin cusub oo ay daabacday warbaahinta ku hadasha afka dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa waxaa lagu shaaciyay xog xasaasi ah oo la xiriirta dagaalkii Isniintii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo bandhigay astaamo muujinayo in weerarkii ciidamada taabacsan Lafta-gareen ku qaadeen magaaladaasi ay ka qayb-qateen maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab. Sidoo kale, warbaahinta ayaa baahisay sawirro laga soo qaaday goobta uu dagaalku ka dhacay, waxayna kusoo bandhigtay illaa 4 caddeymood oo waa wayn oo ay ku jiraan gaadiid qaraxyo ka buuxaan oo la adeegsaday iyo naftood-haligayaal ka tirsan Khawaarijta oo la sheegay inay is qarxiyeen. Hoos ka akhriso Warbixinta :- 1. Intii uu weerarku socday, waxaa is-qarxiyey ilaa saddex gaari oo ay wateen naftood-haligayaal ka tirsan Khawaarijta, waxaana goobaha ay isku qarxiyeen laga helay qaybo ka mid ah haraadiga Qaraxyada iyo xubnaha jirka dhagar-qabayaashii nafta is dhaafsiiyay. 2. Weerarka waxaa loo adeegsaday gaadiid lagu rakibay biraha aysan rasaastu karin, waxaana qaar ka mid ah gaadiidkaas loo adeegsaday qarxyada, halka kuwo kalena gacanta lagu dhigay. 3. Qaar ka mid ah gaadiidkii dagaalka ee gacanta lagu dhigay waxaa laga helay agab lagu yaqaan Khawaarijta, sida calankooda iyo walxaha qarxa ee macmalka ah. 4. Khawaarijtu waxay miinooyin ku aaseen waddooyinkii ay magaalada ka soo galeen. Ciidamada ammaanka ayaa miinooyinkaas ogaaday, waxayna ku guulaysteen inay si nabadgelyo leh dhulka uga soo saaraan, iyagoo aan qarxin. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa si cad u sheegtay in tallaabo adag laga qaadi doono maleeshiyaadkii cadowga iyo Khawaarijta naf-la-caariga ah ku soo hoggaamiyey magaalada Baydhabo. Khawaarijta ayaa lagu jabiyey dagaalkii shalay ay la galeen Ciidanka Qaranka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, waxaana gacanta lagu dhigay tiro maxaabiis ah oo qorshuhu yahay in cadaaladda la horgeeyo. Sidoo kale, warbaahinta ayaa baahisay sawirro laga soo qaaday goobta uu dagaalku ka dhacay, waxayna kusoo bandhigtay illaa 4 caddeymood oo waa wayn oo ay ku jiraan gaadiid qaraxyo ka buuxaan oo la adeegsaday iyo naftood-haligayaal ka tirsan Khawaarijta oo la sheegay inay is qarxiyeen. Hoos ka akhriso Warbixinta :- 1. Intii uu weerarku socday, waxaa is-qarxiyey ilaa saddex gaari oo ay wateen naftood-haligayaal ka tirsan Khawaarijta, waxaana goobaha ay isku qarxiyeen laga helay qaybo ka mid ah haraadiga Qaraxyada iyo xubnaha jirka dhagar-qabayaashii nafta is dhaafsiiyay. 2. Weerarka waxaa loo adeegsaday gaadiid lagu rakibay biraha aysan rasaastu karin, waxaana qaar ka mid ah gaadiidkaas loo adeegsaday qarxyada, halka kuwo kalena gacanta lagu dhigay. 3. Qaar ka mid ah gaadiidkii dagaalka ee gacanta lagu dhigay waxaa laga helay agab lagu yaqaan Khawaarijta, sida calankooda iyo walxaha qarxa ee macmalka ah. 4. Khawaarijtu waxay miinooyin ku aaseen waddooyinkii ay magaalada ka soo galeen. Ciidamada ammaanka ayaa miinooyinkaas ogaaday, waxayna ku guulaysteen inay si nabadgelyo leh dhulka uga soo saaraan, iyagoo aan qarxin. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa si cad u sheegtay in tallaabo adag laga qaadi doono maleeshiyaadkii cadowga iyo Khawaarijta naf-la-caariga ah ku soo hoggaamiyey magaalada Baydhabo. Khawaarijta ayaa lagu jabiyey dagaalkii shalay ay la galeen Ciidanka Qaranka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, waxaana gacanta lagu dhigay tiro maxaabiis ah oo qorshuhu yahay in cadaaladda la horgeeyo. The post Caddeymo xasaasi ah oo la helay kadib dagaalkii Baydhaba + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: The Economist Acknowledges Shift in Mogadishu’s Security Landscape
items.description: The Economist, a leading international publication that previously described Somalia’s state-building project as “broken” and warned that Mogadishu risked falling to Al-Shabaab, has now published a new report acknowledging significant security improvements in the capital. The report, titled “Mogadishu no longer deserves its deadly reputation,” marks a major shift in the publication’s perspective, with data showing that Al-Shabaab attacks in Mogadishu have declined to unprecedented levels. The new report is significant because it represents a major change in how a prominent international publication views Somalia’s capital, confirming what Somalis have long been saying: that the city is transforming and security is improving. The Economist’s data shows that Al-Shabaab attacks in the capital fell from 144 recorded in the third quarter of 2022 to just 5 in the second quarter of 2026. The decline in attacks has been attributed to security measures including the expansion of CCTV cameras, electronic registration for vehicle checks, and the presence of intelligence officers who have been widely deployed. New construction is rapidly transforming Mogadishu, with the Dahab Tower a 26-storey building containing apartments, a mall, a gym and a mosque expected to open this year. The report begins with an incident from six years ago, highlighting the story of a Mogadishu resident who ventured into the city center one night. The following night, a suicide attack at the same location killed seven civilians. That incident exemplified the security situation at the time, with Mogadishu residents living in constant fear that anywhere they went could become the next target. The security shift is not only about fewer attacks; it also affects how people live in the city and how they experience safety. The Economist’s assessment shows that Mogadishu today is different from what it was just a few years ago. The decline in Al-Shabaab attacks, the revival of urban activity, and the improving sense of security all indicate that the capital is recovering from years of fear and violence. However, the report’s central message is that while Mogadishu is moving away from its reputation as a city of death, maintaining the progress achieved and ensuring lasting security remain the biggest challenges ahead. The post The Economist Acknowledges Shift in Mogadishu’s Security Landscape first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: The Economist oo Daaha Ka Rogtay Isbeddelka Amniga Caasimadda Soomaaliya
items.description: Majalladda caalamiga ah ee The Economist, oo sanadkii hore ku sheegtay in mashruuca dowlad-dhiska Soomaaliya uu yahay mid “burburay” iyo in Muqdisho ay halis ku jirto inay gacanta ku dhacdo Al-Shabaab , ayaa hadda soo saartay warbixin cusub oo aqoonsanaysa horumarka amni ee caasimadda. Warbixintan cusub, oo cinwaankeedu yahay “Mogadishu no longer deserves its deadly reputation” , waxay muujinaysaa isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada aragtida majalladda, iyadoo tirakoobyadu ay caddaynayaan in weerarrada Al-Shabaab ee Muqdisho ay hoos u dhaceen heer aan horay loo arag. Warbixintan cusub waxay muhiim u tahay sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan tahay isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada aragtida majalladda caalamiga ah, waxayna xaqiijinaysaa waxa ay Soomaalidu muddo dheer sheegaysay: in caasimaddu tahay mid is-beddeleysa oo horumarka amni ka socda. Tirakoobyada The Economist waxay muujinayaan in weerarrada Al-Shabaab ee caasimadda ay hoos u dhaceen 144 weerar oo la duubay rubuci 3aad ee 2022 , ilaa 5 oo keliya rubuci 2aad ee 2026 . Hoos u dhaca weerarrada ayaa loo aaneynayaa tallaabooyin amni oo ay ka mid yihiin fidinta kamaradaha CCTV-ga, diiwaangelinta elektarooniga ah ee baarista baabuurta lamaanaha, iyo joogitaanka saraakiil sirdoon ah oo si weyn loo baahiyay . Dhismaha cusub ayaa si xawli ah uga socda Muqdisho, iyadoo Dahab Tower, oo ah dhisme 26 dabaq ah oo ka kooban guryo, dukaan weyn, jimicsi iyo masaajid, la filayo inuu sanadkan furmo . Warbixintu waxay ku bilowday dhacdo ka dhacday Muqdisho lix sano ka hor, iyadoo soo qaadatay qisada Saakin Abdi, oo ah qof magaalada ku nool oo habeen u-jalaato doontay bartamaha Muqdisho. Habeenki xigay, isla goobti ayaa waxaa ka dhacay weerar ismiidaamin ah oo lagu dilay toddobo qof oo rayid ah . Dhacdadaasi ayaa tusaale u ah xaaladdii amni ee caasimadda xilligaas, iyadoo dadka Muqdisho ay ku noolaayeen cabsi ah in goob kasta oo ay joogaan ay noqon karto bartilmaameed xiga. Isbeddelka amni ma aha oo keliya tirada weerarrada oo yaraatay; wuxuu sidoo kale taabanayaa habka ay dadka ugu nool yihiin magaalada iyo sida ay u dareemaan amniga. Qiimeynta The Economist waxay muujinaysaa in Muqdisho ay maanta ka duwan tahay sidii ay ahayd dhowr sano ka hor. Hoos-u-dhaca weerarrada Al-Shabaab, soo kabashada dhaqdhaqaaqa magaalada iyo dareenka amni ee soo hagaagaya ayaa tilmaamaya in caasimaddu ay ka soo kabanayso sannado badan oo ay hareeyeen cabsi iyo rabshado. Si kastaba, farriinta ugu muhiimsan ee warbixintu waa in Muqdisho ay ka sii fogaanayso sumcad-darradii ahayd magaalada geerida badan, balse ilaalinta horumarka la gaaray iyo xaqiijinta amni waara ayaa weli ah caqabadda ugu weyn ee hortaalla Muqdisho. The post The Economist oo Daaha Ka Rogtay Isbeddelka Amniga Caasimadda Soomaaliya first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Texas teacher cries after high school students fail to write
items.description: Darius Williams, a teacher at Wheatley High School in Houston, Texas, has sparked a nationwide conversation after posting an emotional video of himself crying over his students’ struggles. Williams teaches 17- and 18-year-old seniors, many of whom are able to express themselves clearly in conversation but face significant difficulties when asked to put their thoughts into writing. The incident occurred early in the school year when Williams gave his class a short reading passage followed by a simple writing exercise. Several students struggled to complete the task. What surprised Williams was that the same students could articulate their opinions, engage in debates, and make strong verbal arguments, but when it came to writing, they fell short. After class, Williams recorded himself in tears, speaking about how heartbreaking it was to see students on the verge of graduation still lacking fundamental literacy skills they should have developed years earlier. The video quickly went viral, sparking a much larger conversation about education gaps in the United States. The situation raised an important question: How can students spend more than a decade in school and still reach their final year without mastering basic reading and writing? For Williams, the experience was more than just a classroom challenge; it was a painful reminder of how critical early intervention and support can be. He hopes his video will encourage more discussion about how to better prepare students for the future. The post Texas teacher cries after high school students fail to write first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Xog: Dalkee maal-geliyey ciidanka uu Xasan tababarka ugu soo xiray GALMUDUG
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Xog dheeri ah ayaa ka soo baxeysa tababar ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya u soo xirtay ku dhowaad 3,000 oo askari oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, kuwaas oo muddo ku dhow hal sano tababar ku qaadanayay xerada Xananbuure ee gobolka Galgaduud. Tirada askarta tababarka dhammeystay ayaa lagu tilmaamay kooxdii ugu ballaarneyd ee heerkan oo kale gudaha Soomaaliya lagu tababaro tan iyo burburkii dowladdii dhexe sanadkii 1991-kii, iyadoo dowladda ay tallaabadan qeyb ka dhigeyso qorshaha dib-u-dhiska ciidamada qaranka. Askarta, oo laga soo kala xulay deegaanno kala duwan oo dalka ah, ayaa muddadii tababarka lagu barayay xeeladaha aasaasiga ah ee dagaalka, anshaxa iyo shuruucda ciidamada, adeegsiga hubka iyo xirfado kale oo muhiim u ah shaqada ciidanka. Tababarka waxaa bixiyay macallimiin militari oo ka kala socday Ukraine, Romania iyo Sudan, waxaana barnaamijka maalgelisay dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya. Barnaamijkan ayaa qeyb ka ah heshiis ay Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudi Carabiya gaareen bishii Febraayo, kaas oo dhigaya in la tababaro ilaa 5,000 oo askari oo Soomaaliyeed. Munaasabadda lagu soo xirayay tababarka waxaa ka qeyb galay madax ka tirsan dowladda federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada, saraakiil ciidan iyo wakiillo ka socday Sacuudi Carabiya oo qeyb ka ahaa la-socodka barnaamijka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo guddoomiyay munaasabadda, ayaa tababarka ciidamada ku tilmaamay astaan muujineysa dib-u-soo-kabashada hay’adaha dowladda iyo dadaalka lagu dhisayo ciidan Soomaaliyeed oo awood u leh inuu dalkiisa difaaco. “Ciidamadani waxay matalayaan soo-kabashada dowladnimada iyo dib-u-dhiska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in awoodda Soomaaliya ay gudaha dalka ugu tababarto tiro badan oo askar ah ay muujineyso horumar laga sameeyay isku-filnaanshaha dhinaca ciidamada. Arrintan ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli dowladda federaalka ay dooneyso in ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si tartiib ah ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda buuxda ee amniga dalka, iyadoo howlgalka ciidamada Midowga Afrika uu wajahayo qorshe dhimis iyo kala-guur ah. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sanadihii dambe kordhisay dadaallada lagu tababarayo laguna qalabeynayo ciidamada, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in ciidanka qaranku ay si weyn ula wareegaan howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo sugidda goobaha ay hadda taageerada ka bixiyaan ciidamada shisheeye. Hase yeeshee, dhismaha ciidan tiro iyo tayo leh keliya ma xallinayo caqabadaha muddada dheer haystay ciidamada Soomaaliya. Waxaa weli muhiim ah in dowladda ay joogteyso mushaharka ciidamada, hubka iyo rasaasta safafka hore, sahayda, daryeelka askarta iyo nidaam awood u leh inuu ciidanka tababaran ku sii hayo shaqada. Sidaas darteed, tababarka kumannaanka askari ee Xananbuure wuxuu dowladda u yahay tallaabo weyn oo dhinaca dhismaha ciidamada ah, balse guusha muddada dheer waxay ku xirnaan doontaa sida ciidamadan loo qalabeeyo, loo maareeyo looguna diyaariyo inay si joogto ah ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga Soomaaliya. The post Xog: Dalkee maal-geliyey ciidanka uu Xasan tababarka ugu soo xiray GALMUDUG appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Macallin Texas ah oo ooyay ka dib markii ardayda sare ay wax qori wayeen
items.description: Darius Williams, oo ah macallin ku sugan Dugsiga Sare ee Wheatley ee Houston, ayaa noqday mid ay dadku ka hadlaan ka dib markii uu duubay isaga oo ooyaya, isagoo ka hadlaya sida ay u adag tahay in ardaydiisa 17 iyo 18 jirka ah ay la kulmaan dhibaatooyin aasaasi ah oo ku saabsan akhriska iyo qorista. Williams ayaa sheegay in ardaydiisa ay si fiican u hadli karaan oo ay u sheegi karaan fikradahooda, laakiin marka la weydiiyo inay wax qoraan ay dhibaato weyn la kulmaan . Sheekadan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay soo kordhisay dood weyn oo ku saabsan waxbarashada iyo farqiga u dhexeeya ardayda, iyadoo la isweydiinayo sida ay suurtagal u tahay in ardaydu 12 sano ku qaataan dugsiga, balse ay gaadhaan fasalka sare iyagoo weli la kulma dhibaatooyin aasaasi ah oo ku saabsan xirfadaha akhriska iyo qorista. Williams ayaa duubay isaga oo ooyaya, isagoo ka hadlaya sida ay u adag tahay in la arko ardayda ku dhow inay ka qalin jebiyaan dugsiga sare iyagoon haysan xirfadihii la filayey inay horay u yeeshaan . items.title: Muqdisho oo laga xusayo 15 sano guuradii ka soo wareegtay markii uu dib u xoogaystay xariika Soomaaliya iyo Turkigu ?
items.description: Munaasabad ballaaran oo lagu xusayo dib u curashadii xariirka istiraatiijiga ah ee Soomaaliya  iyo Turkiga oo hadda jirsaday 15 sano oo xiriir iyo iskaashi diblomaasiyadeed oo qoto dheer ah  ayaa ka dhacday magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoo ay ka qeyb galeen mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, saraakiil iyo diblomaasiyiin ka socday dowladda Turkiga. Munaasabadda ayaa lagu soo bandhigay taariikhda xiriirka labada dal iyo waxqabadkii ka dhashay iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga muddadii 15-ka sano ahayd ee lasoo dhaafay. Xiriirka labada dal ayaa si weyn dib ugu soo xoogaystay 2011-kii, xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahaysay xaalad bani’aadannimo oo aad u adag, oo ay ka jireen abaaro ba’an iyo dagaallo, gaar ahaan dagaalladii u dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda iyo Al-Shabaab ee ka socday qeybo ka mid ah magaalada Muqdisho. Xilligaas, Soomaaliya waxaa hoggaaminayay dowladdii KMG ahayd ee uu madaxweynaha ka ahaa Shariif Sheekh Axmed, iyadoo Turkigu uu noqday mid ka mid ah dalalkii si weyn uga jawaabay xaaladda Soomaaliya. Madaxweyne Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa sannadkii 2011 soo booqday Muqdisho, booqashadaas oo loo arkay mid muhiim u ahayd dib-u-soo-nooleynta xiriirka labada dal iyo muujinta taageerada Turkiga ee Soomaaliya xilli dalka uu ku jiray xaalad adag. Muddooyinkii lasoo dhaafay, iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga wuxuu ku fiday dhinacyo kala duwan, oo ay ka mid yihiin gargaarka bani’aadannimo, horumarinta dhaqaalaha, amniga, waxbarashada, caafimaadka iyo tababarka ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Turkiga ayaa door muuqda ku leh tababarka iyo dhismaha awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliya, iyadoo Ankara ay tababartay cutubyo ka tirsan ciidamada Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin ciidamada Gorgor, oo door ka qaatay howlaha amniga iyo la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab. Mas’uuliyiintii ka hadlay munaasabadda ayaa xusay in xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga uu ka gudbay iskaashi diblomaasiyadeed oo keliya, isla markaana uu noqday xiriir ku dhisan saaxiibtinimo, walaaltinimo iyo iskaashi istiraatiiji ah. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale Muqdisho ku leh safaarad iyo xarumo kala duwan oo ka shaqeeya xoojinta xiriirka labada dal, halka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiguna ay sannadihii dambe kordhiyeen iskaashiga dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga iyo horumarinta.

items.title: NISA oo howlgal ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab ka fulisay deegaanka Fidow
items.description: Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabad Sugidda Qaranka Soomaaliyeed (NISA), iyadoo taageero ka heleysa saaxiibbo caalami ah, ayaa sheegtay inay howlgal qorshaysan ka fulisay deegaanka Fidow ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Sida lagu sheegay war kasoo baxay NISA, howlgalka ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday guri ay hay’addu sheegtay in xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab ay ku dhuumaaleysanayeen, ayadoo NISA ay sheegtay in xubnihii ku jiray guriga lagu dilay howlgalka. Hay’addu faahfaahin dheeraad ah kama bixin tirada dadka lagu dilay howlgalka, cidda ay ahaayeen ama nooca taageerada ay ka heshay saaxiibbada caalamiga ah.

items.title: Dowladda Federaalka oo ciidamo hor leh u daabushay Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya waqooyiga Gobolka Galgaduud ayaa sheegaya in cutubyo ka tirsan ciidamadii tababarka loogu soo xiray Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Xananbuure ay Dowladda Federaalka u dhaqaajisay jiidda hore ee bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Ciidamadan oo loogu talagalay inay la dagaalamaan maleeshiyada ayaa waxaa Axaddii tababarka u soo xiray Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada ka qalabka qaatay Xerada Militariga Xananbuure ay ka qayb qaadanayaan hawlgalka militari ee bariga Gobolka Hiiraan ee lagu xoreynayo dhulka ka maqan gacanta qaranka. Dhaqaaqooda cusub ayaa wuxuu ku aaddan yahay xoojinta guluf ballaaran oo ka dhan ah maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, iyagoo taageeraya ciidamadii maalmahaanba ku sugnaa duleedka deegaanka Teedaan. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud oo tan iyo Jimcihii ku sugan deegaanada Galmudug ay ka go’an tahay in ciidamadu ay dib ugu laabtaan Teedaan, oo ay ka soo baxeen 2-dii bishan, markaas oo ay Al Shabaab la wareegtay. Sarkaal ka tirsan Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo codsaday inaanan magaciisa Warbaahinta loo adeegsan ayaa inoo sheegay in qorshaha la dejiyay uu yahay inay ciidamadu sidoo kale xoreeyaan Degmooyinka Maxaas iyo Moqokori. Shabaabka ayaa dagaalo culus 7-dii iyo 27-kii bishii July ee sanadkii 2025 ku qabsaday Moqokori iyo Maxaas. Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa ah meesha ay hadda dhaqdhaqaaqa ugu xoogan ka wadaan Ciidamada Militariga iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka.

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka BJFS oo kulan la yeeshay Safiirka Sacuudiga ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa xafiiskiisa kulan kula qaatay Safiirka Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ahmed Mohammed Almowallad. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xiriirka soo jireenka ah iyo walaaltinimada labada dal. Safiirka Sacuudiga ayaa ugu horreyn Guddoomiye Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ugu hambalyeeyey doorashadiisa xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee BJFS, isagoo u rajeeyey inuu si wanaagsan uga soo baxo waajibaadka loo igmaday. Dhinaca kale, Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya uga mahadceliyey taageerada joogtada ah ee ay la garab taagan tahay dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale muujiyey muhiimadda ay labada dhinac siinayaan sii xoojinta xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed, walaaltinimo iyo iskaashi ee Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudi Carabiya, kaas oo muddo dheer soo jiray.

items.title: Wasiir FIQI oo si kulul ugu jawaabay mucaaradka DF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa si kulul ugu jawaabay xubnaha mucaaradka ee Madasha Samatabixinta Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo shalay shir jaraa’id oo ka dhan ah dowladda ku qabtay hoteelka Jasiira ee magaalada Muqdisho. Mucaaradka aya si weyn u dhaliilay sida ay wax u waddo dowladda, gaar ahaan arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo howlaha burburinta ee weli ka socda caasimada. Wasiir Fiqi oo inta badan difaaca xukuumadda uu ka tirsan yahay, ayaa si dadban ugu jawaabay mucaaradka, isagoo adeegsaday sheeko uu ka sheegay isbitaalka Laasareeti ee lagu daryeelo dadka qaba xanuunnada dhimmirka. Fiqi ayaa sheegay in xubnaha Madasha ay toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay aamusnaayeen, balse ay hadda dib u bilaabeen catowgoodii, isaga oo tilmaamay inay u baahan yihiin daawada dhabta ah oo uu ku sheegay doorasho qof iyo cod ah. “Madasha calaacalka dhowrkii todobaad ee la soo dhaafay waa aasmunaayeen waxaa loo qaatay in ay soo bogsanayaan, balse ha iska boodboodaan, waxaa la gaari doonaa mar ay daawada dhabta ah qaataan taasoo ah “doorasho qof iyo cod ah,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi. Hoos ka akhriso qoraalka oo dhammaystiran;- Kooxdii madasha Calaacalka oo shidaal lagu soo shubay oo waxaan arkay Shalay galab catowgii dib u bilowday. Waxaa la iiga sheekeeyey sheekooyin ka dhacay isbitaalkii Laasareeti ee lagu daryeeli jiray dadka xanuunka dhimirka qaba!. Waqti waqtiyada ka mid ah ayaa waxaa soo booqday Dhakhtar wasaaradda caafimaadka ka socday ayadoo markii loogu warbixiyay in bukaanadii intoodii badnayd soo bogsanayaan, waxaana la galiyay qol lagu soo uruuriyay intoodii ugu fiicnayd, oo ay ku jireen koox bukaanno ah, waxay isla markiiba dhakhtarkii indhihiisu qabteen saddex nin oo waalan oo boodboodaya. Wuxuu weydiiyey kii koowaad: Maxaad u boodboodaysaa? Wuxuu yiri: Waxaan ahay Rah. Kii labaad ayuu weydiiyey: — Adiguna? Wuxuu asna ku jawaabay: — Aniguna Rah ayaan ahay. Markaas ayuu weydiiyay kii saddexaad: — Adiguna Rah miyaad tahay? Wuxuu yiri:— Maya, anigu waxaan ahay dhakhtar! Dhakhtarkii ayaa farxay oo yiri: — Ugu dambayn qof miyir qaba ayaan helay! Ninkii saddexaad ayaa hal mar la soo booday: — Haa waa aniga kaas, oo waxaan sugayaa inta ay labadan Rah boodboodka ka dhammeysanayaan si aan warqadda daawada ugu qoro! Madasha calaacalka dhowrkii todobaad ee la soo dhaafay waa aasmunaayeen waxaa loo qaatay in ay soo bogsanayaan, balse ha iska boodboodaan, waxaa la gaari doonaa mar ay daawada dhabta ah qaataan taasoo ah “doorasho qof iyo cod ah”. Waqti waqtiyada ka mid ah ayaa waxaa soo booqday Dhakhtar wasaaradda caafimaadka ka socday ayadoo markii loogu warbixiyay in bukaanadii intoodii badnayd soo bogsanayaan, waxaana la galiyay qol lagu soo uruuriyay intoodii ugu fiicnayd, oo ay ku jireen koox bukaanno ah, waxay isla markiiba dhakhtarkii indhihiisu qabteen saddex nin oo waalan oo boodboodaya. Wuxuu weydiiyey kii koowaad: Maxaad u boodboodaysaa? Wuxuu yiri: Waxaan ahay Rah. Kii labaad ayuu weydiiyey: — Adiguna? Wuxuu asna ku jawaabay: — Aniguna Rah ayaan ahay. Markaas ayuu weydiiyay kii saddexaad: — Adiguna Rah miyaad tahay? Wuxuu yiri:— Maya, anigu waxaan ahay dhakhtar! Dhakhtarkii ayaa farxay oo yiri: — Ugu dambayn qof miyir qaba ayaan helay! Ninkii saddexaad ayaa hal mar la soo booday: — Haa waa aniga kaas, oo waxaan sugayaa inta ay labadan Rah boodboodka ka dhammeysanayaan si aan warqadda daawada ugu qoro! Madasha calaacalka dhowrkii todobaad ee la soo dhaafay waa aasmunaayeen waxaa loo qaatay in ay soo bogsanayaan, balse ha iska boodboodaan, waxaa la gaari doonaa mar ay daawada dhabta ah qaataan taasoo ah “doorasho qof iyo cod ah”. items.title: Sheekh Shariif oo sheegay cidda qaadaysa mas’uuliyadda dagaalkii Baydhaba + Video
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee dowladdii ku-meel-gaarka ahayd, Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed, ayaa si adag uga hadlay dagaalkii Isniintii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta Gobolka Baay, kaas oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen). Sheekh Shariif ayaa wax laga xumaado ku tilmaamay dagaallada soo noqnoqday ee ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba, oo ah xarunta ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, wuxuuna tacsi u diray ehellada iyo qoysaska dadkii ku dhintay dagaalkii Isniintii, isaga oo sidoo kale caafimaad deg-deg ah u rajeeyay dadka ku dhaawacmay. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka ayaa mas’uuliyadda wixii ka dhacay Baydhaba dusha uga tuuray Dowladda Federaalka, isaga oo ku eedeeyay inay si khaldan u maareysay isbeddelkii siyaasadeed ee ka dhacay magaaladaas, taas oo uu sheegay inay horseedday xaaladda adag ee maanta taagan. “Baydhaba dad ayaa ku dhintay, dad ayaa qaxay, kuwo kalena waa dhaawacmeen. Mas’uuliyaddee waxaas ku dhacayaan? Mas’uuliyadda dowladda ayay ku dhacayaan. Isbeddel haddii la sameynayo, waxaa la sameyn karay isbeddel heshiis lagu yahay oo dadku ay aqbaleen,” ayuu yiri Sheekh Shariif. Waxaa kale oo uu sii raaciyay, “Reer Koonfur Galbeed inaan isha ka fiirsanno oo aan ka aamusno waa dadnimo xumo, waana ogtihiin inaan ka dignay.” Dhinaca kale, waxa uu soo hadal qaaday khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ka taagan hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka, isaga oo tilmaamay in ilaa iyo hadda aan laga gaarin wax heshiis ah oo ay dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo Dowladda Federaalku si wadajir ah ugu qancaan. Sheekha ayaa sidoo kale eedeymo u jeediyay dowladda dhexe, gaar ahaan sida ay u wajahayso doorashooyinka ka socda qaar ka mid ah Dowlad-goboleedyada dalka. Waxa uu sheegay in Dowladda Federaalku aysan si siman ula dhaqmin dhinacyada siyaasadda, isaga oo su’aal geliyay habka ay dowladdu u maareyneyso doorashooyinka dalka. “Doorashada quruxdeedu waa heshiis. Haddii aan heshiis la ahayn, doorasho kasta oo la sheego macno ma sameyneyso. Laaluushka waagii hore ma gaari jirin baadiyaha. Codka meeqo ayaa la kala gadanayay markii ugu dambeysay? 50 doollar. Sow xaaraan looma geyn dadkaasi?” ayuu mar kale yiri Sheekh Shariif. The post Sheekh Shariif oo sheegay cidda qaadaysa mas’uuliyadda dagaalkii Baydhaba + Video appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Qatar Charity Empowers Needy Families Economically In Somalilan
items.description: MENAFN – Gulf Times) With the support of philanthropists, Qatar Charity (QC), in co-operation with Somaliland’s ministry of employment, social affairs and family, delivered economic empowerment projects benefiting 113 persons from the most vulnerable groups in Hargeisa. The initiative is part of the QC’s development efforts to promote sustainable livelihoods, reduce unemployment, and support self-reliance among low-income families. The distributed projects, which included clothing shops, grocery stores selling food supplies and vegetables, fish and seafood marketing ventures, taxis, motorcycles, three-wheeled vehicles, and barber shops, were selected following an assessment of beneficiaries’ needs and local market requirements to enhance their prospects for success and sustainability. Somaliland’s Minister of Employment, Social Affairs and Family Milgo Mohamed Elmi lauded the project and its role in supporting needy families and strengthening economic and social stability. She affirmed that economic empowerment initiatives are among the most effective solutions for addressing the livelihood challenges faced by many unemployed or low-income families, and added that empowering 113 male and female beneficiaries at this stage reflects the importance of partnership between government institutions and humanitarian and development organisations. Elmi also commended Qatar Charity’s efforts to implement projects with sustainable impact, contributing to building beneficiaries’ capacities and enabling them to become self-reliant in securing their livelihoods. Abdulfattah Adam Moalim, the director of the QC office in Somalia, affirmed that the project embodies Qatar Charity’s commitment to promoting self-sufficiency and supporting the most vulnerable groups through development projects that provide stable sources of income and open new prospects for beneficiaries to build a better future. He said that women, particularly female breadwinners and mothers of orphans, accounted for a large proportion of the project’s beneficiaries. Kaysi Barkhad Abdi, beneficiary of a men’s barber shop project, said:“I had been unemployed for a long time and was looking for an opportunity that would enable me to provide for my family’s needs.” “Today, I feel that I have begun a new chapter in my life after receiving this project,” Abdi said.“I extend my thanks to Qatar Charity and the generous donors for this opportunity, which has given me hope and confidence in the future.”

items.title: Faa’iidada la ogaaday ee uu leeyahay koobka shaaha ah ee aad ka tuurto maalintii
items.description: Daraasad cusub oo la sameeyay ayaa daaha ka qaadday in cabbitaanka koob shaaha ah ama kafee ah maalin kasta ay kaa ilaalin karto da’da, sidoo kalena ay ka hortagi karto daciifnimada jirka iyo gabowga. Sida uu daabacay wargeyska The Telegraph ee ka soo baxa Ingiriiska, daraasaddan waxaa sameeyay koox ka socotay Jaamacadda Qaranka ee Singapore, waxaana ka qayb qaatay 12,000 oo qof, oo da’doodu u dhaxayso 45 ilaa 74 jir, kuwaas oo shaah cabayey muddo 20 sano ah. Ka qaybgalayaasha Daraasadda ee da’doodu ay tahay celcelis ahaan 53, jir ayaa la waydiiyay sida cabitaanka shaaha iyo qaxwaha u caawiyay iyo awoodda ay ka helaan marka ay cabaan . Sid0o kale dadka da’doodu gaadhay 73 jir ayaa waxa la waydiiyay su’aalo la xariira shaaha iyo kaalinta uu ka qaatay xoojinta jirka iyo awoodda . Cilmi-barayaashu waxay sheegeen in ay jiraan dhawr arrimood oo muujinaya qofka la ildaran tabar-darrida jireed oo ah mid da’ ay keentay, miisaanka oo yaraada, daal, gaabiska socodka , iyo daciifnimada murqaha kuwaas oo dhaaman shaahu xoojin karo. Cilmi baaristu waxay muujiyeen in 84 boqolkiiba ka qaybgalayaashu ay sheegeen in ay si joogto ah u cabbaan kafeega, halka 12 boqolkiiba ay sheegeen in ay cabbeen shaaha. In ka badan saddex-meelood laba oo ah (68.5 boqolkiiba) waxay tilmaameen in ay cabaan maalinkii hal koob kafeega ah , halka 42.2 boqolkiiba ay cabaan laba ilaa saddex koob maalintii, ayada oo 4.9 boqolkiiba ay cabbaan 4 koob ama ka badan maalintii. Natiijooyinka waxay muujiyeen in cabbitaanka kafeega ama shaaha ee da’da dhexe qofka ku jira ay waxtar u leedahay, waxaana daraasadda lagu sheegay in kafeega uu aad u wanaagsan yahay marka labadooda la is barbardhigo. Daraasadan la daabacay ayaa xaqiijisay in cabbitaanka laba ilaa saddex koob oo kafee ah maalin kasta ay si weyn u dheerayn karto nolosha qofka .Dadka ku nool daafaha caalamka ayaa cabayay shaaha iyo kafeega kumanaan qarni ka hor iyagoo u arka inuu wanaagsan yahay. Daraasado badan ayaa muujiyay in shaaha uu kaalin mug leh ka qaato habka difaaca jirka, la dagaalanka caabuqyada sababa bararka, xanuunada kansarka iyo wadna xanuunka.Khubarada cuntada ee dalka Maraykanka ayaa horay shaaca uga qaaday in Shaaha uu jirka u leeyahay faa’iido caafimaad oo ay ka mid tahay korriinka jirka. Sidoo kale waxaa ay sheegeen in Shaaha bigayska ee sida joogtada ah loo isticmaalaa uu jirka u leeyahay faa’iido aan la soo koobi karin, sababtoo ah waxa ku jira, Maadada loo yaqaan Flavonoids iyo Antioxidants oo ah maadooyin la dagaalama waxyaabaha gabowga jirka ku dhaliya isla markaana firfircooni galiya dhiiga iyo koriinka jirka oo wasakhda ka saara. Iyadoo uu shaaha iyo kafeegu leeyihiin dhammaan faa’idooyinkaas ayaa haddana waxaa jira khataro caafimaad oo ka dhalan kara haddii uu qofka si xad dhaaf ah u isticmaalo. Dhibaatooyinkaas ayaa waxaa ka mid ah haddii aad kafeega si xad dhaaf ah aad u cabto, taas ayaa laga yaabaa inay kuu horseeddo neerfahaaga oo aad u kaco iyo degenaansho la’aan, waxaana laga yaabaa inay carqaladeyso hurdadaada. Ugu danbeeyna xeeldheerayaasha caafimaadka ayaa qaba in shaaha iyo kafeega ay muhiim yiiin, balse waxaa ay ku taliyeen in aan si xad dhaaf ah loo cabin, sokortana laga yareeyo, ama haddii loo bahdo aan lagu darin. Bbc somali

items.title: Walaac cusub oo dhinaca amniga oo ka jira Magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa waxaa ka jira guux ku saabsan in xoogaga taageersan Madaxweyne Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ay markan weerarada ka abaabuli karaan gudaha magaaladaasi, ka dib weerarkii xooganaa ee Isniintii ay ku soo qaadeen magaalada. Dadka ku nool magaalada ayaa waxay ka cabsi qabaan in weeraro kale laga abaabulo gudaha magaalada. Cabsidan ayaa timid, ka dib dagaalkii cuslaa ee maalin ka hor ka dhacay bartamaha magaalada, iyadoo aan gudaha Baydhabo laga samayn hawlgal sifayn ah. Ciidamada magaalada soo weeraray ayaa Baydhabo ka soo galay hal jiho, balse markii laga saarayay bartamaha magaaladaasi ayay uga baxeen jihooyin kala duwan, kuwaas oo qaarkood la tuhunsan yahay in ay weli ku sugan yihiin magaalada. Weerarku wuxuu ahaa mid ka xoogan weerarkii ay sidaan oo kale 30-kii bishii May gudaha ugu soo galeen magaalada, marka aad eegto saacadaha uu socday iyo khasaaraha nafeed ee uu gaystay. Taageereyaasha Laftagareen ee Isniintii isku soo fidiyay magaalada ayaa isugu jiray ciidamo ka tirsanaa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed iyo maleeshiyaad ku heyb ah Laftagareen, inkastoo Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ay sheegtay in ciidamo daacad u ah Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ay si wadajir ah u soo weerareen magaalada. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyay in weerarka laga soo qaaday bannaanka magaalada, isla-markaana ay ku lug lahaayeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dadka reer Baydhabo ayaa walaac ka muujinaya in ciidamada hubeysan ee la tuhunsan yahay inay ku sugan yihiin magaalada ay ka sameeyaan qalqalgelin amni. Dadku waxay ka welwelsan yihiin inaanu amnigu ahayn mid sugan, isla-markaana aan hal dhinac gacanta ugu jirin, taasna ay halis ku tahay ammaankooda iyo in si nabad ah loogu noolaado magaalada. Baydhabo ayaa waxaa ka socdo kulamo looga hadlayo ammaanka iyo suurtagalnimada in la qaado tallaabooyin dheeraad ah oo lagu xasillinayo magaalada. Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa waxaa ku sugan shan nooc oo ka tirsan Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka, oo kala ah Gorgor, Polizia Militare, Haramcad, NISA iyo Ciidanka Guutada 8aad, Qaybta 60aad ee Xoogga Dalka. items.title: Waa dalkee dalka aqbalay 1200 00 qof oo laga masaafurinaayo dalka Maraykanka?
items.description: Liberia waxay oggolaatay inay qaabisho ilaa 1,200 qof oo laga masaafurinayo Maraykanka, kuwaas oo aan asal ahaan u dhalan Liberia, muddo hal sano ah. Tani waxay ka mid tahay heshiisyada ugu waaweyn ee noocan ah, iyadoo Maraykanku sii adkaynayo siyaasaddiisa ka dhanka ah socdaalka sharci-darrada ah. Dadka la keenayo waxay ka iman doonaan Afrika, Waqooyiga Ameerika, Koonfurta Ameerika iyo Kariibiyaanka. Kooxdii ugu horreysay oo ka kooban 20 qof ayaa la filayaa inay Liberia gaaraan Khamiista. Mas’uuliyiinta Liberia waxay sheegeen in dadkaas la baaray ka hor intaan la keenin, waxaana la sheegay in badankoodu ay galeen xadgudubyo la xiriira sharciga socdaalka. Dadka la keenayo waxay sidoo kale heli doonaan fursad ay magangelyo uga codsadaan Liberia, ama ay dalka uga baxaan haddii ay doonayaan. Dowlado kale oo Afrikaan ah ayaa iyaguna hore u bilaabay inay qaabilaan dad Maraykanku masaafurinayo oo aan si sharci ah loogu celin karin dalalkoodii.

items.title: Somalia ex-president blames govt for Baidoa bloodshed that left 30 dead
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed on Tuesday placed sole responsibility for the deadly fighting in Baidoa on the federal government of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, arguing that the violence was the direct consequence of a change of power imposed by force in Southwest State this past March. Sharif, addressing the escalating crisis in the regional capital, described Monday’s clashes as unfortunate and said they represented something that he, fellow opposition figures, and any person of sound conscience could never stop condemning. The former head of state said his objections to the federal government’s handling of Southwest State were neither new nor selective. He recalled that he had opposed Mogadishu’s move to extend the tenure of regional state leaders, including that of Southwest’s former president, Abdiaziz Laftagaren, and had likewise objected when federal authorities subsequently used force to remove Laftagaren’s administration and install a leadership of their own choosing in the region. Addressing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud directly, Sharif appealed for restraint and reconciliation. Whatever has been done, he said, whether right or wrong, the moment has come to return to the table of dialogue before it becomes too late – before the country fragments to a point beyond recovery. Death Toll and Clashes The fighting in Baidoa left at least 30 people dead, the overwhelming majority of them combatants drawn from federal government troops on one side and forces loyal to ousted Southwest State leader Abdiaziz Laftagaren on the other. Fighters loyal to Laftagaren briefly seized parts of the town before being driven out in a federal counter-attack on Monday. Disputed Government Claims In the aftermath of the clashes, the federal government displayed dead bodies and detainees it said it had captured from forces opposing it, along with what it described as captured military vehicles. Officials characterized those killed and captured as members of Al-Shabaab. However, the government has so far produced no independent evidence to substantiate that claim. Former local officials in Baidoa who reviewed the images of the dead and detained said they recognized the individuals as fighters belonging to Laftagaren’s Darwish forces, the paramilitary units that had served under his administration, rather than as members of the Al-Qaeda-linked militant group. The government also presented the burned wreckage of a vehicle, which it said was evidence of a suicide car bombing carried out during the assault. Somali Guardian could not independently verify this claim, and the evidence presented falls short of establishing it conclusively. Separately, media reports circulating in the early hours of Monday’s attack indicated that a federal military base on the outskirts of Baidoa had come under assault, with a number of government vehicles at the site set ablaze during the fighting. This raises the possibility that the charred wreckage displayed by authorities originated from the government’s own vehicles lost in the battle, rather than from a militant-detonated car bomb – a discrepancy that has not been addressed, and no additional physical evidence of a suicide bombing, such as blast-pattern debris consistent with an explosive-laden vehicle, has been produced. Election Model Under Fire Sharif also turned his criticism toward the federal government’s approach to regional elections, likening its process to results predetermined and delivered by a single individual rather than shaped through genuine competition – a model, he said, that cannot be accepted. He pointed to the recent elections held in Southwest State and Galmudug as examples, alleging that authorities had extended patterns of corruption into rural areas, offering individual voters payments of $50 in exchange for their votes. Such a process, he asked, could not reasonably be called an election. The former president said the essence and beauty of any credible election lies in its being agreeable to all sides and genuinely inclusive. Where those qualities are absent, he said, the exercise cannot be regarded as an election at all. He called on the federal government to reach a negotiated settlement with other political stakeholders over the country’s unresolved electoral disputes. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Ajnabi ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab oo u soo gacan galay dowladda
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Soomaaliya oo war-saxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa sheegtay inuu u soo gacan galay dagaalyahan ajnabi ah oo ka tirsanaa maleeshiyaadka kooxda Al-Shabaab ee ka dagaallanta gudaha Soomaaliya. Qoraalka ayaa lagu sheegay in ninkan oo u dhashay qowmiyadda Oromada ee dalka Itoobiya uu isku soo dhiibay ciidamada deegaanka Quracjoome ee gobolka Bakool, kadib markii uu ka soo goostay Al-Shabaab. Ninkan oo wareysi bixiyay ayaa magaciisa ku sheegay Mufti, balse waxaa kooxda looga dhex yaqaannay Cumar, isaga oo sheegay in muddo 4 sano ah uu ka tirsanaa maleeshiyaadka kooxda, kana dagaallamayay gudaha dalka Soomaaliya. “Waxaa ciidamada deegaanka Quracjoome ee gobolka Bakool isku soo dhiibay mid ka mid ah argagixisada ajnabiga ah ee Khawaarijtu si sharci-darro ah dalka ugu soo gelisay. Ninkan oo ka soo jeeda qowmiyadda Oromada ee dalka Itoobiya, magaciisana ku sheegay Mufti, ayaa markii uu Soomaaliya soo galay loo bixiyay magaca Cumar, wuxuuna muddo 4 sano iyo bil ah ka tirsanaa kooxda Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Al-Shabaab ayaa ajaaniibta dalka ku soo gelisa marin-habaabin iyo been-abuur ku saabsan diinta Islaamka, taas oo xubnaha ka mid noqda kooxda ku noqota layaab marka ay arkaan dhaqanka iyo ficillada ka baxsan diinta Islaamka iyo dhaqanka bini’aadamka, sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga. Waxaa kale oo ay intaas ku sii dartay: “Arrintaas ayaa mararka qaar keenta inay kooxda ka soo baxsadaan, iskuna soo dhiibaan ciidamada dowladda, ama ay kooxdu disho marka ay ogaato inay doonayaan inay isaga baxaan.” Muddooyinkii u dambeeyay, dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah ayaa kordhiyay howlgallada lagu beegsanayo argagixisada, taas oo keentay inay culays dareemaan maleeshiyaadka kooxda, oo qaarkood horay isugu soo dhiibay Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka. Is-dhiibidda ninkan ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmeysa xilli gobolka Bakool uu weli ka mid yahay meelaha Al-Shabaab ay saameynta ku leedahay, gaar ahaan dhulka miyiga ah iyo qaar ka mid ah waddooyinka isku xira degmooyinka gobolka. Warbixinno amni ayaa hore u sheegay in kooxda ay awood u leedahay inay xannibaado ama carqaladeyso waddooyin muhiim ah oo gobolka mara. Bakool iyo gobolka deriska la ah ee Bay ayaa muddo dheer ka mid ahaa goobaha ay ciidamada dowladda, kuwa deegaanka iyo ciidamada Midowga Afrika kula dagaallamaan Al-Shabaab, iyadoo kooxda ay weli awood u leedahay inay weerarro ka fuliso qaybo ka mid ah koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya. Ugu dambeyn, Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa sheegtay in Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwa deegaanka ay sii dardargelin doonaan howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, iyadoo dowladda ay isku dayeyso inay cadaadiska milatari ku kordhiso kooxda, isla markaana ay dhiirrigeliso xubnaha doonaya inay ka soo goostaan. items.title: Imaaraadka oo joojiyay ganacsiga iyo macaamilka Iiraan, ka dib weerar lagu eedeeyay Tehran
items.description: Dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa ku dhawaaqday in si ku-meel-gaar ah loo hakiyay dhammaan is-weydaarsiga ganacsi iyo macaamilka maaliyadeed ee kala dhexeeya Iiraan, iyadoo tallaabadan lagu sheegay inay socon doonto ilaa amar dambe. Wakaaladda wararka rasmiga ah ee Imaaraadka, WAM, ayaa sheegtay in go’aanka uu ku dhawaaqay agaasimaha isgaarsiinta istiraatiijiga ah ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Imaaraadka. Ilaa hadda, dowladda Imaaraadku ma aysan bixin faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan muddada iyo shuruudaha lagu joojinayo tallaabadan. Go’aanka ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii Wasaaradda Difaaca Imaaraadka ay sheegtay in nidaamyada difaaca dalka ay ogaadeen laba gantaal oo ballistic ah oo laga soo riday Iran, kuwaas oo lagu tilmaamay inay bartilmaameedsanayeen maraakiibta iyo isu-socodka badda. Xiisadda u dhexeysa Iiraan iyo dalalka gobolka ayaa sare u kacday kaddib markii Mareykanka iyo Israel ay qaadeen weerarro wadajir ah oo ka dhan ah Iiraan. Tehran ayaa iyaduna kaga jawaabtay oo beenisay weerarkaas lagu qaaday goobo ku yaalla dalal gobolka ah, oo uu Imaaraadku ka mid yahay, iyadoo dalkaasi martigeliyo xarumo iyo hanti militari oo Mareykanku leeyahay.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh: Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay in loo gudbo doorasho qof iyo cod ah
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa si faahfaahsan uga hadlay marxaladihii kala duwanaa ee ay soo martay doorashada Soomaaliya iyo qorshaha dowladda federaalka ee ku aaddan in dalka loo gudbiyo nidaamka doorashada qof iyo cod. Madaxweynaha oo khudbad ka jeediyay munaasabad lagu qabtay magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya muddo ku dhow labaatan sano ay ku soo jirtay nidaam doorasho dadban, kaas oo uu tilmaamay inuu lahaa caqabado iyo xaddidaadyo siyaasadeed. Waxa uu sheegay in dalka laga soo maray heerar kala duwan oo doorasho, kuwaas oo ay ka mid ahaayeen xulista odayaasha dhaqanka, soo xulista xildhibaannada iyo nidaamyo kale oo tirada dadka doorashada ka qeybgalaya si tartiib ah loo kordhiyay. Madaxweynaha ayaa xusay in markii hore odayaasha dhaqanku ay door weyn ku lahaayeen soo xulista baarlamaanka, iyadoo markii dambe nidaamkaas loo beddelay hab ay tiro kooban oo ka mid ah beelaha u matalaan xulista xildhibaannada. Sidoo kale, waxa uu sheegay in marxaladihii dambe la ballaariyay tirada dadka ka qeybqaadanaya doorashada, iyadoo lagu daray boqolaal qof oo magaalooyinka ka qeybgalaya habka xulashada. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in horumarradaas ay ahaayeen tallaabooyin lagu doonayay in si tartiib ah loogu gudbo nidaam doorasho oo shacabka si toos ah uga qeybqaataan. Madaxweynaha ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in hadda loo baahan yahay in dadaalka dowladda iyo hay’adaha siyaasadda lagu saleeyo hirgelinta doorasho qof iyo cod ah, taas oo uu ku tilmaamay tallaabada xigta ee loo baahan yahay in Soomaaliya qaaddo. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in nidaamka doorashooyinka dadban uu muddo dheer dalka ka jiray, balse uu leeyahay caqabado ay muhiim tahay in laga gudbo, iyadoo la raadinayo hannaan doorasho oo shacabka si toos ah ugu lug yeeshaan. Hadalka Madaxweynaha ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli doorashada iyo qaabka loo maareynayo doorashada soo socota ay ka mid yihiin arrimaha ugu waaweyn ee siyaasadda Soomaaliya, iyadoo ay jiraan kala aragti duwanaansho u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada iyo qaar ka mid ah dhinacyada siyaasadda. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ku adkeysanaysa in doorashada qof iyo cod ay tahay waddada lagu xoojin karo ka qeybgalka shacabka iyo hannaanka dimuqraadiyadeed, halka dhinacyo siyaasadeed ay weli ka qabaan walaacyo la xiriira waqtiga, habka loo hirgelinayo iyo heshiiska siyaasadeed ee loo baahan yahay.

items.title: Trump oo sheegay inaysan jirin wax wada-hadal ah oo u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iraan
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in aysan hadda jirin wax wada-hadal ama qorshe wada-hadal oo u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iiraan, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan khilaafaadka ku saabsan mustaqbalka marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz. Trump ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay baraha bulshada ku sheegay in aysan jirin wax wada-hadal ah oo socda ama loo qorsheeyay oo u dhexeeya Washington iyo Tehran. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in xannibaadda ciidamada badda ee lagu hayo dekedaha Iiraan ay weli socato, halka uu ku adkeystay in Marinka Hormuz uu furan yahay oo shaqeynayo. Hadalkan ayaa ka duwanaa sheegashadii Trump ee maalin ka hor, markaas oo uu sheegay in Mareykanku uu waday wada-hadallo dadban oo lala lahaa Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan (IRGC), ayadoo Tehran ay si degdeg ah u beenisay sheegashadaas. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysanaysa iyadoo Iiraan iyo Cumaan ay wada-hadallo ka wadaan sidii loo maareyn lahaa xaaladda Marinka Hormuz, halka Trump uu horey ugu hanjabay in tallaabo militari laga qaadi karo Cumaan haddii ay farageliso arrinta marin-biyoodka.
