items.title: Saynisyahano Japan ah oo lo’ ku rinjiyeeyay si looga hortago duqsi
items.description: Saynisyahano ka socda Japan ayaa helay qaab cusub oo aan caadi ahayn oo lagu yareynayo weerarrada duqsigu ku qaadaan lo’da: rinjiyeynta lo’da iyadoo lagu sameeyo xariijimo madoow iyo caddaan oo u eg haramaha zebra. Tijaabadan yaabka leh ayaa bixisa caddayn dheeri ah oo muujinaysa in haramaha zebra ay u soo baxeen qayb ahaan difaac dabiici ah oo ka dhanka ah duqsiga. Tijaabadan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay soo jeedisaa xal dabiici ah oo lagu yareyn karo duqsiyada lo’da, taasoo ah dhibaato weyn oo saamaysa wax-soo-saarka caanaha iyo hilibka. Cilmi-baarista ayaa waxaa sameeyay saynisyahano ka socda Xarunta Cilmi-baarista Beeraha ee Aichi iyo Jaamacadda Kyoto, waxaana lagu sameeyay lix lo’ oo ah nooca Japanese Black intii lagu jiray xilliyada daaqa ee 2017 iyo 2018. Saynisyahannadu waxay tijaabiyeen lo’da iyagoo adeegsanaya saddex xaaladood oo kala duwan. Qaar ka mid ah lo’da waxaa lagu rinjiyeeyay xariijimo madoow iyo caddaan oo u eg haramaha zebra, iyadoo la adeegsanayo rinji biyo ku salaysan. Kuwo kale waxaa lagu rinjiyeeyay xariijimo madoow oo kaliya, halka koox saddexaad aan wax rinji ah la marin si ay u noqdaan tijaabo lagu barbardhigo. Xariijimaha ayaa ahayd kuwa ballackoodu yahay 4 ilaa 5 sentimitir, rinjiyeynta lo’ kastana waxay qaadatay qiyaastii shan daqiiqo. Natiijooyinku waxay ahaayeen kuwo cajiib ah. Lo’da lagu rinjiyeeyay xariijimo haramaha zebra oo kale ah ayaa soo jiitay 50% duqsi yar marka loo eego lo’da aan la rinjiyeyn ama kuwa lagu rinjiyeeyay madoow oo kaliya. Saynisyahannadu waxay sidoo kale arkayeen in lo’da xariijimaha leh ay muujiyeen 20% dhaqammo yar oo ay ku isku dayaan inay iska caabiyaan duqsiga, oo ay ku jiraan madax ruxid, dhegaha garaacis, cagaha ridis iyo dabada ruxid. Saynisyahannadu waxay rumeysan yihiin in xariijimuhu ay kharribaan sida duqsigu ugu soo dhawaado oo u soo degto xoolaha. Cilmi-baaris hore ayaa muujisay in duqsigu si ka duwan u dhaqmo marka uu arko dusha xariijimaha leh, waxaana dhib ku ah inuu si habboon u soo degto. Caddayntan ayaa taageeraysa fikradda ah in haramaha zebra ay u soo baxeen difaac ka dhanka ah cayayaanka qaniinta, halkii ay u ahaan lahaayeen astaan lagu qariyo ama lagu jahweeriyo ugaadhsadayaasha. Natiijooyinka ayaa sidoo kale muhiim u ah wax-soo-saarka xoolaha. Duqsigu ma aha oo kaliya wax cun ah, waxayna carqaladeeyaan daaqa, cunista, iyo hurdada, waxayna keenaan dhaqanno walaac ku saleysan. Duqsiyada badan ayaa sidoo kale lala xiriiriyay hoos u dhaca wax-soo-saarka caanaha iyo miisaanka. Beeralaydu waxay inta badan isticmaalaan sunta cayayaanka, laakiin isticmaalka soo noqnoqda waxay keeni kartaa in cayayaanku u adkeystaan. Saynisyahannadu waxay soo jeediyeen in qaababka haramaha zebra oo kale ah ay noqon karaan kuwo deegaanka u roon oo lagu dari karo hababka dhaqameed. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, habkani waxa uu leeyahay caqabado. Tijaabadu waxay ku koobnayd lix lo’ oo keliya, rinjiguna wuxuu sii jiray dhowr maalmood oo keliya. Cilmi-baaris dheeri ah oo lagu sameeyo noocyo lo’ oo kala duwan, jawiyo iyo xaalado beer oo kala duwan ayaa loo baahan yahay ka hor inta aan habkan la noqon mid si weyn loo isticmaali karo. The post Saynisyahano Japan ah oo lo’ ku rinjiyeeyay si looga hortago duqsi first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Afar dal oo safiirro cusub u soo diray Soomaaliya + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) ayaa maanta ka guddoomay nuqullada waraaqaha aqoonsiga afar safiir oo cusub oo loo soo magacaabay Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo si rasmi ah u bilaabaya waajibaadkooda diblomaasiyadeed ee dalka. Safiirrada cusub ee loo soo magacaabay Soomaaliya ayaa kala ah Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Mali Mudane Dr. Madou Diallo, Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Nigeria Mudane Danlami Ibrahim, Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Pakistan Marwo Aqsa Nawaz iyo Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Midowga Myanmar Mudane Aung Min. Gudbinta nuqullada waraaqaha aqoonsiga ayaa ah tallaabo diblomaasiyadeed oo muhiim ah, waxaana ay si rasmi ah u astaynaysaa bilowga waajibaadka iyo howlaha safiir kasta ee loo soo magacaabay Soomaaliya, kaddib markii Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ansixisay magacaabistooda. Sidoo kale, munaasabadda guddoomista waraaqaha aqoonsiga ayaa fursad u noqotay in laga wada-hadlo xaaladda xiriirrada Soomaaliya iyo dalalka ay safiirradu matalaan iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan ee labada dhinac. Wasiir Cabdisalaan ayaa si diirran u soo dhaweeyay safiirrada cusub, isaga oo ugu hambalyeeyay xilalka loo soo magacaabay, una rajeeyay in muddada ay Soomaaliya ka howlgalaan ay gacan ka geystaan horumarinta xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo dalalkooda. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale xusay sida ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya uga go’an tahay xoojinta xiriirrada laba geesoodka ah iyo ballaarinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan dhinacyada siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha, amniga, horumarinta iyo arrimaha bulshada. Waxaa kale oo uu tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay in Soomaaliya ay sii xoojiso xiriirrada ay la leedahay dowladaha caalamka, iyadoo loo marayo iskaashi ku dhisan is-ixtiraam, dano wadaag iyo ilaalinta madax-bannaanida labada dal. Dhinacooda, safiirrada cusub ayaa muujiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay in ay ka shaqeeyaan xoojinta xiriirrada Soomaaliya iyo dalalka ay matalaan, iyaga oo ballanqaaday in ay si dhow ula shaqeyn doonaan hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya inta ay gudanayaan waajibaadkooda diblomaasiyadeed. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay wadday dadaallo lagu ballaarinayo xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka caalamka, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo horumarinta danaha qaranka iyo kor u qaadista doorka Soomaaliya ee fagaarayaasha caalamiga ah. Safiirrada cusub ee loo soo magacaabay Soomaaliya ayaa kala ah Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Mali Mudane Dr. Madou Diallo, Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Nigeria Mudane Danlami Ibrahim, Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Pakistan Marwo Aqsa Nawaz iyo Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Midowga Myanmar Mudane Aung Min. Gudbinta nuqullada waraaqaha aqoonsiga ayaa ah tallaabo diblomaasiyadeed oo muhiim ah, waxaana ay si rasmi ah u astaynaysaa bilowga waajibaadka iyo howlaha safiir kasta ee loo soo magacaabay Soomaaliya, kaddib markii Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ansixisay magacaabistooda. Sidoo kale, munaasabadda guddoomista waraaqaha aqoonsiga ayaa fursad u noqotay in laga wada-hadlo xaaladda xiriirrada Soomaaliya iyo dalalka ay safiirradu matalaan iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan ee labada dhinac. Wasiir Cabdisalaan ayaa si diirran u soo dhaweeyay safiirrada cusub, isaga oo ugu hambalyeeyay xilalka loo soo magacaabay, una rajeeyay in muddada ay Soomaaliya ka howlgalaan ay gacan ka geystaan horumarinta xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo dalalkooda. Dhinacooda, safiirrada cusub ayaa muujiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay in ay ka shaqeeyaan xoojinta xiriirrada Soomaaliya iyo dalalka ay matalaan, iyaga oo ballanqaaday in ay si dhow ula shaqeyn doonaan hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya inta ay gudanayaan waajibaadkooda diblomaasiyadeed. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay wadday dadaallo lagu ballaarinayo xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka caalamka, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo horumarinta danaha qaranka iyo kor u qaadista doorka Soomaaliya ee fagaarayaasha caalamiga ah. items.title: Nin Kenya ah oo 26 dacwadood ku guulaystay isagoon shati qabin
items.description: Brian Mwenda Njagi, oo loo yaqaan “Mike Ross-ka Kenya”, ayaa la xiray bishii Oktoobar 2023 kadib markii la ogaaday inuu ku dhaqmayay xirfadda qareynnimo isagoon haysan wax shati ah ama tababar sharciyeed oo rasmi ah. Mwenda wuxuu dad badan ku yaabiyay markii la ogaaday inuu ku guulaystay 26 dacwadood oo isku xiga, isagoo hadal-heyn ka noqday baraha bulshada kadib markii uu isagu naftiisa ku difaacay maxkamadda, isagoo ku guulaystay in la sii daayo dammaanad . Sheekadan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay soo kordhisay su’aalo ku saabsan sida uu nin aan wax tababar ah lahayn ugu guulaystay inuu ku guuleysto dacwado maxkamadeed oo dhab ah, iyadoo la eegayo inuu adeegsaday xatooyo aqoonsi oo uu ku dalban jiray magaca qareen kale. Mwenda waxa uu si xirfad leh ugu gudbi jiray marinnada sharciyeed, isagoo iska dhigaya qareen sharci ah, waxaanu ku guulaystay inuu ku dhameeyo dacwadihii isagoo isticmaalaya aqoon uu isagu naftiisa ku bartay. Ka dib markii la xiray, Mwenda wuxuu door biday inuu isagu naftiisa ku difaaco maxkamadda, halkii uu u xilsaari lahaa qareen kale. Waxa uu isticmaalay kartidiisa hadalka iyo aqoontiisa isku-tababarka ah si uu ugu qanciso garsooraha in la sii daayo dammaanad, taasoo ka dhigtay mid si weyn looga hadlo baraha bulshada. Dad badan ayaa ku tilmaamay nin caqli badan oo halyey ah, halka kuwo kalena ay ku eedeeyeen inuu sharci jebiyey. Dacwadihii uu ku guulaystay Mwenda waxaa ka mid ahaa kiisas adag oo maxkamadaha sare la dagaalamay, waxaanu ugu guulaystay inuu ku qanciyo garsoorayaasha inuu yahay qareen sharci ah, iyadoo ay jiraan caddaymo muujinaya inuu adeegsan jiray magaca qareen dhab ah si uu u helo ogolaansho . Kiiskani waxa uu noqday mid ka mid ah kuwa ugu caansan Kenya, waxaana si weyn looga hadlay baraha bulshada iyo warbaahinta . The post Nin Kenya ah oo 26 dacwadood ku guulaystay isagoon shati qabin first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Mucaaradka oo qaylo dhaan kasoo saaray xaalad ka taagan Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xubnaha Madasha Samatabixinta Soomaaliyeed oo galabta shir ku yeeshay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa qaylo dhaan culus kasoo saaray dhulboobka weli kasii socda magaalada Muqdisho, iyaga oo eedeymo culus u jeediyay Dowladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya. Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka, Mudane Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed oo ka hadlay shir jaraa’id oo ay mucaaradka qabteen, kadib kulankooda ayaa sheegay in dowladdu aysan joojin barakicinta shacabka, isla markaana go’aanka burburinta lagu gaaro Vila Somalia, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Gurigaaga gado ama ka guur ayay maree go’aan walbana maanta waxaa laga gaaraa Villa Somalia xitaa ma xishoodaan ma aqaan siday bulshadaan ula noolaan doonaan,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynihii hore ee dowladdii KMG ka ahayd. Sidoo kale, Ra’iisu wasaarihii hore ee dalka Mudane Xasan Cali Khayre oo isna ka hadlay goobta ayaa ku eedeeyay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh inuu iibsaday dhulkii lagu aaminay, isla markaana uu xargagoostay dhulboobka magaalada Muqdisho. “Dhulkii magaalada Muqdisho ku yaallay ee lagu aaminay oo Madaxweynaha muddo xileedkiisu dhammaaday uu kitaabka gacanta u saaray isaga iyo xulafadiisa ayaa iibsadeen si sharci darro ah,” ayuu yiri Xasan Cali Khayre. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas kusii daray “Hadda waxa socda dhulboob oo kaliya ma aha waa xaalufin waa burcad dhuleednimo sidoo kale waxa hadda socda waxay su’aal gelinayaan bulshe noocee ayaa nahay”. Dhankiisa Madaxweynihii hore ee Galmudug Cabdikariin Xuseen Guuleed ayaa isna sheegay arrinta dhulboobka ay gaartay meel xun, iskuna bedeshay bililiqo, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Mushkiladda dhulka mudda waa soo jiitameysay, laakiin waxaa moodaa marba marka ka dambeysa in culayska uu sii xoogeysanayo gaar ahaan maalmahan ugu dambeeyay oo ay arrinta isku beddeshay bililiqo boob xaddhaaf ah, iyada oo cagafta ay beegsaneyso si gaar ah dadka kuwa ugu liita,” ayuu isna yiri Madaxweynihii hore Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo todobaadyadii ugu dambeeyay ay mar kale soo rogaal celisay xiisadda dhulalka ee caasimada, iyada oo maalmihii la soo dhaafay cagta la mariyay xaafado ay daganaayeen dad badan oo shacab ah.   The post Mucaaradka oo qaylo dhaan kasoo saaray xaalad ka taagan Muqdisho appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Improving surgery with robotics and AI
items.description: By Lauren Monsen Today, undergoing surgery is less risky than it was a generation ago. U.S. advances in medical robotics are dramatically improving surgical precision, enabling minimally invasive procedures that reduce complication rates and patient recovery times. Combining artificial intelligence with medical robotics is further aiding the shift toward precision medicine . With AI-enhanced robotics tools, doctors are diagnosing diseases earlier and tailoring treatments to their patients’ genetics. These medical advances require a secure flow of critical minerals to make the semiconductors and microchips that power new tools. Through the Pax Silica initiative , the U.S. State Department works with international partners to secure supply chains and enable continued technological progress and mutual prosperity amid the AI revolution. Pax Silica priorities include working with partners to prevent advanced technologies designed for healthcare from being misused. The State Department is also piloting a “concierge” service to streamline partners’ access to American-made AI products. Here are several surgical robotics tools developed in the U.S. that are benefiting patients around the world. The da Vinci 5 robotic surgical system’s artificial intelligence tools provide real-time data in the operating room. (© Intuitive) Smaller incisions, less trauma California-based Intuitive Surgical Incorporated’s da Vinci robotic surgical system has been used in 20 million procedures since its launch in 2000. Updated models bring surgeons greater control, enabling operations through smaller incisions. The da Vinci 5’s AI tools help surgeons feel resistance and tension, so they can moderate force, reducing trauma. Plus, the system provides real-time data analysis during surgery. The da Vinci 5 “has changed how I take care of patients,” says Dr. Marc Bailey , a cardiothoracic surgeon at St. Joseph’s/Candler Hospital in Savannah, Georgia. “Robotic surgery has always allowed for smaller incisions and less blood loss, and we can get you walking around faster, with less pain.” The Miniaturized In Vivo Robotic Assistant MIRA™ Surgical System is designed to expand access to robotic surgery, according to the Virtual Incision Corporation based in Lincoln, Nebraska. Used in intestinal and other surgeries, MIRA is lightweight (2 pounds, less than 1 kilogram), allowing hospitals to move the device between operating rooms, reducing lengthy setup times. Virtual Incision says future uses of MIRA will incorporate AI to inform decision-making and enable remote surgeries. In 2024, Virtual Incision and NASA tested the device’s remote-surgery capabilities at the International Space Station using data sent by satellite. NASA astronaut Loral O’Hara displays Virtual Incision’s robotic-assisted surgery system aboard the International Space Station in February 2024. (NASA) Early detection, better outcomes Intuitive’s Ion robotic bronchoscopy system assists with minimally invasive lung biopsies that can detect early-stage cancers, improving patient outcomes. The robotic-assisted tool, initially released in 2019, added AI-powered navigation and rerouting capability in 2025 that can anticipate how a lung nodule may shift over time. Ion’s AI-powered detection tools compare live images against the surgical plan, acting like a GPS navigation system that allows doctors to alter the course of surgery as needed. As of June 2025, there were 900 Ion systems at hospitals across 10 countries. Real-time data, safer procedures The Mako robotic arm, designed by the Michigan-based Stryker corporation, uses AI technology to assist doctors performing knee and hip replacement surgeries. Mako’s patient-specific, preoperative planning and feedback help surgeons adhere to preoperation plans, while other data analysis protects healthy bone. The device also enables precise alignment of artificial knees and hips to improve joint stability and extend the lifespan of implants.

items.title: Sawirro: DF oo xoojinaysa taageerada Danab-ta Gaalkacyo – Maxaa dhacay maanta?
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo uu weheliyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa maanta booqasho shaqo ku tagay xarunta Ururka 163-aad ee Guutada 16-aad Kumaandooska Danab ee magaalada Gaalkacyo. Booqashada ayaa qeyb ka ahayd kormeer ay mas’uuliyiintu ku sameynayeen howlaha ciidamada iyo xaaladda xarunta, iyadoo ay indha-indheeyeen heerka diyaar-garowga ciidamada iyo howlaha amni ee ay ka wadaan deegaanka. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa kulan la yeeshay saraakiisha iyo ciidamada xarunta, iyagoo kala hadlay muhiimadda ay leedahay in ciidamada ay joogteeyaan diyaar-garowgooda iyo gudashada waajibaadka loo igmaday. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sidoo kale ciidamada kula dardaarmay xoojinta wada shaqeynta iyo isku-xirka cutubyada kala duwan ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, si loo adkeeyo amniga loona ilaaliyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Booqashada ayaa sidoo kale fursad u siisay madaxda Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka inay si dhow ugu kuur galaan xaaladda ciidamada ka howlgala deegaanka iyo baahiyaha xarunta. Saraakiisha Ururka 163-aad ayaa wasiirka iyo taliyaha uga warbixiyay howlaha ay ciidamada ka wadaan deegaanka iyo waajibaadka loo igmaday, iyagoo muujiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay gudashada waajibaadkooda qaran. Kormeerkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ay xoogga saarayaan qiimeynta diyaar-garowga ciidamada iyo xoojinta howlaha lagu sugayo amniga deegaanada ay ka howlgalaan cutubyada ciidanka. items.title: Soomaaliya oo ka Guddoontay Waraaqaha Aqoonsiga Afar Safiir oo Cusub
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta si rasmi ah uga guddoontay nuqullada waraaqaha aqoonsiga afar safiir oo cusub oo loo soo magacaabay Soomaaliya. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cali, ayaa nuqullada waraaqaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay safiirrada kala matalaya Mali, Nigeria, Pakistan iyo Myanmar. Safiirrada cusub ayaa kala ah Dr. Madou Diallo, Safiirka Mali; Danlami Ibrahim, Safiirka Nigeria; Aqsa Nawaz, Safiirka Pakistan; iyo Aung Min, Safiirka Myanmar. Gudbinta waraaqaha aqoonsiga ayaa astaan u ah bilowga rasmiga ah ee waajibaadka diblomaasiyadeed ee safiirrada cusub ee Soomaaliya, kaddib markii Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ansixisay magacaabistooda. Wasiir Cabdisalaan Cali ayaa soo dhoweeyay safiirrada cusub, isagoo xusay muhiimadda ay Soomaaliya siinayso xoojinta xiriirrada labageesoodka ah iyo ballaarinta iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka ay safiirradu matalaan. Tallaabadan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya ku xoojinayso xiriirrada ay la leedahay dalalka Afrika iyo qaaradaha kale, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo iskaashi dhinacyo badan leh.

items.title: Ugu Yaraan 25 Qof oo lagu dilay Weerar ka dhacay Bartamaha Nigeria
items.description: ABUJA, Goobjoog — Ugu yaraan 25 qof ayaa lagu dilay weerar habeennimadii xalay lagu qaaday degaan ku yaalla gobolka Plateau ee bartamaha Nigeria, iyadoo dhacdadu dib u soo kicisay walaaca laga qabo rabshado aargoosi ah oo ka dhaca gobolka ay muddada dheer ragaadiyeen iskudhacyada rabshadaha wata. Weerarka ayaa lagu qaaday degaanka Binpe ee degmada Mangu, halkaas oo dableydu guri-guri ugu galeen dadka degaanka, sida ay saraakiil maxalli ah iyo dad goobta ku sugnaa u sheegeen Reuters. Lemun Le’an Iliya, oo ah xubin ka tirsan golaha deegaanka, ayaa sheegay in 23 qof goobta lagu dilay, qof kalena uu markii dambe dhaawacii u dhintay isagoo isbitaal ku jira. Qof degaanka ah oo lagu magacaabo Amos John ayaa Reuters u sheegay in dhimashada qof kale oo dheeraad ah ay tirada guud gaarsiisay ugu yaraan 25 qof. Wuxuu sheegay in haween iyo carruur ay ku jireen dadka ugu badan ee weerarka lagu dilay. Warbaahinta maxalliga ah ee Nigeria ayaa iyaduna sheegtay in dad kale ay ku dhaawacmeen weerarka, inkasta oo aan weli la shaacin tiro rasmi ah oo la isku raacsan yahay. Ma jirto koox si degdeg ah u sheegatay masuuliyadda weerarka, mana cadda cidda fulisay. Dhacdadan ayaa, hasayeeshee, ka dhacday gobol ay muddo dheer ka jireen iskudhacyo soo noqnoqda oo u dhexeeya bulshooyinka beeraleyda ah iyo xoolodhaqatada. Khilaafaadka gobolka Plateau waxaa sal u ah arrimo isbiirsaday oo ay ka mid yihiin murannada dhulka iyo biyaha, tartanka kheyraadka, kala-duwanaanshaha qowmiyadeed iyo diimeed iyo tabashooyin siyaasadeed. Weerarrada iyo aargoosiyada daba socda ayaa sannadihii la soo dhaafay sababay dhimasho, barakac iyo burbur hantiyeed oo baahsan. Weerarkan cusub ayaa kordhiyey walaaca laga qabo in dhinacyada ay colaadaha hore u dhexmareen ay qaadaan falal aargoosi ah, taas oo sii hurin karta xaaladda amni ee gobolka. Nigeria, oo ah dalka ugu dadka badan Afrika, ayaa wajahaysa caqabado amni oo kala duwan. Waqooyibari waxaa ka jira dagaalka kooxaha Boko Haram iyo ISWAP, waqooyigalbeedna waxaa ka hawlgala kooxo hubaysan oo dadka afduuba, halka qaybo ka mid ah bartamaha dalka ay si joogto ah uga dhacaan rabshado la xiriira dhulka, xoolaha iyo khilaafaadka bulshooyinka.

items.title: Muxuu Xasan maanta ka sameeyay Gaalkacyo? + Sawirro
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta kormeer ku tagay Dugsiga Farsamada Gacanta Prof. Cadow ee magaalada Gaalkacyo. Madaxweynaha ayaa warbixin ka dhageystay maamulka dugsiga, isaga oo sidoo kale soo indha-indheeyay qeybaha kala duwan ee xarunta iyo goobaha lagu qabto tababarrada farsamada gacanta. Intii uu kormeerka ku guda jiray, Xasan Sheekh wuxuu booqday fasallada, xafiisyada maamulka iyo goobaha tababarka, halkaas oo ardayda lagu baro xirfado kala duwan oo ay mustaqbalka ku shaqaysan karaan. Xirfadaha lagu barto dugsiga waxaa kamid ah korontada, dhismaha guryaha, cilmiga kombiyuutarrada iyo farsamada gaadiidka, kuwaas oo qeyb muhiim ah ka qaadan kara kobcinta aqoonta iyo xirfadaha dhallinyarada. Madaxweynaha ayaa ku bogaadiyay madaxda dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug sida ay mudnaanta u siinayaan hirgelinta mashaariicda waxbarasho ee bulshada wax weyn u taraya, gaar ahaan kuwa lagu horumarinayo waxbarashada farsamada gacanta. Xasan Sheekh ayaa xusay in maalgelinta xarumaha noocan oo kale ah ay muhiim u tahay horumarinta xirfadaha dhallinyarada, isla markaana ay kaalin ka qaadan karto yareynta shaqo la’aanta ka jirta dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa tilmaamay in dhallinyarada la siiyo aqoon iyo xirfado ay ku shaqaysan karaan ay sidoo kale u sahleyso inay abuuraan fursado shaqo oo cusub, taasoo qeyb ka noqon karta horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo isku-filnaanshaha bulshada. Booqashada Madaxweynaha ee magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa qayb ka ah safarkiisa shaqo ee nabadda iyo u kuur-galka nolosha bulshada qaar ka mid ah deegaanada dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Xasan Sheekh iyo madaxda Dowladda Federaalka ayaa xilligan ku guda jira abaabul siyaasadeed oo la xiriira doorashada Galmudug, gaar ahaan ololaha JSP, iyadoo dowladda ay sidoo kale waddo abaabul ciidan oo ay sheegtay in looga gol leeyahay la-dagaallanka kooxda Al-Shabaab. The post Muxuu Xasan maanta ka sameeyay Gaalkacyo? + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Defying Puntland warning, Somalia’s president visits Galkayo
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud arrived Monday in the southern, Galmudug-administered half of Galkayo, a city still bearing the tension of recent fighting, as Puntland President Saeed Abdullahi Deni remained stationed in the northern half under his administration’s control just kilometers away. The visit comes weeks after forces loyal to the two men clashed in the same city, an engagement in which Mohamud’s allied forces suffered a heavy defeat. It also comes days after Puntland authorities publicly warned the federal president against traveling to Galkayo, describing his presence as a threat to the state’s security. Mohamud reached the city by road as part of a multi-day tour of districts across Galmudug state. The trip unfolds against a backdrop that officials and observers describe as extending beyond an internal Somali power struggle, with signs of involvement by outside states. Saudi-Trained Graduates, Regional Rivalries Earlier this week, President Mohamud attended a graduation ceremony for more than 3,000 Somali soldiers trained by Saudi Arabia in Galmudug , under a bilateral defense agreement the two governments signed in February. That agreement followed Israel’s recognition of Somaliland, and the newly trained forces are intended to operate in northern Somalia, where they would counter both Somaliland and Puntland. Turkey and Qatar are also described as involved in the wider dispute taking shape around these developments. On the other side of the divide, Puntland and Somaliland are both described as receiving strong backing from the United Arab Emirates. UAE-trained and -equipped Puntland Maritime Police Force units are reported to have routed federal forces in the region within a matter of weeks. Defeat, Then Defiance Beyond the immediate political theater, the visit is being read as a pointed signal: despite the recent battlefield defeat of his allied forces in Puntland, Mohamud remains present in Galkayo, and Puntland’s leadership – positioned only a short distance away – has been unable to prevent it. The visit also appears aimed at shoring up support among clans in southern Galkayo who have resisted any federal military push into Puntland’s half of the city launched from their own territory. Weeks earlier, those same clans intercepted a weapons shipment that the federal government allegedly attempted to smuggle through to its allies in the northern half of Galkayo. Parallel Meetings, Tightened Security Puntland President Deni convened security officials on Monday night — the first night of Mohamud’s visit – while the federal president held his own meetings on the opposite side of the city. Security has been reinforced on both sides of Galkayo, and Puntland authorities have closed the crossing point with Galmudug, citing security concerns, according to the Somali Digest news website. The closure comes amid concerns, as reported, that Mohamud spent the past year moving forces and weapons into Galmudug under the cover of counterterrorism operations. A Divide With a Painful History The visit underscores a widening rift between the federal government and Puntland. It also carries the risk of reigniting conflict between the two halves of Galkayo, a city that endured more than two decades of deadly clashes before both administrations agreed, during the term of former President Mohamed Abdullahi Farmajo, to cooperate on security and prevent a recurrence of that violence. Comparisons to a Different Visit Critics have argued that the visit has damaged Mohamud’s standing, casting him, in their view, as resembling a clan leader who visits only the half of a city where his own clansmen live without crossing to the other side. They point to a contrasting precedent: in 2018, then-President Farmajo visited both halves of Galkayo, meeting Galmudug’s regional president, Ahmed Duale Gelle, and Puntland’s regional president, Abdiweli Ali Gas, before the three leaders addressed residents together at a joint rally. Others place the responsibility on the Puntland side, arguing that had Deni invited Mohamud to visit him in the Puntland-administered half of the city, Mohamud would have accepted. They point to a contrasting precedent: in 2018, then-President Farmajo visited both halves of Galkayo, meeting Galmudug’s regional president, Ahmed Duale Gelle, and Puntland’s regional president, Abdiweli Ali Gas, before the three leaders addressed residents together at a joint rally. Others place the responsibility on the Puntland side, arguing that had Deni invited Mohamud to visit him in the Puntland-administered half of the city, Mohamud would have accepted. items.title: Laba Xoolo-dhaqato ah oo Dilay Hoggaamiye Al-Shabaab ah oo ka Howlgali Jiray Shabeellaha Dhexe
items.description: Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in laba wiil oo xoolo-dhaqato ah ay dileen mid ka mid ah horjoogayaasha Al-Shabaab ee sida weyn uga howlgali jiray gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Dhacdadan ayaa la sheegay inay ka dhacday 17 Agoosto 2026 degmada Ruunirgood, waxaana lagu dilay horjoogaha oo lagu magacaabi jiray Xasan Alasow Rage, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaanay Xasan Husuuley, kaas oo da’diisu ahayd 50 sano. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa sheegtay in Xasan Alasow uu ka mid ahaa horjoogayaasha Al-Shabaab ee ka howlgala Shabeellaha Dhexe, isla markaana uu mas’uul ka ahaa howlaha gaadiidka kooxda ee gobolka. Waxa kale oo uu horey u ahaa madaxa ururinta waxa kooxda ugu yeerto “Zakada” ee degmada Ruunirgood. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta Wasaaradda, labada wiil ee xoolo-dhaqatada ah ayaa dilka kaddib gacanta ku dhigay qorigiisii AK-47 iyo rasaastii uu watay. Wasaaradda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in horjoogahan uu dhibaatooyin badan ku hayay dadka deegaanka Ruunirgood iyo nawaaxigeeda, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin xoolo iyo hanti lagala wareego, xannibaado lagu soo rogo isu-socodka dadka iyo barakicin ku qasabtay qaar ka mid ah shacabka inay ka cararaan guryahooda. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa bogaadisay tallaabada ay qaadeen dadka deegaanka, iyadoo sheegtay inay muujinayso sida bulshada Soomaaliyeed uga go’an tahay inay ka hortagaan Al-Shabaab iyo kooxaha hubeysan.

items.title: Ciidanka AUSSOM oo Roondo Amni ka Fuliyay Waddada Beletweyne iyo Ceelgaal
items.description: Ciidanka Qaybta 4-aad ee Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) ayaa shalay roondo amni ka fuliyay waddada muhiimka ah ee isku xirta magaalada Beletweyne iyo deegaanka Ceelgaal ee waqooyiga magaalada. Ciidamada ayaa waddada ka sameeyay baaritaanno la xiriira miinooyinka iyo walxaha qarxa, ka hor inta aysan kolonyadu marin. Sidoo kale, ciidanka lugta ayaa xaqiijiyay amniga waddada iyo dhulka ku hareeraysan, si loo hubiyo in marinku yahay mid ammaan ah. Hawlgalka ayaa ujeedkiisu ahaa in la xaqiijiyo isu-socodka dadka iyo gaadiidka, iyadoo shacabka, badeecooyinka iyo ciidamada ammaanka ay si nabdoon ugu kala gudbi karaan waddada muhiimka ah. AUSSOM ayaa sheegtay inay ka go’an tahay sugidda waddooyinka muhiimka ah, ilaalinta isu-socodka bulshada iyo taageeridda dadaallada lagu xoojinayo nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya.

items.title: Kulankii Labada Madaxweyne iyo Safarkii Guusha: Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Jamhuuriyadda Kenya oo Xoojinaya Xidhiidhka iyo Iskaashiga
items.description: Kulankii Labada Madaxweyne iyo Safarkii Guusha: Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Jamhuuriyadda Kenya oo Xoojinaya Xidhiidhka iyo Iskaashiga Safiirka Somaliland ee Kenya ayaa boggiisa X-ku daabacay warbixin kooban oo ku saabsan xoojinta xidhiidhka iyo iskaashiga Somaliland iyo Kenya, isagoo sheegay in booqashadii Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) ay fursad muhiim ah u ahayd dardar-gelinta iskaashiga labada dhinac. Waxaana lagu yidhi qoraalka: Intii uu Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), booqashada ku joogay dalka Kiiniya, waxa uu kulan la yeeshay Madaxweynaha Kiiniya, William Ruto, kulankaas oo ka dhacay Madaxtooyada Kiiniya. Waxa kale oo uu la kulmay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Qaranka Kiiniya, Moses Wetang’ula, iyo masuuliyiin kale oo sarsare oo Kiiniyaan ah. Kulammadaasi waxa ay fursad muhiim ah u noqdeen sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa xidhiidhka Somaliland iyo Kiiniya, iyadoo laga wada hadlay arrimo ay ka mid yihiin ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga, iskaashiga dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha gobolka ee ay labada dhinac wadaagaan. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale magaalada Nairobi kula kulmay ku dhawaad 20 xubnood oo ka tirsan bulshada diblomaasiyadda iyo hay’adaha horumarinta, halkaas oo uu si toos ah uga hadlay horumarka Somaliland, mudnaanta xukuumaddiisa iyo fursadaha iskaashi ee dhinacyada kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, tamarta, caafimaadka, maalgashiga iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha. Diblomaasiyiinta iyo hay’adaha horumarintu waxa ay iyaguna Madaxweynaha si toos ah u weydiiyeen su’aalo, iyagoo la wadaagay aragtidooda iyo fursadaha iskaashi. Booqashadu waxay sidoo kale fursad u noqotay in lagu sii ambaqaado xidhiidhadii iyo wada-hadalladii ay safaaradda Somaliland ee dalka Kiiniya wadday muddo sannad ah Waxaa muuqata xiise iyo niyad-wanaag weyn oo Kiiniya looga qabo Somaliland, waxaana hadda muhiim ah in niyad-wanaaggaasi loo beddelo iskaashi dhab ah, mashaariic wax-ku-ool ah iyo natiijooyin muuqda oo ay Somaliland ka faa’iidaysato

items.title: Kulan xasaasi ah oo u socda mucaaradka DF + Ujeedka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ee la magac baxay Madasha Samatabixinta Soomaaliyeed ayaa haatan shir xasaasi ah wuxuu uga socdaa hoteelka Jasiira ee magaalada Muqdisho, kaas oo looga hadlayo xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee dalka. Xubnaha mucaaradka ayaa si buuxda uga qayb-galaya shirweynahan, waxaana guddoominaya Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka, Mudane Sheekh Shariif Sheekh oo ah hoggaamiyaha Madasha Samatabixinta Soomaaliyeed. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in shirkan diiradda lagu saarayo xaaladda guud ee dalka, gaar ahaan arrimaha doorashooyinka, amniga, dastuurka iyo khilaafka u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo qaar kamid ah Maamul-goboleedyada dalka. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, doodda ugu wayn ayaa la xiriirta qaddiyadda doorashada oo ay weli isku hayaan Villa Somalia iyo mucaaradka, waxaana la filayaa in shirka laga soo saaro go’aanno wax ku ool ah. Sidoo kale, mucaaradka ayaa shirkooda galabta kusoo qaadi doono murannada dhulalka ee ka taagan caasimada, maadaama ay weli dowladdu sii wato howlaha burburinta, isla markaana haatan la barakiciyay qoysas horleh. Shirkan ayaa kusoo aaday xilli xasaasi ah, isla markaana muddo dheer ay soo socdeen wada-hadallo u dhexeeyay labada dhinac, inkastoo ilaa iyo hadda aan lagu gaarin wax natiijo ah, waxaase sii socda dadaallada xal raadinta. Beesha caalamka ayaa sidoo kale qayb ka ah dhex-dhexaadinta, iyada oo dowladda iyo mucaaradka ku cadaadineysa inay heshiis ka gaaraan nooca doorasho ee dalka ka dhaceyso, si xal loogu helo khilaafka daba dheeraaday. Si kastaba ha’ahaatee, Dadaallada socda ayaa ah kuwa muhiim u ah mustaqbalka geeddi-socodka siyaasadeed ee dalka iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo natiijada wada-hadallada iyo haddii ay dhinacyadu isku fahmaan kulamadooda. items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo Muqdisho ku qaabilay Xoghayaha Guud ee AfCFTA
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa Muqdisho ku qaabilay Xoghayaha Guud ee Aagga Ganacsiga Xorta ah ee Qaaradda Afrika (AfCFTA), Wamkele Mene, oo booqasho rasmi ah ku yimid Soomaaliya. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray fursadaha dhaqaale iyo ganacsi ee Soomaaliya uga furmaya ku biirista nidaamka ganacsiga xorta ah ee qaaradda Afrika, iyadoo dowladda Soomaaliya ay sheegtay inay muhiim tahay in heshiisyada ganacsi loo beddelo wax-soo-saar iyo fursado dhaqaale oo si toos ah uga faa’iideysta shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa sheegay in booqashada Xoghayaha Guud ee AfCFTA ay ku soo beegantay xilli muhiim ah, kaddib go’aanka Soomaaliya ay qaadatay ee ku aaddan ka mid noqoshada nidaamka ganacsiga xorta ah ee Afrika. Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu wuxuu tilmaamay in Soomaaliya ay ku jirto marxalad cusub oo dhaqaale, iyadoo dowladda ay xoogga saarayso hirgelinta Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka 2025–2029, xoojinta hay’adaha dowladda, kobcinta maalgashiga iyo kordhinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha. Sidoo kale, Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa wafdiga AfCFTA u soo bandhigay fursadaha dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan xeebta dheer ee dalka, dekedaha istiraatiijiga ah iyo khayraadka dabiiciga ah. Dowladdu waxay sheegtay inay mudnaanta siinayso kor u qaadista wax-soo-saarka gudaha, gaar ahaan beeraha, xoolaha iyo kalluumeysiga, si badeecooyinka Soomaaliya loo gaarsiiyo heerar tayo oo u saamaxaya inay si tartan leh uga qeyb galaan suuqyada gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Dhankiisa, Xoghayaha Guud ee AfCFTA, Wamkele Mene, ayaa Ra’iisul Wasaaraha uga mahadceliyay soo dhaweynta, isagoo sheegay inuu indhihiisa ku arkay horumarka ka socda kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya iyo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo wax-soo-saarka, hay’adaha dowladda iyo qorshayaasha lagu casriyeynayo dalka. Booqashada Xoghayaha Guud ee AfCFTA ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay raadineyso inay si weyn uga faa’iideysato suuqa mideysan ee qaaradda Afrika, iyadoo fursad loo arko in ganacsiga xorta ahi uu kordhin karo maalgashiga, wax-soo-saarka gudaha iyo isku-xirka ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed iyo suuqyada Afrika.

Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu wuxuu tilmaamay in Soomaaliya ay ku jirto marxalad cusub oo dhaqaale, iyadoo dowladda ay xoogga saarayso hirgelinta Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka 2025–2029, xoojinta hay’adaha dowladda, kobcinta maalgashiga iyo kordhinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha. Sidoo kale, Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa wafdiga AfCFTA u soo bandhigay fursadaha dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan xeebta dheer ee dalka, dekedaha istiraatiijiga ah iyo khayraadka dabiiciga ah. Dowladdu waxay sheegtay inay mudnaanta siinayso kor u qaadista wax-soo-saarka gudaha, gaar ahaan beeraha, xoolaha iyo kalluumeysiga, si badeecooyinka Soomaaliya loo gaarsiiyo heerar tayo oo u saamaxaya inay si tartan leh uga qeyb galaan suuqyada gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Dhankiisa, Xoghayaha Guud ee AfCFTA, Wamkele Mene, ayaa Ra’iisul Wasaaraha uga mahadceliyay soo dhaweynta, isagoo sheegay inuu indhihiisa ku arkay horumarka ka socda kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya iyo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo wax-soo-saarka, hay’adaha dowladda iyo qorshayaasha lagu casriyeynayo dalka. Booqashada Xoghayaha Guud ee AfCFTA ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay raadineyso inay si weyn uga faa’iideysato suuqa mideysan ee qaaradda Afrika, iyadoo fursad loo arko in ganacsiga xorta ahi uu kordhin karo maalgashiga, wax-soo-saarka gudaha iyo isku-xirka ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed iyo suuqyada Afrika.

items.title: Maleeshiyada Lafta-gareen ee shalay weeraray Baydhaba oo war cusub soo saaray
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Maleeshiyada taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen ayaa iska fogeeyay eedeymo la xiriirinaya Al-Shabaab, kadib dagaal culus oo Isniintii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba. Dagaalka ayaa aroornimadii hore ka qarxay qeybo ka mid ah Baydhaba, kadib markii maleeshiyo taageersan Laftagareen ay gudaha u galeen magaalada, halkaas oo ay iska hor yimaadeen ciidamada dowladda federaalka iyo kuwa maamulka cusub ee Koonfur Galbeed. Dagaalka ayaa socday saacado, wuxuuna ahaa kii ugu xoogga badnaa ee magaalada ka dhaca tan iyo bishii Maarso. Ciidamada dowladda federaalka ayaa markii dambe dib uga riixay magaalada xoogaggii weerarka soo qaaday. Dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay inay jireen dhimasho soo gaartay dhinacyadii dagaallamay iyo dad rayid ah. Afhayeen u hadlay maleeshiyada weerarka qaaday, oo isku magacaaba Daraawiishta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, ayaa si adag u diiday in ciidamadooda wax xiriir ah la leeyihiin Al-Shabaab. “Annaga Shabaab nalama dhaho. Dowladda Shabaab iyada ayaa taqaanna ee ha raadiso. Annaga Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa nala dhahaa,” ayuu Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed u sheegay BBC-da. “Waxay Shabaab geystaan mas’uuliyaddooda nalama weydiinayo, Shabaabna ma nihin,” ayuu raaciyay. Hadalkan ayaa yimid iyadoo dowladda federaalka ay sheegtay in ciidamada ku sugan Baydhaba lagu weeraray ka hor waaberigii, iyadoo maleeshiyada adeegsadeen gaadiid walxaha qarxa laga soo buuxiyay. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa sheegtay in ku dhowaad 30 ka mid ah weeraryahannada lagu dilay dagaalka, halka qaar kalena gacanta lagu dhigay. Laba weerar oo isku waqti dhacay Dood gaar ah ayaa ka dhalatay isku soo beegmidda dagaalka ay ciidamada Laftagareen ku qaadeen Baydhaba iyo weerar isla aroornimadaas lala xiriiriyay Al-Shabaab. Qaar ka mid ah dadka Soomaaliyeed ayaa baraha bulshada su’aalo ka keenay sida labada dhacdo ay isku waqti ugu beegmeen, iyadoo sidoo kale dhinaca dowladda laga soo jeediyay eedeymo ku saabsan xiriir ama iskaashi suuragal ah. Ugaas Xasan ayaa taas gebi ahaanba beeniyay. “Annagu kama warqabno taa iyada ah. Annaga iyo Shabaab xiriir nagama dhexeeyo, mana naga dhexeyn karo,” ayuu yiri markii BBC-du weydiisay in ciidamadoodu wax xog ah ka hayeen qorshaha Al-Shabaab. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in ciidamada dowladda federaalka, markii ay bishii Maarso u soo dhaqaaqayeen Baydhaba, ay soo mareen deegaanno ay Al-Shabaab joogaan, isaga oo arrintaas u soo qaatay jawaab uu kaga difaacayo eedeymaha loo jeediyay ciidamadiisa. Ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen ayaa xilligaas iyaguna sheegay in Al-Shabaab ay weerar dhabagal ah ku qaadeen qaar ka mid ah ciidamadooda intii ay u socdeen Baydhaba, ka hor inta aanu maamulka Laftagareen magaalada ka bixin. Ugaas Xasan ayaa dowladda federaalka ku eedeeyay inay “calooshood u shaqeystayaal” adeegsaneyso, islamarkaana ay xoog ku qabsatay maamulkii Koonfur Galbeed. “Daraawiishta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ayaa saaka arooryadii hore Baydhaba dagaal ku qaaday. Dagaalku muddooyinkanba waa socday oo kii koowaad ma aha, wuuna sii soconayaa,” ayuu yiri. Khilaafkii Maarso oo aan xal helin Dagaalka Isniinta wuxuu qeyb ka yahay xiisad soo jiitamaysay tan iyo 30-kii Maarso, markaas oo ciidamada dowladda federaalka ay la wareegeen Baydhaba kadib khilaaf siyaasadeed oo sii xoogeysanayay oo u dhexeeyay Muqdisho iyo maamulkii Laftagareen. Laftagareen ayaa xilka iska casilay markii ciidamada federaalka ay magaalada la wareegeen, maalmo kadib markii dib loogu doortay xilka madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed. Maamulkiisu wuxuu ka horreeyay inuu xiriirka u jaro dowladda federaalka, isagoo kasoo horjeeday isbeddellada dastuurka iyo habka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka dalka. Tan iyo xilligaas, ma jirin wadahadal siyaasadeed oo la shaaciyay oo dhexmaray Laftagareen iyo dowladda federaalka oo lagu xallinayo khilaafka, halka ciidamo isaga taageersan ay dhowr jeer isku dayeen inay weerarro ka geystaan gudaha iyo duleedka Baydhaba. Dagaalkii Isniinta ayaa ahaa isku daygii ugu weynaa ee kooxahaas ay ku galaan gudaha magaalada tan iyo markii Laftagareen awoodda laga tuuray. Ciidamadiisa ayaa saacadihii hore sheegay inay gaareen bartamaha Baydhaba, balse markii dambe ciidamada dowladda ayaa dibadda uga saaray. Markii la weydiiyay in khilaafka lagu xallin karo wadahadal, Ugaas Xasan wuxuu muujiyay in mowqifka ciidamadiisu aanu hadda u jihaysneyn wadaxaajood. “Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo dowladdiisu waxay diideen midnimadayada, inaan si sharci ah isu maamulno oo dadkeennu ay is doortaan oo iyagu aayahooda ka tashadaan. Annaguna waan diidnay wixii ay iyagu keeneen, waan la dagaallameynaa, waanan iska saareynaa, Ilaahay idankiis,” ayuu yiri. Afhayeen u hadlay maleeshiyada weerarka qaaday, oo isku magacaaba Daraawiishta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, ayaa si adag u diiday in ciidamadooda wax xiriir ah la leeyihiin Al-Shabaab. “Annaga Shabaab nalama dhaho. Dowladda Shabaab iyada ayaa taqaanna ee ha raadiso. Annaga Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa nala dhahaa,” ayuu Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed u sheegay BBC-da. “Waxay Shabaab geystaan mas’uuliyaddooda nalama weydiinayo, Shabaabna ma nihin,” ayuu raaciyay. Hadalkan ayaa yimid iyadoo dowladda federaalka ay sheegtay in ciidamada ku sugan Baydhaba lagu weeraray ka hor waaberigii, iyadoo maleeshiyada adeegsadeen gaadiid walxaha qarxa laga soo buuxiyay. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa sheegtay in ku dhowaad 30 ka mid ah weeraryahannada lagu dilay dagaalka, halka qaar kalena gacanta lagu dhigay. Laba weerar oo isku waqti dhacay Dood gaar ah ayaa ka dhalatay isku soo beegmidda dagaalka ay ciidamada Laftagareen ku qaadeen Baydhaba iyo weerar isla aroornimadaas lala xiriiriyay Al-Shabaab. Qaar ka mid ah dadka Soomaaliyeed ayaa baraha bulshada su’aalo ka keenay sida labada dhacdo ay isku waqti ugu beegmeen, iyadoo sidoo kale dhinaca dowladda laga soo jeediyay eedeymo ku saabsan xiriir ama iskaashi suuragal ah. Ugaas Xasan ayaa taas gebi ahaanba beeniyay. “Annagu kama warqabno taa iyada ah. Annaga iyo Shabaab xiriir nagama dhexeeyo, mana naga dhexeyn karo,” ayuu yiri markii BBC-du weydiisay in ciidamadoodu wax xog ah ka hayeen qorshaha Al-Shabaab. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in ciidamada dowladda federaalka, markii ay bishii Maarso u soo dhaqaaqayeen Baydhaba, ay soo mareen deegaanno ay Al-Shabaab joogaan, isaga oo arrintaas u soo qaatay jawaab uu kaga difaacayo eedeymaha loo jeediyay ciidamadiisa. Ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen ayaa xilligaas iyaguna sheegay in Al-Shabaab ay weerar dhabagal ah ku qaadeen qaar ka mid ah ciidamadooda intii ay u socdeen Baydhaba, ka hor inta aanu maamulka Laftagareen magaalada ka bixin. Ugaas Xasan ayaa dowladda federaalka ku eedeeyay inay “calooshood u shaqeystayaal” adeegsaneyso, islamarkaana ay xoog ku qabsatay maamulkii Koonfur Galbeed. “Daraawiishta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ayaa saaka arooryadii hore Baydhaba dagaal ku qaaday. Dagaalku muddooyinkanba waa socday oo kii koowaad ma aha, wuuna sii soconayaa,” ayuu yiri. Khilaafkii Maarso oo aan xal helin Dagaalka Isniinta wuxuu qeyb ka yahay xiisad soo jiitamaysay tan iyo 30-kii Maarso, markaas oo ciidamada dowladda federaalka ay la wareegeen Baydhaba kadib khilaaf siyaasadeed oo sii xoogeysanayay oo u dhexeeyay Muqdisho iyo maamulkii Laftagareen. Laftagareen ayaa xilka iska casilay markii ciidamada federaalka ay magaalada la wareegeen, maalmo kadib markii dib loogu doortay xilka madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed. Maamulkiisu wuxuu ka horreeyay inuu xiriirka u jaro dowladda federaalka, isagoo kasoo horjeeday isbeddellada dastuurka iyo habka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka dalka. Tan iyo xilligaas, ma jirin wadahadal siyaasadeed oo la shaaciyay oo dhexmaray Laftagareen iyo dowladda federaalka oo lagu xallinayo khilaafka, halka ciidamo isaga taageersan ay dhowr jeer isku dayeen inay weerarro ka geystaan gudaha iyo duleedka Baydhaba. Dagaalkii Isniinta ayaa ahaa isku daygii ugu weynaa ee kooxahaas ay ku galaan gudaha magaalada tan iyo markii Laftagareen awoodda laga tuuray. Ciidamadiisa ayaa saacadihii hore sheegay inay gaareen bartamaha Baydhaba, balse markii dambe ciidamada dowladda ayaa dibadda uga saaray. Markii la weydiiyay in khilaafka lagu xallin karo wadahadal, Ugaas Xasan wuxuu muujiyay in mowqifka ciidamadiisu aanu hadda u jihaysneyn wadaxaajood. “Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo dowladdiisu waxay diideen midnimadayada, inaan si sharci ah isu maamulno oo dadkeennu ay is doortaan oo iyagu aayahooda ka tashadaan. Annaguna waan diidnay wixii ay iyagu keeneen, waan la dagaallameynaa, waanan iska saareynaa, Ilaahay idankiis,” ayuu yiri. items.title: 18-Jir Belgium U Dhashay oo Helay Dahab $10 Milyan Lagu Qiyaasay
items.description: Belgium (Raxanreeb Online): Wiil 18 jir ah oo u dhashay dalka Belgium ayaa helay dahab lagu qiyaasay qiimihiisu inuu gaarayo 10 milyan oo dollar, xilli uu ka shaqeynayay duminta dhisme qadiimi ah. Wiilka ayaa la sheegay inuu dhismaha dumintiisa ku guda jiray markii uu arkay wax u eg shilimo dahab ah oo ku daadsanaa goobta. Arrintan ayaa la yaab ku noqotay, waxaana goobta loogu yeeray laamaha ammaanka. Ciidamada ammaanka ayaa markii ay goobta gaareen la wareegay dahabkii laga helay dhismaha, iyadoo ilaa hadda aan si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin cidda leh hantida iyo halka ay asal ahaan ka timid. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay xiiso iyo hadal-heyn ku saabsan halka uu ka yimid dahabka iyo qofka sharci ahaan xaqa u leh hantida laga helay dhismaha qadiimiga ah. items.title: Markab Lagu Afduubay Xeebaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Soomaaliya (Raxanreeb Online): Sida ay sheegtay Wakaaladda Wararka Anadolu, siddeed qof oo lagu tuhunsan yahay burcad-badeednimo ayaa la wareegay markab marayay xeebaha Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan meel koonfur kaga beegan deegaanka Mareero. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in kooxdu ay la wareegtay gacan-ku-haynta markabka kaddib markii ay gaareen goobtii uu ku sugnaa. Ilaa hadda faahfaahin rasmi ah lagama bixin magaca markabka, waxa uu siday iyo halka uu ku wajahnaa. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay soo baxayaan warar ku saabsan dib u soo kordhaya weerarrada burcad-badeedda ee ka dhaca xeebaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo dhowr markab lagu soo warramay in muddooyinkii dambe lala wareegay. items.title: Soomaaliya oo Kalluun U Dhoofinaysa Shiinaha Bisha Soo Socota
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Soomaaliya ayaa la filayaa inay bisha soo socota bilowdo dhoofinta kalluunka ee dalka Shiinaha, iyadoo laga faa’iideysanayo cashuur-dhaafka ay Beijing u sameysay dalalka Afrika. Heshiis ay Muqdisho ku kala saxiixdeen Wasiirka Kalluumeysiga Soomaaliya iyo Safiirka Shiinaha u fadhiya Soomaaliya ayaa lagu sheegay inuu ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed u oggolaanayo inay kalluunka si cashuur-la’aan ah ugu dhoofiyaan suuqa Shiinaha. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa jira caqabado horyaalla dhoofinta kalluunka Soomaaliya, waxaana kamid ah wax-soo-saarka kalluunka oo kooban, warshado waaweyn oo kalluunka farsameeya oo aan dalka ka jirin iyo heerarka tayada oo aan weli si buuxda ula jaanqaadin halbeegyada caalamiga ah. Inkasta oo kalluumaysiga sharci-darrada ah uu weli caqabad ku yahay xeebaha Soomaaliya, haddana ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed ayaa suuqa Shiinaha u arka fursad cusub oo muhiim u ah kobcinta ganacsiga kalluunka iyo dhaqaalaha dalka. The post Soomaaliya oo Kalluun U Dhoofinaysa Shiinaha Bisha Soo Socota appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Putin oo Erdogan Uga Digay Hubka Turkiga ee Ukraine
items.description: Ankara (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweynaha Ruushka, Vladimir Putin, ayaa la sheegay inuu uga digay Madaxweynaha Türkiye, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, in hub iyo gantaallo ku jira kaydka ciidamada Türkiye ee uu Mareykanku siiyay loo wareejiyo Ukraine. Sida uu maanta weriyay telefishinka Ruushka ee RT, Putin ayaa sheegay in haddii hubkaasi loo diro Ukraine ay taasi dhaawici karto xiriirka Moscow iyo Ankara. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, uu Erdoğan ka codsaday in qaar kamid ah gantaallada Mareykanku soo saaray ee ay ciidamada Türkiye haystaan loo diro Ukraine, xilli Ukraine ay wajahaysa baahi dhanka hubka ah. Hase yeeshee, xogta ku saabsan codsiga Trump iyo digniinta Putin waxay u baahan tahay xaqiijin dheeraad ah oo laga helo ilo madax-bannaan, maadaama warkan uu ku saleysan yahay warbaahin Ruush ah. items.title: Mareykanka oo ka fakaraya in uu nukliyeer ku dhufto Iiraan
items.description: Washington (Caasimada online) — Marjorie Taylor Greene, oo hore uga tirsanaan jirtay Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka, ayaa sheegtay in maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu ka wada hadlayo suurta-galnimada in hub nukliyeer ah loo adeegsado Iran, xilli Washington ay la tacaaleyso sidii ay u sii wadi lahayd dagaalka billaha badan socda. “Waxay shirarka istaraatiijiyadda kaga hadlayaan in hub nukliyeer ah loo adeegsado Iran,” ayay Greene ku qortay baraha bulshada habeenkii Axadda. “Ma qiyaasayo arrintan, waan ogahay. Waana shar saafi ah,” ayay raacisay. Greene, oo mar ka mid ahayd xulafadii ugu dhoweyd Trump ee Kongareeska, ayaa shacabka Mareykanka ugu baaqday inay si adag uga hortagaan tallaabo kasta oo dagaalka lagu sii ballaarinayo. “Dadku waa inay hadlaan oo si geesinimo leh u joojiyaan waallidan.” Xiriirka Greene iyo Trump ayaa burburay kaddib markii ay ku cadaadisay maamulka in la shaaciyo faylasha la xiriira Jeffrey Epstein, maal-qabeenkii geeriyooday ee lagu helay dambiyo galmo oo carruurta la xiriira, kaas oo xiriir bulsho la lahaa Trump iyo shaqsiyaad kale oo awood badan. Greene waxay ku eedeysay Washington inay dagaalka ku billowday digniino muddo dheer Israel ku celcelineysay oo ku saabsan barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran. “Trump iyo maamulkiisa waxaa hay’adaha sirdoonka dalkeena u sheegeen in Iran aysan meel dhowba ka joogin sameysashada hub nukliyeer ah, dabadeed Israel waxay ku celisay hadalkii ay tobannaan sano ku celcelineysay ee ahaa ‘Iran toddobaadyo keliya ayay u jirtaa’,” ayay Greene tiri. “Haddana dowladdeenna ayaa ah tan dhab ahaan ka wada hadleysa inay hoos u dhigto xadka adeegsiga hubka nukliyeerka si hub nukliyeer ah loogu adeegsado Iran, inkastoo Trump uu ku dhow 40 jeer ku dhawaaqay inuu dagaalka ku guuleystay, isla markaana uu sheegayo in Mareykanku gacanta ku hayo SoH,” ayay raacisay, iyadoo ula jeedda Marinka Hormuz. Dagaal lagu guuleysan la’yahay Mareykanka iyo Israel ayaa dagaalka ka dhanka ah Iran billaabay 28-kii Febraayo. Weerarrada socda muddada bilaha ah waxay dileen kumannaan rayid Iranian ah, waxay carqaladeeyeen sahayda tamarta caalamka, balse weli kuma aysan guuleysan inay Tehran ka jebiyaan gacan-ku-haynta marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah. Greene ayaa ka digtay in dagaalka oo sii fida uu horseedi karo waxa ay ku tilmaantay “xasuuq nukliyeer oo caalami ah”, hoos-u-dhac dhaqaale oo ba’an iyo khasaare naf oo aan jiilal badan la arag. “Mareykanka ma aha dal aan waxba la gaarsiin karin,” ayay Greene ka digtay. Hadalkeeda ayaa imanaya xilli ciidamada Mareykanka ay wajahaan hoos-u-dhac ku yimid kaydka hubka. Wakaaladda wararka Reuters ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada Mareykanka ay dagaalka ku isticmaaleen “ku dhowaad dhammaan” gantaalladoodii ridada dheer ee beegsiga saxda ah, halka isticmaalka ballaaran ee gantaallada difaaca Patriot iyo THAAD uu wiiqay diyaar-garowga Mareykanka ee meelaha kale. NBC News ayaa bishan sheegtay in Pentagon-ku diyaarinayo istaraatiijiyad cusub oo hubka nukliyeerka ah, taas oo hubka nukliyeerka taatikada ee ridada gaaban siinaysa door weyn oo uu ku yeesho dagaallada goboleed. “Aragtideennu waxay tahay inaan u baahan nahay xulashooyin nukliyeer oo lagu kalsoonaan karo,” ayuu sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan difaaca Mareykanka u sheegay NBC. Mareykanka ayaa weli ah dalka keliya ee hub nukliyeer ah dagaal u adeegsaday, kaddib markii uu 1945-kii burburiyey magaalooyinka Hiroshima iyo Nagasaki ee Japan. The post Mareykanka oo ka fakaraya in uu nukliyeer ku dhufto Iiraan appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: AfCFTA Secretary-General, FESTU Discuss Greater Trade Union Role in Africa’s Trade and Economic Integration
items.description: The Secretary-General of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), Wamkele Mene, met leaders of the Federation of Somali Trade Unions (FESTU) in Mogadishu on Monday, 17 August 2026, for discussions on the role of workers and organised labour in Somalia’s economic integration under the continental free trade framework. The FESTU delegation was led by its general secretary, Omar Faruk Osman. The meeting focused on Somalia’s implementation of the AfCFTA and how expanding trade and investment can contribute to decent job creation, stronger labour rights and greater economic opportunities for Somali workers and their families. The talks came as Somalia deepens its participation in African economic integration, with trade unions seeking to ensure that workers have a meaningful role in decisions that could shape employment, investment and the country’s labour market. The trade union federation told the AfCFTA delegation that workers should be actively involved in the formulation and implementation of trade policies because decisions on economic integration have direct consequences for jobs, wages, working conditions and labour rights. The federation said the success of expanding intra-African trade should not be measured solely by the movement of goods, services and investment across borders but also by its ability to generate decent employment and improve the livelihoods of working people. Reflecting positions advanced by the International Trade Union Confederation (ITUC) and ITUC-Africa, FESTU called for institutionalised and permanent social dialogue between the AfCFTA and organised labour. It also advocated permanent trade union representation within relevant AfCFTA governance structures, giving workers a meaningful voice in shaping and implementing policies that affect them. FESTU General Secretary Omar Faruk Osman said African economic integration would be stronger and more inclusive if workers and their organisations were recognised as active participants in the process. “Workers are at the heart of production, services and economic development. As Somalia advances its participation in the AfCFTA, we want to see trade and investment creating decent jobs, protecting labour rights and delivering real benefits to working people and their families, with trade unions having permanent and structured engagement with the AfCFTA,” Osman said.   Mene welcomed continued engagement with organised labour and highlighted the importance of social dialogue in building an inclusive African economy. He cited FESTU’s engagement in Somalia as a positive example and pointed to ongoing efforts to strengthen engagement between the AfCFTA Secretariat and trade unions across Africa. The discussions also highlighted the importance of cooperation among governments, businesses and workers’ organisations to ensure that the gains from economic integration are broadly shared and contribute to sustainable economic opportunities. FESTU praised Somalia’s Minister of Commerce and Industry, Ambassador Gamal M Hassan, for what it described as an inclusive approach to the country’s AfCFTA implementation by bringing government, the private sector and organised labour into the process. The national trade union federation said such cooperation could help Somalia take full advantage of the continental market, not only as a consumer of goods and services but increasingly as a producer and exporter. It said greater productive capacity, investment and access to African markets could support job creation and economic development while ensuring respect for workers’ rights. The meeting marked a further step in engagement between Somalia’s organised labour movement and the AfCFTA leadership as the country, which recently ratified AfCFTA, and seeks to strengthen its economic links with the rest of the continent and expand its participation in intra-African trade. FESTU said it would continue engaging with the Somali government, the AfCFTA Secretariat and other continental institutions in the spirit of social dialogue, with the aim of advancing an approach to economic integration in which increased trade and investment go hand in hand with decent work and respect for workers’ rights. items.title: Kadib dagaalkii shalay dhacay, saldhigyo cusub oo laga sameeyay duleedka Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo kuwa Daraawiishta maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa fariisimo cusub oo lagu xoojinayo amniga ka sameystay duleedka magaalada Baydhabo, sida ay sheegayaan ilo ku sugan gobolka Baay. Tallaabadan ayaa timid kaddib kulan xalay magaalada Baydhabo ku dhexmaray saraakiisha amniga ee Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed, kaas oo looga hadlay sidii looga hortagi lahaa weerarrada iyo falalka amni darro ee lagu beegsanayo magaalada. Saraakiisha ayaa isla soo qaaday qorsheyaal cusub oo lagu adkeynayo ammaanka Baydhabo, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa maamulka lagu amray inay sare u qaadaan feejignaantooda, gaar ahaan meelaha muhiimka ah ee magaalada iyo duleedkeeda. Sidoo kale, waxaa la adkeeyay xakameynta isu socodka gaadiidka xilliyada hore ee subaxda iyo habeenkii, iyadoo ciidamo dheeraad ah la dhigay waddooyinka iyo goobaha laga cabsi qabo in laga soo abaabulo weerarro. Weerarrada iyo falalka amni darrada ee ka dhanka ah maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa bilihii lasoo dhaafay kordhay, waxaana saraakiisha amniga ay sheegeen inay dejinayaan qorsheyaal cusub oo looga hortagayo weerarradaas iyo wax kasta oo khatar ku ah xasiloonida Baydhabo. Dhanka kale, waxaa sii kordhaya khasaaraha ka dhashay dagaalkii shalay aroortii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhabo iyo duleedkeeda, iyadoo wararka laga helayo deegaanka ay sheegayaan in meydad hor leh laga soo saaray goobihii uu dagaalku ka dhacay. Meydadka ayaa la sheegay inay isugu jiraan dhinacyadii ku dagaallamay magaalada iyo dad rayid ah, iyadoo xaaladda Baydhabo ay weli tahay mid xasaasi ah, isla markaana ay socdaan dadaallo lagu xoojinayo amniga laguna yareynayo khatarta dagaallo kale. items.title: Galmudug oo Shaacisay Natiijada Imtixaanka Shahaadiga ah ee Fasalka 8-aad
items.description: Dowladda Galmudug ayaa maanta shaacisay natiijada imtixaanka shahaadiga ah ee fasalka 8-aad ee dugsiyada ku yaalla deegaanada maamulkaasi, iyadoo natiijada lagu soo bandhigay munaasabad lagu qabtay magaalada Dhuusamareeb, caasimadda Galmudug. Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee Galmudug ayaa sheegtay in imtixaanka ay u fariisteen 8,104 arday , kuwaas oo ka kala socday dugsiyada ku yaalla deegaanada maamulka. Tirada ardayda imtixaanka gashay ayaa waxaa ka mid ahaa 4,180 wiil iyo 3,924 gabdhood . Natiijada la shaaciyay ayaa muujinaysa in 7,881 arday ay ku guuleysteen imtixaanka , halka 223 arday ay ku dhaceen . Ardayda guuleysatay waxaa ka mid ah 4,073 wiil iyo 3,808 gabdhood , taasoo ka dhigan in heerka guud ee guusha imtixaanku uu gaaray ku dhowaad 97 boqolkiiba , halka 2.8 boqolkiiba ardayda ay ku dhaceen. Wasaaradda Waxbarashada Galmudug ayaa sheegtay in natiijadani ay muujinayso dadaalka ay sameeyeen ardayda, macallimiinta, waalidiinta iyo dhammaan dhinacyada ku howlan horumarinta waxbarashada ee deegaanada Galmudug. Imtixaanka fasalka 8-aad ayaa ah mid muhiim u ah ardayda, maadaama uu qeyb ka yahay marxaladda kala guurka ee waxbarashada aasaasiga ah, waxaana natiijadiisa si weyn u sugayay ardayda iyo waalidiinta. Si kastaba ha ahaatee natiijada sanadkan waxay muujinaysaa heer guul oo sare, iyadoo inta badan ardaydii u fariisatay imtixaanka ay ka gudbeen, halka tiro kooban ay ku guuldarreysteen.

items.title: Goorma ayay Somali Airlines dib u bilaabeysa duulimaadka?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Shirkadda diyaaradaha qaranka Soomaaliya ee Somali Airlines ayaa la filayaa inay dib u bilowdo duulimaadyadeeda bisha September 2026 kadib in ka badan 35 sano oo aysan shaqeyn, tan iyo burburkii dowladdii dhexe ee Soomaaliya. Agaasimaha Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed, Axmed Macallin ayaa sheegay in la soo gabagabeeyay diyaar-garowga loogu jiro dib u hawlgelinta shirkadda, isagoo xusay in duulimaadyada cusub la filayo inay bilaabmaan bisha soo socota. Dib u soo noqoshada Somali Airlines ayaa noqon karta tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu soo celinayo shirkad diyaaradeed oo qaran, iyadoo muddo dheer aysan Soomaaliya lahayn shirkad calankeeda sidata oo si joogto ah uga shaqeysa duulimaadyada gudaha iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Garoonka caalamiga ah ee Aadan Cadde ee Muqdisho ayaa xilligan martigeliya shirkado diyaaradeed oo caalami ah, waxaana ka mid ah Ethiopian Airlines, Qatar Airways iyo Turkish Airlines, kuwaas oo isku xira Soomaaliya iyo dalal badan oo gobolka iyo caalamka ah. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sanadihii lasoo dhaafay dhowr jeer shaacisay qorsheyaal lagu soo celinayo Somali Airlines, hase yeeshee waqtiyo kala duwan oo loo qorsheeyay dib u bilaabashada shirkadda ayaa dib u dhacay, taasoo keentay in qorshuhu muddo dheer dib u jiitamo. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa bishii July 2025 ku dhawaaqday inay iibsatay laba diyaaradood oo nooca Airbus A320 ah, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ahaa qorshaha lagu soo noolaynayo shirkadda diyaaradaha qaranka. Heshiiska iibka diyaaradaha ayaa lagu saxiixay xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamza Cabdi Barre, waxaana xilligaas ku dhawaaqay Wasiirkii Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada Maxamed Faarax Nuux, kaas oo sheegay in diyaaradaha lagu shaqeyn doono magaca Somali Airlines muddo laba bilood gudahood ah. Bishii October 2025, Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Somali Airlines ay dib u bilaabi doonto howlaheeda ka hor dhammaadka sanadkaas, iyadoo saraakiishu xilligaas tilmaameen in diyaar-garowgu marayay heerarkii ugu dambeeyay. Somali Airlines waxaa la aas-aasay sanadkii 1964, waxayna muddo dheer ahayd shirkadda calanka u sidda Soomaaliya, iyadoo ka shaqeyn jirtay duulimaadyo gudaha iyo caalami ah. Howlaheeda ayaa hakad galay kaddib dagaalladii sokeeye, waxaana ugu dambeyn si buuxda loo joojiyay sanadkii 1991. Haddii qorshaha hadda jira uu hirgalo, shirkaddu waxay dib ugu soo laaban doontaa hawada Soomaaliya xilli dalka uu wado dadaallo lagu horumarinayo kaabayaasha gaadiidka iyo xoojinta isku xirka Soomaaliya, dalalka gobolka iyo suuqyada caalamka. The post Goorma ayay Somali Airlines dib u bilaabeysa duulimaadka? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ciidamada weeraray Baydhabo oo ka hadlay waxa ay ka ogaayeen weerarkii al-Shabaab ee xerada milatariga Soomaaliya
items.description: Ugu yaraan 30 qof ayaa ku dhintay dagaal culus oo saaka ka qarxay hareerraha iyo gudaha magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta kumeel gaarka ah ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, sida ay BBC-da u sheegeen illo wareedyo ku sugan gobolka. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ee Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay, in dagaalamayaal ka tirsan al-Shabaab iyo mileeshiyo daacad u ah hoggaamiyihii hore ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Laftagareen ay weerarreen, xeryo ciidan oo ku yaala magaalada Baydhabo, balse weerarradaasi lagu jabiyay. Dhanka dowlad goboleedka KGS, waxay xaqiijiyeen in uu jiro khasaare isugu jira dhimasho iyo dhaawac, halka dhanka ciidamadii soo weeraray magaalada ay sheegeen in wali aysan xog rasmi ah ka helin khasaaraha ka dhashay dagaalka, balse filashadoodu ay tahay in dhaawac iyo dhimasho labaduba suuragal yihiin. Saraakiil ka tirsan maamulkii hore ee Laftagareen, ayaa sheegay in ay saaka duulaan ballaaran ku qaadeen magaalada Baydhabo, isla markaana ay khasaare culus gaarsiiyeen ciidamada dawladda.   Wasiirka Amniga ee Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, Isaaq Maxamed Korsaar oo BBC-da la hadlay ayaa isna ku eedeeyay ciidamadii soo weeraray magaalada in ay garab siiyeen al Shabab’ : “Waxaa na soo weeraray Shabab iyo qoladii Shabaabka kalkaalka,” ayuu yiri mar uu ka hadlay weeraradii saaka ka dhacay Baydhabo. Balse afhayeen u hadlay ciidamada la sheegay in ay daacadda u yihiin madaxweyanhii hore ee Koonfur-galbeed iyaguse sheegta in ay yihiin ciidamada Daraawiishta Koonfur-galbeed, ayaa diiday eedaha loo jeediyay ciidankooda. “Annaga Shabab nalama dhaho. Dwoladdu shababaka iyada ayaa taqaana ee haraadsato. Annaga Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa nala dhahaa,” ayuu yiri afhayeenka u hadlay ciidamada, Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo u wararmayay BBC-da. Isaga oo hadalkiisa sii wata ayuu yiri: “waxay Shabaab gaystaan masuuliyadooda nalama waydiinayo, Shabaabna ma nihin.” Ugaas Xasan waxa kale ee uu soo hadal qaaday in markii ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya ay duulaanka ku qaadayeen magaalada Baydhabo ay soo dhexmareen dhul ay joogaan Shabaabku, isaga oo iska difaacayay eedda ay wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya u jeedisay ciidamadooda.

items.title: Trump oo ku hanjabay in uu weerari doono dalka Cumaan
items.description: Washington (Caasimada online) — Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa ku hanjabay in Mareykanku duqeyn doono Cumaan haddii dalkaasi uu “caqabad ku noqdo” dadaallada Washington ee lagu doonayo in heshiis nabadeed lala gaaro Iran. “Haddii Cumaan ay jidka naga hor istaagto, si daran ayaan u duqeyn doonnaa,” ayuu sheegay weriyaha Fox News Trey Yingst in Trump uu yiri intii lagu jiray wareysi telefoon oo dhacay Isniintii. Sida uu Yingst sheegay, Trump ayaa tilmaamay in ciidamada Mareykanka ay weerari karaan dalka Khaliijka ku yaalla haddii uu farageliyo go’doominta maraakiibta Iran ee maraya marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in go’doomintaasi ay cadaadis saarayso Iran, balse ma uusan sheegin waqti cayiman oo dagaalka lagu soo afjarayo, isaga oo sheegay inuusan degdegsaneyn. Wada-xaajoodayaal Iranian ah ayaa toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay wada-hadallo la yeeshay Cumaan, kuwaas oo ku saabsan heshiis ku-meel-gaar ah oo lagu maareynayo isu-socodka maraakiibta ee marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Wada-hadalladaas ayaa weli socda, mana aysan dhalin wax natiijo la taaban karo. Militariga Iran ayaa dhankiisa sii waday inuu rasaas ku furo maraakiibta isku dayaya inay maraan marin-biyoodka iyaga oo aan fasax ka haysan Tehran, iyadoo Iran ay dooneyso inay sii haysato awoodda ay ku xakameyso isu-socodka ganacsiga ee halkaas mara. Si ka duwan bilowgii dagaalka, markii Mareykanku weerarrada noocaas ah uga jawaabi jiray duqeymo uu ku qaado bartilmaameedyo Iranian ah oo ku yaalla hareeraha marin-biyoodka, Washington ilaa hadda kama aysan jawaabin dhacdooyinkii ugu dambeeyay, arrintaas oo niyad-jab ku abuurtay qaar ka mid ah xulafadeeda Khaliijka. Toddobaadkii hore, ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa rasaas ku furay markab watay calanka Panama oo isku dayay inuu jebiyo go’doominta Mareykanka ee dekedaha Iran, tallaabadaas oo muujisay in Washington ay adkeyneyso hirgelinta xannibaadaha badda, xilli ay isku dayeyso inay dowladda Iran cadaadis dhaqaale saarto. Markii uu dagaalku billowday, mas’uuliyiinta Cumaan ayaa si degdeg ah u sameeyay marin xiriir oo aan rasmi ahayn oo ay la yeeshaan Tehran. Sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiin Carbeed, xiriirkaas ayaa gacan ka geystay in dalalka Khaliijku dib u furaan marinnada duulimaadyada. Dadaalka Muscat ay ku dooneyso inay dhexdhexaadiye aan dhinacna raacsaneyn ka noqoto Khaliijka ayaa caro ku abuuray qaar ka mid ah mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka, kuwaas oo ay sii kordhayso aragtidooda ah in habka Cumaan uu khilaafsan yahay danaha Washington. Iran ayaa tan iyo markii dagaalku billowday weerarro xiriir ah ku qaaday goobo ku yaalla Cumaan, kuwaas oo ay ku jireen weerarro diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah oo lagu qaaday dekedo ay isticmaalaan ciidamada Mareykanka. Bishii June, wargeyska The Wall Street Journal ayaa sheegay in maamulka Trump uu ugu hanjabay Cumaan cunaqabateyn iyo duqeyn, kadib markii qiimeyn sirdoon ay soo jeedisay in Muscat ay qorsheyneysay inay Iran kala qeybqaadato lacag laga qaado maraakiibta maraysa marin-biyoodka istaraatiijiga ah. Cumaan ayaa marar badan beenisay inay leedahay qorshe noocaas ah. Dagaalka ayaa hadda socday ku dhowaad lix bilood, wuxuuna sare u qaaday qiimaha shidaalka iyo gaaska, xilli ay soo dhow yihiin doorashooyinka dhexe ee Mareykanka ee November. Wada-hadalladii nabadeed ee Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa hakad galay, halka iska horimaadyo goos-goos ah ay weli carqaladeynayaan isu-socodka shidaalka iyo badeecooyinka kale ee mara marin-biyoodka Hormuz oo muhiimad weyn u leh ganacsiga caalamka. Qoraal uu Isniintii ku daabacay bartiisa Truth Social, Trump ayaa sheegay in “hadafkiisa koowaad” uu weli yahay in la xaqiijiyo in Iran “aysan sinaba, qaabna, ama xaalad kasta ugu yeelan karin hub nukliyeer ah.” The post Trump oo ku hanjabay in uu weerari doono dalka Cumaan appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Mareykanka oo sheegay in aan Qasa dib loo dhisi doono ilaa Xamaas hubka dhigto
items.description: Ergayga Mareykanka Jared Kushner ayaa sheegay in maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uusan oggolaan doonin dib-u-dhiska Marinka Gaza ilaa Xamaas ay hubkeeda dhigto, xilli dadaallada Mareykanka ee lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka Gaza ay weli wajahayaan caqabado. Kushner, oo ah wiilka uu soddogga u yahay Madaxweyne Trump, ayaa Isniintii kulan la yeeshay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu. Kulankaasi, sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta, ma uusan keenin horumar muuqda oo ku saabsan hirgelinta qorshe Gaza ah oo Xamaas ay horey ugu heshiisay. Kushner ayaa sheegay in Washington ay hayso qorshe dib loogu dhisayo Gaza, balse uu ku xirnaan doono marka hore hub-ka-dhigista Xamaas. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in Mareykanku uusan xaddidi doonin waxa uu ku tilmaamay “xaqa Israa’iil u leedahay inay is-difaacdo” haddii ay jiraan khataro degdeg ah. Hadalladan ayaa muujinaya in maamulka Trump uu xoogga saarayo in Gaza laga hirgeliyo qorshe amni oo ku xiran hub-ka-dhigista Xamaas. Dhanka kale, Xamaas ayaa qayb ka ahayd hannaan Mareykanku taageerayo oo ay ku jiraan hub-ka-dhigis, ka bixitaanka ciidamada Israa’iil iyo joojinta weerarrada ka socda Gaza. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa isaguna Isniintii ku baaqay in la joojiyo weerarrada Israa’iil ka fulinayso Gaza, isagoo sheegay in Xamaas ay oggolaatay inay hubka dhigto. Kushner ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu Axaddii kulan la yeeshay masuuliyiin ka tirsan Xamaas, kaas oo ahaa kulan dhif ah oo ka dhacay xilli Washington ay dadaal ugu jirto in la soo afjaro colaadda. weerarrada Israa’iil ee Gaza ayaa tan iyo markii lagu dhawaaqay xabbad-joojinta sanadkii hore lagu dilay ugu yaraan 1,265 qof , halka tirada guud ee dhimashada Falastiiniyiinta tan iyo Oktoobar 2023 ay gaartay 73,399 qof , sida lagu sheegay xogta ay warbixintu xustay. Hadalka Kushner ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo mustaqbalka Gaza uu weli ku xiran yahay arrimo waaweyn oo ay ka mid yihiin hub-ka-dhigista Xamaas, ka bixitaanka ciidamada Israa’iil, amniga Gaza iyo qorshaha dib-u-dhiska dhulka ay dagaalladu si weyn u burburiyeen.

items.title: Madaxweynaha oo Bogaadiyey Nabadda iyo Horumarka Gaalkacyo
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa sheegay in magaalada Gaalkacyo ay haatan ka jirto xaalad nabadgelyo oo wanaagsan, isagoo bogaadiyey dadaallada lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo horumarka magaalada. Madaxweynaha iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo oo booqasho ku tegay magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa halkaasi khudbad ka jeediyey, isagoo ka hadlay isbeddelka amni iyo horumar ee magaalada iyo dadaallada bulshada iyo maamulka deegaanka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in uu Gaalkacyo booqday qiyaastii 20 sano ka hor, xilligaas oo uu sheegay in magaalada ay wajahaysay duruufo adag, xitaa helitaanka biyo nadiif ahna uu ahaa caqabad, hase yeeshee, wuxuu tilmaamay in maanta magaalada laga dareemayo horumar iyo xasillooni ka duwan xaaladdii hore. Madaxweynaha ayaa si gaar ah u ammaanay maamulka iyo shacabka Gaalkacyo, isagoo sheegay inay dadaal muuqda ku bixiyeen sugidda amniga iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada. Waxa uu sidoo kale xusay in Gaalkacyo ay tahay hal magaalo , balse duruufihii amni iyo siyaasadeed ee soo maray ay muddo dheer magaalada u ekaysiiyeen laba qaybood oo kala duwan. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in hadda la dareemayo isu-soo-dhawaansho iyo in magaalada ay si tartiib ah ugu soo laabanayso midnimadeeda. Madaxweynaha ayaa ugu dambeyn ku baaqay in la xoojiyo nabadda, wadajirka iyo iskaashiga bulshada, si Gaalkacyo ay uga faa’iidaysato fursadaha horumarineed ee ka jira dalka, loona sii adkeeyo amniga iyo xasilloonida magaalada.

Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in hadda la dareemayo isu-soo-dhawaansho iyo in magaalada ay si tartiib ah ugu soo laabanayso midnimadeeda. Madaxweynaha ayaa ugu dambeyn ku baaqay in la xoojiyo nabadda, wadajirka iyo iskaashiga bulshada, si Gaalkacyo ay uga faa’iidaysato fursadaha horumarineed ee ka jira dalka, loona sii adkeeyo amniga iyo xasilloonida magaalada.

items.title: Ciidamada Laftagareen oo si gaar ah u bartilmaameedsanaya Magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweyne Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa diiradda saaraya Magaalada Baydhabo, si ka duwan magaalooyinka iyo deegaanada kale ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Ciidamadan ayaa Isniintii weerar uu dhiig badani ku daatay ka gaystay magaaladaasi, ka dib markii ay u suurtagashay in ay dhowr saacadood ka dagaalamaan bartamaha Baydhabo, ka hor inta aan dib looga saarin magaalada. Xoogaga taageersan Laftagareen ayaa 8-dii bishii May bilaabay inay weeraraan barraha kontorool ee ku yaala bannaanada magaalada, waxaana xigay weerar ballaaran oo 30-kii May ay gudaha ugu galeen magaaladaasi. Tan iyo intii ay weerarada ka gaysanayeen magaalada ayaa waxaan jirin weerar qura oo ay ka fuliyeen magaalo kale oo Koonfur Galbeed ah. Sababta taageereyaasha Laftagareen ay u beegsanayaan Baydhabo, waa inay tahay Xarunta KMG ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed iyo goobta uu maamulku ku shaqeeyo, waana tan keeneysa inay si gooniya u bartilmaameedsadaan magaaladaasi. Inkasta oo magaalo xeebeedka Baraawe ee Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose ay tahay Xarunta Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, haddana maamulka ayaa tan iyo markii la aasaasay ku shaqeynayay Baydhabo, halkaas oo ay ku yaallaan Xarumaha Madaxtooyada iyo Baarlamaanka. Magaalada Baydhabo waxay sidoo kale xarun u tahay Gobolka Baay oo isku xira gobolada kale ee Koonfur Galbeed ee Bakool iyo Shabellaha Hoose. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo garabsanaya ciidamo dadka deegaanka ah oo Dowladda Federaalka ay abaabushay ayaa 30-kii bishii March la wareegay gacan ku haynta Magaalada Baydhabo, taasoo sababtay in Cabdicasiis Laftagareen uu ku dhawaaqo inuu xilka iska casilay, ka gadaal markii isla maalintaasi uu Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud uu ka raacay diyaarad u socotay Magaalada Nairobi. Masuuliyiin ka tirsanaa maamulkiisii iyo ciidamo isaga u daacad ah ayaa bishii April ka horyimid tallaabada ay Ciidamada Militariga kula wareegeen amniga Baydhabo, markaas oo Laftagareen uu ka laabtay mowqifkiisii is casilaadda, iyadoo tanina ay sii hurisay xiisaddii siyaasadeed ee kala dhexeysay Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo mid militari oo soo korortay. 10-kii bishii June, Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa waxay Baydhabo ugu doorteen Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) inuu noqdo Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo ay taagnaayeen caqabado siyaasadeed iyo kuwo dhanka amniga ah. Doorashadan oo muran uu hareeyay ayaa timid, iyadoo aan la xalin xaaladaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amniga, waxaana Laftagareen uu ka biyo diiday in uu aqbalo natiijada iyo habka loo maamulay doorashadaasi. Dadka reer Baydhabo ayaa ridistii Laftagareen ka dhaxlay xaalad amni darro, oo aan horey uga jirin magaalada, intii uu xafiiska joogay Laftagareen. Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo Laftagareen ayaa si taban u saameynaya amniga, nolosha iyo xasilloonida guud ee Magaalada Baydhabo iyo nawaaxigeeda. Dadka reer Baydhabo ayaa jeclaan lahaa in wax laga bedelo wada hadal la’aanta labada dhinac, si loo dhameeyo loolanka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya dhinacyada. Reer Baydhabo ayaa qaba in xalka keliya uu yahay in miiska wada hadalka la isugu yimaado, si loo dejiyo xaaladda.
