items.title: AUSSOM Cannot Eradicate Al-Shabaab Without Somali Government’s Full Engagement in the Fight
items.description: By Djama Mahamoud Ali The fight against Al-Shabaab has defined Somalia’s security landscape for nearly two decades. The Al-Qaeda affiliate has proven remarkably resilient against numerous counterinsurgency campaigns, exploiting the Somali government’s lack of appetite to fight against Alshabab, clan divisions, and persistent political crises. The international community has responded with substantial commitments, the African Union has maintained a peacekeeping presence since 2007, transitioning from AMISOM to ATMIS and most recently to AUSSOM, whose mandate extends through December 2026. The United States conducts airstrikes in coordination with the federal government and has completed the creation and training of the Somali Danab elite unit for counterterrorism operations. Turkey has built a parallel security architecture including the TURKSOM Military Training Academy, which has trained thousands of Somali soldiers, including members of the elite Gorgor Commando Brigade. Yet the results have been disappointing. By 2025, Al-Shabaab had launched a broad offensive, taking control of dozens of towns and villages. In August 2026 alone, the extremist group seized the strategic town of Teedaan in central Somalia’s Hiiraan region following intense fighting with government forces. The much-touted “Total War” against Al-Shabaab, launched in 2022, relied on fragile clan-militia alliances and was quickly derailed by political rifts This failure is not primarily military but political. The Somali federal government, under President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, has systematically deployed internationally trained and equipped forces not against Al-Shabaab but against its own federal member states and political opponents. Unless Somalia’s internal political divisions are resolved, the fight against Al-Shabaab cannot succeed. Jubaland Confrontation The federal government’s campaign against Jubaland represents the most significant and costly misdirection of military assets. In December 2024, armed clashes broke out between Somali federal forces and troops loyal to the Jubaland administration in Raskamboni, a strategic town in the Lower Jubba region near the Kenyan border. The federal government had deployed troops to Raskamboni after disagreeing with the outcome of Jubaland polls in which Ahmed Islam Mohamed Madobe was re-elected as president. The operation ended in catastrophic defeat of Somalia’s federal forces. Jubaland forces managed to neutralize the elite Gorgor troops, forcing some to seek refuge in Kenya. Senior Jubaland officials confirmed that 240 federal soldiers surrendered to Jubaland forces, further consolidating their control in the area. The federal troops suffered heavy defeats and were forced to retreat across the Kenyan border. This conflict displaced over 24,000 individuals. The Raskamboni debacle was not an isolated incident. In July 2025, clashes between federal troops and Jubaland forces near Beled-Hawo killed at least 10 people. The SNA forces suffered a major defeat in the December 2024 battle at Raskamboni,  As one analysis observed, the federal government “has entirely failed to learn the lessons of Ras Kamboni”. Federal lawmakers from Jubaland accused the federal government of deliberately preparing and financing militias to create insecurity along the border and disrupt peace. The pattern is unmistakable, internationally trained and equipped forces intended for counterterrorism were instead deployed against a federal member state and were defeated. South-West State Confrontation The most brazen example of military diversion occurred in March 2026, when federal troops forcibly removed Southwest State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. Laftagareen, in power since 2018, was re-elected with 66 percent of the vote but the federal government rejected the result as a “ploy” to hold onto power. Since the previous week, federal troops including Turkish-trained special units of the Somali military had been advancing on Baidoa, 246 kilometers southwest of Mogadishu, with instructions to oust Abdiaziz.This military operation used Turkish-trained Gorgor special forces and Turkish-supplied drones. Southwest State authorities accused Turkey of involvement in the military operations, alleging that Turkish-trained forces, equipment, and drones were used in actions against the administration. Laftagareen was forced to resign on March 30, 2026, and was allowed to fly into exile in Nairobi. The African Union called for restraint, warning that rising tensions between the federal government and Southwest State risked undermining the country’s stability. Renewed fighting continued in Baidoa through July 2026, with forces loyal to Laftagareen taking control of parts of the town while the national army mobilized troops to drive them away. Political Opponents Confrontation Beyond conflicts with member states, the federal government used military forces against domestic political opponents within the capital itself. On June 4, 2026, heavy fighting rocked Mogadishu as government forces and militias aligned with opposition leaders exchanged gunfire. The clashes erupted ahead of planned anti-government demonstrations challenging President Mohamud’s leadership and recent constitutional changes. Former Somalia President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed accused government forces of surrounding and attacking his residence, while former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire alleged that security forces used heavy weapons in densely populated areas and targeted senior opposition figures. Former National Intelligence and Security Agency Director Sanbaloolshe accused President Mohamud of targeting him, Khaire, and traditional elders during the fighting. The violence had devastating humanitarian consequences. Armed clashes between federal government forces and an opposition-affiliated armed group killed at least 13 people, injured 189 others, and displaced about 12,500 households. The fighting began near Dabka junction before spreading into densely populated areas including Hawlwadaag, Abdiaziz, Hodan, Wardhigley, and parts of Karaan. The United States and the United Kingdom condemned the violence, with the U.S. Embassy describing the clashes as reckless. As one opposition politician stated, “forces trained and equipped by international partners were used against political gatherings instead of being deployed strictly for counterterrorism operations.” Puntland Confrontation The most dramatic illustration of the federal government’s misdirection of military assets occurred on August 5, 2026. Heavily armed Puntland forces, backed by military vehicles, launched an operation against a Federal military camp near Galkayo airport. The Army was brought there to conduct operation against Puntland. Howevere, Puntland forces took full control of the camp and detained 101 militia members aligned with the federal government, including senior commanders. They also seized weapons, military vehicles, police uniforms, and other security equipment, including items claimed to be part of Chinese aid provided to the Somali Police Force. Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni accused the federal government of fueling tensions by deploying troops and weapons to the area. “The operation carried out by Puntland forces in Galkayo sends a clear message to anyone engaged in activities that threaten Puntland’s security and state authority,” Deni said. He warned that any consequences would be the federal government’s responsibility and urged Hassan Sheikh to “change course before the crisis deepens”. Jubaland backed Puntland’s actions, stating that “weapons and military equipment were being moved into peaceful areas while Somali forces fighting Al-Shabaab were facing shortages of arms and supplies”. This statement underscores a devastating irony: international military aid intended for the counterterrorism fight is being diverted to internal political conflicts, while frontline forces against Al-Shabaab lack adequate resources. The confrontation was triggered by a disputed shipment of weapons allegedly transported by the federal government into southern Galkayo. Puntland President Deni accused the federal government of backing rival forces and attempting to interfere in Puntland’s internal affairs. Internal Political disagreement and Constitutional Crisis were the bases At the heart of these conflicts lies a broader constitutional crisis. In March 2026, parliament unilaterally approved a package of constitutional amendments hailed by government supporters as the culmination of a fourteen-year constitutional review process. However, opposition leaders and federal member states argue the changes could extend President Mohamud’s tenure and delay national elections. Relations between Mogadishu and several federal member states remain strained. Multiple state and deputy ministers representing Puntland, Jubaland, and Southwest have stepped down as tensions escalated over constitutional revisions and the framework for upcoming federal and regional elections.  The heart of Somalia’s recurrent election crisis is tension between the clan-based power-sharing system and direct elections, a conflict made harder to resolve because the distribution of power between the federal government and its member states is not clearly demarcated in the provisional constitution. The federal government’s unilateral constitutional amendments, enforced through military means using Turkish-trained forces, have alienated member states and deepened the political crisis. Al-Shabaab Exploits Internal Divisions  The diversion of military resources toward internal political objectives has direct and measurable consequences for the counterterrorism effort. Political tensions in Somalia have fueled concerns over security and stability, with analysts warning that political divisions could undermine recent security gains and complicate efforts to combat Al-Shabaab. Observers warn that if political divisions persist, they could erode international confidence in Somalia’s stabilization efforts and affect continued support from development and security partners. A letter from opposition leaders to the international community accused Somalia’s government of failing to “sustain progress against al-Shabaab, take ownership of its security functions, or undertake serious security sector reform,” blaming “internal rivalries and political infighting”. Al-Shabaab has been quick to exploit these divisions. The group launched a broad offensive in 2025, taking control of dozens of towns and villages. In August 2026, Al-Shabaab seized the strategic town of Teedaan in central Somalia following heavy fighting with government forces and allied local militias. The group’s current advance, which it calls Operation Ramadan, began in February 2025. Meanwhile, Somalia’s political class remains “dangerously polarized and unable to forge a united front against their common enemy, al Shabaab.” The juxtaposition is damning: while Al-Shabaab closes in on Mogadishu, the federal government uses its military to fight Puntland, oust regional presidents, and suppress political opposition. It is clear that political fragmentation hinders the fight against Al-Shabaab. If political divisions continue, the further weakening of state authority could accelerate Al-Shabaab’s expansion from rural areas into cities. The Role of International Partners International partners bear partial responsibility for this state of affairs. Turkey has become one of Mohamud’s most prominent bilateral security partners, providing military training, equipment, and support to Somali forces for more than a decade and with no accountability. The TURKSOM Military Training Academy has trained thousands of Somali soldiers, including members of the elite Gorgor Commando Brigade. The United States has continued to provide military assistance, with AFRICOM Commander General Michael Langley reaffirming the United States’ commitment to supporting Somalia’s fight against terrorism. However, as a result of Somali Government’s failure to meaningfully engage war against Alshabab, the US communicated a definitive policy decision establishing December 31, 2026, as the termination date for all support to the United Nations Support Office in Somalia. By continuing to arm and train a federal army that is then deployed against member states and political opponents, the international community is inadvertently enabling the very internal conflicts that undermine the counterterrorism mission. The African Union has called for peaceful dialogue, warning that rising tensions risk undermining stability. But words of restraint are insufficient when military assistance continues without conditionality. A State at War with Itself Cannot Fight a Common Enemy The evidence is unambiguous. The Somali federal government, under President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, has systematically used internationally trained and equipped military forces to: 1. Attack Jubaland, suffering a catastrophic defeat at Raskamboni in December 2024, with 240 federal soldiers surrendering to regional forces; 2. Forcibly remove the elected president of Southwest State in March 2026, using Turkish-trained Gorgor special forces and Turkish-supplied drones; 3. Confront and suppress political opponents in Mogadishu in June 2026, killing at least 13 people and displacing 12,500 households; and 4. Escalate tensions with Puntland, leading to the routing of federal forces and the capture of 101 militiamen on August 5, 2026, all while Al-Shabaab seizes strategic towns and advances its insurgency. AUSSOM cannot clear Al-Shabaab without the Somali government’s full engagement in the fight. But the Somali government is not engaged, it is fighting its own member states and political rivals. As Jubaland stated, weapons and military equipment were being moved into peaceful areas while Somali forces fighting Al-Shabaab faced shortages of arms and supplies. The international community must recognize that military solutions alone cannot succeed where political unity is absent. It is therefore imperative that the international community prioritize resolving Somalia’s internal political problems as a prerequisite for any effective counterterrorism strategy. AUSSOM troop-contributing countries have been urged to make a political settlement the foundation for Somalia’s security arrangements and future governance. Somalia’s opposition leaders have appealed to African Union troop-contributing countries to prioritize an inclusive political settlement before implementing any further security transition. Until Somalia’s federal government and its member states are reconciled, until internationally provided military assets are used exclusively against Al-Shabaab rather than against political opponents, and until Somalia’s political class forges a united front against their common enemy, the fight against Al-Shabaab will continue to yield no fruits. Somalia, which is not with itself, cannot fight against Al-Shabaab. Djama Mahamoud Ali Email: djama_m@yahoo.om The post AUSSOM Cannot Eradicate Al-Shabaab Without Somali Government’s Full Engagement in the Fight appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Jama Moves to Bridge Somalia’s Parliamentary Divide as New Speaker Reaches Out to Opposition MPs
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN ) — Somalia’s newly elected Speaker of the House of the People, Abdulqadir Mohamed Nur “Jama, ” has begun efforts to reach out to lawmakers opposed to the Federal Government’s political agenda, in what could become an important first step toward healing the deep divisions within Somalia’s parliament. Jama has reportedly held a private meeting in Mogadishu with members of a group of opposition lawmakers who have styled themselves the “ Free Parliament.” The group has aligned itself with the broader Future Council opposition coalition, which has emerged as one of the government’s strongest political challengers. The Future Council brings together several prominent Somali political figures, including former presidents, prime ministers, parliamentary speakers and senior ministers. Its influence among opposition lawmakers could therefore make Jama’s attempt at parliamentary reconciliation both politically difficult and potentially significant. A Young Speaker Facing an Old Political Problem Sources close to the new Speaker say Jama’s recent meeting with opposition MPs was intended to listen to their grievances and explore ways of reducing tensions inside the legislature. The initiative comes at a critical moment for Somalia, with parliament deeply divided over elections, constitutional reforms, federal relations and the broader direction of the country’s political transition. Jama’s personal profile could give him an advantage in attempting to bridge those differences. A relatively young with substantial experience in government and politics, he enters the speakership with the opportunity to present himself not simply as the leader of the government-aligned parliamentary majority, but as a Speaker for the entire House. That distinction could prove crucial. The central question now is whether Jama can persuade opposition lawmakers that Parliament can serve as a forum for political compromise rather than another battleground between rival camps. The challenge is considerable. Many of the opposition MPs have longstanding political relationships with leaders of the Future Council and may remain closely aligned with the coalition’s broader strategy. Some are likely to be even more firmly opposed to the government than the senior figures leading the opposition. As a result, efforts to win over individual lawmakers could prove difficult if they are perceived as an attempt to divide the opposition rather than address its underlying grievances. For Jama, the more promising strategy may therefore be to focus on institutional reform, parliamentary independence and inclusive dialogue rather than political calculations. If he can demonstrate that opposition MPs will be heard, that parliamentary procedures will be applied fairly and that the House can exercise meaningful oversight regardless of political affiliation, he could gradually build the confidence necessary to bring rival factions closer together. Jama’s outreach also offers an opportunity to redefine the role of Somalia’s parliament at a time when public confidence in political institutions remains fragile. Rather than allowing Parliament to become an extension of the political confrontation outside the chamber, the new Speaker could seek to establish the House as a neutral arena where disagreements are debated, negotiated and resolved through constitutional procedures. The road ahead will not be easy. Yet if Jama succeeds where previous parliamentary leaders have struggled—by bringing government supporters and opposition lawmakers around the same table—his speakership could mark the beginning of a more united, effective and credible Somali parliament. For now, his decision to reach out to the opposition is a promising signal. The real test will be whether he can turn dialogue into trust, and trust into a parliament capable of representing Somalia rather than its political divisions. items.title: Kadib shaacinta natiijada imtixaanka qaranka, ra’iisul wasaare Xamza oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Hooyo Safiya Macallin Cabdulle Cumar iyo wiilkeeda Maxamed Ciise Daahir oo sannadkan kaalinta koowaad ka galay Imtixaanka Qaranka ee Dugsiyada Sare ee dalka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ugu hambalyeeyay Hooyo Safiya dadaalka iyo halganka ay u gashay barbaarinta iyo waxbarashada wiilkeeda, isagoo sheegay inay kaalinta koowaad kaga jirto Hooyooyinka Soomaaliyeed, halka Maxamed uu kaalinta koowaad kaga jiro ardayda Soomaaliyeed. Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa tilmaamay in guusha Maxamed ay ka dhalatay dadaalka uu sameeyay iyo garabkii uu ka helay hooyadii, isaga oo xusay in waalidku door muhiim ah ku leeyahay horumarka iyo waxbarashada carruurta. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay muhiimad gaar ah siineyso dadaalka ku aaddan waxbaridda carruurta iyo dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed, si bulshada loo gaarsiiyo isbeddel ku saleysan aqoon iyo xirfado. “Haddii tartan la galo in la guuleysto wax sahlan ma aha, runtii wax aad halkaas ku gaartay waa dadaalka iyo halganka aad muujisay iyo barbaarinta Hooyo Safiya. Waxa aan hubaa in dad badan oo kaa fursad badan maanta aad kaalinta koowaad uga horreysay, taasi waxa ay caddeyneysaa sida ay waalidiintu ugu dadaalaan ubadka,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa Hooyo Safiya ku abaalmariyay kaalinta qiimaha badan ee hooyonimo, isaga oo u magacaabay shaqaale rasmi ah oo dowladeed, taas oo qeyb ka ah abaalmarinta loo sameeyay dadaalka ay u gashay barbaarinta wiilkeeda. Sidoo kale, Maxamed Ciise Daahir oo kaalinta koowaad ka galay Imtixaanka Qaranka ee Dugsiyada Sare ayaa lagu abaalmariyay waxbarasho ay dowladda Soomaaliya daboolayso, iyadoo loo dirayo halka uu isagu codsado. items.title: Soomaaliya oo Muhiimadda Ganacsiga Afrika Kala Hadashay Xoghayaha Guud ee AfCFTA
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaam Cali, ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Xoghayaha Guud ee Xoghaynta Aagga Ganacsiga Xorta ah ee Qaaradda Afrika (AfCFTA), Mudane Wamkele Mene. Kulanka oo ka dhacay xarunta Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa looga hadlay hirgelinta heshiiska AfCFTA iyo doorka uu ka qaadan karo horumarinta ajandaha Midowga Afrika ee Agenda 2063. Xoghayaha Guud ee AfCFTA ayaa wasiirka warbixin ka siiyay howlaha iyo hirgelinta waajibaadka AfCFTA, halka Wasiir Cabdisalaam uu mar kale xaqiijiyay sida Soomaaliya uga go’an tahay ka mid noqoshada iyo ka faa’iideysiga heshiiska ganacsiga xorta ah ee qaaradda. Wasiirku wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay Soomaaliya u leedahay in ay ka faa’iideysato fursadaha AfCFTA, gaar ahaan dhinacyada ganacsiga, maalgashiga iyo is-dhexgalka dhaqaale ee qaaradda Afrika. Soomaaliya ayaa hore u ansixisay heshiiska AfCFTA, kaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu xoojiyo ganacsiga dalalka Afrika iyo isku-xirka suuqyada qaaradda.

items.title: Somali Airlines oo La Filayo Inay Dib u Shaqeyso Bisha Soo Socota
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Sida ay baahisay warbaahinta Bloomberg, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa qorsheynaysa in bisha soo socota ay dib u hawlgeliso shirkadda diyaaradaha qaranka ee Somali Airlines, oo hawada ka maqneyd tan iyo sanadkii 1991-kii. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay in shirkaddu ay dib u bilaabi doonto duulimaadyo toos ah, taas oo haddii ay hirgasho noqonaysa tallaabo lagu doonayo in dib loogu soo celiyo adeegga duulimaadyada qaranka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa dhowr jeer horey u shaacisay qorshayaal la xiriira dib u soo celinta Somali Airlines, balse qorshayaashaas qaar badan ma aysan noqon kuwo si buuxda u hirgala. Somali Airlines oo muddo dheer ka maqneyd saaxadda duulimaadyada ayaa ahayd shirkaddii diyaaradaha qaranka ee Soomaaliya, waxaana weli jira rajo iyo xiiso ay dad badan u qabaan in mar kale la arko diyaaradda oo duulimaadyo caalami ah sameyneysa. items.title: Somalia’s Top Student Wins Government Scholarship as Mother Lands State Job
items.description: MOGADISHU,— Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre has received Safiya Macallin Abdulle Omar and her son, Mohamed Issa Dahir, at his office in Mogadishu following Mohamed’s achievement of securing first place nationwide in this year’s National Secondary School Examination. During the meeting, the Prime Minister congratulated Mohamed on his exceptional academic performance and commended his mother for the dedication, perseverance and support she provided throughout his education. Prime Minister Barre said Mohamed’s success reflected not only his own determination and hard work, but also the important role played by his mother in his upbringing and academic development. He described Safiya’s efforts as an example of the contribution Somali parents can make to the educational success of their children. According to a statement issued by the Office of the Prime Minister, Barre reaffirmed the Federal Government’s commitment to education and to equipping Somali young people with the knowledge and skills required to contribute to the country’s development. “Achieving first place in a competitive national examination is no small accomplishment. It is the result of sustained effort, determination and the support you received from your mother,” the Prime Minister said. He noted that Mohamed’s achievement demonstrated how commitment and strong parental support can enable students to excel, even when others may have access to greater opportunities. In recognition of Safiya’s commitment to her son’s upbringing and education, the Prime Minister awarded her a permanent position within the Federal Government of Somalia. Mohamed, meanwhile, was awarded a fully funded scholarship by the Federal Government, which will enable him to continue his higher education at an institution and destination of his choice. The awards are part of the government’s broader effort to recognise academic excellence, encourage high-performing students and highlight the role of families in strengthening education and developing Somalia’s next generation. items.title: Kala Koriinshiyaha ka Jira Magaalada Muqdisho
items.description: Magaalada Muqdisho waa caasimadda kowaad ee Soomaaliya, waxaana ku nool dadyow aad u tiro badan, oo qiyaastii 5 milyan ku dhow, haddaysan ka badnayn. Dadkaasi dhinacyo badan ayay ku kala duwanyihiin oo aysan ka sinnayn, hadday noqoto dhinaca dhaqaalaha, waxbarashada, siyaasadda iyo dhinacyo kale oo badan. Waxaa intaas dheer in bulshada ku nool Muqdisho ay ku kala duwantahay habnololeedka iyo qaabka nolosha loo wajaho. Si guud, inta badan dadka Soomaaliyeed waa dad dhaqaale ahaan sabool ah; hasayeeshee, marka la joogo magaalada Muqdisho, kaladuwanaanshaha noloshu waa mid si weyn u jira. Dadka qaar waa kuwo ku nool dabaqad aad u hoosaysa; qaar baa ku nool dabaqad dhexe; qaar kalana waxay ku noolyihiin dabaqadda sare. Haddii aan dabaqadahaas kala qaadno, nolosha qofku waxay ku salaysantahay hadba dabaqadda uu bulshada kaga jiro. Tusaale ahaan, qofka magaalada Muqdisho ku nool ee lagu tiriyo inuu “ dabaqadda hoose ” ku jiro waa qof aan si joogto ah u helin wax uu nololmaalmeedkiisa ku dabbaro, oo maalin kasta u halgama sidii uu u heli lahaa quudka maalinlaha ah ee qoyskiisu u baahanyahay. Wax intaas dhaafsan ma soo galaan; waxaaba dhici karta in uu waayo quudkaas maalinlaha ah ee isaga ama qoyskiisu ku noolaan lahaayeen. Dhinaca kale, dadka qaar oo isu arka dabaq sare ayaa laga yaabaa in ay maalintii adeegsadaan xaddi lacageed oo qofka “dabaqadda hoose” lagu sheego uu bil dhan masruuf reereed ka dhigan lahaa. Waa sillan-sugan iyo isdiiddo yaab leh! Haddii aan u nimaadno dabaqadda dhexe, waa dadka heli kara nolol maalmeedkooda, isla markaasna maarayn kara aasaasiyaadka kale ee nolosha. Qofka dabaqadda dhexe ku nool wuu iskaafin karaa; waxa uu u baahanyahayna waa uu daberi karaa, hadday noqoto wixii uu cuni lahaa iyo waxbarashada uu xaadirayo. Nolosha qoyskiisana wuu kaafinayaa; waxa uu sidoo kale si caadi ah u daberi karaa joogistiisa magaalada iyo gaadiidkiisa. Dadka dabaqadda sare ku nool magaalada Muqdisho, iyaguna waa kuwa helay waxyaabaha noloshooda ugu muhiimsan iyo wixii ay rabeen. Intaas waxaa u sii dheer waxyaabo ka baxsan maaraynta baahiyahooda maalinlaha ah. Waxay leeyihiin kayd lacageed oo baahidooda ka baxsan iyo guryo ay furayaashooda gacanta ku hayaan. Uma qabaan baahi intaas dheer, laakiin waa hanti ay leeyihiin. Haddaba, annaga oo intaas maanka ku hayna, aan mid kasta si gaar ah u dul-istaagno. Haddii aan ka eegno dhinaca wada noolaanshaha, inta badan dadku waa kuwo noloshoodu isku tiirsantahay; saddexda dabaqadood ee aan soo tibaaxnay midna kan kale kama maarmi karto. Dhammaantood waxay ka wada shaqaynayaan sidii ay u heli lahaayeen ama u gaari lahaayeen hadafyadooda iyo danahooda gaarka ah. Hasayeeshee, waxaa jira kaladuwanaansho nololeed. Tusaale ahaan, dadka ku nool daafaha magaalada, ee baadigoobka ugu jira sidii ay u heli lahaayeen nololmaalmeedkooda caadiga ah, iyo kuwa ku nool magaalada dhexdeeda, ee gawaarida ku socda, guryo badanna furayaashooda sita, ma helaan amni isku mid ah. Inkastoo amniga magaalada guud ahaan uu soo hagaagayo, oo xaaladda maanta jirtaa aysan la mid ahayn tii shan sano ka hor, horumarkuna uu weli socdo, haddana labadaas qof ee aan soo sheegnay isku amni ma aha, iyaga oo weliba isla magaaladii jooga; waa sida aysan isku mid u ahayn amniga degmada Hodan iyo degaanka Weydoow. Dhinaca kale, haddii aan u fiirino degaanka, dadka ku nool dabaqadda dhexe waxaa ka mid ah kireystayaal laga yaabo inay hal guri oo magaalada dhexdeeda ah ku degganyihiin lacag u dhexaysa saddex boqol ilaa lix boqol bil kasta. Kiradaas waxaa u dheer kharashaadka kale ee nolosha, sida waxbarashada iyo cunnada. Dadkaas waxaa la mid ah kuwa ku nool guryo ay leeyihiin, oo aan degganayn degmooyinka dhinacyada ah, laakiin heli kara waxyaabaha ay u baahanyihiin. Dhibaatada iyaga haysata waa kharashka badan ee kaga baxa gaadiidka. Dadka kireystayaasha ahi waxa ay ku yara dhaamaan ayaa ah in aanay kharash ku bixin dhinaca guriga deganaanshihiisa. Dhinaca kale, magaalada Muqdisho waxaa ku sii badanaya dhismooyin casri ah oo saamayn weyn ku yeelanaya wada noolaanshaha bulshada. Tusaale ahaan, qofka dabaqadda hoose ku nool ee deggan guri caadi ah, haddii agagaarka gurigiisa laga dhiso dhismooyin waaweyn oo kiradoodu aad u qaali tahay, laguna soo dego, qofkaas waxaa culays ku noqonaya inuu xaafaddiisa si caadi ah ugu noolaado; adeegyadii uu markii hore raqiis ku heli karayna waxay isu beddeli karaan kuwo qaali ah oo dadkaas dartood loo sameeyo. Sideedaba, kharashka degaan kastaa waxa uu la jaanqaadaa dadka deggan. Tusaale ahaan, dadka magaalada dhexdeeda ama degmooyinka u dhow deggan iyo kuwa meelaha kale ee magaalada deggan ma aha kuwo adeegyada ay helayaan isku kharash ah. Waxaa laga yaabaa in dadka qaar hal shay ku helaan lacag raqiis ah, qaar kalana ay ku helaan lacag aad qaali u ah. Intaas waxa ay ka tarjumaysaa in degaannadu aad ugu kala duwanyihiin dhinaca helidda adeegyo macquul ah iyo amni dadka magaalada u wada siman. Haddaba, magaalada Muqdisho waxa ay u baahantahay in loo sameeyo qorshe degaan (urban planning) oo ka qaybqaata horumarinteeda, isla markaasna suurtageliya in la wada helo nolol isu dhow oo dadkeedu ku wada kori karaan. Waxaa habboon in magaalada laga wada helo dad kala duwan oo si isku mid ah u dareema amniga, si isku mid ahna u hela adeegyada lamahuraanka ah ee qof kastaa u baahanyahay.
items.fullContent: Magaalada Muqdisho waa caasimadda kowaad ee Soomaaliya, waxaana ku nool dadyow aad u tiro badan, oo qiyaastii 5 milyan ku dhow, haddaysan ka badnayn. Dadkaasi dhinacyo badan ayay ku kala duwanyihiin oo aysan ka sinnayn, hadday noqoto dhinaca dhaqaalaha, waxbarashada, siyaasadda iyo dhinacyo kale oo badan. Waxaa intaas dheer in bulshada ku nool Muqdisho ay ku kala duwantahay habnololeedka iyo qaabka nolosha loo wajaho. Si guud, inta badan dadka Soomaaliyeed waa dad dhaqaale ahaan sabool ah; hasayeeshee, marka la joogo magaalada Muqdisho, kaladuwanaanshaha noloshu waa mid si weyn u jira. Dadka qaar waa kuwo ku nool dabaqad aad u hoosaysa; qaar baa ku nool dabaqad dhexe; qaar kalana waxay ku noolyihiin dabaqadda sare. Haddii aan dabaqadahaas kala qaadno, nolosha qofku waxay ku salaysantahay hadba dabaqadda uu bulshada kaga jiro. Tusaale ahaan, qofka magaalada Muqdisho ku nool ee lagu tiriyo inuu “ dabaqadda hoose ” ku jiro waa qof aan si joogto ah u helin wax uu nololmaalmeedkiisa ku dabbaro, oo maalin kasta u halgama sidii uu u heli lahaa quudka maalinlaha ah ee qoyskiisu u baahanyahay. Wax intaas dhaafsan ma soo galaan; waxaaba dhici karta in uu waayo quudkaas maalinlaha ah ee isaga ama qoyskiisu ku noolaan lahaayeen. Dhinaca kale, dadka qaar oo isu arka dabaq sare ayaa laga yaabaa in ay maalintii adeegsadaan xaddi lacageed oo qofka “dabaqadda hoose” lagu sheego uu bil dhan masruuf reereed ka dhigan lahaa. Waa sillan-sugan iyo isdiiddo yaab leh! Haddii aan u nimaadno dabaqadda dhexe, waa dadka heli kara nolol maalmeedkooda, isla markaasna maarayn kara aasaasiyaadka kale ee nolosha. Qofka dabaqadda dhexe ku nool wuu iskaafin karaa; waxa uu u baahanyahayna waa uu daberi karaa, hadday noqoto wixii uu cuni lahaa iyo waxbarashada uu xaadirayo. Nolosha qoyskiisana wuu kaafinayaa; waxa uu sidoo kale si caadi ah u daberi karaa joogistiisa magaalada iyo gaadiidkiisa. Dadka dabaqadda sare ku nool magaalada Muqdisho, iyaguna waa kuwa helay waxyaabaha noloshooda ugu muhiimsan iyo wixii ay rabeen. Intaas waxaa u sii dheer waxyaabo ka baxsan maaraynta baahiyahooda maalinlaha ah. Waxay leeyihiin kayd lacageed oo baahidooda ka baxsan iyo guryo ay furayaashooda gacanta ku hayaan. Uma qabaan baahi intaas dheer, laakiin waa hanti ay leeyihiin. Haddaba, annaga oo intaas maanka ku hayna, aan mid kasta si gaar ah u dul-istaagno. Haddii aan ka eegno dhinaca wada noolaanshaha, inta badan dadku waa kuwo noloshoodu isku tiirsantahay; saddexda dabaqadood ee aan soo tibaaxnay midna kan kale kama maarmi karto. Dhammaantood waxay ka wada shaqaynayaan sidii ay u heli lahaayeen ama u gaari lahaayeen hadafyadooda iyo danahooda gaarka ah. Hasayeeshee, waxaa jira kaladuwanaansho nololeed. Tusaale ahaan, dadka ku nool daafaha magaalada, ee baadigoobka ugu jira sidii ay u heli lahaayeen nololmaalmeedkooda caadiga ah, iyo kuwa ku nool magaalada dhexdeeda, ee gawaarida ku socda, guryo badanna furayaashooda sita, ma helaan amni isku mid ah. Inkastoo amniga magaalada guud ahaan uu soo hagaagayo, oo xaaladda maanta jirtaa aysan la mid ahayn tii shan sano ka hor, horumarkuna uu weli socdo, haddana labadaas qof ee aan soo sheegnay isku amni ma aha, iyaga oo weliba isla magaaladii jooga; waa sida aysan isku mid u ahayn amniga degmada Hodan iyo degaanka Weydoow. Dhinaca kale, haddii aan u fiirino degaanka, dadka ku nool dabaqadda dhexe waxaa ka mid ah kireystayaal laga yaabo inay hal guri oo magaalada dhexdeeda ah ku degganyihiin lacag u dhexaysa saddex boqol ilaa lix boqol bil kasta. Kiradaas waxaa u dheer kharashaadka kale ee nolosha, sida waxbarashada iyo cunnada. Dadkaas waxaa la mid ah kuwa ku nool guryo ay leeyihiin, oo aan degganayn degmooyinka dhinacyada ah, laakiin heli kara waxyaabaha ay u baahanyihiin. Dhibaatada iyaga haysata waa kharashka badan ee kaga baxa gaadiidka. Dadka kireystayaasha ahi waxa ay ku yara dhaamaan ayaa ah in aanay kharash ku bixin dhinaca guriga deganaanshihiisa. items.title: Trump Administration Announces Additional Support Following Colombia Earthquake
items.description: Trump Administration Announces Additional Support Following Colombia Earthquake Office of the Spokesperson The Trump Administration is leading a life-saving response to the devastating 7.4 magnitude earthquake that struck Colombia on August 10. Today, the Department of State is announcing $11 million in additional humanitarian assistance, bringing the total U.S. assistance following the earthquake to $26.5 million. The Department is also leveraging support from the U.S. Department of War (DoW) U.S. Southern Command (SOUTHCOM) to transport relief supplies from the Department of State’s Miami prepositioning warehouse to Colombia. The State Department continues to coordinate with Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella and the Colombian government to assess and respond to earthquake-related needs. Additional Life-Saving Humanitarian Assistance The Department of State is mobilizing a total of $26.5 million – including today’s announcement of an additional $11 million – in humanitarian food, health, protection and shelter assistance, in addition to post-earthquake structural assessments through trusted partners, including Catholic Relief Services (CRS), the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, the International Organization for Migration (IOM), Miyamoto International, UNICEF, the UN World Food Program (WFP), and World Vision. Of the initial $15.5 million in assistance announced on August 11, $3 million provided through CRS draws from the previously announced CRS global assistance award . Additionally, as part of the Department’s $3.8 billion contribution to the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) announced earlier this year, the United States provided $200 million to the Colombia Pooled Fund, which OCHA can use to address earthquake-related needs as well as preexisting humanitarian needs in Colombia. Leveraging DoW Support to Deliver Relief Supplies The Department of State is also leveraging support from SOUTHCOM to transport relief supplies from the Department’s Miami prepositioning warehouse to Colombia. The first of the planned flights is scheduled to depart Homestead Air Force Base in Florida’s Miami-Dade County today, carrying shelter and water and hygiene supplies. Upon arrival in Colombia, IOM and WFP will receive the supplies and oversee last-mile distribution to Colombians impacted by the earthquake. Today’s flight will include hundreds of Starlink kits that will provide reliable, high-speed internet to many humanitarian organizations and the Colombian government to facilitate their relief efforts. The delivery of these kits will occur in coordination with the State Department, following the disaster response coordination memorandum of understanding signed between Starlink and the Department earlier this summer. Arrival of Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) Technical Support Teams In coordination with the Colombian government, the Department of State activated and deployed two USAR technical support teams from the fire departments of Fairfax County, Virginia, and Los Angeles County, California. These teams arrived in Colombia on August 12 and are providing USAR coordination, communications, and structural engineering support to Colombian government-led search and rescue operations. Supporting Americans in Colombia The Trump Administration has no higher priority than the safety and security of Americans. The State Department is working tirelessly to provide consular assistance to U.S. citizens and their families in the affected areas. Americans in Colombia should enroll in the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP) at STEP.state.gov to receive safety and security updates from the U.S. Embassy. They should follow @TravelGov and @USEmbassyBogota on social media for the latest information. The Department’s Bureau of Consular Affairs maintains a call center for Americans seeking information or assistance in connection with the Colombia earthquake: call 888-407-4747 from within the United States or Canada, or +1 202-501-4444 from all other locations.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo safar dhulka ku gaaray Gaalkacyo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta gaaray koonfurta Gaalkacyo ee gobolka Mudug, xilli uu safar dhulka ah ku marayo deegaannada maamulka Galmudug. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa galabta la hadli doono dadweynaha. Waxaa sidoo kale la abaabulay isu-soo-bax lagu taageerayo madaxweynaha. Puntland ayaa si weyn u adkeysay ammaanka dhinaceeda magaalada Gaalkacyo, iyadoo la hakiyay isku-socodka labada dhinac ee magaalada. Maamulka ayaa socdaalka madaxweynaha ku tilmaantay mid abuuri kara qalalaase, waxayna heegan galisay ciidamadeeda. Xasan Sheekh iyo madaxda Dowladda Federaalka ayaa xilligan ku guda jira abaabul siyaasadeed oo la xiriira doorashada Galmudug, gaar ahaan ololaha JSP, iyadoo dowladda ay sidoo kale waddo abaabul ciidan oo ay sheegtay in looga gol leeyahay la-dagaallanka kooxda Al-Shabaab. Magaalada Gaalkacyo waxaa sidoo kale ku sugan Madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni, kaas oo halkaasi ka wada kulamo uu la yeelanayo bulshada iyo dhinacyada siyaasadda, xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka. Ka hor inta uusan soo gaarin Gaalkacyo, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo uu wehliyo hoggaamiyaha Galmudug, Axmed Qoor-Qoor ayaa waxaa si heer sare ah loogu soo dhoweeyay magaalada Bandiiradleey ee gobolka Mudug, halkaasi oo ay isugu soo baxeen boqolaal ka mid ah shacabka magaalada. Booqashada Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee magaalada Bandiiradleey ayaa qayb ka ah safarkiisa nabadda iyo u kuur-galka nolosha bulshada Galmudug, kaas oo uu ku marayo degmooyin iyo deegaanno ka tirsan Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, sida ay sheegtay Villa Soomaaliya. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa si dhow ugu kuur-galaya xaaladda nololeed, amniga iyo horumarka bulshada ee deegaanada uu booqanayo. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa uga mahadceliyay maamulka iyo shacabka magaalada Bandiiradleey soo dhoweynta diirran ee ay u sameeyeen isaga iyo wafdiga uu hoggaaminayo, waxa uuna ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta wadajirka bulshada, amniga iyo horumarka deegaanka. The post Xasan Sheekh oo safar dhulka ku gaaray Gaalkacyo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: In ka badan 150 Soomaali ah oo deeqo waxbarasho ka helay dowladda Shiinaha
items.description: In ka badan 150 Soomaali ah ayaa sanadkan helay deeqo waxbarasho oo ay bixisay dowladda Shiinaha, taas oo noqotay tiradii ugu badnayd ee abid hal mar la siiyo arday iyo shaqaale Soomaali ah. Safiirka Shiinaha u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Wang Yu, ayaa tiradan ku dhawaaqay munaasabad ka dhacday Muqdisho, halkaas oo lagu maamuusay ardayda ku guuleysatay deeqaha waxbarasho. Safiirku wuxuu sheegay in tirada Soomaalida loo dirayo Shiinaha waxbarashada iyo tababarrada milatari ay sanadkan gaartay heerkii ugu sarreeyay, iyadoo tani ay tahay sannadkii labaad oo xiriir ah oo la diiwaangeliyo koror weyn. Barnaamijka deeqaha waxbarasho ayaa dib loo bilaabay iyadoo kooxdii ugu horreysay ay ka koobnayd 16 arday Soomaali ah, halka sanadkan tiradu ka badan tahay 150 qof. Ardayda ayaa fursad u heli doona inay Shiinaha ka bartaan takhasusyo kala duwan, oo ay ka mid yihiin caafimaadka, injineernimada, maamulka iyo culuumta kale, halka qaar ka mid ah Soomaalida ay sidoo kale qaadanayaan tababbarro milatari. Safiirka Wang Yu ayaa ardayda kula dardaarmay inay si wanaagsan uga faa’iideystaan fursadda, waxbarashadana xoogga saaraan, isla markaana xiriirro wanaagsan la sameystaan bulshada Shiinaha. Munaasabadda ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo bandhigay guulo ay gaareen arday Soomaali ah oo hadda wax ka barata jaamacadaha Shiinaha, kuwaas oo qaarkood ku guuleystay tartamada hal-abuurka iyo abaalmarinno dhinaca waxbarashada ah.

items.title: Habraaca baadhitaanka shilalka korontada oo la ansixiyay
items.description: Komishanka Nidaaminta Korontada Qaranka JSL ayaa ansixiyey Habraaca baadhitaanka shilalka korontada, kaasi oo sida ay sheegeen lagu hagi doono shirkadaha bixiya adeega korantada ka dib fadhi ay shakat guddigu ku yeesheen xafiiska guddiga ee magaaladda Hargaysa. Habraaca baadhitaanka shilalka korontada oo falanqayntiisu muddo ay soo soo socotay waxa loo raacayaa sida guddigu ay sheegeen habkii loo baadhi lahaa shilalka korantada ee ka dhaca guud aan geyiga JSL, habraacan ayaa noqonaya kii koobaad ee ay ansixiyaan dhamaan komishanadii dalka soo maray. “Waxa loo raacayaa habkii loo baadhi lahaa shilalka korantada ee ka dhaca guud aan dalka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, waa habraacii koobaad ee kimishanadii dalka soo maray ay ansixiyaan” ayuu yidhi gudomiye ku xigeenka komishanka nidaaminta tamarta qaranka JSL, Geedu Saleebaan Cali. Shilalka ka dhasha korantada ayaa mararka qaar keena khasaare iskugu jira Naf iyo maal waxana habraacan ku shaqayn doona guddiga cabashooyinka oo qayb ka ah komishanka nidaaminta korantada qaranka. Ansixinta Habraaca Baadhitaanka Shilalka Korontada ee Komishanka Nidaaminta Korontada Qaranka JSL waa tallaabo muhiim ah oo mudan in la bogaadiyo, maadaama ay abuurayso hannaan rasmi ah oo lagu baadho laguna qiimeeyo shilalka korontada ee ka dhaca guud ahaan dalka. items.title: Sanbaloolshe: In Shabaab lala safto ma aha arrin la aqbali karo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Agaasimihii hore ee Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka, Cabdullahi Maxamed Cali (Sanbaloolshe) oo qoraal soo saaray ayaa ka fal-celiyay dagaalkii maanta magaalada Baydhabo, kaas oo la sheegay inay ka qayb-qaateen maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab oo “la saftay ciidanka taabacsan Lafta-gareen”, sida ay sheegtay dowladda Soomaaliya. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa lagu sheegay in weerarka ka dhacay Baydhabo ay soo qaadeen maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab iyo ciidamo taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen, isla markaana ay adeegsadeen gaadiid laga soo buuxiyay walxaha qarxa, balse ay fashiliyeen ciidamada ammaanka, ayna gaarsiiyeen khasaare culus. Intaas kadib, waxaa soo hadlay Cabdullahi Maxamed Cali (Sanbaloolshe) oo hadda kamid ah xubnaha mucaaradka, kaas oo shaaca ka qaaday in mucaaradnimadu tahay xaq siyaasadeed oo dastuuri ah, balse aan la aqbali karin in Khawaarijta lagu garab siiyo dagaalka ay kula jirto dowladda Soomaaliya. “In Shabaab lala safto ama lagu garab siiyo dagaalka ay kula jiraan dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed ma ahan siyaasad mucaaradnimo, mana aha arrin ay bulshada Soomaaliyeed aqbali karto. Mabda’ ahaana, mucaaradnimadu waa xaq siyaasadeed oo dastuuri ah, balse marnaba ma noqon karto cudurdaar lagu taageero, laguna garab istaago amaba lagu fududeeyo falalka argagixiso ee Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish,’ ayuu yiri Sanbaloolshe,” ayuu yiri Sanbaloolshe. Waxaa kale uu intaas kusii daray “Haddaba, gunaanadkeygu waa in qof, koox ama qabiil midna u heli karin wax cudurdaar ah inuu Al-Shabaab garab siiyo, ku taageero ama u fududeeyo falalkooda argagixiso. Yaan loo ogolaan guul stratijiyadeed AS”. Sanbaloolshe ayaa sidoo kale farriin u diray guud ahaan dadka Soomaaliyeed, wuxuuna ugu baaqay inay meel uga soo wada jeestaan argagixisada, ayna garab siiyaan Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee ku jira halganka adag. “Haddii aan nahay Soomaali meel aan joognaba, waxaa waajib ah in dowladda, dhammaan xoogagga mucaaradka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay mabda’ ahaan ku midoobaan in Al-Shabaab iyo dhammaan kooxaha argagixisada ahi ay yihiin cadawga dalka iyo dadka Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu mar kale yiri ku yiri qoraalkiisa. Si kastaba, ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay dhanka kooxda Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo ku aadan edeynta loo jeediyay, kadib dagaalkii maanta ee Baydhabo, kaas oo dib loogu celiyay maleeshiyaadkii weerarka soo qaaday. The post Sanbaloolshe: In Shabaab lala safto ma aha arrin la aqbali karo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo gaaray Gaalkacyo
items.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa gaaray magaalada Gaalkacyo, gaar ahaan dhanka koonfureed ee magaalada, kaddib socdaal dhulka ah oo uu ku marayay deegaanno ka tirsan Galmudug. Madaxweynaha ayaa la filayaa inuu galabta la hadlo bulshada magaalada Gaalkacyo, iyadoo loo diyaariyay munaasabad lagu soo dhaweynayo iyo isu-soobax ka dhacaya Garoonka Ciyaaraha Gaalkacyo. Booqashada Madaxweynaha ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli magaalada Gaalkacyo ay ka jirto xiisad siyaasadeed iyo mid amni, iyadoo Puntland ay si weyn u adkaysay ammaanka dhankeeda magaalada. Dhanka kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo Puntland ayaa siyaabo kala duwan uga hadlay xaaladda magaalada, iyadoo Puntland ay walaac ka muujisay socdaalka Madaxweynaha, halka Galmudug ay sheegtay in booqashadu tahay mid uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh xaq u leeyahay. Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa isna ku sugan Gaalkacyo, halkaas oo uu kulamo siyaasadeed iyo bulsho ka wado.

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Shaqo siisay Hooyadii dhashay Ardaygii kaalinta 1-aad ka galay Imtixaanka Qaranka
items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya — Wasiirka Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Danjire Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, ayaa shaqo siisay Hooyo Safiyo Macalin Cabdulle Cumar, oo ah hooyada dhashay Maxamed Ciise Daahir Yuusuf, ardaygii kaalinta koowaad ka galay Imtixaanka Shahaadiga Dugsiyada Sare ee Soomaaliya. Wasiiradda ayaa maanta xafiiskeeda ku qaabishay Hooyo Safiyo iyo wiilkeeda Maxamed Ciise, iyadoo ku ammaanay dadaalka, dulqaadka iyo garab istaagga ay hooyadu u muujisay wiilkeeda intii uu ku guda jiray waxbarashada. Khadiija Al-Makhzoumi ayaa sheegtay in Hooyo Safiyo ay tusaale wanaagsan u tahay hooyooyinka Soomaaliyeed ee u taagan horumarinta iyo waxbarashada ubadkooda. Waxay sidoo kale xustay in wasaaraddu ay garowsan tahay doorka muhiimka ah ee hooyooyinka Soomaaliyeed. Sidaas darteed, Wasiiraddu waxay Hooyo Safiyo siisay fursad shaqo oo ka bilaabanaysa maanta, iyadoo sheegtay in tallaabadan loogu talagalay inay gacan ka geysato horumarinta nolosheeda iyo sii wadista waxbarashada carruurteeda. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale diiradda lagu saaray taariikhda iyo halganka nololeed ee Hooyo Safiyo iyo wiilkeeda, kuwaas oo Wasiiraddu si dhow uga dhageysatay xaaladdooda iyo dadaalkii horseeday guusha Maxamed Ciise.

Sida ay sheegeen ilo ka tirsan Villa Soomaaliya, Madaxweynaha ayaa galabta la filayaa inuu dadweynaha kula hadlo Garoonka Ciyaaraha GM, iyadoo halkaasi laga abaabulay isu-soobax lagu soo dhoweynayo. Dhanka kale, Puntland ayaa adkaysay ammaanka dhankeeda magaalada Gaalkacyo, iyadoo la sheegay in la hakiyay isu-socodka labada dhinac ee magaalada. Puntland ayaa socdaalka madaxda Dowladda Federaalka ku tilmaantay mid qalalaase abuuri kara, waxaana la kordhiyay heeganka ciidamada. Madaxda Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale wada abaabul ciidan oo ay ku sheegtay inuu yahay howlgal ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab, iyadoo xukuumaddu dhinaca kale taageero siyaasadeed ka waddo doorashada Galmudug. Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka ayaa weli isku haya arrimo siyaasadeed oo ay kamid yihiin doorashooyinka dalka iyo ciidamada, iyadoo Puntland ay deegaannadeeda ka saartay ciidamo federaal ah. Madaxweyne Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa isna ku sugan Gaalkacyo, halkaas oo uu ka wado kulamo bulsho iyo siyaasadeed. Sida wararka lagu helayo, xaaladda Gaalkacyo ayaa ah mid xasaasi ah, iyadoo magaalada ay hadda u muuqato inay si weyn ugu kala qeybsan tahay dhaqdhaqaaqyada siyaasadeed ee labada dhinac. items.title: Xasan, Siciid iyo Axmed: Sidee Loollankoodu u Saameynayaa Soomaaliya?
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Socdaalka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee Gaalkacyo, joogitaanka Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ee gobolka Mudug, iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada siyaasadeed ee Madaxweynaha Jubbaland Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe) ayaa dhammaantood kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay ku jirto marxalad siyaasadeed oo xasaasi ah. Loollanka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya hoggaamiyeyaashan ayaa ku soo aadaya xilli dalka uu wajahayo caqabado badan oo dhinaca amniga, siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha iyo xiriirka dowladda dhexe iyo dowlad-goboleedyada ah. Saddexdan hoggaamiye waxay kamid yihiin siyaasiyiinta muddada dheer saameynta ku lahaa siyaasadda Soomaaliya. Mid kasta wuxuu hadda qorayaa bog kamid ah taariikhda siyaasadeed ee dalka, waxaana mustaqbalka lagu qiimeyn doonaa waxa uu qabtay iyo jihada uu dalku u qaaday. Loollanku Soomaaliya Sidee Ayuu U Saameynayaa? Soomaaliya waxay maanta ku jirtaa marxalad ka duwan tii hore. Isbeddellada ka socda dunida, hoos u dhaca taageerada caalamiga ah iyo soo baxa dano cusub oo shisheeye ayaa si toos ah u saameyn kara mustaqbalka dalka. Soomaaliya weli ma gaarin isku-filnaansho buuxa oo dhinacyada dhaqaalaha iyo amniga, kuwaas oo laf-dhabar u ah jiritaanka dowlad awood leh. Xaaladdan ayaa sii adkaan karta haddii khilaafka siyaasadeed uu noqdo mid mudnaanta koowaad la siiyo, iyadoo laga tagayo wadatashi qaran iyo qorsheyaal lagu xoojinayo dowladnimada. Mas’uuliyadda ugu weyn waxay marka hore saaran tahay Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, maadaama uu yahay Madaxweynaha dalka. Waxaa looga baahan yahay inuu raadiyo hannaan lagu yareyn karo khilaafka siyaasadeed, laguna ilaalin karo midnimada dalka. Arrintaas waxaa saldhig u noqon kara Dastuurka, shuruucda dalka, wada-hadal iyo isku-tanaasul siyaasadeed. Tallaabooyinka ciidan, cadaadisyada siyaasadeed iyo tallaabooyin kale oo aan si taxaddar leh loo maareyn waxay kordhin karaan xiisadda, waxayna fursad siin karaan dhinacyo kale oo dano gaar ah ka leh Soomaaliya. Sidee Looga Bixi Karaa Xaaladdan? Si loo helo jiho siyaasadeed oo xasilloon, waxaa muhiim ah in hoggaamiyeyaasha dowladda Federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyadu ay helaan meel dhexe oo wada-hadal iyo kalsooni lagu dhiso. Danaha qaranka waa in laga hormariyaa danaha siyaasadeed ee shaqsiyaadka iyo kooxaha. Sidoo kale, bulshada Soomaaliyeed waxay leedahay door muhiim ah. Odayaasha dhaqanka, aqoonyahannada, culimada, dhallinyarada iyo haweenka waa inay ka qeyb qaataan sidii loo abuuri lahaa aragti qaran oo ka madax-bannaan loollanka siyaasadeed ee madaxda. Haddii khilaafka siyaasadeed uu sii qoto dheeraado, waxaa kordhi kara khatarta ah in xiisaddu isu beddesho isku dhac gudaha ah, kala fogaansho siyaasadeed iyo faragelin shisheeye. Ugu dambeyn, su’aasha ugu muhiimsan ma aha oo keliya yaa ku guuleysanaya loollanka Xasan Sheekh, Siciid Deni iyo Axmed Madoobe? Su’aasha dhabta ah waa: Maxay Soomaaliya ka helaysaa haddii loollankoodu sii socdo? Taasi waa su’aasha ay tahay in dhammaan dhinacyadu ka jawaabaan ka hor inta aysan siyaasadda dalka u horseedin xaalad aan si fudud looga soo kaban karin. items.title: Sawirro: Koonfur Galbeed oo soo bandhigtay maxaabiis lagu qabtay dagaalkii Baydhabo
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidanka Birmadka Booliiska Gaarka ah ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa maanta magaalada Baydhabo ku soo bandhigay maxaabiis tiro badan oo lagu soo qabtay howlgallo ay ka sameeyeen magaalada iyo bannaankeeda, kadib dagaal culus oo ka dhacay halkaasi. Maxaabiista lasoo bandhigayo oo labaatameeyo ah ayaa kamid ah ciidamada taabacsanaa Lafta-gareen ee saaka weerar kusoo qaaday magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Ragga la soo bandhigay waxaa ka mid ah nin magaciisa lagu sheegay Macallin Aadan, oo Koonfur Galbeed ay sheegtay inuu ku lug lahaa falal dhibaato iyo amni-darro oo saameyn ku yeeshay bulshada ku dhaqan magaaladaasi. Koonfur Galbeed waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in howlgalka uu sii socon doono inta laga soo afjarayo kooxaha habeysan ee weli ku sugan duleedka magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay. Dagaalkii saaka ayaa dhaliyay khasaare xooggan, waxaana ka qayb qaadatay ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya oo ka hortagay weerarka ay soo qaadeen ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen, kuwaas oo dib loo celiyay, sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Gaashaanshigga Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale,Wasaaradda oo war-saxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa shaacisay in howlgalka lagu dilay ugu yaraan illaa 30 ka tirsanaa ragga weerarka soo qaaday, lagana soo furtay hub iyo gaadiid dagaal, sida lagu caddeeyay warsaxaafadeedka. “Intii uu socday iska-horimaadka, Ciidanka XDS ayaa dilay ku dhowaad 30 ka mid ah maleeshiyadkii weerarka soo qaaday, halka qaar kalena nololsha lagu qabtay. Ciidammada ayaa sidoo kale gacanta ku dhigay hub iyo gaadiid ay wateen kooxihii weerarka soo qaaday,” ayuu kusii daray qoraalka. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed ayaa weli sii wada howlgal lagu xaqiijinayo amniga magaalada, laguna baacsanayo firxadka maleeshiyadka weerarka soo qaaday oo la sheegay inay ku dhuumaalaysanayaan qeyb ka mid magaalada Baydhabo. The post Sawirro: Koonfur Galbeed oo soo bandhigtay maxaabiis lagu qabtay dagaalkii Baydhabo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wasiir Khadiija oo Shaqo U Ballanqaadday Hooyada Ardaygii Kaalinta 1-aad Galay
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Wasiirka Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka XFS, Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, ayaa xafiiskeeda ku qaabishay Hooyo Safiyo Macallin Cabdulle Cumar, oo ah hooyada dhashay, isla markaana si weyn u garab istaagtay Maxamed Ciise Daahir Yuusuf, oo kaalinta 1-aad ka galay Imtixaanka Shahaadiga Dugsiyada Sare ee Soomaaliya. Wasiiradda ayaa Hooyo Safiyo ku ammaantay dadaalka iyo adkeysiga ay muujisay muddadii ay garab taagnayd wiilkeeda, iyadoo sheegtay inay tusaale wanaagsan u tahay dadaalka iyo kaalinta hooyooyinka Soomaaliyeed ee horumarka ubadkooda. Wasiiradda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Wasaaraddu ay garowsan tahay doorka muhiimka ah ee hooyooyinka, sidaas darteedna ay Hooyo Safiyo siisay fursad shaqo laga bilaabo maanta, si ay uga sii shaqeyso horumarinta nolosheeda iyo waxbarashada ubadkeeda. Ugu dambeyn, Wasiir Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi ayaa u rajeysay Maxamed Ciise Daahir Yuusuf mustaqbal ifaya iyo guulo waaweyn oo uu ka gaaro waxbarashadiisa, iyadoo hambalyo u dirtay dhammaan ardayda Soomaaliyeed ee ku guuleystay Imtixaanka Shahaadiga Dugsiyada Sare. Wasiiraddu waxay carrabka ku adkeysay in guusha ubadku ay ka dhalato dadaalka, dulqaadka iyo garab istaagga waalidka, gaar ahaan hooyooyinka Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Hassan Sheikh Receives Warm Welcome During Galinsoor Visit
items.description: GALGADUUD— President of the Federal Republic of Somalia, Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, has arrived in Galinsoor town in the Galgaduud region as part of his ongoing visit to areas across Galmudug State. President Mohamud, accompanied by Galmudug State President Ahmed Abdi Kariye (Qoorqoor), received a warm welcome from hundreds of residents who lined the streets of Galinsoor to greet the delegation. Addressing members of the public at an open gathering, President Mohamud called on local communities to prioritise the preservation of peace, stability and peaceful coexistence. He stressed the importance of strengthening unity among communities and ensuring that Galinsoor remains a safe and peaceful area where all Somali communities living in the town and surrounding areas can coexist in a spirit of brotherhood, mutual respect and cooperation. The President’s visit comes as part of broader engagements with communities in Galmudug, focusing on peace, reconciliation, security and strengthening relations between the Federal Government and local populations. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay dagaalka culus ee ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Ugu yaraan 25 qof oo ay ku jiraan dad rayid ah ayaa ku dhintay dagaal culus oo saaka ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Goboka Baay. Dhowr qarax ayaa laga maqlay bannaanada magaalada, ka hor inta aanu dagaalka ku soo fidin bartamaha Baydhabo, iyadoo dagaalku uu si weyn u saameeyay amniga iyo xasilloonida magaalada. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Booliska Sida Gaarka ah u tababaran ee Haramcad iyo Booliska Baydhabo ayaa la arkayay, iyagoo gudaha magaalada kula dagaalamaya rag ku labisan dareyska Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed, balse sheegtay in ay taabacsan yihiin Madaxweynihii Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ee awoodda laga tuuray 30-kii bishii March. Goobjoogeyaasha ayaa sheegay in ciidamadii ku sugnaa magaalada ay u suurtagashay inay dibadda uga saaraan ciidamadii kale ee soo weeraray. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa sheegay inay ciidamadu fashiliyeen weerar ay maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ku soo qaadeen Baydhabo. Taliska ayaa warsaxaafadeed ku sheegay in Shabaabku ay muddooyinkii dambe wadeen isku dayo uu ujeedkoodu ahaa inay ku qalqalgeliyaan amniga magaaladaasi. Hase yeeshee Afhayeenkii hore ee Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed, Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed ayaa sheegay in Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ay yihiin kuwa weeraray magaalada, isagoo meesha ka saaray in Daraawiishta iyo Al Shabaab ay si wadajir ah u weerareen magaaladaasi. Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur Galbeed, Isaaq Maxamed Isaaq (Koosaar) ayaa sheegay in ay gacanta ku hayaan maxaabiis, oo isugu jira buu yiri Daraawiish iyo Al Shabaab nool. “Marka wax intaas ka weyn oo caddeymo ah inaan aragno muhiim ma ahan.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka oo ka jawaabayay su’aal ahayd, waxa ay ku caddayn karaan in dagaalka ay ku lug lahaayeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dhaawacyada tobanaan qof oo u badan dhinacyadii dagaalamay ayaa la kala geeyay isbitaalada ku yaala magaalada, iyadoona dhaawacyada ugu badan xaaladdooda lagu la tacaalayo Isbitaal Goboleedka Baay. Waa weerarkii labaad ee ceynkiisa ah ee ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen ay ka gaystaan Magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoo weerarkan midkii ka horreyay ay sidaan oo kale ugu galeen magaaladaasi, 30-kii bishii May.

Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa sheegay inay ciidamadu fashiliyeen weerar ay maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ku soo qaadeen Baydhabo. Taliska ayaa warsaxaafadeed ku sheegay in Shabaabku ay muddooyinkii dambe wadeen isku dayo uu ujeedkoodu ahaa inay ku qalqalgeliyaan amniga magaaladaasi. Hase yeeshee Afhayeenkii hore ee Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed, Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed ayaa sheegay in Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ay yihiin kuwa weeraray magaalada, isagoo meesha ka saaray in Daraawiishta iyo Al Shabaab ay si wadajir ah u weerareen magaaladaasi. Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur Galbeed, Isaaq Maxamed Isaaq (Koosaar) ayaa sheegay in ay gacanta ku hayaan maxaabiis, oo isugu jira buu yiri Daraawiish iyo Al Shabaab nool. “Marka wax intaas ka weyn oo caddeymo ah inaan aragno muhiim ma ahan.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka oo ka jawaabayay su’aal ahayd, waxa ay ku caddayn karaan in dagaalka ay ku lug lahaayeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dhaawacyada tobanaan qof oo u badan dhinacyadii dagaalamay ayaa la kala geeyay isbitaalada ku yaala magaalada, iyadoona dhaawacyada ugu badan xaaladdooda lagu la tacaalayo Isbitaal Goboleedka Baay. Waa weerarkii labaad ee ceynkiisa ah ee ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen ay ka gaystaan Magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoo weerarkan midkii ka horreyay ay sidaan oo kale ugu galeen magaaladaasi, 30-kii bishii May.

items.title: Somali troops push militiamen out of Baidoa after fierce fighting
items.description: Somali federal troops drove opposition forces out of ‌one of the country’s biggest cities, Baidoa, on Monday, following heavy clashes that left many people dead, residents told Reuters. Baidoa, which is home to hundreds of thousands of people displaced by conflict and hunger ​in other areas, was shaken by hours of fighting between the federal soldiers ​and opposition forces loyal to the former president of South West state, ⁠Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. Residents said the clashes in the city centre on Monday were the ​fiercest since March, when federal forces seized control of Baidoa after Laftagareen’s administration said it was ​severing ties with the federal government. Laftagareen then resigned from office. Already struggling to contain a two-decade-old insurgency by the al Shabaab militant group and stave off famine, the federal government has been facing growing ​armed resistance from state governments. State authorities have rejected Mogadishu’s influence over state elections and rejected constitutional changes ​they say concentrate power in the hands of the executive. Somalia’s defence ministry said in a statement that ‌troops ⁠in Baidoa had come under attack before dawn by fighters using vehicles laden with explosives. It said its forces had driven the assailants out of Baidoa, killing about 30 of them. Videos posted on social media and verified by Reuters showed federal soldiers firing from the ​back of an armoured ​vehicle and people carrying ⁠injured civilians through the streets. Four Baidoa residents said federal troops had driven the opposition fighters out of town, and reported seeing dead ​bodies. “I saw 10 dead people including four civilians and six soldiers ​from both ⁠groups,” local elder Farah Ibrahim told Reuters. Laftagareen’s camp, which earlier in the morning said on Facebook that its forces had captured the city centre, could not be immediately reached for comment. Baidoa ⁠faces a ​dire humanitarian crisis, with one in four children at ​its displacement sites severely malnourished, according to a July survey by the French medical charity Medecins Sans Frontieres. Reuters.

items.title: DF oo shaacisay in ciidanka Laftagareen ay adeegsadeen gaadiid qaraxyo lagu soo raray
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya oo warsaxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa ka hadashay dagaalkii saaka ka dhacay magaalada Baydhabo, iyada oo sheegtay in weerarka ay soo qaadeen maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab iyo ciidamo taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Wasaaradda ayaa weerarka ku tilmaamtay mid argagixiso, waxayna shaacisay in maleeshiyaadka duulaanka soo qaaday ay adeegsadeen gaadiid laga soo buuxiyay walxaha qarxa, balse ay fashiliyeen ciidamada ammaanka, isla markaana ay gaarsiiyeen khasaare culus. “Abaaro 5:00 subaxnimo, fariisimo ay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ku leeyihiin magaalada Baydhabo waxaa weerar ku soo qaaday maleeshiyada isugu jira Al-Shabaab iyo kuwa taabacsan Cabdicasis Laftagareen, kuwaas oo weerarka u adeegsaday gaadiid laga soo buuxiyay walxaha qarxa. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa si xirfad iyo geesinimo leh uga hortagay weerarka, iyagoo fashiliyay qorshihii kooxaha weerarka soo qaaday ee ahaa inay qalqal geliyaan amniga iyo xasilloonida magaalada Baydhabo,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Sidoo kale, Wasaaradda ayaa shaacisay in howlgalka lagu dilay ugu yaraan illaa 30 ka tirsanaa ragga weerarka soo qaaday, lagana furtay hub iyo gaadiid dagaal, sida lagu caddeeyay warsaxaafadeedka. “Intii uu socday iska-horimaadka, Ciidanka XDS ayaa dilay ku dhowaad 30 ka mid ah maleeshiyadkii weerarka soo qaaday, halka qaar kalena nololsha lagu qabtay. Ciidammada ayaa sidoo kale gacanta ku dhigay hub iyo gaadiid ay wateen kooxihii weerarka soo qaaday,” ayuu kusii daray qoraalka l. Dhanka kale Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa weli sii wada howlgal lagu xaqiijinayo amniga magaalada, laguna baacsanayo firxadka maleeshiyadka weerarka soo qaaday oo la sheegay inay ku dhuumaalaysanayaan qeyb ka mid magaalada Baydhabo. Ugu dambeyn, Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga waxa ay sheegtay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay la wadaagi doonto faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan weerarka iyo natiijada howlgalka marka uu soo gabagaboobo. Xasan oo kusii jeeda Gaalkacyo laguna soo dhaweeyay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo ku guda jira safarkiisa deegaanada Galmudug ee uu ugu kuur-galayo xaaladaha amniga iyo nolosha bulshada ayaa goordhow gaaray magaalada Galinsoor ee Gobolka Galgaduud, wuxuuna kadib uga sii gudbi doonaa dhanka magaalada Gaalkacyo ee xarunta Gobolka Mudug. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo uu wehliyo Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, Mudane Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoor Qoor) ayaa salaan la dhex qaaday boqolaal ka mid ah shacabka reer Galinsoor, kuwaasi oo safaf dhaadheer ugu jiray soo dhoweynta Madaxweynaha iyo wafdigiisa. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha oo goob fagaare ah kula hadlay bulshada reer Galinsoor ayaa ugu baaqay in ay xoogga saaraan ilaalinta nabadda, xasilloonida iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada. Waxaa kale oo uu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in magaaladu ay noqoto deegaan nabad ah oo ay si walaaltinimo leh ugu wada nool yihiin dhammaan dadka Soomaaliyeed ee wada dega. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa xalay ku hoyday magaalada Cadaado oo gelinkii dambe ee shalay lagu soo dhaweeyay, kadib markii uu safar dhinaca dhulka ah uga soo baxay magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimada Galmudug. Socdaalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya, xilli haatan khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo midka amni ee u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka uu toddobaadyadii ugu dambeeyay si weyn ugu soo uruuray gobolka Mudug, waxaana Puntland ay maalmo kahor digniin adag kasoo saartay booqashada Madaxweynaha ee magaalada Gaalkacyo, taas oo u muuqata inay dhagaha ka fureysatay Villa Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, Dhacdooyinkan ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in muranka siyaasadeed ee Muqdisho iyo Garoowe uu isu beddelo loollan amni oo si toos ah uga dhex muuqda magaalada Gaalkacyo ee xarunta gobolka Mudug. Lama oga sida ay wax noqon doonaan, waxaase laga war sugaa waxa uu safarka Xasan Sheekh ka beddelo xiisadda taagan oo horay u sababtay inay labada dhinac ku dagaalamaan deegaanno ka tirsan Maamul-goboleedka Puntland. items.title: Deadly clashes rock Baidoa as Somalia army battles forces loyal to ousted Southwest leader
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Fierce clashes erupted Monday in Baidoa, the interim capital of Somalia’s Southwest state, between federal government troops and forces loyal to ousted regional leader Abdiaziz Laftagaren, whose spokesman claimed his fighters had entered parts of the city in an early-morning assault. Gunfire and explosions echoed across Baidoa through the morning, forcing families indoors as videos circulating online showed technical vehicles and armed men moving through the city’s main streets. Additional footage showed smoke and flames rising over neighbourhoods. An initial toll put the dead at more than 10, with at least 20 others wounded, though the figures could not be independently verified. Somalia’s army said it had repelled an assault by “Khawarij” – a term the government commonly uses to refer to Al-Shabaab – and said the bodies of attackers were scattered across the city, which it described as fully under its control. A spokesman for Laftagaren, the toppled Southwest state president, disputed that account, saying the ousted leader’s forces controlled Baidoa and had advanced as far as the city centre. The two claims could not be immediately reconciled. Telecommunications services in Baidoa were reported cut during the fighting, hampering efforts to confirm either side’s account of who holds the city. The violence broke out a day after Somalia’s president told a graduation ceremony for 3,000 soldiers trained under a Saudi-funded programme that Somalia no longer needed foreign troops to protect the government, saying the national army was now fully capable of securing the country on its own. Monday’s fighting raises pointed questions about that assertion. Critics noted that a force unable to immediately repel an attack by a smaller, largely clan-organised militia faces a far steeper test in Al-Shabaab, Al-Qaeda’s wealthiest, most resilient and most successful affiliate. items.fullContent: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Fierce clashes erupted Monday in Baidoa, the interim capital of Somalia’s Southwest state, between federal government troops and forces loyal to ousted regional leader Abdiaziz Laftagaren, whose spokesman claimed his fighters had entered parts of the city in an early-morning assault. Gunfire and explosions echoed across Baidoa through the morning, forcing families indoors as videos circulating online showed technical vehicles and armed men moving through the city’s main streets. Additional footage showed smoke and flames rising over neighbourhoods. An initial toll put the dead at more than 10, with at least 20 others wounded, though the figures could not be independently verified. Somalia’s army said it had repelled an assault by “Khawarij” – a term the government commonly uses to refer to Al-Shabaab – and said the bodies of attackers were scattered across the city, which it described as fully under its control. A spokesman for Laftagaren, the toppled Southwest state president, disputed that account, saying the ousted leader’s forces controlled Baidoa and had advanced as far as the city centre. The two claims could not be immediately reconciled. Telecommunications services in Baidoa were reported cut during the fighting, hampering efforts to confirm either side’s account of who holds the city. The violence broke out a day after Somalia’s president told a graduation ceremony for 3,000 soldiers trained under a Saudi-funded programme that Somalia no longer needed foreign troops to protect the government, saying the national army was now fully capable of securing the country on its own. Monday’s fighting raises pointed questions about that assertion. Critics noted that a force unable to immediately repel an attack by a smaller, largely clan-organised militia faces a far steeper test in Al-Shabaab, Al-Qaeda’s wealthiest, most resilient and most successful affiliate. items.title: Heavy Fighting Erupts in Baidoa as Opposition Forces and Federal Troops Battle for Control
items.description: BAIDOA — Intense armed conflict erupted on the outskirts of Baidoa early Monday morning, as forces aligned with the Somali Federal Government engaged loyalist troops associated with former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed “Laftagareen.” The clashes mark a significant escalation in regional instability, with local political leaders and federal military authorities presenting starkly opposing accounts of the battlefield outcomes. Footage verified on social media depicts armed fighters loyal to Laftagareen maneuvering within several districts of Baidoa. Prominent local figures, including Ugaas Hassan and former regional Minister Hassan Abdiquadir, issued public statements asserting that their combatants had successfully established control over the strategic Bay region capital. Conversely, the Command of the Somali National Army (SNA) rejected claims of a city fall, issuing an official communique stating that federal troops successfully intercepted and neutralized a coordinated offensive by militia elements referred to in government parlance as “Khawarij.” According to the Ministry of Defense, the assault coincided with ongoing security operations and heightened-alert protocols across the South West State. Federal authorities reported that government forces maintained pre-established defensive positions and forced the advancing militia into a retreat. In a formal press briefing, military spokespersons confirmed that government forces inflicted substantial personnel and logistical losses on the opposition group. Approximately 30 militia combatants were killed in action during the engagement, with multiple fighters captured alive. Furthermore, federal units recovered heavy armaments, small arms, and operational combat vehicles abandoned by the retreating forces. The SNA Command confirmed that military personnel are currently conducting cleanup operations on the city’s perimeter, with a comprehensive damage assessment report to be released upon final site verification. items.title: Ciidanka Xoogga oo sheegay in 30 maleeshiyaad ah lagu dilay weerarkii ka dhacay Baydhabo
items.description: Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay fashiliyeen weerar ay maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab iyo kuwa taabacsan Cabdicasiis Laftagareen ku qaadeen magaalada Baydhabo. Sida lagu sheegay war kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga, weerarka ayaa dhacay abaare 5:00 subaxnimo, waxaana ciidamadu ay si degdeg ah uga hortageen maleeshiyaadkii weerarka soo qaaday, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay isku dayayeen inay waxyeello u geystaan shacabka iyo inay qalqal geliyaan amniga magaalada. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in ciidanka ay si xirfad iyo geesinimo leh uga hortageen weerarka, isla markaana ay ka hortageen qorshihii ay maleeshiyaadku ku doonayeen inay ku carqaladeeyaan amniga Baydhabo. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in howlgalka ay qayb ka ahaayeen ciidanka XDS, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay dileen 30 ka mid ah maleeshiyaadkii weerarka soo qaaday, halka qaar kalena ay noqdeen kuwo dhaawacmay. Ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale, sida bayaanka lagu sheegay, gacanta ku dhigay hub iyo gaadiid ay wateen kooxihii weerarka soo qaaday. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa intaas ku dartay in ciidamadu ay weli wadaan howlgal lagu xaqiijinayo amniga magaalada, iyadoo sidoo kale baaritaanno iyo dabagal lagu sameynayo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada maleeshiyaadka ku dhuumaaleysanaya qeybo ka mid ah Baydhabo. Dhanka kale, Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed loo soo gudbin doono faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan weerarka iyo natiijada howlgalka marka uu soo gabagaboobo.

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay dagaal ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Faahfaahinno dheeraad ah ayaa kasoo baxaya dagaal qaraar oo saaka ka dhacay magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay, kaas oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed oo dhinac ah iyo ciidamada taabacsan Lafta-gareen oo weerar kusoo qaaday magaaladaasi, iyadoo khasaare xooggan uu dhaliyay iska hor imaadka. Taliska Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka oo warsaxaafadeed soo saaray ayaa guullo ka sheegtay dagaalka, wuxuuna talisku tilmaamay inay ka hortageen weerar uu sheegay inay soo qaadeen kooxaha Khawaarijta oo maalmahan dambe isku uruursanayay bannaanka magaalada. “Taliska Ciidanka XDS ayaa fashiliyay weerar ay maleeshiyaadka Khawaarijtu kusoo qaadeen magaalada Baydhabo, oo ah Caasimadda KG ee Maamul Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale, waxaa lasii raaciyay “Maleeshiyaadka Khawaarijta ayaa muddooyinkii dambe waday isku dayo ay ku doonayaan inay qalqal geliyaan amniga iyo xasilloonida magaalada Baydhabo, xilli magaalada iyo guud ahaan deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed ay ka sameeyeen horumarro muuqda oo dhinaca amniga ah”. Waxaa kale oo warsaxaafadeedka lagu sheegay in maydad ay ka carareen maleeshiyaadka weerarka soo qaaday, sidoo kalena laga qabsaday hub iyo gaadiid dagaal. “Ciidanka XDS oo si buuxda uga foojigan dhagaraha iyo isku dayada cadawga ayaa si adag uga hortagay weerarka, waxaana Khawaarijta la gaarsiiyay jab xooggan oo isu jira khasaaro naf iyo maal ah. Maleeshiyadkii weerarka soo qaaday ayaa lagu qasbay inay goobihii lagu dagaalamay kaga tagaan meydad, hub iyo gaadiid,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri bayaanka. Dhanka kale, Taliska Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa shacabka Baydhabo ugu baaqay inay muujiyaan feejignaan dheeri ah iyo inay la shaqeeyaan ciidamadda Qaranka ee u taagan difaaca shacabka iyo sugidda amniga dalka. Goor sii horreysay ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ayaa markii hore iyaguna sheegtay in qaybo kamid ah magaalada ay la wareegeen, kadibna ay howlgal ka fuliyeen, inkastoo markii dambe dib loo sii durjiyay. Xaaladda ayaa hadda deggan, waxaana magaalada howlgallo amni xaqiijin ah ka wada ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, si looga hortago dagaal mar kale ka dhaca halkaasi. The post Wararkii ugu dambeeyay dagaal ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .
