items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan oo Galinsoor ugu baaqay nabadda iyo xasiloonida
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo ku guda jira safarkiisa deegaanada Galmudug, ayaa soo gaaray magaalada Galinsoor ee Gobolka Galgaduud, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay boqolaal ka mid ah shacabka deegaanka. Madaxweynaha oo uu wehliyo Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, Mudane Axmed Cabdi Kaariye, ayaa salaan la dhex qaaday shacabka ku soo dhaweeyay safaf dhaadheer uga soo baxay. Safarku wuxuu qayb ka yahay dadaallada Madaxweynuhu ugu jiro qiimeynta xaaladaha amniga iyo nolosha bulshada ee gobolka Galmudug. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo goob fagaare ah kula hadlay bulshada reer Galinsoor, ayaa ugu baaqay in ay xoogga saaraan ilaalinta nabadda, xasilloonida iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada, isaga oo adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in magaaladu ay noqoto deegaan nabad ah. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu ku nuuxnuuxsaday in nabadda iyo xasilloonidu ay yihiin tiirka horumarka, waxaanu ka hadlay muhiimadda ay leedahay in shacabku si wadajir ah uga wada shaqeeyaan sidii loo xoojin lahaa amniga deegaannada. Safarkan ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya sida dowladda federaalku uga go’an tahay inay la shaqeyso maamullada deegaanka si loo xaqiijiyo xasillooni waarta. Wuxuu ku soo beegmayaa xilli ay jiraan dadaallo lagu xoojinayo amniga gobolka, iyadoo la filayo in safarku uu horseedo iskaashi dheeri ah oo u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo maamulka Galmudug.   The post Madaxweyne Xasan oo Galinsoor ugu baaqay nabadda iyo xasiloonida first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Baidoa: Government Forces and Laftagareen’s Forces Clash
items.description: Heavy Fighting Erupts in Baidoa as Federal Forces Clash with Forces Loyal to Former South West Leader BAIDOA, Somalia — Heavy gunfire was heard across parts of Baidoa on Monday morning after forces loyal to former South West State leader Abdicaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen clashed with forces affiliated with the Federal Government of Somalia. Witnesses in the city reported intense gunfire in several neighborhoods, sparking fear among civilians. Businesses closed their doors, while traffic and public movement dropped sharply after the fighting began. Preliminary reports indicate that forces supporting Laftagareen entered the city from multiple directions and engaged units of the Federal Government forces stationed in Baidoa. A local businessman told Dalsan TV that the pro-Laftagareen forces entered Baidoa from two directions, with fighting intensifying as the confrontation continued. Casualties Remain Unconfirmed The number of people killed or wounded in the fighting has not yet been independently verified. It also remains unclear which side has full control over the areas where the clashes took place. Statements circulated by the opposing sides have made conflicting claims about the situation, but those claims have yet to be independently confirmed. Residents said the gunfire had occasionally subsided before intensifying again. Military movements have also been reported across the city, raising concerns that the fighting could spread to additional neighborhoods. Political Dispute Escalates into Armed Conflict The latest clashes are rooted in a long-running political dispute between the Federal Government and the former administration of South West State. Laftagareen stepped down from office on March 30, 2026 , following the takeover of Baidoa by Federal Government forces. The political transition followed months of tensions surrounding elections, constitutional amendments, and the distribution of powers between the Federal Government and Somalia’s federal member states. Although Laftagareen left office, forces loyal to him have reportedly carried out several attacks in and around Baidoa in recent months. Laftagareen and his supporters continue to challenge the legitimacy of the political changes that took place in South West State. Civilians Caught in the Middle Civilians are bearing the immediate consequences of the renewed fighting. Many families fear that continued clashes could force them to flee their homes, at a time when the region is already facing the effects of drought, conflict, and difficult living conditions. Residents have been urged to stay away from areas where armed forces are engaged and to remain indoors until the security situation improves. Baidoa is the administrative capital of South West State and an important center for Somalia’s politics, security, and humanitarian operations in the southern part of the country. Prolonged fighting could pose serious risks to civilians, local businesses, and humanitarian aid operations. The Federal Government and forces supporting Laftagareen have yet to issue comprehensive and independently verifiable statements providing a full account of the casualties and the current situation in the city. Businesses closed their doors, while traffic and public movement dropped sharply after the fighting began. Preliminary reports indicate that forces supporting Laftagareen entered the city from multiple directions and engaged units of the Federal Government forces stationed in Baidoa. A local businessman told Dalsan TV that the pro-Laftagareen forces entered Baidoa from two directions, with fighting intensifying as the confrontation continued. Casualties Remain Unconfirmed The number of people killed or wounded in the fighting has not yet been independently verified. It also remains unclear which side has full control over the areas where the clashes took place. Statements circulated by the opposing sides have made conflicting claims about the situation, but those claims have yet to be independently confirmed. Residents said the gunfire had occasionally subsided before intensifying again. Military movements have also been reported across the city, raising concerns that the fighting could spread to additional neighborhoods. Political Dispute Escalates into Armed Conflict The latest clashes are rooted in a long-running political dispute between the Federal Government and the former administration of South West State. Laftagareen stepped down from office on March 30, 2026 , following the takeover of Baidoa by Federal Government forces. The political transition followed months of tensions surrounding elections, constitutional amendments, and the distribution of powers between the Federal Government and Somalia’s federal member states. Although Laftagareen left office, forces loyal to him have reportedly carried out several attacks in and around Baidoa in recent months. Laftagareen and his supporters continue to challenge the legitimacy of the political changes that took place in South West State. Civilians Caught in the Middle Civilians are bearing the immediate consequences of the renewed fighting. Many families fear that continued clashes could force them to flee their homes, at a time when the region is already facing the effects of drought, conflict, and difficult living conditions. Residents have been urged to stay away from areas where armed forces are engaged and to remain indoors until the security situation improves. Baidoa is the administrative capital of South West State and an important center for Somalia’s politics, security, and humanitarian operations in the southern part of the country. Prolonged fighting could pose serious risks to civilians, local businesses, and humanitarian aid operations. The Federal Government and forces supporting Laftagareen have yet to issue comprehensive and independently verifiable statements providing a full account of the casualties and the current situation in the city. The post Baidoa: Government Forces and Laftagareen’s Forces Clash first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Baydhabo: Ciidamada Dowladda Iyo Kuwa Laftagareen Oo Isku Dhacay
items.description: Rasaas xooggan ayaa saaka laga maqlay qaybo ka mid ah magaalada Baydhabo, kaddib markii ciidamo daacad u ah hoggaamiyihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen, ay gudaha magaalada kula dagaallameen ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka. BAYDHABO, Soomaaliya — Xaaladda magaalada Baydhabo ayaa saaka aad u kacsan, iyadoo dagaal culus uu dhex maray ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo xoogag hubeysan oo taageersan hoggaamiyihii hore ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen. Goobjoogayaal ku sugan magaalada ayaa sheegay in rasaas xooggan laga maqlayay xaafado kala duwan, taas oo cabsi ku abuurtay dadka rayidka ah. Ganacsiyo ayaa la xiray, dhaqdhaqaaqii gaadiidka iyo dadweynahana si weyn ayuu u yaraaday markii dagaalku billowday. Wararka hordhaca ah ayaa tilmaamaya in ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen ay magaalada ka soo galeen jihooyin kala duwan, iyagoo iska horimaad la galay cutubyo ka tirsan ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka ee ku sugan Baydhabo. Qof ganacsade ah oo magaalada ku sugan ayaa wakaaladda Dalsan TV u sheegay in xoogagga taageersan hoggaamiyihii hore ay Baydhabo ka soo galeen laba jiho, isla markaana dagaalku sii xoogeysanayay. Khasaaraha oo aan weli la xaqiijin Ilaa hadda si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin khasaaraha dhimasho iyo dhaawac ee ka dhashay dagaalka. Sidoo kale, ma cadda dhinaca si buuxda gacanta ugu haya goobaha lagu dagaallamay. Warar ay baahiyeen dhinacyada iska soo horjeeda ayaa xambaarsan sheegashooyin kala duwan, balse sheegashooyinkaas weli ma helin xaqiijin madax-bannaan. Dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in mararka qaar rasaastu yara degaysay, haddana dib u xoogeysanaysay. Waxaa sidoo kale magaalada laga dareemayaa dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan iyo cabsi laga qabo in dagaalku ku faafo xaafado kale. Khilaaf siyaasadeed oo isu beddelay dagaal hubeysan   Dagaalkan ayaa salka ku haya khilaaf siyaasadeed oo muddo ka dhex jiray Dowladda Federaalka iyo maamulkii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed. Laftagareen ayaa xilka ka degay 30-kii Maarso 2026, kaddib markii ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka ay la wareegeen magaalada Baydhabo. Isbeddelkaas waxaa ka horreeyay muran siyaasadeed oo la xiriiray doorashooyinka, wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka iyo awood-qaybsiga Dowladda Federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada. Inkasta oo uu xilka ka degay, haddana ciidamo daacad u ah Laftagareen ayaa bilihii dambe dhowr jeer weerarro ka fuliyay gudaha iyo duleedka Baydhabo. Laftagareen iyo taageerayaashiisu waxay weli su’aal gelinayaan sharciyadda isbeddelkii siyaasadeed ee ka dhacay Koonfur Galbeed. Cabsi soo wajahday shacabka Dadka rayidka ah ayaa ah kuwa sida tooska ah u dareemaya saameynta dagaalka. Qoysas badan ayaa ka cabsi qaba in dagaallada soo noqnoqda ay ku qasbaan inay ka barakacaan guryahooda, xilli gobolka uu horey ula tacaalayay abaaro, colaado iyo xaalado nololeed oo adag. Dadka magaalada ayaa loogu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan goobaha ay ciidamada isku horfadhiyaan, guryahoodana ku nagaadaan inta ay xaaladdu ka degayso. Baydhabo waa xarunta ku-meel-gaarka ah ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, waana magaalo muhiim u ah siyaasadda, ammaanka iyo howlaha bani’aadannimo ee koonfurta Soomaaliya. Dagaal sii daba dheeraada wuxuu halis gelin karaa nolosha dadka rayidka ah, ganacsiga iyo gargaarka bani’aadannimo. Dowladda Federaalka iyo dhinaca taageersan Laftagareen weli kama aysan soo saarin warbixinno dhammaystiran oo la isku raacsan yahay oo ku saabsan khasaaraha iyo xaaladda magaalada. The post Baydhabo: Ciidamada Dowladda Iyo Kuwa Laftagareen Oo Isku Dhacay first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Madaxweynaha Xasan Sheekh oo Lagu Soo Dhaweeyay Galinsoor
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Galinsoor ee Gobolka Galgaduud, isagoo qeyb ka ah safar uu ku marayo deegaanada Galmudug, kaas oo diiradda lagu saarayo xaaladaha amniga, xasilloonida iyo nolosha bulshada. Madaxweynaha waxaa safarka ku wehliya Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, Mudane Axmed Cabdi Kaariye, waxaana magaalada Galinsoor si weyn ugu soo dhaweeyay boqolaal ka mid ah shacabka deegaanka oo safaf dhaadheer u galay soo dhaweynta wafdiga. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa salaan iyo is-dhexgal la sameeyay bulshada reer Galinsoor, isagoo markii dambe goob fagaare ah kula hadlay shacabka magaalada. Khudbaddiisa, Madaxweynaha ayaa bulshada ugu baaqay inay xoojiyaan dadaallada lagu ilaalinayo nabadda, amniga iyo wada noolaanshaha, isaga oo carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in Galinsoor noqoto deegaan ammaan ah oo ay si walaaltinimo iyo is-ixtiraam leh ugu wada noolaan karaan dhammaan dadka Soomaaliyeed ee deegaanka wada dega. Safarka Madaxweynaha ee Galmudug ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli dowladda federaalka ay xoogga saarayso xoojinta amniga iyo la macaamilka bulshada, iyadoo booqashooyinka deegaanada ay qeyb ka yihiin dadaallada lagu fahmayo baahiyaha shacabka iyo xaaladda guud ee deegaannada.

items.title: Somaliland oo Joojisay Iibinta Laba Dawo oo Muqdisho lagu Sameeyo
items.description: Hay’adda Tayadhowrka Soomaalilaan ayaa joojisay iibinta, qaybinta iyo isticmaalka laba dawo oo ay soo saarto shirkadda YENISOM Healthcare ee fadhigeedu yahay Muqdisho, iyadoo sheegtay in dawooyinkaasi aysan soo marin habraacyada hubinta tayada ee looga baahanyahay badeecadaha dawooyinka ah. Labada dawo ee amarku sida gaarka ah u magacaabay ayaa kala ah YENIPROFEN, oo ah Ibuprofen 400mg, iyo YENIXIUME, oo ah Esomeprazole 40mg. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in sababta joojintu tahay in dawooyinkaasi aysan soo marin habraacyada waajibka ah ee hubinta iyo xaqiijinta tayada marka la keenayo suuqyada Soomaalilaan. Amarka hay’addu ma sheegin in baaritaan lagu ogaaday in dawooyinkaasi caafimaad ahaan waxyeello leeyihiin ama tayadoodu liidato. Joojinta waxaa lagu sababeeyey habraacyada sharci iyo tayahubin ee aan la marin, taas oo ka duwan in dawo la xaqiijiyey inay khatar caafimaad leedahay. YENISOM Healthcare waa shirkad dawooyin ku farsamaysa Muqdisho, waxayna sheegtay in la aasaasay bishii Febraayo 2022kii, iyadoo soosaarta noocyo kala duwan oo dawooyin ah. Go’aanka ayaa soo baxaya iyadoo Soomaaliya ay sannadihii dambe kor u qaadayso waxsoosaarka gudaha ee dawooyinka, taas oo dhinaca kale soo bandhigaysa muhiimadda iswaafajinta nidaamyada ruqsadsiinta, hubinta tayada iyo gelitaanka suuqyada kala duwan ee Soomaalida. Ilaa hadda ma muuqato jawaab rasmi ah oo YENISOM ay si toos ah uga bixisay go’aankan. Shirkaddu, hasayeeshee, boggeeda rasmiga ah waxay ku sheegtaa inay ku shaqayso heerar caalami ah oo waxsoosaarka iyo hubinta tayada dawooyinka ah. Arrintan ayaa hadda su’aal ka dhalinaysa in dawooyinka shirkaddu shati iyo hubin tayo uga haystaan hay’adaha heer federaal, iyo in YENISOM ay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin ay ku buuxinayso shuruudaha ay sheegtay Hay’adda Tayadhowrka Soomaalilaan.

items.title: Dhallinyaro Hargaysa ka hirgaliyay waxbarasho dadka loogu geeyo guryahooda
items.description: (ERGO) – Asma Ismaaciil Axmed oo 23 jir ah waxay galab kasta tagtaa xaafado ka tirsan Hargeysa, halkaas oo ay wax ku barto carruurta iyo waalidiinta aan fursadda u helin waxbarashada iskuullada. Dadka ay waxbarto waxay u badanaayeen kuwa horay ugu baraarugsanayn muhiimadda waxbarashada iyo qaar aan awoodin in carruurtooda oo dhan ay iskuullada geeyaan, duruuf dhaqaale xumo awgeed. Howshan oo ay billowday bishii May ee sanadkan ayaa u noqotay il-dhaqaale, waxaana qoys kasta ay ka heshaa bishii lacag u dhaxaysa $5-$10. Dadka aan awoodin ayay xustay in aysan ku xujayn qiimo go’an. Waxay ka tirsan tahay koox macalimiin ah oo 8 ka kooban, kuwaas oo ku wareega xaafadaha magaalada. Ka hor waxbaridda waxay dadka ku wacyigaliyaan faa’iidada aqoontu leedahay iyo cilladda jaahilnimada. Raadiyow Ergo ayay u sheegtay in aysan ahayn faa’iido doon oo kaliya, balse qoonta ay gaarsiinayso dadka ay u aragto xuquuq ay tahay in qofkasta uu helo. “Marka hore waxaan waalidka u sheegnaa waxa aan dadka u dhigayno iyo casharada aan caruurta ka caawinayno. Sidoo kale waxaanu isku daynaa inaanu tusno waxyaabaha aan u dhigayno, kadib waxaan qaadanaa muddo gaaban si ay u arkaan isbeddelka iyo horumarka ilmuhu samaynaayaan.” “Haddii uu qoyskaas ku qanco saan wax u dhigayno, kaddib qoysaskaas waxay naga caawiyaan sidii ay noogu soo xiri lahaayeen qoysas kale.” Waxay tilmaamtay in aragtida waxbaridda dadka iyo jaceylka ay u qabto macallinimada in ay soo billaabatay xilligii ay ku jirtay dugsiga dhexe, isla markaana ay ka dhabaysay riyadii ay lahayd. Dhinaca kale xirfaddan waxay u noqotay fursad shaqo. Bishii waxaa ka soo gasha lacag u dhaxaysa $150 ilaa $200. Qoyskeeda oo 6 ah ayay ku maaraysaa noloshooda, kuwaas oo ka baxay xaalad nolol xumo. Waxay noqotay qof kaliya ee u dhaqdhaqaaqa nolol-maalmeedka qoyska, markii aabbeheed oo shaqadiisu ahayd rinjiyeenta guryaha ay ka maarantay shirkad uu u shaqeeyanay bishii Febraayo. Billo adag oo qoyskeeda cunno xumo ay wajaheen kaddib, waxay gashay saddex bil ka hor booskiisa iyadoo dabooshay baahidooda cunno iyo tan waxbarasho ee walaalaheed oo iyadu ay curad u tahay. “Baahida dhaqaale ayaa ahayd midda ugu wayn ee nagu riixaysay in aan tallaabadan qaado, isla markaana waxaan ogayn in adeeggan uu bulshada faa’iido u leeyahay, sababtoo ah qoysas badan ma awoodaan in carruurtooda geeyaan dugsiyada qaaliga ah, sidaas darteed waxaan howl u qabanaa nafteena iyo bulshadeena.” Ku dhawaad 200 oo macalin oo koox koox u abaabulan ayaa nidaamkan waxbarasho uu u noqday fursad shaqo, kuwaas oo labadii sano ee u danbeeyay ka baxay dugsiga sare sida ay sheegeen guddi ay leeyihin. Dadka ku xirmaya waxbarashada guryahooda loogu gaynayo ayaa sii kordhaya sida ay xustay Asma, taas oo ku timid wacyigalinta ay ku dhinac wadaan waxbaridda kooxda Asma iyagoo albaab walba garaaca. “Waxaan isku daynaa inaan qofka kula dhaqano heerka aqooneed ama ku habboon yahay. Ilmo yar haddii uu yahay waxaan wax ugu dhignaa si fudud oo xiiso leh, waxaana ku dhiirigelinaa hadal wanaagsan iyo amaan.” “Dadka waawayna waxaanu tusnaa inaanay waxbarashadu ahayn da’, isla markaana ay tahay waxay nolol maalmeedkooda ku dabari karaan, qoyskastana wuxuu helaa waqti ku filan si uu u helo tayo waxbarasho oo fiican.” Waxay beegsadaan xaafadaha ku yaalla hareeraha Hargaysa iyo kuwa isku raranta ah ee ay iskuulladu ku yaryihiin, halkaas oo ay kula kulmaan carruur aan waxba baran iyo waalidiin aan waligood iskuul tagin. Qoysaska hayntooda dhaqaale ay yartahay ayay qiimo jaban ku siiyaan duruusta. Qoys walba oo ay gurigooda wax ku baraan waxaa wax u barta ugu yaraan saddex qof oo iskugu jira carruur iyo waalid. Waalidiinta nidaamkan waxbarasho la jaan-qaaday waxaa ka mid ah Malyuun Cumar Xuseen. Toddobo carruur ah oo kan u yar uu jiro shan sano ayaa duruusta ku qaata qayb ka mid ah gurideeda. Waxay sheegtay in ay u soo gaday sabuuray iyo agab kale oo waxbarashada ay ku qaataan, isla markaana bishii oo dhan ay ku bixiso $5, taas afar jibbaar ka yar lacagtii uga bixi lahayd iskuulka. “Ciyaalkaygu arday weeye. Muddo labo bilood ah waxbarasho ayay ku jiraan. Ardayda secondariyada ka soo baxay ayaa noo yimaada. Wax yar oo jaban bay naga qaadaan, kaddibna carruurta ayay waxbaraan. Waan ku faa’iidnay, ciyaalkana si fiican bay wax u fahamsiiyaan.” Dhallinyarada macalimiinta ah ayay xustay in ay ku qanciyeen waxbarashada carruurtooda xilli ay iska illowday in ay waxbartaan, maaddama lacagta ay iskuulka ku dhigan karaan qofkiiba ay tahay $6. Qoyskeeda waxaa nolol-maalmeedka u soo dhciya saygeeda oo shaqadiisu aysan joogto ahayn. Intaas waxay ku dartay in ay qaataan maaddooyin, far-soomaaliga, xisaabta, tarabiyaha iyo qaar kale. Waxay sheegtay in ay gashay yididiilo ay wax ku barato, markii ay aragtay sida carruurteeda wax loo barayo. Waxay qorshaynaysaa in ay ka mid noqoto waalidiinta qaybta ka ah waxbarashadan. Toddobaadkii shan maalin oo ka mid ah ayay tilmaamtay in ay waxbarashada qaataan carruurteeda iyadoo maalintii labo macalin ay isku bedelaan galinka hore iyo kan danbe. Dhallinyarada ku fooggan waxbarashada waalidiinta iyo carruurta loogu geeyay guryahooda waxaa ka mid ah Nuura Cali Axmed oo 22 jir. Waxay dhamaysay dugsiga sare ee Sheekh Cali Ibraahim sanadkan. Waxay galinka hore iyo kan danbe tagtaa in ka badan 40 guri, halkaas oo carruur iyo dad waawaynay wax ku barto. Waxay sheegtay howsha ay hayso ah mid adag ay ka hesho dhaqaale ku filan qoyskeeda. Lacag u dhaxaysa $200-300 ayay ka heshaa xirfaddan macalinnimo. Waxay u qaybisaa masruufka qoyska sida cuntada, korontada iyo biyaha, halka inta u soo harta ay dhigaalsato si ay u hesho tacliin sare. “Qorshahaygu waa inaan jaamacad ku biro marka aan helo dhaqaale igu filan. Waxaan doonayaa inaan waxbarashadayda hore u sii wato, laakiin ma doonayo inaan joojiyo shaqadan. Haddii ay macmiishu igu badatona waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan dhallinyaro kale ku soo daro, si ay iyaguna uga helaan shaqo.” Waxay sheegtay Nuura in dhiiraan badan ay ka heshay barnaamijkan waxbarasho, kaas oo illowsiiyay caqabadah shaqo la’aan ee dalka ka jira iyo fikirka tahriibka oo dhallinyarada ay ku lug-go’een. Waxay soo jeedisay in fursadaha shaqo ay ka billowdaan in qofku doonaya uu sameeyay howl-karnimo iyo adeeg bulsho, kuwaas oo waxtari kara isaga iyo bulshada uu ku dhex nool yahay. “Waxaan kula talin lahaa inaanay shaqo rasmiya oo kaliya sugin. Qof kasta wuxuu leeyahay aqoon ama xirfad uu bulsha uga faa’iideyn karo. Haddii aad wax baratay dadka wax bar. Anigu shaqadan waxaan ka soo bilaabay aqoon yar oo aan haystay, laakiin maanta waxay iga caawinaysaa nolosha qoyskayga iyo qorshahayga waxbarasho.” Nuura oo shaqadan ku dhiirtay bishii Abriil ee sanadkan waxay sheegtay in billowgiiba ay la kowsatay caqabad ka timid waalidiinta oo ku kalsoonaan waayay, balse wacyigalin joogta kaddib, ay ku qanceen. Kumanaan dhallinyaro ah ayaa sanad walba ka qalin jabiya dugsiyada sare, kuwaas oo u qabysma qaar tahriiba, kuwa shaqo la’aan darteed guri-joog noqda iyo in kale oo curintooda hal-buur ku hela shaqo. items.title: Saddex dal oo qeyb ka noqon kara dagaalka cusub ee Tigray
items.description: Tigray (Somalia Today) — Xiisadihii ugu dambeeyay ee ka soo cusboonaaday gobolka Tigray ee Itoobiya, oo ay ka mid yihiin madaafiic culus iyo weerarro loo adeegsaday diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, ayaa sii kordhiyay cabsida laga qabo in dagaal kale ka qarxo waqooyiga dalka, iyadoo ay jirto walaac ah in dalal shisheeye ay colaadda sii hurin karaan. Maxay tahay xaaladda iminka? Muddo dhowr bilood ah, ciidamada dowladda federaalka Itoobiya ee ENDF iyo kuwa Tigray ee TDF ayaa isku hor fadhiya deegaanno ku teedsan xadka Tigray. Ciidamada la soo dhoobay ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiriirka u dhexeeya dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed iyo hoggaanka Tigray uu sii xumaanayo. Tigray waxaa saameyn weyn ku leh Jabhadda Xoreynta Shacabka Tigray ee TPLF, xisbigii Itoobiya xukumayay intii u dhexeysay 1991 iyo 2018, balse hadda dowladda federaalka ay mamnuucday. Labada dhinac ayaa midba midka kale ku eedeynaya inuu doonayo inuu dib u huriyo dagaal, kaddib colaaddii dhiigga badani ku daatay ee socotay 2020 ilaa 2022, taas oo ay ku dhinteen ugu yaraan 600,000 oo qof. Heshiiskii nabadda ee Pretoria ayaa dagaalkaas soo afjaray, waxaana xigay xasillooni jilicsan oo socotay ilaa dabayaaqadii 2025, markaas oo ay mar kale isku dhaceen ciidamada federaalka iyo kuwa Tigray. Maxaa dhacay tan iyo markaas? 1-dii Agoosto, TPLF ayaa ku eedeysay ciidamada ENDF inay madaafiic culus ku weerareen ciidamadeeda ku sugan Shererina, oo u dhow xadka Sudan. Dowladda Itoobiya si shaacsan ugama hadlin iska horimaadyadaas, hase yeeshee hay’adda ACLED ee la socota colaadaha ayaa xaqiijisay inay dhaceen. Isniintii, TPLF ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn lagu duqeeyay ciidamo Tigray ah oo ku sugnaa koonfurta gobolka. Mas’uul caafimaad oo deegaanka ah ayaa AFP u sheegay in ugu yaraan afar askari oo Tigray ah ay ku dhaawacmeen weerarradaas. Maxay tani ka dhigan tahay? Cameron Hudson, oo ah falanqeeye ka tirsan xarunta CSIS ee Washington, ayaa sheegay in dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ciidan ee ugu dambeeyay ay “kordhinayaan suurta-galnimada dagaal cusub”. Jalale Getachew Birru, oo ka tirsan ACLED, ayaa sheegtay in horraantii 2024 ciidamada Tigray lagu qiyaasayay ku dhowaad 270,000 oo askari. “Hase yeeshee, lama hayo xog ku saabsan tirada ay hadda yihiin ciidamada TDF, maadaama ay weli wadaan qorista askar cusub,” ayay tiri, iyadoo sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah qoristaasi ay tahay mid qasab ah. Dhanka kale, dowladda federaalka Itoobiya ayaa sanad ka hor billowday soo saarista diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Khubarada la socda colaadda ayaa aaminsan in hubkan uu dowladda ka caawiyay inay 2021 joojiso horusocodkii ciidamada Tigray ee kusii jeeday Addis Ababa. “TPLF waxay u muuqataa inay dagaal cusub geli karto iyadoo aad uga tabar yar sidii ay ahayd dagaalkii hore. Waxayna hadda si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay dhinacyo shisheeye,” ayuu yiri Hudson. Waa kuwee dhinacyadaas? Madaxweyne ku xigeenka TPLF, Amanuel Assefa, ayaa AFP u sheegay in kooxdu diyaar u tahay inay la shaqeyso “cid kasta oo la dagaallameysa dowladda federaalka Itoobiya”. Mas’uuliyiinta Itoobiya ayaa TPLF ku eedeeyay inay xiriir la sameysatay Eritrea iyo maleeshiyada Fano ee gobolka deriska la ah ee Amhara, kuwaas oo hubka u qaatay dowladda Addis Ababa sanadkii 2023. Eritrea iyo Fano waxay muddo dheer cadow u ahaayeen TPLF, waxayna dagaalkii hore garab istaageen ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya. Hase yeeshee, xiriirkooda Abiy Ahmed oo xumaaday ayaa markii dambe beddelay xulafeysigii hore. Yaa kale oo ku soo biiri kara? “Waxa iiga walaac badan ayaa ah in marka la barbar dhigo dagaalkii hore ee Tigray, hadda ay jiraan dhinacyo shisheeye oo badan oo colaaddan jiho kale u jiidi kara,” ayuu yiri Hudson. Ciidamada Sudan, oo tan iyo 2023 dagaal kula jira xoogagga RSF, ayaa Itoobiya ku eedeeyay inay RSF u oggolaatay inay dhul Itoobiyaan ah ka abaabulaan howlgallo ka dhan ah Sudan. Addis Ababa weli kama aysan jawaabin eedeymahaas. Dhanka kale, Masar iyo Itoobiya waxaa muddo dheer ka dhex taagnaa khilaaf ku saabsan biyo-xireenka weyn ee Itoobiya ka dhistay webiga Nile, kaas oo Qaahira u aragto “halis ku wajahan jiritaankeeda”. “Dagaalkii hore wuxuu inta badan ku koobnaa gudaha Itoobiya. Haddii dagaal cusub qarxo, waxay u badan tahay inuu soo jiito dalalka deriska ah sida Sudan iyo Eritrea,” ayuu yiri Kjetil Tronvoll, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay gobolka kana tirsan Oslo New University College. “Wuxuu noqon karaa dagaalkii labaad ee adduunka ee Afrika,” ayuu yiri, isagoo ula jeeday dagaalkii Congo ee 1998 ilaa 2003, kaas oo ay ku lug lahaayeen sagaal dal oo Afrikaan ah. Ma jirtaa waddo diblomaasiyadeed? Olusegun Obasanjo, ergeyga gaarka ah ee Midowga Afrika u qaabilsan Geeska Afrika, ayaa bishii Juun booqday Mekelle, caasimadda Tigray. Madaxweynihii hore ee Nigeria ayaa “bilaabay hannaan wada-hadal oo ku saabsan heshiiskii Pretoria”, sida uu AFP u sheegay diblomaasi Afrikaan ah oo codsaday inaan magaciisa la shaacin. Midowga Afrika, oo dhex-dhexaadiyay heshiiska Pretoria, weli wax war ah kama soo saarin iska horimaadyadii ugu dambeeyay. Mareykanka, oo door ka qaatay soo afjaridda dagaalkii hore, ayaa dhanka kale si weyn uga maqnaa dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee hadda socda. “Washington waa inay door muhiim ah ka qaadataa dejinta xiisadda gobolka, laakiin waxay isku dayeysaa inay dhinac walba raalli geliso, iyadoo isla mar ahaantaana raacaysa danaheeda gaarka ah,” ayuu yiri Hudson. Wuxuu sheegay in dagaal cusub uu “saameyn aad u weyn” ku yeelan karo danaha Mareykanka ee la xiriira amniga iyo marin-biyoodka gobolka. “Haddana ma muuqato wax dadaal diblomaasiyadeed oo Mareykanku ku doonayo inuu kaga hortago dagaal cusub.” The post Saddex dal oo qeyb ka noqon kara dagaalka cusub ee Tigray appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Maxay tahay xaaladda iminka? Muddo dhowr bilood ah, ciidamada dowladda federaalka Itoobiya ee ENDF iyo kuwa Tigray ee TDF ayaa isku hor fadhiya deegaanno ku teedsan xadka Tigray. Ciidamada la soo dhoobay ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiriirka u dhexeeya dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed iyo hoggaanka Tigray uu sii xumaanayo. Tigray waxaa saameyn weyn ku leh Jabhadda Xoreynta Shacabka Tigray ee TPLF, xisbigii Itoobiya xukumayay intii u dhexeysay 1991 iyo 2018, balse hadda dowladda federaalka ay mamnuucday. Labada dhinac ayaa midba midka kale ku eedeynaya inuu doonayo inuu dib u huriyo dagaal, kaddib colaaddii dhiigga badani ku daatay ee socotay 2020 ilaa 2022, taas oo ay ku dhinteen ugu yaraan 600,000 oo qof. Heshiiskii nabadda ee Pretoria ayaa dagaalkaas soo afjaray, waxaana xigay xasillooni jilicsan oo socotay ilaa dabayaaqadii 2025, markaas oo ay mar kale isku dhaceen ciidamada federaalka iyo kuwa Tigray. Maxaa dhacay tan iyo markaas? 1-dii Agoosto, TPLF ayaa ku eedeysay ciidamada ENDF inay madaafiic culus ku weerareen ciidamadeeda ku sugan Shererina, oo u dhow xadka Sudan. Dowladda Itoobiya si shaacsan ugama hadlin iska horimaadyadaas, hase yeeshee hay’adda ACLED ee la socota colaadaha ayaa xaqiijisay inay dhaceen. Isniintii, TPLF ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn lagu duqeeyay ciidamo Tigray ah oo ku sugnaa koonfurta gobolka. Mas’uul caafimaad oo deegaanka ah ayaa AFP u sheegay in ugu yaraan afar askari oo Tigray ah ay ku dhaawacmeen weerarradaas. Maxay tani ka dhigan tahay? Cameron Hudson, oo ah falanqeeye ka tirsan xarunta CSIS ee Washington, ayaa sheegay in dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ciidan ee ugu dambeeyay ay “kordhinayaan suurta-galnimada dagaal cusub”. Jalale Getachew Birru, oo ka tirsan ACLED, ayaa sheegtay in horraantii 2024 ciidamada Tigray lagu qiyaasayay ku dhowaad 270,000 oo askari. “Hase yeeshee, lama hayo xog ku saabsan tirada ay hadda yihiin ciidamada TDF, maadaama ay weli wadaan qorista askar cusub,” ayay tiri, iyadoo sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah qoristaasi ay tahay mid qasab ah. Dhanka kale, dowladda federaalka Itoobiya ayaa sanad ka hor billowday soo saarista diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Khubarada la socda colaadda ayaa aaminsan in hubkan uu dowladda ka caawiyay inay 2021 joojiso horusocodkii ciidamada Tigray ee kusii jeeday Addis Ababa. “TPLF waxay u muuqataa inay dagaal cusub geli karto iyadoo aad uga tabar yar sidii ay ahayd dagaalkii hore. Waxayna hadda si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay dhinacyo shisheeye,” ayuu yiri Hudson. Waa kuwee dhinacyadaas? Madaxweyne ku xigeenka TPLF, Amanuel Assefa, ayaa AFP u sheegay in kooxdu diyaar u tahay inay la shaqeyso “cid kasta oo la dagaallameysa dowladda federaalka Itoobiya”. Mas’uuliyiinta Itoobiya ayaa TPLF ku eedeeyay inay xiriir la sameysatay Eritrea iyo maleeshiyada Fano ee gobolka deriska la ah ee Amhara, kuwaas oo hubka u qaatay dowladda Addis Ababa sanadkii 2023. Eritrea iyo Fano waxay muddo dheer cadow u ahaayeen TPLF, waxayna dagaalkii hore garab istaageen ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya. Hase yeeshee, xiriirkooda Abiy Ahmed oo xumaaday ayaa markii dambe beddelay xulafeysigii hore. Yaa kale oo ku soo biiri kara? “Waxa iiga walaac badan ayaa ah in marka la barbar dhigo dagaalkii hore ee Tigray, hadda ay jiraan dhinacyo shisheeye oo badan oo colaaddan jiho kale u jiidi kara,” ayuu yiri Hudson. Ciidamada Sudan, oo tan iyo 2023 dagaal kula jira xoogagga RSF, ayaa Itoobiya ku eedeeyay inay RSF u oggolaatay inay dhul Itoobiyaan ah ka abaabulaan howlgallo ka dhan ah Sudan. Addis Ababa weli kama aysan jawaabin eedeymahaas. Dhanka kale, Masar iyo Itoobiya waxaa muddo dheer ka dhex taagnaa khilaaf ku saabsan biyo-xireenka weyn ee Itoobiya ka dhistay webiga Nile, kaas oo Qaahira u aragto “halis ku wajahan jiritaankeeda”. “Dagaalkii hore wuxuu inta badan ku koobnaa gudaha Itoobiya. Haddii dagaal cusub qarxo, waxay u badan tahay inuu soo jiito dalalka deriska ah sida Sudan iyo Eritrea,” ayuu yiri Kjetil Tronvoll, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay gobolka kana tirsan Oslo New University College. “Wuxuu noqon karaa dagaalkii labaad ee adduunka ee Afrika,” ayuu yiri, isagoo ula jeeday dagaalkii Congo ee 1998 ilaa 2003, kaas oo ay ku lug lahaayeen sagaal dal oo Afrikaan ah. Ma jirtaa waddo diblomaasiyadeed? Olusegun Obasanjo, ergeyga gaarka ah ee Midowga Afrika u qaabilsan Geeska Afrika, ayaa bishii Juun booqday Mekelle, caasimadda Tigray. Madaxweynihii hore ee Nigeria ayaa “bilaabay hannaan wada-hadal oo ku saabsan heshiiskii Pretoria”, sida uu AFP u sheegay diblomaasi Afrikaan ah oo codsaday inaan magaciisa la shaacin. Midowga Afrika, oo dhex-dhexaadiyay heshiiska Pretoria, weli wax war ah kama soo saarin iska horimaadyadii ugu dambeeyay. Mareykanka, oo door ka qaatay soo afjaridda dagaalkii hore, ayaa dhanka kale si weyn uga maqnaa dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee hadda socda. “Washington waa inay door muhiim ah ka qaadataa dejinta xiisadda gobolka, laakiin waxay isku dayeysaa inay dhinac walba raalli geliso, iyadoo isla mar ahaantaana raacaysa danaheeda gaarka ah,” ayuu yiri Hudson. Wuxuu sheegay in dagaal cusub uu “saameyn aad u weyn” ku yeelan karo danaha Mareykanka ee la xiriira amniga iyo marin-biyoodka gobolka. “Haddana ma muuqato wax dadaal diblomaasiyadeed oo Mareykanku ku doonayo inuu kaga hortago dagaal cusub.” The post Saddex dal oo qeyb ka noqon kara dagaalka cusub ee Tigray appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka oo hambalyeeyay heshiiska ka dhacay Maka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, ayaa ka falceliyay heshiiska difaaca wadajirka ah ee Maka ee ay kala saxiixdeen Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Donald Trump ayaa hambalyo u diray hoggaamiyeyaasha saddexda dal, isagoo heshiiska ku tilmaamay “tallaabo geesinimo leh.” Trump ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay bartiisa Truth Social ku yiri: “Aad ayaan ugu faraxsanahay inaan arko in Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay dhawaan saxiixeen Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Maka.” Wuxuu sheegay in heshiisku muujinayo in Bariga Dhexe uu isu soo dhowaanayo, isla markaana dalalku ay hadda awood u yeelan doonaan inay si ka xoog badan sidii hore isu difaacaan. Wuxuuna hambalyo u diray hoggaamiyeyaasha saddexda dal, isagoo heshiiska ku tilmaamay “tallaabo weyn, geesinimo leh oo muhiim ah.” Waxaa xusid mudan in Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Maka uu dhigayo, in haddii mid ka mid ah saddexda dal—Sacuudiga, Turkiga ama Pakistan—uu la kulmo weerar hubaysan, weerarkaas loo aqoonsan doono weerar lagu qaaday dhammaan saddexda dal. Heshiiska ayaa lagu saxiixay magaalada Maka 7-dii Agoosto 2026, waxaana saxiixay Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Mohammed bin Salman, Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan iyo Raysal Wasaaraha Pakistan, Shehbaz Sharif.

items.title: Daawo: Madaxweyne Xasan oo iclaamiyey in la joogo xilligii bixitaanka ciidanka shisheeye
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo maanta kumannaan askari oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed tababar ugu soo xiray deegaanka Xananbuure ee gobolka Galgaduud, ayaa ka hadlay arrimo ku aaddan amniga, xilli la filayo inay dalka ka baxaan ciidamada howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Madaxweynaha ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in la joogo waqtigii ay amniga dalka hanan lahaayeen Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, loona baahan yahay inay muujiyaan dadaal dheeri ah iyo mas’uuliyad qaran, si ay ula wareegaan amniga. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in dhawaan la macasalaameyn doono ciidamada shisheeye ee muddada dheer howlgalka nabad-ilaalinta u joogay dalka, isaga oo si weyn ugu mahadceliyay. “Caalamka iyo saaxiibada waa na kaalmeeyeen, laakiin waqtigeennii ayaa la joogaa oo aan mas’uuliyaddeenna qaadi lahayn. Sidoo kale, waxaa la joogaa waqtigii ciidamada ku sugan dalka aan ubax qurux badan siin lahayn oo aan dhihi lahayn, ‘Walaalayaal, waa mahadsan tihiin,’” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Waxaa kale oo uu bogaadiyay ciidamada maanta loo soo xiray tababarka, kuwaas oo uu tilmaamay in muddo dheer loo carbinayay Xoogga Dalka, wuxuuna rajo wanaagsan ka muujiyay inay wax weyn ku soo kordhin doonaan dalka. “Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed waxaa idinku soo kordhay xoog aan la dhayalsan karin. Ma aha tababar Soomaaliya gudaheeda lagu tababaray oo keliya; muddadii ugu dheereyd ee ciidan la tababaro ayay soo galeen tababar, takhasusyo kala duwanna way soo qaateen,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Ciidamadan ayaa dhammaystay tababarka aasaasiga ah ee ciidanka, kadib muddo ku dhow hal sano oo ay tababar ku qaadanayeen deegaanka Xananbuure ee gobolka Galgaduud. Ciidamadan, oo laga soo qoray dhammaan gobollada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, ayaa noqonaya ciidamadii ugu badnaa ee tababar heerkan ah ku qaata gudaha dalka tan iyo burburkii dalka, iyaga oo qaatay duruus iyo tababbarro ciidan oo dhammaystiran, kuwaas oo ku saabsanaa xirfadaha ciidanka, anshaxa iyo xeerka ciidanka, xeeladaha dagaalka iyo aqoonta lagama maarmaanka u ah gudashada waajibaadka qaran. Cutubyadan ayaa loo diyaariyay inay xoojiyaan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee haatan howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ka wada deegaanno ka tirsan Galmudug iyo gobollada kale ee dalka. Hadalka madaxweynaha ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli dowladda federaalka ay xoogga saareyso dhismaha iyo tayeynta ciidamada qaranka, si tartiib-tartiib ahna loogu wareejiyo mas’uuliyadaha amni ee ay hadda qeyb ka yihiin ciidamada howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. AUSSOM ayaa Soomaaliya ka billowday howlgalkiisa Janaayo 2025, kadib markii uu beddelay howlgalka ATMIS, waxaana waajibaadkiisa ugu weyn kamid ah taageeridda ciidamada Soomaaliya, la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab iyo fududeynta in mas’uuliyadda amniga si tartiib ah loogu wareejiyo ciidamada dowladda. Oggolaanshaha hadda ee howlgalka AUSSOM wuxuu ku egyahay 31-ka December 2026, inkastoo muddadaas la kordhin karo haddii xaaladda amni iyo go’aannada Soomaaliya, Midowga Afrika iyo Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ay sidaas noqdaan. Sidaas darteed, qorshaha bixitaanka ciidamada shisheeye wuxuu si weyn ugu xiran yahay awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliya ay u yeeshaan inay la wareegaan goobaha iyo waajibaadka ay hayaan ciidamada Midowga Afrika. The post Daawo: Madaxweyne Xasan oo iclaamiyey in la joogo xilligii bixitaanka ciidanka shisheeye appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Tijaabisay Hannaan Cusub oo Tallaalka Dabaysha lagu Gaarsiinayo Carruurta Muqdisho
items.description: Soomaaliya ayaa tijaabisay hannaan cusub oo lagu gaarsiinayo tallaalka cudurka dabaysha carruurta ku nool degaannada halista sare leh, iyadoo in ka badan 122,000 oo carruur ah lagu tallaalay saddex degmo oo ka tirsan gobolka Banaadir. Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka WHO ayaa sheegtay in ololaha tijaabada ah laga fuliyey degmooyinka Dayniile, Garasbaaley iyo Kaxda, oo loo aqoonsaday degaanno halis sare leh. Muddo shan maalmood ah waxaa tallaalka cusub ee afka laga qaato ee dabaysha nooca labaad (nOPV2) la siiyay 122,067 carruur ah oo da’doodu ka yar tahay shan sano, tiradaas oo u dhiganta 94 boqolkiiba carruurtii la tiigsanayay. Tallaalkan waxaa si gaar ah loogu adeegsadaa ladagaallanka fayraska dabaysha nooca labaad ee bulshada dhexdeeda ku faafa. Hannaanka cusub ayaa xoogga saaraya in xog faahfaahsan loo adeegsado qorshaynta ololaha, halkii lagu tiirsanaan lahaa qiyaaso guud oo keliya. Kooxaha tallaalka ayaa adeegsaday xogta tirada dadka, Nidaamka Macluumaadka Juqraafiyeed ee GIS, oo ah hannaan xogta lagu xiriiriyo goobaha iyo khariidadaha, xaqiijin laga sameeyo goobaha iyo lasocod toos ah si loo ogaado degaannada mudnaanta leh iyo carruurta laga yaabo inay ololaha ka maqnaadaan. WHO ayaa sheegtay in degaannada magaalooyinku leeyihiin caqabado gaar ah, gaar ahaan isbeddelka joogtada ah ee dadka, soogalootiga cusub iyo qoysaska ku nool degaannada aan rasmiga ahayn. Tijaabadan ayaa loogu talagalay in lagu fahmo sida carruurtaas si ka habboon loogu gaari karo, isla markaasna casharrada laga barto loogu adeegsan karo ololayaasha tallaalka ee mustaqbalka. Soomaaliya tan iyo 2014 kama diiwaangelin kiis ka dhashay fayraska dabiiciga ah ee dabaysha, hasayeeshee tan iyo 2017 waxaa dalka ka jiray nooc fayraska dabaysha ah oo ka soo farcamay tallaalka afka laga qaato kuna dhex wareega bulshada, gaar ahaan nooca labaad (cVDPV2). Fayraskan wuxuu muddo dheer ku dhex faafi karaa bulshooyinka ay heerarka tallaalkoodu aadka u hooseeyo, gaar ahaan marka carruur badan aysan helin tallaalka dabaysha. WHO iyo hay’adaha caafimaadku waxay arrintan ku sababeeyeen tallaalidda oo hoosaysa iyo carruurta oo aan si dhammaystiran ah loo wada gaari karin. Xog ay hore u daabacday Xarunta Xakamaynta iyo Kahortagga Cudurrada ee Maraykanka ayaa muujisay in intii u dhexaysay 2017 iyo Maarso 2024 Soomaaliya laga diiwaangeliyey 39 kiis oo cVDPV2 ah oo ku kala baahay 14 gobol, iyadoo carruur badan oo ku nool qaybo ka mid ah koonfurta iyo bartamaha dalka aan si joogto ah loo gaari karin sababo la xiriira amnidarro iyo xannibaado kale. Tijaabada Banaadir waxaa sidaas darteed lagu eegayaa in xogta juqraafiyeed iyo lasocodka waqtiga dhabta ahi ay yarayn karaan tirada carruurta ka maqnaata tallaalka, gaar ahaan degaannada dadka badani ku nool yihiin ama ay si joogto ah ugu soo guurayaan. items.title: Maxkamad Maraykan ah oo oggolaatay Masaafurinta ku dhowaad 1,100 Qof oo Soomaali ah
items.description: Maxkamad federaal ah oo ku taalla Maraykanka ayaa jidka u bannaysay maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump inuu joojiyo Xaaladda Ilaalinta Kumeelgaarka ah (TPS) ee ku dhowaad 1,100 Soomaali ah. TPS ayaa ah ilaalin sharci oo ku meelgaar ah oo Maraykanku siiyo dadka ka soo jeeda dalal ay ka jiraan dagaallo, aafooyin ama xaalado kale oo halis ah, taas oo u saamaxaysa inay dalkaas ku noolaadaan kana shaqeeyaan iyaga oo laga ilaalinayo masaafurinta. Hay’adda Adeegyada Muwaadinnimada iyo Socdaalka Maraykanka (USCIS) ayaa xaqiijisay in ilaalinta Soomaaliya ay si rasmi ah u dhammaatay 14ka Agoosto 2026. Garsoore Allison Burroughs oo ka tirsan Maxkamadda Federaalka ah ee Boston ayaa Jimcihii meesha ka saartay xannibaad maxkamadeed oo tan iyo bishii Maarso hortaagnayd Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha Maraykanka inay hirgeliso go’aanka lagu joojinayo ilaalinta kumeelgaarka ah ee Soomaalida. Isla garsoorahan ayaa bishii Maarso si kumeelgaar ah u hakisay go’aanka, kaddib dacwad ay soo gudbiyeen afar qof oo Soomaali ah iyo laba urur oo u dooda xuquuqda muhaajiriinta. Dacwoodayaashu waxay ku doodayeen in joojinta barnaamijku ay la xiriirto takoor iyo siyaasadda adag ee socdaalka ee maamulka Trump. Go’aanka cusub ayaa yimid kaddib markii Maxkamadda Sare ee Maraykanku ay bishii Juun xaddidday awoodda maxkamadaha hoose ay dib ugu eegayaan go’aannada Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha ee lagu joojinayo ilaalinta kumeelgaarka ah ee dadka ka soo jeeda dalalka kala duwan. Go’aankaasi wuxuu hore jidka ugu furay joojinta ilaalinta dadka ka soo jeeda dalal ay ka mid yihiin Hayti, Suuriya, Koonfurta Suudaan iyo Mayanmaar. Hay’adda Adeegyada Muwaadinnimada iyo Socdaalka Maraykanka (USCIS) waxay hadda xaqiijisay in ilaalinta kumeelgaarka ah ee Soomaaliya la joojiyay laga bilaabo 14ka Agoosto, isla markaasna waraaqihii oggolaanshaha shaqada ee ku xirnaa ilaalintaas aanay hadda sidii hore ugu sii ansaxayn dadka ay go’aanku khusayso. Xaaladda Ilaalinta Kumeelgaarka ah, oo Ingiriisiga lagu yiraahdo Temporary Protected Status, waa ilaalin sharci oo Maraykanku siin karo dadka ka soo jeeda dalal ay ka jiraan dagaallo, masiibooyin dabiici ah ama xaalado kale oo halis gelin kara dib ugu noqoshadooda. Qofka hela ilaalintan waxaa loo oggolaan karaa inuu Maraykanka sii joogo oo ka shaqeeyo inta ay jirto, balse ilaalintu qofka si toos ah uma siinayso deggenaansho rasmi ah. Soomaaliya waxaa markii ugu horraysay ilaalintan loo asteeyey 1991, xilligii uu burburay dalku, waxaana tan iyo markaas marar badan dib loo cusboonaysiiyay. Dawladda Maraykanka ayaa bishii Jannaayo ee sannadkan ku dhawaaqday inay joojinayso, iyadoo ku doodday in xaaladda Soomaaliya ay isbeddeshay oo aysan mar danbe buuxin doonin shuruudihii sharci ee ilaalintan. Xogta rasmiga ah ee Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha waxay muujinaysaa in 1,082 qof ay haysteen ilaalinta kumeelgaarka ah ee Soomaaliya markii go’aanka joojinta la diyaarinayay, halka 1,383 codsi oo kale ay weli sugayeen go’aan ilaa Diseenbar 2025. Joojinta ilaalintan macnaheedu ma aha in dhammaan Soomaalida ay khusayso isla markiiba la masaafurinayo. Qofka haysta sharci kale oo uu Maraykanka ku joogo wuxuu ku sii nagaan karaa sharcigaas; hayeeshee qofkii ku tiirsanaa ilaalintan oo keliya wuxuu luminayaa difaacii gaarka ahaa ee ka hortaagnaa masaafurinta iyo oggolaanshihii shaqada ee ku xirnaa. Go’aanka ayaa saamaynaya bulsho Soomaaliyeed oo muddo dheer Maraykanka ku noolayd, xilli maamulka Trump uu sii adkaynayo siyaasadaha socdaalka iyo masaafurinta dadka aan haysan sharci joogto ah.

items.title: Ciidanka XDS oo sheegay inay fashiliyeen weerar lagu qaaday Baydhabo
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed (XDS) ayaa sheegay inay fashiliyeen weerar ay Al-Shabaab ku qaadeen magaalada Baydhabo, oo ah caasimadda ku-meelgaarka ah ee Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay Taliska Ciidanka XDS, maleeshiyaadka ayaa muddo isku dayayay inay qalqal geliyaan amniga iyo xasilloonida magaalada Baydhabo, xilli magaalada iyo guud ahaan deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed ay ka jireen dhaqdhaqaaqyo amni oo ay ciidamadu ku tilmaameen kuwo khatar ku ah shacabka. Taliska ayaa sheegay in ciidamada dowladda ay si buuxda uga hortageen weerarka, isla markaana ay iska caabin xooggan kala hor tageen kooxihii soo weeraray. Si kastaba, Taliska XDS ma uusan shaacin tirada rasmiga ah ee dadka lagu dilay ama lagu dhaawacay iska horimaadka, sidoo kalena ma jiraan xog madax-bannaan oo hadda si buuxda u xaqiijinaysa baaxadda khasaaraha ay labada dhinac kala gaareen. Taliska Ciidanka XDS ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ciidamada dowladda ay sii wadi doonaan howlaha amniga iyo sugidda xasilloonida Baydhabo, iyadoo shacabka magaalada iyo guud ahaan bulshada Soomaaliyeed loogu baaqay inay muujiyaan feejignaan iyo wada-shaqeyn ay la yeeshaan ciidamada ammaanka.

items.title: Imaaraadka oo si weyn uga gubanaya heshiiska Makkah
items.description: Abu Dhabi (Somalia Today) — Falanqeeye siyaasadeed oo caan ka ah Imaaraadka Carabta, horena la-taliye ugu ahaa Madaxweynaha dalkaas Mohammed bin Zayed, ayaa dhaliyay caro xooggan kaddib markii uu ku jeesjeesay xaaladda dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee Pakistan, isla markaana su’aal geliyay doorka Islamabad ee difaaca Sacuudi Carabiya, iyadoo la hirgelinayo hannaan cusub oo amni oo gobolka ah. Abdulkhaleq Abdulla ayaa Jimcihii bartiisa X ku qoray inay tahay “mid ka mid ah waxyaabaha yaabka leh ee waqtigan” in dal “rubuc ka mid ah dadkiisu sabool yihiin” isla markaana “saddex meelood meel” aysan wax qorin ama akhrin karin uu si “fursad raadis ah” isu soo taago difaaca dal ka mid ah 20-ka dhaqaale ee ugu waaweyn dunida. Falanqeeyaha Imaaraatiga ah ayaa sidoo kale soo hadal qaaday dakhliga guud ee Pakistan iyo hubkeeda nukliyeerka, isagoo ku dooday in dalkaasi tobannaan sano la daalaa dhacayay xasillooni-darro gudaha ah iyo xukun militari, halka awooddiisa nukliyeerka ah uu ka dhigtay waxa ugu weyn ee uu istaraatiijiyad ahaan ku faano. Abdulla wuxuu sheegay in Pakistan ay “tan iyo markii la aas-aasay la dhibtooneysay xukun militari oo musuqmaasuq ah, qalalaase gudaha ah oo joogto noqday iyo dagaallo ay la gashay dalalka deriska ugu dhow”, isagoo intaas ku daray in waxa ugu weyn ee Pakistan ay haysato ay yihiin “170 bam oo nukliyeer ah”. La-taliyihii hore ee madaxtooyada Imaaraadka ayaa sida muuqata ula jeeday Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Istaraatiijiga ah ee Pakistan iyo Sacuudi Carabiya, oo la saxiixay 17-kii Sebtembar 2025, kaas oo dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado midkood loo arko weerar lagu qaaday labada dal. Hase yeeshee, qoraalkiisa oo tan iyo markii la daabacay helay in ka badan hal milyan oo daawasho, ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay walaaca uu gudaha Imaaraadka ka abuuray heshiiska ballaaran ee Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makkah, oo ay ku mideysan yihiin Pakistan, Turkiga iyo Sacuudi Carabiya. Jawaabaha carada leh ee Pakistan Hadalka Abdulla ee lagu duray Pakistan ayaa dhaliyay jawaab-celin xooggan, gaar ahaan iyadoo ku dhowaad 1.6 milyan oo Pakistaniyiin ah ay ku nool yihiin Imaaraadka, kana mid yihiin dadka sida weyn lacagaha dibadda uga dira dalkooda. Mid ka mid ah dadka uga jawaabay ayaa yiri: “In saboolnimada iyo baaxadda dhaqaalaha lala xiriiriyo mowqif siyaasadeed waa marin-habaabin.” “Pakistan waa dal madax-bannaan oo leh dano iyo xulufo, xaqa ay u leedahay inay door ka qaadato arrimaha caalamiga ahna kuma xirna hantideeda. Sidoo kale, in awooddeeda lagu soo koobo hubka nukliyeerka waxay iska indha-tiraysaa miisaankeeda dadweyne iyo juqraafi-siyaasadeed, iyo dhaqaalaheeda oo dhaafay $400 bilyan,” ayuu qofkaasi raaciyay. Dad kale ayaa dib u soo faafiyay qoraallo hore oo Abdulla uu ka sameeyay Pakistan iyo Israel, si ay u muujiyaan waxa ay ku tilmaameen is-burin ku jirta mowqifyadiisa. Mid ka mid ah qoraalladaas ayuu hore ugu yiri: “Ha halaago qof kasta oo Khaliiji ah oo ku baaqa caadiyeynta xiriirka cadowga Israel.” Qof kale oo barta X isticmaala ayaa dib u soo dhigay hadal uu Abdulla qoray 2015, xilligii faragelintii militari ee Sacuudi Carabiya hoggaamineysay ee Yemen. Markaas ayuu Abdulla yiri: “Diblomaasiyadda Khaliijka iyo Sacuudiga waxay ahayd inay u dhaqaaqdo si xooggan oo miisaan leh, noqoto mid qancisa, isla markaana adeegsato dhammaan awooddeeda si Pakistan loogu kasbado inay ka qeyb gasho Hawlgalka Duufaanta Go’aanka.” Abdulla ayaa horayba su’aal uga keenay macnaha iyo qaabka heshiiska cusub. “Waxaan hambalyeynayaa aas-aaska isbahaysigan, laakiin xoojinta iskaashiga milatari iyo siyaasadeed ee Khaliijka iyo mideynta gudaha Khaliijka ayaa aad uga muhiimsan in maalgelin lagu sameeyo iskaashi goboleed oo milatari iyo siyaasadeed, kaas oo ay ku jiraan dalal aan si dhab ah loogu kalsoonayn awooddooda iyo mowqifkooda ku aaddan khatarta Iran iyo Israel,” ayuu Abdulla ku qoray mid ka mid ah dhowr qoraal oo uu sameeyay 7-dii Agoosto, maalintii heshiiska Makkah la saxiixay. “Shuruudaha lagu guuleysto isbahaysi kasta waxaa ka mid ah in la qeexo cadowga la wada leeyahay. Haddaba, yaa cadow u ah dalalka isbahaysigan?” ayuu raaciyay. Abdulaziz Altwaijri, madaxii hore ee Ururka Islaamka ee Waxbarashada, Sayniska iyo Dhaqanka ee Isesco, oo ah hay’ad hoos tagta Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka ee OIC, ayaa qoraalkaas uga jawaabay barta X, isagoo si dadban u tilmaamay xiriirka Imaaraadka iyo Israel. “Qof kasta oo khiyaaneeya oo la shaqeeya Sahyuuniyadda waligiis amni heli maayo,” ayuu yiri. Markii uu ka jawaabayay qoraalkii Abdulla ee Pakistan, Altwaijri wuxuu mar kale ku qoray X: “Waxay u muuqataa in xanuunka heshiiska Makkah uu madax wareer kugu riday.” Loollanka isbahaysiyada gobolka Hadal-is-weydaarsigan cusub wuxuu iftiiminayaa khilaaf sii qoto dheeraanaya oo u dhexeeya Imaaraadka, oo ahaa dalkii ugu horreeyay ee Khaliijka ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Israel, iyo Sacuudi Carabiya oo weli diiddan inay Israel aqoonsato inkastoo cadaadis kaga yimid Mareykanka. Xiriirka labada dal ayaa sii xumaaday sababo la xiriira taageerada Abu Dhabi ay siiso kooxaha gooni-u-goosadka ee koonfurta Yemen. Falanqeeyayaal ayaa sidoo kale heshiiska Makkah u arka jawaab ama miisaan ka dhan ah iskaashiga militari ee Imaaraadka iyo Israel, kaas oo aan taageero weyn ka haysan meel ka baxsan Israel iyo Mareykanka. Theodore Singer, oo hore uga tirsanaa sirdoonka Mareykanka, ayaa Middle East Eye u sheegay: “Marka hore la eego, isbahaysiga Imaaraadka iyo Israel wuxuu labada dhinac siinayaa faa’iidooyin si cad loo arki karo, laakiin heshiiska Makkah waxaa suurtagal ah inuu mustaqbalka yeesho saameyn ka ballaaran oo aan ku koobneyn dano degdeg ah.” Bishii May, markii Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu uu sheegay inuu booqday Imaaraadka xilligii uu socday dagaalkii Iran, Abu Dhabi ayaa si degdeg ah u beenisay warkaas. Taas beddelkeeda, heshiiska Makkah si furan ayaa loo soo bandhigay loona xusay. Waxaa la shaaciyay in Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Mohammed bin Salman, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif iyo Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan ay salaaddii Jimcaha si wadajir ah ugu tukadeen magaalada ugu barakeysan Islaamka. Qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha ayaa qaba in xaqiiqda ah in saddexda dal ay heshiiskooda si cad oo rasmi ah u qeexeen ay siin karto fursad uu ku kobco, si ka duwan iskaashiga Imaaraadka iyo Israel oo dhinacyo badan ku kooban. Loollanka Imaaraadka iyo Sacuudiga ee ka muuqda hadallada Abdulla ayaa sidoo kale laga dareemayaa doodda ku saabsan cidda laga reebay heshiiska, iyadoo Riyadh ay sii kordhineyso shakiga ay ka qabto sida Madaxweynaha Masar Abdel Fattah el-Sisi ugu dhow yahay Abu Dhabi. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa la sheegay inay kasoo horjeesatay in Masar lagu daro heshiiska cusub ee difaaca, iyadoo walaac ka muujisay waxa ay u aragto in Qaahira si xad-dhaaf ah ugu tiirsan tahay Imaaraadka. Masar ayaa nidaamyo difaaca cirka ah iyo diyaarado dagaal u dirtay Abu Dhabi kaddib weerarro Iran ka geysatay Imaaraadka, halka Sisi uu Mohammed bin Zayed booqday in ka badan hal mar intii uu dagaalku socday. Tallaabooyin la mid ah kama uusan qaadin dhinaca Sacuudi Carabiya. Riyadh waxay sidoo kale qabtaa in dhowr ka mid ah siyaasadaha Imaaraadka ay lid ku yihiin danaha istaraatiijiga ah ee Masar, oo ay ka mid yihiin ku lug lahaanshaha Abu Dhabi ee gobolka Somaliland ee Soomaaliya iyo xiriirka istaraatiijiga ah ee ay la leedahay Israel. Khilaafaadka kale waxaa ka mid ah taageerada Imaaraadka ee Itoobiya xilligii muranka Biyo-xireenka Weyn ee Itoobiya, iyo taageerada Abu Dhabi ay siiso ciidamada RSF ee Sudan. Sida ay horay u werisay Middle East Eye , Masar ma dooneyso inay si cad dhinac uga raacdo laba isbahaysi oo gobolka ka soo baxaya: Turkiga, Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Pakistan oo dhinac ah, iyo Israel, Imaaraadka iyo India oo dhinaca kale ah. Masar waxay sidoo kale heshiis difaac la leedahay Abu Dhabi, waxayna bishii May diyaaradaha dagaalka Rafale u dirtay Imaaraadka kaddib weerarradii Iran, arrintaas oo Sacuudi Carabiya ku sii xoojisay aragtida ah in Qaahira aysan ahayn xulufo si buuxda loogu kalsoonaan karo. items.title: Baidoa: Somali federal forces drive out forces loyal to former South West leader
items.description: Heavy fighting lasting several hours broke out in the Somali city of Baidoa on Monday after federal government forces clashed with armed groups loyal to former South West State president Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Bisha 9-aad ee Sannadkan Billaabaysa Dhoofinta Kalluunka ee Shiinaha
items.description: Soomaaliya ayaa lagu wadaa inay bisha Sebteembar billowdo dhoofinta kalluunka iyo wax-soosaarka kale ee badda ee loo iibgeynayo Shiinaha, iyadoo la hirgelinayo heshiis canshuurdhaaf ah (tariff-free) oo labada dal kala saxiixdeen bishii hore. Qorshaha billaabidda dhoofinta ayaa la shaaciyay toddobaadkan, kaddib heshiiskii 13kii Luulyo ay Muqdisho ku kala saxiixdeen Wasiirka Kalluumaysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ah ee Soomaaliya, Axmed Xasan Aadan, iyo Safiirka Shiinaha ee Soomaaliya, Wang Yu. Heshiiska ayaa dhigaya in waxsoosaarka kalluunka Soomaaliya, oo ay ka mid yihiin tuunnada iyo aargoosatada, loo dhoofin karo suuqa Shiinaha iyadoo laga dhaafayo canshuuraha kastamka. Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda Kalluumaysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ah, Cabdi Diirshe , ayaa sheegay in heshiisku yahay tallaabo taariikhi ah oo lagu doonayo in lagu kobciyo dhaqaalaha buluugga ah, lagu abuuro shaqooyin, laguna soo jiito maalgelin ku wajahan kaydinta qabowga iyo silsiladda gaarsiinta kalluunka. Billowga dhoofinta kalluunka ayaa Soomaaliya u furaya mid ka mid ah suuqyada ugu waaweyn ee waxsoosaarka badda, xilli dawladdu ku hawlantahay sidii kheyraadka xeebaha dalka looga dhigi lahaa il dhaqaale oo kaabaya xoolaha iyo beeraha. Soomaaliya waxay leedahay xeeb dhererkeedu ka badan yahay 3,500 oo kiiloomitir, hasayeeshee qaybta kalluumaysigu muddo dheer kama aysan helin kaabayaal ku filan oo dhinacyada qaboojinta, farsamaynta, gaadiidka iyo suuqgeynta ah. Masuuliyiinta Soomaaliya ayaa rejaynaya in helitaanka suuqa Shiinuhu dhiirrigeliyo maalgelinta dekedaha, goobaha kalluunka laga dejiyo, xarumaha farsamaynta iyo kaydadka qabowga, kuwaas oo muhiim u ah in kalluunka Soomaaliyeed si joogto ah loogu dhoofiyo suuqyada dibadda. Heshiiska ayaa, sidoo kale, imanaya xilli Soomaaliya ay iskudayayso inay ballaariso dhaqaalaha buluugga ah, iyadoo dhinaca kale wajahaysa caqabado ay ka mid yihiin kalluumaysiga sharcidarrada ah iyo awoodda kooban ee lagu ilaaliyo biyaha dalka. Waxaa hadda indhaha lagu hayaa sida loo hirgelin doono dhoofinta bisha Sebteembar, shirkadaha Soomaaliyeed ee kaqaybqaadan doona, dekedaha laga dhoofin doono iyo heerarka tayada ee kalluunka looga baahan doono si uu u galo suuqa Shiinaha.

Masuuliyiinta Soomaaliya ayaa rejaynaya in helitaanka suuqa Shiinuhu dhiirrigeliyo maalgelinta dekedaha, goobaha kalluunka laga dejiyo, xarumaha farsamaynta iyo kaydadka qabowga, kuwaas oo muhiim u ah in kalluunka Soomaaliyeed si joogto ah loogu dhoofiyo suuqyada dibadda. Heshiiska ayaa, sidoo kale, imanaya xilli Soomaaliya ay iskudayayso inay ballaariso dhaqaalaha buluugga ah, iyadoo dhinaca kale wajahaysa caqabado ay ka mid yihiin kalluumaysiga sharcidarrada ah iyo awoodda kooban ee lagu ilaaliyo biyaha dalka. Waxaa hadda indhaha lagu hayaa sida loo hirgelin doono dhoofinta bisha Sebteembar, shirkadaha Soomaaliyeed ee kaqaybqaadan doona, dekedaha laga dhoofin doono iyo heerarka tayada ee kalluunka looga baahan doono si uu u galo suuqa Shiinaha.

items.title: ONLF oo u dabbaaldegtay 42-guuradii aasaaskeeda, kuna dhawaaqday qorshe siyaasadeed cusub
items.description: Jabhadda ONLF/JWXO ayaa munaasabado kala duwan ku qabatay magaalooyin ka tirsan dalal badan oo dunida ah, iyadoo lagu xusayay 42-guuradii ka soo wareegtay markii ururka la aasaasay 15-kii Agoosto 1984. Munaasabadaha ayaa ka dhacay magaalooyin ay ka mid yihiin Nairobi ee Kenya iyo London , iyadoo sidoo kale xusaska lagu qabtay meelo kale oo ay ku nool yihiin taageerayaasha iyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee daneeya qadiyadda ONLF. Xusaska sanadkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ONLF ay sheegtay inay xoogga saarayso halgan siyaasadeed iyo mid diblomaasiyadeed, iyadoo ururku muddo dheer u ololeynayay in shacabka Soomaalida ee ku nool deegaanka Soomaalida Itoobiya ay helaan xaqa ay u leeyihiin inay go’aansadaan mustaqbalkooda siyaasadeed. ONLF waxaa la aasaasay sanadkii 1984, waxaana dhidibada u taagay lix xubnood oo hore uga tirsanaa WSLF iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyadii la xiriiray. Intii ay socdeen munaasabadaha, afhayeenka ONLF, Caddaani Hirmooge , ayaa ka hadlay jihada siyaasadeed ee ururka iyo qorshayaasha uu sheegay in ay horyaallaan. Waxa uu sheegay in ONLF ay hiigsanayso in sannadka soo socda ay munaasabadda sanad-guuradeeda ku qabato gudaha Deegaanka Soomaalida, gaar ahaan magaalada Jigjiga , haddii xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ay saamaxdo. Hirmooge ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ONLF ay doonayso inay door muuqda ka qaadato hoggaaminta siyaasadeed ee Deegaanka Soomaalida, isagoo tilmaamay in ururku hiigsanayo in shacabka deegaanka ay helaan awood ay ku maamulaan arrimahooda siyaasadeed, dhaqaale iyo khayraadka deegaanka. Afhayeenku wuxuu sidoo kale ka hadlay qorsheyaasha ururka ee dhinaca caalamiga ah, isagoo sheegay in ONLF ay doonayso in qadiyadda shacabka Soomaalida Itoobiya loo gudbiyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah, oo ay ku jirto Qaramada Midoobay , si loo helo taageero caalami ah oo ku saabsan waxa ururku ugu yeero xaqa is-determinayshanka. ONLF ayaa muddo dheer la dagaallamaysay dowladda Itoobiya, hase yeeshee sannadkii 2018 waxay heshiis nabadeed la saxiixatay dowladda uu hoggaaminayay Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed, iyadoo ururku ka guuray dagaalkii hubeysnaa una wareegay halgan siyaasadeed. Si kastaba, ONLF ayaa sannadihii dambe muujisay walaac ku saabsan xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Deegaanka Soomaalida iyo sida loo fulinayo qodobbadii heshiiska nabadeed, ayadoo dowladda Itoobiya ay iyaduna sheegtay inay weli muhiim tahay in la ilaaliyo heshiiska nabadda.

items.title: Somaliland oo war ka soo saartay booqashada QM ee magaalada Laascaanood e
items.description: War-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Somaliland ayaa lagu sheegay in Somaliland ay weli ka go’an tahay fududeynta gaarsiinta gargaarka bani’aadannimo dhammaan dadka u baahan, oo ay ku jiraan bulshada ku nool Laascaanood. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Somaliland waxay sheegtay in booqashooyinka saraakiisha sare ee Qaramada Midoobay ee goobaha xasaasiga ah ee dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo amniga ay tahay in lagu maro habraacyada diblomaasiyadeed ee jira. Waxay intaas ku dartay in booqashooyinka noocaas ah loo baahan yahay in dowladda Somaliland horay loogu sii wargeliyo, lagala tashado, isla markaana lala sameeyo isku-duwid rasmi ah. Somaliland waxay sheegtay inay qiimeyso xiriirka iyo iskaashiga muddada dheer ee ay la leedahay Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo xustay inay doonayso in wada-shaqayntaasi ay sii socoto. Somaliland waxay sidoo kale sheegtay inay filayso in mustaqbalka si buuxda loo dhowro habraacyada diblomaasiyadeed iyo waddooyinka rasmiga ah ee isgaarsiinta. Hadalkaan ayaa ku soo aadaya iyadoo Ku-simaha Madaxweynaha uu xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay wafdi uu hoggaaminayay ku xigeenka Ergayga Gaarka ah ee Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, ahna Isuduwaha Arrimaha Gargaarka bani’aadannimada George Conway.‎‎Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga iyo wada-shaqaynta dowladda Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya iyo Qaramada Midoobay.

items.title: Xoghayaha Guud ee Aagga Ganacsiga Xorta ah ee Qaaradda Afrika oo Xamar Yimid
items.description: Soomaaliya ayaa qaaday tallaabo kale oo ku wajahan ballaarinta kaqaybgalkeeda suuqyada Afrika, kaddib ku biiritaankeedii Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC), iyadoo Muqdisho uu booqasho rasmi ah ku yimid Xoghayaha Guud ee Aagga Ganacsiga Xorta ah ee Qaaradda Afrika (AfCFTA), Wamkele Mene. Mene, oo Muqdisho soo gaaray 16ka Agoosto, waxaa Garoonka Aadan Cadde ku qaabbilay Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliya, Jamaal Maxamed Xasan. Booqashadiisu waxay socon doontaa ilaa 18ka Agoosto, waxaana la filayaa inuu kulammo la yeesho masuuliyiin ka tirsan Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed. Wadahadallada ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa hirgelinta AfCFTA, fursadaha uu heshiisku siin karo ganacsiyada Soomaaliyeed iyo sida Soomaaliya uga faa’iidaysan karto suuqa qaaradda oo ay ku nool yihiin in ka badan 1.4 bilyan oo qof. Booqashada ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay sii waddo geeddisocodka isdhexgalka dhaqaale ee gobolka iyo qaaradda. Soomaaliya waxaa Bulshada Bariga Afrika loo oggolaaday inay xubin ka noqoto 24kii Nofeembar 2023, waxayna heshiiska ku biirista saxiixday 15kii Diseenbar ee sannadkaas, ka hor intii aysan xubin buuxda noqon 4tii Maarso 2024. EAC ayaa hadda ka kooban siddeed dal. Ku biirista EAC waxay Soomaaliya gelisay hannaan isdhexgal dhaqaale oo goboleed oo ay ka mid yihiin isusocodka badeecadaha, adeegyada, raasamaalka iyo shaqaalaha. Kaddib xubinnimadaas, Soomaaliya iyo EAC waxay billaabeen diyaarinta qorshe lagu waafajinayo sharciyada iyo hay’adaha dalka nidaamyada Bulshada Bariga Afrika, si Soomaaliya ay si buuxda uga faa’iidaysato xubinnimada ururka. AfCFTA waxaa loogu talagalay in dalalka Afrika ay fududeeyaan ganacsiga dhexdooda, iyagoo dhimaya caqabadaha canshuuraha iyo kuwa kale ee hortaagan isusocodka badeecadaha iyo adeegyada. Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in booqashada Mene ay ku soo aaday iyadoo Soomaaliya qaadayso tallaabooyin muhiim ah oo ay kaga mid noqonayso ugana faa’iidaysanayso suuqa ganacsiga xorta ah ee qaaradda. Inta uu joogo Muqdisho, dhinacyadu waxay sidoo kale ka wadahadli doonaan sidii ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed loogu diyaarin lahaa fursadaha suuqa Afrika. Labada hannaan—EAC iyo AfCFTA—ayaa gebi ahaanba kala duwan: EAC waa ururgoboleed ay Soomaaliya xubin buuxda ka tahay, halka AfCFTA uu yahay hannaan ganacsi oo heer qaaradeed ah, hasayeeshee, labaduba waxay Soomaaliya siinayaan fursad ay dhaqaalaha dalka ugu xirto suuqyo ka ballaaran kuwii ay dhaqanka u lahayd. Booqashada Xoghayaha Guud ee AfCFTA ayaa ku soo aadaysa wax ka badan laba sano kaddib markii Soomaaliya si buuxda ugu biirtay Bulshada Bariga Afrika, iyadoo hadda raadineysa sidii xubinnimada gobolka loogu sii xiri lahaa fursadaha ganacsi ee qaaradda inteeda kale.

items.title: Ciidamada  Lafta-gareen oo soo weeraray Baydhaba iyo dagaal culus oo ka qarxay
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya magaalada Baydhabo ayaa sheegaya in saaka ciidamada taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ay weerar culus ku qaadeen gudaha magaaladaasi, waxaana xigay dagaal culus oo ay la galeen ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo kuwa maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ee ku sugan halkaasi. Dagaalka oo ahaa mid xooggan ayaa dhiancyadu waxay isku adeegsadeen hubka noocyadiisa kala duwan, waxaana jiro khasaare soo kala gaaray labada dhinac iyo shacabka lagu kor dagaalamay. Afhayeen u hadlay ciidamada Lafta-gareen oo lagu magacaabo Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed ayaa sheegtay inay si buuxda ula wareegeen magaalada, isla markaana ciidamadooda ay soo celiyeen gobonnimadeedii iyo sharaftii magaalada Baydhabo, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Ciidamada Daraawiishta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed waxay si buuxda gacanta ugu dhigeen magaalada Baydhabo waxay soo celiyeen gobonnimadeedii iyo sharafteedii,” ayuu yiri Afhayeenka. Sidoo kale, wuxuu farriin u diray dadka deegaanka oo uu ugu baaqay inay bannaanka usoo baxaan, soona dhaweeyaan ciidamadooda, oo uu tilmaamay inay soo celinayaan nidaamka Koonfur Galbeed. “Shacabka Baydhabo waxaan leenahay bannaanka usoo baxa waxaad ka baqeysaan maleh ciidamada Daraawiishta ayaa si buuxda gacanta ugu haya magaalada,” ayuu sii raaciyay Afhayeenku. Dhinaca kale, saraakiil u hadashay ciidamada dowladda ayaa iyagana guul ka sheegtay dagaalka, waxayna tilmaameen inay iska difaaceen ciidamada weerarka soo qaaday, ayna dib u celiyeen. Xaaladda ayaa weli kacsan, waxaana meelaha qaar laga maqlayaa rasaas teel teel ah, sida ay soo sheegayaan dadka deegaanka oo saaka ku waabariistay dagaal culus oo ka qarxay gudaha magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay. items.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo ka Hadashay Socdaalkii Laascaanood ee Kuxigeenka Ergayga QM
items.description: Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in gobolka Sool uu ka mid yahay degaannada sida daran ay u saamaysay abaarta ba’an ee ka jirta Soomaaliya, iyadoo qoysaska ku nool Laascaanood iyo nawaaxigeeda ay wajahayaan barakac, biyo iyo cunto yaraan iyo adeegyo aasaasi ah oo aad u kooban. Isuduwaha Qaramada Midoobay ee Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada Soomaaliya, George Conway, ayaa booqday Laascaanood, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay qoysas ay abaartu saamaysay. Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Isuduwidda Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada (OCHA) ayaa sheegay in dadka uu Conway la kulmay ay baahi weyn u qabaan gargaar degdeg ah. OCHA waxay tilmaantay shan dhibaato oo waaweyn oo qoysaskaasi hadda wajahayaan: barakac, biyo iyo cunto yaraan, adeegyada caafimaadka oo kooban, hoy iyo ilaalin aan ku filnayn iyo taageerada bani’aadannimo oo xaddidan. Hay’addu waxay ku baaqday in si degdeg ah loo kordhiyo gargaarka la gaarsiinayo dadka ay abaartu saamaysay. Xaaladda Sool waxay qayb ka tahay dhibaato bani’aadannimo oo guud ahaan Soomaaliya kasii cuslaanaysa. OCHA ayaa bishan Agoosto sheegtay in 6.5 milyan oo qof oo Soomaaliya ku nool ay la tacaalayaan gaajo, xilli abaarta soo noqnoqotay, colaadaha iyo yaraanshaha maalgelinta gargaarku ay isku biireen. Bilowgii 2026, Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya, Qaramada Midoobay iyo hay’adaha gargaarku waxay codsadeen $852 milyan si sannadkan gargaar naf-badbaadin ah loo gaarsiiyo 2.4 milyan oo qof. Hasayeeshee, farqiga maalgelintu weli waa weyn yahay. Yaraanta dhaqaaluhu waxay ka dhigan tahay in baahida dadka ay kordhayso xilli awoodda hay’adaha gargaarku ay sii yaraanayso. Conway ayaa horraantii sannadkan ka digay in hoosudhaca aan hore loo arag ee maalgelintu uu si weyn u wiiqay awoodda hay’adaha bani’aadannimada ee gaarsiinta adeegyada naf-badbaadinta. Booqashada Laascaanood waxay hadda indhaha ku soo celinaysaa xaaladda Sool, halkaas oo dhibaatada abaartu aysan ku koobnayn oo keliya biyo la’aan, balse ay isku sidkan yihiin gaajo, barakac, caafimaad xumo, hoy la’aan iyo yaraanta gargaarka.

items.title: Duqa Gaalkacyo: “Waxaan rabnaa inaan ka baxno Buntilaan iyo Galmudug”
items.description: Duqa Gaalkacyo ee dhinaca Buntilaan, Xuseen Cabdinuur Maxamed, ayaa sheegay inay doonayaan in mustaqbalka dhow magaalada Gaalkacyo laga dhigo magaalo iskeed isu maamusha oo aan hoos iman labada maamulgoboleed ee Buntilaan iyo Galmudug. Hadalkan ayaa soo baxaya xilli Gaalkacyo ay mar kale xuddun u noqotay xiisadda siyaasadeed ee u dhexaysa Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Buntilaan. “Mustaqbalka dhowna waxaan rabnaa in aan ka baxno labada maamul oo noqonno magaalo ismaamusha oo ka jirta Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri Xuseen Cabdinuur Maxamed. Duqa ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Gaalkacyo ay leedahay xeerar iyo nidaam u gaar ah oo ay tahay in la dhowro, isaga oo ku baaqay in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee ka jira Garoowe iyo Muqdisho aan loo soo rarin magaalada Gaalkacyo. Hadalka Xuseen Cabdinuur ayaa yimid xilli xaaladda Gaalkacyo si dhow isha loogu hayo, kaddib markii Buntilaan ay maalmo ka hor ka digtay safar Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud la sheegay inuu ku tagayo koonfurta magaalada ee ay maamusho Galmudug maanta oo Isniin ah. Buntilaan waxay ku doodday in safarku kordhin karo xiisadda siyaasadeed iyo tan amni, halka Galmudug ay diidday walaacaas, iyadoo sheegtay in Madaxweynaha JFS uu xaq u leeyahay inuu booqdo degaannada dalka oo dhan. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa 14ka Agoosto gaaray Dhuusamareeb, halkaas oo uu ka bilaabay safar uu ku marayo Galmudug, ayadoo Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya ay sheegtay in safarkiisu la xiriiro horumarinta iyo xoojinta arrimaha ciidamada, mashaariicda horumarinta iyo latashiyada bulshada. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Buntilaan, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa ku sugan Gaalkacyo, dhinaca Buntilaan. Madaxtooyada Buntilaan ayaa 15ka Agoosto sheegtay in Deni, oo safarshaqo ku jooga magaalada Gaalkacyo, uu kulan la yeeshay masuuliyiin iyo saraakiil ku sugan gobolka Mudug. Xiisadda cusub ayaa salka ku hayaa iska-hor-imaadkii 5ta Agoosto ka dhacay waqooyiga Gaalkacyo, markaas oo ciidamada Buntilaan ay la wareegeen gacankuhaynta xero ay haysteen ciidamo ka tirsan PSF oo taabacsanaa Dawladda Federaalka ah. Dhacdadaas ayaa sii adkaysay khilaafka muddada soo jiitamayey ee u dhexeeya Garoowe iyo Muqdisho. Hadalka cusub ee Duqa Gaalkacyo wuxuu doodda ku soo kordhinayaa aragti ka duwan muranka labada dhinac: in magaalada, oo maamul ahaan u kala qaybsan Buntilaan iyo Galmudug, mustaqbalka dhow yeelato hannaan ay si gaar ah isugu maamusho. Ilaa hadda ma jiro go’aan rasmi ah ama hannaan siyaasadeed oo dhaafsiisan hadalka Duqa Gaalkacyo ee daanta Buntilaan.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Qatar oo Dib u Eegaya Iskaashigooda ka dib Kulan ka Dhacay Muqdisho
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali, ayaa Axaddii Muqdisho kula kulmay safiirka Qatar u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Dr. Cabdullaahi bin Saalim Al-Nucaymi, iyadoo labada dhinac ay dib u eegeen xidhiidhka iskaashi ee Soomaaliya iyo Qatar. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Qatar ayaa sheegtay in kulanka lagu falanqeeyey iskaashiga labada dal, hasayeeshee faahfaahin dheeraad ah kama aysan bixin dhinacyada gaarka ah ee laga wada hadlay ama in heshiisyo cusub laga gaaray. Kulanka ayaa imanaya maalmo kaddib markii wafdi ka socday dawladda Qatar oo uu hoggaaminayey Talal bin Rashid Al-Hajri uu Muqdisho kula kulmay masuuliyiin ka tirsan Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo wadahadalladaas diiradda lagu saaray fursadaha maalgashi ee waxsoosaarka cuntada iyo caafimaadka. Wafdiga Qatar ayaa sidoo kale Ra’iisulwasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre kala hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga dhaqaale iyo horumarineed ee labada dal. Wada-hadallo kale oo dhacay 11ka Agoosto ayaa lagu soo qaaday fursadaha maalgashi ee xoolaha, beeraha, kalluumaysiga, waxsoosaarka cuntada, caafimaadka iyo maalgelinta horumarinta, iyadoo labada dhinac ay muujinayaan danayn ku aaddan ballaarinta iskaashiga dhaqaale. Hasayeeshee, bayaanka laga soo saaray kulankii Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya iyo safiirka Qatar ma sheegin in mashaariicdaas maalgashi ay si gaar ah uga mid ahaayeen qodobbada kulankii Axadda. Waxa keliya ee sida rasmi ah loo xaqiijiyay ayaa ah in labada dhinac ay dib u eegeen xiriirka iskaashi ee Soomaaliya iyo Qatar.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Sheegay in la Joogo Xilligii Ciidamada Shisheeye la Sagootin lahaa: Maxaa Xiga AUSSOM?
items.description: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay gaartay xilli ciidamadeedu qaadaan masuuliyadda amniga dalka, ciidammada shisheeyahana ugu dambayn laga maarmo. Madaxweynuhu wuxuu hadalkan jeediyay Axaddii, isaga oo ku sugan Galmudug, halkaas oo uu kaga qaybgalay munaasabad lagu soo gebagebeeyay tababarka ciidamo cusub oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Dawladdu waxay ciidammadaas ku tilmaantay qayb ka mid ah dadaalka lagu xoojinayo awoodda Soomaaliya ay kula wareegayso sugidda amnigeeda. Hadalka Madaxweynaha ayaa imanaya iyadoo hawlgalka AUSSOM uu weli qayb ka yahay sugidda amniga Soomaaliya iyo dagaalka ka dhanka ah argaggaxisada al-Shabaab. items.title: Somaliland oo ka carootay tallaabo ay QM qaaday oo ku saabsan Laascaanod
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Somaliland ayaa Axaddii ka horyimid booqasho ay wafdi sare oo ka socda Qaramada Midoobay ku tageen magaalada Laascaanood, isaga oo sheegay in safarrada noocaas ah ee lagu tagayo deegaannada ay isku hayaan dhinacyada siyaasadeed ay tahay in marka hore lagala soo xiriiro Hargeysa. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Somaliland ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay 16-ka Agoosto ku sheegtay in maamulka lagu wargeliyay booqashada wafdiga Qaramada Midoobay, balse aysan faahfaahin cidda wafdiga hoggaamineysa iyo ujeeddada rasmiga ah ee safarkooda. Somaliland waxay sheegtay inay weli diyaar u tahay fududeynta gargaarka bani’aadannimo ee la gaarsiinayo dhammaan dadka u baahan, oo ay ku jiraan dadka ku nool Laascaanood, kuwaas oo ay bayaanka ku tilmaantay “dadkeenna”. Hase yeeshee, waxay ku adkeysatay in booqashooyinka ay saraakiisha sare ee Qaramada Midoobay ku tagayaan goobaha ay ku tilmaantay kuwa “siyaasiyan iyo amni ahaan xasaasiga ah” lagu maro habraacyada diblomaasiyadeed, laguna saleeyo ogeysiis, wadatashi iyo isku-duwid lala sameeyo maamulka Hargeysa. “Dowladdu waxay qiimeyneysaa wada-shaqeynta muddada dheer ee ay la leedahay Qaramada Midoobay, waxaana weli ka go’an xiriir wax-ku-ool ah,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka, iyadoo Somaliland ay dalbatay in la dhowro habraacyada iyo dariiqyada isgaarsiineed ee hore loo dejiyay. Sheegasho aan gacan ku jirin Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Laascaanood ay si buuxda gacanta ugu hayso Dowladda Waqooyi Bari ee Soomaaliya, halka Somaliland ay weli sheegato magaalada iyo qaybo kale oo ka tirsan gobollada Sool iyo Sanaag. Xiisadda Laascaanood waxay si weyn u qaraxday dhammaadkii 2022 iyo bilowgii 2023, markii mudaharaadyo iyo rabshado ka dhashay dilal ka dhacay magaalada ay isu beddeleen dagaal u dhexeeya ciidamada Somaliland iyo xoogagga deegaanka ee taageersanaa SSC-Khaatumo. Odayaasha dhaqanka ee deegaanka ayaa xilligaas sheegay inay doonayaan inay ka hoos baxaan maamulka Somaliland oo ay si toos ah uga mid noqdaan nidaamka federaalka Soomaaliya. Dagaalladii xigay waxay sababeen dhimashada boqolaal qof, dhaawacyo iyo barakac ballaaran, iyadoo hay’adaha caalamiga ah ay marar badan ku baaqeen xabbad-joojin iyo ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah. Bishii Agoosto 2023, ciidamada Somaliland ayaa laga saaray Laascaanood kadib dagaal culus, waxaana tan iyo markaas magaalada gacanta ku hayay maamulka ka dhashay SSC-Khaatumo. Khilaafka ayaa galay marxalad siyaasadeed oo cusub sanadkii 2025, markii shir ka dhacay Laascaanood lagu dhisay Dowladda Waqooyi Bari ee Soomaaliya, laguna ansixiyay dastuurkeeda. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa bishii Agoosto 2025 ku dhawaaqday in geeddi-socodka dhismaha maamulka la soo gabagabeeyay, isla markaana uu ka mid noqday dowlad-goboleedyada federaalka Soomaaliya. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Janaayo 2026 tegay Laascaanood, halkaas oo uu kaga qeyb-galay caleema-saarka Madaxweynaha Waqooyi Bari, Cabdulqaadir Axmed Aw-Cali Firdhiye. Xasan Sheekh ayaa xilligaas ku dhawaaqay in Waqooyi Bari ay tahay dowlad-goboleed buuxa oo ka tirsan Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, arrintaas oo sii adkeysay mowqifka Muqdisho ee ku aaddan Laascaanood. Somaliland, oo sheegata in Soomaaliya ka go’day 1991, ayaa dhankeeda ku adkeysaneysa in Laascaanood iyo deegaannada ku hareeraysan ay qayb ka yihiin dhulka ay sheegato. Mowqifka Somaliland ee arrintan ayaa sidoo kale kusoo aadaya xilli xaaladda diblomaasiyadeed ee maamulka Hargeysa ay is beddeshay. Israel ayaa bishii December 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland, tallaabadaas oo ay Soomaaliya si xooggan u diidday, halka Midowga Afrika iyo dalal kale ay dib u xaqiijiyeen taageeradooda midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya.   The post Somaliland oo ka carootay tallaabo ay QM qaaday oo ku saabsan Laascaanod appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xiisad ciidan oo ka taagan koonfurta iyo waqooyiga Gaalkacyo
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa sheegaya in dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo iska soo horjeeda ay ka jiraan labada dhinac ee Galmudug iyo Puntland, xilli Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu ku sii jeedo magaaladaasi. Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug ayaa ciidamo ku soo daadisay qaybo ka mid ah xaafadaha koonfurta Gaalkacyo, ka dib markii Puntland ay ciidamadeeda ku soo daadisay waddooyinka xaafadaha ku yaala dhanka waqooyi ee magaalada. Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Maxamed (Deni) oo toddobaadkii labaad booqasho ku jooga Gaalkacyo ayaa xalay la kulmay Saraakiisha Ciidamada Puntland ee ka hawlgala Gobolka Mudug, isagoona kala hadlay xaaladda amniga ee gobolkaasi. Saraakiisha Ciidamada Puntland ayaa sheegay in Puntland ay maanta xirtay dhammaan xuduudaheeda, si ay uga hortagto waxa ay ku sheegeen sharta Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamo wato gaadiid badan oo kuwa dagaalka ah, isla-markaana ka tirsan kuwa Dowladda Federaalka ay saacadihii ugu dambeeyay gaareen koonfurta Gaalkacyo. Wasiir Kuxigeenka Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka Galmudug, Maxamuud Guure Guuleed ayaa sheegay in dhaqdhaqaaqa ciidan ee ka jira Magaalada Gaalkacyo, qaybta Galmudug uu la xiriiro in ciidamadu ay sugaan amniga Madaxweynaha Somaliya. Maxamuud Guure ayaa sheegay in iyadoo aanay jirin wax dhibaato ah ay Puntland qaadday tallaabooyin aan ku habbooneyn dadka Soomaaliyeed iyo amnigaba, taasina ay tahay midda ka dhalatay xaaladda feejignaanta ah ee ka jirta koonfurta Gaalkacyo. Guure ayaa adkeeyay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu soo booqan karo deegaanada Galmudug, isagoona Puntland ugu baaqay inay ilaaliso deris wanaagga. Puntland ayaa ka digtay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu safarkiisa uga gol leeyahay colaad uu ka abuuro Gaalkacyo, iyadoo Galmudug ay ku adkeysatay in safarka Madaxweynuhu uu la mid yahay safarada kale ee uu ku tago magaalooyinka dalka.
