items.title: Somalia’s army graduates 3,000 troops in largest class since 1991 collapse
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s national army marked its largest single graduation of security forces since the collapse of the central government in 1991, as roughly 3,000 newly trained soldiers passed out on Sunday in the central region of Galgadud under a Saudi-funded training program. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud attended the ceremony in person, presiding over the pass-out of troops who completed a full year of basic military training. The recruits, drawn from across the country, were trained in military skills, discipline, laws of the military, combat tactics, and the essential competencies required to serve in Somalia’s national forces. The graduation is the latest milestone under a defense agreement Somalia signed with Saudi Arabia in February, under which Riyadh committed to training approximately 5,000 Somali soldiers. Sunday’s graduating cohort accounts for the majority of that pledge delivered in a single class. Foreign military instructors from Romania, Ukraine, Sudan and other countries took part in delivering the training. Saudi military officials made repeated visits over the course of the year to Hanan Bure in Galgadud region, the site of the training base, to oversee the program’s progress. Speaking at the ceremony, President Mohamud framed the graduation as evidence of Somalia’s broader recovery and the reconstruction of its national army, calling it a testament to the country’s rebuilding efforts. A Force Rebuilt Under Pressure The graduation lands at a critical juncture for Somalia’s security architecture. Mogadishu is under mounting pressure to assume full responsibility for the country’s security as African Union peacekeepers move toward a complete drawdown. That timeline has been complicated by threats from Washington to cut logistical support for the African Union mission by December, raising the stakes for Somalia’s own forces to fill the resulting gap. The pressure is compounded by strains already visible elsewhere in the peacekeeping mission: Somaliguardian has previously reported on the AUSSOM funding crisis and Ethiopia’s withdrawal from Burhakaba, both signs of a peacekeeping architecture under financial and political strain even as the handover clock to Somali forces continues to run. Against that backdrop, the Saudi-backed training program – and the scale of Sunday’s graduation in particular – positions the newly trained units as part of the answer to Somalia’s looming security transition. It is, in effect, a test of whether the national army can grow fast enough, and be trained thoroughly enough, to stand on its own as international support structures shift beneath it. items.title: Hiigsiga 10-ka Kun ee Macallin: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Shaacisay Qaadashada 4,000 oo Cusub
items.description: War-murtiyeed ka soo baxay Shirka Wadatashiga Arrimaha Waxbarashada oo u dhaxeeyay Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee Soomaaliya iyo Wasaaradaha Waxbarashada ee Dowlad-goboleedyada dalka ayaa lagu shaaciyay in Dowladda Federaalka ay qaadaneyso 4,000 oo macallin cusub, kuwaas oo qayb weyn ka qaadan doona horumarinta iyo tayeynta waxbarashada dalka. Hiigsiga guud ee dowladda ee ku aaddanaa shaqaaleysiinta macallimiinta dalka ayaa ahaa 10,000 oo macallin. Iyada oo sanadihii 2023 iyo 2024 ay dowladdu hore u shaqaaleysisay 6,000 oo macallin, qaadashada sanadkan ee 4,000 ee macallin ayaa ka dhigan in si buuxda loo xaqiijiyay loona hirgeliyay hiigsigii qorshaysnaa ee tayeynta tacliinta qaranka. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa dhanka kale wali kor u haysa qoondadii macallimiinta ee maamulka Puntland ee sanadihii 2023 iyo 2024, taas oo ka dhalatay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhaxeeya labada dhinac. Haddii aan xal waara laga gaarin kala-aragti-duwanaanta jirta, waxay taasi ka dhigan tahay in Puntland ay markii saddexaad qaadici doonto in deegaannadeeda laga qoro qaybta kaga soo aadday macallimiinta Qaranka. Tallaabadan lagu shaqaaleysiinayo tiradan macallimiinta ah ayaa ku soo aadaysa xilli baahi weyn loo qabo ballaarinta fursadaha waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ee ubadka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan goobaha dhowaan laga xoreeyay kooxaha hubaysan iyo deegaannada miyiga ah. Hirgelinta qorshahan waxa uu door muhiim ah ka qaadan doonaa dhimista tirada carruurta aan fursadda u helin waxbarashada, kor u qaadista manhajka midaysan, iyo tayeynta aqoonta macallimiinta si loo helo jiil aqoon iyo xirfad u leh dhismaha mustaqbalka dalka.

items.title: Four Years of Hassan Sheikh’s Rule Have Produced Economic Decline, Rising Poverty and Growing Displacement: Former PM Kheyre
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Former Somali Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire has launched a scathing assessment of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s tenure, accusing the administration of wasting four years and three months while Somalia has experienced rising unemployment, inflation, poverty and displacement. Khaire argued that the country’s economic performance has deteriorated significantly since Hassan Sheikh returned to the presidency, claiming that household purchasing power and business profitability have declined while the number of internally displaced people has continued to grow. “Four years and three months after the election of a president whose term has now expired, available data confirm a significant decline in economic growth, household purchasing power and business profitability, while unemployment, inflation, poverty and the number of internally displaced people have increased substantially,” Khaire said. He went further, accusing the administration of benefiting from what he described as the mismanagement of national assets and the appropriation of public land. Khaire’s remarks amount to a broader indictment of what he portrays as a presidency that has failed to translate political power into tangible improvements in the lives of ordinary Somalis. A Lost Opportunity? The former prime minister also accused President Hassan Sheikh of damaging economic activity and undermining businesses that, he argued, were performing better before the president returned to office. His criticism comes as Somalia continues to face multiple economic and political pressures, including high unemployment, widespread poverty, displacement and persistent insecurity. For Khaire, the central issue is therefore not simply whether Hassan Sheikh’s administration has achieved individual policy successes, but whether the country is economically and institutionally stronger after more than four years under his leadership. The remarks add to increasingly sharp criticism from opposition figures, who argue that the administration has devoted disproportionate attention to political consolidation, constitutional changes and electoral arrangements while failing to deliver sufficiently broad-based economic gains. The government has rejected many of the opposition’s criticisms, pointing to progress in state-building, debt relief, international financial integration and institutional reforms. Nevertheless, Khaire’s assessment raises a fundamental question about the legacy of Hassan Sheikh’s second presidency: after more than four years in power, has Somalia moved forward—or has the country lost valuable time while ordinary citizens have continued to bear the cost of economic hardship, displacement and political uncertainty? For an administration approaching the end of its contested mandate, that question may prove increasingly difficult to avoid. items.fullContent: Mogadishu (WDN) — Former Somali Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire has launched a scathing assessment of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s tenure, accusing the administration of wasting four years and three months while Somalia has experienced rising unemployment, inflation, poverty and displacement. Khaire argued that the country’s economic performance has deteriorated significantly since Hassan Sheikh returned to the presidency, claiming that household purchasing power and business profitability have declined while the number of internally displaced people has continued to grow. “Four years and three months after the election of a president whose term has now expired, available data confirm a significant decline in economic growth, household purchasing power and business profitability, while unemployment, inflation, poverty and the number of internally displaced people have increased substantially,” Khaire said. He went further, accusing the administration of benefiting from what he described as the mismanagement of national assets and the appropriation of public land. Khaire’s remarks amount to a broader indictment of what he portrays as a presidency that has failed to translate political power into tangible improvements in the lives of ordinary Somalis. A Lost Opportunity? The former prime minister also accused President Hassan Sheikh of damaging economic activity and undermining businesses that, he argued, were performing better before the president returned to office. His criticism comes as Somalia continues to face multiple economic and political pressures, including high unemployment, widespread poverty, displacement and persistent insecurity. For Khaire, the central issue is therefore not simply whether Hassan Sheikh’s administration has achieved individual policy successes, but whether the country is economically and institutionally stronger after more than four years under his leadership. The remarks add to increasingly sharp criticism from opposition figures, who argue that the administration has devoted disproportionate attention to political consolidation, constitutional changes and electoral arrangements while failing to deliver sufficiently broad-based economic gains. The government has rejected many of the opposition’s criticisms, pointing to progress in state-building, debt relief, international financial integration and institutional reforms. Nevertheless, Khaire’s assessment raises a fundamental question about the legacy of Hassan Sheikh’s second presidency: after more than four years in power, has Somalia moved forward—or has the country lost valuable time while ordinary citizens have continued to bear the cost of economic hardship, displacement and political uncertainty? For an administration approaching the end of its contested mandate, that question may prove increasingly difficult to avoid. items.title: Cosoble oo soo saaray digniin ku socota DF kadib markii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Cosoble Cali oo kamid ah siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ayaa caawa soo saaray digniin culus oo ku socota Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, taas oo la xiriirto howlaha burburinta iyo barakicinta shacabka magaalada Muqdisho. Cabdulqaadir Cosoble oo la dareen noqday shacabka deggan xaafadda Buula Axmed Cabdalle ee degmada Kaaraan ayaa eedeymo u jeediyay dowladda, wuxuuna uga digay in la boobo dadka danta yar ee deggan xaafaddaasi. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay haddii aysan dowladda joojin barakicinta in ay la kulmi doonto cawaaqib xumo, isla markaana lala xisaabtami cid kasta oo ku lug leh falalka lagu beegsanayo hantida dadka shacabka ah. “Waxaan mar kale carrabka ku adkeynayaa in laga fogaado dhaca iyo boobka hantida danyarta ee ku foogan tahay dowlada waqtigedu dhamaaday. Haddii falalkaasi sii socdaan, waxaad kala kulmi doontaan cawaaqib xun,” ayuu yiri Cosoble. Dhanka kale, waxa uu farriin u diray dadka deegaanka, isagoo ugu baaqay inay is difaacaan, isla markaana dhiidhiyaan dhulboobka lagu hayo. Wuxuu sidoo kale ugu baaqay shacabka deggan dhulka xaafadda Buula Axmed Cabdalle inay ilaashadaan midnimadooda, isagoo sheegay in isku duubnida bulshada ay muhiim u tahay ka hortagga falalka lagula wareegayo dhulkooda. “Shacabka Buula Axmed Cabdalle, waxaan ku bogaadinayaa isku duubnidooda iyo sida ay ugu diyaarsan yihiin inay iska difaacaan kuwa doonaya inay dhacaan dhulkooda. Shacabka waa inay si mideysan u difaacaan xuquuqdooda, ayna adeegsadaan waddo kasta oo ay isaga difaaci karaan tuugada ku gambanaysa magaca dowladnimada,” ayuu mar kale yiri Xildhibaanku. Si kastaba, Howlgalka burburinta ayaa weli kasii socda xaafadaha Muqdisho, waxaana ugu dambeeyay xaafadda Buulo Eelaay ee degmada Waabari iyo shacabkii deganaa aagga isgoyska Jubba ee degmada Shibis oo labadii maalmood ee lasoo dhaafay laga saaray guryahooda, kadibna dhulka lala simay. items.title: Ruth Anne Stevens-Klitz Named Deputy Chief of Mission at U.S. Embassy in Somalia
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — The United States has appointed Ruth Anne Stevens-Klitz as the new Deputy Chief of Mission at the U.S. Embassy in Somalia, with the senior diplomat expected to begin her assignment in Mogadishu in August 2026. Her arrival comes as Somalia and the United States deepen cooperation on security, counterterrorism, stabilization, institutional development and broader diplomatic engagement. A Veteran U.S. Diplomat Stevens-Klitz brings more than 25 years of experience in the U.S. Foreign Service, with a career spanning assignments across Africa, Europe and the Middle East. Before her appointment to Somalia, she served as Public Affairs Counselor at the U.S. embassies in Senegal and Guinea-Bissau, where she worked extensively with civil society, local institutions and other key stakeholders. Her previous overseas assignments included Ethiopia, Egypt, Morocco, Germany, Israel and Armenia, in addition to several positions at the U.S. Department of State in Washington. Her career has focused heavily on diplomatic engagement, strengthening relationships among governments and international organizations, and expanding cooperation with the private sector and civil society. She has also worked on initiatives supporting young people and emerging leaders, including efforts to expand educational, economic and professional opportunities. Stevens-Klitz’s professional background also includes work involving cultural preservation, economic opportunity and press freedom—areas that remain important in countries dealing with political transition, institutional fragility and security challenges. Her multilingual background is another asset. She speaks French, German, Russian and Arabic, enabling her to engage across diverse linguistic and cultural environments. She holds a bachelor’s degree in Diplomatic Service from Georgetown University and a master’s degree in Strategic Studies from the U.S. Army War College. A New Phase in U.S.-Somalia Relations Her appointment comes at a particularly consequential period for Somalia. Washington remains one of Mogadishu’s most important international partners, particularly in the fight against Al-Shabaab and in efforts to strengthen Somalia’s security institutions. The two countries also cooperate on governance, economic development, humanitarian assistance and democratic institution-building. Against this backdrop, Stevens-Klitz is expected to play an important role in strengthening diplomatic coordination between the United States and Somalia while engaging with Somali government institutions, civil society and other political stakeholders. Her extensive experience across Africa and the Middle East could prove particularly valuable as Somalia navigates complex security, political and economic challenges. For Washington, the appointment signals the importance attached to its relationship with Somalia. For Mogadishu, the arrival of a senior diplomat with extensive regional and international experience comes at a time when closer international engagement remains critical to the country’s security, institutional development and long-term stability. items.title: UN Official Heads to Las Anod as Northeast State Seeks Greater Humanitarian and Development Support
items.description: LasAnod (WDN) — A senior United Nations official is expected to visit Las Anod, the capital of Somalia’s North Eastern State, in a move that could draw renewed international attention to a region that has long complained of being marginalized from major humanitarian, development and public investment programs. George Conway, Deputy Special Representative of the UN Secretary-General for Somalia, is expected to meet with North Eastern State leader Abdulkadir Aw-Ali Firdhiye during the visit. Discussions are expected to focus on humanitarian assistance, coordination among international agencies, and the expansion of development programs in the newly established federal member state. The visit comes at a critical moment for North Eastern State, which is attempting to rebuild institutions and restore livelihoods after years of conflict and instability. A Region bereft from humanitarian and development plans For residents and political leaders in North Eastern State, the visit comes with expectations that international engagement will translate into concrete assistance rather than another round of consultations. The region remains one of the areas of Somalia where the presence of international humanitarian and development organizations is comparatively limited. UN agencies and other international partners have yet to establish the same level of operational presence seen in several other parts of the country. That imbalance has become increasingly difficult to justify as North Eastern State emerges from a prolonged period of conflict and displacement. Local officials and lawmakers have repeatedly argued that communities recovering from war require sustained investment in basic services, infrastructure, education, healthcare, livelihoods and institution-building. Instead, they say, the region has struggled to attract a proportionate share of the development projects and budgetary support available elsewhere in Somalia. Questions Over Federal Development Spending The issue has also become a political matter. Some North Eastern State lawmakers have accused the Federal Government of Somalia of failing to adequately integrate the region into national development programs and donor-funded initiatives. They argue that major projects and financial resources administered through Mogadishu have disproportionately benefited other Federal Member States, leaving North Eastern State with limited access to development financing at precisely the moment when its needs are greatest. The allegations have added to broader concerns over equitable resource distribution within Somalia’s federal system. For a region emerging from conflict, development is not simply an economic objective. It is also an essential component of stabilization. Roads, schools, hospitals, water systems, markets and employment opportunities can help communities recover from displacement while reducing the conditions that allow poverty, insecurity and political grievances to persist. Northeastern State’s emergence therefore presents an opportunity for Somalia’s international partners to rethink how development assistance is distributed across the country. A region recovering from war cannot be expected to rebuild solely through its own limited resources. International support could help establish functioning local institutions, restore essential infrastructure, strengthen public services and create economic opportunities for communities that have endured years of insecurity. The UN official’s visit could provide an important opening for that conversation. For Northeastern State, however, the real measure of international engagement will not be the number of meetings held in Las Anod. It will be whether those discussions are followed by visible projects, sustained humanitarian assistance and meaningful investment in the region’s recovery. After years of being perceived as an afterthought in Somalia’s development agenda, residents of Northeastern State are increasingly demanding something more fundamental: an equitable place in the country’s national development effort. As George Conway begins his engagement in Las Anod, the message from the region is likely to be clear peace has created an opportunity for recovery, but without development, reconstruction and equal access to national and international resources, that peace will remain fragile. items.title: Sawirro: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo safar dhulka ah ku gaaray degmada Cadaado
items.description: Cadaado (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo uu wehliyo Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, Mudane Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoor Qoor) ayaa galabta safar dhulka ah kusoo gaaray degmada Cadaado ee Gobolka Galguduud. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa safarkiisa la xiriiro u kuurgalka nolosha bulshada iyo amniga deegaanka, subaxnimadii hore ka soo bilaabay magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimadda Galmudug, isla markaana soo maray deegaannada Xananbuure iyo Godinlabe, waxaana galabta boqolaal ka mid ah bulshada degmada Cadaado si diiran ugu soo dhoweeyeen fagaare ku yaalla bartamaha magaalada. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha oo bulshada Cadaado kula hadlay goob fagaare ah ayaa ku ammaanay isku duubnida, ilaalinta nabadda iyo taageerada dowladnimada, isaga oo ugu baaqay in ay si buuxda uga qayb qaataan halganka kama dambaysta ah ee dalka looga ciribtirayo Khawaarijta, isla markaana garab istaagaan ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ee u taagan xoreynta dalka iyo difaaca shacabka. Waxaa kale oo la filayaa inuu kulmo maamulka degmada, waxgaradka iyo qaybaha bulshada oo uu ka hadli doono arrimaha amniga, dagaalka Al-Shabaab iyo doorashooyinka oo kamid ah qorshayaashiisa muhiimka ah. Kahor inta uusan Madaxweynaha u safrin magaaladan, wuxuumaanta tababar u soo xiray kumannaan askari oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas dhammaystay tababarka aasaasiga ah ee ciidanka kadib muddo ku dhow hal sano oo ay tababar ku qaadanayeen deegaanka Xananbuure ee Gobolka Galguduud. Ciidamadan oo laga soo qoray dhammaan gobollada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa noqonaya ciidamadii ugu badnaa ee tababar heerkan ah ku qaata gudaha dalka tan iyo burburkii dalka, iyagoo qaatay duruus iyo tababbarro ciidan oo dhammaystiran, kuwaasi oo ku saabsanaa xirfadaha ciidanka, anshaxa iyo xeerka ciidanka, xeeladaha dagaalka iyo aqoonta lagama maarmaanka u ah gudashada waajibaadka qaran. Munaasabadda ayaa waxaa ka qayb-galay Madaxweynaha dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, Wasiirka Hawlaha Guud, Xildhibaanno ka tirsan BFS, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Maamulka Gobolka Galguduud iyo kan magaalada Dhuusamareeb iyo mas’uuliyiin kale. Si kastaba ha’ahaatee, cutubyadan ayaa loo diyaariyay inay xoojiyaan ciidamada xoogga dalka ee haatan howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ka wada deegaano ka tirsan Galmudug iyo gobollada kale ee dalka. items.title: Xaalad xasaasi ah oo ka jirta Gaalkacyo, iyadoo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu ku wajahan yahay
items.description: Shacabka ku dhaqan labada dhinac ee Galmudug iyo Puntland ee Magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa cabsi ka muujinaya in safarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu ku tagayo magaaladaasi uu colaad ka dhex huriyo labada maamul. Xaaladda ka taagan Gaalkacyo ayaa waxaa xoojiyay warqad digniin ah oo habeenkii Khamiista ka soo baxday Madaxtooyada Puntland, loogana soo horjeestay qorshaha safarka Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka uu ku imanayo koonfurta Gaalkacyo ee dhinaca Galmudug, iyadoo Puntland ay xaqiijisay inay heegan buuxa gelisay ciidamadeeda. Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug oo ka jawaabeysa digniinta Puntland ayaa sheegtay in Madaxweynuhu uu xaq u leeyahay inuu soo booqdo deegaanada Galmudug, waxayna intaasi ku dartay in Puntland aysan wax talo ah ama diidmo ah ku lahayn booqashadaas, maadaama ay tahay arrin u dhexeyso Galmudug iyo Dowladda Federaalka. Wasiiru Dowlaha Madaxtooyada Galmudug, Maxamed Faarax Xuseen (Talyaani) ayaa sheegay in Madaxweynuhu uu xilli kasta soo booqan karo koonfurta Gaalkacyo, isla-markaana digniinta ka timid Puntland aysan wax sal iyo raad ku lahayn sharciga. Puntland ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku eedeysay inuu colaad cusub ka hurinayo deegaanada Puntland, waxayna ka digtay in Galmudug loo adeegsado meel loo soo dhex maro Puntland. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Ciidamada Puntland ay dhaqdhaqaaq ka sameynayaan xeryaha ay ku leeyihiin waqooyiga Gaalkacyo, waana wax Puntland ay goor horeba ku sheegtay diyaargarow lagu adkeynayo amniga Gaalkacyo iyo deegaanada hoostaga. Ma jiraan wax calaamado ah oo muujinaya in Puntland ay fara-gelin karto go’aanka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo ogolaanshaha Galmudug ee safarkiisa koonfurta Gaalkacyo, haddana dadka reer Gaalkacyo ayaa ka cabsi qaba in hal tallaabo ama khalad oo dhaca uu sababo dagaal ballaaran. Reer Gaalkacyo ayaa kuu sheegaya in ay arrin khatarteeda leh ay noqon doonto, haddii hal askari uu rasaas ku furo dhinac ka mid ah labada daamood ee magaalada, muddada uu ku sugan yahay Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka. Xaaladda ka jirta Gaalkacyo waa mid xasaasi ah oo dadka deegaanka ay si dhow u eegayaan dhaqdhaqaaqyada siyaasadeed iyo midka amni ee magaaladaasi. Xiriirka labada maamul ayaa muhiim u ah xasilloonida iyo amniga magaalada oo sanadihii u dambeeyay ay si wadajir ah uga wada shaqeynayeen, waana xiriir aad u xoogeysanayay sanadihii la soo dhaafay, inkastoo xiriirkoodu uu mararka qaar yeesho loolan siyaasadeed oo ku qotoma dhanka xadka. Masuuliyiinta labada maamul ugu magacaaban Gobolka Mudug ayaa dadaal ku bixiya, sidii loo xalin lahaa khilaafaadkaas iyaga oo adeegsanaya wada hadal. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa haatan ku sugan Magaalada Cadaado ee Gobolka Galgaduud, iyadoona la sheegayo in aanu jirin wax is bedel ah oo ku yimid qorshihiisa safarka ee Magaalada Gaalkacyo ee Xarunta Gobolka Mudug. Safarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee Gaalkacyo ayaa u muuqdo midkiisii ugu horreyay ee walaac intaa le’eg oo amni ku abuura dadka ku dhaqan magaalo Soomaaliyeed oo uu doonayo in uu booqdo, iyadoo Gaalkacyo ay tahay magaalada keliya ee Somaliya ee leh laba maamul. Inkasta oo Gaalkacyo ay tahay magaalo ay laba maamul ka wada arrimiyaan, haddana dadka deegaanka ayaa waxaa ka dhexeeya ganacsi iyo xiriir qoys oo xoogan.

items.title: Puntland Demands Return of Former Security Personnel Now in Galmudug, Accuses FGS of Destabilization Plot
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — Puntland has sharply criticized former members of its security forces who reportedly joined Somalia’s Federal Government before moving into neighboring Galmudug, demanding that they be returned to Puntland and accusing Mogadishu of using security personnel to fuel tensions in the region. Puntland Minister of Youth and Sports Mohamud Ayid Dirir, speaking at a press conference in Garowe, described the former personnel as criminals and called on the Galmudug administration to hand them over to Puntland authorities. The minister alleged that the men had been part of a group involved in plans to create instability in Galkayo, the divided city jointly administered by Puntland and Galmudug and a longstanding flashpoint for political and security tensions. “Some of those who wanted to create chaos in Galkayo reportedly joined the Federal Government forces before moving to Galmudug,” Dirir said. He insisted that Galmudug now bears responsibility for the individuals and demanded their immediate transfer to Puntland. “Galmudug is expected to return them and hand these criminals over to Puntland,” he said. Dirir also directed serious allegations at President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, accusing his administration of pursuing a strategy aimed at undermining Puntland’s security and damaging relations between Puntland and Galmudug. He alleged that the Federal Government was attempting to drive a wedge between the two neighboring administrations, although he did not present publicly verifiable evidence to substantiate the claims. The accusations come amid already deteriorating relations between Puntland and the Federal Government, with the two sides sharply divided over constitutional amendments, electoral arrangements and the distribution of powers between Mogadishu and the Federal Member States. Tensions Around Galkayo The statement was issued as President Hassan Sheikh was visiting Dhusamareeb, where he has been holding meetings with Galmudug leaders and federal officials. Galkayo remains particularly sensitive because of its divided administration and history of political and security confrontations. Although Puntland and Galmudug have made efforts in recent years to maintain cooperation and prevent renewed conflict, the city’s strategic importance continues to make it vulnerable to wider political disputes. Puntland’s latest allegations therefore risk adding another layer to an already tense relationship between the Federal Government and the regional administration. Neither Galmudug nor the Federal Government has so far issued an official response to the accusations made by the Puntland minister. items.title: Wada-hadallo u bilowday guddoomiye Jaamac iyo xildhibaannada mucaaradka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa galabta kulan gaar ah la yeeshay Xildhibaannada mucaaradka ee muddooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ka maqnaa kulamada Baarlamaanka, sababo la xiriira xiisadda siyaasadeed ee ka taagan dalka. Kulanka oo ka dhacay xarunta Villa Hargeysa ayaa waxaa goobjoog ahaa guddi Xildhibaanno ah oo wakiil ka ah xubnaha Baarlamaanka ee mucaaradka, waxaana iyaga iyo guddoomiyaha ay ka wada-hadleen tabashooyinka jira iyo sidii xal waara loogu heli lahaa. Ujeedka ugu wayn ee wada-hadalka socda ayaa ah sidii ay Xildhibaannadan dib ugu soo noqon lahaayeen kulamada Baarlamaanka oo hadda ay dibadjoog ka yihiin, si ay qayb uga noqdaan shaqooyinka socda ee Golaha Shacabka. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay xafiiska Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa lagu sheegay in lagu ballamay in kulamada ay sii socdaan, inta laga gaarayo heshiis buuxa oo lagu wada shaqeyn karo. “Waxaa maanta shir albaabada u xiranyahay yeeshay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur iyo Guddi Xildhibaanno ah oo wakiil ka ah Xildhibaannada Mucaaradka, waxaana kulanka looga wada hadlay sidii Golaha Shacabka u noqon lahaa hal Gole oo ka shaqeeya xal u helidda khilaafaadka iyo ka shaqeynta danta dalka inta laga soo dooranaya Baarlamaanka 12-aad ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Labada dhinac ayaa u ballamay kulamo kale oo lagu gaarayo heshiis lagu wada shaqeyn karo,” ataa lagu yiri qoraalka. Guddoomiye Jaamac ayaa doorashadiisii kadib ballan qaaday inuu raadin doono saaxibada maqan, isla markaana uu la fariisan doono si xal loogu helo muranka taagan, taas oo uu maanta ka dhabeeyay, isaga oo yeeray xubnaha mucaaradka ee la baxay ‘Baarlamaanka xorta ah, si loo soo afjaro khilaafka taagan. Xildhibaannadan ayaa sidoo kale ka maqnaa doorashadii guddoomiyaha, iyaga markaas shaaciyay inay kasoo horjeedaan, sababo la xiriira farogelinta Villa Somalia. Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya oo uu dhawaan furay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa dib u shaqo bilaabay, waxaana horyaallo shuruuc muhiim ah oo la filayo in la meel-mariyo inta lagu guda jiro Kalfadhiggan 8-aad. Kalfadhigan ayaa kusoo aaday xilli xasaasi ah oo ay taagan tahay xiisad u dhexeysa Dowladda Federaalka iyo kooxaha mucaaradka ee kasoo horjeed. items.title: NISA oo Hawlgal Qorshaysan ka Fulisay Tardo
items.description: Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadeedu, iyagoo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamka, ay howlgal qorsheysan ka fuliyeen deegaanka Tardo ee Gobolka Hiiraan. NISA ayaa sheegtay in howlgalka lagu dilay saddex horjooge oo sare iyo shan maleeshiyaad ah, halka afar kale lagu dhaawacay. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka, saddexda horjooge ee la dilay ayaa kala ahaa Sicid Xuriye, oo lagu sheegay inuu qaabilsanaa baadda Bariga Gobolka Hiiraan; Xamse Bakool, oo ahaa horjoogaha maleeshiyaadka ka howlgala Hiiraan; iyo Cusmaan, oo NISA sheegtay inuu ahaa horjooge ka tirsan kooxda. NISA waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in weerarka lagu dilay shan dhagar-qabe oo ilaalo u ahaa horjoogayaasha, halka afar kale lagu dhaawacay. Waxaa dhaawacyada ku jira horjooge lagu magacaabo Khaalid Ciro. Hay’addu waxay intaas ku dartay in howlgalka uu ka mid yahay dadaallada joogtada ah ee lagu baacsanayo hoggaanka Shabaab, laguna wiiqayo awooddooda abaabul iyo fulinta weerarrada. NISA ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Cabdikariin Yuusuf Axmed, oo ay ku tilmaantay horjooge Shabaab ugu magacaawnaa deegaanka Tardo, uu goobta ka baxsaday. Hay’adda ayaa ugu dambeyn shacabka ugu baaqday inay la wadaagaan xog kasta oo la xiriirta dhaqdhaqaaqyada Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish, gaar ahaan xogaha la xiriira khataraha amni.

items.title: Puntland oo shaacisay inay gacanta ku dhigtay ciidamo iyo hubkii ay wateen
items.description: Qardho (Caasimada Online) – Ciidanka booliska gobolka Karkaar ayaa shaaciyay inay gacanta ku dhigeen ciidamo maleeshiyaad hubaysan ah oo shalay jidgooyo dhigtay duleedka bari ee magaalada Qardho. Maleeshiyaadkan oo la sheegay inay dhibaato ku hayeen shacabka iyo isu socodka gaadiidka ayay ciidamada booliska Karkaar ku soo qabteen howlgal qorsheysan. Howl-galkaan ayaa yimid kadib markii ay soo baxeen warar ku saabsan maleeshiyaad hubaysan oo jidgooyo dhigtay duleedka bari ee magaalada Qardho, kuwaas oo carqalad ku hayay dadka isaga kala gooshaya waddada. Qoraal kasoo baxay booliska gobolka Karkaar ayaa lagu sheegay in ciidamada ammaanku ay qabteen maleeshiyaad abaabulan oo jidgooyo dhigtay, iyadoo sidoo kale gacanta lagu dhigay hubkii ay wateen xilliga la qabanayay. “Ciidamada amniga waxay qabteen maleeshiyaad abaabul oo jidka goostay, kuwaas oo dhibaato ku hayay shacabka iyo isu socodka dadka iyo gaadiidka. Sidoo kale waxaa la qabtay hubkii ay wateen,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka kasoo baxay taliska. Howl-galka lagu soo qabtay maleeshiyaadkan ayaa waxaa hoggaaminayay taliyaha qaybta booliska gobolka Karkaar, G/sare Bashiir Maxamed Maxamuud, iyo taliyaha madaxtooyada gobolka Karkaar, Gaashaanle Cabdi Xirsi Aadan. Labada taliye ayaa la sheegay inay howl-galka ka fuliyeen aaggaasi xilli ay safar kaga yimaadeen deegaanka Kuur-ilaalo ee degmada Rako-raaxo, waxaana ciidamada ay sameeyeen tallaabooyin lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo isu socodka waddada. Taliska qaybta booliska gobolka Karkaar ayaa ugu dambeyn sheegay in uusan u dulqaadan doonin cid kasta oo isku dayda inay jidgooyo dhigato, cabsi geliso shacabka ama carqalad ku noqoto amniga iyo kala dambeynta, isagoo xusay in ciidamada ay sii wadi doonaan howl-gallada lagu sugayo amniga gobolka. items.title: Maxay yihiin ciidanka Xasan Sheekh uu maanta tababarka ugu soo xiray Galmudug?
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ahna Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta tababar u soo xiray kumannaan askari oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Ciidamadan ayaa dhammaystay tababarka aasaasiga ah ee ciidanka kadib muddo ku dhow hal sano oo ay tababar ku qaadanayeen deegaanka Xananbuure ee Gobolka Galguduud. Ciidamadan oo laga soo qoray dhammaan gobollada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa noqonaya ciidamadii ugu badnaa ee tababar heerkan ah ku qaata gudaha dalka tan iyo burburkii dalka, iyagoo qaatay duruus iyo tababbarro ciidan oo dhammaystiran, kuwaasi oo ku saabsanaa xirfadaha ciidanka, anshaxa iyo xeerka ciidanka, xeeladaha dagaalka iyo aqoonta lagama maarmaanka u ah gudashada waajibaadka qaran. Ciidamada tababarka qaatay ayaa munaasabadda kusoo bandhigay dhoolatus ciidan iyo gaadda ka ciyaar, iyagoo muujiyay xirfadaha iyo aqoonta ay ka heleen muddadii uu tababarku socday. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa tilmaamay in ciidamadan ay astaan u yihiin soo kabashada dowladnimada iyo dib-u-dhiska ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed, maadaama markii ugu horreysay kumannaan askari ay ku qalin-jabiyeen dugsi ciidan oo ku yaalla gudaha dalka, iyagoo si rasmi ah ugu biiraya safafka ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa ciidamada kula dardaarmay inay ilaaliyaan anshaxa iyo sharafta ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed, dhowraan midnimada iyo qarannimada dalka, ayna waajibaadkooda u gutaan si daacadnimo, waddaniyad iyo masuuliyad leh. Munaasabadda ayaa waxaa ka qayb-galay Madaxweynaha dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, Wasiirka Hawlaha Guud, Xildhibaanno ka tirsan BFS, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Maamulka Gobolka Galguduud iyo kan magaalada Dhuusamareeb iyo mas’uuliyiin kale. Si kastaba, cutubyadan ayaa loo diyaariyay inay xoojiyaan ciidamada xoogga dalka ee haatan howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ka wada deegaano ka tirsan Galmudug iyo gobollada kale ee dalka. Sidoo kale waxay qeyb ka noqonayaan qorshaha lagu tayeynayo ciidanka xoogga, gaar ahaan askarta loo carbiyay inay mustaqbalka dhow la wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. items.title: New Somali Army Units Graduate Amid Pressure to Hold Gains
items.description: GALGADUUD — President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, Commander-in-Chief of the Somali Armed Forces, on Sunday presided over the graduation of newly trained units of the Somali National Army (SNA) at the Xananbuure Military Training School in Galgaduud region. The ceremony was attended by senior federal and regional officials, including Defence Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi, Somali National Army Chief Brigadier General Ibrahim Mohamed Mohamud, Galmudug President Ahmed Abdi Kariye “Qoorqoor”, and other government and security officials. President Mohamud and the accompanying delegation reviewed a military parade and a series of field demonstrations showcasing the skills and operational capabilities acquired by the troops during their training. Addressing the graduating soldiers, the President called on the armed forces to intensify ongoing operations against militant groups and underscored the military’s central role in safeguarding Somalia’s security, stability and sovereignty. Defence Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi urged the soldiers to apply the knowledge and skills gained during their training in the service of the country, emphasizing the importance of operational readiness, discipline, cohesion and accountability. The army chief also called on the troops to uphold the professionalism, reputation and integrity of the Somali National Army, while maintaining discipline, unity and commitment to their constitutional and national responsibilities. The newly trained personnel were recruited from different regions across Somalia. Officials described the cohort as one of the largest groups of soldiers to receive advanced military training inside the country since the collapse of the central government in 1991. The training programme covered military discipline and regulations, combat tactics, operational preparedness and other core skills aimed at strengthening the soldiers’ ability to carry out national security and defence duties. The graduation comes as the Federal Government continues efforts to expand and professionalise the Somali National Army and strengthen its capacity to assume greater responsibility for security operations across the country. items.title: President Hassan Sheikh Graduates Thousands of Soldiers in Xananbuure
items.description: President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, Commander-in-Chief of the Somali Armed Forces, has officially graduated thousands of soldiers who completed their basic military training at the Xananbuure training camp in the Galguduud region. The soldiers, who underwent nearly a year of intensive training, represent the largest single cohort to complete military training inside Somalia since the collapse of the central government in 1991. The graduation ceremony marks a significant milestone in Somalia’s efforts to rebuild its national army and reduce reliance on foreign troops. The soldiers were recruited from across all federal member states and received comprehensive training in military skills, discipline, military law, combat tactics, and the knowledge required to carry out national duties. President Hassan Sheikh addressed the graduates, describing them as a symbol of the restoration of statehood and the rebuilding of the Somali National Army. He said their graduation inside the country, rather than abroad, demonstrates progress in Somalia’s efforts to develop a self-sufficient military capability. The President urged the soldiers to uphold the discipline and integrity of the armed forces, protect the unity and sovereignty of the nation, and carry out their duties with honesty, patriotism, and responsibility. The ceremony was attended by the President of Galmudug State, the Minister of Defence, the Minister of Public Works, members of the Federal Parliament, the Commander of the Somali National Army, and other senior officials. items.title: Somaliland Finance Minister Leads Talks to Deepen Denmark Development Partnership
items.description: Somaliland’s Minister of Finance and Economic Development, Abdillahi Hassan Aadan, held a high-level meeting with Denmark’s Ambassador to Somaliland and Somalia, Steen Sonne, in talks focused on strengthening development cooperation and accelerating projects designed to deliver tangible benefits to communities across Somaliland. The meeting highlighted Denmark’s continued support for Somaliland’s development agenda, with discussions covering decentralization, democracy, institutional strengthening, local government development and economic infrastructure. A major focus was Denmark’s support for the Somaliland Development Fund (SDF) and projects being implemented through the fund, including road construction and development, the development of Maydh Port, and the establishment of enclosures and other infrastructure projects. Minister Abdillahi thanked Denmark for its sustained development assistance, stressing that SDF-funded projects are playing an important role in strengthening Somaliland’s economic infrastructure and expanding essential services for communities. He also underscored the government’s commitment to ensuring that development projects are implemented efficiently and in line with their approved objectives, while delivering measurable and lasting results for the public. The Minister said Somaliland is prepared to take all necessary measures to strengthen transparency, accountability, quality and project impact, emphasizing that development resources must be managed effectively and sustainably. The meeting also provided an opportunity for the Minister to bid farewell to Mathias, the former Head of Danida Somaliland, whom he thanked for his service and contribution to strengthening development cooperation between Somaliland and Denmark. Minister Abdillahi also welcomed Camilla, the newly appointed head of Danida Somaliland, wishing her success as she assumes her new responsibilities. For his part, Danish Ambassador Steen Sonne commended the Somaliland Government’s commitment to national development and closer cooperation with Denmark. The Ambassador praised the progress achieved by the Ministry of Finance and Economic Development, particularly in public financial management and the implementation of development projects, and reaffirmed Denmark’s commitment to maintaining its development partnership with Somaliland. The meeting concluded with both sides emphasizing the need to deepen cooperation, accelerate ongoing development projects and ensure that development assistance translates into sustainable, effective and tangible benefits for the people of Somaliland. Horntribune

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo Tababar U Soo Xiray Ciidamo Xananbuure+SAWIRO
items.description: Galgaduud (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ahna Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa Dugsiga Tababarka Xananbuure tababar ugu soo xiray cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha waxaa munaasabadda ku weheliyay Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga XFS, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoorqoor) iyo mas’uuliyiin kale. Madaxweynaha iyo mas’uuliyiinta ayaa daawaday bandhig iyo dhoolatus lagu soo bandhigay xirfadaha ay ciidamada soo barteen muddadii ay tababarka ku jireen. Xasan Sheekh ayaa ciidamada faray inay dardargeliyaan dadaallada ka socda dalka ee lagu ciribtirayo kooxaha argagixisada ah, isagoo adkeeyay muhiimadda ay ciidamada u leeyihiin sugidda nabadda iyo xasilloonida dalka. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa ciidamada kula dardaarmay inay aqoonta iyo xirfadaha ay heleen u beddelaan karti wax-ku-ool ah oo ay ugu adeegaan dalka, isagoo xusay muhiimadda diyaargarowga, isku-duubnida iyo mas’uuliyadda ciidanka. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa isna ciidamada kula dardaarmay inay ilaaliyaan sumcadda iyo karaamada ciidanka, isla markaana muujiyaan isku-duubni, mas’uuliyad iyo u-heellanaanta waajibaadka qaran. Ciidamadan oo laga soo qoray dhammaan gobollada Soomaaliya ayaa lagu sheegay inay yihiin ciidamadii ugu badnaa ee tababar heerkan ah ku qaata gudaha dalka tan iyo burburkii dowladdii dhexe, iyagoo qaatay tababbarro la xiriira xirfadaha ciidanka, anshaxa iyo xeerarka ciidamada, xeeladaha dagaalka iyo aqoonta lagama maarmaanka u ah gudashada waajibaadka qaran. items.title: Ciidamo cusub oo tababar loogu soo xiray Xerada Militariga Xananbuure (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo booqasho ku jooga Galmudug ayaa maanta ciidamo cusub tababar ugu soo xiray Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Xananbuure ama Xerada Militariga Xananbuure ee waqooyiga Gobolka Galgaduud. Ciidamadan oo sanadkii hore lagu xareeyay dugsiga ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay halkaasi lagu barayay xirfadaha ciidanimo, iyagoona hadda diyaar u ah inay si rasmi ah uga mid noqdaan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Xafiiska Madaxweynaha Somaliya ayaa sheegay in ciidamadan ay noqonayaan kuwoodii ugu badnaa ee tababar heerkani oo kale ah ku qaata gudaha dalka, tan iyo intii Somaliya ay dib uga soo kabatay xilligii burburka. “Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa tilmaamay in ciidamadan ay astaan u yihiin soo kabashada dowladnimada iyo dib-u-dhiska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, maadaama markii ugu horreysay kumannaan askari ay ku qalin-jabiyeen dugsi ciidan oo ku yaala gudaha dalka, iyagoo si rasmi ah ugu biiraya safafka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Villa Somalia. Warka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa ciidamada kula dardaarmay inay ilaaliyaan anshaxa iyo sharafta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, dhowraan midnimada iyo qaranimada dalka, ayna waajibaadkooda u gutaan si daacadnimo, waddaniyad iyo masuuliyad leh.” Dugsiga Xananbuure ayaa hoostaga Taliska Qaybta 21aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, oo madax uu u yahay Korneyl Maxamed Cabdi Daahir (Maxamed Dhagaweyne), kaas oo dib-u-habayn iyo ballaaran lagu sameeyay sanadkii hore. Doorka dugsigan ayaa ah in la soo saaro cutubyo cusub oo xoojiya dagaalka dalka looga saarayo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Munaasabaddan ayaa waxaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku wehlinayay Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Axmed Macalin Fiqi, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar, Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoorqoor), Xildhibaano ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Federaalka iyo masuuliyiin kale.

items.title: Puntland oo dalbatay in loo soo gacan geliyo ciidamadii u goostay dhanka Galmudug
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Puntland ayaa si adag uga hadlay ciidamo horey uga tirsanaa ciidamadeeda oo markii dambe ku biiray Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo u gudbay dhanka maamulka Galmudug. Wasiirka Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha Puntland, Maxamuud Caydiid Dirir ayaa sheegay in ciidamadaasi ay qeyb ka ahaayeen koox uu ku eedeeyay inay qorsheynayeen qalalaase ka dhaca magaalada Gaalkacyo, balse ay markii dambe u gudbeen dhinaca Galmudug. Caydiid oo shir jaraa’id ku qabtay magaalada Garoowe ayaa sheegay in qaar kamid ah ciidamadaas loo soo bandhigay inay yihiin ciidamo federaal ah, kadib markii ay ka tageen Puntland una gudbeen dhanka Galmudug. “Ciidamadii doonayay inay qalalaase ridaan, qaar ka mid ah oo la yiri waa ciidamo federaal ah ayaa u goostay Galmudug,” ayuu yiri wasiirka. Wasiirka ayaa Galmudug ugu baaqay inay Puntland ku soo celiso ciidamadaasi, una soo gacan geliso, isagoo ku eedeeyay maamulkaasi inay u galeen dad uu ku tilmaamay dambiilayaal. “Galmudug waxaa laga rabaa inay isu celiso, gacanta Puntland ay ku soo sito dambiileyaal,” ayuu yiri Caydiid. Sidoo kale, wasiirka ayaa eedeyn culus u jeediyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isaga oo ku eedeeyay inuu qeyb ka yahay qorshe uu sheegay in lagu abuurayo xiisad u dhexeysa maamullada Puntland iyo Galmudug. Caydiid Dirir ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka ay doonayso inay kala fogeyso labada maamul ee deriska ah, hadalkiisa ayaana kusoo aadaya xilli Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu ku sugan yahay Dhuusamareeb, iyadoo la qorsheynayo inuu safar ku tago Gaalkacyo oo uu haatan ku sugan yahay Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni. The post Puntland oo dalbatay in loo soo gacan geliyo ciidamadii u goostay dhanka Galmudug appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Jeexjeexyada Maqaarka: Yaa Ku Dhaca, Ma La Daaweyn Karaa?
items.description: Jeexjeexyada maqaarka, oo caafimaad ahaan loo yaqaan striae, waa xarriiqo samaysma marka maqaarku si degdeg ah u kala baxo ama isu soo ururo. Inkastoo aysan inta badan khatar caafimaad ah ahayn, dadka qaar ayay ku abuuraan walaac dhinaca muuqaalka ah. Waxay ka soo bixi karaan caloosha, gacmaha kore, bowdyaha, miskaha, naasaha, dhabarka iyo barida, waxayna marka ay cusub yihiin noqon karaan casaan, guduud, bunni ama midab ka madow maqaarka intiisa kale. Jeexjeexyada maqaarku waa dhacdo caadi ah oo ku dhacda dad badan, gaar ahaan kuwa si degdeg ah u cayila ama u dhima miisaanka, haweenka uurka leh, dhallinyarada xilliga koritaanka, iyo dadka murqaha si degdeg ah u dhisa. Waxay sidoo kale ku badan yihiin dadka qoyskooda ay ku badan yihiin jeexjeexyadu ama dadka isticmaala qaar ka mid ah dawooyinka steroid-ka muddo dheer. Marka jirku si dhaqso ah u cayilo, u koro ama miisaankiisu isu beddelo, lakabka dhexe ee maqaarka (dermis) ayaa kala bixi kara. Taasi waxay dhaawici kartaa fiilooyinka taageera maqaarka, waxaana dusha ka muuqda xarriiqaha loo yaqaan stretch marks. Akadeemiyadda Maraykanka ee Cudurrada Maqaarka waxay jeexjeexyadan ku tilmaamaysaa nooc nabar ah oo samaysma marka maqaarku si dhaqso ah u kala baxo ama isu soo ururo. Miisaan dhimistu ma keentaa jeexjeexyada? Jeexjeexyadu waxay inta badan samaysmaan xilligii maqaarku kala baxayay, laakiin waxay si cad u muuqan karaan marka miisaanka dambe la dhimo. Haddii miisaan badan si degdeg ah loo dhimo, maqaarku mararka qaarkood si buuxda uguma soo noqon karo qaabkiisii hore, taasoo sababi karta dabacsanaan ama jeexjeexyadii hore oo si muuqata u soo baxa. Jeexjeexyada maqaarku inta badan ma yihiin calaamad cudur halis ah, balse waxaa habboon in dhakhtar lala xiriiro haddii ay si lama filaan ah u bataan ama ay la socdaan calaamado kale sida cayil ku urura caloosha, waji bararsan, ama maqaarka oo si fudud u nabarma. Calaamadahan waxay la xiriiri karaan xaalad naadir ah oo la yiraahdo Cushing’s syndrome. Daaweynta jeexjeexyada waxaa ka mid noqon kara kareemada tretinoin, daaweynta laser-ka, microneedling, iyo microdermabrasion. Natiijooyinku way kala duwan yihiin, mana jiro hal daaweyn oo qof walba u shaqaysa. Mar walba si buuxda loogama hortagi karo jeexjeexyada, laakiin ilaalinta miisaan caafimaad qaba waxay yareyn kartaa halista. The post Jeexjeexyada Maqaarka: Yaa Ku Dhaca, Ma La Daaweyn Karaa? first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

Haddii miisaan badan si degdeg ah loo dhimo, maqaarku mararka qaarkood si buuxda uguma soo noqon karo qaabkiisii hore, taasoo sababi karta dabacsanaan ama jeexjeexyadii hore oo si muuqata u soo baxa. Jeexjeexyada maqaarku inta badan ma yihiin calaamad cudur halis ah, balse waxaa habboon in dhakhtar lala xiriiro haddii ay si lama filaan ah u bataan ama ay la socdaan calaamado kale sida cayil ku urura caloosha, waji bararsan, ama maqaarka oo si fudud u nabarma. Calaamadahan waxay la xiriiri karaan xaalad naadir ah oo la yiraahdo Cushing’s syndrome. Daaweynta jeexjeexyada waxaa ka mid noqon kara kareemada tretinoin, daaweynta laser-ka, microneedling, iyo microdermabrasion. Natiijooyinku way kala duwan yihiin, mana jiro hal daaweyn oo qof walba u shaqaysa. Mar walba si buuxda loogama hortagi karo jeexjeexyada, laakiin ilaalinta miisaan caafimaad qaba waxay yareyn kartaa halista. items.title: Nairobi oo Lagu Diyaarinayo Shirweyne Daarood
items.description: Nairobi (Raxanreeb Online): Magaalada Nairobi waxaa ka socda qabanqaabada shirweyne ay ka qeyb geli doonaan siyaasiyiin iyo waxgarad ka soo jeeda beesha Daarood, kaas oo looga hadlayo xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Shirkan ayaa sida xogta lagu helayo waxaa abaabulkiisa qeyb weyn ka qaadanaya siyaasiyiin iyo waxgarad ka tirsan Puntland iyo Jubbaland, waxaana la filayaa in looga hadlo xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka iyo mustaqbalka hannaanka doorashooyinka. Sida wararka lagu helayo, shirweynaha ayaa lagu doonayaa in laga gaaro go’aanno waaweyn oo la xiriira xaaladda dalka, gaar ahaan haddii aysan Dowladda Federaalka iyo mucaaradka heshiis ka gaarin wada-hadallada ay wadaan dhexdhexaadiyayaasha caalamiga ah. Puntland iyo Jubbaland ayaa horey u muujiyay mowqif ah in haddii aan xal siyaasadeed laga gaarin doorashada, ay qaadi karaan tallaabooyin kale oo siyaasadeed, oo ay ku jiraan qabashada doorashooyin iyo sameysashada hannaan dowladeed oo ka duwan kan hadda jira. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay Soomaaliya ka socdaan dadaallo lagu doonayo in Dowladda Federaalka iyo mucaaradka lagu heshiisiiyo, gaar ahaan hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee dalka. items.title: Mareykanka oo Soomaaliya u soo magacaabay Safiir ku xigeen cusub
items.description: Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa Ruth Anne Stevens-Klitz u magacawday Ku-xigeenka Madaxa Ergada Diblomaasiyadeed ee Mareykanka (Deputy Chief of Mission) ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo xilkeeda cusub ay ka bilaabayso Muqdisho bishan Agoosto 2026. Stevens-Klitz waa diblomaasi muddo dheer ka tirsanaa Adeegga Diblomaasiyadda Sare ee Mareykanka, waxayna leedahay in ka badan 25 sano oo waayo-aragnimo diblomaasiyadeed ah, gaar ahaan dalalka Afrika, Bariga Dhexe iyo Yurub. Ka hor inta aysan Soomaaliya imaan, waxay ahayd la-taliyaha arrimaha bulshada iyo xiriirka dadweynaha ee Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Senegal iyo Guinea-Bissau, halkaas oo ay xoogga saartay diblomaasiyadda dadweynaha iyo xiriirka bulshada. Intii ay ku jirtay shaqadeeda diblomaasiyadeed, Stevens-Klitz waxay ka soo shaqeysay dalal ay ka mid yihiin Itoobiya, Masar, Morocco, Jarmalka, Israel iyo Armenia, sidoo kalena xilal kala duwan ayay ka soo qabatay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ee Washington. Waxay si gaar ah uga shaqeysay dhisidda xiriirrada dowladaha, hay’adaha caalamiga ah, ganacsatada iyo bulshada rayidka ah, iyadoo sidoo kale khibrad u leh arrimaha dhalinyarada, fursadaha dhaqaale, xorriyadda warbaahinta iyo ilaalinta hidaha dhaqanka. Stevens-Klitz waxay kasoo jeedaa Cleveland, Ohio. Waxay shahaadada koowaad ee cilmiga adeegga diblomaasiyadda ka qaadatay Georgetown University, halka ay shahaadada Master-ka ee Strategic Studies ka qaadatay U.S. Army War College. Waxay sidoo kale ku hadashaa Faransiis, Jarmal, Ruush iyo Carabi. Magacaabistan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Mareykanka iyo Soomaaliya ay sii xoojinayaan iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, dowlad-dhiska iyo horumarinta, gaar ahaan taageerada hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya iyo dagaalka lagula jiro kooxaha hubeysan. Ruth Anne Stevens-Klitz ayaa hadda ka mid noqonaysa masuuliyiinta muhiimka ah ee ka shaqeyn doona xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Mareykanka iyo Soomaaliya.

items.title: Somali Airlines could resume flights in September after three-decade shutdown
items.description: Somalia could once again have a national airline operating scheduled flights as early as September 2026, with the country’s Civil Aviation Authority saying preparations for the long-awaited return of Somali Airlines have been completed. Civil Aviation Authority Director Ahmed Ma’allin said the airline is now nearing the point of resuming operations, more than three decades after Somali Airlines stopped flying in 1991. “Somali airlines is on its final stages, the first flight will be around mid September,” he said. The latest announcement marks another attempt by the Somali government to restore the former flag carrier. Plans to revive the airline have been announced several times in recent years, but previous deadlines passed without commercial flights taking off. In July 2025, the government announced an agreement involving two Airbus A320 aircraft, describing the planes as the starting point for rebuilding Somali Airlines. Officials subsequently said the carrier would begin operations within a few months. By October 2025, the government had again said the airline would return before the end of that year. That deadline was not met, leaving September 2026 as the latest target for the carrier’s return. The revival effort involves more than acquiring aircraft. Before an airline can operate commercially, it must meet safety and regulatory requirements, secure the necessary approvals and ensure qualified personnel are available to run its operations. Systems for aircraft maintenance, insurance, flight planning and airport services must also be in place to support regular flights. The two A320 aircraft secured under the 2025 agreement were intended to form the first part of a wider fleet. The government has indicated that additional aircraft could be acquired as the airline grows and expands its network. Somali Airlines was established in 1964 and once connected Somalia to destinations across the region and beyond. Its operations came to an end in 1991 following the collapse of Somalia’s central government and the civil war that followed. A return to service would have significance beyond restoring the country’s flag carrier. A functioning national airline could improve air connections for Somali travellers, including the large diaspora, while supporting trade and creating employment in aviation and related industries. Somalia has also been working to rebuild its wider aviation sector, creating an environment in which the national carrier can eventually operate. Aviation authorities have made progress in restoring regulatory and operational systems that were disrupted during decades of instability. Eastleigh voice.

items.title: DF oo si adag u dhalleeceysay dhacdo argagax leh oo ka dhacday Hargeysa
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si adag uga hadashay dhacdo argagax leh oo ka dhacday magaalada Hargeysa, taas oo la xiriirta geerida hooyo Soomaaliyeed oo lagu magacaabi jiray Nimco Jaamac Yuusuf. Nimco ayaa dhowaan ku umushay isbitaalka, iyadoo muddo ku dhow toddobaad ku jirtay xaalad adag, iyadoo la sheegay in dhibaatooyin dhaqaale iyo awood la’aanta bixinta kharashaadka adeegga caafimaadka ay qeyb ka ahaayeen duruufihii ay wajahaysay. “Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Hormarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxa ay si aad ah uga tiiraanyeysan tahay dhacdada foosha xun ee ka dhacday Isbitaalka Guud ee magaalada Hargeysa taasi oo ay nafteeda ku weysay Hooyo Danyar ah oo lagu magacaabi jiray Nimco Jaamac Yuusuf,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay wasaaradda. Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka ayaa ku baaqday in aan marnaba la oggolaan in hooyooyin iyo dadka danyarta ah ay waayaan daryeel caafimaad sababo la xiriira duruufo dhaqaale. “Waxaan si aad ah ugu boorineynaa guud ahaan Soomaalida meel walba oo ay joogaan ineynaan ogolaan sii socoshada xaaladaha noocaan ah ee aan ku weyneyno hooyo, taasi oo ah wax aad iyo aad uga fog bani’aadannimada,” ayey si kulul u tiri Wasiirka Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Hormarinta Xuququuqul Insaanka XFS Amb Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi. Wasaaradda ayaa sidoo kale tacsi u dirtay ehelka iyo qoyska marxuumadda, iyadoo Alle uga baryay inuu naxariistiisa janno ka waraabiyo. Dhacdadan ayaa dhalisay murugo iyo hadal-heyn xooggan, iyadoo sidoo kale la isweydiinayo sida dadka danyarta ah u heli karaan daryeel caafimaad marka ay awoodi waayaan kharashaadka. Hoos ka aqriso war-saxaafadeedka Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Hormarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxa ay si aad ah uga tiiraanyeysan tahay dhacdada foosha xun ee ka dhacday Isbitaalka Guud ee magaalada Hargeysa taasi oo ay nafteeda ku weysay Hooyo Danyar ah oo lagu magacaabi jiray Nimco Jaamac Yuusuf. Waxaa arin aad looga murugoodo islamarkaana laga tiiraanyoodo ah daruufta hooyadaas Soomaaliyeed ku kaliftay iney nafteeda goyso (Nafteeda haligto) weliba ayada oo umul ah mudo Todobaad ah taasi oo ay dadka deegaanku sheegeen in dhaqaallaha lagu xiray adeegga caafimaadka iyo daryeelka oo yaraa aawgiis ay ku kaliftay iney nafteeda haligto. “Waxaan si aad ah ugu boorineynaa guud ahaan Soomaalida meel walba oo ay joogaan ineynaan ogolaan sii socoshada xaaladaha noocaan ah ee aan ku weyneyno hooyo, taasi oo ah wax aad iyo aad uga fog bani’aadannimada” ayey si kulul u tiri Wasiirka Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Hormarinta Xuququuqul Insaanka XFS Amb Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi. Dhacdadan foosha xun ee naga soo gaartay magaalada Hargeysa waa dhacdo aad u naxdin badan oo qof walba oo damiir leh si toos ah u taabaneysa damiirkiisa, waxaanna Alle subxaanahu watacaalaa u weydiineynaa in uu naxariistiisa jano siiyo marxuumadda. items.title: Safiirka Itoobiya oo ka tegaya Soomaaliya kadib markii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Safiirka Dowladda Federaalka Itoobiya u qaabilsan arrimaha Soomaaliya, Danjire Suleymaan Dedefo Woshe ayaa haatan macsalaameynaya Soomaaliya, kaddib markii uu soo gabagaboobay muddo xileedkiisii diblomaasiyadeed ee gudaha dalka. Danjire Suleymaan Dedefo ayaa shalay booqasho sagootin ah ku tegay xarunta Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda, halkaas oo uu ku qaabilay Wasiir Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) oo ay yeesheen kulan laba geesood ah. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xiriirka labada dal, iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada diblomaasiyadda, amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo iskaashiga gobolka. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa Danjire Suleymaan uga mahadceliyay dadaalladii uu muddada xilka hayay ku bixiyay horumarinta iyo xoojinta xiriirka labada dal, isaga oo xusay kaalinta uu ka qaatay fududeynta wada-shaqeynta iyo isfahamka u dhexeeya dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa si qoto dheer uga hadlay muhiimadda xiriirka derisnimo iyo iskaashiga labada dal, iyaga oo carrabka ku adkeeyay sida ay uga go’an tahay sii xoojinta nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka Geeska Afrika. Wasiirka iyo Danjiraha ayaa isla qaatay in iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya uu muhiim u yahay horumarinta danaha labada shacab, iyadoo la xoojinayo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo wada-shaqeynta labada dal ee dhinacyada ay danaha wadaagaan. Dhankiisa Danjire Suleymaan Dedefo Woshe ayaa uga mahadceliyay Dowladda Soomaaliya soo dhaweynta iyo wada-shaqeyntii uu helay muddadii uu Soomaaliya ka ahaa Safiirka, isaga oo tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay in labada dal ay sii ambaqaadaan xiriirkooda iyo iskaashigooda. Ugu dambeyn, Wasiir Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali ayaa Danjire Suleymaan u rajeeyay guul, caafimaad iyo horumar uu ka gaaro waajibaadka iyo howlaha diblomaasiyadeed ee loo igmaday mustaqbalka, isaga oo xusay in Soomaaliya ay qiimeynayso dadaalladii uu ku bixiyay xoojinta xiriirka labada waddan. Danjire Suleymaan Dedefo ayaa shalay booqasho sagootin ah ku tegay xarunta Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda, halkaas oo uu ku qaabilay Wasiir Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) oo ay yeesheen kulan laba geesood ah. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xiriirka labada dal, iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada diblomaasiyadda, amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo iskaashiga gobolka. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa Danjire Suleymaan uga mahadceliyay dadaalladii uu muddada xilka hayay ku bixiyay horumarinta iyo xoojinta xiriirka labada dal, isaga oo xusay kaalinta uu ka qaatay fududeynta wada-shaqeynta iyo isfahamka u dhexeeya dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa si qoto dheer uga hadlay muhiimadda xiriirka derisnimo iyo iskaashiga labada dal, iyaga oo carrabka ku adkeeyay sida ay uga go’an tahay sii xoojinta nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka Geeska Afrika. Wasiirka iyo Danjiraha ayaa isla qaatay in iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya uu muhiim u yahay horumarinta danaha labada shacab, iyadoo la xoojinayo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo wada-shaqeynta labada dal ee dhinacyada ay danaha wadaagaan. Dhankiisa Danjire Suleymaan Dedefo Woshe ayaa uga mahadceliyay Dowladda Soomaaliya soo dhaweynta iyo wada-shaqeyntii uu helay muddadii uu Soomaaliya ka ahaa Safiirka, isaga oo tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay in labada dal ay sii ambaqaadaan xiriirkooda iyo iskaashigooda. Ugu dambeyn, Wasiir Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali ayaa Danjire Suleymaan u rajeeyay guul, caafimaad iyo horumar uu ka gaaro waajibaadka iyo howlaha diblomaasiyadeed ee loo igmaday mustaqbalka, isaga oo xusay in Soomaaliya ay qiimeynayso dadaalladii uu ku bixiyay xoojinta xiriirka labada waddan. items.title: Sababta Arsenal iyo Manchester City looga saaray Wembley
items.description: By Saleeymaan Alcadaala Sports Reporter, Radio Dalsan TV Arsenal iyo Manchester City ayaa galabta isku wajahaya FA Community Shield 2026, balse kulankan dhaqanka ah ma ka dhacayo garoonkii caadiga ahaa ee Wembley. Taa beddelkeeda, ciyaarta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Principality Stadium ee magaalada Cardiff, Wales, taasoo ah markii ugu horreysay muddo 20 sano ah oo tartankan lagu qabto Cardiff . Sababta ayaa ah in Wembley uu maanta martigelinayo bandhigyo waaweyn oo horay loo qorsheeyay, kuwaas oo ka dhigtay in garoonka London uusan diyaar u noqon kulanka . Qorshaha bandhigyada Wembley waxaa ka mid ah heesaha fanaanada caanka ah ee The Weeknd, kaas oo afartii maalmood ee u dhaxaysa 14 iyo 19 Agoosto ku sameynayo bandhigyo Wembley . Tani waxay ku beegan tahay maalinta ciyaarta, taasoo keentay in Golaha Kubadda Cagta Ingiriiska (FA) uu u wareejiyay garoonka Cardiff . Principality Stadium, oo awoodiisu tahay 74,000 oo qof, waxa uu horey u martigeliyay tartankan intii u dhaxaysay 2001 iyo 2006, xilli Wembley dib loo dhisayay . Arsenal ayaa kulankan ku soo galaysa iyadoo ah kooxda difaacanaysa horyaalka Premier League, halka Manchester City ay tahay kooxda ku guuleysatay FA Cup-ka . Labada kooxood waxay maanta u dagaallamayaan koobka ugu horreeya ee xilli-ciyaareedka 2026/27. Kulankani wuxuu sidoo kale muhiimad gaar ah u leeyahay Manchester City, maadaama uu yahay kulankii ugu horreeyay ee rasmi ah ee uu Enzo Maresca hoggaamiyo kooxda kadib bixitaankii Pep Guardiola . Dhanka Arsenal, Mikel Arteta waxa uu doonayaa inuu Arsenal ku bilaabo xilli-ciyaareedka koob, isagoo dhiirrigelinaya ciyaartoyda si ay u muujiyaan awooddooda. Labada kooxood waxay galabta doonayaan inay fariin hore u diraan kooxaha kale ee Premier League, iyadoo Arsenal ay doonayso inay sii xaqiijiso awooddeeda gudaha England, halka Manchester City ay doonayso inay dib ugu soo laabato meesha ugu sarreysa kubadda cagta Ingiriiska . The post Sababta Arsenal iyo Manchester City looga saaray Wembley first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: 5 Waxyaabood Oo Raggu Si Qarsoodi Ah Uga Filayaan Xaasaskooda
items.description: Shan Arrimood oo Raggu Jecel Yihiin Inay Ka Helaan Xaasaskooda MOGADISHU — Xiriirka guurka wuxuu ku dhisan yahay isfaham, kalgacal iyo qadarin, balse mararka qaar waxaa jira waxyaabo yaryar oo lammaanuhu jecel yihiin inay ka helaan qofka ay nolosha wadaagaan, iyaga oo aan si toos ah uga codsan. Muuqaal si weyn loo faafiyay ayaa soo bandhigay shan arrimood oo rag badan ay ku qiimeeyaan xiriirka guurka, gaar ahaan marka ay ka helaan xaasaskooda. Arrimahan ayaa inta badan ku saabsan muujinta kalgacalka, qadarin, wada hadal wanaagsan iyo in gurigu noqdo meel lagu dareemo deganaan. 1. In mararka qaar iyadu bilowdo muujinta kalgacalka Mid ka mid ah qodobada lagu xusay muuqaalka ayaa ah in ninku uusan mar walba noqon qofka bilaaba muujinta jacaylka iyo kalgacalka. Mararka qaar, in xaasku iyadu bilowdo dhunkashada, isku soo dhowaanshaha ama muujinta jacaylka waxay ninka siin kartaa dareen ah in isaga laftiisa la doonayo lana qadarinayo. 2. Kalgacal yar oo lama filaan ah Muujinta jacaylku mar walba uma baahna hadallo waaweyn ama hadiyado qaali ah. Taabasho fudud, isku duubni lama filaan ah ama dhunkasho xilliga maalinta ayaa noqon karta wax qofka kale si weyn u farxad geliya. Muuqaalku wuxuu tilmaamayaa in raggu, inkastoo mararka qaar ay muujiyaan adkaysi, ay sidoo kale qiimeeyaan daqiiqadaha yaryar ee tusaya in lammaanahoodu uu si gaar ah u doortay oo u qadariyo. 3. In si furan loo muujiyo qadarin Qadarin lagu muujiyo hadal ayaa sidoo kale lagu tilmaamay arrin muhiim ah. Erayo fudud sida “Waan kugu faanayaa” ama “Waxaan jeclahay sida aad qoyskeenna u daryeesho” waxay qofka siin karaan dareen ah in dadaalkiisa la arkayo lana qiimeynayo. Qof kasta wuxuu u baahan yahay in mararka qaar loo sheego in dadaalkiisa iyo doorkiisa la dareemayo, gaar ahaan marka ay tani ka timaaddo qofka uu nolosha ugu dhow yahay. 4. Wada hadal deggan marka khilaaf yimaado Khilaafku waa qayb ka mid ah xiriirrada bani’aadamka, laakiin sida loola macaamilo ayaa saameyn weyn ku yeelan karta xiriirka. Muuqaalku wuxuu ku talinayaa in marka ay xaasku xanaaqdo ama ay wax ka tabanayso, arrinta si daacad ah oo deggan looga wada hadlo, halkii laga isticmaali lahaa aamusnaan ciqaab ah, jees-jees ama hadallo dhaawac leh. Wada hadal ku dhisan ixtiraam ayaa ka caawin kara lammaanaha inay fahmaan dhibaatada jirta iyaga oo aan dhaawicin xiriirkooda. 5. In gurigu noqdo meel lagu helo deganaan Qodobka ugu dambeeya ayaa xoogga saaraya jawiga guriga. Soo dhaweyn wanaagsan, degganaan iyo dareen diirran ayaa guriga ka dhigi kara meel qofku ku nasto marka uu ka soo laabto waajibaadka iyo culaysyada nolosha. Sida uu muuqaalku xusay, marka qofku gurigiisa ka helo ammaan, deganaan iyo faham, waxaa sii xoogeysan kara xiriirka iyo dareenka uu u qabo lammaanihiisa. Xiriirku wuxuu ka bilaabmaa waxyaabaha yaryar Shanta qodob waxay muujinayaan in xiriir wanaagsan uusan mar walba ku dhisnayn waxyaabo waaweyn. Mararka qaar, hadal wanaagsan, taabasho yar, qadarin, wada hadal deggan iyo jawi wanaagsan oo guriga ah ayaa door weyn ka qaata xoojinta xiriirka lammaanaha. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa qof walba uu ka filayo xiriirkiisa way kala duwanaan karaan, sidaas darteed wada hadal furan oo dhex mara lammaanaha ayaa ah habka ugu wanaagsan ee lagu fahmi karo baahiyaha iyo dareenka labada dhinac. The post 5 Waxyaabood Oo Raggu Si Qarsoodi Ah Uga Filayaan Xaasaskooda first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

Senior UN Delegation Visits Las Anod Amid Humanitarian Concerns
items.description: LAS ANOD— George Conway, the United Nations Deputy Special Representative of the Secretary-General for Somalia and Resident and Humanitarian Coordinator, arrived in Las Anod on Sunday for high-level discussions with authorities and local stakeholders in Somalia’s Northeastern administration. During the visit, Conway is expected to meet senior officials of the Northeastern administration, community representatives and other local stakeholders. The discussions are expected to focus on the humanitarian situation, priority needs of affected communities and opportunities to strengthen coordination between the United Nations, humanitarian partners and local authorities. The visit comes amid continuing humanitarian pressures across Somalia, including the impact of drought and declining levels of international humanitarian funding. Authorities in Las Anod are also expected to raise concerns related to the aftermath of the 2023 conflict in the Sool region, including the situation of hundreds of prisoners captured during fighting with Somaliland forces. Conway is accompanied by a senior UN delegation, in what is regarded as one of the most high-level United Nations visits to Las Anod in recent years. The delegation is expected to assess conditions on the ground, engage directly with local officials and communities, and gather information that could inform the UN’s humanitarian and operational priorities in the area. The visit takes place as the United Nations and other international organisations in Somalia face increasing financial constraints, with funding shortages leading to reductions in programmes, staffing and operations in parts of the country. The discussions in Las Anod are therefore expected to also address how limited resources can be directed towards the most urgent humanitarian needs and how cooperation with local institutions can be strengthened. items.title: Wafdi ka Socda Qaramada Midoobay oo Gaaray Laascaanood
items.description: Wafdi uu hoggaaminayo Ku-xigeenka Ergayga Gaarka ah ee Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, ahna Isuduwaha Arrimaha Bani’aadantinimada iyo Isuduwaha Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, George Conway, ayaa gaaray magaalada Laascaanood. Wafdiga ayaa markii ay gaareen garoonka diyaaradaha Laascaanood waxaa kusoo dhoweeyay masuuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan maamulka Waqooyi Bari, iyadoo kadib loo galbiyay xarunta madaxtooyada magaalada. Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka maamulkaas Cabdirashiid Yuusuf Jabriil ayaa wafdiga ku qaabilay xarunta madaxtooyada, halkaas oo ay ku yeesheen kulan gaar ah oo looga hadlay xaaladda guud ee deegaanka iyo arrimaha bani’aadantinimada. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray arrimo la xiriira xaaladda bulshada, baahiyaha bani’aadantinimo iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga u dhexeeya hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay iyo maamulka deegaanka. Booqashada wafdigan ayaa sidoo kale muhiim u ah xoojinta xiriirka iyo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay iyo maamulka Waqooyi Bari, gaar ahaan dhinacyada gargaarka, adeegyada bulshada iyo howlaha bani’aadantinimo ee ka socda gobolka. Masuuliyiinta maamulka ayaa la filayaa inay wafdiga kala hadleen baahiyaha mudnaanta leh ee ka jira deegaanka, halka Qaramada Midoobayna ay qiimeyn ku sameyn karto xaaladda iyo howlaha ay hay’adaha caalamiga ah ka wadaan deegaannada hoos yimaada maamulka.

items.title: Washington Appoints New Deputy Chief of Mission to Somalia
items.description: MOGADISHU— The United States has appointed senior career diplomat Ruth Anne Stevens-Klitz as Deputy Chief of Mission at the U.S. Embassy in Somalia, where she is expected to take up her post in Mogadishu during August 2026. Stevens-Klitz brings more than 25 years of experience in the U.S. Foreign Service, with an extensive diplomatic career spanning Africa, the Middle East and Europe. Before her appointment to Somalia, she served as Counselor for Public Affairs at the U.S. Embassy in Senegal and Guinea-Bissau. Her previous overseas assignments include postings in Ethiopia, Egypt, Morocco, Germany, Israel and Armenia, alongside a number of diplomatic and policy roles in Washington, D.C. Throughout her career, Stevens-Klitz has developed broad expertise in public diplomacy and international engagement, including building partnerships with host governments, international organisations, private-sector actors and civil society. Her work has also focused on strengthening dialogue, expanding access to information and promoting exchanges of ideas between the United States and its international partners. She has significant experience in initiatives involving youth and emerging leaders, economic and commercial engagement, cultural heritage preservation and the promotion of media freedom. Stevens-Klitz holds a Bachelor of Science in Foreign Service from Georgetown University and a Master of Strategic Studies from the U.S. Army War College. She is also proficient in French, German, Russian and Arabic. Her appointment comes at a significant point in Somalia–U.S. relations, which remain anchored in cooperation on security, counterterrorism, stabilisation, institutional development and diplomatic engagement. As Deputy Chief of Mission, Stevens-Klitz is expected to play a central role in the day-to-day leadership of the U.S. diplomatic mission in Somalia and in advancing Washington’s engagement with the Federal Government of Somalia and other Somali stakeholders. items.title: Muqdisho oo Laga Daahfuray Sharciga Cadaaladda Da’yarta Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Magaalada Muqdisho waxaa ka furmay shirka Qaran ee daahfurka Sharciga Cadaaladda Da’yarta Soomaaliyeed, kaas oo diiradda lagu saarayo hirgelinta nidaam caddaaladeed oo si gaar ah uga jawaabaya baahiyaha iyo xuquuqda carruurta Soomaaliyeed. Munaasabadda ayaa waxaa kasoo qeyb galay madaxda hay’adaha dowladda ee heer federaal iyo dowlad-goboleed, hay’adaha amniga, bahda caddaaladda, hay’adaha caalamiga ah, iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Shirkan ayaa sidoo kale lagu wadaa in lagu qabto doodo iyo falanqeyn ku saabsan dhaqan-gelinta sharciga iyo waajibaadka hay’adaha kala duwan ee ku lugta leh caddaaladda carruurta. Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil, ayaa sheegay in bahda amnigu ay si dhow ula shaqeyn doonaan dhammaan dhinacyada ay khuseyso hirgelinta sharciga, si loo xaqiijiyo cadaalad wax-ku-ool ah iyo ilaalinta xuquuqda carruurta Soomaaliyeed. Wasiirka ayaa carruurta ku tilmaamay qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah mustaqbalka dalka, isagoo yiri: “Marka ay awlaadeennu hagaagaan, dalkuna wuu hagaagayaa. Carruurtu qayb muhiim ah ayay ka qaadanayaan dhismaha mustaqbalka dalka.” Dhanka kale, Ku-xigeenka Wakiilka Barnaamijyada ee Sanduuqa Carruurta Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya ( UNICEF” Nisar Syed, ayaa sheegay in ansixinta Xeerka Caddaaladda Carruurta ay tahay tallaabo taariikhi ah oo Soomaaliya u qaaday dhismaha nidaam caddaaladeed oo ilaalinaya xuquuqda, karaamada iyo mustaqbalka carruurta. “Ansixinta Xeerka Caddaaladda Carruurta waa tallaabo taariikhi ah oo Soomaaliya u qaaday dhismaha nidaam caddaaladeed oo taageeraya carruurta xuquuqdooda, karaamadooda iyo mustaqbalkooda,” ayuu yiri Nisar Syed. Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka, Sulaymaan Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa isna khudbad ka jeediyay munaasabadda, isagoo si gaar ah u tilmaamay muhiimadda Sharciga Cadaaladda Carruurta iyo doorka uu ka qaadanayo dhameystirka nidaamka lagu ilaalinayo xuquuqda iyo daryeelka carruurta Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, Agaasimaha Guud ee Arrimaha Cadaaladda ee Wasaaradda Cadaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka, Cabdinuur Maxamed Xasan, ayaa jeediyay hadal soo dhaweyn ah, isagoo sharaxay ujeeddooyinka munaasabadda qaran iyo muhiimadda daahfurka sharcigan. Sharciga Cadaaladda Da’yarta Soomaaliyeed ayaa la filayaa inuu noqdo hannaan muhiim u ah sidii carruurta iyo da’yarta la kulma nidaamka caddaaladda loo siin lahaa daryeel iyo hannaan cadaaladeed oo tixgelinaya da’dooda, xuquuqdooda iyo mustaqbalkooda. Daahfurka sharcigan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo hay’adaha caddaaladda, amniga iyo ilaalinta xuquuqda aadanaha, iyadoo muhiimadda la siinayo in carruurta lagu dabaqo hannaan caddaaladeed oo ku saleysan ilaalin, dib-u-habeyn iyo fursad ay mustaqbalkooda ku dhistaan.
