items.title: Sawirro: Deni oo Xasan uga hor-maray Gaalkacyo kadibna billaabay dhaq-dhaqaaq culus
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa xalaykulan la yeeshay saraakiisha ciidamada iyo mas’uuliyiinta dowladda ee ku sugan gobolka Mudug, xilli magaalada Gaalkacyo ay ka taagan tahay xiisad siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo u dhexeysa Puntland iyo dowladda federaalka. Kulanka oo ka dhacay Aqalka Madaxtooyada Puntland ee Gaalkacyo ayaa ahaa mid is-xogwareysi ah, waxaana diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda guud ee gobolka Mudug, gaar ahaan dhinaca amniga iyo dib-u-habeynta ciidamada. War kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Puntland ayaa lagu sheegay in Deni iyo saraakiisha ay sidoo kale ka wada-hadleen xaaladda ciidamada ku sugan degmooyinka Saaxo, Gaalkacyo iyo Galdogob, iyo sidii loo dardargelin lahaa dib-u-habeyntooda. Waxaa kale oo kulanka looga hadlay mashaariicda horumarineed ee ka socda gobolka Mudug, kuwaas oo isugu jira kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo xarumaha bixiya adeegyada bulshada, sida lagu sheegay qoraalka Madaxtooyada. Kulanka Deni ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli xaaladda Gaalkacyo ay maalmahan yeelatay xasaasiyad gaar ah, kadib markii Puntland ay si adag uga digtay qorshaha Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu ku tegayo koonfurta Gaalkacyo ee Galmudug maamusho. Puntland ayaa Xasan Sheekh ku eedeysay inuu weli wado “abaabul colaad ka dhan ah deegaannadeeda”, waxayna ku doodday in safarkaasi uu leeyahay ujeeddo lagu doonayo in qalalaase looga abuuro magaalada Gaalkacyo, oo muddooyinkii dambe ka soo kabaneysay colaado iyo xiisado soo noqnoqday. “Dowladda Puntland waxay si dhow ula socotaa abaabulada qorshaysan ee uu Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud wado, waxayna ka digaysaa qorshaha safarka Xasan Sheekh uu ku imaanayo Koonfurta Gaalkacyo ee Dowladda Galmudug,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal ay soo saartay Madaxtooyada Puntland. Dowladda federaalka ayaa dhinaceeda gaashaanka ku dhufatay digniintaas. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa sheegay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu tegayo koonfurta Gaalkacyo, isaga oo ku adkeystay in madaxweynuhu uu booqan karo deegaannada Galmudug. “War waxaas waba ma qaadi karo waa nin iska hadlay Gaalkacyo wuu tegayaa Madaxweynuhu wuxuu tegayaa maamulka Galmudug, sida uu u joogo Dhuusamareeb marka cid uu marti uga yahay ma jirto runtii waxaan is leeyahay warqaddaas waa warqad aan qiil lahayn,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Fiqi. Fiqi ayaa sidoo kale qoraal uu soo saaray Jimcihii ku eedeeyay Madaxweynaha Puntland, isaga oo sheegay inuu la saftay shisheeyihii ay is-hayeen Soomaaliya, oo uu ula jeedo Imaaraadka iyo Itoobiya, isla markaana uu taageeray kala go’a dalka, taas oo qiyaano qaran ah. “Deni wuxuu Soomaaliya kala saftay shisheeyihii la is qabtay, wuxuu taageeray kala go’a dalka, wuxuu gacan siiyay xasuuqa walaalaha Sudan ay cadowgu u geysanayaan,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi. Xiisadda hadda taagan ayaa sidoo kale daba socota dhacdooyin amni oo horraantii bishan ka dhacay Gaalkacyo. 4-tii Agoosto waxaa koonfurta magaalada laga dejiyay hub ay Puntland sheegtay in dowladda federaalka u waday ciidamo ku sugan magaalada, halka maalintii xigtay ciidamada Puntland ay dagaal la galeen ciidamo ka tirsan PSF, kadibna ay la wareegeen xero ay ciidamadaasi kaga sugnaayeen waqooyiga Gaalkacyo. Inkasta oo Madaxtooyada Puntland aysan kulanka caawa si toos ah ugu xiriirin khilaafka kala dhexeeya dowladda federaalka, haddana waqtiga uu dhacayo ayaa muhiimad gaar ah siinaya, maadaama Mudug uu noqday meesha ugu weyn ee uu toddobaadyadii dambe kusoo ururay loollanka siyaasadeed iyo kan amni ee Muqdisho iyo Garoowe. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Tababar U Soo Xiray Cutubyo ka Tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ahna Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa Dugsiga Xananbuure ee Gobolka Galgaduud tababar ugu soo xiray cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Munaasabadda lagu soo gabagabeynayay tababarka ciidamada ayaa waxaa ka qeyb galay Madaxweynaha Galmudug Axmed Cabdi Kaariye Qoor-Qoor, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, xildhibaano, saraakiil ciidan iyo marti-sharaf kale. Ciidamadii tababarka soo dhameystay ayaa munaasabadda kusoo bandhigay dhoolatus ciidan iyo gaada ka ciyaar, iyagoo muujiyay xirfadaha iyo aqoonta ay heleen intii uu socday tababarku. Tababarkan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu tayeynayo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo xoogga lagu saarayo sare u qaadista awoodda, anshaxa iyo diyaargarowga ciidamada si ay uga qeyb qaataan waajibaadka amniga iyo difaaca dalka.

items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka ee Soomaaliya ayaa bilowday wadatashi ku saabsan hindise-sharciyeed cusub oo lagu nidaaminayo maamulka iyo howlaha masaajidda dalka. Hindise-sharciyeedkan ayaa lagu doonayaa in lagu dejiyo xeerar cad oo qeexaya waajibaadka iyo masuuliyadaha dadka iyo dhinacyada ku shaqada leh maamulka masaajidda, iyadoo sidoo kale looga gol leeyahay in la hagaajiyo habka loo maamulo goobaha cibaadada. Sharcigan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu hagaajinayo maamulka masaajidda, isla markaana lagu yareynayo khilaafaadka mararka qaar ka dhasha arrimaha la xiriira maamulka, mas’uuliyadda iyo howlaha masaajidda, sida ay sheegtay wasaaraddu. Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka, Dr. Cabdinafac Axmed Cabdullaahi ayaa Khamiistii furay kulan wadatashi ah oo looga hadlayay hindise-sharciyeedka, kaas oo ay ka qeyb-galeen imaamyo, culimo, wacdiyeyaal iyo maamulayaasha masaajidda. Kulanka ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray qodobbada ku jira hindise-sharciyeedka, iyadoo ka qeybgalayaasha laga dalbaday inay soo gudbiyaan talooyin iyo aragtiyo ku aaddan sidii loo dhammaystiri lahaa sharciga ka hor inta aan loo gudbin Golaha Wasiirrada. Wasaaradda ayaa xaqiijisay in aysan doonayn inay si keligeed ah go’aan uga gaarto arrimaha masaajidda, balse ay muhiim tahay in la helo hannaan ku dhisan wada-tashi iyo ka-qaybgalka dadka ay arrintani khusayso. Hindise-sharciyeedku wuxuu qeexi doonaa waajibaadka iyo masuuliyadaha maamullada masaajidda, habka loo maamulayo howlaha masaajidda, xiriirka iyo wada-shaqeynta dhinacyada ku lugta leh iyo habraacyada lagu yareynayo khilaafaadka ka dhasha is-faham la’aanta maamulka, sida wasaaraddu sheegtay. Imaamyadii iyo maamulayaashii ka qeyb galay kulanka ayaa soo dhaweeyay wadatashiga, iyagoo muujiyay sida ay diyaar ugu yihiin inay wasaaradda la wadaagaan talooyinkooda iyo khibradahooda si loo helo sharci si wanaagsan uga jawaaba baahiyaha masaajidda dalka. Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay in hindise-sharciyeedku uu weli ku jiro marxaladda wadatashiga, iyadoo la ururinayo talooyinka culimada, imaamyada iyo maamulayaasha masaajidda. Si kastaba, hindise-sharciyeedkan ayaa marka la dhammaystiro waxaa la filayaa in loo gudbiyo Golaha Wasiirrada, iyadoo haddii la meel-mariyo uu sharcigu noqon karo tallaabo lagu mideynayo nidaamka maamulka masaajidda iyo caddeynta masuuliyadaha dhinacyada ku shaqada leh. items.title: Somalis burn Turkish flag as resentment grows over Ankara airstrikes
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – A video circulating on social media this week shows Somalis in the country’s Southwest state setting fire to the Turkish flag while holding aloft the state’s own banner, a striking act of defiance that captures a rapid souring of public sentiment toward a country long regarded as one of Somalia’s closest allies. In the footage, a group of men and women can be seen burning the flag and accusing Turkey of bombing rural communities, killing livestock and, they allege, children – grievances they say have become unbearable. The anger traces back to late March, when federal forces removed Southwest state President Abdiaziz Laftagareen in a military offensive that, according to local media reports, Turkey backed with air support, logistics, equipment and forces it had trained. Turkish drones have since carried out strikes near Baidoa, the regional interim capital, in areas where fighters loyal to the ousted leader are positioned – part of what has become a low-level guerrilla campaign against federal troops. For two decades, Somalia’s international security partners confined their military role to the fight against Al-Shabaab, steering clear of intra-Somali political disputes. Analysts say Turkey’s direct involvement in ousting a sitting regional president marks a break from that precedent – one they view as unprecedented and destabilizing. “We and Turkey are not neighbours. Why are they bombing us? We are not terrorists, and we are not at war with Turkey,” said Abdi Ahmed Libow, a former Somali federal state minister of labour, who called on Ankara to withdraw its forces and urged the international community to press Turkey to halt the strikes. Laftagareen’s forces have continued to resist from rural positions around Baidoa. The ousted leader has vowed to fight on , describing the federal troops that removed him as clan militias, and argues that President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s own mandate has lapsed and that he no longer has constitutional standing to lead the country – a dispute that sits at the heart of Somalia’s wider political crisis. Accusations of a “neo-colonial agenda” The Southwest backlash has fed into a broader current of criticism among Somali political and academic figures accusing Turkey of overreach. Prominent among them is Abdi Ismail Samatar, a Somali senator and professor, who has published a series of essays – including one titled “Türkiye’s Neo-Colonial Agenda in Somalia” – accusing Ankara of using its military relationship with Mogadishu to secure control over Somalia’s natural resources. Samatar alleges that Turkish vessels are exploring and drilling for oil in Somali waters under a defence and petroleum arrangement he says has never been made public, telling followers that “the Somali Parliament has yet to see the texts of the two ‘agreements.'” He has also accused the Turkish leadership of proceeding with exploration despite what he describes as full awareness the deals are improperly constituted – language he has used to brand Ankara a “resources pirate.” Samatar has further argued that Ankara’s military support has propped up what he calls a deeply unpopular administration in Mogadishu whose constitutional term ended, saying Somalis “will not forget Türkiye’s” role. In his writing, Samatar goes further still, stating that Mohamud will, in his words, be remembered as the worst president in Somalia’s history, and accusing him of using Turkish military material to entrench what Samatar describes as a personal dictatorship rather than pursue an inclusive political transition – including, he has said, by deploying security forces against opposition demonstrations in Mogadishu. Samatar frames Turkey’s broader objective as the creation of what he calls a client state through which Ankara can extract Somalia’s natural resources and strategic value, and has said Turkish leaders are proceeding with resource agreements he characterizes as fraudulent. In June, opposition figures accused Turkey of supplying suicide drones and weapons used in raids on compounds linked to former president Sharif Sheikh Ahmed and former Premier Hassan Ali Khaire. Both men said they survived “assassination” attempts , which touched off clashes between their guards and federal security forces. Turkish officials have not publicly responded to the allegation of direct involvement in those raids. A documented strike, and a wider pattern Independent of the political allegations, one incident involving Turkish drones has been formally documented: on March 18, 2024, a strike in the village of Baghdad in the Lower Shabelle region killed 23 civilians, including 14 children, and wounded 17 others, according to Amnesty International, which said the incident could amount to a war crime and called for an investigation. Turkey has not claimed responsibility for that strike or issued a public accounting of it. Somali analysts describe the pattern of Turkish drone operations that has followed as the deadliest campaign of aerial bombardment Somalia has experienced in close to two decades of air war in the country – a period that has also included U.S. and other international counterterrorism strikes against Al-Shabaab-held territory. Security analysts warn that Turkish air operations targeting Somali political and clan constituencies, rather than Al-Shabaab positions, carry a compounding risk: they thread directly into the fault lines of Somalia’s clan politics, and analysts caution that strikes perceived as favoring one clan over another could deepen the same rivalries already driving the country’s civil conflict, from Mogadishu’s political standoff to the dispute over Southwest state’s leadership. Civilian casualties from airstrikes, they note, are widely understood to harden local sympathy against the forces responsible for them and to feed the recruitment pipelines of militant groups – a dynamic that risks handing Al-Shabaab a propaganda opening, and one that could, in the analysts’ assessment, set back rather than reinforce Somalia’s broader stabilization effort. Those analysts also caution that Turkey’s deepening involvement in Somalia’s internal political disputes risks eroding two decades of investment by Western partners, principally the United States and the European Union, in funding the African Union peacekeeping mission, building state institutions, and training and equipping Somali forces. They argue that a unified Somali political leadership – rather than competing foreign-backed factions – is the precondition for defeating Al-Shabaab, and that Turkey’s willingness to take sides in domestic power struggles complicates rather than reinforces that effort. They also note the scale gap: Turkish-trained Somali units, known as Gorgor, were driven out of the strategic river-crossing towns of Awdheegle, Barire and Sabiid by Al-Shabaab earlier this year and were unable to retake the towns until African Union forces, backed by U.S. air support, intervened – underscoring how dependent Somalia’s security gains remain on the Western-backed AU mission rather than on Ankara’s more recent and narrower military footprint. Turkey is reported to be expanding Baidoa’s airport to accommodate F-16 fighter jets, a move that would extend its strike capability in a region already marked by acute clan sensitivities, given that the federally installed regional leader hails from a different clan than the ousted Laftagareen. Local officials told Somali Guardian that Turkey also intends to pursue mineral and rare-earth resources in the region, adding a further economic dimension to Ankara’s expanding footprint in the Southwest – though the officials did not describe the basis of any such arrangement. Some Somali commentators have drawn a pointed historical parallel, comparing the current campaign to the aerial bombardment of northwestern Somalia by the regime of Siad Barre in the 1980s – a campaign widely cited by historians as a catalyst for the state’s eventual collapse. Samatar, among the most vocal critics, has argued that President Mohamud is repeating that history “the second time as farce,” accusing him of using Turkish military support to block an inclusive political transition in the same manner that, in Samatar’s account, Barre once refused to accept a peaceful transfer of power. items.title: NISA oo Maxaas Ku Dilay Saddex Horjooge oo Al-Shabaab ah
items.description: Hiiraan (Raxanreeb Online): Ciidanka Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA), oo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamka, ayaa howlgal qorsheysan ka fuliyay degmada Maxaas ee gobolka Hiiraan, kaas oo lagu beegsaday guri ay ku sugnaayeen horjoogeyaal sare oo ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Sida ay NISA sheegtay, howlgalka oo dhacay 12-kii Agoosto 2026 ayaa lagu dilay saddex horjooge oo ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab, halka dhaawac culus lagu gaarsiiyay Mustaf Caato, oo NISA ku tilmaantay madaxa waxa ay kooxda ugu yeerto Jabhadaha Gobolka Hiiraan, iyo laba horjooge oo kale. Mustaf Caato ayaa la sheegay inuu muddo ku lug lahaa qorsheynta iyo isku-dubbaridka weerarrada Al-Shabaab, isla markaana uu horey u maamulay qeybta qaraxyada iyo maleeshiyaadka ismiidaaminta. Horjoogeyaasha lagu dilay howlgalka ayaa lagu kala magacaabay Cabdi Xaafid, oo ka tirsanaa qeybta qaraxyada; Daalibaan, oo ka tirsanaa qeybta gurmadka Gobolka Hiiraan; iyo Cumar Xuseen, oo horjooge ka ahaa qeyb kamid ah waxa kooxda ugu yeerto Jabhadaha. NISA ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in dhaawac culus uu kasoo gaaray howlgalka Maxamed Eeney iyo Salaad Buur, kuwaas oo kamid ahaa horjoogeyaasha kooxda. Hay’adda ayaa sheegtay in Mustaf Caato uu muddo kamid ahaa bartilmaameedyada mudnaanta sare u lahaa hay’adaha amniga, iyadoo howlgalka lagu sheegay inuu qeyb ka yahay dadaallada lagu wiiqayo awoodda iyo hoggaanka Al-Shabaab. items.title: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Shacabka Janaale oo Kulan Amni Yeeshay
items.description: Shabeellaha Hoose (Raxanreeb Online): Kulan amni oo lagu xoojinayo xiriirka iyo wada shaqeynta shacabka iyo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa lagu qabtay deegaanka Janaale ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Kaaliyaha Guutada 14-ka Oktoobar ee Ciidanka Dhulka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, G/le Aadan Xasan Cismaan, ayaa kulan la qaatay qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada Janaale iyo maamulka deegaanka. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sidii loo xoojin lahaa wada shaqeynta shacabka iyo ciidamada, iyadoo bulshada lagu wargeliyay in ujeeddooyinka Al-Shabaab ay kamid yihiin dhibaateynta iyo gumaadka shacabka Soomaaliyeed. G/le Aadan Xasan ayaa sheegay in isku xirnaanta shacabka iyo ciidamada ay muhiim u tahay sugidda amniga, isla markaana ay yareyn karto fursadaha ay Al-Shabaab uga faa’iideysan karaan bulshada dhexdeeda. items.title: Somali Airlines oo Dib u Bilaabaysa Duulimaadyada
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa shaacisay in shirkadda diyaaradaha qaranka ee Somali Airlines ay dib u bilaabi doonto howlaheeda, iyadoo duulimaadkii ugu horreeyay la qorsheeyay inuu bilowdo bisha September. Dib u soo laabashada Somali Airlines ayaa soo afjaraysa in ka badan 30 sano oo shirkaddu hawada ka maqneyd, kaddib markii ay duulimaadyadii joojisay sanadkii 1991-kii. Somali Airlines oo horey loogu naaneysi jiray “Xiddigta Cad ee Afrika” ayaa muddo dheer kamid ahayd shirkadihii diyaaradaha ee caanka ka ahaa qaaradda Afrika. Dowladda ayaa tallaabadan ku tilmaantay mid muhiim u ah dib u soo celinta shirkadda qaranka iyo horumarinta adeegyada duulimaadyada Soomaaliya. items.title: Maamulka Trump oo billaabaya masaafurinta Soomaali badan kadib go’aan maxkamadeed
items.description: Boston (Caasimada Online) — Garsoore federaal ah oo ku sugan gobolka Massachusetts ayaa meesha ka saartay amar si ku-meel-gaar ah u hakiyay qorshaha maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump ee lagu joojinayo sharciga Temporary Protected Status (TPS) ee Soomaalida, taas oo dowladda u fasaxeysa inay dhaqan-geliso go’aankaas ayna billowdo masaafurin. Garsoore Allison Burroughs ayaa Jimcihii laashay hakintii ay hore ugu soo rogtay kiiska, kadib markii Maxkamadda Sare ee Mareykanka ay bishii June xaddidday awoodda maxkamadaha hoose ay dib ugu eegi karaan go’aannada Waaxda Amniga Gudaha ee Mareykanka (DHS) ee lagu joojinayo TPS. Go’aanka cusub macnihiisu ma aha in dhammaan Soomaalida haysta TPS isla markiiba la masaafurinayo. Hase yeeshee, dadka aan haysan sharci kale oo ay Mareykanka ku joogaan waxay waayi karaan difaaca TPS ee ka ilaalinayay masaafurinta, iyo sidoo kale oggolaanshaha shaqada ee ku xirnaa sharcigaas. Go’aanka ayaa saameyn ku yeelan karo ku dhowaad 1,100 Soomaali ah. Tirakoob hore oo ay sameysay Congressional Research Service ayaa dhigayay tirada dadka Soomaaliyeed ee TPS haysta ay yihiin 705 qof, iyadoo kala duwanaanshaha tiradu uu la xiriiro xilliga xogta la ururiyay iyo codsiyada weli socda. Garsoore Burroughs ayaa sheegtay in Soomaalida dacwadda gudbisay ay soo bandhigeen dood xooggan oo muujineysa dhibaatada ka dhalan karta haddii ilaalinta laga qaado, balse ay ku qasban tahay inay raacdo jihada ay Maxkamadda Sare dejisay. “Dacwad-oogayaashu waxay si i qancisa u muujiyeen inay wajihi doonaan dhibaato aan dib loo sixi karin haddii amarka maxkamadeed la waayo,” ayay Burroughs ku qortay go’aankeeda. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in marka la eego dhibaatada labada dhinac iyo danta guud ay arrintu u janjeerto dhinaca dacwad-oogayaasha, maadaama dowladda aysan muujin in sii wadista TPS inta dacwaddu socoto ay culeys aan loo adkeysan karin ku tahay. Hase yeeshee, garsooruhu waxay sheegtay in go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare uu si weyn u ciriiriyay waddooyinka sharci ee ay Soomaalidu ku sii hor istaagi karaan qorshaha dowladda. Dood ku saabsan takoorka Dacwadda waxaa gudbiyay afar Soomaali ah iyo laba urur oo u dooda xuquuqda muhaajiriinta, waxaana doodahooda ugu muhiimsanaa in maamulka Trump uu go’aanka uu Soomaalida uga qaaday TPS ku saleeyay naceyb iyo takoor ku wajahan muhaajiriinta aan caddaanka ahayn. Waxay maxkamadda hor dhigeen hadallo kala duwan oo Trump hore uga jeediyay Soomaalida, gaar ahaan xilli dowladda federaalka ay sare u qaaday howlgallada socdaalka ee Minnesota, oo ay ku nool yihiin Soomaali badan. Burroughs waxay sheegtay in dacwad-oogayaashu soo bandhigeen “dood xooggan” oo muujineysa in qaar ka mid ah hadallada la soo bandhigay ay ahaayeen kuwo cunsuriyad leh. Laakiin waxay intaas ku dartay in go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ee kiiska Mullin v. Doe uu ka dhigay mid aad u adag in dooddaas lagu guuleysto. “Kadib Mullin, maxkamaddu ma aragto waddo ay ku gaari karto gunaanad ah in dacwad-oogayaashu ay u badan tahay inay ku guuleystaan dooddan,” ayay qortay. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in caddeymaha duruufaha ku xeeran go’aanka ay si muuqata u muujinayaan in Soomaaliya iyo Soomaalida si gaar ah loo bartilmaameedsaday, balse taas oo keliya aysan hadda ku filneyn in lagu guuleysto dacwad ku saleysan takoor jinsiyadeed. TPS oo Soomaaliya la siiyay 1991 Soomaaliya waxaa markii ugu horreysay TPS loo aqoonsaday sanadkii 1991, xilli dowladdii dhexe burburtay, dalkuna galay dagaallo sokeeye. TPS waa sharci ku-meel-gaar ah oo dowladda Mareykanka siiso dadka ka soo jeeda dalal aysan si ammaan ah ugu laaban karin sababo la xiriira dagaal, musiibo dabiici ah ama xaalado kale oo aan caadi ahayn. Dadka haysta waxay si sharci ah ugu noolaan karaan ugana shaqeyn karaan Mareykanka inta aqoonsiga dalkooda uu shaqeynayo. Maamulkii Madaxweyne Joe Biden ayaa 2024 mar kale kordhiyay isla markaana dib u cusbooneysiiyay TPS-ka Soomaaliya muddo 18 bilood ah, isagoo xusay dagaallada hubeysan iyo xaaladaha amni ee dalka ka jira. Kordhintaas waxaa loogu talagalay inay socoto ilaa 17-ka March 2026. Maamulka Trump ayaa bishii January 2026 ku dhawaaqay inuu joojinayo TPS-ka Soomaaliya, isagoo sheegay in xaaladda dalka ay soo hagaagtay heer aysan mar dambe buuxin shuruudaha sharciga. Go’aankaas waxaa markii hore loo qorsheeyay inuu dhaqan-galo 17-ka March, balse Burroughs ayaa maalmo ka hor hakisay. Maxkamadda Sare ayaa bishii June, kiis la xiriiray joojinta TPS-ka Haiti iyo Syria, go’aan si weyn u xaddiday awoodda garsoorayaasha federaalka ay ku faragelin karaan go’aannada noocan ah ee DHS. Tan iyo markaas, maxkamado kale ayaa sidoo kale oggolaaday in maamulka Trump uu joojiyo TPS-ka South Sudan iyo Myanmar. Go’aanka Jimcihii ayaa Soomaaliya ka saaraya dalalkii uu joojinta TPS-kooda weli u xannibnaa amar maxkamadeed. Itoobiya ayaa hadda ah dalka keliya ee joojinta TPS-kiisa ay wali maxkamad hakisay. items.title: Dawladda Soomaaliya oo sheegtay in diyaaradda Somali Airlines ay bisha soo socata billaabayso duulimaadyada
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa mar kale ku dhawaaqday qorshe ay dib ugu hawlgelinayso shirkadda diyaaradaha qaranka ee Somali Airlines , iyadoo la sheegay in duulimaadyada tooska ah la bilaabi doono bisha Sebtembar 2026. Maareeyaha Hay’adda duulista Rayidka ah ee Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin ayaa sheegay in diyaar-garowgii loo baahnaa la soo dhammaystiray, duulimaadyada diyaaradduna la filayo inay dhowaan billowdaan. Somali Airlines ayaa duulimaadyadii joojisay 1991-kii, waxaana muddo ka badan 35 sano Soomaaliya aysan lahayn shirkad diyaaradeed oo qaran oo si buuxda u shaqeysa. Bishii Luulyo 2025 ayay dowladda sheegtay inay qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah oo dib loogu soo celinayo shirkadda, kadib markii la shaaciyay heshiis lagu helayo laba diyaaradood oo nooca Airbus A320 ah. Hase yeeshee, ballanqaadka cusub ee Sebtembar wuxuu kusoo beegmayaa iyadoo dowladda horey dhowr jeer u sheegtay in Somali Airlines ay bilaabi doonto duulimaadyo. Bishii Oktoobar 2025, Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada ayaa sheegay in shirkaddu dib u bilaabi doonto hawlaheeda ka hor dhammaadka sanadkaas, halka warbixinno kale ay xilligaas tilmaamayeen in diyaar-garowgii hawlgelinta uu marayay heer gabagabo ah. Si kastaba, dib-u-hawlgelinta shirkad diyaaradeed kuma koobna oo keliya helitaanka diyaarado, balse Waxaa loo baahan yahay in la xaqiijiyo shuruudaha badbaadada iyo rukhsadaha hawlgalka, shaqaale tababaran, dayactir joogto ah, caymis, qorshaha duulimaadyada iyo heshiisyada lagama maarmaanka u ah garoomada ay diyaaradaha ku degayaan.

items.title: NISA oo sheegtay in Saddex horjooge lagu diley howlgal ka dhacay Maxaas
items.description: Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka Soomaaliya (NISA) ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadeeda oo taageero ka helaya saaxiibada caalamka, ay 12-kii Agoosto howlgal qorsheysan ka fuliyeen degmada Maxaas ee gobolka Hiiraan. Sida lagu sheegay warbixin ay NISA soo saartay, howlgalka ayaa ka dhacay guri ay hay’addu sheegtay inay ku sugnaayeen xubno sare oo ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, waxayna hay’addu sheegtay in howlgalka lagu dilay saddex xubnood, halka dhowr kalena lagu dhaawacay. NISA waxay magacyada dadka ay sheegtay in lagu dilay howlgalka ku kala sheegtay Cabdi Xaafid, oo ay ku tilmaantay inuu ka tirsanaa qaybta qaraxyada; Daalibaan, oo ay sheegtay inuu ka tirsanaa qaybta gurmadka gobolka Hiiraan; iyo Cumar Xuseen, oo ay ku tilmaantay horjooge ka tirsanaa waxa kooxda loogu yeero Jabhadaha. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Mustaf Caato, oo ay ku tilmaantay madaxa guud ee Jabhadaha gobolka Hiiraan, uu dhaawac culus ka soo gaaray howlgalka. Sida bayaanka NISA lagu sheegay, Caato ayaa markii dambe laga qaaday Maxaas, waxaana loo gudbiyay degmada Ceelbuur si loogu daweeyo. NISA waxay Mustaf Caato ku eedeysay inuu muddo ku lug lahaa qorsheynta iyo isku-dubbaridka weerarrada Al-Shabaab, iyadoo sheegtay inuu horey u maamulayay qaybaha qaraxyada iyo weerarrada ismiidaaminta. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Maxamed Eeney iyo Salaad Buur ay dhaawacyo culus ka soo gaareen howlgalka. Warbixinta NISA waxay howlgalka ku tilmaantay qayb ka mid ah dadaallada lagu wiiqayo awoodda iyo hoggaanka Al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan xubnaha loo arko inay door muhiim ah ku leeyihiin abaabulka iyo fulinta weerarrada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, faahfaahinta ku saabsan tirada khasaaraha, xaaladda dhaawacyada iyo muhiimadda xubnaha la sheegay in lagu dilay ama lagu dhaawacay ayaa ku saleysan bayaanka NISA.

items.title: Powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake kills at least 20 in Indonesia
items.description: BBC (London) – At least 20 people have been killed after a 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck Indonesia early on Saturday, the nation’s disaster mitigation agency has said. BPBD said that others had been injured to varying degrees, cautioning that the figures were preliminary while search and rescue operations were ongoing. Buildings in the region have been damaged by the quake and the dozens of aftershocks that followed. The quake struck the island of Flores shortly before 05:00 local time on Saturday (22:00 GMT on Friday). It had a depth of 15km, Indonesia’s meteorology and geophysics agency stated. The earthquake struck around 600 miles (1,000km) away from Bali. The shallower an earthquake is, the more destructive its effects on the surface tend to be. Strong aftershocks were felt in the same area, including one with a magnitude of 6.1. Video taken at the port in Maumere showed large chunks of concrete breaking off the terminal building onto passengers waiting to board an inter-island ferry. Some were thrown into the sea when the gangway to a ship collapsed. Emanuel Melkiades Laka Lena, governor of East Nusa Tenggara province, told a news conference that they were killed in their sleep by collapsing rubble. Arnold Welianto, who lives in Talibura, a village near the coastline in Sikka, East Nusa Tenggara, said he was awoken by the “very strong shaking”, adding: “I was startled awake and immediately went to my child’s room.” He told the BBC that many people had already fled into the hills. “Some other residents were standing along the roadside because the sea had also receded,” he explained. “The water remained low for quite some time, so everyone panicked and ran – I went around to the community health centre, and the people there had already been evacuated.” A tsunami warning was issued but lifted around three hours after the initial jolt when no significant sea level rise was detected. A stream of people could be seen moving inland on motorbikes after authorities issued a tsunami warning. BNPB said 2,000 people had evacuated or relocated on their own. It said three fatalities had been recorded in Sikka province, six in Manggarai province, and five in East Manggarai province. At least two others had been seriously injured and 11 slightly injured, the disaster agency added. Welianto said many residents of Talibura were choosing to remain outdoors as the aftershocks meant they were afraid to return to their homes. Yulian Juita Ekalia, a university lecturer from Ruteng, a city to the west of the epicentre, said she had dragged her stove outside and was cooking there for fear of further tremors. “I have never felt an earthquake this big,” she told news agency AFP. “It felt like we were on a trampoline – it was really scary.” It will take time to assess the full extent of the destruction in the region, which is remote and mountainous. Preliminary reports indicated 54 houses had been severely damaged, as well as five healthcare facilities, three places of worship, six government buildings, an educational institution and a warehouse. Manggarai province is among the most affected areas, BNPB said. It advised people to remain calm, and to stay away from coastal areas and structures showing signs of damage. Indonesia is prone to earthquakes and volcanic activity, lying along the meeting point of three major tectonic plates. items.title: Bridging Tradition and Democracy
items.description: Gurmad Qaran Position Paper on Hybrid Electoral Model Somalia stands at a critical stage in its democratic political transition. The constitutional deadline of 15 May 2026 for holding elections has elapsed without political agreement, leaving the country in a constitutional and political limbo. As competing electoral visions continue to prolong divisions, the need for nationally accepted pathway has become increasingly urgent. This Gurmad Qaran position paper first assesses Somalia’s previous electoral models and building on their incremental foundations, proposes Bridging Tradition and Democracy, hybrid electoral framework that thoughtfully integrates Somalia’s traditional clan-based structures with democratic and civic principles as a step closer to universal suffrage. Gurmad Qaran is proposing two options: (1) Clan-level seat allocation based on a rotational principle, followed by competitive candidate selection within the designated clan segment (Jifo), with the candidates securing the majority of votes then presented to district voters for direct election and (2) This option preserves all official House of the People (HoP) seat designations while establishing direct citizen representation. Eligible candidates contest specific seats, and citizens directly elect their preferred representative, with the candidate receiving the most valid votes declared the winner. The Gurmad Qaran proposal is founded on the recognition that the institutional, legal, security, and administrative facilities necessary for the immediate implementation of nationwide One Person, One Vote (1P1V) are far from being fully established. By measuring Somalia’s current socio-political realities against the ideal aspiration of universal suffrage, the proposal offers a practical and consensus-based transitional framework that addresses existing gaps while preserving political inclusivity and stability. Most importantly, it lays the legal, institutional, and operational foundations for the credible implementation of a genuine One Person, One Vote election by 2030/31. Foundational Principles of Electoral Reform: ● A fully independent Electoral Commission must be in place, distinct from all previous bodies by the nature of its formation and synchronized duties that ensures complete independence from both federal and regional political influence or control. ● The Commission shall hold full authority over the administration, management, supervision, and monitoring of the entire electoral process. ● The electoral commission must be established through a transparent, inclusive, and consensus based process, ensuring equitable representation and shared ownership among the Federal Government, Federal Member States, and opposition stakeholders ● Any parliamentary or presidential candidate found to have engaged in corruption, bribery, vote manipulation, or other unlawful conduct shall be immediately disqualified. ● The Electoral Complaints Commission must adjudicate electoral complaints transparently and binding decisions regarding contested results. ● The detailed guidelines for the electoral model will be commissioned once agreement is reached on the core principles and the preferred electoral option, and will be issued as an annex to the agreed model. items.title: Improving Quality: A Healthcare Revolution in Somaliland
items.description: King’s College London   ; Improving Quality: A Healthcare Revolution in Somaliland Abbie Jackson and Catherine Setchell Philanthropy Manager and Communications Manager, King’s Global Health Partnerships 15 May 2026 Over the last 20 years, healthcare improvement work has focussed on improving access to health services globally. Whilst this has led to improvements in health outcomes, poor quality healthcare still causes millions of unnecessary deaths each year. In low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), five million people die each year due to poor quality care, compared to 3.6 million deaths caused by lack of access . 1 King’s health partnership with Somaliland Improving the quality of healthcare is a priority for the Government of Somaliland. For more than 25 years, King’s Global Health Partnerships (KGHP) has worked side by side with partners in Somaliland—transforming medical education, improving hospital safety, and supporting the development of national health policies that put patients first. Over the past 2 years, KGHP has worked with the Ministry of Health Development (MOHD) to lay the foundations needed to transform the quality of the healthcare system, serving a population of 4.2 million people. Watch a short film on the achievements of the 2-year, National Quality Improvement Programme Delivery of a national quality of healthcare policy and strategy In collaboration with Qatar Charity, MoHD, World Health Organisation (WHO) and Global Health Partnerships (formerly THET), King’s helped the Somaliland government to develop a national quality of care policy and strategy – a five-year roadmap to improve the quality of care across the health system. Crucially, the policy was informed by the voices of 2,500 people across Somaliland, who were surveyed about their experiences of healthcare and their confidence in the system. This marked the first time public opinion has directly shaped national health policy in Somaliland – a milestone with the potential to transform how services are designed and delivered. Improving quality of care in six regional hospitals The programme also worked with the country’s six regional hospitals to ensure they met international standards for infection prevention and control (IPC). Hospital leaders and staff were trained in IPC protocols and practices, and Patient Safety and IPC Committees have been established in all six hospitals to lead and oversee improvement to quality and IPC action plans. National infection prevention and control guidelines were developed, creating a roadmap for safe care across the entire health system. With philanthropic support, we procured essential equipment and supplies, from sterilising machines to waste management systems, so hospitals can meet the new safety standards. Patient Safety and IPC Committees have been established in all six hospitals to lead and oversee improvement to quality and IPC action plans. These changes mean hospitals are safer for patients, staff, and families alike—and the systems put in place will enable long-term progress. Strengthening undergraduate and postgraduate medical education Finally, the programme assisted medical schools across the country to transition to a new undergraduate curriculum for medicine. For the first time, all doctors entering the health system should now study a standard set of subjects that is tailored to the country’s needs and meets international standards. In parallel, MoHD and Global Health Partnerships (formerly THET) drafted a health workforce plan which lays out the number and type of specialist doctors needed to provide quality care in Somaliland. And we developed a draft model for how postgraduate medical education should be governed – laying the foundation for a new generation of specialists who will shape the future of healthcare in Somaliland.

items.title: Qoyska gabadha isku dishay Cisbitaalka Hargeisa Oo beeniyay Wararka cadawgu faafinayaan
DF Soomaaliya oo war ka soo saartay dhacdadii argagaxa laheyd ee Hargeysa
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si adag uga hadashay dhacdo murugo badan dhalisay oo ka dhacday Isbitaalka Guud ee magaalada Hargeysa, halkaas oo hooyo danyar ah oo lagu magacaabi jiray Nimco Jaamac Yuusuf la sheegay inay isku dishay, iyadoo muddo toddobaad ah umul ahayd. Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka Soomaaliya ayaa war-saxaafadeed ay Sabtidii soo saartay ku sheegtay inay aad uga tiiraanyeysan tahay geerida Nimco, iyadoo dhacdada ku tilmaantay mid murugo iyo tiiraanyo weyn ku abuurtay bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in xogaha laga helayo dadka deegaanka ay muujinayaan in marxuumadda ay la daalaa-dhacaysay duruufo dhaqaale iyo helitaanka adeeg caafimaad iyo daryeel ku filan, inkastoo faahfaahinta ku saabsan waxa si dhab ah u sababay dhacdada ay weli kala duwan yihiin. “Waxaa arrin aad looga murugoodo islamarkaana laga tiiraanyoodo ah duruufta hooyadaas Soomaaliyeed ku kalliftay inay nafteeda goyso, weliba iyadoo umul ah muddo toddobaad ah,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka wasaaradda. Wasiirka Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka Soomaaliya, Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, ayaa bulshada Soomaaliyeed ugu baaqday inay si gaar ah isha ugu hayaan dadka nugul, gaar ahaan hooyooyinka wajahaya duruufaha dhaqaale, caafimaad iyo kuwa bulsho. “Waxaan si aad ah ugu boorineynaa guud ahaan Soomaalida meel walba oo ay joogaan inaysan ogolaan sii socoshada xaaladaha noocaan ah ee aan ku weyneyno hooyo, taasi oo ah wax aad iyo aad uga fog bini’aadanimada,” ayay tiri wasiir Khadiija. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in dhacdadu ay mar kale muujisay baahida loo qabo in dadka danyarta ah, gaar ahaan hooyooyinka iyo carruurta, loo fududeeyo helitaanka adeegyada aasaasiga ah ee caafimaadka iyo daryeelka. Dhacdada ayaa saacadihii la soo dhaafay si weyn looga hadal hayay baraha bulshada, iyadoo warar maxalli ah ay sheegeen in Nimco ay dhowaan ku umushay Isbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa, isla markaana ilmaha ay dhashay uu ahaa kii ugu horreeyay. Hase yeeshee, waxaa soo baxaya warar is-khilaafsan oo ku saabsan sababta keentay inay Nimco nafteeda disho. Agaasime ku-xigeenka Isbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa, Dr. Cabdiraxmaan Cayngal, ayaa meesha ka saaray sheegashada ah in dhaqaale la’aan ay ahayd sababta tooska ah ee dhacdada. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa dhankeeda ku saleysay hadalkeeda xog ay sheegtay inay ka heshay dadka deegaanka, waxayna dhacdada ku xiriirisay duruufo dhaqaale iyo daryeel caafimaad oo yaraaday. Dhacdadan ayaa timid xilli maamulka caafimaadka Somaliland uu bilihii dambe waday dadaallo lagu ballaarinayo adeegyada Isbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa. Bishii June, Wasaaradda Horumarinta Caafimaadka Somaliland ayaa isbitaalka ka furtay farmashiye shaqeeya 24-ka saac, iyadoo sheegtay in tallaabadaasi qeyb ka tahay qorshe lagu xoojinayo adeegyada bukaannada. items.title: Maxay tahay cabsida amni ee soo wajahday Aadan Madoobe?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) oo maanta booqasho shaqo ku tagay xarunta Hay’adda Maareynta Masiibooyinka Qaranka (SoDMA) ayaa ka hadlay xaaladaha bani’aadanimo iyo kuwa amni ee maamulkaasi. Sheekh Aadan Madoobe oo soo hadal qaaday colaadda ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan ciidamada taabacsan Lafta-gareen ee ku sugan bannaanka magaalada Baydhabo iyo Al-Shabaab oo dhinac kale ah ayaa sheegay inay halis ku hayaan shacabka, ayna sababeen barakaca qoysas badan. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in ka maamul ahaan ay arrintaas cabsi badan ku hayso, maadaama qoysaska soo barakacay ay dareemayaan xaalado adag oo dhanka nolosha ah, isla markaana culeyska ugu badan uu ka jiro Koonfur Galbeed. “Daruufo badan ayaa ka jira Koofur Galbeed dhinaca amniga nimankii ma naxayaasha iyo dhalinyaradii la khalday ee duurka ku jira ay dadkii soo cadaadiyeen iyo magaalooyinkii marka la yimid ayay daruufo ka jiraan haddii El Niño la sheegaayo ay kusii darsamaan cabsi badan ayaan qabnaa in dhibaato iska imaan karto,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed. Sidoo kale wuxuu sii raaciyay “Koonfur Galbeed waa state-ka ugu dadka badan ugu barakacayaasha badan xitaa Muqdisho barakacayaasha jooga inta ugu badan waxay ka yimaadeen deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed”. Aadan Madoobe ayaa intii uu booqashada ku guda jiray Hoggaamiyaha kulan la qaatay maamulka iyo howlwadeennada hay’adda SoDMA, isaga oo ka dhageystay warbixin ku saabsan howlaha ay hay’addu u xilsaaran tahay, gaar ahaan ka hortagga iyo maaraynta, gurmadka degdegga ah iyo taageerada loo fidiyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed xilliyada ay dhacaan musiibooyinka. Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaa bogaadiyey dadaallada Hay’adda SoDMA iyo shaqada muhiimka ah ee ay u hayso shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isagoo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha dowladda iyo hay’adaha ka shaqeeya gurmadka iyo maaraynta musiibooyinka. Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo diyaar-garowga iyo awoodda wax looga qabanayo xaaladaha bani’aadannimo iyo musiibooyinka dabiiciga ah, si gurmad degdeg ah oo hufan loo gaarsiiyo dadka Soomaaliyeed ee ay xaaladahaasi saameeyaan. The post Maxay tahay cabsida amni ee soo wajahday Aadan Madoobe? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Galkayo Youth Choose Brotherhood Over Politics in Powerful Message
items.description: Galkayo (WDN) — In a powerful display of maturity and civic responsibility, young people from the Galmudug side of Galkayo have sent a heartfelt message to their counterparts in Puntland, urging them to reject political division and protect the peace and brotherhood that bind the city together. The message, issued amid heightened political tensions in Somalia, calls on the youth of both sides to refuse attempts by politicians to turn them against one another for political purposes. Addressing young people in Puntland-controlled Galkayo, the Galmudug youth emphasized that the two communities are not enemies but neighbors, friends and brothers who share the same culture, history and way of life. “ Galkayo is one city. The people living on both sides are brothers, sharing the same culture, blood and life.” The young people acknowledged that Galkayo has experienced conflict in the past but stressed that residents on both sides have also experienced the benefits of peace and coexistence. They urged young Somalis not to allow political disagreements among leaders to become conflicts among ordinary citizens. “If political differences exist between leaders, let the politicians disagree. But do not allow those disagreements to come between us, the youth and the people. Do not let young people be turned against one another.” A Message of Hope and Responsibility The message has been welcomed as a striking example of young people taking an honorable role in protecting their communities rather than becoming instruments of political confrontation. The Galmudug youth made clear that they want their relationship with Puntland counterparts to be defined by mutual respect, cooperation and shared development—not by political rivalry. “ Expect no trouble from our side—only development. We expect the same from you.” They also called on residents to use upcoming political events and public gatherings as opportunities to strengthen peace, friendship and social cohesion rather than deepen divisions. Their message was simple but powerful: Galkayo’s youth are turning years of division into a new chapter defined by peace, shared prosperity, and collective development. “Galkayo is our common home. Galmudug and Puntland are neighbors. The people on both sides are brothers.” For a city that has historically experienced the consequences of political and clan tensions, the appeal carries significance far beyond social media. It is a reminder that the future of Galkayo belongs not to political factions, but to the people who live there—and that its young generation can choose cooperation over confrontation. As the backbone of Somalia’s future, the youth of both sides of Galkayo are sending a message: unity, peace, and development are the foundation of a better future. Their shared aspirations transcend political and regional divisions, demonstrating that young Somalis can be a force for reconciliation, cooperation, and progress. At a time when political disputes elsewhere in Somalia threaten to spill into communities, the message from Galkayo’s youth offers a welcome alternative: Galkacyo is one united city. items.title: R/W Xamza oo magacaabis sameeyay kadib is casilaaddii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta soo magacaabay Wasiir Ku xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliya, kaasi oo loo magacaabay Mudane Cismaan Maxamed Cabdi ( Daallo). Xamza oo wareegto soo saaray ayaa kula dardaarma wasiir Ku-xigeenka cusub in uu si hufan u guto waajibaadka shaqo ee horyaalla, isaga oo Alle uga baryay in uu ku asturo mas’uuliyadda uu u qaadday ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Cismaan Daallo ayaa horay uga tirsanaa mucaaradka, balse wuxuu hadda usoo wareegay dhanka dowladda, kadibna sidaas loogu magacaabay xilka. Sidoo kale, Cismaano Daallo ayaa beddalaya Xildhibaan Maxamuud Cabdullaahi Axmed (Abuukaate) oo maalmo ka hor iska casilay xilka Wasiir Ku xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha kadib markii la sheegay inay is qabteen Wasiirka Wasaaraddaasi, Mudane Jamaal Maxamed Xasan. Abuukaate ayaa warqad uu soo saaray 13-kii bishan August 2026 ku caddeeyay inuu iska casilay xilkii Wasiir ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, iyada oo hadda beddelkiisa loo soo magacaabay Cismaan Daallo oo horay xilal kala duwan uga soo qabtay dowladihii soo maray dalka. “Waxaan si rasmi ah isaga casilay xilka Wasiir ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha ee XFS. Waxaan u mahadcelinayaa madaxda dalka fursadda ay ii siiyeen inaan ugu adeego bulshada Soomaaliyeed,” ayaa ku yiri warqadda uu soo saaray Abuukaate. Xildhibaan Maxamuud Cabdullaahi Axmed (Abuukaate) oo hadda kamid ah Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa kamid ahaa raggii aadka ugu ololeeyay Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo Isniintii loo doortay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya. items.title: Madaxweynaha DF oo xarigga ka jaray mashaariic laga hirgeliyay Dhuusamareeb (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo uu wehliyo Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoorqoor) ayaa galabta xarigga ka jaray mashaariic horumarineed oo laga hirgeliyay Magaalada Dhuusamareeb. Villa Somalia ayaa sheegtay in Madaxweynuhu uu si rasmi ah xarigga uga jaray wejiga koowaad ee mashruuca dhismaha laamiga Dhuusamareeb iyo Taalada Cagaaran ee magaalada. “Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa ku bogaadiyay hoggaanka Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug sida hufan ee ay u maareeyeen hirgelinta mashruuca, isla markaana u xaqiijiyeen in mashruucu u qabsoomo sidii loo qorsheeyay, iyadoo si gaar ah loo ilaalinayo tayada iyo heerarka farsamo ee dhismaha.” Ayaa lagu yiri war lagu daabacay bogga wararka ee Madaxtooyada Qaranka. “Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa xusay in mashaariicdan ay astaan u yihiin horumarka kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo bilicda Magaalada Dhuusamareeb, isla-markaana ay wax weyn ka tari doonaan isku socodka bulshada iyo koboca dhaqaale ee deegaanka, isaga oo uga mahadceliyay Bangiga Adduunka iyo Wasaaradda Howlaha Guud ee Xukuumadda Somaliya ee ka qayb qaatay qorsheynta, maalgelinta iyo hirgelinta mashaariicdan.” Ayaa lagu sheegay warka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa warka lagu sheegay inuu Madaxweyne Qoorqoor ku amaanay dhaxalka dowladeed ee waaraya iyo taariikhda muhiimka ah ee uga tagayo deegaanka, isla-markaana uu dadka reer Galmudug ugu baaqay inay ilaashadaan mashaariicda iyo horumarka la xaqiijiyay, ayna sii ambaqaadaan dadaalada lagu horumarinayo deegaanka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayay Jimcihii Dhuusamareeb uga bilaabatay booqasho la sheegay inuu ku marayo deegaanada Galmudug.

Villa Somalia ayaa sheegtay in Madaxweynuhu uu si rasmi ah xarigga uga jaray wejiga koowaad ee mashruuca dhismaha laamiga Dhuusamareeb iyo Taalada Cagaaran ee magaalada. “Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa ku bogaadiyay hoggaanka Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug sida hufan ee ay u maareeyeen hirgelinta mashruuca, isla markaana u xaqiijiyeen in mashruucu u qabsoomo sidii loo qorsheeyay, iyadoo si gaar ah loo ilaalinayo tayada iyo heerarka farsamo ee dhismaha.” Ayaa lagu yiri war lagu daabacay bogga wararka ee Madaxtooyada Qaranka. “Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa xusay in mashaariicdan ay astaan u yihiin horumarka kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo bilicda Magaalada Dhuusamareeb, isla-markaana ay wax weyn ka tari doonaan isku socodka bulshada iyo koboca dhaqaale ee deegaanka, isaga oo uga mahadceliyay Bangiga Adduunka iyo Wasaaradda Howlaha Guud ee Xukuumadda Somaliya ee ka qayb qaatay qorsheynta, maalgelinta iyo hirgelinta mashaariicdan.” Ayaa lagu sheegay warka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa warka lagu sheegay inuu Madaxweyne Qoorqoor ku amaanay dhaxalka dowladeed ee waaraya iyo taariikhda muhiimka ah ee uga tagayo deegaanka, isla-markaana uu dadka reer Galmudug ugu baaqay inay ilaashadaan mashaariicda iyo horumarka la xaqiijiyay, ayna sii ambaqaadaan dadaalada lagu horumarinayo deegaanka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayay Jimcihii Dhuusamareeb uga bilaabatay booqasho la sheegay inuu ku marayo deegaanada Galmudug.

items.title: Puntland Forces Block Key Highway Over Unpaid Wages
items.description: Puntland (Raxanreeb Online) — Scores of vehicles have been stranded along the main road linking Bosaso and Qardho after Puntland security forces blocked the route in protest over several months of unpaid salaries and other financial entitlements. The protesting personnel are reportedly demanding payment of salaries and benefits that they say have remained outstanding for months. The roadblock has caused significant disruption to the movement of passengers, commercial vehicles and goods between the two major cities. The Puntland administration has faced growing criticism over allegations that it has failed to pay salaries and other entitlements owed to members of the security forces and civil servants for up to eight months. The latest protest comes as the Puntland government has, in recent days, reportedly taken back control of hundreds of soldiers who had previously been receiving salaries from the Federal Government of Somalia. Some of these forces had earlier withdrawn from, or distanced themselves from, the administration of Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni, citing prolonged delays in the payment of their salaries and other entitlements. The blockade of the Bosaso–Qardho road has affected travellers and businesses that rely on the route, raising concerns over the wider economic and security implications should the disruption continue. It remains unclear how long the forces will maintain the roadblock or whether the Puntland authorities have opened negotiations with the protesting personnel to resolve the dispute and restore normal traffic along the route. items.title: NISA oo weerartay guri ay ku sugnaayeen Mustaf Caato iyo xubno sare + Khasaaraha
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) ayaa sheegtay in howlgal qorsheysan oo ka dhacay degmada Maxaas ee gobolka Hiiraan lagu dilay saddex horjooge oo ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, halka dhaawac culus lagu gaarsiiyay Mustaf Caato oo kamid ah saraakiisha sare ee kooxda ee gobolkaas. War-saxaafadeed ay NISA soo saartay maanta oo Sabti ah ayay ku sheegtay in howlgalka uu dhacay 12-kii Agoosto, laguna beegsaday guri ku yaalla Maxaas oo ay xilligaas ku sugnaayeen xubno sare oo Al-Shabaab ah. NISA waxay sheegtay in Mustaf Caato uu dhaawac halis ah kasoo gaaray weerarka, isla markaana markii dambe laga qaaday Maxaas, loona gudbiyay degmada Ceelbuur ee gobolka Galgaduud si loogu daweeyo. Sida ay hay’addu sheegtay, Mustaf Caato wuxuu ahaa madaxa guud ee waxa Al-Shabaab ay ugu yeerto “Jabhadaha” gobolka Hiiraan, isaga oo door muhiim ah ku lahaa abaabulka iyo isku-dubbaridka dagaallada kooxda. NISA ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Caato uu horay usoo maamulay qeybta Al-Shabaab u qaabilsan qaraxyada iyo weerarrada is-miidaaminta, islamarkaana muddo kamid ahaa xubnaha ay hay’adaha ammaanku sida gaarka ah u bartilmaameedsanayeen. Saddexda horjooge ee NISA ay sheegtay in lagu dilay howlgalka ayaa kala ah Cabdi Xaafid, oo ka tirsanaa qeybta qaraxyada; Daalibaan, oo ka tirsanaa qeybta gurmadka Al-Shabaab ee gobolka Hiiraan; iyo Cumar Xuseen, oo horjooge u ahaa qeyb ka mid ah dagaalyahannada kooxda. Waxaa sidoo kale weerarka dhaawacyo culus kasoo gaaray Maxamed Eeney iyo Salaad Buur, oo NISA ay labadaba ku tilmaantay horjoogeyaal ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. NISA ma aysan shaacin nooca howlgalka lagu qaaday guriga, balse waxay sheegtay inay kaashatay saaxiibada caalamka. Bayaankan ayaa kusoo aadaya maalin kadib markii NISA ay shaacisay howlgal kale oo ka dhacay deegaanka Warciise ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, oo qiyaastii 25 KM u jira magaalada Jowhar. Howlgalkaas ayay hay’addu sheegtay in lagu dilay sagaal xubnood oo Al-Shabaab ah, oo ay ku jireen laba horjooge oo lagu kala magacaabi jiray Axmed Cali Jimcaale iyo Geedi Maxamed Nuur Cadde. Axmed Cali Jimcaale ayay NISA ku sheegtay inuu ahaa horjoogihii Al-Shabaab ugu magacawnaa degmada Jowhar, halka Geedi Maxamed Nuur Cadde uu ahaa horjoogihii kooxda ee deegaannada Dumaaye iyo Dabagaalo. Labada bayaan ee isku xiga ayaa muujinaya kororka howlgallada ay NISA, oo kaashaneysa saaxiibada caalamka, ku beegsaneyso hoggaanka iyo xubnaha Al-Shabaab ee gobollada Hiiraan iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe. Ma jiro war madax-bannaan oo xaqiijinaya khasaaraha ay NISA sheegtay labada howlgal, Al-Shabaab-na weli kama aysan hadlin sheegashooyinka hay’adda. items.title: Xiiaad ka taagan duleedka deegaanka Teedaan ee Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Wararka laga helayo Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa sheegaya in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley ay bariga gobolkaasi ka wadaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo lagaga soo horjeedo joogitaanka maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ee deegaanka istiraatiijiga ah ee Teedaan. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada oo maalmahaanba abaabul iyo diyaargarow ka waday deegaanka Bukure ay u ruqaansadeen dhinaca Teedaan, isla-markaana ay xiisad u dhexeyso iyaga iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ay ka jirto duleedka Teedaan. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in Ciidamada Militariga iyo Macawiisleyda ay ku siqeen dhufeysada ay Shabaabku ku leeyihiin duleedka Teedaan, ayna tani sii xoojisay xiisaddii maalmahaanba ka taagneyd deegaanada ku yaala jidka isku xira Magaalooyinka Matabaan iyo Maxaas. Cutubyo kale oo ka tirsan Ciidamada Militariga ayaa la sheegay inay heegan ku yihiin deegaanada Bukure, Hees iyo Coomaad oo ka mid ah deegaanada u dhexeeya Matabaan iyo Maxaas. Ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegaya in Al Shabaab ay dhankeeda dhaqdhaqaaq ka waddo Teedaan iyo deegaanada kale ee u dhexeeye Teedaan iyo Maxaas sida Suullaay, Xasan Raqay iyo Sulmo. Shabaabka ayaa la sheegay inay sidoo kale dhaqdhaqaaq ka wadaan deegaanka dhinaca kale ee Maxaas ku yaala ee Goobo, iyadoo Goobo ay ku taalo waddada aadda Magaalada Guriceel ee Gobolka Galgaduud. Goobo oo 15km jihada waqooyi uga beegan Maxaas ayaa ah meesha Shabaabka ku sugan deegaanka Teedaan uu u soo mari karo gurmadka uga imanaya deegaanada hoostaga Magaalada Ceelbuur. Warbaahinta ayaa fahamsan in dhulka uu ka jiro gariirka dagaal ay kol horeba ka barakaceen dadkii deganaa, sababo ku aaddan cabsi ay ka muujiyeen in lagu dul dagaalamo. Toddobaadkii labaad ayaa waxaa hakad ku jira isu socodkii dadka iyo ganacsiga ee deegaanada hoostaga Maxaas iyo deegaanada kale ee ku yaala jidka isku xira Maxaas iyo Matabaan. Isu socodka ganacsiga iyo gaadiidka ayaa waxa uu hakad ku yimid, ka dib markii ciidamadu ay 2-dii bishan ka baxeen Teedaan, isla-markaana ay Al Shabaab la wareegtay gacan ku haynta deegaankaasi. Tallaabada ay Al Shabaab 2-dii bishan ku wareegtay Teedaan ayaa xaaladda ka dhigtay inay cabsidu noqoto mid taagan.

items.title: New Speaker Jama Signals Active Start as He Receives Political Welcome in Balcad
items.description: Balcad (WDN) — Somalia’s newly elected Speaker of the House of the People, Abdulqadir Mohamed Nur Jama, has begun his tenure with a visible public engagement agenda, receiving a high-profile welcome in Balcad, Middle Shabelle, as political and traditional leaders rallied behind his new leadership. The reception, organized by members of Hisrashabeelle community (Mudulood), brought together by President Ali Gudlawe Hussein, federal ministers, lawmakers from both chambers of Parliament, traditional elders and other senior officials. Speakers at the event congratulated Jama on his election as Speaker and expressed hope that he would successfully navigate the significant constitutional and political responsibilities associated with one of Somalia’s most important state offices. President Ali Gudlawe also congratulated Jama, urging him to carry out his constitutional responsibilities with integrity, efficiency and a strong sense of national responsibility. A Speaker Signaling an Active Mandate In his remarks, Speaker Jama said the reception and messages of support represented both encouragement and an additional responsibility as he begins his tenure. He pledged to focus on strengthening the House of the People and ensuring that Parliament effectively fulfills its constitutional mandate. Jama also emphasized the importance of national unity, political cohesion and advancing the broader interests of the Somali people. His early public engagements suggest that the new Speaker intends to establish a visible and active leadership style rather than remain confined to the parliamentary chamber. His election comes at a particularly sensitive moment for Somalia, with the country facing major political disagreements over elections, constitutional arrangements, federal relations and the future direction of the country’s political system. Against that backdrop, the Speaker’s ability to maintain Parliament’s institutional independence while facilitating political dialogue could become one of the defining challenges of his tenure. For now, Jama’s message is one of responsibility and institutional renewal: Parliament, he says, must fulfill its constitutional role and serve the broader national interest. Whether he can translate that commitment into meaningful parliamentary leadership will become clearer as the new Speaker settles into office and confronts the difficult political questions facing Somalia. items.title: Puntland Absorbs Forces Linked to Political Figure
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — Puntland authorities have formally taken control of a group of security personnel previously aligned with Puntland politician Mohamud Mashruuc, in what officials and political observers describe as another step toward consolidating the region’s security institutions under a unified state command. A representative speaking on behalf of the forces confirmed that an agreement had been reached with the Puntland administration, paving the way for the personnel to be formally integrated into Puntland’s security structures. The forces had previously been associated with Mashruuc, a Puntland political figure who, according to local reports, had been receiving a assistance the Federal Government of Somalia despite being from Puntland. The development follows an earlier incident in which Puntland authorities prevented Mashruuc from entering Garowe after he traveled from Carmo toward the regional capital. His movement, and the presence of personnel associated with him, had become part of a wider dispute over the role of politically affiliated security forces operating within Puntland. The agreement was formally presented during a ceremony held in Kur-ilaalo, in Puntland’s Karkaar region, where representatives of the administration and the forces announced the conclusion of the arrangement. The latest development appears to form part of President Said Abdullahi Deni’s broader effort to eliminate political interference and competing chains of command within Puntland’s security sector. For years, the existence of armed formations linked directly or indirectly to individual politicians has presented a challenge to Puntland’s efforts to establish a professional and unified security architecture. The administration has increasingly insisted that security personnel must operate under legitimate state institutions rather than under the authority of individual politicians, political factions or external actors. The integration of Mashruuc-aligned personnel therefore represents more than a personnel transfer. It signals an attempt to transform politically affiliated forces into formal state security institutions subject to a single chain of command. From Political Forces to State Institutions Puntland officials argue that a functioning security sector cannot operate effectively when competing political actors maintain their own armed formations. The administration has consequently sought to bring armed personnel operating outside the formal security structure under government control, while encouraging them to surrender their previous political affiliations and serve the state. Supporters of Deni’s approach say the policy could strengthen discipline, improve command and control, and reduce the risk of political disputes developing into armed confrontations. Critics, however, may question whether the process can be implemented consistently across all political factions and whether sufficient guarantees exist for personnel being absorbed into the state security apparatus. Nevertheless, the agreement with forces associated with Mashruuc adds to a series of recent moves aimed at consolidating Puntland’s security institutions. A Broader Political Message The development also carries a wider political message. By bringing politically affiliated personnel under formal state command, Puntland’s administration is signaling that access to armed forces cannot remain a tool of political competition. For President Deni, the challenge is not simply to control individual armed groups but to establish a security system in which the state—not individual politicians—is the ultimate authority over armed personnel. If sustained, the policy could mark an important shift in Puntland’s political culture, particularly in reducing the role of private or factional security structures and strengthening the principle of institutional control over the security sector. The Kur-ilaalo agreement is therefore likely to be viewed not merely as a local settlement, but as part of Puntland’s broader effort to establish a unified security command and separate political competition from the use of armed forces. Whether the strategy succeeds in creating a genuinely professional and politically neutral security sector will depend on its consistent application across Puntland and the administration’s ability to maintain dialogue with political actors while firmly asserting state authority. Critics, however, may question whether the process can be implemented consistently across all political factions and whether sufficient guarantees exist for personnel being absorbed into the state security apparatus. Nevertheless, the agreement with forces associated with Mashruuc adds to a series of recent moves aimed at consolidating Puntland’s security institutions. A Broader Political Message The development also carries a wider political message. By bringing politically affiliated personnel under formal state command, Puntland’s administration is signaling that access to armed forces cannot remain a tool of political competition. For President Deni, the challenge is not simply to control individual armed groups but to establish a security system in which the state—not individual politicians—is the ultimate authority over armed personnel. If sustained, the policy could mark an important shift in Puntland’s political culture, particularly in reducing the role of private or factional security structures and strengthening the principle of institutional control over the security sector. The Kur-ilaalo agreement is therefore likely to be viewed not merely as a local settlement, but as part of Puntland’s broader effort to establish a unified security command and separate political competition from the use of armed forces. Whether the strategy succeeds in creating a genuinely professional and politically neutral security sector will depend on its consistent application across Puntland and the administration’s ability to maintain dialogue with political actors while firmly asserting state authority. items.title: Uganda oo sheegtay in ciidamadeedu sii joogi doonaan Soomaaliya
items.description: Dowladda Uganda ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadeedu ay sii joogi doonaan Soomaaliya, xitaa haddii uu isbeddel ku yimaado mustaqbalka howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Wasiirka Difaaca Uganda, Kiryowa Kiwanuka, ayaa sheegay in Uganda ay Soomaaliya sii joogi doonto, iyadoo ciidamada qaar lagu sii hayn doono Soomaaliya heshiis laba geesood ah oo ay labada dal kala saxiixdeen. Uganda waxay Soomaaliya ku leedahay ku dhawaad 4,500 askari oo ka tirsan AUSSOM, halka ciidamo kale oo gaaraya ku dhowaad 2,000 ay ku joogaan heshiis toos ah oo u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Uganda. Mustaqbalka AUSSOM ayaa mugdi galay kaddib markii Mareykanku uu ku dhawaaqay inuu dhammaadka sanadkan joojin doono lacagihii uu siin jiray Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, UNSOS, kaas oo muhiim u ah saadka iyo taageerada howlgalka. Wasiir Kiwanuka ayaa sheegay in qaabka ciidamada Uganda Soomaaliya uga sii shaqeyn doonaan uu isbeddeli doono, balse uu caddeeyay in Uganda aysan ka bixi doonin Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, saraakiil ka tirsan militariga ayaa sheegay in dalal ay ka mid yihiin Kenya, Itoobiya iyo Masar ay sidoo kale doonayaan inay ciidamadooda Soomaaliya sii joogteeyaan sannadka 2027. Wasiirrada Difaaca dalalka ciidamada ku leh AUSSOM iyo dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa ku adkeystay in haddii howlgalka Midowga Afrika uu dhammaanayo, bixitaankiisu noqdo mid tartiib ah, nidaamsan oo isku-duwan, si masuuliyadda amniga loogu wareejiyo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Professor Nigerian ah oo haysta 5 PhD, 5 Master’s iyo shahaadooyin kale oo badan
items.description: Abdullahi Abubakar, oo ah aqoonyahan reer Nigeria ah, ayaa soo jiitay indhaha dad badan kadib markii lagu sheegay inuu leeyahay shahaadooyin waxbarasho oo aad u tiro badan. Prof. Abubakar waxaa lagu sheegay inuu haysto 5 shahaado oo PhD ah, 5 Master’s, 7 degree, 11 Diploma iyo 2 NCE. Aqoontiisa waxay ku baahsan tahay dhinacyo kala duwan oo ay ka mid yihiin dhismaha iyo naqshadeynta, injineernimada, qorsheynta magaalooyinka, Quantity Surveying, cilmi-baarista, caafimaadka iyo Computer Studies. Wuxuu muddo ka soo shaqeeyay Ahmadu Bello University ee magaalada Zaria, halkaas oo uu ka qabtay xilal waxbarasho iyo maamul oo kala duwan. Waxaa ka mid ah xilalkii uu soo qabtay Madaxa Waaxda Architecture, Agaasimaha Academic Planning, iyo Hormuudka Faculty of Environmental Design. Sidoo kale, Prof. Abubakar wuxuu xilal hoggaamineed ka soo qabtay Nigerian Institute of Architects, taas oo ah hay’ad muhiim u ah xirfadlayaasha dhismaha iyo naqshadeynta dalka Nigeria. Sheekadiisa ayaa muujinaysa sida uu qofku waxbarashada ugu sii wadi karo heerar kala duwan, xitaa marka uu horey u haysto shahaadooyin badan. Farriinta ugu weyn ee laga qaadan karo waa: waxbarashadu ma laha meel lagu yiraahdo “waa ku filan tahay”; barashadu waxay noqon kartaa safar nolosha oo dhan socda.

items.title: Dhibka ay Xuutiyiintu ku hayaan Maraakiibta maraysa bada cas oo Somaliland siinaysa
items.description: Warbixin caalami ah oo ay baahisay Fox News ayaa lagu sheegay in khatarta sii kordheysa ee Xuutiyiinta ay Iran taageerto ee ka dhanka ah maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Badda Cas ay Somaliland siinayso fursad cusub oo istaraatiiji ah. Warbixinta Fox News ayaa lagu sheegay in weerarrada Xuutiyiintu ay Maraykanka ku riixayaan inuu dib u qiimeeyo istaraatiijiyaddiisa Geeska Afrika, taas oo Somaliland ka dhigaysa lamaane amni oo muhiim ah. Jeneraal hore oo Maraykan ah ayaa Fox News u sheegay in cadaadiska Xuutiyiintu uu Washington ku qasbi karo inay qaadato istaraatiijiyad cusub oo ku aadan Afrika, taas oo si weyn kor ugu qaadaysa muhiimada istaraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland. Warbixinta oo Wargeyska Dawan soo xigtay ayaa lagu sheegay in Somaliland ay yeelanayso door muuqda oo firfircoon. Arrintan ayaa lagu sheegay in ay ka dhalatay muhiimadda juqraafiyeed ee Somaliland iyo halka ay kaga taallo Gacanka Cadmeed. Warbixinta ayaa si gaar ah u xustay muhiimadda Dekedda Berbera, oo ku taalla xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed, una dhow marinka muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandab. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta Dekedda Berbera iyo garoonka diyaaradaha ee ku dhow ayaa Somaliland siinaya awood ay ku noqoto meel muhiim u ah amniga iyo isu-socodka maraakiibta caalamiga ah. Sidoo kale warbixinta ayaa lagu xusay in Dekedda Berbera ay Washington siinayso fursad ay kaga hawlgasho ilaalinta maraakiibta, la socodka khataraha gobolka iyo xoojinta amniga marin-biyoodkan, haddii ay khatarta Xuutiyiintu sii korodho. Sida lagu xusay warbixinta arrintan ayaa Somaliland ka dhigaysa meel aan si fudud la isaga indho-tiri karin marka laga hadlayo mustaqbalka amniga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Waxa kale oo lagu sheegay warbixinta in Somaliland ay muddo dheer ahayd dal nabdoon oo leh hay’ado amni oo awood u leh inay ilaaliyaan dhulkeeda iyo xeebteeda. Iyada oo xaaladda cusub ee soo wajahday Badda Cas ay dooddaas siinayso miisaan dheeraad ah. Sidoo kale waxa lagu xusay warbixinta in Somaliland ay haysato fursad ay ku muujiso muhiimaddeeda istaraatiijiga ah, iyada oo xiligan Maraykanku raadinayo saaxiibo lagu kalsoonaan karo iyo goobo istaraatiiji ah oo dheeraad ah. Warbinta ayaa lagu soo gunaanaday in xidhiidhka u dhexeeya Somaliland iyo AFRICOM uu muujinayo in dhinaca amniga uu jiro is-dhexgal ballaadhan oo sii kordhaya. Iyada oo booqashooyinka saraakiisha Maraykanka iyo wada-hadallada amniga ee u dhexeeya Somaliland iyo Maraykanku ay kor u qaadayaan doorka Somaliland ee qorshayaasha mustaqbalka ee gobolka Geeska Afrika. “Sidaa darteed, hanjabaadda Xuutiyiinta waxay beddelaysaa xisaabta amni ee Badda Cas, taasina waxay si toos ah u kordhinaysaa muhiimadda juqraafiyeed ee Somaliland,” ayaa lagu soo gabagabeeyay Warbixinta Fox News.

items.title: Raysal Wasaare Barre oo si dhakhsa ah u buuxiyay booska Maxamuud Abukaate
items.description: Raysal Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka, Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa Cismaan Maxamed Cabdi u magacaabay in uu noqdo Wasiir Kuxigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha. “Raysal Wasaaraha ayaa Wasiir Kuxigeenka kula dardaarmay in uu si hufan u guto waajibaadka shaqo ee horyaalla, isaga oo Alle uga baryay in uu ku asturo masuuliyadda uu u qaadday ummadda Soomaaliyeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri war qoraal ah oo galabta ka soo baxay Xafiiska Raysal Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre. Jegadan ayaa waxaa Khamiistii iska casilay Maxamuud Cabdullaahi Axmed (Abukaate), kaas oo xilka loo magacaabay bishii March ee sanadkii 2025. Maxamuud Abukaate oo ah Xildhibaan ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka ayaa warqad uu ku saxiixnaa isaga casilay xilkaasi, isagoon sheegin wax sabab ah oo shaqada uu uga tagayo. Xafiiska Raysal Wasaaraha ayaan ka hadlin tallaabada uu isku casilay Maxamuud Abukaate, oo muddooyinkii u dambeeyay uu xiriir wanaagsan kala dhexeeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Maxamuud Abukaate oo deegaan doorashadiisu tahay Gobolka Hiiraan ee Hirshabelle ayaa bishii April ee sanadkii 2022 markii 2aad la guddoonsiiyay shahaadada Xildhibaanimo.

items.title: Wasiir ku xigeen cusub oo loo magacabaay Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha
items.description: Muqdisho — Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa Wasiir-ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha u magacaabay Mudane Cismaan Maxamed Cabdi oo ku magac dheer Cismaan Daallo. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa Wasiir-ku-xigeenka cusub kula dardaarmay inuu si hufan oo xilkasnimo leh u guto waajibaadka shaqo ee loo igmaday, isagoo Alle uga baryay inuu ku asturo mas’uuliyadda loo dhiibay iyo u adeegidda shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Magacaabistan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa kaddib markii Xildhibaan Maxamuud Cabdullaahi Axmed (Abuukaate) uu iska casilay xilkii Wasiir-ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha. Wararka la xiriira is-casilaadda ayaa sheegayay in ay ka dambeysay khilaaf muddo soo jiitamayay oo u dhexeeyay isaga iyo Wasiirka Wasaaradda. Sidaas darteed, magacaabista Cismaan Maxamed Cabdi ayaa noqonaysa tallaabo lagu buuxinayo xilka Wasiir-ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, xilli wasaaraddu ay door muhiim ah ku leedahay horumarinta ganacsiga, warshadaha iyo kobcinta wax-soo-saarka dalka.

items.title: DF oo ku adkeysatay safarka Xasan Sheekh ee Gaalkacyo kadib digniintii Puntland
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa jawaab adag ka bixisay hadalkii Puntland, kadib markii ay ka digtay safar ay sheegtay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu qorsheynayo inuu ku tago koonfurta magaalada Gaalkacyo ee dhinaca Maamulka Galmudug. Puntland ayaa Xasan Sheekh ku eedeysay inuu weli wado “abaabul colaad ka dhan ah deegaannadeeda”, waxayna ku doodday in safarkaasi uu leeyahay ujeeddo lagu doonayo in qalalaase looga abuuro magaalada Gaalkacyo, oo muddooyinkii dambe ka soo kabaneysay colaado iyo xiisado soo noqnoqday. “Dowladda Puntland waxay si dhow ula socotaa abaabulada qorshaysan ee uu Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud wado, waxayna ka digaysaa qorshaha safarka Xasan Sheekh uu ku imaanayo Koonfurta Gaalkacyo ee Dowladda Galmudug,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal ay soo saartay Madaxtooyada Puntland. Intaas kadib waxaa soo jawaabay Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo shaaca ka qaaday in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu tegayo koonfurta Gaalkacyo, isla markaana aysan jirin cid kale oo uu marti uga yahay, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Sidoo kale, digniinta Saciid Deni ayuu ku tilmaamay inay tahay mid qiyaali ah oo aan waxba soo kordhineyneynin. “War waxaas waba ma qaadi karo waa nin iska hadlay Gaalkacyo wuu tegayaa Madaxweynuhu wuxuu tegayaa maamulka Galmudug, sida uu u joogo Dhuusamareeb marka cid uu marti uga yahay ma jirto runtii waxaan is leeyahay warqaddaas waa warqad aan qiil lahayn,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Fiqi. Fiqi ayaa sidoo kale qoraal uu soo saaray Jimcihii ku eedeeyay Madaxweynaha Puntland, isaga oo sheegay inuu la saftay shisheeyihii ay is-hayeen Soomaaliya, oo uu ula jeedo Imaaraadka iyo Itoobiya, isla markaana uu taageeray kala go’a dalka, taas oo qiyaano qaran ah. “Deni wuxuu Soomaaliya kala saftay shisheeyihii la is qabtay, wuxuu taageeray kala go’a dalka, wuxuu gacan siiyay xasuuqa walaalaha Sudan ay cadowgu u geysanayaan,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi. Hadalkan ayaa imaanaya xilli khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo midka amni ee u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka uu toddobaadyadii ugu dambeeyay si weyn ugu soo ururay gobolka Mudug. 4-tii August waxaa koonfurta Gaalkacyo laga dejiyay hub ay Puntland sheegtay in Villa Somalia u waday ciidamo ku sugan dhinaceeda magaalada, hubkaas ayaa markii dambe gacanta u galay koox hubeysan, waxaana halkaas ka dhacay iska-horimaad. Maalintii xigtay, ciidamada Puntland ayaa dagaal la galay ciidamo ka tirsan PSF oo la sheegay inay taageero ka haysteen dowladda federaalka, kaddibna waxay la wareegeen xeradii ay ciidankaasi kaga sugnaayeen waqooyiga Gaalkacyo. Si kastaba ha’ahaateen, Dhacdooyinkan ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in muranka siyaasadeed ee Muqdisho iyo Garoowe uu isu beddelo loollan amni oo si toos ah uga dhex muuqda Gaalkacyo. The post DF oo ku adkeysatay safarka Xasan Sheekh ee Gaalkacyo kadib digniintii Puntland appeared first on Caasimada Online .
