items.title: Warbixin Soo Bandhigtay Maamul-wanaaga Dawladnimda Somaliland iyo Waayo-aragnimadda Nabad-dhiska
items.description: Warbixin caalami ah oo lagu daabacay warbaahinta E-International Relations ayaa lagu sheegay in Somaliland ay ka mid tahay meelaha ugu xasilloon uguna horumarsan dhinaca dimuqraadiyadda ee Geeska Afrika. Warbixintu waxay tilmaantay in waayo-aragnimada Somaliland ay tahay tusaale muujinaya sida isku-tashiga bulshada iyo dedaaladdas siyaasadeed ee maxaliga ah loogu dhisi karo nabad, dimuqraadiyad iyo hay’ado dowladeed shaqaynaya. Warbixintu waxay xustay in Somaliland ay ku guulaysatay inay muddo ka badan soddon sano si joogto ah u qabato doorashooyin tartan leh, isla markaana ay xaqiijiso kala-guur nabadeed oo dhinaca awoodda ah. Warbixinta oo uu qoray Martin Duffy, oo ka mid ahaa kormeerayaashii caalamiga ahaa ee doorashadii madaxtooyada Somaliland ee 13-kii Nofeembar 2024, ayaa lagu sheegay in Somaliland ay samaysatay nidaam siyaasadeed oo deggan oo ku salaysan amni iyo xasillooni, taas oo ka duwan xaaladaha siyaasadeed ee ka jira qaybo badan oo gobolka ah. Mr. Duffy waxa uu soo xigtay falanqeeyayaal caalami ah oo ku tilmaamay geeddi-socodka doorashada Somaliland ee sida nabaddas ah la isugu wareejiyo awoodda ay sii xoojiyeen sumcadda Somaliland ee ah meel ka mid ah meelaha ugu xasilloon uguna dimuqraadiyadda wanaagsan Geeska Afrika. Warbixintu waxay si qoto dheer u falanqaysay doorashadii madaxtooyada Somaliland ee sannadkii 2024, taas oo noqotay dhacdo muhiim ah oo sii xoojisay sumcadda Somaliland ee dhinaca dimuqraadiyadda iyo ixtiraamka rabitaanka shacabka. Sida Martin Duffy, ku sheegay warbixintiisa Doorashadu waxay ahayd tii afraad ee madaxtooyo Somaliland tan iyo 1991, taas oo ay ka qayb galeen in ka badan hal milyan oo codbixiyeyaal ah oo ka codeeyay in ka badan laba kun oo goobood oo codbixineed. Waxaana lagu sheegay warbixinta “Doorashadii madaxtooyada ee 2024 waxay ahayd tii afraad ee madaxtooyo tan iyo 1991. In ka badan hal milyan oo codbixiyeyaal ah ayaa ka qayb qaatay, iyagoo ka codeeyay in ka badan laba kun oo goobood oo codbixin ah.” Warbixin caalami ah oo Wargeyska Dawan ka soo xigtay E-International Relations waxa kale oo ay intaasi raacisay “Natiijada doorashada ayaa muujisay guul weyn oo uu gaadhay musharraxa xisbigii mucaaradka ee WADDANI, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), halka madaxweynihii xilka hayay, Muuse Biixi Cabdi, uu aqbalay natiijada doorashada. Tallaabadaasi waxay horseeday kala-guur nabadeed oo dhinaca awoodda ah, taas oo ahayd astaan muujinaysa bisayl siyaasadeed iyo ixtiraamka nidaamka dimuqraadiyadeed Isla markaana si weyn u sii xoojisay sumcadda Somaliland ee ku aaddan ixtiraamka rabitaanka shacabka.” Martin Duffy waxa uu si gaar ah u ammaanay doorka Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka Somaliland (NEC), isaga oo ku tilmaamay hay’ad ku suntan hufnaan, madax-bannaani iyo kalsoonida shacabka. Warbixintiisa ayuu ku sheegay in guddigu door muhiim ah ka qaatay hirgelinta doorasho xor ah oo nidaamsan, isagoo si hufan u maamulay habraacyadii doorashada, isla markaana suura-galiyay in guud ahaan hawlgalka doorashadu ku dhammaado si guul leh. Duffy wuxuu xusay in Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranku noqday tiir muhiim u ah xasilloonida siyaasadeed iyo horumarka dimuqraadiyadda Somaliland, isagoo helay kalsoonida shacabka iyo qaddarinta kormeerayaasha caalamiga ah. Warbixintu waxay tilmaantay in ololihii doorashada uu ku salaysnaa tartan siyaasadeed oo ku saabsan horumarinta mustaqbalka Somaliland. Isaga oo tilmaamay in Musharraxiintii u tartamayey kursiga madaxtinimada Somaliland ay soo bandhigeen aragtiyo kala duwan oo la xidhiidha dimuqraadiyadda, dib-u-habaynta maamulka, midnimada bulshada, horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo raadinta aqoonsi caalami ah. “Doorashadu sidoo kale, waxay muujisay in shacabka Somaliland ay si nabad ah ugu tartami karaan jihada siyaasadeed ee ay doonayaan, iyadoo aanay dhicin rabshado ka dhasha natiijada doorashada,” ayaa lagu yidhi warbixinta. Gunaanad Marka la eego qiimeynta uu soo bandhigay Martin Duffy, Somaliland waxay sii xoojisay sumcaddeeda ku aaddan dimuqraadiyadda, xasilloonida iyo kala-guurka nabadeed ee awoodda. Doorashadii 2024 waxay muujisay bisayl siyaasadeed, hay’ado shaqaynaya iyo bulsho awood u leh inay si nabad ah u maamusho tartanka siyaasadeed. Warbixintu waxay ku soo gabagabaynaysaa in waayo-aragnimada Somaliland ay tahay tusaale muhiim ah oo lagu baranayo dowlad-dhis, nabad-dhis iyo horumarinta dimuqraadiyadda Geeska Afrika, iyadoo guulahaas lagu gaadhay dadaal gudaha ah, wada-tashi bulsho iyo dhismaha hay’ado qaran.

items.title: Marxaladihii uu soo Maray Imtixaanka Qaranka ee Fasalka 12aad
items.description: 43,028 oo ku kala nool gobolka Banaadir iyo maamulgoboleedyada dalka, marka laga reebo maamullada Puntland iyo Soomaalilaan ayaa u fadhisatay imtixaanka shahaadiga ah ee fasalka 12aad, sanaddugsiyeedka 2025/2026. Imtixaanka ayaa si wadajir ah uga furmay 158 xarumood iyo 58 degmo oo ku yaalla guud ahaan dalka. Imtixaankan oo markii 12aad oo xiriir ah ay qabanayso Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare, waxaa sanadkan u fadhiisatay ardaydii ugu badnayd abid tan iyo markii la billaabay qaadista imtixaankan. Marxaladihii uu soo maray Imtixaanka Qaranka waxaan u kala saari doonnaa seddex marxaladood oo kala ah: Marxaladdii Cabsida iyo Moogganaanta Muddo 24 sano kadib, Wasaaradda Waxbarashada Hiddaha iyonTacliinta Sare ayaa sanadkii 2015kii billawday qaadista Imtixaanka Qaranka. Ardaydu waxa ay galeen imtixaanka iyaga oo aan wadan labiska ama dharka loogu talagalay waxbarashada ee yunifoomka duruufo amniga la xiriira aawadeed, goobaha imtixaanka waxaa lagu diyaariyay gaadiidka gurmadka degdegga ah ee anbalaasta, taas oo cabsida ku sii kordhineysay ardayda imtixaanka galeysa, wxaana  u sii dheeraa in ay ka soo  baxeen dugsiyo leh manaahij kala geddisan. Iyada oo duruuftaas adag ay ardaydu ku soo galeen imtixaanka, waxaa jiray arday badan oo ka baaqsaday Imtixaanka Qaranka, kuwa cabsaday oo u bareeri  waayay iyo kuwa kale oo aan iyagu u arkayn Imtixaanka Qaranka in uu muhiim yahay,  kuwo aysan u suurtagelin qaarkoodna uu dhowaan Ra’isalwasaaraha JFS  Xamse Cabdi Barre u fasaxay markii la qiimeeyay duruuftii berigaas jirtay. Marxaladdii Fadeexadda iyo Ogaalka Waa marxalad ay bulshadu ku baraarugtay muhiimadda uu u leeyahay Imtixaanka Qaranka, marxaladaan inkastoo ay cabsidii weli jirtay, haddana waxaa muquuniyay fahanka muhiimadda imtixaanka, taas oo markii danbe sababtay in ardaydu ee xoogga saaran helitaanka dhibco sare, waana halka ay ka billaabatay fadeexaddii Imtixaanka Qaranka. Waxaa si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyay in uu fashilmo imtixaanka Qaranka qaar ka mid ah bahda waxbarashada heerarkooda kala duwan sida uu sheegay Wasiirkii waxbarashada ee xilkigaas Cabdullahi Goodax Barre, kaas oo markii danbe go’aansaday in la baajiyo imtixaankii xilligaas socday. Waxaa sidoo kale aad u xoogeysatay doodda ah in ardayda gobollada ay heystaan fursad ka wanaagsan tan gobolka Banaadir, waxaana arrinkaas sababay in ardayda ku nool gobollada dalka ay helaan darajo ka sarreysa kuwa caasimadda. Qaar ka mid ah mas’uuliyiinta dawladda ayaana ku eedeyay ardayda caasimadda waxa hoos u dhigay ay tahay balwad iyo isticmaalka daran ee baraha bulshada gaar ahaan Tiktok. Aragtidaas waxa ay keentay in ardayda gobolka Banaadir ay u hayaamaan gobollada dalka iyaga oo rajeynaya in ay keeni doonaan darajo wanaagsan. Marxaladdii Sarukaca iyo Horumarka Waa marxaladda hadda lagu jiro iyo tan ugu wanaagsan tan iyo markii uu bilowday Imtixaanka Qaranka. Ugu horreyn waxaa gabi ahaanba meesha ka baxay cabsidii iyo duruufihii ku gedaamanaa Imtixaanka Qaranka, si la mid ah waxaa la adkeeyay  in uu duso ama baxo imtixaanka Qaranku. Waxaa la geeyay degaanno hor leh oo ka tirsan koonfurta, bartamaha iyo waqooyiga dalka.  Wasaaradda Waxbarashadu, waxa ay sidoo kale ku guuleysatay in dhammaan dadka ka shaqeeya Imtixaanka Qaranka laga soo billaabo dajinta, daabicidda, daabulista, ilaalinta iyo sixitaanka ay noqdaan shaqaalaheeda, taas oo meesha ka saareysa in ay baxaan xogaha la xiriira Imtixaanka qaranka.  XOGTAN HOOSE WAXA AY MUUJINEYSAA ARDAYDA GASHAY IMTIXAANKA 2016-2026  SANADKA ARDAYDA IMTIXAANKA GASHAY ARDAYDA GUDUBTAY ARDAYDA HARTAY kaalinta 1aad Jinsiga  2016 11,574 19,104 1,470 Banaadir dheddig 2017 18,239 15,356 2,883 Banaadir Lab 2018 25,675 20,030 5,645 Banaadir Lab 2019 29,434 22,499 6,935 Banaadir Lab 2020 33,727 25,177 8,550 Banaadir Lab 2021 34,908 30,262 4,646 Galmudug Lab 2022 33,468 32,325 1,143 Banaadir Lab 2023 32,501 30,005 2,496 Jubland dheddig 2024 36,034 33,668 2,366 Banaadir Lab 2025 38,471 32,714 5,757 Banaadir dheddig Gabagabo Imtixaanka Qaranka ee fasalka 12aad wuxuu soo maray saddex marxaladood: cabsi iyo moogganaan, iyo ugu danbayn horumar . items.fullContent: 43,028 oo ku kala nool gobolka Banaadir iyo maamulgoboleedyada dalka, marka laga reebo maamullada Puntland iyo Soomaalilaan ayaa u fadhisatay imtixaanka shahaadiga ah ee fasalka 12aad, sanaddugsiyeedka 2025/2026. Imtixaanka ayaa si wadajir ah uga furmay 158 xarumood iyo 58 degmo oo ku yaalla guud ahaan dalka. Imtixaankan oo markii 12aad oo xiriir ah ay qabanayso Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare, waxaa sanadkan u fadhiisatay ardaydii ugu badnayd abid tan iyo markii la billaabay qaadista imtixaankan. Marxaladihii uu soo maray Imtixaanka Qaranka waxaan u kala saari doonnaa seddex marxaladood oo kala ah: Marxaladdii Cabsida iyo Moogganaanta Muddo 24 sano kadib, Wasaaradda Waxbarashada Hiddaha iyonTacliinta Sare ayaa sanadkii 2015kii billawday qaadista Imtixaanka Qaranka. Ardaydu waxa ay galeen imtixaanka iyaga oo aan wadan labiska ama dharka loogu talagalay waxbarashada ee yunifoomka duruufo amniga la xiriira aawadeed, goobaha imtixaanka waxaa lagu diyaariyay gaadiidka gurmadka degdegga ah ee anbalaasta, taas oo cabsida ku sii kordhineysay ardayda imtixaanka galeysa, wxaana  u sii dheeraa in ay ka soo  baxeen dugsiyo leh manaahij kala geddisan. Iyada oo duruuftaas adag ay ardaydu ku soo galeen imtixaanka, waxaa jiray arday badan oo ka baaqsaday Imtixaanka Qaranka, kuwa cabsaday oo u bareeri  waayay iyo kuwa kale oo aan iyagu u arkayn Imtixaanka Qaranka in uu muhiim yahay,  kuwo aysan u suurtagelin qaarkoodna uu dhowaan Ra’isalwasaaraha JFS  Xamse Cabdi Barre u fasaxay markii la qiimeeyay duruuftii berigaas jirtay. Waxaa sidoo kale aad u xoogeysatay doodda ah in ardayda gobollada ay heystaan fursad ka wanaagsan tan gobolka Banaadir, waxaana arrinkaas sababay in ardayda ku nool gobollada dalka ay helaan darajo ka sarreysa kuwa caasimadda. items.title: Daawo: Qoor Qoor oo sheegay in hal arrin ay Puntland…
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Mudane Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoor Qoor) oo xalay ka qayb-galay xuska 14-ka August oo ku beegan maalinka aasaaska ee maamulkaas, isla markaana uu goobjoog ahaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa ka hadlay arrimo kala dhexeeya maamulka ay dariska yihiin ee Puntland. Qoor Qoor ayaa si gaar ah madaxda Puntland iyo shacabka ugu bogaadiyay wada shaqeynta kala dhexeysa Galmudug, isaga oo tusaale usoo qaatay magaaada Gaalkacyo oo ay wada maamulaan labada dhinac. Madaxweynaha Galmudug ayaa sidoo kale ku amaanay reer Puntland, sida walaaltnimada leh ee ay uga wada shaqeeyeen nabadda magaaladaas, isaga oo tilmaamay in wada shaqeyntooda ay xoojisay isfahamka labada maamul. “Waxaa la sameeyay in maamullada dariska ah, gaar ahaan Puntland aan arrimo jiray iska kaashanay si wanaagsan aan iskula meel dhignay waxaana kamid ah magaalada Gaalkacyo oo si gaar ah uga duwan Soomaaliya, taas oo aan u arkeenay furaha nabadda iyo isfahamka labada maamul, iyadana waa lagu guuleystay,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha Maamul Goboleedka Galmudug. Sidoo kale, wuxuu soo hadal qaaday kala aragti duwanaashaha siyaasadeed ee haatan jira, isaga oo tilmaamay inuu rajeynayo in uusan saameyn wada shaqeynta muddada soo socotay ee u dhexeysa Galmudug iyo Puntland. “Wax kasta halagu kala duwanaadee waa ku amaanayaa madaxdii iyo shacabkii reer Galmudug iyo reer Puntland sida aan u wada shaqeyno oo magaalada Gaalkacyo u tahay qadiyaddii gaarka ah ee lahayd sida loo tixgeliyay ee loo maareeyay, waxaana rajeynayaa inay meeshaa kasii socoto,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Waxaa kale oo uu soo jeediyay in lasii wado howlgallada xasilinta iyo kuwa lagula dagaalamayo maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab ee ka socda gobollada dhexe. Hadalkan wuxuu kusoo aadayaa, iyada oo dhawaan Galmudug iyo Puntland ay is waydaarsadeen eedeymo culus oo la xiriira gobolka Mudug, kadib markii mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan maamulka fadhigiisu yahay Garoowe ay uga digeen maamulka deggan Dhuusamareeb in garoomadooda laga soo dajiyo ciidamo iyo hub ay sheegeen in dowladda dhexe ay ku carqaladeyneyso Puntland. The post Daawo: Qoor Qoor oo sheegay in hal arrin ay Puntland… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Fiqi oo ku biiray booqashada Taliyaha CXD ee Xarunta Taliska Qaybta 21aad (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga Somaliya, Axmed Macalin Fiqi ayaa gaaray Xarunta Taliska Qaybta 21aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Magaalada Dhuusamaareeb, si uu ugu biiro booqashada uu Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud uu maanta ku tegay xaruntaasi. Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga ayaa waxaa xarunta ku soo dhaweeyay Taliyaha Militariga, Taliyaha Qaybta 21aad, Korneyl Maxamed Cabdi Daahir (Maxamed Dhagaweyne) iyo Saraakiil kale. Wasaaradda Gaaashaandhiga ayaa warsaxaafadeed ku sheegtay in Taliyaha Qaybta 21aad uu masuuliyiinta warbixin ka siiyay xaaladda guud ee taliska, howlaha ciidanka iyo shaqooyinka ay u hayaan qaranka. “Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga ayaa Saraakiisha iyo Ciidamada Qaybta 21aad kula dardaarmay inay sii xoojiyaan gudashada waajibaadka qaran ee loo igmaday, ilaalinta dalka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo inay si dhow uga shaqeeyaan xoojinta amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ayaa sheegtay “Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale ku booriyay ciidamada inay ilaaliyaan anshaxa, midnimada iyo wadajirka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, isla markaana ay mar walba u diyaargaroobaan gudashada waajibaadka qaran.” Marka laga soo tago warka wasaaradda, wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in masuuliyiinta ay Saraakiisha Qaybta 21aad ka dhageysteen warbixin ku saabsan qaban-qaabada munaasabadda lagu wado inuu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud tababarka ugu soo xiro ciidamada tababarka ku dhameystay Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Xananbuure. Wasiir Fiqi iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa ka mid ah masuuliyiinta Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku wehlinaya booqashada Jimcihii uga bilaabatay Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee Xarunta Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug.

items.title: Aqalka Sare oo Wasiirka Batroolka iyo Macdanta Kala Hadlay Hindise-sharciga Hay’adda Macdanta Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Muqdisho: Guddiga Khayraadka Qaranka, Kaabayaasha Dhaqaalaha iyo Gaadiidka ee Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta kulan la yeeshay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Batroolka iyo Macdanta XFS, Mudane Daahir Shire Maxamed, iyo masuuliyiin ka tirsan Wasaaradda. Kulanka oo ay shir guddoominaysay Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Khayraadka Qaranka ee Aqalka Sare, Senator Saynab Ismaaciil Maxamed, ayaa diiradda lagu saaray turxaan-bixinta iyo fasiraadda qodobo ka mid ah Hindise-sharcyeedka Dhismaha Hay’adda Macdanta Soomaaliyeed. Xubnaha Guddiga ayaa Wasiirka iyo masuuliyiinta Wasaaradda ka dalbaday faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan qodobo ay su’aalo ka qabeen hindise-sharciga. Wasiirka Batroolka iyo Macdanta iyo masuuliyiinta la socday ayaa si faahfaahsan uga jawaabay su’aalihii Guddiga, waxaana kulanka ka dhacay dood iyo is-dhaafsi aragtiyeed ku saabsan qodobbada muhiimka ah ee hindise-sharciga. Doodda kaddib, labada dhinac ayaa isku waafaqay faham iyo fasiraad ku saabsan qodobbadii u baahnaa in la sii caddeeyo. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada Aqalka Sare uu ku doonayo in hindise-sharciyeedyada loo gudbinayo ay noqdaan kuwo si wanaagsan loo turxaan bixiyay, isla markaana waafaqsan Dastuurka, danta guud ee Qaranka iyo horumarinta hannaanka sharci-dejinta Soomaaliya. Hindise-sharciga Hay’adda Macdanta Soomaaliyeed ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh nidaaminta iyo horumarinta maamulka khayraadka macdanta dalka, iyadoo la filayo in doodaha iyo turxaan-bixinta sharciyeed ay sii socdaan.

items.title: Maxay Itoobiya u billowday in ay dib uga gurato Soomaaliya?
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) — Wareejinta saldhig ciidan oo ay ciidamada Itoobiya ku dhowaad 12 sano ku lahaayeen koonfurta Soomaaliya ayaa dhalisay su’aal ka weyn bixitaanka hal fariisin: maxaa Addis Ababa ku riixaya inay xilligan ka tanaasusho goobo ay muddo dheer gacanta ku haysay? Ciidamada Itoobiya ayaa 8-dii Agoosto si rasmi ah saldhigga hore ee Buurhakaba, gobolka Bay, ugu wareejiyay qeybta 60-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, sida ay sheegtay Hawlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasillinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM). Buurhakaba waxay ku taallaa waddada muhiimka ah ee isku xirta Muqdisho iyo Baydhaba, oo xarun u ah maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, waxaana hareeraheeda ku yaalla deegaanno ay Al-Shabaab weli saameyn xooggan ku leedahay. Ciidamada Itoobiya waxay halkaas joogeen tan iyo 2014-kii. Xog ay heshay Caasimada Online ayaa sheegaysa in fariisimo kale oo Itoobiyaanku ku leeyihiin gobolka Bay lagu wareejin karo ciidamada Soomaaliya, inkastoo Addis Ababa aysan shaacin qorshe guud oo ay ciidamadeeda dalka uga saareyso. Sidaas darteed, ka bixitaanka Buurhakaba micnihiisu ma aha in Itoobiya ay Soomaaliya ka baxeyso. Ciidamadeeda ayaa weli ku sugan deegaanno kale, gaar ahaan Bay iyo Bakool, Itoobiya ayaana weli qeyb ka ah howlgalka ballaaran ee Midowga Afrika. UNSOS ayaa bixiya sahayda cuntada, shidaalka, duulimaadyada, daad-gureynta caafimaadka, gaadiidka iyo adeegyo kale oo suurageliya in ciidamada Midowga Afrika ay ka hawlgalaan saldhigyo ku kala yaalla koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya. Haddii nidaamkaas taageerada ahi meesha ka baxo, joogteynta saldhigyada go’doonsan waxay noqon doontaa mid aad uga qaalisan kana adag sidii hore. Danaha Itoobiya wali waa sidooda Danahaas weli waa kuwo waaweyn. Itoobiya waxay Soomaaliya la wadaagtaa xuduud dheer, waxayna Al-Shabaab u aragtaa khatar si toos ah u taabanaysa amnigeeda qaranka. items.title: Taliyaha Militariga oo booqasho ku tegay Xarunta Taliska Qaybta 21aad ee Dhuusamareeb
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud oo ka mid ah wafdiga Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee ku sugan Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ayaa maanta kormeeray Xarunta Taliska Qaybta 21aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee magaaladaasi. Taliyaha Militariga Somaliya ayaa waxaa halkaasi ku soo dhaweeyay Taliyaha Qaybta 21aad, Korneyl Maxamed Cabdi Daahir (Maxamed Dhagaweyne) iyo Saraakiil kale. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Taliyaha Militariga uu Saraakiisha Qaybta 21aad kala hadlay diyaargarowgii ugu dambeeyay ee ciidamada cusub ee lagu wado in tababarka loogu soo xiro Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Xananbuure ee waqooyiga Gobolka Galgaduud. Dugsigan oo hoostaga Taliska Qaybta 21aad ayaa waxaa diyaar ku ah ciidamo cusub oo tababar ku dhameystay dugsigaasi, kuwaas oo la filayo in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu tababarka u soo xiro. Ciidamadan ayaa si rasmi ah uga mid noqonaya Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, iyadoo ayna tahay inay ka qayb qaataan dagaalka dalka looga saarayo Al Shabaab. Taliska Qaybta 21aad waa mid ka mid ah qaybaha ugu muhiimsan ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, wuxuuna ka kooban yahay Guutooyinka 15aad, 24aad iyo 27aad, waxaana uu taliskoodu yahay Magaalada Dhuusamareeb.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh: Duulaan kuma ahi maamul-goboleedyada
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo xalay Dhuusamareeb uga qayb-galay xuska 14-ka August oo ku beegan maalinta aasaaska ee Galmudug ayaa ka hadlay arrimo ku aadan nidaamka federaalka oo xilligan dood culus ay ka taagan tahay. Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in isaga uu door weyn ku lahaa dhismaha dowlad-goboleedyada hadda jira, isagoo xusay in xilligii dowladdiisii hore la aas-aasay inta badan mamullada haatan shaqeeya. “Dalkan taladiisa siyaasadda markaan nimiday Dowlad-goboleed ma jirin, laakiin dastuurka waa ku qornaayeen Gaalkacyo laga soo bilaabo illaa meesha uga dambeyso Jubbaland bartamaha iyo koonfurta Soomaaliya ayaa la’isku dhihi jiray,” ayuu khudbaddiisa yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in uusan duulaan ku ahayn Dowlad-goboleedyada, balse ay garab qabanayaan si loo xoojiyo wada shaqeynta kala dhexeysa dowladda dhexe. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in loo baahan yahay in la ilaaliyo midnimada iyo wadajirka dalka, si loo horay loogu sii wado dowladnimada Soomaaliyeed. “Maanta waa maamulo hana qaaday oo shaqeynaya dowladda dhexe inay sii xoojiso oo ay sii kaabto ma ogiye marna waxba kama bi’in, hayeeshee haddii dadka qaar mas’uuliyadda loo dhiibay ay la liicaan garabkaa qabaneynaa waan joojineynaa, waana hagaajineynaa,” ayuu sii raaciyay Madaxweynuhu. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo haatan khilaaf xooggan uu u dhexeeyo Dowladda Federaalka iyo qaar kamid ah Maamul-goboleedyada dalka, gaar ahaan Jubbaland iyo Puntland oo guud wada shaqeyntii u jaray dowladda dhexe. items.fullContent: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo xalay Dhuusamareeb uga qayb-galay xuska 14-ka August oo ku beegan maalinta aasaaska ee Galmudug ayaa ka hadlay arrimo ku aadan nidaamka federaalka oo xilligan dood culus ay ka taagan tahay. Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in isaga uu door weyn ku lahaa dhismaha dowlad-goboleedyada hadda jira, isagoo xusay in xilligii dowladdiisii hore la aas-aasay inta badan mamullada haatan shaqeeya. “Dalkan taladiisa siyaasadda markaan nimiday Dowlad-goboleed ma jirin, laakiin dastuurka waa ku qornaayeen Gaalkacyo laga soo bilaabo illaa meesha uga dambeyso Jubbaland bartamaha iyo koonfurta Soomaaliya ayaa la’isku dhihi jiray,” ayuu khudbaddiisa yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in uusan duulaan ku ahayn Dowlad-goboleedyada, balse ay garab qabanayaan si loo xoojiyo wada shaqeynta kala dhexeysa dowladda dhexe. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in loo baahan yahay in la ilaaliyo midnimada iyo wadajirka dalka, si loo horay loogu sii wado dowladnimada Soomaaliyeed. “Maanta waa maamulo hana qaaday oo shaqeynaya dowladda dhexe inay sii xoojiso oo ay sii kaabto ma ogiye marna waxba kama bi’in, hayeeshee haddii dadka qaar mas’uuliyadda loo dhiibay ay la liicaan garabkaa qabaneynaa waan joojineynaa, waana hagaajineynaa,” ayuu sii raaciyay Madaxweynuhu. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo haatan khilaaf xooggan uu u dhexeeyo Dowladda Federaalka iyo qaar kamid ah Maamul-goboleedyada dalka, gaar ahaan Jubbaland iyo Puntland oo guud wada shaqeyntii u jaray dowladda dhexe. items.title: Maxkamad Mareykan ah oo Fasaxday Joojinta TPS-ka Soomaalida
items.description: USA (Raxanreeb Online): Maxkamad federaali ah oo Mareykanka ah ayaa fasaxday in maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu soo afjaro barnaamijka Temporary Protected Status (TPS) ee Soomaalida, taas oo meesha ka saaraysa ilaalintii ku-meelgaarka ahayd ee ka hortageysay in qaar kamid ah dadka Soomaalida ah loo masaafuriyo. Go’aankan ayaa saameynaya ku dhowaad 1,100 Soomaali ah oo haystay TPS, iyadoo maamulka Mareykanka uu hadda heli karo awood uu ku dhaqaajiyo joojinta ilaalintooda iyo tallaabooyinka socda ee la xiriira xaaladdooda socdaal. TPS waa ilaalin sharci ah oo ku-meelgaar ah oo la siiyo muwaadiniin ka soo jeeda dalal ay ka jiraan xaalado aan u saamaxayn inay si ammaan ah ugu laabtaan dalkooda. Joojinta TPS-ka Soomaaliya waxaa maamulka Mareykanka horey ugu dhawaaqay Janaayo 2026. Go’aanka maxkamadda macnihiisu ma aha in Soomaali kasta oo aan haysan sharci deggenaansho si toos ah loo tarxiilayo. Waxa uu si gaar ah khuseeyaa dadka ku tiirsanaa TPS, halka qof kasta xaaladdiisa socdaal iyo sharciyeed ay ku xirnaan karto kiiskiisa gaarka ah. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay walaac xooggan oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka Soomaalida ku nool Mareykanka, gaar ahaan dadka ay joojinta TPS-ku si toos ah u saameyneyso. The post Maxkamad Mareykan ah oo Fasaxday Joojinta TPS-ka Soomaalida appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Maxamed Ciise Daahir oo Noqday Ardayga Kaalinta Koowaad ka Galay Imtixaanka Qaranka
items.description: Maxamed Ciise Daahir Yuusuf ayaa noqday ardayga kaalinta koowaad ka galay Imtixaanka Qaranka ee Dugsiyada Sare ee dalka, isagoo helay 94.14 dhibcood , sida ka muuqata natiijada lagu soo bandhigay sawirka. Maxamed Ciise Daahir ayaa dhiganayay Dugsiga Hawl-Wadaag ee Gobolka Banaadir , waxaana guushiisa lagu tilmaamay mid ka dhalatay dadaal, adkaysi iyo juhdi uu geliyay waxbarashadiisa. Natiijada ayaa muujinaysa in Maxamed uu kaalinta koowaad kaga jiro dhammaan ardaydii u fariisatay Imtixaanka Qaranka ee dugsiyada sare, taasoo ka dhigtay mid ka mid ah ardayda sida weyn loogu faanayo waxqabadka waxbarasho ee sanadkan. Dhanka kale, Farxiya Faarax Cumar Cigaal , oo ka socotay Dugsiga Axmed Binu Xambal ee Jubbaland, ayaa gashay kaalinta labaad , iyadoo heshay 93.71 dhibcood . Natiijooyinkan ayaa muujinaya in ardayda Soomaaliyeed ay awood u leeyihiin inay gaaraan heerar sare oo waxbarasho marka la helo dadaal, taageero iyo jawi waxbarasho oo wanaagsan.

items.title: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Al Shabaab oo ku dagaalamay Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose ayaa sheegaya in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ay shalay iyo maanta maleeshiyada Al Shabaab kula dagaalameen duleedka deegaanka Mubaarak ee gobolkaasi. Ciidamada ayaa Jimcihii shalay weerar ballaaran ku qaaday kooxo ka tirsan Al Shabaab oo isku uruursanayay tuulada Ablik oo ka tirsan deegaankaasi Mubaarak oo hoostaga Degmada Awdheegle. Dagaalka maanta ka dhacay tuulada yar ee Ablik ayaa daba socda midkii shalay, iyadoona Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo cutubyo ka tirsan Kumaandooska Gorgor ay weli halkaasi ka wadaan hawlgal sifayn ah. Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa kuu sheegaya in Shabaabku ay qorsheynayeen weerar ay ku soo qaadaan deegaanka Mubaarak, isla-markaana ay ciidamadu ku howlan yihiin, sidii ay khatarta argagixisada uga fogayn lahaayeen deegaankaasi. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Militariga Uganda ee qaybta ka ah Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ayaa 2-dii bishii March la wareegay gacan ku haynta Mubaarak, ka dib sanado badan oo Shabaabku ay ka arriminayeen. Deegaankan ayaa qiyaastii 10km dhinaca galbeed uga beegan Degmada Awdheegle. Deegaanka Mubaarak ayaa isku xira Awdheegle iyo Janaale, waxaana uu deegaanku ku yaallaa goob istiraatiiji ah iyo waddo u dhexeysa degmooyinka iyo deegaanada geediga ah ee gobolkaasi.

items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo Hambalyeeyay Ardayda Kaalmaha Hore ka Gashay Imtixaanka Qaranka
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa si gaar ah ugu hambalyeeyay saddexda arday ee kaalmaha hore ka galay Imtixaanka Qaranka ee Dugsiyada Sare ee dalka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ardayda ugu hambalyeeyay dadaalka iyo guusha ay ka gaareen imtixaanka, isagoo ku ammaanay dadaalkooda waxbarasho iyo sida ay tusaale ugu noqdeen ardayda Soomaaliyeed. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay damaanad qaaday waxbarashada jaamacadeed ee heerka koowaad ee saddexda arday, si ay fursad ugu helaan inay sii wataan waxbarashadooda sare. Go’aankan ayaa muujinaya muhiimadda ay Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya siinayso waxbarashada, gaar ahaan dhiirrigelinta ardayda dadaalka badan iyo abuurista fursado ay ku horumarin karaan aqoontooda. Saddexda arday ee kaalmaha hore galay ayaa guushooda ku gaaray dadaal, adkaysi iyo waxbarasho joogto ah, iyadoo guushooda loo arko dhiirrigelin ku socota dhammaan ardayda Soomaaliyeed. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa marar kala duwan ku celcelisay muhiimadda waxbarashada iyo horumarinta jiilka cusub, iyadoo waxbarashada sare loo arko mid ka mid ah tiirarka muhiimka ah ee lagu dhisayo mustaqbalka Soomaaliya.

items.title: Jeneraal Jimcaale iyo ciidamo taabacsanaa DF oo dib ugu biiray ciidamada Puntland
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) — Jeneraal Jimcaale Jaamac Takar, oo hoggaamiya ciidamada Danab ee fadhigoodu yahay xerada Ligle ee Garoowe, ayaa ugu dambeyn aqbalay in isaga iyo ciidamadiisu dib uga mid noqdaan ciidamada difaaca Puntland, kaddib muddo ku dhow sanad oo ay ka diiwaan gashanaayeen dowladda federaalka, kana qaadanayeen mushaar. Heshiiska ayaa la gaaray xalay, kaddib kulan ay siyaasiyiin iyo waxgarad kasoo jeeda gobolka Nugaal la yeesheen Gen. Jimcaale, sida ay Caasimada Online u xaqiijiyeen mas’uuliyiin goobjoog ahaa. Dhinacyada ayaa isku raacay in dowladda Puntland ay diiwaangelin rasmi ah u sameyso ciidamada Danab ee Ligle, isla markaana ay si joogto ah u bixiso mushaarkooda iyo xuquuqdooda kale ee ciidan. Taas beddelkeeda, ciidamada ayaa ka baxaya diiwaanka dowladda federaalka oo ay ku jireen muddadii ugu dambeysay, waxaana dib loogu celinayaa nidaamka iyo silsiladda taliska ciidamada Puntland. Gen. Jimcaale ayaa sidoo kale sii ahaanaya taliyaha ciidanka Danab, kaddib markii Puntland ay aqbashay in xilkiisa aan wax laga beddelin. Heshiiska waxaa muddooyinkii dambe garwadeen ka ahaa waxgarad iyo siyaasiyiin kasoo jeeda gobolka Nugaal, kuwaas oo ku howlanaa sidii khilaafka Gen. Jimcaale iyo maamulka Puntland loogu soo afjari lahaa wada-hadal. Puntland ayaa sidoo kale ka laabatay qorshe ay maxkamad ku geyn lahayd siyaasiyiin mucaarad ah oo kasoo jeeda gobolka Nugaal, taas oo qeyb ka noqotay dadaallada lagu dejinayo xiisadda siyaasadeed iyo midda amni ee ka dhalatay kala qaybsanaanta ciidamada. Kuur-ilaalo oo iyaduna heshiis laga gaaray Heshiiska Gen. Jimcaale ayaa qeyb ka ah tallaabooyin xiriir ah oo Puntland ay maalmihii la soo dhaafay ku soo celinaysay ciidamo hore ugu biiray ama xiriir la sameystay dowladda federaalka. Ciidamo maalmihii ugu dambeeyay ku sugnaa deegaanka Kuur-ilaalo ee degmada Rako-raaxo, gobolka Karkaar, kuwaas oo horey ugu biiray dowladda federaalka, ayaa iyaguna aqbalay inay ka mid noqdaan Ciidanka Difaaca Puntland. Is-afgaradkaas ayaa yimid kaddib waanwaan ay sameeyeen qaar kamid ah odayaasha dhaqanka iyo siyaasiyiin kasoo jeeda gobolka Bari. Puntland ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadaas lagu dari doono qaab-dhismeedka rasmiga ah ee ciidankeeda, isla markaana la marsiin doono diiwaangelin, tababar iyo dib-u-habayn si loogu waafajiyo nidaamka, anshaxa iyo silsiladda taliska ciidamada Puntland. “Maleeshiyaadkii hubaysnaa ee ku sugnaa deegaanka Kuur-ilaalo ee degmada Rako-raaxo ayaa aqbalay inay ka mid noqdaan Ciidanka Difaaca Puntland,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Puntland. “Ciidamadan ayaa lagu darayaa qaab-dhismeedka rasmiga ah ee Ciidanka, waxaana loo marayaa habraacyada diiwaangelinta, tababarka iyo dib-u-habaynta ciidan, si loo waafajiyo nidaamka, anshaxa, habraacyada iyo silsiladda taliska ee Ciidanka Difaaca,” ayaa lagu sii yiri qoraalka. Tallaabada Kuur-ilaalo ayaa meesha ka saartay xuddun kale oo ciidan oo khilaaf ka dhex abuuri kartay Puntland iyo dowladda federaalka, gaar ahaan iyadoo maalmahan ay jireen dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan iyo dadaallo lagu kala saarayo ciidamada sida tooska ah uga amar-qaata labada dhinac. items.title: Heshiiska Makkah iyo is-beddelka naqshadda difaac ee amniga Soomaaliya
items.description: 7-dii Agoosto 2026, magaalada ugu barakaysan Islaamka, saddex hoggaamiye ayaa saxiixay heshiis si weyn u beddelay khariidadda istaraatiijiyadeed ee dal kasta oo xiriir milatari la leh midkood. Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan, Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Mohammed bin Salman iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif, oo uu wehliyay taliyaha ciidanka dalkaas, ayaa heshiiska ku kala saxiixday magaalada Makkah. Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makkah wuxuu dhigayaa in weerar hubaysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsanayo weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. In heshiiska lagu saxiixo Makkah ma ahayn arrin iska timid. Miisaanka astaan iyo diin ahaan ay leedahay magaalada ugu barakaysan Islaamka ayaa heshiiska siisay macne ka baxsan iskaashi amni oo keliya. Dadka hindisay heshiiskan waxay doonayaan in loo arko farriin xambaarsan aragti ilbaxnimo iyo mid istaraatiijiyadeed oo ka ballaaran heshiis difaac oo caadi ah. Soomaaliya qolka ma joogin. Soomaaliya ma saxiixin Heshiiska Makkah. Laakiin Soomaaliya waxay heshiisyo milatari la leedahay dhammaan saddexda dal ee saxiixay. Farqigaas — u dhexeeya isbahaysiga la saxiixay 7-dii Agoosto iyo heshiisyada laba-geesoodka ah ee Soomaaliya sannadihii u dambeeyay urursatay — waa su’aasha istaraatiijiyadeed ee ugu weyn ee Muqdisho aan weli lagu qasbin inay si cad uga jawaabto. Laakiin mar uun waa lagu qasbi doonaa. Su’aashu waxay tahay: marka waqtigaas la gaaro, Soomaaliya diyaar ma u noqon doontaa? Turkiga wuxuu Muqdisho ku leeyahay saldhiggiisa milatari ee ugu weyn ee uu ku leeyahay meel ka baxsan dalkiisa. Diyaaradaha dagaalka ee F-16-ka Turkiga ayaa ku sugan garoonka diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde. Ciidamada badda Turkiga waxay gaaf-wareegaan biyaha Soomaaliya, iyagoo ku shaqaynaya oggolaansho la kordhiyay ilaa Luulyo 2028. Turkigu wuxuu tababaraa qaar ka mid ah cutubyada dagaal ee ugu awoodda badan Soomaaliya, wuxuuna ku maamulaa dekedda iyo garoonka diyaaradaha Muqdisho heshiisyo 30 sano ah. Waxa kale oo uu shidaal ka sahminayaa xeebaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo heshiiskaasi Ankara siinayo ilaa 90 boqolkiiba dakhliga marxaladaha hore. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa 9-kii Febraayo 2026 Soomaaliya la saxiixatay heshiis iskaashi milatari, hase yeeshee qodobbadiisa si shaacsan looma faahfaahin. Isla bishaas, Riyadh waxay Soomaaliya la gashay heshiisyo kale oo la xiriira gaadiidka badda iyo horumarinta dekedaha. Pakistan-na waxay Agoosto 2026 Soomaaliya la saxiixatay is-afgarad iskaashi difaac, isla toddobaadkii la dhammaystiray Heshiiska Makkah. Heshiiskaas wuxuu khuseeyaa la-dagaallanka argagixisada, barnaamijyada tayeynta ciidamada iyo is-weydaarsiga khibradaha. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Hindiya waxay xaqiijisay inay si gaar ah ula socoto heshiiska amni ee Pakistan iyo Soomaaliya, iyadoo sidoo kale isha ku haysa Heshiiska Makkah laftiisa. Marka Hindiya ay si shaacsan magac ugu sheegto heshiis laba-geesood ah oo dhex maray laba dal, heshiiskaasi wuxuu yeeshay miisaan istaraatiijiyadeed oo aysan dhinacyadii saxiixay iska indho-tiri karin. Heshiisyadeeda laba-geesoodka ah awgood, Soomaaliya waxay isku mar isku dhex dhigtay saaxadda istaraatiijiyadeed ee dhammaan saddexda dal ee saxiixay Heshiiska Makkah. Su’aasha cusub ee heshiiskaasi dhalinayo waxay tahay waxa ay dhab ahaan ka dhigan tahay in Soomaaliya sidaas ula safan tahay saddex dal oo hadda isku xiran ballanqaad difaac wadajir ah — gaar ahaan marka cidda ay iskaashigaas difaac si dadban uga soo horjeedaan ay tahay isla cidda taageerta xoogagga caqabad ku ah midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Heshiiska Makkah waxaa la saxiixay xilli uu socdo dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Iran, isla markaana uu dib u qarxay dagaalka Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Turkigu wuxuu ku adkaystay in heshiiska aan dal gaar ah loola jeedin. Taasi waa hadal diblomaasiyadeed oo caadi ah. Laakiin duruufaha istaraatiijiyadeed ee heshiiska ku xeeran sidaas uma mugdi badna. Iran waxay taageertaa Xuutiyiinta. Xuutiyiintuna waxay gacanta ku hayaan xeebaha Yemen ee ka soo horjeeda Somaliland. Israa’iil — oo aqoonsatay Somaliland bishii Diseembar 2025, haddana dagaal kula jirta Iran — waa awoodda ay Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo hadda Pakistan sida ugu tooska badan uga hortagayaan ballaarinta saameynteeda Geeska Afrika. Tan iyo Diseembar 2025, Soomaaliya waxay sheegaysay inaysan oggolaan doonin saldhig milatari oo Israa’iil ka samaysato Somaliland, isla markaana ay ka hortagi doonto tallaabo kasta oo noocaas ah. Hadalkaas hadda wuxuu ka dhex jiraa qaab-dhismeed difaac wadajir ah oo ay ku jiraan dalka keliya ee Muslim ah ee haysta hubka nukliyeerka, dhaqaalaha ugu weyn dunida Carabta iyo ciidanka labaad ee ugu weyn NATO. Taasi ma aha isbeddel yar oo ku yimid deegaanka istaraatiijiyadeed ee Soomaaliya. Waa isbeddel salka wax ka beddelaya. Saamaynta uu ku yeelanayo loollanka labada isbahaysi ee hadda ka samaysmaya Geeska Afrika waa mid degdeg ah. Isbahaysiga Muqdisho — Turkiga, Sacuudiga, Masar iyo Qatar — waxaa hadda si rasmi ah u xoojiyay ku biirista Pakistan ee heshiis difaac wadajir ah oo ay la gashay labada xubnood ee ugu awoodda badan isbahaysigaas. Dhanka kale, Isbahaysiga Berbera — Israa’iil, Imaaraadka Carabta iyo Itoobiya — wuxuu wajahayaa xulafo si rasmi ah isu abaabulay, awooddooda milatarina aad uga sarreyso wax kasta oo ay awoodaha doonaya inay beddelaan nidaamka jira ka keeni karaan Geeska Afrika. Itoobiya ma laha awood nukliyeer oo ay cadow ku cabsi geliso. Imaaraadku ma laha heshiis difaac wadajir ah. Israa’iilna waxay isku mar dagaal uga jirtaa dhowr jiho. Isu-dheellitirka ballanqaadyada milatari ee rasmiga ah ee Geeska Afrika wuxuu isu beddelay qaab aan gobolka muddooyinkii dhowaa lagu arag. Hase yeeshee, xaaladda Soomaaliya waxaa ku jira arrin murugsan oo Heshiiska Makkah uusan xal u helin. Soomaaliya waxay heshiisyo milatari la leedahay Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan. Laakiin midkoodna lama laha heshiis difaac rasmi ah oo labada dhinac isku waajibinaya inay dagaal isu galaan. Heshiisyada Soomaaliya waxay khuseeyaan tababar, iskaashi iyo amniga badda. Kuma jiraan qodobka difaaca wadajirka ah ee Heshiiska Makkah hadda ka dhex dhigay saddexda dal ee saxiixay. Soomaaliya waxay ku dhex jirtaa saaxadda istaraatiijiyadeed ee Heshiiska Makkah, iyada oo aan xubin ka ahayn heshiiska laftiisa. Waxay ka faa’iidaysan kartaa awoodda cabsi-gelinta ee isbahaysiga, laakiin ma haysato dammaanadda difaac wadajirka ah ee xubnaha heshiisku leeyihiin. Kala-duwanaanshahaas — ku-tiirsanaan aan xubinnimo lahayn iyo la-safasho aan heshiis difaac rasmi ahi saldhig u ahayn — waa xaalad qaab-dhismeed oo muddo toban sano ku dhow qeexaysay siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya iyo inta badan xiriirrada laba-geesoodka ah ee ay dhisatay. Soomaaliya waxay urursatay iskaashi milatari oo ay la leedahay xulafada ugu awoodda badan qaab-dhismeedka amni ee cusub ee ka soo baxaya Geeska Afrika. Laakiin weli iskaashiyadaas uma beddelin xiriir rasmi ah oo heshiis difaac ku dhisan, kaas oo siin lahaa kursi ay ku yeelato miiska lagu gaarayo go’aannada mustaqbalkeeda qaabeeya. Taasi waa farqiga istaraatiijiyadeed ee Heshiiska Makkah hadda bannaanka keenay. Farqiyada noocaas ahna, siyaasadda quwadaha adduunka, si iskood ah uma xirmaan. W/Q: Mohamed Addow Mohamed Addow waa falanqeeye madax-bannaan oo ku xeeldheer juqraafi-siyaasadeedka, qoraa iyo khabiir arrimaha Geeska Afrika ah, kuna nool Netherlands. Isla bishaas, Riyadh waxay Soomaaliya la gashay heshiisyo kale oo la xiriira gaadiidka badda iyo horumarinta dekedaha. Pakistan-na waxay Agoosto 2026 Soomaaliya la saxiixatay is-afgarad iskaashi difaac, isla toddobaadkii la dhammaystiray Heshiiska Makkah. Heshiiskaas wuxuu khuseeyaa la-dagaallanka argagixisada, barnaamijyada tayeynta ciidamada iyo is-weydaarsiga khibradaha. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Hindiya waxay xaqiijisay inay si gaar ah ula socoto heshiiska amni ee Pakistan iyo Soomaaliya, iyadoo sidoo kale isha ku haysa Heshiiska Makkah laftiisa. Marka Hindiya ay si shaacsan magac ugu sheegto heshiis laba-geesood ah oo dhex maray laba dal, heshiiskaasi wuxuu yeeshay miisaan istaraatiijiyadeed oo aysan dhinacyadii saxiixay iska indho-tiri karin. Heshiisyadeeda laba-geesoodka ah awgood, Soomaaliya waxay isku mar isku dhex dhigtay saaxadda istaraatiijiyadeed ee dhammaan saddexda dal ee saxiixay Heshiiska Makkah. Su’aasha cusub ee heshiiskaasi dhalinayo waxay tahay waxa ay dhab ahaan ka dhigan tahay in Soomaaliya sidaas ula safan tahay saddex dal oo hadda isku xiran ballanqaad difaac wadajir ah — gaar ahaan marka cidda ay iskaashigaas difaac si dadban uga soo horjeedaan ay tahay isla cidda taageerta xoogagga caqabad ku ah midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Heshiiska Makkah waxaa la saxiixay xilli uu socdo dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Iran, isla markaana uu dib u qarxay dagaalka Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Turkigu wuxuu ku adkaystay in heshiiska aan dal gaar ah loola jeedin. Taasi waa hadal diblomaasiyadeed oo caadi ah. Laakiin duruufaha istaraatiijiyadeed ee heshiiska ku xeeran sidaas uma mugdi badna. Iran waxay taageertaa Xuutiyiinta. Xuutiyiintuna waxay gacanta ku hayaan xeebaha Yemen ee ka soo horjeeda Somaliland. Israa’iil — oo aqoonsatay Somaliland bishii Diseembar 2025, haddana dagaal kula jirta Iran — waa awoodda ay Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo hadda Pakistan sida ugu tooska badan uga hortagayaan ballaarinta saameynteeda Geeska Afrika. Tan iyo Diseembar 2025, Soomaaliya waxay sheegaysay inaysan oggolaan doonin saldhig milatari oo Israa’iil ka samaysato Somaliland, isla markaana ay ka hortagi doonto tallaabo kasta oo noocaas ah. Hadalkaas hadda wuxuu ka dhex jiraa qaab-dhismeed difaac wadajir ah oo ay ku jiraan dalka keliya ee Muslim ah ee haysta hubka nukliyeerka, dhaqaalaha ugu weyn dunida Carabta iyo ciidanka labaad ee ugu weyn NATO. Taasi ma aha isbeddel yar oo ku yimid deegaanka istaraatiijiyadeed ee Soomaaliya. Waa isbeddel salka wax ka beddelaya. Saamaynta uu ku yeelanayo loollanka labada isbahaysi ee hadda ka samaysmaya Geeska Afrika waa mid degdeg ah. Isbahaysiga Muqdisho — Turkiga, Sacuudiga, Masar iyo Qatar — waxaa hadda si rasmi ah u xoojiyay ku biirista Pakistan ee heshiis difaac wadajir ah oo ay la gashay labada xubnood ee ugu awoodda badan isbahaysigaas. Dhanka kale, Isbahaysiga Berbera — Israa’iil, Imaaraadka Carabta iyo Itoobiya — wuxuu wajahayaa xulafo si rasmi ah isu abaabulay, awooddooda milatarina aad uga sarreyso wax kasta oo ay awoodaha doonaya inay beddelaan nidaamka jira ka keeni karaan Geeska Afrika. Itoobiya ma laha awood nukliyeer oo ay cadow ku cabsi geliso. Imaaraadku ma laha heshiis difaac wadajir ah. Israa’iilna waxay isku mar dagaal uga jirtaa dhowr jiho. Isu-dheellitirka ballanqaadyada milatari ee rasmiga ah ee Geeska Afrika wuxuu isu beddelay qaab aan gobolka muddooyinkii dhowaa lagu arag. Hase yeeshee, xaaladda Soomaaliya waxaa ku jira arrin murugsan oo Heshiiska Makkah uusan xal u helin. Soomaaliya waxay heshiisyo milatari la leedahay Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan. Laakiin midkoodna lama laha heshiis difaac rasmi ah oo labada dhinac isku waajibinaya inay dagaal isu galaan. Heshiisyada Soomaaliya waxay khuseeyaan tababar, iskaashi iyo amniga badda. Kuma jiraan qodobka difaaca wadajirka ah ee Heshiiska Makkah hadda ka dhex dhigay saddexda dal ee saxiixay. Soomaaliya waxay ku dhex jirtaa saaxadda istaraatiijiyadeed ee Heshiiska Makkah, iyada oo aan xubin ka ahayn heshiiska laftiisa. Waxay ka faa’iidaysan kartaa awoodda cabsi-gelinta ee isbahaysiga, laakiin ma haysato dammaanadda difaac wadajirka ah ee xubnaha heshiisku leeyihiin. Kala-duwanaanshahaas — ku-tiirsanaan aan xubinnimo lahayn iyo la-safasho aan heshiis difaac rasmi ahi saldhig u ahayn — waa xaalad qaab-dhismeed oo muddo toban sano ku dhow qeexaysay siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya iyo inta badan xiriirrada laba-geesoodka ah ee ay dhisatay. Soomaaliya waxay urursatay iskaashi milatari oo ay la leedahay xulafada ugu awoodda badan qaab-dhismeedka amni ee cusub ee ka soo baxaya Geeska Afrika. Laakiin weli iskaashiyadaas uma beddelin xiriir rasmi ah oo heshiis difaac ku dhisan, kaas oo siin lahaa kursi ay ku yeelato miiska lagu gaarayo go’aannada mustaqbalkeeda qaabeeya. Taasi waa farqiga istaraatiijiyadeed ee Heshiiska Makkah hadda bannaanka keenay. Farqiyada noocaas ahna, siyaasadda quwadaha adduunka, si iskood ah uma xirmaan. items.title: Uganda Announces Continued Troop Presence in Somalia
items.description: KAMPALA — Uganda has reaffirmed its commitment to maintaining troops in Somalia as uncertainty grows over the future of the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), which continues to face significant funding challenges. Uganda’s Defence Minister, Kiryowa Kiwanuka, said Kampala intends to sustain its military contribution to Somalia and plans to deploy a new contingent of troops, underscoring Uganda’s continued role in regional efforts to support security and stability in the country. The announcement comes as discussions intensify over the future of AUSSOM and the security arrangements expected to follow the mission’s current framework through the end of 2026. Uganda has also called for changes to the way AUSSOM is financed, stressing the need for a predictable and sustainable funding mechanism to ensure the mission can carry out its mandate effectively. Kampala says reliable financing will be critical to supporting Somalia’s security transition, particularly as Somali forces gradually take on greater responsibility for securing the country while continuing operations against Al-Shabaab. Uganda remains one of the key troop-contributing countries to the African Union mission in Somalia and has played a central role in international efforts to support Somali security institutions. items.title: SOMALIA: Military Command and NISA Issue Conflicting Accounts of Recent Airstrikes Targeting Al-Shabaab
items.description: MOGADISHU — Somalia’s security agencies have reported a series of military operations and airstrikes against Al-Shabaab in parts of the Hiiraan and Middle Shabelle regions, saying several senior commanders and fighters were killed. The National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA) said a planned operation in Warciise, approximately 25 kilometres from Jowhar, resulted in the deaths of nine Al-Shabaab members, including two senior commanders. According to NISA, those killed included Ahmed Ali Jimale, whom the agency identified as Al-Shabaab’s commander for Jowhar district, and Geeddi Mohamed Nur Adde, who was said to be responsible for the group’s activities in the Dumaaye and Dabagaalo areas. The agency said the two commanders had been under surveillance for an extended period and that their movements and activities had been closely monitored before the operation was carried out. Seven other Al-Shabaab members accompanying them were also killed, according to the statement. In a separate statement, the Somali military said the Somali National Army, with support from international partners, conducted a series of operations and airstrikes overnight in Middle Shabelle and Hiiraan. The military said an Al-Shabaab gathering in Warciise was targeted during the operation. Preliminary assessments cited in the statement indicated that 11 commanders were killed, including Ahmed Ali Jimale, Geedi Cadaawe, Geedi Guuleed Abu Nabhaan and Yaasir Kormeed. Further operations were reported in the Teedaan and Yasoomane areas of Hiiraan region, where the military said 15 Al-Shabaab fighters and commanders were killed and 17 others wounded. Those reported killed in the Hiiraan operations included Ahmed Macallin, Zakariye, Muse Omar and Macallin Khalid. In Yasoomane, the military said eight Al-Shabaab fighters were killed, while two commanders identified as Albaani and Bukhaari were wounded in an airstrike. According to the military, a total of seven airstrikes were conducted against locations where Al-Shabaab commanders and fighters were believed to be operating or meeting. The separate statements issued by NISA and the military differed over some details of the Warciise operation. NISA reported that nine Al-Shabaab members were killed, while the military said 11 commanders had been killed. The two accounts also differed on some of the names and positions of those reported dead. The claims could not be independently verified. Somali security authorities said the operations are part of an ongoing campaign to weaken Al-Shabaab’s leadership, disrupt its operational networks and reduce the group’s ability to plan and carry out attacks. NISA also called on members of the public to provide information on the activities and movements of Al-Shabaab and Islamic State-linked militants, saying public cooperation remains an important part of efforts to prevent security threats and protect civilians. items.title: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka oo sheegay in uu ku dhawaaqi doono in Hormuz ay tahay dhul uu Maraykanku leeyahay
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu dhawaan ku dhawaaqi doono in Marinka Hormuz uu yahay “dhul ay leedahay dowladda Mareykanka,” taas oo sii xoojinaysa mowqifkiisa ku aaddan marinkan biyaha ee muhiimka ah. “Markaan dhammaystirno ka guuleysiga Iran… waxaan dhawaan ku dhawaaqi doonaa in Marinka Hormuz uu yahay dhul uu leeyahay Mareykanka,” ayuu yiri Mr. Trump oo khudbad ka jeedinayay magaalada Garden City. Wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters ayaa sheegtay inaan weli la hubin dhabnimada hadalka Trump, ama haddii ay tilmaamayaan isbeddel cusub oo ku yimid siyaasadda Mareykanka ee ku aaddan Marinka Hormuz. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale ku boorriyay muwaadiniintiisa inay aqbalaan koror yar oo ku yimaada qiimaha shidaalka, taas oo loo arko kharashka ku baxaya ka hortagga inay Iran hesho hubka nukliyeerka. Wuxuu sheegay in dadka Mareykanka ah ee laga yaabo inay “wax yar in ka badan” ku iibsadaan shidaalka ay tahay inay xasuustaan ​​inay taasi tahay qiimaha lagu horjoogsanayo “waddan aad u shar badan” inuu helo hubka nukliyeerka. Qiyaastii 20 boqolkiiba shidaalka iyo gaaska dabiiciga ah ee dareeraha ah ee caalamka ayaa sida caadiga ah mara Marinka Hormuz.

items.title: DF oo shaacisay natiijada Imtixaanka shahaadiga ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Waxbarashada Soomaaliya ayaa maanta oo Sabti ah shaacisay natiijada imtixaanka shahaadiga fasalka 12-aad ee sanad-dugsiyeedka 2025 2026-ka iyo ardeyda ka galay kaalmaha hore. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda ayaa lagu seegay in 40,037 arday ay ku guuleysteen imtixaanka, halka 2,879 arday ay ku harreen. Sidoo kale, Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay imtixaanka shahaadiga ee qaranka ee sanadkan uu ka qabsoomay guud ahaan gobollada dalka, iyadoo Wasaaraddu sheegtay in imtixaanku u dhacay si habsami leh oo hufnaan leh. Maxamed Ciise Daahir Yuusuf ayaa galay kaalinta 1-aad, wuxuuna dhigtaa dugsiga Howl-wadaag ee Gobolka Banaadir, isagoo keenay 94.14, halka ay kaalinta 2-aad kusoo baxday Farxiya Faarax Cumar Cigaal oo iyana ku sugan Jubbaland, taas oo keentay 93.71. Sidoo kale, waxaa kaalinta 3-aad galay Aamina Khaalid Cabdalla oo dhigata iskuulka Imaamu Shaafici ee magaalada Muqdisho, waxayna heshay 92.57, sida ay shaacisay Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare. Dhanaca kale, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre, ayaa si gaar ah ugu hambalyeeyay saddexda arday ee kaalmaha ugu sarreeya ka galay imtixaanka qaranka ee dugsiyada sare. Xamza ayaa khadka taleefoonka kula xiriiray ardayda kaalmaha hore galay, isagoo ku bogaadiyay dadaalkii, juhdigii iyo hagar-la’aantii ay muujiyeen intii ay ku guda jireen waxbarashadooda. Ugu dambeyn, Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa ku wargeliyay ardayda kaalmaha hore galay iyo guud ahaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay damaanad qaadday dhammaan kharashaadka waxbarasho ee ardaydaasi ay jaamacadaha ku geli doonaan. items.title: Dugsiga Tababarka Xananbuure oo muhiim u noqday Dowladda Federaalka
items.description: Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ama Xerada Militariga Xananbuure ayaa ka mid noqotay xeryaha diyaarka ah ee lagu tababaro Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, oo ah ciidamo si gaar ah loogu diyaariyo difaaca dalka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Dowladda Federaalka ay sanadkii hore ee 2025 ballaarin ku sameysay Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Xananbuure, markaas oo lagu uruuriyay dhallinyaro fara-badan oo laga soo xulay deegaano kala duwan. Dugsiga Xananbuure ayaa hoostaga Taliska Qaybta 21aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, oo madax uu u yahay Korneyl Maxamed Cabdi Daahir (Maxamed Dhagaweyne). Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa 16-kii bishii May booqday xeradaasi, mar uu qiimeynayay heerka tababarka ee ciidamada halkaasi lagu tababarayay, isagoona noqday sarkaalkii ugu sarreyay ee booqda xeradaasi, tan iyo intii la hawlgeliyay. Dugsiga Xananbuure ayaa hadda ah meelaha ay Dowladda Federaalka ku diyaariso ciidamada cusub ee qaranka, kaas oo awood u leh in hal mar lagu tababaro ku dhawaad kun askari. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo Jimcihii booqashada uu ku marayo Galmudug ka bilaabay Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ayaa la filayaa in uu tago Xananbuure, isaga oo kaga qaybgelaya munaasabad tababar loogu soo xirayo ciidamada halkaasi lagu diyaariyay, laguna qalabeeyay. Cutubyada lagu tababaro Xerada Militariga Xananbuure ee waqooyiga Gobolka Galgaduud ayaa si gaar ah uga mid noqonaya Ciidanka Qaybta 21aad ee Xoogga Dalka, iyadoo Qaybta 21aad ay hadda ka kooban tahay Saddex Guuto oo kala ah Guutada 15aad, Guutada 24aad iyo Guutada 27aad, waxaana uu Xarunta Taliskoodu yahay Dhuusamareeb. Doorka xeradan waa in la soo saaro cutubyo cusub oo loogu talagalay inay xoojiyaan hawlgalada militariga ee ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada. Ciidamada lagu wado in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu dhawaan tababarka ugu soo xiro xeradaasi ayaa ku biiraya safka dagaalka, si ay gacan uga gaystaan hawlgalada dalka looga saarayo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Xananbuure ayaa muhiim u ah Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, oo u baahan inay buuxiso goobaha ay ka baxaan Ciidanka Midowga Afrika ee Hawlgalka AUSSOM.

Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa 16-kii bishii May booqday xeradaasi, mar uu qiimeynayay heerka tababarka ee ciidamada halkaasi lagu tababarayay, isagoona noqday sarkaalkii ugu sarreyay ee booqda xeradaasi, tan iyo intii la hawlgeliyay. Dugsiga Xananbuure ayaa hadda ah meelaha ay Dowladda Federaalka ku diyaariso ciidamada cusub ee qaranka, kaas oo awood u leh in hal mar lagu tababaro ku dhawaad kun askari. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo Jimcihii booqashada uu ku marayo Galmudug ka bilaabay Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ayaa la filayaa in uu tago Xananbuure, isaga oo kaga qaybgelaya munaasabad tababar loogu soo xirayo ciidamada halkaasi lagu diyaariyay, laguna qalabeeyay. Cutubyada lagu tababaro Xerada Militariga Xananbuure ee waqooyiga Gobolka Galgaduud ayaa si gaar ah uga mid noqonaya Ciidanka Qaybta 21aad ee Xoogga Dalka, iyadoo Qaybta 21aad ay hadda ka kooban tahay Saddex Guuto oo kala ah Guutada 15aad, Guutada 24aad iyo Guutada 27aad, waxaana uu Xarunta Taliskoodu yahay Dhuusamareeb. Doorka xeradan waa in la soo saaro cutubyo cusub oo loogu talagalay inay xoojiyaan hawlgalada militariga ee ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada. Ciidamada lagu wado in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu dhawaan tababarka ugu soo xiro xeradaasi ayaa ku biiraya safka dagaalka, si ay gacan uga gaystaan hawlgalada dalka looga saarayo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Xananbuure ayaa muhiim u ah Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, oo u baahan inay buuxiso goobaha ay ka baxaan Ciidanka Midowga Afrika ee Hawlgalka AUSSOM.

items.title: Meta Oo Wajahaysa Dacwad $1.4 Tirilyan Ah
items.description: Shirkadda Meta, oo ay leedahay Facebook iyo Instagram, ayaa toddobaadkan maxkamadda ku hor taagan 29 gobol oo Mareykanka ah kuwaas oo ku eedeeyay inay si ula kac ah uga dhigtay baraha Facebook iyo Instagram kuwo dhalinyarada ku dhejiya taasoo noqonaysa kiiskii ugu weynaa ee la soo dershay arrimaha dhalinyarada iyo baraha bulshada. Maxkamadda federaalka ee Oakland California ayaa lagu furi doonaa Isniinta 18-ka Agoosto, waxaana la filayaa inay socoto muddo todoba toddobaad ah, iyadoo xaakimka Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers ay go’aanka ugu dambeeya soo saari doonto Oktoobar . Maxkamaddan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan tahay markii ugu horreysay ee maxkamad federaali ay soo qaaddo eedeymo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah shirkadda Meta kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan inay si ula kac ah u soo uruurisay xogta carruurta ka yar 13 sano, iyadoo jabisay sharciga qarsoonida federaalka . Sidoo kale waxay eedeynayaan in shirkaddu ay si ula kac ah uga dhigtay baraha kuwo dhalinyarada ku dhejiya, iyadoo ay sii waday inay dadka u sheegto inay ammaan yihiin . Meta ayaa sheegtay in khasaaraha ay la kulmi karto uu gaari karo ilaa $1.4 tirilyan, taasoo ku dhow dhammaan qiimaha shirkadda ee suuqa . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, gobolada ayaa aan sheegin wax cad oo ku saabsan lacagta ay dalbanayaan. Marka laga soo tago magdhowga lacageed, gobolada ayaa sidoo kale ka codsanaya maxkamadda inay ku amarto Meta inay beddesho qaabka baraha u shaqeeyaan oo ay ku jiraan xaddidaad da’eed, in la joojiyo dhaqdhaqaaqa aan dhammaadka lahayn (infinite scroll), iyo in algorithm-ka loo beddelo si uu mudnaanta u siiyo wanaagga dhalinyarada halkii uu ka siin lahaa ku dhajinta . Madaxa shirkadda Meta Mark Zuckerberg iyo madaxa Instagram Adam Mosseri ayaa la filayaa inay maxkamadda ka marag kashadaan. Kiiskani waxa uu ka mid yahay 3,000 oo dacwadood oo maxkamadan ku urursan, waxaana uu imaanayaa xilli ay dhageysato dadweynaha waxay muujinayaan in 85% ay rumeysan yihiin in baraha bulshada ay dhalinyarada ku dhejin karaan . The post Meta Oo Wajahaysa Dacwad $1.4 Tirilyan Ah first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Jaamac oo guddoomiyay kulankii ugu horreeyay BF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa maanta guddoomiyay kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee Baarlamaanka tan iyo markii Isniintii lagu doortay xarunta Villa Hargeysa ee magaalada Muqdisho. Kulanka maanta ay yeesheen xidhibaannada ayaa ahaa kii labaad ee kalfadhiga 8-aad, waxaana guddoomiye Jaamac wehlinayay guddoomiye ku-xigeenka labaad ee Golaha Mudane Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow, iyada oo kulanka uu ku furmay illaa 141 Mudane. Ugu horreyn Xildhibaanada ayaa waxa ay u codeeyeen xubin ka banaaneyd guddiga madaxa banaan ee Xuquuqul Insaanka oo ay soo gudbisay Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horrumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyada oo golaha ay hortay Wasiir khadija Al-makhzoumi Intaasi ka dib, Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka ayaa u codeeyey Maxamed Xasan Nuur oo ay Wasaararda usoo xushay inuu buuxiyo xubintii ka banaaneyd guddiga madaxa banaan ee Xuquuqul Insaanka, waxaana ogolaatay 141 Mudane, laba Xildhibaan ayaa diiday, wax ka aamusayna ma jirin, sida uu sheegay Guddoomiye Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac). Sidoo kale, Guddoomiyaha oo kulanka soo xiray ayaa u mahadceliyey Xildhibaanada, wuxuuna kula dardaarmay in ay xooga saaraan sidii uu goluhu uga shaqeyn lahaayeen shuruucda muhiimka ah ee golaha hortaala kalfadhiga sideedaad. Dhinaca kale Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka ayaa loo qeybiyey Hindise Sharciyeedka Sharciga Dhismaha Hay’adda Dakhliga Qaranka, Hindise Sharciyeedka wax ka bedelka Sharciga Bankiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya sharci LR 130 ee soo baxay 20-kii April-2012 iyo Borotokoolada kaabaya afarta Axdi ee Geneva 1949-kii. Baarlamaanka oo uu dhawaan furay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa si rasmi u guda galay howlaha shaqo ee horyaalla, kuwaas oo muhiim u ah dalka. Kalfadhigan oo doodo badan ay hareeyeen ayaa kusoo aaday, xilli ay taagan tahay xiisad u dhexeysa Villa Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka, taas oo ka dhalatay hannaanka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka oo ay isku hayaan labada dhinac. The post Jaamac oo guddoomiyay kulankii ugu horreeyay BF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo khodbad dhinacyo badan taabanaysa ka jeediyay magaalada Dhuusamareeb
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada Dhuusamareeb uga qeyb galay munaasabad lagu xusayay sanadguurada aas-aaska maamulka Galmudug, isagoo ka hadlay horumarka ay Soomaaliya iyo gaar ahaan Galmudug sameeyeen sannadihii u dambeeyay. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay si tartiib ah uga soo kabanayso dhibaatooyinkii muddada dheer dalka ka jiray, isla markaana ay jiraan horumarro muuqda oo laga sameeyay dhinacyada dowladnimada, amniga iyo dib-u-dhiska hay’adaha dowladda. Madaxweynaha ayaa si gaar ah u ammaanay shacabka Galmudug, isagoo sheegay in dadka ku nool deegaannada maamulkaasi ay muujiyeen isku-tashi iyo dadaal ay ku horumarinayaan deegaannadooda. Wuxuu tilmaamay in xaaladda Galmudug maanta ay si weyn uga duwan tahay sidii ay ahayd sannadihii hore, xilli ay gobolka ka jireen dowlad-darro iyo maamul la’aan muddo dheer soo jiitamaysay. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa xusay in markii uu hore u tagay deegaannada Galmudug ay jireen caqabado waaweyn oo dhinaca dowladnimada iyo amniga ah, balse maanta uu jiro isbeddel muuqda oo ka dhashay dadaallada dowladda iyo shacabka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay waddada horumarka ku jirto, iyadoo dib loo dhisayo hay’adaha dowladda, la xoojinayo amniga, isla markaana la ballaarinayo adeegyada iyo maamulka dowliga ah. Wuxuu sheegay in horumarka la gaaray uu yahay mid u baahan in si wadajir ah loo ilaaliyo, isagoo shacabka iyo dowladda ugu baaqay inay sii wadaan dadaallada lagu dhisayo Soomaaliya xasilloon oo awood u leh inay mas’uuliyadda amniga iyo horumarka dalka si buuxda u maamusho. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay xaaladda amniga, isagoo sheegay in cadowga ugu weyn ee Soomaaliya ay yihiin kooxaha Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish. Waxa uu xusay in kooxahaasi weli ay jiraan, balse ay si weyn u daciifeen marka loo eego sidii ay hore u ahaayeen, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay dagaal adag kula jiraan. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in dowladdu ay sii waddo dadaallada lagu ciribtirayo kooxaha hubeysan, isla markaana ciidamada ammaanka ay guulo ka gaareen howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in horumarka laga sameeyay amniga uu suurageliyay in munaasabado waaweyn lagu qabto deegaanno hore ay xaaladdooda amni adkayd. Wuxuu sheegay in dadka Soomaaliyeed ay hadda awood u leeyihiin inay si nabad ah ugu qabtaan munaasabadaha muhiimka ah magaalooyin iyo deegaanno kala duwan oo dalka ah, taasina ay muujinayso isbeddelka dhinaca amniga iyo dowladnimada. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa maalmahan socdaallo iyo kulamo ku marayay deegaanno ka tirsan Galmudug, isagoo sheegay in dowladda Federaalka ay doonayso inay gaarsiiso adeegyada dowladnimo iyo horumar magaalooyinka iyo deegaannada kale ee maamulkaasi.

items.title: Madaxweynaha Somaliya oo booqasho ku maraya Galmduug
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa booqasho ku maraya deegaanada Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Madaxweynaha ayaa booqashadiisa shalay galab ka bilaabay Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee Xarunta Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, halkaas oo si diiran ay ugu soo dhaweeyeen Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoorqoor), xubno ka mid ah Golihiisa Wasiiro, Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Galmudug qaarkood, masuuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa xalay Dhuusamareeb kaga qaybgalay xaflad lagu xusayay aasaaska Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Madaxweynuhu uu Dhuusamareeb uga sii gudbi doono deegaanka Xananbuure ee waqooyiga Gobolka Galgaduud, isla-markaana uu kaga qaybgeli doono munaasabad tababar loogu soo xirayo ciidamo muddooyinkii u dambeeyay uu tababar uga socday Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Xananbuure. “Safarka Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ee deegaanada Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug ayaa ku qotoma xoojinta dadaalada dowladda ee dhismaha iyo tayaynta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, iyada oo Madaxweynuhu uu ka qaybgeli doono munaasabad tababar lagu soo xirayo cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Villa Somalia. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa muddada uu ku sugan yahay Galmudug daahfuri doona mashaariic horumarineed oo laga hirgeliyay deegaanada Dowlad Goboleedka, kuwaasi oo qayb ka ah qorsheyaasha lagu dardargelinayo adeegyada dadweynaha iyo horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale kulamo la qaadan doona qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada Galmudug, oo uu dhageysan doona aragtidooda, baahiyahooda dowladnimo iyo talooyinkooda ku aaddan horumarka, amniga, dowlad-dhiska iyo mustaqbalka dalka.” Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa waxaa safarkiisa qayb ka ah booqasho la qorsheeyay in uu ku tago Magaalada Gaalkacyo ee Xarunta Gobolka Mudug, inkastoo Puntland ay ka digtay qorshaha safarkiisa Gaalkacyo. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa waxaa booqashadiisa Galmudug ku wehlinaya Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Axmed Macalin Fiqi, Taliyaha Ciidamada, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Taliska Taakuleynta ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Maxamed Maxamuud Xasan (Garabey), Xildhibaano ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Federaalka iyo masuuliyiin kale.
items.fullContent: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa booqasho ku maraya deegaanada Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Madaxweynaha ayaa booqashadiisa shalay galab ka bilaabay Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee Xarunta Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, halkaas oo si diiran ay ugu soo dhaweeyeen Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoorqoor), xubno ka mid ah Golihiisa Wasiiro, Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Galmudug qaarkood, masuuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa xalay Dhuusamareeb kaga qaybgalay xaflad lagu xusayay aasaaska Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Madaxweynuhu uu Dhuusamareeb uga sii gudbi doono deegaanka Xananbuure ee waqooyiga Gobolka Galgaduud, isla-markaana uu kaga qaybgeli doono munaasabad tababar loogu soo xirayo ciidamo muddooyinkii u dambeeyay uu tababar uga socday Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Xananbuure. “Safarka Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ee deegaanada Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug ayaa ku qotoma xoojinta dadaalada dowladda ee dhismaha iyo tayaynta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, iyada oo Madaxweynuhu uu ka qaybgeli doono munaasabad tababar lagu soo xirayo cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Villa Somalia. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa muddada uu ku sugan yahay Galmudug daahfuri doona mashaariic horumarineed oo laga hirgeliyay deegaanada Dowlad Goboleedka, kuwaasi oo qayb ka ah qorsheyaasha lagu dardargelinayo adeegyada dadweynaha iyo horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale kulamo la qaadan doona qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada Galmudug, oo uu dhageysan doona aragtidooda, baahiyahooda dowladnimo iyo talooyinkooda ku aaddan horumarka, amniga, dowlad-dhiska iyo mustaqbalka dalka.” Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa waxaa safarkiisa qayb ka ah booqasho la qorsheeyay in uu ku tago Magaalada Gaalkacyo ee Xarunta Gobolka Mudug, inkastoo Puntland ay ka digtay qorshaha safarkiisa Gaalkacyo. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa waxaa booqashadiisa Galmudug ku wehlinaya Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Axmed Macalin Fiqi, Taliyaha Ciidamada, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Taliska Taakuleynta ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Maxamed Maxamuud Xasan (Garabey), Xildhibaano ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Federaalka iyo masuuliyiin kale.

items.title: Trump oo sheegay inuu doonayo in Marinka Hormuz loogu dhawaaqo dhul Mareykanku leeyahay
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu qorsheynayo in Marinka Hormuz loogu dhawaaqo dhul ka tirsan Mareykanka, wuxuuna hadalkiisu noqday mid sii kordhin kara xiisadda u dhexeysa Washington iyo Tehran xilli dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay kula jiraan Iiraan uu weli socdo. Trump ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay New York xilli uu taageerayay musharraxiinta Xisbiga Jamhuuriga ee doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe ee Mareykanka ee 2026. “Markaan dhammeyno jabinta Iiraan, oo si xun loo jabinayo, dhawaan waxaan ku dhawaaqi doonaa Marinka Hormuz inuu yahay dhul Mareykan ah,” ayuu Trump sheegay. Marinka Hormuz oo ah marin istiraatiiji ah Marinka Hormuz waa mid ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan dunida ee gaadiidka badda, gaar ahaan dhoofinta shidaalka iyo gaaska dabiiciga ah. Ka hor inta uusan dagaalku bilaaban, marinku wuxuu ahaa marin muhiim u ah qayb weyn oo ka mid ah sahayda tamarta caalamka, balse xiisadda hadda ka taagan halkaas ayaa si toos ah u saameysay  suuqyada tamarta iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Iiraan ayaa xaddiday isu-socodka maraakiibta ee marinka, iyadoo ku doodaysa in qaybo ka mid ah biyahaas ay ku jiraan dhul-badeedkeeda ayna leedahay awood ay ku maamusho. Dhinaca kale, Mareykanka ayaa sameeyay xannibaad dhinaca badda ah, wuxuuna toddobaadkan rasaas ku furay markab xamuul ah oo uu ku eedeeyay inuu isku dayayay inuu gaaro dekedaha Iran. Hadalka Trump waxaa si degdeg ah uga falceliyay Kazem Gharibabadi, ku-xigeenka wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Iiraan u qaabilsan arrimaha sharciga iyo caalamiga. Gharibabadi ayaa sheegay in Marinka Hormuz aan lagu qabsan karin qoraal lagu daabaco baraha bulshada, diyaarad xambaarta diyaaradaha dagaalka, amar rasmi ah ama khudbad doorasho. Trump ayaa bishii hore soo jeediyay in Mareykanku noqon karo ilaaliyaha marinka Hormuz, iyadoo laga qaadayo lacag dhan 20 boqolkiiba badeecadaha halkaas mara.

items.title: Somalia: Gen. Jimale Takar rejoins Puntland forces in major blow to Mogadishu
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Gen. Jimale Takar, commander of the Somali National Army’s 54th Division, has rejoined Puntland’s security forces and agreed that Danab units under his command at the Ligle military camp in Garowe will no longer report to Somalia’s federal government in Mogadishu, officials and clan leaders told Somaliguardian on Saturday. The decision marks the latest – and potentially most consequential – in a series of setbacks for Mogadishu as Puntland moves to bring military and security forces operating within its territory under a single regional command. Takar’s decision to rejoin Puntland forces followed talks with clan leaders and intellectuals from the Nugal region, who persuaded him to relinquish his federal position as commander of the 54th Division and rejoin Puntland forces, according to officials and clan leaders familiar with the talks. Under the agreement, Puntland authorities will provide Takar and his forces with salaries and the support they require, while he will remain in command of the force Puntland authorities also agreed that politicians from Garowe who opposed the current regional administration and belong to the same clan as Takar would not be put on trial, despite earlier threats by the authorities, the officials and clan leaders said. Takar’s defection strikes at Mogadishu’s military foothold Gen. Jimale and the Danab forces under his command had been receiving salaries from the federal government for more than a year and had been registered through the government’s biometric army-registration system. His decision to abandon the federal command structure consequently represents a significant loss for Mogadishu, which has sought to establish a stronger foothold in Puntland and, ultimately, to weaken the influence of the region’s leadership and replace it with authorities more amenable to the federal government. The development is particularly significant because Takar’s forces had occupied a position at the intersection of Puntland’s regional security structure and Mogadishu’s federal military architecture. His return now gives Puntland another senior commander and contingent of troops that had been operating under federal authority. Other federal-aligned troops also return to Puntland Takar and his Danab forces are not the only federal-aligned troops to have shifted allegiance. Other troops stationed in Kuur Ilaalo town in Rako Raho district of the Karkaar region have also rejoined Puntland security forces, officials said on Friday. The troops had likewise been registered as federal government forces and had been reporting directly to Mogadishu. Their return forms part of a broader Puntland campaign to dismantle parallel chains of military command inside the regional administration’s territory. Puntland moves to consolidate one military command Puntland authorities have been working to bring all forces operating inside the region under a unified command while removing units that report directly to Mogadishu or remain formally registered as part of Somalia’s federal security apparatus. The Puntland administration says the campaign is necessary to prevent threats from Mogadishu aimed at undermining the region’s security and political authority. The policy has already produced a series of confrontations and military realignments. On August 5, Puntland forces seized the largest federal-aligned PSF (Puntland Security Force) base in Galkayo in a surprise dawn assault that began with mortar fire. The operation resulted in the seizure of weapons and the capture of dozens of soldiers, while some members of the force fled toward southern Galkayo. The takeover followed weeks of escalating tensions surrounding federal-aligned security forces in Puntland. Independent reporting has confirmed that Puntland forces seized a federal-aligned military compound in Galkayo after heavy fighting on August 5. In the days that followed, garrisons at several federal military bases in Bosaso and Armo also surrendered, according to the account provided by officials and clan leaders. The developments are part of a wider Puntland effort to consolidate control over security institutions. Recent analysis has likewise described Puntland as moving to consolidate its control following the Galkayo confrontation. Puntland warns against federal security presence Puntland authorities say the forces taken over during the campaign will be rehabilitated, trained and equipped before being incorporated into a unified command under the Puntland government. The administration has also said that forces registered as part of the Somali National Army or other federal government security agencies will not be allowed to maintain a presence in Puntland. Those who attempt to continue operating under direct federal authority, Puntland authorities have warned, will face consequences similar to those imposed on the PSF in Galkayo. The confrontation has already deepened the divide over whether federally registered forces can operate independently inside a federal member state. Mogadishu, for its part, has defended the federal military’s authority and the right of Somali citizens to serve in the national army. Somalia’s defence minister recently visited soldiers wounded in the August 5 Galkayo fighting and defended their integration into the Somali National Army. A wider Mogadishu – Puntland power struggle The latest military realignments come amid a longstanding political and security dispute between Puntland and Somalia’s federal government. Relations have deteriorated sharply as Puntland authorities have increasingly resisted what they regard as attempts by Mogadishu to extend direct control over security institutions and political affairs in the region. The latest confrontation also follows reports that Somalia’s federal leadership had been planning to oust Puntland’s leadership in a manner similar to the military operation that culminated in the removal of Southwest State President Abdiasis Laftagaren in March. Against that backdrop, Takar’s return to Puntland carries significance well beyond the movement of a single military commander. It removes a federally appointed commander from Mogadishu’s chain of command, brings his Danab forces back under Puntland authority and reinforces Garowe’s campaign to eliminate competing military command structures inside the region. For Puntland, the move strengthens its effort to place the region’s armed forces under one command. For Mogadishu, it represents another contraction of the federal government’s direct military reach in a region where it has long sought to establish a stronger foothold. And for Somalia’s already strained federal system, the dispute over who controls soldiers, bases and chains of command in Puntland has become an increasingly consequential test of the balance of power between the federal government and its member states. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: NISA oo dishay laba horjooge iyo ilaaladooda + Magacyada
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Hay’adda NISA ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa lagu faah-faahiyay howlgal qorsheysan oo maanta ka dhacay duleedka magaalada Jowhar ee caasimada Maamul Goboleedka HirShabelle. NISA ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in howlgalkan oo ay ka qayb-qaateen saaxibada caalamiga ah lagu dilay 9 xubnood oo ay ku jiraan laba horjooge oo ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta, kuwaas oo ku sugnaa deegaanka Warciise ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. “Ciidanka Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA), oo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamka, ayaa howlgal qorsheysan oo ka dhacay deegaanka Warciise, oo 25 KM u jira magaalada Jowhar ee Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, ku dilay sagaal dhagarqabe oo ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab, oo ay ku jireen laba horjooge,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale, Hay’adda ayaa shaacisay magacayada horjoogayaasha la dilay, waxayna kala yihiin Axmed Cali Jimcaale, oo ahaa horjoogihii Khawaarijta ugu magacawnaa degmada Jowhar iyo Geedi Maxamed Nuur Cadde oo isna ahaa horjoogihii kooxda ee deegaannada Dumaaye iyo Dabagaalo, sida lagu sheegay qoraalka. “Horjoogeyaasha howlgalka lagu dilay ayaa kala ahaa Axmed Cali Jimcaale, oo ahaa horjoogihii Khawaarijta ugu magacawnaa degmada Jowhar, iyo Geedi Maxamed Nuur Cadde, oo ahaa horjoogihii kooxda ee deegaannada Dumaaye iyo Dabagaalo. Labadan horjooge ayaa muddo lagu daba jiray xogtooda iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyadooda,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Howlgalka ayaa sidoo kale lagu dilay toddobo dhagarqabe oo ka tirsanaa maleeshiyaadka waxa ay ugu yeeraan xisbada ee deegaanka Warciise, kuwaas oo la socday horjoogeyaasha la beegsaday. Howlgalka ayaa u dhacay sidii loo qorsheeyay, waxaana Khawaarijta lagu gaarsiiyay jab culus”. Howlgalkan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee lagu wiiqayo awoodda kooxda Al-Shabaab, laguna burburinayo horjoogeyaashooda iyo shabakadaha ay u adeegsadaan abaabulka falalka argagixisada. Hay’adda Nabadsugidda Qaranka ayaa ugu dambeyn baaq u dirtay shacabka, waxayna ka codsatay inay soo war geliyaan khatar kasta oo amni oo ay la kulmaan, si looga hortago. “Fadlan muwaadin, wixii khatar amni ah ama macluumaad la xiriira Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish la wadaag NISA: 199 | 0770 747474 | 0620 545454,” ayaa lagu soo gabagabeeyay warsaxaafadeedka. Muddooyinkii u dambeeyay dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa kordhisay howlgallada lagu beegsanayo argagixisada, kadib markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu mar kale iclaamiyay dagaal ka dambeys ah oo lagu qaadayo kooxda Al-Shabaab. The post NISA oo dishay laba horjooge iyo ilaaladooda + Magacyada appeared first on Caasimada Online .
