items.title: Puntland oo ka digtay safarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee Gaalkacyo
items.description: Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland ayaa Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku eedeysay in uu colaad cusub ka hurinayo deegaanada Puntland. Madaxtooyada Puntland oo xalay warsaxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa sheegtay in Puntland ay si dhow ula socoto abaabulada qorsheysan bay tiri ee uu Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud wado. Puntland ayaa ka digtay qorshaha safar ay sheegtay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuuud uu ku imanayo koonfurta Magaalada Gaalkacyo, iyadoona sheegtay in uu uga gol leeyahay in uu colaad uga abuuro magaaladaasi, oo si nabad iyo xasilloonida ah ay ugu wada nool yihiin labada dhinac ee Puntland iyo Galmudug. Waxay sheegtay Puntland in ay heegan buuxa gelisay ciidamadeeda, waxayna dadka reer Puntland ku wargelisay in ay u diyaargaroobaan in maamulku uu qaadayo tallaabooyin dheeraad ah, oo lagu adkeynayo amniga Magaalada Gaalkacyo iyo deegaanada hoos yimaada. Warsaxaafadeedka Puntland Dowladda Puntland waxay si dhow ula socotaa abaabulada qorsheysan ee uu Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud wado, waxayna ka digeysaa qorshaha safarka Xasan Sheekh uu ku imaanayo koonfurta Gaalkacyo ee Dowladda Galmudug, taas oo uu uga gol leeyahay in uu fidno iyo colaad ka abuuro Magaalada Gaalkacyo oo si nabad iyo xasillooni leh ay ugu wada nool yihiin labada dhinac ee Puntland iyo Galmudug. Dowladda Puntland waxay maamulka iyo shacabka Dowladda Galmudug, gaar ahaan koonfurta Gaalkacyo uga mahadcelineysaa kaalinta weyn ee ay ka qaateen ilaalinta nabadda iyo ka hortagga isku dayadii qorsheysnaa ee Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku doonayay in uu qalalaase amni ka abuuro Magaalada Gaalkacyo, si uu uga dhigto foodsaar siyaasadeed, waxayna ugu baaqeysaa maamulka iyo shacabka Galmudug ee koonfurta Gaalkacyo in ay ka hortagaan isku dayada cusub ee Xasan Sheekh uu wado. Dowladda Puntland waxay heegan buuxa gelisay Ciidamada Difaaca Puntland, waxayna dadweynaha reer Puntland ku wargelineysaa in ay u diyaargaroobaan in dowladdu qaadeyso tillaabooyin dheeri ah oo lagu adkeynayo amniga guud ahaan Puntland, gaar ahaan amniga Magaalada Gaalkacyo iyo deegaanada hoos yimaada. Sidoo kale, Dowladda Puntland waxay la socodsiineysaa Ummadda Soomaaliyeed, dalalka deriska iyo guud ahaan Beesha Caalamka in Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu qaadayo masuuliyadda ka dhalata fidmada iyo colaadda uu ka abaabulayo Puntland.

items.title: Puntland Draws a Constitutional Red Line as Somalia’s Political Negotiations Remain Deadlocked
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — Puntland has issued one of its clearest statements yet on the conditions under which it would rejoin a fully agreed Somali federal system, insisting that the country cannot achieve lasting political stability without a constitution endorsed directly by the Somali people. Puntland Minister of Youth and Sports Caydiid Dirir said Puntland would continue to engage with the international community independently until Somalia has a government and political order based on broad national agreement. His remarks come as Somalia’s prolonged political negotiations between President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s Federal Government and opposition forces remain deadlocked after months of internationally supported talks. According to Minister Dirir, Puntland is not opposed to being part of a united Somali state. Rather, he said, Puntland’s position is that such a state must be built on a genuine political agreement and a permanent constitution approved directly by the Somali people. “Puntland is ready to be part of a Somali government that is based on agreement, provided that the country has a constitution that is not provisional and that has been directly approved by the Somali people,” Dirir said. The statement goes to the heart of Somalia’s current political crisis. Negotiations Stalled as Political Maneuvering Continues For months, international partners have attempted to mediate between President Hassan Sheikh’s administration and a broad coalition of opposition leaders over elections, constitutional arrangements, federal-state relations, and the future distribution of political power. Yet the negotiations have repeatedly failed to produce a comprehensive agreement. The central problem is no longer simply disagreement over the technical details of an electoral system. It is a much deeper dispute over who has the authority to determine Somalia’s political rules—and whether those rules can be changed without broad national consent. Critics of the Federal Government accuse President Hassan Sheikh of maintaining an uncompromising negotiating position while simultaneously pursuing a political strategy designed to strengthen his influence outside Mogadishu. They point to developments in several Federal Member States, where opponents allege that the administration has sought to influence regional political processes and install leaderships considered sympathetic to Villa Somalia. For these critics, the contradiction is striking: while international mediators continue trying to bring Somalia’s rival political camps around one negotiating table, political battles over the leadership of Federal Member States continue on the ground. The Federal Member State Question The controversy is particularly significant because Federal Member States are not merely administrative subdivisions. They are central components of Somalia’s federal political architecture. Puntland, Jubaland, South West State, Galmudug and Hirshabelle each possess their own political institutions and security structures, while sharing constitutional responsibilities with the Federal Government. The growing confrontation over regional leadership therefore has national consequences. Critics of President Hassan Sheikh argue that attempts to reshape political leadership in multiple states while negotiations remain unresolved risk undermining the very federal consensus that international mediators are attempting to build. They fear that if regional administrations become politically dependent on Mogadishu, Somalia’s federal system could gradually become centralized around the presidency. Supporters of the Federal Government reject that interpretation, arguing that strengthening national political institutions and encouraging democratic, party-based elections are necessary steps toward building a functioning Somali state. The dispute therefore goes far beyond personalities. It is fundamentally about the future balance between federal authority and regional autonomy. Puntland’s Constitutional Demand Puntland’s latest position reflects a longstanding argument that Somalia’s temporary constitutional arrangements cannot indefinitely serve as the foundation for a permanent political settlement. The demand for a constitution approved directly by the Somali people represents a significant constitutional red line. From Puntland’s perspective, the legitimacy of the country’s future political system must come from a process broad enough to include the Federal Government, Federal Member States, political opposition, traditional leaders, civil society and, ultimately, Somali citizens themselves. Without that consensus, Puntland argues, constitutional changes risk becoming instruments of political competition rather than foundations for stable governance. That position also explains why the current negotiations have become so difficult. The opposing camps are not simply negotiating over how to hold an election. They are negotiating over the rules under which Somalia itself will be governed. The danger is that prolonged negotiations may continue to run in parallel with political developments on the ground. If the Federal Government succeeds in strengthening its influence over several Federal Member States before a national agreement is reached, critics argue, the eventual political settlement could be shaped by a new balance of power rather than by genuine consensus. That could make an eventual agreement even more difficult. Somalia has experienced this cycle before: political competition produces mistrust; mistrust weakens cooperation between Mogadishu and the states; weakened cooperation creates security and political crises; and those crises make national consensus even harder to achieve. Meanwhile, the country faces serious security threats, economic pressures and an uncertain electoral timetable. Every additional month of political paralysis therefore carries a cost. The Choice Before Somalia Puntland’s message is ultimately a challenge to all sides. The Federal Government must decide whether it wants a federal system built around negotiated legitimacy or one increasingly defined by political dominance from the center. The opposition must demonstrate that its alternative is capable of producing functioning institutions rather than simply resisting the incumbent government. And the Federal Member States must determine how they can defend their constitutional powers while remaining part of a viable Somali federation. International partners can facilitate negotiations, provide technical assistance and encourage compromise. But they cannot manufacture the political agreement that Somalia’s leaders themselves have so far failed to reach. The fundamental question is therefore becoming increasingly unavoidable: Will Somalia’s political leaders negotiate a federal settlement broad enough to command national legitimacy—or will political maneuvering continue to deepen the divisions that have kept the country locked in crisis? Puntland’s latest statement suggests that, for now, it is unwilling to accept a political arrangement simply because it has been declared by Mogadishu. Its message is clear: Somalia can be one country, but its political future must be built on agreement, constitutional legitimacy and the consent of its people. Meanwhile, the country faces serious security threats, economic pressures and an uncertain electoral timetable. Every additional month of political paralysis therefore carries a cost. The Choice Before Somalia Puntland’s message is ultimately a challenge to all sides. The Federal Government must decide whether it wants a federal system built around negotiated legitimacy or one increasingly defined by political dominance from the center. The opposition must demonstrate that its alternative is capable of producing functioning institutions rather than simply resisting the incumbent government. And the Federal Member States must determine how they can defend their constitutional powers while remaining part of a viable Somali federation. International partners can facilitate negotiations, provide technical assistance and encourage compromise. But they cannot manufacture the political agreement that Somalia’s leaders themselves have so far failed to reach. The fundamental question is therefore becoming increasingly unavoidable: Will Somalia’s political leaders negotiate a federal settlement broad enough to command national legitimacy—or will political maneuvering continue to deepen the divisions that have kept the country locked in crisis? Puntland’s latest statement suggests that, for now, it is unwilling to accept a political arrangement simply because it has been declared by Mogadishu. Its message is clear: Somalia can be one country, but its political future must be built on agreement, constitutional legitimacy and the consent of its people. items.title: Hassan Sheikh Calls for Rule-Based Politics as Critics Ask Whether His Own Government Is Operating Outside the Rules
items.description: By Abdullahi A. Nor President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has called on Somalia to move beyond personality-driven politics and establish stronger institutions capable of clearly defining who makes national decisions, how those decisions are reached, and which institutions are accountable for implementing them. It is a message that sounds difficult to dispute. Yet coming from a presidency facing persistent accusations of constitutional overreach, political engineering and the concentration of power, it also raises an uncomfortable question: is the President describing the Somalia he wants—or the Somalia his critics say his government is helping to create? Speaking at an event focused on education, national institution-building and the development of Somalia’s human capital, Hassan Sheikh argued that the country cannot achieve sustainable progress while political decision-making remains dominated by individuals and political groups. He urged Somalis to “wake up” and build a political system capable of replacing personality-based politics with institutions governed by clearly defined rules. The President’s argument is that Somalia’s economic and social progress—from expanding commerce to improvements in education and public services—will remain limited unless the country’s political system becomes stable, predictable and institutionally grounded. The argument lands in a deeply polarized political environment. The president’s remarks are seen as nothing more than a performative political rhetoric and empty lip service—an approach to governance that the President has increasingly become accustomed to. The Contradiction at the Center of Somalia’s Crisis Opposition leaders have spent months making almost the opposite argument: that the central problem is not the absence of institutions, but the use of state institutions by the presidency to advance a political agenda. They accuse Hassan Sheikh’s administration of attempting to shape the electoral environment in its own favor, influencing the political leadership of Federal Member States, and pursuing constitutional and electoral changes without the broad consensus they believe Somalia’s federal system requires. These remain political realities, and the government rejects such characterizations. Nevertheless, they expose a striking contradiction at the heart of Somalia’s current crisis. The President says Somalia needs institutions strong enough to prevent individuals from determining the country’s political destiny. His opponents respond that the presidency itself has become too powerful, corrupt and that political institutions are increasingly being used to serve the interests of the incumbent administration. That dispute is particularly significant because Somalia’s political negotiations have remained stalled despite months of engagement between the Federal Government and opposition groups, with international actors attempting to broker an agreement over elections, constitutional arrangements and the country’s political future. While those negotiations continue, political developments in several Federal Member States, SWS, Galmudug, Hirshabeele, have proceeded rapidly, intensifying opposition suspicions that the government is attempting to reshape the political landscape before a national agreement is reached. An Election Designed by Those in Power? One of the most contentious accusations facing the administration concerns the electoral process. Opposition leaders argue that the Federal Government’s preferred model risks allowing the incumbent political establishment to influence the rules, institutions and conditions under which the next election will take place. They have repeatedly called for an electoral framework negotiated among the Federal Government, opposition, Federal Member States and other stakeholders rather than one effectively designed by the government itself. The administration maintains that direct elections and stronger political institutions are essential to ending Somalia’s long dependence on indirect, clan-based political arrangements. The disagreement is therefore not simply about whether Somalia should hold elections. It is about who writes the rules, who controls the institutions administering the process, and whether the political playing field can be considered genuinely neutral. That is the question that continues to haunt Somalia’s political transition. Public Land and the Politics of Accountability The debate also extends beyond elections. Opposition figures and civil society activists have accused this administration in Mogadishu of failing to adequately protect public land and have raised allegations concerning the transfer or sale of valuable government property to politically connected individuals and businesses. Some activists have made particularly disturbing claims involving the encroachment or redevelopment of burial grounds. Such fact requires no investigation or documentary evidence because the eviction of poor people and sale produced nearly living witnesses of 750,000 IDPs, is an established fact. But their persistence reflects a much broader concern over public assets, transparency and accountability in a country where state institutions remain fragile. For critics, the issue is straightforward: a government cannot credibly preach institutional accountability while citizens remain uncertain about how public assets are being allocated and who benefits from them. The specter of kleptocracy, nepotism and the president’s legacy The administration has also faced accusations of nepotism and patronage, with opponents arguing that political appointments and access to state resources have at all times favored individuals with close political, familial or clan connections. Again, the government rejects such accusations. But the broader principle raised by these allegations is important. Strong institutions are not measured by how frequently leaders speak about them. They are measured by whether public appointments, procurement, public land administration, financial management and political decision-making can withstand independent scrutiny. That is where Somalia’s institutional transformation remains unfinished. Hassan Sheikh Mohamud occupies a unique place in Somalia’s political history: he is the first Somali president to return to the presidency after previously serving as head of state. That alone will form an important part of his historical legacy. But history will judge more than the fact that he became the first president elected to two non-consecutive terms. It will also judge what happened to Somalia’s institutions during his tenure. Was the presidency used to strengthen federal institutions or to consolidate political influence? Did constitutional reform produce broader national consensus or deepen political division? Did electoral reform create genuine democratic competition or merely change the mechanism through which political power is distributed? And perhaps most importantly, did Somalia emerge from his presidency with stronger institutions than those he inherited? Those questions are enough to make him the worst president ever in Somalia’s political history. Security, Education and the State Hassan Sheikh also linked political stability to national security and education. Using the metaphor of a farmer preparing the soil before planting, he described security as the foundation upon which education, economic development, dignity and national prosperity must be built. He argued that Somalia’s greatest resource is not oil, minerals, buildings or military hardware but its people and the knowledge they possess. His reference to Japan was intended to illustrate the transformative power of investment in education, research and human capital. That message is difficult to challenge. Somalia desperately needs better schools, universities, skilled professionals, productive businesses and institutions capable of turning knowledge into economic opportunity. But education and security cannot flourish independently of political legitimacy. A university requires predictable institutions. Businesses require enforceable laws. Investors require confidence that contracts and property rights will be respected. Citizens require confidence that government power is constrained by law. President Hassan sold the grounds of the Somali National University including the labs, nursing school among other faculties the medical faculty grounds. In other words, the institutional system the President says Somalia needs is precisely the system his critics argue must first be protected from political interference. A Presidency at a Crossroads The most consequential question facing Hassan Sheikh may therefore be whether his government can reconcile its rhetoric about institutional governance with the political reality confronting the country. Somalia does need to move beyond personality politics. It does need stronger institutions. It does need a predictable constitutional order. It does need transparent elections, accountable government, secure public assets and an independent judiciary. But those principles cannot apply only to political opponents. They must apply equally to the government in power. If Hassan Sheikh succeeds in leaving behind stronger institutions, a credible constitutional settlement and an electoral system trusted by competing political forces, his second presidency could ultimately be remembered as a period of institutional transformation. If, however, political polarization deepens, constitutional disputes remain unresolved, federal relations deteriorate and patronage, corruption and political manipulation continue to dominate public discourse, history may record a very different legacy. The President says Somalia must become a country governed by institutions rather than individuals. That is precisely the standard by which his own presidency should now be measured. The ultimate test is not what the President says about the rule of law. It is whether Somalia’s institutions are strong enough to constrain the President himself. Abdullahi A. items.title: State Department Establishes Task Force to End Birth Tourism
items.description: State Department Establishes Task Force to End Birth Tourism Office of the Spokesperson August 12, 2026 Under President Trump and Secretary Rubio’s leadership, the Department of State is using all available tools to defend the integrity of U.S. citizenship, ensure nonimmigrant visas are used only for their lawful and intended purposes, and prevent their exploitation through birth tourism. As President Trump has made clear, citizenship is not a commodity to be acquired through the calculated exploitation of U.S. immigration laws. The Department of State is working closely with the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to combat birth tourism and protect the integrity of the U.S. immigration system. New Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force To maximize the success of this comprehensive effort, the State Department has established a Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force. The Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force reviews the activities of visa holders worldwide to identify instances of birth tourism, take action to revoke visas of those who engage in or facilitate it, and dismantle the networks that profit from this abuse. The Task Force addresses the abuse by analyzing and connecting information held across the Department and other federal agencies, including the DHS. Thanks to the coordination of the Task Force, the Department of State is addressing birth tourism on a global scale, examining travel histories of individuals from all around the world in order to end this exploitation and abuse. The Birth Tourism taskforce has taken action by revoking more than 600 visas from foreign nationals across the globe to safeguard our nation from this abuse. The Department generally revokes visas when there are indications of a potential ineligibility. The Secretary has broad discretionary authority to revoke visas – and the Trump Administration is committed to exercising that authority to protect the American people and the integrity of our immigration system. Birth Tourism Has Become a For-Profit Industry Facilitators have turned birth tourism into a lucrative, for-profit industry. These facilitators sometimes market themselves as doulas, midwives, or wellness advocates while openly advertising “birth in the U.S.” services, visa coaching, and hospital arrangements. Some forge medical documents or coach clients to conceal their true travel purpose and avoid paying hospital bills, with online marketing promising clients “automatic citizenship” and “a future without borders.” The facts are clear – birth tourism is a pervasive practice that involves nationals from countries spanning every region of the globe. The Department is taking action to dismantle these networks and hold all participants accountable. Birth Tourism Fraud The work of the Bureau of Consular Affairs Task Force and consular officers at U.S. embassies and consulates around the world is exposing widespread patterns of deception. Foreigners who willfully misrepresent the purpose of their travel or entry into the United States may be permanently ineligible for a U.S. visa or entry to the United States. The Department has uncovered patterns that illustrate the lengths some applicants will go to circumvent our laws in order to secure U.S. citizenship for their children – and potentially for themselves in the future. One couple used a conference and a vacation trip to go shopping as cover stories to give birth to two children in the United States, lying about their travel purpose in two separate visa applications. On the second occasion, the couple concealed that they had a child. The visas have been revoked. In another case, a foreign government official requested a visa to travel on behalf of her government for just one week, but instead stayed three months and gave birth in the United States before departing. The Department revoked the visa. Another traveler applied for a visa to go on vacation in Orlando and instead traveled to Los Angeles and gave birth five days after arrival. The Department revoked the visa. Citizenship is not a commodity to be acquired through calculated exploitation and evasion of the immigration laws. Foreign nationals who abuse the visa system, and those who help them do so, may lose their visa, their access, and their future in the United States. This is only the beginning.

items.title: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya oo ka Jawaabay Eedeymaha Hantidhowrka
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya ayaa ka jawaabay eedeymo ka soo baxay Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee Qaranka, kuwaas oo la xiriiray habraaca diblumaasiyiinta iyo shaqaalaha Wasaaradda loo diro dalalka dibadda. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in diblumaasiyiinta Soomaaliya u dirtay safaaradaha iyo qunsuliyadaha dalka ay yihiin shaqaale ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda, isagoo meesha ka saaray in dibadda loo diro dad aan hore uga tirsanaan Wasaaradda. Hadalkan ayaa yimid kaddib markii Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee Qaranka uu warbixin uu soo saaray ku sheegay in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ay dibadda u dirtay 14 diblumaasi oo aan marin dhammaan shuruudihii iyo habraacyadii looga baahnaa, halka 19 shaqaale ahna la sheegay in aysan qaadan tababarkii diblumaasiyadeed ee looga baahnaa ka hor inta aan loo dirin howlahooda. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in arrintan ay wadahadallo uga socdaan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud, si loo kala caddeeyo qodobada ay labada dhinac isku khilaafsan yihiin loona saxo wixii khaladaad ah ee jira. Warbixinta Hantidhowrka ayaa ku baaqday in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ay hagaajiso habraacyada shaqaaleysiinta, tababarka iyo dirista diblumaasiyiinta, iyadoo sidoo kale ka digtay khataraha ka dhalan kara haddii shaqaale loo diro hawlo diblumaasiyadeed iyaga oo aan helin diyaarintii iyo tababarkii loo baahnaa. Arrintan ayaa hadda noqotay dood ka dhex taagan hay’adaha dowladda, iyadoo la sugayo natiijada wadahadallada u dhexeeya Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee Qaranka iyo haddii ay kasoo baxaan wax tallaabooyin ama caddeyn dheeraad ah.

items.title: FARMAAJO oo si adag uga hadlay dhacdadii maanta
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo ayaa si kulul u cambaareeyay barakicinta iyo burburinta guryaha ka socda degmada Waaberi ee magaalada Muqdisho, isaga oo dowladda ku eedeeyay inay awood ciidan u adeegsatay dad ka cabanayay in laga saarayo dhulkooda. Farmaajo ayaa sheegay in tallaabooyinka maanta ka dhacay Waaberi ay meel ka dhac ku yihiin xuquuqda muwaadiniinta iyo waajibaadka dowladda ka saaran ilaalinta shacabka. “Barakicinta, dhul-boobka iyo adeegsiga awoodda ciidan ee ka dhanka ah bulshada ku dhaqan degmada Waaberi ee magaalada Muqdisho waa fal arxan darro ah oo ka soo horjeeda xuquuqda muwaadiniinta iyo waajibaadka hay’adaha dowladda,” ayuu yiri Farmaajo. Madaxweynihii hore ayaa sidoo kale weerar afka ah ku qaaday Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo uu ku tilmaamay “madaxweyne muddo-dhaaf ah”, wuxuuna ku eedeeyay in rasaas iyo xoog loo adeegsaday dad si nabad ah uga cabanayay burburinta hantidooda iyo barakicinta qoysaskooda. “Waa nasiib darro in Madaxweynaha muddo dhaafka ah oo caadeystay barakicinta dadka nugul ee caasimadda uu xabad iyo xoog u adeegsado muwaadiniinta sida nabadda ah u muujinayey cabashadooda,” ayuu yiri. Farmaajo wuxuu sheegay in dowladnimadu ay ku dhisan tahay ilaalinta “nafta, maalka iyo karaamada muwaadinka”, isaga oo ciidamada iyo hay’adaha ammaanka ugu baaqay inay dhowraan sharciga, ilaaliyaan shacabka, kana fogaadaan tallaabo kasta oo dhaawaceysa xuquuqda muwaadiniinta. Wasaaradda Howlaha Guud ayaa bishii May sheegtay in dowladda ay waddo qorshe dib-u-dejin loogu sameynayo ilaa 12,000 oo qoys oo ku nool dhul dowladeed, iyadoo la doonayo in qoysaska nugul loo raro deegaanno cusub. Howlaha dib ula wareegidda dhulka ayaa Muqdisho ka dhaliyay muran xooggan, iyadoo dadka laga raro goobaha qaar ay ka cabanayaan qaabka loo fuliyo, halka dowladda ay ku adkeysaneyso xaqa ay u leedahay inay dib ula wareegto hantida dadweynaha. Barakicinta ayaa tan iyo markaas qeyb ka noqotay khilaafka sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya dowladda iyo mucaaradka, iyadoo hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradku dowladda ku eedeeyaan dhul-boob iyo caburin, halka muranka doorashooyinka iyo muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha uu isna sii adkeeyay xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Muqdisho. items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo gaaray Dhuusamareeb (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa laba toddobaad ka dib ku laabtay Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee Xarunta Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo 27-kii bishii hore ee July gaaray Dhuusamareeb ayaa 29-kii bishaasi soo geba-gabeeyay booqashadii uu ku joogay Galmudug. Taliyaha ayaa gelinkii dambe ee maanta ka degay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Ugaas Nuur ee Dhuusamareeb, halkaas oo ay ku soo dhaweeyeen Saraakiil uu horkacayay Taliyaha Qaybta 21aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Korneyl Maxamed Cabdi Daahir (Maxamed Dhagaweyne). “Soo dhaweynta ka dib, Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa kulamo gaar-gaar ah la qaatay saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee ku sugan Magaalada Dhuusamareeb.” Ayaa lagu yiri war caawa ka soo baxay Taliska Militariga. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Kulamada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda iyo howlaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ee ka hawlgala deegaanada Galmudug.” Ma cadda ujeedka uu haatan Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka u tegay Galmudug, waxaase socda qorshe tababar loogu soo xirayo ciidamo muddooyinkii u dambeeyay uu tababar uga socday Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Xananbuure ee waqooyiga Gobolka Galgaduud. Ciidamadan oo boqolaal gaaraya ayaa lagu wadaa in ay ku biiraan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee ka hawlgala Gobolada Galgaduud iyo Mudug. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa waxaa suurtagal ah in uu u safro Dhuusamareeb, si uu tababarka ugu soo xiro ciidamadaasi, oo loo diyaariyay inay gacan ka gaystaan hawlgalka dib u xoreynta dalka.

items.title: Taiwanese residents to stay in contact with the Taiwanese office in Somaliland.
items.description: Taiwan calls on nationals to postpone trips to Uganda The Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Thursday called on Taiwanese travelers to postpone trips to Uganda following a new visa incident at the African country’s main airport. In early August, a Taiwanese resident had his passport confiscated at Entebbe International Airport, while a tourist was turned away after being refused entry. In a new incident Wednesday, a Taiwanese business traveler and his two relatives were told to show Chinese passports in order to have their Taiwanese passports returned, the ministry said in a statement. The three travelers were allowed to enter Uganda, but immigration officials told them the request was part of the country’s “one China policy.” The ministry said its representative office in Somaliland and the association of Taiwanese businesses in Uganda immediately provided assistance to the travelers. Even though the Ugandan government has not announced any changes to its visa policies for Taiwanese visitors, the ministry said travelers should evaluate the risks when planning a trip to the East African country. The ministry also advised Taiwanese residents to stay in contact with the Taiwanese office in Somaliland. Nearly 70 Taiwanese nationals reside in Uganda, while around 35 Taiwanese-invested companies operate in the country and create local jobs, the ministry said. Tourism from Taiwan has also been rising in recent years. The ministry called on the Ugandan government to respect Taiwan’s sovereignty and refrain from imposing unreasonable entry restrictions. Taiwan News

items.title: Jaamac oo guddoomiyey kulan maanta lagu ansixiyay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaamnta shir guddoomiyay kulanka Guddiga Joogtada ah ee Golaha Shacabka BFS, kaasi oo ka dhacay xarunta guddoonka iyo guddiyada ee Villa Hargeysa. Guddoomiye Jaamac oo uu wehliyo guddoomiye ku-xigeenka 2-aad ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow ayaa warbixinno ka dhageystay Guddiga Joogtada ah, gaar ahaan shuruucda ay gacanta ku hayaan iyo marxaladaha kala duwan ee ay marayaan. Kulanka ayaa si qoto dheer looga dooday dardar-gelinta howlaha sharci-dejinta iyo sidii loo wajihi lahaa howlaha muhiimka ah ee golaha horyaalla inta lagu guda jiro Kalfadhiga 8-aad. Intaas kaddib, xubnaha Guddiga Joogtada ah ayaa ka arrinsaday oo dejiyey ajandayaasha kulamada guud ee Golaha Shacabka ee toddobaadka soo socda, waxayna si wadajir ah u ansixiyeen ajandayaasha kulamada golaha ee todobaadka soo socda. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo kulanka soo xiray ayaa uga mahadceliyey xubnaha Guddiga Joogtada ah doorkooda wax-ku-oolka ah ee ku aadan dejinta ajandayaasha kulamada golaha ee toddobaadka soo socda iyo dardar-gelinta guud ahaan howlaha muhiimka ah ee Golaha horyaalla Kalfadhiga 8-aad. Guddoomiyuhu wuxuu sidoo kale ku boorriyey Guddiyada Golaha inay sii wadaan shaqada muhiimka ah ee loo igmaday, si loo xaqiijiyo in howlaha sharci-dejinta iyo kormeerka golaha ay u socdaan si hufan oo waafaqsan waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee Golaha Shacabka. Si kastaba, Jaamac ayaa markii uu la wareegay xilka guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ballan-qaaday inuu golaha ku hoggaamin doono si caddaalad, hufnaan iyo wadajir ku dhisan, isagoo xusay in mudnaanta koowaad la siin doono xoojinta shaqada sharci-dejinta, ilaalinta doorka dastuuriga ah ee golaha iyo ka shaqeynta danta guud. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Golaha Shacabka uu si wadajir ah uga shaqeyn doono xaqiijinta yoolalka iyo himilooyinka uu hiigsanayo golaha, isagoo ku boorriyey dhammaan xildhibaannada inay si wadajir ah uga qeyb qaataan gudashada waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee loo igmaday. items.title: Omar Artan Makes History as First Non-European Referee to Officiate UEFA Super Cup
items.description: Salzburg, Austria (WDN) — Somali referee Omar Abdulkadir Artan has etched his name into European football history after taking charge of the 2026 UEFA Super Cup between Paris Saint-Germain and Aston Villa at Stadion Salzburg on Wednesday night. The landmark appointment made Artan the first non-European referee to officiate the UEFA Super Cup, placing a Somali official at the center of one of European football’s most prestigious fixtures. The match brought together Paris Saint-Germain, the 2025/26 UEFA Champions League winners, and Aston Villa, the 2025/26 UEFA Europa League champions. PSG ultimately prevailed 2–1 to retain the Super Cup title. For Somalia, however, the significance extended far beyond the final score. A Historic Night for Somalia and Africa Artan’s appointment marked an extraordinary breakthrough for African refereeing. UEFA selected the 34-year-old Somali official following consultations with the Confederation of African Football (CAF), highlighting the growing cooperation between the two continental governing bodies. Artan was joined by two African assistant referees: Liban Abdoulrazack Ahmed of Djibouti and Stephen Eleazar Onyango Yiembe of Kenya. Slovenian referee Rade Obrenovič served as fourth official, while Italy’s Marco Di Bello was the Video Assistant Referee (VAR), with Spain’s Guillermo Cuadra Fernández serving as assistant VAR. The all-African core of the on-field officiating team represented a striking demonstration of how football can transcend geographical boundaries and create opportunities beyond the traditional centers of the sport. From FIFA Setback to European Glory The significance of Artan’s achievement was magnified by what happened only weeks earlier. The Somali referee had been selected for the 2026 FIFA World Cup but was unable to participate after being denied entry to the United States while traveling for the tournament. Reports surrounding the incident cited U.S. authorities’ concerns arising from background screening, including alleged associations with suspected members of terrorist organizations. Those allegations were not independently established, and Artan was ultimately unable to take part in the World Cup. Instead of ending his World Cup dream, however, the setback was followed by one of the most remarkable appointments of his career. UEFA announced in June that Artan would referee the Super Cup, explicitly describing him as one of Africa’s leading referees. UEFA President Aleksander Čeferin said football brings people together and emphasized UEFA’s respect for Artan and his refereeing achievements. The appointment transformed a major disappointment into an extraordinary professional opportunity. Artan has been on the FIFA international refereeing list since 2018 and has steadily established himself among Africa’s most prominent officials. His career reached another major milestone in 2025 when he was named CAF Men’s Referee of the Year, recognition that confirmed his status among the continent’s elite referees. UEFA also noted his experience officiating major CAF competitions, including the 2025/26 CAF Champions League final. His selection for the UEFA Super Cup therefore represents not simply a symbolic gesture but recognition of a referee whose career has reached the highest levels of international football. A Moment of Pride for Somalia Artan’s achievement carries particular significance for Somalia, a country whose name is rarely associated with the biggest stages of European football. For decades, Somalia’s international sporting profile has been overshadowed by political instability, conflict and limited sporting infrastructure. Artan’s rise offers a dramatically different image: a Somali professional trusted to control a match involving two of Europe’s most prominent clubs. His performance in Salzburg was closely followed by Somali supporters at home and across the diaspora. The symbolism was impossible to miss. A Somali referee stood at the center of a European final, surrounded by some of the world’s most famous players and watched by millions of football fans. The match itself produced an entertaining contest. PSG took the lead through Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, before Aston Villa equalized through 17-year-old Brian Madjo, who became the youngest scorer in UEFA Super Cup history. PSG eventually regained the lead through Désiré Doué, whose goal was confirmed following a VAR review. PSG’s 2–1 victory made the French champions back-to-back UEFA Super Cup winners, joining an exclusive group of clubs to achieve consecutive victories in the competition. Yet for many Somali viewers, the most memorable figure of the night was not wearing either club’s shirt. He was wearing the referee’s uniform. Beyond One Match Artan’s achievement represents more than an individual career milestone. It demonstrates the possibilities that can emerge when African sporting institutions and European football authorities cooperate to create pathways for talent from outside the traditional football power centers. His appointment was made possible through the growing cooperation between UEFA and CAF, and it could help establish a precedent for greater African representation in major European competitions. For young Somali athletes and officials, the message is equally powerful: the highest levels of international sport are not necessarily beyond reach. Artan’s journey—from FIFA World Cup selection, through a deeply controversial setback, to the center of the UEFA Super Cup—has become an extraordinary story of resilience. On Wednesday night in Salzburg, Omar Abdulkadir Artan did not merely officiate a football match. He made history. And in doing so, he gave Somalia a rare and powerful moment of sporting pride on one of the world’s biggest stages. items.title: Guddiga Xuquuqul Insaanka iyo UNDP oo ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaranka (GMXIQ), Dr. Maryan Qasim, ayaa maanta Muqdisho kulan kula qaadatay Wakiilka cusub ee UNDP Soomaaliya, Christophoros Politis, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga u dhexeeya Guddiga iyo Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay ee Horumarinta (UNDP). Kulanka ayaa si gaar ah loogu hadlay sidii loo kobcin lahaa awoodda Guddiga, loona xoojin lahaa dadaallada lagu ilaalinayo laguna horumarinayo xuquuqul insaanka Soomaaliya. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay muhiimadda ay leedahay isku-duwidda iyo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha kala duwan ee ka shaqeeya ilaalinta xuquuqda aadanaha, iyo sidii loo abuuri lahaa barnaamijyo wadajir ah oo bulshada Soomaaliyeed wax looga qabanayo. Kulanka waxaa ka qaybgalay Agaasimaha Guud ee Guddiga, Mustafa Axmed Maxamuud, iyo Madaxa Barnaamijyada Dowlad-wanaagga UNDP, Evariste Sibomana. Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaranka uu ku xoojinayo hawlihiisa, iskaashiga uu la leeyahay hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo gudashada waajibaadkiisa qaran ee la xiriira ilaalinta iyo horumarinta xuquuqul insaanka dalka.

items.title: Xilliga la shaacinayo Natiijada Imtixaanka Dugsiga Sare ee Qaranka oo lagu dhawaaqay
items.description: Muqdisho, 13 Agoosto 2026 — Natiijada Imtixaanka Shahaadiga ah ee Dugsiga Sare ee Qaranka ayaa la filayaa in la shaaciyo Sabtida, 15-ka Agoosto 2026, iyadoo kumannaan arday iyo waalidiin ah ay si weyn u sugayaan natiijada imtixaanka. Shaacinta natiijada ayaa noqon doonta marxalad muhiim ah oo soo afjareysa sugitaanka ardayda sanadkan u fariisatay Imtixaanka Qaranka ee Dugsiga Sare, kuwaas oo natiijadoodu go’aamin doonto in ay u gudbaan heerka jaamacadaha iyo waxbarashada sare. Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ayaa mas’uul ka ah qiimeynta iyo imtixaanaadka shahaadiga ah ee dugsiyada dalka, iyadoo sharciga waxbarashada uu dhigayo in ardayda dhammeysa dugsiga sare ay u fariistaan imtixaanka shahaadiga ah ee dowladda. Ardayda, waalidiinta iyo macallimiinta ayaa si gaar ah isha ugu haya natiijada, iyadoo ay jiri doonto farxad iyo dabaaldegyo ay sameeyaan ardayda ku guuleysata dhibcaha sare, halka kuwa aan natiijada ay filayeen helin ay heli doonaan fursad ay dib ugu qiimeeyaan tallaabada xigta ee waxbarashadooda. Sidoo kale, natiijada sanadkan ayaa la filayaa inay muujiso heerka waxqabadka ardayda iyo guud ahaan xaaladda waxbarashada dugsiyada sare ee dalka. Sabtida, 15-ka Agoosto 2026, ayaa sidaas darteed noqon doonta maalin ay si weyn u sugayaan ardayda iyo qoysaskooda.

items.title: Ilhan Omar’s Primary Win: A Path to a Fifth House Term in the U.S. Congress
items.description: Minneapolis (WDN)- U.S. Representative Ilhan Omar has won the Democratic primary for Minnesota’s 5th Congressional District, securing the party’s nomination and clearing a major hurdle on her path toward seeking a fifth term in the U.S. House of Representatives. lhan is one of President Trump’s most outspoken critics, consistently pushing back against his attacks on her Somali heritage and immigrant background. She has become a prominent defender of her roots, confronting Trump whenever he uses his public platform to target her, Somalia, or the broader Somali-American community. Ilham secured more than 80 percent of the vote in a decisive victory over her Democratic challengers. The victory reinforces Omar’s position in a heavily Democratic district centered on Minneapolis, where she has built a strong political base since first entering Congress in 2019. With more than 95 percent of ballots counted, unofficial results showed Omar with 122,640 votes, followed by Julie Trang Le with 10,201 and Latonya T. Reeves with 9,131. Other candidates included Abena McKenzie and Nate Schluter. Omar’s victory was particularly significant given that primary elections in heavily Democratic districts often determine the eventual representative. Minnesota’s 5th District is strongly Democratic and encompasses Minneapolis and surrounding communities. A Dominant Primary Victory Omar, a fourth-term Democrat and prominent progressive voice in Congress, defeated a field that included Le, a former federal prosecutor, and Reeves, a labor and political activist. The scale of the victory left little doubt about Omar’s continued strength among Democratic voters in the district. Her performance also strengthens her position within the progressive wing of the Democratic Party, where she remains one of the most recognizable members of the group known as “The Squad.” The nomination puts Omar in position to seek another term in the November general election. On the Republican side, John Nagel won the party’s primary with approximately 52.1 percent of the vote. If the results are formally certified, Nagel is expected to face Omar in the November general election. The November contest will therefore provide another national political test for Omar, whose career has attracted considerable attention both inside Minnesota and across the United States. Yet the political landscape of the 5th District remains strongly favorable to Democrats. Omar won reelection in 2024 with roughly 74 percent of the general-election vote, underscoring the challenge facing any Republican seeking to unseat her. Omar’s latest primary victory marks another important chapter in a political career that has made her one of the most prominent Somali-American figures in U.S. politics. If she wins in November, Omar would begin a fifth term in Congress, further cementing her place in Minnesota’s political history and extending the influence of one of the most prominent progressive voices in the Democratic Party. For now, the primary result represents a clear message from Democratic voters in Minnesota’s 5th District: Ilhan Omar remains their preferred candidate. The next test comes in November. items.title: Puntland Political Council Calls for Urgent Peaceful Resolution to Kodmo Tensions
items.description: Garowe (WDN ) — The Puntland Council of Politicians and Intellectuals, composed of 26 members, has called for an immediate and peaceful resolution to tensions in Kodmo, in Rako-Raaxo District of Karkaar Region, warning that renewed armed confrontation could have serious consequences for Puntland’s security and stability. In a statement, the council urged the Puntland administration to prioritize dialogue and consult directly with traditional elders and community leaders in the affected area, emphasizing that a negotiated settlement would be preferable to armed confrontation. The council warned that renewed violence could not only put civilian lives at risk but also deepen internal divisions at a particularly sensitive time for Puntland. Warning Against a New Security Crisis The council cautioned that internal conflict could create opportunities for militant groups still operating in the Cal Miskaad mountains, allowing them to exploit political and security divisions within Puntland. The warning comes amid continuing security challenges in parts of the region, where authorities have been seeking to consolidate state control and prevent the emergence of competing armed formations. The council stressed that any security measures, including disarmament initiatives, must be based on broad social consensus rather than unilateral action. “Any disarmament process requires a social agreement, inclusive consultation, and clear laws to guide its implementation,” the council said. It argued that sustainable security cannot be achieved through force alone and that community confidence and cooperation are essential to maintaining long-term stability. Appeal to Puntland’s Leaders and Society The council called on Puntland’s traditional elders, religious scholars, business leaders, politicians, and wider civil society to play an active role in preventing further escalation. It urged all sides to place the interests of Puntland’s peace, unity, and statehood above political or factional considerations. The statement reflects growing concern that localized disputes could develop into broader confrontations if they are not addressed through dialogue and community-based mediation. For Puntland, the immediate challenge is therefore not simply resolving the dispute in Kodmo, but ensuring that the crisis does not become another source of instability in a region already facing significant security pressures. The council’s appeal ultimately centers on a simple warning: Puntland cannot afford to allow internal divisions to weaken its security institutions or create openings for armed extremist groups. A negotiated settlement supported by traditional leaders, community participation, and a clear legal framework may offer the most sustainable path toward preventing further bloodshed and preserving Puntland’s hard-won stability. items.title: Somali power play or genuine development effort for Somaliland?
Qarax ka dhacay Dekedda Rotterdam iyo booliska oo ka hadlay
items.description: Qarax ayaa Khamiistan ka dhacay Dekedda Rotterdam, iyadoo hal qof uu ku dhintay, dhowr kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen, sida ay sheegeen Booliska Netherlands. Boolisku waxay sheegeen in qaraxu uu ka dhacay dekedda, isla-markaana la xiray goobta, si loo ogaado waxa sababay qaraxa. Qoraal ay soo dhigeen baraha bulshada ayay ku sheegeen in qaraxu uu u muuqdo mid ka dhashay shil shaqo xilligan, iyagoon faahfaahin dheeraad ah bixin. Shil shaqo ayaa waxaa loola jeedaa ama uu ka dhigan yahay in dhacdadu aanay ahayn mid si ula kac ah loo gaystay ama weerar la soo abaabulay, balse ay tahay shil ku yimid khalad farsamo, inta lagu guda jiray howl maalmeedka shaqada. Afhayeenka Booliska Rotterdam, Daan Valkenburg ayaa mar dambe sheegay inaanan weli la gaarin wax gunaanad rasmi ah oo ku aaddan natiijada dhacdada, isla-markaana aan meesha laga saari karin dhammaan ku-tala-galada suurtagalka ah. Baareyaasha ayaan weli aqoon sababta dhabta ah ee ka dambeysa qaraxa, baaritaankuna uu weli socdo. Dekedda Rotterdam (Port of Rotterdam) oo ku taala Galbeedka Netherlands ayaa ah dekedda ugu mashquulka badan, uguna weyn Yurub.

items.title: Puntland: Waqooyi Bari waxay maxaabiista Somaliland ka dhigatay ‘mashiinka lacagta’
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Puntland ayaa walaac xooggan ka muujisay xaaladda maxaabiista ciidamada maamulka Somaliland ee ku xiran magaalada Laascaanood, iyadoo ku eedeysay maamulka Waqooyi Bari inuu maxaabiista u adeegsado dano siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale. Wasiirka Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha Puntland, Maxamuud Caydiid Dirir ayaa sheegay in maxaabiista laga helo dhaqaale, isagoo su’aal geliyay habka loo maareeyo lacagaha loogu tala-galay daryeelkooda. “Maxaabiista waa sac caano badan. Waa la maalayaa. Red Cross (Bisha Cas) ayaa halkii askari maalintii looga qaataa sagaal dollar. Dhowr boqol oo kun ayaa bishii maamulka ku qaataa maxaabiista, oo ay u dheer tahay dawadooda. Nimanka Magafe ahaan ayaa loo haystaa ee siyaasad looma haysto,” ayuu yiri Caydiid. Wasiirka ayaa ku eedeeyay maamulka Waqooyi Bari in halkii maxaabiista loo mari lahaa hannaan sharci ah, loo adeegsanayo dano dhaqaale, isagoo ku baaqay in si cad loo baaro dambiyada loo haysto maxbuus kasta. Caydiid ayaa si gaar ah u xusay dhacdooyinkii dilalka iyo tacaddiyada ee la xiriiray dagaalladii Laascaanood, isagoo sheegay in haddii maxaabiista loo haysto dambiyo ay tahay in loo maro hannaan caddaaladeed oo cad, laguna saleeyo eedeymo iyo xog rasmi ah. “Haddii maxaabiista la maxkamadeynayo waa in lagu maxkamadeeyo dambiyadii ay galeen oo runta la sheego,” ayuu yiri wasiir Caydiid, isagoo ku baaqay in la caddeeyo dambiyada loo haysto maxbuus kasta. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in qaar ka mid ah maxaabiista ay u baahan yihiin daryeel caafimaad, gaar ahaan kuwa qaba dhaawacyada iyo xanuunnada kale, wuxuuna ku baaqay in si gaar ah loo qiimeeyo xaaladdooda caafimaad. Maamulka Waqooyi Bari ayaa gacanta ku haya boqolaal maxaabiis ah oo ka tirsan ciidamada Somaliland, kuwaas oo lagu qabtay dagaalkii Laascaanood ee 25-kii Agoosto 2023, xilligaas oo ciidamada Somaliland laga saaray saldhigga Goojacadde kaddib dagaallo muddo bilo ah ka socday magaalada. Dagaalka Laascaanood ayaa sababay khasaarooyin kala duwan, waxaana kadib dagaallada soo noq-noqday ay xaaladdu isu beddeshay in maamulka Waqooyi Bari uu gacanta ku dhigo ciidamo iyo saraakiil ka tirsan Somaliland. Waqooyi Bari ayaa hore u sheegay in sii deynta ama is-weydaarsiga maxaabiista uu ku imaan karo heshiis siyaasadeed iyo nabadeed oo dhexmara dhinacyada, isagoo sidoo kale dalbaday in Somaliland ay ka tanaasusho sheegashada ay ku leedahay gobolka Sool, taas oo si adag u diidan tahay Hargeysa. The post Puntland: Waqooyi Bari waxay maxaabiista Somaliland ka dhigatay ‘mashiinka lacagta’ appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Haybad Qaran oo Burbur Qarka u Saaran
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Isbahaysiga siyaasadeed ee Haybad Qaran ayaa wajahaya xaalad siyaasadeed oo adag, kaddib markii ay isaga baxeen siyaasiyiin miisaan leh oo kamid ahaa xubnihiisa. Wasiirkii hore ee Amniga Soomaaliya Maxamed Abuukar Isloow Ducaale iyo Wasiir Ku-xigeenkii hore ee Gaadiidka iyo Badda Cusmaan Maxamed Cabdi (Daallo) ayaa ka baxay isbahaysiga Haybad Qaran, waxaana ay ku biireen Xisbiga Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP). Cusmaan Daallo ayaa la filayaa inuu qaato kursigii uu baneeyay Wasiir Ku-xigeenkii Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, Maxamuud Cabdullaahi Abuukaate, oo maanta xilka iyo kursiga ka baxay. Ka bixitaanka Isloow Ducaale, oo ah siyaasi iyo ganacsade caan ah, ayaa loo arkaa khasaare siyaasadeed oo weyn oo soo gaaray isbahaysiga Haybad Qaran, iyadoo tallaabadan ay saameyn ku yeelan karto isku-duubnida iyo mustaqbalka isbahaysiga. The post Haybad Qaran oo Burbur Qarka u Saaran appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: New Gedo Power Shift as SNA Commander Returns to Beled Hawo
items.description: BELED HAWO— The commander of the Somali National Army’s 43rd Division, Colonel Osman Haji, arrived in the border town of Beled Hawo on Thursday after spending several months in Mogadishu. Colonel Haji landed at the airstrip inside the UK military training facility in Beled Hawo, according to local sources. His arrival is understood to be part of a new Federal Government plan aimed at strengthening the presence of Somali National Army forces in the Gedo region. Sources say recent talks between the Somali National Army leadership and Abdirashid Janan resulted in an understanding that would allow the Federal Government to deploy additional military officers and troops to Beled Hawo. The development signals renewed efforts by the Federal Government to expand and consolidate its security presence in Gedo, a strategically important region bordering Kenya and Ethiopia. The post New Gedo Power Shift as SNA Commander Returns to Beled Hawo appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Xasan Sheekh iyo Guudlaawe oo Kulmay, Heshiisna La Filayo
items.description: Hirshabeelle (Raxanreeb Online): Kulankii Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Madaxweynaha Hirshabeelle Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe) ayaa soo idlaaday, iyadoo la sheegay in dib la isugu soo laaban doono marka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu kasoo laabto Dhuusamareeb. Warar ku dhow kulanka ayaa sheegaya in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu faray wasiirro iyo siyaasiyiin horey uga soo horjeeday Cali Guudlaawe inay la heshiiyaan Madaxweynaha Hirshabeelle. Sida xogaha lagu helayo, Cali Balcad ayaa kamid noqday siyaasiyiinta Madaxweynaha xiriirka la leh ee la sheegay inay heshiis la gaareen Cali Guudlaawe. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee Cali Guudlaawe iyo inuu weli haysto fursad uu ku sii wadan karo xilka Madaxweynaha Hirshabeelle. Ilaa hadda ma jiraan warar madax-bannaan oo xaqiijinaya ama beeninaya xogtan, balse wararka la helayo ayaa muujinaya in rajada Cali Guudlaawe ee sii joogista xilka ay soo xoogeysaneyso. items.description: 𝗪𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗤𝗼𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗮𝘆𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝗼𝗼 𝗛𝗮𝘆’𝗮𝗱𝗮𝗵𝗮 𝗔𝗮𝗻 𝗗𝗮𝘄𝗹𝗶𝗴𝗮 𝗮𝗵 𝗨 𝗦𝗼𝗼 𝗕𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗵𝗶𝗴𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗤𝗮𝗯𝘆𝗼-𝗾𝗼𝗿𝗮𝗮𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗦𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗤𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗸𝗮 𝗲𝗲 𝗗𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗴𝗮𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗤𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗺𝗮𝘆𝗻𝘁𝗮 Wasaaradda Qorshaynta iyo Horumarinta Qaranka ayaa maanta hay’adaha aan dawliga ahayn ee kala duwan, oo ay ka mid yihiin hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay, hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo hay’adaha maxalliga ah, u soo bandhigtay qabyo-qoraalka Siyaasadda Qaranka ee Dabagalka iyo Qiimaynta, si ay hay’adahaasi uga qaybqaataan dib-u-eegista, talo-bixinta iyo dhamaystirka siyaasadda. Kulanka wadatashiga ah oo lagu qabtay Magaalada Hargeysa, ayaa si rasmi ah u daah-furay 𝗔𝗴𝗮𝗮𝘀𝗶𝗺𝗮𝗵𝗮 𝗪𝗮𝗮𝘅𝗱𝗮 𝗗𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗴𝗮𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗤𝗶𝗶𝗺𝗮𝘆𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝗲𝗲 𝗪𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗤𝗼𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗮𝘆𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗛𝗼𝗿𝘂𝗺𝗮𝗿𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝗤𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗸𝗮, 𝗠𝘂𝗱𝗮𝗻𝗲 𝗖𝗮𝗯𝗱𝗶𝗿𝗮𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗶𝗱 𝗚𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗶, waxaana ka qaybgalay masuuliyiin iyo wakiillo ka socday hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay, hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo hay’adaha maxalliga ah. Ujeeddada kulanka ayaa ahayd in hay’adaha aan dawliga ahayn lala wadaago qabyo-qoraalka Siyaasadda Qaranka ee Dabagalka iyo Qiimaynta, lana siiyo fursad ay kaga qaybqaataan geeddi-socodka diyaarinta siyaasadda, iyagoo soo jeedinaya talooyin, aragtiyo iyo talo-bixinno lagu horumarinayo qabyo-qoraalka. Intii uu kulanku socday, waxaa ka qaybgalayaasha loo soo bandhigay qodobbada muhiimka ah ee qabyo-qoraalka Siyaasadda Qaranka ee Dabagalka iyo Qiimaynta, iyadoo sidoo kale la qabtay dood-wadaagyo ay hay’adaha ka qaybgalay kaga dhiibteen aragtiyahooda, talooyinkooda iyo khibradahooda ku aaddan nidaamka dabagalka iyo qiimaynta mashaariicda iyo barnaamijyada horumarineed. Wadatashigan ayaa qayb muhiim ah ka ah geeddi-socodka diyaarinta Siyaasadda Qaranka ee Dabagalka iyo Qiimaynta, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in la helo siyaasad loo dhan yahay oo ka tarjumaysa baahiyaha iyo waayo-aragnimada dhinacyada kala duwan ee ku hawlan horumarinta dalka. Siyaasaddan oo ah mid heer qaran ah ayaa xoojinaysa nidaamka dabagalka iyo qiimaynta mashaariicda iyo barnaamijyada horumarineed ee laga maalgeliyo deeqaha iyo miisaaniyadda qaranka, waxayna gacan ka geysanaysaa kor u qaadista isla-xisaabtanka, hufnaanta iyo waxtarka mashaariicda horumarineed. Sidoo kale, Siyaasadda Qaranka ee Dabagalka iyo Qiimayntu waxay muhiim u tahay in la helo xog iyo caddayn la isku halayn karo oo lagu salayn karo go’aannada, qorshayaasha iyo siyaasadaha horumarineed ee dalka, iyadoo la xoojinayo wada-shaqaynta iyo isku-duwidda hay’adaha dawladda iyo hay’adaha aan dawliga ahayn ee ka shaqeeya horumarinta Somaliland.

items.title: Mid ka mid ah golaha wasiirrada DF oo is casilay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiir ku-xigeenkii Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Xukuumadda Soomaaliya, Xildhibaan Maxamuud Cabdullaahi Axmed (Abuukaate), ayaa si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqay inuu iska casilay xilkii uu ka hayay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, kadib qoraal uu soo saaray. Wasiir ku xigeenka ayaa warqad uu soo saaray oo ku taariikheysan maanta oo ah 13 August 2026 ku caddeeyay inuu iska casilay xilkii Wasiir ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, balse ma shaacin sababta rasmiga ah ee ka dambeysa is casilaaddiisa. “Waxaan si rasmi ah isaga casilay xilka Wasiir ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha ee XFS,” ayaa ku yiri warqadda uu soo saaray Abuukaate. Sidoo kale wuxuu uga mahadceliyay madaxda dowladda fursadda ay u siiyeen inuu ka mid noqdo xukuumadda Dan-Qaran isaga oo xusay inuu fursaddaas u arkayay mid uu ugu adeego guud ahaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed. “Waxaan u mahadcelinayaa madaxda dalka fursadda ay ii siiyeen inaan ugu adeego bulshada Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu sii raaciyay qoraalkiisa. Is-casilaadda Xildhibaan Maxamuud Cabdullaahi Axmed (Abuukaate) ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay dalka ka socdaan isbeddello siyaasadeed iyo kuwo maamul, is la markaana Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay waddo qorshayaal iyo howlaha la xiriira hannaanka shaqada hay’adaha dowladda. Dhanka kale ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay xukuumadda Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza oo ku aadan tagista Maxamuud Cabdullaahi Axmed (Abuukaate) oo maanta banneeyay xilkii uu ka hayay Wasaaradda Ganacsiga. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee lama oga tallaabada xigta ee ay qaadi doonto dowladda Soomaaliya iyo cidda beddeli doonta Wasiir ku-xigeenka casilay oo ka mid ahaa Xildhibaannadii aadka ugu ololaleenaysay Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo loo doortay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. items.title: Wasiir ka tirsan Xukuumadda Raysal Wasaare Barre oo is casilay
items.description: Wasiir Kuxigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga & Warshadaha Xukuumadda Federaalka, Maxamuud Cabdullaahi Axmed (Abukaate) ayaa maanta shaaciyay inuu iska casilay xilkaasi. “Maanta oo ay taariikhdu tahay 13 Agosto 2026, waxaan si rasmi ah isaga casilay xilka Wasiir Kuxigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Somaliya. Waxaan u mahadcelinayaa madaxda dalka fursadda ay ii siiyeen in aan ugu adeego bulshada Soomaaliyeed.” Ayuu Maxamuud Abukaate ku sheegay warqad uu ku saxiixnaa. Maxamuud Abukaate ayaan sheegin sababta uu xilkaasi isaga casilay, mana jirto wax falcelin ah oo Xafiiska Raysal Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre uu ka bixiyay is casilaaddiisa. Xilkan ayaa loo magacaabay bishii March ee sanadkii 2025, waxayna tallaabada uu isaga casilay ay imaneysaa, iyadoo muddooyinkii u dambeeyay uu xiriir wanaagsan la lahaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Maxamuud Abukaate waa Xildhibaan ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka, waxaana bishii April ee sanadkii 2022 markii 2aad la guddoonsiiyay shahaadada Xildhibaanimo. Maxamuud Abukaate ayaa ah siyaasi laga soo doorto Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle, waxayna deegaan doorashadiisu tahay Magaalada Beledweyne ee Xarunta Gobolka Hiiraan, wuxuuna ku fadhiyaa kursiga uu tirsigiisu yahay HOP#006.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo Galmudug Booqanaya, Ciidanka Puntland Kasoo Goostayna La Kulmaya
items.description: Galmudug (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa booqanaya Galmudug, halkaas oo uu ku tagayo xeryo ay ku sugan yihiin qaar kamid ah ciidamadii kasoo baxay Gaalkacyo iyo deegaanno kale oo Puntland ah. Sida xogtu sheegeyso, ciidamadaasi ayaa loo wareejiyay Galmudug kaddib markii Puntland ay u qabatay muddo 48 saacadood ah inay isu soo dhiibaan, iyadoo markii dambe la go’aamiyay in lagu soo dhaweeyo gudaha Galmudug. Qaar kamid ah ciidamada ayaa xilli habeen ah kasoo baxay xeryihii ay ku sugnaayeen Gaalkacyo, oo ay kamid ahayd xerada Barda-dheere, halkaas oo la sheegay in loogu diyaarinayay howlgal ka dhan ah Puntland. Intooda badan ayaa lagu hayaa gobolka Galgaduud, gaar ahaan xero ku taalla deegaanka Xananbuure. Booqashada Madaxweynaha ayaa lagu wadaa in loo bixiyo xaflad lagu soo xirayo tababar, maadaama Xananbuure ay sidoo kale tababar ku qaadanayeen ciidamo kale oo horey loo soo sheegay. Inkastoo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka uu horey u soo xiray tababarka ciidamadaasi, haddana waxaa la filayaa in Madaxweynaha uu la hadlo ciidamada, isagoo u ballanqaadi doona in la siin doono xuquuqdooda iyo waajibaad qaran oo loo xilsaaro. items.title: Daawo: Xaalad adag oo ka taagan Waabari kadib markii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xaaladda degmada Waabari ee gobolka Banaadir ayaa maanta aad u kacsan, kadib markii ay isku dhaceen ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo shacabka deggan xaafadda Buulo Eelaay oo ka tirsan laanta Hantiwadaag ee degmadasi. Ciidamada ayaa saaka ku jarmaaday xaafaddan, waxayna dumis ku qoreen guryihii shacabka, taas oo keentay inay isku dhacaan iyaga iyo dadka deegaanka. Muuqaallo lagu baahiyay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinayo ciidamada oo rasaas nool nool u adeegsanaya shacabka oo diidan in la dumiyo guryahooda, lagana barakacayo xaafaddaasi oo ah isku raran ah oo ku taalla bartamaha Muqdisho. Hooyo kamid ah dadka deegaanka oo hadashay Shabelle Tv ayaa sheegtay in xaafadda aysan ahayn dhul dowladeed ama obasiibo, isla markaana ay dowladda Soomaaliya uga baaqayaan inay ka dayso beegsiga iyo barakicinta. “Annaga waxaan daganahay xaafad ab ka ab wixii na dhalay ayaa 90 jir ah annaga ayaan kusii xigno marka maanta in nala barakiciyo ma ogolin, dowladda waxaan ka codsaneynaa xaafaddii obasiibo ah ay raadsato annaga xaafadeenna ammaan ha naloo siiyo,” ayay tiri hooyo kamid ah dadka deegaanka. Sidoo kale, waxa ay intaas ku dartay in shaqaaqadii maanta ka dhacday degmada Waabari ay waxyeelo kasoo gaartay hooyo waayeel ah, sidoo kalena la xir xiray wiilashoodii, kadib markii ciidamadu ay xoog iyo rasaas nool nool u adeegsadeen shacbaka. “Khsaare waa jiraa oo gabar ayaa laamiga ku dhaawacantay lug iyo gacan ayay xabad uga dhacday wiilashii oo dhana waa naga wateen,” ayay raacisay. Dhacdadan ayaa kamid ah shaqaaqooyin horay uga dhacay xaafado ku yaalla magaalada Muqdisho oo ay burburin ka sameysay dowladda Soomaaliya, waxaana weli sii socda howlgalka lagu barakicinayo shacabka caasimada. items.title: Guddiga Joogtada ah ee Golaha Shacabka oo Kulmay
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Kulanka Guddiga Joogtada ah ee Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ka dhacay xarunta Guddoonka iyo Guddiyada ee Villa Hargeysa, waxaana shir guddoomiyay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), iyadoo uu ku wehliyay Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow. Guddoomiyeyaasha guddiyada Golaha ayaa xubnaha Guddiga Joogtada ah warbixinno ka siiyay shuruucda ay gacanta ku hayaan iyo marxaladaha ay marayaan, iyadoo si qoto dheer looga hadlay dardargelinta howlaha sharci-dejinta iyo arrimaha muhiimka ah ee Golaha horyaalla inta lagu guda jiro Kalfadhiga 8-aad. Xubnaha Guddiga Joogtada ah ayaa sidoo kale ka arrinsaday ajandayaasha kulamada guud ee Golaha Shacabka ee toddobaadka soo socda, iyagoo si wadajir ah u ansixiyay ajandayaasha la qorsheeyay. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa kulanka soo xiray, isagoo xubnaha Guddiga Joogtada ah uga mahadceliyay doorkooda ku aaddan dejinta ajandayaasha iyo dardargelinta howlaha muhiimka ah ee Golaha. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale guddiyada ku boorriyay inay sii wadaan shaqada loo igmaday, si loo xaqiijiyo in howlaha sharci-dejinta iyo kormeerka Golaha ay si hufan ugu socdaan waajibaadka dastuuriga ah. items.title: Agaasimayaashii ugu badnaa oo maanta xilka la wareegay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Agaasimayaasha cusub ee dhawaan loo magacaabay waaxyaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ayaa maanta si rasmi ah ula kala wareegay mas’uuliyadaha waaxyahooda iyo faylasha rasmiga ah. Wareejinta xilalkan oo maanta ka qabsoomtay xarunta Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa waxay u dhacday sidan: 1. Marwo Huda Nuur Sheikh Haamud ayaa la wareegtay xilka Agaasimaha Waaxda Arrimaha Aasiya, iyadoo mas’uuliyadda kala wareegtay Agaasimihii hore, Mudane Saciid Mire. 2. Mudane Mohamed Mahmud Ali ayaa la wareegay mas’uuliyadda Waaxda Arrimaha Afrika, isagoo xilka kala wareegay Agaasimihii hore ee waaxda, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Burgal. 3. Mudane Saalah Maalin Abuukar ayaa la wareegay mas’uuliyadda Waaxda Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah, isagoo xilka kala wareegay Agaasimihii hore, Mudane Jibriil Afyare 4. Mudane Jibriil Afyare ayaa la wareegay mas’uuliyadda Waaxda Siyaasadda, Qorsheynta iyo Cilmi-baarista, isagoo xilka kala wareegay Agaasimihii hore, Mudane Mohamed Mahmud Colad. 5. Mudane Usman Ahmed Mohamed ayaa la wareegay mas’uuliyadda Waaxda Ururrada Caalamiga ah, isagoo xilka kala wareegay Mudane Cabdinaasir Ibrahim Haji Usman, oo xilkaasi si ku-meel gaar ah u hayay. Munaasabadda xil-wareejinta waxaa goob joog ka ahaa Xoghayaha Joogtada ah ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah, Mudane Hamza Haadow iyo Hantidhowrka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda, Mudane Abdulkadir Hassan Mohamed. Si kastaba, magacaabista mas’uuliyiinta maanta xilka la wareegay ayey hore wasaaraddu ugu sheegtay inay qayb ka yihiin dadaallada joogtada ah ee wasaaradda ee lagu xoojinayo awoodda hay’adeed, hufnaanta maamulka iyo tayada shaqada diblomaasiyadeed, si loo dardar-geliyo hirgelinta mudnaanta siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda iyo danaha qaranka JFS. items.title: Puntland oo cudud ciidan ka heshay Degmada Saaxo (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland ayaa maanta qarameysay ciidamada dadka deegaanka ee ku sugan Degmada Saaxo ee galbeedka Gobolka Mudug. Puntland ayaa si rasmi ah u diiwaangelisay ciidamada deegaanka iyo hubkoodaba, iyadoo ciidamadan oo boqolaal gaaraya ay ku biirayaan Daraawiishta Puntland. Arrintan ayaa qayb ka ah qorshaha lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida deegaanada Puntland, gaar ahaan Gobolka Mudug, laguna mideynayo awoodda ciidamada ee ka hawlgala gudaha Puntland. Qorshaha lagu xoojinayo amniga Puntland ayaa ah mid dib-u-habayn loogu sameynayo Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, iyadoo laga hortagayo fara-gelinta amni ee ay Puntland ku eedeysay Dowladda Federaalka inay ku hayso maamulkaasi. Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo aadeysa, xilli Saraakiisha Ciidamada Puntland ay Gobolka Mudug, qaybta Puntland ka wadaan diiwaangelin lagu sameynayo ciidamada ku sugan gobolkaasi. Madaxweyne Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni oo habeenkii Sabtida Magaalada Gaalkacyo kula kulmay Saraakiisha Ciidamada Puntland ee ka hawlgala gobolkaasi ayaa kula dardaarmay adkaynta amniga Puntland, isla-markaana ay xoojiyaan wada-shaqaynta, feejignaanta iyo waajibaadka ka saaran sugidda amniga. Madaxweyne Deni oo 5-tii bishan shir jaraa’id ku qabtay Magaalada Garoowe ayaa ciidamada ay Dowladda Federaalka ka qoratay deegaanada Puntland ku booriyay inay isa soo dhiibaan, isla-markaana ay ka mid noqdaan ciidamada kale ee Puntland. Puntland ayaa diidan in ciidamo aan ka amar qaadan maamulka ay ka hawlgalaan deegaanadeeda.

Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo aadeysa, xilli Saraakiisha Ciidamada Puntland ay Gobolka Mudug, qaybta Puntland ka wadaan diiwaangelin lagu sameynayo ciidamada ku sugan gobolkaasi. Madaxweyne Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni oo habeenkii Sabtida Magaalada Gaalkacyo kula kulmay Saraakiisha Ciidamada Puntland ee ka hawlgala gobolkaasi ayaa kula dardaarmay adkaynta amniga Puntland, isla-markaana ay xoojiyaan wada-shaqaynta, feejignaanta iyo waajibaadka ka saaran sugidda amniga. Madaxweyne Deni oo 5-tii bishan shir jaraa’id ku qabtay Magaalada Garoowe ayaa ciidamada ay Dowladda Federaalka ka qoratay deegaanada Puntland ku booriyay inay isa soo dhiibaan, isla-markaana ay ka mid noqdaan ciidamada kale ee Puntland. Puntland ayaa diidan in ciidamo aan ka amar qaadan maamulka ay ka hawlgalaan deegaanadeeda.

items.title: Sheekh Cali Wajiis oo dood culus ka keenay nidaamka federaalka Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Sheekh Cali Maxamuud Xasan (Wajiis), oo kamid ah culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan nidaamka federaalka ee dalka ayaa soo jeediyay in dib-u-habeyn lagu sameeyo qaabka dowlad-goboleedyada dalka iyo sida loo qaybsado awoodaha dowladda dhexe iyo maamullada. Sheekh Cali Wajiis ayaa sheegay in nidaamka federaalka Afrika uu leeyahay laba qaab oo waaweyn, kuwaas oo uu ku kala saaray mid ku dhisan isir iyo mid ku dhisan deegaan. Sheekha ayaa xusay in nidaamka xilligan ku haboon Soomaaliya uu yahay midka deegaanka, isaga oo soo jeediyay in dib loogu dhiso 18-kii gobol ee uu ka koobnaa dalka. “Nidaamka Federaalka Africa 5 dowladood ayaa ka qaadatay, isagoo 2 nooc ah 1- mid ku dhisan isir ama Qabyaalad, waana lagu hoobtay Ethiopia iyo Somalia ayaa qaatay colaado ayaana laga dhaxlay. 2- mid ku dhisan deegaan South Africa, Kenya iyo Nigeria ayaa qaatay gobolo ayuu ku dhisanyahay, waana maamul heer gobol oo leesu doorto, dalkana awooddiisa difaac amni iyo diyaasadeed dowladda dhexe ayaa heysa, waana kan Soomaaliya ku habboon iney qaadato, sidaa darteed 18 kii gobol in dib loogu dhiso ayey ahayd xilligii dastuurku furnaay laakiin ilduuf ayaa dhacay ee dowladda soo socota fursaddaas ha qaadato,” ayuu yiri Sheekha oo qoraal soo saaray. Dhanka kale, Sheekh Cali Wajiis ayaa sheegay in xal u helidda khilaafaadka ka dhashay nidaamka federaalka ay muhiim u tahay mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee dalka, wuxuuna ku taliyay in Dastuurka si cad loogu qeexo qaabka ay dowlad-goboleedyadu u dhismi karaan. “Deeganaanshaha dalku wuxuu ku jiraa in xal loo helo dhibaatada federaalku ku kala qoqobay bulshadeenna waxay ahayd in Dastuurka lagu qoro inta uu furnaay (Dowlad goboleedku waxey ka dhismi kartaa hal gobol iyo wixii ka badan), taasoo Xal u noqon lahayd isku raranka gobolada is qaadan la, iyo beelaha isku heesta hoggaaminta goboladaas.” Waxaa kale oo uu ku baaqay in doorashooyinka dowlad-goboleedyada loo maro hannaan xor ah oo la isku raacsan yahay, kadibna hoggaamiyeyaasha cusub ee kasoo baxa ay la shaqeyso Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. “Haddii fursaddaas dowladdu ka ilduuftay hadda waa inay tartanka Madaxweyne goboleedyada si xor ah loo qabtaa cidna aan loo xirin ciddii la doortana dowladdu toos ula mucaamishaa si khilaafaadku usoo dhammaadaan, doorashooyinkuna u noqdaan kuwa la’isku raaco oo soo saara madax lala shaqeeyo,” ayuu qoraalkiisa kusoo gabagabeeyay. The post Sheekh Cali Wajiis oo dood culus ka keenay nidaamka federaalka Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya oo qorshaynaysa maalgelin dhan 35 Milyan oo Dollar ah si loo kobciyo dhoofinta sisinta iyo kalluunka
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa qorshaynaysa in dalka lagu soo jiito ugu yaraan 35 milyan oo dollar oo maalgelin cusub ah oo lagu horumarinayo wax-soo-saarka, farsamaynta iyo dhoofinta sisinta iyo kalluunka , iyadoo tallaabadan qayb ka tahay qorshe qaran oo shan sano ah oo ku saabsan kobcinta ganacsiga iyo wax-soo-saarka dalka. Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha ayaa qabatay kulan-wada-tashi ah oo lagu dhammaystirayo laguna ansixinayo Qorshaha Qaran ee 2026–2030 , kaas oo diiradda saaraya sidii wax-soo-saarka Soomaaliya loogu kordhin lahaa qiime dheeraad ah ka hor inta aan loo dhoofin suuqyada gudaha, kuwa gobolka iyo kuwa caalamka. Qorshahan ayaa sidoo kale lagu doonayaa in wax laga qabto caqabadaha hortaagan silsiladaha wax-soo-saarka, gaar ahaan farsamaynta badeecadaha, tayada, kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, maalgelinta iyo helitaanka suuqyo joogto ah. Sida qorshaha lagu sheegay, dowladda waxay hiigsanaysaa in barnaamijkan lagu taageero 300 ganacsi , isla markaana la sameeyo ugu yaraan 80 xiriir ganacsi oo u dhexeeya soo-saareyaasha Soomaaliyeed iyo iibsadayaasha , iyadoo la filayo in barnaamijku abuuro ku dhowaad 1,200 fursadood oo shaqo . Hindisahan waxaa taageeraya Enhanced Integrated Framework (EIF) oo hoos yimaada Ururka Ganacsiga Adduunka (WTO), iyadoo taageero farsamo laga helayo ESAMI-TRAPCA , oo ah hay’ad gobolka ka shaqaysa dhisidda awoodda ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga. Sisinta ayaa ka mid ah wax-soo-saarka beeraha ee Soomaaliya ee muhiimka u ah dhoofinta. Hase yeeshee, qayb weyn oo ka mid ah wax-soo-saarka dalka ayaa weli ka baxa iyadoo aan si weyn gudaha loogu farsamayn. Dowladdu waxay doonaysaa in la kordhiyo awoodda dalka ee nadiifinta, farsamaynta, baakadaynta iyo kaydinta sisinta , taas oo ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed u suuragelin karta inay qiime badan ka helaan badeecadda halkii ay si toos ah uga dhoofin lahaayeen wax-soo-saar aan la farsamayn. Farsamaynta gudaha ayaa sidoo kale abuuri karta shaqooyin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan warshadaynta, gaadiidka, kaydinta, baakadaynta iyo suuq-geynta. Dhanka kale, kalluumaysiga ayaa ah mid ka mid ah qaybaha Soomaaliya ka caawin kara kala-duwanaanshaha dhaqaalaha iyo abuurista shaqooyin, gaar ahaan bulshada ku nool deegaannada xeebaha. Soomaaliya oo leh xeeb dheer ayaa haysata fursad weyn oo ay kaga faa’iidaysan karto kheyraadka badda, balse waxaa weli jira caqabado ay ka mid yihiin kaabayaal qaboojin iyo kaydin, xarumo farsamaynta kalluunka, nidaamyada hubinta tayada, shahaadooyinka badeecadaha iyo helitaanka suuqyada caalamiga ah .

items.title: Mareykanka oo ku dhawaaqay tallaabo ka sii dari karta colaadda kala dhaxeysa Iran
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Xoghayaha Difaaca Mareykanka, Pete Hegseth ayaa sheegay in ciidamada dalkiisa ay sii wadi karaan xannibaadda dekedaha Iran muddo kasta oo loo baahdo, iyadoo uu sii xoogeysanayo dhaq-dhaqaaqa milatari ee Mareykanka ee gobolka. Hegseth oo wariyeyaasha kula hadlayay Panama ayaa sheegay in ciidamada badda Mareykanka ay awood u leeyihiin inay sii wadaan howl-galka, xilli walaac laga muujinayo muddada uu markabka diyaaradaha qaada ee USS Abraham Lincoln ku sii jiri doono howlgalka. “Ciidamadeenna badda waxay xannibaaddan sii wadi karaan muddo aan xad lahayn, sababtoo ah waxaan maraakiibta u kala wareejinnaa gudaha iyo dibadda, sidii aan horey u sameyn jirnay ayaan mustaqbalkana u sii sameyn doonno,” ayuu yiri Hegseth. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo warbaahinta caalamka ay soo tabineyso qorshayaal la xiriira isbeddel lagu sameynayo maraakiibta dagaalka ee Mareykanka ka howlgala gobolka, gaar ahaan beddelka Abraham Lincoln oo howlgalkiisa ku jiray in ka badan 250 maalmood. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in markabka diyaaradaha qaada ee USS George Washington loo qorsheynayo inuu beddelo Abraham Lincoln, taas oo qeyb ka noqon karta qorshaha Mareykanka ee joogteynta awooddiisa badeed iyo hawlgallada ka socda agagaarka Iran. Xannibaadda iyo joogitaanka maraakiibta Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale la xiriira muhiimadda istiraatiijiyadeed ee marin-biyoodka Hormuz, oo ah mid ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ee dunida looga kala goosho shidaalka iyo badeecooyinka kale ee tamarta. Si kastaba, Iran iyo Mareykanka ayaa labaduba sheeganaya inay awood ku leeyihiin marin-biyoodka Hormuz, iyadoo xiisadda labada dhinac ay sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo saameynta ay xaaladdu ku yeelan karto isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo suuqyada tamarta caalamka. The post Mareykanka oo ku dhawaaqay tallaabo ka sii dari karta colaadda kala dhaxeysa Iran appeared first on Caasimada Online .
