Mas’uuliyiin horudhac ah Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa haatan gaaray Galmudug, kuwaas oo tegay Dhuusamareeb iyo deegaanka Xananbuure oo ah meesha lagu soo xirayo tababarka ciidamada cusub ee Xoogga Dalka. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa inta uu joogo Dhuusamareeb la kulmi doono madaxda Galmudug iyo qaybaha bulshada oo uu kala hadli doono arrimaha ammaanka iyo doorashooyinka maamulkaas oo maraya meel wanaagsan. Safarka Xasan Sheekh ayaa dhanka kale kusoo aadayo xilli xasaasi ah, isla markaana la filayo in Galmudug ay ka dhacdo doorashada Madaxweynaha maamulkaas oo haatan galaangal xoogga ay ku leedahay dowladda dhexe. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya ayaa maalmihii dambeeyay wadday isku dabarid xooggan oo ku aadan arrimaha ciidamada, si loo xoojiyo awoodooda, si ay ula wareegaan amniga dalka, maadaama la qorsheynayo in dalka ay ka baxaan ciidamada shisheeye ee ku jira howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya. Ciidamada AUSSOM ayaa mar kale bilaabay inay wareejiyaan saldhigyadooda, waxaana ugu dambeeyay ciidamadii Itoobiya ee maalmo ka hor ka baxay saldhiggoodii degmada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Baay, iyaga oo ku wareejiyay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Sababaha ugu wayn ee bixitaanka ciidamadan shisheeye ayaa waxaa soo dadajiyay dhaqaale xumada uu wajahayo howlgalkan Midowga Afrkla oo hadda wajahaya mid kamid ah caqabadihii ugu adkaa ee abid soo mara howlgalka. Ciidamada AUSSOM ayaa mar kale bilaabay inay wareejiyaan saldhigyadooda, waxaana ugu dambeeyay ciidamadii Itoobiya ee maalmo ka hor ka baxay saldhiggoodii degmada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Baay, iyaga oo ku wareejiyay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Sababaha ugu wayn ee bixitaanka ciidamadan shisheeye ayaa waxaa soo dadajiyay dhaqaale xumada uu wajahayo howlgalkan Midowga Afrkla oo hadda wajahaya mid kamid ah caqabadihii ugu adkaa ee abid soo mara howlgalka. items.title: Rabshado ka dhacay Degmada Waaberi ee Gobolka Banaadir
items.description: Ciidanka Booliska Gobolka Banaadir ayaa maanta dad shacab ah ku rasaaseeyay Degmada Waaberi, xilli dadkaasi ay dhigayeen bannaanbax ay kaga soo horjeedaan in guryahooda la burburiyo. Ciidamada ayaa saaka dadka ku dhaqan xaafadda Buulo Eelaay ee degmadaasi ku wargeliyay in ay ka guuraan guryahooda, ugu dambayn maalinta Jimcaha, iyagoo u sheegay in haddii kale xoog lagu burburin doono. Dadka deegaanka oo ku kadsoomay amarkaasi ayaa dhigay bannaanbax ay kaga soo horjeedaan in laga barakiciyo guryahooda, tani oo keentay in Ciidanka Booliska ay rasaas nool nool u adeegsadaan dadkaasi, si loo kala eryo. Dadkan ayaa ka cabanaya in si sharci darro ah lagu burburinayo guryahooda, iyagoo haysta dokumentiyo sharci ah, isla-markaana uu Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir diidan yahay in uu eego, si loo xaqiijiyo milkiliyadda ay u leeyihiin guryahaasi. Muuqaalo la soo dhigay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinaya rabshado ka dhacay xaafaddaasi, markii shacabku ay bilaabeen inay waddooyinka xiraan, isla-markaana ay taayaro ku gubaan. Muuqaalada ayaa laga arki karay ciidamada oo rasaasta nool nool u adeegsanaya qoysaska ka hortagaya in si xoog ah guryahooda lagu qaato. Laba qof oo midi ay haweeney tahay ayaa ku dhaawacmay rasaasta ay fureen Ciidanka Booliska Gobolka Banaadir, oo iyaga loo adeegsanayo Hawlgalka Cagafta ee lagu burburiyo guryaha ay dadka shacabka ahi degan yihiin. Hawlgalka Cagafta ee lagu dumiyo guryaha shacabka ee ku yaal Muqdisho ayaa dhaliyay cabsi, walaac iyo carro xoogan. Dadka reer Muqdisho ayaa dareemay dhibaato iyo in aan la ilaalin xuquuqdooda iyo hantidooda. Madaxda sare ee dalka ayaa lagu dhaliilaa inaysan tixgelin walaaca iyo cabashada ay qabaan dadweynaha.

items.title: Turkey will arrest and exile Somalia’s opposition leaders if defiance continues, warns veteran diplomat
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Turkey will move to arrest and exile Somalia’s opposition leaders, including former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, should they persist in their defiance of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s disputed term extension, a veteran Somali diplomat has warned. Hussein Ali Duale, widely known as Ambassador Awil, made the claim in an interview with Geed Fadhi media, arguing that President Mohamud has ceded sweeping concessions to Ankara — including offshore oil blocks and Somalia’s exclusive economic zone — in exchange for unconditional Turkish backing, whether directed against regional states or opposition politicians. Duale described Turkey as a state that pursues its own interests without regard for democratic norms, and said Ankara would not hesitate to detain opposition figures who mount serious resistance to Mohamud’s plans. Any such arrests, he said, would be carried out under the pretext that the detainees were undermining Somalia’s security, with those held then exiled under house arrest in Ankara. His remarks echo accusations opposition figures have leveled at Turkey for months, accusing Ankara of aligning itself fully with President Mohamud in ways they say serve neither Somalia’s interests nor, ultimately, Turkey’s own long-term investment in the country. In June, opposition leaders alleged that Turkish-supplied suicide drones and weaponry were used in strikes on compounds housing former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed and former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire. The two men were reportedly organizing protests against the government’s term extension at the time; the opposition says the compounds were attacked pre-emptively, before any demonstration could take place. Duale is not the only prominent Somali voice to accuse Ankara of enabling authoritarian rule in Mogadishu while extracting the country’s natural resources. Senator and academic Abdi Ismail Samatar has separately accused Turkey of acting as a “resource pirate” in Somali waters. “Turkish vessels are prospecting and drilling for oil in Somali waters. This is exceptionally alarming as the entire affair is illegal,” Samatar said, adding that President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and his government are aware that the defense and petroleum agreements underpinning the activity are, in his words, fraudulent. Samatar noted that Somalia’s parliament has never been shown the text of either agreement, and argued that Turkey’s decision to proceed with exploration regardless amounts to complicity with what he called “an illegitimate and derelict regime” in Mogadishu. He further accused Villa Somalia of relying on Turkish military resources to sustain what he described as a corrupt administration whose constitutional mandate expired. “Ankara has found solace in silence, but the Somali people will not forget Türkiye’s great deception,” Samatar said. Neither the Turkish embassy in Mogadishu nor Villa Somalia has publicly responded to the specific allegations raised by Duale or Samatar. Turkey has previously defended its role in Somalia as one of development partnership, security cooperation and counterterrorism support, and has not commented on claims that it facilitated attacks on opposition figures or entered into undisclosed resource agreements. The allegations surface against the backdrop of Somalia’s deepening constitutional crisis. President Mohamud’s term formally expired on May 15, and parliament’s mandate lapsed a month earlier, but Mohamud has said he intends to remain in office until May 2027 under constitutional amendments extending presidential and parliamentary terms from four years to five — a move the opposition rejects as unconstitutional. Talks brokered at Mogadishu’s Halane compound, with American and British diplomats mediating, collapsed without resolving the standoff. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Trump sees law as obstacle to third term
items.description: US President Donald Trump said he would like to run for a third term as president of the United States, but acknowledged that the country’s constitution prevents him from doing so. Trump made the remarks at Andrews Air Force Base after a reporter asked him about the possibility of running for president again. He said many people want him to continue leading the country, but noted that the US Constitution limits the number of times a president can be elected. The US Constitution, specifically Article 22, states that no one can be elected to the presidency more than twice. This limit was approved in 1951, after Franklin D. Roosevelt became the first president to win more than two terms. Trump, who first became president in 2017, won re-election in 2024, and his second term is expected to end in January 2029. Although Trump has repeatedly raised the idea of ​​running for a third term, his latest remarks have drawn widespread attention, as he acknowledged that current law would prevent such a plan. When asked if he was formally withdrawing from a third term, Trump did not directly answer, but moved on to the next question. Trump’s remarks have already sparked a new debate about the future of American politics and whether the constitutional two-term limit could ever be changed. The post Trump sees law as obstacle to third term first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Trump Oo Sharciga U Arka Caqabad Ku Hortaagan Xil Saddexaad
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu jeclaan lahaa inuu mar saddexaad u tartamo madaxtinimada Mareykanka, balse uu qiray in sharciga dalka uu arrintaasi caqabad ku yahay. Trump ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay saldhigga ciidamada ee Andrews, kaddib markii wariye uu weydiiyay su’aal ku saabsan suuragalnimada inuu mar kale u tartamo xilka madaxweynaha. Wuxuu sheegay in dad badan ay doonayaan inuu sii hoggaamiyo dalka, balse uu xusay in dastuurka Mareykanka uu xaddidayo tirada jeer ee madaxweyne loo dooran karo. Dastuurka Mareykanka, gaar ahaan Qodobka 22-aad, ayaa dhigaya in qof aan loo dooran karin xilka madaxweynaha wax ka badan laba jeer. Xaddidaaddan ayaa la ansixiyay sanadkii 1951-kii, kaddib markii Franklin D. Roosevelt uu noqday madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay ee dalka ee xilka ku guuleysta in ka badan laba jeer. Trump, oo markii ugu horreysay madaxweyne noqday 2017, ayaa mar kale ku guuleystay doorashadii 2024-ka, waxaana muddadiisa labaad la filayaa inay dhammaato Janaayo 2029. Inkasta oo Trump uu horey dhowr jeer u soo hadal qaaday fikradda ah inuu mar saddexaad tartamo, hadalkiisa cusub ayaa si weyn u soo jiitay dareenka, maadaama uu qiray in sharciga hadda jira uu ka hor istaagayo qorshahaas. Markii su’aal kale lagu weydiiyay inuu si rasmi ah uga tanaasulayo tartanka saddexaad, Trump si toos ah ugama jawaabin, balse wuxuu u gudbay su’aasha xigtay. Hadalka Trump ayaa durba dhaliyay dood cusub oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka siyaasadda Mareykanka iyo haddii mar uun wax laga beddeli karo xaddidaadda dastuuriga ah ee labada xilli. The post Trump Oo Sharciga U Arka Caqabad Ku Hortaagan Xil Saddexaad first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Italy Donates Six Armoured Vehicles to Somali Police
items.description: Italy is set to donate six armoured vehicles formerly used by the Italian Carabinieri to the Somali police force, under a bilateral defence cooperation agreement signed between the two governments. The transfer of the six VM-90P vehicles, valued at more than 170,000 euros ($198,000), was approved by the Foreign Affairs and Defence committees of Italy’s Chamber of Deputies and Senate on July 29, just before Parliament’s summer recess . The Italian Defence Ministry has confirmed the donation will not add any extra costs to its defence budget . The donation comes as Somalia continues its efforts to strengthen the capacity of its national security forces and gradually assume greater responsibility for the country’s security . Italy and Somalia have maintained a formal defence partnership since signing a General Cooperation Agreement in Rome in September 2013, which took effect in July 2016 and remains in force with no fixed expiration date . The VM-90Ps have been declared out of service by the Carabinieri Logistics Inspectorate due to their age, high maintenance costs and limited operational capabilities . They have been progressively replaced by the newer VTLM Lince light multirole tactical vehicles . Italian defence officials have described the vehicles as technically obsolete, having entered the logistics cycle between 1996 and 2004 . Their underbody protection was designed primarily against small arms fire and shrapnel, not mines or improvised explosive devices—a limitation that proved tragically fatal in 2006 when an IED struck a VM90P in Nasiriyah, Iraq, killing four Italian soldiers and one Romanian soldier . Italy’s Military Code permits the free transfer of defence equipment declared out of service to developing countries and other eligible recipients, provided the relevant parliamentary committees give their approval . Somalia is classified as a least developed country by the UN Committee for Development Policy . This is not Italy’s first contribution to Somali security forces. In 2025, Rome transferred equipment worth approximately 50,000 euros, including riot-control gear, uniforms, personal equipment, stationery and hygiene supplies . A second shipment of similar value is currently awaiting authorisation . The agreement between the two countries aims to strengthen cooperation between their armed forces, improve defence capabilities and enhance security coordination, while also facilitating the exchange of equipment to improve interoperability The post Italy Donates Six Armoured Vehicles to Somali Police first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo ciidamo dheeraad ah u daabushay HirShabeelle + Ujeedka
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa saacadihii lasoo dhaafay ciidamo u daabushay deegaanno ka tirsan maamulka HirShabelle oo haatan ay ka socdaan abaabulka howlgallo culus oo ka dhan ah maleeshiyaadka kooxda Al-Shabaab. Ciidamada ayaa qaybtood waxay gaareen aagga degmada Raage Ceelle ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, waxaana wehlinayay saraakiil ka tirsan Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka oo isku dabaridaya abaabulka ka socda halkaasi. Saraakiisha ayaa durbo kulamo ka bilaabay magaalada, kuwaas oo ay la yeelanayaan qaybaha bulshada, si ay ugu bandhigaan qorshahooda la xiriira dagaalka Al-Shabaab ee ka bilaabanaya deegaannada HirShabelle. Dhanka kale, ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa dowladda oo gaaray gobolka Hiiraan ayaa iyana dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wada gobolkaas oo todobaadkii hore uu ka dhacay dagaal qaraar oo ay la galeen maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab oo la wareegay deegaanka Teedaan ee gobolkaasi. Ujeedka ciidamada ayaa ah inay dib u xoreeyaan deegaannada ay soo galeen Al-Shabaab, si loogu soo celiyo gacanta dowladda Soomaaliya. Xaaladda ayaa haatan kacsan, waxaana meelo kala duwan oo kamid ah gobolka laga dareemayaa dhaq-dhaqaaqyo iska soo horjeedo oo u dhexeeyo labada dhinac. Arrimahan ayaa kusoo aasayo, iyada oo dhawaan Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu iclaamiyay dagaal kama dambeys ah oo lagu qaado kooxaha Khawaarijta, si mar kale loo bilaabo howlgallada dalka looga xoreynayo argagixisada. items.title: Militariga Somaliya oo ciidamo xoojin ah geeyay bariga Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo safar dhinaca dhulka ah uga ambabaxay Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa gaaray jiidda hore ee bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Ciidamadan oo wata gaadiidka dagaalka ayaa halkaasi loogu diray inay xoojiyaan ciidamada kale ee Militariga Somaliya iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee loogu talagalay inay la dagaalamaan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa wada qorshe ay ciidamadu dib ugu la wareegayaan deegaanka Teedaan, oo ay ka soo baxeen 2-dii bishan, markaas oo Al Shabaab ay qabsatay. General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayay wararku sheegayaan in uu riixayo guluf ballaaran oo lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in maleeshiyaad fara-badan oo kuwa Al Shabaab ah lagu arkayo deegaanada u dhexeeya Degmada Maxaas iyo Teedaan, isla-markaana ay Shabaabku dhufeysyo kaga jiraan bannaanada deegaankaasi Teedaan. Teedaan ayaa ah deegaan istiraatiiji ah oo xiriiriya Magaalooyinka Matabaan, Beledweyne iyo Maxaas, waana deegaan muhiim u ah nabadda iyo ganacsiga ee Gobolada Hiiraan iyo Galgaduud. Shabaabka ayaa isku dayaya, sidii ay u sii haysan lahaayeen Teedaan, si aysan halis ugu iman joogitaankooda Maxaas iyo Moqokori, oo ah laba magaalo oo waaweyn oo haatan ay ka haystaan bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Shabaabku waxay ogyihiin in haddii laga qabsado Teedaan ay ciidamadu kala jari karaan gurmadka iyo saadkooda ee Maxaas iyo Moqokori. Labada dhinac ayaa ahmiyad gaar ah siinaya gacan ku haynta Teedaan, waxaana cabsi laga qabaa in uu halkaas ka qarxo dagaal culus.

items.title: Qorshaha Mareykanka ka leeyahay saldhigga Soomaaliya
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Qorshaha Mareykanka uu ku ballaarinayo joogitaankiisa milateri ee magaalada Boosaaso wuxuu u muuqdaa mid ka weyn dagaalka muddada dheer uu Washington kula jiro kooxaha Daacish iyo Al-Shabaab ee Soomaaliya, sida ay sheegayaan fallanqeeyayaal. Boosaaso waxay ku taallaa meel istaraatiiji ah oo ku foorarta Gacanka Cadmeed, kana soo horjeedda Yemen, iyadoo sidoo kale aan ka fogeyn marin-biyoodka Baab Al-Mandab ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Muhiimadda goobtaas ayaa sii kordheysa xilli dagaalka Iran uu saameyntiisa ku sii fidinayo Badda Cas, Xuutiyiinta Yemen-na ay kordhiyeen weerarrada iyo hanjabaadaha ka dhanka ah maraakiibta iyo danaha Sacuudiga. Taasi waxay Boosaaso u beddeli kartaa meel Mareykanku kaga shaqeyn karo laba jiho: gudaha Soomaaliya oo uu kula dagaallamayo Daacish iyo dhinaca kale ee Gacanka Cadmeed, halkaas oo Yemen iyo Badda Cas ay noqdeen meel sii kordheysa muhiimaddeeda milateri. Bilowgii bishan, taliyaha ciidamada howlgallada gaarka ah ee Mareykanka ee Afrika, Major General Claude Tudor, ayaa Boosaaso heshiis kula saxiixday madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni, kaas oo maamulka Puntland sheegay inuu horseedayo ballaarinta joogitaanka ciidamada Mareykanka ee magaalada. “Qodobka heshiiska wuxuu dhigaya in Mareykanku ballaarin doono saldhiggiisa milateri ee Boosaaso, si loo xoojiyo howlgallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada iyo ilaalinta ammaanka badaha,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan kooban oo kasoo baxay Puntland. Faahfaahinta heshiiska lama shaacin, qoraalkiisa oo dhanna lama soo bandhigin. Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika, AFRICOM, ayaan sidoo kale si rasmi ah u xaqiijin heshiiska markii ugu horreysay ee wararkiisu soo baxeen. Hase yeeshee, waqtiga heshiiska la galay iyo halka uu saldhiggu ku yaallo ayaa bixinaya sawir ka ballaaran dagaalka Daacish. Boosaaso iyo dagaalka Badda Cas Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa 20-kii July ku dhawaaqay xannibaad badeed ay sheegeen inay ku soo rogayaan Sacuudiga, waxaana tan iyo markaas kordhay weerarrada iyo hanjabaadaha ka dhanka ah maraakiibta shidaalka iyo xarumaha Sacuudiga ee ku yaalla xeebaha Badda Cas. Arrintaas ayaa durba saameyn ku yeelatay isu-socodka maraakiibta. Reuters ayaa Arbacadii sheegtay in maraakiib badan oo shidaalka Sacuudiga ka qaada dekedda Yanbu ay daminayaan qalabka lagu ogaado goobta ay marayaan, si ay uga fogaadaan in la bartilmaameedsado. Tirada maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara Baab Al-Mandab ayaa sidoo kale hoos u dhacday. Boosaaso waxay ku taallaa dhinaca kale ee marin-biyoodkan. Diyaaradaha, qalabka sirdoonka iyo ciidamada gaarka ah ee halkaas laga hawlgeliyo waxay si dhow ula socon karaan Gacanka Cadmeed iyo koonfurta Yemen. Michael Woldemariam, oo wax ka dhiga Jaamacadda University of Maryland kana tirsan Atlantic Council, ayaa Responsible Statecraft u sheegay in xiisaha cusub ee Washington ee Puntland ay adag tahay in laga fahmo wax ka baxsan muhiimadda sii kordheysa ee Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo ammaanka marin-biyoodka. Cameron Hudson, oo hore uga soo shaqeeyay Golaha Amniga Qaranka Mareykanka, ayaa isna sheegay in Washington laga yaabo inay hadda aragto baahi muddo dheer ah oo loo qabo saldhig Mareykanku si toos ah u maamulo. Sababta kale ayaa ah Jabuuti. Camp Lemonnier oo ku yaalla Jabuuti waa saldhigga ugu weyn ee joogtada ah ee Mareykanku ku leeyahay Afrika, waana xarunta ugu muhiimsan ee howlgallada Washington ee Geeska Afrika. Hase yeeshee, dowladda Jabuuti ayaa xaddidday in dhulkeeda loo adeegsado weerarro ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta Yemen, iyadoo ka cabsi qabta in dalka lagu soo jiido dagaalka iyo inuu noqdo bartilmaameed aargoosi. Taasi waxay Mareykanka ku qasbeysaa inuu qiimeeyo meelo kale oo siin kara xorriyad howlgaleed oo ka badan tan uu Jabuuti ku haysto. Boosaaso waxay noqon kartaa mid ka mid ah meelahaas. Mareykanku Boosaaso kuma cusba Joogitaanka Mareykanka ee Boosaaso ma aha mid hadda bilaabanaya. Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa sannado adeegsanayay magaalada iyo xarumaha milateri ee halkaas ku yaalla, gaar ahaan saldhigga ku dhow garoonka diyaaradaha Boosaaso oo muddo dheer xiriir la lahaa Imaaraadka Carabta. Hudson wuxuu sheegay in Puntland horey loogu adeegsan jiray meel laga abaabulo howlgallada Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya. Saldhigga ayaa sannadihii dambe si weyn loo ballaariyay. Baaritaanno ay Middle East Eye sameysay ayaa horay u sheegay in goobta lagu rakibay raadaarro, bakhaarro ammaan ah oo hubka lagu keydiyo, hangarro diyaaradeed, xarumo caafimaad iyo kaabayaal qaabili kara diyaaradaha waaweyn ee xamuulka. Boosaaso ayaa sidoo kale magaceedu kusoo baxay dagaalka Sudan. Middle East Eye ayaa baaritaanno hore ku sheegtay in duulimaadyo iyo sahay milateri oo Boosaaso sii maray ay qayb ka ahaayeen shabakad taageero gaarsiisa ciidamada RSF ee dagaalka kula jira ciidanka Sudan. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa markii dambe xaqiijiyay jiritaanka duulimaadyo u dhexeeya Boosaaso iyo Sudan, inkasta oo Imaaraadka uu beeniyay inuu hub siiyo RSF. Laakiin Mareykanka, qiimaha Boosaaso kuma koobna Yemen ama Badda Cas. Buuraleyda gobolka Bari waxaa sannado badan saldhigyo ku lahaa Daacish, waxaana ciidamada Puntland tan iyo dhammaadkii 2024 waday howlgalkii ugu ballaarnaa ee ay kooxdaas ku qaadaan. Mareykanka ayaa howlgalladaas ku taageeray duqeymo cirka ah, taasoo Boosaaso ka dhigeysa xarun sahay iyo howlgallo oo si toos ah ugu dhow goobaha ay Daacish kaga sugan tahay waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya. Saldhig la ballaariyo wuxuu sidaas ku yeelan karaa laba shaqo oo isku mar ah: dagaalka kooxaha hubeysan ee gudaha Soomaaliya iyo ilaalinta danaha Mareykanka ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas. Muqdisho oo dhinac laga maray Su’aasha xasaasiga ah waxay tahay cidda Mareykanku heshiiska la galay. Heshiiska waxaa shaacisay Puntland, mana jirto wax muujinaya in dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay qayb ka ahayd wada-hadallada lagu gaaray. Arrintaas ayaa dib usoo celisay doodda ku saabsan awoodda dowlad-goboleedyada ay u leeyihiin inay si gaar ah ula galaan dowlado shisheeye heshiisyo la xiriira joogitaanka ciidamada iyo ammaanka. Puntland ayaa bishii Maarso 2024 ku dhawaaqday inay kala laabatay kalsoonidii iyo aqoonsigii hay’adaha federaalka kadib markii baarlamaanka Soomaaliya meel mariyay wax-ka-beddello dastuurka lagu sameeyay oo Puntland si weyn uga soo horjeesatay. Khilaafka labada dhinac ayaa tan iyo markaas sii xoogeystay, iyadoo bilihii ugu dambeeyay uu xitaa gaaray isku dhacyo iyo muran ka dhashay ciidamada iyo xarumaha amniga ee Puntland. Falanqeyn ay sameysay Critical Threats Project ayaa sheegtay in xiisadda ciidamada ee billowday bishii June aysan meesha ka saarin khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ballaaran ee u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Garoowe. Sidaas darteed, heshiis weyn oo milateri oo Washington ay si toos ah ula gasho Puntland ma aha oo keliya arrin amni. Wuxuu sidoo kale leeyahay miisaan siyaasadeed. Mareykanku wuxuu si rasmi ah u taageeraa madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, balse muddo dheer wuxuu xiriir toos ah la lahaa dowlad-goboleedyada, isaga oo isla waqtigaas xiriir dhow la leh dowladda federaalka. Responsible Statecraft waxay sheegtay in heshiiska Boosaaso uu tallaabadaas gaarsiin karo heer cusub, gaar ahaan haddii Mareykanku dhiso xarun weyn oo uu si madax-bannaan uga howlgeliyo Puntland. Istaraatiijiyad cusub Arrintan waxay kusoo beegmeysaa xilli Mareykanku dib u qaabeynayo qaabka uu Soomaaliya ula macaamilayo. Duqeymaha Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya ayaa aad u kordhay xilligii labaad ee Donald Trump. Responsible Statecraft waxay sheegtay in Mareykanku fuliyay 124 duqeyn sannadkii 2025, halka 78 kale la fuliyay ilaa hadda sanadkan 2026 — tiro aad uga badan heerarkii xukuumaddii Joe Biden. Dhanka kale, Washington ayaa July ku dhawaaqday inaanay taageeri doonin sii socoshada xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee taageera howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya marka oggolaanshaha hadda jira dhammaado 31-ka December. Go’aankaas ayaa walaac ka dhaliyay mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM. Waxa sidaas kasoo baxaya sawir istaraatiijiyadeed oo is beddelaya: Mareykanka oo yareynaya ku tiirsanaanta qaab-dhismeedyada waaweyn ee caalamiga ah, balse dhinaca kale xoojinaya awooddiisa uu si toos ah u fuliyo duqeymo iyo howlgallo gaar ah. Boosaaso arrintaas waxay siineysaa meel ku habboon. Waxay u dhowdahay saldhigyada Daacish ee Puntland, waxay si toos ah ugu foorartaa Gacanka Cadmeed, waxayna u dhowdahay Yemen iyo Baab Al-Mandab xilli Badda Cas ay isu beddeleyso goob dagaal oo sii weynaanaysa. Laakiin faa’iidadaas milateri waxay Washington u yeelan kartaa kharash siyaasadeed. Haddii Mareykanku ballaariyo joogitaankiisa Boosaaso isaga oo heshiiska si toos ah ula galay Puntland xilli xiriirka Garoowe iyo Muqdisho uu marayo heer aad u hooseeya, waxaa sii xoogeysan karta doodda ah in Washington ay dhinac marayso dowladda dhexe, isla markaana ay sii xoojineyso kala fogaanshaha siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Sidaas darteed, waxa ka socda Boosaaso waxaa laga yaabaa inuusan ahayn oo keliya cutub cusub oo dagaalka Mareykanka ee Daacish. Waxay sidoo kale noqon kartaa calaamad muujineysa in xeebaha Soomaaliya ay Washington uga sii gudbayaan goob ay ka fuliso dagaalka argagixisada, una noqonayaan qayb ka mid ah istaraatiijiyad milateri oo ka bilaabanta Geeska Afrika, ka gudubta Gacanka Cadmeed, kuna fidsan Badda Cas iyo colaadda sii ballaaranaysa ee Bariga Dhexe. Falanqeyn ay sameysay Critical Threats Project ayaa sheegtay in xiisadda ciidamada ee billowday bishii June aysan meesha ka saarin khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ballaaran ee u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Garoowe. Sidaas darteed, heshiis weyn oo milateri oo Washington ay si toos ah ula gasho Puntland ma aha oo keliya arrin amni. Wuxuu sidoo kale leeyahay miisaan siyaasadeed. Mareykanku wuxuu si rasmi ah u taageeraa madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, balse muddo dheer wuxuu xiriir toos ah la lahaa dowlad-goboleedyada, isaga oo isla waqtigaas xiriir dhow la leh dowladda federaalka. Responsible Statecraft waxay sheegtay in heshiiska Boosaaso uu tallaabadaas gaarsiin karo heer cusub, gaar ahaan haddii Mareykanku dhiso xarun weyn oo uu si madax-bannaan uga howlgeliyo Puntland. Istaraatiijiyad cusub Arrintan waxay kusoo beegmeysaa xilli Mareykanku dib u qaabeynayo qaabka uu Soomaaliya ula macaamilayo. Duqeymaha Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya ayaa aad u kordhay xilligii labaad ee Donald Trump. Responsible Statecraft waxay sheegtay in Mareykanku fuliyay 124 duqeyn sannadkii 2025, halka 78 kale la fuliyay ilaa hadda sanadkan 2026 — tiro aad uga badan heerarkii xukuumaddii Joe Biden. Dhanka kale, Washington ayaa July ku dhawaaqday inaanay taageeri doonin sii socoshada xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee taageera howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya marka oggolaanshaha hadda jira dhammaado 31-ka December. Go’aankaas ayaa walaac ka dhaliyay mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM. Waxa sidaas kasoo baxaya sawir istaraatiijiyadeed oo is beddelaya: Mareykanka oo yareynaya ku tiirsanaanta qaab-dhismeedyada waaweyn ee caalamiga ah, balse dhinaca kale xoojinaya awooddiisa uu si toos ah u fuliyo duqeymo iyo howlgallo gaar ah. Boosaaso arrintaas waxay siineysaa meel ku habboon. Waxay u dhowdahay saldhigyada Daacish ee Puntland, waxay si toos ah ugu foorartaa Gacanka Cadmeed, waxayna u dhowdahay Yemen iyo Baab Al-Mandab xilli Badda Cas ay isu beddeleyso goob dagaal oo sii weynaanaysa. Laakiin faa’iidadaas milateri waxay Washington u yeelan kartaa kharash siyaasadeed. Haddii Mareykanku ballaariyo joogitaankiisa Boosaaso isaga oo heshiiska si toos ah ula galay Puntland xilli xiriirka Garoowe iyo Muqdisho uu marayo heer aad u hooseeya, waxaa sii xoogeysan karta doodda ah in Washington ay dhinac marayso dowladda dhexe, isla markaana ay sii xoojineyso kala fogaanshaha siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Sidaas darteed, waxa ka socda Boosaaso waxaa laga yaabaa inuusan ahayn oo keliya cutub cusub oo dagaalka Mareykanka ee Daacish. Waxay sidoo kale noqon kartaa calaamad muujineysa in xeebaha Soomaaliya ay Washington uga sii gudbayaan goob ay ka fuliso dagaalka argagixisada, una noqonayaan qayb ka mid ah istaraatiijiyad milateri oo ka bilaabanta Geeska Afrika, ka gudubta Gacanka Cadmeed, kuna fidsan Badda Cas iyo colaadda sii ballaaranaysa ee Bariga Dhexe. items.title: Madaxda Xuutiyiinta oo loo daad gureenayo goobo ammaan ah.
items.description: Wargeyska Sacuudiga laga leeyahay ee Asharq Al-Awsat ayaa sheegay in saraakiil ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Iiraan loo daadgureynayo goobo ammaan ah. Wargeysku wuxuu intaas ku daray in taliyeyaasha Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan (IRGC) ay si dhow ula socdaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada kooxda iyo culeyska iyo weerarrada sii kordhaya ee kaga imaanaya kooxda isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo, kaas oo taageera dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, iyadoo la filayo in isbahaysigu uu bartilmaameedsado saraakiisha sare ee Xuutiyiinta ee dhinacyada amniga, milatariga iyo dowladda, taas oo jawaab u ah tallaabooyinkooda. Sacuudiga ayaan weli xaqiijin sheegashada Xuutiyiinta ee ku saabsan weerar lagu qaaday markab militari oo Sacuudigu leeyahay iyo weerarro dhimasho sababay oo lagu qaaday ciidamada Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo ka dhacay deegaannada ay dowladda Yemen maamusho 11-kii Agoosto. Wakaaladda wararka Saba oo ay maamulaan Xuutiyiintu ayaa soo xigatay afhayeenka milatariga kooxda, Yahya Saree, isaga oo sheegay in ciidamada Xuutiyiintu ay qaadeen “weerarro sax ah” oo lagu beegsaday “goobo ay ku urursnaayeen ciidamada cadowga Sacuudiga, bakhaarro hub iyo xarumo talis” oo ku yaalla Al-Mokha iyo xerada Tadaween ee gobolka Ma’rib. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in Xuutiyiintu ay bartilmaameedyadaas ku weerareen tiro badan oo gantaallo ballistic ah iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, ayna dileen dad badan, oo ay ku jiraan muwaadiniin Sacuudiyaan ah. Afhayeenka Xuutiyiinta ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in kooxdu ay sii wadi doonto weerarrada ka dhanka ah ciidamada Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo uu sheegay in loo diray Yemen si ay “u sii xoojiyaan colaadda oo ay ula wareegaan gacan ku haynta dalka”.

items.title: Sababta xasaasiga ah ee Sacuudiga u diiday in Masar ku biirto heshiiska Makkah
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) — Sacuudiga ayaa ka hor yimid in Masar lagu daro isbahaysiga cusub ee difaaca ee uu la saxiixday Turkiga iyo Pakistan, inkasta oo Ankara ay dadaal xooggan ku bixisay sidii Qaahira qayb uga noqon lahayd heshiiska, sida ay sheegeen ilo Sacuudi ah oo arrinta xog-ogaal u ah. Saddex ilo-wareed oo Sacuudi ah oo la hadlay Middle East Eye ayaa sheegay in Riyadh aysan doonayn in Masar ay xilligan ku biirto heshiiska, iyagoo arrinta ku sababeeyey kalsooni-darro sii kordhaysa oo Boqortooyadu ka qabto dowladda Madaxweyne Cabdifataax Al-Sisi iyo waxa ay u aragto hoos u dhac ku yimid miisaankii istiraatiijiyadeed iyo midkii militari ee Qaahira. Mid ka mid ah ilaha, oo hore lataliye sare ugu ahaa boqortooyada Sacuudiga, ayaa sheegay in mowqifka Riyadh uu yahay in Masar aan lagu darin heshiiska “ugu yaraan hadda”. Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makkah waxaa 7-dii Agoosto magaalada barakeysan ee Makkah ku saxiixay Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Maxamed bin Salmaan, Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif. Heshiisku wuxuu dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsado weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. In kasta oo heshiiska loo arko tallaabo weyn oo lagu dhisayo nidaam cusub oo amni oo gobolka ah, haddana faahfaahinta ku saabsan xaaladaha sida tooska ah u dhaqaajinaya waajibaadka difaaca iyo qaabka ciidamada saddexda dal u wada hawlgeli doonaan weli si buuxda looma caddeyn. Reuters ayaa sheegtay in Riyadh ay isbahaysiyo noocan ah u aragto hab ay ku xoojin karto awoodda ay kaga hortagayso khataraha gobolka, gaar ahaan kuwa kaga imanaya Xuutiyiinta Yemen iyo kooxaha kale ee Iran taageerto. Khilaaf soo jiitamayay Ilo-wareedyada Sacuudiga ayaa sheegay in diidmada Masar aysan ka dhalan oo keliya qiimeyn militari, balse ay salka ku hayso caro muddo soo urureysay oo Riyadh ay ka qabto siyaasadaha dowladda Sisi. Sacuudiga wuxuu ka mid ahaa dowladihii ugu weynaa ee dhaqaale ahaan garab istaagay Qaahira markii militariga uu hoggaaminayey Sisi uu 2013 xukunka ka tuuray madaxweynihii hore Maxamed Mursi. Riyadh waxay isla sannadkaas ansixisay gargaar shan bilyan oo dollar ah, iyadoo taageerada Sacuudiga iyo dalal kale oo Khaliijka ah ay sanadaha xigay gaartay balaayiin dollar. Hase yeeshee, ilaha la hadlay Middle East Eye ayaa sheegay in madaxda Sacuudigu aaminsan yihiin in taageeradaas aysan la socon garab istaag siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo u dhigma. Waxay si gaar ah farta ugu fiiqeen doorka Masar ee dagaalkii muddada dheer Sacuudigu kula jiray Xuutiyiinta Yemen, kaas oo ay ku tilmaameen mid “kooban oo aan lagu kalsoonaan karin”. Waxay sidoo kale sheegeen in Riyadh ay ka carootay qaabka Masar ula dhaqantay Imaaraadka Carabta intii uu socday dagaalka Iran, xilli xiriirka Sacuudiga iyo Abu Dhabi uu horey cadaadis xooggan ugu jiray. Masar waxay dalalka Khaliijka u dirtay nidaamyo difaaca cirka ah intii uu socday dagaalka Iran, waxaana diyaaradaha dagaalka Rafale ee Masar la geeyey Imaaraadka, sida uu qoray Wall Street Journal. Hase yeeshee, ilaha Sacuudiga ayaa sheegay in Riyadh ay si gaar ah uga xumaatay in Madaxweyne Sisi uu dhowr jeer xiriir dhow la yeeshay hoggaanka Imaaraadka muddadaas, iyagoo ku doodaya in taageerada Qaahira ee Abu Dhabi ay ka muuqatay mid ka xoog badan tan Riyadh. Doorka Imaaraadka Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa iyadoo xiriirka Sacuudiga iyo Imaaraadka uu sanadkan si weyn uga xumaaday arrimaha Yemen. Khilaafka ayaa si cad usoo baxay markii xoogagga gooni-u-goosadka Koonfurta Yemen ee uu Imaaraadku taageero ay dabayaaqadii 2025 ballaariyeen dhulka ay maamulaan, taas oo horseedday in ciidamo uu Sacuudigu taageero ay tallaabo militari qaadaan. Reuters ayaa xilligaas ku tilmaantay dhacdada khilaaf weyn oo ka dhex qarxay labada quwadood ee Khaliijka. Ilo-wareedyada Middle East Eye ayaa sheegay in Riyadh ay sidoo kale ka walaacsan tahay siyaasado kale oo Imaaraadku ka wado gobolka, kuwaas oo Sacuudigu u arko inay mararka qaar lid ku yihiin danaha Masar lafteeda. Waxay ka mid dhigeen xiriirka istiraatiijiyadeed ee Abu Dhabi iyo Israel, taageerada ay siisay Itoobiya xilliyada khilaafka biyo-xireenka GERD, eedeymaha la xiriira taageerada Ciidamada Gurmadka Degdegga ah ee RSF ee Sudan, iyo joogitaanka iyo maalgashiga Imaaraadka ee Somaliland oo ka tirsan Soomaaliya. Mid ka mid ah ilaha ayaa sheegay in iyadoo siyaasadahaas qaarkood si toos ah u taabanayaan danaha Qaahira, haddana xiriirka dhow ee Sisi iyo Abu Dhabi uu sii kordhiyey shakiga Riyadh ka qabto in Masar tahay saaxiib istiraatiiji ah oo lagu kalsoonaan karo. Rabitaanka Turkiga Mowqifka Sacuudiga ayaa ka duwan kan Turkiga. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga Hakan Fidan ayaa Sabtidii Masar ku tilmaamay “saaxiib dabiici ah”, isagoo sheegay inuu rumeysan yahay in Qaahira mustaqbalka kusoo biiri karto isbahaysiga marka la xalliyo arrimaha farsamo ee haray. Ilo Turki ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Ankara ay si weyn uga shaqeysay sidii Masar loogu dari lahaa heshiiska. Hase yeeshee, ilaha Sacuudiga ayaa meesha ka saaray sheegashada ah in Qaahira lafteedu ay go’aansatay inaysan ku biirin. La-taliyihii hore ee boqortooyada ayaa ku tilmaamay arrintaas mid “lagu qoslo”, isagoo ku dooday in Sisi uu si weyn u daneyn lahaa ka mid noqoshada heshiiska, gaar ahaan faa’iidooyinka siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale ee uu ka heli karo. “Go’aan-qaadayaasha hoggaanka waxay walaac weyn ka qabaan daacadnimada Sisi,” ayuu yiri, isaga oo sheegay in madaxda Sacuudigu aysan u arkin hoggaanka Masar mid lagu aamini karo heerka ay u aaminaan Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Ilaha ayaa sidoo kale ku dooday in Ankara iyo Islamabad ay heshiiska kusoo kordhinayaan awood militari oo Riyadh u aragto mid muuqata. Turkiga wuxuu leeyahay warshado difaac oo si xawli ah u kobcaya, oo ay ka mid yihiin diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo nidaamyo hub oo heer sare ah, halka Pakistan ay leedahay ciidan ballaaran, warshado hub iyo awood nukliyeer. Marka la barbar dhigo labadaas dal, ilaha Sacuudiga ayaa su’aal geliyey heerka ay ciidamada Masar maanta diyaar ugu yihiin dagaal casri ah iyo awoodda warshadaha difaaca ee dalka. Mid ka mid ah ayaa ku dhaliilay militariga Masar inuu waqti iyo dhaqaale badan geliyo ganacsiyo rayid ah, isagoo yiri shaqada ciidanku ay tahay inuu horumariyo “awooddiisa wax-soo-saarka militariga” halkii uu ku mashquuli lahaa maamulidda warshadaha cuntada. Sidaas darteed, sida ay ilaha Sacuudigu sheegeen, diidmada Riyadh ma aha oo keliya khilaaf kala dhexeeya dowladda Sisi, balse waxay qayb ka tahay su’aal weyn oo Sacuudigu iska weydiinayo waxa Masar dhab ahaan kusoo kordhin karto nidaamka cusub ee amniga gobolka. Si kastaba, saddexda ilood waxay sheegeen in albaabka aan gebi ahaanba laga xirin Qaahira. Mowqifka hadda ee Riyadh, ayay sheegeen, waa in Masar bannaanka ka joogto heshiiska, iyadoo suuragalnimada ku biiristeeda mustaqbalka ay ku xirnaan karto isbeddel ku yimaada xiriirka labada dal iyo kalsoonida Sacuudigu ku qabo hoggaanka Masar. Ilaha ayaa sidoo kale ku dooday in Ankara iyo Islamabad ay heshiiska kusoo kordhinayaan awood militari oo Riyadh u aragto mid muuqata. Turkiga wuxuu leeyahay warshado difaac oo si xawli ah u kobcaya, oo ay ka mid yihiin diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo nidaamyo hub oo heer sare ah, halka Pakistan ay leedahay ciidan ballaaran, warshado hub iyo awood nukliyeer. Marka la barbar dhigo labadaas dal, ilaha Sacuudiga ayaa su’aal geliyey heerka ay ciidamada Masar maanta diyaar ugu yihiin dagaal casri ah iyo awoodda warshadaha difaaca ee dalka. Mid ka mid ah ayaa ku dhaliilay militariga Masar inuu waqti iyo dhaqaale badan geliyo ganacsiyo rayid ah, isagoo yiri shaqada ciidanku ay tahay inuu horumariyo “awooddiisa wax-soo-saarka militariga” halkii uu ku mashquuli lahaa maamulidda warshadaha cuntada. Sidaas darteed, sida ay ilaha Sacuudigu sheegeen, diidmada Riyadh ma aha oo keliya khilaaf kala dhexeeya dowladda Sisi, balse waxay qayb ka tahay su’aal weyn oo Sacuudigu iska weydiinayo waxa Masar dhab ahaan kusoo kordhin karto nidaamka cusub ee amniga gobolka. Si kastaba, saddexda ilood waxay sheegeen in albaabka aan gebi ahaanba laga xirin Qaahira. Mowqifka hadda ee Riyadh, ayay sheegeen, waa in Masar bannaanka ka joogto heshiiska, iyadoo suuragalnimada ku biiristeeda mustaqbalka ay ku xirnaan karto isbeddel ku yimaada xiriirka labada dal iyo kalsoonida Sacuudigu ku qabo hoggaanka Masar. items.title: Cumar Cartan oo bog cusub ku qoray magaca Soomaaliya
items.description: Salzburg (Caasimada Online) – Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed Cumar Cabdulqaadir Cartan ayaa waxaa uu noqday garsoorihii ugu horeeyay oo aan Yurubiyaan ahayn ee dhex-dhexaadiya koobka UEFA SUPER CUP, oo ay xalay wada dheeleen Kooxda Paris Saint-Germain F.C. (PSG) iyo Aston Villa. Cartan wuxuu dhigay taariikh cusub oo baal-dabah ah ka gashay xiriirka kubadda Cagta Adduunka, isagoo noqday Garsoorihii ugu horeeyay abid ee loo doortay inuu dhex-dhexaadiyo kulan heer sare ah oo kubadda cagta Yurub ah, wuxuuna magaca Soomaaliya ku qoray bog cusub oo taariikhi ah. Guusha uu xalay gaaray Cumar Cartan kaliya kuma eka tan shaqsiga ah, ee waxa uu calanka Soomaaliya ka lulay masraxyada ugu waaweyn, uguna xiisaha badan dunida kubadda cagta, iyadoo garoonka ay ku cayaarayeen Kooxaha PSG iyo Aston Villa u soo daawasha tageen kumanaan Soomaali ah, markii lasoo gato shucuubtii kale ee dunida, si ay u taageeraan Garsoore Cumar Cartan, una lulaan calamka Jamhuuriyadda. Sidoo kale, dunida Kubadda Cagta ayaa ugu hambalyeysay Garsoore Cumar Cartan sida miisaanka leh ee uu u garsooray ciyaarta weyn ee koobka UEFA SUPER CUP, waxaana ka mid ahaa: Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Adduunka UEFA oo qoray “Cumar Cartan waxa uu noqday garsoorihii ugu horeeyay ee aan Qaaradda Yurub kasoo jeedin ee Garsoore ka noqda Finalka UEFA SUPER CUP,” magaca Soomaaliya iyo Afrika oo dhan ayuuna ku qoray bogga Taariikhiga ah ee Kubadda Cagta. Dhanka kale, halyeygii hore ee xulka Talyaaniga iyo kooxda Juventus Gianluigi Buffon ayaa ugu hambalyeeyay sida quruxda badan ee Garoore Cumar Cartan u dhex-dhexaadiyay Koobka UEFA SUPER CUP ee ay xalay ku guuleysatay Kooxda reer France ee PSG, isagoo yiri ”Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed Cumar Cartan xalay Kubadda Cagtu waxay siisay mudnaantii uu lahaa.” Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Afrika ee CAF ayaa isna hambalyo u diray Cumar Cabdulqaadir Cartan guusha taariikhiga ah ee uu xalay ka sameeyay Masraxyada Kubadda Cagta Adduunka iyo sida uu uga soo dhalaalay ciyaartii weyneed ee UEFA SUPER CUP. “Garsoore Cumar Cartan wuxuu Afrika ku metelay Masraxa Kubadda Cagta Adduunka, waana Garsoorihii ugu horeeyay ee Soomaaliyeed ee taariikh ka dhigay Koobka UEFA SUPER CUP, isagoo noqday garsoorihii ugu horeeyay ee Qaaradda Yurub aan kasoo jeedin ee qabta kulankan oo kale, Soomaaliya iyo Afrika ayuuna sharaf ku metelay, guul wayn oo xasuus mudan ayuu Cartan dhigay,” ayaa lagu qoraalka Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Afrika ee CAF. Cumar Cabduqaadir Cartan oo 34 jir ah ayaa ku jira liiska Garsoorayaasha caalamiga ah ee FIFA tan iyo sannadkii 2018. Sannadkii 2025-ka ayaa loo magacaabay Garsooraha ugu fiican Afrika, isaga oo noqday mid ka mid ah garsoorayaasha ugu sarreeya qaaradda Afrika iyo guud ahaan caalamka, waxaana sidoo kale muddadii uu ku jiray garsoorka uu dhex-dhexaadiyay kulamo badan oo heer caalami ah. Si kastaba, Guusha Cumar Cartan ayaa si gaar ah muhiim u noqotay marka la xuso dhacdadii dhowaan ka horreysay ee uu ku waayay fursaddii uu kaga qeyb geli lahaa Koobka Adduunka 2026, kaddib markii Mareykanka uu u diiday inuu dalka galo, inkastoo uu haystay fiiso sax ah. Mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka ayaa xilligaas ku sababeeyay go’aanka walaac la xiriiray xaqiijinta xogtiisa, halka FIFA ay markii dambe xaqiijisay inuusan ka qeyb geli karin tartanka. items.title: Duqeymaha Mareykanka ee Yemen oo sababay dhimashada 153 qof
items.description: Qiimeyn ay samaysay Wasaaradda Difaaca Mareykanka ayaa lagu sheegay in duqeymo ay ciidamada Mareykanku ka fuliyeen Yemen sannadkii 2025 ay sababeen dhimashada 153 qof oo rayid ah, halka 243 qof oo kale ay ku dhaawacmeen. Warbixinta Pentagon-ka oo aan sir ahayn ayaa muujinaysa in dhammaan khasaaraha rayidka ah ee ay ciidamada Mareykanku diiwaangeliyeen sannadkaas uu ka dhashay saddex weerar oo dhacay bishii Abriil 2025. Saddexda duqeymood ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday goobo ay ku sugnaayeen ciidamada Xuutiyiinta iyo deegaanada ku dhow caasimadda Sanca, iyo sidoo kale dekedda shidaalka ee Ras Ciise ee gobolka Xudeyda. Weerarkii ugu khasaaraha badnaa wuxuu ka dhacay dekedda Ras Ciise, halkaas oo sida qiimeynta Pentagon-ka lagu sheegay ay ku dhinteen 80 qof, halka 171 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa xilligaas sheegay in weerarka Ras Ciise uu ahaa mid lagu jarayay il shidaal iyo dhaqaale oo ay Xuutiyiintu ka heli jireen dekedda, ayadoo Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka (CENTCOM) uu sidoo kale sheegay in ujeeddadu aysan ahayn waxyeellada shacabka Yemen. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qiimeyntii Pentagon-ka ayaa markii dambe lagu ogaaday in saddexda weerar ay u badan tahay inay sababeen waxyeello loo geystay rayid, iyadoo qiimeynta lagu saleeyay xog sirdoon, sawirro iyo warbixinno laga helay ilo furan. Tirada khasaaraha ayaa si weyn uga badan tii sanadkii 2024, markaas oo Pentagon-ku qiimeeyay in hawlgallada ciidamada Mareykanka ay Yemen ka fuliyeen ay dileen laba qof oo rayid ah, halka laba kalena ay dhaawacmeen. Pentagon-ku wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in aan la bixin magdhowga tacsiyeed ee loo yaqaan condolence payments dadka ku dhintay ama qoysaskooda, inkastoo warbixintu aysan si faahfaahsan u sharxin sababta go’aankaas. Dhanka kale, khasaaraha rayidka ah ee ka dhashay duqeymaha Mareykanka ee Yemen ayaa laga yaabaa inuu kordho, iyadoo CENTCOM ay ilaa Febraayo 2026 dib u eegis ku waday 15 dhacdo oo kale oo hay’adaha aan dowliga ahayn ay ku soo warrameen inay ahayd khasaaro rayid. Duqeymaha Mareykanka ee Yemen waxay billowdeen xilligii madaxweyne Joe Biden, kaddib markii Xuutiyiintu bilaabeen weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ah oo lagu qaaday maraakiib ganacsi oo mara Badda Cas. Qiimeyntan cusub ee Pentagon-ka ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli si weyn loo eegayo saameynta rayidka ee hawlgallada milatari ee Mareykanka, gaar ahaan siyaasadda maamulka madaxweyne Donald Trump ee ku aaddan weerarrada dibadda.

items.title: Faahfaahinno dheeraad ah oo ka soo baxaya Howlgal ka dhacay degmada Maxaas ee Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Ciidanka Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA), oo taageero ka helaya saaxiibada caalamka, ayaa xalay howlgal ka fuliyay degmada Maxaas ee Gobolka Hiiraan, sida lagu sheegay war ay soo saartay NISA. Howlgalka ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday guri la sheegay in ay ku sugnaayeen xubno sare oo ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab, kuwaas oo sida ay NISA sheegtay muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ka waday deegaannada gobolka qorsheyn iyo abaabul la xiriira dagaallo. Wararka kasoo baxay hay’adda ayaa sheegaya in howlgalka lagu gaarsiiyay kooxda khasaaro xooggan, iyadoo bartilmaameedku ahaa xubno muhiim u ahaa hoggaanka iyo isku-dubbaridka howlgallada kooxda ee gobolka. Howlgalka ayaa qeyb ka ah howlgallo sirdoon oo ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya ay ka wadaan qaybo ka mid ah dalka, gaar ahaan deegaannada Bartamaha iyo Koonfurta dalka. NISA ayaa bilihii u dambeeyay dhowr jeer sheegtay in howlgallo noocan ah lagu bartilmaameedsaday xubno sare iyo xarumo ay kooxda ku lahayd Gobolka Hiiraan iyo meelo kale.

items.title: Qorrax-madoobaad buuxa oo Yurub qaybo ka mid ah mugdi geliyay
items.description: Malaayiin qof ayaa Arbacadii u soo baxay inay daawadaan dhacdo naadir ah oo cirka ah, kaddib markii qorrax-madoobaad buuxa uu daboolay qaybo ka mid ah Yurub, maalintiina isu beddeshay mugdi. Qorrax-madoobaadkan ayaa ahaa kii ugu horreeyay ee noociisa ah ee laga arko qaaradda Yurub tan iyo 1999-kii, iyadoo madoobaadku uu ka soo gudbay dhulka Arctic-ga, Greenland iyo Iceland, ka hor inta uusan gaarin waqooyiga Spain iyo qayb yar oo waqooyi-bari boortaqiiska ah. Markii dayaxu uu si buuxda u hor istaagay qorraxda, meelaha ku jiray jidka madoobaadka waxaa muddo ku dhow laba daqiiqo ka dhacay mugdi aan caadi ahayn, waxaana cirka ka muuqday hareeraha iftiinka qorraxda ee loo yaqaan corona. Qorrax-madoobaadka qayb ahaan ah ayaa isna laga arkay qaybo badan oo Yurub ah iyo meelo ka tirsan Waqooyiga Afrika iyo Waqooyiga Ameerika. Spain ayaa ka mid ahayd meelihii ugu muhiimsanaa ee lagu daawaday dhacdadan, ayadoo kumannaan dad ah ay isugu soo baxeen goobo kala duwan, halka qaar badan ay safarro gaar ah ku tageen dhulka uu maro jidka madoobaadka buuxa. Wararka laga helayo Spain ayaa sheegay in dadku ay si weyn ugu riyaaqeen markii cirka uu mugdi galay, waxaana loo arkayay dhacdo taariikhi ah oo dhif iyo naadir ah. Dhanka Iceland, dad badan ayaa iyaguna sugayay qorrax-madoobaadka, inkastoo xaaladaha cimiladu meelaha qaar ay adkeeyeen in si cad loo daawado. Qaybo ka mid ah dalka ayaa helay fursad wanaagsan oo lagu arko dhacdada, halka daruuruhu ay meelaha kale daboolayeen muuqaalka. Qorrax-madoobaadku wuxuu sidoo kale soo jiitay indhaha khubarada cilmiga xiddigiska, sawir-qaadayaasha iyo dalxiisayaasha, kuwaas oo fursad u helay inay diiwaangeliyaan mid ka mid ah dhacdooyinka cirka ee ugu cajiibsan sannadka 2026. Dhacdadan ayaa xusuus gaar ah ku yeelatay dadka ku nool Yurub, maadaama qorrax-madoobaad buuxa oo qaaradda laga arko uu yahay dhacdo aan si joogto ah u dhicin. Si kastaba ha ahaatee qorrax-madoobaadka 12-ka Agoosto 2026 wuxuu noqday muuqaal dabiici ah oo malaayiin qof ay si toos ah ama sawirro iyo muuqaallo uga daawadeen, iyadoo qaybo ka mid ah Yurub ay muddo kooban la kulmeen mugdi ku dhacay bartamaha maalinta.

Qorrax-madoobaadka qayb ahaan ah ayaa isna laga arkay qaybo badan oo Yurub ah iyo meelo ka tirsan Waqooyiga Afrika iyo Waqooyiga Ameerika. Spain ayaa ka mid ahayd meelihii ugu muhiimsanaa ee lagu daawaday dhacdadan, ayadoo kumannaan dad ah ay isugu soo baxeen goobo kala duwan, halka qaar badan ay safarro gaar ah ku tageen dhulka uu maro jidka madoobaadka buuxa. Wararka laga helayo Spain ayaa sheegay in dadku ay si weyn ugu riyaaqeen markii cirka uu mugdi galay, waxaana loo arkayay dhacdo taariikhi ah oo dhif iyo naadir ah. Dhanka Iceland, dad badan ayaa iyaguna sugayay qorrax-madoobaadka, inkastoo xaaladaha cimiladu meelaha qaar ay adkeeyeen in si cad loo daawado. Qaybo ka mid ah dalka ayaa helay fursad wanaagsan oo lagu arko dhacdada, halka daruuruhu ay meelaha kale daboolayeen muuqaalka. Qorrax-madoobaadku wuxuu sidoo kale soo jiitay indhaha khubarada cilmiga xiddigiska, sawir-qaadayaasha iyo dalxiisayaasha, kuwaas oo fursad u helay inay diiwaangeliyaan mid ka mid ah dhacdooyinka cirka ee ugu cajiibsan sannadka 2026. Dhacdadan ayaa xusuus gaar ah ku yeelatay dadka ku nool Yurub, maadaama qorrax-madoobaad buuxa oo qaaradda laga arko uu yahay dhacdo aan si joogto ah u dhicin. Si kastaba ha ahaatee qorrax-madoobaadka 12-ka Agoosto 2026 wuxuu noqday muuqaal dabiici ah oo malaayiin qof ay si toos ah ama sawirro iyo muuqaallo uga daawadeen, iyadoo qaybo ka mid ah Yurub ay muddo kooban la kulmeen mugdi ku dhacay bartamaha maalinta.

items.title: As the Iran-backed Houthis step up their threat to Red Sea shipping, analysts say the U.S. could consider a major change in strategy.
items.description: JOHANNESBURG: As the Iran-backed Houthis step up their threat to Red Sea shipping, analysts say the U.S. could consider a major change in strategy. Houthi attacks on ships passing through a vital chokepoint may lead Washington to cement relations with more reliable partners along Africa ’s coastline. Somaliland is a pro-U.S. outpost, having broken away from war-torn Somalia in 1991, and is offering the U.S. the use of one of the longest runways in Africa, an air base and a deep sea port on the Red Sea. IRAN AND HOUTHI TERROR PROXY FACING RED SEA THREAT FROM PRO-US AFRICAN NATION An aerial view of The Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a sea route connecting the Indian Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea via the Suez Canal. (Gallo Images/Orbital Horizon/Copernicus Sentinel Data 2021) The Houthis have vowed to close the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait, a narrow waterway through which Saudi Arabia exports up to 7 million barrels of oil a day, now that access to the Strait of Hormuz is severely restricted. In the past month in the Red Sea, the Houthis have reportedly attacked Saudi-flagged ships, are said to have sunk an Indian commercial cargo vessel and, on Aug. 13, an Egyptian cargo ship was hit, with at least four of its crew killed. The U.S. already has a large military base on the Red Sea in Djibouti, but this is claimed to be increasingly problematic. “China is significantly expanding its military and commercial presence in Djibouti, ” Edmund Fitton-Brown previously told Fox News Digital. Fitton-Brown, the former British ambassador to the Houthis’ home country, Yemen, and a senior fellow at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies, (FDD), added, “There is a sense that Djibouti is not a reliable ally for the U.S. So Somaliland’s time has probably come.”Major General Ken Ekman, who retired last year from being the Department of War’s West Africa Coordination Element Lead, said, in essence, the Houthis could force the U.S. into recognizing Somaliland as an independent state. “The Houthis could compel a different U.S. strategy in Africa.” Fox News

items.title: Strategic shift:  Could Somaliland be the key to U.S. strategy in the Horn of Africa?
items.description: As Iran-backed Houthi attacks disrupt Red Sea shipping and traditional allies like Djibouti align closer with China, experts argue Washington needs a strategic pivot. Speaking to Fox News Digital, Bashir Goth, Somaliland Representative to the U.S., highlighted Somaliland’s potential role as a key regional partner: “Somaliland is that partner and our defense officials have been in active dialogue with AFRICOM on Red Sea security. Somaliland has the geography, the stability and the will to work closely with Washington — and will continue to do so.” Fox news

items.title: Somaliland iyo Israel oo yeeshay wada-hadallo cusub
items.description: Dubai (Caasimada Online) – Safiirka Israa’iil u fadhiya Imaaraadka Carabta, Yossi Shelley iyo Wakiilka Somaliland ee Imaaraadka, Mascuud Cabdi Cali ayaa yeeshay kulan ay uga wada-hadleen fursadaha ka abuurmay xiriirka cusub ee u dhexeeya maamulka Somaliland iyo Israa’iil. Shelley ayaa qoraal uu ku baahiyay barta X ku sheegay in kulanka lagu gorfeeyay xoojinta iskaashiga dhaqaale iyo sidii loo horumarin lahaa xiriirka labada dhinac, kaddib markii Israa’iil ay noqotay waddankii ugu horreeyay ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada maamulka Somaliland inuu yahay dal madax-bannaan. Safiirka ayaa sheegay in wakiilka Somaliland uu si weyn u soo dhaweeyay go’aanka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu ee aqoonsiga Somaliland. Wuxuu tallaabadaasi ku tilmaamay mid geesinimo leh oo muhiim u ah dadaalka Somaliland ee raadinta aqoonsi caalami ah. Shelley ayaa sidoo kale shaaciyay in Mascuud Cabdi Cali uu u fidiyay martiqaad uu ku booqdo Somaliland. Safiirka ayaa xusay rajadiisa in dalal kale ay ku daydaan tallaabada ay Israa’iil qaaday, ayna Somaliland aqoonsadaan, inkastoo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay si adag uga hortagayso in dalal kale ku dhiiraadaan tallaabada Tel Aviv oo kale. “Waxaan rajeynayaa in aan dhisno iskaashi xooggan oo aan ku horumarino xasilloonida gobolka,” ayuu yiri Yossi Shelley. Kulanka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli maamulka Somaliland uu waddo dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo uu doonayo inuu ku helo aqoonsi caalami ah, iyadoo xiriirro cusub la sameysanaysa dalal iyo dhinacyo kala duwan oo caalami ah. Si kastaba, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si adag uga soo horjeedda aqoonsiga Somaliland, waxayna waddaa dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo looga hortagayo in dalal kale ay raacaan tallaabada Israa’iil, iyadoo Muqdisho ku adkaysanayso midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. The post Somaliland iyo Israel oo yeeshay wada-hadallo cusub appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ethiopia’s Tigray Crisis Could Reshape Somalia’s Security Landscape as Regional Fault Lines Deepen
items.description: By Abdikarim H. Abdi Buh A dangerous new chapter may be opening in the Horn of Africa. Renewed tensions between Ethiopia’s federal government and the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) are raising fears of another major conflict in northern Ethiopia—one that could extend far beyond Tigray and potentially reshape the security architecture of neighboring Somalia. For Somalia, the question is particularly consequential: what happens if Ethiopia suddenly needs thousands of troops that are currently deployed across the border? That possibility is no longer merely an abstract strategic concern. Tensions between Addis Ababa and the TPLF have intensified following the TPLF’s return to political dominance in Tigray and the weakening of the transitional administration supported by the federal government. The developments have further strained the fragile political understanding created by the 2022 Pretoria peace agreement, which ended two years of devastating war. New clashes in western Tigray have added to concerns that the peace agreement is under its most serious pressure since it was signed. A return to full-scale war would be disastrous for Ethiopia. But its consequences could also be felt across the wider region—including in Somalia, where Ethiopian troops remain a critical component of the country’s security architecture. The Somalia Question Ethiopia has maintained a substantial military presence in Somalia for years, including forces operating along the two countries’ border and troops participating in the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia, AUSSOM. Those forces have become an important part of the regional security equation. Somalia remains heavily dependent on international security assistance while its own security forces continue the difficult process of assuming responsibility for national security. AUSSOM remains a key component of that transition. This creates an uncomfortable strategic reality. If fighting in Tigray escalates to the point where Addis Ababa requires additional troops at home, Ethiopian commanders may face difficult choices about force deployments outside the country. Some Ethiopian troops currently serving in Somalia could potentially be reassigned to domestic priorities. There is, however, no confirmed evidence that Ethiopia has decided to withdraw its forces from Somalia because of the Tigray crisis. Any large-scale redeployment should therefore be treated as a potential scenario rather than an established policy. But in geopolitics, possibilities can be consequential long before they become official decisions. A reduction in Ethiopian forces could create additional pressure on Somalia’s already fragile security transition—particularly at a time when the future financing and international support structure surrounding AUSSOM remains uncertain. A Regional Crisis Waiting to Connect The Tigray crisis cannot be viewed in isolation. One of the most worrying dimensions is the rapidly deteriorating relationship between Ethiopia and Eritrea. The two countries were once close military partners during the 2020–2022 Tigray war, when Eritrean forces fought alongside Ethiopian federal forces against the TPLF. That alliance has since collapsed. Relations between Addis Ababa and Asmara have deteriorated sharply, with disputes involving Eritrean troops in Ethiopian territory, border questions, and Ethiopia’s increasingly explicit interest in securing reliable access to the Red Sea. For Eritrea, Ethiopia’s ambitions on the Red Sea are not simply an economic question. They touch directly on sovereignty and national security. Ethiopia has been landlocked since Eritrea became independent, making reliable access to a Red Sea port strategically important to Addis Ababa. Asmara, meanwhile, has every reason to be wary of an increasingly powerful neighbor seeking a permanent maritime foothold. That makes the Tigray crisis particularly dangerous. A confrontation between Addis Ababa and the TPLF could create opportunities for Eritrea to exert pressure on Ethiopia indirectly—or potentially become involved more directly if its security interests are threatened. The result could be a regional equation in which former enemies become temporary partners because their interests happen to converge. The Enemy of My Enemy? The irony is striking. Eritrea and the TPLF spent decades as bitter enemies. Their confrontation culminated in the devastating 1998–2000 Ethiopia-Eritrea war and later the Tigray conflict. Yet today’s geopolitical landscape is radically different. The principal strategic relationship is no longer simply Eritrea versus TPLF. It is increasingly Eritrea versus an Ethiopian government whose regional ambitions have become a source of concern in Asmara. That distinction matters. TPLF’s political and military resurgence, combined with worsening Ethiopia-Eritrea relations, could create an unexpected convergence of interests—even if no formal alliance exists between the parties. Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has repeatedly warned about external and internal forces seeking to destabilize his government, with Tigray and Eritrea featuring prominently in the government’s security calculations. Meanwhile, reports and assessments have pointed to renewed military mobilization inside Tigray, adding to fears that the Pretoria agreement could be approaching a critical breaking point. Sudan Adds Another Layer of Danger Then there is Sudan. The Horn of Africa’s security crises increasingly overlap. Tigray, Eritrea and Sudan sit within a strategic triangle connecting the Nile Basin, the Red Sea and the wider Horn of Africa. A renewed Ethiopian conflict could therefore interact with Sudan’s devastating civil war and produce consequences that are difficult to contain. A new war in Tigray could generate additional displacement, disrupt cross-border trade, increase arms flows and create new opportunities for armed groups operating across porous borders. What begins as an Ethiopian domestic conflict could rapidly acquire regional characteristics. That is precisely what makes the current situation so alarming. For Somalia, the first and most immediate concern would be security. If Ethiopia were forced to move substantial numbers of troops from Somalia back toward Tigray or other vulnerable areas, Somalia could face a reduction in one of the most significant external military contingents supporting its security environment. That would happen at a particularly difficult moment. Somalia is still confronting Al-Shabaab, while its security institutions remain heavily dependent on international assistance, training, intelligence and logistical support. A sudden reduction in Ethiopian forces could therefore create security gaps in areas where Somali forces are not yet capable of independently replacing them. It could also complicate AUSSOM’s broader transition strategy. The mission is already operating in an environment where questions about financing, troop contributions and long-term international support remain unresolved. A major Ethiopian redeployment would add another layer of uncertainty. The Bigger Horn of Africa Picture The implications extend beyond troop numbers. Ethiopia is one of the most powerful states in the Horn of Africa. Eritrea controls a strategically important stretch of Red Sea coastline. Sudan is engulfed in a devastating civil war. Somalia sits beside the Gulf of Aden and the Bab el-Mandeb, one of the world’s most important maritime corridors. Together, these countries form a geopolitical chain linking East Africa, the Red Sea, the Arabian Peninsula and the Indian Ocean. A major conflict in one part of that chain rarely remains isolated for long. For Somalia, the danger is particularly acute because the country is still rebuilding its security institutions while simultaneously confronting a persistent insurgency. The last thing Mogadishu needs is a sudden deterioration in the regional security environment or a significant reduction in the foreign forces currently helping to contain militant threats. No War Yet—but the Warning Signs Are Growing. It would be premature to declare that Ethiopia is heading inevitably toward another full-scale Tigray war. The federal government retains substantial military capabilities, and political and diplomatic mechanisms remain available to prevent further escalation. But the warning signs are difficult to ignore. The return of TPLF political influence in Tigray, renewed clashes, reported military mobilization, worsening relations between Addis Ababa and Asmara, and the unresolved question of Ethiopia’s Red Sea ambitions have combined to create one of the most volatile strategic environments in the Horn of Africa in years. The Pretoria agreement was supposed to close the chapter on Ethiopia’s devastating internal war. Instead, the region is now watching to see whether its fragile peace can survive a new generation of political and military confrontation. For Somalia, the stakes could hardly be higher. A renewed Ethiopian conflict could alter the deployment of Ethiopian forces, reshape AUSSOM’s security calculations, strengthen regional rivalries and create new opportunities for Al-Shabaab to exploit security gaps. The lesson for Mogadishu is therefore sobering. Somalia cannot afford to build its security strategy on the assumption that Ethiopia will always have enough troops to protect its own borders and simultaneously carry the burden of security beyond them. If war returns to Tigray, Somalia may discover that a conflict hundreds of kilometers away can suddenly become a crisis on its own doorstep. And in the Horn of Africa, that distance can disappear remarkably quickly. Abdikarim H. items.title: Xasan oo weeraray mucaaradka, kuna tilmaamay hoggaamiye kooxeed
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa si weyn u weeraray siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka oo ayagu kasoo horjeeda hanaanka doorasho ee dowladda wado. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay u baahan tahay nidaam qeexaya cidda dalka mas’uulka ka ah iyo habka go’aannada loo gaarayo, isagoo muujiyay aragtidiisa in la dhiso nidaam siyaasadeed oo cad iyo hay’ado awood leh oo qaata go’aannada qaranka. Xasan ayaa tilmaamay in weli ay jiraan siyaasiyiin uu sheegay inay ku faanayaan inay yihiin hoggaamiye-kooxeedyo, taas oo uu tilmaamay inay jahawareer ku keeni karto hannaanka siyaasadeed ee dalka iyo cidda leh awoodda sharciyeed ee go’aannada qaranka. “Dadka Soomaaliyeed waxaan leeyahay kaca oo baraaruga, kaca oo baraaruga. Nidaam sameysta. Siyaasaddu waa waxa aad haysataan. Dhaqaaluhu wuu socdaa, dadku way ganacsanayaan, tacliintuna way sii horumareysaa, laakiin meeshii ay gaari lahayd weli ma gaarin,” ayuu Madaxweyne Xasan ka sheegay munaasabad ka qabsoomtay magaalada Muqdisho. Sidoo kale wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in siyaasadda iyo arrimaha kale ee dalka aysan ku socon karin go’aanno shaqsiyeed, balse loo baahan yahay hannaan iyo hay’ado awood u leh inay si cad u qaataan mas’uuliyadda go’aannada dalka. “Haddii aynaan toosin siyaasadda dalka, haddii aynaan aqoon cidda dalka masuulka ka ah, qof ma aha, hay’adda masuulka ka ah ee go’aanka u gaaraysa ummadda iyo sida ay ugu gaarayso, horumar ma gaari karno,” ayuu yiri. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in amnigu yahay saldhigga lagu dhisi karo waxbarashada, dhaqaalaha iyo horumarka bulshada. “Amnigu waa geed-qaadkii beerta lagu diyaarinayay. Kadib ayaan beeraynaa waxbarasho, dhaqaale, sharaf iyo karaamo,” ayuu yiri madaxweynaha. Ugu dambeyntiina, Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in awoodda ugu weyn ee ummaddu aysan ku jirin oo keliya kheyraadka dabiiciga ah, dhismayaasha dhaadheer ama hubka, balse ay ku jirto aqoonta iyo tayada dadkeeda, isagoo tusaale u soo qaatay Japan oo uu sheegay inay horumarkeeda ku dhistay dadka iyo aqoonta. items.title: Ethiopia Reportedly Asks AU to Accelerate Withdrawal of Its Troops from Somalia
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — In a potentially significant shift in Somalia’s security landscape, Ethiopia has reportedly asked the African Union to accelerate the withdrawal and redeployment of some of its troops serving under the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), prompting the AU to reconsider its previously agreed force-redeployment timetable. The reported request has caught observers by surprise because Ethiopia was not initially expected to significantly reduce its military footprint in Somalia at this stage of the AUSSOM transition. Under the earlier planning framework, greater attention had been placed on reducing Ugandan forces and completing the withdrawal of the remaining Burundian contingent, while Ethiopian forces were expected to maintain a substantial presence in several strategically important areas. That calculation now appears to be changing. According to information emerging from diplomatic and security circles, Addis Ababa’s request is linked to mounting security pressures inside Ethiopia, forcing the government to reassess how many troops it can continue to deploy abroad and where those forces are most urgently required. The first visible indication of the reported shift came on 8 August, when Ethiopian forces formally handed responsibility for one of their military positions in Buurhakaba to Somali security forces. The handover is being viewed as part of a broader restructuring of Ethiopia’s military deployment in Somalia, with additional positions reportedly under consideration for transfer to Somali forces. There are also indications that the number of Ethiopian troops stationed in Baidoa, one of the most strategically important cities in Southwest State, could be reduced. That development is particularly significant given the continuing security threat posed by Al-Shabaab in Bay and surrounding areas. Why Ethiopia Wants Its Troops Back Ethiopia has maintained a substantial military presence in Somalia for years, particularly in areas close to its border and in regions where Somali and international forces have been conducting operations against Al-Shabaab. But Addis Ababa is now confronting its own complicated security environment. Internal security pressures, military commitments and regional tensions are placing new demands on Ethiopia’s armed forces. If those pressures continue to intensify, maintaining a large overseas deployment in Somalia could become increasingly difficult. The reported request therefore appears to reflect a broader reassessment of Ethiopia’s military priorities rather than simply a routine adjustment to the AUSSOM rotation schedule. The timing could hardly be more sensitive. AUSSOM is already undergoing a complicated transition aimed at gradually transferring greater responsibility for national security to Somali forces. Any accelerated reduction by one of the mission’s major troop-contributing countries could disrupt that carefully calibrated process. Ethiopian forces constitute one of the most significant military components supporting Somalia’s security architecture. Their departure from strategically important bases would therefore raise immediate questions about who will take over those positions and whether Somali forces are adequately prepared to assume full responsibility. The concern is particularly acute around Baidoa and the wider Southwest State, where Al-Shabaab continues to maintain operational capabilities and exploit gaps in state security. Could Al-Shabaab Exploit the Vacuum? For Somalia, the greatest danger is not simply the departure of Ethiopian soldiers. It is what happens after they leave. If Ethiopian forces withdraw from strategically important locations faster than Somali forces can replace them, Al-Shabaab could attempt to exploit the resulting security gaps. The Somali government may consequently be forced to accelerate the deployment of national forces to positions vacated by Ethiopian troops. Other AUSSOM contingents could also face pressure to increase their presence in vulnerable areas if the AU wants to prevent a sudden deterioration in security. That would, however, place additional pressure on an already financially and logistically constrained mission. A Significant Test for Somalia’s Security Transition The reported Ethiopian request comes at a particularly delicate moment for Somalia. The Federal Government is under increasing pressure to demonstrate that its security forces can progressively assume responsibility for the country’s security as international forces reduce their presence. For years, Ethiopia’s military has provided a crucial layer of security in parts of Somalia that Somali forces have struggled to secure independently. A substantial and accelerated Ethiopian redeployment would therefore represent one of the most consequential tests yet of Somalia’s security transition. The immediate questions are now becoming increasingly urgent: How many Ethiopian troops will actually leave? Which bases will be transferred? When will Somali forces take over? And will other AUSSOM contingents compensate for the reduction? For now, neither the African Union nor the Somali Federal Government has publicly confirmed the full scale of the reported Ethiopian request. If the reports are confirmed, however, Ethiopia’s decision could mark a major change in the architecture of AUSSOM—one that comes at precisely the moment Somalia can least afford an unexpected security gap. The real test will not be Ethiopia’s decision to reduce its deployment. It will be whether Somalia is ready to fill the space Ethiopia leaves behind. items.title: Sacdiya Bajaaj Released After Appeals Court Overturns Prison Term
items.description: MOGADISHU — The Banadir Regional Court of Appeal has overturned a three-year prison sentence imposed on Sacdiya Macallin Ali, widely known as Sacdiya Bajaaj, leading to her release from custody on Wednesday. Sacdiya was sentenced to three years in prison in late June following an earlier court ruling. Her legal team subsequently appealed the decision, requesting that the appellate court review and overturn the sentence. The Banadir Regional Court of Appeal recently heard submissions from Sacdiya’s lawyers, who presented the grounds for their appeal and challenged the earlier judgment. Following its review of the case, the court announced on Wednesday that it had annulled the previous ruling, effectively restoring Sacdiya’s freedom. Hours before the decision was announced, members of Sacdiya’s family had appealed to the Banadir Regional Court of Appeal to overturn the earlier sentence and order her release. The ruling marks a significant development in the case, bringing an end to the three-year sentence previously imposed on Sacdiya Bajaaj. items.title: Maxay mucaaradka DF ka yiraahdeen sii-deynta Sacdiyo Bajaaj?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ayaa si diirran u soo dhaweeyay sii-deynta Sacdiyo Macallin Cali (Sacdiyo Bajaaj) oo maanta dib u heshay xoriyadeeda. Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka, Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa sheegay in adkeysiga Sacdiyo uu shidaal cusub ku sii shubayo dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed ee u taagan inay si xor ah u muujiyaan, dareenkooda iyo aragtidooda ku aaddan hab-nololeedkooda iyada oo aysan joojin karin awood sheegasho kasta oo lagu lagula kaco. “Waxaan ku faraxsanahay in Sacdiya Macallin Cali ay maanta xorriyadeeda dib u heshay, kadib muddo afar bilood ah oo ay si dulmi ah ugu xirneed nidaamka muddo-xileedkiisu dhammaaday,” ayuu yiri Shariifka. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray: “Waxaan sidoo kale oo u mahadcelinayaa dhallinyarada caasimadda, warbaahinta iyo cid kasta oo garab-istaag u muujisay Sacdiyo Macallin islamarkaana ka dhiidhisay ku takri-falka iyo cabburinta Madaxweynihii hore Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu ku hayo shacabka gaar ahaan dhallinyarada.” Shariif ayaa sidoo kale waxa uu ku dhiirrigaliyay dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed meel walba oo ay joogaan inay muujiyaan isku duubni, adkeysi iyo midnimo. Dhanka kale, Cabdiraxmaan Cabdishakuur Warsame oo kamid ah siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ayaa isna soo dhaweeyay sii-deynta Sacdiyo, isagoo eedeymo u jeediyay hoggaanka tallada haya ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. “Adkaysiga Sacdiyo, iyo ku dhaca Garsoore Cabdifitaax waxay abuurayaan rajo iyo yididiilo. Waxay ina tusayaan in Soomaaliya ay weli leedahay dhalinyaro wanaagsan, mabda’ leh oo geesiyaal ah, kuwaas oo aan damiirkooda iyo mabaadi’dooda ku iibsan xil, xoolo ama dano gaar ah,” ayuu yiri Cabdiraxmaan Cabdishakuur. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray: “Waxaa jira kuwa la mid ah Garsoore Cabdifitaax oo ku jira garsoorka, shaqaalaha rayidka ah, diblomaasiyadda iyo ciidamada oo aaminsan in sharciga, caddaaladda iyo danta qaranku ay ka weyn yihiin qof iyo xukunkiis. Taasi waa dhiirrigelin, waa rajo, waana yididiilo.” Go’aanka Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Racfaanka Gobolka Banaadir ayuu sheegay inuu cashar weyn ugu jiro “kuwa sharaftooda iyo damiirkooda u loogay raalli-gelinta taliska Xasan Sheekh si ay xil, xoolo iyo awood u helaan,” sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Ugu dambeyntiina, Warsame ayaa tilmaamay in awoodda, xilka iyo xooluhu yihiin ku-meel-gaar, balse taariikhdu ay xusuus dheertahay, isla markaana ay xusto kuwa adkaystay, geesinimada muujiyey, una istaagay xaqa markii uu waqtigu ugu adkaa. Maxkamadda Racfaanka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa maanta xorriyadeeda dib u siisay Sacdiya Macallin Cali (Sacdiya Bajaaj) oo ay horay Maxkamadda Gobolka ugu soo xukuntay saddex sano oo xarig ah. Qareennada difaacayay Sacdiya ayaa soo qaatay racfaan, kadibna waxaa guda gashay Maxkamadda Racfaanka Gobolka Banaadir oo maanta burisay xukunkii hore, iyada oo sheegtay in aan loo cuskan asbaab sharci ah. Garsooraha Maxkamadda ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay xor tahay Sacdiya Bajaaj oo in ka badan 100 maalmood ku xirneyd Xabsiga Dhexe ee Xamar. items.title: After 122 Days Behind Bars, “Sacdiya Bajaaj” Walks Free
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — After spending 122 days in detention, nearly four months behind bars , Somali social media personality Sacdiya Macallin Ali, widely known as “Sacdiya Bajaaj,” has regained her freedom after the Banadir Regional Court of Appeal overturned a three-year prison sentence imposed against her by a lower court. The Appeals Court ruled that the earlier sentence was not consistent with the law, effectively bringing Sacdiya’s prolonged detention to an end. Her release comes after months of mounting public concern over her case, which became a powerful flashpoint in Somalia’s increasingly contentious debate over freedom of expression, political accountability, and the limits of government power. Sacdiya’s detention drew particular attention because of her outspoken presence on social media. Opposition politicians, civil society groups, and supporters repeatedly demanded her release, arguing that her imprisonment was unjust and that citizens should not face criminal prosecution simply for expressing criticism of government policies or alleged wrongdoing. The case has therefore become larger than one individual. It has raised uncomfortable questions about the shrinking space for public criticism in Somalia at a time when President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government faces growing accusations from opponents over corruption, political repression, and the use of state institutions against critics. Among the most explosive issues in Mogadishu is the continuing controversy surrounding public land. Opposition figures and activists have alleged that valuable public land in the capital has been transferred or sold to politically connected businessmen and powerful investors, with critics describing the process as one of the country’s most serious forms of institutionalized corruption. Some allegations have gone even further, claiming that cemeteries and burial grounds have been cleared or otherwise encroached upon for commercial development. Those allegations can’t be contested but should be independently verified. But their very presence in public discourse illustrates the growing anger surrounding land ownership and the management of public property in Mogadishu. For critics of the government, Sacdiya’s case has become symbolic of a broader concern: that citizens who publicly challenge powerful interests risk intimidation, detention, or prosecution. The government’s supporters, however, argue that individuals must remain accountable under the law and that criticism does not place anyone above legal proceedings. That argument now faces an important test.
