items.title: Ugandan Commander Sounds Alarm at Carbiska Base, Warns Troops to Stay Ready for Al-Shabaab Attacks
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — A senior Ugandan commander serving with the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) has issued a stark warning to troops stationed at the Carbiska operational base, ordering them to maintain heightened vigilance and remain prepared for possible attacks by Al-Shabaab. Colonel Saul Nabimanya, commander of Uganda’s 46th Battalion under AUSSOM’s First Sector, delivered the warning during an address to soldiers at the Carbiska base, praising their commitment while emphasizing the continuing security risks facing African Union and Somali forces operating around the capital. Nabimanya commended the troops for their discipline and dedication to their mission, but urged them not to become complacent. He instructed soldiers to maintain high levels of professionalism, discipline and operational readiness, stressing that they must be capable of responding rapidly to any emerging security threat while carrying out their duties in Somalia. Al-Shabaab Threat Remains The commander’s warning comes amid continuing concerns over Al-Shabaab activity in areas surrounding Mogadishu and along major roads linking the capital with surrounding communities. Although Somali and AUSSOM forces have intensified joint security operations in recent months, Al-Shabaab continues to retain the ability to conduct ambushes, hit-and-run attacks and other forms of asymmetric warfare against government and international forces. Carbiska is considered a strategically important location within the wider security architecture around Mogadishu. The base supports operations aimed at strengthening security and assisting Somali forces as they gradually assume greater responsibility for protecting the country. For the troops stationed there, the message from their commander was therefore direct: the transition toward greater Somali security responsibility does not mean the threat has disappeared. In an unusual addition to his security-focused message, Colonel Nabimanya also urged his troops to think beyond their immediate military responsibilities. He reminded the soldiers that their deployment in Somalia is temporary and encouraged them to consider the lives and responsibilities that await them when they eventually leave the mission and return home. The commander urged the troops to manage their finances responsibly and make sound decisions that would improve their long-term welfare. His message was effectively twofold: remain alert on the battlefield, but also prepare for life after the battlefield. Nabimanya emphasized that responsible financial management, professional discipline and forward planning should be treated as part of a soldier’s broader responsibility to himself, his family and his future. Uganda’s Continuing Role in Somalia Uganda remains one of the principal troop-contributing countries to the African Union’s Somalia mission and has maintained a major military presence in Somalia for many years. Ugandan forces have operated in several strategically important areas, supporting Somali security forces in counterinsurgency operations and helping protect key population centers and transportation corridors. AUSSOM’s broader mandate includes supporting Somalia’s fight against Al-Shabaab, strengthening national security institutions and helping create the conditions for a gradual transfer of security responsibilities from African Union forces to Somali authorities. That transition, however, remains a delicate undertaking. Somali forces are increasingly expected to take the lead, while AUSSOM contingents continue to provide operational support, training, coordination and security assistance. Colonel Nabimanya’s latest message highlights the difficult reality facing troops at Carbiska and elsewhere in Somalia. The international security presence may eventually decline, but Al-Shabaab’s ability to exploit vulnerabilities has not disappeared. For now, the Ugandan contingent at Carbiska remains on alert, operating alongside Somali forces in an environment where a quiet day can quickly become a security emergency. The commander’s message was therefore more than a routine briefing. It was a reminder that as Somalia moves toward greater national ownership of its security, the forces supporting that transition must remain prepared for the possibility that Al-Shabaab will test them at every opportunity. items.title: Janan Joins Jubaland Forces as Federal & Regional Rivalry Deepens in Gedo
items.description: Kismayo (WDN) — A major shift in the political and security balance of Somalia’s Gedo region is taking shape after former Federal Government security chief Abdirashid Janan in Gedo region, reportedly joined the Jubaland administration following days of talks with Jubaland President Ahmed Mohamed Islam (Ahmed Madobe). Janan, who previously commanded Federal Government forces in Gedo, is reported to have aligned himself and his troops with Jubaland, potentially delivering a significant blow to Mogadishu’s efforts to consolidate federal control over the strategically important region. According to reports, Janan assembled Federal Government forces under his command at the UK military camp outside Beledxaawo and informed them that his long-running dispute with Jubaland had now ended. The reported realignment could fundamentally alter the balance of power in Gedo, where Mogadishu and Kismaayo have spent years competing over political authority, security forces and control of key border areas. A New Blow to Mogadishu’s Strategy Sources told WardheerNews that Jubaland has agreed to assume responsibility for the salaries of the troops, who have reportedly gone for an extended period without receiving regular pay from the Federal Government. Janan is also reported to have told his forces that Mogadishu had failed to demonstrate genuine commitment to Jubaland’s interests, accusing some federal officials of approaching the country’s political disputes through narrow personal and clan-based calculations. The allegations have not been independently verified, but they reflect the increasingly bitter political confrontation between the Federal Government and Jubaland. The reported defection is particularly significant because it comes amid a broader struggle by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration to reshape the political landscape of Somalia’s Federal Member States. Critics of the President accuse Villa Somalia of pursuing a strategy aimed at bringing regional administrations under tighter federal political control—an approach they argue has already produced severe instability in South West State, Galmudug and Hirshabelle. From this perspective, the confrontation with Jubaland and Puntland is not simply a disagreement over administrative authority. It is part of a much larger battle over whether Somalia’s federal system will remain genuinely decentralized or gradually become dominated by the political preferences of the Federal Government. From Political Dispute to Security Confrontation The danger is that political competition is increasingly being conducted through security forces. Rather than resolving disagreements through negotiated federal arrangements, rival administrations have repeatedly sought to build competing military and political structures. Gedo is perhaps the clearest example. Beledxaawo occupies a strategically important position near the Somalia–Kenya border, making control of the area significant not only politically but also for trade, security and cross-border movement. Janan’s reported decision to align with Jubaland could therefore give Kismaayo greater leverage in the region while complicating Mogadishu’s ability to deploy and maintain federal forces there. It could also force the Federal Government to reconsider its wider security strategy in Gedo at a time when Somalia is already struggling with the threat posed by Al-Shabaab and the gradual transition from African Union forces to Somali national security institutions. The episode raises a question that extends far beyond Janan or Gedo: What happens when political disagreements between Mogadishu and federal member states become disputes over armed forces? Supporters of President Hassan Sheikh argue that the Federal Government has a constitutional responsibility to strengthen national institutions and prevent regional administrations from maintaining autonomous security structures outside a unified national framework. Opponents counter that Mogadishu’s approach risks destroying the very federal balance it claims to be protecting. They point to the experiences of South West State, Galmudug and Hirshabelle, arguing that federal political intervention has increasingly produced regional administrations closely aligned with Villa Somalia. Their concern is that Puntland and Jubaland could eventually face similar pressure. Jubaland, however, has demonstrated that it is prepared to resist. Puntland has likewise maintained a firm political distance from Mogadishu, creating an increasingly polarized federal landscape in which cooperation between the center and the regions is becoming more difficult. Janan’s reported realignment is therefore more than the movement of one commander and his troops. It is a reminder that Somalia’s political struggle is increasingly being fought through the institutions and security forces that are supposed to protect the federal system. For now, the immediate consequences will be felt in Gedo. But the political message is much broader: attempts to impose political uniformity on a federal system can produce resistance—and when that resistance acquires an armed dimension, the consequences can extend far beyond the original dispute. items.title: Sidee loo Maareeyaa Marka ay iska Hor Yimaaddaan Jinsiga Jidheed iyo Jinsiga Afeed?
items.description: Waxa jirta dood ka dhalatay qoraal aan bartayda Faysbuug ku baahiyay. Dooddaasi waxay daarrayd sida loo maareeyo marka ay iska hor yimaaddaan jinsiga laftida sheyga iyo jinsiga magacu. Waa arrin yare kakan oo meelo badan madaxa la gelaysa, sidaas darteed, waxay ila noqotay in aan maqaalkan ku faahfaahiyo wixii Alle iga garan siiyo. In kasta oo doodaha qaar u muuqdaan in ay iska hor imanayaan, qaarkoodna aanay af ahaanba caddayn, qoraalka waxan gundhig uga dhigi doonaa sida ereyada loo adeegsado iyo xeerarka afeed ee la raaco marna aan la raacin. Mawduucani waa mid aan aad looga hadlin af ahaan, waana fahanno isgalay oo mararka qaarkood ay adag tahay sida lagu kala saarayaa. Iyada oo ay sidaas tahay ayaa haddana waxa jira mawduucyo aan aqoon ahaan weli meel la saarin sida “sababta ay afafka qaar jinsi u leeyihiin”. Innaga oo intaasba maanka ku haynna waxaynu maqaalkan isku dul taagney mararka jinsiga jidheed iyo kan afeed israacaan iyo mararka ay iska hor yimaaddaan, ama midkoodba iska hor yimaaddo iyo sida uu xalku iila muuqday markii aan u eegay xeerarka afeed ee la adeegsan karo iyo adeegsiga bulshada. Jinsi Jidheed iyo Jinsi Afeed Marka afka laga hadlayo, waxa laga hadlayaa labo fahan oo isdul saaran. Mid waa sheyga midna waa afku sumadda uu u yaqaanno. Marka aynu ka hadlayno bahasha samada haadda, waxaynu adeegsannaa diyaarad. Eeg, labo wax baynu imminka sheegnay. Waa bahasha samada haadda iyo magaca diyaarad. Si kale. Marka ilme inoo dhasho waxaynu u bixinnaa magac. Waxaynu ilmaha magaca ugu bixinnaa in lagu garto. Eeg markanna labo wax baynu ka hadalnay. Waa ilmaha iyo waxa lagu garanayo. Sidaas baa marka aynu afka ka hadlayno labadaas fahan oo iska turjumayaa isu saaran yihiin. Waa shey oo aynu lafdiga waxa laga hadlayo ka wadno iyo sumad oo aynu magaca lagu aqoonsanayo ka wadno. Waa uun shey iyo taarikadiis. Haddaba, labadan fahan ee aynu ka soo hadalnay mid walbi jinsi buu leeyahay. Waxana aynu u kala qaadan karnaa jinsi jidheed iyo jinsi afeed. Jinsiga jidheed waa jinsiga sheyga lafdigiisa ka muuqda. Marka aynu aragno “lax” iyo “wan” isbarbar taagan, waynu kala garannaa tan “lax” ah iyo kan “wan” ah. Waxaynu ku kala garannaa qayb ka mid ah xubnaha jidhkooda. Kaasi waa jinsi jidheed, waxana yeesha noolaha. Waxa isna jira jinsi afeed. Marka aynu jinsi maqalno, waa ay iska caddahay in aynu wax nool ka hadlayno, waxase layaab ah in marka afka la joogo ereyadu jinsi yeeshaan. Layaabku waxa weeye in ereyga “waddo” uu dheddig yahay, ereyga “dhagax” uu isna lab yahay. Lama garan karo sida labadaas erey ama xataa labada wax ee ay ku magcaaban yihiin ay jinsi u yeelan karaan! Afku muxuu jinsi u leeyahay waa mawduuc aan war badan laga hayn, waxase la filayaa in dadku iyagu afka lahaayeen, sidaas darteedna ay jinsiga ugu sameeyeen sida ay iyaba lab iyo dheddig u yihiin. Jinsiga jidheed iyo jinsiga afeed waxaynu si fiican ugu kala garan karnaa noolaha “sac” loo yaqaanno. Noolahan marka aynu jidhkiisa eegno waa dheddig, balse dhinaca kale, noolahan magaciisu waa lab. Waa innaga niraahna “Saca caanihiisa”. Ma niraahno “Saca caanaheeda”, sidaas darteed, “sacu” jidh ahaan waa neef dheddig ah, magac ahaanna wuxuu leeyahay magac lab ah. Waxan filayaa in noolaha aynu “sac” u naqaanno uu ina kaga filan yahay in aan kala fahanno jinsi jidheed iyo jinsi afeed. Maaddaama ay labada jinsi wada shaqeeyaan oo isku dul dhisan yihiin, waxa dhaca: B. Mar labada jinsi iswaafaqaan. T. Mar labada jinsi aanu mid caddayn. J. Mar labada jinsi iska hor yimaaddaan. X. Mar jinsiga afeed iska hor yimaaddo. B. Marka labada jinsi iswaafaqaan: Mar jinsiga jidheed iyo jinsiga afeed ayaa iswaafaqa, waana marka jinsi jidh ahaan lab ama dheddig ah loo bixiyo magac lab ah ama dheddig ah, sida ay u kala horreeyaan. Noolaha aynu “hal” u naqaanno jidh ahaan waa dheddig, magac ahaanna waa dheddig. Waa innaga niraahna “Hasha caanaheeda”. Sida oo kale, noolaha aynu “nin” u naqaanno jidh ahaan waa lab, magac ahaanna waa lab. Labadan marba waa ay iswaafeqeen jinsiga jidheed iyo jinsiga afeed. T. Marka aanu jinsiga afeed caddayn : Waxa dhacda in mararka qaar aanu caddayn mid jinsiyada ka mid ahi. Sida aynu soo sheegnay jinsiga jidheed waxa uun yeelan kara waxyaabaha noolaha ah, balse dhinaca kale afku wuxuu jinsi u sameeyaa wax aan noolaba ahayn. Sidaas darteed, waxa dhacda mar uu kaba gaabsado afku jinsiga sheyga. Afku sidee jinsiga u sheegaa? Afku saddex qaab buu jinsiga sheyga u sheegaa, waana; mar uu dheddig ku sheego, mar uu lab ku sheego iyo mar aanu midna ku sheegin. Afku mar dheddig buu sheyga ku sheegaa marna lab, wuxuna tan ku kala caddeeyaa dhawaaqa magaca. Si kasta oo aanu sheygu jinsi jidheed u lahayn, afku wuxuu u sameeyaa dhawaaq lab ama mid dheddig. Meesha la galo ee “guri” afku wuxuu u yaqaannaa wax lab, xubinta jidhka ee “kelli” iyana wuxuu u yaqaannaa wax dheddig. Mar kale afku wuxuu jinsiga ku caddeeyaa xarfaha ereyga u danbeeya. Ereyada kelida ah ee shaqalka “O” ku dhammaada afku wuxuu u yaqaannaa kuwo dheddig. Waa magacyada ay ka midka yihiin (Dhalo, waddo, Canbaro, Geelo IWM). Dhinaca kale, ereyada ku dhammaada shaqalka “E” iyana afku wuxuu u yaqaannaa kuwo lab. Waa kuwa ay ka midka yihiin (cambe, qare, Barre, Geelle IWM). Labadan waxa soo raaca magacyada “ey” ku dhammaada sida “Caddey, Badey IWM) oo dheddig ah iyo kuwa ku dhammaada “ow” sida (Calasow, Fiidow IWM). Haddaba, wixii magacyada sare ka soo hadha afku wuxuu u aqoonsan yahay in ay lab iyo dheddigba noqon karaan oo hadba sidii la doono loogu dhawaaqi karo. Waxa iyana jirta in marka magacyada gaarka ah la joogo aanu dhawaaqu kala saari karin magacyadan. Tusaale ahaan, magaca “Shugri” marka uu nin yahay iyo marka uu naag yahay ma kala cadda codkiisu in uu lab yahay iyo in uu dheddig yahay. -Shugri baa yimi. -Shugri baa timi. Magaca “Shugri” ragga iyo dumarkaba waa loo bixiyaa. Marka aynu magacan afka ku eegno rag iyo dumarba wuu u yaqaannaa oo ma kala saari karo kan loo jeedo. Haddaba, si labada loo kala saaro waxa loo noqdaa lafdiga sheyga ama jinsiga jidheed. Halkaas ayaa lagu soo go’aamiyaa magacani fal lab ah iyo fal dheddig ah kan uu qaadanayo. J. Marka labada jinsi iska hor yimaaddaan : Mararka qaar waxa dhacda in labada jinsi iska hor yimaaddaan. Shey jinsigiisa jidheed dheddig yahay, ayaa afku jinsi labeed u yeelaa. Sida aynu soo sheegnay noolaha “sac” jidh ahaan waa dheddig, balse afku jinsi labeed buu u yeelay. Waa run oo marba mid baynu qaadannay. Innagu ma qaadan ee dadka oo dhan baa sidaas sameeya, sababtuna waxay noqon kartaa in marka “dadka” laga hadlayo aanay afka marti ka ahayn oo ay yihiin kuwii afkaba lahaa. Sidaas darteed, waxyaabaha kale in labkooda la caddeeyo ama aan la caddayn dadka uma laha muhiimad weyn oo u dhiganta marka arrinku iyaga joogo. X. Sidan si la mid ah waxa dhacda in meel loo yaqaanno “magaalo ama degmo” oo dheddig ah, haddana magac af ahaan lab ah la siiyo. Magaalooyinka (Boorame, Jamaame, Buuhoodle, Buulaburde…) lafdi ahaan mid walba waa “magaalo” oo waa dheddig, waxayse leeyihiin magacyo lab ah oo shaqalka “E” u danbeeyo. Halkan waxa iska hor yimi labadii qodob ee afku jinsigiisa xarfo ahaan ugu caddayn jirey. items.fullContent: Waxa jirta dood ka dhalatay qoraal aan bartayda Faysbuug ku baahiyay. Dooddaasi waxay daarrayd sida loo maareeyo marka ay iska hor yimaaddaan jinsiga laftida sheyga iyo jinsiga magacu. Waa arrin yare kakan oo meelo badan madaxa la gelaysa, sidaas darteed, waxay ila noqotay in aan maqaalkan ku faahfaahiyo wixii Alle iga garan siiyo. In kasta oo doodaha qaar u muuqdaan in ay iska hor imanayaan, qaarkoodna aanay af ahaanba caddayn, qoraalka waxan gundhig uga dhigi doonaa sida ereyada loo adeegsado iyo xeerarka afeed ee la raaco marna aan la raacin. Mawduucani waa mid aan aad looga hadlin af ahaan, waana fahanno isgalay oo mararka qaarkood ay adag tahay sida lagu kala saarayaa. Iyada oo ay sidaas tahay ayaa haddana waxa jira mawduucyo aan aqoon ahaan weli meel la saarin sida “sababta ay afafka qaar jinsi u leeyihiin”. Innaga oo intaasba maanka ku haynna waxaynu maqaalkan isku dul taagney mararka jinsiga jidheed iyo kan afeed israacaan iyo mararka ay iska hor yimaaddaan, ama midkoodba iska hor yimaaddo iyo sida uu xalku iila muuqday markii aan u eegay xeerarka afeed ee la adeegsan karo iyo adeegsiga bulshada. Jinsi Jidheed iyo Jinsi Afeed Marka afka laga hadlayo, waxa laga hadlayaa labo fahan oo isdul saaran. Mid waa sheyga midna waa afku sumadda uu u yaqaanno. Marka aynu ka hadlayno bahasha samada haadda, waxaynu adeegsannaa diyaarad. Eeg, labo wax baynu imminka sheegnay. Waa bahasha samada haadda iyo magaca diyaarad. Si kale. Marka ilme inoo dhasho waxaynu u bixinnaa magac. Waxaynu ilmaha magaca ugu bixinnaa in lagu garto. Eeg markanna labo wax baynu ka hadalnay. Waa ilmaha iyo waxa lagu garanayo. Sidaas baa marka aynu afka ka hadlayno labadaas fahan oo iska turjumayaa isu saaran yihiin. Waa shey oo aynu lafdiga waxa laga hadlayo ka wadno iyo sumad oo aynu magaca lagu aqoonsanayo ka wadno. Waa uun shey iyo taarikadiis. Haddaba, labadan fahan ee aynu ka soo hadalnay mid walbi jinsi buu leeyahay. Waxana aynu u kala qaadan karnaa jinsi jidheed iyo jinsi afeed. Jinsiga jidheed waa jinsiga sheyga lafdigiisa ka muuqda. Marka aynu aragno “lax” iyo “wan” isbarbar taagan, waynu kala garannaa tan “lax” ah iyo kan “wan” ah. Layaabku waxa weeye in ereyga “waddo” uu dheddig yahay, ereyga “dhagax” uu isna lab yahay. Lama garan karo sida labadaas erey ama xataa labada wax ee ay ku magcaaban yihiin ay jinsi u yeelan karaan! Afku muxuu jinsi u leeyahay waa mawduuc aan war badan laga hayn, waxase la filayaa in dadku iyagu afka lahaayeen, sidaas darteedna ay jinsiga ugu sameeyeen sida ay iyaba lab iyo dheddig u yihiin. Jinsiga jidheed iyo jinsiga afeed waxaynu si fiican ugu kala garan karnaa noolaha “sac” loo yaqaanno. Noolahan marka aynu jidhkiisa eegno waa dheddig, balse dhinaca kale, noolahan magaciisu waa lab. Waa innaga niraahna “Saca caanihiisa”. Ma niraahno “Saca caanaheeda”, sidaas darteed, “sacu” jidh ahaan waa neef dheddig ah, magac ahaanna wuxuu leeyahay magac lab ah. Waxan filayaa in noolaha aynu “sac” u naqaanno uu ina kaga filan yahay in aan kala fahanno jinsi jidheed iyo jinsi afeed. Maaddaama ay labada jinsi wada shaqeeyaan oo isku dul dhisan yihiin, waxa dhaca: B. Mar labada jinsi iswaafaqaan. T. Mar labada jinsi aanu mid caddayn. J. Mar labada jinsi iska hor yimaaddaan. X. Ereyada kelida ah ee shaqalka “O” ku dhammaada afku wuxuu u yaqaannaa kuwo dheddig. Waa magacyada ay ka midka yihiin (Dhalo, waddo, Canbaro, Geelo IWM). items.title: Soomaaliya oo si adag uga hortimid dal aqoonsaday madax-bannaanida Israa’iil ee…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u cambaareysay go’aanka ay Dowladda Kolombiya ku aqoonsatay sheegashada Israa’iil ee ku aaddan madax-bannaanida Buuraleyda Golan. Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in aqoonsi kasta oo noocaas ah uu yahay mid aan waxba ka jirin, isla markaana uu ka hor imanayo sharciga caalamiga ah iyo Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay. Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay adkaysay in Buuraleyda Golan uu yahay dhul Suuriyaan ah oo ay Israa’iil haysato, iyadoo diidday tallaabo kasta oo lagu aqoonsanayo sheegashada Israa’iil ee dhulkaasi. Soomaaliya waxay sidoo kale ku baaqday in khilaafka u dhexeeya Israa’iil iyo Suuriya lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo hab nabadeed, iyadoo la dhowrayo mabaadi’da sharciga caalamiga ah. Dowladdu waxay xustay muhiimadda ay leeyihiin qaraarrada Qaramada Midoobay ee khuseeya Buuraleyda Golan, kuwaas oo xaqiijinaya xaqa Suuriya u leedahay dhulkeeda. Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in dhulka Suuriya lagu haysto ay tahay in si buuxda loogu soo celiyo dalkaasi, iyadoo lagu salaynayo xuduudihii jiray ka hor dagaalkii 1967. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa ugu dambeyn ugu baaqday dhammaan dowladaha, oo ay ku jirto Kolombiya, inay dhowraan sharciga caalamiga ah, ixtiraamaan madaxbannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee dowladaha, ayna ka fogaadaan aqoonsiga dhulalka la haysto. items.title: Thousands flee yearslong drought in Somalia as hunger deepens and aid shrinks
items.description: After nearly two weeks on the road with her five children, Luul Mohamed finally arrived in the southwestern Somali city of Baidoa with no food and little sense of what would happen next. Drought conditions had forced Mohamed and her family to leave Saakoow, a town in the Middle Jubba region more than 300 kilometers (186 miles) away. They moved from village to village before arriving in Baidoa, now a major hub for people fleeing drought, insecurity and food shortages, on Aug. 3. “We are very hungry and in a desperate situation,” Mohamed said. “We have nothing to eat and can only place our hope in God, as He is the one who sustains us through this ordeal that culminated in our trip.” The family’s journey is one example of a deepening humanitarian emergency in Somalia, where years of drought, conflict and economic pressures are pushing more families from rural communities into displacement camps as hunger rises and humanitarian funding shrinks. About 2 million people are facing emergency levels of food insecurity, more than double the number recorded last year, according to Plan International, which has provided assistance to more than 200,000 people in Somalia this year. The humanitarian group and Somalia’s Disaster Management Agency are calling for increased international assistance, with concern that the crisis could be compounded by another climate shock later this year. The U.N. Food and Agriculture Organization has projected a greater than 90% probability of El Nino conditions developing from mid-2026 and intensifying during Somalia’s October-to-December rainy season, bringing the severe risk of flooding. Somalia is highly vulnerable to extreme weather and has experienced repeated cycles of prolonged drought followed by destructive flooding. The shocks have eroded livelihoods, displaced communities, contributed to disease outbreaks and worsened food insecurity. In Baidoa, hundreds of thousands of people fleeing prolonged drought have gathered in sprawling displacement settlements on the outskirts of the city. One of them, Habiba Adan, fled her settlement in Awdiinle in the Bay region after four consecutive years of drought destroyed crops and killed livestock. She eventually moved to Baidoa with her two older daughters and now lives in a displacement camp. Adan would like to return home, but she said continuing drought and failed harvests there have left families with little prospect of rebuilding their lives. “The drought we are experiencing has stretched for four consecutive years, and this year, most crops have again been decimated,” Adan said. “Farmers were only able to harvest enough to sow their fields for the next season, leaving our future bleak. Here in these camps, we lack food and essential support. We have no food, water, or money, and we sit idly.” According to Plan International, the city is hosting about 1.6 million people, nearly half of them displaced. It says one in five families lacks reliable access to water, among the most immediate challenges facing displaced families. They are increasingly forced to buy trucked water at steep prices that many simply cannot afford. Families have nothing left after years of drought Reena Ghelani, the global CEO of Plan International, visited Baidoa last week, meeting drought-displaced families and visiting a malnutrition ward in the Bay region. Ghelani said many of the families she met had tried to remain in their communities through successive years of drought, leaving only when their resources were exhausted. Many fled “after waiting and waiting year after year of drought and just surviving,” Ghelani said. “And now they say there’s nothing left. They have no water. They have no stocks. The animals have died. There is literally nothing left anymore.” She said rising prices are placing additional pressure on families already struggling to find enough food. Children are suffering from malnutrition Data released in May by the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification, a global hunger monitoring system, showed that about half of children under 5 in Somalia were facing acute malnutrition. Plan International, citing Save the Children, said the number of children receiving treatment for the most dangerous form of malnutrition in Baidoa had nearly tripled over six months. Dr. Omar Abdikarin, a nutritionist in Baidoa, said patients are arriving for treatment from the Bay as well as the neighboring Bakool and Gedo regions. “Malnutrition is prevalent in this region, and the majority of patients treated at this hospital suffer from malnourishment,” Abdikarin said. The health risks extend beyond malnutrition. Ghelani said she encountered children affected by outbreaks of diphtheria, measles, malaria, cholera and acute diarrhea. The prospect of heavy rainfall later this year presents a new threat to communities facing multiple crises. Intense rainfall and flooding could wash away homes and farmland, contaminate drinking water and force families to move again. Aid agencies warn that the expected El Nino conditions will compound the crisis for countless families before they have had time to recover from prolonged drought conditions. For families arriving in Baidoa such as Mohamed’s, the most urgent question is where to find clean water and food. Mohamed said her husband had left for farms on the outskirts of the city, in search of work or something for their children to eat. A day after arriving in the city, she was still waiting to find out whether her husband would return with good news. AP.

Drought conditions had forced Mohamed and her family to leave Saakoow, a town in the Middle Jubba region more than 300 kilometers (186 miles) away. They moved from village to village before arriving in Baidoa, now a major hub for people fleeing drought, insecurity and food shortages, on Aug. 3. “We are very hungry and in a desperate situation,” Mohamed said. “We have nothing to eat and can only place our hope in God, as He is the one who sustains us through this ordeal that culminated in our trip.” The family’s journey is one example of a deepening humanitarian emergency in Somalia, where years of drought, conflict and economic pressures are pushing more families from rural communities into displacement camps as hunger rises and humanitarian funding shrinks. About 2 million people are facing emergency levels of food insecurity, more than double the number recorded last year, according to Plan International, which has provided assistance to more than 200,000 people in Somalia this year. The humanitarian group and Somalia’s Disaster Management Agency are calling for increased international assistance, with concern that the crisis could be compounded by another climate shock later this year. items.title: Why Washington May Finally Recognise Somaliland
items.description: The meeting between Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi and Major General Claude K. Tudor Jr., commander of US Special Operations Command Africa (SOCAFRICA), to discuss security cooperation and strategic interests in the Horn of Africa suggests that United States (US) recognition of Somaliland may be increasingly likely. As the crisis in Iran and the resulting uncertainty surrounding the Strait of Hormuz continue to disrupt global trade and security, US partnership with Somaliland is no longer merely a diplomatic possibility but rather a geopolitical necessity. As the crisis in Iran and the resulting uncertainty surrounding the Strait of Hormuz continue to disrupt global trade and security, US partnership with Somaliland is no longer merely a diplomatic possibility but rather a geopolitical necessity. Since declaring independence from Somalia in 1991 , Somaliland has functioned as a de facto independent state without receiving international recognition. Despite maintaining democratic institutions, ensuring internal stability, and exercising effective control over its territory, no country has formally recognised Somaliland. This began to change when Israel became the first country to formally recognise Somaliland in December 2025. Although Somaliland previously established diplomatic relations with Taiwan and Ethiopia , neither has reached the level of formal recognition. Yet, shifting geopolitical realities in the Middle East and the Horn of Africa are creating conditions that could fundamentally increase its importance and lead Washington to recognise Somaliland as well. Somaliland’s Geographic Importance for the US The crisis in Iran, which began over Iran’s nuclear programme, has gradually transformed into a wider contest over maritime dominance across the Middle East. While Hormuz remains the centre of gravity, the conflict is steadily moving towards the Bab El-Mandeb Strait . Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world’s most strategically significant maritime chokepoints, linking the Gulf of Aden with the Red Sea. As it carries nearly 12 percent of global trade , including several million barrels of oil, any disruption in the strait would increase freight costs, insurance premiums, fuel consumption, and supply chain costs, as seen during the Red Sea shipping crisis of 2024-25 . The principal source of this threat is the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen. Over the past two years, the Houthis have transformed maritime coercion into an effective instrument of geopolitical influence. Armed with anti-ship ballistic missiles, drones, naval mines and advanced surveillance capabilities supported by Iran, the group has repeatedly targeted commercial shipping in the Red Sea. Now, the prospect of the Houthis eventually regulating maritime traffic or imposing transit fees through Bab el-Mandeb appears increasingly plausible. Washington therefore has a strategic interest in maintaining freedom of navigation through Bab el-Mandeb. Ensuring secure access to the Red Sea, however, would require reliable regional partners capable of supporting sustained military and logistical operations. It is precisely in this context that Somaliland emerges as an increasingly attractive strategic partner. Somaliland occupies one of the most advantageous geographic positions in the region. Stretching over 850 km along the Gulf of Aden, Somaliland overlooks one of the busiest maritime corridors connecting the Indian Ocean with the Mediterranean. Its greatest strategic asset is the Port of Berbera . Over the past decade, Berbera has undergone major modernisation, transforming it into one of the most capable deep-water ports on Africa’s eastern coast. The adjoining airfield, originally constructed during the Cold War, has also been upgraded and can support large military aircraft. Together, these facilities provide an ideal logistics hub for naval deployments, intelligence operations and maritime surveillance. From an American military perspective, Berbera offers several operational advantages. From an American military perspective, Berbera offers several operational advantages. Naval vessels engaged in securing Bab el-Mandeb could be resupplied without relying exclusively on facilities in Djibouti. Air assets conducting surveillance over Yemen or anti-Houthi missions could operate from a location considerably closer to the theatre of operations. Moreover, a larger American presence in Berbera would diversify Washington’s military footprint in the Horn of Africa at a time when strategic competition with both China and Russia is intensifying. Somaliland as a Strategic Counterweight to China The importance of Berbera becomes even greater when viewed alongside China’s expanding regional influence. Beijing has steadily strengthened its strategic position through its military base in Djibouti, extensive infrastructure investments and deepening political engagement with Somalia. China may use airspace restrictions as a tool to isolate Somaliland. Recently, Beijing attempted to prevent the Taiwanese president from travelling to Eswatini by restricting Taiwanese aircraft from using routes through neighbouring countries. The episode in Eswatini could serve as a warning of how Beijing may seek to use airspace restrictions to limit Taiwan’s engagement with other countries. Measures including restrictions on aircraft carrying American officials, tighter visa controls and efforts to limit international engagement with Somaliland may be employed as instruments of geopolitical pressure, restricting US access to Somaliland. For the US, recognising Somaliland could act as a counter to Chinese influence in the region in multiple ways. For the US, recognising Somaliland could act as a counter to Chinese influence in the region in multiple ways. In 2020, Somaliland established formal diplomatic ties with Taiwan despite intense opposition from Beijing. China reportedly attempted to persuade Somaliland to reverse its decision with substantial financial incentives, yet Hargeisa defied Chinese pressure. Since then, Somaliland has increasingly aligned itself with partners such as Taiwan, the United Arab Emirates and Israel, while resisting Chinese political pressure. From Washington’s perspective, Somaliland represents one of the few openly pro-Western actors in a region where Chinese influence is yet to become entrenched. Economic considerations further strengthen the strategic argument. Somaliland possesses considerable untapped reserves of critical minerals and rare-earth elements , resources that are becoming increasingly important as the United States seeks to reduce its dependence on Chinese-controlled supply chains. American recognition could create opportunities for Western companies in mining, logistics and infrastructure. As Washington intensifies efforts to diversify global supply chains for strategic minerals, Somaliland could emerge as an important alternative partner. The Case for US Recognition Counterterrorism is another compelling factor. Although Somaliland is overwhelmingly Muslim, it has consistently rejected Islamist extremism. Unlike neighbouring Somalia, which continues to struggle against the militant group Al-Shabaab , Somaliland has enjoyed relative stability. For the US, this presents an opportunity similar to previous partnerships with local forces in other parts of the Middle East. Rather than relying solely on fragile central governments, Washington has increasingly worked with capable local actors sharing common security objectives. Somaliland’s security institutions and political stability make it a potentially valuable partner for counterterrorism operations across the Horn of Africa. If the conflict surrounding Iran continues to expand westward and Bab el-Mandeb becomes the next major arena of geopolitical competition, the US will require dependable partners positioned at the centre of this emerging maritime theatre. Somaliland offers geographical advantages, political stability, military utility, counterterrorism cooperation, critical mineral potential and alignment with American strategic interests in countering both Iran and China. Given current developments in the region, US recognition of Somaliland appears increasingly likely. Samir Bhattacharya is an Associate Fellow at the Observer Research Foundation.

items.title: Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Austrian Foreign Minister Meinl-Reisinger
items.description: Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Austrian Foreign Minister Meinl-Reisinger Office of the Spokesperson August 11, 2026 The following is attributable to Spokesperson Thomas Pigott: Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with Austrian Foreign Minister Beate Meinl-Reisinger today in Washington. The Secretary and Foreign Minister discussed ways to ensure European security and uphold national sovereignty, including protecting critical technologies. Secretary Rubio welcomed Austria’s election to the UN Security Council and highlighted areas of shared interests.

items.title: United States Mobilizes Life-Saving Response to Colombia Earthquake
items.description: United States Mobilizes Life-Saving Response to Colombia Earthquake Office of the Spokesperson August 11, 2026 The Trump Administration has mobilized an immediate response following the devastating 7.4 magnitude earthquake that struck regions of Colombia on August 10. Within hours of the earthquake, the Department of State announced $15.5 million in life-saving emergency shelter, food, and protection assistance, in addition to post-earthquake structural assessments. The Department also activated a Disaster Assistance Response Team (DART), which includes humanitarian experts from across the State Department. Members of the DART began arriving in Colombia the day of this devastating earthquake, underscoring the Department’s commitment to immediate, life-saving action in the critical hours following natural disasters in our hemisphere. The State Department continues to liaise with Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella and the Colombian government as it assesses the impacts of and responds to this earthquake. Disaster Assistance Response Team Deployment The Department is deploying a DART to provide world-class disaster response expertise, technical and programmatic support, operational leadership, and on-the-ground coordination. The DART is responsible for assessing conditions, identifying humanitarian needs, and leading the U.S. Government’s disaster response. The DART is working closely with existing Department assistance personnel, as well as diplomats at our Embassy in Bogota to coordinate with local authorities and partner organizations. Life-Saving Humanitarian Assistance Through Trusted Partners In response to the earthquake, the State Department is mobilizing an initial $15.5 million in life-saving emergency shelter, food, and protection assistance, in addition to post-earthquake structural assessments through trusted partners, including Catholic Relief Services (CRS), the International Organization for Migration, Miyamoto International, the UN World Food Program, and World Vision. Of the $15.5 million in life-saving assistance, $3 million provided through CRS draws from the previously announced CRS global assistance award . With funding already on hand through its global award, CRS can respond immediately through support from the State Department. Additionally, as part of the Department’s $3.8 billion contribution to the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), the United States provided $200 million to the Colombia Pooled Fund, which OCHA can use to address earthquake-related needs as well as preexisting humanitarian needs in Colombia. Supporting Americans in Colombia The Trump Administration has no higher priority than the safety and security of Americans. The Department of State is working tirelessly to provide consular assistance to U.S. citizens and their families in the affected areas. Americans in Colombia should enroll in the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP) at STEP.state.gov to receive safety and security updates from the U.S. Embassy. They should follow @TravelGov and @USEmbassyBogota on social media for the latest information. The U.S. State Department’s Bureau of Consular Affairs maintains a call center for Americans seeking information or assistance in connection with the Colombia earthquake: call from within the United States 888-407-4747, or from all other locations +1 202-501-4444.

items.title: Somalia’s Northeast Seeks Federal Pay Amid Puntland Tensions
items.description: (Raxanreeb Online) — The Waqooyi Bari administration has called on the Federal Government of Somalia to provide salaries for its security forces, following the reported failure of a federal plan to deploy federal troops within Puntland. MP Kilwa said the Waqooyi Bari security forces require financial support from the Federal Government and urged Mogadishu to take responsibility for their salaries. He linked the request to ongoing political and security developments in areas under the Puntland administration. The remarks come amid continuing political tensions between the Federal Government of Somalia and Puntland, particularly over security arrangements, governance, and the division of powers between the federal authorities and Federal Member States. Disagreements over the deployment, financing and command of security forces remain among the key issues affecting relations between Mogadishu and Puntland. The post Somalia’s Northeast Seeks Federal Pay Amid Puntland Tensions appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Trump oo si qarsoodi ah uga baxay Turkiga kadib hanjabaad Iran ah
items.description: Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump ayaa bishii hore si qarsoodi ah uga baxay dalka Turkiga isagoo wata diyaarad milateri oo ka duwan Air Force One, kadib markii sirdoonka Maraykanku uu helay macluumaad ku saabsan hanjabaad dhimasho oo ka imanaysa Iran . Tallaabadan ammaan ee aan caadiga ahayn ayaa la sameeyay intii uu ka soo qayb galayay shirkii NATO ee magaalada Ankara, waxaana lagu sameeyay qaab khiyaano ah oo ay ku jirtay inuu ku dhex qariyo baabuur cunto gee ah oo garoonka diyaaradaha . Khatarta ayaa loo arkay mid dhab ah, kadib markii sirdoonka Maraykanku uu ogaaday in Iran ay la socotay meesha uu Trump ku sugan yahay Ankara, oo ay ku jirto dabaqa uu ku jiray hotelka . Waxa kale oo la soo sheegay in hanjabaaddu ay ku saabsanayd in diyaaradda Madaxweynaha lagu garaaco gantaal . Trump ayaa markii dambe xaqiijiyay in hay’adaha ammaanku ay ku waaniyeen inuu diyaarad beddelo, isagoona sheegay: “Waxaan u socdaa sida ay Hay’adda Sirta Ilaalinta iyo ciidanku doonaan. Waxay rabeen inaan duullo diyaarad kale, duulimaad kale” . Si loo fuliyo qorshahan khiyaanada ah, Trump ayaa markii hore si rasmi ah u soo fuulay Air Force One hortii kamaradaha, isaga oo ku dhawaaqay inuu diyaaraddii hore ku sii jeedo Ingiriiska “si uu u xuso waqtiyadii hore” . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wax yar ka dib waxa lagu soo degay baabuur cunto gee ah oo garoonka, kaas oo u geeyay diyaarad C-32A ah oo yar . Diyaaraddii Air Force One waxay sii duushay iyadoo ay saarneen saraakiil sare, shaqaale iyo wariyeyaal, kuwaas oo aan waxba ka ogeyn in madaxweynuhu uusan ku jirin . Wariyeyaashii ku socday Air Force One ayaa la sheegay in lagu amray inay xidhaan daaqadaha qaybtooda . Xubno ka mid ah shaqaalaha Aqalka Cad ayaa sidoo kale la rumeysan yahay inay aaminsanaayeen in Trump uu diyaaraddaas ku jiro . Diyaaraddii C-32A oo siday Trump waxay timid Ingiriiska 10:20 fiidnimo, halka Air Force One ay timid daqiiqado yar ka dib . Markii warfiyayaasha ay mar dambe su’aal ka weydiiyeen Trump sababta daaqadaha loo xidhay, waxa uu iska yiri waxay ku jireen “duulimaad khatar ah,” laakiin ma uu shaacin inuu si qarsoodi ah ugu safray diyaarad kale . Aqalka Cad ayaa difaacay tallaabooyinka ammaanka, isagoo sheegay in madaxweynuhu uu yahay bartilmaameedka cadawga Maraykanka, isla markaana hay’aduhu ay isticmaalaan qalab kasta oo ay haystaan si ay uga ilaaliyaan . The post Trump oo si qarsoodi ah uga baxay Turkiga kadib hanjabaad Iran ah first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Al-Shabaab claims deadly IED attack on Somali army truck near Mubarak
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – More than a dozen Somali army personnel were killed on Monday when a military truck carrying troops was struck by an improvised explosive device (IED) near the town of Mubarak in Somalia’s Lower Shabelle region, according to reports. The attack targeted a Somali military vehicle travelling between Awdhegle and Mubarak, two locations where Somali forces maintain bases after capturing the areas several months ago with the assistance of Ugandan ground forces and Turkish air force. Al-Shabaab claimed responsibility for the bombing, saying its attack killed over 20 Somali soldiers and wounded dozens of others. The reported death toll, however, remained disputed. Prominent Somali journalist Abdalle Ahmed Mumin put the number of soldiers killed at 30 and reported that many others were injured. Images following the attack showed the wreckage of the targeted military truck left along the road, underscoring the force of the blast. Reports also indicated that a military commander was among those killed. Somalia’s government has not yet issued a public comment on the attack, and there is therefore no independent government confirmation of the casualty figures claimed by Al-Shabaab or reported by Mumin. The bombing comes as Al-Shabaab intensifies attacks across southern and central Somalia, challenging Somali forces in areas where government troops have sought to consolidate territorial gains against the militant group. The attack also comes at a sensitive moment for Somalia’s security campaign, with African Union troop-contributing countries preparing to draw down their forces ahead of December. The strike near Mubarak highlights the continuing threat facing Somali forces along key routes in the southern and central regions, where military positions and recently captured territory remain vulnerable to insurgent attacks. For the Somali army, the deadly bombing represents another serious challenge as it works to maintain control of territory recovered from Al-Shabaab while the broader regional security presence undergoes a planned transition. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo si rasmi ah xilka ula wareegay
items.description: Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa maanta si rasmi ah ula wareegay xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Munaasabad ka dhacday xarunta Guddoonka iyo Guddiyada ee Villa Hargeysa ayaa lagu qabtay xafladda xil-wareejinta, waxaana ka qeyb galay Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Koowaad ee Golaha Shacabka, Marwo Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar, Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad, Mudane Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow, iyo mas’uuliyiin kale. Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ayaa uga mahadceliyey Guddigii Doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka shaqadii ay qabteen, isagoo sidoo kale ammaanay hoggaankii iyo howlihii ay soo qabatay Marwo Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar intii ay ahayd Kusimaha Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Marwo Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar ayaa dhankeeda uga mahadcelisay Guddigii Doorashada, iyadoo adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay wada shaqeynta iyo sii ambaqaadidda howlaha Golaha Shacabka. Guddoomiyaha cusub, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa sheegay inuu Golaha Shacabka ku hoggaamin doono caddaalad, hufnaan iyo wadajir, isagoo mudnaanta siinaya xoojinta shaqada sharci-dejinta, ilaalinta doorka dastuuriga ah ee Golaha iyo ka shaqeynta danta guud. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale ugu baaqay dhammaan Xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka inay si wadajir ah uga qeyb qaataan gudashada waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee loo igmaday, si loo xaqiijiyo yoolalka iyo himilooyinka Golaha Shacabka. Xil-wareejintan ayaa ku soo beegantay kaddib doorashadii Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, iyadoo Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) uu hadda si rasmi ah u bilaabay hoggaaminta Golaha.

items.title: Albania Appoints World’s First AI Minister to Fight Corruption
items.description: Albania has appointed Diella, a virtual AI minister, to oversee all public procurement in a radical effort to eliminate corruption, making it the first country in the world to use artificial intelligence at a ministerial level. Prime Minister Edi Rama announced the move stating that the AI minister would ensure every single public tender is 100% corruption-free, replacing human decision-making with algorithms designed to eliminate bias bribes and political influence. This move is significant because it represents a new approach to governance and anti-corruption efforts, using technology to bring unprecedented transparency to how taxpayer money is spent. Diella, a woman dressed in traditional Albanian clothing, was first created in January 2025 to assist citizens with government services through the e-Albania platform. She has already processed 36,600 digital documents and nearly 1,000 services. Prime Minister Rama stated that Diella would oversee all government contract decisions, claiming she would ensure that public funds are spent with 100% transparency. He added: “Diella is the first non-human member but made by artificial intelligence.” The AI minister has also addressed parliament, stating: “The real threat to the constitution has never been machines but the inhuman decisions of those in power.” However, the appointment has sparked mixed reactions. Some experts have warned that AI is not a magic solution for corruption, as technology is only as effective as the people who create and manage it. There are also concerns about accountability when important decisions are made by an AI system, as well as questions about Diella’s actual effectiveness. Opposition leader Sali Berisha has described the move as unconstitutional and a publicity stunt, arguing that corruption cannot be controlled through Diella. Albania’s government continues its efforts to fight corruption, which is one of the key requirements for its European Union membership bid. items.title: Xuska Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Dhallinyarada Adduunka

Munaasabaddani waa madal caalami ah oo lagu qiimeeyo awoodda, hal-abuurka iyo waxsoosaarka dhallinyarada, iyadoo si gaar ah loo tixgelinayo saamaynta baaxadda leh ee ay ku leeyihiin isbeddellada dhaqandhaqaale, siyaasadeed iyo tegnolojiyadeed ee dunida maanta. Maalinta Dhallinyarada Adduunka waxay ka curatay Shirweynihii Wasiirradii u xilsaarnaa dhallinyarada oo ka dhacay magaalada Lisbon ee dalka Bortugaal, sannadkii 1998. Ka dib dib-u-eegis iyo falanqayn ay sameeyeen xeeldheerayaal iyo hay’ado caalami ah, Qaramada Midoobay ayaa go’aamisay in 12ka Ogoosto loo aqoonsado weyn oo lagu soo bandhigo baahiyaha, caqabadaha iyo guulaha ay gaareen dhallinyarada caalamku. Sannad kasta, xusku wuxuu xanbaarsan yahay mawduuc gaar ah oo ka tarjumaya baahiyaha dhallinyarada ee xilliyada kala duwan iyo isbeddellada jira. Mawduucyadaas waxaa ka mid ah adeegsiga aaladaha dhijitaalka ah si ay dhallinyaradu u helaan horumar waara, in la adkeeyo ka qaybqaadashada dhallinyarada ee go’aannada masiiriga ah iyo dib-u-habaynta iyo tayaynta waxbarashada si ay u waafaqdo baahiyaha dhallinyarada qarnigan joogta. Ujeeddada guud ee maalintan ayaa ah in dawladaha, hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo bulshada rayidka ah lagu baraarujiyo muhiimadda ay leeyihiin maaraynta dhibaatada shaqo la’aanta, helitaanka waxbarasho tayo leh iyo kaqaybgalinta dhallinyarada go’aannada heer qaran. Dhallinyarada maanta waxay ka dhigan yihiin awoodda ugu weyn ee qaabaysa mustaqbalka aadanaha, maadaama ay yihiin jiilkii ugu tiro badnaa taariikhda. Dhallinyaradu waxay hormuud u yihiin isbeddellada dhanka tegnoolajiyada, maadaama ay ku soo koreen ama ay ku korayaan dunida dhijitaalka ah oo ay si fudud u xiriiriyaan fikradaha cusub. Sida ay sheegtay Qaramada Midoobay (UN), dunida maanta waxaa ku nool ku dhowaad 1.2 bilyan oo dhallinyaro ah oo da’doodu u dhexeyso 15 ilaa 24 sano, tanina waxay muujinaysaa in saamayntoodu ka muuqato meel kasta oo ay joogaan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dhallinyaradu waxay maanta wajahayaan xaalado kakan iyo caqabado kala duwan oo ku xiran dibudhaca ama horumarka bulshada iyo waddamada ay ka soo jeedaan. Dunida soo koraysa, gaar ahaan qaaradda Afrika, waxaa ka jira fursado waaweyn oo ku aaddan dhiirrigelinta iyo koruqaadista xirfadaha cusub ee dhallinyarada hibada leh, iyadoo saamaynta fikirka dhallinyarada ay ka muuqato dhinacyada ganacsiga dhijitaalka ah iyo dadaallada bulshada ee dhinaca waxsoosaarka ah. Waxaa intaas dheer, Bangiga Adduunka (World Bank) wuxuu sheegay in maalgashiga aqoonta, caafimaadka iyo shaqa-abuurka dhallinyaradu uu yahay furaha ugu muhiimsan ee waddamadu ku gaari karaan horumar dhaqaale oo waara. Markaan u soo laabanno taariikhda dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed, waxa ay safka hore kaga jiraan isbeddelladii waaweynaa ee ka dhacay dalkeenna. Laga soo bilaabo 15kii Maajo 1943dii, waxaa jiray saddex iyo toban dhallinyaro ah oo taariikhda Soomaaliya baal dahab ah ka galay. Dhallinyaradaas waxa ay aasaaseen Naadigii Dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed ee Somali Youth Club (SYC). Isbahaysigaas ay dhallinyaradu sameeyeen wuxuu ahaa matoorkii unkay gobannimadii dalka, iyagoo ku dhiirraday in ay qaadaan tallaabo aan hore loo qaadin. Waxa ay garawsadeen in ay iskuduubni kaga guuleysteen gumaysigii iyo xukunkii gumeystaha ee dalka maamulayay. Guushaas waxay caddayn u tahay in dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed, marka ay leeyihiin iskuduubni iyo midnimo, ay beddeli karaan jihada ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Xaaladda ay maanta dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed ku sugan yihiin waa mid meel fiican sii maraysa. Dhallinyaradeennu qiyaas ahaan waxay boqolkiiba toddobaatan ka yihiin tirada guud ee bulshada dalka, iyagoo ka qaybqaata awoodaha, shaqooyinka iyo isbeddellada ugu weyn ee dalka ka dhaca. Wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha dawliga ah iyo ururrada bulshada ee madaniga ah ayay dhallinyaradu door weyn ku leeyihiin. Waxaa jira wasaarado inta badan ka shaqeeya sidii ay dhallinyaradu uga shaqayn lahaayeen horumarkooda, taas oo ay ka mid tahay Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha. Inta badan waxa ay dhallinyarada u abuurtaa fursado shaqo, waxbarasho iyo fursado ay ku soo bandhigi karaan hal-abuurkooda. Waxa ay sidoo kale dhallinyarada siisaa ama u abuurtaa madallo waaweyn oo fikir-wadaag iyo aqoonkororsi ah. Intaas waxaa dheer, dhallinyarada waxaa fursad loo siiyaa in ay la kulmaan ama ay wax isweydaarsadaan dhallinyarada dhiggooda ah ee daafaha kale ee adduunweynaha ku nool. Dhallinyaradu waxa ay inta badan garab-istaag u muujiyaan dadka danyarta ah ama haysta dhibaatooyinka gaarka ah, iyaga oo muujinaya garab-istaag iyo isku-xirnaan buuxda. Xilliyada ay dhacaan abaaraha ama fatahaadaha noocooda kala duwan, dhallinyaradu waxa ay gurmad u fidiyaan dadka ay waxyeelladu gaarto, iyaga oo adeegsanaya aaladaha kala duwan ee baraha bulshada si ay dhaqaale, taageero iyo garab-istaag ugu ururiyaan dadka ay dhibaatadu saamayso. Sidoo kale, waxaa jira dhallinyaro tiro badan oo u taagan wacyigelinta bulshada, haddii ay noqon lahayd dhinaca waxbarashada, waxsoosaarka iyo degaanka. Waxay horseedeen mashruucyo dhirbeereed, nadiifinta xeebaha iyo ilaalinta degaanka, kuwaas oo hoos u dhigaya saamaynta isbeddelka cimilada iyo masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah. Dhallinyaradu waxay, sidoo kale, door firfircoon ka ciyaaraan geeddisocodka dhismaha nabadda iyo xallinta khilaafaadka. Waddammada soo maray dagaallada ama weli ku jira xaaladaha kala guurka ah, dhallinyaradu waxa ay qayb ka yihiin dhisidda madallo lagu wadahadalyo; waa kuwo soo saara maqaallo iyo suugaan dhiirrigelisa wadajirka, kana qaybqaata dhisidda xiriirka bulshada ku nool degaannada kala duwan. Dhiirrigelinta wadahadallada, isdhaafsiga dhaqanka iyo mashaariicda ciyaaraha ayaa muujisay in dhallinyaradu ay yihiin dabarka isku xira qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Inkasta oo ay jiraan guulo waaweyn iyo rajooyin badan, haddana dhallinyarada adduunka iyo kuwa Soomaaliyeedba waxay wajahayaan caqabado dhowr ah oo u baahan in la xalliyo. Waxaa ugu horreeya shaqo la’aanta, maadaama awoodda ganacsiyadu aad u yar tahay oo aanay dabooli karin tirada ballaaran ee dhallinyarada ka soo baxa jaamacadaha iyo iskuullada waxbarashada sannad kasta. Dhinaca kale, dhallinyarada waxaa haysata dhibaatada tahriibka, taas oo naftooda halis gelin karta. Haddaba, Maalinta Dhallinyarada Adduunka waa maalin lagu weyneeyo lagu na dhiirrigeliyo qof kasta oo dhallinyaro ah oo haddana halgamaya, lehna hammi fog oo ah in uu gaaro meelo sare. Maalintan weyn, waa in madaxda iyo hoggaamiyayaasha dunida, dawladaha iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshadu ay dhallinyarada u abuuraan fursad ay wax kaga beddelaan noloshooda. Taasi waxa ay dhallinyarada u noqonaysaa shidaalin iyo in ay dedaalkooda sii laba jibaaraan. Marka dhallinyarada la siiyo agabkii ay wax ku qabsan lahaayeen, aqoonta iyo xorriyadda hal-abuurka, waxay xallin karaan dhibaatooyinka ugu adag.

items.title: Kulan dhex maray Danjiraha Somaliland u jooga Imaaraadka iyo ka u jooga Israel
items.description: Danjirayaasha Somaliland iyo Israel ee UAE oo kulan gaar ah yeeshay Danjiraha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland u fadhiya Imaaraadka Carabta, Amb Mascuud Cali Xasan, ayaa kulan gaar ah la yeeshay danjiraha dawladda Israel u fadhiya Imaaraadka Carabta, Amb Yossi Shelley. Kulankan oo ka dhacay Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa lagaga wada hadlay xoojinta xidhiidhka laba geesoodka ah iyo sidii loo sii horumarin lahaa iskaashiga ka dhexeeya labada dal iyo shacabkooda. Amb. Mascuud Cali Xasan oo ka hadlay kulanka ayaa sheegay in uu ahaa kulan wax-ku-ool ah oo dhisaya xidhiidhka labada dal, isaga oo xusay in labada dhinac ay is weydaarsadeen aragtiyo ku saabsan xoojinta xidhiidhka iyo sidii kor loogu sii qaadi lahaa fursadaha iskaashi.

items.title: Albania oo magacawday Wasiirka AI ee ugu horreeya adduunka
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Albania, Edi Rama, ayaa magacaabay wasiirka ugu horreeya adduunka ee uu dhalay Artificial Intelligence (AI), kaas oo loo magacaabay Diella. Wasiirkan dhijitaalka ah ayaa loo xilsaaray inuu kormeero dhammaan howlaha qandaraaska dawliga ah si uu uga dhigo kuwo 100% hufan oo aan musuqmaasuq lahayn . Tallaabadan ayaa ka dhigtay Albania dal ugu horreeya adduunka ee isticmaala AI heer wasiir si uu ula dagaallamo musuqmaasuqa . Tallaabadan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan tahay isku day cusub oo lagu doonayo in lagu hagaajiyo hufnaanta maamulka iyo la dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa iyadoo la adeegsanayo tignoolajiyadda casriga ah. Diella, oo ah haweeney lagu soo bandhigay dharka dhaqanka Albania, waxaa markii hore la sameeyay Janaayo 2025 si ay uga caawiso dadka adeegsiga rasmiga ah ee barta e-Albania iyadoo ilaa hadda soo saartay 36,600 dokumenti dhijitaal ah iyo ku dhawaad 1,000 adeeg . Ra’iisul Wasaare Rama ayaa sheegay in Diella ay leedahay awood ay ku kormeerto dhammaan go’aannada qandaraaska dawliga ah isagoona ku tilmaamay inay suurtogelin doonto in lacagaha dawliga ah ay noqdaan kuwo 100% daah-furan. Waxa uu intaas ku daray: “Diella waa xubintii ugu horreysay ee aan jir ahaan u jirin balse ay sameysay Artificial Intelligence” . Wasiirka AI ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inuu la hadlay baarlamaanka, isagoo sheegay: “khatarta dhabta ah ee dastuurka marna ma aha mashiinnada, balse waa go’aannada aan bini’aadamnimada lahayn ee kuwa xoogga haya” . Si kastaba ha ahaatee magacaabista Diella waxay kicisay falcelinno kala duwan. Qaar ka mid ah khubarada ayaa ka digay in AI aysan ahayn xal sixir ah oo lagu xallin karo musuqmaasuqa iyadoo ay ugu wacan tahay in tignoolajiyadu ay tahay mid uun sida ay u wanaagsan yihiin dadka abuura oo maamula . Sidoo kale, waxaa jira welwel ku saabsan sida looga jawaabi doono su’aasha mas’uuliyadda marka go’aanno muhiim ah laga qaato nidaam AI ah, iyadoo ay jirtaan sidoo kale su’aalo ku saabsan waxqabadka dhabta ah ee Diella iyo haddii ay tahay mid wax ku ool ah . Dhanka kale hoggaamiyaha mucaaradka Sali Berisha, ayaa ku tilmaamay talaabadan mid aan dastuuri ahayn oo loogu talagalay inay soo jiito dareenka, isagoo sheegay inaysan suurtogal ahayn in lagu xakameeyo musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo Diella . Dowladda Albania ayaa sii wadda dadaalladeeda ay kula dagaallamayso musuqmaasuqa, taasoo ah mid ka mid ah shuruudaha ugu muhiimsan ee ay uga midowdo Midowga Yurub . The post Albania oo magacawday Wasiirka AI ee ugu horreeya adduunka first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

Diella, oo ah haweeney lagu soo bandhigay dharka dhaqanka Albania, waxaa markii hore la sameeyay Janaayo 2025 si ay uga caawiso dadka adeegsiga rasmiga ah ee barta e-Albania iyadoo ilaa hadda soo saartay 36,600 dokumenti dhijitaal ah iyo ku dhawaad 1,000 adeeg . Ra’iisul Wasaare Rama ayaa sheegay in Diella ay leedahay awood ay ku kormeerto dhammaan go’aannada qandaraaska dawliga ah isagoona ku tilmaamay inay suurtogelin doonto in lacagaha dawliga ah ay noqdaan kuwo 100% daah-furan. Waxa uu intaas ku daray: “Diella waa xubintii ugu horreysay ee aan jir ahaan u jirin balse ay sameysay Artificial Intelligence” . Wasiirka AI ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inuu la hadlay baarlamaanka, isagoo sheegay: “khatarta dhabta ah ee dastuurka marna ma aha mashiinnada, balse waa go’aannada aan bini’aadamnimada lahayn ee kuwa xoogga haya” . Si kastaba ha ahaatee magacaabista Diella waxay kicisay falcelinno kala duwan. Qaar ka mid ah khubarada ayaa ka digay in AI aysan ahayn xal sixir ah oo lagu xallin karo musuqmaasuqa iyadoo ay ugu wacan tahay in tignoolajiyadu ay tahay mid uun sida ay u wanaagsan yihiin dadka abuura oo maamula . Sidoo kale, waxaa jira welwel ku saabsan sida looga jawaabi doono su’aasha mas’uuliyadda marka go’aanno muhiim ah laga qaato nidaam AI ah, iyadoo ay jirtaan sidoo kale su’aalo ku saabsan waxqabadka dhabta ah ee Diella iyo haddii ay tahay mid wax ku ool ah . Dhanka kale hoggaamiyaha mucaaradka Sali Berisha, ayaa ku tilmaamay talaabadan mid aan dastuuri ahayn oo loogu talagalay inay soo jiito dareenka, isagoo sheegay inaysan suurtogal ahayn in lagu xakameeyo musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo Diella . Dowladda Albania ayaa sii wadda dadaalladeeda ay kula dagaallamayso musuqmaasuqa, taasoo ah mid ka mid ah shuruudaha ugu muhiimsan ee ay uga midowdo Midowga Yurub . items.title: Daawo: Xasan oo weerar culus ku qaaday mucaaradka DF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo maanta khudbada dheer ka jeediyay xafladda qalin-jabinta saddexda dufcadood ee Machadka Sare ee Daraasaadka Amniga iyo Istaraatiijiyadda Qaranka ayaa weerar culus oo dhanka afka ah ku qaaday siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ee kasoo horjeedo dowladdiisa. Xasan Sheekh ayaa ku eedeeyay siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ah ee haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ka wada magaalada Muqdisho inay dalka dib ugu celinayaan marxaladihii adkaa ee lasoo maray, isla markaana ay doonayaan in loo dhaqmo sida xilligii hoggaamiye kooxeedyadu awoodda ku lahaayeen caasimadda. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale farriin culus u diray shacabka Soomaaliyeed, wuxuuna ugu baaqday inay u istaagaan horumarka dalka, ayna garab istaagaan dowladdooda. “Nimanaa maanta waxay ku adkeysanayaan oo bannaanka ay la taagan yihiin inay weli hoggaamiye kooxeed ahaadaan siyaasad aan la garanayn institution aan lahayn qaabka go’aanka loo gaaro aan la garaneyn,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. Sidoo kale wuxuu sii raaciyay “Dadka Soomaaliyeed waxaan leeyahay kaca oo baraaruga nidaam sameysta siyaasadda waa waxa na haystaa dhaqaaluhu waa socdaa dadku waa ganacsanaayaan tacliintana waa soo noolaatay”. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, xilli xasaasi ah oo Villa Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka ay isku hayaan hannaanka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka iyo wax ka beddelka lagu sameeyay dastuurka ku-meel-gaarka ah ee dalka. Labada dhinac ayaa hadda u ballansan in dib loo amba qaado wada-hadalladii u socday, oo ay dhex-dhexaadineyso beesha caalamka, si xal loo gaaro. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, wada-hadallada ayaa si rasmi ah dib loo bilaabayaa todobaadka soo socda, iyadoo qorshuhu yahay inay is arkaan Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka, oo ka wada-hadli doono doodaha la xiriira nooca doorasho ee xilligan ka dhici karta dalka. Dhowaan xubnaha beesha caalamka ee dhex-dhexaadinta wada ayaa kulan la yeeshay Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka oo ay ka hadleen arrimaha la xiriira doorashooyinka waddanka iyo sida ay u noqon karaan kuwo lagu heshiiyo. The post Daawo: Xasan oo weerar culus ku qaaday mucaaradka DF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Garsoore Cumar Cartan oo taariikh ka sameynaya UEFA Super Cup
items.description: Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed ee heerka caalami, Cumar Cabduqaadir Cartan, ayaa caawa taariikh cusub ka sameynaya kubadda cagta Yurub, isagoo noqonaya garsoorihii ugu horreeyay ee aan Yurub ka soo jeedin ee dhex-dhexaadiya kulanka UEFA Super Cup. Kulankan weyn, oo caawa 10:00 PM habeenimo ka dhici doona magaalada Salzburg ee dalka Austria, waxaa isaga hor imaanaya Paris Saint-Germain, oo ku guuleysatay UEFA Champions League, iyo Aston Villa oo qaaday UEFA Europa League . Tallaabadan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan tahay guul taariikhi ah oo sharaf u ah Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan qaaradda Afrika, iyadoo Cartan uu ku soo laabtay heer sare kadib markii loo diiday inuu galo Mareykanka si uu uga qayb qaato Koobka Adduunka bishii Juun . Garsoore Cartan, oo 34 jir ah, ayaa ku jira liiska garsoorayaasha caalamiga ah ee FIFA tan iyo sannadkii 2018, waxaana sannadkii 2025 loo magacaabay Garsooraha ugu fiican Afrika . Cartan ayaa laga saaray garsoorayaashii Koobka Adduunka ka dib markii uu yimid Miami International Airport, waxaana loo sheegay inuu “xiriir la leeyahay tuhmanayaal ka tirsan kooxo argagixiso ah” . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, UEFA ayaa ku magacaabay garsooraha kulanka Super Cup shan maalin ka dib, iyadoo ay ugu wacan tahay heshiis iskaashi oo u dhexeeya UEFA iyo CAF . Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya, Cali Cabdi Maxamed, ayaa guul weyn ku tilmaamay in Cartan iyo labadiisa caawiye oo kasoo kala jeeda Jabuuti iyo Kenya loo doorto inay dhex-dhexaadiyaan kulankan . Indhaha taageerayaasha Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwa Afrika ayaa caawa ku sii jeeda garoonka Red Bull Arena ee Salzburg, halkaas oo Garsoore Cumar Cabduqaadir Cartan uu magaca Soomaaliya ku qori doono bog cusub oo taariikhi ah oo kubadda cagta Yurub ah . The post Garsoore Cumar Cartan oo taariikh ka sameynaya UEFA Super Cup first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somali Journalist Released After 39 Days in NISA Detention
items.description: MOGADISHU – Somali journalist and Xogbile media founder Mascuud Warsame has been released after spending 39 days in detention by Somalia’s National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA), according to the Somali Journalists Syndicate (SJS). SJS said Warsame was detained in Mogadishu on 30 June 2026 and released on 8 August without being charged or brought before a court. According to SJS, Warsame said he was initially taken to a police station in Hodan district before being transferred to a NISA detention facility near Mogadishu port. He told the journalists’ union that he was repeatedly questioned about his social media activity and reports published by Xogbile that were critical of the leadership of Southwest State. SJS said Warsame described being held in a dark and hot cell with limited access to his family. According to his account to the union, his health deteriorated during detention and he collapsed twice before being taken to a doctor under armed guard. SJS said Warsame was suffering from fever and weakness when he was released and was later diagnosed with malaria and allergic conditions. SJS welcomed Warsame’s release but raised concerns over his prolonged detention without charge, judicial appearance or regular access to family and legal representation. The union called on Somali authorities to end what it described as the use of intelligence and security agencies to intimidate or arbitrarily detain journalists and urged authorities to respect media freedom and due process. items.title: North East Calls on FGS to Pay Its Forces
items.description: North East (Raxanreeb Online): The North East Administration has called on the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS) to pay the salaries of its security forces, following the reported failure of a plan by the Federal Government to deploy federal forces into Puntland. MP Kilwa said the North East forces need the Federal Government to provide their salaries, linking the request to the ongoing political and security developments in Puntland. The statement comes amid continued political tensions between the Federal Government and Puntland, particularly over security forces, administration, and the distribution of powers between the central government and federal member states. items.title: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Somaliland oo kulan la yeeshay safiirka dawladda Denmark
items.description: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, ahna ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi, ayaa kulan muhiim ah Qasriga Madaxtooyada kula yeeshay Safiirka Dowladda Denmark, Mudane Steen Sonne Andersen, kulankaasi oo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xidhiidhka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Denmark, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga iyo xasilloonida, horumarinta bulshada, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, dimuqraadiyadda iyo doorashooyinka. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka waxa kulanka ku wehelinayey Wasiirka Madaxtooyada, Wasiirka Qorshaynta iyo Horumarinta Qaranka, Agaasimaha Guud ee Arrimaha Dibedda, Afhayeenka Madaxweynaha iyo Xoghayaha gaarka ah ee Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL ayaa Safiirka uga mahad naqay taageerada dhaqaale iyo ta horumarineed ee ay Dawladda Denmark siiso Somaliland, isaga oo xusay in iskaashiga noocan ahi uu door muhiim ah ka qaato horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, kobcinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, xoojinta amniga iyo kobcinta Hay’adaha Dimuqraadiyadda iyo Doorashooyinka. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL waxa uu Safiirka ku adkeeyey muhimadda ay leedahay in Denmark ay sii xoojiso taageerada dhaqaale ee ay siiso Somaliland, gaar ahaan mashaariicda sida toos ah u taabanaya nolosha bulshada, horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo adkaynta Dawladnimada iyo nidaamka dimuqraadiyadda. Dhinaca kale, Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL ahna ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in Dawladda Denmark, Dalalka Iskaandineefiyanka iyo Midowga Yurub ay si dhab ah u qiimeeyaan xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo ta juqraafiyeed ee ka jirta Geeska Afrika, isla markaana ay gar-waaqsadaan xaqiiqada ka jirta Somaliland oo ah dal leh Hay’ado Qaran oo adag, nidaam dimuqraadiyadeed, nabadgelyo iyo Dawladnimo muddo dheer soo dhismaysay. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL waxa uu Safiirka Dawladda Denmark ku baraarujiyey in Somaliland ay mudan tahay in xaqiiqadeeda siyaasadeed loo wajaho si dhab ahaan ka tarjumaysa rabitaanka Shacabka JSL iyo kaalinta muhiimka ah ee ay Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ku leedahay nabadda, xasilloonida iyo guud ahaanba amniga Gobolka Geeska Afrika, gaar ahaan sugidda amniga marinnada istaraatiijiga ah ee Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Isaguna dhankiisa, Safiirka Denmark, Mudane Steen Sonne Andersen ayaa bogaadiyey amniga, xasilloonida, horumarka iyo hannaanka dimuqraadiga ah ee ka hana-qaaday Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isaga oo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo iskaashiga labada dhinac. Safiirku waxa uu xaqiijiyey in Dawladda Denmark ay sii wadi doonto taageerada mashaariicda horumarineed ee waxtarka u leh bulshada Somaliland, gaar ahaan sii xoojinta taageerada ay Denmark muddada dheer ku lahayd Sanduuqa Horumarinta Somaliland (SDF), oo ah Sanduuq muhiim u ah maalgelinta mashaariicda horumarineed ee la jaanqaadaya arrimaha mudnaanta u leh Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Kulanka waxa Safiirka ku wehelinayey madaxii hore ee Hay’adda DANIDA Somaliland (Mathias Kjaer), madaxa cusub ee DANIDA ⁠(Camilla Christensen) iyo Cabdiqani Maxamed Xuseen (Political Officer). Kulanka ayaa ku soo dhammaaday is-faham iyo aragti wadaag ku saabsan sii xoojinta iskaashiga iyo wada shaqaynta labada dhinac, iyada oo Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay muujisay in ay ka go’an tahay dhismaha xidhiidh caalami ah oo ku salaysan iskaashi waxtar leh, dano-wadaag iyo hiigsiga himilo horumarineed oo waarta.

items.title: Sacdiya Bajaaj oo maanta la sii daayay kadib markii go’aan…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maxkamadda Racfaanka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa maanta xorriyadeeda dib u siisay Sacdiya Macallin Cali (Sacdiya Bajaaj) oo ay horay Maxkamadda Gobolka ugu soo xukuntay saddex sano oo xarig ah. Qareennada difaacayay Sacdiya ayaa soo qaatay racfaan, kadibna waxaa guda gashay Maxkamadda Racfaanka Gobolka oo maanta burisay xukunkii hore, iyada oo sheegtay in aan loo cuskan asbaab sharci ah. Garsooraha Maxkamadda ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay xor tahay Sacdiya Bajaaj oo in ka badan 100 maalmood ku xirneyd Xabsiga Dhexe ee Xamar. Intaas kadib waxaa warbaahinta la hadlay mid kamid ah qareennada u doodayay Sacdiya oo sheegay inay ku faraxsan yihiin go’aanka ay gaartay Maxkamadda. “Annaga markii hore waxaan aaminsaneyn in Sacdiya ay bari tahay aynaan fal dambiyeen gelin, Maxkamadda waxaa u cadaatay waana lasii daayay,” ayuu yiri Abuukaate Maxamed Sheekh oo u doodayay Sacdiya Macallin Cali. Fadhigga Maxkamadda waxaa maanta goobjoog ahaa ehellada Sacdiya Bajaaj, dadweyne isaga kala yimid xaafadaha Muqdisho iyo Wariyeyaasha oo soo tabinayay xukunka kasoo baxay Maxkamadda Racfaanka Gobolka Banaadir. Gabdhahan oo caan ka noqotay baraha bulshada ayaa horay si wayn uga soo muuqan jirtay warbaahinta, waxaana sidoo kale marar badan ay ka qayb gashay kulamo ay qabteen mucaaradka oo looga soo horjeeday Dowladda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, sii deynta Sacdiyo Macallin Cali ayaa dhalisay falcelin ballaaran, iyadoo dad badan oo Soomaaliyeed ay si weyn usoo dhaweeyeen xorriyaddeeda, kuna tilmaameen tallaabo farxad iyo rajo gelisay bulshada. items.title: Hargeysa oo Laga Dareemayo Yaraanta Weelasha Cuntada
items.description: Hargeysa (Raxanreeb Online): Magaalada Hargeysa ayaa bishii u dambaysay laga dareemayay yaraanta weelasha hal mar la isticmaalo ee cuntada safaariga lagu qaato, kuwaas oo loo yaqaan “One Time Use”. Qaar ka mid ah ganacsatada ayaa yaraanta weelashan ku sababeeyay xidhnaanshaha marinnada muhiimka ah ee ay badeecaduhu uga soo geli jireen Somaliland. Qaar kamid ah hoteellada iyo maqaaxiyaha ayaa hadda cuntada macaamiisha ku ridaya bac, taas oo walaac ka dhalisay badqabka iyo nadaafadda cuntada. Meelaha weli laga heli karo weelashan ayaa iyaguna qiimahooda kor u qaaday, iyadoo la sheegay inay mararka qaar laba jibbaar ka badan yihiin qiimihii hore. Weelashan waxaa badanaa laga sameeyaa aluminium khafiif ah (aluminium foil), waxaana lagu farsameeyaa mashiinno gaar ah oo aluminium-ka lagu cadaadiyo laguna qaabeeyo. Waa kuwo fudud, kulaylka u adkaysta, isla markaana dib loo warshadayn karo. Dalalka sida weyn u soo saara weelashan waxaa kamid ah Shiinaha, Hindiya iyo Turkiga, waxaana suuqyada Somaliland lagu keenaa iyadoo dibadda laga soo dhoofiyo.
