items.title: Mareykanka ma wuxuu billaabay inuu dhinac maro DF kadib tallaabadii lama filaanka?
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) — Horraantii bishan Agoosto, taliyaha ugu sarreeya ciidamada gaarka ah ee Mareykanka ee Afrika ayaa heshiis amni saxiixay isaga iyo madaxweynaha Puntland — oo ah maamul iskiis isu maamula oo ku yaalla waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya — si loo ballaariyo saldhigga milatari ee Mareykanka ee halkaas ku yaalla. Heshiiska ayaa bannaanka yimid kaddib bayaan kooban oo kasoo baxay dowladda Puntland. “Sida ku cad heshiiska, Mareykanku wuxuu ballaarin doonaa saldhiggiisa milatari ee Boosaaso si loo wanaajiyo howlgallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada, loogana qeyb qaato ilaalinta amniga badaha,” ayay Dowladda Puntland ee Soomaaliya ku sheegtay bayaan. “Dowladda Puntland waxaa ka go’an la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo khatar kasta oo waxyeello u geysan karta amniga, xasilloonida iyo horumarka Puntland, Soomaaliya iyo Geeska Afrika.” Faahfaahin aad u yar ayaa laga hayaa heshiiskan, mana jiro qoraal rasmi ah oo shaacsan loo baahiyay, iyadoo sidoo kale uusan weli xaqiijin Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika (AFRICOM) ama mas’uul kale oo ka tirsan dowladda Mareykanka. “Qaabka aan rasmiga ahayn ee arrintan loo maray aad ayey muhiim u tahay,” ayay tiri Samar Al-Bulushi, oo professor ku-xigeenka cilmiga anthropology-ga ee Jaamacadda California, Irvine, isla markaana ah cilmi-baare ka tirsan Quincy Institute. “Haddii Mareykanku doonayo inuu ku adkeysto sheegashadiisa — oo u muuqata inay sheegasho keliya tahay — ee ah inuu ixtiraamayo madax-bannaanida dowladda Soomaaliya, markaas aragti ahaan ma ahayn inuu heshiisyo rasmi ah la galo maamulladan ismaamulka ah.” Heshiiska ayaa lagu soo warramayaa in laga wada xaajooday iyada oo aan wax door ah laga siin dowladda dhexe ee Muqdisho — oo maamulka Puntland aanu aqoonsaneyn awooddeeda — taasoo muujineysa isbeddel muuqda oo ah dhanka sida loola macaamilayo dowlad-goboleedyada ku yaalla darafyada federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo loo qaadanayo dhinacyo madax-bannaan oo si toos ah heshiisyo loola geli karo. Inkastoo heshiiska laftiisu aanu caddeyn badan lahayn, haddana wuxuu muujinayaa jihada cusub ee ay suuragalka tahay in ay qaadeyso siyaasadda maamulka Trump ee Geeska Afrika. Khubaradu waxay sheegayaan in waxa ugu weyn ee arrintan riixaya ay tahay ballaarashada dagaalka Iran oo gaaray Badda Cas, halkii uu ka ahaan lahaa falcelin ku saabsan dhacdooyinka gudaha Soomaaliya. Hase yeeshee, tallaabadan waxay sidoo kale halis u tahay inay sii qoto-dheereyso khilaafka u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo dowlad-goboleedyada ay muddo dheer ku adkayd dowladda dhexe inay isku hayso. Xiriirka Mareykanka ee maamulladan ma aha mid gebi ahaanba cusub. Cameron Hudson, oo ah falanqeeye horeyna uga soo shaqeeyay agaasimaha arrimaha Afrika ee Golaha Amniga Qaranka Mareykanka, ayaa sheegay in Mareykanku muddo sannado ah Puntland u adeegsanayay meel uu kasoo abaabulo howlgallada gudaha Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan isagoo adeegsanaya saldhig ay Imaaraadka Carabta maamulaan oo ku yaalla magaalada dekedda ah ee Boosaaso. “Mareykanku waxay u badan tahay inuu hadda arko baahi muddo dheer ah oo ah inuu gobolka ku yeesho saldhig si buuxda isaga ugu gaar ah, isaga ayaana si buuxda u maamula,” ayuu Hudson yiri, isagoo sheegay in tallaabadan ay u badan tahay inay muujineyso koror ku yimaada duqeymaha milatari ee gudaha Soomaaliya ama inay qeyb ka tahay dadaal ballaaran oo lagula tacaalayo khataraha sii kordhaya ee gobolka. Washington ayaa sannado badan Soomaaliya ka wadday siyaasad loo yaqaan “dual-track”, taasoo ay isku mar ku taageerto dowladda dhexe ee Soomaaliya ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, isla markaana xiriir toos ah la dhisato maamul goboleedyada iyo kuwa maxalliga ah ee ka baxsan Muqdisho, sida Puntland ama Somaliland. AFRICOM waxay sheegtay inaysan qorsheyneyn inay saldhig milatari ka dhisto Somaliland, inkastoo qaar ka mid ah xildhibaannada Jamhuuriga ee Congress-ka ay Trump ugu baaqeen inuu aqoonsado madax-bannaanida maamulkaas. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale dhowaan noqday xubinta keliya ee Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ee aan cambaareyn aqoonsigii Israel ee Somaliland. Xiriirka lala leeyahay maamullada ku yaalla darafyada Soomaaliya ayaa yeeshay muhiimad istaraatiiji ah oo cusub tan iyo markii dagaalka Iran uu ku fiday Badda Cas. Kaddib markii Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay ku dhawaaqeen 20-kii July inay xannibaad dhinaca badda ah ku soo rogi doonaan Sacuudi Carabiya, gudaha Badda Cas, taasoo ay sheegeen inay jawaab u tahay weerarro cusub oo kaga yimid Riyadh, Washington iyo xulafadeeda ayaa raadinayay siyaabo looga hortagi karo in xannibaaddaasi sii carqaladeyso silsiladda sahayda adduunka. Saldhig ku yaalla Boosaaso wuxuu ciidamada Mareykanka u dhoweyn karaa furintaas dagaalka. “Maamulka Trump waxaa laga yaabaa inuu dib uga fiirsanayo qaabka uu ula macaamilayo Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri Ahmed Ibrahim, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay anthropology-ga bulshada iyo dhaqanka, isla markaana wax badan ka qoray Geeska Afrika. Muddo sannad iyo bar ah, maamulka Trump wuxuu inta badan ka fogaaday inuu ballaariyo joogitaankiisa dhulka ee Bariga Afrika, ayuu yiri Ibrahim, isaga oo taa beddelkeeda xoogga saaray duqeymaha diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee lagula dagaallamayo kooxaha argagixisada sida Al-Shabaab. Trump ayaa sannadkii hore Soomaaliya ka fuliyay rikoor dhan 124 duqeyn, waxaana intaas u dheer 78 duqeyn oo kale oo la fuliyay ilaa hadda 2026, taasoo aad uga badan 51-kii duqeyn ee guud ahaan la fuliyay muddadii Madaxweyne Joe Biden xilka hayay. Inkastoo tallaabadani ay muujin karto isbeddel ku yimid habka Mareykanku ula macaamilayo Soomaaliya, dagaalka Iran iyo saameyntiisa ayaa ah waxa ugu weyn ee arrintan dedejinaya, sida uu sheegay Michael Woldemariam, oo ah professor ku-xigeen ka tirsan Jaamacadda Maryland, isla markaana ah cilmi-baare sare oo aan deegaan aheyn oo ka tirsan Atlantic Council. “Arrintan runtii waxaa keliya oo lagu fahmi karaa marka laga eego su’aasha Badda Cas,” ayuu yiri. “Way igu adag tahay inaan fahmo waxa macquulka ka dhigaya arrintan haddii aanay jirin diiradda sii kordheysa ee lagu hayo Badda Cas, Khaliijka iyo arrimaha amniga badaha.” Fikirkaas ayaa sharxi kara sababta Puntland, halkii ay ka ahaan lahayd Jabuuti oo xuduud la leh waqooyi-galbeed Soomaaliya, ay u noqotay mid ka mid ah saaxiibada ay Washington doorbideyso marka ay dooneyso inay ballaariso marin-u-helkeeda agagaarka marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab — oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, isla markaana ay maraan 10 ilaa 12 boqolkiiba maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamka — sida ay sheegtay Al-Bulushi. Jabuuti waxay martigelisaa Camp Lemonnier, oo ah saldhigga joogtada ah ee ugu weyn Mareykanka ku leeyahay qaaradda Afrika, balse dowladdeedu waxay xariiq cad sameysay tan iyo markii uu billowday dagaalka Israel ee Gaza iyo weerarradii xigay ee Badda Cas, iyadoo Washington u sheegtay inaysan saldhigga ciidanka badda ee dalkeeda uga duuli karin weerarro ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta, sababo la xiriira cabsi laga qabo in arrintaasi Jabuuti kusoo jiiddo dagaalka. Saldhigga Puntland ayaa AFRICOM siin kara dabacsanaan howlgaleed oo noocaas ah. Al-Bulushi waxay qorshahan bilowga ah ku tilmaantay mid ka tarjumaya xiriir “milatari-ilaa-milatari ah”, kaasoo u muuqda inuu inta badan meesha ka saarayo wakiillada la soo doortay, diblomaasiyiinta ama mas’uuliyiinta siyaasadeed ee labada dhinac. “Arrintani waxay dib ugu laabaneysaa maamulkii koowaad ee Trump iyo kaddib maamulkii Biden, kuwaasoo ciidamada Mareykanka, gaar ahaan AFRICOM, siiyay awood aad u ballaaran oo aan ku koobneyn oo keliya inay galaan wada-xaajoodyo oo ay heshiisyo gaaraan, balse sidoo kale inay howlgallo ka fuliyaan dhulka iyaga oo aan la tashan qeybaha kale ee dowladda Mareykanka,” ayay tiri. Hudson wuxuu sheegay in ballaarinta saldhigga Puntland ay qeyb ka noqon karto dadaal ballaaran oo taliska dagaalka uu ku doonayo inuu “qiil ugu sameeyo jiritaankiisa”, isagoo xusay in AFRICOM la sheegay inay ka mid aheyd hay’adihii la qorsheynayay in la dhimo ama la baabi’iyo bilowgii xilliga Trump, balse tan iyo markaas uu qaaradda ka helay ujeeddo cusub. Saraakiisha AFRICOM ayaa sidoo kale la kulmay madaxda Jubaland, oo ah dowlad-goboleed kale oo federaal ah oo aan aqoonsaneyn awoodda Muqdisho, maalmo ka hor inta aysan dowladda Puntland ku dhawaaqin heshiiskan. Dadaalladan ayaa xoojin kara hannaan halis u ah inuu sii qoto-dheereeyo kala qeybsanaanta uu Mareykanku sheegayo inuu doonayo in la xalliyo. “Waxaan abuureynaa saadaal iyadu iskeed isu rumeyneysa,” ayuu yiri Hudson. “Haddii aan ka cabanno tabar-darrida iyo kala qeybsanaanta, dabadeedna aan hakino taageeradii dowladda dhexe oo aan xoojino maamullada ku yaalla darafyada, markaas waxaan dedejineynaa isla arrinta aan sida ugu weyn uga cabaneyno.” Woldemariam wuxuu ku doodayaa in siyaasadda Soomaaliya ay durba u socotay jihada xasillooni-darrada ka hor heshiiskan, isagoo tilmaamay khilaafaadka aan weli la xallin ee ku saabsan isbeddellada dastuurka, kuwaasoo hakiyay wada-shaqeyntii Muqdisho iyo maamullada ka go’ay. “Ma hubo in iskaashiga amni ee lala yeesho Puntland ama Somaliland uu xaaladda sii xumeynayo. Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan durba joogno heer aad looga walaaco,” ayuu yiri. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu weli ka digayaa jihada ay qaadan karto siyaasadda gobolka ee Mareykanka kaddib ballaarinta saldhigga milatari ee Puntland. “Qiiq badan ayaa halkan ka muuqda,” ayuu yiri Woldemariam. “Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u soconno jihada joogitaanka Mareykanka ee si weyn loo ballaariyay dhammaan xeebaha Badda Cas ee Geeska Afrika. Ugu dambeyn, qaabka uu joogitaankaasi yeelan doono wali lama oga.” The post Mareykanka ma wuxuu billaabay inuu dhinac maro DF kadib tallaabadii lama filaanka? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Dadaalladan ayaa xoojin kara hannaan halis u ah inuu sii qoto-dheereeyo kala qeybsanaanta uu Mareykanku sheegayo inuu doonayo in la xalliyo. “Waxaan abuureynaa saadaal iyadu iskeed isu rumeyneysa,” ayuu yiri Hudson. “Haddii aan ka cabanno tabar-darrida iyo kala qeybsanaanta, dabadeedna aan hakino taageeradii dowladda dhexe oo aan xoojino maamullada ku yaalla darafyada, markaas waxaan dedejineynaa isla arrinta aan sida ugu weyn uga cabaneyno.” Woldemariam wuxuu ku doodayaa in siyaasadda Soomaaliya ay durba u socotay jihada xasillooni-darrada ka hor heshiiskan, isagoo tilmaamay khilaafaadka aan weli la xallin ee ku saabsan isbeddellada dastuurka, kuwaasoo hakiyay wada-shaqeyntii Muqdisho iyo maamullada ka go’ay. “Ma hubo in iskaashiga amni ee lala yeesho Puntland ama Somaliland uu xaaladda sii xumeynayo. Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan durba joogno heer aad looga walaaco,” ayuu yiri. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu weli ka digayaa jihada ay qaadan karto siyaasadda gobolka ee Mareykanka kaddib ballaarinta saldhigga milatari ee Puntland. “Qiiq badan ayaa halkan ka muuqda,” ayuu yiri Woldemariam. “Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u soconno jihada joogitaanka Mareykanka ee si weyn loo ballaariyay dhammaan xeebaha Badda Cas ee Geeska Afrika. Ugu dambeyn, qaabka uu joogitaankaasi yeelan doono wali lama oga.” The post Mareykanka ma wuxuu billaabay inuu dhinac maro DF kadib tallaabadii lama filaanka? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ilhaan Cumar oo Minnesota Guul Ka Gaartay

items.title: Wadahadallada Dowladda iyo Mucaaradka oo Weli Xanniban
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Wadahadalkii u dhexeeyay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka ee dhacay 20-kii July ayaan kasoo bixin wax heshiis ah, hase yeeshee waxaa socda dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu doonayo in dhinacyada la isku soo dhaweeyo, loona abuuro jawi ku habboon in mar kale wada-hadallo loo fariisto. Dhexdhexaadiyayaasha ayaa wada la-tashiyo ay la yeelanayaan dhinacyada kala duwan ee arrinta ku lugta leh, iyagoo labada dhinac u gudbiyay qoraal ku saabsan qaabka loo wajihi karo wada-xaajoodka xiga. Qoraalka ayaa sidoo kale taabanaya cidda maamuleysa arrimaha doorashooyinka Federaalka, iyadoo la filayo in arrintaasi loo sameeyo guddi hawleed gaar ah. Sida muuqata, arrimaha doorashooyinka dowlad-goboleedyada laguma darin ajandaha wada-hadallada la qorsheynayo. Dhexdhexaadiyayaasha ayaa sidoo kale la tashanaya khubaro iyo siyaasiyiin kala duwan, iyagoo ka dhageysanaya aragtiyahooda ku saabsan qodobada mudnaanta leh iyo qaabka ugu habboon ee dhinacyada loogu soo bandhigi karo marka ay mar kale miiska wada-hadalka isugu yimaadaan. Wadahadalladan ayaa xasaasi u ah jihada siyaasadda dalka, gaar ahaan hannaanka doorashooyinka, maamulka doorashooyinka Federaalka iyo sidii loo heli lahaa heshiis siyaasadeed oo ay dhinacyadu wada qaataan. The post Wadahadallada Dowladda iyo Mucaaradka oo Weli Xanniban appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Deni oo Xarigga Ka Jaray Waddada Bacaadweyn-Gaalkacyo
items.description: Mudug (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa shalay si rasmi ah xarigga uga jaray wejiga koowaad ee waddada laamiga ah ee isku xirta Bacaadweyn iyo Gaalkacyo ee gobolka Mudug. Qaybta la dhameystiray ee waddada ayaa dhererkeedu yahay 20 KM, iyadoo ay marto deegaannada Heemo, Cagaaran, Horogle iyo Laanta-dusmada. Mashruucan ayaa lagu sheegay in lagu hirgeliyay cashuurtii shacabka oo dib loogu celiyay horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha Puntland. Shirkadda Kebarco Construction Co ayaa dhistay 13 KM oo kamid ah waddada, halka shirkadda Albaashi ay dhistay 7-da KM ee kale. Madaxweynaha oo ay weheliyeen masuuliyiin ka tirsan goleyaasha Puntland, maamulka gobolka Mudug iyo degmada Gaalkacyo, ayaa warbixin ka dhageystay Wasaaradda Hawlaha Guud, Hay’adda Waddooyinka Puntland, injineerrada iyo hawl-wadeennada shirkadaha dhisay waddada. Deni ayaa kula dardaarmay masuuliyiinta iyo shirkadaha in la dardargeliyo shaqada, lana dhammeystiro wejiga labaad ee mashruuca, kaas oo isna dhererkiisu yahay 20 KM. items.title: Maxay goosashada Janan ka beddeli kartaa xaaladda Gedo?
items.description: Beledxaawo (Caasimada Online) – Falcelin iyo hadal-heyn xooggan ayaa ka dhalatay goosashada Cabdirashiid Janan oo mar kale dib ula midoobay maamulka Jubbaland, kadib markii uu ka baxay garabka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Janan ayaa hadda ahaa Taliyaha NISA ee gobolka Gedo, wuxuuna wada-hadal hoose la galay Axmed Madoobe, kaas oo dhaliyay inay wada gaaraan heshiis rasmi ah. Siyaasiga Cabdisataar Xasan Cali oo ka hadlay arrinta Cabdirashiid Janaan ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in goosashadiisa aysan waxba ka beddeli doonin xaaladda Gedo, sababo la xiriira siyaasadaha is diidan ee weli ka jira gobolkaasi. “Cabdirashiid Janan in fikikiisa uu isbeddalay kuma imaaneyso xasilloonida gobolka Gedo, waana wax guur guuraayo siyaasadaha gobolkan sida dabeyshii oo kale,” ayuu yiri siyaasi Cabdisataar Xasan Cali oo la hadlay Radio Kulmiye. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay arrinta gobolka Gedo ay lamid tahay xaaladda reer Hiiraan oo iyana tabasho ka qaba maamul goboleedka HirShabelle. “Xaaladda gobolka Gedo waxay la mid tahay arrinta gobolka Hiiraan oo ka cowda maamulka HirShabelle marka siyaasado guur guuraayo ayaa ka jira labadaas gobol oo ka kala tirsan HirShabelle iyo Jubbaland,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Illaa iyo hadda ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay Dowladda Federaalka oo ku aadan arrinta Cabdirashiid Janan oo haatan u wareegay dhanka Jubbaland, waxaana la filayaa in dhowaan uu la kulmo Madaxweyne Axmed Madoobe. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Janan oo ah nin siyaasad ahaan isbedbeddala, ayaa horay sidaan oo kale dhabarka uga jabiyay dowladdii Madaxweyne Farmaajo, xilligaasna dib ula heshiiyay Axmed Madoobe, isaga oo mar kale maanta ku sameeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. The post Maxay goosashada Janan ka beddeli kartaa xaaladda Gedo? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ugu yaraan 15 qof oo ku geeriyooday doon rakaab oo ku degtay Harada Kariba ee Zimbabwe
items.description: Ugu yaraan 15 qof ayaa ku dhintay, halka 27 qof oo kale weli la la’yahay, kadib markii doon rakaab oo buux-dhaaf ah ay ku rogmatay Harada Kariba ee dalka Zimbabwe. Hay’adda Ilaalinta Madaniga ah ee Zimbabwe ayaa sheegtay in shilku dhacay Talaadadii, xilli doonta ay la kulantay mowjado xooggan. items.title: Maxkamadda Rafcaanka Gobolka Banaadir oo Maanta Go’aan ka Soo Saaraysa Dacwadda Sacadiya Bajaaj
items.description: Maxkamadda Rafcaanka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa maanta la filayaa inay go’aan ka soo saarto dacwadda Sacadiya Bajaaj, oo wajahaysa eedeymo la xariira kicin dadweyne iyo aflagaado ka dhan ah madaxda qaranka, sida ay xeer-ilaalintu sheegtay. Sacadiya Bajaaj ayaa horey Maxkamadda Gobolka Banaadir ugu xukuntay saddex sano oo xabsi ah, kaddib fadhiyo kala duwan oo ay kiiskeeda ka yeelatay. Qareennada Sacadiya ayaa racfaan ka qaatay xukunkaasi, iyagoo Maxkamadda Rafcaanka ka dalbaday in dib loo eego go’aankii Maxkamadda Gobolka Banaadir, isla markaana la buriyo ama wax laga beddelo xukunkii saddexda sano ahaa. Dacwaddan ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay si weyn loo hadal hayay, gaar ahaan baraha bulshada, iyadoo dad badan ay si dhow ula socdeen marxaladaha kala duwan ee kiiska iyo xaaladda Sacadiya oo muddo ku jirtay xabsiga. Maanta ayaa indhaha lagu hayaa go’aanka Maxkamadda Rafcaanka, iyadoo qareennada iyo dhinacyada kale ee kiiska ay sugayaan xukunka kama dambaysta ah ee ay maxkamaddu ka gaari doonto racfaanka. Go’aanka Maxkamadda Rafcaanka ayaa noqon doona mid muhiim u ah Sacadiya Bajaaj iyo qareennadeeda, kuwaas oo rajeynaya in xukunkii hore la buriyo ama wax laga beddelo, halka dhinaca kale ay maxkamaddu qiimeyn doonto doodihii iyo caddeymihii la horgeeyay intii ay socotay dacwaddu.

items.title: Sida yaabka leh ee Trump uga baxsaday shirqoolkii Iran ku khaarajin rabtay ee Ankara
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa bishii hore si qarsoodi ah loogu dhex qariyay konteenar lagu qaado cuntada diyaaradaha, lagana dejiyay diyaaradda Air Force One, kadib markii saraakiisha Mareykanka ay heleen xog lagu kalsoonaan karo oo sheegeysay in Iiraan ay dooneysay in ay khaarajiso. Howlgalka oo ka dhacay Turkiga 8-dii July, kadib shir madaxeedkii NATO, ayaa qeyb ka ahaa qorshe marin-habaabin ah oo si degdeg ah loo diyaariyay, sida ay sheegeen laba sarkaal oo sare oo Mareykan ah oo la hadlay New York Times . Trump ayaa markii hore isaga oo ay duubayaan kaamiradaha galay mid ka mid ah diyaaradaha duugga ah ee Air Force One, taas oo wariyeyaasha iyo dadweynuhu u qaateen inuu Britain ugu duulayo. Laakiin markii wariyeyaasha la socday madaxweynaha ay dhinaca kale diyaaradda kaga mashquulsanaayeen fuulitaanka, Trump ayaa si qarsoodi ah looga saaray dhinaca kale. Saraakiisha ayaa sheegay in konteenar wiish sare loogu qaado, oo caadi ahaan loo adeegsado in cuntada iyo agabka kale lagu geliyo diyaaradaha, loo adeegsaday in madaxweynaha laga soo dejiyo dhinaca aanay wariyeyaashu arki karin. Waxaa kadib lagu qaaday gaari waxaana loo wareejiyay diyaarad militari oo saddexaad, taas oo si qarsoodi ah uga qaaday Turkiga kuna geysay Britain. Washington Post ayaa markii hore werisay in diyaaraddaas ay ahayd C-32A, oo ah nooca militariga ee Boeing 757. Sidee qorshaha u dhacay? Trump iyo saraakiishiisa ayaa xilligaas si shaacsan u sheegay inuu Turkiga kaga baxayo diyaaradda duugga ah ee Air Force One halkii uu isticmaali lahaa Boeing 747-8 cusub oo Qatar ay siisay Mareykanka. Trump wuxuu wariyeyaasha u sheegay inuu diyaaradda hore u raacayo “xusuustii hore darteed”. Muuqaal ayaa laga duubay isaga oo albaabka bidix ka galaya diyaaradda, halka wariyeyaasha la socda ay iyaguna fuuleen iyagoo rumeysnaa in madaxweynuhu gudaha ku jiro. Laakiin diyaaraddaas waxaa dhab ahaantii loo adeegsaday marin-habaabin ahaan iyo in lagu khaldo Iiraan. Wariyeyaasha iyo qaar ka mid ah shaqaalaha Aqalka Cad looma sheegin in Trump uusan diyaaradda la socon, taas oo ka dhigtay kuwo iyagoo aan ogeyn qeyb ka noqday qorshaha lagu qarinayay halka uu madaxweynuhu ku sugnaa. Markii diyaaradda duugga ah ay Turkiga ka kacday, wariyeyaasha saarnaa waxaa sidoo kale lagu amray inay xirtaan daahyada daaqadaha. Diyaaradda ayaa 10:16 habeenimo ka degtay saldhigga ciidamada Mareykanka ee Mildenhall ee Britain. Hase yeeshee, Trump ayaa xilligaas hore Britain ugu yimid diyaaraddii militariga ee qarsoodiga ahayd. Waxaa gaari looga soo qaaday diyaaraddaas, kadibna dib loogu geeyay Air Force One-ka, oo uu ka galay albaab kale. Qiyaastii 40 daqiiqo kadib ayuu Trump kasoo degay albaabka sare ee Air Force One iyadoo wariyeyaashu daawanayaan, taas oo abuurtay muuqaal muujinayay inuu diyaaraddaas Turkiga kaga yimid. Kadib ayuu garoonka lug uga gudbay diyaaradda cusub ee Qatar ay siisay, taas oo isaga iyo wariyeyaashu Washington ugu duuleen. Hanjabaad Iran laga helay Qorshaha ayaa la sheegay in saacado gudahood lagu diyaariyay kadib markii saraakiisha Mareykanka ay go’aamiyeen in halista Iran ay tahay mid dhab ah. Trump ayaa intii uu Turkiga joogay lagu wargeliyay khatarta, waxaana howlgalka ku lug lahaa koox kooban oo saraakiil sare ah. Waxaa ka mid ahaa xoghayaha difaaca Pete Hegseth iyo guddoomiyaha Taliyeyaasha Guud ee ciidamada Mareykanka, General Dan Caine. Warbixinnadii hore ayaa diiradda saarayay ammaanka diyaaradda Boeing 747-8 ee Qatar ay siisay Mareykanka, taas oo aan weli lagu rakibin dhammaan qalabka difaaca ee ku jira diyaaradaha kale ee madaxweynaha. Laakiin dadka xog-ogaalka ah ayaa sheegay in hanjabaadda Iran aysan ku koobneyn diyaaraddaas. Waxay sheegeen in Trump lagu bartilmaameedsanayay diyaaradda kasta oo uu ku safri lahaa, taas oo keentay in saraakiishu adeegsadaan dhowr heer oo marin-habaabin ah. Markii Trump la weydiiyay sababta diyaaraddii hore uu uga raacay Turkiga, wuxuu sheegay inuu doonayay in ciidamada Mareykanka ee ku sugan Britain ay arkaan diyaaradda cusub. Wariyeyaashu waxay sidoo kale weydiiyeen sababta loogu amray inay daahyada daaqadaha xiraan. Trump wuxuu sheegay inuusan ogeyn hanjabaad gaar ah, balse uu muddo dheer bartilmaameed u ahaa Iran. “Aniga ayaa lambarka koowaad kaga jira liiskooda, idinka ka hor,” ayuu yiri. Trump iyo hanjabaadaha Iran Trump iyo qaar ka mid ah la-taliyeyaashiisa ayaa muddo sanado ah wajahaya shirqoolo lala xiriirinayo Iran. Xiisadda ayaa si weyn u korortay kadib markii Trump uu muddadiisii koowaad ee madaxtinimada uu amray weerarkii 2020 lagu dilay General Qassem Soleimani, oo ahaa taliyihii ciidamada Quds ee Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran. Intii lagu jiray ololihii doorashada 2024, saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale helay xog sirdoon oo muujineysay in Iran ay weli dooneyso inay waxyeello u geysato Trump. Arrintaas ayaa mararka qaar keentay in ololihiisa lagu isticmaalo diyaarado marin-habaabin ah, iyadoo Trump lagu qaadi jiray diyaarad qarsoodi ah halka shaqaalihiisu ay raacayeen diyaaraddiisa gaarka ah. Maamulka madaxweynihii hore Joe Biden ayaa xagaagii 2024 kordhiyay ilaalinta Trump kadib xog cusub oo ku saabsan qorshayaal lagu dili karo. Trump ayaa isla sanadkaas ka badbaaday laba isku day dil oo aan lala xiriirin Iran, mid ka dhacay Butler, Pennsylvania, iyo mid kale oo dhacay bishii September. Howlgalkii Turkiga ayaa haddana ahaa mid aan caadi ahayn, maadaama ay aad dhif u tahay in madaxweynaha Mareykanka si qarsoodi ah loo raro iyadoo wariyeyaasha rasmiga ah ee la socda aanay ogeyn halka uu dhab ahaantii ku sugan yahay. Saraakiisha amniga ayaa ku doodaya in marka khatar toos ah jirto, ilaalinta madaxweynaha ay ka horreyso in dadweynaha iyo saxaafadda loo sheego faahfaahinta dhaq-dhaqaaqiisa. items.title: Qoysas danyar ah oo soo kabasho ganacsi ka helay waddo cusub oo laga dhisay Badhan
items.description: (ERGO) –  In ka badan labo boqol oo qoys oo ku nool magaalada Baran ee gobolka Sanaag ayaa ka soo kabtay nolol xumo markii ay ganacsiyo yaryar ka furteen xaafaddooda saddexdii bil ee la soo dhaafay. Arrintaas ayaa u suuragashay markii waddo jay ah la saaray xaafadda Galbeed oo ay ku nool yihiin.  Qoysaskan oo ahaa danyar ayaa markii waddada la dhisay xaafaddooda ka furtay ganacsiyo, taas oo u horseeday isbeddel nololeed. Faadumo Maxamuud Shire waxay qol ka mid ah guri labo qol ah oo ay deganaayeen ka furatay dukaan ay ku iibiso raashinka, dharka dumarka iyo bagaash .   Waxay xustay in fikraddan ay ku dhalatay markii gurigeedu uu noqday kan ugu horreeya ee ku yaalla waddada, ayna aragtay ganacsiyada sida xooggan ugu soo batay hareeraha jidka. Waxay xustay in ganacsigeeda cusub ay maalintii ka hesho ugu yaraan $8 oo faa’iido ah, taas oo nolol wanaagsan u horseedday.  “Nolosheenu waa heerka u sareeyay, weligay meeshan ma filanayn, nolol xumadii waan ka baxnay, waa ii shaqeeya ganacsigii, faa’iido xoog leh ayaan ka helaa maalin kasta. Waddadaan annagoo mugdi ku jirna ayay na iftiimisay.”  Faadumo, oo keligeed korisa lix carruur agoon ah, ayaa sheegtay in ka hor ganacsiga ay ku tiirsanaayeen taageero yar oo ay siin jireen dad ay ehel yihiin, taas oo aan ku filnayn. Waxay xustay in maalmaha qaar ay waayi jirtay wax ay dabka u saarto.  Ganacsigeeda oo ay furtay horraantii May ayay sheegtay inuu yeeshay macaamiil, taas oo keentay inuu koro si xawli ah muddo kooban. Waxay tilmaantay in marba marka ka dambaysa uu sii korayo ganacsiga xaafadda oo ay qayb ka tahay, taas oo sare u qaadda halgankeeda.  Waxay xustay in dukaankeeda ay ku maalgelisay lacag ay bangi dayn uga qaadatay, iyadoo gurigeeda rahan u dhigatay si lacagtaas loogu siiyo, haddii ay celin wayso. Go’aankaas oo ay u qaadatay si geesinimo leh ayaa u horseeday hadafkii ay ku taamaysay.  “Lacagtaa anniga oo aan shilling haysanin ayaa la ii siiyay. $500 ayay ahayd, iyadaan ku bilaabay, dhamaana waan iska celiyay. Lacagtaa markaas aan helay ganacsigu wuu ii ballaartay, waana sii fidiyay oo sii gallay. Wax weyn bay ii tartay xaqiiqdii.”  Faadumo ayaa sheegtay in ganacsigeedu uu hadda ku kacayo qiimo ay ku qiyaastay $2,000, taas oo ah faa’iido aad u xooggan marka loo eego muddada uu shaqaynayay. Waxay xustay inay qorshaynayso inay sii ballaariso.  Dhanka kale, haweenaydan waxay sheegtay in guulaha ay ka gaartay ganacsiga ay u dheertahay inay waxbarasho ku dartay saddex ka mid ah carruurteeda, kuwaas oo horay ay u gayn waysay dhaqaale xumada darteed. Waxay bishii ka dhiibtaa $30, taas oo aan culays ku hayn. Arrintaas waa mid ay kala siman yihiin dhammaan dadka ganacsiyada samaystay oo si isku mid ah u hantay faa’iido wax ku ool ah. Xaafaddan oo awal ahayd meel isku raran ah oo ay ku nool yihiin dadka danyarta ah ayaa isku beddeshay suuqa ugu weyn ee magaalada ku yaalla.  Dadkii horay u deganaa ayaa fursaddaas si isku mid ah uga faa’iidaystay, iyada oo qof kasta uu gurigiisa u beddelay goob ganacsi. Kaltuun Cumar Xasan waxay balbalo ay bagaash iyo shaah ku iibiso ka samaysatay guri ay leeyihiin dad ay qaraabo yihiin hortiisa.  Haweenaydan oo kaligeed korsata 10 carruur ah oo lagu furay oo aan lagu daryeelin ayaa sheegtay in muddo labo bil iyo bar ah ay ganacsiga waddo. Waxay ka soo kabteen nolol xumo ay wajahayeen oo ay ugu horraysay cunno xumo.  “Markii aan waddadan jirin iyo maanta ganacsigu waa kala duwan yahay noloshuna waa kala duwan tahay. Waxa ugu yar waxa waaye gawaarida waddada maraysa biyaha iyo cuntada ayay xitaa iga sii gataan oo wax badan ayay nagu soo kordhisay.”  Qoyska Kaltuun ayaa labo sano ka hor ka soo barakacay miyiga magaalada Baran oo ay deganaayeen, markii daaq xumo ka dhalatay roob yari ay ku dhaafeen 140 ari ah oo ay dhaqanayeen. Waxay ilmaheeda ku masruufaysay wax ay ku caawiyaan dadka magaalada oo ay ku dhex wareegaysay, iyada oo dulsaar ku ahayd qoys ay qaraabo yihiin oo siiyay hal qol.  Noloshaas adkayd ayay sheegtay inay hadda ka saartay ilmaheeda, iyada oo u kiraysay labo qol oo ay bishii ka dhiibto $30. Waxay sidoo kale qorshaynaysaa inay hesho guri ay iyadu leedahay, waxayna maalin kasta meel dhigtaa in ka mid ah lacagta ay hesho si ay uga dhabayso hamigeeda.  Kaltuun inay maaraysay nolosha qoyskeeda waxa u dheer inay bishii Juun waxbarasho ku dartay afar ka mid ah carruurteeda, kuwaas oo ay bishii ka bixiso $40. Maaddaama uu hana qaaday ganacsigeeda, waxay sheegtay inay naawilayso inay kuwa kalena gayso bilaha soo aaddan.  “Walaal Carruurta iskuul iyo dugsi ayay ii dhigtaan. Aniga waxaan u ordayaa in aan ilmahayga caafimaadkooda, waxbarashadooda iyo cuntadooda aan keeno waana helaa Alxamdullilaah wax kasta oo aan u baahdo. Miyiga aniga iyo carruurtaba waan ka raysannay.” Kaltuun ayaa sheegtay in ganacsigeedu uu haysto macaamiil badan maaddaama ay ka mid tahay ganacsatadii ugu horraysay ee maqaaxi ka furta waddada. Waxay ku beegantay xilli ay magaalada u soo guurayaan dadka ka soo xagaa-baxaya magaalada Boosaaso.  Waxay sheegtay in hadda ay iska celisay $800 oo ay ganacsiga ku billowday, taas oo ay daymiyeen dad qaraabo ah. Waxay xustay in hadda ay doonayso inay sii ballaariso maqaaxida oo ay kiraysato goob weyn oo ku filan, maaddaama macaamiisheedu ay sii kordhayaan.  Haweenaydan oo ah 40 jir nolosheeda oo dhan ku soo qaadatay miyiga ayaa sheegtay inay ku faraxsan tahay inuu guul gaaray ganacsigeedii ugu horreeyay. Waxay aaminsan tahay hadda inay maamuli karto dhaqaale intaas ka badan maaddaama ay faham fiican heshay.  Waxay sheegtay in ganacsigeeda cusub uu hadda ka wax-soo-saar badan yahay xoolihii ay dhaqanayeen, oo waayadii dambe ay curyaamiyeen abaaraha soo laalaabtay. Waxay xustay in haddii ay ganacsiga sii waddo ay aaminsan tahay inay gaari karto heer aad uga sarreeya halka ay maanta joogto.  Fursadda ay heleen dadkan danyarta ah, oo aan markii hore ganacsiyo ka hirgelin karin magaalada ayaa timid markii la hirgeliyay waddadan oo ay maalgelisay Safaaradda Ingiriiska ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo kaashanaysa Sanduuqa Somalia Stability Fund iyo Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Waddooyinka Puntland.  Ujeeddada barnaamijkan ayaa ah in la ballaariyo isku socodka iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha deegaannada soo koraya, sida uu sheegay Maxamed Muuse Cali oo dawlada hoose ee degmada Baran u xilsaartay barnaamijkan.  Dadka ku nool xaafadaan oo markii hore ahaa danyar aan dabka si joogto ah u shidan karin ayaa muddo kooban ku gaaray heer aad uga wanaagsan noloshii hore taas oo muujisay muhiimadda ay leeyihiin horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha oo ay jidadku ka midka yihiin. items.title: Ugu yaraan 6 Qof oo Lagu Dilay Weerar ay Xuutiyiintu Ka Geysteen Marinka Bab al-Mandab
items.description: Ugu yaraan lix qof ayaa ku dhintay, 10 kalena ku dhaawacmeen weerar ay Xuutiyiinta Yemen ku qaadeen markab ganacsi oo laga leeyahay Masar, xilli uu marayay marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab, sida ay sheegtay dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay. Weerarka oo dhacay Talaadadii ayaa lagu qaaday markabka Tihamah, waxaana masuuliyiinta Yemen ay sheegeen in Xuutiyiintu ku dhufteen saddex gantaal oo ballistic ah. Gantaallada ayaa sababay dab xooggan iyo burbur weyn oo soo gaaray markabka, ayadoo wasaaradda Gaadiidka Yemen ay sheegtay in dadka dhintay ay ku jiraan saddex muwaadin oo Pakistan u dhashay iyo hal muwaadin oo Indonesia ah. Laba askari oo ka tirsan ciidamadii gurmadka ayaa iyaguna lagu dilay weerar labaad sida ay sheegeen ilaalada xeebaha Yemen, oo Tilmaamay in markii ciidamada gurmadku bilaabeen daadgureynta shaqaalaha markabka iyo dadka ku dhaawacmay weerarkii hore, Xuutiyiintu ay markabka ku soo rideen gantaal kale. Gantaalka labaad ayaa ku dhacay goobtii uu ka socday howlgalka samatabbixintu, waxaana halkaas ku dhintay laba askari, taas oo tirada Guud ka dhigtay 6 dhimasho ah iyo 10 dhaawac ah. Bab al-Mandab waa marin-biyood muhiim ah oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, isla markaana muhiim u ah isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga ee u kala goosha Aasiya, Bariga Dhexe iyo Yurub. Weerarrada sii kordhaya ayaa sare u qaadaya walaaca laga qabo in amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga uu mar kale si weyn u xumaado, iyadoo khatartaasi ay saameyn ku yeelan karto ganacsiga iyo dhaqaalaha caalamka. .

items.title: Cumar Cartan oo taariikh cusub ka dhigaya kubadda cagta Yurub
items.description: Salzburg (Caasimada Online) – Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed ee heerka caalami Cumar Cabduqaadir Cartan ayaa caawa taariikh cusub ka sameynaya kubadda cagta Yurub, kaddib markii loo doortay inuu dhex-dhexaadiyo mid ka mid ah kulamada ugu waaweyn ee xilli-ciyaareedka kubadda cagta qaaradda Yurub. Cartan ayaa garsoore ka noqonaya kulanka weyn ee UEFA Super Cup, kaas oo lagu qabanayo magaalada Salzburg ee dalka Austria, iyadoo ay isku wajahayaan labada kooxood ee ku guuleystay tartamada waaweyn ee UEFA. Kulanka ayaa waxaa wada ciyaaraya Paris Saint-Germain (PSG), oo xilli-ciyaareedkii hore ku guuleysatay UEFA Champions League, iyo Aston Villa, oo qaaday UEFA Europa League. Labada kooxood ayaa isku arki doona kulan xiiso badan, iyadoo indhaha taageerayaasha kubadda cagta Yurub iyo kuwa caalamka ay si gaar ah ugu jeedaan garoonka iyo shaqada garsoore Cumar Cartan. Cumar Cartan ayaa noqonaya garsoorihii ugu horreeyay ee aan Yurub kasoo jeedin ee loo igmado inuu dhex-dhexaadiyo kulanka UEFA Super Cup, taas oo ka dhigaysa dhacdadan mid xusuus gaar ah ku leh taariikhda garsoorka kubadda cagta. Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya, ahna Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka CECAFA Cali Cabdi Maxamed, ayaa guul weyn ku tilmaamay in Garsoore Cumar Cartan iyo labadiisa caawiye oo kasoo kala jeeda dalalka Bariga iyo Bartamaha Afrika, loo doorto inay dhex-dhexaadiyaan kulanka weyn ee UEFA Super Cup Fursaddan ayaa sare u qaadaysa magaca Soomaaliya, iyadoo garsoore Soomaaliyeed uu helay kalsoonida hay’adaha ugu sarreeya kubadda cagta Yurub, si uu u maamulo kulan ay ka qeybgalayaan kooxaha ugu magaca weyn qaaradda. Guushan ayaa muujineysa horumarka uu sameeyay Cartan sannadihii lasoo dhaafay iyo sida uu uga mid noqday garsoorayaasha Afrika ee awoodda u leh inay ka shaqeeyaan kulamada heerka ugu sarreeya ee kubadda cagta caalamka. Cumar Cabduqaadir Cartan oo 34 jir ah ayaa ku jira liiska garsoorayaasha caalamiga ah ee FIFA tan iyo sannadkii 2018. Sannadkii 2025-ka ayaa loo magacaabay Garsooraha ugu fiican Afrika, isaga oo noqday mid ka mid ah garsoorayaasha ugu sarreeya qaaradda Afrika iyo guud ahaan caalamka, waxaana sidoo kale muddadii uu ku jiray garsoorka uu dhex-dhexaadiyay kulamo badan oo heer caalami ah. items.title: Qorax madoobaad la filaayo in uu dunida ka dhaco
items.description: Qorrax madoobaad la filayo maanta iyo meelaa uu ka dhici doono. Waxaa Arbacada maanta ah, 12-ka Agoosto la filayaa inuu ka dhaco qaybo kala duwan oo dunida ah qorrax madoobaad. Meelaha qaar ayaa laga arki doonaa madoobaad buuxa, halka meelo kalana laga arki doono madoobaad qayb ah. Haddii aadan si toos ah xitaa u arki karin, waxaa jiri doono muuqaallo cajiib ah oo ay suurtagal tahay in laga baahiyo meelo kala duwan oo dunida ah. Madoobaadka qorraxda ayaa dhaca marka dayaxu u dhaxeeyo dhulka iyo qorraxda, taas oo xannibaysa qayb ama dhammaan iftiinka qorraxda ee ina soo gaara. Noocyo kala duwan ayaa jira oo madoobaadka qorraxda ah. Nooca aad arki doonto wuxuu ku xiran yahay meesha aad ka joogto Dhulka iyo masaafada u dhexeysa Dayaxa iyo Dhulka. Madoobaadka qorraxda ee xiga ayaa la filayaa inuu dhico Arbacada, 12-ka Agoosto. Madoobaadka buuxa ayaa la filayaa in laga arki doonaa: Waqooyiga Ruushka, Greenland, Iceland, Isbayn iyo Boortaqiiska. Madoobaadkan lagama arki doono Turkiga. Madoobaadka qorraxda ee xiga ee laga daawan karo Turkiga wuxuu noqon doonaa madoobaad qayb ahaan ah, kaas oo dhici doona 2-da Agoosto, 2027. Sida ay sheegtay NASA, madoobaadka buuxa wuxuu ka bilaaban doonaa duhurnimada meel yar oo fog oo ku taalla waqooyiga Ruushka. Kadibna iyadoo Dhulku wareegayo, madoobaadku wuxuu u gudbi doonaa dhinaca Isbayn, halkaas oo laga arki doono fiidkii wax yar ka hor qorrax-dhaca. Muddada madoobaadka buuxu waxay noqon doontaa mid aad u gaaban, wax ka yar laba daqiiqo iyo bar. Qaybo ka mid ah waqooyiga Maraykanka, Kanada, waqooyi-galbeed Afrika, iyo meelo badan oo Yurub ah waxay arki doonaan madoobaad qayb ahaan ah, iyadoo meelo qaarkood in ka badan 90% Qorraxda la dabooli doono. Dhacdadan waxay sii noqon doontaa mid gaar ah, maadaama qaybo ka mid ah Afrika iyo qaaradda Yurub ay arki doonaan madoobaad ku beegan qorrax-dhac, taas oo macnaheedu yahay in Qorraxdu qayb ahaan madoobaan doonto iyadoo dhacaysa.

items.title: Ilhan Omar oo ku guuleysatay in ka badan 80% codadka doorashada hordhaca ah ee Congress-ka Mareykanka
items.description: Xildhibaanad Ilhaan Cumar ayaa si weyn ugu guuleysatay doorashada hordhaca ah ee Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ee degmada 5-aad ee Congress-ka gobolka Minnesota, iyadoo heshay in ka badan 80% codadka. Guushan ayaa u oggolaanaysa inay mar kale noqoto musharraxa Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ee degmada 5-aad doorashada guud ee bisha November 2026. Degmadan oo ay ku jirto magaalada Minneapolis ayaa lagu tilmaamaa mid ka mid ah degmooyinka ugu taageerada badan Dimuqraadiga ee Minnesota iyo guud ahaan Mareykanka. Ilhaan, oo Congress-ka Mareykanka ku matalaysay degmadan tan iyo 2018-kii, ayaa markan wajahday tartan adag oo ay la gashay musharraxiinta kala ah: Julie T. Le, Abena McKenzie, Latonya Reeves iyo Nate Schluter. Guusha ayaa sidoo kale muhiim u ah Ilhaan iyadoo ololaheeda siyaasadeed uu muddo dheer ku salaysnaa arrimo ay ka mid yihiin socdaalka, xuquuqda bulshada iyo siyaasadda Mareykanka ee Bariga Dhexe. Xogta doorashada ayaa muujinaysa in ay heshay taageero aad u ballaaran oo ka timid cod-bixiyayaasha degmada, ayadoo warbixinnada la helayo ay sidoo kale xusayaan in ay ololahan wajahday iyada oo aan taageero ka helin AIPAC oo ah urur saameynta weyn ku leh siyaasadda Mareykanka ee la xiriirta Israa’iil. Arrintan ayaa ka dhigtay ololaheeda mid si gaar ah loo hadal hayo, maadaama Ilhaan ay muddo dheer si adag u dhaleecaynaysay siyaasadda Israa’iil iyo dagaalka marinka Qasa. Doorashada hordhaca ah ayaa ahayd tallaabada koowaad; balse Ilhaan weli waxay u baahan tahay inay ku guuleysato doorashada guud ee November si ay u sii haysato kursigeeda Congress-ka.

items.title: Somali PM calls for new approach to international engagement
items.description: Mogadishu, Somalia — Somali Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre has called on United Nations agencies, donors and international organisations working in Somalia to change their approach, saying the country should no longer be treated as a transitional state.

items.title: Madaxweyne Zelenskyy oo safiir u magacaabay Somalia
items.description: Kyiv (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy ayaa Yuriy Tokar, oo ah safiirka dalkiisa u fadhiya Kenya, u magacaabay inuu sidoo kale noqdo safiirka Ukraine u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, xilli Kyiv ay sii ballaarineyso xiriirkeeda diblomaasiyadeed ee Afrika. Magacaabista ayaa lagu xaqiijiyay wareegto madaxweyne oo tirsigeedu yahay 717/2026, taas oo Zelenskyy saxiixay 11-ka August, laguna daabacay bogga rasmiga ah ee madaxtooyada Ukraine. Wareegtada ayaa dhigaysa in Yuriy Lyubomirovich Tokar, oo hadda ah safiirka Ukraine ee Kenya, uu isla xilkaas ka qaban doono Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in Ukraine aysan Muqdisho u soo dirin safiir gaar ah oo cusub, balse Tokar uu sii joogi doono Kenya, isaga oo halkaas ka qaabilsanaan doona Soomaaliya. Nidaamkan ayaa dalalku inta badan adeegsadaan marka aysan safaarad joogto ah ku lahayn waddan, iyadoo safiir ku sugan dal kale oo gobolka ah loo igmado inuu xiriirkaas diblomaasiyadeed maamulo. Magacaabista Tokar ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Ukraine uu sannadihii dambe sii muuqday. Bishii November 2025, safiirka Soomaaliya ee Ukraine, Mohamed Abdullahi Ahmed, oo isna aan dalkaas si joogto ah u deggeneyn, ayaa waraaqihiisa aqoonsiga gudbiyay, waxaana Zelenskyy xilligaas uga mahadceliyay Soomaaliya mowqifkeeda ku aaddan madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Ukraine. Ukraine ayaa dhankeeda sidoo kale si cad u taageertay madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Labada dal ayaa sidoo kale xiriirkoodu taabtay dhinaca sugnaanta cuntada. Soomaaliya waxay ka mid ahayd dalalka Afrika ee helay gargaar cunto oo ka yimid Ukraine, gaar ahaan barnaamijka “Grain from Ukraine”, oo Kyiv billowday kaddib duullaankii Ruushka ee Ukraine. Barnaamijkaas ayaa Ukraine u noqday mid ka mid ah waddooyinka ay ku xoojineyso xiriirka ay la leedahay dalalka Afrika, iyadoo gargaar badar ah gaarsiisay Soomaaliya iyo dalal kale oo qaaradda ku yaalla. Magacaabista cusub ayaa sidoo kale qayb ka ah dadaal ballaaran oo Ukraine ay ku kordhineyso joogitaankeeda Afrika tan iyo markii dagaalka Ruushka uu billowday 2022. Kyiv ayaa furtay safaarado cusub oo dhowr ah oo Afrika ku yaalla, iyadoo isku dayaysa inay xoojiso xiriirka siyaasadeed iyo ganacsi ee qaaradda, isla markaana ay hesho taageero diblomaasiyadeed xilli Moscow ay muddo dheer xiriir xooggan ku lahayd dalal badan oo Afrikaan ah. items.title: Somalia’s Post-Federal Governance Map
items.description: By Isha Qarsoon Four months ago, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud declared that Somalia had moved from a Provisional Constitution (PC) to a Final Constitution. The declaration followed constitutional amendments adopted by Parliament without three steps explicitly required by the PC: agreement with the Federal Member States (FMSs) on the division of powers and resources, consultation with the states and the public, and ratification by the Somali people. In two essays published shortly thereafter, Isha Qarsoon  argued that the amendments had not completed Somalia’s federal project. Instead, they had replaced the federal bargain embodied in the PC with a different constitutional order that unilaterally reallocates powers among the Federal Government (FGS), the FMSs and local governments newly established as a separate constitutional tier carved out of the FMS constitutional domain under the PC. The amendments also changed presidential and parliamentary terms from four years to five. What has happened in the four months since is more revealing than the new constitutional text. Hassan Sheikh was elected to a four-year term and had previously said the new arrangement would apply to the next government. He nevertheless claimed the fifth year for himself and began implementing the amended Constitution. One of its most consequential provisions created a Supreme Judicial Council with broad authority over the courts, and the government has begun nominating its members for parliamentary approval. Yet both the President and Parliament remain in office only because the new five-year term has been applied to the current incumbents. Parliament is now being asked to approve a Judicial Council that will help constitute and govern the new judiciary. If the amendments were unconstitutionally adopted, the defect therefore extends well beyond the President’s fifth year. It reaches Parliament’s continued tenure and the federal laws it passes, the Judicial Council it approves, and ultimately the judiciary that Council will help create, reproducing the original constitutional defect across the executive, legislature and judiciary. President Hassan Sheikh More immediately, Villa Somalia is using that additional year to reshape who governs the FMSs before the next federal election. The Constitution does not authorize the federal president to choose state leaders, remove incumbents he no longer supports or reorganize regional politics around his preferred candidates. No other law gives him that authority. Yet Hassan Sheikh is intervening directly in state political processes, using federal money, appointments, security forces and the power of the presidency. The FMSs remain formally autonomous, but Mogadishu is increasingly deciding who leads them. Yet even as Villa Somalia consolidates political control over the institutions and state governments it can reach, the FGS remains unable to govern much of the country it claims. Puntland has further consolidated its self-government. Jubaland continues to operate outside effective federal control. Somaliland remains beyond Mogadishu’s reach. Northeast State is aligned with Mogadishu but geographically separated from it and contested by both Puntland and Somaliland. Across much of central and southern Somalia, Al-Shabaab continues to govern territory that is part of Somalia. Together, these developments show how differently Somalia is governed from the country described in the amended Constitution. That Constitution created a new map of its own, adding local governments as a separate constitutional tier and weakening the autonomy of the FMSs. But even that is not the map by which Somalia is actually governed. This essay describes the country as it exists in practice. Start in Somaliland. For more than three decades, little has changed. Hargeisa has governed itself since its declared secession in 1991. Mogadishu has neither negotiated a settlement that brought Somaliland back into the state nor changed the situation by force. Somalia continues to claim Somaliland as part of the Republic, and the international community continues to recognize that claim. Neither fact changes who governs there. Somaliland remains entirely outside Mogadishu’s reach. The Northeast State lies between Somaliland and Puntland. Mogadishu recognizes and supports it, while Hargeisa and Garowe claim all or parts of its territory. The FGS presented its creation as an expansion of the federal order into northern Somalia. It also gave Villa Somalia another regional administration aligned with Mogadishu and another possible source of support in the next federal election. Yet the new state is cut off by land from the federal center. Any overland route from Mogadishu must cross Hirshabelle and Galmudug, where government control is already interrupted, and then Puntland, which has rejected the presence of federal forces in its territory. Somaliland offers no alternative route for the FGS. Federal officials can still fly into Las Anod, assuming air access remains open, but ordinary life depends on roads. Goods, traders, patients, students and families move into Somaliland or through Puntland, and anyone traveling overland toward the rest of the Federal Republic must pass through Puntland. Federal recognition may give a small political class appointments and direct access to Villa Somalia, but it does not change where Northeast State sits or how its people move. That leaves Northeast State politically tied to Mogadishu but physically dependent on its neighbors. It will need working relations with Garowe, Hargeisa or both regardless of its relationship with the FGS. Recognition changed its political status, not its geography. How long that arrangement can last is uncertain. Farther east is Puntland. Unlike Somaliland, it does not claim independence from Somalia. Unlike Northeast State, it does not look to Mogadishu to sustain its political position. Garowe governs Puntland through its own institutions, commands its own forces and decides who may organize armed units inside its territory. Its recent declaration that no federal forces remain in Puntland merely acknowledged that Mogadishu no longer exercises military authority there. Even before the latest clashes, Puntland was turning increasingly toward itself rather than Mogadishu. Its twenty-eighth anniversary was marked by unusually elaborate celebrations of Puntland’s institutions, security forces and political identity. It was not a declaration of independence, but the celebration showed how far Puntland has moved from the federal center. The speeches, ceremonies and displays focused on Puntland’s government, its forces and its future, not on its place in a functioning federal system. South of Puntland lies the part of the country most often described as the FGS’s base. That description is misleading. South West, Galmudug and Hirshabelle have not been tied to Mogadishu through an agreed and functioning federal arrangement. Villa Somalia has instead increasingly shaped their leadership, political succession and the arrangements through which regional power is exercised. South West is the clearest example of how selectively Villa Somalia invokes constitutional authority. Hassan Sheikh treated the new five-year federal term as extending his own presidency, although he had been elected for four years. But when Abdiaziz Laftagareen resisted Mogadishu’s constitutional and electoral program, the FGS declared his mandate expired and rejected the political process organized by South West itself. Federal forces moved into Baidoa, Laftagareen resigned, and Villa Somalia took control of the succession. The process that followed produced a president backed by Hassan Sheikh’s party after major candidates withdrew and complained that the result had been arranged in advance. The issue was not adherence to a new constitutional order. It was who controlled the political outcome. Galmudug is beginning to follow South West’s path. Ahmed Qoorqoor supported Hassan Sheikh’s constitutional program, but Villa Somalia did not support him for another term. Relations deteriorated when Qoorqoor resisted federal interference in Galmudug’s security command. Hassan Sheikh’s party then selected Libaan Shuluq as its candidate. Qoorqoor initially refused to step aside as Mogadishu challenged his control over the state’s security forces. After weeks of pressure and negotiations over his departure, he withdrew from the race and endorsed the FGS’s electoral plans. The prime minister then traveled to Dhusamareb as Villa Somalia pressed ahead with Shuluq’s candidacy. In Abudwaq, opponents of the federally backed candidate warned: “We will not be treated like Baidoa.” In Hirshabelle, Hassan Sheikh’s involvement is even more direct. He played a central role in creating the state during his first presidency and has repeatedly intervened in its leadership. On August 4, he met the Hawadle ugaas and senior politicians to discuss who should become the next Hirshabelle president. The Hawadle leadership reportedly left the choice of its candidate to Hassan Sheikh himself. Since the presidency is expected to pass to a Hawadle candidate, the federal president now has a direct role in choosing who may next govern the state. South West, Galmudug and Hirshabelle are the three FMSs where Villa Somalia has gone furthest in determining who governs. In South West, it forced a change of leadership. In Galmudug, it has pushed aside an incumbent it no longer supports. In Hirshabelle, Hassan Sheikh is now directly involved in choosing the next president. The states remain formally autonomous, but decisions over who leads them are increasingly being made in Mogadishu. But controlling a state presidency does not mean governing the state. A president backed by Villa Somalia may sit in Baidoa, Dhusamareb or Jowhar while large areas beyond the capital remain outside his government’s reach. Government authority is concentrated in the main towns and along some roads. In parts of Galmudug, Hiraan and Middle Shabelle, government forces cannot move freely, secure the roads or prevent Al-Shabaab from exercising authority over local communities. Al-Shabaab fills that gap with government of its own. It collects taxes, controls movement, settles disputes and enforces its decisions. Its reach extends even into some government-held towns, where businesses and residents pay it because the government cannot protect them from retaliation. Its rule is coercive and illegitimate, but in many communities it is the authority people encounter in their daily lives. A map showing all of Galmudug, Hirshabelle and South West as governed from Mogadishu therefore bears little resemblance to the country on the ground. Farther south is Jubaland. It remains part of Somalia in law, but Kismayo does not take political or military direction from Villa Somalia. When Mogadishu rejected Ahmed Madobe’s reelection and sent federal forces into Jubaland, the regional government resisted. Federal troops were defeated at Ras Kamboni in December 2024, and hundreds crossed into Kenya. Madobe remained in office and Mogadishu failed to remove him. The declaration followed constitutional amendments adopted by Parliament without three steps explicitly required by the PC: agreement with the Federal Member States (FMSs) on the division of powers and resources, consultation with the states and the public, and ratification by the Somali people. Hassan Sheikh was elected to a four-year term and had previously said the new arrangement would apply to the next government. He nevertheless claimed the fifth year for himself and began implementing the amended Constitution. One of its most consequential provisions created a Supreme Judicial Council with broad authority over the courts, and the government has begun nominating its members for parliamentary approval. Parliament is now being asked to approve a Judicial Council that will help constitute and govern the new judiciary. If the amendments were unconstitutionally adopted, the defect therefore extends well beyond the President’s fifth year. It reaches Parliament’s continued tenure and the federal laws it passes, the Judicial Council it approves, and ultimately the judiciary that Council will help create, reproducing the original constitutional defect across the executive, legislature and judiciary. President Hassan Sheikh More immediately, Villa Somalia is using that additional year to reshape who governs the FMSs before the next federal election. The Constitution does not authorize the federal president to choose state leaders, remove incumbents he no longer supports or reorganize regional politics around his preferred candidates. Northeast State is aligned with Mogadishu but geographically separated from it and contested by both Puntland and Somaliland. Across much of central and southern Somalia, Al-Shabaab continues to govern territory that is part of Somalia. Hargeisa has governed itself since its declared secession in 1991. Mogadishu has neither negotiated a settlement that brought Somaliland back into the state nor changed the situation by force. Somalia continues to claim Somaliland as part of the Republic, and the international community continues to recognize that claim. Neither fact changes who governs there. Somaliland remains entirely outside Mogadishu’s reach. The Northeast State lies between Somaliland and Puntland. Mogadishu recognizes and supports it, while Hargeisa and Garowe claim all or parts of its territory. The FGS presented its creation as an expansion of the federal order into northern Somalia. It also gave Villa Somalia another regional administration aligned with Mogadishu and another possible source of support in the next federal election. Yet the new state is cut off by land from the federal center. Any overland route from Mogadishu must cross Hirshabelle and Galmudug, where government control is already interrupted, and then Puntland, which has rejected the presence of federal forces in its territory. Somaliland offers no alternative route for the FGS. Federal officials can still fly into Las Anod, assuming air access remains open, but ordinary life depends on roads. items.title: Puntland Launches Major Galkayo Flash Flood Management Project
items.description: Galkayo (WDN) — A new chapter in Galkayo’s development began as Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni officially launched an ambitious flash flood management project, marking a landmark push toward a cleaner and safer city, addressing one of the city’s longest-standing challenges and transforming its urban environment. The project, described as a major investment in Galkayo’s future, is designed to tackle persistent flooding and water-management problems that have affected residents, businesses, roads, public spaces and the overall appearance of the city, particularly during the rainy season. The initiative has brought together the Puntland Government, the Somali diaspora, local residents, businesses and the wider private sector in what officials described as a collective effort to build a lasting solution for the city. A $3 Million Investment in Galkayo’s Future The first phase of the project is estimated to cost approximately $3 million. The Puntland Government has committed $1 million, while the remaining funding is expected to come from Galkayo residents, local businesses, national companies and Puntland’s large and increasingly influential diaspora community. The financing model itself represents an important feature of the initiative. Rather than relying exclusively on government resources, the project is being presented as a shared investment in the future of Galkayo—one in which the people who live, work and invest in the city have a direct stake in its transformation. At the launch ceremony, the Galkayo Development Committee presented the project’s overall plan, outlined preparations already completed and explained the steps that will guide implementation. The committee said the project tender will soon be publicly advertised, with companies invited to compete through a transparent procurement process designed to ensure fairness and accountability. For years, water management has been one of Galkayo’s most persistent urban challenges. Heavy rainfall can rapidly overwhelm drainage routes, affecting roads and residential areas while disrupting traffic and damaging property. The problem has become more complicated as the city has expanded and climate variability has increased the frequency and intensity of extreme weather events. The new project is intended to change that equation. At today’s ceremony, organizers highlighted the impact of poor water management on public health, urban cleanliness, traffic movement, environmental conditions and the city’s overall appearance. The objective is therefore broader than simply controlling rainwater. It is about creating a more resilient, cleaner and better-planned urban environment capable of supporting Galkayo’s continued growth. Businesses and the Community Step Forward The launch also demonstrated the enthusiasm of the private sector and the wider community. Several Somali-owned companies made direct financial contributions to the project during the ceremony, depositing funds into the committee’s designated account. Former ministers, parliamentarians and other prominent Puntland figures who have previously supported the initiative were also recognized for their contributions. The participation of businesses and individuals reflects a growing understanding that the development of Galkayo cannot be left to government institutions alone. For a city whose commercial and residential population continues to expand, sustainable infrastructure increasingly depends on cooperation between government, communities, businesses and the diaspora. President Deni used the occasion to appeal directly to residents to cooperate with the project by protecting natural waterways and drainage corridors. He particularly urged residents to remove structures that have been built across natural watercourses and obstruct the movement of rainwater. The President also instructed security authorities to work closely with the project committee in addressing encroachments and ensuring that designated drainage routes remain open. The message was clear: infrastructure investment can only succeed if the community protects and respects the infrastructure once it is built. A New Vision for Galkayo The Galkayo water-management project comes at a time when the city is undergoing significant economic and urban transformation. With growing commercial activity and an expanding population, the demand for modern urban infrastructure has never been greater. If successfully implemented, the project could deliver benefits far beyond flood prevention. It could improve road access, reduce environmental hazards, protect businesses and homes, enhance public health, improve the appearance of the city and make Galkayo more attractive for future investment. For residents who have endured years of flooding and the disruption it causes, today’s launch represents more than the beginning of an infrastructure project. It represents the possibility of a different future. A cleaner city. a safer city and a more resilient city. And perhaps most importantly, a Galkayo whose government, businesses, diaspora and citizens are working together to solve a problem that has challenged the city for generations. The road ahead will require money, discipline, transparency and sustained public cooperation. But with the first phase now formally launched and financial commitments already beginning to materialize, Galkayo has taken an important step toward turning one of its greatest urban challenges into an opportunity for lasting development. For a city that has waited so long for a solution, today’s announcement is a reason for optimism. items.title: Xamza oo digniin culus u diray wakiilada beesha caalamka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre oo maanta khudbad xasaasi ah ka jeediyay Shirweynaha Qaran ee Maalgashiga Beeraha iyo Nidaamka Cuntada Soomaaliyeed (NAFIS 2026) ayaa farriin culus u diray wakiilada beesha caalamka ee fadhigoodu yahay magaalada Muqdisho. Xamza ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in Soomaaliya ay ka gudubtay caqabado kala duwan oo ay soo martay iyo xaaladii kumeel gaarnimada. Sidoo kale wuxuu ugu baaqay xubnaha beesha caalamka inay wax ka bedelaan sida ay hadda ula dhaqmaan Dowladda Soomaaliya, maadaama ay xaqiijisay guullo waa wayn oo la taaban karo, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo dhismaha hay’adaha dowladda. “Beesha caalamka iyo deeq-bixiyeyaasha dhibaatada ugu weyn iyaga ayay haysataa oo u baahan in ay isbeddelaan. Soomaaliyadii ay yiqiineen ee KMG-ka ahayd ayay weli ku socdaan,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre. Hadalka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha yaa imaanaya xilli haatan wakiilada beesha caalamka ay Dowladda Federaalka iyo Mucaaradka ku cadaadinayaan in ay gaaraan heshiis loo dhan yahay si uu dalka u aado doorasho loo dhan yahay. Waxaa kale oo socda wada-hadallo hoose oo lagu doonayo in lagu soo afjaro khilaafka daba dheeraaday ee labada dhinac, si xal loogu helo muranka hareeyay hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo wax ka beddelka dastuurka dalka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Soomaaliya ayaa haatan ku jirta marxalad adag oo ka dhalatay isgoyska siyaasadeed ee ay taagan tahay, taas oo mugdi sii gelinaysa mustaqbalka dalka, maadaama aan weli si cad loo ogeyn jihada uu dalku u socdo. items.title: Fannaankii Hore Ee Hobollada Iftin Sheekh Cabdullaahi Zulfa Oo Dib Ugu Soo Laabtay Muqdisho 30 Sano Ka Dib
items.description: Wasiirrada Gaashaandhigga iyo Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ku soo dhaweeyay fannaankii caanka ahaa Sheekh Cabdullaahi Zulfa, oo muddo ka badan 30 sano dalka dibaddiisa ku maqnaa. Sheekh Cabdullaahi Zulfa ayaa ka mid ahaa fannaaniintii Kooxda Hobollada Iftin ee Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, isagoo qeyb ka ahaa hal-abuurkii iyo fanka Soomaaliyeed ee xilliyadii hore. Soo laabashadiisa Muqdisho ayaa loo arkay dhacdo farxad iyo xusuus gaar ah xambaarsan, iyadoo ay soo dhaweyntiisa ka qeyb qaateen Wasiirrada Gaashaandhigga iyo Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska. Muddo dheer oo uu dalka ka maqnaa kaddib, dib ugu soo laabashada Zulfa ayaa dib u soo nooleynaysa xusuusta fankii Soomaaliyeed iyo doorkii ay fannaaniintii hore ku lahaayeen kobcinta dhaqanka, suugaanta iyo wacyigelinta bulshada. Sheekh Cabdullaahi Zulfa ayaa ka mid ahaa fannaaniintii taariikhda ku lahaa Kooxda Hobollada Iftin ee Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, oo kaalin muuqata ku lahayd fanka iyo suugaanta Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: C/rashiid Janan oo ka goostay DF kuna biiray Jubaland
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Cabdirashiid Xasan Nuur (Janan) oo ahaa taliyihii NISA ee Gobolka Gedo ayaa maanta ka goostay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaliya isagoo dib ugu biiray Maamulka Jubbaland oo uu horay uga tirsanaa. Janan oo wada-hadallo hoose la galay Madaxweyne Axmed Madoobe ayaa ugu dambeyn heshiis la galay, isaga oo ku dhawaaqay in lasoo afjaray colaaddii muddada dheer ka taagneyd gobolka Geddo ee koofurta Soomaaliya. Muuqaal kooban oo laga helay Cabdirashiid Janan ayaa waxa uu uga hadlay arrimaha soo kordhay, gaar ahaan wada-hadalka uu la galay Jubbaland. “Annaga waxaan bilownay wadahadal aan go’aansanay in dhiiga Soomaaliyeed oo Gedo ka socday ku joojino, ciidamadii aan ka adkaanay oo xuduuda aan gelinay inaan kula heshiino oo aan Shabaab cid aan ahayn col lala noqon,” ayuu yiri Cabdirashiid Xasan Nuur (Janan). Sidoo kale, waxaa haatan socda qorshe guud oo lagu mideynayo ciidamada Daraawiishta Jubbaland ee horay uga tallaabay xadka Kenya iyo kuwa Janan ee ku sugan degmada Beledxaawo iyo deegaannada kale ee gobolka Gedo. Wararka ayaa intaas kusii daraya in dhowaan kulan foolka fool ah ay yeelan doonaan Axmed Madoobe iyo Cabdirashii Janan, kaas oo lagu dhammaystirayo heshiiska labada dhinac, sida ay innoo xaqiijyeen saraakiil ka tirsan Jubbaland. Saraakiishu ma shaacina waqtiga rasmiga oo uu u dhacayo kulankaas iyo goobta uu sida gaarka ah uga qabsoomi doono. Dhanka kale, ma jiro war kasoo baxay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo ku aadan arrinta Cabdirashiid Janan oo haatan u goostay dhanka Jubbaland. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Janan oo ah nin siyaasad ahaan isbedbeddala, ayaa horay sidaan oo kale dhabarka uga jabiyay dowladdii Madaxweyne Farmaajo, xilligaasna dib ula heshiiyay Axmed Madoobe, isaga oo mar kale maanta ku sameeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. items.title: Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo la kulmay Gudoomiyaha Aqalka Sare (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Gudoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa Talaadadan Magaalada Muqdisho kula kulmay Gudoomiyaha Golaha Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka, Cabdi Xaashi Cabdullaahi. Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Somaliya ayaa Isniintii Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur u doortay in uu noqdo Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, isaga oo bedelaya Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe). War caawa lagu daabacay bogga wararka ee Xafiiska Guddoonka Golaha Shacabka ayaa lagu sheegay in Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka uu hoygiisa ku booqday Gudoomiye Cabdi Xaashi Cabdullaahi. “Gudoomiyaha Golaha Aqalka sare ayaa ugu horrayn Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ugu hambalyeeyey guushiisii loogu doortay xilka Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, wuxuuna u rajeeyey inuu Alle u fududeeyo masuuliyadda culus ee loo doortay.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Kulanka Labada Gudoomiye ayaa looga hadlay arrimo la xiriira howlaha horyaalla Labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Somaliya, xoojinta wada-shaqaynta Labada Aqal iyo sidoo kale sidii Kalfadhigga 8aad loo dhameystiri lahaa shuruucda muhiimka u ah horumarka dowladnimo ee dalka, waxaana kulanka ka qaybgalay Xildhibaan Ismaaciil Ciid Maxamed, Xildhibaan Saadaq Cumar Xasan, Xildhibaan Gobsan Maxamed iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Shacabka.” Jaamac ayaa shalay iska casilay xilka Wasiirka Dekedaha & Gaadiidka Badda Somaliya, ka dib markii loo doortay jegada Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Is casilaaddan ayuu isla shalay kaga dhawaaqay Xarunta Golaha Shacabka ee Villa Hargeisa, halkaas oo Xildhibaanadu ay ku doorteen.

items.title: NISA oo weerar ku beegsatay saddex ka mid ah xubnaha sare ee Shabaab + Magacyada
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka ee NISA ayaa shaacisay in howlgal qorsheysan oo ay ka fulisay deegaanka Tawakal ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose lagu dilay toddobo xubnood oo ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab, halka lagu dhaawacay saraakiil sare oo kooxda ka tirsan. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay NISA ayaa lagu sheegay in howlgalka, oo lala kaashaday saaxiibada caalamka, lagu beegsaday xarun ay Al-Shabaab ku lahayd deegaanka Tawakal, kadib markii hay’addu heshay xog sirdoon oo xaqiijisay inay halkaas ku sugnaayeen xubno muhiim ah oo kooxda ka tirsan. NISA waxay sheegtay in goobta la beegsaday ay ahayd meel gaar ah oo ay hoggaamiyeyaasha Al-Shabaab ku kulmi jireen, isla markaana howlgalka la fuliyay xilli ay halkaas ku sugnaayeen dhowr mas’uul oo kooxda ka tirsan. Saraakiisha ay NISA sheegtay inay goobta ku sugnaayeen waxaa kamid ahaa Yoonis Macallim Abuukar, oo kooxda u qaabilsanaa deegaanka Mushaani, iyo Abuu Xaaji Fareey, oo lagu sheegay inuu ahaa hoggaamiyaha maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab ee deegaanka Tawakal. Sidoo kale, hay’addu waxay magacawday Ayaatullaahi, oo ay sheegtay inuu ahaa hoggaamiyaha jabhadda Al-Shabaab ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, iyo Cabdifitaax Rooble, oo lagu tilmaamay hoggaamiyihii kooxda ee deegaanka Baladul-Amiin. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka, xogta hordhaca ah ayaa muujineysa in Yoonis Macallim Abuukar iyo Cabdifitaax Rooble ay dhaawacyo culus kasoo gaareen howlgalka. NISA ma shaacin nooca weerarka loo adeegsaday howlgalka, balse waxay sheegtay inuu qeyb ka yahay dadaallada joogtada ah ee lagu wiiqayo awoodda Al-Shabaab, laguna burburinayo hoggaankeeda iyo goobaha ay u adeegsato qorsheynta weerarrada. Howlgalkan ayaa yimid maalmo kooban kadib markii NISA ay 7-dii Agoosto sheegtay inay gacanta ku dhigtay sagaal xubnood oo Al-Shabaab ah, kuwaas oo lagu eedeeyay inay ku howlanaaayeen qorsheynta falal amni-darro oo ka dhaca Muqdisho iyo deegaanada ku dhow. Hay’addu waxay xilligaas sheegtay in xubnahaasi si dhuumaaleysi ah ugu sugnaayeen degmooyinka Garasbaaley iyo Kaxda, iyo xaafado ka tirsan Ceelasha Biyaha. Afar kamid ah sagaalka qof ayaa NISA sheegtay inay ahaayeen shabakad isku xiran oo qorsheyneysay weerarro lagu dhibaateynayo shacabka, laguna qalqal-gelinayo ammaanka iyo xasilloonida caasimadda. NISA waxay sidoo kale sheegtay inay muddo la socotay dhaq-dhaqaaqyada iyo qorshayaasha xubnahaas, ka hor inta aan mid kasta lagu qaban goobtii uu ku sugnaa. Labada howlgal oo dhacay muddo dhowr maalmood gudahood ah ayaa kusoo aadaya iyadoo hay’adaha ammaanka dowladda ay kordhiyeen howlgallada lagu beegsanayo xubnaha iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha Al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan Muqdisho iyo gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. NISA ayaa ugu dambeyn shacabka ugu baaqday inay hay’adaha ammaanka la wadaagaan xog kasta oo la xiriirta dhaq-dhaqaaqyada Al-Shabaab iyo kooxda Daacish. items.title: Somalia: Former Gedo Intelligence Chief Rejoins Jubaland Administration
items.description: Gedo, Somalia — The former Jubaland security minister and former National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA) chief for Gedo region has announced that he has rejoined the Jubaland administration following talks with the government of Jubaland President Ahmed Mohamed Islam, known as Ahmed Madobe.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Daahfurtay Qorshaha Dhismaha Golaha Qaran ee Dadweynaha iyo Horumarinta
items.description: Muqdisho, 11 Agoosto 2026 – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta daahfurtay qorshaha lagu dhisayo Golaha Qaran ee Dadweynaha iyo Horumarinta (National Council for Population and Development). Golahan ayaa Dowladda ka taageeri doona in qorshayaasha horumarinta dalka lagu saleeyo baahiyaha dhabta ah ee bulshada, gaar ahaan dhinacyada caafimaadka, waxbarashada, shaqo-abuurka, hoyga iyo adeegyada kale ee bulshada. Golaha ayaa mideyn doona dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada iyo bah-wadaagta kale, si arrimaha la xiriira dadweynaha loogu daro qorshayaasha horumarinta dalka, loogana shaqeeyo adeegyo iyo fursado si wanaagsan u gaara bulshada. Munaasabadda waxaa ka qayb galay madax ka kala socotay hay’adaha Dowladda, Qaramada Midoobay, deeq-bixiyeyaasha, bulshada rayidka ah, bahda waxbarashada iyo ganacsiga gaarka loo leeyahay. Ka qaybgalayaashu waxay soo dhaweeyeen hindisaha, iyagoo muujiyay taageeradooda ku aaddan dhismaha Gole wax-ku-ool ah. Dhismaha Golaha Qaran ee Dadweynaha iyo Horumarinta ayaa ka dhashay ballanqaadyadii Soomaaliya ay ku gaartay shirkii ICPD25 ee Nairobi, wuxuuna sidoo kale taageerayaa hirgelinta Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka (NTP 2025–2029).

items.title: Ciidankii PSF ee Gaalkacyo laga qabsaday oo xerooyin cusub looga sameeyay…
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamo ka tirsan PSF oo dhawaan laga qabsaday xeradii ay ku lahaayeen bariga magaalada Gaalkacyo kadib markii ay la wareegeen ciidamada maamulka Puntland ayaa gaaray deegaanka Xananbuure ee gobolka Galgaduud ee dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadaasi dib u dejin loogu sameeyay xero ciidan oo ku taalla deegaanka Xananbuure, waxaana la filayaa inay halkaasi ku sugnaadaan illaa amar ama isbeddel cusub uu kaga yimaado Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Ciidamadan ayaa kamid ahaa xoogagga PSF ee muddooyinkii dambe u wareegay dhinaca Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, kaddib markii ay soo wajahday xiisad iyo cadaadis kaga yimid maamulka Puntland, gaar ahaan arrimaha la xiriira qaab-dhismeedka iyo maamulka ciidamada. PSF ayaa ah ciidamo si gaar ah loo tababaray, kuwaas oo horay taageero uga heli jiray Mareykanka, waxaana muddooyinkii dambe Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay bixineysay mushaarkooda iyo qaar kamid ah qalabkooda ciidan. U guuritaanka ciidamadaasi ee dhinaca maamulka Galmudug ayaa kusoo beegmaya kaddib markii Puntland ay la wareegtay xeradii ay ku lahaayeen bariga Gaalkacyo, taas oo qayb ka ahayd tallaabooyin maamulka Puntland uu ku doonayay inuu dib ugu soo celiyo gacantiisa ciidamada ka howlgala deegaannadiisa. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya weli si rasmi ah ugama hadlin qorshaha muddada fog ee ay ka leedahay ciidamada PSF ee hadda ku sugan Xananbuure, iyadoo aan sidoo kale si cad loo shaacin halka ay ku dambeyn doonaan iyo howlaha loo diyaarinayo. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay socdaan dadaallo lagu mideynayo ciidamada ka diiwaangashan Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa maamullada, iyadoo xaaladda ciidamada PSF iyo halka ay ku sugan yihiin ay noqon karto arrin saameyn ku yeelata xiriirka amni ee Dowladda Federaalka, Puntland iyo Galmudug. The post Ciidankii PSF ee Gaalkacyo laga qabsaday oo xerooyin cusub looga sameeyay… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Musk oo qorshe “waalli” ah uga hadlay warshadaha dayaxa
items.description: Elon Musk, oo ah madaxa shirkadda SpaceX, ayaa shaaca ka qaaday qorshe hammi leh oo lagu doonayo in dayaxa laga dhigo saldhig wax-soo-saar oo warshadeed, isagoo intii uu ka hadlayay wicitaankii ugu horreeyay ee dakhliga shirkadda tan iyo markii ay si guud looga iibsaday saamiyadeeda ku sheegay in dayaxa laga dhisi doono warshado ay robot-yadu qabtaan shaqadooda. Musk ayaa qirtay in fikradda ay u ekaan karto mid “waalli” ah, balse waxa uu ku andacooday inay tahay wax dhici kara . Qorshahan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada sida wax looga soo saaro dayaxa, isagoo dayaxa uga dhigaya saldhig wax-soo-saar oo awood u leh inuu soo saaro tignoolajiyad heersare ah. SpaceX waxay qorsheyneysaa inay adeegsato dayaxa si ay u weyneyso awooddeeda wax-soo-saarka, iyadoo qalab iyo agab badan ku soo rari doonta dayaxa iyadoo la adeegsanaya gantaalada Starship . Mid ka mid ah yoolalka ugu muhiimsan ayaa ah dhismaha warshado soo saari kara tiro badan oo dayax-gacmeedyo (satellites) oo loogu talagalay xisaabinta Artificial Intelligence (AI). Sida qorshayaasha SpaceX sheegayaan, dayax-gacmeedyadan waxaa laga yaabaa in qaybahooda laga soo saaro khayraadka laga helo dayaxa laftiisa, sida aluminium, titanium, iyo silikon, halka qaybaha khasabka ah sida chips-ka laga keeni doono Dhulka . Marka warshadaha dayaxu shaqeeyaan, SpaceX waxay doonaysaa inay isticmaasho nidaam loo yaqaan “lunar mass driver” kaas oo ah qalab elektromagnetic ah oo loogu talagalay in lagu soo raro wax soo saarka dayaxa oo la geliyo hawada sare iyada oo aan loo baahnayn gantaallo . Qorshahan ayaa qayb ka ah hammiga weyn ee Musk, kaas oo uu doonayo in SpaceX ay marka hore ka shaqeyso dayaxa, kadibna u gudubto Mars si ay u sameyso degsiimo bini’aadam ah . Khubarada qaarkood ayaa ku tilmaamay qorshahan mid “waalli” ah, laakiin waxay sidoo kale qireen in Musk uu leeyahay taariikh ku dheehan tahay hammiyo aad u weyn . Waxaana jira khubaro kale oo sheegay in fikraddu ay tahay mid suurtagal ah, maadaama khayraadka laga helo dayaxa ay yihiin kuwo la isticmaali karo, isla markaana dayaxa uu dhow yahay Dhulka marka loo eego Mars . The post Musk oo qorshe “waalli” ah uga hadlay warshadaha dayaxa first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Madoobe Oo Muqdisho Kula Kulmay Safiirka Turkiga
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho kulan kula yeeshay Safiirka Dowladda Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Danjire Alper Aktaş. Kulankan ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha bani’aadannimada ee Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, kuwaas oo ah qaybo muhiim ah oo horumarinta gobolka lagu wado . Kulankan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo cusub oo lagu xoojinayo xiriirka u dhexeeya Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed iyo Turkiga, kuwaas oo muddo dheer lahaa iskaashi dhow oo dhinacyada horumarinta ah. items.title: Somalia PM rebukes international partners over political pressure
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre on Tuesday launched a blistering attack on the country’s international partners, accusing them of facing a “cultural problem” and of continuing to treat Somalia as though it were still in the transitional period, when the country had no laws, constitution or meaningful government. Barre said international partners must change the way they deal with Somalia, arguing that they continue to act as though they can dictate to his government what it should do and what it should not do. He said international partners may have been accustomed to exercising such influence during Somalia’s transitional government period, but argued that they should no longer approach the country in the same manner. The prime minister’s remarks appeared to target Western partners who, in recent months, have expressed concern over Somalia’s ongoing political crisis and pressured Mogadishu to reach a political settlement with the opposition in an effort to resolve the electoral dispute and prevent the country from descending into an abyss. Barre also pushed back against what he portrayed as a dismissive attitude toward Somalia, saying the country exceeds many East African countries on multiple fronts and should not be held in contempt. He called on Somalia’s international partners to change their approach. The remarks came just one week after President Hassan Mohamud told a summit of countries contributing troops to the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia, known as AUSSOM, that a clause in the summit communiqué calling on the Somali government to engage with the opposition and other stakeholders to end the country’s political crisis should be removed. Mohamud argued that Somalia’s political issues are matters of national sovereignty and should not be included in the communiqué. Barre’s remarks represent the strongest attack so far on Somalia’s Western partners, with whom the Somali government has been dependent for decades for support in state-building and the fight against insurgents. The unusually forceful criticism comes amid a growing wedge between Mogadishu and some of its international partners over Somalia’s political crisis, with Western partners pressing for engagement between the government, opposition and other stakeholders while Somalia’s leadership maintains that the country’s political affairs are sovereign matters. The prime minister’s comments underscore the increasingly tense relationship between Somalia and international partners that have played a central role in supporting the country’s state-building efforts and its fight against insurgents, while Mogadishu insists that its government should no longer be treated as it was during the transitional period.
