items.title: New Map Reveals the Extraordinary Scale of AUSSOM’s Security Footprint in Somalia
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — The African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) is preparing to withdraw from Somalia by December 31, 2026, yet the country remains unprepared to fill the security and stabilization vacuum its departure could create. Somalia’s security forces still face significant capacity and coordination challenges, while political divisions continue to undermine national cohesion. A new map published by the Belqees Center for Studies has laid bare the extraordinary scale of the African Union’s security presence in Somalia, revealing that AUSSOM forces are spread across 56 military bases in five major operational sectors. According to data presented by the research center, Uganda maintains the largest number of military bases, with 22, followed by Ethiopia with 15, Kenya with eight, Djibouti with six, and Burundi with five. Taken together, the deployment represents an estimated 11,826 African Union personnel stationed across Somalia, underscoring just how heavily the country’s security architecture continues to depend on foreign forces more than three decades after the collapse of the Somali state. The figures provide a striking visual reminder of the scale of the challenge facing Somalia: despite years of international military assistance and repeated offensives against Al-Shabaab, thousands of African troops remain deployed across the country to support Somali forces and protect key strategic locations. A Security Mission Built on International Support AUSSOM’s operations depend heavily on international logistical and financial support, particularly through the United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS). That support encompasses a wide range of essential services, including transportation, supplies, logistics, communications, medical evacuation and other operational requirements without which maintaining such a geographically dispersed force would be extraordinarily difficult. But that support system is now facing a potentially disruptive turning point. The United States has decided that it will not continue supporting UNSOS beyond 31 December 2026, raising serious questions about how AUSSOM will sustain its current operations and whether the mission can maintain its existing footprint. The implications could be profound. ‘No Time to Drift’ In its report, titled “No Time to Drift,” the Belqees Center warns that the end of 2026 could place Somalia at a particularly sensitive security crossroads unless a credible transition strategy is put in place. The center is calling for a structured and carefully sequenced plan to transfer security responsibilities progressively to the Somali National Army and other national security institutions. The objective is clear: prevent a security vacuum from emerging as African forces reduce their presence and international financial and logistical support declines. The warning comes at a critical moment for Somalia. Although Somali security forces have expanded their capabilities in recent years, they have not yet demonstrated the capacity to assume every responsibility currently carried by AUSSOM across the country’s vast and difficult operating environment. Three Questions Will Define AUSSOM’s Future According to the Belqees Center, the future of the mission will largely depend on three interconnected factors. First, funding. AUSSOM will require predictable and sustainable international financing if it is to maintain its operations during the transition. Second, logistics. The continued availability of transportation, communications, medical evacuation, supplies and other operational support will be essential to keeping the mission functioning. Third, Somali capacity. The Somali security forces must be prepared to assume responsibilities gradually and sustainably rather than being forced into an abrupt takeover for which they may not yet be adequately prepared. These challenges expose a fundamental contradiction at the heart of Somalia’s security transition. The country is expected to take increasing responsibility for its own security, yet the international forces supporting that transition remain essential to maintaining stability in many parts of the country. A Dangerous Transition The Belqees Center warns that a sudden decline in international funding or logistical assistance could place enormous pressure on both AUSSOM and the Somali government’s ability to confront continuing security threats. For Somalia, the stakes could hardly be higher. A premature reduction in international support could create vulnerabilities that Al-Shabaab would be quick to exploit. Conversely, an indefinite dependence on foreign forces is neither financially sustainable nor compatible with Somalia’s long-term objective of building a genuinely sovereign national security architecture. The challenge, therefore, is not simply how to end AUSSOM. It is how to replace it without creating a vacuum. With 56 bases, nearly 12,000 African troops and an operational structure heavily dependent on international support, the scale of Somalia’s security dependence has rarely been more visible. As the December 2026 deadline approaches, Mogadishu and its international partners face an increasingly urgent question: Can Somalia build the capacity to secure itself before the international system that has been carrying much of that burden begins to disappear? items.title: Puntland Declares First Phase of Mudug Security Operation Complete as Galkayo Forces Join State Security
items.description: Galkayo (WDN) — Puntland has declared the successful completion of the first phase of its security operation in Mudug, announcing that armed forces stationed at the Istanbul military camp in Galkayo’s Garsoor district have agreed to join the Puntland Defence Forces. The development marks a significant shift in the security landscape of Mudug, where tensions had recently intensified over the presence and movement of forces aligned with Somalia’s Federal Government. In a statement, the Puntland Police said the first phase of the operation had focused on strengthening security, restoring public order and consolidating the state’s security command under legitimate government institutions. “The Puntland Defence Forces have officially concluded the first phase of the security operation in Mudug, focusing on strengthening security, restoring law and order, and consolidating security authority under government institutions,” the statement said. From Rival Forces to a Unified Command Puntland authorities said the armed personnel who had been stationed in Galkayo have agreed to become part of the Puntland Defence Forces. The forces are now expected to undergo formal integration, including military training and restructuring designed to bring them into compliance with Puntland’s established command structure, discipline, procedures and operational standards. The move could significantly reduce the risk of confrontation between competing security formations and establish a clearer chain of command in an area where overlapping political and military loyalties have created tensions. Rather than allowing rival armed groups to remain outside the formal security structure, Puntland’s approach appears aimed at bringing them under a single institutional command. The announcement came as Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni held talks with Ugaas Abdirahman Ugaas Mohamed, the traditional leader of the Leelkase community. The meeting carried particular significance given the role that clan and traditional leadership continue to play in maintaining stability in Mudug. Meanwhile, several military officers from the Leelkase community held a press conference in Galkayo and announced their decision to join Puntland’s security forces. The developments suggest that the security operation is increasingly being accompanied by political and traditional engagement designed to prevent the dispute from becoming a wider confrontation between communities. A Test of State Authority Puntland’s announcement comes against the backdrop of broader disagreements between the regional administration and Somalia’s Federal Government over the deployment and command of security forces in Puntland. The integration of the Galkayo-based forces could therefore represent more than a routine military restructuring. It is also a test of Puntland’s ability to establish a unified security command and assert the authority of its civilian institutions over armed formations operating within its territory. For residents of Galkayo, the most important outcome may be the prospect of greater stability. A unified command structure can reduce the risk of misunderstandings between rival forces, improve coordination and create clearer responsibility for maintaining public security. The completion of the first phase now leaves Puntland facing the more difficult task of ensuring that integration is implemented effectively and that the newly incorporated personnel receive the training, discipline and institutional support necessary to operate as a professional security force. If that process succeeds, the Mudug operation could become an important example of how political dialogue, traditional leadership and institutional security reform can work together to reduce armed confrontation. For Puntland, the message is increasingly clear: security authority must ultimately rest with accountable state institutions, not competing armed formations. items.title: Laftagareen’s Forces Tighten the Noose Around Baidoa
items.description: Baidoa (WDN) — The battle for Baidoa may be entering a decisive new phase, with forces loyal to former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen reportedly reinforcing their positions around the regional capital and preparing for another attempt to penetrate the city. Images circulating on social media by supporters of Laftagareen show what they describe as newly arrived fighters gathering on the outskirts of Baidoa. If the reports are accurate, the arrival represents a significant reinforcement of an armed movement that has repeatedly sought to challenge the authorities currently controlling the city. According to sources familiar with the developments, the new fighters have arrived in the Bay region to join Laftagareen-aligned forces already operating in rural areas surrounding Baidoa. Their stated objective is to strengthen the existing force and create the conditions for a renewed offensive aimed at reclaiming the city. The reported contingent is said to be led by a commander identified as Ali Mohamed Salad. Local sources claim that the fighters were welcomed by senior figures associated with Laftagareen’s political and military network, including former spokesman Ugaas Hassan Abdi Mohamed. The fighters reportedly originated from Berdale district before moving toward areas where Laftagareen’s forces have established positions. Their arrival is significant because it suggests that the confrontation over Baidoa is no longer a fading political dispute but an increasingly organized struggle over territorial control. A Battle That Has Refused to Disappear Laftagareen-aligned forces have previously attempted to approach or enter Baidoa, but those efforts have failed to dislodge government-aligned forces from the city. The latest reinforcement, however, raises the possibility that the balance of forces around the regional capital could gradually change. For months, the political crisis surrounding South West State has increasingly spilled into the security arena. What began as a dispute over political legitimacy, leadership and federal authority has developed into an armed confrontation in which competing sides are attempting to establish facts on the ground. The strategy of Laftagareen’s supporters appears increasingly focused on surrounding the political center of South West State rather than attempting an immediate frontal assault. By maintaining fighters in the countryside, recruiting additional personnel and gradually strengthening positions around Baidoa, the former president’s supporters could be seeking to isolate the city and stretch the forces defending it. If that strategy continues, the question may no longer be whether Laftagareen’s forces can reach Baidoa—they have already demonstrated their ability to operate in its vicinity—but whether the authorities inside the city can sustain control indefinitely. The Road to Baidoa The reported arrival of fighters from Berdale adds another layer of complexity to an already volatile security environment. Berdale is strategically important because of its location within Bay region and its connection to areas surrounding Baidoa. The movement of armed personnel from the district toward Laftagareen’s positions could provide the latter with additional manpower and local networks as his forces attempt to increase pressure on the regional capital. For Laftagareen’s supporters, the objective is straightforward: build sufficient military strength to make another attempt at entering Baidoa possible. For the authorities controlling the city, the development represents a serious warning that the conflict may be entering a more dangerous phase. The central question now confronting South West State is whether the repeated pressure from Laftagareen-aligned forces will eventually translate into a successful takeover. There is no independent confirmation that the newly reported fighters are preparing for an immediate assault, nor is there reliable information about their exact numbers, equipment or current positions. Claims circulating online should therefore be treated cautiously. But the broader trend is difficult to ignore. New fighters are reportedly arriving. Existing forces remain positioned outside the city. Previous attempts to penetrate Baidoa have demonstrated that the opposition retains the capacity to mount military operations. And the political dispute that produced the confrontation remains unresolved. Taken together, these developments create the possibility of a prolonged campaign in which control of Baidoa could ultimately be determined not in political negotiations, but on the battlefield. If Laftagareen’s forces succeed in continuously expanding their manpower and consolidating positions around the city, the pressure on Baidoa’s defenders will inevitably increase. The former president’s supporters clearly believe that time is on their side. Their calculation appears to be that every new fighter who joins the campaign, every additional position established outside the city and every failure by the authorities to resolve the underlying political crisis brings them one step closer to the ultimate objective: returning Laftagareen to power in Baidoa. Whether that ambition becomes reality remains uncertain. But one thing is increasingly clear: the struggle for Baidoa is far from over, and the possibility that the city could eventually fall under the control of forces loyal to Laftagareen can no longer be dismissed. There is no independent confirmation that the newly reported fighters are preparing for an immediate assault, nor is there reliable information about their exact numbers, equipment or current positions. Claims circulating online should therefore be treated cautiously. But the broader trend is difficult to ignore. New fighters are reportedly arriving. Existing forces remain positioned outside the city. Previous attempts to penetrate Baidoa have demonstrated that the opposition retains the capacity to mount military operations. And the political dispute that produced the confrontation remains unresolved. Taken together, these developments create the possibility of a prolonged campaign in which control of Baidoa could ultimately be determined not in political negotiations, but on the battlefield. If Laftagareen’s forces succeed in continuously expanding their manpower and consolidating positions around the city, the pressure on Baidoa’s defenders will inevitably increase. The former president’s supporters clearly believe that time is on their side. Their calculation appears to be that every new fighter who joins the campaign, every additional position established outside the city and every failure by the authorities to resolve the underlying political crisis brings them one step closer to the ultimate objective: returning Laftagareen to power in Baidoa. Whether that ambition becomes reality remains uncertain. items.title: Doon Qorrax Ku Shaqaysa Oo 3,106 Mayl Safartay
items.description: Safare Finnish ah oo lagu magacaabo Lukas Sjoman ayaa ku guulaystay inuu ku dhammeystiro safar dheer oo u dhexeeya Finland iyo Spain isagoo adeegsanaya doon uu ku dhisay oo ku shaqeysa tamarta qoraxda oo kaliya, iyada oo aan la adeegsan shidaal dhaqameed. Doontan oo uu ku magacaabay Helios 11 , waxaa uu ku qaatay ku dhawaad 200 maalmood oo uu naqshadeynayo oo uu dhisayo, isagoo diiradda saaray inay noqoto mid madax banaan oo deegaanka u roon. Safarkan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu muujinayaa awoodda tamarta qoraxda ee loo adeegsan karo safarada badda ee dheer, taasoo furta albaab cusub oo loogu talagalay sahamin waara oo deegaanka la jaanqaada. Doontu waxay isticmaashaa muraayadaha qoraxda (solar panels) si ay u soo ururiso tamarta iftiinka qoraxda una beddesho koronto, taasoo ku shaqeysa mishiinnada doonta oo u dhaqaajisa biyaha, iyada oo aan loo baahnayn naafto ama batrool. Dhawaan, Sjoman ayaa dhammeystay safar dhan 3,106 mayl, isagoo ka soo duulay Finland kuna sii jeeday Spain, isagoo booqday meelo ay ka mid tahay Ibiza. Safarku waxa uu noqday tijaabo muhiim ah oo lagu qiimeynayo waxa doon qoraxda ku shaqeysa ay ku dhammeysan karto safar dheer. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, safarku ma ahayn mid dhib la’aan. Intii doontu ku sugneyd meel u dhow La Rápita ee Spain, Sjoman waxaa ku dhacay khasaare weyn markii doontiisa yar ee taageerada (utility dinghy) la xaday. Doontan yar waxay ahayd mid muhiim ah oo u oggolaanaysa isaga iyo shaqaalihiisa inay u dhex maraan doonta weyn iyo xeebta. Maadaama Helios 11 ay aad u weyn tahay oo aan si fudud looga soo saari karin xeebaha gacmeed ama lagu dhex marin karo dekedo aad u yar, luminta doonta yar waxay ka dhigtay hawsha maalinleyda mid aad u adag. Halkii uu ka joojin lahaa safarkiisa, Sjoman iyo shaqaalihiisu waxay heleen xal degdeg ah. Waxay si degdeg ah u dhisteen doon yar oo nooca catamaran ah si ay dib ugu soo celiyaan awooddooda ay ku tagaan xeebta oo ay u sii wataan safarkooda. Sheekadani waxay muujinaysaa sida hal-abuurnimada, go’aan adayga, iyo tamarta la cusboonaysiin karo ay isugu imaan karaan. Safarka Sjoman ee Helios 11 waxa uu muujinayaa awoodda tamarta qoraxda ee safarada badda, waxaanu iftiiminayaa fursado cusub oo loogu talagalay sahamin waara. items.title: AUSSOM oo Heegan Gelisay Ciidamada Shabeellaha Dhexe
items.description: Shabeellaha Dhexe (Raxanreeb Online): Midowga Afrika ayaa heegan buuxa geliyay ciidamadiisa ku sugan furimaha hore ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, kaddib booqasho uu maanta deegaanka Garsale ku tagay Taliye-ku-xigeenka Qaybta 5-aad ee AUSSOM, Kornayl Mathias Sibomana. Taliyaha ayaa ciidamada ku boorriyay inay sare u qaadaan feejignaantooda isla markaana diyaar u noqdaan hawlgallo dhici kara xilli kasta, isagoo sidoo kale faray inay bilaabaan roondooyin iyo gaafwareeg joogto ah, maadaama sida uu sheegay ay jiraan khataro amni oo ka badan kuwii hore. Tallaabadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo sidoo kale heegan la geliyay ciidamada AUSSOM ee ku sugan Carbiska, duleedka Muqdisho, taasoo muujinaysa in dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidamada howlgalka Midowga Afrika ay sii kordhayaan. Qaar ka mid ah dadka arrintan falanqeeyay ayaa u sababeynaya dhaq-dhaqaaqyada cusub ee AUSSOM xaaladda amni iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada Al-Shabaab, halka kuwo kale ay aaminsan yihiin in ciidamada howlgalka ay doonayaan inay muujiyaan feejignaan dheeraad ah xilli la sheegay inay socdaan qiimeynno ku saabsan waxqabadkooda iyo mustaqbalkooda Soomaaliya. The post AUSSOM oo Heegan Gelisay Ciidamada Shabeellaha Dhexe appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo qaabilay Duqa magaalada Bristol + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta xarunta madaxtooyada ku qaabilay Duqa Magaalada Bristol ee dalka Ingiriiska Yaasiin Maxamuud, oo asal ahaan Soomaali ah, isla markaana haatan booqasho ku joogo magaalada Muqdisho. Madaxweynaha ayaa ku bogaadiyay Yaasiin Maxamuud dadaalka uu muujiyay iyo hoggaamintiisa Bristol oo kamid ah magaalooyinka ugu muhiimsan dalka Ingriiska. “Waxaan Madaxtooyada ku qaabilay Duqa magaalada Bristol ee dalka Ingiriiska, Mudane Yaasiin Maxamuud, oo ah muwaadin Soomaaliyeed oo hoggaamiya mid ka mid ah magaalooyinka waaweyn ee dalka Ingiriiska. Waxaan si gaar ah ugu bogaadiyay Mudane Yaasiin dadaalka iyo hoggaaminta uu ku muujiyay magaalada Bristol iyo guusha uu ka gaaray hoggaaminta mid ka mid ah magaalooyinka muhiimka ah ee dalka Ingiriiska,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in guushiisa ay sharaf wayn u tahay guud ahaan dadka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan kuwa ku nool dalka dibaddiisa, kuwaas oo fursado muhiim ah ka helay dalalka ay ku nool yihiin. “Guushiisa iyo doorkiisa hoggaamineed waxa ay sawir wanaagsan ka bixinayaan kartida, aqoonta iyo awoodda dadka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan jiilka Soomaaliyeed ee ku nool qurbaha, kuwaasi oo fursad u helay in ay kaalin muuqata ka qaataan hoggaaminta iyo horumarinta bulshooyinka ay ku nool yihiin,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Horay waxaa Duqa Magaalada Bristol u qaabilay Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre, isaga oo la wadaagay, sida ay magaalada Muqdisho uga soo kabanayso burburkii soo gaaray, gaar ahaan horumarka muuqda ee dhanka kaabeyaasha ah iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in dowladaha hoose ee Muqdisho iyo Bristol is-dhaafsadaan khibradaha maamulka iyo adeegyada bulshada. Sidoo kale, wuxuu Duqa Bristol uga mahadceliyay booqashada uu ku yimid caasimadda Soomaaliya ee Muqdisho si uu indhihiisa ugu arko dib-u-dhiska baaxadda leh ee ka socda dalkeenna gaar ahaanna caasimadda ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Kulankaas waxaa Ra’iisul wasaaraha ku wehlinayay Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir, ahna Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho, mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya.     The post Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo qaabilay Duqa magaalada Bristol + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: UNTMIS oo taageertay kulan lagu xoojinayo wada shaqeynta xoolo-dhaqatada iyo beeraleyda
items.description: Beledweyne – Magaalada Beledweyne ayaa dhawaan lagu qabtay kulan wadatashi ah oo socday muddo laba maalmood ah, kaas oo lagu xoojinayay iskaashiga iyo wada shaqeynta u dhexeeya xoolo-dhaqatada iyo beeraleyda, si looga hortago khilaafaadka ka dhasha tartanka kheyraadka dabiiciga ah. Kulanka waxaa soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, Dowladaha Hoose iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta Hirshabeelle, iyadoo UNTMIS ay taageero ka geysatay qabsoomidda kulanka. Intii uu socday wadatashiga, waxaa si gaar ah looga hadlay sidii loo maareyn lahaa khilaafaadka ka dhasha isticmaalka dhulka daaqa iyo kheyraadka dabiiciga ah, iyadoo sidoo kale xoogga la saaray ilaalinta deegaanka iyo sidii loo heli lahaa hannaan bulsho oo lagu yareeyo isku dhacyada u dhexeeya beeraleyda iyo xoolo-dhaqatada. Ka qeybgalayaashu waxay carrabka ku adkeeyeen muhiimadda ay leedahay in bulshada si joogto ah looga qeybgeliyo dadaallada lagu horumarinayo wada noolaanshaha nabdoon, isku-xirnaanta bulshada iyo adkeysiga bulshada, gaar ahaan xilliyada ay sii kordhayaan cadaadiska iyo tartanka ku saabsan kheyraadka. Kulanka ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu dhisayo iskaashi iyo isfaham dhex mara bulshada ku tiirsan xoolaha iyo beeraha, si khilaafaadka kheyraadka looga hortago kahor inta aysan isu beddelin isku dhacyo.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo dilay badmaaxiin, markii ay garaaceen markab ganacsi
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa maanta gantaalo ku weeraray markab ganacsi oo marayay marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Wasaaradda Gaadiidka ee dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay ee Yemen ayaa sheegtay in weerarka ay ku dhinteen afar ka mid ah shaqaalihii markabka, oo u kala dhashay Pakistan iyo Indonesia. Wasaaradda ayaa galabta sheegtay in saddex ka mid ah shaqaalaha ay u dhasheen Pakistan, kan kalena uu ahaa muwaadin Indonesian ah. Wasaaradda ayaa warsaxaafadeed ku sheegtay in Xuutiyiinta ay saddex gantaal oo nooca ballaastikada ah ku dhufteen markabka ganacsiga ee Yemen, taas oo sababtay dab iyo burbur soo gaaray markabka. Markabkan oo lagu magacaabo Tihamah ayaa waxaa jira warar sheegaya in laga leeyahay dalkaasi Masar, inkastoo Dowladda Yemen ay sheegtay inuu ahaa markab ganacsi oo Yemeni ah. Weerarka dhimashada sababay ee lagu qaaday markabkaasi ayaa imanaya, xilli Xuutiyiinta ay weeraro ku hayeen magaalada dekedda leh ee Mokha, oo ay gacanta ku hayso Dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudiga uu taageero, kuna taala Badda Cas. Waa weerarkii ugu horreyay oo dad ay ku dhintaan oo Xuutiyiintu ku qaadaan markab ganacsi, tan iyo markii 20-kii bishii July ay go’doomin dhanka badda ah ku soo rogeen Dekedaha Sacuudiga. Ka dib markii dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Iran uu saameeyay Marinka Hormuz, Sacuudiga ayaa Marinka Bab El-Mandeb oo ku yaala cirifka koonfureed ee Yemen u isticmaalayay waddo uu ka dhoofiyo shidaalkiisa.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Talyaaniga oo ka wada hadlay horumarinta kalluumeysiga iyo dhoofinta kalluunka
items.description: Wasiirka Kalluumeysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ee Soomaaliya, Axmed Xasan Aadan, ayaa Muqdisho kula kulmay Danjiraha Talyaaniga ee Soomaaliya, Pier Mario Daccò Coppi, iyagoo ka wada hadlay xoojinta wax-soo-saarka kalluumeysiga iyo sidii kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed ay si wanaagsan uga faa’iideysan lahaayeen kheyraadka badda dalka. items.title: Markab maraayay marin biyoodka Baabul-mandab oo la weeraray laguna dilay
items.description: Laba shaqaale oo la socday markab xamuul ah oo lagu weeraray meel u dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab ayaa “la dilay” Horaan u soo sheegnay in markab xamuul ah lagu weeraray koonfurta Badda Cas. Hadda, shirkad amniga badda oo laga leeyahay Britain ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan laba qof lagu dilay weerar lagu qaaday markabka meel u dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, oo ka baxsan xeebta koonfureed ee Yemen. Shirkadda Vanguard ayaa sheegtay in dadka dhintay ay ahaayeen “laba shaqaale oo markabka ka tirsanaa, mid u dhashay Pakistan iyo mid u dhashay Indonesia.” Sida warbixintu sheegtay, afar qof oo kale ayaa sidoo kale dhaawacmay, kuwaas oo saddex ka mid ahi yihiin muwaadiniin Pakistani ah, halka qofka kalena uu yahay muwaadin Indonesian ah. Shirkaddu waxay sheegtay: “Kadib weerarka, ciidamada badda Yemen ayaa u gurmaday markabka si ay u caawiyaan, balse rasaas ayaa lagu furay, taas oo sababtay in hal qof oo kale uu dhinto ama dhaawacmo.”

items.title: PSF Forces Move to Galmudug After Puntland Clash
items.description: A group of Puntland Security Forces (PSF) personnel has been relocated to Xananbuure in Somalia’s Galgaduud region after Puntland forces took control of the unit’s former base in eastern Gaalkacyo. Sources said the personnel have been accommodated at a military camp in Xananbuure, within Galmudug State, where they are expected to remain pending further instructions from the Federal Government of Somalia. The PSF, a specially trained force that previously received support from the United States, has in recent months reportedly moved closer to the Federal Government, which has been providing salaries and military equipment to the unit. The relocation follows mounting tensions between the PSF and the Puntland administration of President Said Abdullahi Deni, culminating in Puntland forces taking over the PSF position in eastern Gaalkacyo. The Federal Government has not publicly disclosed its long-term plans for the relocated personnel or clarified what role the unit may assume following the loss of its Gaalkacyo base. items.title: 7.4-magnitude earthquake destroys Manizales Cathedral
items.description: A powerful 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck Colombia today, causing part of the historic Manizales Cathedral to collapse and sending debris spilling into the streets of the city. Widespread damage has been reported across several cities, with injuries confirmed and emergency crews now assessing the full extent of the destruction. The earthquake, one of the strongest to hit the country in years, has devastated parts of Manizales, a city known for its cultural and architectural heritage. The cathedral, a landmark and one of the most iconic religious buildings in Colombia, suffered significant structural damage, with large sections crumbling to the ground. Emergency response teams have been deployed to affected areas, with rescue operations underway in multiple cities. While official casualty figures have not yet been released, local authorities have confirmed that there are injuries and that search-and-rescue efforts are continuing. In addition to the damage in Manizales, other cities have reported collapsed buildings, cracked roads, and power outages. Residents have been seen fleeing their homes, fearing further aftershocks. The government has urged calm and called on citizens to cooperate with emergency services as they work to secure affected areas. The full scale of the damage is still being assessed, but initial reports indicate that the quake has left a trail of destruction across the region. items.title: Dhul-gariir 7.4 Ah Oo Burburiyay Cathedral-ka Manizales
items.description: Dhul-gariir xooggan oo cabirkiisu yahay 7.4 ah ayaa maanta ku dhuftay dalka Colombia, kaas oo burburiyay qaybo ka mid ah Cathedral-ka taariikhiga ah ee magaalada Manizales, halkaas oo burburka uu ku daatay waddooyinka magaalada. Khasaare baahsan ayaa ka dhacay magaalooyin badan, iyadoo ay jiraan dad dhaawacmay, waxaana gurmadka degdegga ah la geeyay goobaha ay saamayntu ka dhacday . Dhul-gariirkan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay mid ka mid ah dhul-gariiryada ugu xooggan ee ku dhaca Colombia muddo sanado ah, isagoo burburiyay mid ka mid ah dhismayaasha taariikhiga ah ee ugu waaweyn dalka. Waxaa la soo sheegay in Cathedral-ka Manizales, oo ah mid ka mid ah dhismayaasha diinta ugu caansan Colombia, uu waxyeello weyn ka soo gaaray. Kooxaha gurmadka degdegga ah ayaa hadda qiimeynaya baaxadda khasaaraha, iyadoo xogta hordhaca ah ay muujinayso in burburka uu ku yimi dhismayaal badan oo magaalada ku yaal. Ma jiro warar rasmi ah oo ku saabsan tirada dadka dhaawacmay ama khasaaraha nafeed, laakiin maamulka gobolka ayaa sheegay inay hawlgalo gurmad ah ka socdaan magaalooyinka ay saamayntu ka dhacday. Magaalooyinka qaar ayaa laga soo sheegay in ay ka dhaceen daadad iyo burbur dhismayaal ah, iyadoo dadka deegaanku ay ka baxsadeen guryahooda iyagoo ka baqaya in dhismayaashu ay ku dumaadaan. Ciidamada booliska iyo gurmadka ayaa goobjoog ka ah waddooyinka si ay u caawiyaan dadka dhaawacmay iyo kuwa ay saamayntu ka dhacday. items.title: Cabdirashiid Janan oo sheegay in ciidamada ku sugan Gobolka Gedo ay ku biirayaan Jubbaland
items.description: Cabdirashiid Xasan Cabdinuur (Janan) ayaa sheegay inay wada hadal nabadeed la gelayaan Dowlad Goboleedka Jubbaland, warkiisa oo laga dhadhansan karay in ciidamada ku sugan Gobolka Gedo ay dhabarka u jeedinayaan Dowladda Federaalka. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa bishii July ee saandkii 2025, Cabdirashiid Janan u magacawday Taliyaha Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda ee Jubbaland iyo Madaxa Amniga ee Gobolka Gedo, waxayna magacaabiddiisu ka dambeysay, ka dib markii uu xoogeystay khilaafka Dowladda Federaalka iyo Jubbaland. Khilaafkan oo soo ifbaxay bishii October ee sanadkii 2024 ayaa keenay in Dowladda Federaalka ay sanadkii hore ee 2025 la wareegto inta badan Degmooyinka Gobolka Gedo, iyadoona ka hawlgelisay ciidamo awaamiirteeda ku shaqeeya. Cabdirashiid Janan oo maanta ciidamada kula hadlay Degmada Beledxaawo ayaa sheegay inay aadayaan dhinaca Jubbaland, ka gadaal markii uu Dowladda Federaalka ku eedeeyay inay diiday bixinta mushaarka iyo garaamka ee ciidamada gobolkaasi. Waxa uu sheegay in uu isagu ahaa ninka ugu sarreyay ciidamada taabacsan Dowladda Federaalka ee ku sugan gobolka, isla-markaana ay xanuun-jisay inaanan la siinin xuquuqdooda. “Askariga waxa dhibaayo xaaladdiisa, waan la xanuunsadaa. Xaaladdaas marka waxay nagu ahayd caqabad fara-badan.” Ayuu yiri Cabdirashiid Xasan Cabdinuur. Cabdirashiid Janan ayaa sheegay inay go’aansadeen in wada hadal nabadeed ay la galaan Jubbaland, si aysan mar dambe u dagaalamin ciidamada ku sugan duleedka Degmada Beledxaawo iyo kuwa Jubbaland ee ku sugan dhinaca Degmada Mandhera ee Gobolka Waqooyi Bari Kenya. Waxa uu intaasi ku daray in qorshaha nabadeynta uu sahli doono inay xuquuqdooda helaan Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee ka hawlgala gobolkaasi. “Askariga federaal ah ama Ciidanka Nabad Sugidda ka tirsan ama Booliska Soomaaliyeed ka tirsan ama Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ka tirsan, waxa uu ahaa wuu ahaanayaa. Kii intaas aan ahayn magac kale ayaa loo bixinayaa, xuquuqna waa la siinayaa.” Ayuu yiri Cabdirashiid Janan. Janan ayaa intaasi ku daray “Nimankaas heshiis baan la aadaynaa, waxaad tihiin baana tihiin, waxaana la keeni doonnaa nidaam lagu heshiiyo. Guddiyo ayaa la qabanayaa, dib-u-heshiisiin sax ah oo ciidankii diriray lagu heshiinayo baan ka shaqeynaynaa.” Hadalka ka soo yeeray Cabdirashiid Janan ayaa ku soo aadaya, xilli uu weli taagan yahay khilaafka Dowladda Federaalka kala dhexeeya Jubbaland.

Dowladda Federaalka ayaa bishii July ee saandkii 2025, Cabdirashiid Janan u magacawday Taliyaha Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda ee Jubbaland iyo Madaxa Amniga ee Gobolka Gedo, waxayna magacaabiddiisu ka dambeysay, ka dib markii uu xoogeystay khilaafka Dowladda Federaalka iyo Jubbaland. Khilaafkan oo soo ifbaxay bishii October ee sanadkii 2024 ayaa keenay in Dowladda Federaalka ay sanadkii hore ee 2025 la wareegto inta badan Degmooyinka Gobolka Gedo, iyadoona ka hawlgelisay ciidamo awaamiirteeda ku shaqeeya. Cabdirashiid Janan oo maanta ciidamada kula hadlay Degmada Beledxaawo ayaa sheegay inay aadayaan dhinaca Jubbaland, ka gadaal markii uu Dowladda Federaalka ku eedeeyay inay diiday bixinta mushaarka iyo garaamka ee ciidamada gobolkaasi. Waxa uu sheegay in uu isagu ahaa ninka ugu sarreyay ciidamada taabacsan Dowladda Federaalka ee ku sugan gobolka, isla-markaana ay xanuun-jisay inaanan la siinin xuquuqdooda. “Askariga waxa dhibaayo xaaladdiisa, waan la xanuunsadaa. Xaaladdaas marka waxay nagu ahayd caqabad fara-badan.” Ayuu yiri Cabdirashiid Xasan Cabdinuur. Cabdirashiid Janan ayaa sheegay inay go’aansadeen in wada hadal nabadeed ay la galaan Jubbaland, si aysan mar dambe u dagaalamin ciidamada ku sugan duleedka Degmada Beledxaawo iyo kuwa Jubbaland ee ku sugan dhinaca Degmada Mandhera ee Gobolka Waqooyi Bari Kenya. Waxa uu intaasi ku daray in qorshaha nabadeynta uu sahli doono inay xuquuqdooda helaan Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee ka hawlgala gobolkaasi. “Askariga federaal ah ama Ciidanka Nabad Sugidda ka tirsan ama Booliska Soomaaliyeed ka tirsan ama Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ka tirsan, waxa uu ahaa wuu ahaanayaa. Kii intaas aan ahayn magac kale ayaa loo bixinayaa, xuquuqna waa la siinayaa.” Ayuu yiri Cabdirashiid Janan. Janan ayaa intaasi ku daray “Nimankaas heshiis baan la aadaynaa, waxaad tihiin baana tihiin, waxaana la keeni doonnaa nidaam lagu heshiiyo. Guddiyo ayaa la qabanayaa, dib-u-heshiisiin sax ah oo ciidankii diriray lagu heshiinayo baan ka shaqeynaynaa.” Hadalka ka soo yeeray Cabdirashiid Janan ayaa ku soo aadaya, xilli uu weli taagan yahay khilaafka Dowladda Federaalka kala dhexeeya Jubbaland.

items.title: Shiinaha oo maraakiib dagaal u soo diraya biyaha Soomaaliya iyo arrinta ka dambeysa
items.description: Beijing (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Shiinaha ayaa bartamaha bishan August lagu wadaa inuu maraakiib dagaal oo cusub u soo diro Gacanka Cadmeed iyo biyaha Soomaaliya. Maraakiibtan ayaa la sheegay inay ka qeyb qaadan doonaan howlaha ilaalinta maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara marin-biyoodka caalamiga ah. Wasaaradda Difaaca Qaranka Shiinaha ayaa sheegtay in howl-galka cusub uu noqonayo kii 49-aad ee ciidamada badda dalkaasi ay ka fuliyaan Gacanka Cadmeed iyo biyaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo kooxdan cusub ay beddeli doonto cutubkii 48-aad ee howl-galkan. Cutubkii hore ayaa gobolka ku sugnaa tan iyo bishii October ee sanadkii hore, waxaana ciidamada badda Shiinaha ay muddo dheer ka qeyb qaadanayeen howlaha lagu sugayo amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo maraakiibta kale ee isticmaala marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah. Sida ay sheegtay wasaaradda difaaca Shiinaha, kooxda cusub ayaa ka koobnaan doonta markabka dagaalka ee gantaallada riddada dheer Kunming, markabka dagaalka Yueyang iyo markabka sahayda iyo taageerada Luomahu. Beijing ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada badda Shiinaha ay doonayaan inay gacan ka geystaan sugidda amniga marin-biyoodka caalamiga ah iyo xasilloonida gobolka, iyadoo howl-galka lagu saleynayo iskaashi dhinaca amniga badda ah. Shiinaha ayaa tan iyo sannadkii 2008 si joogto ah maraakiib dagaal uga howlgeliya Gacanka Cadmeed iyo biyaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo Beijing ay sheegtay in howl-galadaasi ay ku saleysan yihiin qaraarrada Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Dowladda Shiinaha ayaa sheegtay in maraakiibteeda ay ilaa hadda galbiyeen in ka badan 7,000 oo markab oo isugu jira kuwo Shiine ah iyo kuwo dalal kale laga leeyahay, iyadoo sidoo kale ay samatabbixiyeen ama gargaar siiyeen maraakiib ku jiray xaalado halis ah. Maraakiibta Shiinaha ayaa sidoo kale horey uga qeyb qaatay daadgureynta muwaadiniin Shiineys ah iyo ajaanib kale oo laga soo saaray dalal ay ka jireen dagaallo iyo colaado hubeysan, iyadoo howl-galka cusub uu kusoo beegmayo xilli amniga marin-biyoodka gobolka uu weli yahay arrin muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamiga ah. The post Shiinaha oo maraakiib dagaal u soo diraya biyaha Soomaaliya iyo arrinta ka dambeysa appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Uganda oo Heegan Gelisay Ciidamadeeda Carbiska SAWIRO
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Uganda ayaa heegan buuxa gelisay ciidamadeeda ka tirsan howlgalka AUSSOM ee ku sugan deegaanka Carbiska, duleedka magaalada Muqdisho, kaddib kulan uu Taliyaha Guutada 46-aad ee Qaybta 1-aad ee AUSSOM, Kornayl Saul Nabimanya, la yeeshay ciidamada. Taliyaha ayaa ciidamada kula hadlay Saldhigga Hawlgalka Furinta ee Carbiska (FOB), isagoo ku boorriyay inay si joogto ah u ilaashadaan feejignaanta isla markaana diyaar u noqdaan wax ka qabashada khataraha amni. Kornayl Nabimanya ayaa sidoo kale ciidamada u sheegay in ay jiraan walaacyo la xiriira dhaqaalaha lagu bixiyo howlgalka, isaga oo kula dardaarmay inay si masuuliyad leh u maareeyaan dhaqaalahooda oo ay ka fogaadaan kharashaadka aan daruuriga ahayn. Taliyaha ayaa ciidamada ku ammaanay feejignaantooda iyo sida ay uga go’an tahay ka hortagga khataraha ka imaan kara Al-Shabaab, isagoo sheegay in loo baahan yahay diyaar-garow joogto ah si looga jawaabo caqabadaha cusub ee amni. Nabimanya ayaa sidoo kale xusay in waajibaadka ciidamada uusan ku koobnayn muddada ay howlgalka ku jiraan, wuxuuna kula dardaarmay inay qaataan go’aanno wanaagsan oo mustaqbalkooda anfaca marka ay ka baxaan adeegga ciidanka. The post Uganda oo Heegan Gelisay Ciidamadeeda Carbiska SAWIRO appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Aadan Madoobe iyo Safiirka Turkiga oo Muqdisho Ku Kulmay
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Hoggaamiyaha Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa magaalada Muqdisho kula kulmay Safiirka Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Alper Aktaş, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Koonfur Galbeed iyo Turkiga. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda guud ee Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, adeegyada bulshada, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha bani’aadannimada. Aadan Madoobe ayaa uga mahadceliyay dowladda iyo shacabka Turkiga taageerada joogtada ah ee ay siiyaan Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan Koonfur Galbeed, isagoo tilmaamay doorka Turkigu ku leeyahay taageerada Soomaaliya iyo dib-u-dhiska dalka. Sidoo kale, Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaa Danjiraha la wadaagay xaaladda ka jirta deegaannada maamulka iyo dadaallada lagu horumarinayo adeegyada bulshada, xoojinta amniga iyo kobcinta dhaqaalaha. Aadan Madoobe ayaa sheegay in Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed uu diyaar u yahay xoojinta xiriirka iyo wada shaqeynta uu la leeyahay dowladda Turkiga, iyadoo mudnaanta la siinayo arrimaha ka qeyb qaadanaya horumarka iyo xasilloonida bulshada. Kulanka ayaa qeyb ka ahaa kulamo shaqo oo Aadan Madoobe uu Muqdisho kula yeelanayo madaxda dowladda Federaalka, diblomaasiyiinta iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah. Waxaa kulanka sidoo kale ka qeybgalay Wasiirka Beeraha iyo Agaasimaha Guud ee Madaxtooyada Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. items.title: Maxkamad ku taalla dalka Suuriya oo dil ku xukuntay Bashaar Al-Asad iyo saraakiil hore
items.description: Maxkamadda Dambiyada ee magaalada Dimishiq ayaa soo saartay xukunno culus oo ka dhan ah madaxweynihii hore ee Suuriya Bashaar Al-Asad iyo saraakiil kale oo ka tirsanaa nidaamkiisii, iyadoo maxkamaddu ku heshay dambiyo ay ka mid yihiin dil, jirdil, afduub, xorriyad ka qaadis iyo falal ay ku tilmaantay dambiyo ka dhan ah bani’aadannimada iyo dambiyo dagaal. Maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay in Bashaar Al-Asad lagu helay dambiyo kala duwan oo ay ka mid yihiin dilal ula kac ah oo loo geystay dad badan, dilal loo geystay carruur ka yar 15 sano, dilal lala xiriiriyay jirdil iyo tacaddi, kicin iyo dhiirrigelin dilal soo noqnoqday, jirdil sababay dhimasho iyo xorriyad ka qaadis dad badan. Sida ku cad go’aanka maxkamadda, dambiyadan ayaa loo aqoonsaday kuwo ka dhan ah bani’aadannimada iyo dambiyo dagaal, waxaana Bashaar Al-Asad lagu xukumay dil . Xukunka ayaa sidoo kale lagu riday walaalkiis Maahir Al-Asad iyo saraakiil kale oo hore uga tirsanaa nidaamkii taliskii hore, ayadoo Saraakiishan dilka lagu xukumay ay ka midyihiin Fahad Al-Fureej, Luay Al-Cali, Qusay Mahiib, Wafiq Naasir iyo Talaal Al-Caythami. Maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay in eedaha loo haysto ay ku jiraan dilal badan, jirdil, afduub, xorriyad ka qaadis iyo falal kale oo loo aqoonsaday dambiyo dagaal iyo dambiyo ka dhan ah bani’aadannimada. Kiiska sida gaarka ah loo hadal hayo ayaa ahaa midka Caatef Najiib, oo hore u ahaa madaxa Laanta Amniga Siyaasadda ee Darca, waxaana Najiib uu ahaa eedeysanaha maxkamadda hor yimid, halka inta badan dadka kale ee lagu xukumay ay yihiin eedeysanayaal baxsad ah. Maxkamaddu waxay Najiib ku heshay dilal, jirdil sababay dhimasho, afduub iyo xorriyad ka qaadis, iyadoo sidoo kale lagu soo oogay dambiyo kale oo ay ka mid yihiin hurinta colaadaha iyo nacaybka kooxeed, ku takri-falka awoodda, ku xadgudubka waajibaadka shaqada, lunsashada hanti dadweyne iyo lacag dhaqis. Maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay in Najiib uu si buuxda u diiday dhammaan eedaha loo soo jeediyay, isla markaana uu diiday markhaatiyadii lagu hor keenay maxkamadda, hase yeeshee, garsoorku wuxuu sheegay in eedaha lagu taageeray caddaymo badan oo ay ka mid yihiin markhaatiyo, hadallada dhibbanayaasha, dukumentiyo rasmi ah, warbixinno caafimaad, muuqaallo iyo codad laga soo bandhigay dhageysiga dacwadda iyo warbixinno caalami ah oo la diiwaangeliyay. Go’aanka maxkamaddu wuxuu si gaar ah u xusay dhacdooyinkii ka dhacay magaalada Darca, halkaas oo lagu eedeeyay in ciidamada iyo hay’adaha amniga ay si xooggan uga jawaabeen kacdoonkii bilowday sannadkii 2011.

Maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay in eedaha loo haysto ay ku jiraan dilal badan, jirdil, afduub, xorriyad ka qaadis iyo falal kale oo loo aqoonsaday dambiyo dagaal iyo dambiyo ka dhan ah bani’aadannimada. Kiiska sida gaarka ah loo hadal hayo ayaa ahaa midka Caatef Najiib, oo hore u ahaa madaxa Laanta Amniga Siyaasadda ee Darca, waxaana Najiib uu ahaa eedeysanaha maxkamadda hor yimid, halka inta badan dadka kale ee lagu xukumay ay yihiin eedeysanayaal baxsad ah. Maxkamaddu waxay Najiib ku heshay dilal, jirdil sababay dhimasho, afduub iyo xorriyad ka qaadis, iyadoo sidoo kale lagu soo oogay dambiyo kale oo ay ka mid yihiin hurinta colaadaha iyo nacaybka kooxeed, ku takri-falka awoodda, ku xadgudubka waajibaadka shaqada, lunsashada hanti dadweyne iyo lacag dhaqis. Maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay in Najiib uu si buuxda u diiday dhammaan eedaha loo soo jeediyay, isla markaana uu diiday markhaatiyadii lagu hor keenay maxkamadda, hase yeeshee, garsoorku wuxuu sheegay in eedaha lagu taageeray caddaymo badan oo ay ka mid yihiin markhaatiyo, hadallada dhibbanayaasha, dukumentiyo rasmi ah, warbixinno caafimaad, muuqaallo iyo codad laga soo bandhigay dhageysiga dacwadda iyo warbixinno caalami ah oo la diiwaangeliyay. Go’aanka maxkamaddu wuxuu si gaar ah u xusay dhacdooyinkii ka dhacay magaalada Darca, halkaas oo lagu eedeeyay in ciidamada iyo hay’adaha amniga ay si xooggan uga jawaabeen kacdoonkii bilowday sannadkii 2011.

items.title: Major Blow to Mogadishu as Janan and Gedo Forces Join Jubaland
items.description: BELED HAWO— Abdirashid Janan, who had been appointed by the Federal Government of Somalia as the intelligence chief for the Gedo region, has reportedly joined the Jubaland administration following several days of talks with Jubaland President Ahmed Madobe. Reports say Janan addressed troops under his command on Tuesday morning at a military camp on the outskirts of Beled Hawo, telling them that his dispute with the Jubaland administration had come to an end. The forces, which had been operating under the Federal Government, were reportedly informed that a new understanding had been reached with Jubaland. Sources also say Jubaland has agreed to take responsibility for paying the salaries of the troops stationed in the area. The soldiers are reported to have gone without salaries from the Federal Government for some time. The development is being viewed as a significant shift in the political and security dynamics in Gedo, where the Federal Government and Jubaland have long been engaged in disputes over political authority and control of security forces. Janan had in recent months been regarded as an important figure in the Federal Government’s efforts to maintain its presence in Beled Hawo. During his address to the troops, Janan reportedly accused the Federal Government of failing to act in good faith in its dealings with Jubaland. He was also reported to have criticised some senior security officials and Federal Government leaders, accusing them of pursuing personal and clan interests in their handling of national affairs. The development comes amid a longstanding dispute between the Federal Government and the Jubaland administration, particularly over the administration of Gedo region and control of security forces deployed there. Jubaland has reportedly agreed to receive the troops into its structures and assume responsibility for their salaries and other entitlements. items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya oo Furay Shirweynaha Maalgashiga cuntada iyo Beeraha Soomaaliya
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ka furay Shirweynaha Maalgashiga cuntada iyo beeraha dalka, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray horumarinta iyo maalgashiga dhinaca beeraha iyo wax-soo-saarka dalka. Shirweynahan oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Waraabka ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya , ayaa looga hadlayaa sidii loo xoojin lahaa wax-soo-saarka gudaha, loo kordhin lahaa maalgashiga beeraha, isla markaana Soomaaliya ay si wanaagsan uga faa’iidaysan lahayd kheyraadkeeda dabiiciga ah iyo dhul-beereedkeeda. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sheegay in ay muhiim tahay in Soomaaliya ay kordhiso wax-soo-saarkeeda gudaha, si loo yareeyo ku tiirsanaanta waxyaabaha dibadda laga keeno. Waxa uu tilmaamay in loo baahan yahay in la casriyeeyo nidaamka wax-soo-saarka beeraha, lana taageero beeraleyda Soomaaliyeed si ay u helaan fursado iyo qalab casri ah oo kor u qaada wax-soo-saarkooda. Waxa uu sidoo kale xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in maalgashadayaasha gudaha iyo kuwa dibadda lagu dhiirrigeliyo inay maalgashadaan waaxda beeraha, maadaama Soomaaliya ay leedahay dhul ballaaran iyo fursado badan oo dhinaca wax-soo-saarka beeraha ah. Shirweynaha waxaa ka qayb galay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, ganacsato, maalgashadayaal iyo daneeyayaal kale oo ku howlan horumarinta beeraha. Beeruhu waxay laf-dhabar u yihiin dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya, maadaama ay si toos ah ugu xiran yihiin sugnaanta cuntada, shaqo-abuurka iyo nolol-maalmeedka bulshada. Soomaaliya ayaa weli si weyn ugu tiirsan waxyaabaha dibadda laga keeno, gaar ahaan raashinka iyo badeecooyinka kale ee gudaha lagu isticmaalo.

items.title: Jaamac oo qaaday tallaabadii u horeysay kadib doorashadiisa
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo shalay loo doortay Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka ayaa wada-hadal khadka telefoonka ah la yeeshay dhiggiisa Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti, Dileita Mohamed Dileita. Guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka Jabuuti ayaa ugu horreyn hambalyo iyo bogaadin u diray guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka, isagoo ugu hambalyeeyay doorashadii shalay loogu doortay xilka guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Labada guddoomiye ayaa intii uu socday wada-hadalkoodu ka wada-hadlay xoojinta xiriirka soo jireenka ah ee walaaltinimo iyo iskaashi ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti, gaar ahaan sidii loo sii adkeyn lahaa wada shaqeynta iyo iskaashiga labada baarlamaan. Waxay sidoo kale isla garteen muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo xiriirka iyo is-dhaafsiga khibradaha baarlamaanada labada dal, iyadoo la sii horumarinayo iskaashiga dhinacyada sharci-dejinta iyo baarlamaanka. Guddoomiye Jaamac ayaa uga mahadceliyay dhiggiisa Jabuuti hambalyada iyo bogaadinta uu u diray, isagoo adkeeyay muhiimadda uu leeyahay xiriirka walaaltinimo ee qotada dheer ee Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti iyo sidoo kale doorka baarlamaanada labada dal ay ku leeyihiin xoojinta xiriirkaas. Jaamac oo shalay loo doortay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa wajahay diidmo adag uga timid siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka oo ayagu u arka in sifo sharci ah aan lagu dooran, maadaama ay ku doodayaan in muddo-xileedkii dastuuriga ahaa ee baarlamaanka Soomaaliya uu ku ekaa 14-kii April 2026. Sidaas darteedna mucaaradka ayaa qaba in golaha uusan laheyn wax sharciyad dastuur iyo mid siyaasadeed oo uu ku dooran karo hoggaamiye cusub. items.title: Ex Madaxweyne Bashar Al Assad oo dil lagu xukumay
items.description: Maxmakad Suuriyaan ah ayaa maanta xukun dil ah ku xukuntay Madaxweynihii hore ee Suuriya, Bashar Al Assad isaga oo aan goobta ku sugneyn, iyadoona lala xukumay xubno kale. Maxkamadda ayaa dil ku xukuntay Ex Madaxweyne Bashar Al Assad, walaalkiis Maher Al Assad iyo dhowr sarkaal oo ka tirsanaa maamulkii hore, ka dib markii lagu helay dembiyo ka dhan ah bani’aadantinimada, dilal sharci darro ah, xarig iyo jirdil loo gaystay carruur. Maxkamaddan oo ku taala Caasimadda Dimishiq ayaa xubnaha kale ee dilka ku xukuntay waxaa ka mid ah nin ay ilmo adeer yihiin Bashar Al Assad oo lagu magacaabo Atef Najib, oo ahaa Madaxa Amniga iyo Siyaasadda ee Gobolka Daraa. Atef Najib ayaa ah shakhsiga keliya ee isagoo xiran lagu xukumay dil. Xubnaha kale ee la xukumay ayaa kala ah Fahd Jassem Al Freij, Mohammed Ayman Ayoush, Louay Al Ali, Qusai Ibrahim Mhayoub, Wafiq Saleh Nasser iyo Talal Fares Al Asimi, kuwaas oo maqaneyaal ah. Garsoore Fakhr Al Din Al Aryan ayaa sheegay in doorka Madaxweyne Assad ee dembiyadaas uu ahaa shakhsiga ugu sarreya ee go’aanada gaara, isagoo intaasi ku daray inuu adeegsaday hay’adaha dowladda, si uu u fududeeyo gaysashada dembiyadaasi. Garsooraha ayaa sheegay in maxkamaddu ay Madaxweynihii hore ku heshay dembi ah dil ula kac ah oo loo gaystay dad badan oo carruur ay ku jiraan, xarig aan loo meel dayin iyo dembiyo ka dhan ah aadanaha. Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Qaranka ee Caddaaladda, Abdul Basit Abdul Latif ayaa sheegay in xukunkani uu yahay tallaabo muhiim ah oo wax weyn ka bedeleysa habka loo xaqiijinayo inay caddaalad helaan dhibaneyaasha iyo xoojinta sarreynta sharciga. Dad fara-badan ayaa isugu soo baxay afaafka hore Xarunta Maxkamadda Caddaaladda ee Dimishiq, iyagoo u dabaal-degaya xukunka dilka ah ee ay maxkamaddu ridday. Bashar Al Assad iyo xubno ka mid ah qoyskiisa ayaa isaga cararay dalka, ka dib markii awoodda laga tuuray 8-dii bishii December ee sanadkii 2024.

items.title: Fiqi oo Muqdisho Ku Booqday Askarta Ku Dhaawacantay Gaalkacyo
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa maanta Isbitaalka Madiina ku booqday askar ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed oo dhaawacyo kasoo gaareen weerarkii toddobaadkii hore lagu qaaday saldhigga Ciidanka XDS ee magaalada Gaalkacyo. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa dhakhaatiirta iyo maamulka isbitaalka ka xog-wareystay xaaladda caafimaad ee askarta, isaga oo faray in loo fidiyo daryeel caafimaad oo dhammaystiran, isla markaana xoogga la saaro daaweyntooda iyo sidii ay si wanaagsan uga soo kaban lahaayeen dhaawacyada. Wasiirka ayaa askarta uga mahadceliyay dadaalkii iyo naf-hurnimadii ay sannado badan ugu jireen sugidda amniga deegaanada Puntland iyo la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish, xilli ay hore uga tirsanaayeen ciidamada PSF. Fiqi ayaa sheegay in askartaasi ay muddo dheer u adeegayeen shacabka iyo xasilloonida Puntland, balse ay markii dambe doorteen inay khibraddooda iyo aqoontooda ciidan ugu adeegaan difaaca iyo amniga qaranka Soomaaliya. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale xusay in ku biirista Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay tahay xaq uu muwaadin Soomaaliyeed leeyahay, isagoo sheegay inaan tallaabadaasi loo arki karin sabab lagu weeraro ama lagu bartilmaameedsado askarta. Dhanka kale, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga ayaa caddeeyay in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka uusan dagaal kula jirin shacabka Soomaaliyeed ama maamullada dalka, balse uu waajibkiisu yahay la-dagaallanka kooxaha argagixisada iyo cid kasta oo khatar ku ah amniga, madaxbannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa mar kale sheegtay in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed yahay ciidan qaran oo u taagan difaaca dalka iyo shacabka, ilaalinta madaxbannaanida iyo midnimada Soomaaliya, iyo sugidda amniga qaranka guud ahaan dalka. items.title: Somalia’s opposition alliance, the Somali Future Council (SFC), has rejected the……..
items.description: Somalia’s opposition alliance, the Somali Future Council (SFC), has rejected the election of Abdulkadir Mohammed Nur Jama as Speaker of Parliament, terming it fraudulent. The manner in which the outgoing President manipulated this so-called election is a clear example of his blueprint for managing the upcoming Federal Parliament and Presidential elections. He intends to seize control of the electoral process, block strong competitors, and predetermine the final outcomes. The Somali Future Council reiterates that the electoral dispute in Somalia cannot be resolved through unilateral actions, abuse of power, and processes with predetermined results. The only path to restoring constitutional legitimacy and political trust is an inclusive consensus agreement. This must serve as the foundation for an election that is mutually agreed upon, with a process and outcome that everyone can trust. An expired mandate cannot generate a new mandate; and a stolen election cannot generate legitimacy

items.title: DF oo markii u horeysay ka hadashay dagaalkii Gaalkacyo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa markii ugu horreysay ka hadashay dagaalkii todobaadkii hore ka dhacay magaalaga Gaalkacyo, kaas oo u dhaxeeyay ciidamada taabacsan ee PSF iyo kuwa Puntland. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa Madaxweynaha Puntland ku eedeysay inuu weerar ku qaaday saldhig ay ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliya ku lahaayeen Gaalkacyo, iyadoo xustay in ciidamada la weeraray ay sannado badan ka soo qayb qaateen sugidda amniga maamulka iyo la-dagaallanka argagixisada. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo eedeyntan jeediyay ayaa sheegay in ku biirista PSF ee federaalka aysan ahayn dambi lagu weerari karo. Fiqi ayaa isbitaalka Madiina ee magaalada Muqdisho ku booqday askar ka tirsan ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed oo ku dhaawacmay dagaalkii Gaalkacyo. Wasiirka ayaa xaaladda caafimaad ee askarta dhaawaca ah ka waraystay dhakhaatiirta iyo maamulka Isbitaalka Madiina, isagoo faray in la siiyo daryeel caafimaad oo dhammaystiran, isla markaana si gaar ah loogu dadaalo daaweyntooda iyo soo kabashadooda. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa askarta ku bogaadiyay kaalintii geesinimada iyo naf-hurnimada lahayd ee ay sannado badan ka soo qaateen sugidda amniga Puntland iyo la-dagaallanka kooxaha argagixisada Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish xilligii ay ka tirsanaayeen PSF. Wuxuu xusay in ciidamadani ay muddo dheer u soo adeegayeen difaaca shacabka iyo xasilloonida deegaannada Puntland, isla markaana maanta doortay inay khibraddooda iyo kartidooda ugu adeegaan difaaca iyo amniga guud ee qaranka, ku biiristooda ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeedna aysan ahayn dambi ay ku mutaysteen in la weeraro. “Ku biirista ciidanka xoogga waa xaq qaran oo ay leeyihiin muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee jeclaada inay dalkooda u adeegaan, isla markaana aan loo fasiran karin tallaabo liddi ku ah cid gaar ah,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Fiqi. Sidoo kale wuxuu caddeeyay in ciidanka xoogga dalka uusan colaad la lahayn shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo maamullada dalka ka jira, balse cadawgoodu yahay kooxaha argagixisada iyo cid kasta oo khatar ku ah amniga, madaxbannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiggu ayaa adkaysay in ciidanka xoogga uu yahay ciidan qaran oo u taagan difaaca dalka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, ilaalinta madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed iyo sugidda amniga qaranka meel kasta oo ka mid ah Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Wuxuu xusay in ciidamadani ay muddo dheer u soo adeegayeen difaaca shacabka iyo xasilloonida deegaannada Puntland, isla markaana maanta doortay inay khibraddooda iyo kartidooda ugu adeegaan difaaca iyo amniga guud ee qaranka, ku biiristooda ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeedna aysan ahayn dambi ay ku mutaysteen in la weeraro. “Ku biirista ciidanka xoogga waa xaq qaran oo ay leeyihiin muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee jeclaada inay dalkooda u adeegaan, isla markaana aan loo fasiran karin tallaabo liddi ku ah cid gaar ah,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Fiqi. Sidoo kale wuxuu caddeeyay in ciidanka xoogga dalka uusan colaad la lahayn shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo maamullada dalka ka jira, balse cadawgoodu yahay kooxaha argagixisada iyo cid kasta oo khatar ku ah amniga, madaxbannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiggu ayaa adkaysay in ciidanka xoogga uu yahay ciidan qaran oo u taagan difaaca dalka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, ilaalinta madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed iyo sugidda amniga qaranka meel kasta oo ka mid ah Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. items.title: Itoobiya oo Buur Xakaba ka Baxaysa
items.description: Itoobiya (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa shaacisay in ay ciidamadeeda kala baxayso magaalada Buur Xakaba ee gobolka Bay, halkaas oo ay ku sugnaayeen muddo 12-kii sano ee la soo dhaafay. Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer ciidamada ka joogay magaalada Buur Xakaba, kuwaas oo door weyn ka qaatay sugidda amniga iyo ka hortagga weerarrada kooxaha argagixisada. Magaalada ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh amniga iyo isku socodka gobolka Bay. Buur Xakaba ayaa muddo dheer si weyn ugu tiirsaneyd joogitaanka ciidamada Itoobiya, iyadoo Itoobiya ay kamid ahayd dhinacyadii ugu muhiimsanaa ee amniga magaalada gacanta ku hayay. Ka bixitaanka ciidamada Itoobiya ayaa dhalinaya su’aalo ku saabsan cidda la wareegi doonta amniga magaalada iyo saameynta ay tallaabadan ku yeelan karto xaaladda amni ee gobolka Bay. items.title: Turkey’s ally wins Somalia speaker vote, opposition objects
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s parliament handed its most powerful gavel to a man widely regarded as Ankara’s foremost asset in Mogadishu on Monday, electing Minister of Ports and Maritime Transport Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur as speaker of the House of the People in a vote the opposition immediately branded illegal. Nur, known across Somali political circles simply as Jama, won by a commanding 142 votes to 30 against his sole remaining challenger, lawmaker Abdulkadir Omar Moallin, with two ballots declared spoiled. The scale of the victory owed as much to the field he did not have to face as to the one he did: critics say the candidates capable of mounting a genuine contest were squeezed out of the race well before lawmakers cast a single vote, under pressure traced back to the presidential palace. He inherits the chamber from Sheikh Adan Mohamed Nur Madobe, who vacated the speakership in June after his own election as president of South West State — a contest opposition figures likewise describe as choreographed rather than contested, its result settled before voters were ever consulted. “No mandate to sit, let alone choose a speaker” For the Somali Future Council, an opposition-aligned bloc, the deeper objection is constitutional, not personal. The council argues that parliament’s term lapsed on April 14 and that the body has since been operating without lawful authority — a defect it says renders Monday’s proceedings void from the outset. “The manner in which President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has manipulated this so-called election reveals precisely how he intends to conduct the forthcoming parliamentary and presidential elections: total control of the electoral process in his own hands, the elimination of any candidate capable of mounting a genuine challenge, and outcomes determined well before a single vote is cast,” the council said in a statement. It went further, framing Monday’s vote not as an isolated procedural lapse but as a dress rehearsal. “Somalia’s electoral disputes cannot be resolved through unilateral measures, abuse of power, or processes whose outcomes are settled in advance. The only path back to constitutional legitimacy and political trust is an inclusive agreement – one that provides the foundation for elections whose process and outcome all parties can genuinely trust,” the statement said, calling instead for an inclusive political settlement as the only credible foundation for elections whose process and outcome can be trusted. The making of “Turkey’s man” Nur’s résumé reads as a case study in continuity through two successive administrations — justice, then defence, then ports, an unbroken run through some of the government’s most consequential portfolios. Analysts trace that durability to a single, decisive source of patronage: Ankara. “Long-serving cabinet minister in strategic dockets — defence, ports — educated in Turkey and fluent in Turkish, a self-confessed admirer of Turkish imperial Ottoman history, widely regarded as ‘Turkey’s man’ in Somalia,” said Rashid Abdi, a Horn of Africa analyst at Sahan Research. His time at the Ministry of Defence was the most turbulent chapter of that career, coinciding with the 2023 unraveling of the US-backed offensive against Al-Shabaab and with recurring friction between Mogadishu and Washington over the campaign’s direction. Abdi argues that Nur’s elevation now serves two agendas that happen to converge in one appointment. “If Jama takes over the No. 2 most powerful post in the country, he will most certainly serve and advance two powerful converging consolidation imperatives — that of the Turkish state in Somalia and that of President Hassan Sheikh and his contested one-year term extension,” he said. “But more importantly, this will mark another progression in the strategic institutionalisation of Turkish clout and influence in Somalia.” He situates the appointment within a wider pattern rather than treating it as an isolated event, pointing to the recent installation of a young, Turkish-trained officer atop the national army as a parallel signal of intent. “The meteoric rise of Jama and the appointment of a young Turkish-trained officer as Somali army commander are also all signals Ankara is planning for a post-Hassan Sheikh Mohamud landscape, playing the long game and placing its allies in key positions of power and influence,” Abdi said. A widening fault line The consequences, if analysts like Abdi are right, extend well beyond Mogadishu’s parliament chamber. Turkey’s deepening presence across Somalia’s security and political institutions — now spanning both the army’s command structure and the legislature’s presiding office — is likely to register uneasily in Washington and among regional partners including the United Arab Emirates and Israel, each of whom has its own stake in how the Horn of Africa’s balance of power evolves. Inside Somalia, though, the more urgent question is domestic. For an opposition already convinced that this month’s speakership vote was scripted before the first ballot was cast, the real test is what it portends for the presidential and parliamentary elections still to come — and whether Monday’s outcome was less a routine changing of the guard than a preview of how those far higher-stakes contests will be run. items.title: Beesha caalamka oo qaaday tallaabo lama filaan ah, bogaadiyeyna doorashada…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha iyo qaar kamid ah wakiilada caalamka u fadhiya Soomaaliya ayaa kulan muhiim ah ku yeeshay magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoo wakiilada caalamiga bogaadiyeen geedi socodka doorashada qof iyo cod. Kulankan oo ka dhacay xayndaabka garoonka Aadan Cadde ee gudaha Xalane ayaa waxaa ka qeyb-galay safiirro kala socday Mareykanka, Boqortooyada Ingiriiska, Shiinaha, Turkiga, Itoobiya, Kenya, Suudaan iyo Masar. Kulanka ayaa waxaa sidoo kale qeyb ka ahaa xubno ka socday hay’adaha caalamiga sida Qaramada Midoobey, ururka Midowga Afrika iyo ururka iskaashiga Islaamka. Kulanka ayaa waxay wakiilada caalamka warbixin uga dhageysteen guddiga doorashooyinka qaranka, oo ayagu gacanta ku haya hanaanka doorasho ee diidan yihiin mucaaradka. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay guddiga doorashooyinka, wakiilada caalamka ayaa bogaadiyay horumarka laga sameeyay geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka qof iyo cod, oo ay wadaan guddiga doorashooyinka qaranka. “Safiirrada iyo wakiillada beesha caalamka ayaa waxay xaqiijiyeen inay taageerayaan dadaallada lagu xoojinayo hannaan dimuqraadi ah oo awoodda doorashada dib loogu celinayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka guddiga. Sidoo kale, guddiga ayaa sheegay in wakiilada caalamiga ah ee ay la kulmeen ay xaqiijiyeen inay kala shaqeynayaan guddiga hirgelinta doorashooyin loo dhan yahay, hufan oo lagu kalsoonaan karo. Hoos ka aqriso war-saxaafadeedka guddiga Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Madax-banaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha Mudane Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan, oo ay waheliyaaan Komishanar Cabdi Cadow, Komishanar Maxamed Amiiin Xasan iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee Guddiga Xuseen Nuunow Cali ayaa kulan xogsiin ah la qaatay xubnaha beesha calamka. Kulankan xogsiinta ah ayaa waxaa goobjoog ka ahaa safiirada wadamada Mareykanka, Boqortooyada Ingiriiska, Shiinaha, Turkey, Ethopia, Kenya, Sudan iyo Masar, sidoo kale Xubno ka socday hay’adaha caalamiga sida Qaramada Midoobey, Ururka Midowga Afrika, Ururka Iskaashi Islaamka ayaa looga hadlay ariimaha Doorashooyinka. Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Mudane Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan ugu horreyn khudbad ka jeediyay kulanka ayaa ka warbixiyay waxyaabaha u qobsoomay Guddiga madaxa-banaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha oo ay ugu muhiimsanaayeen Doorashooyinki Golaha Deegaanka ee ka qabsoomay Gobolka Banaadir, iyo Doorshooyinkii isku-sidkanaa ee Golaha Degeenka iyo Golaha Wakiilada ee ka qabsoomay Dawlad Goboleedyada Koonfur Galbeed, Galmudug iyo Doorashooyinka isku-sidkan ee qorsheysan inay ka qabsoomaan Dawlad Goboleedka Hirshabeelle. Gudoomiyah ayaa sheegay in Geedi-socodka Doorashada qof iyo Cod uu si wanagaasan dalka uga hirgalay islamarkaan dadka Soomaaliyeed ay fursad u heleen kudhawaad muddo kusiman 57 sano inay dootaan wakiiladooda kumatalayo siyaasada heerarkeda kala duwan. Safiirrada iyo wakiillada beesha caalamka oo iyaguna dhankooda su’aalo iyo hadalo kajeediyay kulanka ayaa soo dhaweeyay horumarka laga sameeyay geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka qof iyo cod. Waxay sidoo kale xaqiijiyeen inay taageerayaan dadaallada lagu xoojinayo hannaan dimuqraadi ah oo awoodda doorashada dib loogu celinayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isla markaana ay Guddiga kala shaqeynayaan hirgelinta doorashooyin loo dhan yahay, hufan oo lagu kalsoonaan karo. items.title: Sawirro: Xamza oo maanta Muqdisho ka furay shirka…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa si rasmi ah u furay Shirweynaha Qaran ee Maalgashiga Beeraha iyo Nidaamka Cuntada Soomaaliyeed (NAFIS 2026). Shirweynahan ayaa diirradda lagu saaraya xoojinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha, horumarinta beeraha iyo kobcinta maalgashiga. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xamza ayaa sheegay in qabashada shirweynaha NAFIS 2026 uu xambaarsan yahay farriin muhiim ah oo muujinaysa jihada cusub ee hoggaanka qaranka, kaasi oo salka ku haya qorshaha isbeddelka qaranka (NTP) iyo dadaallada lagu horumarinayo dhaqaalaha, laguna kordhinayo wax-soo-saarka iyo abuurista fursadaha maalgashiga ee dhinacyada Beeraha. Xamza ayaa xusay in Soomaaliya ay leedahay fursado waaweyn oo dhanka wax-soo-saarka cuntada, oo ay saldhig u yihiin dhulkeenna ballaaran ee ku habboon beeraha, khayraadka biyaha iyo awoodda bulshada Soomaaliyeed oo xilligan u diyaarsan in ay gaaraan isku filnaansho dhanka cuntada ah. “Waxaan hubaa in maalgashiga Beeraha iyo Nidaamka cuntada uu muhiim u yahay dalkeenna iyo guud ahaan Geeska Afrika. Wax-soo-soo saarka dalkeennu waxa uu kor u qaadaya dhaqaalaha dalka,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray “Waxa uu kobcinayaa kaabeyaasha horumarineed ee gobolka, waxa uunna fursad siinayaa dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed, waanna billowga dakhliga iyo xaqiijinta isku-filnaanshaha cuntada dalka.” Ugu dambeyntiina, ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa ka dhawaajiyay in aysan Soomaaliya sidii hore ahayn oo isbeddel lagu sameeyay qorshayaasha qaranka, sidaas darteedna hay’adaha ka howlgala dalkeenna ay taas ogaadaan, ayna muhiim tahay in ay ula shaqeeyaan dowladda sida ay u horumartay, ayna u dajisay qorshayaasha lagu tagayeynayo dowladnimada, kuwaas oo ka tarjumaya Soomaaliyada cusub. Xamza ayaa xusay in Soomaaliya ay leedahay fursado waaweyn oo dhanka wax-soo-saarka cuntada, oo ay saldhig u yihiin dhulkeenna ballaaran ee ku habboon beeraha, khayraadka biyaha iyo awoodda bulshada Soomaaliyeed oo xilligan u diyaarsan in ay gaaraan isku filnaansho dhanka cuntada ah. “Waxaan hubaa in maalgashiga Beeraha iyo Nidaamka cuntada uu muhiim u yahay dalkeenna iyo guud ahaan Geeska Afrika. Wax-soo-soo saarka dalkeennu waxa uu kor u qaadaya dhaqaalaha dalka,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray “Waxa uu kobcinayaa kaabeyaasha horumarineed ee gobolka, waxa uunna fursad siinayaa dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed, waanna billowga dakhliga iyo xaqiijinta isku-filnaanshaha cuntada dalka.” Ugu dambeyntiina, ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa ka dhawaajiyay in aysan Soomaaliya sidii hore ahayn oo isbeddel lagu sameeyay qorshayaasha qaranka, sidaas darteedna hay’adaha ka howlgala dalkeenna ay taas ogaadaan, ayna muhiim tahay in ay ula shaqeeyaan dowladda sida ay u horumartay, ayna u dajisay qorshayaasha lagu tagayeynayo dowladnimada, kuwaas oo ka tarjumaya Soomaaliyada cusub.
