In the middle of this uncertainty, one question has become unavoidable: if there is no political agreement and no agreed timetable for a new Parliament, should the existing House of the People simply abandon its chamber and leave the country without a functioning legislature? That is the dilemma facing Somalia. The 11th Parliament’s mandate expired on April 14, 2026. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s mandate subsequently expired on May 15. Yet neither a new Parliament nor a new president has emerged because the country’s political leadership remains locked in negotiations over the electoral and constitutional arrangements that will determine the next phase of the transition. International partners have repeatedly encouraged the government and opposition to reach a compromise. Meeting after meeting has been convened. Statements have been issued. Political delegations have traveled, consulted, and negotiated. But the fundamental disagreement remains unresolved.There is still no political settlement capable of providing Somalia with a universally accepted electoral roadmap. So What Was Parliament Supposed to Do? The question becomes particularly important when viewed against the circumstances surrounding the vacant speakership. Former Speaker Sheikh Aden Mohamed Nur (Aden Madoobe) left the position after being elected President of Southwest State. His departure created a vacancy at the top of the House of the People at precisely the moment when Somalia’s constitutional order was already under extraordinary pressure. Rather than leaving the institution without a permanent presiding officer, the 11th Parliament proceeded to elect a new Speaker. Abdulqadir Mohamed Nur Jama, a relatively young but experienced Somali political figure, emerged as the winner. Jama brings considerable experience in Somalia’s political, legal, security, and administrative affairs. He has previously served as Minister of Justice, Minister of Defense, and Minister of Ports and Transport, and has also served as Deputy Commander of the National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA) and as a senior adviser to Speaker Mohamed Mursal Sheikh Abdirahman during the 10th Parliament. Should the House of the People simply close its doors indefinitely? Should MPs abandon their institutional responsibilities while politicians negotiate without a deadline? Should Somalia deliberately create a legislative vacuum while waiting for rival political camps to agree on an electoral formula? They go to the heart of Somalia’s institutional survival. The President’s mandate has expired. The Parliament’s mandate has expired. The electoral process remains disputed. The constitutional framework itself is contested. And the opposition and government have yet to agree on the mechanism through which political authority should transition. Under such circumstances, there is a legitimate distinction between constitutional legitimacy and institutional continuity. The fact that Somalia has not yet agreed on the next political arrangement does not necessarily mean that every existing state institution should cease functioning overnight. Indeed, doing so could create a far more dangerous situation. A functioning legislature—even one operating under a contested transitional arrangement—may provide a degree of institutional continuity that is preferable to an empty Parliament and an expanding political vacuum. The alternative could be political paralysis without any institutional mechanism capable of managing it. The opposition has not yet produced a universally accepted mechanism through which the country can move from the expired 11th Parliament to a legitimate 12th Parliament while negotiations continue. That is the uncomfortable reality.  It is easy to say that Parliament should not elect a Speaker. It is considerably harder to explain what should replace the institution while the government and opposition remain unable to agree. Somalia cannot be governed indefinitely through political objections alone. At some point, every political actor must present a workable pathway through the crisis. items.title: The New Strategic Triangle: Why Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan Are Changing the Region’s Security Calculus
items.description: By Abdikarim H. Abdi Buh The most important thing about the new security partnership involving Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan may not be what the three countries have promised each other. It may be what their potential adversaries now have to calculate. The signing of a trilateral defense and security agreement in Mecca marks a potentially important moment in the evolution of the Middle East and South Asian security order. On paper, it is a framework for cooperation in defense, intelligence, military training, technology, maritime security and the defense industry. But geopolitics is rarely about the words on a document alone. It is about what those words make possible. Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan are three very different powers with distinct foreign-policy priorities. Yet they also possess something increasingly valuable in an unstable world: complementary strategic capabilities. Turkey brings a sophisticated and rapidly expanding defense industry, extensive military experience and a growing ability to produce drones, armored vehicles, naval platforms, missiles and other advanced systems. Saudi Arabia brings financial power, energy resources and extraordinary geographic importance. Sitting at the crossroads of the Gulf, the Red Sea and major global energy routes, Riyadh occupies territory that is central to the security of the international economy. Pakistan brings decades of military experience, an established defense industry, access to the Arabian Sea and a nuclear deterrent. Its border with Iran adds another layer of strategic significance. Individually, these capabilities matter. Together, they could create leverage. From Dependence to Strategic Options For decades, much of the security architecture of the Middle East has depended heavily on external powers, particularly the United States and its military presence in the region. That model is not necessarily disappearing. But it is changing. Regional powers are increasingly seeking multiple strategic relationships rather than relying entirely on a single security guarantor. Saudi Arabia’s expanding defense cooperation with Turkey and Pakistan should therefore not automatically be interpreted as an anti-American move. It may be something more pragmatic. Strategic insurance. Riyadh can maintain its relationship with Washington while simultaneously developing new defense partnerships. Turkey can remain a NATO member while expanding its strategic relationships beyond the Western alliance. Pakistan can deepen cooperation with Gulf powers while preserving its own independent strategic calculations. The message is not necessarily that the old alliances are ending. It is that new options are being added. And in geopolitics, options are power. Iran Will Notice the Geography The agreement does not need to name Iran as an adversary to have consequences for Tehran. Geography does much of the talking. Saudi Arabia and Iran face each other across the Gulf. Pakistan shares a land border with Iran. Turkey sits at the intersection of Europe, the Middle East and Eurasia and possesses one of the region’s most capable indigenous defense industries. Recent confrontations involving Iran and Israel have already demonstrated how quickly regional instability can threaten energy infrastructure, maritime routes and international commerce. The Strait of Hormuz remains one of the world’s most sensitive strategic chokepoints. Any prolonged disruption could reverberate through global energy markets. Against this backdrop, deeper military coordination among Ankara, Riyadh and Islamabad inevitably changes the strategic equation. Tehran does not necessarily have to believe that these three countries are preparing for war. It only has to recognize that there are now more variables to consider. And that is where deterrence begins. The question confronting any potential adversary becomes increasingly complicated: If I escalate, what happens next? If the answer becomes harder to predict, the cost of escalation rises. A Signature Is Not an Alliance There is, however, a danger in exaggerating the significance of the agreement. A signature does not create an alliance. Implementation does. The real test will come in the months and years ahead. Will the three countries conduct meaningful joint military exercises? Will intelligence-sharing mechanisms become institutionalized? Will they cooperate on air and missile defense? Will their militaries develop greater interoperability? Will defense companies establish joint production and technology partnerships? Will maritime-security cooperation move beyond political declarations? If the answer to these questions is yes, the agreement could evolve into something far more consequential than a diplomatic statement. It could become security infrastructure. That distinction matters. Many international agreements look impressive when they are signed and far less impressive once the cameras disappear. The credibility of this partnership will ultimately be determined by capabilities, institutions and sustained cooperation—not ceremonies. Not an “Islamic NATO” It may be tempting to describe the arrangement as an emerging “Islamic NATO.” That would probably be misleading. NATO is a formal collective-defense alliance with deeply integrated institutions and treaty-based commitments. Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan have different foreign policies, different strategic priorities and different relationships with major global powers. They do not need to become a single bloc. Their cooperation may actually be more effective if it remains flexible. They can work together where their interests overlap while maintaining independent foreign policies elsewhere. Counterterrorism, maritime security, military technology, intelligence, training, defense production and protection of strategic trade routes are obvious areas of convergence. The emerging model is therefore less about creating a single geopolitical camp and more about creating a network of strategic options. That may be more consistent with modern geopolitics. Washington Should Pay Attention For the United States, this development presents both an opportunity and a challenge. A stronger regional capacity for counterterrorism, maritime security and defense cooperation could reduce the burden on American forces and allow Washington to share more responsibility with capable regional partners. But greater strategic autonomy also means that regional states will increasingly make decisions based on their own calculations rather than waiting for Washington to provide every answer. That is not necessarily bad for the United States. In fact, a region capable of taking greater responsibility for its own security could ultimately serve American interests. The challenge for Washington will be maintaining influence without assuming that influence must mean control. China Has an Interest Too China will also be watching closely. Beijing does not need to join the partnership to be affected by it. China has enormous interests in Gulf energy supplies, Red Sea shipping, South Asian trade and infrastructure connectivity. Greater regional stability could serve Chinese economic interests. But if this partnership develops into a sophisticated security network, it could also contribute to a broader transformation of the regional balance of power. China’s response may therefore be carefully calibrated: supportive of stability, attentive to energy security and cautious about any development that could intensify great-power competition. The Real Test Will Come During the Next Crisis Ultimately, the significance of this agreement will not be determined in Mecca. It will be determined during the next serious regional crisis. Imagine a major confrontation involving missile attacks, drone strikes, terrorism or disruption of maritime trade. An adversary would then have to ask: What will Saudi Arabia do? What role could Pakistan play? How might Turkey respond? Would intelligence be shared? Would military assistance follow? Could the crisis spread? And, most importantly, could it still be contained? That uncertainty can itself become a strategic asset. Deterrence does not always require the immediate threat of war. Sometimes it works by convincing an adversary that the consequences of escalation are too uncertain, too costly or too difficult to control. Three Countries, Three Strengths The emerging strategic triangle is therefore worth watching closely. Saudi Arabia brings capital, energy resources and Gulf geography. Turkey brings defense technology, military expertise and an increasingly powerful indigenous arms industry. Pakistan brings military experience, strategic geography and nuclear deterrence. Three countries. Three different strengths. One emerging calculation. Separately, they possess important capabilities. Connected through sustained cooperation, those capabilities could become strategic leverage. But there is another possibility. The agreement could remain largely symbolic—a diplomatic expression of shared interests without developing into a genuine security mechanism. History provides plenty of examples of ambitious agreements that never moved beyond paper. That is why the next stage matters more than the signing ceremony. If joint exercises, intelligence cooperation, defense production, maritime coordination and interoperable military capabilities become reality, the partnership will have crossed an important threshold. It will no longer simply be an agreement. It will be a network. And if that network works, an adversary may no longer be calculating against one country. It may have to calculate against three. That is the deeper significance of the emerging partnership. For years, the question across parts of the region has been: Who will protect us?  A new question is now taking shape: Can we build enough strategic capacity to protect ourselves? The answer will not be found in the language of the agreement. It will be found in the first crisis that tests it. That is when the world will discover whether Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan have merely signed a document—or whether they have begun building a new security architecture capable of changing the regional balance of power. Abdikarim H. items.title: Daawo: Deni oo Gaalkacyo ka furay mashruuc si weyn loo sugayay
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Dowlad-goboleedka Puntland, Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u daah-furay mashruuca biyo-saarka magaalada Gaalkacyo oo ah mashruuc muhiim ah oo muddo dheer ay baahi weyn u qabtay bulshada Gaalkacyo. Mashruucan ayaa loogu talagalay in xal waara looga gaaro dhibaatooyinka ay biyuhu ku hayaan magaalada Gaalkacyo, gaar ahaan xilliyada roobabka, waxaana maalgelintiisa iska kaashanaya maamulka Puntland, qurbo-joogta iyo bulshada ku nool gudaha dalka. Waxaa lagu qiyaasayaa in wejiga koowaad ee mashruuca ay ku baxayso lacag dhan 3 milyan oo dollar, iyadoo maamulka Puntland uu ballanqaaday inuu bixinayp hal milyan oo dollar, halka dhaqaalaha intiisa kale laga filayo bulshada, ganacsatada, shirkadaha waddaniga ah iyo qurbo-joogta reer Puntland. Munaasabadda daah-furka mashruuca oo uu soo qaban-qaabiyey guddiga horumarinta magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa lagu soo bandhigay qorshaha guud ee mashruuca, halka ay marayaan diyaar-garowgiisa iyo tallaabooyinka loo marayo hirgelintiisa. Guddigu wuxuu sheegay in dhowaan si rasmi ah loo xayeysiin doono qandaraaska mashruuca, kaas oo loogu tartamidoono hab daah-furan oo waafaqsan hannaanka loo dejiyey. Sidoo kale guddigu wuxuu soo bandhigay caqabadaha la xiriira biyo-saarka magaalada iyo qorshaha looga gudbi karo. Waxaa madasha lagu soo bandhigay saamaynta ay biyuhu ku yeesheen nolosha bulshada, bilicda magaalada, isu-socodka iyo deegaanka, iyadoo isbeddelka cimiladu uu sii kordhiyey baahida loo qabo in Gaalkacyo hesho hannaan casri ah oo lagu maareeyo biyaha. Intii ay munaasabaddu socotay, qaar ka mid ah shirkadaha waddaniga ah ayaa si toos ah lacag ugu shubay akoonka guddiga mashruuca, waxaana sidoo kale la soo bandhigay shaqsiyaad iyo masuuliyiin hore uga qayb qaatay taageerada mashruuca oo ay ku jiraan wasiiro iyo xildhibaanno. Madaxweynaha ayaa boggaadiyey shaqooyinka hordhaca ah ee guddigu qabtay, wuxuuna cod dheer ku sheegay in maamulkiisu doonayo Gaalkacyo qurxoon, nadiif ah oo ammaan ah. Sidoo kale wuxuu bulshada Gaalkacyo ugu baaqay inay baneeyaan dhulka iyo marinnada dabiiciga ah ee biyuhu maraan, gaar ahaan goobaha laga dhistay dhismayaasha xannibaya socodka biyaha, iyadoo laamaha amnigana la faray in ay arrintaasi kala shaqeeyaan guddiga. Ugu dambeyntiina, Deni ayaa uga mahadceliyey injineerrada, guddiga horumarinta magaalada Gaalkacyo, masuuliyiinta, ganacsatada, qurbo-joogta iyo dhammaan bulshada qaybta ka qaadatay qorshaynta iyo hirgelinta mashruucan. Si kastaba, waxaa mashruuca biyo-saarka Gaalkacyo laga filayaa inuu wax weyn ka beddelo bilicda, nadaafadda, caafimaadka deegaanka iyo isu-socodka magaalada, isla markaana uu qayb muhiim ah ka noqdo horumarinta mustaqbalka Gaalkacyo. items.fullContent: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Dowlad-goboleedka Puntland, Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u daah-furay mashruuca biyo-saarka magaalada Gaalkacyo oo ah mashruuc muhiim ah oo muddo dheer ay baahi weyn u qabtay bulshada Gaalkacyo. Mashruucan ayaa loogu talagalay in xal waara looga gaaro dhibaatooyinka ay biyuhu ku hayaan magaalada Gaalkacyo, gaar ahaan xilliyada roobabka, waxaana maalgelintiisa iska kaashanaya maamulka Puntland, qurbo-joogta iyo bulshada ku nool gudaha dalka. Waxaa lagu qiyaasayaa in wejiga koowaad ee mashruuca ay ku baxayso lacag dhan 3 milyan oo dollar, iyadoo maamulka Puntland uu ballanqaaday inuu bixinayp hal milyan oo dollar, halka dhaqaalaha intiisa kale laga filayo bulshada, ganacsatada, shirkadaha waddaniga ah iyo qurbo-joogta reer Puntland. Munaasabadda daah-furka mashruuca oo uu soo qaban-qaabiyey guddiga horumarinta magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa lagu soo bandhigay qorshaha guud ee mashruuca, halka ay marayaan diyaar-garowgiisa iyo tallaabooyinka loo marayo hirgelintiisa. Guddigu wuxuu sheegay in dhowaan si rasmi ah loo xayeysiin doono qandaraaska mashruuca, kaas oo loogu tartamidoono hab daah-furan oo waafaqsan hannaanka loo dejiyey. Sidoo kale guddigu wuxuu soo bandhigay caqabadaha la xiriira biyo-saarka magaalada iyo qorshaha looga gudbi karo. Waxaa madasha lagu soo bandhigay saamaynta ay biyuhu ku yeesheen nolosha bulshada, bilicda magaalada, isu-socodka iyo deegaanka, iyadoo isbeddelka cimiladu uu sii kordhiyey baahida loo qabo in Gaalkacyo hesho hannaan casri ah oo lagu maareeyo biyaha. Intii ay munaasabaddu socotay, qaar ka mid ah shirkadaha waddaniga ah ayaa si toos ah lacag ugu shubay akoonka guddiga mashruuca, waxaana sidoo kale la soo bandhigay shaqsiyaad iyo masuuliyiin hore uga qayb qaatay taageerada mashruuca oo ay ku jiraan wasiiro iyo xildhibaanno. Madaxweynaha ayaa boggaadiyey shaqooyinka hordhaca ah ee guddigu qabtay, wuxuuna cod dheer ku sheegay in maamulkiisu doonayo Gaalkacyo qurxoon, nadiif ah oo ammaan ah. Sidoo kale wuxuu bulshada Gaalkacyo ugu baaqay inay baneeyaan dhulka iyo marinnada dabiiciga ah ee biyuhu maraan, gaar ahaan goobaha laga dhistay dhismayaasha xannibaya socodka biyaha, iyadoo laamaha amnigana la faray in ay arrintaasi kala shaqeeyaan guddiga. Ugu dambeyntiina, Deni ayaa uga mahadceliyey injineerrada, guddiga horumarinta magaalada Gaalkacyo, masuuliyiinta, ganacsatada, qurbo-joogta iyo dhammaan bulshada qaybta ka qaadatay qorshaynta iyo hirgelinta mashruucan. Si kastaba, waxaa mashruuca biyo-saarka Gaalkacyo laga filayaa inuu wax weyn ka beddelo bilicda, nadaafadda, caafimaadka deegaanka iyo isu-socodka magaalada, isla markaana uu qayb muhiim ah ka noqdo horumarinta mustaqbalka Gaalkacyo. items.title: UN Puts Somalia Mission Assets Up For Sale As US Funding Cutoff Looms
items.description: Mogadishu, Somalia — The United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS) has opened a tender seeking licensed auctioneers to sell off a wide range of its vehicles, generators and other equipment in Somalia, a notice published on the UN Global Marketplace shows. The call for expressions of interest, issued August 6, comes as Washington moves to cut off funding for the UN’s logistical support mission by the end of 2026, deepening uncertainty over the future of international backing for Somalia’s fight against al-Shabab. The tender matters now because it lands at the center of a widening rift between the United States and the United Nations over how and whether, to keep supporting Somalia’s security transition. UNSOS underpins the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), supplying transport, fuel, food and other non-lethal supplies to roughly 12,000 African troops and police fighting a resilient insurgency. Any wind-down of that support network would strike at the core of the mission’s ability to operate. Under the terms of the tender, UNSOS is looking to establish a local contract for the “commercial sale” of UN-owned property. The initial deal would run three months, with up to three additional three-month extensions depending on performance and operational need. The list of items up for sale is extensive: vehicles, generators, computers and IT equipment, office equipment, shipping containers, security watchtowers, wastewater treatment plants, prefabricated accommodation materials, medical and laboratory equipment, electrical appliances and heavy construction machinery. UNSOS said the list is indicative and may grow. Interested firms have a narrow window to respond, with registration required by August 11 — just five days after the notice was published. Civil society analysts in Mogadishu have indicated that the auction notice does not lay out a clear mechanism for independent oversight, warning that disposing of mission assets without transparency could weaken public trust and open the door to diversion of state property. The auction notice does not link the sale to the funding dispute. But it follows a July 1 letter in which the United States cited concerns over Somalia’s performance against al-Shabab and its handling of security and governance issues, and comes as Washington has pushed back against extending UN logistical support for AUSSOM beyond current arrangements. Somalia has fought al-Shabab for nearly two decades, and the group still holds sway over parts of the country. Leaders of AUSSOM troop-contributing nations have warned that a premature drawdown in support could open a security vacuum. items.title: International Community Receives Update on Somalia’s Elections
items.description: The Chairman of the National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission, Mr. Abdikarin Ahmed Hassan, along with Commissioners Abdi Cadow, Mohamed Amin Hassan, and Secretary General Hussein Nunow Ali, held a briefing session with members of the international community in Mogadishu. The meeting was attended by ambassadors from the United States, the United Kingdom, China, Turkey, Ethiopia, Kenya, Sudan and Egypt, as well as representatives from the United Nations, the African Union, and the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation. The briefing is significant as it demonstrates the Commission’s commitment to transparency and its efforts to keep international partners informed on the progress of the electoral process. Chairman Abdikarin Ahmed Hassan provided a detailed update on the electoral milestones achieved so far, including the successful conclusion of the District Council elections in Banadir Region, the simultaneous elections for District and Regional Councils in South West State and Galmudug, and the upcoming elections planned for Hirshabelle State. The Chairman noted that the one-person-one-vote electoral process has been implemented successfully across the country, and that the Somali people have, for the first time in nearly 57 years, had the opportunity to elect their representatives at various levels of government. He reiterated the Commission’s commitment to ensuring that the process remains inclusive, transparent, and credible. Ambassadors and international representatives welcomed the progress made in the electoral process and reaffirmed their support for the Commission’s efforts to strengthen democratic governance in Somalia. They also confirmed their continued cooperation in ensuring the successful implementation of future elections. The post International Community Receives Update on Somalia’s Elections first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Mucaaradka oo si adag uga horyimid doorashada Jaamac
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa si adag uga horyimid doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), iyagoo cambaareeyay wixii maanta ka dhacay xarunta baarlamaanka. Golaha ayaa sheegay in muddo-xileedkii dastuuriga ahaa ee baarlamaanka Soomaaliya uu ku ekaa 14-kii April 2026, sidaas darteedna uusan laheyn wax sharciyad dastuur iyo mid siyaasadeed oo uu ku dooran karo hoggaamiye cusub. “Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed (GMS) wuxuu si adag u cambaaraynayaa, una diiddan yahay doorasho-ku-sheegga Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee muddo-xileedkiisu dhammaaday,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed. Golahan oo ay ku mideysan yihiin qaar kamid ah hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka iyo madaxda Puntland iyo Jubaland ayaa sidoo kale Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku eedeeyay inuu doonayo in uu gacanta ku dhigo hannaanka doorashada, uuna hor istaago tartamayaasha awoodda leh, isla markaana uu natiijada horay u sii jaan-gooyo. Golaha ayaa mar kale adkeeyay in khilaafka doorashooyinka Soomaaliya aan lagu xallin karin tallaabooyin hal dhinac ah, ku-takrifal awoodeed iyo hannaan natiijadiisa horay loo sii go’aamiyey. “Jidka keliya ee lagu soo celin karo sharcinimada dastuuriga ah iyo kalsoonida siyaasadeed waa heshiis loo dhan yahay oo saldhig u noqda doorasho heshiis lagu yahay, laguna kalsoonaan karo hannaankeeda iyo natiijadeeda,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed. Hoos ka aqriso war-saxaafadeedka Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed (GMS) wuxuu si adag u cambaaraynayaa, una diiddan yahay doorasho-ku-sheegga Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee muddo-xileedkiisu dhammaaday. Muddo-xileedkii dastuuriga ahaa ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya wuxuu ku ekaa 14-kii Abriil 2026, sidaa darteed Baarlamaanku ma lahan sharciyad dastuur iyo mid siyaasadeed oo uu ku dooran karo guddoomiye cusub, mana yeelan karo awood muddo kordhin. Haddii uu Madaxweyneha muddo-xileedkiisu dhammaaday ugu tafaralay doorasho-ku-sheeggaan wuxuu tusaale cad u yahay qorshaha uu doonayo in uu ku maareeyo doorashooyinka soo socda ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka iyo Madaxweyneha, taasoo uu doonayo in uu gacanta ku dhigo hannaanka doorashada, hor istaago tartamayaasha awoodda leh, natiijadana horay loo sii jaan-gooyo. Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed wuxuu mar kale adkaynayaa in khilaafka doorashooyinka Soomaaliya aan lagu xallin karin tallaabooyin hal dhinac ah, ku-takrifal awoodeed iyo hannaan natiijadiisa horay loo sii go’aamiyey. Jidka keliya ee lagu soo celin karo sharcinimada dastuuriga ah iyo kalsoonida siyaasadeed waa heshiis loo dhan yahay oo saldhig u noqda doorasho heshiis lagu yahay, laguna kalsoonaan karo hannaankeeda iyo natiijadeeda. Muddo-xileed dhammaaday ma dhalin karo muddo-xileed cusub; doorasho la boobayna ma dhalin karto sharciyad. -Dhammaad- The post Mucaaradka oo si adag uga horyimid doorashada Jaamac appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur elected speaker of Somali parliament
items.description: The Somali parliament on Monday elected Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur, a lawmaker who completed his higher education in Türkiye, as its new speaker. Nur, who was the ports and transport minister, received 142 votes, defeating Abdulkadir Omar Maolim, who got 30. The lower house of parliament has 275 members. He took the oath of office after the vote. Nur, an influential politician in the country for nearly a decade, studied international relations at Ankara University’s Faculty of Political Sciences from 2012 to 2016, where he completed his bachelor’s degree. He also worked at Somalia’s embassy in the Turkish capital. Constitutionally, the speaker is considered the second-most powerful leader in the Horn of Africa country, after the president. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud congratulated the new speaker, urging him to lead the house in accordance with the Constitution. He reassured the speaker of his and the executive branch’s full support. Anadolu .

items.title: Somalia Elects New Speaker Amid Disputes
items.description: MOGADISHU (Raxanreeb Online) – Somali lawmakers have elected Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur (Jaamac) as the new Speaker of the House of the People of the Federal Parliament of Somalia following an election held in Mogadishu. Jaamac defeated fellow lawmaker Abdulkadir Omar Moallin (Daada), who was the other candidate contesting the position. First Deputy Speaker Saadia announced that Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur received 142 votes, while Abdulkadir Omar Moallin secured 30 votes, confirming Jaamac’s election as the new Speaker of the House of the People. Before his election as Speaker, Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur served as a member of the House of the People and as Somalia’s Minister of Ports and Marine Transport. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud congratulated the newly elected Speaker, saying his victory reflected the confidence placed in him by members of the House of the People. The President wished the new Speaker success in carrying out his constitutional responsibilities and urged him to lead the House with transparency, responsibility and commitment to the national interest. President Mohamud also highlighted the important role of the House of the People in Somalia’s state-building process, particularly in legislation, representing citizens and strengthening accountability among government institutions. He called on the new Speaker to lead Parliament in accordance with the Constitution and to prioritise national unity, consultation and the broader interests of the Somali people. items.title: Israa’iil oo sheegtay in ay xoojinayso xulafo cusub oo ay qeyb ka tahay Somaliland
items.description: Tel Aviv (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Arrimaha Qurba-joogta Israa’iil, Amichai Chikli ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu u baahan yahay inuu sii xoojiyo xiriirka uu la leeyahay xulafada ay ka mid yihiin Somaliland, Giriigga, Qubrus iyo Imaaraadka Carabta, xilli ay sii kordhayaan walaacyada Israa’iil ee isbeddellada cusub ee dhinaca amniga iyo difaaca ee Bariga Dhexe. Sida ay baahisay Clash Report, Chikli ayaa si gaar ah u xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in Israa’iil ay sii qoto-dheereyso xiriirrada ay la leedahay maamulka Somaliland, Giriigga, Qubrus iyo Imaaraadka Carabta. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale walaac xooggan ka muujiyay waxa uu ku tilmaamay “horumar aad khatar u ah oo walaac leh” oo ka dhashay Isbahaysiga Makka, kaas oo ay dhowaan wada saxiixdeen Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Chikli ayaa sheegay in Sacuudiga uu horey heshiis difaac ula lahaa Pakistan, balse uu walaac gaar ah ka qabo xiriirka sii xoogeysanaya ee Riyaad iyo Ankara, isaga oo Turkiga ku eedeeyay inuu hadda si toos ah uga soo horjeedo Israa’iil. “Isbahaysiga Makka waa horumar aad khatar u ah oo aad u walaac badan,” ayuu yiri Chikli. Tallaabada Sacuudiga ugu sii dhowaanayo Turkiga ayuu sheegay inay yeelan karto cawaaqib culus oo dhinaca amniga iyo siyaasadda ah, gaar ahaan marka la eego xaaladaha ka jira Badda Mediterranean-ka iyo jiidda Suuriya. Hadalladan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiriirka u dhexeeya Israa’iil iyo Turkiga uu muddooyinkii dambe si weyn u xumaaday, iyadoo labada dal ay isku hayaan arrimo la xiriira siyaasadda gobolka, amniga iyo xaaladda Bariga Dhexe. Walaaca Tel Aviv ayaa sidoo kale imanaya iyadoo Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay xoojinayaan iskaashigooda dhinaca difaaca, taas oo Israa’iil u aragto isbeddel cusub oo saameyn ku yeelan kara isu-dheellitirka awoodaha gobolka. Si kastaba, xaaladda cusub ayaa Israa’iil ku qasbeysa inay sii xoojiso iskaashiga ay la leedahay dhinacyada ay u aragto xulafada muhiimka ah, kuwaas oo ay kamid yihiin maamulka Somaliland, Giriigga, Qubrus iyo Imaaraadka Carabta, sida uu sheegay Chikli. The post Israa’iil oo sheegtay in ay xoojinayso xulafo cusub oo ay qeyb ka tahay Somaliland appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Deadly Missile and Drone Strike Hits Yemen’s Al-Makha Port, Raising Fresh Alarm Over Red Sea Security
items.description: Al-Makha, Yemen (WDN) — At least seven people have reportedly been killed and dozens wounded after a missile and drone attack struck the western Yemeni port city of Al-Makha, or Mocha, in an assault that has renewed fears over the security of one of the world’s most strategically important maritime corridors. Initial reports put the number of wounded at around 35, although casualty figures remain fluid. The Associated Press separately reported that at least 15 civilians were wounded in the attack. The Houthi movement has claimed responsibility for the strike, which reportedly targeted the port and surrounding areas controlled by forces aligned with Yemen’s internationally recognized government. Witnesses and local reports described multiple explosions in and around the port as missiles and unmanned aerial vehicles were used in the attack. Several facilities and sections of port infrastructure were reportedly damaged, although the full extent of the destruction remains unclear. The attack sent residents scrambling for safety as emergency workers transported the wounded to medical facilities. The incident has also raised immediate concerns about the potential impact on commercial activity at the port and the movement of essential goods through the area. A Strike with Regional Consequences The significance of the attack extends far beyond the immediate casualties and damage. Al-Makha sits on Yemen’s western coast, close to the Bab al-Mandab Strait, the narrow maritime gateway linking the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden. The waterway is a critical artery for international trade, connecting shipping routes between Asia, the Middle East and Europe. Any sustained deterioration in security around Al-Makha or Bab al-Mandab could therefore have consequences far beyond Yemen’s borders. The Red Sea has already become one of the world’s most closely watched maritime security zones following repeated attacks on commercial shipping and escalating regional tensions. Further attacks near major ports could increase insurance costs, disrupt shipping schedules and encourage more vessels to take longer routes around the African continent. For a country already devastated by years of war and economic collapse, damage to critical port infrastructure could be particularly severe. Yemen depends heavily on its ports for the importation of food, fuel, medicine and other essential commodities. Any prolonged disruption could therefore compound the humanitarian and economic pressures facing millions of Yemenis. Houthis Claim Responsibility The Houthis have acknowledged responsibility for the attack, placing it within a broader pattern of missile and drone operations conducted by the movement in Yemen and around the Red Sea. The group has repeatedly used missiles and drones against what it describes as military, commercial or strategic targets linked to its regional adversaries. Its attacks have transformed the Red Sea into a major theater of the wider Middle Eastern security crisis. The latest strike demonstrates that despite a reduction in some large-scale ground fighting inside Yemen compared with the most intense years of the conflict, the Houthis retain significant capabilities to launch long-range missile and drone attacks. That capability remains a major concern for Yemen’s internationally recognized government, its regional partners and international shipping interests. The Bab al-Mandab Factor The location of the attack is particularly significant. Bab al-Mandab is one of the world’s most important maritime chokepoints. Thousands of commercial vessels pass through the broader Red Sea corridor, carrying energy supplies, manufactured goods and other commodities between major global markets. When security risks increase, shipping companies can reroute vessels around the Cape of Good Hope. But that alternative comes at a price: longer voyages, higher fuel consumption, increased insurance premiums and rising transportation costs. The consequences can eventually reach consumers far from the battlefield. For that reason, every major attack around Yemen’s western coastline is closely monitored by governments, militaries and shipping companies around the world. The Al-Makha attack comes amid renewed regional tensions and a broader escalation involving the Houthis and their opponents. Reuters also reported that the Houthis carried out a drone attack targeting a facility associated with Saudi Aramco in Jizan, adding to concerns that the geographic scope of the confrontation could widen. The combination of attacks on Yemeni infrastructure and targets beyond Yemen’s borders raises the possibility that regional rivalries could once again spill directly into critical maritime and energy corridors. That prospect is particularly concerning given the proximity of Al-Makha to Bab al-Mandab. Yemen has endured political fragmentation and armed conflict since the Houthis seized control of Sanaa in 2014. The movement controls the capital and large parts of northern and western Yemen, while the internationally recognized government and allied forces control other parts of the country. Although the intensity of ground warfare has declined from the worst periods of the conflict, the latest missile and drone attacks demonstrate that the war’s most dangerous dimensions have not disappeared. The Houthis retain the ability to rapidly escalate tensions through attacks that can have consequences well beyond the battlefield. For Yemen’s civilian population, the danger is immediate. For the international community, the concern is broader: the possibility that another cycle of escalation could once again threaten one of the world’s most important trade routes. What Comes Next The full human and material toll of the Al-Makha attack remains unclear. Authorities are expected to provide further information on the casualties, the identities of those killed and wounded, and the extent of damage to the port. The response from Yemen’s government and its allies will also be closely watched. For now, however, the attack serves as a stark reminder that Yemen’s conflict remains capable of producing sudden and devastating violence—and that events on its western coastline can quickly become a global security concern. What happens around Al-Makha may ultimately matter far beyond Yemen. Just offshore lies Bab al-Mandab, a narrow passage through which the world’s economy moves. And when that passage becomes a battlefield, the consequences are rarely confined to the countries at war. items.title: Hantidhawrka Guud oo Soo Saaray Warbixinta Baarista Dowladda ee 2025
items.description: Xafiiska Hantidhawraha Guud ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo si sanadle ah u soo saara warbixinnada baarista hay’adaha dowladda iyo shirkadaha ay leedahay ama qayb ku leedahay dowladda ayaa maanta soo saaray warbixintii baarista uu sameeyay sanadkii 2025. Baarista uu xafiisku sameeyo ayaa kala ah baarista maaliyadeed, baarista u hoggaansanaanta sharciga, baarista waxqabadka, baarista nidaamyada macluumaadka teknoolojiyadda, dib-u-eegista deeqaha dowladda iyo baarista gaarka ah. BAARISTA MAALIYADDA Xafiiska Hantidhawraha Guud wuxuu baaris ku sameeyay 30 mashruuc oo ay maalgeliyeen hay’ado caalami ah, kuwaas oo 22 ka mid ah ay maalgelisay Bangiga Adduunka, 7 ay maalgelisay Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika, halka hal mashruuc uu maalgeliyay Sanduuqa Caalamiga ah. Baaristu waxay diiradda saartay maamulka maaliyadda, habraacyada iyo hannaanka iibka, u hoggaansanaanta sharciga, u hoggaansanaanta heshiisyada maalgelinta iyo fulinta mashaariicda. Natiijada baarista ayaa muujisay in loo baahan yahay in la xoojiyo habraacyada bixinta qandaraasyada. Baarista warbixinta maaliyadeed ee sanadlaha ah waxay ku saabsanayd lacagaha ay qabatay dowladda, lacagaha ay kharash-gareysay, qulqulka lacagaha iyo is-barbardhigga miisaaniyadda iyo waxa la qabtay. Natiijada baaristu waxay muujisay in miisaaniyaddii iyo xisaabaadka kale ay is waafaqeen, isla markaana aysan jirin wax cillad ah. Faallada Hantidhawraha ee warbixinta maaliyadeed waxay ahayd “Unqualified”. Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay heshiis dheef-wadaag ah kula jirtaa shirkadaha maamula garoonka iyo dekadda Muqdisho. Shirkadda Favori oo dowladda ku leh saamiga 25% ayaa dowladda ka heshay lacag dhan $4,153,948, halka shirkadda Al-Bayrak oo dowladda ku leh saamiga 62.17% ay dowladda ka heshay lacag dhan $38,081,786. Wadarta guud ee lacagta ay dowladda ka heshay labada heshiis waxay noqotay $42,235,734. Natiijada baaristu waxay muujisay in aan la helin warbixinta maaliyadeed ee shirkadda Al-Bayrak, sidaas darteedna aan la xaqiijin karin saxnaanta dakhliga la sheegay. Marka laga hadlayo isku-xirnaanta nidaamka dakhliga iyo nidaamka maareynta maaliyadda, baaristu waxay ogaatay in todobo nidaam aysan ku xirnayn SFMIS. Nidaamyadaas waxaa ka mid ah Nidaamka Diiwaangelinta Ganacsiga Soomaaliya, Nidaamka Maamulka Canshuuraha Elektarooniga ah, Nidaamka Canshuurta Waddo-marista, Nidaamka Canshuurta Dakhliga Kirada, E-Visa, Nidaamka Elektarooniga ah ee Dakhliga aan Canshuurta ahayn iyo Nidaamka Aruurinta Dakhliga ee DFS. Isku-xirnaan la’aanta nidaamyadan waxay keeni kartaa khatar dhinaca kala duwanaanshaha xogta ah iyo dib u dhac ku yimaada diiwaangelinta dakhliga. BAARISTA U HOGGAANSANAANTA SHARCIGA Baarista u hoggaansanaanta sharciga waa baaris lagu xaqiijinayo in hay’adaha dowladda ay u hoggaansameen sharciga iyo habraacyada loo dejiyay. Baaristan waxaa lagu sameeyay 22 hay’adood oo miisaaniyaddoodu ahayd $821,996,254, taas oo ka ahayd 60.1% miisaaniyadda guud ee dowladda. Baaristu waxay ku qotontay iibka, maamulka shaqaalaha iyo maamulka ilaalinta gudaha, waxaana laga helay 66 khalad. Dhanka iibka, 59% hay’adihii la baaray ma aysan raacin habraacyada magacaabista guddiyada qandaraasyada sannadlaha ah, iyadoo hay’adahaasi ay fuliyeen iib dhan $18,554,459. Sidoo kale, 53% hay’adaha la baaray ma aysan raacin habraacyada xulashada adeeg-bixiyeyaasha iyo la-taliyeyaasha. Dhanka maamulka shaqaalaha, 46% hay’adihii la baaray ma aysan dhisin guddiyada dallacsiinta iyo anshaxa. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu ogaaday in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ay dirtay 14 diblomaasi oo aan marin shuruudihii loo baahnaa, halka 19 shaqaale oo aan qaadan tababar diblomaasiyadeed la shaqaaleysiiyay. Baaristu waxay sidoo kale muujisay in 50% hay’adihii baarista maray aysan hawlgelin baarayaasha gudaha. Arrimaha kale ee baaristu taabatay waxaa ka mid ahaa diiwaangelinta gaadiidka, heshiisyada dheef-wadaagga, diiwaangelinta hantida, deeqaha dibadda iyo maamulka iyo maareynta masaajidda. BAARISTA WAXQABADKA Baarista waxqabadka waxay taabatay arrimo ay ka mid yihiin waxbarasho tayo leh, duulista rayidka, ku filnaanshaha lacagta caddaanka ah ee qoysaska nugul iyo dib-u-eegista heshiiska dhismaha cusub ee Wasaaradda Awqaafta. BAARISTA NIDAAMYADA MACLUUMAADKA TEKNOLOJIYADDA Xafiiska Hantidhawraha Guud wuxuu sameeyay baaris cusub oo lagu sameeyay Nidaamka Macluumaadka Maareynta Waxbarashada Sare (HEMIS) iyo Nidaamka Macluumaadka Kheyraadka Aadanaha ee Shaqaalaha Rayidka. Waxaa sidoo kale dabagal lagu sameeyay SFMIS iyo Nidaamka Diiwaangelinta Ganacsiga Soomaaliya. Labada baaris ee cusub waxaa laga helay 59 khalad, kuwaas oo 38 ka mid ah loo aqoonsaday inay yihiin khataro. Sidaa darteed, hay’adaha adeegsada nidaamyadan ayaa si degdeg ah ugu baahan inay xoojiyaan amniga nidaamyadaas isla markaana wax ka qabtaan khaladaadka iyo khataraha la ogaaday. DIB-U-EEGISTA DEEQAHA DOWLADDA EE 2024 IYO 2025 Sanadkii 2024, dowladda Soomaaliya waxay heshay 3,125,402 shixnadood oo agab caafimaad ah, 55,324 mitric tan oo raashin ah, 1,207 teendho iyo 105 gaadiid ah. Sanadkii 2025, dowladda waxay heshay 6,000,555 shixnadood oo agab caafimaad ah iyo 9 gaadiid ah. Baarista deeqaha dowladda waxay muujisay in loo baahan yahay in deeqaha si degdeg ah looga diiwaangeliyo SFMIS ka hor inta aan la qaybin. Diiwaangelinta deeqaha ka hor qaybintooda waxay muhiim u tahay xaqiijinta jiritaanka xog sax ah, dabagalka deeqaha iyo xoojinta isla-xisaabtanka maamulka hantida iyo deeqaha dowladda.

Baaristu waxay ku qotontay iibka, maamulka shaqaalaha iyo maamulka ilaalinta gudaha, waxaana laga helay 66 khalad. Dhanka iibka, 59% hay’adihii la baaray ma aysan raacin habraacyada magacaabista guddiyada qandaraasyada sannadlaha ah, iyadoo hay’adahaasi ay fuliyeen iib dhan $18,554,459. Sidoo kale, 53% hay’adaha la baaray ma aysan raacin habraacyada xulashada adeeg-bixiyeyaasha iyo la-taliyeyaasha. Dhanka maamulka shaqaalaha, 46% hay’adihii la baaray ma aysan dhisin guddiyada dallacsiinta iyo anshaxa. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu ogaaday in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ay dirtay 14 diblomaasi oo aan marin shuruudihii loo baahnaa, halka 19 shaqaale oo aan qaadan tababar diblomaasiyadeed la shaqaaleysiiyay. Baaristu waxay sidoo kale muujisay in 50% hay’adihii baarista maray aysan hawlgelin baarayaasha gudaha. Arrimaha kale ee baaristu taabatay waxaa ka mid ahaa diiwaangelinta gaadiidka, heshiisyada dheef-wadaagga, diiwaangelinta hantida, deeqaha dibadda iyo maamulka iyo maareynta masaajidda. BAARISTA WAXQABADKA Baarista waxqabadka waxay taabatay arrimo ay ka mid yihiin waxbarasho tayo leh, duulista rayidka, ku filnaanshaha lacagta caddaanka ah ee qoysaska nugul iyo dib-u-eegista heshiiska dhismaha cusub ee Wasaaradda Awqaafta. BAARISTA NIDAAMYADA MACLUUMAADKA TEKNOLOJIYADDA Xafiiska Hantidhawraha Guud wuxuu sameeyay baaris cusub oo lagu sameeyay Nidaamka Macluumaadka Maareynta Waxbarashada Sare (HEMIS) iyo Nidaamka Macluumaadka Kheyraadka Aadanaha ee Shaqaalaha Rayidka. Waxaa sidoo kale dabagal lagu sameeyay SFMIS iyo Nidaamka Diiwaangelinta Ganacsiga Soomaaliya. Labada baaris ee cusub waxaa laga helay 59 khalad, kuwaas oo 38 ka mid ah loo aqoonsaday inay yihiin khataro. Sidaa darteed, hay’adaha adeegsada nidaamyadan ayaa si degdeg ah ugu baahan inay xoojiyaan amniga nidaamyadaas isla markaana wax ka qabtaan khaladaadka iyo khataraha la ogaaday. DIB-U-EEGISTA DEEQAHA DOWLADDA EE 2024 IYO 2025 Sanadkii 2024, dowladda Soomaaliya waxay heshay 3,125,402 shixnadood oo agab caafimaad ah, 55,324 mitric tan oo raashin ah, 1,207 teendho iyo 105 gaadiid ah. Sanadkii 2025, dowladda waxay heshay 6,000,555 shixnadood oo agab caafimaad ah iyo 9 gaadiid ah. Baarista deeqaha dowladda waxay muujisay in loo baahan yahay in deeqaha si degdeg ah looga diiwaangeliyo SFMIS ka hor inta aan la qaybin. Diiwaangelinta deeqaha ka hor qaybintooda waxay muhiim u tahay xaqiijinta jiritaanka xog sax ah, dabagalka deeqaha iyo xoojinta isla-xisaabtanka maamulka hantida iyo deeqaha dowladda.

items.title: Abdirahman Abdishakur Accuses Hassan Sheikh of Engineering Elections to Produce Predetermined Winners
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Opposition leader Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame has launched a scathing attack on President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s electoral strategy, accusing the Federal Government of attempting to organize elections around predetermined political outcomes rather than allowing voters to freely determine Somalia’s next leadership. Warsame, a prominent figure in the opposition-led Future Council, argued that the government’s current approach reflects a political formula that could be summarized as: “Bring your own decoy candidate.” In a brief statement published on social media, Warsame accused President Hassan Sheikh of seeking to reproduce in other parts of the country what he described as the model used in Baidoa, while simultaneously attempting to influence upcoming elections in Galmudug and Hirshabelle. He also linked the government’s efforts to the planned election of a new Speaker of the House of the People, despite his contention that the current parliament’s constitutional mandate has already expired. According to Warsame, all of these efforts form part of a broader political strategy designed to ensure that the preferred candidates of the incumbent administration emerge victorious. “The election Hassan Sheikh would like to win is the one he conducted in Baidoa, the one he wants to implement in Galmudug and Hirshabelle. Its slogan is: ‘Bring your own decoy candidate.’” Warsame went further, arguing that President Hassan Sheikh’s political project will ultimately fail to secure his continued hold on power.  His greater concern, he said, is what the President will leave behind. “I am not worried about whether he will leave office,” Warsame said in substance. “What concerns me is the damage he has inflicted on the state—damage that will be difficult to repair—and the negative political culture through which he has undermined values, ethics, integrity and humanity.” The remarks reflect a broader argument increasingly advanced by opposition leaders: that Somalia’s current political crisis is not simply a dispute over the next election, but a struggle over the country’s political culture and the credibility of its institutions. Warsame also accused the President of political inconsistency, portraying his administration as one that repeatedly changes its position depending on circumstances. He referred to what he described as a striking contradiction in the President’s political behavior, saying: “You see a person who, as he himself has said, is one person in the morning, another person in the afternoon, and a third person in the evening.” Warsame argued that such political behavior can have consequences that outlast an individual presidency. In his view, political institutions can recover from the departure of a leader, but political norms and public trust are much harder to rebuild once they have been weakened. The Bigger Battle Over Somalia’s Political Future The statement comes as Somalia remains locked in a bitter dispute over elections, constitutional authority, federal-state relations and the future of the country’s political system. The Federal Government has repeatedly defended its electoral agenda as necessary to advance direct elections and strengthen democratic participation. Opposition groups, however, have accused the administration of using state institutions and electoral processes to consolidate political power and influence the outcome of upcoming contests. Warsame’s latest intervention therefore places the dispute in a broader context. For the opposition leader, the central question is not simply who will win the next election, but whether Somalia’s political institutions will be allowed to produce leaders through a genuinely competitive process. The accusation that elections are being designed around expected winners is particularly serious in a country where political legitimacy remains fragile and where disagreements over electoral rules have repeatedly triggered political crises. Ultimately, Warsame’s warning is about what happens after the ballots are counted. A president may leave office, he argues, but the political habits established during that presidency can remain embedded in institutions long after the individual has departed. That, he suggests, is the more enduring danger facing Somalia: not merely the possibility of one political leader staying too long, but the normalization of a political system in which institutions, elections and public offices are perceived as instruments for producing predetermined outcomes. For Somalia, the stakes extend well beyond the next election. The country’s political future may depend on whether competing leaders can restore confidence that elections are contests to determine the will of the people—not mechanisms through which political elites decide the winner before voters ever cast their ballots. items.title: Beesha Caalamka Oo Warbixin Ka Heshay Doorashada Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho – Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madax-banaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha, Mudane Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan, ayaa kulan xogsiin ah la qaatay safiirada iyo wakiillada beesha caalamka isagoo ka warbixiyay horumarka laga gaaray geedi-socodka doorashooyinka qof iyo cod ee dalka ka socda. Kulankan ayaa waxaa goobjoog ka ahaa safiirada dalalka Mareykanka, Ingiriiska, Shiinaha, Turkiga, Itoobiya, Kenya Suudaan iyo Masar, iyo sidoo kale wakiillo ka socday Qaramada Midoobay, Midowga Afrika iyo Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka . Kulankan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu muujinayaa sida Guddigu ula wadaagayo beesha caalamka horumarka doorashooyinka, iyadoo ay jirto taageero caalami ah oo lagu xoojinayo hannaan dimuqraadi ah. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in doorashooyinka Golaha Deegaanka ee Gobolka Banaadir ay si wanaagsan u soo dhameystireen, iyo in doorashooyin isku-sidkan ah ay ka qabsoomeen Gobolada Koonfur Galbeed, Galmudug, iyo in qorshaha Hirshabeelle uu socdo. Guddoomiyaha ayaa xusay in dadka Soomaaliyeed ay fursad u heleen ku dhawaad 57 sano kadib inay doortaan wakiiladooda siyaasadeed, taasoo ah tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo dimuqraadiyadda dalka. Safiirrada iyo wakiillada beesha caalamka ayaa soo dhaweeyay horumarka laga gaaray, waxayna xaqiijiyeen inay taageerayaan dadaallada lagu xoojinayo hannaan dimuqraadi ah oo awoodda doorashada dib loogu celinayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Waxay sidoo kale cadeeyeen inay Guddiga kala shaqeynayaan hirgelinta doorashooyin loo dhan yahay, hufan oo lagu kalsoonaan karo. The post Beesha Caalamka Oo Warbixin Ka Heshay Doorashada Soomaaliya first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Maxay Xasan iyo Xamza ka dhaheen doorashada Jaamac?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa hambalyo u kala diray Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur oo maanta loo doortag hoggaanka golaha. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa Guddoomiyaha cusub ugu hambalyeeyay kalsoonida ay xubnaha Golaha Shacabka ku aamineen, isagoo u rajeeyay in uu si hufan oo masuuliyad leh u guto waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee ka saaran hoggaaminta Golaha, ilaalinta dastuurka, danta guud qaranka iyo matalaadda shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Xasan Sheekh ayaa xusay muhiimadda uu Golaha Shacabku u leeyahay dowlad-dhiska Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan sharci-dejinta, matalaadda shacabka iyo xoojinta isla-xisaabtanka hay’adaha dowladda. Waxa uuna ku boorriyey Guddoomiyaha cusub in uu hoggaamiyo Golaha Shacabka si waafaqsan Dastuurka, isagoo mudnaanta siinaya midnimada, wada-tashiga iyo danta guud ee shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa hambalyo u diray Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Barlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur, oo ku guueleystay in uu sii hoggaamiyo Golaha Shacabka. Xamza ayaa guddoomiyaha cusub ugu hambalyeeyay kalsoonida ay xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka u muujiyeen, isaga oo u rajeeyay in uu si hufan oo xilkasnimo leh u guto waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee loo igmaday, isla markaana uu hormuud ka noqdo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo shaqada iyo doorka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay wada-shaqeynta iyo isku-duubnida dhow ee ka dhexaysa hay’adaha dowladda gaar ahaan Xukuumadda iyo Barlamaanka, taasi oo mudnaan gaar ah siinaysa dardargelinta qorshayaasha Qaranka, si loo xoojiyo dowladnimada, loona gaaro himilooyinka shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Ugu dambayntiina, Xamza ayaa guddoomiyaha cusub u rajeeyay masuuliyad gudasho, isagoo caddeeyay in xukuumadda Dan-Qaran ay diyaar u tahay in ay si dhow ula shaqayso hey’adaha sharci-dajinta dalka, si loo horumariyo shuruucda iyo siyaasadaha muhiimka u ah xasilloonida iyo mustaqbalka Soomaaliya. Jaamac oo isla maanta loo dhaariyay xilka guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa ku soo baxay cod aqlabiyad leh, wuxuuna helay 142 cod, sida ay shaacisay guddoomiye Sacdiya Yaasiin oo ku dhawaaqday natiijada. Musharraxii la tartamayay ee Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Cumar Macallin (Daada) ayaa helay 30-cod, kaas oo malxiis ahaan u galay tartanka. Natiijada doorashadan ayaa horay loo sii ogaa, waxaana la filayay inuu kusoo baxo Jaamac sida dhacday, wuxuuna taageero weyn ka helay Villa Soomaaliya. Guddoomiyaha cusub ayaa beddalay Sheekh Aadan Madoobe oo dhawaan loo doortay Madaxweynaha maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa horay xilal kala duwan soo qabtay, wuxuu hadda ahaa Wasiirka Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda, horayna wuxuu usoo noqday Wasiirka Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Soomaaliya. Jaamac ayaa haatan si rasmi ah ula wareegay guddoonka baarlamaanka oo hadda ku jira kalfadhigiisii 8-aad oo uu dhawaan furay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, kaasi oo doodo badan ay hareeyeen, xilli ay taagan tahay xiisad u dhexeysa Villa Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka, taas oo ka dhalatay hannaanka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka oo ay isku hayaan labada dhinac. items.title: Deni Rules Out Third Term, Putting Puntland’s Constitutional Limits in Sharp Contrast with Mogadishu
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni has delivered an unusually clear message on presidential tenure, declaring that he will not seek a third term and insisting that the next Puntland president must be chosen through a free and timely election. Speaking in Galkayo on Thursday evening, Deni said the Puntland Constitution had allowed him to serve two terms, both of which he had won through elections, and that he would respect the constitutional limit. “The Constitution allowed me to lead Puntland twice, and I was elected both times. I still have two years remaining. Whoever wants the presidency should come forward and compete in a free election held on time. Our party will have a candidate, and we will build that candidate,” Deni said. The declaration effectively removes one of the most persistent questions surrounding Puntland’s political future: whether the incumbent president might seek to extend his tenure beyond the constitutionally permitted two terms. Deni’s statement is significant because speculation had intensified in recent months over the possibility of reopening or amending Puntland’s constitutional framework to allow him to seek another term. Opposition groups had expressed concern that any attempt to alter the constitutional rules governing presidential tenure could pave the way for a third-term bid. By publicly ruling out such a possibility, Deni has sought to close that chapter of the political debate—at least for now. His message was particularly direct: those seeking the presidency should prepare to compete rather than seek changes to the rules governing the contest. That position places constitutional limits and the electoral timetable at the center of Puntland’s political succession. Deni’s declaration also carries significance beyond Puntland. Somalia has entered a period of intense political debate over presidential mandates, constitutional authority and the rules governing the country’s next elections. Against that backdrop, an incumbent regional leader voluntarily declaring that he will not seek a third term presents a markedly different political message. The contrast is especially striking because Puntland has historically portrayed itself as an institutionally distinct and relatively stable component of Somalia’s federal system, where constitutional rules and political succession remain central to its claims of political legitimacy. Deni’s announcement therefore gives his administration an opportunity to argue that political power should ultimately be governed by rules rather than by the ambitions of individual officeholders. items.title: Saciid Deni oo ku dhowaaqay in uusan mar kale is-sharxi doonin balse uu dhisi doono…
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa markii ugu horreysay si cad u sheegay in uusan mar saddexaad isu sharixi doonin xilka madaxweynaha Puntland marka la gaaro doorashada 2029, isaga oo meesha ka saaray hadal-heyn muddooyinkii dambe ka taagneyd qorshihiisa siyaasadeed. Deni, oo la hadlayay dhallinyaro iyo haween ku sugan gobolka Mudug, ayaa sheegay in dastuurka Puntland uu qofka u oggol yahay inuu xilka madaxweynaha qabto laba xilli oo keliya, isaga oo xusay in labadaas xilli la doortay. “Dastuurku laba jeer ayuu ii oggolaaday hoggaanka Puntland, labadii jeerna waa la ii doortay, laba sano ayaa ii hadhay,” ayuu yiri madaxweyne Deni. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in qof kasta oo doonaya inuu hoggaamiyo Puntland uu isu diyaariyo inuu codka shacabka raadsado, isaga oo sheegay in qorshuhu yahay in doorashada soo socota lagu galo nidaam dadweynuhu codkooda si toos ah u dhiibtaan. “Ninka doonaya xilka ha iskeeno doorasho xor ah oo waqtigeeda ku dhacda, xisbigeennuna musharrax ayuu yeelanayaa oo aan dhiseyno,” ayuu yiri. Hadalka Deni ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijinaya in xisbiga talada haya ee Kaah uu musharrax cusub u soo bandhigi doono doorashada madaxtinimada ee 2029, inkasta oo uusan madaxweynuhu sheegin qofka uu taageeri doono ama sida musharraxa xisbiga lagu soo xuli doono. Deni waxaa markii ugu horreysay madaxweynaha Puntland loo doortay 8-dii Janaayo 2019, waxaana 8-dii Janaayo 2024 dib loogu doortay muddo shan sano oo labaad. Sidaas darteed, haddii jadwalka dastuuriga ah la ilaaliyo, muddadiisa labaad waxay ku egtahay Janaayo 2029. Hadal-heyntii qodobka 79-aad Hadalka cusub ayaa imanaya xilli siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka Puntland ay muddo ka digayeen suurta-galnimada in wax laga beddelo qodobka 79-aad ee dastuurka, oo khuseeya muddada xilka madaxweynaha. Arrintaas ayaa si gaar ah u soo xoogeysatay markii maamulka Deni uu bilaabay dib-u-eegis iyo wax-ka-beddel lagu sameynayay qeybo ka mid ah dastuurka Puntland. Hase yeeshee, baarlamaanka Puntland ayaa dhammaadkii bishii July ansixiyay wax-ka-beddello lagu sameeyay dhowr qodob oo dastuurka ka mid ah, iyadoo qodobka 79-aad aan lagu darin qodobbada la beddelay. Xildhibaan ka tirsan baarlamaanka ayaa markaas sheegay in qodobkaas uusan qeyb ka ahayn soo-jeedintii xukuumaddu u gudbisay golaha. Mucaaradka ayaa hore uga cabsi qabay in furitaanka dastuurka loo adeegsan karo in meesha laga saaro ama wax laga beddelo xaddidaadda muddada madaxweynaha, taas oo Deni u furi lahayd waddo uu mar saddexaad ku tartamo. Hadalka madaxweynaha ee hadda ayaa si toos ah uga jawaabaya walaacaas, isaga oo caddeeyay inuu dhammeystiran doono muddada u harsan, balse aanu doonayn inuu mar kale magaca madaxweynaha ku tartamo. Go’aanka Deni ayaa hadda indhaha siyaasadda Puntland u jeedinaya cidda noqon doonta musharraxa xisbiga Kaah iyo sida loo maareyn doono dhaxalka siyaasadeed ee madaxweynaha. Kaah wuxuu noqon doonaa mid ka mid ah xisbiyada doonaya inay sii haystaan awoodda marka Deni meesha ka baxo, waxaana hadalkiisa laga dheehan karaa inuu door muuqda ku yeelan doono dhismaha iyo taageeridda musharraxa xisbiga. Taasi waxay suuragal ka dhigeysaa in loollan gudaha ah uu ka dhex bilowdo siyaasiyiinta Kaah ee doonaya inay helaan taageerada madaxweynaha iyo hoggaanka xisbiga ka hor doorashada 2029. Dhinaca kale, siyaasiyiin mucaarad ah ayaa durba wada dhaq-dhaqaaqyo siyaasadeed, iyadoo tartanka madaxtinimada uu u muuqdo inuu bilaabanayo waqti hore. items.title: Ethiopia withdraws troops from militant-encircled Burhakaba in Somalia as AUSSOM faces mounting crisis
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Ethiopian troops serving under the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) have withdrawn from Burhakaba, a strategic Bay region town ringed on every side by Al-Shabaab, handing security responsibility to the Somali National Army after nearly twelve years in place — a transfer that lands squarely inside the most precarious funding crisis the mission has faced since its founding. AUSSOM said in a statement that it had, with support from the UN Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS), officially handed over the mission’s forward operating base in Burhakaba to the 60th Division of the Somali National Army on 8 August. The base had been held since 2014 by Ethiopian National Defence Forces under AUSSOM’s Sector 3 command. The mission described the handover as a step toward Somalia assuming lead responsibility for its own security, part of a gradual transfer of duties to national forces. Burhakaba sits roughly 185 kilometres northwest of Mogadishu on the road linking the capital to Baidoa, the interim capital of South West State. Every direction out of the district is held by Al-Shabaab, a geography that has fuelled concern the town could fall to the insurgency now that the force that anchored it for over a decade has gone. Somali officials in the region have voiced doubts about whether national forces are yet equipped to hold the line alone, and there is concern that the withdrawal could disrupt supply routes feeding the AUSSOM units that remain. Somali journalists reported on social media that Ethiopian peacekeepers withdrew overnight overnight in the hours following the base handover, with a number of Somali officials said to have accompanied them out of fear of insurgent attack. Somali Guardian has not independently verified these reports. Separate accounts suggest Ethiopian forces intend to vacate several more Bay region towns that are similarly besieged, part of what Radio Dalsan has reported will be a handover of at least three major towns to Somali forces in the coming weeks. The Federal Government of Somalia has asked for a two-year delay to the withdrawal of foreign troops, but the mission’s funding shortfall has made that request increasingly difficult to accommodate. AUSSOM’s current mandate runs out on 31 December 2026, and any extension depends on a UN Security Council decision and on funding that, at present, does not exist. A summit that confirmed the crisis it was meant to resolve The retreat from Burhakaba comes amid a diplomatic reckoning in Kampala. The Second Extraordinary Summit of AUSSOM’s troop-contributing countries and the Federal Government of Somalia convened in Uganda’s capital on 31 July, following the United States Mission to the African Union’s notification to the AU Commission on 1 July that Washington would not support extending UNSOS – the UN-funded logistical backbone of AUSSOM – beyond the mission’s current mandate, which expires at the end of December. Washington indicated it would not object to AUSSOM’s mandate itself being renewed, but that it would oppose any Security Council resolution preserving UNSOS. According to Amani Africa, the Addis Ababa-based think tank that closely tracks the AU Peace and Security Council, the summit’s outcome exposed rather than closed the gap between what AUSSOM needs to function and what troop contributors can currently deliver. Contributing states — Burundi, Djibouti, Egypt, Ethiopia, Kenya and Uganda — endorsed a communiqué calling on the Security Council to extend the mission for 18 to 24 months. But Amani Africa, in an analysis published under the title “With no viable collective plan emerging from the AU and Kampala summit, it falls on each AUSSOM TCC to plan for saving itself individually,” judged that framework unmoored from any financing or logistics plan that actually exists. Uganda’s Chief of Defence Forces used the gathering to press for what he called African-led alternative arrangements to sustain the mission beyond 2026, a proposal Amani Africa noted depends entirely on the United States reversing a decision it has shown no sign of reversing. Absent that reversal, the think tank argued the more honest planning horizon is not 18 to 24 months but a compressed six-to-twelve-month wind-down run alongside a replacement security arrangement, such as bilateral deployments, rather than the longer transition the summit has no visible means of funding. The communiqué did direct troop-contributing countries’ foreign ministers to form a joint task force and pursue a donors’ conference in search of predictable financing — an effort that remains at an early stage. The UN starts selling the furniture A second, quieter signal of the mission’s trajectory emerged this week from UNSOS itself. On 6 August, the UN Support Office in Somalia posted a request for expressions of interest on the UN Global Marketplace, seeking licensed auctioneers to run the commercial sale of a wide inventory of UN-owned property in Somalia — computers, phones and other IT equipment, shipping containers, security watchtowers, wastewater treatment plants, vehicles, generators, prefabricated accommodation units, and medical and laboratory equipment among the items listed. The initial contract would run three months, with three optional three-month extensions. Submissions close on 11 August, a strikingly narrow five-day window that has itself drawn comment among observers watching the mission’s finances unravel. It is not yet clear whether the pace of the Ethiopian drawdown in Bay region is calibrated, at least in part, to pressure Washington into reconsidering before December. Analysts who track the mission say that if Al-Shabaab is seen visibly reclaiming towns across southern and central Somalia as international forces pull back, the Trump administration could find itself pulled toward the deeper involvement it has so far tried to avoid. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: China’s “Administrative Measures” at Scarborough Reef
items.description: China’s “Administrative Measures” at Scarborough Reef Press Statement Thomas “Tommy” Pigott, Spokesperson The United States rejects China’s ongoing attempts to enforce its destabilizing “national nature reserve” at Scarborough Reef and deny Filipino fishermen access to their traditional fishing ground as reflected in the 2016 Arbitral Award. This is yet another unilateral attempt by China to use dubious environmental and legal pretexts, backed by coercion, to advance its sweeping territorial and maritime claims in the South China Sea at the expense of its neighbors. The United States stands with our Ally, the Philippines, in support of a free and open Indo-Pacific.

items.title: Beesha Caalamka oo Taageertay Geeddi-socodka Doorashooyinka Qof iyo Cod ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa kulan xog-isdhaafsi ah la yeeshay safiirrada iyo wakiillada beesha caalamka, iyadoo diiradda lagu saaray horumarka laga sameeyay geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka qof iyo cod ee Soomaaliya. Kulanka waxaa hoggaaminayay Guddoomiyaha Guddiga, Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan, waxaana ka qeyb galay Komishanarrada Cabdi Cadow iyo Maxamed Amiin Xasan, iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee Guddiga Xuseen Nuunow Cali. Waxaa kulanka sidoo kale goobjoog ka ahaa safiirrada Mareykanka, Boqortooyada Ingiriiska, Shiinaha, Türkiye, Itoobiya, Kenya, Suudaan iyo Masar, iyo wakiillo ka socday Qaramada Midoobay, Midowga Afrika iyo Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga ayaa ka warbixiyay waxqabadka iyo hawlaha doorasho ee dalka ka qabsoomay, gaar ahaan doorashooyinkii Golaha Deegaanka ee Gobolka Banaadir, iyo doorashooyinkii isku sidkan ee Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada ee ka dhacay dowlad-goboleedyada Koonfur Galbeed iyo Galmudug. Sidoo kale, waxaa laga hadlay doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee qorshuhu yahay inay ka dhacaan Hirshabeelle. Guddoomiye Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan ayaa sheegay in geeddi-socodka qof iyo cod uu si wanaagsan uga hirgalay dalka, isagoo xusay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay heleen fursad ay muddo ku dhow 57 sano kaddib si toos ah ugu doortaan wakiilladooda siyaasadeed ee heerarka kala duwan. Dhinaca kale, safiirrada iyo wakiillada beesha caalamka ayaa soo dhaweeyay horumarka laga sameeyay geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka qof iyo cod. Waxay sidoo kale caddeeyeen inay taageerayaan dadaallada lagu xoojinayo hannaanka dimuqraadiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo sidii awoodda doorashada loogu celin lahaa shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Beesha caalamka ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inay diyaar u tahay inay Guddiga kala shaqeyso hirgelinta doorashooyin loo dhan yahay, hufan oo lagu kalsoonaan karo.

items.title: Hanti-dhowrka oo ku dheggan wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hantidhowrka Guud ee Qaranka Axmed Ciise Guutaale oo maanta soo bandhigay baaris sannadeed uu sameeyay xafiiskiisa ayaa eedeymo culus u jeediyay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha kale oo ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Ugu horreyn Hantidhowrka ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in baarista lagu sameeyay 22 xarumo dowladeed iyo 32 mashruuc oo ka socda dalka, isaga oo sheegay in baarista lagu ogaaday in ay jiraan 66 khaladaad, oo uu kusoo bandhigay warbixintiisa. Guutaale ayaa sidoo kale xusay in miisaaniyadda hay’adaha la baaray ay u dhiganto 60.1% iyada oo lacagtaas ay tahay $821,996,254, halka wadarta miisaaniyadda dowladdu tahay $1,359,714,328. Sidoo kale, 59% hay’adaha maray baarista wuxuu sheegay in aysan raacin habraacyada guddiyada qandaraasyada iyo qorshaha iibka, halka 53% hay’adaha maray baarista xafiiska Hantidhowrka la shaaciyay in aysan marin habraacyada xulashada adeeg-bixiyeyaasha iyo la-taliyeyaasha. Halka 46% hay’adaha maray baaristan aanay dhisin guddiyada dallacsiinta, abaalmarinta iyo anshaxa. Waxaa kale oo uu Hantidhowrku xusay in 50% hay’adaha maray baaristooda sannadlaha ah aanay howlgelin baaraha gudaha ah, taas oo muujisay in ay jiraan gaabisyo ka jiro dhanka diiwaangelinta gaadidika heshiisyada dheef wadaagga ah. Dhinaca kale, waxaa warbixinta baarista lagu soo bandhigay eedeymo culus oo toos ugu socdo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Soomaaliya oo lagu sheegay inay diblumaasiyiin aan marin shuruucdii loo baahnaa iyo shaqaale aan qaadan tababarka diblumaasiyadda u dirtay dalka dibaddiisa, kuwaas oo howlgalay. “Wasaaradda arrimaha dibaddu waxa ay dibadda u dirtay 14 diblumaasi iyada oo aan si buuxda loo raacin shuruudii looga baahnaa, halka 19 shaqaale aysan qaadan tababarka diblumaasiyadda kahor inta aysan howlgelin,” ayuu yiri Hantidhowrku. Ugu dambeyn, Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee Qaranka ayaa sheegay in uu talooyin ku saabsan khataraha iyo sida looga hortagi karo uu siiyay maamulka hay’adaha ku shaqada leh baaristan, sida lagu xusay warbixinta uu soo saaray. The post Hanti-dhowrka oo ku dheggan wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: There’s Something in Your Fingers That You Don’t Know
items.description: Have you ever noticed the tiny hairs on your fingers? These fine, almost invisible strands grow on the surface of your fingers and thumbs, but most people go their entire lives without ever realizing they exist. They are much shorter and thinner than the hair on other parts of the body, making them easy to miss under normal lighting. Under bright light, however, you may spot tiny, delicate hairs growing along your fingers. They don’t look the same on everyone for some people, they’re barely visible, while for others, they’re surprisingly noticeable. You may even notice that some fingers have several tiny hairs while other areas look completely smooth. This variation is simply part of the natural diversity of the human body. Interestingly, scientists are not entirely sure why these tiny hairs exist. They are thought to have some sensory function, possibly helping the skin detect subtle movements, vibrations, or light touches. But their exact purpose remains a topic of ongoing research. What’s amusing is that we use our fingers constantly to touch, grip, type, write, and feel different textures yet most of us go years without ever noticing these tiny hairs. Now that you’ve read this, there’s a good chance you’re going to look at your fingers a little differently. Go ahead. Take a closer look. The post There’s Something in Your Fingers That You Don’t Know first appeared on Radio Dalsan .
