items.title: How Guinea-Bissau’s planned recognition of Somaliland fell apart
items.description: In the final week of July, reports circulated that Somaliland was close to securing a second formal recognition, this time from an African country, following that of Israel in late December. Guinea-Bissau was said to be preparing to recognize the self-declared republic, a move that would have made it the first African country to do so. Somaliland has sought official recognition for more than three decades. It declared its independence from Somalia in 1991 after the collapse of the country’s central government and the outbreak of a civil war that has now entered its fourth decade. Since then, it has pursued international recognition, setting itself apart from Somalia’s federal member states. Such a move would have marked a departure from the longstanding position of the African Union and its member states, which have generally avoided decisions that affect the borders of fellow African states. The closest Somaliland came was in early 2024, when it signed a memorandum of understanding with Ethiopia that would have granted Addis Ababa access to a 20-km stretch of the breakaway state’s coastline under a long-term lease. Then-Somaliland President Muse Bihi Abdi said the agreement was expected to pave the way for Ethiopian recognition. However, the deal failed to deliver the outcome Somaliland had envisaged after Addis Ababa and Mogadishu reached an agreement in Turkey, culminating in what became known as the Ankara Declaration. The speculation around the second recognition, however, subsided after Guinea-Bissau’s Foreign Ministry issued a statement on July 26 denying the reports. The ministry said the West African state had “neither taken nor is considering any decision” to recognize Somaliland. Mada Masr has followed the reports and has spoken with senior officials familiar with the matter to establish whether diplomatic contacts took place between the two sides. Speaking on condition of anonymity, two senior Somaliland officials familiar with the matter confirm to Mada Masr that Guinea-Bissau’s discussions with Somaliland representatives over possible diplomatic recognition collapsed after a last-minute intervention by Somalia’s federal government and several allied countries. Ministerial-level contacts between Guinea-Bissau and Somaliland officials had been underway for some time, a senior Somaliland official tells Mada Masr. The official declined to say when discussions began or provide a precise timeline. According to the official, three senior Somaliland representatives, including the foreign minister, traveled by private jet to Guinea-Bissau for meetings with senior government officials. The source describes the initial talks as “successful” and says the delegation left the meetings optimistic that recognition was imminent. The president of Somaliland, Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi, known locally as Irro, was awaiting an official declaration and expected a confirmation call from Bissau, the official says. But before that communication took place, Somalia intervened with support from Turkey, Egypt and Saudi Arabia, according to the source. The talks subsequently unraveled, the official says. A senior Somali official involved in the diplomatic response confirms to Mada Masr that Somalia had received information that a high-level Somaliland delegation was in Guinea-Bissau. The Somali official says Mogadishu contacted Guinea-Bissau’s foreign minister after learning of the visit. According to the source, the Guinea-Bissau side denied that Somaliland officials were in the country and said Bissau had no intention of recognizing the territory. The Somali official also says Somaliland representatives had lobbied Eswatini, South Sudan and other countries for recognition around the same time. Somalia responded through diplomatic efforts coordinated with what the source calls “friendly countries,” adding that those efforts had so far contained the recognition campaign. According to the same source, the Somaliland lobbying effort is being supported and spearheaded by the United Arab Emirates and Israel. The latter offered Somaliland a diplomatic breakthrough. But despite initial expectations that other states would follow suit, the move has failed to deliver the outcome the leaders had hoped for. In a July 29 interview with Universal TV, a local media outlet, Somali State Foreign Minister Ali Mohamed Omar said Mogadishu had been able to dissuade six countries from following Israel’s lead. Without naming the countries, he said Somalia had sent letters to their governments urging them not to recognize Hargeisa. Ali expressed confidence that no African country or major international power would take such a step, but says Israel had lobbied several smaller countries. Guinea-Bissau was not the first West African country Somaliland had approached. In 2019, Muse made an official state visit to Conakry, prompting Somalia to sever diplomatic ties with Guinea. An analyst who closely followed the episode tells Mada Masr that, around the same time, officials in Hargeisa had also reached out to Bissau. Although those efforts by Somaliland did not lead to recognition, Irro has repeatedly said that several countries are considering recognizing the territory. In November, Irro sent letters to more than 190 United Nations member states, urging them to recognize Somaliland. Speaking during the celebration of June 26, the anniversary of the former British Somaliland protectorate’s independence in 1960, Irro acknowledged the limited response his diplomatic appeal has received. Of the 193 countries that received the letter, he said, only two, Denmark and Israel, had replied. However, the diplomatic efforts of the Irro administration have intensified since Israel became the first country to recognize Somaliland in December. Since then, the relationship between Hargeisa and Tel Aviv has moved at speed and in full view. Before recognition, however, the relationship had largely remained behind closed doors. Irro made a secret visit to Israel in October, two months before recognition was officially announced. During a meeting with Irro, Israel’s Defence Minister Israel Katz said the relationship had been developing for years. Israel then appointed Michael Lotem as its non-resident ambassador to Somaliland and Hargeisa appointed Mohamed Hagi, its former ambassador to Taiwan, as its emissary to Tel Aviv. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu also extended an official state visit invitation to President Irro. Irro made that visit in June. Over the course of the two-week visit in Israel, he met senior officials, including the president and Israel’s far-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich, and signed a strategic declaration of cooperation with Netanyahu. Having secured recognition for Somaliland, relations between Hargeisa and Tel Aviv enjoyed overwhelming support within Somaliland and across the political spectrum. However, speculation as to how exactly Somaliland was able to secure Tel Avis’s recognition and at what cost has drawn some criticism, especially over the lack of a clear account from the government in Hargeisa. Muse, who remains a powerful figure in Somaliland politics, has called on the government to release the terms of its agreement with Israel. In his first remarks on the issue during a video message in February, Muse discussed Turkey’s and Egypt’s responses to Israel’s recognition of Somaliland and accused Ankara of undermining talks between Somalia and Somaliland. However, his central demand was directed at the government in Hargeisa. “The government has not yet disclosed what we agreed with Israel, and it is expected to do so,” Muse said in an interview with local media. “If the agreement violates Somaliland laws, harms Muslims, causes suffering to other Muslim people, or is not an agreement between equal parties, it will be discussed.” Muse returned to the issue in June in a social media post that drew broad attention. He called for an assessment of the agreements, the changes taking place around Somaliland, and the risks they might pose to its national interest. “It is essential to thoroughly assess the implications and likely outcomes of the agreements and the changes unfolding now in order to avoid political uncertainty,” he wrote. “The state … must therefore carefully examine the potential impact of these global developments, so as to avoid a political miscalculation.” Another issue that has raised concern in Somaliland over the Hargeisa-Tel Aviv relationship is the decision to base Somaliland’s diplomatic mission in the contested city of Jerusalem. The government has faced criticism over the decision, with the main opposition parties rejecting the office’s proposed location. However, Irro defended his government’s decision while speaking at a meeting of the ruling party’s Central Committee, saying the office was located in West Jerusalem, which falls within Israel’s regionally and internationally recognized borders. The president’s explanation did not satisfy the opposition, who, despite supporting the mutual recognition between Israel and Somaliland, drew a clear distinction between establishing diplomatic ties and locating Somaliland’s office in Jerusalem. Mahmoud Hashi Abdi, the chai of the Kaah Party, told local media that his party had initially sought clarification about the nature of Somaliland’s relationship with Israel. It also asked whether the president had made any specific commitments to Israel and whether any agreements were currently under negotiation. According to Mahmoud, during a meeting with the three national political parties, the president assured them “there are no conditions and no agreements that we will enter into until we are in a stronger position.” “The Kaah Party rejects and opposes the opening of a Somaliland office in the holy city of Jerusalem,” Mahmoud says, explaining his party’s position. “We are unequivocally against it.” The relationship between Israel and Somaliland, as well as Hargeisa’s diplomatic manoeuvres, has irked Mogadishu. Since December, Somalia’s government has sought support from Muslim-majority countries and key regional allies in a diplomatic campaign aimed at containing the recognition and discouraging other countries from recognising Somaliland. Two Egyptian officials tell Mada Masr that Egypt is working with Saudi Arabia to reach out to other African countries with a simple message: if secession is tolerated with Somaliland, it will not be the only case. “Clearly this is something that will resonate with every African leader, especially those in East Africa,” one of the officials says. Madamasr

An analyst who closely followed the episode tells Mada Masr that, around the same time, officials in Hargeisa had also reached out to Bissau. Although those efforts by Somaliland did not lead to recognition, Irro has repeatedly said that several countries are considering recognizing the territory. In November, Irro sent letters to more than 190 United Nations member states, urging them to recognize Somaliland. Speaking during the celebration of June 26, the anniversary of the former British Somaliland protectorate’s independence in 1960, Irro acknowledged the limited response his diplomatic appeal has received. Of the 193 countries that received the letter, he said, only two, Denmark and Israel, had replied. However, the diplomatic efforts of the Irro administration have intensified since Israel became the first country to recognize Somaliland in December. Since then, the relationship between Hargeisa and Tel Aviv has moved at speed and in full view. Before recognition, however, the relationship had largely remained behind closed doors. Irro made a secret visit to Israel in October, two months before recognition was officially announced. During a meeting with Irro, Israel’s Defence Minister Israel Katz said the relationship had been developing for years. Israel then appointed Michael Lotem as its non-resident ambassador to Somaliland and Hargeisa appointed Mohamed Hagi, its former ambassador to Taiwan, as its emissary to Tel Aviv. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu also extended an official state visit invitation to President Irro. Irro made that visit in June. Over the course of the two-week visit in Israel, he met senior officials, including the president and Israel’s far-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich, and signed a strategic declaration of cooperation with Netanyahu. Having secured recognition for Somaliland, relations between Hargeisa and Tel Aviv enjoyed overwhelming support within Somaliland and across the political spectrum. However, speculation as to how exactly Somaliland was able to secure Tel Avis’s recognition and at what cost has drawn some criticism, especially over the lack of a clear account from the government in Hargeisa. Muse, who remains a powerful figure in Somaliland politics, has called on the government to release the terms of its agreement with Israel. In his first remarks on the issue during a video message in February, Muse discussed Turkey’s and Egypt’s responses to Israel’s recognition of Somaliland and accused Ankara of undermining talks between Somalia and Somaliland. However, his central demand was directed at the government in Hargeisa. “The government has not yet disclosed what we agreed with Israel, and it is expected to do so,” Muse said in an interview with local media. “If the agreement violates Somaliland laws, harms Muslims, causes suffering to other Muslim people, or is not an agreement between equal parties, it will be discussed.” Muse returned to the issue in June in a social media post that drew broad attention. He called for an assessment of the agreements, the changes taking place around Somaliland, and the risks they might pose to its national interest. “It is essential to thoroughly assess the implications and likely outcomes of the agreements and the changes unfolding now in order to avoid political uncertainty,” he wrote. “The state … must therefore carefully examine the potential impact of these global developments, so as to avoid a political miscalculation.” Another issue that has raised concern in Somaliland over the Hargeisa-Tel Aviv relationship is the decision to base Somaliland’s diplomatic mission in the contested city of Jerusalem. The government has faced criticism over the decision, with the main opposition parties rejecting the office’s proposed location. However, Irro defended his government’s decision while speaking at a meeting of the ruling party’s Central Committee, saying the office was located in West Jerusalem, which falls within Israel’s regionally and internationally recognized borders. The president’s explanation did not satisfy the opposition, who, despite supporting the mutual recognition between Israel and Somaliland, drew a clear distinction between establishing diplomatic ties and locating Somaliland’s office in Jerusalem. Mahmoud Hashi Abdi, the chai of the Kaah Party, told local media that his party had initially sought clarification about the nature of Somaliland’s relationship with Israel. It also asked whether the president had made any specific commitments to Israel and whether any agreements were currently under negotiation. According to Mahmoud, during a meeting with the three national political parties, the president assured them “there are no conditions and no agreements that we will enter into until we are in a stronger position.” “The Kaah Party rejects and opposes the opening of a Somaliland office in the holy city of Jerusalem,” Mahmoud says, explaining his party’s position. “We are unequivocally against it.” The relationship between Israel and Somaliland, as well as Hargeisa’s diplomatic manoeuvres, has irked Mogadishu. Since December, Somalia’s government has sought support from Muslim-majority countries and key regional allies in a diplomatic campaign aimed at containing the recognition and discouraging other countries from recognising Somaliland. Two Egyptian officials tell Mada Masr that Egypt is working with Saudi Arabia to reach out to other African countries with a simple message: if secession is tolerated with Somaliland, it will not be the only case. “Clearly this is something that will resonate with every African leader, especially those in East Africa,” one of the officials says. Madamasr

items.title: Farahaaga Waxaa Ku Jira Wax Aadan Ogayn
items.description: Waxaad ma ogtahay in farahaagu ay leeyihiin timo yaryar oo aad u jilicsan? Timahan yaryar, oo ah kuwa ugu gaagaaban jidhka, waxay ku koraan farahaaga, laakiin inta badan dadku ma oga inay jiraan sababtoo ah way aad u yar yihiin oo midabkoodu waa mid iftiin leh, waxayna u baahan yihiin iftiin xooggan si loo arko. Waxaa jira sabab xamaasad leh oo aad ku eegi karto timaha farahaaga, maadaama ay timuhu yaryar yihiin oo ay yihiin kuwo aan la arki karin. Waxay u koraan dhinaca sare ee faraha iyo suulasha, inkasta oo aan la ogeyn sababta qaar ka mid ah dadku u leeyihiin timo badan halka kuwa kale ay yar yihiin. Dadka qaarkiis waxay leeyihiin timo aad u badan oo faraha ka buuxa, halka kuwa kale ay leeyihiin timo yar ama aan lahayn. Timahan yaryar waxay ka mid yihiin kala duwanaanta dabiiciga ah ee jidhka bini’aadamka. Waxay si gaar ah ugu cusub yihiin dhinacyada faraha, waxayna u koraan si ka duwan timaha jidhka kale. Inkastoo aysan ahayn kuwo si fiican loo fahmay, waxay u egtahay in timahan yaryar ay tahay inay yeeshaan qaar ka mid ah waxqabadyada dareemayaasha ee ay faraha leeyihiin, laga yaabee inay ka caawiyaan dareenka taabashada. Dadku waxay isticmaalaan farahooda si joogto ah si ay wax u qabtaan, u qoraan, u qoraan, oo ay u dareemaan dareemo kala duwan—hase yeeshee dad badani waxay sanado ku noolaadaan iyagoon waligood ogaanin timahan yaryar. Haddaba, marka aad akhrido tan, waxaa suurtagal ah inaad si kale u eegto farahaaga. Isku day, eeg si dhow. The post Farahaaga Waxaa Ku Jira Wax Aadan Ogayn first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Hambalyo u Diray Guddoomiyaha Cusub ee Golaha Shacabka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa hambalyo u diray Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur, kaddib markii maanta ay Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka u doorteen xilka Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Guddoomiyaha cusub ugu hambalyeeyay kalsoonida ay Xildhibaanadu siiyeen, isagoo u rajeeyay inuu si hufan, masuuliyad iyo daacadnimo leh u guto waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee ka saaran hoggaaminta Golaha Shacabka. Madaxweynaha ayaa si gaar ah u xusay muhiimadda Golaha Shacabka uu u leeyahay dowlad-dhiska Soomaaliya, isagoo tilmaamay doorka Golaha ee sharci-dejinta, matalaadda shacabka iyo xoojinta isla-xisaabtanka hay’adaha dowladda. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale Guddoomiyaha cusub ugu baaqay inuu Golaha Shacabka ku hoggaamiyo si waafaqsan Dastuurka Federaalka Soomaaliya, isagoo mudnaanta siinaya midnimada, wada-tashiga iyo danta guud ee shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Doorashada Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Golaha Shacabka uu wajahayo howlo muhiim ah oo la xiriira sharci-dejinta iyo geeddi-socodka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa ugu dambeyn u rajeeyay Guddoomiyaha cusub guul iyo inuu si wanaagsan uga soo baxo mas’uuliyadda culus ee loo igmaday.

items.title: Ciidanka Itoobiya oo ka baxay saldhiggoodii magaalada…
items.description: Buurhakaba (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Itoobiya ee qeybta ka ah howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ee Soomaaliya ayaa 8-dii bishan si rasmi ah u wareejiyay taliskoodii magaalada Buurhakaba ee Gobolka Baay, iyaga oo amniga magaaladaas ku wareejiyey Ciidanka Xoogga Soomaaliyeed. Munaasabad ka dhacday saldhigga ciidanka Itoobiya ee degmada Buurhakaba ayaa waxaa maamulka iyo mas’uuliyadda amniga si rasmi ah ugula wareegay Qeybta 60-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, kuwaas oo sii wadi doona sugidda amniga magaalada Buurhakaba oo ah deegaan muhiim u ah Gobolka Baay. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Taliska Ciidanka AUSSOM ayaa lagu sheegay in tallaabadan ay qayb ka tahay qorshaha ay amniga dalka ugu wareejinayaan ciidamada Soomaaliya, kaas oo muddooyinkii ugu dambeeyay soo socday. “Tallaabadani waxay astaan u tahay dardargelinta wareejinta mas’uuliyadaha amniga ee sida tartiib-tartiibta ah loogu wareejinayo Ciidamada Amniga ee Soomaaliya,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka kasoo baxay taliska AUSSOM. Sidoo kale, qoraalka ayaa lagu sheegay in wareejintan ay astaan u tahay tallaabo kale oo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo arrimaha amniga ee ay Soomaalidu hoggaanka u hayso iyo dardargelinta wareejinta mas’uuliyadaha amniga dalka. Saldhigga Buurhakaba ee ay haatan la wareegtay Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa tan iyo 2014-kii waxaa ka howlgalayay Ciidanka Itoobiya, halkaas oo ay ka fulin jireen howlgallo ka dhan ah maleeshiyaadka kooxda Al-Shabaab. Tallaabadan ayaa sidoo kale loo sababeynayaa dhaqaale xumada soo wajahaday howlgalka oo hadda wajahaya mid kamid ah caqabadihii ugu adkaa ee abid soo mara. Si kastaba, Buurhakaba oo ah magaalo istaraatiiji ah ayaa waxaa hadda ku sugan ciidamada Milatariga Soomaaliya, Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed iyo maleeshiyaad deegaanka ah oo maalmahan howgallo ka waday magaaladaasi. The post Ciidanka Itoobiya oo ka baxay saldhiggoodii magaalada… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: JAAMAC oo maanta loo doortay Guddoomiyaha BF Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa maanta loo doortay guddoomiyaha rasmiga ah ee Golaha Shacabka, kadib doorasho ka dhacday xarunta Villa Hargeysa ee magaalada Muqdisho. Jaamac ayaa kusoo baxay cod aqlabiyad leh, wuxuuna helay 142 cod, sida ay shaacisay guddoomiye Sacdiya Yaasiin oo ku dhawaaqday natiijada. Sidoo kale, musharraxii la tartamayay ee Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Cumar Macallin (Daada) ayaa helay 30-cod, kaas oo malxiis ahaan u galay tartanka. Natiijada doorashadan ayaa horay loo sii ogaa, waxaana la filayay inuu kusoo baxo Jaamac sida dhacday, wuxuuna taageero ka helay Villa Soomaaliya. Guddoomiyaha cusub ayaa beddalay Sheekh Aadan Madoobe oo dhawaan loo doortay Madaxweynaha cusub ee Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa horay xilal kala duwan soo qabtay, wuxuu hadda ahaa Wasiirka Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda, horayna wuxuu usoo noqday Wasiirka Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Soomaaliya. Doorashada kadib waxaa isla goobta lagu dhaariyay guddoomiyaha cusub oo si rasmi ah ula wareegay guddoonka Baarlamaanka oo hadda ku jira kalfadhigiisii 8-aad oo uu dhawaan furay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Kalfadhigan oo doodo badan ay hareeyeen ayaa kusoo aaday, xilli ay taagan tahay xiisad u dhexeysa Villa Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka, taas oo ka dhalatay hannaanka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka oo ay isku hayaan labada dhinac. items.title: Ethiopian AUSSOM Troops Exit Buurhakaba After 12 Years
items.description: Buurhakaba— Ethiopian troops serving under the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) have formally withdrawn from Buurhakaba in Bay region, ending more than 12 years of deployment in the strategically important town. AUSSOM said the Forward Operating Base (FOB) in Buurhakaba has officially been handed over to the 60th Division of the Somali National Army (SNA), which will now assume responsibility for the facility and related security operations. The Ethiopian National Defence Force (ENDF) had maintained a presence at the base since 2014 as part of successive African Union missions in Somalia. During their deployment, Ethiopian troops played a significant role in securing Buurhakaba and supporting security operations across parts of Bay region. According to AUSSOM, the handover forms part of the broader security transition aimed at strengthening Somali ownership of national security and gradually transferring responsibilities from African Union forces to the Somali Security Forces. Buurhakaba is strategically located along key transport routes connecting several areas of South West State and southern Somalia. The withdrawal of Ethiopian forces places greater responsibility for the security of the town and surrounding areas on the Somali National Army and South West State authorities. Sources familiar with the AUSSOM transition process say Buurhakaba is not the only location expected to undergo a similar handover. At least three other major towns are reportedly expected to be included in the next phase of the transition in the coming weeks. The handover comes as Somalia intensifies efforts to strengthen the capacity of its national security forces and move towards full Somali responsibility for the country’s security. AUSSOM said the Forward Operating Base (FOB) in Buurhakaba has officially been handed over to the 60th Division of the Somali National Army (SNA), which will now assume responsibility for the facility and related security operations. The Ethiopian National Defence Force (ENDF) had maintained a presence at the base since 2014 as part of successive African Union missions in Somalia. During their deployment, Ethiopian troops played a significant role in securing Buurhakaba and supporting security operations across parts of Bay region. According to AUSSOM, the handover forms part of the broader security transition aimed at strengthening Somali ownership of national security and gradually transferring responsibilities from African Union forces to the Somali Security Forces. Buurhakaba is strategically located along key transport routes connecting several areas of South West State and southern Somalia. The withdrawal of Ethiopian forces places greater responsibility for the security of the town and surrounding areas on the Somali National Army and South West State authorities. items.description: Bulsho kasta oo dunidan ku nool waxa ay leedahay hidde iyo dhaqan gaar ah oo ay ka soo minguuriyeen waxyaabaha ay aaminsan yihiin. Markaan ka hadlayno ciyaardhaqameedyada Soomaalida waa hiddaha dhaqameed ee ay bulshadu ku muujiso nolosheeda, falsafaddeeda, wadajirkeeda iyo wadanoolaanshaheeda. Ciyaardhaqameedyadu waxa ay bulshooyinka u yihiin madadaallo; mar kalana waa u kayd taariikheed iyo haybta guud ee ay bulshadu leedahay. Bulshada Soomaaliyeed si kasta oo uu degaankooda iyo habnololeedku u kala geddisanyihiin, haddana waa bulsho ka siman in ay tahay bulsho asalkeeda waxna qorin waxna akhrin, taas beddelkeed waxay sheekooyinkeeda dhaqan iyo taariikhba ku tebin jirtay suugaanta noocyadeeda kala duwan iyo ciyaaraha dhaqanka, middaas oo habkaas ku dhaxalsiinaysa jiilasheeda haraayga kaydkeeda taariikheed iyo mid dhaqanba. Taariikh ahaan ciyaardhaqameedyada Soomaalida waa dhaxal aan ka soo gaarnay awoowayaasheenna oo sidaas jiilba jiilkii ka danbeeya la isugu gudbinayay. Inta badan ma jirto taariikh rasmi ah oo sheegaysa halka ay ka soo bilaabatay ciyaardhaqameedyada iyo qofka sida gaar ka ah u soo bilaabay. Inta badan dadka Soomaaliyeed waa dad hodan ku ah ciyaardhaqameedyada iyo maansooyinka, waxa ay leeyihiin xiiso gaar ah oo ay dadka u sameeyeen si ay ugu noqoto madadaallo iyo meel ay ku qaataan xusuuso iyo waqtiyo mashxaradi ku jirto. Qaar ciyaaraha ka mid ah baa lagu ciyaaraa istaag, qaar kalana fadhi baa lagu ciyaaraa. Waxaa kaloo jira ciyaaro waqtiyo gaar ah leh, sida ciyaaraha munaasabadaha la ciyaaro oo ay ka mid tahay aroosyada oo kale iyo munaasabadaha farxadeed. Qaar kale waxaa la ciyaaraa xilliyada ay barwaaqadu jirto. Ciyaardhaqameedyada markii laga hadlayo guud ahaan dadka Soomaaliyeed way ka wada siman yihiin, laakiin waxaa jira kaladuwanaansho dhanka degaanka ah, tusaale, dadka beeraleyda ah waxa ay ciyaaraan ciyaaro gaar ah, sidaa si la mid ah dadka geelleyda ahana waxa ay ciyaaraan kuwa ka duwan ciyaaraha beeraleyda. items.title: Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) Oo Loo Doortay Guddoomiyaha Cusub Ee Golaha Shacabka
items.description: MUQDISHO — Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur , oo loo yaqaan “Jaamac”, ayaa maanta loo doortay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, kaddib doorasho ka dhacday Muqdisho. Doorashadan ayaa noqonaysa mid cusub oo kusoo biirtay taariikhda siyaasadeed ee Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur, kaas oo muddooyinkii lasoo dhaafay kasoo shaqeeyay xilal kala duwan oo dowladda Soomaaliya ah, isaga oo soo noqday wasiir, taliye ku-xigeen hay’ad amni iyo la-taliye siyaasadeed. Xildhibaanimo 7-dii Abriil 2026 ayaa Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur Jaamac loo doortay xildhibaan ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka, iyadoo uu galay siyaasadda baarlamaanka xilli uu Koonfur Galbeed ka jiray isbeddel siyaasadeed oo weyn. Xilka xildhibaanimo ayaa yimid kaddib markii kursiga uu horay u hayay Isaaq Cali Subugle , iyadoo muddadii xildhibaanimo ee kursigaas ay weli ahayd arrin siyaasadeed oo muran dhalisay qaabka uu kusoo qaatay. Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Ankara iyo NISA Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur wuxuu horay uga soo shaqeeyay Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Ankara, dalka Turkiga, halkaas oo uu kasoo qabtay shaqooyin diblomaasiyadeed. Sidoo kale wuxuu noqday Taliye Ku-xigeenka NISA, isagoo ka mid noqday masuuliyiintii kasoo shaqeeyay hay’adda sirdoonka iyo nabadsugidda qaranka. Intii uu siyaasadda ku jiray, wuxuu sidoo kale soo noqday la-taliyaha Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, xilli uu guddoonka hayay Maxamed Mursal Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan. Wasiirro uu kasoo noqday xukuumaddii Rooble Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa sidoo kale xilal wasiirnimo kasoo qabtay xukuumaddii Ra’iisul Wasaare Maxamed Xuseen Rooble. Wuxuu noqday Wasiirka Caddaaladda, xilli Soomaaliya ay ku jirtay marxalad siyaasadeed oo xasaasi ah, gaar ahaan khilaafkii siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeyay madaxweynihii xilligaas, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo, iyo Ra’iisul Wasaare Rooble. Xilligaas waxaa soo baxay muuqaallo iyo hadallo siyaasadeed oo lagu fasiray inuu si cad ugu dhawaa garabka Ra’iisul Wasaare Rooble. Waxaa sidoo kale loo bixiyay naaneyska “Madaxa Na Furan”, oo si gaar ah loogu xusuusto muuqaal uu iska duubay xilli ay taagneyd xiisaddii siyaasadeed ee Farmaajo iyo Rooble. Naaneyskaas ayaa markii dambe kusoo noqnoqday hadal-heynta siyaasadda Soomaaliya. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur wuxuu xukuumaddii Rooble ka noqday Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, isagoo masuul ka noqday wasaarad muhiim ah oo xilligaas wajahaysay arrimo la xiriira amniga, dib-u-dhiska ciidamada iyo dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Kadib markii Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud loo doortay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa mar kale loo magacaabay Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, taas oo muujisay inuu sii watay kaalintiisa siyaasadeed iyo dowladeed. Wasiirka Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda Xilkiisii ugu dambeeyay ee dowladda federaalka wuxuu ahaa Wasiirka Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda, xil uu kaga shaqeynayay arrimaha dekedaha, gaadiidka badda iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha ee la xiriira badda. Kadib safar siyaasadeed oo soo maray dhinacyo kala duwan—diblomaasiyad, amni, caddaalad, gaashaandhig iyo dekedaha—Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa maanta gaaray mid ka mid ah xilalka ugu sarreeya ee siyaasadda Soomaaliya. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Doorashadiisa Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka waxay timid xilli uu Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ka baxay xilka guddoomiyaha, kaddib markii uu noqday Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: Waqooyi Kuuriya oo AI-ga u adeegsanaysa weerarrada dhanka internetka
items.description: Waqooyi Kuuriya ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay sii kordhisay adeegsiga sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) si ay u xoojiso weerarrada dhanka internetka, iyadoo koox hackers ah oo lala xiriiriyo hay’adaha sirdoonka dalkaasi ay AI u adeegsanayso diyaarinta dukumentiyo been-abuur ah iyo hawlgallo lagu beegsanayo bartilmaameedyo xasaasi ah. Warbixin cusub oo ay soo saartay shirkadda Kuuriyada Koonfureed ee amniga internetka ee Genians ayaa lagu sheegay in kooxda loo yaqaan Kimsuky, oo lala xiriiriyo adeegyada sirdoonka Waqooyi Kuuriya, ay tan iyo bilowgii 2026 adeegsanaysay dukumentiyo ay AI soo saartay si ay u fuliso weerarro loo yaqaan spear-phishing. Weerarradan ayaa si gaar ah loogu beegsanayaa dhinacyada milatariga, diblomaasiyadda iyo tacliinta, ayadoo warbixintu sheegtay in ay hackers-ku AI u adeegsanayaan inay si otomaatig ah u abuuraan faylal been-abuur ah oo loo ekaysiiyay dukumentiyo sharci ah, sida warbixinno cilmi-baaris, casuumaado iyo qoraallo kale oo qofka bartilmaameedka ah ku dhalin kara kalsooni. Ujeeddada ayaa ah in qofka loo diro dukumenti ama fariin u muuqata mid rasmi ah, si uu u furto ama ula falgalo, taasoo weeraryahannada siin karta fursad ay ku helaan xog ama ay ku dhex galaan nidaamka kombiyuutarka qofkaas. Genians waxay sheegtay in Kimsuky ay sidoo kale adeegsanayso qalabyo AI oo il-furan ah, oo ay ka mid yihiin Ollama, GPT4All iyo Msty, kuwaas oo u oggolaanaya in moodooyinka sirdoonka macmalka ah lagu shaqaysiiyo gudaha nidaamka iyada oo aan loo baahnayn xiriir joogto ah oo internet-ka ah. Habkan ayaa weeraryahannada siin kara fursad ay ku farsameeyaan xog iyo dukumentiyo iyaga oo yareynaya raadadka ay kaga tagayaan adeegyada internetka. Shirkadda Genians ayaa sheegtay in arrintan ay muhiim tahay, maadaama aysan AI kaliya ka caawinayn hackers-ka inay sameeyaan dukumentiyo khiyaano ah, balse ay u oggolaanayso inay si degdeg ah oo tiro badan u abuuraan agab loo adeegsan karo weerarrada bulshada, taasoo sare u qaadaysa awoodda kooxaha internetka ku shaqeeya. Kimsuky iyo kooxo kale oo lala xiriiriyo Waqooyi Kuuriya ayaa muddo dheer lagu eedaynayay weerarro dhanka internet-ka ah oo lagu doonayo in lagu helo sirdoon iyo dhaqaale. Warbixinno hore ayaa sheegay in hackers-ka Waqooyi Kuuriya ay xadeen lacago cryptocurrency ah oo malaayiin iyo balaayiin doollar gaaraya, iyagoo weerarro dhanka internet-ka ah u adeegsaday inay dhaqaale ku helaan. Isticmaalka AI-ga ayaa hadda keeni kara isbeddel cusub, maadaama tiknoolajiyaddu ay fududayn karto in weerarrada la diyaariyo waqti gaaban, iyadoo sidoo kale kordhinaysa tayada qoraallada, dukumentiyada iyo fariimaha loo adeegsado khiyaanada dadka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee khubarada amniga internet-ka ayaa ka digaya in tani ay hoos u dhigi karto caqabaddii farsamo ee horay uga hor istaagi jirtay kooxo badan inay fuliyaan weerarro casri ah.

items.title: Guddoomiye Muungaab oo ka hadlay doorashada Jaamac
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), ayaa hambalyo u diray Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), oo maanta loo doortay guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya. Muungaab ayaa guddoomiyaha cusub u rajeeyay inuu xilka loo doortay u guto si hufan oo masuuliyad leh, isaga oo sidoo kale muujiyay diyaar u ahaanshaha maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ee wada-shaqeyn dhow oo lala yeesho hoggaanka cusub ee Golaha Shacabka. “Waxaan u rajeynayaa inuu si hufan oo xilkasnimo leh u guto mas’uuliyadda loo igmaday, islamarkaana uu door muuqda ka qaato horumarinta shaqada Golaha Shacabka iyo gudashada waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka kasoo baxay xafiiska Duqa Muqdisho. Muungaab ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha dowladda, gaar ahaan xilli siyaasadda dalka ay ku jirto marxalad xasaasi ah oo ay socdaan doodaha ku saabsan doorashooyinka soo socda. “Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir wuxuu diyaar u yahay sii xoojinta wada-shaqeynta iyo iskaashi wax-ku-ool ah oo lagu horumarinayo arrimaha danta guud iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri Muungaab. Hambalyada Duqa Muqdisho ayaa qeyb ka ah falcelinno kala duwan oo kasoo baxay madaxda dowladda kadib doorashadii maanta. items.title: Ciidanka Itoobiya oo baneeyay fariisimo ay ku la hayeen degmada Buurhakaba
items.description: Buurhakaba ( Raxanreeb Online) Wararka inaga soo gaaraya degmada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Baay, ayaa ku waramaya in ciidamada Itoobiya ee qeybta ka ah howlgalka ciidamada midowga Afrika (AUSSOM), ay isaga baxay qeybo kamid ah magaalada.. Ciidamadan ayaa fariisimo ku lahaa goobo muhiim ah oo ku yaalla degmada Buurhakaba, waxaana la tilmaamay in ay u dhaq-dhaqaaqeen dhinaca iyo deegaannada kale ee gobolka Baay. Ciidamadan ayaa la sheegay in muddo dheer ah ay ku lahayeen fariisimo muhiim ah oo ay uga qeyb qaadanayeen dagaal kooxda Al-shabaab ee ka socda deegaannada maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Amniga magaalada, waxaa la wareegay Ciidanka Danab ee xoogga dalka, kuwaasi oo muddooyinkii dambe howlgallo lagu xaqiijinayo amniga ka sameeynayay halkaasi. Sidoo kale ciidamada Itoobiya ayaa tan 2014-kii waxa fariisintan u aheyd mid muhiim ah iyaga oo inta badan degmada Buurhakaba ka difaaci jiray weerarada kooxda Al-shabaab kusoo qadaan magaalada. Sikastaba, tallaabadan ayaa ku soo aadeysa xilli howlgalka AUSSOM uu wajahayo caqabado dhaqaale oo culus. items.title: Somali Army Chief Arrives in Turkey to Strengthen Military Cooperation
items.description: The Commander of the Somali National Army, Major General Ibrahim Mohamed Mohamud, arrived in Ankara, Turkey, today leading a high-level delegation of senior military officials. The official visit is part of ongoing efforts to strengthen defence and security cooperation between Somalia and Turkey. The Commander’s visit is significant as it represents a new step in deepening the long-standing military ties between the two countries. Turkey has played a key role in training thousands of Somali troops, both at facilities in Turkey and at the TURKSOM base in Mogadishu, as part of a broader defence and economic framework agreement signed in 2024. During the visit, the Commander and his delegation are expected to hold meetings with senior Turkish military and defence officials. Discussions are set to focus on enhancing military coordination, expanding training programmes, and improving the capacity of the Somali National Army. The talks are also likely to cover equipment support and ways to strengthen Somali forces as they prepare to take on greater security responsibilities. The visit comes as Somalia continues to build its military capabilities with the support of international partners. Turkey’s contribution has been central to this effort, particularly in preparing Somali forces for counter-insurgency operations and stabilisation missions. The delegation’s trip is expected to conclude with a series of agreements aimed at further advancing the bilateral defence partnership. items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka XDS oo gaaray Turkiga si loo xoojiyo iskaashiga milateri
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sareeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u gaaray magaalada Ankara ee dalka Turkiga, isagoo hogaaminaya wafdi ka kooban saraakiil sare oo ka tirsan ciidanka . Booqashadan rasmiga ah ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca iyo amniga ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga . Booqashada Taliyaha ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan tahay tallaabo cusub oo lagu xoojinayo xiriirka milateri ee labada dal, kuwaas oo muddo dheer lahaa iskaashi dhow oo dhinacyada difaaca, amniga iyo tababarrada ciidamada ah . Turkiga ayaa qeyb muhiim ah ka qaatay tababarka kumanaan ciidan Soomaaliyeed, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa lagu tababaray Turkiga iyo saldhigga TURKSOM ee Muqdisho . Inta uu socdaalku socdo, Taliyaha iyo wafdigiisa ayaa la filayaa inay kulamo la yeeshaan mas’uuliyiin iyo saraakiil sare oo ka tirsan dhinaca Turkiga, iyadoo diiradda lagu saarayo xoojinta wada shaqaynta ciidan, tababarrada iyo tayeynta ciidanka . Waxaa la filayaa in kulamada ay daboolaan arrimo ay ka mid yihiin tababarka, qalabaynta, iyo xoojinta awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed si ay u qaataan mas’uuliyad dheeri ah oo ku aaddan amniga dalka . Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa kala saxiixday qaab-dhismeed iskaashi oo dhinaca difaaca iyo dhaqaalaha ah sanadkii 2024 , kaas oo Turkiga uu ku raaciyay inuu taageero marin-badeedka Soomaaliya iyo awoodda difaaca guud . Tallaabadan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada dowladda Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan dhisida ciidan karti leh oo awood u leh inuu difaaco qaranka . items.title: Ethiopian Troops Withdraw from Buurhakaba, Somali Forces Take Over Security
items.description: Ethiopian troops serving under the African Union mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) have officially withdrawn from the strategic town of Buurhakaba in the Bay region, after nearly 12 years of deployment. Somali National Army forces have now assumed full responsibility for security in the town, marking a significant step in the transition of security responsibilities to Somali forces . The withdrawal comes at a time when the AUSSOM mission is facing serious financial challenges, with reports indicating that three major towns will be handed over to Somali forces in the coming weeks. This development places considerable pressure on the Federal Government of Somalia, which has requested a two-year delay in the withdrawal of foreign troops, but funding shortages have made this increasingly difficult. Ethiopian forces had been stationed in Buurhakaba since 2014, playing a key role in stabilising the region. Their departure follows the broader AUSSOM drawdown plan, with the African Union mission set to conclude its current mandate by 31 December 2026. Any extension of the mission will depend on decisions by the UN Security Council and the availability of sustainable funding. The handover has raised concerns among Somali officials about whether national forces are fully prepared to fill the security gap, particularly in areas where Al-Shabaab remains active. There are also fears that supply routes may be disrupted, potentially undermining the effectiveness of the remaining AUSSOM forces. The Federal Government of Somalia has repeatedly called for additional international support to strengthen its military capacity, as it faces the dual challenge of securing liberated areas and countering ongoing militant threats. items.title: Ciidanka Itoobiya oo baneeyay Buurhakaba, Soomaaliya oo la wareegtay amniga
items.description: Ciidanka Itoobiya ee ka tirsan howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, ayaa si rasmi ah uga baxay magaalada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Baay, kadib muddo ku dhow 12 sano oo ay ku sugnaayeen. Gacan ku haynta amniga magaalada waxaa la wareegay Ciidanka Milatariga Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo hadda mas’uul ka ah ilaalinta nabadda iyo xasiloonida deegaanka . Bixitaankan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada qaabka amniga dalka, iyadoo dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay si tartiib ah u la wareegayso mas’uuliyadda amniga gobolada kala duwan. Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo aadeysa xilli howlgalka AUSSOM uu wajahayo caqabado dhaqaale oo xooggan, iyadoo la filayo in ciidamada shisheeye ay baneeyaan magaalooyin dheeri ah asbuucyada soo socda. Ciidanka Itoobiya ayaa degmada Buurhakaba gacanta ku hayay laga soo bilaabo 2014, waxayna ka qeyb qaateen howlgalo lagu xoojinayo amniga deegaanka. Bixitaankoodu waxa uu imaanayaa iyadoo Midowga Afrika uu soo dhoweynayo dhammaadka waajibaadkiisa hadda ee 31 December 2026, iyadoo kordhinta howlgalkuna ay ku xirnaan doonto go’aannada Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo helitaanka maalgelin waarta. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa iyaduna dalbanaysa in bixitaanka ciidanka dib loo dhigo ilaa 2 sano, si loo xoojiyo awoodda ciidamada dalka . Mas’uuliyiinta dowladda Federaalka ayaa ka walaacsan in bixitaanka ciidamada shisheeye uu abuuri karo jahawareer amni, gaar ahaan haddii ciidamada Soomaaliyeed aysan helin taageerada ay u baahan yihiin. Sidoo kale, go’aankaan ayaa imaanaya xilli ay jiraan cabsi badan oo ku saabsan marinada saadka oo gabaabsi ah, taasoo saamayn ku yeelan karta mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM. items.title: Muxuu hoggaamiye Aadan Madoobe kala hadlay madaxa xafiiska siyaasadda Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya ?
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Hoggaamiyaha dowlad goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa Hoyga uu ka degan yahay Magaalada Muqdisho ku qaabilay Madaxa Xafiiska Siyaasadda Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, Vikram Parekh iyo Christopher Laker Ku-xigeenka Wakiilka Deganaanshaha ee UNDP. items.title: Laba xildhibaan oo u tartamaya guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho – Doorashada guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta ka dhacaysa Xarunta Baarlamaanka ee magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoo laba musharrax ay ku tartamayaan xilkan muhiimka ah. Musharraxiinta waxaa ka mid ah Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur Jaamac, oo lagu tilmaamo inuu yahay mid ka mid ah musharraxiinta ugu cad-cad ee ku guulaysan kara, iyo Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Cumar, kuwaas oo u taagan xilka guddoomiyaha golaha shacabka ee Baarlamaanka 10-aad ee dalka . Doorashadan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay qayb ka tahay habka dimuqraadiga ah ee dalka, iyadoo Baarlamaanku uu doonayo inuu soo xulo hoggaamiye cusub oo hagaya shaqadiisa muddada soo socota. Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa sheegay inuu doonayo inuu Baarlamaanka ka dhigo mid dijitaal ah, islamarkaana aan loo baahnayn waraaqaha is-xaadirinta, taasoo muujinaysa aragti cusub oo ku aaddan casriyeynta shaqada golaha. Doorashada ayaa si habsami leh uga socota xarunta Baarlamaanka, iyadoo la filayo in codbixintu ay dhammaato maanta. Ammaanka magaalada Muqdisho ayaa si weyn loo adkeeyay, gaar ahaan agagaarka xarunta ay ka dhaceyso doorashada, si loo xaqiijiyo in ay si nabadeed u socoto . Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur Jaamac, oo hore u soo noqday Wasiirka Cadaaladda, ayaa waxa uu ku dhawaaqay inuu Baarlamaanka ku soo kordhin doono tiknoolajiyad casri ah, isagoo sheegay inay tahay waqtigii looga guuri lahaa waraaqaha is-xaadirinta. Dhanka kale, Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Cumar ayaa sidoo kale soo bandhigay barnaamij uu ku doonayo inuu horumariyo shaqada Baarlamaanka. Doorashadan ayaa soo jiidatay indhaha dadweynaha Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo la filayo in guddoomiyaha cusub uu qaadi doono mas’uuliyad weyn oo ku aaddan hoggaaminta Baarlamaanka xilligan muhiimka ah ee dalka uu marayo. The post Laba xildhibaan oo u tartamaya guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Iiraan oo heshay fursad ay ciidamada Mareykanka uga mamnuucdo Gacanka Faaris
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Iran ayaa ku hanjabtay inay maraakiibta dagaalka ee ciidamada badda Mareykanka ka mamnuuci doonto inay maraan marin-biyoodka Hormuz, iyadoo arrintaas qeyb uga dhigeysa heshiis lagu doonayo in dib loogu furo marin-biyoodka, islamarkaana sii riixeysa hadafkeeda ah in la yareeyo joogitaanka militari ee Mareykanka ee tobannaan sano ka jiray Gacanka Faaris. Hanjabaadda Tehran ayaa muujineysa sida xubnaha mayalka adag ee ku jira hoggaanka Iran, gaar ahaan kuwa Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah, ay saameyntoodu u sii xoogeysaneyso. Kooxahan ayaa muddo dheer ku baaqayay in ciidamada Mareykanka laga saaro gobolka. Inkasta oo Iran ay dagaalka kala kulantay jab militari oo aad u culus, madaxdeedu waxay hadda u arkaan wada-hadallada lagu doonayo in lagu soo afjaro dagaalka lixda bilood socday fursad ay Mareykanka kaga riixi karaan kaalinta awoodda ugu weyn ee Gacanka Faaris. Saraakiisha Iran ayaa hanjabaaddan si fagaare ah u soo bandhigay iyadoo ay socdaan wada-hadallo ay Cumaan la leedahay Tehran. Cumaan, oo ku taalla xeebta koonfureed ee Hormuz, ayaa hoggaamineysa dadaallada dhex-dhexaadinta. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa dhex-dhexaadiyeyaasha u sheegay in Washington aysan aqbali doonin xayiraad ay Iran saarto maraakiibta Hormuz maraysa ama lacago laga qaado. Arrintan ayaa ka mid ah dhowr khilaaf oo waaweyn oo u dhexeeya Washington iyo Tehran oo dib u dhigay dhammeystirka heshiiska. Marka dhinaca militariga laga eego, falanqeeyayaal iyo saraakiil hore oo sare oo militari ayaa sheegaya in Iran aysan u badneyn inay awood u yeelato inay ciidamada badda Mareykanka ka hor istaagto Gacanka haddii Washington go’aansato inay maraakiibteeda marsiiso Hormuz. Pentagon-ka ayaa bishii Abriil, xilli dagaalku marayay heerkiisii ugu sarreeyay, laba markab oo ciidamada badda Mareykanka ah oo ku hubeysan gantaallada la hago mariyay Hormuz. Trump oo wajahaya imtixaan Hase yeeshee, iyadoo Iran ay soo bandhigeyso dalabyo aad u sarreeya, Tehran waxaa laga yaabaa inay tijaabineyso sida Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu diyaar ugu yahay inuu dagaalka dib u bilaabo, ama uu doorbido waddo uu uga baxo xiisadda, xitaa haddii taas macnaheedu yahay inuusan markiiba ka hor imaan isku dayga Iran ee lagu doonayo in Mareykanka looga xiro Gacanka. Jonathan Panikoff, oo horay u ahaa sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan sirdoonka Mareykanka haddana ka tirsan Atlantic Council, ayaa sheegay in wax kasta oo Trump sameeyo, natiijada aasaasiga ahi ay noqon doonto “in Iran ay si dhab ah u hesho awood weyn oo ay ku maamusho marin-biyoodka.” Maamulka Trump ayaa aqbali kara oo keliya nidaam Hormuz ka dhaqan gala oo Iran aysan wax lacago ama khidmad ah ku qaadin, isla markaana aysan cidna ka hor istaagi karin inay marto marin-biyoodka, sida uu sheegay sarkaal Mareykan ah. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in waddooyin gaar ah oo loo asteeyo maraakiibta ay noqon doonaan kuwo ku-meel-gaar ah. Sarkaal kale oo Mareykan ah ayaa sheegay in Washington ay qaadi doonto xannibaadda ay saartay dekedaha Iran haddii Tehran ay Hormuz furto iyadoo aan carqalad lagu sameyn maraakiibta. Trump ayaa Khamiistii wariyeyaasha u sheegay in Hormuz “si uun hadda u furan yahay” sababo la xiriira xannibaadda Mareykanka. Wuxuu qiray in Iran ay “mar walba wax toogan karto, wax sameyn karto ama miino dhigi karto”, isagoo sheegay in xitaa hal miino oo marin-biyoodka taalla ay jahwareer weyn abuuri karto, maadaama shirkadaha maraakiibta aysan dooneyn inay maraakiibtooda balaayiinka dollar ku kacaya halis geliyaan. Is-afgaradkii Trump iyo Iran ay saxiixeen bishii Juun ayaa isna lagu doonayay in Hormuz dib loo furo, loona gogol xaaro wada-hadallo qoto dheer iyo ugu dambeyn soo afjaridda dagaalka. Hase yeeshee, is-afgaradkaas ayaa burburay kaddib markii Iran ay weerarro ku qaaday maraakiib, iyadoo isku dayeysay inay xoojiso maamulkeeda marin-biyoodka. Qabyo-qoraalka heshiiska Qabyo-qoraalka heshiiska Hormuz ayaa dhigaya in si ku-meel-gaar ah loo sameeyo marin ay maraakiibta soo galaysa isticmaalaan oo u dhow Iran iyo marin kale oo maraakiibta baxaysa ah oo u dhow Cumaan, inkasta oo hoggaanka sare ee Iran uusan weli ansixin heshiiska. Heshiisku wuxuu gacan ka geysan karaa dib u soo celinta qulqulka tamarta ee Hormuz iyo yareynta cadaadiska saaran dhaqaalaha caalamka. Hase yeeshee, dalalka Carabta ee shidaalka dhoofiya ee Gacanka, inkasta oo ay ka daaleen dagaal dhaawac weyn u geystay dhaqaalahooda, ayaa ka walaacsan in heshiisku Iran siiyo awood joogto ah oo ay ku yeelato marin-biyoodka laf-dhabarta u ah dhaqaalahooda. Diblomaasiyiinta Iran, oo cadaadis kala kulmaya Ilaalada Kacaanka, ayaa ku adkeysanaya in tallaabooyin dheeraad ah loo baahan yahay ka hor inta Hormuz si buuxda dib loogu furin. Waxaa ka mid ah in la fududeeyo cunaqabateynta shidaalka Iran iyo in Mareykanku qaado xannibaadda dekedaha Iran. Maraakiibta Israel ayaa sidoo kale laga mamnuuci doonaa inay maraan Hormuz, sida lagu sheegay warbixin ay baahisay wakaaladda Fars News Agency oo xiriir la leh Ilaalada Kacaanka. Waxaa sidoo kale la mamnuuci doonaa maraakiib ama xamuul lala xiriirinayo tallaabooyin ka dhan ah kooxaha hubeysan ee gobolka ee ay Iran taageerto. Dalalka loo arko inay Iran waxyeello gaarsiiyeen ayaa laga doonayaa inay magdhow bixiyaan ka hor inta aan loo oggolaan inay maraan marin-biyoodka. Dowladda Iran iyo militarigeeda ayaa sidoo kale maamuli doona hagidda iyo isu-socodka maraakiibta, sida ay sheegtay Fars, oo intaas ku dartay in shuruudahaasi ku jiraan hindise sharciyeed ay dib u eegayaan Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran. Ali Vaez, oo ah agaasimaha mashruuca Iran ee Crisis Group, ayaa sheegay in mamnuucidda maraakiibta dagaalka ay udub-dhexaad u tahay dalabyada Tehran. “Maamulka Iran waxaa loogu talagalay inuu siiyo qalab ay uga hor istaagi karto maraakiibta cadowga ah,” ayuu yiri Vaez. Dhex-dhexaadiyeyaasha ayaa sheegay in heshiiska Iran iyo Cumaan uusan ku jirin qodobadaas ay Fars soo bandhigtay. Hase yeeshee, waxay dalabyada Iran si dhab ah u qaateen kaddib markii saraakiisha Tehran ay u gudbiyeen dhex-dhexaadiyeyaasha Carabta, taas oo dib u dhac ku keentay wada-hadallada, islamarkaana muujisay sida Ilaalada Kacaanka uga go’an tahay inay soo afjarto maritaanka aan xadidneyn ee Hormuz. Maamul ay Iran ku yeelato Hormuz wuxuu adkeyn karaa mashaariic badan oo dhaqaale iyo amni oo Gacanka ka socda. Qiyaastii shan-meelood meel shidaalka dunida ayaa caadi ahaan mara Hormuz, waxaana sidoo kale marin-biyoodka mara gaaska dabiiciga ah ee dareeraha ah ee Qatar oo qiimihiisu sanadkii gaarayo tobannaan bilyan oo dollar. Dubai ayaa iyaduna ganacsi maraakiib oo faa’iido badan leh ka maamusha dekedda Jebel Ali oo ku dhow marin-biyoodka. Joogitaanka Mareykanka Joogitaanka joogtada ah ee ciidamada badda Mareykanka ee Gacanka wuxuu dib ugu laabanayaa 1971, markaas oo Mareykanku la wareegay saldhig ay Britain ku lahayd Bahrain, kaas oo markii dambe noqday xarunta Taliska Shanaad ee Ciidamada Badda Mareykanka. Joogitaanka militari ee Mareykanka ee Gacanka ayaa tobannaan sano ee xigay sii ballaartay, isagoo gaaray 30,000 oo askari oo ku kala sugan saldhigyo ku yaalla Kuwait, Sacuudi Carabiya, Qatar iyo Imaaraadka Carabta. Hase yeeshee, weerarrada Iran ku qaaday saldhigyadaas ayaa Pentagon-ka ku qasbay inuu ciidamo dib u kala raro, isla markaana si weyn ugu tiirsanaado saldhigyo ka baxsan Gacanka oo ka nuglaan yar weerarrada. Isbeddelkaas ayaa muujinaya sida dagaalku durba wax uga beddelay qaabka ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka. “Waxay durba si wax ku ool ah nooga saareen Gacanka Faaris marka laga hadlayo awood militari oo la adeegsan karo,” ayay tiri Rosemary Kelanic, oo madax ka ah Barnaamijka Bariga Dhexe ee Defense Priorities, kana mid ah dadka dhaliila joogitaanka militari ee Mareykanka ee Bariga Dhexe. Bilowgii dagaalka, Iran ayaa ku dhawaaqday xilli cusub oo ay ku maamuli doonto Hormuz. Madaxda Tehran ayaa xakameynta marin-biyoodka u arka dammaanad amni oo la mid ah barnaamijkooda nukliyeerka iyo kaydkooda gantaallada. Iran ayaa sameysay hay’ad dowladeed oo lagu magacaabo Persian Gulf Strait Authority, waxayna dalbatay in milkiilayaasha maraakiibta ay hay’adda iska diiwaangeliyaan si ay Hormuz uga gudbaan, isla markaana ay lacag caymis ah bixiyaan. Mareykanka ayaa cunaqabateyn saaray hay’addaas, isagoo ku hanjabay ciqaab shirkad kasta oo maraakiib ah oo la macaamisha. Inkasta oo Mareykanku diidan yahay in Iran ay maamusho marin-biyoodka, ciidamada badda Mareykanka ayaa intii dagaalku socday marar kooban oo keliya halis u galay inay galaan Gacanka Faaris, howlgaladaasna waxay ahaayeen kuwo muddo gaaban socday. Shirkadaha maraakiibta ganacsiga ayaa iyaguna ka caga-jiidaya inay Hormuz maraan iyagoo aan helin dammaanad ah in Iran aysan weerari doonin. Guud ahaan, isu-socodka Hormuz ayaa si weyn u curyaamay. Xubnaha mayalka adag ee Tehran ayaa sheegaya inay dhaqan gelin doonaan dalabyadooda. Mowqifka adag ee Iran Mohsen Rezaei, oo ah taliye hawlgab ah oo ka tirsanaa Ilaalada Kacaanka isla markaana la-taliye dhow u ah Hoggaamiyaha Sare Mojtaba Khamenei, ayaa Khamiistii sheegay in Iran aysan oggolaan doonin in waddooyin kale laga sameeyo marin-biyoodka. Chris Long, oo horay uga tirsanaa ciidamada badda Britain ee Gacanka Faaris, haddana madax ka ah sirdoonka shirkadda la-talinta maraakiibta ee Neptune P2P Group, ayaa sheegay inuu filayo in qulqulka tamarta ee marin-biyoodka uu “sannado badan ahaan doono mid gaabis ah oo hooseeya.” Saraakiisha Khaliijka ayaa qiraya in heshiiska la soo jeediyay uu Tehran siinayo maamul Hormuz ah, isla markaana maamulkaasi uu noqon karo mid joogto ah, balse waxay sheegayaan in xilligan ay tahay ikhtiyaarka ugu wanaagsan ee ay haystaan. Ilaalada Kacaanka ayaa muujisay inay diyaar u tahay inay xiisadda sii kordhiso, islamarkaana dagaalka ka dhigto mid sida ugu macquulsan qaali ugu noqda xulafada Mareykanka ee gobolka. Dalalka Khaliijka ayaa durba eegaya qorshayaal ay Hormuz uga leexan karaan, iyagoo ballaarinaya dhuumaha shidaalka ee taga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cumaan, isla markaana kordhinaya maalgashiga kaydka shidaalka ee dibadda. Hase yeeshee, saraakiisha gobolka ayaa sheegaya in waddooyinka kale aysan ka hortagi karin in Ilaalada Kacaanka ay weerarto kaabayaasha tamarta haddii aan la helin heshiis nabadeed oo lagu kalsoonaan karo. Trump ayaa Khamiistii wariyeyaasha u sheegay in Hormuz “si uun hadda u furan yahay” sababo la xiriira xannibaadda Mareykanka. Wuxuu qiray in Iran ay “mar walba wax toogan karto, wax sameyn karto ama miino dhigi karto”, isagoo sheegay in xitaa hal miino oo marin-biyoodka taalla ay jahwareer weyn abuuri karto, maadaama shirkadaha maraakiibta aysan dooneyn inay maraakiibtooda balaayiinka dollar ku kacaya halis geliyaan. Is-afgaradkii Trump iyo Iran ay saxiixeen bishii Juun ayaa isna lagu doonayay in Hormuz dib loo furo, loona gogol xaaro wada-hadallo qoto dheer iyo ugu dambeyn soo afjaridda dagaalka. Hase yeeshee, is-afgaradkaas ayaa burburay kaddib markii Iran ay weerarro ku qaaday maraakiib, iyadoo isku dayeysay inay xoojiso maamulkeeda marin-biyoodka. Qabyo-qoraalka heshiiska Qabyo-qoraalka heshiiska Hormuz ayaa dhigaya in si ku-meel-gaar ah loo sameeyo marin ay maraakiibta soo galaysa isticmaalaan oo u dhow Iran iyo marin kale oo maraakiibta baxaysa ah oo u dhow Cumaan, inkasta oo hoggaanka sare ee Iran uusan weli ansixin heshiiska. Heshiisku wuxuu gacan ka geysan karaa dib u soo celinta qulqulka tamarta ee Hormuz iyo yareynta cadaadiska saaran dhaqaalaha caalamka. Hase yeeshee, dalalka Carabta ee shidaalka dhoofiya ee Gacanka, inkasta oo ay ka daaleen dagaal dhaawac weyn u geystay dhaqaalahooda, ayaa ka walaacsan in heshiisku Iran siiyo awood joogto ah oo ay ku yeelato marin-biyoodka laf-dhabarta u ah dhaqaalahooda. Diblomaasiyiinta Iran, oo cadaadis kala kulmaya Ilaalada Kacaanka, ayaa ku adkeysanaya in tallaabooyin dheeraad ah loo baahan yahay ka hor inta Hormuz si buuxda dib loogu furin. Waxaa ka mid ah in la fududeeyo cunaqabateynta shidaalka Iran iyo in Mareykanku qaado xannibaadda dekedaha Iran. Maraakiibta Israel ayaa sidoo kale laga mamnuuci doonaa inay maraan Hormuz, sida lagu sheegay warbixin ay baahisay wakaaladda Fars News Agency oo xiriir la leh Ilaalada Kacaanka. Waxaa sidoo kale la mamnuuci doonaa maraakiib ama xamuul lala xiriirinayo tallaabooyin ka dhan ah kooxaha hubeysan ee gobolka ee ay Iran taageerto. Dalalka loo arko inay Iran waxyeello gaarsiiyeen ayaa laga doonayaa inay magdhow bixiyaan ka hor inta aan loo oggolaan inay maraan marin-biyoodka. Dowladda Iran iyo militarigeeda ayaa sidoo kale maamuli doona hagidda iyo isu-socodka maraakiibta, sida ay sheegtay Fars, oo intaas ku dartay in shuruudahaasi ku jiraan hindise sharciyeed ay dib u eegayaan Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran. Ali Vaez, oo ah agaasimaha mashruuca Iran ee Crisis Group, ayaa sheegay in mamnuucidda maraakiibta dagaalka ay udub-dhexaad u tahay dalabyada Tehran. “Maamulka Iran waxaa loogu talagalay inuu siiyo qalab ay uga hor istaagi karto maraakiibta cadowga ah,” ayuu yiri Vaez. Dhex-dhexaadiyeyaasha ayaa sheegay in heshiiska Iran iyo Cumaan uusan ku jirin qodobadaas ay Fars soo bandhigtay. Hase yeeshee, waxay dalabyada Iran si dhab ah u qaateen kaddib markii saraakiisha Tehran ay u gudbiyeen dhex-dhexaadiyeyaasha Carabta, taas oo dib u dhac ku keentay wada-hadallada, islamarkaana muujisay sida Ilaalada Kacaanka uga go’an tahay inay soo afjarto maritaanka aan xadidneyn ee Hormuz. Maamul ay Iran ku yeelato Hormuz wuxuu adkeyn karaa mashaariic badan oo dhaqaale iyo amni oo Gacanka ka socda. Qiyaastii shan-meelood meel shidaalka dunida ayaa caadi ahaan mara Hormuz, waxaana sidoo kale marin-biyoodka mara gaaska dabiiciga ah ee dareeraha ah ee Qatar oo qiimihiisu sanadkii gaarayo tobannaan bilyan oo dollar. Dubai ayaa iyaduna ganacsi maraakiib oo faa’iido badan leh ka maamusha dekedda Jebel Ali oo ku dhow marin-biyoodka. Joogitaanka Mareykanka Joogitaanka joogtada ah ee ciidamada badda Mareykanka ee Gacanka wuxuu dib ugu laabanayaa 1971, markaas oo Mareykanku la wareegay saldhig ay Britain ku lahayd Bahrain, kaas oo markii dambe noqday xarunta Taliska Shanaad ee Ciidamada Badda Mareykanka. Joogitaanka militari ee Mareykanka ee Gacanka ayaa tobannaan sano ee xigay sii ballaartay, isagoo gaaray 30,000 oo askari oo ku kala sugan saldhigyo ku yaalla Kuwait, Sacuudi Carabiya, Qatar iyo Imaaraadka Carabta. Hase yeeshee, weerarrada Iran ku qaaday saldhigyadaas ayaa Pentagon-ka ku qasbay inuu ciidamo dib u kala raro, isla markaana si weyn ugu tiirsanaado saldhigyo ka baxsan Gacanka oo ka nuglaan yar weerarrada. Isbeddelkaas ayaa muujinaya sida dagaalku durba wax uga beddelay qaabka ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka. “Waxay durba si wax ku ool ah nooga saareen Gacanka Faaris marka laga hadlayo awood militari oo la adeegsan karo,” ayay tiri Rosemary Kelanic, oo madax ka ah Barnaamijka Bariga Dhexe ee Defense Priorities, kana mid ah dadka dhaliila joogitaanka militari ee Mareykanka ee Bariga Dhexe. Bilowgii dagaalka, Iran ayaa ku dhawaaqday xilli cusub oo ay ku maamuli doonto Hormuz. Madaxda Tehran ayaa xakameynta marin-biyoodka u arka dammaanad amni oo la mid ah barnaamijkooda nukliyeerka iyo kaydkooda gantaallada. Iran ayaa sameysay hay’ad dowladeed oo lagu magacaabo Persian Gulf Strait Authority, waxayna dalbatay in milkiilayaasha maraakiibta ay hay’adda iska diiwaangeliyaan si ay Hormuz uga gudbaan, isla markaana ay lacag caymis ah bixiyaan. Mareykanka ayaa cunaqabateyn saaray hay’addaas, isagoo ku hanjabay ciqaab shirkad kasta oo maraakiib ah oo la macaamisha. Inkasta oo Mareykanku diidan yahay in Iran ay maamusho marin-biyoodka, ciidamada badda Mareykanka ayaa intii dagaalku socday marar kooban oo keliya halis u galay inay galaan Gacanka Faaris, howlgaladaasna waxay ahaayeen kuwo muddo gaaban socday. Shirkadaha maraakiibta ganacsiga ayaa iyaguna ka caga-jiidaya inay Hormuz maraan iyagoo aan helin dammaanad ah in Iran aysan weerari doonin. Guud ahaan, isu-socodka Hormuz ayaa si weyn u curyaamay. Xubnaha mayalka adag ee Tehran ayaa sheegaya inay dhaqan gelin doonaan dalabyadooda. Mowqifka adag ee Iran Mohsen Rezaei, oo ah taliye hawlgab ah oo ka tirsanaa Ilaalada Kacaanka isla markaana la-taliye dhow u ah Hoggaamiyaha Sare Mojtaba Khamenei, ayaa Khamiistii sheegay in Iran aysan oggolaan doonin in waddooyin kale laga sameeyo marin-biyoodka. Chris Long, oo horay uga tirsanaa ciidamada badda Britain ee Gacanka Faaris, haddana madax ka ah sirdoonka shirkadda la-talinta maraakiibta ee Neptune P2P Group, ayaa sheegay inuu filayo in qulqulka tamarta ee marin-biyoodka uu “sannado badan ahaan doono mid gaabis ah oo hooseeya.” Saraakiisha Khaliijka ayaa qiraya in heshiiska la soo jeediyay uu Tehran siinayo maamul Hormuz ah, isla markaana maamulkaasi uu noqon karo mid joogto ah, balse waxay sheegayaan in xilligan ay tahay ikhtiyaarka ugu wanaagsan ee ay haystaan. Ilaalada Kacaanka ayaa muujisay inay diyaar u tahay inay xiisadda sii kordhiso, islamarkaana dagaalka ka dhigto mid sida ugu macquulsan qaali ugu noqda xulafada Mareykanka ee gobolka. Dalalka Khaliijka ayaa durba eegaya qorshayaal ay Hormuz uga leexan karaan, iyagoo ballaarinaya dhuumaha shidaalka ee taga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cumaan, isla markaana kordhinaya maalgashiga kaydka shidaalka ee dibadda. Hase yeeshee, saraakiisha gobolka ayaa sheegaya in waddooyinka kale aysan ka hortagi karin in Ilaalada Kacaanka ay weerarto kaabayaasha tamarta haddii aan la helin heshiis nabadeed oo lagu kalsoonaan karo. items.title: Israa’iil oo sheegtay in ay xoojineyso xiriirka Imaaraatka, Somaliland iyo Giriigga
items.description: Wasiirka Israa’iil u qaabilsan Arrimaha Qurba-joogta, Amichai Chikli, ayaa sheegay in dalkiisa ay muhiim u tahay inuu sii adkeeyo xiriirrada uu la leeyahay Somaliland, Giriigga, Qubrus iyo Imaaraadka Carabta. Chikli ayaa hadalkan jeediyay xilli Israa’iil ay si dhow ula socoto isbeddellada ku soo kordhaya iskaashiga siyaasadeed iyo kan amni ee Bariga Dhexe iyo guud ahaan gobolka. Warbaahinta Clash Report ayaa sheegtay in wasiirku carrabka ku adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in Israa’iil ay horumariso oo ay qoto-dheereyso xiriirka ay la leedahay afarta dhinac ee uu xusay, kuwaas oo uu u arko kuwo muhiim u ah danaha istiraatiijiga ah ee Israa’iil. Geesta kale, Chikli wuxuu walaac ka muujiyay iskaashiga sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan, kaas oo lagu tilmaamay Isbahaysiga Makka. Wasiirku wuxuu arrintan ku tilmaamay isbeddel halis ah oo mudan in si gaar ah loo fiiriyo, wuxuuna xusay in Sacuudiga uu muddo dheer xiriir dhinaca difaaca ah la lahaa Pakistan, balse waxa uu tilmaamay inuu walaaca ugu weyn ka muujiyay suuragalnimada in Riyadh ay si weyn ugu dhowaato Ankara, taasina ay khatar ku tahay jiritaanka Israa’iil. Sikastaba, hadalka kasoo yeeray wasiirka arrimaha Qurba-joogta Israa’iil, ayaa imaanaya iyada oo dhowaan magaalada Barakeysan ee Makka, ay heshiis difaac ee Makka, kaasi oo khatar ku tilmaameen wadamada gobolka. items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo maanta dooranaya guddoomiye cusub iyo laba musharrax oo is haya
items.description: Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta u fadhiya doorashada guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha, kaddib markii xilka uu bannaanaaday bilo ka hor. Doorashada ayaa waxaa ku tartamaya laba musharrax oo kala ah Cabdulkadir Maxamed Nuur “Jaamac” iyo Cabdulkadir Cumar Macallin “Daada”, kuwaas oo labaduba helay shahaadooyinka musharraxnimo, sida uu sheegay Guddiga  doorashadu. Xilka guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa bannaanaaday kaddib markii Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) loo doortay Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Tan iyo 20-kii Juun, Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Koowaad ee Golaha Shacabka Sacadiyo Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar ayaa xilkan si kumeelgaarka ah u sii haysay. Labada musharrax ayaa olole xooggan sameeyay, iyadoo doorashadan ay ku soo beegantay xilli siyaasadda Soomaaliya ay marayso marxalad xasaasi ah, gaar ahaan doodaha ku saabsan wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka, nidaamka doorashooyinka iyo mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Doorashada ayaa ka socota xarunta Baarlamaanka ee Villa Hargeysa, waxaana la filayaa in xildhibaannadu ay codkooda si qarsoodi ah ugu dhiibtaan labada musharrax. Musharraxa hela codadka ugu badan ee waafaqsan xeerarka doorashada ayaa noqonaya guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka wuxuu hayaa xil muhiim ah oo ka mid ah hay’adaha ugu sarreeya dowladda Federaalka, maadaama uu hoggaamiyo aqalka hoose ee Baarlamaanka, isla markaana uu door weyn ku leeyahay hagidda howlaha sharci-dejinta iyo ajandayaasha baarlamaanka. Natiijada doorashada ayaa si weyn loo sugayaa, iyadoo ay tahay mid saamayn ku yeelan karta jihada siyaasadeed ee Baarlamaanka iyo xiriirka u dhexeeya dhinacyada kala duwan ee siyaasadda Soomaaliya.

items.title: Somalia iyo QM oo ka wada-hadlay arrin xasaasi ah si loo ilaaliyo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa Axaddii ku qaabilay xafiiskiisa Ku-xigeenka Ergayga Gaarka ah ee Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, ahna Isku-duwaha Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada, Mudane George Conway, iyo Wakiilka UNICEF u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, Marwo Sandra Lattouf, iyaga oo ka wada-hadlay arrimo ku aadan xaaladda carruurta Soomaaliyeed. Ugu horreyn kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga u dhexeeya Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Qaramada Midoobay iyo UNICEF ee ilaalinta carruurta ay saameeyeen colaadaha hubeysan, iyadoo qayb ka ah hirgelinta siyaasadda qaran ee ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah. Sidoo kale, waxaa kulanka lagu soo qaaday sidii loo dhisi lahaa hannaan isku-duwan oo lagu soo tebiyo, lagu diiwaangeliyo, lagulana socdo eedeymaha la xiriira xadgudubyada, loona xaqiijin lahaa in jawaabaha iyo tallaabooyinka muuqda ee Dowladda Soomaaliya si sax ah loogu muujiyo warbixinnada khuseeya ee Qaramada Midoobay. Waxaa kale oo kulanka lagu falanqeeyay dardargelinta qorshe-howleedka qaran ee carruurta iyo colaadaha hubeysan, sida lagu sheegay warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya. Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo madasha ka hadla ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay horumarka ay Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ka sameeyeen ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah, gaar ahaan carruurta, isagoo xusay in ciidamadu ay u howlgalaan si waafaqsan siyaasadaha qaranka iyo waajibaadka caalamiga ah ee khuseeya ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah. Fiqi ayaa Qaramada Midoobay iyo UNICEF uga mahadceliyey iskaashiga iyo taageerada joogtada ah ee ay la garab taagan yihiin dowladda Soomaaliya. Wuxuu sidoo kale dib u xaqiijiyey sida ay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga uga go’an tahay xoojinta wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha ay khuseyso, si loo sii adkeeyo ilaalinta carruurta iyo dadka rayidka ah ee ay saameeyeen colaadaha hubeysan. Soomaaliya ayaa kamid ah dalalka ay weli ka jiraan colaadaha hubeysan, waxaana dhibaatooyinka ugu badan ay kasoo gaaraan dadka nugul, sida carruurta, haweenka iyo dadka da’ah ee ku dhaqan meelaha ay ka jiraan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ciidan ee iska soo horjeeda, gaar ahaan dagaallada tooska ah. items.title: Soomaali loo qabtay toogasho iyo dil ka dhacay meel u dhow xarunta ICE ee Portland
items.description: Portland (Caasimada Online) – Booliska magaalada Portland ee gobolka Oregon ayaa gacanta ku dhigay Mahmoud Said Ali, oo 42 jir ah, kaas oo loo haysto dilka nin kale oo lagu magacaabi jiray Anwar A. Osman, kadib toogasho ka dhacday meel u dhow xarun ay leedahay hay’adda socdaalka Mareykanka ee ICE. Mahmoud ayaa la xiray aroornimadii Sabtida, 8-dii Agoosto, kadib markii baarayaasha dambiyada dilalka ay ku raadjoogeen, xaafad ku taalla waqooyi-bari magaalada Portland ee gobolka Oregon, sida uu sheegay Taliska Booliska Portland. Booliska ayaa sheegay in Mahmoud lagu xiray xabsiga Multnomah County, laguna soo oogay dacwado ay ka mid yihiin dil darajada labaad ah iyo adeegsiga hub si sharci-darro ah. Warbaahinta Mareykanka qaarkeed ayaa Mahmoud ku sheegtay Soomaali soo-galooti ah, iyadoo warbixin gaar ah oo uu daabacay The Post Millennial ay xogtaas ku saleysay diiwaanno laga helay internet-ka. Booliska Portland, si kastaba, waxa ay si rasmi ah ugu tilmaameen oo keliya nin deggan Portland, mana aysan shaacin dhalashadiisa ama xaaladdiisa socdaalka. Dhibbanaha, Anwar A. Osman oo 41 jir ahaa, ayaa isna ahaa qof deggen Portland, sida ay boolisku xaqiijiyeen. Baaritaanka hordhaca ah ayaa sidoo kale lagu ogaaday in labada nin ay hore isu yaqaaneen, inkastoo aan weli la shaacin xiriirka ka dhexeeyay ama waxa sababay muranka horseeday dilka. Sidee wax u dhaceen? Dhacdada ayaa bilaabatay wax yar kadib afartii aroornimo ee Talaadadii, 4-tii Agoosto, markii sarkaal boolis ah oo roondo ku jiray uu arkay gaari ku dhacay dhisme ku yaalla South Macadam Avenue. Isla waqtigaas, dadka deegaanka ayaa telefoonno u dirayay adeegga gurmadka iyagoo sheegay inay maqleen rasaas. Markii askartu gaareen gaariga, waxay gudaha ka heleen Anwar oo miyir la’ isla markaana qaba dhaawacyo rasaaseed. Booliska ayaa gaariga kala soo baxay waxayna isku dayeen inay badbaadiyaan, balse wuxuu ku geeriyooday goobta. Xafiiska dhakhtarka baarista dhimashada ee gobolka Oregon ayaa markii dambe xaqiijiyay in Anwar uu u dhintay rasaas, islamarkaana kiiska loo aqoonsaday dil. Baarayaasha ayaa rumeysan in rasaasta la furay xilli gaadiidku ku hakaday nalalka waddada ee isgoyska South Bancroft Street iyo South Macadam Avenue. Ninka lagu tuhunsan yahay inuu rasaasta furay ayaa kadib goobta gaari kaga baxsaday, halka gaarigii Anwar uu hoos u dhaqaaqay ilaa uu ugu dambeyn ku dhacay dhisme ku dhow goobta. Telefishinka maxalliga ah ee FOX 12 ayaa sheegay in Anwar ay haleeshay rasaas dhowr ah. Baarayaasha dambiyada dilalka ayaa maalmo kadib dhacdada ku qaatay ururinta iyo falanqeynta caddeymaha, wareysiga markhaatiyaasha iyo dabagalka xogaha la helayay, ka hor inta aysan Mahmoud u aqoonsan qofka lagu tuhunsan yahay dilka. Fiidnimadii Jimcaha ayay boolisku heleen xog muujineysa halka uu ku sugnaa, waxaana howlgalka lagu xirayay lagu daray ciidamada gaarka ah ee SERT iyo kooxda qaabilsan wada-xaajoodka xaaladaha halista ah. Mahmoud ayaa ugu dambeyn la qabtay qiyaastii 3:30 aroornimo, isaga oo ku sugnaa aagga 13100 ee Northeast Glisan Street. Booliska weli ma shaacin in gacanta lagu dhigay hubkii lagu fuliyay dilka. Muhiimadda goobta Dhacdada ayaa markii hore si weyn indhaha u soo jiidatay sababtoo ah waxay ka dhacday meel aad ugu dhow xarunta ICE ee Portland, oo bilihii iyo sanadihii dambe xuddun u ahayd dibadbaxyo ka dhan ah siyaasadaha socdaalka ee dowladda federaalka Mareykanka. Hase yeeshee, booliska ayaa sheegay in ilaa hadda aysan jirin wax caddeyn ah oo dilka xiriirinaya xarunta ICE ama howlaha socdaalka ee ka socda halkaas. “Marka laga reebo isku dhawaanshaha goobaha toogashada iyo shilka,” ayay boolisku sheegeen, ma muuqato in xarunta ICE ay wax xiriir ah la leedahay dhacdada. Warbaahinta maxalliga ah ee KATU ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in baarayaashu aysan helin xiriir u dhexeeya dilka iyo howlaha xarunta. Booliska sidoo kale ma aysan soo bandhigin wax caddeyn ah oo muujinaya in dilku la xiriiray asal, dhalasho ama xaalad socdaal oo labada nin midkood ah. Mahmoud Said Ali ayaa weli ku jira xabsiga, iyadoo baaritaanka kiiska uu socdo, waxaana boolisku ugu baaqeen qof kasta oo haya xog la xiriirta dhacdada inuu la xiriiro waaxda dambiyada dilalka ee Portland. The post Soomaali loo qabtay toogasho iyo dil ka dhacay meel u dhow xarunta ICE ee Portland appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Iiraan oo baahisay muuqaal cusub oo laga duubay Hoggaamiyaha Sare Mojtaba Khamenei
items.description: Warbaahinta Iiraan ayaa baahisay muuqaal naadir ah oo lagu arkayo Hoggaamiyaha Sare ee Iiraan, Mojtaba Khamenei, xilli ay sii socdeen su’aalaha iyo hadal-heynta ku saabsan xaaladdiisa iyo maqnaanshihiisa muuqaalka dadweynaha. Wakaaladda wararka ee Mehr ayaa muuqaalka ku baahisay Telegram iyo baraha kale ee ay isticmaasho 8-dii Agoosto 2026. Muuqaalka ayaa muujinaya Khamenei oo ay hareer taagan yihiin dhowr qof, isaga oo u muuqda inuu la hadlayo ama cashar siinayo dadka ku xeeran, balse warbixinta Mehr laguma sheegin goorta ama goobta saxda ah ee muuqaalka laga duubay, sidoo kalena lama aqoonsan dadka kale ee muuqaalka ka muuqda. Muuqaalka ayaa soo baxay xilli ay jireen warar iyo hadal-heyn xooggan oo ku saabsan caafimaadka Khamenei iyo sababta uu muddo dheer uga maqnaa muuqaalada dadweynaha, iyadoo warbaahinta Iran ay horey u sheegtay in madaxweynaha Iiraan, Masoud Pezeshkian, uu kulan la yeeshay Khamenei dabayaaqadii July, islamarkaana kulankaasi uu la xiriiray arrimo milatari, dhaqaale iyo tamar. Sida ay fallanqeeyaasha qaar sheegayaan, faafinta muuqaalka cusub waxaa loo arki karaa isku day lagu muujinayo in Hoggaamiyaha Sare uu weli firfircoon yahay, iyadoo la doonayo in la yareeyo shakiga iyo wararka ku saabsan xaaladdiisa. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, maadaama aan la shaacin taariikhda iyo goobta lagu duubay muuqaalka, muuqaalka kaligiis ma xaqiijinayo goorta la duubay ama xaaladda caafimaad ee Khamenei waqtigan.

items.title: Xogta ninka geystay toogashada oo la ogaaday
items.description: Bangkok ( Raxanreeb Online) Ninka lagu eedeeyay toogashada oo la yiraahdo Chalong Reawraeng, ayaa saddex xilli soo noqday xildhibaan baarlamaanka Thailand, waxaana markii ugu dambeysay uu ka tirsanaa xisbiga Pheu Thai. Ninkan oo 71 jir ah ayaa sannadkii 1997 lagu naanaysi jiray “cobra” (mas) , oo ah erey siyaasadeed oo Thailand looga isticmaalo xildhibaan ama siyaasi ka hor yimaada mowqifka xisbigiisa, kaddib markii uu u codeeyay musharrax raysal-wasaare oo ka socday xisbi kale. Doorashadii ugu dambeysay ayuu isu sharaxay isagoo ka socday xisbiga talada haya ee Bhumjaithai, balse kuma guulaysan inuu kursi helo. Qofka uu toogtay, Thongchai Yenprasert, waa sarkaal hore oo booliis ah, wuxuuna hadda yahay guddoomiyaha Ururka Maamulka Gobolka Nonthaburi. Ninkan oo 71 jir ah ayaa ku biiray ciidamada booliiska sannadkii 1984, wuxuuna soo noqday ku-xigeenka taliyaha iyo taliyaha saldhigyo booliis oo dhowr ah oo ku yaalla degmada Nonthaburi, oo ku taalla duleedka Bangkok. Sannadkii 2004 ayaa loo magacaabay madaxa hay’adda maamulka gobolka. Toogashadii dhacday Isniina maanta ah ayaa timid saddex maalmood oo keliya kaddib markii wiil 14 jir ah uu weerar toogasho ah ka geystay gurigooda iyo iskuulkiisa, sidoo kale gobolka Nonthaburi ee ku dhow caasimadda Thailand ee Bangkok. The post Xogta ninka geystay toogashada oo la ogaaday appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .
