items.title: Beeraley colaad uga cararay dalagyo u soo go’ay oo nolol xumo ku wajahaya Baydhabo
items.description: (ERGO) – Beeraley ku howlanaa goosashada dalagyo ay beerteen bilihii Maarso iyo Abriil ayaa colaad qabiil uga barakacay deegaanada Weelgaduude, Yaaqle iyo Daawudow oo hoostaga magaalada Baydhabo. Xeryo aysan ku haysan hoy, cunto iyo biyo ayay dantu ku qasabtay inay maciin bidaan. Beerihii ay filayeen inay uga soo kabtaan xilliyo adag oo aysan waxba tacban ayaa noqday kuwo lagu fasaxay xoolo. Qaar kale oo xaaladaas ka badbaaday ayaysan dadku ka faa’ideysan karin, colaadda qabiilka oo wali taagan deegaannadooda awgeed. Maamulka xeryaha Faanoole iyo Afar-waab dhoobey ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay inay soo gaareen 180 qoys oo hadda ku sugan xaalad hubanti la’aan ah. Aadan Ibraahim Nuur oo ku barakacay xerada Faanoole ee duleedka Baydhabo ayaa sheegay inaysan haysan waxay dabka ku shitaan. Waxa kaliya ee ay heli karaan ayaa ah raashiin bisil oo aan baahi tiri karin oo ay u keenaan dadka xerada kula nool. “Waxan carruurta aan siiyo ayaa iigu daran, inta dagaalka uusan dhicin nolosheenna way fiicneyd. Markii degaalka uu dhacay gaajo ayaan daris noqonay aniga iyo carruurta dhamaantooda.” Aadan oo ah aabbaha toddobo carruur ah ayaa xusay in dagaalku qabsaday xilli uu ku howlanaa gurista dalagyo u soo go’ay oo kala ah masago, digir iyo khudaar. Wuxuu sheegay in reerku ku tiirsanaa dalagyadaas oo hadba qeyb ay guranayeen, isagoo ku fakarayay inuu keydsado raashiin badan si xilliyada adag ee jiilaalka iyo abaaraha oo beeruhu aysan wax soo saar laheyn ay isticmaalaan. Wax ka duwan filashadiisii ayaa dhacay shantii bishan, markii si lama filaan ah uu ku qarxay dagaal qabiil oo ka dhashay isku qabsiga dhul daaqsimeed. Beertii rajada u aheyd ayuu tilmaamay in si ku talo gal ah loogu fasaxay xoolo daaqa. Waa shan hektar oo uu aaminay in dalagga uga baxay uu uga badbaaday musiibooyin ragaadiyay oo ahaa roob yari iyo cayayaan. Xaaladdaas waxaa u raacday dhibaato xasilooni darro. “Dameer xaafadda ii joogey oo gaadiid ahaa naftirkiisa xabad wiifto ah ayaa ku dhacday oo u dhintay. Beerta badar fiican ayaa noogu yaaley, badarkii waa laga soo kala orday, meeshii xoolo ayaa daaqay, sida ay tahay xitaa lama sheegi karo inay wax ka hareen iyo in kale.” Aadan oo 38 jir ah ayaa tilmaamay in gaajada ay wajahayaan ay u dheertahay in laga sugayo bixinta $300 oo ah deyn uu ku qarash gareeyay beerta. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in afar carruur ah ay ka xanuunsan yihiin muddo toddobaad ah, islamarkaana woodin inuu geeyo goobaha caafimaadka ee lacagta ah. Xerada ayuu sheegay inaysan ku haysan hu’ iyo hoy ka xajiya qabowga habeenkii iyo qoraxda maalinkii. Wuxuu tilmaamay inay u sii dheertahay warwar dhanka ammaanka ah, maadaama dhaca tuugada iyo hadal heyntoodu ay tahay xaalad mar kasta taagan. Xeradan oo ay u soo lugeynayeen muddo 6 saac ah ayuu sheegay in nolosheedu adag tahay oo aysan ka jirin wax adeegyo bulsho ah, sida caafimaadka, waxbarashada iyo biyaha. Carruurtiisa oo baran jiray Qur’aanka ayuu xusay inuu u waayay Dugsi uu geeyo. Helitaanka biyaha ayaa ah mid adag. Wuxuu tilmaamay in caagado dushooda ay ku qaadan uga soo dhaansadaan ceel biyood bilaash ah oo u jira masaafo loo lugeeyo soddon daqiiqo. Dagaalka qabiilka ayaa ah mid sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac. Xal lagama gaarin wali, taasina waa mid uga sii dareysa nolosha qoysaska soo barakacay oo aan u adkeysan karin cunto yarida iyo dhaqaale la’aanta ay colaaddu biday. Ekow Isxaaq Maxamed oo ka mid ah dadka uu saameeyay ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay in deegaanka Qoriile ay uga soo carartay raashiin u keydsanaa oo ahaa boqol kiilo oo ah masago iyo galley, hoygii ay degganaayeen iyo agabkii yiilay. Waxay sheegtay in raashiinka u keydsanaa oo iskugu jiray mesego iyo digir uga baxayay beerteeda oo 4 hektar ah oo ay guran laheyd bishan ay ahaayeen waxa kaliya ee noloshoodu ku tiirsaneyd. Xerada ay tagtay oo lagu magacaabo Afar-waab dhoobey oo ku taalla magaalada Baydhabo ayay sheegtay in ay ka dawarsato, xaaladdaas hoy xumo ayaa u wehlisa. “Jiifka aad iyo aad ayuu u xun yahay, qof derin isiiyay iyo jeex yar aan hore u soo qaatay oo aan la soo orday, qof dhabarkiisa wax ku soo qaaday oo gaari aan ku soo guurin oo silac ku yimi ayaan nahay. Ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ee tababarka ku qaata Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale helay tababarro ciidan oo casri ah, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo sare u qaadista aqoonta, anshaxa iyo awoodda hawlgelineed ee ciidanka. Kulamada uu Janaraalku la yeelanayo madaxda milatariga Turkiga ayaa la filayaa inay gacan ka geystaan xoojinta xiriirka difaaca ee labada dal, iyo in la sii ambaqaado qorshayaasha lagu horumarinayo tababarka, qalabaynta iyo tayada Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, wada-shaqeynta milatari ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa loo arkaa mid ka mid ah tiirarka muhiimka ah ee xiriirka labada dal, iyadoo Ankara ay sannadihii u dambeeyay si gaar ah uga shaqaynaysay taageerada dhismaha hay’adaha amniga iyo ciidamada Soomaaliya.

Dhibaatadu ayaa la sheegay in aysan koobneen oo keliya carruurtu dugsiyada ka maqnaadaan, balse waxay halis ku tahay mustaqbalkooda oo dhan; waxaana sii kordhaya waxbarasho lumista, dhaawacyada maskaxeed iyo khatarta ah in jiil dhan laga tago. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee doorashada guddoomiyaha BF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta oo Isniin ah ka dhaceysa Muqdisho, sida uu horay jadwal ugu shaaciyay guddiga maamulaya doorashada. Qaban-qaabadii ugu dambeysay ee doorashada ayaa saaka ka socota xarunta Villa Hargeysa oo ay haatan kusii qulquayaan Xildhibaannada Baarlamaanka, si ay usoo doortaan guddoomiye rasmi ah. Doorashadan oo si weyn isha loogu hayo ayaa waxaa illaa iyo haatan ugu cad-cad Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo qaatay shahaadada musharraxnimada, kadib markii uu isku diiwaangeliyay doorashada, wuxuuna olole ballaaran ka sameeyay magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimada Soomaaliya. Jaamac oo hadda ah Wasiirka Dekadaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda Xukuumadda Soomaaliya ayaa wxaa la tartami doono Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Cumar Macallin oo loo yaqaano (Daada) oo isna shahaadada ka qaatay guddiga maamulka doorashada. Labadan musharrax ayaa hadda isugu soo haray tartanka, maadaama ay horay u tanaasuleen musharrixiintii kale, waxaana ugu dambeeyay Saadaad Caliyow oo maalmo kahor ku dhawaaqay inuu ka haray tartanka, kadib heshiis uu la gaaray Jaamac, kaas oo ay sidoo kal garwadeen ka ahayd Villa Soomaaliya. Musharrax Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur oo xilal kala duwan kasoo qabtay xukuumadda hadda jirta ayaa la filayaa inuu soo buuxiyo kursigii uu baneeyay Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe), wuxuuna taageerada ugu badan ka helayaa Madaxweynaha iyo Ra’iisul wasaaraha, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen ilo wareedyo xilkas ah. Dhanka kale, ninka la tartamaya Jaamac oo kasoo jeeda degmada Tiyeeglow ayaa loo arkaa malxiis oo kaliya, taas oo dhalisay falcelin xooggan. Si kastaba, diyaargarowgii u dambeeyay ee doorashada ayaa hadda ka scoda Muqdisho, iyada oo shalay Guddoomiyaha KMG ah ahna Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Koowaad ee Golaha Shacabka Marwo Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar ay kormeer ku tagtay goobta loo diyaariyey in ay ka dhacdo doorashada. Kormeerka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray hubinta diyaar-garowga goobta loo qorsheeyey inay ka dhacdo doorashada, iyadoo sidoo kale la eegay habraacyada iyo agabka loogu talagalay in loo adeegsado howlaha doorashada. items.title: Dawladda Iran sidee ayay u aragtaa heshiiska Sucuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan?
items.description: Falanqeeyayaashu waxay sheegayaan in heshiisku uusan Iiraan xilligan si toos ah khatar ugu ahayn, iyadoo mas’uuliyiinta Iiraan ay xoogga saarayaan dhinaca heshiiska iyo xallinta arrimaha kala dhexeeya Maraykanka. Heshiiska saddex-geesoodka ah ayaa lagu dhawaaqay in ka badan shan bilood kaddib markii Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay bilaabeen duqeymo ka dhan ah Iiraan, kuwaas oo sababay dagaal si degdeg ah ugu fiday waddamada Khaliijka, isla markaana carqaladeeyay isu-socodka maraakiibta ee marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Pakistan, Sacuudiga iyo Turkiga ayaa taxaddar weyn muujiyay si aysan u carqaladeyn ama uga hor imaan dhinac kasta oo gobolka ama caalamka ah, xilli ay soo gabagabeynayeen heshiiskan oo ay sheegeen inuu ka dhashay sannado badan oo shaqo iyo wada-xaajood ah. Waxay carrabka ku adkeeyeen in heshiisku oo aan si gaar ah uga dhex muuqan halis amni uusan ka dhan ahayn waddan gaar ah, gaar ahaan Iiraan, isla markaana uusan burin ama beddelin heshiisyo kale oo hore ay ula galeen dhinacyo kale. Jawaabta ay Tehraan illaa iyo hadda waa mid diblomaasiyadeed oo degan, iyadoo mas’uuliyiintu xoogga saareen iskaashiga gobolka iyo kan Muslimiinta, iyo sidoo kale waxa ay u arkaan inuu yahay heshiiskan mid muujinaya in hoos uu ku yimid saameyntii Mareykanka ee waddamadaan. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan, Cabbas Araghchi, ayaa Jimcihii yiri “marka Muslimiintu midoobaan, waxaan si wadajir ah uga hortagi karna caqabad kasta oo ay dibadda noogu soo maleegaan dhinacyo xun.” “Waa waqtigii aan isku tiirsanaan lahayn oo keliya, isla markaana aan qaadan lahayn walaaltinimada dhabta ah,” ayuu ku qoray bartiisa X, isaga oo aan si toos ah u xusin heshiiska saddex-geesoodka ah ee ay kala saxiixdeyn Sacuudiga, Pakistaan iyo Turkiga. Bbc somali

items.title: Siciid Deni oo sheegay inuusan mar saddexaad u tartami doonin madaxtinnimada Puntland
items.description: Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa hadal uu ka jeediyay magaalada Gaalkacyo ku sheegay inuusan doonayn inuu mar saddexaad u tartamo xilka Madaxweynaha Puntland, isagoo xusay in dastuurku u oggol yahay inuu xilka qabto laba xilli oo keliya. Deni ayaa sheegay in isaga iyo ururka siyaasadeedkiisa Kaah ay diyaarin doonaan musharrax u tartama doorashada Puntland marka uu dhammaado muddo-xileedkiisa hadda. Madaxweyne Deni ayaa markii ugu horreysay xilka Puntland loo doortay 2019, waxaana mar kale loo doortay 8-dii Janaayo 2024, isagoo helay 45 cod oo ka mid ah 66-da xubnood ee Baarlamaanka Puntland. Hadalkiisa ayuu ku sheegay in qof kasta oo doonaya xilka Madaxweynaha Puntland uu diyaar u yahay inuu galo doorasho xor ah oo waqtigeeda ku dhacda, halka Kaah uu isaguna yeelan doono musharrax uu u diyaariyo tartanka madaxtinnimada. Arrintan ayaa imanaysa xilli dood siyaasadeed ay ka taagnayd mustaqbalka Deni iyo doonistiisa xilka Madaxweynaha Federaalka oo uu hadda ka hor mar u tartamay. Dastuurka maamulka Puntland ayaa qaba ah in mudada xil-haynta Madaxweynuhu ay tahay shan sano ah oo hal, islamarkaana dib loo dooran kara mar labaad.

items.title: Hamza Meets with Farmaajo in Mogadishu as Somalia Moves Toward New Election Talks
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s political landscape may be entering a new phase of negotiations after Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre paid a late-night visit to former President Mohamed Abdullahi Farmaajo at his residence in Mogadishu, with the two reportedly discussing the country’s deepening political crisis and the search for an electoral agreement. The meeting comes at a particularly sensitive moment, as the Federal Government and opposition groups prepare for another round of discussions aimed at resolving long-running disagreements over Somalia’s next elections. According to sources familiar with the meeting, the Prime Minister and the former president discussed the country’s political situation, with electoral arrangements reportedly featuring prominently in their conversation. The meeting also comes ahead of an expected gathering during this month, August, between senior government officials and opposition leaders, where the competing sides are expected to revisit the framework for the next national election. A Possible Opening for Compromise For months, repeated attempts to bring the government and opposition together have produced little progress. Previous negotiations frequently stalled over disagreements about the electoral model, with the Federal Government insisting on a one-person, one-vote system while opposition groups questioned whether the necessary political, administrative and security conditions existed to implement it. The political landscape may now be shifting. Sources say a significant portion of the opposition has moved closer to accepting the principle of direct elections, but has demanded that the process be administered by a joint or broadly representative electoral commission capable of winning the confidence of all major political stakeholders. That demand could provide the basis for a compromise. There is growing speculation that the government and opposition may soon agree on the establishment of a mixed electoral body tasked with negotiating and implementing the practical arrangements required for the next election. If such an agreement is reached, it could represent one of the most important breakthroughs in Somalia’s prolonged political standoff. The Road to a Hassan Sheikh–Opposition Meeting Political sources told WardheerNews, that there is a growing optimism that an agreement on the election model and electoral commission that could pave the way for a direct meeting between President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and senior opposition leaders. Such a meeting would carry considerable political significance after months of confrontation and failed negotiations. The opposition delegation is expected to include former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni, and Jubaland President Ahmed Mohamed Islam (Ahmed Madobe) under the umbrella of the Samato Bixinta  Council. Farmaajo, meanwhile, is expected to represent his Nabad iyo Nolol political organization. The participation of Farmaajo adds another important dimension to the political calculations. As a former president and one of Hassan Sheikh’s principal political rivals, his involvement could help broaden the opposition’s negotiating position while also providing an additional channel for dialogue with the Federal Government. A Narrowing Political Divide The developments suggest that the political divide may no longer center exclusively on whether Somalia should hold direct elections. Instead, the emerging debate appears increasingly focused on how those elections should be organized, who should oversee them, and what guarantees are required to ensure that the process is accepted by both government and opposition forces. That shift could prove crucial. For months, the two sides appeared trapped in fundamentally opposing positions. The government’s insistence on one-person, one-vote was viewed by much of the opposition as insufficient without agreement on the institutions and rules governing the process. If the opposition is now prepared to accept direct elections in principle while the government is willing to consider a more inclusive electoral commission, the distance between the two camps may have narrowed considerably. Prime Minister Hamza’s decision to meet Farmaajo privately is also significant because Somalia’s political disputes have increasingly become intertwined with personal rivalries among the country’s former and current leaders. Farmaajo remains an influential political figure with a substantial constituency, particularly among those critical of the current administration. His participation in any future political settlement could therefore be important not only for the electoral process but also for building broader political legitimacy around whatever agreement eventually emerges. The challenge will be transforming private consultations into a national political agreement that extends beyond the interests of individual leaders. A Fragile Opportunity Despite the renewed optimism, significant obstacles remain. Previous attempts at dialogue have repeatedly collapsed after initial signs of progress. Questions surrounding the composition of the electoral commission, constitutional authority, the electoral timetable, federal-state relations and the distribution of political power could all return to the negotiating table. The credibility of any future agreement will ultimately depend on whether the major political actors believe that the electoral process is genuinely impartial. For Somalia, the stakes are enormous. A negotiated electoral framework could reduce political tensions, strengthen confidence in state institutions and prevent the country from entering another prolonged constitutional crisis. But failure could once again deepen the confrontation between Villa Somalia and its opponents, with potentially serious consequences for the country’s already fragile political and security environment. For now, however, the meeting between Hamza and Farmaajo offers a small but potentially significant signal that Somalia’s political leaders may be searching for a way out of the impasse. The next test will be whether that private conversation can help produce something Somalia has struggled to achieve for years: an electoral agreement broad enough for both government and opposition to accept—and a political transition whose legitimacy is not disputed before the first ballot is cast. items.title: Cali Jeyte oo mar kale hoggaamin kara Macawiisleyda Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa sheegaya in Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud uu ka fekerayo suurtagalnimada in uu u yeero Cali Jeyte Cismaan, si uu u hoggaamiyo Ciidanka Difaaca Shacabka (Macawiisley) ee Gobolka Hiiraan. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa wada dadaalo lagu xakameynayo dhaqdhaqaayqada sii xoogeysanaya ee Al Shabaab ka waddo bariga gobolkaasi, iyadoo maleeshiyada ay illaa sanadkii hore culeys amni ku haysay deegaanada xorta ah ee gobolka. Ciidamada ayaa waxay dhibaato ka haysataa inay joojiyaan weerarada is ballaarinta ee Al Shabaab iyo in ay jaraan gurmadka iyo saadka maleeshiyada ee bariga iyo galbeedka gobolkaasi iyo isu socodkooda Gobolada Koonfurta & Bartamaha. Sarkaal ka tirsan Xarunta Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Muqdisho ayaa Universaltv u sheegay in Taliyaha Militariga uu haysto dhowr ikhtiyaar oo miiska saaran, si wax looga qabto xaaladda Gobolka Hiiraan, isla-markaana xulashooyinka horyaalla uu qayb ka yahay Cali Jeyte Cismaan oo laba jeer soo noqday Gudoomiyaha Gobolka Hiiraan. Sarkaal kale oo ka tirsan Militariga Somaliya ayaa sheegay in Cali Jeyte loo arko nin gacan ka gaysan kara in ciidamadu ay xaqiijiyaan yoolalka dagaalka ee gobolkaasi. General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa la sheegaya in uu tixgelin karo in Jeyte uu ka caawiyo gulufka ka dhanka ah Al Shabaab, bacdamaa uu khibrad u leeyahay dagaalka maleeshiyada, isla-markaana uu ciidamadu u horseedi karo guul ay xilligan adag ka gaaraan dagaalka. Jeyte ayaa si weyn uga dhex muuqday dagaaladii lala galay Al Shabaab, intii uu socday wejiga koowaad ee hawlgalka dib u xoreynta dalka ee sanadihii 2022 iyo 2023 laga sameeyay gobolkaasi, markaas oo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Macawiisleyda ay maleeshiyada ka saareen bariga gobolka. Jeyte ayaa bishii September ee sanadkii 2022 abaabulay oo horkacay kacdoon dadweyne oo lagaga soo horjeedo Shabaabka Gobolka Hiiraan, markii dambena ku fiday Gobolada Shabellaha Dhexe, Galgaduud iyo Mudug. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo kaashanaya dadka deegaanka ee hubka u qaatay inay iska difaacaan Al Shabaab ayaa sanadihii 2022 iyo 2023 Shabaabka ka saaray ku dhawaad toddobaatan boqolkiiba (70%) dhulkii ay ka haysteen deegaanada Hirshabelle iyo Galmudug, inkastoo maleeshiyadu ay dib u soo qabsatay inta badan deegaanadii laga kiciyay, ka dib markii uu hakad ku yimid hawlgalkii lagu la dagaalamayay. Khubarada dhanka militariga ayaa kuu sheegaya in hawlgalkaasi laga bartay in muddo gaaban lagaga adkaan karo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, isla-markaana ay ka jilicsan yihiin sidii la moodayay. Jeyte ayaa 29-kii bishii October ee sanadkii 2023 loo magacaabay U Qaybsanaha Xafiiska Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ee Arrimaha Ciidanka Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley, balse doorkiisa hoggaamineed ee ciidamada ayaa hoos loo dhigay amaba la xaddiday labadii sano ee u dambeysay, sababtuna waa in Villa Somalia ay ka mashquushay la dagaalanka Al Shabaab, iyadoo u jiheysatay wax ka bedelka & dhameystirka Dastuurka KMG iyo arrimaha doorashooyinka dalka. Jeyte ayaa waxaa suurtagal ah in mar kale uu hoggaamiyo Macawiisleyda, waa haddii Taliye Ibraahim uu ku qanco in uu hoggaanka qabto, isla-markaana uu ogolaansho uga helo Madaxda Dowladda Federaalka.

items.title: Xildhibaanada oo Xarunta Villa Hargeisa ku dooranaya Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka
items.description: Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Somaliya ayaa Isniinta maanta ah Magaalada Muqdisho ku dooranaya Gudoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka. Gudoomiyaha cusub ayaa lagu dooranayaa Xarunta Golaha Shacabka ee Villa Hargeisa, taas oo ku dhex taala Madaxtooyada Qaranka (Villa Somalia). Waxaa xilka Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka isu diiwaangeliyay laba musharax oo Guddiga Doorashada Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ay Sabtidii guddoonsiiyeen shahaadada musharaxnimada, oo kala ah Xildhibaan Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) iyo Xildhibaan Cabdiqaadir Cumar Macalin (Daada). Ka hor doorashada, labada musharax ayaa u leh hadal-jeedin ay ku soo bandhigayaan taariikhdooda, qorshahooda siyaasadeed iyo waxa ay qaban doonaan, haddii la doorto. Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka ayaa qaab qarsoodi ah ku dooran doona Gudoomiyaha cusub, iyadoona Xarunta Villa Hargeisa lagu diyaariyay sanaadiiqdii ay Xildhibaanadu ku codayn lahaayeen. Doorashadan ayaa waxaa maamulaya guddi ka kooban sagaal xubnood oo la magacaabay 2-dii bishan, isla-markaana uu Gudoomiye u yahay Xildhibaan Cabdirisaaq Cumar Maxamed. Xildhibaan Jaamac oo hadda ku magacaaban Wasiirka Dekedaha & Gaadiidka Badda Somaliya ayaa la filayaa in uu ku guuleysan doono jegada Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ay Jaamac ku gacan siineyso inuu ku guuleysto doorashadan, si uu u bedelo Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo afartii sano ee u dambeysay ahaa Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Mr. Madoobe ayaa 10-kii bishii June loo doortay in uu noqdo Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Jaamac waxaa lagu tilmaamaa mid ka mid ah xubnaha aadka ugu dhow Madaxda Dowladda Federaalka iyo saaxiibka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Jaamac oo horey u soo noqday Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Wasiirka Caddaaladda iyo diblomaasi ka soo shaqeeyay Safaaradda Somaliya ee Turkiga ayaa lagu tiriyaa inuu ka mid yahay masuuliyiinta saameynaya saaxada siyaasadda Dowladda Federaalka, isla-markaana xiriir dhow la leh madaxda sare ee dalka.

items.title: Somalia’s Lost Opportunities: The Cost of Putting Narrow Interests Before the Common Good
items.description: By Abdisalam Ali Farah (Biligsey) History occasionally presents nations with defining moments—rare opportunities capable of changing the trajectory of generations. Some are created by diplomacy, others by political transitions, international circumstances, or moments of crisis. What distinguishes successful nations is often not the absence of difficult choices, but their ability to recognize such moments and place the long-term national interest above immediate political, personal, or factional advantage. Somalia’s modern history can, in many respects, be understood as a history of missed opportunities. While historians may debate the significance of individual events and the choices available to Somali leaders at different moments, one recurring pattern is difficult to ignore: the repeated failure to place the common good above narrower interests. The Missed Opportunity of 1946 One of the earliest examples frequently cited is the proposal associated with British Foreign Secretary Ernest Bevin in 1946, which envisioned bringing Somali-inhabited territories within a broader political framework under British administration during a transition toward eventual self-government. Whether Bevin’s proposal could realistically have been implemented remains a matter of historical debate. Colonial rivalries, competing European interests, and the emerging international order after the Second World War created formidable obstacles. Yet for many Somalis, the proposal represented something larger: an opportunity to pursue Somali territorial unity through diplomacy and international negotiation rather than through decades of confrontation. The opportunity passed. What followed was a complicated struggle for independence and unification, eventually leaving Somali-inhabited territories divided among different political administrations. Unity Pursued Through Conflict After independence in 1960, the aspiration to unite Somali territories remained one of the most powerful ideas in Somali political life. The dream itself enjoyed broad popular support. The tragedy was that its pursuit increasingly became intertwined with military confrontation. Somalia’s governments sought to advance national unity through a combination of diplomacy, political pressure, and military force. The resulting conflicts imposed enormous human and economic costs and placed increasing pressure on the country’s young institutions. The pursuit of national unity through war ultimately produced a painful paradox: a project intended to strengthen the Somali nation contributed to the weakening of the state itself. Military expenditures grew, political tensions intensified, and the country became increasingly vulnerable to internal divisions and external pressures. The lesson was profound, but Somalia would continue to face moments in which short-term calculations overshadowed long-term national interests. 1991: The Collapse of the State The collapse of the Somali state in 1991 was perhaps the most consequential missed opportunity of the modern era. Civil war devastated the country. State institutions disintegrated. Communities were displaced, livelihoods destroyed, and famine claimed countless lives. The international community intervened in 1992 with the immediate objective of delivering humanitarian assistance and, eventually, helping Somalia rebuild a functioning national government.But the international intervention became entangled in Somalia’s internal armed conflict. The confrontation between international forces and Somali factions culminated in violent battles that profoundly changed the international community’s approach to Somalia. The experience contributed to a growing reluctance among external actors to undertake another ambitious nation-building effort in the country. For Somalia, the consequences were enormous. At precisely the moment when the country most desperately needed sustained international engagement, reconstruction became fragmented, political reconciliation remained elusive, and the country entered a prolonged period of institutional weakness. Another opportunity had been lost. The Politics of 2022 More recently, Somalia’s 2022 presidential election offered another important test of political judgment. More than 30 candidates competed for the presidency before Parliament ultimately elected Hassan Sheikh Mohamud to a second term. Supporters regarded his return as an opportunity to bring experience and political maturity to a country facing profound security, economic, and institutional challenges. Critics, however, argued that his previous record should have weighed more heavily in Parliament’s decision and raised concerns about political patronage, corruption, and the continuing influence of clan calculations in the electoral process. Whatever one’s political assessment of Hassan Sheikh’s presidency, the 2022 election illustrates a broader challenge that has repeatedly confronted Somalia: how to reconcile immediate political interests with the long-term requirements of national development. The question is not simply who wins an election. It is whether political institutions are capable of making decisions based on the interests of the country as a whole. The Common Thread The episodes are separated by decades, different political systems, and dramatically different circumstances. Yet they share a troubling common thread. Somalia has repeatedly struggled to place the common good above narrower loyalties. At different times, personal ambition, factional competition, clan calculations, institutional weakness, and short-term political survival have influenced decisions that carried consequences far beyond the individuals who made them. This does not mean that every historical setback was caused by Somali leaders alone. Colonialism, Cold War geopolitics, regional rivalries, foreign intervention, environmental disasters, and international decisions have all profoundly shaped Somalia’s trajectory. But acknowledging external forces should not prevent Somalis from examining their own choices. Nations are not destroyed only by the decisions of their enemies. They can also be weakened by the inability of their own political and social elites to recognize when compromise, restraint, and collective interest are more valuable than victory for one faction. The Cost of Missed Opportunities The cost of these missed opportunities has been enormous. It has been measured in lives lost, generations displaced, institutions destroyed, investments abandoned, businesses closed, communities divided, and young people forced to seek opportunities elsewhere. But perhaps the greatest cost has been the erosion of public trust. When citizens repeatedly witness institutions being used for narrow political interests, they lose faith in government. When political competition becomes a struggle for control of resources rather than a contest over ideas and national priorities, institutions become weaker. And when clan, faction, or personal loyalty consistently overrides national responsibility, the very idea of a shared Somali future becomes harder to sustain. This is why the debate about Somalia’s future cannot be reduced to constitutional formulas, electoral systems, or individual political leaders. The deeper challenge is political culture. A Different Future Is Still Possible History does not have to dictate Somalia’s future. The country still possesses enormous human and economic potential: a young population, a strategic geographic location, extensive coastlines, livestock resources, fisheries, a growing private sector, and a diaspora with considerable skills and financial capacity. But potential alone is not enough. Somalia needs institutions capable of thinking beyond electoral cycles and political personalities. It needs leaders willing to make decisions whose benefits may not be visible during their own tenure. It needs citizens and political actors prepared to recognize that national prosperity cannot be built by one clan, one party, one administration, or one faction acting alone. Most importantly, Somalia needs a political culture in which national interest is not merely a slogan but a governing principle. No country is given unlimited opportunities. History occasionally opens a door, but the door does not remain open forever. Once a moment has passed, it may never return in the same form. Somalia has already lost too many such moments. The challenge now is not to recover the past, but to recognize the next opportunity when it arrives—and to have the courage, wisdom, and national vision to seize it. The central lesson is simple: a society that consistently sacrifices the common good for narrow interests eventually discovers that even those narrow interests cannot be protected. Peace, prosperity, stability, and national dignity are collective achievements. They require institutions that serve the public, leaders who think beyond themselves, and citizens who understand that the future of the nation is ultimately a shared responsibility. Somalia’s greatest opportunity may therefore not be a single political event or international initiative. It may be the opportunity to change the way the country makes decisions. And that opportunity is still within reach. Abdisalam Ali Farah (Biligsey) Email: biligsey2005@gmail.com The post Somalia’s Lost Opportunities: The Cost of Putting Narrow Interests Before the Common Good appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: UN puts Somalia mission assets up for sale as Washington pulls plug on AUSSOM lifeline
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS) has opened a public tender for licensed auctioneers to liquidate a sprawling inventory of mission property, from vehicles and heavy construction machinery to modular housing units and medical laboratories, in the clearest signal yet that the UN is bracing for the possible shutdown of the logistics backbone underpinning Africa’s largest peacekeeping operation. The request for expressions of interest, posted August 6 on the UN Global Marketplace, seeks Somalia-based firms to manage the commercial disposal of assets belonging to UNSOS, which supplies fuel, transport, and roughly 240 tonnes of food each month to African Union peacekeepers fighting Al-Shabaab across the country. The notice arrives as UNSOS confronts the prospect of closing entirely by December 31, 2026, after the United States moved to cut off the funding that keeps it running. On July 1, Washington formally notified the African Union it would end its financial support for UNSOS once the current mandate for the AU Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) lapses at year’s end. The US supplies roughly a quarter of the UNSOS budget and has gone further than simply withdrawing its own share: it has signaled it will block any UN Security Council effort to preserve the existing funding mechanism altogether, leaving the mission little room to improvise a workaround. Acting Head of UNSOS Qurat ul Ain Sadozai has called the moment a critical juncture for the office’s future in Somalia. Officials familiar with internal contingency planning say staff have been told to prepare for every scenario, including total closure within five months. A five-day window, and a warehouse of assets on the block The tender itself moves at a pace that reflects the urgency behind it. Companies have until August 11 — just five days after the notice was published — to register interest via the UN Global Marketplace, present valid licenses, and demonstrate a physical presence inside Somalia. The initial contract runs three months, with three optional three-month extensions contingent on performance, and the UN has reserved the right to cancel the requirement outright or split the award among multiple vendors. The scale of what could go on the block is significant: vehicle fleets, generators, IT equipment, shipping containers, security watchtowers, wastewater treatment plants, prefabricated accommodation materials, and heavy construction machinery accumulated over nearly two decades of UN logistical support to peace operations in Somalia. Corruption watchdogs raise alarm over oversight gaps The prospect of liquidating millions of dollars in mission assets inside one of the world’s most opaque procurement environments has drawn swift criticism from anti-corruption advocates. Somalia sits tied with South Sudan at the bottom of Transparency International’s 2025 Corruption Perceptions Index, and critics argue the auction notice offers no visible mechanism for independent monitoring of the sale. Their concerns are sharpened by a 2025 internal audit from the UN Office of Internal Oversight Services (OIOS), which found systemic weaknesses inside UNSOS, including a 30 percent vacancy rate in its procurement section and incomplete records covering the disposal of UN-owned property. Civil society analysts in Mogadishu warn that offloading mission infrastructure without transparent safeguards risks eroding public trust and could open the door to the illicit diversion of state assets — a risk they say is amplified, not reduced, by the compressed submission timeline. Kampala summit ends without a financing deal, Amani Africa warns The tender lands just days after African leaders failed to resolve the funding question that triggered it. The pan-African think tank Amani Africa, in an analysis of the July 31 Extraordinary Summit of AUSSOM troop-contributing countries held in Kampala, concluded that the gathering closed without securing financing, without a political agreement with Somalia’s federal government, and without a credible contingency plan for the mission’s worst-case scenario. According to Amani Africa, the summit’s headline outcome — a call for an 18-to-24-month UN-mandated support arrangement to sustain AUSSOM through a security transition — amounted to little more than an aspiration. Foreign ministers from troop-contributing nations were tasked with forming a joint diplomatic outreach group and organizing a donors’ conference, but the summit committed no actual funds and secured no binding pledge from any partner. The think tank noted that an earlier attempt to convene a full donors’ conference never materialized, and pointed to the failure of a prior High-Level Financing Event on the margins of the UN General Assembly as evidence that the pattern is unlikely to break this time. Compounding the diplomatic setback, summit organizers were unable to persuade President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government to commit to political dialogue with Somalia’s opposition over the country’s unresolved election crisis — a precondition several delegations, including Uganda’s, had pushed as essential to sustaining international confidence in the mission. Analysts say that failure leaves troop-contributing countries approaching Washington from a position of diminished leverage, unable to point to political progress in Mogadishu as justification for continued American engagement. Amani Africa’s blunt assessment is that, absent a genuine collective breakthrough, each troop-contributing country will now need to plan for its own exposure individually rather than rely on a joint AU financing solution that has repeatedly failed to materialize. What a UNSOS withdrawal would mean on the ground UNSOS provides the integrated logistical spine that keeps AUSSOM’s roughly 11,000 to 12,000 troops and police officers supplied, fed, fuelled, and mobile across a country where commercial supply chains remain fragile and dangerous. Military planners warn that without that backbone, the African Union mission could become operationally unsustainable within months, potentially forcing a premature drawdown of peacekeepers at a moment when Al-Shabaab has been making territorial gains in central Somalia. High-level diplomatic talks are continuing in New York, Addis Ababa, and Mogadishu as officials search for a replacement financing model before the December 31 deadline. But with Washington opposed to preserving the existing UNSOS mechanism through the Security Council, and Kampala having failed to produce a binding alternative, the auction now underway in Mogadishu stands as the most concrete sign yet of how seriously the UN is treating the possibility that its logistical presence in Somalia may not survive the year. items.fullContent: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS) has opened a public tender for licensed auctioneers to liquidate a sprawling inventory of mission property, from vehicles and heavy construction machinery to modular housing units and medical laboratories, in the clearest signal yet that the UN is bracing for the possible shutdown of the logistics backbone underpinning Africa’s largest peacekeeping operation. The request for expressions of interest, posted August 6 on the UN Global Marketplace, seeks Somalia-based firms to manage the commercial disposal of assets belonging to UNSOS, which supplies fuel, transport, and roughly 240 tonnes of food each month to African Union peacekeepers fighting Al-Shabaab across the country. The notice arrives as UNSOS confronts the prospect of closing entirely by December 31, 2026, after the United States moved to cut off the funding that keeps it running. On July 1, Washington formally notified the African Union it would end its financial support for UNSOS once the current mandate for the AU Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) lapses at year’s end. The US supplies roughly a quarter of the UNSOS budget and has gone further than simply withdrawing its own share: it has signaled it will block any UN Security Council effort to preserve the existing funding mechanism altogether, leaving the mission little room to improvise a workaround. Acting Head of UNSOS Qurat ul Ain Sadozai has called the moment a critical juncture for the office’s future in Somalia. Officials familiar with internal contingency planning say staff have been told to prepare for every scenario, including total closure within five months. A five-day window, and a warehouse of assets on the block The tender itself moves at a pace that reflects the urgency behind it. Companies have until August 11 — just five days after the notice was published — to register interest via the UN Global Marketplace, present valid licenses, and demonstrate a physical presence inside Somalia. items.title: Families Wait in Agony as Pakistan Pushes for Release of Crew Held by Somali Pirates
items.description: Islamabad (WD) — Pakistan is intensifying diplomatic efforts to secure the release of several of its citizens being held by Somali pirates, as the prolonged captivity places growing emotional and psychological pressure on the crew members and their families thousands of miles away. The Pakistani nationals were members of the crew of a vessel that was hijacked off the Somali coast and are believed to have fallen into the hands of Somali piracy networks seeking a ransom for their release. For the families of those being held, however, the negotiations are about far more than money. They are waiting anxiously for news of loved ones whose safety remains uncertain, with every day in captivity bringing renewed fear and uncertainty. Pakistan’s Foreign Ministry said it remains actively engaged in efforts to secure the crew’s release and expressed hope that ongoing diplomatic contacts will eventually produce a safe outcome. A ministry spokesperson said Pakistan has been communicating with the Somali Federal Government and other relevant authorities in an effort to coordinate the release of the hostages. But Islamabad acknowledges that the situation is complicated by the location where the crew members are being held. According to the Pakistani government, the hostages are believed to be in an area administered by Puntland, a Federal Member State of Somalia that maintains its own security and administrative structures and has frequently had political disagreements with the Federal Government in Mogadishu. That fragmented political and security environment has complicated international efforts to respond to incidents along Somalia’s coastline. “One of the challenges in securing the release of the crew is that they are being held in an area that is self-administered within Somalia, which makes efforts to secure their safe release from the pirates more difficult,” the Pakistani Foreign Ministry spokesperson said. Despite the difficulties, Islamabad says it has not abandoned efforts to bring the crew home. Pakistani officials said they have maintained contacts with the Somali Federal Government, Puntland authorities and other parties capable of influencing the situation, seeking a coordinated approach that could secure the hostages’ safe release. The case also highlights the continuing vulnerability of commercial shipping along Somalia’s long coastline, where piracy, although dramatically reduced from the peak of the piracy crisis more than a decade ago, remains a serious threat whenever security conditions deteriorate. For the families of the Pakistani crew, those broader geopolitical and security questions are painfully personal. They are waiting for husbands, fathers, sons and brothers to return home. While diplomats negotiate and authorities navigate Somalia’s complex political landscape, the fate of the crew remains uncertain. Their families can only hope that the ongoing contacts will lead to a breakthrough—and that the men will ultimately return home safely. For Islamabad, the priority is clear: secure the crew’s freedom without further endangering their lives. For their families, the objective is even simpler—to hear that their loved ones are finally coming home. items.title: Xamza oo caawa kulan xasaasi ah la yeeshay Farmaajo + Ujeedka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa caawa booqasho ugu tegay Madaxweynihii hore Maxamed Cabdullahi Maxamed (Farmaajo) oo haatan ku sugan magaalada Muqdisho. Ujeedka kulankan yaa ku saabsanaa salaan iyo is-xog-wareysi, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen mas’uuliyiin ku dhow xafiiska Ra’iisul wasaaraha. Sidoo kale, labada mas’uul ayaa isla soo qaaday xaaladda-siyaasadeed ee dalka iyo arrimaha doorashooyinka oo weli uu ka taagan yahay muran xooggan, maadaama ay isku hayaan Villa Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka. Kulanka Xamza iyo Farmaajo ayaa kusoo aaday xilli xasaasi ah, isla markaana la filayo in dhawaan ay dib u bilowdaan wada-hadallada Dowladda Federaalka iyo Mucaaradka, kuwaas oo ay garwadeen ka tahay beesha caalamka. Sidoo kale waxa la filayaa in todobaadyadan la sameeyo guddi isku-dhaf ah oo ka shaqeynaya sidiii loo gaari heshiis ku aadan is mariwaaga labada dhinac, si xal loogu helo muranka daba dheeraaday ee ka taagan doorashooyinka dalka. Si kastaba, Farmaajo ayaa horay u muujiyay dabacsanaan ku aadan qodobada ay la timid Villa Somalia, gaar ahaan arrimaha la xiriira doorashooyinka, isaga oo aqbalay nooca doorasho ee ay soo bandhigtay Dowladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya, inkastoo ay diideen xubnaha Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed. Soomaaliya ayaa haatan ku jirto marxalad xasaasi ah oo kala dhalatay xaaladda kala guurka ee uu dalka ku jiro, waxaana daba dheereeyay fashilka wada-hadallo dhowr wareeg ah oo ay yeesheen dowladda iyo mucaaradka. items.title: Somalia: Puntland President Deni rules out bid for third term
items.description: Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni has confirmed that he will not seek a third term in office, ending speculation over whether he would attempt to remain in power beyond his current mandate.

items.title: Somali Defense Minister Meets Senior UN Delegation in Mogadishu
items.description: MOGADISHU — Somalia’s Minister of Defense, Ahmed Maallin Fiqi, convened a high-level bilateral meeting today with senior United Nations officials in Mogadishu to align strategic priorities on regional security and humanitarian intervention. The UN delegation included George Conway, Deputy Special Representative of the Secretary-General for Somalia and Resident Humanitarian Coordinator, and Sandra Lattouf, UNICEF Representative for Somalia. Discussions centered on critical stabilization efforts, peacebuilding, and the coordination of international assistance. Minister Fiqi presented the Federal Government of Somalia’s strategic outlook on national security and briefed the officials on ongoing military and stabilization operations aimed at restoring long-term regional stability. The meeting focused on expanding structured collaboration between federal authorities and UN entities to streamline emergency aid delivery and bolster institutional support for vulnerable populations affected by persistent socio-economic and environmental pressures. items.title: DANAB oo nolosha ku soo qabatay horjoogihii qaraxyada Al-Shabaab iyo ilaaladiisa
items.description: Afgooye (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa waxaa laga helayaa howlgal qorsheysan oo maanta ciidamada kumaandooska Danab ay ka sameeyeen deegaanka Dadumaay oo ka tirsan gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Danab ayaa howlgalka ku beegsaday maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab oo u qaabilsanaa dhanka qaraxyada iyo dilalka qorsheysan, kadib xog sirdoon oo ay heleen. Saraakiil ka tirsan Xoogga Dalka ayaa sheegay in howlgalkan lagu soo qabtay horjooge ka tirsanaa khawaarijta iyo laba xubnood oo la socday, kuwaas oo xilliga lasoo qabanayay maleegayay dhagar lagu dhibaateynayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, waxay saraakiishu sheegeen in horjoogaha la qabtay uu kooxda u qaabilsanaa sameynta qaraxyada iyo howlgallada deegaannada isku xira magaalooyinka Kuntuwaarey iyo Afgooye ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Xubnaha lasoo qabtay ayaa waxaa haatan ku socda baaritaanno dheeraad ah, maadaama lagu soo qabtay, iyaga oo falkii gacanta kula jira. Howlgalkan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada ay waddo dowladda Soomaaliya ee lagu beegsanayo maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab, waxaana muddooyinkan sii laba jibaarmay weerarrada iyo duqeymaha ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada. Gulufka Al-Shabaab ayaa mar kale ay dowladdu dib usii amba qaaday, kadib markii uu dhawaan Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iclaamiyay duulaan culus oo kama dambeys ah oo dalka looga xoreynayo kooxaha Khawaarijta. items.title: An Election in Form Not In Substance
items.description: By Halima Ismail Ibrahim Since the collapse of Somalia’s military regime in 1991, the country’s political landscape has been defined by severe conflict, structural instability, and ongoing security challenges. Yet, amidst this volatility, the nation established a rare and essential political precedent: the peaceful transfer of executive power. Through successive electoral cycles, incoming and outgoing administrations, despite intense disagreements and efforts by incumbent leaders to prolong their mandates, ultimately acquiesced to negotiated political settlements. This recurring consensus became the bedrock of modern Somali state-building and a safeguard against total systemic collapse. That tradition now faces a pivotal crisis under President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, who unilaterally extended his term following its expiration on May 15, 2026. Under the guise of an ambitious transition to universal suffrage, his administration is promoting a “one-person, one-vote” model, but a centralizing tactic to mask an autocratic power grab. However, beneath this democratic narrative of universal suffrage lies a strategic initiative to alter the political timetable. Through a combination of political pressure, or toppling defiant regional leaders, and golden parachute packages for compliant ones, President Hassan has centralized authority to hand pick leadership successions across Federal Member States under his Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP) flagship. In a number of dominant-party or authoritarian political systems, the ruling party often establishes, sponsors, or encourages the formation of smaller satellite parties to create the appearance of political pluralism and competitive elections. While these parties formally participate in the electoral process, they generally pose little or no genuine challenge to the governing party. Instead, they are frequently allocated a limited number of parliamentary seats and once elected, consistently support the ruling party’s legislative agenda. Variations of this political model have been observed in countries such as Djibouti, Uganda, and Comoros. Viewed from this perspective, I find it surprising that some observers now argue that the Towfiiq Party was unfairly treated. If there is evidence that the party was denied seats in Mogadishu and South West State, it is reasonable to ask why these concerns were not raised with the same urgency at the time those events allegedly occurred.  The current developments in Galmudug appear to raise similar questions, suggesting that the issues being debated today may not be new but rather part of a broader and more consistent political pattern. Equally important are the questions surrounding the formation and political alignment of the JSP, including whether it genuinely represented Ahlu Sunna Wal Jama’a or was instead associated with individuals aligned with Sheikh Mohamud. Likewise, if Sheikh Shakir had exercised decisive political influence over the process, one might reasonably question whether the current outcome would have unfolded in the same manner. More broadly, the current debate illustrates an important lesson about dominant-party systems. The existence of multiple political parties does not, by itself, guarantee meaningful political competition. The essential question is whether those parties operate independently and possess a genuine capacity to compete for power. Where opposition parties are dependent on, aligned with, or ultimately supportive of the ruling party, the electoral process may project the image of democratic competition while leaving the underlying balance of political power fundamentally unchanged. For this reason, evaluating the credibility of an electoral process requires looking beyond the number of parties participating. It requires careful examination of the independence of political actors, the fairness of the electoral environment, and whether elections provide voters with a genuine opportunity to choose among competing political alternatives. Moreover, consistency is essential. If similar concerns arise across different regions and electoral processes, they should be assessed according to the same standards rather than only when they affect a particular part of a political constituency. The existence of multiple political parties does not, by itself, guarantee meaningful political competition. The essential question is whether those parties operate independently and possess a genuine capacity to compete for power. Where opposition parties are dependent on, aligned with, or ultimately supportive of the ruling party, the electoral process may project the image of democratic competition while leaving the underlying balance of political power fundamentally unchanged. For this reason, evaluating the credibility of an electoral process requires looking beyond the number of parties participating. It requires careful examination of the independence of political actors, the fairness of the electoral environment, and whether elections provide voters with a genuine opportunity to choose among competing political alternatives. Moreover, consistency is essential. If similar concerns arise across different regions and electoral processes, they should be assessed according to the same standards rather than only when they affect a particular part of a political constituency. items.title: Puntland Draws a Red Line: No Room for Parallel Armies
items.description: Bosaso (WDN) — Puntland has intensified its military pressure on forces aligned with Somalia’s Federal Government, making clear that it will not accept the existence of parallel armed formations operating outside the authority of the Puntland state. Puntland forces have moved into Baxo-raako district in Karkaar region in pursuit of troops described by Puntland authorities as federal-aligned forces that withdrew from Carmo in Bari region overnight and subsequently moved into Karkaar. According to local sources who spoke with WardheerNews, , Puntland troops have continued advancing toward Kodmo, an area within Baxo-raako where the federal-aligned forces are reportedly positioned. The movement has sharply increased tensions in the area, with fears growing that a direct confrontation could erupt between the two forces. Puntland’s Red Line The confrontation reflects a much deeper dispute than a single military deployment. At its core is Puntland’s insistence that there can be only one legitimate military command within its territory. Puntland authorities have repeatedly warned that armed units operating under the command of the Federal Government cannot establish independent military positions or move through Puntland territory without authorization from the regional administration. The latest military movements suggest that the Puntland government is now prepared to enforce that position on the ground. Officials have previously called on the federal-aligned forces to surrender and integrate into Puntland’s formal security structures. The message now appears increasingly stark: surrender and submit to the state’s authority, or face military action. The arrival of Puntland forces near Kodmo has transformed what had been a political and administrative dispute into an increasingly dangerous security confrontation. Local communities are closely watching the developments, amid concerns that fighting between forces drawn from the same broader population could result in civilian casualties, displacement and further political polarization. The potential confrontation is particularly sensitive because the forces described as federal-aligned reportedly originate from the area. Any fighting could therefore carry consequences extending well beyond the battlefield, potentially deepening clan and political tensions. Puntland has nonetheless maintained that the issue is fundamentally one of state authority and military command rather than political competition. One State, One Security Structure The Puntland government’s position is increasingly explicit: it will not tolerate two competing armies operating within its territory. For the administration, allowing a separate force to maintain its own command structure under federal authority would create what it views as a parallel security system capable of challenging Puntland’s constitutional and administrative authority. The government therefore appears determined to force a resolution—either through the surrender and integration of the forces involved or through military confrontation if they refuse. The coming hours could prove decisive. If negotiations fail and the federal-aligned troops refuse to withdraw or surrender, Kodmo could become the latest flashpoint in the growing dispute between Puntland and the Federal Government over control of security forces, territorial authority and the limits of federal power. For now, Puntland has drawn its line. There will not be two armies operating in Puntland. The remaining question is whether the standoff ends through surrender and integration—or through another battle. items.title: Two Djibouti Sailors Wounded in Red Sea Clash with Suspected Smuggling Boat
items.description: Djibouti City (WDN) — Two Djiboutian naval personnel have been wounded in an armed confrontation with a boat suspected of involvement in migrant smuggling, marking an unusual escalation in a type of maritime encounter Djibouti’s security forces have faced before—but one that has now resulted in injuries to its personnel. The incident occurred in Djibouti’s territorial waters while naval forces were conducting a routine patrol, according to the country’s Ministry of Defence. Authorities said the patrol encountered a vessel approaching Djibouti’s coastline and attempted to intercept and inspect it. The boat was reportedly carrying several people and was believed to have arrived from Yemen. Instead of complying with the naval patrol, the vessel allegedly attempted to flee toward Yemen, triggering a brief maritime pursuit. According to a statement issued by the Ministry of Defence and reported by the state-run Agence Djiboutienne d’Information (ADI), the situation escalated when the suspected smuggling boat suddenly turned toward the pursuing naval forces and opened fire. Djiboutian sailors returned fire, resulting in an armed exchange in which two members of the navy were wounded. The ministry has not provided further details about the severity of their injuries or their current condition. A Familiar Challenge Takes a More Dangerous Turn Djibouti has long confronted vessels suspected of involvement in smuggling, trafficking and other illicit maritime activities in the waters surrounding the country. Its strategic location at the entrance to the Red Sea places it along one of the world’s most important maritime corridors, while its proximity to Yemen has made the waters particularly sensitive to irregular migration and cross-border criminal activity. Previous encounters involving suspected smuggling vessels have generally centered on interception, pursuit and inspection. This incident, however, represents a more serious development. The reported use of firearms against Djiboutian naval personnel—and the resulting injuries—marks a significant escalation and highlights the risks faced by security forces operating in the country’s territorial waters. Authorities have yet to disclose the identities or nationalities of the people aboard the vessel. It also remains unclear whether anyone was arrested following the confrontation or whether the boat managed to escape back toward Yemen. The absence of detailed information has left important questions unanswered, including the nature of the suspected smuggling operation, who was operating the vessel and whether those aboard were migrants, traffickers or members of an organized criminal network. Djiboutian authorities are expected to provide further details as the investigation progresses. A Strategic Maritime Security Challenge The incident comes as Djibouti continues to strengthen surveillance and security operations across its territorial waters and along the strategically important Red Sea and Gulf of Aden corridor. The country’s maritime position gives it an outsized role in regional security. Thousands of commercial vessels pass through the wider maritime corridor each year, while the region remains exposed to smuggling, trafficking, piracy and other forms of organized crime. The latest confrontation therefore serves as a reminder that maritime security operations can quickly turn dangerous, even when they begin as routine patrols. For Djibouti, the challenge is no longer simply detecting and intercepting suspicious vessels. Security forces must also be prepared for the possibility that those being pursued may resist with violence. The full circumstances surrounding the confrontation remain under investigation. But one fact is already clear: a familiar maritime security challenge has taken a more dangerous turn, with two Djiboutian sailors now injured in the line of duty. items.title: U.S. Embassy Issues Alert After Military Aircraft Reports Technical Problem Over Djibouti
items.description: Djibouti city (WDN) — The U.S. Embassy in Djibouti has issued a brief public alert urging people in the country to remain vigilant after a U.S. military aircraft experienced a reported technical problem while operating in Djiboutian airspace. The embassy’s warning provided few details about the incident. It did not identify the type of aircraft involved, disclose the condition of its crew or passengers, specify the nature of the technical problem, or say where the aircraft was headed. The embassy also did not indicate that the incident was linked to a security threat, hostile action, or any form of attack. Based on the information currently available, there is therefore no confirmed evidence that the episode involved anything beyond a reported aircraft malfunction. That lack of detail, however, has prompted heightened attention because of Djibouti’s critical role in U.S. military operations across the Horn of Africa. A Critical U.S. Military Hub Djibouti hosts some of the most important U.S. military facilities in Africa, including Camp Lemonnier and Chabelley Airfield, both of which support American military operations across the region. Chabelley Airfield is regularly used by U.S. forces and elements of the Combined Joint Task Force–Horn of Africa (CJTF-HOA) for aviation, logistical support, emergency response and other regional operations. The facility also has capabilities supporting emergency response and medical evacuation missions. Djibouti’s strategic importance is largely geographic. The country sits near the Gulf of Aden and the Bab el-Mandeb, one of the world’s most strategically important maritime chokepoints connecting the Red Sea with the Indian Ocean. For Washington, that location provides a critical platform from which to monitor and respond to security developments across the Horn of Africa, the Red Sea and surrounding maritime routes. CJTF-HOA operates across a broad regional area that includes Djibouti and maintains security partnerships and operations involving countries such as Somalia, Ethiopia and Kenya. Chabelley has also been used for exercises designed to test the U.S. military’s ability to respond rapidly to emergencies, including aviation and medical contingencies. That context makes any reported incident involving a U.S. military aircraft in Djibouti worthy of close attention. At the same time, caution is essential. The embassy’s alert, as currently reported, does not establish that the aircraft was in danger, that it made an emergency landing, or that the incident was connected to hostile activity. Nor has sufficient information been made public to determine the aircraft’s final destination or the circumstances surrounding the reported malfunction. More Questions Than Answers The most important details remain unknown: What type of aircraft was involved? What caused the technical problem? Was the aircraft able to continue its mission, return safely to base, or land elsewhere? And were all crew members and passengers accounted for? Until U.S. military or diplomatic authorities release additional information, speculation about the incident should be treated with caution. For now, the episode remains a reported aviation incident rather than a confirmed security emergency. But given Djibouti’s importance to the U.S. military presence in Africa—and the increasingly volatile security environment surrounding the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden—the embassy’s warning is likely to attract continued attention until officials provide a clearer account of what happened. items.title: Drone-ka MQ-9 Reaper ee Mareykanka oo ku burburtay Jabuuti
items.description: JABUUTI — Diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo nooca MQ-9 Reaper ah oo Mareykanku leeyahay ayaa la sheegay inay Axaddii ku burburtay dalka Jabuuti, sida ay qortay Warbaahinta dalka Jabuuti. Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Jabuuti ayaa ayaa horay u shaacisay inay la socoto xaalad ay ku tilmaantay “diyaarad ku jirta xaalad degdeg ah” oo ku sugan hawada Jabuuti. Safaaradda ayaa dadka uga digtay inay ka fogaadaan agagaarka Chabelley Airbase, halkaas oo dhacdadu la xiriirto. Warbixinta waxay sheegtay in diyaaradda la rumeysan yahay inay tahay MQ-9 Reaper, oo ah drone ay ciidamada Mareykanku si weyn ugu adeegsadaan hawlgallada ilaalinta iyo duqeymaha meelaha fogfog. Dhanka kale, warbixinta la heli karo ma bixineyso faahfaahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan sababta uu drone-ku u burburay. Sidoo kale, lama xaqiijin in diyaaradda la soo riday, cilad farsamo ku timid ama ay sabab kale keentay.

items.title: MUUNGAAB oo Dahab guddoonsiiyay gabdhihii Imtixaanka kaalmaha hore galay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho, Mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), ayaa Axadda maanta ah hoggaamiyay munaasabad lagu shaaciyay natiijada Imtixaanka Shahaadiga ah ee Fasalka 8-aad ee Dugsiyada Dhexe, isaga oo Dahab iyo abaal-marinno kale guddoonsiiyay ardayda galay kaalmaha hore. Munaasabadda oo lagu shaaciyay magacyada iyo xogta Ardayda galay saddexda kaalin ee ugu sarreysa kuwaasi oo kala ah: 𝐊𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝟏𝐚𝐚𝐝; Sumayo Xasan Abshir Aadam, 𝐊𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝟐𝐚𝐚𝐝; Balqiisa Maxamed Cumar Maxamed, 𝐊𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝟑𝐚𝐚𝐝; Axmed Cabdinaasir Cabdullaahi Cabdi Guddoomiye Muungaab ayaa ardeyda guuleysatay guddoonsiiyay abaal-marinno isugu jiray, Dahab, Computer Laptop iyo hadiyado kale, si loogu dhiirrigeliyo dadaalkooda waxbarasho iyo kobcinta aqoontooda. Sidoo kale Guddoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, Mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), oo hambalyo u diray dhammaan ardayda ka qaybgashay imtixaanka, ayaa xusay in waxbarashadu tahay tiirka aasaasiga ah ee horumarka bulshada iyo dhismaha jiil aqoon, karti iyo mas’uuliyad leh. Waxaa kale oo uu ardayda ku boorriyay inay sii laba-jibaaraan dadaalkooda waxbarasho, kana faa’iideystaan fursadaha loo abuurayo mustaqbalkooda. Isagoo ballanqaaday in saddexda Arday ee kaalimaha galay uu Maamulka Gobolka uu si buuxda uga daboolayo qarashka waxbarashada dugsiga sare. Sida lagu sheegay xogta natiijada, imtixaanka waxaa galay ilaa 45,452 arday, kuwaas oo muddooyinkii lasoo dhaafay sugayay natiijada kaddib markii la soo gabagabeeyay hannaanka sixitaanka waraaqaha imtixaanka. Agaasinka Waxbarashada Gobolka Banaadir ayaa sheegay in ardayda gabdhaha ah ee imtixaanka galay ay tiradoodu ahayd 20,666, halka wiilashuna ay ahaayeen 23,351 arday, iyadoo tirada guud ay muujinayso baaxadda imtixaanka sanadkan. Natiijada la shaaciyay ayaa muujisay in 44,017 arday ay ku guuleysteen imtixaanka, halka ay ku dhaceen 1,435 arday. Tirada ardayda dhacday ayaa u dhiganta qiyaastii 3.2 boqolkiiba ardaydii imtixaanka u fariisatay. The post MUUNGAAB oo Dahab guddoonsiiyay gabdhihii Imtixaanka kaalmaha hore galay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Garaadka Macmalka ah oo Soomaaliya ka Caawinaya Saadaalinta Meelaha Gaajadu ku Fidi Karto
items.description: MUQDISHO, Soomaaliya — Garaadka macmalka ah (AI) ayaa loo adeegsanayaa si loo saadaaliyo deegaannada ay khatarta gaajo iyo nafaqo-darro ka sii dari karto, iyadoo hay’adaha gargaarku ay doonayaan inay tallaabo qaadaan ka hor inta aysan xaaladdu noqon mid aad u daran. Barnaamijka Cunnada Adduunka ee Qaramada Midoobay (WFP) ayaa adeegsanaya HungerMap Live, oo ah nidaam xogeed isku dara xogta roobabka iyo cimilada, fatahaadaha, qiimaha cuntada, colaadaha iyo xaaladda nafaqada si loo aqoonsado meelaha ay xaaladaha bani’aadantinimo u badan tahay inay ka sii daraan. Burhakaba oo tusaale u noqotay Mid ka mid ah meelaha nidaamkan uu ka caawiyay WFP inay si hore ah u ogaato baahida ayaa ah Burhakaba ee gobolka Bay, halkaas oo carruur badan ay wajahaan nafaqo-darro daran. Markii xogta la helay ay muujisay in xaaladdu sii xumaan karto, WFP waxay gargaar cunto oo degdeg ah gaarsiisay 48,000 qof, halka ku dhowaad 3,000 haween iyo carruur ah la gaarsiiyay taageero dhinaca nafaqada ah. Simon Renk, oo madax ka ah falanqaynta nuglaanta iyo khariidaynta ee WFP Soomaaliya, ayaa sheegay in nidaamku hay’adda u saamaxayo inay khatarta ogaato ka hor inta aysan xaaladdu gaarin heer aad u daran. Soomaaliya iyo khatarta cunto-yarida Soomaaliya ayaa weli wajahaysa xaalad bani’aadantinimo oo culus, iyadoo malaayiin qof ay la tacaalayaan cunto yari, barakac, abaaro iyo saameynta colaadaha. WFP ayaa sheegtay in ku dhowaad 6 milyan oo Soomaali ah ay ku jiraan xaalado cunto yari oo daran, iyadoo baahida jirta ay ka badan tahay awoodda hay’adaha gargaarka ay ku gaarsiin karaan taageero dhammaan dadka u baahan. AI oo loo adeegsanayo digniin hore HungerMap Live 2.0, oo WFP soo bandhigtay bishii April, ayaa lagu daray awoodaha garaadka macmalka ah ee ka caawinaya saadaalinta meelaha ay gaajadu u badan tahay inay ku fido ama xaaladda cunto-yaridu ka sii darto. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, WFP waxay sheegtay in AI uusan beddel u ahayn shaqaalaha iyo xogta laga helo goobaha ay xaaladuhu ka jiraan. Halkii, waxaa loo adeegsanayaa inay hay’addu si wanaagsan u kala hormariso meelaha ugu nugul iyo dadka ugu baahida badan. $192 milyan oo gargaar dheeraad ah Iyadoo baahida bani’aadantinimo ay sii kordhayso, WFP Soomaaliya waxay sheegtay inay u baahan tahay $192 milyan oo dheeraad ah inta u dhexaysa hadda iyo Janaayo 2027 si ay u sii waddo gaarsiinta gargaar muhiim ah dadka ay saameeyeen gaajada iyo nafaqo-darradu. Isticmaalka AI-ga ayaa sidaas darteed noqonaya aalad cusub oo lagu xoojinayo digniinta hore, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in gargaarku gaaro dadka nugul ka hor inta aysan xaaladdu isu beddelin musiibo bani’aadantinimo.

items.title: Muxuu RW Xamza la wadaagay Duqa Bristol? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Duqa Magaalada Bristol ee dalka Ingiriiska Yaasiin Maxamuud, oo asal ahaan Soomaali ah, isla markaana booqasho ku yimid magaalada Muqdisho. Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa Duqa Bristol la wadaagay sida ay caasimada Muqdisho uga soo kabanayso burburkii soo gaaray, gaar ahaan horumarka muuqda ee dhanka kaabeyaasha ah iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in dowladaha hoose ee Muqdisho iyo Bristol is-dhaafsadaan khibradaha maamulka iyo adeegyada bulshada. “Waxa aan maanta xafiiskayga ku qaabilay Duqa Magaalada Bristol ee dalka Ingiriiska, Mudane Yaasiin Maxamuud, oo booqasho ku yimid caasimadda Muqdisho. Guddoomiyaha waxa aan la-wadaagay sida ay caasimadaha dalkeennu uga soo kabanayaan burburkii soo gaaray, gaar ahaan caasimadda Muqdisho oo muujinaysa horumar muuqda oo dhanka kaabeyaasha ah iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in dowladaha hoose ee Muqdisho iyo Bristol, is-dhaafsadaan khibradaha maamulka, adeegyada bulshada iyo sidii loo abuuri lahaa fursadaha wax-wada qabsiga magaalooyinka,” ayuu yiri Xamza oo qoraal kasoo saaray kulanka. Sidoo kale, wuxuu Duqa Bristol uga mahadceliyay booqashada uu ku yimid caasimadda Soomaaliya ee Muqdisho si uu indhihiisa ugu arko dib-u-dhiska baaxadda leh ee ka socda dalkeenna gaar ahaanna caasimadda ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Waxaa kale oo uu bogaadiyay guulihiisa hoggaamineed ee uu xaqiijiyay wuxuuna ku dhiirrigeliyay in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo qurba-joogta Soomaaliyeed. Kulankan waxaa Ra’iisul wasaaraha ku wehlinayay Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir, ahna Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya. Duqa Magaalada Bristol ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu kulmo Madaxweynaha iyo madaxda kale ee dowladda oo uu kala hadli doono xiriirka labada dhinac.   The post Muxuu RW Xamza la wadaagay Duqa Bristol? + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxda Xukunka Haysa iyo Baahida Aragti Fog
items.description: W/Q Cabdishakuur Shuceyb Mursal Dal kasta wuxuu u baahan yahay hoggaan aan ku koobnayn danaha maanta jira, balse ka fekera halka uu dalka gaari doono tobannaan sano kadib. Mid ka mid ah caqabadaha ugu waaweyn ee dalalka dimuqraadiga ah waa marka madaxda xilka haysa ay mudnaanta siiyaan sii joogista kursiga, halkii ay xoogga saari lahaayeen dhismaha hay’adaha iyo sharciyad waarta. Danta Qaranka iyo Hay’adaha Dowladda Arrimaha xasaasiga ah sida doorashooyinka, maxkamadda dastuuriga ah, iyo madaxbannaanida hay’adaha dowladda waa in lagu saleeyaa danta guud ee qaranka, ee aan lagu salayn dan siyaasadeed oo ku eg muddo-xileedka hoggaanka jooga. Haddii go’aannada noocaas ah loo qaato si ay ugu adeegaan soo noqoshada hoggaanka hadda jooga, waxaa dhaawacma kalsoonida shacabka, waxaa daciifa hay’adaha dowladda, waxaana adkaata in la helo nidaam caddaalad iyo isla xisaabtan leh. Su’aasha Hoggaamiyaha Isweydiinayo Madaxdu waa inay isweydiiso: sharciyada iyo hay’adaha aan maanta dhisayo ma u adeegi doonaan dalka haddii aan berri xilka ka dego? Haddii jawaabtu tahay maya, waxaa jirta baahi dib loogu eego jihada la qaaday. Hoggaaminta wanaagsan waxaa lagu gartaa in la dhiso nidaam dadka u siman, iyadoo aan loo eegin cidda talada haysa maanta ama berri. Doorashooyin Xor ah iyo Maxkamad Madax-bannaan Doorashooyin xor iyo xalaal ah iyo maxkamad dastuuri ah oo madax-bannaan waxay ka mid yihiin tiirarka ugu muhiimsan ee dowladnimada. Marka hay’adahaas laga ilaaliyo faragelinta siyaasadeed, waxaa kor u kaca kalsoonida shacabka, xasilloonida siyaasadda, iyo maalgashiga mustaqbalka dalka. Gunaanad Ugu dambayn, hoggaamiyaha taariikhdu xusto ma aha kan muddo dheer kursiga ku sii nagaada, balse waa kan dhisa hay’ado adag oo sii shaqeeya xitaa marka uu xilka ka dego. Mustaqbalka dalka waxaa lagu ilaaliyaa go’aanno ku salaysan danta qaranka, caddaaladda, iyo aragti fog, ee aan ku koobnayn danaha siyaasadeed ee waqtiga gaaban. items.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo qalabkeeda Soomaaliya xaraashaysa, maxay tani ka dhigan tahay?
items.description: Qaramada Midoobay ayaa Soomaaliya ka billowday habraac lagu xaraashayo qaar ka mid ah qalab iyo agab ay ku leedahay dalka, tallaabadan oo kusoo beegmaysa xilli uu isbeddel weyn ku yimid doorkii hay’adda ee Soomaaliya. Muddo tobannaan sano ah, Qaramada Midoobay waxay Soomaaliya ku lahayd door muuqda oo dhinacyada siyaasadda, gargaarka bani’aadantinimo, dowlad-dhiska iyo taageerada amniga ah. Hase yeeshee, xaaladda Soomaaliya ayaa si tartiib ah isu beddeshay. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sanadihii ugu dambeeyay xoogga saartay in mas’uuliyadda siyaasadda, amniga iyo maamulka dalka ay si buuxda ugu soo laabato gacanta hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed. Xaraashka qalabka iyo agabka Qaramada Midoobay, sidaas darteed, wuxuu kusoo beegmayaa xilli la wajahayo marxalad cusub oo ku saabsan joogitaanka iyo howlaha hay’adaha caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya. Tallaabadan keliya looma fasiran karo inay Qaramada Midoobay gabi ahaanba ka baxayso Soomaaliya, maadaama hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay ay weli dalka ka wadaan howlo bani’aadantinimo iyo kuwo horumarineed. Si kastaba, waxay muujin kartaa in qaabka iyo baaxadda hawlihii hore loo waday ay is beddelayaan, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay si weyn u doonayso inay la wareegto mas’uuliyadaha ay muddo dheer ku tiirsaneyd taageerada caalamiga ah.

items.title: Xildhibaannada mucaaradka oo war culus kasoo saaray doorashada guddoomiyaha BF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaannada mucaaradka ee la magac baxay ‘Baarlamaanka Xorta ah’ oo maanta shir jaraa’id ku qabtay gudaha magaalada Muqdisho ayaa ka hadlay doorashada guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo lagu wado in maalinta berri ah ay ka dhacdo Villa Hargeysa. Xubnahan oo soo saaray go’aanno xasaasi ah ayaa ka horyimid doorashada berri oo ay sheegeen in lasii ogyahay natiijadeeda. Sidoo kale, waxa ay ku eedeeyeen Villa Soomaaliya inay faragelin ku hayso doorashada, isla markaana xubnihii mucaaradka loo diiday tartanka. Xildhibaan Yuusuf Gama’diid oo ka hadlay shirka jaraa’id ayaa ka warbixiyay ujeedka kulankooda wuxuuna shaaca ka qaaday in doorashada berri ay lamid tahay kuwii ka dhacay gobollada, isla markaana lasii ogyaay cidda kusoo baxaysa. “Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya biritoole hanaan lamid ah kuwii gobollada oo natiijada lasii ogyahay uu galayo, isla markaana qof kasta oo rabay inuu tartamo loo diiday tartanka, iyadoo guddigu sharci darro ku dhisnaa,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Yuusuf Gama’diid. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in Xidhibaannada mucaaradka aysan beri tegi doonin Baarlamaanka, ayna bannnaanka ka joogi doonaan doorashadaas. “Waxaa noo soo baxday in Xildhibaannadu Shahaado Zuur ka noqon waxaa iyaga ah dadkaas la dulmiyay ee xildhibaannada ah ee saaxibadeenna ah oo lacagtooda inta ay bixiyeen haddana wixii loo diidayne korkooda wax doorashado lagu sheegaayo qayb kama noqoneyno,” ayuu sii raaciyay.
