items.title: Dagaal Dhexmaray Ciidanka Jabuuti iyo kooxda Xuutiyiinta
items.description: Jabuuti (Raxanreeb Online) Laba askari oo ka tirsan ciidamada badda ee Jabuuti ayaa ku dhaawacmay iska horimaad hubeysan oo dhex maray ciidamada badda iyo doon looga shakisan yahay inay ku lug lahayd tahriibin, sida ay Sabtidii sheegtay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga dalka Jabuuti. Dhacdadan ayaa ka dhacday biyaha dhuleed ee Jabuuti, xilli ciidamada badda ay ku jireen roondo caadi ah. Ciidamada ayaa arkay doon ku soo wajahan xeebaha Jabuuti, waxaana ay isku dayeen inay qabtaan oo ay baaritaan ku sameeyaan. Sida lagu sheegay qoraal kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Jabuuti ayaa la sheegay inay ka timid Yemen, iyadoo ay saarnaayeen dhowr qof. Markii ciidamada badda Jabuuti ay u soo dhowaadeen, doontii ayaa isku dayday inay ka baxsato oo ay dib ugu cararto dhanka Yemen. Ciidamada Jabuuti ayaa bilaabay inay daba galaan doonta, waxaana halkaasi ka dhacay eryasho kooban oo badeed. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa sheegtay in intii ay daba socdeen, doontii looga shakisan yahay tahriibinta ay si lama filaan ah u soo jeesatay, kadibna ay rasaas ku furtay ciidamada badda ee Jabuuti. Ciidamada Jabuuti ayaa ka jawaabay rasaasta, waxaana iska horimaadkaasi ka dhashay dhaawaca laba askari oo ka tirsan ciidamada badda. Ilaa hadda, faahfaahin dheeraad ah lagama bixin xaaladda dadka saarnaa doonta, cidda ay ka tirsan yihiin iyo haddii ay jiraan dad lagu qabtay dhacdada. items.title: Maxey kawada hadleyn wasiir Fiqi iyo madaxda ka socotay Qaramada Midoobay?
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Onlin) Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa maanta kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Qaramada Midoobay oo ka howlgala Soomaaliya. Kulanka waxaa ka qeyb galay Ku-xigeenka Ergayga Gaarka ah ee Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, ahna Isku-duwaha Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada, George Conway, iyo Wakiilka UNICEF u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, Sandra Lattouf. Wadahadalka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray arrimaha muhiimka ah ee khuseeya xaaladda Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, arrimaha bani’aadannimada iyo taageerada shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Wasiirka ayaa mas’uuliyiinta Qaramada Midoobay la wadaagay aragtida dowladda Federaalka ee ku aaddan xaaladda dalka iyo dadaallada socda ee lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, kulanka ayaa fursad u ahaa dhinacyada in ay ka wada hadlaan sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga u dhexeeya dowladda Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay, gaar ahaan taageerada loo fidiyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee u baahan adeegyada bani’aadannimo،isla markaana la daala dhacaya duruufo nolaleed. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Qaramada Midoobay oo Xoojinaya Ilaalinta Carruurta Xilliyada Colaadaha
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa maanta Muqdisho kulan kula yeeshay Ku-xigeenka Ergayga Gaarka ah ee Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, ahna Isku-duwaha Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada, George Conway, iyo Wakiilka UNICEF ee Soomaaliya, Sandra Lattouf. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga, Qaramada Midoobay iyo UNICEF, gaar ahaan ilaalinta carruurta iyo dadka rayidka ah ee ay saameeyeen colaadaha hubeysan. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay dhismaha hannaan isku-duwan oo lagu soo tebiyo, lagu diiwaangeliyo, laguna dabagalo eedeymaha la xiriira xadgudubyada, iyo sidii tallaabooyinka Dowladda Soomaaliya loogu muujin lahaa warbixinnada Qaramada Midoobay. Sidoo kale, kulanka waxaa lagu soo qaaday dardargelinta Qorshe-hawleedka Qaran ee Carruurta iyo Colaadaha Hubeysan. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa sheegay in Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay horumar ka sameeyeen ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah, gaar ahaan carruurta, isagoo xusay in ciidamada ay howlgalladooda u fuliyaan si waafaqsan siyaasadaha qaranka iyo waajibaadka caalamiga ah ee ilaalinta rayidka. Ugu dambeyn, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga ayaa Qaramada Midoobay iyo UNICEF uga mahadceliyey taageerada iyo iskaashiga ay Soomaaliya la leeyihiin, isagoo caddeeyey in Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiggu ay ka go’an tahay sii xoojinta wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha ay khuseyso, si loo adkeeyo ilaalinta carruurta iyo dadka rayidka ah ee ay saameeyeen colaadaha.

items.title: Saadaal Siyaasadeed: Somaliland iyo Sool Bari
items.description: Xilliyada dhow waxa la filan karaa in ay soo bataan haldoorka Reer Laascaanood iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada ee dib ugu soo noqonaya Somaliland ama bilaabaya isu soo dhawaansho siyaasadeed iyo bulsho. Sidoo kale, waxa suuragal ah in ay bilowdaan heshiisyo hordhac ah oo dhex mara Somaliland iyo Sool Bari, kuwaas oo gogol-xaadh u noqon kara wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad ballaadhan. Arrinta maxaabiistuna waxay noqon kartaa meelaha ugu horreeya ee laga gaadhi karo heshiis iyo tallaabooyin kalsooni-dhis ah. Hadda waxa jira shirar muhiim ah oo magaalada Nairobi ee dalka Kenya ku dhex maray waftiga Madaxweynaha Somaliland iyo masuuliyiin isugu jira madax-dhaqameed iyo siyaasiyiin ka soo jeeda Sool Bari. Kulamadaasi waxay qayb ka noqon karaan dhaqdhaqaaqyada siyaasadeed ee gogol-xaadhka u ah isu soo dhawaanshaha labada dhinac. Dhanka kale, waxa hoos u dhici kara xidhiidhka heer bulsho ee Puntland iyo Somaliland, gaar ahaan haddii isu soo dhawaanshaha Somaliland iyo Reer Laascaanood uu sii xoogaysto. Puntland gudaheeda waxa sidoo kale ka soo bixi kara codad iyo kooxo si weyn uga soo horjeeda isu soo dhawaanshaha Somaliland iyo Reer Laascaanood, iyaga oo u arki kara isbeddelkaasi inuu saamayn ku yeelanayo miisaanka siyaasadeed iyo danaha gobolka. Isbeddelladan oo kale waa wax iska caadi ka ah siyaasadda Soomaalida dhexdeeda. Dabayluhu haddii ay shalay bari ka soo dhacayeen, berri dhinac kale ayay ka soo dhici karaan. Siyaasaddu saaxiib iyo col joogto ah ma laha, duruufaha iyo danaha ayaana jihadeeda beddela. Sultaan Abdikarim

items.title: Goobta lagu dooranayo Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo la soo bandhigay (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Gudoomiye 1aad Kuxigeenka ee Golaha Shacabka ahna Kusimaha Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar iyo xubno kale ayaa maanta kormeeray goobta lagu wado in lagu doorto Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka. Sacdiya Yaasiin, Gudoomiye Kuxigeenka 2aad ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow, Guddiga Doorashada Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdulle (Jaabiri) ayaa soo indha-indheeyay goobta loo diyaariyay in lagu qabto doorashada. “Kormeerkan ayaa ujeedkiisu ahaa hubinta diyaargarowga goobta, habraacyada doorashada iyo agabka loogu talagalay in lagu hawlgalo maalinta doorashada, si loo xaqiijiyo in dhammaan howlaha doorashadu ay u dhacaan si habsami leh, hufan oo waafaqsan habraacyada iyo xeerarka u degsan Golaha Shacabka.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Guddoonka Golaha Shacabka. items.title: Muqdisho Oo Shaacisay Natiijada Fasalka 8aad 2025-2026
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Dr. Xasan Maxamed Xuseen Muungaab, ayaa Axadda maanta ah hoggaamiyay munaasabad lagu shaaciyay natiijada Imtixaanka Shahaadiga ah ee Fasalka 8aad ee Dugsiyada Dhexe, kaas oo lagu qabtay magaalada Muqdisho. Munaasabadda waxaa lagu shaaciyay magacyada iyo xogta ardayda galay saddexda kaalin ee ugu sarreysa, kuwaas oo kala ah Sumayo Xasan Abshir Aadam (kaalinta 1aad), Balqiisa Maxamed Cumar Maxamed (kaalinta 2aad), iyo Axmed Cabdinaasir Cabdullaahi Cabdi (kaalinta 3aad). Munaasabadan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay muujinaysaa sida Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ugu go’an tahay horumarinta waxbarashada iyo dhiirrigelinta ardayda. Ardayda waxaa la guddoonsiiyay abaalmarinno isugu jiray Dahab, Computer laptop iyo hadiyado kale, si loogu dhiirrigeliyo dadaalkooda waxbarasho iyo kobcinta aqoontooda, taasoo noqonaysa mid ugu horraysa oo maamulku uu ku abaal-marinayo ardayda . Guddoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, Dr. Xasan Maxamed Xuseen Muungaab, oo hambalyo u diray dhammaan ardayda ka qaybgashay imtixaanka, ayaa xusay in waxbarashadu tahay tiirka aasaasiga ah ee horumarka bulshada iyo dhismaha jiil aqoon, karti iyo mas’uuliyad leh. Waxa uu ardayda ku boorriyay inay sii laba-jibaaraan dadaalkooda waxbarasho, kana faa’iideystaan fursadaha loo abuurayo mustaqbalkooda. Isagoo intaas ku daray, waxa uu ballanqaaday in saddexda arday ee kaalimaha galay uu Maamulka Gobolka uu si buuxda uga daboolayo qarashka waxbarashada dugsiga sare. Munaasabadda waxaa goobjoog ka ahaa mas’uuliyiin heerar kala duwan, bahda waxbarashada, macallimiin, waalidiin iyo arday. The post Muqdisho Oo Shaacisay Natiijada Fasalka 8aad 2025-2026 first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Xafiiska QM ee Soomaaliya oo xaraashaya qalabkii ka yaalay Muqdisho + Sababta
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xafiiska siyaasada ee Qaramada Midoobay (UNSOS) ayaa xaraashaya qalabkii ka yaalay Soomaaliya, sida uu xafiiska ku shaaciyay qoraal uu soo daaray. Go’aanka xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ugu xaraashayo agabka iyo qalab kala duwan oo ay hore ugu adeegsan jireen howlahooda Soomaaliya ayaa imanaya kaddib tallaabo la xiriirta xiritaanka xafiiska. Qalabka la qorsheynayo in la iibiyo waxaa kamid ah gaadiid, qalabka xafiisyada, kombiyuutarro iyo laptop-yo, matoorro, kontaynarro, qalabka caafimaadka iyo shaybaarrada, iyo mashiinnada iyo qalabka dhismaha culus, sida cagaf-cagafta. Qoraalka kasoo baxay Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya (UNSOS) ayaa lagu sheegay in la raadinayo shirkado xaraash-bixiyeyaal ah oo u qalma inay qabtaan iibinta agabka Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya. Sida ku cad ogeysiiska, Qaramada Midoobay waxay doonaysaa inay la gasho shirkad maxalli ah qandaraas soconaya saddex bilood, iyadoo ay jiri karaan laba muddo-kordhin oo midkiiba yahay saddex bilood. Shirkadaha daneynaya ayaa laga doonayaa inay buuxiyaan shuruudaha lagu xusay ogeysiiska. Tallaabadan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli Dowladda Soomaaliya ay dalbatay in albaabada loo laabo xafiis Qaramada Midoobay ah oo muddo ku lahaa Soomaaliya awood iyo door muuqda oo la xiriira arrimaha siyaasadda gudaha dalka. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa hore u muujisay in ay dooneyso in hay’adaha caalamiga ah ee dalka ka howlgala ay ixtiraamaan doorka iyo awoodda dowladda, gaar ahaan arrimaha siyaasadda iyo maamulka gudaha Soomaaliya. The post Xafiiska QM ee Soomaaliya oo xaraashaya qalabkii ka yaalay Muqdisho + Sababta appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xiisad ciidan oo mar kale ka taagan Puntland – Maxaa cusub?
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Puntland iyo ciidamadii ka diiwaangashanaa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee kasoo baxay degmada Carmo ayaa la sheegay inay isku horfadhiyaan deegaanno ka tirsan gobolka Karkaar, iyadoo xaaladda ay ka taagan tahay halkaasi ay sii abuureyso walaac laga qabo isku dhac cusub. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada labada dhinac ay ku sugan yihiin meelo isu dhow, halka odayaasha dhaqanka ee deegaannada Xumbays iyo Rako-Raaxo ay wadaan dadaallo waan-waan iyo wada-hadal ah oo lagu doonayo in lagu qaboojiyo xiisadda ka dhalatay is-hor-fadhiga ciidamada. Puntland ayaa dhankeeda ku adkeysanaysa mowqifkeeda ah in deegaannadeeda aysan ka hawlgeli karin ciidan aan ka amar qaadan maamulka, iyadoo sheegtay in ciidamada hore uga diiwaangashanaa Dowladda Federaalka lagu sameynayo dib-u-qaabeyn iyo tababar. Xiisaddan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay soo baxayaan walaacyo ku saabsan halka ay ku dambeyn doonaan ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka ee kasoo baxay Carmo, kuwaas oo muddooyinkii dambe ku sugnaa deegaano ka tirsan Puntland. Boqor Cabdirashiid Boqor Cumar oo ka mid ah isimada dhaqanka ee gobolka Bari ayaa maamulka ugu baaqay inay ka fiirsato tallaabo kasta oo xaaladda uga sii dari karta, gaar ahaan in ciidamada looga daba tago deegaannadii ay kasoo jeedeen. “In ciidamadan looga daba tago deegaannadoodii, iyadoo bulshada deegaannadaas ay horey tabashooyin u qabeen, adeegga dowladduna aanu si buuxda u gaarin, waxay abuuri kartaa xaalad adag oo cawaaqibkeedu aanu wanaagsanayn,” ayuu yiri Boqor Cabdirashiid. Boqorka ayaa sheegay inuu rajeynayo in dowladda ay si wanaagsan u fahmi doonto xaaladda, isagoo ugu baaqay inay ciidamadan kasoo celiso deegaanka, kana fogaato tallaabo kasta oo keeni karta iska horimaad iyo xiisad hor leh. Si kastaba, Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa kulamo la leh bulshada Puntland iyo Galmudug ee magaalada Gaalkacyo, kaddib dagaalladii dhawaan halkaasi ka dhacay, iyadoo dadaallada lagu dejinayo xaaladda amni iyo siyaasadeed ee magaalada ay weli socdaan. The post Xiisad ciidan oo mar kale ka taagan Puntland – Maxaa cusub? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Nin Soomaaliya usoo waday Drone oo lagu xiray magaalada…
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) — Booliska Kenya ayaa magaalada Nairobi ku xiray nin lagu qabtay diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo nooca drone-ka ah, taas oo la sheegay in loo sii waday magaalada Beled-Xaawo ee gobolka Gedo. Ninka la xiray oo lagu magacaabo Mohamud Hared ayaa Jimcihii lagu qabtay shirkad xamuul oo ku taalla xaafadda Eastleigh ee Nairobi, kadib markii uu halkaas u tagay inuu kala wareego baakad laga soo diray Shiinaha. Warbixin boolis ayaa lagu sheegay in baakadda uu soo diray qof lagu magacaabo Abdi Kafi, balse shaqaalaha shirkadda xamuulka ay ka shakiyeen kadib markii ay ogaadeen in si adag loo xirxiray, isla markaana aan hore loo caddeyn waxa ku jira. Hared ayaa la sheegay inuu lacagta lagu keenay xamuulka ku bixiyay adeegga M-Pesa, kadibna codsaday in baakadda loo furo. Markii la furay, waxaa gudaha laga helay drone qeybihiisa la kala furfuray iyo qalab kale oo la socda. Maamulka shirkadda xamuulka ayaa kadib la xiriiray booliska, kuwaas oo goobta yimid, isla markaana gacanta ku dhigay Hared. Waxaa loo qaaday saldhigga booliska Pangani si su’aalo loo weydiiyo. Drone-ka oo loo waday Beled-Xaawo Booliska Kenya ayaa sheegay in Hared uu baarayaasha u sheegay in drone-ka loo waday magaalada Beled-Xaawo ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo la qorsheynayay in marka hore la geeyo Mandera oo ku taalla xadka Kenya iyo Soomaaliya. Sida ku cad xogta booliska, qalabka waxaa Mandera kala wareegi lahaa nin lagu magacaabo Yussuf Abdi Abdille oo lagu sheegay inuu deggan yahay magaalada xadka ku taalla. Ma cadda sababta drone-ka loo geynayay Beled-Xaawo iyo cidda ugu dambeyn isticmaali lahayd, waxaana booliska Kenya ay sheegeen in baaritaan lagu hayo ujeeddada qalabka iyo dadka kale ee ku lugta leh soo dejintiisa iyo gudbintiisa. Hared ayaa weli ku jira gacanta booliska, iyadoo baarayaashu isku dayayaan inay ogaadaan halka uu kasoo bilowday qorshaha lagu soo diray drone-ka iyo cidda dhab ahaan iska lahayd. Booliska Kenya ayaa muujiyay walaac ah in qalabka noocan oo kale ah loo adeegsan karo falal amni-darro, balse ilaa hadda ma aysan soo bandhigin caddeyn muujineysa in drone-kan gaarka ah loogu talagalay weerar ama fal argagixiso. Qabashada ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli hay’adaha ammaanka Kenya ay si gaar ah ula socdaan dhaqdhaqaaqyada ka jira deegaannada ku teedsan xadka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan Mandera, halkaas oo muddo dheer ay ka jireen khataro la xiriira Al-Shabaab. Beled-Xaawo oo dhinaca Soomaaliya kaga beegan Mandera ayaa sidoo kale ah marin muhiim ah oo isku xira labada dal, waxaana si joogto ah isaga gudba dadka iyo badeecadaha. Hay’adaha ammaanka Kenya ayaa sannadihii dambe sare u qaaday baaritaanka badeecadaha iyo qalabka teknoolajiyadda ee dalka la soo geliyo, gaar ahaan kuwa loo sii gudbinayo deegaannada xadka, sababo la xiriira cabsi laga qabo in qalab casri ah uu gacanta u galo kooxaha hubeysan. Baaritaanka kiiskan ayaa hadda la filayaa inuu diiradda saaro qofka Shiinaha kasoo diray baakadda, xiriirka uu la leeyahay Hared iyo qofka la sheegay inuu Mandera kula wareegi lahaa, iyo sidoo kale ujeeddada drone-ka loogu waday Beled-Xaawo. items.title: Dhowr gantaal oo lagu weeraray Dekedda Mokha
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya dalkaasi Yemen ayaa sheegaya in maanta la weeraray Dekedda Mokha, iyadoo la adeegsanayo gantaalo. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in dhowr gantaal ay ku dhaceen xaafado ku yaala meel u dhow Dekedda Mokha iyo in ugu yaraan hal gantaal uu gudaha ugu dhacay dekeddaasi. Wakaaladda Wararka Yemen ee Saba ayaa sheegtay in Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ay weerareen dekedda, balse ay gantaaladoodu ku dhaceen xaafado ay dadku degan yihiin. Wakaaladda Wararka Saba ayaan tafaasiil ka bixin khasaaraha nafeed ama burburka hantiyadeed ay gantaaladu gaysteen. Muuqaal la soo dhigay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinaya in gantaal uu ku dhacay bartamaha dekedda, halkaas oo qiiq uu cirka isku shareeray. Muuqaal kale ayaa laga arki karaa in gantaal labaad uu ku dhacay meel dekedda dhinaceeda ah, isla-markaana uu dab ka holcaayo. Ururka Xuutiyiinta ayaan markiiba sheegan masuuliyadda weerarka. Mokha waa magaalo dekedeed oo ku taala Koonfur Galbeed Yemen, iyadoona saaran Badda Cas, waxayna 75km dhanka waqooyi uga beegan tahay marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Magaaladan iyo dekeddaba ayaa waxaa gacanta ku haya oo maamula Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudiga uu taageero.

items.title: Natiijada Imtixaanka Shahaadiga ee Fasalka 8-aad oo la soo shaaciyay, xilli sanadkan ay wax badan ug duwantahay kuwii hore
items.description: Munaasabad ballaaran oo lagu soo bandhigayay natiijada imtixaanka shahaadiga ah ee fasalka 8-aadeed ayaa lagu qabtay magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoo ay ka qayb galeen masuuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo maamulka gobolka Banaadir, iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Munaasabadda ayaa si rasmi ah loogu shaaciyey natiijada imtixaanka sanadkan, waxaana lagu sheegay in guud ahaan imtixaanka ay u fariisteen 45,452 arday. Natiijada la soo bandhigay ayaa muujisay in 44,017 arday ay ku guuleysteen imtixaanka oo ay gudbeen, halka 1,435 arday ay ku dhaceen. Marka loo eego tirada guud ee ardayda imtixaanka gashay, heerka guusha ayaa gaaraya qiyaastii 96.8 boqolkiiba, halka ardayda ku dhacay imtixaanka ay yihiin ku dhowaad 3.2 boqolkiiba. Natiijadan ayaa sidoo kale muujinaysa in inta badan ardaydii sanadkan u fariisatay imtixaanka shahaadiga ah ay ku guuleysteen inay ka gudbaan marxaladdan waxbarasho, taas oo ah natiijo muhiim u ah ardayda, waalidiinta, macallimiinta iyo guud ahaan bahda waxbarashada. Kaalinta koowaad waxaa gashay Sumayo Abshir Xasan, oo dhigata Iskuulka Maxamuud Xarbi, iyadoo sheegtay in dadaal badan ay gelisay waxbarashadeeda, ayna filaysay inay kaalinta koowaad ka gasho imtixaanka. Guud ahaan natiijada sanadkan ayaa ka duwan kuwii maadaama heerka gudbiddu uu aad u xoogganyahay, markii la barbar dhigo sanadihii hore qaarkood oo heer dhiciddu aad u sarreeyay.

items.title: Fahad Yaasiin oo shaaciyey waxa uu Heshiiska Makkah uga dhigan yahay Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Agaasimihii hore ee Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA), Fahad Yaasiin Xaaji Daahir, ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ka mid noqon karto dalalka sida weyn uga faa’iideysta heshiiska cusub ee difaaca wadajirka ah ee ay kala saxiixdeen Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Fahad Yaasiin, oo sidoo kale horey u soo noqday la-taliyaha amniga qaranka Soomaaliya, ayaa heshiiska ku tilmaamay “tallaabo taariikhi ah”, isaga oo sheegay in saameyntiisa aysan ku koobnaan doonin saddexda dal ee sida tooska ah u kala saxiixday. “Soomaaliya waxay ka mid tahay dalalka ka faa’iideysanaya heshiiskan, maadaama amnigeeda qaranku uu taageero xooggan ka helayo deegaankeeda Carabta iyo Islaamka,” ayuu Fahad Yaasiin ku yiri qoraal uu ku baahiyey barta X. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in heshiisku leeyahay muhiimad istaraatiiji ah oo ka ballaaran saddexda dal, gaar ahaan marka la eego dalalka ku yaalla labada dhinac ee Badda Cas iyo Badweynta Hindiya, oo muddooyinkii dambe noqday goob ay ku sii xoogeysanayaan loollanka quwadaha gobolka, khataraha amniga badda iyo tartanka saameynta siyaasadeed iyo ciidan. “Heshiiska difaaca wadajirka ah ee Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan wuxuu metelayaa tallaabo taariikhi ah iyo go’aan istaraatiiji ah oo ilaalinaya danaha dalalka ku yaalla labada dhinac ee Badda Cas iyo Badweynta Hindiya,” ayuu yiri. Hadallada Fahad Yaasiin ayaa ka mid ah falcelinnada siyaasadeed ee ugu cadcad ee dhinaca Soomaaliya laga bixiyey heshiiskan, oo Jimcihii magaalada Makka ay ku kala saxiixdeen Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudi Carabiya Maxamed bin Salmaan, Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif. Heshiiska, oo loogu magac daray Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makka , ayaa dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsan doono weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Ujeeddada heshiiska ayaa ah in la xoojiyo awoodda wadajirka ah ee looga hortagayo gardarro dibadeed, isla markaana la sii qoto-dheereeyo iskaashiga dhinacyada difaaca, ciidamada iyo amniga. Soomaaliya maxay ka faa’iidi kartaa? Soomaaliya kama mid aha dalalka heshiiska saxiixay, sidaas darteed qodobka dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado hal dal loo arko weerar lagu qaaday dhammaan xubnaha si rasmi ah uguma fidinayo Soomaaliya. Hase yeeshee, Fahad Yaasiin ayaa qaba in Soomaaliya ay si dadban uga faa’iideysan karto isku soo dhowaanshaha iyo wada-shaqeynta sii xoogeysaneysa ee saddex dal oo leh saameyn siyaasadeed, ciidan iyo dhaqaale oo sii kordheysa Bariga Dhexe, Geeska Afrika, Badda Cas iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Saddexda dalba waxay xiriir la leeyihiin dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, inkasta oo Turkigu leeyahay joogitaanka militari iyo iskaashiga difaac ee ugu ballaaran. Turkiga ayaa Muqdisho ku leh saldhigga weyn ee tababarka ciidamada ee TURKSOM, waxaana sanadihii lasoo dhaafay halkaas lagu tababaray kumannaan askari oo ka tirsan ciidamada Soomaaliya, taas oo qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu dhisayo awoodda ciidamada qalabka sida. Ankara ayaa sidoo kale ballaarisay iskaashigeeda Soomaaliya, iyadoo ka gudubtay tababarka ciidamada una gudubtay dhinacyada amniga badda, difaaca, tamarta iyo iskaashi istaraatiiji ah oo muddo dheer ah. Bishii July, baarlamaanka Turkiga ayaa kordhiyey muddada howlgalka ciidamada Turkiga ee Soomaaliya ilaa sanadka 2028, taas oo muujineysa sida Ankara ay u sii xoojineyso kaalinteeda amni iyo militari ee dalka. Pakistan ayaa iyaduna muddooyinkii dambe ku dhaqaaqday sidii ay u ballaarin lahayd xiriirka difaac iyo amni ee ay la leedahay Soomaaliya, waxaana iskaashiga labada dhinac ka mid ah la-dagaallanka argagixisada, tababarka ciidamada iyo is-weydaarsiga khibradaha militari. Xiriirradaas ayaa Soomaaliya ka dhigaya dal si dhow ula shaqeeya laba ka mid ah saddexda quwadood ee hadda uu mideynayo heshiiska difaaca ee Makka. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sidoo kale Soomaaliya la leh xiriir siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale oo soo jireen ah, waxayna ka mid tahay dalalka saameynta weyn ku leh siyaasadda iyo ammaanka gobolka Badda Cas. Farriin gobolka loo diray Fahad Yaasiin ayaa sheegay in isu-imaatinka Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan uu xambaarsan yahay farriin gaar ah xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha iyo hubanti la’aanta amni ee ka jirta gobolka. “Midnimada iyo isku duubnida quwadaha waaweyn ee Islaamka xilligan xasaasiga ah waxay farriin cad u direysaa cid kasta oo isku dayaysa inay waxyeello u geysato amniga istaraatiijiga ah ee saddexda dal iyo guud ahaan deegaankooda,” ayuu yiri. Heshiiska ayaa isku keenaya saddex dal oo mid kasta uu leeyahay awood gaar ah. Heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale kusoo aadaya xilli culeys xooggan uu saaran yahay nidaamka amniga gobolka, isla markaana ay sii kordhayaan walaacyada laga qabo badqabka maraakiibta, kaabeyaasha tamarta iyo marin-biyoodyada istaraatiijiga ah ee ka soo bilowda Khaliijka, mara Badda Cas kuna sii fida Badweynta Hindiya. Soomaaliya ayaa juqraafi ahaan meel muhiim ah kaga taalla aaggaas, iyadoo leh xeeb dheer oo ku fidsan Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya, isla markaana ku dhow marin-biyoodka koonfureed ee laga galo Badda Cas. Soomaaliya, faa’iidada ugu weyn waxay ka iman kartaa sameysanka isbahaysi si dhow isaga kaashanaya arrimaha amniga iyo difaaca oo ay ku mideysan yihiin quwado Muslim ah oo Muqdisho horeyba xiriir siyaasadeed, militari iyo amni oo muhiim ah ula lahayd. Fahad Yaasiin, oo sidoo kale horey u soo noqday la-taliyaha amniga qaranka Soomaaliya, ayaa heshiiska ku tilmaamay “tallaabo taariikhi ah”, isaga oo sheegay in saameyntiisa aysan ku koobnaan doonin saddexda dal ee sida tooska ah u kala saxiixday. “Soomaaliya waxay ka mid tahay dalalka ka faa’iideysanaya heshiiskan, maadaama amnigeeda qaranku uu taageero xooggan ka helayo deegaankeeda Carabta iyo Islaamka,” ayuu Fahad Yaasiin ku yiri qoraal uu ku baahiyey barta X. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in heshiisku leeyahay muhiimad istaraatiiji ah oo ka ballaaran saddexda dal, gaar ahaan marka la eego dalalka ku yaalla labada dhinac ee Badda Cas iyo Badweynta Hindiya, oo muddooyinkii dambe noqday goob ay ku sii xoogeysanayaan loollanka quwadaha gobolka, khataraha amniga badda iyo tartanka saameynta siyaasadeed iyo ciidan. “Heshiiska difaaca wadajirka ah ee Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan wuxuu metelayaa tallaabo taariikhi ah iyo go’aan istaraatiiji ah oo ilaalinaya danaha dalalka ku yaalla labada dhinac ee Badda Cas iyo Badweynta Hindiya,” ayuu yiri. Hadallada Fahad Yaasiin ayaa ka mid ah falcelinnada siyaasadeed ee ugu cadcad ee dhinaca Soomaaliya laga bixiyey heshiiskan, oo Jimcihii magaalada Makka ay ku kala saxiixdeen Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudi Carabiya Maxamed bin Salmaan, Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif. Heshiiska, oo loogu magac daray Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makka , ayaa dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsan doono weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Ujeeddada heshiiska ayaa ah in la xoojiyo awoodda wadajirka ah ee looga hortagayo gardarro dibadeed, isla markaana la sii qoto-dheereeyo iskaashiga dhinacyada difaaca, ciidamada iyo amniga. Soomaaliya maxay ka faa’iidi kartaa? items.title: Kampala summit fails to secure Somalia’s AUSSOM future
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – A summit convened specifically to keep Somalia’s African Union peacekeeping mission functioning has instead confirmed how unresolved its future remains, according to Amani Africa ‘s analysis of the gathering, published this week under the title “With no viable collective plan emerging from the AU and Kampala summit, it falls on each AUSSOM TCC to plan for saving itself individually.” The second Extraordinary Summit of AUSSOM troop-contributing countries (TCCs) and the Federal Government of Somalia met in Kampala on 31 July 2026, called into being by a blunt warning from Washington. On 1 July, the United States Mission to the African Union notified the AU Commission it would not support extending the UN Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS) beyond AUSSOM’s current mandate expiry on 31 December 2026 . The US added that while it would not object to AUSSOM’s mandate itself being renewed, it would refuse to back any UN Security Council resolution preserving UNSOS or authorising UN logistical and operational support — the machinery that keeps the mission’s troops fed, fuelled and mobile. Amani Africa is unambiguous about what that letter means in practice: AUSSOM may still hold a mandate after December, but without the logistical architecture required to implement it. Kampala was meant to close that gap. By Amani Africa’s own account, it did not. Failure One: No Financing Was Actually Secured The summit’s headline outcome — a call for a UN-mandated integrated support arrangement to sustain AUSSOM for 18 to 24 months — sounds decisive. Amani Africa’s analysis treats it as largely aspirational. The summit tasked TCC foreign ministers with forming a Joint Task Force to pursue “diplomatic outreach” and organise a donors’ conference, but committed no actual funds and secured no binding pledge. The think tank is pointed about why this matters: an earlier attempt at a full donors’ conference never materialised at all, and when a High-Level Financing Event was held on the margins of the UN General Assembly in September 2025, it raised only around $44 million — nowhere close to what the mission requires. Troop-contributing countries have effectively been left to subsidise AUSSOM out of their own budgets, and efforts to draw in non-traditional donors have “repeatedly produced little.” Amani Africa’s verdict on repeating this playbook is blunt: there is little reason to assume another round of fundraising will fundamentally change the situation, given that international partners’ priorities have shifted and the political consensus that sustained the mission for two decades has visibly weakened. Failure Two: The Financing Plan Rests on Assumptions Kampala Didn’t Secure Even the 18-to-24-month framework the summit did agree to is, in Amani Africa’s assessment, built on a foundation that doesn’t yet exist. Its feasibility depends entirely on financing and logistical support that are — in the think tank’s words — “now least certain.” A companion Amani Africa analysis notes that Uganda’s Chief of Defence Forces used the Kampala gathering to call for “African-led alternative arrangements that would sustain the mission beyond 2026” — but acknowledged this option is contingent on the US reversing a decision it has shown no sign of reversing. Given that, Amani Africa argues the more honest planning horizon isn’t 18 to 24 months at all — it’s a compressed six-to-twelve-month orderly wind-down, run in parallel with a replacement arrangement such as bilateral security deployment, rather than a longer transition the summit has no real means of funding. Failure Three: Somalia Rejected the Political Deal — Again Where Amani Africa’s analysis turns sharpest is on the summit’s political failure. Since the first Extraordinary Summit in Kampala in April 2025, TCCs have pushed for a parallel political accountability process to accompany the security transition. IGAD Deputy Executive Secretary Mohamed Abdi Ware told the ministerial meeting preceding the summit that Somalia “must insist” on assuming responsibility for its sovereign territory “in the shortest possible time,” and pressed the summit to secure an “iron-clad commitment” from Mogadishu toward political settlement. At the Chiefs of Defence Forces meeting on 29 July, Uganda pushed for Somalia to produce a roadmap for inclusive political dialogue; Somalia and Djibouti sought to defer the matter to the leaders’ level instead. It was deferred, then rejected outright. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, as he had in April 2025, firmly and repeatedly objected to including political matters in the communiqué, insisting Somalia’s political affairs were a sovereign matter for Somalis alone to resolve. The provision was struck. Amani Africa’s framing is exact on what this cost: for the second consecutive summit, the opportunity for mutual accountability and a shared commitment was lost. The consequences reach directly into the financing failure above. Amani Africa argues that stripping the political clause from the communiqué robbed the TCCs of “a much-needed bargaining tool” in their outreach to Washington and other partners – making it harder, not easier, to convince the mission’s key backers to keep funding it. Failure Four: No Plan for the Worst Case The most consequential gap, in Amani Africa’s assessment, is what the summit failed to produce even as a backstop. The think tank had argued in earlier analysis that a contingency plan for AUSSOM’s full withdrawal by December 2026 needed to be on the table. It wasn’t adopted. Amani Africa’s verdict is unambiguous: with no viable collective plan emerging from the AU and Kampala summit, it falls on each AUSSOM TCC to plan for saving itself individually. In practice, that means each troop-contributing nation is now left drafting its own contingency plan in isolation — with no shared framework, no coordinated fallback, and no guarantee that individual national plans will align with each other if AUSSOM’s funding and logistics collapse simultaneously in December. The Backdrop the Summit Didn’t Resolve None of these failures occurred in isolation from Somalia’s deepening internal crisis. Relations between the Federal Government and the Federal Member States have deteriorated sharply, with Jubaland and Puntland formally suspending cooperation with Mogadishu. Disputes over constitutional amendments and the electoral process have widened the rift, and in June, tensions spilled into armed clashes in Mogadishu between federal government forces and opposition-aligned fighters. A government unable to demonstrate political cohesion at home, Amani Africa’s analysis implies, has a weaker hand in persuading international partners to keep underwriting its security abroad. What Comes Next With the summit’s communiqué offering aspiration rather than commitment, Amani Africa’s central warning is that the question facing the AU, the TCCs and Somalia is no longer simply how to preserve AUSSOM for another two or three years — it is how to keep the mission’s mounting financial and logistical strain from ending in a disorderly collapse, with serious consequences for the thousands of AU troops who have paid for the mission in lives and limbs, and for two decades of stabilisation investment now hanging on decisions still unresolved. items.title: Banadir Announces 2025 Middle School Exam Results as Over 44,000 Students Pass
items.description: MOGADISHU — The Banadir Regional Education Directorate has announced the results of the 2025 Middle School Certificate Examination, following the completion of the marking and assessment process. According to figures released by the Directorate, 45,452 students sat the examination across Banadir Region during the 2025 academic year. The results indicate that 44,017 students passed the examination, while 1,435 candidates were unsuccessful, representing a failure rate of approximately 3.2 percent. The Directorate said 20,666 female students and 23,351 male students participated in the examination. Sumayo Hassan Abshir Adam emerged as the highest-performing student, securing first place in the region. Balqiisa Mohamed Omar Mohamed ranked second, while Ahmed Abdinasir Abdullahi Abdi secured third place. The top-performing students were presented with awards in recognition of their academic achievement and efforts throughout the school year. Education officials said the awards were intended to encourage the students to maintain their academic performance as they progress to secondary education. The annual middle school examination is an important stage in the education system, marking the completion of intermediate-level studies and determining students’ progression to secondary school. This year’s results show that the overwhelming majority of candidates successfully completed the examination, with only a small proportion required to repeat or retake the assessment. items.title: Yahya Saree oo xaqiijiyay inay Xuutiyiintu gaysteen weerarka warshadda Jizan ee Sacuudiga
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegtay masuuliyadda weerar lagu qaaday xarun shidaal oo Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ay leedahay, taas oo ku taala Magaalada Jizan ee Koonfur Galbeed Sacuudiga. Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa sheegay in Ciidamada Yemen ay Axaddan beegsadeen warshadda shidaalka sifeysa ee Shirkadda Aramco leedahay ee Jizan (Jazan). Afhayeenka ayaa sheegay in weerarka loo adeegsaday diyaarad drone ah, isla-markaana uu jawaab u yahay xadgudub ay diyaaradaha Sacuudiga ku soo sameeyeen hawada Magaalooyinka Saada iyo Hajjah ee Waqooyi Galbeed Yemen. Wasaaradda Tamarta Sacuudiga ayaa saaka sheegtay in dab uu ka kacay mid ka mid ah xarumaha shidaalka lagu sifeeyo ee magaalada dekedda leh ee Jizan. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in la demiyay dabkaasi, balse ma aysan sheegin sababta keentay dabka. Weerarkan ayaa ah kii ugu dambeeyay ee ay Xuutiyiintu sheegtaan, isla-markaana lagu beegsado xarumaha tamarta iyo maraakiibta shidaalka Sacuudiga ee ka gudbaya marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Sacuudiga ayaa weeraro gantaalo iyo drones ah kala kulmaya dalka ugu saboolsan ee dunida Carabta, iyadoo weeraradaasi ay halis gelinayaan dhaqaalaha boqortooyada ee ku tiirsan iibinta shidaalka.

Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa sheegay in Ciidamada Yemen ay Axaddan beegsadeen warshadda shidaalka sifeysa ee Shirkadda Aramco leedahay ee Jizan (Jazan). Afhayeenka ayaa sheegay in weerarka loo adeegsaday diyaarad drone ah, isla-markaana uu jawaab u yahay xadgudub ay diyaaradaha Sacuudiga ku soo sameeyeen hawada Magaalooyinka Saada iyo Hajjah ee Waqooyi Galbeed Yemen. Wasaaradda Tamarta Sacuudiga ayaa saaka sheegtay in dab uu ka kacay mid ka mid ah xarumaha shidaalka lagu sifeeyo ee magaalada dekedda leh ee Jizan. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in la demiyay dabkaasi, balse ma aysan sheegin sababta keentay dabka. Weerarkan ayaa ah kii ugu dambeeyay ee ay Xuutiyiintu sheegtaan, isla-markaana lagu beegsado xarumaha tamarta iyo maraakiibta shidaalka Sacuudiga ee ka gudbaya marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Sacuudiga ayaa weeraro gantaalo iyo drones ah kala kulmaya dalka ugu saboolsan ee dunida Carabta, iyadoo weeraradaasi ay halis gelinayaan dhaqaalaha boqortooyada ee ku tiirsan iibinta shidaalka.

items.title: Maxaa ka jira in Jeneral Jimcaale oo isku dhiibay Puntland?
items.description: Garoowe (Raxanreeb Online) Sida wararka sheegayaan waxaa weli go’aankoodii federaalka ka tanaasulin ciidanka Danab ee hoggaamiyo Jeneral Jimcaale Jaamac Takar, kuwaas oo saldhigoodu yahay magaalada caasimadda ah ee Garoowe. Guddi ka mid ah waxgaradka gobolka Nugaal, ayaa ku jira arrinta ciidankan, kuwaas oo dowladda Puntland ka sugayso xalka kama dambays ah. Guddigan waxay hore u sheegeen in ay xal ka gaareen xiisadda dowladda iyo ciidanka Danab, balse taasi ma dhaqangelin. Qaar ka mid ciidamadii federaalka ee ku sugnaa deegaannada Puntland ayaa dhowaan dagaal lagu qabtay, halka kuwa is dhiibeen, kuwana ka talaabeen deegaannada Puntland oo u galeen maamullada Galmudug iyo Waqooyi Bari. Sidoo kale waxaa jira kuwa weli ku sugan deegaannadeeda maamukka Puntland, kuwaas oo aan u hoggaansamin hadalkii madaxweyne Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ee ahaa in ay 48 saac gudaheed ah isku soo dhiibaan ciidanka ammaanka Puntland. items.title: The Somali girls stepping into the boxing ring – and challenging tradition. MOGADISHU, Somalia
items.description: In a small training hall in Mogadishu’s Waaberi district, the sharp sound of boxing gloves hitting training pads fills the air each evening as a group of Somali girls train in a sport that has long been viewed by some as unsuitable for women. For the first time, girls in the capital are taking part in structured boxing training, seeking to develop self-defence skills, build confidence, and, for some, pursue a future in competitive sport. “For me, boxing has made me more focused on what I am doing. My mind and body now work together. I feel more confident and energetic,” said 19-year-old Saxar Aadan, one of around ten girls aged between 18 and 20 who train at the facility. The group trains at a facility linked to the Somali Boxing Association, where training is provided free of charge. Participants say they mainly joined to learn self-defence at a time when women can face harassment and insecurity. “Girls learn boxing so they can defend themselves if they face threats or attacks,” Saxar said. She said she initially worried about how her family would react, given that women’s participation in combat sports remains uncommon in Somali society. “When I told my family I wanted to learn boxing, they were surprised. But they allowed me. Now I feel stronger and more confident,” she said. A girl who trained in secret Not all the girls who started training have been able to continue. Fatima Mohamed was among those interested in boxing but eventually left the programme after her family objected. Fatima initially began training in secret because she feared that her family would not approve. She continued attending the sessions without telling them, but when her family found out, they asked her to stop. The decision forced Fatima to give up something she had become interested in, highlighting the challenges some girls face when they try to take part in sports that parts of society consider unsuitable for women. Fatima’s experience also illustrates how family support can be crucial for girls who want to continue participating in sports, particularly combat sports that remain uncommon among Somali women. A mother worried about her daughter’s future. Sahra Omar, a Somali mother, also stopped her daughter from attending boxing training because she was concerned about her daughter’s future and how participation in the sport could affect her prospects for marriage. Sahra said her decision was driven by concerns about her daughter’s marriage prospects and how Somali society and cultural expectations might view a girl involved in boxing. “I was worried about my daughter’s marriage and her future,” Sahra said, reflecting concerns among some parents that their daughters’ participation in boxing could affect how they are perceived by society or their future marriage prospects. Sahra’s experience shows that the challenges facing girls who want to take up boxing go beyond access to training facilities or equipment. They are also shaped by social and cultural expectations about women’s roles and their futures. The girls who continue to train say boxing has improved not only their physical strength but also their mental resilience and self-esteem. However, they face significant challenges, including pressure from families, negative reactions within their communities, and criticism on social media. Some girls have also dropped out after being discouraged at home or publicly criticized online. “When girls get married, they are often stopped from continuing their training,” some participants said, describing this as one of the biggest setbacks they face. The programme is led by coach Sayid Cabdi Fitaax Maxamed Axmed, a former boxer with more than 10 years of experience and an international coaching certificate. He said the initiative began as a voluntary effort by him and fellow boxing enthusiasts, with most of the equipment provided through donations. “We organized ourselves on a voluntary basis. The equipment we use was donated by humanitarian organizations about five years ago, which encouraged us to continue,” he said. He said families often worry that boxing could negatively affect girls’ future prospects or conflict with traditional expectations about women’s roles. Despite these concerns, he believes attitudes are slowly changing. “Somali girls have the talent and strength to reach high levels if they are given consistent support and opportunities,” he said. The program currently trains around ten girls, six days a week. Organizers say the number fluctuates as some girls drop out because of family pressure, social pressure, or criticism on social media. Participants say they hope to go beyond self-defense and eventually compete internationally, representing Somalia on larger sporting stages. In recent years, Mogadishu has seen a gradual increase in vocational and sporting opportunities for young women, creating new pathways towards independence and employment. Still, trainers say the biggest challenge is not boxing itself but building sustained acceptance and support from families, communities, and online spaces for women who want to take up the sport. By Maryan Ladane, Bilan Media The post The Somali girls stepping into the boxing ring – and challenging tradition. MOGADISHU, Somalia first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somalia oo dooneyso inay ku biirto heshiis difaac oo weyn
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Soomaaliya ayaa kamid noqonaysa dalalka sida weyn u daneynaya inay ku biiraan heshiis cusub oo difaaca oo ay dhawaan wada saxiixdeen madaxda dalalka Sacuudiga, Pakistan iyo Turkiga, kaas oo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga amni iyo difaac ee dalalka saxiixay. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa soo dhaweysay heshiiskaasi, iyadoo sheegtay inay kalsooni buuxda ku qabto ujeeddooyinka heshiiska iyo kaalinta uu ka qaadan karo xoojinta nabadda iyo amniga gobolka iyo guud ahaan caalamka. “Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay mar walba soo dhoweynaysaa tallaabo kasta oo lagu xoojinayo nabadgelyada iyo iskaashiga difaaca ee dalalka saaxiibada ah, si loo helo gobol ammaan ah oo horumarsan,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya. Soo dhaweynta ay Soomaaliya u muujisay heshiiskan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo Madaxweynaha Turkiga, Recep Tayyip Erdogan uu Jimcihii ugu baaqay dalalka ay arrintani khusayso inay ku biiraan iskaashiga cusub ee dhinaca difaaca. Wararka soo baxaya ayaa sheegaya in Soomaaliya ay ka fiirsanayso inay qayb ka noqoto heshiiskan, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka ay xiriir dhow oo dhinaca amniga iyo difaaca ah la leedahay qaar ka mid ah dalalka aas-aasay heshiiska. Muhiimadda heshiiskan ayaa Soomaaliya si gaar ah u khusaysa, maadaama dalka uu ku yaallo marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo meel u dhow marinka Bab al-Mandab oo ah mid ka mid ah waddooyinka ugu muhiimsan ee isku xira ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo dalalka Bariga Dhexe. Isbaheysiga cusub ayaa loo aas-aasay xoojinta iskaashiga difaaca iyo sugidda amniga marin-biyoodka caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan marinka Bab al-Mandab iyo Gacanka Faaris, iyadoo ku biirista Soomaaliya ay haddii ay dhacdo noqon karto tallaabo cusub oo lagu xoojinayo xiriirka amni iyo difaac ee Muqdisho iyo dalalka gobolka. Heshiiskan cusub ayaa xambaarsan fariin siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo ka weyn magaca heshiiska laftiisa. Saddexdan dal oo ka mid ah quwadaha ugu waaweyn dunida Muslimka ayaa dhisaya hannaan cusub oo iskaashi amni, xilli kalsoonida lagu qabo nidaamkii amni ee muddada dheer gobolka ka jiray ii sii wiiqmayo. Sacuudiga wuxuu heshiiska la imanayaa awood dhaqaale iyo miisaan siyaasadeed, Turkiga wuxuu leeyahay ciidanka labaad ee ugu weyn NATO iyo warshado difaac oo si xawli ah u koraya, halka Pakistan ay leedahay awood ciidan oo weyn iyo hubka nukliyeerka ee keliya ee uu leeyahay dal Muslim ah. Su’aasha ugu weyn ma ahan in saddexdan dal ay doonayaan inay Mareykanka ka saaraan gobolka ama beddelaan kaalintiisa. Waxa muhiimka ah waa in Riyaad, Ankara iyo Islamabad ay u muuqdaan kuwo rumeysan in Washington oo keliya aysan mar dambe siin karin dammaanadda amni ee ay u baahan yihiin. Arrintaas ayaa Sacuudiga si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah. Boqortooyadu muddo tobannaan sano ah waxay ku tiirsaneyd dalladda amni ee Mareykanka, waxayna soo iibsatay qaar ka mid ah hubka ugu casrisan dunida. Si kastaba, gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Iran iyo kooxaha ay Tehran taageerto ayaa dhowr jeer muujiyey nuglaanta amniga Sacuudiga iyo guud ahaan Khaliijka. items.title: Erdoğan: Guulaystaha Dhabta ah ee Dagaalka Bariga Dhexe
items.description: Wargeyska caanka ah ee ka soo baxa dalka Ingiriiska ee The Daily Telegraph , loona yaqaan The Telegraph , oo la aasaasay bishii Juun 1855, ayaa baahiyay warbixin xiiso leh oo falanqaynaysa isbeddellada siyaasadeed iyo amniyeed ee ka dhashay dagaalka u dhexeeya Maraykanka iyo Israa’iil iyo Iiraan, iyo saamaynta uu ku yeeshay dalka Turkiga. Warbixintan, oo soo baxday dhammaadka bishii Maajo 2026, waxaa qortay wariyaha caanka ah ee Sophia Yan, oo hore ugu guulaysatay abaalmarinta Marie Colvin Award (MCA) bishii Oktoobar 2020, sabab la xiriirta tebinteedii caalamiga ahayd ee Shiinaha, oo ay muddo toban sano ah degganayd, halkaas oo ay ku soo bandhigtay baaritaanno la xiriira ka ganacsiga dadka, hubka sharcidarrada ah, denbiyada dagaalka iyo maalgelinta argagixisada. Haddaba, nuxurka guud ee maqaalkani wuxuu daaha ka qaadayaa sida uu Madaxweynaha Turkiga, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, uga faa’iidaystay jawiga dagaalka ee Bariga Dhexe, si uu u ballaariyo awooddiisa shakhsiga ah, u burburiyo xorriyaddii siyaasadeed ee dalkiisa, isla markaasna uu Turkiga uga dhigo awood caalami ah oo aan la loodin karin. Warbixintu waxay si gun iyo baar ah u qaadaadhigaysaa qodobbo muhiim ah, kuwaas oo daaha ka rogaya guulaha waaweyn ee dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga iyo dhaqaalaha ee uu Erdoğan ka dhex helay dhibaatadan caalamiga ah. Dabcan, warbixintani waxay tusaale nool u tahay murtidii Soomaaliyeed ee ahayd: “Qayladii yeertaa, qolo ayay khayr ugu jirtaa.” Gabaabsiga Dimuqraadiyadda Turkiga Warbixintu waxay si guud u sawiraysaa in xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka Turkiga ay marayso meel aad u adag, ka dib cadaadis daran iyo weerar toos ah oo lagula kacay mid ka mid ah xisbiyada mucaaradka ee dalkaas. Ciidamada booliska ee rabshadaha ka-hortaga ayaa la sheegay inay xoog ku jebiyeen albaabbada xarunta ugu weyn ee xisbiga mucaaradka dalkaas ee Cumhuriyet Halk Partisi (CHP). Xisbigan, oo ah kan ugu cimri dheer dalka Turkiga, isla markaasna la aasaasay 50 maalmood ka hor dhalashadii Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga, ayaa dhidibbada loo taagay bishii Sebteembar sannadkii 1923, waxaana aasaasay isla aasaasihii dalka Turkiga, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk. Hawlgalkan, oo dhacay dabayaaqadii bishii Maajo sannadkii 2026, booliska oo fulinayay amar maxkamadeed ayaa xoog ku jiiray taageerayaashii isku dayay inay hor istaagaan ee ku sugnaa gudaha iyo hareeraha xarunta xisbiga. Xiisaddan ayaa salka ku haysa khilaaf sharci iyo mid siyaasadeed oo ka dhashay Shirweynihii 38aad ee rasmiga ahaa ee xisbiga CHP, kaas oo qabsoomay bishii Nofeenbar sannadkii 2023. Doorashadaas, oo dhex martay ergooyinka xisbiga, waxaa guul taariikhi ah ku guulaystay Özgür Özel, ka dib markii uu helay codad gaarayay 59.4%, isaga oo ka guulaystay hoggaamiyihii muddo 13 sannadood ah xisbiga hayay ee Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu. Dhacdadan iyo go’aanka maxkamadda, oo la fahamsan yahay in xukuumadda Erdoğan ay gadaal ka riixaysay, ayaa dad badan ku reebay cabsi xooggan oo laga qabo in si rasmi ah loo aasay haraadigii iyo raadadkii ugu danbeeyay ee dimuqraadiyadda iyo xorriyadda siyaasadeed ee dalka Turkiga. Warbixintu waxay kale oo tilmaantay in duqa magaalada Istanbul, Ekrem İmamoğlu, oo ahaa ninkii ugu weynaa ee la tartami lahaa Erdoğan, isna la horkeenay maxkamadda maalmo yar ka dib markii uu kacdoonku qarxay. Sidaas darteed, warbixintu waxay gabagabadii cutubkan ku muujisay in madaxda mucaaradka iyo taageerayaashoodu ay yihiin dhibbanayaasha kowaad ee xukuumadda Erdoğan. Isbeddelka Ammaanka ee Bariga Dhexe Marka loo gudbo arrimaha la xiriira isbeddelka amniga iyo milateriga gobolka, warbixintu waxay tilmaantay in dhibaatadan caalamiga ahi ay keentay in waddamada gobolka Bariga Dhexe ay kalsoonidii kala noqdaan dalka Maraykanka, gaar ahaan ka dib markii ay arkeen gantaallada Iiraan oo ku soo dhacayay caasimadahooda, iyada oo aan la helin difaac ku filan. items.title: Maxaa ka socda Muqdisho ka hor doorashada guddoonka BF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha KMG ah ahna Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Koowaad ee Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Marwo Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar ayaa maanta kormeer ku tagtay goobta loo diyaariyey in maalinta berri ah lagu qabto doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Sacdiya Yaasiin ayaa kormeerka ku wehlisay Guddoomiye ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow, Guddiga Doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdulle (Jaabiri). Kormeerka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray hubinta diyaar-garowga goobta loo qorsheeyey inay ka dhacdo doorashada, iyadoo sidoo kale la eegay habraacyada iyo agabka loogu talagalay in loo adeegsado howlaha doorashada maalinta berri ah. Sidoo kale, waxaa la hubiyey nidaamka cod-bixinta, goobaha ay ka howlgeli doonaan Guddiga Doorashada iyo agabka loo diyaariyey xildhibaanada ka qeybgalaya doorashada. items.title: Wasaaradda Tamarta Sacuudiga: Dab ka kacay
items.description: Wasaaradda Tamarta Sacuudiga: Dab ka kacay mid ka mid ah xarumaha sifaynta shidaalka ee Aramco ee Jazan oo la xakameeyay Wasaaradda Tamarta Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in dab ka kacay xarun ka tirsan warshadda sifaynta shidaalka ee Aramco ee magaalada Jazan la xakameeyay. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in dabku uu kacay aroornimadii hore ee Axadda, isla markaana ay damiyeen waaxda dab-damiska ee Amniga Warshadaha Aramco. Wax dhaawac ah lagama soo sheegin dhacdada, waxaana mas’uuliyiintu wadaan baaritaan ku saabsan sababta keentay dabka. Sababta dabka weli lama shaacin. Xarumaha Aramco ee Jazan ayaa toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay la kulmay weerarro, xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo colaadda gobolka. Reuters ayaa hore u soo werisay in Xuutiyiintu ay bishii July bartilmaameedsadeen xarumaha shidaalka ee Jazan iyo Yanbu.

items.title: Iran oo shuruudo yaab leh ku xirtay dib u furista Hormuz
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) — Iran ayaa Sabtidii soo bandhigtay shuruudo culus oo ay sheegtay in Mareykanka laga doonayo inuu fuliyo ka hor inta aan dib loo furin Marinka Hormuz, arrintaas oo mugdi gelisay rajadii laga qabay in dhowaan dib loo soo celiyo isu socodka caadiga ah ee maraakiibta ganacsiga. Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr, xoghayaha Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran, ayaa sheegay in dib u furista marinkan istaraatiijiga ah aysan dhici doonin ilaa Washington ay wax ka beddesho siyaasaddeeda ku wajahan Tehran. Zolghadr ayaa dalbaday in Mareykanka uu qaado xannibaadda badda ee lagu hayo dekedaha Iran, meesha ka saaro cunaqabateynta dhaqaale, isla markaana ciidamadiisa kala baxo hareeraha Iran. Waxa uu sidoo kale dalbaday in Iran la siiyo magdhow la xiriira dagaalka, loo fasaxo hantida Iran ee dibadda lagu xannibay, lana joojiyo hanjabaadaha ka dhanka ah Tehran iyo weerarrada lagu hayo xulafadeeda gobolka. Shuruudahan ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in wadahadallada socda aysan horseedin dib u furis degdeg ah oo lagu sameeyo Marinka Hormuz, oo ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga tamarta caalamka. Aqalka Cad ayaan isla markiiba ka jawaabin dalabaadka cusub ee Iran. Heshiis xabbad-joojin ah oo Mareykanka iyo Iran ay gaareen bishii June ayaa dhigaya in si buuxda looga qaado Tehran cunaqabateynta haddii heshiis kama dambeys ah laga gaaro barnaamijkeeda nukliyeerka. Washington ayaa sidoo kale horay u sheegtay in Iran aysan heli karin hantideeda dibadda lagu xannibay ilaa ay marka hore ka tanaasusho kaydkeeda yuraaniyaamka sida aadka ah loo tayeeyay. Wada-hadallada Iran iyo Cumaan Hadalka Zolghadr ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Iran iyo Cumaan ay wadahadallo ka leeyihiin nidaamka mustaqbalka ee lagu maamulayo Marinka Hormuz, oo labada dal u dhexeeya. Iran ayaa si weyn u xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta marinka kadib markii Mareykanka iyo Israel ay weerar ku qaadeen dalkaas bishii February, taas oo dhalisay dagaal saameyn weyn ku yeeshay ganacsiga iyo suuqyada tamarta caalamka. Maalmihii ugu dambeeyay waxaa jiray rajo xooggan oo laga qabay in heshiiska Tehran iyo Muscat uu suurtagelin karo in maraakiibta ganacsiga ay si caadi ah ugu soo laabtaan Hormuz. Hase yeeshee, dalabaadka cusub ee Iran ayaa muujinaya in Tehran ay arrinta marinka ku xireyso heshiis siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo ballaaran oo ay la gaarto Mareykanka. Afhayeenka Ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran, Hossein Mohebbi, ayaa Sabtidii sheegay in dib u furista Hormuz aysan si toos ah ugu xirneyn wadahadallada Iran iyo Cumaan. Waxa uu sheegay in arrintu ay ku xiran tahay in Mareykanka uu “si buuxda u aqbalo shuruudaha Iran”. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Iran Abbas Araghchi ayaa dhankiisa sheegay in Tehran iyo Muscat ay “aad ugu dhow yihiin” heshiis, balse taas aysan la macno ahayn in marinka isla markiiba la furi doono. Araghchi ayaa sheegay in Mareykanka laga doonayo inuu magdhow ka bixiyo waxa Iran ay ku tilmaamtay jebinta heshiiskii xabbad-joojinta ee lagu gaaray Islamabad bishii June. Heshiiskaas, oo dhexdhexaadiyey Pakistan, ayaa qeyb ka ahaa dadaal lagu doonayay in dib loogu furo Hormuz, si ku-meel-gaar ahna looga qaado qaar ka mid ah cunaqabateynta saliidda Iran. Laakiin Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa siyaabo kala duwan u fasirtay qodobada heshiiska, waxaana markii dambe dib u qarxay dagaalka. Muranka maamulka Hormuz Khilaafka ugu weyn ayaa sidoo kale ku saabsan cidda awoodda u yeelaneysa nidaaminta maraakiibta isticmaala marinka. Mareykanka ayaa taageeray marin dhinaca koonfureed ah oo maraakiibta u dhoweynaya xeebaha Cumaan, kana fogeynaya biyaha Iran. Tehran ayaa arrintaas u aragtay isku day lagu wiiqayo awoodda ay sheeganeyso inay ku leedahay maamulka Hormuz, waxayna digniin iyo weerarro la beegsatay qaar ka mid ah maraakiibtii isticmaashay waddadaas. “Maraykanku wuxuu doonayay inuu sameeyo marinno cusub oo Hormuz ah, inkastoo digniino uga yimid dalkeenna,” ayuu yiri Araghchi. Waxa uu sheegay in Iran aysan aqbali doonin tallaabo kasta oo wax u dhimeysa waxa ay u aragto xaqeeda maamulka marinka. Iran iyo Cumaan ayaa hadda ka wadahadlaya waddo ku-meel-gaar ah oo maraakiibtu isticmaali karaan, iyadoo ciidamada labada dal ay ka shaqeynayaan faahfaahinta farsamo. Weerarro cusub oo maraakiibta ah Wadahadallada ayaa sidoo kale socda iyadoo weerarrada ka dhanka ah maraakiibta Hormuz aysan joogsan. Dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa Sabtidii sheegtay in Iran ay weerartay markab shidaal oo xiriir la leh shirkadda dowladda ee Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, xilli uu marayay Hormuz. ADNOC ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan 15 markab oo ay leedahay la weeraray tan iyo markii dagaalku billowday, iyadoo hal qof oo shaqaale ah uu dhintay, 20 kalena ay dhaawacmeen. Wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Cumaan ayaa cambaareysay “weerarrada soo noqnoqday ee maraakiibta maraysa Marinka Hormuz”, iyadoo sheegtay inay xadgudub ku yihiin sharciga caalamiga ah. Muscat ayaa haddana sheegtay in wadahadallada ay Iran la leedahay ay ku socdaan “jawi wanaagsan oo wax dhisaya”, waxayna dhinacyada ugu baaqday inay ka fogaadaan tallaabo kasta oo dhaawici karta horumarka la gaaray. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Mareykanka JD Vance ayaa Sabtidii sheegay in wadahadalladu ay weli socdaan, isla markaana diiradda la saarayo sidii loo sameyn lahaa nidaam ay maraakiibtu si nabad ah ugu isticmaali karaan Hormuz. Waxa uu sheegay in arrintaas ay qeyb ka tahay miino-saarista marinka iyo in Iran laga helo ballanqaad ah inaysan weerari doonin maraakiibta ganacsiga. Dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta Hormuz ayaa weli aad uga hooseeya heerkii dagaalka ka hor. Wax yar ka badan toban markab maalintii ayaa toddobaadkii ugu dambeeyay marayay marinka, halka ka hor dagaalka celcelis ahaan ilaa 130 markab ay maalin kasta isticmaali jireen. Qaar ka mid ah maraakiibta ayaa sidoo kale damiya qalabka gudbiya goobta ay ku sugan yihiin si ay uga fogaadaan in ciidamada Iran ama Mareykanka ay ogaadaan, taas oo adkeyneysa in si sax ah loo tiriyo maraakiibta weli isticmaasha marinka. Marinka Hormuz ayaa ah mid ka mid ah halbowlayaasha ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga tamarta dunida, sidaas darteedna dib u dhac kasta oo ku yimaada furitaankiisa wuxuu si toos ah u saameyn karaa qiimaha saliidda, gaaska iyo sicir-bararka caalamka. Marinka Hormuz ayaa ah mid ka mid ah halbowlayaasha ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga tamarta dunida, sidaas darteedna dib u dhac kasta oo ku yimaada furitaankiisa wuxuu si toos ah u saameyn karaa qiimaha saliidda, gaaska iyo sicir-bararka caalamka. items.title: Hay’adda Amnesty International oo Dalbatay in Si Shuruud La’aan ah Loo Sii Daayo Sacadiyo Bajaaj
items.description: Hay’adda Amnesty International ayaa dalbatay in si degdeg ah oo shuruud la’aan ah loo sii daayo Sacadiyo Macallin Cali ” Sacadiyo Bajaaj” oo dhowaan ay maxkamadda gobolka Banaadir xukun 3 sano ah ku ridday. Sacadiyo ayaa sida ay Amnesty International sheegtay la xiray 12-kii Abriil 2026 magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoo hay’addu sheegtay in xariggeedu la xiriiray dhaqdhaqaaqeeda bulshada, gaar ahaan hadalladeeda baraha bulshada iyo ka qeybgalkeeda bannaanbaxyo nabadeed. 25-kii Juun 2026 ayay maxkamadda gobolka Banaadir ku xukuntay saddex sano oo xabsi ah, ka dib markii la sheegay in lagu helay falal la xariira kicin dadweyne. Amnesty International ayaa sheegtay inay Sacadiyo Bajaaj kula hadashay gudaha xabsiga ay ku jirto, iyadoo ku adkeysatay in dacwadda, xarigga iyo xukunka lagu riday ay yihiin kuwo siyaasadeysan, isla markaana ay aaminsan tahay in loo ciqaabay hadalladeeda iyo cambaareynta caqabadaha ay bulshada Soomaaliyeed wajahayso. Sacadiyo, oo bartay  umuliso-nimada, ayaa sheegtay in markii ay waxbarashada dhammeysay ay dhowr jeer shaqo ka raadsatay Muqdisho balse ay ku adkaatay inay hesho shaqo la xiriirta xirfaddeeda. Waxay sheegtay inay la kulantay caqabado ay ku tilmaantay takoor, sidoo kalena ay aaminsan tahay in nidaamka awood-qaybsiga beelaha ee 4.5 uu saameyn ku yeeshay fursadaha shaqo ee ay heli kartay. Maadaama aysan helin shaqo rasmi ah, Sacadiyo waxay sheegtay inay isku dayday shaqooyin kala duwan oo ay ka mid yihiin cunto karinta iyo ku iibinta cuntooyinka  internetka, ka hor inta aysan ugu dambeyn bilaabin wadista bajaajta si ay nolol maalmeedkeeda u maareyso. Waxay sheegtay in waaya-aragnimadeeda nololeed iyo dhibaatooyinka ay maalin kasta ku aragtay bulshada ay ku dhiirrigeliyeen inay si furan uga hadasho arrimaha saameeya dadka caadiga ah, iyadoo adeegsanaysa baraha bulshada iyo ka qeybgalka bannaanbaxyada nabadeed. Sacadiyo Bajaaj ayaa sheegtay sida lagu xusay warbixinta amnesty international in waxa ugu xanuunka badan uu yahay in xilligii lagu xukumayay ay gabadheedu ahayd hal sano jir oo weli ay nuujinaysay. Waxay sheegtay in xariggeedu uu saameyn weyn ku yeeshay qoyskeeda, gaar ahaan gabadheeda oo ay sheegtay in aysan tan iyo markii la xiray hal marna arag. Sacadiyo Bajaaj waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in ay iyadu ahayd qofka ugu weyn ee qoyska dhaqaale ahaan taageera, halka hooyadeedna ay xanuunsatay kadib markii ay maqashay xukunka gabadheeda, taas oo ay sheegtay inay xaaladda qoyska sii adkaysay. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inay xabsiga ku dhex wajahday dhibaatooyin caafimaad oo ay ka mid yihiin xanuun kelyaha ah, neef, xanuun indhaha ah iyo dhibaato maqal oo ay sheegtay inay bilaabatay kadib markii askari boolis ahi dhagta ka dharbaaxay xilligii la xirayay. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay inay miisaan ay u soo bandhigeen in la sii daayo haddii ay ogolaato inay aamusto. Wax yar kadib, ayay sheegtay, sarkaal sare oo dowladeed uu u soo bandhigay shaqo iyadoo shuruud looga dhigay inay aamusto. Si kastaba ha ahaatee amnesty  International ayaa codsatay in si degdeg ah oo shuruud la’aan ah lagu sii daayo, iyadoo arrinteeda ku tilmaantay kiis la xiriira xorriyadda hadalka, xuquuqda aadanaha, haweenka iyo dadka u dooda xuquuqda bulshada.

items.title: Xarunta Gaaska ee Shirkadda Aramco ee Jubail oo gubaneysa
items.description: Qarax xoogan ayaa saaka laga maqlay Magaalada Warshadaha Jubail ee Bariga Sacuudiga, ka dib markii la bartilmaameedsaday Xarunta Gaaska ee Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco ee magaaladaasi. Dadka deegaanka ayaa laga soo xigtay in la bartilmaameedsaday Xarunta Gaaska laga maamulo ee magaaladaasi, taas oo sababtay in dab ka kaco goobtaasi. Muuqaalo la soo dhigay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinaya dab aad u weyn oo ka kacay goobta, isla-markaana gubaneysa. Dhacdadan ayaa hoosta ka xariiqeysa in weerarku uu yahay kiisii ugu horreyay ee lagu qaado Xarumaha Gaaska Sacuudiga, iyadoo toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay ay Xuutiyiinta Yemen weeraro ku hayeen kaabeyaasha kale ee batroolka dalkaasi. Jubail waxay ku taal Gacanka Faaris, waana magaalo deked leh, isla-markaana ka mid ah ilaha ugu muhiimsan ee dhaqaalaha Sacuudiga. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ayaa 25-kii bishii July bilaabay inay beegsadaan kaabeyaasha tamarta ee boqortooyada, ka dib duqaymihii habeenimada 24-kii July lagu beegsaday Dekedda Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran ee Galbeedka Yemen. Xuutiyiinta ayaa 20-kii bishii July xayiraad dhanka badda ah ku soo rogay Dekedaha Sacuudiga oo jawaab u ahayd, wax ay ku tilmaameen go’doomin uu Sacuudigu saaray Yemen, eedeyntaas oo Riyadh ay beenisay.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo la tuhunsan yahay inay ka dambeeyaan dabka ka kacay warshadda shidaalka ee Jizan
items.description: Dab ayaa waaberigii hore ee saaka ka kacay warshadda shidaalka sifeysa ee Boqortooyada Sacuudiga ee ku taala Magaalada Jizan ee saaran xeebaha Badda Cas. Wasaaradda Tamarta Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in la demiyay dab ka kacay mid ka mid ah xarumaha shidaalka lagu sifeeyo ee Shirkadda Aramco ay ku leedahay magaalada dekedda leh ee Jizan (Jazan) ee Koonfur Galbeed Sacuudiga. Wasaaradda ayaa war qoraal ah ku sheegtay in dabku uu ka kacay xarun ka tirsan warshadda sifaynta shidaalka ee Aramco ee magaaladaasi, isla-markaana lagu guuleystay in la xakameeyo. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay inaysan jirin cid wax ku noqotay dhacdada, wax sharaxaad ahna kama bixin, haddii uu weerar dhacay, balse waxay sheegtay in la baarayo sababta keentay dabka. Waxaa jira shaki ku aaddan in Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay garaaceen xaruntaasi, lana sugaayo inay ka hadlaan. Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa 25-kii bishii July gubay warshadda saliidda Jizan, wuxuuna Afhayeenka Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree uu xilligaasi sheegay in weerarka loo adeegsado gantaalada ballaastikada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. General Saree ayaa sheegay in weerarkaasi lagaga jawaabayay duqaymo uu isbahaysiga uu Sacuudiga hoggaamiyo ay 24-kii bishaasi ka gaysteen Dekedda Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran ee Galbeedka Yemen.

items.title: Turkiga oo sheegay in heshiiska difaaca ee Maka uusan Iran bartilmaameedsanayn
items.description: Turkiga ayaa sheegay in heshiiska cusub ee difaaca ee ay wada saxiixdeen Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan aanu si gaar ah uga dhan ahayn Iiraan, inkastoo heshiiskaasi uu xambaarsan yahay qodob dhigaya in weerar hubaysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo tixgelin doono weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Heshiiska oo loogu magac daray Heshiiska Wadajirka Difaaca ee Maka ayaa 7-dii Agoosto lagu kala saxiixday magaalada Maka, waxaana kala saxiixday Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan, Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Mohammed bin Salman iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif. Heshiiskan ayaa loo arkaa tallaabo cusub oo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga amni iyo difaac ee saddexda dal, xilli Bariga Dhexe ay ka jiraan xiisado militari iyo siyaasadeed oo sii kordhaya. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga Hakan Fidan ayaa sheegay in heshiisku aanu magacaabin Iiraan ama dal kale oo loo aqoonsaday inuu yahay khatar ama cadow wadajir ah. Fidan ayaa sheegay in heshiisku farsamo ahaan uu la mid yahay Qodobka 5-aad ee NATO, kaas oo dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado xubin ka tirsan isbahaysiga loo arko weerar lagu qaaday dhammaan xubnaha. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wuxuu caddeeyay in jawaabta la bixinayo ay ku xirnaan doonto xaaladda iyo nooca taageero ee dalka la weeraray uu codsado. Sida uu sheegay Fidan, dalka la weeraro ayaa codsan kara taageero dhinaca xogta sirdoonka, saadka, rasaasta ama xitaa in ciidamo militari loo diro, ayadoo saddexda dal ay sidoo kale qorsheynayaan inay sameystaan guddiyo siyaasadeed iyo kuwo militari, halka xoghayn joogto ah laga dhisayo Sacuudiga. Iskaashiga ayaa sidoo kale ku wajahan tababbarro militari oo wadajir ah, xog-isweydaarsi sirdoon, isku-xirka saadka, qiimeynta khataraha amni iyo in ciidamada saddexda dal ay yeeshaan awood ay si wadajir ah ugu shaqeeyaan. Dhinaca kale, iskaashiga warshadaha difaaca ayaa la filayaa inuu noqdo qayb muhiim ah oo heshiiska ka mid ah, ayadoo Fidan uu sheegay in hoggaamiyeyaasha saddexda dal ay si gaar ah uga wada hadleen sidii ay uga faa’iidaysan lahaayeen tiknoolajiyadda iyo awoodaha warshadaha milatari ee midba midka kale. Wasiirka Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in wada-hadallada heshiiskan ay socdeen ku dhawaad laba sano iyo siddeed bilood, taas oo muujinaysa in heshiisku aanu ahayn tallaabo si degdeg ah looga jawaabayo xiisadda hadda ka taagan gobolka. Inkasta oo Ankara ay ku adkaysanayso in Iiraan aanu heshiisku bartilmaameedsanayn, haddana qaar ka mid ah mas’uuliyiinta Iiraan ayaa walaac ka muujiyay heshiiska. Mahmoud Nabavian, oo ka tirsan Guddiga Amniga Qaranka iyo Siyaasadda Dibadda ee Baarlamaanka Iiraan, ayaa sheegay in Sacuudigu aanu heli doonin dammaanad amni oo buuxda isaga oo ku tiirsan Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Xubin kale oo guddigaas ka tirsan, Ebrahim Rezaei, ayaa heshiiska ku tilmaamay “heshiis warqad ku qoran”, xilli Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan Abbas Araghchi si toos ah aanu hadlin heshiiska, balse uu ugu baaqay dalalka gobolka inay isku tashadaan oo ay raadiyaan waxa uu ku tilmaamay walaaltinimo dhab ah. Dhanka kale, Turkiga ayaa sheegay in heshiiska aan lagu koobin doonin saddexda dal ee hadda saxiixay, ayadoo Hakan Fidan uu sheegay in Ankara ay dooneyso in qaab-dhismeedka cusub ee amni uu ku fido dalal kale oo gobolka ah, isagoo si gaar ah u xusay Masar oo uu ku tilmaamay lamaane dabiici ah. Sida uu sheegay, Masar ayaa laga yaabaa inay ku biirto heshiiska marka la dhammeeyo arrimaha farsamo ee weli taagan. Heshiiska Maka ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli Bariga Dhexe uu wajahayo xaalad amni oo cakiran, iyadoo xiisadaha u dhexeeya Iran iyo dalalka kale ee gobolka ay weli yihiin arrin weyn.
items.fullContent: Turkiga ayaa sheegay in heshiiska cusub ee difaaca ee ay wada saxiixdeen Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan aanu si gaar ah uga dhan ahayn Iiraan, inkastoo heshiiskaasi uu xambaarsan yahay qodob dhigaya in weerar hubaysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo tixgelin doono weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Heshiiska oo loogu magac daray Heshiiska Wadajirka Difaaca ee Maka ayaa 7-dii Agoosto lagu kala saxiixday magaalada Maka, waxaana kala saxiixday Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan, Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Mohammed bin Salman iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif. Heshiiskan ayaa loo arkaa tallaabo cusub oo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga amni iyo difaac ee saddexda dal, xilli Bariga Dhexe ay ka jiraan xiisado militari iyo siyaasadeed oo sii kordhaya. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga Hakan Fidan ayaa sheegay in heshiisku aanu magacaabin Iiraan ama dal kale oo loo aqoonsaday inuu yahay khatar ama cadow wadajir ah. Fidan ayaa sheegay in heshiisku farsamo ahaan uu la mid yahay Qodobka 5-aad ee NATO, kaas oo dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado xubin ka tirsan isbahaysiga loo arko weerar lagu qaaday dhammaan xubnaha. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wuxuu caddeeyay in jawaabta la bixinayo ay ku xirnaan doonto xaaladda iyo nooca taageero ee dalka la weeraray uu codsado. Sida uu sheegay Fidan, dalka la weeraro ayaa codsan kara taageero dhinaca xogta sirdoonka, saadka, rasaasta ama xitaa in ciidamo militari loo diro, ayadoo saddexda dal ay sidoo kale qorsheynayaan inay sameystaan guddiyo siyaasadeed iyo kuwo militari, halka xoghayn joogto ah laga dhisayo Sacuudiga. Iskaashiga ayaa sidoo kale ku wajahan tababbarro militari oo wadajir ah, xog-isweydaarsi sirdoon, isku-xirka saadka, qiimeynta khataraha amni iyo in ciidamada saddexda dal ay yeeshaan awood ay si wadajir ah ugu shaqeeyaan. Dhinaca kale, iskaashiga warshadaha difaaca ayaa la filayaa inuu noqdo qayb muhiim ah oo heshiiska ka mid ah, ayadoo Fidan uu sheegay in hoggaamiyeyaasha saddexda dal ay si gaar ah uga wada hadleen sidii ay uga faa’iidaysan lahaayeen tiknoolajiyadda iyo awoodaha warshadaha milatari ee midba midka kale. Inkasta oo Ankara ay ku adkaysanayso in Iiraan aanu heshiisku bartilmaameedsanayn, haddana qaar ka mid ah mas’uuliyiinta Iiraan ayaa walaac ka muujiyay heshiiska. Sida uu sheegay, Masar ayaa laga yaabaa inay ku biirto heshiiska marka la dhammeeyo arrimaha farsamo ee weli taagan. Heshiiska Maka ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli Bariga Dhexe uu wajahayo xaalad amni oo cakiran, iyadoo xiisadaha u dhexeeya Iran iyo dalalka kale ee gobolka ay weli yihiin arrin weyn.

items.title: Deni oo la kulmay Saraakiisha Ciidamada Puntland ee Gobolka Mudug (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Maxamed (Deni) ayaa Magaalada Gaalkacyo kula kulmay Saraakiisha Ciidamada Puntland ee ku sugan Gobolka Mudug, qaybta Puntland. Madaxweynaha ayaa kulanka la yeeshay Saraakiisha Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee ka hawlgala gobolkaasi, iyadoo ay kulanka ka qaybgaleen Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada. “Kulanka waxaa ka qaybgalay Saraakiisha Ciidamada kala duwan oo ay hoggaaminayaan Taliyaha Ciidanka Daraawiishta Dowladda Puntland, General Aadan Cabdi Xaashi, Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska Dowladda Puntland, General Muumin Cabdi Shire iyo Saraakiisha Ciidamada kala duwan ee Dowladda Puntland.” Ayaa lagu yiri war xalay ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada Puntland. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay in kulanka looga hadlay xaaladda nabadgelyada Gobolka Mudug iyo guud ahaan deegaanada Puntland. “Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda nabadgelyada Gobolka Mudug iyo guud ahaan Puntland, iyadoo la iska xog-wareystay xaaladaha amni iyo dadaalada socda ee lagu xoojinayo nabadgelyada iyo xasilloonida.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Madaxweyne Deni ayaa warka lagu sheegay inuu Saraakiisha Ciidamada kula dardaarmay adkaynta amniga Puntland, isla-markaana ay xoojiyaan wada-shaqaynta, feejignaanta iyo waajibaadka ka saaran sugidda amniga. Madaxweyne Deni iyo xubno ka tirsan Golihiisa Wasiirada ayaa booqasho ku jooga Magaalada Gaalkacyo ee Xarunta Gobolka Mudug, gaar ahaan waqooyiga magaaladaasi oo Puntland ay maamusho. Safarka Deni ee Gaalkacyo ayaa imanaya maalmo ka dib, markii Ciidamada Puntland ay Arbacadii dagaal kula wareegeen xerada ay Ciidanka PSF ku lahaayeen bariga magaaladaasi.
