items.title: A President on the Road: What Deni’s Midnight Journey Says About Puntland—and Somalia’s Security Failure
items.description: By Abdiqani Haji Abdi There are moments in Somali politics when a seemingly ordinary event reveals something far more profound about the state. President Said Abdullahi Deni’s overnight journey from Garowe to Galkayo is one of those moments. Deni left Puntland’s capital during the night and traveled roughly 200 miles by road before arriving safely in Galkayo the following morning. On the surface, it was simply a presidential trip. But viewed against Somalia’s broader security landscape, the journey carries a significance that should not be overlooked. A president traveling hundreds of miles by road, at night, across his own territory is not merely a logistical detail. It is a measure of territorial control. And it raises an uncomfortable question for Somalia’s national leadership: why is such mobility still possible in Puntland while it remains extraordinarily difficult across much of southern Somalia? The Road Tells the Story Somalia’s security debate is often dominated by statistics—territories captured, militants killed, military operations launched and international funds spent. But sometimes the simplest measure is the road. Can a government move its president safely from one major city to another? Can civilians travel between towns without fearing checkpoints controlled by militants? Can traders move their goods without paying illegal taxes? Can security forces move reinforcements without facing ambushes? Can a national government exercise meaningful authority beyond the walls of its administrative capital? These are not abstract questions. They are the practical definition of statehood. President Deni’s journey from Garowe to Galkayo demonstrates that, despite Puntland’s political and security challenges, its administration retains a significant degree of territorial mobility. That achievement should not be dismissed. The situation in much of southern Somalia is dramatically different. For President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, traveling by road from Mogadishu to places such as Jowhar, Marka or Afgooye is not a routine presidential journey. Security considerations make such movements extraordinarily difficult, and senior federal officials depend heavily on air transport when traveling between major population centers. The reason is obvious: Al-Shabaab continues to maintain influence across large rural areas and along important transportation corridors . The Federal Government may control Mogadishu and other major urban centers, but controlling a city is not the same as controlling the territory between cities. That distinction is fundamental. A government that cannot guarantee the security of the road connecting its capital to another major city possesses formal authority—but limited practical reach. Puntland Is Not Perfect None of this means Puntland is free from insecurity. Puntland faces militant threats, political tensions, armed rivalries and periodic confrontations between competing security forces. The recent clashes in Galkayo are a reminder that the region has serious security problems of its own. But the comparison remains important. Despite these challenges, Puntland has maintained security institutions capable of exercising authority in all its territory. Roads connecting major population centers remain sufficiently accessible to permit political leaders, security officials, businesses and ordinary citizens to move with considerably greater freedom than is possible in many parts of the south. That difference has economic consequences as well. Security creates mobility. Mobility creates commerce. Commerce creates revenue. Revenue strengthens institutions. Insecurity reverses that cycle. When roads become dangerous, markets become fragmented, transportation costs rise, investment declines, and government institutions struggle to extend services beyond urban centers. The Real Test of Statehood For decades, Somalia has measured state-building largely through institutions in Mogadishu: ministries, parliament, constitutional amendments, international conferences, and political agreements. But statehood cannot be measured only from inside government buildings. It must be measured on the roads. A functioning state is one whose citizens can travel safely across its territory, whose security forces can move freely, whose businesses can operate without militant taxation, and whose government can reach communities outside major cities. By that measure, Somalia’s biggest problem is not simply that Al-Shabaab exists. The deeper problem is that the state has struggled to replace the security and governance vacuum that allows the group to survive. Rather than treating Puntland’s relative security as a political competition, Somalia’s Federal Government should study it as a governance lesson. Puntland’s experience demonstrates that security cannot be created through military operations alone. It requires functioning local institutions, community relationships, territorial administration, security forces with clear chains of command, and a political environment in which local authorities have sufficient capacity to govern. The Federal Government should therefore ask a more important question than who controls which political office: Why can one Somali administration move its president hundreds of miles across its territory at night, while another struggles to move its leadership safely between neighboring cities? That is the question that should dominate Somalia’s national security debate. A Symbol Larger Than One Journey President Deni’s arrival in Galkayo should therefore be viewed as more than another item on a presidential itinerary. It is a snapshot of two very different realities within the same country. In one part of Somalia, a regional president can leave his capital at night and travel hundreds of miles by road. In another, the national leadership remains heavily dependent on aircraft to move between major cities because the roads connecting them cannot be reliably secured. That contrast exposes the central weakness of Somalia’s state-building project. The country has spent billions of dollars and received decades of international military assistance. Yet in large parts of the south, the most basic measure of sovereignty—the freedom to move safely across one’s own territory—remains elusive. Puntland’s relative security should not be romanticized, and its problems should not be ignored. But neither should its achievements be dismissed because they complicate the national political narrative. If Somalia is serious about defeating Al-Shabaab and building a functioning federal state, it must learn to measure success not only by the number of military operations announced in Mogadishu, but by what happens on the roads outside the capital. Because ultimately, the strength of a state is not demonstrated by how securely its leaders sit in their offices. It is demonstrated by how freely they can travel through the country they claim to govern. This version deliberately uses Deni’s journey as the opening argument, rather than treating it as the main news event, and builds toward a broader critique of Somalia’s state capacity and security model. items.title: Ciidamadii ka baxay Carmo oo soo saaray go’aan culus oo ka dhan ah Puntland
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamo dhawaan ku biiray Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo xalay ka baxay saldhig ay ku lahaayeen degmada Carmo ee gobolka Bari ayaa sheegay in aysan aqoonsaneyn in Puntland ay tahay dowlad ay ka amar qaataan, iyagoo ku adkeystay in dowladda dhexe ee Soomaaliya ay tahay maamulka keliya ee ay hoos tagaan. Mid ka mid ah saraakiisha hoggaamineysa ciidamada ayaa maanta sheegay in ciidankoodu u guuray deegaanka Xumbays ee gobolka Karkaar, balse aysan isku dhiibin ama ku biirin ciidamada Puntland. Sarkaalku wuxuu sheegay in ciidamadaasi ay ka tirsan yihiin Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isla markaana aysan jirin dowlad kale oo ay aqoonsan yihiin ama ka amar qaataan marka laga reebo dowladda dhexe ee Soomaaliya. Ciidamada ayaa habeenkii Jimcaha ka baxay fariisinkoodii Carmo, iyagoo u dhaqaaqay dhinaca Xumbays. Hadalka sarkaalkan ayaa si toos ah uga hor imaanaya mowqifka Puntland oo ku adkeysaneysa in aysan oggolaan doonin ciidamo hubeysan oo aan ka amar qaadan hay’adaha ammaanka Puntland inay saldhigyo iyo dhaqdhaqaaq ciidan ka sameeyaan deegaannada ay maamusho. Dhanka kale, Puntland ayaa maanta sheegtay inay si buuxda ula wareegtay saldhiggii ay ciidamadaasi ku lahaayeen degmada Carmo, kaddib markii ay halkaas isaga baxeen. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Taliska Booliska Puntland ayaa lagu sheegay in ciidamada ammaanku ay la wareegeen xarunta, islamarkaana la sugay ammaankeeda iyo maamulka goobta. “Dawladda Puntland ayaa maanta si rasmi ah ula wareegtay talis ciidan oo ku yaalla magaalada Carmo, kaas oo ay hore u deggenaayeen maleeshiyaad hubaysan kuwaas oo degaannada Puntland ka waday falal lagu khal-khalgelinayo amniga iyo xasiloonida bulshada,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka Puntland. Puntland ayaa sheegtay in tallaabadan ay qeyb ka tahay qorshe ay ku dooneyso in dhammaan xarumaha iyo ciidamada hubeysan ee ka jira deegaannadeeda lagu hoos geeyo hal talis oo ay maamulaan hay’adaha ammaanka ee maamulka. Maamulka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu sii wadi doono howlgallada ka dhanka ah ciidamada aan hoos iman taliskiisa, isagoo ku adkeystay in dhaqdhaqaaq kasta oo ciidan uu waafaqsanaado shuruucda iyo nidaamka Puntland. Arrinta Carmo ayaa timid maalmo kaddib markii Puntland ay muddo 48 saac ah u qabatay ciidamada ka amar qaata Dowladda Federaalka ee ku sugan deegaannadeeda inay isku soo dhiibaan hay’adaha ammaanka Puntland. Hase yeeshee, ciidamada Carmo ayaa halkii ay isku dhiibi lahaayeen ka baxay saldhiggoodii, una dhaqaaqay Xumbays oo isla gudaha Puntland ah, taasoo muujineysa in khilaafka ku saabsan cidda ay ciidamadaasi ka amar qaadanayaan uusan weli dhammaan. Xogta maanta kasoo baxday gobolka Bari ayaa sidoo kale ka dhigeysa Carmo xaruntii ugu dambeysay ee Puntland ay gacanta ku dhigto iyadoo maamulku toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay kordhiyay cadaadiska uu saarayo ciidamo xiriir la leh dowladda federaalka. Puntland ayaa 5-tii Agoosto xoog kula wareegtay xarun ciidan oo ku taalla waqooyiga Gaalkacyo, halka 6-dii Agoosto ay ciidamada Puntland la wareegeen xaruntii hore ee PSF ee magaalada Boosaaso. Labada xarumoodba waxaa ku sugnaa ciidamo xiriir dhow la yeeshay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Gaalkacyo waxaa ka dhacay dagaal ay hub culus isku adeegsadeen ciidamada Puntland iyo ciidamada kale, ka hor inta aysan Puntland la wareegin xarunta. Madaxweyne Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa Sabtidii tegay Gaalkacyo, iyadoo xaaladda ammaanka iyo xoojinta maamulka Puntland ay qeyb ka yihiin arrimaha ugu waaweyn ee socdaalkiisa. Xiisadda hadda jirta ayaa salka ku haysa khilaaf siyaasadeed oo muddo dheer u dhexeeyay Dowladda Federaalka iyo Puntland, balse bilihii ugu dambeeyay isu beddelay muran toos ah oo ku saabsan cidda xaqa u leh inay ciidamo qorto, saldhigyo sameysato ama dhaqdhaqaaq ciidan ka sameyso gudaha Puntland. Dhinaca kale, Dowladda Federaalka waxay ku adkeysatay inay xaq u leedahay qorista ciidamada qaranka ee ka imanaya dhammaan gobollada dalka. Mid ka mid ah saraakiisha hoggaamineysa ciidamada ayaa maanta sheegay in ciidankoodu u guuray deegaanka Xumbays ee gobolka Karkaar, balse aysan isku dhiibin ama ku biirin ciidamada Puntland. items.description: Irro Pitch: Somaliland Offers Trade Ties, Not Handouts Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdillahi (Irro) urged international partners and diplomats in Nairobi to move past traditional aid dependency and embrace direct economic investment. items.title: Weriye Mascuud Warsame Oo Xorriyaddiisa Dib U Helay Ka Dib 40 Maalmood Oo Uu Sharci-Darro U Xirnaa
items.description: Magaalada Muqdisho waxaa maanta xabsi laga sii daayay Weriye Mascuud Warsame oo ah Maamulaha Telefishanka Xogbile TV, ka dib markii uu 40 maalmood oo xiriir ah ku jiray gacanta hay’adaha ammaanka ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Sii-deynta weriyaha ayaa timid iyadoo aan wax eed ah oo sharci ah lagu soo oogin intii uu xirnaa, taas oo muujinaysa in xariggiisu uu ahaa mid sharci-darro ah oo ka dhan ah xorriyadda saxaafadda. Bannaanbaxyo iyo dadaallo ay dhigeen hawlwadeennada warbaahinta iyo ururka u-dooda xuquuqda suxufiyiinta ee Safe Reporters of Somalia (SRS) ayaa ugu dambeyntii dhaliyay in Mascuud uu dib u helo xorriyaddiisa, dibna ugu laabto shaqadiisii. Dhanka kale, wariyaha iyo bahda saxaafadda ayaa dowladda Soomaaliya ugu baaqay in ay xil gaar ah iska saarto ilaalinta iyo badqabka hawlwadeennada warbaahinta, kuwaas oo u taagan u-adeegidda bulshada iyo baahinta xogta ay muwaadiniintu xaqa u leeyihiin.

Warsaxaadeed goor sii horreysay kasoo baxay Booliska Puntland ayaa lagu sheegay in ciidamadu qabsadeen taliskii magaalada Carmo, isla markaana ay xaqiijiyeen amniga guud ee taliska iyo maamulka goobta. “Dawladda Puntland ayaa maanta si rasmi ah ula wareegtay talis ciidan oo ku yaalla magaalada Carmo, kaas oo ay hore u deggenaayeen maleeshiyaad hubaysan kuwaas oo degaannada Puntland ka waday falal lagu khal-khalgalinaayo amniga iyo xasiloonida bulshada,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Intaas kadib waxaa sheegashada Puntland siyaabo kala duwan uga falceliyay dadweynaha isticmaala baraha bulshada oo qaarkood sheegay in ciidamada dowladda ay mar hore si nabad ah uga baxeen xerada ay ku lahaayeen magaalada Carmo. Cabdullahi Bashaa: “Raga maad soo qab-qabataan hadddii aad run sheegaysaan, mise duulaanku ciidan gaar ah ayuu ahaa”. Maxamuud Macallinm: “Waxa aad la wareegteen ma dambaskii iyo digsiyadii cuntada lagu karsan jiraybaa, ileen ceeb looma dhinto”. Cabdi Cali Axmed: “Muhiimadda hubka ayey ahayd miyaa laga qaaday? mise xero qalalan ayaa la wareegteen?. Shacabka runta haloo sheego”. Salmaan Maxamd Barre: “Maxaad naftiina been ugu shegaysaan ciidankii halkaa daganaa inay xalay ka gureen cid walbaa og”. Cabdirxmaan Shire: “Guul iyo Gobanimo waa astaan dowladnimo oo xoogeysaneysa”. Maxamed Jaamac: “Ciidanka meesha deganaa in ay ka baxayn ayaan maqlayaa bal sawirro soo raaciya”. items.title: Grenade Explosion In Hargeisa Injures Four in Rare Security Incident
items.description: Hargeisa (WDN) — A rare and deeply unsettling security incident has shaken Hargeisa after a hand grenade exploded in the city overnight, injuring four people in an incident that appears highly unusual for Somaliland, widely regarded as one of the safest and most stable parts of Somalia. According to the Somaliland Police Command, the explosion injured four people—two civilians and two members of the Somaliland military. All four were taken to Hargeisa General Hospital, where they are receiving medical treatment. Police said the explosion occurred at a location where two Somaliland soldiers were sitting. A hand grenade reportedly detonated at the scene, causing injuries to the two soldiers as well as two civilians who were nearby. The circumstances surrounding the explosion remain under investigation.In a statement, police said the grenade fell to the ground from one of the injured soldiers, although authorities have not yet explained how the device came into his possession or what caused it to detonate. The incident has caused particular alarm because serious security incidents involving explosives are exceptionally rare in Hargeisa. Somaliland has long been regarded as one of the more peaceful and secure areas of Somalia, with Hargeisa generally insulated from the kind of militant attacks, bombings and armed violence that have periodically affected other major Somali cities. The explosion has generated shock among residents and raised questions about how a hand grenade came to be present in a public setting in the capital. While there is currently no indication from the authorities that the incident was a terrorist attack, police have yet to establish the full circumstances surrounding the explosion. Investigation Underway The Somaliland Police Command said its investigation remains ongoing and promised to provide further details once the circumstances become clearer. The authorities have not identified any suspect, nor have they suggested that the explosion was linked to an organized militant group. For now, the incident remains an unexplained explosion involving a military-grade hand grenade, with both soldiers and civilians among the casualties. The rarity of such an event in Hargeisa has nevertheless amplified public concern. For decades, Somaliland’s relative stability has been one of its defining characteristics and a central part of its political identity. Any incident involving explosives in the heart of the capital is therefore likely to attract considerably more attention than a similar event elsewhere in Somalia. As investigators work to determine exactly what happened, residents are waiting for answers to the most important questions: How did the grenade reach the scene, why did it explode, and was the incident accidental or something more deliberate? Until those questions are answered, the explosion remains a disturbing and highly unusual event in a city that has long prided itself on its exceptional record of security. items.title: Somaliya oo ka Baxday 10-ka dal ee ugu halista badan dunida – Warbixinta IEP
items.description: Soomaaliya kuma jirto 10-ka dal ee ugu hooseeya marka la eego heerka nabadda dunida, sida lagu sheegay warbixinta cusub ee Global Peace Index 2026, oo uu soo saaray Machadka Dhaqaalaha iyo Nabadda. Warbixinta oo qiimeysay 163 dal iyo dhulal madax-bannaan ayaa Soomaaliya gelisay kaalinta 153-aad, iyadoo heshay dhibcaha 2.973. Taasi waxay Soomaaliya ka dhigaysaa dalka 11-aad ee ugu hooseeya qiimeynta nabadda, sidaas darteedna kama mid aha 10-ka dal ee ugu dambeeya liiska. 10-ka dal ee ugu hooseeya qiimeynta Global Peace Index 2026 waxaa ka mid ah Ruushka oo kaalinta 163-aad ku jira, Suudaan 162-aad, Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo 161-aad, Ukraine 160-aad, Israel 159-aad, Koonfurta Suudaan 158-aad, Afghanistan 157-aad, Yemen 156-aad, Suuriya 155-aad iyo Mali 154-aad. Soomaaliya oo kaalinta 153-aad ku jirta ayaa sidaas darteed hal boos ka sarreysa Mali, oo ah dalka 10-aad ee ugu hooseeya qiimeynta. Soomaaliya oo weli wajahaysa caqabado amni Inkasta oo Soomaaliya aysan ku jirin 10-ka dal ee ugu hooseeya, warbixintu ma muujinayso in xaaladda nabadda Soomaaliya ay wanaagsan tahay. Dhibcaha Soomaaliya ee 2026 waxay ahaayeen 2.973, waxaana dalka laga diiwaangeliyey hoos-u-dhac afar boos ah marka loo eego qiimeyntii hore. Warbixintu sidoo kale waxay sheegtay in Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay dalalka ay xaaladda amni iyo nabadgelyo si weyn uga sii dartay. Marka la eego qaaradda Afrika ee ka hooseysa Saxaraha, Soomaaliya waxay kaalinta 41-aad kaga jirtaa 44-ka dal ee gobolkaas lagu qiimeeyay. Kaliya Mali, Koonfurta Suudaan iyo Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo ayaa ka hooseeya Soomaaliya. Warbixintu waxay sheegtay in gobolka Afrika ee ka hooseeya Saxaraha uu guud ahaan wax yar hoos ugu dhacay dhinaca nabadda, iyadoo 8 ka mid ah 20-ka dal ee ugu nabada darran dunida ay ku yaallaan gobolkaas. IEP ayaa tilmaantay in hoos-u-dhaca muddada dheer uu si weyn ula xiriiray kororka colaadaha hubeysan iyo argagixisada, gaar ahaan gobolka Saaxil. Soomaaliya iyo colaadaha Geeska Afrika Warbixinta IEP waxay si gaar ah u tilmaamaysaa in colaadaha Geeska Afrika aysan hadda ahayn kuwo si buuxda u kala madax-bannaan. Soomaaliya, Suudaan, Itoobiya, Eritrea iyo Koonfurta Suudaan ayaa lagu tilmaamay inay qayb ka yihiin nidaam colaadeed oo isku xiran, iyadoo dhaqdhaqaaqa qaxootiga, shabakadaha tahriibka dahabka, taageerada dhinacyada dagaallamaya iyo tartanka dekedaha Badda Cas ay ka mid yihiin arrimaha xiriirinaya colaadaha gobolka. Dunida oo dhan nabaddu hoos u dhacday Global Peace Index 2026 wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in xaaladda nabadda adduunka ay sii xumaatay. Celceliska heerka nabadda caalamka ayaa hoos u dhacay 0.7 boqolkiiba, waana sanadkii 12-aad oo xiriir ah oo nabaddu dunida ka sii xumaato. IEP waxay qiimeynta ku saleeysay 23 tilmaamood, kuwaas oo loo qaybiyey saddex qaybood oo waaweyn: amniga iyo badbaadada bulshada, colaadaha gudaha iyo kuwa caalamiga ah, iyo militariga. Sidaas darteed, inkastoo Soomaaliya ay weli ku jirto dalalka ugu hooseeya qiimeynta nabadda, haddana xogta IEP waxay si cad u muujinaysaa in Soomaaliya aysan ku jirin 10-ka dal ee ugu hooseeya Global Peace Index 2026; waxay ku jirtaa kaalinta 153-aad ee 163 dal, taas oo ka dhigan inay tahay 11-aad ee ugu hooseeya.

items.title: Refugees International Iyo Dowladda Soomaaliya Oo Ka Wada Hadlay Xoojinta Iskaashiga Beeraha Iyo Laqabsiga Cimilada
items.description: Wasiirka Beeraha iyo Waraabka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Maxamed Cabdi Xayir (Maareeye), ayaa maanta qaabilay wafdi ka socday hay’adda Refugees International (RI), oo uu hoggaaminayay Guddoomiyaha hay’adda, Jeremy Konyndyk, oo uu weheliyo Cabdullaahi Halakhe. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada sugnaanta cuntada, adkeysiga bulshada iyo sidii maalgelinta beeraha loogu adeegsan lahaa soo kabashada hab-nololeedyada, gaar ahaan kuwa dadka barakacayaasha ah, iyo helidda xalal waara. Sidoo kale, waxaa si gaar ah looga hadlay u diyaar-garowga khataraha ka dhalan kara xaaladaha El Niño, oo ay ka mid yihiin daadadka, roobabka xad-dhaafka ah, waxyeellada dalagyada iyo barakaca bulshada. Wasiir Maareeye ayaa kulanka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo nidaamyada digniinta hore, maaraynta biyaha, waraabka iyo horumarinta beero u adkeysan kara isbeddelka cimilada, si loo yareeyo saameynta musiibooyinka loona ilaaliyo wax-soo-saarka beeraha. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo qaaday maalgelinta beeraha, horumarinta silsiladaha qiimaha wax-soo-saarka, dhismaha kaabayaasha miyiga iyo abuurista fursado shaqo oo loogu talagalay dhalinyarada iyo haweenka. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Refugees International ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah, si Soomaaliya looga taageero la qabsiga isbeddelka cimilada, soo kabashada hab-nololeedyada iyo dhismaha nidaam cunto oo adkeysi leh.

items.title: Kenyan Court Hands Somali Suspect 115-Year Sentence in Al-Shabaab-Linked Case
items.description: Nairobi (WDN) — A Kenyan court has sentenced Ibrahim Hussein Hassan to a staggering combined 115 years in prison after finding him guilty on seven separate charges in a case involving allegations of terrorism, weapons use, and links to the militant group Al-Shabaab. Despite the extraordinary length of the combined sentences, Kenyan law reportedly limits the maximum period an individual can actually spend in prison to 20 years. Ibrahim, who was arrested in 2022, is therefore expected to remain behind bars until approximately 2042, barring any change in the law, successful appeal, or other judicial decision. The prosecution presented 10 witnesses, along with videos recovered from the defendant’s mobile phone and other evidence that prosecutors said demonstrated his involvement with weapons and his links to Al-Shabaab. The court also ordered Ibrahim to participate in a deradicalization and rehabilitation programme during his imprisonment. The measure is intended to address extremist beliefs and reduce the risk of him returning to activities associated with the charges after his eventual release. The case highlights Kenya’s continuing efforts to confront Al-Shabaab’s networks, particularly in communities near the country’s border with Somalia. Kenyan authorities have arrested numerous Somali and Kenyan nationals in recent years on allegations ranging from supporting or facilitating Al-Shabaab to possessing weapons and attempting to cross into Somalia to join the militant organization. Some suspects have been detained during security operations in border areas, while others have reportedly been arrested while attempting to travel toward Somalia. Kenya has continued to tighten security measures along its Somali border as the threat posed by Al-Shabaab remains a major national-security concern. Kenyan courts have consequently handled a growing number of cases involving terrorism-related allegations, weapons offences, and attempts to join or support armed extremist groups. The Ibrahim Hussein Hassan case is particularly striking because of the 115-year cumulative sentence, even though the practical period of imprisonment is reportedly capped at two decades. The verdict nevertheless sends a powerful message from Kenya’s judicial system: authorities intend to pursue severe legal consequences against individuals found responsible for supporting militant networks and activities linked to Al-Shabaab. items.title: Yemeni National Stabbed to Death Inside Mogadishu Mosque During Friday Prayers
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — A Yemeni national, Fikri Hassan Al-Musbahi, was reportedly stabbed to death inside a mosque in Mogadishu while attending Friday prayers, in a shocking incident that has drawn condemnation from his family and renewed concerns over the safety of civilians in places of worship. According to his brother, Mohammed Hassan Al-Musbahi, Fikri was violently attacked inside the Suuqa Xayaat Mosque in Mogadishu’s Boondheere district. The family says he was stabbed multiple times by a Somali national, ultimately suffering fatal injuries. The circumstances surrounding the attack remain unclear, including what may have triggered the confrontation. No official account from Somali authorities has been provided in the information available. For the Al-Musbahi family, the killing is particularly devastating because it allegedly occurred inside a mosque during one of the most sacred moments of the Islamic week. The family described the incident as a horrifying act that violated not only Fikri’s right to life but also the sanctity of a place of worship. Fikri had reportedly moved to Somalia in search of employment and had secured a job with an electricity company. Before relocating to Somalia, he had worked at the Al-Mansoura Power Station in Aden, Yemen. According to his relatives, he came to Somalia simply to earn a living and support his family. The family described Fikri as a peaceful man known for his good character, respectful conduct and positive reputation among those who knew him. Family Demands Justice The Al-Musbahi family has strongly condemned the killing and called on Somali security authorities to conduct an immediate, transparent and thorough investigation. They are demanding that the circumstances surrounding the attack be established and that anyone responsible be brought before the law. The family has emphasized that its demand is for justice, not revenge, insisting that the killing must be handled through due process and the rule of law. They have also appealed to the Yemeni government, the Yemeni Embassy in Somalia, and the company that employed Fikri to closely monitor the case and cooperate with Somali authorities to ensure that his rights and those of his family are protected. The family has further appealed for all necessary procedures to be expedited so that Fikri’s body can be returned to Yemen, allowing his relatives to bury him among his family and loved ones. For the Al-Musbahi family, the tragedy extends beyond the loss of a beloved relative. They say the killing raises serious questions about the safety and dignity of Yemeni citizens living and working abroad. The alleged killing of a foreign national inside a mosque during Friday prayers is likely to face intense scrutiny, particularly as authorities seek to establish exactly what happened, why the attack occurred and whether the suspect has been apprehended. Until an official investigation is completed, key details surrounding the killing remain unverified. But for Fikri’s family, one demand is unequivocal: the truth must be established, justice must prevail, and those responsible must be held accountable under the law. items.title: Muxuu Axmed Madoobe kala hadlay danjiraha Faransiiska? + Sawirro
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jubbaland, Mudane Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe) ayaa maanta magaalada Kismaayo kula kulmay safiirka dowladda Faransiiska u qaabilsan dalalka Soomaaliya iyo Kenya Danjire Arnaud Suquet, isaga oo kala hadlay xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay. Kulanka oo uu Axmed Madoobe ku wehliyey Wasiirka Qorshaynta Jubbaland Cabdiraxmaan Cabdi Axmed ayaa diiradda lagu saaray arrimaha amniga, la dagaallanka argagixisada, xaaladda guud ee Soomaaliya iyo arrimaha kale ee muhiimka u ah xoojinta dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda iyo xasilloonida. Sidoo kale, waxaa kulanka lagu soo qaaday horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, arrimaha bini’aadantinimada iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in la dardargeliyo taageerada caalamiga ah ee lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo horumarka. Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dhaq-dhaqaaqyo uu maalmahan Axmed Madoobe ka waday Kismaayo, isaga oo ku qaabilay wafuud kala duwan oo ka socda beesha caalamka iyo Mareykanka, waxaana ugu dambeeyay xubnihii Golaha Congress-ka ee uu kusoo dhaweeyay xarunta madaxtooyada ee Jubbaland. Kulankaas ayaa looga hadlay iskaashiga Jubaland iyo Mareykanka ee la xiriira la dagaallanka Al-Shabaab. Waxaa kale oo lagu soo qaaday taageerada Mareykanka ee amniga iyo dhismaha hay’adaha dowladda. Mas’uuliyiinta ka socday dowladda Maraykanka ayaa sidoo kale bogaadiyey dadaallada joogtada ah ee ay Jubaland ku bixisay la dagaallanka argagixisada, maadaama muddo dheer oo sanado ah ay dagaal kula jirto Khawaarijta. Waxay sidoo kale bogaadiyeen guulihii u dambeeyey ee ay gaareen Ciidamada Daraawiishta Jubaland iyo kuwa Danab qeybta Jubaland, kuwaas oo iyaga oo kaashanaya AFRICOM fuliyey hawlgallo wadajir ah oo lagu wiiqayo argagixisada. items.title: Somalia: Puntland seizes third federal base
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Puntland security forces seized a third military base from Somalia’s federal government on Saturday, part of a sweeping campaign to strip Mogadishu-aligned troops from the region and place the use of force exclusively under regional authority. Regional police said in a statement that they had taken control of a federal government base in the town of Carmo, in Bari region, roughly 100 kilometres from the commercial port city of Bosaso. The takeover was carried out without clashes, police said, and was accompanied by the dismantling of what they described as militias accused of plotting to destabilise the regional administration. The Carmo operation extends a rapid succession of base seizures across Puntland’s northeastern territory over the past week, each testing the reach of the federal government and the cohesion of its forces stationed outside the capital. A week of retreats The campaign began days earlier when regional forces took a federal base in Bosaso peacefully, after government troops stationed there surrendered without resistance. It escalated sharply on Wednesday, when Puntland forces captured a large military complex in Galkayo following a gunfight that left dozens wounded, though no fatalities were confirmed. Analysts have described Wednesday’s fall of the Galkayo complex as the most significant setback President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration has suffered at the hands of a federal member state since the Raskamboni debacle of 2024, when more than 1,500 federal forces were routed by Jubaland regional troops. That earlier collapse followed a bitter dispute over the re-election of Jubaland President Ahmed Madobe, a vote Mogadishu branded a sham, rigged and unacceptable. A widening pattern Taken together, the Bosaso, Galkayo and Carmo operations point to a coordinated effort by Puntland’s administration to dismantle the federal government’s remaining military footprint in the region and assert unchallenged control over armed force within its borders – a trajectory that echoes, and now risks compounding, the precedent set by Jubaland two years earlier. items.title: Yaa la tartamaya Jaamac oo loo wado xilka afhayeenka BF?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimada Soomaaliya waxaa haatan ka socota qaban-qaabadii ugu dambeysay ee doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, taas oo lagu wado inay dhacdo 10-ka bishan oo ku beegan maalinta Isniinta ah ee soo socota. Doorashadan oo si weyn isha loogu hayo ayaa waxaa llaa iyo haatan ugu cad-cad Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo maanta qaatay shahaadada musharraxnimada, kadib markii uu isku diiwaangeliyay doorashada. Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo hadda ah Wasiirka Dekadaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda Xukuumadda Soomaaliya ayaa wxaa la tartami doono Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Cumar Macallin (Daada) oo isna qaatay shahaadada. Labadan musharrax ayaa hadda isugu soo haray tartanka, maadaama ay horay u tanaasuleen musharrixiintii kale, waxaana ugu dambeeyay Saadaad Caliyow oo maalmo kahor ku dhawaaqay inuu ka haray tartanka, kadib heshiis uu la gaaray Jaamac, kaas oo ay sidoo kal garwadeen ka ahayd Villa Soomaaliya. Jaamac oo xilal kala duwan kasoo qabtay xukuumadda hadda jirta ayaa la filayaa inuu soo buuxiyo kursigii uu baneeyay Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe), wuxuuna taageerada ugu badan ka helayaa Madaxweynaha iyo Ra’iisul wasaaraha, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen ilo wareedyo xilkas ah. Ninka la tartamaya Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Cumar Macallin (Daada) oo kasoo jeeda degmada Tiyeeglow ayaa loo arkaa malxiis oo kaliya, waxaana si wayn uga falceliyay qaar kamid ah dadweynaha isticmaala baraha bulshada. Saciid Shuuriye: “Doorashada xiiso ma laha ee waxaa tartanka jiilka cusbaa soo xiray Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo dalka xoog ku qabsaday”. Cabdinaasir Shariif : “Doorasho ma ahan waa xulasho kalsooni iskuma qabo Jaamac waa fulay caadi ah”. Deeq Sheekh Mukhtaar: “Jaamac iskuma kasloona in laga badinayo ayuu ogyahay dadkii la tartami lahaa intuu ka cabsaday ayuu malxiis soo watay”. Si kastaba, Doorashadan ayaa waxa ay kusoo aadeysaa, xilli xasaasi ah oo taagan tahay xiisad u dhexeysa Villa Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka oo weli isku hayaano hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo wax ka beddelka dastuurka dalka. items.title: Cirro oo shardi ku xiray dib u bilaabista wada-hadallada Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro, ayaa sheegay in dib loo bilaabi karo wada-hadallada u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland, balse uu shardi ka dhigay in marka hore la fuliyo heshiisyadii hore ee ay labada dhinac gaareen. Cirro ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay magaalada Nairobi, xilli uu khudbad u jeedinayay safiirro, madaxda hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo saaxiibbada horumarinta ee ku sugan Kenya. Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa sheegay in Somaliland ay horey u muujisay inay diyaar u tahay wada-hadallada, balse uu ku dooday in heshiisyadii hore ee labada dhinac aan si buuxda loo fulin. “Waxaan si xushmad leh uga codsaneynaa saaxiibbadeenna caalamka inaysan ku ekaan dhiirrigelinta wada-hadalka, balse ay sidoo kale Soomaaliya ku dhiirrigeliyaan inay fuliso heshiisyadii hore loo gaaray,” ayuu yiri Cirro. Wuxuu si gaar ah u tusaaleeyay maamulka hawada rayidka ah, oo uu sheegay inuu ka mid yahay heshiisyadii hore ee labada dhinac, balse aan weli la fulin sida uu sheegay. Cirro ayaa sidoo kale dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ku eedeeyay inay faragelin ku hayso arrimaha Somaliland, isagoo sheegay in Muqdisho ay xoogga saarayso Somaliland halkii ay wax uga qaban lahayd caqabadaha siyaasadeed, amni iyo bani’aadantinimo ee ka jira gudaha Soomaaliya. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga jawaabin hadallada Madaxweynaha Somaliland. Somaliland ayaa 1991 ku dhawaaqday inay ka go’day Soomaaliya, iyadoo tan iyo xilligaas raadineysay aqoonsi caalami ah. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda si joogto ah u sheegta inay ilaalinayso midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, waxayna diiddan tahay madax-bannaanida Somaliland.

items.title: Lafta-gareen oo war yaab leh ka soo saaray doorashada guddoomiyaha BF Soomaaliya
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen) oo war qoraal ah soo saaray ayaa ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan doorashada guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka iyo xaaladda guud ee Koonfur Galbeed. Lafta-gareen oo weli sheeganaya inuu yahay Madaxweynaha sharciga ah ee Koonfur Galbeed ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in aysan qayb ka ahayn doorashada Muqdisho ka socoto ee lagu doonayo in lagu soo buuxiyo kursigii Baarlamaanka ee uu baneeyay Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur Madoobe) Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in aysan jirin cid wakiil uga doorashadaas oo ay ku tartami doonaan xildhibaanno kasoo jeedo Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. “Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Waxa ay cadeynaysaa in aysan qeyb ka ahayn doorashada sharcidaradda ah ee uu Xasan Shiikh ka wado Muqdisho, qeyb kama nihin, mana aqoonsanin cid wakiil nooga ahna majirto,” Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo haatan dibad joog ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ay weli ku howlan yihiin sidii loo xoreyn lahaa Koonfur Galbeed, ayna sii wadi doonaan howlgallada ay ka wadaan aagga magaaada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. “Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed waajibaadkeeda u yaallo kaliya waxa waaya gobbanimada, xornimada iyo sidii ay usoo celin lahayd dowladnimada Koonfur Galbeed oo ay gumaysiga uga dulqaadi lahayd”. Dhinaca kale, Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo ah afhayeenka Lafta-gareen oo isaguna shir jaraa’id qabtay ayaa faah-faahiyay go’aannadooda, wuxuuna sheegay in gebi ahaanba aysan aqoonsaneen Baarlamaan Soomaaliyeed oo dalka ka jira, isaga oo uu sheegay inuu ka dhammaaday muddo xileedka. “Dowladda koonfur Galbeed Soomaaiya ma aqoonsana Baarlamaan Soomaaliyeed oo maanta ka jiro Soomaaliya, sababtoo ah Baarlamaanka waqtigiisu waa dhacay,” ayuu isna yiri afhayeenka Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. items.title: US Releases 600,000 Mosquitoes to Fight Mosquitoes
items.description: US Company Releases 600,000 Male Mosquitoes in New Effort to Control Disease-Carrying Species WASHINGTON — Hundreds of thousands of specially treated male mosquitoes are being released into residential neighborhoods in the Washington area as part of an innovative effort to reduce populations of disease-carrying mosquitoes without relying heavily on chemical pesticides. A US mosquito-control company plans to release approximately 600,000 male mosquitoes across the region by the end of the summer, targeting the invasive Asian tiger mosquito, scientifically known as Aedes albopictus . The released mosquitoes are males, meaning they do not bite humans. They carry a naturally occurring bacterium known as Wolbachia , which scientists have used as a biological tool to disrupt mosquito reproduction. When the treated males mate with wild female Asian tiger mosquitoes, the resulting eggs fail to hatch, helping to reduce the mosquito population over time. Targeting an Invasive Mosquito Species The program specifically targets Aedes albopictus , commonly known as the Asian tiger mosquito because of its distinctive black-and-white markings. The species is considered invasive in the United States and is capable of transmitting several serious diseases, including dengue, Zika and chikungunya . Unlike conventional mosquito-control methods that may involve widespread pesticide spraying, the Wolbachia approach is designed to target a particular mosquito species. Supporters say this could provide a more environmentally focused way of controlling mosquito populations while reducing the use of chemicals around homes, gardens, pets and waterways. How Does the Technology Work? Wolbachia is a bacterium that occurs naturally in many insect species. Scientists have developed different ways of using the bacterium to control mosquitoes. In this program, male mosquitoes carrying a specific strain of Wolbachia are released into areas populated by wild female tiger mosquitoes. When the two mate, biological incompatibility prevents the eggs from successfully developing and hatching. Because only male mosquitoes are released, the program does not introduce additional biting mosquitoes into residential neighborhoods. Male mosquitoes primarily feed on plant nectar rather than blood. Over repeated releases, researchers hope the process will significantly reduce the number of Asian tiger mosquitoes in targeted areas. Thousands Released Every Week Around 25 households have reportedly signed up for the residential program. Participating properties receive approximately 1,500 male mosquitoes each week for 16 weeks , allowing large numbers of treated males to continuously compete with wild males for mates. The company behind the initiative says the project represents the first residential mosquito-control service of its kind in the United States . The company expects to release around 600,000 mosquitoes across participating areas by the end of the summer. An Alternative to Chemical Spraying For some residents, one of the biggest attractions of the program is the possibility of reducing dependence on traditional insecticides. Chemical mosquito-control products remain widely used, but concerns about their potential impact on other insects and the surrounding environment have encouraged scientists and mosquito-control companies to explore more targeted alternatives. Residents participating in the program say they were attracted by an approach that seeks to reduce mosquito numbers biologically rather than through repeated chemical spraying. Scientists Say Local Conditions Matter Despite growing interest in Wolbachia-based mosquito control, researchers caution that its effectiveness can vary depending on local environmental conditions. Mosquitoes from surrounding untreated areas can move into neighborhoods where releases are taking place, potentially reducing the overall impact. Geography, weather, mosquito density and movement between neighborhoods can therefore influence how successful the strategy becomes. Wolbachia technology has also been studied internationally for another purpose: reducing mosquitoes’ ability to transmit viruses such as dengue. Researchers continue to examine how the technology can be used effectively at larger scales and under different environmental conditions. Demand Growing for New Mosquito-Control Approach The residential program has reportedly reached capacity for this year, with reservations already being accepted for 2027 . The growing interest comes as governments, scientists and communities around the world search for new ways to combat mosquito-borne diseases while reducing dependence on conventional pesticides. While researchers say further assessment is needed to determine how effectively residential releases can suppress mosquito populations across wider areas, the Washington initiative provides a glimpse of how biological mosquito control could increasingly become part of efforts to protect communities from invasive, disease-carrying species. The post US Releases 600,000 Mosquitoes to Fight Mosquitoes first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Mareykanka Oo 600,000 Kaneecooyin Dagaal La Galaya.
items.description: Mareykanka oo 600,000 oo Kaneeco ah Sii Deynaya si Looga Hortago Faafitaanka Cudurrada WASHINGTON — Hab cusub oo lagula dagaallamayo kaneecada ayaa laga hirgeliyey deegaanno ka tirsan Washington DC iyo nawaaxigeeda, iyadoo boqollaal kun oo kaneeco lab ah lagu sii deynayo xaafadaha si loo yareeyo tirada kaneecada gudbisa cudurrada. Shirkad Mareykan ah oo lagu magacaabo Bee Safe Mosquito Control ayaa qorsheyneysa inay xagaagan sii deyso ilaa 600,000 oo kaneeco lab ah , kuwaas oo si gaar ah loogu diyaariyey inay carqaladeeyaan taranka kaneecada duurjoogta ah. Kaneecada la sii deynayo waa lab, sidaas darteed dadka ma qaniinto. Waxay siddaa bakteeriyo dabiici ah oo loo yaqaan Wolbachia , taas oo marka kaneecada labka ahi la kulanto dheddigga duurjoogta ah sababta in ukumaha ka dhasha aysan dillaacin. Habkan ayaa loogu talagalay in si tartiib tartiib ah loo yareeyo tirada kaneecada, iyadoo aan si weyn loogu tiirsanaan sunta cayayaanka lagu buufiyo. Waxaa si gaar ah loo beegsanayaa kaneecada Tiger-ka Barnaamijkan ayaa diiradda saaraya nooca kaneecada ee Aedes albopictus , oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Asian tiger mosquito. Waa nooc kaneeco ah oo ku faafay qaybo badan oo dunida ah, waxaana uu awood u leeyahay gudbinta cudurro ay ka mid yihiin dengue, Zika iyo chikungunya . Shirkadda fulineysa mashruuca ayaa sheegtay in farsamadan ay si gaar ah u beegsaneyso noocan kaneecada ah, halkii la isticmaali lahaa sun si guud u saameyn karta cayayaanka kale. Sidee ayuu nidaamku u shaqeeyaa? Fikradda farsamadan ayaa ah mid fudud: kaneecada labka ah ee sidda Wolbachia ayaa lagu sii daayaa deegaanka, halkaas oo ay kula kulmeyso kaneecada dheddigga ah ee duurjoogta ah. Marka ay isqabtaan, ukumaha ay dheddiggu dhasho ma noqdaan kuwo sii noolaan kara oo dillaaca. Maadaama kaneecada labka ahi aysan dadka qaniinin, sii deyntooda looma arko inay kordhineyso halista qaniinyada kaneecada. Wolbachia lafteedu waa bakteeriyo si dabiici ah looga helo cayayaan badan, waxaana muddo dheer daraasad ku sameynayay saynisyahanno doonaya habab cusub oo lagu xakameeyo kaneecada iyo cudurrada ay gudbiso. 1,500 oo kaneeco ah toddobaad kasta Qiyaastii 25 macaamiil oo deggan Washington DC iyo Maryland ayaa sanadkan ka qeyb qaadanaya adeegga. Guryaha ka qeyb qaadanaya barnaamijka waxaa toddobaad kasta lagu sii daayaa qiyaastii 1,500 oo kaneeco lab ah , iyadoo sii deyntu soconeyso toddobaadyo badan inta lagu jiro xilliga kaneecadu badan tahay. Shirkaddu waxay sheegtay in tani ay tahay markii ugu horreysay ee Mareykanka adeeg noocan ah si toos ah loogu bixiyo guryaha dadka. Beddelka sunta cayayaanka Mid ka mid ah sababaha mashruucan loo bilaabay ayaa ah in la helo hab kale oo lagu xakameeyo kaneecada, iyadoo la yareynayo isticmaalka sunta cayayaanka. Dadka taageersan farsamadan ayaa qaba in isticmaalka kaneecada labka ah uu noqon karo hab deegaanka u wanaagsan, gaar ahaan meelaha ay dadku ka walaacsan yihiin sunta lagu buufiyo agagaarka guryaha, jardiinooyinka iyo xayawaanka guryaha lagu dhaqdo. Habka Wolbachia ma aha mid gebi ahaanba ku cusub dunida. Farsamooyin la xiriira bakteeriyadan ayaa hore loogu tijaabiyey dalal iyo deegaanno kala duwan si loo xakameeyo kaneecada iyo cudurrada ay gudbiso. Saynisyahannada oo weli qiimeynaya waxtarkiisa Inkasta oo farsamadani muujisay natiijooyin rajo leh, cilmi-baarayaashu waxay tilmaamayaan in guusheedu ku xirnaan karto xaaladda deegaanka. Tusaale ahaan, haddii kaneeco badan ay ka soo guurto xaafadaha aan barnaamijka laga fulin oo ay soo gasho goobaha la daweeyey, waxaa hoos u dhici kara waxtarka mashruuca. Dhaqdhaqaaqa kaneecada, cimilada, juqraafiyadda deegaanka iyo tirada kaneecada duurjoogta ah ayaa dhammaantood saameyn ku yeelan kara natiijada. Daraasad lagu daabacay New England Journal of Medicine sanadkan ayaa sidoo kale muujisay in sii deynta kaneeco lab ah oo Wolbachia sidda ay qeyb ka noqon karto dadaallada lagu yareynayo kaneecada iyo halista dengue, taas oo sii kordhisay xiisaha loo qabo farsamadan. Dalabka adeegga oo kordhay Bee Safe Mosquito Control ayaa sheegtay in adeeggeeda residential-ka ee sanadkan uu hadda buuxsamay, isla markaana shirkaddu ay billowday inay qaadato dadka doonaya inay ka qeyb qaataan 2027 . Haddii mashruucan iyo daraasadaha kale ay muujiyaan natiijooyin wanaagsan, farsamada Wolbachia waxay mustaqbalka noqon kartaa mid ka mid ah hababka muhiimka ah ee magaalooyinka loogu xakameeyo kaneecada, gaar ahaan xilli cudurrada kaneecadu gudbiso ay weli caqabad ku yihiin caafimaadka bulshada qaybo badan oo dunida ah. items.title: Qaabka iyo qiyamka aqoonsiga waa ku dhaawac waxn Somalia inoo soo maraa
items.description: Dawladihii kala dambeeyey ee Somaliland, waxay aqbaleen in metelaad Soomaaliya loo soo diray, sida Danjire Soomaaliya fadhigiisu yahay dalkeena lagu soo dhaweeyo ama in mashruuc iyo maaliyad la inoo soo mariyo oo aynu u daba fadhino Muqdisho. Dhaqankaas waxaa xalaaleeyay fahanka iyo aqbalaadda rayul-caamka, balse waa dhaawac qaran oo aan la dhaadin. Arrinta maaliyadda waxa jiri kara xalal haddii ay jirto tashi iyo qab qaranimo. Haayadaha caalamiga ah iyo kuwa Qaramada Midoobay mararka qaar dalal aanay aqoonsanayn ayaa lagu qasbaa inay gaar ula macaamilaan. items.title: President Irro Highlights Somaliland’s Peace, Recognition Efforts and Infrastructure Progress, Urges World to Engage as a Sovereign Partner
items.description: Republic of Somaliland’s President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi “Irro” has told diplomats, international organizations and development partners that his government has made significant progress in restoring peace, strengthening national institutions, expanding infrastructure and reducing electricity costs, while calling for deeper international engagement with Somaliland as a responsible and capable sovereign partner. Addressing a gathering of ambassadors, heads of missions, representatives of international organizations and development partners in Nairobi, President Irro said his government had moved from making commitments at the beginning of its tenure to presenting evidence of what it has achieved during its first year and seven months in office. “When I addressed many of you in this very forum shortly after assuming office, our government was only beginning its work,” the President said. “Today, I return not merely to restate those commitments, but to report on the progress we have made, the challenges we continue to confront, and the partnership we seek as we move forward.” Peace and demobilization President Irro placed peace and national reconciliation at the top of his government’s priorities, highlighting the restoration of peace in eastern Somaliland. He said approximately 6,000 militia members had voluntarily surrendered their weapons and entered a government-led demobilization and military integration programme. The President announced that the process had now been successfully completed, with the former combatants trained and integrated into the Somaliland National Army. He also pointed to a separate conflict between two major communities that, he said, had been brought under control through sustained government engagement, traditional leadership and inclusive dialogue. A government-sponsored reconciliation conference in Garissa was cited as an example of Somaliland’s longstanding approach of resolving disputes through dialogue, consensus and mutual respect. “Peace remains the foundation upon which every other national objective must rest,” Irro said, adding that the conclusion of the conference had produced positive results aimed at consolidating peace in the region. From four priorities to a broader development agenda When his government first assumed office, President Irro said it identified four strategic productive sectors as key drivers of economic development: livestock, agriculture, fisheries and renewable energy. However, he said implementation had demonstrated that these sectors could not achieve their full potential without modern infrastructure. The government’s development priorities were therefore expanded to include investment in roads, water, energy, healthcare, education and communications. “These are the essential pillars upon which sustainable economic transformation depends,” he said. The President reiterated his government’s position that Somaliland is seeking partnership rather than dependence. “We seek partnership, not dependency. We seek investment, not charity,” Irro told the gathering, emphasizing that Somaliland wanted relations based on mutual respect, shared interests and common responsibilities. Israel recognition hailed as historic milestone One of the most significant developments during his administration, President Irro said, was Israel’s recognition of Somaliland on 26 December 2025. He described the decision as a historic diplomatic milestone and an affirmation of what Somaliland had built and defended over more than three decades. “For the people of Somaliland, this was not merely a diplomatic milestone,” he said. “It was the affirmation of reality they had defended, sustained and strengthened over more than three decades.” Irro acknowledged that the international response had been mixed, with some countries welcoming the development while others expressed reservations. Nevertheless, he said Somaliland would remain firm in its belief that its statehood should be recognized on the basis of what it has demonstrated, including democratic governance, peaceful transfers of power, functioning institutions, responsible security and regional stability. “Recognition is not the conclusion of our journey,” he said. “It is the natural consequence of what Somaliland has consistently demonstrated.” President Irro conditions the resumption of talks with Somalia President Irro also addressed Somaliland’s relationship with Somalia, saying his government remained committed to pursuing what he described as a Somaliland-led solution to the conflict in the eastern through dialogue, reconciliation and national consensus. At the same time, he accused Somalia’s federal government of increasingly destabilizing interference in Somaliland’s internal affairs. He argued that Mogadishu should focus on the political, security and humanitarian challenges confronting its own citizens rather than externalizing its difficulties. Irro acknowledged that international partners continued to encourage renewed dialogue between Somaliland and Somalia, but argued that previous negotiations had produced agreements that were not subsequently implemented. “The management of civil aviation and airspace remains a clear and contemporary example,” he said. The President urged international partners to go beyond simply encouraging dialogue and press Somalia to comply with agreements already reached. “Dialogue requires mutual respect, implementation of commitments, and confidence that agreements will be honoured,” he said. Major road projects gather momentum The President said Somaliland’s infrastructure programme was continuing to expand, with much of the financing coming from domestic resources. He cited the Borama–Baki Road and Hargeisa–Balligubadle Road as projects approaching completion. Construction is also continuing on the Lowyacaddo–Saylac–Borama corridor, with support from development partners. He said expansion work in Hargeisa-inna Guxa was also progressing, while the government had commenced two additional strategic projects, including the Burco–Oodweyne–Hargeisa corridor and the Erigavo –Maydh road. “These projects are vital for our national cohesion, regional commerce, and economic inclusion,” Irro said. He added that Somaliland was prepared to contribute significantly to the financing and implementation of major national infrastructure projects. Electricity prices cut as government targets affordable power Energy was another major component of the President’s address. For years, Somaliland has faced some of the world’s highest electricity tariffs, creating obstacles for industrial development, private investment and household welfare. Irro said his government had already reduced electricity costs in the country’s principal urban centres from approximately 80 cents to 59 cents per kilowatt. In Berbera, he said tariffs had fallen to as low as 20 cents per kilowatt, largely as a result of investment in renewable energy. The administration’s goal, he said, is to expand affordable, reliable and sustainable electricity throughout Somaliland and bring national electricity costs closer to the Berbera model before the end of its current term. Deep groundwater: Somaliland seeks advanced expertise Water security, the President said, remains one of Somaliland’s most serious long-term challenges. In several areas along the country’s southern frontier, groundwater reserves are believed to lie more than 600 metres underground, requiring advanced geological and technological expertise to locate and assess. “We therefore seek partnerships with institutions and countries possessing the technical capabilities necessary to unlock this resource,” Irro said. He also highlighted the importance of cooperation with the Royal Norwegian Embassy regarding findings from a Norwegian-supported study on deep groundwater resources in Somaliland. The government, he said, wants data specifically relating to Somaliland to remain available for future national water planning. Hargeisa Group Hospital targeted for transformation Healthcare was another area highlighted by the President as a major national priority. He said thousands of Somaliland citizens travel abroad every year to obtain specialist medical treatment, placing heavy financial pressure on families and the national economy. The government therefore aims to transform Hargeisa Group Hospital into a modern national referral facility capable of delivering high-quality specialist treatment inside Somaliland. “This is not simply an investment in healthcare,” Irro said. “This is an investment in dignity, self-reliance, and national resilience.” ‘We have returned with evidence, not a longer list of requests’ In his concluding remarks, President Irro sought to frame Somaliland’s international engagement around achievements rather than appeals for assistance. “We have not returned to Nairobi today with a longer list of requests,” he said. “We have returned with evidence.” He cited the peaceful integration of former militia members into the national army, the resolution of conflicts through dialogue, strengthened democratic institutions, the progress toward international recognition, road construction, declining electricity prices and modernization of healthcare facilities. “Evidence of roads under construction. Electricity is becoming more affordable. Hospitals are being modernized, and national development is advancing through our own commitment and resources,” he said. The President reaffirmed Somaliland’s commitment to peace, responsible governance, regional stability and constructive international engagement. He ended with a direct appeal to Somaliland’s international partners: “Engage with Somaliland not as an extension of another political entity, but as a responsible and capable sovereign partner ready to continue our shared objective of peace, security, prosperity, and sustainable development.” “Together, let us build partnerships founded not on assumptions, but on achievements; not on aspirations alone, but on demonstrated commitment,” President Irro said. He concluded by thanking the diplomatic and development community and invoking blessings for Somaliland and its international partnerships

items.title: Puntland oo xeradii sadexaad kala wareegtay ciidamada taabacsan DF Soomaaliya
items.description: Carmo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada difaaca Puntland ayaa maanta la wareegay xeradii saddexaad oo ay horay ugu sugnaayeen ciidamada taabacsan Dowladda Federaalka ee ku sugan deegaannada maamulkaasi, kuwaas oo horay dagaallo ula galay maamulka Madaxweyne Saciid Deni. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Taliska Booliska Puntland ayaa lagu sheegay in maanta ciidamadu ay la wareegeen xarun ay magaalada Carmo ku lahaayeen ciidamada dowladda ee ku sugnaa halkaasi, kuwaas oo ay Puntland ku eedeysay inay wadeen falal lagu khal-khalgelinayo amniga deegaannadaasi. “Dawladda Puntland ayaa maanta si rasmi ah ula wareegtay talis ciidan oo ku yaalla magaalada Carmo, kaas oo ay hore u deggenaayeen maleeshiyaad hubaysan kuwaas oo degaannada Puntland ka waday falal lagu khal-khalgalinaayo amniga iyo xasiloonida bulshada,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal. Sidoo kale, Puntland ayaa la wareegista xeradan ku tilmaamtay inay qayb ka tahay tallaabooyinka ay ku xaqiijinayso amniga, kala dambeynta iyo awoodda hay’adaha dowliga ah ee deegaannada maamulkaasi. Waxaa kale oo warsaxaafadeedka lagu sheegay in taliska Carmo ay hadda si buuxda gacanta ugu hayaan ciidamada Puntland, isla markaana ay sugeen amniga guud ee taliska iyo maamulka goobta. “Ciidamada Puntland ayaa si buuxda ula wareegay xarunta, waxaana la xaqiijiyey amnigeeda iyo maamulka goobta, iyadoo la faray dhammaan dhinacyada hubaysan inay u hoggaansamaan hay’adaha sharciga ah ee Dawladda Puntland,” ayaa lasii raaciyay bayaanka. Puntland ayaa sidoo kale intaas kusii dartay in ay sii wadeyso howlgallada ka dhanka ah ciidamada taabacsan ee dowladda ee ku sugan gobollada maamulkaasi, si loo soo afjaro ciidamada kasoo horjeedo maamulka. “Dawladda Puntland waxay caddeyneysaa inay sii wadi doonto tallaabooyinka lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo ilaalinta shacabka, iyadoo dhammaan hawlgallada lagu fulinayo si waafaqsan sharciga iyo Dastuurka Puntland,” ayaa lagu soo gabagabeeyay warsaxaafadeedka. Howlgalkan waxaa ka horeeyay kuwa kale oo ka dhacay Boosaaso iyo Gaalkacyo oo Puntland ay kula wareegtay laba talis oo ay magaalooyinkaas ku lahaayeen ciidanka gaarka ah ee PSF-ta ee taabacsan Dowladda Soomaaliya. Xaaladda Puntland ayaa ah mid kacsan, taas oo ka dhalatay dhaq-dhaqaaqyada hubeysan ee u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa maamulkaas oo dhawaan ku dagaalamay magaalooyin ka tirsan Puntland. The post Puntland oo xeradii sadexaad kala wareegtay ciidamada taabacsan DF Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Tababarka Gorgor oo lagu soo xiray Turkiga
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar (Khaalid) , ayaa maanta magaalada Manisa ee dalka Turkiga kula soo xiray tababar heersare ah Guutada 21 – aad Qaybta 1-aad ee Kumaandooska Gorgor, tababarkana waxaa soo xiray Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga Jeneraal Metin Tokel . Munaasabaddan ayaa noqonaysa mid taariikhi ah maadaama ay tahay guutadii ugu horreysay ee dhammaystiran oo ka tirsan Kumaandooska Gorgor taas oo hal goob lagu wada tababaray . Tababarkan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay iskaashiga milateri ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, kuwaas oo sii xoojinaya xiriirkooda istiraatiijiyadeed. Tallaabadan ayaa looga gol leeyahay dardargelinta dhismaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka si ay waajibaadka qaran ee horyaalla ugu gutaan awood iyo isku-xirnaan buuxda. Guutada Gorgor ayaa la filayaa inay door muhiim ah ka qaaddo howlgallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada, gaar ahaan dalka laga sifeeyo kooxaha Khawaarijta. items.title: Maxkamad ku taalla Kenya oo 115 sano ku xukuntay nin loo haysto inuu ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab
items.description: Maxkamad ku taalla Kenya ayaa xukun xabsi ah oo wadar ahaan gaaraya 115 sano ku ridday nin lagu helay toddobo dacwadood oo la xiriira falal argagixiso iyo xiriir uu la lahaa kooxda Al-Shabaab. Ninka lagu magacaabo Ibrahim Hussein Hassan ayaa lagu xukumay Maxkamadda Kahawa Law Courts, kaddib markii xeer-ilaalintu ay maxkamadda u soo bandhigtay caddeymo ay sheegtay inay muujinayaan inuu xubin ka ahaa Al-Shabaab, isla markaana uu ururiyay xog iyo agab lala xiriiriyay falal argagixiso. Inkasta oo xukunnada toddobada qodob ay marka la isku daro gaarayaan 115 sano , maxkamaddu waxay go’aamisay in xukunnadu isku mar u wada socdaan , taasoo ka dhigan in muddada dhabta ah ee uu xukunku dhaqan gelayo ay tahay 20 sano oo xabsi ah , oo ah xukunka ugu dheer ee lagu riday mid ka mid ah toddobada qodob. Hassan ayaa lagu xukumay 20 sano oo ku saabsan xubinimada Al-Shabaab, halka saddex qodob oo kale oo la xiriiray ururinta xog loo adeegsan karo fulinta fal argagixiso lagu xukumay midkiiba 20 sano. Saddex qodob oo dheeraad ah oo ku saabsanaa haysashada agab lala xiriiriyay argagixisada ayaa midkiiba lagu xukumay 15 sano. Kiiskan ayaa dib ugu laabanaya Sebtembar 2022 , markaas oo Hassan lagu qabtay deegaanka Eastleigh ee magaalada Nairobi, oo ay ku nool yihiin Soomaali badan. Intii ay socotay maxkamadeyntiisa, xeer-ilaalintu waxay soo bandhigtay caddeymo farsamo oo laga helay taleefan Samsung ah oo laga qabtay eedeysanaha. Sida ay maxkamaddu maqashay, taleefanka waxaa ku jiray saddex muuqaal oo loo aqoonsaday inay yihiin muuqaallo dacaayad xagjirnimo ah . Xeer-ilaalintu waxay ku dooday in agabkaasi loo adeegsan karo qorista, tababarka iyo xagjiraynta dhalinyarada , iyadoo maxkamaddu dhageysatay markhaatiyo gaaraya 10 qof. Garsooraha Maxkamadda Kahawa, Gideon Kiage , ayaa sheegay in xeer-ilaalintu ay si aan shaki macquul ah ku jirin u caddeysay dacwadda lagu soo oogay Hassan. Marka laga soo tago xukunka xabsiga, maxkamaddu waxay sidoo kale amartay in Hassan uu inta uu xabsiga ku jiro maro barnaamijka ka-hortagga xagjirnimada iyo dib-u-dhaqan-celinta (deradicalisation) . Kiiskan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Kenya ay sii xoojinayso tallaabooyinka sharci iyo amni ee ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo kooxaha kale ee xagjirka ah. Hay’adaha Kenya ayaa si isa soo taraysa ugu tiirsan caddeymaha dijitaalka ah marka ay baarayaan iyo maxkamadeynayaan kiisaska la xiriira argagixisada. Kenya waxay la kulantay weerarro badan oo lala xiriiriyay Al-Shabaab tan iyo markii ciidamadeedu ay gudaha Soomaaliya u galeen sanadkii 2011 . Weerarrada kooxda ayaa si gaar ah u saameeyay ciidamada ammaanka iyo shacabka ku nool deegaannada u dhow xuduudda Kenya iyo Soomaaliya, inkastoo weerarro waaweyn ay sidoo kale ka dhaceen magaalooyinka Kenya. Haddaba Kiiskan ayaa muujinaya sida dowladda Kenya ay iskuugu darsanayso hawlgallada amniga iyo dacwadaha maxkamadeed , iyadoo xoogga la saarayo in la carqaladeeyo qorista xubnaha cusub, xagjiraynta iyo hawlaha kale ee ay ku lug leeyihiin shabakadaha xagjirka ah.

items.title: Guddiga Doorashada Guddoonka Golaha Shacabka oo shahaadooyinka musharraxnimo guddoonsiiyay laba xildhibaan
items.description: Guddiga doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa kulan ku yeeshay xarunta golayaasha ee Villa Hargeysa , halkaas oo lagu bixiyay shahaadooyinka musharraxnimo ee doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Guddiga ayaa shahaadada musharraxnimo guddoonsiiyay Xildhibaan Cabdullaqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) iyo Xildhibaan Cabdullaqaadir Cumar Macallin (Daada) , kuwaas oo si rasmi ah uga mid noqday xildhibaannada u taagan xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Kulanka ayaa qeyb ka ahaa hannaanka doorashada guddoonka Golaha Shacabka, iyadoo guddiga doorashadu uu qaabilayo musharraxiinta doonaya inay u tartamaan xilka ugu sarreeya ee Golaha Shacabka. Labada musharrax ayaa hadda wajihi doona marxaladaha xiga ee hannaanka doorashada, iyadoo xubnaha Golaha Shacabka ay ugu dambeyn go’aanka ka gaari doonaan cidda qabanaysa xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha. Doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh shaqada Baarlamaanka Federaalka, maadaama guddoomiyuhu mas’uul ka yahay hoggaaminta fadhiyada Golaha, isku-dubbaridka howlaha baarlamaanka iyo matalaadda Golaha Shacabka marka ay timaaddo arrimaha rasmiga ah. Guddiga doorashada ayaa sii wadi doona howlaha la xiriira diyaarinta iyo maamulka doorashada, iyadoo la sugayo jadwalka iyo tallaabooyinka xiga ee hannaanka doorashada.

items.title: Khayre oo qaylo dhaan kasoo saaray tallaabo ay qaaday DF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul wasaariihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Cali Khayre ayaa si kulul uga hadlay howlgal burburin ah oo ay dowladda Soomaaliya ka sameysay degmada Kaaraan ee Gobolk Banaadir. Khayre ayaa cambaareeyay dhul-boob iy barakacin laga sameeyay xaafadda Seylici iyo Mowlaca Sheekh Muxuddiin Celi ee degmada Kaaraan, iyada oo lagu beegsaday dad shacab ah, sida uu ku sheegay warsaxaafadeedkiisa. Sidoo kale, wuxuu sheegay in dhulka la burburiyay ay dagan yihiin xerta iyo dhasha Sheekh Muxudiin Celi iyo Sheekh Cabdi Celi oo kaalin hoggaamineed ka qaatay faafinta diinta Islaamka. “Waxaan si adag u cambaareynayaa dhulboobka, burburinta iyo barakicinta uu taliska arxanka-daran ee Madaxweynaha muddo-xileedkiisu dhammaaday uu maanta kula kacay xaafadda Seylici iyo Mowlaca Sheekh Muxuddiin Celi ee degmada Kaaraan, halkaas oo ay deggan yihiin xerta iyo dhasha Sheekh Muxudiin Celi iyo Sheekh Cabdi Celi oo kaalin hoggaamineed ka qaatay faafinta diinta Islaamka,” ayuu yiri Mudane Xasan Cali Khayre. Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud inuu weli sii wado burburinta iyo barakacinta shacabka, isla markaana waxa uu ku tilmaamay inay tahay arrin ayaan darro ah. “Waxaa ayaandarro iyo musiibo qaran ah in Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday uu subax kasta u soo kallahaayo burburinta dhulka shacabka, kuna dhiirranaayo barakicinta culimada ku hawllan faafinta dacwada Islaamka, kana boobayo dhul ay degganaayeen muddo ku dhow hal qarni, kaas oo saldhig u ahaa Alle ha u wada naxariistee Sheekh Muxudiin Celi iyo Sheekh Cabdi Celi,” ayuu mar kale yiri Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya. Xaafadaha qaar ee magaalada Muqdisho ayaa waxaa weli ka socda buburin xoogleh, iyada oo shacab fara badan ay isaga barakaceen guryahooda, kadib markii dhulalka lala simay. Arrintan ayaa muddo soo taagnayd, iyada oo ay si gaar ah u saameysay dadka dan-yarta ah ee ku dhaqan gudaha caasimada, maadaama la barakiciyay. The post Khayre oo qaylo dhaan kasoo saaray tallaabo ay qaaday DF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya oo door muuqda ka qaadatay CECAFA Kagame Cup 2026
items.description: Waxaa magaalada Kigali lagu soo gabagabeeyay tartanka CECAFA Kagame Cup 2026 , iyadoo Soomaaliya ay ka mid ahayd dalalkii door muhiim ah ku lahaa dhacdooyinka tartanka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada garsoorka iyo hoggaanka kubadda cagta ee gobolka. items.title: Maamulka Puntland oo shaaciyay inuu la wareegay saldhiggii ciidanka federaalku ay ku lahaayeen Carmo
items.description: Maamulka Puntland ayaa sheegay in lagu wareegeen saldhig ay ciidamo hoostaga DFS ku lahaayeen magaalada Carmo wax ay Booliska Puntland ugu yeereen howlgal amni. Sida lagu sheegay war kasoo baxay Ciidanka Booliska Puntland, howlgalka ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday saldhigga oo saacado ka hor ay ka baxeen ciidamadii ku sugnaa. Maamulka Puntland ayaa sheegay in tillaabadani ay qeyb ka tahay howlgallo amniga lagu xaqiijinayo, iyadoo sidoo kale la sameeyay kala-dambeyn iyo hubin lagu sameeyay xaaladda magaalada. Dhinaca sargaal ka tirsan ciidamadii saaka carmo ka guuray ayaa sheegay inay halkaas xeelad ciidan uga baxeen, asagoo sheegay inay saldhig kale oo isla gobolkaas ku yaalla ku suganyihiin, islamarkaana aysan Puntland isku dhiibi doonin. Maamulka Puntland oo dagaal adag kula jira dawladda Soomaaliya iyo Ciidankeeda ayaa sheegay in aysan deegaannadiisa ku sugnaan karin xoogag aan ayaga ka amar qaadan, ayagoo 48 saacado oo dhammaatay horay ugu qabtay ciidamadaas.

items.title: Turkiga oo guuto cusub usoo tababaray Somalia + Sawirro
items.description: Ankara (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Turkiga ayaa tababar usoo xirtay ciidan hal guuto ah oo dhammaystiran, kuwaas oo kamid noqonaya kuwa Xoogga Dalka, waxayna tababar heer sare ah ku qaateen gudaha dalkaasi. Munaasabadda xiritaanka tababarka ciidamadan cusub ee loo soo tababaray Soomaaliya, waxaa ka qayb-galay Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar (Khaalid) iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga, Jeneraal Metin Tokel, iyada oo ciidanka tababarka loo soo xiray ay yihiin Guutada 21-aad qaybta 1-aad ee Kumaandooska Gorgor ee Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Guutadan ayaa noqoneysa tii ugu horreysay ee dhammaystiran oo ka tirsan Kumaandooska Gorgor, taas oo hal waqti iyo hal goob lagu wada tababaray, iyada oo lagu tilmaamay tallaabo taariikhi ah oo guul u ah Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, tallaabadan ayaa looga gol leeyahay dardargelinta dhismaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, si ay waajibaadka qaran ee horyaalla ugu gutaan awood iyo isku-xirnaan buuxda. Qalin-jebinta ciidankan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka ay haatan wadaan diyaar-garow xooggan oo ku aaddan howlgallo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah argagixisada, si dalka looga sifeeyo kooxaha Khawaarijta. Sidoo kale, ciidamada cusub ayaa kusoo biiraya safafka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, waxaana laga filayaa inay qeyb ka noqdaan dadaallada lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo difaaca dalka. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa horey u sheegtay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la helo ciidan qaran oo leh tayo, leh tababar iyo qalab ku filan, si uu uga shaqeeyo xasilloonida iyo nabad-gelyada guud ee dalka. Si kastaba ha’ahaatee, Turkiga ayaa ah saaxibka koowaad ee Soomaaliya, wuxuuna taageero wayn siiyaa Dowladda Federaalka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga iyo dib-u-dhiska Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. The post Turkiga oo guuto cusub usoo tababaray Somalia + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland oo ka hadashay qaraxii ka dhacay magaalada Hargeysa
items.description: Hargeysa ( Raxanreeb Online) Taliska Booliska Somaliland, ayaa ka hadlay qarax xalay ka dhacay magaalada Hargeysa, kaasi oo geystay. War-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay Taliska Booliska Somaliland ayaa lagu sheegay in qaraxaasi uu sababay dhaawaca afar qof oo labo ka mid ah yihiin shacab, halka labada kalana yihiin askar, kuwaas oo hadda lagula tacaalayo isbitaalka guud ee magaalada Hargeysa. Booliska Somaliland ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in baaritaannadu ay weli socdaan, isla markaana si faah faahsan uga hadli doonaan wax sabab dhacdada.  “Waxaa bambo-gacmeed ku qaraxday goob ay fadhiyeen laba askari oo ka tirsan ciidanka milatariga Somaliland, taas oo sababtay dhaawaca labada askari iyo laba qof oo shacab ah oo ku sugnaa goobta. Dhammaan dadka dhaawacmay waxa loo gudbiyey isbitaalka guud ee magaalada Hargeysa” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale Booliska ayaa sheegay in bam-gacmeedka ay dhulka kaga dhacday mid kamid ah askarta dhaawacmay, isla markaana ay baaritaano kale socdaan. items.title: Muwaadin Yemen ah oo lagu dilay Masjid ku yaalla gudaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Muwaadin u dhashay dalka Yemen, isla markaana lagu magacaabi jiray Fikri Xasan Al-Misbahi, ayaa ku geeriyooday gudaha masaajid ku yaalla Soomaaliya, kaddib markii la sheegay in dhowr jeer lagu dhuftay toorey xilli uu ku jiray gudashada salaadda Jimcaha. Ehelada marxuumka ayaa sheegay in Fikri uu dhaawacyo culus soo gaaray, balse uu ugu dambeyn u geeriyooday dhaawacii soo gaaray Walaalkiis Maxamed Xasan Al-Misbahi, ayaa sheegay in marxuumka dhowr jeer la tooreeyey. Fikri Xasan Al-Misbahi ayaa Soomaaliya u yimid arrimo shaqo, isagoo doonayay inuu helo fursad uu ku horumariyo noloshiisa iyo taageerada qoyskiisa. Sida ay qoyskiisu sheegeen, wuxuu hore uga soo shaqeeyay Saldhigga Korontada Al-Mansuurah ee magaalada Cadan, ka hor inta uusan Soomaaliya u soo qixin, waxa uuna hadda raadinayay shaqeyso dhinaca korontada. Ehelada marxuumka ayaa ku tilmaamay Fikri inuu ahaa qof leh akhlaaq wanaagsan, isla markaana lagu yaqaanay dhaqan wanaagsan iyo la macaamil wanaagsan oo uu la lahaa dadka. Qoyska ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in falka lagu tuhunsan yahay inuu geystay muwaadin Soomaali ah, balse ilaa hadda ma jiraan faahfaahin rasmi ah oo si cad u qeexaysa sababta loo dilay. Ehelada Al-Misbahi ayaa ugu baaqay dowladda Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha ammaanka inay si buuxda u baaritaan dhacdadan, si loo ogaado waxa sababay dilka iyo cidda mas’uulka ka ahayd. Waxay sidoo kale dalbadeen in haddii la helo qofkii falka geystay, loo maro waddada sharciga oo cadaaladda la horkeeno. items.title: Maxkamad ku taalla Kenya oo 115 sanno ku xukuntay nin lagu helay inuu katirsanaa kooxda AS
items.description: Nairobi ( Raxanreeb Online) Maxkamadda Kahawa Law Courts ee dalka Kenya ayaa nin lagu magacaabo Ibraahim Xuseen Xasan, ku xukuntay 115 sanno oo xabsi ah, kaddib markii lagu helay toddobo dambi oo la xiriira argagixisanimo iyo xubinnimada kooxda Al-Shabaab. Maxkamaddu waxay ninka ku heshay dambiga ah inuu xubin ka ahaa Al-Shabaab, oo Kenya u aqoonsan tahay Urur argagixiso. Sidoo kale waxaa lagu helay saddex dacwadood oo la xiriira ururinta xog loo adeegsan karo falal argagixiso iyo saddex kale oo ku saabsan haysashada waxyaabo lala xiriiriyay falal argagixiso. Garsoore Gideon Kiage, ayaa sheegay in xeer-ilaalintu ay maxkamadda si macquul ah uga dhaadhicisay dhammaan eedihii loo haystay, iyadoo dacwaddu ku dhisnayd caddeymo ay soo bandhigeen 10 markhaati. Kiiska ayaa salka ku haya xarigga Ibraahim Xasan oo dhacay 6-dii Sebtember 2022, xilli lagu qabtay deegaanka Eastleigh Section III ee magaalada Nairobi. Baaritaan lagu sameeyay taleefan Samsung ah oo laga helay ayaa lagu sheegay in laga helay saddex muqaal oo xagjirnimo ah, kuwaas oo sida maxkamaddu sheegtay loo adeegsan karay qorista, xagjiraynta iyo tababarka dhalinyarada. items.title: Irro tells foreign diplomats in Nairobi: Engage Somaliland as sovereign state, not extension of Somalia
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro urged Western diplomats on Friday to engage his administration as a sovereign, capable partner rather than an extension of Somalia, pressing the case for deeper international cooperation on security and peace. Addressing the gathering of Western envoys, Irro said he had come to the meeting not with a list of requests, but with a record of results, laying out what he described as concrete progress in conflict resolution, militia demobilisation, road construction and public service delivery since taking office. The Somaliland leader said his government had overseen the voluntary disarmament of 6,000 militia fighters in the eastern regions, who have since been demobilised and integrated into the region’s army. He said authorities had also resolved conflict between two clans in the Awdal region and a separate dispute in Sanaag, and that his administration was now working to settle tensions with Harti clans in the Sool region, particularly in Laascaanood, through what he called a Somaliland-owned peace process. Irro accused Somalia’s federal government of interfering in that process, alleging Mogadishu’s interventions were undermining the effort.
