items.title: Booliska Somaliland oo xog ka bixiyey qaraxii Hargeysa
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Afar qof ayaa xalay ku dhaawacmay bambo-gacmeed si kama’ ah ugu qaraxday goob ay fadhiyeen laba askari oo ka tirsan ciidamada Militariga Somaliland oo ku taalla magaalada Hargeysa, sida uu sheegay Taliska Ciidanka Booliska Somaliland. Booliska ayaa war-saxaafadeed uu soo saaray ku sheegay in dhacdadu ay abbaaro 7:00 fiidnimo dhacday, kaddib markii bambo-gacmeed uu watay mid ka mid ah askarta uu dhulka kaga dhacay, taasoo keentay inuu qarxo. Labada askari iyo laba qof oo shacab ah oo goobta ku sugnaa ayaa ku dhaawacmay qaraxa, waxaana dhammaantood loo qaaday Cisbitaalka Guud ee magaalada Hargeysa si loogu daweeyo dhaawacyada soo gaaray. “Abbaaro 7:00 fiidnimo waxa bambo-gacmeed ku qaraxday goob ay fadhiyeen laba askari oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Milatariga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, taas oo sababtay dhaawaca labada askari iyo laba qof oo shacab ah oo ku sugnaa goobta. Dhammaan dadka dhaawacmay waxa loo gudbiyey Cisbitaalka Guud ee Magaalada Hargeysa,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Taliska Booliska Somaliland ayaa sheegay in xogta hordhaca ah ay muujineyso in bamku uusan ahayn mid goobta lagu soo tuuray ama qaraxa si ula kac ah loo fuliyay. “Bambo-gacmeedka ayaa dhulka kaga dhacay mid ka mid ah askarta dhaawacantay, mana jirto wax ujeeddo ah oo loo tuuray bambo-gacmeedka, waxaana socda baadhitaan dheeraad ah,” ayuu talisku sheegay. Booliska ayaa sheegay in baaritaan dheeraad ah lagu sameynayo duruufaha ku xeeran dhacdada, inkastoo aan warsaxaafadeedka lagu faahfaahin halka saxda ah ee ay magaalada kaga dhacday ama sida uu bamku uga dhacay askariga. Dhacdadan ayaa dhalisay warar kala duwan oo si weyn loogu faafiyey baraha bulshada, kuwaasoo qaarkood ku tilmaamay qaraxa mid amni oo si ula kac ah uga dhacay Hargeysa. Taliska Booliska ayaa beeniyey wararkaasi, isagoo sheegay in dhacdada la faafiyey aanay ahayn weerar ama qarax qorsheysan, balse ay ka dhalatay bambo-gacmeed si kama’ ah uga dhacay askari. “Taliska Ciidanka Booliska Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si cad u beeninayaa wararka marin-habaabinta ah ee lagu baahiyey baraha bulshada ee sheegaya in qarax ka dhacay Magaalada Hargeysa,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Booliska ayaa sidoo kale bulshada ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan faafinta xogaha aan laga hubin hay’adaha rasmiga ah, gaar ahaan marka ay la xiriiraan arrimaha amniga. “Sidoo kale, Taliska Ciidanka Boolisku waxa uu bulshada uga digayaa faafinta wararka aan la hubin ee dhaawici kara amniga iyo xasilloonida,” ayaa lagu soo gabagabeeyey warsaxaafadeedka. Ma jiro ilaa hadda war rasmi ah oo sheegaya in xaaladda dadka dhaawacmay ay halis tahay, waxaana boolisku sheegay in baaritaanka dhacdada uu weli socdo. items.title: Baarlamaanka Uganda oo Ansixiyay Ciidamo Loo Diro marinka Qasa
items.description: Baarlamaanka Uganda ayaa ansixiyay qorshe dowladda dalkaasi u oggolaanaya inay ciidamo u dirto Marinka Gaza, si ay uga qaybqaataan ciidanka caalamiga ah ee loo qorsheeyay xasilinta Qasa. Tallaabadan ayaa Uganda ka dhigaysa mid ka mid ah dalalka muujiyay diyaar-garowga ay ugu biirayaan hawlgalka caalamiga ah ee la xiriira qorshaha cusub ee Qasa. Mooshinka ayaa baarlamaanka waxaa horgeeyay Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Uganda, Kiryowa Kiwanuka, kaas oo sheegay in ciidamada Uganda ay leeyihiin khibrad ballaaran oo ku saabsan hawlgallada nabad-ilaalinta iyo xasilinta, gaar ahaan kuwa ay ka sameeyeen Soomaaliya iyo dalal kale oo Afrikaan ah. Wasiirku wuxuu ku dooday in khibradda ciidamada Uganda ay ka dhigi karto kuwo ku habboon ka qaybqaadashada hawlgalka Qasa. go’aankan ayaa dhaliyay dood iyo su’aalo ka yimid qaar ka mid ah xildhibaannada mucaaradka, ayadoo Xildhibaan lagu magacaabo Hassan Kirumira uu su’aal geliyay ujeeddada dhabta ah ee ciidamo Uganda leedahay inay Qasa u dirto, isagoo sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyay saameynta diblomaasiyadeed ee arrintani ku yeelan karto Uganda oo xiriir la leh dunida Muslimka. Wuxuu si gaar ah u weydiiyay dhinaca ay ciidamada Uganda ka istaagi doonaan haddii ay gudaha Qasa galaan iyo cidda ay amarrada ka qaadan doonaan. Dowladda Uganda ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay in ciidamada loo diri doono ujeeddooyin xasilin iyo nabad-ilaalin ah, iyadoo faahfaahinta hawlgalkana lagu qeexi doono heshiis rasmi ah oo lala galo dhinacyada ay khusayso. Sida qorshuhu yahay, ciidanka caalamiga ah ayaa la geyn doonaa Qasa marka ay Israa’iil fuliso wejiyada loogu talagalay ka bixitaanka ciidamada, iyadoo ciidanka caalamiga ahi uu markaas door ka qaadan doono sugidda amniga iyo taageeridda marxaladda kala-guurka. Ciidanka caalamiga ah ayaa lagu qorsheeyay inuu ka koobnaado ilaa 20,000 oo askari , waxaana hoggaaminaya Major General Jasper Jeffers oo ka tirsan ciidamada Mareykanka. Dalal kale oo ay ka mid tahay Morocco ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay inay diyaar u yihiin inay ciidamo ku biiriyaan hawlgalka, halka Uganda ay hadda qaaday tallaabada sharci ee u oggolaanaysa inay qayb ka noqoto qorshahaas. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ciidamo Uganda ah weli si toos ah looma dirin Gaza, waxaana weli jira arrimo muhiim ah oo u baahan in la caddeeyo, sida xilliga hawlgalku bilaabanayo, awoodda ciidamada loo siin doono, cidda ay ka amar qaadanayaan iyo sida ay ula macaamilayaan kooxaha hubeysan ee Qasa. Go’aanka Uganda ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed lagu doonayo in lagu dhaqan geliyo heshiiska xabbad-joojinta Qasa iyo qorshe loogu gudbayo marxalad cusub oo amni iyo maamul ah. Haddii qorshaha ciidanka caalamiga ah uu hirgalo, ciidamada Uganda waxay noqon karaan qayb ka mid ah xoogagga dibadda ee loo xilsaari doono inay kaalin ka qaataan amniga Qasa. Tallaabada Kampala waxay sidoo kale leedahay muhiimad siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed, maadaama Uganda muddo dheer ciidamo uga qaybqaadanaysay hawlgallada nabad-ilaalinta ee Afrika, gaar ahaan Soomaaliya. ansixinta baarlamaanka Uganda ma ahan in ciidamadu isla markiiba Gaza u ambabaxayaan , balse waxay dowladda siisay waddo sharci iyo siyaasadeed oo ay kaga qaybqaadan karto ciidanka caalamiga ah haddii qorshaha xasilinta Qasa la dhaqan geliyo. Xukuumadda Kampala ayaa hadda wajahaysa marxalad kale oo ah in la caddeeyo tirada ciidamada la diri doono, waajibaadkooda iyo xeerarka ay ku shaqeyn doonaan, iyadoo indhaha caalamku ku jeedaan sida qorshaha amni ee Qasa uu u hirgeli doono.

items.title: NISA oo Muqdisho ku qabatay 9 nin oo waday qorshe halis ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) ayaa Jimcihii sheegtay inay gacanta ku dhigtay sagaal qof oo ay ku eedeysay inay ka tirsan yihiin kooxda Al-Shabaab, kuwaas oo sida ay hay’addu sheegtay qorsheynayay falal amni-darro oo ka dhaca magaalada Muqdisho iyo deegaannada ku xeeran. War-saxaafadeed ay NISA soo saartay ayaa lagu sheegay in raggan lagu qabtay howlgallo ka dhacay degmooyinka Garasbaaley iyo Kaxda, iyo sidoo kale xaafado ka tirsan deegaanka Ceelasha Biyaha ee duleedka Muqdisho. NISA waxay sheegtay in xubnaha la qabtay ay si qarsoodi ah ugu sugnaayeen goobahaas, isla markaana muddo lala socday dhaq-dhaqaaqyadooda iyo qorshayaashooda ka hor inta aan la fulin howlgalka lagu soo qabtay. “Afar ka mid ah waxa ay ahaayeen shabakad isku xiran oo qorsheynaysay falal argagixiso oo lagu dhibaateynayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, laguna qalqal-gelinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida caasimadda,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka NISA. Hay’addu ma aysan faahfaahin nooca weerarrada ay tuhmanayaasha qorsheynayeen, goobaha la bartilmaameedsanayay iyo xilliga la filayay inay fuliyaan, balse waxay sheegtay in howlgalka uu ka dhashay dabagal sirdoon iyo xog-ururin muddo socday. NISA ayaa intaas ku dartay in sagaalka qof mid kasta lagu qabtay goobtii uu ku sugnaa, iyadoo hadda baaritaanno dheeraad ah lagu hayo. Marka baaritaanka la soo gabagabeeyo, hay’addu waxay sheegtay in tuhmanayaasha loo gudbin doono hay’adaha garsoorka si loo marsiiyo hannaanka sharciga. Howlgalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ciidamada ammaanka ay kordhiyeen howlgallada ka dhanka ah xubnaha iyo shabakadaha Al-Shabaab ee ka dhex dhaq-dhaqaaqa Muqdisho iyo deegaannada ku teedsan caasimadda. Al-Shabaab ayaa muddo dheer Muqdisho ka fulineysay qaraxyo, dilal qorsheysan iyo weerarro kale, inkastoo ciidamada dowladda ay sannadihii dambe xoojiyeen howlgallada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo xubnaha kooxda iyo dadka lagu tuhmo inay u fududeeyaan weerarrada, taasi oo Meesha ka saartay halistii kooxda ay ku haysay caasimadda. Degmooyinka Kaxda iyo Garasbaaley iyo deegaanka Ceelasha Biyaha ayaa ka mid ah aagagga ku yaalla galbeedka iyo koonfur-galbeedka Muqdisho ee ay ciidamada ammaanku marar badan ka fuliyaan howlgallo lagu baadigoobayo xubnaha Al-Shabaab. NISA ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in xogaha ay shacabka la wadaagaan hay’adaha ammaanka ay door muhiim ah ka qaataan fashilinta qorshayaasha kooxda, waxayna ugu baaqday dadka inay soo gudbiyaan macluumaad kasta oo la xiriira khataraha amniga ama dhaq-dhaqaaqyada Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish. Hay’addu waxay mar kale sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto howlgallada looga hortagayo falalka wax u dhimaya ammaanka Muqdisho iyo badqabka shacabka. Al-Shabaab ayaa muddo dheer Muqdisho ka fulineysay qaraxyo, dilal qorsheysan iyo weerarro kale, inkastoo ciidamada dowladda ay sannadihii dambe xoojiyeen howlgallada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo xubnaha kooxda iyo dadka lagu tuhmo inay u fududeeyaan weerarrada, taasi oo Meesha ka saartay halistii kooxda ay ku haysay caasimadda. Degmooyinka Kaxda iyo Garasbaaley iyo deegaanka Ceelasha Biyaha ayaa ka mid ah aagagga ku yaalla galbeedka iyo koonfur-galbeedka Muqdisho ee ay ciidamada ammaanku marar badan ka fuliyaan howlgallo lagu baadigoobayo xubnaha Al-Shabaab. NISA ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in xogaha ay shacabka la wadaagaan hay’adaha ammaanka ay door muhiim ah ka qaataan fashilinta qorshayaasha kooxda, waxayna ugu baaqday dadka inay soo gudbiyaan macluumaad kasta oo la xiriira khataraha amniga ama dhaq-dhaqaaqyada Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish. Hay’addu waxay mar kale sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto howlgallada looga hortagayo falalka wax u dhimaya ammaanka Muqdisho iyo badqabka shacabka. items.title: Muwaadinin u dhashay dalka Taiwan oo loo diiday in ay galaan dalka Uganda
items.description: Wararka ayaa sheegaaya in Sabtidii Uganda ay garoonka diyaaradaha kala wareegtay baasaboorka qof u dhashay Taiwan oo halkaas deganaa, isla markaana ay dib u celisay dalxiise kale, iyadoo u diidday inuu dalka soo galo. Sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta UDN, labada dhacdo waxay ka dhaceen Garoonka Diyaaradaha ee Entebbe, oo ku yaalla dalkaas Bariga Afrika, horraantii bishan. Saraakiisha socdaalka ayaa sababta tallaabadaas loogu qaaday qofka u dhashay Taiwan ku sheegay “siyaasad cusub.” Ninka u dhashay Taiwan ee laga qaaday baasaboorka ayaa ka shaqeynayay Uganda isagoo haysta ogolaansho shaqo oo sax ah, sida ay ku warrantay Liberty Times. Baasaboorka ayaa laga qaaday markii uu soo gaadhay Entebbe . Warbixinta ayaa sheegtay inaan weli loo soo celin baasaborkiisa. Dhacdooyinkan ayaa sababay in shirkadaha safarka ee Taiwan ay dib u dhigaan safarro loo qorsheeyay bisha Sebtembar ilaa ugu yaraan bisha Abriil ee sannadka soo socda, sida ay sheegtay UDN. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa sheegtay inay la xiriirtay xafiiska Taiwan ee Somaliland iyo ururka ganacsatada Taiwan ee Uganda si ay u bixiyaan caawimaad. 2-dii Juun, Taiwan ayaa bilowday inay dhaqangeliso xayiraado dhanka soo-galitaanka ah oo saaran dadka ka imaanaya Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Kongo iyo Uganda, sababo la xiriira dillaaca fayraska Ebola ee dalkaas. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa soconayay muddo 90 maalmood ah. Ma jirin wax hadal ah oo degdeg ah oo ku saabsan xiriir ka dhexeeya dhacdooyinka Garoonka Entebbe iyo tallaabooyinka Ebola ama cadaadis uga imaanaya Shiinaha. Uganda waa dalkii labaad ee Afrikaan ah oo safarka ku adkeeya dadka u dhashay Taiwan, ka dib markii Morocco ay bishii Luulyo ku dhawaaqday inaysan mar dambe ka shaqeyn doonin codsiyada fiisaha ee dadka u dhashay Taiwan ee laga soo gudbiyo safaaraddeeda Japan. Taiwan ayaa taas kaga jawaabtay inay hakisay inta badan codsiyada fiisaha ee muwaadiniinta Morocco laga bilaabo 30-kii Luulyo.

items.title: Elite Gorgor Forces Complete Training in Türkiye
items.description: The Ground Forces Commander Brigadier General Sahal Abdullahi Omar Khaalid and Türkiye’s Land Forces Commander General Metin Tokel on Saturday attended a ceremony in Manisa marking the completion of military training for a new batch of Somalia’s elite Gorgor “Eagle” commando forces. The graduation comes as Mogadishu seeks to bolster the capability and professionalism of its armed forces amid preparations for intensified military operations against Al-Shabaab and other armed groups. The training forms part of Somalia’s expanding defence partnership with Türkiye, which has emerged as a key security partner for the Somali government. The Somali commandos have spent a period undergoing specialised military instruction in Türkiye, with the programme focusing on combat skills, military discipline, unit cohesion and operational readiness. The Gorgor forces are among Somalia’s most specialised combat units and have played a prominent role in government-led military operations against Al-Shabaab. Their training and deployment are central to Mogadishu’s broader efforts to develop a more capable national security architecture. Somali and Turkish officials at the ceremony underlined the importance of developing a disciplined and professionally trained national army capable of independently carrying out its constitutional mandate to safeguard the country and its population. The latest graduation comes at a critical juncture for Somalia’s security transition. The federal government has been seeking to expand the capacity of its forces as it assumes greater responsibility for national security and sustains military pressure on Al-Shabaab, the militant group that has waged an insurgency for more than a decade. Türkiye has played a significant role in that effort. Ankara operates the TURKSOM military training facility in Mogadishu, established in 2017, where thousands of Somali soldiers have received military training. The bilateral defence relationship has since expanded beyond basic military instruction to include specialised training and broader security cooperation. Training programmes in Türkiye have also provided Somali personnel with exposure to advanced military practices, leadership and specialised operations. Officials said the continued training reflects the two countries’ commitment to strengthening Somalia’s national defence institutions and developing forces capable of assuming greater responsibility for the country’s security. For Mogadishu, the graduation represents another investment in the long-term transformation of the Somali National Army from a force heavily dependent on external security assistance into a more cohesive and operationally capable national institution. The post Elite Gorgor Forces Complete Training in Türkiye first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Puntland oo beegsaneysa siyaasiyiin iyo saraakiil ciidan oo taageeray DF Soomaaliya
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) — Golaha Wasiirrada Puntland ayaa dhowaan go’aamiyay in hay’adaha caddaaladda loo gudbiyo siyaasiyiin, saraakiil ciidan iyo shaqsiyaad saameyn ku leh baraha bulshada oo lagu eedeeyay inay ku lug leeyihiin falal lagu khalkhal-gelinayo amniga iyo nidaamka maamulkaasi. War kasoo baxay Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa lagu faray hay’adaha amniga iyo kuwa caddaaladda inay tallaabo sharci ah ka qaadaan dadka lagu tuhmo abaabulka falal wax u dhimaya amniga iyo xasilloonida Puntland. Xog ay heshay Caasimada Online ayaa sheegeysa in dadka uu go’aankani sida gaarka ah u saameyn karo ay ku jiraan siyaasiyiin taageersan dowladda federaalka iyo saraakiil ciidan oo muddooyinkii dambe sheegay inay ka tirsan yihiin Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa sidoo kale faray dhammaan hay’adaha amniga in deegaannada Puntland aan lagu dhex wadan karin ciidamo iyo gaadiid dagaal oo aan ka tirsanayn ama fasax ka haysan hay’adaha amniga Puntland. Go’aankan ayaa sii adkeynaya tallaabooyin ay Puntland horey u qaaday, kadib markii bishii Juun ay xaddidday dhaqdhaqaaqa ciidammada iyo kooxaha hubeysan ee xiriirka la leh dowladda federaalka. Xiisadda ayaa bishii Luulyo isu beddeshay iska horimaad hubeysan, markii ciidamada Puntland iyo kuwa PSF ay ku dagaallameen deegaanka Laag ee duleedka Boosaaso. Qaar ka mid ah saraakiisha PSF ayaa markaas sheegay inay hoos tagaan dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Golaha Wasiirrada Puntland ayaa dhinaca kale go’aamiyay in tallaabo waafaqsan sharciga laga qaado mulkiilayaasha iyo adeegsadayaasha baraha bulshada ee faafiya warar ay dowladdu ku tilmaantay kuwo aan xaqiiqda ku dhisnayn ama lagu sumcad-dilayo hay’adaha dowliga ah. Goluhu wuxuu sidoo kale ugu baaqay warbaahinta iyo suxufiyiinta ka hawlgala Puntland inay ilaaliyaan xeerarka saxaafadda iyo anshaxa mihnadda. Dhanka amniga badda, ciidamada ayaa lagu amray inay xoojiyaan la-dagaallanka dambiyada abaabulan ee ka dhaca xeebaha iyo badaha, oo ay ku jiraan burcad-badeednimada iyo kalluumeysiga sharci-darrada ah. Puntland waxay sheegtay in cid kasta oo ku xadgudubta biyaha ay maamusho la horkeeni doono caddaaladda. Go’aannadan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiisadda u dhexeysa Puntland iyo dowladda federaalka ay gaartay heerkii ugu sarreeyay muddooyinkii dambe, isla markaana ciidamada Puntland ay howlgallo ka dhan ah PSF iyo ciidamo kale oo taageersan dowladda federaalka ka sameeyeen magaalooyin dhowr ah. Saddexdii maalmood ee lasoo dhaafay, ciidamada Puntland ayaa la wareegay xarumo ay ciidammadaasi ku lahaayeen Gaalkacyo iyo Boosaaso, kadib dagaallo iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo labada dhinac dhexmaray. Hase yeeshee, weli waxaa duleedka Garoowe ku sugan ciidamo uu hoggaamiyo Jen. Jimcaale Jaamac Takar, kuwaas oo wata gaadiid dagaal oo lagu qiyaasay ilaa 30 iyo ciidamo tiro badan. Ciidamadan ayaa horey u sheegay inay ka tirsan yihiin taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Xiisadda hadda taagan ayaa qeyb ka ah khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo muddo soo jiitamayay oo u dhexeeya Puntland iyo dowladda federaalka, kaas oo bilihii ugu dambeeyay si tartiib ah ugu sii gudbay loollan ku saabsan cidda awoodda u leh abaabulka iyo maamulka ciidamada ka howlgala gudaha Puntland. The post Puntland oo beegsaneysa siyaasiyiin iyo saraakiil ciidan oo taageeray DF Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Booliska Somaliland maxay ka yidhaahdeen Bambo gacmeedkii ka qaraxday asksriga
items.description: Xalay magaalada Hargeysa ee caasimadda Somaliland, waxaa ka dhacay qarax ka dhashay sida ay boolisku sheegeen bambo-gacmeed. War qoraal ah oo ka soo baxay ciidamada booliska Somaliland ayaa lagu yiri: “Waxa bambo-gacmeed ku qaraxday goob ay fadhiyeen laba askari oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Milatariga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, sababtay dhaawaca laba askari iyo laba qof oo shacab ah oo ku sugnaa goobta. Dhammaan dadka dhaawacmay waxa loo gudbiyey Cisbitaalka Guud ee magaalada Hargeysa”. Warkan kooban ee ka soo baxay ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale lagu faahfaahiyay sababta keentay in bambo-gacmeedku ay qaraxdo. “Bambo-gacmeedka ayaa dhulka kaga dhacay mid ka mid ah askarta dhaawacantay, mana jirto wax ujeeddo ah oo loo tuuray bambo-gacmeedka, waxaana socda baadhitaan dheeraad ah”. Qoraalka ayaa sidoo kale lagu yiri: “Taliska Ciidanka Booliska Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si cad u beeninayaa wararka marin-habaabinta ah ee lagu baahiyey baraha bulshada ee sheegaya in qarax ka dhacay magaalada Hargeysa”.

items.title: Somaliland Offers Partnerships, Not Aid Requests, Says President
items.description: Somaliland Offers Partnerships, Not Aid Requests, Says President Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi (Irro) declared at an international meeting in Nairobi that his government is not seeking foreign aid, but rather offering tangible developmental achievements and mutually beneficial partnerships to the global community. Addressing key regional dynamics, President Irro reaffirmed Somaliland’s commitment to resolving the Las Anod conflict through peaceful dialogue and diplomatic engagement.

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka Soomaaliya iyo taliyaha ciidanka dhulka Turkiga oo tababar u soo xiray guutada 21-aad ee Kumaandooska Gorgor
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka Soomaaliya, S/Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar (Khaalid), iyo Taliyaha Ciidamada Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga, Jeneraal Metin Tokel, ayaa maanta magaalada Manisa ee dalka Turkiga ka qeyb galay munaasabad lagu soo gabagabeynayay tababar ciidan oo loo qabtay cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Kumaandooska “Eagle” ee Ciidanka Dhulka Soomaaliya. Tababarkan ayaa ah mid muhiim u ah dhismaha iyo tayeynta Ciidanka Qaranka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo ciidamadu ay muddo tababarro kala duwan ku qaadanayeen dalka Turkiga. Tababarka ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saarayay kobcinta xirfadaha milatari, anshaxa, isku-duubnida iyo awoodda hawlgallada ee ciidamada Kumaandooska, kuwaas oo qayb muhiim ah ka qaata hawlgallada amniga iyo la-dagaallanka kooxaha hubeysan. Mas’uuliyiinta ka qeyb galay munaasabadda ayaa xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in Ciidanka Qaranka Soomaaliya loo dhiso ciidan leh tababar iyo awood ku filan oo uu ku gudan karo waajibaadkiisa qaran, isla markaana gacan ka geysan kara sugidda amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka. Munaasabaddan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay isku diyaarinayaan hawlgallo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah kooxaha argagixisada, iyadoo dowladda ay sheegtay inay muhiimad gaar ah siinayso xoojinta awoodda ciidamada iyo sidii dalka looga sifeyn lahaa kooxaha hubeysan ee khatarta ku haya nabadda iyo horumarka Soomaaliya. Tababarka iyo qalin-jabinta ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa tallaabo ka mid ah dadaallada lagu dhisayo Ciidan Qaran oo tayo leh, isku duuban, isla markaana awood u leh inuu si buuxda u guto waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee ilaalinta dalka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ee dhinaca milatariga ayaa muddooyinkii dambe xoogaystay, iyadoo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay Turkiga ku qaataan tababbarro lagu horumarinayo xirfadaha dagaalka, hoggaanka iyo hawlgallada gaarka ah.

items.title: Who Owns the Credit? Minister Presents World Bank–Funded Hargeisa Project as a Federal Government Initiative
items.description: By Ahmed A. Yusuf Somalia’s Federal Minister of Public Works, Reconstruction and Housing, Ayuub Ismail Yusuf, has announced the signing of an agreement for the design and technical studies of a major infrastructure project in Hargeisa, presenting it as part of the Federal Government’s broader programme to develop roads and urban infrastructure across Somalia. But that presentation leaves out a critical part of the story. The Hargeisa investment is not a development project independently conceived and financed by the Federal Government in Mogadishu. It is part of the World Bank-financed Nagaad Project, and the World Bank’s additional financing framework specifically identifies Hargeisa as a beneficiary city. That distinction matters—not merely as a technical detail, but because development finance should be presented to the public with accuracy and institutional clarity. A World Bank Investment Specifically Allocated to Hargeisa The World Bank’s project documentation identifies Hargeisa as the location for the expanded Nagaad investment and provides dedicated financing for urban infrastructure and related activities. The additional financing includes US$20 million for urban infrastructure and US$1 million for urban analytics, with additional resources allocated for project management and institutional capacity. The structure of the financing makes clear that the Hargeisa component was incorporated into the programme through World Bank-approved additional financing. It is therefore misleading to portray the investment as though Mogadishu independently decided to allocate a Federal Government development project to Hargeisa. The Federal Government has a role within the wider Nagaad framework, but that role should not be confused with ownership of the financing or direct political ownership of the Hargeisa investment. Who Is Actually Responsible for Implementation? The implementation arrangements are even more revealing. The World Bank framework provides for a dedicated Project Implementation Unit in Hargeisa to oversee procurement, implementation, day-to-day supervision and monitoring of the city’s investments. The Federal Project Coordination Unit has a supporting and backstopping role, while an inter-ministerial steering mechanism for Somaliland is responsible for strategic oversight and guidance. UNOPS is also identified as a technical partner for engineering and supervision of civil works. This institutional architecture does not resemble a conventional Federal Government construction project in which Mogadishu designs, finances and directly executes infrastructure in Somaliland. Rather, it reflects a multilayered development arrangement in which the international financier provides the resources, local implementation structures oversee delivery, and federal institutions perform defined coordination and support functions. That distinction should be reflected honestly in public statements. The 45-Kilometre Road Programme Minister Ayuub has said the project will eventually cover approximately 45 kilometres of roads, divided into two phases. The first phase is expected to include approximately 23 kilometres of roads within Hargeisa, intended to improve mobility, strengthen connections between neighbourhoods and surrounding communities, and facilitate commercial activity. The minister has also identified Buundaweyn, or the Great Bridge, as an important component of the first phase and put the cost of its rehabilitation or modernization at approximately US$20 million. That figure, however, should not automatically be interpreted as a separate World Bank allocation for the bridge itself. The World Bank documentation identifies US$20 million for Hargeisa urban infrastructure investments overall. Unless the detailed project documentation specifically establishes a separate US$20 million allocation for Buundaweyn, public officials should avoid presenting the two figures as though they are necessarily identical. Accuracy matters, particularly when public money and international development financing are involved. Nagaad Is Not a Mogadishu-Owned Development Programme The minister’s presentation also risks creating the impression that the Federal Government is single-handedly extending its infrastructure programme across all Somali territories. The reality is considerably more complex. Nagaad—the Somali name associated with the Somalia Urban Resilience Project Phase II (SURP-II)—is a World Bank-supported programme designed to strengthen urban infrastructure and municipal service delivery. Its broader portfolio has included investments in roads, drainage, pedestrian infrastructure and other urban services, alongside efforts to strengthen municipal institutional capacity. The programme has operated across several Somali cities, with implementation arrangements adapted to the institutional and administrative circumstances of each location. The inclusion of Hargeisa in the expanded programme should therefore be understood as an extension of a World Bank-supported development programme, not as proof that the Federal Government has assumed direct responsibility for Somaliland’s urban development. Why Political Credit Matters Some may argue that this is merely a question of semantics. It is not. In development policy, financing, ownership, implementation and accountability are distinct concepts. If the World Bank provides the financing, Hargeisa has a dedicated implementation structure, and federal institutions perform coordination or support functions, then describing the entire project as a Federal Government initiative risks obscuring who actually financed and is responsible for delivering the investment. This is particularly sensitive in Somaliland, whose political and administrative institutions operate separately from the Federal Government in Mogadishu. The issue is therefore not whether Hargeisa deserves better roads and bridges. It unquestionably does. Nor is it whether federal institutions can have a legitimate role in an internationally financed programme. They can, depending on the financing and implementation arrangements. The issue is whether political officials should transform a World Bank-financed investmentspecifically structured for Hargeisa into a narrative of Federal Government largesse. Development Finance Should Not Become Political Messaging International development assistance is intended to deliver measurable improvements in people’s lives—not to provide political ammunition to competing authorities. When governments announce donor-funded projects, the public deserves to know four basic things: Who financed the project? Who approved it? Who is implementing it? And who is accountable for the results? Those questions are particularly important where political authority is contested. In the case of the Hargeisa investment, the World Bank’s project framework provides considerably more detail than the minister’s announcement. It identifies Hargeisa as the beneficiary city, provides dedicated financing for the urban investment, establishes a local implementation mechanism and assigns federal structures defined coordination and support responsibilities. That is very different from suggesting that Mogadishu independently designed, financed and is directly implementing the project. The Minister Owes the Public Clarity Minister Ayuub’s announcement should therefore be viewed through a broader principle of public accountability. Federal officials have every right to highlight Somalia’s infrastructure needs and to explain the role of federal institutions in coordinating development programmes. But international financing should not be repackaged in ways that exaggerate the Federal Government’s direct contribution or obscure the institutional arrangements established by the financier. Hargeisa’s residents deserve the roads, bridges and urban infrastructure promised under the project. They also deserve an accurate account of the investment. The World Bank has allocated financing for Hargeisa under the expanded Nagaad programme. The project has its own implementation arrangements. Federal institutions have defined responsibilities within the broader framework. Those facts should not be blurred for political effect. At a time when Somalia’s political institutions are already divided over questions of federal authority, constitutional powers and relations between Mogadishu and Somaliland, development projects should be handled with greater transparency, not greater political spin. The real achievement will not be who receives the political credit. It will be whether the people of Hargeisa ultimately receive the roads, bridges and urban services they were promised—and whether those responsible for delivering them can be held accountable for the results. items.title: Heshiiska Sacuudiga, Turkey iyo Pakistan: Bariga Dhexe oo galay marxalad cusub
items.description: Makkah (Caasimada Online) – Heshiiska difaaca ee Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay Jimcihii ku saxiixdeen magaalada Makkah weli ma ahan “NATO Islaami ah”, balse waxa uu xambaarsan yahay fariin siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo ka weyn magaca heshiiska laftiisa. Saddexdan dal oo ka mid ah quwadaha ugu waaweyn dunida Muslimka ayaa dhisaya hannaan cusub oo iskaashi amni, xilli kalsoonida lagu qabo nidaamkii amni ee muddada dheer gobolka ka jiray ii sii wiiqmayo. Sacuudiga wuxuu heshiiska la imanayaa awood dhaqaale iyo miisaan siyaasadeed, Turkiga wuxuu leeyahay ciidanka labaad ee ugu weyn NATO iyo warshado difaac oo si xawli ah u koraya, halka Pakistan ay leedahay awood ciidan oo weyn iyo hubka nukliyeerka ee keliya ee uu leeyahay dal Muslim ah. Su’aasha ugu weyn ma ahan in saddexdan dal ay doonayaan inay Mareykanka ka saaraan gobolka ama beddelaan kaalintiisa. Waxa muhiimka ah waa in Riyadh, Ankara iyo Islamabad ay u muuqdaan kuwo rumeysan in Washington oo keliya aysan mar dambe siin karin dammaanadda amni ee ay u baahan yihiin. Arrintaas ayaa Sacuudiga si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah. Boqortooyadu muddo tobannaan sano ah waxay ku tiirsaneyd dalladda amni ee Mareykanka, waxayna soo iibsatay qaar ka mid ah hubka ugu casrisan dunida. Si kastaba, gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Iran iyo kooxaha ay Tehran taageerto ayaa dhowr jeer muujiyey nuglaanta amniga Sacuudiga iyo guud ahaan Khaliijka. Dagaalka hadda ka socda gobolka ayaa walaacaas sii xoojiyey. Weerarro Iiraani ah ayaa gaaray kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah ee dalalka Khaliijka, halka xiisadda ka jirta marin-biyoodka Hormuz ay khatar gelisay isu-socodka maraakiibta iyo dhaqaalaha Sacuudiga oo weli si weyn ugu tiirsan shidaalka. Iran ayaa sidoo kale bartilmaameedsatay nidaamyada raadaarka iyo isgaarsiinta ee laf-dhabarta u ah difaacyada cirka ee Mareykanku hoggaamiyo ee Khaliijka, taas oo sii muujisay in xitaa nidaamyada difaaca ugu casrisan ay leeyihiin meelo nugul. Sacuudiga oo raadinaya caymis Falanqeeyaha Sacuudiga Ali Shihabi ayaa Financial Times u sheegay in isbaheysigan uu ka tarjumayo faham sii xoogeysanaya oo ah in awoodda Mareykanka ee ka-hortagga cadowga ay “si weyn u daciiftay”, taasna ay ku qasabtay dalalka gobolka inay iyagu qaataan masuuliyad dheeraad ah. Taasi macnaheedu ma ahan in Sacuudigu ka tegayo Mareykanka. Riyadh weli waxay si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay hubka, sirdoonka iyo kaabeyaasha militari ee Mareykanka. Turkiga wuxuu weli xubin muhiim ah ka yahay NATO, halka Pakistan ay iyaduna xiriir ciidan oo muhiim ah la leedahay Washington. Sidaas darteed, heshiiska Makkah wuxuu hadda u egyahay caymis istaraatiiji ah oo dheeraad ah, halkii uu ka ahaan lahaa kala-tag siyaasadeed oo Mareykanka lala sameynayo. Burcu Ozcelik oo ka tirsan machadka Royal United Services Institute ayaa ku doodday in iskaashi amni oo xooggan oo dhex mara dalalka gobolka uu xitaa la jaanqaadi karo rabitaanka muddada dheer ee Washington ee ah in xulafadeedu qaadaan qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah masuuliyadda difaacooda. Turkiga, heshiisku wuxuu sidoo kale la jaanqaadayaa aragtida Ankara ee ah “xalalka gobolka in laga raadiyo gudaha gobolka”, taas oo Turkiga siinaysa fursad uu ku kordhiyo saameyntiisa isaga oo aan wax u dhimeyn xubinnimadiisa NATO. Ku biirista Turkiga waxay sidoo kale beddeleysaa qaabka xiriirka amni ee markii hore inta badan u dhexeeyey Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan. Ankara waxay leedahay ciidan ballaaran, awood badeed oo muhiim ah iyo warshado difaac oo noqday dhoofiye weyn oo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, gantaallada iyo maraakiibta dagaalka ah. Sacuudiga wuxuu doonayaa inuu yareeyo ku-tiirsanaanta hubka dibadda laga soo iibsado, halka Turkiga uu raadinayo suuqyo cusub, maalgashi iyo door weyn oo dhinaca amniga gobolka ah. Arrintaas waxay fursad u abuureysaa wax-soo-saar hub oo wadajir ah, iibsasho militari, wadaagista sirdoonka iyo mustaqbalka qorsheyn ciidan oo isku xiran. Haddii saddexda dal ay u gudbaan dhoolatusyo militari oo joogto ah, roondo badeed ama nidaamyo isku dhafan oo difaaca cirka iyo gantaallada ah, heshiiska Makkah wuxuu noqon karaa mid si weyn uga gudba astaantii munaasabaddii Jimcaha. Miisaanka Pakistan Pakistan ayaa heshiiska ku soo kordhineysa arrin kale oo aad muhiim u ah: waa dal haysta hub nukliyeer ah. Taasi waxay durba dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan in awoodda nukliyeerka Pakistan ay si dadban u dabooli karto Sacuudiga iyo Turkiga. Ilaa hadda ma jirto caddeyn muujineysa in Islamabad ay bixisay dammaanad nukliyeer. Saraakiisha saddexda dal ayaa ku adkeysanaya in heshiisku yahay mid difaac ah oo aan dal gaar ah lagu bartilmaameedsan, halka falanqeeyayaashuna ka digayaan in si toos ah loo fasirto inay Pakistan ballanqaaday adeegsiga awooddeeda nukliyeerka. Si kastaba, jiritaanka awood nukliyeer ayaa kaligeed saameyn kara xisaabta dal kasta oo qorsheynaya weerar ballaaran. Dal ka fikiraya inuu weeraro Sacuudiga waa inuu hadda sidoo kale qiimeeyaa sida Islamabad uga falcelin karto qodobka dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo arko weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Pakistan sidoo kale waxay leedahay awood ciidan oo caadi ah oo weyn, waxayna horey kumannaan askari iyo qalab militari ugu dirtay Sacuudiga, iyadoo labada dal muddo dheer lahaa xiriir dhinaca difaaca ah. Islamabad, xiriir amni oo sii xoogeysanaya oo ay la yeelato Khaliijka wuxuu siin karaa saameyn siyaasadeed, maalgashi iyo iskaashi dhinaca tamarta ah, iyadoo Pakistan ay sidoo kale ballaarineyso kaalinteeda istaraatiijiyeed ee ka baxsan loollankeeda taariikhiga ah ee India. Iran ayaa ah walaaca amni ee ugu dhow, balse heshiiska Makkah ma aha in loo arko oo keliya diyaar-garow dagaal lala galo Tehran. Sacuudiga wuxuu doonayaa awood ka-hortag oo xooggan, balse isla mar ahaantaana ma doonayo dagaal aan dhammaad lahayn oo dhaawici kara dhoofinta shidaalka, maalgashiga iyo qorshaha ballaaran ee dhaxal-suge Maxamed bin Salman uu ku doonayo inuu ku beddelo dhaqaalaha boqortooyada. Dalalka Khaliijka waxay rabaan inay ka badbaadaan awoodda Iran, laakiin juqraafi ahaan waxay sidoo kale og yihiin in Tehran ay tahay deris aan meel kale u guuri doonin, taas oo ka dhigeysa nooc wada-noolaansho siyaasadeed mid aan laga maarmi karin mustaqbalka. Ujeeddada Riyadh sidaas darteed ma aha khasab inay Turkiga iyo Pakistan ku qanciso inay Iran la dagaallamaan. Waxa ay dooneyso ayaa ah in Tehran ay ogaato in weerar lagu ballaariyo Sacuudiga uu keeni karo cawaaqib iyo kharash ka weyn kii hore. Israel oo si dhow ula socota Israel ayaa ah dhinaca kale ee muhiimka ah ee si dhow u eegaya heshiiska. Xiriirka Turkiga iyo Israel ayaa aad u xumaaday sannadihii dambe, halka qorshaha Sacuudiga iyo Israel ay ku gaari lahaayeen xiriir rasmi ah uu sii adkaaday kadib dagaalka Gaza iyo qalalaasaha ballaaran ee gobolka. Falanqeeyayaal Israeli ah ayaa durba walaac ka muujiyey in heshiiska cusub uu dhinac militari ku daro xiriirka siyaasadeed ee sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya qaar ka mid ah quwadaha ugu waaweyn dunida Muslimka. Gallia Lindenstrauss oo ka tirsan machadka Israel Institute for National Security Studies ayaa heshiiska ku tilmaantay horumar “aad looga walaaco” marka laga eego dhinaca Israel, iyadoo sheegtay inuu sii adkeyn karo dadaallada caadiyeynta xiriirka Sacuudiga iyo Israel. Taasi macnaheedu ma aha in heshiiska Makkah uu yahay isbaheysi ka dhan ah Israel. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu Riyadh siinayaa waddo amni oo kale, xilli Washington ay rajeyneysay in dammaanadaha amni ee Mareykanka iyo xiriir rasmi ah oo Sacuudiga iyo Israel dhex mara ay saldhig u noqdaan nidaam cusub oo gobolka ah. Hadda Sacuudigu wuxuu iskaashiga amni ee Turkiga iyo Pakistan horumarin karaa isaga oo aan arrintaas ku xirin mustaqbalka xiriirka uu la yeelanayo Israel. Nidaam goboleed oo isbeddelaya Muhiimadda ugu weyn ee heshiiska waxay ku jirtaa madaxbannaanida istaraatiijiyeed ee uu siin karo saddexda dal. Heshiiska Makkah wuxuu abuurayaa hannaan amni oo aan khasab ka dhigeyn in Mareykanku abaabulo qayb kasta oo difaaca gobolka ah, isla markaana la jaanqaadi kara xulafada iyo iskaashiyada hore u jiray halkii uu beddeli lahaa. items.fullContent: Makkah (Caasimada Online) – Heshiiska difaaca ee Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay Jimcihii ku saxiixdeen magaalada Makkah weli ma ahan “NATO Islaami ah”, balse waxa uu xambaarsan yahay fariin siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo ka weyn magaca heshiiska laftiisa. Saddexdan dal oo ka mid ah quwadaha ugu waaweyn dunida Muslimka ayaa dhisaya hannaan cusub oo iskaashi amni, xilli kalsoonida lagu qabo nidaamkii amni ee muddada dheer gobolka ka jiray ii sii wiiqmayo. Sacuudiga wuxuu heshiiska la imanayaa awood dhaqaale iyo miisaan siyaasadeed, Turkiga wuxuu leeyahay ciidanka labaad ee ugu weyn NATO iyo warshado difaac oo si xawli ah u koraya, halka Pakistan ay leedahay awood ciidan oo weyn iyo hubka nukliyeerka ee keliya ee uu leeyahay dal Muslim ah. Su’aasha ugu weyn ma ahan in saddexdan dal ay doonayaan inay Mareykanka ka saaraan gobolka ama beddelaan kaalintiisa. Waxa muhiimka ah waa in Riyadh, Ankara iyo Islamabad ay u muuqdaan kuwo rumeysan in Washington oo keliya aysan mar dambe siin karin dammaanadda amni ee ay u baahan yihiin. Arrintaas ayaa Sacuudiga si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah. Boqortooyadu muddo tobannaan sano ah waxay ku tiirsaneyd dalladda amni ee Mareykanka, waxayna soo iibsatay qaar ka mid ah hubka ugu casrisan dunida. Si kastaba, gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Iran iyo kooxaha ay Tehran taageerto ayaa dhowr jeer muujiyey nuglaanta amniga Sacuudiga iyo guud ahaan Khaliijka. Dagaalka hadda ka socda gobolka ayaa walaacaas sii xoojiyey. Weerarro Iiraani ah ayaa gaaray kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah ee dalalka Khaliijka, halka xiisadda ka jirta marin-biyoodka Hormuz ay khatar gelisay isu-socodka maraakiibta iyo dhaqaalaha Sacuudiga oo weli si weyn ugu tiirsan shidaalka. Iran ayaa sidoo kale bartilmaameedsatay nidaamyada raadaarka iyo isgaarsiinta ee laf-dhabarta u ah difaacyada cirka ee Mareykanku hoggaamiyo ee Khaliijka, taas oo sii muujisay in xitaa nidaamyada difaaca ugu casrisan ay leeyihiin meelo nugul. Sacuudiga oo raadinaya caymis Falanqeeyaha Sacuudiga Ali Shihabi ayaa Financial Times u sheegay in isbaheysigan uu ka tarjumayo faham sii xoogeysanaya oo ah in awoodda Mareykanka ee ka-hortagga cadowga ay “si weyn u daciiftay”, taasna ay ku qasabtay dalalka gobolka inay iyagu qaataan masuuliyad dheeraad ah. Taasi macnaheedu ma ahan in Sacuudigu ka tegayo Mareykanka. Riyadh weli waxay si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay hubka, sirdoonka iyo kaabeyaasha militari ee Mareykanka. Burcu Ozcelik oo ka tirsan machadka Royal United Services Institute ayaa ku doodday in iskaashi amni oo xooggan oo dhex mara dalalka gobolka uu xitaa la jaanqaadi karo rabitaanka muddada dheer ee Washington ee ah in xulafadeedu qaadaan qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah masuuliyadda difaacooda. Miisaanka Pakistan Pakistan ayaa heshiiska ku soo kordhineysa arrin kale oo aad muhiim u ah: waa dal haysta hub nukliyeer ah. Ilaa hadda ma jirto caddeyn muujineysa in Islamabad ay bixisay dammaanad nukliyeer. Saraakiisha saddexda dal ayaa ku adkeysanaya in heshiisku yahay mid difaac ah oo aan dal gaar ah lagu bartilmaameedsan, halka falanqeeyayaashuna ka digayaan in si toos ah loo fasirto inay Pakistan ballanqaaday adeegsiga awooddeeda nukliyeerka. Si kastaba, jiritaanka awood nukliyeer ayaa kaligeed saameyn kara xisaabta dal kasta oo qorsheynaya weerar ballaaran. items.title: Dagaalka Suudaan oo Halis Geliyay Mustaqbalka Jiil Dhan iyo Qaramada Midoobay oo Digniin Culus Soo Saartay
items.description: Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ka digtay in dagaalka sokeeye ee ka socda Suudaan uu halis weyn ku yahay mustaqbalka jiil dhan oo carruur ah, iyadoo in ka badan 8 milyan oo carruur ah oo da’doodu tahay da’da waxbarashada ay hadda ka maqanyihiin iskuullada. Digniintan ayaa waxaa jeedisay Aamina Maxamed , Ku-xigeenka Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, xilli ay Jimcihii ka hadlaysay kulan aan rasmi ahayn oo Golaha Ammaanka Qaramada Midoobay looga hadlayay ilaalinta waxbarashada carruurta Suudaan. Dagaalka u dhexeeya Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Suudaan (SAF) iyo kooxda Rapid Support Forces (RSF) ayaa galay maalintiisii 1,210-aad, iyadoo colaadda ay bilaabatay Abriil 2023. Aamina Maxamed ayaa sheegtay in khasaaraha dagaalku uusan ku koobnayn dhimashada, barakaca iyo burburka kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, balse uu sidoo kale si weyn u saameynayo mustaqbalka carruurta Suudaan. Waxay tilmaantay in carruur badan laga qaaday fursaddii waxbarasho, taas oo haddii ay sii socoto keeni karta in jiil dhan uu waayo aqoon iyo xirfado uu mustaqbalkiisa ku dhisto. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in ku dhowaad saddex-meelood meel meel? —sax ahaan, ku dhowaad saddex-meelood afar meelood (75%) —iskuullada ku yaalla gobolka Darfur ay waxyeello soo gaartay, la burburiyay ama aan loo isticmaali karin waxbarasho tan iyo markii dagaalku billowday. Sidoo kale, tan iyo 2024 waxaa la diiwaangeliyay in ka badan 67 weerar oo lagu qaaday iskuullo , halka in ka badan 154 jeer iskuullo loo adeegsaday arrimo militari. Xaaladda macallimiinta ayaa iyaduna aad u adag. Qaramada Midoobay waxay sheegtay in in ka badan kala bar macallimiinta Suudaan aysan helin mushaharkooda , hase yeeshee qaar badan oo kamid ah ay weli sii wadaan shaqadooda, iyagoo isku dayaya inay carruurta waxbarasho siiyaan inkastoo xaaladda amni iyo dhaqaale ay aad u adag tahay. Dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale sababay in waalidiin badan ay carruurtooda ka fogeeyaan iskuullada, maadaama ay u arkaan guryaha inay yihiin meelaha ugu ammaan badan ee ay carruurtooda ku hayn karaan. Sida ay sheegtay Qaramada Midoobay, shan carruur ah oo lixdii carruur ahba waxay ka maqanyihiin iskuullada , taas oo muujinaysa baaxadda dhibaatada waxbarasho ee dalka. Inkasta oo Qaramada Midoobay iyo hay’adaha ay bahwadaagta yihiin ay sanadkan dib ugu soo celiyeen waxbarasho nooc ka mid ah in ka badan hal milyan oo carruur Suudaani ah , haddana tiradaasi aad ayay uga hooseysaa baahida dhabta ah ee jirta. Dhinaca kale, UNICEF ayaa sheegtay in qiyaastii 15 milyan oo qof ay ku barakaceen gudaha iyo dibadda Suudaan tan iyo markii dagaalku billowday. Ku dhowaad 33 milyan oo qof ayaa sidoo kale si daran ugu baahan gargaar bani’aadannimo, waxaana in ka badan kala bar dadkaas ay yihiin carruur. Qaramada Midoobay waxay sidoo kale xustay in dagaalku si gaar ah ugu culus yahay haweenka iyo carruurta , kuwaas oo aan wax door ah ku lahayn go’aannada sababay colaadda, balse ay yihiin dadka ugu badan ee la kulmaya cawaaqibkeeda. Dagaalka Suudaan ayaa sidoo kale sababay eedeymo culus oo la xiriira xadgudubyo ka dhan ah xuquuqda aadanaha, oo ay ku jiraan dilal wadareed iyo kufsi loo adeegsado hub dagaal. Madaxa Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan xuquuqda aadanaha, Volker Türk , ayaa horay u sheegay in waxa Suudaan ka dhacaya aysan ahayn oo keliya dagaal caadi ah, balse ay tahay musiibo xuquuqda aadanaha ah oo indhaha caalamku si toos ah u daawanayo . Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sidaas darteed ku celisay baaqeeda ku aaddan in la ilaaliyo carruurta iyo goobaha waxbarashada, lana sameeyo dadaallo lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka, si malaayiinta carruurta ah ee waxbarashada ka maqani ay ugu helaan fursad ay dib ugu dhistaan noloshooda iyo mustaqbalkooda. Digniinta ugu weyn ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ah in haddii dagaalku sii socdo, khasaaraha Suudaan uusan ku ekaan doonin jiilka maanta dagaalka ku dhex jira, balse uu saameyn doono jiilalka mustaqbalka ee dalka.

items.title: Commentary on Abdi Faarax Siciid (Juxa)’s ‘Reer Puntland & 100 Sano Kadib (1927–2026)’
items.description: By Abdirashid Yaasin Musse Introduction: Abdi Faarax Siciid (Juxa)’s article offers a century-long reflection on Puntland’s political , economic, and social evolution. More importantly, it attempts to explain how the historical experiences of the people of Puntland have shaped their contemporary political thinking. While some of the author’s political conclusions remain open to debate, his central thesis—that Puntland’s current political outlook is rooted in a century of sacrifice, displacement, state-building, and repeated disappointment—is worthy of serious consideration. Indeed, Juxa’s historical narrative complements a broader argument that many Puntland scholars and political observers have advanced for years: Puntland has consistently invested its people, resources, and leadership in building the Somali nation, yet many believe those sacrifices have rarely been matched by equitable political partnership or national investment. From the Collapse of the Sultanates to the Birth of Somali Nationalism Juxa correctly begins his narrative before independence, tracing Puntland’s modern political history to the destruction of the indigenous Sultanates during the 1920s. The collapse of the Majeerteen Sultanate, the Hobyo Sultanate, the Warsangali Sultanate, and the defeat of the Dervish movement fundamentally altered the trajectory of the region. These events were not merely military defeats. They dismantled functioning indigenous political systems, disrupted commerce, weakened traditional governance, and accelerated migration. The resulting economic isolation transformed much of the region into what later became known as “Gaari Waa”—a symbolic description of a region left geographically and economically disconnected from the rest of the country. Rather than rebuilding locally, generations of Puntland’s most educated citizens sought opportunities elsewhere, particularly in southern Somalia. This migration unintentionally created one of the earliest examples of brain drain and capital flight from Puntland. While individuals prospered and contributed nationally, the region itself remained underdeveloped. Building Somalia before Building Puntland One of the strongest themes in both Juxa’s article and Puntland’s historical experience is that its people consistently prioritized building Somalia before building Puntland. During the struggle for independence, Puntland intellectuals became leading participants in the Somali Youth League (SYL) and the nationalist movement. They viewed Somali unity as a collective national mission that transcended regional identity. After independence in 1960, Puntland continued supplying administrators, judges, military officers, diplomats, educators, and civil servants to the Somali Republic. Many of Somalia’s institutions were built with substantial contributions from professionals originating from Puntland. Ironically, this national commitment further deepened Puntland’s own institutional weakness. As skilled professionals and entrepreneurs relocated southward, investment and administrative capacity followed them. Consequently, while Puntland played an outsized role in constructing the Somali state, comparatively little state investment returned to develop the region itself. Juxa’s article illustrates this historical paradox well: Puntland repeatedly exported leadership while importing neglect. Military Rule and the Deepening of Historical Grievances The military takeover of 1969 marked another decisive turning point. As opposition to Maxamed Siyaad Barre’s government intensified, Puntland increasingly became associated with the Somali Salvation Democratic Front (SSDF), Somalia’s first major armed opposition movement. Juxa documents the severe consequences that followed, including political repression, arrests, destruction of infrastructure, and widespread insecurity. Many historians and residents of Puntland argue that the government’s actions extended beyond counterinsurgency and amounted to collective punishment against communities associated with the SSDF. Whether interpreted politically or historically, these experiences profoundly shaped Puntland’s constitutional thinking. They reinforced a belief that concentrating excessive authority in a single central government could expose entire regions to political vulnerability whenever power was abused. Civil War: Returning Home to an Empty Homeland Perhaps the most emotionally powerful section of Juxa’s article is his description of the 1991 state collapse. For decades, successive generations of Puntland families had established businesses, careers, and homes throughout southern Somalia. When civil war erupted, they lost virtually everything. Many became refugees or internally displaced persons who eventually returned to Puntland. Yet they returned not to a developed homeland but to a region that had long suffered from underinvestment precisely because so much of its human capital had been devoted to the national project. This historical irony deserves greater recognition. Puntland was forced to rebuild itself almost entirely from scratch—not because its people had neglected their homeland, but because for generations they had invested overwhelmingly in building Somalia itself. Puntland: A Project to Save Somalia Juxa strongly emphasizes that Puntland was not established as a secessionist entity. Following eight years of waiting for Somalia’s reconciliation efforts to succeed, traditional elders, intellectuals, business leaders, and former SSDF leadership established Puntland in 1998. Their objective was twofold. The first was to restore security, governance, justice, and public services for their own population. The second was to demonstrate that Somalia could be rebuilt through decentralized governance founded upon constitutional federalism. This distinction remains one of the most important aspects of Puntland’s political identity. Unlike outright secessionist projects, Puntland presented itself as both a regional administration and a constitutional model for rebuilding the Somali Republic. Federalism was viewed not as an obstacle to Somali unity but as a safeguard against the return of authoritarian centralization that had characterized previous governments. From Federal Optimism to Constitutional Frustration The election of Puntland’s founding President, Cabdullaahi Yuusuf Axmed, as President of Somalia represented a moment of enormous hope. For many Puntland citizens, it appeared that the ideals upon which Puntland had been established—constitutional governance, reconciliation, and federal partnership—would finally guide Somalia’s national recovery. However, as Juxa argues, that optimism gradually faded. Renewed conflict in Muqdisho, President Cabdullaahi Yuusuf’s resignation, and subsequent constitutional disagreements between Puntland and successive federal administrations generated increasing mistrust. Juxa interprets the administrations that followed as progressively centralizing authority while weakening the federal arrangements negotiated during Somalia’s reconciliation process. Whether one agrees entirely with that assessment or not, it is undeniable that disputes over constitutional interpretation, power-sharing, fiscal arrangements, and state autonomy have remained among Somalia’s most persistent political challenges. Why Confederation Has Entered the Debate Juxa concludes by advocating consideration of a confederal model for Somalia. His proposal is not presented simply as an ideological preference but as the logical consequence of a century of historical experience. His argument is that if constitutional federalism can be altered or weakened through political majorities at the centre, then stronger constitutional guarantees may be necessary to protect regional self-government while preserving cooperation on agreed national responsibilities. Others maintain that Somalia’s federal constitution remains sufficient if implemented faithfully and consistently. That debate is likely to continue. Nevertheless, Juxa succeeds in explaining why increasing numbers of Puntland intellectuals have begun discussing confederation—not because they necessarily reject Somali unity, but because they seek stronger institutional safeguards against the recurrence of centralized political domination. Conclusion Juxa’s article ultimately tells the story of a people who repeatedly chose national service over regional advantage. From resisting colonial rule, to contributing to the independence movement, to building Somalia’s first republic, to enduring military repression, to rebuilding governance after total state collapse, Puntland has consistently played a central role in Somalia’s modern history. His article argues that these experiences have fundamentally shaped Puntland’s contemporary political thinking. Whether readers agree with his endorsement of confederation or continue to support federalism, the broader lesson remains compelling: constitutional systems survive only when all parties believe that agreements will be respected, power will be shared fairly, and no region will again experience the neglect, marginalization, or concentration of authority that has characterized too much of Somalia’s modern history. If Somalia is to achieve lasting peace and stable governance, it must honestly confront its historical experiences, strengthen constitutional trust, and build a political order in which every region sees itself not as a subject of the state, but as an equal partner in its future. items.title: Gariirka dagaal ee ka jira Gobolka Hiiraan oo caqabad ku noqday dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsiga
items.description: Ka dib dagaaladii xooganaa ee 1-dii iyo 2-dii bishan ka dhacay deegaanada u dhexeeya Teedaan iyo Degmada Maxaas ee Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa sababay in uu hakad ku yimaado isu socodkii dadka iyo ganacsiga ee labada magaalo ee Maxaas iyo Matabaan. Inkasta oo aanu jirin dagaal toos ah oo ka dhacay gobolka, wixii ka dambeeyay Axaddii oo Al Shabaab ay qabsatay deegaanka Teedaan, haddana waxaa weli taagan cabsi iyo gariir dagaal oo u dhexeeya labada dhinac. Shabaabka ayaa dhufeysyo ka sameystay deegaanka Teedaan, halka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka (Macawiisley) ee ka baxay Teedaan ay ku sugan yihiin deegaanka Bukure. Shabaabka ayaa dadaal ugu jira, sidii ay u ilaashan lahaayeen Teedaan, halka Saraakiisha Militariga ay wadaan qorshe dib maleeshiyada looga saarayo deegaankaasi. Dadka ku dhaqan deegaanada Bukure, Hees iyo Coomaad ayaa kuu sheegaya in maalmihii u dambeeyay aan la arkin gaadiidka dadweynaha iyo kuwa xamuulka oo ka soo gudbaya deegaanka Teedaan, isla-markaana imanaya deegaanadaasi amaba u socda dhanka Galmudug. Ganacsatada iyo wadayaasha gaadiidka xamuulka ayaa dareemaya in aagga ay ka jirto xiisad adag, oo muujineysa in qarka loo saaran yahay inay dhacaan dagaalo kale, waana dareen ka dhashay jewi muujinaya inuu jiro diyaargarow dagaal. Qoysaska ay saameeyeen dagaaladii ka dhacay deegaanada Suullaay, Xasan Raqay, Sulmo, Xagar iyo aagga Teedaan oo qaybtood u barakacay deegaanka Hees ayaa ka cabanaya nolol xumo iyo inaysan Dowladda Federaalka soo gaarsiinin kaalmo bani’aadantinimo. Deegaanka Teedaan ayaa muhiim u ah dhaqdhaqaaqa dadka iyo ganacsiga ee Gobolada Hiiraan iyo Galgaduud, waana deegaan xiriiriya Magaalooyinka Beledweyne, Matabaan iyo Maxaas.

items.title: Maleeshiyadii Al Shabaab ee Degmada Aadan Yabaal oo loo wareejiyay Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe ayaa sheegaya in Al Shabaab ay inta badan maleeshiyadeeda ka daadgureysay Degmada Aadan Yabaal ee gobolkaasi, si ay u xoojiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyadooda Gobolka Hiiraan ee ay kaga hortaggayaan gulufka ballaaran ee Militariga Somaliya uu qorsheynayo in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ay dib ugu la wareegaan deegaankaasi Teedaan oo hoostaga Degmada Maxaas. Shabaabka ayaa Axaddii la wareegay gacan ku haynta deegaanka istiraatiijiga ah ee Teedaan, ka dib dagaalo culus oo ka dhacay deegaanada u dhexeeya Degmada Maxaas iyo Teedaan. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in maleeshiyada Shabaabka ee banneeyay Degmada Aadan Yabaal ay Khamiistii iyo Jimcihii gaareen Degmada Moqokori ee Gobolka Hiiraan, isla-markaana ay uga sii gudbeen jihada Degmada Maxaas. Ilo dadka deegaanka ah oo ku sugan Degmada Aadan Yabaal ayaa sheegay in Al Shabaab ay dagaal-yahanadeeda Jabhadaha u wareejisay dhinaca bariga Gobolka Hiiraan, isla-markaana ay degmadaasi ku sugan yihiin oo keliya tiro yar oo ka mid ah maleeshiyada Xisbada ee sida booliska oo kale u tababaran, si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga magaalada. Shabaabka ayaa ka cararaya in ay lumiyaan gacan ku haynta deegaanka Teedaan, sababtu tahay muhiimadda juqraafiyadeed ee uu leeyahay, iyadoona deegaanku uu isku xiro Maxaas, Beledweyne iyo Matabaan. items.title: Mossad Shaken by Alleged Iran Operation Failure
items.description: TEL AVIV (WDN) — Israel’s intelligence establishment is reportedly facing a dramatic internal shake-up after two senior Mossad officials were dismissed over their alleged roles in a covert strategy aimed at destabilizing Iran’s government—an extraordinary development that, if confirmed, could expose the scale and ambition of Israel’s clandestine confrontation with Tehran. Israeli media reports say the dismissals were ordered by newly appointed Mossad Director Roman Goffman, who assumed the agency’s leadership in June, succeeding David Barnea. Goffman is reportedly undertaking a sweeping review of the agency’s senior leadership and operations, including missions that failed to deliver their intended results. According to Israel’s Channel 12, the two dismissed officials were among Mossad’s most senior intelligence figures. One reportedly served as the agency’s intelligence operations chief since December 2015, while the other headed the division responsible for Iran-related operations. Their identities have not been publicly disclosed, reportedly because of the extreme sensitivity surrounding Israeli intelligence operations. A Covert Strategy Targeting Tehran The reports allege that the two officials were involved in developing an ambitious intelligence strategy designed to intensify internal pressure on Iran’s government by exploiting opposition networks, encouraging mass protests and supporting activities capable of generating political instability. According to the reports, the strategy sought to combine covert external support with existing domestic opposition movements in an attempt to create conditions for significant political change inside Iran. Among the alleged elements of the operation were contacts with armed Kurdish groups, efforts to strengthen opposition activity and attempts to encourage large-scale demonstrations in major Iranian cities. The reported strategy bears similarities to information previously attributed to The New York Times, which described alleged Israeli efforts to increase internal pressure on the Iranian leadership. If accurate, the revelations would point to an intelligence campaign extending far beyond conventional espionage—one aimed at influencing the internal political trajectory of one of Israel’s most formidable regional adversaries. Netanyahu and Trump Israeli media reports have also claimed that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu presented elements of the strategy to then-President Donald Trump during discussions in March. According to those reports, Netanyahu sought to persuade Trump to support military action against Iran, arguing that military pressure combined with internal unrest could accelerate political change in Tehran. The alleged strategy therefore appears to have rested on a highly consequential assumption: that external military pressure and carefully cultivated internal instability could reinforce each other and ultimately weaken Iran’s political leadership. But according to the Israeli reports, the expected outcome did not materialize. The failure reportedly triggered a reassessment of Mossad’s Iran operations and contributed to the decision to remove the two senior officials. A Rare Glimpse Inside Israel’s Shadow War The reported dismissals are significant not simply because of the seniority of the officials involved, but because they potentially offer a rare glimpse into the extraordinary lengths to which Israel and Iran have gone in their long-running shadow war. For years, the two countries have confronted each other through intelligence operations, cyber activity, covert actions, proxy networks and increasingly direct military threats. Iran’s nuclear programme, regional influence and military capabilities have remained at the heart of the confrontation. Against that backdrop, an intelligence strategy designed to generate political upheaval inside Iran would represent one of the most ambitious forms of covert intervention imaginable. Yet it would also carry enormous risks. Attempting to manipulate political unrest inside a country as large, heavily securitized and politically complex as Iran is a formidable undertaking. A failure could expose intelligence networks, damage operational credibility and provoke countermeasures from Iranian security agencies. Mossad Remains Silent Neither the Israeli government nor Mossad has publicly confirmed or denied the reports concerning the dismissals or the alleged Iran operation. Iranian authorities have likewise not publicly responded to the claims regarding an alleged Israeli strategy to destabilize the government in Tehran. That silence leaves important questions unanswered. Were the two officials removed because the operation genuinely failed? Was the dismissal part of a broader leadership restructuring under Goffman? Or do the reports reflect only one part of a much larger reassessment of Israel’s strategy toward Iran? For now, those questions remain unanswered. But if the reports are eventually confirmed, the episode could prove to be far more than some internal personnel change at Mossad. It would offer a remarkable window into the intensity of the Israeli-Iranian intelligence war—and into the extraordinary risks being taken behind the scenes as both countries struggle for strategic advantage across the Middle East. In the opaque world of intelligence, where successes are rarely acknowledged and failures are often buried in secrecy, the reported removal of two senior Mossad officials would itself be an unusually revealing signal. It would suggest that, somewhere inside Israel’s most secretive institution, the Iran file has become important enough—and contentious enough—to shake the agency at its highest levels. items.title: Amnesty Calls for Release of Somali Activist Sadiya Moalim Ali
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Amnesty International has published an interview with Somali social activist and bajaj driver Sadiya Moalim Ali, who is serving a three-year prison sentence in Mogadishu after being convicted in a case the rights organization says is linked to her freedom of expression and participation in peaceful demonstrations. Sadia Moalim Ali: “Not even prison will silence me” – Amnesty International Amnesty says Sadiya was arrested on April 12, 2026, following comments she made on social media and her participation in peaceful protests. The organization has called for her immediate and unconditional release, arguing that her detention and conviction are connected to her exercise of fundamental rights. Speaking in an interview conducted inside prison, Sadiya said she does not believe her conviction was based on genuine justice. Instead, she described her imprisonment as retaliation for speaking publicly about the hardships facing ordinary Somalis. “I believe my arrest and conviction are political and intended to punish me for speaking openly about social issues,” she said. Sadiya said little had changed in her circumstances since her conviction and expressed frustration that peaceful criticism had resulted in a lengthy prison sentence. Sadiya told Amnesty that she trained as a midwife but repeatedly failed to secure employment in her profession despite submitting several applications. She said she faced significant barriers to employment and believes Somalia’s 4.5 clan-based power-sharing system affected her opportunities because she comes from a minority clan. After failing to find professional employment, Sadiya said she turned to selling food online before eventually becoming a bajaj driver to support herself and her family. She said her decision to speak publicly about social and political issues was driven by the problems she encountered in everyday life and the hardships she witnessed among ordinary Somalis. One of the most painful consequences of her imprisonment, Sadiya said, has been her separation from her daughter. She told Amnesty that her daughter was only one year old and still breastfeeding when she was sentenced. “What hurts me most is being separated from my daughter while she is still so young,” she said. Sadiya said the separation has caused significant emotional distress for both her and her family. She also claimed that she has not been permitted to see her daughter or other members of her family since her arrest. Alleged Pressure to Apologize Sadiya further alleged that, following her conviction, individuals she believed were affiliated with government institutions visited her and pressured her to admit wrongdoing, apologize to Somalia’s president and seek a presidential pardon. According to her account, she was also allegedly offered release if she agreed to stop speaking publicly about the issues she had been raising. She said a senior official additionally offered her employment on the condition that she cease her public commentary. Sadiya said she rejected the proposals because she did not want to confess to an offense she maintains she did not commit. Sadiya also described a number of health problems she says she has experienced during her imprisonment, including kidney problems, asthma, an eye condition and hearing difficulties. She attributed her hearing problems to an injury to her ear sustained during her arrest. She also complained about poor sanitation inside the prison, saying it had contributed to skin rashes and other injuries. According to her account, she has lost significant weight and has not been allowed adequate access to medical care. The allegations raise additional concerns about her conditions of detention, although no independent medical assessment was cited in the interview. Amnesty Demands Immediate Release Amnesty International has renewed its call for Sadiya’s immediate and unconditional release, describing her detention and conviction as violations of her rights to freedom of expression and peaceful assembly. The organization has urged Somali authorities to ensure that individuals are not imprisoned simply for peacefully expressing political or social views or participating in peaceful demonstrations. Sadiya, meanwhile, said she still has some faith in the judicial system and hopes her appeal can provide an opportunity for an independent review of her case. She said genuine justice would only be possible if an independent judge hears the case and reaches a decision based on the facts and evidence. Sadiya has appealed to Somalis to speak out against what she describes as an injustice, warning that what has happened to her could happen to others. “If it happened to me today, it could happen to someone else tomorrow,” she said. She also called on the international community to continue raising awareness about her case and supporting efforts to secure her release. Her case has become another test of Somalia’s commitment to protecting freedom of expression at a time when political tensions remain high and public criticism of government institutions continues to generate controversy. For Amnesty International, the central issue is straightforward: peaceful expression and assembly should not result in imprisonment. For Sadiya, the stakes are deeply personal—three years behind bars, separation from her young daughter, deteriorating health and uncertainty over whether an appeal will deliver the justice she says she has been denied. As of publication, there had been no official response from the Federal Government of Somalia to Amnesty International’s latest interview or to the allegations made by Sadiya regarding her arrest, conviction, treatment in prison and the alleged offers made to secure her release. items.title: U.S. Special Operations Commander Meets Jubaland President Ahmed Madobe to Discuss Counterterrorism Cooperation
items.description: Kismayo (WDN) — The United States has intensified security engagement with Jubaland after the Commander of U.S. Africa Command’s Special Operations Forces, Major General Claude K. Tudor Jr., held talks with Jubaland President Ahmed Mohamed Islam (Ahmed Madobe). The meeting focused on strengthening counterterrorism cooperation, accelerating operations against extremist groups in Jubaland, and enhancing security coordination between Jubaland authorities and the United States. Jubaland officials said discussions centered on ongoing efforts to improve security operations in the region, particularly against Al-Shabaab, which continues to maintain a significant presence in parts of southern Somalia. The talks were also attended by Jubaland Intelligence Director Mohamed Ahmed Sabriye, highlighting the importance of intelligence cooperation and operational coordination in the fight against militant networks. The engagement comes as Jubaland remains a strategically important region in Somalia’s security landscape due to its proximity to Kenya, its long coastline, and its role in ongoing counterterrorism operations. For Washington, Jubaland has long been a key partner in efforts to disrupt Al-Shabaab’s operational networks, strengthen local security forces, and support regional stability. U.S. military and intelligence cooperation with Somali federal and regional authorities has included training, advisory support, intelligence sharing, and counterterrorism operations. The meeting with President Ahmed Madobe signals continued American engagement with Jubaland at a time when Somalia faces complex security challenges, including militant activity, political tensions, and the need for stronger coordination among security institutions. While details of the discussions were not publicly disclosed, the talks underscore the continued strategic importance of the partnership between Jubaland and the United States in addressing security threats in southern Somalia. items.title: Sirdoonka NISA oo gacanta ku dhigay xubno ka tirsan Shabaab
items.description: Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda & Sirdoonka Qaranka (NISA) ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadu ay gacanta ku dhigeen sagaal xubnood oo ka tirsan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, isla-markaana doonayay in ay falal amni darro ah ka gaystaan Magaalada Muqdisho iyo deegaanada ku xeeran. Hay’adda NISA oo caawa warsaxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa sheegtay in xubnahan ay si dhuumaaleysi ah ugu sugnaayeen Degmooyinka Garasbaaley iyo Kaxda ee Gobolka Banaadir iyo weliba xaafado ka tirsan deegaanka Ceelasha Biyaha ee duleedka Muqdisho, isla-markaana afar ka mid ah ay ahaayeen shabakad isku xiran oo qorsheynaysay falal argagixiso oo lagu dhibaateynayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, laguna qalqalgelinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida caasimadda. NISA ayaa sheegtay in Xoogaga Sirdoonka ay muddo si dhow ula socdeen dhaqdhaqaaqyada iyo qorsheyaasha xubnahan, dabagal iyo xog uruurin ka dibna lagu guuleystay in mid kastaa laga soo qabto goobtii uu ku sugnaa. NISA ayaan sheegin goorta la soo xiray xubnahan, waxayse sheegtay in baaritaan dheeraad ah lagu wado, ka dibna loo gudbin doono sharciga. Warsaxaafadeedka ayaa u qornaa:- Ciidanka Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabad Sugidda Qaranka (NISA) ayaa gacanta ku dhigay Sagaal dhagar-qabe oo ka tirsan Khawaarijta Al Shabaab, kuwaas oo ku howlanaa qorsheynta falal amniga lid ku ah oo ay doonayeen in ay ka fuliyaan Magaalada Muqdisho iyo deegaannada ku xeeran. Dhagar-qabeyaashan ayaa si dhuumaaleysi ah ugu sugnaa Degmooyinka Garasbaaley, Kaxda iyo xaafado ka tirsan Ceelasha Biyaha. Afar ka mid ah waxa ay ahaayeen shabakad isku xiran oo qorsheynaysay falal argagixiso oo lagu dhibaateynayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, laguna qalqalgelinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida caasimadda. Sirdoonka Hay’adda NISA ayaa muddo si dhow ula socday dhaqdhaqaaqyada iyo qorsheyaasha xubnahan, waxaana dabagal iyo xog-ururin ka dib lagu guuleystay in mid kasta lagu qabto goobtii uu ku sugnaa, waxaana hadda ku socda baaritaanno, iyada oo ka dib loo gudbin doono hay’adaha garsoorka, si sharciga loo waafajiyo. Hay’adda NISA waxa ay u mahadcelinaysaa shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee mar walba la wadaaga xogaha la xiriira khataraha amniga, waxayna mar kale xaqiijinaysaa sida ay uga go’an tahay ilaalinta badqabka muwaadiniinta.

Dhagar-qabeyaashan ayaa si dhuumaaleysi ah ugu sugnaa Degmooyinka Garasbaaley, Kaxda iyo xaafado ka tirsan Ceelasha Biyaha. Afar ka mid ah waxa ay ahaayeen shabakad isku xiran oo qorsheynaysay falal argagixiso oo lagu dhibaateynayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, laguna qalqalgelinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida caasimadda. items.title: Booliska Somaliland oo sheegay in bambada ku qaraxday Hargeysa aan wax ujeeddo ah loo tuurin
items.description: Taliska Ciidanka Booliska Somaliland ayaa warsaxaafadeed ka soo saaray bambo gacmeed caawa ku qaraxday goob ay fadhiyeen laba askari oo ka tirsan Militariga Somaliland oo ku taala Magaalada Hargeysa, isla-markaana ay ku dhaawacmeen afar qof oo labadaasi askari ay ku jiraan. Taliska ayaa sheegay in bambada ay dhulka kaga dhacday mid ka mid ah askartaasi, isla-markaana aysan jirin wax ujeeddo ah oo loo tuuray bambadaasi. “Caawa abbaaro 7:00 fiidnimo waxa bambo-gacmeed ku qaraxday goob ay fadhiyeen laba askari oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Milatariga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, taas oo sababtay dhaawaca labada askari iyo laba qof oo shacab ah oo ku sugnaa goobta. Dhammaan dadka dhaawacmay waxa loo gudbiyey Cisbitaalka Guud ee Magaalada Hargeysa.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka oo lagu xusay “Bambo-gacmeedka ayaa dhulka kaga dhacay mid ka mid ah askarta dhaawacantay, mana jirto wax ujeeddo ah oo loo tuuray bambo-gacmeedka, waxaana socda baadhitaan dheeraad ah.” Taliska ayaa dhanka kale beeniyay wararka la isku la wadaagay baraha bulshada ee sheegaya in qarax uu ka dhacay Hargeysa. “Taliska Ciidanka Booliska Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si cad u beeninayaa wararka marin-habaabinta ah ee lagu baahiyey baraha bulshada ee sheegaya in qarax ka dhacay Magaalada Hargeysa.” Ayuu talisku ku sheegay warsaxaafadeedka. Taliska ayaa bulshada uga digay faafinta wararka aan la hubin ee dhaawici kara baa warsaxaafadeedka lagu yiri amniga iyo xasilloonida. “Sidoo kale, Taliska Ciidanka Boolisku waxa uu bulshada uga digayaa faafinta wararka aan la hubin ee dhaawici kara amniga iyo xasilloonida.” Ayaa lagu soo geba-gabeeyay warsaxaafadeedka Booliska Somaliland.

items.title: Qarax bambo oo caawa ka dhacay magaalada Hargeysa
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Wararka aan ka helayno magaalada Hargeysa ee caasimadda Somaliland ayaa sheegaya in caawa uu magaalada ka dhacay qarax bambo-gacmeed. Bambada ayaa la sheegay inay ku qaraxday shaqsi aan weli si rasmi ah loo aqoonsan, kaas oo sida wararku sheegayaan gacanta ku hayay xilliga uu qaraxu dhacay. Dhawaaqa qaraxa ayaa si weyn looga maqlay qeybo kamid ah xaafadda Biibsiga ee magaalada Hargeysa, halkaasi oo la sheegay inuu qaraxu ka dhacay. Dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay inay argagax ku abuurtay dhacdadu. Sida ay Caasimada Online u sheegeen ilo-wareedyo goobjoog ah, bambada ayaa qaraxday xilli uu qofka gacanta ku hayay uu fara-fareynayay, taas oo sababtay in uu dhaawac kasoo gaaro qaraxa. Wararka hordhaca ah ayaa sheegaya in dhaawac culus uu soo gaaray qofkii gacanta ku hayay bambada iyo qof kale oo goobta ka ag dhawaa, kuwaas oo la sheegay in qaraxu uu si weyn u waxyeelleeyay. Ilaa hadda lama soo sheegin khasaare kale oo ka dhashay qaraxa, waxaana weli socda xog uruurinta ku saabsan dhacdada iyo xaaladda dadka waxyeelladu kasoo gaartay. Ciidamada ammaanka Somaliland ayaa si degdeg ah u gaaray goobta uu qaraxu ka dhacay, iyagoo halkaasi ka wada baaritaanno. Wixii kasoo kordha dhacdadan kala soco Caasimada Online.
