items.title: DF oo shaacisay waxa uu ka dhigan yahay heshiiska Turkey, Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo dhoweysay heshiiska cusub ee difaaca wadajirka ah ee ay Jimcaha maanta ah ay magaalada Makka ku kala saxiixdeen Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan, iyadoo ku tilmaantay tallaabo taariikhi ah oo xoojinaysa amniga wadajirka ah iyo iskaashiga milatari. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ugu hambalyeysay saddexda dal saxiixa “Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makka”, iyadoo sheegtay inuu abuurayo iskaashi istaraatiiji ah oo awood u leh inuu wax ka qabto caqabadaha amni ee ay wadaagaan. “Heshiiskani wuxuu matalayaa tallaabo taariikhi ah oo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo amniga wadajirka ah, lagu horumarinayo iskaashiga difaaca, laguna dhisayo iskaashi istaraatiiji ah oo wax ku ool ah si looga hortago caqabadaha amni ee la wadaago,” ayay wasaaraddu tiri. Wasaaradda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inay aaminsan tahay in heshiisku gacan weyn ka geysan doono dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka iyo caalamka, isla markaana uu xoojinayo iskaashiga, isku-duubnida iyo mas’uuliyadda wadajirka ah. Heshiiska ayaa lagu saxiixay Qasriga Al-Safa ee magaalada Makka, kadib shir ay yeesheen Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Mohammed bin Salman, Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif. Bayaan wadajir ah oo ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Sacuudiga ayaa lagu sheegay in heshiisku ku dhisan yahay xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee saddexda dal, walaaltinimada iyo isku-duubnida Islaamka, iyo danaha istaraatiijiga ah ee ay wadaagaan. Qodobka ugu weyn ee heshiiska ayaa dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsan doono weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Heshiisku wuxuu sidoo kale dhigayaa in la ballaariyo dhammaan dhinacyada iskaashiga difaaca ee Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Xilli xasaasi ah Heshiiska ayaa imanaya xilli xaaladda amni ee Bariga Dhexe ay aad u kacsan tahay, iyadoo dalalka gobolka ay wajahaan khataro isa soo taraya oo la xiriira dagaallada, weerarrada gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo loollanka quwadaha gobolka. Sacuudiga ayaa muddooyinkii dambe sare u qaaday feejignaanta amniga, iyadoo walaac laga muujinayo weerarro lagu qaado xarumaha tamarta iyo kaabayaasha kale ee muhiimka ah ee boqortooyada. Heshiiska cusub sidoo kale ma ahan bilowga iskaashiga difaac ee Riyadh iyo Islamabad. Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan ayaa horey u lahaa iskaashi milatari oo muddo dheer soo jiray, waxaana labada dal ay sii xoojiyeen xiriirkooda difaaca sanadihii ugu dambeeyay. Ku biirista Turkiga waxay heshiiska siinaysaa miisaan dheeraad ah, maadaama Ankara ay leedahay mid ka mid ah ciidamada ugu awoodda badan NATO, warshado difaac oo si weyn u kobcay iyo khibrad milatari oo ka baxsan xuduudaheeda. Pakistan ayaa dhankeeda leh ciidan weyn iyo awood nukliyeer, halka Sacuudigu leeyahay awood dhaqaale iyo saameyn siyaasadeed oo muhiim ah oo ka jirta Bariga Dhexe iyo dunida Muslimka. Saddexda dal ayaa sheegay in heshiiska looga gol leeyahay in lagu xoojiyo awoodda wadajirka ah ee looga hortagayo gardarro kasta, isla markaana lagu taageerayo nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka iyo caalamka. Xiriirka Soomaaliya Soo dhoweynta Muqdisho waxay sidoo kale ku soo aadeysaa iyadoo Soomaaliya ay xiriir difaac oo xooggan la leedahay laba ka mid ah saddexda dal ee heshiiska saxiixay. Turkiga ayaa ka mid ah saaxiibada ugu waaweyn ee Soomaaliya dhinaca amniga iyo difaaca. Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa bishii February 2024 ansixiyay heshiis difaac iyo iskaashi dhaqaale oo 10 sano ah oo labada dal dhexmaray, kaas oo ay Muqdisho sheegtay inuu muhiim u yahay ilaalinta madax-bannaanida dalka iyo kheyraadkiisa badda. Ankara ayaa muddo sanado ah tababar iyo qalab siinaysay ciidamada Soomaaliya, waxayna Muqdisho ku leedahay xarunta TURKSOM oo ah mid ka mid ah xarumaha ugu waaweyn ee lagu tababaro ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale sanadkan xoojiyay xiriirkooda difaaca, kadib markii labada dowladood ay Riyadh ku saxiixdeen heshiis iskaashi militari oo lagu ballaarinayo wada-shaqeynta dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca. Muqdisho ayaa sidoo kale dhowaan muujisay taageerada ay u hayso amniga iyo xasilloonida Sacuudiga, iyadoo cambaareysay hanjabaado loo jeediyay boqortooyada. Soo dhoweynta heshiiska Makka ayaa sidaas darteed ku soo aadeysa xilli Soomaaliya ay sii xoojineyso xiriirkeeda amni iyo difaac ee dalalka muhiimka ah ee Bariga Dhexe iyo kuwa ku teedsan Badda Cas. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ugu hambalyeysay saddexda dal saxiixa “Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makka”, iyadoo sheegtay inuu abuurayo iskaashi istaraatiiji ah oo awood u leh inuu wax ka qabto caqabadaha amni ee ay wadaagaan. “Heshiiskani wuxuu matalayaa tallaabo taariikhi ah oo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo amniga wadajirka ah, lagu horumarinayo iskaashiga difaaca, laguna dhisayo iskaashi istaraatiiji ah oo wax ku ool ah si looga hortago caqabadaha amni ee la wadaago,” ayay wasaaraddu tiri. Wasaaradda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inay aaminsan tahay in heshiisku gacan weyn ka geysan doono dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka iyo caalamka, isla markaana uu xoojinayo iskaashiga, isku-duubnida iyo mas’uuliyadda wadajirka ah. Heshiiska ayaa lagu saxiixay Qasriga Al-Safa ee magaalada Makka, kadib shir ay yeesheen Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Mohammed bin Salman, Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif. Bayaan wadajir ah oo ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Sacuudiga ayaa lagu sheegay in heshiisku ku dhisan yahay xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee saddexda dal, walaaltinimada iyo isku-duubnida Islaamka, iyo danaha istaraatiijiga ah ee ay wadaagaan. Qodobka ugu weyn ee heshiiska ayaa dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsan doono weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Heshiisku wuxuu sidoo kale dhigayaa in la ballaariyo dhammaan dhinacyada iskaashiga difaaca ee Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Xilli xasaasi ah Heshiiska ayaa imanaya xilli xaaladda amni ee Bariga Dhexe ay aad u kacsan tahay, iyadoo dalalka gobolka ay wajahaan khataro isa soo taraya oo la xiriira dagaallada, weerarrada gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo loollanka quwadaha gobolka. Sacuudiga ayaa muddooyinkii dambe sare u qaaday feejignaanta amniga, iyadoo walaac laga muujinayo weerarro lagu qaado xarumaha tamarta iyo kaabayaasha kale ee muhiimka ah ee boqortooyada. Heshiiska cusub sidoo kale ma ahan bilowga iskaashiga difaac ee Riyadh iyo Islamabad. Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan ayaa horey u lahaa iskaashi milatari oo muddo dheer soo jiray, waxaana labada dal ay sii xoojiyeen xiriirkooda difaaca sanadihii ugu dambeeyay. Ku biirista Turkiga waxay heshiiska siinaysaa miisaan dheeraad ah, maadaama Ankara ay leedahay mid ka mid ah ciidamada ugu awoodda badan NATO, warshado difaac oo si weyn u kobcay iyo khibrad milatari oo ka baxsan xuduudaheeda. Pakistan ayaa dhankeeda leh ciidan weyn iyo awood nukliyeer, halka Sacuudigu leeyahay awood dhaqaale iyo saameyn siyaasadeed oo muhiim ah oo ka jirta Bariga Dhexe iyo dunida Muslimka. Saddexda dal ayaa sheegay in heshiiska looga gol leeyahay in lagu xoojiyo awoodda wadajirka ah ee looga hortagayo gardarro kasta, isla markaana lagu taageerayo nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka iyo caalamka. Xiriirka Soomaaliya Soo dhoweynta Muqdisho waxay sidoo kale ku soo aadeysaa iyadoo Soomaaliya ay xiriir difaac oo xooggan la leedahay laba ka mid ah saddexda dal ee heshiiska saxiixay. Turkiga ayaa ka mid ah saaxiibada ugu waaweyn ee Soomaaliya dhinaca amniga iyo difaaca. Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa bishii February 2024 ansixiyay heshiis difaac iyo iskaashi dhaqaale oo 10 sano ah oo labada dal dhexmaray, kaas oo ay Muqdisho sheegtay inuu muhiim u yahay ilaalinta madax-bannaanida dalka iyo kheyraadkiisa badda. Ankara ayaa muddo sanado ah tababar iyo qalab siinaysay ciidamada Soomaaliya, waxayna Muqdisho ku leedahay xarunta TURKSOM oo ah mid ka mid ah xarumaha ugu waaweyn ee lagu tababaro ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale sanadkan xoojiyay xiriirkooda difaaca, kadib markii labada dowladood ay Riyadh ku saxiixdeen heshiis iskaashi militari oo lagu ballaarinayo wada-shaqeynta dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca. Muqdisho ayaa sidoo kale dhowaan muujisay taageerada ay u hayso amniga iyo xasilloonida Sacuudiga, iyadoo cambaareysay hanjabaado loo jeediyay boqortooyada. Soo dhoweynta heshiiska Makka ayaa sidaas darteed ku soo aadeysa xilli Soomaaliya ay sii xoojineyso xiriirkeeda amni iyo difaac ee dalalka muhiimka ah ee Bariga Dhexe iyo kuwa ku teedsan Badda Cas. items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), oo safar shaqo ku jooga magaalada Nairobi ee dalka Kenya, ayaa kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay wakiillada Beesha Caalamka iyo Hay’adaha Caalamiga ah ee fadhigoodu yahay Nairobi, isaga oo u soo bandhigay horumarka ay ku tallaabsatay Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, mudnaanta Qaranka iyo hiigsiga Xukuumadda ee ku aaddan xoojinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu adkeeyey in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay doonayso iskaashi iyo maalgashi ku dhisan dano-wadaag iyo wax-wada-qabsi, halkii ay ku tiirsanaan lahayd gargaar dibadeed iyo gacan-hoorsi. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu wakiillada Beesha Caalamka iyo Hay’adaha Caalamiga ah u sheegay in nabadda iyo xasilloonidu ay yihiin mudnaanta koowaad ee Xukuumaddiisa. Waxa uu tilmaamay in ka badan 6,000 oo ciidan-beeleed ah, iyaga iyo qalabkoodiiba, si nabad ah loo qarameeyey, tababarna loo furay, kaddibna lagu daray Ciidanka Qaranka Somaliland. Madaxweynuhu waxa kale oo uu xusay in shaqaaqooyinkii ka dhacay Gobolada Galbeedka lagu wajahayo wada-hadal, dib-u-heshiisiin iyo hannaanka nabadaynta iyo wada-xaajoodka ee ay bulshada Somaliland muddada dheer ku soo caano-maashay. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu Beesha Caalamka u caddeeyey in Somaliland ay ka go’an tahay in arrinta Laascaanood lagu xalliyo wada-hadal, is-afgarad iyo hannaan nabadeed oo walaaltinimo ku dhisan. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu xusay in aqoonsigii ay Dawladda Israa’iil 26-kii Diseembar 2025 ku aqoonsatay qarannimada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland uu ahaa dhacdo taariikhi ah. Waxa uu tilmaamay in aqoonsiga Israa’iil aanu ahayn dhammaadka geeddi-socodka aqoonsi-raadiska Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, balse uu qayb ka yahay xaqiijinta himilada ay shacabka Somaliland muddada dheer ku taamayeen, kuna dhisan amni iyo xasillooni, dimuqraadiyad, hay’ado dawli ah oo si dhab ah u shaqaynaya iyo talada dalka oo si nabad ah oo daah-furan la isugu wareejiyo; kuwaas oo dhammaantood saldhig u yihiin rabitaanka shacabka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Xagga horumarka, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu sheegay in Xukuumaddu mudnaan gaar ah siinayso horumarinta waddooyinka, biyaha, tamarta, caafimaadka, waxbarashada iyo isgaadhsiinta. Waxa uu tilmaamay in dalka ay ka socdaan mashaariic waddooyin istaraatiiji ah, halka hoos-u-dhigista qiimaha korontada iyo maalgashiga tamarta nadiifta ahi ay qayb muhiim ah ka yihiin dadaallada lagu dardargelinayo koboca dhaqaalaha dalka. Dhinaca kale, Madaxweynuhu waxa uu tilmaamay muhiimadda sugnaanshaha biyaha dalka, gaar ahaan sahminta iyo ka faa’iidaysiga kaydka biyaha dhulka hoostiisa ku jira, isaga oo Beesha Caalamka ugu baaqay iskaashi dhinacyada khibradda, farsamada iyo tiknoolajiyadda ah. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyey in Somaliland aanay Beesha Caalamka ula iman liis codsiyo iyo gacan-hoorsi ah, balse ay la wadaagayso natiijooyin horumarineed oo dhab ah, waxqabad la taaban karo iyo fursado iskaashi oo labada dhinacba dan u ah. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu saaxiibbada iyo bah-wadaagta caalamka ugu baaqay inay Somaliland ku qiimeeyaan xaqiiqada ka jirta dalka, waxqabadkeeda iyo hannaankeeda dawladnimo, isla markaana ay ula macaamilaan si waafaqsan xaqiiqooyinkaas, loona sii xoojiyo wax-wada-qabsi dhab ah. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku boorriyey Beesha Caalamka inay garwaaqsato xaqiiqada biyo-kama-dhibcaanka ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo doorka lama huraanka ah ee ay ku leedahay nabadda, amniga, ganacsiga iyo guud ahaan horumarka Gobolka Geeska Afrika. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu hadalkiisa ku soo afmeeray in iskaashiga Somaliland iyo Beesha Caalamku uu ku dhisnaado xaqiiqo, waxqabad, is-ixtiraam iyo dano-wadaag, si loo abuuro mustaqbal ku salaysan nabad, xasillooni, horumar iyo barwaaqo waarta oo faa’iido u leh shucuubta Gobolka Geeska Afrika.

items.title: Hay’adda sirdoonka Israel oo qaaday tallaabo lama filaan ah
items.description: Tel Aviv (Caasimada Online) – Laba sarkaal oo sare oo ka tirsanaa hay’adda sirdoonka Mossad ayaa shaqada laga eryay, kaddib markii uu fashilmay qorshe la sheegay in lagu doonayay in lagu rido dowladda Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan, sida ay baahisay warbaahinta Israa’iil. Agaasimaha cusub ee Mossad, Roman Goffman ayaa xilka ka qaaday labada sarkaal, kuwaas oo lagu tilmaamay inay ahaayeen maskaxdii ka dambeysay qorshihii fashilmay ee lagu doonayay in lagu afgambiyo xukuumadda Tehran. Telefishinka Israa’iil ee Channel 12 ayaa sheegay in mid ka mid ah saraakiisha la eryay uu hoggaaminayay waax ka tirsan Mossad tan iyo bishii Diseembar 2015, halka sarkaalkii kale uu madax ka ahaa waaxda qaabilsan arrimaha Iiraan ee hay’adda sirdoonka. Warbixinta ayaa intaas ku dartay in magacyada labada sarkaal aan la shaacin, balse ay labadooduba door muhiim ah ku lahaayeen diyaarinta qorshe hawlgal oo lagu doonayay in lagu wiiqo dowladda Iiraan. Qorshaha la sheegay ayaa ahaa mid qoran, waxaana lagu doonayay in lagu kaashado kooxaha Kurdida iyo in la dhiirrigeliyo mudaaharaadyo ballaaran oo gudaha Iiraan ka dhaca, kuwaas oo la rajeynayay inay horseedaan isbeddel siyaasadeed oo ka dhan ah dowladda hadda jirta. Warbaahinta Israa’iil ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in qorshahan uu yahay kii horey faahfaahin uga bixiyay wargeyska The New York Times, iyadoo la sheegay in qorshuhu qayb ka ahaa dadaallada Israa’iil ee lagu cadaadinayay dowladda Iiraan. Sida warbixinnadu tilmaamayaan, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa qorshahan la xiriira Iiraan u bandhigay Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump xilli uu dadaal ugu jiray inuu ku qanciyo inuu taageero tallaabo militari oo ka dhan ah Tehran bishii Maarso. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Mossad uu dhowaan yeeshay isbeddel hoggaamineed, iyadoo Roman Goffman uu xilka agaasimaha hay’adda kala wareegay David Barnea bishii Juun ee sanadkan. Warbixinnada ku saabsan xil-ka-qaadista saraakiisha Mossad iyo qorshaha la sheegay in lagu doonayay in lagu rido dowladda Iiraan ayaan weli si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin, halka hay’adda sirdoonka Israa’iil aysan si rasmi ah uga hadlin faahfaahinta arrintan. items.title: NISA oo Muqdisho ku qabatay 9 xubnood oo lagu eedeeyay Al-Shabaab
items.description: Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka Soomaaliya (NISA) ayaa sheegtay inay Muqdisho iyo nawaaxigeeda ku qabatay sagaal qof oo ay ku eedeysay inay ka tirsan yihiin Al-Shabaab, kuwaas oo sida ay hay’addu sheegtay ku howlanaa qorsheynta falal amni-darro ah. NISA ayaa sheegtay in dadka la qabtay ay si dhuumaaleysi ah ugu sugnaayeen Garasbaaley, Kaxda iyo xaafado ka tirsan Ceelasha Biyaha. Hay’addu waxay intaas ku dartay in afar ka mid ah dadka la qabtay ay ahaayeen shabakad isku xiran oo lagu eedeeyay inay qorsheynayeen falal argagixiso oo lagu waxyeelleyn lahaa shacabka, laguna qalqal gelin lahaa amniga caasimadda. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka NISA, sirdoonka ayaa muddo dabagal ku hayay dhaq-dhaqaaqyada xubnahan, waxaana ugu dambeyn lagu qabtay goobihii ay ku sugnaayeen. NISA waxay sheegtay in baaritaanno lagu wado dadka la qabtay, iyadoo markii dambe loo gudbin doono hay’adaha garsoorka si loo waafajiyo sharciga.

items.title: Cirro oo Nairobi kulan xasaasi kula yeeshay wakiillada beesha caalamka kuna wargeliyey in…
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) oo haatan ku sugan magaalada Nairobi ee dalka Kenya ayaa kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay wakiillada beesha caalamka iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah ee fadhigoodu yahay Nairobi. Sida ay baahisay Madaxtooyada Somaliland, Cirro saga ayaa wakiillada caalamiga u soo bandhigay horumarka ay ku tallaabsatay Somaliland, mudnaanta maamulka iyo hiigsiga xukuumadda ee ku aaddan xoojinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa adkeeyey in Somaliland ay doonayso iskaashi iyo maalgashi ku dhisan dano-wadaag iyo wax-wada-qabsi, halkii ay ku tiirsanaan lahayd gargaar dibadeed iyo gacan-hoorsi. Sidoo kale waxa uu wakiillada beesha caalamka iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah u sheegay in nabadda iyo xasilloonidu ay yihiin mudnaanta koowaad ee xukuumaddiisa, isafoo tilmaamay in ka badan 6,000 oo ciidan-beeleed ah, iyaga iyo qalabkoodiiba, si nabad ah loo qarameeyey, tababarna loo furay, kaddibna lagu daray ciidanka Somaliland. Madaxweynuhu waxa kale oo uu xusay in shaqaaqooyinkii ka dhacay gobolada Galbeedka lagu wajahayo wada-hadal, dib-u-heshiisiin iyo hannaanka nabadaynta iyo wada-xaajoodka ee ay bulshada Somaliland muddada dheer ku soo caano-maashay. Sidoo kale, waxa uu beesha caalamka u caddeeyey in Somaliland ay ka go’an tahay in arrinta Laascaanood lagu xalliyo wada-hadal, is-afgarad iyo hannaan nabadeed oo walaaltinimo ku dhisan. “Madaxweynuhu waxa uu xusay in aqoonsigii ay Dawladda Israa’iil 26-kii Diseembar 2025 ku aqoonsatay qarannimada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland uu ahaa dhacdo taariikhi ah,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Somaliland. Cabdiraxmaan Cirro ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in aqoonsiga Israa’iil aanu ahayn dhammaadka geeddi-socodka aqoonsi-raadiska Somaliland, balse uu qayb ka yahay xaqiijinta himilada ay shacabka Somaliland muddada dheer ku taamayeen, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Xagga horumarka, Cirro waxa uu sheegay in xukuumaddiisu mudnaan gaar ah siinayso horumarinta waddooyinka, biyaha, tamarta, caafimaadka, waxbarashada iyo isgaadhsiinta. Waxa uu tilmaamay in Somaliland ay ka socdaan mashaariic waddooyin istaraatiiji ah, halka hoos-u-dhigista qiimaha korontada iyo maalgashiga tamarta nadiifta ahi ay qayb muhiim ah ka yihiin dadaallada lagu dardargelinayo koboca dhaqaalaha dalka. Dhinaca kale, Cirro waxa uu tilmaamay muhiimadda sugnaanshaha biyaha dalka, gaar ahaan sahminta iyo ka faa’iidaysiga kaydka biyaha dhulka hoostiisa ku jira, isaga oo beesha caalamka ugu baaqay iskaashi dhinacyada khibradda, farsamada iyo tiknoolajiyadda ah. Waxa kale oo uu carrabka ku adkeeyey in Somaliland aanay beesha caalamka ula iman liis codsiyo iyo gacan-hoorsi ah, balse ay la wadaagayso natiijooyin horumarineed oo dhab ah, waxqabad la taaban karo iyo fursado iskaashi oo labada dhinacba dan u ah. Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa wakiillada caalamka ugu baaqay inay Somaliland ku qiimeeyaan xaqiiqada ka jirta dalka, waxqabadkeeda iyo hannaankeeda dawladnimo, isla markaana ay ula macaamilaan si waafaqsan xaqiiqooyinkaas, loona sii xoojiyo wax-wada-qabsi dhab ah. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku boorriyey beesha caalamka inay garwaaqsato xaqiiqada biyo-kama-dhibcaanka ah ee Somaliland iyo doorka lama huraanka ah ee ay ku leedahay nabadda, amniga, ganacsiga iyo guud ahaan horumarka Gobolka Geeska Afrika. Ugu dambeyntiina, Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa hadalkiisa ku soo afmeeray in iskaashiga Somaliland iyo beesha caalamku uu ku dhisnaado xaqiiqo, waxqabad, is-ixtiraam iyo dano-wadaag, si loo abuuro mustaqbal ku salaysan nabad, xasillooni, horumar iyo barwaaqo waarta oo faa’iido u leh shucuubta gobolka Geeska Afrika. items.title: Puntland Cabinet Orders Legal Action Against Alleged Security Threats, Moves to Tighten Control Over Security and Media
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — The Puntland Cabinet has ordered that the names of politicians, security officials and other individuals accused of involvement in activities aimed at undermining security and the state’s governing institutions be referred to the justice authorities for legal action. The decision, announced following a Cabinet meeting, signals a tougher stance by the Puntland administration toward individuals it believes are involved in efforts to destabilize the region or disrupt its constitutional and institutional order. The Cabinet directed that the allegations against the named individuals be handled through the appropriate legal and judicial channels, with those accused to be brought before the law. Restrictions on Unauthorized Forces and Social Media In a separate security directive, the Cabinet ordered all security institutions to prevent military personnel and vehicles that are not part of officially recognized security agencies from operating or moving freely within Puntland territory. The directive appears aimed at tightening control over armed formations and preventing unauthorized military movements, amid broader concerns over security coordination and competing chains of command. The Cabinet emphasized that security operations and the movement of armed personnel must remain under the authority of officially established state security institutions. The Puntland government also turned its attention to social media, ordering that legal measures be taken against owners and users of platforms who publish what authorities describe as false information intended to damage the reputation of Puntland’s governing institutions. The decision could further intensify debate over the balance between combating misinformation and protecting freedom of expression, particularly as social media has become an increasingly influential platform for political debate and public criticism. The Cabinet called on media organizations and journalists operating in Puntland to comply with the Puntland media laws and uphold professional and ethical standards. Authorities stressed that journalists and media outlets have a responsibility to observe established regulations and professional standards in their reporting. The Cabinet also instructed Puntland security forces to intensify efforts against organized crimes at sea, including piracy and illegal fishing. Security forces were directed to take action against individuals and groups involved in organized maritime criminal activities and to respond to any violations of Puntland’s territorial waters. The order reflects Puntland’s continued concern over the security and protection of its extensive coastline, particularly in relation to illegal fishing, maritime crime and unauthorized activities in its waters. Taken together, the Cabinet’s decisions represent a broad security and governance push focused on controlling unauthorized armed movements, pursuing individuals accused of destabilizing the state, regulating information considered harmful to public order, and strengthening maritime security. The measures also place renewed emphasis on the role of Puntland’s formal institutions in maintaining security and political stability. The government is now expected to translate the Cabinet’s directives into concrete legal and security measures, with particular attention likely to fall on how the authorities handle the cases referred to the justice system and how the new restrictions on unauthorized forces and social-media activity are enforced. The effectiveness of the measures—and whether they strengthen stability without further deepening political tensions—will ultimately depend on their implementation within the framework of Puntland’s laws and judicial institutions. items.title: Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan oo kala saxiixday heshiis difaac oo wadajir ah (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Dalalka Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ayaa maanta kala saxiixday heshiis difaac oo saddex geesood ah, ka dib kulan ka dhacay Magaalada Makka. Heshiiska difaaca wadajirka ayaa dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsan doono weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Kulanka ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay Dhaxal-sugaha Boqortooyada ahna Raysal Wasaaraha Sacuudiga, Mohammed bin Salman, Madaxweynaha Turkiga, Recep Tayyip Erdogan iyo Raysal Wasaaraha Pakistan, Shehbaz Sharif. Heshiiskan ayaa ku soo aadaya, xilli Bariga Dhexe ay ka taagan tahay xiisad u dhexeyso Mareykanka iyo Iran, isla-markaana si weyn u saameysay Dowladaha Khaliijka Carabta. Heshiiska ayaa waxa kaloo uu imanaya, iyadoo dhawaan ay gobolka ka soo korortay xiisad cusub oo Sacuudiga kala dhexeysa Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Xiisadaha gobolka ayaa cawaaqib ku yeeshay dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga ee ka gudbaya Marinka Hormuz iyo marin biyoodka dhinaca kale ku yaala ee Bab El-Mandeb. Dhaqaalaha Sacuudiga ayaa halis galay, ka dib markii Xuutiyiinta ay 20-kii bishii July ku dhawaaqeen go’aan ay maraakiibta Sacuudiga uga mamnuucayaan inay adeegsadaan Marinka Bab El-Mandeb ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Hubanti la’aanta ku gadaaman taageerada difaaca Mareykanka ayaa Sacuudiga ku riixday in uu raadsado iskaashi ka madaxbannaan midkii asalka ahaa. Sacuudiga iyo Mareykanka ayaa tobanaan sano lahaa iskaashi dhanka difaaca iyo amniga. Washington ayaa ku guuldareysatay in ay difaacdo xulafadeeda xilliga adag. Heshiiska Makka ayaa muujinaya in Riyadh ay dooneyso inay yareyso ku tiirsanaanta hubka iyo difaaca Mareykanka, oo macnaheedu yahay in Boqortooyada Sacuudiga aysan rabin in dal qura ku haleyso amnigeeda iyo xasilloonideeda Gacanka Khaliijka. Heshiiska wadajirka ah ee Jimcahan lagu saxiixay Magaalada Makka oo loogu magac-daray (Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makka ama Mecca Joint Defence Agreement) ayaa mideynaya awoodda saddex dal oo waaweyn. Sacuudiga ayaa ah dalka ugu weyn ee shidaalka dhoofiya, iyadoo Turkiga uu yahay dalka labaad ee leh ciidaamada ugu badan ee NATO iyo Pakistan oo iyana ah dalka keliya ee Muslim ah ee haysta hubka nuclear-ka.

items.title: Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan Set to Sign Landmark Defense Pact in Jeddah
items.description: Jeddah (WDN) — Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan are expected to sign a trilateral agreement in Jeddah on Friday aimed at deepening cooperation in defense, security and military affairs, according to informed regional sources cited by Reuters. The agreement, if signed as expected, could mark a significant expansion of strategic cooperation among three influential Muslim-majority states at a time of mounting security tensions across the Middle East and South Asia. A senior Turkish government official has confirmed that an agreement is due to be signed, although its detailed provisions have not yet been publicly disclosed. Diplomatic sources say the pact is expected to cover military cooperation, intelligence sharing, joint training, defense-industrial development and cooperation in military technology. According to Reuters, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Pakistan’s army chief, Field Marshal Asim Munir, are expected to meet Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman in Jeddah, where the leaders are expected to formally sign the agreement. A Strategic Partnership Takes Shape The proposed pact comes as all three countries seek to strengthen their defense capabilities and reduce vulnerabilities in an increasingly unpredictable regional security environment. Turkey has rapidly expanded its domestic defense industry in recent years, emerging as a major producer of drones, armored vehicles, naval platforms and other advanced military systems. Its defense exports and technological capabilities have also increased Ankara’s strategic influence beyond its immediate neighborhood. Saudi Arabia, meanwhile, is pursuing an ambitious effort to reduce its dependence on imported weapons by developing domestic defense manufacturing and attracting foreign investment and technology partnerships. Pakistan brings extensive military experience and an established defense industry, as well as a unique strategic position as the only Muslim-majority nuclear-armed state. Together, the three countries possess complementary military, technological and financial capabilities that could give the proposed partnership considerable strategic weight. The agreement comes against the backdrop of rapidly changing security dynamics in the Middle East. Recent hostilities involving Iran and Israel have underscored vulnerabilities across the Gulf and raised concerns about the security of critical trade and energy routes. The Strait of Hormuz remains particularly sensitive. Any prolonged disruption in the waterway could have significant consequences for global energy markets because of its importance to international oil and gas shipments. The changing security environment has increased pressure on regional powers to strengthen their ability to respond to missile attacks, drone strikes, terrorism and threats to maritime trade. Sources familiar with the negotiations say discussions on the proposed agreement have continued for nearly a year as the three governments worked to establish a more permanent framework for defense and security cooperation. The agreement is expected to provide mechanisms for joint military planning, training exercises, counterterrorism cooperation, maritime security and the development of military capabilities and technologies. If implemented, the framework could allow the three countries to coordinate more closely in responding to emerging security threats while expanding opportunities for defense-industry cooperation. Security analysts say the agreement could significantly strengthen the regional roles of Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan and give the three countries a broader platform for coordinated responses to emerging threats. Those threats include terrorism, missile and drone attacks, maritime insecurity and disruptions to critical trade and energy corridors. The pact could also have implications beyond bilateral defense cooperation, potentially contributing to a broader effort among Muslim-majority countries to develop greater strategic autonomy in defense and security. items.title: Somalia welcomes Saudi, Turkiye and Pakistan defence pact
items.description: Regional countries on Friday welcomed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement signed by Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan, describing it as a step toward strengthening collective security, defense cooperation and regional stability. Somalia described the agreement as a historic step toward strengthening collective security and defense cooperation. In a statement, the Defense Ministry said the agreement establishes a strategic partnership capable of addressing shared security challenges while advancing long-term defense cooperation among the three countries. The ministry said it was confident the pact would make a significant contribution to enhancing regional peace and stability and reinforce the principles of cooperation, solidarity and shared responsibility. It added that the agreement would serve the interests of the peoples of the region while supporting international peace and security. Bahrain called the development a strategic partnership that would strengthen deterrence and contribute to regional and international security and stability. The Foreign Ministry highlighted the countries’ established defense capabilities, extensive military experience and longstanding roles in promoting regional security and stability. It said the agreement represents a strategic partnership among equal partners, with each contributing its capabilities toward preserving regional and global security. According to the ministry, the pact complements the Gulf Cooperation Council’s collective defense system, enhances its effectiveness and reinforces regional security through solidarity, integration and partnership among brotherly countries. The ministry reiterated that Saudi Arabia’s security is an integral part of Bahrain’s own security, and affirmed support for efforts to safeguard regional stability, protect the sovereignty and territorial integrity of states and advance political solutions to regional issues. The historic agreement was signed on Friday at a summit in the Muslim holy city of Mecca attended by Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif. The agreement says that “any armed attack against any one of the three states shall be regarded as an attack against them all.” Anadolu.

items.title: Hay’adda Sirdoonka Israa’iil oo tallaabo lama filaan ah qaaday
items.description: Hay’adda Sirdoonka Israa’iil oo tallaabo lama filaan ah qaaday Warbaahinta Israa’iil ayaa sheegtay in laba sarkaal oo sare oo ka tirsan Mossad shaqada laga eryay, kadib “qorshe fashilmay oo lagu doonayay in lagu afgambiyo Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan.” Sida ay sheegayaan warbixinnada warbaahinta Israa’iil, Agaasimaha Mossad, Roman Goffman, ayaa shaqada ka eryay laba ka mid ah saraakiisha ugu sarreysa hay’adda sirdoonka, kuwaas oo lagu tilmaamay inay ahaayeen “maskaxdii ka dambeysay qorshihii fashilmay ee lagu doonayay in lagu rido dowladda Iiraan.” Telefishinka Israa’iil ee Channel 12 ayaa sheegay in mid ka mid ah labada sarkaal uu ahaa madaxa hay’adda sirdoonka Mossad tan iyo bishii Diseembar 2015, halka kan kalena uu ahaa madaxa waaxda Iiraan ee hay’adda sirdoonka. Magacyada labada sarkaal laguma sheegin warbixinta telefishinka. Sida warbixintu sheegtay, labada sarkaal ee la eryay waxay ahaayeen “qorsheeyayaashii qorshe hawlgal oo qoran” oo lagu doonayay in lagu rido Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan, iyadoo la kaashanayo kooxaha Kurdida iyo kicinta mudaaharaadyo ballaaran. Qorshahan ayaa ahaa isla kii ay hore faahfaahin uga bixisay wargeyska New York Times. Waxaa la sheegay in Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu uu isla qorshahan u bandhigay Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump intii uu ku guda jiray dadaalladiisa uu ku doonayay inuu ku qanciyo Trump inuu weeraro Iiraan bishii Maarso. Madaxa Mossad xilligaas wuxuu ahaa David Barnea, kaas oo bishii Juun ee sanadkan lagu beddelay Roman Goffman. Bbc somali

items.title: Dawladda Muqdisho oo taageertay heshiiska ay kala saxeexdeen Sucuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa war ka soo saartay heshiiska difaac ee wadajirka ah ee maanta kala saxiixdeen dalalka Sacuuudi Carabiya, Turkeyga iyo Pakistan. Heshiisku wuxuu dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsan doono inuu yahay weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. War qoraal ah oo ka soo baxay wasaaradda gaashaandhigga ee Soomaaliya ayaa lagu hambalyeey heshiiska dalalka Muslimka ah ay wada saxiixdeen “Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay hambalyo u diraysaa Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga, iyo Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Pakistan munaasabadda saxiixa “Heshiiska Makka ee Difaaca Wadajirka ah”, Soomaaliya waxay heshiiska ku tilmaamtay tallaabo taariikhi ah oo muhiim u ah xoojinta amniga wadajirka ah, horumarinta iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca, iyo dhisidda iskaashi istiraatiiji ah oo wax ku ool ah si wax looga qabto caqabadaha amni ee ay wadaagaan. Wasaaradd gaashaandhiga ayaa qoraalkeeda ku sheegtay inay xaqiijinayso in heshiiskani uu gacan ka geysan doono taageeridda dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka iyo caalamka, isla markaana uu kobcin doono mabaadi’da iskaashiga, isku duubnida iyo mas’uuliyadda wadajirka ah, isagoo u adeegaya danaha shucuubta gobolka isla markaana taageeraya dadaallada lagu dhisayo nabad iyo amni.

items.title: Sacuudi Carabiya, Pakistan iyo Turkiga oo kala saxiixday heshiis difaac oo weyn
items.description: Islamabad (Caasimada Online) – Pakistan, Sacuudiga iyo Turkiga ayaa maanta kala saxiixday heshiis wadajir ah oo dhinaca difaaca ah, kaas oo dhigaya “in weerar lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsan doono weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood,” xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha ka taagan Bariga Dhexe. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan, Shehbaz Sharif, Dhaxal-sugaha Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, Maxamed Bin Salmaan iyo Madaxweynaha Turkiga, Recep Tayyip Erdogan ayaa heshiiska oo loo bixiyay “Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makkah” ku kala saxiixday kulan ka dhacay Qasriga Al-Safa ee magaalada Makkah, sida lagu sheegay bayaan wadajir ah oo ay soo saareen saddexda dowladood. Bayaanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in heshiisku uu dhigayo “xoojinta dhammaan dhinacyada iskaashiga difaaca ee u dhexeeya saddexda dowladood.” Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo beegmeysa xilli colaadda Bariga Dhexe ay ku sii fidayso dhowr jiho, oo ay ku jiraan Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Baab al-Mandab, taas oo dalalka Khaliijka ku riixeysa inay xoojiyaan iskaashiga amniga gobolka. Ra’iisul Wasaare Sharif ayaa bishii April booqday Sacuudiga, isagoo kulamo la yeeshay madaxda sare ee boqortooyada. Toddobaadkii lasoo dhaafay, Sacuudiga ayaa soo jeediyay sameynta Isbahaysiga Difaaca Badaha ee Caalamiga ah (MMDC), kaas oo looga gol leeyahay ilaalinta marinnada ganacsiga iyo waddooyinka muhiimka u ah sahayda tamarta ee mara Badda Cas iyo Baab al-Mandab, kadib markii maraakiib Sacuudiyaan ah ay weerareen Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee Iran taageerto. Warbixino soo baxaya ayaa sheegay in 14 dal, oo uu Pakistan ku jiro ay taageereen hindisahaasi, taas oo muujineysa walaaca sii kordhaya ee laga qabo amniga mid ka mid ah marinnada badeed ee ugu muhiimsan caalamka. Sidoo kale, Pakistan ayaa toddobaadkii hore sheegtay inay “dadaal kasta oo ay awooddo” ku bixinayso sidii Mareykanka iyo Iran dib loogu celin lahaa miiska wada-hadallada, iyadoo taas lagu saleynayo is-afgaradkii Islamabad ee la saxiixay 18-kii June. Bayaanka wadajirka ah ayaa sheegay in heshiiska Makkah uu muujinayo “ka go’naanshaha saddexda dowladood ee xoojinta amnigooda wadajirka ah iyo horumarinta nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka iyo meelaha ka baxsan, si loo gaaro mustaqbal ammaan iyo barwaaqo leh.” Bishii September ee sanadkii hore, Pakistan iyo Sacuudiga ayaa kala saxiixday “Heshiiska Istiraatiijiga ah ee Difaaca Is-dhaafka ah,” kaas oo labada dhinac ay ku ballanqaadeen in weerar lagu qaado midkood loo aqoonsan doono “fal gardarro ah oo lagu qaaday labada dal.” Heshiiskaasi ayaa horseeday in Pakistan ay ciidamo iyo diyaarado militari u dirto Sacuudiga, si ay uga qeyb qaataan tababarrada wadajirka ah, iskaashiga difaaca iyo taageerada amniga boqortooyada. Bayaanka ayaa intaas ku daray in heshiiska Makkah uu ku saleysan yahay xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee muddada dheer soo jiray ee saddexda dal, iyo xiriirka walaaltinimo iyo isku duubnida Islaamiga ah ee mideeya, iyadoo sidoo kale laga duulayo danaha istiraatiijiga ah ee ay wadaagaan iyo iskaashigooda difaaca ee soo jireenka ah. Kulankii Jimcihii, saddexda dhinac waxay dib u eegeen xiriirkooda, waxayna ka wada-hadleen arrimo dhowr ah oo dan u ah dhammaan dhinacyada. Kahor shirkan, Ra’iisul Wasaare Sharif iyo Taliyaha Ciidamada Difaaca Pakistan, Field Marshal Asim Munir oo Khamiistii gaaray Sacuudiga booqasho rasmi ah oo saddex maalmood ah ayaa kulan la yeeshay Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, sida lagu sheegay war kasoo baxay xafiiska ra’iisul wasaaraha Pakistan. Sharif waxaa sidoo kale safarka ku wehliyay Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka ahna Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda, Ishaq Dar, Wasiirka Difaaca Khawaja Asif iyo masuuliyiin kale. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Pakistan ayaa Khamiistii sheegtay in inkastoo booqashadu ku soo beegmeyso xilli ay sare u kacayaan xiisadaha gobolka Khaliijka, haddana ay leedahay muhiimad ka baxsan “xiisadda degdegga ah iyo tixgelinnada muddada gaaban.” Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in booqashadu sii xoojin doonto xiriirka labada dal, qoto dheereyn doonto iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah, kor u qaadi doonto isku-duwidda arrimaha gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah ee ay danaha ka leeyihiin, isla markaana xoojin doonto iskaashiga dhinacyada badan. items.description: Mogadishu — Somalia's Ministry of Defence has welcomed the signing of the Mecca Agreement for Joint Defense by Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan, describing the pact as a significant milestone in strengthening regional defence cooperation and collective security.

items.title: Sucuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan oo kala saxiixday heshiis difaac oo taariikhi ah
items.description: Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ayaa magaalada Makka ku kala saxiixday heshiis cusub oo iskaashi difaac ah, kaas oo dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsan doono weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Heshiiskan oo loogu magac daray “Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makka” ayaa yimid xilli xiisadaha militari iyo colaadaha Bariga Dhexe ay sare u sii kacayaan. Saddexda dal ayaa sheegay in heshiisku yahay mid lagu xoojinayo amniga wadajirka ah, nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Heshiiska waxaa magaalada Makka ku kala saxiixday Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif, iyo Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Mohammed bin Salman. Pakistan ayaa heshiiskan ku soo kordhinaysa ciidan khibrad leh iyo awood milatari oo ay ku jirto hubka nukliyeerka, halka Turkigu leeyahay awood weyn oo dhinaca diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, hubka casriga ah iyo warshadaha difaaca ah. Sacuudigana wuxuu leeyahay awood dhaqaale oo ballaaran iyo muhiimad istiraatiiji ah oo gobolka ah. Heshiiskan ayaa sidoo kale sii xoojinaya xiriirkii milatari ee hore uga dhexeeyay saddexda waddan, iyadoo Pakistan muddo dheer tababar iyo taageero farsamo siinaysay ciidamada Sacuudiga, halka Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay leeyihiin iskaashi dhinaca maraakiibta dagaalka, diyaaradaha iyo qalabka difaaca. Inkasta oo heshiisku si rasmi ah loogu sheegay inuu yahay mid difaac, haddana waxaa loo arkaa tallaabo wax ka beddeli karta qaab-dhismeedka amniga Bariga Dhexe, iyadoo saddexda dal ay doonayaan inay si wadajir ah uga jawaabaan khataraha amni ee gobolka. Heshiiskan ayaa sidoo kale noqon kara bilowga iskaashi ballaaran oo dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, siyaasadda iyo amniga ah, iyadoo saddexda dal ay doonayaan inay yeeshaan awood wadajir ah oo ka hortagta khataraha mustaqbalka.

items.title: Diidmo laga muujiyay in Digil iyo Mirifle kaliya loo asteeyo kursiga guddoomiyaha BF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Arlaadi ayaa si adag uga soo horjeestay in xilka Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya loo asteeyo beesha Digil iyo Mirifle, taas oo haatan doorashadiisa la qabanayo 10-ka August 2026. Golaha Arlaadi ayaa diiday isku day kasta oo lagu doonayo in xilka Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya loo asteeyo beesha Digil iyo Mirifle, isagoo sheegay in arrintaasi ay ka hor imaanayso himilooyinka siyaasadeed iyo xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee beesha. War-saxaafadeedka Arlaadi ayaa lagu sheegay in masiirka siyaasadeed ee Digil iyo Mirifle aanu ku koobnayn hal xil oo qaran, balse beeshu ay xaq u leedahay inay si siman ugu tartanto dhammaan jagooyinka ugu sarreeya dalka, sida Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha iyo xilalka kale ee dowladda federaalka. “Masiirka siyaasadeed ee Digil & Mirifle laguma koobi karo mana aha in lagu koobo hal xil oo keliya,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in qof kasta oo aqbala xilka Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka isaga oo u arka saamiga siyaasadeed ee ugu dambeeya ee beesha, uu dhaawacayo halgankii dheeraa ee loo soo galay matalaad siman iyo ka-qaybgal buuxa oo siyaasadeed. “Qof kasta oo xilkaas ku aqbala magaca beesha isagoo beddel uga dhigaya himilooyinka qaran ee ballaaran ee beesha, inuu yahay jebin culus oo lagu sameeyey kasoonidii ay shacabka u dhiibteen, khiyaano loo geystay halgankii dheeraa ee beesha ugu jirtay matalaad siman.” Arrintan ayuu goluhu ku tilmaamay mid wiiqi karta dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo sinnaanta siyaasadeed ee dalka. Bayaankan waxaa soo saaray Golaha Arlaadi, waxaana saxiixay xubno ay ka mid yihiin: Prof. Abdi Mohamed Kusow, Prof. Mohamed Haji Mukhtar iyo xubo kale oo golaha ka tirsan. Hoos ka aqriso war-saxaafadeedka oo dhameystiran Bayaan Deg-deg ah oo Looga Soo Horjeedo in Guddoomiyeha Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya Loo Astaaysto Beesha Digil & Mirifle Golaha Arlaadi wuxuu si cad oo aan mugdi ku jirin u caddaynayaa in qof kasta oo u tartama ama aqbala xilka Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya isagoo beddel uga dhigaya xuquuqda qaran, sinnaanta siyaasadeed, iyo himilooyinka sharciga ah ee beesha Digil & Mirifle, uu si toos ah uga hor imanayo aragtida guud, halgankii taariikhiga ahaa, iyo mabaadii’da asaaska ah ee ay beelshu ku dhisan tahay. Masiirka siyaasadeed ee Digil & Mirifle laguma koobi karo mana aha in lagu koobo hal xil oo keliya. Dalabkan beelshu mar walba wuxuu ahaa in ay hesho fursad siman oo ay ku gaari karto dhammaan jagoyinka fulinta ee ugu sarreeya Qaranka Soomaaliyeed, oo ay ku jiraan Madaxtinimada Jamhuuriyadda, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, iyo dhammaan xilalka kale ee sare ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, si waafaqsan mabaadii’da sinnaanta, xuquuqda dastuuriga ah, iyo ka-qaybgal buuxa oo ku salaysan maamul dalka. Sidaas darteed, Golaha Arlaadi wuxuu u arkaa isku day kasta oo lagu sheegay in xilka Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka yahay saamiga siyaasadeed ee ugu dambeeya ee beesha Digil & Mirifle, ama qof kasta oo xilkaas ku aqbala magaca beesha isagoo beddel uga dhigaya himilooyinka qaran ee ballaaran ee beesha, inuu yahay jebin culus oo lagu sameeyey kasoonidii ay shacabka u dhiibteen, khiyaano loo geystay halgankii dheeraa ee beesha ugu jirtay matalaad siman, iyo dib-u-dhac ku yimaada raadinta sinnaanta siyaasadeed ee dhabta ah gudahа Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Waxaa soo saaray Golaha Arlaadi: Xubnaha Golaha Arlaadi Prof. Mohamed Haji Mukhtar Prof. Abdi Mohamed Kusow Dir. Ali Scego Mr. Nur Malak Mr. Ibrahim Moalim Eng. Nuradin Tanaas Dir. items.title: Baanka Somaliland iyo Baanka Adduunka oo si wada jir ahnu shaaciyay
items.description: Baanka Somaliland iyo Baanka Adduunka (The World Bank) oo si wadajir ah u shaaciyey dhaqangelinta Mashruuca SPRING. Guddoomiyaha Baanka Somaliland Mudane Cabdinaasir Axmed Xirsi iyo wafdi ka socda Baanka Adduunka (The World Bank) oo ay hogaaminayeen Mr. Sameer Goyal kuna wehelinaysay Binu Malhotra ayaa si wadajir ah ugu dhawaaqay dhaqangelinta Mashruuca SPRING, kaasi oo Baanka Adduunku ku taageerayo Baanka Somaliland si loo dardargeliyo qorshayaasha casriyeynta iyo horumarinta Baanka Somaliland. Kullanka shaacinta mashruuca waxaa goob joog ka ahaa Guddoomiye ku xigeenka baanka Somaliland Mudane Hamse Cabdiraxmaan Khayre, Agaasimaha Guud ee baanka Mudane Yaasin Jaamac Axmed, Xidhiidhiyaha mashruuca SPRING mudane Maxamuud Cumar Xuseen iyo saraakiil ka tirsan Baanka Somaliland. Mashruuca SPRING oo ah mashruuc uu maalgelinayo Baanka Adduunku, ayaa ujeeddadiisu tahay in la xoojiyo koboca dhaqaalaha, horumarinta ganacsiga gaarka loo leeyahay, iyo adkaynta nidaamyada maaliyadeed ee Somaliland. Mashruucan ayaa door muhiim ah ka qaadan doonaa hirgelinta dib-u-habaynta (Reforms-ka) ka socda Baanka Somaliland isaga oo gacan ka geysan doona dhismaha Bangi Dhexe oo casri ah, isla markaana la jaanqaadaya heerarka iyo habraacyada caalamiga ah. Mashruucu waxa uu si gaar ah diiradda u saari doonaa horumarinta shuruucda iyo siyaasadaha maaliyadeed, tiknoolajiyadda, iyo kor u qaadidda helitaanka adeegyada maaliyadeed (Financial inclusion). Guddoomiyaha Baanka Somaliland ayaa uga mahadceliyey Baanka Adduunka (The World Bank) taageerada joogtada ah iyo iskaashiga dhow ee uu la leeyahay Baanka Somaliland, isaga oo xusay in Mashruuca SPRING uu kaalin muuqata ka qaadan doono horumarinta, casriyeynta iyo xoojinta awoodda Baanka Somaliland, taasi oo saldhig u noqon doonta horumarinta iyo adkaynta nidaamka maaliyadeed ee dalka.

items.title: Cabsi xooggan oo soo wajahday Soomaalida ku ganacsata…
items.description: Capetown (Caasimada Online) – Cabsida dhinaca nafta iyo hantida ah ee Soomaalida ku nool Koonfur Afrika ayaa sii kordheysa, kaddib markii mid ka mid ah goobaha ganacsi ee ay leeyihiin muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed lagu boobay rabshado ay sameynayeen dad dibadbaxayaal ah oo ka cabanaya joogitaanka ajaanibta dalkaas. Muuqaallo lagu baahiyay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinaya dad gudaha u galay goob ganacsi oo ay Soomaali leedahay, kadibna boobaya badeecooyin iyo hanti kale. Wararka ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in ciidamada ammaanka aysan tallaabo muuqata ka qaadin dadka ku lugta lahaa dhacdada. Deegaannada Inanda iyo KwaMashu ee duleedka magaalada Durban, gobolka KwaZulu-Natal ayaa kamid ah meelaha ay sida weyn uga taagan tahay cabsida laga qabo rabshadaha. Ganacsato Soomaali ah ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inay albaabada u xireen dukaamadooda, iyagoo isku dayaya inay ilaashadaan naftooda iyo hantidooda. Rabshadaha ka socda Koonfur Afrika ayaa mararka qaar isku beddela weerarro lagu beegsanayo ajaanibta, iyadoo Soomaalida ay kamid yihiin dadka sida weyn uga dhex muuqda ganacsiga yaryar iyo kuwa dhexdhexaadka ah ee dalkaas. Xaaladda ayaa sidoo kale walaac ka abuurtay ururrada iyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee ku nool Koonfur Afrika, kuwaas oo ka cabsi qaba in rabshaduhu ku fidaan deegaanno kale, isla markaana ay halis geliyaan nolosha iyo hantida muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed. Midowga Afrika ayaa dhowaan ugu baaqay dowladda Koonfur Afrika inay qaaddo tallaabooyin sharci iyo kuwo amni oo lagu ilaalinayo nolosha iyo hantida ajaanibta Afrikaanka ah, xilli ay soo noqnoqdeen dhacdooyinka la xiriira rabshadaha iyo nacaybka ajaanibta. Dibadbaxyada iyo rabshadaha ka dhaca qaybo ka mid ah Koonfur Afrika ayaa xilliyada qaar isu beddela dhacdooyin lagu beegsado ajaanibta iyo goobahooda ganacsi, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka lagu eedeeyo inay ku guuldarreysteen ama ka gaabiyeen ka hortagga boobka iyo weerarrada. xaaladda ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca Soomaalida ku nool dalkaas, gaar ahaan ganacsatada ku sugan meelaha ay rabshaduhu ka socdaan. Midowga Afrika ayaa dhowaan ugu baaqay dowladda Koonfur Afrika inay qaaddo tallaabooyin sharci iyo kuwo amni oo lagu ilaalinayo nolosha iyo hantida ajaanibta Afrikaanka ah, xilli ay soo noqnoqdeen dhacdooyinka la xiriira rabshadaha iyo nacaybka ajaanibta. Dibadbaxyada iyo rabshadaha ka dhaca qaybo ka mid ah Koonfur Afrika ayaa xilliyada qaar isu beddela dhacdooyin lagu beegsado ajaanibta iyo goobahooda ganacsi, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka lagu eedeeyo inay ku guuldarreysteen ama ka gaabiyeen ka hortagga boobka iyo weerarrada. xaaladda ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca Soomaalida ku nool dalkaas, gaar ahaan ganacsatada ku sugan meelaha ay rabshaduhu ka socdaan. items.title: DF oo saxiixday mashruuc laga hirgelinayo gudaha Hargeysa
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa saxiixday mashruuc lagu dhisayo waddo dhererkeedu gaarayo 45KM oo laga hirgelinayo magaalada Hargeysa ee maamulka Somaliland. Waddadan ayaa qeyb ka ah mashaariic horumarineed oo dowladda sheegtay inay gaarsiinayso gobollada dalka. Heshiiska mashruucan ayaa maanta lagu saxiixay magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoo Wasiirka Howlaha Guud, Dib-u-dhiska iyo Guriyeynta Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Ayuub Ismaaciil, uu sheegay in mashruucu qeyb ka yahay qorshayaasha lagu horumarinayo kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha dalka. Wasiir Ayuub Ismaaciil oo warbaahinta kula hadlay Muqdisho xilli uu saxiixayay heshiiska ayaa bogaadiyay mashaariicda dib-u-dhiska, isagoo sheegay inay muhiim u yihiin horumarinta isku socodka dadka iyo gaadiidka iyo kobcinta dhaqaalaha. Wuxuu tilmaamay in dowladda ay qorsheyneyso in howlaha dib-u-dhiska iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha la gaarsiiyo guud ahaan gobollada dalka, iyadoo mudnaan la siinayo dhismaha waddooyinka, buundooyinka iyo biyo-mareennada casriga ah. “Waxaan dooneynaa in howlaha dib-u-dhiska iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha ay gaaraan guud ahaan gobollada dalka, iyadoo la dhisayo waddooyin, buundooyin iyo biyo-mareenno casri ah,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Ayuub. Sida uu sheegay Wasiirka Howlaha Guud, mashaariicdan waxaa qeyb ka ah maalgelin iyo taageero lagu horumarinayo kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, iyadoo dowladda ay dooneyso in faa’iidooyinka mashaariicdu gaaraan deegaanno kala duwan oo dalka ah. Wasiir Ayuub Ismaaciil ayaa sheegay in guud ahaan lacagta ku baxaysa mashaariicda kala duwan ee dib-u-dhiska iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha ay gaareyso $245 milyan oo doollar, iyadoo dowladda ay sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto qorshayaasha lagu horumarinayo waddooyinka, buundooyinka iyo adeegyada kale ee muhiimka u ah isku socodka iyo horumarka dalka. items.title: Madaxweynaha Jubbaland oo la kulmay Saraakiisha Mareykanka ee SOCAF (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jubbaland, Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe) ayaa la kulmay Taliyaha Hawlgalada Gaarka Mareykanka ee Afrika (SOCAF/SOCAFRICA), General Claude K. Tudor iyo Saraakiil kale. Madaxtooyada Jubbaland ayaa maanta sheegtay in kulanka looga hadlay dardargelinta hawlgalada lagu xoreynayo deegaanada Jubbaland iyo xoojinta iskaashiga labada dhinac ee lagu ciribtirayo argagixisada. “Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray dardargelinta hawlgalada lagu xoreynayo deegaanada Jubbaland iyo xoojinta iskaashiga laba geesoodka ah ee lagu ciribtirayo argagixisada.” Ayaa lagu yiri war qoraal ah oo ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Madaxweynaha waxaa kulanka ku wehliyay Agaasimaha Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabad Sugidda Jubbaland, Mudane Maxamed Axmed Sabriye.” Warka ayaan lagu sheegin goobta uu kulanka ka dhacay iyo haddii Saraakiisha Mareykanka ay booqasho ku taggeen Magaalada Kismaayo. Taliska SOCAF ama SOCAFRICA ayaa ah talis hoosaadka USSOCOM, kaas oo hoostaga Taliska Ciidamada Mareykanka ee Qaaradda Afrika (AFRICOM), waxa uuna Taliska SOCAF qabtaa noocyada kala duwan ee hawlgalada, wuxuuna dhisaa taatikada iyo hawlgalka ka hortagga ururada xagjirka ah iyo rabshadaha, iyadoo dalalka iskaashiga la leh Mareykanka laga caawinayo horumarinta qaab dhismeedka amniga, si loo la dagaalamo khataraha qaaradda, loona abuuro xasillooni. Saraakiisha SOCAF ayaa waxay xoogga saaraan dhisidda awoodda amniga, la dagaanka argagixisada iyo la shaqaynta dalalka saaxiibada Mareykanka ee qaaradda.

items.title: Qiimaha shidaalka oo Kor u Kacay, iyadoo Walaac Laga Qabo Mustaqbalka Marin-biyoodka Hormuz
items.description: Qiimaha saliidda ceeriin ee caalamka ayaa sare u kacay Jimcihii, iyadoo suuqyada tamarta ay si dhow ula socdaan qorsheyaal cusub oo ay Iiraan soo bandhigtay oo ku saabsan maamulka maraakiibta isticmaasha marin-biyoodka istaraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz. Qiimaha Brent Crude ayaa kor u kacay ku dhowaad 0.9%, isagoo gaaray $83.24 halkii foosto, halka West Texas Intermediate (WTI) uu kordhay 0.5%, isagoo gaaray $77.71 halkii foosto. Kororka qiimaha ayaa yimid kadib markii Iiraan ay dib u eegis ku billowday hindise sharciyeed lagu mamnuucayo maraakiibta Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil inay maraan marin-biyoodka Hormuz, isla markaana la soo jeediyay in maraakiibta kale laga qaado lacag u dhexeysa 5% ilaa 7% qiimaha shixnadaha ay sidaan. Dhanka kale, Cumaan ayaa la sheegay inay soo jeedisay khidmad qiyaastii 3%, halka Mareykanku uu doonayo in aan wax lacag ah laga qaadin maraakiibta. Marin-biyoodka Hormuz ayaa ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga tamarta dunida, waxaana caadi ahaan mara ku dhowaad shan meelood meel (20%) saliidda iyo gaaska dabiiciga ah ee dareeraha ah (LNG) ee dunida la dhoofiyo. Sidaas darteed, isbeddel kasta oo ku yimaadda habka loo maamulayo marin-biyoodkan wuxuu si toos ah u saameeyaa suuqyada caalamiga ah. Khubarada tamarta ayaa sheegay in sare u kaca qiimaha uu muujinayo in suuqyadu ay weli ka walaacsan yihiin xiisadda u dhexeysa Iiraan iyo Mareykanka, isla markaana aysan weli muuqan xal buuxa oo dib loogu soo celinayo isu-socodkii caadiga ahaa ee maraakiibta. Waxaa sidoo kale jira caqabado sharci iyo dhaqaale oo hortaagan heshiis kasta oo suurtagal ah, maadaama cunaqabateynta Mareykanka iyo xeerarka caymiska maraakiibta ay adkeynayaan hirgelinta qorshayaasha lacagaha laga qaadayo maraakiibta. Dhanka kale, fallaagada Xuuthiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegtay inay weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku qaadeen saldhigyo ciidan oo Sacuudi Carabtu ku leedahay gobollada Ma’rib iyo Hadramawt, taasoo sii kordhisay walaaca amni ee gobolka. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu rumeysan yahay in dagaalka gobolka uu dhawaan soo afjarmi doono, hase yeeshee suuqyada tamarta ayaa weli ka taxaddaraya xaaladda, iyagoo sugaya horumar kasta oo ku saabsan wada-hadallada iyo go’aannada la xiriira marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Dhanka dhaqaalaha, indhaha maalgashadayaasha ayaa sidoo kale ku sii jeeda warbixinta shaqooyinka Mareykanka ee la filayo in la soo saaro, maadaama natiijadeedu saameyn ku yeelan karto go’aannada bangiga dhexe ee Mareykanka (Federal Reserve) ee dulsaarka, arrintaas oo iyaduna saamayn ku leh baahida iyo qiimaha saliidda caalamka.

items.title: Xoolo-dhaqato ku wajahaya Somaliland cunno xumo, go’doon iyo roob la’aan
items.description: (ERGO) – Boqollaal qoys oo xoolo dhaqato ah ayaa xaalad nolol xumo ah ku wajahaya deegaannada Qool-cadey, iyo Uubaale tan iyo bishii saddexaad ee sanadkan oo ay naq raac ku tageen. Qoysaskan ayaa sheegay inay isku raacday dhulkii oo xaaluf noqday markii lagu batay iyo cudurro aysan aqoon oo ay uga le’anayaan xoolihii ay noloshooda ku tiirsanayd. Qoysaskan oo roob yari uga soo barakacay deegaannadoodii billowgii 2026 ayaa tilmaamay inaysan hadda guurin karin sabab la xiriirta xoolihii oo tabar dhigay iyo iyaga oo aan haysan dhaqaale ay gawaari ugu kireeyaan. Cabdikariin Sulub Maxamed oo ka mid ah, wuxuu maaro u la’ yahay xoolihiisa oo u dhimanaya baad xumo iyo bushi uusan garanayn tan bishii Abriil oo ay soo dageen deegaanka Qool-cadey. Wuxuu tilmaamay inay ka dhinteen 16 oo geel ah iyo tiro iyo bar ari ah, kuwaas oo tiir dhexaad u ahaa noloshooda. “Xooluhu waa xoolo aan dusha ka qoyinoo aanu roob helin oo iska abaaraysan dee nafaqa gasha muu arag. Ariga haddaan isaga iskaba daayoo isagu wuu iska baxay markaa wax yar baa imika ka sii joogjooga.” “Xagga geela marka uu dhawr iyo toban marayo dee dhawr iyo toban geelii nimay ka baxday waad garanaysaa. Dee geel yar ma aha dee imikana nafna lama celin karoo haddana geel badani waa ku daba jiraa aragtidayda.” Ninkan ayaa reerka iyo xoolaha ka soo raray deegaanka Ina-guuxaa oo dhanka waqooyi kaga beegan magaalada Hargeysa una deegaanka hadda uu jooga qiyas 40 km. Wuxuu tilmaamay inay filashadooda ahayd inay xoolahooda u helayaan calaf iyo biyo kaddibna ay ka helayaan nacfi balse maanta waxay joogaan xaallad quus ah. Cabdikariin ayaa sheegay inay u joogaan 17 neef oo geel ah iyo toban ari ah, kuwaas oo aan lahayn caano, iyo cadna midna balse uga baahan quudin si ay u badbaadaan.  Wuxuu intaas ku daray inaysan ku jirin wax u gadmaya xilligan taas oo xaaladda sii adkaysay. Xaaladahan isku biirsaday ayaa ninkan bidday inuu biyo iyo cunno ku filan u awoodi waayo qoyskiisa oo lix ah. Wuxuu tilmaamay inay habeennada qaar ku joogaan gaajo haddii deriska aysan ka helin wax ay cunnaan. “Bakhaaro aan ka biil qaataa baa jirtoo, mararka qaarkood waxa dhici kartaba waji aan kula hagaago oo aan wax kaga qaatoba inaan u waayaa dhici karta oo aan ka xishoodaba. “Haddana anigiyoo u baahan oo meel kaloo aan u dhaafo garanay dantu igu qasabtay inaan afka u kala qaado oo aan wax waydiisto. Markaa taasi aadbay u badan tahay.” Cabdikariin waxaa culeysyada ku kordhinaya dayn gaaraysa kun doollar, taas bilooyinkii la soo dhaafay uu reerka ugu qaaday raashin. Wuxuu xusay in dukaamada uu raashinka ka qaadan jiray ay hadda u diideen inay sii siiyaan mid kale, maaddaama xisaabtii hore ay ku taagan tahay. “Wallaahi waxaa werwerka igu hayaa waa xagga daymankaas uun, daynkuna wax la dugsado ma aha aakhiro iyo aduunka midnaba kuuma fiicna. Daymankaas uun baa walbahaar aada igu haya, reerkiina waa dheri dab saaranoo waa ka rogoo mid kale saar.” Ninkan ayaa sheegay inuusan helin dhakhtar xoolaha u daweeya isla markaanna uu waayay dhaqaale uu dawooyin ku soo gato. Wuxuu xusay in geela uu afka ka jirranayo taas oo keenaysay inuu baadka joojiyo kaddiba uu dhinto. Dhimashada xoolihiisa ayuu u sababeeyay cudur iyo abaar u nuglaysay. Dhanka kale, Axmed Maxamed Diigaale oo ka mid ah xoolo dhaqatada soo barakacay kana soo hayaamay deegaanka Balli Cabane ayaa sheegay in isaga iyo qoyskiisa oo ka kooban sagaal ay wajahayaan hubanti la’aan. Tan iyo bishii Jannaayo ee sanadkan waxaa calaf xumo, biyo yari iyo cudurro uga dhintay toddobo geel ah iyo 64 ari ah, kuwaas oo qoyskiisa u ahaa laf dhabar. Hadda waxaa u jooga 30 ari ah iyo toban geel ah kuwaas oo uga baahan sida dadka inuu u quudiyo. Ninkan ayaa isku keeni la’ inuu qoyskiisa raashin u gado iyo calafka  xoolihiisa. Duruufahaas waxaa u dheer hoy xumo, taas oo keentay inay dibad-yaal u noqdaan cadceedda. Waxaa u dhisan buul ka samaysan baco, kaas oo aan u adkaysan karin dabaylaha xagaaga. “Xaaladayada in dhawayd oo ay roobab da’een waanu iska roonayn. Imika laakiin way adag tahay xaaladayd oo dhulkii wuu abaarsaday dabayl xaggaa way dhacaysaa. Waxa u daran hoy daciifa oo aan daryeelayn dhibaatooyinka na haysta ayay ka mid tahay.” Axmed ayaa sheegay inay sidoo kale ku dhib qabaan helidda biyo nadiif ah oo ku filan qoyskiisa. Dhawr jeer oo hore baaq waanu ka soo diray waxa ugu daran hoy iyo cunto maadaamoo xoolihiina abaaraysan yihiin oo xoolihiina caano lahayn taanaa ugu warwerka badan nahay.” Qoysaskan xoolo-dhaqatada ah ee ka soo hayaamay deegaannada Garabis, Ina-guuxaa, Balli Cabane iyo deegaannada kale ayaa weli wajahaya xaalad nololeed oo aad u adag. Waxay indhaha ka dhawrayaan xoolahoodii oo u dhimanaya cudurro iyo calaf la’aan, taas oo qudhooda galisay xaalad rajo beel ah oo aysan hubin sida ay uga soo kaban karaan haddii aysan gurmad samata-bixin ah helin. items.fullContent: (ERGO) – Boqollaal qoys oo xoolo dhaqato ah ayaa xaalad nolol xumo ah ku wajahaya deegaannada Qool-cadey, iyo Uubaale tan iyo bishii saddexaad ee sanadkan oo ay naq raac ku tageen. Qoysaskan ayaa sheegay inay isku raacday dhulkii oo xaaluf noqday markii lagu batay iyo cudurro aysan aqoon oo ay uga le’anayaan xoolihii ay noloshooda ku tiirsanayd. Qoysaskan oo roob yari uga soo barakacay deegaannadoodii billowgii 2026 ayaa tilmaamay inaysan hadda guurin karin sabab la xiriirta xoolihii oo tabar dhigay iyo iyaga oo aan haysan dhaqaale ay gawaari ugu kireeyaan. Cabdikariin Sulub Maxamed oo ka mid ah, wuxuu maaro u la’ yahay xoolihiisa oo u dhimanaya baad xumo iyo bushi uusan garanayn tan bishii Abriil oo ay soo dageen deegaanka Qool-cadey. Wuxuu tilmaamay inay ka dhinteen 16 oo geel ah iyo tiro iyo bar ari ah, kuwaas oo tiir dhexaad u ahaa noloshooda. “Xooluhu waa xoolo aan dusha ka qoyinoo aanu roob helin oo iska abaaraysan dee nafaqa gasha muu arag. Ariga haddaan isaga iskaba daayoo isagu wuu iska baxay markaa wax yar baa imika ka sii joogjooga.” “Xagga geela marka uu dhawr iyo toban marayo dee dhawr iyo toban geelii nimay ka baxday waad garanaysaa. items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo ansixisay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ansixisay sharciga asalka badeecadaha, taas oo ay sheegtay inay qeyb muhiim ah ka tahay dadaallada lagu kobcinayo wax-soo-saarka gudaha iyo sidii badeecadaha Soomaaliya loogu fududeyn lahaa inay galaan suuqyada gobolka iyo qaaradda Afrika. Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, Jamaal Maxamed Xasan oo warbaahinta la hadlay kadib kulankii Golaha Wasiirrada ee Khamiista ayaa sheegay in sharcigan uu ganacsatada iyo warshadaha gudaha u sahli doono inay helaan shahaadada caddeynta asalka badeecadaha (Certificate of Origin). Wasiirka ayaa xusay in shahaadadaasi ay muhiim u tahay badeecadaha Soomaaliyeed ee loo dhoofinayo dalalka ay Soomaaliya heshiisyada ganacsi la leedahay, gaar ahaan Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC) iyo Aagga Ganacsiga Xorta ah ee Afrika (AfCFTA), maadaama ay u oggolaaneyso inay ka faa’iideystaan cashuur-dhaafyada iyo fududeymaha ku jira heshiisyadaas. Wasiir Jamaal ayaa sheegay in badeecadaha buuxiya shuruudaha sharciga oo ay ku jiraan kuwa lagu farsameeyo ama lagu soo saaro Soomaaliya, ay heli doonaan aqoonsi rasmi ah oo caddeynaya halka ay asal ahaan ka soo jeedaan. Tallaabadan ayaa la filayaa inay fududeyso dhoofinta isla markaana kor u qaaddo tartanka wax-soo-saarka gudaha. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dowladda ay waddo qorsheyaal lagu dhiirrigelinayo warshadaha gudaha, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin dib-u-eegista siyaasadaha canshuuraha, si mudnaan iyo dhiirrigelin loogu sameeyo badeecadaha gudaha lagu soo saaro, loona xoojiyo awoodda shirkadaha Soomaaliyeed. Sida uu sheegay Jamaal, siyaasadaha cusub waxaa sidoo kale looga gol leeyahay in lagu kordhiyo maalgashiga gudaha, lagu abuuro fursado shaqo oo dheeraad ah, isla markaana la yareeyo ku-tiirsanaanta badeecadaha dibadda laga soo dejiyo. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto dejinta siyaasado lagu ilaalinayo wax-soo-saarka gudaha, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in la dhiso dhaqaale ku tiirsan warshadaha iyo beeraha dalka, lana xoojiyo awoodda Soomaaliya ee dhoofinta badeecadaha iyo ka qaybgalka suuqyada gobolka iyo qaaradda Afrika. The post Dowladda Soomaaliya oo ansixisay… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya oo Qaabilay Taliye Ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Difaaca Yugaandha
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa Madaxtooyada Qaranka ku qaabilay Taliye Ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Difaaca Jamhuuriyadda Yugaandha, General Sam Okiding, oo booqasho ku jooga Muqdisho si uu uga qayb galo Shirka Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada ee dalalka ciidamadoodu ka howlgalaan Soomaaliya. Kulanka ayaa qayb ka ahaa wada-hadallada Madaxweynaha uu la yeelanayo madaxda ciidamada ee ka soo qeybgalaya shirka, kaas oo diiradda lagu saarayo xoojinta iskaashiga dhinaca amniga, dardargelinta howlgalka lagula dagaallamayo kooxaha argagixisada, iyo horumarinta wada-shaqeynta u dhexeysa Soomaaliya iyo dalalka taageera amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa uga mahadceliyey dowladda iyo shacabka Yugaandha kaalinta ay ku leeyihiin taageerada Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhismaha iyo tayeynta hay’adaha amniga, iyo ka qaybqaadashada dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo nabad waarta. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay sii xoojinta xiriirka istaraatiijiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Yugaandha, isaga oo xusay in iskaashiga labada dal uu door weyn ka qaato xasilloonida gobolka iyo guusha laga gaarayo dadaallada lagula dagaallamayo argagixisada. Shirka Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada ee ka socda Muqdisho ayaa la filayaa inuu horseedo is-afgaradyo lagu xoojinayo wada-shaqeynta ciidamada dalalka ka qeyb qaata howlgalka taageerada iyo xasilinta Soomaaliya, xilli dowladda Federaalka ay sii waddo dadaallada lagu adkeynayo amniga iyo dib u dhiska hay’adaha difaaca dalka.

items.title: Taliyaha ciidanka Pakistan oo wacad ku maray in Soomaaliya…
items.description: Islamabad (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha ugu sarreeya ciidamada Pakistan, Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, ayaa dowladda Soomaaliya u ballanqaaday taageero lagu xoojinayo hay’adaha ammaanka iyo awoodda ciidamada, iyadoo labada dal ay sare u qaadayaan iskaashigooda dhinacyada la-dagaallanka argagixisada, tababarrada milatari iyo dhismaha awoodda difaaca. Munir, oo ah taliyaha ciidamada difaaca iyo kan ciidanka dhulka Pakistan, ayaa ballanqaadkan sameeyey Khamiistii, kaddib kulan uu xarunta guud ee ciidamada ee Rawalpindi kula yeeshay wasiirka gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi. War-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay waaxda xiriirka dadweynaha ciidamada Pakistan ayaa lagu sheegay in Munir uu mar kale xaqiijiyey sida Islamabad uga go’an tahay inay Soomaaliya ka taageerto xoojinta hay’adaha ammaanka iyo sidii nabad waarta looga hirgelin lahaa gobolka. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda amniga gobolka, danaha istaraatiijiyadeed ee ay wadaagaan labada waddan iyo tallaabooyinka lagu ballaarin karo iskaashiga difaaca. Labada dhinac waxay sidoo kale isku raaceen baahida loo qabo in la xoojiyo xiriirka tooska ah ee ciidamada labada dal, lana ballaariyo barnaamijyada tababarka iyo kor u qaadista xirfadaha si looga hortago khataraha amni ee ay wadaagaan. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa Pakistan uga mahadceliyey taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, isaga oo bogaadiyey doorka iyo xirfadda ciidamada Pakistan ee ku aaddan ilaalinta nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Hase yeeshee, labada dowladood ma shaacin in heshiisyada la gaaray ay ku jiraan hub la siinayo Soomaaliya, ciidamo Pakistani ah oo la geynayo dalka ama jadwal rasmi ah oo lagu hirgelinayo qodobbada lagu heshiiyey. Heshiis cusub oo difaaca ah Kulanka Fiqi iyo Munir ayaa soo gabagabeeyey maalmo wadahadallo heer sare ah oo wasiirka gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya uu ku joogay Pakistan, kuwaas oo ay labada dowladood ku kala saxiixdeen heshiis cusub oo dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga ah. Fiqi iyo wasiirka difaaca Pakistan Khawaja Muhammad Asif ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Islamabad ku saxiixay heshiis is-afgarad ah. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in heshiisku uu khuseeyo iskaashiga la-dagaallanka argagixisada, tababarka ciidamada iyo is-dhaafsiga aqoonta iyo khibradaha xirfadeed. Labada dal ayaa sidoo kale ku heshiiyey inay iska kaashadaan xoojinta awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, oo weli dagaal muddo dheer socda kula jira kooxda Al-Shabaab. Al-Shabaab, oo xiriir la leh Al-Qaacida, ayaa ku dhowaad labaatan sano dagaal kula jirtay dowladihii kala dambeeyey ee Soomaaliya. Kooxdan ayaa waxay weli ku sugan tahay qaybo ka mid ah miyiga koonfurta iyo bartamaha dalka, waxayna weerarro joogto ah ku qaaddaa saldhigyada ciidamada, xarumaha dowladda iyo goobaha ay dadka rayidka ahi ku badan yihiin. Heshiiskan cusub ayaa daba socda hannaan iskaashi oo dhanka difaaca ah oo Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan ay kala saxiixdeen bishii Agoosto 2025. Heshiiskaas hore ayaa lagu sheegay inuu ku jiray tababarka ciidamada badda, iskaashiga la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda iyo taageero farsamo. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu dhisay guddi wadajir ah oo la socda hirgelinta heshiisyada, isla markaana hagaya iskaashiga mustaqbalka. Munir, oo ah taliyaha ciidamada difaaca iyo kan ciidanka dhulka Pakistan, ayaa ballanqaadkan sameeyey Khamiistii, kaddib kulan uu xarunta guud ee ciidamada ee Rawalpindi kula yeeshay wasiirka gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi. items.title: Going to war with your own regional states is bad for any central state
items.description: Going to war with your own regional states is bad for any central state, any leader of a decentralised state. There must be extreme and compelling reason to justify such a war. Going to war with your own regional states when you are feeble, fragmented state and cannot project lethal power much beyond one city is sheer madness. Mogadishu’s plan to seize control of Puntland in Aug 2026 falls apart just as its plan to seize control of Jubaland fell apart in Dec 2024. Mogadishu’s electoral conquests in South West State and Galmudug do not signal a state that ‘stabilising’ the periphery. They demonstrate a state fomenting further fragmentation A reminder of the old wisdom: Never go to war unless you are sure to win Rashid Abdi

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo 11 qof ku dhaawacay gudaha Sucuudiga
items.description: Isbahaysiga uu hoggaamiyo Sacuudi Carabiya ee taageera dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay ayaa sheegay, in 11 qof oo rayid ah ay ku dhaawacmeen weerar ay Xuutiyiintu ku qaadeen gobolka xuduudda ee Najran ee Sacuudi Carabiya. Afhayeen ayaa sheegay in dadka dhaawacmay ay ka koobnaayeen toddobo muwaadiniin Sacuudi ah, hal Yemeni ah, laba Masaari ah iyo hal Pakistani ah. Weerarkan ayaa yimid laba maalmood kaddib markii Xuutiyiintu sheegeen inay weerar diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ah ay ku qaadeen garoonka diyaaradaha ee Najran. Xiisaddu waxay sii korortay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay kaddib markii kooxda ay Iiraan taageerto ay ku dhawaaqday go’doomin dhinaca badda ah oo ka jirta Badda Cas, isla markaana ay weerarro ku qaaday booyadaha shidaalka iyo xarumaha saliidda ee Sacuudi Carabiya. Riyaad ayaa taas uga jawaabtay duqeymo ay la beegsatay saldhigyo ciidan oo ku yaalla Yemen. Horey, weerarro ay Xuutiyiintu geysteen ayaa la sheegay inay ku dhinteen ugu yaraan 30 askari oo ka tirsanaa ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee bartamaha Yemen.

items.title: IIRAAN oo imtixaan adag u dhiibtay dalalka Khaliijka
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Iran ayaa dalalka Khaliijka u sheegtay inay madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ku qanciyaan inuu joojiyo weerarrada ka dhanka ah Tehran, iyadoo uga digtay in xarumahooda shidaalka, korontada iyo biyaha ay bartilmaameed noqon doonaan haddii Washington ay weerarto kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha Iran. Digniintan oo loo gudbiyey dowladaha gobolka iyada oo loo marayo xiriirro diblomaasiyadeed oo heer sare ah ayaa muujineysa in Tehran ay dooneyso inay dalalka xulafada dhow la ah Washington ku qasabto inay ka shaqeeyaan xal wadahadal ah. Sarkaal sare oo Iranian ah ayaa sheegay in bartilmaameedyada la tilmaamay ay ka mid yihiin ceelasha shidaalka, warshadaha sifeynta, xarumaha korontada, nidaamyada biyaha, isku-xirka gaadiidka iyo hantida kale ee muhiimka u ah dhaqaalaha dalalka Khaliijka. Digniinta ayaa daba socotay markii Trump uu 28-kii July ku hanjabay inuu weerari doono shabakadaha tamarta iyo kaabeyaasha kale ee Iran, haddii Tehran aysan aqbalin shuruudaha Washington. Digniin isku mid ah Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Iran, Abbas Araqchi, ayaa la hadlay dhiggiisa Sacuudiga, Qatar iyo Turkiga, iyo sidoo kale taliyaha ciidamada Pakistan, sida ay sheegeen saraakiil Iranian ah, ilo Khaliiji ah iyo diblomaasi sare oo gobolka ah. Dadka xogta bixiyey ayaa magacyadooda qariyey, sababo la xiriira xasaasiyadda wada-hadallada. Araqchi ayaa madaxda gobolka ka dalbaday inay saameyntooda ku isticmaalaan Trump, si looga hor istaago weerarro kale oo Mareykanku ku qaado Iran. Waxa uu uga digay in weerar kasta oo lagu qaado kaabeyaasha Iran uu dhalin doono aargoosi lagu beegsanayo hantida Mareykanka iyo xarumaha muhiimka ah ee dalalka gobolka. “Waxaan diyaar u nahay inaan ka jawaabno, laakiin helitaanka xal diblomaasiyadeed ayaa ah waddada ugu wanaagsan ee looga hortagi karo fiditaanka dagaalka iyo burbur ka dhaca gobolka oo dhan,” ayuu yiri diblomaasiga sare, isaga oo sharxaya farriinta Iran. Mid ka mid ah ilaha Khaliijka ayaa sheegay in digniintu aysan mugdi ku jirin. “Haddii Mareykanku bartilmaameedsado kaabeyaasha Iran, waxay kaga jawaabi doonaan weerarro lagu qaado xarumaha tamarta ee Khaliijka iyo bartilmaameedyo kale oo gobolka ah,” ayuu yiri. Ololahan diblomaasiyadeed ayaa muujinaya in Iran ay nuglaanta dhaqaale ee dalalka Khaliijka u adeegsaneyso cadaadis siyaasadeed, iyadoo u sheegaysa in dagaal kale oo dhex mara Tehran iyo Washington uusan ku ekaan doonin gudaha Iran. Sacuudiga oo la hadlay Trump Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Mohammed bin Salman, ayaa markii dambe la hadlay Trump, isaga oo ku boorriyey inuu dib u dhigo tallaabo militari, dib ugu laabto wadahadalka, isla markaana taageero xabbad-joojin iyo heshiis siyaasadeed. Digniinta Iran waxaa loogu talagalay dhammaan dalalka Khaliijka, balse Tehran ayaa farriinta inteeda badan sii marsiisay Sacuudiga iyo Qatar, oo xiriir dhow la leh Washington, isla markaana door muhiim ah ka qaata dadaallada dhexdhexaadinta. Sacuudiga, Qatar iyo Cumaan ayaa dhammaantood Mareykanka ugu baaqay inuu dib u bilaabo wadahadalka Tehran, si looga hortago dagaal cusub oo saameyn kara gobolka iyo suuqyada tamarta adduunka. Sarkaal Iranian ah ayaa sheegay in weerarro kale oo Mareykanku qaado ay “gobolka u rogi karaan kubbad dab ah”. Trump ayaa 2-dii August sheegay inuu oggolaaday in la joojiyo weerar la qorsheynayey, balse wuxuu go’aankaas ku xiray in heshiis degdeg ah lala gaaro Iran. “Waxaan oggolaaday inaan baajiyo weerarka, iyadoo ay shardi tahay in si dhaqso ah heshiis loo gaari karo,” ayuu Trump yiri. Maamulka Mareykanka wuxuu doonayaa heshiis wax looga qabanayo barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran iyo marin-u-helidda maraakiibta ee marinka Hormuz, oo muhiim u ah dhoofinta shidaalka iyo gaaska caalamka. Inkasta oo Sacuudigu ku boorriyey Washington inay diblomaasiyadda fursad siiso, haddana Riyadh waxay Tehran u sheegtay inay is-difaaci doonto haddii dhulkeeda la weeraro. “Sacuudigu wuxuu aaminsan yahay in xiisad kale ay keeneyso burbur dheeraad ah,” ayuu yiri il Khaliiji ah. “Taas ayaana sababtay inuu Trump ku boorriyo inuu diblomaasiyadda fursad siiyo.” Ilo kale ayaa sheegay in Sacuudigu caddeeyey in weerar lagu qaado dhulkiisa uu la kulmi doono jawaab militari. Falanqeeye Sacuudi ah oo lagu magacaabo Ali Shihabi ayaa sheegay in qiimeynta Riyadh ay tahay in kordhinta weerarradu aysan keeneyn natiijada la doonayo. “Boqortooyadu waxay aaminsan tahay in jawaabo militari oo isu dheellitiran iyo cadaadis joogto ah oo Iran lagu saaro marinka Hormuz ay yihiin waddada ugu wanaagsan ee lagu gaari karo heshiis diblomaasiyadeed oo la fulin karo,” ayuu yiri Shihabi. Xusuusta weerarkii Aramco Hanjabaadda Iran ayaa soo nooleysay xusuusta weerarradii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo gantaallada ee September 2019 lagu qaaday xarumaha Abqaiq iyo Khurais ee shirkadda shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco. Weerarradaas ayaa si ku-meel-gaar ah meesha uga saaray in ka badan kala bar wax-soo-saarkii shidaalka Sacuudiga, waxayna muujiyeen nuglaanta xarumaha waaweyn ee tamarta gobolka. “Weli waxay xusuustaan Aramco,” ayuu yiri sarkaal Iranian ah, isaga oo tilmaamaya saameyntii weerarradaas ku yeesheen dhaqaalaha iyo suuqyada shidaalka. Dalalka Khaliijka ayaa sidoo kale si weyn ugu tiirsan xarumaha biyaha badda lagu macaaneeyo. Weerar lagu qaado nidaamyada korontada ama biyaha ayaa saameyn degdeg ah ku yeelan kara malaayiin qof iyo howlaha magaalooyinka waaweyn. “Haddii Iran ay khasaare soo gaarto, waxay jawaabteeda ku geysan doontaa khasaare aad uga weyn,” ayuu yiri sarkaalka Iranian-ka ah. Iran ayaa dhowr jeer dalalka Khaliijka ka dalbatay inay joojiyaan inay xog sirdoon la wadaagaan Washington, iyadoo Tehran ay rumeysan tahay in xogtaas loo adeegsanayo weerarrada ka dhanka ah ciidamadeeda iyo kaabeyaasha dalka. Waxay sidoo kale ku baaqday in la xiro saldhigyada ciidamada Mareykanka ee ku yaalla gobolka. Marka laga eego aragtida Tehran, Trump wuxuu horyaallaa laba doorasho oo adag: inuu ballaariyo dagaal khatar gelin kara dalalka Khaliijka iyo shidaalka adduunka, ama inuu aqbalo heshiis aan siineyn guul militari oo buuxda. Diblomaasiga gobolka ayaa sheegay in mid ka mid ah caqabadaha ugu waaweyn uu yahay rabitaanka Washington ee ah inay hesho wax ay shacabka Mareykanka iyo xulafadeeda ugu soo bandhigi karto guul. “Mareykanku wuxuu doonayaa wax uu u soo bandhigi karo caddeyn muujineysa inuu dagaalka ku guuleystay,” ayuu yiri diblomaasiga. Inkasta oo weerarkii la qorsheynayey hadda la hakiyey, digniinta Iran iyo jawaabta adag ee Sacuudiga ayaa muujinaya in xaaladdu weli jilicsan tahay, isla markaana tallaabo militari oo cusub ay si degdeg ah dagaalka ugu fidin karto guud ahaan gobolka Khaliijka.
