Waxa uu uga digay in weerar kasta oo lagu qaado kaabeyaasha Iran uu dhalin doono aargoosi lagu beegsanayo hantida Mareykanka iyo xarumaha muhiimka ah ee dalalka gobolka. “Waxaan diyaar u nahay inaan ka jawaabno, laakiin helitaanka xal diblomaasiyadeed ayaa ah waddada ugu wanaagsan ee looga hortagi karo fiditaanka dagaalka iyo burbur ka dhaca gobolka oo dhan,” ayuu yiri diblomaasiga sare, isaga oo sharxaya farriinta Iran. Mid ka mid ah ilaha Khaliijka ayaa sheegay in digniintu aysan mugdi ku jirin. “Haddii Mareykanku bartilmaameedsado kaabeyaasha Iran, waxay kaga jawaabi doonaan weerarro lagu qaado xarumaha tamarta ee Khaliijka iyo bartilmaameedyo kale oo gobolka ah,” ayuu yiri. Ololahan diblomaasiyadeed ayaa muujinaya in Iran ay nuglaanta dhaqaale ee dalalka Khaliijka u adeegsaneyso cadaadis siyaasadeed, iyadoo u sheegaysa in dagaal kale oo dhex mara Tehran iyo Washington uusan ku ekaan doonin gudaha Iran. Sacuudiga oo la hadlay Trump Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Mohammed bin Salman, ayaa markii dambe la hadlay Trump, isaga oo ku boorriyey inuu dib u dhigo tallaabo militari, dib ugu laabto wadahadalka, isla markaana taageero xabbad-joojin iyo heshiis siyaasadeed. Digniinta Iran waxaa loogu talagalay dhammaan dalalka Khaliijka, balse Tehran ayaa farriinta inteeda badan sii marsiisay Sacuudiga iyo Qatar, oo xiriir dhow la leh Washington, isla markaana door muhiim ah ka qaata dadaallada dhexdhexaadinta. Sacuudiga, Qatar iyo Cumaan ayaa dhammaantood Mareykanka ugu baaqay inuu dib u bilaabo wadahadalka Tehran, si looga hortago dagaal cusub oo saameyn kara gobolka iyo suuqyada tamarta adduunka. Sarkaal Iranian ah ayaa sheegay in weerarro kale oo Mareykanku qaado ay “gobolka u rogi karaan kubbad dab ah”. Trump ayaa 2-dii August sheegay inuu oggolaaday in la joojiyo weerar la qorsheynayey, balse wuxuu go’aankaas ku xiray in heshiis degdeg ah lala gaaro Iran. “Waxaan oggolaaday inaan baajiyo weerarka, iyadoo ay shardi tahay in si dhaqso ah heshiis loo gaari karo,” ayuu Trump yiri. Maamulka Mareykanka wuxuu doonayaa heshiis wax looga qabanayo barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran iyo marin-u-helidda maraakiibta ee marinka Hormuz, oo muhiim u ah dhoofinta shidaalka iyo gaaska caalamka. Inkasta oo Sacuudigu ku boorriyey Washington inay diblomaasiyadda fursad siiso, haddana Riyadh waxay Tehran u sheegtay inay is-difaaci doonto haddii dhulkeeda la weeraro. “Sacuudigu wuxuu aaminsan yahay in xiisad kale ay keeneyso burbur dheeraad ah,” ayuu yiri il Khaliiji ah. “Taas ayaana sababtay inuu Trump ku boorriyo inuu diblomaasiyadda fursad siiyo.” Ilo kale ayaa sheegay in Sacuudigu caddeeyey in weerar lagu qaado dhulkiisa uu la kulmi doono jawaab militari. Falanqeeye Sacuudi ah oo lagu magacaabo Ali Shihabi ayaa sheegay in qiimeynta Riyadh ay tahay in kordhinta weerarradu aysan keeneyn natiijada la doonayo. “Boqortooyadu waxay aaminsan tahay in jawaabo militari oo isu dheellitiran iyo cadaadis joogto ah oo Iran lagu saaro marinka Hormuz ay yihiin waddada ugu wanaagsan ee lagu gaari karo heshiis diblomaasiyadeed oo la fulin karo,” ayuu yiri Shihabi. Xusuusta weerarkii Aramco Hanjabaadda Iran ayaa soo nooleysay xusuusta weerarradii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo gantaallada ee September 2019 lagu qaaday xarumaha Abqaiq iyo Khurais ee shirkadda shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco. Weerarradaas ayaa si ku-meel-gaar ah meesha uga saaray in ka badan kala bar wax-soo-saarkii shidaalka Sacuudiga, waxayna muujiyeen nuglaanta xarumaha waaweyn ee tamarta gobolka. “Weli waxay xusuustaan Aramco,” ayuu yiri sarkaal Iranian ah, isaga oo tilmaamaya saameyntii weerarradaas ku yeesheen dhaqaalaha iyo suuqyada shidaalka. Dalalka Khaliijka ayaa sidoo kale si weyn ugu tiirsan xarumaha biyaha badda lagu macaaneeyo. Weerar lagu qaado nidaamyada korontada ama biyaha ayaa saameyn degdeg ah ku yeelan kara malaayiin qof iyo howlaha magaalooyinka waaweyn. “Haddii Iran ay khasaare soo gaarto, waxay jawaabteeda ku geysan doontaa khasaare aad uga weyn,” ayuu yiri sarkaalka Iranian-ka ah. Iran ayaa dhowr jeer dalalka Khaliijka ka dalbatay inay joojiyaan inay xog sirdoon la wadaagaan Washington, iyadoo Tehran ay rumeysan tahay in xogtaas loo adeegsanayo weerarrada ka dhanka ah ciidamadeeda iyo kaabeyaasha dalka. Waxay sidoo kale ku baaqday in la xiro saldhigyada ciidamada Mareykanka ee ku yaalla gobolka. Marka laga eego aragtida Tehran, Trump wuxuu horyaallaa laba doorasho oo adag: inuu ballaariyo dagaal khatar gelin kara dalalka Khaliijka iyo shidaalka adduunka, ama inuu aqbalo heshiis aan siineyn guul militari oo buuxda. Diblomaasiga gobolka ayaa sheegay in mid ka mid ah caqabadaha ugu waaweyn uu yahay rabitaanka Washington ee ah inay hesho wax ay shacabka Mareykanka iyo xulafadeeda ugu soo bandhigi karto guul. “Mareykanku wuxuu doonayaa wax uu u soo bandhigi karo caddeyn muujineysa inuu dagaalka ku guuleystay,” ayuu yiri diblomaasiga. Inkasta oo weerarkii la qorsheynayey hadda la hakiyey, digniinta Iran iyo jawaabta adag ee Sacuudiga ayaa muujinaya in xaaladdu weli jilicsan tahay, isla markaana tallaabo militari oo cusub ay si degdeg ah dagaalka ugu fidin karto guud ahaan gobolka Khaliijka. items.title: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka oo saxeexay amaro waaweyn oo saamayn kara Soomaalida
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, ayaa mar kale isku dayayaa inuu yareeyo xuquuqda dhalashada ku salaysan ee Maraykanka, toddobaadyo uun ka dib markii Maxkamadda Sare ee Maraykanka ay diidday isku daygiisii hore ee lagu baabi’inayay xuquuqdan. Madaxweynaha ayaa Khamiistii saxiixay laba amar oo fulineed, kuwaas oo midkood ballaarinaya qeexitaannada dadka aan muwaadiniinta ahayn ee carruurtoodu aanay xaq u yeelan doonin dhalashada Maraykanka hadii ay ku dhashaan dalkaas. Amarka labaadna wuxuu mamnuucayaa waxa loo yaqaan “dalxiiska dhalmada” oo ah marka haweenka uurka leh ay u safraan Maraykanka si ay halkaas ugu dhalaan carruurtooda, si ilmuhu u helo dhalashada Maraykanka. Trump ayaa ka sheegay Xafiiska Oval-ka: “Tani waxay ahayd inay dhacdo sannado ka hor, laakiin hadda ayaan hirgelinaynaa.” Wuxuu sidoo kale dhaliilay go’aankii Maxkamadda Sare ee lagu diiday isku daygiisii hore ee lagu soo afjarayay siyaasaddan jirtay ku dhowaad 150 sano. Amarka fulinta ee ugu horreeya ayaa lagu yiri: “Maamulkaygu wuxuu ka hortagay khataraha ay keenaan shakhsiyaad iyo kooxo shisheeye, kuwaas oo isku daya inay khiyaaneeyaan muwaadiniinta Maraykanka iyagoo ka faa’iidaysanaya deeqsinimada dalkeenna.” Amarkan wuxuu mamnuucayaa in si toos ah dhalashada Maraykanka loo siiyo carruurta ku dhalata gudaha Maraykanka, haddii labadooda waalid aysan ahayn muwaadiniin Maraykan ah, isla markaana mid ka mid ah waalidiinta uu yahay: xubin ka tirsan koox argagixiso oo shisheeye, shaqaale u shaqeeya dowlad shisheeye, qof isku dayay inuu ku helo dhalashada Maraykanka khiyaano ama been-abuur, ama qof ku nool dhulalka Maraykanku maamulo ee aan sharci federaali ahi siin dhalasho toos ah. Dhalashada dadka ku dhasha dhulalka Maraykanka sida Puerto Rico, waxaa si cad u dammaanad qaadaya sharci federaal ah. Trump iyo xubnaha maamulkiisa ayaa marar badan cambaareeyay dalxiiska xiliga ay dhowdahay dhalmada, iyagoo ku eedeeyay waddamo ay ka mid yihiin Ruushka iyo Shiinaha inay ka faa’iidaystaan nidaamka dhalashada ku salaysan, si ay dad ugu dhex geliyaan Maraykanka. Amaraddan oo uu Khamiistii kaga dhawaaqayay Xafiiska Oval-ka, Trump wuxuu sheegay in boqolaal kun oo carruur ah ay ku dhasheen Maraykanka iyada oo loo marayo waxa loo yaqaan dalxiiska dhalmada (birth tourism).

items.title: Sawirro: Maxay ka wada-hadleen Axmed Madoobe iyo saraakiisha AFRICOM?
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Dowlad-goboleedka Jubaland, Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe) ayaa kulan la qaatay Taliyaha Howl-gallada Gaarka ah ee Taliska Ciidamada Maraykanka ee Afrika (AFRICOM), Sarreeye Gaas Claude K. Tudor Jr iyo mas’uuliyiin kale. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray dardargelinta howl-gallada lagu xoreynayo deegaannada maamulka Jubaland, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen sidii loo xoojin lahaa dadaallada lagu xoreynayo deegaannada ay weli kooxdaasi kaga sugan tahay Jubaland. War kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Jubaland ayaa lagu sheegay in kulanka sidoo kale lagu falanqeeyay iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, gaar ahaan dagaalka Al-Shabaab iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa isku-duwidda howl-gallada milatari ee socda. Madaxweyne Axmed Madoobe waxaa kulanka ku weheliyay Agaasimaha Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabad-sugidda Jubaland, Maxamed Axmed Sabriye, halka wafdiga AFRICOM ay hoggaaminayeen Sarreeye Gaas Claude K. Tudor Jr iyo saraakiil kale oo ka tirsan Taliska Ciidamada Mareykanka ee Afrika. Kulankan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Jubaland ay wadaan howl-gallo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab oo ka socda qaybo ka mid ah gobolka Jubbada Hoose, iyadoo la doonayo in dib looga qabsado deegaanno ay kooxdaasi muddo gacanta ku haysay. Maalmihii lasoo dhaafay, howl-gallada milatari ee ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ayaa si weyn uga xoogaystay deegaannada Jubaland, iyadoo ciidamada iskaashanaya ay gaareen goobo ku dhow degmada Jilib, oo ah mid kamid ah meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee kooxda Al-Shabaab ay ku leedahay koonfurta Soomaaliya. Kulanka Axmed Madoobe iyo saraakiisha AFRICOM ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Mareykanka uu kordhinayo iskaashiga amni ee uu la leeyahay dhinacyada kala duwan ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan taageerada howlgalada lagu wiiqayo awoodda Al-Shabaab iyo xoojinta awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Maxaa laga filan karaa kulanka hoggaamiyaasha Sacuudiga, Pakistan, iyo Turkiga?
items.description: Madaxweynaha Turkiga, Recep Tayyip Erdogan, ayaa saaka booqasho hal maalin ah ku tagay Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, halkaas oo uu kulamo kula yeelanayo Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Maxamed Bin Salmaan iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan, Shehbaz Sharif. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in hoggaamiyeyaashu ay diiradda saari doonaan xoojinta xiriirka labada dhinac, horumarinta iskaashiga difaaca iyo arrimaha amniga gobolka. Sidoo kale waxaa la filayaa in laga wada hadlo saameynta dagaalka u dhexeeya Mareykanka, Israa’iil iyo Iiraan, amniga marinnada badda iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Warbaahinta caalamiga ah ayaa qortay in ay jirto suurtagalnimo ay Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan ku saxiixaan heshiis iskaashi difaac oo saddex geesood ah. Ilo ku dhow dhinacyadan ayaa sheegay in heshiiskaasi uu noqon karo ballaarin lagu sameeyo heshiiskii difaaca ee Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan ay kala saxiixdeen sanadkii 2025, kaas oo dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado midkood loo arko weerar lagu qaaday labada dal. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dowladaha Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan weli si rasmi ah uma aysan xaqiijin jiritaanka heshiiskaas, waxaana suuragal ah in kulanka uu ku soo dhammaado oo keliya bayaan wadajir ah oo ku saabsan iskaashiga siyaasadda, amniga iyo dhaqaalaha. Booqashadan ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmaysa toddobaad kadib markii Sacuudigu ku dhawaaqay isbahaysi caalami ah oo loogu talagalay ilaalinta maraakiibta maraya Badda Cas, marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Isbahaysigaas waxaa taageeray 14 dal oo ay ku jiraan Turkiga iyo Pakistan, iyadoo xiisadaha ka taagan marin-biyoodka Hormuz iyo weerarrada ay is dhaafsanayaan Iiraan iyo xulafada Mareykanka, iyo sidoo kale dagaallada u dhexeeya Sacuudiga iyo kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen, ay ka dhigayaan kulankan mid si weyn isha loogu hayo. Booqashadii ugu dambeysay ee Erdogan uu ku tagay Riyadh bishii Febraayo ee sanadkan ayaa labada dal ku heshiiyeen xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, tamarta iyo difaaca.

items.title: Baarlamanka Uganda oo go’aan ka gaaray in ciidamo loo diro Gaza iyo in kale
items.description: Kampala (Caasimada Online) – Baarlamaanka Uganda ayaa Khamiistii ansixiyey qorshe ay dowladdu ciidamo ugu dirayso Marinka Gaza, si ay uga mid noqdaan ciidan caalami ah oo uu Mareykanku taageerayo, kaas oo loo xil-saarayo sugidda amniga iyo xasilinta dhulka Falastiiniyiinta ee dagaalladu burburiyeen. Mooshinka baarlamaanku meel mariyey ayaa xukuumadda Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni u oggolaanaya inay cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidamada Difaaca Uganda, UPDF, u dirto Gaza, kaddib codsi uga yimid dowladda Mareykanka. Dowladda Uganda ma shaacin tirada askarta la dirayo iyo waqtiga rasmiga ah ee ay howlgalka bilaabi doonaan. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga iyo Arrimaha Halyeeyada, Kiryowa Kiwanuka, ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Uganda ay ka qeyb qaadan doonaan la socodka heshiisyada xabbad-joojinta, ilaalinta shacabka iyo ka hortagga in dagaal kale dib uga qarxo Gaza. “Uganda waxay leedahay ciidan awood leh iyo hannaan abaabul oo suurtageliyey inay si guul leh uga qeyb qaadato howlgallada nabad ilaalinta,” ayuu Kiwanuka u sheegay xildhibaannada. Wuxuu tusaale u soo qaatay howlgalka muddada dheer ay ciidamada Uganda ka wadaan Soomaaliya, iyo sidoo kale howlgallada ay dalkaasi uga qeyb galeen Koonfurta Suudaan, Jamhuuriyadda Afrikada Dhexe iyo hawlgallada Qaramada Midoobay. Fadhiga baarlamaanka, oo uu guddoominayey guddoomiye ku-xigeenka Thomas Tayebwa, ayaa mooshinka ansixiyey, inkastoo xildhibaannada mucaaradka ay dalbadeen waqti dheeraad ah oo lagu baaro ujeeddada howlgalka, kharashaadkiisa iyo khatarta ay ciidamada wajihi karaan. Ciidanka xasilinta Gaza Kiwanuka ayaa sheegay in howlgalka Uganda uu waafaqsan yahay qaraar uu Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ansixiyey bishii Nofeembar 2025, kaas oo oggolaaday in Gaza laga sameeyo ciidan ku-meel-gaar ah oo caalami ah oo lagu magacaabo International Stabilisation Force. Qaraarka ayaa qayb ka ahaa qorshaha Gaza ee Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump, waxaana Golaha Ammaanka ku taageeray 13 dal, iyadoo Shiinaha iyo Ruushku ka aamuseen codeynta. Ciidanka caalamiga ah ayaa la filayaa inuu taageero maamul Falastiini ah oo ku-meel-gaar ah, ilaaliyo howlaha gargaarka bani’aadannimo, isla markaana gacan ka geysto hub ka dhigista Xamaas iyo kooxaha kale ee hubeysan. Howlgalka waxaa maamuli doona hay’ad caalami ah oo loo xilsaaray inay kormeerto nidaamka amniga, maamulka iyo dib-u-dhiska Gaza. “Ka qeybgalka Uganda ee ciidanka xasilinta caalamiga ah wuxuu gacan ka geysan doonaa ka hortagga dagaal kale oo gobolka ka dhaca,” ayuu yiri Kiwanuka. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in howlgalka uu dhinacyada isku haya siin karo fursad ay nabad ku raadiyaan, isla markaana uu caawin karo ciribtirka kooxaha uu ku tilmaamay argagixisada ee khatarta ku haya ammaanka caalamka. Jeneraalka Mareykanka Jasper Jeffers, oo la sheegay inuu hoggaamin doono howlgalka, ayaa soo bandhigay qorshe lagu dhisayo ciidan gaari kara 20,000 oo askari, kuwaas oo la shaqeyn doona 12,000 oo askari oo boolis Falastiiniyiin ah oo la tababaray. Dalalka Indonesia, Morocco, Kazakhstan, Kosovo iyo Albania ayaa horay u ballanqaaday inay ciidamo ku biirinayaan howlgalka, halka Masar iyo Urdun ay oggolaadeen inay ka qeyb qaataan tababarka booliska Falastiiniyiinta. Golaha ammaanka ee Israa’iil ayaa sidoo kale ansixiyey qaab sharciyeed u oggolaanaya ciidamo shisheeye inay galaan Gaza. Sarkaal Israa’iili ah ayaa sheegay in wejiga koowaad ee howlgalka ay ka qeyb qaadan doonaan ku dhowaad 200 oo askari oo ka socda dalal saaxiib la ah Israa’iil, oo ay ku jiraan Uganda iyo Morocco. Ciidamadaas ayaa marka hore ka howl geli doona deegaanno aan si toos ah gacanta ugu jirin militariga Israa’iil, balse dal kasta oo ciidan diraya wuxuu weli u baahan doonaa oggolaansho gaar ah oo Israa’iil ah. Ballanqaad dhex-dhexaadnimo Dowladda Uganda ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadeedu aysan la safan doonin dhinac ka mid ah dhinacyada siyaasadeed iyo kuwa militari ee isku haya Gaza. “Inta uu howlgalku socdo, UPDF waxay ahaan doontaa dhexdhexaad, waxayna ilaalin doontaa sharciga caalamiga ah ee bani’aadannimada, shacabka ayay ilaalin doontaa, kamana qeyb qaadan doonto murannada siyaasadeed,” ayaa lagu yiri mooshinka. Jeneraal Henry Masiko, oo ciidamada ku metela baarlamaanka, ayaa soo dhoweeyey go’aanka, wuxuuna howlgalka ku tilmaamay waajib qaran oo sharaf leh. “Uma soconno halkaas inaan ciyaarno. Waxaan u soconnaa inaan wajahno khataraha ka dhanka ah bulshada iyo bani’aadannimada,” ayuu yiri Masiko. “Waa inaan ku faannaa arrintan.” Hase yeeshee, xildhibaannada mucaaradka ayaa su’aalo ka keenay ujeeddada ciidamada loo dirayo, iyagoo ka digay in howlgalka Gaza uu Uganda gelin karo khataro siyaasadeed, diblomaasiyadeed iyo kuwo amni. Xildhibaan Hassan Kirumira ayaa xusay in Uganda ay xubin ka tahay Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka, wuxuuna dalbaday in si cad loo sharaxo cidda ay ciidamada Uganda taageerayaan. “Dhinacee ayay ciidamadeennu u dagaallami doonaan?” ayuu weydiiyey. Wasiirka gaashaandhigga ee xukuumadda hooska, Joseph Ssewungu, ayaa ku eedeeyey dowladda inay mooshinka si kedis ah baarlamaanka u hor keentay, iyadoo aan mucaaradka la siin waqti ku filan oo uu ku barto. Wuxuu codsaday in codeynta dib loo dhigo, balse dalabkiisa lama aqbalin. John Baptist Nambeshe, oo ka tirsan xisbiga mucaaradka ee National Unity Platform, ayaa sheegay inuu taageersan yahay dadaallada nabadda, balse loo baahan yahay in marka hore la qiimeeyo natiijada howlgalladii hore ee Uganda. “Waxaan u baahan nahay inaan ogaanno in howlgalladii hore ay guuleysteen iyo in kale, ka hor inta aan ciidamadeenna loo dirin Gaza oo khatar badan,” ayuu yiri Nambeshe. Wuxuu dalbaday warbixin dhammeystiran oo lagu qiimeynayo waxqabadka, kharashaadka iyo cawaaqibta ka dhalatay howlgalladii hore ee ciidamada Uganda. Mushaharka ciidamada Qaar ka mid ah xildhibaannada ayaa sidoo kale dalbaday dammaanad qaad ah in askarta la dirayo ay heli doonaan mushaharkooda, gunnooyinkooda iyo xuquuqdooda kale oo dhameystiran. “Wiilasheenna iyo gabdhaheenna waa in si wanaagsan loola dhaqmaa marka ay ka soo laabtaan howlgallada caalamiga ah,” ayuu yiri xildhibaan Peter Okot. “Horay waxay askartu uga cawdeen in loo diiday ama laga haystay gunnooyinkoodii.” Xildhibaan James Waluswaka ayaa digniin u diray mas’uuliyiinta maamuli doona lacagaha ciidamada. “Waxaan u digeynaa cid kasta oo isku dayda inay wax ka lunsato xuquuqda ciidamada UPDF ee loo dirayo Gaza. Markan arrintu sidii hore ma ahaan doonto,” ayuu yiri. Madaxa xildhibaannada mucaaradka, Paul Mwiru, ayaa dowladda ugu baaqay inay baarlamaanka hor keento heshiiska kama dambeysta ah ee lagu maamulayo howlgalka, gaar ahaan qodobbada ku saabsan mushaharka, taliska ciidamada iyo ammaankooda. Guddoomiye ku-xigeenka baarlamaanka ayaa dowladda faray inay heshiiska soo gudbiso marka ay dhammaadaan wada-hadallada lala leeyahay waddamada iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah. Baarlamaanka ayaa ugu dambeyn mooshinka ku ansixiyey qodobka 38-aad ee sharciga ciidamada Uganda, kaas oo nidaamiya in ciidamo loo diro meel ka baxsan dalka. Khibradda Soomaaliya Uganda waxay ka mid tahay waddamada Afrika ee sida joogtada ah ciidamada uga dira howlgallada gobolka, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay tahay dalka uu ka socdo howlgalkii ugu dheeraa uguna ballaarnaa ee ciidamadeeda dibadda. Uganda ayaa sanadkii 2007 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyey ee ciidamo u dira Soomaaliya, markii la aas-aasay howlgalka Midowga Afrika. Waxay markii dambe noqotay dalka ciidanka ugu badan ku biiriya howlgalka. Ciidamada Uganda ayaa hadda ka tirsan howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, waxayna ciidamada Soomaaliya ka taageeraan dagaalka Al-Shabaab iyo ilaalinta magaalooyinka, waddooyinka iyo xarumaha muhiimka ah. Ciidamo kale oo Ugandheys ah ayaa ka tirsan cutubka ilaalada Qaramada Midoobay ee Muqdisho, kuwaas oo ilaaliya xarumaha iyo shaqaalaha hay’adda. Si kastaba, mustaqbalka howlgalka Soomaaliya ayaa wajahaya hubanti la’aan ka dhalatay dhaqaale yari iyo cadaadis lagu saarayo dowladda Soomaaliya inay la wareegto mas’uuliyad dheeraad ah oo dhinaca amniga ah. Uganda waxay ku dhowaad labaatan sano ciidamo ku lahayd Soomaaliya, inkastoo howlgalka Midowga Afrika uu la kulmay khasaare culus iyo muranno soo noqnoqday oo ku saabsan mushaharka, gunnooyinka iyo taageerada saadka. Ciidamada Uganda ayaa sidoo kale ka howlgala bariga Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Congo, halkaas oo ay ciidamada Congo kula dagaallamaan kooxda Allied Democratic Forces, oo xiriir la leh ururka Daacish. Uganda waxay sidoo kale ciidamo iyo tababarayaal ku leedahay Koonfurta Suudaan iyo Equatorial Guinea, iyadoo horay uga qeyb qaadatay howlgallo laga fuliyey Jamhuuriyadda Afrikada Dhexe. items.title: Kleptocracy and Nepotism: The Family Business of Somalia
items.description: By Mukhtar H. Qoransay There is a country in the Horn of Africa where the president’s term expired in May , and the president responded the way a man responds to an expired gym membership: he kept using the equipment and dared anyone to say something. Welcome to Somalia, 2026. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s mandate ran out on 15 May; parliament’s a month earlier. There has been no election. Instead there was a rewrite, and the timing is the whole story. On 4 March 2026, with weeks remaining before its own term expired, parliament approved a revised constitution stretching the mandates of federal institutions from four years to five. The president signed it on 8 March and discovered, to what I assume was his complete surprise, that he was now entitled to an extra year in office. Imagine writing yourself a permission slip a few weeks before the deadline, signing it, grading it, then framing it. Start with the ground, because in the prank state even the earth is for sale. The Coalition of Somalia Human Rights Defenders has documented substantial tracts of public land sold to tycoons with the complicity of senior officials, including, it says, the president. Since 2022 dozens of public properties, among them markets, military camps and government buildings, have passed from the Somali people to the well-connected, and the poor sheltering there were cleared to make room. When security forces emptied the Horseed and Tarabuunka plots in Mogadishu, four people died. The government blamed “militias”; the men in the gunfight wore uniforms. Eviction of IDPs from public land with no prior notice nor support plan And how did the president answer the outrage? With a joke. “The Somali mother,” he told a gathering, “shouldn’t care whether I own a high-rise building or a small one; that’s not her business.” The Somali mother, Mr President, buried the four who died at Tarabuunka. It is precisely her business. The liquidation has gone international. Foreign Ministry correspondence seen by this author shows the government put the ambassador’s residence in Le Vésinet, one of the wealthiest suburbs of Paris, on the market in December 2024 for €2,500,000. A second letter, dated 5 July 2026, weeks after the president’s mandate expired, instructs the embassy to accept €1,800,000: seven hundred thousand below its own asking price, rushed to closing by an administration racing a clock only it can see. When a government whose term has run out discounts the state’s house in Paris, the question is no longer whether the state is being looted. It is what will be left by the time someone turns off the lights. And who holds what remains? In my years in Somali public service I watched the revenue points of the state quietly become a family estate. I name no private individuals, but the arrangement is known to everyone in Mogadishu who has tried to do business: the national quality-control and standards bureau, headed by one of the president’s in-laws; the airport, administered by a close relative; the seaport, by a relative of that relative; the VIP and cargo terminals, where traders report being squeezed for payments they never agreed to, under the son of the president’s second wife; the immigration and visa-entry contract, held by the president’s wife and her family; the airport bus terminal, run by the president’s brother; the airport cleaning contract, awarded to a company belonging to the member of parliament who serves as the president’s own chief of security. Every one of those is a point where money enters the Somali state, or fails to. People say this government cannot collect revenue. It collects revenue beautifully; the revenue simply arrives somewhere other than the treasury, which is why soldiers and civil servants wait months for salaries in a country whose private money-transfer firms move billions flawlessly. The Somali state cannot do what a Somali teenager with a phone and a hawala account does before breakfast. This is no longer corruption within a state. It is a state reorganised as a household. What we have now is a prank state built on institutionalised nepotism. Watch, then, how the prank state manufactures leaders. In Galmudug the ruling party has decreed a single candidate. Not nominated after a contest: decreed. He is a khat trader and former militia commander whom the president appointed to oversee military logistics in the region, a portfolio one of his own associates called “a huge project with a lot of profit. Millions of dollars.” The incumbent was eased aside with what the Somali press openly calls a golden handshake. Galmudug votes on 30 July, and in Mogadishu nobody needs the result to know the outcome. Baidoa perfected the method first. In March, South West State’s lawmakers re-elected Abdiaziz Laftagareen. Mogadishu called that vote unconstitutional, a word this government deploys exclusively against other people’s elections, and sent in the national army. Laftagareen resigned, later saying he was forced out, or bought off. In June the man raised in his place won 88 of 90 votes after his rival withdrew citing irregularities; on voting day the winner was still Speaker of the federal parliament. Hirshabelle is next, and nobody expects the third performance to deviate from the script. This is not a series of elections but an assembly line, and it assembles regional presidents who owe their chairs to Villa Somalia rather than to the people they govern. Captured regions are not trophies; they are revenue. And the men who run this machinery? On Sunday, the Kenyan press reported, Somalia’s State Minister at the Presidency was refused entry at Nairobi’s airport over the Kenyan passport he was travelling with, and placed on a flight back to Mogadishu. He was not the first. A month earlier the Deputy Prime Minister, the same man who served as interim leader of South West State and handed power to its new president in Baidoa, was stopped there over a Kenyan passport he was alleged to have obtained fraudulently and, per sources cited by the Kenyan press, admitted possessing it but refused to surrender it, proposing the courts settle the matter. He made that argument from the VIP lounge, where he waited until they walked him onto a flight home. He has since publicly denied wrongdoing, saying he never acted against the security or sovereignty of either country. It is a denial that answers a question nobody had asked. Mogadishu’s response was to summon Kenya’s ambassador for an explanation: a sovereign republic demanding to know why its ministers cannot enter a neighbour on that neighbour’s passports. Now set that beside this. On 12 April, intelligence officers arrested Sadia Moalim Ali, known across Mogadishu as “Sadia Bajaj”, a 27-year-old tuktuk driver whose crime was saying on Facebook and TikTok what this article says in print: that corruption is eating the state, that the young have no work, that fuel and taxes crush the poor while officials feast. On 25 June, after nearly three months in detention, the Banadir Regional Court sentenced her to three years in prison. Her lawyer argued the prosecution had produced insufficient evidence; the judges convicted her anyway. Amnesty International, which is still demanding her immediate and unconditional release, calls the detention arbitrary and tied solely to the peaceful expression of her views. In one video she had said that if any harm came to her, responsibility would lie with the president. A tuktuk driver showed more courage on a phone screen than the entire cabinet has shown in office, and drew three years for it, in a country where nobody has been charged over the sale of the state’s house in Paris. She is in a cell for describing the prank; the men who perform it are in the departure lounge on another country’s passport. Understand this much: Somalis are not a broken people attached to a broken state. They are an unbreakable people attached to a broken political class, and I include the opposition grandees now rediscovering their love of constitutions they ignored when the microphone was theirs. The presidency circulates among a small circle of men who pass it like a wedding microphone, each convinced the last singer ruined the song; eighteen million Somalis were never consulted about the playlist. This is a nation that lost its government in 1991 and answered by building one of the world’s most sophisticated informal economies. Families rebuilt Mogadishu’s skyline with remittances while their leaders rebuilt their compounds with the national budget. This week the question moved abroad. In Kampala, the African countries whose soldiers have held Somalia together for two decades met to decide the future of the African Union mission, at a moment when its funding is collapsing. Somalia’s opposition coalition wrote to those governments formally, noting that the president’s mandate expired on 15 May and asking them to weigh that fact before committing anything further. It is a reasonable request. States that send their own soldiers to die in another country are entitled to know who they are dying for. So, to the international community that funds this theatre and attends its performances: stop reviewing the play and start auditing the theatre. Who sold which land, and to whom. Why the state’s house in Paris was discounted €700,000 by a government with an expired mandate. Which relatives hold which contracts, and which terminals collect which fees. And while the auditors work, open the cell in Mogadishu Central Prison: a government that jails a tuktuk driver for describing corruption while its ministers are turned back at foreign borders on other countries’ passports has already confessed what any investigation would find. The president says the new constitution is the law of the land. Very well. Let him be the first man in Somali history governed by the document he wrote. The rest of us are done being the punchline: the taxpayers, the diaspora, the mothers of Tarabuunka whose business it very much is, the driver in her cell who told the truth for free. Mukhtar H. items.title: Puntland Mourns the Passing of Beeldaaje Ahmed Mataan Hassan, a Revered Custodian of Tradition and Unity
items.description: Garowe (WDN) – Puntland is mourning the loss of one of its most respected traditional leaders following the death of Beeldaaje Ahmed Mataan Hassan, whose passing marks the end of a distinguished life dedicated to customary leadership, conflict resolution, and the preservation of Somali traditions. The veteran elder died on Thursday in Garowe, just one day after returning from an extended stay abroad, including time in Egypt. His death has prompted an outpouring of grief from political leaders, fellow traditional elders, scholars, and members of the public, many of whom remembered him as a wise mediator, a champion of peace, and a steadfast guardian of Puntland’s cultural heritage. Beeldaaje Ahmed Mataan Hassan served as the Traditional Leader, a position that placed him at the heart of community leadership during a period of profound political and social transformation in Puntland and Somalia. Although he was formally installed as Beeldaaje in October 2023, his influence in traditional affairs extended back many years. Long before assuming the title, he was widely consulted on matters of customary law, reconciliation, and communal relations, earning a reputation for wisdom, patience, moderation, and sound judgment. His coronation in Farjano, Buurtinle District, in the Nugaal region was attended by some of Somalia’s most prominent traditional leaders, reflecting both his personal stature and the respect he commanded across clan and regional lines. The ceremony was widely viewed as a reaffirmation of the enduring importance of Somalia’s indigenous governance system at a time when traditional institutions continue to play a crucial role in maintaining social cohesion. Throughout his life, Beeldaaje Ahmed championed dialogue over confrontation. Those who knew him describe a leader who consistently encouraged the peaceful settlement of disputes, respect for Somali customary law ( xeer ), and constructive cooperation between traditional institutions and modern state structures. In Puntland, where traditional elders remain central to conflict resolution, reconciliation efforts, and community cohesion, his voice carried considerable moral authority. His counsel was frequently sought during periods of political tension and local disputes, where his calm demeanor and balanced approach helped preserve stability and mutual understanding. His passing represents not only a profound loss to his particular clan community but also a significant loss to Puntland’s broader traditional leadership. At a time when Somalia continues to navigate complex political, security, and social challenges, respected elders such as Beeldaaje Ahmed have remained indispensable bridges between communities, government institutions, and society. Messages of condolence have poured in from Puntland’s leadership, fellow traditional elders, civil society organizations, and citizens across the region. Many praised his lifelong commitment to unity, justice, and public service, describing him as a leader who embodied dignity, humility, integrity, and wisdom. As Puntland prepares to bid farewell to one of its distinguished sons, many believe Beeldaaje Ahmed Mataan Hassan leaves behind a legacy that extends far beyond his title. His life reflected the enduring role of Somalia’s traditional institutions in preserving peace, safeguarding social harmony, resolving disputes, and guiding communities through times of both prosperity and uncertainty. Though his voice has fallen silent, the principles he championed—dialogue, reconciliation, justice, and communal responsibility—will continue to inspire future generations of traditional leaders and the communities they serve. May Allah (SWT) have mercy upon Beeldaaje Ahmed Mataan Hassan, forgive his shortcomings, and grant him the highest ranks of Jannatul Firdaws. May He also grant patience, strength, and comfort to his family, the Muuse Nooleys (Idigfacle) community, and the people of Puntland during this time of mourning. Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji’un. items.title: Puntland Declares Victory Over Armed Factions, Vows Single Unified Security Command
items.description: Bosaso (WDN) – Puntland authorities have declared a major security victory after announcing that state forces had seized full control of the former Puntland Security Force (PSF) headquarters in Bosaso, describing the operation as a decisive step toward dismantling unauthorized armed groups and establishing a single, unified security command across the state. In a statement issued on Thursday, the Puntland Defense Forces confirmed they had taken control of the facility previously occupied by the PSF, a force the government says had been operating outside Puntland’s legally recognized security structure. The announcement follows a broader security operation launched a day earlier in Galkayo, where Puntland forces targeted armed groups accused of undermining public order, state authority, and regional stability. According to the government, security forces detained 101 suspects, while 60 wounded fighters were taken into custody. Authorities also reported seizing a substantial cache of weapons, ammunition, military vehicles, communications equipment, and police gear, including uniforms, boots, and handcuffs. Puntland further alleged that some of the recovered equipment formed part of an earlier donation from the Chinese government to the Somali Police Force. Officials said the operation was conducted in accordance with Puntland’s Constitution and laws, stressing that its objective was to protect civilians, strengthen state institutions, and reinforce the rule of law. Toward a Single Security Command More significantly, Puntland used the operation to announce what could become one of the most consequential shifts in its security policy in years. The government declared that all armed groups operating outside Puntland’s official security institutions must either disarm or surrender, including formations claiming allegiance to Somalia’s Federal Government. Officials made clear that Puntland will no longer tolerate parallel military structures or competing chains of command, insisting that the state recognizes only one lawful security authority responsible for maintaining public order and defending Puntland’s territory. Authorities called on all remaining armed groups to surrender voluntarily and return to the legal security framework, warning that those who refuse will face continued military operations and prosecution under Puntland law. The government also cautioned that anyone providing shelter, logistical support, or other assistance to armed groups would be held legally accountable. Puntland appealed to residents to continue cooperating with security agencies by reporting individuals or groups involved in activities that threaten public safety. Citizens were encouraged to use the state’s emergency hotline, with authorities pledging to protect the identity and safety of those providing information. The latest operation marks a significant effort by Puntland to consolidate all security institutions under a centralized command structure. Officials argue that eliminating parallel armed formations is essential to strengthening governance, preventing internal fragmentation, and ensuring long-term stability. If fully implemented, the policy would effectively end the presence of competing armed organizations within Puntland and establish a single, unified security architecture under the authority of the Puntland Government—an outcome officials describe as fundamental to safeguarding the state’s security, stability, and rule of law. items.title: Somali Cabinet Approves Key Trade Law, Pushes Digital Governance and Defends National Passport
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Somalia’s Federal Cabinet on Thursday approved a series of measures aimed at strengthening governance, modernizing public administration, and promoting economic reforms, while Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre urged government officials to use only Somali passports during official foreign travel. The weekly Cabinet meeting, chaired by Prime Minister Hamza, focused on national security, economic development, judicial reform, and the digital transformation of government services. A key item on the agenda was a comprehensive briefing from the Ministry of Internal Security on the rollout of Somalia’s third-generation polycarbonate electronic passport (E-Passport). Officials told the Cabinet that the new biometric passport incorporates enhanced security features designed to improve document integrity, facilitate international travel, and strengthen the global credibility of Somali travel documents. The ministry also announced that personal information on newly issued passports can no longer be altered after issuance, describing the measure as an important safeguard against fraud and document manipulation. The Cabinet also reviewed first- and second-quarter (Q1 and Q2) performance reports submitted by government ministries, alongside progress on implementing an electronic Cabinet (E-Cabinet) system, a digital platform intended to modernize Cabinet administration, improve decision-making, and streamline government operations. In a significant economic policy decision, ministers approved the Draft Law on Rules of Origin, introduced by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. The legislation is expected to strengthen Somalia’s trade regulatory framework by establishing clearer standards for determining the origin of goods, improving quality control, and enhancing confidence in products traded both domestically and internationally. Addressing the Cabinet, Prime Minister Hamza briefed ministers on his recent visit to the North Eastern State, praising what he described as the unity and cooperation demonstrated by the regional administration and its residents. Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre also congratulated the people and administration of Galmudug following the completion of the state’s recent one-person, one-vote elections, describing the exercise as an important democratic milestone. However, critics reject that characterization, arguing that the reality on the ground tells a different story. They contend that the outcome had effectively been decided long before ballots were cast, with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP) candidate widely perceived as the predetermined winner. In their view, the election was little more than a managed political exercise designed to legitimize a prearranged outcome rather than reflect the genuine will of the electorate. The Prime Minister called on all ministers and senior government officials to travel exclusively on Somali passports during official overseas visits, arguing that doing so reinforces the country’s sovereignty and enhances the international standing of the Somali state. Hamza also commended Second Deputy Prime Minister Jibril Abdirashid Haji for voluntarily renouncing his foreign passport, describing the decision as an act of patriotism and respect for Somalia’s national symbols. Its important to note that the recent barring of several officials from President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration from entering Kenya has become a significant embarrassment for the Federal Government of Somalia, particularly in the absence of any apparent response or accountability from Mogadishu. The incident has also raised broader questions about the administration’s vetting and appointment process. The appointments are driven less by merit, competence, or integrity than by an individual’s proximity to the President, his family, or his inner circle, fueling strong concerns about favoritism and weakening public confidence in the credibility of government institutions. The Cabinet concluded its session by approving a change to the membership of the Judicial Service Commission following a recommendation from the Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs. Under the decision, Ali Macalin was replaced by legal expert Adan Kuulow Macalin Qasim, a move the government said is intended to further strengthen judicial administration and the rule of law. Nevertheless, it is no secret that President Hassan exercises tight control over appointments throughout his administration. All recent nominations are widely seen as the sole work of the President, with little or no meaningful input from the relevant ministries or government institutions. Whether at the junior or senior level, virtually every appointment begins and ends in his office, leaving ministries and other state institutions with little meaningful authority over responsibilities that would ordinarily fall within their mandate. The ministry also announced that personal information on newly issued passports can no longer be altered after issuance, describing the measure as an important safeguard against fraud and document manipulation. The Cabinet also reviewed first- and second-quarter (Q1 and Q2) performance reports submitted by government ministries, alongside progress on implementing an electronic Cabinet (E-Cabinet) system, a digital platform intended to modernize Cabinet administration, improve decision-making, and streamline government operations. In a significant economic policy decision, ministers approved the Draft Law on Rules of Origin, introduced by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. The legislation is expected to strengthen Somalia’s trade regulatory framework by establishing clearer standards for determining the origin of goods, improving quality control, and enhancing confidence in products traded both domestically and internationally. Addressing the Cabinet, Prime Minister Hamza briefed ministers on his recent visit to the North Eastern State, praising what he described as the unity and cooperation demonstrated by the regional administration and its residents. Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre also congratulated the people and administration of Galmudug following the completion of the state’s recent one-person, one-vote elections, describing the exercise as an important democratic milestone. However, critics reject that characterization, arguing that the reality on the ground tells a different story. They contend that the outcome had effectively been decided long before ballots were cast, with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP) candidate widely perceived as the predetermined winner. In their view, the election was little more than a managed political exercise designed to legitimize a prearranged outcome rather than reflect the genuine will of the electorate. The Prime Minister called on all ministers and senior government officials to travel exclusively on Somali passports during official overseas visits, arguing that doing so reinforces the country’s sovereignty and enhances the international standing of the Somali state. Hamza also commended Second Deputy Prime Minister Jibril Abdirashid Haji for voluntarily renouncing his foreign passport, describing the decision as an act of patriotism and respect for Somalia’s national symbols. Its important to note that the recent barring of several officials from President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration from entering Kenya has become a significant embarrassment for the Federal Government of Somalia, particularly in the absence of any apparent response or accountability from Mogadishu. The incident has also raised broader questions about the administration’s vetting and appointment process. The appointments are driven less by merit, competence, or integrity than by an individual’s proximity to the President, his family, or his inner circle, fueling strong concerns about favoritism and weakening public confidence in the credibility of government institutions. The Cabinet concluded its session by approving a change to the membership of the Judicial Service Commission following a recommendation from the Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs. Under the decision, Ali Macalin was replaced by legal expert Adan Kuulow Macalin Qasim, a move the government said is intended to further strengthen judicial administration and the rule of law. Nevertheless, it is no secret that President Hassan exercises tight control over appointments throughout his administration. All recent nominations are widely seen as the sole work of the President, with little or no meaningful input from the relevant ministries or government institutions. Whether at the junior or senior level, virtually every appointment begins and ends in his office, leaving ministries and other state institutions with little meaningful authority over responsibilities that would ordinarily fall within their mandate. items.title: Xogta kulan caawa ka dhacay Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Madaxtooyada Qaranka ku qaabilay Taliye Ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Difaaca Jamhuuriyadda Uganda, General Sam Okiding oo booqasho ku jooga magaalada Muqdisho. General Okiding ayaa magaalada Muqdisho u yimid ka qayb-galka Shirka Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada ee dalalka ciidamada ka joogaan Soomaaliya, kaas oo diiradda lagu saarayo amniga, iskaashiga militari iyo howl-galka AUSSOM. Kulanka Madaxweynaha iyo Taliye Ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Difaaca Yugaandha ayaa qeyb ka ah kulamo isdaba joog ah oo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh la yeelanayo madaxda ciidamada dalalka ka qeyb-galaya shirka, si loo xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta dhinaca amniga. Intii uu kulanku socday ayaa si gaar ah looga hadlay dardar-gelinta dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxda Al-Shabaab, sare u qaadidda iskaashiga amniga iyo tayeynta wada-shaqeynta dalalka saaxiibka la ah Soomaaliya ee taageera nabadda iyo xasilloonida dalka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa dowladda iyo shacabka Uganda uga mahadceliyay doorka muuqda ee ay ka qaadanayaan dib u dhiska hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliyeed iyo taageerada ay siiyaan howlaha lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii xoojinta iskaashiga istaraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Uganda, isaga oo xusay in wada-shaqeynta labada dal ay laf-dhabar u tahay dadaallada lagu ciribtirayo argagixisada. Uganda ayaa ka mid ah dalalka ciidamada ugu badan u soo diray Soomaaliya, iyadoo ciidamadeedu door muuqda ka qaataan howl-galka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasillinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), kaas oo ka garab shaqeeya Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka. items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada DF oo sixid iyo wax ka bedel ku sameeyay magacaabis hore oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Wasiirrada Soomaaliya ayaa si rasmi ah u ansixiyay dhammaan xubnaha magacaabista ku imaanaya ee ka mid noqonaya Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka, si waafaqsan qodobka 145-aad ee dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Golaha oo fadhi hore ku ansixiyay afarta xubnood ayaa maanta dib u sixid iyo bedel ku sameeyay xubnahan kadib soojeedin ka timid Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka. Xubinka la badeley ayaa ah Cabdiqaadir Cali Macalin, waxaana lagu badeley xeeldheere sharci Aadan Kuuloow Macalin Qaasim. Xubnaha goluhu ansixiyay ayaa kala ah: Maxamed-deeq Macallin Aadan Maryan Sheekh Cismaan Cabdirisaaq Maxamed Ismaaciil Aadan Kuuloow Macallin Qaasim Xubnahan ayaa isugu jira qareenno sare, xeeldheereyaal sharci iyo barayaal muddo dheer ka soo shaqeynayay horumarinta cilmiga iyo ku dhaqanka sharciga, kuwaas oo leh aqoon iyo waayo-aragnimo heer sare ah. Waxay xubinnimada Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka ku adeegayaan muddo shan (5) sano ah, iyagoo door muhiim ah ka qaadan doona gudashada waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee Golaha. Xubnaha kale ee Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka ayaa ku imaanayaan xilkooda (hadba mas’uulka xilkaas haya uu ka mid noqonayo golahan), waxayna xilalkan kala yihiin: Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Dastuurka Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka Guddoomiyeyaasha Maxkamadaha Kore ee Dowlad-goboleedyada iyo Maamulka Caasimadda Jamhuuriyadda Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha. items.title: Laba musharax oo isku diiwaan-geliyay xilka guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta soo xiray diiwaangelinta musharrixiinta u tartameysa xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, taasoo loo qorsheeyey in ay laba maalin socoto. Waxaa maanta xafiiska guddiga ee xarunta guddiga ee Villa Hargeysa iska diiwaangeliyay laba musharrax oo u taagan hoggaanka Golaha Shacabka, kuwaas oo buuxiyay shuruudihii looga baahnaa tartanka. Labada musharrax ee sida rasmiga ah loo diiwaangeliyay ayaa kala ah Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Cumar Macallin (Daada) iyo Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), sida uu shaaciyay Guddiga Doorashada. Guddigu wuxuu sheegay in labada musharrax ay is-diiwaangeliyeen kahor waqtigii kama dambaysta ahaa ee loo asteeyay diiwaangelinta, islamarkaana la dhammeystiray hubinta iyo aqbalaadda codsiyadooda. Guddiga doorashada ee Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa asteeyay in maalinta Sabtida ah taariikhduna ay ku beegantahay 08-08-2026 la guddoonsiiyo musharixiinta maanta is diiwaangeliyey shahaadadooda musharaxnimo, si ay uga qeyb-galaan doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo dhowaan dhici doonta. Doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa la filayaa inay qabsoonto 10-ka bishaan, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo cidda ku guuleysan doonta xilkan muhiimka ah ee hoggaanka Golaha Shacabka. Si kastaba, Jaamac oo kamid labada musharax ee maanta isdiiwaan-geliyay ayaa taageero weyn ka helaya Villa Soomaaliya oo dooneysa inay ku guuleysato kursigaas, si uusan uga bixin gacanta shaqsiyaadka daacadda u ah Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Arrimahan ayaa imanaya xilli mucaaradka uu weli muujinayo in uusan ku qanacsanayn qaabka loo wajahayo doorashada guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, inkastoo ay jiraan dadaallo socda oo lagu doonayo in dhammaan xildhibaannadu si buuxda uga qayb qaataan codbixinta. Haddii xildhibaannada mucaaradku si mideysan uga qayb-galaan doorashada waxay saameyn weyn ku yeelan karaan natiijada, isla markaana ay suuragal tahay inay ka adkaadaan musharraxa ay taageerayso Villa Soomaaliya. items.title: SACUUDIGA OO MAGACAABAY TALIYAHA CUSUB EE HOGGAAMINAYA ISBAHAAYSI CIIDAN OO AY SOOMAALIYA XUBIN KA TAHAY
items.description: Dowladda Sacuudiga ayaa ku dhawaaqday magacaabista Admiral Abdullah bin Salem Al-Shehri oo loo magacaabay taliyaha hoggaaminaya ciidamada isbahaysiga cusub ee ay ku mideysan yihiin dalal ka tirsan dunida Islaamka. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Sacuudiga ayaa Admiral Abdullah bin Salem Al-Shehri ku tilmaantay sarkaal ciidan oo leh khibrad sare iyo hoggaan militari oo heer wanaagsan, iyadoo magacaabistiisa lagu tilmaamay tallaabo muhiim u ah isku-dubbaridka ciidamada dalalka xubnaha ka ah isbahaysiga. Isbahaysigan oo Sacuudigu ku dhawaaqay 30-kii July 2026 ayaa waxaa xubno ka ah Sacuudiga, Soomaaliya, Bahrain, Bangladesh, Comoros, Jabuuti, Masar, Urdun, Kuwait, Pakistan, Qatar, Sudan, Türkiye iyo Yemen. Magacaabista Admiral Al-Shehri ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli dalalka gobolka ay si gaar ah diiradda u saarayaan amniga iyo ilaalinta marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah, gaar ahaan Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab Al-Mandab. Soomaaliya oo ku jirta dalalka xubnaha ka ah isbahaysigan ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah qorshayaasha amniga badda, maadaama ay leedahay xeeb ka mid ah kuwa ugu dheer Afrika, isla markaana ay ku taallo meel istiraatiiji ah oo isku xirta Badweynta Hindiya, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas. Magacaabista taliyaha cusub waxay muujin kartaa in isbahaysigu u gudbayo marxalad cusub oo diiradda lagu saarayo isku-xirka ciidamada, ilaalinta marin-biyoodka iyo xoojinta iskaashiga amni ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah.

items.title: Puntland oo amartay in la soo xiro siyaasiyiin iyo saraakiil lagu tuhmayo DF
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Wasiirrada Dowlad-goboleedka Puntland oo maanta ka shiray xaaladda amni ee maamulka ayaa go’aamiyay in la soo xiro siyaasiyiin iyo saraakiil lagu eedeeyay inay khalkhal-gelin amni ka wadaan maamulka Puntland. Shirkan oo uu guddoomiyey Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni oo uu weheliyo Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka ayaa si qoto dheer looga dooday xaaladda amni ee Puntland, iyadoo goluhu bogaadiyey hawlgalada amni ee ay ciidamda difaaca maamulka maalmahaan ka fuliyeen qaybo kamid magalooyinka Puntland. Howl-galladan ayay sheegeen in lagu fashiliyey duullaan qorshaysan oo Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya uu ku doonayey in lagu khalkhal geliyo amniga iyo dowladnimada Puntland, sida lagu yiri war-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay shirka. Golaha ayaa faray dhammaan hay’adaha amniga in aan gudaha deegaannada maamulka Puntland lagula dhex socon karin ciidan iyo gaadiid aan ka tirsanayn hay’adaha amniga rasmiga ah ee maamulka. Sidoo kale, waxay fareen in ciidamadu ka hortagaan, kana hawl-galaan dambiyada abaabulann ee ka dhaca biyaha badaha sida Burcad Badeedda iyo kallumaysatada sharci darrada ah iyo in cid kasta oo ku soo xad gudubta biyaha badaha Puntland talaabo adag oo waafaqsan sharciga laga qaado. Golaha ayaa go’aamiyey in hay’adaha Caddaaladda ee Dowladda Puntland loo gudbiyo magacyada xubnaha siyaasiyiinta, saraakiisha iyo shaqsiyaadka lagu eedeeyey inay ku lug leeyihiin falal lagu khalkhal-gelinayo amniga iyo nidaamka dowladnimada Puntland si caddaaladda loo horkeeno. “Goluhu wuxuu xasuusinayaa dhammaan warbaahinta iyo saxaafadda ka hawlgasha gudaha Puntland inay ilaaliyaan xeerarka saxaafadda Dowladda Puntland iyo anshaxa guud ee mihnadda saxaafadda,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka Golaha Wasiirrada Puntland. Sidoo kale waxaa lagu yiri: “Goluhu wuxuu go’aamiyey in tallaabooyin waafaqsan sharciga laga qaado mulkiilayaasha iyo adeegsadayaasha Baraha Bulshada ee caadaystay baahinta warar aan xaqiiqda ku dhisnayn, laguna sumcad xumaynayo nidaamka dowladnimada Puntland.” Golaha ayaa ugu dambeyntiina faray ciidamada kala duwan inay waajibaadkooda u gutaan si waafaqsan Dastuurka iyo qawaaniinta kale ee dhawraysa xuquuq insaanka, isagoo ugu baaqay shacabka Puntland inay door muuqata ka qaataan ilaalinta amniga, xasilloonid iyo wadajirka bulshada, si loo adkeeyo nabadda iyo dowladnimada Puntland. items.title: Yemen Deports Somaliland Trade Representative After Two Months in Detention
items.description: Aden (WDN) – Yemeni authorities have deported Somaliland’s trade representative in Aden, Idiris Adan Rage, after holding him in detention for more than two months, according to Yemeni sources and Somali media reports. Rage was reportedly released shortly before being escorted to Aden International Airport, where he boarded an Air Djibouti flight out of Yemen. The Yemeni government has not officially disclosed the reasons behind either his arrest or subsequent deportation. Security forces arrested Rage on June 13 following a raid on Somaliland’s trade office in Aden’s Khormaksar district. The office had been operating in Aden after being relocated from the Yemeni capital, Sana’a. According to local reports, the arrest was linked to an event Rage organized on May 18 to commemorate what Somaliland marks as its Independence Day. Yemeni media reported that the gathering was held without official authorization from the Yemeni government and was attended by members of the Southern Transitional Council (STC) , the UAE-backed faction that controls large parts of southern Yemen. Somaliland lawmaker Guuleed Mohamed Warsame alleged that Yemeni security forces confiscated equipment and other property from the trade office during Rage’s detention. He also claimed that the representative was deported immediately after his release. Neither the Somaliland authorities nor the Yemeni government has issued an official statement addressing the incident. For years, Somaliland has maintained a trade office in Yemen to facilitate commercial ties and cooperation across the Gulf of Aden. However, Yemen continues to recognize the Federal Republic of Somalia as the country’s sole sovereign authority and does not recognize Somaliland as an independent state. The deportation is likely to draw renewed attention to the diplomatic constraints facing Somaliland’s overseas representations, which operate without formal recognition in most countries despite maintaining unofficial trade and liaison offices abroad. items.title: Beeldaaje Axmed Mataan oo ku geeriyooday Garoowe
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Allaha u naxariistee, Beeldaaje Axmed Mataan Xasan oo ka mid ahaa isimada dhaqanka ee Puntland ayaa maanta ku geeriyooday magaalada Garoowe, sida ay xaqiijiyeen ilo ku dhow qoyskiisa iyo madaxda dhaqanka. Marxuumka ayaa ahaa Beeldaajaha Guud ee Beesha Muuse Nooleys (Idigfacle), wuxuuna door muuqda ka soo qaatay arrimaha dhaqanka, nabadeynta iyo mideynta bulshada muddadii uu xilka hayay. Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in Beeldaaje Axmed Mataan Xasan uu shalay soo gaaray magaalada Garoowe, kaddib safar uu muddo ugu maqnaa dalka Masar, halkaas oo uu ku sugnaa bilihii la soo dhaafay. Geerida Beeldaajaha ayaa si weyn looga dareemay deegaannada Puntland, iyadoo madaxda maamulka, isimada dhaqanka iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada ay ka tacsiyeeyeen geerida marxuumka, una duceeyeen qoyskii, ehelkii iyo dhammaan shacabka uu ka baxay. Beeldaaje Axmed Mataan Xasan ayaa bishii Oktoobar ee sannadkii 2023 lagu caleema-saaray deegaanka Farjano ee degmada Buurtinle, gobolka Nugaal. Munaasabaddii caleemo-saarkiisa waxaa ka qayb galay isimmo iyo waxgarad caan ka ah guud ahaan Soomaaliya. Mudadii uu xilka hayay, marxuumku wuxuu caan ku ahaa ka shaqeynta nabadda, xalinta khilaafaadka iyo xoojinta wadajirka bulshada, isagoo ka mid ahaa isimada dhaqanka ee saameynta ku lahaa arrimaha bulshada Puntland. Geerida Beeldaaje Axmed Mataan Xasan ayaa ka dhigan luminta oday dhaqameed door muhiim ah ku lahaa bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Alle ha u naxariisto, samir iyo iimaanna haka siiyo qoyskiisa, ehelkiisa iyo dhammaan ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Innaa Lillaahi Wa Innaa Ilayhi Raajicuun. items.title: Somalia: Puntland seizes second federal camp, alleges China-donated arms diverted
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Northeastern Somalia’s Puntland security forces seized a second military camp belonging to federal government-aligned troops within 24 hours on Thursday, capturing a command centre in the commercial port city of Bosaso a day after a fierce gun battle handed regional forces control of a federal base in the central town of Galkayo – a battle that Puntland officials say produced physical evidence of Mogadishu diverting Chinese-donated police weapons and Defence Ministry arms to forces working against the region. Why This Matters Puntland has functioned as a semi-autonomous state within the Somali federation for decades, maintaining its own security forces and periodically clashing with Mogadishu over the limits of federal authority in its territory. The events described here – camp seizures, prisoner counts and a public ultimatum – represent a sharp escalation in that long-running tension, and the weapons allegation, if substantiated, would mark one of the more serious accusations Garowe has levelled at the federal government in recent memory. The Bosaso Seizure Regional police said in a statement that the camp seized in Bosaso included a military command centre belonging to the PSF force, which had aligned itself with the federal government. Troops stationed inside surrendered without a fight, the statement said, allowing Puntland forces to take the position. The Galkayo Battle and Prisoner Count The Bosaso operation followed a considerably bloodier confrontation a day earlier in Galkayo, where regional forces stormed a federal troops’ base, triggering intense fighting. Regional authorities said 101 federal fighters were captured uninjured, while a further 60 were taken prisoner after sustaining injuries in the clash – putting the total number of prisoners of war from the Galkayo operation, by Puntland’s own count, at more than 160. Weapons Cache and the China-Donation Allegation Puntland forces also recovered a substantial cache of weapons, police uniforms and other military equipment from the Galkayo base, regional officials said. Among the seized matériel, authorities said, were arms recently donated by China to Somalia’s police forces, along with boxes of weapons marked with the insignia of Somalia’s Ministry of Defence, which regional officials displayed to journalists. Puntland authorities alleged the markings point to a deliberate diversion of federal assistance: rather than reaching regional forces engaged in the fight against militant groups, they said, the weapons were instead funnelled to units they accuse Mogadishu of using to undermine security in the region and distract from counter-terrorism efforts. Neither the claim of diversion nor the origin of the weapons has been independently verified, and the federal government has not responded to the allegation as of Thursday. Deni’s Warning Speaking on Wednesday after the Galkayo operation, Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni described the assault as a clear warning to anyone seeking to destabilise the regional administration, cautioning that any force siding with Mogadishu to foment unrest or chaos within Puntland’s territory would meet the same fate. He thanked regional security forces for what he called the successful and disciplined execution of the “law enforcement operation.” What Happens Next Puntland’s regional government has since issued an ultimatum to other federal-aligned forces stationed in towns across the territory, giving them 24 hours to surrender or face a similar outcome to those overrun in Galkayo. As of Thursday, Mogadishu has issued no public response to the ultimatum, to the loss of the two camps, or to the weapons allegation. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: U.S. Participation in Special Meeting at the OAS Permanent Council on Nicaragua
items.description: U.S. Participation in Special Meeting at the OAS Permanent Council on Nicaragua Office of the Spokesperson Senior Bureau Official for Western Hemisphere Affairs Michael Kozak delivered remarks today before a Special Meeting of the Organization of American States (OAS) Permanent Council to address the Murillo-Ortega dictatorship’s threat to the peace and security of our hemisphere. The United States addressed the Permanent Council on the need for urgent action, presenting a draft resolution co-sponsored by Argentina, Costa Rica, Panama, and Paraguay to convene a Meeting of Consultation of Ministers of Foreign Affairs to determine a collective response. The United States cannot continue to act alone against the threat the Murillo-Ortega dictatorship poses to the stability of our region. Now is the time for OAS to demonstrate its value in bringing together the region to address the desecration of democratic principles and support the Nicaraguan people’s right to a future free from tyranny.

items.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo ka digtay in Soomaaliya ay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ka digtay in Soomaaliya ay wajahdo khatar sii kordheysa oo ka dhalan karta roobabka la xiriira ifafaalaha El Niño, iyadoo la saadaalinayo in xilliga roobabka ee u dhexeeya bilaha October iyo December uu sababi karo fatahaado baahsan oo saameeya qaybo badan oo dalka ah. Warbixin ay soo saartay Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Isku-duwidda Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada (OCHA) ayaa lagu sheegay in hay’adaha gargaarka iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay sare u qaadeen heerka diyaar-garowga, iyagoo diyaariyay qorshayaal degdeg ah, qiimeyn khataro iyo hannaan isku-duwid ah oo heer federaal iyo heer dowlad-goboleedba ah. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in qorshayaashan ay salka ku hayaan casharradii laga bartay musiibooyinkii sanadkii 2023, markaas oo fatahaado iyo abaaro is biirsaday ay barakiciyeen ku dhowaad 2.3 milyan oo qof, isla markaana ay sababeen xaalad bani’aadannimo oo aad u daran. Warbixintu waxay xustay in Soomaaliya ay weli la daalaa-dhaceyso dhibaatooyin is biirsaday oo ay ka mid yihiin abaaro soo noqnoqday, fatahaado, colaado hubeysan iyo hoos u dhac weyn oo ku yimid maalgelinta howlaha gargaarka bani’aadannimo. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in qiyaastii 6.5 milyan oo qof, oo u dhiganta ku dhowaad saddex meelood meel shacabka Soomaaliya, ay wajahayaan cunto yari ba’an. items.title: Somaliland trains a new generation of women justice leaders
items.description: In Hargeisa, 91 women now shaping Somaliland’s justice institutions have completed training that puts survivors — not procedure — at the centre of how justice is delivered. Delivered by UNDP through the UN Joint Rule of Law Programme II , in partnership with UN Women and the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) , with funding from the European Union . the training held on 6 to 22 July 2026 strengthened 91 participants’ legal expertise while promoting survivor-centred, gender-responsive approaches to justice and stronger collaboration across Somaliland’s justice institutions. The participants recorded an average 27-percentage-point improvement in legal skills assessments, strengthening their ability to support survivors of gender-based violence. The programme builds on broader efforts to strengthen access to justice across Somaliland. In 2025 Somaliland’s new Legal Aid Law helped more than 1,800 vulnerable people access free legal aid, including 547 women , while Baahi-Koob Centres in Hargeisa, Burao and Borama supported 464 survivors of gender-based violence with integrated legal, medical and psychosocial care. Participants represented the Attorney General’s Office, the Somaliland Judiciary, the Somaliland Women Lawyers Association ( SWLA), the Somaliland Lawyers Association ( SOLLA), the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs, Baahi-Koob Centre, Hargeisa University, the Faculty of Law and Legal Clinic, the National Human Rights Commission and civil society organizations. Opening the programme, H.E. Mohamud Abdirizak , Director General of the Ministry of Justice , emphasized that women justice professionals are central to rebuilding public trust in institutions that have historically been difficult for many women to access. Other speakers, including representatives from the Attorney General Office, Somaliland Lawyers Association and the High Court, reinforced this message, emphasizing that women are not only beneficiaries of capacity-building initiatives but also leaders and decision-makers shaping stronger justice institutions. “For women survivors, navigating the justice system can be very daunting. They often must engage with multiple institutions including community support, police, prosecution, lawyers and courts. A delay or error at one stage can create cascading effects throughout the justice pathway and have significant consequences for their wellbeing, access to justice and confidence in the system,” said Nimco Ali Jama, Attorney at the Attorney General’s Office . That perspective was reinforced by participants who stressed that strengthening women’s representation within justice institutions is equally important. “I think we need more women professionals in the justice system. While increasing the number of women may not be sufficient to transform the justice system, greater gender diversity brings a wider range of perspectives and can help address the gender power imbalances in the justice system and the legal, cultural and institutional barriers that women face in accessing justice and, in the long term, improve justice outcomes for women,” said Amina Hassan Osman, Senior Lawyer at the Somaliland Lawyers Association . The training combined technical legal knowledge with practical, gender-responsive, survivor-centred and inclusive approaches to justice. It addressed the barriers women and vulnerable groups continue to face in accessing justice, including social stigma, limited access to female justice professionals, obstacles affecting persons with disabilities, and the frequent informal resolution of serious gender-based violence and family-related cases outside the formal justice system. Participants also explored practical challenges such as incomplete investigation files, insufficient evidence, delayed medical and forensic documentation, confidentiality concerns and inappropriate pressure on prosecutors handling sensitive cases. Bringing together prosecutors, lawyers and paralegals who typically engage at different stages of a case, the training created a rare opportunity to examine the justice system as an interconnected process. Participants identified opportunities to strengthen coordination across reporting, investigation, prosecution, court proceedings and survivor support, helping reduce gaps that can affect survivors’ access to justice. “We need to gather all the information in order to establish the facts, but the way we ask can either encourage the person to speak and share experiences or make her close down,” said Khadra Hussein Mohamud , Deputy Attorney General. The impact of the training was reflected in participants’ assessment scores, which increased from 65 to 89 percent in the first cohort, 56 to 84 percent in the second and 50 to 80 percent in the third, representing an average improvement of more than 27 percentage points across all participants. About the Project The UN Joint Rule of Law Programme II is implemented by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in partnership with UN Women and the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) , with financial support from the European Union . The programme supports justice institutions across Somaliland to strengthen the rule of law, improve equitable access to justice and promote accountable, inclusive and gender-responsive justice systems. UNDP gratefully acknowledges the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands for its financial contribution through UNDP Window Funding, which contributed to the successful implementation of this training.

items.title: Somali Cabinet Ministers Directed to Travel on Somali Passports
items.description: Mogadishu, Somalia — The Council of Ministers of the Federal Government of Somalia has reviewed the country’s overall situation, with particular focus on national security, economic development and ongoing efforts to strengthen the integrity of the Somali passport system. During the meeting, the Cabinet approved by majority vote the Draft Law on the Rules of Origin of Goods, submitted by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. The proposed legislation is intended to strengthen Somalia’s trade regulatory framework and establish clear procedures for determining the country of origin of imported and exported goods. The Ministry of Internal Security presented a comprehensive report on the Somali passport system, supported by statistical data and detailed visual information. The Ministry stated that all amendments to the personal details contained in issued passports had been suspended in order to safeguard the credibility, security and international reputation of the Somali passport. Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre encouraged Cabinet ministers and other senior government officials to travel using Somali passports, stressing the importance of preserving the dignity and honour associated with public office. He also commended Second Deputy Prime Minister Jibril Abdirashid Haji Abdi for returning his foreign passport and choosing to use the Somali passport. The Council of Ministers also approved a correction to the appointment of a member of the Judicial Service Commission, following a proposal submitted by the Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs. Ali Maalin was replaced by legal expert Aden Kulow Maalin Qasim. The post Somali Cabinet Ministers Directed to Travel on Somali Passports appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Golaha Wasiirada Soomaaliya oo amar culus la dul-dhigay kadib tallaabadii KENYA
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Wasiirrada Soomaaliya oo maanta yeeshay kulankoodii toddobaadlaha ahaa, ayaa lagaga hadlay xaaladda guud ee dalka gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo warbixin ku saabsan Geeddi-socodka sameynta Baasaboorka Soomaaliya ee Jiilka Saddexaad (Polycarbonate E-Passport), kaasi oo fududeyn doona isku-socodka, dib-u-habeynta Baasaboorka dalka iyo habka ay ku helayaan muwaadiniinta. Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha oo warbixin faahfaahsan oo wadata xog naqshadaysan oo ku saabsan baasaboorka iyo tirakoobyo, ayaa warbixinta ku sheegtay in gebi ahaanba la joojiyay wax ka badelka xogta shaqsiga ah ee baasaboorka si loo xaqiijiyo sumcadda baasaboorka. Sidoo kale, kulanka oo uu shir-guddoomiyey Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo bandhigay warbixinnada Heerka Waxqabadka Wasaaradaha ee Rubuca 1-aad iyo Rubaca 2-aad ee (Q1- Q2 Ministerial Performance) iyo Qorshaha—Horumarinta Nidaamka Shaqada Golaha Wasiirrada (E-Cabinet System) kuwaas oo ay soo jeediyeen mas’uuliyiinta sarsare ee Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha iyo khubaro. Golaha Wasiiradda ayaa sidoo kale cod aqlabiyad ah ku ansixiyay Hindise-Sharciyeedka Asalka Badeecadaha oo ay soo gudbisay Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre oo golaha u sameeyay hadal-jeedin ayaa ka warbixiyay safarkii uu mardhow ku tagay dowlad goboleedka Waqooyi Bari, isaga oo bogaadiyay isku duubnaanta shacabka iyo maamulka, wuxuu sidoo kale hambalyeeyay doorashadii qof iyo cod ee ka qabsoontay Galmudug. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa wasiiradda iyo mas’uuliyiinta sarsare ee dowladda ku booriyay in ay ku safraan baasaboorka Soomaaliga si loo illaaliyo xurmadda iyo sharafta mas’uulka dowladeed leeyahay, isaga oo boggaadiyay Ra’iisul Wasaare ku xigeenka labaad Mudane Jibriil Cabdirishiid Xaaji celintii baasaboorka ajnabiga ah. Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa sixid iyo wax ka badel ku sameeyay magacaabistii xubin ka mid ah xubnaha Golaha Adeegga Garsoorka kadib soo jeedin ka timid Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka. Xubinka la badeley ayaa ah Mudane Cali Macalin, waxaana lagu badeley xeeldheere sharci Mudane Aadan Kuuloow Macalin Qaasim. items.title: Taliye Ibraahim oo la kulmay saraakiil ay soo direen Ethiopia, Kenya iyo Uganda
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho kulan xasaasi ah kula yeeshay saraakiil ka socotay ciidamada difaaca dalalka Ethiopia, Kenya iyo Uganda, kaas oo si gaar ah uga ka dhacay xafiikiisa. Wafuudaan ayaa magaalada Muqdisho uga qayb-galay Shirka Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada Difaaca ee Dalalka Ciidamada ku taageera Howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) oo lagu qabtay caasimada Soomaaliya. Intii uu socday kulanka ayaa waxaa diiradda lagu saaray is xogwaraysi iyo mahadcelin ku aaddan guusha shirka, iyadoo sidoo kale laga wada hadlay sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada difaaca, amniga iyo xiriirka wada shaqeyneed ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo dalalka ciidamada ku taageera dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda iyo xasilloonida dalka. Taliye Ibraahim ayaa uga mahadceliyay wufuudda kaalinta ay dalalkoodu ka qaadanayaan taageerada Ciidanka XDS iyo dadaallada lagu ciribtirayo kooxaha argagixisada, isagoo xusay in iskaashiga dhow uu door muhiim ah ka qaato horumarinta awoodda Ciidanka iyo xaqiijinta amniga Soomaaliya. Dhankooda, madaxda wufuudda ayaa bogaadiyay martigelinta Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, iyagoo adkeeyay sida ay uga go’an tahay sii wadidda iskaashiga iyo taageerada ay la garab taaganyihiin Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii ugu dambeeyay waday kulamo iyo wada-tashiyo joogto ah oo ay la yeelanaysay waddamada saaxiibka la ah Soomaaliya si loo mideeyo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amni waara iyo in ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si buuxda ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda sugidda amniga dalka. Ethiopia, Kenya iyo Uganda ayaa ka mid ah dalalka ugu dhow Soomaaliya dhinaca iskaashiga amniga iyo difaaca, waxaana ciidamadoodu qayb ka yihiin howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ee hadda ka socda gudaha Soomaaliya. Waddamadan ayaa sidoo kale Soomaaliya ka taageera tababarka ciidamada, is-dhaafsiga xogaha sirdoonka iyo horumarinta iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca.
