items.title: Jubaland Accuses Hassan Sheikh of Fueling Conflict in Puntland Amid Galkayo Clashes
items.description: Kismayo (WDN) – The Jubaland administration has strongly condemned the armed clashes that erupted on Wednesday between Puntland security forces and the Puntland Security Forces (PSF) in northern Galkayo, accusing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of deliberately escalating tensions in Puntland. In a statement issued by the Jubaland Presidency, the administration alleged that the Federal Government is diverting military resources away from the fight against Al-Shabaab and instead using them to provoke instability in areas that have remained relatively peaceful. “It is deeply regrettable that, while the Somali National Army units fighting Al-Shabaab—particularly in the Hiiraan region—continue to face shortages of weapons and logistical support, military equipment and arms are instead being transported into peaceful areas where security and stability have already been established,” the statement said. Jubaland argued that such actions risk undermining national security priorities at a time when Somali forces remain engaged in intense operations against Al-Shabaab in several regions of the country. The administration further warned that the reported movement of weapons and military personnel into Puntland threatens peace, stability, and social cohesion, while jeopardizing the hard-earned progress made in restoring security and reconciliation in the divided city of Galkayo. Jubaland also praised what it described as the unity demonstrated by the Puntland Government and its people in confronting what it characterized as an attempt to destabilize the regional administration. “The people and leadership of Puntland deserve recognition for standing together to defend the state’s security and constitutional order,” the statement said. Wednesday’s fighting in Galkayo resulted in casualties, although the exact number of those killed or wounded has yet to be independently confirmed. The latest accusations underscore the widening political and security rift between Somalia’s Federal Government and two of its largest Federal Member States—Puntland and Jubaland—raising fresh concerns that internal disputes are increasingly spilling over into armed confrontations at a time when Al-Shabaab continues to mount significant offensives across southern and central Somalia. items.title: Egypt Rejects Ethiopia’s Maritime Ambitions, Highlighting Somalia’s Diplomatic Vulnerability
items.description: Cairo/Mogadishu (WDN) – Egypt has openly rejected any arrangement that would allow Ethiopia to secure a port facility or military base in Somalia or Eritrea, once again highlighting the intense geopolitical competition unfolding across the Horn of Africa and raising questions about Somalia’s ability to independently shape regional decisions affecting its sovereignty and security. Egyptian writer and political analyst Emad El-Din Hussein reported that Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty firmly dismissed the possibility of Cairo accepting an Ethiopian maritime presence on the Red Sea or Indian Ocean coast, even if Addis Ababa were to offer a final settlement over the long-running dispute surrounding the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD). According to Hussein, reports had circulated suggesting that Ethiopia was exploring a possible deal linking access to a maritime outlet with progress on resolving the GERD dispute. However, the Egyptian Foreign Minister stated that no such proposal had been formally presented to Cairo by the Ethiopian government. The remarks come amid intensifying strategic competition in the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea, where access to ports, military bases, and maritime routes has become increasingly central to regional power struggles. Egypt reiterated its support for Somalia’s sovereignty, territorial integrity, and national unity, while opposing what it described as any unilateral actions that could undermine Somalia’s federal government or destabilize the wider region. For Somalia, however, the episode reflects a broader diplomatic challenge: despite being the country whose coastline and sovereignty are directly affected, major regional powers continue to dominate discussions over maritime access and security arrangements in the Horn of Africa. Ethiopia’s Search for Sea Access Ethiopia, Africa’s most populous landlocked country, has intensified efforts in recent years to secure reliable access to the sea. Addis Ababa currently depends heavily on Djibouti for the majority of its international trade, a dependence Ethiopian leaders have repeatedly described as a strategic vulnerability. The issue became a major regional flashpoint after Ethiopia signed a memorandum of understanding with Somaliland in January 2024, reportedly seeking access to coastal facilities in exchange for possible recognition-related arrangements. Somalia’s Federal Government strongly rejected the agreement, describing it as a violation of its sovereignty and territorial integrity. Although Somalia and Ethiopia later agreed in late 2024 to resolve their disagreements through dialogue, the question of Ethiopia’s long-term maritime access remains unresolved. No formal agreement currently exists granting Ethiopia a port or military base in Somalia or Eritrea. Claims that maritime access could be linked to negotiations over the GERD dispute remain based on unverified reports rather than confirmed diplomatic agreements. A Region of Competing Interests The dispute illustrates the increasingly complex strategic environment surrounding the Horn of Africa. Egypt views Ethiopia’s expanding regional influence—particularly its control over the Nile through the GERD and its search for maritime access—as a direct strategic concern. Ethiopia, meanwhile, argues that access to the sea is an economic and security necessity for a nation of more than 120 million people. Caught between these competing interests is Somalia, a country with one of Africa’s longest coastlines but limited political leverage due to internal divisions, security challenges, and dependence on international support. The growing involvement of Egypt, Ethiopia, Turkey, the Gulf states, and other international actors in Somalia’s affairs has raised concerns that decisions affecting Somalia’s strategic future are increasingly shaped by external powers rather than through a unified national diplomatic strategy. As competition over the Red Sea and Horn of Africa intensifies, Somalia faces a critical challenge: strengthening its own diplomatic capacity and ensuring that regional agreements involving its territory are determined by Somali interests rather than the agendas of neighboring states. items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo sheegay inay gubeen markab shidaal Sacuudiga leeyahay
items.description: Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa Arbacadan sheegay in Ciidamada Yemen ay gubeen markab shidaal oo marayay waqooyiga Badda Cas. Afhayeenka ayaa sheegay in ciidamadu ay si guul leh u bartilmaameedsadeen markabka shidaalka Sacuudiga ee NCC WAFA meel u dhow Dekedda Yanbu ee ku taala Badda Cas. Afhayeenka ayaa Warbaahinta u sheegay in weerarka loo adeegsaday tiro gantaalada ballaastikada ah. General Yahya Saree ayaa tilmaamay in tallaabadan lagaga jawaabayay diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Sacuudiga oo ku soo xadgudbay buu yiri hawada Magaalada Sacda (Saada). General Saree ayaa intaasi ku daray, tan iyo markii 20-kii bishii July ay go’doominta badeed ku soo rogeen Dekedaha Sacuudiga inay Marinka Bab El-Mandeb ka celiyeen 29 markab oo kuwa shidaalka ah, isla-markaana lala xiriiriyay xeebaha dalkaasi. Maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ayaa daba-yaaqadii bishii hore ee July bilaabay inay ka weecdaan marinka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab El-Mandeb ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, ka dib markii Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ay 22-kii bishaasi bilaabeen hawlgalo lagu beegsanayo maraakiibta isku daya inay jebiyaan xayiraadaha saaran Dekedaha Sacuudiga. Xuutiyiinta ayaa maraakiibta shidaalka iyo kuwa shixnadaha ganacsiga ee ku sii jeeda Dekedaha Sacuudiga ama ka imaanaya ka mamnuucay inay adeegsadaan Badda Cas iyo Bab El-Mandeb. Shirkadaha gaadiidka xamuulka badda oo ka fogaanaya in ay bartilmaameed noqdaan ayaa ka wareegaya Bab El-Mandeb, iyagoo adeegsanaya biyaha Afrika, si ay uga taxadaraan badqabka shaqaalahooda iyo badeecadaha.

items.title: Saadad Caliyow oo ka Haray Tartanka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka
items.description: Saadad Caliyow, oo horay isaga casilay xilkii Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, ayaa si rasmi ah uga haray tartanka musharaxnimada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, isagoo taageeradiisa ku dhawaaqay inuu siinayo musharraxa kale ee u taagan xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadit Maxamed Nuur Jaamac. Ka bixitaanka Saadad Caliyow ayaa wax ka beddelaya loollanka xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, iyadoo hadda tartanka uu kusoo haray Wasiir Jaamac. Sida wararku sheegayaan, Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur, ayaa door muuqda ku lahaa dadaallada iyo wada-hadallada horseeday in Saadad Caliyow uu ka tanaasulo tartanka. Tallaabadan ayaa loo arkaa mid xoojin karta dhinaca musharraxa uu Saadad Caliyow taageeradiisa siiyay, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo sida ay arrintani u saameyn doonto tartanka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka iyo xulashada hoggaanka cusub ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya.

items.title: DF oo shaacisay inay warshado waa weyn ka hirgelinayso magaalada…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa shaacisay qorshe ay ku doonayso inay warshado waaweyn uga hirgeliso degmada Balcad ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay door muhiim ah ka qaadan doonaan kor u qaadista wax-soo-saarka dalka iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha. Qorshahan ayaa lagu dhawaaqay intii uu wafdi uu hoggaaminayay Wasiirka Beeraha iyo Waraabka XFS, Maxamed Cabdi Xayir Maareeye booqasho ku tagay degmada Balcad, halkaas oo ay ku qaabileen maamulka degmada iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Wasiir Maareeye ayaa sheegay in Balcad loo qorsheeyay in laga hirgeliyo warshado waaweyn, isagoo xusay in dowladda ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso kordhinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha iyo dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga dalka. “Degmada Balcad waxa aan ka hirgelin doonnaa warshado waaweyn, maadaama dalku galay marxalad isku-filnaansho ah. Soomaaliya waxay ka gudbaysaa xilligii ay ku tiirsanayd kaalmo dibadeed,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Maareeye. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in dowladda ay waddo qorshe ballaaran oo lagu horumarinayo beeraha, warshadaha iyo kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, si loo abuuro shaqooyin cusub loona xoojiyo wax-soo-saarka gudaha. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa muddooyinkii dambe xoogga saareysay sidii looga faa’iideysan lahaa kheyraadka iyo ilaha wax-soo-saarka dalka, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in la yareeyo ku tiirsanaanta gargaarka dibadda, lana dhiirrigeliyo maalgashiga gudaha iyo kan caalamiga ah. items.title: Joint Statement on the U.S.-Pakistan Counterterrorism Dialogue
items.description: Joint Statement on the U.S.-Pakistan Counterterrorism Dialogue Office of the Spokesperson The text of the following statement was released by the Government of the United States and by the Government of Pakistan. Begin Text. The United States and Pakistan convened for the Fourth U.S.-Pakistan Counterterrorism Dialogue on August 4, 2026, in Washington, D.C., led by U.S. Coordinator for Counterterrorism Ambassador Gregory LoGerfo and Pakistan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs Special Secretary Ambassador Nabeel Munir. The dialogue underscored shared interests in the U.S.-Pakistan counterterrorism partnership and the two countries’ determination to confront terrorism. Delegations exchanged views on the current threat environment, explored avenues to enhance collaboration, and discussed steps to strengthen border security and disrupt terrorist facilitation networks. The United States and Pakistan affirmed their joint resolve to confront terrorist organizations that endanger the safety of their citizens and the stability of the region, including ISIS-Khorasan (ISIS-K), al-Qa’ida (AQ), the Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), and the Balochistan Liberation Army (BLA) and its affiliates. The two governments committed to ensuring their counterterrorism collaboration to keep both of their nations safe and secure, and as part of an enduring vision of regional peace, prosperity, and stability.

items.title: Three Federal States, One Political Strategy, and Somalia’s Most Dangerous Gamble
items.description: By Mohamed A Yasin Somalia stands at one of the most consequential crossroads in its modern history. The national debate has moved well beyond elections, constitutional amendments, or the rivalry between competing political camps. The fundamental question now is whether the Somali state can preserve its political cohesion while confronting an insurgency that has spent nearly two decades exploiting every weakness in governance. From where I stand, Somalia’s greatest challenge is no longer primarily military—it is political. The political strategy unfolding across the country’s Federal Member States has become increasingly predictable. First comes the restructuring of regional political institutions, followed by tightly managed electoral processes whose outcomes appear evident long before the first ballot is cast. Once new regional administrations are installed, parliamentary representation follows, ultimately shaping the balance of power in Mogadishu and determining who occupies Villa Somalia. South West State provided the first major example. Galmudug has now followed an almost identical path. Hirshabelle increasingly appears destined to become the next chapter in what has become a familiar political script. Viewed through the lens of electoral arithmetic, the strategy possesses its own internal logic: consolidate influence over enough Federal Member States to secure the parliamentary numbers necessary to shape Somalia’s next presidential election. Viewed through the lens of state-building, however, the implications are far more troubling. The three Federal Member States central to this political strategy—South West State, Galmudug, and Hirshabelle—remain among the region’s most heavily affected by Al-Shabaab’s insurgency. Despite repeated military offensives, Al-Shabaab continues to exert influence across vast rural areas , collect taxes, recruit fighters, conduct sophisticated attacks, and challenge state authority. Military operations have undoubtedly produced tactical successes. Yet strategically, the picture remains deeply concerning. Again and again, government forces have liberated territory only to relinquish it months later because liberated communities were never provided with functioning administration, effective policing, justice systems, or sustainable public services. This cycle has repeated itself so frequently that it can no longer be dismissed as a temporary operational setback. It has become one of the defining structural weaknesses of the Somali state. That concern was recently echoed by General Dagvin Anderson, Commander of the United States Africa Command (AFRICOM), who expressed disappointment that areas previously liberated had once again required military operations after falling back under Al-Shabaab’s influence. His remarks reflected a lesson well understood in modern counterinsurgency: military victories rarely endure unless they are immediately followed by governance, justice, public services, and lasting stabilization. Somalia continues to struggle with precisely that transition. Meanwhile, national political attention has become increasingly consumed by constitutional disputes, electoral calculations, and competition for institutional control. This imbalance creates precisely the environment in which insurgent movements thrive. Al-Shabaab does not need to control every district or every town. It merely requires enough political dysfunction to convince local communities that government authority is temporary while its own presence appears permanent. Political fragmentation has become one of its greatest strategic assets. The deeper Somalia’s internal divisions become, the easier it becomes for militant groups to portray themselves as enduring actors, even where their authority is maintained through intimidation and violence. Perhaps the greatest contradiction confronting Somalia today is the geographic overlap between political consolidation and insurgent influence. The very Federal Member States expected to provide the parliamentary foundation for future political power remain among those where state authority is most fragile. Political control on paper cannot substitute for effective governance on the ground. History has repeatedly demonstrated that elections alone do not secure territory. Only functioning institutions, public confidence, security, justice, and accountable administration can achieve that objective. At the same time, Somalia’s federal compact itself is under unprecedented strain. Puntland has effectively severed political relations with the Federal Government and increasingly functions with the institutions, fiscal administration, and security structures of a self-governing state. Jubaland has likewise suspended political cooperation with Mogadishu following prolonged disputes with the Federal Government and has successfully resisted attempts by the center to impose its authority. Somaliland, meanwhile, has operated for more than three decades with its own government, elections, judiciary, armed forces, currency, and administrative institutions while continuing to pursue international recognition as an independent state. These are no longer isolated political disagreements. They represent three distinct political realities existing alongside the Federal Government. Against this backdrop, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud appears increasingly focused on consolidating influence within the remaining allied Federal Member States—South West State, Galmudug, and potentially Hirshabelle. Should these administrations remain politically aligned with Villa Somalia, they would collectively produce a substantial parliamentary bloc capable of shaping future federal elections. Such a strategy may succeed in securing political dominance within the institutions that continue to recognize Mogadishu’s authority. Yet it raises a far more profound constitutional question. Can any president realistically claim to govern a united Somalia when Puntland no longer cooperates politically with the Federal Government, Jubaland has likewise severed relations, and Somaliland continues to operate entirely outside Mogadishu’s authority? That question transcends electoral mathematics. It goes to the very definition of the Somali Republic. More troubling still is the reality that the Federal Member States upon which Mogadishu increasingly depends remain among those where Al-Shabaab retains its strongest foothold. Should Somalia’s political fragmentation deepen while governance continues to weaken in these regions, the country risks creating a dangerous paradox: political authority divided among competing administrations while large parts of the countryside remain vulnerable to insurgent expansion. In such circumstances, Al-Shabaab would require little additional effort. Political fragmentation would accomplish much of its strategic objective. Somalia therefore risks evolving into a country defined by multiple political centers of gravity: Somaliland continuing its long-standing pursuit of international recognition; Puntland functioning as an increasingly autonomous state; Jubaland charting its own political course; and the Federal Government exercising effective authority largely within the remaining allied Federal Member States. Whether this trajectory ultimately leads to formal constitutional separation cannot be predicted with certainty. That outcome will depend on future political decisions by Somali leaders, Federal Member States, and the wider Somali public. Yet the longer the current political impasse continues without an inclusive national settlement, the greater the danger that today’s political fragmentation becomes tomorrow’s constitutional reality. History offers a consistent warning. Insurgencies rarely defeat states solely through military superiority. More often, states weaken themselves through political division, institutional erosion, and the loss of national consensus. Somalia cannot afford to repeat that lesson once again. The country’s future will not ultimately be decided by parliamentary numbers or electoral engineering. It will be determined by whether its political leaders can restore constitutional legitimacy, rebuild trust between Mogadishu and the Federal Member States, and create a state that citizens regard as more credible, more permanent, and more legitimate than the armed movements seeking to replace it. Until that happens, military victories will remain temporary, political gains will remain fragile, and Somalia’s greatest unfinished battle will continue to be fought not on the battlefield, but in the realm of politics. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga oo ballaarinaya iskaashiga Waxbarashada Islaamka iyo Awqaafta
items.description: Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa ku heshiiyey in la ballaariyo iskaashiga dhinacyada waxbarashada Islaamka, adeegyada diinta, Sakada iyo horumarinta Awqaafta, iyadoo dowladda Turkiga ay ballanqaadday inay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya. Heshiiskan ayaa ka dhashay kulan magaalada Ankara ku dhex maray Wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka Soomaaliya, Sheekh Mukhtaar Roobow Cali, iyo Madaxweynaha Hay’adda Diinta Turkiga ee Diyanet, Prof. Dr. Safi Arpaguş. Labada dhinac ayaa ka wada hadlay sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada waxbarashada Islaamka, adeegyada diinta, horumarinta hay’adaha iyo wacyigelinta bulshada, iyadoo sidoo kale la xoojinayo iskaashiga farsamo ee lagu dhisayo laguna maamulayo Sanduuqa Sakada Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha Awqaafta. Madaxweynaha Diyanet-ka Turkiga ayaa sheegay in hay’addiisu ay sii wadi doonto taageerada barnaamijyada mudnaanta u leh Soomaaliya ee dhinaca arrimaha diinta, halka Wasiir Sheekh Mukhtaar Roobow uu soo dhaweeyey iskaashiga cusub, isagoo sheegay inuu gacan ka geysan doono xoojinta hay’adaha diinta iyo dib-u-habaynta Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale xoojiyey wada-shaqaynta ka hor inta aan la dhaqan-gelin heshiis is-afgarad ah oo rasmi ka dhigaya iskaashiga labada dal ee arrimaha diinta, waxbarashada Islaamka, tababarrada iyo dhismaha hay’adaha. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa horay u ansixisay hindise sharciyeed lagu ansixinayo heshiiska u dhexeeya Diyanet-ka Turkiga iyo Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka, waxaana la filayaa in hindisaha loo gudbiyo Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya si loo meel mariyo, kaddibna heshiiska is-afgaradku u dhaqan galo.

items.title: Abdul El-Sayed oo ku guuleystay magacaabista Dimuqraadiga ee Senate-ka Michigan
items.description: Abdul El-Sayed, oo ah dhakhtar iyo siyaasi ka tirsan xisbiga Demoqraadiga, ayaa ku guuleystay doorashadii hordhaca ahayd ee xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ee gobolka Michigan, isagoo ka adkaaday Congresswoman Haley Stevens. Guushan ayaa loo arkaa mid weyn oo u soo hoyatay garabka horumarka (progressive) ee xisbiga. El-Sayed wuxuu ololihiisa ku dhisay siyaasado ay ka mid yihiin dib-u-habeyn lagu sameeyo nidaamka maalgelinta doorashooyinka, iyo in Mareykanku joojiyo kaalmada milatari ee uu siiyo Israel. Wuxuu sidoo kale si adag uga hadlay dagaalka Gaza iyo siyaasadda Mareykanka ee Bariga Dhexe. Ololihiisa waxaa taageeray xubno caan ah oo ka tirsan garabka bidix/progressive ee Dimuqraadiga, gaar ahaan Senator Bernie Sanders iyo Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (AOC). Dhinaca kale, Haley Stevens waxaa taageerayay hoggaamiyeyaal ka tirsan xisbiga iyo kooxo siyaasadeed oo waaweyn. Abdul El-Sayed waa siyaasi Mareykan ah oo ka tirsan Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga, asal ahaanna ka soo jeeda Masar. Waa dhakhtar iyo khabiir caafimaadka dadweynaha ah, wuxuuna hore uga soo shaqeeyay maamulka caafimaadka Wayne County ee gobolka Michigan. Hadda El-Sayed wuxuu wajihi doonaa Mike Rogers, oo ah musharraxa Jamhuuriga, doorashada guud ee November 2026. Haddii uu ku guuleysto doorashadaas, wuxuu geli doonaa Senate-ka Mareykanka isagoo matalaya Michigan.

items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Labaad oo Muqdisho ku soo xiray Shirweynaha 1-aad ee Badaha Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka labaad ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Jibriil Cabdirashiid, ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ku soo xiray Shirweynaha 1-aad ee Badaha Soomaaliyeed, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray muhiimadda istaraatiijiga ah ee badaha Soomaaliya iyo sida looga faa’iideysan karo kheyraadka buluugga ah. Shirweynaha ayaa looga hadlay doorka badaha Soomaaliya ku leeyihiin koboca dhaqaalaha dalka, xoojinta amniga iyo ilaalinta xeebaha, dhowrista deegaanka badda iyo horumarinta kheyraadka dabiiciga ah ee ku jira badaha Soomaaliya. Waxaa shirweynaha ka qeyb galay masuuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Dowlad-goboleedyada, ganacsato, aqoonyahanno, cilmi-baarayaal, wakiillo ka socday hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo daneeyayaal kale oo ku howlan arrimaha badda iyo dhaqaalaha buluugga ah. Shirkan ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa fursad lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga u dhexeeya dowladda, dowlad-goboleedyada, ganacsatada iyo bahda aqoonta, si loo sameeyo qorshayaal lagu horumarinayo kalluumeysiga, dhaqaalaha badda, ilaalinta deegaanka iyo amniga xeebaha. Masuuliyiinta ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in Soomaaliya si waara uga faa’iideysato kheyraadkeeda badeed, iyadoo la ilaalinayo deegaanka iyo danaha jiilalka mustaqbalka.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo kulan la yeeshay taliyaha Ciidanka Jabuuti
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Xarunta Madaxtooyada ku qaabilay Taliyaha Ciidanka Qalabka Sida ee Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti, General Sakaria Sheekh Ibrahim, iyo saraakiil sare oo la socday. Taliyaha iyo wafdigiisa ayaa Muqdisho u yimid ka qaybgalka Shirka Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada ee dalalka ka qaybta ah Hawlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), kaasi oo diiradda lagu saarayo xoojinta iskaashiga amniga, isku-dubbaridka hawlgallada iyo dardargelinta dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya. Kulanka Madaxweynaha iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Jabuuti ayaa lagu adkeeyey xiriirka walaaltinimo iyo iskaashiga difaaca ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti, iyada oo Madaxweynaha uu uga mahadceliyey dowladda iyo shacabka Jabuuti doorka muuqda ee ay ka qaadanayaan taageerada amniga, la dagaallanka argagixisada iyo dib u dhiska hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya.

items.title: Somalia: Puntland seizes federal-aligned base in Galkayo
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Puntland security forces on Wednesday seized a military base in the northern part of Galkayo that had been held by forces aligned with Somalia’s federal government, marking the latest and most significant escalation in the long-running political and military standoff between the Puntland administration and Mogadishu. The capture represents the second major battlefield setback suffered by federal-aligned forces at the hands of a federal member state since the 2024 Raskamboni confrontation, when Jubaland forces routed more than 1,500 members of the Somali National Army (SNA) during a federal operation aimed at forcing the regional administration into compliance. According to local media reports, Puntland forces launched a large-scale assault at dawn on the base located on the northern outskirts of Galkayo near the city’s main airport. Heavy weapons and mortars were exchanged during the fighting, with shells reportedly landing in areas well beyond the immediate battlefield. Residents captured dramatic images showing thick plumes of black smoke rising above the military installation shortly after sunrise – an extraordinary sight in Galkayo, a city that has enjoyed relative calm in recent years. The whereabouts of members of the Puntland Security Force (PSF) faction aligned with Somalia’s federal government who were driven from the base remain unclear. Some reports suggested they retreated into the southern part of Galkayo, which is administered by Galmudug. The Somali Digest reported that the fall of the base effectively ends the presence of the last federal-aligned force in Puntland, eliminating what had been viewed as Mogadishu’s remaining source of military pressure against President Said Abdullahi Deni’s administration. However, most media reports indicate that federal-aligned PSF elements still maintain another base in Bosaso. Last month, a convoy departing that base was reportedly ambushed by Puntland regional forces, resulting in the capture of at least 13 military vehicles . Wednesday’s battle came just one day after media reports claimed that clan militias intercepted and seized a cache of weapons allegedly smuggled by the federal government through Galkayo in an attempt to resupply the besieged base. The installation had reportedly been surrounded by Puntland forces for weeks, with repeated efforts to reinforce it failing to materialize beyond promises from Mogadishu. Local media also reported that the base’s collapse had been widely anticipated. According to those accounts, many personnel stationed there had already surrendered in recent days, while those who remained were left increasingly isolated, suffering from dwindling supplies and declining morale after weeks under siege. Hours after the operation, Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni praised the regional security forces for what he described as their professionalism, planning and successful execution of the attack. Deni said the operation should serve as a warning to anyone seeking to undermine Puntland’s administration. He also urged other armed personnel across Puntland whom he claimed had been misled into believing they were members of Somalia’s federal armed forces solely through biometric registration to surrender, warning that they could otherwise face a similar outcome. The offensive follows weeks of rapidly escalating tensions between Puntland and Somalia’s federal government. Last month, Puntland accused Mogadishu of conducting military manoeuvres designed to undermine the regional administration in Galkayo. During the same period, Somali Guardian published multiple reports warning that Galkayo was increasingly on edge amid fears of an imminent confrontation between the two sides. Earlier, Deni’s administration imposed sweeping restrictions on federal activities inside Puntland, including banning federal officials from entering the region, prohibiting federal military recruitment within Puntland and restricting the movement of federal-aligned forces between major cities , particularly Garowe, Galkayo and Bosaso. Those measures were widely interpreted as preparations for a possible military confrontation. It remains unclear whether Wednesday’s victory will give Deni a decisive strategic advantage over President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud or whether the federal government will attempt to respond militarily. Some observers speculate that Mogadishu could deploy regular federal troops through the Galmudug-controlled southern section of Galkayo in an effort to launch a large-scale counteroffensive, similar to the operation conducted in Baidoa in March, during which federal forces removed Southwest State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed “Laftagareen” after he defied orders from the federal leadership. Whether a similar approach could be attempted in Puntland—or achieve the same outcome—remains uncertain. For many analysts, the reported capture of the Galkayo base represents the third major military setback suffered by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s federal government at the hands of a federal member state, following previous confrontations including the Raskamboni debacle, where Jubaland forces reportedly captured hundreds of federal troops. Others, however, warn that the latest confrontation could have far-reaching consequences beyond the immediate battlefield. They argue the fighting risks deepening clan divisions within Puntland, fragmenting the region politically and diverting increasingly scarce security resources away from the ongoing campaign against militant groups, potentially undermining broader counterterrorism efforts across Somalia. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Madaxweynaha Puntland oo ka hadlay dagaalka Gaalkacyo
items.description: Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa Saraakiisha Ciidamada Puntland faray in ay si wanaagsan ula dhaqmaan maxaabiis uu xaqiijiyay in lagu qabtay dagaalkii maanta ka dhacay Magaalada Gaalkacyo. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Ciidamada Puntland ay hawlgal qorsheysan ka fuliyeen magaalada, kaasoo looga hawlgalay buu yiri xero halkaas ku taalo oo Dowladda Federaalka muddadii u dambeysay hub iyo ciidan uu sheegay inay ugu talagashay in ay ku qalqalgeliso amniga iyo xasilloonida Puntland ku soo daabuleysay. “Waxaan ciidamada iyo saraakiisha hoggaamineysaba halkan uga soo jeedinayaa ama farayaa inay xasilloonida ilaaliyaan, in dhaawaca la daryeelo in maxaabiista si fiican loola dhaqmo iyo in wax qalqal ku saabsan ama tacaddi aan loo gaysan guud ahaan dhallinyaradaasi la khalday ee halkaasi lagu qabtay.” Ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha Puntland oo shir jaraa’id ku qabtay Magaalada Garoowe. Madaxweyne Deni ayaa ciidamada kale ee ku sugan deegaanada Puntland, isla-markaana taabacsan Dowladda Federaalka ugu baaqay inay isu soo dhiibaan Ciidanka Puntland, isagoona adkeeyay inaanay Puntland ka jirin ciidan aan ahayn kuwa maamulka. “Waxaan rabaa dhallinyaradaasi inay Ciidamada Dowladda Puntland ka mid noqdaan, isu soo dhiibaan, nidaamka dowliga ahna ay raacaan. Ciddii ka dhega-adeygta jawaabo jawaabahaas la mid ah ayay heleysaa.” Ayuu yiri Deni. Deni oo sii hadlayay ayaa yiri “Puntland waxay u taagan tahay midnimada iyo dowladnimada Somaliya. Waxay adkeynaysaa nidaamka dowliga ah ee curdunka ah, waxayna hormuud u tahay nidaamka federaalka ah ee dalka Somaliya lagu dabaalayo.” Dhanka kale Deni ayaa Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug uga mahadceliyay wada-shaqayn dhow, oo sida uu sheegay ay lahaayeen muddadii uu xilka hayay, wuxuuna sheegay in ciidamada labada maamul ay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan amniga Gobolka Mudug. Deni ayaa intaasi ku daray inaysan iyagu rabin inay cid gaar ahi ku xadgudbaan, balse waxa uu Dowladda Federaalka ku eedeeyay inay xasillooni darro ka sameyso magaalooyinka xasilloon. Deni ayaa Madaxda Dowladda Federaalka ugu baaqay in ay joojiyaan in hubkii lagu la dagaalami lahaa Al Shabaab in lagu huriyo xasarado u dhexeeya qabaa’ilada ama Siyaasiyiinta Soomaaliyeed dhexdooda. Hadalka Deni ayaa muujinaya in uu meeshii ugu sarreysay gaaray khilaafka maamulkiisa kala dhexeeya Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland ayaa ah mid qoto dheer oo muddooyinkii u dambeeyay salka ku hayay wax ka bedelka lagu sameeyay Dastuurka KMG iyo is mari-waaga hareeyay nooca doorasho ee dalka laga qabanayo. Khilaafka labada dhinac ayaa sii xoogeystay, ka dib markii Xildhibaanada Labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka ay bishii March ansixiyeen wax ka bedel iyo dhameystir lagu sameeyay Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda, kaas oo muddo xileedka hay’adaha dastuuriga ka dhigay shan sano, halkii uu ka ahaa afar sano. Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland ayaa waxay arrintan u aragtaa muddo kordhin sharci darro ah, oo uu sameeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, taas oo keentay in Villa Somalia ay fara-gelin amni ku sameyso maamulkaasi, iyadoo ciidamo cusub ka qoraneysa gudaha deegaanada Puntland.

items.title: Mucaaradka DF oo war culus kasoo saaray dagaalka Gaalkacyo, weerarayna Xasan
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hoggaamiyaha Madasha Samatabixinta Soomaaliya, Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa si adag u cambaareeyay dagaalkii maanta ka dhacay magaalada Gaalkacyo, kaasi oo u dhaxeeyay ciidamada Puntland iyo kuwa PSF-ta ee taabacsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Shariif ayaa sheegay in mas’uuliyadda wixii dhacay uu qaadayo Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo uu ku eedeeyay inay talo xumadiisa tahay xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo rabshadaha hubeysan ee ka taagan qeybo ka mid ah dalka gaar ahaan magaaladda Gaalkacyo. “Waxaan si wayn uga xumahay kana tacsiyeeynayaa khasaaraha ka dhashay qalalaasaha amni darro ee ka dhacay maanta magaalada Gaalkacyo ee xarunta gobolka Mudug,” ayuu Sheekh Shariif ku yiri war-saxaafadeed uu soo saaray. Sidoo kale wuxuu ugu baaqay bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee ku wada nool magaaladda inay si wadjir ah uga hortagaan ficillada gurracan ee la doonayo in la isaga horkeeno. “Niidaamka waqtigiisu dhammaaday wuxuu horay uga sameeyey dowladaha Koonfur Galbeed iyo Jubaland dagaallo kan la mid ah, mana ahan wax bulshada Soomaaliyeed ay indhaha ka sii daawan karto,” ayuu yiri. Hoos ka aqriso war-saxaafadeedka Waxaan si wayn uga xumahay kana tacsiyeeynayaa khasaaraha ka dhashay qalalaasaha amni darro ee ka dhacay maanta Magaalada Gaalkacyo ee xarunta gobolka Mudug. Waxaan ugu baaqayaa bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee ku wada nool Magaaladda inay si wadjir ah uga hortagaan ficillada gurracan ee la doonayo in la isaga horkeeno. Waxaan si adag u cambaareynayaa xilkasnimo darrada Madaxweynaha muddo dhaafka ah, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo isaga si toos ah u qaadayaa mas’uuliyadda iyo talo xumada xiisadaha siyaasadeed & rabshadaha hubeysan ee ka taagan qeybo ka mid ah dalka gaar ahaan Magaaladda Gaalkacyo. Niidaamka waqtigiisu dhammaaday wuxuu horay uga sameeyey dowladaha Koonfur Galbeed iyo Jubaland dagaallo kan la mid ah, mana ahan wax bulshada Soomaaliyeed ay indhaha ka sii daawan karto. items.title: Puntland forces seize government-held camp in Somalia’s Galkayo
items.description: Armed forces from Somalia’s semi-autonomous Puntland state have attacked a camp held by federal government troops, in the latest flare-up between regional leaders and the Somali government. Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni told a news conference on Wednesday in the regional capital Garowe that the assault was “a planned security operation” to send a “clear message to anyone working against the Puntland government”. “The operation targeted a camp where the federal government has recently been transporting weapons, military equipment and troops in an attempt to undermine Puntland’s security and stability,” he claimed. Deni said his administration had repeatedly raised concerns over the Somali president’s decisions, but did not elaborate. “These actions are disrupting Somalia’s already fragile peace and, in particular, threatening the long-standing stability of Puntland, which has remained peaceful for many years,” he said. Government-held camp overrun Heavily armed Puntland forces, backed by military vehicles, launched an operation on Wednesday morning against a military camp near the airport in northern Galkayo city. The camp was occupied by troops formerly aligned with Puntland authorities but whose commanders recently pledged allegiance to Mogadishu. Undated footage circulating on social media appeared to show armed men purporting to be Puntland forces taking control of a military facility. It is not clear where the footage was filmed. In a short statement, Puntland police said local forces had “successfully concluded a planned security operation”, leading to the arrest of more than 100 people. The statement said the Puntland forces had also “seized weapons, vehicles and military equipment, including firearms, ammunition, police uniforms, handcuffs, police boots and other supplies”. Galkayo residents told the AFP news agency that they had heard several mortar rounds, some landing in residential areas, during the fighting, which lasted for more than an hour. Casualties were reported, but exact figures were not available. Resident Mohamed Jama told AFP by telephone that the fighting had ended. “Puntland forces took control of the camp where the fighting occurred, while the opposing forces aligned with the federal government withdrew to southern Galkayo after being overpowered,” another resident, Abdiqani Muse, said. No immediate reaction Neither the federal government nor commanders of the rival force have issued a response to Puntland’s claims. It is not the first such clash in the country. In March, federal troops attacked and deposed the leader of South West State, and in August last year, fighting broke out between the federal army and Jubaland forces, killing a number of soldiers. The thorny relations partly stem from the decision by Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud to change the constitution in March before planned elections. Opposition parties and rivals are against the reforms, seeing them as a power grab by the president. Somalia is deeply fractured along regional lines, with Puntland President Deni being a vocal opponent of President Mohamud’s push to centralise governance. Al Jazeera.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha oo Kala Saxiixday Heshiis Gargaar Bani’aadannimo oo Dhan $2.1 Milyan
items.description: Dowladda Shiinaha ayaa Soomaaliya la saxiixatay heshiis gargaar bani’aadannimo oo qiimihiisu yahay 15 milyan oo Yuan, oo u dhiganta ku dhawaad $2.1 milyan oo doollar, kaas oo lagu taageerayo bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee nugul ee ay saameeyeen xaaladaha bani’aadannimo. Heshiiska waxaa kala saxiixday Mas’uul ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Danjiraha Shiinaha u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Wang Yu. Gargaarka Shiinaha ayaa lagu gaarsiin doonaa bulshada ku nool qaar ka mid ah deegaannada sida weyn u saameeyeen xaaladaha bani’aadannimo, iyadoo la xoojinayo dadaallada gurmadka iyo taageerada dadka ay saameeyeen xaaladaha degdegga ah. Danjire Wang Yu ayaa sheegay in Shiinuhu uu sii wadi doono taageerada uu Soomaaliya siiyo, gaar ahaan dhinacyada gargaarka bani’aadannimo iyo iskaashiga labada dal. Dhinaca Soomaaliya ayaa dowladda Shiinaha uga mahadcelisay taageerada joogtada ah, gaar ahaan dadaallada lagu caawinayo dadka nugul iyo xoojinta awoodda dalka ee wax looga qabanayo musiibooyinka. Heshiiskan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay weli wajahdo abaaro, fatahaado, colaado iyo barakac, kuwaas oo sababay in malaayiin qof ay u baahdaan gargaar bani’aadannimo.

items.title: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha ayaa soo gebogabeeyey shirka nabadaynta Samawade ee ka socday deegaanka Geerisa ee gobolka Awdal
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Cabdalle Maxamed Carab, ayaa soo gebogabeeyey shirka nabadaynta Samawade ee ka socday deegaanka Geerisa ee gobolka Awdal, kaas oo lagu meel mariyey heshiis iyo qodobbo lagu xoojinayo nabadda iyo wada noolaanshaha laba beelood oo walaalo ah kadib wada-hadallo socday muddo saddex maalmood ah. Shirka ayaa waxa hoggaaminayey Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga iyadoo ay kala shaqaynayeen Guddiga Nabadaynta ee Golaha Guurtida, xubno ka tirsan Golaha Wasiirrada oo ay ka mid ahaayeen Wasiirrada Tiknoolajiyada, Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha, Macdanta iyo Tamarta, Wasiir Ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Dastuurka iyo masuuliyiinta gobollada Awdal, Selel iyo Saaxil. Qoddobada laga soo saaray shirka ayaa waxa si wadajir ah u ansixiyey Golaha Guurtida iyo ergadii ka socotay labada beelood ee gogosha nabadda la isugu keenay. Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Cabdalle Maxamed Carab, ayaa sheegay in xukuumaddu fulin doonto wixii lagu heshiiyey, isla markaana si adag loola tacaali doono cid kasta oo jebisa ama carqaladeysa heshiiska. Cuqaal iyo waxgarad ka socday labada beelood ayaa dhinacooda ballanqaaday inay ka shaqayn doonaan hirgelinta qodobbada lagu heshiiyey iyo adkaynta nabadda. Shirka nabadaynta Samawade ayaa ugu dambayn lagu soo xidhay jawi deggan, iyadoo laga muujiyey rejo ku wajahan in heshiiskaasi saldhig u noqdo nabad waarta iyo xasillooni ka hanaqaadda deegaanka Gobollada galbeedka Somaliland.

items.title: Jubaland oo war kasoo saartay dagaalka DF iyo Puntland
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Jubbaland ayaa waxaa looga hadlay dagaalkii maanta ciidamada PSF-ta ee taabacsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo kuwa Puntland ku dhex-maray waqooyiga magaalada Gaalkacyo ee xarunta gobolka Mudug. Jubbaland oo garab istaag u muujisay dhiggeeda Puntland ayaa cambaareysay colaad ay sheegtay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu ka hurinayo deegaannada maamulkaasi, maadaama ay dagaallo ka qarxeen meelaha qaar, sida Bari iyo Mudug. “Dowladda Jubaland waxay si adag u cambaaraynaysaa colaadaha iyo xasillooni-darrada uu Madaxwaynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka hurinayo deegaannada Puntland, gaar ahaan magaalada Gaalkacyo ee gobolka Mudug,” ayay tiri Madaxtooyada Jubbaland. Sidoo kale, waxaa Jubbaland ay sheegtay inay nasiib darro tahay in ciidamadii Xoogga Dalka iyo hubkii Dowladda Federaalka lagu daabulayo deegaannada nabdoon, iyada oo weli ay dalka halis ku hayaan kooxaha argagixisada. “Waxaa nasiib-darro ah in, iyadoo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee dagaalka kula jira Argagixisada ay heleen guulo iyo horumar la taaban karo oo ay uga difaacayaan dalka kooxaha argagixisada, haddana hub iyo ciidan lagu daabulayo deegaanno nabdoon oo ka jira amni iyo kala dambayn,” ayay sii raacisay Puntland. Waxaa kale oo Jubbaland ay sheegtay in tallaabooyinkani ay khatar ku yihiin nabadda, xasilloonida iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada, iyagoo wiiqaya horumarka muuqda ee laga gaaray amniga iyo dib-u-heshiisiinta magaalada Gaalkacyo muddadii tobanka sano ahayd ee la soo dhaafay. Jubbaland ayaa sidoo kale ugu baaqday madaxda iyo shacabka Puntland inay muujiyaan baraarug iyo midnimo, kana hortagaan wax kasta oo horseedi kara burburinta jiritaanka Puntland iyo amniga ay maanta ku naaloonayso. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyadoo Puntland ay guul wayn ka sheegatay dagaalkii ka dhacay magaalada Gaalkacyo, waxayna sheegtay in lasoo afjaray ciidamadii PSF ee ku sugnaa xerada lagu dagaalamay. Madaxweyne Saciid Deni oo dagaalka kadib shir jaraa’id qabtay ayaa sheegay in howlgalkan uu yahay farriin ku socota cid kasta oo kasoo horjeedo nidaamkooda. “Howlgalka ay ciidamadu ka sameeyeen Gaalkacyo waa fariin ku socota cidkasta oo ka shaqeynaysa waxkasta oo lidi ku ah Dowladnimada Puntland,” ayuu yiri Saciid Deni. items.title: Jubbaland Accuses Federal Government of Fuelling Conflict in Puntland Following Galkayo Clashes
items.description: KISMAYO,— The Jubbaland administration has accused the Federal Government of Somalia of fuelling conflict in Puntland following armed clashes and security operations reported in Galkayo, Mudug region. In a statement issued by the Jubbaland Presidency, the administration described the developments as deeply concerning and criticised the alleged use of Somali National Army personnel and military equipment in conflicts taking place in otherwise peaceful areas. Jubbaland said national military resources should be directed towards ongoing operations against Al-Shabaab rather than being used in confrontations that could destabilise communities and deepen political tensions. The administration warned that such actions threaten peace, stability and peaceful coexistence, while potentially undermining years of efforts to restore security and promote development in Galkayo. Jubbaland also expressed solidarity with the Puntland government and its people, commending their efforts to maintain security and stability across the region. The statement comes amid heightened tensions between the Federal Government and Puntland after security operations and armed confrontations took place in Galkayo on Wednesday. The circumstances surrounding the clashes and the identities of all forces involved have not yet been independently verified. items.title: Yemen deports Somaliland trade representative after more than two months in detention
items.description: Yemeni authorities have deported Somaliland’s trade representative, Idris Aden Raage, after holding him for more than two months in detention in the southern port city of Aden, according to Yemeni sources and Somali media reports on Wednesday. Raage was reportedly released from custody before being flown out of Aden International Airport aboard an Air Djibouti flight. The Yemeni government has not publicly explained the reasons for his arrest or deportation. Security forces arrested Raage on June 13 after raiding the Somaliland trade office in Aden’s Khormaksar district, where the mission has operated since relocating from Sana’a. The arrest was reportedly linked to an event organized by Raage on May 18 to commemorate Somaliland self-Independence Day. Local media said the gathering was held without official authorization and was attended by members of Yemen’s Southern Transitional Council (STC), the UAE-backed group that controls much of southern Yemen. Somaliland lawmaker Guled Mohamed Warsame said authorities confiscated equipment and other property from the trade office during Raage’s detention. He said the envoy was deported immediately after his release. Neither Somaliland authorities nor the Yemeni government had issued an official statement on the case by Wednesday.

items.title: Saciid Deni oo guul weyn ka sheegtay dagaalkii Gaalkacyo
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Puntland, Saciid Cabdullahi Deni oo shir jaraa’id qabtay ayaa si kulul uga hadlay dagaalkii cuslaa ee maanta ka dhacay waqooyiga magaalada Gaakacyo, ee u dhexeeyay ciidamada ammaanka maamulkaas iyo kuwa PSF-ta ee taabacsan dowladda Soomaaliya, kaas oo guul wayn ay ka sheegatay Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland. Saciid Deni ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in dagaalkaas oo ay qaadeen ciidamada Puntland lagu soo afjaray xero uu sheegay in laga soo abaabulayay amni darrada oo ay horay ugu sugnaayeen ciidamada taabacsan dowladda dhexe. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in howlgalkan ee ay guusha ka gaartay Puntand uu yahay farriin ku socota cid kasta oo kasoo horjeedo nidaamka dowliga ah. “Howlgalka ay ciidamadu ka sameeyeen Gaalkacyo waa fariin ku socota cidkasta oo ka shaqeynaysa waxkasta oo lidi ku ah Dowladnimada Puntland,” ayuu yiri Saciid Deni. Madaxweynaha Puntland ayaa sidoo kale farriin u diray ciidamada la sheegay in Dowladda Federaaka ay ka qoratay deegaannada maamulkaas, isaga oo ugu baaqay inay isa soo dhiibaan, kuna biiraan ciidamada Daraawiishta. “Puntand ciidanka jooga waa ciidanka Puntland maanta, ciidan kale oo ka jiraa ma jiraan, waxaan rabaa in dhalinyaradaas ay ciidamada dowladda Puntland kamid noqdaan isu soo dhiibaan, nidaamka dowliga ahna raacaan,” ayuu raaciyay. Dhinaca kale, warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Taliska Booliska Puntland ayaa lagu sheegay in lasoo gabagabeeyay howlgalkii ka dhacay gudaha magaalada Gaalkacyo, isla markaana lasoo qabtay saraakiishii hoggaamineysay ciidamadii ku sugnaa xerada PSF ee dhanka waqooyi bari ee magaaladaasi. “Ciidanka Difaaca Puntland ayaa maanta si guul leh u soo gabagabeeyey hawlgal amni oo qorshaysnaa kana dhacay magaalada Gaalkacyo, kaas oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday kooxo hubaysan oo ku sugnaa magaalada, kuwaas oo falalkoodu khatar ku ahaa amniga iyo kala dambeynta. Hawlgalka ayaa lagu soo qabtay saraakiishii hoggaaminaysay kooxaha hubaysan, waxaana ka mid ah Giijaale Cabdi Baydhabo, Taliyihii maleeshiyaadka Gaalkacyo. Baariyoow, ku-xigeenkiisii Mahad Mowliid, iyo shakhsigii u qaabilsanaa maamulka xogta (Database) ee Booliska Soomaaliyeed,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Booliska ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in nolosha lagu qabtay ilaa 101 eedeysane iyo 60 kale oo dhaawacyo ah, kuwaas oo hadda ku jira gacanta Puntand. “Hawlgalka waxaa lagu soo qabtay 101 eedeysane, halka sidoo kale gacanta lagu dhigay 60 qof oo dhaawac ah. Marka laga reebo saraakiisha iyo shaqsiyaadka loo haysto dambiyada culus, ehellada dadka dhaawaca ah waxay la wareegi karaan iyagoo raacaya habraacyada ay dejinayaan hay’adaha amniga iyo garsoorka,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Waxaa kale oo Puntland ay sheegtay in howlgalka lagu qabtay hub, gaadiid iyo agab ciidan oo kala duwan, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin tuutayaal Boolis, qoryo, rasaas, jeebbooyinka gacanta lagu xiro (handcuffs), kabaha Booliska iyo agab kale oo ay ku jiraan qalab ka mid ah deeqihii Dawladda Shiinaha ugu deeqday Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed. Ugu dambeyn, Ciidanka Difaaca Puntland ayaa digniin ada u diray dhammaan shaqsiyaadka iyo kooxaha hubaysan ee weli ku sugan deegaannada kala duwan, iyaga ugu baaqay inay si degdeg ah isugu dhiibaan Puntland, kuna soo laabtaan dariiqa sharciga ah. The post Saciid Deni oo guul weyn ka sheegtay dagaalkii Gaalkacyo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maxey tahay qorshaha uu hoggaamiye Aadan Madoobe u tagay Muqdisho ?
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Hoggaamiyaha dowlad goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa si weyn maanta loogu soo dhoweeyay Magaalada Muqdisho ee Caasimadda Dalka, halkaas oo uu uga bilaabanayo kulamo lagu xoojinayo wada-shaqeynta u dhaxeysa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Saaxibada Beesha Caalamka iyo Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed. Hoggaamiyaha iyo wafdigiisa ayaa waxaa garoonka diyaaradaha kuso dhoweyey Wasiiro iyo Xildhibaanno ka tirsan Dowladd Federaalka Soomaaliya, xubno ka socday Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed iyo Qeybaha kala duwan ee Bulshada Caasimada. Safarkan shaqo ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ay ugu jirto xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga kala dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Saaxibada Beesha Caalamka si loo dardargeliyo hirgelinta qorshayaasha horumarineed iyo kuwa lagu xoojinayo dowladnimada Koonfur Galbeed. Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed Shekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa inta uu ku suganyahay Magaalada Muqdisho wuxuu kulamo miro-dhal ah la yeelan doonaa Madaxda ugu Saraysa Qaranka iyo Dowladaha Taageera Soomaaliya Kulamadaas ayaa diiradda lagu saari doonaa adkeynta amniga, dardargelinta howlgalka ciribtirka kooxaha Khawaarijta, horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, xoojinta iskaashiga hay’adaha dowladda, hirgelinta mashaariicda horumarineed ee Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, iyo arrimo kale oo muhiim u ah horumarka iyo xasilloonida dalka. items.title: Soomaaliya oo Ku Biirtay Isbahaysiga Badeed ee Sacuudigu Hoggaaminayo
items.description: Sacuudiga iyo 13 dal oo kale ayaa ku dhawaaqay sameynta Isbahaysi Difaaca Badda oo Caalami ah, kaas oo diiradda saaraya ilaalinta maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo waddooyinka muhiimka u ah gaadiidka badeecadaha iyo tamarta. Isbahaysigan ayaa qorsheynaya inuu xoojiyo amniga maraakiibta mara Bab al-Mandab, Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed—marinnada isku xira Badweynta Hindiya iyo Badda Mediterranean-ka. Dalalka lagu sheegay inay ku biireen waxaa ka mid ah Soomaaliya, Jabuuti, Masar, Yemen, Suudaan, Pakistan, Turkiga, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, Urdun, Bangladesh iyo Comoros, iyadoo Sacuudigu noqonayo xubin aasaase ah isla markaana martigelinaya xarunta isbahaysiga. Isbahaysigu wuxuu sheegay in iskaashigiisu uu ku salaysnaan doono wadaagista xogta sirdoonka, isku-dubaridka hawlgallada, qorsheynta howlgallada iyo tababbarro ciidan oo wadajir ah. Sacuudigu wuxuu sheegay in isbahaysigu yahay mid difaac ahaan uun u dhisan oo aan lagu bartilmaameedsanayn dal gaar ah. Soomaaliya oo qayb ka noqotay qorshaha Ka mid noqoshada Soomaaliya ayaa muhiimad gaar ah yeelan karta, maadaama Soomaaliya ay ku taallo xeebta dheer ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya, halkaas oo maraakiibta caalamiga ahi ay ku maraan waddo ganacsi oo muhiim ah. Bab al-Mandab ayaa ah marin aad u cidhiidhi ah oo isku xira Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas. Qiyaastii 10 ilaa 12 boqolkiiba ganacsiga badda ee dunida ayaa mara aaggaas, sida lagu sheegay warbixinta Al Jazeera. Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli ay sii kordhayaan khataraha ka dhanka ah maraakiibta ganacsiga ee gobolka, gaar ahaan weerarrada ay Xuutiyiintu ku qaadaan maraakiibta ku sugan Badda Cas. Isbahaysiga cusub ayaa sidoo kale albaabka u furay dalal kale oo doonaya inay ku biiraan, kadib marka ay dhammaystiraan habraacyadooda gudaha. Soomaaliya, oo leh xeebta ugu dheer qaaradda Afrika, ayaa sidaas ku biirtay dadaal caalami ah oo lagu doonayo in lagu ilaaliyo mid ka mid ah marinnada badeed ee ugu muhiimsan dunida.

Qoraal kasoo baxay madaxtooyada Jubbaland, ayaa lagu cambaareeyay dagaalka iyada oo madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud lagu eedeeyey inuu colaado ka hurinayo deegaannada Puntland gaar ahaan magaalada Gaalkacyo. “Waxaa nasiib darro ah in iyada oo ciidanka xoogga dalka ee dagaalka kula jira Argagaxisada ay heli la’yihiin hub iyo saad ku filan si ay u difaacaan goobihii u dambeeyay ee Argagaxisada kula dagaalamayaan gaar ahaan gobolka Hiiraan hadana hub iyo agab ciidan lagu daabulayo deegaannada nabadoon oo ay ka jirto amni iyo kala dambeyn” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka kazoo baxay madaxtooyada Jubbaland. Sidoo kale Jubbaland waxa ay sheegtay in tallaabooyin ay khatar ku yihiin nabada, xasiloonida iyo wada-noolashada bulshada, isla markaana wiiqaya horumarka muuqda ee laga gaaray amniga iyo dib u-heshiisiinta magaalada Gaalkacyo. Ugu dambeyn maamulka Jubbaland ayaa sheegay inuu bogaadinayo midnimada ay muujiyeen dowladda iyo shacabka Puntland, iyo sida ay uga hortageen qorshaha lagu burburin rabay jiritaanka Puntland. items.title: Qoysas ku hanti beelay colaad oo Muqdisho ku wajahaya nolol xumo
items.description: (ERGO) – Cunno xumo, biyo yari, hoy la’aan iyo adeeg caafimaad oo aan jirin ayay wajahayaan ku dhawaad 200 oo qoys oo tan iyo bishii June gaaray xerada Siinka-dheer ee degmada Garasbaalley. Colaad qabiil ayay uga soo barakaceen deegaanka Jalalaqsi oo qiyaaastii 60 km waqooyi ka xiga magaalada Jowhar.  Qaarkood waxay dulsaar ku yihiin reero uga soo horeeyay, halka kuwo kalena ay isla cariirsadaan aqallo ka samaysan baco, maryo iyo geedo la isku geeyay oo lagu caawiyay oo aan deeqin. Sahra Xasan Aadan ayaa sheegtay inay ka maqan yihiin dhamaan adeegyada aas-aasiga ah oo biyaha iyo cunnadu ay ugu horeeyaan. Dadkii ay meesha ugu yimaadeen ayay la wadaagaan waxa yar ee ay helaan. “Hal mar ayaa si dhiba loogu kariyaa carruurta ama waa waynaa. Cunnada iyo biyaha sida aan ku helnaa waa adag tahay. Dad soo qaxay oo dhulkoodii ka yimid ayaa nahay. Meel biyo la’aan ah ayaan nimid, hal jirigaan ayaa lana siiyaa martina waa nahay.” Carruurteeda oo kan ugu yar hal sano jiro ayaa ayay sheegtay in ay biyo ku aamusiyo marka ay ooyaan, maaddaama aysan wax kale u helayn, taas oo murug iyo niyad jab ku abuurta. Waxay joogto u raadisaa shaqooyin nadaafad ah si ay cunno ugu hesho, balse waxba ma helin. Saddex carruurteeda ah ayay tan iyo 19 June ku aragtay shuban iyo qandho badan. Xeradu ma lahan xarun caafimaad umana awoodo qarash ay isbitaal ku gayso. Joogto uma helaan biyaha iyo musqulo ku filan, taas oo ku sababtay inay xanuunsadaan. “Meeshan waxaa nagu haysato nadaafad xumo, carruurtii waxaa ku dhacay cudurro aysan horay u qabin. Xaaladooda ayaa noogu culus. Gaajada ayaa uga sii daraysa, silic ayaan ku jirnaa. Jirrada ilmaha ayaa walwal kale ah.” Barakacan oo ku cusub ayay la qabsan la’yihiin carruurteeda oo 7 ah oo uu ugu weyn yahay 16 jir. Maarayntooda ayay kali ku tahay, maaddaama saygeedii uu jiro deegaankii ay ka yimaadeen. Waxay uga soo tageen 9 neef oo ari ah oo xoolo ay ka leeyihiin. Waxau xustay in arigooda oo ku dhawaad boqol neef intii badnayd ay ku dhinteen diraacdii hore iyo roob mahiigaan ah oo tuulada ka da’ay dhamaadkii bishii May. Waxay soo barakaceen, markii kufsi iyo jir dil loo gaystay gabadheeda oo 15 jir ah horraantii June. Saddex nin ayay sheegtay inay farxumeeyeen xilli ay bannaanka xaabo uga diratay. “Gabadh ayaa kufsi wadareed nalooga gaystay. Arinta inanta si weyn ayay noo saamaysay, iyadana qalbi ahaan iyo jir ahaanba waa u saamaysay. Waxaa laga gubay beer 2 hektar ah oo abuur cusub ugu jiray, aqal Soomaali ay duleedka tuulada ku lahaayeen iyo agabkii u yaallay, sida gogoshii, maacuunkii iyo raashinkii. Dagaalka dad ugama dhiman balse waxay xustay inay ku dhaawacmeen labo wiil oo ay eedo u tahay. Safar qaatay 3 maalin oo lug ah ayay ku soo gaareen magaalada Muqdisho, markii ay waayeen nooliga gaariga. Roobab da’ay ayaa waddada dhiiqo ka dhigay, taas oo socodka adkaysay. Waxay tilmaamtay in ay colaada ka hor ku jireen nolol middaan u dhaantay. Dhanka kale, Hodan Cabdi Cali oo qoyskeeda oo lix ah ay yimaadeen 22 June ayaa sheegtay in colaada iyo barakacu ka saameeyay dhankasta. Waxay carruurteeda la soo raadsatay amni, balse waxay u la’dahay cunno, biyo iyo hoy ay gabaadsadaan. “Labo mar oo isku xigta dabka lama heli karo, halkii mar ayaa nagu adag oo aan joogto ahayn. Wallaahi waxaan ku jirnaa xaalad aan laga sheekayn karin. Cid aan waxba nagu dhaamin ayaan dulsaar ku nahay, ilmo ayaan wadanaa wax nagu filana ma helno.” Hodan ayaa sheegtay in 20 liitar oo biyo ah uu maalinkii ku caawiyo guddoomiyaha xerada oo aan wax kale u awoodin. Way dhaqaalaystaan si ay maalinka xiga ugu gaaraan. Labo qol oo jiingad ah iyo agabkii u yaallay ayaysan waxba ka soo qaadan. Waxay hal buush oo cariiri ah la wadaagaan qoys ay qaraabo yihiin oo uga soo horeeyay xerada. Gaari ehelkeeda ka bixiyeen qarashkiisa ayay xustay inay carruurta ku keentay Muqdisho. Ninkeeda wuxuu ku haray deegaankii,sababo amni dartood ayuu jidka u soo mari waayay. Hodan ayaa sheegtay inaysan lahayn xirfad ay ku shaqaysato. Waxaay tilmaamtay inay raadisay shaqooyin nadaafad ah, balse aysan waxba helin. Deegaankoodii nolol wanaagsan ayay ku haysteen oo dhaqashada xoolaha iyo beeraha ku tiirsanayd, balse colaada ayay waxkasta ku waayeen. “Cabsida ugu weyn ee na keentay waa haweenka iyo gabadha oo la kufsanayay. Nafteena kali ah ayaan la soo baxsanay, maba laga gaarin waqti wax la soo qaato. Markii hore xaaladeena waa iska fiicnayd, balse nabadgalyo la’aanta ayay hantideenii ku burburtay.” Hodan ayaa xustay inaysan haysan gogol fiican. Hal sijaayad oo ay dariska ka heleen ayay dhigtaan. Markii ay deegaankoodii joogeen dalaga beeraha iyo nacfiga xoolaha ayay ku noolaayeen. Waxay sheegtay inay u adkaysan la’ yihiin culaysyada haysta. Saddex carruurteeda ah oo dugsi quraan u dhigan jiray ayaa colaada uga waxbarasho beelay. Waxay ka bixin jirtay min $4, balse hadda waxba uma heli karta oo quud-maalmeedkoodii ayay u la’dahay. Dhanka kale guddoomiyaha xerada Siinka Dheer oo qoysaskaan ay soo maciinsadeen Axmed Xuseen Maxamuud ayaa Raadiyaha Ergo sheegay in dadka cusub ay soo dul dageen kuwii hore oo la halgamayay daruufo nololeed.  Wuxuu sheegay inay u dhex galeen dadka oo ay uga soo aruuriyaan raashin bisil si ay hal mar u cunaan. Wuxuu xusay inay yihiin dad nugul oo caawin u baahan. “Dadkaan waxaa haysta caqabado badan, ma haystaan nolol-maalmeedkii. Qofku cunno la’aan ma noolaan karo. Waxay isugu jiraan ilmo yaryar, umulo iyo dad xanuunsan. Hoy, raashin iyo caafimaad la’aan waaye. Meeshaan adeeg caafimaad iyo waxbarasho midna ma leh.” Guddoomiyaha ayaa walaac ka muujiyay xaaladda qoysaskan haddii aysan helin gargaar degdeg ah. Wuxuu hay’adaha samafalka, maamulkaa gobolka iyo dowlada dhexe ka codsaday inay kaalmo la soo gaaraan. Colaadaha ku soo lalaabanaya qaybo ka mid ah gobolka Shabeellaha dhexe waxaa ku soo kordhay dhacdooyin cusub. Maleeshiyaadka qabiilka ee dagaalamaya waxay dab qabadsiiyeen guryo, beero iyo hanti kale sannadihii ugu danbeeyay, taas oo dad badan u horseeday xaalad soo kabsan-waa ah. items.title: Maxay ka wada-hadleen Xasan iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Qalabka Sida ee Jabuuti? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta kulan la yeeshay Taliyaha Ciidanka Qalabka Sida ee Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti, General Sakaria Sheekh Ibrahim, iyo saraakiil sare oo la socday, kuwaas oo haatan booqasho ku joogo magaalada Muqdisho. Kulanka oo ka dhacay Xarunta Madaxtooyada Qaranka aya diiradda lagu saarayo xoojinta iskaashiga amniga, isku-dubbaridka hawlgallada iyo dardargelinta dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya, waxaana goobjoog ahaa Taliyaha Xoogga Dalka iyo saraakiil kale. Sidoo kale, kulanka Madaxweynaha iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Jabuuti ayaa lagu adkeeyey xiriirka walaaltinimo iyo iskaashiga difaaca ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti, iyada oo Madaxweynaha uu uga mahadceliyey dowladda iyo shacabka Jabuuti doorka muuqda ee ay ka qaadanayaan taageerada amniga, la dagaallanka argagixisada iyo dib u dhiska hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya. Taliyaha iyo wafdigiisa ayaa magaalada Muqdisho u yimid ka qaybgalka shirka taliyeyaasha ciidamada ee dalalka ka qaybta ah hawlgalka taageerada iyo xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), oo Jabuuti ay ku jirto. Dowladda ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay waday kulamo iyo wada-tashiyo joogto ah oo ay la yeelanaysay waddamada saaxiibka la ah Soomaaliya si loo mideeyo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amni waara iyo in ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si buuxda ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda sugidda amniga dalka. Jabuuti ayaa ka mid ah dalalka ugu dhow Soomaaliya dhinaca iskaashiga amniga iyo difaaca, waxaana ciidamadeedu qayb ka yihiin hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, oo billowday sanadkii 2025, kana dambeeyay hawlgalkii ATMIS. Ciidamada Jabuuti ayaa muddo dheere ka howlgalaya gobollo ka tirsan dalka, iyagoo door muuqda ka qaata sugidda amniga, taageeridda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed iyo hawlgallada lagu beegsanayo Al-Shabaab. Sidoo kale, Jabuuti waxay Soomaaliya ka taageertay tababarka ciidamada, is-dhaafsiga xogaha sirdoonka iyo horumarinta iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Madaxtooyada ku qaabilay Taliyaha Ciidamada Jabuuti
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Madaxtooyada Qaranka ku qaabilay Taliyaha Ciidamada Jabuuti, General Zakariye Sheekh Ibraahim iyo wafdi saraakiil ah oo uu hoggaaminayo oo booqasho ku jooga Magaalada Muqdisho. “Taliyaha iyo wafdigiisa ayaa Muqdisho u yimid ka qaybgalka Shirka Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada ee dalalka ka qaybta ah Hawlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasillinta Midowga Afrika ee Somaliya (AUSSOM), kaasi oo diiradda lagu saarayo xoojinta iskaashiga amniga, isku-dubaridka hawlgalada iyo dardargelinta dadaalada lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda iyo xasilloonida Somaliya.” Ayay ku warantay Warbaahinta Dowladda. Warbaahinta ayaa sheegtay “Kulanka Madaxweynaha iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Jabuuti ayaa lagu adkeeyay xiriirka walaaltinimo iyo iskaashiga difaaca ee u dhexeeya Somaliya iyo Jabuuti, iyada oo Madaxweynaha uu uga mahadceliyay dowladda iyo shacabka Jabuuti doorka muuqda ee ay ka qaadanayaan taageerada amniga, la dagaalanka argagixisada iyo dib-u-dhiska hay’adaha amniga Somaliya.” Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti ayaa waxay ka mid tahay dalalka Afrika ee ciidamada ku yaboohay Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Somaliya oo horey loogu yaqaanay (AMISOM/ATMIS), haddana lagu magacaabo AUSSOM. Illaa kun askari oo Militariga Jabuuti ah ayaa ka hawlgala Magaalooyinka Beledweyne, Buuloburde iyo Jalalaqsi ee Gobolka Hiiraan, waxayna sidoo kale degan yihiin agagaarka Garoonka Diyaaradaha Ugaas Nuur ee Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee Xarunta Gobolka Galgaduud, iyagoo gacan ka gaysta amniga garoonkaasi.

items.title: PUNTLAND oo la wareegtay xerada PSF ee Gaalkacyo
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa waxaa laga helayaa dagaal culus oo saaka ka dhacay duleedka waqooyi bari ee magaalada Gaalkacyo ee xarunta gobolka Mudug, kaas oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada PSF-ta ee taabsan dowladda Soomaaliya iyo kuwa Puntland. Dagaalka oo aroortii hore qarxay ayaa lagu oo warramayaa inuu qaatay saacado badan, iyada oo labada dhinac ay isku adeegsadeen hubka noocyadiisa kala duwan oo ay kamid yihiin hoobiyeyaal ku dhacay xaafado ay dagan yihiin dad shacab ah. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada Daraawiishta Puntland oo dagaalka qaaday ay gudaha u galeen xerada ay daganaayeen ciidamada PFS, kadib markii halkaasi laga saaray ciidamadii ku sugnaa. Muuqaalo lagu baahiyay baraha bulshada ayay Puntland kusoo bandhigtay gaadiid dagaal iyo hub oo xerada yaalla, isla markaana la sheegay inay lahaayeen ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee PFS ee taabasan dowladda dhexe. Sidoo kale, warbaahinta deegaannada Puntland ayaa tebisay in qaar kamid ah ciidamada PFS-ta ee dagaaka ku jiray ay is dhiibeen, waxaana weli xaaladdu ay tahay mid kacsan, iyada dhaq-dhaqaaqyo laga dareemayaa Gaalkacyo. Si kastaba, Dagaalkan wuxuu daba socdaa hub la sheegay in Talaadadii ay dowladda Soomaaliya ka dajisay koonfurta Gaalkacyo, kaas oo ay Puntland sheegtay in loogu talagalay in loo gudbiyo deegaannadeeda, si loogu abuuro xasillooni darro. Muddooyinkii ugu dambeeyay waxaa kacsaneyd xaaladda deegaannada Puntland, kadib markii ay ka bilowdeen dhaq-dhaqaaqyo iska soo horjeedo oo u dhexeeyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo maamulka Puntland. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay dagaalka Magaalada Gaalkacyo
items.description: Ciidamada Puntland ayaa Arbacadan la wareegay xeradii Ciidanka PSF ay ku lahaayeen bariga Magaalada Gaalkacyo ee Gobolka Mudug, ka dib dagaal culus oo labada dhinac halkaasi ku dhex maray. Ciidamada Puntland ayaa saakay madaafiic xoogan ku garaacay xeradaasi, ka hor inta aysan weerar ballaaran ku qaadin. Ciidanka PSF ayaa isaga baxay xeradaasi, iyadoo aan si dhab ah loo aqoon halka ay aadeen, laakiin tiro ka mid ah ayaa isu dhiibay Daraawiishta Puntland, ka dib markii la hareereeyay. Ciidanka PSF oo u tababaran la dagaalanka argagixisada ayaa horey uga tirsanaa Ciidamada Puntland, iyagoona hadda ka amar qaadanayay Dowladda Federaalka oo qarameysay. Madaxtooyada Puntland ayaa 25-kii bishii hore ee July ku dhawaaqday inaysan jirin ciidan la yiraahdo PSF oo si sharci ah uga tirsan Ciidamada Puntland. “Dowladda Puntland waxay caddeynaysaa inaysan jirin ciidan la yiraahdo PSF oo si sharci ah uga tirsan Ciidamada Difaaca Dowladda Puntland. Sidoo kale dowladdu waxay caddeynaysaa inaysan jirin ciidan ka diiwaangashan Dowladda Federaalka oo ka hawlgala deegaanada Dowladda Puntland.” Ayay Madaxtooyada Puntland ku sheegtay warsaxaafadeed. Go’aankan ayaa ahaa mid lagu xoojinayay amar soo baxay 24-kii bishii June oo gudaha deegaanada Puntland looga mamnuucay inay ka hawlgalaan ciidan aan ahayn kuwa maamulka. Dhanka kale dagaalka maanta ka dhacay Magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa gaystay khasaare isugu jira dhimasho iyo dhaawac oo u badan ciidamada. Sidoo kale waxaa jira guryo la deganaa oo madaafiic ay ku dhaceen, iyadoona qaybo ka mid ah dhanka bari ee magaalada ay dadka deegaanka isaga barakaceen. Qoysaska oo cabsi ay soo food saartay ayaa isaga cararay rasaasta. Dagaalka ayaa magaalada ka abuuray qalqal amni iyo hakad ku yimid dhaqdhaqaaqii ganacsiga oo saameeyay nolosha dadka. Suuqyada waaweyn iyo goobaha ganacsiga ayaa xirmay, intii uu dagaalku socday. Dagaalkan ayaa uga sii daray xiisaddii siyaasadeed ee Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland.

items.title: Masar oo diiday qorshe ay Itoobiya rabto in bad Somalia ah looga beddesho heshiis…

Jawaabta wasiirka ayaa ahayd mid “cad, go’aan leh oo aan mugdi ku jirin”, sida uu Hussein ku qoray maqaal ra’yi ah oo Al Jazeera ay daabacday. “Maya,” ayuu wasiirku ku jawaabay, sida uu qoraagu sheegay. Hase yeeshee, Abdelatty ayaa beeniyay in dowladda Itoobiya ay Masar si rasmi ah ugu soo bandhigtay qorshe noocaas ah. Hussein ayaa soo xigtay diblomaasiyiin iyo siyaasiyiin Afrikaan ah oo aanu magacyadooda shaacin, kuwaas oo sheegay in Itoobiya ay fikradda u gudbisay dhinacyo goboleed iyo kuwo caalami ah oo dhex-dhexaadinayay. Sida uu qoraagu sheegay, qorshaha ayaa dhigayay in Masar ay aqbasho in Itoobiya ay deked ganacsi iyo saldhig milatari ka hesho Soomaaliya ama Eritrea, iyadoo beddelkeeda la gaarayo heshiis waajib ah oo ku saabsan biyo-xireenka. Masar iyo Itoobiya midkoodna si rasmi ah uma xaqiijin in hindisahan la soo jeediyay, mana jiraan caddeymo madax-bannaan oo ilaa hadda taageeraya sheegashada. Loollanka Badda Cas Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Masar ay sare u qaaday dhaqdhaqaaqeeda diblomaasiyadeed ee Geeska Afrika, halkaas oo uu sii xoogeysanayo loollanka la xiriira dekedaha, saldhigyada milatari iyo marin-biyoodka istaraatiijiga ah ee Badda Cas. 19-kii July, wasiir Abdelatty ayaa magaalada Qaahira kula kulmay wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali, dhiggiisa Eritrea Cismaan Saalax iyo Massad Boulos, oo ah la-taliye sare oo Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump kala taliya arrimaha Afrika iyo Carabta. Wadahadallada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray ammaanka iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas, oo ay sanadihii dambe kusoo kordheen xiisado siyaasadeed, dhaqdhaqaaqyo militari iyo tartan dhinaca saameynta ah. Abdelatty ayaa kulankaas mar kale xaqiijiyay taageerada Masar ee madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Wuxuu sidoo kale diiday tallaabo kasta oo hal dhinac ah oo wiiqi karta awoodda iyo sharciyadda dowladda federaalka. Wasiirku wuxuu cambaareeyay safaarad ay Somaliland ka furatay magaalada Jerusalem, isagoo ku tilmaamay tallaabo ka hor imaaneysa sharciga caalamiga ah iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Somaliland ayaa safaarad ka furatay Jerusalem kadib markii Israel ay noqotay dowladdii ugu horreysay ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay oo Somaliland u aqoonsata dal madax-bannaan. Masar ayaa muddo dheer ku doodaysay in dowladaha ku teedsan Badda Cas ay tahay inay si gaar ah mas’uul uga noqdaan ammaanka iyo maareynta marin-biyoodkaas, iyadoo ka soo horjeedda in dalal aan xeeb ku lahayn ay helaan joogitaan militari oo joogto ah. Bad raadinta Itoobiya Itoobiya, oo ah dalka labaad ee ugu dadka badan Afrika, ayaa noqotay dal aan bad lahayn kadib markii Eritrea ay madax-bannaanideeda qaadatay sanadkii 1993-kii. Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed ayaa marar badan sheegay in dalkiisa uu u baahan yahay marin-badeed ammaan ah oo joogto ah, isagoo arrintaas ku tilmaamay baahi dhaqaale iyo mid istaraatiiji ah. Itoobiya waxay hadda inta badan badeecadaheeda dhoofinta iyo soo dejinta marsiisaa dalka Jabuuti, taas oo Addis Ababa ay ku bixiso lacago badan sanad kasta. Hammiga Itoobiya ee badda ayaa sababay khilaaf diblomaasiyadeed oo weyn bishii Janaayo 2024, markii Addis Ababa ay heshiis is-afgarad ah la saxiixatay Somaliland. Heshiiskaas ayaa Itoobiya u oggolaan lahaa inay muddo 50 sano ah kireysato dhul xeebeed gaaraya 20 kiiloomitir oo ku dhow Berbera, si loogu isticmaalo ganacsi iyo saldhig ciidan-badeed. Mas’uuliyiinta Somaliland ayaa xilligaas sheegay in Itoobiya ay beddelkeeda tixgelin doonto aqoonsiga Somaliland. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa heshiiska ku tilmaantay xadgudub lagu sameeyay madax-bannaanideeda, waxayna Itoobiya ku eedeysay inay isku dayeyso inay la wareegto qeyb ka mid ah dhulka Soomaaliya. Xiisaddaas ayaa soo jiidatay quwado goboleed, waxayna ugu dambeyn horseedday wadahadallo ay Turkiga dhex-dhexaadinayeen oo dhexmaray Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya. Labada dal ayaa bishii December 2024 ku heshiiyay inay iska kaashadaan xalinta khilaafka, balse Itoobiya weli si rasmi ah uma aqoonsan Somaliland, mana jiro heshiis deked oo si cad loo dhammeystiray ama loo dhaqan-geliyay. Soomaaliya ayaa go’aanka ku tilmaantay weerar ka dhan ah madax-bannaanideeda, halka Masar, Turkiga, Jabuuti, Midowga Afrika iyo dowlado kale ay mar kale taageereen midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Israel Gideon Sa’ar ayaa bishii January booqday Hargeysa, halka madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi uu bishii June booqasho rasmi ah ku tegay Israel. Xiriirka sii kordhaya ee labada dhinac ayaa loollanka ka jira Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas ku daray waji cusub oo dhinacyada amniga iyo saameynta siyaasadeed ah. Somaliland ayaa qiratay inay Israel ka heshay tababarro amni, balse waxay beenisay wararka sheegaya in labada dhinac ay ka wada hadlayaan dhismaha saldhig militari oo Israel leedahay. Masar iyo Soomaaliya Masar ayaa dhinaceeda xoojisay xiriirka siyaasadeed iyo militari ee ay la leedahay Soomaaliya, xilli uu sii qoto dheeraanayo khilaafkeeda Itoobiya ee la xiriira webiga Nile iyo raadinta Addis Ababa ee marin-badeed. Qaahira iyo Muqdisho ayaa bishii January 2025 xiriirkooda gaarsiiyay heer iskaashi istaraatiiji ah. Heshiiskaas ayaa daboolaya wadatashiyada siyaasadeed, iskaashiga difaaca, ganacsiga, maalgashiga, beeraha, gaadiidka iyo tamarta. Masar ayaa sidoo kale ballanqaadday inay taageerada Soomaaliya sii wadi doonto, iyadoo lagu saleynayo heshiis iskaashi difaac oo labada dal ay saxiixeen bishii August 2024. Qaahira ayaa markii dambe hub iyo qalab militari u dirtay Soomaaliya, arrintaas oo Itoobiya ay ka muujisay walaac, iyadoo sheegtay in hubkaasi uu sii kicin karo xiisadaha gobolka. Masar ayaa sidoo kale oggolaatay inay ciidamo ku biiriso howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya, ee AUSSOM. Abdelatty ayaa sheegay in Masar ay go’aankaas gaartay kadib codsi uga yimid dowladda Soomaaliya iyo oggolaansho ay bixiyeen Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka ee Midowga Afrika. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa ku adkeysatay inay xaq u leedahay inay go’aamiso dowladaha ciidamadoodu ka qeyb qaadanayaan howlgalka, kaas oo ciidamada Soomaaliya ka taageera dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxda Al-Shabaab. Maqaalka Al Jazeera ayaa ku dooday in Qaahira ay hammiga badeed ee Itoobiya u aragto qeyb ka mid ah loollan ballaaran oo ka socda Soomaaliya, Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas. Hase yeeshee, sheegashada ugu weyn ee ah in Itoobiya ay soo jeedisay in heshiiska biyo-xireenka lagu beddesho deked ama saldhig militari oo ay ka hesho Soomaaliya ama Eritrea ayaa ah arrin ku cusub xiisadda. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan oo yeeshay shir lagu xoojinayay xiriirka labada dal
items.description: Cammaan Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaan Cali Dhaay, ayaa kulan laba geesood ah la yeeshay Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka ahna Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ah ee Pakistan, Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar. Labada wasiir ayaa ka wada hadlay xiriirka laba geesoodka ah iyo arrimaha ay labada dal wadaagaan. Inta uu kulanka socday ayaa labada hoggaamiye waxa ay diirada sareen sida ay uga go’an tahay xoojinta iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, gaar ahaan dhinacyada diblomaasiyadda, dhaqaalaha iyo mudnaanta horumarinta bulshada. Kulankan labada wasiir ayaa ka dhacay magaalada Cammaan, halkaasi oo uu ka socdo shir caalami ah oo ay marti-gelisay dowladda Jordan. items.title: Ciidamada Puntland oo dagaal kula wareegay xerada PSF ee Gaalkacyo
items.description: Gaalkacyo ( Raxanreeb Online) Ciidamada ammaanka ee maamulka Puntland, ayaa la wareegay xerada ay ku sugnaayeen ciidamada PSF (Puntland Security Force) ee magaalada Gaalkacyo, kaddib dagaal saakay ka dhacay magaalada. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada Puntland ay gudaha u galeen xerada, kaddib dagaal culus oo ka dhacay xerada, kaasi oo laisku adeegsaday hubka noocyadiisa kala duwan. Ilo deegaanka ah ayaa sheegay in qaar ka mid ah ciidamada PSF ay isaga baxeen xerada ka hor intii aan la wareegin. Muuqaalo lagu baahiyay baraha bulshada ayay Puntland kusoo bandhigtay gaadiid dagaal iyo hub oo xerada yaalla, isla markaana la sheegay inay lahaayeen ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee PFS ee taabasan dowladda dhexe. Sidoo kale, warbaahinta deegaannada Puntland ayaa tebisay in qaar kamid ah ciidamada PFS-ta ee dagaaka ku jiray ay is dhiibeen, waxaana weli xaaladdu ay tahay mid kacsan, iyada dhaq-dhaqaaqyo laga dareemayaa Gaalkacyo ee gobolka Mudug. La wareegista xeradan ayaa daba socota xiisado soo jiitamayay oo u dhexeeyay maamulka Puntland iyo ciidamada PSF, kuwaas oo sare u kacay toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay. Ilaa iyo hadda si dhab ah looma oga khasaaraha dhimashada iyo dhaawaca ee soo kala gaaray dhinacyada dagaalamayay.
