items.title: Puntland Forces Clash with Federal-Aligned Unit as Civilians Flee Galkayo Airport Area
items.description: Heavy fighting broke out early Wednesday morning between Puntland security forces and a federally aligned security unit at a military camp near General Abdullahi Yusuf International Airport on the outskirts of Galkayo. In a statement, the Puntland Police Command said its forces had launched a planned operation against a camp occupied by personnel who had recently announced their integration into forces operating under the Federal Government of Somalia. Puntland authorities said the security operation remained ongoing and warned that action would be taken against any group attempting to undermine security, public order or stability in areas under the administration’s control. The clashes reportedly involved Puntland Darawish forces and members of the Puntland Security Forces who are said to be aligned with the Federal Government. The precise command structure and affiliation of the forces involved have not been independently verified. Preliminary reports indicate that at least three people were injured by artillery fire and gunfire exchanged between the two sides. The full extent of the casualties and damage remains unclear. The fighting also displaced families from several neighbourhoods in eastern Galkayo. Local residents told Mustaqbal Media that some families had begun leaving the area in the hours preceding the confrontation after observing military deployments and growing signs of tension. The clashes followed several hours of heightened military activity, with both sides reportedly reinforcing their positions and carrying out opposing troop movements. The Puntland administration has accused Somalia’s Federal Government of fuelling instability in eastern Mudug region. It also warned that the federal-aligned forces would not be allowed to advance further into Galkayo. The Federal Government of Somalia has not yet publicly responded to the accusations. Independent confirmation of the circumstances surrounding the fighting and the number of casualties was not immediately available. items.title: Soomaaliya oo Tacsi u Dirtay Dowladda Itoobiya Kaddib Masiibadii Roobabka Gobolka Amxaarada
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa tacsi rasmi ah u dirtay Dowladda Federaalka Dimuqraadiga Itoobiya, kaddib masiibadii ka dhalatay roobab xooggan oo ka da’ay gobolka Amxaarada, kuwaas oo sababay khasaaro naf iyo maalba leh. War-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya ayaa lagu sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay murugada la qaybsaneyso dowladda, shacabka iyo qoysaska ay dhibaatadu saameysay. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale muujisay garab istaag ay la garab taagan tahay Itoobiya xilligan adag, iyadoo u rajeysay dadka ku dhaawacmay masiibada inay si degdeg ah u bogsadaan. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa lagu bogaadiyay dadaallada socda ee lagu badbaadinayo dadka ay saameeyeen fatahaadaha iyo roobabka xooggan, waxaana lagu baaqay in la sii wado gurmadka bani’aadannimo ee loo fidinayo bulshada ay dhibaatadu haleeshay. Ugu dambeyn, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa mar kale u dirtay shacabka iyo dowladda Itoobiya tacsi iyo tiiraanyo, iyadoo u rajeysay dhaawacyada caafimaad degdeg ah, isla markaana muujisay sida ay uga xun tahay masiibada dabiiciga ah ee ka dhacday gobolka Amxaarada.

items.title: Ciidamada maamulka Puntland oo La Wareegay Xeradii PSF ee Gaalkacyo
items.description: Ciidamada Ammaanka maamulka Puntland ayaa la wareegay xarun ay hore u isticmaali jireen ciidamada PSF ee magaalada Gaalkacyo, kaddib dagaal Culus oo saaka halkaas ka dhacay. War-saxaafadeed ay soo saareen Ciidanka Booliska Puntland ayaa lagu sheegay in dagaalka uu bartilmaameedkiisu ahaa goobo uu maamulka Puntland ku eedeeyay inay ku sugnaayeen maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo khatar ku ahaa amniga, xasilloonida iyo kala dambeynta deegaanka. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka, oo Puntland ay booskii dagaalka u adeegsatay erayga “Howgal amni” dhacdadu waxay qayb ka hayd qorshe lagu adkeynayo fulinta sharciga, ilaalinta nabadgelyada iyo ciribtirka kooxaha hubeysan ee loo arko inay wiiqayaan amniga. Si kastaba ha ahaatee dagaalka Gaalkacyo oo muddo saacado ah socday ayay Puntland ku guuleystay inay qabsato xaruntii PSF, lamana oga tillaabada xegi doonta.

items.title: Mareykanka oo ku qasban in uu joojiyo dagaalka Iran kadib markii ay ka dhamaadeen…
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Militariga Mareykanka ayaa isticmaalay inta badan keydkoodii gantaallada riddada dheer ee sida tooska h loo hago, kadib shan bilood oo dagaal ah oo uu kula jiray Iran, arrintaas oo dhalisay walaac ku saabsan awoodda Washington ay uga jawaabi karto dagaallo ama qalalaase cusub oo ka dhaca meelo kale oo dunida ah. Saddex qof oo xog-ogaal u ah tirakoobka hubka militariga ayaa Reuter s u sheegay in Mareykanku uu si weyn u isticmaalay gantaallada dhulka laga rido ee loo yaqaanno Army Tactical Missile Systems — ATACMS — iyo Precision Strike Missiles — PrSM. Laba ka mid ah ilahaas ayaa sheegay in “ku dhowaad dhammaan” keydkii labadan nooc ee gantaallada la isticmaalay, inkasta oo aysan shaacin tirada hubka hadda u hartay militariga Mareykanka. Xogta muujineysa heerka uu hoos ugu dhacay keydka gantaallada ATACMS iyo PrSM ayaan hore si faahfaahsan loogu soo bandhigin warbaahinta. Gantaalladan oo midkiiba qiimihiisu ka badan yahay hal milyan oo dollar ayaa militariga u oggolaanaya inuu bartilmaameedyo si sax ah uga duqeeyo masaafo fog, isaga oo aan askarta iyo diyaaradaha dagaalka gelin khatar toos ah. Gantaallada ATACMS ee Mareykanku siiyay Ukraine ayaa sidoo kale door weyn ka qaatay dagaalka Ruushka iyo Ukraine, iyagoo ciidamada Kyiv u suurtageliyay inay weeraraan bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla gudaha dhulka Ruushka. PrSM waa jiil cusub oo casri ah, waxaana la qorsheynayaa inuu beddelo ATACMS, oo leh awood iyo masaafo ka gaaban tan gantaallada cusub. Weerarro halis badan Hoos u dhaca weyn ee keydka gantaallada riddada dheer ayaa la sheegay inay madaxweyne Donald Trump ku qasbi karto inuu ku tiirsanaado diyaarado ay duuliyayaal wadaan, haddii uu mar kale billaabo duqeymo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah Iran. Taasi waxay sare u qaadi kartaa khatarta ay la kulmayaan duuliyayaasha Mareykanka, gaar ahaan marka la weerarayo waddan leh nidaamyo difaaca cirka oo xooggan. Trump ayaa dagaalka Iran si wadajir ah ula billaabay Israel bishii Febraayo, isaga oo xilligaas saadaaliyay in colaadda ay muddo kooban socon doonto. Hase yeeshee, dagaalka oo sii daba-dheeraaday ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in isticmaalka joogtada ah ee hubka casriga ah uu wiiqo awoodda Mareykanka uu kaga hortagi karo dalal kale oo ay xafiiltamaan, sida Ruushka iyo Shiinaha. Il afraad oo arrintan xog-ogaal u ah ayaa sheegay in inkasta oo tiro badan oo hubka saxda ah la isticmaalay, haddana Mareykanku uu weli awoodo inuu dib u buuxiyo keydkiisa. Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka, oo maamula howlgalada ciidamada dalkaas ee Bariga Dhexe, ayaa hub kasoo uruuriyay saldhigyada iyo keydadka Mareykanka ee ku kala yaalla dunida, sida uu sheegay qofkaas. Dhammaan ilaha xogta bixiyay ayaa codsaday inaan magacyadooda la shaacin, sababo la xiriira xasaasiyadda macluumaadka ay ka hadlayeen. Aqalka Cad oo beeniyay Markii wax laga weydiiyay xaaladda keydka hubka, Aqalka Cad ayaa soo saaray bayaan uu Trump ku sheegay in Mareykanku haysto “hub ka badan dal kasta oo dunida ku yaalla”, isla markaana uu haysto wax ka badan inta uu u baahan yahay. “Shirkadaha difaaca Mareykanka waxay xilligan sameynayaan hub ka badan intii ay waligood sameeyeen, waxayna si aan hore loo arag u ballaarinayaan warshadahooda iyo qalabkooda,” ayuu yiri Trump. Falanqeeyayaasha ayaa isku raacsan in wax-soo-saarka qaar ka mid ah hubka, oo ay ku jiraan madaafiicda iyo noocyo kala duwan oo gantaallo ah, uu gaaray heerar sare. Hase yeeshee, waxay ka digayaan in wax-soo-saarka hadda jira uusan la jaanqaadi karin baahida ka dhalan karta dagaal weyn oo muddo dheer socda. Shirkadda Lockheed Martin, oo sameysa gantaallada ATACMS iyo PrSM, iyo sidoo kale nidaamka difaaca gantaallada ee THAAD, kama aysan jawaabin su’aalaha la xiriira xaaladda keydka. Shirkadda Raytheon, oo soo saarta gantaallada Tomahawk iyo kuwa difaaca ee Patriot, ayaan iyaduna markiiba ka jawaabin codsiga faallo bixinta. Afhayeenka ugu sarreeya Pentagon-ka, Sean Parnell, ayaa sheegay in militariga Mareykanka uu weli yahay kan ugu awoodda badan dunida, isla markaana uu haysto wax kasta oo uu u baahan yahay. “Militariga Mareykanka wuxuu awood u leeyahay inuu fuliyo howlgal kasta, goob kasta iyo xilli kasta oo uu madaxweynuhu doorto,” ayuu yiri Parnell. “Waxaan fulinnay howlgallo badan oo guuleystay, annagoo isla markaana xaqiijinnay in militarigu haysto hub iyo awood ku filan oo lagu difaaco shacabka iyo danaha Mareykanka.” Dood ka dhex taagan maamulka Xogta la xiriirta yaraanshaha hubka ayaa toddobaadkii lasoo dhaafay dhex wareegeysay hay’adaha dowladda Mareykanka, xilli saraakiisha maamulka Trump ay ka doodayeen muddada uu dalku sii wadi karo weerarrada Iran. Walaaca ugu weyn ayaa ah in haddii keydka hubka loo isticmaalo dagaalka Iran uu gaaro heer aad u hooseeya, Mareykanku uusan awoodin inuu si degdeg ah uga jawaabo qalalaase cusub oo ka dhaca Yurub ama gobolka Indo-Pacific. Mid ka mid ah ilaha ayaa sheegay in isticmaalka badan ee ATACMS iyo PrSM uu ka dhashay go’aan maamulka Trump uu ku doonayay inuu ka fogaado weerarro ay fulinayaan diyaarado ay duuliyayaal wadaan. Hubkan ayaa bartilmaameedyada laga weerari karaa masaafo fog, waana sababta uu muhiim ugu yahay dagaal lala galo waddan leh difaac cirka oo horumarsan, sida Shiinaha. Warbixin bishii Maarso ay soo saartay xarunta daraasaadka ee Center for Strategic and International Studies — CSIS — ayaa sheegtay in gantaallada PrSM loo adeegsaday weerarro ka dhacay gudaha Iran. Keydka PrSM ayaa markii horeba koobnaa, maadaama uu yahay hub cusub, hase yeeshee militariga Mareykanka ayaa dalbaday tiro badan oo gantaalladan ah oo la filayo in la soo saaro ama la gaarsiiyo sannadka 2027. Ciidamada dhulka Mareykanka ayaa sheegay inay si tartiib ah meesha uga saarayaan ATACMS, iyadoo wax-soo-saarka loo wareejinayo PrSM. Hubka difaaca oo isna yaraaday Saraakiisha militariga ayaa toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay Trump uga digayay in keydka hubka difaaca, gaar ahaan gantaallada Patriot ee lagu burburiyo gantaallada ballistic-ga ah, uu si degdeg ah u yaraanayo. Warbaahinno dhowr ah ayaa toddobaadkii hore sheegay in Trump uu ka laabtay weerar kale oo ballaaran oo lagu qaado Iran, kadib markii la-taliyayaashiisa militariga ay uga digeen xaaladda keydka hubka. Sarkaal Mareykan ah ayaa arrintaas beeniyay, wuxuuna sheegay in Trump uu weerarka uga laabtay cadaadis uga yimid dowladaha Khaliijka. Dagaalka Bariga Dhexe ayaa sidoo kale dhaliyay dood xooggan oo ku saabsan awoodda sharci ee Trump uu ku sii wadi karo dagaalka Iran, isaga oo aan oggolaansho ka haysan Congress-ka. Maamulka Trump ayaan Congress-ka u gudbin codsi rasmi ah oo lagu iclaaminayo dagaal ama lagu ansixinayo adeegsiga awoodda militariga. Warbixin kale oo CSIS ay soo saartay ayaa qiyaastay in intii u dhexeysay Febraayo iyo Luulyo la isticmaalay ku dhowaad 65 boqolkiiba gantaallada Patriot ee keydka Mareykanka. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in tirada gantaallada THAAD ee hadda ku jira keydka ay ugu yaraan 38 boqolkiiba ka yar tahay tiradii jirtay markii dagaalka la billaabay. Laba ka mid ah ilaha xog-ogaalka ah ayaa sheegay in qiyaasahaas ay waafaqsan yihiin xogta gudaha ee dowladda Mareykanka. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inuu isticmaalay wax yar ka yar kala bar keydkiisa caalamiga ah ee gantaallada Tomahawk tan iyo markii dagaalka Iran uu billowday, inkasta oo tiradaas aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin. Tomahawk waa gantaal ay isticmaalaan ciidamada badda Mareykanka, waxaana laga ridi karaa maraakiibta dagaalka iyo gujisyada, isaga oo u oggolaanaya militariga inuu weeraro goobaha sida weyn loo ilaaliyo, iyada oo aan khatar la gelin duuliyayaasha. Shirkadda Raytheon ayaa heshiis hordhac ah oo dhowr sano ah la gaartay Pentagon-ka si loo kordhiyo wax-soo-saarka Tomahawk iyo hub kale, xilli Washington ay dadaal ugu jirto inay dib u dhisto keydkeeda sii yaraanaya. Mid ka mid ah ilaha ayaa sheegay in isticmaalka badan ee ATACMS iyo PrSM uu ka dhashay go’aan maamulka Trump uu ku doonayay inuu ka fogaado weerarro ay fulinayaan diyaarado ay duuliyayaal wadaan. Hubkan ayaa bartilmaameedyada laga weerari karaa masaafo fog, waana sababta uu muhiim ugu yahay dagaal lala galo waddan leh difaac cirka oo horumarsan, sida Shiinaha. Warbixin bishii Maarso ay soo saartay xarunta daraasaadka ee Center for Strategic and International Studies — CSIS — ayaa sheegtay in gantaallada PrSM loo adeegsaday weerarro ka dhacay gudaha Iran. Keydka PrSM ayaa markii horeba koobnaa, maadaama uu yahay hub cusub, hase yeeshee militariga Mareykanka ayaa dalbaday tiro badan oo gantaalladan ah oo la filayo in la soo saaro ama la gaarsiiyo sannadka 2027. Ciidamada dhulka Mareykanka ayaa sheegay inay si tartiib ah meesha uga saarayaan ATACMS, iyadoo wax-soo-saarka loo wareejinayo PrSM. Hubka difaaca oo isna yaraaday Saraakiisha militariga ayaa toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay Trump uga digayay in keydka hubka difaaca, gaar ahaan gantaallada Patriot ee lagu burburiyo gantaallada ballistic-ga ah, uu si degdeg ah u yaraanayo. Warbaahinno dhowr ah ayaa toddobaadkii hore sheegay in Trump uu ka laabtay weerar kale oo ballaaran oo lagu qaado Iran, kadib markii la-taliyayaashiisa militariga ay uga digeen xaaladda keydka hubka. Sarkaal Mareykan ah ayaa arrintaas beeniyay, wuxuuna sheegay in Trump uu weerarka uga laabtay cadaadis uga yimid dowladaha Khaliijka. Dagaalka Bariga Dhexe ayaa sidoo kale dhaliyay dood xooggan oo ku saabsan awoodda sharci ee Trump uu ku sii wadi karo dagaalka Iran, isaga oo aan oggolaansho ka haysan Congress-ka. Maamulka Trump ayaan Congress-ka u gudbin codsi rasmi ah oo lagu iclaaminayo dagaal ama lagu ansixinayo adeegsiga awoodda militariga. Warbixin kale oo CSIS ay soo saartay ayaa qiyaastay in intii u dhexeysay Febraayo iyo Luulyo la isticmaalay ku dhowaad 65 boqolkiiba gantaallada Patriot ee keydka Mareykanka. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in tirada gantaallada THAAD ee hadda ku jira keydka ay ugu yaraan 38 boqolkiiba ka yar tahay tiradii jirtay markii dagaalka la billaabay. Laba ka mid ah ilaha xog-ogaalka ah ayaa sheegay in qiyaasahaas ay waafaqsan yihiin xogta gudaha ee dowladda Mareykanka. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inuu isticmaalay wax yar ka yar kala bar keydkiisa caalamiga ah ee gantaallada Tomahawk tan iyo markii dagaalka Iran uu billowday, inkasta oo tiradaas aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin. Tomahawk waa gantaal ay isticmaalaan ciidamada badda Mareykanka, waxaana laga ridi karaa maraakiibta dagaalka iyo gujisyada, isaga oo u oggolaanaya militariga inuu weeraro goobaha sida weyn loo ilaaliyo, iyada oo aan khatar la gelin duuliyayaasha. Shirkadda Raytheon ayaa heshiis hordhac ah oo dhowr sano ah la gaartay Pentagon-ka si loo kordhiyo wax-soo-saarka Tomahawk iyo hub kale, xilli Washington ay dadaal ugu jirto inay dib u dhisto keydkeeda sii yaraanaya. items.title: Puntland oo ka hadashay dagaalka culus ee ka dhacay Gaalkacyo
items.description: Puntland ayaa war ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in ciidamadeeda ay maanta hawlgal ka fuliyeen Magaalada Gaalkacyo ee Gobolka Mudug, kaas oo ay sheegtay in lagu beegsaday goobo ay ku sugnaayeen maleeshiyaad hubeysan, oo ay ku eedeysay inay khatar ku ahaayeen amniga. “Ciidanka Amniga Puntland ayaa maanta hawlgal amni ka fuliyay Magaalada Gaalkacyo ee Gobolka Mudug, halkaas oo lagu beegsaday goobo ay ku sugnaayeen maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo khatar ku ahaa amniga, xasilloonida iyo kala dambeynta dalka.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Hawlgalka ayaa qayb ka ah dadaalada joogtada ah ee lagu xaqiijinayo sarreynta sharciga, ilaalinta shacabka iyo ciribtirka kooxaha hubeysan ee isku daya inay wax u dhimaan nabadda iyo amniga. Hawlgalku weli wuu socdaa, waxaana loo fulinayaa si waafaqsan sharciga iyo habraacyada ciidamada amniga.” Puntland ayaa waxay sheegtay in tallaabooyin adag oo sharci ah laga qaadi doono cid kasta oo ku lug yeelata falal ka dhan ah amniga iyo kala dambaynta, isla-markaana aan loo dulqaadan doonin koox ama shakhsi kasta oo u adeegaya cadowga Puntland. “Ciidanka Amniga Puntland waxay caddeynayaan in tallaabooyin adag oo sharci ah laga qaadi doono cid kasta oo ku lug yeelata falal ka dhan ah amniga iyo kala dambeynta. Dowladda Puntland waxaa ka go’an in aan marnaba loo dulqaadan doonin koox ama shakhsi kasta oo u adeegaya cadowga Puntland ama halis gelinaya amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Dhanka kale wararka ka imanaya Magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa sheegaya in Ciidamada Puntland, gaar ahaan Daraawiishta iyo kuwa PMPF ay la wareegeen xerada ay Ciidanka PSF ku lahaayeen bariga magaaladaasi. Ciidanka PSF oo Dowladda Federaalka ay taageerto ayay wararku sheegayaan in ay isaga baxeen xeradaasi, ka dib dagaalkii ay saaka magaalada kula galeen Ciidamada Puntland. Dagaalka Gaalkacyo ayaa sii kordhiyay xiisaddii siyaasadeed ee horey uga dhexeysay Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland.

items.title: Midowga Yurub oo Heshiis ka Gaaray Xiisaddii Ka Dhalatay Siyaasadda Spain ee Ceuta
items.description: Wasiirrada Arrimaha Gudaha ee Midowga Yurub ayaa magaalada Brussels ku soo gabagabeeyay shir xasaasi ah oo looga hadlayay siyaasadda socdaalka iyo ilaalinta xuduudaha, kaddib toddobaadyo ay socotay kala-qeybsanaan diblomaasiyadeed oo ka dhalatay tallaabooyinkii Spain ka qaaday maamulka xuduudda Ceuta. Xiisaddan ayaa cirka isku shareertay ka hor shirka,  ka dib markii 22 dal oo ka tirsan Midowga Yurub, kuwaas oo ay hormuud u ahaayeen Talyaaniga iyo Denmark, ay warqad wadajir ah u direen madaxda sare ee Midowga Yurub iyo dowladda Spain. Warqaddaasi waxay ku muujiyeen walaac ku saabsan habka Spain u maareyneyso xuduudaha, iyagoo ku baaqay in la adkeeyo ilaalinta xadka dibadda ee Yurub si loo xakameeyo tahriibka sharci-darrada ah. Dhanka kale, Guddoomiyaha Komishanka Yurub Ursula von der Leyen ayaa taageero u muujisay dowladda Spain, iyadoo warqad ay u dirtay Ra’iisul Wasaare Pedro Sánchez ku ammaantay wada-shaqeynta Spain iyo Morocco ee lagu xakameynayo xaaladda Ceuta, iyadoo sheegtay in tallaabooyinkaas ay gacan ka geysteen ka hortagga qulqulka tahriibayaasha. Shirka Brussels ayaa ugu dambeyn lagu gaaray heshiis lagu dejinayo xiisadda, iyadoo waddamada xubnaha ka ah Midowga Yurub ay isku raaceen in la xoojiyo iskaashiga dhinaca ilaalinta xuduudaha iyo burburinta shabakadaha caalamiga ah ee ka ganacsada tahriibinta dadka. Sidoo kale, wasiirradu waxay isku afgarteen in la kordhiyo la socodka baraha bulshada iyo aaladaha internetka ee ay isticmaalaan kooxaha tahriibiyeyaasha, lana horumariyo wadaagga xogta sirdoonka iyo nidaamyada digniinta hore si looga hortago tahriibka. Inkastoo ay jireen doodo iyo walaac ay muujiyeen qaar ka mid ah waddamada xubnaha ka ah, gaar ahaan Talyaaniga, shirku wuxuu si cad u xaqiijiyay in Spain ay sii ahaaneyso xubin buuxda oo ka tirsan aagga Schengen, isla markaana aan wax isbeddel ah lagu sameyn doonin maqaamkeeda. Mas’uuliyiinta Midowga Yurub ayaa sidoo kale si rasmi ah u bogaadiyay dadaallada Spain ee lagu xakameeyay isku dayadii tahriibayaasha ay ku doonayeen inay uga gudbaan Ceuta gudaha qaaradda Yurub. Inkastoo ay jireen kala aragti duwanaansho siyaasadeed, haddana heshiiska la gaaray ayaa dib u xoojiyay wadajirka dalalka xubnaha ka ah, isagoo caddeeyay in la-dagaallanka tahriibka iyo sugidda amniga xuduudaha ay yihiin mas’uuliyad wadajir ah oo ay wadaagaan dhammaan waddamada Midowga Yurub.

items.title: Golaha Mustaqbalka oo ku baaqay ficil ka dhan ah Xasan Sheekh kadib hubkii Gaalkacyo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa si adag uga falceliyey hub iyo ciidamo la sheegay in dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay geysay magaalada Gaalkacyo, kaddib iska-horimaad ka dhacay dhinaca koonfureed ee magaalada oo sababay dhaawaca ugu yaraan laba qof. Golaha oo ay ku mideysan yihiin siyaasiyiin mucaarad ah ayaa ku eedeeyey Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud inuu magaalada Gaalkacyo ka abuurayo xiisad colaadeed oo halis gelin karta nabadda, xasilloonida iyo wada-noolaanshaha bulshada ku dhaqan deegaannada Galmudug iyo Puntland. “Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed wuxuu si adag u cambaareynayaa hubka iyo ciidamada uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku daabulayo magaalada Gaalkacyo,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeed uu goluhu soo saaray Talaadadii. Goluhu wuxuu sheegay in dagaalkii ka dhashay hubka loo daabulayey Gaalkacyo uu muujinayo khatarta ka dhalan karta waxa uu ku tilmaamay “mas’uuliyad-darro iyo damac gurracan” oo lagu hurinayo khilaaf cusub. Iska-horimaadka ayaa qarxay kaddib markii hub laga dejiyey dhinaca Galmudug ee magaalada ay dhexda u galeen rag hubeysan, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay la wareegeen qayb ka mid ah saanadda oo gaadiid lagu raray. Ciidamada ammaanka Galmudug ayaa la sheegay inay bilaabeen howlgal ay ku doonayeen inay kusoo ceshadaan hubka, waxaana halkaas ka dhacay dagaal sababay dhaawaca laba qof. Xaaladda magaalada ayaa kacsaneyd saacado kaddib iska-horimaadka. Ilaa hadda ma cadda tirada hubka la geeyey Gaalkacyo, cidda loo waday iyo halka uu qorshuhu ahaa in lagu wareejiyo. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo maamulka Galmudug weli si rasmi ah ugama hadlin dhacdada. ‘ Gaalkacyo colaad uma baahna’ Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa sheegay in Gaalkacyo ay tobankii sano ee lasoo dhaafay kasoo kabanaysay dagaallo iyo colaado sokeeye oo sababay dhimasho, barakac iyo burbur dhaqaale. Goluhu wuxuu ku dooday inay nasiib-darro tahay in xilli magaalada ay dib u soo ceshaneyso xasilloonideeda, lagu sameeyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo militari oo horseedi kara isku dhac cusub. “Waa ayaan-darro in Madaxweynaha muddo-xileedkiisu dhammaaday uu colaad hor leh ka hurinayo magaalada, dibna uga abuurayo xasillooni-darro amni,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Gaalkacyo waxay ka kooban tahay laba dhinac oo ay kala maamulaan Puntland iyo Galmudug, balse bulshada magaalada ayaa wadaaga ganacsi, adeegyo iyo xiriirro qoys iyo dhaqan. Magaaladu waxay horey u martigelisay dagaallo culus oo dhex maray ciidamo iyo maleeshiyaad kala taabacsanaa labada maamul, hase yeeshee heshiisyo nabadeed iyo wada-shaqeyn amni ayaa sanadihii dambe yareeyey isku dhacyada. Golaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay la yaab leh tahay in dowladda federaalka ay hub iyo ciidamo u adeegsato xiisado siyaasadeed, xilli kooxda Al-Shabaab ay dib ula wareegeyso deegaanno ay horay uga saareen ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa deegaanka. Baaq loo diray bulshada Mucaaradka ayaa ugu baaqay maamullada Galmudug iyo Puntland, isimada dhaqanka, culimada, waxgaradka iyo ururrada bulshada rayidka inay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan dejinta xaaladda. Goluhu wuxuu si gaar ah uga digay in khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo Puntland uu isu beddelo dagaal ka qarxa Gaalkacyo. “Waxaan ugu baaqeynaa dhammaan qeybaha bulshada inay si wadajir ah uga hortagaan colaadda uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ka hurinayo Gaalkacyo,” ayuu goluhu yiri. War-saxaafadeedka mucaaradka ayaa yimid wax yar kaddib markii Puntland ay dowladda federaalka ku eedeysay inay hub iyo ciidamo kusoo daabuleyso deegaannadeeda. Puntland ayaa sheegtay in hubka laga dejiyey dhinaca Galmudug loo qorsheeyey in loo gudbiyo deegaannada ay maamusho, balse hay’adaha ammaanka iyo dadka deegaanka ay hor istaageen. Maamulka Puntland wuxuu sidoo kale uga digay shacabka inay ka feejignaadaan waxa uu ku tilmaamay faragelin amni oo lagu doonayo in lagu dhaawaco dowladnimada iyo xasilloonida deegaannada maamulkaas. Dowladda federaalka weli kama jawaabin eedeymaha kasoo baxay Puntland iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed. Magaaladu waxay horey u martigelisay dagaallo culus oo dhex maray ciidamo iyo maleeshiyaad kala taabacsanaa labada maamul, hase yeeshee heshiisyo nabadeed iyo wada-shaqeyn amni ayaa sanadihii dambe yareeyey isku dhacyada. Golaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay la yaab leh tahay in dowladda federaalka ay hub iyo ciidamo u adeegsato xiisado siyaasadeed, xilli kooxda Al-Shabaab ay dib ula wareegeyso deegaanno ay horay uga saareen ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa deegaanka. Baaq loo diray bulshada Mucaaradka ayaa ugu baaqay maamullada Galmudug iyo Puntland, isimada dhaqanka, culimada, waxgaradka iyo ururrada bulshada rayidka inay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan dejinta xaaladda. Goluhu wuxuu si gaar ah uga digay in khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo Puntland uu isu beddelo dagaal ka qarxa Gaalkacyo. “Waxaan ugu baaqeynaa dhammaan qeybaha bulshada inay si wadajir ah uga hortagaan colaadda uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ka hurinayo Gaalkacyo,” ayuu goluhu yiri. War-saxaafadeedka mucaaradka ayaa yimid wax yar kaddib markii Puntland ay dowladda federaalka ku eedeysay inay hub iyo ciidamo kusoo daabuleyso deegaannadeeda. Puntland ayaa sheegtay in hubka laga dejiyey dhinaca Galmudug loo qorsheeyey in loo gudbiyo deegaannada ay maamusho, balse hay’adaha ammaanka iyo dadka deegaanka ay hor istaageen. Maamulka Puntland wuxuu sidoo kale uga digay shacabka inay ka feejignaadaan waxa uu ku tilmaamay faragelin amni oo lagu doonayo in lagu dhaawaco dowladnimada iyo xasilloonida deegaannada maamulkaas. Dowladda federaalka weli kama jawaabin eedeymaha kasoo baxay Puntland iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Dagaal u dhexeeya ciidanka DF iyo kuwa Puntland oo ka qarxay magaalada Gaalkacyo
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya gobolka Mudug ayaa sheegaya in saaka aroortii hore uu dagaal culus ka qarxay dhanka waqooyi bari ee magaalada Gaalkacyo, kaas oo u dhexeeyo ciidamada Puntland iyo kuwa PSF-ta ee taabacsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Dagaalka ayaa yimid, kadib markii ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa Puntland ay weerareen fariisimo ay ciidamada PSF-ta ku leeyihiin bariga Gaalkacyo, waxaana kadib sidaas ku qarxay dagaal toos ah. Labada dhinac ayaa isku adeegsanaya hub culus oo ay kamid yihiin hoobiyeyaal lasoo wariyay in qaarkood ay ku dhaceen xaafado ay dagan yihiin shacab waxaana jira khasaare kala duwan, inkastoo aan la xaqiijin karin tirada rasmiga ah. Sidoo kale, dadka deegaanka ayaa dhankooda bilaabay inay ka barakacaan waxyeello kasoo gaarta dagaalka, maadaama ay xaaladda faraha ka baxday, isla markaana dagaalka uu ku fidayo goobo horleh oo ka tirsan magaaladaasi. Wararka ayaa intaa kusii daraya in dagaalka uu sii xoogeysanayo, isla markaana dhinacyadu ay helaan gurmadyo, taas oo uga sii dareysa xiisadda. Dagaalkan wuxuu daba socdaa hub la sheegay in Talaadadii ay dowladda Soomaaliya ka dajisay koonfurta Gaalkacyo, kaas oo ay Puntland sheegtay in loogu talagalay in loo gudbiyo deegaannadeeda, si loogu abuuro xasillooni darro. Muddooyinkii ugu dambeeyay waxaa kacsaneyd xaaladda deegaannada Puntland, kadib markii ay ka bilowdeen dhaq-dhaqaaqyo iska soo horjeedo oo u dhexeeyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo maamulka Puntland. items.title: Dagaal ka qarxay Magaalada Gaalkacyo
items.description: Xiisadda u dhaxeyso Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland ee ka taagan Magaalada Gaalkacyo ee Xarunta Gobolka Mudug ayaa cirka isku shareertay, ka dib markii saaka uu dagaal ka qarxay bariga magaaladaasi. Daraawiishta Puntland iyo Ciidanka PSF ayaa isku horfadhiyay dhanka bari ee magaaalda, gaar ahaan meel u dhow Garoonka Diyaaradaha. Xoogaga PSF ayaa ah cutubyo gaar ah oo horey uga tirsanaa Maamulka Puntland, kuwaas oo ay qarameysay Dowladda Federaalka. Magaalada ayaa waxaa laga dareemaya xaalad aad u kacsan, waxaana waqooyiga Gaalkacyo oo Puntland ay ka arrimiso dhaqdhaqaaq ka wada ciidamada maamulkaasi. Inta badan goobaha ganacsiga ee waqooyiga magaalada ayaa xiran, waxayna dadku ka cabsi qabaan in xaaladda magaalada ay faraha ka baxdo. Warsaxaafadeed xalay ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada Puntland ayaa lagu cambaareeyay Dowladda Federaalka, oo lagu eedeeyay in ciidan iyo hub ku soo daabuleyso deegaanada Puntland. “Maanta 4-ta August 2026 ayay DFS hub kale ka soo dejisay Magaalada Gaalkacyo, gaar ahaan dhinaca Galmudug, si ay ugu soo gudbiso dhinaca Puntland, balse ay ka hortaggeen hay’adaha amniga iyo shacabka Dowladda Galmudug, taas oo keentay iska horimaad sababay khasaare.” Ayaa lagu sheegay warsaxaafadeedka. “Dowladda Puntland waxay ku bogaadineysaa Dowladda Galmudug, ciidankeeda iyo shacabkeeda in ay ka hortaggeen amni darrada ay Dowladda Federalka Somaliya ka waddo Gobolka Mudug iyo in la soo dhex mariyo hub iyo ciidan lagu waxyeeleynayo nabadgelyada deegaanada Puntland.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka oo intaasi ku daray “Puntland iyo Galmudug waxaa ka dhexeeya deris wanaag, wada noolaansho bulsho iyo wada shaqayn maamul oo soo jireen ah. Ilaalinta amniga iyo xasilloonida guud ahaan deegaanada labada maamul waa masuuliyad saaran labada dhinac.” Puntland ayaa ka digtay in wixii ka dhasha falalka amni darrada ay Dowladda Federaalka ku eedeysay inay ka waddo Gobolka Mudug, gaar ahaan Magaalada Gaalkacyo uu masuuliyaddeeda qaadayo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Dowladda Federaalka ayaan weli ka hadlin eedeyntan ugu dambeysay ee uga timid Puntland, waxayna eedeyntan imaneysaa, xilli shalay galab uu koonfurta Gaalkacyo ka dhacay iska horimaad kooban, kaas oo ka dhashay muran la xiriira gaari hub siday. Hubkan oo qayb ahaan ay dhaceen ciidamo loo maleynayo in ay ka tirsan yihiin Daraawiishta Galmudug ayay wararka sheegayaan in odayaasha deegaanka ay xalay ku guuleysteen in la soo celiyo.

items.title: Somaliland oo Noqotay Xulashadda Istaraatiijiigga ah ee Maraykanka ee Geeska Afrika
items.description: Warbixin Caalami ah: Somaliland oo Kasbatay Dareenka Washington” “Dib-u-eegista Siyaasadda Maraykanka: Berbera oo noqotay furaha siyaasadda cusub ee U.S” Brussels (Dawan) Warbixin caalami ah oo ay daabacday International Crisis Group (ICG) ayaa iftiimisay doorka sii kordhaya ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ku leedahay istaraatiijiyadda amniga Geeska Afrika, xilli maamulka madaxweyne Donald Trump uu dib u eegayo siyaasadda dawladda Maraykanka ee Soomaaliya. Sida lagu xusay warbixinta, oo Wargeyska Dawan soo xigtay, xasilloonida Somaliland, goobteeda istaraatiijiga ah iyo awoodda hay’adaha dawladnimo ayaa sii kordhinaya kaalinteeda siyaasadeed iyo tan amni ee gobolka. Warbixintu waxay tilmaamaysaa in Somaliland ay noqotay tiir muhiim ah oo saamaynteeda aan la iska indho-tiri karin ama aan si fudud looga maarmi karin. Sidoo kale, warbixintu waxay muujinaysaa in Somaliland ay leedahay muhiimad istaraatiiji ah oo sii kordhaysa, isla markaana ay ku soo baxday lammaane muhiim u ah Maraykanka. Waxa ay intaa ku dartay in maamulka Trump uu dib u eegayo siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda Maraykanka, iyadoo ay sii xoogaysanayaan doodaha ku saabsan doorka Somaliland iyo muhiimaddeeda istaraatiijiga ah ee Geeska Afrika. Warbixintu waxay tilmaamaysaa in dadaalladii Dawladda Maraykanku ku taageeraysay dowladda Muqdisho muddo ka badan labaatan sano aanay weli horseedin xasillooni waarta. Waxay sheegtay in ururka Al-Shabaab uu weli yahay khatar amni oo weyn, halka khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo dowlad-goboleedyadu ay caqabad ku yihiin dhismaha dowlad awood leh iyo horumarinta amniga. Dhanka Somaliland, warbixintu waxay xustay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay si weyn uga duwan tahay xaaladda qasan ee Soomaaliya. Waxay tilmaantay in Somaliland ay muddo ka badan soddon sano ku guulaysatay dhismaha hay’ado dowladeed oo dimuquraadi ah, ilaalinta amniga iyo xasiloonida gudaha iyo qabashada doorashooyin daah-furan oo isdaba joog ah, kuwaas oo sare u qaaday muhiimaddeeda istaraatiijiga ah ee gobolka. “Marka laga eego dhinaca Somaliland, xaaladdu way ka duwan tahay. Somaliland waxay tan iyo 1991 dhistay hay’ado dowladeed, waxay ilaalisay amniga gudaha, isla markaana waxay qabatay doorashooyin isdaba joog ah. Arrimahaas ayaa sare u qaaday doorkeeda istaraatiijiga ah, gaar ahaan iyadoo ay sii kordhayaan tartamada awoodaha waaweyn ee Geeska Afrika,” ayaa lagu yidhi warbixinta. Sidoo kale, Warbixintu waxay si gaar ah u xustay muhiimadda dekedda Berbera oo ku taalla marin-biyoodka Gacanka Cadmeed. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, dekedda iyo garoonka diyaaradaha ee Magaalada Berbera ayaa loo arkaa fursad istaraatiiji ah oo uu Maraykanku ku ballaadhin karo joogitaankiisa gobolka, isla markaana uu ku yareyn karo ku tiirsanaanta saldhiggiisa milatari ee Djibouti. Intaa waxaa dheer, warbixintu waxay sheegtay in gudaha Washington ay sii kordhayaan cododka diblumaasiyadeed ee taageeraya qaddiyadda Somaliland iyo doodaha ku saabsan dib u eegista siyaasaddii muddada dheer lagu taageerayay mabda’a “Hal Soomaaliya”, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta iyo falanqeeyayaashu ay Somaliland u arkaan lammaane amni iyo istaraatiiji ah oo la isku hallayn karo.

items.title: Qaylo-dhaan laga muujiyay dagaalka mar kale ka qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya
items.description: Ururka xuquuqda aadanaha ee Amnesty International ayaa muujiyay walaac uu ka qabo dib u soo cusboonaanshaha dagaallada u dhexeeya Ciidanka Difaaca Itoobiya iyo ciidammada Tigrayga ee ka socda gobolka Tigray, isagoo sheegay in arrintani ay dadka rayidka ah mar kale u muujinayso xadgudubyo ka dhan ah xuquuqda aadanaha. Agaasimaha Amnesty International ee Bariga iyo Koonfurta Afrika, Tigeree Chagutaa, ayaa sheegtay in dagaallada dib u billowday ay khatar gelinayaan dad aan weli ka soo kaban dhibaatadii dagaalkii hore, isla markaana aan helin caddaalad. War-saxaafadeed ay Amnesty soo saartay saddexdii August ayaa lagu sheegay in ururku sidoo kale uu daba-gal iyo diiwaangelin ku hayo xadgudubyada xuquuqda aadanaha ee ka dhacaya gobollada Amxaarada iyo Oromiya, kuwaas oo lala xidhiidhinayo iska horimaadyo u dhexeeya kooxo hubeysan iyo ciidammada dawladda. Amnesty International ayaa ku baaqday in hay’adaha gudaha iyo kuwa caalamiga ah loo oggolaado in ay si madax-bannaan u baadhaan xadgudubyada xuquuqda aadanaha ee ka dhacaya Itoobiya. Ururku wuxuu xusay in intii uu socday dagaalkii waqooyiga Itoobiya ee u dhexeeyay Nofeembar 2020 ilaa Nofeembar 2022, kaas oo ku dhammaaday heshiis nabadeed, uu ka tagay xadgudubyo aad u daran oo xuquuqda aadanaha ah, kuwaas oo badankood noqon kara dambiyo dagaal iyo dambiyo ka dhan ah aadanaha. Amnesty ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in dawladda Itoobiya aanay ku filnayn baadhitaannada ku saabsan xadgudubyada dhacay, isla markaana aanay caadi ka dhigan in dadka lagu eedeeyo dambiyadaas sharciga la hor geeyo. Ururku wuxuu ugu baaqay dawladda federaalka Itoobiya iyo maamulka Tigray in ay ilaaliyaan oo ixtiraamaan xeerarka caalamiga ah ee xuquuqda aadanaha iyo xuquuqda dadka rayidka ah. Kowdii bishan ayaa la soo sheegay in dagaal uu ka dhacay deegaanka Sharari ee galbeedka Tigray, kaas oo u dhexeeyay Ciidanka Difaaca Itoobiya iyo ciidammada Tigrayga. TPLF ayaa ku eedeysay dawladda Itoobiya in ay weerar ku qaadday ciidammadeeda, iyadoo sheegtay in dagaalku socday laga bilaabo subaxnimadii ilaa galabtii, inkastoo dawladda Itoobiya aanay arrintaas ka jawaabin. Sida ay AFP sheegtay, boqollaal qof oo ka tirsan dadka reer Tigray ayaa dagaalkaas kaddib u qaxay dalka Suudaan. Dawladda Itoobiya ayaa marar kala duwan ku eedeysay TPLF in ay la shaqeynayso Eritrea iyo kooxo kale oo aan dooneyn horumarka Itoobiya si ay dalka u qalalaaseeyaan. Dawladda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Eritrea iyo kooxaha hubaysan ee Fano ay isu diyaarinayeen dagaal cusub. Amnesty International waxay ku baaqday in hay’adaha caalamiga ah ee xuquuqda aadanaha iyo warbaahinta loo oggolaado inay si xor ah u galaan goobaha dagaalku saameeyay ee Tigray si ay baadhitaanno u sameeyaan, waxayna ugu baaqday beesha caalamka in ay arrintan kala hadasho dawladda Itoobiya iyo mas’uuliyiinta TPLF. Ururku wuxuu sheegay in hay’adihii bilaabay baadhitaannada xadgudubyadii dhacay intii lagu jiray dagaalkii waqooyiga Itoobiya la hakiyay markii laga qaaday oggolaanshahoodii. Waxa kale oo uu xusay in guddigii khubarada Qaramada Midoobay iyo guddigii Midowga Afrika ee baadhayay arrimaha xuquuqda aadanaha ee Itoobiya ay joojiyeen shaqadoodii. Amnesty International ayaa sheegtay in hakadka ku yimid geeddi-socodkii caddaaladda ku-meel-gaadhka ahaa ee ay dawladda Itoobiya bilowday uu sababay in dhibbanayaashu aanay helin caddaalad. Dagaalkii labada sano socday ee waqooyiga Itoobiya ayaa sababay dhimashada ku dhowaad 600,000 oo qof, sida uu sheegay ergaygii gaarka ahaa ee Midowga Afrika, Olusegun Obasanjo. Labadii bilood ee u dambeeyay, Amnesty International ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in mas’uuliyiinta TPLF lagu eedeeyay inay xidheen warbaahinta madaxa-bannaan, iyo in ay si khasab ah u qoreen dad badan oo ay ku jiraan dhallinyaro si loogu tababaro ciidan ahaan, isla markaana waxay xaddideen dhaqdhaqaaqa shacabka iyo shaqooyinka hay’adaha xuquuqda aadanuhu ka hayaan aaggaasi. Bbc somali

items.title: Iraan iyo Cumaan oo Heshiis Ku-meel-gaar ah ka Gaaray Isku-socodka Maraakiibta ee Marin-badeedka Hormuz
items.description: Sida uu qoray Wargeyska Financial Times, oo soo xiganaya ilo xog-ogaal ah,Iraan iyo Cumaan ayaa gaaray heshiis ku-meel-gaar ah oo lagu habeynayo isku-socodka maraakiibta ee maraan-badeedka Hormuz. Tallaabadan ayaa lagu sheegay mid looga golleeyahay in lagu yareeyo xiisadaha amni iyo caqabadaha saameeya marin-biyoodkan oo ka mid ah kuwa ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga tamarta caalamka. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, heshiiska ayaa dhigaya in maraakiibta soo galaysa marin-badeedka ay maraan biyaha dhanka Iraan, halka kuwa ka baxaya ay isticmaalaan kanaal u badan biyaha Cumaan. Habkan cusub ayaa la filayaa inuu fududeeyo maamulka isku-socodka maraakiibta isla markaana kor u qaado amniga iyo xasilloonida marinka. Wararka ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in haddii heshiiska si rasmi ah loo dhaqan geliyo, ay dhici karto in Mareykanku dabciyo ama qaado qaar ka mid ah xayiraadaha saaran dekedaha iyo dhoofinta shidaalka ee Iraan. Arrintaasi waxay Tehraan u sahli kartaa inay dib u ballaariso dhoofinta saliidda iyo batroolka, inkastoo aan weli si rasmi ah loo shaacin go’aan noocaas ah. Ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegay in wada-hadallada ay dib u dhaceen sababo la xiriira kala duwanaansho ka dhex jiray Iraan, Mareykanka iyo Cumaan, iyadoo Muscat ay ka walaacsaneyd in qodobada heshiisku aysan ka hor iman shuruucda caalamiga ah ee badaha ama aysan wax u dhimin madax-bannaanida biyaha Cumaan. Warbixintu waxay intaas ku dartay in khilaafaadkii ka taagnaa qoraalka iyo erey-bixinta heshiiska la xalliyay, isla markaana hadda la sugayo ansixinta rasmiga ah ee mas’uuliyiinta ugu sarreeya Iraan ka hor inta aan la guda gelin fulinta heshiiska. Haddii heshiiskan la meel mariyo, waxaa la filayaa inuu saameyn ku yeesho amniga marin-badeedka Hormuz iyo isu-socodka ganacsiga caalamiga ah, maadaama marinkan uu yahay marin istaraatiiji ah oo ay maraan qayb weyn oo ka mid ah shidaalka dunida.

items.title: Hay’adaha Caalamiga ah oo ku Baaqaya in  Taageero Degdeg ah loo dad ay samaysay colaadda Suudaan
items.description: Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Laanqeyrta Cas iyo Bisha Cas (IFRC) ayaa ugu baaqay beesha caalamka inay si degdeg ah u kordhiyaan taageerada bani’aadannimo ee Suudaan, isagoo ka digay in hoos u dhaca dhaqaalaha gargaarka uu halis gelinayo malaayiin qof oo ay saameysay colaadda dalkaasi. Ergeyga gaarka ah ee IFRC u qaabilsan Suudaan, Derk Segaar, ayaa sheegay in Suudaan ay weli tahay mid ka mid ah dhibaatooyinka bani’aadannimo ee ugu waaweyn dunida, balse aan helin dareenka iyo taageerada ku filan ee caalamka. Dagaalka Suudaan oo billowday bishii Abriil 2023, kana dhex qarxay ciidamada dowladda iyo kooxda RSF, ayaa sababay dhimashada ugu yaraan 59,000 oo qof, inkastoo hay’adaha gargaarku ay rumeysan yihiin in tirada dhabta ahi ay intaas aad uga badan tahay. Warbixinta ayaa xustay in 35 milyan oo qof ay u baahan yihiin gargaar bani’aadannimo, halka in ka badan 9 milyan oo qof ay ku barakaceen gudaha dalka, iyadoo 4.5 milyan oo kale ay u qaxeen dalalka deriska ah. Gobollada Kordofaan iyo Daarfuur ayaa weli wajahaya dagaallo culus, halka magaalada Khartuum ay ka jiraan koronto la’aan, biyo yari, adeegyo caafimaad oo burburay, iyo halis sii kordheysa oo ka dhalatay cudurka daacuunka, nafaqo-darrada iyo fatahaadaha. Dhanka militariga, taliye ku xigeenka ciidamada Suudaan, Jeneraal Yaasir Al-Atta, ayaa sheegay in ciidamadu ay ka socdaan guluf dagaal oo ka socda dhammaan jihooyinka, isagoo ku hanjabay in ciidamada RSF laga saari doono goobaha ay ka joogaan dalka ka hor dhammaadka sanadkan. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa xoojisay dadaallada dib loogu soo nooleynayo wada-hadallada siyaasadeed, ayadoo wakiillo ka socda Midowga Afrika, IGAD, Midowga Yurub iyo Jaamacadda Carabta ay la kulmeen hoggaamiyeyaasha rayidka Suudaan si loo dardargeliyo geeddi-socodka nabadda iyo dhismaha kalsoonida. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in ergaygeeda gaarka ah ee Suudaan, Pekka Haavisto, uu wada-hadallo la leeyahay hoggaamiyaha RSF, Jeneraal Maxamed Xamdaan Dagalo (Hemedti), si loo yareeyo xiisadda loona abuuro fursad lagu gaaro xal siyaasadeed oo waara. Si kastaba ha ahaatee hay’adaha gargaarka ayaa ugu dambeyn ku baaqay in beesha caalamku si degdeg ah u kordhiso maalgelinta iyo gurmadka bani’aadannimo si looga hortago in xaaladda Suudaan ay isu beddesho masiibo ka sii daran tan hadda jirta.

items.title: In ka badan 274 Kun oo Qof oo Halis ugu Jira Fatahaadaha El Niño iyo Qaramada Midoobay oo Ku Baaqday Diyaar-garow Degdeg ah
items.description: Hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay, gaar ahaan Hay’adda Cunnada iyo Beeraha (FAO), ayaa ka digtay khatar weyn oo fatahaado ah oo ka dhalan karta roobabka El Niño, kuwaas oo la saadaaliyay inay saameyn xooggan ku yeelan karaan dooxada Webiga Shabeelle. Sida ay sheegtay Waaxda Maareynta Xogta Biyaha iyo Dhulka ee FAO (SWALIM), in ka badan 274,000 oo qof ayaa halis ugu jira fatahaado, kuwaas oo sababi kara barakac ballaaran, burbur ku yimaada dhul-beereedka iyo go’doomin soo wajahda bulshooyinka ku nool hareeraha webiga, gaar ahaan gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Hay’adaha gargaarka ayaa ugu baaqay dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha samafalka inay si degdeg ah u xoojiyaan qorshayaasha ka hortagga masiibooyinka. Tallaabooyinka mudnaanta leh waxaa ka mid ah in bulshada la gaarsiiyo digniino horudhac ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha, si dadka deggan deegaannada halista ku jira ay ugu guuraan goobo ammaan ah ka hor inta aysan biyuhu soo gaarin. Sidoo kale, waxaa la adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay dayactirka iyo nadiifinta biyo-xireennada, gaar ahaan biyo-xireenka Sabuun ee magaalada Jowhar, si loo yareeyo halista biyaha ku fatahaya deegaannada ku dhow. Dhanka kale, FAO ayaa ku baaqday in si degdeg ah loo maareeyo deeq lacageed oo dhan hal milyan oo doollar oo dowladda Belgium ku taageertay sanduuqa SFERA, si gargaar lacageed loogu gaarsiiyo qoysaska ugu nugul ka hor inta aysan fatahaaduhu go’doomin. Hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay waxay xuseen in Soomaaliya ay weli ka mid tahay dalalka ugu daran ee ay saameeyaan isbeddelka cimilada, iyagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in maalgelinta iyo diyaar-garowga ka hor masiibada ay ka waxtar badan yihiin gurmadka la sameeyo marka ay musiibadu dhacdo. items.title: Al-Shabaab Opens Multiple Fronts as Somalia’s Political Crisis Deepens
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – While Somalia’s political leadership remains consumed by a prolonged constitutional and electoral standoff, Al-Shabaab is once again demonstrating an unsettling capacity to wage coordinated military operations across multiple regions of the country—raising fresh questions about whether political paralysis is creating dangerous opportunities for the insurgency. According to reports from the Hiiraan region, fierce fighting that raged for more than 48 hours between Somali government forces and Al-Shabaab ended with the militant group taking control of the strategic villages of Teedaan, Suulaay, and Xasan Raqay after government troops reportedly carried out what officials described as a tactical withdrawal. The clashes were among the most intense reported in recent months. Local sources said hundreds of fighters from both sides were killed or wounded, with Al-Shabaab believed to have suffered particularly heavy casualties. Independent verification of the casualty figures remains unavailable. Military sources attribute the setback partly to reported disagreements between the Somali National Army and local Macawiisley community fighters, whose cooperation has been a cornerstone of previous counterinsurgency successes in central Somalia. The reported breakdown in coordination is said to have weakened the government’s defensive positions at a critical moment. Al-Shabaab, meanwhile, reportedly reinforced its offensive by deploying thousands of additional fighters from other parts of the country, highlighting the group’s ability to rapidly shift manpower and sustain simultaneous operations across multiple battlefronts. A Movement Fighting on Multiple Fronts Security analysts say the latest developments underscore a broader trend that has become increasingly difficult to ignore. Despite years of military campaigns, international assistance, and repeated government declarations that the insurgency is nearing defeat, Al-Shabaab continues to demonstrate remarkable operational resilience. The group has repeatedly shown it can launch coordinated attacks across several Federal Member States while maintaining pressure along the Kenya-Somalia border. Its ability to reinforce battles in Hiiraan while sustaining operations elsewhere reflects a level of organization, logistics, and command that remains a formidable challenge for Somali security forces. The renewed battlefield momentum comes as Somalia remains mired in one of its deepest political crises in years. The Federal Government and major opposition groups remain divided over elections, constitutional reforms, and the legitimacy of national institutions. Relations between Mogadishu and several Federal Member States have also deteriorated, limiting the unified national response many security experts argue is essential for defeating Al-Shabaab. Critics contend that prolonged political confrontation has diverted attention and resources away from counterterrorism operations at a time when the insurgency is adapting and regrouping. Some political observers further argue that controversial disputes over public land in Mogadishu, which they say have displaced hundreds of thousands of people, have compounded social and economic pressures. They warn that large-scale displacement, unemployment, and weakened public trust in state institutions can create conditions that extremist groups seek to exploit for recruitment, although the extent of that impact remains difficult to quantify. A Growing Strategic Concern For many analysts, the fighting in Hiiraan is about more than the loss of several rural settlements. It reflects a broader concern that Somalia’s political divisions are beginning to undermine military gains painstakingly achieved over the past several years. As government institutions remain preoccupied with political disputes, Al-Shabaab appears intent on projecting strength, demonstrating mobility, and exploiting every opportunity created by fragmentation among its opponents. Whether the latest territorial gains prove temporary or signal a broader shift on the battlefield remains to be seen. What is increasingly clear, however, is that Somalia’s security and political crises are no longer separate challenges. Each is reinforcing the other. Unless political consensus is restored and military operations are matched by sustained governance, analysts warn that Al-Shabaab will continue to exploit divisions and regain influence in areas once thought to have been secured. items.title: Somalia: A Republic, Not a Throne
items.description: By Abdullahi A. Nor Somalia’s constitutional crisis has evolved into something far greater than a dispute over election dates or political rivalries. At its core lies a fundamental question that will shape the country’s democratic future for generations: Can a constitutional republic function if the limits placed on executive power are no longer respected ? That question has taken on renewed urgency following remarks by opposition leader Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame, who defended the Somali Future Council’s proposal for an inclusive caretaker arrangement or an alternative transitional political mechanism should negotiations over elections remain deadlocked. His argument is straightforward: Somalia’s crisis is political, and only a political settlement grounded in constitutional legitimacy can resolve it. Whether one agrees with the opposition’s proposal is ultimately secondary to the larger constitutional debate it has exposed. The controversy is no longer simply about who governs Somalia next. It is about whether constitutional authority is determined by law or by the political preferences of those already in office. For more than three decades, Somalis have struggled to rebuild a nation shattered by civil war, institutional collapse, and political fragmentation. Through countless reconciliation conferences, constitutional negotiations, and state-building efforts, one principle has remained at the heart of Somalia’s democratic aspirations: no individual should stand above the Constitution. Today, that principle faces one of its greatest tests. The debate reignited by Abdirahman Abdishakur is not simply another disagreement over elections or a contest between the government and the opposition. It is a much deeper argument about the very nature of the Somali state. Is Somalia a constitutional republic governed by law, or is it becoming a political system where the continued exercise of power depends primarily on the will of the individual occupying Villa Somalia? That question goes to the heart of the country’s democratic future. In every constitutional democracy, political authority derives from law rather than personality. Presidents govern because constitutions authorize them to do so—not because they personally decide when their mandate begins or ends. When constitutional terms expire, governments continue only within clearly defined caretaker limitations as per Article 103 of the PFCS until a new political settlement or election restores full democratic legitimacy. That is how constitutional republics preserve stability. Monarchies function differently. In monarchies, continuity revolves around the ruler. In republics, continuity revolves around institutions. Somalia’s Provisional Constitution was drafted precisely to prevent the return of unlimited executive authority. After decades of authoritarian rule followed by state collapse, Somali political leaders deliberately chose a constitutional order built upon negotiated legitimacy, institutional checks, and power-sharing. The Constitution was never intended to become a document that leaders interpret according to political convenience. It was intended to establish rules that apply equally to everyone—including those holding the highest office. That is why the current constitutional dispute has become so significant. Abdirahman Abdishakur argues that Somalia’s crisis cannot be solved with additional military operations, larger donor packages, or increased security assistance. His central argument deserves careful consideration. Political crises are ultimately resolved through political agreements. History repeatedly demonstrates that security operations may suppress violence temporarily, while financial assistance may stabilize institutions for a period. Neither, however, can substitute for political legitimacy. No amount of foreign funding can persuade citizens that disputed constitutional authority is legitimate. No military victory can permanently overcome a crisis of governance. No external actor can negotiate constitutional consensus on behalf of Somalis. That explains why the Somali Future Council recently proposed alternatives that include either the establishment of an inclusive caretaker government or, should that prove politically impossible, a temporary national mechanism to oversee the country’s electoral transition until a broad political settlement can be reached. Predictably, critics immediately portrayed these proposals as an attempt to drag Somalia back into the era of transitional governments. That criticism fundamentally misunderstands the proposal. The issue is not whether Somalia should become transitional again. The issue is whether Somalia should remain constitutional. Every mature democracy recognizes that exceptional political disputes occasionally require temporary arrangements designed to preserve institutional legitimacy while political disagreements are resolved. Caretaker governments exist precisely because constitutions recognize that elections cannot always occur exactly as planned. What is extraordinary is not proposing temporary constitutional mechanisms. What is extraordinary is expecting an administration whose constitutional mandate has expired to continue exercising unrestricted executive authority while simultaneously overseeing an election in which it is itself a principal political actor. That is precisely where public concern has intensified. Many Somalis increasingly fear that constitutional limits are being treated as political inconveniences rather than binding legal obligations. Whether one supports or opposes President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud politically is almost beside the point. The more important question is institutional. If constitutional limits can be ignored today because one political leader considers them inconvenient, what prevents future leaders from doing exactly the same thing? Constitutions lose their value the moment they become optional. The country already faces extraordinary challenges. Al-Shabaab remains one of Africa’s most resilient insurgent movements. Relations between the Federal Government and several Federal Member States remain deeply strained. International partners have repeatedly expressed concern about the absence of broad political consensus. Questions surrounding elections, constitutional amendments, and institutional legitimacy continue to dominate Somalia’s political landscape. Adding a constitutional legitimacy crisis to this already volatile environment serves no national interest. Somalia’s democratic future will ultimately be determined not by who wins the next election, but by whether every political actor—including those currently exercising executive authority—accepts that public office is temporary, constitutional authority is limited, and political legitimacy must continuously derive from law rather than personal preference. That is the defining difference between democratic leadership and personal rule. It is also the defining difference between governing a constitutional republic and governing as though one occupies a throne. Somalia has already sacrificed too much in pursuit of constitutional government to allow that distinction to become blurred. The country deserves institutions that outlive individual leaders, elections that command broad confidence, and constitutional rules that bind everyone equally. Only then will Somalia complete the democratic journey it began more than three decades ago—not toward the rule of one individual, but toward the enduring supremacy of the Constitution. Abdullahi A. items.title: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo dul degay deegaanka Teedaan ee Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa sheegaya in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley ay saldhig cusub ka sameysteen deegaanka Bukure, oo u dhow deegaanka Teedaan ee Gobolka Hiiraan. Ciidamada ayaa isku diyaarinaya guluf ballaaran oo ay dib ugu qabsanayaan deegaanka Teedaan, kaas oo ay lumiyeen Axaddii, isla-markaana ay la wareegeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadu ay si xiriirsan ugu sugan yihiin deegaanada u dhaxeeya Magaalooyinka Maxaas iyo Matabaan, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin Bukure, Hees iyo Coomaad. Deegaanada ku yaala inta u dhaxeyso labada magaalo ayaa waxaa laga dareemaya inay xiisad ka jirto, waxaana uu hakad ku yimid isu socodkii dadka iyo ganacsiga ee waddada xiriirisa magaalooyinkaasi. Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada ay sugayaan gurmad iyo in xagga cirka laga garaaco Shabaabka ku sugan deegaankaasi Teedaan. Shabaabka ayaa la sheegay inay dhufeysyo ka sameysteen bannaanada Teedaan iyo in ay xitaa godad ka dhex qoteen gudaha deegaankaasi. Taliyaha Qaybta 27aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/dhexe Cali Axmed Xaashi (Cagey) oo ku sugan aagga Bukure ayaa Saraakiisha Ciidamada u sheegay in aan la ogolaan karin in Shabaabku ay ku sii sugnaadaan deegaankaasi. Teedaan ayaa ahayd taliskii laga hoggaaminayay hawlgalka ay ciidamadu 19-kii bishii July ka bilaabeen deegaanada hoostaga Degmada Maxaas. Deegaankan ayaa muhiim u ahaa isu socodka dadka iyo ganacsiga gobolka, wuxuuna isku xiraa Beledweyne, Matabaan iyo Maxaas.

items.title: Galkayo’s Dangerous Turning Point: A Federal Arms Convoy, a Gun Battle, and a Wounded Governor
items.description: Galkayo (WDN) – The Governor of Mudug Region under the Galmudug administration, Abdinasir “Mareexaan,” was wounded on Tuesday after heavy fighting erupted in Galkayo between forces aligned with Somalia’s Federal Government and a local clan militia, exposing growing security tensions in one of the country’s most strategically sensitive cities. According to local sources, the confrontation was triggered by a disputed shipment of weapons allegedly transported by the Federal Government into southern Galkayo. Reports indicate that the weapons, delivered aboard two vehicles after being unloaded at South Galkayo Airport, were intended for transfer to the northern part of the city, where Federal Government-backed forces originating from Puntland are stationed. Those forces reportedly continue to receive salaries from Mogadishu despite longstanding objections from the Puntland administration, which has repeatedly opposed their presence and legitimacy. Local sources say the arms shipment was intercepted by clan militia members after it allegedly entered their area of influence. The weapons were then taken to a militia base in southern Galkayo, dramatically escalating tensions. Federal Government forces subsequently launched an operation to recover the weapons, leading to an intense armed confrontation with the clan fighters. Witnesses described sustained exchanges of heavy gunfire that echoed across parts of Galkayo, sending residents scrambling for safety and raising fears that the violence could spread further across the divided city. During the fighting, Mudug Governor Abdinasir was reportedly wounded. Authorities have not released official information regarding the severity of his injuries or the medical facility where he is receiving treatment. Neither the Federal Government nor military commanders involved in the confrontation have issued an official statement detailing casualties or confirming the sequence of events. As a result, the number of people killed or injured remains unknown. The latest violence comes amid increasing political and security tensions in Galkayo, a city divided between Puntland and Galmudug that has historically been vulnerable to armed confrontations involving rival security forces, clan militias, and competing political interests. The incident also follows growing accusations from Puntland that the Federal Government is attempting to deploy weapons and establish loyal armed units inside Puntland territory without the consent of the regional administration—claims that Mogadishu has yet to publicly address. As of publication, neither the Galmudug administration nor Somalia’s Federal Government had issued a comprehensive statement explaining the fighting or outlining measures to prevent further escalation. Local elders and community leaders are expected to intensify mediation efforts in an attempt to restore calm and prevent the latest confrontation from developing into a broader regional security crisis. Local elders and community leaders are expected to intensify mediation efforts in an attempt to restore calm and prevent the latest confrontation from developing into a broader regional security crisis. items.title: Puntland Accuses Federal Government of Fueling Conflict, Alleges Fresh Arms Shipments into Mudug
items.description: Garowe (WDN) – Puntland has issued a strongly worded statement accusing Somalia’s Federal Government of deliberately escalating tensions by transporting weapons and military personnel into Puntland territory, warning that such actions threaten the fragile stability of the Mudug region. In a press release issued on 4 August 2026, the Puntland Presidency alleged that the Federal Government transported another shipment of weapons into Galkayo on Tuesday through the Galmudug-controlled side of the divided city, claiming the arms were ultimately intended for deployment inside Puntland. According to the statement, security agencies and local residents in Galmudug intercepted the shipment before it reached its intended destination. Puntland further alleged that the interception triggered an armed confrontation that resulted in casualties, although it did not specify the number of those killed or wounded. The Federal Government has not publicly responded to Puntland’s allegations, and the claims could not be independently verified. Puntland praised the Galmudug administration, its security forces, and local communities for what it described as preventing an attempt by the Federal Government to destabilize the Mudug region. The regional administration said the incident demonstrated the importance of continued security cooperation between Puntland and Galmudug, noting that the two neighboring administrations have maintained longstanding relations based on peaceful coexistence, shared communities, and mutual responsibility for preserving stability in the region. The statement went further by directly accusing former Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of attempting to ignite conflict in Mudug, particularly in Galkayo, a city shared by Puntland and Galmudug that has historically experienced periodic tensions but has largely remained stable in recent years. Puntland warned that any deterioration in security resulting from what it described as the Federal Government’s actions would rest solely with Mogadishu. The administration also appealed to the Somali public and the international community to closely monitor what it characterized as increasingly destabilizing activities by the Federal Government, arguing that introducing weapons into politically sensitive areas risks undermining regional peace at a time when Somalia is already grappling with heightened political uncertainty and persistent security threats. Concluding its statement, Puntland called on its citizens to remain vigilant against what it described as Federal Government interference in the region’s security affairs and urged the public to unite in safeguarding Puntland’s autonomy, security, and stability. The allegations come amid growing strains between Puntland and the Federal Government, further highlighting the deepening political and security divisions that continue to shape relations between Mogadishu and several of Somalia’s federal member states. items.title: The Stanley Cup puts professional ice hockey in a league of its own
items.description: True stories of a traveling trophy The Stanley Cup puts professional ice hockey in a league of its own By Susan Milligan   It has held champagne, breakfast cereal and even babies. It has been hoisted, hugged and almost kidnapped. It travels all over and has a team of chaperones to assure its safety. It’s the Stanley Cup, the trophy awarded to the National Hockey League championship team each year. This year, the Carolina Hurricanes, based in Raleigh, North Carolina, have won the coveted Cup, and the team is beginning a summer of passing the trophy from player to player. Unlike other national professional sports trophies, which are newly made and awarded to a new championship team to keep, there’s just one Stanley Cup. The champions in ice hockey only borrow the Stanley Cup for awhile, before it heads back to a vault in the Hockey Hall of Fame in Toronto. The players revere their brief turns to hold the Stanley Cup — the oldest trophy awarded to North American pro athletes. After the Cup was donated to Canada in 1892 by Sir Frederick Arthur Stanley, a British earl serving in Canada whose children loved ice hockey, the National Hockey League acquired it in 1910 to establish it as the award for League champions. Florida Panthers Matthew Tkachuk poses in front of the Gateway Arch in St. Louis, Missouri, during his time with the Stanley Cup in 2025. (Courtesy of the Florida Panthers) A sterling tradition Today, each winning player has his name stamped on one of the five rings that make up the barrel of the Cup. When there is no more room for players’ names, a ring is removed and sent to storage, and another one replaces it. No matter what mishaps or age-related stresses befall the silver-and-nickel trophy year after year, “they don’t create a new one,” says Hockey Hall of Fame official Kevin Shea, author of 21 books about hockey, including Travels with Stanley . “It’s got its dents and scratches. It’s a real living thing,” Shea says. If you watched the final playoff game in the championship, just after the final buzzer sounds, you would have seen Hurricanes players skating jubilantly around the rink, some carrying the massive and heavy — it’s 35 pounds (16 kilograms)! — Stanley Cup over their heads. Soon the real fun begins. A decadeslong tradition, which became official in 1995, dictates that each player and team staff member will get one day to have the Cup all to himself, celebrating in whatever way is special to him (without damaging the iconic trophy, of course). In earlier years, the winners have come up with some sterling ways to make the most of their day with the Cup. (State Dept./B. Insley) The ‘Keeper of the Cup’ From one tradition grew another. Today, there is a “Keeper of the Cup” who, along with some deputies, keeps an eye on the trophy through all of this. They move with the trophy during a roughly 100-day period when players and staff members each have their day with it. That all got started, according to the New York Rangers’ Neil Smith, when “one person took it, and the top came off. … And for some reason, somebody thought it would be wise to have an auto body guy weld it back on.” “It wasn’t me,” Smith quips. Keeper of the Cup Phil Pritchard (© Mark Blinch/Reuters) Since then, the keeper of the Cup — Phil Pritchard, vice president of the Hockey Hall of Fame — accompanies it wherever it goes. Pritchard and his helpers clean and polish the Stanley Cup at the end of each day before awarding it to the next player. Players get it from 6 a.m. to midnight, with veteran players getting first dibs on the schedule. It’s a special honor, notes Shea of the Hockey Hall of Fame, since ice hockey players, out of superstition, won’t touch the Cup unless and until they win the championship. How the Cup will enter the daily lives of 47 Hurricanes players and staff is yet to be seen. But it will connect them to champions from teams decades ago. That is what makes the tradition so inspiring, Smith says. “Ice hockey teaches you things you can’t get anywhere else. … Great values of sharing, of being in a group,” Smith says. And the Stanley Cup, every summer, joins the group. Susan Milligan is a freelance writer.

items.title: Puntland oo ka hadashay hubka ay DF maanta ka dajisay Gaalkacyo iyo dagaalkii dhacay
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Puntland ayaa waxaa looga hadlay hub ay maanta Dowladda Federaalka ka dajisay gudaha magaalada Gaalkacyo ee xarunta gobolka Mudug, kaas oo sababay dagaal ka dhacay koonfur magaaladaasi. Bayaanka ayaa lagu sheegay in hubka laga dajiyay dhinaca Galmudug, isla markaana ujeedka uu ahaa in loo gudbiyo dhanka Puntland, balse ay ka hortageen shacabka iyo ciidamada ammaanka ee maamulka Galmudug. “Dowladda Puntland waxay cambaaraynaysaa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee waqtigeedu dhammaaday, oo ciidan iyo hub ku soo daabulaysa deegaannada Dowladda Puntland. Maanta, 4 August 2026, ayey DFS hub kale kasoo dejisay magaalada Gaalkacyo, gaar ahaan dhinaca Gamuudug, si ay ugu soo gudbiso dhinaca Puntland balse ay ka hortageen hay’adaha amniga iyo shacabka Dowladda Galmudug, taas oo keentay iska hor imaad sababay khasaare,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Puntland ayaa bogaadisay Galmudug iyo shacabkii ka hortagay hubkaas oo ay sheegtay in la doonayo in amni darro looga abuuro gobolka Mudug. Waxaa kale oo ay ku eedeysay dowladda dhexe in ay weli ciidamo iyo hub ku daabaleyso gobolkaas, si loogu waxyeelleeyo nabadgelyada deegaannadeeda. Waxaa kale oo Puntland warsaxaafadeedka ku bogaadisay wada shaqeynta iyo darisnimada kala dhexeysa Galmudug oo ay wada maamulaan gobolka Mudug. “Puntland iyo Galmudug waxaa ka dhexeeya daris wanaag, wada noolaasho bulsho iyo wada shaqeyn maamul oo soo jireen ah, ilaalinta amniga iyo xasilloonida guud ahaan deegaannada labada maamul waa masuuliyad saaran labada dhinacba” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri bayaanka Madaxtooyada Puntland. Sidoo kale waxaa la sii raaciyay “Dowladda Puntland waxay Ummadda Soomaaliyeed iyo Beesha Caalamka la socodsiinaysaa in Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Shiikh Maxamuud, uu colaad ka hurinayo Gobolka Mudug, gaar ahaan magaalada Gaalkacyo oo ay si nabad ah kuwa deggan yihiin dadka iyo dowladaha walaalaha ah ee Puntland iyo Galmudug. Sidaasi darteed wixii amni darro ka dhasha falkaasi waxaa masuuliyaddeeda qaadaya Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday”. Ugu dambayn,Puntland waxay shacabkeeda ugu baaqday inay ka digtoonaadaan faragelinta amni ee ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka waddo deegaannadeeda, ayna meel uga soo wada jeestaan wax kasta oo dhaawici kara dowladnimada, amniga iyo xasilloonida Puntland. Warka kasoo baxay Puntland ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo caawa ay kacsan tahay xaaladda guud ee Gaalkacyo, kadib markii uu saacado kahor uu iska hor imaad ka dhacay gudaha magaalada, kaas oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada ammaanka iyo ragga hubeysan oo la sheegay inay la wareegeen qaar kamid ah hubkii maanta laga dajiyay koonfuta Gaalkacyo. Muddooyinkii dambe ayaa waxaa gobolka Mudug ka jiray dhaq-dhaqaaqyo iska soo horjeeday, kadib markii la sheegay in ciidamo ay ka qoratay dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo la doonayo inay ka howlgalaan Puntland. items.title: Somalia’s president, international partners hold fresh talks to break electoral deadlock
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud met international partners on Tuesday as diplomatic efforts gathered pace to ease growing political tensions over Somalia’s electoral process and encourage dialogue between the federal government and the opposition. The discussions followed a separate meeting a day earlier between international representatives and opposition leaders, where both sides explored ways to reduce the electoral standoff and build broader political consensus. Officials familiar with Tuesday’s talks said President Mohamud used the meeting to present the federal government’s electoral agenda, which is focused on introducing nationwide direct elections based on the principle of one person, one vote. The government argues that future members of parliament should be elected through universal suffrage, replacing Somalia’s existing indirect electoral model. Opposition figures, however, continue to press for wider political agreement on the proposed electoral framework, warning that unresolved differences could further intensify the country’s political crisis. The latest diplomatic engagement reflects increasing international efforts to bring Somalia’s political stakeholders closer to a shared position as the country works towards agreement on its electoral roadmap. items.title: DF iyo Shiinaha oo kala saxiixday heshiis ku kacaya…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta heshiis cusub la saxiixatay dowladda Shiinaha oo kamid ah dowladaha waa wayn ee taageera Soomaaliya, kaas oo ku kacay 15 milyan oo Yuan-ka Shiinaha ah, una dhiganta qiyaastii 2.1 milyan oo dollarka Mareykanka ah. Heshiiskan oo ku qotoma mashruuc gargaar ah oo ay Dowladda Shiinaha ku taageereyso Soomaaliya ayaa waxaa wada saxiixay Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Qaranka (SoDMA), Mudane Maxamuud Macalin Cabdulle iyo Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Shacabka Shiinaha u fadhiya Muqdisho Mudane Wang Yu. Mashruucan ayaa si gaar ah loogu talagalay in lagu caawiyo dadka nugul ee ay saameeyeen xaaladaha bani’aadannimo, iyadoo gargaarkan la gaarsiin doono deegaannada ugu baahida badan dalka, si loo xoojiyo dadaallada gurmadka iyo taageerada bulshada. Safiirka Shacabka Shiinaha u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Mudane Wang Yu, ayaa saxiixa kadib sheegay in dowladdiisa ay sii wadi doonto garab istaagga iyo taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada gargaarka bani’aadannimo iyo xoojinta iskaashiga labada dal. Dhankiisa Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda SoDMA, Mudane Maxamuud Macalin Cabdulle, ayaa uga mahadceliyay dowladda Shiinaha taageerada iyo garab istaagga joogtada ah ee ay la garab taagan tahay shacabka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dadaallada lagu caawinayo dadka nugul. Guddoomiyuhu waxa uu sidoo kale tilmaamay in SoDMA ay sii wadi doonto la shaqeynta saaxiibbada caalamiga ah si loo helo taageero waarta oo lagu xoojinayo u diyaargarowga iyo ka jawaabista musiibooyinka, loona hubiyo in gargaarku si hufan oo caddaalad ah u gaaro dadka ugu baahida badan. Si kastaba, Heshiiskan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dowladda Shiinaha ay ku xoojinayaan iskaashiga dhinacyada gargaarka bani’aadannimo, horumarinta bulshada iyo taageeridda shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee wajahaya xaaladaha adag. Waxaa sidoo kale la filayaa in mashruucani uu gacan ka geysto yareynta saameynta dhibaatooyinka bani’aadannimo iyo kor u qaadista rajada bulshada nugul ee ku nool deegaannada ugu baahida badan dalka. Safiirka Shacabka Shiinaha u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Mudane Wang Yu, ayaa saxiixa kadib sheegay in dowladdiisa ay sii wadi doonto garab istaagga iyo taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada gargaarka bani’aadannimo iyo xoojinta iskaashiga labada dal. Dhankiisa Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda SoDMA, Mudane Maxamuud Macalin Cabdulle, ayaa uga mahadceliyay dowladda Shiinaha taageerada iyo garab istaagga joogtada ah ee ay la garab taagan tahay shacabka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dadaallada lagu caawinayo dadka nugul. Guddoomiyuhu waxa uu sidoo kale tilmaamay in SoDMA ay sii wadi doonto la shaqeynta saaxiibbada caalamiga ah si loo helo taageero waarta oo lagu xoojinayo u diyaargarowga iyo ka jawaabista musiibooyinka, loona hubiyo in gargaarku si hufan oo caddaalad ah u gaaro dadka ugu baahida badan. Si kastaba, Heshiiskan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dowladda Shiinaha ay ku xoojinayaan iskaashiga dhinacyada gargaarka bani’aadannimo, horumarinta bulshada iyo taageeridda shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee wajahaya xaaladaha adag. Waxaa sidoo kale la filayaa in mashruucani uu gacan ka geysto yareynta saameynta dhibaatooyinka bani’aadannimo iyo kor u qaadista rajada bulshada nugul ee ku nool deegaannada ugu baahida badan dalka. items.title: Puntland oo walaac ka muujisay hub ay sheegtay in DFS ka dejisay Gaalkacyo, bogaadisayna tallaabadii Galmudug
items.description: Maamulka  Puntland ayaa si adag uga hadashay xaaladda amni ee ka taagan magaalada Gaalkacyo, kaddib markii ay sheegtay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ciidamo iyo hub ku soo dejisay magaalada Gaalkacyo, gaar ahaan dhinaca Galmudug, iyadoo Puntland ay ku eedeysay in tallaabadaasi ay khatar ku tahay amniga iyo xasilloonida deegaanka. Puntland ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadan iyo hubka la sheegay in laga soo dejiyay garoonka diyaaradaha Gaalkacyo ay ku soo dhowaanayaan dhinaca Puntland, iyadoo walaac laga muujiyay inay horseedi karaan iska horimaadyo iyo khalkhal amni. Puntland waxay ugu baaqday Dowladda Galmudug iyo ciidamadeeda inay ka hortagaan wax kasta oo sababi kara amni-darro, iyadoo ku adkaysatay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ciidamadeeda iyo hubkeeda ka saarto Gobolka Mudug, isla markaana la soo dhexmaro hub iyo ciidamo lagu wiiqayo nabadgelyada deegaanada Puntland. Puntland waxay sidoo kale xustay xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee ka dhexeeya Puntland iyo Galmudug, oo ay ku tilmaantay deris wanaagsan, wada noolaansho bulsho iyo wada shaqeyn soo jireen ah. Sidaas darteed, waxay sheegtay in mas’uuliyadda amniga iyo xasilloonida labada dhinac ay saaran tahay maamullada Puntland iyo Galmudug. Puntland ayaa ugu dambeyn ugu baaqday shacabka Puntland inay ka digtoonaadaan faragelin kasta oo ay sheegtay inay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka waddo deegaanadeeda, iyadoo sheegtay in tallaabooyinka noocaas ah ay dhaawici karaan dowladnimada, amniga iyo xasilloonida Puntland.

items.title: Somalia, Pakistan sign defence cooperation pact in Islamabad
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia and Pakistan have signed a memorandum of understanding to deepen cooperation in defence, security and military capacity building, Somalia’s Ministry of Defence said on Tuesday. The agreement was signed in Islamabad by Somalia’s Defence Minister, Ahmed Moallim Fiqi, and his Pakistani counterpart, Khawaja Muhammad Asif, according to a ministry statement. Under the memorandum, the two countries will cooperate on counterterrorism operations, military training programmes, and the exchange of military expertise, the statement said. It also provides a framework for broader defence capacity building between the two nations’ armed forces. The Somali ministry described the pact as a reflection of the two countries’ commitment to strengthening their strategic relationship, and said it lays the groundwork for closer collaboration between their respective militaries in the years ahead. The signing comes as Somalia continues to widen its network of defence partnerships with regional and international allies, part of a broader push to rebuild security institutions weakened by more than three decades of conflict. Somali forces remain engaged in a protracted fight against Al-Shabaab, the Al-Qaeda-linked insurgency that continues to hold territory in parts of the country and stage attacks on government and civilian targets.
