items.title: Al-Shabaab oo Fursado ka heshay Qalalaasaha Siyaasaddeed ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Iyadoo hoggaanka siyaasadda Soomaaliya uu weli ku mashquulsan yahay ismariwaaga daba dheeraaday ee dastuurka iyo doorashooyinka, Al-Shabaab ayaa mar kale muujinaysa awood walaac leh oo ay ku qaadi karto weerarro gobollo badan oo dalka ah. Taas oo dhalisay su’aalo ku aadan qalalaasaha siyaasaddeed in uu siinayo fursado halis ah. Sida ay sheegayaan wararka laga helayo gobolka Hiiraan, dagaal culus oo socday in ka badan 48 saacaddood oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Al-Shabaab ayaa ku dhammaaday iyadoo Al Shabaab la wareegtay gacan ku haynta deegaannada istaraatiijiga ah ee Teedaan, Suulaay, iyo Xasan Raqay, kadib markii ciidamada dowladda ay sameeyeen waxa saraakiishu ku tilmaameen dib-u-gurasho xeeladaysan. Dagaalladan ayaa ka mid ahaa kuwii ugu xoogganaa ee la soo sheegay bilihii u dambeeyay. Ilo deegaanka ah ayaa sheegay in boqolaal ka tirsan labada dhinac ay ku dhinteen ama ku dhaawacmeen, iyadoo la rumeysan yahay in Al-Shabaab ay la kulantay khasaare culus. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, tirada khasaaraha si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Ilo militari ayaa guul-darrada dowladda qayb ahaan ku sababeeyay khilaaf la sheegay inuu soo kala dhex galay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo ciidamada deegaanka ee Macawiisleyda, kuwaas oo iskaashigoodu uu laf-dhabar u ahaa guulihii hore ee dagaalka lagula jiray Al Shabaab bartamaha Soomaaliya. Iskaashiga iyo wadashaqeynta oo burburtay ayaa la sheegay inay wiiqday difaacyada dowladda xilli aad u xasaasi ah. Dhanka kale, Al-Shabaab ayaa la sheegay inay xoojisay weerarkeeda iyadoo kumannaan Maleeshiyo  dheeraad ah ka soo daadgureysay gobollo kale oo dalka ah, taas oo mar kale muujisay awoodda ay u leedahay inay si degdeg ah u dhaqaajiso ciidamadeeda isla markaana ay dagaallo ka waddo jihooyin badan isku mar. Koox Ka Dagaallamaysa Jihooyin Badan Falanqeeyayaasha amniga ayaa sheegaya in dhacdooyinkan ay muujinayaan isbeddel ballaaran oo sii adkaanaya in la iska indho tiro. Inkasta oo muddo badan ololey military, taageero caalami iyo dhawaaqyo isdaba joog ah oo dowladda ka soo baxay ay sheegeen in Al-Shabaab laga adkaanayo, haddana kooxda ayaa sii wadday inay muujiso xeeladdo hawlgal oo aad u sarreeya. Waxay si joogto ah u caddeysay inay awood u leedahay inay weerarro isku mar ah ka fuliso dhowr Dowlad-Gobolleedyo, iyadoo isla mar ahaantaana sii wadday cadaadiska ay ka waddo xadka u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Kenya. Awoodda ay u leedahay inay xoojiso dagaallada Hiiraan iyadoo weliba sii wada hawlgallada gobollo kale ayaa ka tarjumaysa heer abaabul, saadka iyo talis oo weli caqabad weyn ku ah ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya. Siyaasadda iyo Amniga oo Isku Milmay Weerarrada cusub ee Al-Shabaab ee furimaha dagaalka ayaa imanaya xilli Soomaaliya ay ku jirto mid ka mid ah qalalaasayaashii siyaasaddeed ee ugu qotada dheeraa sannadihii u dambeeyay. Dowladda Federaalka iyo mucaaradka ayaa weli isku haya arrimaha doorashooyinka, wax-ka badelka dastuurka iyo sharciyadda hay’addaha qaranka. Xiriirka u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo dhowr Dowlad-Gobolleed ayaa sidoo kale sii xumaaday, taasoo xaddidaysa jawaabta mideysan ee ay khubarada amnigu aaminsan yihiin inay lagama maarmaan u tahay jabinta Al-Shabaab. Dadka dhaliila dowladda ayaa ku dooddaya in iska horimaadka siyaasaddeed ee daba saameeyay qorshayaashii iyo dhaqaalihii loogu talagalay la dagaallanka argagixisada xilli Al-Shabaab ay dib isu abaabulayso isla markaana ka faa’iidaysanaysa duruufaha cusub. Qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha siyaasadda ayaa sidoo kale ku dooddaya in murannada la xiriira iibinta dhulka danta guud ee Muqdisho, oo ay sheegeen inay sababeen barakaca boqolaal kun oo qof, ay sii kordhiyeen culaysyada bulsho iyo dhaqaale. Waxay ka digayaan in barakaca baahsan, shaqo la’aanta iyo kalsoonida shacabka ee hay’adaha dowladda oo sii daciifaysa ay abuuri karaan xaaladdo ay kooxaha xagjirka ahi uga faa’iideystaan qorista xubno cusub, inkastoo baaxadda saameyntaasi ay weli adag tahay in si sax ah loo cabbiro. Walaac Istaraatiiji ah oo Sii Kordhaya Falanqeeyayaal badan oo la hadley WardheerNews ayaa sheegay in dagaanada Hiiraan ay ku badan yihiin luminta dhowr deegaan oo miyiga ah, oo Al Shabab dib u qabsatay. Waxay ka tarjumayaan walaac sii kordhaya oo ah in kala qaybsanaanta siyaasaddeed ee Soomaaliya ay bilaabayso inay burburiso guulihii militari ee si dhib badan loo gaaray sannadihii la soo dhaafay. Iyadoo hay’addaha dowladda ay weli ku mashquulsan yihiin khilaafaadka siyaasaddeed, Al-Shabaab waxay u muuqataa inay doonayso inay muujiso awood, dhaqdhaqaaq iyo inay ka faa’iidaysato fursad kasta oo ka dhalata kala qaybsanaanta ka dhex jirta cidda la dagaallamaysa. In guulaha ugu dambeeyay ee kooxda ay noqon doonaan kuwo ku meel gaar ah ama ay muujinayaan isbeddel weyn oo ka dhacay furimaha dagaalka weli waa arrin la sugayo. Waxa sii caddaanaya, si kastaba ha ahaatee, ayaa ah in dhibaatooyinka amniga iyo siyaasadda Soomaaliya aysan hadda ahayn laba caqabad oo kala go’an. Mid kastaa wuxuu sii xoojinayaa kan kale. Haddii aan dib loo soo celin is-afgarad siyaasaddeed oo qaran, isla markaana hawlgallada militari lagu lammaanin maamul iyo dowladnimo waarta, khubaradu waxay ka digayaan in Al-Shabaab ay sii wadi doonto ka faa’iidaysiga kala qaybsanaanta, dibna u soo ceshan doonto saameynteeda deegaannadii hore looga saaray. items.title: Soomaaliya oo heshiis difaac la gashay Pakistan + Sawirro
items.description: Islamabad (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta heshiis cusub oo dhanka iskaashiga difaaca ah lasoo gashay dowladda Pakistaan, kaas oo lagu tilmaamay is-fagarad taariikhi ah, sida lagu sheegay warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga Soomaaliya. Heshiiskan ayaa ah mid lagu xoojinayo wada shaqeynta dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, iyada oo sidoo kale lagu horumarinayo awoodda ciidamada. “Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Pakistan ayaa maanta kala saxiixday Is-afgarad Iskaashi oo u dhexeeya labada Wasaaradood ee Gaashaandhigga, kaas oo lagu xoojinayo wada-shaqeynta dhinacyada difaaca, amniga iyo horumarinta awoodaha ciidamada,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya. Heshiiska oo ka dhacay magaalada Islamabad ayaa waxaa Soomaaliya u saxiixay Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, oo booqasho rasmi ah ku jooga dalka Pakistan isaga oo hoggaaminaya wafdiga Dowladda Federraalka, halka Pakistaan uu saxiixay Wasiirka Difaaca, Mudane Khawaja Muhammad Asif. Sida ku cad warsaxaafadeedka is-afgaradkan ayaa dhigaya in labada dhinac ay iska kaashadaan la-dagaallanka argagixisada, tababarrada ciidamada, is-weydaarsiga khibradaha, aqoonta milatari, kobcinta awoodaha difaaca iyo xoojinta wada-shaqeynta amniga. Sidoo kale ujeedada ugu wayn ee heshiiska ayaa lagu sheegay in lagu xoojinayo taageerada dadaallada nabadda iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Indonesia oo Xoojinaya Iskaashiga Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ah
items.description: Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Cali Cumar, ayaa Muqdisho ku qaabilay Danjiraha Indonesia u fadhiya Kenya ahna Danjiraha aan degganayn ee Soomaaliya, Witjaksono Adji. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Indonesia, gaar ahaan iskaashiga dhinacyada badda iyo dhaqaalaha buluugga ah (Blue Economy). Danjire Adji ayaa mar kale xaqiijiyay taageerada Indonesia ee madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa dhankiisa soo bandhigay mudnaanta Soomaaliya ee la xiriirta horumarinta khayraadka badda iyo dhaqaalaha buluugga ah ee gobolka Badweynta Hindiya. Labada dhinac oo ka wada tirsan Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC) ayaa isku raacay in la sameeyo kooxo farsamo oo heer shaqo ah, kuwaas oo ka shaqeeya iskaashiga maamulka khayraadka badda, dhisidda awoodda hay’adaha iyo horumar waara. Kulankan ayaa muujinaya dadaallada lagu sii xoojinayo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Indonesia, iyadoo labada dal ay wadaagaan dano istiraatiiji ah oo ku saabsan badda, khayraadka dabiiciga ah iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha buluugga ah.

items.title: Qorshe lagu burburinayo guryaha xaasleyda BOOLISKA oo ka socda Xamar Jajab
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamo ka tirsan Booliska Soomaaliyeed iyo shaqaale farsamo ayaa saaka gaaray xaafadda Zerandi ee degmada Xamar Jajab, iyaga oo doonaya inay burburiyaan guryaha xaasleyda Ciidanka Booliska, sida ay xaqiijiyeen dadka deegaanka iyo ilo ku dhow taliska. Guryahan oo la dhisay 20-kii Diseembar 1980 ayaa hoy u ah ku dhawaad 72 qoys, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan agoon, dad naafo ah, qoysaska askar dhintay iyo saraakiil weli ka tirsan Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed. Xogta ay heshay Caasimada Online ayaa muujineysa in Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska, Jeneral Assad Diyaano, uu goobta geeyey cutub ciidan ah iyo shaqaale farsamo oo loo diyaariyey burburinta guryaha. Dadka deggan xaafadda ayaa sheegay inaan loo soo bandhigin amar maxkamadeed, digniin rasmi ah ama oggolaansho sharci oo fasaxaya in guryaha la dumiyo. Waxay sidoo kale sheegeen in madaxda ugu sarreysa dowladda aysan la socon qorshaha, isla markaana aan wax fasax ah laga helin hay’adaha garsoorka, Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha iyo madaxda qaranka. Eedeymo culus Qoysaska cabashada qaba ayaa qorshaha ku eedeeyey ganacsato, xildhibaanno iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska Assad Diyaano, kuwaas oo ay sheegeen inay iska kaashanayaan la wareegidda dhulka ay ku yaallaan guryaha. Waxay tallaabada ku tilmaameen boob hanti dadweyne, iyaga oo sheegay in shaqsiyaadka ku lugta leh ay isku dayayaan inay ballaariyaan ruqsad hore loogu bixiyey dhul ku yaalla Buula-Gaaljecel. Dadka deegaanka ayaa ku adkeysanaya in xaafadda Zerandi aysan ka mid ahayn dhulkii Buula-Gaaljecel, sidaas darteedna aan ruqsad ama oggolaansho halkaas laga bixiyey lagu fidin karin guryaha xaasleyda Booliska. Waxay ka cabsi qabaan in ciidamadu dib ugu soo laabtaan goobta, isla markaana burburinta guryaha la fuliyo saacadaha soo socda, haddii aysan madaxda dowladda si degdeg ah u faragelin. Sharciga Booliska Qoysaska ayaa daliishanaya Sharciga Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan Sharci Lr. 02 ee 4-tii Janaayo 1972. Sida uu dhigayo sharcigaas, guryaha xaasleyda Booliska waa hanti ma-guurto ah oo loogu talagalay inay ku intifaacaan xubnaha Ciidanka Booliska iyo qoysaskooda. Dadka deegaanka ayaa ku doodaya inaan hantidaas la iibin karin, la wareejin karin ama la burburin karin iyada oo aan la helin oggolaansho rasmi ah oo ka yimid madaxda qaranka, hay’adaha garsoorka iyo wasaaradda uu Boolisku hoos yimaado. Waxay sheegeen in guryaha aysan ahayn dhul bannaan oo ganacsato loo wareejin karo, balse ay yihiin hanti qaran oo muddo tobannaan sano ah hoy u ahayd saraakiil iyo qoysas xiriir la leh Ciidanka Booliska. Qaar ka mid ah dadka halkaas deggan ayaa sheegay in qoysaskoodu guryaha ku noolaayeen tan iyo markii la dhisay, isla markaana aysan haysan meel kale oo ay u guuraan haddii la burburiyo. Baaq loo diray madaxda Qoysaska deggan guryaha xaasleyda Booliska ayaa ugu baaqay madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, ra’iisul wasaaraha, Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha iyo hay’adaha garsoorka inay joojiyaan qorshaha burburinta. Waxay sidoo kale dalbadeen in baaritaan lagu sameeyo cidda bixisay amarka, sharciyadda ruqsadda la adeegsanayo iyo doorka ganacsatada, xildhibaannada iyo saraakiisha lagu eedeeyey qorshaha. “Maanta waxaa lagu abaal-dhacayaa saraakiil qarankooda u soo shaqeeyey,” ayay yiraahdeen qaar ka mid ah qoysaska cabashada qaba. Waxay ku adkeysteen in tallaabo kasta oo laga qaadayo guryaha lagu saleeyo sharciga, lana ilaaliyo xuquuqda agoonta, dadka naafada ah, qoysaska ciidamada iyo saraakiisha weli u adeegaya dalka. items.title: Somali Prime Minister Calls for Unconditional Release of Somaliland Prisoners as Laascaanood Seeks Reconciliation
items.description: Laascaanood (WDN) – Somalia’s Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre has called on the North Eastern State (NES) administration to unconditionally release prisoners captured during the conflict with Somaliland, describing the move as an important step toward reconciliation and lasting peace. Speaking during a public address in Laascaanood on Monday evening, Prime Minister Hamza urged the regional administration to take the initiative despite the painful legacy of the conflict. “No matter how difficult it may be, North Eastern State should release the prisoners first and set the example,” the Prime Minister said. His remarks represent one of the clearest calls yet from the Federal Government for confidence-building measures between the two sides following the bitter conflict that transformed Laascaanood into one of the most heavily contested cities in Somalia in recent years. The issue of prisoners remains among the most sensitive legacies of the war. International humanitarian practice generally treats captured combatants as prisoners of war whose release is commonly achieved through negotiated exchanges rather than ordinary criminal prosecution. While there is no single international law governing every prisoner exchange, such arrangements are typically guided by the Geneva Conventions, humanitarian principles, negotiated political agreements, and long-established military practice. For many residents of North Eastern State, however, the issue extends beyond legal principles. The memory of the intense shelling that struck Laascaanood during the conflict remains deeply embedded in public consciousness. Community elders and local leaders continue to recall the heavy bombardment that devastated residential neighborhoods, caused civilian casualties, and displaced thousands of families. Those painful memories have fueled strong public sentiment against releasing prisoners without accountability. Nevertheless, many observers who talked to WardheerNews argue that genuine reconciliation requires political leaders to rise above the bitterness and grievances of war. They contend that the first essential confidence-building measure is to reduce tensions and establish a conducive environment for meaningful dialogue between the two sides. Such a process would lay the groundwork for broader peace negotiations, including a mutually agreed prisoner exchange as an important step toward lasting reconciliation. Prime Minister Hamza’s appeal comes only days after the North Eastern State Parliament reportedly adopted a resolution calling for the prosecution of Somaliland prisoners currently being held in Laascaanood. His intervention therefore appears aimed at encouraging a different path—one centered on political compromise rather than judicial confrontation. The Prime Minister also directed a message toward Somaliland’s leadership, urging it to recognize North Eastern State as a political reality and to pursue dialogue instead of continued confrontation. He called for future negotiations to be facilitated by traditional elders and community peace committees, reflecting the longstanding Somali tradition of resolving complex disputes through customary mediation alongside formal political processes. Political analysts note that prisoner exchanges have frequently served as the first practical step toward reducing hostilities in conflicts around the world. They argue that humanitarian gestures often create the trust necessary for more comprehensive negotiations addressing security, governance, and long-term political disputes. Whether Hamza’s proposal will be accepted by either side remains uncertain. What is clear, however, is that the fate of the prisoners has evolved beyond a humanitarian issue. It has become a significant political test of whether North Eastern State and Somaliland are prepared to move from the battlefield toward dialogue after one of the most destructive conflicts witnessed in northern Somalia in recent years. items.title: International Mediators Enter Final Phase of Somalia Talks as Hope for Political Breakthrough Begins to Fade
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Ambassadors representing Somalia’s principal international partners met with leaders of the opposition-aligned Future Council on Monday inside the heavily fortified Halane compound, delivering what participants described as a candid assessment of the country’s deepening political crisis and the narrowing window for a negotiated settlement. According to sources familiar with the discussions, the meeting brought together representatives of the United Nations, the United States, the European Union, and the African Union, who shared their growing concern over Somalia’s prolonged political deadlock and the uncertainty surrounding the country’s transition. The Future Council delegation was represented in person by former President Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire, and MP Abdi Hassan Cosoble, while Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni, Jubaland President Ahmed Mohamed Islam (Ahmed Madobe), and MP Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame joined the discussions via video conference. Diplomatic sources said the international partners informed the opposition leaders that the mediation process has now entered what they described as its final phase, with negotiations moving beyond technical discussions to direct engagement among the principal political decision-makers. According to the sources, the mediators intend to convene a decisive face-to-face meeting between the opposing sides before 15 August, describing it as the final opportunity to secure a political agreement after months of internationally facilitated dialogue. The diplomats reportedly stressed that Puntland President Said Deni and Jubaland President Ahmed Madobe would be brought into the final negotiations, underscoring the view that no durable political settlement can be achieved without the participation of Somalia’s key federal member states. More significantly, the international representatives are said to have delivered a clear warning that if the rival parties fail to reach an agreement during the upcoming talks, the international community would consider taking what they described as its own measures, although no details were provided regarding the nature of those possible actions. The reported warning reflects what many observers see as growing frustration among international partners, who have spent months attempting to bridge differences between Somalia’s political actors with little tangible progress. What began as cautious optimism that dialogue could resolve disputes over elections, constitutional legitimacy, and governance has increasingly given way to concern that the mediation process may be approaching its final chance for success. With the reported August 15 deadline rapidly approaching, diplomatic expectations now appear to rest on a single decisive round of negotiations. Whether that meeting produces the long-sought political breakthrough—or marks the end of an international mediation effort that has so far failed to reconcile Somalia’s deeply divided political leadership—may determine the country’s political trajectory in the months ahead. items.title: Guddoomiyaha Mudug oo ku dhaawacmay iska horimaad ka dhacay Gaalkacyo
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Mudug ee Galmudug, Cabdinaasir Mareexaan, ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inuu ku dhaawacmay iska horimaad hubeysan oo ka dhacay magaalada Gaalkacyo, gaar ahaan dhinaca koonfureed ee magaalada. Dagaalka ayaa la xiriira xiisad ka dhalatay hub ay leedahay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo laga dejiyay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Gaalkacyo, iyadoo wararku sheegayaan in qayb ka mid ah hubkaasi ay la wareegeen maleeshiyo beeleed la sheegay inay kasoo jeedaan dhinaca Galmudug. Wararka laga helayo goobta ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in hubka la isku haysto uu sababay isku dhaca, iyadoo maleeshiyooyin hubeysan ay bililiqeysteen ama la baxeen qayb ka mid ah saanadda milatari ee garoonka laga dejiyay. Inta uu dagaalku socday waxaa sidoo kale dhaawacmay laba sarkaal oo ka tirsan Ciidamada Daraawiishta Galmudug, sida ay sheegayaan wararka hordhaca ah. Xaaladda magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa hadda kacsan, iyadoo ciidamada iyo maleeshiyooyinka hubeysan ay ku jiraan iska horimaad, waxaana socda dadaallo lagu doonayo in lagu dejiyo xiisadda. Ilaa hadda ma cadda tirada saxda ah ee hubka la qaatay iyo cidda si rasmi ah u maamuleysa saanadda la isku hayo.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan oo Kala Saxiixday Is-afgarad Lagu Xoojinayo Iskaashiga Difaaca
items.description: Islamabad, Pakistan — Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Dowladda Pakistan ayaa kala saxiixday is-afgarad cusub oo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga. Is-afgaradka ayaa maanta magaalada Islamabad ku kala saxiixay Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, oo booqasho rasmi ah ku jooga Pakistan, iyo Wasiirka Difaaca Pakistan, Khawaja Muhammad Asif. Heshiiskan ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa xoojinta wada-shaqeynta labada dal ee dhinacyada la-dagaallanka argagixisada, tababarrada ciidamada, is-weydaarsiga khibradaha iyo aqoonta milatari, iyo horumarinta awoodaha difaaca ee Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, is-afgaradku wuxuu dhabbaha u xaarayaa in Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan ay sii xoojiyaan iskaashiga amniga iyo difaaca, iyadoo la kobcinayo awoodaha ciidamada iyo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha difaaca ee labada dal. Saxiixa heshiiskan ayaa loo arkaa tallaabo lagu ballaarinayo xiriirka istaraatiijiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca, iyadoo labada dhinac ay muujinayaan rabitaan ku aaddan iskaashi waqti dheer ah.

items.title: Xog: Maleeshiyaad la wareegay hub laga dajiyay Gaalkacyo iyo dagaal culus oo qarxay
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya gobolka Mudug ayaa sheegaya in haatan ay kacsan tahay xaaladda magaalada Gaalkacyo, kadib markii la sheegay in lagu dhacay ‘hub ay leedahay dowladda Soomaaliya’ oo laga dajiyay koonfurta magaaladaasi. Ilo wareedyo lagu kalsoonaan karo ayaa innoo sheegay in hubkaas oo laga dajiyay koonfurta magaalada Gaalkacyo ay dhexda u galeen maleeshiyaad hubeysan, kadibna ay la wareegeen hubka qaarkiis oo gaadiid lagu raray. Sidoo kale, waxaa goobta ka qarxay dagaal u dhexeeyay ciidamada ammaanka iyo ragga hubeysan, kaas oo lagu dhaawacay laba qof, waxaana weli xaaladdu ay tahay mid adag. Dagaalka oo ay qaadeen ciidamada Galmudug ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inay ku doonayaan inay kusoo furtaan hubka u gacan galay maleeshiyaadka, waxaana weli socda howlgalka Hubkan oo ay dowladdu gaysay Gaalkacyo ayaa la rumaysan yahay in loo waday ciidamada taageersan Villa Soomaaliya ee ku sugan dhinaca Puntland. Ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay dowladda Soomaaliya, Galmudug iyo Puntland oo ku aadan xaaladda kasoo cusboonaatay Gaalkacyo iyo hubka la geeyay ee qaarkood u gacan galay maleeshiyaad kasoo jeeda isla deegaanka. Muddooyinkii dambe ayaa waxaa gobolka Mudug ka jiray dhaq-dhaqaaqyo iska soo horjeeday, kadib markii la sheegay in ciidamo ay ka qoratay dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo la doonayo inay ka howlgalaan Puntland. items.title: U.S. Congressional Delegation Reaffirms Support for Jubaland as Strategic Frontline Against Al-Shabaab
items.description: Kismayo (WDN) – The Jubaland State Presidency has released details of a high-level meeting held in Kismayo on 29 July 2026, where President Ahmed Mohamed Islam (Ahmed Madobe) hosted a senior delegation from the United States Congress and the U.S. Embassy in Somalia, underscoring Washington’s continued interest in one of Somalia’s most strategically significant regions. According to a statement issued by the Jubaland Presidency, the American delegation comprised 11 members of the U.S. Congress, led by Congressman Ronny Jackson, and included Justin Davis, the Chargé d’Affaires at the U.S. Embassy in Somalia, along with other senior U.S. officials. The talks focused on strengthening cooperation between Jubaland and the United States in the areas of counterterrorism, regional security, institution-building, and development assistance. The visit comes at a time when Jubaland remains one of the Horn of Africa’s most strategically important territories. Bordering both Kenya and Ethiopia, the federal member state serves as a critical security buffer against the expansion of Al-Shabaab toward two of East Africa’s most important regional powers. Much of Somalia’s southern frontier passes through Jubaland, making the region central not only to Somalia’s national security but also to the wider security architecture of the Horn of Africa. Any significant deterioration in security there would have immediate implications for cross-border stability, trade, refugee movements, and regional counterterrorism efforts. According to the Jubaland Presidency, U.S. officials commended the administration’s sustained commitment to combating Al-Shabaab, praising the recent successes achieved by the Jubaland Darawiish Forces and Danab Special Forces operating in Jubaland, working in coordination with the U.S. Africa Command (AFRICOM). Those joint operations, the statement said, have significantly weakened militant capabilities in parts of southern Somalia. For Washington, maintaining pressure on Al-Shabaab in Jubaland is viewed as strategically important. The region has long served as the principal barrier preventing the militant group from expanding its operational reach toward Kenya and Ethiopia, both key American security partners in East Africa. President Ahmed Madobe, for his part, expressed appreciation for the United States’ longstanding support for the Somali people, particularly in the areas of security cooperation, military training, and stabilization efforts in areas recovered from extremist groups. He emphasized that continued international cooperation remains essential to sustaining security gains and preventing Al-Shabaab from re-establishing safe havens in southern Somalia. The meeting was also attended by MP Ahmed Abdi Kooshin, Secretary of the Federal Parliament’s Defence Committee; MP Mursal Mohamed Khalif, Chairman of the Somalia–United States Parliamentary Friendship Committee; and MP Abdirashid Jire Qalinle, Jubaland’s representative in Somalia’s House of the People. The visit highlights Jubaland’s enduring strategic relevance at a time when security challenges continue to dominate regional politics. As the federal member state guarding Somalia’s southern gateway, Jubaland remains a pivotal frontline in the broader effort to contain Al-Shabaab and protect the stability of the Horn of Africa. items.title: Sawirro: Maxay yihiin ciidanka cusub ee tababarka loogu soo xiray Balli-doogle?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, oo uu wehliyo Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Darajada Koowaad ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, Gaashaanlle Sare Xasan Cali Nuur Shuute, ayaa maanta ciidamo cusub tababar ugu soo xiray xerada Balli-doogle ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, kuwaas oo kamid noqonayo Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Ciidamada cusub ee tababarka loo soo xiray ayaa ah askar si gaar ah uga tirsan Ciidamada Kumaandooska Danab (Danab Special Forces) oo uu tababaro Mareykanka, waxaana munaasabadda goobjoog ahaa taliyaha Xerada Balli-doogle ee Mareykanka, AOB Commander BMA, Major Robert Zimmerman, iyo saraakiil kale. Intii ay munaasabaddu socotay ayaa waxaa la soo bandhigay xirfadaha ay askartu barteen muddadii tababarka, iyadoo lagu muujiyay heerka ay gaareen dhanka tababarka gaarka ah, isu-duwidda howlgalada, iyo awoodda ay u leeyihiin fulinta waajibaadka qaran ee loo igmaday. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud oo ka hadlay munaasabadda ayaa u hambalyeeyay askarta tababarka dhammaysatay, maadaama ay muujiyeen dadaal iyo adkaysi. Waxaa kale oo uu ku boorriyay inay si daacadnimo leh ugu adeegaan dadka iyo dalka, ayna ka faa’iideystaan aqoonta iyo xirfadaha ay tababarka ku soo qaateen. Sidoo kale wuxuu taliyuhu sheegay in ciidamada Danab ay laf-dhabar u yihiin howlgalada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga dalka, isla markaana laga filayo inay muujiyaan anshax, geesinimo, iyo wadashaqeyn joogto ah. Wuxuu sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay ilaalinta xuquuqda shacabka iyo ku dhaqanka shuruucda ciidamada inta lagu jiro howlgalada. Tababarkan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu tayeynayo awoodda iyo xirfadaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan Ciidanka Danab oo ka qeyb qaata howlgallada ka dhanka ah Khawaarijta, sida uu sheegay Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Ugu dambeyn, munaasabadda oo ku soo idlaatay jawi deggan ayaa shahaadooyin lagu guddoonsiiyay qaar kamid ah askarta qalin-jebisay, dadaalladan ayaa qayb ka ah qorshaha qaran ee lagu dhisayo ciidan Soomaaliyeed oo xirfad iyo karti sare leh, isla markaana awood u leh difaaca qarannimada iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Uganda’s Deputy Defence Chief Arrives in Mogadishu for AUSSOM Military Talks
items.description: MOGADISHU — Uganda’s Deputy Chief of Defence Forces, General Sam Okiding, arrived in Mogadishu on Tuesday to attend a high-level meeting of defence chiefs from countries contributing troops to the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM). General Okiding was received upon arrival by senior officers of the Somali National Armed Forces. The meeting is expected to focus on strengthening regional security cooperation, intensifying military operations against Al-Shabaab, improving intelligence-sharing and enhancing support for the Somali National Army. The defence chiefs will review a joint operational plan developed by military experts to implement the resolutions adopted at the Extraordinary Summit of AUSSOM troop-contributing countries held in Kampala. The proposed plan outlines coordinated measures to accelerate counterterrorism operations, strengthen intelligence-sharing and improve the coordination of military personnel, equipment and other operational resources. The plan has been submitted to the participating defence chiefs for review and approval. Once endorsed, it is expected to guide the next phase of joint military operations aimed at weakening Al-Shabaab and advancing peace, security and long-term stability in Somalia and the wider region. items.title: TPLF oo Lagu Eedeeyay Inay Dib u Hurineyso Xiisadda Tigray
items.description: Xiisadda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee gobolka Tigray ee waqooyiga Itoobiya ayaa mar kale soo cusboonaatay, kaddib markii koox isku magacawday Ciidamada Nabadgelyada Tigray (Tigray Peace Force) ay eedeymo culus u jeediyeen hoggaanka Jabhadda TPLF. Kooxdan ayaa sheegtay in hoggaanka TPLF uu door ku leeyahay sii xumaanshaha xaaladda gobolka, isla markaana uu danaynayo ilaalinta awoodda iyo saamaynta siyaasadeed ee jabhadda. Waxay sidoo kale ka digtay in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee gudaha Tigray ay sababi karaan in gobolka uu mar kale u laabto dagaal sokeeye, iyadoo xusuusta dagaalkii hore iyo dhibaatooyinkii ka dhashay ay weli saameyn ku leeyihiin shacabka. Ciidamada Nabadgelyada Tigray ayaa ugu baaqay dowladda Itoobiya, beesha caalamka iyo dhinacyada kale ee gobolka inay qaadaan tallaabooyin looga hortagayo in xiisadda ay isu beddesho dagaal cusub. Kooxdan ayaa la sheegay inay soo baxday sannadkii 2025, kaddib markii saraakiil iyo siyaasiyiin hore uga tirsanaa TPLF ay ka go’een jabhadda, iyagoo khilaaf kala dhexeeyay hoggaanka iyo jihada siyaasadeed ee TPLF. Xiisadaha ka dhex jira dhinacyada siyaasadda Tigray ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli gobolka uu weli ku guda jiro dib-u-dhis iyo soo kabasho ka dhalatay dagaalkii Tigray, waxaana cabsi laga qabaa in khilaafyada cusub ay carqaladeeyaan dadaallada nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka.

items.title: Ciidamada AUSSOM oo Muqdisho ku diyaarinaya qorshe cusub oo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab
items.description: Muqdisho – Kulan ay Muqdisho ku yeesheen khubaro milatari oo ka kala socda dalalka ciidamada ku biiriyay Howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) ayaa looga hadlay diyaarinta qorshe hawlgal oo mideysan oo lagu dhaqangelinayo go’aamadii ka soo baxay shirkii aan caadiga ahayn ee dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya AUSSOM, kaas oo dhawaan lagu qabtay Kampala, Uganda. Qorshaha ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa dardargelinta howlgallada wadajirka ah ee ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, xoojinta xog-wadaagga iyo sirdoonka, iyo isku-dubaridka ciidamada, agabka iyo awoodaha hawlgal ee ciidamada ka qeybgalaya howlgalka. Kulanka waxaa guddoominayay Sarreeye Guuto Maxamed Cali Bariise, oo sheegay in qorshahan uu sare u qaadi doono iskaashiga u dhexeeya Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, AUSSOM iyo dalalka ciidamada ku biiriyay howlgalka. Khubarada milatariga ayaa qorshaha ay diyaariyeen u gudbiyay Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada Difaaca si ay dib-u-eegis iyo ansixin ugu sameeyaan. Haddii la ansixiyo, qorshahan ayaa noqonaya khariidadda hawlgal ee wejiga xiga ee dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in la wiiqo awoodda kooxda, lana xoojiyo amniga iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya iyo gobolka.

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo tababar u soo xiray ciidamo ka tirsan Danab
items.description: Muqdisho – Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa tababar ugu soo xiray Xerada Balli-doogle ee Gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose ciidamo ka tirsan Kumaandooska Danab ee sida gaarka ah u tababaran. Munaasabadda ayaa waxaa Taliyaha ku wehliyay Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Darajada Koowaad ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, G/Sare Xasan Cali Nuur Shuute, waxaana sidoo kale ka qeybgalay Taliyaha Xerada Balli-doogle ee Mareykanka, Major Robert Zimmerman, iyo saraakiil kale. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa askarta tababarka dhammaysatay u jeediyay dardaaran, isagoo ku booriyay inay ka faa’iideystaan xirfadaha ay barteen, isla markaana si masuuliyad leh ugu gutaan waajibaadka loo igmaday. Tababarkan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo tayada, aqoonta iyo awoodda hawlgelineed ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, gaar ahaan ciidamada Danab oo door muhiim ah ka qaata howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Munaasabadda ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ciidamada dowladda ay wadaan dadaallo lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidanka iyo diyaar-garowga hawlgallada amniga ee dalka.

items.title: Xasan oo shaaciyay in DF ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u daah-furay Shirweynaha 1-aad ee Badaha Soomaaliyeed, kaas oo diiradda lagu saarayo muhiimadda ay badaha Soomaaliya u leeyihiin kobaca dhaqaalaha, amniga, ilaalinta deegaanka iyo horumarinta kheyraadka buluugga ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa khudbaddii furitaanka ku sheegay in badaha Soomaaliyeed ay yihiin hanti qaran oo laf-dhabar u noqon karta horumarka dalka, haddii si hufan loo maareeyo loogana faa’iideysto. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in dowladda, dowlad-goboleedyada iyo dhammaan dhinacyada ay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan ilaalinta iyo maareynta khayraadka badda, si waafaqsan shuruucda dalka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso horumarinta dhaqaalaha buluugga ah, xoojinta amniga badda iyo la dagaallanka kalluumeysiga sharci darrada ah. Waxa uu sidoo kale tilmaamay in dowladda ay dhiirrigelinayso maalgashiga kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha ee la xiriira xeebaha iyo dekedaha dalka, si loo kordhiyo fursadaha dhaqaale iyo shaqo-abuurka. Shirweynaha 1-aad ee Badaha Soomaaliyeed ayaa waxaa ka qeyb-galay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada, ganacsato, aqoonyahanno, cilmi-baarayaal, wakiillo ka socda hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo daneeyayaal kale. Shirkan ayaa la filayaa in laga soo saaro talooyin iyo aragtiyo lagu horumarinayo ka faa’iideysiga khayraadka badda Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo la xoojinayo ilaalinta deegaanka, amniga badaha iyo kobaca dhaqaalaha dalka.     The post Xasan oo shaaciyay in DF ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland president orders free dialysis services, expansion of kidney care
items.description: Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdillahi Irro has ordered that kidney dialysis services be provided free of charge following complaints from patients over inadequate treatment and rising medical costs. According to a statement issued Monday by the Somaliland Presidency, Irro also instructed the Ministry of Health to immediately procure 15 new dialysis machines to expand treatment capacity and reduce pressure on existing equipment at Hargeisa General Hospital. The president also ordered that all services required by kidney patients, including dialysis treatment and related medical care, be provided free of charge. The directives followed the president’s recent visit to Hargeisa General Hospital, where he met hospital administrators, health workers and dialysis patients to hear firsthand accounts of the challenges facing the facility. As part of the government’s response, Irro appointed a technical committee to conduct a comprehensive assessment of Hargeisa General Hospital and regional hospitals providing kidney care. The committee has been tasked with reviewing hospital management, health services, medical equipment, infrastructure and patient care before submitting recommendations on both immediate interventions and long-term reforms. The presidency said the measures form part of the government’s broader effort to improve healthcare services and strengthen public health infrastructure. The announcement comes days after dozens of kidney disease patients staged a protest in Hargeisa, saying they faced high costs for medicines and dialysis supplies, shortages of functioning dialysis machines, overcrowding and long delays in receiving treatment. Patients warned that the lack of adequate services had disrupted their regular dialysis schedules, placing many lives at risk.

items.title: Xisbiga Shaakir oo diiday natiijada doorashooyinka Galmudug, dalbadayna in…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xisbiga Towfiiq ayaa si adag u diiday natiijada doorashooyinka goleyaasha deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada ee Galmudug ee uu ku dhawaaqay Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka. Xisbiga Sheekh Maxamed Shaakir ayaa ku eedeeyay guddiga doorashooyinka in uu ku tuntay rabitaanka codbixiyeyaasha isla markaana uu dhaawacay hannaanka doorashada qof iyo cod. War-saxaafadeed uu soo saaray xisbiga ayaa lagu sheegay in natiijada la shaaciyay ay shacabka Galmudug ka qaaday xuquuqdoodii dastuuriga ahayd, isla markaana ay wiiqday kalsoonidii lagu qabay geeddi-socodka doorashada. Xisbigu wuxuu ku dooday in habka codbixinta iyo tirinta codadka ay hareeyeen musuq iyo eex, kuwaas oo si weyn u saameeyay natiijada kama dambaysta ah. Towfiiq ayaa sheegay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay filayeen doorasho xor iyo xalaal ah oo ka tarjumaysa rabitaankooda, balse natiijada lagu dhawaaqay aysan waafaqsanayn xogta ay goobaha codbixinta ka ururiyeen wakiilladiisa. Sidoo kale wuxuu ka digay in aqbalidda natiijadan ay dhaawici karto kalsoonida lagu qabo hannaanka dimuqraadiyadda iyo doorashooyinka mustaqbalka. Xisbigu wuxuu ugu baaqay guddiga doorashooyinka iyo dhammaan dhinacyada ay arrintu khusayso in dib loogu noqdo natiijada lagu dhawaaqay, isla markaana dib-u-eegis madax-bannaan lagu sameeyo codadka laga kala helay tobanka degmo ee doorashadu ka dhacday, si loo xaqiijiyo in rabitaanka shacabka si sax ah loo muujiyo. Sida uu sheegay Towfiiq, doorashada Golaha Wakiillada ee Galmudug waxaa codkooda dhiibtay 58,519 qof, halka codadka halaabay ay gaarayeen 987 oo u dhiganta ku dhowaad boqolkiiba hal. Xisbigu wuxuu ku andacooday inuu helay 53,054 cod, oo u dhiganta 53.85% codadkii la dhiibtay, taasoo uu sheegay inay siinaysay 47 ka mid ah 89-ka kursi ee Golaha Wakiillada. Dhanka goleyaasha deegaanka, Towfiiq wuxuu sheegay inuu helay 54,064 cod, oo u dhiganta 54.87% codadkii la dhiibtay, isagoo ku dooday in natiijadaasi xaq u siinaysay 104 ka mid ah 243-da kursi ee goleyaasha deegaanka ee Galmudug. Dhanka kale, guddiga doorashooyinka ayaa shalay ku dhawaaqay natiijada rasmiga ah ee doorashada, iyagoo sheegay in Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka uu noqday ururka ugu codadka badan, kadib markii uu helay 135,247 cod iyo 63 kursi. Sidoo kale, guddigu wuxuu shaaciyay in ururka Towfiiq uu galay kaalinta labaad, isagoo helay 26,003 cod iyo 12 kursi. Natiijadan ayaa sii xoojisay muranka siyaasadeed ee ka dhashay doorashada, iyadoo weli la sugayo sida ay guddiga iyo dhinacyada kale uga falcelin doonaan cabashada uu gudbiyay Xisbiga Towfiiq. Doorashooyinka Galmudug ayaa ka mid ahaa doorashooyinka qof iyo cod ee lagu dooranayay Golaha Wakiillada iyo goleyaasha deegaanka ee maamulkaas. Inkastoo guddigu ku adkaystay natiijada uu shaaciyay, haddana diidmada Towfiiq ayaa muujinaysa in muranka doorashada uu weli taagan yahay, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo tallaabooyinka xiga ee ay qaadaan dhinacyada ay khusayso. Xisbiga Sheekh Maxamed Shaakir ayaa ku eedeeyay guddiga doorashooyinka in uu ku tuntay rabitaanka codbixiyeyaasha isla markaana uu dhaawacay hannaanka doorashada qof iyo cod. War-saxaafadeed uu soo saaray xisbiga ayaa lagu sheegay in natiijada la shaaciyay ay shacabka Galmudug ka qaaday xuquuqdoodii dastuuriga ahayd, isla markaana ay wiiqday kalsoonidii lagu qabay geeddi-socodka doorashada. Xisbigu wuxuu ku dooday in habka codbixinta iyo tirinta codadka ay hareeyeen musuq iyo eex, kuwaas oo si weyn u saameeyay natiijada kama dambaysta ah. Towfiiq ayaa sheegay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay filayeen doorasho xor iyo xalaal ah oo ka tarjumaysa rabitaankooda, balse natiijada lagu dhawaaqay aysan waafaqsanayn xogta ay goobaha codbixinta ka ururiyeen wakiilladiisa. Sidoo kale wuxuu ka digay in aqbalidda natiijadan ay dhaawici karto kalsoonida lagu qabo hannaanka dimuqraadiyadda iyo doorashooyinka mustaqbalka. Xisbigu wuxuu ugu baaqay guddiga doorashooyinka iyo dhammaan dhinacyada ay arrintu khusayso in dib loogu noqdo natiijada lagu dhawaaqay, isla markaana dib-u-eegis madax-bannaan lagu sameeyo codadka laga kala helay tobanka degmo ee doorashadu ka dhacday, si loo xaqiijiyo in rabitaanka shacabka si sax ah loo muujiyo. Sida uu sheegay Towfiiq, doorashada Golaha Wakiillada ee Galmudug waxaa codkooda dhiibtay 58,519 qof, halka codadka halaabay ay gaarayeen 987 oo u dhiganta ku dhowaad boqolkiiba hal. Xisbigu wuxuu ku andacooday inuu helay 53,054 cod, oo u dhiganta 53.85% codadkii la dhiibtay, taasoo uu sheegay inay siinaysay 47 ka mid ah 89-ka kursi ee Golaha Wakiillada. Dhanka goleyaasha deegaanka, Towfiiq wuxuu sheegay inuu helay 54,064 cod, oo u dhiganta 54.87% codadkii la dhiibtay, isagoo ku dooday in natiijadaasi xaq u siinaysay 104 ka mid ah 243-da kursi ee goleyaasha deegaanka ee Galmudug. Dhanka kale, guddiga doorashooyinka ayaa shalay ku dhawaaqay natiijada rasmiga ah ee doorashada, iyagoo sheegay in Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka uu noqday ururka ugu codadka badan, kadib markii uu helay 135,247 cod iyo 63 kursi. Sidoo kale, guddigu wuxuu shaaciyay in ururka Towfiiq uu galay kaalinta labaad, isagoo helay 26,003 cod iyo 12 kursi. Natiijadan ayaa sii xoojisay muranka siyaasadeed ee ka dhashay doorashada, iyadoo weli la sugayo sida ay guddiga iyo dhinacyada kale uga falcelin doonaan cabashada uu gudbiyay Xisbiga Towfiiq. Doorashooyinka Galmudug ayaa ka mid ahaa doorashooyinka qof iyo cod ee lagu dooranayay Golaha Wakiillada iyo goleyaasha deegaanka ee maamulkaas. Inkastoo guddigu ku adkaystay natiijada uu shaaciyay, haddana diidmada Towfiiq ayaa muujinaysa in muranka doorashada uu weli taagan yahay, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo tallaabooyinka xiga ee ay qaadaan dhinacyada ay khusayso. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo furay shirweynaha 1-aad Badaha Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u daah-furay Shirweynaha 1-aad ee Badaha Soomaaliyeed, kaasi oo lagu lafagurayo muhiimadda ay badaha Soomaaliya u leeyihiin koboca dhaqaalaha, amniga, ilaalinta deegaanka iyo horumarinta kheyraadka buluugga ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa khudbaddiisa furitaanka ku adkeeyay in badaha Soomaaliyeed ay yihiin hanti qaran oo laf-dhabar u noqon karta horumarka dalka, isaga oo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in si wadajir ah looga shaqeeyo ilaalinta, maareynta iyo ka faa’iidaysiga kheyraadka badda si waafaqsan shuruucda dalka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa tilmaamay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso horumarinta dhaqaalaha buluugga ah, xoojinta amniga badda, la dagaallanka kalluumeysiga sharci darrada ah iyo dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha ee la xiriira xeebaha iyo dekedaha dalka. Shirweynaha 1-aad ee Badaha Soomaaliyeed ayaa waxaa ka soo qayb galay masuuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Dowlad-Goboleedyada, ganacsato, aqoonyahanno, cilmi-baarayaal, wakiillo ka socda hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo daneeyeyaal kale. The post Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo furay shirweynaha 1-aad Badaha Soomaaliyeed appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Madaxweynaha JFS oo furay Shirweynaha koobaad ee badaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u furay Shirweynihii Koowaad ee Badaha Soomaaliyeed , kaas oo la qorsheeyay inuu noqdo shir sanadle ah oo lagu gorfeeyo horumarinta iyo ka faa’iidaysiga khayraadka badda Soomaaliya. Shirkan ayaa diiradda lagu saaray arrimo muhiim u ah mustaqbalka dhaqaalaha buluugga ah ee dalka, sida ilaalinta iyo bedqabka badda, horumarinta gaadiidka iyo isu-socodka badda, kobcinta kalluumeysiga, iyo sidii si waara looga faa’iideysan lahaa khayraadka hodanka ah ee ku jira xeebaha Soomaaliya. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa khudbaddiisii furitaanka ku adkeeyay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay xaq u leeyihiin inay si buuxda uga faa’iideystaan khayraadka dabiiciga ah ee dalkooda, gaar ahaan badda oo uu ku tilmaamay tiir muhiim u ah horumarka dhaqaalaha iyo abuurista fursado shaqo. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dowladdu mudnaan gaar ah siin doonto horumarinta arrimaha badda, isla markaana la xoojin doono qorshayaasha lagu ilaalinayo khayraadka badda iyo kobcinta wax-soo-saarka kalluumeysiga. Dhankiisa, Safiirka Dowladda Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in Turkigu sii xoojin doono taageerada uu siiyo Soomaaliya ee la xiriirta horumarinta kalluumeysiga. Wuxuu xusay in dowladda Turkiga ay dhawaan dalka keeni doonto doomo iyo qalab casri ah oo loogu talagalay in lagu horumariyo kalluumeysiga, lana kordhiyo wax-soo-saarka iyo awoodda kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed. Shirweynaha Koowaad ee Badaha Soomaaliyeed ayaa ah tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu dejinayo istaraatiijiyad qaran oo lagu horumarinayo dhaqaalaha buluugga ah, iyadoo la xoojinayo iskaashiga dowladda, hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo saaxiibbada Soomaaliya si looga faa’iideysto khayraadka badda si waara, loona abuuro horumar dhaqaale oo shacabka Soomaaliyeed u horseeda nolol wanaagsan.

items.title: Muxuu yahay dalabka R/W Xamza uu Laascaanood uga soo diray Somaliland?
items.description: Laascaanood (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa bogaadiyay horumarka uu sheegay in maamulka Waqooyi Bari uu ka sameeyay dhinacyada amniga, dib-u-dhiska iyo siyaasadda muddadii sanadka ahayd ee uu jiray maamulkaasi. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ugu baaqay shacabka iyo madaxda Waqooyi Bari inay sii ilaaliyaan nabadda, wadajirka iyo xasilloonida siyaasadeed ee ka jirta deegaannada maamulka. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay garab taagan tahay maamulka, isla markaana ay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso. Dhanka kale, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa farriin u diray siyaasiyiinta Somaliland, isagoo ugu baaqay inay dib ugu soo laabtaan miiska wada-hadalka si xal nabadeed looga gaaro tabashooyinka iyo khilaafaadka jira. Wuxuu sheegay in wada-hadalku yahay waddada ugu habboon ee lagu gaari karo xal waara. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa xusay in loo baahan yahay in horay loo socdo, lana iska cafiyo wixii dhacay, halkii dib loogu noqon lahaa dhacdooyinkii hore. Sida uu sheegay, dib u milicsiga khilaafaadkii hore keliya ma horseedi karo xal rasmi ah oo lagu soo afjaro murannada taagan. Isagoo ka hadlayay siyaasadda dibadda ee Somaliland, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa sheegay inay tahay arrin laga xumaado in xukuumadda Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ay, sida uu hadalka u dhigay, xiriir la yeelato Israa’iil. Wuxuu ku baaqay in dib looga laabto tallaabooyinkaasi. “Geeddii Somaliland ay rartay meel qaldan ayay ku furtay. Dhammaan dadka Soomaaliyeed, ummadaha Islaamka iyo shucuubta rumaysan bani’aadannimada ayaa arrintaas kasoo horjeeda. Khaladkaas waxaa kasii daran in lagu sii adkaysto oo aan dib looga soo laaban,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ugu dambeyn sheegay inuusan jirin kala qaybsanaan u dhexeysa shacabka Soomaaliyeed meel kasta oo ay joogaan, balse waxa uu ku dooday in khilaafaadka jira ay salka ku hayaan aragtiyo siyaasadeed oo ay wataan qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta Somaliland. Wuxuu ku baaqay in la xoojiyo midnimada, wada-hadalka iyo is-afgaradka si loo xaqiijiyo xasilloonida iyo horumarka dalka. The post Muxuu yahay dalabka R/W Xamza uu Laascaanood uga soo diray Somaliland? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Cabinet Officials Brace to Relinquish Kenyan Passports After Presidential Ultimatum
items.description: A mounting cohort of senior Somali government ministers is poised to surrender their Kenyan passports and national identity documents within days, heeding President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s ultimatum that dual citizens holding public office must forswear their foreign nationality or immediately vacate their posts, according to multiple informed sources. The impending wave of surrenders represents the most aggressive enforcement of citizenship integrity standards within the executive branch in recent memory, building on Deputy Prime Minister Jibril Abdirashid Haji’s unilateral decision to return his Kenyan travel documents,a move that effectively set a binding precedent for his cabinet colleagues. Deputy Prime Minister Jibril Abdirashid Haji became the first senior figure to bow to the directive when he formally handed over his Kenyan passport to the Kenyan Embassy in Mogadishu earlier this week. In a terse statement, Jibril asserted the move was designed to guarantee “complete transparency” in the execution of his official duties and to preempt any challenge to his national allegiance. Sources who spoke to Dalsan on condition of anonymity, citing lack of authorisation to engage publicly on the matter, disclosed that several ministers and state ministers are now finalising arrangements to submit their Kenyan travel credentials and identification cards to the diplomatic mission. The sources indicated that the officials are acting with haste to avoid being perceived as defying the President’s edict, which was first articulated during a closed-door cabinet sitting last Thursday. “The President made it unequivocally clear that retaining a foreign passport while occupying a senior government portfolio is untenable,” one source told Dalsan. “Those who intend to retain their cabinet seats are moving swiftly to comply, and a series of handovers is widely anticipated before the week concludes.” The directive has cast a harsh glare on the prevalence of dual citizenship among Somalia’s political elite—a sensitive issue long left unaddressed but now thrust into the open. Although Somalia’s provisional constitution does not explicitly outlaw dual nationality for public officials, the President’s order effectively imposes a new litmus test for the upper echelons of power, compelling officials to choose definitively between their Somali responsibilities and foreign entitlements. The enforcement drive comes against the backdrop of heightened scrutiny of senior officials’ travel documentation, with some figures having recently encountered obstacles at Kenyan ports of entry. State Minister at the Presidency Abdirashid was among those reportedly turned away by Kenyan immigration authorities, although it remains unclear whether that incident directly precipitated the presidential directive. Villa Somalia has yet to issue a formal communiqué on the enforcement timeline, and the Kenyan government has likewise refrained from commenting on the expected influx of surrendered documents. However, insiders suggest the list of compliant officials will expand as the President’s unannounced deadline looms, with further developments expected imminently. The post Cabinet Officials Brace to Relinquish Kenyan Passports After Presidential Ultimatum first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Soomaaliya waa inay dib uga fiirsataa ka mid ahaanshaha ururka IGAD + Sababata
items.description: Soomaaliya waxay xubin aas-aase ka tahay Urur-goboleedka IGAD . IGAD waxaa loo aas-aasay horumarinta iskaashiga gobolka iyo is-dhexgalka dhaqaale. IGAD looma aas-aasin inuu noqdo urur nabad-ilaalin ama amni-wadareed. Mas’uuliyadda nabadda iyo amniga qaaradda waxaa iska leh Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka Midowga Afrika , kaas oo lagu dhisay Hab-maamuuska Nabadda iyo Ammaanka ee Midowga Afrika. Sidaas darteed, isku-day kasta oo lagu ballaarinayo shaqooyinka IGAD si uu u galo arrimo ka baxsan ujeeddooyinkii loo aas-aasay wuxuu noqon karaa mid natiijo lid ku ah keena. Ururrada gobolladu waxay waxtar badan yeeshaan marka ay ku shaqeeyaan xadka mas’uuliyadaha loo igmaday, isla markaana ay u hoggaansamaan qaab-dhismeedka hay’adaha nabadda iyo ammaanka ee ka jira Midowga Afrika. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya waa inay sameysaa qiimeyn qoto dheer oo ku saabsan IGAD. Qiimeyntaas waa inaysan ku salaysnaan shucuur ama siyaasad, balse ay ku salaysnaato xaqiiqooyin, waxqabad iyo natiijooyin. In ka badan 30-kii sano ee lasoo dhaafay, Soomaaliya waxay wajahaysay colaado, argagixiso, xasillooni-darro siyaasadeed iyo dhibaatooyin bani’aadannimo. Muddadaas, IGAD waxay qaadatay doorar kala duwan. Qaar waxay ahaayeen kuwo wanaagsan. Qaar kalena waxay ahaayeen kuwo muran dhaliyay. Soomaali badan ayaa aaminsan in ururku inta badan ku adkaatay inuu dhexdhexaad ka ahaado arrimaha sida tooska ah u saameynaya madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya iyo mustaqbalkeeda siyaasadeed. Urur goboleed waa inuu dalalka xubnaha ka ah ka caawiyaa inay xoog yeeshaan. Waa inuusan abuurin ku-tiirsanaan. Waa inuusan noqon meel ay dano dibadeed ku qaabeeyaan mustaqbalka dal xubin ka ah. Soomaaliya waxay mudan tahay hay’ado ixtiraama madaxbannaanideeda, taageerana go’aannada ay Soomaalidu gaaraan. Soomaali badan ayaa sidoo kale isweydiinaya in IGAD ay la jaanqaadday isbeddellada waqtiga. Soomaaliya maanta ma aha Soomaaliya labaatan sano ka hor jirtay. Dalku wuxuu dib u dhisay hay’adihii qaranka. Ciidamada ammaanku waxay ballaariyeen kaalintooda. Dhaqaaluhu si tartiib ah ayuu u kobcayaa, inkastoo ay jiraan caqabado badan. Dowladdu waxay raadineysaa iskaashi caalami ah oo xooggan, kuna dhisan is-ixtiraam halkii uu ku salaysnaan lahaa ku-tiirsanaan. Isbeddelladani waxay u baahan yihiin xiriir ka duwan kii hore oo lala yeesho ururrada gobollada. Soomaaliya waa inay sidoo kale isweydiisaa in IGAD ay si siman ula dhaqantay dhammaan dalalka xubnaha ka ah. Hay’adaha gobolladu waxay kasbadaan kalsooni marka ay halbeegyo isku mid ah ku dabaqaan dal kasta. Marka ay dhalato aragti ah in la adeegsanayo halbeegyo kala duwan, kalsoonidu waxay billowdaa inay lunto. Kalsooni ma sii jiri karto haddii dalalka xubnaha ka ahi rumeysan yihiin in dowladaha qaar loola dhaqmo si ka duwan kuwa kale. Arrin kale oo walaac leh waa isla-xisaabtan la’aanta. Urur kasta waa in lagu qiimeeyaa waxqabadkiisa. IGAD ma gaarsiisay gobolka nabad waarta? Ma yareysay colaadaha? Ma xoojisay ganacsiga gobolka ? Ma noqotay mid hufan oo lagula xisaabtami karo muwaadiniinta dalalka xubnaha ka ah? Kuwani waa su’aalo xaq ah oo mudan jawaabo daacad ah. Hoggaanka ururrada gobolladu waa in uusan marnaba noqon il joogto ah oo dano shaqsiyeed laga helo. Adeegga dadweynuhu waa mas’uuliyad, mana aha xirfad lagu dhiso ilaalinta xilalka. Hay’aduhu way daciifaan marka hoggaamiyayaashu xoogga saaraan ilaalinta xafiisyadooda halkii ay ka horumarin lahaayeen ururka. Guusha urur goboleed kasta waxay ku xiran tahay xirfad, hufnaan iyo u heellanaanta danaha dhammaan dalalka xubnaha ka ah. Soomaaliya waxay qiimo culus ku bixisay xasillooni-darrada. Ma awooddo hay’ado gaabiya horumarkeeda ama sii murjiya mudnaanta qarankeeda. Iskaashi kasta oo caalami ah waa in lagu cabbiraa hal su’aal oo fudud: Ma Soomaaliya ayuu sii xoojinayaa? Dib-u-eegista xubinnimada ama ka-qaybgalka IGAD macnaheedu ma aha in laga tagayo iskaashiga gobolka. Soomaaliya waxay deriskeeda la wadaagtaa xuduudo, marinno ganacsi, caqabado amni iyo walaacyo deegaan. Iskaashigu weli waa lama huraan. Argagixisada, tahriibka, abaarta iyo dambiyada xuduudaha ka gudba hal dal kaligiis wax kama qaban karo. Hase yeeshee, iskaashigu waa in uusan marnaba ku iman kharashka madax-bannaanida qaranka. Soomaaliya waa inay urur kasta oo goboleed ula macaamishaa si kalsooni leh, ee aysan ula macaamilin ku-tiirsanaan. Waa inay taageertaa iskaashiyada keena natiijooyin la cabbiri karo, isla markaana ay su’aal gelisaa kuwa aan ka soo bixin wixii laga filayay. Dib-u-eegis rasmi ah oo ay dowladdu sameyso waxay siyaasiyiinta u oggolaan lahayd inay si taxaddar leh u qiimeeyaan waxqabadka IGAD. Dib-u-eegistu waa inay qiimeysaa danaha siyaasadeed, dhaqaale iyo amni ee Soomaaliya. Waa inay caddeysaa meelaha ay IGAD wax ku kordhisay iyo meelaha dib-u-habeyn looga baahan yahay. Natiijooyinka waa in lala wadaagaa Baarlamaanka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Haddii dib-u-habeyn loo baahan yahay, Soomaaliya waa inay u dooddaa. Haddii ururku si wanaagsan ugu adeegi karo xubnihiisa iyadoo la xoojinayo maamul-wanaagga, hufnaanta iyo go’aan-qaadashada dheellitiran, isbeddelladaas waa in la dhiirrigeliyaa. Dhaliil wax-dhisaysa inta badan waa tallaabada koowaad ee lagu gaaro horumarinta hay’adaha. Soomaaliya waxay gashay bog cusub oo taariikhdeeda ah. Waxay dib u hanatay aqoonsi caalami ah oo dhinacyo badan ah, waxayna sii waddaa xoojinta hay’adaha dowladda. Siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee dalku waa inay ka tarjumtaa horumarkaas. Iskaashi kasta oo goboleed iyo mid caalami ah waa inuu horumariyaa danaha fog ee Soomaaliya, ilaaliyaa madax-bannaanideeda, kana qaybqaataa nabadda iyo horumarka. Hay’adna waa in aysan ka sarreyn dib-u-eegis. Xubinnimada ururrada gobollada waa inaan marnaba loo arag mid joogto ah ama si toos ah u soconaysa. Waa in lagu kasbadaa waxqabad iyo is-ixtiraam. Soomaaliya waxay gacan ka geysatay aas-aaska IGAD. Taariikhdaas waxay mudan tahay ixtiraam. Laakiin taariikh keliya kuma filna. Xiriirku waa inuu sii socdaa oo keliya haddii uu u adeegayo danaha shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isla markaana uu taageerayo mustaqbalka dalka. Ismail D. Osman waa agaasime ku-xigeenkii hore ee Hay’adda Nabad-sugidda iyo Sirdoonka Qaranka Soomaaliya. Wuxuu wax ka qoraa Soomaaliya, Geeska Afrika iyo amniga gobolka, isaga oo diiradda saaraya dowladnimada iyo loollanka awoodda. items.title: Cabinet officials brace to relinquish Kenyan passports after presidential ultimatum
items.description: A mounting cohort of senior Somali government ministers is poised to surrender their Kenyan passports and national identity documents within days, heeding President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s ultimatum that dual citizens holding public office must forswear their foreign nationality or immediately vacate their posts, according to multiple informed sources. The impending wave of surrenders represents the most aggressive enforcement of citizenship integrity standards within the executive branch in recent memory, building on Deputy Prime Minister Jibril Abdirashid Haji’s unilateral decision to return his Kenyan travel documents—a move that effectively set a binding precedent for his cabinet colleagues. Deputy Prime Minister Jibril Abdirashid Haji became the first senior figure to bow to the directive when he formally handed over his Kenyan passport to the Kenyan Embassy in Mogadishu earlier this week. In a terse statement, Jibril asserted the move was designed to guarantee “complete transparency” in the execution of his official duties and to preempt any challenge to his national allegiance. Sources who spoke to Dalsan on condition of anonymity, citing lack of authorisation to engage publicly on the matter, disclosed that several ministers and state ministers are now finalising arrangements to submit their Kenyan travel credentials and identification cards to the diplomatic mission. The sources indicated that the officials are acting with haste to avoid being perceived as defying the President’s edict, which was first articulated during a closed-door cabinet sitting last Thursday. “The President made it unequivocally clear that retaining a foreign passport while occupying a senior government portfolio is untenable,” one source told Dalsan. “Those who intend to retain their cabinet seats are moving swiftly to comply, and a series of handovers is widely anticipated before the week concludes.” The directive has cast a harsh glare on the prevalence of dual citizenship among Somalia’s political elite—a sensitive issue long left unaddressed but now thrust into the open. Although Somalia’s provisional constitution does not explicitly outlaw dual nationality for public officials, the President’s order effectively imposes a new litmus test for the upper echelons of power, compelling officials to choose definitively between their Somali responsibilities and foreign entitlements. The enforcement drive comes against the backdrop of heightened scrutiny of senior officials’ travel documentation, with some figures having recently encountered obstacles at Kenyan ports of entry. State Minister at the Presidency Abdirashid was among those reportedly turned away by Kenyan immigration authorities, although it remains unclear whether that incident directly precipitated the presidential directive. Villa Somalia has yet to issue a formal communiqué on the enforcement timeline, and the Kenyan government has likewise refrained from commenting on the expected influx of surrendered documents. However, insiders suggest the list of compliant officials will expand as the President’s unannounced deadline looms, with further developments expected imminently. The post Cabinet officials brace to relinquish Kenyan passports after presidential ultimatum first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Xisbiga Towfiiq oo diiday natiijada doorashooyinka Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb ( Raxanreeb Online) Xisbiga Towfiiq ayaa si rasmi ah u diiday natiijada doorashooyinkii dhowaan ka dhacay Galmudug, isagoo ku eedeeyay habraaca tirinta codadka iyo ku dhawaaqista natiijooyinka guddiga doorashooyinka, in ay tahay mid aan lagu kalsoonaan karin. War-saxaafadeed uu xisbigu soo saaray ayaa lagu sheegay in natiijada lagu dhawaaqay aysan si buuxda uga tarjumayn codadkii shacabka Galmudug ay dhiibteen. Xisbiga ayaa sheegay inuu hayo xog iyo dukumiintiyo cadeeynaya in habka loo maray tirinta codadka ay tahay mid musuq-maasuq iyo Eex, isla markaana arrintaas ay tahay mid si weyn u saameysay natiijada la filayay. Xisbiga Towfiiq, ayaa ugu baaqay Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha in la sameeyo dib-u-eegis madax-bannaan oo lagu hubinayo saxnaanta natiijooyinka, si loo ilaaliyo kalsoonida shacabka iyo daahfurnaanta geeddi-socodka doorashada. Xisbiga ayaa sidoo kale ku boorriyay guddiga inuu si cad uga jawaabo cabashooyinka ay soo gudbiyeen dhinacyada ka qaybgalay doorashada. Sida uu xisbigu sheegay, doorashada tobanka degmo ee Galmudug waxaa codkooda dhiibtay 58,519 qof, halka codadka halaabay ay gaarayeen 987, oo u dhiganta ku dhowaad boqolkiiba hal. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo maanta furaya shirweynaha…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u furaya Shirweynaha 1-aad ee Badaha Soomaaliya, kaas oo ay ka qeyb-galayaan mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda, khubaro iyo dhinacyo kale oo lagu casuumay munaasabadda. Shirkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay dadaal ugu jirto sidii ay uga faa’iideysan lahayd kheyraadka badda, u horumarin lahayd dhaqaalaha buluugga ah, isla markaana ay u xoojin lahayd amniga xeebaha iyo marin-biyoodka dalka. Ajendaha shirweynaha waxaa qeyb muhiim ah ka ah arrimaha la xiriira amniga badaha, sugidda isu socodka maraakiibta, horumarinta dekedaha iyo xeebaha, ka faa’iideysiga kheyraadka badda, iyo fursadaha maalgashi ee ka jira dhaqaalaha badda. Waxaa sidoo kale la filayaa in doodaha shirka lagu soo bandhigo qorshayaal lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga dowladda iyo hay’adaha kale ee ku lug leh ilaalinta iyo horumarinta kheyraadka badda, si kor loogu qaado ka faa’iideysiga fursadaha dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa shirka ka jeedin doona khudbad uu kaga hadlayo muhiimadda ay baddu u leedahay horumarka dalka, doorka ay ku leedahay kobaca dhaqaalaha qaranka iyo dadaallada dowladda ee lagu horumarinayo waaxda badda. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa iftiimin doona fursadaha maalgashi ee ka jira Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada kalluumeysiga, gaadiidka badda, dekedaha iyo ka faa’iideysiga kheyraadka dabiiciga ah ee ku jira badda Soomaaliya. Shirweynaha 1-aad ee Badaha Soomaaliya ayaa la filayaa inuu noqdo madal lagu soo bandhigo aragtiyo iyo qorshayaal cusub oo lagu horumarinayo dhaqaalaha buluugga ah, laguna xoojinayo amniga badaha iyo ka faa’iideysiga xeebta ugu dheer qaaradda Afrika ee ay Soomaaliya leedahay. The post Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo maanta furaya shirweynaha… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland, Kenya Explore Stronger Trade Ties as President Irro Hosts MP Mpuru Aburi
items.description: Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro on Saturday hosted Kenyan Member of Parliament Mpuru Aburi and a high-level investment delegation at the Presidential Palace in Hargeisa, with both sides expressing commitment to strengthening trade, investment and broader bilateral cooperation. The delegation, led by the Tigania East MP from Meru County, held talks with President Irro on expanding economic partnerships, increasing investment and enhancing political engagement between Somaliland and Kenya. President Irro was joined by senior leaders of the ruling Waddani Party, including Chairman Hirsi Ali Haji Hassan and Deputy Chairman Mohamed Haji Yusuf (Waabeeyo). During the meeting, the President reaffirmed Somaliland’s commitment to creating a favourable environment for foreign direct investment, saying the country remains open to investors across key sectors of the economy. He highlighted Somaliland’s strategic location, stable investment climate and untapped economic potential, inviting Kenyan businesses to explore opportunities in infrastructure, livestock, fisheries, agriculture, energy and other productive sectors. Legislator Mpuru Aburi welcomed the growing engagement between the two sides and pledged to support stronger economic and diplomatic relations between Kenya and Somaliland. He thanked President Irro for the warm reception and expressed his commitment to advancing shared economic interests through closer cooperation. The visit also featured discussions on expanding agricultural trade, including the long-standing miraa (khat) business between Kenya and Somaliland. The crop, largely produced in Kenya’s Meru region, remains one of the country’s key agricultural exports to Somaliland and supports thousands of farmers, traders and transport operators in both territories. They explored ways of ensuring predictable trade, improving market access and strengthening commercial links to support the continued flow of miraa and other agricultural products, although no specific agreements were announced following the meeting. The discussions form part of broader efforts to deepen practical cooperation between Somaliland and Kenya in trade, investment and regional economic development. Official statements from the Presidency of the Republic of Somaliland described the meeting as constructive and focused on building mutually beneficial partnerships. The officials expressed optimism that continued engagement would pave the way for expanded economic cooperation and stronger people-to-people ties. Yunis Dekow Yunis Dekow is a Kenyan Pan-African journalist, media entrepreneur, and strategic communications expert. With over a decade of experience across local and international media houses, he specializes in narratives covering Northern Kenya and the Horn of Africa.

items.title: Iiraan oo u muuqata in ay heshay gacanta sare kadib go’aankii Donald Trump
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Markii Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu mar kale u muuqday inuu ka laabtay hanjabaad militari oo ka dhan ahayd Tehran, wuxuu fursad cusub siiyay sheekada ay madaxda Iran doonayaan inay dunida ka dhaadhiciyaan: Iran ma aha cidda dagaalka ka baqaysa — Trump ayaa ka baqaya. Hoggaanka Iran wuxuu aaminsan yahay inuu helay meesha ay dunidu ka nugushahay. Tehran, oo kaashanaysa maleeshiyaad ay xulafo yihiin oo ku sugan gobolka, waxay toddobaadkii lasoo dhaafay muujisay inay halis gelin karto qaar ka mid ah xarumaha tamarta iyo marin-biyoodyada ugu muhiimsan caalamka. Iran waxay sidoo kale sii kordhisay cadaadiska ay ku hayso Washington, xilli labada dhinac ay isku hayaan goorta iyo sida loo joojin karo colaadda dib u soo cusboonaatay, looguna noqon karo heshiiskii muddada gaaban jiray ee lagu billaabi lahaa wada-hadallo nabadeed, kaas oo burburay bishii hore. Markii Trump uu maalmihii lasoo dhaafay muujiyay in weerar weyn uu dhow yahay haddii Iran aysan sameyn wax tanaasul ah, laba mas’uul oo hore oo Iiraani ah ayaa sheegay in hoggaanka Tehran uu si cad ugu jawaabay: samee. “Waxay diyaar u yihiin dagaalka, dibna uma laabanayaan,” ayuu yiri Amir al-Mousawi, oo ah diblomaasi hore oo Iiraani ah. Al-Mousawi wuxuu sheegay inuu dhammaadka toddobaadka la kulmay kooxda ku dhow madaxa wada-xaajoodyada Iran, ahna guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf. Sida uu sheegay, mas’uuliyiin Mareykan iyo Iiraani ah ayaa dhammaadka toddobaadka fariimo isweydaarsaday, kuwaas oo loo sii mariyay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Pakistan iyo Qatar. Wuxuu sheegay in Trump uu ku hanjabay weerar culus oo lagu qaado kaabayaasha rayidka, sida xarumaha korontada, haddii Iran aysan dib ugu laaban wada-hadallada. Iran ayaa diidday, ayuu yiri, waxayna ku adkeysatay in Washington ay marka hore ku noqoto “is-afgaradkii” hore, kaas oo khubaro badan ay sheegeen inuu Tehran u janjeeray. “Wax dhib ah kuma qabno dagaalka, waxaana diyaar u nahay iska-horimaad weyn,” ayuu al-Mousawi sheegay in Iran ay Mareykanka ku tiri. “Trump wuxuu Iran ku yiri: ‘Waxaan weerari doonaa korontadiinna.’ Iran-na waxay ugu jawaabtay: ‘Haddii aad na weerartaan, annaguna waan idin weerareynaa.’” Sasan Karimi, oo hore xil sare uga soo qabtay dowladda Iran, haddana cilmiga Iran ka dhiga Jaamacadda Tehran, wuxuu sheegay in madaxda Tehran ay fahmeen habka uu Trump u adeegsado wada-xaajoodyada. “Mar kasta oo fariimo la isweydaarsado, Trump wuxuu billaabaa inuu xaaladda cadaadis saaro, isaga oo Iran u hanjabaya si uu tanaasul dheeraad ah uga helo,” ayuu yiri. “Laakiin Iran si fudud looma marin-habaabin karo.” Axaddii, Trump wuxuu sheegay inuu ka laabtay qorshihii uu ku doonayay inuu xaaladda sii kiciyo, kaddib markii Iran iyo dalal kale oo Bariga Dhexe ah ay ka codsadeen inuu weerarka dib u dhigo. Trump wuxuu sheegay in “qaab-dhismeedka heshiiska” la isku afgartay. Hase yeeshee, ma jiraan calaamado muuqda oo muujinaya in wada-hadalladii Mareykanka iyo Iran dib loo billaabay. Waxa keliya ee muuqda ayaa ah in Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Qatar ay walaac ka muujiyeen awoodda ay u leeyihiin inay si ku filan u difaacaan xarumahooda saliidda iyo gaaska, sida ay sheegeen laba diblomaasi oo gobolka ka tirsan. Telefishinka rasmiga ah ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa Axaddii sheegay in Dhaxal-sugaha Mohammed bin Salman, oo ah hoggaamiyaha dhabta ah ee dalkaas, uu dhowaan Trump kala hadlay “baahida loo qabo in mudnaanta la siiyo wada-hadalka si xiisadda loo dejiyo” loogana “hortago dagaal ballaaran”. Weerarradii dhowaan ka dhacay gobolka ayaa muujinaya sida walaacaasi u culus yahay. Laba toddobaad ka hor, Xuutiyiinta Yemen, oo Iran la safan, ayaa xannibay maraakiibta Sacuudi Carabiya ee isticmaasha marin-biyoodka Baab al-Mandab ee Badda Cas. Sacuudigu wuxuu saliidda dhuumo ugu gudbinayay deked ku taalla xeebtiisa galbeed ee Badda Cas, si uu uga wareego xakamaynta Iran ay ku hayso maraakiibta caalamka ee mara marin-biyoodka Hormuz, oo ah jidka ugu muhiimsan ee saliidda looga dhoofiyo Gacanka. Toddobaadkii lasoo dhaafay, diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ayaa weeraray laba xarumood oo waaweyn oo saliidda Sacuudi Carabiya ah. Riyadh waxay weerarka ku eedeysay maleeshiyaad Iran taageerto oo ku sugan Ciraaq. Maalin kaddib, laba markab ayaa dab ku qabsaday dekedda Damiyaad ee Masar. Mas’uuliyiinta Masar waxay sheegeen in dhacdadu u muuqatay weerar ay fuliyeen diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn. Falanqeeyayaal badan oo gobolka ah ayaa weerarka u arkay mid kale oo ay Iran ama kooxaha wakiillada u ah fuliyeen. H.A. Hellyer, oo ah cilmi-baare sare oo ka tirsan Royal United Services Institute ee London, wuxuu sheegay in loollanka hadda socda uu salka ku hayo “dib-u-qaabeynta nidaamka amniga gobolka”. Wuxuu sheegay in xudunta khilaafku tahay cidda maamuleysa marin-biyoodka Hormuz. “Iran aad iyo aad ayay uga go’an tahay inaysan ka tanaasulin xakamaynta marin-biyoodka,” ayuu yiri. “Waxayna diyaar u tahay inay wax duqeyso si ay arrintaas u xaqiijiso.” Waxaa taas dheer weerarkii lama filaanka ahaa ee 17-kii July lagu qaaday xarumo ciidan oo Mareykanku ku leeyahay Jordan, kaas oo lagu dilay saddex askari oo Mareykan ah. “Weerarkii Jordan wuxuu ahaa dhacdadii wax walba beddeshay,” ayuu yiri Ali Vaez, agaasimaha mashruuca Iran ee kooxda International Crisis Group. Wuxuu sheegay in weerarku uusan muujin oo keliya in Iran ay weli haysato keyd weyn oo gantaallo ah, balse uu sidoo kale caddeeyay in awoodda sirdoon ee Tehran ay ka sarreyso sidii hore loo rumeysnaa. Weerarku wuxuu sidoo kale abuuray mucaaradad aan caadi ahayn gudaha Jordan, oo ah xulafo muhiim ah oo Mareykanku ku leeyahay dhinaca ammaanka. Boqollaal qof oo caan ka ah dalkaas, oo ay ku jiraan siyaasiyiin iyo qareenno, ayaa ka hor yimid xaddidaadaha xorriyadda hadalka, waxayna dalbadeen in ciidamada Mareykanka laga saaro Jordan. “Istaraatiijiyadda Iran muddadan oo dhan waxay ahayd inay Mareykanka fahamsiiso in haddii wareeg kale oo dagaal ahi dhaco, jawaabta Iran ay gobolka iyo dhaqaalaha caalamka ku yeelan doonto saameyn aad uga daran,” ayuu Vaez yiri. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Trump uusan weligiis si buuxda u fahmin waxa Iran dhaqaajiya iyo sida aysan u aqbalin in la cabsi geliyo ama xoog lagu maquuniyo. Intii lagu jiray mudda xileedkiisa hadda iyo tiisii horeba, ayuu yiri, Trump “wuxuu ka gaabsaday inuu barto casharka” ah in cadaadiska iyo hanjabaadaha lagu hayo Iran ay keliya sii adkeeyaan mowqifkeeda. “Waa siddeed sano oo uu waday cadaadiskiisa ugu sarreeya,” ayuu yiri, isaga oo ka hadlayay cunaqabateynta dhaqaale ee hadda lagu daray cadaadis militari. “Waligeedna ma keenin wixii uu doonayay.” Dhanka kale, Washington waxay la tacaaleysaa keyd hub oo sii yaraanaya. Qaar ka mid ah saraakiisha militariga ayaa ka digaya in hub yaridu dhaawici karto awoodda Mareykanka ee dagaallada mustaqbalka, sida dagaal quwado waaweyn oo lala galo Shiinaha. Saraakiishu waxay sheegayaan in dib-u-buuxinta hubka qaarkii ay qaadan karto sannado, gaar ahaan gantaallada difaaca sida Patriot-ka. Farzan Sabet, oo ah falanqeeye arrimaha Iran ah kana tirsan Geneva Graduate Institute ee Switzerland, wuxuu sheegay in fursadaha militari ee Mareykanku aysan fiicneyn. “Ma aha oo keliya hub yaraanta la soo sheegay,” ayuu yiri. “Marka koowaad, ma cadda in weerar kooban oo waqti xaddidan leh, kaas oo Trump xilligan diyaar u yahay inuu qaado, uu ku filnaan karo inuu beddelo xisaabta Iran.” “Marka labaad, way adag tahay in la rumaysto in fursadahaas militari ay si weyn u dhaawici karaan awoodda gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Iran, ilaa heer aysan xiri karin marin-biyoodka Hormuz ama aysan waxyeello dheeraad ah u geysan karin kaabayaasha muhiimka ah iyo xarumaha tamarta ee Khaliijka.” Iyagoo dareemaya kalsooni dheeraad ah, qaar ka mid ah mayalka adag ee Iran ayaa ku jeesjeesay xaaladda adag ee maamulka Trump uu galay. Ebrahim Rezaei, afhayeenka guddiga amniga qaranka iyo siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Baarlamaanka Iran, ayaa ka jawaabay hanjabaadihii cusub ee Trump. Wuxuu tixraacay hadal uu Trump bishii April ku sheegay inuu Iran duqeyn doono ilaa uu “dib ugu celiyo xilligii dhagaxa”. “Haddii Iran la weeraro,” ayuu Rezaei ku qoray X, “waxaan gobolka oo dhan iyo kaabayaashiisa dib ugu celin doonnaa xilligii dhagaxa.” Markii Trump uu sheegay inuu dib u dhigay weerarka, falanqeeye caan ah oo mayal adag, Seyed Mohammad Marandi, ayaa bartiisa X kusoo bandhigay sawir TACOS digaag ah. Sawirka wuxuu tixraacayay erey-gaaban oo ay dadka Trump dhaliila u adeegsadaan si jeesjees ah: TACO, oo ah “Trump Always Chickens Out” — Trump mar walba wuu baqaa oo ka laabtaa. “Iran mowqifkeeda waxba kama beddelin,” ayuu ku qoray sawirka. Halkii Mareykanka iyo Iran ay wada-hadallo isugu soo dhowaan lahaayeen, khubaro badan oo gobolka ah waxay aaminsan yihiin in labada dhinac ay hadda ka sii kala fog yihiin sidii hore. Karimi, mas’uulkii hore ee Iran, wuxuu sheegay in Tehran ay tahay inay isu diyaariso weji kale oo dagaal toddobaadyada soo socda. Wuxuu sheegay in inta labada dhinacba ay ku qanacsan yihiin in dalabaadkooda oo keliya la fuliyo, wada-hadalladu aysan noqon doonin kuwo macno leh. “Si heshiis loo gaaro, labada dhinac waa inay siyaasad ahaan is-hoosaysiiyaan, isla markaana aqbalaan in himilooyinkooda xad-dhaafka ahi aysan shaqeyn doonin,” ayuu yiri. Laakiin wuxuu intaas ku daray in, xilligan, “arrimahaas aysan miiska saarneyn”.
