items.title: Somaliland Condemns Somali Prime Minister’s Visit to Las Anod, Appeals to International Community
items.description: Hargeisa (WDN ) – Somaliland has strongly condemned Somali Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre’s visit to Las Anod on Sunday, describing the trip as a deliberate political provocation and calling on the international community to pressure the Federal Government of Somalia to halt what it termed “escalatory actions.” Prime Minister Hamza arrived in Las Anod onAugust 2, 2026 at the head of a high-level delegation dominated by cabinet ministers to attend celebrations marking the first anniversary of the self-declared North Eastern State (NES) administration. The visit, his third to the city, has been widely viewed as a significant political statement by Mogadishu, reinforcing its support for the administration that now controls Las Anod following Somaliland’s withdrawal from the city in 2023. In a sharply worded statement, Somaliland accused the Federal Government of attempting to inflame tensions in the disputed Sool region and warned that the visit could further destabilize an already fragile security environment. “Somaliland strongly condemns the provocative visit by the Prime Minister of the Federal Government of Somalia to parts of the eastern Sool region,” the statement said. The administration argued that the trip was not a routine official visit but a politically charged move designed to challenge Somaliland’s longstanding claim over the territory. Somaliland further urged international partners—including governments, regional organizations, and diplomatic missions—to intervene and press Mogadishu to refrain from what it described as actions that risk increasing instability in the Horn of Africa. According to the statement, the visit constitutes “a violation of the sovereignty, territorial integrity, and existence of the Republic of Somaliland” and represents “an act that fuels conflict while undermining regional peace and security.” Officials in Hargeisa warned that the visit could deepen political divisions and create new flashpoints in one of the Horn of Africa’s most sensitive territorial disputes. A Deepening Political Divide The reaction underscores the widening gulf between Somaliland and Somalia’s Federal Government over the future of Las Anod and the wider Northeast region (Sool and Sanaag). Since local clan forces expelled Somaliland’s military from Las Anod in early 2023, the city has remained under the control of local authorities aligned with the newly established North Eastern State administration, which has openly pledged allegiance to the Federal Republic of Somalia. Mogadishu has steadily strengthened its political engagement with the administration through repeated high-level visits, public endorsements, and official recognition. For Somaliland, however, each visit by senior Somali officials is viewed as an attempt to consolidate federal authority in territory that Hargeisa continues to regard as part of Somaliland. Prime Minister Hamza’s latest trip therefore represents more than a ceremonial visit. It highlights the increasingly competing claims of sovereignty and political legitimacy between Mogadishu and Hargeisa, while further illustrating how Las Anod has become one of the most strategically and politically contested cities in the Horn of Africa. Somalia’s Federal Government had not publicly responded to Somaliland’s statement thus far or its appeal to the international community. With both sides maintaining firmly opposing positions, the dispute over Las Anod continues to evolve beyond a territorial disagreement into a broader contest over political authority, statehood, and the future constitutional map of Somalia. items.title: Taliyaha Militariga oo kormeeray Dugsiga General Gordon ee Muqdisho (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud oo maanta ka soo laabtay booqasho uu Axaddii ku tegay Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa kormeeray Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee General Gordon ee Magaalada Muqdisho. Dugsiga General Gordan ayaa la sheegay in ay tababar ku qaadanayaan cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Gaarka ee Xoogga Dalka. “Taliyaha ayaa waxaa halkaasi ku soo dhaweeyey Taliyaha Ciidanka Gaarka ah, Sareeye Guuto Aadan Maxamed Cumar (Aadan Dheere), isagoo warbixin ka dhageystay xaaladda guud ee dugsiga iyo horumarka tababarada ka socda.” Ayaa lagu yiri war uu soo saaray Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay in kormeerka ay ujeeddadiisu ahayd qiimeynta tayada tababarka, dardargelinta iyo dhiirigelinta askarta. “Kormeerka ayaa ujeeddadiisu ahayd qiimeynta tayada tababarka, dardargelinta ciidamada iyo dhiirigelinta askarta. Taliyaha ayaa ku amaanay ciidamada dadaalkooda, naf-hurnimadooda iyo sida ay uga go’an tahay difaaca dalka.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Ciidamada ayaa intii uu Taliyuhu ku guda jiray kormeerkiisa, xerada ku soo bandhigay dhoolatus ay ku muujinayaan heerka tababarkooda, oo ah sida loogu carbiyay difaaca qaranka. Warka ayaa lagu xusay in dhanka kale uu Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka la kulmay saraakiisha iyo macalimiinta bixiya tababarada kala duwan, isla-markaana uu bogaadiyay doorkooda ku aaddan tayaynta ciidamada. Xeradan ayaa wadata magaca General Maxamed Ibraahim Faarax (Gordon), oo ahaa Sarkaal caan ka ahaa Militariga Somaliya, kaas oo 29-kii bishii October ee sanadkii 2012 ku dhintay weerar qorsheysan oo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ay ka gaysteen deegaanka Buufow ee duleedka Magaalada Marka ee Xarunta Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose. Kormeerka General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Militariga Somaliya ee xerada ayaa ku soo aadaya, xilli ay hawlgalo ka socdaan gobolada dalka qaarkood.

items.title: Puntland, U.S. Expand Security Partnership as AFRICOM Agrees to Broaden Bosaso Base
items.description: Bosaso (WDN) – Puntland and the United States have agreed to significantly expand their security cooperation following high-level talks in Bosaso, culminating in a new agreement that will allow the United States to enlarge its military presence at Bosaso as part of broader counterterrorism and maritime security efforts in the Horn of Africa. Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni, accompanied by cabinet ministers, senior military commanders and presidential advisers, met on Saturday with a U.S. delegation led by Major General Claude Tudor, Commander of U.S. Africa Command’s (AFRICOM) Special Operations component. The discussions focused on strengthening the long-standing security partnership between Puntland and the United States, with particular emphasis on counterterrorism operations and safeguarding the strategically vital Red Sea and Gulf of Aden shipping corridors. At the conclusion of the meeting, the two sides signed an agreement expanding bilateral security cooperation. Under the deal, the United States will be permitted to enlarge its operational facilities in Bosaso to enhance counterterrorism missions and maritime security operations in one of the world’s busiest and most strategically important waterways. The expansion is expected to improve operational coordination, intelligence-sharing, and logistical support for ongoing efforts to combat terrorist networks operating in Somalia and to protect international shipping routes from security threats. The agreement comes at a time of heightened concern over regional security, including the continued threat posed by extremist groups and the growing importance of securing maritime trade routes linking the Red Sea, the Gulf of Aden, and the wider Indian Ocean. Puntland has positioned itself as a key partner in regional counterterrorism efforts, particularly through its military campaigns against extremist groups in the Cal Miskaad mountains and its role in securing Somalia’s northeastern coastline. President Deni reaffirmed Puntland’s commitment to working closely with international partners to confront terrorism and preserve regional stability. “The Puntland Government remains fully committed to combating terrorism and any threat that undermines the security, stability, and development of Puntland, Somalia, and the wider Horn of Africa,” the Puntland administration said in a statement following the meeting. For Washington, the expanded presence in Bosaso underscores the strategic importance of Puntland as a partner in efforts to counter militant groups and enhance maritime security across a region that serves as a critical gateway for global commerce. The agreement signals a further deepening of U.S.-Puntland security ties at a time when both sides are seeking to strengthen coordinated operations against extremist organizations while protecting one of the world’s most vital international shipping lanes. items.title: Maamulka gobolka oo dib uga howl-gelinaya Muqdisho…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka gobolka Banaadir ayaa dib u bilaabay howl-gelinta biyo-mareennada degmada Shangaani, iyadoo mashruucan uu qeyb ka yahay qorshe ballaaran oo lagu dayactirayo kanaallada iyo dhuumaha qaada biyaha roobka si loo yareeyo fatahaadaha iyo biyo-fariisadka ka dhasha xilliyada roobabka. Mas’uuliyiinta gobolka ayaa sheegay in biyo-mareenka laga hirgelinayo degmada Shangaani uu dhererkiisu gaarayo 500 oo mitir, isla markaana uu door muhiim ah ka qaadan doono hagaajinta bilicda magaalada, dardar-gelinta nadaafadda iyo fududeynta qul-qulka biyaha roobka. Sidoo kale, maamulka gobolka Banaadir ayaa tilmaamay in mashruucan uu qeyb ka yahay dadaallada lagu horumarinayo kaabeyaasha magaalada Muqdisho, si looga hortago dhibaatooyinka soo noq-noqda ee ka dhasha biyo-mareennada xiran ama burburay. Maamulka ayaa digniin adag u diray cid kasta oo isku dayda inay waxyeello gaarsiiso ama caqabad ku noqoto biyo-mareennada la dhisayo, isagoo caddeeyay in tallaabooyin sharci ah laga qaadi doono qof kasta oo lagu helo falalkaas. Xilliyada roobabka, qeybo badan oo ka tirsan Muqdisho ayaa waxaa ka dhasha biyo-fariisin sababa in waddooyin muhiim ah ay xirmaan, taas oo saameyn ku yeelata isu socodka gaadiidka iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa dadweynaha. Meelo badan oo caasimadda ka mid ah ayaa inta badan loo adeegsadaa booyado si looga saaro biyaha ku fataha waddooyinka, hase yeeshee arrintaasi waxay keentaa dib u dhac ku yimaada isu socodka iyo culeys dheeraad ah oo soo wajaha shacabka iyo gaadiidka isticmaala waddooyinka. Dib u howlgelinta biyo-mareennada degmada Shangaani ayaa la filayaa inay wax ka tari doonto yareynta fatahaadaha xilliyada roobka, isla markaana ay gacan ka geysato hagaajinta nadaafadda iyo bilicda caasimadda, iyadoo maamulka gobolka Banaadir uu sheegay inuu sii wadi doono mashaariicda lagu horumarinayo kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah ee Muqdisho. items.title: Xilliga la qabanayo Doorashada Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo la shaaciyay
items.description: Guddiga Doorashada Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa galabta muddeeyay waqtiga la qabanayo Doorashada Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, iyadoo dhinaca kalena uu guddigu shaaciyay shuruudaha laga doonayo xubnaha daneynaya jegadaasi. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in 5-ta illaa 6-da bishan la diiwaangelinayo musharaxiinta, in 8-da bishan la bixin doono shahaadooyinka musharaxnimada iyo in 10-ka bishan ay u asteeyeen maalinta doorashada ee Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Shuruudaha laga doonayo musharaxa 1. In uu xubin ka yahay Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Somaliya. 2. In da’da Musharaxa Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka aysan ka yaraan shan iyo soddon (35) sano. 3. In labadiisa waalid ay yihiin muwaadiniin Jahuuriyadda Federaalka Somaliya. 4. In uusan/aysan qabin xaas/nin ajnabi ah. 5. In musharaxa haysta jinsiyad dal kale uu caddeeyo ka noqoshada jinsiyaddaas, haddii uu ku guuleysto Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka BJFS. 6. In uu caddeeyo hantida uu leeyahay, una gudbiyo hab qoraal ah Xafiiska Hantidhowraha Guud ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Somaliya. 7. In uu keeno codsiga musharaxa, taariikh nololeed (CV), nuqulka aqoonsiga Xildhibaanimo (ID Card), labo sawir iyo warqadda caddeynta lacag bixinta ee Bankiga Dhexe. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in musharaxa is diiwaangelinaya, haddii uu nin yahay laga doonayo in uu bixiyo kharash dhan soddon kun oo dollar ($30,000) oo aan celis lahayn, isla-markaana uu ku shubo xisaabta furan ee Lr. 127 ee Golaha Shacabka ku leeyahay Baanka Dhexe. “Haddii Musharaxa Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka BJFS dumar tahay, kharashaadka diiwaangelinta waa $15,000 (Shan iyo toban kun oo dollar).” Ayuu guddigu ku sheegay warqad la soo dhigay bogga Golaha Shacabka. Guddiga Doorashada Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo maanta kulankoodii 1aad ku yeeshay Xarunta Golaha Shacabka (Villa Hargeisa) ee Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa Xildhibaan Cabdirisaaq Cumar Maxamed u doortay in uu noqdo Gudoomiyaha Guddiga. Guddiga oo ka kooban sagaal xubnood ayay laba ka mid ah yihiin haween, iyadoo ayna Axaddii magacawday Gudoomiye 1aad Kuxigeenka ee Golaha Shacabka, Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar oo hadda ah Kusimaha Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka.

In uu keeno codsiga musharaxa, taariikh nololeed (CV), nuqulka aqoonsiga Xildhibaanimo (ID Card), labo sawir iyo warqadda caddeynta lacag bixinta ee Bankiga Dhexe. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in musharaxa is diiwaangelinaya, haddii uu nin yahay laga doonayo in uu bixiyo kharash dhan soddon kun oo dollar ($30,000) oo aan celis lahayn, isla-markaana uu ku shubo xisaabta furan ee Lr. 127 ee Golaha Shacabka ku leeyahay Baanka Dhexe. “Haddii Musharaxa Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka BJFS dumar tahay, kharashaadka diiwaangelinta waa $15,000 (Shan iyo toban kun oo dollar).” Ayuu guddigu ku sheegay warqad la soo dhigay bogga Golaha Shacabka. Guddiga Doorashada Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo maanta kulankoodii 1aad ku yeeshay Xarunta Golaha Shacabka (Villa Hargeisa) ee Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa Xildhibaan Cabdirisaaq Cumar Maxamed u doortay in uu noqdo Gudoomiyaha Guddiga. Guddiga oo ka kooban sagaal xubnood ayay laba ka mid ah yihiin haween, iyadoo ayna Axaddii magacawday Gudoomiye 1aad Kuxigeenka ee Golaha Shacabka, Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar oo hadda ah Kusimaha Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka.

items.title: Al-Shabaab retakes Teedaan in Somalia’s Hiran region
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Al-Shabaab fighters recaptured the town of Teedaan in central Somalia’s Hiran region on Sunday, seizing a position that has long served as a key line of defence for the regional capital, after clashes that left dozens of people dead. The assault began when insurgents struck a base manned by the Somali army and allied clan militias using a vehicle-borne improvised explosive device (VBIED), touching off fighting that forced the allied forces to withdraw from the town entirely. It marked the first time since 2022 that Al-Shabaab has flown its flag over Teedaan and held control of it. Al-Shabaab, through affiliated media channels, claimed its fighters killed 41 soldiers and wounded 60 others in the attack. The claim has not been independently verified. The Somali federal government, the national army and regional officials have not commented on the fighting, the withdrawal of forces, the reported casualties, or whether a counter-offensive to retake the town is planned. Teedaan sits near Mahas , a town Al-Shabaab seized in a rapid offensive in 2025. Mahas had been under federal government control since 2014, when Ethiopian forces expelled Al-Shabaab from the area. Those Ethiopian forces withdrew in 2024, and Mahas changed hands for the first time in a decade. Across 2025, Al-Shabaab retook dozens of other towns, villages and settlements throughout Hiran and Middle Shabelle regions – a resurgence that has underscored the difficulty Somali forces face in holding territory captured during offensives conducted with international air and, at times, ground support. A commander’s warning, tested days later The fall of Teedaan comes just days after U.S. Africa Command chief Gen. Dagvin Anderson, in an interview on Friday, described a recurring pattern in which Somali and international partner forces recapture ground previously lost to militants — territory that slips away again once political attention shifts elsewhere. Anderson attributed the cycle to political infighting and dysfunction within Somalia’s government. “I was here active with the Special Operations Command from 2019 to 2021. And we worked with the Somali National Army and the Danab to move down the Lower Shabelle River to make progress, taking all the way down to Mubarak. I came back to AFRICOM as the commander, and we’re retaking the same territory again,” Anderson said. “This is what causes the frustration, because that territory was lost because somewhere the focus on terrorism was not there and was elsewhere,” he added. Hiran and the loss of Teedaan now stand as a real-time test of Anderson’s remarks — a test that, so far, is not unfolding in Mogadishu’s favour. The setback comes as Somali media have reported in recent weeks that the federal government is preparing a large-scale military campaign to reclaim territory Al-Shabaab captured during its 2025 counter-offensive, when the group seized dozens of towns and villages it had lost in a federal offensive in 2022 — reversing most of the gains made in that earlier campaign. What remains under government control Following the fall of Teedaan, the Somali government holds only a handful of major towns in Hiran region — Baladweyne, Halgan, Mataban and Jalalaqsi — with the surrounding areas of each now under militant influence. All but one of these towns are manned by Ethiopian and Djiboutian peacekeeping forces. Silence from Mogadishu Somali authorities’ silence in the wake of Teedaan’s capture has drawn attention in itself. The government and army have historically moved quickly to dispute Al-Shabaab’s casualty claims when the group announces territorial gains. Analysing the development, the Somali Digest website noted that Somali army commands typically respond fast to inflated claims of this kind, because leaving a figure such as 41 unchallenged cedes both the battlefield and the surrounding narrative to the group. It described rebuttals as a low-cost, minimum obligation owed to the families of the soldiers involved — and observed that on this occasion, no response came at all. The outlet added that, as a result, Al-Shabaab’s account stands as the only detailed version of events at Teedaan available to anyone following the war — including soldiers holding neighbouring positions and clan militias weighing whether to keep fighting alongside them. It characterised the silence as a propaganda defeat layered on top of a territorial one, and one it judged avoidable in a way the territorial loss may not have been. What comes next There is growing concern that, following Teedaan’s fall, Al-Shabaab will move to pressure Baladweyne and the town of Mataban. Mataban is considered especially vulnerable, as it is not manned by African Union peacekeepers — though several villages, including Bacda and Beergadiid, lie between the militants’ current positions and the town. items.title: Wefdi ka socday Koongareeska Mareykanka oo booqday magaalada Kismaayo
items.description: Kismaayo ( Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha dowlad goboleedka Jubbaland Axmed Maxamed Islaam, ayaa maanta magaalada Kismaayo ku qaabilay wefdi uu hogaaminayay Xildhibaan Ronny Jackson, oo ka koobnaa 11 Xildhibaan oo ka tirsan Koongareeska Maraykanka, Ku-simaha Safaaradda Maraykanka ee Soomaaliya, Justin Davis, iyo masuuliyiin kale. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray iskaashiga laba geesoodka ah ee dagaalka lagula jiro argagixisada, iyo sidoo kale taageerada Dowladda Maraykanka ee dhinacyada amniga, dhismaha hay’adaha dowlada, iyo arrimaha kale ee muhiimka u ah horumarka Jubaland. Masuuliyiinta heerka Sare ah ee kasocday Dowladda Maraykanka ayaa bogaadiyey dadaallada joogtada ah ee Dowladda Jubaland ay sannado badan ku bixisay la-dagaallanka argagixisada. Waxay sidoo kale bogaadiyeen guulihii u dambeeyey ee ay gaareen Ciidamada Ammaanka Jubaland iyo Kumaandooska Danab qeybta Jubaland, oo iyagoo kaashanaya AFRICOM fuliyey hawlgallo wadajir ah oo lagu wiiqayo kooxda Al-shabaab. Madaxda Jubaland ayaa uga Mahad celisay Dowladda Maraykanka taageerada joogtada ah ee ay mudada dheer u fidinaysay shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale madaxweyne Axmed Madoobe, waxaa kulanka ku weheliyey Xildhibaan Axmed Cabdi Kooshin, Xoghayaha Guddiga Difaaca ee Baarlamaanka 11-aad ee Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xildhibaan Mursal Maxamed Khaliif, Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Saaxiibtinimada Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya iyo Maraykanka iyo Xildhibaan Cabdirashiid Jire Qalinle, Wakiilka Dowladda Jubaland ee Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliya. The post Wefdi ka socday Koongareeska Mareykanka oo booqday magaalada Kismaayo appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Galmudug: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo shaaciyay natiijada doorashada Goleyaasha deegaanka
items.description: Dhuusamareeb ( Raxanreeb Online) Guddoomiyaha guddiga doorashooyinka madax-banaan ee Qaranka Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan, ayaa ku dhawaaqay natiijada doorashada goleyaasha deegaanka iyo Wakiilada ee dowlad goboleedka Galmudug oo dhacday 1-dii bishan Luulyo. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in doorashada ay ku tartameen 16 Urur siyasadeed, isla markaana codadka la dhiibtay ay gaarayan 197,971 cod, halka codadka ansaxay ay yihiin  191,504, waxa uuna carabka ku dhuftay guddoomiyaha in codadka xumaaday ay garayaan 6,467. Ururka Cadaalad iyo Wadajir ayaa noqday Ururka ugu codka badan isaga oo helay 135,247 cod, taas oo u dhiganta in ka badan kala bar codadkii la dhiibtay, waxaana uu ku guuleystay 63 kursi oo ka mid ah kuraasta golaha wakiillada. Ururka Towfiiq ayaa kaalinta labaad galay isaga oo helay 26,003 cod, waxa uuna helay 12 Kursi. Sidoo kale Ururka Sincad ayaa helay 12,867 cod, waxa uuna helay 6 Kursi, halka Ururka Karaama uu helay 10,668 cod, uuna helay 5 Kursi. Geesta kale qaar kamid ah Ururada siyaasadeed ee tartamayay ayaa muujiyay in aysan ku qanacsaneen natiijada doorashada iyo sida loo maamulay intaba. Sikastaba, Guddiga doorashooyinka madaxa-banaan iyo Sohdimaha, ayaa ka jawaabin cabashada ay qabaan qaar kamid ah Ururada tartamayay. The post Galmudug: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo shaaciyay natiijada doorashada Goleyaasha deegaanka appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Natiijada doorashooyinkii Galmudug oo la shaaciyay – Sidee ayaa loo kala helay?
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa ku dhawaaqay natiijada doorashadii goleyaasha deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada ee maamulka Galmudug, taas oo dhacday 30-kii Luulyo. Guddiga doorashooyinka ayaa saacadihii u dambeeyay ku howlanaa tirinta iyo xaqiijinta codadkii laga dhiibtay goobaha codbixinta, iyadoo guddoomiyaha guddiga uu galabta shaaciyay in doorashooyinkii ka dhacay deegaannada Galmudug ay codeeyeen 197,971 qof, halka codadka ansaxay ee doorashada goleyaasha deegaanka ay noqdeen 191,504 cod. Codadka xumaaday ayaa noqday 6,467 cod. Guddoomiyaha guddiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in wadarta guud ee kuraasta lagu tartamay ay ahayd 247 kursi. Sida loo kala helay codadka iyo kuraasta goleyaasha deegaanka: Ururka Cadaaladda iyo Wadajirka: 106,388 – wuxuu helay 115 kursi, oo ah 47% kuraasta la tartamay. Ururka Towfiiq: 26,063 cod – wuxuu helay 49 kursi. Ururka Karaama: 22,029 cod – wuxuu helay 29 kursi. Ururka Sincad: 19,901 cod – wuxuu helay 25 kursi. Ururka Madalsan: 3,960 cod – wuxuu helay 10 kursi. Ururrada kale ayaa qaarkood helay hal kursi, halka kuwo kalena aysan wax kursi ah helin, sida Ururka Tiir iyo Ururka Muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed. Natiijada Golaha Wakiillada Doorashadan ayaa ka dhacday 11 degmo, waxaana Golaha Wakiillada ku tartamay 12 urur siyaasadeed. Wadarta dadka codeeyay ayaa ahayd 197,971 qof, halka codadka ansaxay ay noqdeen 193,451 cod. Codadka xumaaday ayaa iyaguna noqday 4,520 cod. Waxaana lagu tartamay 89 kursi oo Golaha Wakiillada ah. Sida loo kala helay kuraasta Golaha Wakiillada: Ururka Cadaaladda iyo Wadajirka: 63 kursi. Ururka Towfiiq: 12 kursi. Ururka Sincad: 6 kursi. Ururka Karaama: 5 kursi. Ururka Ramaas: 1 kursi. Ururka Madalsan: 1 kursi. Ururka SAAB: 1 kursi. Doorashadan ayaa loo arkaa mid ka mid ah dhacdooyinka siyaasadeed ee ugu waaweyn ee sanadkan ka dhacay Galmudug. Doorashadan oo dhacday 30-kii Luulyo ayaa ahayd mid dadweyne, waxaana tan iyo waaberigii maalintaas goobaha codbixinta buux dhaafiyay kumannaan qof oo ka kala yimid degmooyinka Galmudug si ay codadkooda u dhiibtaan una soo doortaan hoggaankooda. Doorashada ayaa isugu jirtay doorashada Golaha Wakiillada iyo goleyaasha deegaanka. items.title: Daawo: Ra’iisul Wasaare ku xigeenka labaad ee dalka oo celiyay dhalashada Kenya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul wasaare ku xigeenka Soomaaliya, Mudane Jabriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji Cabdi ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u celiyay dhalashadii waddanka Kenya, kadib markii dhawaan laga soo celiyay dalkaasi. Jabriil oo tegay xarunta safaaradda Kenya ee magaalada Muqdisho ayaa geeyay dhalashada dalkaas oo uu haystay muddo 20 sanno ah, sida uu ku sheegay shirkiisa jaraa’id. “Ujeedka socdaalkayga waxa uu ahaa inaan safaaradda u celiyo dhalashadii Kenya ee aan haystay muddo ka badan 20 sano, iyagana ay ku sheegeen inay tahay mid aan Fake aheyn,” ayuu yiri Jabriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji Cabdi. Sababta uu u celiyay Ra’iisul wasaare ku-xigeenka labaad ee dalka ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in markii uu arkay caqabadaha soo kordhay iyo dhibaatooyinka la xiriira isticmaalka baasaboorka Kenya, uu go’aansaday inuu dib u celiyo, isla markaana uu si rasmi ah uga tanaasulo dhalashada Kenya. Waxa uu xusay in go’aankaasi uu ka tarjumayo kalsoonida uu ku qabo dalkiisa, isla markaana hadda kadib uu adeegsan doono baasaboorka Soomaaliga ah. “Markii aan arkay daruufaha hadda soo cusboonaaday iyo markii aan arkay caqabadaha jira waxaan go’aansaday inaan u celiyo oo aan ka tanaasulo dhalashadii Kenyaanka ahayd ee aan haystay,” ayuu mar kale yiri Ra’iisul wasaare ku xigeenka dalka. Sidoo kale wuxuu sii raaciyay “Dowladda Kenya iyo dadkaas waa dowlad aan walaalo nahay oo aan saaxibo nahay daruufo hadda soo cusboonaaday uunbaa keenay ciriiriga hadda jira”. Jabriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji Cabdi oo hadalkiisa sii wata ayaa sheegay inuu si dhow ula socdo cabashooyinka la xiriira sida loola dhaqmo qaar ka mid ah dadka Soomaaliyeed ee ka daga garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Jomo Kenyatta (JKIA) ee Nairobi, isagoo xusay in mararka qaar laga qaado baasaboorradooda. Waxa uu kula taliyay muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed inay ku kalsoonaadaan dalkooda,ayna iska celiyaan dhalashada Kenya. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo dhawaan mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan dowladda oo ay kamid yihiin Ra’iisul wasaare ku xigeenka labaad ee dalka iyo wasiiru dowlaha madaxtooyada, Abshir Bukhaari laga soo celiyay dalka Kenya. The post Daawo: Ra’iisul Wasaare ku xigeenka labaad ee dalka oo celiyay dhalashada Kenya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: U kuur galidii iyo booqashadii kediska ahayd ee madaxweynuhu ku tagay cisbatalka waybta kelyaha waxa uu soo saaray
items.description: 𝐖𝐀𝐑-𝐒𝐀𝐗𝐀𝐀𝐅𝐀𝐃𝐄𝐄𝐃 Kaddib cabashadii qaybo ka mid ah bukaanka kelyaha ee Cisbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), waxa uu Cisbitaalka ku tegey booqasho kedis ah oo uu ugu kuurgelayay cabashadan, iyo guud ahaanba xaaladda Cisbitaalka. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu kulamo xog waraysi ah la yeeshay maamulka, hawl-wadeennada caafimaadka iyo bukaanka, gaar ahaan qaybta maydhista kelyaha. Intaa kaddib, Madaxweynuhu waxa uu qaaday tallaabooyinka soo socda oo hordhac u noqonaya xal-u-helidda guud ahaan xaaladaha cisbitaallada dalka, gaar ahaan Cisbitaalka guud ee Hargeysa oo uu saaran yahay culays badan oo xagga adeeg-bixinta ah. 𝟏. 𝐈𝐧 𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐚𝐬𝐡 𝐥𝐚𝐠𝐚 𝐝𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐨 𝐝𝐡𝐚𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐚𝐧 𝐤𝐚𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐚 𝐤𝐞𝐥𝐲𝐨 𝐦𝐚𝐲𝐝𝐡𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐚: Madaxweynuhu waxa uu amray adeegga kelyo maydhista oo imikaba bilaash ah, in sidoo kale bukaanka kelyaha loo maydhayo laga dhaafo lacagaha kooban ee ay ku iibsadaan dawooyinka iyo agabka yaryar ee la xidhiidha kelyo maydhista. 𝟐. 𝐈𝐧 𝐬𝐢 𝐝𝐞𝐠𝐝𝐞𝐠 𝐚𝐡 𝐥𝐨𝐨 𝐬𝐨𝐨 𝐢𝐢𝐛𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐒𝐡𝐚𝐧 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐓𝐨𝐛𝐚𝐧 𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐢𝐧𝐧𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐊𝐞𝐥𝐲𝐨 𝐦𝐚𝐲𝐝𝐡𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐚 𝐚𝐡: Madaxweynuhu waxa uu amray in si degdeg ah loo soo iibiyo Shan iyo Toban mishiinnada Kelyo maydhista ah, si loo sii kordhiyo awoodda qaybta kelyo maydhista, loona yareeyo cadaadiska shaqo ee saaran mishiinnada hadda yaalla. Sida oo kalana loo hubiyo in bukaanka intii awoodda ah la wada gaadhsiiyo adeeggan, xilliga iyo saacadaha ku haboon. 𝟑. Guddidan farsamo waxa ay Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland siin doonaan warbixin buuxda oo sees u noqota xalalka degdegga loogu baahan yahay iyo kuwa muddada dheer. items.title: Natiijada Doorashada Galmudug oo la Shaaciyey
items.description: Dhuusamareeb – Waxaa la shaaciyey natiijada doorashada golaha Wakiilada Galmudug, iyadoo ururka JSP uu ku guuleystay kuraasta ugu badan ee doorashada. JSP ayaa helay 63 kursi, waxaana ku xigay Towfiiq oo helay 12 kursi, halka Sincad uu helay 6 kursi, Karaama 5 kursi, Ramaasna uu helay hal kursi, Madalsan hal kursi iyo ururka Saab oo asna helay Hal kursi. Natiijadan ayaa muujinaysa hoggaanka weyn ee JSP uu ka helay doorashada, iyadoo guud ahaan shanta urur ay wada heleen 89 kursi. items.title: Ciidamada hawlgalka ka wada Gobolka Hiiraan oo u baahan inay diiradda saaraan Yasooman
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee hawlgalka ka wada Gobolka Hiiraan ayay tahay inay la wareegaan deegaankaasi Yasooman oo hoostaga Degmada Buuloburde, kaas oo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab u suurtagelinaya in ay isugu kala gooshaan Gobolada Bartamaha iyo kuwa Koonfureed. Shabaabka ku sugan deegaanada Galmudug ee u socdaalaya Gobolada Koonfureed ayuu marinkooda ugu weyn yahay deegaanka Yasooman oo ku yaala meel istiraatiiji ah, isla-markaana isku xira Degmooyinka Buuloburde, Moqokori iyo Maxaas. Yasooman ayaa sidoo kale ah marinka ay adeegsadaan Shabaabka ka imanaya Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe ee u gudbaya dhinaca Magaalada Ceelbuur ee geeska bari ee Gobolka Galgaduud iyo deegaanka Jowle ee koonfurta fog ee Gobolka Mudug. Yasooman ayaa waxaa dhanka kale u furan waddada Aboorey ee tagta deegaanka Jicibow ee looga tallaabo galbeedka Gobolka Hiiraan, iyadoo Jicibow ay dhacdo jiinka bari ee Webiga Shabelle, waana deegaanka ay Shabaabku soo marsiiyaan saadkooda ka gudbaya Yasooman ee loo wado Moqokori, Maxaas iyo weliba deegaanada Galmudug. Cutubyo ka tirsan Kumaandooska Gorgor iyo Macawiisleyda ayaa daba-yaaqadii bishii July dhaqdhaqaaq ka bilaabay aagga Yasooman, inkastoo aad mooddo inay ka gaabiyeen weerar ay ku qaadaan deegaankaasi. Shabaabka ayaa 16-kii bishii April ee sanadkii hore bilaa dagaal kula wareegay dhulka buuraleyda ee Yasooman, ka dib markii ay isaga baxeen Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, waana isla maalintii ay Shabaabku dagaalka culus ku qabsadeen Degmada Aadan Yabaal ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe. Ciidamada ayaa mararka qaarkood si fudud uga soo baxa dhul ay dhibaato ka mareen inay qabsadaan, taas oo hadhow adkeysa in ay ku laabtaan, waana mid u baahan inay wax ka bartaan. Goobaha ay ciidamadu ka soo baxaan ayaa dhibaato ku ah istiraatiijiyadda lagu la dagaalamayo Al Shabaab, waxaana loo baahan yahay qorshayn iyo sugidda amniga waara, ka hor inta aysan ciidamadu dhul cusub qabsan, maadaama ay caqabado ka maraan.

items.title: Sawirro: Jubaland oo war ka soo saartay kulankii xubnaha Congress-ka iyo A/Madoobe
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Jubaland ayaa lagu faah-faahiyay kulan xasaasi ah oo uu 29-kii bishii hore Madaxweyne Axmed Madoobe la qaatay wafdi culus oo ka socday Golaha Congresska iyo safaaradda Mareykanka ee magaalada Muqdisho. Kulankaas ayaa waxaa ka qayb-galay illaa 11 Xildhibaan oo ka tirsan Golaha Congresska Mareykanka, waxaana hogaaminayay Xildhibaan Ronny Jackson, sida ay shaacisay Madaxtooyada Dowlad Goboleedka Jubbaland. Bayaanka ayaa lagu sheegay in kulanka looga hadlay iskaashiga Jubaland iyo Mareykanka ee la xiriira la dagaallanka Al-Shabaab. Waxaa kale oo lagu soo qaaday taageerada Mareykanka ee amniga iyo dhismaha hay’adaha dowladda. “Madaxweynaha Dowladda Jubaland, Mudane Axmed Maxamed Islaam, ayaa Magaalada Kismaayo ku qaabilay 29-kii Luulyo 2026, wafdi uu hogaaminayay Xildhibaan Ronny Jackson, oo ka koobnaa 11 Xildhibaan oo ka tirsan Koongareeska Maraykanka, Ku-simaha Safaaradda Maraykanka ee Soomaaliya, Justin Davis, iyo masuuliyiin kale. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray iskaashiga laba geesoodka ah ee dagaalka lagula jiro argagixisada, iyo sidoo kale taageerada Dowladda Maraykanka ee dhinacyada amniga, dhismaha hay’adaha dowlada, iyo arrimaha kale ee muhiimka u ah horumarka Jubaland,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Dhankooda mas’uuliyiinta ka socday dowladda Maraykanka ayaa bogaadiyey dadaallada joogtada ah ee ay Jubaland ku bixisay la dagaallanka argagixisada, maadaama muddo dheer oo sanado ah ay dagaal kula jirto Khawaarijta. Waxay sidoo kale bogaadiyeen guulihii u dambeeyey ee ay gaareen Ciidamada Daraawiishta Jubaland iyo kuwa Danab qeybta Jubaland, kuwaas oo iyaga oo kaashanaya AFRICOM fuliyey hawlgallo wadajir ah oo lagu wiiqayo argagixisada. Dhanka kale, Dowlad Goboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee Jubaland ayaa uga mahadcelisay dowladda Maraykanka taageerada joogtada ah ee ay mudada dheer u fidinaysay shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Si kastaba, waxaa kulankan Axmed Madoobe ku weheliyey Xildhibaan Axmed Cabdi Kooshin, Xoghayaha Guddiga Difaaca ee Baarlamaanka 11-aad ee Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xildhibaan Mursal Maxamed Khaliif, Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Saaxiibtinimada Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya iyo Maraykanka iyo Xildhibaan Cabdirashiid Jire Qalinle, Wakiilka Jubaland ee Golaha Mustaqbalka. The post Sawirro: Jubaland oo war ka soo saartay kulankii xubnaha Congress-ka iyo A/Madoobe appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: RW ku-xigeenka labaad ee Soomaaliya oo sheegay inuu ka tanaasulay Baasaboorka Kenya
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka labaad ee Xukuumadda Soomaaliya Jibriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji, ayaa sheegay inuu ka tanaasulay baasaboorkii Kenya, isaga oo tilmaamay in dedaalkaas uu yahay mid lagu xoojinayo hufnaanta iyo daaf-furnaanta laga filayo mas’uuliyiinta xilalka ka haya dowladda Soomaaliya. Jibriil oo la hadlay warbaahinta dowladda, ayaa sheegay in go’aankiisa uu uga tanaasulay baasaboorka Kenya uu yahay mid uu ku muujinayo daacadnimadiisa iyo in sare loo qaado Baasabarooka Soomaaliya. “Anigoo ilaalinaya mabaadi’da ugu sarreysa ee adeegga guud isla markaana doonaya in aan meesha ka saaro madmadow kasta oo la xiriira waajibaadkayga rasmiga ah, waxaan si iskaa ah ugu celiyey baasaboorkaas hay’adaha awoodda u leh ee Jamhuuriyadda Kenya” ayuu yiri RW ku-xigeenka labaad Jibriil Cabdirashiid. “Tallabadan waxa ay ka tarjumeysa sida ay go’an tahay ilaalinta hufnaanta xilka aan hayo iyo daacadnimadeyda ku aadan Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya” ayuu yiri Jibriil. Bishii Juun ee sannadkaan ayaa Jibriil Cabdirashiid, laga celiyey garoonka diyaaradaha ee magaalada Nairobi, kaddib markii dowladda Kenya ay ku eedeysay inuu si aan sharci ahayn ku helay baasaboorka dalkaas. Masuulkan ayaa markaas kaddib beeniyey eedeyntaasi, isaga oo ku adkaystay in baasaboorka loo siiyey si waafaqsan sharciga Kenya. The post RW ku-xigeenka labaad ee Soomaaliya oo sheegay inuu ka tanaasulay Baasaboorka Kenya appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Guddiga Doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo guda galay shaqadooda
items.description: Guddiga doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa guda galay shaqadooda, kaddib markii dhawaan la magacaabay. Guddiga ayaa kulan ugu horreeyay la yeeshay Guddoomiyaha KMG ah ee Golaha Shacabka ahna Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Koowaad, Marwo Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar. Kulanka waxaa sidoo kale ka qeyb galay Hab-dhowraha Golaha Shacabka, Xildhibaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi Xasan (Nuux), iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdulle (Jaabiri). Xubnaha guddiga ayaa intii uu kulanku socday si gacan-taag ah u doortay hoggaanka guddiga, waxaana Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Doorashada loo doortay Xildhibaan Cabdirisaaq Cumar Maxamed. Guddoomiyaha KMG ah ee Golaha Shacabka ayaa guddiga ugu baaqday inay si cadaalad, hufnaan iyo masuuliyad leh u gutaan waajibaadka loo igmaday, ayna si habsami leh u diyaariyaan doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Guddigan ayaa hadda bilaabay howlaha la xiriira diyaarinta iyo qabanqaabada doorashada Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka.

items.title: Raysal Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Labaad oo Celiyey Baasaboorkii Kenya
items.description: Raysal Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Soomaaliya ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu si iskiis ah ugu celiyey Dowladda Kenya baasaboorkii Kenya ee horay loo siiyey. Wuxuu sheegay in baasaboorkaasi uu ahaa dukumenti safar oo si sharci ah loo bixiyey, isla markaana si waafaqsan shuruucda iyo habraacyada Kenya loo helay loona isticmaalay. Raysal Wasaare Ku-xigeenka ayaa sheegay in go’aanka uu ku celiyey baasaboorka uu yahay tallaabo maamul oo uu isagu si ikhtiyaari ah u qaaday, ayna jirin khilaaf ama codsi uga yimid hay’ad dowladeed oo ku qasbay. Wuxuu sidoo kale uga mahadceliyey Dowladda iyo shacabka Kenya taageerada iyo martigelinta ay muddo dheer u fidiyeen Soomaalida, isagoo xusay in xiriirka iyo saaxiibtinimada labada dal uu muhiim yahay. Mas’uulkan ayaa caddeeyey in xilka uu hayo uu ka dhigayo inuu si buuxda ugu heellan yahay Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isagoo sheegay in celinta baasaboorka Kenya ay qayb ka tahay dadaalkiisa ku aaddan in si cad loo qeexo doorkiisa iyo mas’uuliyadda uu u hayo Soomaaliya. Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu sheegay inuu weli si weyn u ixtiraamayo Kenya iyo hay’adaha dowladdeeda, isla markaana uu ka shaqeyn doono xoojinta xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Kenya.

Mas’uulkan ayaa caddeeyey in xilka uu hayo uu ka dhigayo inuu si buuxda ugu heellan yahay Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isagoo sheegay in celinta baasaboorka Kenya ay qayb ka tahay dadaalkiisa ku aaddan in si cad loo qeexo doorkiisa iyo mas’uuliyadda uu u hayo Soomaaliya. Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu sheegay inuu weli si weyn u ixtiraamayo Kenya iyo hay’adaha dowladdeeda, isla markaana uu ka shaqeyn doono xoojinta xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Kenya.

items.title: Israel oo heshiis UN la gashay si loo raro 16,250 oo muhaajiriin ah
items.description: Dawladda Israel ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay baabi’isay qorshihii ay ku doonaysay inay muhaajiriin Afrikaan ah ku soo celiso Afrika iyadoo ay ku beddeshay heshiis ay la gashay Hay’adda Qaramida Midoobay u qaabilsan Qaxootiga (UNHCR), kaas oo uu dhigayo in in ka badan 16,250 oo qof oo Afrikaan ah loo raro dalalka reer Galbeedka . Qorshaha cusub oo ra’iisul wasaaraha Benjamin Netanyahu ku tilmaamay heshiis gaar ah ayaa sidoo kale u oggolaanaya muhaajiriinta kale ee hadhay inay sii joogaan Israel ugu yaraan shan sano oo kale . Tallaabadan ayaa soo afjartay muddo dheer oo muran ka dhashay arrinta dadka Afrikaan ah ee ku sugan Israel kuwaas oo tiradoodu dhan tahay ilaa 37,000 . Heshiiskan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah wuxuu ka dhigan yahay isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada siyaasaddii hore ee Israel, taasoo ku lug lahayd in muhaajiriinta lagu celiyo Afrika iyadoo la siinayo $3,500 iyo tikit diyaarad . Bishii Febraayo Israel waxay siisay 20,000 oo muhaajiriin ah oo lab ah waraaqo ku sheegaysa inay laba bilood ku leeyihiin si ay u baxaan ama haddii kale xabsi ku dhici doonaan . Si kastaba ha ahaatee hay’adaha xuquuqda aadamaha ayaa ku dooday in muhaajiriinta badan ay ka carareen dagaal iyo tacaddi, isla markaana soo celintooda Afrika ay khatar ku noqon karto . Netanyahu ayaa sheegay in dalalka Galbeedka loo rarayo ay ka mid yihiin Canada Jarmalka iyo Talyaaniga, isagoo sheegay in waa ballan uu hay’addu ka qaadatay inay qabanqaabiso oo ay maalgasho . Hay’adda UNHCR ayaa caddaynaysa heshiiska balse faahfaahin dheeri ah kamay bixin . Heshiiskan ayaa imaanaya kadib markii Maxkamadda Sare ee Israel ay bishii Maarso soo saartay amar ku meel gaar ah oo joojinaya hirgelinta qorshihii hore . Qorshaha soo celinta muhaajiriinta ee la baabi’iyay ayaa lagu soo qaaday inuu yahay qarsoodi waxaana jira dukumeentiyo sheegaya in dalal ay ka mid yihiin Rwanda ay diideen inay si rasmi ah u xaqiijiyaan . The post Israel oo heshiis UN la gashay si loo raro 16,250 oo muhaajiriin ah first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somalia: US signs Bosaso base deal with Puntland, bypassing Mogadishu
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The United States military has signed a new security agreement with Puntland, Somalia’s northeastern federal member state, bypassing the federal government in Mogadishu altogether – a move analysts describe as the clearest evidence yet of a hardening American “dual-track” policy toward Somalia, driven by Washington’s mounting exasperation with the political infighting paralysing the capital and undercutting the broader war against Al-Shabaab and ISIS-Somalia. The agreement was signed on Sunday during talks in the port city of Bosaso between Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni and a high-level American delegation from the US Africa Command (AFRICOM), led by Major General Claude Tudor, commander of AFRICOM’s Special Operations component. “The President of the Puntland State, H.E Said Abdullahi Deni, together with ministers, military officers, and advisors, held a meeting in Bosaso with a delegation from the United States Government, especially AFRICOM, led by Major General Claude Tudor, Commander of AFRICOM Special Operations,” Deni said in a statement posted on X. “The meeting focused on strengthening cooperation between Puntland and the United States, especially in fighting terrorism and improving security in the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden,” he added. Bosaso Base Set for Expansion Puntland’s leadership confirmed that the centrepiece of the talks was a new deal to expand the American military footprint at Bosaso and deepen maritime security cooperation — a move widely expected to support operations against Yemen’s Houthi rebels, a scenario long anticipated by regional observers. “Puntland and the United States also signed a new agreement to expand their cooperation. Under the agreement, the United States will expand its military base in Bosaso to improve operations against terrorism and to help protect maritime security,” Deni said. Somaliland Talks Mirror Puntland Deal The same US delegation had, days earlier, held parallel talks with Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi and members of his cabinet on August 1 in Hargeisa. Somaliland officials said security cooperation and maritime security dominated the discussion – the very themes underpinning the Puntland agreement. “Dual-Track Diplomacy” in Full View For Horn of Africa analysts, the near-simultaneous engagements with Puntland and Somaliland — two territories operating largely outside Mogadishu’s direct control — signal a deliberate American recalibration. “The US military is actively stepping up ‘dual-track diplomacy’ to deepen cooperation with strategic Somali territories — Somaliland, Puntland and Jubaland,” said Rashid Abdi, a Horn of Africa analyst at Nairobi-based Sahan Research. “The three are crucial US partners and deemed more active in the fight against terrorist groups in the Horn. The US military signed a deal with Puntland for use of region for counterterrorism, maritime security purposes,” Abdi said. A Warning from Washington’s Own Policy Circles The expanding US footprint in Somalia’s northern territories has not gone unchallenged inside Washington’s own foreign policy establishment. A recent report by the think tank Defense Priorities cautioned against American plans to build up to four military and naval bases in the breakaway region of Somaliland, alongside additional installations in neighbouring Puntland, warning that such a push would drag the United States deeper into Somalia’s quagmire and yield nothing but damage to American interests while driving up the costs of what it called an endless war. On Washington’s rationale that a stronger footprint is needed to counter the Houthi threat, the report argued that no insurgency has ever been defeated through air power alone, and that the Houthi threat can only be genuinely resolved by addressing its root causes — namely, ending the conflict in Gaza and the wider confrontation with Iran. Rather than deepening its entanglement in Somalia’s internal conflicts, the report urged Washington to fully withdraw from the country, arguing the United States derives no meaningful strategic interest from remaining. Patience Wearing Thin in Washington Underscoring the shift, AFRICOM’s chief Gen. Dagvin Anderson signalled in an interview on Friday that the US military’s continued presence in Somalia could become untenable if Somali leaders fail to resolve their political disputes and dysfunction. He noted growing voices in Washington questioning when Somalis will take full ownership of their own security, stressing that Somalia must ultimately assume complete responsibility for its own security future. items.title: Todd Blanche Officially Scraps $1.8B ‘Anti-Weaponization’ Fund
items.description: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche issued an order on Sunday officially rescinding the controversial $1.8 billion “anti-weaponization” fund removing the final obstacle to his confirmation as permanent Attorney General. The move came two days before the Senate Judiciary Committee is set to vote on his nomination ending a weeks-long standoff between the Trump administration and two key Republican senators. The fund which was part of a settlement agreement stemming from a lawsuit President Donald Trump filed against the IRS, had faced intense criticism. Critics expressed concern that the payouts could extend to participants in the January 6, 2021, Capitol riot, including those convicted of assaulting police officers. The settlement had also shielded the Trump family from tax audits. Sens. John Cornyn (Texas) and Thom Tillis (North Carolina) had made clear they would not support Blanche unless he provided written assurance that the fund would be scrapped and that the IRS settlement would be strictly retroactive. Cornyn stated he did not want the fund or the settlement’s anti-weaponization provisions to be used to reward Trump supporters. Blanche posted on X that the fund was rescinded and would have “no force or effect” adding: “This order establishes beyond any doubt that there is no fund.” The order also clarified that the tax audit immunity agreement “applies by its terms only retroactively” to claims open at the time of the settlement and does not protect the president from examination of future tax filings. The deal has cleared the path for Blanche to advance through the Judiciary Committee, though he is still expected to face opposition in the full Senate. President Trump had threatened to “push hard” to revive the fund if Blanche was not confirmed but this agreement appears to have secured his path forward. The post Todd Blanche Officially Scraps $1.8B ‘Anti-Weaponization’ Fund first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Blanche Oo Baabi’iyay Sanduuqii $1.8 Bilyan
items.description: Todd Blanche, oo ah Agaasimaha Hawlaha Wasaaradda Caddaaladda ee ku-simaha xilka ayaa Axadii soo saaray amar si rasmi ah u baabi’inaya sanduuqa dhan $1.8 bilyan ee ‘Anti-Weaponization’ taasoo meesha ka saartay caqabadii ugu weyneyd ee hor taagtay xaqiijintiisa inuu noqdo Wasiirka Caddaaladda . Tallaabadan ayaa timid laba maalmood ka hor inta aan Guddiga Cadaaladda ee Guurtida u codeyn magacaabistiisa, waxayna soo afjartay muran bilo ah oo u dhexeeya maamulka Trump iyo laba Senator oo Jamhuuri ah . Sanduuqa la baabi’iyay waxaa lagu sameeyay heshiisii Maxkamadda IRS iyo Trump kaas oo la sheegay inuu ku siin lahaa lacag dadka sheeganaya inay yihiin dhibanayaal loo adeegsaday hubka siyaasadeed ee dowladda . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qorshaha ayaa si weyn loo cambaareeyay, waxaana laga baqay in lacagta la siiyo kuwa ku lug lahaa rabshadihii 6-da Janaayo 2021 ee Capitol Hill oo ay ku jiraan kuwa lagu xukumay inay weerareen saraakiisha booliska . Sens. John Cornyn (Texas) iyo Thom Tillis (North Carolina) ayaa caddeeyay inaysan taageeri doonin Blanche ilaa uusan si qoraal ah u ballan qaadin in sanduuqa la baabi’in doono isla markaana la caddeeyo in heshiiska IRS uu ku ekeysan yahay oo kaliya kiisashii hore . Cornyn ayaa sheegay in uusan doonayn in sanduuqa ama kahortagga soo jeedinta mustaqbalka loo adeegsado in lagu abaal-mariyo taageerayaasha Trump . Blanche ayaa ku qoray qoraal uu ku baahiyay X in sanduuqa la baabi’iyay oo uusan yeelan doonin wax saamayn ah isagoo sheegay: “Amarkan wuxuu caddaynayaa, shaki la’aan, inaanay jirin wax sanduuq ah” . Sidoo kale waxaa lagu caddeeyay in heshiiska kahortagga IRS uu yahay mid dib-u-eegis ah oo kaliya lana adeegsan karo kiisaskii la dacweeyay, ma aha kan mustaqbalka . Tallaabadan ayaa furtay jidka Blanche si uu uga gudbo Guddiga Cadaaladda waxaana la filayaa inuu sii wado wajihi doono doodaha ka dhanka ah Guddiga buuxa ee Guurtida . Madaxweyne Trump ayaa si weyn ugu hanjabay inuu dib u soo nooleeyo sanduuqa haddii Blanche aan la xaqiijin . Si kastaba ha ahaatee heshiiskan waxa uu u muuqdaa mid suurtageliyay jidka xaqiijintiisa . The post Blanche Oo Baabi’iyay Sanduuqii $1.8 Bilyan first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Shir xasaasi ah oo u furmay mucaaradka iyo beesha caalamka + Ujeedka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Waxaa barqannimadii maanta xarunta Xalane ee magaalada Muqdisho ka furmay shir u dhexeeya Golaha Mustaqbalka iyo wakiillada beesha caalamka, kaas oo looga hadlayo arrimo muhiim ah oo la xiriira xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo arrimaha doorashooyinka dalka. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, shirka waxaa ka qayb-galaya Madaxweynihii hore ee dowladdii ku-meel-gaarka ahayd, Mudane Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed ,Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee dalka Xasan Cali Kheyre iyo Xildhibaan Cali Cabdullaahi Cosoble, halka Madaxweynayaasha Jubbaland iyo Madaxweynaha Puntland ay uga qeyb galayaan hab fogaan-arag ah. Maxaa laga wada-hadlayaa? Shirka u furmay mucaaradka iyo beesha caalamka ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saarayaa xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee dalka, gaar ahaan khilaafka u dhexeeya Villa Soomaaliya iyo Golaha Mustaqbaka ee ka dhashay doorashada. Ilo wareedyo xilkas ah ayaa innoo sheegay in lasii amba qaadayoo wada-hadallada ay garwadeenka ka tahay beesha caalamka ee lagu doonayo in lagu soo afjaro khilaafka daba dheeraaday u dhexeeya dowladda iyo mucaaradka. Wada-hadallada ayaa dhawr jeer oo hore fashilmay, kadib markii ay labada dhinacba isku fahmi waayeen ajendayaasha qaran ee la’isku hayo. Kulanka socda oo si weyn isha loogu hayo ayaa ujeedkiisa ugu wayn waxa uu yahay mid lagu raadinayo xal waara oo lagu yareynayo khilaafaadka iyo in la helo hannaan wada-shaqeyn oo horseeda xasillooni iyo horumar. Waxaa kale oo la gorfeynayaa caqabadaha horyaalla geeddi-socodka arrimaha siyaasadeed iyo sidii loo abuuri lahaa jawi ku dhisan wada-hadal iyo isu-soo dhawaansho dhinacyada kala duwan. Soomaaliya ayaa haatan ku jirto marxalad adag oo ka dhalatay isgoyska la taagan yahay, waxaana la’isku hayaa hannaanka doorashada iyo wax ka beddelka dastuurka dalka. items.title: Bruno Guimarães on the Verge of Completing Arsenal Move
items.description: Arsenal appear to be on the verge of signing Newcastle United midfielder Bruno Guimarães, after transfer expert Fabrizio Romano revealed that Newcastle have accepted the Brazilian star’s departure. Mikel Arteta’s side have made strengthening their midfield a priority this summer with Guimarães identified as their primary target. According to Romano Arsenal and Newcastle are now in direct talks over the fee with Newcastle’s previously firm stance having softened significantly. “The time for Bruno Guimarães has come. Arsenal and Newcastle are talking and it seems Newcastle have opened the door for his departure. Both sides are now negotiating the transfer fee” Romano said. In May, June and July, Newcastle had firmly rejected the idea of selling Guimarães but the situation has now changed. Romano stated that Arsenal are confident of completing the deal with Newcastle accepting that the Brazilian will leave if an agreement on the financial terms is reached. Mikel Arteta is looking to strengthen his midfield options, aiming to create strong competition between Martin Zubimendi, Declan Rice and Bruno Guimarães. Arsenal believe Guimarães can bring quality experience and composure to the squad especially in a season where they are defending the Premier League title and aiming for major European success. The only remaining hurdle is for the two clubs to agree on the final fee before the player undergoes a medical and signs the official contract. The post Bruno Guimarães on the Verge of Completing Arsenal Move first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Arsenal Intensify Pursuit of Vinícius Júnior with Arteta’s Major Promise
items.description: Arsenal have stepped up their efforts to sign Real Madrid winger Vinícius Júnior, with manager Mikel Arteta personally leading the campaign to bring the Brazilian star to the Emirates Stadium. Reports suggest that the Gunners are prepared to make the biggest financial outlay in the club’s history to secure his signature, should contract extension talks with Real Madrid fail. This pursuit comes as Vinícius, 26, enters the final year of his contract with Real Madrid. Contract negotiations have been ongoing for 18 months but have reportedly stalled over his wage demands of around €30 million net per year (€550,000 per week) . If an agreement cannot be reached, Real Madrid are understood to be willing to sell rather than lose him for free next summer, opening the door for Arsenal. Arteta, who led Arsenal to the Premier League title last season, has reportedly made a personal promise to the Brazilian star. According to Spanish newspaper AS, Arteta has assured Vinícius that he would become the centerpiece of Arsenal’s project, with the team built around his playing style. This promise is seen as a significant attraction for Vinícius, who is believed to be unhappy with his role at Real Madrid, particularly since Kylian Mbappé joined the club. However, significant financial hurdles remain. Arsenal would need to pay a fee believed to be close to €150 million , in addition to covering his high salary demands. It is believed that Arsenal have the financial capacity to complete such a deal, and there is confidence within the club that Vinícius would be open to the move. But everything now depends on the outcome of the upcoming talks between Vinícius and Real Madrid regarding a new contract. items.title: Atlético Madrid Eyeing Jack Grealish
items.description: Atlético Madrid are showing serious interest in signing Manchester City star Jack Grealish , with reports suggesting they want to offer him a fresh opportunity to revive his career. Grealish’s future at the Etihad Stadium appears uncertain, with Manchester City management and manager Enzo Maresca reportedly open to listening to suitable offers if the player decides to leave. Atlético’s interest comes as Grealish faces an uncertain future at Manchester City. The 30-year-old England international is seeking regular first-team football after a loan spell at Everton, where he showed promising form before a foot injury halted his progress. Diego Simeone, the Atlético Madrid manager, is known to greatly admire Grealish’s work rate, his ability to hold the ball under pressure, and his capacity to draw fouls from opposition teams. Despite having several attacking options, Simeone believes Grealish could bring creativity, experience, and composure to his side. However, Grealish would not be guaranteed a starting spot at Atlético, given the strong competition in their attacking lineup. The club have also strengthened their squad this summer, with the arrival of South Korean star Kang-in Lee. Atlético Madrid are not the only club interested in Grealish. Everton are still exploring the possibility of another deal, while Aston Villa are considering bringing back their former captain. Clubs from Saudi Arabia and MLS are also monitoring his situation, offering Manchester City various options should they decide to sell. Jack Grealish now faces a crucial decision about his future. If Atlético Madrid submit a formal offer, the England star could have a fresh start in La Liga, while Manchester City will have to decide on the future of one of their most high-profile players. items.title: Guddiga doorashada Qaranka oo goordhow shaacin doona natiida doorashadii ka dhacday Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb ( Raxanreeb Onlie) Guddiga doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa sacaadaha soo socda Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimada dowlad goboleedka Galmudug, kaga dhawaaqi doonaa natiijada kasoo baxday Doorashadii Dadweyne ee Isku sidkanayd taas oo ka qabsoomtay deegaannada Maamul Galmudug. Guddiga Doorashooyinka ayaa ku mashquulsanaa saacadihii u dambeeyay tirinta codadkii la dhiibtay, waxaana maanta ay shaacinayaan natiijadaas iyada oo ay sugayaan ururradii Siyaasadda ee ka qaybgalay Doorashadaas si ay u helaan natiijada ay sugayaan. Doorashada Dadweyne ee Galmudug ka dhacday waa tii afaraad oo guddigaan uu qabtay, markii ugu horreysay waxa uu dhammaadkii 2025 doorasho ka hirgeliyay Gobolka Banaadir, halka sannadkaan uu doorasho sidaan oo kale ugu qabtay Koofur Galbeed. Sidoo kale hogaamiyaha Xisbiga Towfiiq Sheekh Shaakir, ayaa gadood xooggan ka muujiyey shaqada gudiga doorashooyinka, lamana oga inuu aqbali doono natiijada doorashada soo baxda. items.title: Atlético Madrid oo isha ku haysa Jack Grealish
items.description: By Saleeymaan Alcadaala Sports Reporter, Radio Dalsan TV Atlético Madrid ayaa si dhab ah u danaynaysa saxiixa xiddiga Manchester City , Jack Grealish iyadoo la rumeysan yahay inay doonayso inay siiso fursad cusub oo uu dib ugu soo nooleeyo xirfaddiisa. Mustaqbalka Grealish ee Etihad Stadium ayaa u muuqda mid aan weli caddayn waxaana la sheegayaa in maamulka Manchester City iyo tababare Enzo Maresca ay diyaar u yihiin inay dhageystaan dalab kasta oo ku habboon haddii ciyaaryahanku go’aansado inuu kooxda ka tago . Danaha Atlético Madrid ayaa soo ifbaxaya iyadoo Grealish uu ku jiro xaalad adag oo uu mustaqbalkiisu mugdi ku yahay . Xiddiga reer Ingiriiska, oo 30 jir ah ayaa raadinaya koox uu si joogto ah uga ciyaaro, kaddib xilli uu amaah ku qaatay Everton halkaas oo uu soo bandhigay qaab ciyaareed dhiirrigelin leh ka hor inta uusan dhaawac cagta ah uu hakiyin horumarkiisii. Tababaraha Atlético Madrid Diego Simeone ayaa si weyn u qadariya shaqada adag ee Grealish, awooddiisa uu kubadda u ilaashado cadaadiska iyo kartidiisa uu khaladaad uga kasbado kooxaha kasoo horjeeda . Inkastoo Atlético ay leedahay ciyaartoy badan oo weerarka ah, Simeone wuxuu rumeysan yahay in Grealish uu kooxda siin karo hal-abuur khibrad iyo xasillooni marka la maamulayo ciyaarta. Si kastaba ha ahaatee haddii uu ku biiro Atlético Madrid, Grealish looma dammaanad qaadi doono boos joogto ah, maadaama kooxda ay leedahay tartan xooggan oo ka jira safka weerarka . Kooxda reer Madrid ayaa sidoo kale sii wadday xoojinta safkeeda xagaagan waxaana ka mid ah ciyaartoyda cusub xiddiga Koonfur Kuuriya ee Kang-in Lee. Atlético Madrid ma aha kooxda keliya ee doonaysa Grealish. Everton ayaa weli sahaminaysa suurtagalnimada heshiis kale, halka Aston Villa ay ka fiirsanayso inay dib u soo ceshato kabtankeedii hore . Sidoo kale, kooxo ka dhisan Sacuudiga iyo horyaalka MLS ayaa isha ku haya xaaladdiisa, taasoo siin karta Manchester City doorashooyin kala duwan haddii ay go’aansato inay iibiso ciyaaryahanka. Jack Grealish ayaa wajahaya go’aan muhiim ah oo ku saabsan mustaqbalkiisa. Haddii Atlético Madrid ay gudbiso dalab rasmi ah, xiddiga reer England wuxuu heli karaa fursad cusub oo uu bog cusub uga bilaabo horyaalka La Liga, halka Manchester City ay go’aan ka gaari doonto mustaqbalka mid ka mid ah ciyaartoydeedii ugu magaca weynaa. The post Atlético Madrid oo isha ku haysa Jack Grealish first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somaliland oo cabasho ka gudbisay R/W Xamza kadib…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xukuumadda Somaliland oo war-saxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa si adag u cambaareysay socdaalka uu Axaddii Ra’iisul wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre ku tegay magaalada Laascaanood ee xarunta gobolka Sool, iyada oo cabasho u gudbisay saaxibada beesha caalamka. Somaliland ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in ay booqashada Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ee magaaladaas u aragto daandaansi iyo xadgudub ka dhan ah waxa ay ku tilmaantay madax-bannaanideeda. Maamulka Somaliland ayaa sheegay in booqashadu ay sii hurin karto xiisadda siyaasadeed, isla markaana ay ka digayaan tallaabo kasta oo keeni karta amni-darro ama qalalaase horleh. “Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa ay si adag u cambaaraynaysaa socdaalka daandaansiga ah ee ra’iisul wasaaraha dawladda federaalka Soomaaliya, ku yimid qaybo ka mid ah bariga gobolka Sool,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu yiri qoraalka: “Tallaabadani waxay hordhac u tahay hurin colaadeed iyo muran siyaasadeed oo aan geedna loogu soo gabban, waana ku-xad-gudub madaxbannaanida dhuleed iyo jiritaanka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, sidoo kalena waa ficil sii hurinaya colaadda, khalkhal na gelinaya amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka.” Nabadda gobolka Sool Somaliland waxay bayaankeeda ku xustay in booqashada Ra’iisul wasaaraha Soomaaliya ku joogo Laascaanood ay wiiqayso dadaallada saaxibada caalamiga ee ku aadan sidii xasillooni loogu soo dabaali lahaa gobolka. Waxaa kale oo ay intaas ku dartay in itallaabada uu qaaday Ra’iisul wasaaraha ay tahay mid mas’uuliyad darro ah, sida lagu caddeeyay qiraalka. “Xukuumadda JSL waxa ay si cad u sheegaysaa in falalkan masuuliyad-darrada ahi iyo socdaalladan aan micnaha ku fadhiyini aanay waxba ku soo kordhinayn nabadda gobolka, balse ay si toos ah u wiiqayaan dedaallada dunidu ku doonayso xasillooni waarta iyo nabadgelyo gobolka ka hanaqaadda,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Cabashada Somaliland Somaliland ayaa dhanka kale farriin dacwo ah u dirtay beesha caalamka, Midowga Afrika, IGAD iyo Qaramada Midoobay, iyada oo ku wargelisay in ay si weyn uga soo horjeedo tallaabooyinka uu qaaday Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza. Sidoo kale, xukuumadda Hargeysa ayaa ka codsatay saaxibada caalamka in Dowladda Federaalka ay kala hadlaan inay ka waantowdo falalka hurinta ah. “Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxay ugu baaqaysaa Midawga Afrika, IGAD, Qarammada Midoobay iyo dhammaan saaxiibbada caalamka inay si cad uga soo horjeeddo tallaabooyinkan kicinta ah, isla markaana ay dawladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ku boorriyaan inay ka waantowdo falalka sii hurinaya xiisadaha gobolka,” ayuu ku sii daray warsaxaafadeedka. Ugu dambeyn Somaliland ayaa xaqiijisay inay u taagan tahay nabad, xasillooni, wada-noolaansho iyo wada-jir ku dhisan is-ixtiraam. hase yeeshee waxa ay sheegtay in ay si buuxda u adeegsan doonto dhammaan tallaabooyinka sharci iyo qarannimo ee lagama maarmaanka u ah difaaca madax-bannaanideeda, amnigeeda iyo midnimada dhulkeeda. Somaliland ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in ay booqashada Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ee magaaladaas u aragto daandaansi iyo xadgudub ka dhan ah waxa ay ku tilmaantay madax-bannaanideeda. Maamulka Somaliland ayaa sheegay in booqashadu ay sii hurin karto xiisadda siyaasadeed, isla markaana ay ka digayaan tallaabo kasta oo keeni karta amni-darro ama qalalaase horleh. “Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa ay si adag u cambaaraynaysaa socdaalka daandaansiga ah ee ra’iisul wasaaraha dawladda federaalka Soomaaliya, ku yimid qaybo ka mid ah bariga gobolka Sool,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu yiri qoraalka: “Tallaabadani waxay hordhac u tahay hurin colaadeed iyo muran siyaasadeed oo aan geedna loogu soo gabban, waana ku-xad-gudub madaxbannaanida dhuleed iyo jiritaanka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, sidoo kalena waa ficil sii hurinaya colaadda, khalkhal na gelinaya amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka.” Nabadda gobolka Sool Somaliland waxay bayaankeeda ku xustay in booqashada Ra’iisul wasaaraha Soomaaliya ku joogo Laascaanood ay wiiqayso dadaallada saaxibada caalamiga ee ku aadan sidii xasillooni loogu soo dabaali lahaa gobolka. Waxaa kale oo ay intaas ku dartay in itallaabada uu qaaday Ra’iisul wasaaraha ay tahay mid mas’uuliyad darro ah, sida lagu caddeeyay qiraalka. “Xukuumadda JSL waxa ay si cad u sheegaysaa in falalkan masuuliyad-darrada ahi iyo socdaalladan aan micnaha ku fadhiyini aanay waxba ku soo kordhinayn nabadda gobolka, balse ay si toos ah u wiiqayaan dedaallada dunidu ku doonayso xasillooni waarta iyo nabadgelyo gobolka ka hanaqaadda,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Cabashada Somaliland Somaliland ayaa dhanka kale farriin dacwo ah u dirtay beesha caalamka, Midowga Afrika, IGAD iyo Qaramada Midoobay, iyada oo ku wargelisay in ay si weyn uga soo horjeedo tallaabooyinka uu qaaday Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza. Sidoo kale, xukuumadda Hargeysa ayaa ka codsatay saaxibada caalamka in Dowladda Federaalka ay kala hadlaan inay ka waantowdo falalka hurinta ah. “Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxay ugu baaqaysaa Midawga Afrika, IGAD, Qarammada Midoobay iyo dhammaan saaxiibbada caalamka inay si cad uga soo horjeeddo tallaabooyinkan kicinta ah, isla markaana ay dawladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ku boorriyaan inay ka waantowdo falalka sii hurinaya xiisadaha gobolka,” ayuu ku sii daray warsaxaafadeedka. Ugu dambeyn Somaliland ayaa xaqiijisay inay u taagan tahay nabad, xasillooni, wada-noolaansho iyo wada-jir ku dhisan is-ixtiraam. hase yeeshee waxa ay sheegtay in ay si buuxda u adeegsan doonto dhammaan tallaabooyinka sharci iyo qarannimo ee lagama maarmaanka u ah difaaca madax-bannaanideeda, amnigeeda iyo midnimada dhulkeeda. items.title: Arsenal oo dardargelinaysa baacsiga Vinícius Júnior
items.description: By Saleeymaan Alcadaala Sports Reporter, Radio Dalsan TV Arsenal ayaa si weyn u kordhisay dadaalkeeda ku aaddan saxiixa xiddiga garabka ee Real Madrid , Vinícius Júnior , iyadoo tababare Mikel Arteta uu si shakhsi ah u hoggaaminayo qorshaha lagu doonayo in lagu keeno Emirates Stadium. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Gunners ay diyaar u yihiin inay sameeyaan maalgelintii ugu weyneyd taariikhda kooxda si ay u soo xero geliyaan xiddiga reer Brazil, haddii uu fashilmo heshiis kordhinta qandaraaskiisa ee Real Madrid . Xiisaha Arsenal ayaa soo kordhay iyadoo Vinícius, oo 26 jir ah uu galayay sannadkii ugu dambeeyay ee qandaraaskiisa Real Madrid. Wada-hadallada kordhinta heshiiska ayaa muddo 18 bilood ah socday, waxayna istaageen meel adag, iyadoo uu doonayo mushahar dhan 30 milyan oo Yuuro oo saafiya sannadkii (€550,000 usbuucii) . Haday heshiis la gaari waayaan Real Madrid waxay isku qabtaa inay iibiso xiddigeeda halkii ay ku lumin lahayd lacag la’aan xagaaga dambe, taasoo albaab u furtay Arsenal . Tababare Arteta oo xilli ciyaareedkii hore ku guulaystay horyaalka Premier League ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu yahay mid firfircoon oo uu doonayo inuu sii wado horumarinta kooxda, isagoona sheegay: “Waan firfircoon nahay waxaanan dooneynaa inaan horumarinno oo aan kobcino kooxda. Waxaan rajeyneynaa inaan soo kordhinno maalmaha soo socda” . Go’aankii ay Real Madrid ku bedeshay kala iibsiga xiddiga Yan Diomande ayaa sidoo kale loo arkay inuu yahay calaamad muujinaysa in Vinícius uu bixi karo . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa jira caqabado weyn oo dhinaca lacagta ah. Arsenal waxay u baahan doontaa inay bixiso qiimo aad u sarreeya oo la sheegay inuu dhowaado €150 milyan iyo sidoo kale inay daboolaan mushaharkiisa aadka u sarreeya. Waxaa la rumeysan yahay in Arsenal ay awood u leedahay inay heshiiskan ku dhammeystirto waxaana jira kalsooni ka dhex jirta gudaha kooxda in Vinícius uu aqbali doono inuu ku biiro . Laakiin hadda wax walba waxay ku xiran yihiin sida ay u dhammaadaan wada-hadallada u dhexeeya Vinícius iyo Real Madrid ee ku saabsan heshiiska cusub. items.title: In ku dhow 20 qof oo duqeyn lagu dilay magaalada Gasa
items.description: Falastiin ( Raxanreeb Online) Sideed iyo toban qof oo ay ku jiraan carruur dhowr ah, ayaa lagu dilay duqeymihii ugu dambeeyay ee ka dhacay Gaza, sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha Falastiiniyiinta. Hay’adda Difaaca Rayidka ee Gaza ayaa sheegtay in diyaaradaha milatariga Israa’iil ay weerarro ka fuliyeen Magaalada Gaza, Khan Younis iyo Deir el-Balah. Tani waxay ahayd habeenkii labaad oo xiriir ah oo ay Israa’iil duqeymo ka fulisay dhulka Gaza. Waxay timid maalmo kadib markii Xamaas ay aqbashay qorshe hub-ka-dhigis ah, kaas oo dhigaya in kooxda Falastiiniyiinta ay hubkooda ku wareejiyaan Guddiga Nabadda ee uu sameeyay Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump. Afhayeen u hadlay Ciidamada Difaaca Israa’iil (IDF) ayaa sheegay in ciidamadu ay bartilmaameedsanayeen xubno militari oo ka tirsan Gaza, isla markaana laba dagaalyahan oo Xamaas ah la dilay. Wasiirka Tamarta ee Israa’iil, Eli Cohen, ayaa Axaddii sheegay in aan wax heshiis ah laga gaarin joojinta weerarrada lagu hayo Marinka Gaza, oo hadda in ka badan 70% ay Israa’iil maamusho. The post In ku dhow 20 qof oo duqeyn lagu dilay magaalada Gasa appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Bruno Guimarães Oo Qarka U Saaran Arsenal
items.description: By Saleeymaan Alcadaala Sports Reporter, Radio Dalsan TV Arsenal ayaa si weyn ugu dhowdahay saxiixa khadka dhexe ee Newcastle United , Bruno Guimarães , kaddib markii wariyaha caanka ah ee suuqa kala iibsiga, Fabrizio Romano, uu shaaca ka qaaday in Newcastle ay aqbashay bixitaanka xiddiga reer Brazil. Kooxda Mikel Arteta ayaa xagaagan diiradda saartay sidii ay u xoojin lahayd khadka dhexe iyadoo Bruno Guimarães loo arko bartilmaameedka koowaad ee Arsenal . Wareeggani ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada mowqifkii adkaa ee Newcastle, kuwaas oo bilihii May, Juun iyo Luulyo si adag u diiday inay iibiyaan kabtankooda . Sida uu sheegay Fabrizio Romano mowqifkii adkaa ee Newcastle ayaa hadda si weyn isu beddelay iyadoo labada kooxood ay hadda si toos ah uga wada-hadlayaan qiimaha heshiiska . Saxaafadda ayaa sheegaysa in Arsenal ay heshiis ku dhowdahay bixinta lacag dhan £70 milyan oo rasmi ah iyo £10 milyan oo gunnooyin (add-ons) ah taasoo noqonaysa wadarta £80 milyan . Waxaa la sheegay in Bruno uu balan qaaday inuu saxiixi doono qandaraas shan sano ah waxaana la filayaa inuu London ku sameeyo tijaabada caafimaadka maalmaha soo socda . Tababare Mikel Arteta ayaa doonaya inuu sii xoojiyo safkiisa dhexe si uu u helo tartan adag oo u dhexeeya Martin Zubimendi , Declan Rice iyo Bruno Guimarães . Arsenal waxay rumeysan tahay in Bruno uu kooxda ku soo kordhin karo tayo, khibrad iyo degganaansho gaar ahaan xilli ciyaareed ay kooxda difaacaneyso horyaalka Premier League isla markaana ay hiigsaneyso guulo waaweyn oo Yurub ah.   The post Bruno Guimarães Oo Qarka U Saaran Arsenal first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Sacuudiga Oo Hoggaaminaya Isbahaysi Ka Kooban 14 Dal Oo Lagu Sugayo Amniga Badda Cas Iyo Bab al-Mandeb
items.description: Sacuudiga ayaa ku dhawaaqay dhismaha isbahaysi difaac oo caalami ah oo lagu xoojinayo amniga Badda Cas, marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in la ilaaliyo maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo kuwa shidaalka ee mara marinnadaas muhiimka ah. Tallaabadan ayaa timid kadib markii ay sii kordheen weerarrada kooxda Xuuthiyiinta ee Yemen ku bartilmaameedsanayaan maraakiibta, taasoo sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo ammaanka ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Shir lagu qabtay magaalada Riyadh oo ay ka qeyb galeen wakiillo ka socday 43 dal iyo Midowga Yurub ayaa lagu soo bandhigay qorshaha isbahaysigan cusub. Dowladda Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay inay hoggaamin doonto isbahaysiga, isla markaana xaruntiisa laga dhisi doono gudaha boqortooyada. Ilaa hadda, 14 dal ayaa si rasmi ah u taageeray qorshahan, waxaana ka mid ah Masar, Turkiga, Pakistan, Suudaan iyo Jabuuti, iyadoo albaabku u furan yahay dalal kale oo doonaya inay ku biiraan. Isbahaysiga ayaa diiradda saari doona ilaalinta xorriyadda isu socodka maraakiibta, sugidda marinnada ganacsiga iyo tamarta, wadaagga xogaha sirdoonka, iyo isku-dubaridka howlaha ciidamada badda ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah. Waxaa sidoo kale la qorsheynayaa in la kordhiyo roondooyinka badda iyo awoodda lagu wajahayo weerarrada gantaallada, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo doomaha qaraxyada ee khatarta ku haya maraakiibta. Go’aankan ayaa yimid kadib markii kooxda Xuuthiyiinta, oo ay taageerto Iiraan, ay kordhiyeen weerarrada ay ku hayaan maraakiibta maraya Badda Cas iyo Bab al-Mandab, isla markaana ay ku dhawaaqeen cunaqabatayn dhinaca badda ah oo ka dhan ah maraakiibta la xiriira Sacuudiga. Weeraradan ayaa saameyn ku yeeshay isu socodka ganacsiga caalamiga ah, iyadoo shirkado badan oo maraakiibta leh ay ku qasbanaadeen inay maraakiibtooda u leexiyaan marinno kale oo dheer, taasoo kordhisay kharashaadka iyo waqtiga safarka. Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab ayaa ka mid ah meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee ganacsiga dunida, waxaana halkaas mara qayb weyn oo ka mid ah shidaalka iyo badeecadaha u kala goosha Yurub, Aasiya iyo Afrika. Sidaa darteed, khalkhal kasta oo ka dhaca marinkan wuxuu saameyn toos ah ku yeelan karaa qiimaha shidaalka, ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo dhaqaalaha dunida. Khubarada amniga ayaa aaminsan in isbahaysigan cusub uu xoojin karo amniga Badda Cas isla markaana uu yareyn karo khatarta weerarrada lagu hayo maraakiibta. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa jira walaac ah in tallaabadan ay sii hurin karto xiisadda u dhexeysa Sacuudiga iyo Xuuthiyiinta, isla markaana ay saameyn ku yeelan karto xiriirka gobolka iyadoo colaadaha Bariga Dhexe ay weli taagan yihiin.

items.title: Armenia Should Recognize Somaliland
items.description: Not only has Somaliland held eight elections, but it became the first country in the world to secure voter registration with biometric iris scans. Somalia, meanwhile, has squandered ore than $2 billion in international election assistance but has yet to hold a single direct election or accept universal suffrage. Hargeisa, Somaliland — Somalilanders identify with Armenians for multiple reasons. Just as the Armenian Genocide left an indelible imprint on Armenian culture and identity, so too did the Isaaq Genocide transform Somaliland’s identity. For Somalilanders, Cold War-era Somali dictator Mohamed Siad Barre systematic slaughter of an estimated 200,000 members of the Isaaq clan, the Somali clan that predominates in the former British Somaliland, remains living memory. Somalilanders, like Armenians, are resilient. Just as the Soviet Union interrupted Armenia’s independence, proponents of a Greater Somalia ended Somaliland’s brief independence in 1960. Somaliland’s marriage with Somalia was unhappy. When the Somali National Movement forced Siad Barre into exile, Somalia collapsed and famine raged. In December 1992, President George H.W. Bush deployed around 11,000 troops into the country to distribute aid and forestall humanitarian disaster. It was a disastrous operation which culminated in the “Black Hawk Dawn” episode in which 18 Americans died with Somalis dragging their corpses through the streets. Not all of Somalia descended into state failure and warlordism, however. Somaliland’s elders, businessmen, and intellectuals saw the Somali collapse and forged a compact that transformed reassert its independence. While, unlike with the Armenian case, the international community refused to recognize the restoration of Somaliland’s independence, Somalilanders did not stand on ceremony: They rebuilt their country without significant aid or assistance and built the Horn of Africa’s most thriving democracy. Not only has Somaliland held eight elections, but it became the first country in the world to secure voter registration with biometric iris scans. Somalia, meanwhile, has squandered ore than $2 billion in international election assistance but has yet to hold a single direct election or accept universal suffrage. Somaliland and Armenia likewise have transformed a disadvantageous economic hand into a winning deal. While Armenia had its agriculture and Somaliland had its livestock, both invested heavily in the tech sector. More than 99 percent of all Somaliland businesses accept mobile money, and over 80 percent of commercial transactions are electronic. Even street beggars carry signs with their Zaad account code rather than take cash. To walk into the multibillion-dollar Telesom control room is like walking into NASA. Both countries have also prioritized education. When orphans, war refugees, and shepherds matriculate through Somaliland’s Abaarso school network, they win scholarships to universities such as Yale, Harvard, and CalTech; several have gone from abject poverty to STEM Ph.D’s in global top ten programs and then returned to their country to help it build. Simply put, Somaliland centers increasingly have the same vibe as Yerevan’s TUMO Center for Creative Technologies. Unfortunately, both Armenia and Somaliland also share the same adversaries. Turkey both continues its illegal blockade of Armenia’s border while Turkish Special Forces supply and encourage Azerbaijani aggression and encroachment on sovereign Armenian territory. Simultaneously, Turkey has moved to undermine Somaliland, encouraging a Somali-backed insurgency in southeastern Somaliland, sending drones and even F-16s to Mogadishu, and challenging Somaliland’s control over its territorial waters. Armenian diplomacy is often cautious; Armenians diplomats appear to favor reaction to proactivity and ignore opportunities beyond their region or traditional partners. That should change. While only Taiwan and Israel formally recognize Somaliland, many other countries — Denmark, the United Kingdom, Kenya, and Ethiopia, for example — have officers or consulates in the country’s capital Hargeisa. If Armenia joined them, it would solidify an alliance of small-state democracies facing a common adversary.

items.title: Iiraan oo sheegtay inay wada-hadal kula jirin Mareykanka
items.description: Dowladda Iiraan ayaa sheegtay in aysan xilligan wax wada-hadal ah kula jirin Mareykanka, iyadoo meesha ka saartay warar sheegayay in labada dal ay dib u billaabayaan wada-xaajoodyo. Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan, Esmaeil Baghaei, ayaa sheegay in wada-hadallada keliya ee socda ay la leeyihiin dowladda Cumaan, isla markaana ay diiradda saarayaan arrimaha marinka istaraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz. Baghaei wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in wada-xaajoodyadan aysan wax xiriir ah la lahayn Mareykanka, balse ay yihiin wada-hadallo laba geesood ah oo u dhexeeya Tehraan iyo Muscat, kuwaas oo looga hadlayo habraacyada maraakiibta uga gudbi kara marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Hadalka Iiraan ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump uu sheegay in wareeg cusub oo wada-hadallo ah uu la bilaaban doono Iiraan gelinka dambe ee Isniinta maanta ah , arrintaas oo Tehraan ay si cad u beenisay.
