items.title: The Kampala Summit Raises the Question: Who Secured Mogadishu?
items.description: By Isha Qarsoon When President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, his ministers, or his supporters are confronted with the government’s failure to provide basic public services, they return to one answer: it made Mogadishu safer. They point to the contrast with the capital in 2000 or 2010. Mogadishu is calmer, more functional, and more stable than it was during the worst years of the conflict. From that improvement they draw a broader political conclusion: whatever the government’s failures elsewhere, it restored order and built the security system that now protects the capital. The comparison establishes that Mogadishu changed. It does not establish who secured the city, who sustained that security, or whether the Federal Government can preserve it without foreign forces. For nearly two decades, a foreign-financed and foreign-led military coalition has defended Mogadishu and supported the wider security architecture around it. The Kampala summit that concluded on 31 July was convened to address the future of that coalition’s funding. Instead, it forced Somali officials to confront the premise beneath their own political rhetoric. When asked, in effect, what would happen if the foreign structure disappeared, they did not answer that Somalia could now manage without it. They asked for more time, continued logistical support, and a gradual withdrawal to prevent a security vacuum. That response is the admission. In political terms, Kampala may be the emperor-has-no-clothes moment for the government’s claim that it secured Mogadishu. The claim rests on the image of a state that has already built the capacity to protect the capital. The government’s own case in Kampala was that this capacity is still being built. On 1 July 2026, the United States informed the African Union that it would not support renewal of AUSSOM’s mandate in December if the mission continued to depend on funding and logistics supplied through the United Nations Support Office in Somalia, UNSOS. For years, UNSOS has kept roughly 12,000 African Union troops supplied, transported, medically supported, and operational. Without that system, AUSSOM cannot continue in its present form. This is not a quarrel over accounting. It is a threat to the mechanism that has underwritten security in Mogadishu since 2007. Two convenient stories now compete. One predicts immediate collapse once AUSSOM leaves. The other insists that the Somali National Army is already capable of taking over and that foreign support merely postpones a transition that is otherwise complete. Neither proposition has been tested. The foreign military presence has never been removed long enough to show what the Somali state can sustain on its own. That avoidance has a long history. AMISOM’s drawdown schedules, and ATMIS’s phased handovers were delayed, revised, or extended rather than completed. Somali leaders preferred the political credit that came with visible improvements in the capital. Foreign partners preferred the predictability of extending an unfinished arrangement. What makes 2026 different is that the money sustaining that compromise may no longer be available. The clearest evidence of who secured Mogadishu comes from the Somali government itself. Speaking at the Kampala summit in late July, State Minister for Foreign Affairs Ali Balcad said Somali forces now lead operations against Al-Shabaab while AUSSOM troops remain at key bases providing security and operational support. He expressed confidence in the national forces, but added that AUSSOM remained important during the transition while Somalia’s full security capacity was being built. The decisive words are being built. Not built. Being built. Nineteen years after the African Union mission first deployed, the government’s own description is that full national capacity remains unfinished. Ali Balcad did not ask AUSSOM to depart because its work was complete. He proposed an eighteen-month to two-year phased withdrawal, with bases transferred gradually to avoid a security vacuum. That is not a minor qualification to the government’s political claim. It goes to the claim’s foundation. A government that has already secured Mogadishu should not need another two years of foreign support to determine whether it can keep the city secure. The simplest test remains the most revealing. If the government’s account is correct, it should be able to identify a short and definite timetable under which Somali forces will assume responsibility for every base, position, and function now held by AUSSOM. No senior official has done so. The request is always for more time, more financing, or a longer transition. That is not the language of a state declining assistance it no longer needs. It is the language of a state that fears what the withdrawal of that assistance may expose. AUSSOM’s Head of Mission made essentially the same point. Addressing the African Union Commission, he said the American funding decision had underscored the need for Somalia to assume greater responsibility for its own security. The statement did not confirm that Somalia had achieved self-sufficiency. It emphasized that Somalia still needed to reach it. President Mohamud made the more politically important admission. Addressing the Heads of State session in Entebbe, he thanked the troop-contributing countries and said the AU mission had been vital in degrading Al-Shabaab, expanding humanitarian access, training Somali forces, and saving countless lives. The verbs matter because they assign responsibility. The mission degraded Al-Shabaab. The mission expanded humanitarian access. The mission trained Somali forces. The mission saved lives. In Kampala, the president himself credited the foreign mission with the work that his supporters routinely present at home as proof of his government’s success. Gratitude to allies is not, by itself, a concession. But this was more than ceremonial praise. The government was trying to persuade foreign states to preserve the system on which its security claim depends. It therefore described that system honestly enough to reveal the contradiction. At home, the administration claims political credit for securing Mogadishu. Abroad, it argues that the forces, financing, logistics, and bases that made the achievement possible remain indispensable. The dispute over political legitimacy makes the contradiction more consequential. Five days before the Kampala meeting, the Somali Future Council, which includes a former president, former prime ministers, and other political leaders, wrote to the leaders of the troop-contributing countries. It argued that President Mohamud’s constitutional mandate expired on 15 May 2026 and asked those governments to recognize that Somalia lacks an agreed framework for political leadership and succession. HSM’s supporters often answer such objections with an appeal to performance. Whatever the constitutional dispute, they imply, the government should be judged by the order it restored and the security it delivered in Mogadishu. That defense becomes much weaker if the administration cannot show that it created, controls, or can independently maintain the system for which it claims credit. The same government facing a challenge to the constitutional basis of its authority is asking for another eighteen months to two years to complete the security capacity that supposedly demonstrates its effectiveness. The Somali National Army is regularly offered as proof that the transition is already far advanced. On paper, the force numbers roughly 32,000 personnel. Independent assessments place the realistically deployable number much lower, closer to 19,000, citing uneven training, clan-based recruitment, and continuing Al-Shabaab infiltration. In November, the Chief of Defence Forces told Parliament that between ten and fifteen thousand soldiers had been killed or wounded during the previous three years. Those figures describe a force under severe and sustained pressure, not one plainly ready to replace the external military and logistical system on which current operations depend. The political setting has also deteriorated. Constitutional amendments extending presidential and parliamentary terms, adopted in March without agreement from the opposition or all federal member states, deepened political divisions at precisely the moment a successful security handover would require broader national cohesion. A national army cannot easily hold the country together when major parts of the political system dispute the authority directing it. The immediate risk should therefore be stated without exaggeration. If AUSSOM’s logistical network begins to fail and the mission reduces its presence before Somali forces can replace it, the first losses may not occur in Mogadishu. They are more likely to appear in towns and district capitals that have depended on African Union deployments for years. Foreign forces occupied and defended those locations because the Somali state had not yet developed the independent capacity to govern and protect them. Mogadishu will probably be the last place where the consequences become visible. It is the political center, the principal destination for whatever international support remains, and the most heavily defended part of the country. It may also be the last place where the government admits that the transition has failed. Some analysts believe Al-Shabaab’s eventual capture of the capital, through force or negotiation, is only a matter of time. That conclusion may be wrong. But it does not arise from fantasy. It follows from the vulnerability of any security system that depends heavily on external personnel, financing, and logistics when that support begins to disappear. The present moment is significant not because the dependency has suddenly been discovered. It has been visible for years. What has changed is that the principal financing mechanism now faces a serious threat. A claim long protected from testing may finally have to be proved. For nineteen years, that test was postponed. Donors preferred the stability produced by an incomplete transition. Somali leaders preferred to claim the political benefits of success before they possessed the institutions needed to sustain it. Each side had reason to treat an unverified outcome as an established achievement. The Federal Government could make a credible case without denying this reality. It could acknowledge that Somalia has made substantial progress but still lacks the institutions, logistics, command systems, and military capacity needed to secure the country without foreign assistance. It could request a defined period in which to complete that work and explain that an abrupt withdrawal would create a vacuum that existing institutions cannot yet fill. Such candor might persuade skeptical legislators in Washington or increasingly reluctant voters in Europe. Instead, officials and supporters return to the same political claim: Mogadishu is secure. Look at 2000. Look at 2010. The comparison is true, but it does not answer the charge. The question is not whether Mogadishu improved. It is who produced that improvement, which institutions still sustain it, and whether the Federal Government can preserve it once external support declines. Kampala brought the government’s boast and its admission into the same record. The domestic boast is that HSM’s government secured Mogadishu. The admission in Kampala is that foreign assistance remains vital, full Somali capacity is still being built, and withdrawal must be delayed and carefully managed to avoid a vacuum. The administration cannot rely on the first proposition for political credit while treating the second as an incidental detail. The summit closed on 31 July with familiar language. Uganda reaffirmed its commitment to Somalia’s path toward peace, stability, and self-reliance. Participants called for stronger regional cooperation, sustainable financing, and a comprehensive approach to Somalia’s security challenges. Yet the central problem remained unresolved. A meeting prompted by disappearing funds ended with an acknowledgment, expressed in diplomatic terms, that the foreign-funded system is still needed. So who secured Mogadishu? Not the Federal Government acting alone. AUSSOM and the missions that preceded it played the decisive role, at enormous financial and human cost. Somali officials acknowledged as much in Kampala. They did not argue that the mission had become unnecessary. They argued that Somalia still needed time before it could function without it. The financing that sustained the arrangement is now uncertain. Whether the Federal Government can do what HSM and his supporters have long claimed it already did is no longer an abstract argument. It is becoming a practical test, and the government may no longer be able to postpone the answer. items.title: “Wax Gargaar Dibaddeed Ah Uma Baahnin”- Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (WDN) – Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Soomaaliya, Saalax Axmed Jaamac, ayaa hadal jeedin ka fog xaqiiqda ka jirta dalka sheegay , isagoo tilmaamay in Soomaaliya ay ka gudubtay ku tiirsanaantii gargaarka dibadda, arrintaas oo si weyn uga yaabisay bulshada Soomaaliyeed iyo falanqeeyayaasha siyaasadda. Hadalkiisa ayaa dhaliyay dood ballaaran, iyadoo dad badan ay isweydiinayaan sida dal muddo ka badan 30 sano si weyn ugu tiirsanaa taageerada caalamka xag dhaqaale, amni ahaan iyo hay’ad dhis ahaan uu hal mar isu sheegi karo inuu yahay dal isku filan. Hadalka Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka ayaa kusoo beegmay xilli Soomaaliya wajahaysa caqabado siyaasadeed iyo amni oo culus. Dalku weli wuxuu si weyn ugu tiirsan yahay deeqaha caalamiga ah ee lagu maalgeliyo miisaaniyadda dowladda, adeegyada bani’aadannimada, tababarka iyo qalabaynta ciidamada, iyo sidoo kale howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Dhanka kale, khilaafka siyaasaddeed ee u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo mucaaradka ayaa weli taagan, iyadoo aan ilaa hadda laga gaarin heshiis ku saabsan doorashooyinka iyo sharciyadda hay’addaha dowladda. Haddaba, su’aasha ay dad badani isweydiinayaan ayaa ah mid fudud: Soomaaliya ma dhab ahaantii waxay gaartay heer ay isku filnaato, mise wali waa yool fog oo u baahan sannado badan oo dib-u-dhis, xasillooni siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale? items.title: ‘We No Longer Need Foreign Aid’: Somali Deputy Prime Minister’s Stunning Claim
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) –Somalia’s Deputy Prime Minister, Salah Ahmed Jama, has sparked widespread surprise and disbelief after declaring what many have described as performative politics, that the country has moved beyond its dependence on foreign assistance—a statement that many Somalis say bears little resemblance to the country’s current political and economic realities. His remarks have generated intense debate across political and public circles, with many questioning how a nation that has relied heavily on international financial and security assistance for more than three decades could suddenly describe itself as self-sufficient. The comments come at a particularly delicate moment. Somalia remains deeply dependent on foreign donors to finance its budget, support humanitarian programs, train and equip its security forces, and sustain the African Union peace support mission. At the same time, the country continues to face a prolonged political crisis, with negotiations between the Federal Government and opposition groups remaining deadlocked amid disputes over elections and constitutional legitimacy. The Deputy Prime Minister’s statement also coincides with one of the most significant challenges facing Somalia’s security sector. The United States has confirmed that it will end its logistical support for approximately 23,000 African Union peacekeepers serving under AUSSOM at the end of this year. In response, the African Union and troop-contributing countries have launched an urgent search for alternative funding from the European Union, the United Nations, and other international partners to prevent the mission from facing a financial crisis. Security analysts have repeatedly warned that Somalia’s security forces are still undergoing development and may not yet be fully prepared to independently assume nationwide security responsibilities should international support decline significantly. The Deputy Prime Minister’s remarks surprised many observers. “We are now a self-sufficient nation in every respect. We have moved beyond dependence on assistance from the international community and the United States,” Salah Ahmed Jama declared. He made the comments while addressing the launch of a strategy meeting for Somalia’s National Trade Facilitation Committee (NTFC), where he emphasized the government’s plans to expand trade and integrate Somali products into markets across the East African Community and beyond. According to the Deputy Prime Minister, Somalia is pursuing a comprehensive economic strategy designed to strengthen domestic production, expand exports, and reduce long-term reliance on foreign support. Few Somalis would disagree with the aspiration. For decades, many citizens have hoped to see their country regain genuine economic independence, build sustainable institutions, and free itself from the cycle of international aid that has often been accompanied by significant external influence over domestic affairs. Yet many economists and political observers argue that aspiration should not be confused with current reality. Somalia continues to depend extensively on international partners for budgetary assistance, security financing, humanitarian relief, infrastructure development, and institutional support. Much of the country’s public sector—including significant portions of its security architecture—remains closely linked to donor funding. Critics viewed the Deputy Prime Minister’s declaration as strikingly detached from the realities confronting the country. Some commentators who spoke to WardheerNews, remarked that such a claim would be difficult to reconcile even with publicly available government financial data, while others described the statement as unusually optimistic at a time when Somalia faces mounting uncertainty over both its political future and the sustainability of international security assistance. Whether the remarks reflected confidence in Somalia’s long-term economic ambitions, performative politics or an overly ambitious assessment of its current position, they have undoubtedly become one of the most talked-about political statements of the week. For many Somalis, the desire for genuine self-reliance remains unquestioned. The debate, however, centers on a simpler question: Has Somalia already reached that destination—or is it still a long way from getting there? items.description: Boosaaso (Raxanreeb Online) Magaalada Boosaaso ee xarunta ganacsiga Puntland, waxaa maanta kulan ku yeeshay madaxweynaha dowlad goboleedka Puntland Siciid Deni iyo Dowladda Mareykanka, gaar ahaan hawlgalka AFRICOM oo uu hogaaminayey Taliyaha hawlgalka gaarka ah ee AFRICOM Major Gen Claude Tudor. items.title: AFRICOM Chief Voices Frustration as Al-Shabaab Reclaims Liberated Areas, Warns Military Victories Are Being Squandered
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN ) – The commander of U.S. Africa Command (AFRICOM), General Dagvin R.M. Anderson, in an interview with journalist Omar Faruk, has delivered one of the clearest expressions yet of American frustration over Somalia’s counterterrorism campaign, lamenting that Somali and international forces have repeatedly been forced to recapture territory they had already liberated years ago. His remarks underscore growing concerns within Washington that hard-won battlefield gains have too often been undermined by weak governance, inadequate stabilization efforts, and poor post-conflict planning—allowing Al-Shabaab to return to areas where it had previously been driven out. General Anderson recalled that between 2019 and 2021, U.S. forces, the Somali National Army, and the elite Danab Special Forces achieved significant successes along the Shabelle River corridor, liberating a number of strategic communities, including Mubaarak. Yet those gains ultimately proved temporary. According to Anderson, many of the same areas later fell back under Al-Shabaab control, forcing Somali forces and their international partners to launch fresh military operations this year to recapture territory that had already been secured at considerable human and financial cost. His comments reflected more than military disappointment. They highlighted a recurring pattern that has plagued Somalia’s counterinsurgency campaign for years: battlefield victories followed by governance failures that create the conditions for Al-Shabaab’s return. “The liberation of territory alone is not enough,” Anderson emphasized, arguing that once military operations conclude, the Somali government must rapidly establish functioning local administrations, provide justice, restore public services, and deploy security forces capable of protecting liberated communities. Without those essential follow-up measures, he warned, military victories cannot endure. The AFRICOM commander’s remarks echo a long-standing concern among many international security analysts who argue that Al-Shabaab’s resilience stems not only from its military capabilities but also from the state’s inability to consolidate gains after successful offensives. In numerous previously liberated areas, delayed government services, limited security presence, and administrative weaknesses have allowed the militant group to quietly rebuild its networks, intimidate local populations, and eventually regain control. The consequences have been costly. Repeated withdrawals from liberated areas have enabled Al-Shabaab not only to re-establish its influence but, on several occasions in recent years, to seize large quantities of military equipment abandoned or captured from Somali security forces during poorly coordinated withdrawals and battlefield setbacks. The loss of weapons, vehicles, ammunition, and other military equipment has strengthened the group’s operational capabilities while raising broader questions about planning, logistics, and force protection during Somali military operations. General Anderson also issued a carefully worded warning regarding future American assistance. He said continued U.S. support would increasingly depend on measurable progress in Somalia’s campaign against Al-Shabaab and on the effective use of resources provided by international partners. If counterterrorism resources are diverted from their intended purpose or fail to produce sustainable results, he suggested, it would become increasingly difficult for Washington to justify maintaining its current level of military support. The comments reflect growing expectations among Somalia’s international partners that military operations must be accompanied by stronger governance, greater accountability, and effective stabilization policies if long-term security gains are to be achieved. Despite expressing disappointment over the loss of previously liberated territory, Anderson praised the elite Danab Special Forces, describing them as among the best-trained military units on the African continent. He noted that the United States has largely completed its primary mission of developing the force and stressed that responsibility now rests with the Somali government to adequately fund, sustain, equip, and further strengthen Danab’s operational capabilities. His remarks come as Somali government forces and the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission continue military operations against Al-Shabaab across southern and central Somalia, supported by ongoing U.S. airstrikes targeting militant positions. The broader message from AFRICOM was unmistakable. Military offensives alone cannot defeat Al-Shabaab. Lasting success depends on what follows after the fighting ends. Unless liberated areas are quickly stabilized through effective governance, reliable security, functioning public institutions, and sustained state presence, the sacrifices made on the battlefield risk being repeated—and Somalia’s international partners may become increasingly reluctant to continue investing in a cycle of liberation followed by renewed militant resurgence. His remarks come as Somali government forces and the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission continue military operations against Al-Shabaab across southern and central Somalia, supported by ongoing U.S. airstrikes targeting militant positions. The broader message from AFRICOM was unmistakable. Military offensives alone cannot defeat Al-Shabaab. Lasting success depends on what follows after the fighting ends. Unless liberated areas are quickly stabilized through effective governance, reliable security, functioning public institutions, and sustained state presence, the sacrifices made on the battlefield risk being repeated—and Somalia’s international partners may become increasingly reluctant to continue investing in a cycle of liberation followed by renewed militant resurgence. items.title: Prime Minister’s Las Anod Visit Sparks Speculation as Federal Government Announces Revival of Historic 26th Military Command
items.description: Lasanod (WDN) – Somalia’s Federal Government has announced plans to revive the 26th Command of the Somali National Army (SNA), a military formation that disappeared with the collapse of the Somali state more than three decades ago. Yet despite the symbolic significance of the announcement, many political observers in Las Anod believe the military initiative is little more than a distraction from the real purpose of Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre’s latest visit. According to widespread local opinion, the Prime Minister’s trip is primarily aimed at addressing the politically sensitive issue of Somaliland prisoners of war still being held following the conflict over Las Anod, rather than launching a major restructuring of Somalia’s military command. The Federal Government has presented the reactivation of the 26th Command, to be headquartered in Las Anod, as part of its broader effort to rebuild the Somali National Army’s historic command structure and strengthen its security presence in northern Somalia. Advance units of the Somali National Army arrived in Las Anod ahead of the Prime Minister’s visit, where he is expected to formally inaugurate the Northern Regions Command. Before the collapse of Somalia’s central government in 1991, the 26th Military Command was headquartered in Hargeisa and served as one of the country’s principal regional military commands. Only weeks earlier, the Federal Government also announced the reactivation of the 54th Command, headquartered in Garowe, describing both initiatives as part of a nationwide effort to modernize command and control within the Somali National Army. However, the announcement has been met with considerable skepticism in North Eastern State. Many local politicians and residents question whether the creation of another military command can be regarded as a meaningful achievement when, they argue, the Federal Government has yet to provide the region with tangible institutional support since recognizing the new administration. Critics point out that North Eastern State has received no meaningful federal development projects, no direct budgetary support, and no financial assistance to pay its own security forces, despite repeated appeals from the regional leadership. Some observers argue that discussions surrounding the revival of the 26th Command amount to little more than a political smoke screen designed to project federal engagement while avoiding more pressing issues facing the administration. “The region doesn’t need another military headquarters on paper,” one political observer told WardheerNews. “It needs functioning institutions, development funding, and support for the security forces already maintaining stability on the ground.” Prime Minister Hamza arrived in Las Anod on Sunday to a warm public reception, marking his third visit to the city. Speaking shortly after his arrival, he said he had come to participate in celebrations marking the first anniversary of the establishment of North Eastern State. “I am delighted to return for the third time to the capital of Somali unity, Las Anod,” the Prime Minister said. “I have come to celebrate this anniversary with you. I love you all.” His first visit to Las Anod took place on 12 April 2025, followed by a second visit on 16 January 2026. Yet despite the ceremonial language surrounding the anniversary celebrations, political attention remains focused elsewhere. Among residents and regional political figures, expectations appear to center less on military restructuring and more on whether the Prime Minister’s visit will produce movement on the long-standing issue of prisoner exchanges between North Eastern State and Somaliland—an issue many believe has become one of the defining humanitarian and political questions following the conflict. Whether the announcement of the revived 26th Command ultimately develops into a fully operational military structure or proves to be largely symbolic remains to be seen. For many in Las Anod, however, the more immediate question is whether the Federal Government is finally prepared to back its political recognition of North Eastern State with concrete financial support, development investment, and assistance for the regional security forces—or whether the latest military announcement will remain another headline without meaningful implementation. items.title: Daawo: Shaakir oo niyad-jab weyn ka muujiyay doorashadii Galmudug – Maxaa dhacay?
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Xisbiga Towfiiq Sheekh Maxamed Shaakir Cali Xasan oo maanta shir jaraa’id u qabtay Wariyeyaasha ayaa ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan doorashadii dhawaan ka dhacday maamulka Galmudug, isagoo muujiyay niyad-jab wayn. Sheekha ayaa marka hore dhaliilay sida loo maamulay doorashadaas oo ay ku tartameen in ka badan 30 urur oo isku soo sharraxay golaha wakiilada cusub iyo kuwa deegaanka ee maamul goboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee Galmudug. Maxaa dhacay? Guddoomiyaha Xisbiga Towfiiq oo faah-faahin dheeri ah bixiyay ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in aysan fileyn waxa dhacay, gaar ahaan in la xir-xiro wakiiladii ay u dirsadeen qaar kamid ah goobaha cod-bixinta ee deegaannada maamulkaasi. Sidoo kale, wuxuu u tacsiyeeyay dhibanayaasha iyo dad uu sheegay inay dhaawcyo soo gaareen intii ay socotay doorashada, ayna uga xun yihiin dhibaatada gaartay. “Waxa dhacay arrin aan raalli ka nahay ma ahan arrin aan filaneynay ma ahan, mana ahan arrin aan u fadhinay haddii aan nahay ururradii oo dhan. Doorasho qof iyo cod ah xor iyo xalaal ah ayaan abaabulnay oo aan ka shaqeynay,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiye Sheekh Maxamad Shaakir Cali Xasan. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas raaciyay “Doorasho lagu dilayo lagu dhaawacayo codkooda lagu caburinayo uma istaagin laakiin wax dhacay waayay. Waxaan u tacsiyeynayaa wakilladii urur kasta ha ahaadeen xabsiga ku galay, waxna lagu gaarsiiyay arrinkaas raalli kama nihin,” ayuu markale yiri. Muxuu yahay dalabkooda? Sheekh Maxamed Shaakir Cali Xasan oo saameyn wayn ku leh gobollada dhexe ayaa farriin culus u diray guddiga doorashada, isaga oo ugu baaqay in ay soo bandhigaan natiijo doorasho oo ku salaysan caddaalad. Waxaa kale oo uu ku dooday in ururradu ay haystaan natiijooyinkooda hordhaca ah, ayna u qoran yihiin codadka ay ka heleen goobaha cod-bixinta, maadaama ay u dirsadeen wakiilo goob joog ahaa maalintii doorashada. “Urur walba way u qoran tahay goob kasta ee seejooyinka la geeyay natiijadeeda, waxaana sugeynaa natiijadaas,” ayuu kusii daray Sheekh. Natiijada doorashooyinkii ka dhacay deegaanada Galmudug ayaa haatan laga sugayaa guddiga doorashada oo ku howlan tirinta codadka, kadibna waxaa ku xigi doonta doorashada madaxtooyada oo iyana si weyn isha loogu wada hayo. The post Daawo: Shaakir oo niyad-jab weyn ka muujiyay doorashadii Galmudug – Maxaa dhacay? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay dagaal qaraar oo ka dhacay Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Warar dheeraad ah ayaa ka soo baxaya dagaal saacado badan socday oo Axadda maanta ah ka dhacay deegaanada ku xeeran Degmada Maxaas ee Gobolka Hiiraan, iyadoo dagaalku uu daba socday mid shalay ka dhacay deegaanada qaar ee hoostaga degmadaasi. Dagaalka ayaa saakay ka qarxay aagga deegaanka Xasan Raqay oo shalay galab lagu kubaareeyay maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, ka dib markii maleeshiyadaasi ay weerar qaraxyo ku bilowdeen ku qaadeen deegaankaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in intaasi ka dib uu dagaalku ku fiday goobihii kale ee ay ciidamadu kaga sugnaayeen ee deegaanada Suullaay, Sulmo, Xagar iyo Teedaan. Dagaal socday 10 saac ka dib, ciidamada ayaa la sheegay inay dib uga gurteen deegaanka Teedaan, oo ah taliskii ugu weynaa ee hadda laga hoggaaminayay hawlgalka dib u xoreynta ee bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegaya in maleeshiyada Shabaabku ay gudaha u galeen Teedaan, isla-markaana Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan ay ku sugan yihiin aagga deegaanka Bukure. Dadka deegaanka ayaa xaqiijiyay in dhulkii lagu dagaalamay Sabtidii ay hadda ku sugan yihiin maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, isla-markaana ay halkaasi ka socdaan duqaymo dhanka cirka ah. Shabaabka ayaa waxaa u suurtagashay in ay xitaa ciidamada ka fogeeyaan deegaanka dhinaca kale ee Maxaas ku yaala ee Goobo, isla-markaana ciidamadii culeyska ku hayay deegaankaasi ay uga baxeen jihada deegaanka Coomaad oo hoostaga Magaalada Matabaan. Ma cadda, sida Shabaabku ay uga xeeladeysanayaan weerarada cirka ee lagu taageerayo ciidamada hawlgalka maalmihii u dambeeyay ka waday deegaanada hoostaga Degmada Maxaas. Dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in Shabaabku ay si degdeg ah u soo hujuumayeen dhulkii ay ciidamadu ku sugnaayeen, mar kasta oo ay gaystaan weeraro ay u adeegsanayeen gaadiid ay ka soo buuxiyeen walxaha qarxa, taasoo ay dadka qaar u maleynayaan inay maleeshiyada siineysay gacanta sare ee dagaalka. Xaalad kacsanaan ah iyo abaabul ciidan ayaa ka jira deegaanada u dhaxeeya Maxaas iyo Matabaan, iyadoona la sheegayo in ciidamadu ay sii wadi doonaan hawlgalka ka dhanka ah maleeshiyadaasi. Magaalooyinka Matabaan iyo Guriceel ee Gobolada Hiiraan iyo Galgaduud ayaa waxaa ka socda abaabul ballaaran oo lagu diyaarinayo ciidamo dhiig cusub ku shuba hawlgalkan, si mar kale ciidamadu ay u wajahaan kooxahaasi. Saraakiil ka tirsan Qaybta 27aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo aan la hadalnay ayaa Dowladda Federaalka iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ku dhaliilay inaanay gurmadka iyo saadka soo gaarsiinin waqtigii saxda ahaa. Taliyaha Qaybta 27aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/dhexe Cali Axmed Xaashi (Cagey) oo ku sugan jiidda hore ee gobolka ayaa Saraakiisha ku dhow dhow laga soo xigtay in Taliyuhu uu wacad ku maray inaanan laga hari doonin kooxaha argagixisada, dagaalkuna aanu sidaan ku dhamaan. Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga hadlin khasaaraha nafeed ee dagaalku uu gaystay, balse Al Shabaab ayaa war ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in maleeshiyadeeda ay dagaalka ku dileen 41 askari oo saraakiil ay ku jiraan. Ilaha ka madaxbannaan ee labada dhinac ayaa sheegaya in ay dhaawacyadooda u kala qaateen goobo kala duwan. Dhaawacyada Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Macawiisleyda ayaa la sheegay in la geeyay Matabaan iyo Guriceel, halka kuwa Shabaabka loo qaaday Maxaas iyo Ceelbuur. Ciidamada Militariga iyo kuwa Macawiisleyda ayaa 19-kii bishii July dhaqdhaqaaq ka bilaabay deegaanada u dhaxeeya Teedaan iyo Maxaas, taas oo keentay in Shabaabku ay iyana toddobaadkii xigay dhaqdhaqaaq ka sameeyaan bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Si kastaba ha-ahaatee xaaladda Degmada Maxaas iyo deegaanada ku teedsan ayaa ah mid is bedbedeleysa, lamana oga waxa ay ku dambayn doonto.

items.title: Maxkamadda Racfaanka Gobolka Banaadir oo Dhageysatay Racfaanka Sacdiya Bajaaj
items.description: Maxkamadda Racfaanka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa guda gashay dhageysiga racfaanka ay qaadatay Eedeysane Sacdiya Macalin Cali, oo loo yaqaan Sacdiya Bajaaj, kaddib markii aysan ku qanacsanaan xukunkii hore ee kasoo baxay Maxkamadda Gobolka Banaadir. Intii ay socotay dhageysiga, qareennada difaaca Sacdiya Bajaaj ayaa Maxkamadda Racfaanka u soo bandhigay sababaha sharci ee ay racfaanka uga qaateen xukunkii Maxkamadda Gobolka Banaadir. Abukaate Sakariye Ismaaciil Nuur, oo ka mid ah qareennada difaaca Eedeysane Sacdiya Macalin Cali, ayaa si faahfaahsan Maxkamadda ugu sharaxay doodda dhinaca sharciga iyo sababaha ay difaacu u arkaan in xukunkii hore dib loogu eego. Qareennada difaaca ayaa Maxkamadda ka codsaday in la tixgeliyo doodahooda iyo qodobada ay ku saleynayaan racfaanka, iyadoo Maxkamadda Racfaanku ay qiimeyn doonto sababaha loo soo gudbiyay iyo xukunkii hore ee Maxkamadda Gobolka Banaadir. Racfaankan ayaa salka ku haya xukunkii hore ee Maxkamadda Gobolka Banaadir ka soo saartay kiiska Sacdiya Macalin Cali (Sacdiya Bajaaj), kaas oo eedeysanaha iyo qareennadeedu aysan ku qanacsanayn. items.title: Hoggaamiye Aadan Madoobe oo Bilaabay Dadaallo Dib-u-heshiisiin ah, Xilli Xiisad Siyaasadeed Ka Jirto Baydhabo
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa bilaabay dadaallo uu ku xoojinayo dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada iyo wada-tashiga siyaasadeed, xilli xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Baydhabo iyo nawaaxigeeda ay weli tahay mid xasaasi ah. Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa Baydhabo kulan kula qaatay Odayaasha Dhaqanka Koonfur Galbeed, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray doorka ay dhaqanku ku leeyihiin xalinta khilaafaadka, mideynta bulshada, xoojinta nabadda iyo dhismaha dowladnimo ku dhisan wada-tashi. Kulanka ayaa lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in dowladda iyo odayaasha dhaqanku si dhow uga wada shaqeeyaan xalinta khilaafaadka iyo abuurista jawi siyaasadeed oo horseeda wada noolaansho iyo kalsooni bulsho. Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sheegay in dowladdiisu ay muhiimad gaar ah siinayso talada iyo waaya-aragnimada odayaasha dhaqanka, isagoo xusay in ay yihiin tiir muhiim u ah dadaallada dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo xasilinta bulshada. Dadaalladan ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmaya magacaabista Mohamed Isack Osman (Fanah) oo Hoggaamiye Aadan Madoobe u magacaabay La-taliye Sare ee Arrimaha Dib-u-heshiisiinta ee Xafiiska Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed. Magacaabistan ayaa loo arki karaa tallaabo lagu doonayo in dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada loo sameeyo hannaan iyo masuul si gaar ah ugu hawlgala, gaar ahaan xilli ay jiraan kala aragti duwanaansho siyaasadeed iyo tabashooyin u baahan wada-hadal. Dadaallada dib-u-heshiisiinta ayaa dhacaya iyadoo duleedka Baydhabo ay joogaan ciidamo uu hoggaaminayo Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen, iyo taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Asluubta, kuwaas oo sida lagu warramayo si weyn uga soo horjeeda hoggaanka Aadan Madoobe. Xaaladdan ayaa ka dhigaysa dadaalka dib-u-heshiisiinta mid xasaasi ah, maadaama xal waara uu u baahan yahay in dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo bulshada ee isku haya Koonfur Galbeed ay helaan waddo ay ku wada-hadlaan. Hoggaamiye Aadan Madoobe ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ay sii xoojin doonto wada-shaqeynta ay la leedahay odayaasha dhaqanka, si loo dardargeliyo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo nabad waarta, dowladnimo xooggan iyo horumar loo siman yahay. Si kastaba, guusha dadaalladan waxay ku xirnaan doontaa in dib-u-heshiisiintu noqoto mid ay ka qayb qaataan dhammaan dhinacyada ay khusayso, ayna ka gudubto kulamo iyo magacaabis rasmi ah, una gudubto wada-hadal dhab ah oo lagu xallinayo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: War cusub oo kasoo kordhay doorashada guddoomiyaha BF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Onlie) – Guddoomiyaha ku-meel gaarka ah ee Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya, Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar ayaa maanta tallaabadii ugu horreysay u qaaday doorashada guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka, si loo soo buuxiyo kursigii uu dhawaan banneeyay Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo loo doortay Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed. Warqad kasoo baxday xafiiska guddoomiye Sacdiya Yaasiin ayaa waxaa lagu magacaabay guddiga doorashada ee guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, si loo dadajiyo howsha, loona soo doorto guddoomiye Baarlamaan oo rasmi ah. Xubnaha la magacaabay oo ka kooban 9 Xildhibaan ayaa la faray inay gutaan waajibaadka loo igmaday, ayna isku dabaridaan hawlaha doorashada. “Waxaa la farayaa xubnaha kor ku xusan inay si degdeg ah u gutaan waajibaadka loo igmaday, si waafaqsan xeerhoosaadka golaha,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Yaa ku tartamaya doorashada? Doorashada kursigan oo si weyn isha loogu wada hayo ayaa waxaa isku soo taagay musharrixiin ay kamid yihiin Wasiirka Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo dhawaan uun soo qaatay kursi Xildhibaannimo iyo Xildhibaan Saadaad Caliyow oo shalay iska casilay xilka Wsasiiru Dowlaha Wasaaraddaha Arrimaha Gudaha Soomaaliya. Labada musharrax ayaa haatan olole xooggan ka wada magaalada Muqdisho, iyaga oo gooni gooni ula shiraya Xildhibaannada, si ay codad uga helaan, waxaase lagu kala bixi doonaa hoolka doorashada oo ah Villa Hargeysa. Sidoo kale, waxaa doorashadan saameyn ku leh Villa Somalia oo la sheegay inay wadato musharrax ay dooneyso inuu noqdo guddoomiyaha cusub ee Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya, si uu u beddelo Sheekh Aadan Madoobe. Shaqada u taalla Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya Kalfadhigga 8-aad ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya oo uu shalay si rasmi ah u furay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa la filayaa in Labada Gole ay sii amba qaadaan hawlaha muhiimka ah ee horyaalla, gaar ahaan arrimaha hortabinta u leh dalka oo ay ugu horreyso doorashada oo haatan uu ka taagan yahay muran xooggan. Furitaanka Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa kusoo aaday, iyada oo ay jiraan caqabado siyaasadeed oo waaweyn, kuwaas oo la xiriira sharciyadda kalfadhigga sannadka dheeraadka ah. Arrintan ayaa sii xoojisay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ka taagan hay’adaha federaalka. Si kastaba, Kalfadhigan waxaa Labada Gole ee Baarlamaanka horyaalla shaqooyin adag, iyadoo ajandaha ugu horreeyo uu noqonayo qabashada doorashada guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, maadaama uu bannaanyahay xilkaasi. items.title: Shaqo la’aan ku dhacday dad xeryaha Gaalkacyo ka samayn jiray wacy-galin bulsho
items.description: (ERGO) – Wuxuu noqday guri-joog aan wax shaqo qaban tan iyo billowgii sanadkan Xasan Xuseen Noor, kaas oo cunno xumo ay wajahayaan qoyskiisa oo barakac ku ah Gaalkacyo. Wuxuu ku dabari jiray howl samafal oo si madax-bannaan uu ugu qaban jiray hay’ad gargaar. Waxaa la mid ah ku dhawaad 100 dhallinyaro, kuwaas oo kala shaqayn jiray dhinaca wacyi-galinta iyo faya-dhowrka hay’ado ay ka mid yihiin CARE, DRC iyo Kuwo kale oo gargaarka gaarsiin jiray kaamamka. Waxay ka howl-gali jireen xeryaha ay ku nool yihiin iyagoo ku shaqayn jiray mushahar ay si bille ah u heli jireen. Xasan oo ay ka istaagtay $200 oo ahayd isha dhaqaale ee qoyskiisa wuxuu la daalaadhacaya duruuf nolol xumo oo ka dhalatay xaaladdaas. Toddobaadkii labo maalin oo ka mid ah ayay helaan cunno 2 waqti ay dabka saartan. Waxaa soo dhicisa xaaskiisa oo shaqo xoogsi ah qabata. Bishii labaad ee sanadkan ayay ku qasbanaatay in ay ku wareegto gudaha iyo daafaha magaalada si ay u soo aruuriso biraha macdanka ah, kuwaas oo asbuucii labo mar oo ka mid ah ay ka iibsadaan raga biraha tuma. Waxay ka heshaa lacag aan joogto ahayn oo u dhacaysa $3-5. Dhaqaalahan oo aan ku filnayn ayaa ku riixay in ay dayn ku kaalmaystaan. Xasan wuxuu gocanayaan shaqadii uu ka helayay mushaharka joogtada ahaa. “Xaga dab-shidka culay baa ka jiro. $200 ciyaalkayga waa ku filnaa jirtay. Saddexda waqti raashinkooda way ku filnayd. Hadda ma haysano wixii dhan. Rajo ayaa nagu jirta. Hay’ada markay soo laabayo daynta iska mag.” Wuxuu tilmaamay in muddo Afar sano ah uu qoyskiisu ku tiirsanaa dhaqaalaha ay siinaysay hay’adda DRC oo uu u shaqayanayay. Wuxuu u qaabilsanaa wacyi-galinta, ilaalinta nadaafadda iyo xog aruurinta la xariirta tacadiyada ka dhaca xeradiisa Samawade 1. Wuxuu sheegay in uu ahaa adeeg bulsho oo marna uu ka faa’iideysanayay shaqada uu yahay, marna uu ugu shaqaynayay dadkiisa nugul, taas oo hadda meesha ka baxday, markii hay’addu ay fasaxday. Waxaa lagu war-galiyay in shaqo joojintan ay la xariirto dhaqaale xumo. Ka hor shaqadan wuxuu ahaa farsamo yaqaan qaabilsanaa dhismaha guryaha, balse fursad tababar oo uu ka helay hay’adda uu u shaqaynayay ayaa siisay in uu si madax-bannaan ugu biiro kooxaha ka howl-galayay xertaha. Xasan ayaa sheegay in uu jeclaan lahaa dib ugu laabashada xirfaddiisii hore, balse qiimayn uu ku sameeyay uu ogaaday in heliddeedu ay adag tahay xilligan. “Farsamadii aan ku shaqayn jiray waanba ilaawayba. Macaamiishii aan la shaqaynayey dad kalaa u shaqaynaya. In aan doon doono nambarada aan wacdo mooyee dadkii niman kalaa u shaqeeya. Qof cusub baa magaalada ka noqday. Hay’ada Ilaahay wax iigu soo dhiibi jiray meelba ma aadin shaqada, shaqadii horana waan iska illaaway oo faryaamo ayaan qandaraas ka qaadanayay. Hadda magaalada iyadaaba iska xiran. Wax laga shaqeeyo malahan.” Wuxuu rajo xumo ka muujiyay saamaynta sii wiiqmaysa ee hay’adaha samafalka, kuwaas oo sidoo kale xeradiisa ka bixiya raashin, kaas oo hadda aan joogto ahayn. Wuxuu xusay in mararka qaar la helo, inta badana la waayo. Waa culays kale si guud looga cabanayo. Duruufaha kale ee haysta Xasan waxaa ka mid ah dayn uu qaadanayay tan bishii Janaayo ee sanadkan oo dadka ku leh ay ku qasbanayaan in uu bixiyo. Wuxuu sheegay in uusan awoodin lacagtaas oo ah $350 oo raashin uu ku qaatay. Intaas wuxuu ku daray in sidoo kale lagu leeyahay $120 oo ah lacag ay waxbarashada ku dhiganayeen afar ilmood oo uu dhalay. Wuxuu xusay in uu ku sii faro adaygayo si aysan waxbarashada iskuulkooda uga harin duruufta haysa awgeed. Afartan iyo shan xero oo ku yaalla Gaalkacyo ayay ka howl-galayeen dhallinyarada shaqo la’aanta noqday. Xero kasta waxaa ka shaqaynayay 2 qof xirfad u leh iskudubbaridka arrimaha wacy-galinta bulshada, faya-dhowrka iyo qaar kale sida ay inoo sheegeen horjoogayaasha xerayaha. Xirsi Jaamac Baadi oo ah guddoomiyaha xerada Danwadaag ayaa ka mid ah masuuliyiinta culays soo kordhay ku tilmaamay howlaha samafal ee meesha ka baxaya iyo dhallinyarada shaqo la’aanta noqday. Wuxuu tilmaamay in kaalin wayn ay uga jireen baraarugga bulshada barakaca ah iyo xitaa dhaqaalaha ka soo galayay hay’adaha oo ku dhex-wareegi jiray xeryaha gaar ahaan ganacsiyada ay wax ka iibsanayeen. Taakuladii gargaar iyo tii wacyi-galin ayuu xusay in ay waayeen dadka xeradiisa iyo kuwa la mid ka ah, taas oo rajadooda nololeed sii adkaysay. “Dadkaas hoy ma haystaan, caafimaad ma haystaan iyo waxbarasho ma haystaan. Quutul duruurigii cuni lahaayeen ma haystaan. Wax Allaale oo aasaasi ah oo qofka bani’aadamka u baahan yahay bay u baahan yihiin. Raashin hadii nala siiyo waan qaadan lahayd waa na anfacaysaa. Wax aan diidayno ma jirto.” Sacdiyo Cabdi Axmed oo ah hooyo kaligeed korisa sagaal carruur ah waxay ka soo kaban la’dahay shaqo la’aan ku dhacday. Waxay ahayd xariiriyaha hay’adaha, bulshada iyo maamulka xerada Danwadaag. Waxay sheegtay in shaqadaasi ay ahayd isha keliya ee dhaqaale ee qoyskeeda ku tiirsana ilaa 2023, isla markaana ay ka dabooli jirtay baahiyaha cunto ee qoyskeeda iyo tan waxbarasho ee carruurteeda. Waxay ka dayrisay xaaladda qoyskeeda ay ku jireen lixdii bil ee u danbeeyay. 24 ba mar ayay xustay in ay dabka saartaan cunno aan ku filnay. Waxay ka heshaa shaqo xoogsi ah oo aan joogto ahayn. “Waxaan ku maareeyaa noloshayda inaan shaax kariyo iyo inaan meelo soo xaaqo. Meeshay noloshayda ku jirto ayaan wax ama bariiskayga aan kala soo baxaa, kaamkayaga wax yaala malahan waa xero cayr ah. Aniga oo mar $50 ama $100 isoo dhici jirtay ayaa ugu wacnaa.” Sacdiyo Waxay Shaaxa ku karisaa gurigeeda iyadoo ka dibna ku wareejisa suuqyada iyo goobaha ganacsiga, Iyadoo koobka shaxaa ay ku iibiso $0.2. Haweenaydan Waxay xustay in dhowr hay’adood in ay si madax-bannaan ay u la shaqayn jirtay, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin. Waxay si bille ah ugu heli jirtay lacag cadad ahaan kala duwan. Waxay ku xirnayd shaqooyinka ay qabato bilaha qaar ayay xustay in ay shaqaysan jirtay $150, taas oo ku filnayd nolol ahaan, balse la’aanteed waxay qoyskeedu galeen xaalado nolol xumo oo isbarkan. Waxay sheegtay in daymihii ay heli jirtay in hadda ay gabaabi noqdeen sabab la xariirta lacag badan oo lagu yeeshay. $440 ayay ku leeyihiin ganacsato iyo xarumo waxbarasho oo 4 carruur ah u dhigtaan. “Maalintay iga go’day lacagtaas nolo mugdi ah oo waxaan galay. Dhaqaale daro darteed caruurtayda dugsiga waa ka hareen, Iskuuladiina waa ka hareen.” Sacdiyo iyo qoyskeeda waxay sanadkii 2018 ka soo barakaceen deegaanka Buursaalax ee gobolka Mudug, markii abaar ay dhaafisay xoolo ay dhaqanayeen oo ahaa ishooda dhaqaale. Waxay isku martay dhowr xero, balse sadddexdii sano ee u danbeeyay waxay ku nagaatay xerada lagu barakacay ee Danwadaag, halkaas oo ay uga howl-galaysay hay’adaha gargaarka bixiya. Dadka soo barakacay waa kuwa ugu badan ee saamaynta ay ku yeelatay hoos u dhaca dhaqaale ee ku dhacay hay’ado cunno iyo shaqo abuur siinayay dadka ku jira xeryaha. Meeshay noloshayda ku jirto ayaan wax ama bariiskayga aan kala soo baxaa, kaamkayaga wax yaala malahan waa xero cayr ah. Aniga oo mar $50 ama $100 isoo dhici jirtay ayaa ugu wacnaa.” Sacdiyo Waxay Shaaxa ku karisaa gurigeeda iyadoo ka dibna ku wareejisa suuqyada iyo goobaha ganacsiga, Iyadoo koobka shaxaa ay ku iibiso $0.2. Haweenaydan Waxay xustay in dhowr hay’adood in ay si madax-bannaan ay u la shaqayn jirtay, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin. Waxay si bille ah ugu heli jirtay lacag cadad ahaan kala duwan. Waxay ku xirnayd shaqooyinka ay qabato bilaha qaar ayay xustay in ay shaqaysan jirtay $150, taas oo ku filnayd nolol ahaan, balse la’aanteed waxay qoyskeedu galeen xaalado nolol xumo oo isbarkan. Waxay sheegtay in daymihii ay heli jirtay in hadda ay gabaabi noqdeen sabab la xariirta lacag badan oo lagu yeeshay. $440 ayay ku leeyihiin ganacsato iyo xarumo waxbarasho oo 4 carruur ah u dhigtaan. “Maalintay iga go’day lacagtaas nolo mugdi ah oo waxaan galay. Dhaqaale daro darteed caruurtayda dugsiga waa ka hareen, Iskuuladiina waa ka hareen.” Sacdiyo iyo qoyskeeda waxay sanadkii 2018 ka soo barakaceen deegaanka Buursaalax ee gobolka Mudug, markii abaar ay dhaafisay xoolo ay dhaqanayeen oo ahaa ishooda dhaqaale. Waxay isku martay dhowr xero, balse sadddexdii sano ee u danbeeyay waxay ku nagaatay xerada lagu barakacay ee Danwadaag, halkaas oo ay uga howl-galaysay hay’adaha gargaarka bixiya. Dadka soo barakacay waa kuwa ugu badan ee saamaynta ay ku yeelatay hoos u dhaca dhaqaale ee ku dhacay hay’ado cunno iyo shaqo abuur siinayay dadka ku jira xeryaha. items.title: Somalia president forces Uganda to soften dialogue clause in AUSSOM communique
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud openly clashed with his Ugandan hosts on Friday at the close of an extraordinary summit of African Union troop and police contributing countries (TPCCs), pushing back against communique language calling for dialogue between his government and the opposition – a confrontation that ended with the passage softened in the final text. Mohamud objected to the wording during closing negotiations at Speke Resort Munyonyo, arguing it fell outside the summit’s mandate. He insisted Somalia’s internal politics were a domestic matter, not a subject for African troop-contributing states, and that the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) should confine itself to security. “The political matters of Somalia is very internal and I don’t want to be included in this communique,” Mohamud told delegates. “This summit was meant for security and the AU mission… and the issue of Al-Shabaab.” “That’s local politics of Somalia and must not be internationalised, regionalised,” he added. Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni, who chaired the closing session, directed the drafting team to revisit the language. The explicit call for dialogue between Mohamud’s government and opposition figures was reworked into broader phrasing urging Somali political stakeholders to prioritize national unity and reconciliation – stripping the pointed reference while leaving a general political message intact. Analyst: “Sheer Blackmail” The episode drew sharp criticism from Rashid Abdi, a political analyst with Nairobi-based Sahan Research, who said Mohamud had again leaned on pressure tactics to shape a regional outcome in his favor. Mohamud “knows how to get what he wants by sheer blackmail,” Abdi said. “Throw a few tantrums and the weak-kneed African neighbours will back down.” He added of the result: “He was right. That’s what they did.” Abdi argued that treating Somalia’s security crisis and its political dysfunction as separable issues was untenable. “Delinking Somali politics from security is a sheer absurdity and everyone knows it,” he said, invoking Clausewitz’s axiom that military campaigns exist to serve political ends. “Clausewitz’s dictum… is lost on HSM but should it be lost too to AUSSOM and Ugandan generals?” He questioned the strategic purpose of the AU mission itself. “AUSSOM’s role is not robotic kinetic action against jihadists but creating the political space for Somalis to reconcile, unite, construct a viable state and healthy progressive politics,” Abdi said, warning that “endemic political dysfunction, state contraction and fragmentation raises fundamental question about what end AUSSOM serves.” “If East Africa cannot call Somalia to order; cannot offer honest opinion and advice; cannot correct its wayward leadership — of what use then is the military campaign?” he asked. A Diluted, Not Deleted, Message The final communique, issued Friday, urged Somali political stakeholders to prioritize national unity and reconciliation – a marked softening from the original draft’s more direct call for dialogue between Mohamud’s federal government and opposition leaders. The episode has since drawn criticism from regional actors, including Jubaland’s Minister of Information, who accused Mohamud of dismissing legitimate regional concern over Somalia’s prolonged political crisis. The confrontation underscores a recurring tension at the heart of AUSSOM’s mandate: whether a mission built to fight Al-Shabaab can — or should — stay silent on the political dysfunction its critics say fuels the insurgency it is meant to defeat. items.title: Soomaaliya oo ansixisay xeerar cusub oo lagu xakameynayo caanaha beddelka naaska
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya, UNICEF iyo Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) ayaa si rasmi ah u daah-furay xeerar cusub oo lagu nidaaminayo caanaha budada ah iyo waxyaabaha loo isticmaalo beddelka naaska (BMS). Xeerarkan ayaa looga gol leeyahay in si adag loo xakameeyo suuq-geynta iyo xayeysiinta caanaha beddelka naaska, iyadoo mudnaanta la siinayo ilaalinta caafimaadka iyo nafaqada carruurta. Wasiirka Caafimaadka iyo Adeegyada Aadanaha Soomaaliya, Cali Xaaji Aadan, ayaa sheegay in naasnuujintu ay ka mid tahay tallaabooyinka ugu waxtarka badan ee lagu hubin karo in carruurtu noolaadaan, si wanaagsan u koraan, una helaan caafimaad wanaagsan. Ansixinta xeerarkan ayaa ka dhacday munaasabadda daah-furka Toddobaadka Naasnuujinta Adduunka 2026, oo soconaya 1 ilaa 7 Agoosto, laguna wado hal-ku-dhigga: “Naasnuujinta oo saldhig u ah nolol waarta: Xooji waxa shaqeeya.” WHO iyo UNICEF ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay sii wadi doonaan taageerada Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan hirgelinta siyaasado ku saleysan caddayn cilmiyeed iyo xoojinta nidaamka caafimaadka si loo ilaaliyo nafaqada iyo caafimaadka dhallaanka. UNICEF waxay carrabka ku adkaysay in nafaqada saxda ah ee dhallaanku ay xoojiso difaaca jirka, isla markaana ay gacan ka geysato badbaadinta nolosha carruur badan. Xeerarkan cusub ayaa Soomaaliya u noqon kara tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu ilaalinayo naasnuujinta iyo xaqa carruurta Soomaaliyeed u leeyihiin bilow nololeed caafimaad qaba.

items.title: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga oo Qaabilay Safiirka Dowladda Shiinaha u Fadhiya Soomaaliya
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa maanta qaabilay Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Dadka Shiinaha u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Danjire Wang Yu. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray dadaallada ay dowladdu waddo ee la-dagaallanka argagixisada, xaaladda iyo taageerada Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasillinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), xoojinta iskaashiga difaaca ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha, iyo horumarinta awoodda hay’adaha amniga. Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa uga mahadceliyey Dowladda Jamhuuriyadda Dadka Shiinaha garab-istaagga joogtada ah iyo mowqifkeeda ku aaddan taageerada midnimada, madaxbannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Dib-u-habeyn Ganacsi Wadda, Kalluumeysiga oo Loo Aqoonsaday Warshad Dhaqaale oo Mustaqbal Leh
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaare ku-xigeenka Soomaaliya, Saalax Axmed Jaamac, ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay u baahan tahay in ay xoojiso is-dhexgalka ganacsi ee gobolka, iyadoo dib-u-habeyn lagu sameynayo nidaamka ganacsiga si loo yareeyo caqabadaha hortaagan ganacsatada iyo maalgashadayaasha. Saalax ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay shir looga hadlayay horumarinta ganacsiga iyo diyaarinta qorshe lagu casriyeynayo siyaasadaha ganacsi ee Soomaaliya, kaas oo ay ka qeyb galeen mas’uuliyiin dowladeed, khubaro ganacsi iyo wakiillo ka socday dalalka xubnaha ka ah Ururka Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC). Wuxuu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay muhiim u tahay in ay la jaanqaaddo dalalka gobolka, iyadoo la mideynayo xeerarka ganacsiga, tayada badeecooyinka iyo habraacyada xuduudaha, si loo fududeeyo isu-socodka badeecooyinka loona yareeyo kharashaadka ganacsiga. Kalluumeysiga ayuu si gaar ah ugu tilmaamay mid ka mid ah qaybaha dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya ee leh fursadda ugu weyn ee kobaca. Wuxuu ku baaqay in la kordhiyo maalgashiga kalluumeysiga si loo kobciyo wax-soo-saarka, dhoofinta iyo shaqo-abuurka. Soomaaliya waxay leedahay xeeb ka mid ah kuwa ugu dheer Afrika iyo khayraad badeed oo ballaaran, balse awoodda dalka ee ka faa’iidaysiga khayraadkaas ayaa weli ka hooseysa fursadda jirta. Haddii la horumariyo kaabayaasha kalluumeysiga, sida dekedaha, suuqyada kalluunka, qaboojinta, farsamaynta iyo gaadiidka, kalluunka Soomaaliya wuxuu noqon karaa badeeco si weyn loogu dhoofiyo suuqyada gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale dooneysa in ay dhaqaalaha ka weeciso ku-tiirsanaanta dhaqameed ee dhoofinta xoolaha, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo kalluumeysiga, beeraha iyo wax-soo-saarka gudaha.

items.title: Somali Prime Minister Arrives in Las Anod for Official Visit
items.description: LAS ANOD — Somali Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre, accompanied by a delegation of cabinet ministers, arrived in Las Anod, the administrative capital of the North Eastern State of Somalia, where the federal government is implementing a range of public service and development initiatives. The Prime Minister was warmly received at Las Anod Airport by the leadership of the North Eastern administration, traditional elders and representatives from various sections of society. His visit comes as the administration marks the first anniversary of its establishment. Addressing a large crowd gathered at the airport to welcome him, Prime Minister Barre expressed his appreciation for the reception. “Thank you for your warm welcome. I want you to know that I love you, that we stand together, and that I am here to join you in celebrating the anniversary of the establishment of the administration,” he said. Several federal ministries are expected to establish public service offices in the region as part of the government’s efforts to expand essential services and support local development. During his visit, Prime Minister Barre is also scheduled to join the leadership and residents of the North Eastern State at a public gathering commemorating the first anniversary of the administration’s establishment. items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse oo gaaray Laascaanood
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa gaaray magaalada Laascaanood, xarunta Maamulka Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya, halkaas oo uu kula soo biiray hoggaanka maamulka iyo dadweynaha si ay ugu dabaaldegaan sanad-guuraha koowaad ee asaaska maamulka . Waftiga uu hoggaaminayo ayaa waxaa ka mid ah wasiirro ka socda xukuumadda, kuwaas oo maamulka ka fulinaya hawlo horumarineed iyo kuwo adeeg bulsho. Socdaalkan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu muujinayaa iskaashiga u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo Maamulka Waqooyi Bari, kaas oo la aasaasay sanad ka hor. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa kula qayb-galay munaasabado ay ka soo qayb-galeen madaxda heerarkooda kala duwan iyo kumanyaal dadweyne ah, iyadoo la qaban-qaabiyay kulamo dadweyne oo loogu dabaal-degayo sanad-guuraha koowaad. Hoggaanka maamulka Waqooyi Bari ayaa si weyn ugu soo dhaweeyay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha iyo waftigiisa garoonka diyaaradaha, iyadoo ay ku soo dhoweeyeen odayaasha dhaqanka, mas’uuliyiinta maamulka iyo dadweyne badan oo isugu soo baxay si ay u muujiyaan taageeradooda dowladda federaalka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xamsa Cabdi Barre, oo garoonka kula hadlay dadweynihii soo dhaweyntiisa, ayaa sheegay in uu si weyn u mahadcelinayo soo dhaweynta, isagoona xusay in uu si wada jir ah ula qayb-gelayo dabaaldegga sanad-guuraha maamulka. Waxaa la filayaa in Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu uu kulan la yeesho hoggaanka maamulka Waqooyi Bari, iyadoo la sheegay in uu sidoo kale booqan doono mashaariicda horumarineed ee ay dowladda federaalku ka fulinayso magaalada, kuwaas oo qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo adeegyada bulshada iyo kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha. The post Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse oo gaaray Laascaanood first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay qarax ka dhacay gobolka Bari
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Wararka hordhaca ah ee laga helayo qarax miino oo ka dhacay gobolka Bari ayaa sheegaya in khasaare xooggan uu ka dhashay, iyadoo inta badan askartii saarneyd gaadiidkii la beegsaday ay ku geeriyoodeen goobta. Sidoo kale, waxaa la soo warinayaa in askar kale ay soo gaareen dhaawacyo kala duwan. Inkastoo aan weli si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin tirada dhimashada iyo dhaawaca, haddana wararka hordhaca ah ayaa sheegaya in illaa 8 askari ay ku dhinteen qaraxan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, maamulka Puntland ayaan illaa hadda soo saarin war rasmi ah oo faahfaahinaya khasaaraha ama duruufaha ku xeeran weerarka. Dhacdadan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli magaalada Boosaaso uu ka socdo kulan u dhexeeya Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, iyo saraakiil sare oo ka socda Taliska Mareykanka ee AFRICOM. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa xaaladda amniga Soomaaliya iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga dhinaca la dagaallanka argagixisada. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in mas’uuliyiinta labada dhinac ay sidoo kale ka wada hadlayaan xaaladda amni ee Puntland, gaar ahaan dagaalka lagula jiro kooxda Daacish ee ku sugan buuraha Calmiskaad iyo doorka iskaashiga caalamiga ah ee howl-galladaas. Dhanka kale, Mareykanka ayaa dhawaan hakiyay duqeymihii cirka ee uu ka fulin jiray fariisimaha kooxda Daacish ee Puntland, arrintaas oo ku soo beegantay xilli uu socdo dib-u-eegis lagu sameynayo howl-gallada militari ee gobolka. Waxaa sidoo kale la sheegay in qulqulatooyinka dhinaca ciidamada ee ka taagan Puntland ay saameyn ku yeesheen howl-galladii ka dhanka ahaa Daacish. Kooxda ayaa weli ku sugan qaybo ka mid ah buuraha Calmiskaad, halkaas oo muddo bilo ah ay ka socdeen dagaallo iyo duqeymo xiriir ah. Maamulka ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyay ciidamo badan ka soo daad-gureeyay furimaha hore ee dagaalka, si ay uga qeyb qaataan munaasabadda xuska sannad-guuradii 28-aad ee aas-aaska Puntland, oo ku beegneyd shalay. Lama oga in dhaq-dhaqaaqaas uu saameyn ku yeeshay xaaladda amni ee furimaha dagaalka, iyadoo weli la sugayo faahfaahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan weerarka iyo khasaaraha ka dhashay. items.title: Madaxweynaha Somaliland oo Furay  Shirka Todobaadka Qurbo’jooga Somaliland
items.description: 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐰𝐞𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐡𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐟𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐲 𝐓𝐨𝐝𝐝𝐨𝐛𝐚𝐚𝐝𝐤𝐚 𝐐𝐮𝐫𝐛𝐚-𝐣𝐨𝐨𝐠𝐠𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝, 𝐤𝐮𝐧𝐚 𝐛𝐨𝐠𝐚𝐚𝐝𝐢𝐲𝐞𝐲 𝐃𝐨𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐚 𝐥𝐚𝐦𝐚 𝐡𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐚𝐡 𝐞𝐞 𝐐𝐮𝐫𝐛𝐚-𝐣𝐨𝐨𝐠𝐠𝐮 𝐤𝐮 𝐥𝐞𝐞𝐲𝐢𝐡𝐢𝐢𝐧 𝐝𝐡𝐢𝐬𝐦𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐐𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐇𝐨𝐫𝐮𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐢𝐢𝐬𝐚 Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u furay Toddobaadka Qurba-joogga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland oo ah munaasabad Qaran oo loogu talagalay xoojinta xidhiidhka ka dhexeeya Qaranka iyo Qurba-joogga, laguna xusayo kaalinta lama illaawaanka ah ee ay Qurba-jooggu ku leeyihiin dhismaha, horumarka iyo difaaca jiritaanka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Madaxweynaha ayaa munaasabadda ka jeediyey khudbad qaran oo qoto dheer, taasi oo xambaarsanayd mahadnaq, dhiirrigelin iyo dardaaran. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu si cad u qiray in Qurba-joogga Somaliland ay yihiin laf-dhabarta guulo badan oo dalku gaadhay, isla markaana ay door muhiim ah ku lahaayeen marxalad kasta oo uu Qaranku soo maray. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu si gaar ah u bogaadiyey kaalintii lama illaawaanka ahayd ee ay Qurba-jooggu ka qaateen halgankii dib-u-xoraynta dalka, iyaga oo codkooda, dhaqaalahooda, aqoontooda iyo dedaalkooda u huray dib-u-soo-celinta karaamada iyo xorriyadda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa xusay kaalinta weyn ee ay Qurba-jooggu ku lahaayeen dib-u-dhiska Qaranka, kaddib burburkii magaalooyinka iyo barakacii loo geystay shacabka Somaliland. Waxa uu sheegay in Qurba-jooggu ahaayeen laf-dhabarta dib-u-soo-nooleynta adeegyada aasaasiga ah, dhismaha Hay’adaha Qaranka, kobcinta dhaqaalaha iyo adkaynta nabadda iyo xasilloonida ay Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland maanta ku naaloonayso. Madaxweynuhu waxa kale oo uu xusay in Qurba-jooggu ay hormuud ka yihiin maalgashiga dalka, fursadaha shaqo abuurka iyo abuurista adeegyada bulshada, iyaga oo door muuqda ka qaatay horumarinta Waxbarashada, Caafimaadka, Ganacsiga, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha taasi oo si toos ah saldhig ugu noqotay horumarka maanta ka muuqda Qaranka JSL. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si weyn u ammaanay dedaalka joogtada ah ee ay Qurba-joogga Somaliland ugu jiraan ictiraaf-raadinta iyo kor u qaadista qaddiyadda Somaliland ee fagaarayaasha caalamka. Waxa uu tilmaamay in Qurba-jooggu yihiin codka ugu saamaynta badan ee dunida u gudbiya xaqiiqada Somaliland, dimuqraadiyaddeeda, nabaddeeda iyo xaqa shacabka Somaliland ay u leeyihiin in ay dunida ka helaan aqoonsi caalami ah oo ay mudan yihiin. Madaxweynaha ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyey in Qurba-joogga Somaliland aan lagu qiimayn karin kaalintooda dhaqaale oo keliya, balse ay yihiin hanti qaran oo lama huraan ah, maadaama ay dalkooda ugu hagar baxeen aqoontooda, xirfaddooda, hal-abuurkooda, khibradda iyo waayo-aragnimadooda taasi oo laf-dhabar u noqotay qorshayaasha horumarineed iyo dhismaha Hay’adaha casriga ah ee Qaranka JSL. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu sheegay in Xukuumaddiisu ay ka go’an tahay xoojinta xidhiidhka iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay Qurba-joogga Somaliland ee daafaha dunida, iyada oo la abuuri doono jawi dhiirrigelinaya maalgashiga, dib-u-soo-noqoshada aqoonyahanka iyo ka-qaybgalka bulshada Qurba-joogga ee horumarinta dalka iyo hirgelinta himilooyinka Qaranka. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa sheegay in Qurba-joogga Somaliland ay yihiin hanti Qaran, safiirrada JSL ee daafaha Caalamka, kaydka aqoonta iyo waayo-aragnimada halbawlaha u ah horumarka dalka isla markaana ay ku suntan yihiin guulaha uu gaadhay Qaranka JSL iyo kuwa uu hiigsanayo mustaqbalka. Ugu dambayn, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu bulshada Qurba-joogga kula dardaarmay adkaynta midnimada dhexdooda, ka qayb-galka dedaallada nabadda iyo sii xoojinta kaalinta soo jireenka ah ee ku leeyihiin ictiraaf raadinta iyo ku adkaanshaha Diinteenna Suubban iyo dhaqankeenna qaniga ah.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo sheegay in Somalia dib u soo ceshatay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay dib u soo ceshatay kaalinteedii caalamiga ahayd. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in isbeddelkan ku yimid siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda uu ka mid yahay guulaha ugu waaweyn ee la gaaray afartii sano ee la soo dhaafay. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in dib-u-habeynta siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ay sare u qaaday sumcadda iyo matalaadda Soomaaliya ee heer gobol iyo heer caalami. Wuxuu tilmaamay in dowladda ay mudnaanta siisay xoojinta xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo difaaca danaha qaranka. “Mid ka mid ah guulaha ugu waaweyn ee afartii sano ee la soo dhaafay waa isbeddelka ku yimid siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya muddo dheer ahayd dal inta badan laga hadlo, balse maanta ay isu beddeshay dal si firfircoon uga qeyb qaata doodaha iyo go’aamada khuseeya gobolka iyo caalamka. items.title: Taliyaha Africom oo arrin yaab leh ka shaaciyey ciidanka DF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha ciidamada Mareykanka ee Afrika, Jeneraal Dagvin Anderson, ayaa muujiyey caro iyo niyad-jab ku saabsan in ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadooda caalamiga ah ay mar kale ku qasbanaadeen inay u dagaallamaan deegaanno ku yaalla Soomaaliya oo sannado ka hor laga saaray kooxda Al-Shabaab. Anderson ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Mareykanka, kuwa xoogga dalka Soomaaliya iyo kumaandooska Danab ay intii u dhexeysay 2019-kii iyo 2021-kii horumar weyn ka sameeyeen hareeraha webiga Shabeelle, iyaga oo howlgalladooda gaarsiiyey illaa deegaanka Mubaarak. Hase yeeshee, deegaannadaas ayaa markii dambe dib ugu dhacay gacanta Al-Shabaab, taas oo keentay in ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taageeraya ay sannadkan mar kale qaadaan howlgallo lagu doonayo in kooxda looga saaro isla dhulkii horay loogu dagaallamay. “Waxaan halkan ka howlgalayay aniga oo ka tirsan Taliska Howlgallada Gaarka ah intii u dhexeysay 2019 iyo 2021,” ayuu Anderson ku yiri wareysi ay Jimcihii baahisay Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Muqdisho. “Waxaan la shaqeynay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo Danab, annaga oo ku sii soconnay hareeraha webiga Shabeelle, horumarna sameynay illaa aan ka gaarnay Mubaarak. Hadda waxaan kusoo laabtay aniga oo ah taliyaha AFRICOM, waxaana mar kale dib u qabsaneynaa isla dhulkii,” ayuu yiri. Hadallada Anderson ayaa si aan caadi ahayn u muujinaya walaaca Mareykanka uu ka qabo fashilka ku yimid ilaalinta qaar ka mid ah guulihii militari ee laga gaaray dagaalka Al-Shabaab, inkasta oo Washington ay sannado badan tababar, hub, sirdoon iyo taageero dhinaca cirka ah siisay ciidamada Soomaaliya. Diiradda oo la leexiyey Anderson ayaa sheegay in deegaannadaas la waayay kaddib markii diiraddii laga leexiyey dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, inkasta oo uusan si toos ah u magacaabin cidda uu mas’uuliyadda saarayo ama arrimaha kale ee lagu mashquulay. “Taasi waa waxa niyad-jabka keenaya, sababtoo ah dhulkaas waa la waayay, maadaama meel uun diiraddii la-dagaallanka argagixisada laga qaaday oo meel kale loo jeediyey,” ayuu yiri. Shabeellaha Hoose ayaa muddo dheer ka mid ahaa goobaha ugu muhiimsan ee uu ka socdo dagaalka Al-Shabaab, sababo la xiriira u dhowaanshaha Muqdisho, waddooyinka isku xira caasimadda iyo gobollada koonfureed iyo dhulka beeraha hodanka ah ee ku teedsan webiga Shabeelle. Al-Shabaab ayaa sidoo kale deegaannada miyiga ah ee gobolka u adeegsata inay dhaqaale ka ururiso dadka iyo gaadiidka, ku diyaariso weerarro, kuna ilaaliso waddooyin ay dagaalyahannadeedu isaga gudbaan gobollada Shabeellaha Hoose, Bay iyo Jubbada Dhexe. Ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo kuwa Midowga Afrika ayaa bishii March dib ula wareegay Mubaarak iyo Daarusalaam, oo lagu tilmaamay deegaanno istaraatiiji ah oo Al-Shabaab ay muddo u adeegsanaysay saldhigyo iyo goobo ay kasoo abaabusho weerarrada. Howlgalkaas, oo ay dowladda Soomaaliya ugu yeertay “Rolling Thunder”, wuxuu qeyb ka ahaa guluf ballaaran oo lagu magacaabay howlgalka Beder, kaas oo ciidamada Soomaaliya, kuwa Midowga Afrika iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah ay ka fuliyeen qeybo ka mid ah Shabeellaha Hoose. Al-Shabaab ayaa toddobaadyo kaddib isku dayday inay dib u weerarto Mubaarak, balse ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo kuwa Uganda ee ka tirsan howlgalka AUSSOM ayaa sheegay inay iska caabiyeen weerarka, ayna dileen in ka badan 40 dagaalyahan. Tiradaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. ‘Awood kaliya kuma filna’ Anderson ayaa sheegay in awoodda lagu qabsado dhul aysan keligeed keenayn guul waarta, haddii aysan dowladda Soomaaliya awoodin inay halkaas geyso maamul, caddaalad, adeegyo iyo ciidamo si joogto ah u suga ammaanka. “Qabsashada dhulku waa qeybta amniga,” ayuu yiri. “Laakiin kaddib waa inaad awood u yeelataan inaad sii haysataan, aad keentaan maamul iyo caddaalad, isla markaana aad abuurtaan xasilloonida loo baahan yahay si horumar iyo barwaaqo ay u dhacaan.” Wuxuu sheegay in Mareykanku ka caawin karo Soomaaliya dhinaca amniga, balse dowladda federaalka looga baahan yahay inay qaadato mas’uuliyadda maamulidda iyo xasilinta deegaannada laga saaro Al-Shabaab. “Annagu dhinaca militariga waxaan ka caawinnaa qeybta amniga. Waxaan Soomaaliya uga baahan nahay inay keento maamulka, ayna abuurto xasilloonida suuragelinaysa horumarka,” ayuu yiri. Dowladaha Soomaaliya ayaa sannado badan wajahaya caqabado la xiriira sidii maamul iyo adeegyo degdeg ah loogu gaarsiin lahaa deegaannada laga saaro Al-Shabaab. Marar badan, ciidamada ayaa qabsada magaalooyin iyo tuulooyin, balse dib uga baxa sababo la xiriira ciidamo yari, sahay la’aan, khilaafaad siyaasadeed ama iyadoo aan la dhisin maamul maxalli ah oo buuxiya booska ay ka baxday kooxda. Taliyaha AFRICOM ayaa sidoo kale digniin ka bixiyey in taageerada Mareykanka aysan sii socon karin haddii kheyraadka loogu talagalay dagaalka Al-Shabaab loo adeegsado arrimo kale. “Haddii kheyraadkaas meelo kale iyo arrimo kale loo adeegsado, halkii loo adeegsan lahaa dagaalka ka dhanka ah argagixisada, way igu adkaan doontaa inaan qiil u sameeyo sababta aan halkan ugu sii hayneyno, iyadoo ay jiraan baahiyo kale oo badan,” ayuu yiri. “Waxaan aaminsanahay howlgalkaan, waxaana aaminsanahay inaan idinla garab istaagno la-dagaallanka argagixisada, laakiin waa inaan aragnaa horumar,” ayuu hadalkiisa raaciyey. Hadalladan ayaa loo arki karaa digniin ku socota madaxda Soomaaliya, xilli khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee dowladda federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada iyo mucaaradka ay marar badan saameeyeen isku-duwidda dagaalka Al-Shabaab. Mustaqbalka Danab Anderson ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Mareykanku dhameystiray kaalintii ugu weynayd ee uu ku lahaa dhismaha ciidamada kumaandooska Danab, isaga oo mas’uuliyadda sii jiritaanka iyo horumarinta ciidankaas hadda dusha ka saaray dowladda Soomaaliya. Danab ayaa la aasaasay in ka badan toban sano ka hor, waxaana Mareykanku siiyey tababar, qalab, mushaar iyo taageero dhinaca howlgallada ah, si loo dhiso ciidan isku dhafan oo fulin kara weerarro gaar ah oo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab. Cutubkan ayaa ka mid noqday ciidamada Soomaaliya ee sida joogtada ah uga qeyb qaata howlgallada lagu beegsado hoggaamiyeyaasha Al-Shabaab, xarumaha kooxda iyo deegaannada ay maamusho. “Annaga oo ah Mareykanka — aniguna aan qeyb ka ahaa markii aan hore halkan u joogay — waxaan gacan ka geysanay dhismaha Danab, oo ka mid ah ciidamada ugu awoodda badan qaaradda,” ayuu Anderson yiri. “Aad ayaan ugu faraxsanahay kaalintii aan ku lahayn dhismaha ciidankaas la-dagaallanka argagixisada. Waan dhameystirnay taas; waan dhisnay ciidanka, maanta wuu joogaa, diyaarna wuxuu u yahay in loo adeegsado la-dagaallanka argagixisada.” Hase yeeshee, wuxuu sheegay in Soomaaliya laga doonayo inay hadda maalgeliso, ilaaliso oo sii horumariso ciidanka, isla markaana aysan ka leexin ujeeddadii loo dhisay. “Hadda Soomaaliya ayay ku xiran tahay inay sii waddo ciidankaas, dhisto, ilaaliso waxtarkiisa mustaqbalka, una adeegsato sidii loogu talagalay oo ah la-dagaallanka argagixisada,” ayuu yiri. Anderson, oo hoggaanka AFRICOM la wareegay bishii August 2025, ayaa hore u soo noqday taliyaha ciidamada howlgallada gaarka ah ee Mareykanka ee Afrika intii u dhexeysay 2019 iyo 2021, xilligaas oo Mareykanku kordhiyey howlgallada iyo duqeymaha ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Mareykanka ayaa weli duqeymo cirka ah ka fuliya Soomaaliya, isaga oo taageeraya ciidamada dowladda ee la dagaallamaya Al-Shabaab koonfurta iyo bartamaha dalka iyo kooxda Daacish ee ku sugan buuraha Puntland. Bishii July oo keliya, AFRICOM ayaa shaaciyey duqeymo dhowr ah oo lagu beegsaday Al-Shabaab, oo uu ku jiro weerar ka dhacay agagaarka degmada Sablaale ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Hadallada Anderson ayaa muujinaya in walaaca ugu weyn uusan hadda ahayn oo keliya awoodda lagu qabsan karo deegaannada ay Al-Shabaab joogto, balse uu yahay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay awooddo inay sii haysato, maamusho oo ka hortagto in ciidamada mar kale loogu celiyo isla goobihii horay dhiigga iyo dhaqaalaha badan loogu bixiyey. Cutubkan ayaa ka mid noqday ciidamada Soomaaliya ee sida joogtada ah uga qeyb qaata howlgallada lagu beegsado hoggaamiyeyaasha Al-Shabaab, xarumaha kooxda iyo deegaannada ay maamusho. “Annaga oo ah Mareykanka — aniguna aan qeyb ka ahaa markii aan hore halkan u joogay — waxaan gacan ka geysanay dhismaha Danab, oo ka mid ah ciidamada ugu awoodda badan qaaradda,” ayuu Anderson yiri. “Aad ayaan ugu faraxsanahay kaalintii aan ku lahayn dhismaha ciidankaas la-dagaallanka argagixisada. Waan dhameystirnay taas; waan dhisnay ciidanka, maanta wuu joogaa, diyaarna wuxuu u yahay in loo adeegsado la-dagaallanka argagixisada.” Hase yeeshee, wuxuu sheegay in Soomaaliya laga doonayo inay hadda maalgeliso, ilaaliso oo sii horumariso ciidanka, isla markaana aysan ka leexin ujeeddadii loo dhisay. “Hadda Soomaaliya ayay ku xiran tahay inay sii waddo ciidankaas, dhisto, ilaaliso waxtarkiisa mustaqbalka, una adeegsato sidii loogu talagalay oo ah la-dagaallanka argagixisada,” ayuu yiri. Anderson, oo hoggaanka AFRICOM la wareegay bishii August 2025, ayaa hore u soo noqday taliyaha ciidamada howlgallada gaarka ah ee Mareykanka ee Afrika intii u dhexeysay 2019 iyo 2021, xilligaas oo Mareykanku kordhiyey howlgallada iyo duqeymaha ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Mareykanka ayaa weli duqeymo cirka ah ka fuliya Soomaaliya, isaga oo taageeraya ciidamada dowladda ee la dagaallamaya Al-Shabaab koonfurta iyo bartamaha dalka iyo kooxda Daacish ee ku sugan buuraha Puntland. Bishii July oo keliya, AFRICOM ayaa shaaciyey duqeymo dhowr ah oo lagu beegsaday Al-Shabaab, oo uu ku jiro weerar ka dhacay agagaarka degmada Sablaale ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Hadallada Anderson ayaa muujinaya in walaaca ugu weyn uusan hadda ahayn oo keliya awoodda lagu qabsan karo deegaannada ay Al-Shabaab joogto, balse uu yahay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay awooddo inay sii haysato, maamusho oo ka hortagto in ciidamada mar kale loogu celiyo isla goobihii horay dhiigga iyo dhaqaalaha badan loogu bixiyey.
