items.title: Xisbiga Awoodda Shacabka oo ka baxay Madasha Heybad Qaran
items.description: Muqdisho, 1 Agoosto 2026 – Xisbiga Awoodda Shacabka, oo ka mid ahaa tobanka xisbi ee ku mideysnaa Madasha Heybad Qaran, ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu isaga baxay Madasha, kadib markii uu kasoo horjeestay go’aan ay dhawaan soo saareen Golaha Mustaqbalka. Xisbiga ayaa sheegay in muddadii uu ka tirsanaa Madasha uu si joogto ah uga qayb qaatay doodaha iyo aragtiyada lagu salaynayo xasilloonida dalka iyo nidaamka doorashooyinka. Hase yeeshee, Awoodda Shacabka ayaa sheegay in warqaddii Golaha Mustaqbalka ee 28-kii Luulyo 2026 ay ku jireen qodobo aysan ku waafaqsanayn, gaar ahaan arrimo la xiriira doorashada dalka, muddada xilka hay’adaha dowladda iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliya. Xisbiga ayaa si cad u sheegay: “Kadib qiimeyn iyo wadatashi guddaha Xisbiga Awoodda Shacabka, waxaan gaarnay go’aan ah in Xisbiga Awoodda Shacabka uusan qayb ka sii ahaan karin Midowga Heybad Qaran.” Go’aanka ayaa ka dhigan in Awoodda Shacabka uu si rasmi ah uga baxay Midowga Madasha Heybad Qaran, isagoo uga mahadceliyay hoggaanka Madasha iyo dhammaan xubnihii ay wada shaqeynayeen. Arrintan ayaa noqon karta isbeddel siyaasadeed oo muhiim ah, maadaama ay imaaneyso xilli ay Soomaaliya ka taagan yihiin doodo xooggan oo ku saabsan jihada siyaasadda iyo doorashooyinka dalka.

items.title: Jubaland Minister Rebukes President Hassan Sheikh Over Kampala Summit Remarks
items.description: KISMAYO (WDN) — Jubaland’s Minister of Information, Abdifatah Mohamed Mukhtar, has sharply criticized President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud following the conclusion of the AUSSOM Troop-Contributing Countries Summit in Kampala, accusing the Somali leader of dismissing legitimate regional concerns over Somalia’s prolonged political crisis. The Kampala summit focused primarily on the future of the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), whose operations continue to face serious funding shortfalls. Regional leaders also discussed Somalia’s political deadlock, with several participants emphasizing the need for dialogue between the Federal Government and opposition groups to safeguard national stability. According to participants, President Hassan Sheikh objected to discussions concerning Somalia’s internal political dispute, arguing that disagreements between the Federal Government and the opposition were domestic matters that should not be debated at an international summit. His remarks drew a swift response from Jubaland. In a strongly worded statement, Minister Abdifatah argued that the Kampala gathering was not a political rally but a summit attended by regional leaders whose countries have invested heavily in Somalia’s security and stabilization over the past two decades. “Kampala is not Banadir, where supporters simply applaud the President,” the minister said. “This was a meeting of countries that have committed enormous financial and military resources to the peace and stability that much of Somalia enjoys today, alongside the sacrifices made by our own Somali security forces.” The minister suggested that countries contributing troops and financial support to Somalia have a legitimate interest in discussing both the country’s security challenges and the political disputes that could undermine hard-won gains against Al-Shabaab. He went further, accusing President Hassan Sheikh of presenting Somalis with what he described as a false political choice: either accept his continued rule or face national collapse. “The President appears to be telling the Somali people that either his government remains in power, or the country descends into chaos and violence,” Abdifatah alleged. He argued that such rhetoric risks deepening political polarization at a time when Somalia requires broader national consensus. Concluding his statement, the Jubaland minister expressed confidence that political accountability would eventually prevail. “Leaders are coming together, difficult truths are being spoken, and, God willing, accountability will come,” he wrote in a brief message posted on his official Facebook page. Growing Regional Concern The exchange underscores the widening rift between the Federal Government and some Federal Member States, particularly Jubaland, as disagreements over elections, constitutional reforms, and power-sharing continue to dominate Somalia’s political landscape. The Kampala summit highlighted an increasingly shared view among Somalia’s regional partners that sustainable security cannot be separated from political stability. While the summit’s principal agenda centered on the future of AUSSOM and securing long-term funding for the mission, discussions also reflected growing concern that Somalia’s unresolved political divisions could jeopardize gains made against militant groups. As Somalia approaches another critical political period, the increasingly public war of words between Mogadishu and regional leaders illustrates the formidable challenge of achieving both military success and political consensus—objectives many regional partners now regard as inseparable. items.title: Puntland 28 Sano Kadib: Dib-u-milicsiga Sooyaalka iyo Jiheynta Mustaqbalka
items.description: Curashadii Puntland ee  1-dii Agoosto 1998  waxay iftiin iyo rajo weyn u ahayd bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Todobo sano kadib burburkii dowladdii dhexe ee Soomaaliya, waxay dib u soo noolaysay rajadii ahayd in dowladnimo, kala dambayn iyo nabad laga hirgelin karo qayb ka mid ah dalka, isla markaana ay horseedi karto dib u unkidda dowlad Federaal ah oo mideysa ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Himiladii iyo hanka Soomaaliyeed ee ay lahaayeen aasaasayaashii Puntland waxay noqdeen mabda’ sharaf leh iyo aragti fog oo dhiirrigelisay Soomaali badan. Taasi waa sababta Puntland loogu naanayso  “Hooyada Federaalka Soomaaliyeed” , maadaama ay hormuud u noqotay hirgelinta nidaamka federaalka ee markii dambe saldhig u noqday dowladnimada Soomaaliya. Guushaasi-se ma ahayn mid si sahlan ku timid. Waxay ahayd natiijada dadaal, tanaasul iyo shirar adag oo ay galeen isimadii dhaqanka, siyaasiyiintii iyo waxgaradkii Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo gartay in xasilloonida dhulkooda ay tahay tallaabada ugu horreysa ee lagu soo celin karo dowladnimadii Soomaaliyeed ee luntay. Muddo 28 sano ah, Puntland waxay gaartay horumar muuqda dhinacyo badan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, weli waxaa jira hawlo badan oo u baahan in la qabto. Sidaas darteed, sanad-guuradani waa inay noqotaa fursad lagu milicsado wixii la soo maray, lagu qiimeeyo halka la joogo, laguna dejiyo hiigsi cad oo ku wajahan mustaqbalka. Dowlad kasta waxaa dhisa aragti iyo qadiyad ay u taagan tahay. Sidaas awgeed, waxaa waajib ku ah jiilkii aasaasay Puntland iyo madaxda maanta joogta inay jiilka soo koraya u gudbiyaan himilada iyo qiyamka dowladnimada, si ay u noqoto dhaxal ay jiilba jiilka kale uga tagaan. Qadiyaddu ma aha mid is beddesha, balse waa la cusboonaysiin karaa hababka lagu gaadhayo himiladeeda. Mashruuca dowladnimadu waa aragti ay jiilashu wadaagaan, kuna suntan quluubta waayeelka iyo dhalinyarada. Qadiyadda Puntland ma ahayn mid ka dhalatay duruufo keliya, balse waxay salka ku haysay halgan qaran iyo himilo Soomaaliyeed oo soo taxnayd muddo dheer. Waxay ka dhaxashay iftiinkii dhaqdhaqaaqyadii gobannimo-doonka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan doorkii  SYL , taasoo muujinaysa in dowladnimadu tahay mashruuc jiilal badan ay wada dhiseen. Sanad-guuradan waxay ku soo beegmaysaa xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahaysay caqabado siyaasadeed iyo kuwo amni oo halis gelinaya wadajirkeeda. Khilaafaadka dastuuriga ah, jahawareerka doorashooyinka, musuqmaasuqa, hoggaan xumada iyo faragelinta shisheeye ayaa caqabad ku noqday horumarka dowladnimada. Waxaa intaas dheer isbeddellada istaraatiijiyadeed ee ka socda Geeska Afrika iyo colaadaha caalamiga ah, kuwaas oo Soomaaliya, maadaama ay ku taallo marin istaraatiiji ah, ka dhigaya meel ay saameyntoodu si toos ah u gaarto. Marxaladdan, waxaa lama huraan ah in la adkeeyo midnimada iyo wadajirka bulshada reer Puntland. Waa in si mideysan looga hortagaa khatar kasta oo dibadda uga timaadda, iyadoo aan loo oggolaan faragelin dhaawici karta madax-bannaanida iyo xasilloonida Puntland. Sidoo kale, waxaa masuuliyad kawada saaranmuxaafidka iyo mucaaradka ilaalinta dowladnimada iyo danta guud. Xukuumadda waxaa si gaar ah loogafilayaa inay xoojiso wadajirka bulshada, isu keentoaragtiyaha kala duwan, dhegaysatana codadkadhaliilsan siyaasaddeeda. Dulqaadka siyaasadeed, ilaalinta xuquuqda dastuuriga ah iyo aqbalidda kala aragti duwanaanta ayaa ah tiirarka dowladnimo waarta. Waxaa sidoo kale muhiim ah in xukuumadda ay sidaacadnimo leh uga jawaabto tabashooyinka bulshadaiyo gaabiska adeegyada dowladda. Caddaaladda bulshada, isla xisaabtanka iyo maamul wanaaggu waa tiirarka lagu ilaaliyo dowladnimo iyo wadajir bulsho. Puntland iyo Marxaladda Soo Socota Puntland waxaa horyaalla ajande muhiim u ah mustaqbalkeeda iyo kaalinteeda Soomaaliya, waxaana ka mid ah: • Ka qayb qaadashada xal waara oo laga gaaro khilaafaadka dastuurka iyo doorashooyinka Federaalka Soomaaliya. • Dhamaystirka geeddi-socodka dimuqraadiyeynta iyo shuruucda doorashooyinka Puntland. • Xoojinta wada hadalka siyaasadeed iyo dhageysiga aragtiyada mucaaradka iyo bulshada rayidka ah. • Dhismaha hay’ad madax-bannaan oo la dagaallanta musuqmaasuqa, kana shaqeysa maamul wanaag iyo isla xisaabtan. Sidoo kale ilaalintamadaxbanaanida Hay’adda Hanti-dhowrkaPuntland. • Dardargelinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, gaar ahaanwaddooyinka Ceeldaahir–Badhan, Xarfo–Gaalkacyo, Bosaso – Qandala, Kalabayr–Caluula, Dangorayo – Eyl iyo Garacad–Tuurdibi, iyo dhamaystirka adeegyada DekeddahaBoosaso iyo Garacad iyo dib-u-dhiska Garoonka Diyaaradaha Gaalkacyo. • Dhisidda isbitaallo takhasus leh iyo gaarsiinta adeegyada caafimaadka deegaannada fogfog. • Xal u helidda biyo yarida iyo abaaraha soonoqnoqda iyo saamaynta isbadelka cimilada. • Tayaynta Waxbarashada asaasiga ah iyo tan sare, iyadoo muhiim ay tahay xukuumaddu inay fuliso miisaaniyadda waxbarashada oo aan helin wax ku filan. • Dhismaha xarumo cilmi baaris iyo kuwahorumarineed kuwaasoo dowladda ka caawiyajihaynta iyo dajinta qorshayaal istiraatiiji ah.  • Casriyeynta Ciidanka Daraawiishta, hubinta xuquuqdooda, tayeyntooda iyo qalabayntooda, si loo helo ciidan qaran oo beddela ku tiirsanaanta maleeshiyaad beeleed. • Dib-u-habaynta garsoorka iyo xaqiijinta caddaalad hufan oo bulshada kalsooni ku qabto. Ugu dambayn, xuska sanad-guurada 28-aad waa inuusan ku ekaan dabaaldeg iyo lulidda calanka oo keliya. Waa inuu noqdaa toddobaad lagu xusuusto taariikhdii aasaaska Puntland, lagu maamuuso haldoorkii dhisay, laguna baro jiilka cusub halgankii, himiladii iyo qiyamkii ay Puntland ku dhalatay. Waxaa habboon in la qabto doodo, waraysiyo iyo barnaamijyo ay ka qayb qaataan aasaasayaashii Puntland iyo jiilalka dambe, si bulshada loogu gudbiyo waayo-aragnimadii iyo casharradii laga bartay safarkii dheeraa ee dowladnimada. Xukuumaddu waa inayErgooyinka ay ku martiqaadayso munaasabadan ay noqdan kuwa wax kusoo kordhinaya reer Puntland xambaari karana fariinta iyo qadiyada reer Puntland.  Bulsho aan taariikhdeeda aqooni ma dhisi karto mustaqbal adag. Sidaas darteed, waa in sanad-guuradu noqotaa isku xiraha  tagtada, joogtada iyo hiigsiga mustaqbalka , si jiil walba u fahmo halka laga yimid iyo halka loo socdo. Sanad-guuro Wacan Puntland. items.title: Maxay ka wada-hadleen Cirro iyo wafdiga Mareykanka? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi (Cirro), ayaa maanta maanta kulan gaar la qaatay wafdi sare oo ka socday dowladda Mareykanka, kaas oo uu hoggaaminayo Major General Claude K. Tudor Jr. oo ah Taliyaha Ciidamada hawl-gallada gaarka ah ee Maraykanka ee Afrika (Special Operations Commander of Africa- SOCAFRICA). Wafdigan ayaa si heer sare loogu soo dhaweeyay qasriga madaxtooyada Somaliland, halkaas oo uu ka dhacay kulanka labada dhinac oo looga hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan xaaladda Somaliland iyo arrimaha gobolka. Ugu horreyn Madaxweyne Cirro ayaa Major General Claude K. Tudor iyo wefdiga uu horkacayo uga mahadceliyay booqashada ay ku yimaadeen magaalada Hargeysa, isaga oo tilmaamay inay xoojineyso xiriirka labada dhinac. Intaas kadib kulanka ayaa si qoto dheer loogu lafa-guray xoojinta iskaashiga amniga iyo danaha kale ee ay wadaagaan Somaliland iyo Maraykanka, gaar ahaan sugidda amniga Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo guud ahaanba amniga iyo xasilloonida Gobolka Geeska Afrika. Cabdiraxmaan Cirro ayaa tilmaamay in Somaliland ay tahay meesha ugu muhiimsan marka la eego ilaalinta amniga Marin-biyoodka gobolka (Badda Cas, Bab Al-Mandab iyo Gacanka Cadmeed), ayna leedahay in ka badan 850 KM oo xeeb ah oo ku teedsan mid ka mid ah marin-biyoodada ugu muhiimsan adduunka. Waxaa kale oo uu xusay in amniga xeebaha Somaliland uu yahay qayb ka mid ah amniga gobolka iyo kan caalamkaba. Sidoo kale, wuxuu hoosta ka xarriiqay in ay lagama maarmaan tahay in cid kasta oo danaynaysa iskaashiga amni ee xeebaha Somaliland ay si toos ah ula shaqayso kalana hadasho Somaliland oo kaliya. Madaxweynuhu waxa kale oo uu xaqiijiyey in Somaliland ay tahay nabad, isla markaana leh hay’ado dawli ah oo dhisan iyo hannaan siyaasadeed oo dimuqraadi ah. Dhankiisa, Major General Claude K. Tudor Jr. ayaa sheegay in Maraykanka iyo Somaliland ay wadaagaan dano amni oo muhiim ah oo khuseeya berriga iyo baddaba, isaga oo xusay in xasilloonida Geeska Afrika iyo amniga marin-biyoodka caalamiga ahi ay yihiin mudnaan muhiim u ah labada dhinacba. Waxa uu intaa ku daray in Maraykanku diyaar u yahay in uu Somaliland si dhow ugala shaqeeyo arrimaha istaraatiijiga ah ee labada dhinacba danta u ah, isla markaana la sii xoojiyo wada-shaqaynta, xog-is-dhaafsiga, isdhaafsiga khibradaha iyo iskaashiga amni ee mustaqbalka. Ugu dambeyn Kulanka ayaa ku soo dhamaday is-afgarad iyo in labada dhinac ay sii xoojiyaan ka wada shaqaynta danaha muhiimka ah ee la wadaago. items.title: AFRICOM Reaffirms Support for Somalia’s Territorial Integrity
items.description: Washington (WDN) – The commander of the United States Africa Command (AFRICOM), General Dagvin R. Anderson, has firmly dismissed speculation that Washington is preparing to recognize Somaliland, reaffirming that longstanding U.S. policy remains firmly committed to the sovereignty, unity, and territorial integrity of the Federal Republic of Somalia. Speaking on U.S. policy toward the Horn of Africa, General Anderson made it clear that the United States has no plans to alter its position on Somaliland’s status, despite recurring speculation fueled by high-level visits and growing security cooperation with authorities in Hargeisa. The AFRICOM commander also rejected reports suggesting that the United States intends to establish a military base in Somaliland. He explained that previous visits by AFRICOM officials to Somaliland were conducted solely for security assessments and cooperation discussions and should not be interpreted as evidence of plans for a permanent American military presence or a shift in Washington’s diplomatic policy. “The visits were related to security cooperation and assessments,” Anderson indicated, emphasizing that they do not signal any intention to establish a U.S. military installation or recognize Somaliland as an independent state. Reaffirming Washington’s partnership with Mogadishu, Anderson said the United States will continue supporting Somalia’s efforts to strengthen national security, promote stability, and advance long-term development. He stressed that the United States remains committed to working alongside the Federal Government of Somalia in addressing shared security challenges, particularly the fight against terrorism and efforts to build capable national institutions. The AFRICOM chief added that the United States stands ready to cooperate with a Somali government committed to tackling security threats while advancing the mutual interests shared by both countries. items.title: Puntland Parliament Approves Constitutional Amendments, Leaves Presidential Term Limits Unchanged
items.description: Garowe (WDN) —Puntland’s Parliament has overwhelmingly approved a package of constitutional amendments proposed by the administration of President Said Abdullahi Deni, marking another significant step in the region’s ongoing institutional and electoral reforms. The amendments were passed during Thursday’s parliamentary session with broad support, signaling a rare consensus among lawmakers on key governance issues. Notably, Article 79 of the Puntland Constitution—which governs the presidential term of office and has been one of the most contentious issues in Puntland politics—was left untouched. The provision had been the focus of sustained criticism from opposition politicians, who had feared that the government might seek to alter presidential term limits. Addressing the media after the vote, MP Yasin Jama Omar confirmed that Article 79 was not among the constitutional provisions submitted by the executive for amendment, effectively leaving the existing presidential tenure provisions intact. Instead, Parliament approved amendments to Articles 37, 41, 44, 47, 74, 81, 90, 113, and 126 of the Puntland Constitution. According to lawmakers, the revised provisions primarily relate to Puntland’s transition toward one person, one vote elections, civilian financial administration, judicial tenure, and other institutional governance matters designed to strengthen the region’s constitutional framework. The amendments were adopted by an overwhelming majority. According to an official statement issued by the Puntland Parliament, 41 lawmakers voted in favor, none voted against, while four members abstained. The unanimous support among those casting votes in favor reflects a broad parliamentary consensus on the proposed reforms, despite the political sensitivities that have surrounded constitutional changes in Puntland in recent years. The decision is expected to provide greater clarity for Puntland’s electoral and governance agenda as the administration continues implementing institutional reforms aimed at strengthening democratic governance and modernizing public institutions. By leaving the politically sensitive presidential term provision unchanged while advancing reforms in other areas, the Puntland government appears to have sought a balance between responding to opposition concerns and moving forward with its broader constitutional reform program. Political observers are likely to view the outcome as an attempt to reduce tensions over executive tenure while maintaining momentum on electoral reform, institutional development, and the modernization of Puntland’s constitutional framework. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan oo ku adkeystay in dowladda ay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u furay Kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, kaddib kulan wadajir ah oo ay Xildhibaanada Labada Aqal ku yeesheen xarunta Villa Hargaysa. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo khudbad dhinacyo badan taabanaysa ka jeediyay kulanka ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda guud ee dalka, gaar ahaan arrimaha amniga, siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha iyo guulaha la taaban karo ee ay xaqiijisay dowladdiisa. Ugu horreyn Madaxweynaha ayaa bogaadiyey Guddoonka iyo Xildhibaannada Labada Gole ee Baarlamaanka, isaga oo ku ammaanay doorka wax ku oolka ah ee ay ka qaateen dowlad-dhiska dalka, xoojinta isla xisaabtanka hay’adaha dowladda, horumarinta sharciyada muhiimka u ah qaranka iyo matalaadda danaha shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, wuxuu si qoto dheer uga hadlay xaaladda guud ee dalka, waxa uuna tilmaamay in dowladdu ay sii waddo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga, xasilloonida iyo horumarka Soomaaliya, isla markqqna guulo la taaban karo laga gaaray dagaalka lagula jiro Khawaarijta, kuwaas oo ay hormuud u yihiin Ciidamada Qalabka Sida Soomaaliyeed oo garab ka helaya shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha ayaa iftiimiyey horumarka laga gaaray geeddi-socodka dimuqraadiyeynta dalka, isaga oo adkeeyey sida ay dowladda uga go’an tahay hirgelinta doorashooyin toos ah oo ku dhisan rabitaanka shacabka, si loo xaqiijiyo hannaan siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, laguna xoojiyo dowladnimada iyo ka qaybgalka muwaadiniinta. Furitaanka Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa kusoo aaday, iyada oo ay jiraan caqabado siyaasadeed oo waaweyn, kuwaas oo la xiriira sharciyadda kalfadhiga sannadka dheeraadka ah. Arrintan ayaa sii xoojisay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ka taagan hay’adaha federaalka. Kalfadhigan waxaa Labada Gole eE Baarlamaanka horyaalla shaqooyin adag, iyadoo ajandaha ugu horreeyo uu noqonayo qabashada doorashada guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka, maadaama uu xilkaas banneeyay Aadan Madoobe oo dhawaan loo doortay Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo khudbad u jeediyay Xildhibaanada Labada Aqal (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo maanta furay Kalfadhigga 8aad ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka ayaa khudbad ka jeediyay Xarunta Villa Hargeisa ee Magaalada Muqdisho. Madaxweynaha ayaa ka hadlay arrimo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, doorashooyinka, wax ka bedelkii iyo dhameystirkii horaantii sanadkan lagu sameeyay Dastuurka KMG, iyadoo Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka iyo Senatorada Golaha Aqalka Sare ay dhageysanayeen. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo kaashanaya shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay guulo la taaban karo ka gaareen dagaalka lagu la jiro kooxaha argagixisada. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa ballanqaaday in la sii wadi doono dadaalada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka, oo fure u ah in laga adkaado argagixisada. Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka ayaa ku celiyay go’aanka dowladdiisa ee hirgelinta doorashooyinka toos ah oo waafaqsan rabitaanka shacabka. Madaxweynaha ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda hannaanka siyaasadeed ee loo dhan yahay, si loo xoojiyo ka qaybgalka muwaadiniinta. “Doorashooyinkii ka qabsoomay Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed iyo tartanka doorasho ee hadda ka socda weli Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, waxay caddeynayaan in Somaliya ay ka gudubtay xilligii ay doorashadu ku koobneyd heshiisyo siyaasadeed oo cid gaar ah yeelato. Waxaan u tallaabsanay hannaan muwaadinka Soomaaliyeed uu codkiisa leeyahay qiimi sharci ah iyo mid sinnaan ah, taas waa guul dastuuri ah, waa guul dimoqraadi ah, waa guul ay wada leeyihiin shacabka Soomaaliyeed.” Ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka 11aad ku amaanay inay qaateen masuuliyadda ah in la dhameystiro Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda, ka dib sanado badan oo uu soo jiitamayay dhameystirkiisa. “Muddo dheer shacabka Soomaaliyeed waxay sugayeen in la helo hannaan doorasho oo dadweynuhu ay ku soo doortaan wakiiladooda. Waxay sugayeen dadka Soomaaliyeed in Somaliya ay yeelato sharciyo casri ah oo la jaan-qaadayo dowladnimada casriga ah. Waxay sugayeen Baarlamaan ka shaqeeya mustaqbalka dalka, halkii uu ku mashquulsanaan lahaa khilaafaad siyaasadeed oo aan dhammaad lahayn. Intaas oo masuuliyaddooda ah idinka oo tixgelinaya ayaa waxaad noqoteen Baarlamaankii qaatay masuuliyaddaas, isla-markaana xaqiijiyay gudashadeeda. Waxaad noqoteen Baarlamaankii dhameystiray dib-u-eegista Dastuurkii KMG ahaa.” Ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa wax nasiib darro ah ku tilmaamay in siyaasiyiinta qaarkood ay ka horyimaadaan dhameystirka iyo ansixinta dastuurka cusub, xilli sida uu sheegay uu mudnaan u leeyahay horu-socodka dalka, taasoo uu sheegay in laga gudbi doono.

items.title: Hambalyo 28-guurada Aasaaska Puntland
items.description: Hambalyo 28-guurada Aasaaska Puntland Anigoo ka mid ah waayeelka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, waxaan hambalyo iyo salaan sharaf u dirayaa Dowladda iyo shacabka Puntland munaasabadda 28-guurada aasaaska Puntland. Waxaan Alle SWT uga baryayaa inuu Puntland ku gallado nabad waarta, amni sugan, xasillooni, horumar joogto ah iyo barwaaqo. Waxaan rajaynayaa in xidhiidhka derisnimo ee u dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Puntland uu sii xoojisto is-ixtiraamka, deris-wanaagga, wada noolaanshaha nabadda ku dhisan iyo iskaashiga wax-ku-oolka ah ee dan u ah labada dhinac iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika. Munaasabaddan awgeed, waxaan mar kale Dowladda iyo shacabka Puntland u dirayaa hambalyo iyo duco wanaagsan. Sultan Abdikariim Dagaal. Carrada Ilaahay Nabad Weeye.

items.title: Mid ka mid golaha wasiirrada DF oo is casilay + Sababta
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiiru dowlaha wasaaradda arrimaha gudaha Soomaaliya, Saadaad Maxamed Nuur (Caliyow), sidoo kalena ah Xildhibaan ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka ayaa maanta ku dhawaaqay inuu is-casilay kadib shir jaraa’id oo uu ku qabtay xarunta Villa Hargeysa ee magaalada Muqdisho. Saadaad oo saddexdii sano ee lasoo dhaafay ka tirsanaa Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa hadda u tartamaya xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo uu horay u banneeyay Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo isna loo doortay Madaxweynaha cusub ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Wasiirka ayaa sababta is casilaaddiisa ku sheegay inuu galayo tartan adag, uuna doonayo inuu xaqiijiyo damaciisa ku aadan xilka guddoomiyaha. “Maanta oo Taariikhda tahay 01/08/2026 waxaa rabaa inaan halkaan kula wadaago inaan iska casiley Xilka Wasiirdowlaha Arrimaha Gudaha Federaalka iyo dib uheshiisiinta. Waxaa go’aansadey inaan hankeyga iyo damaceyga xaqiijiyo oo ah inaan musharax u ahay Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Waxaa mahad oo dhan u sugnaatey Allahii igu simay mudada 3 sanadood aan joogey,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Saadaad Caliyow. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ka codsaday guddoomiyaha KMG ah ee Baarlamaanka Sacdiya Yaasiin inay qabato doorasho xalaal ah oo ay u siman yihiin xildhibaannada tartamaya. “Waxaan rajaynayaa in doorashada ay noqoto mid loo siman yahay dadka musharrixiinta ahna ay u siman yihiin cadaaladna ah,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Loollan xooggan ayaa loogu jiraa kursigii uu banneeyay Sheekh Aadan Madoobe, waxaana u hanqal taaaya siyaasiyiin kasoo jeedo Koonfur Galbeed, oo saami ahaan leh kursiga, kuwaas haatan wada olole ay ku doonayaan inay kusoo buuxiyaan. Siyaasiyiinta caddeeyay musharraxnimadooda waxaa kale oo kamid ah Wasiirka Dekedaha, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo dhawaan soo qaatay kursi xildhibaannimo, kaas oo hadda olole ka wada magaalada Muqdisho. Kalfadhigga Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta furmay, maadaama uu kororsaday hal sano si lamid ah hay’adaha kale ee dowladda, waxaana shaqada ugu horreysa ay noqoneysaa in lasoo doorto guddoomiye cusub. Waxaa go’aansadey inaan hankeyga iyo damaceyga xaqiijiyo oo ah inaan musharax u ahay Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Waxaa mahad oo dhan u sugnaatey Allahii igu simay mudada 3 sanadood aan joogey,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Saadaad Caliyow. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo furay Kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u furay Kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, kaddib kulan wadajir ah oo Xildhibaanada Labada Aqal ee Golaha Shacabka iyo Aqalka Sare isugu yimaadeen xarunta Villa Hargaysa. Madaxweynaha oo khudbad dhinacyo badan taabanaysa ka jeediyay kulanka ayaa ugu horreyn bogaadiyey Guddoonka iyo Xildhibaannada Labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka, isaga oo ku ammaanay doorka wax ku oolka ah ee ay ka qaateen dowlad-dhiska dalka, xoojinta isla xisaabtanka hay’adaha dowladda, horumarinta sharciyada muhiimka u ah qaranka iyo matalaadda danaha shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha ayaa si qoto dheer uga hadlay xaaladda guud ee dalka, waxa uuna tilmaamay in dowladdu ay sii waddo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga, xasilloonida iyo horumarka Soomaaliya, isla markqqna guulo la taaban karo laga gaaray dagaalka lagula jiro Khawaarijta, kuwaas oo ay hormuud u yihiin Ciidamada Qalabka Sida Soomaaliyeed oo garab ka helaya shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in horumarka laga gaaray geeddi-socodka dimuqraadiyeynta dalka, isaga oo tilmaamay in dowladda ay ka go’an tahay hirgelinta doorashooyin toos ah oo ku dhisan rabitaanka shacabka, si loo xaqiijiyo hannaan siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, laguna xoojiyo dowladnimada iyo ka qaybgalka muwaadiniinta. The post Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo furay Kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Xasan oo baarlamanka ka sheegay arrin loo ogolyahay mucaaradka dowladda
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo maanta si rasmi u furay kalfadhiga labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka ayaa ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan xaaladda dalka. Xasan Sheekh ayaa khudbadiisa kusoo hadal qaaday xaaladda siyaasadeed ee ka taagan dalka, isaga oo u jawaabay xubnaha mucaaradka ee haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ka wada gudaha magaalada Muqdisho. Madaxweynaha ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in dowladdu ogoshahay banaanbax iyo isku imaatin, balse aysan aqbali doonin in hub lasoo qaato, lana qalqal-geliyo amniga dalka. “Maanta qof kasta afkiisa xor ayuu u yahay Jasiira teg hoteel kale tag inta aanan amniga shacabka waxa u dhimeynin oo aadan qoray la cararaynin xor ayaa u tahay. Banaanbaxaa furan isu imaatin aya furay, talaa furan,” ayuuyiri Xasan Sheekh. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas kusii daray “Awoodda qoray qaadashada iyo haddii wax lagu fulinayo sharciga dowladda ayuu siiyay bis, dowladda lafteeda sida ay rabto ma ahan, waana iska ilaalinaa in aan loo baahan”. Sidoo kale, wuxuu hoosta ka xariiqay in dowladda Soomaaliyeed ay dadaal xooggan ku bixisay amniga dalka iyo hormarka dowladnimada, isla markaana ay ka go’an tahay in lasii wado geeddi socodka dowlad dhiska Soomaaliya. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo horay mucaaradka iyo dowladda ay ugu dagaalameen xaafado ka tirsan magaalada Muqdisho, kadib dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ay degmooyinka qaar ka sameeyeen xubno kamid ah Golaha Mustaqbalka oo ay ku mideysan yihiin Madasha Samatabixinta, Jubbaland iyo Puntland. Soomaaliya ayaa haatan ku jirto marxalad hubanti la’aan ah, waxaana la’isku hayaa hannaanka doorashada iyo wax ka beddelka dastuurka KMG ee dalka. items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo beeniyay in lacag laga qaadayo maraakiibta mara Badda Cas
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa beeniyay wararka sheegaya in ururka reer Yemen uu wado qorshe ay ku canshuurayaan maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraya Marinka Bab El-Mandeb iyo Badda Cas. Ururka ayaa sheegay inaanu jirin wax qorshe ah oo ay ku doonayaan inay lacago uga qaadaan maraakiibta maraya Badda Cas, iyagoona sheegay in marinka biyahaasi uu weli yahay mid bilaash ah. Diidmada ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay bayaan ay maanta soo saartay Xarunta Isku-dubaridka Howlaha Bani’aadantinimada (HOCC) ee ay maamulaan Xuutiyiintu, taas oo kormeerta dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta ee Marinka Bab El-Mandeb. HOCC ayaa sheegtay in adeegsiga marinka uu yahay mid ikhtiyaari oo bilaash ah, iyadoo raacisay in qof kasta oo lacag ka dalbada marinkaasi uusan metelin Yemen ama HOCC. Waxay ku boorisay shirkadaha maraakiibta inaysan bixin lacag ama aysan macluumaad la wadaagin dhinacyo aan loo idman inay howshaas qabtaan. Bayaanka ayaa daba socda warbixin ay Wakaaladda Wararka Reuters qortay Arbacadii, iyadoo soo xiganeysa ilo wareedyo gobolka ah oo sheegaya in Xuutiyiinta ay ka fiirsanayaan inay lacago ku soo rogaan maraakiibta ka gudbaya marin biyoodka, sagaal maalmood ka dib, markii ururku uu ku dhawaaqay xayiraad dhanka badda ah oo ka dhan ah Dekedaha Sacuudiga. Marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb, oo ah albaabka koonfureed ee laga galo Badda Cas ayaa isku xira Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas, waxaana adeegsada maraakiibta booyadaha shidaalka iyo kuwa kale ee shixnadaha ganacisga ee u kala gooshaya Asia, Yurub iyo Waqooyiga Mareykanka. Dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta ee Badda Cas ayaa si weyn hoos ugu dhacay, ka dib markii Xuutiyiinta ay ku weerareen maraakiib lala xiriiriyay Sacuudiga.

items.title: Somalia’s Federal Parliament to Open Eighth Session Amid Leadership Contest
items.description: MOGADISHU — The eighth session of Somalia’s Federal Parliament is expected to formally open today at Villa Hargeysa, where President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud will deliver the constitutionally mandated opening address. Members of both the House of the People and the Upper House returned to Mogadishu on Friday to attend the opening ceremony and resume parliamentary proceedings. President Mohamud’s address is expected to outline the country’s current political and security situation, the ongoing military campaign against Al-Shabaab, and the Federal Government’s priorities for the coming months. Following the opening ceremony, lawmakers are expected to begin the process of appointing an electoral committee tasked with organising the election of the Speaker of the House of the People. The election is expected to take place within a short timeframe. Competition for the speakership has intensified, with several candidates conducting campaigns to secure the support of members of Parliament. Separately, reports indicate that President Mohamud may travel to frontline areas following the parliamentary opening to assess military operations being conducted by government forces and local community fighters against Al-Shabaab. items.title: Imaaraadka Carabta oo u hoyday Iran kadib ciqaab adag
items.description: Abu Dhabi (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa si taxaddar leh dib ugu furtay waddooyinka diblomaasiyadeed iyo kuwa ganacsi ee kala dhexeeya Iran, iyadoo isku dayaysa inay yareyso khatarta amni ee ka imaanaysa Tehran, isla markaana dib u soo nooleyso dhaqaalaha ay dagaallada gobolka saameeyeen. Tallaabadan ayaa qeyb ka ah istaraatiijiyad halis badan oo Abu Dhabi ay ku dooneyso inay xiriir shaqo la yeelato Iran, iyadoo aan wiiqayn iskaashiga difaac ee ay la leedahay Mareykanka iyo Israel. Shan bilood kadib markii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Iran ay qalqal geliyeen xarunta maaliyadda ee Dubai, bankiyada caalamiga ah, shirkadaha maareeya hantida iyo ganacsatada ayaa mar kale billaabay inay ku soo laabtaan magaalada. Doomaha dhaqanka ee loo yaqaanno dhows-ka ayaa dib u billaabay inay badeecooyin u kala qaadaan dekedaha Dubai iyo Iran, halka duulimaadyada ka imanaya Iran ay mar kale ka degayaan garoonka caalamiga ah ee Dubai. Mas’uuliyiinta Imaaraadka ayaa sidoo kale u oggolaaday inay dalka ku soo laabtaan ku dhowaad 20,000 oo qof oo Iranian ah oo dibadda ku xayirmay markii uu dagaalku billowday. Sida lagu sheegay warbixin faahfaahsan oo uu daabacay wargeyska Financial Times, dadaalladan ayaa qeyb ka ah qorshe ballaaran oo Imaaraadku ku doonayo inuu dib ugu soo celiyo noloshii caadiga ahayd, kadib qalalaasihii ugu cuslaa ee dalka soo mara tan iyo markii uu xornimada qaatay sanadkii 1971-kii. Hase yeeshee, isku dayga lagu dejinayo xiriirka Tehran ayaa weli ah mid jilicsan, maadaama xabbad-joojintii u dhexeysay Iran iyo Mareykanka ay sii daciifeyso, xiisaduhuna ay ka sii socdaan dalalka Khaliijka. Laakiin inaad muddo dheer si liidata u sii shaqeyso ayaa ka daran.” Ganacsigu wuxuu billaabay inuu soo kabsado bishii June, balse September ayaa noqon doonta imtixaanka ugu weyn. Dib u furitaanka iskuullada ayaa muujin doona tirada qoysaska ajaanibta ah ee dalka ku soo laabtay, halka cimilada qabow ay tijaabin doonto awoodda Dubai ee dib loogu soo jiidan karo dalxiisayaasha. Imaaraadka oo xoojinaya adkeysiga Qalalaasaha ayaa ereyga “adkeysi” ka dhigay tiirka ugu weyn ee qorshayaasha mustaqbalka Imaaraadka. Dowladdu waxay ka fiirsaneysaa in dhuumaha shidaalka iyo xarumaha xogta ee muhiimka ah dhulka hoostiisa la geliyo, lana xoojiyo kaydka cuntada iyo bakhaarrada badeecooyinka muhiimka ah. Shirkadda DP World ayaa qorsheyneysa inay laba terminal ka dhisto Fujairah, oo ku taalla xeebta bari ee Imaaraadka, si loo yareeyo ku-tiirsanaanta dekedda Jebel Ali ee ku taalla gudaha marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Shirkadda shidaalka qaranka ee ADNOC ayaa sidoo kale dardargelineysa dhismaha dhuun shidaal oo lagu doonayo in lagu labanlaabo awoodda dhoofinta ee dekedda Fujairah. Hase yeeshee, mas’uuliyiinta iyo khubarada ayaa qiraya in Imaaraadku uusan meesha ka saari karin dhammaan khataraha ku xeeran. “Dubai iyo Abu Dhabi waxay sameyn karaan wax kasta oo ay awoodaan, laakiin dhibaatadu waxay tahay in arrimahan oo dhan aan xal loo heli karin,” ayuu yiri la-taliye la hadlay Financial Times. “Xarumaha tamarta qaarkood waxay ku yaallaan badda, sidaas darteed way furnaan doonaan. Xitaa haddii shidaalka laga dhoofiyo Fujairah, weli wuxuu ku jiraa meel ay weerarradu gaari karaan.” Imaaraadka ayaa hadda sharad ku gelaya inuu sii ahaan karo xulafada amni ee Mareykanka iyo Israel, isagoo dhinaca kale xiriir ganacsi iyo wadahadal ku dhisan dano gaar ah la yeelanaya Iran. “Dubai waddo kasta ayay tijaabin doontaa,” ayuu yiri maamulaha Imaaraatiga ah. “Fikrado badan ayaa la qiimeynayaa, laakiin dhammaantood waxay macno yeelanayaan oo keliya haddii dagaalku si dhab ah u dhammaado.” The post Imaaraadka Carabta oo u hoyday Iran kadib ciqaab adag appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.description: 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐰𝐞𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐡𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐤𝐮𝐥𝐚𝐧 𝐦𝐮𝐡𝐢𝐢𝐦 𝐚𝐡 𝐥𝐚 𝐲𝐞𝐞𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐲 𝐓𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐂𝐢𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐇𝐚𝐰𝐥-𝐠𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐚 𝐚𝐡 𝐞𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐤𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐞𝐞 𝐀𝐟𝐫𝐢𝐤𝐚 Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa maanta kulan muhiim ah oo istaraatiiji ah la yeeshay Major General Claude K. Tudor Jr. oo ah Taliyaha Ciidamada Hawl-gallada Gaarka ah ee Maraykanka ee Afrika (Special Operations Commander of Africa- SOCAFRICA) iyo wefti ballaadhan oo uu hoggaaminayo. Madaxweynaha ayaa ugu horrayn Major General Claude K. Tudor iyo weftiga ballaadhan ee uu hoggaaminayey uga mahad naqay booqashada ay ku yimaadeen Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Kulanka waxa si qoto dheer loogu lafa-guray xoojinta iskaashiga amniga iyo danaha istaraatiijiga ah ee ay wadaagaan Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Dawladda Maraykanka, gaar ahaan sugidda amniga Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo guud ahaanba amniga iyo xasilloonida Gobolka Geeska Afrika. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu tilmaamay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay tahay dalka ugu muhiimsan marka la eego ilaalinta amniga Marin-biyoodka gobolka (Badda Cas, Bab Al-Mandab iyo Gacanka Cadmeed) iyada oo leh in ka badan 850 km oo xeeb ah oo ku teedsan mid ka mid ah marin-biyoodada ugu muhiimsan adduunka. Waxa uu xusay in amniga Xeebaha Somaliland uu yahay qayb ka mid ah amniga Gobolka iyo kan Caalamkaba. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in aan Somaliland indhaha laga lalin karin, isla markaana ay lagama maarmaan tahay in cid kasta oo danaynaysa iskaashiga amni ee Xeebaha Somaliland ay si toos ah ula shaqayso kalana hadasho Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Madaxweynuhu waxa kale oo uu xaqiijiyey in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay tahay dal muddo ka badan 35 sano nabad ah, xasilloon, leh hay’ado Dawli ah oo dhisan iyo hannaan siyaasadeed oo dimuqraadi ah. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si cad u tibaaxay in Somaliland ay diyaar u tahay in ay iskaashi dhow oo joogto ah la yeelato Ciidamada iyo Hay’adaha amniga kala duwan ee dalka Maraykanka, si loo xoojiyo la-dagaallanka argagixisada, budhcad-badeedda, dambiyada abaabulan iyo khataraha kale ee saamaynta ku leh nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Dhankiisa, Major General Claude K. Tudor Jr. ayaa sheegay in Maraykanka iyo Somaliland ay wadaagaan dano amni oo muhiim ah oo khuseeya berriga iyo baddaba, isaga oo xusay in xasilloonida Geeska Afrika iyo amniga marin-biyoodka caalamiga ahi ay yihiin mudnaan muhiim u ah labada dhinacba. Waxa uu intaa ku daray in Maraykanku diyaar u yahay in uu Somaliland si dhow ugala shaqeeyo arrimaha istaraatiijiga ah ee labada dhinacba danta u ah, isla markaana la sii xoojiyo wada-shaqaynta, xog-is-dhaafsiga, isdhaafsiga khibradaha iyo iskaashiga amni ee mustaqbalka. Kulanka ayaa ku soo gebogeboobay is-afgarad iyo in labada dhinac ay sii xoojiyaan ka wada shaqaynta danaha muhiimka ah ee la wadaago. https://qarannews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/8c9d1b06fa68d2e466f60028cea36471_1785590535384.mp4

items.title: Ciidanka dowladda oo lagala wareegay deegaanka Teedaan
items.description: Maxaas (Raxanreeb Online) Wararka inaga soo gaaray deegaanka Teedaan ee hoostaga degmada Maxaas ee Gobolka Hiiraan, ayaa sheegaya in halkaasi uu maanta ka dhacay dagaal u dhaxeeya ciidanka dowladda iyo kuwa deegaanka oo dhinac ah iyo maleeshiyaad katirsan kooxda Al-shabaab. Dagaalka ayaa la sheegay inuu yimid kaddib markii xubno katirsan Al-shabaab, ay weerar ku qadeen deegaankaas, waxaana la tilmaamay in halkaasi uu ka dhacay dagaal laisku adeegsaday hub culus. Goob jogayaal deegaanka ah ayaa sheegay in dagaalka uu ahaa mid culus, oo labada dhinac isku adeegsanayeen hubka noocyadiisa kala duwan, balse aysan ogeyn khasaaraha soo kala gaaray inta uu yahay. Sidoo kale warar madax banaan ayaa sheegaya in dagaal kaddib ciidanka dowladda, ay deegaanka isaga baxeen, isla.markaana ay la wareegeen maleeshiyaadka Al-shabaab. Geesta kale taliska ciidanka xoogga weli kama uusan hadlin khaasaraha dagaalka maanta ka dhacay deegaanka Teedaan iyo la wareegida kooxda Al-shabaab ee deegaanka. The post Ciidanka dowladda oo lagala wareegay deegaanka Teedaan appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Mareykanka: Somaliland saldhig ciidan kama dhisaneyno
items.description: Taliyaha cusub ee Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika (AFRICOM), Gen. Dagvin Anderson, ayaa sheegay in Mareykanku uusan qorsheynayn inuu saldhig milatari ka sameysto Somaliland, xilli booqashooyin ay saraakiil Mareykan ah ku tageen Hargeysa iyo Berbera ay dhalisay warar ku saabsan qorshe saldhig cusub. Anderson wuxuu sidoo kale si cad u sheegay in mowqifka Mareykanka uusan isbeddelin, isla markaana Washington ay weli taageersan tahay madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Arrintan ayaa muhiimad gaar ah yeelanaysa iyadoo Berbera iyo Somaliland ay noqdeen meel istiraatiiji ah oo ay daneynayaan quwadaha shisheeye, gaar ahaan sababo la xiriira Gacanka Cadmeed iyo marin-biyoodka Bab-el-Mandeb. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale xustay in xiisaha Somaliland uusan ku koobnayn Mareykanka, balse ay gobolka ku lug leeyihiin Israel, Itoobiya, Imaaraadka Carabta, Türkiye iyo Jabuuti, iyadoo heshiiskii Itoobiya iyo Somaliland ee 2024 uu ahaa mid ka mid ah arrimaha ugu waaweyn ee xiisadda gobolka.

items.title: TALIYAHA AFRICOM OO QIRAY IN DUQEYMAHA MAREYKANKA EE SOOMAALIYA AY HORAY U SABABEEN KHASAARE SHACAB
items.description: Taliyaha Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika (AFRICOM), Gen. Dagvin Anderson, ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Mareykanku ay dadaal badan sameeyaan si looga fogaado waxyeellada shacabka marka ay duqeymaha ka fulinayaan Soomaaliya. Gen. Anderson oo Muqdisho kula hadlay warbaahinta ayaa sheegay in AFRICOM ay baaritaan ku sameyso eedeymaha la aamini karo ee la xiriira khasaaraha shacabka, isagoo qiray in mararka qaar ay dhaceen khaladaad sababay dhimasho ama dhaawac dad rayid ah, isla markaana xaaladaha qaar magdhow la bixiyay. Taliyaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in duqeymaha Mareykanka ay inta badan bartilmaameedsadaan Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish, gaar ahaan goobaha ay kooxahaasi ku leeyihiin Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, hay’ado madax-bannaan oo dabagala khasaaraha shacabka ayaa soo bandhigay dhacdooyin ay ku sheegeen in duqeymo ama howlgallo militari oo Mareykan ah ay sababeen dhimasho rayid. AFRICOM ayaa qaar ka mid ah eedeymahaas diiday, halka kuwo kalena ay weli baaritaan ku jiraan. Gen. Anderson ayaa ku adkeystay in khasaaraha ay Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish u geystaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed uu aad uga badan yahay khasaaraha ka dhasha howlgallada Mareykanka, isagoo sidoo kale sheegay in kooxaha hubeysan ay mararka qaar buunbuuniyaan ama sameeyaan eedeymo ku saabsan khasaaraha shacabka si ay uga faa’iideystaan dacaayad ahaan.

items.title: Saadad Caliyow Oo Iska Casilay Xilka Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Gudaha
items.description: Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta, Saadad Cali, ayaa maanta ku dhawaaqay inuu iska casilay xilkii uu ka hayay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Saadad Caliyow ayaa sheegay in go’aankiisa uu salka ku hayo damaciisa siyaasadeed iyo rabitaankiisa ah inuu u tartamo xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya. “Waxaan go’aansaday inaan hankayga iyo damacayga xaqiijiyo, oo ah inaan musharrax u ahay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka,” ayuu yiri Saadad Cali. Wasiirku wuxuu sidoo kale u mahadceliyay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Xamse Cabdi Barre, isagoo uga mahadceliyay muddadii uu xilka soo hayay. Saadad Caliyow ayaa sheegay inuu Alle uga mahadcelinayo muddadii saddexda sano ahayd ee uu ka tirsanaa dowladda, isagoo ugu dambeyn guul iyo shaqo wanaagsan u rajeeyay bahda Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta ee ay muddada dheer soo wada shaqeeyeen. items.title: Midowga Afrika oo dalbaday in taageero joogta la siiyo howlgalka AUSSOM
items.description: Addis Ababa (Raxanreeb Online) Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf, ayaa ku baaqay in la xoojiyo taageerada joogtada ah ee loo fidinayo Hawlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), isagoo sheegay in hawlgalku door muhiim ah ka qaato nabadda iyo amniga Soomaaliya. Isagoo ka hadlay shir uu Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka ee Midowga Afrika, uga tashanayay mustaqbalka AUSSOM, guddoomiyuhu wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in hawlgalku u baahan yahay maalgelin waarta, taageero siyaasadeed iyo iskaashi caalami ah si uu u sii wado howlihiisa. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in muhiim ay tahay in la ilaaliyo guulihii laga gaaray dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab iyo xasilinta Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale guddoomiyaha, ayaa ku baaqay in la dardargeliyo hirgelinta Sanduuqa Nabadda ee Midowga Afrika, lana kordhiyo tabarucaadka dalalka xubnaha ka ah ururka iyo taageerada ay bixiyaan saaxiibbada caalamiga ah, si loo helo dhaqaale la isku halayn karo oo lagu sii wado hawlgalka. Baaqa Midowga Afrika ayaa ku soo aadaya xilli ay jiraan walaacyo ku saabsan mustaqbalka maalgelinta AUSSOM, taas oo muhiim u ah taageerada ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya iyo dadaallada lagu xasilinayo dalka. items.title: Ciidamada DF oo ku wajahan degaano ay ka baxeen Shabaab
items.description: Cadale (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ayaa sheegaya in maanta ciidamada Xoogga Dalka ay dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wadaan duleedka degmada Cadale ee gobolkaasi, kuwaas oo ay ku doonayaan in ay kula wareegaan deeggaanno ay ka baxeen maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, maleeshiyada argagixisada ah ayaa saaka faarujiyay deegaanka Geed-Yaxiir iyo tuulooyin kale oo kamid ah meelihii ay horay ula wareegeen ee gobolkaasi. Dadka deegaanka ayaa innoo sheegay in Geed-Yaxiir iyo tuulooyinka hoos yimaada ay ka wada baxeen xubnihii Al-Shabaab, mana cadda sababta rasmiga ah ee ka dambeysa. Wararka ayaa intaasi kusii daraya in Al-Shabaabkii ku sugnaa aaggaasi ay u baxeen deeggaanno kale oo ka tirsan isla gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe oo ay weli gacanta ku hayso kooxda Al-Shabaab, halkaas oo ay isku uruursanayaan maleeshiyaadka Khawaarijta. Xaaladda deegaanka ayaa hataan ah mid kacsan, maadaama dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ay ka socdaan halkaasi, kuwaas oo ka dhashay qorahaha dowladda ee dib ula wareegidda deegaannada ay ka baxeen Al-Shabaab, si loo sugo amnigooda. Sababta ugu weyn ee soo dadajisay bixitaanka kooxda Al-Shabaab ayaa loo arkaa culeyska ay kala kulmeen guluf cusub oo ay mar kale dowladda dhexe ka bilaabeen qaybo kamid dalka, kadib dagaalkii uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iclaamiyay intii lagu guda jiray todobaadkii xorriyadda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay dhinaca dowladda ee ku aaddan dib u gurashada argagixisada oo maanta ka baxay deegaanno ku yaalla Shabeellaha Dhexe ee maamulka HirShabelle. The post Ciidamada DF oo ku wajahan degaano ay ka baxeen Shabaab appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maxay ahaayeen Qodobadii ugu muhiimsanaa ee uu maanta ka hadlay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud?
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa khudbad ka jeediyay furitaanka kalfadhiga Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, isagoo si weyn uga hadlay arrimo siyaasadeed, amni, dastuur, doorashooyin iyo duulaanka maamulka Yahuuda. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay adeegsanayso awoodda iyo xeeladaha siyaasadeed ee ay haysato si looga hortago in Israa’iil ay Somaliland ku yeelato saameyn joogto ah. Wuxuu xusay in arrintan ay dowladda si gaar ah uga shaqeynayso. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay madaxda iyo masuuliyiinta dowladda, isagoo sheegay in haddii masuul dowladeed lagu xiro dal kale isaga oo wata baasaboorka Soomaaliya, xilka laga qaadi doono. “Masuulkii dowladeed ee dal kale ee uu baasaboorkiisa sito lagu xiro, isla xilligaas ayaan xilka ka qaadeynaa,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Dhanka siyaasadda gudaha, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in guddiga doorashooyinka Soomaaliya ay khibrad iyo waayo-aragnimo ka kororsadeen Guddiga Doorashooyinka Somaliland, isagoo sidoo kale ka hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo dadaallada mucaaradka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay inuusan oggolaan doonin in odayaasha mucaaradka ay sameystaan heshiisyo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo aan dhab ahayn, isagoo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo hannaan sharci ah. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Baarlamaanka 11-aad ay u harsan yihiin laba kalfadhi oo Dastuuri ah, taas oo qeyb ka ah geeddi-socodka lagu dhammaystirayo hawlaha baarlamaanka. Arrimaha amniga, Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay leedahay awood ciidan oo ay isku filnaan karto, isagoo ka hadlay bixitaanka ama hoos u dhaca ciidamada Afrika ee howlgalka Soomaaliya iyo baahida loo qabo in dalka uu si tartiib ah ula wareego mas’uuliyadda amniga. Dhanka waxbarashada, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh wuxuu sheegay in xilligan dowladda ay leedahay hal jaamacad oo lacag la’aan ah, taas oo ah Jaamacadda Ummadda Soomaaliyeed, balse uu qorshuhu yahay in maalmaha soo socda la furo jaamacad kale oo dowladda leedahay, taas oo tirada jaamacadaha dowladda ee lacag la’aanta ah ka dhigi doonta laba. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha ayaa kusoo beegantay xilli Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya uu galay kalfadhigiisa cusub, iyadoo dalka ay ka socdaan dooddo siyaasadeed oo la xiriira dastuurka, doorashooyinka, amniga iyo xiriirka dowladda federaalka iyo dhinacyada siyaasadda.

items.title: Puntland oo u dabaaldegaysa sanad-guuradeedii 28-aad: Guulo, caqabo iyo kaalinta ay ku leedahay nidaamka federaalka Soomaaliya
items.description: Maamul-goboleedka Puntland ayaa maanta u dabaaldegaya sanad-guuradii 28-aad ee ka soo wareegtay markii la aas-aasay 1-dii Agoosto 1998. Puntland ayaa ah maamulka labaad ee ugu faca weyn dalka markii laga soo tago Soomaaliland oo la dhisay sanadkii 1991-dii xilli dalka uu ku jira dagaalkii sokeeye, waxayna mudadii 28-ka sano ahayd ee ay jirtay, Puntland noqatay mid kamid ah maamullada ugu waaweyn uguna xasilloon Soomaaliya. Puntland waxay ku guuleysatay inay dhisto hay’ado dowladeed oo shaqeeya, sugto amniga deegaannadeeda, isla markaana hirgeliso adeegyo dowladeed oo kala duwan. Tan iyo markii la aas-aasay, Puntland waxaa soo maray lix madaxweyne oo kala ah Cabdullaahi Yuusuf Axmed, Maxamed Cabdi Xaashi, Maxamuud Muuse Xirsi (Cadde Muuse), Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Faroole, Cabdiweli Maxamed Cali Gaas iyo madaxweynaha hadda talada haya Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni. Puntland ayaa door muuqda ka qaadatay hirgelinta nidaamka federaalka Soomaaliya, ayadoo hoggaamiyeyaashii maamulkaasi ay ka mid ahaayeen siyaasiyiintii hormuudka ka ahaa doodaha iyo heshiisyadii lagu dhisay hannaanka federaalka, taas oo sababtay in Puntland loogu yeero “Hooyada Federaalka Soomaaliya.” Dhanka amniga, Puntland waxay muddo dheer caan ku ahayd xasillooni ka wanaagsan inta badan deegaannada kale ee dalka, yadoo ciidamada ammaanka ay la dagaalameen kooxaha argagixisada iyo burcad-badeedda, islamarkaana deegaanada maamulkaas intooda  badani ay noqdeen meelo ku habboon ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga. Sidoo kale, maamulka ayaa sameeyay goleyaal dowladeed oo ay ka mid yihiin Golaha Wakiillada iyo Garsoorka, kuwaas oo door ka qaatay dhismaha hay’adaha dowliga ah iyo maamulka deegaannada. Muddooyinkii la soo dhaafay waxaa Puntland laga hirgeliyay mashaariic badan oo dhinacyada waddooyinka, dekedda Garacad, garoomada diyaaradaha, waxbarashada, caafimaadka iyo horumarinta dakhliga gudaha ah, taas oo sare u qaaday awoodda maamulka ee isku filnaanshaha dhaqaale. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Puntland inkastoo ay gudeheeda xasillooni tahayna haddana waxaa marar badan wajahday khilaafyo siyaasadeed oo  aan dhammaan oo kala dhexeeyay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Khilaafaadkaas ayaa inta badan salka ku haya awood-qeybsiga, wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka, maamulka doorashooyinka iyo qaabka loo wajahayo arrimaha federaalka, iyadoo xilligan, xiriirka u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya uusan gebi ahaanba shaqaynayn. Puntland ayaa markasta oo khilaaf yimaado sheegta inay hakisay wada-shaqeyntii hay’adaha federaalka, iyadoo ku dooda in la ilaaliyo nidaamka federaalka iyo heshiisyadii lagu dhisay dowladda. Si kastaba haahaatee, iyadoo loo dabaaldegayo sanad-guuradii 28-aad, Puntland waxay soo bandhigaysaa guulo ay ka gaartay dhinacyada amniga, maamulka iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, balse dhanka kale, waxay weli wajahaysaa caqabado ay ka mid yihiin xoojinta dimuqraadiyadda, kobcinta dhaqaalaha, dhammaystirka nidaamka federaalka iyo hagaajinta xiriirka kala dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya.

Puntland ayaa ah maamulka labaad ee ugu faca weyn dalka markii laga soo tago Soomaaliland oo la dhisay sanadkii 1991-dii xilli dalka uu ku jira dagaalkii sokeeye, waxayna mudadii 28-ka sano ahayd ee ay jirtay, Puntland noqatay mid kamid ah maamullada ugu waaweyn uguna xasilloon Soomaaliya. Puntland waxay ku guuleysatay inay dhisto hay’ado dowladeed oo shaqeeya, sugto amniga deegaannadeeda, isla markaana hirgeliso adeegyo dowladeed oo kala duwan. Tan iyo markii la aas-aasay, Puntland waxaa soo maray lix madaxweyne oo kala ah Cabdullaahi Yuusuf Axmed, Maxamed Cabdi Xaashi, Maxamuud Muuse Xirsi (Cadde Muuse), Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Faroole, Cabdiweli Maxamed Cali Gaas iyo madaxweynaha hadda talada haya Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni. Puntland ayaa door muuqda ka qaadatay hirgelinta nidaamka federaalka Soomaaliya, ayadoo hoggaamiyeyaashii maamulkaasi ay ka mid ahaayeen siyaasiyiintii hormuudka ka ahaa doodaha iyo heshiisyadii lagu dhisay hannaanka federaalka, taas oo sababtay in Puntland loogu yeero “Hooyada Federaalka Soomaaliya.” Dhanka amniga, Puntland waxay muddo dheer caan ku ahayd xasillooni ka wanaagsan inta badan deegaannada kale ee dalka, yadoo ciidamada ammaanka ay la dagaalameen kooxaha argagixisada iyo burcad-badeedda, islamarkaana deegaanada maamulkaas intooda  badani ay noqdeen meelo ku habboon ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga. Sidoo kale, maamulka ayaa sameeyay goleyaal dowladeed oo ay ka mid yihiin Golaha Wakiillada iyo Garsoorka, kuwaas oo door ka qaatay dhismaha hay’adaha dowliga ah iyo maamulka deegaannada. Muddooyinkii la soo dhaafay waxaa Puntland laga hirgeliyay mashaariic badan oo dhinacyada waddooyinka, dekedda Garacad, garoomada diyaaradaha, waxbarashada, caafimaadka iyo horumarinta dakhliga gudaha ah, taas oo sare u qaaday awoodda maamulka ee isku filnaanshaha dhaqaale. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Puntland inkastoo ay gudeheeda xasillooni tahayna haddana waxaa marar badan wajahday khilaafyo siyaasadeed oo  aan dhammaan oo kala dhexeeyay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Khilaafaadkaas ayaa inta badan salka ku haya awood-qeybsiga, wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka, maamulka doorashooyinka iyo qaabka loo wajahayo arrimaha federaalka, iyadoo xilligan, xiriirka u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya uusan gebi ahaanba shaqaynayn. Puntland ayaa markasta oo khilaaf yimaado sheegta inay hakisay wada-shaqeyntii hay’adaha federaalka, iyadoo ku dooda in la ilaaliyo nidaamka federaalka iyo heshiisyadii lagu dhisay dowladda. Si kastaba haahaatee, iyadoo loo dabaaldegayo sanad-guuradii 28-aad, Puntland waxay soo bandhigaysaa guulo ay ka gaartay dhinacyada amniga, maamulka iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, balse dhanka kale, waxay weli wajahaysaa caqabado ay ka mid yihiin xoojinta dimuqraadiyadda, kobcinta dhaqaalaha, dhammaystirka nidaamka federaalka iyo hagaajinta xiriirka kala dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya.

items.title: haradheere Votes for First Time in 15 Years After Al-Shabab Ouster
items.description: Residents of Haradheere, a town in Somalia’s Mudug region, cast ballots this week to elect local council and regional parliamentary representatives, marking the community’s first vote since Somali federal forces recaptured it from al-Shabab in early 2023. The election forms part of a wider round of direct polling under way across Galmudug state, following similar exercises already completed in Banadir and South West State. The vote matters because it tests whether Somalia’s push toward one-person-one-vote democracy can take root in areas long held by militants. Al-Shabab maintained strongholds in the southern portion of Galmudug for roughly a decade, largely in the districts of Xaradheere, Ceel Buur and Ceel Dheere, where residents were reportedly subjected to illegal taxation, movement restrictions, extortion and forced conscription. Its removal was seen as a rare, durable security gain in a conflict that has otherwise proven difficult to reverse. For nearly 15 years, according to local accounts, Xaradheere functioned as one of al-Shabab’s most significant footholds in central Somalia. Somali National Army units, backed by local clan militias, retook the town in January 2023, ending years of militant administration. Somali election officials have described the broader Galmudug process as the third instance of direct district-level voting under the federal government’s electoral roadmap. Twelve political parties fielded 369 candidates for 89 seats in the House of Representatives, while 16 parties put forward 924 candidates for 243 seats in the regional assembly across the state, though it was not immediately clear how many of those seats applied specifically to Xaradheere. Radio Dalsan The vote has not been free of controversy. Galmudug’s regional administration earlier accused the electoral commission chairman of aligning with a presidential candidate’s campaign and demanded guarantees of an impartial process, allegations the commission has not publicly addressed. Analysts have also warned that entrenched clan rivalries and a contested one-person-one-vote model could complicate the broader Galmudug election. Radio Dalsan Security and governance analysts say success will ultimately be measured not only by the town’s liberation from militant control, but by whether basic services, schooling, commerce and courts can now function without armed group interference. Reconstruction in Xaradheere has reportedly included a new district council building, a police station and other government facilities. For many residents, officials say, the election represents a symbolic shift — from decisions imposed under threat of violence to choices made at the ballot box. items.title: Mareykanka oo ku hanjabay in haddii uu sii socdo khilaafka siyaasadda Soomaaliya…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha ciidamada Mareykanka ee Afrika (AFRICOM), Jeneraal Dagvin Anderson, ayaa ka digay in xasillooni-darrada siyaasadeed iyo khilaafka daba-dheeraaday ee madaxda Soomaaliya ay adkeyn karaan in Washington sii waddo kaalinteeda muddada dheer ee dalka. Anderson ayaa wareysi ay Jimcihii baahisay Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Muqdisho ku beeniyay wararka sheegaya in Washington ay qorsheyneyso inay Soomaaliya ka baxdo. Wuxuu sheegay in Mareykanku uusan “dhabarka u jeedin” Soomaaliya, isaga oo xusay taageerada uu dalka siinayay sannadihii lasoo dhaafay, oo ay ku jirto dhismaha iyo tababarka ciidanka kumaandooska Danab. Hase yeeshee, taliyaha AFRICOM ayaa caddeeyay in sii socoshada taageeradaas ay ku xirnaan doonto sida madaxda Soomaaliya ay u qaataan mas’uuliyadda hoggaaminta dalka, una xalliyaan khilaafaadka siyaasadeed. “Haddii Soomaaliya ay kaalinteeda qaadato, dowladduna ay hormuud ka noqoto arrimahan, waan sii joogi doonnaa, sababtoo ah waxaa jira dano naga dhexeeya,” ayuu yiri Anderson. “Laakiin haddii aynaan taas arkin, xasillooni-darrada siyaasadeed iyo isqabqabsiguna ay sii socdaan, aad ayay noogu adkaan doontaa inaan sii wadno ka-qaybgalkeenna,” ayuu raaciyay. Hadalka Anderson ayaa muujinaya in Washington aysan ka hadleyn bixitaan degdeg ah, balse ay madaxda Soomaaliya u direyso fariin ah in taageerada Mareykanka aysan sii ahaan karin mid aan shuruud lahayn. Taliyaha AFRICOM ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in hawlgallada militari aysan kaligood Soomaaliya u horseedi karin amni waara, haddii aysan barbar socon dowladnimo shaqeysa, hay’ado deggan iyo maamul gaara deegaannada laga saaro kooxaha hubeysan. “Waxaan Soomaaliya uga baahan nahay inay keento dowladnimo. Waxaan uga baahan nahay inay abuurto xasillooni horseedi karta barwaaqo,” ayuu yiri. “Haddii xasilloonidaas la helo, Mareykanku aad ayuu u daneynayaa inuu maalgashado.” Mareykanka ayaa muddo dheer tababar, qalab iyo taageero hawlgaleed siinayay ciidamada Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan Danab, oo door weyn ka qaata hawlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Laakiin Anderson ayaa sheegay in gudaha Mareykanka ay sii kordhayaan su’aalaha ku saabsan muddada uu Washington sii wadi karo kaalinta uu ku leeyahay Soomaaliya, iyadoo aan la arkin dowlad awood u leh inay si madax-bannaan ula tacaasho caqabadaha amniga iyo siyaasadda. “Waxaa Washington iyo qeybaha kale ee dalka ku sugan dad leh, ‘Sannado badan ayaan halkan joognay. Goorma ayay Soomaaliya madax-bannaan noqon doontaa oo ay arrimahan mas’uuliyaddooda qaadan doontaa?’” ayuu yiri. Anderson ayaa sheegay in deegaanno lagu xaqiijiyay hawlgallo socday intii u dhaxeysay 2019-kii iyo 2021-kii ay markii dambe dib ugu gacan galeen Al-Shabaab, taas oo keentay in mar kale loo baahdo olole dib loogu qabsado. Anderson, oo Soomaaliya ka tirsanaa Taliska Hawlgallada Gaarka ah ee Mareykanka intii u dhaxeysay 2019 iyo 2021, ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Mareykanka iyo kuwa Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, oo ay ku jiraan kumaandooska Danab, ay xilligaas horumar ka sameeyeen jiinka webiga Shabeellaha Hoose, ayna gaareen degmada Mubaarak. “Waxaan halkan ka howlgalayay anigoo ka tirsan Taliska Hawlgallada Gaarka ah intii u dhaxeysay 2019 iyo 2021. Waxaan la shaqeynay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo Danab, waxaana ku sii soconnay jiinka webiga Shabeellaha Hoose, annagoo horumar sameynay oo gaarnay ilaa Mubaarak,” ayuu yiri Anderson. “Hadda waxaan kusoo laabtay AFRICOM anigoo taliye ah, waxaana mar kale dib u qabsaneynaa isla deegaannadii,” ayuu raaciyay. Wuxuu sheegay in deegaannadaas la lumiyay kaddib markii diiradda laga leexiyay dagaalka ka dhanka ah argagixisada. “Tani waa waxa keena niyad-jabka, sababtoo ah dhulkaas waxaa la lumiyay markii meel uun diiraddii argagixisada laga qaaday oo arrimo kale loo weeciyay,” ayuu yiri. Anderson ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in hawlgallada militari aysan kaligood ku filneyn in la ilaaliyo guulaha laga gaaro dagaalka, isaga oo adkeeyay in deegaannada dib loo qabsado ay tahay in la gaarsiiyo dowladnimo, caddaalad iyo xasillooni. “In dhulkaas la qabsado waa qeyb ka mid ah sugidda amniga. Laakiin markaas waa inaad awood u yeelataan inaad dhulkaas sii haysataan, dowladnimo gaarsiisaan, caddaalad hirgelisaan, isla markaana abuurtaan xasilloonida lagama maarmaanka u ah in barwaaqo ay ka dhalato,” ayuu yiri. Hadallada taliyaha AFRICOM ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli dowladda federaalka ah ay wajaheyso khilaaf xooggan oo ku saabsan doorashooyinka, wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka iyo xiriirka kala dhexeeya siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka iyo qaar ka mid ah dowlad-goboleedyada. Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa bishii Maarso ansixiyay wax-ka-beddello dastuur oo dhalisay muran ku saabsan muddada xilka madaxda iyo waqtiga doorashooyinka. Falanqeeyayaal ayaa sheegay in doorashooyinka ay dib u dhacayaan, maadaama aysan jirin hannaan doorasho oo ay dhinacyada siyaasadda isku raacsan yihiin. Xiisadda siyaasadeed ayaa bishii June gaartay heer ay Muqdisho ku dagaallamaan ciidamada dowladda iyo kooxo taageersan siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, iyadoo Mareykanka iyo Qaramada Midoobay ay dhinacyada ugu baaqeen inay khilaafkooda ku dhammeeyaan wada-hadal. Safaaradda Mareykanka ayaa xilligaas sheegtay in madaxda Soomaalida oo dhan ay mas’uuliyad ka saaran tahay ilaalinta xasilloonida iyo in tallaabooyinka ay qaadaan ay saameyn muddo dheer ah ku yeelan karaan amniga, midnimada iyo mustaqbalka Soomaaliya. Digniinta Anderson ayaa sidaas darteed cadaadis dheeraad ah saaraysa madaxda dowladda federaalka, iyadoo Washington ay si cad isugu xirtay taageerada amniga, xasilloonida siyaasadeed iyo awoodda Soomaaliya ay ugu istaagi karto mas’uuliyadda dowladnimadeeda. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay dagaal xoogan oo ka dhacay Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Wararka naga soo gaaraya Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa sheegaya in dagaal culus uu saakay ka dhacay nawaaxiga deegaanka Suullaay ee bariga Gobolka Hiiraan, ka dib markii maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ay weerareen saldhig ay halkaasi ku leeyihiin Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley. Ciidamada ayaa toddobaadkii hore dagaal ku qabsaday saldhiggaasi, iyagoona sii waday gulufka uu qorshuhu yahay in ay kula wareegaan deegaankaasi oo 17km jihada koonfureed uga beegan deegaanka Teedaan oo hoostaga Degmada Maxaas. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Shabaabku ay dhowr jiho ka weerareen saldhigga ay ciidamadu ku leeyihiin inta u dhaxeyso Suullaay iyo Teedaan, isla-markaana uu halkaasi ku dhex maray dagaal hubka noocyadiisa kala duwan la isku adeegsaday. Warbaahinta ku hadasha afka Al Shabaab ayaa sheegtay in Shabaabku ay qabsadeen saldhig ku yaala duleedka Teedaan, sidoo kalena ay ciidamadu ka furteen gaari Cabdi Bile ah. Saraakiisha Qaybta 27aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee ku sugan furimaha hore ee bariga Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa kuu sheegaya in ciidamadu ay si weyn isaga caabiyeen weerarkaasi, isla-markaana ay fashiliyeen isku daygii maleeshiyada ay ku dooneysay in ay kula wareegto saldhigga ay ciidamada ka sameysteen meel u dhow deegaanka Suullaay. Warbaahinta ayaa fahamsan in Shabaabku ay damacsan yihiin inay fashiliyaan istiraatiijiyadda dagaalka ee ay ciidamada ku kala jarayaan gurmadka iyo sahayda maleeshiyada ee Degmooyinka Maxaas iyo Moqokori. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Macawiisleyda ayaa hawlgal midkani oo kale ah ka wada agagaarka deegaanka Yasooman oo hoostaga Degmada Buuloburde, waana deegaan muhiim u ah isu socodka gobolka, wuxuuna isku xiraa Degmooyinka Buuloburde, Moqokori iyo Maxaas. items.title: Xarardheere oo ay si nabad ah doorasho uga dhacday ka dib ku dhowaad 15 sano oo ay Al-Shabaab maamulayaeen
items.description: Magaalada Xaradheere ee gobolka Mudug ayaa gashay marxalad cusub oo siyaasadeed, iyadoo shacabka deegaanku ay codkooda ku dooranayaan xubnaha golaha deegaanka iyo baarlamaanka Galmudug, kaddib markii magaalada laga xoreeyay Al-Shabaab sanadkii 2023. Xaradheere ayaa muddo ku dhow 15 sano ahayd mid ka mid ah fariisimihii ugu waaweynaa ee Al-Shabaab, halkaas oo shacabka lagu soo rogi jiray canshuuro sharci darro ah, xayiraado dhaqdhaqaaq, caburin iyo askareyn khasab ah. Bishii Janaayo 2023 ayay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed oo garab ka helayay ciidamada deegaanka dib ula wareegeen magaalada, taasoo soo afjartay sannado badan oo ay kooxdu ka talinaysay. Doorashada ka socota magaalada ayaa loo arkaa tallaabo muhiim u ah dib u soo celinta dowladnimada iyo in shacabka ay si xor ah u doortaan hoggaankooda, halkii go’aannada looga qaadan lahaa cabsi iyo qasab. Khubarada amniga iyo maamulka ayaa sheegaya in guusha dagaalka aan lagu qiimeyn oo keliya deegaannada laga qabsado Al-Shabaab, balse sidoo kale lagu cabbiro sida adeegyada dowladda dib loogu soo celiyo, shacabka loogu suurtageliyo waxbarashada, ganacsiga, caddaaladda iyo doorashooyinka. Sidoo kale waxaa la xusay in dib u dhiska Xaradheere laga hirgeliyay mashaariic ay ka mid yihiin xarunta golaha deegaanka, saldhigga booliiska iyo adeegyo kale oo lagu xoojinayo hay’adaha dowladda, kuwaas oo lagu qiyaasay malaayiin doollar. Shacabka Xaradheere ayaa lagu ammaanay adkeysiga iyo kaalinta ay ka qaateen dib u dhiska magaalada, iyadoo doorashadan lagu tilmaamay astaan muujinaysa in deegaanku ka gudbay xilligii rasaasta una tallaabay hannaan ku dhisan cod iyo doorasho.

items.title: Sawirro: Xasan oo 5 qodob ku soo bandhigay shirka Kampala
items.description: Kampala (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo Jimcihii dalka Uganda uga qayb galay Shir-Madaxeedka Labaad ee Waddamada Ciidamadooda ka qeyb qaata howlgalka Taageerada iyo xasillinta ee Midowga Afrika ayaa kusoo bandhigay 5 qodob oo muhiim h. Xasan Sheekh oo khudbad xasaasi ah ka jeediyay shirka ayaa shanta qodob ku soo bandhigay horumarka la taaban karo ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka gaartay dib-u-xoreynta dalka, dib-u-habaynta hay’adaha amniga, xoojinta dowladnimada, kobcinta dhaqaalaha iyo tayeynta adeegyada bulshada. Sidoo kale, wuxuu adkeeyey in guulahaasi ay saldhig u yihiin wadajirka shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo garab istaagga saaxiibbada caalamka.A Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale uga mahadceliyay waddamada ciidamada usoo diray Soomaaliya, oo dadaal ku bixiyay amniga iyo xasiloonida Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, War-murtiyeedka laga soo saaray shirka ayaa lagu sheegay in Al-Shabaab ay weli tahay khatar amni oo halis ku ah Soomaaliya, isla markaana ay sii waddo beegsiga ciidamada iyo hay’adaha amniga ee dalka. Dalalka ka qeyb-galay shirka ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab lagu lammaaniyo xoojinta maamulka, dib-u-heshiisiin siyaasadeed, kobcinta dhaqaalaha iyo wax ka qabashada saboolnimada, si loo helo nabad waarta. Shirku wuxuu sidoo kale ku nuux-nuuxsaday muhiimadda kala-guurka amni ee qorsheysan, isaga oo ka digay in meelaha ciidamada laga saaro ama laga wareejiyo ay abuuri karaan firaaq amni oo ay ka faa’iideystaan kooxaha hubeysan. Ugu dambeyn, dalalka shirka ka qeyb-galay waxay xuseen in maalgelinta howl-galka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ay weli tahay mudnaan muhiim ah, iyagoo ugu baaqay beesha caalamka inay sii waddo taageerada dhaqaale si loo ilaaliyo guulaha amni ee la gaaray loogana hortago dib-u-dhac. items.title: Ciidamada oo u qalab qaatay deegaanka Masaajid Cali Gaduud
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe ayaa sheegaya in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ay u qalab qaateen, sidii ay maleeshiyada Al Shabaab uga saari lahaayeen deegaanka Masaajid Cali Gaduud oo hoostaga Degmada Cadale ee gobolkaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in hawlgalka ay hoggaaminayaan Kumaandooska Gorgor, isla-markaana ay kaabayaan cutubyo kale oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley. Ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadu ay ka ruqaansadeen saldhigga ay ku leeyihiin deegaanka xeebta u dhow ee Wargaadhi, isla-markaana ay hadda ku sugan yihiin meel u dhow tuulada Towfiiq oo 8km dhinaca waqooyi galbeed uga beegan Wargaadhi. Tuulada Towfiiq ayaa qiyaastii 10km u jirta deegaanka Masaajid Cali Gaduud, iyadoo Towfiiq ay ka mid tahay tuulooyinka yaryar ee hoostaga Masaajid Cali Gaduud iyo mid ka mid ah marinada laga galo deegaankaasi. Tuulooyinka kale ee ku xeeran deegaankaasi ayaa kala ah Daarasalaam, Tawakal iyo Geedi-xeyr. Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ay isaga baxeen tuulada Geedi-xeyr, balse ay weli ku sugan yihiin tuulooyinka kale ee Daarasalaam iyo Tawakal, isla-markaana ay dhaqdhaqaaq ka wadaan deegaanka Masaajid Cali Gaduud. Deegaanka Masaajid Cali Gaduud ayaa ah deegaan istiraatiiji ah, waana dhuun iyo marin muhiim u ah isku xirka iyo gudbinta saadka iyo sahayda ciidamada ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe. Shabaabka ayaa 26-kii bishii March ee sanadkii 2025 dagaal culus kula wareegay gacan ku haynta Masaajid Cali Gaduud, waxaana bishii xigtay ee April fashilmay qorshe ay ciidamadu dib ugu la wareegi lahaayeen deegaankaasi. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa dadka deegaanka ayaa la xusuustaa in 30-kii bishii October ee sanadkii 2022 ay dagaal maalmo socday kula wareegeen Masaajid Cali Gaduud, ka dib wax ka badan 10 sano oo Shabaabku ay ka arriminayeen. Haddii ciidamadu ay hadda dib ula wareegaan deegaankaasi ayaa waxay ka dhigan tahay in sanad iyo dhowr bilood ka dib ay ku soo celiyeen gacanta Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle.

items.title: Shirkii Kampala oo lagu ansixiyay qorshaha AUSSOM ugu wareejinayo amniga Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka
items.description: Hoggaamiyeyaasha dalalka ciidamada ku leh Hawlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) ayaa isku raacay qorshe lagu wareejinayo mas’uuliyadda amniga Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed muddo u dhexeysa 18 illaa 24 bilood ee soo socota. Go’aankan ayaa lagu gaaray Shirkii Labaad ee Aan Caadiga Ahayn ee Dalalka Ciidamada ku biiriya AUSSOM, kaas oo Jimcihii ka qabsoomay magaalada Kampala ee dalka Uganda, waxaana martigeliyay Madaxweynaha Uganda, Yoweri Kaguta Museveni. Shirka waxaa ka qeyb galay Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, madaxda dalalka ciidamada ku leh AUSSOM, iyo mas’uuliyiin ka socday Midowga Afrika (AU), Urur-Goboleedka IGAD iyo Qaramada Midoobay. War-murtiyeedkii laga soo saaray shirka ayaa lagu ammaanay doorka dalalka ciidamada ku leh AUSSOM ee taageerada ay siiyeen Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab iyo dadaallada lagu xasilinayo dalka. Shirku wuxuu dib u xaqiijiyay taageerada uu u hayo Soomaaliya mideysan, xor ah oo leh hay’ado dowladeed oo awood leh, isagoo xusay in xoojinta dowladnimada, dimuqraadiyadda iyo midnimada qaranku ay saldhig u yihiin nabadda waarta. Qorshaha kala-guurka ee la ansixiyay ayaa dhigaya in si tartiib tartiib ah masuuliyadda amniga loogu wareejiyo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo la eegayo heerka ay ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ka gaarayaan dhismaha iyo awooddooda hawlgal. Hoggaamiyeyaashu waxay carrabka ku adkeeyeen in kala-guurkaasi uu ku saleysnaado xaaladda dhabta ah ee amniga, isla markaana uu barbar socdo sii wadista hawlgallada militari ee ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Waxay sidoo kale ku baaqeen in la sii xoojiyo taageerada la siinayo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan cutubyada guurguura iyo ciidamada deegaanka ee suga amniga deegaannada laga xoreeyay kooxda. War-murtiyeedka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay muhiimadda ay leedahay kor u qaadista awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo la xoojinayo taageerada dhinacyada cirka, wadaagga sirdoonka, dabagalka iyo tababarrada mideysan, si loo dhiso ciidan qaran oo awood leh. Dhanka kale, madaxdu waxay xuseen in la dagaallanka fikirka xagjirka ah uusan ku koobnaan karin hawlgallo militari oo keliya, balse loo baahan yahay in la kordhiyo adeegyada bulshada, la abuuro fursado dhaqaale iyo shaqo, isla markaana la xoojiyo adkeysiga bulshada si dhalinyarada looga ilaaliyo ku biirista kooxaha xagjirka ah. Shirku wuxuu sidoo kale iftiimiyay caqabadaha dhaqaale ee weli haysta howlgalka AUSSOM, iyadoo la isku raacay in la sameeyo guddi wadajir ah oo ka shaqeeya xal u helidda maalgelinta hawlgalka iyo taageerada kala-guurka amniga Soomaaliya.
