Waxay sidoo kale ku baaqeen in la sii xoojiyo taageerada la siinayo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan cutubyada guurguura iyo ciidamada deegaanka ee suga amniga deegaannada laga xoreeyay kooxda. War-murtiyeedka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay muhiimadda ay leedahay kor u qaadista awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo la xoojinayo taageerada dhinacyada cirka, wadaagga sirdoonka, dabagalka iyo tababarrada mideysan, si loo dhiso ciidan qaran oo awood leh. Dhanka kale, madaxdu waxay xuseen in la dagaallanka fikirka xagjirka ah uusan ku koobnaan karin hawlgallo militari oo keliya, balse loo baahan yahay in la kordhiyo adeegyada bulshada, la abuuro fursado dhaqaale iyo shaqo, isla markaana la xoojiyo adkeysiga bulshada si dhalinyarada looga ilaaliyo ku biirista kooxaha xagjirka ah. Shirku wuxuu sidoo kale iftiimiyay caqabadaha dhaqaale ee weli haysta howlgalka AUSSOM, iyadoo la isku raacay in la sameeyo guddi wadajir ah oo ka shaqeeya xal u helidda maalgelinta hawlgalka iyo taageerada kala-guurka amniga Soomaaliya.

items.title: Taliyaha AFRICOM oo shaaca ka qaaday go’aanka rasmiga ee saldhig laga furo Berbera
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Taliska Ciidamada Mareykanka ee Afrika ee AFRICOM, Jeneraal Dagvin Anderson, ayaa si cad u sheegay in Washington aysan wax qorshe ah ka lahayn inay saldhig ciidan ka sameysato deegaanada Somaliland ee waqooyiga Soomaaliya. Anderson ayaa sidoo kale ku celiyay in siyaasadda Mareykanka ay weli taageersan tahay madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isaga oo meesha ka saaray wararka sheegaya in Washington ay ka fikirayso inay aqoonsato Somaliland. Wareysi ay Jimcihii 31-ka Luulyo baahisay safaaradda Mareykanka ee Muqdisho ayaa Anderson lagu weydiiyay booqashooyinka soo noqnoqday ee saraakiisha AFRICOM ay ku tagaan Somaliland iyo haddii booqashooyinkaas ay hordhac u yihiin qorshe saldhig ciidan looga dhisayo halkaas. “Ma jiro wax qorshe ah oo saldhig looga dhisayo Somaliland,” ayuu yiri Jeneraal Anderson. Markii la weydiiyay in Mareykanku Somaliland u aqoonsan karo dal ka madax-bannaan Soomaaliya, taliyaha AFRICOM ayaa sheegay in mowqifka Washington uusan waxba iska beddelin. “Siyaasadda Mareykanka waxay ahayd, welina tahay, taageeridda madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Taasi waxba iskama beddelin,” ayuu yiri. Booqashooyinkii Berbera Su’aalaha ku saabsan qorshaha Mareykanka ayaa xoogaystay kadib booqashooyin ay saraakiil sare oo AFRICOM ah ku tageen Hargeysa iyo Berbera. Anderson ayaa bishii November 2025 hoggaamiyay wafdi sare oo AFRICOM ah oo booqday Somaliland, isaga oo sidoo kale kormeeray dekedda iyo garoonka diyaaradaha Berbera. AFRICOM ayaa xilligaas sheegtay in booqashadu qeyb ka ahayd safar Bariga Afrika ah oo looga gol lahaa xoojinta iskaashiga amniga iyo mideynta dadaallada lagula dagaallamayo kooxaha argagixisada. Taliska Mareykanka ma uusan sheegin in booqashadu la xiriirtay qorshe lagu dhisayo saldhig ciidan. Berbera waxay ku taallaa Gacanka Cadmeed, meel aan ka fogeyn marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Maraakiibta isticmaasha marin-biyoodkaas ayaa sanadihii dambe la kulmay weerarro ay qaadeen Xuutiyiinta Yemen, taas oo kordhisay muhiimadda militari iyo ganacsi ee xeebaha ku dhow marin-biyoodka. Dekedda Berbera waxaa maamusha shirkadda DP World ee laga leeyahay Imaaraadka Carabta, halka Abu Dhabi ay sidoo kale maalgashi ku sameysay garoonka diyaaradaha iyo aagga ganacsiga xorta ah ee magaalada. Goobta ay Berbera ku taallo iyo dhabaha dheer ee diyaaraduhu ku ordaan ayaa magaalada ka dhigay meel ay daneynayaan quwadaha ku tartamaya Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Geeska Afrika. Wararka saldhigga Mala’awaalka ku saabsan saldhig Mareykan ah ayaa sii kordhay kadib warbixin ay wargeyska Faransiiska ah ee Le Monde daabacay horraantii Luulyo. Warbixinta ayaa sheegtay in Imaaraadka Carabta uu ballaarin militari ka sameynayo garoonka Berbera, iyadoo goobta mustaqbalka ay isticmaali karaan ciidamada Imaaraadka, Mareykanka iyo Israel. Mareykanka ma uusan xaqiijin sheegashadaas, halka hadalka Anderson uu hadda si toos ah meesha uga saarayo in Washington ay qorsheyneyso saldhig ciidan oo Somaliland laga dhiso. Arrinta Berbera ayaa sidoo kale dood dhalisay bishii Maarso 2025, kadib markii la faafiyay qabyo-qoraal warqad uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ugu talagalay Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump. Qabyo-qoraalkaas ayaa Mareykanka loogu soo bandhigay inuu helo marin iyo awood hawlgal oo uu ku isticmaalo dekedaha iyo garoomada Berbera, Boosaaso iyo Balli-doogle, si loo xoojiyo iskaashiga amniga. Sarkaal ka tirsan wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa xilligaas xaqiijiyay in dokumentigu ahaa qabyo-qoraal sax ah, balse ma uusan xaqiijin in nuqulkii ugu dambeeyay loo diray Trump. Somaliland ayaa ka hortimid soo-jeedintaas, iyadoo ku doodday in dowladda federaalka aysan awood u lahayn inay dal kale u soo bandhigto dekedda ama garoonka Berbera. Somaliland ayaa sanadkii 1991 ku dhawaaqday inay ka go’day Soomaaliya, waxayna tan iyo markaas yeelatay maamul, ciidan iyo hay’ado u gaar ah. Inkasta oo Somaliland ay dadaal xooggan ku bixisay raadinta aqoonsi caalami ah iyo xiriir toos ah oo ay la yeelato Washington, Mareykanka ayaa ku adkeysanayay taageerada midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Hadalka Anderson ayaa muujinaya in booqashooyinka militari ee Mareykanka uu ku tago Somaliland aysan, ugu yaraan hadda, ka dhigneyn in Washington ay beddeshay siyaasaddeeda ku saabsan aqoonsiga ama ay qorsheyneyso joogitaan ciidan oo rasmi ah. Jeneraal Anderson ayaa hadalkan jeediyay intii uu booqasho ku joogay Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, madaxda amniga Soomaaliya iyo saraakiil Mareykan ah. Wadahadallada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish, iskaashiga ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka iyo xaaladda guud ee amniga dalka.[td_smart_list_end] The post Taliyaha AFRICOM oo shaaca ka qaaday go’aanka rasmiga ee saldhig laga furo Berbera appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Kooxda Xuutiyiinta oo beeniyay in ay lacag ka qaataan Maraakiibta
items.description: Sanca ( Raxanreeb Online) Hay’adda Isku-xirka Arrimaha Badda ee ay maamulaan Xuutiyiinta Yemen, ayaa beenisay wararka sheegaya in kooxdu qorsheynayso in ay canshuur ama khidmad ka qaaddo maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara Marinka Baab al-Mandab. Hay’addu waxay bayaan ay soo saartay Sabtidii ku sheegtay in “aan wax go’aan ah laga gaadhin arrintan, isla markaana maritaanka maraakiibta ee marin-biyoodkan muhiimka ah uu weli yahay mid xor ah. Kooxda Xutiyiinta, ayaa sheegay in Maraakiibta ganacsiga ee laga lee yahay dalalka Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil, aysan isticmaali doonin Marinka Baab al-Mandab. Sidoo kale Jawaabtan ayaa timid kaddib markii wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters ay Arbacadii sheegtay, iyadoo soo xiganaysa ilo ka tirsan gobolka, in dhaqdhaqaaqa Xuutiyiinta ee Iiraan taageerto uu qorshaynayo in uu lacag ka qaado maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara koonfurta Badda Cas, kaddib markii Sacuudi Carabiya ay ku dhawaaqday xannibaad badeed. The post Kooxda Xuutiyiinta oo beeniyay in ay lacag ka qaataan Maraakiibta appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya oo Maanta Furmaya, iyadoo Kursiga Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka uu Bannaanyahay
items.description: Kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya oo Maanta Furmaya, iyadoo Kursiga Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka uu BannaanyahayMagaalada Muqdisho waxaa maanta oo Sabti ah, 1-da Agoosto 2026, ka furaanaya Kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, kaas oo ay wadajir u fadhiisan doonaan Mudanayaasha labada aqal (Golaha Shacabka iyo Aqalka Sare). Munaasabadda furitaanka oo ka dhacayso xarunta Villa Hargeysa ayaa waxaa si rasmi ah u furi doona Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo sida la filayo ka jeedin doona khudbad sannadla ah oo taabanaysa xaaladda guud ee dalka, arrimaha amniga, siyaasadda, iyo jihooyinka wax-qabad ee xukuumadda. Kursiga Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo BannaanKalfadhigan 8-aad ayaa ku soo beegmay xilli xasaasi ah oo uu bannaanyahay kursiga Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Arrintan ayaa la filayaa in ay noqoto diiradda ugu weyn ee ay Xildhibaanadu wada-sexeexan doonaan maalmaha soo socda, iyadoo hawsha ugu horreysa ay noqon doonto dhisida Guddiga Doorashada iyo go’aaminta jadwalka loo marayo doorashada Guddoomiyaha cusub ee hoggaamin doona Baarlamaanka 11-aad. Khilaafka Muddo-xileedka Xukuumadda iyo Sharciyadda BaarlamaankaDhanka kale, kalfadhigan ayaa ku soo beegmay xilli uu taagan yahay khilaafka iyo dood ka dhan ah muddo-xileedka xukuumadda iyo doorka sharciyadeed ee Baarlamaanka. Mudanayaasha labada aqal ayaa la filayaa in ay kalfadhigan dhexdiisa diiradda ku saaraan xaddidaadda awoodaha sharci-dejinta, kormeerka degdegga ah ee shaqada xukuumadda, iyo sidii loo kala caddeyn lahaa kafeega sharciyada ka dhanka ah muddo-kordhinta ama marinta go’aammada siyaasadeed ee xasaasiga ah.

Arrintan ayaa la filayaa in ay noqoto diiradda ugu weyn ee ay Xildhibaanadu wada-sexeexan doonaan maalmaha soo socda, iyadoo hawsha ugu horreysa ay noqon doonto dhisida Guddiga Doorashada iyo go’aaminta jadwalka loo marayo doorashada Guddoomiyaha cusub ee hoggaamin doona Baarlamaanka 11-aad. Khilaafka Muddo-xileedka Xukuumadda iyo Sharciyadda BaarlamaankaDhanka kale, kalfadhigan ayaa ku soo beegmay xilli uu taagan yahay khilaafka iyo dood ka dhan ah muddo-xileedka xukuumadda iyo doorka sharciyadeed ee Baarlamaanka. items.title: R/W Xamza oo soo saaray farriin ku socota Puntland
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul wasaaraha Soomaaliya oo warsaxaafadeed soo saaray ayaa hambalyo u diray shacabka Puntland oo maanta u dabaal-degaya sanad guuradda 28-aad ee aas aaska maamulkaasi. Xamza ayaa shacabka iyo maamulka u diray farriin hambalyo ah, isaga oo ku bogaadiyay horumarka iyo biseylka dowladnimo ee ay muujiyeen. Sidoo kale wuxuu u hambalyeeyay hoggaannadii soo maray maamulkaas kaalintii ay ka qaateen dowlad dhiska dalka iyo dhabar-adeygii ay muujiyeen xiliyadii kala duwanaa ee lagu jiray dhismaha iyo yagleelidda maamulkaas Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale u rajeeyay hoggaanka iyo bulshada Puntland nabad waarta, horumar iyo barwaaqo. Waxaa kale oo uu ugu baaqay dhammaan shacabka inay xoojiyaan wadajirka, is-kaashiga iyo ilaalinta nabadda, si loo gaaro Soomaaliya horumarsan lehna hay’ado adag iyo mustaqbal ifaya. Garoowe iyo magaalooyinka kale ayaa xalay si weyn looga dabaal-degay sanad guuradda 28-aad ee aas aaska Puntland, waxaaa sidoo kale shacabka la hadlay madaxda sare ee maamulkaas oo iyaguna diray farriimo hambalyo ah. Xuska Munaasabada 1 Augusto ayaa sanadkan kusoo aaday, iyada oo weli ay taagan tahay xiisad culus oo u dhexeysa Dowladda Federaalka iyo Puntland oo ka dhalatay arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo wax ka beddelka dasturka dalka. Waxaa sidoo kale, todobaadyadii u dambeeyay soo kordhay dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo u dhexeeya labada dhinac oo laga dareemay gudaha Puntland, taas oo sii hurisay xiisadda siyaasadeed ee u dhexeysa Muqdisho iyo Garoowe. The post R/W Xamza oo soo saaray farriin ku socota Puntland appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Kulamada Baarlamaanka Somaliya oo maanta furmaya, ka dib fasaxii ugu dheeraa ee Xildhibaanada
items.description: Kalfadhigga 8aad ee Labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka ayaa lagu wadaa in maanta uu ka furmo Xarunta Villa Hargeisa ee Magaalada Muqdisho, ka dib in ka badan afar bilood oo Xildhibaanada Labada Gole ay fasax ku maqnaayeen. Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Somaliya ayaa fasax galay 4-tii bishii March, markaas oo ay ansixiyeen wax ka bedelka iyo dhameystirka lagu sameeyay Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda. Fasaxan ayaa ah kiisii ugu dheeraa ee ay galaan Xildhibaanada Labada Aqal, waana xilli muddo xileedkooda sharciga ah uu dhamaaday 14-kii bishii April. Dastuurka cusub ee Xildhibaanadu ay ansixiyeen oo buuq badan uu hareeyay, isla-markaana uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud saxiixay 8-dii bishii March ayaa muddo xileedka hay’adaha dastuuriga ah ka dhigaya shan sano, inkastoo Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka 11aad iyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh lagu doortay Dastuurkii KMG ee la bedelay, kaas oo qeexayay in muddo xileedka Madaxtooyada iyo Baarlamaanka 11aad uu afar sano yahay. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo 15-kii bishii May ka hadlayay Muqdisho oo muddo xileedkiisu uu ku ekaa ayaa ku dhawaaqay in muddo xileedka Madaxtooyada iyo Baarlamaanka uu ku egyahay 15-ka bisha May ee sanadka soo socda ee 2027. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa dhowr jeer oo hore oo intii uu socday wax ka bedelka iyo dhameystirka dastuurka sheegay in dhaqangelinta dastuurka cusub uu ka bilaabanayo dowladda dambe, oo aanu khuseynin dowladda hadda jirta. Hadalka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee ku saabsan goorta uu bilaabanayo dhaqangelinta dastuurka cusub ee is bedelay ayaa dhaliyay doodo siyaasadeed iyo walaac ku saabsan hufnaanta nidaamka dalka. Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka ee Dowladda Federaalka, Puntland iyo Jubbaland ayaa si adag uga horyimid in la bedelo Dastuurkii KMG ee la sameeyay sanadkii 2012. Madaxweye Xasan Sheekh ayaa la filayaa in Sabtidan uu khudbad ka jeedin doono furitaanka Kalfadhigga 8aad ee Labada Aqal. Gudoomiye 1aad Kuxigeenka ee Golaha Shacabka, Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar oo hadda ah Kusimaha Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa fadhiyada soo socda ee golaha shir guddoomin doonta, inta ay Xildhibaanada ka soo dooranayaan Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, ka dib markii Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo afartii sano ee la soo dhaafay ku magacawnaa jegadaasi loo doortay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo beeniyay inay lacag ku soo rogi doonaan maraakiibta mara Badda Cas
items.description: Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa si rasmi ah u beenisay wararka sheegayay inay qorsheynayaan inay lacag ka qaadaan maraakiibta ku goosha marin-biyoodka istaraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab, iyagoo caddeeyay in marinkaasi uu weli u furan yahay maraakiibta si lacag la’aan ah. Bayaan ay soo saareenXuutiyiintu ayaa lagu sheegay in adeegga ay ugu yeeraan “maritaanka nabdoon” uu yahay mid ikhtiyaari ah isla markaana aan wax lacag ah laga qaadin. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale uga digtay shirkadaha maraakiibta inaysan wax lacag ah siin ama xog u gudbin cid aan si rasmi ah uga tirsanayn dhankooda, iyadoo sheegtay in cid kasta oo lacag dalbanaysa aysan matalin maamulka Xuutiyiinta. Hadalkan ayaa yimid kadib markii wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters ay daabacday war sheegaya in Xuutiyiintu ay ka fiirsanayeen inay canshuur ku soo rogaan maraakiibta isticmaasha marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Warbixinta Reuters ayaa soo xiganaysay ilo gobolka ah oo sheegay in arrintaasi lagala hadlay mas’uuliyiin Iiraan ah intii lagu jiray booqasho ay wafdi Xuutiyiin ahi ku tageen Tehran bishii Luulyo. Marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab ayaa ah marin muhiim u ah isu socodka ganacsiga caalamiga ah, isagoo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Maraakiibta sida shidaalka iyo badeecadaha u kala goosha Aasiya, Yurub iyo Bariga Dhexe ayaa si weyn ugu tiirsan marinkan. Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay ayaa hore u sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay doonayaan inay ku daydaan habka ay Iiraan u maamusho marin-biyoodka Hormuz, halkaas oo ay muddooyinkii dambe ka jireen xiisado amni.

items.title: Taariikh Nololeedka: kumuu ahaa Axmed Cali Cigaal ?
items.description: Alle ha u naxariistee dalka Mareykanka ku geeriyooday fannaankii weynaa ee Axmed Cali Cigaal oo muddooyinkii dambe la sheegay inuu halkaas ku xanuunsanaa. Axmed Cali Cigaal wuxuu ka mid ahaa haldoorkii ugu waaweynaa ee fanka Soomaaliyeed, isagoo caan ku ahaa codkiisa baxsan, jilitaankiisa mucjisada, laxamiistiisa iyo curinta heesaha. Waxa uu kaalin weyn ku lahaa kobcinta fanka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan xilligii dahabiga ahaa ee kooxdii hobollada waaberi ay hormuudka u ahaayeen suugaanta Soomaaliyeed. Axmed Cali Cigaal wuxuu dhashay sanadkii 1952-kii, asagoo ku dhashay magaalada Wardheer ee gobolka Doollo oo ka tirsan deegaanka Soomaalida. Intii uu yaraa ayuu u soo wareegay magaalada Muqdisho , halkaas oo uu ku soo barbaaray kuna qaatay waxbarashadiisii dugsiyada hoose iyo dhexe. Kadib waxbarashadiisa aasaasiga ah, wuxuu 1966-kii ku biiray iskuul lagu baran jiray muusigga, taasoo u gogol xaartey xirfaddiisa faneed. Labo sano ka dib ayuu si rasmi ah ugu biiray bahda fanka Soomaaliyeed, hase yeeshee fanka wuxuu bilaabay isagoo weli arday ah sanadkii 1967-kii . Riwaayaddii ugu caansanayd ee uu ka qayb galo waxay ahayd “Shabeel Naagood” , oo uu curiyay Alle ha u naxariistee Xasan Sheekh Muumin, w axa uu sidoo kale si weyn magiciisu u soo shaac baxay riwaayaddii “Yaxaas Dhagaduub” , oo uu qoray Alle ha u naxariistee Maxamuud Sangub . Labadan riwaayadood ayaa noqday kuwo si weyn loogu ammaanay, laguna bartay hibadiisa faneed, waxaana ay Axmed Cali Cigaal u horseedeen inuu noqdo fanaan caan ka ah guud ahaan Soomaaliya. Intii uu ku jiray bahda fanka, Axmed wuxuu noqday xubin muhiim ah oo ka tirsan Kooxda Hobollada Waaberi , halkaas oo uu ku soo bandhigay riwaayado iyo heeso badan oo bulshada Soomaaliyeed qalbigeeda ku reebay raad waara. Axmed Cali Cigaal wuxuu ahaa fanaan codkar ah, laxamiiste xirfad leh, jilaa heer sare ah iyo curiye suugaan leh, w axaana lagu xusuustaa heeso badan oo weli caan ka ah bulshada Soomaaliyeed, waxaana ka mid ah: • Badu Inay Madowdahay • Cuku Howl Adduun Badanaa • Gayaan (oo uu la qaaday Khadra Daahir Cige) • Kaban • Dad Hargeysa Soo Maray • Sida Dhoolka Guga • Sida Neefta Weylaha • Deeqa • Waa Laysu Soo Noqon Sidoo kale, wuxuu ka qayb qaatay matalaadda riwaayado badan oo soo baxay xilligii dahabiga ahaa ee fanka Soomaaliyeed. Mid ka mid ah guulihii ugu waaweynaa ee uu gaaray ayaa ahaa inuu ka mid noqdo aas-aasayaashii kooxdii Somali Jazz , oo horseed u noqotay soo bandhigista heeso casri ah oo Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo bulshada u furay qaab cusub oo muusig iyo madadaalo ah. Muddooyinkii dambe ee noloshiisa, Axmed Cali Cigaal wuxuu ku noolaa dalka Mareykanka, asagoo sanado ka hor w areysi uu bixiyay ku sheegay inuu ka yaraaday masraxyada fanka, islamarkaana uu xoogga saarayo cibaadada, isagoo sheegay in loo yaqaan Sheekh Axmed . Saacado ka hor ayaa Alle ha u naxariistee Axmed Cali Cigaal ku geeriyooday dalka Mareykanka, ka dib muddo uu xanuunsanaa, waxaana geeridiisa si weyn uga tacsiyeeyay madax, bahda fanka Soomaaliyeed, hal-abuurro iyo dad kale oo saameyn leh.

Intii uu ku jiray bahda fanka, Axmed wuxuu noqday xubin muhiim ah oo ka tirsan Kooxda Hobollada Waaberi , halkaas oo uu ku soo bandhigay riwaayado iyo heeso badan oo bulshada Soomaaliyeed qalbigeeda ku reebay raad waara. Axmed Cali Cigaal wuxuu ahaa fanaan codkar ah, laxamiiste xirfad leh, jilaa heer sare ah iyo curiye suugaan leh, w axaana lagu xusuustaa heeso badan oo weli caan ka ah bulshada Soomaaliyeed, waxaana ka mid ah: • Badu Inay Madowdahay • Cuku Howl Adduun Badanaa • Gayaan (oo uu la qaaday Khadra Daahir Cige) • Kaban • Dad Hargeysa Soo Maray • Sida Dhoolka Guga • Sida Neefta Weylaha • Deeqa • Waa Laysu Soo Noqon Sidoo kale, wuxuu ka qayb qaatay matalaadda riwaayado badan oo soo baxay xilligii dahabiga ahaa ee fanka Soomaaliyeed. Mid ka mid ah guulihii ugu waaweynaa ee uu gaaray ayaa ahaa inuu ka mid noqdo aas-aasayaashii kooxdii Somali Jazz , oo horseed u noqotay soo bandhigista heeso casri ah oo Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo bulshada u furay qaab cusub oo muusig iyo madadaalo ah. Muddooyinkii dambe ee noloshiisa, Axmed Cali Cigaal wuxuu ku noolaa dalka Mareykanka, asagoo sanado ka hor w areysi uu bixiyay ku sheegay inuu ka yaraaday masraxyada fanka, islamarkaana uu xoogga saarayo cibaadada, isagoo sheegay in loo yaqaan Sheekh Axmed . Saacado ka hor ayaa Alle ha u naxariistee Axmed Cali Cigaal ku geeriyooday dalka Mareykanka, ka dib muddo uu xanuunsanaa, waxaana geeridiisa si weyn uga tacsiyeeyay madax, bahda fanka Soomaaliyeed, hal-abuurro iyo dad kale oo saameyn leh.

items.title: TRUMP oo iska fogeeyey fadeexadda Gianni Infantino
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuusan wax lug ah ku lahayn, islamarkaana kala hadlin madaxweynaha xiriirka kubadda cagta adduunka ee FIFA, Gianni Infantino, qorshaha muranka dhaliyey ee ururkaasi uu doonayo inuu qayb ka mid ah xuquuqdiisa ganacsi ugu wareejiyo maal-gashadayaal gaar ah. Trump ayaa hadalkan Jimcihii ka sheegay kulan ay golihiisa wasiirradu ku yeesheen Camp David, kaddib markii wariye uu weydiiyey inuu Infantino kala hadlay qorshaha cusub ee FIFA. “Lama aanan hadlin,” ayuu Trump ku jawaabay, isaga oo aan faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka bixin mowqifkiisa ku aaddan qorshaha. FIFA ayaa toddobaadkan soo bandhigtay hindise ay ku doonayso inay balaayiin dollar ku ururiso, iyadoo saamiyo ka mid ah xuquuqdeeda ganacsi, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa Koobka Adduunka, ka iibinaysa maal-gashadayaal gaar ah. Qorshaha ayaa durba dhaliyey mucaaradad xooggan oo uga timid xiriirrada kubadda cagta ee qaaradaha iyo saraakiil ka tirsan FIFA. Qaadacadda UEFA Xiriirka kubadda cagta Yurub ee UEFA ayaa ku hanjabay in 55-ka xiriir qaran ee xubnaha ka ah aysan ka qeyb geli doonin tartamada FIFA haddii ururka caalamiga ahi ku sii adkeysto qorshaha maal-gashadayaasha gaarka ah. UEFA waxay sheegtay in Koobka Adduunka aan loo beddeli karin hanti ama badeecad ay saamiyo ku yeelan karaan shirkado iyo maal-gashadayaal gaar loo leeyahay. Xiriirka kubadda cagta Waqooyiga iyo Bartamaha Ameerika iyo Kariibiyaanka ee CONCACAF iyo xiriirka kubadda cagta Aasiya ee AFC ayaa iyaguna iska fogeeyey qorshaha, taas oo sare u qaaday cadaadiska lagu hayo hoggaanka FIFA. Gudaha FIFA-na khilaafka ayaa sii xoogeysanaya. La-taliye sare oo ka tirsanaa kooxda Infantino ayaa xilka iska casilay, halka madaxa hawlgallada FIFA uu sheegay in mashruuca uu ahaa qorshe uu hormuud ka ahaa hal qof. Hadalladaasi waxay muujinayaan in hindisaha uusan weli taageero buuxda ka haysan saraakiisha sare ee ururka. Xiriirka qoyska Trump Wargeyska The Times ayaa sheegay in maal-gashadaha dhinaca teknoolojiyadda Joshua Kushner uu wada-hadallo ugu jiro inuu hoggaamiyo maal-gashiga la qorsheynayo, isaga oo adeegsanaya sanduuqiisa Thrive Eternal. Joshua Kushner waxaa walaalkiis ah Jared Kushner, oo qaba gabadha Trump ee Ivanka Trump, isla markaana la-taliye sare ka soo noqday Aqalka Cad muddadii koowaad ee Trump. Afhayeen u hadlay FIFA ayaa xaqiijiyey in Thrive la filayo inay hoggaamiso kooxda maal-gashadayaasha. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in FIFA ay qorshaha kala shaqeyneyso bankiga maalgashiga ee JPMorgan. Si kastaba, weli ma cadda in qorshuhu uu taageero aqlabiyadeed ka haysto 211-ka xiriir qaran ee xubnaha ka ah FIFA. Qorshuhu wuxuu imaanayaa xilli FIFA ay isku dayeyso inay kordhiso dakhligooda ganacsi, gaar ahaan xuquuqda baahinta, kafaala-qaadka iyo tartamada waaweyn sida Koobka Adduunka iyo Koobka Kooxaha Adduunka. Hase yeeshee, kooxaha kasoo horjeeda waxay ka digayaan in maal-gashadayaasha gaarka ah ay saameyn ku yeelan karaan maamulka kubadda cagta, qaabka tartamada loo abaabulo iyo sida dakhliga loogu qeybiyo xiriirrada xubnaha ka ah FIFA. Infantino ayaa ugu dambeyn xalay ka laabtay hindisihiisii, isagoo bayaan soo saaray goor dambe oo Jimcihii ah kuna sheegay in “hindisaha aan la sii wadi doonin.” “Kadib markii aan si taxaddar leh u dhageystay dhammaan aragtiyaha la soo bandhigay, waxaa caddaatay in mashruucan uu abuuray kala qeybsanaan heerkeedu yahay mid, iyada oo aan loo eegin taageerada uu haysto, aan hadda waafaqsaneyn ujeeddadii markii hore loo dejiyay,” ayuu yiri. The post TRUMP oo iska fogeeyey fadeexadda Gianni Infantino appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Editing the Kampala Communiqué Will Not Solve Somalia’s Political Crisis
items.description: By Hassan Yusuf A short video circulating widely on social media has reignited an important national conversation. In the clip, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud appears to question why Somalia’s internal political issues were reflected in the Kampala summit communiqué, suggesting that such matters should not form part of a regional document. The remarks have generated predictable political reactions, but they also raise a much more fundamental question: if Somalia’s internal political affairs are already being discussed by regional leaders behind closed doors, what exactly is achieved by removing them from the final communiqué? This is where the debate deserves greater honesty. A communiqué is not the source of a country’s political problems. It is merely a record of what leaders considered important enough to discuss. If Somalia’s political disagreements occupy a significant place during a regional summit attended by Heads of State and Government, then the issue is not the wording of the communiqué. The issue is why Somalia’s domestic politics have become significant enough to command the attention of the region. No Somali would welcome unnecessary external involvement in national affairs. Every nation values its sovereignty and the right to determine its own political future. But sovereignty is not protected simply by objecting to language in diplomatic documents. Sovereignty is strengthened when national institutions are capable of resolving political disagreements without requiring regional mediation or international concern. The strongest demonstration of independence is not insisting that others remain silent; it is showing that the country’s own political system is functioning effectively. Somalia occupies a unique place in the Horn of Africa. Its security, economy, coastline, migration patterns, and political stability directly affect its neighbours. Instability in Somalia does not stop at its borders. Trade corridors are disrupted, humanitarian needs expand, refugee movements increase, security cooperation becomes more complex, and regional economic integration slows. For that reason, Somalia’s political developments inevitably become matters of regional interest. This is not because neighbouring countries wish to interfere in Somalia’s sovereignty, but because they inevitably bear the consequences of prolonged political uncertainty. That reality explains why discussions about Somalia at regional summits increasingly extend beyond military operations and security cooperation. Political consensus, constitutional implementation, relations between the Federal Government and Federal Member States, electoral processes, and governance have all become subjects of regional concern because they directly influence peace and stability across the Horn of Africa. Pretending these issues remain purely domestic does not make their regional implications disappear. The greater concern is that Somalia often appears to spend more energy debating how political realities are described than addressing the realities themselves. Whether the issue is a communiqué, a press statement, or an international report, public attention frequently shifts to the wording instead of the substance. Yet changing the language of a document has never resolved a constitutional dispute, restored political trust, or produced national consensus. Only dialogue can achieve that. Perhaps the question Somalis should be asking is not why regional leaders discussed Somalia’s internal political situation. The more important question is why those issues required discussion at a regional summit at all. If relations between political stakeholders were functioning smoothly, if constitutional questions had been settled, if elections were broadly accepted, and if institutions enjoyed widespread confidence, Somalia’s domestic politics would rarely dominate regional meetings. Stable countries are discussed for their contributions to regional integration, trade, investment, and shared prosperity-not because their internal political disputes require collective attention. This is not an argument against regional engagement. The Horn of Africa is an interconnected region where cooperation is essential. Regional organizations have an important role in supporting peace, security, economic development, and collective stability. But sustainable political solutions cannot be imported. They must emerge from Somali-led dialogue built on compromise, mutual respect, and a shared commitment to national interests above political competition. The viral video should therefore serve as an opportunity for reflection rather than polarization. Somalia deserves a serious national conversation about why its political disputes continue to attract regional attention and, more importantly, what can be done to change that reality. The country’s future will not be secured by editing diplomatic communiqués. It will be secured by building political consensus, strengthening institutions, completing constitutional reforms, and restoring confidence among all stakeholders. In the end, the Kampala communiqué is not the story. It is only a symptom. The real story is Somalia’s unfinished political conversation-one that only Somalis themselves can complete. When that conversation is finally concluded with wisdom and compromise, future regional summits will speak of Somalia not as a political challenge to be managed, but as a stable partner helping shape the future of the Horn of Africa. Hassan Yusuf Email: hyusufka@gmail.com ——————– Hassan writes about current politics in the Horn of Africa Region The post Editing the Kampala Communiqué Will Not Solve Somalia’s Political Crisis appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Sacuudiga oo dhisay isbahaysi la dagaalama Xuutiyiinta
items.description: Sacuudiga ayaa aasaasay isbahaysi cusub oo qorshuhu yahay in lagu la dagaalamo Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee dagaalka ka furay marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb iyo Badda Cas. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ayaa 20-kii bishii July ku dhawaaqay go’doomin ka dhan ah Dekedaha Sacuudiga, waxayna maraakiibta ku sii jeeda dekedaha dalkaasi ama ka imanaya ka mamnuuceen inay adeegsadaan Marinka Bab El-Mandeb iyo Badda Cas. Warbaahinta Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in wejiga koowaad ee isbahaysigan lagu aasaasay 14 dal oo Riyadh ka gacan siiya, sidii loo sugi lahaa amniga Badda Cas, Bab El-Mandeb iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Wakaaladda Wararka Sacuudiga ee SPA ayaa Jimcihii ku warantay in Somaliya ay xubin ka tahay isbahaysigan, oo dalalka ugu waaweyn ay yihiin Turkiga, Masar iyo Pakistan. Wakaaladda Wararka SPA ayaa sheegtay in dalalka kale ee heshiiska saxiixay ay yihiin Sacuudiga, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Jordan, Yemen, Sudan, Jabuuti, Nigeria iyo Bangladesh. Wasaaradda Difaaca Sacuudiga ayaa Khamiistii Caasimadda Riyadh ku qabatay shir looga hadlayay hindisaha boqortooyada ee lagu dhisayo isbahaysi difaac oo caalami ah, kaas oo ay ka qaybgaleen wakiilada dalalka saaxiibada la ah iyo wafdi ka socda Midowga Yurub. “Hindisahan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaalada lagu xoojinayo amniga badda, lagu ilaalinayo marinada badda ee caalamiga ah, laguna dagaalamayo khataraha ku wajahan isu socodka maraakiibta iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah.” Ayay ku warantay SPA. SPA ayaa qortay “Ka qaybgalka ballaaran wuxuu muujinayaa xiisaha caalamiga ah ee sii kordhaya ee lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga difaaca badda iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay mideynta dadaalada lagu xallinayo khataraha la wadaago ee amniga marinada badda ee caalamiga ah. Ka qaybgalayaashu waxay ka wada hadleen khataraha sii kordhaya ee amniga badda, oo ay ku jiraan weerarada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo maraakiibta ganacsiga, booyadaha shidaalka iyo kaabeyaasha tamarta. items.title: Hundreds of Migrants Reach Spain’s Ceuta Enclave in Dramatic Sea Crossing
items.description: Ceuta, Spain (WDN) — Hundreds of migrants have reached the Spanish enclave of Ceuta in recent days after making the perilous journey across the waters separating Morocco from the European territory, in a fresh surge that has caught the attention of Spanish authorities and humanitarian organizations. Dramatic footage broadcast by local television stations and international media showed dozens of migrants swimming through rough coastal waters toward Ceuta, while others, exhausted but determined, sprinted inland moments after setting foot on Spanish soil. The scenes underscored both the desperation of those seeking a better future in Europe and the continuing challenges facing European border authorities as irregular migration pressures persist. Ceuta, together with the nearby Spanish enclave of Melilla, occupies a unique geopolitical position. The two territories are Spain’s only land holdings on the African continent and represent the European Union’s only land borders with Africa. As a result, they have long served as key entry points for migrants and asylum seekers attempting to reach Europe from Africa and, in some cases, the Middle East. The latest influx prompted Spanish security forces to reinforce border patrols and increase surveillance around the enclave in an effort to contain further crossings. Emergency response teams and humanitarian organizations were also deployed to assist many of the arrivals, several of whom were suffering from exhaustion, dehydration, and exposure after undertaking the dangerous sea crossing. This massive influx of about 60,000 migrants into Spanish territory , has resulted Italy to temporarily suspended Schengen free-travel arrangements with Spain, implementing air and sea border checks. Spain and Morocco have maintained close cooperation for years in efforts to curb irregular migration, coordinating border security and law enforcement operations. Nevertheless, sudden waves of crossings continue to occur, particularly during periods of calm weather that make sea crossings less hazardous or when worsening economic hardship, conflict, or political instability drives more people to leave their home countries. Migration experts say such movements often reflect broader regional pressures rather than isolated incidents, with poverty, unemployment, armed conflict, and climate-related challenges continuing to push thousands toward Europe despite the significant risks involved. The latest arrivals also highlight the enduring humanitarian crisis unfolding along one of the world’s deadliest migration routes. The United Nations and international human rights organizations have repeatedly warned that thousands of migrants lose their lives every year attempting to cross the Mediterranean Sea or other maritime routes linking Africa and Europe. Despite the dangers, many migrants continue to undertake these life-threatening journeys, viewing the risks at sea as preferable to the hardships they face at home. The latest scenes from Ceuta serve as a stark reminder that the forces driving irregular migration remain as powerful as ever, ensuring that Europe’s southern frontier continues to witness repeated waves of desperate arrivals. items.title: Tobannaan Kun oo Muhaajiriin ah oo Gudbay Xadka Ceuta ee Spain
items.description: Tobannaan kun oo muhaajiriin ah, oo lagu qiyaasay inta u dhaxaysa 50,000 ilaa 60,000 qof, ayaa 24-kii saac ee la soo dhaafay ka gudbay xadka u dhexeeya magaalada Ceuta ee Spain iyo dalka Morocco. Dadkaasi ayaa la sheegay inay xadka uga tallaabeen si lug ah iyo iyagoo badda ka soo gudbay, taasoo keentay xaalad degdeg ah oo amni iyo bani’aadannimo. Dowladda Spain ayaa ciidamo iyo booliis dheeraad ah u dirtay Ceuta si loo xakameeyo qulqulka muhaajiriinta, halka Midowga Yurub uu si dhow ula socdo xaaladda. Wararka hordhaca ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in dad badan ay ku dhinteen ama ku dhaawacmeen isku dhex-yaac iyo isku daygii ay ugu gudbayeen xadka, inkastoo tirada rasmiga ah ee khasaaraha aan weli si buuxda loo xaqiijin. Sida ay wararka hordhaca ahi sheegayaan, dad badan ayaa badda dabaal uga gudbay xadka u dhexeeya Morocco iyo magaalada Ceuta ee Spain, halka kuwo kalena ay ka gudbeen iyagoo lugaynaya ama adeegsanaya waxyaabo sabbeeya. Badda u dhexeysa Morocco iyo Ceuta waa masaafo gaaban meelaha qaar, sidaas darteed sanadihii la soo dhaafay waxaa soo noqnoqday in muhaajiriin ay isku dayaan inay dabaal ku gaaraan Ceuta. Dhacdadii maanta sidoo kale waxaa la sheegay in qaar badan ay badda ka soo gudbeen, inkastoo ay ahayd safar aad u halis badan oo sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawacyo. Dhacdadan ayaa lagu tilmaamay mid ka mid ah qulqulkii ugu ballaarnaa ee muhaajiriinta ee soo mara xadka Spain sannadkan, iyadoo dib u soo nooleysay doodda ku saabsan socdaalka sharci darrada ah iyo ilaalinta xuduudaha Yurub.

items.title: Company United States Sanctioning Iran’s Mahan Air Network and IRGC-Linked Front Company
items.description: United States Sanctioning Iran’s Mahan Air Network and IRGC-Linked Front Company Press Statement Thomas “Tommy” Pigott, Spokesperson The United States today sanctioned six entities and individuals in China, India, Russia, and Iran that enable the Iranian regime’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC). These include entities that support Mahan Air, the IRGC’s airline of choice for moving weapons, military personnel, and equipment. Today’s action also targets DadeNegar Startup Studio, an IRGC-affiliated front company supporting Iranian military targeting by soliciting locations of American and Israeli equipment in the Middle East. The United States calls on the international community, particularly companies and individuals doing business with Mahan Air or any other sanctioned Iranian carrier, to recognize the serious risks raised by continuing such engagement. The United States will continue to expose and disrupt entities providing the IRGC with the tools and information it uses to threaten American personnel, our partners, and regional stability. OFAC is taking this action pursuant to Executive Order (E.O.) 13224, as amended, which targets terrorist groups, their supporters, and those who aid acts of terrorism, and in furtherance of the President’s National Security Presidential Memorandum 2 (NSPM-2), which directs the U.S. government to deny the IRGC access to assets and resources that sustain its destabilizing activities. On October 12, 2011, OFAC designated Mahan Air pursuant to E.O. 13224 for providing financial, material, and technological support to Iran’s IRGC-Qods Force (IRGC-QF), which OFAC designated pursuant to E.O. 13224 in October 2007 for providing material support to multiple terrorist organizations. The U.S. Department of State designated the IRGC itself pursuant to the counterproliferation authority E.O. 13382 in 2007, and OFAC designated the IRGC pursuant to E.O. 13224 in October 2017 for providing support to the IRGC-QF. F or more information on today’s action, please see Treasury’s press release .

items.title: In Loving Memory of Axmed Cali Cigaal: A Timeless Voice of Somali Music and Theatre
items.description: By Anwar Maxamed Diiriye The Somali people, the global Somali diaspora, and lovers of Somali arts have lost one of their brightest cultural icons. On July 31, 2026, Axmed Cali Cigaal, one of the most influential figures in the history of Somali music and theatre, passed away in Minneapolis, Minnesota, after a brief hospitalization. He was in his late 70s. His passing marks the end of a remarkable artistic journey that spanned more than five decades and helped shape the golden age of Somali performing arts. As a singer, melodist, ‘oudist, and actor, Axmed Cali Cigaal left behind an enduring legacy that continues to inspire artists and audiences across Somalia and throughout the Somali diaspora. Born in Wardheer, Cigaal entered Somali cultural life in 1967 while still a young student. From childhood, he was captivated by the songs broadcast on Radio Muqdisho and Radio Hargeysa, carefully studying the voices and styles of the country’s finest performers. That early passion blossomed into an extraordinary career that earned him a place among the greatest artists in the history of Somali theatrical music. His rise to national prominence began with his performances in Shabeel Naagood ( Libertine ), written by the late Xasan Sheekh Muumin; Talo iyo Talaabo by Dheeg; and Yaxaas Dhagaduub by the late Maxamuud Cabdillaahi Singub. These landmark productions introduced him to audiences throughout Somalia and established him as one of the country’s leading stage performers. As a member of the legendary Waaberi National Performing Arts Troupe, he toured extensively, bringing Somali theatre and music to communities across the nation and abroad equally. Although celebrated primarily as a singer, Axmed Cali Cigaal possessed an exceptionally broad range of artistic talents. He composed melodies, played the kaban (‘oud) with distinction, acted on stage, and contributed to theatrical productions as a complete musician. His rare ability to excel in every aspect of performance earned him widespread admiration and the reputation of being one of Somalia’s most versatile artists. He also played a pioneering role in the development of Somali Jazz, helping introduce one of the earliest modern band formats in Somali music. By blending traditional Somali poetry and melodies with contemporary instrumental arrangements, he contributed significantly to the evolution of modern Somali musical expression while preserving its rich cultural identity. Throughout his distinguished career, Cigaal recorded hundreds of songs that remain beloved by Somali audiences around the world. Among some of his most celebrated works are Cakuye Hawl Adduun , Caraweelo , Suleekha , and Baabullaha Libaax , songs admired for their poetic beauty, memorable melodies, and emotional depth. His recordings continue to be cherished by generations of Somalis, preserving his voice as an enduring part of the nation’s cultural heritage. He collaborated with many of Somalia’s greatest artists. His memorable duets with his former wives, the renowned singers Maryan Mursal Ciise and Khadra Daahir Cige, remain among the most cherished recordings in Somali music. He also performed with legendary artists, including Xaliimo Khaliif “Magool” and others, creating timeless works that continue to inspire musicians and audiences alike. In later years, Axmed Cali Cigaal made the United States his home but never abandoned his lifelong commitment to Somali culture. He continued participating in Somali theatrical productions and cultural events throughout North America, Africa, and Europe, helping preserve and promote Somali artistic traditions for younger generations living abroad. While his artistic achievements earned him national recognition, those who knew Axmed Cali Cigaal personally remember him just as much for the person he was. Friends, colleagues, and acquaintances describe him as a faithful, humble, generous, kind, polite, and genuinely warm individual who treated everyone with respect. He welcomed people with a sincere smile, spoke gently, and never allowed his fame to distance him from others. Whether meeting lifelong friends or someone for the first time, he made people feel valued and comfortable. His humility, generosity of spirit, and gracious character earned him the admiration and affection of everyone fortunate enough to know him. News of his passing spread quickly across Somali communities around the world, prompting an outpouring of grief from fellow artists, family members, friends, and admirers. Many described him not only as one of the pillars of Somali music and theatre but also as a man of exceptional character whose kindness matched his extraordinary talent. Axmed Cali Cigaal’s legacy reaches far beyond the songs he sang or the stages on which he performed. He helped preserve Somali artistic traditions while contributing to their growth and modernization. His work bridged generations, inspired countless performers, and enriched the cultural identity of the Somali people. His voice, melodies, and artistic vision will continue to live on through the music and theatre he helped create.He is survived by his family, fellow artists, friends, and countless admirers whose lives were enriched by his remarkable career and generous spirit. Although the Somali nation has lost one of its greatest cultural icons, his legacy will continue wherever Somali music is sung, the ‘oud is played, and the stories of the nation’s theatre are remembered. His life reminds us that true greatness is measured not only by artistic achievement but also by humility, kindness, generosity, and the lasting impact one leaves on the hearts of others. Future generations will continue to hear his voice, study his artistry, and celebrate the remarkable contribution he made to Somali culture. May his legacy remain a source of pride and inspiration for all Somalis for generations to come. O Allah, the Most Merciful, forgive our deceased brother, pardon all his shortcomings, accept his righteous deeds, and envelop him in Your boundless mercy. Protect him from the punishment and torment of the grave, make the questioning by the angels easy, and keep his tongue firm upon the truth. Expand and fill his grave with Your light, peace, and mercy, making it a garden from the gardens of Paradise. O Allah, admit him into the highest ranks of Jannatul Firdaws without reckoning, reunite him with the Prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous, and protect him from the Fire. O Allah, grant patience, strength, and comfort to his family, friends, loved ones, and everyone who mourns his passing. Forgive all our deceased Muslims, have mercy upon them, and grant them eternal peace and everlasting joy in Paradise. Aamiin. items.title: DF oo war kasoo saartay weerarkii lagu qaaday dekedda…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u cambaareysay weerarkii argagixiso ee loo adeegsaday diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn (drones) ee lagu bartilmaameedsaday dekedda Damiietta ee Jamhuuriyadda Carabta Masar. Weerarkaasi oo dhacay 29-kii Luulyo 2026 ayaa sababay dab ka kacay laba markab, waxaana sidoo kale uu halis geliyay kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah ee dekedda. War-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Soomaaliya ayaa lagu sheegay in dowladda ay si buuxda ula garab taagan tahay Masar dadaallada ay ugu jirto la tacaalidda weerarrada noocan oo kale ah. “Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay garab taagan tahay Jamhuuriyadda Carabta Masar dadaallada ay ugu jirto la tacaalidda khatartaan, waxayna walaac xooggan ka muujinaysaa weerarrada halista ku ah xorriyadda isu socodka maraakiibta iyo xasilloonida guud ee gobolka,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa muujisay walaac xooggan oo ay ka qabto weerarrada lagu beegsanayo kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah iyo marinada ganacsiga, kuwaas oo saameyn ku yeelan kara amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Dowladdu waxay mar kale adkeysay mowqifkeeda adag ee ka dhanka ah argagixisada nooc kasta oo ay tahay, iyadoo cambaareysay falalka sii hurinaya xiisadaha gobolka ee khatarta ku ah nabadda, amniga iyo barwaaqada shacabka. Soomaaliya ayaa ugu dambeyn ku celisay inay ka go’an tahay taageeridda dadaallada lagu xoojinayo nabadda, amniga iyo iskaashiga gobolka, iyadoo ku baaqday in si wadajir ah looga hortago khataraha argagixisada iyo weerarrada wax u dhimaya amniga marinada badda. items.title: R/W Xamza oo ku wajahan Laascaanood + Ujeedka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa lagu wadaa inay maalmaha soo socda gaaraan magaalada Laascaanood ee xarunta maamulka Waqooyi Bari, iyadoo ay socoto qaban-qaabadii ugu dambeysay ee lagu soo dhoweynayo wafdiga. Wararka laga helayo Laascaanood ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada ilaalada gaarka ah ee Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ay maanta gaareen magaalada, kuwaas oo hordhac u ah safarka Xamza iyo wafdigiisa. Sidoo kale, waxaa la adkeeyay ammaanka magaalada Laascaanood ee xarunta maamulka Waqooyi Bari, iyadoo si habsami leh u socoto diyaar-garowga la xiriira booqashada. Safarka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa noqonaya kii saddexaad ee uu ku tago Laascaanood tan iyo markii ay Dowladda Federaalka billowday xoojinta xiriirka ay la leedahay maamulka Waqooyi Bari. Wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in ujeeddada ugu weyn ee booqashadu ay la xiriirto arrimaha ciidamada maamulka Waqooyi Bari, kuwaas oo Dowladda Federaalka qorsheyneyso in si rasmi ah loogu daro ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed, si loo mideeyo taliska iyo hannaanka ciidamada qaranka. Safarkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli shalay magaalada Laascaanood ay gaareen Taliyaha ciidanka lugta xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed, Jeneraal Khaalid Cabdullaahi Cumar iyo saraakiil kale oo ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay u tageen dardar-gelinta qorshayaasha amniga iyo diyaarinta booqashada Ra’iisul Wasaaraha. Ilo ku dhow maamulka Waqooyi Bari ayaa sheegaya in inta uu Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu joogo Laascaanood la filayo inuu kulamo la yeesho madaxda maamulka, odayaasha dhaqanka iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada, iyadoo diiradda lagu saarayo arrimaha amniga, maamulka iyo xiriirka kala dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka. Booqashada Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa loo arkaa mid muhiim u ah xoojinta wada-shaqeynta Dowladda Federaalka iyo maamulka Waqooyi Bari, gaar ahaan dadaallada lagu mideynayo ciidamada, lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo hirgelinta qorshayaasha dowladda ee deegaannada maamulkaas. items.title: Kulanka BF oo berri furmaya iyo xiisad culus oo taagan
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa lagu wadaa inuu maalinta berri ah yeesho kalfadhigiisii ugu horreeyay ee sannadka dheeraadka ah, iyadoo ajandaha ugu muhiimsan uu yahay furitaanka kalfadhiga cusub iyo qabashada doorashada guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka. Xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka ayaa loo diray farriimo rasmi ah oo lagu wargelinayo inay kasoo qeyb-galaan fadhiga, kaas oo si rasmi ah loogu daah-furayo kalfadhiga sannadka dheeraadka ah. Maamulka Golaha ayaa sidoo kale diyaariyay qaban-qaabada kulanka, iyadoo la filayo in ammaanka xarunta baarlamaanka si weyn loo adkeeyo. Doorashada guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa noqotay qodobka ugu weyn ee indhaha lagu hayo, iyadoo musharrixiin dhowr ah ay ku loollamayaan xilka bannaan. Musharrixiinta ayaa maalmihii la soo dhaafay waday ololeyaal siyaasadeed iyo kulamo ay taageero kaga raadinayeen xildhibaannada. Si kastaba, kulanka berri ayaa wajahaya caqabado siyaasadeed oo waaweyn, kuwaas oo la xiriira sharciyadda kalfadhiga sannadka dheeraadka ah. Arrintan ayaa sii xoojisay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ka taagan hay’adaha federaalka. Xildhibaanno badan ayaa si cad uga soo horjeestay furitaanka kalfadhigan, iyagoo ku doodaya in muddo-xileedka hay’adaha federaalka uu dhammaaday, sidaas darteedna aysan sharci ahayn in la qabto kalfadhi cusub ama lagu doorto guddoomiye cusub. Dhanka kale, xildhibaannada laga soo doortay Puntland iyo Jubbaland ayaa hore u shaaciyay inay qaadaceen sannadka dheeraadka ah ee baarlamaanka. Ilaa iyo hadda ma cadda inay kasoo qeyb-geli doonaan fadhiga berri iyo doorashada guddoomiyaha cusub, taas oo saameyn ku yeelan karta kooramka iyo habsami u socodka kulanka. Wararka laga helayo Villa Hargeysa ayaa sheegaya in dadaallo siyaasadeed ay weli socdaan si loo helo tiro ku filan oo xildhibaanno ah, loona xaqiijiyo in fadhigu ku furmo kooram sharci ah, isla markaana doorashadu u dhacdo sidii loo qorsheeyay. Indhaha siyaasadda Soomaaliya ayaa hadda ku wajahan kulanka berri ee baarlamaanka, iyadoo la sugayo sida uu u qabsoomi doono furitaanka kalfadhiga, in la helo kooram ku filan iyo in Golaha Shacabka uu doorto guddoomiye cusub, xilli uu weli taagan yahay muranka siyaasadeed ee hareeyay sharciyadda sannadka dheeraadka ah. items.title: Somalia Mourns the Loss of Cultural Icon Ahmed Ali Igal, Who Dies in the United States
items.description: Minneapolis (WDN)— Somalia’s cultural community and Somalis at home and around the world has been plunged into mourning following the death of legendary Somali artist Ahmed Ali Igal, one of the country’s most celebrated performers and a towering figure in Somali music, theatre, and poetry. He passed away in the United States, bringing to a close a remarkable career that helped shape generations of Somali artistic expression. The news of his passing has sent shockwaves through Somalia’s artistic community and across the Somali diaspora. Tributes have poured in on social media from Somalis across, fellow artists, public figures, and admirers, many describing him as one of the last great ambassadors of Somalia’s classical performing arts. Others recalled his humility, professionalism, and unwavering commitment to preserving Somali cultural heritage. The Federal Government of Somalia’s Ministry of Information, Culture and Tourism officially announced its condolences, describing Ahmed Ali Igal as one of the nation’s most distinguished cultural icons whose contributions left an enduring mark on Somalia’s artistic heritage. In a statement signed by Minister of Information, Culture and Tourism Abdifitah Qasim Mahmoud, Deputy Minister Abdirahman Yusuf Omar (Al-Cadaala), the Ministry’s Director General, senior officials, and staff, the government extended heartfelt condolences to the late artist’s family, relatives, colleagues, the Somali artistic community, and the Somali people at large. The ministry praised Ahmed Ali Igal as a pioneering figure whose lifelong dedication played a pivotal role in preserving, promoting, and enriching Somali culture through music, theatre, and literature. In its condolence message, the Ministry prayed that Allah grant Ahmed Ali Igal Jannatul Firdaws, the highest place in Paradise, and bless his family, friends, colleagues, and the Somali people with patience and strength during this difficult time. A Pillar of Waaberi’s Golden Era Ahmed Ali Igal was a prominent member of the legendary Waaberi National Troupe, widely regarded as the cornerstone of Somalia’s modern performing arts during its golden era. As part of Waaberi, he participated in numerous landmark theatrical productions and musical performances that entertained audiences while conveying powerful messages of national unity, social awareness, and cultural pride. His performances helped elevate Somali artistic traditions and ensured that music and theatre remained powerful tools for education, storytelling, and national identity. For many Somalis, Ahmed Ali Igal’s voice and performances became inseparable from an era when Somali culture flourished both at home and abroad. His passing is not only the loss of an extraordinary artist—it is the end of a remarkable chapter in Somalia’s cultural history. Yet the legacy he leaves behind will continue to inspire generations, ensuring that his voice, his artistry, and his contribution to Somali culture will never be forgotten. Igal’s marks the loss of another member of the generation of artists who laid the foundations of modern Somali music, theatre, and poetry, leaving behind a legacy that continues to inspire younger generations of performers. A Legacy That Will Endure Beyond the grief, Ahmed Ali Igal’s passing serves as a poignant reminder of the immeasurable contribution made by the artists of the Waaberi National Troupe. Through their creativity and dedication, they safeguarded Somalia’s language, folklore, music, and collective memory during some of the nation’s most defining decades. WardheerNews joins the Somali people, the global Somali community, and all admirers of Somali arts and culture in mourning the passing of the legendary Somali icon, Ahmed Ali Igal. Although Ahmed Ali Igal is no longer with us, his remarkable artistic legacy will endure for generations to come. Through his timeless songs, captivating theatrical performances, and invaluable contributions to Somali culture, he inspired countless people and helped preserve and celebrate the richness of Somali heritage. His work transcended entertainment, serving as a powerful expression of identity, unity, and the shared experiences of the Somali people. His voice may have fallen silent, but the impact of his artistry will continue to resonate in the hearts of Somalis around the world. WardheerNews extends its deepest condolences to his family, friends, colleagues, and the entire Somali nation. May Allah (SWT) grant him Jannatul Firdaws and give strength and comfort to all who mourn his loss. items.title: Hassan Sheikh Meets Museveni in Kampala as Somalia Faces Security and Political Crossroads
items.description: Kampala, Uganda (WDN)— Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud arrived in Kampala on Friday for high-level talks with Ugandan President Yoweri Kaguta Museveni, ahead of a summit of troop-contributing countries to the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM). The meeting comes at a pivotal moment for Somalia, as the country confronts mounting security challenges, uncertainty over international support for AUSSOM, and an unresolved political dispute over the country’s electoral framework. According to the Somali Presidency, the two leaders held extensive discussions on the longstanding bilateral relationship between Somalia and Uganda, reaffirming their commitment to expanding cooperation in security, politics, economic development, and institutional capacity-building. Security dominated the discussions, with both presidents reviewing the ongoing campaign against Al-Shabaab and the need to strengthen regional cooperation in counterterrorism operations. Both leaders agreed that Somalia’s security remains fundamental to the stability of the Horn of Africa and emphasized the importance of sustained cooperation among regional governments, the African Union, and international partners. Beyond Security: Could Politics Also Be on the Agenda? While the official readout focused almost exclusively on security and bilateral cooperation, the timing of the meeting has inevitably fueled broader political speculation. Somalia is not only confronting a difficult security environment but also an ongoing political impasse over elections and governance. Talks between the Federal Government and opposition groups have yet to produce a comprehensive agreement on the country’s electoral roadmap, leaving key constitutional and political questions unresolved. items.title: Shirkii Kampala: Dalalka Ciidamadu ka jooggaan Soomaaliya oo isku raacay qorshe cusub oo lagu xoojinayo amniga dalka
items.description: Shir-Madaxeedkii Labaad ee Aan Caadiga Ahayn ee dalalka ciidamada  Hawlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasillinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta lagu qabtay magaalada Kampala ee dalka Uganda. Shirka waxaa martigeliyay Madaxweynaha Uganda, Yoweri Kaguta Museveni, waxaana ka qayb galay Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Dr. Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, madax iyo wakiillo ka socday dalalka ciidamada ka jooga Soomaaliya, Midowga Afrika (AU), IGAD iyo Qaramada Midoobay. War-murtiyeedkii kasoo baxay shirka ayaa lagu bogaadiyay dalalka ciidamada ku leh Soomaaliya doorkooda ku aaddan la dagaallanka argagixisada iyo taageerada xasilloonida dalka. Sidoo kale, waxaa tacsi loo diray askartii ku naf-waayay ama ku dhaawacantay howlgalka. Shirku wuxuu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la dhiso Soomaaliya mideysan oo leh hay’ado dowladeed oo xooggan, isla markaana la xoojiyo hannaanka dimuqraadiyadda, iyadoo mudnaanta la siinayo midnimada qaranka iyo danaha guud. Qodobka ugu muhiimsan ee shirka ayaa ahaa in la isku raacay qorshe nidaamsan oo lagu soo afjarayo howlgalka AUSSOM muddo u dhexeysa 18 ilaa 24 bilood, iyadoo si tartiib tartiib ah mas’uuliyadda amniga loogu wareejinayo Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliya. Qorshahan ayaa sidoo kale diiradda saaraya ciribtirka Al-Shabaab iyo taageeridda ciidamada deegaanka iyo kuwa moobilka ah ee suga amniga deegaannada la xoreeyay. War-murtiyeedka ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in la kordhiyo taageerada dhinaca diyaaradaha, sirdoonka, sahanka iyo la socodka hawlgallada, si loo xoojiyo awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu baaqay in la mideeyo tababarka iyo istaraatiijiyadda ciidamada qaranka. Dhanka kale, shirku wuxuu ku baaqay in la xoojiyo dadaallada lagula dagaallamayo fikirka xagjirka ah ee Al-Shabaab, iyadoo la horumarinayo adeegyada iyo fursadaha bulshada si loo yareeyo sababaha keena ku biirista kooxaha argagixisada. Si loo xaqiijiyo sii socoshada howlgalka AUSSOM, Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda ee dalalka ciidamada bixiya, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika ayaa loo xil saaray inay dhisaan guddi wadajir ah oo ka shaqeeya helidda maalgelin waarta oo lagu taageero howlgalka. Ugu dambeyn, war-murtiyeedka iyo go’aannada kasoo baxay shirka ayaa loo gudbin doonaa Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka ee Midowga Afrika (AU PSC), si ay u ansixiyaan ka hor inta aan loo gudbin Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay.

items.title: Former Somali Prison Commander Issues Dire Threats Against South West Leader, Escalating Political Tensions
items.description: Mogadishu  (WDN)— Former Somali Custodial Corps Commander Mahad Abdirahman, widely known as “Taliye Shub,” has issued a series of inflammatory threats against Aadan Mohamed Nur (Aadan Madoobe), the leader of South West State, accusing him of orchestrating his arrest in Mogadishu and warning that he would never enjoy peace in Baidoa. In a strongly worded public statement, the former security commander alleged that Aadan Madoobe was the architect of his detention in the Somali capital, claiming the arrest was politically motivated. He offered no evidence to support the accusation. Shub went further, delivering what appeared to be an explicit threat of continued armed confrontation against the South West administration. “If you believe you will sleep peacefully and complete your term after seizing control of South West by force, then I alone will bear the blame for believing that. You will never sleep in peace. If you had come to power peacefully, you would have lived in peace,” he declared. The former commander also asserted that there was now “only bullets” between himself and the South West leadership, insisting that there was no room for dialogue or political reconciliation. His remarks suggest a complete rejection of negotiations, raising fresh concerns over the risk of escalating violence in a region already grappling with political instability and persistent security challenges. Shub further accused Aadan Madoobe of initiating the conflict by allegedly relying on the Federal Government of Somalia to secure and consolidate political power in South West State. According to the former commander, the use of federal backing to influence regional leadership ignited the confrontation that has since deepened political divisions. The comments represent one of the most direct and provocative public attacks against the South West leadership in recent months. Security analysts warn that such rhetoric, particularly from former senior military figures, has the potential to inflame tensions and further destabilize an already fragile political environment. Neither Aadan Madoobe nor the South West State administration has publicly responded to the allegations or the threats at the time of publication. The latest exchange underscores the increasingly polarized political climate in South West State, where disputes over leadership, governance, and the role of the Federal Government continue to fuel confrontation. Whether the verbal escalation translates into renewed violence remains uncertain, but the remarks are likely to heighten concerns among political observers and security officials monitoring developments in the region. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo saxiixay ansixinta…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa saxiixay sharciga ansixinta heshiiska aagga ganacsiga xorta ah ee qaaradda Afrika (AfCFTA), taasoo dhammaystirtay geeddi-socodkii sharci ee ku biirista Soomaaliya ee suuqa ganacsi ee ugu weyn Afrika. War-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay wasaaradda ganacsiga iyo warshadaha ayaa lagu sheegay in saxiixa madaxweynaha uu u oggolaanayo Soomaaliya inay si rasmi ah ugu gudbiso Midowga Afrika dukumentiga ansixinta heshiiska kadib markii uu hore u meel-mariyay Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya. Dowladdu waxay sheegtay in ku biirista AfCFTA ay ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed, warshadaha, iskaashatooyinka iyo maalgashadayaasha u fureyso suuq mideysan oo ay ku nool yihiin in ka badan 1.4 bilyan oo qof. Heshiiskan ayaa sidoo kale kor u qaadi kara dhoofinta, maalgashiga, warshadeynta iyo abuurista fursado shaqo oo cusub, sida ay sheegtay wasaaradda Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, Jamaal Maxamed Xasan ayaa ku tilmaamay heshiiska mid taariikhi ah oo Soomaaliya u horseedaya fursado dhaqaale oo cusub, isagoo sheegay in ku biirista AfCFTA ay dalka ka dhigeyso qayb ka mid ah aagga ganacsiga xorta ah ee ugu weyn dunida, isla markaana ay sare u qaadi doonto tartanka iyo kobaca ganacsiga gaarka loo leeyahay. Wasaaradda ganacsiga ayaa sheegtay inay hoggaamin doonto hirgelinta heshiiska, iyadoo diiradda la saari doono waafajinta canshuuraha kastamka, diyaarinta habraacyada ganacsiga iyo wacyigelinta ganacsatada, gaar ahaan shirkadaha yaryar iyo kuwa dhexdhexaadka ah, si ay uga faa’iideystaan fursadaha cusub ee uu heshiisku abuurayo. AfCFTA oo uu aas-aasay Midowga Afrika ayaa ujeeddadiisu tahay in la kordhiyo ganacsiga u dhexeeya dalalka Afrika, la xoojiyo silsiladaha wax-soo-saarka ee gobolka iyo in la dardargeliyo koboca dhaqaalaha qaaradda. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya ayaa ku biiristeeda heshiiskan loo arkaa tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu ballaarinayo xiriirka ganacsi iyo maalgashi ee ay la leedahay dalalka Afrika. Heshiiskan ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu sare u qaado isdhex-galka dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya iyo dalalka Afrika, isagoo dalka siinaya fursad uu ku ballaariyo suuqyada wax-soo-saarkiisa, u soo jiito maalgashi cusub, ugana faa’iideysto kobaca ganacsiga ee qaaradda. items.title: Raysal Wasaaraha Spain oo si degdeg ah u tegay Jasiiradda Ceuta
items.description: Raysal Wasaaraha Spain, Pedro Sanchez ayaa ku tilmaamay qulqulka muhaajiriinta faraha badan ee Jasiiradda Ceuta duulaan ka dhan ah Spain. Tobanaan kun oo qof ayaa Khamiistii gaaray Jasiiradda Ceuta ee ku taala xadka Spain iyo Morocco, iyadoona Madrid ay halkaasi u dirtay ciidamo militari ah, si ay u xakameeyaan xaaladda. Sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Spain in ka badan 50,000 oo qof ayaa si sharci-darro ah ku soo galay jasiiraddaasi, badankooduna ay soo galeen iyagoo dabaalanaya. Wasaaradda ayaana xaqiijisay in 34 qof ay ku dhinteen badda, intii ay isaga tallaabayeen biyaha Morocco iyo Spain. Raysal Wasaaraha Spain oo maanta booqday Ceuta ayaa sheegay wixii shalay ka dhacay halkaasi inay ahaayeen weerar iyo xadgudub ka dhan ah madaxbannaanida dhuleed ee Spain. “Waxaan ku tilmaamaynaa wixii shalay dhacay inay ahaayeen weerar iyo xadgudub ka dhan ah madaxbannaanida dhuleed ee Spain.” Ayuu yiri Raysal Wasaaruhu. Raysal Wasaare Sanchez ayaa shabakadaha dadka tahriibiya ku eedeeyay inay ka faa’iideysteen xaaladaha jira. Sanchez ayaa sheegay in dowladdu ay damaanad qaadi doonto amniga dadka deegaanka, iyadoo xoojineysa joogitaanka Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee waddooyinka Ceuta. Tani waxay timid, ka dib markii uu buuq soo dhawayn ah kala kulmay dadka deegaanka, ciidamada amnigana ay ku khasbanaadeen inay gacan adag u adeegsadaan dadkaasi, markii Sanchez uu halkaasi gaaray. Mr. Sanchez oo dejinaya carrada dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in ciidamada la dhigi doono hareeraha darbiga badda ee xadka ee El Tarajal, si ay u hor istaagaan dadka cusub ee imanaya xeebaha dalka, isagoo intaasi ku daray in muhaajiriinta aan loo ogolaan doonin inay soo gaaraan xeebta deegaankaasi. Ceuta ayaa xudun u ah dadka magangelyo doonka ah ee doonaya in ay taggaan dalkaasi Spain, waana marin muhiim ah oo ay adeegsadaan qayb ka mid ah muhaajiriinta fursadda nololeed u raadsaneysa Qaaradda Yurub.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo ka qeyb galay Shir-Madaxeedka Waddamada Ciidamadooda ka qeyb qaata Howlgalka AUSSOM
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada Kampala ee dalka Uganda kaga qeyb galay Shir-Madaxeedka Labaad ee Waddamada ciidamadooda ka qeyb qaata Howlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasillinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM). Madaxweynaha ayaa khudbad uu ka jeediyey shirka ku soo bandhigay guulaha la taaban karo ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka gaartay dib-u-xoreynta deegaannada ay ku sugnaayeen kooxaha argagixisada, dib-u-habaynta hay’adaha amniga, xoojinta dowladnimada, kobcinta dhaqaalaha iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyey in guulahaas ay ku yimaadeen dadaalka iyo wadajirka shacabka Soomaaliyeed, ciidamada qalabka sida iyo garab istaagga saaxiibbada caalamka, isaga oo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii wadista taageerada caalamiga ah si loo xaqiijiyo nabad waarta iyo xasillooni Soomaaliya ka hanaqaadda. Shirkan ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga dalalka ciidamadoodu ka qeyb qaataan howlgalka AUSSOM, dardargelinta dagaalka lagula jiro argagixisada iyo taageeridda dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee lagu dhisayo amni iyo dowladnimo waarta.

items.title: Arab split over Red Sea security widens
items.description: Arab split over Red Sea security widens Saudi-Egypt competition for leadership and dominance over the Red Sea intensifying as Riyadh assembles regional states to sign up to a new maritime security framework. Cairo has long been resentful of the Saudi initiative to construct a Red Sea security framework it dominates. Egypt sees itself as the quintessential No. 1 Red Sea power, in large part because of its control of the Suez chokepoint. The North African state sees both Israel’s pivot to Somaliland and ongoing Saudi Red Sea ‘minilateralism’ as a threat. Rashid Abdi

items.title: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha DFS oo Madaxweyne Deni ku eedeeyay hoggaan-xumo iyo kala-qeybin siyaasadeed
items.description: Muqdisho – Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta Soomaaliya, Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh), ayaa ka jawaabay khudbad uu xalay magaalada Garoowe ka jeediyay Madaxweynaha Puntland. Wasiir Cali Xoosh ayaa sheegay in dhibaatada ka taagan Puntland ay salka ku hayso hoggaan-xumo, shaqsiyeynta maamulka iyo ku-takrifalka dowladnimada. “Dhibaatada Puntland ka taagani waa ciladda ka imaaneysa hoggaan-xumada, shaqsiyeynta iyo ku-takrifalka dowladnimada Puntland,” ayuu yiri wasiirku. Sidoo kale, wuxuu xusay in shacabka Puntland ay muddo dheer lahaayeen dhaqan siyaasadeed oo ku dhisnaa wada-hadal, is-afgarad iyo in talada laga qeyb-geliyo waxgaradka iyo bulshada deegaanka. Wasiirka ayaa ku eedeeyay Madaxweyne Deni inuu beddelay dhaqamadii siyaasadeed ee wanaagsanaa, isagoo sheegay in halkoodii ay ka dhasheen loollan siyaasadeed, awood ku saleysan xoog iyo kala-qeybin bulsho. “Waxaad burburisay dhaqamadii siyaasadeed ee wanaagsanaa, waxaadna soo kordhisay boob siyaasadeed, awood qori keliya lagu raadiyo iyo kala-qeybinta bulshada Puntland,” ayuu yiri Cali Xoosh. Hadalladan ayaa imanaya iyadoo uu sii xoogeysanayo is-maandhaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo maamulka Puntland.

items.title: DF oo shaacisay inay ka hor-tagtay dalal doonayay inay aqoonsadaan Somaliland
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay ka hortagtay dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo ay waddamo kala duwan ku doonayeen inay ku aqoonsadaan Somaliland, iyadoo ku eedeysay Israa’iil iyo Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta inay hormuud ka yihiin olole lagu raadinayo aqoonsi caalami ah oo maamulka Somaliland helo. Hadalkan waxaa sheegay Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cali Balcad oo xusay in Dowladda Federaalka ay bilihii u dambeeyay qaaday dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu qancinayay dalal la sheegay inay ka fiirsanayeen aqoonsiga Somaliland. Dadaalladaas ayaa horseeday in aan weli wax dal ah ku dhawaaqin aqoonsi rasmi ah, sida uu sheegay. “Waa nasiib darro in Somaliland ay Israa’iil tagto oo ay gobolka kusoo kordhiso xasarado iyo khilaafyo badan. Dowlad ahaan waxaan ka shaqeynaynay in aan la aqoonsan Somaliland. Dalal badan ayaa arrinta ka fikirayay, balse dadaallada ay sameeyeen Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo madaxda qaranka waxay horseedeen in aanay waddamo kale ku biirin,” ayuu yiri Cali Balcad. Wasiiru-dowlaha ayaa sheegay in illaa lix waddan ay ka fiirsanayeen aqoonsiga Somaliland, hase yeeshee dowladda Soomaaliya ay dhammaantood kala hadashay arrintaas. Wuxuu tusaale u soo qaatay Guinea-Bissau, oo ayadu dhawaan beenisay inay aqoonsaneyso Somaliland. Cali Balcad ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay Israa’iil iyo Imaaraadka Carabta inay dadaal ugu jiraan sidii ay dalal kale ugu qancin lahaayeen inay aqoonsadaan maamulka Somaliland. Labada dal ayuu ku eedeeyay inay adeegsanayaan dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed iyo dhaqaale si ay u taageeraan ololahaas. “Dalal badan ayay la hadleen, dhaqaale badanna way ku bixinayaan. Annaguna si dhow ayaan ula soconnaa, waxaana ka shaqeyneynaa inaan ka hortagno dadaalladaas,” ayuu yiri wasiiru-dowlaha arrimaha dibadda. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in dowladda Soomaaliya aysan si weyn uga walaacsanayn suurtagalnimada ay qaar ka mid ah dalalka Afrika u aqoonsan karaan Somaliland. Inkastoo uu sheegay inuu jiro olole ay Israa’iil ka waddo qaar ka mid ah waddamada ku yaalla Badweynta Baasifigga, si ay ugu dhiirrigeliso inay aqoonsadaan maamulka Somaliland. Somaliland ayaa iyadu muddo ka badan soddon sano waday dadaallo ay ku raadineyso aqoonsi caalami ah, iyadoo sannadihii u dambeeyay xoojisay xiriirka ay la leedahay dalal kala duwan. Mas’uuliyiinta Somaliland ayaa marar badan sheegay inay sii wadi doonaan ololahooda diblomaasiyadeed ilaa ay ka helayaan aqoonsi rasmi ah oo caalami ah. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda ku celisay mowqifkeeda ah inay ka soo horjeeddo tallaabo kasta oo lagu aqoonsanayo Somaliland dal madax-bannaan, iyadoo ku adkeysaneysa in midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya ay yihiin qodob aan laga tanaasuli karin. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu xoojinayo mowqifkaas iyo ka hortagga isku day kasta oo lagu aqoonsanayo Somaliland. The post DF oo shaacisay inay ka hor-tagtay dalal doonayay inay aqoonsadaan Somaliland appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dimuqraadiyadii Somaliland  waxay ku noqotay Labaatan jir Galkacayo Ilahay uma xil qarin
items.description: DIMUQRAADIYADDII SOMALILAND WAXAY KU NOQOTAY LABAATAN JIR GAALKACAYO JOOGA ILAAHAY UMUU XIL QARIN Tweet Dimuqraadiyadda aynu qaadanay waxay leedahay khasaare dhinac socda dhaqankeenna iyo diinteenna suubban waxa ka mida waxyeeladeeda. 1.Warbaahintii oo laga faafinayo fasahaad xishooddarro iyo dhaqammo aanay ogolayn diinta islaamku, waa xaaraan in qof muslim ah cirdigiisa iyo sharaftiisa lagu qaawiyo umadda horteeda si xaqdarro ah ula kac (ku xumee). 2.dimuqraadiyaddu waxay inna bartay dadkii lagu baxsanjiray sida ABWAANADII iyo madaxdhaqameedkii in loo adeegsado kaambaynno siyaasadeed iyo dano shaqsi oo gaar ah taasina waxay dhaawac ku tahay nolosheenna. Waxaynu qaadanay mabda’ inna jaahwareeriyay oo hooyooyinkii warbihinta loo adeegsaday. Waxaynu nahay dad muslim ah oo haysta diinta islaamka oo ah mabda’ binu aadmi qaato kii ugu cajiibsanaa dariiqii nebi MOHAMAD SWCW. oo ah halkay ku xasisho nolosha binu aadmigu. Maxaa innoo diidadaya inaynu diinteenna ku dhaqanno taasaaba laynagu ictiraafayaaye. MAHADSANID. CABDI BACAW. LONDON. GUUL ALLE.

items.title: Hobalkii caanka ee Axmed Cali Cigaal oo geeriyooday
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Alle ha u naxariistee, hobolkii caanka ahaa ee Soomaaliyeed, Axmed Cali Cigaal ayaa maanta ku geeriyooday dalka Mareykanka, halkaas oo uu muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ku noolaa. Geerida marxuumka ayaa murugo iyo tiiraanyo ku abuurtay bahda fanka Soomaaliyeed, qoyskiisa, asxaabtiisa iyo kumannaan qof oo muddo dheer ku riyaaqayay hal-abuurkiisa iyo doorkii uu ku lahaa horumarinta fanka Soomaaliyeed. Axmed Cali Cigaal waxa uu ka mid ahaa haldooradii ugu magaca dheeraa ee fanka Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo caan ku ahaa heesaha, laxan-samaynta iyo tumista muusigga. Intii uu ku jiray mihnadda fanka, wuxuu door muuqda ka qaatay kobcinta suugaanta iyo hiddaha Soomaaliyeed, isagoo laxan u sameeyay boqolaal heesood oo ay qaadeen fanaaniintii ugu waaweynaa dalka, halka qaar kalena uu codkiisa ku qaaday. Taariikhdiisa Marxuumka ayaa la sheegay inuu dabayaaqadii sannadihii 1940-meeyadii ku dhashay magaalada Wardheer ee gobolka Doollo. Horraantii lixdamaadkii ayuu u guuray magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu ka bilaabay waxbarashadiisa, isla markaana ay ka curtay hibadiisii faneed ee markii dambe ka dhigtay mid ka mid ah magacyada ugu waaweyn fanka Soomaaliyeed. Socdaalkiisa fanka ayaa si rasmi ah u billowday sannadkii 1964, markii Raadiyow Muqdisho laga baahiyay heestii ugu horreysay ee uu qaaday, taas oo cinwaankeedu ahaa “Bari iyo Galbeed, keebaa na baantay?”. Heestaasi waxay si weyn u soo jiidatay dhageystayaasha, waxayna u noqotay albaabkii uu kaga dhex muuqday fagaaraha fanka Soomaaliyeed. Kadib wuxuu ku biiray Dugsigii Muusigga Qaranka, halkaas oo uu si cilmiyaysan ugu bartay muusigga, laxan-samaynta iyo farsamooyinka fanka. Hibadiisa ayaa si degdeg ah u soo ifbaxday, isagoo laxan u sameeyay ruwaayado badan oo caan baxay, sida “Talo iyo Tallaabo,” “Yaxaas Dhagaduub” iyo “Shabeelnaagood,” kuwaas oo raad weyn ku reebay masraxyadii fanka Soomaaliyeed. Muddo ka badan nus qarni ayuu Axmed Cali Cigaal ka tirsanaa Hobollada Qaranka Waaberi, isagoo ka mid noqday tiirarkii ugu muhiimsanaa kooxda. Intii uu halkaas ka howlgelayay wuxuu curiyay laxamo badan oo noqday astaamo lagu xusuusto fanka Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo weli si weyn loo dhegeysto. Heesaha uu laxanka u sameeyay ama uu ka qeyb qaatay waxaa ka mid ah Batalaale, Candaliibka, Raad Abeeso, Dadnimada Aqoonso, Galaydh, Feejignow, Haasaawe, Gayaan, Gacallo iyo Caraweelo, kuwaas oo dhammaantood ka mid noqday kaydka dahabiga ah ee fanka Soomaaliyeed. Hal-abuurkiisa ayaa lagu tilmaamaa mid saameyn weyn ku yeeshay jiilal badan oo fanaaniin ah. Geerida Axmed Cali Cigaal ayaa ka dhigan luminta haldoor qaran oo door weyn ku lahaa horumarka suugaanta, muusigga iyo dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed. Bahda fanka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed ayaa si weyn uga tacsiyeynaya geeridiisa, iyagoo xusuusan doona kaalintii uu ku lahaa kobcinta hiddaha iyo fanka dalka. Marxuum Axmed Cali Cigaal wuxuu ka tegay dhaxal faneed oo qani ah, kaas oo sii noolaan doona jiilasha soo socda. Laxamadiisii, heesihii uu qaaday iyo kaalintii uu ka qaatay horumarinta fanka Soomaaliyeed ayaa ka dhigaya magac aan si fudud uga bixi doonin taariikhda fanka Soomaaliya.
