Taariikhdiisa Marxuumka ayaa la sheegay inuu dabayaaqadii sannadihii 1940-meeyadii ku dhashay magaalada Wardheer ee gobolka Doollo. Horraantii lixdamaadkii ayuu u guuray magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu ka bilaabay waxbarashadiisa, isla markaana ay ka curtay hibadiisii faneed ee markii dambe ka dhigtay mid ka mid ah magacyada ugu waaweyn fanka Soomaaliyeed. Socdaalkiisa fanka ayaa si rasmi ah u billowday sannadkii 1964, markii Raadiyow Muqdisho laga baahiyay heestii ugu horreysay ee uu qaaday, taas oo cinwaankeedu ahaa “Bari iyo Galbeed, keebaa na baantay?”. Heestaasi waxay si weyn u soo jiidatay dhageystayaasha, waxayna u noqotay albaabkii uu kaga dhex muuqday fagaaraha fanka Soomaaliyeed. Kadib wuxuu ku biiray Dugsigii Muusigga Qaranka, halkaas oo uu si cilmiyaysan ugu bartay muusigga, laxan-samaynta iyo farsamooyinka fanka. Hibadiisa ayaa si degdeg ah u soo ifbaxday, isagoo laxan u sameeyay ruwaayado badan oo caan baxay, sida “Talo iyo Tallaabo,” “Yaxaas Dhagaduub” iyo “Shabeelnaagood,” kuwaas oo raad weyn ku reebay masraxyadii fanka Soomaaliyeed. Muddo ka badan nus qarni ayuu Axmed Cali Cigaal ka tirsanaa Hobollada Qaranka Waaberi, isagoo ka mid noqday tiirarkii ugu muhiimsanaa kooxda. Intii uu halkaas ka howlgelayay wuxuu curiyay laxamo badan oo noqday astaamo lagu xusuusto fanka Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo weli si weyn loo dhegeysto. Heesaha uu laxanka u sameeyay ama uu ka qeyb qaatay waxaa ka mid ah Batalaale, Candaliibka, Raad Abeeso, Dadnimada Aqoonso, Galaydh, Feejignow, Haasaawe, Gayaan, Gacallo iyo Caraweelo, kuwaas oo dhammaantood ka mid noqday kaydka dahabiga ah ee fanka Soomaaliyeed. Hal-abuurkiisa ayaa lagu tilmaamaa mid saameyn weyn ku yeeshay jiilal badan oo fanaaniin ah. Geerida Axmed Cali Cigaal ayaa ka dhigan luminta haldoor qaran oo door weyn ku lahaa horumarka suugaanta, muusigga iyo dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed. Bahda fanka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed ayaa si weyn uga tacsiyeynaya geeridiisa, iyagoo xusuusan doona kaalintii uu ku lahaa kobcinta hiddaha iyo fanka dalka. Marxuum Axmed Cali Cigaal wuxuu ka tegay dhaxal faneed oo qani ah, kaas oo sii noolaan doona jiilasha soo socda. Laxamadiisii, heesihii uu qaaday iyo kaalintii uu ka qaatay horumarinta fanka Soomaaliyeed ayaa ka dhigaya magac aan si fudud uga bixi doonin taariikhda fanka Soomaaliya. items.title: Raysal wasaaraha cusub ee Ingriiska oo khadka telefoonka kula hadlay Trump ayaa u sheegay suurtagalnimada in
items.description: Andy Burnham ayaa bixiyay warbixin ku saabsan wada-hadal khadka taleefanka ah oo uu Khamiistii la yeeshay Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa u sheegay Mr. Trump inuu albaabka u furay suurtagalnimada in mustaqbalka laga qodo shidaalka Badda Waqooyi (North Sea), isagoo sheegay inaan la iska indho-tiri karin kheyraadka halkaas ku jira. Labada hoggaamiye ayaa wada-hadal taleefan yeeshay maalintii ugu horreysay ee Mr. Burnham uu xilka la wareegay; xilligaas oo uu Madaxweynaha Mareykanku sheegay in Ra’iisul Wasaaraha cusub uu u sheegay inuu “furi doono qodista shidaalka Badda Waqooyi”. “Waxa aan wada-hadalka ku caddeeyay — sida aan horey u sheegay Isniintii hore — inaan qaadan doono hab wax-ku-ool ah marka ay timaaddo arrinta Badda Waqooyi, waana taas qorshahayga marka aan tallaabooyinka xiga qaadeyno,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu. “Halkaas waxaa yaalla kheyraad. Marka ay dadku dhibaatooyin haystaan, ma iska indho-tiri karno arrintaas. Sidaa darteed ayaan arrintaas ugu sheegay madaxweynaha,” ayuu raaciyay. Faallooyinkani waxay u muuqdeen inay ka hor imaanayaan manufesto-kii Xisbiga Shaqaalaha ee 2024, kaas oo xisbigu uusan soo saari doonin shatiyo cusub oo Badda Waqooyi ah. Ed Miliband, oo haystay tamar iyo macluumaad kooban xilligii Sir Keir Starmer isla markaana ahaa taageere weyn oo ballanqaadka doorashada ah, ayaa hadda qaatay doorka Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda. Gabadha uu u magacaabay Xoghayaha Tamarta, Miatta Fahnbulleh, ayaa sheegay in manufesto-ku uu cad yahay in ay jirto fursad lagu faa’iidaysan karo shatiyada jira iyo in saliidda iyo gaaska ay “qayb ka yihiin isku darka” – laakiin laguma soo koobi doono in la sameeyo qorshayaal dheeraad ah. Dowladda Mr Burnham waxay sidoo kale wajahaysaa baaqyo ka imanaya waaxda tamarta si ay u ansixiyaan gaaska Jackdaw ee bariga Aberdeen iyo gaaska Rosebank ee galbeedka Shetland. Ololayaasha ayaa ka digay in sidaas la sameeyo ay jebin doonto manufesto-ka Xisbiga Shaqaalaha. Wadatashiyada mashaariicda ayaa la filayaa inay socdaan ilaa Agoosto 10 iyo Agoosto 17, siday u kala horreeyaan. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, oo ah taageere xooggan oo shidaalka fosil ah, ayaa muddo dheer ka soo horjeeday “warshadaha dabaysha”. Wuxuu ku guuldareystay dagaal sharci ah oo uu la galay Dowladda Scotland si uu u joojiyo horumarinta matoorada dabaysha ee ka muuqda garoonkiisa golf-ka ee Aberdeenshire. Mr Trump ayaa sidoo kale ku daray in Ra’iisul Wasaare Burnham uu wax ka qaban doono socdaalka, kaas oo “dilaya dalkaaga”. Mr Burnham wuxuu ku adkeystay in horumar laga sameeyay xakamaynta ka gudubka muhaajiriinta ee ka gudbaya Kanaalka Ingiriiska. Hogaamiyaha Xisbiga Cagaaran Zack Polanski ayaa uga digay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha in la sii wado qodista Badda Waqooyi maadaama ay “ka sii dari doonto burburka cimilada”. Wuxuu yiri: “Dalkeennu wuu gubanayaa. Dalagyada ayaa fashilmaya. Kumanaan qof ayaa ku dhintay kulayl aad u daran. Waajibka ugu horreeya ee ra’iisul wasaare kasta waa inuu ilaaliyo dadka dalkan oo ammaan ah, haddana, dadku waxay dareemayaan cabsi. “Ogolaanshaha qodista cusub ee saliidda iyo gaaska ee Badda Waqooyi waxay sii xumeyn doontaa burburka cimilada, taasoo khatar gelin doonta nolol badan iyo waxyeello aan la soo koobi karin u geysan doonta dhaqaalaheena.” Badda Waqooyi waxaa ku jira Belgium, Denmark, Jarmalka, Netherlands, Norway, iyo Boqortooyada Ingiriiska. Dabaysha badda, saliidda badda iyo gaaska waxaa loo arkaa inay yihiin waaxyo muhiim ah oo aagga ah.

items.title: Galmudug oo qortay bog cusub iyo Xasan Sheekh oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa hambalyo iyo bogaadin u diray shacabka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan shacabka Galmudug, guusha taariikhiga ah ee ay ka gaareen doorashooyinkii shalay si nabad ah uga dhacay deegaannada dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Xasan Sheekh ayaa u mahadceliyay madaxda dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, guddiga doorashooyinka, hay’adaha amniga, ururrada siyaasadda iyo dhammaan shacabka Galmudug dadaalkii, wadajirka iyo masuuliyadda ay muujiyeen, kuwaasi oo horseeday in doorashooyinkani ku qabsoomaan jawi nabdoon. “Waxa ay ahayd maalin taariikhi ah oo ay si sharaf, ilbaxnimo iyo kalsooni leh ugu soo baxeen odayaasha, hooyooyinka iyo dhallinyarada, kuwaasi oo intooda badan markii ugu horreysay codkooda ku dhiibtay doorasho toos ah,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Sidoo kale wuxuu arrintan ku tilmaamay inay tahay farriin cad oo tarjumaysa in bulshada Soomaaliyeed ay diyaar u tahay xoojinta dimuqraadiyadda, dowladnimada iyo in codka muwaadinka uu noqdo saldhigga hoggaanka dalka. “Waxaan si gaar ah u bogaadinayaa ururrada siyaasadda ee maalmihii loo asteeyay ololahooda ka sameeyey dhammaan deegaannada Galmudug, iyaga oo muujiyey tartan ku saleysan xamaasad, is-ixtiraam, nabad iyo u hoggaansanaanta sharciga,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha. Hab-dhaqankan bisil ayuu sheegay inuu caddeeyay in kala aragti duwanaanshaha siyaasadeed uu noqon karo mid lagu tartamo si nabad ah, iyadoo la ilaalinayo midnimada bulshada iyo danta qaranka. Ugu dambeyntiina, Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dowladdiisa ka go’an tahay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed dib loogu soo celiyo xuquuqdooda dastuuriga ah, gaar ahaan xaqa ay u leeyihiin in ay si xor iyo xalaal ah u doortaan hoggaankooda. “Tani waa ballan aan horay u qaadnay oo aana marnaba laga gorgortami doonin, waayo codka shacabka waa tiirka dowladnimada, dimuqraadiyadda iyo horumarka Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. items.title: Maxaa kasoo baxay shirka Kampala ee Soomaaliya?
items.description: Kampala (Caasimada Online) – Dalalka ciidamada ka joogaan Soomaaliya ayaa si wadajir ah u sheegay in guusha laga gaarayo dagaalka Al-Shabaab aysan ku iman karin howlgal millateri oo keliya, balse ay u baahan tahay xasillooni siyaasadeed, wada-hadal iyo dhismaha hay’adaha dowladda. Qodobkan ayaa lagu muujiyay shir ka dhacay magaalada Kampala ee caasimadda Uganda, kaas oo ay ka qeyb-galeen Soomaaliya, Jabuuti, Uganda, Burundi, Itoobiya, Masar iyo Kenya, iyadoo sidoo kale ay goobjoog ahaayeen wakiillo ka socday Midowga Afrika (AU), urur-goboleedka IGAD iyo Qaramada Midoobay. War-murtiyeedka shirka ayaa lagu sheegay in Al-Shabaab ay weli tahay khatar amni oo halis ku ah Soomaaliya, isla markaana ay sii waddo beegsiga ciidamada iyo hay’adaha amniga ee dalka. Dalalka ka qeyb-galay shirka ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab lagu lammaaniyo xoojinta maamulka, dib-u-heshiisiin siyaasadeed, kobcinta dhaqaalaha iyo wax ka qabashada saboolnimada, si loo helo nabad waarta. Shirku wuxuu sidoo kale ku nuux-nuuxsaday muhiimadda kala-guurka amni ee qorsheysan, isaga oo ka digay in meelaha ciidamada laga saaro ama laga wareejiyo ay abuuri karaan firaaq amni oo ay ka faa’iideystaan kooxaha hubeysan. Sidoo kale, waxaa la isku raacay in mustaqbalka amniga Soomaaliya uu ku xiran yahay dhismaha ciidan Soomaaliyeed oo awood leh, kuwaas oo si buuxda ula wareegi kara mas’uuliyadda sugidda amniga dalka. War-murtiyeedka ayaa xasilloonida siyaasadeed ku tilmaamay tiirka ugu muhiimsan ee nabadda Soomaaliya, iyadoo lagu baaqay wada-hadal joogto ah iyo iskaashi dhow oo u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dowlad-goboleedyada. Ugu dambeyn, dalalka shirka ka qeyb-galay waxay xuseen in maalgelinta howl-galka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ay weli tahay mudnaan muhiim ah, iyagoo ugu baaqay beesha caalamka inay sii waddo taageerada dhaqaale si loo ilaaliyo guulaha amni ee la gaaray loogana hortago dib-u-dhac. items.title: Somalia clears final legal hurdle to join Africa’s free trade bloc
items.description: Somalia has completed the final legal step toward joining the African Continental Free Trade Area after President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud signed the agreement into law. The move opens the way for formal accession to the world's largest free trade area by participating countries, but economists say the country's biggest challenge remains expanding production and exports rather than gaining market access.

items.title: Mareykanka oo beeniyey arrimo la isla dhex-marayo kadib kulankii Soomaaliya
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – La-taliye sare oo ka tirsan maamulka madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa si adag u beeniyay wararka sheegaya in Mareykanku uu ka shaqeynayo dhismaha isbaheysi ka dhan ah Itoobiya oo ay ku mideysan yihiin qaar ka mid ah dalalka Geeska Afrika oo Soomaaliya ay ku jirto. Massad Boulos, oo ah la-taliyaha sare ee madaxweynaha Mareykanka ee arrimaha Carabta iyo Afrika, ayaa sheegay in warar “been abuur ah oo marin-habaabinaya” si khaldan loogu fasiray dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Washington ka waddo gobolka. “Warar been ah oo marin-habaabinaya ayaa diblomaasiyadda Mareykanka ee Geeska Afrika ku tilmaamay isku day lagu kasbanayo isbaheysi ka dhan ah Itoobiya,” ayuu Boulos ku yiri qoraal uu ku baahiyay barta X. “Aragtidaas waa mid aan sax ahayn, isla markaana si aan loo baahneyn u hurineysa xiisadaha gobolka,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Boulos ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in Mareykanku uu la shaqeeyo Itoobiya iyo dhammaan dalalka Geeska Afrika iyo kuwa ku teedsan Badda Cas, si loo hormariyo danaha wadajirka ah ee nabadda, amniga iyo horumarka. Hadalkiisa ayaa u muuqday jawaab toos ah oo ku socota warbixin ay daabacday majaladda The Africa Report, taas oo cinwaan looga dhigay in Massad Boulos uu taageero ka raadinayo isbaheysi ay Masar hoggaamineyso oo ka dhan ah Itoobiya. Warbixintaas ayaa ku doodday in Geeska Afrika uu u sii kala qeybsamayo laba garab, kuwaas oo kala ah Masar, Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea oo dhinac ah, halka dhinaca kale ay xiriir sii yeelanayaan Itoobiya, Somaliland iyo Israel. Kulamadii Qaahira Boulos ayaa 19-kii July magaalada Qaahira uga qeyb-galay wada-hadallo heer sare ah oo uu la yeeshay wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Masar Badr Abdelatty, wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali iyo dhiggiisa Eritrea Osman Saleh. Dowladda Masar ayaa sheegtay in wada-hadalladu ay qeyb ka ahaayeen dadaallada lagu taageerayo nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa yeeshay kulamo gaar-gaar ah iyo wada-tashiyo ballaaran, hase yeeshee war-saxaafadeedyadii la soo saaray laguma shaacin isbaheysi rasmi ah, heshiis milatari ama qorshe amni oo wadajir ah. Kadib kulankii uu la yeeshay wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya, Boulos ayaa sheegay inay ka wada-hadleen arrimo muhiim u ah amniga iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika, iskaashiga labada dal, xaaladda gobolka iyo wada-hadallada siyaasadeed ee gudaha Soomaaliya. Kulamadii uu la yeeshay wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Eritrea ayaa iyaguna diiradda lagu saaray ganacsiga, horumarinta dhaqaalaha gobolka iyo arrimaha amniga. Boulos ayaa sheegay in labada dhinac ay isku raaceen muhiimadda ay leedahay in si wax-ku-ool ah looga wada shaqeeyo xalinta colaadaha gobolka iyo horumarinta nabadda iyo barwaaqada Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika. Si kastaba, qaar ka mid ah hadalladii kasoo baxay kulamada Qaahira ayaa sii xoojiyay hadal-heynta la xiriirta Itoobiya. Masar iyo Eritrea ayaa sheegay in mas’uuliyadda amniga iyo maamulka Badda Cas ay si gaar ah u saaran tahay dalalka ku teedsan biyahaas. Labada dal ayaa sidoo kale diiday isku-day kasta oo ay dowlado aan xeeb ku lahayn Badda Cas ku raadinayaan door amni ama marin-badeed ka hor imaanaya sharciga caalamiga ah. Inkastoo aysan si toos ah Itoobiya u magacaabin, haddana hadalladaas ayaa loo fasiray inay ku wajahan yihiin ololaha Addis Ababa ay ku dooneyso marin-badeed joogto ah, maadaama Itoobiya ay tahay dal aan bad lahayn. Khilaafka marin-badeedka Arrinta marin-badeedka Itoobiya ayaa noqotay mid ka mid ah khilaafaadka ugu xasaasisan ee ka jira Geeska Afrika. Soomaaliya ayaa si caro leh uga jawaabtay heshiiskii is-afgarad ee Itoobiya ay bishii Janaayo 2024 la saxiixatay maamulka Somaliland, kaas oo Addis Ababa loogu oggolaan lahaa inay isticmaasho qeyb ka mid ah xeebaha Soomaaliya, isla markaana laga yaabo inay ka sameysato saldhig ciidan oo badeed. Somaliland ayaa sheegtay in heshiiskaas uu sidoo kale horseedi lahaa in Itoobiya ay aqoonsato madax-bannaanida ay sheegato, hase yeeshee dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa heshiiska ku tilmaantay sharci-darro iyo xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee dalka. Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ayaa markii dambe saxiixay Baaqa Ankara oo ay garwadeen ka ahayd dowladda Turkiga. Heshiiskaas ayaa labada dhinac ku ballanqaadeen inay ixtiraamayaan madax-bannaanida midba midka kale, isla markaana laga wada-hadlo sidii Itoobiya ay marin ganacsi uga heli lahayd badda iyadoo loo marayo awoodda iyo sharciga dowladda Soomaaliya. Baaqa Ankara ayaa dejiyay xiisaddii degdegga ahayd ee labada dal, balse ma uusan soo afjarin walaaca gobolka ee ku saabsan damaca Itoobiya ee marin-badeedka. Xiriirka sii xoogeysanaya ee Soomaaliya la leedahay Masar iyo Eritrea ayaa sidoo kale walaac ka abuuray Addis Ababa. Masar iyo Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer isku hayay Biyo-xireenka Weyn ee Itoobiya ka dhistay webiga Nile-ka Buluugga ah, halka xiriirka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea uu xumaaday kadib iskaashigii ku-meel-gaarka ahaa ee labada dal intii uu socday dagaalkii Tigray. Madaxweynayaasha Soomaaliya, Masar iyo Eritrea ayaa bishii October 2024 ku kulmay magaalada Asmara, iyagoo ku heshiiyay in la sameeyo guddi wadajir ah oo ay hoggaaminayaan wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda. War-murtiyeedkii kulankaas ayaa xoogga lagu saaray ilaalinta madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya, xoojinta hay’adaha amniga dalka iyo iskaashiga dowladaha ku teedsan Badda Cas. Diidmada Mareykanka Washington ayaa dhanka kale sii waday xiriirka ay la leedahay Itoobiya, xilli Boulos uu ballaarinayay wada-hadallada Mareykanka uu la leeyahay Qaahira, Muqdisho iyo Asmara. Sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan Wasaaradda Ganacsiga Mareykanka ayaa Arbacadii sheegay in Washington ay dooneyso in shirkadaha Mareykanka ay ka qeyb qaataan mashruuca garoonka diyaaradaha Bishoftu ee Ethiopian Airlines, kaas oo ku kacaya 12.5 bilyan oo dollar. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay inuu doonayo xiriir ganacsi oo dhow oo uu la yeesho qeybta teknoolajiyadda Itoobiya. Dhaqdhaqaaqyadaas ganacsi ayaa xoojinaya doodda Washington ee ah in xiriirka ay la leedahay Soomaaliya, Masar iyo Eritrea uusan ka dhigneyn cadaawad ama siyaasad ka dhan ah Itoobiya. Boulos ayaa ku adkeystay in diblomaasiyadda Mareykanka aysan ku dhisneyn sameynta garabyo iska soo horjeeda ama sii kala qeybinta dalalka gobolka. “Xiriirka lala yeesho hal saaxiib oo gobolka ah ma ahan in si khaldan loogu fasirto cadaawad loo qabo dal kale,” ayuu yiri. “Diblomaasiyadda Mareykanku ma ahan mid lagu abuurayo garabyo iska soo horjeeda ama lagu sii xoojinayo kala qeybsanaanta. Waxay ku saabsan tahay in si wax-ku-ool ah loola shaqeeyo dhammaan saaxiibada, si looga hortago colaadaha loona horumariyo nabad iyo amni waara.” The post Mareykanka oo beeniyey arrimo la isla dhex-marayo kadib kulankii Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: DF oo shaacisay go’aan la xiriira howl-galka AUSSOM
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cali Cumar Cali (Balcad) ayaa sheegay in howl-galka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) uusan deg-deg uga baxayn dalka, uuna sii socon doono illaa laba sano, xilli uu wajahayo caqabado la xiriira maalgelinta. Wasiiru-dowluhu ayaa sheegay in shirka ay ka qeyb-galayaan madaxda dalalka ciidamada ka jooga Soomaaliya, wasiirrada gaashaandhigga iyo taliyeyaasha ciidamada uu diiradda saari doono sidii xal loogu heli lahaa caqabadaha dhaqaale ee soo wajahay howl-galka AUSSOM, isla markaana loo sii wadi lahaa taageerada amniga Soomaaliya. Wuxuu sheegay in howl-galka AUSSOM uu ku tiirsan yahay laba tiir oo waaweyn oo kala ah gunnooyinka ciidamada iyo adeegyada saadka, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan gaadiidka, caafimaadka, qalabka iyo adeegyada kale ee muhiimka u ah howlgalka. Cali Balcad ayaa xusay in walaaca ugu weyn uu ka dhashay dib u eegista uu Mareykanku ku wado taageerada uu siiyo qaar ka mid ah howl-galada caalamiga ah, taas oo uu sheegay inay dhalisay in la qiimeeyo qaabab cusub oo lagu sii wadi karo maalgelinta howlgalka, ama loo diyaariyo qorshe kale oo lagu maareeyo haddii ay isbeddello dhacaan. “Waa muhiim in la fahmo in xitaa haddii ay yaraato ama ay hakato taageerada dhaqaale, ciidamada AUSSOM aysan Soomaaliya hal mar uga bixi karin. Ka bixitaankoodu wuxuu u baahan yahay qorshe kala-guur ah oo qaadan kara hal sano illaa sanad iyo bar, si si nidaamsan ay uga baxaan, ugana daad-gureystaan qalabkooda,” ayuu yiri wasiiru-dowluhu. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka ay shirka la tageyso qorshe cad oo lagu doonayo in muddo laba sano gudahood ah ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si buuxda ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. Qorshahaasi ayuu sheegay inuu qeyb ka yahay istaraatiijiyadda dowladda ee lagu dhisayo ciidan qaran oo isku filan. Wasiiru-dowlaha ayaa tilmaamay in ciidamada qalabka sida ee Soomaaliya ay hore ula wareegeen goobo badan oo ay maamuli jireen ciidamada Midowga Afrika, isla markaana qorshuhu yahay in si tartiib tartiib ah loogu wareejiyo goobaha harsan, iyadoo la ilaalinayo xasilloonida amniga. Isagoo ka hadlayay awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, Cali Balcad wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada qaranku ay maanta yihiin kuwa hoggaaminaya dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, halka ciidamada AUSSOM ay inta badan ku sugan yihiin saldhigyada waaweyn iyo goobaha istaraatiijiga ah ee ay ka geystaan taageero iyo sugidda amniga. Gunnooyinka ciidamada ayaa waxaa muddo dheer maalgelin jiray Midowga Yurub, halka adeegyada saadka iyo taageerada farsamada ay bixin jirtay Qaramada Midoobay iyadoo loo marayo Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya (UNSOS). Hadallada wasiiru-dowlaha ayaa imanaya xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan doodaha ku saabsan mustaqbalka howl-galka AUSSOM, kaddib caqabado dhaqaale oo soo wajahay howlgalka iyo dib u eegista ay qaar ka mid ah dalalka deeq-bixiyeyaasha ah ku wadaan taageeradooda. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa ku adkeysaneysa in hadafkeedu yahay in ciidamada qaranku si buuxda ula wareegaan amniga dalka, iyadoo AUSSOM uu door taageero ka sii qaadanayo inta lagu jiro marxaladda kala-guurka. The post DF oo shaacisay go’aan la xiriira howl-galka AUSSOM appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Cali Balcad ayaa xusay in walaaca ugu weyn uu ka dhashay dib u eegista uu Mareykanku ku wado taageerada uu siiyo qaar ka mid ah howl-galada caalamiga ah, taas oo uu sheegay inay dhalisay in la qiimeeyo qaabab cusub oo lagu sii wadi karo maalgelinta howlgalka, ama loo diyaariyo qorshe kale oo lagu maareeyo haddii ay isbeddello dhacaan. “Waa muhiim in la fahmo in xitaa haddii ay yaraato ama ay hakato taageerada dhaqaale, ciidamada AUSSOM aysan Soomaaliya hal mar uga bixi karin. Ka bixitaankoodu wuxuu u baahan yahay qorshe kala-guur ah oo qaadan kara hal sano illaa sanad iyo bar, si si nidaamsan ay uga baxaan, ugana daad-gureystaan qalabkooda,” ayuu yiri wasiiru-dowluhu. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka ay shirka la tageyso qorshe cad oo lagu doonayo in muddo laba sano gudahood ah ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si buuxda ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. Qorshahaasi ayuu sheegay inuu qeyb ka yahay istaraatiijiyadda dowladda ee lagu dhisayo ciidan qaran oo isku filan. Wasiiru-dowlaha ayaa tilmaamay in ciidamada qalabka sida ee Soomaaliya ay hore ula wareegeen goobo badan oo ay maamuli jireen ciidamada Midowga Afrika, isla markaana qorshuhu yahay in si tartiib tartiib ah loogu wareejiyo goobaha harsan, iyadoo la ilaalinayo xasilloonida amniga. Isagoo ka hadlayay awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, Cali Balcad wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada qaranku ay maanta yihiin kuwa hoggaaminaya dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, halka ciidamada AUSSOM ay inta badan ku sugan yihiin saldhigyada waaweyn iyo goobaha istaraatiijiga ah ee ay ka geystaan taageero iyo sugidda amniga. Gunnooyinka ciidamada ayaa waxaa muddo dheer maalgelin jiray Midowga Yurub, halka adeegyada saadka iyo taageerada farsamada ay bixin jirtay Qaramada Midoobay iyadoo loo marayo Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya (UNSOS). Hadallada wasiiru-dowlaha ayaa imanaya xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan doodaha ku saabsan mustaqbalka howl-galka AUSSOM, kaddib caqabado dhaqaale oo soo wajahay howlgalka iyo dib u eegista ay qaar ka mid ah dalalka deeq-bixiyeyaasha ah ku wadaan taageeradooda. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa ku adkeysaneysa in hadafkeedu yahay in ciidamada qaranku si buuxda ula wareegaan amniga dalka, iyadoo AUSSOM uu door taageero ka sii qaadanayo inta lagu jiro marxaladda kala-guurka. items.title: Fanaanka caanka ahaa ee Axmed Cali Cigaal ayaa geeriyooday
items.description: Fannaanka caanka ah ee Soomaaliyeed Axmed Cali Cigaal ayaa geeriyooday, isagoo ka tegay taariikh iyo dhaxal faneed qiimo badan oo si weyn uga dhex muuqda suugaanta iyo fanka Soomaaliyeed. Marxuumku waxa uu caan ku ahaa codkiisa macaan iyo heesihii uu bulshada ku reebay, kuwaas oo qalbiyada shacabka Soomaaliyeed ku lahaa xusuus gaar ah. Geeridiisa ayaa murugo weyn ku abuurtay bahda fanka, qoyskiisa, asxaabtiisa iyo dhammaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee jeclaa fankiisa. Dhanka kale Fanaan/Abwaan Sir Maxamuud Cumar oo la hadlay shabakada qarannews.com ayaa sheegay in uu marxuumku ahaa rukun adag oo ka baxay fanka Solmaaliyeed, waxana uu aad uu ugu dhèeraaday shaqsiyadii wanaagsanayd ee Axmed Cali Cigaal oo uu sheegay in uu ahaa fanaan qaali ahaa oo aan la heli karin noocisa. Waxa uu tacsi u diray ehelkii iyo qaraabadii marxuumka meel kasta oo ay jokgaan iyo dhamaan umadda ku hadasha afka Soomaaliga . Dhamaan maamulka iyo hawl wadeenada shabkada qarannews.com waxa ay tacdu u dirayaan qoyskii iyo qaraabadii uu ka baxay marxuumku

items.title: Maxaad ka ogtahay 14ka dal ee Sucuudigu rabo in uu bada cas ku khal khal galiyo
items.description: Turkiga,Sucuudiga,Masar iyo Djibouti ayaa doonaaya in ay khal khal galiyaan marin biyoodka Baabul mandab iyo bada cas, Afartan dal oo hore hanjabaado iyo colaad tusay nabada iyo horumarka ka jira Somaliland ayaa iska indho tiraaya xaqiiqda ka jirta bada Somaliland.. Hadaba dalaka Sucuudiga ayaa hada maal galinaaya sidii uu khal khal iyo dhib aan jirin uga abuuri lahaa bada isaga oo soo urursaday markaana maal galinaaya dalal aan wax xuduud ah la lahayn Bada Cas. Dalalka la aqoonsanyahay ee aan ku jirin isbahaysiga waxa kanmid ah Eritrea iyo Somaliland oo aan sinba looga maar maynin. Somaliland oo ciudamada badeedi ay aad u dhisanyihiin isla markaana haysta gantaalo iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn.iyo Maraakikb casri ah waxa ay awood u leeyihiin in ay bafokda ka difaacdaan dalalka ku soo duulaaya ee abuuraaya amni darada. Hadaba waa kuwee dalaka uu Sacuudigu uu ku.shiriyay dalkiisa in ay bada cas iyo Baabulmandab ay khal.khal galiyaan. Sacuudi Carabiya Somalia Turkey Masar Djibouti Baxrayn · Bangaladhesh · Urdun · Kuweyt · Nayjeeriya · Baakistaan · Qadar · Suudaan · Yemen

items.title: Kalluunka laga jillaabto webiga oo badbaado kumeel-gaar ah u ah beeralayda Baarsanguuni
items.description: (ERGO) – Shan boqol oo qoys oo ah beeraleyda tuulada Baar-sanguuni ayaa wajahaya xaalad cunno xumo tan iyo bishii Juun ee sanadkan, markii dalag u saarnaa beerahooda ay ka qaadday fatahaadda webiga Jubba. Waxay si lama filaan ah u la kulmeen biyaha webiga iyaga oo ku foogan guridda dalagga. Faysal Daahir Muuse oo leh beer 5 hiktar ah ayaa ka mid ah. Qoyskiisa oo 12 ah ayaa la dhibaatoonaya cunno yari. Wuxuu ku qasbanaaday in webiga uu ka jillaabto kalluun qabashadiisa uusan xirfad u lahayn. 48 saacba mar ayuu sheegay in uu helo hal xabbo oo qoyskiisa uu dabka u saaro, marar qaarna uu ku hungoobo. Wuxuu xusay in uusan haysan qalab uu ku soo dabto, caqabado badana uu ku qabo qabashadiisa. Wuxuu rajo xumo ka muujiyay hubanti la’aanta cunno ee haysa qoyskiisa oo aan haysan il-dhaqaale. “Malayga markaad soo wayso Lulubo ayaad raadinaysaa. Labadaas middaad soo hesho ilmahaa lagu maareeyaa. Wax kale oo loo helayo malahan. Hal waqti weeye meel kale oo aad u dhaafayso ma jirto.” “Haddii la waayo ilmaha Caleen baa loo karinaa. Caleentaas bay cabayaan. Shaax xitaa maahan. Caleenta oo qaraar ah ayaa la siiyaa.” Wuxuu tilmaamay in uusan ku sii tiirsanaan karin kalluunka uu ka jillaabto webiga, kaas oo la wayn karo haddii heerka biyaha webiga uu hoos u dhaco, maaddama uusan haysan agab uu ku galo webiga. Qoysaska ku nool deegaankiisa oo beeraley ah ayuu xusay in ay isku duruuf yihiin haddii ay is caawin lahaayeen, taas oo xaaladda ku sii adkaysay qoyskiisa iyo kuwa la midka ah oo kaalmo kale aan haysan. In ka badan 300 oo geed oo moos ah ayay biyuhu ka jareen, halka ay qaadeen dalag u badnaa galley, digir, sisin iyo noocyo kala duwan oo khudaar ah, kuwaas oo bishii Abriil ee sanadkan oo uu dayn ku helay abuurkooda. Wuxuu qorshaynayay in uu iskaga gudo $2,000 oo qayb ka ahayd lacagtii uu galiyay beertiisa, taas oo uu ku bixiyay falidda, abuurka iyo shaqaalaha beerta oo 3 ah, kuwaas oo shaqo la’aan noqday. Hase ahaate, beddekeed wuxuu la kulmay qasaare uu ka soo kaban la’yahay. Biyaha galay beertiisa waxaa fududeeyay kanaallo fatahaad horay u dhacday ay furtay, kuwaas dhulka la simay beertiisa. “Fatahaadda aad ayey noo halaagtay. Faraha qaar fataahaddii hore ee waynayd (2023) ayaa toddobbo far jaray. Toddobada far waxaa ugu daran 4 far oo biyo yar haddii ay yimaadaan beeraha ayay shab soo siinayaan. Farahaas awood aan iskaga xirno mahayno.” Fatahaadaha ku soo laalaabta deegaankiisa ayuu sheegay in nolosha qoyskiisa ay cuuryaamiyeen. Dabayaaqadii sanadkii 2023 waxay ka dumiyeen guri ka koobnaa 4 qol oo hoy u ahaa. Wuxuu awood u waayay dib u dhiska guriga, waxaana dhulkii uu ku yaallay uu ka dhistay aqal cooshad ah oo gabaad u noqda, balse fatahaaddii u danbeysay ayaa dumisay, inkasta oo uu dib u yagleelay. Beeraleyda Baar-sanguuni waxay cabayanaan kanaallo waawayn oo beerahooda ku xira webiga. Waxay nugulyihiin beerahooda fatahaadda oo dhacda xilli kasta oo webigu uu biyo keeno. Kanaallada waxaa la sameeyay xilligii dowladdii dhexe ee dalka, balse dayac ku yimid burburkii dalka kadib, waxay isku beddeleen halka saldhigga u ah qasaaraha gaara beeraha tuulada Baar-sanguuni. Timiro Cabdullaahi Maxamed oo 70 jir ah waa waayo arag u soo joogtay isbeddeladii ku yimid kanaalladan, kuwaas oo beeraleydii hore ay ku tiirsanaayeen waraabkooda. Waxay Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay in hadda ay noqdeen musiibo sida joogta ah u burburisa beeraha iyo guryaha, taas oo awood dowladeed oo xakamaysa aysan jirin. Nolosheeda oo dhan waxay ku qaadatay beero falashada. Hadda se waxay quus ka joogtaa ku tiirsanaanta beerta. Waxay xustay in sanad walba mar ama labo uu ku fataho webiga Jubba. Arrinta waxay ku qasabtay in ay hoos u dhigto dhaqaalihii badnaa ee ay galin jirtay beerta si ay uga fogaato qasaare wayn oo soo gaaray. Fathaaddii u danbeeyay waxay saamaysay bishii hore. “Beerta $150 ayaa iga gashay. Waxii kale walaal ayaan tuugay. Waa la iigu kaalmeeyay. Waxaa la igu caawiyey xoog. Dhalinyaro ayaan tuugtuugay way ii imaadeen. Beerta qashin bay lahayd. Way iga qaadeen.” “Waxna lacagtii aan gashaday bay ahayd, waxna iyaga (dhallinyarada) igu kaalmeeyay. Hadda waxba gacan kuma hayo. Dalaggii wuu iga go’ay. Waan iska fadhiyaa.” Beerteeda oo 2 hiktar ah waxaa ku beernaa dalag iskugu jira raashin iyo khudaar, kuwaas oo u badnaa kuwa ku baxa dhowrka bil, sida qaraha, digirta, galleyda, basbaaska, banbanooniga iyo qaar kale. Dalagga ka qaasaray wuxuu ka hor istaagay raashin dayn ah oo ay dukaamada uga qaadi jirtay qoyskeeda oo shan qof ah, maaddama dalaggii ay ku tashanaysay si ay daynta u gudo uu qasaray. Waxay dantu bidday in ay ka jillaabato webiga, halkaas oo ay kala soo baxdo kalluun aan joogto ahayn. Waxay xustay ay fariisto webiga jiinkiisa iyadoo sugta kalluunka u soo baxay qararka webiga. “Maalintii oo dhan ayaan biyaha ku jirnaa annaga oo raadinaynayna malaay ama Dhoomaal. Hadii aad hesho nasiibkaa haddii aad waydo nasiibkaa. Waxii aan soo helno Dhoomaalkii xoogaa ayaa laga cunaa, waxana waa la reebanaa.” Fatahaadda waxay sidoo kale ku waysay guri saddex qol ka koobnaa oo ku agyaallay beerteeda. Qoyskeeda waxaa hoy u ah geedaha hoostooda inkastoo dhibaato ay ku hayso biyo baxada. Guddoomiyaha deegaanka Baar-sanguuni Maslax Cali Saalax ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in fatahaadda joogtada noqotay ay niyad jabisay beeraleyda ku tiirsanaa dalagga ay tacbadaan. Wuxuu tilmaamay in wax ka qabashada kanaallada biyaha ku sii daayay beeraha ay awooddooda ka wayn tahay, isla markaana Jubbaland ay la wadaageen howlaha hortabinta leh ee lagu xiro karo. Wuxuu intaas ku daray wajiga koobaad ee xiridda kanaallada ay ku qiimeeyeen lacagta ku bixi karta $3500 iyo qalab gaar ah oo loo adeegsado duugista faraha biyaha soo daaya xilliga roobka. Wuxuu xusay in beeraleyda qaar ay ka tageen beerahooda si ay u samaystaan ilo kale oo dhaqaale, maaddama ay ka soo kaban waayeen fatahaadda joogtada ah. “Qoysas badan waxaa ay go’aansadeen in ay ka tagaan beerahooda oo ay galaan magaalooyinka waawayn oo ay meelaha ka xamaashan, maaddama fatahada soo noq noqday la maarayn waayey oo beeraha tacabka ay galiyaanba ay ka baabi’inaysa. Waxay goosteen in magaalooyinka galaan iska xamaashan oo gaadhi gacankooda iska qaatan.” Beeraley badan ayaa aaminsan in haddii ay helaan gacan ka taageerta xiridda kanaallada ay soo maraan biyaha ku fataha in ay ka soo kaban karaan caqabadaha dib u dhigay, kuwaas oo u nugleeyay duruufta. The post Kalluunka laga jillaabto webiga oo badbaado kumeel-gaar ah u ah beeralayda Baarsanguuni appeared first on Radio Ergo - Somali Humanitarian News and Information .

Waxay xustay ay fariisto webiga jiinkiisa iyadoo sugta kalluunka u soo baxay qararka webiga. “Maalintii oo dhan ayaan biyaha ku jirnaa annaga oo raadinaynayna malaay ama Dhoomaal. Hadii aad hesho nasiibkaa haddii aad waydo nasiibkaa. Waxii aan soo helno Dhoomaalkii xoogaa ayaa laga cunaa, waxana waa la reebanaa.” Fatahaadda waxay sidoo kale ku waysay guri saddex qol ka koobnaa oo ku agyaallay beerteeda. Qoyskeeda waxaa hoy u ah geedaha hoostooda inkastoo dhibaato ay ku hayso biyo baxada. Guddoomiyaha deegaanka Baar-sanguuni Maslax Cali Saalax ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in fatahaadda joogtada noqotay ay niyad jabisay beeraleyda ku tiirsanaa dalagga ay tacbadaan. Wuxuu tilmaamay in wax ka qabashada kanaallada biyaha ku sii daayay beeraha ay awooddooda ka wayn tahay, isla markaana Jubbaland ay la wadaageen howlaha hortabinta leh ee lagu xiro karo. Wuxuu intaas ku daray wajiga koobaad ee xiridda kanaallada ay ku qiimeeyeen lacagta ku bixi karta $3500 iyo qalab gaar ah oo loo adeegsado duugista faraha biyaha soo daaya xilliga roobka. Wuxuu xusay in beeraleyda qaar ay ka tageen beerahooda si ay u samaystaan ilo kale oo dhaqaale, maaddama ay ka soo kaban waayeen fatahaadda joogtada ah. “Qoysas badan waxaa ay go’aansadeen in ay ka tagaan beerahooda oo ay galaan magaalooyinka waawayn oo ay meelaha ka xamaashan, maaddama fatahada soo noq noqday la maarayn waayey oo beeraha tacabka ay galiyaanba ay ka baabi’inaysa. Waxay goosteen in magaalooyinka galaan iska xamaashan oo gaadhi gacankooda iska qaatan.” Beeraley badan ayaa aaminsan in haddii ay helaan gacan ka taageerta xiridda kanaallada ay soo maraan biyaha ku fataha in ay ka soo kaban karaan caqabadaha dib u dhigay, kuwaas oo u nugleeyay duruufta. items.title: Xamaas oo ogolaatay Hub ka dhigis Iyo in ciidamada Israel ay ka baxaan Marinka Gaza
items.description: Xalay, Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la gaadhay heshiis dhigaya in gebi ahaanba hubka laga dhigo Xamaas iyo dhammaan kooxaha kale ee hubeysan ee Gaza, isla markaana ciidamada Israa’iil ay ka baxaan Marinka Gaza. Waxa ilaa hadda la og yahay: Trump ayaa sheegay in heshiiskan uu gaaray Golahiisa Nabadda, wuxuuna ku tilmaamay “tallaabo muhiim ah oo Gaza ugu dambayn loogu horseedayo inay maamusho dowlad cusub oo Falastiiniyiin ah.” Qorshe afar bog ka kooban oo ay BBC-du heshay ayaa faahfaahinaya in hub ka dhigista Xamaas loo fulin doono si marxalad-marxalad ah, isla markaana ciidamada Israa’iil ay iyaguna si tartiib tartiib ah uga bixi doonaan Gaza. Saraakiisha Maraykanka ayaa sheegay in tallaabo kasta oo qorshaha ka mid ah la xaqiijin doono lana hubin doono ka hor inta aan loo gudbin tallaabada xigta. Sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan Xamaas ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in ururku oggolaaday qorshaha, hase yeeshee weli Xamaas kama aysan soo saarin war rasmi ah. Sarkaal Maraykan ah ayaa sheegay in Madaxweyne Trump uu si weyn uga niyad jabi doono haddii Israa’iil ay diido inay ciidamadeeda kala baxdo Gaza. Waxa weli aan la ogeyn: Mowqifka rasmiga ah ee Israa’iil ee heshiiskan, iyo inay qayb ka ahayd wada-hadalladii lagu gaaray, ma cadda, maadaama aan wax hadal ah laga maqal mas’uuliyiinta Israa’iil tan iyo ku dhawaaqistii Trump. Sida ay u dhici doonto ka bixitaanka ciidamada Israa’iil, iyo in bixitaanku uu ku jiri doono aagga kala xadaynta ee loo yaqaan “Khadka Jaallaha” (Yellow Line). Cidda ugu dambayn gacanta ku hayn doonta hubka ay Xamaas wareejin doonto marka heshiiska la fuliyo. Sida uu si dhab ah u shaqayn doono habka xaqiijinta iyo kormeerka ee Maraykanku soo jeediyay.

items.title: Maxkamadda Rafcaanka Mareykanka oo Diidday Siyaasaddii Trump ee Xarigga Qasabka ah ee Muhaajiriinta
items.description: Maxkamadda Rafcaanka Federaalka ee Wareegga 9-aad ee Mareykanka ayaa go’aan ku gaartay in maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uusan si toos ah ugu diidi karin muhaajiriinta lagu hayo gudaha dalka inay codsadaan dammaanad  si ay si ku-meel-gaar ah xorriyaddooda ugu helaan inta dacwadahooda socdaalka ay socdaan. Go’aanka maxkamadda, oo lagu ansixiyay cod 2–1, ayaa lagu sheegay in sharciga socdaalka uusan si cad u oggolaanayn in dhammaan muhaajiriinta lagu hayo gudaha Mareykanka lagu xiro xabsi qasab ah iyagoo aan helin fursad ay maxkamad uga codsadaan sii-deyn dammaanad ah. Maamulka Trump ayaa difaacay siyaasaddan, isagoo ku dooday in wax-ka-beddel lagu sameeyay sharciga socdaalka sanadkii 1996 uu dowladda siinayo awood ay ku hirgeliso xarig qasab ah oo lagu dabaqo muhaajiriinta gudaha dalka, kana baxsan kuwa lagu qabto xuduudaha. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, inta badan garsoorayaasha maxkamaddu waxay sheegeen in fasiraadda taariikhiga ah ee sharcigu aysan taageerayn aragtida maamulka. Dhanka kale, Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha ee Mareykanka (DHS) ayaa muujisay inay si adag uga soo horjeeddo go’aanka maxkamadda, iyadoo ku adkaysatay in siyaasaddeedu waafaqsan tahay sharciga isla markaana ay muhiim u tahay ilaalinta amniga dalka. Afar maxkamadood oo kale ayaa hore u diiday siyaasadda xarigga qasabka ah, halka laba maxkamadood ay taageereen maamulka Trump. Arrintan ayaa sare u qaadday suurtagalnimada in Maxkamadda Sare ee Mareykanka ay go’aan kama dambeys ah ka gaarto murankan sharci. Siyaasadda xarigga qasabka ah ayaa qayb ka ahayd ololaha ballaaran ee maamulka Trump ee lagu xoojinayo masaafurinta muhaajiriinta. Waxay sidoo kale dhalisay dacwado badan oo ay gudbiyeen muhaajiriinta lagu hayo xarumaha socdaalka, kuwaas oo dalbanaya in loo oggolaado dhegeysiga codsiyadooda dammaanadda.

items.title: Sacuudiga, Soomaaliya iyo 12 dal oo ku dhowaaqay isbaheysi militari oo cusub
items.description: Riyaad (Caasimada Online) – Sacuudi Carabiya, Soomaaliya iyo 12 dal oo kale ayaa ku dhawaaqay dhismaha isbaheysi militari oo dhinaca badda ah, kaas oo lagu ilaalinayo xorriyadda isu-socodka maraakiibta ee marinnada Bab al-Mandab, Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Wasaaradda Difaaca Sacuudiga ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay Khamiistii ku sheegtay in Isbaheysiga Difaaca Badaha ee Dalalka Badan loo aasaasay qaab lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga wadajirka ah ee difaaca badda. Dalalka xubnaha ka ah isbaheysiga ayaa sheegay inay doonayaan inay ilaaliyaan xorriyadda isu-socodka maraakiibta, ammaanka waddooyinka ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo marinada loo adeegsado dhoofinta tamarta. Bab al-Mandab, Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ayaa sameeya marin istaraatiiji ah oo isku xira Badweynta Hindiya iyo Badda Mediterranean-ka. Dhismaha isbaheysigan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dagaalka u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran uu xooggiisu ku ururay marinka Hormuz, kaas oo xiritaankiisa ku dhowaad dhammeystiran uu culeys weyn ku keenay dhaqaalaha caalamka. Marinka Hormuz ayaa horey u qaadi jiray ku dhowaad 20 boqolkiiba dhoofinta saliidda iyo gaaska dunida. Dhanka kale, marinka isku xira Bab al-Mandab, Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ayaa wajahaya weerarro isdaba joog ah oo ay fulinayaan dagaalyahannada Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee ay Iran taageerto. ‘Mas’uuliyad wadajir ah’ Wakiillo ka socday 43 dal oo ka mid ah 51 dal oo lagu casuumay ayaa ka qeyb galay kulankii lagu aas-aasay isbaheysiga. Wasaaradda Difaaca Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in wafdi ka socday Midowga Yurub uu sidoo kale kulanka ka qeyb galay. Midowga Yurub ayaa horey Badda Cas uga fulinayay howlgal lagu ilaalinayo maraakiibta oo lagu magacaabo Aspides, inkasta oo aysan caddayn sida isbaheysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaaminayo uga duwanaan doono howlgalkaas. Dalalka kale ee la sheegay inay saxiixeen heshiiska isbaheysiga ayaa kala ah Turkiga, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Jordan, Masar, Pakistan, Jabuuti, Soomaaliya, Bangladesh, Yemen, Sudan iyo Comoros. Waxaa si gaar ah loo xusay in Imaaraadka Carabta iyo Cumaan aysan ku biirin isbaheysiga, inkasta oo ay leeyihiin dano amni oo la mid ah kuwa dalalka xubnaha ka noqday, gaar ahaan marka la eego colaadda ku saleysan Iran. “Albaabka wuxuu u furan yahay dalalka kale ee doonaya inay ku biiraan axdiga isbaheysiga, marka ay dhammaystiraan habraacyadooda qaran,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka Wasaaradda Difaaca Sacuudiga. Dalalka ka qeybgalaya ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay wadaagaan “aaminaadda ah in ammaanka baduhu yahay mas’uuliyad wadajir ah, isla markaana iskaashiga iyo isku-duwidda dalalku ay yihiin tiirka ugu muhiimsan ee lagu wajahayo khataraha badda ee wadajirka ah iyo kuwa ka gudba xuduudaha.” Bayaanka laguma sheegin maraakiibta ama diyaaradaha uu dal kasta ku biirin doono howlaha isbaheysiga. Hase yeeshee, howlaha la qorsheeyay ayaa waxaa ka mid noqon doona wadaagista sirdoonka iyo macluumaadka, qorsheynta howlgallada, qabashada dhoolatusyo wadajir ah iyo fulinta howlgallo dhinaca badda ah. Isbaheysiga ayaa lagu tilmaamay mid “difaac oo keliya ah, oo aan lagu bartilmaameedsanayn dowlad gaar ah.” Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa loo aqoonsaday xubin aas-aase ah, waxaana dalkaas laga dhigi doonaa xarunta dhexe ee isbaheysiga, inkasta oo aan bayaanka lagu caddeyn halka saxda ah ee xaruntu ku taallaan doonto. Muhiimadda Bab al-Mandab Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa toddobaadkii hore ku soo rogtay Sacuudi Carabiya xannibaad dhinaca badda ah, taas oo carqaladeysay shixnadihii saliidda ee loo wareejiyay dhinaca Badda Cas. Tan iyo markii uu dagaalka Iran billowday dabayaaqadii bishii Febraayo, isla markaana uu si dhab ah u xirmay marinka Hormuz, Sacuudi Carabiya waxay awoodday inay sii waddo dhoofinta inta badan saliiddeeda. Arrintan ayaa waxaa u suurageliyay dhuunta shidaalka ee Bariga iyo Galbeedka, taas oo warshadaha sifeynta saliidda ee bariga Sacuudiga ku xirta dekedda Yanbu ee xeebta Badda Cas. Saliidda Sacuudiga ee halkaas laga dhoofiyo waa inay martaa Bab al-Mandab, oo ku yaalla inta u dhexeysa Eritrea, Jabuuti iyo Yemen. Gobolka galbeed ee Yemen ee ku wajahan marinka muhiimka ah ayaa waxaa gacanta ku haya Xuutiyiinta, taas oo kooxda siinaysa awood istaraatiiji ah oo ay ku bartilmaameedsan karto maraakiibta ku socda Badda Cas. Qiyaastii 10 ilaa 12 boqolkiiba ganacsiga badda ee caalamka ayaa mara Bab al-Mandab, waxaana ka mid ah malaayiin fuusto oo saliid ah maalintii. Marinkani sidoo kale waa mid ka mid ah labada marin ee laga galo ama looga baxo Badda Cas, halka kan kale uu yahay Kanaalka Suweys. Bab al-Mandab ayaa meesha ugu ciriirisan ballaciisu yahay 29 kiiloomitir, taas oo isu-socodka maraakiibta ku koobeysa laba marin oo ay kala isticmaalaan maraakiibta soo galeysa iyo kuwa ka baxaya. Sidaas darteed, carqalad kasta oo ka dhacda aaggaas waxay sababi kartaa sare-u-kac cusub oo ku yimaada qiimaha tamarta caalamka. Waxaa si gaar ah loo xusay in Imaaraadka Carabta iyo Cumaan aysan ku biirin isbaheysiga, inkasta oo ay leeyihiin dano amni oo la mid ah kuwa dalalka xubnaha ka noqday, gaar ahaan marka la eego colaadda ku saleysan Iran. “Albaabka wuxuu u furan yahay dalalka kale ee doonaya inay ku biiraan axdiga isbaheysiga, marka ay dhammaystiraan habraacyadooda qaran,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka Wasaaradda Difaaca Sacuudiga. Dalalka ka qeybgalaya ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay wadaagaan “aaminaadda ah in ammaanka baduhu yahay mas’uuliyad wadajir ah, isla markaana iskaashiga iyo isku-duwidda dalalku ay yihiin tiirka ugu muhiimsan ee lagu wajahayo khataraha badda ee wadajirka ah iyo kuwa ka gudba xuduudaha.” Bayaanka laguma sheegin maraakiibta ama diyaaradaha uu dal kasta ku biirin doono howlaha isbaheysiga. Hase yeeshee, howlaha la qorsheeyay ayaa waxaa ka mid noqon doona wadaagista sirdoonka iyo macluumaadka, qorsheynta howlgallada, qabashada dhoolatusyo wadajir ah iyo fulinta howlgallo dhinaca badda ah. Isbaheysiga ayaa lagu tilmaamay mid “difaac oo keliya ah, oo aan lagu bartilmaameedsanayn dowlad gaar ah.” Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa loo aqoonsaday xubin aas-aase ah, waxaana dalkaas laga dhigi doonaa xarunta dhexe ee isbaheysiga, inkasta oo aan bayaanka lagu caddeyn halka saxda ah ee xaruntu ku taallaan doonto. Muhiimadda Bab al-Mandab Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa toddobaadkii hore ku soo rogtay Sacuudi Carabiya xannibaad dhinaca badda ah, taas oo carqaladeysay shixnadihii saliidda ee loo wareejiyay dhinaca Badda Cas. Tan iyo markii uu dagaalka Iran billowday dabayaaqadii bishii Febraayo, isla markaana uu si dhab ah u xirmay marinka Hormuz, Sacuudi Carabiya waxay awoodday inay sii waddo dhoofinta inta badan saliiddeeda. Arrintan ayaa waxaa u suurageliyay dhuunta shidaalka ee Bariga iyo Galbeedka, taas oo warshadaha sifeynta saliidda ee bariga Sacuudiga ku xirta dekedda Yanbu ee xeebta Badda Cas. Saliidda Sacuudiga ee halkaas laga dhoofiyo waa inay martaa Bab al-Mandab, oo ku yaalla inta u dhexeysa Eritrea, Jabuuti iyo Yemen. Gobolka galbeed ee Yemen ee ku wajahan marinka muhiimka ah ayaa waxaa gacanta ku haya Xuutiyiinta, taas oo kooxda siinaysa awood istaraatiiji ah oo ay ku bartilmaameedsan karto maraakiibta ku socda Badda Cas. Qiyaastii 10 ilaa 12 boqolkiiba ganacsiga badda ee caalamka ayaa mara Bab al-Mandab, waxaana ka mid ah malaayiin fuusto oo saliid ah maalintii. Marinkani sidoo kale waa mid ka mid ah labada marin ee laga galo ama looga baxo Badda Cas, halka kan kale uu yahay Kanaalka Suweys. Bab al-Mandab ayaa meesha ugu ciriirisan ballaciisu yahay 29 kiiloomitir, taas oo isu-socodka maraakiibta ku koobeysa laba marin oo ay kala isticmaalaan maraakiibta soo galeysa iyo kuwa ka baxaya. Sidaas darteed, carqalad kasta oo ka dhacda aaggaas waxay sababi kartaa sare-u-kac cusub oo ku yimaada qiimaha tamarta caalamka. items.title: Dalalka Yurub oo qaadacay koobka adduunka kadib tallaabadii uu qaaday Infantino
items.description: Nyon (Caasimada Online) – Xiriirka kubadda cagta Yurub ee UEFA ayaa Khamiistii ku dhawaaqay in xulalka qaaradda aysan ka qeyb geli doonin tartamada FIFA, oo uu ku jiro Koobka Adduunka, haddii hay’adda kubadda cagta adduunku ay sii waddo qorshaheeda ah in maalgashadayaal gaar loo leeyahay saamiyo laga siiyo shirkad maamuli doonta tartamadeeda ugu waaweyn. “Ma jiro xul qaran oo UEFA ka tirsan oo ka qeyb geli doona tartan ay FIFA maamusho inta ay soo jeedimahan weli jiraan,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan kasoo baxay UEFA. UEFA ayaa sheegtay in qaadacaadda laga baaqsan karo oo keliya haddii FIFA ay gebi ahaanba ka noqoto qorshaha, isla markaana ay bixiso dammaanad sharci ah oo caddeyneysa in aysan mar dambe maamulka ama tartamada kubadda cagta u furi doonin lahaanshaha maalgashadayaasha gaarka ah. “Koobka Adduunka looma arki karo badeecad maalgashi,” ayay UEFA tiri. “Qeyb ka mid ah marna looma gacan gelin karo maalgashadayaal gaar loo leeyahay. Koobka Adduunka iib ma aha.” FIFA ayaa Talaadadii shaacisay qorshe lagu dhisayo shirkad ganacsi oo gaar ah, taas oo maamuli doonta dhacdooyinka ugu waaweyn ee hay’adda, oo ay ka mid yihiin Koobka Adduunka iyo Koobka Adduunka ee Naadiyada. Sida uu qorshuhu dhigayo, maalgashadayaal gaar loo leeyahay ayaa loo oggolaan doonaa inay saamiyo ka iibsadaan shirkadda, inkasta oo FIFA ay sheegtay inay ahaan doonaan saamiley tiro yar. FIFA ayaa rajeyneysa inay qorshaha FIFA Forward Enterprise, oo loo soo gaabiyo FFE, ku hesho lacag gaareysa 4.2 bilyan oo dollar, iyadoo qiimaha guud ee shirkadda lagu qiyaasayo 20 bilyan oo dollar. Haddii la ansixiyo, mid kasta oo ka mid ah 211-ka xiriir ee xubnaha ka ah FIFA ayaa horraanta 2027 heli kara lacag hal mar ah oo dhan 20 milyan oo dollar. Waxaa sidoo kale qorshaha ku jira in dhaqaalaha loo qoondeeyo xiriir kasta muddada 2027 illaa 2030 laga kordhiyo siddeed milyan oo dollar, lagana dhigo 20 milyan oo dollar. Madaxweynaha FIFA Gianni Infantino ayaa Arbacadii qorshaha ku tilmaamay “fursad dahabi ah oo si xooggan loogu dardargelinayo horumarinta kubadda cagta adduunka.” Hase yeeshee, UEFA ayaa si adag uga hortimid qorshaha, iyadoo sheegtay inuusan qaabkan boos ku lahayn kubadda cagta caalamka. “Mustaqbalka kubadda cagta laguma go’aamin karo filashada kuwa waajibkooda koowaad uu yahay inay sare u qaadaan faa’iidada dhaqaale,” ayuu yiri madaxweynaha UEFA Aleksander Ceferin. “Danaha xiriirrada qaranka, horyaallada, naadiyada, ciyaartoyda iyo taageerayaasha looma hoos-geyn karo faa’iidada maalgashadayaasha. Kubadda cagtu ma deynsan karto mustaqbalkeeda si ay dhaqaale u hesho.” Ceferin ayaa sheegay in mowqifka Yurub uu yahay mid cad, isla markaana aysan sharciyad siin doonin qaabkan. “Qofna ma laha awoodda anshaxeed ee uu ku iibiyo wax uu kaliya wakiil uga yahay jiilka soo socda,” ayuu yiri. Mucaaradad kordheysa Qorshaha FIFA ayaa sidoo kale dhaleeceyn kala kulmay xiriirro waaweyn oo Yurub ah iyo mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Midowga Yurub, kuwaas oo u arka tallaabada mid sii xoojinaysa ganacsiyeynta ciyaaraha. Waxaa sidoo kale la muujiyay walaac la xiriira isku dhacyada danaha ee ka dhalan kara marka maalgashadayaal gaar loo leeyahay ay saamiyo ku yeeshaan shirkad maamuleysa tartamada FIFA. Midowga Yurub ayaa Khamiistii UEFA ku ammaanay “difaacidda hufnaanta ciyaarta.” “Waxaan soo dhoweynayaa bayaanka UEFA, waxaana si buuxda u taageerayaa mowqifkeeda,” ayuu baraha bulshada ku qoray guddoomiyaha Midowga Yurub ee ciyaaraha Glenn Micallef. “Waxaan ku faraxsanahay inaan arko xiriirrada kubadda cagta Yurub oo hoggaaminaya maamulka wanaagsan, isla markaana ku adkeysanaya mabaadi’dooda,” ayuu raaciyay. Dhammaan 41-ka xubnood ee xiriirka kubadda cagta Waqooyiga iyo Bartamaha Ameerika ee CONCACAF, oo ay ku jiraan Mareykanka, Mexico iyo Canada, ayaa Khamiistii si wadajir ah u diiday qorshaha. CONCACAF ayaa sheegtay in xubnaheedu muujiyeen walaac xooggan oo ku saabsan habraac la’aanta qorshaha, waqtiga kooban ee sida degdegga ah loogu qabtay go’aan gaarista iyo inaanu jirin dib-u-eegis ama oggolaansho kasoo baxay hay’adaha maamulka FIFA. Xiriirka kubadda cagta Aasiya ee AFC ayaa isna walaac ka muujiyay in qorshaha la shaaciyay ka hor inta aan si buuxda loola tashan dhammaan 211-ka xiriir ee FIFA. Xiriirka kubadda cagta Afrika ee CAF ayaa xubnihiisa ugu baaqay inay dib-u-eegis ku sameeyaan qorshaha muranka dhaliyay. ‘Marna iib ma aha’ UEFA ayaa bayaankeeda ku sheegtay in Koobka Adduunku yahay mid ka mid ah dhaxallada ugu waaweyn ee ciyaaraha, kaas oo ay jiilal badan dhiseen ciyaartoy, xulal qaran iyo taageerayaal ku kala nool dhammaan qaaradaha. “Waa mas’uuliyad-darro aan la difaaci karin in qorshe muhiimad sidan u weyn u leh kubadda cagta si qarsoodi ah loo diyaariyo, kadibna qarka loo saaro ansixin iyadoo aan jirin wax wada-tashi macno leh oo lala yeeshay kuwa loo igmaday ilaalinta ciyaarta,” ayay UEFA tiri. Waxay ku tilmaantay arrintaas fashil hoggaamineed oo qoto dheer iyo ka tanaasulidda waajibaadkii FIFA ee ahaa inay ilaaliso kubadda cagta adduunka. “Xiriirrada qaranka ee dunida waxaa hadda la hor dhigayaa laba doorasho oo khasab ah — inay aqbalaan in tartamada ugu waaweyn kubadda cagta si aan laga noqon karin gacanta loogu geliyo maalgashadayaal ama ay qaataan cawaaqibka,” ayay UEFA tiri. UEFA ayaa sheegtay in arrintani aysan ahayn go’aan dimuqraadi ah, balse ay tahay maamul ku dhisan cabsi-gelin iyo cadaadis aan ku habbooneyn hay’ad loo igmaday ilaalinta ciyaarta caalamka. “Waxaa jira waqtiyo hay’adaha aan lagu qiimeyn waxa ay diyaar u yihiin inay aqbalaan, balse lagu qiimeeyo waxa ay diidaan inay ka tanaasulaan,” ayay UEFA tiri. “Waxyaabaha qaar waa kuwo aad muhiim u ah oo aan la iibin karin. Koobka Adduunka ee FIFA waxaa iska leh kubadda cagta. Sidaas ayuu weligiis ahaan doonaa. Inta Yurub cod leedahayna, marna iib ma noqon doono.” The post Dalalka Yurub oo qaadacay koobka adduunka kadib tallaabadii uu qaaday Infantino appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo Sacuudiga weerar uga soo billaabay Ciraaq
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa qaar ka mid ah weerarradii ugu dambeeyey ee lagu qaaday Sacuudi Carabiya kasoo fulisay gudaha Ciraaq, iyada oo gacan ka heleysa kooxo hubeysan oo Ciraaqi ah oo xiriir la leh Iran, sida ay sheegeen saraakiil gobolka ka tirsan. Qiimeyn ay sameeyeen Sacuudi Carabiya iyo qaar ka mid ah dalalka ay saaxiibada yihiin ayaa muujineysa in weerarrada loo fuliyey si wadajir ah, isla markaana ay kormeerayeen xubno ka tirsan Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran ee IRGC. Xogtan ayaa ka duwan warbixinnada rasmiga ah ee ilaa hadda laga bixiyey weerarrada, kuwaas oo Xuutiyiintu ay mas’uuliyaddooda sheegteen, halka Sacuudi Carabiya ay si rasmi ah ugu eedeysay kooxo hubeysan oo Ciraaqi ah oo taageero ka hela Tehran. Dowladda Ciraaq ayaa dhinaceeda sheegtay inay baaritaan ku sameyneyso arrinta. Weerarrada waxaa ka mid ahaa gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday xarumo shidaal oo ku yaalla bariga Sacuudi Carabiya, halkaas oo ay ku yaallaan qaar ka mid ah goobaha ugu muhiimsan ee boqortooyadu kasoo saarto, ku keydiso, kuna dhoofiso saliidda. Mareykanka iyo Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa jawaab ahaan duqeymo wadajir ah ka fuliyey goobo ku yaalla Ciraaq oo ay sheegeen inay isticmaalaan kooxo hubeysan oo Iran taageerto. Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in duqeymaha lagu bartilmaameedsaday kooxo uu IRGC ku amray inay weeraraan ciidamada Mareykanka iyo kaabayaasha tamarta ee Sacuudi Carabiya. Warbaahinta taageerta Iran ayaa duqeymaha kadib baahisay tacsi loo dirayo xubno ka tirsanaa IRGC, dagaalyahanno Ciraaqi ah iyo ugu yaraan hal xubin oo ka tirsanaa Xuutiyiinta, taas oo sii xoojisay tuhunka ku saabsan iskaashiga tooska ah ee kooxahaas. Iskaashi sii xoogeysanaya Farea al-Muslimi, oo ah cilmi-baare ka tirsan barnaamijka Bariga Dhexe iyo Waqooyiga Afrika ee machadka Chatham House, ayaa sheegay in xiriirka kooxaha loo yaqaan “Isbahaysiga Iska-caabbinta” uu hadda gaaray heer cusub. “Waxaa hadda jira tababar iyo isku-dubarid toos ah oo dhexmara xubnaha Isbahaysiga Iska-caabbinta, mana aha oo keliya xiriir u dhexeeya koox kasta iyo Iran,” ayuu yiri al-Muslimi. Horumarkan ayaa muujinaya in kooxaha Iran taageerto ay awood u yeesheen inay si toos ah u wada shaqeeyaan, xilli duqeymo badan oo ay fuliyeen Mareykanka iyo Israel ay sanadihii dambe wiiqeen awoodda qaar ka mid ah xubnaha isbahaysigaas ee Lubnaan, Suuriya iyo Iran. Falanqeeyayaasha ayaa sheegaya in dalka Ciraaq uu noqday xarun muhiim u ah dhaq-dhaqaaqyada kooxaha Iran taageerto, gaar ahaan kadib ridistii dowladdii Bashar al-Assad ee Suuriya iyo wiiqitaankii xooggan ee ururka Hezbollah ee Lubnaan. Baaxadda dhulka Ciraaq, deegaannada bannaan iyo awoodda xaddidan ee dowladda dhexe ay ku leedahay qaar ka mid ah kooxaha hubeysan ayaa dalkaas ka dhigaya meel laga abaabuli karo weerarro qarsoodi ah. Xadka u dhexeeya Ciraaq iyo Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa dhererkiisu ka badan yahay 800 oo kiiloomitir, waxaana adagtahay in si buuxda loo ilaaliyo, taas oo fududeyn karta in gantaallo ama diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn laga soo rido gudaha Ciraaq. Saraakiil ka tirsan dalalka Khaliijka ayaa boqolaal weerar oo lagu qaaday Sacuudi Carabiya, Kuwait iyo Imaaraadka Carabta ku eedeeyey kooxo ka howlgala Ciraaq. Waxaa ka mid ahaa weerar diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn lagu qaaday safaaradda Mareykanka ee Riyadh bishii Maarso iyo weerar bishii May lagu qaaday warshadda tamarta nukliyeerka Barakah ee Imaaraadka. Xiriir muddo soo jiray Iskaashiga Xuutiyiinta iyo kooxaha hubeysan ee Ciraaq ma aha mid cusub. Xuutiyiinta ayaa xiriir dhow la leh Kataa’ib Xizbullah, oo loo arko mid ka mid ah kooxaha Ciraaq ugu hubka iyo abaabulka wanaagsan. Hoggaamiyaha Xuutiyiinta Cabdulmalik al-Xuuti ayaa sanadkii 2024 shaaciyey in la sameeyey qol hawlgallo oo ay wadaagaan kooxdiisa iyo kooxaha hubeysan ee Ciraaq. Dabayaaqadii isla sanadkaas ayay dhinacyadu ku dhawaaqeen hawlgalkoodii ugu horreeyey ee wadajir ah oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday Israel. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale muddo xafiisyo iyo wakiil rasmi ah ku lahaa Ciraaq. Wakiilkooda Axmed al-Sharafi ayaa kulamo la shaaciyey la yeeshay xisbiyo Shiico ah iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha kooxaha hubeysan ee xiriirka la leh Iran. Boorar ay ku qoran yihiin hal-ku-dhegga Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale muddo sannado ah lagu arkayey qaybo ka mid ah magaalada Baghdad. Dowladda Ciraaq ayaa marar badan ballanqaadday inay baari doonto eedeymaha sheegaya in dalalka Carabta laga soo weeraro dhulkeeda, balse dadka dhaliila ayaa sheegaya in Baghdad aysan weli muujin awood ay ku xakameyn karto kooxaha hubeysan. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Ciraaq Cali al-Zaidi ayaa baajiyey booqasho uu Khamiistii ku tagi lahaa Sacuudi Carabiya, halkaas oo lagu waday inuu kula kulmo dhaxal-sugaha boqortooyada Maxamed bin Salmaan. Go’aanka ayaa yimid kadib duqeymaha Sacuudiga iyo Mareykanka ay ka fuliyeen gudaha Ciraaq. Al-Zaidi ayaa horay u soo bandhigay qorshe uu doonayo in dhammaan hubka dalka lagu hoos geeyo maamulka dowladda dhammaadka bisha September, hase yeeshee qorshahaas ayaa wajahaya diidmo kaga imaaneysa qaar ka mid ah kooxaha hubeysan ee awoodda badan. Xiisaddan cusub ayaa sare u qaadeysa halista ah in dagaallada gobolka ay yeeshaan furimo cusub, iyadoo weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo xarumaha shidaalka iyo marinada ganacsiga ay saameyn ku yeelan karaan dhoofinta tamarta iyo dhaqaalaha caalamka. items.fullContent: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa qaar ka mid ah weerarradii ugu dambeeyey ee lagu qaaday Sacuudi Carabiya kasoo fulisay gudaha Ciraaq, iyada oo gacan ka heleysa kooxo hubeysan oo Ciraaqi ah oo xiriir la leh Iran, sida ay sheegeen saraakiil gobolka ka tirsan. Qiimeyn ay sameeyeen Sacuudi Carabiya iyo qaar ka mid ah dalalka ay saaxiibada yihiin ayaa muujineysa in weerarrada loo fuliyey si wadajir ah, isla markaana ay kormeerayeen xubno ka tirsan Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran ee IRGC. Xogtan ayaa ka duwan warbixinnada rasmiga ah ee ilaa hadda laga bixiyey weerarrada, kuwaas oo Xuutiyiintu ay mas’uuliyaddooda sheegteen, halka Sacuudi Carabiya ay si rasmi ah ugu eedeysay kooxo hubeysan oo Ciraaqi ah oo taageero ka hela Tehran. Dowladda Ciraaq ayaa dhinaceeda sheegtay inay baaritaan ku sameyneyso arrinta. Weerarrada waxaa ka mid ahaa gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday xarumo shidaal oo ku yaalla bariga Sacuudi Carabiya, halkaas oo ay ku yaallaan qaar ka mid ah goobaha ugu muhiimsan ee boqortooyadu kasoo saarto, ku keydiso, kuna dhoofiso saliidda. Mareykanka iyo Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa jawaab ahaan duqeymo wadajir ah ka fuliyey goobo ku yaalla Ciraaq oo ay sheegeen inay isticmaalaan kooxo hubeysan oo Iran taageerto. items.title: Puntland Audit Raises Alarm Over $21.4 Million in Unverified Government Spending
items.description: Garowe (WDN) – A bombshell audit by Puntland’s Office of the Auditor General has uncovered more than $21.39 million in government expenditure that cannot be fully verified, exposing what auditors describe as serious weaknesses in financial management, documentation, and public accountability. The findings, contained in the 2025 Financial Audit Report released on June 30, 2026, have reignited concerns over transparency in Puntland’s public finances and prompted fresh questions about whether millions of dollars in taxpayers’ money were properly accounted for. The Auditor General issued a Qualified Opinion on the government’s 2025 financial statements—a formal accounting conclusion indicating that significant deficiencies prevented auditors from verifying portions of the government’s expenditure. Millions Spent Without Adequate Documentation According to the report, $21,390,477.60 in government spending lacked sufficient documentary evidence or could not be independently verified. The questionable expenditures fall into two major categories. The first, totaling $5,876,195.55, was processed through the Government Bank and recorded in the Public Financial Management Information System (PFMIS). However, auditors reported they were unable to identify the final beneficiaries of those payments. The second and far larger category—$15,514,282.05—consisted of expenditures that lacked adequate supporting documentation altogether. Within that amount: $7,360,743 had no payment requests attached. $8,153,539.05 contained incomplete approvals, missing signatures, or insufficient authorization documents. For financial auditors, missing documentation is more than an administrative oversight. Without complete records, it becomes impossible to determine precisely who received the money, what it was spent on, whether the expenditure was legally authorized, or whether taxpayers received value for money. Importantly, the Auditor General does not conclude that the $21.39 million was stolen or embezzled. Instead, the report states that the government failed to provide sufficient evidence to verify the legitimacy of those expenditures. In public finance, this distinction is significant. Poor documentation does not automatically prove corruption. Some expenditures may have been legitimate government spending that was simply recorded improperly. However, the absence of proper documentation substantially increases the risk of fraud, misuse of public funds, and financial abuse because independent verification becomes impossible. In other words, millions of dollars remain effectively unaccounted for until the missing records are produced. The report also raises broader concerns regarding payments made to individuals whose identities or official status could not always be clearly established through government records. Auditors stress that every government payment should clearly identify: The recipient, The purpose of the payment, The approving authority, The legal basis for the expenditure. Where those elements are missing, serious questions inevitably arise regarding the integrity of the government’s financial controls. Political opponents have interpreted portions of the audit as evidence that government funds may have benefited political allies and advisers of President Said Abdullahi Deni. However, the Auditor General’s report itself does not make that allegation. Nor does it conclude that any specific payments were directed toward the President’s supporters. Those accusations remain political claims unless supported by additional documentary evidence or future investigations. Government Liabilities Also Underreported Beyond expenditure concerns, the audit uncovered significant weaknesses in the recording of government liabilities. Officially reported government obligations amounted to $16.35 million. However, auditors discovered additional liabilities that had not been included in the government’s official records. These include outstanding obligations involving: Hantaara Company, Electricity providers, Water suppliers, Internet service providers, and Gondogooye. Failure to record all government liabilities accurately creates additional risks because future budgets may underestimate the state’s true financial obligations. Revenue Growth Overshadowed by Accountability Questions Ironically, the audit arrives as Puntland continues to report improving domestic revenue collection. For the 2025 fiscal year: Approved Budget: $124.54 million Actual Treasury Expenditure: $107.83 million Budget Execution Rate: 87% While stronger revenue performance is generally viewed positively, auditors note that increasing revenue also demands stronger financial accountability. Higher revenues lose much of their significance if governments cannot fully demonstrate where the money ultimately goes. Auditor General Calls for Sweeping Reforms The report recommends major improvements to Puntland’s financial management system. Among the key recommendations are: Every government payment should contain complete supporting documentation. Every payment recipient must be clearly identified. PFMIS records should be regularly reconciled with banking records. A comprehensive register of all government liabilities should be maintained. Procurement procedures should rely on open competition and complete documentation. Tax deductions and treasury deposits should be more rigorously monitored. These reforms, auditors argue, are essential if Puntland hopes to strengthen transparency and public confidence in government finances. Pressure Mounts on the Government The audit places Puntland’s Ministry of Finance and other public institutions under increasing pressure to produce the missing documentation requested by auditors. Until those records are provided, significant questions remain over one of the largest groups of unverified public expenditures identified in recent years. For citizens, the issue extends beyond accounting procedures. Every dollar that cannot be properly traced is a dollar whose ultimate destination remains uncertain. As Puntland’s budget continues to expand, so too does the expectation that public officials will demonstrate the highest standards of transparency, accountability, and stewardship over public resources. The Auditor General’s findings do not amount to a criminal conviction, nor do they prove that public money was deliberately stolen. They do, however, expose systemic weaknesses serious enough to undermine confidence in the government’s financial management. Whether the missing documentation eventually resolves those questions—or deepens them—will now depend on how quickly Puntland’s authorities respond to the audit’s findings and whether they can account for every dollar entrusted to the public treasury. items.title: Somalia joins Saudi coalition to counter Houthis in Red Sea
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia has formally thrown its weight behind a Saudi-engineered coalition designed to shield the Red Sea’s arteries of global trade from Houthi attacks, aligning itself with a bloc of nations racing to contain an escalation between Yemen’s Iran-backed movement and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The announcement lands just weeks after President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud cautioned the breakaway northern region of Somaliland against entangling itself in the widening Houthi-Israel confrontation, warning that any such move would carry dire consequences for both the region and Somalia at large. A Coalition Takes Shape in Riyadh Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Defense announced on Thursday that it had convened chiefs of staff and senior military representatives to advance the Kingdom’s initiative to stand up a multinational defensive maritime coalition against the Houthis – a bloc Riyadh intends to lead and headquarter on its own soil. According to the ministry’s statement, the gathering drew participation from 43 countries out of 51 formally invited, alongside a delegation representing the European Union, with attendance split between in-person representation and video conferencing. Saudi officials described the turnout as evidence of “growing international interest in enhancing defensive maritime cooperation” and stressed the need to “unify efforts to confront common threats” to international shipping lanes falling within the coalition’s designated zone of responsibility. Delegates worked through the architecture of the emerging bloc, reviewing a draft charter, supporting reference documents, and the coalition’s proposed organizational structure, command-and-control arrangements, and operational mechanisms. The stated objective, per the ministry, is to build “an effective institutional framework” capable of confronting shared maritime threats across three of the world’s most strategically sensitive waterways: the Bab el-Mandeb Strait , the Red Sea , and the Gulf of Aden . Participants agreed that military planners from nations wishing to join would continue working through the coming phase to finalize the charter, complete the organizational and command framework, and stand up the technical teams needed to operationalize the alliance – running in parallel with each willing country’s domestic ratification procedures ahead of a formal signing and launch. Somalia Among 14 Founding Signatories In a significant outcome of the Riyadh meeting, 14 countries issued a joint statement declaring their backing for the coalition and welcoming the consensus reached on its foundational arrangements. Somalia stands among them, alongside Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Pakistan, Turkey, Egypt, Jordan, Yemen, Bangladesh, Nigeria, Sudan, and Djibouti. The Saudi Ministry of Defense noted that additional participating nations voiced support for the initiative as well, and are now working through internal procedures before formally joining the statement – with the door left open to them, and to any other willing country, once national approval processes are complete. Somalia’s inclusion places it in company with fellow Red Sea and Horn of Africa littoral states Djibouti and Sudan, reinforcing reporting that Red Sea littoral states central to the effort, including Egypt and Sudan, had agreed to take part alongside Djibouti and Somalia. The Trigger: A Houthi Blockade and a Region on Edge The Riyadh coalition did not emerge in a vacuum. On July 20, Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi group announced what it described as a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia in the Red Sea and has since claimed responsibility for multiple attacks on Saudi-linked vessels. At least one Saudi-owned tanker has been struck, pushing other vessels to either turn back or reroute through the costlier, longer Suez Canal passage. The disruption has rattled energy markets: Brent crude has surged past $100 a barrel for the first time since May, underscoring the strain the standoff is placing on global oil trade. The stakes are compounded by the Kingdom’s shifting export logistics. With the Strait of Hormuz effectively closed amid the wider Iran conflict, Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea terminal at Yanbu has emerged as a critical artery for the country’s oil exports, leaving Riyadh with little room to tolerate a prolonged Houthi campaign along its western coastline. Somaliland’s Israel Gambit and Mohamud’s Warning Somalia’s move to formally back the Saudi-led bloc cannot be separated from the diplomatic storm brewing to its north. Weeks earlier, President Mohamud had directly cautioned Somaliland’s administration against courting the Houthi-Israel conflict, arguing that the breakaway territory’s overtures toward Israel – including its recognition by Tel Aviv and a subsequent state visit – risked importing a war that neither Somaliland nor Somalia proper could contain. Mohamud has repeatedly framed Israel’s recognition of Somaliland, and any accompanying military foothold along the Gulf of Aden, as an existential threat to Somali sovereignty rather than a purely northern affair. He has previously argued that Israel’s recognition of Somaliland was driven chiefly by three considerations: Somaliland’s potential accession to the Abraham Accords, the relocation of Palestinians from Gaza, and the establishment of an Israeli military base along the Gulf of Aden – a prospect he has warned could draw the Houthis, and by extension Iran, directly into Somali territorial waters. Mohamud has cautioned that if Israel turns Somaliland into a proxy platform to strike at others’ interests, those adversaries would retaliate against Somaliland and Somalia alike, a scenario he has called anything but favorable for the wider region. Against that backdrop, Mogadishu’s decision reads as more than a security gesture. It binds Somalia’s foreign policy to the Gulf Arab camp opposing Houthi and Iranian expansion – even as Somaliland edges toward the opposite pole. Why the Bab el-Mandeb Matters The stretch of water at the center of this diplomatic scramble is not a peripheral shipping lane. The Bab al-Mandeb Strait, connecting the southern Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden and the Indian Ocean, ranks among the world’s most consequential corridors for global trade and energy shipments. Houthi attacks on shipping through the strait first erupted in 2023, framed by the group as an act of solidarity with Palestinians during the Gaza war, but the waterway’s importance has only grown since, serving as a critical alternative export route as the Strait of Hormuz came under threat amid the broader Iran conflict. For Saudi Arabia, the calculus is now existential rather than merely commercial. Analysts have argued the Kingdom “cannot afford to let this blockade stand,” given how directly the Houthi campaign threatens one of its few remaining viable oil export corridors. Skepticism Amid the Show of Unity Not every reaction to Thursday’s announcement has been celebratory. Public commentary beneath Saudi state media’s own coverage of the summit has questioned whether a Riyadh-led coalition can actually deliver results, with one widely circulated response predicting that, absent decisive action, the Houthis could end up controlling the Bab al-Mandeb outright within years and charging vessels for passage – a blunt reminder that skepticism toward Gulf-led security initiatives runs deep, even among audiences sympathetic to Riyadh. What Comes Next For now, the coalition remains a framework rather than a fielded force. Military planners from Somalia and the other 13 signatory nations – plus any additional states that complete their domestic procedures – are expected to spend the coming weeks finalizing the charter, settling command structures, and building the technical apparatus needed before the alliance can formally launch and begin operations in the Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb, and Gulf of Aden. Whether that framework can translate into a credible deterrent against the Houthi movement that has already disrupted global shipping for two consecutive years will determine whether Somalia’s bet on Riyadh – and its implicit rebuke of Somaliland’s Israel outreach – proves to be a strategic masterstroke or merely a diplomatic gesture overtaken by events at sea. The stated objective, per the ministry, is to build “an effective institutional framework” capable of confronting shared maritime threats across three of the world’s most strategically sensitive waterways: the Bab el-Mandeb Strait , the Red Sea , and the Gulf of Aden . Participants agreed that military planners from nations wishing to join would continue working through the coming phase to finalize the charter, complete the organizational and command framework, and stand up the technical teams needed to operationalize the alliance – running in parallel with each willing country’s domestic ratification procedures ahead of a formal signing and launch. Somalia Among 14 Founding Signatories In a significant outcome of the Riyadh meeting, 14 countries issued a joint statement declaring their backing for the coalition and welcoming the consensus reached on its foundational arrangements. Somalia stands among them, alongside Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Pakistan, Turkey, Egypt, Jordan, Yemen, Bangladesh, Nigeria, Sudan, and Djibouti. The Saudi Ministry of Defense noted that additional participating nations voiced support for the initiative as well, and are now working through internal procedures before formally joining the statement – with the door left open to them, and to any other willing country, once national approval processes are complete. Somalia’s inclusion places it in company with fellow Red Sea and Horn of Africa littoral states Djibouti and Sudan, reinforcing reporting that Red Sea littoral states central to the effort, including Egypt and Sudan, had agreed to take part alongside Djibouti and Somalia. The Trigger: A Houthi Blockade and a Region on Edge The Riyadh coalition did not emerge in a vacuum. On July 20, Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi group announced what it described as a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia in the Red Sea and has since claimed responsibility for multiple attacks on Saudi-linked vessels. At least one Saudi-owned tanker has been struck, pushing other vessels to either turn back or reroute through the costlier, longer Suez Canal passage. The disruption has rattled energy markets: Brent crude has surged past $100 a barrel for the first time since May, underscoring the strain the standoff is placing on global oil trade. The stakes are compounded by the Kingdom’s shifting export logistics. With the Strait of Hormuz effectively closed amid the wider Iran conflict, Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea terminal at Yanbu has emerged as a critical artery for the country’s oil exports, leaving Riyadh with little room to tolerate a prolonged Houthi campaign along its western coastline. Somaliland’s Israel Gambit and Mohamud’s Warning Somalia’s move to formally back the Saudi-led bloc cannot be separated from the diplomatic storm brewing to its north. Weeks earlier, President Mohamud had directly cautioned Somaliland’s administration against courting the Houthi-Israel conflict, arguing that the breakaway territory’s overtures toward Israel – including its recognition by Tel Aviv and a subsequent state visit – risked importing a war that neither Somaliland nor Somalia proper could contain. Mohamud has repeatedly framed Israel’s recognition of Somaliland, and any accompanying military foothold along the Gulf of Aden, as an existential threat to Somali sovereignty rather than a purely northern affair. He has previously argued that Israel’s recognition of Somaliland was driven chiefly by three considerations: Somaliland’s potential accession to the Abraham Accords, the relocation of Palestinians from Gaza, and the establishment of an Israeli military base along the Gulf of Aden – a prospect he has warned could draw the Houthis, and by extension Iran, directly into Somali territorial waters. Mohamud has cautioned that if Israel turns Somaliland into a proxy platform to strike at others’ interests, those adversaries would retaliate against Somaliland and Somalia alike, a scenario he has called anything but favorable for the wider region. Against that backdrop, Mogadishu’s decision reads as more than a security gesture. It binds Somalia’s foreign policy to the Gulf Arab camp opposing Houthi and Iranian expansion – even as Somaliland edges toward the opposite pole. Why the Bab el-Mandeb Matters The stretch of water at the center of this diplomatic scramble is not a peripheral shipping lane. The Bab al-Mandeb Strait, connecting the southern Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden and the Indian Ocean, ranks among the world’s most consequential corridors for global trade and energy shipments. Houthi attacks on shipping through the strait first erupted in 2023, framed by the group as an act of solidarity with Palestinians during the Gaza war, but the waterway’s importance has only grown since, serving as a critical alternative export route as the Strait of Hormuz came under threat amid the broader Iran conflict. For Saudi Arabia, the calculus is now existential rather than merely commercial. Analysts have argued the Kingdom “cannot afford to let this blockade stand,” given how directly the Houthi campaign threatens one of its few remaining viable oil export corridors. Skepticism Amid the Show of Unity Not every reaction to Thursday’s announcement has been celebratory. Public commentary beneath Saudi state media’s own coverage of the summit has questioned whether a Riyadh-led coalition can actually deliver results, with one widely circulated response predicting that, absent decisive action, the Houthis could end up controlling the Bab al-Mandeb outright within years and charging vessels for passage – a blunt reminder that skepticism toward Gulf-led security initiatives runs deep, even among audiences sympathetic to Riyadh. What Comes Next For now, the coalition remains a framework rather than a fielded force. Military planners from Somalia and the other 13 signatory nations – plus any additional states that complete their domestic procedures – are expected to spend the coming weeks finalizing the charter, settling command structures, and building the technical apparatus needed before the alliance can formally launch and begin operations in the Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb, and Gulf of Aden. Whether that framework can translate into a credible deterrent against the Houthi movement that has already disrupted global shipping for two consecutive years will determine whether Somalia’s bet on Riyadh – and its implicit rebuke of Somaliland’s Israel outreach – proves to be a strategic masterstroke or merely a diplomatic gesture overtaken by events at sea.
