items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo Taliyaha AFRICOM oo ka wada hadlay amniga iyo xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta oo ku beegan 30-ka Luulyo 2026 kulan la yeeshay Taliyaha Ciidamada Mareykanka ee Qaaradda Afrika (AFRICOM), Jeneraal Dagvin R.M. Anderson. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda amniga ee gobolka, dardargelinta dagaalka ka dhanka ah argagixisada, xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, iyo taageerada Mareykanka ee nabadda iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa dowladda Mareykanka uga mahadceliyay taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, isagoo xusay in iskaashiga labada dal uu door muhiim ah ka qaadanayo tayeynta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, adkeynta amniga, iyo horumarinta xasilloonida gobolka. Dhankiisa, Taliyaha AFRICOM, Jeneraal Dagvin R.M. Anderson, ayaa caddeeyay in dowladda Mareykanku ay ka go’an tahay sii wadista taageerada Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada la dagaallanka argagixisada, horumarinta awoodda ciidamada, iyo xoojinta iskaashiga istaraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeeya labada dal. Kulankan ayaa imanaya xilli Soomaaliya ay sii waddo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo amniga dalka iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay saaxiibada caalamiga ah si loo ciribtiro khatarta argagixisada loona dhiso hay’ado amni oo awood leh.

items.title: Muxuu muuqaalkii uu sii duubay ku sheegay ninkii fuliyey weerarka Berlin?
items.description: Berlin (Caasimada Online) – Ninkii looga shakisan yahay inuu ka dambeeyay weerar gaari loo adeegsaday oo ka dhacay magaalada Berlin ayaa taleefankiisa kaga tagay muuqaal uu ku sheegayo inuu daacad u yahay kooxda Daacish, sida ay Talaadadii shaaciyeen dacwad-oogayaasha Jarmalka. Afhayeen u hadlay xafiiska dacwad-oogaha federaalka ayaa sheegay in qofka ka muuqda muuqaalka uu wejiga duubnaa, balse hay’adaha ammaanku ay rumeysan yihiin inuu yahay eedeysanaha weerarka, oo lagu magacaabi jiray Abdul Ballout. Ballout, oo ahaa 21 jir haystay dhalashada Jarmalka, ayaa boolisku toogteen Axaddii, kaddib markii lagu tuhmay inuu gaari jiirsiiyay dad ku sugnaa beerta Tiergarten ee bartamaha Berlin, meel aan ka fogeyn albaabka caanka ah ee Brandenburg Gate. Weerarka, oo dhacay fiidnimadii Sabtida, ayaa waxaa ku dhimatay haweeney Polish ah oo da’deedu ahayd lixdameeyada, halka 29 qof oo kale ay ku dhaawacmeen. Qaar ka mid ah dadka dhaawacmay ayaa la sheegay inay xaaladdoodu culus tahay. Dacwad-oogayaasha ayaan weli shaacin xilliga la duubay muuqaalka laga helay taleefanka Ballout, ama in weerarka uu si toos ah uga amar qaatay Daacish iyo in kale. Baarayaasha ayaa sidoo kale baaraya xiriirro kale oo suurtagal ah iyo sida uu weerarka u qorsheeyay. Dhacdadan ayaa Jarmalka ka dhalisay dood xooggan oo ku saabsan fashilka hay’adaha ammaanka iyo sababta Ballout loogu sii daayay bulshada isaga oo kormeer sharci ah ku jira, halkii xabsi lagu hayn lahaa. Wasiirka arrimaha gudaha Jarmalka ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqay dib-u-habeyn lagu sameynayo nidaamka ammaanka, gaar ahaan habka loola socdo dadka horay loogu helay dambiyada la xiriira xagjirnimada iyo qorsheynta falal halis ku ah qaranka. Ballout ayaa bishii May lagu xukumay xabsi, kaddib markii lagu helay inuu diyaarinayay fal rabshado culus oo khatar gelin kara ammaanka dowladda. Hase yeeshee, waxaa loo oggolaaday inuu bannaanka joogo isaga oo hoos yimaada kormeerka sarkaal qaabilsan dadka xukunka shuruudda leh lagu sii daayo. Arrintaas ayaa caro weyn ka dhalisay gudaha Jarmalka, iyadoo siyaasiyiin iyo dadweyne badan ay dalbanayaan in si faahfaahsan loo caddeeyo sababta qof loo aqoonsaday inuu khatar amni yahay loogu oggolaaday inuu si xor ah bulshada dhexdeeda ugu noolaado. Weerarka ayaa sidoo kale sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo khataraha xagjirnimada, xilli Jarmalku kordhiyay ammaanka munaasabadaha waaweyn iyo goobaha dadweynuhu ku badan yihiin. items.title: Muqdisho Oo Martigelisay Shir Dhaqaale Oo Muhiim Ah
items.description: Muqdisho – Shir-sanaadeedkii 4aad ee Siyaasadda Dhaqaalaha, oo uu soo qabanqaabiyay Bankiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya (BDhS) , ayaa lagu soo gabagabeeyay magaalada Muqdisho iyadoo shirku uu socday laba maalmood. Shirkan waxaa ka soo qeyb galay in ka badan 75 hay’adood oo ay ka mid yihiin wasaarado iyo hay’adaha dowladda, hay’adaha caalamiga ah sida Bangiga Adduunka, ururrada bangiyada, xawaaladaha amaahda yar-yar shirkadaha caymiska jaamacadaha machadyada cilmi-baarista, iyo khubaro dhaqaale. Shirkan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay isku-duwidda hay’adaha dhaqaalaha dalka si looga wada hadlo xasiloonida maaliyadeed iyo saameynta dhimista taageerada dhaqaale ee dibedda. Shirka waxaa si rasmi ah u furay Wasiirka Maaliyadda Mudane Biixi Iimaan Cige isagoo ku ammaanay Bankiga Dhexe qaban-qaabada shirkan sannadlaha ah isla markaana ku booriyey hay’adaha dowladda inay si wadajir ah uga wada shaqeeyaan arrimaha kobcinta dhaqaalaha dalka. Gabagabadii shirka waxaa si rasmi ah u soo xiray Marwo Xaniifa Maxamed Ibraahim oo ka tirsan Guddiga-maamulka Sare ee Bankiga Dhexe, iyadoo mahadcelin ballaaran u jeedisay dhammaan kaqaybgalayaasha iyo qabanqaabiyeyaasha shirka. items.title: Daawo: Madaale oo jawaab kulul siiyay mucaaradka DF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Onine) – Guddoomiyihii hore ee Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, Mudane Yuusuf Xuseen Jimcaale (Madaale) oo xalay ka qayb-galay kulan ka dhacay hoteelka Jasiira ayaa u jawaabay siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ee kasoo horjeedo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo dhawaan warqad furan u diray dalalka ay ciidamada ka joogaan gudaha Soomaaliya. Madaale ayaa ku eedeeyay mucaaradka in ay dalka dib u celinayaan, ayna wadaan tallaabooyin, sida uu sheegay wiiqaya horumarka dalka iyo geeddi-socodka dowlad dhiska. “Niman odayaal ah oo saaxibo nahay warqado ayay dibadaha u diroowaan waxay leeyihiin amaa dib loo noqdaa, waxaan leeyahay dowladdaan waa dhaq-dhaqaaqday ee yaan dib loo celin,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiye Madaale. Sidoo kale, guddoomiyihii hore ee Gobolka Banaadir, oo haddana kamid ah hoggaanka sare ee Xisbiga JSP ee Madaxweynaha ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in dalka uu aaday doorasho, isagoo tusaale usoo qaatay doorashada Galmudug. Warqadda mucaaradka oo ku taariikheysneyd 27-ki bishaan July ayaa dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya AUSSOM looga codsaday inay taageeradooda Soomaaliya ku xiraan heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, iyadoo sidoo kale lagu soo jeediyey dhismaha gole ku-meelgaar ah oo si wadajir ah u kormeera marxaladda dastuurka iyo doorashooyinka. Soo jeedintaas ayaa dhalisay muran xooggan, gaar ahaan qodobka ku saabsan dhismaha gole ku-meelgaar ah, oo siyaasiyiin ay ku jiraan xubno ka tirsan isbahaysiyada ku mideysan Golaha Mustaqbalka ay ku tilmaameen mid Soomaaliya dib ugu celin karta ku-meelgaarnimadii laga soo gudbay. Si kastaba, dooddan ayaa khilaaf ka dhex dhalisay mucaaradka, kadib markii xubnaha qaar ay ka horyimaadeen qoraalka loo diray dalalka ciidamada usoo diray Soomaaliya. Warqadda ayaa sidoo kale dhalisay mucaarado xoogan oo Golaha Mustaqbalka uga timid shacabka, oo lama filaan ay ku noqotay in dad doonaya inay dalka maamulaan ay haddana dalbanayaan in dib loogu noqdo marxalad ku-meel gaar ah. The post Daawo: Madaale oo jawaab kulul siiyay mucaaradka DF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Doorashada Goleyaasha Wakiilada iyo deegaanka oo maanta ka bilaabtay Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb ( Raxanreeb Online) Shacabka ku nool deegaannada Galmudug ayaa saaka u dareeray doorasho qof iyo cod ah oo isku sidkan, taas oo lagu dooranayo golayaasha deegaanka iyo wakiillada ee maamulkaas. Doorashadan ayaa looga dareeray 11 degmo oo ka tirsan gobollada Galgaduud iyo koonfurta Mudug, kuwaas oo kala ah Dhuusamareeb, Cadaado, Guraceel, Caabudwaaq, Balanbale, Hobyo, Xarardheere, Xeraale, Ceeldheer, Galcad iyo koonfurta Gaalkacyo. In ka badan 200,000 oo qof ayaa isku diiwaangeliyay doorashadan oo lagu dooranayo 243 xubnood oo gole deegaan ah iyo 89 xubnood oo gole wakiillo ah, waxaana ku tartamaya dhowr urur oo ugu tunweyn yahay Xisbiga JSP. Sidoo kale dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo maamulaysa doorashadan waxay madaxweynaha maamulka Galmudug u wadataa Liibaan Shuluq oo ka tartamaya ururka uu hoggaamiyo madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee JSP. Dowladda Federaalka waxay hore doorasho noocaan oo kale ah uga soo qabatay magaalada Muqdisho iyo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, kuwaas oo ay dhaliileen mucaaradka islamarkaana ku tilmaameen doorashooyin aan daahfurnayn. items.title: Sawirro: Xasan Sheekh oo kulan xasaasi ah la yeeshay taliyaha ciidanka AFRICOM
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta kulan xasaasi ah la qaatay Taliyaha Ciidamada Mareykanka ee Qaaradda Afrika (AFRICOM), General Dagvin R.M. Anderson, kaas oo looga hadlay xaaladda amniga dalka iyo dagaalka Al-Shabaab. Labada dhinac ayaa kulankooda si gaar ah diiradda ugu saaray xaaladda amni ee guud ahaan gobolka, dardargelinta dagaalka ka dhanka ah argagixisada, xoojinta iskaashiga amniga iyo difaaca ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka. Sidoo kale, intii u socday kulanka waxaa lagu soo qaaday xoojinta taageerada Mareykanka ee ku aaddan horumarinta nabadda iyo ammaanka Soomaaliya, maadaama uu ka qayb-qaato howlgallada ka dhanka ah kooxda Al-Shabaab. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo madasha ka hadlay ayaa uga mahadceliyey dowladda Mareykanka garab istaagga iyo taageerada joogtada ah ee ay siiso Soomaaliya, isaga oo xusay in iskaashiga labada dal uu door muuqda ka qaadanayo xoojinta awoodda ciidamada Qaranka Soomaaliyeed, iyo adkaynta amniga, xasilloonida iyo horumarka gobolka. Taliyaha AFRICOM, General Dagvin R.M. Anderson ayaa dhankiisa adkeeyey sida ay Dowladda Mareykanka uga go’an tahay sii wadidda taageerada ay la garab taagan tahay Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada la dagaallanka argagixisada, tayeynta ciidamada iyo xoojinta wada-shaqeynta istaraatiijiga ah ee labada dal. Kulankan ayaa imaanaya xilli Soomaaliya ay sii waddo howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, iyada oo mudnaan gaar ah siinayso xoojinta iskaashiga amniga ee ay la leedahay saaxiibbada caalamiga ah. Mareykanka ayaa ka mid ah dalalka sida joogtada ah u taageera Soomaaliya dhinacyada tababarka iyo tayeynta ciidamada, duqeymaha ka dhanka ah kooxaha hubeysan, iyo taageerada dhismaha hay’adaha amniga. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa marar badan sheegtay in iskaashigan uu muhiim u yahay dardargelinta dagaalka lagula jiro argagixisada iyo xoojinta amniga dalka. Si kastaba, shalay ayay ahayd markii wafdi ka socda Congress-ka iyo taliska milatariga ay gaareen magaalada Kismaayo, halkaas oo ay wada-hadallo kula soo yeesheen Madaxweynaha Jubbada, Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe), waxaana la sheegay inay usii gudbi doonaan magaalooyinka Garoowe iyo Hargeysa oo ay kula kulmi doonaan madaxda Puntland iyo Somaliland. items.title: Five Kenyan officers killed in Al-Shabaab ambush near Somalia border as Mandera’s deadly corridor claims more lives
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Al-Shabaab fighters ambushed a Kenyan police patrol near the Somali border on Tuesday, killing five officers from an elite counter-terrorism unit. As reinforcements rushed to the scene, a roadside bomb tore through one of their armoured vehicles. Kenyan police confirmed both attacks on Wednesday, calling it one of the deadliest single strikes yet in a district that has become the epicentre of the group’s cross-border insurgency. Al-Shabaab, which is linked to Al-Qaeda, claimed the operation through affiliated media outlets and attributed it to its armed wing. The group’s reported toll is far higher than what Kenyan authorities have confirmed – a familiar and unresolved gap in how the two sides account for casualties along this contested frontier. How the attack unfolded A Kenyan police report says the assault began shortly after midday. A patrol from the Special Operations Group – an elite police counter-terrorism unit – came under fire near Wantey Dam, roughly 6km (4 miles) from the Lafey police station. Five officers were killed in the initial burst of gunfire. A reinforcement team was dispatched immediately. As it neared the scene, a roadside bomb detonated and destroyed one of its armoured vehicles. Remarkably, police said no one aboard was injured. The sequence – ambush first, delayed explosive second – reflects a tactic Al-Shabaab has increasingly relied on: striking first responders, not just the initial target. Competing casualty accounts Al-Shabab’s affiliated media network told a different story. It claimed 13 soldiers were killed and 12 wounded, and said its fighters destroyed an armoured vehicle and five motorcycles. The group also claimed to have seized weapons, military equipment and one motorcycle. Kenyan authorities have not corroborated any of those figures. The gulf between official and Al-Shabaab-claimed numbers is a near-constant feature of cross-border clashes here, where remote terrain and tight security restrictions make independent verification difficult. Part of a wider, intensifying pattern Tuesday’s ambush was not an isolated event. It is the latest in a string of attacks concentrated along the same stretch of Mandera in recent weeks – a pattern Kenyan officials say shows Al-Shabaab’s intent to keep the region under sustained pressure. On July 13, Kenyan forces stormed a suspected militant camp near the border. They killed 11 fighters and, officials said, disrupted a plot by roughly 30 Al-Shabaab members to attack a nearby village. Eleven days later, on July 24, gunmen struck two villages in the same district – Fino and Arabia – within an hour of each other. A two-decade insurgency with a cross-border reach Al-Shabaab has fought Somalia’s government for nearly two decades and now controls large swaths of south-central Somalia. Kenya has been entangled in that fight since 2011, when its troops crossed the border to push the group back. Nairobi has since partnered closely with Somali authorities to contain Al-Shabaab – and the group has answered with repeated cross-border attacks inside Kenya. A report submitted to Kenya’s parliament last November named the corridor around Lafey – the same area hit on Tuesday – as one of the main routes militants use to infiltrate the country. It documented dozens of security force casualties across the wider region over the previous year. That report counted 61 “terror-related incidents” across four northeastern counties – Mandera, Wajir, Garissa and Lamu – between September 2024 and August 2025. Mandera alone accounted for 38 of them, more than any other county, making it the hardest-hit corner of Kenya’s northeast. Why Al-Shabaab keeps striking Kenyan soil Samira Gaid, a regional security analyst at Balqiis Insights, told Al Jazeera TV that these cross-border strikes are no accident. They are, she said, a deliberate and long-standing part of Al-Shabaab’s strategy, one that traces back to Kenya’s 2011 intervention in Somalia. Al-Shabab has little interest in holding Kenyan territory the way it does in Somalia, Gaid explained. Instead, its cross-border operations are meant to raise the domestic political cost of Kenya’s military involvement – with the ultimate goal of pressuring Nairobi into pulling its troops out of Somalia entirely. A regional mission at a crossroads The attack lands at a delicate moment for the wider campaign against Al-Shabaab. Heads of state from countries contributing troops to the African Union’s peacekeeping mission in Somalia are due to meet later this week to discuss the mission’s future . The meeting follows Washington’s announcement that it is cutting crucial funding for the operation . The United States said in early July that it would end logistics support for the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), which has backed Somalia’s army in its fight against Al-Shabaab. Analysts warn the funding cut could threaten the mission’s viability – just as Al-Shabaab is showing renewed capacity to strike across Somalia’s borders. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo warbixiyay sida ay doorashadu u socoto
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxa-Bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (NIEBC) ayaa faahfaahin ka bixiyay habsami u socodka doorashada Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada ee ka socota Dowlad-Goboleedka Galmudug, isaga oo sheegay in geeddi-socodku uu ku socdo jawi deggan oo nidaamsan. Guddoomiyuhu wuxuu sheegay in dhammaan goobaha codbixinta ay si wanaagsan u shaqeynayaan, isla markaana la qaaday tallaabooyin adag oo lagu sugayo amniga, si codbixiyeyaashu ay ugu gutaan xuquuqdooda si nabad ah. Waxa uu bulshada ugu baaqay inay si ballaaran uga qayb qaataan doorashada, islamarkaana ay soo baxaan oo codkooda dhiibtaan, isagoo ku tilmaamay codbixinta inay tahay fursad muhiim u ah shacabka inay doortaan hoggaankooda. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale farriin u diray ururrada siyaasadda ee ku tartamaya doorashada, isagoo ugu baaqay inay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan guddiga doorashooyinka, ayna ilaaliyaan hannaanka doorashada. Wuxuu si gaar ah uga digay in ururradu aysan wax isbeddel ah ku samayn murashaxiintooda inta geeddi-socodka doorashadu socdo, si loo ilaaliyo daahfurnaanta iyo kalsoonida lagu qabo nidaamka doorashada. Guddiga Doorashooyinka ayaa mar kale xaqiijiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay in doorashadu ku qabsoonto si xor, xalaal ah oo hufan, iyadoo la ilaalinayo shuruucda iyo habraacyada u dejisan doorashooyinka Galmudug.

items.title: Doorashada Golaha Deegaanka iyo Wakiillada Galmudug oo Si Rasmi ah u Bilaabatay
items.description: Doorashada Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada Dowlad-Goboleedka Galmudug ayaa maanta si rasmi ah uga bilaabatay degmooyinka maamulkaas, iyadoo kumannaan codbixiyeyaal ah ay u dareereen goobaha codbixinta si ay u gutaan waajibaadkooda dastuuriga ah. Doorashadan oo ah mid taariikhi ah ayaa ka socota guud ahaan degmooyinka loo asteeyay geeddi-socodka codbixinta, waxaana si weyn loo adkeeyay amniga goobaha doorashada si loo xaqiijiyo in hawshu u dhacdo si nabad ah oo hufan. Masuuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale codkooda ka dhiibtay magaalooyinka waaweyn ee Galmudug, iyagoo bulshada ku bogaadiyay ka-qaybgalka doorashada isla markaana ku baaqay in la ilaaliyo nabadda iyo wadajirka inta ay socoto codbixintu. Doorashadan waxaa ku tartamaya boqolaal musharrax oo u sharaxan kuraasta Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada, kuwaas oo matalaya ururro siyaasadeed oo kala duwan. Waxaa la filayaa in natiijada doorashadu door muhiim ah ka qaadato dhismaha hay’adaha dowladnimo ee Galmudug iyo xoojinta nidaamka dimuqraadiyadeed. Mas’uuliyiinta guddiga doorashooyinka ayaa sheegay in habsami u socodka codbixintu uu yahay mudnaanta koowaad, iyagoo xusay in natiijooyinka si rasmi ah loo shaacin doono marka la soo gabagabeeyo tirinta codadka. Doorashadan ayaa ah tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo hannaanka dimuqraadiyadda, isla markaana lagu dhiirrigelinayo shacabka Galmudug inay si toos ah uga qayb qaataan doorashada hoggaankooda deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada.

items.title: Galmudug opens long-awaited regional elections amid tight security
items.description: Voters across Galmudug state turned out in large numbers on Thursday as polls opened at 7:00 a.m. in all 11 designated districts for state assembly and House of Representatives elections, marking a pivotal step in the federal member state’s democratic transition after weeks of delay. The vote, twice postponed at the request of political parties seeking more preparation time, is being watched closely as a test of Somalia’s broader push toward direct, one-person-one-vote elections at the state level. Galmudug follows Banadir and South West State in holding direct polls, part of a national electoral roadmap the federal election commission unveiled earlier this year. Abdikarin Ahmed Hassan, chairman of the National Independent Electoral Commission, confirmed polling stations opened on schedule and described the atmosphere as calm. “All 11 districts where we announced elections would take place in the Galmudug region have opened, voting began at 7:00 a.m., and we want to tell Somalis wherever they are that the process has started and will continue as planned,” Hassan said. More than 200,000 people registered to vote in Galmudug, according to the commission, with most having already collected their voter cards. An earlier registration exercise recorded 215,860 voters across the state’s two regions, Mudug and Galgadud, split roughly 54 percent men and 46 percent women. Hassan said any registered resident of Galmudug is entitled to vote, using either a physical voter card or a temporary certificate. Security was tightened around polling districts, with movement restrictions imposed to monitor activity and protect voters, authorities said. The election had been rescheduled twice. The vote was originally planned for July 25 before being pushed to July 30, with the commission citing requests from political parties for more time to prepare. An earlier date of July 20 had also been shifted after consultations with parties on June 4. The polls are not without controversy. Galmudug’s regional administration earlier accused Chairman Hassan of joining a campaign linked to a presidential candidate, and demanded guarantees of an impartial electoral process. The commission has not publicly responded to those accusations. Twelve political parties are fielding 369 candidates for 89 seats in the House of Representatives, while 16 parties have put forward 924 candidates for 243 seats in the regional assembly. Results are expected to be announced once counting concludes at the district level, though no official timeline has been given. The post Galmudug opens long-awaited regional elections amid tight security first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Booqashadii madaxweyne Cirro ee saaka iyo sidii uu ugu kuurgalay qaybta Kalyaha ee cisbatalka guud ee Hargeisa
items.description: 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐰𝐞𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐡𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐛𝐨𝐨𝐪𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐐𝐚𝐲𝐛𝐭𝐚 𝐒𝐢𝐟𝐚𝐲𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐊𝐞𝐥𝐲𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐞𝐞 𝐂𝐮𝐬𝐛𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐆𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐞𝐞 𝐇𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐲𝐬𝐚, 𝐛𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐪𝐚𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐲𝐧𝐚 𝐰𝐚𝐱-𝐤𝐚-𝐪𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐛𝐚𝐚𝐡𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐜𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐨𝐲𝐢𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐛𝐮𝐤𝐚𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa saaka aroortii hore booqasho ku tagay Qaybta Sifaynta Kelyaha ee Cusbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa, halkaas oo uu qof qof ula kulmay bukaannada adeeggaasi ku tiirsan, isaga oo xog-ogaal u noqday xaaladdooda caafimaad iyo caqabadaha ay la kulmaan mararka qaar. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu si dhow u dhegaystay cabashooyinka iyo baahiyaha bukaanka, isaga oo carrabka ku adkeeyey in daryeelka caafimaadku yahay waajib Qaran, isla markaana ay Xukuumaddu ka saaran tahay masuuliyadda ugu weyn ee hubinta helitaanka adeeg caafimaad oo tayo leh. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay doorashada qof iyo codka ah ee ka bilaabatay Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Deegaannada Galmudug waxaa maanta ka bilowday doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee maamulkaasi, iyada oo saaka dadweynaha ay buux dhaafiyeen goobaha loo asteeyay cod-bixinta. Doorashadan oo ah mid xasaasi ah ayaa waxaa usoo baxay dadweyne fara badan oo isaga kala yimid degmooyinka kala duwan ee Galmudug, si ay codadkooda u dhiibtaan, una soo doortaan hoggaankooda. Guddoomiyaha guddiga doorashooyinka qaranka, Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan oo ka warbixiyay doorashadan ayaa sheegay inay daah-fureen saaka aroortii hore, isla markaana ay doorashadu ku socoto jawi deggan oo nabdoon. “Dhammaan 11-ka degmo oo aan u iclaaminay inay ka dhacdo doorashadu deegaanku Galmudug, waxayna furantay 7:00am, waxaan u sheegeynaa ummadda Soomaaliyeed meel kasta oo ay joogaan inay doorashadii bilaabatay, howshuna ay sidaas ku socon doonto,” ayuu yiri guddoomiyuhu. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay inay is diiwaangeliyeen dad ka badan 200,000, isla markaana intooda badan ay qaateen kaararka cod-bixinta, si ay codadkooda u dhiibtaan, isaga oo tilmaamay in Galmudug ay qaaday waddadii dimoquraadiyadda. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in qof kasta oo reer Galmudug oo is diiwaangeliyay uu xaq u leeyahay ka qayb-galka doorashada, isaga oo xusay in lagu codeyn karo kaarka iyo sidoo kale shahaadada ku-meel-gaarka ah. “Dadku badi way wada qaateen kaararka, waxaana leenahay waxaa lagu coden karaa kaarka lafta ah iyo shahaadada ku-meel-gaarka ah, qof walba oo diiwaangashan oo reer Galmudug ah wuxuu maanta xaq u leeyahay inuu codeeyo,” ayuu sii raaciyay Guddoomiyaha guddiga doorashooyinka qaranka. Dhanka kale, ammaanka ayaa loo adkeeyay, iyada oo degmooyinka ay ka dhacayaan doorashooyinka lagu soo rogay bandow, si loola socda dhaq-dhaqaaq guud, loona sugo amniga dadka ka qayb-gala doorashada. Si kastaba, Doorashadan ayaa iskugu jirto golaha Wakiillada oo ay ku tartamayaan 12 urur siyaasadeed oo ay iska soo sharraxeyn musharixiin gaareysa 369 musharax, kuwaas oo ku tartamaya 89 kursi, iyo golaha deegaanka, waxaana yaallada kuraas dhan 243 kursi oo ay ku tartamayaan 16 urur siyaasadeed, kuwaas ooay ka sharaxan yihiin illaa 924 musharax. items.title: Maxaa laga ogyahay shirka Kampala ee Soomaaliya?
items.description: Kampala (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Uganda ayaa martigelineysa shir-madaxeed aan caadi ahayn oo ay isugu imaanayaan dalalka ciidamada ku biiriyay howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya ee AUSSOM, xilli ay sii kordhayaan su’aalaha ku saabsan mustaqbalka howlgalka, maalgelintiisa iyo waajibaadka uu yeelan doono wixii ka dambeeya sannadka 2026. Shirkan oo soconaya muddo saddex maalmood ah ayaa looga hadlayaa sidii loo sii wadi lahaa dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya, iyadoo halku-dhiggiisu yahay “Sii wadidda geeddi-socodka xasillinta Soomaaliya.” Sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Difaaca Uganda, shirku wuxuu Arbacadii ku furmay kulan ay yeesheen taliyeyaasha ciidamada dalalka ka qeybgalaya, halka Khamiista maanta ah ay kulmi doonaan wasiirrada gaashaandhigga. Madaxda dalalka iyo dowladaha ayaa lagu wadaa inay kulankooda ugu sarreeya yeeshaan Jimcaha. Madax iyo wakiillo sare oo ka socda Burundi, Jabuuti, Masar, Itoobiya, Kenya, Soomaaliya iyo Uganda ayaa ka ka qeyb galaya shirka. Waxaa sidoo kale ka qeybgalaya mas’uuliyiin ka socda Midowga Afrika, Qaramada Midoobay iyo Urur-goboleedka IGAD. Shirkan ayaa ku soo aadaya xilli xasaasi ah oo ciidamada Soomaaliya, kuwa AUSSOM iyo saaxiibbada caalamiga ah ay sii wadaan howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, iyadoo dowladda federaalka ay isku diyaarineyso inay si buuxda ula wareegto masuuliyadda amniga dalka. Mustaqbalka howlgalka Mas’uuliyiinta Qaramada Midoobay ee la filayo inay shirka ka qeyb galaan waxaa ka mid ah ku-xigeenka xoghayaha guud ee howlgalada nabad-ilaalinta, ku-xigeenka wakiilka gaarka ah ee xoghayaha guud ee Soomaaliya iyo madaxa Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya ee UNSOS. Wafdiga Midowga Afrika waxaa hoggaaminaya guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Mahmoud Ali Youssouf. Waxaa sidoo kale ka mid ah guddiga Midowga Afrika u qaabilsan arrimaha siyaasadda, nabadda iyo ammaanka, iyo wakiilka gaarka ah ee guddoomiyaha Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, ahna madaxa AUSSOM, Danjire El Hadji Ibrahima Diene. IGAD ayaa dhankeeda waxaa shirka ku matalaya ku-xigeenka xoghayaha fulinta ururka. Dowladda Uganda ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ka hor shirka ku sheegtay inay ka go’an tahay taageeridda nabadda, ammaanka iyo xasilloonida gobolka, iyadoo la kaashaneysa Midowga Afrika, Qaramada Midoobay, IGAD iyo saaxiibbada kale ee caalamiga ah. “Dowladda Uganda waxay sharaf u aragtaa inay martigeliso kulankan muhiimka ah, waxayna mar kale xaqiijineysaa sida aan leexleexadka lahayn ee ay uga go’an tahay nabadda, ammaanka iyo xasilloonida gobolka,” ayuu yiri Colonel Chris Magezi, oo ah sii-hayaha agaasimaha warfaafinta ciidamada Uganda. Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa bishii December 2025 muddo sannad ah ku kordhiyay waajibaadka AUSSOM, isaga oo isla markaana ku baaqay in la sii taageero qorshaha Soomaaliya ay kula wareegeyso masuuliyadda buuxda ee amnigeeda. Hase yeeshee, weli waxaa taagan hubanti la’aan ku saabsan qaabka uu howlgalka u shaqeyn doono wixii ka dambeeya dhammaadka sannadkan, tirada iyo goobaha ciidamada la geynayo, iyo halka laga heli doono maalgelin joogto ah. Howlgallada Al-Shabaab Inkastoo Al-Shabaab ay weli fuliso weerarro ka dhaca qeybo ka mid ah Soomaaliya, mas’uuliyiinta dowladda ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa deegaanka ay sannadkii la soo dhaafay dib ula wareegeen deegaanno istaraatiiji ah. Dowladdu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in howlgallada lagu dilay hoggaamiyeyaal iyo dagaalyahanno ka tirsan kooxda, isla markaana adeegyada aasaasiga ah dib loogu celiyay qaar ka mid ah deegaannadii laga saaray Al-Shabaab. Adeegyada dib loo howlgeliyay waxaa ka mid ah xarumaha caafimaadka, iskuullada iyo waddooyinka isku xira deegaannada, inkastoo xaaladda amniga ay weli caqabado ka jiraan gobollo badan. Dadaallada militari waxaa taageeraya saaxiibbo caalami ah, iyadoo Turkiga uu door sii kordhaya ka qaadanayo tababarka ciidamada, iskaashiga amniga iyo dadaallada siyaasadeed ee lagu xoojinayo dowlad-dhiska Soomaaliya. Tan iyo horraantii bishan July, Ankara ayaa sidoo kale fududeysay wadahadallo u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, kuwaas oo looga gol leeyahay in lagu yareeyo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ka hor marxaladda xigta ee dowlad-dhiska iyo dib-u-habeynta amniga. Dhaqdhaqaaqyada diblomaasiyadeed ayaa sidoo kale ka socday xarunta Midowga Afrika. Isniintii, Danjire El Hadji Ibrahima Diene ayaa guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika warbixin ka siiyay fulinta waajibaadka AUSSOM iyo xaaladda guud ee amniga Soomaaliya. Falanqeeyayaasha ayaa sheegaya in madaxda ku kulmeysa Kampala ay xoogga saari doonaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa in dib looga laabto guulaha amni ee la gaaray, isla markaana loo dejin lahaa qorshe cad oo ku saabsan maalgelinta, qaab-dhismeedka ciidamada iyo habka kala-guurka ee howlgalka. Go’aannada kasoo baxa shirka ayaa la filayaa inay saameyn weyn ku yeeshaan marxaladda xigta ee howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, waxaana suuragal ah in laga diyaariyo talooyin loo gudbiyo Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka ee Midowga Afrika iyo Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. The post Maxaa laga ogyahay shirka Kampala ee Soomaaliya? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Dowladdu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in howlgallada lagu dilay hoggaamiyeyaal iyo dagaalyahanno ka tirsan kooxda, isla markaana adeegyada aasaasiga ah dib loogu celiyay qaar ka mid ah deegaannadii laga saaray Al-Shabaab. Adeegyada dib loo howlgeliyay waxaa ka mid ah xarumaha caafimaadka, iskuullada iyo waddooyinka isku xira deegaannada, inkastoo xaaladda amniga ay weli caqabado ka jiraan gobollo badan. Dadaallada militari waxaa taageeraya saaxiibbo caalami ah, iyadoo Turkiga uu door sii kordhaya ka qaadanayo tababarka ciidamada, iskaashiga amniga iyo dadaallada siyaasadeed ee lagu xoojinayo dowlad-dhiska Soomaaliya. Tan iyo horraantii bishan July, Ankara ayaa sidoo kale fududeysay wadahadallo u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, kuwaas oo looga gol leeyahay in lagu yareeyo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ka hor marxaladda xigta ee dowlad-dhiska iyo dib-u-habeynta amniga. Dhaqdhaqaaqyada diblomaasiyadeed ayaa sidoo kale ka socday xarunta Midowga Afrika. Isniintii, Danjire El Hadji Ibrahima Diene ayaa guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika warbixin ka siiyay fulinta waajibaadka AUSSOM iyo xaaladda guud ee amniga Soomaaliya. Falanqeeyayaasha ayaa sheegaya in madaxda ku kulmeysa Kampala ay xoogga saari doonaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa in dib looga laabto guulaha amni ee la gaaray, isla markaana loo dejin lahaa qorshe cad oo ku saabsan maalgelinta, qaab-dhismeedka ciidamada iyo habka kala-guurka ee howlgalka. Go’aannada kasoo baxa shirka ayaa la filayaa inay saameyn weyn ku yeeshaan marxaladda xigta ee howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, waxaana suuragal ah in laga diyaariyo talooyin loo gudbiyo Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka ee Midowga Afrika iyo Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. items.title: Ugu yaraan 5 askari oo ka tirsan militariga Kenya oo ku dhintay weerar gaadmo ah oo Al-Shabaab ay fuliyeen
items.description: Ugu yaraan shan askari oo ka tirsan ciidamada ammaanka Kenya ayaa lagu dilay weerar gaadmo ah oo ay kooxda Al-Shabaab ku qaaday degmada Mandera ee waqooyi-bari Kenya, meel u dhow xadka Soomaaliya. Sida ay sheegeen booliska Kenya, weerarka ayaa dhacay Talaadadii xilli cutub ka tirsan ciidamada howlgalka gaarka ah (Special Operations Group) ay roondo ka wadeen deegaanka Wantey Dam, oo qiyaastii lix kiiloomitir u jira saldhigga booliska ee Lafey. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in shanta askari ay ku dhinteen rasaastii weerarka bilowga ahayd. Intii gurmad loo dirayay goobta, gaari gaashaaman oo ay wateen ciidamadii gurmadka ahaa ayaa la kulmay miino waddada dhinaceeda lagu aasay, taas oo burburisay gaariga. Inkastoo gaariga uu burburay, saraakiishu waxay sheegeen inaan wax khasaare nafeed ah ka dhalan qaraxaasi. Kooxda Al-Shabaab ayaa warbaahinteeda ku sheegatay mas’uuliyadda weerarka, iyadoo sheegtay in uu fuliyay garabka hubeysan ee kooxda. Weerarkan ayaa noqonaya mid ka mid ah kuwii ugu khasaaraha badnaa ee toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay ka dhaca gobolka Mandera. Horraantii bishan, ciidamada Kenya ayaa sheegay inay dileen 11 dagaalyahan oo looga shakisan yahay Al-Shabaab kadib howlgal laga fuliyay deegaanka xadka ku dhow. Sidoo kale, 24-kii Luulyo waxaa weerarro lagu qaaday laba tuulo oo isla gobolkaas ku yaalla. Al-Shabaab, oo xiriir la leh ururka Al-Qaacida, ayaa muddo ku dhow labaatan sano dagaal kula jirtay dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, waxayna marar badan weerarro ka fulisay gudaha Kenya tan iyo markii ciidamada Kenya ay gudaha u galeen Soomaaliya sanadkii 2011. Weerarkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli hoggaamiyeyaasha dalalka ciidamadu ka joogaan howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya ay isku diyaarinayaan shir looga arrinsanayo mustaqbalka howlgalka, kadib markii Mareykanku uu ku dhawaaqay inuu dhimayo taageeradii saadka ee howlgalkaasi.

items.title: Iiraan oo Shiinaha ka heshay gantaallo wax weyn beddelaya
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Iran ayaa la filayaa inay toddobaadyada soo socda hesho shixnaddii ugu horreysay ee illaa 400 oo gantaallada difaaca cirka ah oo garabka laga rido, kuwaas oo lagu sameeyey Shiinaha, xilli Tehran ay dib u dhiseyso awooddeeda difaaca kaddib bilo dagaal ah oo ay la gashay Mareykanka iyo Israel. Saddex ilo-wareed oo xog-ogaal u ah heshiiska ayaa Reuters u sheegay in Iran ay dalbatay inta u dhexeysa 300 illaa 400 oo ah nidaamyada difaaca cirka ee la qaadan karo, kuwaas oo loo yaqaan MANPADS. Heshiiska oo lagu qiimeeyey $60 milyan illaa $70 milyan ayaa waxaa ku jira gantaallada noocyada QW-12 iyo FN-16, waxaana uu ka mid yahay dadaalladii ugu waaweynaa ee Tehran ku xoojineyso difaaceeda cirka ee masaafada gaaban tan iyo markii uu billowday dagaalka ay kula jirto Mareykanka iyo Israel. Dagaalka ayaa bannaanka soo dhigay daldaloolo waaweyn oo ka jira awoodda Iran ay ku difaaci karto xarumaheeda militariga, warshadaha hubka iyo kaabayaasha istaraatiijiga ah, kuwaas oo weerarro joogto ah kala kulmay diyaaradaha Mareykanka iyo Israel. Ilo-wareedyada ayaa sheegay in heshiiska lala saxiixday shirkadda Zhongqing Baoshang International Investment oo fadhigeedu yahay Hong Kong, taas oo dhex-dhexaadinaysay dhinaca Iran iyo shirkadda Shiinaha ee soo saareysa hubka. Wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Iran kama aysan jawaabin codsi loo diray oo ku saabsanaa inay faallo ka bixiso heshiiska. Shiinaha ayaa dhankiisa beeniyay warbixinta. “Wararka arrintan la xiriira gebi ahaanba waa kuwo aan sal iyo raad lahayn. Shiinuhu wuxuu si joogto ah door uga qaatay horumarinta nabadda iyo soo afjaridda colaadda,” ayay wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Shiinaha ku tiri bayaan. Shirkadda Zhong Qing Bao Shang Group, oo ah shirkadda iska leh Zhongqing Baoshang International Investment, ayaan sidoo kale ka jawaabin codsi faallo ah. Iran oo dib u hubeyneysa ciidamadeeda Iran ayaa baahi weyn u qabta inay dib u hubeyso ciidamadeeda kaddib bilo dagaal ah, oo Mareykanka iyo Israel ay ku garaaceen xarumo la xiriira barnaamijyada gantaallada, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo difaaca cirka. Tehran ayaa weerarradaas uga jawaabtay gantaallo ballistic ah iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo ay ku weerartay bartilmaameedyo la xiriira Mareykanka iyo Israel. Duqeymaha ayaa muujiyey dhibaatada Iran ka haysata difaacidda xarumaha militariga ee go’an, iyadoo ay la tacaaleyso diyaarado casri ah iyo hub si sax ah loo hago. Mareykanka ayaa Sabtidii si lama filaan ah u hakiyey duqeymo socday laba toddobaad, hase yeeshee Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in weerarradu dib u billaaban doonaan haddii wada-hadalladu ku guuldareystaan inay soo afjaraan dagaalka shanta bilood socda. Colaadda ayaa ku jirtay xaalad xabbad-joojin ah tan iyo bishii April, inkasta oo labada dhinac ay sii wadeen weerarro iyo hanjabaado militari. Helitaanka boqolaal gantaal oo garabka laga rido ayaa si weyn u kordhin kara kaydka hubka difaaca cirka ee Iran, gaar ahaan awoodda ay uga hortagi karto diyaaradaha joog hoose ku duula, helikobtarrada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya xiriirka militariga ee sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya Tehran iyo Beijing, inkasta oo dowladda Shiinaha ay si rasmi ah u beenisay inay hubkaas iibineyso. Ilo-wareedyada ayaa ka digay in inkasta oo heshiiska la saxiixay, haddana jadwalka keenista, tirada ugu dambeysa iyo faahfaahinta fulintiisa ay weli isbeddeli karaan. Pakistan oo beenisay inuu hubku sii marayo Sida uu dhigayo qorshaha ay dhinacyadu ku heshiiyeen, shixnadaha ugu horreeya ayaa diyaarad looga soo qaadi doonaa magaalada Urumqi ee galbeedka Shiinaha, kaddibna waxaa la sii marin doonaa Pakistan si loo gaarsiiyo Iran. Ilo-wareedyadu ma aysan caddeyn in hubka Pakistan looga sii qaadi doono diyaarad ama waddo dhulka ah. Militariga Pakistan ayaa si adag u beeniyay in dalkaasi qeyb ka yahay qorshe hubka Shiinaha lagu gaarsiinayo Iran. “Mala’awaalka sheegaya in Pakistan ay ku lug leedahay hubka difaaca cirka ee Shiinaha looga gudbinayo Iran waa been abuur aan waxba ka jirin,” ayey tiri waaxda warfaafinta militariga Pakistan ee ISPR. Wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Pakistan kama aysan jawaabin codsi faallo ah. Inkasta oo Iran labaatankii sano ee lasoo dhaafay maalgelin xooggan ku sameysay gantaallada, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo nidaamyada raadaarka, khubarada militariga ayaa sheegaya in gantaallada difaaca cirka ee la qaadan karo ay leeyihiin faa’iidooyin gaar ah. Hubkan waxaa si fudud u isticmaali kara kooxo yar, si dhaqso ah ayaa meel kale loogu wareejin karaa, waxaana adag in la ogaado ama la burburiyo marka loo eego nidaamyada waaweyn ee difaaca cirka ee hal goob lagu rakibo. Mas’uul amni oo Yurub ah ayaa sheegay in dowladdiisu ka warqabto dhowr heshiis oo laga wada hadlayo, kuwaas oo ku saabsan in Iran laga iibiyo gantaallada taxanaha QW, oo ay ku jiraan QW-12, QW-18 iyo QW-19. Ilo kale oo amni oo ku sugan Bariga Dhexe ayaa sheegay in Iran ay raadineysay gantaallada QW-12 iyo QW-18, balse uusan ogeyn in heshiis kama dambeys ah la gaaray. Gantaallada QW-12 iyo FN-16 ayaa ah hub garabka laga rido oo ku shaqeeya nidaam kulayl-raac ah, waxaana loogu talagalay inay bartilmaameedsadaan diyaaradaha joog hoose ku duula, helikobtarrada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Waxaa si degdeg ah loo geyn karaa hareeraha saldhigyada militariga, xarumaha tamarta iyo goobaha kale ee xasaasiga ah. Khubarada difaaca ayaa QW-12 u arka mid ka awood yar noocyada cusub ee QW-18 iyo QW-19, hase yeeshee waxay sheegayaan inuu weli bixin karo difaac wax ku ool ah oo looga hortago diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo bartilmaameedyada joog hoose ku socda. Laba ilo sirdoon oo reer Galbeed ah iyo mas’uul Iranian ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Tehran ay baartay suurta-galnimada in waddooyinka dhulka la mariyo hubka iyo qalabka Shiinaha, si qarsoodi ahna looga gudbiyo caqabadaha iyo weerarrada suurtagalka ah. Heshiiskan ayaa muujinaya sida Iran, inkasta oo ay muddo dheer saarnaayeen cunaqabateyn iyo xayiraado la xiriira hubka, ay weli isugu tiirsan tahay wax-soo-saarkeeda gudaha iyo hubka ay ka hesho dalal shisheeye. Reuters ayaa horey u sheegtay in Iran ay ku dhoweyd heshiis kale oo ay Shiinaha kaga iibsaneyso gantaallada lidka maraakiibta, inkasta oo aan la xaqiijin in heshiiskaas ugu dambeyn la dhammaystiray. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo lacago ku soo rogaya maraakiibta Badda Cas
items.description: Sanca (Caasimada Online) – Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa ka fiirsaneysa inay lacago ku soo rogto maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraya koonfurta Badda Cas, toddobaad kaddib markii ay ku dhawaaqday xannibaad badeed ka dhan ah Sacuudi Carabiya, sida ay sheegeen ilo-wareedyo gobolka ah oo arrintan xog-ogaal u ah. Qorshahan ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa inta badan maraakiibta isticmaasha marin-biyoodka ciriiriga ah ee Bab al-Mandab, kaas oo isku xira koonfurta Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, isla markaana ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ee ganacsiga iyo tamarta caalamka. Ilo-wareedyada ma aysan sheegin xilliga qorshahan la hirgelin karo, halka xafiiska warbaahinta Xuutiyiinta uusan ka jawaabin codsi ku saabsan inuu faallo ka bixiyo arrintan. Weerarradii Xuutiyiinta ee maraakiibta ganacsiga ayaa istaagay kaddib xabbad-joojintii Gaza ee bishii October ee sanadkii hore. Ugu yaraan hal markab oo shidaal oo Sacuudi ah ayaa toddobaadkii lasoo dhaafay lagu weeraray meel ka baxsan dekedda Jizan ee koonfurta Sacuudi Carabiya, una dhow xadka Yemen. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegtay mas’uuliyadda weerarkaas. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale horey loogu eedeeyay inay lacago ka qaadeen qaar ka mid ah shirkadaha maraakiibta ee isticmaala Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed intii ay socdeen weerarradii badda ee sanadkii 2024, iyaga oo taa beddelkeeda u ballan-qaadayay marin nabdoon. Lacagaha la sheegay in Xuutiyiintu qaadi jireen ayaa lagu qiyaasay inay gaareen $180 milyan bishii, inkasta oo tiradaas aan sidoo kale si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin. Marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab ayaa muhiim u ah ganacsiga u dhexeeya Aasiya, Bariga Dhexe iyo Yurub. Maraakiibta isticmaasha marin-biyoodkaas ayaa celcelis ahaan 16 maalmood ku gaara Aasiya, halka leexashada jidka dheer ee ku wareegsan koonfurta Afrika ay safarka gaarsiin karto illaa 50 maalmood. items.title: Dadka reer Galmudug oo dooranaya Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka
items.description: Dadka reer Galmudug ayaa Khamiistan u dareeraya goobaha codbixinta, si ay u soo doortaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Galmudug. Dad gaaraya 267,420 qof ayaa isku diiwaangeliyay in maanta oo ah maalinta codbixinta inay codkooda dhiibtaan, sida ku cad tira-koobkii u dambeeyay ee Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka uu shaaciyay Arbacadii. 11 magaalo oo ka kala tirsan Gobolada Galgaduud iyo Mudug ayaa laga qabanayaa doorashadan, oo ay ku tartamayaan in ka badan 10 Urur Siyaasadeed. Dadweynaha ayaa ka codeynaya goobaha codbixinta ee loogu diyaariyay Dhuusamareeb, Gaalkacyo, Hobyo, Balanballe, Cadaado, Caabudwaaq, Xeraale, Ceeldheer, Xarardheere, Guriceel iyo Masagawaa iyo weliba deegaanada qaar ee hoostaga magaalooyinkaasi. Doorashada oo loogu talagalay in hal maalin ay ku qabsoomto ayaa la sheegay in goobaha codbixinta la furi doono 6-da subaxnimo, lana soo xiri doono 6-da fiidnimo. Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka, Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan ayaa shacabka ugu baaqay in ay u soo baxaan doorashada oo codkoodana ay dhiibtaan. Ururada JSP iyo Towfiiq ayaa la qiyaasayaa in ay ku guuleysan doonaan kuraasta ugu badan ee Baarlamaanka iyo Golaha Deegaanka, waana suurtagal in qiyaasaha ay wax iska bedelaan. Kuraasta Baarlamaanka ee lagu tartamayo ayaa ah 89 kursi oo ay u taagan yihiin 369 musharax, halka kuraasta Golaha Deegaanka lagu sheegay 243 kursi oo ay ku tartamayaan 924 musharax. Musharaxiinta ayaana metelaya Ururada Siyaasadda. Dhanka kale laamaha amniga ayaa hakad geliyay isu socodka gaadiidka, waxaana la xiray Garoomada Diyaaradaha ee Galmudug. Cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Booliska iyo Nabad Sugidda Galmudug ayaa iska kaashanaya dadaalada lagu sugayo amniga. Doorashadan ayaa ah middii ugu horreysay ee toos ah ee laga qabto Gobolada Dhexe, ku dhawaad 58 sano ka dib. Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan, Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa maanta ku tilmaamay maalin taariikhi ah, isagoona ugu hambalyeeyay shacabka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan reer Galmudug.

items.title: Turkey’s New Armored Vehicles Arrive in Somalia as Political Questions Overshadow Military Cooperation
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – The appearance of Turkish-made ACV-15 armored infantry fighting vehicles on the frontlines in central Somalia has reignited a broader political debate over Ankara’s increasingly visible military role in the country, with critics questioning not the equipment itself but the timing of its deployment and the political context surrounding it. The armored vehicles were recently spotted in Sumadaale, a strategic area in the Middle Shabelle region that Somali government forces say they recaptured from Al-Shabaab during ongoing military operations. Images circulating from the battlefield show the tracked armored carriers transporting government troops as operations continue in the area. Turkish made ACV-15 armored vehicle The ACV-15, manufactured by FNSS Defence Systems of Türkiye, is one of the Turkish military industry’s best-known armored fighting vehicles. Designed to transport infantry safely through hostile environments, the vehicle carries between 10 and 13 soldiers while providing protection against heavy gunfire and artillery fragments. It can also be fitted with heavy machine guns or remotely operated weapon systems, making it a valuable asset in conventional military operations. Military analysts say the ACV-15 significantly enhances battlefield mobility and troop protection, particularly in difficult terrain where lightly armored vehicles are vulnerable to ambushes and improvised explosive devices. The deployment highlights the deepening defense partnership between Somalia and Türkiye. Over the past decade, Ankara has become one of Mogadishu’s closest security partners, providing military training, equipment, infrastructure, and advisory support. Turkish-backed units, including the elite Gorgor Commandos, have played increasingly prominent roles in operations against Al-Shabaab. However, while the Federal Government portrays Turkish military assistance as essential to defeating terrorism, the growing partnership has become politically contentious. Large segments of Somalia’s opposition, together with political leaders in Puntland and Jubaland, increasingly argue that Türkiye is no longer perceived as a neutral security partner. Instead, they contend that Ankara has become closely aligned with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration. That perception was reinforced, critics say, during the May military operation in South West State, when Turkish drones and technical military assistance were reportedly used in support of Federal Government forces during fighting that opponents describe as directed not against Al-Shabaab but against political rivals inside Somalia. Although neither Ankara nor Villa Somalia has accepted that characterization, the episode significantly altered how many opposition figures view Türkiye’s role. “The concern is no longer simply about military cooperation,” one opposition politician recently told WardheerNews. “It is about whether foreign military assistance is being used to influence Somalia’s internal political balance.” Timing Raises New Questions The arrival of additional Turkish armored vehicles comes at a particularly sensitive moment. Somalia remains locked in a deep political impasse over elections, constitutional legitimacy, and relations between the Federal Government and several Federal Member States. Critics argue that the delivery of heavy military equipment inevitably invites political scrutiny. In Puntland, where tensions between the regional administration and Mogadishu remain high, some political observers fear that the Federal Government could once again deploy military resources in ways that deepen domestic political confrontations rather than focus exclusively on counterterrorism operations. Those concerns have intensified amid allegations from Puntland officials and opposition groups that Villa Somalia is preparing measures aimed at increasing pressure on Puntland, Somalia’s most stable and secure Federal Member State. The Federal Government has consistently rejected such accusations, maintaining that all military deployments are directed solely toward defeating Al-Shabaab and strengthening national security. Few dispute Türkiye’s substantial contribution to rebuilding Somalia’s security forces. Since opening its military training facility in Mogadishu, Ankara has trained thousands of Somali soldiers, supplied military equipment, supported naval development, and expanded defense cooperation through a comprehensive bilateral security agreement. Yet analysts note that successful counterinsurgency campaigns depend not only on military capability but also on public confidence and political legitimacy. Where sections of the population believe foreign military assistance is being used in domestic political disputes, that perception—whether accurate or not—can undermine trust in both the government and its international partners. For many Somalis, the debate surrounding the ACV-15 is therefore less about the armored vehicles themselves than about how they may ultimately be employed. Will they remain focused on operations against Al-Shabaab, or could they become entangled in Somalia’s increasingly polarized internal politics? That question continues to shape public debate as Türkiye expands its military footprint in Somalia. While Ankara insists its support is intended to strengthen Somalia’s internationally recognized institutions and combat terrorism, many opposition figures and regional leaders remain unconvinced. In today’s Somalia, every new military shipment is no longer viewed solely through the lens of national security. Increasingly, it is also measured against the country’s unresolved political crisis—and the growing concern that military power, rather than political consensus, may determine Somalia’s future direction. In Puntland, where tensions between the regional administration and Mogadishu remain high, some political observers fear that the Federal Government could once again deploy military resources in ways that deepen domestic political confrontations rather than focus exclusively on counterterrorism operations. Those concerns have intensified amid allegations from Puntland officials and opposition groups that Villa Somalia is preparing measures aimed at increasing pressure on Puntland, Somalia’s most stable and secure Federal Member State. The Federal Government has consistently rejected such accusations, maintaining that all military deployments are directed solely toward defeating Al-Shabaab and strengthening national security. Few dispute Türkiye’s substantial contribution to rebuilding Somalia’s security forces. Since opening its military training facility in Mogadishu, Ankara has trained thousands of Somali soldiers, supplied military equipment, supported naval development, and expanded defense cooperation through a comprehensive bilateral security agreement. Yet analysts note that successful counterinsurgency campaigns depend not only on military capability but also on public confidence and political legitimacy. Where sections of the population believe foreign military assistance is being used in domestic political disputes, that perception—whether accurate or not—can undermine trust in both the government and its international partners. For many Somalis, the debate surrounding the ACV-15 is therefore less about the armored vehicles themselves than about how they may ultimately be employed. Will they remain focused on operations against Al-Shabaab, or could they become entangled in Somalia’s increasingly polarized internal politics? That question continues to shape public debate as Türkiye expands its military footprint in Somalia. While Ankara insists its support is intended to strengthen Somalia’s internationally recognized institutions and combat terrorism, many opposition figures and regional leaders remain unconvinced. In today’s Somalia, every new military shipment is no longer viewed solely through the lens of national security. Increasingly, it is also measured against the country’s unresolved political crisis—and the growing concern that military power, rather than political consensus, may determine Somalia’s future direction. items.title: Madaxweyne CIIN beertay
items.description: Madaxweyne CIIN beertay By Cabdillaahi Cawad Cige Madaxweyne Cirro golihiisa wasiirrada isaga ayaa keensaday. Qurux iyo foolxumo kay yeeshaan cid kale oo loo raacayaa ma jirto. Wasiirka caafimaadka ee maanta bukaanka cabashada la jalaadaya ku eedeeyay in la ga dambeeyaa, wuxu ka mid yahay xulka madaxweynuhu la soo baxay. Wasaaradda caafimaadka iyo shaqadeedu kaftan iyo siyaasad midna ma gasho. Caafimaadku waa mid ka mid ah baahiyaha aasaasiga ah ee ay tahay bulsho kasta in dawladdeedu isku daydo daboolisteeda. Waxa jiray ismaandhaaf dhexmaray wasiirka caafimaadka iyo agaasimihiisa oo dhan ah iyo wasiirkuxigeenkii hore ee caafimaadka. Wasiirkuxigeenku(Samsam Salah) waxay ahayd qofkii xoogga ku wadday ee dabada ka riixaysay dhaqangelintii Xeerka Caafimaadka Qaranka. Xeerkaasi waa ka u damaanadqaadaya bukaanka cabanaya in daryeelka caafimaadkooda ay helaan. Xeerkaas oo keli ah ma aha ee Samsam Maxamed Saalax waa qof xirfad iyo aqoon u leh caafimaadka bulshada, lexejeclo badan na u haysa dadkeeda, is la markaa na ay ka go’nayd inay isbeddel muuqda ku samayso hay’adaha caafimaadka ee dalkeeda. Si kale marka loo dhigo waa qofkii ugu habboonaa(xulka wasiirrada) ee noqon lahaa wasiirka caafimaadka. Ma dhicin taasi ee madaxweynuhu wuxu tixgeliyay arrimo kale, oo qabyaaladi kow ka tahay. Waxa dabadeed yimid iskudhac wasiirka iyo kuxigeenkiisa dhexmaray. Ismaandhaafkaas madaxweynuhu wuu ka garnaqay, wuxu na go’aansaday in kuxigeenku, qofkii aqoon iyo karti ba wasaaradda ugu habboonaa, fududdahay in booska la dhaafiyo. Madaxweynuhu wuxu beertay ciin, waa na kaas caawa haya midhihii u soo go’ay. Ha u qaadan in Samsam Maxamed Saalax mar keli ah ku dhammayn lahayd baahideenna caafimaad, xaasha, taasi waa hawl aad u adag. Mid se waa xaqiiq in aanay marna ba yeesheen, inay ku dheeldheesho bukaan cabasho u la yimid. Isbeddelku inuu daacad noqdo uun buu bulshada wax ugu tari karaa, haddii kale waa kud ka guur oo qanjo u guur.

items.title: The Stanley Cup puts professional ice hockey in a league of its own
items.description: True stories of a traveling trophy The Stanley Cup puts professional ice hockey in a league of its own By Susan Milligan   It has held champagne, breakfast cereal and even babies. It has been hoisted, hugged and almost kidnapped. It travels all over and has a team of chaperones to assure its safety. It’s the Stanley Cup, the trophy awarded to the National Hockey League championship team each year. This year, the Carolina Hurricanes, based in Raleigh, North Carolina, have won the coveted Cup, and the team is beginning a summer of passing the trophy from player to player. Unlike other national professional sports trophies, which are newly made and awarded to a new championship team to keep, there’s just one Stanley Cup. The champions in ice hockey only borrow the Stanley Cup for awhile, before it heads back to a vault in the Hockey Hall of Fame in Toronto. The players revere their brief turns to hold the Stanley Cup — the oldest trophy awarded to North American pro athletes. After the Cup was donated to Canada in 1892 by Sir Frederick Arthur Stanley, a British earl serving in Canada whose children loved ice hockey, the National Hockey League acquired it in 1910 to establish it as the award for League champions. Florida Panthers Matthew Tkachuk poses in front of the Gateway Arch in St. Louis, Missouri, during his time with the Stanley Cup in 2025. (Courtesy of the Florida Panthers) A sterling tradition Today, each winning player has his name stamped on one of the five rings that make up the barrel of the Cup. When there is no more room for players’ names, a ring is removed and sent to storage, and another one replaces it. No matter what mishaps or age-related stresses befall the silver-and-nickel trophy year after year, “they don’t create a new one,” says Hockey Hall of Fame official Kevin Shea, author of 21 books about hockey, including Travels with Stanley . “It’s got its dents and scratches. It’s a real living thing,” Shea says. If you watched the final playoff game in the championship, just after the final buzzer sounds, you would have seen Hurricanes players skating jubilantly around the rink, some carrying the massive and heavy — it’s 35 pounds (16 kilograms)! — Stanley Cup over their heads. Soon the real fun begins. A decadeslong tradition, which became official in 1995, dictates that each player and team staff member will get one day to have the Cup all to himself, celebrating in whatever way is special to him (without damaging the iconic trophy, of course). In earlier years, the winners have come up with some sterling ways to make the most of their day with the Cup. (State Dept./B. Insley) The ‘Keeper of the Cup’ From one tradition grew another. Today, there is a “Keeper of the Cup” who, along with some deputies, keeps an eye on the trophy through all of this. They move with the trophy during a roughly 100-day period when players and staff members each have their day with it. That all got started, according to the New York Rangers’ Neil Smith, when “one person took it, and the top came off. … And for some reason, somebody thought it would be wise to have an auto body guy weld it back on.” “It wasn’t me,” Smith quips. Keeper of the Cup Phil Pritchard (© Mark Blinch/Reuters) Since then, the keeper of the Cup — Phil Pritchard, vice president of the Hockey Hall of Fame — accompanies it wherever it goes. Pritchard and his helpers clean and polish the Stanley Cup at the end of each day before awarding it to the next player. Players get it from 6 a.m. to midnight, with veteran players getting first dibs on the schedule. It’s a special honor, notes Shea of the Hockey Hall of Fame, since ice hockey players, out of superstition, won’t touch the Cup unless and until they win the championship. How the Cup will enter the daily lives of 47 Hurricanes players and staff is yet to be seen. But it will connect them to champions from teams decades ago. That is what makes the tradition so inspiring, Smith says. “Ice hockey teaches you things you can’t get anywhere else. … Great values of sharing, of being in a group,” Smith says. And the Stanley Cup, every summer, joins the group. Susan Milligan is a freelance

items.title: Puntland Danab Commandos Warn of Escalating Internal Conflict
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — Puntland’s Danab Commando Force has issued an unusually forceful public statement warning that the region is on the brink of a dangerous internal conflict, cautioning that any renewed military confrontation—particularly against the Puntland Security Force (PSF)—could plunge Puntland into another round of destabilizing violence. The statement, released by the force’s leadership, reflects growing concern over rising tensions within Puntland’s security establishment following recent clashes involving the PSF and government forces. In the statement, the Danab Commandos accused Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni of steering the region toward internal conflict, alleging that his administration is once again preparing to use military force against fellow Puntland security personnel rather than pursuing dialogue. According to the command, reports suggesting the possibility of renewed attacks against the PSF have heightened fears of another armed confrontation. “We strongly warn against the outbreak of war in Puntland and against any unjustified military assault on the Puntland Security Force (PSF),” the statement said. The command accused President Deni of fueling political divisions that risk escalating into armed conflict, arguing that Puntland has already experienced several similar crises under his leadership. “This would be the fourth time such internal conflicts have occurred in Puntland, with state security forces being turned against one another,” the statement claimed. The Danab leadership stressed that the current crisis is not the result of an external threat or foreign aggression, but rather a political dispute among Puntland’s own leadership. “There is no outside force invading Puntland,” the statement asserted. “The conflict is political in nature and is rooted in disagreements among the people of Puntland.” The statement went further, alleging that the underlying dispute centers on what it described as “authoritarian rule and the monopolization of power by President Said Deni’s family”—language that underscores the depth of political polarization gripping Puntland. The command also accused President Deni of treating political dissent as a security threat. According to the statement, anyone expressing views that differ from those of the administration increasingly risks becoming a target, while Puntland is being transformed into a political environment where only one viewpoint is tolerated. The Danab Commandos appealed directly to Puntland’s political leaders, security institutions, and the wider public to prevent further bloodshed among forces drawn from the same communities. “We call on all Puntland stakeholders to prevent the shedding of Puntland soldiers’ blood and to stop efforts aimed at pitting Puntland’s security forces against one another,” the statement said. In one of its strongest assertions, the force declared that President Deni would bear full responsibility for any future outbreak of armed conflict within Puntland. “The responsibility for initiating any war or civil conflict in Puntland will rest entirely with President Said Abdullahi Deni,” the statement concluded. The warning comes at a particularly sensitive moment following recent fighting involving the PSF, whose legal and institutional status has become increasingly contested amid broader political disagreements within Puntland. The statement also highlights growing strains within Puntland’s own security institutions, raising fresh concerns that unresolved political disputes could increasingly spill over into military confrontations. Puntland authorities had not publicly responded to the allegations contained in the Danab statement at the time of publication. The unusually direct criticism from an elite security unit underscores the seriousness of the current political and security climate. As tensions continue to rise, observers warn that preventing further escalation will require political dialogue and restraint rather than military confrontation if Puntland is to avoid another potentially destabilizing internal conflict. items.title: Sen. Cruz Sends Letter Urging Region-Specific Travel Advisory for Somaliland
items.description: Published: 07.29.2026 Sen. Cruz Sends Letter Urging Region-Specific Travel Advisory for Somaliland WASHINGTON, D.C. – U.S. Sen. Ted Cruz (R-Texas), Chairman of the Senate Foreign Relations Subcommittee on Africa and Global Health Policy, sent a letter to Secretary of State Marco Rubio urging the U.S. Department of State to establish a region-specific Travel Advisory that distinguishes Somaliland from Somalia. Below are highlights and excerpts from the letter: “The Department currently maintains a Level 4 “Do Not Travel” advisory for Somalia that applies equally to Somaliland. The Department’s website warns Americans not to travel to Somalia because of “crime, kidnapping, terrorism, unrest, health, landmines, systematic mistreatment of women, systematic mistreatment of gay and lesbian individuals, piracy, abuse of residents in rehabilitation centers, and confiscation of passports by family members.” That assessment does not reflect the reality on the ground in Somaliland. “Somaliland has functioned as a stable, self-governing, democratic nation for nearly three decades. Since 2003, it has held multiple peaceful, competitive elections and democratic transfers of power. Somaliland is also a reliable security and diplomatic partner for the United States that advance American interests in the Horn of Africa and beyond. “The current advisory is inaccurate and counterproductive to U.S. national security interests. Americans deserve travel guidance that reflects the conditions on the ground, rather than a onesize-fits-all assessment that fails to distinguish Somaliland’s peaceful governance and security environment from conditions elsewhere in Somalia. “I urge you to promptly direct Diplomatic Security to conduct a tiered assessment of Somalia and establish a separate, region-specific Travel Advisory for Somaliland. Doing so would provide Americans with more accurate travel guidance while supporting robust engagement with one of our most dependable partners in the Horn of Africa.” Click here to read the full letter. BACKGROUND: In August 2025 , Sen. Cruz sent a letter to President Trump urging the administration to formally recognize the Republic of Somaliland as an independent state.

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidamada Mareykanka ee AFRICOM oo booqasho ku yimid Muqdisho
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa gelinkii dambe ee maanta Magaalada Muqdisho kula kulmay Taliyaha Ciidamada Mareykanka ee Qaaradda Afrika (AFRICOM), General Dagvin Anderson oo booqasho ku yimid dalka. Labada dhinac ayaa yeeshay kulan la xiriira taageerada hawlgalada ka dhanka ah argagixisada iyo dardargelinta wada-shaqaynta u dhaxeysa Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa AFRICOM, sida lagu sheegay war ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga Somaliya. “Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray taageerada hawlgalada ka dhanka ah argagixisada iyo dardargelinta wada-shaqeynta u dhaxeysa Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo AFRICOM.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ayaa sheegtay in sidoo kale kulanka looga hadlay diyaargarowga guluf ballaaran oo lagu ciribtirayo argagixisada, ayna Dowladda Mareykanka dib u xaqiijisay sii wadidda taageerada Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. “Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay diyaar-garowga gulufka ballaaran ee lagu ciribtirayo argagixisada, iyadoo Dowladda Mareykanku ay dib u xaqiijisay sida ay uga go’an tahay sii wadidda taageerada ay siiso Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dhinacyada hawlgalada iyo la dagaalanka argagixisada.” Ayaa lagu sheegay warka. Mareykanka ayaa Dowladda Somaliya ka taageera tababarka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, gaar ahaan Kumaandooska Danab, qalabayntooda iyo hawlgalada hawada ee ka dhanka ah maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Ciidanka Danab oo u tababaran la dagaalanka argagixisada ayaa fuliya weerarada qorsheysan ee lagu bartilmaameedsado Shabaabka, iyagoona ka qayb qaata hawlgalada dib u xoreynta dalka. Taageerada Mareykanka ayaa muhiim u ah dagaalka lagu la jiro Al Shabaab, oo Washington ay u aragto khatarta ugu weyn ee xilligan ka jirta Afrika.

Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ayaa sheegtay in sidoo kale kulanka looga hadlay diyaargarowga guluf ballaaran oo lagu ciribtirayo argagixisada, ayna Dowladda Mareykanka dib u xaqiijisay sii wadidda taageerada Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. “Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay diyaar-garowga gulufka ballaaran ee lagu ciribtirayo argagixisada, iyadoo Dowladda Mareykanku ay dib u xaqiijisay sida ay uga go’an tahay sii wadidda taageerada ay siiso Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dhinacyada hawlgalada iyo la dagaalanka argagixisada.” Ayaa lagu sheegay warka. Mareykanka ayaa Dowladda Somaliya ka taageera tababarka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, gaar ahaan Kumaandooska Danab, qalabayntooda iyo hawlgalada hawada ee ka dhanka ah maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Ciidanka Danab oo u tababaran la dagaalanka argagixisada ayaa fuliya weerarada qorsheysan ee lagu bartilmaameedsado Shabaabka, iyagoona ka qayb qaata hawlgalada dib u xoreynta dalka. Taageerada Mareykanka ayaa muhiim u ah dagaalka lagu la jiro Al Shabaab, oo Washington ay u aragto khatarta ugu weyn ee xilligan ka jirta Afrika.

items.title: Muxuu Xasan Sheekh kusoo arkay dekedda Muqdisho? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta kormeer shaqo ku tagay dekedda caalamiga ah ee magaalada Muqdisho, halkaasi oo uu ugu kuurgalay horumarka ka socda kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee dalka iyo qorshayaasha lagu casriyeynayo adeegyada dekedda. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa soo indha indheeyay xarumaha kaydka Shidaalka dekedda, bakhaarada iyo dhismaha cusub ee xafiisyada maamulka dekedda magaalada Muqdisho. Xasan Sheekh ayaa xog ogaal u noqday dadaalada dib u habeynta iyo casriyeynta xarumaha muhiimka ah ee dowladda iyo kor u qaadista tayada adeegyada ay helaan shacabka iyo ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha ayaa kormeerka kaddib, kulan muhiim ah la qaatay wasiirka dekedaha iyo gaadiidka badda iyo maareeyaha guud ee dekedda Muqdisho oo uu ka dhageystay warbixin faah-faahsan oo ku saabsan xaaladda guud ee dekedda. Xasan ayaa indhaha saaray horumarka laga gaaray mashaariicda socda iyo qorshaha dhismaha dekedda cusub ee Muqdisho oo loogu talagalay in ay daboosho dhammaan baahida dakadeed ee caasimadda, isla markaana kor loo qaaddo awoodda ay u leedahay la tacaalidda kororka ganacsiga iyo koboca dhaqaalaha dalka. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa adkeeyey in horumarinta dekedaha ay laf-dhabar u tahay kobaca dhaqaalaha dalka, kor u qaadista ganacsiga, abuurista fursado shaqo iyo xoojinta isku xirka dalka iyo suuqyada caalamka. Ugu dambeyntiina, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa kula dardaarmay masuuliyiinta wasaaradda iyo maamulka dekedda in ay laba jibaaraan dadaallada lagu horumarinayo adeegyada dekedda. The post Muxuu Xasan Sheekh kusoo arkay dekedda Muqdisho? + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: The U.S. Should Embrace Somaliland to Break Iranian and the Houthi Trade Chokeholds
items.description: While Somaliland is entirely Muslim, it is anti-Islamist not only in rhetoric but also in deed. While terrorism is a weekly feature of life in Mogadishu, Somalia, there has not been a terrorist attack in Somaliland in almost 20 years. Shutterstock HARGEISA, Somaliland — The desire to embrace cause-and-effect rationality to blame President Donald Trump for Iran’s ongoing aggression gets two things wrong. First, the notion that the Islamic Republic would remain cautious and restrained had the United States and Israel not killed supreme leader Ali Khamenei on the first day of Operation Epic Fury ignores Khamenei’s age: The ayatollah was 86 years old and faced multiple health crises. Trump’s critics ignore that the eventual succession to his son Mojtaba Khamenei would likely have remained the same. Second, Trump’s critics say the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps’ closure of the Strait of Hormuz is a direct result of U.S. action, but, before the Iran war erupted and Tehran began seeking to impose tolls to pass through the strait, the Islamic Republic and its proxy Houthi militia were already testing the strategy in the Bab el-Mandeb, the narrow passage that connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden. As Yemen’s southern forces pointed out during a visit to Aden a year ago, the Houthis maintained an invisible line in the Gulf of Aden. With the help of Iranian spy ships and Russian satellites, the Houthis would demand payment for any ship that traversed the line on its way to the Red Sea. If they failed to pay up, they could expect drones, missiles, or mines to interrupt their passage. While American politicians, partisans, and the press prefer to play the blame game, the fact remains: Iran is blocking the Strait of Hormuz. The Houthis are threatening the Bab el-Mandeb and striking shipping in the Red Sea, and simply walking away will not resolve the problem. To make a World War II analogy, the United States lost the Battle of Bataan in 1942, and the Japanese then humiliated the U.S., killing over 10,000 more during the Bataan Death March. Fortunately, President Franklin D. Roosevelt did not face critics who sought to pillory him for challenging the Japanese. Returning home in 1942 may have cut losses, but it would have resulted in a far different world. If Trump means to win the war against Iran and the Houthis to restore freedom of navigation through the world’s choke points, it is time to bring the State Department into line. While Secretary of State Marco Rubio doubles down on Hillary Clinton’s Somalia policy, there simply is no way to win the war without Somaliland. Clinton doubled down on Somalia following the killing of U.S. Ambassador Chris Stevens in Libya, especially as critics began questioning whether she had any achievements to show. While Somaliland was briefly independent in 1960, it walked away from its union with the rest of Somalia in 1991. While Somalia descended into chaos and warlordism, Somaliland embraced democracy and remained open for business. While Somalia then tilted toward China and Turkey, Somaliland aligned itself with Taiwan and Israel. Somaliland may not be wealthy, but it is unapologetically pro-American. And while Somaliland is entirely Muslim , it is anti-Islamist not only in rhetoric but also in deed. While terrorism is a weekly feature of life in Mogadishu, there has not been a terrorist attack in Somaliland in almost 20 years. Given Somaliland’s preference for investment over aid and its rich, rare-earth reserves, embracing Somaliland could reap American companies windfall profits. The State Department’s reading of history is inconsistent. While Clinton and Rubio justify inaction on the supposed inviolability of borders, they ignore the long history of failed federations returning to their constituent parts: Czechoslovakia, the United Arab Republic that briefly united Egypt and Syria, Senegambia, and the Soviet Union. Given Somalia’s failure, forcing Somaliland’s subordination to it would be like forcing Texas into Mexico’s control or accepting Russia’s claims to Ukraine. The reason why Somaliland is crucial to winning the war is its strategic geography. It has a 530-mile coastline on the Strait of Hormuz. Its deepwater port at Berbera and neighboring airfield are both recently renovated and among Africa’s best-equipped. Running anti-piracy, anti-Houthi operations from Berbera could keep the Bab el-Mandeb. The port could also help resupply U.S. Navy ships at sea closer to Hormuz. Given Somaliland’s preference for investment over aid and its rich, rare-earth reserves, embracing Somaliland could reap American companies windfall profits. Rubio may default to State Department groupthink, but that has never won a war. Embracing Somaliland will. Michael Rubin Michael Rubin specializes in Iran, Turkey and the Horn of Africa. His career includes time as a Pentagon official, with field experiences in Iran, Yemen, and Iraq, as well as engagements with the Taliban prior to 9/11. Mr. Rubin has also contributed to military education, teaching U.S. Navy and Marine units about regional conflicts and terrorism. His scholarly work includes several key publications, such as “Dancing with the Devil” and “Eternal Iran.” Rubin earned his Ph.D. and M.A. in history and a B.S. in biology from Yale University.
