items.title: Shirkii golaha wasiiradda Somaliland iyo waxyaabahii lagaga wadahadlay
items.description: Fadhigii 70-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada Jammhuuriyadda Somaliland oo uu Shir-gudoominayey Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), isla markaana uu wehelinayey Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi, ayaa waxa lagaga wada hadlay qodobbada soo socda: 𝟏. 𝐃𝐨𝐨𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐀𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐒𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐐𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐧 𝐞𝐞 𝐂𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐟𝐤𝐚 𝐗𝐨𝐨𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa dood qoto dheer ka yeeshay Siyaasadda Qaran ee Calafka Xoolaha, iyaga oo falanqeeyey muhiimadda ay Siyaasaddani u leedahay sugnaanta calafka Xoolaha, horumarinta wax-soo-saarka Xoolaha, iyo xoojinta adkaysiga bulshada reer miyiga ah ee la xidhiidha saamaynta Abaaraha iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada. Siyaasaddan ayaa dejinaysa hannaan Qaran oo lagu horumarinayo soo saarista, kaydinta, tayaynta iyo maaraynta calafka Xoolaha, iyada oo la dhiirrigelinayo maalgashiga, cilmi-baadhista, iyo iskaashiga Hay’adaha Dawladda, ganacsiga gaarka loo leeyahay iyo bulshada. Dood iyo falanqayn dheer kaddib, Golaha Wasiirrada JSL ayaa si buuxda oo aan loo kala hadhin cod gacan taag ah ku ansixiyey Siyaasadda Qaran ee Calafka Xoolaha, taasi oo laf-dhabar u noqon doonta horumarinta iyo tayeynta nolosha Xoolaha oo ah Tiirka ugu muhiimsan ee dhaqaalaha Qaranka JSL. 𝟐. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐀𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka JSL, Mudane Cabdalle Maxamed Carab ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey xaaladda guud ee amniga dalka, isaga oo xaqiijiyey in amniga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland uu yahay mid sugan, isla markaana dhammaan Gobollada dalka ay ka jirto nabad iyo xasillooni buuxda. Sidoo kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha la wadaagay in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka iyo Wasaaradda Tamarta iyo Macdantu ay si wadajir ah u dejiyeen hannaan lagu adkaynayo amniga, xasilloonida iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada ee goobaha khayraadka dabiiciga ah, si gaar ah meelaha laga baadho lagana soo saaro dahabka iyo macdanaha kale, iyada oo mudnaanta la siinayo ilaalinta danaha guud ee Qaranka iyo nabadda bulshada. 𝟑. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐃𝐡𝐚𝐪𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha JSL, Mudane Cabdilaahi Xasan Aadan ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey xaaladda guud ee dhaqaalaha dalka, saamaynta ay colaadaha Bariga Dhexe ku yeesheen dakhliga Qaranka, korodhka qiimaha shidaalka iyo maciishadda, taasoo saamayn toos ah ku yeelatay nolosha bulshada. Dhinaca kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha uga xog-warramay halka ay marayso diyaarinta Miisaaniyadda Qaranka ee sannadka 2027-ka, isaga oo xusay in mudnaanta la siinayo xoojinta dakhliga gudaha, adkaynta maamulka-maaliyadeed, ilaalinta xasilloonida dhaqaalaha, iyo dejinta miisaaniyad ku salaysan mudnaanaha horumarineed ee uu leeyahay Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. 𝟒. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐇𝐚𝐰𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐖𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐈𝐬𝐠𝐚𝐚𝐝𝐡𝐬𝐢𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐓𝐞𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐨𝐥𝐚𝐣𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 Wasiirka Wasaaradda Isgaadhsiinta iyo Teknoolajiyadda JSL, Mudane Dr. Cabdisalaan Xuseen Cawaale ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland u guurto nidaamka casriga ah ee Digitalization, si ay ula jaanqaaddo horumarka teknoolajiyadeed ee haatan dunidu ku tallaabsatay. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha u sharraxay in qorshahani yahay hannaan Qaran oo dardar-gelinaya hufnaanta adeegyada Dawladda, kobcinta dhaqaalaha Dijitalka ah iyo horumarinta aqoonta, isaga oo Golaha ku boorriyey in arrintan loo aqoonsado Qorshe Qaran oo istaraatiji ah oo laf-dhabar u noqonaya horumarka iyo casriyeynta adeegyada Qaranka ee nidaamka Dijitalka ah. 𝟓. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐅𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐇𝐨𝐫𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐊𝐮𝐛𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐠𝐭𝐚 𝐞𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiir ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha, Mudane Yuusuf Nuux Yuusuf (Tadhase) ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin qoto dheer ka siiyey Furitaanka Horyaalka Kubadda Cagta ee Gobollada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isaga oo xusay in tartankani yahay madal muhiim u ah horumarinta hibada dhallinyarada, xoojinta midnimada bulshada, iyo dhiirrigelinta is-dhexgalka bulshada ee Gobollada dalka. Waxa uu tilmaamay in Wasaaraddu dhamaystirtay diyaar-garowgii lagama maarmaanka ahaa si Horyaalku ugu qabsoomo jawi hufan oo waafaqsan qorshaha horumarinta Ciyaaraha Qaranka. Wasiir ku-xigeenku waxa kale oo uu Golaha la wadaagay in 14.08.2026-ka ay Somaliland marti gelin doonto Oroddada Mahratoonka, kaasi oo sannadkan ay ka soo qayb geli doonaan Waddamo badan. 𝟔. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐖𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐗𝐢𝐝𝐡𝐢𝐢𝐝𝐡𝐤𝐚 𝐆𝐨𝐥𝐞𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐀𝐫𝐫𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Xidhiidhka Goleyaasha iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka, Mudane Axmed Aw Dahir X. Xasan ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada la wadaagay warbixin la xidhiidha waxqabadka Wasaaradda, gaar ahaan xoojinta xidhiidhka Hay’adaha Dastuuriga ah, horumarinta nidaamka sharci-dejinta iyo la socodka hirgelinta arrimaha Dastuurka. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in Wasaaraddiisu ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso tayeynta Hay’adaha Qaranka iyo adkaynta Tiirarka Dawladnimada, dib-u-habaynta Xeerarka iyo Shuruucda Qaranka ee weli qabyada ah, kobcinta Waddaniyadda, fahamka bulshada ee Dastuurka Qaranka iyo Xeerarka ka farcama, kor u qaadista ka-qayb-galka muwaadiniinta JSL ee nidaamka dawladnimada iyo hannaanka dimuqraadiyadda. 𝟕. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐖𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐀𝐫𝐫𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐢𝐛𝐞𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐈𝐬𝐤𝐚𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐠𝐚: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibedda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Daahir Aadan ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada la wadaagay warbixin guud oo la xidhiidha hab-sami-u-socodka iyo horumarka laga gaadhay Siyaasadda Arrimaha Dibedda, dedaalladii ugu dambeeyey ee aqoonsi raadiska iyo xoojinta xidhiidhada diblomaasiyadeed ee ay Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland la leedahay Beesha Caalamka. Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in xilligan ay sii kordheen dadka iyo dalalka ka xun jiritaanka iyo Qarannimada JSL, sidaa darteedna ay lagama maarmaan tahay in aynu noqonno Qaran leh hal cod iyo hal ujeeddo oo heegan ugu jira difaaca danaha iyo Qarannimada
items.fullContent: Fadhigii 70-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada Jammhuuriyadda Somaliland oo uu Shir-gudoominayey Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), isla markaana uu wehelinayey Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi, ayaa waxa lagaga wada hadlay qodobbada soo socda: 𝟏. 𝐃𝐨𝐨𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐀𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐒𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐐𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐧 𝐞𝐞 𝐂𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐟𝐤𝐚 𝐗𝐨𝐨𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa dood qoto dheer ka yeeshay Siyaasadda Qaran ee Calafka Xoolaha, iyaga oo falanqeeyey muhiimadda ay Siyaasaddani u leedahay sugnaanta calafka Xoolaha, horumarinta wax-soo-saarka Xoolaha, iyo xoojinta adkaysiga bulshada reer miyiga ah ee la xidhiidha saamaynta Abaaraha iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada. Siyaasaddan ayaa dejinaysa hannaan Qaran oo lagu horumarinayo soo saarista, kaydinta, tayaynta iyo maaraynta calafka Xoolaha, iyada oo la dhiirrigelinayo maalgashiga, cilmi-baadhista, iyo iskaashiga Hay’adaha Dawladda, ganacsiga gaarka loo leeyahay iyo bulshada. Dood iyo falanqayn dheer kaddib, Golaha Wasiirrada JSL ayaa si buuxda oo aan loo kala hadhin cod gacan taag ah ku ansixiyey Siyaasadda Qaran ee Calafka Xoolaha, taasi oo laf-dhabar u noqon doonta horumarinta iyo tayeynta nolosha Xoolaha oo ah Tiirka ugu muhiimsan ee dhaqaalaha Qaranka JSL. 𝟐. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐀𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka JSL, Mudane Cabdalle Maxamed Carab ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey xaaladda guud ee amniga dalka, isaga oo xaqiijiyey in amniga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland uu yahay mid sugan, isla markaana dhammaan Gobollada dalka ay ka jirto nabad iyo xasillooni buuxda. Sidoo kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha la wadaagay in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka iyo Wasaaradda Tamarta iyo Macdantu ay si wadajir ah u dejiyeen hannaan lagu adkaynayo amniga, xasilloonida iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada ee goobaha khayraadka dabiiciga ah, si gaar ah meelaha laga baadho lagana soo saaro dahabka iyo macdanaha kale, iyada oo mudnaanta la siinayo ilaalinta danaha guud ee Qaranka iyo nabadda bulshada. 𝟑. Dhinaca kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha uga xog-warramay halka ay marayso diyaarinta Miisaaniyadda Qaranka ee sannadka 2027-ka, isaga oo xusay in mudnaanta la siinayo xoojinta dakhliga gudaha, adkaynta maamulka-maaliyadeed, ilaalinta xasilloonida dhaqaalaha, iyo dejinta miisaaniyad ku salaysan mudnaanaha horumarineed ee uu leeyahay Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. 𝟒. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐇𝐚𝐰𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐖𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐈𝐬𝐠𝐚𝐚𝐝𝐡𝐬𝐢𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐓𝐞𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐨𝐥𝐚𝐣𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 Wasiirka Wasaaradda Isgaadhsiinta iyo Teknoolajiyadda JSL, Mudane Dr. Cabdisalaan Xuseen Cawaale ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland u guurto nidaamka casriga ah ee Digitalization, si ay ula jaanqaaddo horumarka teknoolajiyadeed ee haatan dunidu ku tallaabsatay. items.title: Golaha Mustaqbalka oo caawa ku dhawaaqay in Soomaaliya ay gashay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed oo caawa shir jaraa’id ku qabtay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa ku dhawaaqay in dalka uu u baahan yahay badbaado qaran, uuna haatan galay xaalad halis ah, sida ay sheegeen. Golaha ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku eedeeyay inuu god dheer ku riday Soomaaliya, isla markaana uu dalka ku sii hayo sharci-darro, iyagoo bulshada Soomaaliyeed ugu baaqay inay u istaagaan badbaadada dalka. “Waxaan u arkaa xilliga hadda la joogo, iyadoo muddo-xileedkii dowladda uu dhammaaday, doorasho heshiis lagu yahayna aysan dalka ka jirin, inay tahay nasiib-darro. Bani’aadamku wuxuu wax ka bartaa wixii hore, in meeshii la joogi jiray maalin walba la taagnaado waxay dhaawac ku tahay dadka Soomaaliyeed iyo adduunkaba,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed. Shariifka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Soomaaliya ay haatan gashay marxaladdii Afghanistan oo kale, ayna weliba ka sii liidato, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Lacagta Soomaaliya lagu bixinayay iyo tan Afghanistan lagu bixinayay iskuma dhowa. Sidan oo kale madaxweynihii markaas joogay waxaa laga kari waayay war dadka la heshii. Laba ciladood oo waaweyn oo Afghanistan u duntay ayaa Soomaaliya ka jira, kuwaas oo ahaa heshiis la’aan iyo musuq-maasuq, waxaana u maleynayaa inaan musuqa ka badanahay.” Sidoo kale, Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Xasan Cali Kheyre oo ka hadlay shirka jaraa’id ayaa si weyn u weeraray Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isagoo sheegay in dalka uu ku wado xaalad dib ugu celinaysa burburkii. “Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Beesha Caalamka halis ayuu ku jiraa. Kaalmadii ciidamada Afrikaanka ah ee dalka jooga iyo tii Ciidanka sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Danab waa la jartay, sababo la xiriira hubanti la’aanta dowladda waqtigeedu dhammaaday dalka u horseedday,” ayuu yiri. items.title: Emergency Uganda AUSSOM summit opens as U.S. funding threat puts Somalia mission at risk
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Countries contributing troops and police to the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) convened an extraordinary summit in Uganda’s capital, Kampala, on Wednesday to discuss urgent measures aimed at preventing the mission from sliding toward a potential crisis after the United States threatened to end its support for continued United Nations logistical assistance beyond December. The emergency meeting opened at Speke Resort Munyonyo under the theme, “To Sustain the Stabilization Process in Somalia,” bringing together representatives from AUSSOM troop- and police-contributing countries — Uganda, Kenya, Burundi, Djibouti, Ethiopia, Egypt and Somalia, the host nation of the multinational mission. Senior officials from the United Nations, including the UN Department of Peace Operations (DPO) and the United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS), the African Union Commission and the Intergovernmental Authority on Development (IGAD) are also participating in the summit. The three-day Uganda summit is being held in stages. Chiefs of Defence Forces met on Wednesday, defence ministers are scheduled to meet on Thursday, July 30, while heads of state and government from AUSSOM troop-contributing countries will conclude the summit on Friday, July 31. The Kampala summit is expected to review the prevailing security situation in Somalia, evaluate AUSSOM’s operational performance and transition process, and discuss funding, logistics and long-term strategies aimed at sustaining regional stability in the Horn of Africa. The meeting comes amid mounting concern over the future of the African Union mission after Washington threatened to discontinue support for continued UN logistical assistance beyond December. Troop-contributing countries and Somali officials have warned that such a move could place AUSSOM under severe strain. UN logistical support has long served as the operational backbone of AUSSOM, enabling the mission to sustain its operations across Somalia. For nearly two decades, the African Union mission has remained the principal bulwark against the Al-Shabaab militant group, which continues to wage an insurgency with the stated objective of overthrowing Somalia’s Western-backed federal government in Mogadishu. Former Somali National Security Advisor Hussein Sheikh, who worked with the current administration for years, said he does not know how Somali security forces would sustain the security gains achieved over the years if AUSSOM were to draw down completely. He warned that such a scenario raises fears that Al-Shabaab could mount a significant comeback and regain control of large parts of south and central Somalia. The summit also takes place against the backdrop of Somalia’s escalating political crisis, with elections delayed and the constitutional terms of both the federal government and parliament having expired months ago. Earlier this week, Somalia’s opposition appealed to leaders attending the Kampala summit to support the establishment of an inclusive national transitional council to help resolve the political impasse, steer the country toward elections and oversee a peaceful transfer of power. The opposition argues that such a transitional arrangement is the only viable path to prevent what it describes as the potential collapse of a Somali state rebuilt over the past two decades with the support of Western taxpayer funds and the sacrifices of African troop-contributing countries. items.title: Puntland and Galmudug Security Chiefs Unite in Galkacyo as Leaders Push Dialogue Over Escalation
items.description: Galkacyo (WDN) – Senior security officials from Puntland and Galmudug met in Gaalkacyo on Tuesday in a significant show of cooperation, reinforcing calls for restraint and dialogue at a time of growing tensions fueled by the deployment of additional Federal Government forces near Puntland. The joint meeting, held at the Puntland Presidency in Mudug, brought together senior officials from both regional administrations to discuss ways of strengthening security coordination, preserving stability, and preventing any deterioration of the fragile peace that has prevailed along one of Somalia’s most sensitive regional boundaries. The meeting was co-chaired by Puntland’s Deputy Minister of Security, Abdirahman Yusuf Dujaana, and Galmudug’s Minister of Security, Adan Warsame Ilmi. It was attended by ministers, regional administrators, district commissioners, and senior security officials from both sides. According to officials, discussions focused on enhancing joint security cooperation, improving communication between the two administrations, and ensuring that Mudug remains insulated from the broader political disputes unfolding elsewhere in Somalia. Following the talks, the delegations made a symbolic walk across both sides of Gaalkacyo—a city divided administratively between Puntland and Galmudug but whose residents have spent years rebuilding trust after repeated cycles of violence. The gesture was widely interpreted as a public affirmation that both administrations remain committed to peaceful coexistence despite mounting political pressures. Officials stressed that security cooperation and community unity remain the strongest foundations for long-term peace, emphasizing that continued dialogue between Puntland and Galmudug is essential to preventing misunderstandings from escalating into armed confrontation. The renewed commitment to cooperation comes as concerns continue to grow over the deployment of additional Federal Government forces near Puntland, a move that Puntland officials have repeatedly criticized as unilateral and politically motivated. Political observers warn that, should tensions erupt into open conflict, it would not be national political leaders who bear the immediate consequences. Instead, it would be the ordinary residents of Mudug—families, traders, students, and pastoral communities—whose homes, businesses, and livelihoods would once again become the battlefield. Many local elders argue that the people of Gaalkacyo have already endured enough bloodshed over the past three decades and have invested enormous effort in restoring peace between Puntland and Galmudug. That hard-won stability, they say, should not become collateral damage in disputes driven by national politics. Negotiation, Not Confrontation Community leaders across Mudug continue to urge all political actors to prioritize negotiations over military posturing. They argue that dialogue remains the only sustainable path toward resolving Somalia’s widening political crisis and caution against allowing local communities to become victims of decisions taken hundreds of kilometers away in Mogadishu. Analysts note that any military confrontation would almost certainly undermine years of confidence-building between Puntland and Galmudug, disrupt trade across central Somalia, displace civilians, and divert security resources away from the ongoing fight against Al-Shabaab. For many residents, the message emerging from Saturday’s meeting was both practical and urgent: whatever political disagreements exist at the national level, they should be resolved through negotiation—not through armed confrontation. As Somalia grapples with one of its most delicate political periods in recent years, the images of Puntland and Galmudug officials walking together through Gaalkacyo served as a reminder that cooperation remains possible—and that preserving peace may ultimately require leaders to place the welfare of ordinary Somalis above political rivalry. items.title: Somalia’s Defense Minister Weighs in on Puntland Again
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Somalia’s Minister of Defense, Ahmed Moallim Fiqi, has once again stepped into a politically charged debate far beyond the traditional remit of his ministry, dismissing reports that the Federal Government is conducting military operations against Puntland in the divided city of Galkayo. The remarks are the latest in a long series of public interventions by Fiqi on virtually every major political controversy in Somalia—a habit that has earned him a reputation among many Somalis as one of the government’s most outspoken political spokespersons rather than simply its defense chief. Critics often joke that no national issue is complete until Fiqi comments on it. Addressing tensions in Puntland, the minister rejected allegations that Mogadishu is orchestrating military activities aimed at destabilizing the regional state. “There is no operation being conducted by the Federal Government against Puntland,” Fiqi said, urging both sides to preserve peace in Galkayo. He noted that the city had remained free from major conflict for the past eight years, arguing that its last significant unrest occurred during President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s previous administration. Rather than substantively and constructive addressing the issue, Fiqi claimed that the current tensions stem from Puntland opposition groups, whom he alleged have established bases in and around Galkayo. He also denied persistent accusations that the Federal Government has supplied weapons, logistics, or military support to those groups through neighboring Galmudug. Those denials, however, are unlikely to settle the growing political controversy. Puntland authorities have repeatedly accused Mogadishu of attempting to undermine the region’s stability by cultivating armed groups and encouraging political unrest—allegations the Federal Government has consistently rejected. The dispute has intensified in recent weeks after Puntland security forces seized weapons from troops they said were operating under the authority of the Federal Government in Bari region. Puntland has since announced efforts to identify and dismantle any remaining armed elements it believes maintain links to Mogadishu. Fiqi’s comments have drawn mixed reactions. Supporters of the government argue that the minister is merely attempting to calm tensions and prevent further escalation. Critics see something different. They argue that Fiqi has become the administration’s chief political defender, routinely commenting on elections, constitutional disputes, federal-state relations, opposition politics, diplomacy, and regional crises—subjects that often bear little direct relation to Somalia’s defense portfolio. That pattern, critics say, has diminished the impact of his public statements. “Whenever there’s a political controversy, Fiqi is first to the microphone,” one political observer told WardheerNews. “Yet Somalis rarely hear him speak in comparable detail about defense reform, military modernization, or battlefield strategy.” Whether that criticism is fair or not, it reflects a broader perception that the Defense Ministry has increasingly become one of the government’s principal political messaging platforms. As tensions between Puntland and the Federal Government continue to rise, the challenge facing both sides extends beyond competing public statements. For many observers, preventing further deterioration will depend less on political rhetoric and more on sustained dialogue, confidence-building measures, and credible efforts to reassure regional administrations that Somalia’s security institutions remain national rather than partisan. For now, however, Ahmed Moallim Fiqi remains one of the loudest voices in the debate—speaking frequently on almost every issue confronting the country, even as many Somalis continue to ask whether the Defense Minister’s greatest battlefield has become the political arena rather than the defense ministry itself. items.title: Jubaland Accuses Federal Government of Turning Its Attention to Puntland After “Failure” in Jubaland Campaign
items.description: Kismayo (WDN) – Jubaland has accused Somalia’s Federal Government of shifting its political and military focus toward Puntland after, in its view, failing to achieve its objectives during last year’s confrontation in Jubaland. In a strongly worded statement posted on his official Facebook page, Jubaland’s Minister of Information, Abdifatah Mohamed Mukhtar, alleged that Mogadishu is pursuing against Puntland the same strategy it previously employed in Jubaland. “The Federal Government of Somalia, after failing in its offensives against Jubaland and after the people of Jubaland firmly defended themselves, has now redirected its political ambitions and pressure toward Puntland,” the minister wrote. His remarks come amid escalating political and security tensions surrounding Puntland, where concerns have grown over the deployment of Federal Government forces and armed units in and around the region. Puntland officials have repeatedly argued that such deployments have taken place without consultation with the regional administration, raising fears of a wider confrontation. Mukhtar expressed confidence that Puntland would respond in the same manner that Jubaland claims to have resisted previous federal pressure. “The reality is that the people and the Government of Puntland are equally capable of resisting and confronting any attempt that threatens their peace, stability, and self-governance,” he said. The comments underscore growing solidarity between Puntland and Jubaland, the two Federal Member States that have frequently found themselves at odds with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration over constitutional reforms, electoral arrangements, and the balance of power within Somalia’s federal system. The Jubaland minister also delivered a direct message to President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, warning that political decisions based on coercion rather than dialogue could carry lasting consequences. “Politics is not built on power and pressure alone,” Mukhtar wrote. “Every coercive action carries political consequences that will ultimately have to be accounted for.” The statement reflects the increasingly confrontational rhetoric emerging from Somalia’s regional administrations as relations between Mogadishu and several Federal Member States continue to deteriorate. Rising Political Tensions The exchange comes at a particularly sensitive moment as Somalia faces deep disagreements over elections, constitutional legitimacy, and the future of the country’s federal structure. Opposition leaders and several regional administrations have accused the Federal Government of centralizing power and undermining federal autonomy, allegations that Mogadishu has consistently rejected. With Puntland and Jubaland openly aligning their political messaging, observers warn that the dispute risks widening the divide between the Federal Government and key regional stakeholders, adding further uncertainty to Somalia’s already fragile political landscape. Whether the latest accusations will lead to renewed dialogue or deepen the political standoff remains uncertain, but the increasingly sharp exchanges illustrate the growing strain on Somalia’s federal system at a time when national consensus has become more elusive than ever. items.title: Galmudug oo lagu soo rogay bandow guud + Sababta
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug ayaa ku dhawaaqay bandow guud oo laga hirgelinayo dhammaan magaalooyinka waaweyn ee deegaannada maamulkaas. Bandowgan ayaa bilaabanaya caawa oo Khamiis ah kuna eg habeen dambe, iyadoo tallaabadan lagu sheegay mid lagu xoojinayo amniga inta lagu jiro diyaar-garowga doorashada qof iyo cod. Bandowgan ayaa qeyb ka ah qorsheyaasha amni ee ay wadaan hay’adaha ammaanka Galmudug, xilli maamulka uu isu diyaarinayo qabashada doorasho qof iyo cod ah oo la filayo inay maalmaha soo socda ka dhacdo deegaannada maamulka. Mas’uuliyiintu waxay sheegeen in ujeeddadu tahay in la xaqiijiyo jawi amni oo suurtageliya qabsoomidda doorashada. Taliyaha qeybta booliska Galmudug, Gaashaanle Sare Khaliif Cabdulle Maalin oo warbaahinta la hadlay ayaa si rasmi ah u shaaciyay amarka bandowga. Wuxuu sheegay in dhaqan-galkiisu uu bilaabanayo caawa, isagoo shacabka ugu baaqay inay si buuxda ugu hoggaansamaan awaamiirta ciidamada amniga. Taliyaha ayaa caddeeyay in muddada bandowga la xaddidayo dhaqdhaqaaqa gaadiidka iyo dadweynaha, si looga hortago wax kasta oo halis gelin kara amniga ama carqaladeyn kara habsami u socodka doorashada. Wuxuu xusay in ciidamada ammaanka ay si dhow ula socon doonaan fulinta amarkan. Si kastaba, waxaa jira adeegyo iyo hay’ado laga reebay bandowga. Kuwaas waxaa ka mid ah gaadiidka laamaha amniga, gaadiidka Guddiga Doorashooyinka, hawl-wadeennada doorashada iyo warbaahinta, si ay u gutaan waajibaadkooda inta lagu jiro howlaha doorashada. “Ujeeddada bandowgu ma aha in shacabka la dhibaateeyo, balse waa in la sugo nabadgelyadooda iyo tan doorashada taariikhiga ah ee nagu soo fool leh. Waxaan ka codsaneynaa muwaadiniinta inay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan ciidamada ammaanka,” ayuu yiri Taliyaha Booliiska Galmudug. Sidoo kale, ciidamada ammaanka ayaa lagu arkayay iyagoo si weyn loogu daadiyay waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee magaalooyinka Dhuusamareeb, Gaalkacyo iyo Cadaado, halkaas oo ay ka wadaan howlgallo lagu adkeynayo amniga iyo dhaqan-gelinta amarka bandowga. Doorashada qof iyo cod ee Galmudug ayaa lagu wadaa in lagu soo doorto xubnaha goleyaasha deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada ee maamulka, waxaana loo arkaa mid ka mid ah tijaabooyinka ugu muhiimsan ee maamulka uu ku hirgelinayo nidaamka doorashooyinka tooska ah. Go’aanka maamulka Galmudug ee ku aaddan bandowga ayaa imanaya xilli indhaha lagu hayo sida ay u qabsoomi doonto doorashadan iyo heerka amni ee deegaannada maamulka. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa muujiyay rajo ah in tallaabooyinka la qaaday ay gacan ka geysan doonaan qabsoomidda doorasho nabdoon oo hufan. items.title: Virtual Press Briefing with U.S. Vice Admiral Jeffrey T. Jablon, Japanese Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi, and ROK Rear Admiral In-ho Kim on the Closing of the 2026 Rim of the Pacific (RIMPAC) Exercise
items.description: Virtual Press Briefing with U.S. Vice Admiral Jeffrey T. Jablon, Japanese Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi, and ROK Rear Admiral In-ho Kim on the Closing of the 2026 Rim of the Pacific (RIMPAC) Exercise Special Briefing Vice Admiral Jeffrey T. Jablon Deputy Commander, U.S. Pacific Fleet Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi, Commander, Escort Flotilla ONE, Japan Maritime Self Defense Force Rear Admiral In-ho Kim, Combined Forces Maritime Component Commander Asia Pacific Media Hub July 29, 2026 Audio Player 00:00 00:00 MODERATOR: Greetings from the U.S. Department of State’s Asia Pacific Media Hub. I’m Tim Johnson, and it’s my pleasure to welcome journalists to today’s on-the-record briefing. Today we’re honored to be joined by Vice Admiral Jeffrey T. Jablon of the United States, Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi of Japan, and Rear Admiral In-ho Kim of the Republic of Korea. Our speakers today will discuss the 2026 Rim of the Pacific Exercise, known as RIMPAC. With that, let’s get started. Vice Admiral Jablon, I’ll turn it over to you for your opening remarks. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Well, thank you, Tim, and good afternoon. As Tim said, I am Vice Admiral Jeff Jablon. I am Commander, Combined Task Force RIMPAC, and I want to thank each of you for joining us from across the Pacific and around the world this afternoon. I really appreciate the work that you do, and we are all happy here to take the time with you this afternoon as RIMPAC 2026 comes to a close this week. So I want to give some background on RIMPAC. RIMPAC began in 1971, and this year marks the 30th iteration of the world’s largest international maritime exercise. Over the past several weeks, we’ve brought together 30 nations, more than 30,000 personnel, 31 surface ships, five submarines, and over 190 aircraft to train together in and around Hawaii. Our theme this year is “Partners: Integrated and Prepared,” and it captures exactly what this exercise is all about. The SAILEXes on the way to RIMPAC demonstrated coordinated maneuvering, maritime fires, and combined command and control across a diverse multinational formation. This year’s major tactical events showed integration in action. Our SINKEXes brought together nine nations to identify and destroy two hulls, the ex- Mobile Bay and the ex- Peleliu , in a realistic maritime environment. Our culminating amphibious operations, led by Peru, validated integrated planning, ship-to-shore movement, and combined effects across the maritime, air, and land domains. Each event reflected the professionalism, trust, and capability this coalition brings to the Pacific. RIMPAC 2026 strengthened humanitarian assistance and disaster response, or HADR, readiness. Our training brought together military forces, interagency partners, nongovernmental organizations, and international observers to rehearse core disaster response tasks, including mass casualty care, medical triage, logistics coordination, and rapid delivery of relief supplies. These events sharpened our ability to respond at a moment’s notice and reinforce the trust and interoperability we rely on when communities across the Pacific and the world need help. This event was so successful, we will be expanding HADR operations in RIMPAC 2028. No single nation can ensure security in the Pacific alone. The global maritime environment is too large and too complex for any one country to safeguard by itself. RIMPAC gives us the chance to build the trust and relationships that make us stronger long before any crisis happens. When nations know each other, train together, and communicate well, they can respond faster and more effectively, whether it’s a security challenge, a humanitarian crisis, or a natural disaster. This year during RIMPAC ’26, our forces executed more than 500 maritime exercise events, over 2,400 flight sorties, and responded to more than 5,000 scenario-based problem sets. Those realistic scenarios strengthen combined readiness across the maritime, air, cyber, and amphibious domains. We saw real interoperability gains, including coordinated maritime operations, integrated logistics, and improved information sharing practices that allow this coalition to operate as a cohesive, capable force. We also incorporated more than 35 experiments focused on unmanned systems and emerging technologies. We demonstrated shipboard 3D printing linked with autonomous drone delivery and executed an historic unmanned underway replenishment when a Typhoon unmanned surface vessel autonomously entered the well deck of the USS Essex . These efforts help us understand how new capabilities fit into the fight and give operators real-world feedback early in the process. RIMPAC showcased historic leadership milestones. The Republic of Korea commanded the Combined Force Maritime Component for the first time. Peru led the Amphibious Task Force, a first for any Latin American navy. Chile served as a deputy commander of the entire Combined Task Force. And the Philippine Coast Guard participated for the first time with an offshore patrol vessel. These roles reflect partner capability, shared responsibility, and the momentum this exercise continues to build towards future multinational exercises and readiness. Environmental stewardship was one of my top priorities. We work closely with the state of Hawaii, their agencies, Native Hawaiian organizations to protect cultural resources, and we continue the Navy’s commitment to marine mammal research and mitigation. Balancing realistic training with responsible environmental practices is essential to how we operate. This year’s exercise carried additional significance as it coincided with the 250th anniversary of the United States. For 250 years, our nation has built enduring relationships with allies and partners based on trust, mutual respect, and shared interests. RIMPAC demonstrates that the U.S. operates alongside capable partners who share a commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific for all nations, regardless of size or strength. I’m proud of what this team accomplished and I’m confident these partnerships will strengthen how we operate together in the years ahead. I appreciate your interest in this year’s exercise and look forward to your questions. With that, I’d like to introduce two key leaders who played central roles in RIMPAC 2026: Rear Admiral Kobayashi, our Vice Commander of the Combined Task Force, and Rear Admiral Kim, the Commander of the Combined Force Maritime Component. I’ll first turn it over to Rear Admiral Kobayashi. REAR ADMIRAL KOBAYASHI: Thank you, Admiral Jablon. Thank you, Tim, and good afternoon, all. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you very much. We’ll now turn to the Q&A portion of today’s briefing. Our first question goes to Hyunsoo Kim of Yonhap, if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Hello, can you hear me? MODERATOR: Yes. QUESTION: Oh, great. So my question is: How do you assess South Korea’s role as Commander of Combined Maritime Component Forces during this year’s RIMPAC? And how did South Korea’s taking on this role bolster or enhance the country’s efforts to achieve OPCON transfer from Washington? REAR ADMIRAL KIM: Okay, thank you for a good question. RIMPAC is a multinational exercise that helps protect the sea lanes of communication and respond to maritime threat and improve interoperability and combine operational capabilities. By taking part in RIMPAC, the ROK Navy continues to strengthen its ability to conduct combined operations. In this sense (inaudible), RIMPAC (inaudible) give us a valuable opportunity to further improve our ability to lead and carry out combined maritime operations. However, RIMPAC is not a training exercise specifically designed for the transfer of wartime operational control. Through RIMPAC and other combined exercise, the ROK Navy will continue to improve our ability to plan and command combined operations following the transition. With respect to shipbuilding cooperation, those policy matters that are best addressed by the appropriate national authorities. From the RIMPAC perspective, our purpose is on improving interoperability through realistic multinational training. MODERATOR: Thank you so much. Our next question goes to Ridzwan Rahmat of Janes in Singapore, if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Yes, hi. Thank you for the opportunity. I would just like to ask about the Taigei-class submarine that was involved in the SINKEX. I understand it’s the first time that a torpedo has been used from the Taigei-class submarine in a live-firing exercise at RIMPAC. Correct me if I’m wrong. So the SINKEX, we actually had two SINKEXes that were extremely successful. Now, what stood out was how seamlessly these nations integrated sensors, shooters, and command and control across different platforms, languages, and technologies. Each of those nations brought real capability to the table, and the Combined Force operated as a single cohesive team. That level of coordination strengthens deterrence, improves readiness, and reinforces our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. Multilateral partnerships enhance regional security and prosperity by demonstrating collective resolve and shared capability, and the SINKEX was just one example during RIMPAC. Thank you. And what you see during RIMPAC is 30 nations improving their ability to operate together, respond to crisis, and deter aggression. I believe we successfully achieved our shared goal of establishing maritime security and enhancing interoperability. This year’s training across the maritime, air, cyber, and amphibious domains shows what “Partners: Integrated and Prepared” looks like in practice and reinforces our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. Thank you again for joining us today, and we all appreciate your time and your interest. Thank you. MODERATOR: All right, thank you so much to our speakers and thank you to journalists for joining us today. We’ll provide a transcript of the briefing to participating journalists as soon as it’s available. If you have any feedback or further questions, please feel free to contact us at AsiaPacMedia@state.gov. Thanks again for your participation and we hope to join – hope you can join us for another briefing soon. Take care.

Given the situation and location of the Philippines, sir, in the Indo-Pacific region and its experiences in different disaster and calamity, how this exercise, sir, will strengthen participant skills when it comes to HADR? Thank you, sir. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: So first I want to talk about the Philippine Coast Guard participation, which was the first time ever the Philippine Coast Guard has participated. And they really brought valuable capability to the exercise, especially in maritime law enforcement, search and rescue, and humanitarian assistance that you just talked about. BRP Gabriela Silang integrated seamlessly with partner nations throughout the at-sea phase. Their participation reflects the growing role of coast guards in regional security and reinforces our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. It also highlights the strength of the U.S.-Philippines partnership. Capable maritime partners are essential to sharing the burden of securing the global commons and preserving sovereignty across the Pacific, and the Philippine Coast Guard involvement in RIMPAC is just one example. So thank you for that question. MODERATOR: All right, our next question goes to Samantha Beltran of The South China Morning Post , if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Good morning. So I have two questions. So first, for allies such as the Philippines and those in the first island chain, what were the most important benchmarks for success in this exercise? And for my second question, South Korean Rear Admiral In-ho Kim is the first officer from an Asian country to lead RIMPAC’s Multinational Component – Maritime Multinational Component, while Japan’s Rear Admiral Takuo Kobayashi served as Vice Commander of the Combined Task Force. What was the value and importance of having officials from Asian forces take on leadership roles in this exercise? Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Let me answer – this is Admiral Jablon. I’ll answer the first one and then I’ll turn it over to my leadership on my right and left side to answer the second question. So really, for RIMPAC 2026, what stood out is how quickly this multinational force integrated. Our theme, “Partners: Integrated and Prepared,” isn’t just a theme. It’s exactly what we saw in land, in air, and at sea. We had 30 nations executing more than 500 maritime events, and the combined force demonstrated real gains in how we detect, track, and defeat maritime threats together. The leadership structure – including Chile, the Republic of Korea, Canada, and Japan – that could meet in key command roles allowed us to operate as a cohesive, capable team from day one. This level of integration reflects an asymmetric advantage – interoperability with allies and partners that adversaries cannot match – and it strengthens our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. And I’ll turn it over to Admiral Kobayashi for his thoughts on the leadership aspect. REAR ADMIRAL KOBAYASHI: Yeah, this is Rear Admiral Kobayashi. So again, no single nation can address these complex security issues around. So that’s why the RIMPAC force is needed to have a multinational leadership for (inaudible) and soldiers. From my perspective serving as the Vice Commander for this Multilateral Combined Command, (inaudible) for me that despite their different capabilities and expertise, nations can collaborate effectively towards a shared objective. I believe that the foundation for successful multilateral cooperation lies in the relationship of trust and the mutual understanding built over time. That’s why we are here for our RIMPAC Exercise. Thank you. REAR ADMIRAL KIM: Okay. I’m Rear Admiral Kim. I believe this exercise showed that the ROK Navy can effectively command and integrate to the Multinational Maritime Force (inaudible) and coordinated multinational ships and assessed to conduct its mission on the common operation objective. This achievement was not built in a single exercise. It was based on many years of RIMPAC experience and the trust we built with the participants. I believe the ROK Navy successfully met the given responsibility and expectation. Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Hey, Admiral Jablon. I just want to add one more thought about this, is that from my perspective, I saw high-level professionalism and trust between the leadership roles and the individuals. As I mentioned earlier, Chile served as deputy commander. Korea commanded the maritime component. Canada commanded the air component and Japan led the humanitarian assistance and disaster relief. And those leadership roles weren’t symbolic; they were operational. And each nation brought real capability and the combined force benefited from their leadership. Shared responsibility is a core part of the theme, “Partners: Integrated and Prepared,” and it strengthens our ability to maintain a free and open Indo-Pacific. What you saw were closer to closer military integration, which enabled clear lines of communication and fostered cooperation to meet regional and global challenges. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you so much. We’re going to move to Raissa Robles of South China Morning Post , if you could unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Good morning from Manila. From your brief history, RIMPAC was established during the Cold War. I want to ask: What has changed with RIMPAC since the end of the Cold War to today, when new technology like drone swarms and submarine drones are being used with much effectiveness in certain ongoing conflicts? And my second question is: How is RIMPAC relevant to the Philippine Navy and Coast Guard and its conflict in the South China Sea? Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: I think the theme of RIMPAC with multinational cooperation with likeminded nations to ensure a free and open Indo-Pacific remains from the start of RIMPAC in 1971 all the way through to 2026. And what you’ve seen is a expansion, which started in 1971 at five nations, now out to 30 nations, that likeminded nations joining together to improve trust, build those relationships, being able to operate together is really a common theme throughout, but the expansion has been really significant. And I think that’s a major impetus for maintaining a free and open Indo-Pacific. As I talked about before, the participation of the Philippines, especially the first time for the Philippine Coast Guard, is really a significant event for RIMPAC as we look to expand in the future participation of a coast guard through law enforcement, through maritime exercises, to make RIMPAC even more effective in ensuring a free and open Indo-Pacific. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you. Our next question goes to Jayvee Vallejera of the Pacific Island Times , if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Hello, can you hear me? MODERATOR: Yes. QUESTION: Hello. Thank you and good morning. I have two questions. First, in early July, China test fired a nuclear-capable ballistic missile into the Pacific Ocean. They said it was part of their annual training. It happened as RIMPAC was ongoing and was about to wrap up. Would you like to comment on that? Secondly, Guam is often called the tip of the spear in America’s defense strategy in the Indo-Pacific region. Was there any reason why Guam was not included in the RIMPAC this year? That’s all. Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: So to answer your question, RIMPAC isn’t about signaling to one country; it’s really about readiness. And as I mentioned before, the Pacific is extremely vast. No single country can ensure stability alone. When you see 30 nations improving their ability to operate together, respond to crisis, and deter aggression, that’s significant. And that scale reflects our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific and the strength of our theme, “Partners: Integrated and Prepared.” And as I said previously, this exercise strengthens collective capability, which is essential to today’s security environment. RIMPAC participants work together to strengthen regional security, protect coercion, and preserve sovereignty across the Pacific. With respect to your question of Guam, Guam is a part of the United States, and we had U.S. forces obviously as part of RIMPAC. MODERATOR: All right, thank you. We have time for one more question and it will go to Franco Jose Baroña of The Manila Bulletin , if you could please unmute yourself – excuse me, The Manila Times , if you could please unmute yourself and go ahead. QUESTION: Yes, good morning from Manila. How does RIMPAC contribute to improving maritime security and freedom of navigation in the Indo-Pacific, particularly in contested areas such as South China Sea/West Philippine Sea? Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Again, RIMPAC, for our theme of “Partners: Integrated and Prepared,” brings together 30 likeminded nations who build the trust, cooperation, and the interoperability to ensure a free and open Indo-Pacific. Through our exercises over the last month, we’ve been able to work together, operate, and conduct, as I said, over 5,000 different events in RIMPAC, showing our relationship is true. We’re able to operate together, we’re able to communicate together, and we enabled a very successful RIMPAC. We’ve got most of the force coming back to Pearl Harbor today, and we’ll be ending RIMPAC this Friday. But overall, extremely pleased with the RIMPAC 2026 and the outcome of all our events. Thank you. MODERATOR: Thank you so much. That brings us to the end of today’s briefing. Before we conclude, though, I’ll turn it back to our speakers if they have any closing remarks. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Okay, what we’ll do is I’ll turn it over to Admiral Kobayashi first, then Admiral Kim, and then I’ll provide closing remarks at the end. Thank you. REAR ADMIRAL KOBAYASHI: Thank you, Admiral Jablon. For me, RIMPAC reminded us that the interoperability is something we must continue to develop. Different language, procedures, and systems can create gaps, and realistic trainings allows us to identify and reduce those gaps before a real crisis occurs. (Inaudible) shared experiences and personal relationships developed during RIMPAC Exercise strengthen our ability to respond together, whether supporting maritime security or assisting communities after disaster. By continuing to prepare together, we support secure sea lanes in a free and open Indo-Pacific. Thank you. REAR ADMIRAL KIM: I’m Admiral Kim. As the (inaudible) for this year’s RIMPAC, I would like to thank all participating nations for their strong support and commitment. I believe we successfully achieved our shared goal of establishing maritime security and enhancing interoperability. Also, I want to express my gratitude to the media for the strong interest in the exercise. Thank you all for joining us today. Thank you. VICE ADMIRAL JABLON: Thank you, Admiral Kim. And I also want to express my thanks to the media and for you that are out there on this call for your thoughtful questions and for your continued coverage of RIMPAC 2026. The interest from journalists across the Pacific reflects the importance of this exercise and the value of transparency as our nations train together. RIMPAC is about strengthening relationships, improving interoperability, and preparing capable partners to operate together whenever and wherever needed. While RIMPAC lasts a little over a month, the trust, cooperation, and integration built here endure well beyond the conclusion of this training exercise. This year’s training across the maritime, air, cyber, and amphibious domains shows what “Partners: Integrated and Prepared” looks like in practice and reinforces our shared commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. Thank you again for joining us today, and we all appreciate your time and your interest. Thank you. MODERATOR: All right, thank you so much to our speakers and thank you to journalists for joining us today. We’ll provide a transcript of the briefing to participating journalists as soon as it’s available. If you have any feedback or further questions, please feel free to contact us at AsiaPacMedia@state.gov. Thanks again for your participation and we hope to join – hope you can join us for another briefing soon. Take care.

items.title: Fiqi oo sheegay in la garaacay guri uu shir uga socday horjoogeyaal ka tirsan Al Shabaab
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga Somaliya, Axmed Macalin Fiqi oo galabta shir jaraa’id ku qabtay Magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa sheegay in weerar xagga cirka ah lagu qaaday guri ku yaala Degmada Aadan Yabaal ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe, halkaas oo uu sheegay in uu shir uga socday horjoogeyaal ka tirsan Al Shabaab. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamka ay Isniintii afar duqaymo oo waaweyn oo xagga cirka ah ka fuliyeen Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe, ka dib xogo sirdoon oo la helay. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in la beegsaday guri lagu magacaabo Villa Aadan Yabaal, oo ay ku shirayeen horjoogeyaasha Al Shabaab, isla-markaana uu shir guddoominayay Yuusuf Ciise Kaba Kutukade, Gudoomiyaha Al Shabaab ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe. “Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed oo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamka ayaa waxay afar duqaymo oo waaweyn oo dhanka cirka ah ay ka fuliyeen Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe, taasoo loo qorsheeyay, laguna hagayay xogo sirdoon, lana fuliyay taariikhdu markay ahayd 27-kii bisha 7aad, 2026. Meesha la beegsaday waxay ahayd guriga Villa Aadan Yabaal la yiraahdo oo ay ku shirayeen horjoogeyaasha maleeshiyaadka Khawaarijta ah ee Al Shabaab.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka. “Shirkan horjoogeyaasha argagixisada ayaa waxaa shir guddoominayay waali ku sheega argagixisada Al Shabaab ugu magacaaban Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe, Yuusuf Ciise Kaba Kutukade.” Ayuu yiri Wasiir Fiqi oo intaa raaciyay in hawlgalka lagu dilay 11 ka mid ah horjoogeyaashii uu shirka gurigaasi uga socday, laguna dhaawacay afar kale. “Hawlgalkan oo u dhacay, sidii loo qorsheeyay ayaa waxaa argagixisada Al Shabaab lagu gaarsiiyay khasaare xoogan, waxaana lagu khaarijiyay 11 ka mid ah horjoogeyaashii shirka halkaa uga socday, waxaana sidoo kale dhaawacyo culus la gaarsiiyay afar horjooge. Hawlgalkan ayaa waxaa sidoo kale lagu gubay afar gaadiid ah.” Ayuu yiri Wasiir Fiqi. Fiqi ayaa xusay in hawlgalka lagu dilay laba ka mid ah ilaalada Yuusuf Ciise Kaba Kutukade, kuwaas oo magacyadooda uu ku soo koobay Cabdifitaax iyo Xaashi. Waxa kaloo uu sheegay in Kaba Kutukade uu ka mid yahay xubnaha ku dhaawacmay weerarkaasi, kaasoo uu sheegay in dhaawac culus uu soo gaaray. “Horjoogeyaasha ku dhaawacmay hawlgalkan waxaa ka mid ah Yuusuf Ciise Kaba Kutukade, waaliga argagixisada ugu magacaaban Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe oo runtii sida xoguhu ay sheegayaan dhaawac culus inuu halkaa ka soo gaaray.” Ayuu yiri Axmed Macalin Fiqi, Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga. Fiqi ayaa tilmaamay in xubnaha kale ee la dilay ay ka tirsanaayeen horjoogeyaasha Al Shabaab ee Gobolada Shabellaha Dhexe, Hiiraan iyo Galgaduud iyo niman u qaabilsanaa dhinaca qabaa’ilada. “Waxaa halkaasi ka socday qorshe weeraro iyo qaraxyo la rabo in deegaanada iyo degmooyinkaasi saddexda gobol in laga fuliyo ay kooxdaasi qorsheynaysay oo loogu soo diray in Kaba Kutukade ay xoojiyaan qorshihiisa.” Ayuu yiri Fiqi. Shabaabka ayaan ka hadlin duqayntan oo habeen hore ka dhacday Degmada Aadan Yabaal, inkastoo ay dabeecad ka dhigteen inaysan ka falcelin waxyeelada horjoogeyaasha iyo maleeshiyadooda ka soo gaarta hawlgalada socda.

items.title: Muxuu yahay mashruuca Bankiga Adduunka bixinayo ee laga reebay Waqooyi Bari?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Bangiga Adduunka iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa kala saxiixday heshiis ballaaran oo lagu maalgelinayo horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha dalka, kaas oo lagu dhisayo laguna dayactirayo garoomada diyaaradaha, waddooyinka, biyo-mareennada magaalooyinka iyo adeegyo kale oo muhiim u ah kobaca dhaqaalaha iyo isku xirka gobollada. Mashruucan oo lagu qiyaasay $500 milyan ayaa la qorsheeyay in laga hirgeliyo Gobolka Banaadir iyo dowlad-goboleedyada dalka, sida ku cad heshiiska ay labada dhinac kala saxiixdeen bishii April 2026. Ujeeddada mashruuca ayaa ah in sare loo qaado tayada kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, lana xoojiyo adeegyada muhiimka u ah bulshada iyo ganacsiga. Sida ku xusan heshiiska, mashruucu wuxuu socon doonaa illaa sannadka 2031, iyadoo muddadaas lagu fulin doono wejiyo kala duwan oo dhismaha iyo dayactirka ah. Dowladda Federaalka iyo Bangiga Adduunka ayaa si wadajir ah uga shaqeyn doona xulashada goobaha mudnaanta la siinayo iyo jadwalka lagu hirgelinayo mashaariicda. Qeyb muhiim ah oo mashruuca ka mid ah ayaa lagu horumarinayaa garoomada diyaaradaha si loo xoojiyo badqabka duullimaadyada gudaha iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Garoomada lagu xusay qorshaha waxaa ka mid ah kuwa Muqdisho, Baydhabo, Kismaayo, Hargeysa, Garoowe, Gaalkacyo, Jowhar iyo Dhoobley. Mashruucu wuxuu sidoo kale xoogga saarayaa horumarinta nidaamyada biyo-mareennada iyo xakamaynta fatahaadaha ka dhaca magaalooyinka, iyadoo la doonayo in la yareeyo saameynta ay roobabka iyo daadadku ku yeeshaan bulshada iyo kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha. Intaa waxaa dheer, qorshahan waxaa lagu daray dib-u-dayactirka iyo casriyeynta garoomada diyaaradaha qaarkood, si loo kordhiyo awooddooda adeeg iyo soo jiidashada maalgashiga. Dowladda iyo Bangiga Adduunka ayaa aaminsan in horumarinta kaabayaasha ay door weyn ka qaadan doonto kobcinta dhaqaalaha, fududeynta ganacsiga iyo abuurista fursado shaqo. Si kastaba, mashruucan laguma xusin magaalada Laascaanood oo ah xarunta maamulka Waqooyi Bari, mana jirto sabab rasmi ah oo ilaa hadda lagu caddeeyay sababta looga reebay qorshaha, inkastoo Gobolka Banaadir iyo dowlad-goboleedyada kale lagu daray mashaariicda la maalgelinayo. Ka maqnaanshaha Laascaanood ee liiska goobaha mashruucu ka hirgelayo ayaa dhalin kara su’aalo ku saabsan habka loo xushay deegaannada ka faa’iideysanaya maalgelintan. Dowladda Federaalka iyo Bangiga Adduunka ayaan weli ka hadlin sababta magaaladaasi uga maqan tahay qorshaha, iyadoo la filayo in faahfaahin dheeraad ah laga bixiyo marxaladaha dambe ee hirgelinta mashruuca. items.title: Al Shabaab kills five Kenyan security personnel in ambush
items.description: Five Kenyan security personnel have been killed while on patrol near the Somalia border in Mandera county by the armed group al-Shabab. Kenyan police said on Wednesday that the Tuesday attack occurred just before a bomb destroyed a vehicle sent to reinforce the targeted patrol. Al-Shabab has claimed responsibility through an affiliated media outlet, attributing the operation to its armed wing. Tuesday’s attack was among the deadliest in a string of recent attacks along the same stretch of Mandera, in northeastern Kenya, in recent weeks, underscoring the group’s intent to continue targeting the region . According to a Kenyan police report, a Special Operations Group patrol, an elite police “counter-terrorism” unit, came under fire near Wantey Dam, about 6km (4 miles) from Lafey police station, shortly after midday. Five members of the security forces were killed in the initial assault. A reinforcement team dispatched to the scene was then struck by a roadside bomb that destroyed an armoured vehicle, though no one on board was hurt. On July 13, Kenyan forces stormed a suspected camp near the border, killing 11 fighters and disrupting what officials said was a plan by around 30 to attack a nearby village. Eleven days later, on July 24, gunmen struck two villages in the same district, Fino and Arabia, within an hour of each other. Al-Shabab, an armed group linked to al-Qaeda, controls large areas of south-central Somalia and has been fighting the country’s central government for close to two decades. Kenya has partnered with Somali authorities to contain the group since 2011, when Kenyan troops entered Somalia, and the group has carried out repeated cross-border attacks in both Kenya and Ethiopia since then. A report submitted to Kenya’s parliament last November identified the corridor around Lafey as one of the main routes that militants use to infiltrate the country. It recorded dozens of security force casualties in the wider region over the previous year. The report found that Kenya recorded 61 “terror-related incidents” across Mandera, Wajir, Garissa and Lamu counties between September 2024 and August 2025. Mandera alone accounted for 38 of them, making it the hardest-hit county in the northeast. Samira Gaid, a regional security analyst at Balqiis Insights, told Al Jazeera that the said cross-border attacks have long been “a deliberate part of al-Shabab’s strategy”, dating to Kenya’s 2011 intervention in Somalia. Gaid added that al-Shabab doesn’t seek to control territory in Kenya in the same way as it does in Somalia, but instead carried out attacks to “coerce Kenya into withdrawing troops from Somalia by raising the domestic cost of intervention”. The attack comes as heads of state from countries contributing troops to the African Union’s peacekeeping mission in Somalia are due to meet later this week to deliberate on its future, following an announcement by the United States that it is cutting crucial funding for the operation. Washington said in early July that it would end logistics support for the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia , which has backed Somalia’s army in its fight against al-Shabab, a move experts fear could threaten the viability of the peacekeeping force. Al Jazeera.

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo ka hadashay weerar lagu qaaday Masjidka Aq-Aqsa
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa si kulul u cambaareeysay weerar lagu qaaday Masjidka Barakeysan ee Al-Aqsa, kaasi oo hoggaaminayay sarkaal Israa’iil ah oo ay wehlinayaan kooxo xagjir ah iyo ciidamaa ammaanka Israa’iil. “Falkaani wuxuu ka dhigan yahay xadgudub weyn oo lagu sameeyay karaamada iyo xurmada mid ka mid ah goobaha ugu barakaysan Islaamka, isla markaana gef ku ah dareenka malaayiinta Muslimiinta ah ee dunida ku nool” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya. Dowladda Soomaaliya waxa ay sheegtay in ay taageersan tahay shacab ah Falastiin iyo goobaha Barakeysan magaalada Qudus. Waxa ay ugu baaqday beesha Calaamka iyo Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay inay ka hortagaan falalka noocan oo kale ah ee kicinta xambaarsan isla markaana la hubiyo isla xisaabtan ku aaddan cid kasta oo ku lug leh. Sidoo kale Soomaaliya waxay ugu baaqday dhammaan dhinacyada inay muujiyaan is xakameyn isla markaana ay u istaagaan wadahadal miro dhal ah oo lagu gaari karo nabad caddaalad ku dhisan oo waarta, taas oo waafaqsan sharciga caalamiga ah iyo qaraarrada Qaramada Midoobay. items.title: Duqeyn ka dhacday Shabeellaha Dhexe oo lagu beegsaday hoggaamiyeyaal ka tirsan Al-Shabaab
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in duqeyn ka dhacday gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe lagu dilay madax ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, halka lagu dhaawacay xubno kale oo uu ku jiro Yuusuf Ciise Kabakutukade. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, oo ka hadlay magaalada Gaalkacyo, ayaa sheegay in duqeyntu ka dhacday degmada Aadan Yabaal, isla markaana lagu beegsaday goob ay ku sugnaayeen hoggaamiyeyaal sare oo ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Wasiir Fiqi ma uusan shaacin tirada rasmiga ah ee dadka lagu dilay ama lagu dhaawacay weerarka. Wuxuu sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay sii wadi doonto howlgalka ka dhanka ah Madaxda Shabaab.

items.title: Real Madrid oo xiriir rasmi ah la furtay Manchester City si ay ula saxiixato Rodri
items.description: By Saleeymaan Alcadaala Sports Reporter, Radio Dalsan TV Kooxda Real Madrid ayaa qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah oo ku aaddan saxiixa xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Manchester City, Rodri, kaddib markii madaxweynaha kooxda, Florentino Pérez , uu bixiyay oggolaanshaha in wada-hadallo rasmi ah lala furo kooxda reer England. Sida ay sheegayaan warbaahinta Isbaanishka, labada kooxood ayaa sii wada wadahallada, iyadoo la filayo in heshiis lagu gaaro dhawaantaan . Tallaabadan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah Rodri, oo 30 jir ah, waxa uu ka mid yahay ciyaaryahannada ugu wanaagsan adduunka isagoo ku guulaystay Ballon d’Or 2024 iyo inuu Spain ku hoggaamiyay guushii Koobka Adduunka 2026 . Heshiiskiisa hadda wuxuu ku dhammaanayaa xagaaga 2027, Man City -na waxay halis ugu jirtaa inay ku lumiso lacag la’aan haddii aan la iibin sanadkan . Sida ay sheegayaan ilo wareeg ah, Real Madrid waxay hore ula heshiisay dhinaca wakiillada Rodri shuruudaha shaqsiyeed, iyadoo hadda diiradda la saarayo wada-hadallada tooska ah ee labada kooxood. Man City ayaa la filayaa inay dalabto ilaa €100 milyan, halka Real Madrid ay rabto inay ku dhowaato €60 milyan , iyadoo lacag dhex-dhexaad ah oo ku dhow €80 milyan la filayo inay heshiisku ku dhammaado . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Rodri ayaa dhawaan la qabtay qaliin yar oo dhabarka ah, waxaana la filayaa inuu ka maqnaado muddo gaaban. Tababare cusub ee Man City , Enzo Maresca , ayaa sheegay in uusan ka walaacsanayn xanta ku saabsan Rodri, isagoo yiri: “Ciyaartoyda waaweyn waxaa ku wareegsan xanta, taasina waa wax caadi ah. Waxaan u maleynayaa in kastaabarbaraha uu rabo inuu lahaado Rodri, waayo waa ciyaaryahan heer sare ah” . Waxaa sidoo kale lagu soo waramayaa in Real Madrid ay soo jeedisay in ka badan €50 milyan si Rodri ugu soo biiro Bernabéu, laakiin Man City ayaa la filayaa inay dalbato lacag ka badan taas. Ilaa hadda, kooxda Ingiriiska kama aysan jawaabin dalabka rasmiga ah, iyadoo sidoo kale la filayo inay kooxo kale ku soo biiraan tartanka saxiixa ciyaaryahanka. Rodri ayaa la sheegay inuu mudnaanta siinayo ku biirista Real Madrid, taasoo sare u qaadaysa rajada kooxda reer Spain. items.title: Maxkamad Brazil oo ganaax culus ku ridday Victor Gabriel
items.description: By Saleeymaan Alcadaala Sports Reporter, Radio Dalsan TV Maxkamadda ciyaaraha ee Brazil ayaa ganaax aan horay loo arag ku ridday daafaca kooxda Internacional, Victor Gabriel, kaddib dhaawac halis ah oo uu u geystay weeraryahanka Cruzeiro, Gabriel Pec. Go’aanka maxkamadda ayaa dhigaya in Victor Gabriel laga mamnuuco ka qeybgalka dhammaan tartamada rasmiga ah ilaa Gabriel Pec uu caafimaad ahaan u soo laabto tababarka, iyadoo xadka ugu badan uu yahay 180 maalmood . Go’aankan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay ciqaab aan horay loogu arag kubadda cagta Brazil. Maxkamadda ayaa sheegtay in ganaaxyada caadiga ah ee u dhexeeya hal ilaa lix kulan aysan ka turjumeyn culayska dhaawaca . Sidaas awgeed, waxaa la go’aamiyay in la adeegsado Qodobka 254aad ee Xeerka Ciyaaraha Brazil, kaas oo ogolaanaya in muddada ciqaabtu la jaanqaado wakhtiga ay dhaawaca u baahan tahay . Gabriel Pec, oo 25 jir ah, waxa uu lahaa kulankiisii ugu horreeyay Cruzeiro kadib markii uu kaga soo biiray LA Galaxy lacag dhan $12 milyan . Dhaawaca ayaa ku yimid 13 daqiiqo kadib intii uu ciyaarta ka soo galay, waxaana lagu ogaaday inuu ka dhacay lugtiisa bidix . Waxaa la filayaa inuu ka maqnaado 3 ilaa 4 bilood . Victor Gabriel, oo 22 jir ah, ayaa maxkamadda kaga hadlay dhacdada, isagoo sheegay inuusan u jeedin inuu dhaawaco Pec. Wuxuu yidhi: “Waxaan soo dhaafay habeeno aan hurdayn anigoo u duceynaya, waxaanan si qalbiga ah ugu raali-gelinayaa dhamaan taageerayaasha Cruzeiro” . Wuxuu kaloo sheegay inuu uu raaliga ka yahay, isla markaana uusan u jeedin wax xumaato ah . Go’aanka maxkamadda ayaa kala qaybiyay garsoorayaasha, iyadoo mid ka mid ah u codeeyay ganaax caadi ah oo lix kulan ah, laakiin inta badan waxay ku wada oggolaadeen ganaaxa dheer . Kooxda Internacional ayaa sidoo kale soo bandhigtay caddayn been abuur ah oo ah duubis VAR ah, taasoo ay markii dambe ka baxeen . The post Maxkamad Brazil oo ganaax culus ku ridday Victor Gabriel first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Soomaaliya ka qeyb gashay Shirka Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada ku taageera AUSSOM
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka XDS, Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta magaalada Kampala ee Jamhuuriyadda Uganda kaga qayb galay Shirka Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada Difaaca (CDFs Meeting) ee Dalalka Ciidamada ku taageera Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM). Shirka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray qiimeynta xaaladda amni ee Soomaaliya, dib u eegista horumarka laga sameeyey dib u dhiska iyo tayeynta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed, xaaladda guud ee hawlgalka AUSSOM iyo taageerada la xiriirta, iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga iyo isku duwidda hawlgallada wadajirka ah ee u dhexeeya Ciidanka XDS iyo Ciidamada Hawlgalka AUSSOM. Intii uu shirku socday, madaxda ka qayb gashay waxay adkeeyeen muhiimadda ay leedahay sii wadidda wada shaqeynta istaraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeysa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Midowga Afrika iyo dalalka ciidamadooda qaybta ka yihiin hawlgalka AUSSOM, si loo dardargeliyo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga dalka, korna loogu qaado awoodda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed, loona xoojiyo la dagaallanka kooxaha argagixisada. Ka qaybgalka Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ee shirkan ayaa muujinaya doorka hoggaamineed ee Ciidanka XDS ku leeyahay xoojinta iskaashiga amniga gobolka iyo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo nabad waarta, xasillooni iyo isku filnaanshaha awoodda difaaca ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya.

items.title: Five Kenyan Security Officers Killed in Al-Shabaab Attack in Mandera
items.description: MANDERA, — At least five Kenyan security officers were killed in an attack by suspected Al-Shabaab militants in Mandera County, near the border with Somalia, according to Kenyan police. The officers, who were attached to the Alungu-based Special Operations Group, came under attack in the Wantey Dam area, triggering a heavy exchange of gunfire with the militants. A preliminary police report said five officers were killed during the confrontation. Reinforcements were deployed to the area shortly after the fighting began to support the security team and pursue the attackers. However, an armoured vehicle carrying members of the reinforcement unit was struck by an improvised explosive device planted along the road. Police did not immediately disclose whether the explosion caused further casualties. Security forces subsequently launched an operation in the area to track down the militants and secure the surrounding communities. Al-Shabaab has carried out repeated attacks in Kenya’s northeastern counties, particularly in areas close to the Somali border. The group frequently targets security personnel and government vehicles through ambushes, roadside bombings and other armed attacks. items.title: Ciidanka Danab oo diyaarado u adeegsaday howlgal maanta ka dhacay…
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Kumaandooska Danab ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa maanta howlgal qorsheysan oo diyaarado loo adeegsaday ka fuliyay deegaanno ku teedsan jiinka Webiga Jubba, halkaas oo lagu beegsaday fariisimo iyo difaacyo ay Al-Shabaab ku leeyihiin aaggaas. Diyaaradaha milatari ee ka qayb-qaatay howlgalka ayaa lagu daabulay ciidamada la geeyay goobta, iyaga oo kadib si toos ah u gaaray aagagga ay ku dhuumaaleysanayeen maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab, sida lagu sheegay bayaan kasoo baxay Taliska Ciidanka Gaarka ah ee Danab. Howlgalkan oo ahaa bartilmaameed ayaa khasaare culus lagu gaarsiiyay argagixisada, iyada oo la burburiyay fariisimo ay ku lahaayeen halkaasi. “Markii ciidamada ay gaareen goobta, waxay qaadeen hawlgallo qorsheysan oo lagu beegsaday fariisimihii iyo difaacyadii Khawaarijta, waxaana kooxda la gaarsiiyay jab xooggan iyo khasaare culus,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Intii uu socday hawlgalku, ciidamada ayaa burburiyay awooddii Khawaarijta ee goobihii la beegsaday, iyadoo maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda la gaarsiiyay khasaare, halka qaar kalena ay ka firxadeen fariisimahoodii”. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in howlgalkan uu muujinayo awoodda iyo diyaar-garowga Ciidanka Danab, iyo sida ay uga go’an tahay inay gaaraan goob kasta oo Khawaarijtu isku daydo inay gabaad iyo difaac ka dhigato. Dhanka kale, Taliska Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ayaa xaqiijiyay in howlgallada socda lagu wiiqayo awoodda Khawaarijta iyo lagu xaqiijinayo amniga deegaannada ay sii socon doonaan, iyadoo ciidamada ay ka go’an tahay difaaca shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo ilaalinta qarannimada Soomaaliya. Jubbooyinka ayaa kamid ah meelaha ay ku xooggan yihiin Al-Shabaab, waxaana badanaa howlgallo ka fuliya ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Jubbaland. items.title: MADAXWEYNE XASAN SHEEKH OO KORMEER SHAQO KU TEGAY DEKEDDA MUQDISHO
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta kormeer shaqo ku tagay Dekedda caalamiga ah ee magaalada Muqdisho, halkaasi oo uu ugu kuurgalay horumarka ka socda kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee dalka iyo qorshayaasha lagu casriyeynayo adeegyada dekedda. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa soo indha indheeyay xarumaha kaydka Shidaalka dekedda, bakhaarada iyo dhismaha cusub ee xafiisyada maamulka dekedda, isaga oo xog ogaal u noqday dadaalada dib u habeynta iyo casriyeynta xarumaha muhiimka ah ee dowladda iyo kor u qaadista tayada adeegyada ay helaan shacabka iyo ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha ayaa kormeerka kaddib, kulan muhiim ah la qaatay Wasiirka Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda iyo Maareeyaha Guud ee Dekedda Muqdisho, oo uu ka dhageystay warbixin faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan xaaladda guud ee dekedda, horumarka laga gaaray mashaariicda socda iyo qorshaha dhismaha Dekedda Cusub ee Muqdisho oo loogu talagalay in ay daboosha dhammaan baahida dakadeed ee caasimadda, islamarkaana kor loo qaaddo awoodda ay u leedahay la tacaalidda kororka ganacsiga iyo koboca dhaqaalaha dalka. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa adkeeyey in horumarinta dekedaha ay laf-dhabar u tahay kobaca dhaqaalaha dalka, kor u qaadista ganacsiga, abuurista fursado shaqo iyo xoojinta isku xirka dalka iyo suuqyada caalamka, waxa uuna kula dardaarmay masuuliyiinta Wasaaradda iyo maamulka Dekedda in ay laba jibaaraan dadaallada lagu horumarinayo adeegyada dekedda.

items.title: Mashruuc heer qaran ah oo lagu horumarinaayo waxbarashada Ceel-afweyn
items.description: Ceel-afweyn: Masuuliyiin Heer Qaran iyo Heer Gobol ah oo Daah-furay Mashruuc Lagu Horumarinayo Waxbarashada 19 Dugsi oo ku yaalla Gobolka Sanaag Agaasimaha Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Barbaarinta iyo Sayniska Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Sanaag, Gudomiyaha Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Barbaarinta iyo Sayniska ee Gobolka Sanaag, Maayir Ku-xigeenka Degmada Ceel-afweyn Maamuulaha Wasarada Waxbarshada Barbaarinta Iyo Sayniska Degmada Ceelafwayn iyo Agaasimaha Dugsiyada Hoose ee Degmada Ceel-afweyn ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u daah-furay mashruuc ay fulinayso hay’adda YOVENCO, kaas oo laga hirgelinayo 19 dugsi oo ku yaalla gobolka Sanaag. Mashruucan ayaa diiradda saaraya horumarinta tayada waxbarashada, kor u qaadista deegaanka waxbarasho iyo taageeridda dugsiyada degmada Ceel-afweyn, oo waxbarashadoodu dib-u-dhac la kulantay sannadihii u dambeeyey. Masuuliyiintii ka qayb-gashay munaasabadda ayaa sheegay in mashruucani wax weyn ka tari doono dib u soo kabashada waxbarashada degmada Ceel-afweyn, isla markaana uu sare u qaadi doono tayada waxbaridda iyo waxbarashada ardayda dhigata 19-ka dugsi ee mashruucu ka hirgelayo. Waxay sidoo kale bogaadiyeen doorka ay hay’adda YOVENCO ka qaadanayso horumarinta waxbarashada gobolka Sanaag, iyagoo xusay in iskaashiga Wasaaradda Waxbarashada iyo hay’adaha horumarintu uu muhiim u yahay horumarinta adeegyada waxbarasho iyo tayaynta fursadaha ay helayaan ardayda gobolka.

items.title: Taliyaha Militariga Somaliya oo ka qaybgalay shir la xiriira Hawlgalka AUSSOM
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa maanta Magaalada Kampala uga qaybgalay Shirka Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada ee dalalka Afrika ay ciidamada ka joogaan Somaliya. Shirkan oo ay martigelisay Dowladda Uganda ayaa looga hadlay Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Somaliya (AUSSOM), waxaana uu yimid, ka dib markii Mareykanka uu horaantii bishan sheegay in uu joojin doono taageerada Ciidanka AUSSOM, oo aan waqtigooda la cusbooneysiin doonin, marka la gaaro 31-ka bisha December. Mareykanka ayaa go’aankiisan u sababeeyay fashilka dagaalka Al Shabaab iyo horumar la’aanta amniga Somaliya. “Shirka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray qiimeynta xaaladda amni ee Somaliya, dib-u-eegista horumarka laga sameeyay dib-u-dhiska iyo tayaynta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed, xaaladda guud ee Hawlgalka AUSSOM iyo taageerada la xiriirta iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga iyo isku-duwidda hawlgalada wadajirka ah ee u dhaxeeya Ciidanka XDS iyo Ciidamada Hawlgalka AUSSOM.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Militariga Somaliya. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Intii uu shirku socday, madaxda ka qaybgashay waxay adkeeyeen muhiimadda ay leedahay sii wadidda wada-shaqaynta istiraatiijiga ah ee u dhaxeysa Dowladda Federaalka Somaliya, Midowga Afrika iyo dalalka ciidamadooda qaybta ka yihiin Hawlgalka AUSSOM, si loo dardargeliyo dadaalada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga dalka, korna loogu qaado awoodda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed, loona xoojiyo la dagaalanka kooxaha argagixisada.” Dalalka Uganda, Burundi, Kenya, Itoobiya, Jabuuti iyo Masar ayaa ah dalalka ciidamada ku deeqay Hawlgalka AUSSOM, iyadoo Uganda ay tahay dalka ciidamada ugu badan ka joogaan Somaliya. Xoogaga AUSSOM ayaa Dowladda Soomaaliyeed ka taageera howlaha sugidda amniga iyo la dagaalanka kooxaha argagixisada.

items.title: Galmudug oo hakisay duulimaadyada rayidka inta lagu jiro doorashooyinka
items.description: Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada ee Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug ayaa ku dhawaaqday in si ku-meel-gaar ah loo hakinayo dhammaan duulimaadyada rayidka ee ka baxa kana soo dega garoomada diyaaradaha Galmudug, iyadoo la tixgelinayo sugidda amniga iyo xaqiijinta habsami-u-socodka doorashooyinka. Warqad kasoo baxday Xafiiska Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada, Cabdiqor Maxamed Maxamed, ayaa lagu sheegay in go’aankan uu dhaqan geli doono 30-ka Luulyo 2026, isla markaana uu sii jiri doono inta ay socoto doorashada ama ilaa amar kale oo rasmi ah kasoo baxa Wasaaradda. Go’aanka ayaa khuseeya dhammaan shirkadaha diyaaradaha, maamulka garoomada, Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed (SCAA) iyo hay’adaha kale ee ay quseyso. Wasaaraddu waxay xustay in duulimaadyada la xiriira xaaladaha degdegga ah, gargaarka bani’aadannimada ama arrimaha amniga loo oggolaan doono oo keliya fasax rasmi ah oo ay bixiso Wasaaradda. Ugu dambeyn, Wasaaradda ayaa ugu baaqday dhammaan hay’adaha iyo shirkadaha ay khuseyso inay si buuxda u fuliyaan amarkan, isla markaana ay la shaqeeyaan hay’adaha amniga si loo xaqiijiyo nabadgelyada iyo habsami-u-socodka doorashada.

items.title: DF oo shaacisay cadadka lacagta ay beesha calamka ka goosatay Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Maaliyadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Biixi Imaan Cige ayaa sheegay in ay hoos u dhacday kaalmadii iyo deeqihii ay Dowladda Federaalka ka heli jirtay caalamka, isaga oo shaaciyay cadadka lacagta ay beesha caalamka ka goosatay Soomaaliya. Wasiir Biixi ayaa qiray in sanadihii 2025 iyo 2024 ay si weyn hoos ugu dhaceen deeqihii ka imaanayay caalamka, isla markaana loo baahan yahay in la qaado tallaabooyin gudaha ah oo lagu xoojinayo isku tiirsanaanta Soomaaliya. “Labadii sano ee ugu dambeysay kaalmada soo gasha Soomaaliya 25% ayay hoos u dhacday, wayna kasii badaneysaa sanadba sanadka ka dambeeya. Waa lama huraan qorshe gudaha ah inaan yeelano oo isku tiirsanaan ah oo laga maarmayo deeqaha dunida,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Maaliyadda Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, wuxuu xaqiijiyay in dalalka beesha caalamka ay goosteen lacag dhan 450 illaa 600 milyan oo dollar, taas oo saameyn ku yeelatay howlaha muhiimka ah ee dowladda, gaar ahaan arrimaha bulshada iyo amniga. “Waxaan ka hadleynaa sanadkii 450 milyan, illaa 600 oo milyan oo dalka soo geli jirtay oo meesha ka baxaysa,” ayuu mar kale yiri Wasiir Biixi Iimaan Cige. Waxaa kale oo uu intaasi sii raaciyay “Qeybaha u badan ee ay saameynta ugu wayn ugu yeelaneysaa waa Sector-ka Social-ka sida caafimaadka, waxbarashada, arrimaha la xiriira security-ga iyo arrimaha bani’aadanimada”. Hadalka Wasiirka Maaliyadda Soomaaliya ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dowladda ay wajahaysa caqabado dhaqaale oo ay ka mid yihiin hoos u dhaca deeqaha dibadda iyo baahida loo qabo in la helo ilo dhaqaale oo gudaha ah, si loo sii wado adeegyada muhiimka ah iyo hawlaha dowladda. Soomaaliya ayaa muddo ka badan labaatan sano si weyn ugu tiirsaneyd deeqaha iyo kaalmada ee beesha caalamka, si loo maalgeliyo adeegyada aasaasiga ah sida caafimaadka, waxbarashada, gargaarka bani’aadannimada iyo dib u dhiska hay’adaha dowladda. The post DF oo shaacisay cadadka lacagta ay beesha calamka ka goosatay Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .
