items.title: Maxaa ka Jira Warka Sheegaya in Cunaqabataynta laga Qaaday Sheekh Xasan Daahir Aweys?
items.description: Warar lagu faafiyay baraha bulshada oo sheegaya in Waaxda Hantida ee Maraykanka (Office of Foreign Assets Control – OFAC) ay cunaqabataynta ka qaaday Sheekh Xasan Daahir Aweys ayaan sax ahayn. Baaritaan lagu sameeyay diiwaannada rasmiga ah ee OFAC ayaa muujinaya in aan la samayn delisting (ka saarista liiska cunaqabataynta), balse ay dhacday oo keliya dib-u-habayn farsamo (administrative update) oo lagu mideeyay diiwaanno soo noqnoqday. OFAC waxay 27kii Luulyo 2026 ku dhawaaqday inay isku dartay 18 galitaan oo labajibbaarnaa (duplicate entries), iyadoo meesha ka saartay diiwaannadii soo noqnoqday. Hay’addu waxay si cad u sheegtay in inkasta oo galitaannadaas la tiray, haddana dadka iyo hantida la xiriirta ay weli ku jiraan cunaqabataynta, isla markaasna hantidooda ay weli xanniban tahay. Kiiska Sheekh Xasan Daahir Aweys, waxa la tiray oo keliya galitaankii soo noqnoqday (Duplicate UID 11744), halka galitaankii asalka ahaa (UID 7006) uu weli ku jiro liiska SDN ee OFAC. Sidaas darteed, xaaladdiisa sharci ee cunaqabataynta wax isbeddel ah kuma iman. (ofac.treasury.gov⁠) Sida caadiga ah, marka OFAC ay qof ama hay’ad si rasmi ah uga saarto liiska cunaqabataynta, waxay si cad ugu sheegtaa bayaankeeda in qofkaas ama hay’addaas la delisted (laga saaray liiska). Hasayeeshee, marka ay saxayso diiwaanno isdulsaaran ama xog soo noqnoqotay, waxay adeegsataa ereyo ay ka mid yihiin “duplicate entries”, “duplicate UID” ama “duplicate records”, kuwaas oo aan ka dhignayn in cunaqabatayn la qaaday. Sidaas awgeed, sheegashada ah in OFAC ay cunaqabataynta ka qaaday Sheekh Xasan Daahir Aweys waa xog aan sax ahayn, maaddaama isbeddelka dhacay uu ahaa mid farsamo oo keliya, isla markaana aanu waxba ka beddelin xaaladdiisa cunaqabatayneed. Isha rasmiga ah: OFAC

items.title: Ciidanka Danab ee Puntland oo taageeray PSF una digay Deni
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Kumaandooska Danab ee Puntland oo warsaxaafadeed soo saaray ayaa digniin adag u diray Madaxweynaha maamulkaasi, Saciid Cabdullahi Deni, taas oo ku aadan xaaladda sii cakirmeysa ee Puntland oo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ay ka jiraan. Ciidamadan oo uu hoggaamiyo Jeneraal Jimcaale Takar, isla markana ay taageerto Dowladda Federaalka ayaa garab istaag u muujiyay ciidamada PSF oo dhawaan kuwa Daraawiishta Puntland kula dagaalamay Gobolka Bari. “PSF waxay door muhiim ka soo qaateen amniga Puntland sannado badan, waana ciidamo reer Puntland,” ayaa lagu yiri warqadda. Warsaxaafadeedka Ciidanka Danab ayaa lagu sheegay in Saciid Deni uu dagaal sokeeye ka hurinayo gudaha Puntland, isla markaana uu isku adeesanayo ciidamada maamulkaasi. “Hoggaamiye Siciid Deni wuxuu hurinayaa colaad iyo dagaal sokeeye, waana markii afaraad oo dagaallo noocaan ka dhacaan gudaha Puntland, ciidamada Puntland-na uu isu adeegsado,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale, Taliska ayaa sheegay in aysan jirin cid Puntland kusoo duushay, isla markaana khilaafka jira uu u dhexeeyo dad reer Puntland oo diidan kelitalisnimada Saciid Deni iyo boob qoyskiisu wadaan, sida lagu caddeeyay bayaanka. “Ma jirto cid Puntland kaga soo duushey dibadda, khilaafka jira waa mid salka ku haya khilaaf siyaasadeed oo u dhexeeya dad reer Puntland ah, waxa la isku hayana waa hoggaaminta taletisnimada iyo boobka qoyska Siciid Deni,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Waxuu weerar ku yahay cid kasta oo ka aragti duwan, wuxuuna rabaa in uu Puntland ka dhigo meel ay ka shaqeyso kelitalisnimadiisa keliya. Waxaan soo jeedinaynaa in laga hortago daadinta dhiigga askar reer Puntland ah iyo colaad la dhex-dhigo qeybaha ciidamada reer Puntland”. Ciidanka Danab ayaa ugu dambeyn shaaca ka qaaday in mas’uuliyadda bilaabashada dagaal iyo colaad sokeeye oo ka dhaca gudaha Puntland uu qaadi doono Madaxweynaha maamulkaas, Mudane Siciid Cabdillaahi Deni. Warqaddan ayaa kusoo aadeyso xilli xasaasi ah, isla markaana Puntland ay wajaheyso dhaq-dhaqaaq ciidan oo ka jira deegaannadeeda, kadib markii la sheegay in dowladda dhexe ay abaabul ka bilowday gudaha maamulkaasi. The post Ciidanka Danab ee Puntland oo taageeray PSF una digay Deni appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.description: Garoowe ( Raxanreeb Online) Ciidamada uu hoggaaminayo Jimcaale Jaamac Takar oo ku sugan duleedka magaalada Garoowe, ayaa soo saaray bayaan ay ku muujinayaan walaac ku saabsan wararka sheegaya iska hor imaad hubaysan oo ka dhaca Puntland iyo xiisad sii kordheysa oo ka dhex jirta ciidamada amniga gobolka. War-saxaafadeedka, ciidamadu waxay ku eedeeyeen maamulka Puntland, gaar ahaan Madaxweyne Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni, inay gacan ka geysteen sii kordhinta xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amniga. Waxay ka digeen in la oggolaado khilaafaadka siyaasadeed inay isu beddelaan iska hor imaadyo hubaysan oo khatar gelin kara dadka rayidka ah, wiiqaya xasilloonida iyo abuurista kala qaybsanaan ka dhex dhacda hay’adaha amniga. items.title: Soomaaliya oo shirka Baarlamaanka Afrika ka soo jeeda
items.description: Midrand, Koonfur Afrika – Xildhibaano ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya labadiisa Aqal ayaa ka qeyb galaya Shirweynaha Baarlamaanka Afrika (Pan-African Parliament) oo ka socda magaalada Midrand ee dalka Koonfur Afrika. Shirka sanadkan oo hal-ku-dhiggiisu yahay “Xaqiijinta Helitaanka Biyo Waara iyo Nidaamyo Fayadhowr oo Ammaan ah si loo gaaro Himilooyinka Ajendaha 2063”, ayaa lagaga doodayaa arrimo muhiim u ah qaaradda Afrika oo ay ka mid yihiin nabadda iyo amniga, dimuqraadiyadda, dowlad-wanaagga, iyo isdhexgalka dalalka Afrika. Ka qeybgalka Soomaaliya shirkan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu muujinayaa ka qeybgalka dalka ee heerka qaaradda iyo ka go’naanshaha siyaasadda Afrika. Wafdiga Xildhibaanada ah ee Soomaaliya ku metelaya shirweynaha, waxaa ku wehliya mas’uuliyiinta safaaradda Soomaaliya ee dalka Koonfur Afrika oo uu ugu horreeyo Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya u fadhiya dalka Koonfur Afrika Danjire Aadan Isaaq iyo Diblomaasiyiinta kale ee safaaradda. Shirweynaha Baarlamaanka Afrika ayaa ah mid ka mid ah hay’adaha ugu muhiimsan ee Midowga Afrika, waxaana la aasaasay si loo xoojiyo isdhexgalka qaaradda iyo loo horumariyo dimuqraadiyadda iyo dowlad-wanaagga. Soomaaliya, oo sanadkii hore dib u soo noqotay hay’addan kadib markii ay ka maqanayd muddo dheer, ayaa hadda si firfircoon uga qeyb qaadanaysa shirarka iyo doodaha heerka qaaradda. Doodaha shirka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa helitaanka biyo nadiif ah iyo nidaamyo fayadhowr oo ammaan ah, kuwaas oo qayb ka ah Yoolalka Horumarka Waara ee Midowga Afrika. Sidoo kale, waxaa laga wada hadlayaa sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo dowlad-wanaagga si loo gaaro himilooyinka Ajendaha 2063, kaas oo ah qorshaha Midowga Afrika ee lagu doonayo in lagu beddelo qaaradda Afrika tan iyo 2063. Wafdiga Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale la kulmay wafdiyo kale oo ka kala socda dalalka Afrika, iyagoo ka wada hadlay sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo dalalka kale ee qaaradda. Kulamadan ayaa muhiim u ah sidii loo xoojin lahaa xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan. The post Soomaaliya oo shirka Baarlamaanka Afrika ka soo jeeda first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Gaalkacyo oo Hoggaaminaysa Diiwaangelinta Codbixiyeyaasha Galmudug
items.description: Guddiga Madaxa-Bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa si rasmi ah u shaaciyay natiijada diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaasha ee 11-ka degmo ee Dowlad-Goboleedka Galmudug, iyadoo degmada Gaalkacyo ay noqotay tan ugu horreysa marka la eego tirada dadka isdiiwaangeliyay. Sida lagu sheegay xogta guddiga, degmada Gaalkacyo waxaa laga diiwaangeliyay 65,950 codbixiye, taasoo ka dhigaysa degmada ugu codbixiyeyaal badan deegaannada Galmudug ee doorashooyinku ka qabsoomi doonaan. Waxaa ku xigta degmada Caabudwaaq oo leh 48,358 codbixiye, halka Hobyo ay gashay kaalinta saddexaad iyadoo laga diiwaangeliyay 37,734 codbixiye. Liiska degmooyinka kale ayaa muujinaya in Cadaado laga diiwaangeliyay 33,679 codbixiye, Dhuusamareeb 23,735, Guriceel 22,011, Xarardheere 9,929, Xeraale 8,872, Balanbale 7,349, Ceeldheer 5,435, halka Galcad/Masagawayn ay noqotay degmada ugu codbixiyeyaal yar diiwaangelinta, iyadoo laga qoray 4,368 codbixiye. Guud ahaan, tirada codbixiyeyaasha laga diiwaangeliyay 11-ka degmo ee Galmudug ayaa gaartay 259,020 codbixiye, taasoo muujinaysa heerka ka-qaybgalka bulshada ee geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka deegaanka. Dhanka kale, guddiga doorashooyinka ayaa sidoo kale shaaciyay in 1,273 musharax ay u taagan yihiin doorashooyinka Galmudug. Musharaxiinta Golaha Wakiillada ayaa gaaraya 349 musharax, kuwaas oo ka socda 12 urur siyaasadeed, kuna tartamaya 89 kursi, halka 84% ay rag yihiin, 16%-na ay dumar yihiin. Sidoo kale, doorashada Golaha Deegaanka waxaa ku tartamaya 924 musharax oo ka socda 16 urur siyaasadeed, kuwaas oo u loollamaya 243 kursi. Shaacinta xogtan ayaa ah tallaabo muhiim ah oo muujinaysa sii socoshada diyaar-garowga doorashooyinka dimuqraadiga ah ee Galmudug, iyadoo la filayo in bulshada deegaannadu ay door muuqda ka qaataan doorashada maamullada deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada.

items.title: Wafdi ka socda Congress-ka iyo milatariga Mareykanka oo tegay Kismaayo
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Xubno ka socda Golaha Congress-ka iyo saraakiil ka tirsan milatariga Mareykanka ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Kismaayo ee xarunta gobolka Jubbada Hoose, halkaas oo si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyay. Wadigan ayaa booqan doono xarumaha ciidamada AUSSOM ee ku yaalla halkaasi, waxayna sidoo kale la kulmi doonaan madaxda sare ee Jubbaland, iyaga oo kala hadli doono arrimo ku aadan dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab. Sidoo kale, wafdiga ka socda Mareykanka ayaa wada wada tashiyo ku aadan mustaqbalka AUSSOM, wuxuuna wadaa qiimeyn, kahor shirka ka dhacaya Uganda oo ay isugu tegi doonaan dalalka ay ciidamada ka joogaan Soomaaliya. Wararka ayaa intaasi kusii daraya in booqashadooda ay kusii gaari doonaan magaalooyinka Garoowe iyo Hargeysa, halkaas oo ay kula kulmi doonaan madaxda Puntland iyo Somaliland oo ay kala hadli doonaan arrimaha ammaanka. Booqashada wafdigan ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli mustaqbalka AUSSOM uu galay hubanti la’aan, kadib markii Mareykanka uu sheegay inuusan taageeri doonin sii wadista howlaha Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, UNSOS, wixii ka dambeeya dhammaadka sanadkan. UNSOS ayaa AUSSOM siisa adeegyada muhiimka ah ee ay ka mid yihiin cuntada, biyaha, shidaalka, gaadiidka, adeegyada caafimaadka iyo daad-gureynta ciidamada dhaawacma. Mareykanka ayaa Midowga Afrika ku wargeliyey inuu Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ka hor istaagi doono qorshe kasta oo sii wadaya taageerada dhaqaale iyo tan farsamo ee UNSOS. Miisaaniyadda UNSOS ayaa gaareysa ku dhowaad $500 milyan sanadkii, halka AUSSOM ay sidoo kale la daalaa-dhaceyso dhaqaale yari weyn oo wiiqday awooddeeda howlgal. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, AUSSOM waxaa ka tirsan ku dhowaad 12,000 oo askari, kuwaas oo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ka taageera dagaalka Al-Shabaab iyo ilaalinta xarumo muhiim ah oo ku yaalla Muqdisho iyo gobollada koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya. items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo Shaaciyay Tirada Musharaxiinta Golaha Wakiillada iyo Deegaanka ee Galmudug
items.description: Guddiga Madaxa-Bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (NIEBC) ayaa si rasmi ah u shaaciyay tirada guud ee musharaxiinta u taagan doorashooyinka Golaha Wakiillada iyo Golaha Deegaanka ee Dowlad-Goboleedka Galmudug. Sida ku xusan xogta rasmiga ah ee guddigu soo saaray, tartanka doorashada ayaa si weyn uga dhex muuqda ururrada siyaasadeed ee dalka, iyadoo la soo bandhigay kala sarraynta musharaxiinta ragga iyo dumarka ee u tartamaya kuraasta kala duwan. Musharaxiinta Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug Tirada Ururrada: Waxaa ka qayb galaya 12 urur siyaasadeed. Kuraasta Loo Tartamayo: Waxay dhan yihiin 89 kuraasta Golaha Wakiillada ah. Wadarta Musharaxiinta: Waxaa u tartamaya 349 musharax. Kala-sooca Jinsiga: Rag: 293 musharax (84.0%). Dumar: 56 musharax (16.0%). Ururrada siyaasadeed sida Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka iyo Towfiiq ayaa hormuud ka ah tirada ugu badan ee musharaxiinta Golaha Wakiillada, iyaga oo urur kasta uu soo bandhigay 89 musharax (77 rag ah iyo 12 dumar ah). Musharaxiinta Golaha Deegaanka Galmudug Tirada Ururrada: Waxaa tartanka ka qayb galaya 16 urur siyaasadeed. Kuraasta Loo Tartamayo: Waxay dhan yihiin 243 kuraasta Golaha Deegaanka ah. Wadarta Musharaxiinta: Waxa ay u taagan yihiin 924 musharax. Kala-sooca Jinsiga : Rag: 726 musharax (78.6%). Dumar: 198 musharax (21.4%). Golaha Deegaanka waxaa sidoo kalena ka dhex muuqda tartanka ugu culus ee ururrada Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka oo leh 237 musharax, Towfiiq oo leh 199 musharax, Sincad oo leh 108 musharax, iyo Karaama oo leh 105 musharax. Shaacinta xogtan ayaa muujinaysa diyaar-garowga baaxadda leh ee loogu jiro geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka dimuqraadiga ah ee ka socda deegaannada Galmudug, iyadoo haweenku ay qayb weyn ka yihiin tartanka Golaha Deegaanka oo ay ka helayn kaParticipation gaaraya 21.4%.

Shaacinta xogtan ayaa muujinaysa diyaar-garowga baaxadda leh ee loogu jiro geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka dimuqraadiga ah ee ka socda deegaannada Galmudug, iyadoo haweenku ay qayb weyn ka yihiin tartanka Golaha Deegaanka oo ay ka helayn kaParticipation gaaraya 21.4%.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Bartamaha Afrika kala hadashay xoojinta xiriirka ka dhaxeeya
items.description: Addis Ababa ( Raxanreeb Online) Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cali Dhaay, ayaa kulan laba geesood ah la yeeshay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Jamhuuriyadda Bartamaha Afrika, Marwo Sylvie Baïpo-Temon, intii uu socday Kalfadhiga 49-aad ee Golaha Fulinta Midowga Afrika. Labada wasiir ayaa ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga laba geesoodka ah, iyagoo si gaar ah diiradda u saaray horumarinta mudnaanta Midowga Afrika, adkaynta nabadda iyo amniga gobolka, iyo kobcinta iskaashiga dhinacyada horumarinta. Marwo Sylvie Baïpo-Temon ayaa dib u xaqiijisay taageerada hagar la’aanta ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Bartamaha Afrika ay u hayso madaxbannaanida, midnimada, wadajirka dhuleed iyo xornimada siyaasadeed ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Waxay sidoo kale carrabka ku adkaysay in ixtiraamka mabaadi’daas uu saldhig u yahay xasilloonida gobolka iyo ilaalinta nidaamka caalamiga ah ee ku dhisan xeerarka. Kulanka ayaa ku soo dhammaaday guul iyadoo labada dhinac ay muujiyeen sida ay uga go’an tahay sii xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal, iyagoo sii wadi doona wada hadallada iyo iskaashiga dhow ee ay ka yeeshaan Midowga Afrika iyo fagaarayaasha kale ee caalamiga ah. items.title: Somalia: Puntland forces surround PSF camp in Galkayo as conflict fears rise
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Puntland regional forces have surrounded a camp in Galkayo used by Puntland Security Force (PSF) personnel aligned with Somalia’s federal government, intensifying a rapidly escalating standoff that has heightened fears of a broader conflict in the strategic central town, where former Prime Minister Omar Abdirashid Ali Sharmarke has warned that any confrontation could drain resources needed for Somalia’s fight against insurgents. The Daily Somalia news outlet reported on Tuesday that Puntland forces had deployed around all sides of the PSF camp, with tensions between the rival sides reaching their highest level since 2021. The latest deployment follows a sharp deterioration in relations after recent fighting near Bosaso, where Puntland authorities said their forces seized 13 military vehicles, captured 30 PSF members and overran their positions in the Laag area, north of the strategic port city. Puntland authorities have also accused Somalia’s federal government of carrying out military maneuvers in Galkayo aimed at undermining the regional administration. The regional government further said the PSF is neither part of Puntland’s official security forces nor registered under the federal government. The growing military buildup has prompted an increasing number of former Puntland officials to warn against the risk of armed conflict in Galkayo. Former Somali Prime Minister Omar Abdirashid Ali Sharmarke on Tuesday urged Puntland’s leadership to avoid what he described as an unjustified military confrontation, warning that such a conflict would divert critical personnel and equipment from Somalia’s campaign against insurgents. “Galkacyo is not Almiskad. Puntland State authority must refrain itself from waging a war of aggression against fellow Puntland Forces without any legal justifications,” he said. Sharmarke warned that a conflict in Galkayo would carry consequences extending well beyond the immediate battlefield. “The amount of weaponry that has been directed towards this looming conflict in Galkacyo city will definitely drain human and material capital needed for the war on terror. Further, it may trigger some serious consequences including: regional instability, humanitarian crisis and the risk of pulling other forces into this military escalation.” The developments reflect deepening tensions between Puntland and Somalia’s federal government, with the latest military deployments and recent clashes fueling concerns that the standoff could further strain security efforts at a time when the country continues to battle a persistent insurgency. items.title: Maraykanku Waxa Uu Dawladda Ethiopian ku Dhiirigelinayaa Aqoonsiga Somaliland
items.description: Warbixin caalami ah oo lagu daabacay wargeyska The National Interest ayaa sheegtay in dawladda Maraykanku ay dhiirrigelinayso in Itoobiya si rasmi ah u aqoonsato Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Warbixintu waxay tilmaamaysaa in Washington ay aaminsan tahay in tallaabadaasi ay gacan ka geysan karto xoojinta xasilloonida Geeska Afrika, kor u qaadista iskaashiga amniga gobolka, isla markaana ay u adeegi karto danaha istaraatiijiga ah ee Maraykanka. Warbixintan oo Wargeyska Dawan soo xigtay, waxay falanqayn qoto dheer ku samaysay sababaha Maraykanku u taageerayo isla markaana u dhiirrigelinayo aqoonsiga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee dawladda Itoobiya, iyadoo si faahfaahsan u sharraxaysa saamaynta ay tallaabadaasi ku yeelan karto siyaasadda Geeska Afrika, amniga gobolka, isu-dheellitirka awoodaha gobolka, iyo danaha istaraatiijiga ah ee Washington, gaar ahaan kuwa la xidhiidha Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Baabul-Mandab. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, Somaliland tan iyo markii ay dib ula soo noqotay madaxbannaanideeda sannadkii 1991 waxay ku tallaabsatay dhismaha nidaam dimuqraadi ah, hay’ado dowladeed oo shaqaynaya iyo hannaan dawladnimo oo deggan. Waxa kale oo warbixintu xustay in Somaliland ay qabatay doorashooyin xor iyo xalaal ah, isla markaana ay ku guulaysatay ilaalinta amniga iyo xasilloonida gudaha. Sida ay warbixintu ku doodayso, arrimahaasi waxay Somaliland ka dhigayaan saaxiib lagu kalsoonaan karo oo ku habboon iskaashi siyaasadeed, amni iyo mid dhaqaale. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in iskaashi dhow oo dhex mara Maraykanka, Itoobiya iyo Somaliland uu xoojin karo amniga Geeska Afrika, gaar ahaan ilaalinta marin-biyoodka istaraatiijiga ah ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Baabul-Mandab. Waxa ay intaasi ku dartay in Itoobiya, oo aan lahayn marin-badeed, ay u baahan tahay deked ay ku kobciso ganacsigeeda iyo dhaqaalaheeda, iyadoo warbixintu si rasmi ah u soo jeedisay in iskaashiga Somaliland iyo Itoobiya uu dabooli karo baahidaas. Dhanka kale, warbixintu waxay tilmaamaysaa in Maraykanku uu gobolka Geeska Afrika kula jiro tartan istaraatiiji ah quwado ay ka mid yihiin Shiinaha iyo Ruushka. Sida ay warbixintu qabto, iskaashi rasmi ah oo lala yeesho Somaliland wuxuu Maraykanka siin karaa saameyn siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo ballaadhan, isla markaana wuxuu xoojin karaa joogitaankiisa gobolka iyo Badda Cas. Gunaanadkii Warbixinta Wargeyska The National Interest waxay ku talinasaa in Maraykanku sii dhiirrigeliyo Itoobiya inay si rasmi ah u aqoonsato Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isaga oo ku doodaya in tallaabadaasi ay kor u qaadi karto xasilloonida Geeska Afrika, xoojinta iskaashiga gobolka, isla markaana ay si toos ah ugu adeegi karto danaha istaraatiijiga ah ee Maraykanka.

items.title: Somalia denies owning Berlin building
items.description: Somalia’s Federal Government has rejected circulating claims that it owns land in Berlin’s Friedenau district said to house a historic building, with Deputy Foreign Minister Ali Omar Balcad stating on Tuesday that no such property belongs to the state and that Somalia’s embassy in Germany operates from rented premises. The denial comes amid a wave of unverified social media reports claiming Mogadishu holds valuable real estate in the German capital, a narrative the government says is not the first of its kind. Somalia’s Foreign Ministry has previously pushed back against similarly unsubstantiated claims, warning against the spread of misinformation on social media platforms. Balcad addressed the reports directly in a post on his X account, stating that the land in question does not belong to Somalia. “Somalia does not own a building in Berlin, where did this information come from?” Balcad wrote. “Our embassy operates from rented office space. If you have evidence supporting your claim, please present it and help us locate this beautiful building you speak of, or retract these reports.” The deputy minister demanded that anyone circulating the claims produce official documentation proving ownership by Somalia’s embassy in Germany, warning that the reports would otherwise be treated as misleading. Somalia’s government has repeatedly cautioned the public against spreading unverified information, particularly claims relating to state assets and diplomatic property abroad. Officials say such narratives can create false impressions about the country’s foreign holdings and diplomatic footprint. The Friedenau district, located in southwestern Berlin, is known for its residential architecture and 19th and early 20th century buildings, some of which carry heritage protections under German law. No independent verification of the ownership claim has been found in official German property records or Somali government documentation. This is not the first time Somali officials have had to publicly clarify claims involving foreign missions. The Foreign Ministry has in past instances addressed rumors involving embassy operations and diplomatic dealings, urging citizens to rely on official government channels for accurate information. The post Somalia denies owning Berlin building first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Wasiir Fiqi oo si adag uga jawaabay hadal kasoo yeeray maamulka Puntland
items.description: Gaalkacyo ( Raxanreeb Online) Wasiirka wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ee Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa sheegay in wax howlgal ah ay dowladda federaalka ka wadin dhinaca Puntland, waxa uuna ku baaqay in la sii adkeeyo nabadda labada dhinac. “Waxa ay ahayd magaalo aanu dagaal ka dhcin 8 sano ee la soo dhaafay, waxana colaad ugu dambaysay kal xukunkii hore ee madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayuu yiri wasiir Fiqi. Sidoo kale wasiirka ayaa tilmaamay in magaaladan waxa xiisadda ka abuuraya ay yihiin mucaaridka Puntland oo fadhiisimo ka samaystay meelo ka mid ah magaalada iyo agagaarkeedam. Waxa uu beeniyay wasiir Fiqi, in xubnahaas wax taakulo iyo saanad ka heleen dhinaca dowadda federaalka, isla markaana loo soo dhex mariyo Galmudug. Magaalada Gaalkacayo oo ah magaalo ay ka wadataliyaan Galmudug iyo Puntland waana xarunta gobolka Mudug,waxana marta xuduudka maamuullada Puntland iyo Galmudug. Geesta kale Xukuumadda Puntland oo dhawaan la wareegtay hub ay gobolka bari ku haysteen ciidan ka amar qaata dawladda federlaalka ayaa hadda doonaysa in ay sifayso dhammaan ciidankasta oo ay u tuhmayso in ay xiriir la leeyihiin dowladda federaalka. items.title: finance minister sounds alarm over vanishing revenue
items.description: Somalia’s Finance Minister Bihi Imaan Egeh warned on Tuesday in Mogadishu that the country is losing between $450 million and $600 million in income that previously flowed into the economy, and urged accelerated private sector growth to offset the shortfall. The warning lands as Somalia’s federal budget already shows signs of strain, with a July 2026 policy paper projecting a $29 million fiscal deficit and continued heavy reliance on foreign grants. Egeh’s comments frame private enterprise not as a policy preference but as a necessity, given shrinking external support and volatile customs revenue. “The $450 million to $600 million that used to enter the country is disappearing,” Egeh said. “So the situation is really not easy, and it is important that we strengthen the private sector, which is the backbone of economic development.” Despite the pressure, Egeh pointed to gains over the past decade. He said Somalia’s economy has grown from roughly $150 million to about $2.3 billion, alongside a stronger banking sector. Commercial bank financing to the private sector has nearly doubled in five years, reaching approximately $500 million, according to the minister. He said lending to businesses has expanded sharply as banks build capacity. However, Egeh acknowledged a persistent gap: too little of that financing reaches productive sectors such as agriculture, livestock and industry. He called on banks to redirect lending toward domestic production and job creation, calling it essential to sustainable growth. The remarks coincide with a Somali Public Agenda paper showing the 2026 federal budget projects $1.36 billion in total revenues and grants against $1.39 billion in expenditure. Domestic revenue is expected to rise to $479 million, driven by income tax and administrative fee reforms, though customs receipts remain exposed to global trade shocks. External grants make up $878.8 million — nearly 65 percent of total resources — including $174.4 million in direct budget support and $704.4 million for donor-financed projects, underscoring Mogadishu’s continued dependence on foreign financing. Egeh has led Somalia’s Finance Ministry since July 2023, a tenure marked by the country reaching the Heavily Indebted Poor Countries completion point in December 2023, unlocking roughly $4.5 billion in debt relief. His ministry has since launched initiatives such as the World Bank-backed SPRING project, aimed at strengthening private-sector-driven growth. The post finance minister sounds alarm over vanishing revenue first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

His ministry has since launched initiatives such as the World Bank-backed SPRING project, aimed at strengthening private-sector-driven growth. items.title: Puntland-Based Forces Warn Against Armed Confrontation Amid Political Tensions
items.description: GAROWE— Forces led by Jimcaale Jamaac Takar and stationed on the outskirts of Garowe have issued a statement expressing concern over reports of a possible armed confrontation in Puntland and growing tensions among the region’s security forces. In the statement, the forces accused the Puntland administration, particularly President Said Abdullahi Deni, of contributing to the escalation of political and security tensions. They warned against allowing political disagreements to develop into armed clashes that could endanger civilians, undermine stability and create divisions within the security services. The statement called on the people of Puntland and members of the armed forces to exercise restraint and avoid actions that could lead to bloodshed or further political and social fragmentation. The forces urged all parties to resolve their differences through dialogue and peaceful political mechanisms, stressing the need to protect Puntland’s security, stability and social cohesion. The statement also highlighted the role played by the Puntland Security Force, commonly known as the PSF, in maintaining security in the region over the years. It described the PSF as an institution belonging to the people of Puntland and called for unity and cooperation among the region’s security forces. The forces concluded by warning against any political or military action that could trigger renewed violence and instability in Puntland. items.title: Ciidamada oo fariisimo ka sameystay deegaanka laga saaray Shabaab ee Sumadaale
items.description: Ciidanka Kumaandooska Gorgor ee Xoogga Dalka ayaa fariisimo cusub ka sameystay deegaanka Sumadaale ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe, ka dib markii Talaadadii ay dib uga saareen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ayaa shalay sheegtay in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ay burburiyeen fariisimihii iyo godadkii gabaadka u ahaa maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, isla-markaana ay ku guuleysteen inay ka saaraan deegaankaasi. “Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa haatan sii wada hawlgalada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga deegaanka, iyadoo sidoo kale uu sii socdo baacsiga maleeshiyaadkii iyo horjoogeyaashii goobta ka firxaday.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeed ay wasaaraddu soo saartay. Ciidanka Ururka 9aad, Guutada 18aad ee Kumaandooska Gorgor ayaa fariisimo ka sameystay duleedka deegaanka Sumadaale oo hoostaga Degmada Cadale, si halkaasi looga ilaaliyo amniga degmadaasi oo ka mid ah Degmooyinka Hirshabelle ee laga qabanayo doorashada qof iyo codka. Taliyaha Guutada 18aad, Qaybta 1aad ee Kumaandooska Gorgor, Korneyl Aadan Maxamed Faarax ayaa muujiyay in ciidamadu aysan sii joogi doonin deegaankaasi, haddii ay heleen xog ku saabsan meel ay Shabaabku joogaan. Taliyaha oo la hadlay Raadiyaha Ciidamada ayaa shacabka ugu baaqay inay iska dulqaadaan cadowga, isla-markaana ay la shaqeeyaan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Gobolada Hiiraan iyo Shabellaha Dhexe ee Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle ayaa waxaa ka socdo hawlgalo ay ciidamadu cadaadis militari ku saarayaan Al Shabaab, si maleeshiyadu aysan u carqaladayn doorashada ay dadweynaha ku soo dooranayaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Hirshabelle. Shabaabka ayaa Sumadaale qabsaday bishii March ee sanadkii hore, waana intii ay socdeen weeraradii ay bishii February ka bilaabeen bariga Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe ee socday illaa bishii April ee sanadkaasi. Weeraradan oo ahaa kuwo ka yaabiyay dadka deegaanka ayay Shabaabku xilligaasi ku qabsadeen Degmooyinka Ceelbaraf, Alkowsar, Aadan Yabaal iyo deegaano kaloo badan oo dhaca bariga gobolkaasi.

items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaarihii Hore ee Soomaaliya Cumar Cabdirashiid oo Puntland uga digay isku dhac ciidan oo ka dhaca Gaalkacyo
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Cumar Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke, ayaa ugu baaqay maamulka Puntland inuu ka waantoobo dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo isku dhac ka abuuri kara magaalada Gaalkacyo, isagoo ka digay in xaaladahaani ay dib u soo celin karaan xasilooni darro iyo barakac ka dhaca xarunta gobolka Mudug. Qoraal uu soo dhigay baraha bulshada ayuu Cumar Cabdirashiid ku naqdiyay dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidamada Puntland ee Gaalkacyo, isagoo madaxda maamulkaas ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan isku dhac dhexmara ciidamada maamulka iyo kuwa deegaanka, waxaana uu yiri “Gaalkacyo maaha Calmiskaat, maamulku waa inuu joojiyaa isku dhac kasta oo aan cudurdaar sharci ah lahayn.” Sidoo kale, Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ayaa sheegay in hubka iyo dhaqaalaha loo weecinayo abaabulka ciidan ee Gaalkacyo ay yihiin kuwa hoos u dhigaya awooddii iyo dhaqaalihii loo baahnaa in lagula dagaallamo kooxaha argagixisada ah. Wuxuu ugu baaqay madaxda dhaqanka, culimada, iyo mas’uuliyiinta dowladda in ay u istaagaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa xiisaddaan, iyadoo khilaafaadka lagu xallinayo wada-hadal. Xiisaddaan ayaa soo if-baxday kadib markii Puntland ay dhawaan ka digtay in maamulka Galmudug uu u ogolaado hub iyo ciidamo inay sii maraan deegaannadiisa si ay u galaan dhulka Puntland maamusho. Galmudug ayaa dhankeeda beenisay eedeymahaas, iyadoo caddaysay inay diyaar u tahay in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wada-hadal. Magaalada Gaalkacyo, oo u kala qaybsan dhanka waqooyi oo ay maamusho Puntland iyo dhanka koonfur oo ay Galmudug gacanta ku hayso, ayaa horay u soo martay xiisado beeleed iyo isku dhacyo hubeysan, waxaana dhaqdhaqaaq kasta oo ciidan oo halkaas laga dareemo uu yahay mid walaac dhaliya.

items.title: Jubaland oo war culus kasoo saartay xiisadda Puntland ka taagan maamulka Deni iyo DF
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Jubbaland oo warsaxaafadeed soo saaray ayaa ka hadlay xiisadda u dhexeysa Dowladda Federaalka iyo Puntland, isaga oo garab istaag u muujiyay xukuumadda Madaxweyne Saciid Deni, xilli haatan labada dhinac ay wadaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo iska soo horjeedo. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Jubbaland, Cabdifitaax Maxamed Mukhtaar oo isagu qoraalka soo saaray ayaa sheegay in fashilkii ay Dowladda Federaalka kala kulantay duulaankii Jubbaland kadib ay cadaadiska u wareejisay Puntland, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, markii ay ku fashilantay duullaannadii ay ku qaadday Jubbaland, isla markaana shacabka reer Jubbaland ay si adag isaga difaaceen, ayay hadda damaceedii iyo cadaadiskii siyaasadeed u weecisay Puntland,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Warfaafinta Maamulka Jubbaland. Cabdifitaax Maxamed Mukhtaar ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in shacabka Puntland ay kalsooni ku qabaan dowladooda, isla markaana ay iska difaaci doonaan wax kasta oo wax u dhimaya nabaddooda iyo midnimadooda. Sidoo kale, Wasiirka ayaa weerar ku qaaday Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, wuxuuna sheegay in siyaasaddiisa ay ku dhisan tahay cadaadis, balse uu ka dhexli doono cawaaqib xumo, sida uu ku dooday. “Xaqiiqadu waxay tahay in shacabka iyo Dowladda Puntland ay sidoo kale si adag uga hortagi doonaan damac kasta oo wax u dhimaya nabadda, xasilloonida iyo dowladnimadooda. Xasan Sheekh waa inuu fahmaa in siyaasadda aysan ku dhisnayn awood iyo cadaadis oo keliya, balse ay leedahay xisaab iyo cawaaqib. Tallaabo kasta oo qardajeex ah oo la qaado waxay dhalin kartaa xisaab siyaasadeed oo mustaqbalka la isugu yimaado,” ayuu mar kale yiri Wasiirku. Jubbaland iyo Puntland ayaa haatan ah xulafo siyaasadeed oo ku wada jira Golaha Mustaqbalka, waxayna si wayn uga soo horjeedaan qorshaha Dowladda Federaalka ee la xiriira doorasho qof iyo cod ah oo ka dhacda dalka. Horay Puntland ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ugu eedeysay inuu wado dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo lagu hurinayo colaado, laguna wiiqayo nidaamka dowladnimo ee maamulkaasi. Warsaxaafadeed ay Puntland soo saartay 25-kii bishan July ayay Xasan Sheekh ku tilmaantay “Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday”, iyada oo sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo maalmihii u dambeeyey ka socday qaybo ka mid ah deegaannadeeda iyo meelaha ku dhow. items.title: Shabaab oo 5 askari ku dilay weerar ay ku qaadeen Kenya
items.description: Mandheera (Caasimada Online) — Shan ka tirsan ciidamada ammaanka Kenya ayaa lagu dilay iska-horimaad ay la galeen dagaalyahanno looga shakisan yahay inay ka tirsan yihiin kooxda Al-Shabaab, kaas oo ka dhacay degmada Mandheera ee ku dhow xadka Soomaaliya, sida ay booliska Kenya sheegeen. Iska-horimaadka ayaa dhacay duhurnimadii Talaadada, kaddib markii cutub ka tirsan ciidamada gaarka ah ee SOG Alungu uu dagaalyahannada kula kulmay deegaanka guud ee biyo-xireenka Wantey Dam. “Ciidamo roondo ah oo ka socday SOG Alungu ayaa dagaalyahanno Al-Shabaab ah kula kulmay deegaanka guud ee Wantey Dam,” ayaa lagu yiri warbixin ay boolisku soo saareen. Booliska ayaa sheegay inay ciidamada ammaanku weli baadi-goobayaan dagaalyahannadii ka dambeeyay weerarka, kuwaas oo goobta ka baxsaday kaddib iska-horimaadka. Ciidamo gurmad ahaan loogu diray deegaanka ayaa sidoo kale lala beegsaday qarax miino oo lagu aasay waddada. Qaraxa ayaa burburiyay gaari gaashaaman, hase yeeshee booliska ayaa sheegay in uusan geysan wax dhimasho ama dhaawac ah. Kooxda Al-Shabaab ayaa khasaare intaas aad uga badan ka sheegatay weerarka. Warbaahinta kooxda ayaa sheegtay in dhimashada ciidamada Kenya ay gaarayso ugu yaraan 13 askari, halka dhaawacana yahya 12 askari. Warbaahinta koxoda waxay sidoo kale sheegatay in weerarka ku gubeen gaari gaashaaman oo noociisu ahaa Taw iyo sidoo kale 5 Mooto. Ma jirto cid si madax-banaan u xaqiijin karta sheegashada kooxda, oo inta badan caan ku ah in ay weriso khasaare ka badan kan dhabta ah. Al-Shabaab ayaa muddo sannado ah dagaal kula jirtay dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo dooneysa inay xukunka la wareegto, kuna soo rogto dalka fahamkeeda adag ee shareecada Islaamka. Kooxda ayaa sidoo kale weerarro joogto ah ka fulisa deegaannada waqooyi-bari Kenya ee xadka la wadaaga Soomaaliya, iyadoo bartilmaameedsata ciidamada ammaanka, saraakiisha dowladda iyo dadka rayidka ah. Bishii Janaayo, booliska Kenya ayaa sheegay in dagaalyahanno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab ay dileen guddoomiye deegaan iyo macallin ku sugnaa degmada Gaarisa, oo deris la ah Mandheera. items.title: Mareykanka iyo UK oo wada qorshe la xiriira Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladaha Mareykanka iyo Britain ayaa qorsheynaya dadaal diblomaasiyadeed oo cusub oo lagu doonayo in madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka Soomaaliya la isugu keeno wada-hadallo kama dambeys ah oo looga gaarayo heshiis siyaasadeed oo dhameystiran oo ku saabsan doorashooyinka dalka, sida ay sheegeen ilo xog-ogaal ah. Kulanka la qorsheynayo ayaa la filayaa inay ka qeyb-galaan madaxda maamul-goboleedyada Puntland iyo Jubaland, hoggaamiyeyaasha sare ee Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ee fadhigoodu yahay Muqdisho, iyo madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Ilo diblomaasiyadeed ayaa sheegay in qorshahan loo arko dadaalkii ugu dambeeyey ee lagu jebin lahaa ismari-waaga siyaasadeed ee muddo bilo ah ka taagnaa arrimaha doorashooyinka, wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka iyo qaabka loo wajahayo marxaladda siyaasadeed ee soo socota. Hase yeeshee, ilaha ayaa ka digay in rajada laga qabo in kulankaasi keeno heshiis weyn ay weli hooseyso, sababo la xiriira kala fogaanshaha mowqifyada dowladda federaalka, maamul-goboleedyada qaarkood iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka. Dowladda federaalka ayaa ku adkeysanaysa qorshaheeda doorasho qof iyo cod ah, halka Puntland, Jubaland iyo inta badan mucaaradka ay ku baaqayaan heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay ka hor inta aan la hirgelin hannaan doorasho oo cusub. Ilo diblomaasiyadeed ayaa sheegay in dowladaha reer Galbeedka ay toddobaadyadii dambe kordhiyeen dadaallada lagu raadinayo xal laga gaaro arrimaha doorashada. Diblomaasiyiinta ayaa ka digay in sii socoshada khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ay wiiqi karto horumarrada laga sameeyey dhismaha hay’adaha dowladda, dib-u-habeynta maamulka, tayeynta ciidamada ammaanka iyo taageerada dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya ka hesho saaxiibadeeda caalamka. Mucaaradka oo waraaq diray Dadaalladan ayaa imanaya ayada oo hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ay warqad furan u direen dowladaha Afrikaanka ah ee ciidamada ku biiriyey howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya ee AUSSOM. Mucaaradka ayaa dalalkaasi ugu baaqay inay mudnaanta siiyaan heshiis siyaasadeed oo dhameystiran ka hor inta aan la sii dardargelin qorshaha ay ciidamada Soomaaliya kula wareegayaan mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. Warqadda ayaa lagu soo jeediyay in la sameeyo “Gole ku-meel gaar ah oo loo dhan yahay”, kaas oo maamula geeddi-socodka dastuurka iyo doorashooyinka ilaa laga soo dhisayo hay’ado qaran oo sharciyad lagu wada qanacsan yahay. Waxay sheegeen in heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay uu muhiim u yahay qabashada doorashooyin qaran oo lagu wada qanacsan yahay, isla markaana lagu soo afjaro waxa ay ku tilmaameen “firaaq dastuuri ah” iyo hubanti la’aanta siyaasadeed ee dalka ka jirta. Mucaaradka ayaa sidoo kale ka digay in ciidamada ammaanka iyo taageerada caalamiga ah loo adeegsado xoojinta hal dhinac oo siyaasadeed, iyagoo ku baaqay in howlgalka AUSSOM iyo dowladaha taageera Soomaaliya ay dhexdhexaad ka noqdaan khilaafka siyaasadeed. Warqadda ayaa carro ka dhex-abuurtay shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Dad badan ayaa fahmay in mucaaradku doonayo in meesha laga saaro hay’adaha dowladda ee hadda jira, laguna beddelo gole aan la dooran, inkasta oo warqaddu aanay si cad u sheegin in la kala dirayo madaxtooyada, baarlamaanka ama xukuumadda. Mucaaradka oo is khilaafay Hase yeeshee, warqadda ayaa muujisay kala aragti duwanaansho ka dhex jira kooxaha ku mideysan mucaaradka. Xildhibaan Maxamed Abuukar Islow, oo ka tirsan Isbahaysiga Haybad Qaran iyo Xaqsoor, kana mid ah isbahaysiyada ku jira Golaha Mustaqbalka, ayaa sheegay inuu la yaabay qoraalka lagu dalbaday gole ku-meelgaar ah. “Haddii qoraalkaasi sax yahay, waa wax aad looga xumaado inay maanta jiraan dad mustaqbal ka leh hoggaaminta dalka oo doonaya in Soomaaliya dib loogu celiyo ku-meelgaarnimo,” ayuu yiri Islow. Waxa uu sheegay in xal loo baahan yahay laga gaaro madaxweyne muddo-xileedkiisa dhammaaday iyo hannaan doorasho oo heshiis lagu yahay, balse aan hay’adaha dowladeed lagu beddeli karin gole ay soo xuleen shaqsiyaad aan sharciyad haysan. “Shaqsi ahaan waxaan qabaa inaan cidna lagu metelin taladan oo kasoo horjeedda danta, dalka iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri. Guddoomiyihii hore ee gobolka Banaadir Thaabit Cabdi Maxamed, oo isna ka tirsan isla isbahaysiga, ayaa si la mid ah uga digay in dib loogu noqdo nidaam ku-meelgaar ah. “Dowladnimadu ma aha wax si sahlan loo dayici karo,” ayuu yiri Thaabit, isaga oo sheegay in wiiqidda sharciyadda hay’adaha hadda jira iyo dhismaha gole cusub ay Soomaaliya dib u celin karto 15 sano. Thaabit ayaa ku dooday in xalka ugu dhow uu yahay in lala xaajoodo madaxda muddo-xileedkooda lagu muransan yahay, labada dhinacna ay sameeyaan tanaasul siyaasadeed. “Khilaafaadka siyaasadeed waa la xallin karaa haddii la hormariyo wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad, maadaama gobonnimada iyo jiritaanka dowladnimada Soomaaliya ay ka weyn yihiin khilaafka siyaasadeed ee dhexdeenna ah,” ayuu yiri. items.title: Trump oo Aqalka Cad ku qaabilay Raysal Wasaaraha Israel
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu kulan aad u wanaagsan la yeeshay Raysal Wasaaraha Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu oo Talaadadii uu ku qaabilay Aqalka Cad. Madaxweynaha ayaa tilmaamay in kulanka oo ay qayb ka ahaayeen xubno ka tirsan Congress-ka Mareykanka looga hadlay arrimo badan oo muhiim ah, sida uu yiri. “Raysal Wasaaraha Israel Bibi Netanyahu, aniga iyo Xildhibaano ayaa yeelanay kulan aad u wanaagsan. Sida muuqata waxaa laga hadlay arrimo badan oo muhiim ah.” Ayuu Trump ku qoray bartiisa Truth Social, isagoo soo raaciyay sawirro dhowr ah oo laga qaaday kulankaas. Trump ayaan sharaxaad ka bixin arrimaha ay sida dhow uga wada hadleen Netanyahu, balse war ka soo baxay Aqalka Cad ayaa lagu sheegay in ay yeesheen wada hadalo wax ku ool ah. Xoghayaha Warfaafinta ee Aqalka Cad, Karoline Leavitt ayaa sheegtay in Trump iyo Netanyahu ay yeesheen kulan albaabada u xirnaayeen oo qaatay ku dhawaad ​​saacad iyo bar, uuna ahaa mid wanaagsan oo miro-dhal ah. Netanyahu ayaa dhankiisa sheegay inuu kulan aad u wanaagsan la qaatay Madaxweyne Trump, iyadoo kulanku uu Netanyahu u furay fursad uu ku xaliyo mad madowga soo kala dhex galay xiriirkooda, waxayna ahayd markii ugu horreysay oo ay kulmaan muddo billo ah. Kulanka ku dhex maray Xafiiska Oval ee Aqalka Cad ayaa ah kiisii ugu horreyay oo fool ka fool ah oo labada hoggaamiye ay yeeshaan, tan iyo duulaankii wadajirka ahaa ee Mareykanka iyo Israel ay 28-kii bishii February ku qaadeen Iran. Kulankan ayaa ku soo beegmay, xilli ay jireen kala aragti duwanaansho ku aaddan in diblomaasiyadda la siiyo fursad iyo in cadaadiska militari ee ka dhanka ah Iran uu sii socdo.

items.title: Netanyahu oo bah-dil kala kulmay booqashadii Aqalka Cad
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa Talaadadii kulan ku yeeshay Aqalka Cad, xilli xiriirkooda uu wajahayo khilaaf sii kordhaya, shan bilood kaddib markii labada dal ay bilaabeen dagaalka Iran oo noqday mid ka adag sidii ay labada hoggaamiye filayeen. Xiisadda u dhexeysa Trump iyo Netanyahu ayaa toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay si tartiib ah u sii xoogeysanaysay, waxaana ilaa dabayaaqadii toddobaadkii hore aan la hubin in madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu oggolaan doono inuu la kulmo ra’iisul wasaaraha Israel. Si kulanka loo xaqiijiyo, maamulka Trump ayaa Netanyahu ku cadaadiyey inuu qaado tallaabooyin muujinaya inuu dhab ka yahay horumarinta wada-hadallada nabadeed ee Mareykanku garwadeenka ka yahay ee Gaza iyo Lubnaan, sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiin iyo dad xog-ogaal u ah arrinta. Trump oo ka carooday cadaadiska Iran Saacado ka hor kulanka, Trump ayaa u muuqday inuu ka carooday suurta-galnimada ah in Israel ay si fagaare ah Aqalka Cad ugu cadaadineyso inuu sii wado dagaalka Iran. Wareysi uu siiyey Fox News ayuu Trump ku sheegay in goob Iran ku taalla oo lagu magacaabo Pickaxe Mountain, taas oo ay sirdoonka Israel dhowaan diiradda saareen, aysan ahayn “dhibaato weyn.” Hadalkaas ayaa muujiyey kala duwanaanshaha u dhexeeya labada hoggaamiye ee ku saabsan sida loo wajaho Iran iyo in dagaalka hadda socda la sii ballaariyo. Kulanka oo socday ku dhowaad saacad markii uu soo dhammaaday, Netanyahu ayaa ku tilmaamay “mid ka mid ah wada-hadalladii ugu wanaagsanaa” ee uu abid la yeesho Trump. Sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan Aqalka Cad ayaa sheegay in Trump uu xiriir wanaagsan la leeyahay Netanyahu, wuxuuna Israel ku ammaanay inay Mareykanka ka caawisay wiiqidda awoodda Iran ee horumarinta hub nukliyeer ah. Si kastaba, labada dhinac midkoodna ma bixin tilmaam cad oo ku saabsan istaraatiijiyadda dhow ee Aqalka Cad ee Iran iyo kaalinta ay Israel ku yeelan doonto. Saameyntii Netanyahu oo hoos u dhacday Netanyahu ayaa muddo bilo ah raadinayey kulan uu la yeesho Trump, xilli uu gudaha Israel kala kulmayo dhaleeceyn sii kordheysa, doorashooyinna ay soo dhow yihiin. Mas’uuliyiin ayaa sheegay in Netanyahu uu Washington ku yimid isaga oo leh saameyn iyo awood siyaasadeed oo ka yar tii uu lahaa booqashooyinkiisii hore. Waxa uu sidoo kale si gaar ah uga taxaddarayey waxyaabaha uu Trump doonayo in laga hadlo iyo arrimaha laga yaabo inay ka careysiiyaan madaxweynaha Mareykanka. Geerida Senator Lindsey Graham ayaa iyaduna dharbaaxo weyn ku noqotay Netanyahu, maadaama senatarkii Jamhuuriga ahaa ee South Carolina uu muddo dheer ahaa dhex-dhexaadiye isku xira Trump iyo hoggaamiyaha Israel. Dhibaatooyinka siyaasadeed ee Netanyahu ku haysta Mareykanka ayaa bilooyinkii lasoo dhaafay sii kordhayey, isaga oo wajahaya cadaadis uga imaanaya xubno ka tirsan xisbiga Jamhuuriga ee Trump iyo sidoo kale Dimuqraadiyiinta. Ka hor booqashadiisa, Trump ayaa si gaar ah saaxiibbadiisa ugu muujiyey caro uu ka qabo Netanyahu, isaga oo sidoo kale wareysiyo fagaare ah ku muujiyey niyad-jab ku saabsan sida uu dagaalka Iran u sii dheeraaday. Gaza iyo Lubnaan oo khilaafka qeyb ka ah Qodobbada khilaafka ka dhex abuuray Mareykanka iyo Israel waxaa ka mid ah dagaalka Gaza iyo colaadda ka taagan Lubnaan ee u dhexeysa Israel iyo xoogagga Xisbullah ee Iran taageerto. Si kulanka Trump loo xaqiijiyo, Netanyahu ayaa oggolaaday in ciidamada Israel dib looga soo saaro waxa loogu yeeray “aagagga tijaabada” ee koonfurta Lubnaan. Ciidamada dowladda Lubnaan ayaa loo daabulayaa goobahaas, si loo tijaabiyo awooddooda ay ku sugi karaan ammaanka deegaannada la cayimay. Netanyahu ayaa sidoo kale ku dhawaaqay in Israel ay xubnaha Golaha Nabadda ee uu Trump hoggaamiyo u oggolaan doonto inay galaan Gaza, kaddib bilo ay arrintaasi hakad ku jirtay. Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel kama jawaabin codsi faallo ah oo loo diray. Kulanka Trump kaddib, Netanyahu ayaa ka qeyb galay aaska Senator Lindsey Graham. Markii martidu ku qulquleysay Washington National Cathedral, Netanyahu ayaa la arkayey isaga oo la sheekeysanaya mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan maamulka Mareykanka. Waxaa ka mid ahaa safiirka Mareykanka ee Qaramada Midoobay Mike Waltz, Xoghayaha Ganacsiga Howard Lutnick iyo Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky, oo isaguna Trump la kulmay maalintaas. Markii weriyaha Fox News Sean Hannity uu ka hadlay aaska Graham, wuxuu ku tilmaamay senatarka inuu ahaa saaxiibkii ugu weynaa ee Israel. Netanyahu iyo xaaskiisa oo fadhiyey goobta ayaa madaxa u ruxay si ay u muujiyaan inay hadalkaas ku raacsan yihiin. Dagaalka Iiraan oo sii dheeraaday Kulankii ugu dambeeyey ee Trump iyo Netanyahu ayaa dhacay bishii Febraayo, wax yar ka hor inta aan la bilaabin duqeymaha wadajirka ah ee Mareykanka iyo Israel ay ka fuliyeen Iran. Waqtigaas, Netanyahu iyo madaxii hore ee hay’adda sirdoonka Israel ee Mossad ayaa Trump u bandhigay qorshe lagu doonayey in lagu rido maamulka Iran, sida uu sheegay sarkaal Israeli ah. Dagaalka ayaa haatan socday muddo ka dheer intii Trump markii hore saadaaliyey, wuxuuna weli yahay mid aan taageero badan ka haysan cod-bixiyeyaasha Mareykanka. Arrintaas ayaa Netanyahu ku abuurtay dhibaatooyin siyaasadeed oo uga imaanaya Jamhuuriga iyo Dimoqraadiyiinta labadaba. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Mareykanka JD Vance ayaa dhowaan ku eedeeyey xubno ka tirsan dowladda Israel inay ka dambeeyaan olole xiriirka dadweynaha ah oo lagu doonayo in dagaalka “si aan xad lahayn loo sii wado.” Hadalladaas oo uu Vance ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyey Joe Rogan ayaa muujiyey khilaafka sii kordhaya ee xisbiga Jamhuuriga dhexdiisa ee ku saabsan mustaqbalka xiriirka Mareykanka iyo Israel. Sidoo kale bishan, in ka badan 100 xubnood oo Dimoqraadiyiin ah oo ka tirsan Aqalka Wakiillada ayaa u codeeyey wax-ka-beddel lagu joojin lahaa maalgelinta milateri ee Mareykanka siiyo Israel. items.fullContent: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa Talaadadii kulan ku yeeshay Aqalka Cad, xilli xiriirkooda uu wajahayo khilaaf sii kordhaya, shan bilood kaddib markii labada dal ay bilaabeen dagaalka Iran oo noqday mid ka adag sidii ay labada hoggaamiye filayeen. Xiisadda u dhexeysa Trump iyo Netanyahu ayaa toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay si tartiib ah u sii xoogeysanaysay, waxaana ilaa dabayaaqadii toddobaadkii hore aan la hubin in madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu oggolaan doono inuu la kulmo ra’iisul wasaaraha Israel. Si kulanka loo xaqiijiyo, maamulka Trump ayaa Netanyahu ku cadaadiyey inuu qaado tallaabooyin muujinaya inuu dhab ka yahay horumarinta wada-hadallada nabadeed ee Mareykanku garwadeenka ka yahay ee Gaza iyo Lubnaan, sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiin iyo dad xog-ogaal u ah arrinta. Trump oo ka carooday cadaadiska Iran Saacado ka hor kulanka, Trump ayaa u muuqday inuu ka carooday suurta-galnimada ah in Israel ay si fagaare ah Aqalka Cad ugu cadaadineyso inuu sii wado dagaalka Iran. Wareysi uu siiyey Fox News ayuu Trump ku sheegay in goob Iran ku taalla oo lagu magacaabo Pickaxe Mountain, taas oo ay sirdoonka Israel dhowaan diiradda saareen, aysan ahayn “dhibaato weyn.” Hadalkaas ayaa muujiyey kala duwanaanshaha u dhexeeya labada hoggaamiye ee ku saabsan sida loo wajaho Iran iyo in dagaalka hadda socda la sii ballaariyo. Kulanka oo socday ku dhowaad saacad markii uu soo dhammaaday, Netanyahu ayaa ku tilmaamay “mid ka mid ah wada-hadalladii ugu wanaagsanaa” ee uu abid la yeesho Trump. Sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan Aqalka Cad ayaa sheegay in Trump uu xiriir wanaagsan la leeyahay Netanyahu, wuxuuna Israel ku ammaanay inay Mareykanka ka caawisay wiiqidda awoodda Iran ee horumarinta hub nukliyeer ah. Si kastaba, labada dhinac midkoodna ma bixin tilmaam cad oo ku saabsan istaraatiijiyadda dhow ee Aqalka Cad ee Iran iyo kaalinta ay Israel ku yeelan doonto. Saameyntii Netanyahu oo hoos u dhacday Netanyahu ayaa muddo bilo ah raadinayey kulan uu la yeesho Trump, xilli uu gudaha Israel kala kulmayo dhaleeceyn sii kordheysa, doorashooyinna ay soo dhow yihiin. Mas’uuliyiin ayaa sheegay in Netanyahu uu Washington ku yimid isaga oo leh saameyn iyo awood siyaasadeed oo ka yar tii uu lahaa booqashooyinkiisii hore. Waxa uu sidoo kale si gaar ah uga taxaddarayey waxyaabaha uu Trump doonayo in laga hadlo iyo arrimaha laga yaabo inay ka careysiiyaan madaxweynaha Mareykanka. Geerida Senator Lindsey Graham ayaa iyaduna dharbaaxo weyn ku noqotay Netanyahu, maadaama senatarkii Jamhuuriga ahaa ee South Carolina uu muddo dheer ahaa dhex-dhexaadiye isku xira Trump iyo hoggaamiyaha Israel. Dhibaatooyinka siyaasadeed ee Netanyahu ku haysta Mareykanka ayaa bilooyinkii lasoo dhaafay sii kordhayey, isaga oo wajahaya cadaadis uga imaanaya xubno ka tirsan xisbiga Jamhuuriga ee Trump iyo sidoo kale Dimuqraadiyiinta. Ka hor booqashadiisa, Trump ayaa si gaar ah saaxiibbadiisa ugu muujiyey caro uu ka qabo Netanyahu, isaga oo sidoo kale wareysiyo fagaare ah ku muujiyey niyad-jab ku saabsan sida uu dagaalka Iran u sii dheeraaday. Gaza iyo Lubnaan oo khilaafka qeyb ka ah Qodobbada khilaafka ka dhex abuuray Mareykanka iyo Israel waxaa ka mid ah dagaalka Gaza iyo colaadda ka taagan Lubnaan ee u dhexeysa Israel iyo xoogagga Xisbullah ee Iran taageerto. Si kulanka Trump loo xaqiijiyo, Netanyahu ayaa oggolaaday in ciidamada Israel dib looga soo saaro waxa loogu yeeray “aagagga tijaabada” ee koonfurta Lubnaan. Ciidamada dowladda Lubnaan ayaa loo daabulayaa goobahaas, si loo tijaabiyo awooddooda ay ku sugi karaan ammaanka deegaannada la cayimay. Netanyahu ayaa sidoo kale ku dhawaaqay in Israel ay xubnaha Golaha Nabadda ee uu Trump hoggaamiyo u oggolaan doonto inay galaan Gaza, kaddib bilo ay arrintaasi hakad ku jirtay. Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel kama jawaabin codsi faallo ah oo loo diray. Kulanka Trump kaddib, Netanyahu ayaa ka qeyb galay aaska Senator Lindsey Graham. Markii martidu ku qulquleysay Washington National Cathedral, Netanyahu ayaa la arkayey isaga oo la sheekeysanaya mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan maamulka Mareykanka. Waxaa ka mid ahaa safiirka Mareykanka ee Qaramada Midoobay Mike Waltz, Xoghayaha Ganacsiga Howard Lutnick iyo Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky, oo isaguna Trump la kulmay maalintaas. Markii weriyaha Fox News Sean Hannity uu ka hadlay aaska Graham, wuxuu ku tilmaamay senatarka inuu ahaa saaxiibkii ugu weynaa ee Israel. Netanyahu iyo xaaskiisa oo fadhiyey goobta ayaa madaxa u ruxay si ay u muujiyaan inay hadalkaas ku raacsan yihiin. Dagaalka ayaa haatan socday muddo ka dheer intii Trump markii hore saadaaliyey, wuxuuna weli yahay mid aan taageero badan ka haysan cod-bixiyeyaasha Mareykanka. Arrintaas ayaa Netanyahu ku abuurtay dhibaatooyin siyaasadeed oo uga imaanaya Jamhuuriga iyo Dimoqraadiyiinta labadaba. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Mareykanka JD Vance ayaa dhowaan ku eedeeyey xubno ka tirsan dowladda Israel inay ka dambeeyaan olole xiriirka dadweynaha ah oo lagu doonayo in dagaalka “si aan xad lahayn loo sii wado.” Hadalladaas oo uu Vance ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyey Joe Rogan ayaa muujiyey khilaafka sii kordhaya ee xisbiga Jamhuuriga dhexdiisa ee ku saabsan mustaqbalka xiriirka Mareykanka iyo Israel. items.title: Sacuudiga iyo Mareykanka oo duqeymo ka fuliyay Ciraaq, xiisadda gobolka oo sii korortay
items.description: Dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sheegtay inay, iyadoo iskaashi la sameynaysa Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM), duqeymo bartilmaameed ah ka fulisay kooxo hubeysan oo ay ku tilmaantay kuwo ay Iiraan taageerto, kuwaas oo ku sugan gudaha Ciraaq. Wasaaradda Difaaca Sacuudiga ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in weerarradan ay jawaab u ahaayeen weerarro diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn (drones) oo dhowaan lagu bartilmaameedsaday xarumo shidaal oo ku yaalla Bariga Sacuudiga iyo gobolka Riyaad. Dowladda Sucuudiga ayaa intaas ku dartay in difaacyadeeda cirka ay soo rideen dhowr drone oo la sheegay in laga soo diray dhulka Ciraaq. Dhanka kale, Ciidamada loo yaqaanno PMF ee Ciraaq ayaa sheegay in siddeed ka tirsan xubnahooda lagu dilay duqeymaha, halka afar kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. PMF waxay ku tilmaantay weerarka mid halis gelinaya amniga gobolka isla markaana xadgudub ku ah madaxbannaanida Ciraaq. Kooxda Islamic Resistance in Iraq, oo ay ku mideysan yihiin kooxo ay Iiraan taageerto, ayaa beenisay inay wax lug ah ku lahayd weerarradii drones-ka ee lagu qaaday Sacuudiga. Waxay ku tilmaantay eedeymaha Sacuudiga kuwo aan sal iyo raad lahayn, iyagoo sidoo kale ka digay inay si adag uga jawaabi doonaan tallaabo kasta oo militari oo ka dhan ah. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Ciraaq, Cali Al-Zaidi, ayaa la filayaa inuu booqasho ku tago Sacuudi Carabiya maalinta Khamiista, maalmo kadib markii uu amar ku bixiyay in baaritaan lagu sameeyo weerarradii drones-ka ee lagu qaaday Sacuudiga. Dowladda Ciraaq ayaa hore u sheegtay inay ka go’an tahay inaan dhulkeeda loo adeegsan weerarro lagu qaado dalalka deriska ah. Duqeymihii ugu dambeeyay ayaa imanaya iyadoo xiisadda u dhaxaysa Sacuudiga, Mareykanka iyo kooxaha ay Iiraan taageerto ay sii kordhayso, arrintaas oo sare u qaadaysa walaaca laga qabo in colaaddu ku fido dalal kale oo Bariga Dhexe ah.

items.title: Maxaa lagu heshiiyey kulankii qarsoonaa ee Trump iyo Netanyahu?
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil, Benjamin Netanyahu, ayaa Talaadadii booqday Aqalka Cad ee Maraykanka, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay madaxweyne Donald Trump markii ugu horreysay tan iyo markii Israa’iil iyo Maraykanku si wadajir ah dagaal ula galeen Iiraan. Dagaalkaas ayaa waxaa hareeyay khilaafyo iyo ismaandhaafyo ka dhex jiray xidhiidhka labada hoggaamiye. Netanyahu ayaa sheegay in uu kulan “aad u wanaagsan” uu la yeeshay Trump, isla markaana ay diiradda saareen hadafka ay wadaagaan ee ah in Iiraan laga hor istaago inay hesho hub nukliyeer ah. “Waxaan hadda soo gabagabeeyey kulan aad u wanaagsan oo aan la yeeshay Madaxweyne Trump,” ayuu Netanyahu ku sheegay muuqaal uu baahiyey, isaga oo intaas ku daray in kulanku ku salaysnaa “faham wadajir ah oo ku aaddan hadafkeenna guud ee ah inaan hubinno in Iiraan aysan yeelan hub nukliyeer ah.” Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in kulankan uu ahaa kii ugu horreeyey ee ay yeeshaan tan iyo markii dalalkoodu bilaabeen dagaalka ka dhanka ah Iiraan bishii Febraayo, isagoo yiri: “Tani waxay ahayd mid ka mid ah wada-hadalladii ugu wanaagsanaa ee aan abid la yeesho madaxweyne Maraykan ah, saaxiibkeen Donald Trump.” Xidhiidhka labada hoggaamiye ayaa gaadhay heerkii ugu liitay bishii Abriil, xilligii wada-hadallada xabbad-joojinta ee u dhexeeyey Maraykanka iyo Iiraan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xaaladdu waxay sii xumaatay wixii ka dambeeyey 7-dii Luulyo, markii dagaalladu dib uga qarxeen Maraykanka iyo Iiraan, iyadoo Israa’iil aanay markan si toos ah uga qaybgelin. Waxaa la filayey in dagaalka Iiraan uu noqdo qodobka ugu weyn ee lagaga hadlayo kulanka albaabbadu u xidhan yihiin, xilli Washington ay ku adkaysanayso inay weli fursad siinayso waddada wada-hadallada diblomaasiyadeed ee ay la leedahay Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan. Kulanka, oo Aqalka Cad ku tilmaamay mid “wanaagsan oo miro-dhal ah”, ayaa socday ku dhowaad saacad iyo badh. Waxa uu ahaa kulankii siddeedaad ee dhex mara Netanyahu iyo Trump tan iyo markii Trump dib ugu soo laabtay Aqalka Cad sannadkii hore, isaga oo bilaabay muddo-xileedkiisii labaad ee aan isku xigin. Wargeyska Israa’iil ee Yediot Aharonot ayaa arrintan ka faallooday, isagoo sheegay in “aanu jirin hoggaamiye kale oo caalami ah oo intaas jeer kula kulmay Trump muddadiisa xil-haynta ee hadda jirta.” Netanyahu ayaa ka hor intuusan Isniintii ka bixin Israa’iil sheegay in kulankiisa Trump uu yahay “sharaf weyn, balse sidoo kale masuuliyad culus.” Wuxuu yidhi: “Waxaan ka wada hadli doonnaa dhammaan arrimaha miiska saaran, kuwa ugu horreeyana waa Iiraan. Dabcan, hadafkeenna waa inaan ilaalinno amnigeenna, isla markaana aan ballaadhinno wareegga nabadda ee inagu xeeran.” Markii uu gaadhay Washington, Netanyahu waxa uu ka qaybgalay casho xusuus gaar ah oo loo sameeyey Senator Lindsey Graham oo geeriyooday 11-kii Luulyo, sida uu xaqiijiyey xafiiskiisu. Waxa la qorsheeyey in Talaadada dambe loo qabto munaasabad lagu xusayo senator-ka geeriyooday. Intii ay jireen xiisadaha u dhexeeyey labada dhinac, Trump ayaa dhaliilo kulul u jeediyey Netanyahu, isaga oo waraysi uu bixiyey ku tilmaamay “nin aad u adag,” sababtoo ah ciidamada Israa’iil ayaa si xooggan u duqaynayey Lubnaan xilli Washington ay hormuud ka ahayd wada-hadalladii lagu doonayey in lagu soo afjaro dagaalka Iiraan, arrintaas oo carqaladaysay dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed. Trump ayaa hore u qirtay inuu Netanyahu kula hadlay ereyo adag oo aan munaasib ahayn intii lagu jiray wada-hadal telefoon oo dhex maray. Dhankiisa, Netanyahu ayaa yareeyey muhiimadda khilaafaadkaas, isaga oo ku tilmaamay “kala duwanaansho dhinaca habka loo wajahayo arrimaha,” isla markaana ku adkaystay in labada dhinac ay isku raacsan yihiin ujeeddooyinka dagaalka. Waxaa la filayaa in kulanka labada hoggaamiye uu sidoo kale diiradda saaro hirgelinta heshiiskii qaab-dhismeedka ahaa ee Maraykanku garwadeenka ka ahaa, kaas oo Israa’iil iyo Lubnaan ay saxeexeen bishii hore, hase yeeshee weli caqabado ka haystaan fulintiisa dhulka. Dagaalka Lubnaan ayaa qarxay kaddib markii ururka Xisbullah uu gantaallo ku weeraray Israa’iil isagoo taageero u muujinaya Iiraan. Inkasta oo hawlgalladii milatari ee Israa’iil ay joogsadeen kaddib saxeexa heshiiska, haddana Israa’iil weli waxay gacanta ku haysaa dhul ballaadhan oo ku yaalla koonfurta Lubnaan. Wada-hadalladu waxay sidoo kale taaban doonaan xaaladda Marinka Gaza, maadaama dadaalladii diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu bilaabi lahaa dib-u-dhiska deegaannada dagaalku burburiyey ay hakad ku jiraan. Ku dhowaad saddex sano kaddib markii uu billowday dagaalka u dhexeeya Israa’iil iyo Xamaas, xaaladda bini’aadantinimo ee dhulka Falastiiniyiinta ayaa weli aad u liidata, halka ciidamada Israa’iil ay sii wadaan duqaymaha ay sheegeen inay beegsanayaan dagaalyahannada hubaysan. Xigashada Sawirka, Getty Images ‘Wax waaweyn laguma kala duwana’ Sida uu sheegay Yonatan Freeman, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay xiriirka caalamiga ah oo ka tirsan jaamacad ku taala Qudus, ujeeddada ugu weyn ee booqashadan ayaa ah in la beeniyo wararka sheegaya inuu qabow ku yimid xidhiidhka labada dal ee xulafada ah. Waxa uu wakaaladda AFP u sheegay: “Waxaan aaminsanahay in arrinta ugu muhiimsan ay tahay in dunida, Iiraan, Lubnaan iyo dalalka kale loo muujiyo inaanu jirin kala-go’ ama khilaaf weyn oo u dhexeeya Maraykanka iyo Israa’iil.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Qodobada ay isku waafaqsan yihiin labada hoggaamiye ayaa aad uga badan qodobada ay isku khilaafsan yihiin.” Freeman waxa uu rumaysan yahay in wixii khilaaf ah ee u dhexeeya Trump iyo Netanyahu ay ku kooban yihiin habka lagu gaadhayo himilooyinka la doonayo, sida waqtiga hawlgallada la fulinayo, heerka ay le’eg yihiin ama ujeeddooyinka degdegga ah ee la hiigsanayo, balse aanay khusayn himilooyinka waaweyn ee ay wadaagaan. Dhanka kale, Trump ayaa la filayaa inuu diiradda saaro labadiisa mudnaan ee ugu waaweyn ee gobolka, kuwaas oo kala ah Iiraan iyo ballaadhinta Heshiisyada Ibraahimiyiinta ee caadiyeynta xidhiidhka Israa’iil iyo dalalka Carabta, halkii uu mudnaan weyn siin lahaa arrinta Falastiin, oo uu u arko mid aan hadda ahayn mudnaanta koowaad. Booqashada Netanyahu ayaa ku soo beegmaysa bilo yar ka hor doorashooyinka baarlamaanka Israa’iil, kuwaas oo uu ku doonayo inuu ku hantiyo muddo-xileed cusub. Sahanno dhowaan la sameeyey ayaa muujinaya in taageerada dadweynaha ee Netanyahu ay hoos u dhacday, iyadoo ay weli jirto cadho ka dhalatay fashilka dowladdiisa ee ka hortagga weerarkii aan hore loo arag ee ay Xamaas qaaday 7-dii Oktoobar, kaas oo sababay inuu qarxo dagaalka Gaza. Ilo diblomaasiyadeed oo Faransiis ah ayaa sheegay in Paris ay “u oggolaatay diyaaradda Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil inay dul marto hawadeeda” intii ay ku sii jeedday Maraykanka. Bishii Sebtembar 2025, diyaaradda Netanyahu ayaa ka leexatay hawada dalal dhowr ah oo ku yaalla bartamaha iyo waqooyiga Yurub intii ay ku sii jeedday magaalada New York. Inkasta oo Faransiisku oggolaaday inay marto hawadiisa, haddana diyaaraddu waxay ka fogaatay hawada Faransiiska waxayna dul martay marinka Gibraltar. Warbaahinta Israa’iil ayaa xilligaas sheegtay in qorshahan loo adeegsaday sidii looga fogaan lahaa dalalka saxeexay Axdiga Rooma ee aasaasay Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah, kuwaas oo fulin kara amar lagu soo xidho Netanyahu haddii ay dhacdo in diyaaraddiisu degdeg ugu degto mid ka mid ah dalalkaas. Bishii Nofeembar 2024, Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah ayaa soo saartay amarro lagu soo xidhayo Netanyahu iyo wasiirkiisii hore ee gaashaandhigga, Yoav Gallant, iyada oo lagu eedeeyey dambiyo dagaal iyo dambiyo ka dhan ah bini’aadantinimada oo ka dhacay Marinka Gaza. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xaaladdu waxay sii xumaatay wixii ka dambeeyey 7-dii Luulyo, markii dagaalladu dib uga qarxeen Maraykanka iyo Iiraan, iyadoo Israa’iil aanay markan si toos ah uga qaybgelin. Waxaa la filayey in dagaalka Iiraan uu noqdo qodobka ugu weyn ee lagaga hadlayo kulanka albaabbadu u xidhan yihiin, xilli Washington ay ku adkaysanayso inay weli fursad siinayso waddada wada-hadallada diblomaasiyadeed ee ay la leedahay Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan. Kulanka, oo Aqalka Cad ku tilmaamay mid “wanaagsan oo miro-dhal ah”, ayaa socday ku dhowaad saacad iyo badh. Waxa uu ahaa kulankii siddeedaad ee dhex mara Netanyahu iyo Trump tan iyo markii Trump dib ugu soo laabtay Aqalka Cad sannadkii hore, isaga oo bilaabay muddo-xileedkiisii labaad ee aan isku xigin. Wargeyska Israa’iil ee Yediot Aharonot ayaa arrintan ka faallooday, isagoo sheegay in “aanu jirin hoggaamiye kale oo caalami ah oo intaas jeer kula kulmay Trump muddadiisa xil-haynta ee hadda jirta.” Netanyahu ayaa ka hor intuusan Isniintii ka bixin Israa’iil sheegay in kulankiisa Trump uu yahay “sharaf weyn, balse sidoo kale masuuliyad culus.” Wuxuu yidhi: “Waxaan ka wada hadli doonnaa dhammaan arrimaha miiska saaran, kuwa ugu horreeyana waa Iiraan. Dabcan, hadafkeenna waa inaan ilaalinno amnigeenna, isla markaana aan ballaadhinno wareegga nabadda ee inagu xeeran.” Markii uu gaadhay Washington, Netanyahu waxa uu ka qaybgalay casho xusuus gaar ah oo loo sameeyey Senator Lindsey Graham oo geeriyooday 11-kii Luulyo, sida uu xaqiijiyey xafiiskiisu. Waxa la qorsheeyey in Talaadada dambe loo qabto munaasabad lagu xusayo senator-ka geeriyooday. Intii ay jireen xiisadaha u dhexeeyey labada dhinac, Trump ayaa dhaliilo kulul u jeediyey Netanyahu, isaga oo waraysi uu bixiyey ku tilmaamay “nin aad u adag,” sababtoo ah ciidamada Israa’iil ayaa si xooggan u duqaynayey Lubnaan xilli Washington ay hormuud ka ahayd wada-hadalladii lagu doonayey in lagu soo afjaro dagaalka Iiraan, arrintaas oo carqaladaysay dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed. Trump ayaa hore u qirtay inuu Netanyahu kula hadlay ereyo adag oo aan munaasib ahayn intii lagu jiray wada-hadal telefoon oo dhex maray. Dhankiisa, Netanyahu ayaa yareeyey muhiimadda khilaafaadkaas, isaga oo ku tilmaamay “kala duwanaansho dhinaca habka loo wajahayo arrimaha,” isla markaana ku adkaystay in labada dhinac ay isku raacsan yihiin ujeeddooyinka dagaalka. Waxaa la filayaa in kulanka labada hoggaamiye uu sidoo kale diiradda saaro hirgelinta heshiiskii qaab-dhismeedka ahaa ee Maraykanku garwadeenka ka ahaa, kaas oo Israa’iil iyo Lubnaan ay saxeexeen bishii hore, hase yeeshee weli caqabado ka haystaan fulintiisa dhulka. Dagaalka Lubnaan ayaa qarxay kaddib markii ururka Xisbullah uu gantaallo ku weeraray Israa’iil isagoo taageero u muujinaya Iiraan. Inkasta oo hawlgalladii milatari ee Israa’iil ay joogsadeen kaddib saxeexa heshiiska, haddana Israa’iil weli waxay gacanta ku haysaa dhul ballaadhan oo ku yaalla koonfurta Lubnaan. Wada-hadalladu waxay sidoo kale taaban doonaan xaaladda Marinka Gaza, maadaama dadaalladii diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu bilaabi lahaa dib-u-dhiska deegaannada dagaalku burburiyey ay hakad ku jiraan. Ku dhowaad saddex sano kaddib markii uu billowday dagaalka u dhexeeya Israa’iil iyo Xamaas, xaaladda bini’aadantinimo ee dhulka Falastiiniyiinta ayaa weli aad u liidata, halka ciidamada Israa’iil ay sii wadaan duqaymaha ay sheegeen inay beegsanayaan dagaalyahannada hubaysan. Xigashada Sawirka, Getty Images ‘Wax waaweyn laguma kala duwana’ Sida uu sheegay Yonatan Freeman, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay xiriirka caalamiga ah oo ka tirsan jaamacad ku taala Qudus, ujeeddada ugu weyn ee booqashadan ayaa ah in la beeniyo wararka sheegaya inuu qabow ku yimid xidhiidhka labada dal ee xulafada ah. Waxa uu wakaaladda AFP u sheegay: “Waxaan aaminsanahay in arrinta ugu muhiimsan ay tahay in dunida, Iiraan, Lubnaan iyo dalalka kale loo muujiyo inaanu jirin kala-go’ ama khilaaf weyn oo u dhexeeya Maraykanka iyo Israa’iil.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Qodobada ay isku waafaqsan yihiin labada hoggaamiye ayaa aad uga badan qodobada ay isku khilaafsan yihiin.” Freeman waxa uu rumaysan yahay in wixii khilaaf ah ee u dhexeeya Trump iyo Netanyahu ay ku kooban yihiin habka lagu gaadhayo himilooyinka la doonayo, sida waqtiga hawlgallada la fulinayo, heerka ay le’eg yihiin ama ujeeddooyinka degdegga ah ee la hiigsanayo, balse aanay khusayn himilooyinka waaweyn ee ay wadaagaan. Dhanka kale, Trump ayaa la filayaa inuu diiradda saaro labadiisa mudnaan ee ugu waaweyn ee gobolka, kuwaas oo kala ah Iiraan iyo ballaadhinta Heshiisyada Ibraahimiyiinta ee caadiyeynta xidhiidhka Israa’iil iyo dalalka Carabta, halkii uu mudnaan weyn siin lahaa arrinta Falastiin, oo uu u arko mid aan hadda ahayn mudnaanta koowaad. Booqashada Netanyahu ayaa ku soo beegmaysa bilo yar ka hor doorashooyinka baarlamaanka Israa’iil, kuwaas oo uu ku doonayo inuu ku hantiyo muddo-xileed cusub. Sahanno dhowaan la sameeyey ayaa muujinaya in taageerada dadweynaha ee Netanyahu ay hoos u dhacday, iyadoo ay weli jirto cadho ka dhalatay fashilka dowladdiisa ee ka hortagga weerarkii aan hore loo arag ee ay Xamaas qaaday 7-dii Oktoobar, kaas oo sababay inuu qarxo dagaalka Gaza. Ilo diblomaasiyadeed oo Faransiis ah ayaa sheegay in Paris ay “u oggolaatay diyaaradda Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil inay dul marto hawadeeda” intii ay ku sii jeedday Maraykanka. Bishii Sebtembar 2025, diyaaradda Netanyahu ayaa ka leexatay hawada dalal dhowr ah oo ku yaalla bartamaha iyo waqooyiga Yurub intii ay ku sii jeedday magaalada New York. Inkasta oo Faransiisku oggolaaday inay marto hawadiisa, haddana diyaaraddu waxay ka fogaatay hawada Faransiiska waxayna dul martay marinka Gibraltar. Warbaahinta Israa’iil ayaa xilligaas sheegtay in qorshahan loo adeegsaday sidii looga fogaan lahaa dalalka saxeexay Axdiga Rooma ee aasaasay Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah, kuwaas oo fulin kara amar lagu soo xidho Netanyahu haddii ay dhacdo in diyaaraddiisu degdeg ugu degto mid ka mid ah dalalkaas. Bishii Nofeembar 2024, Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah ayaa soo saartay amarro lagu soo xidhayo Netanyahu iyo wasiirkiisii hore ee gaashaandhigga, Yoav Gallant, iyada oo lagu eedeeyey dambiyo dagaal iyo dambiyo ka dhan ah bini’aadantinimada oo ka dhacay Marinka Gaza. Bbc somali

items.title: China says its trade with Africa reaches record high in 1st half of 2026
items.description: China on Monday said that its trade with Africa reached a record high in the first half of 2026, attributing the growth to its zero-tariff policy for all African countries that maintain diplomatic ties with Beijing. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian said at a regular news conference that two-way trade totaled 1.41 trillion yuan ($196.6 billion) in the first six months of the year, marking a record level for the period. “The total trade volume achieved faster growth and is expected to reach an even higher level by the end of this year,” Lin said in response to a question on the impact of China’s zero-tariff policy. He said capital goods and intermediate goods accounted for about 75% of China’s exports to Africa, arguing that the shipments supported the continent’s industrialization and agricultural modernization rather than serving only consumer demand. Rejecting criticism over trade imbalances, Lin said such narratives were “merely traps designed by those with ulterior motives aimed at disrupting friendly cooperation between China and Africa.” He said China remained committed to expanding high-level opening-up despite global challenges, including regional conflicts and rising unilateralism and protectionism. Looking ahead, Lin said China would further facilitate bilateral trade, expand market access for more high-quality African products and inject fresh momentum into building what Beijing describes as an “all-weather China-Africa community with a shared future for the new era.” Source: AA The post China says its trade with Africa reaches record high in 1st half of 2026 appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Burcad badeedda Somalia oo mid ka mid ah maraakiibta ay haystaan u beddelay xarun…
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Kooxo burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ayaa markab ganacsi oo ay qafaasheen u beddelay saldhig ay ka abaabulaan weerarro cusub, xilli xeebaha Puntland ay mar kale ka soo cusboonaadeen falalka afduubka maraakiibta. Burcad-badeedda ayaa markabka xamuulka qaada ee MV Sward u adeegsanaya waxa loo yaqaan “markab hooyo” ama mothership , kaas oo ay ka kala diraan doomaha dheereeya ee lagu weeraro maraakiibta ku sugan meelaha ka fog xeebaha Soomaaliya. Warbixin uu daabacay wargeyska The Telegraph ayaa sheegtay in kooxaha ka hawlgala markabka Sward ay 16-kii July qafaasheen laba doon oo kalluumeysi oo laga leeyahay Iran, kaddib howlgal si weyn loo soo agaasimay oo ka dhacay biyaha Badweynta Hindiya. Labada doon ayaa Sabtidii la sii daayay, kaddib markii sida ay odayaasha deegaanka sheegeen la bixiyay madax-furasho dhan $20,000 oo doolar doontii. Waxaa xilligaas xeebaha Puntland lagu haystay illaa lix markab iyo doonyo, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah weli gacanta ugu jiraan kooxaha burcad-badeedda. Maraakiibta la haystay waxaa ka mid ahaa Honour 25 iyo MT Eureka , markabka shidaalka iyo kiimikada qaada ee MT Asana , markabka xamuulka ee MV Sward iyo labada doon ee kalluumeysiga Iran. Hay’adda Badaha Adduunka ee IMO ayaa horraantii bishan sheegtay in 44 badmaax lagu haystay saddexda markab ee Honour 25, Eureka iyo Sward, kuwaas oo la qafaashay intii u dhexeysay April iyo May. IMO waxay ka digtay in afduubyadani muujinayaan in khatarta burcad-badeednimadu aysan dhammaan, loona baahan yahay iskaashi caalami ah oo joogto ah. Markab weerarro laga abaabulayo MV Sward, oo dhererkiisu yahay ku dhowaad 100 mitir, ayaa la qafaashay 26-kii April isagoo shamiindo ka soo qaaday magaalada Suez ee dalka Masar, kuna sii jeeday dekedda Mombasa ee Kenya. Markabka ayaa lagu weeraray meel qiyaastii lix mayl-badeed waqooyi-bari kaga beegan degmada Garacad, iyadoo kooxo hubeysan ay la wareegeen, kuna jiheeyeen xeebaha Soomaaliya. Ciidamada Midowga Yurub ee howlgalka Atalanta ayaa xaqiijiyay in markabka lagu qafaashay aagga Dhinowda ee xeebaha waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya. Warbixinno hore ayaa sheegay in shaqaalaha markabka ay ka koobnaayeen 13 muwaadin oo Suuriyaan ah iyo laba Hindi ah. Markabka ayaa markii dambe lagu xiray meel u dhow deegaanka Ceel-Dhanaane ee gobolka Mudug, ka hor inta aan loo dhaqaajin dhanka xeebaha Bandar Beyla. Ilo dhanka sirdoonka iyo ammaanka ah ayaa sheegay in MV Sward uu xeebahaas ka bilaabay dhaqdhaqaaqyo cusub, iyadoo doomaha dheereeya ee laga soo diro ay weeraraan maraakiibta iyo doonyaha kalluumeysiga ee maraya biyaha Soomaaliya. Markabka ayaa la sheegay inuu meel dhow ka joogay markii la qafaalanayay labada doon ee Iran, taas oo muujineysa in burcad-badeeddu dib ugu laabanayaan xeeladihii ay isticmaali jireen xilligii ay ugu awoodda badnaayeen xeebaha Soomaaliya, 15 sano ka hor. Markabka weyn wuxuu burcad-badeedda siinayaa awood ay toddobaadyo ama bilo ku joogaan badda, isagoo u qaada shidaal, cunto, hub iyo doomaha yar-yar ee loo adeegsado weerarrada. Taageero ay ka helayaan gudaha Saraakiisha ammaanka Puntland ayaa sheegay in kooxaha burcad-badeedda ay taageero ka helayaan dad iyo maleeshiyaad ku sugan deegaannada xeebaha, arrintaas oo adkeyneysa in la soo qabto ama laga dulqaado maraakiibta ay haystaan. Mid ka mid ah raggii hoggaaminayay qafaalka MV Sward, isla markaana ku hadli jiray luqadaha Carabiga iyo Ingiriiska intii ay socdeen wada-hadallada madax-furashada, ayaa lagu qabtay deegaanka Garacad. Ninka ayaa la geeyay saldhigga booliska, balse maalintii xigtay maleeshiyaad hubeysan ayaa weeraray saldhigga, iyagoo isku dayay inay xoog ku sii daayaan. Is-rasaaseynta ka dhalatay weerarka waxaa ku dhintay askari boolis ah, halka mid kalena uu ku dhaawacmay. Sarkaal ka tirsan Puntland ayaa sheegay in weerarka kaddib la ogaaday inaan ninka lagu sii hayn karin Garacad, sababo la xiriira xiriirka qabiil iyo taageerada uu deegaanka ku leeyahay. Ciidamo dheeraad ah ayaa lagu daadgureeyay magaalada, waxaana ugu dambeyn loo qaaday Garoowe. Dhacdooyinka ayaa muujinaya sida xeebaha gobolka Mudug ay mar kale ugu soo noqonayaan xarun ay kooxaha burcad-badeeddu ku haystaan maraakiibta, ugana maamulaan wada-hadallada madax-furashada. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay markii bartamihii bishan degmada Jariiban lagu dilay taliyihii booliska degmada, Gaashaanle Dhexe Guuleed Cabdulqaadir Kadleeye, oo sidoo kale loo xil saaray la dagaallanka burcad-badeedda. Dableyda dishay taliyaha ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay xiriir la lahaayeen kooxaha burcad-badeedda, iyadoo wararka qaar ay sidoo kale ku xireen weerarkii lagu qaaday saldhigga booliska Garacad. Puntland ayaa 17-kii July fulisay xukun dil ah oo lagu riday Ibraahim Axmed Kooshin, kaas oo lagu helay dilka taliyaha. Saraakiisha Puntland ayaa sheegay in ciidamadu maalmihii ka horreeyay dilka xoojiyeen howlgallada ka dhanka ah shabakadaha burcad-badeedda ee ka soo cusboonaaday xeebaha gobolka Mudug. Dagaalka Iran oo fursad noqday Kororka weerarrada ayaa qayb ahaan lala xiriirinayaa dagaalka ka socda Iran iyo xiisadaha ka taagan Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Maraakiib badan oo dagaal oo horay uga qeyb qaadan jiray ilaalinta biyaha Soomaaliya ayaa loo wareejiyay Bariga Dhexe, si ay uga jawaabaan weerarrada maraakiibta, dhaqdhaqaaqyada Iran iyo hanjabaadaha kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Taasi waxay abuurtay meelo bannaan oo dhanka ammaanka ah, kuwaas oo burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya ay ka faa’iideysanayaan. Hay’adaha ammaanka badaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in kooxahaasi ay adeegsanayaan isgaarsiinta dayax-gacmeedka, qalabka GPS-ka iyo maraakiib la qafaashay oo ay saldhigyo ka dhigtaan. Dhinaca kale, kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed ayaa muddo dheer ka cabanayay maraakiib shisheeye oo si sharci-darro ah uga kalluumeysata xeebaha dalka, gaar ahaan kuwa ka yimaada Iran, Yemen, Pakistan, India, Thailand iyo China. Maraakiibta Iran ayaa si gaar ah loogu eedeeyay kalluumeysi aan fasax lahayn, iyadoo cilmi-baarisyo hore ay tilmaameen inay qayb weyn ka yihiin kalluunka ay maraakiibta shisheeye sida sharci-darrada ah uga gurtaan biyaha Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, la wareegidda maraakiib ganacsi, afduubka shaqaalahooda iyo dalbashada madax-furashada ayaa loo arkaa falal dambiyeed abaabulan, halkii ay ka ahaan lahaayeen tallaabooyin lagu difaacayo kheyraadka badda. Burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya ayaa intii u dhexeysay 2005 iyo 2012 lagu eedeeyay in ka badan kun weerar, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah shaqaalaha maraakiibta sanado lagu haystay xaalado aad u liita. Howlgallada ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah iyo shaqaaleysiinta ilaalo hubeysan ayaa markii dambe hoos u dhigay weerarrada in ka badan 90%. Hase yeeshee, qafaalka maraakiibta cusub iyo isticmaalka MV Sward oo saldhig laga fuliyo weerarro kale ayaa muujinaya in shabakadaha burcad-badeedda ay dib isu abaabulayaan, iyagoo ka faa’iideysanaya mashquulka ciidamada caalamiga ah iyo tabar-darrada ammaanka xeebaha Soomaaliya.
