Mid ka mid ah raggii hoggaaminayay qafaalka MV Sward, isla markaana ku hadli jiray luqadaha Carabiga iyo Ingiriiska intii ay socdeen wada-hadallada madax-furashada, ayaa lagu qabtay deegaanka Garacad. Ninka ayaa la geeyay saldhigga booliska, balse maalintii xigtay maleeshiyaad hubeysan ayaa weeraray saldhigga, iyagoo isku dayay inay xoog ku sii daayaan. Is-rasaaseynta ka dhalatay weerarka waxaa ku dhintay askari boolis ah, halka mid kalena uu ku dhaawacmay. Sarkaal ka tirsan Puntland ayaa sheegay in weerarka kaddib la ogaaday inaan ninka lagu sii hayn karin Garacad, sababo la xiriira xiriirka qabiil iyo taageerada uu deegaanka ku leeyahay. Ciidamo dheeraad ah ayaa lagu daadgureeyay magaalada, waxaana ugu dambeyn loo qaaday Garoowe. Dhacdooyinka ayaa muujinaya sida xeebaha gobolka Mudug ay mar kale ugu soo noqonayaan xarun ay kooxaha burcad-badeeddu ku haystaan maraakiibta, ugana maamulaan wada-hadallada madax-furashada. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay markii bartamihii bishan degmada Jariiban lagu dilay taliyihii booliska degmada, Gaashaanle Dhexe Guuleed Cabdulqaadir Kadleeye, oo sidoo kale loo xil saaray la dagaallanka burcad-badeedda. Dableyda dishay taliyaha ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay xiriir la lahaayeen kooxaha burcad-badeedda, iyadoo wararka qaar ay sidoo kale ku xireen weerarkii lagu qaaday saldhigga booliska Garacad. Puntland ayaa 17-kii July fulisay xukun dil ah oo lagu riday Ibraahim Axmed Kooshin, kaas oo lagu helay dilka taliyaha. Saraakiisha Puntland ayaa sheegay in ciidamadu maalmihii ka horreeyay dilka xoojiyeen howlgallada ka dhanka ah shabakadaha burcad-badeedda ee ka soo cusboonaaday xeebaha gobolka Mudug. Dagaalka Iran oo fursad noqday Kororka weerarrada ayaa qayb ahaan lala xiriirinayaa dagaalka ka socda Iran iyo xiisadaha ka taagan Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Maraakiib badan oo dagaal oo horay uga qeyb qaadan jiray ilaalinta biyaha Soomaaliya ayaa loo wareejiyay Bariga Dhexe, si ay uga jawaabaan weerarrada maraakiibta, dhaqdhaqaaqyada Iran iyo hanjabaadaha kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Taasi waxay abuurtay meelo bannaan oo dhanka ammaanka ah, kuwaas oo burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya ay ka faa’iideysanayaan. Hay’adaha ammaanka badaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in kooxahaasi ay adeegsanayaan isgaarsiinta dayax-gacmeedka, qalabka GPS-ka iyo maraakiib la qafaashay oo ay saldhigyo ka dhigtaan. Dhinaca kale, kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed ayaa muddo dheer ka cabanayay maraakiib shisheeye oo si sharci-darro ah uga kalluumeysata xeebaha dalka, gaar ahaan kuwa ka yimaada Iran, Yemen, Pakistan, India, Thailand iyo China. Maraakiibta Iran ayaa si gaar ah loogu eedeeyay kalluumeysi aan fasax lahayn, iyadoo cilmi-baarisyo hore ay tilmaameen inay qayb weyn ka yihiin kalluunka ay maraakiibta shisheeye sida sharci-darrada ah uga gurtaan biyaha Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, la wareegidda maraakiib ganacsi, afduubka shaqaalahooda iyo dalbashada madax-furashada ayaa loo arkaa falal dambiyeed abaabulan, halkii ay ka ahaan lahaayeen tallaabooyin lagu difaacayo kheyraadka badda. Burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya ayaa intii u dhexeysay 2005 iyo 2012 lagu eedeeyay in ka badan kun weerar, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah shaqaalaha maraakiibta sanado lagu haystay xaalado aad u liita. Howlgallada ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah iyo shaqaaleysiinta ilaalo hubeysan ayaa markii dambe hoos u dhigay weerarrada in ka badan 90%. Hase yeeshee, qafaalka maraakiibta cusub iyo isticmaalka MV Sward oo saldhig laga fuliyo weerarro kale ayaa muujinaya in shabakadaha burcad-badeedda ay dib isu abaabulayaan, iyagoo ka faa’iideysanaya mashquulka ciidamada caalamiga ah iyo tabar-darrada ammaanka xeebaha Soomaaliya. items.title: Soomaaliya oo si kulul u cambaareysay xadgudubka Israa’iil ee Masjidka Al-Aqsa
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u cambaareysay weerarka Israa’iil ee Masjidka Barakeysan ee Al-Aqsa, kadib markii sarkaal Israa’iili ah, oo ay wehliyaan kooxo xagjir ah iyo ciidamo ay galeen masjidka, kadibna ay ka gaysteen xadgudubyo waawayn. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sheegtay in falkan uu ka dhigan yahay xadgudub weyn oo lagu sameeyay karaamada iyo xurmada mid ka mid ah goobaha ugu barakaysan Islaamka, isla markaana gef ku ah dareenka malaayiinta Muslimiinta ah ee dunida ku nool. Sidoo kale, Soomaaliya oo xubin ka ah Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC), ayaa mar kale adkaysay mowqifkeeda ku aaddan taageeridda shacabka Falastiin iyo difaaca xaaladda taariikhiga ah iyo tan sharci ee goobaha barakaysan ee diimaha ku yaalla Qudus. Dhanka kale, Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa ka dalbatay beesha caalamka iyo Qaramada Midoobay inay qaadaan tallaabooyin deg-deg ah oo looga hortagayo xadgudubka ay Israa’iil ka gaysaneyso gudaha Masjidka Al-Aqsa. “Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay ugu baaqaysaa beesha caalamka iyo Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay inay ka hortagaan falalka noocan oo kale ah ee kicinta xambaarsan isla markaana la hubiyo isla xisaabtan ku aaddan cid kasta oo ku lug leh,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda. Waxaa kale oo ay Soomaaliya ugu baaqday dhammaan dhinacyada inay muujiyaan is xakameyn isla markaana ay u istaagaan wadahadal miro dhal ah oo lagu gaari karo nabad caddaalad ku dhisan oo waarta, taas oo waafaqsan sharciga caalamiga ah iyo qaraarrada Qaramada Midoobay. Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday inay garab taagan tahay shacabka Falastiin iyo xaqooda sharciyeed ee ay u leeyihiin inay helaan dowlad madax-bannaan. “Soomaaliya waxay taageersan tahay xalka labada dowladood, iyada oo u aragta jidka keliya ee lagu gaari karo nabad, amni iyo xasillooni waarta oo ka hirgasha Bariga Dhexe,” ayaa lasii raaciyay bayaanka. Ugu dambeyn, Dowladda Federaalka ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in ay ka go’an tahay ilaalinta sharciga caalamiga ah, dhowrista madaxbannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalalka, iyo xallinta khilaafaadka, iyadoo loo wajahayo si nabad ah. items.title: Mareykanka iyo Sacuudiga oo duqaymo ka gaystay Bariga Ciraaq
items.description: Boqortooyada Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in weerarkan laga fuliyay dalkaasi Ciraaq uu yahay is difaac ay is difaaceyso boqortooyada. Ciidanka Cirka Sacuudiga iyo kuwa Mareykanka ayaa xalay si wadajir ah u garaacay goobo ku yaala dalkaasi, oo lala xiriiriyay kooxo ay Iran taageerto. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay inay beegsadeen goobo badan oo lagu kaydiyo hubka iyo saadka oo ku yaala Bariga Ciraaq. Taliska ayaa sheegay in tani lagaga jawaabayay in ka badan 30 weerar oo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah, oo qaarkoodna lagu qaaday xarumaha saliidda ee Sacuudiga, 72-kii saacadood ee u dambeeyay. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in duqaymaha wadajirka ah oo laga fuliyay bartilmaameedyo gaar ah ay ku saleysnaayeen xuquuqda is difaaca ee uu damaanad qaaday sharciga caalamiga ah. Wasaaradda ayaa bayaan ay Arbacadan soo saartay ku sheegtay in duqaymahan ay jawaab u ahaayeen weeraro aan la aqbali karin, oo ay gaysteen maleeshiyo ay Iran taageerto oo ku sugan Ciraaq, kuwaas oo ay ku eedeysay inay bartilmaameedsanayaan xarumaha saliidda ee boqortooyada. Wasaaradda ayaa waxay sheegtay in inkastoo Sacuudigu uusan dooneyn in xiisadda loo sii huriyo, haddana aysan ka waaban doonin in la qaado dhammaan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah, si loo difaaco madaxbannaanida, muwaadiniinta iyo hantida dalka, haddii ay mar kale la kulmaan weeraro dheeraad ah. Wasaaradda Difaaca Sacuudiga ayaa ururada ay Iran taageerto ee ku sugan gobolka uga digtay in ay falal gardarro ah ku soo sameeyaan dalkaasi, haddii kalena ay la kulmi doonaan jawaab xoog badan.

items.title: Ciidanka Kumaandooska DANAB oo ka digay dagaal ka dhaca Puntland, eedeynna u jeediyay Madaxweyne Siciid Deni
items.description: Ciidanka Kumaandooska DANAB ee ka howlgala Puntland ayaa soo saaray war-saxaafadeed ay kaga digeen suura-galnimada inuu dagaal ka qarxo deegaannada Puntland, iyagoo sheegay inay jiraan warar la xiriira weerarro lagu qaadi karo ciidanka PSF. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa lagu sheegay in khilaafka ka jira Puntland uu yahay mid siyaasadeed, islamarkaana aanu ka dhalan hanjabaad dibadda uga timid maamulka. DANAB  sidoo kale, waxay eedeyn u jeediyeen Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, iyagoo ku sheegay inuu mas’uul ka yahay hurinta xiisadaha iyo suuragalnimada dagaal sokeeye oo ka dhex dhaca ciidamada Puntland. Waxay ku baaqeen in laga fogaado tallaabo kasta oo horseedi karta dhiig daadasho iyo iska horimaad dhexmara ciidamada. Ciidanka DANAB waxay xuseen doorka ay sannado badan ka qaadanayeen sugidda amniga Puntland, iyagoo sheegay inay yihiin ciidan u adeega shacabka Puntland. Xiisadda siyaasadeed ee Puntland ayaa weli taagan, iyadoo bulshada iyo dhinacyada siyaasadda ay ugu baaqayaan madaxda inay khilaafaadka ku xalliyaan wada hadal si looga baaqsado isku dhac iyo xaalad amni darro, xilli Maamulka Deni uu ciidamo ku daabulayo gobolka Mudug.

items.title: Iran oo muujisay in ay ka soo baxday heerka militari ee difaaca, ka dib weerarka ay ku qaadday Jordan
items.description: Ciidamada Iran ayaa weeraro kala dambeeyay oo gantaalo loo adeegsaday ku qaaday xarumo ay Ciidamada Mareykanka ku leeyihiin dalkaasi Jordan. Taliska Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ee Iran ayaa saaka sheegay in Ciidamada Iran ay saqdii dhexe ee xalay bartilmaameedsadeen Saldhigga Ciidanka Cirka Mareykanka iyo Xarunta Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM) ee Jordan, iyagoo adeegsanaya gantaalada ballaastikada. Taliska ayaa sheegay inay si sax ah u garaaceen Saldhigga Ciidanka Cirka iyo Xarunta Taliska CENTCOM ee dalkaasi. Taliska Ciidamada Mareykanka ee CENTCOM ayaa xarumo iyo xiriiro dhanka difaaca ah ku leh Jordan, iyadoo Saldhigga Ciidanka Cirka ee Muwaffaq Salti ay ku sugan yihiin ciidamo iyo diyaarado dagaal oo Mareykanka uu leeyahay. Taliska Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ee Iran ayaa wacad ku maray in Ciidamada Iran ay sii wadi doonaan iska caabinta, inta ay socdaan tallaabooyinka sharci darrada ah iyo kuwa khalafsan ee Mareykanka uu ku hayo Iran. “Waa inay joogsadaan hanjabaadaha ka imaanaya Saraakiisha Mareykanka iyo fara-gelinta sharci darrada ah ee ka dhanka ah danahayaga.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Dhanka kale Taliska CENTCOM ayaa sheegay inay qabteen dhowr gantaal oo nooca ballaastikada, kuwaas oo ku sii jeeday Saldhigyada Mareykanka ee Bariga Dhexe. Taliska CENTCOM ayaa war qoraal ah oo ka soo baxay, waxa uu weerarku ku tilmaamay isku day weerar oo lama filaan ah. Weerarada Iran ayaa soo afjaraya afar habeen oo hakad uu ku jiray dagaalka kala dhaxeeya Mareykanka, ka dib markii Wasaaradda Difaaca Mareykanka ee The Pentagon ay Jimcihii joojisay duqaymihii lagu hayay bartilmaameedyada gudaha Iran. Weerarada Iran ayaad mooddaa in lagu beeninayo war Talaadadii ka soo yeeray Madaxweyne Donald Trump, oo ku saabsanaa in Iran ay si joogta ah uga codsaneyso in laga joojiyo duqaymaha. Weeraradan ayaa noqonaya kuwoodii ugu horreyay ee Iran ku hormarto amaba ku qaaddo Saldhigyada Mareykanka ee gobolka, taasoo ku tusineysa in ciidamadeeda ay diyaar u yihiin inay ka gudbaan heerka difaaca iyo aargoosiga, ayna u gudbaan heerka weerarka.

items.title: Al Shabaab oo maleeshiyaad cusub keentay Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa sheegaya in Talaadadii ay gaareen gurmad maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ah, ka dib markii ay ka soo gudbeen xuduudda uu gobolkaasi la wadaago Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe. Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa waxaa dhaqdhaqaaq ka wada Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo garabsanaya kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley, si Al Shabaab looga saaro deegaanada qaar ee dhaca bariga gobolkaasi. Tani ayaa keentay in Al Shabaab ay dhankeeda dhaqdhaqaaq ka bilowdo gobolkaasi, si Shabaabku ay u sii haystaan deegaanada ay ka maamulaan bariga gobolkaasi. Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in gurmad Shabaab ah oo ka kala yimid Degmooyinka Aadan Yabaal iyo Ceelbaraf ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe ay gaareen Degmada Moqokori iyo weliba deegaanka kale ee lagu magacaabo Tardo. Tardo waxay ku taallaa goob istiraatiiji ah oo xiriirisa Moqokori, Jalalaqsi, Buuloburde iyo Maxaas. Maleeshiyada ayaa sidoo kale dhaqdhaqaaq ka waddo deegaanka Jicibow ee ku yaala jiinka bari ee Webiga Shabelle, waana mid ka mid ah deegaanada la isaga tallaabo webiga oo bari iyo galbeed u kala qaybiya Gobolka Hiiraan. Shabaabka ayaa gurmad isaga keena goobo kala duwan, marka sidaan oo kale uu culeys uga soo fuulo dhulka loo socdo in laga saaro. Shabaabka ayaa isku dayaya in ay difaacdaan deegaanada istiraatiijiga ah ee isku xira Degmooyinka Moqokori iyo Maxaas, si aysan go’doon u gelin. Militariga Somaliya ayaa diiradda saaraya in Shabaabka laga riixo deegaanada Yasooman, Suullaay iyo Waabweyn iyo in aan la ogolaan inay ku sii sugnaadaan tuulooyinka yaryar ee ku dhow dhow.

items.title: Dr. Mohamed Mohamoud Ulusow Clarifies Future Council Proposal for Transitional Supreme Council
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN ) – Dr. Mohamed Mohamoud Ulusow, a political analyst and a former government official has issued a clarification following what he described as misinformation and misinterpretation circulating on social media, particularly TikTok, regarding the recent proposal by the Somalia Future Council to establish a Transitional Supreme Council. According to Dr. Ulusow, the proposal does not seek to dismantle, replace, or diminish Somalia’s internationally recognized statehood. Instead, he said, it is intended as an emergency constitutional mechanism to safeguard a state that he argues is facing an unprecedented legitimacy crisis. “The establishment of a Transitional Supreme Council would neither undermine Somalia’s sovereignty nor weaken its international recognition,” Dr. Ulusow said. “Its sole purpose is to preserve the continuity of state institutions and rescue the country’s constitutional order before it deteriorates further.” He argued that Somalia has effectively lost four years to prolonged political deadlock and warned that the country’s state-building project has reached what he described as a “critical stage,” requiring urgent political intervention. According to Ulusow, the proposed council would be assigned a narrowly defined, short-term mandate focused on overseeing the day-to-day administration of government and organizing long-overdue national elections. He compared the proposed body’s role to that of a caretaker administration envisaged under Article 103 of Somalia’s Provisional Federal Constitution, which governs governments serving in a caretaker capacity. Ulusow further argued that, because the current administration has, in his view, failed to discharge those caretaker responsibilities effectively, the creation of a temporary transitional body has become necessary to restore constitutional legitimacy and public confidence. “The greatest threat to Somalia’s statehood is not the establishment of a temporary transitional mechanism,” he said. “The real danger lies in allowing a leadership whose constitutional legitimacy is widely disputed to continue governing while political divisions deepen and state institutions weaken.” He also maintained that there is little disagreement over the expiration of the mandates of the Federal Government’s leadership. Instead, he said, the central political dispute has long centered on the failure to reach consensus on an agreed electoral process. According to Dr. Ulusow, repeated attempts at negotiations have failed to produce meaningful progress, leaving political stakeholders with few remaining options other than proposing a transitional mechanism capable of restoring constitutional order. “The call for a Transitional Supreme Council arose only after confidence in the current dialogue process largely collapsed,” he explained. “Its objective is to protect the nation and preserve Somalia’s statehood before political divisions become irreversible.” Dr. Ulusow concluded that the proposal should be viewed not as a retreat from Somalia’s state-building journey but as an attempt to preserve it during one of the country’s most challenging political periods. He stressed that the overriding priority must remain safeguarding Somalia’s unity, constitutional legitimacy, and national institutions before the country’s political crisis deepens further. items.title: Gaalkacyo Deserves Development, Not Recurring Conflict
items.description: By Mohammed A Mohammud (Baldho) Introduction Few Somali cities symbolise both the promise and the tragedy of Somalia as profoundly as Galkacyo. Situated at the heart of the country, the city has long served as a commercial gateway linking northern and southern Somalia. It is a place where trade, pastoral livelihoods and entrepreneurship have flourished despite decades of political instability. Yet, instead of becoming a model of national integration and economic growth, Gaalkacyo has repeatedly been reduced to a battleground for political competition and inter-clan tensions. Today, once again emerge of military reinforcements and rising tensions in and around the city, Gaalkacyo residents should ask a simple but urgent question: have we learnt anything from the past? The answer, regrettably, appears to be no. Every cycle of confrontation in Gaalkacyo has followed a familiar pattern. Political disagreements escalate into military deployments. Communities become anxious. Markets slow down. Families begin preparing for displacement. Elders intervene to restore calm after lives have already been lost, only for the same mistakes to be repeated a few years later. This cycle has become so familiar that many have come to accept it as inevitable. It is not For too long, the discourse surrounding Gaalkacyo has been dominated by the grim lexicon of war: checkpoints, militias, and frontlines, buffer zone, and armed militias. However, a critical examination of the city’s trajectory reveals a devastating truth: the cycle of violence is not an inevitable curse of nature but a consequence of sustained political negligence, failed governance, and a cynical addiction to militarism over meaningful development. The current sabre-rattling and reinforcement of forces in the region signal a regression to the dark days of 2015 and 2016, ignoring the hard-won lessons of the local peace processes. It is a policy of deliberate destabilisation that serves only the narrow political interests of a few. The people of Gaalkacyo deserve better than this. Lessons from History The roots of today’s challenges lie in the political fragmentation that followed the collapse of the Somali state in 1991. Like many parts of the country, Gaalkacyo experienced profound changes as competing political authorities emerged and administrative boundaries hardened. Over time, the northern part of the city came under the administration that later became Puntland, while the southern part formed part of what would eventually become Galmudug. Although administrative divisions developed, the people themselves remained connected through family ties, business relationships and generations of coexistence. Commerce continued across neighbourhoods, marriages united families from different communities, and local elders remained influential in resolving disputes. This social fabric is often overlooked in political discourse. Too frequently, Gaalkacyo is portrayed solely as a divided city. In reality, it has always been a shared city whose people have repeatedly demonstrated a remarkable capacity for reconciliation whenever political leaders have allowed space for dialogue. One of the clearest examples was the Gaalkacyo Peace Agreement of 1993. Brokered through the efforts of respected Somali leaders and traditional elders, the agreement sought to restore stability after the violence that followed the collapse of the central government. It facilitated the return of displaced families, reduced military tensions and enabled commercial activity to resume. The agreement reflected one of Somalia’s greatest strengths: the ability of communities to resolve conflicts through dialogue, customary law and consensus. Yet its long-term promise was never fully realised. Neither national nor international actors invested sufficiently in transforming that local agreement into a durable peacebuilding framework. Institutions remained weak, public investment was minimal, and the city continued to be viewed primarily through a security lens rather than as an engine of economic growth. The result was predictable. The underlying political and administrative disputes remained unresolved, leaving Gaalkacyo vulnerable to renewed confrontation. The Cost of the 2015 and 2016 Conflicts The façade of stability shattered spectacularly in 2015 and 2016, marking a low point in the city’s modern history. The conflict was ostensibly triggered by political expansionism and territorial disputes. However, the roots lay deeper: competition for grazing land, water points, exacerbated by the presence of Al-Shabaab elements exploiting the security vacuum. The conflict of 2015 was brutal. It was characterised by the use of heavy weaponry, indiscriminate shelling, and the displacement of over 60,000 civilians. It was a conflict that saw the rise of battle wagons and a flagrant disregard for civilian infrastructure. The 2016 escalation was even more severe, leading to the internationalisation of the dispute and a flurry of desperate mediations. These conflicts did not resolve any issue; they merely recalibrated the balance of fear. They provided nothing but death, destruction, and the maiming of youth who were cynically recruited to fight for the interests of distant politicians. These young men, the future of the city, were sacrificed on the altar of political ambition. What is striking about these conflicts is the role of the federal government of Somalia. Rather than investing in conflict resolution mechanisms or de-escalation, FGS’s strategy was overwhelmingly militaristic role play. This demonstrates a profound lack of political maturity and a failure to understand that a military solution in a culturally homogenous and intermarried society is a chimera. The state was fighting a war against its own people. The Quiet Success of Local Peacebuilding Following the violence of 2015 and 2016, local elders, community representatives and government officials undertook an intensive reconciliation process that remains one of Somalia’s most significant, yet least recognised, peacebuilding achievements. This agreement emphasised the withdrawal of “excess” forces, the establishment of joint security committees, and crucially, the facilitation of a return for displaced populations. Rather than relying exclusively on formal political negotiations, communities engaged directly with one another. Traditional mechanisms of reconciliation were revived. Disputes were addressed through dialogue. Compensation arrangements were negotiated where appropriate. Displaced families gradually returned home, markets reopened and movement across different parts of the city resumed. For several years, Gaalkacyo demonstrated that peaceful coexistence was not only possible but practical. Businesses recovered, commercial links strengthened and ordinary citizens resumed the routines of everyday life. Yet this remarkable achievement received little sustained support. Peace agreements, however well negotiated, cannot endure indefinitely without tangible improvements in people’s daily lives. Communities that experience peace but continue to live without reliable roads, clean water, sanitation, employment and functioning public institutions inevitably become vulnerable to renewed instability. This is precisely where Gaalkacyo finds itself today. The city’s greatest challenge is no longer simply preventing conflict; it is transforming peace into development. Unless that transformation takes place, every period of calm will remain vulnerable to the next political crisis. Militarisation Is Not a Strategy The recent movement of additional forces into and around Gaalkacyo should concern every Gaalkacyo residence who values peace and stability. In a city that still carries the scars of previous conflicts, military mobilisation is never interpreted as a routine security measure. It sends a powerful political message, one that revives painful memories and fuels uncertainty among communities that have worked tirelessly to rebuild trust. Security is undoubtedly a legitimate responsibility of government. Every state has the duty to protect its citizens and maintain public order. However, there is a fundamental difference between providing security and pursuing militarisation as a substitute for political leadership. Gaalkacyo has repeatedly demonstrated that the accumulation of armed forces cannot resolve disputes rooted in governance, administration, resource management and political mistrust. The conflicts of 2015 and 2016 proved precisely that. Despite considerable military engagement, none of the underlying issues were resolved through force. Peace returned only after dialogue, mediation and community led reconciliation. To repeat the same military approach today while expecting a different outcome would ignore the lessons of recent history. The Development Deficit While political leaders debate administrative boundaries and security arrangements, many residents of Gaalkacyo continue to face challenges that have little to do with politics and everything to do with governance. The city still lacks many of the basic public services expected of a regional commercial centre. Poor urban planning has contributed to flooding, inadequate drainage and environmental degradation. A modern sewage system remains absent, creating significant public health risks, particularly during the rainy seasons. Road infrastructure remains another major constraint. The strategic road connecting Gaalkacyo with Bosaso requires substantial rehabilitation, increasing transport costs for businesses and reducing economic competitiveness. Likewise, improving transport links between Garacad Port, Gaalkacyo and neighbouring markets would significantly strengthen regional trade. The modernisation of Abdullahi Yusuf International Airport presents another untapped opportunity. A more efficient airport would improve domestic and international connectivity, attract investment and strengthen Gaalkacyo’s position as a commercial hub linking central and northern Somalia. These are not ambitious dreams beyond Somalia’s reach. They are practical development priorities capable of generating employment, stimulating private investment and strengthening public confidence in government institutions. Unfortunately, they have too often been overshadowed by political disputes and security concerns. The irony is striking. Resources continue to be devoted to managing repeated cycles of tension while comparatively little attention is given to the investments that would reduce those tensions over the long term. Shared Responsibility Assigning blame alone will not move Gaalkacyo forward. The Federal Government of Somalia, Puntland and Galmudug each bear responsibilities for safeguarding stability while promoting development. Political differences between governments should never come at the expense of ordinary citizens whose primary concerns are security, livelihoods and public services. The Federal Government has a constitutional responsibility to support peacebuilding across the country. This role extends beyond responding to immediate security incidents. It includes encouraging dialogue, facilitating cooperation between federal member states and ensuring that development initiatives reach strategically important cities such as Gaalkacyo. Similarly, regional administrations have a responsibility to prioritise the welfare of their citizens above political competition. Public confidence is strengthened not by displays of military strength but by visible improvements in governance, infrastructure and service delivery. Investing in People Somalia’s greatest resource has always been its people, particularly its young generation. Across Gaalkacyo, thousands of young men and women are eager to contribute to their communities if given the opportunity. They require quality education, vocational training, access to finance and pathways into productive employment. The private sector also has an essential role to play. Gaalkacyo has long been known for its entrepreneurial spirit. Local businesses have continued trading despite insecurity, demonstrating remarkable resilience. Government policies should encourage this spirit through improved infrastructure, transparent regulation and easier access to investment. Strengthening Local Governance Traditional elders have repeatedly demonstrated their ability to mediate disputes before they escalate. Rather than operating separately from formal government structures, these customary institutions should work alongside elected local authorities, police services and judicial institutions in a complementary manner. Strengthening municipal government would also improve accountability for service delivery. Local authorities are often best placed to understand community priorities, whether those involve waste management, road maintenance, urban planning or dispute resolution. Federalism should encourage cooperation rather than competition. The constitutional relationship between the Federal Government and the Federal Member States will continue to evolve, but these political discussions should never prevent practical cooperation on issues that directly affect ordinary citizens. Roads, hospitals, schools and water systems should not become casualties of political disagreement. Conclusion Gaalkacyo has carried the burden of conflict for far too long. Its people have endured displacement, economic hardship and political uncertainty with remarkable resilience. They have repeatedly demonstrated a willingness to reconcile, rebuild and move forward. What they require now is leadership that rewards those efforts rather than placing them at risk once again. Somalia’s future will not be secured by increasing the number of armed men stationed in its cities. It will be secured by increasing the number of children attending school, the number of young people finding meaningful employment, the number of businesses investing with confidence and the number of communities connected by roads instead of divided by frontlines. The true measure of political leadership is not the capacity to mobilise forces; it is the ability to improve people’s lives. For Gaalkacyo, that means replacing uncertainty with opportunity, political rivalry with cooperation and military competition with sustainable development. The city has already shown that peace is possible. It is now the responsibility of Somalia’s leaders to prove that peace can also be lasting. The people of Gaalkacyo do not ask for special treatment. They ask only for what every Somali community deserves: security founded on justice, prosperity built through development and a future free from the recurring fear of conflict. The city has already shown that peace is possible. It is now the responsibility of Somalia’s leaders to prove that peace can also be lasting. The people of Gaalkacyo do not ask for special treatment. They ask only for what every Somali community deserves: security founded on justice, prosperity built through development and a future free from the recurring fear of conflict. items.title: Somaliland Arrests Murder Suspect Who Fled from Ethiopia’s Somali Region
items.description: Hargeisa (WDN) — Somaliland police have arrested a murder suspect who allegedly fled across the border after a fatal killing in Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State, marking another example of growing cross-border security cooperation between authorities in the Horn of Africa. The suspect, Najax Hassan Muse, is accused of killing Abdikarim Muse Osman in Abdi Yusuf, an area within the Daroor district of Ethiopia’s Somali Region (formerly known as Region Five), before escaping into Somaliland. According to Somaliland police, investigators tracked the suspect through intelligence gathering before launching a planned operation in Dabo-Gorayaale, in the Daadmadheedh region, where he was arrested without incident. Authorities said the suspect will be presented before the courts, where the allegations against him will be examined in accordance with legal procedures. Cross-Border Security Cooperation Expands If Somaliland authorities proceed with transferring the suspect to officials in Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State, it would mark the third cross-border handover of a Somali murder suspect to Jigjiga authorities during July alone, highlighting an apparent increase in judicial and security cooperation between neighboring administrations. Only days ago , Puntland handed over another murder suspect wanted by Ethiopian authorities after officials from Jigjiga crossed the border to take custody of the accused. In a separate case earlier this month, another suspect wanted for murder in Ethiopia’s Somali Region was arrested in Mogadishu before being transferred to Abudwaq in Galmudug, a town near the Ethiopian border. Ethiopian security officials subsequently traveled from Jigjiga to receive custody of the suspect. The succession of transfers suggests that regional authorities are increasingly coordinating efforts to prevent suspects accused of serious crimes from evading justice by crossing administrative and international borders. Security analysts say such cooperation reflects a broader effort among Somali administrations and neighboring Ethiopia to strengthen law enforcement collaboration against transnational crime, particularly in border regions where suspects have historically exploited jurisdictional boundaries to avoid prosecution. The latest arrest reinforces a growing message from regional security agencies: crossing the border is no longer a guarantee of escaping justice. Nevertheless, many people that have talked to WardheerNews warned that security cooperation must be narrowly confined to combating criminal activities and should never be used as a tool to target political opponents. Such concerns are reinforced by allegations that, in recent years, Puntland authorities have transferred Ethiopian opposition members to Ethiopian authorities, fueling fears that cross-border security arrangements could be exploited for political purposes rather than legitimate law enforcement. items.title: Fiqi oo bogaadiyey tallaabo ay qaadeen xubno kamid ah mucaaradka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo qoraal soo saaray ayaa si weyn u bogaadiyay xubnaha mucaaradka ee ka horyimid warqaddii shalay kasoo baxday Golaha Mustaqbalka ee loo diray waddamada ay ciidamada ka joogaan gudaha Soomaaliya. Fiqi ayaa marka hore su’aal ka keenay qorshaha Golaha Mustaqbalka oo iyagu diray warqaddaas oo muran badan dhalisay, maadaama ay ku dalbadeen in la dhiso Gole ku-meel-gaar ah oo uu dalku yeesho, wuxuuna yiri “Ma Qaranimada Soomaaliya ayay mucaarad ku yihiin mise Dawladda?!”. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga ayaa sidoo kale ammaanay xubnaha mucaaradka ee iska bari yeelay warqaddaasi, maadaama ay khilaaf ka dhex abuurtay Golaha, sidoo kalena ay ka xumaadeen inta badan dadka Soomaaliyeed oo siyaabo kala duwan uga falceliyay warqaddaas. “Waxay mudan yihiin xubnaha mucaaradka ka tirsan ee sida xilkasnimada leh uga falceliyay warqaddii ceebeyd ee kuwa ceebaysan ay qoreen, taasoo dalal shisheeye ay uga codsadeen in dalka maxmiyad la geliyo. Waxaa la is dheer yahay garaadka, xilkasnimada iyo u turidda dalka iyo dawladnimadeena sida adag lagu soo dhisay,” ayuu yiri Wasiirku. Sidoo kale, wuxuu weeraray hoggaanka sare ee Golaha Mustaqbalka oo uu ku eedeeyay inay diidan yihiin qarannimada, ayna rabaan inay meesha ka saaraan dowladnimada Soomaaliya, sida uu hadalka u dhigay “Waxaa muuqata in xubnaha Golaha Mustaqbalka Madow aysan dawladda jirta mucaarad ku ahayn balse ay hadda muujiyeen in ay qaranimada Soomaaliya mucaarad ku yihiin oo ay rabaan in ay meesha ka saaraan. Waa koox gaartay in aysan ka xishoon ku dhawaaqidda hadallo galaya qaanadda khiyaano qaran iyo sidoo kale in ay ajendayaal shisheeye ku shaqeeyaan,” ayuu raaciyay. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka dowladda Soomaaliya ay isku khilaafeen warqaddii furneyd ee shalay Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed u diray dalalka ay ciidamadoodu qeybta ka yihiin howl-galka AUSSOM iyo taageerayaasha caalamiga. Warqaddaas ayaa waxaa durba si adag uga horyimid qaar ka mid ah garabyada mucaaradka, iyadoo Wasiirkii hore ee Amniga, Xildhibaan Maxamed Abuukar Islow uu si adag u diiday dalabkii ku qornaa warqaddaas, isaga oo sheegay in arrintaasi ay god ku rideyso dowladnimada Soomaaliya. “Waxaan aad ula yaabay qoraal la sheegay inuu kasoo baxay Golaha Mustaqbalka oo Beesha caalamka looga dalbaday in Soomaaliya loo dhiso Gole Kumeelgaar ah,” ayuu yiri Islow oo kamid ah garabka mucaaradka ee Haybad Qaran. items.title: Daawo: Maxaa ka cusub doorashada Galmudug oo dhaceysa Khamiista?
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyha Guddiga Madaxa-banaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka, Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan oo galabta shir jaraa’id ku qabtay magaalada Dhuusamareeb ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu soo dhammaaday ololihii doorashada ee deegaannada Galmudug, isla markaana maalinta Khamiista ah oo ku beegan 30-ka July ay dhici doonto doorashada. Guddoomiyaha ayaa amray in la fujiya calaamadaha ololaha doorashada ee ku dhagan gaadiidka iyo goobaha dadweynaha, wuxuuna sheegay ololaha uu ku ekaa maanta oo Talaado ah. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ugu baaqay shacabka inay si buuxda uga soo qayb-galaan doorashada, isla markaana ay tagaan goobaha cod-bixinta, iyaga oo wata kaararkooda, si ay codadka u dhiibtaan. “Guddigu wuxuu ugu baaqayaa dhammaan cod-bixiyeyaasha is-diiwaangeliyay inay si buuxda uga qayb-qaataan doorashada, si nabad ahna u gutaan xuquuqdooda dastuuriga ah. Sidoo kale waxaa lagu boorinayaa cod-bixiyeyaasha inay soo qaataan kaararkooda cod-bixiyaha ama shahaadadooda ku-meel-gaarka ah ee diiwaangelinta ee looga baahan yahay, ayna raacaan tilmaamaha shaqaalaha doorashada, si loo ilaaliyo nidaamka iyo habsami u socodka doorashada,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiye Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan. Sidoo kale, wuxuu guddigu shaaca ka qaaday in dadka aan haysan kaarka ay ku codeyn karaan shahaadada ay isku diiwaangeliyeen, isla markaana laga reebi doono codeynta kadib. “Fiiro gaar ah muwaadiiniinta haysta shahaadada KMG ah ee diiwaangelinta ee raba inay codeeyaan waxaa shahaadada looga reebi doonaa goobta cod-bixinta, sidaas daraadeed waxaan ugu baaqeynaa muwaadiniinta ay howlwadeennada goobaha doorashad u fududeeyaan gudashada waajibaadkooda sharciga ah,” ayuu sii raaciyay guddoomiyuhu. Dhanka kale, wuxuu farriin u diray ururrada siyaasadda ee ka qayb-galaya doorashada oo uu ugu baaqay inay soo dirsadaan wakiillo aan kamid ahayn musarraxiinta, si ay goobjoog u noqdaan goobaha doorashada. Sidoo kale wuxuu warbaahinta ugu baaqay inay tebiyaan xog sax ah oo dheelitiraan, laguna kalsoonaan karo. Ugu dambeyn wuxuu hoosta ka xariiqay in amniga doorashada ay sugi doonaan ciidamada Booliska oo ka amar qaadan doono guddiga, si loo xaqiijiyo amniga cod-bixiyeyaasha, shaqaalaha doorashada iyo kormeerayaasha tegaya gobaha cod-bixinta dadweynaha. The post Daawo: Maxaa ka cusub doorashada Galmudug oo dhaceysa Khamiista? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xog: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo ku wajahan Uganda + Ujeedka
items.description: Kampala (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa lagu wadaa inuu ambabaxo magaalada Kampala ee caasimadda dalka Uganda, halkaas oo la filayo in todobaadkan dhammaadkiisa uu uga qayb-galo shir muhiim ah. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, waxaa maanta Muqdisho ka baxay wafdi hordhac u ah Madaxweynaha oo ay kamid yihiin Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha, Mudane Cabdullahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag) iyo Taliyaha Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed Jeneraal Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, kuwaas oo gaaray magaalada Kampala. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Madaxweynaha iyo wafdigiisa ay ka qayb-galayaan shir looga hadlayo mustaqbalka howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee ka scoda Soomaaliya, kaas oo wajahaya xaalad adag, maadaama uu howlgalku wajahayo dhaqaale xumo wayn. Shirkan ka furmi doono Kampala ayaa wuxuu kusoo aadayaa xilli mustaqbalka AUSSOM uu galay hubanti la’aan, kadib markii Mareykanka uu sheegay inuusan taageeri doonin sii wadista howlaha Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, UNSOS, wixii ka dambeeya dhammaadka sanadkan. UNSOS ayaa AUSSOM siisa adeegyada muhiimka ah ee ay ka mid yihiin cuntada, biyaha, shidaalka, gaadiidka, adeegyada caafimaadka iyo daad-gureynta ciidamada dhaawacma. Mareykanka ayaa Midowga Afrika ku wargeliyey inuu Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ka hor istaagi doono qorshe kasta oo sii wadaya taageerada dhaqaale iyo tan farsamo ee UNSOS.   Miisaaniyadda UNSOS ayaa gaareysa ku dhowaad $500 milyan sanadkii, halka AUSSOM ay sidoo kale la daalaa-dhaceyso dhaqaale yari weyn oo wiiqday awooddeeda howlgal. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, AUSSOM waxaa ka tirsan ku dhowaad 12,000 oo askari, kuwaas oo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ka taageera dagaalka Al-Shabaab iyo ilaalinta xarumo muhiim ah oo ku yaalla Muqdisho iyo gobollada koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya. The post Xog: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo ku wajahan Uganda + Ujeedka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wasiirka Tamarta iyo macdanta oo qaabilay  wefti ka socday shirkadda AuRONYX
items.description: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Tamarta iyo Macdanta Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Eng.Axmed Jaamac Barre, ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay wefti ka socday shirkadda AuRONYX, oo danaynaysa maalgashiga iyo sahaminta khayraadka Tamarta iyo Macdanta Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Weftiga shirkadda waxa hoggaaminayey Lorenzo Morolda iyo Xildhibaan Sir Gavin Williamson, kuwaas oo Wasiirka kala hadlay fursadaha maalgashi ee ka jira macdanta, Jsl horumarinta iskaashiga, iyo sidii loo dardargelin lahaa maalgashiyo wax ku ool ah oo qayb ka qaata koboca dhaqaalaha Somaliland. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu falanqeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in maalgashigu ku salaysnaado hufnaan, isla xisaabtan, iyo u hoggaansanaanta shuruucda iyo xeerarka dalka, si loo xaqiijiyo ka faa’iidaysi waara oo khayraadka dabiiciga ah. Wasiir Axmed Jaamac Barre ayaa sheegay in Somaliland ay leedahay khayraad macdaneed oo hodan ah iyo jawi maalgashi oo soo jiidasho leh, isagoo xusay in Wasaaraddu ay soo dhowaynayso maalgashadayaasha u hoggaansamaya shuruucda dalka isla markaana doonaya iskaashi waara oo faa’iido u leh labada dhinac.

items.title: Madaxweynaha Waqooyi Bari oo kormeer ku tegay fadhiisinka ciidamada Daraawiishta ee Sallinta
items.description: Madaxweynaha maamulka Waqooyi Bari, Cabdiqaadir Axmed Aw-cali, ayaa maanta kormeer shaqo ku tegay fadhiisinka ciidamada Daraawiishta ee deegaanka Sallinta, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay saraakiisha iyo ciidamada ku sugan furimaha difaaca. Madaxweynaha ayaa markii uu gaaray saldhigga salaan sharaf ka qaatay cutubyo ka tirsan ciidamada Daraawiishta, isagoo sidoo kale gacan qaaday askarta, kuna ammaanay doorkooda ku aaddan sugidda amniga iyo difaaca deegaannada Waqooyi Bari. Intii uu booqashada ku jiray, Madaxweyne Cabdiqaadir ayaa kulan la yeeshay saraakiisha ciidamada, isagoo kala hadlay xoojinta feejignaanta amni, diyaar-garowga ciidamada iyo sida looga jawaabi karo khatar kasta oo amniga wax u dhimi karta. Waxa uu sidoo kale bogaadiyey naf-hurnimada ciidamada Daraawiishta ee ay ku ilaalinayaan shacabka iyo deegaannada ay masuulka ka yihiin, isagoo ballanqaaday in dowladdu ay dhammaystiri doonto xuquuqda ciidamada iyo dib-u-habaynta hay’adaha amniga, taas oo uu sheegay inay mareyso heerarkii ugu dambeeyay.

items.title: XILDHIBAANO KA TIRSAN BAARLAMAANKA JAMHUURIYADDA FEDERAALKA SOOMAALIYA OO KOONFUR AFRIKA UGA QEYB GALAYA SHIRKA BAARLAMAANKA AFRIKA
items.description: Shirweynaha Baarlamaanka Afrika ee (Pan-African Parliament) ayaa ka socda magaalada Midrand ee dalka Koonfur Afrika, waxaana shirka oo ay ka qeyb galayaan xildhibaanno ka kala socda baarlamaanada dalalka Afrika, Soomaaliya ku metelaya Xildhibaano ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya labadiisa Aqal. Shirka sanadkan oo halku dhigiisu yahay Xaqiijinta Helitaanka Biyo Waara iyo Nidaamyo Fayadhowr oo Ammaan ah si loo gaaro Himilooyinka Ajendaha 2063, ayaa sidoo kale waxaa looga doodayaa arrimo muhiim u ah qaaradda Afrika oo ay ka mid yihiin nabadda iyo amniga, dimuqraadiyadda, dowlad-wanaagga, iyo isdhexgalka dalalka Afrika. Wafdiga Xildhibaanada ah ee Soomaaliya ku metelaya shirweynaha Afrika ee (Pan-African Parliament), waxaa ku wehliya mas’uuliyiinta safaaradda Soomaaliya ee dalka koonfur Afrika oo uu ugu horreeyo Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya u fadhiya dalka Koonfur Afrika Danjire Aadan Isaaq iyo Diblomaasiyiinta kale ee safaaradda.

items.title: Daawo: Mucaaradka oo laga dalbaday inay ka laabtaan warqadii muranka dhalisay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Abwaanada Soomaaliyeed oo maanta shir jaraa’id ku qabtay gudaha magaalada Muqdisho ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka, gaar ahaan warqaddii muranka dhalisay ee ay mucaaradka u direen m adaxda dalalka ay ciidamada ka joogaan Soomaaliya. Abwaan Xirsi Nuux oo ka hadlay kulanka ayaa ka dalbaday siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, gaar ahaan Golaha Mustaqbalka inay ka laabtaan warqadda ay ku dalbeen in la dhiso Gole ku-meel-gaar ah oo dalka hoggaamiya, inta lagu jiro kala guurka. Sidoo kale, Abwaanka ayaa ugu baaqay xubnaha mucaaradka in aysan dalkooda ka gelin godob siyaasadeed, isla markaana ay fakiraan mustaqbalka dowladnimada Soomaaliya. “Siyaasiyiinta Soomaaliyeed ee warka ku gudbiyay warqadda, waxaan idin leenahay ka laabta wixii aad dhahdeen haddii aad rabtaan inaad berri Soomaali xukuntaan,” ayuu yiri Abwaan Xirsi Dhuux. Waxaa kale oo uu sii raaciyay “Soomaaliya dowlad la’aan ma ahaan karto, Soomaaliya Maxmiyad ma galeyso, mana rabto lama gumeysan karo, lamana gumeysan doono”. Abwaan Xirsi ayaa sidoo kale ugu baaqay mucaaradka inay ka fogaadaan hadallada iyo falalka niyad-jabka ku abuuri kara shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo taageerayaashooda, maadaama ay hami ka leeyihiin hoggaaminta dalka. “Waxaan idinka codsaneynaa in aadan niyad-jebin dadka Soomaaliyeed ee horumarka iyo dowladnimada jecel, sidoo kalena aadna niyad-jebina dadka sida qaaska idin taageera,” ayuu mar kale yiri Abwaanka Xirsi Dhuux. Si kastaba, m uranka ka dhashay warqadda ay direen mucaaradka ayaa hadda u muuqda mid aan ku koobneyn khilaafka dowladda iyo mucaaradka, balse bannaanka keenay kala duwanaansho ka dhex jira Golaha Mustaqbalka iyo isbahaysiyada xubnaha ka ah, gaar ahaan su’aasha ah in xal siyaasadeed lagu raadiyo gole ku-meelgaar ah ama wada-hadal lala galo madaxda hadda talada haysa. Warqadda ayaa sidoo kale dhalisay mucaarado xooggan oo mucaaradka uga timid shacabka, oo lama filaan ay ku noqotay in dad doonaya in ay dalka maamulaan ay hadda dalbanayaan in dib loogu noqdo marxalad ku-meel gaar ah. The post Daawo: Mucaaradka oo laga dalbaday inay ka laabtaan warqadii muranka dhalisay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia Election Talks Collapse as Opposition Pushes for Transitional Authority Amid Growing Political Rift
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — More than two months of internationally mediated negotiations between Somalia’s Federal Government and opposition leaders have reportedly ended without agreement, plunging the country deeper into constitutional and electoral uncertainty. The talks, facilitated by international partners, sought to bridge differences over Somalia’s electoral model and constitutional disputes. Instead, they concluded in deadlock, with opposition leaders accusing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of refusing to make the political compromises necessary to reach a national consensus. Following the collapse of the negotiations, the opposition-led Future Forum proposed the establishment of an inclusive transitional governing authority, arguing that such an arrangement is now the only viable mechanism to restore political legitimacy, rebuild public confidence, and steer the country toward agreed constitutional and electoral reforms. Opposition Proposal Sparks Immediate Backlash The proposal immediately drew criticism from two opposition politicians, namely former r Minister Mohamed Abukar Islow  and former mayor of Mogadishu Thabit Mohamed, who argued that replacing existing institutions with an unelected transitional body could weaken Somalia’s fragile statehood and reverse years of institutional progress. Their response, however, triggered an equally sharp backlash from sections of the opposition and a sizeable number of politically engaged Somalis, who questioned both the timing and substance of their objections. Supporters of the Future Forum argue that while the two politicians were quick to reject the transitional proposal, they failed to offer any credible alternative for breaking the current political deadlock. According to critics, simply urging further dialogue without presenting a practical roadmap does little to resolve a crisis that has already defied months of internationally sponsored mediation. The criticism has gone beyond the proposal itself. Within opposition circles, and among a significant segment of the politically active public, the two politicians are increasingly viewed as voices that consistently defend President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration rather than acting as independent opposition figures. Their detractors argue that their public interventions frequently mirror the government’s position while rarely challenging policies that have generated widespread political controversy. Critics point to what they describe as their silence during several contentious episodes over the past four years, including allegations surrounding the sale of public land in Mogadishu, which opposition figures claim displaced more than 760,000 low-income residents, as well as security operations directed against political opponents. Those allegations remain disputed and have not been independently established. For many supporters of the Future Forum, the issue is no longer simply whether the transitional proposal is the best solution. Rather, they argue that those rejecting it have yet to explain what realistic alternative exists after repeated negotiations have failed to produce agreement. On the other hand, the strongest government reaction came from Defense Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi, who forcefully rejected the proposal and accused the Future Forum of seeking to dismantle Somalia’s constitutional order. Fiqi also alleged that foreign interests were attempting to exploit Somalia’s political divisions, although he presented no public evidence to substantiate the claim. Referring to the violent confrontations that took place in Mogadishu in June 2026, the minister warned that any attempt to undermine the government would be met “with the same firmness” displayed during those events. His remarks have heightened concerns among political observers, who warn that increasingly confrontational rhetoric from senior officials risks further polarizing an already fragile political environment. No Breakthrough in Sight With internationally mediated talks now at an impasse, Somalia appears farther than ever from achieving consensus on elections and constitutional governance. The Future Forum insists that a broad-based transitional authority offers the only realistic path out of the crisis. Its critics reject that approach but have yet to unite around an alternative proposal capable of commanding broad political support. As a result, the national debate has shifted beyond whether a transitional arrangement is desirable to a more pressing question: if not a transitional authority, what practical mechanism remains for ending a political stalemate that months of negotiations have failed to resolve? Until that question is convincingly answered, Somalia’s constitutional crisis is likely to deepen, leaving uncertainty—not consensus—as the defining feature of the country’s political landscape. items.title: Jordan, Somalia foreign ministers talk ties, region
items.description: Minister of Foreign and Expatriates Affairs Ayman Safadi discussed ties and regional developments during a telephone call on Tuesday with Somalia’s Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Abdisalam Abdi Ali. The two ministers reviewed the situation in the occupied West Bank and ongoing efforts to ensure adherence to the ceasefire agreement between the United States and Iran, as well as efforts to reach a comprehensive agreement that promotes lasting security and stability. Safadi said Jordan supports Somalia’s security, stability, sovereignty and territorial integrity. Petra .

items.title: Military Truck Plows into Civilians Near Kismayo, Killing at Least Four
items.description: Kismayo (WDN) – At least four civilians were killed and another seriously injured after a military truck belonging to Somali National Army forces operating in Jubaland reportedly veered off the road and crashed into a group of civilian workers near Kismayo on Tuesday, according to reports from local media and eyewitnesses. The fatal incident occurred on the road linking Kismayo Airport with the Haadweyne Water Company facilities, an area where utility workers were carrying out maintenance on the city’s water infrastructure. Witnesses told local media that the military vehicle was traveling at high speed when the driver allegedly lost control, causing the truck to leave the roadway and plow directly into workers repairing water pipelines along the roadside. The impact was devastating. Employees of Haadweyne Water Company confirmed that four workers were killed instantly, while another sustained serious injuries and was rushed for medical treatment. “The truck suddenly came off the road and struck the workers without warning,” one eyewitness reportedly said, describing scenes of panic and devastation as bystanders rushed to assist the victims. The victims were reportedly engaged in routine maintenance work on water supply pipes when the accident occurred, leaving colleagues and residents in shock. The tragedy has once again raised serious concerns about road safety involving military vehicles operating in civilian areas, particularly around populated urban centers where speeding and inadequate traffic controls can have deadly consequences. As of publication, no official statement had been issued by the Somali National Army or relevant government authorities explaining the cause of the crash, the condition of the military driver, or whether an investigation has been launched. The absence of an immediate official response is likely to fuel calls for accountability from victims’ families and local residents, who are demanding answers over how a routine day’s work ended in such a devastating loss of life. The incident has cast a shadow over Kismayo, where many residents are mourning the deaths of workers who were simply carrying out essential public service duties when disaster struck. items.title: AUSSOM oo Bilowday Qorshaha Wareejinta Hawgalka Amniga Soomaaliya, 20 Sano Sano Kadib
items.description: Addis Ababa (WDN) – Hawlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) ayaa si rasmi ah u bilaabay diyaarinta qorshaha lagu wareejinayo mas’uuliyadda amniga ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, taas oo calaamad u ah wejiga ugu dambeeya ee hawlgal muddo ku dhow labaatan sano laf-dhabar u ahaa amniga Soomaaliya. Qorshahan ayaa saldhig u ahaa kulan ka dhacay magaalada Addis Ababa, kaas oo dhex maray Madaxa Hawlgalka AUSSOM, Danjire El Hadji Ibrahima Diene, iyo Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf, iyagoo ka wada hadlay istaraatiijiyadda bixitaanka AUSSOM iyo sida Soomaaliya uga diyaarsan tahay inay si buuxda ula wareegto amniga dalka. Sida ilo xog-ogaal ahi sheegeen, Danjire Diene ayaa qiray in go’aannadii ugu dambeeyay ee Mareykanka ee la xiriiray taageerada hawlgalka ay caqabado hor leh ku abuureen AUSSOM, taasoo sii xoojisay baahida loo qabo in ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya ay si degdeg ah ula wareegaan masuuliyadda amniga ka hor dhammaadka sanadkan, marka uu dhacayo muddo-xileedka hawlgalka. Wareejintan ayaa loo arkaa mid ka mid ah isbeddellada ugu waaweyn ee soo mara taariikhda amniga Soomaaliya. Tan iyo markii la aas-aasay AMISOM, ka dibna loo beddelay AUSSOM, ciidamada Midowga Afrika waxay door muhiim ah ka ciyaareen dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab, difaaca hay’adaha dowladda, iyo dib-u-dhiska ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliyeed. Inkasta oo beesha caalamku sannado badan maalgelin iyo tababar ku bixisay ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, haddana waxaa weli taagan walaac xooggan oo ku saabsan in ciidamada qaranku ay si buuxda u buuxin karaan kaalinta ay banayn doonaan kumannaan askari oo AUSSOM ah marka ay dalka ka baxaan. Arrimahaasi ayaa la filayaa inay si weyn uga dhex muuqdaan shir heer sare ah oo toddobaadka soo socda ka furmi doona magaalada Kampala, Uganda, kaas oo ay ka qayb geli doonaan Qaramada Midoobay, Midowga Afrika, dowladaha ciidamada ku leh Soomaaliya iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Shirka Kampala ayaa lagu wadaa in lagu gaaro go’aanno kama dambeys ah oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka hawlgalka, jadwalka bixitaanka ciidamada, wareejinta masuuliyadda amniga, iyo nooca taageero ee caalamku sii siin doono Soomaaliya marka uu dhammaado waajibaadka AUSSOM. La-tashiyo diblomaasiyaddeed ayaa durba socda, iyadoo dhinacyada ay khusayso ay isku dayayaan inay gaaraan is-afgarad ku saabsan sida ugu habboon ee loo maareyn karo marxaladdan kala-guurka ah. Go’aannada ka soo baxa Kampala ayaa la rumeysan yahay inay si weyn u qaabeyn doonaan mustaqbalka amniga Soomaaliya, iyadoo la isku miisaamayo khatarta ka dhalan karta dhammaadka mid ka mid ah hawlgalladii nabad-ilaalinta ugu dheeraa ee Afrika iyo baahida sii kordheysa ee ah in Soomaaliya ay si buuxda ula wareegto mas’uuliyadda amniga dalkeeda. Soomaaliya, natiijada shirkan waxay noqon kartaa mid go’aamisa jihada mustaqbalka—ma aha oo keliya dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab, balse sidoo kale dadaallada lagu xoojinayo dowladnimada iyo hay’addaha qaranka kadib labaatan sano oo taageero ciidan iyo mid amni oo caalami ah. items.title: Puntland oo ciidamo badan geeysay waqooyiga magaalada Gaalkacyo
items.description: Garoowe ( Raxanreeb Online) Maamul goboleedka Puntland ayaa ciidamo aad u badan ku daabulay magaalada Gaalkacayo ee xarunta gobolka Mudug, iyadoo dawladda Soomaaliya ku eedaysay in ay colaad ka hurinayso gobolka Mudug. Puntland ayaa sheegtay in Koonfurta Gaalkacayo, ay dowladda federaalka ka soo gelinayso hub laga keenay magalaada Muqdisho sida ay shegeen mas’uuliyiin u hadlay Puntland. Waxa ay intaas ku dareen mas’uuliyiinta, in ciidamo kala duwan ay gaareen jiidaha magaalada Gaalkacayo gaar ahaan waqooyiga magaalada. Ciidamada Puntland geysay halkaasi ayaa la tilmaamay in ay kor u qaadayaan amniga iyo nabad-galyada magaalada. Sidoo kale maamulka Puntland ayaa sheegay in ay qabateen  dhar, kabo ciidan iyo saanad kale oo laga soo geliyey dhinaca Galmudug loona waday ciidamo ka amar qaata dawladda Soomaaliya oo ku sugan gudaha Puntland. items.title: Political Shock Deepens in Northeast State as Six MPs Defect to Somaliland
items.description: LasAnod (WDN) – The political crisis facing the Northeast State administration has deepened dramatically after six members of the North Eastern State parliament announced their decision to align themselves with Somaliland, raising fresh questions about the cohesion, legitimacy, and long-term viability of the fledgling administration. The defections have dealt a significant political blow to Northeast leadership, exposing divisions that critics say have been simmering beneath the surface since the administration was established. Despite the seriousness of the development, Northeast leader Abdikadir Ahmed Aw-Ali “Firdhiye” sought to project confidence, insisting that the administration remains united and committed to its political course. His reassurances, however, have done little to quiet growing concerns among observers, who argue that the loss of six sitting lawmakers represents far more than an isolated political disagreement. Instead, they view it as a test of the administration’s ability to maintain internal cohesion at a time when its institutions are still taking shape. Political analysts note that parliamentary defections are particularly significant because they signal discontent from within the very institutions responsible for sustaining the administration’s legitimacy. The departure of elected representatives inevitably raises questions about confidence in the leadership and the direction of the political project. Some critics argue that the response from Firdhiye has underestimated the scale of the crisis. Rather than acknowledging the political implications of losing multiple legislators, they contend that the administration has projected an image of business as usual despite a development that could have lasting consequences. The episode has also revived debate over the strategic assumptions that underpinned the creation of Northeast. Some political commentators have recalled earlier warnings by the respected traditional leader Garad Jama Garad Ali Garad Jama, who urged that political decisions be grounded in long-term realities rather than public emotion. Those critics now argue that recent events have reinforced concerns that political enthusiasm alone cannot substitute for durable institutions, broad consensus, and sustainable governance. Another issue highlighted by critics is the administration’s territorial reach. They argue that Northeast currently exercises authority over only a limited number of districts and lacks effective administrative control beyond those areas. They further maintain that the wider Sanaag region remains outside Northeast’s authority and continues to be administered largely by Puntland—an issue that remains politically contested and subject to competing claims. For supporters of Northeast, however, the defections represent a temporary political setback rather than a strategic defeat. They argue that political realignments are common during periods of institutional formation and insist that the administration remains committed to consolidating governance and expanding public support. The contrasting narratives illustrate the increasingly polarized debate surrounding Northeast’s future. Whether the recent parliamentary defections prove to be an isolated incident or the beginning of a broader political realignment remains uncertain. What is clear is that the administration now faces one of its most serious internal challenges since its establishment. As political tensions continue to evolve, the central question confronting Northeast is no longer simply one of political recognition or territorial claims. It is whether its leadership can maintain unity, rebuild confidence, and demonstrate that the project can withstand growing internal and external pressures. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo qaabilay xildhibaan katirsan golaha Wakiilada Mareykanka
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Villa Somalia, ku qaabilay Xildhibaan Darin LaHood oo ka tirsan Aqalka Golaha Wakiillada Dowladda Mareykanka, kaasi oo safar shaqo kusoo gaaray dalka. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka istaraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka ee dhinacyada xoojinta nabadda, amniga, la dagaallanka argagixisada, iyo arrimaha kale ee ganacsiga iyo dhiiragelinta maalgashiga. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa uga mahadceliyey Dowladda iyo shacabka Mareykanka taageerada ay la garab taagan yihiin shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo adkeeyey in Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay sii xoojinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah iyo xaqiijinta jawi amni oo horseeda maalgashi iyo horumar. Dhankiisa, Xildhibaan Darin LaHood ayaa bogaadiyey horumarka ay Soomaaliya ka sameyneyso dib u dhiska hay’adaha dowladda, xasillinta dalka iyo dagaalka lagula jiro argagixisada, isaga oo muujiyey sida ay uga go’an tahay sii xoojinta xiriirka saaxiibtinimo iyo wada-shaqeynta u dhexeysa labada dal. items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo Madaxtooyada ku qaabilay Xildhibaan Mareykan ah + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynah Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta Talaado ah Aqalka Madaxtooyada ku qaabilay Xildhibaan Darin LaHood oo ka tirsan Aqalka Golaha Wakiillada Mareykanka, kaasi oo safar shaqo kusoo gaaray dalka. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Villa Soomaaliya ayaa lagu sheegay in kulanka looga hadlay xoojinta xiriirka istaraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada nabadda, amniga iyo la dagaallanka argagixisada. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha iyo Xildhibaanka ayaa kulankooda ku soo qaaday arrimaha kale ee ganacsiga iyo dhiiragelinta maalgashiga, maadaama ay fursado muhiim ah ka jiraan gudaha Soomaaliya. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale uga mahadceliyey Dowladda iyo shacabka Mareykanka taageerada ay la garab taagan yihiin shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo adkeeyey in Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay sii xoojinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah iyo xaqiijinta jawi amni oo horseeda maalgashi iyo horumar. Xildhibaan Darin LaHood ayaa dhankiisa bogaadiyey horumarka ay Soomaaliya ka sameyneyso dib u dhiska hay’adaha dowladda, xasillinta dalka iyo dagaalka lagula jiro argagixisada, isaga oo muujiyey sida ay uga go’an tahay sii xoojinta xiriirka saaxiibtinimo iyo wada-shaqeynta u dhexeysa labada dal. Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka ayaa muddo dheer ku saleysnaa iskaashi dhinacyo badan leh, gaar ahaan amniga, la dagaallanka argagixisada, dib u dhiska hay’adaha dowladda, horumarinta dimuqraadiyadda iyo taageerada bani’aadannimo. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale ka mid ah saaxiibbada ugu waaweyn ee Soomaaliya, isaga oo si joogto ah u taageerta dadaallada lagu xoojinayo awoodda hay’adaha amniga iyo kuwa rayidka ah, waxaa kale oo uu ka qeyb qaataa mashaariic lagu horumarinayo adeegyada bulshada iyo kobcinta dhaqaalaha. Booqashada Xildhibaan Darin LaHood ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay dardargelinayso dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka ay la leedahay dalalka saaxiibka la ah Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan Mareykanka. items.title: Gudoomiyaha xisbiga talada haya ee Waddani oo xafiiskiisa  ku qaabilay waftiyo ka socda Maraykanka Iyo  Czech

items.title: Arsenal oo caqabado kala kulmeysa xiisaha Bruno Guimarães
items.description: Kooxda Arsenal ayaa sii wadda dadaalka ay ku dooneyso kabtanka Newcastle United , Bruno Guimarães, balse tababaraha Newcastle Eddie Howe ayaa sheegay in uusan hubin mustaqbalka ciyaaryahanka reer Brazil . Newcastle ayaa ku adkeysaneysa inaysan iibin kabtankooda haddii aan la helin qiimaha ay ku qanacsan yihiin, iyadoo la sheegay in Arsenal ay diyaar u tahay inay bixiso £70 milyan , balse Newcastle ay u arkaan qiimahaas mid aad u hooseeya . Xiisaha Arsenal ayaa yimid xilli ay kooxdu sidoo kale u baahan tahay daafac cusub kadib dhaawacii William Saliba . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, maamulka Newcastle ayaa caddeeyay inaysan doonayn inay iibiyaan Guimarães , waxaana la sheegay inay ku qanacsan yihiin qiimo aad u sarreeya . Ilaa iyo hadda lama xaqiijin dalab rasmi ah oo Arsenal ay u dirtay Newcastle, mana dhicin wada-hadallo toos ah oo dhex maray labada kooxood . Eddie Howe, oo ka hadlay kadib kulankii saaxiibtinimo ee ay la ciyaareen Gateshead, ayaa sheegay inuu la yeeshay wada-hadallo wanaagsan Guimarães ka hor, xilligii, iyo ka dib Koobka Adduunka . Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Ma garanayo waxa ku dhacaya mustaqbalka Bruno. Taasi waa wax ay dadka kale ku sheekeystaan, waana wada-hadallo aanan qayb ka ahayn” . Howe ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu rajeynayo inuu Bruno sii joogo St James’ Park , isagoo ku ammaanay ciyaaryahankeeda. “Bruno waa kabtanka kooxdeena. Wuxuu ahaa ciyaaryahan iyo qof aan la rumeysan karin intii aan wada shaqaynay,” ayuu yiri . Wuxuu caddeeyay in Bruno uusan muujin wax calaamad ah oo ah inuu diiday inuu ku biiro diyaar-garowga xilli ciyaareedka cusub, isagoo la filayo inuu ku soo laabato tababarka 31-ka Luulyo . Arsenal sidoo kale waxay raadineysaa daafac cusub oo dabooli kara maqnaanshaha William Saliba , kaas oo dhaawac ka soo gaaray Koobka Adduunka . John Stones, oo ah ciyaaryahan xor ah ka dib markii uu ka tagay Manchester City , ayaa la xiriiriyay Arsenal iyadoo Mikel Arteta uu garanayo ciyaaryahanka, balse waxaa jira welwel ku saabsan taariikhdiisa dhaawacyada . Ezri Konsa oo Aston Villa ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inuu yahay bartilmaameed, laakiin Villa waxay ku qiimeyso £60 milyan . The post Arsenal oo caqabado kala kulmeysa xiisaha Bruno Guimarães first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Wasiirka Amniga iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka XDS oo u ambabaxay Kampala ka hor safarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh
items.description: Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag), iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa u ambabaxay magaalada Kampala ee caasimadda dalka Uganda. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Kenya oo ka wada-hadlay arrimaha socdaalka kadib bahdilkii…
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) oo magaalada Addis Ababa uga qayb-galay Kalfadhiga 49-aad ee Golaha Fulinta Midowga Afrika ayaa maanta kulan doceed la yeeshay dhiggiisa dalka Kenya Hon Musalia W Mudavadi, isaga oo kala hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ay kamid yihiin socdaalka labada waddan. Labada wasiir ayaa kulankooda si gaar ah diiradda ugu saaray dhacdooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ee la xiriira arrimaha socdaalka, kadib markii maalmo kahor wasiirro ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya laga soo celiyay gudaha magaalada Nairobi ee caasimada Kenya, taas oo dhalisay hadal-heyn xooggan. Wasiirrada labada dowladood ayaa ku heshiiyay in la xoojiyo iskaashiga iyo isku-duwidda arrimaha qunsuliyadaha iyo fududeynta isu socodka shacabka labada dal. Cabdisalaan iyo Mudavadi ayaa si wadajir ah u sheegay sida ay uga go’an tahay sii xoojinta xiriirka laba geesoodka ah, gaar ahaan arrimaha muhiimka u ah xasilloonida iyo nabadgelyada gobolka. Dhacdadooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ee dhacay ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo Kenya uu wajahayo marxalad xasaasi ah, iyada oo labada dal ay ka wada shaqeynayaan arrimo la xiriira amniga, ganacsiga iyo iskaashiga gobolka, balse ay mararka qaar soo kala dhex galaan khilaafaad siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa shalay ugu yeertay safiirka Kenya u fadhiya Muqdisho, si wax looga waydiiyo tallaabooyinka ay qaaday dowladdiisa ee lagu soo celiyay wasiirrada oo ugu dambeeyay Abshir Maxamed Axmed (Bukhaari) oo ah wasiiru dowlaha Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya, kaas oo Axaddii lasoo dhaafay laga soo celiyay Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA). Dhacdadan ayaa si weyn u qabsatay baraha bulshada iyo warbaahinta, kuwaas oo si weyn u falalqeeyay soo celinta Wasiir Abshir Bukhaari oo aad ugu dhow Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka XFS oo Gaaray Gaalkacyo iyadoo Galmudug isu diyaarinayso Doorashooyinka
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Saalax Axmed Jaamac, iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Gaalkacyo ee gobolka Mudug. Ilaa iyo hadda, Dowladda Federaalka iyo maamulka Galmudug si rasmi ah ugama aysan hadlin ujeeddada safarka wafdigan, hase yeeshee imaanshahooda ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli uu sare u kacay dhaqdhaqaaqa siyaasadeed ee la xiriira doorashooyinka la filayo inay ka dhacaan deegaannada maamulka Galmudug.

items.title: Former PM Warns Puntland Against ‘Aggression’ in Galkayo
items.description: Former Somali Prime Minister Omar Abdirashid Ali Sharmarke has warned Puntland’s leadership that any armed confrontation in Galkayo could carry serious political and security consequences. In a statement addressing mounting tensions in the city, Sharmarke urged Puntland authorities to exercise restraint and avoid actions that could lead to clashes between forces affiliated with the administration. He said Galkayo’s political and security dynamics differed significantly from those of the Cal-Miskaad mountain region, stressing that the situation required dialogue, de-escalation and a negotiated settlement rather than military action. Sharmarke cautioned Puntland against launching what he described as an “act of aggression” against other Puntland-affiliated forces without a clear legal justification. He also raised concerns over reported troop movements and the deployment of weapons towards Galkayo, warning that diverting military resources to an internal dispute could weaken ongoing operations against militant groups. The former prime minister said internal confrontation could undermine counterterrorism efforts, deepen political divisions and destabilise an already sensitive city. He called on Puntland’s leadership to prioritise peace, dialogue and coordination among security forces, warning that internal disputes should not be allowed to derail broader efforts to maintain stability and combat terrorism. items.title: Soomaaliya oo ka qaybgalaysa Kalfadhiga 49-aad ee Golaha Fulinta Midowga Afrika
items.description: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Abdisalaam Cabdi Cali (Dhaay), ayaa hoggaaminaya wafdiga Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ka qaybgalaya Kalfadhiga 49-aad ee caadiga ah ee Golaha Fulinta Midowga Afrika, kaas oo lagu qabanayo magaalada Addis Ababa ee dalka Itoobiya. Kalfadhigan ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa halku-dhigga “Sugidda Helitaanka Biyaha Joogtada ah”, iyadoo waddamada xubnaha ka ah Midowga Afrika ay iska kaashanayaan xal u helidda caqabadaha la xiriira biyaha iyo isbeddelka cimilada. Inta uu socdo shirka, Soomaaliya ayaa soo bandhigi doonta dadaallada ay ku xoojinayso amniga biyaha, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin Mashruuca Barwaaqo ee Biyaha iyo Adkeysiga Reer Miyiga, iyo hirgelinta laba ceel-biyood oo cusub oo ku shaqeeya tamarta qorraxda, kuwaas oo lagu ballaarinayo helitaanka biyo nadiif ah ee bulshada. Sidoo kale, wafdiga Soomaaliya ayaa ka qayb qaadan doona doodaha ku saabsan xoojinta Guddiga Midowga Afrika iyo horumarinta mudnaanta iyo himilooyinka wadajirka ah ee qaaradda, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay muujinayso doorkeeda ku aaddan iskaashiga iyo horumarka Afrika.

items.title: Xaalad adag oo ka taagan ITOOBIYA kadib markii…
items.description: Mekelle (Caasimada Online) – Xaalad adag ayaa ka taagan dalka Itoobiya kadib markii roobab culus, baraf iyo dabeylo xooggan oo ku dhuftay qaybo ka mid ah gobolka Tigray ee waqooyiga Itoobiya. Ugu yaraan hal wiil oo 12 jir ah ayaa geeriyooday, halka in ka badan 10,000 oo qof ay ku barakaceen roobabka, iyadoo mas’uuliyiinta deegaanka ay sheegeen in masiibadan dabiiciga ah ay sababtay burbur baahsan oo soo gaaray guryaha, beeraha iyo xoolaha nool. Habtom Zenebe oo ah ku-xigeenka maamulaha degmada ay dhibaatadu sida weyn u saameysay ee ku taalla Aagga Dhexe ee Tigray ayaa sheegay in cimilada daran ay ahayd mid aan horay loo arag. Wuxuu xusay in roobka watay dhagaxaan baraf ah iyo dabeylaha xooggan ay saameeyeen shan aag maamul iyo toddobo degmo, taasoo dhalisay khasaaro baaxad leh. “Waxaan la kulannay roob baraf wata oo aad u culus, kaas oo aan hore loogu arag deegaannadan,” ayuu yiri Habtom, isagoo xusay in duufaantu ay ku dhufatay deegaanka Talaadadii la soo dhaafay, isla markaana dhagaxyadii barafka ay weli ka muuqdaan dhulka inkastoo dhowr maalmood ay ka soo wareegeen dhacdada. Mas’uulkan ayaa sheegay in wiilka geeriyooday uu xilligaas lo’diisa la joogay, balse uu ku qaaday daadad degdeg ah oo ka dhashay roobka xooggan. “Gurigiisa ma uusan gaarin markii ay haleeleen roobkii iyo daadadkii,” ayuu yiri, isagoo tilmaamay in tani ay tahay dhimashada keliya ee ilaa hadda si rasmi ah loo diiwaangeliyay. Khasaaraha ugu weyn waxaa laga diiwaangeliyay degmada Red Tikhili, inkastoo degmooyin kale oo ka tirsan Aagga Dhexe ee Tigray ay sidoo kale soo gaareen waxyeello. Sidoo kale waxaa la xaqiijiyay dhimashada 201 neef oo xoolo ah oo ay ku jiraan lo’ iyo ari, halka 12 guri ay gebi ahaanba burbureen, 625 guri oo kalena ay soo gaareen burbur iyo dhaawac kala duwan. Duufaantu waxay sidoo kale saameyn xooggan ku yeelatay dhinaca beeraha. Qiyaastii 1,060 hektar oo dalag ah ayaa waxyeello soo gaartay, kuwaas oo intooda badan la beeray xilligii roobabka Abriil, islamarkaana weli ku jiray marxaladdii koritaanka. Mas’uuliyiintu waxay ka digeen in khasaarahan uu saameyn ku yeelan karo wax-soo-saarka cuntada iyo nolosha kumannaan qoys oo beeraley ah. Habtom Zenebe ayaa sheegay in degmada ay ka hor duufaanta soo martay 46 maalmood oo xiriir ah oo aan wax roob ahi ka di’in. Wuxuu xusay in saadaasha hawadu ay muujinayso in roobabka xilliyeedku ay dib u dhici doonaan, isla markaana aysan si joogto ah u di’i doonin, arrintaas oo sii kordhin karta walaaca laga qabo xaaladda beeraha iyo maciishadda dadka deegaanka. Saraakiisha degmada ayaa sheegay in 2,134 qoys oo u dhiganta ku dhowaad 10,556 qof, ay ku barakaceen musiibada. Intooda badan waxay gabaad ka dhigteen guryaha eheladooda iyo deriskooda, halka qaar kalena la dejiyay hoy ku-meel-gaar ah. Maamulka ayaa sheegay in dadkaasi ay si degdeg ah ugu baahan yihiin cunto, biyo nadiif ah, hoy iyo adeegyo caafimaad. “Ilaa hadda wax gargaar ah lama helin, balse mas’uuliyiin ka socday degmada, gobolka iyo aagga ayaa booqday goobaha ay dhibaatadu ka dhacday, waxaana rajeynaynaa in gargaar degdeg ah uu xigi doono,” ayuu yiri Habtom oo ka digay in xaaladdu kasii dari karto haddii gargaar degdeg ah aan la gaarsiin. Dhanka kale, Hay’adda Saadaasha Hawada ee Itoobiya ayaa ka digtay in isbeddellada aan caadiga ahayn ee cimiladu ay saameyn ku yeelan karaan qaybo badan oo dalka ah, oo ay ku jirto gobolka Tigray. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in deegaanno qaar ay wajihi karaan abaaro, halka kuwo kalena ay halis ugu jiraan daadad iyo dhul-go’ ka dhasha roobab ka badan heerarkii caadiga ahaa, taasoo sare u qaadaysa baahida loo qabo gurmad degdeg ah. The post Xaalad adag oo ka taagan ITOOBIYA kadib markii… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo guul ka sheegatay dagaal ka dhacay gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose
items.description: Shabeellaha Hoose ( Raxanreeb Online) Warar dheeraad ah ayaa kasoo baxaya dagaal u dhaxeeyay ciidanak xoogga dalka iyo maleeshiyaad katirsan A-shabaab oo ka dhacay deegaankka Sumadaale ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Bayaan kasoo baxay wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ee xukuumadda Soomaaliya, ayaa lagu sheegay in ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay dagaal ku qaadeen deegaanka Sumadaale ee Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, halkaas oo waayahii ugu dambeeyay ay ku dhuumaaleysanayeen maleeshiyada katirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab. Ciidamada ayaa la tilmaamay in ay beegsadeen fariisimihii iyo godadkii gabbaadka u ahaa maleeshiyada , iyagoo burburiyay goobihii ay ku dhuumaaleysanayeen, kuna guuleystay inay ka saaraan deegaanka. Sidoo kale bayaan wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa lagu xusay in ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay haatan sii wadaan howlgallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga deegaanka, iyadoo oo weli sii baacsanaya maleeshiyaadkii iyo horjoogayaashii goobta ka baxsday. Ugu dambeyn wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, ayaa lagu xaqiijinayay in gulufka ka dhanka ah Al-shabaab, uu sii socon doono, si dalka looga ciribtiro dalka.
