items.title: Buunbuuninta Al-Shabaab: Dano Dhaqaale, Siyaasadeed iyo Dagaal Nafsi ah
items.description: Muddo ka badan toban sano, qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha amniga ee ku kala sugan dibadda iyo gudaha dalka waxay si joogto ah u dhayalsanayeen adkaysiga shacabka iyo kartida Ciidamada Amniga Soomaaliyeed. Waxay qaadanayeen, qaybna ka ahaayeen, kas iyo kama’ba, sheekada kooxda al-Shabaab (AS), iyaga oo dhawr jeer saadaaliyay in caasimadda dalka ee Muqdisho ay ku dhacayso gacanta kooxda. Tusaalaha ugu weyn waxa aynu u soo qaadan karnaa warbixinnadii la daabacay iyo warbaahintii faafisay xilligii uu socday dagaalkii caanka ahaa ee ay kooxda AS soo qaaday Ramadaankii 2010. Subaxnimadii 23kii Agoosto 2010, kooxda AS waxay soo qaaday duullaan ballaadhan oo ay ugu magacdartay “Nihaayatul Muctadiin”, dadkuse waxay u yaqaannaan Dagaalkii Ramadaanka, sababtoo ah bishii Ramadaan ayaa maraysay 12keedii. Boqolkiiba toddobaatan Muqdisho waxa gacanta ku haysay kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee AS, halka Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka ahayd ee uu Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed madaxweyne ka ahaa ay keliya joogtay Madaxtooyada, gegida diyaaradaha iyo waddada isku xidha labadaas goobood. Haddaba, warbaahinta iyo xarumaha falanqaynta ee reer Galbeedku waxay soo saareen warbixinno iyo saadaallo isdabajoog ah oo u janjeeray dhinaca argaggaxisada, kuna doodayay in dawladda Soomaaliya ay ku dhowdahay inay gebi ahaanba meesha ka baxdo. Wargeyska caanka ah ee The New York Times ayaa 24kii Agoosto 2010 baahiyay warbixin aad u faaftay oo uu qoray suxufiga caanka ah ee Jeffrey Gettleman. Warbixintaas waxa cinwaan looga dhigay: “At Least 30 Killed in Attack on Hotel in Somalia”. Jeffrey wuxuu warbixintiisa ku falanqeeyay weerarkii khasaaraha badan dhaliyay ee ay laba ka mid ah inqimaasiyiinta kooxdu ku qaadeen Huteel Muna oo ku dhowaa xarunta Madaxtooyada. Jeffrey wuxuu si toos ah u sheegay in weerarkaas huteelku bannaanka keenay masiirka dhabta ah ee magaalada iyo sida ay u nugushahay dawladda Soomaaliya, isaga oo xilligaas ku sifeeyay in dawladda daciifka ahi ay dhawr tallaabo oo keliya u jirto inay gebi ahaanba burburto. Jeffrey wuxuu ka mid ahaa suxufiyiinta iyo saadaaliyayaasha rumaystay sheekadii kooxda ee ahayd in al-Shabaab, si ay ula wareegto Muqdisho, ay u baahan tahay muddo hal toddobaad ah oo keliya. Sidoo kale, wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters iyo telefishinka BBC-da ayaa baahiyay warbixinno dhawr ah oo ay ku sheegeen in Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka ahayd ay ku go’doonsanayd dhawr goobood. Waxay adeegsanayeen falanqayntii hay’adda caalamiga ah ee International Crisis Group (ICG), taas oo saadaalisay in caasimaddu ku dhowdahay inay si buuxda u gasho gacanta kooxda. Sidoo kale, shirkadda falanqaynta sirdoonka ee Stratfor ayaa soo saartay qiimayn amni oo ay ku sheegtay in istiraatiijiyadda kooxda ee duullaanka Nihaayatul Muctadiin ay ahayd dharbaaxadii ugu dambaysay ee meesha ka saari lahayd dawladda fadhigeedu ahaa Villa Somalia. Haddaba, kaddib sannad xidhiidh ah oo uu dagaal ba’ani socday, 6dii Agoosto 2011, warbaahintii reer Galbeedka iyo wariyayaashii afkooda ku saadaalinayay in Muqdisho lala wareegayo, oo Jeffrey ugu horreeyay, ayaa qoray in kooxda AS gebi ahaanba laga saaray caasimadda dalka ee Muqdisho. Tan iyo xilligaas, waxa muuqata in aanay cashar ka qaadan dhacdadaas, welina ay ku taagan yihiin dhabbadii khaldanayd. Falanqeeyayaashu waxay weli dhawrkii sannadoodba mar saadaaliyaan in kooxdu la wareegayso dalka. Tusaale ahaan, bishii Agoosto 2021, markii Daalibaan si buuxda ula wareegtay dalka Afgaanistaan, waxa soo baxay maqaallo dhawr ah oo ay qoreen xarumaha falanqaynta iyo warbaahinta caalamiga ahi, kuwaas oo si toos ah isugu barbardhigay Kaabul iyo Muqdisho. Warbixinnadaasi waxay saadaalinayeen in burburkii ku dhacay dawladdii Afgaanistaan uu si la mid ah ugu dhici karo dawladda Soomaaliya haddii ciidamada caalamiga ahi ay dalka ka baxaan. Mar kale, dhicitaankii dawladdii Bashaar Al-Asad ee dalka Suuriya bishii Diseembar 2024 wuxuu sababay in xarumo falanqayneed oo reer Galbeed ah, sida The Horn Institute, ay soo saaraan warbixinno ay isku dayayaan inay Soomaaliya la barbardhigaan Suuriya. Warbixinnadaasi waxay ku doodeen in, haddii ciidamada caalamiga ahi dalka ka baxaan, dawladdu u burburi karto si la mid ah sidii nidaamkii Dimishiq ugu burburay dhawr maalmood gudahood. Mar kalana, duullaankii ay kooxda AS soo qaadday horraantii 2025, ee ay ku qabsatay Aadanyabaal, ayaa haddana si la mid ah loo saadaaliyay in sannadkaas aanay dawladda Soomaaliya sii jiri karin. Caadi ahaan, sheekada ah in ciidamada shisheeye haddii ay baxaan ay kooxdu dalka maalmo gudahood ku qabsan karto, muddo badan waxa iibinaysay argaggaxisada, waxaana sii buunbuuninayay warbaahinta reer Galbeedka. Hasayeeshee, sheekadaas waxa buriyay oo beeniyay duullaankii ay dawladdu ku qaadday kooxda AS sannadihii 2022–2023 ee gobollada dhexe, kaas oo aanu la socon hal askari oo AMISOM ahi. In kasta oo duullaankaasi wax badan ka qaldanaayeen istiraatiijiyad ahaan iyo nidaam ahaanba, haddana jug culus ayuu arggaxisada gaarsiiyay; dhul badan ayaa laga qabsaday, saraakiil badanna waa looga dilay. Guusha ugu weynina waxay noqotay burinta sheekadii muddada dheer lagu celcelinayay ee ahayd in dawladdani aanay ka dambayn doonin bixitaanka AMISOM, iyo jebinta darbigii weynaa ee cabsida ahaa ee lagu sheegay in kooxda AS aan la iska dhicin karin. Haddaba, weydiinta mudan in la istoydo waxay tahay: waa ayo cidda ay saadaashani anfacayso, yayse faa’iido u tahay? Waxaa iska cad in saadaashani u adeegayso dano dhaqaale iyo kuwo siyaasadeed oo keliya ku sii jiri kara jiritaanka kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee al-Shabaab. Marka kowaad, waxay u adeegaysaa mashaariicda amniga ee lagu soo qaato magaca ah in argaggixiso lala dagaallamayo. Xarumaha falanqaynta iyo qandaraaslayaasha amniga ee reer Galbeedku waxay u baahan yihiin in khatarta al-Shabaab had iyo jeer la weyneeyo, laguna sifeeyo mid maalin kasta caasimadda qabsan karta, si ay u sii socoto helitaanka maalgelinta iyo miisaaniyado malaayiin doollar ah oo lagu bixiyo barnaamijyada “ladagaallanka argaggixisada”. Marka labaad, saadaashani waxay si toos ah ugu adeegaysaa kooxda AS oo u adeegsata borobagaando iyo dagaal nafsi ah. Kooxdu waxay soo xigataa qoraallada iyo saadaalaha fashilma ee reer Galbeedka, si ay u wiiqdo kalsoonida shacabka, cabsi ugu geliso bulshada, una disho niyadda askarta geesiyaasha ah ee ku jira furimaha dagaalka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, masiirka iyo amniga Soomaaliya kuma xidhna saadaalaha miisaska dushooda lagu qoro ee danaha dhaqaale laga leeyahay, waxayse ku xiran yihiin dhiigga iyo geesinimada Ciidamada Amniga Qaranka iyo go’aanka aan la loodin karin ee shacabka Soomaaliyeed.
items.fullContent: Muddo ka badan toban sano, qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha amniga ee ku kala sugan dibadda iyo gudaha dalka waxay si joogto ah u dhayalsanayeen adkaysiga shacabka iyo kartida Ciidamada Amniga Soomaaliyeed. Waxay qaadanayeen, qaybna ka ahaayeen, kas iyo kama’ba, sheekada kooxda al-Shabaab (AS), iyaga oo dhawr jeer saadaaliyay in caasimadda dalka ee Muqdisho ay ku dhacayso gacanta kooxda. Tusaalaha ugu weyn waxa aynu u soo qaadan karnaa warbixinnadii la daabacay iyo warbaahintii faafisay xilligii uu socday dagaalkii caanka ahaa ee ay kooxda AS soo qaaday Ramadaankii 2010. Subaxnimadii 23kii Agoosto 2010, kooxda AS waxay soo qaaday duullaan ballaadhan oo ay ugu magacdartay “Nihaayatul Muctadiin”, dadkuse waxay u yaqaannaan Dagaalkii Ramadaanka, sababtoo ah bishii Ramadaan ayaa maraysay 12keedii. Boqolkiiba toddobaatan Muqdisho waxa gacanta ku haysay kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee AS, halka Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka ahayd ee uu Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed madaxweyne ka ahaa ay keliya joogtay Madaxtooyada, gegida diyaaradaha iyo waddada isku xidha labadaas goobood. Haddaba, warbaahinta iyo xarumaha falanqaynta ee reer Galbeedku waxay soo saareen warbixinno iyo saadaallo isdabajoog ah oo u janjeeray dhinaca argaggaxisada, kuna doodayay in dawladda Soomaaliya ay ku dhowdahay inay gebi ahaanba meesha ka baxdo. Wargeyska caanka ah ee The New York Times ayaa 24kii Agoosto 2010 baahiyay warbixin aad u faaftay oo uu qoray suxufiga caanka ah ee Jeffrey Gettleman. Warbixintaas waxa cinwaan looga dhigay: “At Least 30 Killed in Attack on Hotel in Somalia”. Jeffrey wuxuu warbixintiisa ku falanqeeyay weerarkii khasaaraha badan dhaliyay ee ay laba ka mid ah inqimaasiyiinta kooxdu ku qaadeen Huteel Muna oo ku dhowaa xarunta Madaxtooyada. Jeffrey wuxuu si toos ah u sheegay in weerarkaas huteelku bannaanka keenay masiirka dhabta ah ee magaalada iyo sida ay u nugushahay dawladda Soomaaliya, isaga oo xilligaas ku sifeeyay in dawladda daciifka ahi ay dhawr tallaabo oo keliya u jirto inay gebi ahaanba burburto. Jeffrey wuxuu ka mid ahaa suxufiyiinta iyo saadaaliyayaasha rumaystay sheekadii kooxda ee ahayd in al-Shabaab, si ay ula wareegto Muqdisho, ay u baahan tahay muddo hal toddobaad ah oo keliya. Sidoo kale, wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters iyo telefishinka BBC-da ayaa baahiyay warbixinno dhawr ah oo ay ku sheegeen in Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka ahayd ay ku go’doonsanayd dhawr goobood. Waxay adeegsanayeen falanqayntii hay’adda caalamiga ah ee International Crisis Group (ICG), taas oo saadaalisay in caasimaddu ku dhowdahay inay si buuxda u gasho gacanta kooxda. Sidoo kale, shirkadda falanqaynta sirdoonka ee Stratfor ayaa soo saartay qiimayn amni oo ay ku sheegtay in istiraatiijiyadda kooxda ee duullaanka Nihaayatul Muctadiin ay ahayd dharbaaxadii ugu dambaysay ee meesha ka saari lahayd dawladda fadhigeedu ahaa Villa Somalia. Haddaba, kaddib sannad xidhiidh ah oo uu dagaal ba’ani socday, 6dii Agoosto 2011, warbaahintii reer Galbeedka iyo wariyayaashii afkooda ku saadaalinayay in Muqdisho lala wareegayo, oo Jeffrey ugu horreeyay, ayaa qoray in kooxda AS gebi ahaanba laga saaray caasimadda dalka ee Muqdisho. Tan iyo xilligaas, waxa muuqata in aanay cashar ka qaadan dhacdadaas, welina ay ku taagan yihiin dhabbadii khaldanayd. Falanqeeyayaashu waxay weli dhawrkii sannadoodba mar saadaaliyaan in kooxdu la wareegayso dalka. Tusaale ahaan, bishii Agoosto 2021, markii Daalibaan si buuxda ula wareegtay dalka Afgaanistaan, waxa soo baxay maqaallo dhawr ah oo ay qoreen xarumaha falanqaynta iyo warbaahinta caalamiga ahi, kuwaas oo si toos ah isugu barbardhigay Kaabul iyo Muqdisho. Warbixinnadaasi waxay saadaalinayeen in burburkii ku dhacay dawladdii Afgaanistaan uu si la mid ah ugu dhici karo dawladda Soomaaliya haddii ciidamada caalamiga ahi ay dalka ka baxaan. items.title: Somaliland oo shaacisay sida lagu sii deyn karo maxaabiista ay ka hayso Waqooyi Bari
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Somaliland, Barkhad Jaamac Batuun oo maanta shir jaraa’id ku qabtay magaalada Hargeysa ayaa ka hadlay arrimo ku aadan xaaladda Gobolka Sool iyo maxaabiista lagu qabtay dagaalkii Laascaanood ee weli ku jira gacantooda. Barkhad Jaamac Batuun ayaa marka hore beeniyay in ay jiraan maxaabiis lasii daayay, wuxuuna sheegay in arrintaas ay u taallo xukuumadda oo kaliya, isla markaana iyada uun wax laga waydiin doono. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in hadda qorshaha aysan ugu jirin sii deynta maxaabiista, balse wuxuu shaaciyay in lagu fasixi karo oo kaliya go’aan dowladeed iyo talo Madaxweyne, maadaama dagaal lagu soo qabtay. “Arrinka maxaabiistu waa arrin u yaalla xukuumadda oo aan u oolin cid kale siyaasadda xukuumadduna waa mid cad meel maxaabiis lagu wareejiyay, haddana lagu wareejinaayo ama lagu wareejin doono ma jirto, illaa la helo amar dowladeed iyo talo Madaxweyne,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Warfaafinta. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale shacabka Somaliland ugu baaqay inay ka feejignaadaan wararka been abuurka ah iyo wax kasta oo wax u dhimi kara wadajirkooda iyo deganaashahooda. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in siyaasadda xukuumadda Somaliland ee gobolka Sool ay tahay in lagu wajaho nabad, isla markaana uu garwadeen ka yahay Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullahi (Cirro). “Xukuumadda Somaliland siyaasadda uu Madxweynuhu ku hoggaaminayo ee garwadeenka ugu yahay gobolka Sool waxa ay tahay in Madaxweynaha arrintaas uu ku wajaho hab nabad ah,” ayuu markale yiri Barkhaad Baatuun. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo shalay xubnaha Golaha Wakiilada Maamulka Waqooyi Bari ay qaraar kasoo saareen maxaabiista Somaliland ee ku xiran Laascaanood, iyaga oo Madaxweynaha ka dalbaday inuu dhiso Maxkamadda Ciidan, si maxaabiista loo saaro, looguna xisaabtamo dambiyada ay galeen. The post Somaliland oo shaacisay sida lagu sii deyn karo maxaabiista ay ka hayso Waqooyi Bari appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Galmudug oo jawaab kulul ka bixisay digniintii Puntland
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Maamul Goboleedka Galmudug ayaa ka jawaabtay war-saxaafadeedkii loogu digay ee kasoo baxay Puntland, sidoo kalena lagu eedeeyay Madaxweynaha dowladda Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo haatan ay is hayaan hogaamiye Saciid Cabdullahi Deni. Puntland ayaa maalin kahor digniin gaar ah u dirtay dhiggeeda Galmudug, oo ay xuduud dheer la wadaagto, iyada oo ugu baaqday in aysan garoomadeeda diyaaradaha iyo dhulka ay maamusho u oggolaan in laga soo gudbiyo saanad ciidan, hub iyo maleeshiyaad ay Puntland sheegtay in loo adeegsan karo weerarro ama qalqal-gelin ka dhan ah deegaannadeeda. “Puntland waxay Galmudug ugu baaqaysaa inay ka waantoowdo in saanad ciidan iyo maleeshiyaad la soo mariyo garoomada iyo dhulka ay maamusho, kuwaas oo looga dan leeyahay in lagu dhibaateeyo shacabka reer Puntland,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka kasoo baxay Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland. Wasiirka Qorshaynta Galmudug Cabdiraxmaan Axmed Xayle oo wareysi bixiyay ayaa jawaabay hadalka kasoo yeeray Puntland, wuxuuna sheegay in eedaha ay jeedisay ay yihiin waxba kama jiraan, isla markaana garoomada Galmudug aan laga soo dajin hub iyo ciidan lagu weerarayo maamulkaasi. Cabdiraxmaan Xayle ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in mushkiladu ay ka jirto gudaha Puntland, loona baahan yahay inay xalisato, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Waxyaabaha noo muuqdo waxay tahay kacdoon shacab oo ka jira gudaha Puntland, taasna waxay ku haboon tahay, kuna qurux badan tahay Puntland dhexdeeda inay xaliso oo aysan ahayn meel aan ku xag-xagan karto ama ay usoo mari karto in aysan ahayn Galmudug,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Cabdiraxmaan Xayle. Waxaa kale oo uu kusii daray “Waan caddeyneynaa in aysan jirin ciidan iyo hub saanad ah oo lagu weeraraayo shacabka Puntland oo halkan kasoo dagay, laakiin waxaan xaqiijineynaa oo runtii noo cad in Puntland dhexdeeda ay wax ka dhaceen oo maalin walbana ay ka dhacaayaan oo aan wax qaroosn ahayn”. Si kastaba, Puntland aya haatan wajaheyso dhaq-dhaqaaq ciidan oo gudaha deegaannadeeda ah, iyada oo sidoo kale dhawaan ay wada dagaalameen ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran PSF, ee taabacsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo kuwa Daraawiishta maamulkaas. The post Galmudug oo jawaab kulul ka bixisay digniintii Puntland appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dabka Soo Noqnoqda ee Suuqyada Dalka: Ma Jirtaa Tallaabo Ka Baddan Daminta Marka Uu Kaco?
items.description: Musiibadii ugu dambeysay ee ka dhacday Suuqa Bakaaraha waxay mar kale si xanuun badan inoo xasuusisay dhibaatada joogtada ah ee ka taagan badbaadada iyo ka-fijignaanta dabka ee xituunaha waaweyn ee ganacsiga dalka. Ganacsiyo, xoolo, iyo shaqooyin sanado badan loo adkeysanayay ayaa saacado yar gudaheood ku baaba’a, iyada oo xaaladdu mar walba ku dambayso gurmad kaddib markii uu khasaaruhu dhaco. Maxaa Sababa Musiibooyinkan? Waxyaabaha ugu waaweyn ee keena in dhibaatadan ay dib u soo laablaabato waxaa ka mid ah nidaamka korontada oo taya-xun, iyada oo fiilooyinka duugoobay ama aan si habaysan loo gelin ay keenaan culeys ka badan inta ay xamili karaan. Sidoo kale, waxaa jira baahi weyn oo loo qabo agabka badbaadada sida qalabka yar-yar ee dabdamiska ee xarumaha la dhigo iyo in tubooyinka biyaha awoodda leh lagu xiro dhismayaasha, maadaama suuqyada waaweyn ay inta badan ka caagan yihiin qalabka ka-hortagga dabka, haba ugu yaraatee calaamadaha digniinta. Dhanka kale, qorshe-la’aanta dhismaha iyo waddooyinka ciriiriga ah ayaa caqabad ku ah in gaadiidka dabdamiska ay waqti ku gaaraan goobaha uu dabku ka kaco. Saamaynta Dhaqaale iyo Bulsho Khasaaraha ka dhasha dabka Bakaaraha oo kale kuma eka oo kaliya hantida ku baaba’da goobta. Ganacsato badan oo aan lahayn caymis ayaa hal habeen ku waaya ilaha kaliya ee ay ku tiirsanaayeen, taas oo reer badan u horseeda dayac, deyn, iyo dhibaatada dhaqaale iyo mid nafsi ah. Dhanka kale, maadaama Bakaaraha uu yahay xudunta dhaqaalaha ee dalka, gubashadiisu waxay abuurtaa gabaabsi ku yimaada badeecadaha, qiimaha raashinka oo kor u kaca, iyo curyaamin ku timaada guud ahaan silsiladdii ganacsiga Soomaaliya. Ilaa Goorma Ayay Maareyntu Noqon Doontaa Gurmad Kaliya? Ilaalinta hantida iyo nafta mas’uuliyaddeedu waxay saaran tahay maamullada dowladda iyo ganacsatada, maadaama ay lagama maarmaan tahay in la garawsado in ka-hortaggu uu ka hawl yar yahay kana qiimo yar yahay daminta iyo maareynta dhibaatada ka dib. Si dhibaatadan loo baajiyo, waxaa daruuri ah in dowladda heer degmo iyo heer qaran ay dejiso xeerar adag oo kormeerka ka-hortagga dabka iyo korontada ah, in la hagaajiyo kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha iyadoo la furayo waddooyinka gurmadka iyo ilaha biyaha ee xaaladaha degdegga ah, iyo in la sameeyo guddiyo farsamo oo ka kooban ganacsatada iyo dowladda si suuqyada looga helo qalabka lagaga hortago dabka ka hor inta uusan fidin. Amniga iyo badbaadada suuqyadeenna ma aha wax dib loo dhigi karo ama maareynteeda marka ay dhacdo kaliya lagu koobi karo; waa tiir muhiim u ah xasiloonida dhaqaale iyo jiritaanka bulshada Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Dahabka oo kor u kacay, suuqyaduna Fed-ka ayay sugayaan
items.description: Qiimaha dahabka ee suuqyada caalamka ayaa Isniintii sare u kacay kadib markii uu hoos u dhac weyn ku yimid qiimaha shidaalka, taasoo keeni karto in sicir-bararka la yareeyo . Dahabka waxa uu si cad uga faa’iidaystay dhaqdhaqaaqa laba geesoodka ah ee saliidda iyo doollarka Maraykanka, kuwaas oo labaduba hoos u dhaceen kadib markii la yeeshay rajo deganaansho oo u dhexeysa Mareykanka iyo Iiraan . Qiimaha dahabka waxa uu sare u kacay 1.4% isagoo gaaray $4,110.56 halkii wiqiyad, iyadoo dahabka mustaqbalka ee Maraykankuna uu kacay 1% . Kororkani ayaa yimid iyadoo maalgashadayaashu ay si dhow ula socdaan kulanka Bangiga Dhexe ee Mareykanka (Federal Reserve) ee la filayo inuu dhaco usbuucaan. Sannad ka badan, dahabka ayaa hoos uga dhacay heerarkiisii ugu sarreeyay, kuwaas oo gaaray qiyaastii $5,600 halkii wiqiyad, taasoo sabab u ahayd sicir-bararka joogtada ah iyo filashada in la kordhiyo dulsaarka . Saliidda ayaa hoos u dhacday 4% ka dib markii sarkaal ka tirsan Iiraan uu sheegay in Tehran ay joojin doonto weeraradeeda ilaa Mareykankuna uu sidaas sameeyo . Tani waxay ku timid kadib markii Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump uu hakiyay ololihii duqaynta, iyadoo lataliyayaashiisa ay u sheegeen in bartilmaameedyadu ay yaraadeen . Khubarada ayaa sheegaya in dahabka uu weli yahay mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee ay maalgashadayaashu u wareegaan marka ay jiraan hubanti la’aan siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale . Tim Waterer oo ah falanqeeye sare oo ka tirsan KCM Trade, ayaa yiri: “Dahabku waa mid si cad uga faa’iidaysta dhaqdhaqaaqa laba geesoodka ah ee saliidda iyo doollarka. Saliid hoose ayaa yareynaysa walaaca sicir-bararka.” Dhinaca kale, indhaha suuqyada ayaa ku wajahan go’aanka Fed-ka , iyadoo la filayo in dulsaarka la joojiyo, balse suurtagal ah in la kordhiyo Sebtembar, taas oo saameyn ku yeelan karto jihada dahabka mustaqbalka . Sidoo kale, ra’yiga khubarada ayaa isku raacsan in dahabka uu sii kori doono, iyadoo bangiyada waaweyn sida Goldman Sachs ay saadaaliyeen inuu gaari doono $4,900 dhamaadka sanadka . The post Dahabka oo kor u kacay, suuqyaduna Fed-ka ayay sugayaan first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah oo ka fogaanaya Badda Cas
items.description: Isku dhacyada Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee dib uga soo cusboonaaday Bariga Dhexe ayaa carqaladeynaya isu socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee Badda Cas iyo Bab El-Mandeb. Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo ka ag-dhow Badda Cas iyo Marinka Bab El-Mandeb ayaa 20-kii bishan ka mamnuucay inay maraan maraakiibta Sacuudiga, laakiin marka la eego heerka khatarta ee halkaasi ka jirta ayaa waxay maraakiibta kale ee ganacsiga ku riixeysaa in ay ka fogaadaan adeegsiga Marinka Bab El-Mandeb, oo ah albaabka koonfureed ee laga galo Badda Cas. Colaaddan ayaa xiisad aan caadi ahayn ka abuurtay Badda Cas, waxayna dhalisay walaac caalami ah oo laga qabo in uu xirmo Marinka Bab El-Mandeb ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Cabsida ayaa keentay inuu si weyn hoos ugu dhaco dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Badda Cas iyo koror ku yimid qiimaha sahayda tamarta adduunka. Xaaladda aadka u kacsan ee Badda Cas ayaa soo jiidatay Maamulada Shirkadaha Maraakiibta iyo kuwa kale ee Caymiska, oo si dhakhsa ah u kordhiyay qiimaha iyo kharashka halista ee lagu qaado xamuulka badda. Dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta ee Marinka Bab El-Mandeb ayaa la sheegay in hadda uu si weyn isu bedbedelayo, sababo la xiriira colaadda gobolka. Shirkadda xogta dhinaca badda ee Kpler ayaa sheegtay in Axaddii shalay ay 11 markab oo keliya ka gudbeen marinkaasi, taas oo hoos u dhac weyn ku ah heerka caadiga ah ee xilligii ka horreeyay xiisadda. Hay’adaha la socda dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta ayaa laga soo xigtay colaaddan ka hor in 72 illaa 75 markab ay maalintii marayeen Bab El-Mandeb. Weerarka Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ay Arbacadii ku beegsadeen laba markab oo lala xiriiriyay Dekedaha Sacuudiga ayaa la sheegay in loo arkay halis weyn oo ka taagan marinka ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Maraakiib badan ayaa la sheegay inay ka leexdeen Bab El-Mandeb iyo Badda Cas, iyagoo maraya biyaha Qaaradda Afrika, taasna waxay dheereynaysaa waqtiga safarka badeecadaha oo qaadanaya muddo ka badan sidii hore. Shidaalka iyo shixnadaha ganacsiga ee ka gudba Bab El-Mandeb iyo Badda Cas ayaa soo gaabiya safarka maraakiibta ee u dhaxeeya Qaaradaha Aasiya iyo Yurub, iyadoo Dekedaha Sacuudiga ee ku yaala Badda Cas ay muhiim u yihiin waddooyinka ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee Bariga Fog, Yurub iyo Waqooyiga Mareykanka. Afhayeenka Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ee ka hawlgala Yemen, General Turki Al Maliki ayaa Sabtidii sheegay inay dadaal ugu jiraan, sidii loo ilaalin lahaa xasilloonida badda iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah, laakiin General Yahya Saree, Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta oo ka daba hadlay ayaa ka digay in tallaabo kasta oo Sacuudiga ka timaada ay u tixgelin doonaan mid aan laga fiirsan, ayna uga sii dari doonto xaaladda. Hubanti la’aanta ka jirta Badda Cas ayaa qalqal-gelineysa dhoofinta shidaalka iyo ganacsiga isaga kala gudba qaaradaha, iyadoo markii horeba uu xirnaa marinka ugu weyn sahayda tamarta adduunka ee Hormuz, waana sababta indhaha dunida ku soo jeedineysa Badda Cas oo markan ay ku loolamayaan Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta.

Colaaddan ayaa xiisad aan caadi ahayn ka abuurtay Badda Cas, waxayna dhalisay walaac caalami ah oo laga qabo in uu xirmo Marinka Bab El-Mandeb ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Cabsida ayaa keentay inuu si weyn hoos ugu dhaco dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Badda Cas iyo koror ku yimid qiimaha sahayda tamarta adduunka. Xaaladda aadka u kacsan ee Badda Cas ayaa soo jiidatay Maamulada Shirkadaha Maraakiibta iyo kuwa kale ee Caymiska, oo si dhakhsa ah u kordhiyay qiimaha iyo kharashka halista ee lagu qaado xamuulka badda. Dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta ee Marinka Bab El-Mandeb ayaa la sheegay in hadda uu si weyn isu bedbedelayo, sababo la xiriira colaadda gobolka. Shirkadda xogta dhinaca badda ee Kpler ayaa sheegtay in Axaddii shalay ay 11 markab oo keliya ka gudbeen marinkaasi, taas oo hoos u dhac weyn ku ah heerka caadiga ah ee xilligii ka horreeyay xiisadda. Hay’adaha la socda dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta ayaa laga soo xigtay colaaddan ka hor in 72 illaa 75 markab ay maalintii marayeen Bab El-Mandeb. Weerarka Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ay Arbacadii ku beegsadeen laba markab oo lala xiriiriyay Dekedaha Sacuudiga ayaa la sheegay in loo arkay halis weyn oo ka taagan marinka ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Maraakiib badan ayaa la sheegay inay ka leexdeen Bab El-Mandeb iyo Badda Cas, iyagoo maraya biyaha Qaaradda Afrika, taasna waxay dheereynaysaa waqtiga safarka badeecadaha oo qaadanaya muddo ka badan sidii hore. Shidaalka iyo shixnadaha ganacsiga ee ka gudba Bab El-Mandeb iyo Badda Cas ayaa soo gaabiya safarka maraakiibta ee u dhaxeeya Qaaradaha Aasiya iyo Yurub, iyadoo Dekedaha Sacuudiga ee ku yaala Badda Cas ay muhiim u yihiin waddooyinka ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee Bariga Fog, Yurub iyo Waqooyiga Mareykanka. Afhayeenka Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ee ka hawlgala Yemen, General Turki Al Maliki ayaa Sabtidii sheegay inay dadaal ugu jiraan, sidii loo ilaalin lahaa xasilloonida badda iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah, laakiin General Yahya Saree, Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta oo ka daba hadlay ayaa ka digay in tallaabo kasta oo Sacuudiga ka timaada ay u tixgelin doonaan mid aan laga fiirsan, ayna uga sii dari doonto xaaladda. Hubanti la’aanta ka jirta Badda Cas ayaa qalqal-gelineysa dhoofinta shidaalka iyo ganacsiga isaga kala gudba qaaradaha, iyadoo markii horeba uu xirnaa marinka ugu weyn sahayda tamarta adduunka ee Hormuz, waana sababta indhaha dunida ku soo jeedineysa Badda Cas oo markan ay ku loolamayaan Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ku dhowaatay bixitaanka ciidanka AUSSOM
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa wajahaysa cadaadis caalami ah oo sii kordhaya, kaas oo looga dalbanayo inay soo bandhigto qorshe cad oo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed kula wareegayaan mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka ee ay hadda qayb weyn ka qaadato howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Cadaadiskan ayaa xoogaystay kadib kulan heer gobol ah oo dhowaan lagu qabtay magaalada Addis Ababa ee dalka Itoobiya, kaas oo looga hadlay mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM iyo caqabadaha dhaqaale ee hortaagan sii socoshadiisa. Ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa wakaaladda wararka Afrika ee APA u sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya laga sugayo qorshe faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan “wareejinta mas’uuliyadda amniga qaranka” laguna wareejinayo ciidamada Soomaaliya. Qorshaha ayaa la filayaa inuu caddeeyo saldhigyada ciidamada Midowga Afrika laga wareejinayo, jadwalka bixitaanka ciidamada shisheeye, awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed iyo taageerada ay weli u baahan doonaan marka ay la wareegaan goobahaas. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maalmihii lasoo dhaafay kulamo la yeeshay saraakiil sare oo ka tirsan hay’adaha ammaanka, oo ay ku jiraan hoggaanka ciidamada xoogga dalka. Kulamadaas ayaa lagu falanqeeyey diyaar-garowga ciidamada iyo suurtagalnimada inay la wareegaan dhowr saldhig oo ay hadda ku sugan yihiin ciidamada AUSSOM, sida lagu sheegay xogta laga helayo wada-hadallada socda. Caqabad dhaqaale xumo Dhaq-dhaqaaqan cusub wuxuu kusoo aadayaa xilli mustaqbalka AUSSOM uu galay hubanti la’aan weyn, kadib markii Mareykanka uu sheegay inuusan taageeri doonin sii wadista howlaha Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, UNSOS, wixii ka dambeeya dhammaadka sanadkan. UNSOS ayaa AUSSOM siisa adeegyada muhiimka ah ee ay ka mid yihiin cuntada, biyaha, shidaalka, gaadiidka, adeegyada caafimaadka iyo daad-gureynta ciidamada dhaawacma. Mareykanka ayaa Midowga Afrika ku wargeliyey inuu Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ka hor istaagi doono qorshe kasta oo sii wadaya taageerada dhaqaale iyo tan farsamo ee UNSOS. Miisaaniyadda UNSOS ayaa gaareysa ku dhowaad $500 milyan sanadkii, halka AUSSOM ay sidoo kale la daalaa-dhaceyso dhaqaale yari weyn oo wiiqday awooddeeda howlgal. Afhayeen u hadlay wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in Washington ay ku dhowaad $2 bilyan ku bixisay UNSOS iyo hay’adihii ka horreeyey, balse Soomaaliya aysan weli si madax-bannaan u ilaalin karin guulihii laga gaaray dagaalka Al-Shabaab. “Ma ahan inaan sii maalgelinno howlgal aan gaarin ujeeddooyinkiisii aasaasiga ahaa,” ayuu yiri afhayeenka, isaga oo sidoo kale dowladda Soomaaliya ku eedeeyey khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo gaabis ku yimid dib-u-habeynta ciidamada. Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in khilaafaadka gudaha iyo loollanka siyaasadeed ay dhaawacayaan dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab iyo kooxda Daacish, isla markaana taageerada caalamku aysan natiijo buuxda keeni karin inta madaxda Soomaaliyeed aysan mideyn dadaalladooda. Cabsi laga qabo firaaq amni AUSSOM waxaa ka tirsan ku dhowaad 12,000 oo askari, kuwaas oo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ka taageera dagaalka Al-Shabaab iyo ilaalinta xarumo muhiim ah oo ku yaalla Muqdisho iyo gobollada koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya. Diblomaasiyiin xog-ogaal ah ayaa ka digay in howlgalka uusan sii shaqeyn karin haddii aan la helin cid beddesha taageerada Qaramada Midoobay, gaar ahaan adeegyada saadka iyo gaadiidka. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf, ayaa horraantii bishan sheegay in mustaqbalka AUSSOM loo baahan yahay in lagu saleeyo “ujeeddooyin istaraatiiji ah oo cad”, isaga oo ku baaqay maalgelin joogto ah oo lagu badbaadinayo guulaha laga gaaray Soomaaliya. Midowga Afrika ayaa horay u sheegay in AUSSOM uusan ahayn howlgal aan dhammaad lahayn, balse uu yahay howlgalka ugu dambeeya ee ururka Afrika ka fuliyo Soomaaliya, kaas oo loogu talagalay inuu dalka gaarsiiyo inuu si buuxda ula wareego mas’uuliyadda amnigiisa. Hase yeeshee, walaaca ugu weyn ayaa ah in bixitaan degdeg ah oo aan qorshe wanaagsan loo diyaarin uu abuuri karo firaaq amni oo ay ka faa’iideysato Al-Shabaab, xilli kooxda ay weli weerarro ka fuliso qaybo ka mid ah dalka. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa hadda laga sugayaa inay caddeyso tirada iyo awoodda ciidamada la wareegaya saldhigyada AUSSOM, dhaqaalaha lagu maamuli doono, iyo sida loo hubinayo inaan dib looga noqon guulihii amni ee lagu gaaray taageerada ciidamada Midowga Afrika. The post Soomaaliya oo ku dhowaatay bixitaanka ciidanka AUSSOM appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dalalka Ururka Bulshada Bariga Afrika oo dardargelinaya qorshaha soo saarista lacag mideysan oo la doonayo inay hirgasho 2031
items.description: Guddoomiyeyaasha Bangiyada Dhexe ee dalalka ku bahoobay Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC) ayaa dib u xaqiijiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay hirgelinta lacag mideysan oo ay dalalka xubnaha ka ah isticmaalaan marka la gaaro sannadka 2031, inkasta oo ay weli jiraan caqabado dhaqaale iyo kala duwanaansho dhanka diyaar-garowga ah oo u dhexeeya waddamada xubnaha ka ah. Go’aankan ayaa lagu gaaray shirkii 29-aad ee Guddiga Arrimaha Lacagta ee EAC (Monetary Affairs Committee – MAC), oo lagu qabtay magaalada Kampala ee dalka Uganda. Shirka ayaa waxaa guddoomiyay Guddoomiyaha Bangiga Dhexe ee Uganda, Michael Atingi-Ego, waxaana ka qeyb galay madaxda bangiyada dhexe ee Soomaaliya, Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, Koonfurta Suudaan iyo Uganda. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in hirgelinta lacag mideysan ay muhiim u tahay xoojinta isdhexgalka dhaqaale ee gobolka, iyadoo la doonayo in la yareeyo kharashaadka is-weydaarsiga lacagaha kala duwan, la fududeeyo ganacsiga xuduudaha isaga gudba, isla markaana la dhiirrigeliyo maalgashiga gudaha gobolka. Shirka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in inkasta oo dhaqaalaha caalamka uu weli wajahayo caqabado ay ka mid yihiin sicir-bararka, qiimaha shidaalka iyo saameynta colaadaha caalamiga ah, haddana dhaqaalaha dalalka Bariga Afrika la filayo inuu sii kobco, iyadoo la saadaalinayo korriin gaareysa 5.2%. Si kastaba ha ahaatee qaar kamid ah dalalka xubnaha ka ah ururkan ayaan weli si buuxda u buuxin shuruudaha dhaqaale ee looga baahan yahay midaynta lacagta, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin xakamaynta sicir-bararka, xoojinta kaydka lacagaha qalaad iyo ilaalinta heerarka deynta dowladda. Si loo dardargeliyo geeddi-socodka, guddigu wuxuu isku raacay in la sameeyo hab is-qiimeyn joogto ah oo ay dalalka xubnaha ka ah isku kormeeraan, si loo hubiyo inay gaaraan shuruudaha looga baahan yahay muddada u dhexeysa 2026 ilaa 2031. Haddii qorshahan uu hirgalo, lacagta mideysan ee EAC ayaa noqon doonta tallaabo weyn oo lagu xoojinayo isdhexgalka dhaqaale ee Bariga Afrika, iyadoo Soomaaliya iyo lixda dal ee kale ee xubnaha ka ah ay wadaagi doonaan hal nidaam lacageed oo la filayo inuu fududeeyo ganacsiga, maalgashiga iyo kobaca dhaqaalaha gobolka.

items.title: Trump Asks Public About Things That Never Happened
items.description: US President Donald Trump has once again sparked controversy after claiming that two years ago, many people were unable to watch a political debate due to a lack of wind. Trump stated that reliance on wind energy caused televisions to stop working during a debate between himself and former President Joe Biden . However, media outlets and fact-checkers have confirmed that there is no evidence to support this claim, and such an event never occurred. Trump’s remarks come as he continues to make claims that are frequently debunked . For instance, he has persisted in alleging that elections in California are rigged, despite state election officials confirming that the vote-counting process is lawful and simply takes time due to the large number of mail-in ballots. Experts explain that California takes longer to count votes, but this is not evidence of fraud. Additionally, Trump has repeatedly claimed that mail-in voting plans are fraudulent, though state officials have stated that the system is efficient and secure. He has also asserted that California experiences frequent blackouts, but state authorities have denied this, noting that there have been no widespread or regular outages in recent years. Trump’s statements have intensified debates about the accuracy of information used by politicians, as the US prepares for new political phases. Political experts warn that unsubstantiated claims can undermine public trust in democratic systems, especially when they come from the country’s highest office. The post Trump Asks Public About Things That Never Happened first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Trump oo dadka weydiiyay wax aan dhicin
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa mar kale hadal uu jeediyay dhaliyay dood iyo muran, kadib markii uu sheegay in laba sano ka hor dad badan aysan awoodin inay daawadaan dood siyaasadeed sababo la xiriira dabayl la’aan . Trump ayaa sheegay in ku tiirsanaanta tamarta dabaysha ay sababtay in telefishinnada aysan shaqeyn xilli uu socday dood dhexmartay isaga iyo madaxweynihii hore Joe Biden . Si kastaba, warbaahinta iyo khubarada xaqiijinta xogaha ayaa sheegay in dhacdadaas aysan jirin wax caddeyn ah oo muujinaya inay dhacday. Hadallada Trump ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli uu si joogto ah u sameynayo sheegashooyin ay dad badani beeniyaan. Tusaale ahaan, waxa uu sii wadaa ku doodista in doorashooyinka California ay yihiin kuwo khiyaano ah, inkastoo madaxda doorashooyinka gobolka ay caddeeyeen in tirinta codadku ay si sharci ah u socoto oo ay tahay mid waqti dheer qaadato sababtoo ah dad badan oo codbixiyaan ah ayaa u codeeya boostada . Khubaradu waxay sheegaan in California ay kaa qaadato waqti dheer si ay u tiri codadka, taasina maaha caddayn khiyaano . items.title: Abshir Bukhaari oo laga soo celiyay Kenya + Sababta
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa waxaa laga helayaa tallaabo ay Axaddii qaaday dowladda Kenya oo la sheegay in dalkeeda ay kasoo celisay Wasiiru Dowlaha Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya, Mudane Abshir Maxamed Axmed (Bukhaari) oo shalay ka dagay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Nairobi. Wasiirka ayaa lagu soo warramayaa ‘in Kenya ay u diiday inuu gudaha u galo caasimada dalkaas’ waxaana dib loogu soo celiyay Soomaaliya, taas oo dhalisay hadal-heyn xooggan. Warar kala duwan ayaa kasoo baxaya sababta ka dambeysa go’aankan, waxaana wararka qaar ay sheegayaan in Abshir Bukhaari uu watay Baasaboorka Kenya, isla markaana loo arkay inuu ku qaatay qaab shari darro ah, halka kuwa kalena ay sheegayaan inuu baal maray nidaamka waaxda socdaalka ee dalkaasi, sidaas daraadeedna looga soo masaafuriyay Kenya. Dhacdadan ayaa si weyn u qabsatay baraha bulshada iyo warbaahinta, kuwaas oo falalqeynaya soo celinta Wasiiru Dowlaha Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya, Abshir Bukhaari oo aad ugu dhow Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Illaa iyo hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay labada dowladood oo ku aadan dhacdadaasi ka dhalatay is hortaagga lagu sameeyay wasiirka. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa haatan wadda baaris dheeraad ah oo ku aadan waxa sababay in lasoo celiyo wasiirkeeda, waxaana loo yeeray safiirka Kenya u fadhiya gudaha magaalada Muqdisho, si wax looga waydiiyo tallaabada ay qaaday dowladdiisa. Horay waxaa marar kala duwan dalka Kenya looga soo celiyay mas’uuliyiin Soomaaliyeed oo qaarkood xilal ka haya Dowladda Federaalka, iyada oo dowladda Kenya ay sababo kala duwan dalkeeda ugu diiday mas’uuliyiintaas. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya iyo Kenya oo ah laba dal oo daris ah ayaa waxaa ka dhexeeya xiriir wanaagsan, waxaana si toos ah u macaamila labada madaxweyne, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo William Ruto oo horay kulamo ka duwan u yeeshay, kuwaas oo looga hadlay iskaashiga labada dowladood. items.title: Opposition Council Urges AU Allies to Push Political Deal
items.description: Somalia’s opposition-led Somali Future Council has appealed to six African nations contributing troops and police to the African Union mission in the country, urging them to make an inclusive political settlement a priority alongside their security support. The letter, dated July 27 and addressed to the leaders of Uganda, Kenya, Ethiopia, Djibouti, Burundi and Egypt, comes as tensions between the federal government and regional states such as Puntland and Jubaland remain unresolved. The appeal matters because it lands at a delicate moment for Somalia’s security architecture. AUSSOM, the AU mission that replaced ATMIS in January 2025, is already grappling with a severe funding crisis, and troop-contributing countries are due to meet in Kampala this week — with a defence ministers’ session on July 30 and an extraordinary summit of leaders on July 31 — to decide the mission’s future. The council’s warning that political fragmentation could undermine the fight against Al-Shabaab adds pressure to talks already strained by money and mandate disputes. In the letter, the council thanked the six countries for nearly two decades of military and security support, acknowledging the sacrifices of African personnel in Somalia’s stabilization effort. It then urged them to use their diplomatic leverage to push the federal government, federal member states and opposition groups toward a negotiated political roadmap. The council argues that the mandates of federal institutions have lapsed without an agreed transition plan — a position the federal government disputes, defending its constitutional changes and direct-election plans. The council proposed creating a Somali Transitional Council to oversee constitutional and electoral processes until legitimate national institutions are in place. It also called on troop-contributing countries to condition support on an inclusive political agreement. The dispute has real security stakes. Puntland and Jubaland have each been at odds with Mogadishu over federal authority, and armed clashes were reported in the capital in June. The African Union has called for restraint and a return to dialogue, while talks in May between the government and opposition representatives ended without agreement. The letter was copied to the African Union, the UN Security Council, IGAD, the European Union, the United States, the United Kingdom and Turkey, underscoring how closely Somalia’s political crisis and its international security partnership are now intertwined. items.title: Maqaayad Xalaal Ah Oo Kala Qaybisay Faransiiska
items.description: Furitaanka makhaayad digaag xalaal ah oo ku taal magaalada Saint-Ouen-sur-Seine ee duleedka Paris ayaa kicisay muran siyaasadeed oo baahsan. Duqa magaalada oo ah Karim Bouamrane oo ka tirsan xisbiga Sooshaalistaha ayaa isku dayay inuu joojiyo shaqada makhaayadda “Master Poulet” isagoo ku andacoonay in urta iyo buuqa ka soo baxa ay saameyn ku yeeshaan dadka deegaanka. Si kastaba maxkamad ayaa go’aamisay in aan la hor istaagi karin ganacsiga, waxaana duqa lagu amray inuu ka saaro caqabadihii uu dhigay. Murkankan, oo hadda loo yaqaan “l’affaire Master Poulet” ayaa si dhakhso ah u noqday dood qaran. Duqa ayaa isku dayay inuu albaabka makhaayadda ka xiro iyadoo la adeegsanayo caqabado dhismeed, balse maxkamaddu waxay ku amartay inuu meesha ka saaro. Kadib, wuxuu dhigay weelal dhir weyn oo muugaalka makhaayadda ka qariyay. Makhaayaddu waxay uga jawaabtay calaamooyin kicinaya iyo muuqaallo kaftan ah oo baraha bulshada lagu faafiyay, iyadoo dadka deegaanku ay ka cabanayeen gaadiidka habeenkii iyo urta cuntada. Inkastoo duqa magaaladu uu sheegay inuu la dagaallamayo “cuntada waxyeellada leh ” iyo ilaalinta tayada nolosha shacabka, haddana tallaabooyinkiisu waxay soo jiiteen dareenka qaranka. Xisbiga far-left ee France Unbowed (LFI) ayaa ku eedeeyay duqa inuu wado siyaasad “takoorka dabaqadda” iyo “nacaybka dabaqadda shaqeeya” . Waxay ku andacoodeen inuu doonayo inuu saaro ganacsi u adeega bulshada dakhligoodu hooseeyo iyo soogalootiga magaalada isbeddeleysa, halkaas oo qiimaha guryuhu aad u kordhay. Dooddan ayaa hadda noqotay astaan u ah kala qaybsanaanta qoto dheer ee ka dhex jirta garabka bidix ee Faransiiska: dhinac waxaa ku yaal kuwa mudnaanta siiya caafimaadka dadweynaha iyo dib-u-habeynta magaalooyinka, dhinaca kalena waxaa ku yaal kuwa diiradda saaraya la dagaallanka takoorka dhaqaale iyo waxa ay ku tilmaameen “xidhidh dhaqaale bulsho, iyo cunto”. Duqa ayaa beeniyay eedeymahaas, wuxuuna ku eedeeyay LFI inay doonayaan inay “ku xidhaan dabaqadda shaqeeya xaaladdooda” halkii ay ka caawin lahaayeen inay horumaraan. Dooddan ayaa sidoo kale dib u soo nooleysay arrimo la xiriira dib-u-habeynta magaalooyinka, sare u kaca qiimaha guryaha, iyo sida isbeddelladaasi u saameeyaan ganacsiyada yaryar iyo bulshada dakhligoodu hooseeyo. The post Maqaayad Xalaal Ah Oo Kala Qaybisay Faransiiska first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliya oo dalbanaya heshiis siyaasadeed ka hor inta aysan bixin ciidanka howlgalka AUSSOM
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliya ayaa ugu baaqay waddamada ciidamada iyo shaqaalaha booliiska ku biirinaya Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) inay ka dhigaan sii wadidda taageerada dhanka amniga mid ku xiran gaarista heshiis siyaasadeed qaran oo loo dhan yahay. Warqad furan oo taariikhdeedu tahay 27-ka Luulyo 2026, ayuu goluhu ugu baaqay hoggaamiyeyaasha Uganda, Kenya, Itoobiya, Jabuuti, Burundi iyo Masar, ka hor shir heer sare ah oo la filayo inuu ka dhaco Kampala dhammaadka bishan, kaas oo looga hadlayo mustaqbalka AUSSOM iyo kala-guurka amniga Soomaaliya. Goluhu wuxuu ka digay in Soomaaliya ay wajahayso qalalaase siyaasadeed iyo mid dastuuri ah oo sii xoogaysanaya, isagoo sheegay in muddo-xileedka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu ku ekaa 15-kii Maajo 2026-kii, halka muddo-xileedka Baarlamaanka Federaalkuna uu ku dhammaaday 14-kii Abriil 2026-kii. Wuxuu xusay in dalku uusan weli gaarin heshiis siyaasadeed oo si ballaaran loo aqbalay, kaas oo qeexaya waddo sharci ah oo loo maro kala-guurka dastuuriga ah iyo doorashooyinka mustaqbalka. Hadalka kasoo yeeray golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliya, ayaa ku soo beegmaya, iyada oo madaxda howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, ay shaaciyeen in ciidamada howlgalkoodu uu ku eg yahay 31-da December 2026, isla markaana amniga guud ay la wareegi doonaan ciidamada xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Northeastern State Parliament Demands Trials for Gooja’adde Detainees
items.description: Somalia’s Northeastern State parliament passed a resolution on July 26, 2026, calling on the government to prosecute officers and soldiers held since the 2023 Gooja’adde fighting who face allegations of human rights violations. The move matters because it is the first formal push by lawmakers to force court action on detainees who have been held for nearly three years without trial, and it lands amid heightened friction between Somaliland and the Northeastern administration over Sool’s contested territory. Lawmakers said the resolution was grounded in parliament’s constitutional duty to uphold justice, the rule of law and human rights. The House called on the government to bring all accused promptly before competent courts. The statement did not name individuals but called for expedited trials for those held in administrative custody over alleged crimes against the Northeastern administration and its people. Lawmakers stressed that any proceedings must be fair and transparent, and that detainees’ legal rights be respected throughout. The detainees, Somaliland officials and soldiers, were captured during the August 2023 battle at Gooja’adde base on the outskirts of Las Anod, a turning point in the conflict that saw SSC-Khatumo forces overrun Somaliland positions and capture significant numbers of troops. They have since been held in Northeastern-run prisons. Somaliland has previously described its withdrawal from Gooja’adde as a “strategic” repositioning rather than a defeat, [Indirect Quote — Somaliland Ministry of Defence, paraphrased from earlier statements]. The resolution follows a tense month in the region’s politics. Earlier in July, the Northeastern State parliament stripped six lawmakers of their immunity after they resigned and returned to Somaliland, underscoring ongoing defections and loyalty disputes tied to the Sool-Sanaag dispute. The Northeastern administration, formed from the SSC-Khatumo movement following the Gooja’adde victory, continues to assert control over areas claimed by both Somaliland and Puntland. The detainees, Somaliland officials and soldiers, were captured during the August 2023 battle at Gooja’adde base on the outskirts of Las Anod, a turning point in the conflict that saw SSC-Khatumo forces overrun Somaliland positions and capture significant numbers of troops. They have since been held in Northeastern-run prisons. Somaliland has previously described its withdrawal from Gooja’adde as a “strategic” repositioning rather than a defeat, [Indirect Quote — Somaliland Ministry of Defence, paraphrased from earlier statements]. The resolution follows a tense month in the region’s politics. Earlier in July, the Northeastern State parliament stripped six lawmakers of their immunity after they resigned and returned to Somaliland, underscoring ongoing defections and loyalty disputes tied to the Sool-Sanaag dispute. The Northeastern administration, formed from the SSC-Khatumo movement following the Gooja’adde victory, continues to assert control over areas claimed by both Somaliland and Puntland. items.title: A Halal Chicken Shop That Shook French Politics
items.description: The opening of a halal rotisserie chicken shop in a Paris suburb has sparked a political firestorm. Socialist mayor Karim Bouamrane tried to block the restaurant, “Master Poulet” citing smell and noise complaints from residents .A court ruled against the mayor but the dispute quickly escalated into a national debate, pitting two factions of the French left against each other . The controversy, now widely known in France as “l’affaire Master Poulet” began simply: a low-cost halal chicken chain opened a branch in the town square of Saint-Ouen-sur-Seine . Mayor Bouamrane a Socialist immediately fought the restaurant’s presence. He attempted to block the entrance with concrete barriers was ordered by a court to remove them, and then replaced them with large plant pots to obscure the shop’s view . “Master Poulet” responded with provocative signs and satirical social media videos, while local residents have expressed frustration with the late-night deliveries and smells . While the mayor argued he was fighting “junk food” and protecting residents’ quality of life , his actions soon drew national attention. The far-left party France Unbowed (LFI) , accused the mayor of pursuing a policy of “gentrification” and “class contempt” . They argued that he was trying to push out a business that served the working class and immigrant communities in the transforming city where property prices have soared . The dispute has now become a symbol of a deeper split within the French left between two visions: one that prioritizes public health and urban renewal and another that emphasizes fighting economic exclusion and what it calls a “form of social, economic, and even dietary confinement” . The mayor has returned the criticism, stating that LFI is trying to “trap working class people” in their social condition . The post A Halal Chicken Shop That Shook French Politics first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Guniea-Bissau oo beenisay in ay aqoonsaneyso Somaliland
items.description: Dowladda Guinea-Bissau ayaa si cad u beenisay warar iyo hadallo ku faafay baraha bulshada oo sheegayay inay qorsheynayso ama ay aqoonsan doonto Somaliland. Sida lagu daabacay boggaga rasmiga ah wasaaradda Arrimaha dibadda ee dawladda Guinea-Bissau, waxa ay beenisay in ay aqoonsaneyso Somaliland iyada oo sheegtay in aanay waxba ka jirin warar ay qoreen qaar ka mid ah Warbaahinta luuqaddaha Ingiriisiga wax ku tabiya iyo baraha bulshada. Guinea-Bissau waxa ay sheegtay in ay ixtiraamayso madaxbannaanida iyo xuduudaha waddamada Afrikaca iyo xeerarka Qaramada midoobay. “dowladda Guinea-Bissau waxay xaqiijisa inay sii wadayso ixtiraamka mabda’a midnimada iyo wadajirka dalalka xubnaha ka ah Midowga Afrika, iyadoo aan wax isbeddel ah lagu sameyn mowqifkeeda ku aaddan arrinta Somaliland” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Sikastaba, ma ahan markii ugu horeeysay oo dal Afrikaan ah uu si cad ah u sheego inuu ilaalin doono midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. The post Guniea-Bissau oo beenisay in ay aqoonsaneyso Somaliland appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Somali Future Council Demands Political Deal Before Further AUSSOM Support
items.description: MOGADISHU— The Somali Future Council has urged countries contributing troops and police personnel to the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia, AUSSOM, to make continued security assistance conditional on the achievement of an inclusive national political agreement. In an open letter dated July 27, 2026, the council appealed to the leaders of Uganda, Kenya, Ethiopia, Djibouti, Burundi and Egypt ahead of a high-level meeting expected to take place in Kampala at the end of the month to discuss the future of AUSSOM and Somalia’s security transition. The council warned that Somalia was facing a deepening political and constitutional crisis, claiming that President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s mandate expired on May 15, 2026, while the mandate of the Federal Parliament ended on April 14, 2026. It said the country had yet to reach a broadly accepted political agreement outlining a legitimate path for the constitutional transition and future elections. According to the letter, widening political divisions have weakened national cohesion and undermined military operations against Al-Shabaab and Islamic State-linked militants. The council accused the Federal Government of allowing domestic political disputes to take priority over the fight against extremist groups. The council also expressed concern over deteriorating relations between the Federal Government and the regional administrations of Puntland and Jubaland. It said forces from both administrations remained actively engaged in operations against Al-Shabaab and Islamic State militants but had not received adequate financial, military and logistical support. The council argued that the financial and operational challenges facing AUSSOM and broader international security assistance were not primarily the result of shortcomings within the mission. Instead, it attributed them to Somalia’s continuing political instability and the absence of a legitimate and inclusive national settlement. It called on the leaders of AUSSOM troop-contributing countries to support a comprehensive political agreement and the establishment of a transitional council to oversee the constitutional process, political transition and elections. The council said an inclusive political settlement should form the basis for, and become a condition of, continued international security support to Somalia. items.title: Guinea-Bissau Quashes Somaliland Recognition Buzz
items.description: Guinea-Bissau’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Sunday rejected social media reports claiming the West African nation was preparing to recognise Somaliland as an independent state, insisting no such decision has been made or is under consideration. The clarification matters because it comes just months after Israel became the first country in more than three decades to formally recognise Somaliland, a move the African Union and Somalia’s federal government both denounced as a violation of Somalia’s sovereignty. Any additional recognition, even a rumoured one, carries outsized diplomatic weight for Hargeisa’s decades-long campaign for statehood and for Mogadishu’s efforts to hold the line against it. In its statement, the ministry said it was “denying reports circulating on social media claiming that Guinea-Bissau is considering recognising what is called the ‘Republic of Somaliland.'” Bissau added that its foreign policy rests on respect for state sovereignty and territorial integrity, and adherence to the principles of the United Nations Charter and the African Union’s Constitutive Act. The government was explicit that no formal process is under way. “The Government of the Republic of Guinea-Bissau has not taken, nor is it currently considering, any decision on this matter,” the statement said. The denial followed a wave of unverified posts overnight claiming Bissau was on the verge of extending recognition to Somaliland, which declared independence from Somalia in 1991 but has never won broad international acknowledgement. Somali officials, meanwhile, have previously indicated they would treat any recognition move by an African state as a serious breach of Somalia’s sovereignty. Somaliland’s government has not commented publicly on the Guinea-Bissau reports. The territory, which maintains its own currency, military and government in Hargeisa, has stepped up its recognition push since Israel’s move in late 2025, a decision that African regional bodies swiftly rejected as contrary to the UN Charter, the AU’s founding act and the IGAD agreement. The post Guinea-Bissau Quashes Somaliland Recognition Buzz first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Puntland, Jubbaland, iyo mucaaradka oo beesha caalamka ka dalbaday in Soomaaliya la geliyo hannaan kumeelgaarka ah
items.description: Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ee ay ku mideysanyihiin Puntland, Jubbaland, iyo mucaaradka ayaa warqad furan u diray madaxda dalalka ciidamada iyo booliska ku leh Howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), iyagoo ku baaqay in xal siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay laga hormariyo marxalad kasta oo la xiriirta amniga iyo kala-guurka Soomaaliya. Warqadda, oo ku taariikheysan 27-ka Luulyo 2026, ayaa loo diray madaxda dalalka Uganda, Kenya, Itoobiya, Jabuuti, Burundi iyo Masar, kuwaas oo ciidamo ku leh howlgalka AUSSOM. Goluhu wuxuu ugu horreyn uga mahadceliyay dalalkaas doorkii ay ku lahaayeen taageerada Soomaaliya muddo ku dhow labaatan sano, isagoo xusay in kumannaan askari oo Afrikaan ah ay naf iyo maalba u hureen sidii Soomaaliya u heli lahayd nabad iyo xasillooni. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, warqaddu waxay sheegtay in Soomaaliya ay gashay marxalad siyaasadeed oo aad u adag, iyadoo lagu sheegay in muddo-xileedka dastuuriga ah ee Madaxweynaha uu dhammaaday 15-kii May 2026, halka Baarlamaankuna uu muddo-xileedkiisu ku egyahay 14-kii Abriil 2026. Golaha ayaa sheegay in weli aan la gaarin heshiis siyaasadeed oo hagaya kala-guurka dowladda. Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay walaac ku saabsan khilaafka u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo qaar ka mid ah Dowlad-Goboleedyada, gaar ahaan Puntland iyo Jubbaland, kuwaas oo ay sheegeen inay safka hore kaga jiraan dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish. Warqadda waxaa lagu sheegay in kala qeybsanaanta siyaasadeed ay wiiqday midnimada dalka iyo dadaalladii lagula dagaallamayay kooxaha hubeysan, taasoo keentay in caqabad ay ku noqoto amniga iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya. Goluhu wuxuu soo jeediyay in la dhiso Golaha Ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Kala-guurka Soomaaliyeed, kaas oo si wadajir ah u maamuli lahaa geeddi-socodka dastuurka iyo doorashooyinka ilaa laga soo dhisayo hay’ado qaran oo sharciyad buuxda leh. Sidoo kale, Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed wuxuu ugu baaqay madaxda dalalka AUSSOM inay taageeradooda ku xiraan heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, iyagoo sheegay in guusha howlgalka AUSSOM aysan ku xirnayn oo keliya guulo ciidan, balse ay ku xirnaan doonto helitaanka dowlad sharciyad leh oo mideysan. Warqaddan ayaa nuqullo ka mid ah loo diray Midowga Afrika, Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, IGAD, Qaramada Midoobay, Midowga Yurub, Mareykanka, Boqortooyada Ingiriiska iyo Turkiga. Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa ku soo gabagabeeyay warqaddiisa in Soomaaliya maanta u baahan tahay heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, kaas oo saldhig u noqon kara dib u dhiska hay’adaha dowladda, xoojinta amniga iyo qabsoomidda kala-guur nabdoon.

items.title: Galmudug oo beenisay eedeymo uga yimid Puntland
items.description: Maamulka Galmudug ayaa si adag u beeniyay eedeymo uga yimid Puntland oo sheegayay in hub lagu weeraray deegaannada Puntland uu sii maray ama laga soo gudbiyay garoomo ku yaalla Galmudug. Wasiirka Qorsheynta, Maalgashiga iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha Galmudug, Cabdiraxmaan Axmed Xayle, oo la hadlay laanta Af-Soomaaliga ee BBC-da, ayaa sheegay in wararkaasi aysan waxba ka jirin, isla markaana aysan jirin wax hub ah oo laga daabulay deegaannada Galmudug si loogu adeegsado deegaannada Puntland. Wasiirku wuxuu xusay in Galmudug iyo Puntland ay ka dhexeeyaan xiriir iyo iskaashi dhinacyo badan leh, isagoo tilmaamay in labada maamul ay muhiim u tahay wada shaqeynta amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolku. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya aysan u baahnayn inay u adeegsato Galmudug waddo ay u marto howlgallada gudaha Puntland, asagoo sheegay in gudaha maamulkaas ay toos uga howlgasho. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in maamulka Galmudug uu la yaabay warqadda iyo eedeymaha kasoo baxay Puntland, isagoo ku baaqay in la xoojiyo wada hadalka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya labada dhinac, halkii la isweydaarsan lahaa eedeymo aan la xaqiijin. Hadalka wasiirka ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo dhowaan Puntland ay soo saartay warqadda ay Galmudug uga digayso in dawladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay deegaannada maamulkaas u adeegsato meel looga soo duulo Puntland

items.title: Ciidanka PSF oo beeniyay inay ka howlgalaan koonfurta magaalada Gaalkacyo
items.description: Gaalkacyo ( Raxanreeb Online) Ciidamada PSF ayaa baneeyay xaruntoodii magaalada Gaalkacyo ee Puntland, iyaga oo u guuray xaafadda Baraxley ee dhanka maamulka Galmudug. Ciidamada PSF oo xaruntooda labaad ee Puntland ku lahaa meel u dhow garoonka diyaaradaha Gaalkacyo waxay guureen kaddib markii ay agagaarkooda soo dageen ciidamo farabadan oo ka tirsan Puntland. Ciidamada PSF ayaa dhanka Galmudug la aaday 5 gaari oo ay haysteen, waxaana xaruntoodii ciid carakaabo ah ku jartay dowladda hoose ee degmada Gaalkacyo. Sidoo kale saraakiisha ciidanka PSF, oo hadda ka tirsan yihiin ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, oo dhawaan lagala wareegay 8 gaari, kaddib dagaal ka dhacay deegaanka Laag ee degmada Boosaaso ee gobolka Bari. items.title: Somalia summons Kenya’s ambassador after state minister Abshir Bukhaari reportedly deported from Nairobi
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia has summoned Kenya’s ambassador for talks after State Minister at the Presidency Abshir Bukhaari was reportedly denied entry into Kenya upon arrival at Nairobi’s Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA) and deported back to Mogadishu on Sunday, according to government sources and multiple reports, in a development that threatens to deepen diplomatic tensions between the neighboring countries. Government sources said Somalia’s Foreign Ministry called in Kenya’s ambassador for consultations on Monday following reports that Bukhaari and several other Somali federal officials were denied entry upon arrival. The meeting is expected to seek clarification from Kenyan authorities over the reported incidents, which could become a fresh diplomatic flashpoint between Mogadishu and Nairobi. Neither the Somali nor Kenyan governments has publicly commented on the reports. Sources familiar with the matter said Kenyan immigration authorities denied Bukhaari entry because he was travelling on a Kenyan passport. The circumstances surrounding the reported decision have not been officially confirmed. The reported deportation comes only weeks after Somalia’s Deputy Prime Minister Jibril Abdirashid was also reportedly denied entry into Kenya after arriving on a Kenyan passport before being deported to Mogadishu. Somali authorities did not publicly explain that incident, fueling speculation over the state of relations between the two countries and the reasons behind the reported immigration actions. Former Somali federal lawmaker Abdillahi Hashi Abib, who was removed from parliament after criticizing the government, claimed the latest incident was linked to investigations involving individuals close to President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. Writing on X, Abib alleged that Bukhaari, whom he described as a senior member of the president’s inner circle and a Dam Jadiid figure, entered Kenya using two passports, including what he claimed was an illegally obtained Kenyan passport. Abib further alleged that Bukhaari was carrying cash linked to money laundering and the possible misuse of U.S. taxpayer funds. He also claimed Kenyan authorities were implementing an agreement with the United States to target Somali officials allegedly connected to financial crimes and investments in Nairobi’s real estate sector. Somaliguardian could not independently verify those allegations. No evidence has been publicly presented by the Kenyan, Somali or U.S. governments to substantiate the claims, and none of the three governments has publicly linked Bukhaari or other Somali officials to any such investigation. Neither Bukhaari nor Somalia’s presidency has publicly responded to Abib’s allegations. Kenyan authorities have likewise not commented on the reported deportation or the claims circulating on social media. The reported incident adds another layer of uncertainty to relations between Somalia and Kenya, whose cooperation spans security, trade, diplomacy and regional counterterrorism efforts. Whether the latest episode develops into a wider diplomatic dispute is likely to depend on the outcome of the consultations between Somalia’s Foreign Ministry and Kenya’s ambassador, as both governments come under increasing pressure to clarify the circumstances surrounding the reported deportations. items.title: Sidee ayaa looga falceliyay dacwada Golaha Mustaqbalka ay ka gudbiyeen DF?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Falcelin xooggan iyo hadal-heyn ayaa ka dhalatay warqad furan oo ay maanta Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed u direen waddamada ay ciidamada ka joogaan Soomaaliya, iyaga oo u jeediyay dalab ka dhan ah Dowladda Federaalka, kuna aadan marxaladda kala guurka ah, waxayna sheegeen in dowladdu lumisay sharciyadii heshiiska lagu ahaa. Golaha ayaa soo jeediyay in loo baahan yahay dhismaha Gole KMG ah, si loo badbaadiyo sharciyadda iyo kalsoonida. Sidoo kale waxa ay ka codsadeen dalalka Afrikaanka ee ciidamada ku taageeray howlgalka AUSSOM in ay sii wadaan taageeradooda inta laga helayo xal siyaasadeed oo laga gaaro khilaafka ka taagan hannaanka doorashooyinka. Sidoo kale waxa ay in ciidamadaas ay kaalin weyn ka qaateen amniga dalka iyo la dagaallanka argagixisada, isla markaana ay muujiyeen muhiimadda iskaashiga Afrika, waxayna sidoo kale uga mahadceliyeen dadaalkooda naf-hurnimada ah oo muddo ku dhow 20 sano ay ku bixiyeen dalka Soomaaliya. “Heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay uu noqdo saldhigga iyo shuruudda ugu weyn ee lagu sii wadi karo taageerada amniga Soomaaliya,” ayaa lagu yiri warqadda furan ee loo diray waddamada ciidamada usoo diray Soomaaliya. Haddaba Sidee looga falceliyay dacawadda ay Golaha Mustaqbalka ka gudbiyeen DF? Saleebaan Axmed Aadan: “War kuwaasi waxba idin qaban maayaane la heshiiya Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud”. Cabdikariin Xasan: “Waxaan taageersanahay qoraalka kasoo baxay Goloha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed”. Cabdiraxmaan Khaliif: “Waa wax lagu qoslo, waa na laga adkaaday oo cad waayey”. Cabdullahi Cali: “Mustaqbalka Soomaaliya wuxuu ku xiran yahay midnimada, wada-hadalka iyo danta shacabka. Waxaan ugu baaqayaa dhammaan masuuliyiinta iyo kooxaha siyaasadda inay ka hormariyaan danta qaranka danaha gaarka ah”. items.title: Is rasaasayn galaafatay nolosha saddex qof oo ka dhacday Mareykanka
items.description: Saddex qof ayaa ku dhintay, afar kalena way ku dhaawacmeen rasaas lagu furay goob ku taala Magaalada Seattle ee Gobolka Washington, sida ay sheegeen Saraakiisha Mareykanka. Dhacdadan ayaa ka dhacday Xarunta Seattle, halkaas oo sida la sheegay ay ka socotay bandhig cunto oo sanadle ah. Saraakiisha Booliska ayaa xaqiijiyay in rasaasta la furay, intii lagu guda jiray xafladda cuntada ee Bite of Seattle ee Seattle Center. Taliye Kuxigeenka Booliska Seattle, Tyrone Davis ayaa sheegay in hal qof loo soo xiray dhacdadaasi, mid kalena lagu daba joogo. Tyrone Davis ayaa intaasi ku daray inay aaminsan yihiin in labada qof ay is rasaaseynayeen, isla-markaana aysan jirin khatar soo wajahday dadweynaha. Tyrone Davis oo Wariyeyaasha la hadlay, waxna laga weydiiyay qofka weli baxsadka ah ayaa sheegay inaysan laamaha amnigu haynin sharaxaad ku saabsan qofkaasi. Rasaasta ayaa laga maqlay goobta abaare 6:00 fiidnimo ee waqtiga maxaliga ah, sida ay ku warantay Warbaahinta gudaha. Weerarada toogashada ayaa ah wax aad ugu badan Mareykanka, sababtuna waa in shacabka dalkaasi loo ogolyahay in ay hubka haysan karaan.

items.title: Sababta bah-dilka ah ee Donald Trump ku qasabtay inuu hakiyo weerarada Iiraan
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa hadda hakiyey qorshe uu si weyn ugu ballaarin lahaa duqeymaha ka dhanka ah Iran, kadib markii saraakiisha militariga ay ka digeen in dagaal cusub uu si halis ah u wiiqi karo keydka gantaallada difaaca cirka ee Pentagon-ka. Sida uu ku warramaya wargeyska The New York Tims Mareykanka, walaaca ugu weyn wuxuu ku saabsan yahay yaraanta gantaallada Patriot ee lagu qabto gantaallada riddada dheer, iyo hubka kale ee difaaca cirka ee Mareykanku ku daabulay Bariga Dhexe. Trump iyo la-taliyeyaashiisa sare ayaa sidoo kale ka cabsi qaba in weerarro ballaaran ay dagaalka ku sii fidiyaan gobolka, ay kala fogaadaan Mareykanka iyo xulafadiisa Khaliijka, isla markaana ay sii xumeeyaan dhibaatooyinka dhaqaale, tamar iyo qaxooti ee ka dhashay dagaalka. Go’aanka ku-meel-gaarka ah ayaa daba socda kulan Trump uu Jimcihii la yeeshay la-taliyeyaashiisa ugu sarreeya iyo xubno ka tirsan golihiisa wasiirrada, sida ay sheegeen laba qof oo xog-ogaal u ahaa wada-hadallada. Keydka Patriot oo yaraaay Doodaha gaarka ah ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray keydka Pentagon-ka ee gantaallada Patriot iyo hubka kale ee difaaca cirka, kuwaas oo si degdeg ah loogu adeegsanayo difaaca saldhigyada Mareykanka iyo kuwa xulafadiisa. Saddex askari oo Mareykan ah ayaa Jimcihii hore lagu dilay Jordan, kadib markii gantaal ballistic ah uu ka gudbay nidaamyada difaaca cirka ee la tacaalayey tiro badan oo gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo Iran laga soo riday. Guddoomiyaha Taliyeyaasha Guud ee Ciidamada Mareykanka, Jeneraal Dan Caine, ayaa Trump si gaar ah ugu sheegay in dib loo billaabi karo howlgallo militari oo waaweyn, balse ay taasi si khatar ah u dhimi karto gantaallada difaaca ee yaalla taliska CENTCOM, oo mas’uul ka ah howlgallada Bariga Dhexe. Afhayeen u hadlay Jeneraal Caine ayaa diiday inuu faallo ka bixiyo talooyinka uu jeneraalka siiyo madaxweynaha. Agaasimaha isgaarsiinta Aqalka Cad Steven Cheung ayaa sheegay in Trump uu mar walba doorbido xal diblomaasiyadeed, balse ay wali miiska saaran yihiin dhammaan fursadaha haddii Iran ay sii waddo weerarrada ay ka fulineyso marin-biyoodka Hormuz ama ay ku beegsaneyso xulafada Mareykanka. “Waxay Iran u wanaagsan tahay inay u dhaqaaqdo heshiis lagu gaarayo wada-hadal, haddii kale way og yihiin waxa dhici kara,” ayuu yiri Cheung. Weerarrada oo Iran mideeyey Trump ayaa muddo ku dhow shan bilood ah la tacaalayey sida uu u maareyn lahaa dagaalka Iran iyo sidii dib loogu furi lahaa marin-biyoodka Hormuz, xilli qiimaha shidaalka uu mar kale sare u kacayo kadib dagaallo dib u qarxay labadii toddobaad ee lasoo dhaafay. Wada-hadalladii diblomaasiyadeed ayaa burburay, halka duqeymihii ugu dambeeyey ee Mareykanka aysan muuqan inay Iran ka joojiyeen howlgalladeeda militari. Dad xog-ogaal u ah doodaha gudaha maamulka ayaa sheegay in tiro yar oo ka mid ah dadka ku dhow Trump ay taageersanaayeen qorshaha dagaalka lagu sii ballaarinayo. Sarkaal sare oo Mareykan ah ayaa muujiyey shaki ku saabsan in weerarro cusub ay Iran dib ugu celin karaan miiska wada-hadallada. Sarkaalku wuxuu sheegay in duqeymaha ay keeneen natiijo ka duwan tii la rabay, iyagoo mideeyey Iran, isla markaana madaxda Tehran u oggolaaday inay shacabka ku mashquuliyaan halista dibadda kaga imaaneysa. Dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa Sabtidii u muuqday inuu yaraaday markii ugu horreysay muddo laba toddobaad ah. Ciidamada Mareykanka ma aysan shaacin weerarro habeenkaas, kadib 13 habeen oo xiriir ah oo ay duqeymo ka fuliyeen gudaha Iran. Xiisadda gobolka ayaa hase yeeshee sii sarreysay, iyadoo dagaallo ay ka dhex qarxeen ciidamada ay Sacuudiga taageerto iyo Xuutiyiinta ay Iran garab istaagto ee Yemen. ‘Waan diyaarsannahay’ Kahor kulankii Jimcaha, Trump wuxuu muujiyey in ciidamada Mareykanka ay diyaar u yihiin weerarro ka culus kuwii hore, inkastoo uu sheegay in waddada diblomaasiyadda aysan wali xirmin. “Waan hubeysannahay, waana diyaar,” ayuu Trump wariyeyaasha u sheegay. “Laakiin waan la hadleynaa, marka waxaa laga yaabaa inay timaaddo ama aysan imaan meel wax walba beddesha.” Trump ayaa sidoo kale wareysi uu Khamiistii siiyey warbaahinta Axios ku sheegay inuu ka fiirsanayo “weerar aad u ballaaran, kana weyn kuwii hore”, isaga oo intaas ku daray inuu ku dhow yahay go’aan kama dambeys ah. Pentagon-ka ayaa maalmahan Bariga Dhexe u diray ciidamo, hub iyo sahay dheeraad ah, si loogu diyaargaroobo dagaal kasii xooggan. Saraakiisha militariga ayaa sheegay in Trump uu markii hore u muuqday inuu ansixinayo wejiga koowaad ee olole duqeymo dhowr marxaladood leh, kaas oo lagu beegsan lahaa raadaarrada xeebaha, goobaha gantaallada lidka maraakiibta iyo doomaha dheereeya ee Iran. Waxaa sidoo kale la tixgelinayey weerarro lagu qaado xarumaha tamarta, buundooyinka tareennada, goobaha nukliyeerka iyo saldhigyo ay Iran sahayda uga gudbiso xeebaha ku dhow marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Beegsiga saldhigyada Dhammaadkii Jimcaha, Trump ayaa si ku-meel-gaar ah u hakiyey qorshaha duqeymaha ballaaran, kadib digniino sheegaya in weerar noocaas ah uu dhalin karo jawaab Iran ka timaadda oo ka xoog badan kuwii hore. Iran ayaa labadii toddobaad ee lasoo dhaafay weerarro culus ku qaadday saldhigyada Mareykanka ee Jordan, Kuwait, Bahrain iyo Imaaraadka Carabta, taas oo cadaadis dheeraad ah saartay nidaamyada difaaca cirka. Pentagon-ka ayaa dagaalka ku isticmaalay in ka badan 1,200 oo gantaal oo ah nooca Patriot, kuwaas oo midkiiba qiimihiisu ka badan yahay afar milyan oo dollar, sida ay bishii April warisay The New York Times. Saraakiisha militariga ayaa sheegay in keydka gantaalladaas uu tan iyo markaas kasii yaraaday. Qaar badan oo ka mid ah la-taliyeyaasha Trump, oo uu ka mid yahay wiilka uu soddogga u yahay Jared Kushner, ayaa ku doodaya in Mareykanku qaadi karo waddo khatarteedu yar tahay, taas oo ah in la sii wado wada-hadallada iyo cadaadiska dhaqaale ee Iran. Si kastaba, ma cadda wada-hadallo rasmi ah oo hadda socda iyo in khilaafaadka ka dhex jira madaxda Iran ay suurtagelin doonaan heshiis cusub. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale dib u soo celiyey xannibaadda maraakiibta galaya ama ka baxaya dekedaha Iran, balse falanqeeyayaasha ayaa sheegaya in natiijada tallaabadaas ay weli isku dhafan tahay. Wasiirka Maaliyadda Mareykanka Scott Bessent ayaa sheegay in Shiinuhu uu bilihii u dambeeyey qiyaastii 40 boqolkiiba dhimay shidaalka ceyriinka ah ee uu ka iibsado Iran, taas oo si weyn u yareysay dakhliga Tehran. Waaxda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ayaa Jimcihii sidoo kale cunaqabateyn kusoo rogtay sagaal shirkadood iyo afar qof oo lala xiriiriyey shabakad ganacsi oo uu leeyahay maalgeliyaha reer Iran Babak Zanjani. Sida uu ku warramaya wargeyska The New York Tims Mareykanka, walaaca ugu weyn wuxuu ku saabsan yahay yaraanta gantaallada Patriot ee lagu qabto gantaallada riddada dheer, iyo hubka kale ee difaaca cirka ee Mareykanku ku daabulay Bariga Dhexe. Trump iyo la-taliyeyaashiisa sare ayaa sidoo kale ka cabsi qaba in weerarro ballaaran ay dagaalka ku sii fidiyaan gobolka, ay kala fogaadaan Mareykanka iyo xulafadiisa Khaliijka, isla markaana ay sii xumeeyaan dhibaatooyinka dhaqaale, tamar iyo qaxooti ee ka dhashay dagaalka. Go’aanka ku-meel-gaarka ah ayaa daba socda kulan Trump uu Jimcihii la yeeshay la-taliyeyaashiisa ugu sarreeya iyo xubno ka tirsan golihiisa wasiirrada, sida ay sheegeen laba qof oo xog-ogaal u ahaa wada-hadallada. Keydka Patriot oo yaraaay Doodaha gaarka ah ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray keydka Pentagon-ka ee gantaallada Patriot iyo hubka kale ee difaaca cirka, kuwaas oo si degdeg ah loogu adeegsanayo difaaca saldhigyada Mareykanka iyo kuwa xulafadiisa. Saddex askari oo Mareykan ah ayaa Jimcihii hore lagu dilay Jordan, kadib markii gantaal ballistic ah uu ka gudbay nidaamyada difaaca cirka ee la tacaalayey tiro badan oo gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo Iran laga soo riday. Guddoomiyaha Taliyeyaasha Guud ee Ciidamada Mareykanka, Jeneraal Dan Caine, ayaa Trump si gaar ah ugu sheegay in dib loo billaabi karo howlgallo militari oo waaweyn, balse ay taasi si khatar ah u dhimi karto gantaallada difaaca ee yaalla taliska CENTCOM, oo mas’uul ka ah howlgallada Bariga Dhexe. Afhayeen u hadlay Jeneraal Caine ayaa diiday inuu faallo ka bixiyo talooyinka uu jeneraalka siiyo madaxweynaha. Agaasimaha isgaarsiinta Aqalka Cad Steven Cheung ayaa sheegay in Trump uu mar walba doorbido xal diblomaasiyadeed, balse ay wali miiska saaran yihiin dhammaan fursadaha haddii Iran ay sii waddo weerarrada ay ka fulineyso marin-biyoodka Hormuz ama ay ku beegsaneyso xulafada Mareykanka. “Waxay Iran u wanaagsan tahay inay u dhaqaaqdo heshiis lagu gaarayo wada-hadal, haddii kale way og yihiin waxa dhici kara,” ayuu yiri Cheung. Weerarrada oo Iran mideeyey Trump ayaa muddo ku dhow shan bilood ah la tacaalayey sida uu u maareyn lahaa dagaalka Iran iyo sidii dib loogu furi lahaa marin-biyoodka Hormuz, xilli qiimaha shidaalka uu mar kale sare u kacayo kadib dagaallo dib u qarxay labadii toddobaad ee lasoo dhaafay. Wada-hadalladii diblomaasiyadeed ayaa burburay, halka duqeymihii ugu dambeeyey ee Mareykanka aysan muuqan inay Iran ka joojiyeen howlgalladeeda militari. Dad xog-ogaal u ah doodaha gudaha maamulka ayaa sheegay in tiro yar oo ka mid ah dadka ku dhow Trump ay taageersanaayeen qorshaha dagaalka lagu sii ballaarinayo. Sarkaal sare oo Mareykan ah ayaa muujiyey shaki ku saabsan in weerarro cusub ay Iran dib ugu celin karaan miiska wada-hadallada. Sarkaalku wuxuu sheegay in duqeymaha ay keeneen natiijo ka duwan tii la rabay, iyagoo mideeyey Iran, isla markaana madaxda Tehran u oggolaaday inay shacabka ku mashquuliyaan halista dibadda kaga imaaneysa. Dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa Sabtidii u muuqday inuu yaraaday markii ugu horreysay muddo laba toddobaad ah. Ciidamada Mareykanka ma aysan shaacin weerarro habeenkaas, kadib 13 habeen oo xiriir ah oo ay duqeymo ka fuliyeen gudaha Iran. Xiisadda gobolka ayaa hase yeeshee sii sarreysay, iyadoo dagaallo ay ka dhex qarxeen ciidamada ay Sacuudiga taageerto iyo Xuutiyiinta ay Iran garab istaagto ee Yemen. ‘Waan diyaarsannahay’ Kahor kulankii Jimcaha, Trump wuxuu muujiyey in ciidamada Mareykanka ay diyaar u yihiin weerarro ka culus kuwii hore, inkastoo uu sheegay in waddada diblomaasiyadda aysan wali xirmin. “Waan hubeysannahay, waana diyaar,” ayuu Trump wariyeyaasha u sheegay. “Laakiin waan la hadleynaa, marka waxaa laga yaabaa inay timaaddo ama aysan imaan meel wax walba beddesha.” Trump ayaa sidoo kale wareysi uu Khamiistii siiyey warbaahinta Axios ku sheegay inuu ka fiirsanayo “weerar aad u ballaaran, kana weyn kuwii hore”, isaga oo intaas ku daray inuu ku dhow yahay go’aan kama dambeys ah. Pentagon-ka ayaa maalmahan Bariga Dhexe u diray ciidamo, hub iyo sahay dheeraad ah, si loogu diyaargaroobo dagaal kasii xooggan. Saraakiisha militariga ayaa sheegay in Trump uu markii hore u muuqday inuu ansixinayo wejiga koowaad ee olole duqeymo dhowr marxaladood leh, kaas oo lagu beegsan lahaa raadaarrada xeebaha, goobaha gantaallada lidka maraakiibta iyo doomaha dheereeya ee Iran. Waxaa sidoo kale la tixgelinayey weerarro lagu qaado xarumaha tamarta, buundooyinka tareennada, goobaha nukliyeerka iyo saldhigyo ay Iran sahayda uga gudbiso xeebaha ku dhow marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Beegsiga saldhigyada Dhammaadkii Jimcaha, Trump ayaa si ku-meel-gaar ah u hakiyey qorshaha duqeymaha ballaaran, kadib digniino sheegaya in weerar noocaas ah uu dhalin karo jawaab Iran ka timaadda oo ka xoog badan kuwii hore. Iran ayaa labadii toddobaad ee lasoo dhaafay weerarro culus ku qaadday saldhigyada Mareykanka ee Jordan, Kuwait, Bahrain iyo Imaaraadka Carabta, taas oo cadaadis dheeraad ah saartay nidaamyada difaaca cirka. Pentagon-ka ayaa dagaalka ku isticmaalay in ka badan 1,200 oo gantaal oo ah nooca Patriot, kuwaas oo midkiiba qiimihiisu ka badan yahay afar milyan oo dollar, sida ay bishii April warisay The New York Times. Saraakiisha militariga ayaa sheegay in keydka gantaalladaas uu tan iyo markaas kasii yaraaday. Qaar badan oo ka mid ah la-taliyeyaasha Trump, oo uu ka mid yahay wiilka uu soddogga u yahay Jared Kushner, ayaa ku doodaya in Mareykanku qaadi karo waddo khatarteedu yar tahay, taas oo ah in la sii wado wada-hadallada iyo cadaadiska dhaqaale ee Iran. Si kastaba, ma cadda wada-hadallo rasmi ah oo hadda socda iyo in khilaafaadka ka dhex jira madaxda Iran ay suurtagelin doonaan heshiis cusub. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale dib u soo celiyey xannibaadda maraakiibta galaya ama ka baxaya dekedaha Iran, balse falanqeeyayaasha ayaa sheegaya in natiijada tallaabadaas ay weli isku dhafan tahay. Wasiirka Maaliyadda Mareykanka Scott Bessent ayaa sheegay in Shiinuhu uu bilihii u dambeeyey qiyaastii 40 boqolkiiba dhimay shidaalka ceyriinka ah ee uu ka iibsado Iran, taas oo si weyn u yareysay dakhliga Tehran. Waaxda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ayaa Jimcihii sidoo kale cunaqabateyn kusoo rogtay sagaal shirkadood iyo afar qof oo lala xiriiriyey shabakad ganacsi oo uu leeyahay maalgeliyaha reer Iran Babak Zanjani.
