items.title: Ciidamada oo hawlgal ka dhan ah Al Shabaab ka wada bariga Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley ayaa jihooyin kala duwan ka cadaadinaya maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ee ku sugan bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Ciidamada ayaa toddobaadkii hore xoojiyay hawlgalka ka dhanka ah maleeshiyadaasi, iyagoona dhaqdhaqaaqyyo ciidan iyo cadaadis militari ka wada jihooyin kala duwan oo deegaano hoostaga Degmooyinka Maxaas iyo Buuloburde, isla-markaana ay Shabaabku ku sugan yihiin. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadu ay hawlgal ka wadaan agagaarka deegaanada Yasooman, Waabweyn iyo Suullaay, si loo kala jaro isu socodka, gurmadka iyo saadka maleeshiyada ee Degmooyinka Maxaas iyo Moqokori. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in hawlgalka ay qayb ka yihiin diyaaradaha dagaalka ee saaxiibada caalamiga ah, isla-markaana ay mararka qaarkood duqaynayaan meelaha muhiimka ah. Taliyaha Qaybta 27aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/dhexe Cali Axmed Xaashi (Cagey) oo ku sugan jiidda hore ee gobolka ayaa soo diray farriin uu shacabka ugu sheegayo in ay ka fogaadaan goobaha cadowga. Xoogaga Macawiisleyda, oo ah dadka deegaanka ee hubeysan, isla-markaana ay Dowladda Federaalka taakuleyso ayaa Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ka caawinaya in la beegsado goobaha ay ku yaallaan saldhigyada Al Shabaab. Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan ayaa u muuqdo kuwo hoggaaminayo hawlgalka is ballaarinta ee ay ciidamadu ka wadaan bariga gobolkaasi. Hawlgalka wadajirka ah ayuu ujeedkiisu koowaad yahay in Shabaabka laga fogeeyo magaalooyinka iyo deegaanada Hirshabelle ee dhawaan laga qabanayo doorashada qof iyo codka ee lagu soo dooranayo Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Hirshabelle.

items.title: Maxaa ka jira in Guinea-Bissau aqoonsaneyso Somaliland?
items.description: Bissau (Caasimada Online) – Bayaan kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee dowladda Guinea-Bissau ayaa lagu beeniyay wararka lagu faafiyay baraha bulshada ee sheegaya in dalkaasi uu qorsheynayo inuu aqoonsado Somaliland. Guinea-Bissau ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in mowqifkeeda rasmiga ah uusan wax isbeddel ah ku imaan, isla markaana aanu jirin qorshe ay ku aqoonsanayso Somaliland. “Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda, Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah iyo Jaaliyadaha waxay beeninaysaa wararka lagu faafinayo baraha bulshada ee sheegaya in Guinea-Bissau ay ka fiirsanayso inay aqoonsato waxa loogu yeero ‘Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Sidoo kale, waxaa warsaxaafadeedka lagu sheegay in siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Guinea-Bissau ku dhisan tahay ixtiraamka madaxbannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dowladaha, iyo ku dhaqanka mabaadi’da ku xusan Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay iyo Xeerka Aasaasiga ah ee Midowga Afrika. Waxaa kale oo qoraalka lagu caddeeyay in Guinea-Bissau aysan weli qaadan, isla markaana hadda ka fakireyn, wax go’aan ah oo la xiriira aqoonsiga Somaliland “Dowladda Jamhuuriyadda Guinea-Bissau ma aysan qaadan, mana ka fiirsanayso, wax go’aan ah oo arrintaas la xiriira,” ayaa la sii raaciyay. Bayaankan ayaa yimid kaddib markii xalay baraha bulshada si wayn loogu baahiyay warar sheegaya in waddanka Afrikaan ah uu aqoonsanayo Somaliland, waxaase soo jawaabay Guinea-Bissau oo beenisay warkaasi. Si kastaba, Somaliland oo horay aqoonsi uga heshay Israa’iil ayaa sii laba jibaartay dadaalladeeda gobolka iyo caalamka, si ay u hesho ictiraaf kale. items.title: Niger oo Faransiiska ku eedeeyay weerarro ka dhacay caasimadda dalkaas
items.description: Dowladda militariga ee Niger ayaa si kulul u eedeysay dowladda Faransiiska, iyadoo sheegtay inay hayso caddeymo muujinaya in Paris ay maalgelin iyo tababar siisay dagaalyahanno ka tirsan kooxda hubeysan ee Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM), oo ka dagaallanta dalal badan oo ka tirsan Galbeedka Afrika. Afhayeen u hadlay militariga Niger ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay rumeysan tahay in Faransiisku door ku lahaa taageerada kooxda, isla markaana uu gacan ka geystay weerarro lagu bartilmaameedsaday dalka, oo ay ku jiraan weerarro ka dhacay agagaarka caasimadda Niamey intii lagu jiray sanadkan. Mas’uuliyiinta Niger waxay sheegeen inay hayaan xog sirdoon iyo caddeymo ay ku doonayaan inay ku taageeraan eedeymahaas, hase yeeshee illaa hadda ma aysan soo bandhigin caddeymo si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyay. Dhanka kale, dowladda Faransiiska ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga jawaabin eedeymahan cusub. Hore ayay Faransiisku u beenisay eedeymo la mid ah, isagoo sheegay in siyaasaddiisu tahay la dagaallanka kooxaha argagixisada ee ka howlgala gobolka Saaxil. Xiriirka Niger iyo Faransiiska ayaa sii xumaaday tan iyo afgambigii militariga ee dhacay sannadkii 2023. Dowladda cusub ee Niger ayaa tan iyo markaas joojisay iskaashigii amniga ee ay la lahayd Faransiiska, waxayna dalbatay in ciidamada Faransiisku ka baxaan dalka. Niger ayaa sidoo kale xoojisay xiriirka ay la leedahay dalalka Mali iyo Burkina Faso, kuwaas oo ay wadaagaan maamullo militari. Khubarada amniga ayaa sheegaya in gobolka Saaxil uu weli wajahayo khataro amni oo sii kordhaya, iyadoo kooxaha hubeysan ay sii wadaan weerarrada ka dhanka ah ciidamada dowladda iyo shacabka rayidka ah.

items.title: Ciidanka Suudaan Dib u Qabsaday Waddo Istaraatiiji ah oo isku xirta Khartuum iyo El-Obeid
items.description: Ciidanka Dowladda Suudaan ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu si buuxda dib ugu qabsaday waddada istaraatiijiga ah ee Al Sadarat, taas oo isku xirta caasimadda Khartuum iyo magaalada El-Obeid, kaddib laba maalmood oo dagaallo culus ay la galeen ciidamada gurmadka degdegga ah ee RSF. War-saxaafadeed ay soo saareen ciidamada dowladda ayaa lagu sheegay in ay dib ula wareegeen magaalooyin iyo deegaanno muhiim ah oo ku yaalla waddadan, isla markaana ay khasaare xooggan gaarsiiyeen ciidamada RSF, kuwaas oo lagu qasbay inay dib u gurtaan. Dib u qabsashada waddadan ayaa la sheegay inay ciidamada Suudaan u fududeyn doonto inay si dhaqso leh ugu gudbiyaan ciidamo, hub, shidaal iyo sahay magaalada El-Obeid, isla markaana ay wiiqi doonto isku dayga RSF ee lagu doonayay inay la wareegaan magaaladaas oo ah xarunta gobolka North Kordofan. furitaanka waddadan ayaa sidoo kale kor u qaadi karto gaarsiinta gargaarka bani’aadannimo iyo dib u soo nooleynta isu socodka ganacsiga ee gobolka, iyadoo boqolaal kun oo qof ay muddo bilooyin ah ku go’doonsanaayeen El-Obeid. Dagaalka u dhexeeya Ciidanka Dowladda Suudaan iyo RSF ayaa billowday bishii Abriil 2023, waxaana lagu qiyaasaa inuu sababay dhimashada tobannaan kun oo qof iyo barakaca in ka badan 14 milyan oo ruux, taasoo ka dhigtay mid ka mid ah dhibaatooyinka bani’aadannimo ee ugu waaweyn dunida.

Dagaalka u dhexeeya Ciidanka Dowladda Suudaan iyo RSF ayaa billowday bishii Abriil 2023, waxaana lagu qiyaasaa inuu sababay dhimashada tobannaan kun oo qof iyo barakaca in ka badan 14 milyan oo ruux, taasoo ka dhigtay mid ka mid ah dhibaatooyinka bani’aadannimo ee ugu waaweyn dunida.

items.title: Mike Waltz oo sheegay in Madaxweyne Trump uu joojiyay weeraradii Iran
items.description: Safiirka Mareykanka ee Qaramada Midoobey, Mike Waltz ayaa sheegay in Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu amray in la joojiyo ama la hakiyo weeraradii lagu hayay dalkaasi Iran, si uu fursad u siiyo dadaalada diblomaasiyadeed ee socda, isla-markaana uu meel ugu banneeyo wada hadalada. Safiirka ayaa Axaddii sheegay in amarka Madaxweynaha Mareykanka lagu joojiyay weeraradii lagu qaadayay Iran habeenkii 2aad oo xiriir ah, si waqti dheeraad ah loo siiyo dadaalada diblomaasiyadda caalamiga ah. Wasaaradda Difaaca Mareykanka ee The Pentagon ayaa habeenkii Jimcaha joojisay duqaymihii xiriirka ahaa ee socday 13-ka habeen, waxaana habeenadii u dambeeyay la dareemayay qaboojin ku timid dagaalka. Mike Waltz ayaa sheegay inkastoo ciidamada ay diyaar u yihiin in dagaalka la sii wado, haddana Trump uu fursad siinayo dadaalada laga dhex wado iyaga iyo Iran. Waxa uu sheegay in fursadda diblomaasiyadeed aysan la macno ahayn in Mareykanku uusan sii wadi karin dagaalka, balse ay weli miiska saaran yihiin dhammaan xulashooyinka kale ee militari. Dhanka kale Mike Waltz ayaa beeniyay wararka sheegaya in uu sii yaraanayo kaydka hubka Mareykanka, taasna ay caqabad ku tahay in Washington ay ballaariso dagaalka Iran. Safiirka Mareykanka u fadhiya Qaramada Midoobey ayaa Barnaamijka “Meet the Press” ee Telefishinka NBC News u sheegay in Mareykanku uu haysto wax kasta oo uu u baahan yahay, si uu u fuliyo hawlgalo militari oo ka dhan ah Iran. “Waxaan rabaa inaan arrintan si cad u sheego. Ciidamada Mareykanka waxay haystaan ​​wax kasta oo ay ugu baahan yihiin inay hawlgalkan u fuliyaan si heerka ugu sarreeya ee waxtarka leh.” Ayuu yiri Waltz oo intaasi ku daray “Waxaan idiin sheegayaa, dadka soo dusinaya hadaladan aan sal iyo raadka lahayn inay mudan yihiin in xabsiga la dhigo.” Warbaahinta Mareykanka ayaa maalmihii la soo dhaafay ku warameysay in dagaalka sii socda ee Iran uu Mareykanka ku riixayo in uu noqdo dal aan lahayn kayd hub. Dagaalka Bariga Dhexe ayaa caqabad weyn ku noqday agabka difaaca Mareykanka ee gobolka, iyadoo isticmaalka badan ciidamada ee gantaalada difaaca hawada, sida Patriot iyo THAAD ay halis geliyeen kaydkii gobolka.

items.title: Golaha Mustaqbalka oo dalab xasaasi ah u diray dalalka Soomaaliya u soo diray…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed oo warqad furan u diray waddamada ay ciidamada ka joogaan Soomaaliya ayaa u jeediyay dalab xasaasi ah oo ku aadan marxaladda kala guurka ah ee dalka, waxayna sheegeen in dowladdu lumisay sharciyadii heshiiska lagu ahaa. Ugu horreyn Golaha ayaa soo jeediyay in loo baahan yahay dhismaha Gole KMG ah, si loo badbaadiyo sharciyadda iyo kalsoonida. Sidoo kale waxa ay ka codsadeen dalalka Afrikaanka ee ciidamada ku taageeray howlgalka AUSSOM in ay sii wadaan taageeradooda inta laga helayo xal siyaasadeed oo laga gaaro khilaafka ka taagan hannaanka doorashooyinka. Golaha ayaa sheegay in ciidamadaas ay kaalin weyn ka qaateen amniga dalka iyo la dagaallanka argagixisada, isla markaana ay muujiyeen muhiimadda iskaashiga Afrika, waxayna sidoo kale uga mahadceliyeen dadaalkooda naf-hurnimada ah oo muddo ku dhow 20 sano ay ku bixiyeen dalka Soomaaliya. “Heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay uu noqdo saldhigga iyo shuruudda ugu weyn ee lagu sii wadi karo taageerada amniga Soomaaliya,” ayaa lagu yiri warqadda furan ee loo diray waddamada ciidamada usoo diray Soomaaliya. Waxaa kale oo uu goluhu xusay in Soomaaliya aysan si guul leh ula dagaalami karin kooxaha hubeysan, iyadoo dowladda dhexe iyo dowlad-goboleedyadu ay is khilaafsan yihiin, maadaama weli uu maran ka taagan yahay hannaanka doorashada iyo wax ka beddelka lagu sameeyay dastuurkii KMG ahaa. Warqaddu waxay intaas ku dartay in caqabadaha haysta maalgelinta AUSSOM iyo UNSOS ay ka dhasheen qalalaasaha siyaasadeed ee gudaha, isla markaana khatarta ugu weyn aysan ahayn dhaqaale la’aan, balse ay tahay dowlad aan haysan kalsoonida shacabka iyo sidoo kale saaxiibbada caalamka. Ugu dambeyn, Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa ku baaqay in la gaaro heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, laguna saleeyo wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad, si dib loogu soo celiyo sharciyadda hay’adaha dowladda, loo ilaaliyo dhex-dhexaadnimada ciidamada qaranka, loona abuuro hannaan doorasho iyo marxa;ad kala-guur oo nabdoon. Waxay madaxda dalalka ciidamada ay ka joogaan Soomaaliya ka codsadeen inay taageeraan dadaal kasta oo horseedaya heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, iyagoo sheegay in heshiiskaas uu yahay shuruudda ugu muhiimsan ee guusha howlgal kasta oo amni iyo xasilin ee ka socda gudaha Soomaaliya. items.title: Waa kuma Abdul Ballout – Ninka fuliyey weerarkii Berlin?
items.description: Berlin (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada gaarka ah ee booliska Jarmalka ayaa toogasho ku dilay nin lagu tuhmay inuu gaari jiirsiiyey dadweyne, kadibna seef ku weeraray dad kale oo ku sugnaa meel u dhow xaflad weyn oo Sabtidii ka dhacday magaalada Berlin. Weerarka ayaa sababay dhimashada hal haweeney ah, halka 29 qof oo kale ay ku dhaawacmeen, sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiinta Jarmalka. Dhacdadan ayaa ka dhacday jardiinada Tiergarten, meel aan ka fogeyn Brandenburg Gate, xilli ay gabagabo ku dhoweyd xafladda sannadlaha ah ee Christopher Street Day, oo ka mid ah munaasabadaha LGBTQ+ ee ugu waaweyn Yurub. Booliska ayaa sheegay inay galabnimadii Axadda heleen Abdul Ballout, oo ahaa 21 jir haysta dhalashada Jarmalka, xilli uu ku sugnaa dhul beereed yar oo ku yaalla degmada Spandau ee galbeedka Berlin. Markii ciidamadu isku dayeen inay qabtaan, Ballout ayaa la sheegay inuu dhankooda u soo cararay isaga oo sita seef . Booliska ayaa rasaas ku furay, waxaana uu ku dhintay goobta, inkasta oo shaqaalaha gurmadku isku dayeen inay badbaadiyaan. Toogashadaas ayaa soo afjartay howlgal ballaaran oo ku dhowaad 24 saacadood socday, kaas oo lagu baadigoobayey ninka lagu tuhmay weerarka. Gaari lagu jiirsiiyey dadweyne Weerarka ayaa billowday abaare 10-kii fiidnimo ee Sabtidii, markii gaari yar oo nooca xamuulka ah lagu jiirsiiyey dad marayey waddo dhex marta jardiinada Tiergarten. Gaariga ayaa ugu dambeyn geed ku dhacay, waxaana laga helay isaga oo cidlo ah. Baarayaasha ayaa sheegay in qof ama dadkii gaariga saarnaa ay goobta ka baxsadeen, halka dad kale lagu dhaawacay hub la rumeysan yahay inuu ahaa mindi weyn ama baangad. Booliska iyo xafiiska dacwad-oogaha Berlin ayaa sheegay inay sidoo kale baarayaan suurtagalnimada in qof labaad uu gaariga ku jiray, maadaama markii hore la arkay in hal qof ama in ka badan ay ka baxeen gaariga kadib markii uu geedka ku dhacay. Telefoon gacanta ah oo laga helay gudaha gaariga ayaa baarayaasha ka caawiyey inay tuhunkooda ku jeediyaan Ballout, oo horey ay hay’adaha ammaanku ula socdeen sababo la xiriira dambiyo iyo xiriirro xagjirnimo. Wasiirka arrimaha gudaha Jarmalka Alexander Dobrindt ayaa weerarka ku tilmaamay fal ay caddaymihii hore muujinayaan inuu la xiriiro xagjirnimada Islaamiga ah. “Waxaan la macaamilaynaa qof horey indhaha ugu soo dhacay dambiyada tirada badan ee uu galay, xagjirnimadiisa iyo ku lug lahaanshihiisa deegaanka Islaamiyiinta,” ayuu yiri Dobrindt ka hor inta aan la dilin tuhmanaha. Xukun hore oo argagixiso Xafiiska dacwad-oogaha Berlin ayaa sheegay in Ballout uu ku dhashay kuna soo barbaaray magaalada Berlin, isla markaana uu haystay dhalashada Jarmalka. Hooyadii oo asal ahaan Lubnaani ah ayaa qaadatay dhalashada Jarmalka sannadkii 2002, saddex sano ka hor dhalashadiisa. Ballout ayaa sannadkii 2025 u safray Lubnaan isaga oo la sheegay inuu doonayey inuu halkaas uga gudbo Suuriya, si uu ugu biiro kooxda Daacish. Waxa uu Lubnaan kula xiriiray dad uu rumeysnaa inay xubno ka yihiin Daacish, hase yeeshee ciidamada ammaanka Lubnaan ayaa xiray bishii July 2025. Maxkamad militari ayaa ku xukuntay saddex bilood oo xabsi ah, waxaana markii dambe dib loogu celiyey Jarmalka. Maxkamad ku taalla Berlin ayaa 12-kii May 2026 ku heshay dambi ah inuu diyaarinayey fal rabshado culus oo halis gelin kara dowladda, iyo inuu bartiisa Instagram-ka ku faafiyey muuqaallo iyo dacaayado mamnuuc ah oo ay leedahay Daacish. Waxaa lagu xukumay hal sano iyo 10 bilood oo xabsi dhalinyaro ah, balse go’aanka ku saabsan inuu xabsiga si toos ah u galo ayaa muddo lix bilood ah dib loo dhigay. Maxkamaddu waxay sidoo kale amartay in sarkaal kormeera dhaqankiisa loo magacaabo. Dacwad-oogayaasha ayaa racfaan ka qaatay go’aanka, iyaga oo dalbaday xukun ka adag iyo in xabsiga lagu sii hayo. Maxkamadda ayaa sii-deyntiisa ku sababeysay muddadii uu horey xabsiga ugu jiray Lubnaan iyo Jarmalka, qirashadiisa iyo sheegashadiisa ah inuu ka fogaaday Daacish. Xogta ah in tuhmanuhu horey ugu jiray diiwaanka hay’adaha ammaanka ayaa dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan sababta loogu oggolaaday inuu xor ahaado, inkasta oo lagu helay dambi la xiriira qorshe xagjirnimo. Merz oo cambaareeyey weerarka Qabanqaabiyeyaasha ayaa joojiyey qaybihii ka harsanaa xafladda kadib weerarka, iyadoo dadkii goobta ku sugnaa si degdeg ah loo kala diray. Ra’iisul wasaaraha Jarmalka Friedrich Merz ayaa weerarka ku tilmaamay fal laga yaqyaqsoodo, isaga oo sheegay in dowladda ay si buuxda u baari doonto, isla markaana ay difaaci doonto xorriyadda iyo furnaanta bulshada Jarmalka. “Falalkan waxay leeyihiin hal ujeeddo oo keliya: inay kala qaybiyaan bulshadeenna,” ayuu yiri Merz. “Waxay doonayaan inay naga qaadaan waxa ugu muhiimsan ee aan haysanno, oo ah furnaanteenna iyo xorriyaddeenna.” Jarmalka ayaa horey ula kulmay weerarro dhowr ah oo gaadiid lagu jiirsiiyey dadweyne. Bishii December 2016, xubin ka tirsanaa Daacish ayaa gaari xamuul ah ku jiirsiiyey suuq lagu qabanayey munaasabadda Kirismaska ee Berlin, waxaana ku dhintay 13 qof. Bishii December 2024, nin u dhashay Sacuudiga oo caan ku ahaa aragtiyo ka dhan ah Islaamka ayaa gaari ku dhex jiiray suuq kale oo Kirismas ah oo ku yaalla magaalada Magdeburg, halkaas oo lix qof lagu dilay, boqolaal kalena lagu dhaawacay. Weerarkii Sabtida ayaa la filayaa inuu dib u soo nooleeyo doodda gudaha Jarmalka ee ku saabsan awoodda hay’adaha ammaanka, la socodka dadka lagu tuhmo xagjirnimada iyo siyaasadaha socdaalka. Telefoon gacanta ah oo laga helay gudaha gaariga ayaa baarayaasha ka caawiyey inay tuhunkooda ku jeediyaan Ballout, oo horey ay hay’adaha ammaanku ula socdeen sababo la xiriira dambiyo iyo xiriirro xagjirnimo. Wasiirka arrimaha gudaha Jarmalka Alexander Dobrindt ayaa weerarka ku tilmaamay fal ay caddaymihii hore muujinayaan inuu la xiriiro xagjirnimada Islaamiga ah. “Waxaan la macaamilaynaa qof horey indhaha ugu soo dhacay dambiyada tirada badan ee uu galay, xagjirnimadiisa iyo ku lug lahaanshihiisa deegaanka Islaamiyiinta,” ayuu yiri Dobrindt ka hor inta aan la dilin tuhmanaha. Xukun hore oo argagixiso Xafiiska dacwad-oogaha Berlin ayaa sheegay in Ballout uu ku dhashay kuna soo barbaaray magaalada Berlin, isla markaana uu haystay dhalashada Jarmalka. Hooyadii oo asal ahaan Lubnaani ah ayaa qaadatay dhalashada Jarmalka sannadkii 2002, saddex sano ka hor dhalashadiisa. Ballout ayaa sannadkii 2025 u safray Lubnaan isaga oo la sheegay inuu doonayey inuu halkaas uga gudbo Suuriya, si uu ugu biiro kooxda Daacish. Waxa uu Lubnaan kula xiriiray dad uu rumeysnaa inay xubno ka yihiin Daacish, hase yeeshee ciidamada ammaanka Lubnaan ayaa xiray bishii July 2025. Maxkamad militari ayaa ku xukuntay saddex bilood oo xabsi ah, waxaana markii dambe dib loogu celiyey Jarmalka. Maxkamad ku taalla Berlin ayaa 12-kii May 2026 ku heshay dambi ah inuu diyaarinayey fal rabshado culus oo halis gelin kara dowladda, iyo inuu bartiisa Instagram-ka ku faafiyey muuqaallo iyo dacaayado mamnuuc ah oo ay leedahay Daacish. Waxaa lagu xukumay hal sano iyo 10 bilood oo xabsi dhalinyaro ah, balse go’aanka ku saabsan inuu xabsiga si toos ah u galo ayaa muddo lix bilood ah dib loo dhigay. Maxkamaddu waxay sidoo kale amartay in sarkaal kormeera dhaqankiisa loo magacaabo. Dacwad-oogayaasha ayaa racfaan ka qaatay go’aanka, iyaga oo dalbaday xukun ka adag iyo in xabsiga lagu sii hayo. Maxkamadda ayaa sii-deyntiisa ku sababeysay muddadii uu horey xabsiga ugu jiray Lubnaan iyo Jarmalka, qirashadiisa iyo sheegashadiisa ah inuu ka fogaaday Daacish. Xogta ah in tuhmanuhu horey ugu jiray diiwaanka hay’adaha ammaanka ayaa dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan sababta loogu oggolaaday inuu xor ahaado, inkasta oo lagu helay dambi la xiriira qorshe xagjirnimo. Merz oo cambaareeyey weerarka Qabanqaabiyeyaasha ayaa joojiyey qaybihii ka harsanaa xafladda kadib weerarka, iyadoo dadkii goobta ku sugnaa si degdeg ah loo kala diray. Ra’iisul wasaaraha Jarmalka Friedrich Merz ayaa weerarka ku tilmaamay fal laga yaqyaqsoodo, isaga oo sheegay in dowladda ay si buuxda u baari doonto, isla markaana ay difaaci doonto xorriyadda iyo furnaanta bulshada Jarmalka. “Falalkan waxay leeyihiin hal ujeeddo oo keliya: inay kala qaybiyaan bulshadeenna,” ayuu yiri Merz. “Waxay doonayaan inay naga qaadaan waxa ugu muhiimsan ee aan haysanno, oo ah furnaanteenna iyo xorriyaddeenna.” Jarmalka ayaa horey ula kulmay weerarro dhowr ah oo gaadiid lagu jiirsiiyey dadweyne. Bishii December 2016, xubin ka tirsanaa Daacish ayaa gaari xamuul ah ku jiirsiiyey suuq lagu qabanayey munaasabadda Kirismaska ee Berlin, waxaana ku dhintay 13 qof. Bishii December 2024, nin u dhashay Sacuudiga oo caan ku ahaa aragtiyo ka dhan ah Islaamka ayaa gaari ku dhex jiiray suuq kale oo Kirismas ah oo ku yaalla magaalada Magdeburg, halkaas oo lix qof lagu dilay, boqolaal kalena lagu dhaawacay. Weerarkii Sabtida ayaa la filayaa inuu dib u soo nooleeyo doodda gudaha Jarmalka ee ku saabsan awoodda hay’adaha ammaanka, la socodka dadka lagu tuhmo xagjirnimada iyo siyaasadaha socdaalka. items.title: US and Iran pause their attacks after days of escalation
items.description: CAIRO (AP) — The United States and  Iran  paused their attacks for a second straight day Sunday, as efforts continued to bring them back to negotiations on an  interim ceasefire deal  largely undermined by recent exchanges of fire. It was not clear  why the U.S. has paused  after targeting Iranian coastal areas and infrastructure in a nearly two-week escalation sparked by Iran’s firing at ships trying to transit the Strait of Hormuz. The Pentagon did not respond to questions. U.S. President Donald Trump is “giving talks some space. He’s giving it a little bit of room,” Mike Waltz, the U.S. ambassador to the United Nations, told Fox News. “We’ve had both Oman and Iran, and a number of our other negotiators, engaged at every level, from the most senior levels all the way down to the technical level over the past few weeks, and particularly in the past few days.” Waltz dismissed the idea that the U.S. stockpile of interceptors crucial in defending against Iranian attacks is running low, but experts have questioned how long both the U.S. and Iran can afford to keep up attacks. Since the U.S. has halted attacks for the past two nights, Iran has as well, its army spokesperson told Iran’s state TV on Sunday. Tehran in recent days has counterattacked against countries in the region hosting U.S. military forces, killing at least three  service members  at a base in Jordan and one in Iraq. A regional official calls the pause a ‘positive signal’ The 60-day period that began when the interim deal was signed by both countries in mid-June is now well into its second half, and major issues that were meant to be negotiated -– notably  Iran’s nuclear program  at the heart of tensions -– remain set aside as mediators try to keep both sides talking. A regional official involved in mediation efforts said diplomacy was underway and that a pause in U.S. and Iranian strikes was a “positive signal that helps their efforts to de-escalate.” The official said both countries want to return to the interim ceasefire deal and that a compromise being negotiated centers on having Iran run vessel transit through the Strait of Hormuz with fewer restrictions on ships. The official was not authorized to discuss the matter and spoke on condition of anonymity. Shipping traffic on the strait is at a 3-week low Concerns continued about shipping on the strait and now on another crucial waterway in the region, the  Bab al-Mandeb strait  to the Red Sea. Iranian-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen last week threatened a blockade of Saudi shipping there. Global energy supplies and the economy remain in the balance as  gasoline prices have risen again . Commercial shipping traffic on the Strait of Hormuz was at a three-week low, a maritime body overseen by the U.S. Navy said Sunday, adding that no new attacks had been confirmed in the past 72 hours. It said traffic remained steady through the Bab el-Mandeb. Iran on Sunday said it continued to speak with Oman about managing the safe passage of ships on the Strait of Hormuz, which passes between the countries. Iran’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson, Esmail Baghaei, said talks had made progress and continued. Baghaei also said the strait’s status remained unchanged. Tehran has asserted that the interim deal with the U.S. allows it to manage shipping on the waterway for now, and it has objected to U.S. efforts to support a route through the strait that passes close to Oman instead. The strait was considered an international waterway before the war. The U.S. military on Saturday said its recently reimposed naval blockade against Iran continued, with a dozen commercial ships redirected, two disabled and two boarded. U.S. forces “remain highly vigilant, focused, lethal, and ready,” it added. Netanyahu says he ‘fully’ backs Trump’s efforts Meanwhile, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu plans to travel to the United States and meet with Trump in Washington on Tuesday, his office has said. They last met in Washington in February, weeks before they  launched the war  on Iran that killed senior leaders including Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. The Iranian-backed Hezbollah fired at Israel two days after the war began, and Israel responded with airstrikes and ground forces in southern Lebanon. Since then, the U.S. has supported landmark direct talks between Lebanon and Israel to try to calm that front and find a way to disarm Hezbollah. Netanyahu on Sunday told Fox News he “fully” backs Trump’s efforts to weaken Iran and press it to end its nuclear program, adding: “If he can do so without returning to intense military fighting, that’s fine. Why not?” The prime minister indicated he would not present new information to “our good friend” Trump and instead would listen to “what he has in mind, because I think in many ways, it’s his decision.” But Netanyahu warned that if Iran again attacks Israel, directly or with armed proxies, “it will make a terrible mistake.” Source: AP The post US and Iran pause their attacks after days of escalation appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay xiisadda Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen
items.description: Indhaha dunida ayaa waxay ku sii jeedaan Badda Cas, ka dib markii ay dib u bilowdeen, isla-markaana ay cirka isku shareereen xiisadaha Boqortooyada Sacuudiga iyo Ururka Xuutiyiinta ee ka arrimiya inta badan dhulka Yemen. Xaaladdan cusub ayaa timid, ka dib markii Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ay go’doomin badeed ku soo rogeen Dekedaha Sacuudiga, isla-markaana ay maraakiibta boqortooyada ka mamnuuceen inay adeegsadaan Badda Cas iyo marinka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab El-Mandeb, iyadoona Sacuudigu uu sheegay inay qaadayaan dhammaan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah, si loo ilaaliyo maaakiibta ganacsiga. Xiisadda labada dhinac ayaa cirka isku shareertay, ka dib duqaymihii ay diyaaradaha dagaalka Sacuudiga habeenkii Jimcaha ka gaysteen Magaalada Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran ee Galbeedka Yemen iyo weeraradii daba socday ee ay Xuutiyiinta Sabtidii ku qaadeen xarumaha ay Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco ku leedahay Magaalooyinka Jizan iyo Yanbu ee dalkaasi Sacuudiga. Weeraradan ugu dambeeyay ayaa ka dhigan ballaaran cusub oo ku aaddan dagaalka Bariga Dhexe, iyadoo weerarada Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta ay carqaladeynayaan isu socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee Badda Cas iyo Bab El-Mandeb. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta oo saamayn togan ku leh Badda Cas iyo Marinka Bab El-Mandeb ayaa 20-kii bishan ka mamnuucay inay maraan maraakiibta Sacuudiga, taas oo Sacuudigu uu sheegay inaysan ogolaan doonin. Xiisaddan ayaa waxaa sal u ah weerar 13-kii bishan lagu qaaday Garoonka Diyaaradaha Sanca, taasoo ay Xuutiyiinta ku eedeeyeen inuu gaystay Sacuudiga. Duqayntan ayaa lagu hor istaagay diyaarad ay Iran leedahay oo ka degan rabtay garoonkaasi. Toddobaadkii xigay, taariikhdu markay ahayd 20-kii July, Xuutiyiinta ayaa ku dhawaaqay cunaqabatayn ka dhan ah Sacuudiga, oo lagu hor istaagayo maraakiibta ku sii jeeda dekedaha dalkaasi iyo kuwa kale ee ka imanaya. Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa Khamiistii sheegay in Ciidamada Yemen ay Arbacadii Badda Cas ku gubeen laba markab oo nooca shidaalka qaada ah, isla-markaana laga leeyahay Sacuudiga, wuxuuna sababta weerarka ku sheegay inay ku xadgudbeen cunaqabataynta badda ee ay ku soo rogeen dekedaha dalkaasi, tanina waxay keentay in Sacuudigu uu weerar xagga cirka ah ku qaado Magaalada Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran. Afhayeenka Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ee ka hawlgala Yemen, General Turki Al Maliki ayaa sheegay in duqaymahaasi lagu beegsaday kaabeyaasha militari ee Xuutiyiinta ku leeyihiin Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran, kuwaas oo uu sheegay in loo adeegsanayay in lagu khatar geliyo maraakiibta ganacsiga ee ku gooshaya Badda Cas. General Turki Al Maliki ayaa Xuutiyiinta ugu yeeray inay joojiyaan weerarada ka dhanka ah maraakiibta, haddii kalena ay kala kulmi doonaan cawaaqib daran. Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo aan dhageysanin digniintaasi ayaa saacado ka dib garaacay warshadaha wax soosaarka tamarta ee ku yaala Jizan iyo Yanbu. General Yahya Saree, Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Yemen ay bartilmaameedsadeen ilaha dhaqaalaha ee Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, iyadoo laga jawaabayo gardarrada Riyadh, oo uu ula jeedo duqaymihii laga gaystay Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran. General Yahya Saree ayaa ku hanjabay inay sii wadi doonaan weerarada ka dhanka ah Sacuudiga, illaa iyo inta uu ka joojinayo xadgudubyada ka dhanka ah muwaadiniinta Yemen iyo madaxbannaanida dalkaasi. Lama oga tallaabooyinka xiga ee Sacuudigu uu qaadi doono, oo noqon kara jawaab adag oo militari, xoojinta difaaca shidaalka iyo taageerada Dowladda Yemen amaba in ay heshiis nabadeed la galaan Xuutiyiinta. Khubarada dhanka militariga ayaa qaba in Sacuudigu uu noqon doono kan khasaaraha ugu weyn uu soo gaari doono, haddii uu go’aansado in dagaal buuxa lala galo Xuutiyiinta.

items.title: Puntland Accuses President Hassan Sheikh of Destabilization as Rift with Mogadishu Deepens
items.description: Garowe (WDN) – Puntland has sharply escalated its confrontation with Somalia’s Federal Government, accusing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of pursuing military activities that it says threaten the security, stability, and constitutional autonomy of the Puntland State. In a strongly worded statement issued, the Puntland administration alleged that the Federal Government is orchestrating military deployments inside Puntland without the consent of regional authorities, describing the moves as a direct challenge to Puntland’s governance and security institutions. The administration further declared that it does not recognize any security forces registered by the Federal Government within Puntland’s territory, insisting that no force identified as the Puntland Security Force (PSF) forms part of Puntland’s legally recognized security apparatus. The statement reflects the growing distrust that has come to define relations between Garowe and Mogadishu, with Puntland accusing the Federal Government of attempting to establish parallel military structures inside the state. Puntland also issued a warning to neighboring Galmudug State, urging its authorities not to allow their territory or airports to be used for the transfer of weapons, armed personnel, or militia forces that could contribute to the escalating tensions. As of publication, neither Somalia’s Federal Government nor the Galmudug administration had publicly responded to Puntland’s allegations. The latest accusations come in the aftermath of recent armed clashes in the Laag area between Puntland forces and fighters associated with the PSF, an incident that further exposed the increasingly fragile security environment in northeastern Somalia. The dispute unfolds against a backdrop of a much broader political crisis between Puntland and Mogadishu. The two sides remain deeply divided over constitutional amendments, the country’s electoral framework, the command and control of security forces, and the future balance of power within Somalia’s federal system. Political analysts warn that the continued breakdown in trust between the Federal Government and Puntland risks transforming political disagreements into recurring security confrontations. With negotiations over Somalia’s constitutional future and electoral process already deadlocked, observers fear that additional military disputes could further complicate efforts to restore national consensus and political stability. Whether the competing sides can reverse the growing atmosphere of suspicion through dialogue remains uncertain. For now, Puntland’s latest statement illustrates just how deeply relations between Garowe and Mogadishu have deteriorated, with security issues increasingly becoming another front in Somalia’s broader constitutional and political crisis. Political analysts warn that the continued breakdown in trust between the Federal Government and Puntland risks transforming political disagreements into recurring security confrontations. With negotiations over Somalia’s constitutional future and electoral process already deadlocked, observers fear that additional military disputes could further complicate efforts to restore national consensus and political stability. items.title: Golaha Wakiillada Waqooyi Bari oo amray in maxkamad la horkeeno xubnaha xiran ee kasoo jeddda Somaliland
items.description: Golaha Wakiillada Dowladda Waqooyi Bari ee Soomaaliya ayaa soo saaray go’aan rasmi ah oo ku taariikhaysan 26-ka Luulyo 2026, kaas oo ku saabsan habraaca sharci ee dadka u xiran dowladda. Goluhu wuxuu faray Xukuumadda Dowladda Waqooyi Bari inay si degdeg ah maxkamad awood u leh u horkeento dhammaan dadka ku xiran xabsiyada dowladda ee lagu eedeeyay dambiyada la xiriira amniga, argagixisada iyo dambiyada kale, si dacwadahooda loogu qaado si waafaqsan dastuurka iyo shuruucda dalka. Sidoo kale, Golaha Wakiilladu wuxuu adkeeyay in dacwadahaasi loo fuliyo si hufan, caddaalad ah, lana dhowro dhammaan xuquuqaha uu sharcigu dammaanad qaaday eedeysanayaasha inta uu socdo habraaca garsoorka. Golaha ayaa sheegay in go’aankan uu salka ku hayo ilaalinta caddaaladda, sareynta sharciga iyo dhowrista xuquuqda shacabka.

items.title: Sheekh Cali Wajiis: Saciid Deni waxaan leeyahay ha ku daba dhiman Imaaraadka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Sheekh Cali Maxamuud Xasan (Wajiis) oo kamid ah culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa ka hadlay arrimo ku aadan xaaladda Puntland oo haatan laga dareemayo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo iska soo horjeedo. Ugu horreyn Sheekh Cali Wajiis ayaa weerar afka ah ku qaaday Madaxweyne Saciid Deni, isaga oo ugu baaqay inuu ka haro Imaaraadka Carabta oo uu weli la leeyahay xiriir xooggan, xilli ay horay dalka uga cayrisay dowladda dhexe. Sheekha ayaa sheegay in Imaaraadka uu kusoo fashilmay dowladihii iyo ururradii uu horay xiriirka ula yeeshay, isla markaana siyaasad ahaan looga adkaaday dhammaan waddamadii uu ka howlgalay. “Walaalkey Saciid Deni waxaan leeyahay ha ku daba dhiman Imaaraad oo gabalkiisu dhacay oo Suudaan laga saaray, Liibiya laga saaray, Yemen laga saaray oo Suuriya laga saaray. Soomaaliyana waa laga saaraa,” ayuu wareysiga ku yiri Sheekha. Sidoo kale, wuxuu soo hadal qaaday dhaq-dhaqaaqa ciidan ee haatan u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka, isaga oo xusay in Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay xaq u leeyihiin inay ka howlgalaan magaalooyinka waa wayn maamulkaas iyo guud ahaan dalka. “Milatariga Soomaaliya Gaalkacyo ha joogaano ama Garoowe, Boosaaso iyo Xaafuun ha joogaane xaq waa u leeyihiin in dowladda Soomaaliya u tegto hub iyo rasaas siiso, ilaaliso jiritaankooda,” ayuu mar kale yiri Sheekh Cali Wajiis. Waxaa kale oo uu sii raaciyay “Yaan la weerarin milatariga yaan hub laga qaadanin oo dhibaato la gelin haloo aqoonsado ciidan qaran oo meesha jooga inuu yahay, wada-hadalkana hala galo oo siyaasiyiinta Garoowe ha’isugu tagaano ama Xamar ha isugu yimaadaano”. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo goor sii horreysay oo maanta ah ay Puntland soo saartay warsaxaafadeed ay ku eedeysay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, sidoo kalena loogu digay maamulka ay dariska yihiin ee Galmudug. Puntland ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu wado dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo lagu hurinayo colaado, laguna wiiqayo nidaamka dowladnimo ee Puntland, halka ay Galmudug ygu baaqday in aysan garoomadeeda diyaaradaha iyo dhulka ay maamusho u oggolaan in laga soo gudbiyo saanad ciidan, hub iyo maleeshiyaad ay Puntland sheegtay in loo adeegsan karo weerarro ama qalqal-gelin ka dhan ah deegaannadeeda. The post Sheekh Cali Wajiis: Saciid Deni waxaan leeyahay ha ku daba dhiman Imaaraadka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Waqooyi Bari oo qaaday tallaabo la xiriirta maxaabiista Somaliland iyo xildhibaanadi…
items.description: Laascaanood (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya ayaa maanta qaaday tallaabo culus oo la xiriirta maxaabiista Somaliland ee weli ku xiran magaalada Laascaanood iyo Xildhibaannadii xalay iska casilay Baarlamaanka maamulkaas, kadib warsaxaafadeed ay soo saareen. Xildhibaannadaas oo kala ah 1-Makhtal Siciid Maxamuud 2-Cabdisalaan Cabdillaahi Cabdiraxmaan 3-Sidiiq Jaamac Muuse 4-Axmed Cali Maxamed 5-Axmed Caabi Xasan, ayaa sheegay in maamulka uu ka leexday ujeeddooyinkii loo aasaasay, sidaas darteedna ay isaga casileen xububinnimadii golaha. Baarlamaanka Waqooyi Bari ayaa maanta kulan aan caadi ahayn ka yeeshay arrinta 5-ta Xildhibaan oo lagu eedeeyay qiyaano qaran, iyaga oo kadib ku sameeyay maamuus ka xayuubin, waxaana ogolaaday 57 Mudane oo ka tirsan Golaha, sida uu ku dhawaaqay guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka, Mudane Aadan Cabdullaahi Aw-Xasan. Sidoo kale, Xildhibaannada ayaa ka shiray sida laga yeelayo maxaabiista gacanta ku jirta ee laga qabtay Somaliland, intii uu socday dagaalkii ka dhacay magaalada Laascaanood ee uu dhiigga faraha badan ku daatay. Xildhibaan Maxamed Nuur oo ka tirsan Golaha Wakiilada Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya ayaa wareysi uu siiyay Telefishinka Universal ku faah-faahiyay kalankooda, wuxuuna farriin u diray shacabka oo uu ugu baaqay inay ilaashadaan midnimadooda, ayna muujiyaan feejignaan dheeri ah. “Waxaa saaka halkan ka dhacay kulan aan caadi ahayn oo ku saabsan Xildhibaanno aan saaxib ahayn oo hadda aaday dhankaas waqooyi galbeed (Somaliland) sida ay xoguhu sheegayaan, waxaan bulshada halkan uga soo jeedineynaa in Xildhibaan tegay labo iyo saddex aysan macno lahayn, laakiin bulshada ay muujiyaan feejignaan iyo deganaan,” ayuu yiri Maxamed Nuur. Sidoo kale, wuxuu Madaxweyne Firdhiye ugu baaqay inuu soo dhiso Maxkamadda Ciidamada, si maxaabiista loo soo saaro, looguna xisaabtamo dambiga ay galeen. “Maxaabiistu waa maxaabiis dagaal lagu qabtay, waana maxaabiistii magaaladan dhibaateysay oo wixii la ogaa gaystay. Madaxweynaha waxaan ugu baaqeynaa in Maxkamadda Ciidamada uu soo dhiso, si loo maxkamadeeyo ragga xiran,” ayuu mar kale yiri Xildhibaanku. Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya ayaa haatan waxaa kala furfur ku haysa Somaliland, iyada oo dhawaan ay tegtay Xildhibaan Fahiima Yuusuf Quuje oo maalmo kahor lagu soo dhaweeyay magaalada Hargeysa ee caasimada maamulkaasi.   The post Waqooyi Bari oo qaaday tallaabo la xiriirta maxaabiista Somaliland iyo xildhibaanadi… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: John Cena oo u tartamaya siduu u helo qaraxa nukliyeerka ee ‘Matchbox’
items.description: John Cena ayaa ku soo baxay filimkiisa cusub ee ‘Matchbox The Movie’ isagoo ah wakiil sir ah oo CIA ah, kaas oo saaxiibadiis ku tuulaya halis caalami ah kadib markii qarax nukliyeer uu lumo. Filimkan oo ay soo saartay Apple TV+, waxaa lagu soo bandhigay muqaalkiisa ugu horreeyay shirkii San Diego Comic-Con ee maalintii Sabtida, waxaanu si rasmi ah uga furmi doonaa Adeegga Apple TV+ bisha Oktoobar 9, 2026 . Filimkan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah wuxuu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo cusub oo ay Mattel Studios uga sii dhowaanayso soo saarista filimaan ku saleysan alaabteeda caanka ah, iyadoo la raacayo guushii weyneyd ee ‘Barbie’ ee 2023 . Filimkan waxaa agaasimay Sam Hargrave, oo caan ku ah filimada ‘Extraction’, waxaana qoray David Coggeshall . Sheekada filimku waxay ku saabsan tahay koox asxaab ah oo ku soo koraay wada ciyaarka baabuurta yaryar ee Matchbox, kuwaas oo markay weynaadaan ay ogaadaan in hoggaamiyihii hore, Sean (Cena), uu yahay wakiil sir ah oo CIA ah. Noloshiisa qarsoon ayaa kooxda ku tuulaysa howl caalami ah oo ay ku doonayaan inay badbaadiyaan adduunka kadib markii qarax nukliyeer uu lumo . Cena ayaa ku yidhi muqaalka: “Qarax nukliyeer ayaa lumay. CIA waxay u maleynaysaa inay aniga ihaayey – ama innaga.” Jessica Biel, oo jilaysa saaxiibadii hore, ayaa soo jeedisay qorshe aan fududayn: “Waxaan u baahanahay inaan dib u xanno bambaanada si aan u soo celinno nololihiinna” . Filimkan waxaa jilaya jilayaal caan ah oo ay ka mid yihiin Jessica Biel, Arturo Castro, Sam Richardson, Teyonah Parris, Danai Gurira, Golshifteh Farahani, Corey Stoll iyo Bill Camp . Waxaa soo saaray Skydance Media iyo Mattel Studios, waxaana soo saareyaal ka mid ah David Ellison, Dana Goldberg, Don Granger, Robbie Brenner, Ynon Kreiz iyo Jules Daly . The post John Cena oo u tartamaya siduu u helo qaraxa nukliyeerka ee ‘Matchbox’ first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Ukraine oo daandaansi ku bilowday Iraan kadibna…
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Ukraine ayaa saacadihii dambe ee Sabtidii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ku weerartay markab ganacsi oo ay leedahay Iiraan oo marayay biyaha xiran ee Caspian, wuxuuna weerarkan dhaliyay dhimashada hal badmaax ,halka mid kalena uu ku dhaawacmay, iyadoo weerarkan uu ka caraysiiyay Iiraan. Weerarka ka dib, Iiraan ayaa si adag u cambaaraysay. Waxaa lagu sheegay warsaxaafadeed maanta ka soo baxay wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Iiraan inaysan Iiraan gacmaha laaban doonin oo ay ka jawaabi doonto. Sidoo kale, waxay wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Iiraan u yeertay madaxa ergada siyaasadeed ee Ukraine u fadhiya Tehran. Illaa hadda Ukraine kama aysan hadlin sababta ay u fulisay weerarkan. Muxuu muhiim ugu yahay Iiraan marinka Caspian? Badda Caspian waa biyaha ugu waaweyn adduunka ee xiran oo aan bad kale ku xirnayn. Inkastoo loogu yeero bad, hadana waxaa loo aqoonsanyahay haro aad u weyn oo cusbo leh. Waxay ku taallaa inta u dhaxaysa Yurub iyo Aasiya, waxaana ku hareeraysan shan dal, Ruushka oo kaga yeel jihada waqooyi-galbeed, Kazakhstan (waqooyi-bari),Turkmenistan (koonfur-bari) ,Iiraan (koonfur) iyo Azerbaijan (galbeed). Badda Caspian waxay leedahay muhiimad istiraatiiji ah oo aad u weyn,sababtoo ah waa marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga u dhexeeya Ruushka, Bartamaha Aasiya iyo Iiraan. items.title: Puntland Declares PSF Has No Legal Status as Rift Over Security Forces Deepens
items.description: Garowe (WDN) – Puntland’s Presidency has issued a categorical declaration that no security force operating under the name Puntland Security Force (PSF) has any legal status within the state’s official defense structure, underscoring the widening political and military rift over competing chains of command inside the region. In a statement released late Tuesday, the Puntland administration sought to end growing public debate over the force’s legal standing. “The Puntland Government clarifies that there is no force known as the PSF that legally forms part of Puntland’s defense forces,” the presidential statement said. The declaration comes amid heightened tensions following recent armed confrontations between Puntland security forces and fighters identifying themselves as PSF, the latest of which erupted last week in the Laag area near Bosaso. Contradicting Local Elders The Presidency’s statement directly contradicts a declaration issued a day earlier by several respected elders from Mudug, Galkacyo region (the Osman Mahmoud clan), who insisted that the PSF remains a legitimate component of Puntland’s security institutions. The elders also announced that they were mediating between President Said Abdullahi Deni and the PSF leadership in an effort to prevent further clashes and restore dialogue. The conflicting statements have highlighted the deep divisions surrounding the future of the force and the broader security architecture of Puntland. The controversy dates back to November 24, 2021, when President Deni dismissed then-PSF commander Gen. Mohamud Osman Diyaano following a bitter power struggle that triggered one of Puntland’s most serious internal security crises. Several months later, in March 2022, Deni reorganized the force by appointing Diyaano to lead the newly established Puntland Security Commando Forces (PSCF) while restructuring the broader security apparatus into separate formations, including the Puntland Intelligence and Special Forces (PISF). Despite those reforms, disagreements over command, legitimacy, and operational authority have continued to fuel recurring confrontations. Security Tensions Escalate The Puntland government and fighters operating under the PSF banner have clashed on multiple occasions over the past several years. Their latest confrontation in Laag once again exposed the fragile security environment and the unresolved dispute over who has the legal authority to command armed forces within Puntland. Political observers warn that the Presidency’s latest declaration is likely to deepen an already polarized debate, particularly as influential clan elders continue to advocate dialogue while government officials insist that only state-recognized security institutions can legally operate inside Puntland. With trust between the rival sides deteriorating and security tensions remaining high, analysts caution that resolving the dispute will require more than military measures. A lasting settlement, they argue, will depend on a political agreement capable of addressing the competing claims of legitimacy that continue to divide Puntland’s security establishment. items.title: Renewed Clan Fighting Erupts in Sanaag as Peace Efforts Continue to Falter
items.description: Erigavo (WDN) – Fresh clan fighting erupted on Tuesday in the Laashimo area near Erigavo in Somalia’s Sanaag region, underscoring the persistence of a conflict that has repeatedly defied mediation efforts and left communities trapped in an apparently endless cycle of violence. According to local reports, the latest clashes resulted in deaths and injuries, although the exact casualty figures have not yet been independently verified. The renewed fighting comes only days after Puntland authorities withdrew security forces that had been stationed in the area, where they had been positioned between militias from the two rival clans in an effort to prevent further bloodshed. The timing of the withdrawal has raised fresh concerns about the fragile security situation in the region, with fears that the absence of a neutral security presence may have contributed to the rapid resurgence of hostilities. A member of the Puntland Parliament appealed to both sides to immediately halt the fighting and embrace dialogue, warning that continued violence would only deepen the suffering of local communities and further destabilize the region. The conflict in Laashimo is the latest chapter in a long-running series of clan confrontations that have repeatedly erupted despite numerous reconciliation initiatives. Residents say each new outbreak not only claims lives but also displaces families, disrupts livelihoods, and deepens mistrust between neighboring communities. Puntland authorities and traditional elders have increasingly faced criticism from local residents and community leaders, who argue that efforts to secure a lasting political and traditional settlement have fallen short. Critics say temporary ceasefires have repeatedly collapsed because the underlying grievances driving the conflict remain unresolved. As the latest violence unfolds, many residents fear that without a comprehensive reconciliation process backed by sustained security guarantees, the cycle of retaliation will continue, leaving the Sanaag region vulnerable to further instability. With no confirmed breakthrough in mediation efforts and both communities remaining heavily armed, the prospects for lasting peace remain uncertain, reinforcing concerns that one of Puntland’s most persistent clan conflicts is far from over. items.title: Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Ilaalinta Nidaamdegaaneedka Mangaroofka
items.description: Sannad kasta 26ka Luulyo, dunidu waxay xustaa Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Ilaalinta Nidaamdegaaneedka Mangaroofka . Maalintan waxaa sannadkii 2015 si rasmi ah u ansixisay hay’adda UNESCO, si kor loogu qaado wacyiga caalamiga ah ee ku saabsan muhiimadda kaymaha mangaroofka iyo baahida loo qabo ilaalintooda. Mangaroofku wuxuu ka mid yahay nidaamdegaaneedyada xeebaha ugu qiimaha badan dunida. Inkasta oo kaymahani ay daboolaan qeyb yar oo ka mid ah oogada dhulka, haddana doorka ay ku leeyihiin ilaalinta xeebaha, kaydinta kaarboonka, kobcinta noolaha badda iyo taageeridda nololmaalmeedka bulshooyinka xeebaha waa mid aad u ballaaran. Dhanka kale, mangaroofku wuxuu ka mid yahay nidaamdegaaneedyada sida weyn khatarta u wajahaya, maadaama jarista dhirta, ballaarinta magaalooyinka xeebaha, wasakhowga hawada, daaqsinka xoolaha iyo isbeddelka cimiladu ay faro ba’an ku hayaan. Waa maxay mangaroofku? Mangaroofku waa geedo iyo dhir gaagaaban oo ka baxa xeebaha ku yaalla dhulka kulaylaha iyo kulaylxigeenka ah. Waxaa badanaa laga helaa dhulka dhoobada ah ee ay biyaha baddu ku soo noqnoqdaan iyo meelaha ay ku kulmaan biyaha macaan iyo biyaha cusbadu. Soomaalidu mangaroofka waxay mararka qaarkood u taqaannaa geedaha badda ama kaymaha xeebaha . Dhirtaasi waxay leedahay astaamo gaar ah oo u suurageliya inay ku noolaato biyaha cusbada leh, dhulka jilicsan iyo ciidda ay ogsajiintu ku yar tahay. Qaar ka mid ah geedaha mangaroofku waxay leeyihiin xididdo ciidda kor uga soo baxa, kuwaas oo geedka ka caawiya inuu hawada ka helo ogsajiin. Xididdadaas waxaa cilmi ahaan loo yaqaannaa pneumatophores , waxaana af Soomaali ahaan lagu tilmaami karaa xididdidda neefsashada . Xididdadu waxay sidoo kale geedka ku sugaan dhulka dhoobada ah ee jilicsan, waxayna qabtaan ciidda iyo walxaha biyuhu sidaan. Sidaas awgeed, mangaroofku wuxuu yareeyaa nabaadguurka xeebaha, wuxuuna ka qeybqaataa samaysanka iyo xasilloonida dhulka xeebaha. Sida mangaroofku ula qabsado biyaha cusbada leh Astaamaha ugu muhiimsan ee mangaroofka waxaa ka mid ah awoodda uu ugu adkaysto cusbada biyaha badda. Noocyada qaar waxay cusbada ka reebaan biyaha inta aysan xididdadu nuugin, halka kuwo kalena ay cusbada caleemaha ka saaraan. Hababkaas dabiiciga ahi waxay dhirta u suurageliyaan inay ku noolaato meelo aysan dhirta badankeedu ku kori karin. Noocyada mangaroofka ee laga helo xeebaha Bariga Afrika waxaa ka mid ah: Avicennia marina ; Rhizophora mucronata ; Ceriops tagal ; Sonneratia alba . Noocyadani waxay ku kala duwan yihiin qaabka xididdada, heerka ay cusbada ugu adkaysan karaan iyo goobaha ay kaga baxaan xeebaha. Hoyga iyo goobta taranka noolaha badda Kaymaha mangaroofku waa hoy, goob taran iyo meel ay ku koraan noocyo badan oo kalluun, carsaanyo, haley, shimbiro iyo nooleyaal kale. Xididdada isku dhex yaacsan ee geeduhu waxay kalluunka yaryar iyo noolaha kale ka ilaaliyaan ugaarsadayaasha, waxayna siiyaan meel ammaan ah oo ay ku koraan inta aysan u gudbin biyaha furan. Caleemaha iyo laamaha mangaroofka ee dhaca waxaa burburiya bakteeriyo, fangas iyo nooleyaal kale oo aad u yaryar. Walxahaas burburay waxay isu beddelaan nafaqo ay ka faa’iidaystaan kalluunka iyo noolaha kale ee badda. Sidaas awgeed, mangaroofku wuxuu qeyb weyn ka qaataa silsiladda cuntada ee degaannada xeebaha, wuxuuna taageeraa waxsoosaarka kalluumaysiga. Burburka kaymaha mangaroofku wuxuu keeni karaa yaraanshaha kalluunka, hoos u dhaca kala-duwanaanta noolaha iyo dhaawac ku yimaadda nololmaalmeedka bulshooyinka ku tiirsan kheyraadka badda. Gaashaanka dabiiciga ah ee xeebaha Faa’iidooyinka ugu waaweyn ee mangaroofka waxaa ka mid ah ilaalinta xeebaha. Xididdada, jirridda iyo laamaha cufan ee dhirtu waxay yareeyaan xoogga hirarka, waxay qabtaan ciidda, waxayna hoos u dhigaan nabaadguurka xeebaha. Kaymaha mangaroofku waxay sidoo kale yareyn karaan saamaynta duufaannada, daadadka xeebaha iyo hirarka xooggan. Mangaroofku si buuxda uma joojin karo masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah, hasayeeshee wuxuu si weyn u dhimi karaa awoodda biyaha iyo khasaaraha ka dhalan kara. Bulshooyinka deggan xeebaha ay kaymahani ku dhow yihiin waxay ka helaan difaac dabiici ah oo yareeya halista ku timaadda guryaha, kaabayaasha dhaqaale iyo beeraha ku dhow xeebaha. Kaydka Kaarboonka Buluugga ah Mangaroofku wuxuu ka mid yahay nidaamdegaaneedyada sida weyn u kaydiya kaarboonka. Kaarboonka ku kaydsan dhirta, xididdada iyo ciidda xeebaha waxaa loo yaqaannaa Kaarboonka Buluugga ah ama Blue Carbon . Qeybta ugu badan ee kaarboonka mangaroofku waxay ku kaydsan tahay ciidda qoyan ee ka hoosaysa dhirta. Ciiddaas waxaa ku urura caleemo, laamo iyo walxo dabiici ah oo si gaabis ah u burbura. Marka kaymaha mangaroofka la jaro ama la burburiyo, kaarboonkii ku kaydsanaa dhirta iyo ciidda ayaa hawada ku sii dayn kara gaasaska kululeeya cimilada. Sidaas darteed, ilaalinta mangaroofku waxay qeyb ka tahay dadaallada lagu yareynayo saamaynta isbeddelka cimilada. Khataraha haysta mangaroofka Tobannaankii sano ee u dambeeyay, kaymaha mangaroofka ee dunidu waxay wajahayeen xaalufin iyo hoos u dhac ka dhashay hawlaha aadanaha iyo isbeddellada dabiiciga ah. Waxyaabaha ugu waaweyn ee khatarta ku haya waxaa ka mid ah: jarista dhirta si looga dhigto dhuxul, xaabo iyo qalabka dhismaha; ballaarinta magaalooyinka iyo dhismayaasha xeebaha; beddelidda kaymaha oo laga sameeyo beero ama xarumo ganacsi; wasakhowga badda iyo daadinta qashinka; qodista ciidda iyo burburinta dhulka xeebaha; daaqsinka xoolaha; kor u kaca heerka badda; abaaraha iyo isbeddelka cimilada. Marka mangaroofka la waayo, xeebuhu waxay u nuglaadaan nabaadguur, daadad iyo hirar xooggan, halka kalluunka iyo noolaha kale ee badduna ay waayaan goobihii ay ku tarmeen kuna koreen. Muhiimadda dhaqaale iyo bulsho Faa’iidooyinka mangaroofku kuma koobna ilaalinta degaanka oo keliya. Kaymahani waxay si toos iyo si dadbanba u taageeraan dhaqaalaha bulshooyinka xeebaha. Kalluumaysatada waxay ka faa’iidaystaan kalluunka iyo noolaha kale ee ku tarma mangaroofka. Bulshooyinka qaarkoodna waxay kaymaha ka helaan malab, dawooyin dhaqameed iyo kheyraad kale oo dabiici ah. Mangaroofku wuxuu sidoo kale dhiirrigelin karaa dalxiiska dabiiciga ah, daawashada shimbiraha, cilmibaarista iyo waxbarashada ku saabsan noolaha badda. Hasayeeshee, ka faa’iidaysiga kheyraadka mangaroofka waa inuu noqdaa mid qorshaysan oo waara, si aan loo dhaawicin awoodda uu nidaamku isku cusboonaysiin karo. Mangaroofka Soomaaliya Soomaaliya waxay leedahay xeebta ugu dheer dhulweynaha Afrika, taas oo ku teedsan Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Qeybo ka mid ah xeebahaas waxaa laga helaa kaymo mangaroof ah. Degaannada ugu waaweyn ee mangaroofka Soomaaliya laga helo waxaa ka mid ah Jubbada Hoose, gaar ahaan aagga Jasiiradaha Bajuni, Kismaayo iyo afka Wabiga Jubba. Degaannadaas waxaa laga helaa kaymo cufan oo qaarkood gaara dherer u dhexeeya 10 iyo 15 mitir. Mangaroofka waxaa sidoo kale laga helaa qeybo ka mid ah xeebaha waqooyi iyo waqooyigalbeed, sida: Saylac iyo Jasiiradaha Sacadadiin; Berbera; Caluula; Xaabo; Boosaaso; qeybo kale oo ka tirsan xeebaha Gacanka Cadmeed. Qiyaaso kaladuwan ayaa muujinaya in baaxadda kaymaha mangaroofka Soomaaliya ay tahay dhawr iyo afartan kiiloomitir oo labajibbaaran. Hasayeeshee, cabbirka saxda ahi wuxuu u baahan yahay sahanno dhuleed iyo sawirro dayaxgacmeed oo si joogto ah loo cusboonaysiiyo. Waxaa jira calaamado muujinaya in qeybo ka mid ah kaymaha mangaroofku ay hoos u dhaceen sannadihii u dambeeyay, sababo la xiriira jarista dhirta, ballaarinta degaannada, daaqsinka xoolaha iyo isbeddellada ku dhacay xeebaha. Kormeerka mangaroofka Soomaaliya Hay’adda FAO-SWALIM iyo hay’ado kale ayaa Soomaaliya ka sameeyay daraasado iyo khariidado lagu ogaanayo goobaha mangaroofku ka baxo iyo xaaladda kaymaha xeebaha. Sannadihii dambe, waxaa kordhay adeegsiga sawirrada dayax-gacmeedka iyo farsamada dareemidda fog. Farsamooyinkaas waxaa lagu ogaan karaa cufnaanta dhirta, xaalufka kaymaha iyo isbeddellada ku dhaca degaannada xeebaha. Waxaa muhiim ah in lala socodsiiyo sahanno dhuleed, xog laga helo bulshada degaanka iyo daraasado lagu baarayo noocyada dhirta iyo noolaha ku tiirsan. Jarista geedaha si looga dhigto dhuxul, xaabo iyo qalabka dhismaha ayaa ka mid ah khataraha ugu waaweyn. Dhismaha guryaha iyo xarumaha ganacsi ee laga sameeyo agagaarka xeebaha ayaa, sidoo kale, ciriirinaya goobihii dabiiciga ahaa ee mangaroofku ku fidi lahaa. Burburkii dawladdii dhexe ka dib, awooddii lagu ilaalin lahaa kheyraadka dabiiciga ah way daciiftay, taas oo sahashay jarista sharcidarrada ah iyo ka faa’iidaysiga aan qorshaysnayn ee kaymaha xeebaha. Daaqsinka xoolaha, gaar ahaan geela iyo lo’da, ayaa isaguna dhaawici kara caleemaha iyo geedaha yaryar ee mangaroofka, gaar ahaan xilliyada abaarta iyo jilaalka. Wasakhowga badda, qashinka magaalooyinka iyo saliidaha ku daata xeebaha ayaa sidoo kale khatar ku ah dhirta iyo noolaha ku dhex jira mangaroofka. Kor u kaca heerka badda, kulaylka sii kordhaya iyo isbeddelka roobabku waxay mustaqbalka caqabad dheeraad ah ku noqon karaan kaymaha mangaroofka Soomaaliya. Dadaallada ilaalinta Qaar ka mid ah maamullada, hay’adaha iyo bulshooyinka degaannada xeebaha ayaa bilaabay dadaallo lagu ilaalinayo mangaroofka. Degaannada qaarkood waxaa laga sameeyay wacyigelin ku saabsan joojinta jarista dhirta, xaddididda daaqsinka xoolaha iyo ilaalinta meelaha mangaroofku ka soo kabanayo. Hasayeeshee, dadaalladaasi waxay u baahan yihiin sharciyo cad, dhaqaale, shaqaale tababaran iyo kaqeybgal joogto ah oo bulshada degaanka ah. Maxaa la gudboon Soomaaliya? Ilaalinta mangaroofku waxay u baahan tahay qorshe qaran oo isku xiraya Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya, dawladgoboleedyada, maamullada degaannada, bulshada xeebaha, jaamacadaha, cilmibaarayaasha iyo ururrada ka shaqeeya ilaalinta degaanka. Waxaa muhiim ah in: la diyaariyo sharciyo cad oo lagu ilaalinayo kaymaha mangaroofka; la mamnuuco jarista sharcidarrada ah; la xoojiyo kormeerka iyo isla xisaabtanka; bulshada degaanka lagu daro maamulka kaymaha; la abuuro ilo nololmaalmeed oo beddel u noqda jarista dhirta; dib loogu beero meelaha mangaroofku ka xaalufay; la xaddido dhismayaasha laga samaynayo goobaha nugul ee xeebaha; la kordhiyo cilmibaarista iyo khariidaynta kaymaha; la sameeyo keyd xogeed qaran oo lagu diiwaangeliyo xaaladda mangaroofka; la wacyigeliyo kalluumaysatada, xooladhaqatada, dhallinyarada iyo ardayda; la xoojiyo iskaashiga hay’adaha dawladda iyo bulshada. Dib-u-beerista mangaroofku waa inay ku salaysnaataa daraasad cilmiyeed. Ma aha in geedo si aan qorshaysnayn loogu beero meel kasta oo xeeb ah, balse waa in la doortaa noocyada ku habboon goobta, lana tixgeliyaa socodka biyaha, cusbada, ciidda iyo xaaladaha dabiiciga ah. Gunaanad Ilaalinta mangaroofku ma aha oo keliya badbaadinta geedo ka baxa xeebaha. Waa ilaalinta kalluunka, noolaha badda, dhaqaalaha bulshooyinka xeebaha, badqabka magaalooyinka iyo awoodda Soomaaliya ay ugu adkaysan karto isbeddelka cimilada. Kaymaha mangaroofku waxay qabtaan hawlo aad uga weyn baaxadda dhulka ay ku fadhiyaan. Waxay xoojiyaan xeebaha, kaydiyaan kaarboonka, hoy u noqdaan nooleyaal badan, waxayna taageeraan nololmaalmeedka kumannaan qof. Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Ilaalinta Nidaamdegaaneedka Mangaroofku waxay ina xusuusinaysaa in ilaalinta kaymahani ay tahay masuuliyad wada saaran dawladda, bulshada, ganacsatada iyo jiil kasta oo Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Confusion Deepens as Five Lawmakers Resign from Northeast Parliament Amid Mystery Over Missing Legislators
items.description: LasAnod (WDN) – Political uncertainty has deepened inside the Parliament of the Northeast administration after five lawmakers announced their resignation following hours of confusion surrounding the whereabouts of several members of the regional legislature. In a joint statement released after prolonged uncertainty gripped the parliament, the five legislators confirmed they had resigned from their parliamentary seats. However, they did not disclose their next political destination or clarify whether they intended to align themselves with either Puntland or Somaliland, leaving observers speculating about the motives behind their decision. The resignations came against the backdrop of an extraordinary situation inside the regional assembly. Earlier, the leadership of the House issued a public notice seeking information on the whereabouts of several lawmakers whose locations and means of contact had reportedly become unknown. The parliamentary leadership called on the missing members to make contact and disclose their whereabouts within 12 hours. The unusual appeal underscored the level of uncertainty engulfing the legislature, raising fresh questions about internal divisions and the cohesion of the fledgling administration. Political observers say the simultaneous disappearance of several lawmakers and the resignation of others points to growing instability within the Northeast political leadership at a time when the administration continues to navigate complex relations with both Puntland and Somaliland. Neither the parliamentary leadership nor the departing lawmakers have publicly explained the circumstances surrounding the disappearances or the reasons behind the resignations. As speculation intensifies, analysts warn that the episode could signal a broader political realignment within the region, although the ultimate destination and political intentions of the departing legislators remain unclear. For now, the unexplained resignations and the search for missing lawmakers have added another layer of uncertainty to an already fragile political landscape, leaving many unanswered questions about the future direction of the Northeast administration. items.description: Tartanka loogu jiro xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa galay marxalad cusub, kaddib markii ay kusoo hareen laba musharrax oo kala ah Wasiiru Dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Sadaad Caliyow iyo Wasiirka Dekeddaha Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur Jaamac. Dhanka kale, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Cabdisalaan Dhay ayaa la sheegay inuu ka haray tartanka. Labada musharrax ee ku haray loollanka ayaa lagu tilmaamaa siyaasiyiin saameyn ku leh xiriirka Villa Soomaaliya, taasoo ka dhigeysa tartanka mid si weyn isha loogu hayo maadaama labada dhinacba ay leeyihiin taageero siyaasadeed oo muuqata. Doorashadan ayaa timid kaddib markii Guddoomiyihii hore ee Golaha Shacabka loo doortay Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, taasoo sababtay in la buuxiyo jagada bannaan. Waxaa la filayaa in maalmaha soo socda ay sii xoogaystaan ololayaasha iyo dadaallada lagu kasbanayo taageerada xubnaha Golaha Shacabka, iyadoo natiijada doorashadu saameyn ku yeelan karto jihada siyaasadda dalka iyo wada shaqeynta hay’adaha dowladda.

items.title: South West’s Political Gamble: Can Reconciliation Succeed While an Insurgency Continues?
items.description: Baidoa (WDN) – South West State news President Aden Mohamed Nur (Aden Madoobe) has launched what appears to be a broad political reconciliation initiative aimed at easing divisions in the region. However, critics argue that the effort overlooks a central reality: military control alone has not ended the insurgency that has repeatedly challenged government authority around Baidoa. Since federal-backed forces assumed control of South West State in May 2026, fighters aligned with former President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen have mounted repeated attacks on Baidoa and surrounding areas, underscoring the resilience of the armed movement despite the government’s military presence. The latest reconciliation initiative seeks to bring together traditional elders, politicians, and community representatives from across South West State. Officials say the goal is to reduce political tensions, promote dialogue among rival clans, and bridge differences over the contentious political transition that brought the current administration to power. Supporters view the initiative as an opportunity to foster unity and stabilize the region. Critics, however, question whether meaningful reconciliation is possible if key political stakeholders remain absent from the process. Opponents argue that many of the figures expected to participate do not represent the principal political forces challenging the current administration. Without the participation of influential opposition leaders and those aligned with Laftagareen, they contend, the dialogue risks being viewed as symbolic rather than genuinely inclusive. The continuing insurgency has reinforced those concerns. Despite repeated military operations and the deployment of federal forces, Laftagareen-aligned fighters have continued launching attacks on Baidoa since the conflict escalated earlier this year. Analysts note that the persistence of these operations suggests the movement retains both operational capability and local support in parts of the region. For many observers, this illustrates a broader lesson drawn from insurgencies around the world: military superiority does not necessarily translate into lasting political control. While conventional forces may secure towns and strategic installations, insurgent movements often adapt by relying on mobility, local networks, and prolonged campaigns of attrition. That reality has become increasingly apparent in Bay Region, where recurring attacks continue despite the government’s efforts to consolidate its authority. Political analysts argue that lasting stability is unlikely to be achieved through security measures alone. Instead, they say, any durable settlement will require a political process that is widely regarded as inclusive, credible, and capable of addressing the grievances driving the conflict. As South West State embarks on its latest reconciliation initiative, the central question remains whether dialogue can succeed without the participation of the movement that continues to challenge government authority on the battlefield. Until that question is answered, many observers believe the conflict is likely to remain both a political and military contest—one in which control of territory alone may not determine the ultimate outcome. items.title: Trumpfying the World: A Critical Look at Global Politics and American Influence
items.description: By Awes Osman Throughout history, humanity’s pursuit of survival has often driven conflict and power struggles. Wars are rarely accidental; they are meticulously planned and executed, with nations vying for dominance and resources. Each century leaves its mark through its unique geopolitical struggles. In the 19th century, Europe underwent a significant transformation. The continent capitalized on the industrial revolution, expanding aggressively through colonization and exploiting the resources and labor of other nations. Colonial powers competed fiercely for territories, leading to conflicts over the control of colonies. The 1884 Berlin Conference marked a pivotal moment with the partition of Africa, where European nations agreed to divide the continent among themselves. However, this agreement was short-lived as greed and ambition fueled subsequent conflicts over territorial disputes, igniting wars among colonial powers. These divisions and conflicts inspired African nations to question their subjugation. The fight for independence gained momentum in the mid-20th century, culminating in the decolonization wave of the 1960s. African leaders and martyrs fought not only for sovereignty but also for the right to harness their natural resources and improve their peoples’ lives. In every nation, groups vying for power seek control to achieve better living conditions. Similarly, U.S. President Donald Trump’s “America First” policy underscores a focus on national interests, emphasizing economic strength and superiority. His approach marked a departure from traditional diplomatic norms, making it clear that he prioritized American interests—often intertwined with his personal business ventures—above global or moral considerations. This shift has significant implications. Trump’s policies have fostered a more materialistic and less humanitarian approach to international relations. His administration’s withdrawal from global aid agencies like UNICEF, UNDP, and UNHCR, coupled with reduced contributions to international organizations, threatens to destabilize global cooperation and potentially spark new conflicts. Furthermore, Trump’s background as a businessman raises concerns about conflicts of interest, where personal financial gains may influence national policy. Such a focus on economic and financial interests, often at the expense of humanitarian and environmental issues, marks a stark contrast to previous American administrations that balanced national priorities with global responsibility. This new approach has profound consequences. It risks undermining long-term American influence and damaging international relations. The rise of nationalist and far-right movements in Europe, emboldened by similar policies, has led to increased hostility toward refugees and minority groups. If this trend continues, the world edges closer to a potential new global conflict. The danger lies in allowing these policies—what some might call “trumpfying”—to escalate unchecked. To avoid a future marked by increased conflict and global instability, it is crucial to reconsider the balance between national interests and global humanitarian responsibilities. The world must act swiftly to prevent the destructive path of “trumpfying” from leading us into another devastating world war. Only through renewed commitment to diplomacy, cooperation, and moral responsibility can we hope to build a more stable and equitable future for all. items.title: Turkey Launches a Fisheries Project at the Port of Mogadishu
items.description: The Mogadishu Port Authority has held a meeting with a delegation from the Turkish government and major fishing companies to discuss accelerating the implementation of the fisheries project previously agreed upon by the two countries. The delegation also toured various sections of the Mogadishu Port to assess the infrastructure needed for this project, which is crucial for the country’s economic development. This meeting is significant as it represents a new step by the Somali government toward implementing previously signed agreements between the two nations. The delegation visited the Mogadishu Port to evaluate existing infrastructure and identify requirements for the project’s implementation. The meeting was attended by officials from the Port Authority and fishing companies. Although further details about the discussions have not been disclosed, the project is expected to significantly boost Somalia’s economy, particularly in the fisheries sector one of the country’s most important natural resources. The delegation’s visit is part of Turkey’s ongoing efforts to strengthen cooperation with Somalia across various sectors, including economy, security, and infrastructure development. items.title: Turkiga oo Dekedda Muqdisho kawada mashruuca kalluumeysi
items.description: Maamulka Dekedda Muqdisho ayaa kulan la yeeshay wafdi ka socday Dowladda Turkiga iyo shirkado waaweyn oo ka shaqeeya kalluumeysiga, iyagoo ka wadahadlay sidii loo dardargelin lahaa hirgelinta mashruuca kalluumeysiga ee ay hore ugu heshiiyeen labada dal. Wafdiga ayaa sidoo kale booqday qaybaha kala duwan ee Dekedda Muqdisho si ay u qiimeeyaan kaabeyaasha lagu fulin doono mashruucan muhiimka u ah horumarka dhaqaalaha dalka. Kulankan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo cusub oo ay Dowladda Soomaaliya uga sii dhowaanayso dhaqangelinta heshiisyadii horay looga soo saaray iskaashiga labada dal. Wafdigan ayaa booqday Dekedda Muqdisho si ay u qiimeeyaan kaabayaasha jira iyo waxyaabaha looga baahan yahay si loo hirgeliyo mashruuca, waxaana kulanka ka soo qaybgalay mas’uuliyiin ka socota Maamulka Dekedda iyo shirkadaha kalluumeysiga. Inkasta oo aan la helin faahfaahin dheeri ah oo ku saabsan waxyaabaha laga wadahadlay kulanka, haddana waxaa la filayaa in mashruucani uu kaalmo weyn ku yeesho horumarinta dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinaca kalluumeysiga oo ah mid ka mid ah khayraadka ugu muhiimsan ee dalka. Booqashada wafdiga ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada Dowladda Turkiga ee lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga ay la leedahay Soomaaliya dhinacyada kala duwan, oo ay ku jiraan dhaqaalaha, amniga, iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha. The post Turkiga oo Dekedda Muqdisho kawada mashruuca kalluumeysi first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Qaali Cali Shire: Nabadda Gaalkacyo DENI uma taallo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xidhibaan Qaali Cali Shire oo ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya ayaa ka jawaabtay warsaxaafadeedka kasoo baxay Puntland ee lagu eedeeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, sidoo kalena loogu digay maamulka ay dariska yihiin ee Galmudug. Puntland ayaa ku eedeysay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud inuu wado dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo lagu hurinayo colaado, laguna wiiqayo nidaamka dowladnimo ee Puntland, iyadoo sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo maalmihii u dambeeyey ka socday qaybo ka mid ah deegaannadeeda iyo meelaha ku dhow. Sidoo kale, Puntland a yaa digniin gaar ah u dirtay maamulka Galmudug, oo ay xuduud dheer la wadaagto, gaar ahaan gobolka Mudug oo magaalada Gaalkacyo ay labada maamul kala maamulaan. Waxay Galmudug ugu baaqday in aysan garoomadeeda diyaaradaha iyo dhulka ay maamusho u oggolaan in laga soo gudbiyo saanad ciidan, hub iyo maleeshiyaad ay Puntland sheegtay in loo adeegsan karo weerarro ama qalqal-gelin ka dhan ah deegaannadeeda. Intaas kadib waxaa iyana qoraal soo saartay Xildhibaan Qaali Cali Shire oo laga soo doortay Galmudug, waxaana ay jawaab siisay Puntland, iyada oo sheegtay in nabadda Gaalkacyo uusan shaqo ku lahayn Madaxweyne Saciid Cabdullahi Maxamed (Deni), isla markaana aan waxba laga waydiin doonin. “Nabadda Gaalkacyo ma aha arrin laga waraysanayo Madaxweyne Dani iyo cid kasta oo la halmaasha, ee waa mid u taalla dadka degaanka wadaagga ah ee reer Gaalkacyo. Sidoo kale, ma aha mid si gaar ah ay uga shaqeeyeen Galmudug iyo Puntland, balse waa guul ka dhalatay dadaalka iyo is-afgaradka ay muujiyeen beelaha walaalaha ah ee deegaanka wada dega,” ayay tiri Qaali. Sidoo kale waxa ay beenisay eedda kasoo yeertay Puntland ee ku aadan hubka ay sheegtay in lasoo dhex-mariyo deegaannada Galmudug. “Dhanka kale, diyaaraddii caanaha booraha noo keeni jirtay ayaad xitaa ku tilmaantay inay rasaas waddo. Fadhiyadii iyo alaabtii aan Jawaanada ku keenayna waxeey kuula ekadeen rasaas. Arrintaasi ma waafaqsana xaqiiqada,” ayay mar kale tiri Xildhibaannaddu. Waxaa kale oo ay sii raacisay “Waxa halkaas ka muuqda inuu ku dhibayo waa in doorasho heer federaal ah lagu qabto deegaankaas. Hase yeeshee, waxa maanta ka jira waa isfahan iyo wadajir, ee ku soco”. Ugu dambeyn waxay qoraalkeeda kusoo gabagabeysay farriin ay dirtay shacabka Galmudug oo ay ugu baaqday inay gacmaha is qabsadaan. “Dadka degaankaas gacmaha ayay is haystaan. Sidaas darteed, hadallo horseedi kara colaad ama kala fogeyn looma baahna. Dabadeedna in la yiraahdo “hawiyaa igu soo duulay” wax xal ah ma keenayso, ee waxay sii fogeynaysaa isfahamka. Nabaddaa naas la nuugo leh; ilaalinteeduna waa waajib qof walba saaran”. The post Qaali Cali Shire: Nabadda Gaalkacyo DENI uma taallo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Afrika oo wajahaysa khasaare dhaqaale oo gaaraya $10–20 bilyan sababo la xiriira El Niño xooggan
items.description: Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika (AfDB) ayaa ka digay in ifafaalaha cimilo ee loo yaqaan “Super El Niño” uu sababi karo khasaare dhaqaale oo u dhexeeya $10 bilyan illaa $20 bilyan dalalka Afrika ee sida weyn u saameyn doona, iyadoo sidoo kale la filayo inuu horseedo barakac ballaaran iyo dhibaatooyin bani’aadamnimo. Agaasimaha Isbeddelka Cimilada iyo Kobaca Cagaaran ee AfDB, Anthony Nyong, ayaa sheegay in dalalka ugu daran ay waxyeelladu ku dhici doonto ay celcelis ahaan lumin karaan 1% ilaa 2% wax-soo-saarkooda guud (GDP). Wuxuu xusay in abaarta, fatahaadaha iyo duufaannada la xiriira El Niño ay sii wiiqi doonaan sugnaanta cuntada iyo biyaha, isla markaana dhaawici doonaan kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha. Nyong ayaa sidoo kale ka digay in dalal ay ka mid yihiin Soomaaliya, Suudaan, Koonfurta Suudaan, Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo, Mali, Burundi iyo Nigeria ay wajihi karaan saameyn aad u daran, taasoo keeni karta barakac ballaaran iyo tartan ku saabsan biyaha iyo dhulka daaqsinka. AfDB waxay sheegtay in beeraleyda Afrika ay sanadkan hore u wajahayaan khasaare lagu qiyaasay $330 milyan, halka waaxda kalluumeysigana ay saameyn ku yeelan doonaan kuleylka badda iyo duufaannada. Bangigu wuxuu intaa ku daray in baahida maalgelinta la-qabsiga isbeddelka cimilada ee Afrika ay hadda gaari karto $100 bilyan sanadkan, si loo yareeyo saameynta El Niño ee la filayo.
