items.title: Wareysiyada Wadajirka ah ee Siyaasiyiinta Soomaaliyeed: Faa’iido mise Khatar?
items.description: B y Dr. Abukar Yusuf Warsame Hordhac Wareysiyada Wadajirka ah Warbaahinta Soomaaliyeed waxay soo martay isbeddel weyn siiba labaatankii sano ee la soo dhaafay. Muddo dheer wareysiyada siyaasaddeed waxaa lagu qaban jiray idaacado iyo telefishanno leh hal wareyste. Wareysiyadaasi waxay badanaa ku koobnaayeen waqti kooban iyo arrimaha siyaasadeed ee ugu kulul waqtigaas. Idaacadihii iyo telefishannadii ayaa maanta waxaa barbar socda YouTube, Podcast-yo, Facebook, iyo aalado kale. Isbeddelkan ayaa horseeday in suxufiyiin madaxbannaan iyo madallo cusub ay helaan dhagaystayaal aad u ballaaran. Markii ay soo baxeen warbaahinta bulshada iyo podcast-yadu, waxaa kordhay fursadda dooddaha dheer iyo falanqaynta qotada dheer. Dadku waxay bilaabeen inay door bidaan doodaha dhaadheer ee sharraxaya sababaha iyo saameynta arrimaha siyaasadeed. Dhinaca kale siyaasiyiintuna waxay doonayaan inay gaaraan dhagaystayaal badan halka warbaahintuna ay rabto inay isu geyso aqoon, waayo-aragnimo iyo dhagaystayaal mug leh. Dhamaan arrimahan ayaa horseeday kororka wareysiyada wadajirka ah. Mid ka mid ah isbeddellada ugu xiisaha badan ayaa ah soo ifbaxa wareysiyada wadajirka ah ee ay sameeyaan/u wada qabtaan/qaadaan laba ama in ka badan oo warbaahin ama suxufiyiin ah. Dalal badan ayaa hore u isticmaalay habkan. Wareysiyada kooxeed, dooddaha siyaasaddeed iyo podcast-yada wadajirka ah ayaa noqday hab caan ah oo lagu xoojiyo doodaha dadweynaha. Khibradahaasi waxay muujinayaan in guusha lagu gaaro diyaar-garow wanaagsan, anshax saxaafadeed iyo xaqiiqo ku saleynta doodaha. Haddaba habkan cusub ma mudan yahay in si qoto dheer loo falanqeeyo maadaama uu saameyn ku yeelan karo isla-xisaabtanka siyaasiyiinta, tayada saxaafadda, iyo fahamka bulshadeenna Soomaaliyeed? Faa’iidooyinka iyo khataraha wareysiyada wadajirka ah Wareysiyada wadajirka ahi waxay kordhin karaan isla-xisaabtanka iyo tayada saxaafadda, balse sidoo kale waxay la yimaadaan khataro ay ka mid yihiin koox-fikir, eex siyaasadeed iyo hoos u dhac ku yimaada madaxbannaanida warbaahinta. Faa’iidooyinka Dhinaca Isla-Xisaabtanka: Marka laba ama in ka badan oo wareyste ay su’aalayaan hal siyaasi, way adkaanaysaa in laga baxsado su’aalaha adag. Hal wareyste ayaa weydiin kara su’aal, halka kan kalena uu daba geli karo jawaabta ama tilmaami karo meelaha ay jawaabtu iska hor imanayso ama aysan waafaqsanayn xaqiiqooyinka jira. Habkan ayaa sare u qaadaya isla-xisaabtanka, wuxuuna bulshada ka caawinayaa inay hesho sawir dhammaystiran oo ku saabsan mowduuca laga hadlayo. Dhinaca Warbaahinta: Iskaashiga warbaahintu wuxuu sare u qaadaa tayada shaqada suxufiyiinta. Waxay wadaagi karaan cilmi-baaris, dukumeenti, xog ururin iyo khibrado kala duwan. Waxa kale oo ay isku baran karaan farsamooyinka wareysiga iyo hababka su’aalaha loo dhiso, taasoo kor u qaadaysa xirfadda guud ee saxaafadda Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, wada-shaqeyntu waxay yareyn kartaa kharashaadka soo saarista barnaamijyada waaweyn, iyadoo la isku darsanayo agab, waqti iyo khubaro. Dhinaca Bulshada: Bulshadu waa dhinaca ugu faa’iidada badan wareysiyadan wadajirka ah. Daawadayaashu waxay helayaan su’aalo badan, aragtiyo kala duwan iyo faham qoto dheer oo ku saabsan arrimaha laga doodayo. Habkani wuxuu sidoo kale mideyn karaa dhagaystayaal kala duwan oo hore ugu kala xirnaa warbaahino kala duwan, taas oo kordhinaysa wadaagga xogta iyo doodda bulshada. Intaa waxaa dheer, wuxuu sare u qaadi karaa kalsoonida dadweynaha haddii bulshada ay dareento in su’aalaha muhiimka ah aan laga tagayn. Khataraha Inkasta oo faa’iidooyinkaasi jiraan, haddana waxaa jira khataro dhowr ah oo dhinac socda wareysiyada wadajirka ah. Dhinaca Koox-Fikirka : Waxaa xaqiiqo ah in suxufi kasta uu leeyahay aragtiyo iyo fikirro u gaar ah. Xirfadda saxaafaddu waxay ku dhisan tahay caddaalad, xaqiiqo iyo dhexdhexaadnimo. Wareysiyada wadajirka ahi waxay kor u qaadi karaan dhexdhexaadnimada haddii ay kulmiyaan suxufiyiin leh aragtiyo kala duwan. Hase yeeshee, haddii dhammaan wareystayaashu ay ka yimaadaan hal aragti siyaasadeed ama hal jiho fikir, wareysigu wuxuu noqon karaa mid aan dheellitirnayn oo dhinac ka raran. Taasi waxay dhaawici kartaa kalsoonida bulshada ee warbaahinta. Dhinaca Madaxbannaanida: Khatar kale waa in madaxbannaanida warbaahintu yaraato, maadaama wada-shaqeyntu mararka qaarkood u baahan karto tanaasul ku saabsan su’aalaha la weydiinayo, habka loo maamulayo wareysiga ama mowduucyada mudnaanta la siinayo. Haddii tanaasulkaasi bato, waxaa dhici karta in xorriyadda tifaftirka (editorial independence) ay hoos u dhacdo. Dhinaca Mas’uuliyadda : Waxaa dhici karta inay adkaato in la ogaado cidda mas’uulka ka ah khaladaadka, xogta aan saxda ahayn ama hab-maamuuska khaldan ee wareysiga. Taasi waxay keeni kartaa in khaladaadka aan si degdeg ah loo sixin ama aan si cad loo ogeyn cidda laga rabo inay bulshada u sharaxdo wixii dhacay. Dhinaca Caannimo Raadiska iyo Is-Muujinta : Mararka qaarkood waxaa dhici karta in qaar ka mid ah wareystayaashu ay xoogga saaraan sidii ay u kordhin lahaayeen caannimadooda ama u noqon lahaayeen qofka ugu hadal-heynta badan baraha bulshada oo wariyuhu ulakac war/faalo dareen-kicis ah u abuuro isagoo caan raadis ah, halkii ay mudnaanta siin lahaayeen helitaanka xogta iyo isla-xisaabtanka siyaasiga. Haddii wareysigu isu beddelo tartan u dhexeeya wariyeyaasha halkii uu ka ahaan lahaa dood bulshada anfaceysa, waxaa dhaawacmi kara tayada iyo ujeeddadii wareysiga. Dhinaca Xulashada Martida: Waxaa sidoo kale jiri karta khatar ah in siyaasiyiintu ay doortaan oo keliya barnaamijyada ama kooxaha wariyeyaasha ee ay u arkaan kuwo dabacsan ama saaxiibtinimo ula dhaqmaya. Sidoo kale waxa meesha ka baxaysa kala-duwanaanshihii (diversity) oo haddii isku-darsigu bato ay ku soo ururureyso dhawr warbaahin (oligopoly). Haddii arrintaasi dhacdo, waxay yareyn kartaa sinnaanta fursadaha iyo kalsoonida lagu qabo in warbaahintu si madax-bannaan u gudato waajibaadkeeda. Dhinaca Tartanka iyo Tirada Daawadayaasha: In kasta oo iskaashigu kordhin karo tirada daawadayaasha, haddana waxaa jiri karta cadaadis ah in mudnaanta la siiyo mowduucyada soo jiidanaya daawasho badan halkii laga dooran lahaa arrimaha bulshada ugu muhiimsan. Taasi waxay horseedi kartaa in tayada doodda lagu beddelo raadinta daawasho iyo faafin (viral content), taas oo dhaawici karta doorka warbaahinta ee u adeegga bulshada. Gunaanad Soo ifbaxa wareysiyada wadajirka ah waa tallaabo cusub oo muhiim u ah horumarka warbaahinta Soomaaliyeed. Waxay muujinayaan biseylka warbaahinta casriga ah ee ku saleysan dijitaalka iyo rabitaanka bulshada ee dood qoto dheer. Guushoodu kuma xirnaan doonto tirada daawadayaasha ama sumcadda martigeliyayaasha, balse waxay ku xirnaan doontaa inta ay bulshada ka caawinayaan fahamka arrimaha saameynaya mustaqbalka Soomaaliya. Waxaan ku soo gunaanadayaa talooyin ku socda warbaahinta Soomaaliyeed siiba qolada qabata wareysiyada wadajirka ah: Ilaaliya madaxbannaanida tifaftirka wareysiyada. Ka fogaada eexda siyaasadeed, magacyada qabiilka adeegsigooda, iyo kaftanka xanafta reebi kara ama fasiraad qaldan keeni kara. U adeegsada wareysiyadiinna caddeymo iyo xaqiiqooyin. Si siman ula macaamila dhammaan siyaasiyiinta. Saxa khaladaadka marka ay dhacaan. Ka hormariya danta guud danaha gaarka ah. items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo soo riday diyaaradda Bayraktar Akinci
items.description: Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa ku dhawaaqay in Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Yemen ay Axaddan soo rideen diyaarad aan duuliyaha lahayn oo nooceedu yahay Bayraktar Akinci. Diyaaraddan ayaa ka mid ah drones-ka uu Turkigu sameeyo, waana mid ka mid ah diyaaradaha drones-ka ee ugu casrisan ee maanta dunida yaala, waxaana la sheegay in muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ay isticmaalayeen Ciidamada Sacuudiga. Diyaaraddan ayaa waxaa loo adeegsadaa hawlgalada sahanka iyo burburinta hadafka militari ama bartilmaameedyada cadowga, waana mid ka mid ah diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ugu awoodda badan dunida casriga ah. Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in diyaaradda lagu soo riday hawada Gobolka Al-Jawf ee Waqooyiga Yemen, ka dib markii uu sheegay inay wadday hawlgalo cadowtinimo ah. Afhayeenka ayaa intaasi ku daray in diyaaradda lagu soo riday hub ku habboon, oo uu ula jeedo in loo adeegsaday gantaal laga tuuray dhulka. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ayaa ku hubeysan gantaalo casri ah, oo ay ku jiraan gantaalada ballaastikada iyo kuwa kale ee cruise-ka. Tallaabada lagu soo riday diyaaraddan ayaa waxay qayb ka tahay xiisadda sii kordheysa ee Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga oo gaartay meeshii ugu sarreysay. items.title: Sirdoonka Mareykanka oo wixii ay ka cabsi qabeen ka ogaaday Mojtaba Khamenei
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adaha sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa rumeysan in hoggaamiyaha cusub ee Iran, Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, uu aabbihii uga furfuran yahay in Tehran ay sameysato hub nukliyeer ah, taasi oo ah wax laga cabsi qabay kahor dilkii aabihiis. Qiimeyn cusub oo sirdoon, oo ay heleen mas’uuliyiin Mareykan ah, ayaa muujineysa in Mojtaba Khamenei iyo dowladda mayalka adag ee ka dhalatay dilkii hoggaamiyayaashii hore ee Iran ay daneynayaan horumarinta hub nukliyeer oo casri ah. Wargeyska New York Times , oo soo xigtay saraakiil lagu wargeliyey qiimeynta, ayaa sheegay in hoggaamiyaha cusub uusan weligiis si furan ugu baaqin in Iran ay sameysato bam nukliyeer ah. Hase yeeshee, wada-hadallo ay sirdoonku dhexda ka qabteen iyo mowqifyo uu muujiyey dagaalka ka hor ayaa saraakiisha Mareykanka ku qanciyey inuusan Mojtaba la wadaagin taxaddarkii aabbihii, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. Ali Khamenei, oo Iran hoggaaminayey in ka badan 36 sano, ayaa lagu dilay weerar ay Israel billowgii dagaalka fulisay, kaas oo la sheegay inay gacan ka geysteen xogaha sirdoonka Mareykanka. Hoggaamiyihii hore ayaa muddo dheer diidanaa in Iran ay sameysato ama adeegsato hub nukliyeer ah, inkasta oo Washington ay aaminsaneyd in Tehran ay dooneysay awood ay si degdeg ah ugu sameysan karto hubkaas haddii ay go’aansato. Dowladda cusub ee Iran ayaa sidoo kale adkeysay dadaallada ay ku doonayso inay saameyn weyn ugu yeelato marin-biyoodka Hormuz, iyadoo isla markaana noqotay dhinac ay Washington ku adkaatay inay heshiis la gaarto. Haddii dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Israel uu Iran ku riixay inay hub nukliyeer sameysato halkii uu ka hor istaagi lahaa, arrintaas waxay noqon kartaa mid ka mid ah cawaaqibta ugu khatarta badan ee ka dhashay dilkii hoggaamiyihii hore iyo isku daygii maamulka Donald Trump ee ahaa in la beddelo nidaamka Tehran. Awood aan la mid ahayn tii aabbihii Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa ka digaya in xogta ugu badan ee laga hayo aragtida Mojtaba Khamenei la ururiyey dagaalka ka hor. Hoggaamiyaha cusub ayaa si xun ugu dhaawacmay wejigii hore ee dagaalka, waxaana tan iyo markaas yaraaday isgaarsiintiisa iyo kasoo muuqashadiisa fagaarayaasha. Saraakiisha ayaa sheegay inuu arrintaas u sameynayo dhaawaciisa awgiis iyo cabsi uu ka qabo in lagu beegsado weerar cirka ah. Qiimeynta Mareykanka ayaa muujineysa inuu weli gacanta ku hayo dowladda, balse uusan lahayn awooddii buuxda iyo saameyntii uu aabbihii ku dhex lahaa nidaamka siyaasadeed, militariga iyo hay’adaha diinta ee Iran. Qiimeyntan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli madaxweyne Trump uu ka fiirsanayo inuu sii ballaariyo ololaha militari ee ka dhanka ah Iran. Haddii la xaqiijiyo in hoggaamiyaha cusub uu taageersan yahay sameysashada hub nukliyeer ah, arrintaas ayaa maamulka Trump siin karta sabab kale oo uu ku xoojiyo weerarrada. Si kastaba, saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sheegaya in Tehran aysan weli qaadin tallaabo cad oo ay dib ugu bilaabeyso kobcinta uranium-ka ama howlaha kale ee muhiimka u ah sameynta hub nukliyeer. Waxayse Iran qaaday tallaabooyin lagu ilaalinayo qalabkeeda nukliyeerka kadib weerarradii Mareykanka ee sanadkii hore iyo xilliyadii dagaalka hadda socda uu yara hakaday. Qalab loo raray buur dhulka hoostiisa ah Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in Iran ay ugu yaraan qaar ka mid ah qalabka centrifuges-ka u rartay xarun si weyn loo adkeeyey oo ku taalla bartamaha dalka, taas oo Washington ay ugu yeerto “Buurta Pickaxe”. Centrifuges-ku waa mashiinnada lagu kobciyo uranium-ka, waxaana dhaqdhaqaaqooda markii ugu horreysay toddobaadkan baahisay Wall Street Journal , oo sheegtay in sirdoonka Israel uu la socday raristooda. Tallaabadaas waxay noqon kartaa bilowga dib-u-dhiska awoodda kobcinta uranium-ka. Hase yeeshee, saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa rumeysan in Iran ay hadda diiradda saareyso badbaadinta qalabka, iyadoo u rareysa meel ka baxsan awoodda bambooyinka Mareykanka. Bishii June 2025, Trump ayaa amray in ciidamada Mareykanka ay weeraraan saddex ka mid ah xarumaha ugu muhiimsan barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran. Diyaaradaha qarsoon ee B-2 ayaa bambooyinka caadiga ah ee ugu waaweyn ee Mareykanku haysto ku garaacay xarumaha Fordo iyo Natanz, halka xarunta Isfahan lagu dhuftay gantaallada Tomahawk. Trump ayaa markiiba sheegay in howlgalka lagu “baabi’iyey” xarumahaas, balse qiimeyntii hore ee sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa ka taxaddar badneyd hadalkaas, iyadoo sheegtay in barnaamijka dib loo dhigay dhowr bilood oo keliya. Buurta Pickaxe laguma darin weerarradaas, waxaana xaruntaasi ay ciidamada Mareykanka u tahay bartilmaameed aad uga adag kuwii hore. Dhismayaasha gudaha xarunta ayaa si qoto dheer uga hooseeya buur, waxaana saraakiil Mareykan ah ay sheegeen inay ka baxsan yihiin awoodda bambooyinka caadiga ah ee ugu xooggan ee Washington hayso. Iran ayaa la sheegay inay baaritaan ku sameysay burburkii Fordo si ay u ogaato heerka ay gaareen bambooyinka Mareykanka, kadibna ay ku qanacday in godadka Buurta Pickaxe oo ka sii qoto dheer ay ka badbaadi karaan weerar cirka ah. Si kastaba, Tehran waxay ka walaacsan tahay in Mareykanku fuliyo weerar kumaandoos ah oo ciidamada dhulka ay gudaha ugu galaan xarunta, qalabkana halkaas ku burburiyaan. Sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in Iran ay ciidamo dhulka ah geysay agagaarka Buurta Pickaxe si ay uga hortagto weerar noocaas ah. Trump ayaa toddobaadkan ku hanjabay inuu weerari karo xarunta, isaga oo ku tilmaamay “bartilmaameed suurtagal ah oo lagu dhufan karo jug weyn oo albaabkeeda hore ah”. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in Mareykanku uusan halkaas ku arag wax howl nukliyeer ah, taas oo saraakiishu ku fasireen in Iran aysan weli dib u bilaabin kobcinta uranium-ka, inkasta oo ay qalab u rartay xarunta. Kaydka uranium-ka oo weli jira Weerarradii Mareykanka iyo Israel ayaa ugu yaraan hakiyey horumarkii barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran. Hay’adaha sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa markii hore qiyaasay in burburka xarumaha uu barnaamijka dib u dhigi lahaa lix bilood oo keliya haddii Tehran ay si degdeg ah u dayactiri lahayd centrifuges-ka ama ay kobcinta uranium-ka ka bilaabi lahayd xarumo kale. Laakiin saraakiisha ayaa sheegay in Iran aysan isla markiiba qodin xarumihii burburay, isla markaana aysan howlaha kobcinta ka bilaabin goobo kale. Hase yeeshee, waxyaabaha ugu muhiimsan ee lagu sameyn karo bamka, gaar ahaan kaydka uranium-ka heerka sare loo kobciyey, ayaa weli jira, waxaana la rumeysan yahay in Tehran ay heli karto. Ali Khamenei ayaa hore u soo saaray fatwo diimeed uu ku mamnuucayo adeegsiga hubka nukliyeerka. Mowqifkaas ayaa si rasmi ah loogu gudbiyey Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Tamarta Nukliyeerka sanadkii 2005. Fatwadaas ma aysan joojin Iran inay horumariso barnaamijkeeda nukliyeerka ama ay qaaddo tallaabooyin farsamo oo u dhow sameynta hub. Kooxo mayal adag oo dowladda ka tirsan ayaa xitaa xilligii Ali Khamenei doonayey in Iran ay yeelato awood ay si degdeg ah hub ugu sameysan karto. Sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa hadda rumeysan in Mojtaba Khamenei uu xiiseynayo hub ka casrisan bamka fudud ee Iran ay sahamineysay dhammaadkii maamulkii Joe Biden. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in Tehran waqtigaas baareysay suurtagalnimada sameynta bam u eg kuwii hore ee nukliyeerka, kaas oo adkaan lahaa in lagu rakibo gantaal balse loo adeegsan karay cabsi-gelin iyo ka-hortag weerar. Mojtaba ayaa la rumeysan yahay inuusan hub noocaas ah u arkin mid faa’iido badan leh, balse uu taageersan yahay horumarinta madax dagaal thermonuclear ah oo mustaqbalka la yareyn karo laguna rakibi karo gantaallada riddada dheer. Khudbadihiisa fagaare, hoggaamiyaha cusub wuxuu ku ballanqaaday inuu ilaalinayo awoodda nukliyeerka Iran, balse si toos ah ugama uusan hadlin sameysashada hub. Wuxuu sidoo kale iska fogeeyey heshiis ay Mareykanka iyo Iran saxiixeen bishii June, kaas oo Tehran ku ballanqaadday inaysan raadin doonin hub nukliyeer. Mojtaba ayaa sheegay inuu oggolaaday in heshiiska la saxiixo, balse uusan mabda’ ahaan ku qanacsaneyn. Rosemary Kelanic, oo madax ka ah barnaamijka Bariga Dhexe ee machadka Defense Priorities, ayaa sheegtay in dagaalka iyo qorshaha Mareykanka ee lagu taageerayo Sacuudi Carabiya inay yeelato xarumo lagu kobciyo uranium-ka ay kordhinayaan fursadda Iran ay hub nukliyeer ku raadiso. “Iran waxay hadda haysataa sabab aad uga weyn oo ay hub nukliyeer u sameysato, si ay uga hortagto isku dayo kale oo Mareykanka ama Israel ay ku doonayaan inay ku burburiyaan nidaamka ama dowladda Iran,” ayay tiri. Waxay intaas ku dartay in dagaalku sidaas darteed kasoo horjeedo hadafkii loo sheegay ee ahaa in Iran laga hor istaago faafinta hubka nukliyeerka. Saraakiil Mareykan ah ayaa sheegay in mas’uuliyiin Iranian ah oo muddo dheer ku doodayey in hub nukliyeer oo keliya uu dalkooda ka difaaci karo weerar ay qaadaan Israel ama Mareykanka ay hadda rumeysan yihiin in dagaalku xoojiyey doodooda. Rosemary Kelanic, oo madax ka ah barnaamijka Bariga Dhexe ee machadka Defense Priorities, ayaa sheegtay in dagaalka iyo qorshaha Mareykanka ee lagu taageerayo Sacuudi Carabiya inay yeelato xarumo lagu kobciyo uranium-ka ay kordhinayaan fursadda Iran ay hub nukliyeer ku raadiso. “Iran waxay hadda haysataa sabab aad uga weyn oo ay hub nukliyeer u sameysato, si ay uga hortagto isku dayo kale oo Mareykanka ama Israel ay ku doonayaan inay ku burburiyaan nidaamka ama dowladda Iran,” ayay tiri. Waxay intaas ku dartay in dagaalku sidaas darteed kasoo horjeedo hadafkii loo sheegay ee ahaa in Iran laga hor istaago faafinta hubka nukliyeerka. Saraakiil Mareykan ah ayaa sheegay in mas’uuliyiin Iranian ah oo muddo dheer ku doodayey in hub nukliyeer oo keliya uu dalkooda ka difaaci karo weerar ay qaadaan Israel ama Mareykanka ay hadda rumeysan yihiin in dagaalku xoojiyey doodooda. items.title: Puntland oo digniin u dirtay Galmudug iyo madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh kadib markii…
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Puntland ayaa soo saartay war-saxaafadeed ay ku eedeysay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud inuu wado dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo lagu hurinayo colaado, laguna wiiqayo nidaamka dowladnimo ee Puntland. Warsaxaafadeedka oo ku taariikheysan 25-ka July 2026 ayaa Puntland waxay Xasan Sheekh ku tilmaantay “madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhammaaday”, iyadoo sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo maalmihii u dambeeyey ka socday qaybo ka mid ah deegaannadeeda iyo meelaha ku dhow. Puntland ma aysan soo bandhigin faahfaahin buuxda oo ku saabsan ciidamada ay sheegtay in la abaabulayo, cidda hoggaamineysa iyo goobaha ay ku wajahan yihiin, balse waxay ku adkeysatay inay arrintan u aragto qorshe lagu dhaawacayo ammaankeeda iyo hay’adaha maamulkeeda. “Dowladda Puntland waxay caddeyneysaa inaysan jirin ciidan la yiraahdo PSF oo si sharci ah uga tirsan ciidamada Difaaca Dowladda Puntland,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Maamulka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuusan aqoonsaneyn ciidamo ay Dowladda Federaalka diiwaangelisay oo gudaha Puntland ka sameynaya dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan oggolaansho ka haysan hay’adaha ammaanka ee maamulka. Digniin loo diray Galmudug Puntland ayaa digniin gaar ah u dirtay dowladda Galmudug, oo xuduud dheer la wadaagta, gaar ahaan gobolka Mudug oo magaalada Gaalkacyo ay labada maamul kala maamulaan. Waxay Galmudug ugu baaqday in aysan garoomadeeda diyaaradaha iyo dhulka ay maamusho u oggolaan in laga soo gudbiyo saanad ciidan, hub iyo maleeshiyaad ay Puntland sheegtay in loo adeegsan karo weerarro ama qalqal-gelin ka dhan ah deegaannadeeda. Puntland waxay ku doodday in labada maamul ay muddo dheer lahaayeen derisnimo wanaagsan, iskaashi amni iyo nabadgelyo ay bulshooyinka ku nool Mudug ku wada noolaayeen. “Puntland waxay Galmudug ugu baaqaysaa inay ka waantoowdo in saanad ciidan iyo maleeshiyaad la soo mariyo garoomada iyo dhulka ay maamusho, kuwaas oo looga dan leeyahay in lagu dhibaateeyo shacabka reer Puntland,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Dowladda Galmudug iyo Dowladda Federaalka weli si rasmi ah ugama aysan jawaabin warsaxaafadeedkan iyo eedeymaha cusub ee Puntland. Digniintan ayaa timid laba maalmood kaddib markii wasiir ku-xigeenka amniga Puntland, Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf Dujaana, uu sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka ay hub soo gelisay magaalada Gaalkacyo, kaas oo uu sheegay inuu yaallo dhinaca ay maamusho Galmudug. Dujaana wuxuu sheegay in Puntland ay hayso caddeymo ku saabsan hubka, isla markaana ay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin ay ku difaaceyso ammaankeeda. Dowladda Federaalka kama aysan jawaabin sheegashadaas, mana jirto cid madax-bannaan oo xaqiijisay hubka la sheegay in la geeyay Gaalkacyo. Puntland ayaa sidoo kale maalmihii ugu dambeeyey ciidamo dheeraad ah geysay gobolka Mudug, iyadoo isbeddel ku sameysay hoggaanka cutubyo ka tirsan ciidamada Daraawiishta ee halkaas ka howlgala. Tallaabadaas ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in xiisadda siyaasadeed ay isu beddesho isku dhac ciidan. Dagaalkii Laag War-saxaafadeedka cusub ayaa sidoo kale daba socda dagaal 20-kii July deegaanka Laag ee duleedka Boosaaso ku dhexmaray ciidamada Daraawiishta Puntland iyo ciidamo ka tirsan PSF. Iska horimaadka ayaa qarxay markii ciidamada Puntland ay joojiyeen kolonyo PSF ah oo ka soo baxday Boosaaso, xilli maamulka uu horey u mamnuucay dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidamada aan ka amar qaadan hay’adihiisa. Ciidamada Puntland ayaa markii dambe la wareegay gaadiid dagaal, hub iyo askar ka tirsan PSF, halka ciidamadii kale ay lug kaga baxeen goobta. Wararka maxalliga ah ayaa tirooyin kala duwan ka bixiyey askarta la qabtay ama isa soo dhiibtay, balse Puntland waxay sheegtay inay si buuxda ula wareegtay deegaanka Laag. PSF ayaa markii hore ahaa ciidan la-dagaallama argagixisada oo Mareykanku tababar iyo taageero siin jiray, balse xiriirka ciidankaas iyo maamulka Madaxweyne Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa xumaaday tan iyo khilaafkii hubeysnaa ee Boosaaso ka dhacay dabayaaqadii 2021. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay markii mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka ay PSF ku dareen cutub cusub oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, arrintaas oo Puntland si adag u diidday, kuna tilmaantay faragelin lagu sameynayo nidaamkeeda amni. Khilaafka amni wuxuu qayb ka yahay muran siyaasadeed oo ballaaran oo u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka, kaas oo salka ku haya wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka, nidaamka doorashada, awood-qaybsiga iyo maamulka ciidamada federaalka ee ku sugan Puntland. Puntland ayaa ugu dambeyn shacabka deegaannadeeda ugu baaqday inay ilaashadaan dhulkooda iyo dowladnimadooda, iyadoo ka digtay dhaqdhaqaaq kasta oo ay ku tilmaantay mid lagu qalqal-gelinayo ammaanka iyo xasilloonida maamulka. items.title: Hambalyo ku socota Maayarka iyo ku xigeenka Berbera
items.description: Marka hore, waxa aan halkan hambalyo iyo boogaadin u marinayaa Duqa (Mayor) cusub ee Degmada Berbera Mudane Maxamed Ibrahim Ismaaciil (Maxamed Dable) iyo Duq-ku-xigeenka (Deputy Mayor) Mudane Baashe Cabdillaahi Ibrahim (Yacquub) oo maanta, 26/07/2026, golaha deegaanka ee Berbera u kala doorteen xilalkaasi. Marka labaadna, waxa aan illaahay uga baryayaa in uu labadoodaba ku asturo xilkaas ay qaadeen ee loo igmaday. Waxa kale oo aan Mudane Maxamed iyo Mudane Baashe-ba ku boorin lahaa in ay ka shaqeeyaan sidii ay u mideyn lahaayeen 13 mudane ee golaha deegaanka Berbera maadaama ay yihiin guddoomiyaha iyo guddoomiye ku-xieenka golaha deegaanka. Dhamaan xubnaha Golaha Degaanka Berberana waxa aan xusuusin lahaa gudashada Waajibaadkooda ee sida buuxda ugu qeexan Xeerka Ismaamulka Gobolladda iyo Degmooyinka, Lr. 23/2019. Ugu denbeyntii, waxa aan u rajeynayaa mustaqbal fiican duqii hore ee degmada Berbera Mudane C/shakuur Maxamuud Xassan (C/shakuur Cidin) iyo Ku-xigeenkiisii Mudane Nuur Cabdi Jaamac (Nuur Cadde). Waxa aan leeyahay wixii aad u qabateen degmadiina, dadkiina, iyo deegaankiinaba waxa xusi doonta taariikhda aan wax hilmaamin. Allaa Weyn. Qofkii Aaminaa Awood leh.

items.title: Xog: Xasan oo weji gabax kala kulmay fara-gelinta loollanka guddoonka BF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa soo fara-geliyay loollanka kursiga Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, kaasi oo xubno ka tirsan xukuumadda ay isu soo taageen. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa dhowr kulan oo gaar gaar ah la yeeshay Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, Saadaat Maxamed Caliyoow oo hore u shaaciyay damaciisa ku aaddan qabashada xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Ilo ku dhow wada-hadallada ayaa sheegay in kulamadaasi ay si toos ah u dhexmareen madaxweynaha iyo musharraxa, iyadoo la isku dayay in la helo is-afgarad siyaasadeed. Hase yeeshee, dadaalladaasi ma dhalin wax natiijo ah, kadib markii Saadaat uu ku adkeystay inuu geli doono tartanka. Wararku waxay intaasi ku darayaan in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu xoojiyay dadaallada lagu doonayo in musharraxa looga leexiyo tartanka, isagoo arrintaas kala hadlay qaar ka mid ah saaxiibadiisa siyaasadeed, ra’iisul wasaaraha iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo dowladda ka tirsan. Sidoo kale, ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegay in madaxweynaha uu toddobaadkan ka codsaday mas’uuliyiintaasi inay cadaadis siyaasadeed saaraan Saadaat Caliyoow, si loo xaqiijiyo inuu ka haro loollanka doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, inkastoo weli dadaalladaasi miro dhalin. Dhanka kale, xafiiska ololaha Musharrax Saadaat Maxamed Caliyoow ayaa xaqiijiyay inay si buuxda ugu diyaar garoobeen doorashada, isla markaana ay rumeysan yihiin inay haystaan taageero siyaasadeed oo ku filan si ay ugu guuleystaan tartanka. Go’aanka Saadaat ee ah inuu ka harin tartanka ayaa la micno ah in musharraxa ay Madaxtooyadu taageereyso, Wasiir Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur uu wajahayo loollan adag, maadaama labada dhinacba ay wadaan olole lagu kasbanayo codadka xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka. Doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa haatan isu beddeshay loollan siyaasadeed oo si weyn isha loogu hayo, iyadoo la filayo in maalmaha soo socda ay sii xoogaystaan ololayaasha musharraxiinta iyo dadaallada ay dhinacyadu ku raadinayaan taageerada xildhibaannada, taas oo ka dhigeysa doorashadan mid saameyn weyn ku yeelan karta jihada siyaasadda dalka. items.title: NISA Kills Al-Shabaab Chiefs, 14 Fighters
items.description: Somalia’s National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA) said Sunday that its forces, working with international partners, killed two senior Al-Shabaab propaganda officials and 14 other militants in coordinated raids across Hirshabelle State, dealing a fresh blow to the group’s media and combat operations. The operations, carried out in the Miirtaqwo area of Middle Shabelle and the Tardo area of Hiiraan, form part of an intensifying campaign by Somali security forces and their allies to dismantle Al-Shabaab’s leadership, propaganda infrastructure and fighting capacity. The strikes come as the government pushes ongoing offensives in central Somalia, where the al-Qaeda-linked group has clung to territory despite losing several towns in recent years. In Miirtaqwo, NISA said its forces destroyed a facility the militants called the “Security House,” which was reportedly being used to store equipment for Al-Andalus radio, Al-Shabaab’s main propaganda outlet. items.title: Suldaan Siciid Yuusuf Ducaale wax wanaagsan ayuu ku hadlay
items.description: SULDDAAN SICIID YUUSUF DUCAALE WAX WANAAGSAN AYUU KU HADLAY. Sulddaan siciid Yuusuf ducaale oo ka soo jeeda qoys siyaasadda Somaliland ilaa halgankii kaalin culus kaga jiray oo ka Hadlay arrimaha maxaabiista ayaan halkan ka hambalyaynayaa sida odaynimada ah ee uu uga hadlay. Dadkii reer somaliland gaar ahaan qurbbajoogii waxa ku soo batay maggafeyaal siyaasadeed oo meel kasta wax ka dayaya kuwaasoo Warbbaahinta kicin dadweyne iyo been la soo fadhiya maxaabiista qaarnna waalla sii deynayaa qaarna waalla haynayaa caqliga ma gasho ee dadka wax kale u sheega oo lafihiina u xishooda. Waddanku wuxuu u baahanyay nabaddiisa in la xoojiyo la adkeeyo oo lagu dhiirrigeliyo dawladdu inay gamco bir ah ku qabato fidmowaleyaasha caanka ah ee xamar iyo cadowkasta oo ay Somaliland leedahay masaariifsada. Somaliland wax go’ lagu qaado ka weyn. MAHADSANID. CABDI BACAW. GUUL ALLE. LONDON.

items.title: Puntland oo Galmudug ku eedeeysay inay taageerto ciidamo wax u dhimaya amnigeeda
items.description: Garoowe ( Raxanreeb Online) Maamulka Puntland ayaa war ka soo saaray xaaladda amniga ee deegaannada ay xuduudda la wadaagaan maamulka Galmudug, iyadoo ku eedeysay maamulka Galmudug in deegaanadeeda laga soo abaabulo maleeshiyaad carqaladeynayo amniga Puntland. Sida lagu sheegay bayaanka Puntland, ciidamadaasi ayaa la sheegay inay ku sugan yihiin deegaanno ka tirsan Galmudug, isla markaana ay khatar ku yihiin nabadgelyada iyo xasilloonida gobolka, waxa ayna sheegtay Puntland in ay ugu baaqeyso in Galmudug ay qaaddo tallaabooyin lagu hubinayo inaan deegaannadeeda looga abaabulin falal amni-darro. Dhanka kale, ilaa iyo hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo ka soo baxay maamulka Galmudug oo si toos ah uga jawaabaya eedeymaha ay Puntland soo jeedisay ee ku aadan in maleeshiyaad hubeysan ay dhibaato amni darro ku hayaan shacabka Puntland. Sikastaba, arrintaan ayaa imaaneysa xilli ay jiraan dadaallo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga dhinaca amniga ee u dhexeeya dowlad-goboleedyada iyo dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, si looga hortago khataraha kooxaha hubeysan iyo falalka amni-darrada. The post Puntland oo Galmudug ku eedeeysay inay taageerto ciidamo wax u dhimaya amnigeeda appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Shan xildhibaan oo katirsan golaha Wakiilada Waqooyi Bari oo xilkii laga xayuubiyay
items.description: Laascaanood ( Raxanreeb Online) Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Maamulka Waqooyi Bari ayaa la sheegay inuu Golaha Wakiillada ka codsaday in xasaanadda laga qaado shan xildhibaan oo katirsan golaha wakiilada Waqooyi Bari. Golaha Wakiillada Waqooyi Bari oo kulan ku yeeshay magaalada Laascaanood, ayaa xilkii ka xayuubin ku sameeyay Xildhibaannada kala ah. Makhtal Siciid Maxamuud, Cabdisalaan Cabdillaahi Cabdiraxmaan, Sidiiq Jaamac Muuse, Axmed Cali Maxamed iyo Axmed Caabi Xasan. waxaana cod gacan taagtay ah ku oggolaaday (57) Mudane, waxaana la tilmaamay in Saddex meelood oo Laba Xubnaha Golaha Wakiillada, sida uu dhigayo Xeer hoosaadka Golaha Wakiillada qodobkiisa 9-aad. Sidoo kale Xeer Ilaaliyaha guud, ayaa sheegay in codsiga uu salka ku hayo qodobada 50-aad iyo 51-aad ee dastuurka dowlad goboleedka Waqooyi Bari, isaga oo tixraacaya qodobada 184. 218 iyo 221 ee xeer ciqaabta Soomaaliyeed. Geesta kale Xildhibaannada ayaa sheegay in go’aankoodu uu salka ku hayo sida maamulka loo hoggaaminayo iyo jihada siyaasadeed ee uu u socdo, iyagoo sheegay in dadaallo ay hore ugu bixiyeen xalinta khilaafaadka gudaha aysan miro dhalin. Arrintan ayaa kusoo aadaysa maalmo kaddib markii Fahiima Yuusuf Quuje ay u goosatay Somaliland, isla markaana ay ka degtay magaalada Hargeysa ee caasimada Somaliland. The post Shan xildhibaan oo katirsan golaha Wakiilada Waqooyi Bari oo xilkii laga xayuubiyay appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Puntland warns over Somalia federal military moves in Galkayo after Bosaso clashes
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Authorities in northeastern Somalia’s Puntland state on Saturday said they were closely monitoring what they described as military maneuvers by Somalia’s federal government in the central town of Galkayo, warning that the developments could threaten regional stability and Puntland’s governing institutions. Puntland authorities accused the federal government of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of attempting to use military and political pressure to weaken Puntland’s governance system, saying the movements around Galkayo risk provoking a confrontation between the two sides. In a statement, Puntland authorities clarified that no force known as the Puntland Security Force (PSF) is legally recognized as part of Puntland’s official defense structure, adding that the unit currently operating under that name in Puntland is not registered under the authority of the federal government either. Puntland also sent a message to neighboring Galmudug state and the international community, urging Galmudug authorities not to allow its territory, airports, or other facilities to be used for the movement of weapons and forces that could be directed against Puntland. The Puntland administration emphasized its longstanding relationship with Galmudug communities, highlighting years of neighborly relations, security cooperation, and peaceful coexistence between the two regions. The authorities further called on Puntland residents to remain vigilant and protect the security and stability of their state. The warning comes amid increasing reports that the federal government has expanded its support for allied political and security figures in Galkayo, a strategically important town divided between Puntland and Galmudug, raising fears that the escalating rivalry could develop into direct armed confrontation. Observers say the growing military buildup could trigger a rapid escalation between Puntland forces and federal government-aligned forces, with Mogadishu allegedly seeking to strengthen its influence over several Puntland areas, including Galkayo. The latest tensions follow a major confrontation near Bosaso last week, where Puntland forces said they seized 13 military vehicles from PSF units aligned with the federal government following clashes in the Laag area, about 30km north of the commercial port city. Puntland authorities also said they captured 30 members of the force during the fighting, marking the first direct armed confrontation between the two sides since tensions intensified in recent months. The dispute reflects a widening political and security rift between Puntland and Somalia’s federal government, with disagreements spanning control over security forces, the scope of federal authority, and competing political influence within Puntland. Meanwhile, some local media outlets have reported that President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud recently held meetings with influential Puntland politicians and security figures who command forces in the region and maintain strong local influence. According to those reports, the president urged the figures to unite their position against Puntland leader Said Abdullahi Deni, allegedly offering federal support, including resources and security assistance, while warning that failure to act could lead him to align with Deni instead. The reports have not been independently verified. The developments come as Somalia continues to face heightened political tensions between the federal government and some federal member states, with concerns that disputes over power, security structures, and political influence could further destabilize relations between Mogadishu and regional administrations. Puntland, established in 1998 as a semi-autonomous federal member state, has frequently clashed politically with successive federal governments over constitutional authority, resource-sharing, security arrangements, and the balance of power between Mogadishu and regional states. items.title: Guutooyinka milatariga ee ku sugan magaalada Muqdisho oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa sameeyay dib-u-habeyn ku saabsan magacaabista laba ka mid ah guutooyinka booliska milatariga, kuwaas oo door muhiim ah ka qaata sugidda amniga caasimadda Muqdisho. Dib-u-habeyntan ayaa lagu beddelay magacyadii hore ee Guutooyinka 22-aad iyo 23-aad, kuwaas oo hadda loo bixiyay Guutooyinka 73-aad iyo 74-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Isbeddelkan ayaa yimid kaddib markii lambarradii 22-aad iyo 23-aad loo qoondeeyay cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Kumaandooska Gorgor. Tallaabadan ayaa waxaa looga gol leeyahay in la mideeyo nidaamka magacaabista guutooyinka kala duwan ee ciidanka xoogga dalka, isla markaana meesha looga saaro isku ekaanshaha lambarrada ay adeegsanayeen cutubyo kala duwan, sida ay sheegeen ilo xog-ogaal ah. Wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in Ciidanka Gorgor ay horey u lahaayeen nidaam gaar ah oo lambarrada guutooyinka ah, kuwaas oo isugu xigay Guutooyinka 17-aad, 18-aad, 19-aad, 20-aad, 21-aad iyo 22-aad. Taasi ayaa dhalisay baahida loo qabo in dib loo habeeyo lambarrada guutooyinka booliska milatariga si loo helo kala-duwanaansho iyo nidaam mideysan. Guutooyinka booliska milatariga ayaa ka mid ah cutubyada ugu muhiimsan ee ciidanka xoogga dalka, waxaana loo xil saaraa sugidda amniga xarumaha dowladda, ilaalinta goobaha istaraatiijiga ah, dhaqan-gelinta nidaamka ciidamada iyo taageeridda howlaha amniga ee ka socda magaalada Muqdisho. Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan laamaha amniga ayaa aaminsan in dib-u-habeyntan ay fududeyn doonto maamulka ciidanka, isuduwidda howl-gallada, iyo kala soocidda cutubyada, iyadoo sidoo kale sare u qaadeysa hufnaanta qaab-dhismeedka ciidanka xoogga dalka. Dib-u-habeyntan ayaa qeyb ka ah qorshaha ballaaran ee lagu casriyeynayo ciidanka xoogga dalka, laguna xoojinayo nidaamka maamulka iyo hoggaaminta cutubyada kala duwan, iyadoo dowladda Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu horumarinayo tayada iyo awoodda hay’adaha amniga si ay uga jawaabaan caqabadaha amni ee dalka. items.description: Berlin (Caasimada Online) – Booliska magaalada Berlin ee dalka Jarmalka ayaa baadi-goob xooggan ku haya nin lagu magacaabay Abdul B. oo 21 jir ah, kadib markii lagu tuhmay inuu ku lug lahaa weerar sababay dhimashada hal qof iyo dhaawaca ugu yaraan 16 kale xilli ay socotay munaasabadda Berlin Pride. Bayaan ay soo saareen booliska ayaa lagu sheegay in tuhmanaha uu yahay nin caato ah oo leh timo madow, isla markaana xilliga dhacdada uu xirnaa funaanad madow oo koofiyad leh iyo surwaal cad. Hay’adaha ammaanka ayaa shacabka ka codsaday inay si degdeg ah ula xiriiraan booliiska haddii ay arkaan ama ay hayaan xog la xiriirta halka uu ku sugan yahay. Booliiska ayaa sheegay in Abdul B. lagu tuhunsan yahay inuu dhaawacay dhowr qof oo ku sugnaa deegaanka Tiergarten, halkaas oo ay ka socotay munaasabadda Pride. Waxay xuseen in baaritaannada hordhaca ah ay muujinayaan in tuhmanuhu uu weli baxsad yahay, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka ay wadaan howlgal ballaaran oo lagu baadi-goobayo. Saraakiisha baaritaanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in la rumeysan yahay in hal ama in ka badan oo qof ay ka carareen gaariga kadib markii uu weerarku dhacay. Booliska ayaa hadda isku dayaya inay aqoonsadaan dadkaasi si loo ogaado doorkooda iyo waxa ay ka ogaayeen dhacdada. Mas’uuliyiinta Berlin ayaa xaqiijiyay in ugu yaraan hal qof uu ku geeriyooday, halka 16 kalena ay dhaawacyo kala duwan soo gaareen. Qaar ka mid ah dadka dhaawacmay ayaa la sheegay inay xaaladdoodu culus tahay, waxaana isbitaallada magaalada la dhigay tiro badan oo ka mid ah dhibbanayaasha. Dhacdadan ayaa argagax ku abuurtay magaalada Berlin, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka ay xoojiyeen ilaalinta goobaha ay dadku isugu yimaadaan. Baarayaashu weli ma shaacin sababta rasmiga ah ee weerarka, mana caddeyn inay dhacdadan la xiriirto fal argagixiso ama ujeeddo kale oo dembiyeed. items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Guurtida Somaliland oo Qaabilay Guddida Nabadda Qaranka
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Guurtida Somaliland oo Qaabilay Guddida Nabadda Qaranka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Guurtida Somaliland, Mudane Muuse Xaaji Cabdi Ducaale, ayaa xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Guddida Nabadda Qaranka oo uu hoggaaminayo Guddoomiye Cabdilqaadir Xaaji Ismaaciil Jirde. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Guurtida Somaliland, Mudane Muuse Xaaji Cabdi Ducaale, ayaa xafiiskiisa ku soo dhaweeyay Guddida Nabadda Qaranka, iyadoo ay kulanka ku weheliyeen guddoomiye ku-xigeenka koowaad iyo labaad iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Guurtida. Kulanka ayaa lagaga wada hadlay xoojinta geeddi-socodka nabadda, iskaashiga Golaha Guurtida iyo Guddida Nabadda iyo sidii kor loogu qaadi lahaa wacyiga bulshada ee ku aaddan nabadda iyo horumarka qaranka. Guddida Nabadda ayaa sidoo kale adkaysay muhiimadda wada shaqaynta iyo kala warqaadashada, iyadoo Golaha Guurtida lagu tilmaamay gole door muhiim ah ku leh nabadda, diinta iyo dhaqanka.

items.title: Puntland oo shaacisay in aysan aqoonsaneyn ciidan la yiraahdo PSF
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Dowlad-goboleedka Puntland ayaa war-saxaafadeed uu soo saaray ku sheegay in aanu jirin ciidan lagu magacaabo PSF oo si sharci ah uga tirsan ciidamada maamulka Puntland. Maamulka ayaa caddeeyay in hay’adaha amniga ee rasmiga ah ay yihiin kuwa lagu dhisay shuruucda Puntland, isla markaana aan la aqoonsan karin ciidan magac kale wata oo ka baxsan nidaamkaas. War-saxaafadeedka Madaxtooyada Puntland ayaa si cad loogu yiri: “Dowladda Puntland waxay caddeynaysaa inaysan jirin ciidan la yiraahdo PSF oo si sharci ah uga tirsan ciidamada difaaca Puntland.” Maamulka ayaasheegtay in dhammaan arrimaha la xiriira ciidamada ammaanka ay ku saleysan yihiin dastuurka iyo shuruucda u degsan maamulka Puntland. Hadalka Madaxtooyada ayaa ku soo beegmay xilli qaar ka mid ah waxgaradka beesha Cismaan Maxamuud ay shalay soo saareen war-saxaafadeed ay ku sheegeen in ciidamada PSF ay ka tirsan yihiin ciidamada Puntland. Waxgaradka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay wadaan dadaallo lagu dhex-dhexaadinayo Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni iyo hoggaanka PSF, si loo dejiyo xiisadda u dhexeysa labada dhinac. Khilaafka u dhexeeya maamulka Puntland iyo hoggaanka PSF ayaa soo jiitamayay tan iyo dabayaaqadii sanadkii 2021, markaas oo Madaxweyne Deni uu xilka ka qaaday Agaasimihii PSF, Jeneraal Maxamuud Cismaan Diyaano. Go’aankaas ayaa xilligaas sababay muran siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo saameeyay magaalada Boosaaso iyo deegaanno kale oo ka tirsan gobolka Bari. Bishii Maarso 2022 ayuu Madaxweyne Deni mar kale magacaabay Jeneraal Maxamuud Cismaan Diyaano, isagoo u magacaabay Agaasimaha Ciidanka Kumaandooska Amniga Puntland (Puntland Security Commando Forces – PSCF). Isla xilligaas ayay dowladdu dib-u-habeyn ku sameysay hay’adda, iyadoo u kala qaybisay laba qeybood oo kala ah PSCF iyo PISF, si dib loogu habeeyo qaab-dhismeedka ciidamada amniga. Inkasta oo dib-u-habeyntaasi la sameeyay, haddana khilaafka u dhexeeya maamulka Puntland iyo hoggaanka PSF si buuxda uma dhammaan. Dhinacyada ayaa marar kala duwan isku dhacay, waxaana colaadahaasi sababeen khasaare isugu jira dhimasho, dhaawac iyo burbur hantiyeed, gaar ahaan magaalada Boosaaso iyo nawaaxigeeda. Toddobaadkii hore ayaa mar kale dagaal ka dhacay deegaanka Laag ee degmada Boosaaso, halkaas oo ay isku fara saareen ciidamada Puntland iyo ciidamada PSF oo haatan taabacsan Dowladda Federaalka. Inkastoo aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin khasaaraha ka dhashay dagaalkaas, haddana wuxuu sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo amniga gobolka Bari iyo saameynta uu khilaafku ku yeelan karo xasilloonida Puntland. War-saxaafadeedka cusub ee Madaxtooyada Puntland ayaa muujinaya in dowladda ay weli ku adkeysaneyso mowqifkeeda ku aaddan qaab-dhismeedka ciidamada ammaanka, xilli ay socdaan dadaallo ay wadaan waxgaradka iyo odayaasha dhaqanka oo lagu doonayo in xal siyaasadeed looga gaaro khilaafka u dhexeeya dowladda iyo hoggaanka PSF, si looga fogaado isku dhacyo horleh iyo xiisado amni. The post Puntland oo shaacisay in aysan aqoonsaneyn ciidan la yiraahdo PSF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Manchester United oo wada-hadallo la yeelatay wakiillada khadka dhexe ee kooxda Roma, Manu Koné.
items.description: By Saleeymaan Alcadaala Sports Reporter, Radio Dalsan TV Manchester United ayaa xiriir toos ah la sameysay wakiillada khadka dhexe ee kooxda Roma, Manu Koné , si ay uga wada hadlaan suurtagalnimada in ciyaaryahanka reer France uu u soo wareego Old Trafford. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, kooxda Ingiriiska ayaan weli wada-hadal rasmi ah la furin Roma, mana aysan gudbin wax dalab ah oo ku saabsan ciyaaryahanka 25-jirka ah, sida uu sheegay wariyaha caanka ah Fabrizio Romano . Xiisaha Manchester United ayaa yimid xilli ay kooxdu doonayso inay ku xoojiso khadka dhexe ka dib markii Casemiro uu kooxda ka tagay, Manuel Ugarte uu dhaawac culus ka soo gaaray Koobka Adduunka, iyo waxaa la filayaa in sii joogitaanka Mason Mount uu yahay mid aan la hubin . United waxay horay u soo wareegtay laba ciyaaryahan oo khadka dhexe ah xagaagan: Andrey Santos oo kaga yimid Chelsea £48 milyan, iyo Youri Tielemans oo kaga yimid Aston Villa £35 milyan . Sida ay sheegeen ilo wareeg ah, Manchester United ayaa heshiis horudhac ah kula gaartay Koné shuruudaha shaqsiyeed, waxayna hadda diiradda saareen wada-xaajoodka lacagta wareegidda . Kooxda Roma ayaa hadda ku qiimeysa Koné €60 milyan , halka Manchester United ay soo bandhigtay qiyaastii €50 milyan . Roma waxay u baahan tahay inay iibiso ciyaaryahan ka hor dhammaadka bisha si ay uga gudubto heerarka maaliyadeed, taasoo keeni karta inay hoos u dhigto qiimaha . Koné, oo 25 jir ah, ayaa soo jiitay indhaha kooxo badan ka dib bandhigyadiisa cajiibka ah ee Koobka Adduunka 2026 , halkaas oo uu qayb muhiim ka qaatay xulka Faransiiska . Waxaa la sheegay in Arsenal ay sidoo kale xiiseeyso ciyaaryahanka, balse Manchester United ayaa hoggaanka ugu jirta tartanka saxiixiisa . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, maamulka Manchester United ayaa weli qiimeynaya fursado kale, oo ay ku jiraan Carlos Baleba oo Brighton ah iyo Aurelien Tchouameni oo Real Madrid ah . Tchouameni ayaa la sheegay inuu kusii dhawaahey heshiis cusub oo Real Madrid ah, halka Baleba lagu qiimeeyay £100 milyan . Waxaa la filayaa in Manchester United ay go’aan ka gaari doonto haddii ay sii wado socodka Koné ama ay u weecdo bartilmaameedyada kale, iyadoo wada-hadallada la filayo inay galaan heer xasaasi ah dhammaadka bisha . The post Manchester United oo wada-hadallo la yeelatay wakiillada khadka dhexe ee kooxda Roma, Manu Koné. first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: DABAGAL: Waa Sidee Hirgelinta Canshuurta Macaashmacaashka (VAT) ee Muqdisho?
items.description: Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii u danbeeyay xoogga saartay hirgelinta canshuurta macaashmacaashka (VAT) oo heerkeedu yahay 5%. Dawladdu waxay canshuurtan ku tilmaantay il muhiim u ah kordhinta dakhliga gudaha iyo maalgelinta adeegyada aasaasiga ah, iyadoo mas’uuliyiintu marar badan ku celceliyeen in si caddaalad iyo sinnaan leh looga qaadayo ganacsiyada iyo dadka adeegyada isticmaala. Hasayeeshee, dabagal iyo xog-ururin ay sameeyeen wariyayaal ka tirsan Goobjoog ayaa muujinaya in hirgelinta VAT-ku ay si weyn ugu kooban tahay hoteellada waaweyn iyo xarumaha ganacsi ee nidaamkoodu muuqdo, halka suuqyada waaweyn ee caasimadda, gaar ahaan Bakaaraha, iyo ganacsiyo kale oo badan aan si isku mid ah looga dhaqan gelin. Ganacsato ka hawlgasha Muqdisho, kuwaas oo qaarkood codsaday inaan magacyadooda la shaacin sababo amni iyo ganacsi awgood, ayaa Goobjoog u sheegay in saraakiil ka tirsan hay’adaha canshuuraha ay ganacsatada qaarkood la galaan heshiisyo aan rasmi ahayn, kuwaas oo lagu dhimayo ama gebi ahaanba lagaga baaqsanayo bixinta VAT-ka rasmiga ah. Mid ka mid ah ganacsatada Suuqa Bakaaraha ayaa sheegay in xarumo ganacsi oo badan aysan adeegsan nidaamka rasmiga ah ee lagu diiwaangeliyo laguna xareeyo canshuuraha, balse taa beddelkeeda ay saraakiisha canshuuraha qaarkood la galaan heshiis afka ah, iyaga oo bil kasta siiya lacag go’an. “Waxaa jira goobo badan oo aan VAT rasmi ah laga qaadin. Ganacsatada qaar waxay bixiyaan lacag go’an oo aan si rasmi ah ugu dhicin khasnadda dawladda,” ayuu yiri ganacsaduhu. Xogta ay Goobjoog ururisay waxay tilmaamaysaa in hoteellada waaweyn iyo xarumaha adeegyada bixiya ay yihiin meelaha sida joogtada ah looga dhaqangeliyo canshuurta, maadaama hay’adaha dawladdu ay si dhow ula socdaan dhaqdhaqaaqyada koontooyinkooxa maaliyadeed. Dhanka kale, ilo kala duwan ayaa sheegaya in ganacsiyo kale ay helaan marinno ay kaga baxsadaan nidaamka canshuurqaaxista ee rasmiga ah. Aragtida shacabka iyo falcelinta bulshada Muqdisho ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya in culayska VAT-ka si gaar ah looga dareemayo hoteellada iyo goobaha adeegyada muuqda, halka suuqyada iyo xarumaha kale aan si la mid ah looga arkin hirgelinta canshuurta. Qaar ka mid ah dadka Muqdisho ayaa sheegay inay dareemayaan in culayska canshuuraha lagu koobay adeegyada ay bulshadu sida joogtada ah u isticmaasho, halka ganacsiyo kale oo waaweyn aysan u muuqan kuwo si la mid ah u gudanaya waajibaadkooda canshuureed. “Markaad hoteel tagto ama adeeg isticmaasho, VAT waa lagaa qaadayaa, laakiin markaad suuqyada kale wax ka iibsanayso, marar badan wax canshuur ah lagama arko,” ayuu yiri mid ka mid ah dadka Muqdisho ku nool. Dadka falanqeeya dhaqaalaha ayaa ka digaya in haddii nidaamka canshuuruhu uusan noqon mid daahfuran oo si siman loogu dabaqo dhammaan ganacsiyada, ay taasi dhaawici karto kalsoonida shacabka, isla markaasna wiiqi karto hufnaanta ururinta dakhliga dawladda. Khubarrada dhaqaaluhu waxay ku baaqayaan in Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya ay samayso dabagal iyo islaxisaabtan dhab ah oo lagu ogaanayo habka loo ururiyo dakhliga canshuuraha, halka uu ku dhacayo iyo sababta ganacsiyo badan loogu tuhunsan yahay inay ka baxsanayaan nidaamka VAT-ka. Haddii VAT-ka si siman oo hufan loo hirgeliyo, wuxuu si weyn u kordhin karaa dakhliga dawladda, isla markaasna wuxuu xoojin karaa maalgelinta adeegyada bulshada. Hasayeeshee, haddii hirgelintiisu noqoto mid aan sinnayn, waxay dhaawici kartaa u hoggaansanaanta canshuuraha, waxayna sii ballaarin kartaa qaybta dhaqaalaha aan rasmiga ahayn, taas oo hoos u dhigaysa dakhliga guud ee la filayo. Khubarradu waxay, sidoo kale, ku talinayaan in la xoojiyo nidaamyada elektaroonigga ah ee diiwaangelinta iyo ururinta canshuuraha, si loo yareeyo musuqmaasuqa, wax-isdabamarinta iyo faragelinta shaqsiyaadka. Marka la eego isbarbardhigga gobolka, Kenya waxay VAT-ka ku qaaddaa heer dhan 16%, halka Itoobiya uu heerku yahay 15%. Soomaaliya, dhankeeda, VAT-ku waa 5% oo keliya. Sidaas awgeed, caqabadda ugu weyn ma aha heerka canshuurta, balse waa sida aan sinnayn ee loo hirgeliyo. Khubarro badan ayaa xaaladdan ku soo kooba: “Canshuur yar iyo fulin daciif ahi waxay horseedaan dakhli hoose.” Arrintan ayaa ku soo aadaysa xilli Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya ay dadaal ugu jirto kordhinta dakhliga gudaha iyo yaraynta kutiirsanaanta deeqaha dibadda. Hasayeeshee, warbixinnada la xiriira canshuur-la-baxsiga iyo heshiisyada aan rasmiga ahayn ayaa dhalinaya su’aalo ku saabsan daahfurnaanta nidaamka VAT-ka iyo awoodda dawladdu u leedahay la dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa ka dhex jira hay’adaha maaliyadda. Haddii aan la qaadin tallaabooyin adag oo lagu xoojinayo dabagalka, isla xisaabtanka iyo hirgelinta siman, waxaa laga cabsi qabaa in VAT-ku ku koobnaado hoteellada iyo goobaha sida muuqata loo maamulo, halka suuqyada waaweyn iyo ganacsiyada awoodda leh ay sii wataan ka baxsiga nidaamka canshuuraha, iyaga oo ay arrintaas u fududaynayaan saraakiil loo xil saaray ilaalinta iyo fulinta nidaamka.

items.title: Puntland Warns Galmudug Over Alleged Militia Transit
items.description: Puntland’s regional government on Saturday accused neighboring Galmudug State of allowing airports and territory under its control to be used for moving militia and military supplies allegedly organized by Somalia’s federal government to threaten Puntland’s security. The statement, issued by the Puntland administration, called on Galmudug to halt any such passage and instead prioritize good-neighborly relations and security cooperation between the two states. No immediate response has come from Galmudug. The accusation lands amid a rapid deterioration in relations between Garowe and Mogadishu, driven by a dispute over who commands security forces operating in Puntland and by wider disagreements over federal constitutional changes and the expired mandate of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government. It matters now because the rhetoric has already translated into gunfire: just a week earlier, two rival Puntland-aligned forces clashed on the ground, raising fears that political friction could escalate into broader armed conflict in the country’s northeast. Puntland’s statement said it was monitoring military activity it linked to forces under federal command and to the Puntland Security Force (PSF), which Garowe says has effectively aligned itself with Mogadishu. The administration described the activity as a direct threat to its security. Puntland has accused Somalia’s “term-expired” federal leadership of orchestrating military movements aimed at destabilizing the northeastern state, alleging the goal was to incite conflict and undermine its system of government. Garowe also disputed the legal standing of the PSF, saying no force known as “PSF” legally forms part of the Puntland Defense Forces, and that no Somali federal forces are authorized to operate militarily inside Puntland-administered territory. The warning follows a violent standoff on July 20 in the Laag area of Bari region, where PSF troops and Puntland Dervish forces clashed before officials intervened to defuse the tension, after PSF forces traveling from Bosaso to Hafun were stopped at a bridge near Laag. Radio Dalsan reported at least one PSF soldier was killed in a related exchange in the nearby Madar-Jiif area. Puntland forces later said they seized military vehicles, weapons and several PSF fighters during a follow-up operation, according to regional media. The post Puntland Warns Galmudug Over Alleged Militia Transit first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Al-Shabab Attacks Garissa Mast, Teacher Missing
items.description: Suspected al-Shabab militants attacked Abakaile village in Dadaab, Garissa County, on Saturday night, opening fire on a Safaricom telecommunications mast before fleeing the scene, area officials confirmed. The assault, which took place around 8 p.m., briefly sparked fears that a local teacher had been abducted, though authorities later said all teachers in the area had been accounted for. The attack is the latest in a string of assaults on communications infrastructure along Kenya’s border with Somalia, a tactic security analysts say al-Shabab uses to disrupt police coordination and sow fear among residents before or after larger operations. It comes just two days after militants struck a security camp in neighbouring Mandera County, underscoring a resurgence of cross-border activity that is testing Kenya’s northeastern security apparatus. No injuries were reported in the Garissa attack despite initial alarm among residents. Area Chief Mohammed Hutle Bull confirmed the incident, saying no injuries were reported despite initial concerns about residents’ safety. Confusion initially spread after a teacher working in the area went missing in the aftermath of the raid. But it was later established that the teacher had been caught up in the confusion after the militants stormed a residential area, with four teachers residing in the area all accounted for afterward, according to Chief Bull. Indirectly, police sources indicated that security agencies have launched an operation to track down the fleeing attackers and to reinforce protection around the mast, though neither the Teachers Service Commission nor the National Police Service had issued an official statement by the time of publication. The incident echoes previous attempts targeting the same area. Authorities noted the latest incident mirrors a similar attack in the same area four years ago, in which a suspected al-Shabab operative died after explosives detonated prematurely during an assault on the telecommunications facility. The Garissa attack follows Friday’s assault on the Fino security camp in Mandera County, where police officers exchanged fire with militants, forcing their retreat. A student was shot in the stomach during that incident and was reported in stable condition after being taken to hospital. Police have since launched a pursuit operation in Mandera as well. Telecommunications masts have repeatedly been targeted in Kenya’s northeastern counties over the past decade, with past attacks in Garissa, Mandera and Wajir resulting in fatalities among police, civilians and schoolchildren. Security agencies say enhanced surveillance around critical infrastructure remains a priority as cross-border militant activity persists. items.title: Kiisaska Ebola ee DR Congo oo kor u dhaafay 3,000
items.description: Dowladda Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo (DRC) ayaa shaacisay in tirada dadka si rasmi ah looga xaqiijiyey cudurka Ebola ay kor u dhaaftay 3,000 oo kiis, iyadoo cudurkan uu sababay dhimashada 1,354 qof, sida lagu sheegay xog ay dowladdu soo saartay Sabtidii. Warbixinta ayaa muujinaysa in guud ahaan la diiwaangeliyey 3,075 kiis oo la xaqiijiyey, taasoo ka dhigaysa mid ka mid ah dillaacyadii ugu waaweynaa ee Ebola ee dalkaasi soo mara sannadihii u dambeeyey. Mas’uuliyiinta caafimaadka ayaa sii xoojinaya dadaallada lagu xakameynayo faafitaanka cudurka, iyagoo kordhiyey baaritaannada, raadraaca dadka la kulmay bukaannada iyo adeegyada daaweynta ee goobaha uu cudurku sida weyn uga jiro. Sidoo kale waxaa socata wacyi-gelin bulshada lagu barayo calaamadaha cudurka iyo hababka looga hortagi karo, ayadoo dhanka kale, ururro caafimaad oo ka shaqeeya gobolka ay ka digeen in tirada rasmiga ah ee la xaqiijiyey laga yaabo inay ka yar tahay xaqiiqada dhabta ah. Waxay sheegeen in xaaladaha amni, gaadiidka oo adag iyo adeegyada caafimaad ee meelaha qaar ay caqabad ku yihiin in dhammaan kiisaska la ogaado. Ebola waa cudur halis ah oo fayras uu keeno, waxaana uu ku faafaa taabashada dheecaannada jirka ee qof qaba ama geeriyooday, ayadoo Calaamadihiisa ay ka midyihii qandho daran, madax-xanuun, murqo xanuun, matag, shuban iyo dhiig-bax xaaladaha daran. Hay’adaha caafimaadka ee gudaha iyo kuwa caalamiga ah ayaa sii wada iskaashiga ay kula jiraan dowladda Congo si loo xakameeyo faafitaanka cudurka, loona yareeyo khasaaraha naf iyo maalba leh ee ka dhashay dillaacan cusub. Sida ay muujinayso xogtii ugu dambeysay ee dowladda, 3,075 qof ayaa laga helay Ebola halka 1,354 qof ay u geeriyoodeen cudurka, taasoo mar kale iftiiminaysa baahida loo qabo in la dardargeliyo tallaabooyinka caafimaad iyo ka hortagga faafitaanka fayraska.

items.title: Five MPs walk out as North East parliament splinters
items.description: Five members of the North East administration’s regional parliament announced their resignation on Sunday, citing unresolved disputes over governance and the direction of the young Somali federal state. The lawmakers, Makhtal Said Mohomoud, Ahmed Caabi Hassan, Abdulsalam Abdullahi Mohamed, Sadiq Jama Muse and Ahmed Ali Mohamed, said in a joint statement that they had formally relinquished their seats after internal dialogue failed to resolve their concerns. The departures matter because the North East administration is barely a year old, having been formally established in 2025 following years of conflict in Las Anod between Somaliland forces and SSC-Khatumo militias. Any sign of fracture in its legislature raises questions about whether the fledgling state can consolidate authority while still contesting territory and building institutions from scratch. In their statement, the five MPs said they had spent considerable time trying to resolve disagreements over how the administration was being governed through consultation, but that these efforts “had failed to produce an outcome they could accept.” They promised further details on their decision at a later date. A spokesperson for the North East administration is yet to comment publicly on the resignations, though officials close to the parliament have previously indicated they intend to press ahead with institution-building despite internal friction, according to regional media. The resignations follow closely on the heels of another political shock. Lawmaker Fahiima Yusuf Quuje recently announced she was quitting the administration entirely, declaring her support for Somaliland and renouncing the “Greater Somalia” vision she had once championed, a move that prompted the regional parliament to take formal steps regarding her membership. It is not yet clear whether the five latest lawmakers to resign intend to align with Somaliland, another administration, or remain independent. Unlike Quuje, they have not indicated any intention to defect. The North East administration, whose formation is tied to broader territorial disputes involving Puntland and Somaliland, has also faced security challenges in areas it claims. Analysts say the cohesion of its 83-member parliament — assembled last year through a clan-based power-sharing formula, will be tested further if more lawmakers follow suit. Whether Sunday’s resignations mark an isolated internal dispute or the start of a wider unraveling will likely depend on the administration’s response and whether other MPs choose to follow. The departures matter because the North East administration is barely a year old, having been formally established in 2025 following years of conflict in Las Anod between Somaliland forces and SSC-Khatumo militias. Any sign of fracture in its legislature raises questions about whether the fledgling state can consolidate authority while still contesting territory and building institutions from scratch. In their statement, the five MPs said they had spent considerable time trying to resolve disagreements over how the administration was being governed through consultation, but that these efforts “had failed to produce an outcome they could accept.” They promised further details on their decision at a later date. A spokesperson for the North East administration is yet to comment publicly on the resignations, though officials close to the parliament have previously indicated they intend to press ahead with institution-building despite internal friction, according to regional media. The resignations follow closely on the heels of another political shock. Lawmaker Fahiima Yusuf Quuje recently announced she was quitting the administration entirely, declaring her support for Somaliland and renouncing the “Greater Somalia” vision she had once championed, a move that prompted the regional parliament to take formal steps regarding her membership. It is not yet clear whether the five latest lawmakers to resign intend to align with Somaliland, another administration, or remain independent. Unlike Quuje, they have not indicated any intention to defect. The North East administration, whose formation is tied to broader territorial disputes involving Puntland and Somaliland, has also faced security challenges in areas it claims. Analysts say the cohesion of its 83-member parliament — assembled last year through a clan-based power-sharing formula, will be tested further if more lawmakers follow suit. Whether Sunday’s resignations mark an isolated internal dispute or the start of a wider unraveling will likely depend on the administration’s response and whether other MPs choose to follow. items.title: Mustaqbalka AUSSOM oo laga shirayo – Maxaa soo kordhay?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Muqdisho iyo caasimadaha Addis Ababa ee Itoobiya iyo Kampala ee Uganda waxaa ka socda wada-hadallo iyo shirar heerar kala duwan leh oo diiradda lagu saarayo mustaqbalka Howlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM). Kulamadan ayaa si gaar ah loogu falanqeynayaa sidii xal loogu heli lahaa caqabadaha dhaqaale ee soo wajahay howlgalka, kaddib markii Mareykanku hakiyay qayb ka mid ah taageeradii maaliyadeed ee uu bixin jiray. Shirarkan oo billowday horraantii bishan ayaa si isdaba joog ah uga socday saddexda magaalo, iyadoo dhinacyada ay ka qeybgalayaan mas’uuliyiin ka socota Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Midowga Afrika, waddamada ciidamada ku leh howlgalka iyo dalalka kale ee taageera amniga Soomaaliya. Wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in la qorsheynayo shir heer sare ah oo 31-ka bishan ka qabsoomi doona magaalada Kampala, kaas oo la filayo inay ka soo baxaan go’aanno la xiriira maalgelinta howlgalka, dib-u-habeyntiisa iyo qorshaha lagu sii wadi karo taageerada amniga Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, Madaxa Howlgalka AUSSOM ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ku qaabilay mas’uuliyiin ka kala socotay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mareykanka, dalalka taageera howlgalka iyo ururro caalami ah. Kulamadaas ayaa lagu falanqeeyay xaaladda amni ee dalka, caqabadaha horyaalla howlgalka iyo baahiyaha dhaqaale iyo farsamo ee lagama maarmaanka u ah sii socoshada howlgalka. Sidoo kale, wararka ayaa sheegaya in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay kulamadaas ku soo bandhigtay horumarka ay ka gaartay dhismaha ciidamada qalabka sida. Dowladda ayaa xustay in ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay sanadihii u dambeeyay muujiyeen awood ay si madax-bannaan ugu fuliyaan howlgallo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab, isla markaana ay ula wareegeen sugidda amniga xarumo muhiim ah iyo ilaalinta madaxda dowladda. Ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamaya in dowladda Soomaaliya ay waddo qorsheyaal amni oo cusub, kuwaas oo faahfaahintooda aan weli si rasmi ah loo shaacin sababo la xiriira xaaladda amniga. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa la rumeysan yahay inay qeyb ka yihiin qorshaha loogu diyaar garoobayo marxalad ay ciidamada Soomaaliyeed si buuxda ugu qaadi karaan mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa 26-kii Juun sheegay in dowladdiisu diyaarisay guluf ballaaran oo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab, isagoo xusay in qorshahaasi si rasmi ah shacabka loogu soo bandhigi doono marka la soo dhameystiro diyaar-garowgiisa dhinaca farsamada iyo howlgalka. Doodaha ku saabsan mustaqbalka AUSSOM ayaa imanaya xilli ay sii kordhayaan walaacyada ku saabsan maalgelinta howlgalka iyo sida loo xaqiijin karo in ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si buuxda ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. Dowladda Federaalka iyo Midowga Afrika ayaa hore u sheegay inay ka shaqeynayaan qorshe mideysan oo lagu xaqiijinayo kala-guurka amniga iyo sii wadista dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. items.title: Xildhibaanno hor leh oo iska casilay barlamanka maamulka Waqooyi Bari + Sababta
items.description: Laascaanood (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaanno horleh oo ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Dowlad Goboleedka Waqooyi Bari ayaa maanta is casilay, kuwaas oo sheegay in maamulka uu ka leexday ujeeddooyinkii loo aasaasay. Illaa 5 Xildhibaan oo ka tirsan Golaha Wakiilada Waqooyi Bari ayaa si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqay is casilaadooda, kadib wrasaxaafadeed ay si wadajir ah usoo saareen, waxayna kala yihiin;- 1-Xildhibaan Makhtal Saciid Maxamuud, 2-Xildhibaan Cabdisalaan Cabdullahi Maxamed, 3-Xildhibaan Sadiiq Jaamac Muuse 4-Xildhibaan Axmed Cali Maxamed 5-Axmed Caabi Shire. Wareysi uu bixiyay mid kamid ah Xildhibaannadan oo lagu magacaabo Makhtal Saciid Maxamuud, ayaa Wariye Maxamed Yuusuf Bakayle u sheegay in go’aankooda ay ku gaareen si iskood ah, isaga oo xusay inay si buuxda uga tanaasuleen xubinnimadii Baarlamaanka Maamulka Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya. “Aniga oo ku hadlayo afkooda iyo kaygaba waxaan xaqiijinayaa caddeynayaa si buuxda inaanu uga tanaasulnay, isagana casilnay xubinnimadii Baarlamaanka Waqooyi Bari, annaga oo maskax ahaan iyo miir ahaan u fiyow,” ayuu yiri Makhtal Saciid Maxamuud oo kamid ah xubnaha is casilay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in sababta ugu weyn ee ay isku casileen ay tahay in himiladii iyo hadafkii lagu dhisay maamulka ay meesha ka baxeen, wuxuuna eedda ugu wayn dusha u saaray Madaxweynaha iyo ku xigeenkiisa. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in maamulka noqday mid ay si gaar ah u maamulaan Cabdulqaadir Firdhiye iyo Cabdirashii Abwaan, ayna ka dhigeen “NGO ay jeebka ku sitaan”, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Arrinkaa waxaa keenay oo na gaarsiiyay inay naa soo go’do ujeedkii iyo hadafkii aan maamulka Waqooyi Bari u dhisanay iyo wixii qorshuhuu ahaa ee laga lahaa wax ka weecsan kana duwan in aan meeshaas kala kulanay. Haddii aan faah-faahiyo ujeedka waxa uu ahaa in ummadda ku midowday maamulkaas lagu meelmariyo noloshooda iyo horumarkooda, laakiin waxay isu bedashay wax lamid ah ama ka hooseeya NGO ina Firdhiye iyo Abwaan iska leeyihiin oo jeebka ay ku sitaan ayuu noqday,” ayuu raaciyay Xildhibaanku. Makhtal ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaday in saacadaha soo socda ay shaacin doonaan tallaabada xigta ee ay qaadi doonaan, gaar ahaan jihada ay aadayaan, maadaama ay shaaciyeen inay iska casileen Baarlamaankii ay ka tirsanaayeen. Ilaa hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay maamulka Waqooyi Bari oo ku aadan arrinta Xildhibaannadaas, waxaase lasoo warinayaa inuu socdo qorshe la doonayo in looga qaado xasaanadda, si kadib loola xisaatamo. Horay waxaa sidaan oo kale isku casishay Xildhibaan Fahiima Yuusuf Quuje oo kadib u goosatay Somaliland, taas oo maalmo kahor lagu soo dhaweeyay magaalada Hargeysa, waxayna arrintaas keentay hadal-heyn qabsatay baraha bulshada. The post Xildhibaanno hor leh oo iska casilay barlamanka maamulka Waqooyi Bari + Sababta appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maamulka Waqooyi Bari oo wajahaya Jahwareer Siyaasadeed iyo 5 xildhibaan oo is casilay
items.description: Maamulka Waqooyi Bari ayaa wajahaya xaalad siyaasadeed ah, kadib markii shan xildhibaan oo ka tirsanaa golaha wakiillada maamulkaasi ay si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqeen inay iska casileen xubinnimadoodii. Qoraal ay xildhibaannadu soo saareen ayay ku sheegeen in go’aankooda uu yimid kadib markii ay muddo dheer ka biyo diideen habka maamulka loo hoggaaminayo, isla markaana ay ku qanci waayeen jihada siyaasadeed ee uu maamulka u socdo. Waxay sheegeen inay muddo isku dayayeen inay arrimaha gudaha ku xalliyaan wada-hadal iyo talooyin, balse dadaalladaasi aysan wax natiijo ah dhalin. Xildhibaannada is-casilay ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay si rasmi ah uga tanaasuleen xubinnimadoodii golaha wakiillada maamulka Waqooyi Bari, iyagoo xusay inay mustaqbalka si faahfaahsan uga hadli doonaan arrintan. xildhibaannada is-casilay ayaa kala ah: Xildhibaan: 1) Makhtal Said Mohomoud 2) Xildhibaan Ahmed Caabi Xasan 3) Xildhibaan Abdisalaan Abdulaahi Mohamed 4) Xildhibaan Sadiq Jama Muse 5) Xildhibaan Ahmed Ali Mohamed Is-casilaaddan ayaa imaanaysa xilli dhowaan xildhibaan Fahiima Yuusuf Quuji ay ku biirtay dhinaca Somaliland, lamana oga in xubnahan cusubi ay qaadi doonaan tallaabi taas lamid ah. Is casilaadda xildhibaannadan ayaa saameyn ku yeelan karo isku-duubnida golaha wakiillada iyo mustaqbalka maamulka Waqooyi Bari, gaar ahaan iyadoo ay jiraan khilaafaad siyaasadeed oo soo noqnoqday.

items.title: Golahii Barlamaanka bariga Sool oo gabo ahaanba burburay Iyo xubno hor leh oo is casilay
items.description: Golahii barlamaanka ee bariga gobolka Sool ayaa gabi ahaanba burburay oo lagu kala yaacay tan iyo intii ay xildhibaanad Fahiima Quunje ay ka goostay magaalada Laascaanood waxa bilwday furfur iyo kala yaac kj yimid golahaasi. Waxa ayaamaha fooda inagu soo haya Somaliland soo gaadhi doona tiro aad u faro badan oo xildhibaano ah oo ka soo goostay magaaladda Laascaanood kuwaasi oo ku soo waajahan Somaliland. Dhanka kalena waxa xalay ku dhawaaqay in ay fikirkii ay aamisanaayeen ee maamulka Laascaanood ay ka tanaasuleen oo iska baxeen 5 xildhabaan oo ka doo jeeda beesha Warsangali, kuwaasi oo ay wararku sheegayaan in ay iyaga laftoodu ay wada hadal house la furteen dawladda Somaliland oo ay iyana dhawaan ku biiri doonaan Somaliland oo sh dalkoodii.

items.title: Awoodda Turkiga shidaal uga soo saari karo Soomaaliya oo shaki la geliyey + Sababta
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirkii hore ee waxbarashada Puntland, ahna falanqeeye siyaasadeed, Cali Xaaji Warsame, ayaa su’aal geliyey awoodda Turkiga uu si ganacsi ah ugu soo saari karo shidaalka ku jira badda Soomaaliya, isaga oo sheegay in howlaha hadda socda ay yihiin qodis sahamineed iyo tijaabooyin hordhac ah. Cali Xaaji Warsame oo dhowaan bixiyey wareysi ayaa sheegay in markabka Turkiga ee ka howlgalaya xeebaha Soomaaliya uusan weli bilaabin soo saarista shidaal ganacsi, balse uu qodayo ceel tijaabo ah oo lagu xaqiijinayo in goobta la baarayo ay leedahay kayd shidaal ama gaas oo dhaqaale ahaan loo soo saari karo. Waxa uu ku dooday in baaritaanka hadda socda iyo soo saarista shidaalka ganacsi ay yihiin laba marxaladood oo aad u kala fog, isla markaana aysan sax ahayn in bulshada loo muujiyo in Soomaaliya ay qarka u saaran tahay inay shidaal dhoofiso. “Bulshada waxaa loo sawirayaa in wax-soo-saarka shidaalku uu dhow yahay, halka geeddi-socodku uu weli sanado badan qaadan karo,” ayuu yiri Cali Xaaji Warsame. Sida uu sheegay, Turkiga weli ma laha awoodda farsamo iyo dhaqaale ee uu keligiis ugu horumarin karo ceelasha badda ee lagu wareejiyey heshiiska shidaalka ee uu la galay dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in Ankara ay ugu dambeyn u baahan doonto shirkado waaweyn oo caalami ah oo ku takhasusay shidaalka badda, kuwaas oo awood u leh inay maalgeliyaan qodista ceelasha, dhismaha kaabayaasha iyo soo saarista shidaalka. Cali Xaaji Warsame ayaa sidoo kale saadaaliyey in Soomaaliya aysan arki doonin shidaal badeed oo si ganacsi ah loo soo saaro ka hor sanadka 2034, xitaa haddii qodista hadda socota lagu ogaado kayd shidaal oo wanaagsan. Waxa uu sheegay in marka hore loo baahan yahay in la xaqiijiyo jiritaanka shidaalka, la qiimeeyo baaxadda kaydka, la helo maalgelin caalami ah, lana dhiso kaabayaal qaali ah oo suuragelinaya soo saarista iyo dhoofinta shidaalka. Ballan-qaadka Erdogan Hadallada Cali Xaaji Warsame ayaa ka duwan rajada ay muujiyeen madaxda Turkiga iyo dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Madaxweynaha Turkiga, Recep Tayyip Erdogan, ayaa bishii May sheegay in Ankara ay rajeyneyso inay lix ilaa sagaal bilood gudahood ku soo gabagabeyso qodista ceelka shidaalka ee laga fulinayo biyaha Soomaaliya, haddii xaaladaha cimilada iyo badda ay saamaxaan. Erdogan ayaa howlgalka ku tilmaamay mid leh “muhiimad taariikhi ah”, maadaama uu yahay qodistii ugu horreysay ee shidaal-badeed oo Turkigu ka fuliyo meel ka baxsan dalkiisa. “Waxaan rajeyneynaa inaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee walaalaha ah, oo muddo dheer la daalaa-dhacayay xasillooni-darro iyo macluul, gaarsiino bishaarada ay sugayeen,” ayuu yiri Erdogan. Markabka qodista ee Çağrı Bey ayaa ceelka Curad-1 ka qodaya meel qiyaastii 372 kiiloomitir u jirta Muqdisho. Qorshaha ayaa ah in markabku gaaro qoto dhan 7,500 mitir, iyadoo howlgalka qodista loo qorsheeyay inuu socdo 288 maalmood. Natiijada qodista ayaa lagu ogaan doonaa in goobta ay ku jirto shidaal ama gaas, inta uu le’eg yahay kaydkaas iyo in soo saaristiisu dhaqaale ahaan faa’iido leedahay. DF oo rajo muujisay Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa qodista ku tilmaantay tallaabo taariikhi ah oo dalka u horseedi karta inuu markii ugu horreysay ka faa’iideysto kheyraadka shidaalka iyo gaaska. Wasiirka Batroolka iyo Macdanta Soomaaliya, Daahir Shire Maxamed, ayaa sheegay in markabka Turkiga uusan biyaha Soomaaliya u imaan howlgal astaan uun ah, balse uu fulinayo qodis dhab ah. “Markabka qodista marka uu yimaado biyaha Soomaaliya ee Badweynta Hindiya, uma imaanayo arrin astaan ah. Kalluumeysi uma imaanayo. Wuxuu u imaanayaa inuu qodo,” ayuu yiri wasiirku. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in howlaha shidaalka loo fulinayo si daah-furan, isla markaana loogu talagalay inay faa’iido u yeeshaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed. “Maalmo wanaagsan ayaa soo socda. Ma jiraan wax la qarinayo. Hannaankan si daah-furan ayaa loo fulinayaa, waxaana loo fulinayaa danta shacabka Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri Daahir Shire. Mas’uuliyiinta dowladda ayaa ku doodaya in iskaashiga Turkiga uu Soomaaliya ka caawinayo inay hesho farsamada, maalgelinta iyo waayo-aragnimada looga baahan yahay horumarinta kheyraadka dabiiciga ah. Hase yeeshee, qodista ceel sahamineed oo lagu ogaado shidaal kama dhigna in wax-soo-saarka ganacsigu isla markiiba bilaabanayo. Haddii shidaal la helo, waxaa xigi kara qiimeynno farsamo, daraasado dhaqaale, qorshe horumarineed, maalgelin iyo dhismaha kaabayaasha wax-soo-saarka. Dhaliisha heshiiska Wasiirkii hore ee Puntland ayaa sidoo kale dhaliilay qodobbada heshiiska shidaalka ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, isaga oo ku eedeeyey inaan heshiiska si buuxda loogu bandhigin shacabka iyo hay’adaha qaranka. Waxa uu ku andacooday in Turkiga loo oggolaaday inuu helo saami gaaraya boqolkiiba 90 dakhliga ama wax-soo-saarka shidaalka, isaga oo heshiiska ku tilmaamay mid aan daah-furneyn oo aan dan weyn ugu jirin Soomaaliya. Hase yeeshee, sheegashadaas iyo qaabka uu boqolkiiba 90-ku u shaqeynayo weli waxaa ka jira dood. Dowladda ayaa ku doodda in lacagaha ama shidaalka ay qaadan karto shirkadda Turkiga ay la xiriiraan dib-u-soo-celinta kharashaadka sahaminta, qodista iyo horumarinta ceelasha, ee aysan ahayn boqolkiiba 90 faa’iidada saafiga ah. Faahfaahin dhammeystiran oo ay labada dowladood si fudud ugu sharxayaan kharashaadka, dakhliga iyo saamiga uu dhinac kasta heli doono ayaan weli si ballaaran loogu soo bandhigin bulshada. Cali Xaaji Warsame ayaa ku eedeeyey mas’uuliyiinta dowladda inay bulshada geliyeen rajooyin ka horreeya xaqiiqada farsamo iyo tan maaliyadeed ee warshadaha shidaalka. Dhaliishiisa waxaa la qaba aqoonyahanno, siyaasiyiin iyo shaqsiyaad kale oo Soomaaliyeed oo muddooyinkii dambe su’aalo ka keenayay hufnaanta, sharcinimada iyo danaha ku jira iskaashiga shidaalka ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga. Eedeymahaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin, waxaana dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ay iskaashigooda ku tilmaamaan mid ku dhisan danaha labada dal. Iskaashi ballaaranaya Turkiga ayaa sanadihii dambe si weyn u ballaariyey joogitaankiisa Soomaaliya, isaga oo ka shaqeeya dhinacyada amniga, tababarka ciidamada, kaabayaasha, gargaarka bani’aadannimo iyo horumarinta tamarta. Heshiis ay kala saxiixdeen labada dowladood ayaa dhigaya iskaashi ku saabsan sahaminta, qiimeynta, horumarinta iyo soo saarista shidaalka iyo gaaska ku jira qaar kamid ah dhulka iyo biyaha Soomaaliya. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si joogto ah u difaacday iskaashiga, iyadoo sheegtay in howlaha loo fulinayo si waafaqsan sharciga dalka, isla markaana natiijadoodu mustaqbalka faa’iido u yeelan doonto shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Turkiga ayaa isna heshiiska ku tilmaamay qeyb kamid ah iskaashi istaraatiiji ah oo ka ballaaran shidaalka, kaas oo lagu taageerayo amniga, dowlad-dhiska iyo horumarka dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya. items.title: War cusub oo ka soo kordhay weerarkii Berlin iyo magaca tumnaha oo la shaaciyey
items.description: Booliiska Berlin ayaa shaaciyay in tuhmanaha lagu magacaabo Abdul B., oo ah nin 21 jir ah oo caato ah lehna timo madow. Waxay sheegeen inuu xirnaa funaanad madow oo koofiyad leh iyo surwaal cad. Sida lagu sheegay bayaanka booliiska, waxaa lagu tuhunsan yahay inuu dhaawacay dhowr qof oo ku sugnaa deegaanka Tiergarten, isla markaana uu weli baxsad yahay. Booliisku waxay intaas ku dareen: “Waxaa la rumeysan yahay in hal ama in ka badan oo qof ay ka carareen gaariga kadib dhacdada.” Waxay sidoo kale sheegeen: “Waxaa intaa dheer, waxaa la soo sheegay in dhowr qof lagu dhaawacay hub af leh.”
