items.title: Dagaalka Iran oo ku fiday Badda Cas iyo Badda Caspian, iyadoo Maraykanku hakiyay duqeymihii tooska ahaa
items.description: Calaamado muujinaya in colaadda u dhexeysa Mareykanka iyo Iiraan iyo xulafadeedu ay sii ballaaraneyso ayaa soo baxay horraantii toddobaadkan, iyadoo weerarro cusub laga soo sheegay Badda Cas iyo Badda Caspian. Xoogagga Xuuthiyiinta ee Yemen, oo taageero ka hela Iiraan, ayaa sheegay inay gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku weerareen xarumo shidaal oo ay leedahay shirkadda Sucuudiga ee Aramco, gaar ahaan magaalooyinka Jizan iyo Yanbu ee xeebta Badda Cas. Muuqaallo la baahiyey ayaa muujinaya qiiq weyn oo ka kacaya agagaarka warshadda sifeynta shidaalka ee Jizan, halka warar hordhac ahi ay tilmaamayaan in bakhaarro shidaal ay waxyeello soo gaartay. Dhanka kale, ilo amni oo Giriig ah ayaa sheegay in nidaamka difaaca gantaallada Patriot uu soo riday laba gantaal oo loo soo ganay xarumaha shidaalka ee Yanbu. Dekedda Yanbu ayaa muhiim u ah dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga, maadaama ay tahay marin kale oo looga maarmo marin-biyoodka Hormuz oo ay Iiraan xanibaad ku soo rogtay. Sidoo kale, dowladda Iiraan ayaa ku eedeysay Ukraine inay weerartay markab ganacsi oo Iiraan leedahay oo marayey Badda Caspian-ka. Tehran waxay sheegtay in qaraxa markabka haleelay uu sababay dhimashada hal shaqaale iyo dhaawaca mid kale, iyadoo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan ay u yeertay wakiilka Ukraine si ay uga gudbiso cabasho rasmi ah. Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy ayaa dhankiisa sheegay in ciidamadiisu ay fuliyeen weerarro fog oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday maraakiib sida qalabka milatariga, balse ma uusan caddeyn waddanka ay maraakiibtaasi ka tirsanaayeen. Dhanka Maraykanka, militarigu wuxuu xaqiijiyay in cunaqabateynta badda ee ka dhanka ah Iiraan ay weli socoto, inkastoo la hakiyay duqeymihii habeenlaha ahaa ee socday 13-kii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay. Sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in Madaxweynaha uu weli doorbidayo xal diblomaasiyadeed, balse uu Iran u caddeeyay cawaaqibka ka dhalan kara haddii aysan si dhab ah uga qeybgelin wada-hadallada. Warbaahinta New York Times ayaa sidoo kale werisay in Madaxweyne Trump uu si ku meel gaar ah uga laabtay qorshe lagu ballaarin lahaa weerarrada ka dhanka ah Iran, sababo la xiriira cabsi laga qabo in colaaddu ku faafto gobolka oo dhan, saameynna ku yeelato dhaqaalaha caalamka iyo sahayda tamarta. Gudaha Yemen, ciidamada dowladda ee ay Sacuudigu taageeraan ayaa duqeymo ka fuliyay saldhigyo iyo bakhaarro hub oo ay leeyihiin Xuuthiyiinta gobollada Marib iyo Al-Jawf. Dhinacyada dagaallamaya ayaa sidoo kale bilaabay inay ciidamo ku urursadaan jiidaha hore, taasoo sare u qaadaysa walaaca laga qabo in dib u qarxo dagaalkii sokeeye ee Yemen, kaas oo xabbad-joojin ku jiray tan iyo sanadkii 2022. Falanqeeyayaashu waxay ka digayaan in haddii weerarrada Xuuthiyiintu sii socdaan, ay halis geli karaan isu socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Badda Cas iyo sahayda shidaalka caalamka, taasoo sii xumeyn karta xiisadda Bariga Dhexe iyo saameynta ay ku leedahay suuqyada tamarta ee dunida.

Dhanka kale, ilo amni oo Giriig ah ayaa sheegay in nidaamka difaaca gantaallada Patriot uu soo riday laba gantaal oo loo soo ganay xarumaha shidaalka ee Yanbu. Dekedda Yanbu ayaa muhiim u ah dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga, maadaama ay tahay marin kale oo looga maarmo marin-biyoodka Hormuz oo ay Iiraan xanibaad ku soo rogtay. Sidoo kale, dowladda Iiraan ayaa ku eedeysay Ukraine inay weerartay markab ganacsi oo Iiraan leedahay oo marayey Badda Caspian-ka. Tehran waxay sheegtay in qaraxa markabka haleelay uu sababay dhimashada hal shaqaale iyo dhaawaca mid kale, iyadoo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan ay u yeertay wakiilka Ukraine si ay uga gudbiso cabasho rasmi ah. Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy ayaa dhankiisa sheegay in ciidamadiisu ay fuliyeen weerarro fog oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday maraakiib sida qalabka milatariga, balse ma uusan caddeyn waddanka ay maraakiibtaasi ka tirsanaayeen. Dhanka Maraykanka, militarigu wuxuu xaqiijiyay in cunaqabateynta badda ee ka dhanka ah Iiraan ay weli socoto, inkastoo la hakiyay duqeymihii habeenlaha ahaa ee socday 13-kii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay. Sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in Madaxweynaha uu weli doorbidayo xal diblomaasiyadeed, balse uu Iran u caddeeyay cawaaqibka ka dhalan kara haddii aysan si dhab ah uga qeybgelin wada-hadallada. Warbaahinta New York Times ayaa sidoo kale werisay in Madaxweyne Trump uu si ku meel gaar ah uga laabtay qorshe lagu ballaarin lahaa weerarrada ka dhanka ah Iran, sababo la xiriira cabsi laga qabo in colaaddu ku faafto gobolka oo dhan, saameynna ku yeelato dhaqaalaha caalamka iyo sahayda tamarta. Gudaha Yemen, ciidamada dowladda ee ay Sacuudigu taageeraan ayaa duqeymo ka fuliyay saldhigyo iyo bakhaarro hub oo ay leeyihiin Xuuthiyiinta gobollada Marib iyo Al-Jawf. Dhinacyada dagaallamaya ayaa sidoo kale bilaabay inay ciidamo ku urursadaan jiidaha hore, taasoo sare u qaadaysa walaaca laga qabo in dib u qarxo dagaalkii sokeeye ee Yemen, kaas oo xabbad-joojin ku jiray tan iyo sanadkii 2022. Falanqeeyayaashu waxay ka digayaan in haddii weerarrada Xuuthiyiintu sii socdaan, ay halis geli karaan isu socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Badda Cas iyo sahayda shidaalka caalamka, taasoo sii xumeyn karta xiisadda Bariga Dhexe iyo saameynta ay ku leedahay suuqyada tamarta ee dunida.

items.title: Wadajir Leader Calls for Independent Election Commission as Key to Breaking Somalia’s Political Deadlock
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Wadajir Party leader Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame has argued that Somalia’s prolonged electoral dispute can only be resolved through the creation of a genuinely independent election commission agreed upon by all major political stakeholders. Speaking as negotiations over the country’s electoral future continue in Mogadishu, Abdishakur said the management of elections must be removed from the control of the Federal Government, federal member states, and political parties alike. Instead, he called for a neutral institution capable of administering a transparent and credible electoral process. “The Federal Government, the federal member states, the opposition, and the outgoing administrations must jointly agree on an electoral framework that all sides can trust,” he said. Abdishakur stressed that he does not support an electoral system administered solely by the Federal Government or by regional state authorities, arguing that only an independent electoral body can command broad public confidence. Addressing Somalia’s longstanding 4.5 power-sharing formula, he noted that while parliamentary seats continue to be allocated along clan lines, voting itself should be open to all eligible citizens residing in the constituency where the seat is contested. He said this would represent a significant improvement over previous systems in which electoral outcomes were largely determined by selected delegates or committees perceived to be under the influence of incumbent authorities. He further argued that any future election commission must enjoy complete institutional independence, with exclusive responsibility for voter registration, election administration, ballot counting, and the official announcement of results, free from political interference. Abdishakur also criticized the conduct of previous elections in some federal member states, claiming that in certain cases the winners were effectively known before ballots were cast, undermining public confidence in the credibility and competitiveness of the electoral process. His remarks come as the second round of Somalia’s electoral negotiations continues in Mogadishu under Turkish facilitation. The talks bring together representatives of the Federal Government, the Somali Salvation Council, the Nabad iyo Nolol political movement, and international partners including Turkey, the United States, the United Kingdom, the European Union, and the United Nations. According to informed sources, mediators have received four separate electoral proposals from the participating political groups. Despite continued discussions, however, no final agreement has been reached, with the structure, authority, and independence of the election management body remaining the central point of contention. As negotiations enter a critical phase, many political observers believe that the question of who manages Somalia’s elections may ultimately prove just as decisive as how those elections are conducted, making the composition of an independent electoral commission one of the most consequential issues in the country’s ongoing search for political consensus. items.title: Puntland oo eedeysay Dowladda Federaalka, baaqna u dirtay Galmudug iyo shacabka reer Puntland
items.description: Maamulka Puntland ayaa war-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay maanta ku sheegtay inay si adag u cambaareyneyso waxa ay ku tilmaantay dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo uu wado Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Puntland waxay ku eedeysay tallaabooyinkaas inay halis ku yihiin colaado hor leh iyo xasilloonida nidaamka dowladnimada Puntland. Puntland ayaa sidoo kale caddeysay in ciidanka keliya ee sharci ahaan uga hawlgali kara deegaannadeeda ay yihiin Ciidamada Difaaca Puntland (PSF), isla markaana aysan aqbali doonin ciidamo ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka oo ka howlgala gudaha Puntland. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa sidoo kale fariin loogu diray Dowladda Galmudug iyo beesha caalamka, iyadoo Puntland ugu baaqday Galmudug inay ka fogaato ku lug yeelashada dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan ama maleeshiyaad lagu dhibaateynayo shacabka reer Puntland, isla markaana la xoojiyo deris wanaagga, iskaashiga amniga iyo nabadgelyada. Ugu dambeyn, maamulkavPuntland waxay shacabka reer Puntland ugu baaqday inay ilaashadaan midnimada, deganaanshaha iyo dowladnimada Puntland.

items.title: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha oo Baaq Nabadeed ka Soo Saartay Colaadda Ka Taagan Dawaco ee Gobolka Sanaag
items.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo saartay baaq nabadeed oo degdeg ah, kaddib markii ay walaac ka muujisay colaadda ka dhex aloosan beelo walaalo ah oo ku dagaallamaya deegaanka Dawaco ee degmada Badhan, Gobolka Sanaag. Wasaaraddu waxay ugu baaqday dhammaan dhinacyada ku lugta leh dagaalka inay si shuruud la’aan ah u joojiyaan colaadda iyo xabbadda, isla markaana muujiyaan is-xakameyn, kana fogaadaan falal iyo hadallo sii hurin kara xiisadda. Waxay sidoo kale ku boorrisay dhinacyada inay u jeestaan wada-hadal iyo xal nabadeed oo lagu soo afjaro colaadda. Bayaanka ayaa lagu adkeeyay in nabadda iyo dib-u-heshiisiintu yihiin tiirarka lagu ilaalin karo badqabka shacabka, horumarka bulshada iyo midnimada ummadda Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka ay caddeysay inay garab taagan tahay dadaal kasta oo lagu soo afjarayo colaaddan. Ugu dambeyn, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha waxay ugu baaqday Odeyaasha Dhaqanka, Culumada, Haweenka, Dhalinyarada, maamulka heerarka kala duwan iyo dhammaan waxgaradka Soomaaliyeed inay si mideysan uga qeyb qaataan dadaallada nabadeynta, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo isu soo dhoweynta dhinacyada ku dagaallamaya deegaanka Dawaco.

items.title: Somalia marks 4 years of diplomatic gains
items.description: Somalia’s State Minister for Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Ali Mohamed Omar, presented a review of the country’s diplomatic performance over the past four years during a lecture at the Ministry’s headquarters in Mogadishu on Saturday, an event organized by the Ministry’s Diplomatic Institute to promote public understanding of Somalia’s foreign policy. The presentation lands at a moment when Somalia is pushing to expand its international footprint under the government’s National Transformational Plan (2025–2029), a roadmap aimed at regional stability, economic integration and stronger global influence — making the Ministry’s own account of its progress a marker of how far that push has come, and how far it still has to go. The session drew Permanent Secretary Hamza Adan Haadow, Ministry directors and staff, government officials, and students from Somalia National University and Mogadishu University. Omar’s remarks touched on four areas: deeper bilateral and multilateral partnerships, expanded economic diplomacy, efforts to safeguard Somalia’s sovereignty and territorial integrity, and a stronger international profile for the country. According to the Ministry, the session was intended to reinforce public engagement with diplomatic policy, particularly among students likely to enter government or foreign service. Omar, now serving his second term in Somalia’s Parliament, previously served as Chief of Staff to President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud during the president’s first term from 2014 to 2017. Before entering politics, he spent two decades as a senior software engineer at IBM in the United States. The Ministry is currently led by Minister Abdisalam Abdi Ali, appointed in a 2025 cabinet reshuffle, under whom Somalia has expanded its participation in regional and continental bodies, including the African Union. The Ministry closed the session by reaffirming its commitment to Somalia’s foreign policy priorities and to strengthening international partnerships in support of peace, stability and sustainable development. No timeline was given for the Ministry’s next public briefing on diplomatic progress. The post Somalia marks 4 years of diplomatic gains first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Janan oo arrimo xasaasi ah kashifay kuna tilmaamay dagaalkii Beledxaawo…
items.description: Beledxaawo (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha hay’adda NISA ee gobolka Gedo, Cabdirashiid Xasan Nuur (Janan), ayaa maanta ka hadlay xaaladda gobolka, isaga oo faahfaahin ka bixiyay dagaalkii horay degmada Beledxaawo ugu dhex-maray ciidamada dowladda federaalka iyo kuwa Daraawiishta Jubbaland. Janan, oo muddooyinkii dambe aan kasoo muuqan warbaahinta, ayaa shir jaraa’id oo uu ku qabtay Beledxaawo diiradda ku saaray xaaladda guud ee gobolka Gedo, gaar ahaan dagaal-beeleedyada soo noqnoqday iyo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee saameeyay deegaanka. Waxaa si gaar ah indhaha loogu hayay sida uu uga hadli doono khilaafka u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo maamulka Jubbaland. Hase yeeshee, Janan ayaa ka gaabsaday inuu si toos ah uga hadlo Jubbaland ama uu eedeyn u jeediyo madaxweynaha maamulkaas, Axmed Madoobe, oo uu hore dhowr jeer ugu weeraray warbaahinta. Ka fogaanshaha hadalladii kululaa ee looga bartay ayaa dhaliyay su’aalo ku saabsan in wax iska beddeleen mowqifkiisa siyaasadeed iyo xiriirkii kala dhexeeyay madaxda Jubbaland. Janan ayaa sheegay in dagaalkii hore uga dhacay degmada Beledxaawo uu ahaa dagaal salka ku hayay arrimo siyaasadeed, isaga oo tilmaamay in bulshada deegaanka ay si wanaagsan ula socoto sababihii keenay iyo qaabkii uu u dhacay. “Meeshan dagaal ayaa ka dhacay, dagaal siyaasadeed ayuuna ahaa. Sida uu ku yimid, sababta uu ku yimid iyo qaabkii ay wax u dhaceen waa arrimo qof kasta oo reer Beledxaawo ah uu ka dharagsan yahay,” ayuu yiri Cabdirashiid Janan. Taliyaha NISA ee gobolka Gedo ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in wixii hadda ka dambeeya aysan garab siin doonin cid ku lug leh falal waxyeello u geysan kara shacabka ama xasilloonida gobolka. “Ma jiri doonto cid dambe oo aan xumaan ku gacan siin doonno,” ayuu mar kale yiri Janan, inkasta oo uusan si cad u magacaabin cidda uu hadalkaas ula jeeday. Hadalka Cabdirashiid Janan ayaa durba hadal-heyn ka abuuray baraha bulshada, iyadoo dadka qaarkood ay ku fasireen fariin muujineysa isbeddel ku yimid mowqifkiisii hore ee ku aaddanaa maamulka Jubbaland. Waxa uu sidoo kale sii xoojiyay wararka sheegaya inay jiraan wada-hadallo hoose oo u socda Janan iyo madaxweynaha Jubbaland Axmed Madoobe, inkasta oo labada dhinac aysan weli si rasmi ah uga hadlin arrintaas. Cabdirashiid Janan ayaa muddo dheer ka mid ahaa siyaasiyiinta iyo saraakiisha sida weyn ugu lugta lahaa loollanka siyaasadeed iyo midka amni ee gobolka Gedo, waxaana hadalladiisa cusub si dhow ula soconaya dhinacyada isku haya saameynta gobolka. items.title: Dad badan oo ku dhintay shil gaari oo dhacay magaalada Dimishiq
items.description: Dimishiq ( Raxanreeb Online) In ku dhow 35 qof ayaa ku dhintay, 30 kalena way ku dhaawacmeen shil gaari oo ka dhacay wadada Dimishiq-Deir ez-Zor, ee bariga Suuriya, Sabtidii. items.title: Guddiga doorashooyinka oo shaaciyay jawdalka doorashada Hir-shabeelle
items.description: Jowhar ( Raxanreeb Online) Guddiga Qaran ee Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa si rasmi ah u shaaciyay jadwalka doorashada Golaha Deegaanka iyo golaha Wakiilada ee Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle. “Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha, isagoo gudanaya waajibaadkiisa shaqo ee ku xusan Qodobka 10-aad ee Sharciga Dhismaha, isla markaana fulinaya Qodobka 18-aad ee Sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka, wuxuu si rasmi ah u shaacinayaa jadwalka doorashada Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabelle” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka kasoo baxay guddiga. Sida uu guddigu sheegay, jadwalku wuxuu qeexayaa marxaladaha kala duwan ee doorashada, kuwaas oo isugu jira diiwaangelinta musharrixiinta, ololaha doorashada, diyaarinta goobaha codbixinta doorashada. Guddigu ayaa ugu baaqay dhammaan dhinacyada ay khusayso, oo ay ku jiraan axsaabta siyaasadda, musharrixiinta, bulshada rayidka ah iyo shacabka Hirshabeelle, inay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan guddiga si doorashadu ugu dhacdo si hufan, nabad ah oo waafaqsan shuruucda dalka. Shaacinta jadwalkan ayaa loo arkaa tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu dardargelinayo diyaar-garowga doorashada, iyadoo la filayo in shacabka Hirshabeelle ay door muuqda ku yeeshaan doorashada goleyaasha deegaanka ee Qof iyo Cod. items.title: Trump oo go’aan lama filaan ah ka soo saaray dagaalka Iran
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Jimcihii amar ku bixiyey in ciidamada dalkiisa aysan duqeymo cusub ka fulin Iran, isaga oo hakad geliyey weerarro maalinle ahaa oo socday 13 maalmood oo xiriir ah, sida ay sheegeen laba ilo-wareed oo xog-ogaal u ah go’aanka. Amarkan ayaa noqon kara calaamaddii ugu xoogganeyd ee muujineysa in Trump uu doonayo inuu waqti dheeraad ah siiyo dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu qaboojinayo xiisadda sii xoogeysaneysa ee u dhexeysa Washington iyo Tehran. Hase yeeshee, weli ma cadda in hakadka Jimcaha uu ahaa go’aan hal maalin ah iyo in uu bilow u yahay joojinta duqeymaha Mareykanka ee Iran muddo dheer. Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa weli awood u leh inay weerarrada dib u bilaabaan muddo gaaban gudaheed haddii Trump uu bixiyo amar cusub. Maalin kasta labadii toddobaad ee la soo dhaafay, saraakiisha militariga Mareykanka ayaa Trump horgeynayey qorsheyaal duqeyn ah, kuwaas oo madaxweynuhu ansixinayey galabtii, ka hor inta aan weerarrada la fulin saacado yar kaddib. Jimcihii, Trump waxaa la horgeeyey qorshe kale oo la mid ah kuwii hore, balse markan ma uusan siin oggolaanshaha lagu fulin lahaa. Taa beddelkeeda, wuxuu ciidamada faray inaysan wax duqeyn ah qaadin, sida ay sheegeen labada ilo-wareed. Go’aanka Trump ayaa la rumeysan yahay inuu salka ku hayo laba arrimood. Midda koowaad waa rabitaankiisa ah inuu waddada u furo wada-hadallada socda, halka midda labaad ay tahay qiimeyn muujineysa in duqeymaha xaddidan ee maalinlaha ahi ay gaareen heerkii ugu sarreeyey ee ay wax-ku-ool noqon karaan, haddii aan dib loogu noqon dagaal ballaaran. Militariga Mareykanka ayaa weli diyaarinaya qorsheyaal la xiriira suurtagalnimada in dib loo bilaabo hawlgallo militari oo waaweyn. Si kastaba, Trump weli ma uusan amrin in diyaar-garowgaas loo beddelo hawlgal rasmi ah. Aqalka Cad kama jawaabin codsi loo diray oo ku saabsanaa in uu faahfaahin ka bixiyo amarka hakinta duqeymaha. ‘Istaraatiijiyad caqli badan’ Wax yar kaddib markii uu amarka siiyey ciidamada, Trump ayaa wariyeyaasha Aqalka Cad u sheegay inuu weli haysto fursado kala duwan, oo ay ku jiraan sii wadista duqeymaha ama in Mareykanku kordhiyo awoodda weerarradiisa. Wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada Mareykanku ay awoodaan inay Iran ka burburiyaan “wax kasta oo ay haystaan,” balse wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyey in xalka uu hadda doorbidayo uu yahay heshiis lagu gaaro wada-xaajood. “Waxaan hadda la hadlaynaa [Iraaniyiinta]. Waxaan u maleynayaa inay maalinba maalinta ka dambeysa sii noqonayaan kuwo dhab ka ah arrintan. Waan diyaarsannahay, hubkeenuna waa diyaar, balse waan la hadlaynaa,” ayuu yiri Trump. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in “istaraatiijiyadda caqliga badan” ay tahay in Iran lala gaaro heshiis, halkii si degdeg ah loogu dhaqaaqi lahaa weerarro kale oo horseedi kara dagaal ka ballaaran kan hadda socda. Hase yeeshee, markii dambe oo Jimcihii ahayd, Trump ayaa khudbad uu ka jeediyey cashada ururka wariyeyaasha Aqalka Cad ku sheegay in uusan rumeysneyn in Iran ay xilligan diyaar u tahay inay heshiis gasho. “Uma maleynayo inay hadda diyaar u yihiin inay heshiis sameeyaan, balse diyaar ayaan u ahay inaan dhageysto,” ayuu yiri. Hadalladiisa ayaa muujinaya in inkasta oo duqeymaha la hakiyey, haddana farqiga u dhexeeya labada dhinac uu weli weyn yahay, isla markaana Washington aysan meesha ka saarin in cadaadis militari mar kale la adeegsado. Wafdi gaaray Tehran Amarka hakinta duqeymaha ayaa la bixiyey dhowr saacadood kaddib markii wafdi ka socda Cumaan uu Jimcihii gaaray magaalada Tehran, si uu mas’uuliyiinta Iran ugala hadlo qorshe cusub oo lagu furayo Marinka Hormuz. Cumaan ayaa muddo dheer door dhexdhexaadin ah ka ciyaareysay khilaafaadka u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran, iyadoo xiriir la leh labada dhinac. Wafdiga ayaa Tehran kala xaajoonaya nidaam lagu maamulo isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo kuwa shidaalka ee marinka. Laba ilo-wareed oo gobolka ah oo xog-ogaal u ah wada-hadallada ayaa sheegay in horumar laga sameeyey kulamada, isla markaana Cumaan iyo Iran ay heshiis gaari karaan dhammaadka toddobaadkan. Haddii labada dhinac ay isku raacaan hindisaha cusub, Madaxweyne Trump ayaa markaas go’aan ka gaari doona inuu aqbalo iyo in kale. Marinka Hormuz, oo u dhexeeya Iran iyo Cumaan, ayaa ka mid ah marinnada badeed ee ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga caalamka, waxaana caadi ahaan mara qayb weyn oo ka mid ah shidaalka loo dhoofiyo suuqyada dunida. Xiisadda ka taagan marinka ayaa saameyn ku yeelatay maraakiibta ganacsiga, qiimaha tamarta iyo ammaanka guud ee gobolka. Hakinta duqeymaha Jimcaha ayaa sidaas darteed fursad siin karta dadaallada Cumaan, balse weli ma jiro heshiis rasmi ah oo xaqiijinaya in dagaalka la qaboojiyey. Haddii wada-hadalladu fashilmaan, Trump ayaa weli awood u leh inuu muddo gaaban gudaheed dib u amro duqeymaha ama uu qaado tallaabooyin militari oo ka xoog badan kuwii 13-ka maalmood ee la soo dhaafay. items.title: Fursadaha Dhaqaalaha Buluugga iyo Doorka Shirkadda SOMTURK ee Casriyeinta Kalluumeysiga
items.description: Shir looga hadlay horumarinta dhaqaalaha buluugga ah iyo kobcinta maalgashiga ayaa lagu dhiirrigeliyay ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed inay ballaariyaan maalgashigooda, iyagoo diiradda saaraya qeybaha wax-soo-saarka leh sida kalluumeysiga iyo ka faa’iideysiga kheyraadka badda. Madasha ayaa lagu adkeeyay in ganacsatadu ay ka gudbaan ganacsiyada ku kooban agabka fudud, isla markaana ay maalgashi ku sameeyaan warshadaha kalluunka, qaboojiyeyaasha casriga ah, iyo mashaariicda shaqo-abuurka, si loo xoojiyo dhaqaalaha dalka. Sidoo kale, waxaa la sheegay in ganacsatada iyo maalgeliyeyaasha ajnabiga ah ee doonaya inay ka shaqeeyaan Soomaaliya ay heli doonaan fursado ay kula shaqeeyaan ganacsatada gudaha, taasoo sare u qaadi karta maalgashiga iyo isdhaafsiga khibradaha. Mas’uuliyiinta dowladda, oo uu ka mid yahay Wasiirka Kalluumeysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ah, ayaa caddeeyay in dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay si buuxda u soo dhoweynayso maalgashiga, isla markaana ay diyaar u tahay fududeynta sharciyada iyo habraacyada lagu taageerayo mashaariicda horseedaya shaqo-abuurka iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha badda. Dhanka kale, waxaa shirka lagu soo bandhigay doorka shirkadda SOMTURK, oo ah shirkad wadajir ah oo ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo shirkadda Turkiga ee OYAK Group aasaaseen bishii Diseembar 2025. Shirkaddan ayaa ujeeddadeedu tahay horumarinta dhaqaalaha buluugga ah, maareynta kheyraadka badda, la dagaallanka kalluumeysiga sharci-darrada ah, iyo casriyeynta kaabayaasha kalluumeysiga. SOMTURK ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inay hormuud ka noqoto nidaaminta ruqsadaha kalluumeysiga, dhismaha qaboojiyeyaasha iyo warshadaha farsamaynta kalluunka, iyadoo la rajeynayo inay kordhiso dakhliga dowladda, abuurto kumannaan shaqo, isla markaana kalluumeysiga Soomaaliya u furto suuqyo caalami ah iyo tiknoolajiyad casri ah.

items.title: Jadwalka doorashada HirShabelle oo la shaaciyay – Goorma ayey dhaceysa?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u shaaciyay jadwalka guud ee hawlaha doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada ee Dowlad-goboleedka HirShabeelle. War-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay guddiga ayaa lagu sheegay in jadwalkan uu yahay hagaha rasmiga ah ee dhammaan hawlaha doorashada, laga bilaabo diiwaan-gelinta iyo ansixinta musharraxiinta illaa maalinta codbixinta. Sida ku cad jadwalka, diiwaan-gelinta iyo qaybinta foomamka codbixiyeyaasha ayaa dhammaan doonta 5-ta August, halka 7-da August la asteyn doono laguna dhawaaqi doono xarumaha iyo goobaha codbixinta ee doorashadu ka dhici doonto. Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale shaaciyay in 8-da August la soo bandhigi doono liiska hordhaca ah ee diiwaanka codbixiyeyaasha. Intaas kaddib, 11-ka August ayay ururrada siyaasaddu soo gudbin doonaan liiska wakiilladooda ee goobaha codbixinta. Sidoo kale, 15-ka August ayaa loo asteeyay soo gudbinta iyo xaqiijinta liiska musharraxiinta u tartamaya Golaha Wakiillada iyo goleyaasha deegaanka, halka 16-ka August la shaacin doono liiska kama dambaysta ah ee codbixiyeyaasha. Jadwalku wuxuu kaloo tilmaamaya in 18-ka August la soo bandhigi doono liiska musharraxiinta ururrada siyaasadda, ka hor inta aan la gaarin maalinta codbixinta oo si rasmi ah loogu asteeyay 20-ka August 2026. War-saxaafadeedka guddiga ayaa lagu adkeeyay in dhammaan ururrada siyaasadda, musharraxiinta iyo hay’adaha kale ee ay khusayso doorashadu ay u hoggaansamaan jadwalka iyo tilmaamaha uu guddigu soo saaray. Waxa kale oo guddigu ugu baaqay shacabka HirShabeelle inay si nabad ah uga qayb qaataan geeddi-socodka doorashada, iyagoo dhowraya shuruucda iyo nidaamyada u yaalla. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in jadwalku ujeeddadiisu tahay in doorashadu u dhacdo si hufan, daah-furan, isla markaana waafaqsan shuruucda dalka. Si kastaba, shaacinta jadwalkan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli doorashada HirShabeelle ay si weyn isha ugu hayaan dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo bulshada rayidka ah. Doorashadan ayaa noqon doonta tijaabo muhiim ah oo lagu qiimeeyo hirgelinta nidaamka doorashooyinka isku sidkan, iyadoo la filayo in maalmaha soo socda ay dardar galaan diyaar-garowga ururrada siyaasadda iyo musharraxiinta ka qaybgalaya tartanka. items.title: Somalia’s Turkish Illusion
items.description: By Isha Qarsoon Every Somali understands that Ethiopia pursues Ethiopian interests. Nobody is surprised when Kenya advances Kenyan interests. No one expects the United States, China, the United Arab Emirates, or Britain to place Somalia’s interests above their own. That is the nature of international politics. States exist to advance the welfare, security, and prosperity of their own people. Their generosity may be genuine, their partnerships sincere, but their foreign policy ultimately serves their national interest. Yet somehow Turkey escaped this basic rule in the Somali imagination. It became the one foreign power that many Somalis stopped analyzing as a foreign power. Instead, it came to be viewed as a brother, a friend, an exception to the normal rules of statecraft. That perception, more than any agreement or investment, may prove to be Turkey’s greatest achievement in Somalia. To say this is not to deny Turkey’s contribution. It arrived when many others stayed away. President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan visited Mogadishu at a time when such visits were politically risky. Turkish hospitals treated Somali patients. Roads were built. Scholarships were awarded. Businesses invested. Military officers were trained. Turkish officials spoke a language of partnership and dignity rather than charity or tutelage. These are facts, not propaganda, and Somalis had every reason to welcome them. Gratitude was entirely appropriate. But gratitude and strategic judgment are not the same thing. The mistake was not embracing Turkey as a partner. The mistake was concluding that Turkey, unlike every other state, had somehow ceased to pursue Turkish interests. That conclusion has shaped Somali politics in ways that few people appreciate. The greatest influence is often the influence that no longer appears to be influence. Once a foreign government acquires a reputation for exceptional goodwill, scrutiny fades. Agreements that would provoke fierce national debate if signed with another country are accepted with little discussion because they involve the trusted friend. Skepticism is dismissed as ingratitude. Questions become politically awkward. Slowly, almost imperceptibly, a foreign state’s intentions cease to be examined with the same discipline applied to everyone else. This is not because Turkey deceived Somalis. Rather, Somalis gradually stopped asking the questions that every sovereign nation should ask of every foreign government. What does this country seek? How does this agreement advance its interests? What are the long-term consequences for ours? These are not hostile questions. They are the ordinary questions of a politically mature society. Friendship does not eliminate the need to ask them. If anything, friendship makes them more important, because trust has a way of lowering our guard. Seen through this lens, Turkey’s expanding role in Somalia appears less as a series of unrelated developments and more as a coherent progression. It began with humanitarian engagement and public goodwill. It expanded into infrastructure and commerce. From there it moved naturally into military cooperation and institutional presence. Turkey became a principal security partner, trained elite Somali forces, assumed important operational responsibilities, and steadily deepened its relationship with the presidency. None of these developments, viewed in isolation, seemed alarming. Each could be defended on its own merits. Yet foreign influence is rarely accumulated in a single dramatic step. It grows incrementally, each stage making the next appear entirely reasonable. The pattern became clearer as Turkey’s role expanded beyond traditional cooperation into sectors that will shape Somalia’s future prosperity. The hydrocarbons agreement was not simply another investment contract. It placed Turkey in a privileged position within Somalia’s emerging petroleum sector. More recently, attention has turned to cooperation in the country’s mineral resources, suggesting that petroleum may represent the beginning rather than the culmination of a broader economic relationship. Again, each agreement can be defended individually. Collectively, however, they reveal a foreign partner whose influence now extends across security, infrastructure, diplomacy, and strategic natural resources. That combination deserves careful examination, not because Turkey is uniquely malevolent, but because no foreign state should occupy such a broad position in another country’s affairs without rigorous public scrutiny. Perhaps the clearest illustration of this changing relationship came during the crisis triggered by Ethiopia’s memorandum of understanding with Somaliland. At one of the most difficult diplomatic moments faced by the Federal Government, Turkey emerged as the indispensable intermediary. It possessed the relationships, credibility, and access necessary to engage both Mogadishu and Addis Ababa. Somalia needed Turkey’s diplomatic support. Turkey, by contrast, did not depend upon Somalia in the same way. That imbalance should have prompted a national conversation about the implications of relying so heavily upon one external partner while simultaneously negotiating agreements affecting the country’s strategic resources. Instead, the two developments were largely discussed as though they existed in separate worlds. International politics does not work that way. States accumulate political capital over many years and deploy it when opportunities arise. There is nothing unusual about this. The United States does it. China does it. The Gulf states do it. Turkey does it. Successful governments convert goodwill into influence, influence into access, and access into opportunities that advance their national interests. The remarkable aspect of Somalia’s experience is not that Turkey has behaved like a state. It is that so many Somalis continue to discuss Turkey as though it were something other than a state. This is where the focus must shift from Ankara to Mogadishu. The central question is not whether Turkey is pursuing Turkish interests. Of course it is. Every responsible government should. The real question is why Somali institutions have become so willing to concentrate political, security, economic, and diplomatic relationships in a single foreign partner without developing equally strong mechanisms of constitutional oversight and public accountability. Every major agreement bears Somali signatures. Every concession is approved by Somali officials. Every expansion of foreign influence reflects a decision taken within Somali institutions. Foreign governments cannot surrender powers that do not belong to them. Only Somalis can do that. For too long we have explained Somalia’s difficulties by pointing outward. Foreign interference has become the default explanation for nearly every political failure. There is truth in that accusation, but it is only half the story. External actors can exploit weaknesses that already exist; they cannot create constitutional indifference, institutional fragility, or executive overreach on their own. Those are domestic failures. When foreign governments discover that important decisions can be negotiated through a narrow circle of political actors rather than through resilient institutions, they naturally adapt their diplomacy to that reality. The responsibility for changing it lies not with Ankara, Abu Dhabi, Addis Ababa, Washington, or Beijing. It lies with us. This is why the debate over Turkey should not become an exercise in resentment. Turkey owes its first duty to the Turkish people. No one should expect otherwise. The burden of protecting Somalia’s sovereignty rests entirely upon Somali shoulders. That protection does not require rejecting foreign investment or abandoning international partnerships. It requires something much more difficult: the discipline to distinguish gratitude from judgment and friendship from permanent alignment of interests. Nations that fail to make that distinction eventually discover that they have confused trust with strategy. The greatest natural resource Turkey has acquired in Somalia may not be oil or minerals. It is trust. Trust is what allowed Turkey to become the one foreign power that many Somalis stopped questioning. Trust reduced the political cost of expanding influence into ever more strategic sectors. Trust made extraordinary agreements appear ordinary because they were concluded with an extraordinary friend. Yet trust, however well deserved, can never substitute for constitutional safeguards, institutional balance, or vigilant public scrutiny. A sovereign nation does not suspend critical judgment because it admires a partner. It applies the same standards to every foreign government precisely because it values that partnership enough to place it on a durable and transparent foundation. Somalia does not need fewer friends. It needs a clearer understanding of what friendship means in international politics. A true partner should welcome transparent institutions, constitutional procedures, parliamentary oversight, and informed public debate because those are the foundations of legitimate and enduring cooperation. Relationships that depend upon unquestioning trust are inherently fragile. Relationships that survive rigorous scrutiny are the ones that endure. History will not judge Turkey harshly for advancing Turkish interests. That is what governments exist to do. History will judge Somalia by a different standard. It will ask whether Somali leaders and Somali citizens remembered that protecting Somalia’s interests is their responsibility alone. The day a nation stops asking what another state wants is the day it begins to lose something more valuable than territory or natural resources. It begins to lose the habit of thinking like a sovereign people. items.title: Bosaso Port Dispute Reignites as Traders Say DP World Failed to Honor Fee Agreement
items.description: Bosaso (WDN) – Just days after authorities announced a breakthrough in the long-running dispute over port charges at Bosaso Port, the controversy has unexpectedly flared up again, with traders accusing DP World of failing to implement the agreement that many believed had finally brought the crisis to an end. The renewed disagreement has come as a surprise to the business community, which had welcomed last week’s announcement as a significant step toward restoring confidence and stability at Puntland’s principal commercial gateway. However, several Bosaso traders now insist that the underlying dispute remains unresolved. In a joint statement, representatives of the business community alleged that DP World has continued to impose the same disputed MT/CBM port handling charges despite the recently announced agreement with the Puntland government. They claim they have effectively been compelled to pay the very fees they had challenged throughout the dispute. The traders argued that the agreement has yet to be reflected in practice, raising fresh questions about its implementation and enforcement. Seeking greater transparency, the business community called for an immediate review of the MT/CBM tariff system introduced by DP World at Bosaso Port. They also urged Puntland authorities to require the company to publicly explain the basis, methodology, and justification for the new fee structure. In addition, the traders requested an official comparative assessment of port charges at Bosaso, Berbera, and Mogadishu, arguing that the fees imposed at Bosaso appear significantly higher than those charged at competing ports in the region. They contend that the disparity risks undermining Bosaso’s competitiveness as a major commercial hub and increasing costs for importers, exporters, and ultimately consumers. The renewed dispute has prompted traders to appeal directly to Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni, urging him to personally intervene and ensure that the commitments announced during last week’s negotiations are fully implemented. The disagreement had previously disrupted commercial activity in Bosaso and contributed to rising prices of essential goods across Puntland before a settlement was announced. The latest developments have therefore revived concerns that the dispute could once again affect trade, supply chains, and business confidence if a durable resolution is not reached. As of publication, neither DP World nor the Puntland government had publicly responded to the traders’ latest allegations or clarified whether additional negotiations are planned to resolve the renewed impasse. The renewed disagreement has come as a surprise to the business community, which had welcomed last week’s announcement as a significant step toward restoring confidence and stability at Puntland’s principal commercial gateway. However, several Bosaso traders now insist that the underlying dispute remains unresolved. In a joint statement, representatives of the business community alleged that DP World has continued to impose the same disputed MT/CBM port handling charges despite the recently announced agreement with the Puntland government. They claim they have effectively been compelled to pay the very fees they had challenged throughout the dispute. The traders argued that the agreement has yet to be reflected in practice, raising fresh questions about its implementation and enforcement. Seeking greater transparency, the business community called for an immediate review of the MT/CBM tariff system introduced by DP World at Bosaso Port. They also urged Puntland authorities to require the company to publicly explain the basis, methodology, and justification for the new fee structure. In addition, the traders requested an official comparative assessment of port charges at Bosaso, Berbera, and Mogadishu, arguing that the fees imposed at Bosaso appear significantly higher than those charged at competing ports in the region. They contend that the disparity risks undermining Bosaso’s competitiveness as a major commercial hub and increasing costs for importers, exporters, and ultimately consumers. The renewed dispute has prompted traders to appeal directly to Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni, urging him to personally intervene and ensure that the commitments announced during last week’s negotiations are fully implemented. The disagreement had previously disrupted commercial activity in Bosaso and contributed to rising prices of essential goods across Puntland before a settlement was announced. The latest developments have therefore revived concerns that the dispute could once again affect trade, supply chains, and business confidence if a durable resolution is not reached. As of publication, neither DP World nor the Puntland government had publicly responded to the traders’ latest allegations or clarified whether additional negotiations are planned to resolve the renewed impasse. items.title: Somali Pirates Seize Fourth Vessel in Three Months as Maritime Security Fears Grow
items.description: EYL (WDN) – Somali piracy appears to be making a troubling comeback after another commercial vessel hijacked off the coast of Yemen was brought to the Puntland coastline, underscoring growing concerns that pirate networks are once again expanding their operations across the western Indian Ocean. The cargo vessel Asana, sailing under the Tanzanian flag, arrived off the coast of Eyl district in Somalia’s Nugaal region after being seized by armed pirates last Friday in waters off Yemen. According to a resident in the nearby community of Maraya, food supplies and weapons were delivered overnight to the armed group holding the vessel, suggesting the hijackers are preparing for a potentially prolonged standoff while awaiting ransom negotiations. The Asana is carrying 20 crew members, including eight German nationals and ten Filipino nationals, while the nationalities of the remaining crew members have not been disclosed. The hijacking marks the fourth commercial vessel captured by Somali pirates in just three months, signaling what maritime security experts fear could be the beginning of a broader resurgence in piracy after years of relative calm. Three other vessels remain anchored off the Puntland coast in the Bari and Mudug regions, where pirate groups are reportedly demanding substantial ransom payments for the release of the ships, their cargo, and their crews. The growing number of hijackings is fueling renewed concern among shipping companies, insurers, and regional governments that pirate networks are rebuilding the operational capabilities they once used to terrorize one of the world’s busiest maritime corridors. Between 2008 and 2018, Somali pirates disrupted global shipping, seized dozens of commercial vessels, and extracted millions of dollars in ransom, prompting an unprecedented international naval response in the Gulf of Aden and the western Indian Ocean. Although piracy declined sharply following coordinated international anti-piracy operations and improved onboard security measures, attacks began resurfacing in late 2023. The latest hijacking suggests that the threat is no longer isolated. With multiple vessels now being held simultaneously and pirate groups appearing increasingly organized, observers warn that maritime insecurity is once again spreading its wings, threatening international trade routes, increasing shipping costs, and making life considerably more dangerous for seafarers navigating the waters around the Horn of Africa. Unless regional authorities and international naval forces strengthen coordinated maritime security efforts, analysts caution that Somali piracy could once again evolve from a sporadic criminal enterprise into a major threat to global commerce. items.title: Kenyan Minister’s Remarks on Historical Discrimination Against Somali Community Spark National Backlash
items.description: Nairobi (WDN) — Remarks by Kenya’s Cabinet Secretary for Health, Aden Barre Duale, have ignited a fierce political debate, drawing strong reactions across the country—particularly among members of the Kikuyu community—after he accused previous Kenyan administrations of systematically discriminating against ethnic Somalis. Speaking at a public event, Duale alleged that successive governments led by former Presidents Jomo Kenyatta and Mwai Kibaki deliberately denied thousands of young Kenyan Somalis access to national identity cards, effectively limiting their ability to fully participate in the country’s civic and economic life. “Previous governments intentionally discriminated against Somalis by denying our youth national identity cards,” Duale said. “They should remember that Somalis are a nation of nearly 40 million people across the region, while they number only around three million and are confined within Kenya.” The comments immediately triggered widespread criticism and intense public debate, with many Kenyans arguing that references to ethnic population size risk inflaming longstanding sensitivities surrounding identity and national cohesion. Political observers noted that while historical grievances over citizenship documentation in Kenya’s North Eastern region have long been documented and debated, Duale’s choice of language has shifted attention away from the policy issue itself toward concerns over ethnic rhetoric. The remarks have also prompted unease within sections of Kenya’s Somali community. Some community leaders warned that statements framed in ethnic terms could unintentionally expose Somali-owned businesses and communities to heightened political tensions at a time when national unity remains a sensitive issue. Meanwhile, several traditional elders from Kenya’s North Eastern region echoed Duale’s broader criticism of past administrations, arguing that previous governments under Jomo Kenyatta, Daniel arap Moi, and Mwai Kibaki pursued policies that marginalized Kenyan Somalis because of their perceived political affinity with neighboring Somalia. One elder claimed that during the Moi administration, local communities were warned that continued expressions of support for Somalia would invite severe government retaliation. According to the elder, officials even threatened to poison community water wells if such sentiments persisted—a claim that has not been independently verified. The controversy has reopened discussion over one of Kenya’s most contentious historical issues: the long-standing complaints by many residents of the North Eastern region regarding delays and obstacles in obtaining national identity cards, a prerequisite for voting, employment, education, banking, and other public services. Although recent governments have introduced reforms aimed at improving access to identity documents, the issue continues to resonate politically among many Kenyan Somalis, who view it as part of a broader legacy of historical exclusion. As public debate intensifies, analysts caution that discussions about historical injustices require careful handling. While acknowledging legitimate grievances, they warn that framing such issues through ethnic comparisons risks deepening divisions rather than fostering reconciliation. The Kenyan government has not issued an official statement addressing the controversy surrounding Duale’s remarks, but the comments have already become one of the country’s most widely discussed political issues, underscoring the enduring sensitivity of questions surrounding citizenship, equality, and national identity. items.title: Somali-American Extradited from Somalia Faces Murder Charges in Ohio
items.description: Columbus, Ohio (WDN) – A 23-year-old Somali-American who was extradited from Somalia has appeared before a court in Ohio to face murder and aggravated robbery charges stemming from a fatal shooting that occurred in 2021. The defendant, Hanut Abdulle, is accused in connection with the killing of Bryce Persang, who was fatally shot during an alleged armed robbery in Columbus on September 16, 2021. During his initial court appearance, the judge set bail at $2 million. If released pending trial, Abdulle would be required to surrender his passport and wear a GPS electronic monitoring device to track his movements. According to investigators, Abdulle and a second suspect, Tahir Said, 24, are believed to have been involved in the fatal incident. Authorities say both men left the United States shortly after the shooting. Abdulle was later located in Somalia and extradited to the United States through cooperation between Somali and U.S. law enforcement agencies. The second suspect, Tahir Said, remains at large, and authorities continue efforts to locate and apprehend him. The case has drawn attention not only because of the international manhunt and extradition but also because it underscores the enduring grief surrounding violent crime. For the victim’s family, the return of a suspect to face justice represents an important step in a case that has remained unresolved for nearly four years. Abdulle is currently facing criminal charges, but no verdict has been reached. Under the U.S. legal system, he is presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty in a court of law. items.title: Guddiga doorashooyinka oo shaacisay jadwalka doorashada Hirshabeelle
items.description: Muqdisho – Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (GMDQS) ayaa si rasmi ah u shaaciyay jadwalka doorashada Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle, isagoo gudanaya waajibaadkiisa shaqo ee ku xusan Qodobka 10-aad ee Sharciga Dhismaha GMDQS iyo Qodobka 18-aad ee Sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka. Jadwalka uu guddigu soo saaray ayaa muujinaya in diiwaangelinta iyo qaybinta kaararka codbixiyeyaasha ay bilaaban doonto 5-ta Agoosto, halka 7-da Agoosto la shaacin doono xarumaha iyo goobaha codbixinta. Sidoo kale, 8-da Agoosto waxaa la soo bandhigi doonaa liiska hordhaca ah ee codbixiyeyaasha, iyadoo maalmaha xiga la dhammaystiri doono gudbinta iyo xaqiijinta liisaska musharraxiinta iyo wakiillada ururrada siyaasadda. GMDQS ayaa sidoo kale shaacisay in 16-ka Agoosto la soo saari doono liiska kama dambaysta ah ee codbixiyeyaasha, halka 18-ka Agoosto la daabici doono liiska kama dambaysta ah ee musharraxiinta ururrada siyaasadda. Sida jadwalku tilmaamayo, doorashada Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle ayaa si rasmi ah u dhici doonta 20-ka Agoosto.

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyey ee dagaalka Sanaag iyo DF oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa markii ugu horeysay ka hadashay dagaal beeleedka mar kale dib uga qarxay degaanno ka tirsan gobolka Sool ee Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya, iyada oo baaq nabeed u dirtay beelo walaalo ah oo ku dagaalamaya halkaasi. Wasiirka Ganacsiga Soomaaliya, Jamaal Maxamed Xasan oo kasoo jeedo gobolkaas ayaa nasiib darro ku tilmaamay dagaalkan, wuxuuna ugu baaqay beelaha walaalaha inay xabadda joojiyaan, isa markaana ay xalka ku raadiyaan wada-hadal iyo deganaan. Sidoo kale wuxuu guud ahaan bulshada deegaanka ka dalbaday inay nabadda ka shaqeeyaan, ayna u istaagaan sidii loo joojiyaan colaadda qabaa’ilka. “Waa nasiib-darro weyn in shacabka gobolka Sanaag ay wakhtigan dib ugu laabtaan dagaal sokeeye iyo aanooyinkii Soomaali curyaamiyay, balse ay iyagu ka nabad-galeen xilliyadii ugu adkaa ee dalkani soo maray. Waxaan si adag ugu baaqayaa joojinta colaadda ka soo cusboonaatay deegaanka Dawaco ee gobolka Sanaag, aniga oo labada dhinac ku boorrinaya inay si degdeg ah oo bilaa shuruud ah u joojiyaan dagaalka,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Jamaal Maxamed Xasan. Sidoo kale, wuxuu farriin u diray Maamul-goboleedka Waqooyi Bari oo uu ka socday inuu qaado tallaabo looga hortagayo dagaal beeleedka goboka Sanaag. “Waxaan ku boorrinayaa Maamulka Waqooyi Bari, culimada, haweenka, guurtida, dhallinyarada, iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada inay si degdeg ah uga hawlgaan daminta colaaddaas, isla markaana kala dhex-galaan walaalaha dhiiggoodu daadanayo,” ayuu mar kale yiri Wasiirku. Waxaa kale oo uu sii raaciyay “Ugu dambayntii, colaaddu ma istaagayso haddaan labada dhinac si caddaalad ah loogu kala-garqaadin, nabad waartana la dhex-dhigin. Sidaasi awgeed, guurtida iyo odayaasha dhaqanka waxa saaran masuuliyad culus oo ay tahay inay si dhakhso ah u gutaan,” Dagaalka ka socda gudaha gobolka Sanaag ayaa dhaliyay khasaare isugu jiro dhimasho iyo dhaawac, iyada oo weli xaaladdu ay tahay mid kacsan. Si kastaba, soo noqoshada dagaalkan ayaa sababtay kadib markii ay Puntland halkaas kasoo saartay ciidamadii horay loo kala dhex-galay labada beelood, waxaana kadib sidaas ku bilowday dagaalka, waxaana weli is horfadhiya labada dhinac. items.title: General Yahya Saree oo ka hadlay laba weerar oo Xuutiyiinta ka fuliyeen gudaha Sacuudiga
items.description: Ururka Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay inay ciidamadoodu beegsadeen xarumaha ay Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco ku leedahay Magaalooyinka Jizan iyo Yanbu oo saaran xeebaha Badda Cas. Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa sheegay in Sabtidan ay gantaalo iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ku weerareen kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, iyadoo laga jawaabayo gardarrada Riyadh. Afhayeenka ayaa sheegay in Sacuudiga uu xalay weeraro xagga cirka ah ka gaystay Dekedda Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran oo ku taal xeebta galbeed ee Yemen. General Yahya Saree ayaa sheegay in duqaymahaasi ay muujinayaan, sida Sacuudiga ay uga go’an tahay inuu sii wado go’doominta buu yiri shacabkeenna iyo ku xadgudubka madaxbannaanida dalkeenna. Saree ayaa wacad ku maray in Ciidamada Yemen ay qaadi doonaan jawaab celin adag oo la mid ah falalka uu ku eedeeyay Boqortooyada Sacuudiga. Dhanka kale Madaxa Wada-xaajoodka Xuuthiyiinta, Mohammed Abdul Salam ayaa Riyadh ku eedeeyay inay weli hortaagan tahay db u furista Garoonka Diyaaradaha Sanca, wuxuuna siyaasadda Sacuudiga ee Yemen uu ku tilmaamay mid la mid ah tan Israel, isagoo labadaba ku eedeeyay inay ka siman yihiin beenta, isla weynida, naceybka iyo gardarrada. Mohammed Abdul Salam ayaa ku hanjabay in ururka reer Yemen uu sii wadi doono weerarada ka dhanka ah Sacuudiga, isagoo sheegay in tallaabo kasta oo ay Sacuudiga ku doonayaan inay xayiraado dheeraad ah ku soo rogaan Dekedaha Yemen ay la kulmi doonaan jawaabteeda, taasna ay sii xumeynayso xiisadda Badda Cas, sida uu yiri. Warka Saraakiisha Xuutiyiinta ayaa imanaya, xilli ay ka sii dareyso xiisadda labada dhinac ee ka taagan Bariga Dhexe, gaar ahaan Badda Cas.

Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa sheegay in Sabtidan ay gantaalo iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ku weerareen kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, iyadoo laga jawaabayo gardarrada Riyadh. Afhayeenka ayaa sheegay in Sacuudiga uu xalay weeraro xagga cirka ah ka gaystay Dekedda Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran oo ku taal xeebta galbeed ee Yemen. General Yahya Saree ayaa sheegay in duqaymahaasi ay muujinayaan, sida Sacuudiga ay uga go’an tahay inuu sii wado go’doominta buu yiri shacabkeenna iyo ku xadgudubka madaxbannaanida dalkeenna. Saree ayaa wacad ku maray in Ciidamada Yemen ay qaadi doonaan jawaab celin adag oo la mid ah falalka uu ku eedeeyay Boqortooyada Sacuudiga. Dhanka kale Madaxa Wada-xaajoodka Xuuthiyiinta, Mohammed Abdul Salam ayaa Riyadh ku eedeeyay inay weli hortaagan tahay db u furista Garoonka Diyaaradaha Sanca, wuxuuna siyaasadda Sacuudiga ee Yemen uu ku tilmaamay mid la mid ah tan Israel, isagoo labadaba ku eedeeyay inay ka siman yihiin beenta, isla weynida, naceybka iyo gardarrada. Mohammed Abdul Salam ayaa ku hanjabay in ururka reer Yemen uu sii wadi doono weerarada ka dhanka ah Sacuudiga, isagoo sheegay in tallaabo kasta oo ay Sacuudiga ku doonayaan inay xayiraado dheeraad ah ku soo rogaan Dekedaha Yemen ay la kulmi doonaan jawaabteeda, taasna ay sii xumeynayso xiisadda Badda Cas, sida uu yiri. Warka Saraakiisha Xuutiyiinta ayaa imanaya, xilli ay ka sii dareyso xiisadda labada dhinac ee ka taagan Bariga Dhexe, gaar ahaan Badda Cas.

items.title: Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan hay’adaha dawladda oo casho-sharaf u sameeyey qurbejoog ka
items.description: Hargeysa – Xubno ka tirsan masuuliyiinta hay’adaha kala duwan ee dawladda Somaliland ayaa magaalada Hargeysa ku qabtay munaasibad casho-sharaf ah oo lagu maamuusay qaar ka mid ah qurbejoogta Somaliland ee ka yimid dalalka Yurub, taas oo lagu xoojiyey xidhiidhka u dhexeeya qurbejoogta iyo hay’adaha dawladda. Masuuliyiinta soo qabanqaabiyey munaasibadda ayaa kala ahaa Maareeyaha Hay’adda Horumarinta Waddooyinka Somaliland, Mudane Maxamed Faarax Cabdi, Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland, Mudane Xamse Cabdiraxmaan Khayre, Agaasimaha Waaxda Maamulka iyo Xisaabaadka ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah, Mudane Shabac Cabdi Maxamed, iyo Maareeyaha Kaydka Haamaha Shiidaalka Somaliland, Mudane Maxamed Sidiiq Dhamme. Kulankaas waxaa ka qaybgalay oo kale aqoonyahanno iyo xubno ka tirsan qurbejoogta Somaliland ee dalalka Yurub, iyadoo diiradda lagu saaray adkaynta wada shaqaynta, midnimada iyo doorka qurbejoogtu ku leeyihiin horumarka iyo dhismaha qaranka. Maareeyaha Hay’adda Horumarinta Waddooyinka Somaliland, Mudane Maxamed Faarax Cabdi, Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland, Mudane Xamse Cabdiraxmaan Khayre, Agaasimaha Waaxda Maamulka iyo Xisaabaadka ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah, Mudane Shabac Cabdi Maxamed oo madasha ka hadlay ayaa sheegay in socdaallo shaqo oo ay dhawaan ku tageen dalal ka tirsan Yurub ay kaga qaybgaleen munaasibadihii loo dabaaldegayey xuska maalinta qaranimada Somaliland ee 18-ka May 2026, halkaas oo ay kula kulmeen jaaliyadaha Somaliland ee ku dhaqan waddamadaas. Mas’uuliyiintaas ayaa si weyn u ammaanay isku-duubnida, wadajirka iyo sida hufan ee jaaliyaduhu u soo agaasimeen munaasibadaha xuska 18-ka May, iyagoo tilmaamay in arrintaasi ay muujinayso dareenka waddaniyadeed iyo taageerada joogtada ah ee qurbejoogtu u hayaan dalkooda. Masuuliyiintu waxay ugu baaqeen jaaliyadaha Somaliland ee ku nool dalalka Yurub inay sii xoojiyaan midnimadooda iyo wada shaqayntooda, isla markaana ay sii laba jibbaaraan kaalinta ay ka qaataan horumarka, maalgashiga iyo taageerada ay u fidiyaan dalkooda. Waxa kale oo ay madasha ku soo bandhigeen warbixin ku saabsan xaaladda guud ee dalka, horumarka ay xukuumaddu ka waddo dhinacyada kala duwan iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in qurbejoogtu sii xoojiso xidhiidhka iyo wada shaqaynta ay la leeyihiin hay’adaha qaranka. Dhinaca kale, xubno ka mid ah qurbejoogtii ka soo qaybgashay munaasibadda ayaa halkaas ka hadlay, iyagoo uga mahadceliyey masuuliyiinta dawladda qabanqaabada casho-sharafta iyo sida ay u muujiyeen qiimaha ay xukuumaddu siinayso qurbejoogta Somaliland, Waxay sidoo kale caddeeyeen inay sii wadi doonaan taageerada ay u hayaan dalkooda, isla markaana ay ka qayb qaadan doonaan dadaallada lagu horumarinayo Somaliland.

items.title: Sacuudiga oo tallaabo qaaday kadib gantaallo lagu weeraray
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Nidaamka difaaca cirka ee ay isticmaalaan militariga Giriigga ee Sacuudi Carabiya yaalla ayaa maanta qabtay laba gantaal oo nuuca ballistic-ga ah oo laga soo riday gudaha dalka Yemen. Gantaallada laga hortegay ayaa ujeedkooda ahaa in lagu bartilmaameedsado warshadaha saliidda ee Yanbu, sida ay ilo-wareedyo amni oo Giriig ah u sheegeen Reuters. Sidoo kale, saacado ka hor, Ururka Difaaca Madaniga ah ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la baabi’iyay khatarta weerar ka dhici kara gobolka Yanbu. Digniintan ayaa timid saacado ka dib markii Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay ku dhawaaqeen inay qaadi doonaan tallaabo aargoosi ah oo ay kaga jawaabayaan weerarrada isbahaysiga uu hoggaamiyo Sacuudigu uu ku qaaday goobaha kooxda ee Hodeidah. Horay waxay Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee taageerada ka hesha Iran ugu dhawaaqeen inay xannibaad badeed kusoo rogtay Sacuudi Carabiya, taas oo loo arkay tallaabo sii ballaarin karta dagaalka u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran, isla markaana halis cusub gelinaysa maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo sahayda shidaalka caalamka. “Waxaan ku dhawaaqeynaa xannibaad badeed oo ka dhan ah cadowga Sacuudiga, annaga oo ku dhaqmeyna mabda’a ah il ka il,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka Xuutiyiinta. Tallaabadan ayaa furtay jiho cusub oo dagaal xilli Mareykanka iyo Iran ay wel is weydaarsanayaan weerarro culus, kuwaas oo ku fiday dalal dhowr ah oo ku yaalla Bariga Dhexe. Bab al-Mandab waa marin istaraatiiji ah oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, waxaana mara qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah shidaalka iyo badeecadaha u kala goosha Aasiya, Bariga Dhexe iyo Yurub. Haddii marinka si buuxda loo xiro, waxaa hakad geli kara shidaal u dhigma ku dhowaad toddoba boqolkiiba sahayda caalamka, iyadoo inta badan dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga ee dhinaca Badda Cas ay ku adkaan karto inay gaarto suuqyada caalamka. Dagaalka ka socda Gacanka ayaa durba hoos u dhigay qulqulka shidaalka caalamka qiyaastii 10 boqolkiiba, taas oo sare u qaadday qiimaha tamarta, gaadiidka iyo badeecadaha kale. Qiimaha shidaalka ayaa markii hore kor u kacay kadib ku dhawaaqista Xuutiyiinta, balse dib ayuu hoos ugu soo laabtay markii suuqyadu rajo ka muujiyeen dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed. The post Sacuudiga oo tallaabo qaaday kadib gantaallo lagu weeraray appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Kenya oo Dhistay Cutub Gaar ah oo La Dagaallama Ka Ganacsiga Dadka iyo Dambiyada Xuduudaha Ka Gudba
items.description: Nairobi – Dowladda Kenya ayaa hawlgelisay cutub boolis oo khaas ah oo loogu talagalay la dagaallanka ka ganacsiga dadka, tahriibinta muhaajiriinta iyo dambiyada abaabulan ee la xiriira socdaalka. Mas’uuliyiintu waxay sheegeen in uu yahay cutubkii ugu horreeyay ee noociisa ah Bariga Afrika. Cutubkan oo ka kooban 29 sarkaal, laguna magacaabo Counter-Organised Immigration Crime Team (COICT), ayaa ka shaqeyn doona baaritaanka shabakadaha dambiyada ee ka faa’iideysta xuduudaha iyo nidaamka socdaalka Kenya. Waxaa la geyn doonaa goobaha muhiimka ah ee xuduudaha dalka. Saraakiisha ayaa tababar heer sare ah ku qaatay baaritaannada ku saleysan xog sirdoon, falanqaynta caddeymaha dijitaalka iyo maaliyadda, maamulka goobaha dambiyada, iskaashiga caalamiga ah iyo ilaalinta xuquuqda dhibbanayaasha. Agaasimaha Waaxda Dambi-baarista Kenya (DCI), Mohamed Amin, ayaa sheegay in cutubkan uu diiradda saari doono burburinta shabakadaha dambiyada abaabulan iyadoo isla markaana la dhowrayo xuquuqda iyo karaamada dadka ay dhibaatadu soo gaarto. Mashruucan waxaa taageeray Barnaamijka Amniga Xuduudaha Bariga Afrika, iyadoo ay gacan ka geysteen Dowladda Boqortooyada Midowday (UK), hay’adaha VALAR iyo HAART Kenya. Tallaabadan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada ay dalalka Bariga Afrika ku xoojinayaan iskaashiga amniga si loola dagaallamo ka ganacsiga dadka, tahriibinta muhaajiriinta, maalgelinta argagixisada iyo been-abuurka dukumentiyada safarka.

items.title: Midowga Afrika oo wada-tashi ka billaabay mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Qeybta Howlgallada Taageerada Nabadda ee Midowga Afrika (African Union Peace Support Operations Division) ayaa 24-kii Luulyo qabatay shir heer khubaro ah oo lagu falanqeeyay mustaqbalka ka-qaybgalka Midowga Afrika ee arrimaha amniga iyo nabadeynta Soomaaliya. Shirka, oo uu guddoominayay Agaasimaha Qeybta Howlgallada Taageerada Nabadda ee Midowga Afrika, Jeneraal Cheick Dembele, ayaa waxaa ka qeyb galay wakiillo ka socday Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Howlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), dalalka ciidamada iyo booliiska ku biiriya howlgalka, Guddiga Saraakiisha Militariga ee Midowga Afrika, kooxda A3 ee Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo Qaramada Midoobay. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray is-weydaarsiga aragtiyo iyo talooyin ku saabsan jihada uu qaadan doono howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo la eegayo xaaladda amni, dadaallada dowlad-dhisidda iyo qorshaha kala-guurka ee lagu wareejinayo mas’uuliyadda amniga ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Mas’uuliyiinta ka qeyb gashay ayaa sidoo kale falanqeeyay sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Midowga Afrika iyo saaxiibbada caalamiga ah, si loo xaqiijiyo nabad waarta, xasillooni iyo horumar laga gaaro la dagaallanka kooxaha argagixisada. Midowga Afrika ayaa sheegay in shirkan uu qeyb ka yahay geeddi-socod istaraatiiji ah oo wada-tashi joogto ah, kaas oo lagu taageerayo go’aan ka gaarista qaabka iyo doorka uu Midowga Afrika mustaqbalka uga sii shaqeyn doono Soomaaliya, iyadoo la tixgelinayo baahiyaha dalka iyo xaaladaha amni ee isbeddelaya. Kulankan ayaa imanaya xilli ay socdaan dadaallo lagu qiimeynayo mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM iyo sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa in Soomaaliya ay si tartiib tartiib ah ula wareegto mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka, iyadoo taageero ka helaysa Midowga Afrika iyo beesha caalamka.

items.title: Turkey cannot commercially drill Somalia’s offshore oil: ex-Puntland minister
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Former Puntland minister and Somali political commentator Ali Haji Warsame has questioned Turkey’s ability to commercially develop Somalia’s offshore oil resources, arguing that Ankara’s current operations in Somali waters are limited to exploration and fall far short of full-scale oil production. Speaking in a recent interview, Warsame said the Turkish exploration vessel operating off central Somalia is carrying out what he described as test drilling and exploration activities, not commercial drilling or oil extraction. He argued that Turkey does not currently possess the capability to independently develop the offshore blocks awarded under its hydrocarbons agreement with Somalia’s federal government and would ultimately require partnerships with major international energy companies before any commercial production could begin. Warsame further claimed that the development process could take years, saying Somalia is unlikely to see commercially produced offshore oil before 2034, even if exploration proves successful and future investment moves ahead. The former Puntland minister also criticized the terms of the Somalia-Turkey petroleum agreement, alleging that Ankara is seeking a 90% share of profits under what he described as an opaque and unfavorable deal negotiated with the current federal administration. He argued that the Somali public has not been fully informed about the agreement and accused officials of creating unrealistic expectations by suggesting the country is on the verge of producing offshore oil. “The public is being led to believe commercial oil production is imminent when the process remains years away,” Warsame said. Warsame joins a growing number of Somali academics, politicians and public figures who have publicly questioned the transparency and legal basis of Somalia’s petroleum partnership with Turkey. Among the most prominent critics is Somali scholar Professor Abdi Ismail Samatar, who has repeatedly argued that the agreement lacks sufficient transparency and should have undergone broader legal and institutional scrutiny before implementation. In recent social media posts, Samatar accused Turkey of pursuing Somalia’s natural resources through what he characterized as an improperly negotiated agreement with the federal government. He also alleged that Ankara’s military support for Mogadishu – including drones, air support and other security assistance – is intended to safeguard its strategic and economic interests in Somalia. Those allegations have not been independently verified, and neither the Turkish nor Somali governments have accepted such claims. Turkey has significantly expanded its presence in Somalia in recent years through cooperation in defense, infrastructure, humanitarian assistance and energy development. Under a hydrocarbons agreement signed with Somalia’s federal government, Turkish exploration vessels have begun offshore operations aimed at assessing the country’s oil and natural gas potential. Somalia’s federal government has consistently defended the partnership, saying the agreement is intended to unlock the country’s offshore energy resources, attract foreign investment and strengthen long-term economic development. Officials maintain that exploration activities are being conducted in accordance with Somali law and are designed to benefit the country’s future energy sector. Turkey has likewise described its energy cooperation with Somalia as part of a broader strategic partnership focused on supporting Somalia’s development while exploring the commercial potential of its offshore hydrocarbon resources. items.title: Ruushka oo saraakiil cusub usoo tababaray Soomaaliya
items.description: Moscow (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Ruushka ayaa haatan saraakiil cusub usoo tababartay Booliska Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo Jimcihii si rasmi ah uga qalinjabiyay Akadeemiyadda Maamulka ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha dalkaas, iyagoo ku guuleystay shahaadada heerka labaad ee Jaamacadda (Master Degree). Saraakiishan oo afar ah ayaa si gaar ah ugu takhasusay maamulka guud iyo qorshaynta istaraatiijiga ah, oo ah aqoon muhiim u ah hoggaaminta hay’adaha amniga, horumarinta maamulka, dejinta siyaasadaha, iyo qorsheynta istaraatiijiyadda lagu xoojinayo tayada adeegyada Booliska Soomaaliyeed. Qalin-jebinta afarta sarkaal ayaa loo arkaa guul weyn oo u soo hoyatay Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed iyo guud ahaan dalka, maadaama ay sare u qaadayso aqoonta iyo xirfadaha hoggaamineed ee saraakiisha loo diyaarinayo inay door muuqda ka qaataan dib-u-dhiska iyo casriyeynta hay’adaha amniga. Sidoo kale, dhacdadani waxay leedahay muhiimad taariikhi ah, iyadoo ay tahay markii ugu horreysay muddo ku dhow 40 sano oo saraakiil Soomaaliyeed ay kasoo qalinjebiyaan Jaamacad ku taalla dalka Ruushka. Tani waxay ka tarjumaysaa inuu dib u soo noolaanayo iskaashiga waxbarasho iyo xiriirka u dhexeeya dalalka Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada tababarka, aqoon-is-weydaarsiga, iyo horumarinta awoodda hay’adaha dowladda. Waxaa la filayaa in aqoonta iyo waayo-aragnimada ay saraakiishan cusub kasoo kororsadeen waxbarashadooda ay door weyn ka qaadato horumarinta Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, kor u qaadista hufnaanta shaqada, iyo xoojinta qorsheynta istaraatiijiga ah ee lagu horumarinayo amniga iyo adeegyada bulshada. Guushan ayaa sidoo kale dhiirrigelin u noqonaysa saraakiisha kale ee Soomaaliyeed ee doonaya inay sii wataan waxbarashadooda sare iyo kobcinta xirfadooda hoggaamineed. The post Ruushka oo saraakiil cusub usoo tababaray Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Gaadhsiinta biyaha ee dalka oo dhami waa qorshaha xukuumadda
items.description: Wasaaradda Qorshaynta iyo Horumarinta Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Marwo Kaltuun Sheekh Xasan, ayaa sheegtay in biyuhu yihiin mudnaanta koowaad ee Xukuumadda wadajir iyo waxqabad, iyadoo xustay in qorshuhu yahay in la gaadhsiiyo deegaan kasta oo dalka ah. Wasiir Kaltuun ayaa tilmaantay in Madaxweynaha Qaranka Jamhuuiryadda Somaliland Mudane Dr. Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro mudnaan gaar ah siiyay sidii degmo kasta oo laga heli karo biyo loogu hirgelin lahaa mashaariic biyo-gelin ah, iyadoo Wasaaradda Horumarinta Biyuhuna ay si joogto ah uga shaqayso sidii bulshada loo gaadhsiin lahaa adeegga biyaha. “Biyuhu waa mudnaanta koowaad ee Madaxweynaha Qaranka, waxaana mudnaan la siiyay in degmo kasta oo biyo laga heli karo laga hirgeliyo mashaariic biyo-gelin ah, Qorshaha Xukuumaddu Waa In Biyaha La Gaadhsiiyo Deegaan Kasta” ayay tidhi Wasiir Kaltuun Sheekh Xasan.

items.title: Maayarkii ugu wax qabadka badnaa Berbera iyo ku xigeenkiisii oo is casilay
items.description: Cabdishakuur Maxamed Cidin, Maayarkii magaalada Berbera oo xilkan hayey muddo 14 sano ah, ayaa si rasmi ah uga dhawaaqay inuu guud ahaanba iska casilay xilkii Maayirnimo ee degmada, waxaana sidoo kale isna is casilay maayar ku xigeenkiisii Nuur Jaamac Jaamac (Nuur Cad). Cabdishakuur Cidin, oo ahaa maayirkii ugu wax qabadka badnaa ee soo mara magaalada Berbera waxa uu sheegay in golaha deegaanku ay iska dhex dooran doonaan maayarka iyo ku xigeenkiisa. Maayar Cidin waxa lagu xasuustaa wax qabad karti, hawl karnimo, daacadnuu dalkiisa iyo dagmadiisba u ahaa iyo waliba dad isku wad.

items.title: Laba ka mid ah dalalka Khaliijka oo weerar toos ah ku qaaday Iiraan kuna biiray dagaalka
items.description: Manama (Caasimada Online) – Baxreyn iyo Kuwait ayaa si qarsoodi ah diyaarado dagaal ugu diray gudaha Iran, iyagoo duqeeyay goobo militari oo ku yaalla dalkaas, sida ay sheegeen ilo xog-ogaal ah. Weerarradan, oo dhacay horraantii bishan, ayaa noqonaya tallaabadii ugu horreysay ee ay labada dal si toos ah uga qaadaan Iran, xilli dagaalka gobolka uu sii daba-dheeraanayo, dowladaha Carabtuna ay wajahaan xaalad amni iyo dhaqaale oo aad u adag. Duqeymaha ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday bakhaarro lagu keydiyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo gantaallada, iyo sidoo kale xarumo kale oo militari, sida ay ilo xog-ogaal ah u sheegeen wargeyska Wall Street Journal. Imaaraadka Carabta, oo dhowr jeer weerarro ka fuliyay Iran bilowgii dagaalka, ayaa labada dal siiyay xog sirdoon oo ku saabsan bartilmaameedyada, iyo difaac cirka ah oo lagu ilaalinayay diyaaradaha fulinayay weerarrada. Tallaabadan ayaa muujineysa bilowga iskaashi militari oo sii xoogeysanaya oo u dhexeeya qaar ka mid ah dalalka Carabta, kuwaas oo doonaya inay si wadajir ah uga hortagaan weerarrada Iran. Iran ayaa toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay inta badan weerarradeeda aargoosiga ah ku bartilmaameedsatay Baxreyn iyo Kuwait, oo labaduba martigeliya saldhigyo militari oo Mareykanku leeyahay. Labada dal waxay leeyihiin ciidamo cirka oo tiro ahaan kooban, kuwaas oo ku hubeysan diyaarado ay sameeyeen Mareykanka iyo dalal Yurub ah. Hase yeeshee, waxay go’aansadeen inaysan Iran u oggolaan inay sii waddo weerarrada iyada oo aan wax jawaab ah la siin, sida ay sheegeen dadka xogta u leh arrintan. Dowladda Imaaraadka ayaa sheegtay inay taageersan tahay dadaallada lagu dhimayo xiisadda gobolka, oo ay ku jirto in si buuxda dib loogu furo marin-biyoodka Hormuz, oo muhiim u ah dhoofinta saliidda dalalka Khaliijka. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Imaaraadka ayaa sidoo kale cambaareysay weerarrada lagu qaaday Kuwait iyo Baxreyn, waxayna sheegtay inay “si buuxda ula garab taagan tahay dalalkaas, ayna taageersan tahay dhammaan tallaabooyinka lagu ilaalinayo ammaankooda iyo xasilloonidooda”. Afhayeenno u hadlay dowladaha Kuwait iyo Baxreyn kama aysan jawaabin codsiyo loo diray oo ku saabsanaa inay faallo ka bixiyaan duqeymaha. Dalalka Carabta ee Khaliijka ayaa hadda ku dhex jira dagaal aysan dooneyn, iyagoo dhinaca kalena deris la ah Iran oo ka weyn, awood badanna leh, isla markaana u aragta in si weyn loo dhibaateeyay. Dalalkan ayaa si wadajir ah u qaaday qeybta ugu badan ee weerarradii Iran ay fulisay intii uu dagaalku socday. Waxay hadda la tacaalayaan suuragalnimada in colaadda iyo is-horfadhigu sii dheeraadaan, taas oo khatar ku ah ammaankooda iyo dhaqaalahooda. “Dagaalka oo sidan hadda uu ku socdo kusii socda waa xaaladda ugu xun ee ay wajihi karaan,” ayay tiri Dina Esfandiary, oo ah khabiir ku takhasustay Bariga Dhexe kana tirsan Bloomberg Economics. Waxay sheegtay in dagaalku uusan dalalka Khaliijka siin fursad ay dib ugu dhistaan sawirkooda ah inay yihiin meel xasilloon oo ku dhex taalla gobol qalalaase badan, isla markaana uu saameynayo qaab-dhismeedka dhaqaalahooda. Imaaraadka ayaa dagaalka ku lug yeeshay xilli hore, isagoo tobannaan duqeymo ah ka fuliyay Iran tan iyo bilowgii colaadda, weerarradana sii waday ilaa maalintii ka dambeysay markii xabbad-joojin lagu dhawaaqay bishii April. Iran ayaa toddobaadyadii dambe inta badan ka gaabsatay inay weerarto Imaaraadka, inkastoo horraantii bishan ay duqeysay laba markab oo shidaal oo laga leeyahay dalkaas. Kuwait iyo Baxreyn ayaa wajahaya xaalad ka sii adag. Labada dal muddo tobannaan sano ah xiriir wanaagsan lama lahayn Iran, waxayna noqdeen bartilmaameedyada ugu waaweyn ee weerarradii ugu dambeeyay. Iran ayaa hadda kordhisay weerarrada ay ku beegsaneyso kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Kuwait ayaa Axaddii sheegtay in Iran ay weerartay warshad koronto iyo xarun biyaha badda looga dhigo kuwo la cabbi karo. Kuwait waxay weerarka ku tilmaantay khatar ka dhan ah muwaadiniinteeda iyo tallaabo si weyn u sii hurineysa xiisadda gobolka. Dalalka Oman iyo Qatar ayaa muddo dheer isku dheellitirayay xiriirkooda Iran iyo reer Galbeedka, mana muujin rabitaan weyn oo ay Tehran si toos ah ula galaan dagaal. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa bilowgii dagaalka Imaaraadka kala qeyb qaadatay weerarrada Iran, balse hadda waxay dib u qiimeyneysaa mowqifkeeda, sida ay sheegeen ilo xog-ogaal ah. Dowladaha Carabta ayaa markii hore rajeynayay in dagaalku si degdeg ah ku dhammaado, si ay dib ugu laabtaan qorshayaashooda dhaqaale. Hase yeeshee, colaadda ayaa hadda gashay bishii shanaad, iyadoo aanay jirin calaamad muujineysa in dhinacyadu gaareen ujeeddooyinkooda ama ay diyaar u yihiin inay dib u gurtaan. Dhoofinta saliidda dalalka Khaliijka ayaa si weyn u dhaawacantay, kadib markii Iran ay ciriiri gelisay marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Khatar kale ayaa toddobaadkan kasoo baxday Badda Cas, halkaas oo kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee ay Iran taageerto ay xayiraad kusoo rogtay maraakiibta, isla markaana weerarro ku qaaday gaadiidka badda. Dalxiiskii gobolka ayaa hoos u dhacay, halka maalgelintii caalamiga ahayd ay cadaadis sii kordhaya wajahayso. Weerarradan, oo dhacay horraantii bishan, ayaa noqonaya tallaabadii ugu horreysay ee ay labada dal si toos ah uga qaadaan Iran, xilli dagaalka gobolka uu sii daba-dheeraanayo, dowladaha Carabtuna ay wajahaan xaalad amni iyo dhaqaale oo aad u adag. Duqeymaha ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday bakhaarro lagu keydiyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo gantaallada, iyo sidoo kale xarumo kale oo militari, sida ay ilo xog-ogaal ah u sheegeen wargeyska Wall Street Journal. Imaaraadka Carabta, oo dhowr jeer weerarro ka fuliyay Iran bilowgii dagaalka, ayaa labada dal siiyay xog sirdoon oo ku saabsan bartilmaameedyada, iyo difaac cirka ah oo lagu ilaalinayay diyaaradaha fulinayay weerarrada. Tallaabadan ayaa muujineysa bilowga iskaashi militari oo sii xoogeysanaya oo u dhexeeya qaar ka mid ah dalalka Carabta, kuwaas oo doonaya inay si wadajir ah uga hortagaan weerarrada Iran. Dowladda Imaaraadka ayaa sheegtay inay taageersan tahay dadaallada lagu dhimayo xiisadda gobolka, oo ay ku jirto in si buuxda dib loogu furo marin-biyoodka Hormuz, oo muhiim u ah dhoofinta saliidda dalalka Khaliijka.
