items.title: Mareykanka oo wada-hadallo culus la billaabay Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea kadib markii ay…
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa sare u qaaday wada-hadallada ay la leedahay Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea, xilli weerarrada sii kordhaya ee lagu beegsanayo maraakiibta ganacsiga ay walaac cusub ka abuureen ammaanka Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Tallaabadan diblomaasiyadeed ayaa timid kaddib kulamo 19-kii July magaalada Qaahira ku dhexmaray Massad Boulos, oo ah la-taliyaha sare ee madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ee arrimaha Carabta iyo Afrika, iyo wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea. Kulamada, oo ay sidoo kale qeyb ka ahaayeen mas’uuliyiin Masaari ah, ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda amni ee Geeska Afrika, xasilloonida Badda Cas iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga dalalka gobolka. Mas’uuliyiintu ma shaacin wax heshiis ah oo ku saabsan saldhigyo ciidan ama marin-badeed uu Mareykanku ka heli doono Soomaaliya ama Eritrea. Si kastaba, kulamadan ayaa dhaliyay su’aalo ku saabsan in Washington ay dooneyso inay dhisto qorshe amni oo ballaaran oo ka hanaqaada xeebaha Afrika ee Badda Cas. Boulos ayaa sheegay inuu wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cabdi Cali, kala hadlay “arrimo muhiim ah oo la xiriira ammaanka iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika”, oo ay ku jiraan iskaashiga gobolka iyo wada-hadallada siyaasadeed ee gudaha Soomaaliya. Kaddib kulankii uu la yeeshay wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Eritrea, Osman Saleh, Boulos wuxuu sheegay in labada dhinac ay ka wada-hadleen sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga ganacsiga, horumarinta dhaqaalaha gobolka iyo arrimaha amniga. “Xilli dadaallada wadajirka ahi ay ka muhiimsan yihiin sidii hore, waxaan adkeynay baahida loo qabo inaan si wax-ku-ool ah uga wada shaqeyno xalinta khilaafaadka gobolka iyo horumarinta nabad, xasillooni iyo barwaaqo waarta oo ka hanaqaada Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika,” ayuu yiri Boulos. Halisaha maraakiibta Wada-hadalladan ayaa ku soo aadaya xilli kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay kordhisay hanjabaadaha iyo weerarrada ka dhanka ah maraakiibta isticmaasha marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, oo kala qeybiya Yemen, Jabuuti iyo Eritrea. Weerarrada lagu qaaday maraakiibta shidaalka iyo digniinaha la xiriira xannibaad ballaaran ayaa ku qasbay shirkado badan inay beddelaan marinadii ay isticmaali jireen. Xiisadda ka taagan marin-biyoodka Hormuz ayaa sidoo kale kordhisay cabsida laga qabo in carqalad ay ku timaado labada dhinac ee marinka muhiimka u ah dhoofinta shidaalka dalalka Khaliijka. Qiimaha shidaalka ayaa sare u kacay, iyadoo suuqyada caalamka ay si dhow ula socdaan weerarrada maraakiibta iyo suuragalnimada in sahayda tamarta ay hakad gasho. Mareykanka ayaa horey uga digay in maraakiibta xiriirka la leh Washington, Britain ama Israel ay wajahaan halis sare marka ay marayaan koonfurta Badda Cas, Bab al-Mandab iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Bab al-Mandab wuxuu isku xiraa Badweynta Hindiya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, isaga oo maraakiibta u sii gudbiya Kanaalka Suweys, waxaana uu kamid yahay marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga iyo tamarta caalamka. Weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ayaa horey hoos ugu dhigay tirada maraakiibta isticmaasha marinkan, waxaana shirkado badan lagu qasbay inay qaataan jidka dheer ee ku wareega koonfurta Afrika. Cameron Hudson, oo horey uga tirsanaa Aqalka Cad xilligii madaxweyne George W. Bush, ayaa sheegay in Washington ay dooneyso in dalalka ku yaalla xeebaha Afrika aysan noqon ilo cusub oo xasillooni-darro ah. “Mareykanku wuxuu u muuqdaa inuu leeyahay, ‘Haddii aydnaan naga caawin karin Badda Cas, ugu yaraan ha noqonina dhinac xaaladda sii xumeeya,’” ayuu yiri Hudson. Muhiimadda xeebaha Dhaqdhaqaaqan cusub ee Mareykanka ayaa Eritrea siinaya miisaan istaraatiiji ah oo sii kordhaya. Eritrea waxay leedahay dekedaha Massawa iyo Assab iyo xeeb dheer oo ku teedsan mid kamid ah marinnada ganacsi ee ugu mashquulka badan dunida. Xiriirka Washington iyo Asmara ayaa muddo dheer xumaa, balse maamulka Trump ayaa muujiyay inuu daneynayo dib-u-soo-celinta xiriirka, maadaama ammaanka Badda Cas uu noqday arrin muhiim ah. Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale leh xeeb istaraatiiji ah oo ka bilaabata Gacanka Cadmeed kuna fidsan Badweynta Hindiya, waxayna Mareykanka kala shaqeysaa la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab iyo kooxda Daacish. Bishii March 2025, madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Mareykanka u soo bandhigay inuu isticmaalo garoomo diyaaradeed iyo dekedo ay ku jiraan Baledogle, Berbera iyo Boosaaso. Qorshahaas ayaa lagu sheegay inuu Mareykanka siin karo marin milatari iyo mid sahay oo joogto ah, isla markaana ka hortagi karo in dalal ay Washington tartan kula jirto ay saameyn xooggan ku yeeshaan gobolka. Si kastaba, ku darista Berbera ayaa muran dhalisay, maadaama ay ku taallo Somaliland, oo Soomaaliya ay u aqoonsan tahay qeyb kamid ah dhulkeeda. Mareykanka ayaa hadda saldhiggiisa ugu weyn ee gobolka ee Camp Lemonnier ku leh dalka Jabuuti, wuxuuna sidoo kale sii wadaa duqeymaha uu Soomaaliya kula beegsanayo Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish. Falanqeeye amni oo lagu magacaabo Mubarak Aliyu ayaa sheegay in iskaashiga Masar iyo Mareykanka uu muujinayo in dhibaatooyinka Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas aan hadda si kala gooni ah loo wajihi karin. “Iskaashiga Masar iyo Mareykanka wuxuu caddeynayaa in dhibaatooyinka Geeska Afrika ay isku xiran yihiin, ayna u baahan yihiin diblomaasiyad isku dheellitirta awood-celinta, iskaashiga gobolka iyo xasilloonida muddada dheer,” ayuu yiri. Inkasta oo Washington aysan weli si cad u shaacin qorshaheeda, haddana kororka halisaha Bab al-Mandab ayaa Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea siinaya muhiimad diblomaasiyadeed iyo mid amni oo cusub, iyadoo xeebaha Afrika ee Badda Cas ay sii galayaan xisaabta istaraatiijiyadda Mareykanka. items.title: Somali President Plans Frontline Visit as Anti-Al-Shabaab Offensive Gathers Pace
items.description: MOGADISHU— Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud is expected to visit frontline areas in the Middle Shabelle and Galgaduud regions in the coming days, as the Federal Government intensifies preparations for a renewed military offensive against Al-Shabaab, according to informed sources. The sources said several units of the Somali security forces have been deployed to the coastal town of Adale in Middle Shabelle to reinforce security and prepare for the president’s anticipated visit. Senior commanders of the Somali National Army have also recently held meetings in Adale, focusing on security arrangements and operational plans for a new military campaign targeting Al-Shabaab positions across the region. President Mohamud is also expected to travel to El Dheer in the Galgaduud region, where he is reportedly scheduled to meet senior military commanders, local authorities and officials involved in operations along the frontlines. The anticipated visits come amid growing indications that the Federal Government is preparing to reinvigorate its campaign against Al-Shabaab. Military mobilisation and operational preparations are already underway in several areas of Hirshabelle State, where government forces and allied local fighters are seeking to increase pressure on the militant group. The planned offensive is understood to form part of the government’s broader strategy to weaken Al-Shabaab’s presence, disrupt its operational networks and regain control of areas where the group remains active. However, the Somali presidency and other government institutions have not formally confirmed the visits, and no official timetable for the president’s travel has been announced. The post Somali President Plans Frontline Visit as Anti-Al-Shabaab Offensive Gathers Pace appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Juventus Eyeing Manchester United Captain Bruno Fernandes
items.description: By Saleeymaan Alcadaala Sports Reporter, Radio Dalsan TV Juventus have been linked with a ambitious move for Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes, as Luciano Spalletti looks to add more creativity and leadership to his squad. The 31-year-old’s Serie A experience and technical quality have caught the attention of Juve’s hierarchy, who are keen to restore the club to the top of European competition. Juventus’ interest comes at a time when contract extension talks with Fernandes are progressing slowly. While the Italian club have made contact with the player’s representatives to assess the market value, any potential transfer appears difficult on multiple fronts. Manchester United are reportedly demanding a fee between €50 million and €75 million , which alone presents a significant financial challenge for the Turin-based club. Another obstacle is Fernandes’ high salary. He currently earns around £375,000 per week, and a new contract is expected to push that figure to £400,000 , making him United’s highest earner. This wage level is far above what Juventus currently pay, with their top earner on approximately €6 million per year. Furthermore, recent reports suggest Fernandes is not ready to leave Old Trafford. Contract negotiations are said to be ongoing, with the Portuguese international fully committed to staying at United, having already rejected approaches from clubs in Saudi Arabia . There is also an option to extend his current deal by a further year. Juventus would need to make a substantial financial outlay and match high salary demands to lure the Portuguese star away from Manchester. However, almost all indications point towards him remaining at United, where he remains a key figure in attack and the club’s captain. The post Juventus Eyeing Manchester United Captain Bruno Fernandes first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Kooxda Juventus oo soo gashay tartanka kaptanka kooxda Manchester United ee Bruno Fernandes
items.description: By Saleeymaan Alcadaala wariye katirsan Radio Dalsan Tv Juventus ayaa la sheegay inay sahaminayso u dhaqaaqis hami leh oo ay ku doonayso kabtanka Manchester United Bruno Fernandes, iyadoo Luciano Spalletti uu doonayo inuu hal-abuur iyo hoggaan dheeri ah ku daro kooxdiisa. Khibradda 31-jirka ee Serie A iyo tayadiisa farsamo ayaa ka dhigaysa mid si weyn u soo jiidatay maamulka Juve, kuwaasoo raba in kooxdu mar kale u tartanto tartamada waaweyn . Xiisaha Juventus ayaa yimid xilli ay wada-hadallada kordhinta qandaraaska Fernandes ay si tartiib ah u socdaan. Inkasta oo kooxda Talyaaniga ay xiriir la samaysay wakiilada ciyaaryahanka si ay u ogaadaan qiimaha suuqa , wareegiddani waxay u muuqataa mid dhib badan dhinacyo badan . Ilo wareeg ah ayaa sheegaya in Manchester United ay dalban karto lacag u dhaxaysa €50 milyan iyo €75 milyan , taasoo iyadu keligeed ah caqabad weyn oo Juventus hortaagan. Dhibaato kale ayaa ah mushaharka sare ee Fernandes. Wuxuu hadda ku qaataa qiyaastii £375,000 usbuucii , waxaana la filayaa in qandaraas cusub uu kor u qaadi karo ilaa £400,000 , taasoo ka dhigaysa ciyaaryahanka ugu mushaharka badan United . Heerkan mushaharku wuu ka sarreeyaa waxa Juve hadda bixiso, iyadoo mushaharka ugu sareeya uu yahay 6 milyan oo Yuuro sannadkiiba . Waxa intaa dheer, warbixinno dhow ayaa sheegaya in Fernandes uusan diyaar u ahayn inuu ka tago Old Trafford. Wada-hadallada qandaraaska cusub ayaa la sheegay inay sii socdaan , iyadoo Fernandes uu si buuxda uga go’an yahay sii joogista kooxda, isagoo hore u diiday dalabyo ka yimid kooxaha Carabta . Sidoo kale, waxaa jira ikhtiyaar ah in qandaraaskiisa lagu kordhiyo xilli ciyaareed kale . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, haddii ay jirto ikhtiyaar dhinaca Juventus , waxay u baahan doontaa inay bixiso lacag cusub oo ay la jaanqaadaan mushahar aad u sarreeya si ay u soo jiitaan xiddigan reer Portugal. Balse ku dhawaad dhammaan calaamaduhu waxay tilmaamayaan in uu sii joogi doono Manchester United , isagoo yahay halbeeg muhiim u ah howlaha weerarka iyo kabtanka kooxda . The post Kooxda Juventus oo soo gashay tartanka kaptanka kooxda Manchester United ee Bruno Fernandes first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Daawo: Trump oo markale weeraray Ilhaan: Waa inay ka baxdaa dalkeenna
items.description: Washigton (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Maraykanka, Donald Trump ayaa maanta mar kale weerar culus oo afka ah ku qaaday X ildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar oo ka tirsan Golaha Congresska, isla markaana ay si wen isugu hayaan siyaasadda dalkaasi. Donald Trump ayaa Ilhaan ku tilmaamay qof aan caad ahayn, wxuuna amray inay ka baxdo dalka Mareykanka, sida uu ku dooday. Trump oo sidoo kale aflagaadeynaya Ilhaan Cumar ayaa yiri “Ilhan Omar Waa qof caqli ahaan liita, sidoo kalena waa qof aan daacad ahayn. Waa inay dalkeenna ka baxdaa, ma ahan inay sii joogto”. Trump, oo horey u weeraray asalka Soomaalinimo ee Ilhaan Cumar ayaa sidoo kale si adag u dhaleeceeyay Soomaaliya oo uu xitaa u gefay dhowr jeer oo hore. H adallada Trump ee ku saabsan Ilhaan, oo ku dhalatay Soomaaliya ka hor inta aysan qoyskeedu imaan Mareykanka sannadihii 1990-meeyadii, ayaa marar badan soo noq-noqday, isaga oo sidoo kale u gefay dalka ay asal ahaan kasoo jeedo. Ilhaan Cumar, weli dhankeeda kama jawaabin weerarkan cusub ee Trump, balse horey ayay uga falcelisay weerarradiisa, iyadoo ku sheegtay inay tahay astaan u taagan halganka muhaajiriinta iyo dadka laga tirada badan yahay ee Mareykanka. Si kastaba, Madaxweynaha Mareykanka oo caan ku ah hadallo soo noq-noqda iyo jees-jees, ayaa muddo dheer ku celinayay kaftan uu ka sheegay Ilhaan, isagoo xittaa mar shaaciyay inuu Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh weydiiyay in “dib loogu celin karo” dalkii ay asal ahaan ka soo jeeday. The post Daawo: Trump oo markale weeraray Ilhaan: Waa inay ka baxdaa dalkeenna appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dagaal culus oo dhexmaray Al-Shabaab iyo ciidanka Kenya
items.description: Mandera (Caasimada Online) – Warar kala duwan ayaa kasoo baxaya dagaal culus oo maanta ka dhacay deegaanno hoostaga magaalada Mandera ee Gobolka Waqooyi Bari, kaas oo u dhexeeyay maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab iyo ciidamada dowladda Kenya. Dagaalka oo laba goobood ka kala dhacay ayaa yimid, kadib markii maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab ay weerareen fariisimo ay ciidamada Kenya ku leeyihiin duleedka magaalada, waxaana kadib xigay dagaal toos ah. Weerarka koowaad ayay maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab ku qaadeen deegaanka lagu magacaabo Fino, iyaga oo beegsaday saldhig ciidamada Kenya ku leeyihiin halkaasi, waxaana kadib la maqlay rasaas ay is waydaarsanayaan labada dhinac. Sidoo kale, weerarka labaad ayaa ka dhacay deegaanka Carabiya oo isna hoostaga Mandera, halkaas oo ay beegsadeen maleeshiyaad kale oo ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen ilo deegaanka ah. Illaa iyo hadda ma cadda khasaaraha rasmiga ah ee ka dhashay weerarradan iyo dagaallada xigay, maadaama goobaha la beegsaday ay yihiin saldhigyo ay dagan yihiin ciidamada dalka Kenya. Dhanka kale, ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay saraakiisha laamaha ammaanka Kenya oo ku aadan weerarradaas iyo haddii ay jiraan howlgallo ay sameeyeen ciidamada kadib dagaalka. Xaaladda ayaa weli kacsan, waxaana haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo laga dareemayaa qaybo badan oo kamid ah xadka dheer ee ay wadaagaan dalalka Soomaaliya iyo Kenya, halkaas oo ay dhuumaaleysi uga gudbaan xubnaha Shabaab ee weerarada ka fuliya Gobolka Waqooyi Bari. Inta badan maleeshiyada Al-Shabaab ayaa weeraro ku dhufo oo ka dhaqaaq ah ku qaada xarumaha ciidamada Kenya ku yaalla halkaasi, maadaama ay weli kooxda si weyn ugu xoogan tahay gobollada Jubbooyinka ee koonfurta dalka Soomaaliya. The post Dagaal culus oo dhexmaray Al-Shabaab iyo ciidanka Kenya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Trump oo xaqiijiyay in Natanyahu uu imaanayo Washington
items.description: Washington ( Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqay in ra’iisul wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu uu booqan doono Mareykanka toddobaadka soo socda. Mr. Trump ayaa warkan ku dhawaaqay shalay khudbad uu ka jeediyay casho sharafta ururka saxafiyiinta ee Aqalka Cad. Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil ayaa horay u shaaciyay in Mr. Netanyahu uu u safri doono Washington maalinta Isniinta ah, uuna la kulmi doono Donald Trump maalinta Talaadada ah. Xafiiska Netanyahu ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday inuu ka qeyb galayo aaska marxuum Seneter Lindsey Graham. items.title: Kooxda AS oo weerar ka geystay Ismaamulka Mandheera
items.description: Mandheera ( Raxanreeb Online) Faah faahino dheeraad ah ayaa laga kasoo baxaya weeraro kala duwan oo kooxda Al-shabaab, ay ka geystay magaalooyinka Arabia iyo Fino ee ismaamulka Mandheera ee dalka Kenya. Weeraradan ayaa la sheegay in ay dhaceen sacaadihii lasoo dhaafay waxaana ka dhashay dhaawaca 1 qof oo shacab ah, sida ay sheegeen laamaha amniga. Saraakiisha amniga ee Mandheera, ayaa tilmaamay in ciidamada ay ka jawaabeen weerarka, isla markaana ay ku raad jogaan xubnihii weerarka fuliyay oo ay shegeen in ay yihiin maleeshiyaad katirsan Al-shabaab. Sidoo kale xubnaha weerarka geystay ayaa la tilmaamay in ay gaarayeen 10 ruux, isla markaana hadda uu socdo howlgallo lagu raadinayo sidii gacanta loogu soo dhigi lahaa. Dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in dagaalka uu dhacay xiliga Salaada Maqrib la galayay. Sikastaba, dowladda Kenya ayaa todobaadkii lasoo dhaafay waxa ay ciidamo dheeraad ah geysay xadka ay la wadaagto Soomaaliya, waxaana ujeedka ciidamada loo geeyay halkaasi ay tahay inay ka hor tagaan weerarada mararka qaar ay Al-shabaab ka geystay gobolka Waqooyi Bari ee dalka Kenya. items.title: Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta oo gubay warshadda shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Jizan
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa waaberigii saaka weeraray warshad saliidda sifeysa oo ku taala magaalada dekedda leh ee Jizan (Jazan) ee Koonfur Galbeed Sacuudiga. Warshaddan oo ay leedahay Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco ayaa gubatay, ka dib weerarka ay ku qaadeen Xuutiyiinta oo loo adeegsaday gantaal nooca ballaastikada iyo drones. Muuqaalo la soo dhigay barraha bulshada ayaa muujinaya goobta la beegsaday oo gubaneysa iyo dadaalo lagu deminayo dabka oo socda. Muuqaalada ayaa laga arki karaa qiiq cirka isku shareeray hawada magaalada iyo xarunta sifeynta shidaalka ee Saudi Aramco ee Jazan oo dab weyn uu qabsaday. items.title: Baarlamanka K/Galbeed oo qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaannada Baarlamaanka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya oo maanta yeeshay kulankoodii 6-aad ee kalfadhiga 1-aad ayaa qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah oo ku aadan dhismaha guddiyada golaha. Kulanka oo ahaa mid xasaasi ah ayaa waxaa guddoomiyay Mudane Mudane Mahad Maxamed Sheekh Xasan oo ah Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo si buuxda ay uga soo qayb-galeen mudanayaasha golaha. Xildhibaannada Golaha Wakiillada ayaa cod aqlabiyad leh ku ansixiyay Guddiyada iyo hab-dhowreyaasha Golaha si loo dardar geliyo howlaha hortabinta u leh Dowladda Koofur galbeed Soomaaliya. Guddiyada la dhisay oo ka kooban illaa 8 Guddi ayaa kala ah:- 1-Guddiga-Xeer-Hoosaadka, Anshaxa, Xasaanadda, Daryeelka Xildhibaannada iyo Dastuurka. 2-Guddiga Garsoorka, Arrimaha Diinta iyo Awqaafta. 3-Guddiga Amniga, Arrimaha Gudaha, Maamulka Gobolada, Degmooyinka, Dib-uheshiisiinta iyo Horumarinta Reer Miyiga. 4-Guddiga Arrimaha Bulshada, Shaqada, Shaqaalaha, Dhalinyarada, Isboortiga, Isgaarsiinta, Warfaafinta iyo Wacyigelinta. 5-Guddiga Horumarinta Kheyraadka. 6-Guddiga Maaliyadda, Ganacsiga, Warshadaha, Qorsheynta iyo Tira koobka. 7-Guddiga Haweenka, Xuquuqul Insaanka, Gargaarka, iyo Maaraynta Musiibooyinka. 8-Guddiga Howlaha Guud, Dib-udhiska Dalka, Dekadaha iyo Gaadiidka. Sidoo kale Hab-dhowreyaasha ay meel mariyeen Xildhibaannada Koonfur galbeed Soomaaliya oo ka kooban saddex Hab-dhowre ayaa kala ah:- 1-Idiris Axmed Yacquub ( Guddoomiye ). 2-Maxamed Mucaawiye Ibraahim ( ku xigeenka 1aad ). 3-Maxaad Maxamed Ciise ( ku xigeenka 2aad ). Ugu dambeyn, Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Maamulka Koofur galbeed Soomaaliya Mahad Maxamed Sheekh Xasan oo natiijada codaynta ku dhawaaqay ayaa Xildhibaannada ugu mahadceliyay gudashada waajibaadkooda iyo ka shaqaynta howlaha hortabinta u leh Dowlad dhiskeenna. The post Baarlamanka K/Galbeed oo qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Siciid Deni oo u safray dalka Imaaraatka Carabta
items.description: Garoowe ( Raxanreeb Online) Hoggaamiyaha dowlad goboleedka Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa u amba-baxay magaalada Abu-dhabi ee dalka isu-tagga Imaaraatka Carabta. Deni ayaa la sheegay in gelinkii dambe ee shalay ay diyaarad ka qaaday magaalada Garoowe, isla markaana uu sii maray magaalada Addis Ababa ee caasimada dalka Itoobiya. Madaxtooyada maamulka Puntland, kama aysan hadlin safarka uu Siciid Deni ku aaday Imaaraatka Carabta, iyo waxa uu ku qotomo. Socdaalka hoggaamiyaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa imaanaya xili xiriirka diblumaasiyadeed  ee dowladda federaalka iyo Imaaraatka Carabta uu yahay mid aan wanaagsaneen muddooyinkii dambe. Ma ahan markii ugu horeeysay oo uu hoggaamiyaha Puntland safar aan la ogeyn waxa uu salka ku hayo uu ku tago dalka Imaaraatka Carabta. The post Siciid Deni oo u safray dalka Imaaraatka Carabta appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Somaliland’s Buurmadow says he would support reunification with Somalia if Hargeisa became Capital
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Veteran Somaliland traditional leader Osman Aw Mohamud, widely known as Buurmadow, has proposed that Somaliland should consider reunification with Somalia if a political settlement designates Hargeisa as the national capital, marking one of the clearest public endorsements of conditional unity by a prominent Somaliland figure since the region declared independence in 1991. Buurmadow said reunification would, in his view, represent a more favourable outcome than pursuing international recognition if the settlement placed Hargeisa at the centre of a unified Somali state, allowed the Somali national flag to fly over the city and established a single national government. He also urged Somaliland’s leadership to open negotiations with Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, arguing that the current administration presents the best opportunity in years to reach a durable political agreement between Hargeisa and Mogadishu. He described Hassan Sheikh as more receptive to dialogue with Somaliland than previous Somali presidents and said any agreement should include relocating the national capital to Hargeisa. The remarks represent a notable departure from Somaliland’s longstanding political position, which has centred on seeking international recognition rather than reunification with Somalia. Since declaring independence in 1991, Somaliland has maintained its own government, legislature, security institutions and currency while operating separately from the federal authorities in Mogadishu, although it remains internationally recognised by the vast majority of states as part of Somalia. Buurmadow’s proposal has generated significant discussion across Somaliland and Somalia because senior political and traditional leaders in Somaliland have rarely advocated reunification publicly, even on a conditional basis, during more than three decades of self-rule. Neither Somaliland’s government nor leading traditional institutions have publicly responded to the remarks at the time of publication. The comments come at a time of renewed debate over Somaliland’s political future and its relationship with Somalia, with both sides continuing to hold fundamentally different positions on the territory’s constitutional status. While Somaliland maintains that its sovereignty is non-negotiable, Somalia’s federal government continues to regard the region as an integral part of the Somali state. Although Buurmadow’s proposal does not constitute an official policy shift, his intervention introduces an influential voice into one of the Horn of Africa’s most consequential political questions and is likely to intensify debate over whether future dialogue should focus on recognition, reunification or an alternative political settlement. items.title: UK oo Shaaciyay Sababta Geerida Amiir Sacuudiyaan ah oo meydkiisa laga Hoteel ku Yaalla London
items.description: Maxkamad baaritaan oo ku taalla magaalada London ayaa soo saartay natiijada baaritaanka geerida Amiir Cabdullaahi bin Fahad bin Cabdullaahi bin Cabdulcasiis bin Jalawi Al Saud , iyadoo lagu sheegay inuu u geeriyooday isku-darka khamri iyo maandooriye kale, halka aan la helin wax caddeyn ah oo muujinaysa is dilid ama fal-dambiyeed. Amiirka oo 29 jir ahaa kana tirsanaa qoyska boqortooyada Sacuudiga ayaa meydkiisa laga helay 25-kii November 2025 gudaha musqusha qolkiisa oo ku yaallay hoteelka Marriott Hotel ee degmada Kensington, galbeedka magaalada London. Baaritaanka maxkamadda ayaa lagu sheegay in amiirku uu dhiiggiisa ku jiray heer khamri ah oo ku dhowaad saddex jibbaar ka sarreeyay xadka sharciga ee loo oggol yahay darawallada England. Sidoo kale waxaa laga helay maandooriyaha GHB , oo loo yaqaan “party drug”, xashiishad iyo dawooyinka dejinta ee ay ka mid yihiin Xanax (alprazolam) iyo dawooyin kale oo loo isticmaalo welwelka. Dhakhaatiirta baaritaanka sameeyay ayaa sheegay in isku-darka walxahaasi uu sababay wadne istaag, k taasoo ugu dambeyn sababay geeridiisa. Warbixinta maxkamadda ayaa sidoo kale xustay in amiirku muddo bilo ah ka hor geeridiisa uu ku jiray xarumo caafimaad oo gaar loo leeyahay oo lagu daweeyo dadka la tacaalaya balwadda khamriga iyo dawooyinka dejinta. Waxaa lagu daaweeyay xarunta caanka ah ee Priory Clinic ee London iyo xarun kale oo ku taalla gobolka Merseyside, halkaas oo la sheegay inuu si wanaagsan uga qaatay daaweynta. Dhakhaatiirta cilmi-nafsiga ayaa maxkamadda u sheegay in amiirku uusan muujin wax calaamado ah oo la xiriira ismiidaamin, isla markaana uu si wanaagsan uga qayb qaatay daaweynta intii uu ku jiray xarumaha caafimaadka. Kaamirooyinka amniga (CCTV) ayaa muujiyay in habeenkii ka horreeyay geeridiisa uu keligiis ka baxay hoteelka si uu sigaar u cabo, kadibna uu kaligiis ugu soo laabtay qolkiisa, baarayaashuna ma helin wax caddeyn ah oo muujinaysa in qof kale ku lug lahaa geeridiisa. Kaaliyaha baaraha geerida ee UK, Jean Harkin , ayaa warbixinta ku soo gabagabeysay in geeridu ahayd shil ka dhashay isticmaalka isku-darka maandooriyaha iyo khamriga, iyadoo aan jirin wax tilmaamaya ismiidaamin ama faragelin qof kale. Waxay sidoo kale tacsi u dirtay qoyska boqortooyada Sacuudiga. Kiiskan ayaana si weyn u soo jiitay warbaahinta caalamka, maadaama uu khuseeyo xubin ka tirsan qoyska boqortooyada Sacuudiga.

items.title: DF oo ka farxisay ardeyda Soomaaliyeed ee Kenya
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Dalka Kenya oo maalmahan ku howlanayd sidii looga gudbi lahaa caqabadaha ka haysta ardayda Soomaaliyeed ee dalka Kenya u yimaada waxbarashada heerarkeeda kala duwan, ayaa sii xoojisay dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo aqoonsiga iyo isu-ekeysiinta shahaadooyinka dugsiyada sare ee Soomaaliya iyo kuwa Kenya. Dadaalladan oo uu hormuud ka yahay Danjire Jabriil Ibraahim Cabdulle iyo diblomaasiyiinta, howlwadeenada, ayaa lagu doonayaa in ardayda Soomaaliyeed loo fududeeyo helitaanka fursadaha waxbarasho ee jaamacadaha iyo machadyada kala duwan ee ku yaala dalkanKenya, iyadoo meesha laga saarayo caqabadihii muddooyinka soo jiitamayay ee la xiriiray aqoonsiga shahaadooyinka. Iyadoo arrintaasi ay qayb katahay qorshaha Safaaradda ee lagu horumarinayo adeegyada ay u hayso muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed, ayaa Danjire Jabriil Ibraahim Cabdulle iyo mas’uuliyiin ka socota Wasaaradda Waxbarashada iyo Taclinta sare ee Soomaaliya ay kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay Agaasimaha Guud ee Golaha Imtixaanaadka Qaranka Kenya (KNEC), Dr. David Njengere, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray horumarka laga sameeyay geeddi-socodka aqoonsiga iyo isu-ekeysiinta shahaadooyinka dugsiyada sare ee Soomaaliya iyo Kenya. Kulanka intii uu socday, Danjiruhu wuxuu Agaasimaha Guud ee hay’adda KNEC la wadaagay horumarka laga gaaray soo ururinta iyo diyaarinta dukumiintiyada looga baahan yahay dalka Soomaaliya, isagoo caddeeyay in Safaaraddu ay si dhow ula shaqaynayso hay’adaha ay khusayso si loo dhammaystiro dukumiintiyada harsan loona soo gudbiyo waqtiga ugu dhow. Dhankiisa, Agaasimaha Guud ee KNEC, Dr. David Njengere, ayaa soo dhaweeyay dadaalka iyo horumarka ay Safaaraddu ku tallaabsatay, isagoo xaqiijiyay in hay’adda KNEC ay diyaar u tahay inay si degdeg ah u guda gasho qiimeynta farsamo ee shahaadooyinka marka la helo dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay. Wuxuu sidoo kale muujiyay sida ay hay’addu uga go’an tahay inay ka shaqeyso xal waara oo dan u ah ardayda Soomaaliyeed. Lataliyaha wasiirka Waxbarashada Soomaaliya Mudane Cabdullahi Sujuu ayaa is a dhankiisa ka cadeeyay in Wasaaradda Soomaaliyeed ay taabagalinayso codsiyadda ka yimid hay’adaha Waxbarashada dalka Kenya. Danjire Jabriil Ibraahim Cabdulle, oo kulanka ka hadlay, ayaa sheegay in Safaaradda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee Dalka Kenya ay mudnaan gaar ah siisay xallinta caqabadaha waxbarasho ee haysta ardayda Soomaaliyeed, maadaama ay si toos ah u saameynayaan mustaqbalka kumannaan dhallinyaro Soomaaliyeed oo doonaya inay sii wataan waxbarashadooda. “Waxaa naga go’an inaan xaqiijinno in arday kasta oo Soomaaliyeed uu helo fursad waxbarasho oo caddaalad iyo sinaan ku dhisan. Muddooyinkii u dambeeyay waxaan dadaal xooggan aan gelinnay sidii looga gudbi lahaa caqabadaha la xiriira aqoonsiga shahaadooyinka, annagoo si joogto ah ula shaqaynaynay hay’adaha ay khusayso ee Soomaaliya iyo Kenya. Horumarka maanta la gaaray waa mid dhiirrigelin leh, waxaana rajaynaynaa in tallaabooyinka harsan si degdeg ah loo dhammaystiro, si ardaydeennu aysan mar dambe ula kulmin dib u dhac ku yimaada waxbarashadooda ama fursadahooda mustaqbalka. Safaaraddu waxay sii wadi doontaa dadaal kasta oo lagu difaacayo laguna horumarinayo danaha muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee ku nool ama wax ku barta dalka Kenya,” ayuu yiri Danjire Jabriil Ibraahim. Si kastaba, Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee Safaaradda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee Dalka Kenya ay ku xoojinayso adeegyada ay u hayso muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dhinacyada waxbarashada, horumarinta aqoonta iyo fududeynta fursadaha ay ka faa’iideysanayaan ardayda Soomaaliyeed ee waxbarashada u jooga dalka Kenya. Labada dhinac ayaa ugu dambayn isku raacay in la dhiso guddi farsamo oo wadajir ah, kaas oo si dhow ula socon doona dhammaystirka geeddi-socodka isu-ekeysiinta shahaadooyinka, isla markaana dardargelin doona tallaabooyinka farsamo ee harsan si arrintan loo soo gabagabeeyo. Waxaana la isla qaatay in bisha Sabtembar la soo afjaro qorshaha Qiimeybta shahaadooyinka si ay Ardeyda soomaliyeed ula jaan -qaadaan bilowga sanad- jamavadeedka ee bilaabano sandakan. Talabadaan ayaa ah mid farxad-gelinaysa ardeyda Soomaaliyeed ee danaynaysa in ay waxbarashadooda sare ku qaataan dalka kenya iyo guud ahaan geedisocdka wabarashada Soomaaliya.   The post DF oo ka farxisay ardeyda Soomaaliyeed ee Kenya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Al-Shabaab attacks Kenyan military bases in Mandera
items.description: Al-Shabaab militants launched coordinated attacks on two Kenyan military positions in the Fiino and Carabiya areas on the outskirts of Mandera town in Kenya’s North Eastern region on Saturday, triggering heavy exchanges of gunfire that left the border zone on high alert. The assaults targeted Kenyan Defence Force outposts near the Somali border, a volatile corridor where Al-Shabaab retains a significant operational presence across the Jubaland regions of southern Somalia and frequently stages cross-border raids. The attacks come as Kenyan security forces have intensified counter-terrorism operations along the frontier, with intelligence-led raids killing 11 militants in Mandera County just two weeks ago . Militants struck the first position in the Fiino area, targeting a Kenyan military base there, according to local sources. A second attack followed in the Carabiya area, also within Mandera’s outskirts, where additional Al-Shabaab fighters engaged Kenyan forces. The official casualty toll from both attacks and the subsequent firefights remains unclear, as the targeted positions are Kenyan military installations. Kenyan security officials have not yet issued any statement regarding the assaults or whether follow-up operations have been conducted. The situation along the Kenya-Somalia border remains tense, with increased security force movements reported in several areas. Al-Shabaab fighters frequently use the porous border to launch attacks before retreating into Somali territory, where the group maintains strongholds in the southern Jubaland regions. “Al-Shabaab, an al-Qaida-linked militant group based in Somalia, has carried out numerous attacks in Kenya over the past decade, particularly in areas near the shared border,” analysts note . Kenyan authorities have stepped up intelligence-led operations to prevent cross-border assaults, recently killing 11 suspected Al-Shabaab militants and recovering three PKM machine guns and 409 rounds of ammunition in a raid near the Esagur Cutline area . Security forces have also foiled planned attacks on border villages in Mandera County . Saturday’s attacks underscore the persistent threat Al-Shabaab poses to Kenya’s northeastern region, despite ongoing counter-terrorism efforts by both Kenyan and allied forces. The post Al-Shabaab attacks Kenyan military bases in Mandera first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Muxuu Wasiir Fiqi  kala hadlay madaxa howlgalka AUSSOM?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa maanta kulan la yeeshay Wakiilka Gaarka ah ee Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, ahna madaxa howlgalka taageerada iyo xasiloonida Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), Mudane El Hadji Ibrahima Diene, isaga oo kala hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah, gaar ahaan amniga dalka iyo dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab. Labada mas’uul ayaa kulankooda diiradda ku saaray xoojinta iskaashiga u dhexeeya Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo howlgalka AUSSOM, iyadoo laga wada-hadlay taageerada howlgallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada. Sidoo kale, waxa ay isla soo qaadeen muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo isku duubnida iyo isku xirnaanta hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya iyo ciidamada taageerada caalamiga ah, si loo dardargeliyo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo nabadgelyada iyo xasilloonida dalka. Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo kulanka ka hadlay ayaa uga mahadceliyay Madaxa AUSSOM taageerada joogtada ah ee ay siiso Soomaaliya, isagoo bogaadiyay iskaashiga dhow ee u dhexeeya Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo AUSSOM. Waxaa kale oo uu xusay in wada shaqeyn hufan oo dhex-marta labada dhinac ay muhiim u tahay guulaha laga gaarayo dagaalka ka dhanka ah argagixisada iyo sugidda amniga guud ee dalka. Dhankiisa, Madaxa Howlgalka AUSSOM, Mudane El Hadji Ibrahima Diene ayaa muujiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay Midowga Afrika in ay sii wadaan taageerada ay siinayaan dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dadaallada lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada amniga Soomaaliya iyo xaqiijinta nabad waarta. Kulanka ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli haatan dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay waddo qorshayaal lagu horumarinayo awoodda difaaca Qaranka iyo in mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka si buuxda loogu wareejiyo Ciidamada Xoogga Soomaaliyeed. Si kastaba, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa intii lagu guda jiray todobaadkii xorriyadda mar kale ku dhawaaqay dagaal kama dambeys ah oo lagu qaadayo Al-Shabaab, waxaana haatan socda isku dabaridda Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka. The post Muxuu Wasiir Fiqi kala hadlay madaxa howlgalka AUSSOM? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maxaa ka socda Geerisa, Ee galbeedka  Somaliland?
items.description: Maxaa ka socda Geerisa, Somaliland? Xukuumadda ayaa ku guulaysatay inay xabbad-joojin dhex dhigto labada beelood ee xeebta ku dagaalamayay, Gadabuursi iyo Ciise. Dagaalku wuxuu ahaa mid la soo waariday oo ah dagaal wakaaladeed oo wakhti dheer jiray, laakiin waxa iskaga hor yimid dad deegaan ahaan is xiga. Xabbad-joojinta ka dib, dawladdu waxay ka hawlgashay sidii loo qaban lahaa shirweyne oo gogol nabadeed ah, kaas oo lagu soo afjaro xaaladda coladeed, laguna kala saxeexdo heshiis nabadeed oo qoraal ah iyadoo dawladdu goob joog tahay. G. Guntigaab Beesha Ciise way diiday gogosha, halka Gadabuursi ay diyaar u tahay labada kay u dhacdaba colaad sii socota iyo nabad la gaadho. Wax hadal ah oo ay ku darsadeen arrintaas ma jirin. Beesha Ciise waxay ku andacootay in aanay nabad dhici doonin ilaa Somaliland iyo beesha Isaaq oo ay wax dagaal ah kala dhaxayn ay wada hadlaan. Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Ma joojinayno dagaalka Gadabuursi aan kula jirno ilaa aan Somaliland wada hadalno.” Waxay ku doodeen in dagaalku u dhexeeyo Ciise iyo Somaliland, oo ay Isaaq ugu yeedheen dhinaca kale. Si ay uga hor tagaan gogosha nabadeed ee loo asteeyay Geerisa, habeenkii 22-ka July waxay gubeen hanti Gadabuursi leedahay oo ku taalla Geerisa (guryo iyo meherado). May doonaan oo kuma duulin xarumaha Somaliland, mana raadsan Isaaq waxay weerareen Gadabuursi, sidaas darteed nabad Gadabuursi iyo Ciise dhex marta ma jiri karto ilaa Somaliland iyo Isaaq (oo aan waxba naga dhexayn) marka hore wada hadalno. Xukuumadda Somaliland ayaa isku dayday inay gacanta ku soo dhigto dadkii lagu eedeeyay inay gubeen hantida Geerisa. Arrintaas waxaa ka hor yimid dad mudaharaadayay, kuwaas oo markii dambe hub qaatay. Iska hor imaad ayaa dhacay, waxaana dhaawacmay qaar ka mid ah dadkii rabshadaha waday. Maanta, 24-ka July, jabhado hubaysan ayaa weerar ku qaaday ciidanka qaranka Somaliland, waxaana dhacay iska hor imaad ka dhacay deegaannadaas. Xaqiiqda biyo kama dhibcaan ah ayaa ah in dagaalkani aanu ahayn mid qabiil ama deegaan oo keliya, balse uu yahay mid siyaasadeed oo ka baxsan xuduudaha deegaanka, isla markaana ah dagaal la soo abaabulay. Ilaa xurgufta siyaasadeed marka hore la dhammeeyo oo dhinacyadu ku kala hadhaan, way adkaan doontaa in nabad waarta ay ka dhacdo deegaanka.

May doonaan oo kuma duulin xarumaha Somaliland, mana raadsan Isaaq waxay weerareen Gadabuursi, sidaas darteed nabad Gadabuursi iyo Ciise dhex marta ma jiri karto ilaa Somaliland iyo Isaaq (oo aan waxba naga dhexayn) marka hore wada hadalno. Xukuumadda Somaliland ayaa isku dayday inay gacanta ku soo dhigto dadkii lagu eedeeyay inay gubeen hantida Geerisa. Arrintaas waxaa ka hor yimid dad mudaharaadayay, kuwaas oo markii dambe hub qaatay. Iska hor imaad ayaa dhacay, waxaana dhaawacmay qaar ka mid ah dadkii rabshadaha waday. Maanta, 24-ka July, jabhado hubaysan ayaa weerar ku qaaday ciidanka qaranka Somaliland, waxaana dhacay iska hor imaad ka dhacay deegaannadaas. Xaqiiqda biyo kama dhibcaan ah ayaa ah in dagaalkani aanu ahayn mid qabiil ama deegaan oo keliya, balse uu yahay mid siyaasadeed oo ka baxsan xuduudaha deegaanka, isla markaana ah dagaal la soo abaabulay. Ilaa xurgufta siyaasadeed marka hore la dhammeeyo oo dhinacyadu ku kala hadhaan, way adkaan doontaa in nabad waarta ay ka dhacdo deegaanka.

items.title: Officers earn Russian master’s degrees in historic first
items.description: Four officers from the Somali Police Force graduated with master’s degrees from Russia’s Academy of Administration under the Ministry of Interior on Friday, marking the first time in more than 40 years that Somali police officers have completed advanced studies in Russia, in a ceremony that signals a revival of bilateral security cooperation between Mogadishu and Moscow. The officers specialised in General Administration and Strategic Planning – expertise critical for leading security institutions, improving management, setting policy, and strengthening the quality of police services. The graduation comes as Somalia pursues a diversified foreign policy, expanding international partnerships for security training with countries including Turkey, Egypt, Italy, Uganda, Qatar and the UAE, while Russia simultaneously seeks to deepen its diplomatic and security engagement across Africa. The four officers received their qualifications at a ceremony held at the Academy of Administration in Russia. Somali police authorities described the qualification as one that would strengthen leadership and institutional capacity within the force. Government officials hailed the graduation as a significant milestone in the revival of educational and security cooperation between Somalia and Russia, noting it was the first such graduation by Somali police officers from a Russian institution in four decades. “The knowledge and experience these officers have gained will play a major role in developing the Somali Police Force, improving operational efficiency, and strengthening strategic planning for security and community services,” a police source said. The officers are expected to return to Somalia and apply their expertise in strategic planning, public administration and institutional management as the country continues reforms aimed at modernising its security sector. Overseas professional education plays an increasingly important role in helping Somalia develop leadership within its security institutions, complementing domestic reforms and international support aimed at improving policing, governance and public safety. The graduation is also expected to encourage other Somali officers to pursue advanced studies and develop their leadership skills. The post Officers earn Russian master’s degrees in historic first first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somalia, IOM launch regional crackdown on human smuggling
items.description: Somalia’s Minister of Internal Security, General Abdullahi Sheikh Ismail Fartaag, officially launched a three-year Regional Counter-Smuggling Programme in Mogadishu on Thursday, in partnership with the International Organization for Migration (IOM) and the United Kingdom Border Security Command, to combat migrant smuggling, document fraud, and transnational organised crime across Somalia, Ethiopia, and Kenya. The initiative targets criminal networks that exploit weak border management and limited information-sharing to facilitate irregular migration, leaving migrants vulnerable to abuse, exploitation, and trafficking. It comes as Somalia’s federal government pushes to modernise its immigration and border systems amid persistent security challenges, with the Horn of Africa remaining a major transit route for smuggling and human trafficking. Speaking at the launch ceremony, Minister Fartaag described secure borders and airports as a cornerstone of Somalia’s national security strategy, stressing that the Federal Government is prioritising investment in professional, well-trained security institutions capable of responding to evolving threats. “Protecting our borders is fundamental to safeguarding Somalia’s security, facilitating legitimate travel and trade, and preventing transnational crime,” the minister said. The programme will focus on modernising border management, upgrading airport security systems, enhancing the detection of fraudulent travel and identity documents, supporting intelligence-led operations, improving inter-agency coordination, and promoting protection-sensitive responses to migrant smuggling and related crimes. According to the IOM, the initiative will strengthen the operational capacity of national security institutions and expand international cooperation to support the country’s stabilisation efforts. The programme also aims to promote closer cooperation between Somalia and neighbouring countries, including Ethiopia, Kenya and Uganda, to address cross-border human smuggling networks. Officials say the initiative will introduce internationally recognised border management practices and align Somalia’s border systems with global standards, helping facilitate legitimate travel while reinforcing measures against cross-border security threats. The launch follows years of IOM support for Somalia’s immigration and border management systems, with capacity-building work previously funded by the UK, the Netherlands, the United States, Finland, and Japan. No budget figures for the programme were disclosed. The post Somalia, IOM launch regional crackdown on human smuggling first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: IOM oo Soomaaliya ka Daah-furtay Barnaamij Lagula Dagaallamayo Tahriibinta iyo Dambiyada Xuduudaha
items.description: Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Socdaalka (IOM) ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ka daah-furtay barnaamij cusub oo heer gobol ah oo loogu talagalay la dagaallanka tahriibinta dadka, dukumentiyada been-abuurka ah iyo dambiyada abaabulan ee ka gudba xuduudaha. Barnaamijkan oo socon doona muddo saddex sano ah ayaa ka hirgelaya dalalka Soomaaliya, Itoobiya iyo Kenya, waxaana uu diiradda saarayaa burburinta shabakadaha dambiyada ee ka faa’iideysta daciifnimada maamulka xuduudaha, awoodda hay’adaha dowladda iyo wadaagga xogaha amniga. Sida ay IOM sheegtay, arrimahan ayaa sabab u noqda in muhaajiriin badan ay la kulmaan tacaddi, ka faa’iideysi, tahriibin iyo ganacsi dadka lagu iibiyo. Munaasabadda daah-furka waxaa si rasmi ah u furay Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Janaraal Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag), oo sheegay in barnaamijkani door muhiim ah ka qaadan doono xoojinta awoodda hay’adaha amniga iyo ilaalinta xuduudaha dalka. Wasiirku wuxuu xusay in ilaalinta xuduudaha ay saldhig u tahay sugidda amniga qaranka, fududeynta isu-socodka sharciyeysan ee dadka iyo ganacsiga, iyo ka hortagga dambiyada caalamiga ah. Wuxuu sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso dhismaha ciidan amni oo xirfad leh, si ay ula tacaalaan khataraha sii kordhaya. Barnaamijkan cusub ayaa diiradda saari doona casriyeynta maamulka xuduudaha, horumarinta nidaamyada amniga garoomada diyaaradaha, xoojinta awoodda lagu ogaanayo dukumentiyada safarka ee been-abuurka ah, kobcinta hawlgallada ku saleysan xogaha sirdoonka, hagaajinta iskaashiga hay’adaha dowladda iyo kor u qaadidda dadaallada lagu difaacayo xuquuqda dadka nugul ee ay saameeyaan tahriibinta iyo dambiyada la xiriira. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa rajo ka muujiyay in iskaashigan uu gacan ka geysan doono xoojinta amniga Soomaaliya iyo gobolka, isla markaana uu yareyn doono khataraha ka dhasha tahriibinta sharci darrada ah iyo dambiyada ka gudba xuduudaha.

items.title: Wajiga Koowaad ee Wada-tashiyada AUSSOM oo ka Dhacay Addis Ababa iyo Qorshaha Kala-guurka ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Midowga Afrika ayaa soo gabagabeeyay wajigii koowaad ee wada-tashiyada istaraatiijiga ah ee ku saabsan mustaqbalka joogitaanka hawlgalkiisa Soomaaliya, kaddib kulammo labo maalmood ah oo 22-kii iyo 23-kii Luulyo ka dhacay magaalada Addis Ababa, kuwaas oo lagu qiimeeyay wajiga xiga ee Hawlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM). Wada-tashiyadan ayaa daba socday kulankii 22-aad ee aan rasmiga ahayn ee Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka Midowga Afrika, kaas oo qabsoomay 8-dii Luulyo, laguna go’aamiyay in la dhiso koox shaqo oo soo diyaarinaysa istaraatiijiyad ku saabsan mustaqbalka hawlgalka AUSSOM. Wejiga koowaad ee wada-tashiyada ayaa isugu jiray kulammo farsamo oo ay ka qeyb-galeen wakiillo ka socday Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Hawlgalka AUSSOM, Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Taageerada Soomaaliya (UNSOS) iyo Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Midowga Afrika (UNOAU). Sida uu sheegay Guddiga Midowga Afrika, kulammadan farsamo waxay diiradda ku saareen arrimaha saamaynta muhiimka ah ku leh mustaqbalka hawlgalka, sida hogaaminta iyo siyaasadda oo ay ka mid yihiin qorshaha kala-guurka iyo shuruudaha hirgelinta wajiga cusub. Sidoo kale, waxaa si xeeldheer looga dooday maalgelinta, dhinaca sharciga, qaab-dhismeedka ciidanka, iyo taageerada farsamo ee loo baahan yahay, iyadoo dhanka kalena lagu falanqeeyay fursadaha iyo caqabadaha hortaagan hannaanka amniga ee dalka Soomaaliya. Habka wada-tashiga ayaa sidoo kale ka koobnaan doona kulan heer khubaro ah oo ay ka qeyb geli doonaan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, dalalka ciidammada iyo booliiska ku leh AUSSOM, iyo xubnaha Guddiga Saraakiisha Militariga ee Midowga Afrika. Natiijooyinka wada-tashiyada Addis Ababa ayaa loo gudbin doonaa shirarka Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada Difaaca iyo Booliiska, Wasiirrada Difaaca, iyo ugu dambeyn Shir Madaxeedka aan Caadiga ahayn ee dalalka ciidammada iyo booliiska ku leh AUSSOM, kaas oo lagu qaban doono magaalada Kampala 30-ka iyo 31-ka Luulyo, ka hor inta aan talooyinka loo gudbin hay’adaha go’aan qaadashada ee Midowga Afrika.

items.title: Open AI oo sheegtay in sirdoonkeeda AI uu xakamaha goostay isla markaana fuliyay weerar dhanka internetka ah oo “aan hore loo arag”
items.description: Qoraalka sawirka, Waxaa isa soo taraya su’aalaha la xiriira in nidaamyada ilaalinta ee hadda jira ay ku filnaan doonaan marka sirdoonka macmalka ah uu sii awood bato Article Information Author, Laura Cress Role, Weriye dhanka tiknoolajiyadda ah Published 24 Luulyo 2026 Waqtiga akhriska: 5 daqiiqo Shirkadda OpenAI ayaa sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah moodelladeeda ugu horumarsan ee sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) ay ka baxeen xakamaynta intii lagu jiray tijaabo amni, isla markaana ay u suurtagashay inay galaan nidaamyada shirkad billow ah. Shirkadda samaysay ChatGPT ayaa sheegtay in qeybtan — oo ah nidaam awood u leh inuu si madax-bannaan u fuliyo hawlo marka uu qofku siiyo amar — lagu tijaabinayay deegaan si adag loo xakameeyay. Hase yeeshee, markii uu ogaaday meelaha nugul ee nidaamka, wuxuu awooday inuu ka gudbo xayndaabyadii iyo xaddidaaddii loo dejiyay tijaabada. Intii ay tijaabadu socotay, AI-gu wuxuu bartilmaameedsaday shirkadda Hugging Face, oo ka mid ah baraha ugu waaweyn adduunka ee lagu wadaago laguna horumariyo moodellada sirdoonka macmalka ah, wuxuuna ku guuleystay inuu galo qaar ka mid ah nidaamyadeeda gudaha. OpenAI ayaa dhacdadan ku tilmaantay “mid aan hore loo arag”, waxayna sheegtay inay si wadajir ah ula shaqaynayso Hugging Face si loo baaro waxa dhacay. Dhanka kale, Clément Delangue, madaxa fulinta (CEO) ee Hugging Face, ayaa qoraal uu ku daabacay barta X ku yiri: “Wax\a runtii la yaabka leh waa in dhammaan arrimahan ay si toos ah oo iskood ah u dhaceen.” Clément Delangue ayaa sheegay: “Baaritaanku wali wuu socdaa, waxaana soo saari doonnaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan waxa u muuqda inuu noqon karo dhacdadii ugu horreysay ee noocan ah.” Afhayeen u hadlay dowladda Boqortooyada Midowday (UK) ayaa sheegay in Machadka Ammaanka Sirdoonka Macmalka ah (AI Security Institute) ee dalkaasi uu baarayo hab-dhaqankii nidaamka AI-ga ee dhacdadan ku lug lahaa. Wuxuu intaa ku daray in machadku uu sii wadi doono la shaqaynta OpenAI iyo shaybaarrada kale ee ka shaqeeya sirdoonka macmalka ah si loo xoojiyo tallaabooyinka amniga iyo ilaalinta. Waxa kale oo ay sheegeen in hay’adaha iyo shirkaduhu ay tahay inay sare u qaadaan awooddooda difaaca internetka, iyagoo qaadaya tallaabooyin ay ka mid yihiin helitaanka shahaadada Cyber Essentials, oo ah barnaamij ay taageerto dowladda UK, kaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu xoojiyo difaaca ka dhanka ah weerarrada internetka. Goobo lagu sameeyo tijaabooyin oo aan si ku filan loo sugin amnigooda Gina Neff, oo ah madaxa Xarunta Tiknoolajiyadda iyo Dimuqraadiyadda Minderoo ee Jaamacadda Cambridge, ayaa u sheegtay barnaamijka Today ee idaacadda BBC Radio 4 in tijaabooyinka amniga caadi ahaan lagu sameeyo “deegaanno ammaan ah”, ama waxa loo yaqaan “sandbox”. Kuwani waa deegaanno xaddidan oo loogu talagalay in lagu tijaabiyo laguna qiimeeyo awoodaha moodellada sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) iyada oo aan khatar loo gelin nidaamyada dhabta ah. Waxay intaas ku dartay: “Waxay u muuqataa in dhacdadan, OpenAI aysan awoodin inay abuurto sandbox amnigiisu ku filan yahay.” Halkii ay ku ekaan lahaayeen deegaanka tijaabada, AI agent-yadu waxay weerar dhanka internetka ah ku qaadeen isla sandbox-kii, waxayna heleen nuglaansho (vulnerability) u saamaxday inay ka baxaan xaddidaadihii lagu xiray. Markii ay ka baxeen deegaankaas, AI-gu wuxuu ogaaday in Hugging Face ay u badan tahay inay tahay meesha laga heli karo jawaabihii uu tijaabadu raadinayay, sidaas darteedna wuxuu isku dayay inuu galo qaar ka mid ah nidaamyada gudaha ee shirkadda. Dhanka kale, Neil Lawrence, oo ah borofisar ku takhasusay barashada mashiinnada (Machine Learning) kana tirsan Jaamacadda Cambridge, ayaa ku tilmaamay dhacdadan “guul farsamo oo cajiib ah”, balse wuxuu ka digay in awooddan aysan ka baxsanayn waxa hore loogu yaqaanay moodellada casriga ah ee AI-da. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in OpenAI ay isku diyaarinayso inay gasho suuqa saamiyada (stock market), isla markaana ay wajahdo tartan xooggan oo uga imanaya shirkadda Anthropic, taas oo si weyn loogu hadal hayo qalabkeeda AI ee awoodda badan ee Mythos. Lawrence wuxuu yiri: “OpenAI hadda waxay isku dayaysaa inay dib u soo ceshato kaalinteedii, waxayna doonaysaa inay muujiso awoodda nidaamyadeeda ee dhinaca amniga internetka.” Laakiin wuxuu raaciyay: “Dhacdadan waxay muujinaysaa in OpenAI weli aysan awoodin inay tiknoolajiyadeeda si buuxda oo ammaan ah u maamusho.” War-saxaafadeedkii ugu horreeyay ee Hugging Face, oo la daabacay 16-kii Luulyo, ayaa lagu sheegay in shirkaddu ay wali baarayso in xogta macaamiisheeda ama la-hawlgalayaasheeda ganacsi ay saameyn soo gaartay iyo in kale. Waxay intaas ku dartay inay la xiriiri doonto cid kasta oo ay dhibaatadu saamaysay haddii loo baahdo. Shirkaddu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay inay hadda xirtay dhammaan nuglaanshihii la ogaaday intii ay dhacdadani socotay, isla markaana dib u dhistay nidaamyadii ay saameysay. War-saxaafaddu waxay ku adkaysatay: “Qalabka weerarrada iskiis u fuliya ee ku salaysan sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) hadda ma aha oo kaliya mala-awaal ama fikrad aragtiyeed.” Waxay sii raacisay: “Difaaca aaladaha internetka wuxuu hadda u baahan yahay in xogta iyo moodellada AI loo arko bartilmaameedyo waaweyn oo weerarro lagu qaadi karo, isla markaana AI lafteeda loo adeegsado difaac si loola jaanqaado khataraha isa soo taraya.” Ugu dambayn, Hugging Face waxay sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto maalgelinta dhinacan, isla markaana ay la wadaagi doonto bulshada aqoonta iyo casharrada ay ka barato. Dhacdo digniin weyn ah Dhacdadan ayaa mar kale dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan awoodaha nidaamyada casriga ah ee sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) iyo in tallaabooyinka amniga ee hadda jira ay weli ku filan yihiin iyo in kale, iyadoo tiknoolajiyadani sii xoogaysanayso. Spencer Starkey, oo ka mid ah madaxda shirkadda amniga internetka ee SonicWall, ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in dhacdadani si cad u muujinayso in hay’aduhu ay tahay inay kor u qaadaan difaacooda dhanka internetka isla markaana adkeysiga amniga internetka ka dhigaan mid ka mid ah mudnaantooda ugu weyn. Shirkadda samaysay ChatGPT ayaa sheegtay in qeybtan — oo ah nidaam awood u leh inuu si madax-bannaan u fuliyo hawlo marka uu qofku siiyo amar — lagu tijaabinayay deegaan si adag loo xakameeyay. Hase yeeshee, markii uu ogaaday meelaha nugul ee nidaamka, wuxuu awooday inuu ka gudbo xayndaabyadii iyo xaddidaaddii loo dejiyay tijaabada. Intii ay tijaabadu socotay, AI-gu wuxuu bartilmaameedsaday shirkadda Hugging Face, oo ka mid ah baraha ugu waaweyn adduunka ee lagu wadaago laguna horumariyo moodellada sirdoonka macmalka ah, wuxuuna ku guuleystay inuu galo qaar ka mid ah nidaamyadeeda gudaha. OpenAI ayaa dhacdadan ku tilmaantay “mid aan hore loo arag”, waxayna sheegtay inay si wadajir ah ula shaqaynayso Hugging Face si loo baaro waxa dhacay. Dhanka kale, Clément Delangue, madaxa fulinta (CEO) ee Hugging Face, ayaa qoraal uu ku daabacay barta X ku yiri: “Wax\a runtii la yaabka leh waa in dhammaan arrimahan ay si toos ah oo iskood ah u dhaceen.” Clément Delangue ayaa sheegay: “Baaritaanku wali wuu socdaa, waxaana soo saari doonnaa macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan waxa u muuqda inuu noqon karo dhacdadii ugu horreysay ee noocan ah.” Afhayeen u hadlay dowladda Boqortooyada Midowday (UK) ayaa sheegay in Machadka Ammaanka Sirdoonka Macmalka ah (AI Security Institute) ee dalkaasi uu baarayo hab-dhaqankii nidaamka AI-ga ee dhacdadan ku lug lahaa. Wuxuu intaa ku daray in machadku uu sii wadi doono la shaqaynta OpenAI iyo shaybaarrada kale ee ka shaqeeya sirdoonka macmalka ah si loo xoojiyo tallaabooyinka amniga iyo ilaalinta. Waxa kale oo ay sheegeen in hay’adaha iyo shirkaduhu ay tahay inay sare u qaadaan awooddooda difaaca internetka, iyagoo qaadaya tallaabooyin ay ka mid yihiin helitaanka shahaadada Cyber Essentials, oo ah barnaamij ay taageerto dowladda UK, kaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu xoojiyo difaaca ka dhanka ah weerarrada internetka. Kuwani waa deegaanno xaddidan oo loogu talagalay in lagu tijaabiyo laguna qiimeeyo awoodaha moodellada sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) iyada oo aan khatar loo gelin nidaamyada dhabta ah. items.title: Ciidamada Mareykanka oo garaacay markab isku dayay inuu jebiyo go’doominta Dekedaha Iran
items.description: Militariga Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in ciidamadooda ay Jimcihii garaaceen markab shidaal oo ku sugnaa Gacanka Cumaan ee ku dhow marin biyoodka Hormuz. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay in ciidamadooda ay fariisiyeen markab shidaal, kaas oo isku dayayay inuu ka dhuunto xayiraadda uu Mareykanku saaray Dekedaha Iran. Markabkan ganacsi ayaa ah markabkii labaad ee ay Mareykanku hawlgab ka dhigaan bishan, tan iyo markii ay dhawaan dib u soo celiyeen go’doomintii Dekedaha Iran, taas oo daba socotay ku dhawaaqistii Madaxweyne Donald Trump ee inuu burburay heshiiskii xabad joojinta ee labada dal ee la gaaray bishii June. Afhayeenka Taliska Dhexe ee CENTCOM, Captain Tim Hawkins ayaa sheegay in shaqaalaha markabka ay iska dhega tireen digniino la siiyay, taas oo Ciidanka Badda Mareykanka ku khasabtay in ay waxyeeleeyaan qaybta matoorka ee markabka, si ay u joojiyaan. “Markabku hadda uma sii socdo dhinaca Iran.” Ayuu yiri Afhayeenka oo iftiiminaya in markabka lagu magacaabo M/T Lavine ay jug weyn u gaysteen. Afhayeenka ayaa tilmaamay in Ciidamada Mareykanka ay fulinayaan, si looga hortago in maraakiibtu ay galaan ama ka baxaan xeebaha dalkaasi. Madaxweyne Trump ayaa 13-kii July ku dhawaaqay in Mareykanku uu soo celinayo xayiraadihii Dekedaha Iran ee la qaaday bartamihii bishii June, iyadoona maalintii xigtay ee ciidamadiisa ku sugan aagga Gacanka Cumaan ay dhaqangeliyeen cunaqabataynta dhanka badda ee ka dhanka ah Iran. Militariga Mareykanka ayaa dhowr jeer sheegay in dhammaan maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ay adeegsan karaan Marinka Hormuz, aan ka ahayn kuwo lala xiriiriyo Iran. Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaan illaa iyo hadda muujin wax rabitaan ah oo lagu soo afjarayo colaadda, waxayna sii wadaan weeraradooda. Calaamadaha muuqda ayaa suurtagal ka dhigaya in dagaalku uu sii socdo.

items.title: Isbahaysiga Sacuudiga oo ka hadlay duqaymaha Yemen iyo digniin uu u jeediyay Xuutiyiinta
items.description: Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudiga hoggaamiyo ee ka hawlgala Yemen ayaa sheegay inay xalay garaaceen bartilmaameedyada militari ee Xuutiyiinta ku leeyihiin Magaalada Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran ee Galbeedka Yemen. General Turki Al Maliki, oo ah Afhayeenka Isbahaysiga Assifat Al-Hazm ayaa sheegay inay duqaymo ka gaysteen goobo militari oo Xuutiyiinta ay leeyihiin, kuwaas oo uu xusay in loo adeegsanayay in lagu khatar geliyo maraakiibta ganacsiga ee ku gooshaya Badda Cas. Telefishinka Al Masirah oo ku hadla afka Ururka Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in Sacuudigu uu beegsaday Dekedda Hodeidah, isla-markaana ay gantaalo ku dhaceen xarumo ay leedahay Shirkadda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka ee Magaalada Hodeidah. General Turki Al Maliki ayaa saaka beeniyay in la duqeeyay Dekedda Hodeidah, isla-markaana dhammaan Dekedaha Yemen oo ay ku jiraan Hodeidah, Ras Isa iyo Salif ay weli u furan yihiin dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta badda, ayna qaabilayaan maraakiibta ganacsiga. Jananka ayaa Xuutiyiinta Yemen ku eedeeyay in ay iyagu ka masuul yihiin xaaladda sii xumaaneyso ee gobolka, wuxuuna ku tilmaamay weerarada Xuutiyiinta ee maraakiibta maraya Badda Cas kuwo fuleynimo ah iyo masuuliyad darro. Xafiiska Siyaasadda Xuutiyiinta ayaan wax shaki ah gelin inay ka aargudan doonaan weerarka Sacuudiga, iyadoona xafiisku uu weerarkaasi ku tilmaamay fiditaan uu Sacuudigu ku sameeyay dagaalka Bariga Dhexe. General Al Maliki ayaa ku hanjabay in isbahaysigu uu sii wadi doono qaadashada dhammaan tallaabooyinka iyo hawlgalada lagama maarmaanka ah, isagoo intaas ku daray in haddii Xuutiyiintu ay sii wadaan falalkooda cadawtinimada ah, jawaab laga bixin doono, iyadoo aan wax dib-u-dhac ah la samaynayn. Duqaymaha isbahaysiga ee ka dhanka ah bartilmaameedyada Xuutiyiinta ayaa yimid, ka dib markii ururka reer Yemen uu 20-kii bishan ku dhawaaqay xayiraad iyo cunaqabatayn dhanka badda oo ay ku soo rogeen dalkaasi Sacuudiga. Xuutiyiinta ayaa Khamiistii sheegtay in Arbacadii ay dab saareen laba markab oo sida shidaal, lagana leeyahay Sacuudiga iyaga oo maraya Badda Cas, sababtu tahay inay ku xadgudbeen xayiraadda ay saareen dalkaasi. Waxay u badan tahay in Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay ka aargoosan doonaan duqaymaha Sacuudiga, sida looga bartayba in ay ka dhabeeyaan hanjabaadahooda, balse lama oga goorta iyo goobta ay bartilmaameedsan doonaan.

items.title: Senior Government Religious Official Condemns Mogadishu Demolitions
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – A senior Somali government religious official has publicly criticized the Federal Government over the demolition of homes and a mosque in Mogadishu, warning that continued forced evictions could turn loyal citizens into political opponents. Sheikh Ali Dheere, a prominent Islamic scholar and Director General at Somalia’s Ministry of Religious Affairs and Endowments, appeared on independent media to denounce the latest demolitions, saying his criticism extended far beyond his own personal losses. Somalia federal govertment religious leaders According to the Sheikh, government authorities demolished property that included his own land and a mosque in the Karaan district of Mogadishu, near Keysaney Hospital. He stressed that he was speaking on behalf of all affected residents rather than solely defending his personal interests. “I am not speaking only for my own property,” Sheikh Ali Dheere said. “I am speaking for all the people who have gathered here after being displaced.” Addressing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Banadir Regional Administration Chairman Mohamed Ahmed Amiir (Muungaab), the cleric urged both leaders to govern with justice and compassion rather than confrontation. He questioned why land that had previously been formally recognized by earlier administrations—including previous terms under both President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and former Banadir Governor Muungaab—was now being cleared, leaving residents displaced without a clear public explanation. The Sheikh warned that the government’s handling of forced evictions risks creating unnecessary political divisions at a time when Somalia is already facing a constitutional crisis, electoral uncertainty, and ongoing security challenges. “These people are not opponents of the government; they are its supporters,” he said. “But it is possible to turn supporters into opponents. Do not force people into becoming your critics. Do not make them curse or lose faith in their government.” He also criticized what he described as the government’s failure to adequately consult Somalia’s religious scholars before carrying out large-scale demolitions affecting civilian communities. The latest controversy comes amid continuing criticism from opposition figures, civil society groups, and displaced residents over urban redevelopment and land clearance operations in Mogadishu. Critics have repeatedly alleged that large-scale demolitions and disputed land acquisitions have displaced hundreds of thousands of residents. Some estimates cited by opposition figures put the number of internally displaced people (IDPs) at approximately 570,000 , although these figures remain politically contested and have not been independently verified. The public intervention by a senior serving government official is particularly notable, reflecting growing unease over the social and political consequences of the demolition campaign. His remarks highlight concerns that unresolved land disputes and forced evictions could further erode public confidence in government institutions at a time when Somalia is seeking political consensus on its constitutional and electoral future. items.title: Saraakiil ka tirsan Booliska Soomaaliyeed ah oo ka qalin-jebiyay Akadeemiyadda Maamulka ee Ruushka
items.description: Afar sarkaal oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed ayaa si rasmi ah uga qalinjebiyay Akadeemiyadda Maamulka ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha ee Dowladda Ruushka, halkaas oo ay ku qaateen shahaadada heerka labaad ee jaamacadda (Master Degree). Saraakiishan ayaa ku takhasusay cilmiga Maamulka Guud iyo Qorshaynta Istaraatiijiga ah, taas oo kor u qaadaysa aqoontooda iyo xirfaddooda hoggaamineed, isla markaana kaalin muhiim ah ka qaadan doonta horumarinta hay’adaha amniga ee Soomaaliya. Qalin-jebintan ayaa ah mid taariikhi ah, maadaama ay tahay markii ugu horreysay muddo ku dhow 40 sano oo saraakiil Soomaaliyeed ay ka qalinjebiyaan Akadeemiyaddan sare ee Ruushka. Arrintan ayaa muujinaysa dib u soo noolaanshaha iskaashiga dhinacyada waxbarashada iyo horumarinta tayada ciidamada ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka. Khubarada amniga ayaa aaminsan in aqoonta iyo waayo-aragnimada ay saraakiishani soo kororsadeen ay door muuqda ka qaadan doonto horumarinta maamulka, qorsheynta hawlgallada, iyo sare u qaadidda hufnaanta Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed. Qalin-jebinta afartan sarkaal ayaa sidoo kale dhiirrigelin u ah saraakiisha kale ee Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo muujinaysa muhiimadda ay leedahay maalgelinta waxbarashada iyo tababarrada sare si loo helo ciidan leh aqoon casri ah oo ka jawaabi kara caqabadaha amni ee dalka.

items.title: Weerar xagga cirka ah oo lagu qaaday Dekedda Hodeidah ee Galbeedka Yemen
items.description: Qaraxyo xoogan ayaa xalay ruxay Dekedda Hodeidah ee Galbeedka Yemen, xilli ay sii kordheyso xiisadda Mareykanka iyo Iran ee ka jirta Gobolka Bariga Dhexe. Wakaaladda Wararka Reuters oo soo xiganeysa goobjoogeyaal ayaa ku warantay in qaraxyo laga maqlay Dekedda Hodeidah oo Xuutiyiinta ay gacanta ku hayaan. Telefishinka afka Xuutiyiinta ku hadla ee Al Masirah ayaa sheegay in gantaalo ay ku dhaceen xarumo ay leedahay Shirkadda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka ee Magaalada Hodeidah. Telefishinka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in weerar kale lagu qaaday Jasiiradda Kamaran oo ku taal xeebta galbeed ee Yemen. Illaa iyo hadda waxaa la ogyahay in qof dumar ahi ay ku dhaawacantay weerarka Jasiirada Kamaran, sida uu telefishinku sheegay. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Xuutiyiinta ayaa Sacuudiga ku eedeysay in uu ka masuul yahay duqaynta dhanka cirka ee lagu qaaday Dekedda Hodeidah. Wasaaradda ayaa ka digtay in Sacuudigu uu qiimo badan ku bixin doono weerarka ay ku eedeysay inuu ka gaystay dekeddaasi, isla-markaana uu ururku ka jawaabi doono weerarkaasi. “Beegsiga Hodeidah, nidaamka Sacuudigu wuxuu sameeyay kor u kaca sii kordhaya, oo ah astaan qeexeysa marxaladda soo socota.” Ayay wasaaraddu ku sheegtay warsaxaafadeed. Tallaabadan ayaa ah middii ugu dambeysay ee uga sii dareysa xiisadda colaadeed ee Bariga Dhexe, iyadoo gobolka ay ku dagaalamayaan Mareykanka iyo Iran. Magaalada dekedda leh ee Hodeidah ayaa ah marin muhiim ah oo nolosha dadka ku xiran tahay, gaar ahaan qaybaha Yemen ee ay maamulaan Xuutiyiinta. Dekeddan waxay qaabishaa inta badan badeecadaha ganacsiga iyo gargaarka bani’aadantinimo ee loo soo raro Waqooyiga Yemen ee ay gacanta ku hayaan Xoogaga Xuutiyiintu. Xuutiyiinta Yemen waa urur aad u hubeysan oo ka jira dalkaasi, waxayna gacanta ku hayaan inta badan dhulka dalkaasi. Xuutiyiinta Yemen waxaa lagu sheegaa mid ka mid ah ururada ugu weyn ee siyaasadeed iyo militari ee ka jira Bariga Dhexe, wuxuuna ururka reer Yemen uu saamayn xoog leh ku leeyahay Badda Cas iyo marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb.

items.title: Iiraan oo duqeymo ku burburisay xarunta xogta ee…
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran (IRGC) ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay burburiyeen xarun xogeed (Data Center) oo ay sheegeen inay leedahay shirkadda weyn ee Amazon, taasoo ku taalla dalka Baxreyn. Sheegashadan ayaa imanaysa iyadoo xiisadda u dhexeysa Iiraan iyo Mareykanka ay sii xoogeysaneyso, isla markaana gobolka Bariga Dhexe uu wajahayo xaalad amni oo aad u cakiran. Bayaan ay soo saareen IRGC ayaa lagu sheegay in weerarkan uu qeyb ka ahaa mowjaddii 27-aad ee hawl-galka “Nasr 2”, kaasoo ay ku tilmaameen inuu ahaa howlgal lagu dhammaystirayay weerarro hore oo lagu qaaday xarunta xogta ee Amazon. Ciidanka ayaa sheegay inay bartilmaameedsadeen qaybihii ugu dambeeyay ee xarunta, isla markaana ay gabi ahaanba burburiyeen dhismaha harsanaa. Sida lagu sheegay bayaanka, howl-galka waxaa lagu fuliyay weerarro qorsheysan oo lagu beegsaday kaabayaal ay Iiraan ku eedeysay inay taageero farsamo iyo xog ururin u fidiyaan ciidamada Mareykanka iyo xulafadooda gobolka. IRGC ma aysan soo bandhigin caddeyn muuqaal ah oo xaqiijinaysa heerka burburka ay sheegtay. IRGC ayaa hore u sheegtay 21-kii Luulyo inay weerartay isla xaruntan xogta, iyadoo adeegsatay dhowr gantaal oo nooca cruise missile-ka ah. Waxay markaas ku tilmaantay xarunta Amazon inay tahay goob muhiim u ah kaabayaasha xogta ee Mareykanka ku leeyahay gobolka. Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka ayaa sheegay in weerarkan uu yahay jawaab toos ah oo ay ka bixinayaan weerarkii uu Mareykanku ku qaaday xarunta nukliyeerka ee Darkhuyn, kaasoo Iiraan ay ku eedeysay Washington inay ku xadgudubtay madax-bannaanideeda isla markaana ay waxyeello gaarsiisay xarumo muhiim ah oo dalkaasi leeyahay. Mas’uuliyiinta dowladda Baxreyn ayaa ilaa iyo hadda wax war rasmi ah ka soo saarin sheegashada Iiraan. Sidoo kale, shirkadda Amazon ayaan weli soo saarin wax bayaan ah oo arrintan ku saabsan. Khubarada amniga gobolka ayaa sheegay in tani noqon karto tallaabo cusub oo muujinaysa in dagaalka u dhexeeya Tehran iyo Washington uu ku sii fidayo bartilmaameedsiga kaabayaasha tiknoolajiyadda iyo xarumaha xogta ee muhiimka u ah adeegyada dijitaalka ah. Si kastaba, dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli ay sii kordhayaan weerarrada u dhexeeya Iiraan iyo Mareykanka, iyadoo laga digayo in weerarro lagu beegsado xarumaha xogta iyo kaabayaasha muhiimka ah ay halis gelin karaan adeegyada dijitaalka ah iyo dhaqaalaha gobolka, isla markaana ay sii hurin karaan xiisadda ka taagan Bariga Dhexe. items.title: Xog: Saldhigga Israa’iil ee Berbera oo dardar ku socda
items.description: Berbera (Caasimada Online) – Garoonka diyaaradaha Berbera ayaa waxaa haatan ka socda mashruuc ballaaran oo lagu dhisayo saldhig milatari oo la sheegay inay si wadajir ah u adeegsan doonaan Mareykanka, Israa’iil iyo Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta. Mashruucan ayaa la rumeysan yahay inuu qayb ka yahay isbeddel istaraatiiji ah oo ka socda gobolka Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan tartanka quwadaha caalamiga ah. Sida ay sheegayaan ilo xog-ogaal ah, qorshaha ugu weyn ayaa ah in garoonka Berbera oo hadda ay isticmaalaan diyaaradaha rayidka, si tartiib tartiib ah loogu beddelo xarun milatari oo istaraatiiji ah. Garoonkan ayaa la filayaa inuu noqdo saldhig muhiim u ah hawl-gallada dhinaca cirka iyo saadka ee quwadaha ku lugta leh mashruucan. Xogaha la helay waxay muujinayaan in dhismaha iyo ballaarinta xaruntaasi ay si joogto ah u socdeen muddo ku dhow 10 bilood. Inta lagu guda jiray muddadaas waxaa la sheegay in la dhisay xarumo cusub, goobo amni iyo kaabayaal kale oo la xiriira adeegyada milatariga, inkastoo aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin nooca dhismayaasha la hirgelinayo. Tan iyo markii uu mashruucan billowday, waxaa si weyn loo adkeeyay ammaanka garoonka. Ilo deegaanka ah ayaa sheegaya in si adag loo xaddiday gelitaanka garoonka, isla markaana gebi ahaanba la xiray waddadii ugu weyneyd ee loo mari jiray, iyadoo dhaq-dhaqaaq kasta oo ka ag dhow garoonka lagu soo rogay kormeer iyo xannibaado amni. Garoonka Berbera wuxuu ku yaallaa xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed, meel aan ka fogeyn marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab oo ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan caalamka. Goobtan ayaa muhiimad weyn u leh isku socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo kuwa milatariga, taasoo ka dhigeysa saldhig kasta oo halkaas laga dhiso mid leh qiime istaraatiiji ah. Arrintan ayaa imanaysa xilli Israa’iil ay bishii December 2025 qaaday tallaabo aan hore loo arag oo ay ku aqoonsatay madaxbannaanida ay ku doodo Somaliland. Aqoonsigaas ayaa xilligaas dhaliyay falcelin siyaasadeed iyo mid diblomaasiyadeed oo ka timid dalal iyo dhinacyo kala duwan, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya meel adag iska taagtay xad-gudubkaasi. Sida ay tilmaamayaan xogaha sirdoon ee la helayo, saldhiggan ayaa loogu talagalay inuu noqdo xarun laga fuliyo hawl-gallo oo u dhow Yemen, halkaas oo xoogagga Xuutiyiinta ay weerarro ka dhan ah Israa’iil ka bilaabeen dabayaaqadii bishii Maarso. Ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta uu hormuud ka yahay hirgelinta mashruucan, isagoo ka duulaya heshiis iskaashi oo dhinaca difaaca ah oo maamulka Somaliland uu la galay sanadkii 2017. Heshiiskaas ayaa hore u horseeday ballaarinta dekedda Berbera iyo mashaariic kale oo istaraatiiji ah oo gobolka laga fuliyay. Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ayaan ilaa hadda si rasmi ah uga hadlin wararka la xiriira saldhigga la sheegay inuu ka socdo Berbera, sidoo kale ma jirto wax faahfaahin ah oo ay Somaliland ama Imaaraadka Carabta ka bixiyeen xogahan. Mashruucan ayaa la rumeysan yahay inuu qayb ka yahay isbeddel istaraatiiji ah oo ka socda gobolka Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan tartanka quwadaha caalamiga ah. Sida ay sheegayaan ilo xog-ogaal ah, qorshaha ugu weyn ayaa ah in garoonka Berbera oo hadda ay isticmaalaan diyaaradaha rayidka, si tartiib tartiib ah loogu beddelo xarun milatari oo istaraatiiji ah. Garoonkan ayaa la filayaa inuu noqdo saldhig muhiim u ah hawl-gallada dhinaca cirka iyo saadka ee quwadaha ku lugta leh mashruucan. Xogaha la helay waxay muujinayaan in dhismaha iyo ballaarinta xaruntaasi ay si joogto ah u socdeen muddo ku dhow 10 bilood. Inta lagu guda jiray muddadaas waxaa la sheegay in la dhisay xarumo cusub, goobo amni iyo kaabayaal kale oo la xiriira adeegyada milatariga, inkastoo aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin nooca dhismayaasha la hirgelinayo. Tan iyo markii uu mashruucan billowday, waxaa si weyn loo adkeeyay ammaanka garoonka. Ilo deegaanka ah ayaa sheegaya in si adag loo xaddiday gelitaanka garoonka, isla markaana gebi ahaanba la xiray waddadii ugu weyneyd ee loo mari jiray, iyadoo dhaq-dhaqaaq kasta oo ka ag dhow garoonka lagu soo rogay kormeer iyo xannibaado amni. Garoonka Berbera wuxuu ku yaallaa xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed, meel aan ka fogeyn marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab oo ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan caalamka. Goobtan ayaa muhiimad weyn u leh isku socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo kuwa milatariga, taasoo ka dhigeysa saldhig kasta oo halkaas laga dhiso mid leh qiime istaraatiiji ah. Arrintan ayaa imanaysa xilli Israa’iil ay bishii December 2025 qaaday tallaabo aan hore loo arag oo ay ku aqoonsatay madaxbannaanida ay ku doodo Somaliland. Aqoonsigaas ayaa xilligaas dhaliyay falcelin siyaasadeed iyo mid diblomaasiyadeed oo ka timid dalal iyo dhinacyo kala duwan, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya meel adag iska taagtay xad-gudubkaasi. Sida ay tilmaamayaan xogaha sirdoon ee la helayo, saldhiggan ayaa loogu talagalay inuu noqdo xarun laga fuliyo hawl-gallo oo u dhow Yemen, halkaas oo xoogagga Xuutiyiinta ay weerarro ka dhan ah Israa’iil ka bilaabeen dabayaaqadii bishii Maarso. Ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta uu hormuud ka yahay hirgelinta mashruucan, isagoo ka duulaya heshiis iskaashi oo dhinaca difaaca ah oo maamulka Somaliland uu la galay sanadkii 2017. Heshiiskaas ayaa hore u horseeday ballaarinta dekedda Berbera iyo mashaariic kale oo istaraatiiji ah oo gobolka laga fuliyay. Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ayaan ilaa hadda si rasmi ah uga hadlin wararka la xiriira saldhigga la sheegay inuu ka socdo Berbera, sidoo kale ma jirto wax faahfaahin ah oo ay Somaliland ama Imaaraadka Carabta ka bixiyeen xogahan. items.title: Saciid DENI oo safar aan la shaacin ugu baxay dalka…
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa maanta galinkii dambe safar aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin ugu ambabaxay dalka dibaddiisa. Madaxweyne Deni ayaa ka dhoofay garoonka diyaaradaha General Maxamed Abshir ee magaalada Garoowe. Sida ay sheegayaan ilo xog-ogaal ah, wuxuu marka hore sii mari doonaa magaalada Addis Ababa ee caasimadda Itoobiya, ka hor inta uusan u gudbin magaalada Dubai ee dalka Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta. Madaxtooyada Puntland ayaa weli wax war ah kasoo saarin safarka Madaxweyne Deni, ujeeddada booqashadiisa ama muddada uu qaadan doono. Madaxweyne Deni ayaa hore dhowr jeer safarro aan la shaacin ujeeddadooda ugu tagay dalalka Itoobiya, Kenya iyo Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta. Safarradaas ayaa qaarkood qaatay maalmo ama toddobaadyo, iyadoo inta badan uusan la socon wafdi ballaaran oo ka tirsan xukuumaddiisa. Safarkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Labada dhinac ayaa muddooyinkii dambe isku hayay arrimo la xiriira amniga, maamulka ciidamada iyo khilaafyo siyaasadeed. Maalin ka hor, wasiir ku-xigeenka amniga Puntland, Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf Dujaana ayaa ku eedeeyay Dowladda Federaalka inay hub soo gelisay magaalada Gaalkacyo, isagoo sheegay in hubkaas loogu talagalay in lagu khalkhal-geliyo amniga Puntland. Dowladda Federaalka ayaan weli wax jawaab ah ka bixin eedeymahaas. Xiisadda u dhexeysa labada dhinac ayaa sii xoogeysatay kadib iska horimaadyo iyo muranno amni oo ka dhacay deegaanno ka tirsan Puntland, kuwaas oo ay ka mid tahay deegaanka Laag ee gobolka Bari. Arrimahaas ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo amniga iyo xiriirka u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka. Si kastaba, waxaa la filayaa in maalmaha soo socda ay soo baxaan faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan kulamada iyo ajandaha safarka Madaxweynaha Puntland ee Itoobiya iyo Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta.
