items.title: Somalia presses Meta for safeguards before WhatsApp username rollout
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia has raised concerns over WhatsApp’s planned introduction of usernames, warning that the privacy-focused feature could complicate efforts to investigate terrorism, financial fraud and cybercrime unless adequate safeguards are put in place. The Somali government says it has opened discussions with Meta, the parent company of WhatsApp, seeking assurances that the new system will preserve the ability of law enforcement agencies to identify criminal actors while protecting users’ privacy. The feature, expected to be introduced globally in the coming months, will allow WhatsApp users to communicate using unique usernames instead of sharing their phone numbers with other users. Although intended to strengthen privacy, Somali officials argue that the change presents distinct challenges for a country confronting persistent security threats and an economy heavily dependent on mobile financial services. Communications and Technology Minister Ahmed Osman Dirie said Somalia’s concerns stem from the country’s unique security environment, where authorities rely on registered mobile numbers to investigate crimes, trace suspects and disrupt networks involved in terrorism, extortion and online fraud. Officials fear that if usernames become the primary public identity on WhatsApp, malicious actors could find it easier to conceal their identities while targeting victims or coordinating criminal activity. Somalia has spent more than two decades battling Al-Shabab, the Al-Qaeda-linked militant group responsible for deadly attacks across the Horn of Africa. Authorities say the organization has exploited digital platforms for propaganda and intimidation, making online communications an increasingly important front in the country’s counterterrorism efforts. Government officials also point to Somalia’s widespread use of mobile money, which has become the backbone of everyday commerce. They warn that anonymous or frequently changing usernames could create new opportunities for impersonation scams and financial fraud unless strong verification measures accompany the rollout. According to the government, linking WhatsApp accounts to registered phone numbers has provided investigators with an important avenue for tracing criminal activity. Officials are now seeking detailed explanations from Meta on how digital accountability will be maintained after usernames become available. Somalia says it is not opposed to technological innovation but wants evidence that the new feature will not weaken existing security mechanisms. Authorities have requested information on how users will be verified, how fraudulent accounts will be detected and how law enforcement agencies will be able to identify individuals involved in serious criminal investigations while respecting legitimate privacy rights. Meta has emphasized that the feature has not yet been launched and that users will continue to register WhatsApp accounts using valid phone numbers. The company also says it is building safeguards designed to reduce impersonation, scams and abuse while giving users greater control over how they present themselves on the platform. The debate reflects a broader global discussion over balancing digital privacy with public safety. India, WhatsApp’s largest market, has also expressed concerns that usernames could increase the risk of online fraud and impersonation if implemented without sufficient protections. Indian authorities have urged Meta to continue consultations before introducing the feature. Technology analysts say the update represents another step in WhatsApp’s evolution toward a broader digital identity model similar to other social platforms, where usernames rather than phone numbers become the public-facing identity. Supporters argue that hiding phone numbers will better protect users from harassment, unwanted contact and the misuse of personal information, particularly in large public groups and community forums. Critics, however, contend that stronger privacy tools should not come at the expense of accountability, especially in countries facing organized crime, terrorism or widespread digital fraud. Cybersecurity experts say the challenge lies in striking a balance between two legitimate objectives: protecting individual privacy while ensuring authorities retain lawful means to investigate serious crimes. They argue that the success of WhatsApp’s new system will ultimately depend on the strength of its identity verification, abuse detection and cooperation with regulators where legally required. For Somalia, the discussions with Meta are expected to continue as the company prepares one of WhatsApp’s most significant privacy updates in recent years. Government officials say they remain open to the feature but want clear assurances that enhanced privacy will not inadvertently provide greater cover for criminals operating online. The outcome could influence how the feature is received not only in Somalia but also in other countries weighing the benefits of stronger user privacy against the practical demands of law enforcement and national security. Technology analysts say the update represents another step in WhatsApp’s evolution toward a broader digital identity model similar to other social platforms, where usernames rather than phone numbers become the public-facing identity. Supporters argue that hiding phone numbers will better protect users from harassment, unwanted contact and the misuse of personal information, particularly in large public groups and community forums. Critics, however, contend that stronger privacy tools should not come at the expense of accountability, especially in countries facing organized crime, terrorism or widespread digital fraud. Cybersecurity experts say the challenge lies in striking a balance between two legitimate objectives: protecting individual privacy while ensuring authorities retain lawful means to investigate serious crimes. They argue that the success of WhatsApp’s new system will ultimately depend on the strength of its identity verification, abuse detection and cooperation with regulators where legally required. For Somalia, the discussions with Meta are expected to continue as the company prepares one of WhatsApp’s most significant privacy updates in recent years. Government officials say they remain open to the feature but want clear assurances that enhanced privacy will not inadvertently provide greater cover for criminals operating online. The outcome could influence how the feature is received not only in Somalia but also in other countries weighing the benefits of stronger user privacy against the practical demands of law enforcement and national security. items.title: Somalia Cabinet Approves New Members of Supreme Judicial Council
items.description: Somalia's Council of Ministers has approved four new members to serve on the Supreme Judicial Council, while also endorsing a series of legislative and administrative decisions, including a new higher education leadership appointment, an aviation cooperation agreement with Oman, and the African Youth Charter.

items.title: Golaha Wasiirada oo cod aqlabiyad leh ku ansixiyay dhismaha Golaha Sare ee Adeegga Garsoorka
items.description: Golaha Wasiirada Somaliya ayaa Khamiistan ansixiyay dhismaha Golaha Sare ee Adeegga Garsoorka, iyagoo ka duulaya soo jeedinta Wasaaradda Caddaaladda & Arrimaha Garsoorka, sida lagu sheegay warsaxaafadeed ka soo baxay Xafiiska Raysal Wasaaraha Xukuumadda, Xamse Cabdi Barre. Warsaxaafadeedka ayaa lagu sheegay in Golaha Wasiirada ay cod aqlabiyad leh ku ansixiyeen magacaabista Xubnaha Golaha Sare ee Adeegga Garsoorka. “Golaha Wasiiradu oo uu shir guddoominayay Raysal Wasaare Kuxigeenka Mudane Saalax Axmed Jaamac ayaa meelmariyay xubnaha soo socda oo kala ah laba (2) Qareen Sare iyo laba (2) Xeeldheere Sharci oo uu xilkooduna noqonayo shan (5) sano, ka dib marka ay dhameystiranto habraaca ansixintooda.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Xubnaha la magacaabay ayaa kala ah:- 1. Maxamed-deeq Macalllin Aadan 2. Maryan Sheekh Cismaan 3. Cabdirisaaq Maxamed Ismaaciil 4. Cabdiqaadir Cali Macallin. Xubnahan ayaa ah kuwa keliya ee magacaabis ku imaanaya, halka xubnaha kale ee Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka ay ku imaanayaan xilkooda (Hadba Masuulka xilkaas haya uu ka mid noqonayo golahan), waxayna xilalkan kala yihiin:- 1. Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare 2. Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Dastuurka 3. Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka 4. Gudoomiyeyaasha Maxkamadaha Sare ee Dowlad Goboleedyada iyo Maamulka Caasimadda Jamhuuriyadda 5. Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha. Dhanka kale Golaha Wasiirada ayaa xilka ka qaaday Gudoomiyihii Guddiga Tacliinta Sare ee Qaranka, Dr. Cabdinuur Sheekh Maxamuud, kaas oo booskiisa loo magacaabay Maxamuud Axmed Jimcaale. “Ugu dambayn Golaha Wasiirada XFS ayaa meel-mariyay Hindise Sharciyeedka Dhaqanka iyo Farxashanka iyo heshiis u dhaxeeya Dowladaha Somaliya iyo Cumaan, kaasi oo diirrada saaraya iskaashiga Gaadiidka Cirka. Axdiga Dhallinyarada Afrika kaasi oo awoodda saaraya in dhallinyarada laga qaybgeliyo go’aanada siyaasadda iyo doorka dowladaha ee horumarinta dhallinyarada Afrika.” Ayaa lagu soo geba-gabeeyay warsaxaafadeedka.

items.title: Iiraan oo weerartay xarumo ay leedahay CIA-da iyo dal la ogaaday inuu ka caawiyey
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adaha sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa baaraya suurta-galnimada in Ruushka uu Iran ka caawiyay xogta bartilmaameedyada ama farsamada diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee loo adeegsaday weerarro lagu qaaday xarumo ay CIA-du ku leedahay dalalka Khaliijka, sida ay sheegeen afar qof oo xog-ogaal u ah qiimeynta sirdoonka Mareykanka. Ilaha, oo codsaday inaan magacyadooda la shaacin maadaama ay ka hadlayeen arrimo xasaasi ah oo amniga qaranka la xiriira, ayaa sheegay in saraakiisha sirdoonka Mareykanka aysan weli gaarin gunaanad rasmi ah oo ku saabsan kaalinta Ruushka. Hase yeeshee, saxnaanta iyo waxtarka weerarrada, iyo sidoo kale taageerada farsamo ee Moscow ay muddooyinkii dambe siisay Tehran, ayaa sare u qaaday shakiga ah in Iran ay heshay caawimaad dibadeed. Warbaahinta caalamiga ah ayaa horay u sheegtay, saraakiil Mareykan ahna way xaqiijiyeen, in Ruushka uu Iran siiyay xog iyo taageero kale oo ay u adeegsatay weerarrada ka dhanka ah bartilmaameedyada Mareykanka ee gobolka Khaliijka. Si kastaba, baaritaanka gaarka ah ee ku saabsan in Moscow ay gacan ka geysatay weerarrada lagu qaaday xarumaha CIA-da ayaan horey loo shaacin. Xarumaha CIA-da ee la beegsaday Ugu yaraan laba xarumood oo CIA-da ay isticmaasho ayaa la weeraray bishii Maarso, sida ay horay u sheegeen Reuters iyo warbaahin kale. Mid ka mid ah xarumahaas wuxuu ahaa saldhigga CIA-da ee Sacuudi Carabiya, kaas oo ku dhex yaalla safaaradda Mareykanka ee magaalada Riyadh. Xarun kale ayaa ku taallay bariga dalka Ciraaq. Qaar ka mid ah ilaha ayaa sheegay in xarumo kale oo CIA-da ah sidoo kale la weeraray, balse waxay ka gaabsadeen inay bixiyaan faahfaahin ku saabsan goobahooda ama tiradooda. Mid ka mid ah ilaha ayaa sheegay in tirada xarumaha la beegsaday ay ahayd “in ka badan hal, balse ka yar 12”, halka il kale uu sheegay in dhowr xarumood la weeraray. Xarumaha CIA-da ee dibadda waxaa ka mid ah xafiisyada ugu muhiimsan ee hay’addu ku leedahay dalalka kala duwan, kuwaas oo inta badan ku dhex yaalla safaaradaha Mareykanka, loona yaqaan “stations”. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale leedahay xafiisyo qarsoodi ah, guryo ammaan ah, xarumo saadka iyo goobo lagu fuliyo howlgallada dabagalka iyo sirdoonka. Goobaha xarumahaas waxaa loo ilaaliyaa si aad u adag. Xog sirdoon oo farta ku fiiqday Ruushka Qoraal gudaha ah oo ay diyaarisay hay’ad sirdoon oo reer Galbeed ah ayaa lagu sheegay in Ruushka ay u badan tahay inuu kaalin ka qaatay bartilmaameedsiga xarumaha CIA-da ee gobolka. Sarkaal ka tirsan gobolka oo arkay qoraalkaas ayaa sheegay in qiimeynta sirdoonku ay farta ku fiiqeyso kaalinta Moscow, balse wuxuu codsaday inaan la shaacin hay’adda sida gaarka ah u diyaarisay warbixinta. Laba sarkaal oo reer Galbeed ah oo ku sugan Khaliijka, kuwaas oo la socodsiiyay warbixinnada sirdoonka, ayaa sheegay in weerarkii Sacuudi Carabiya loo adeegsaday laba diyaaradood oo nooca Shahed ah oo Iran leedahay, kuwaas oo la rumeysan yahay in Ruushku farsamo ahaan horumariyay. Sida ay saraakiishu sheegeen, diyaaraddii koowaad ayaa dalool ka sameysay qeyb nugul oo ka mid ah gidaarka bannaanka ee safaaradda, halka diyaaraddii labaad ay daloolkaas ka dhex gudubtay ka hor inta aysan qarxin. Weerarka laguma soo warramin inuu sababay wax dhimasho ama dhaawac ah. Haddii la xaqiijiyo in Ruushka uu si gaar ah uga qeyb qaatay bartilmaameedsiga xarumaha CIA-da, waxay taasi muujin kartaa in Moscow ay diyaar u tahay inay sare u qaaddo dadaalladeeda lagu carqaladeynayo howlgallada Mareykanka ee gobolka. Shakiga laga qabo in Ruushka uu Iran siinayo xogta bartilmaameedyada ayaa sii xoogaystay kaddib weerarro lagu qaaday saldhig Mareykanku ku leeyahay Jordan, halkaas oo gantaallo ballistic ah lagu beegsaday xeryo ay ciidamada ku sugnaayeen, laguna dilay laba askari. Aqalka Cad ayaa codsi faallo ah u gudbiyay CIA-da, balse hay’addu way ka gaabsatay inay ka hadasho arrinta. Sidoo kale, wakiillada Iran ee Qaramada Midoobay, Wasaaradda Difaaca Ruushka iyo dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya kama jawaabin codsiyo faallo ah. Teknoolajiyada Ruushka oo gaartay Iran Saraakiisha reer Galbeedka ayaa sheegay in Ruushka uu Iran ka caawiyay sidii ay u horumarin lahayd awoodda diyaaradaha Shahed ee lagu gaari karo laguna beegsan karo bartilmaameedyada. Il kale ayaa sheegay in Moscow ay Tehran siisay nidaam hagidda dayax-gacmeedka ku shaqeeya oo lagu magacaabo Kometa-M, kaas oo loo adeegsaday in lagu kordhiyo saxnaanta diyaaradaha Shahed-136. Khubarada ayaa sheegaya in nidaamka Kometa-M uu ka saxnaan badan yahay nidaamyada ay Iran soo saarto, sidoo kalena ay adag tahay in la carqaladeeyo ama la marin-habaabiyo. Wargeyska Wall Street Journal ayaa bishii Maarso markii ugu horreysay sheegay in Ruushku uu nidaamka Kometa-M siiyay Iran. Kremlin-ka ayaa markaas beeniyay warka, isaga oo ku tilmaamay “war been abuur ah”. Baarayaasha sirdoonka Mareykanka ayaa hadda isku dayaya inay ogaadaan in Iran ay xog bartilmaameed oo Ruushku bixiyay u adeegsatay weerarkii safaaradda Mareykanka ee Riyadh. Si kastaba, weli waxaa jira shaki ku saabsan in qeybta CIA-da si ula kac ah loo beegsaday. Qaar ka mid ah ilaha ayaa sheegay inay suurtagal tahay in Iran ay weerarka ula jeedday guud ahaan safaaradda Mareykanka, balse diyaaradaha ay si kadis ah ugu dhaceen qeybta ay CIA-du isticmaasho. Hase yeeshee, falanqeeyayaasha qaar ayaa rumeysan in dalal yar oo aan Ruushka ahayn ay awood iyo danba u leeyihiin inay helaan xog sidaas u xasaasi ah, kaddibna u adeegsadaan weerarro ka dhan ah Mareykanka. Daniel Hoffman, oo horay madax uga soo noqday xarun CIA-da ah isla markaana ka tirsanaa saraakiisha howlgallada qarsoon, ayaa sheegay in aysan la yaab noqon doonin haddii Moscow ay Tehran ka caawisay beegsiga xarumaha CIA-da. “Waxay wadaagaan dan ah inay yareeyaan ama gebi ahaanba meesha ka saaraan saameynta Mareykanka ee deegaannada ay iyagu u arkaan inay yihiin goobahooda saameynta,” ayuu yiri Hoffman. The post Iiraan oo weerartay xarumo ay leedahay CIA-da iyo dal la ogaaday inuu ka caawiyey appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada oo Ansixiyey Xubnaha Magacaabista Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka
items.description: Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta ansixiyey xubnaha magacaabista ku imaanaya ee Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka, kadib shir uu guddoomiyay Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka dalka, Mudane Saalax Axmed Jaamac. Go’aanka Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa yimid kaddib soo jeedin ay gudbisay Wasaaradda Cadaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka, iyadoo magacaabista lagu saleeyey Qodobka 145-aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee 2026. Xubnaha la ansixiyey ayaa isugu jira laba qareen sare iyo laba xeeldheere sharci, kuwaas oo muddo shan sano ah ka mid noqon doona Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka marka la dhammaystiro habraacyada sharci ee ansixintooda. Xubnaha la magacaabay ayaa kala ah: 1) Maxamed-deeq Macallin Aadan 2) Maryan Sheekh Cismaan 3) Cabdirisaaq Maxamed Ismaaciil 4) Cabdiqaadir Cali Macallin Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka waxaa sidoo kale ka mid noqonaya masuuliyiin xilalkooda ku matalaya, sida Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Dastuurka, Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka, Guddoomiyeyaasha Maxkamadaha Sare ee Dowlad-goboleedyada iyo Maamulka Caasimadda, iyo Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxbannaan ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha. Dhanka kale, Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa xilkii ka qaaday Guddoomiyihii Golaha Tacliinta Sare, waxaana xilkaas loo magacaabay Mudane Maxamuud Axmed Jimcaale. Sidoo kale, Golaha ayaa meel mariyey Hindise-sharciyeedka Dhaqanka iyo Farshaxanka, heshiis iskaashi oo dhinaca gaadiidka cirka ah oo dhex maraya Soomaaliya iyo Cummaan, iyo Axdiga Dhallinyarada Afrika oo lagu xoojinayo ka qaybgalka dhallinyarada ee go’aannada siyaasadda iyo horumarinta qaaradda Afrika.

items.title: Iran oo ka hadashay tirada dadkii ku dhintay weeraradii ugu dambeeyey ee Mareykanka
items.description: Tehran ( Raxanreeb Online) Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee Iiraan: 53 qof ayaa ku dhintay weerarradii ugu dambeeyay ee Maraykanka. Sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee Iiraan, illaa 53 qof ayaa ku dhintay meertadii ugu dambaysay ee weerarrada Maraykanku ku qaaday Iiraan. Sida ku xusan xogta ay soo saartay wasaaraddu, dhimashadan ayaa dhacday muddadii u dhaxeysay 27-kii Juun illaa subaxnimadii 22-ka July. Agaasimaha Xidhiidhka Dadweynaha iyo Xogta ee Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Iiraan, Hossein Kermanpour, oo xogtan ku baahiyay barta X, ayaa sheegay in 592 qof ay sidoo kale ku dhaawacmeen weerarrada Maraykanka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ma aanu caddayn inta ay le’eg tahay tirada dadka dhintay ee millatariga ah iyo inta ay le’eg tahay tirada rayidka ah. Sida ay sheegayaan warbixinnada warbaahinta Maraykanka, ugu yaraan 18 askari oo milatariga Maraykanka ah ayaa ku dhintay tan iyo markii uu bilowday Dagaalka Maraykanka iyo Israa’iil ee ka dhanka ah Iiraan bishii March ee sannadkii hore. The post Iran oo ka hadashay tirada dadkii ku dhintay weeraradii ugu dambeeyey ee Mareykanka appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada oo ansixiyay magacaabista 4 xubnood oo Garsoorka Sare
items.description: Muqdisho – Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, oo uu shir guddoomiyanayay Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Mudane Saalax Jaamac , ayaa si aqlabiyad ah u ansixiyay xubnaha magacaabista ku imaanaya ee Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka, sida uu dhigayo Qodobka 145aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya 2026. Ansixintani waxay timid kadib soo jeedin ay soo bandhigtay Wasaaradda Cadaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka. Ansixintani ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan tahay tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo madaxbannaanida garsoorka iyo dhisidda hay’adaha caddaaladda ee dalka. Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka wuxuu ka kooban yahay xubno ka kala socda maxkamadaha sare, dastuurka, xeer-ilaalinta, iyo xuquuqda aadanaha, kuwaas oo wadajir u xaqiijinaya caddaaladda dalka . Xubnaha magacaabista ku imaanaya waxaa ka mid ah: Maxamed-deeq Macallin Aadan Maryan Sheekh Cismaan Cabdirisaaq Maxamed Ismaaciil Cabdiqaadir Cali Macallin Kuwani waxay noqon doonaan kuwa keliya ee magacaabis ku imaanaya Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka, halka xubnaha kale ay ku imaanayaan xilkooda, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Dastuurka, Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka, Guddoomiyeyaasha Maxkamadaha Sare ee Dowlad-goboleedyada, iyo Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha . Sidoo kale, Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa xilkii ka qaaday Guddoomiyihii Golaha Tacliinta Sare, waxayna xilkaas u magacaabeen Mudane Maxamuud Axmed Jimcaale. Tallaabadan ayaa qayb ka ah dib-u-habeynta hay’adaha waxbarashada sare ee dalka. Intaa waxaa dheer, Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa meel-mariyay Hindise-sharciyeedka Dhaqanka iyo Farxashanka, iyo Heshiis u dhexeeya Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Cummaan kaasi oo diiradda saaraya iskaashiga Gaadiidka Cirka. Sidoo kale, waxaa la meel-mariyay Axdiga Dhallinyarada Afrika, kaasi oo awoodda saaraya in dhallinyarada laga qaybgaliyo go’aannada siyaasadda iyo doorka dowladaha ee horumarinta dhallinyarada Afrika. The post Golaha Wasiirrada oo ansixiyay magacaabista 4 xubnood oo Garsoorka Sare first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Rubik’s Cube: The Tiny Puzzle That Shaped Millions of Minds
items.description: There are countless games that have gained worldwide fame, but few can simultaneously serve as entertainment, competition, and mental training. One of them is the Rubik’s Cube – the six-sided puzzle that has captivated children, teenagers, and adults for over forty years. The first time someone holds a Rubik’s Cube, it can appear to be an unsolvable enigma, with colors scattered in disarray and each side seeming far from being aligned. However, those who learn the correct methods discover that this cube follows a structured system with clear rules that can be mastered. This puzzle matters because it is not merely a toy but a powerful tool for enhancing cognitive skills such as memory, focus, problem-solving, and logical thinking. Various studies have shown that repeatedly solving the Rubik’s Cube can help individuals develop these abilities, making it a valuable educational resource. Many people assume that solving the Rubik’s Cube is simply about matching colors. But the reality is far more profound. Each piece of the cube has its own unique position. Corner pieces carry three colors, while edge pieces have two. These pieces move in predictable patterns, meaning that solving is not based on luck but on understanding how each component interacts and shifts. When it comes to speedcubing competitions, the most popular method used is known as CFOP. This system, employed by most professional cubers worldwide, consists of four stages: Cross, F2L (First Two Layers) , OLL (Orientation of Last Layer), and PLL (Permutation of Last Layer). To achieve high speeds, competitors memorize algorithms – specific sequences of moves that rearrange particular pieces without disrupting what has already been solved. Although a speed cube may look identical to a standard Rubik’s Cube from the outside, its internal design is significantly different. Its components are engineered to create low friction, resulting in smooth and rapid rotations. Advanced models even incorporate Maglev (Magnetic Levitation) technology, where magnets replace traditional springs to reduce internal friction and create a quieter, smoother experience. As a result, many schools and educational institutions have adopted the Rubik’s Cube as a tool to strengthen students’ mental skills. It is not just a game; it is a puzzle that combines science, mathematics, patience, and skill. Anyone who learns the proper method discovers that what initially seemed impossible can become a challenge solved through strategy and consistent practice. That is why the Rubik’s Cube remains one of the world’s most beloved puzzles, continuing to inspire millions of people to learn a new skill that enhances their cognitive abilities. items.title: Rubik’s Cube oo malaayiin maskax ku xoojiyay xirfadaha hal-abuurka ah
items.description: Waxaa jira ciyaaro badan oo dunida caan ka noqday, balse kuwo yar ayaa isku mar noqon kara madadaalo, tartan, iyo tababar maskaxeed. Mid ka mid ah waa Rubik’s Cube – halxiraalaha lixda weji leh ee muddo ka badan afartan sano soo jiitay carruur, dhalinyaro iyo dadka waaweyn. Marka ugu horreysa ee qof gacanta ku dhigo Rubik’s Cube , waxa uu u muuqan karaa halxiraale aan xal lahayn, balse dadka barta habka saxda ah waxay ogaadaan in cube-kan uu leeyahay nidaam iyo xeerar cad oo lagu xallin karo. Halxiraalahan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah ma aha oo keliya ciyaar lagu madadaasho, balse waa qalab lagu horumariyo xirfadaha maskaxeed sida xusuusta, feejignaanta, xallinta dhibaatooyinka iyo fikirka nidaamsan. Cilmi-baarisyo kala duwan ayaa muujiyey in ku celcelinta xallinta Rubik’s Cube ay ka caawin karto qofka horumarinta xirfadahan. Dad badan waxay u maleeyaan in xallinta Rubik’s Cube ay tahay in la isku keeno midab kasta, laakiin xaqiiqdu waa mid ka qoto dheer. Qayb kasta oo cube-ka ka mid ahi waxay leedahay meel u gaar ah. Geesaha (corner pieces) waxay wataan saddex midab, halka qaybaha dhexe ( edge pieces ) ay leeyihiin laba midab. Qaybahani mar walba way isla socdaan, taasoo ka dhigaysa in xallintu aysan ku salaysnayn nasiib, balse ay ku salaysan tahay fahamka sida qaybuhu u dhaqaaqaan. Marka laga hadlayo tartamada xawaaraha, habka ugu caansan ee lagu xalliyo cube-ka waxaa loo yaqaan CFOP. Waa nidaam ay isticmaalaan inta badan ciyaartoyda heerka caalami, kuna kala baxa afar marxaladood: Cross, F2L, OLL, iyo PLL. Si loo gaaro xawaare sare, ciyaartoydu waxay bartaan algorithms, oo ah taxane dhaqdhaqaaqyo gaar ah oo lagu beddelo qaybo cayiman iyadoo aan la burburin wixii hore loo xalliyey. Inkasta oo uu dibadda uga ekaan karo Rubik’s Cube-ka caadiga ah, speed cube-ku gudaha ayuu kaga duwan yahay. Qaybihiisa waxaa loo naqshadeeyey si ay u yeeshaan isqabqabsi yar, taasoo ka dhigaysa in leexashadu noqoto mid siman oo degdeg ah. Noocyo casri ah ayaa sidoo kale isticmaala Maglev (Magnetic Levitation), halkaas oo magnets-ku beddelaan ilihii dhaqanka ahaa. Sababtaas awgeed, dugsiyo iyo xarumo waxbarasho oo badan ayaa u adeegsada Rubik’s Cube qalab lagu kobciyo xirfadaha maskaxeed ee ardayda. Rubik’s Cube ma aha oo keliya ciyaar lagu madadaasho. Waa halxiraale isku dara saynis, xisaab, dulqaad iyo xirfad. Qof kasta oo barta habka saxda ah wuxuu ogaanayaa in waxa markii hore u muuqday wax aan suurtagal ahayn uu noqon karo caqabad lagu xallin karo qorshe iyo tababar joogto ah. Taasi waa sababta Rubik’s Cube uu maanta uga mid yahay halxiraalayaasha ugu caansan dunida, isla markaana uu weli u dhiirrigeliyo malaayiin qof inay bartaan xirfad cusub oo kobcisa maskaxdooda. The post Rubik’s Cube oo malaayiin maskax ku xoojiyay xirfadaha hal-abuurka ah first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

Shirka oo uu guddoomiyanayay Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku Xigeenka Dalka, Mudane Saalax Jaamac ayaa lagu meel-mariyay xubnaha soo socda oo kala ah laba (2) Qareen Sare iyo laba (2) Xeeldheere Sharci oo uu xilkooduna noqonayo shan (5) sano, ka dib marka ay dhammeystiranto habraaca ansixintooda: 1. Maxamed-deeq Macalllin Aadan 2. Maryan Sheekh Cismaan 3. Cabdirisaaq Maxamed Ismaaciil 4. Cabdiqaadir Cali Macallin Sidoo kale bayaanka lagu sheegay in xubnahan ay yihiin kuwa keliya ee magacaabis ku imaanaya, halka xubnaha kale ee Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka ay ku imaanayaan xilkooda (Hadba Mas’uulka xilkaas haya uu ka mid noqonayo golahan), waxayna xilalkan kala yihiin: 1. Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare 2. Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Dastuurka 3. Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka 4. Guddoomiyeyaasha Maxkamadaha Kore ee Dowlad goboleedyada iyo Maamulka Caasimadda Jamhuuriyadda 5. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha. Dhanka kale, Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa maanta xilkii ka qaaday guddoomiyihii Golaha Tacliinta Sare, waxayna xilkaas u magacaabeen Mudane Maxamuud Axmed Jimcaale. Ugu dambayn Golaha Wasiirrada XFS,ayaa meel-mariyey Hindise-sharciyeedka Dhaqanka iyo Farxashanka iyo Heshiis u dhexeeya Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Cummaan kaasi oo diirrada saaraya iskaashiga Gaadiidka Cirka. Axdiga Dhallinyarada Afrika kaasi oo awoodda saaraya in dhallinyarada laga qaybgaliyo go’aannada siyaasadda iyo doorka dowladaha ee horumarinta dhallinyarada Afrika. items.title: Gaari Sinotruk oo toddobo qof ku dilay Jigjiga
items.description: Ugu yaraan toddobo qof ayaa ku dhintay shil gaari oo xalay ka dhacay Magaalada Jigjiga ee Xarunta Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida. Laamaha amniga ayaa sheegay in gaariga oo xawaare ku socday uu ka baxay waddada, ka dibna uu jiiray dad fadhiyay goobo ganacsi oo ku yaala magaaladaasi. Sarkaal u hadlay Booliska Jigjiga ayaa sheegay in gaarigan oo noociisu ahaa Sinotruk oo kuwa dhagaxa qaada ah uu halkaasi ku dilay toddobo qof, oo isugu jira shan rag iyo laba dumar ah, halka ilmo yarna uu ku dhaawacmay shilkaasi. Maamulka ayaa magacaabay guddi uu hoggaaminayo Kuxigeenka Duqa Jigjiga oo ka shaqeeya masiibada shilka gaariga, si ay u fududeeyaan qaban-qaabada iyo diyaarinta ee aaska dadkaasi, iyadoo la dhameystirayo caddeymaha sharciga ee loo baahan yahay, oo ay ku jirto xaqiijinta iyo in la helo ehelada dhibaneyaasha. Shilkan ayaa noqonaya midkii labaad ee ugu khasaaraha badnaa ee dhowr cisho gudahood ka dhaca Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida. Axaddii ayay ahayd, markii shil ay ku dhinteen in ka badan 10 qof uu ka dhacay waddada Jigjiga iyo Qabri-bayax, ka dib markii gaari qaad siday uu ku dhacay Mooto Bajaaj.

items.title: Seven Somalis intercepted in Zambia
items.description: Zambian authorities have intercepted seven Somali nationals who were concealed beneath bags of rice in a vehicle bound for Zimbabwe, in the latest crackdown on irregular migration along a key southern African smuggling corridor. The Zambia Revenue Authority (ZRA) stopped a Toyota Probox during a routine enforcement exercise near Kapiri Mposhi town in Central Province, which was heading towards the Chirundu border post linking Zambia and Zimbabwe. A search revealed the seven men, all Somali nationals, hidden in the rear cargo compartment under bags of rice and other goods. The Zambian driver was also detained. ZRA Public Relations Manager Oliver Nzala confirmed the interception, stating that the driver and the seven Somali nationals were handed over to the Department of Immigration for profiling and processing under the Immigration and Deportation Act. He said the authority remains committed to protecting Zambia’s borders and safeguarding national revenue. “During a recent enforcement exercise on the Kapiri Mposhi road leading to Chirundu One-Stop Border Post, our officers intercepted a Toyota Probox which had seven Somali nationals concealed under bags of rice in the boot area,” Nzala said. “The driver and the illegal immigrants were handed over to the Department of Immigration for further action.” Authorities believe the migrants were being smuggled through Zimbabwe en route to South Africa, a common destination for Horn of Africa migrants seeking economic opportunities. Zambia has become a major transit route for irregular migrants from the Horn of Africa traveling south, with smugglers frequently using commercial vehicles to evade border controls. In a separate enforcement operation, the ZRA impounded a vehicle that had remained in Zambia illegally after its temporary import permit expired. The vehicle entered through the Kasumbalesa Border Post in December 2025 but was never re-exported, breaching customs regulations. The revenue authority used both incidents to remind motorists, importers and transport operators to comply with immigration and customs laws, warning that violations could result in enforcement action including seizure of vehicles and goods. The interception comes amid heightened enforcement along Zambia’s border routes as authorities seek to curb smuggling and irregular migration. Similar operations in recent months have netted dozens of Somali and Ethiopian nationals attempting to transit through the country. The seven men are currently in immigration custody awaiting further processing. The post Seven Somalis intercepted in Zambia first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somalia, World Bank reaffirm economic reform partnership
items.description: Somalia and the World Bank have reaffirmed their commitment to deepening cooperation on economic reforms, institutional development and regional integration during high-level talks in Mogadishu on July 22, as the country pushes ahead with efforts to accelerate growth and strengthen public institutions. The discussions, which brought together State Minister for Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation Ali Mohamed Omar, Permanent Secretary Hamza Adan Haadow and World Bank Country Manager Hideki Matsunaga, come at a pivotal moment for Somalia’s economic trajectory. The meeting reflects continued engagement between Mogadishu and international financial institutions as the country seeks to transition from humanitarian dependence towards long-term development, while addressing persistent challenges such as climate vulnerability, unemployment and limited infrastructure. According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the talks focused on aligning the World Bank’s support with the country’s development priorities, including strengthening government institutions, promoting regional integration and advancing economic diplomacy to attract investment and expand trade opportunities. The ministry thanked the World Bank for its longstanding partnership, highlighting its support for governance reforms, infrastructure development and efforts to improve public services. World Bank Country Manager Hideki Matsunaga acknowledged Somalia’s progress while underscoring the need for sustained reform. “Somalia has made important progress in strengthening macroeconomic management and institutions under difficult conditions,” Matsunaga said. “However, overlapping shocks are slowing growth and putting pressure on jobs and household livelihoods.” The meeting comes as Somalia seeks to consolidate gains made since reaching the completion point of the Heavily Indebted Poor Countries (HIPC) Initiative in December 2023, which resulted in the cancellation of more than $4.5 billion in external debt. Since then, the government has focused on maintaining economic reforms, strengthening domestic revenue collection and creating conditions to attract greater foreign investment. The World Bank has played a central role in supporting Somalia’s recovery through investments in transport, education, health, social protection, urban development and digital transformation. Earlier this year, the bank reiterated its support for the implementation of Somalia’s National Transformation Plan (2025–2029), which aims to drive inclusive economic growth, improve governance and reduce poverty. However, the economic outlook remains fragile. Somalia’s growth moderated to an estimated 3 percent in 2025, down from about 4 percent in 2023–24, as declining foreign aid, drought conditions, and rising living costs weighed on demand. Real GDP growth is projected at 2.8 percent in 2026 and 3.1 percent in 2027, constrained by continued aid reductions, climate variability, global price shocks, and limited productive capacity. Both sides said they remained committed to working together to support Somalia’s long-term development, economic resilience and sustainable growth. Sustained cooperation with development partners is seen as key to preserving reform momentum and unlocking investment needed to support Somalia’s economic recovery and state-building efforts. The post Somalia, World Bank reaffirm economic reform partnership first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Golaha wasiirada K/Galbeed oo shirkii ugu horreeyay yeeshay – Maxaa kasoo baxay?
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimda Online) – Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa maanta guddoomiyey shirkii ugu horreeyey ee Golaha Wasiirrada cusub ee maamulkaas, kaas oo maanta lagu qabtay xarunta Madaxtooyada ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Kulanka oo ay si buuxda uga soo qayb-galeen xubnaha golaha ayaa diiradda lagu saaray dardargelinta adeegyada mudnaanta u leh bulshada iyo sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa in hay’adaha dowladdu si hufan oo wadajir ah ugu adeegaan shacabka. Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada ku adkeeyey inay mudnaanta koowaad siiyaan adeegyada aasaasiga ah ee bulshada, xoojinta isla xisaabtanka, Qabsoomida Dib uheshiisin dhab ah, hufnaanta maamulka, iyo dardargelinta hirgelinta barnaamijyada horumarineed ee Koonfur Galbeed. Sidoo kale, intii uu shirku socday ayaa golaha wasiirradu soo bandhigeen qorshayaasha bilowga ah ee wasaaradahooda, iyagoo ballanqaaday inay si dhow isaga kaashan doonaan fulinta siyaasadaha iyo himilooyinka Dowladda si loo gaaro adeeg hufan oo waxtar u leh shacabka Koonfur Galbeed. Waxaa kale oo shirka lagu falanqeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay isku-dubaridka howlaha wasaaradaha, kor u qaadista tayada adeegyada dowladda, iyo dardargelinta mashaariicda horumarineed ee saameynta togan ku leh nolosha bulshada, Hanti dhowrka guud Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sidoo kale shirka looga dhagaystay warbixin guud oo ku aadan hantida Dowladda. Ugu dambeyn Madaxweyne Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada ugu baaqay inay si mideysan, daacadnimo iyo masuuliyad leh ugu adeegaan shacabka, si loo xaqiijiyo horumar waara, amni, iyo dowladnimo tayo leh oo ka hanaqaadda guud ahaan deegaannada Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed. items.title: Electoral commission sets July 25 deadline for Galmudug elections
items.description: The National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (NIEBC) has called on political parties to complete their registration for upcoming local council elections in the central state of Galmudug by July 25, with candidate nominations closing on July 30, as part of Somalia’s broader push to expand direct democratic representation. The appeal, issued from Dhusamareeb on Tuesday, comes as Galmudug prepares for what observers view as a critical test of Somalia’s electoral transition. The polls represent the latest phase in the federal government’s effort to replace the country’s decades-old indirect, clan-based selection system with direct universal suffrage—a reform that has sparked political tensions across federal member states. The commission urged political organisations to complete all legal requirements within the prescribed timelines, warning that timely compliance would help ensure the smooth organisation of the polls. It also appealed to parties to intensify public awareness campaigns aimed at encouraging voter participation and improving understanding of the electoral process. NIEBC Chairman Abdikarim Ahmed Hassan has made clear that the commission will not entertain requests to delay the vote. “We will not change the election schedule that was previously set for July 25,” Hassan told representatives of political parties during a meeting in Dhusamareb, according to officials present. The chairman confirmed that the commission had already completed technical preparations and that security arrangements were being coordinated with officials to ensure the safety of polling stations. Political parties had formally submitted a request seeking an extension of the campaign period, citing logistical challenges and the difficulty of reaching voters across Galmudug’s vast and remote districts. They argued that the compressed timeline could disadvantage candidates lacking resources for rapid, widespread outreach and undermine the quality of public engagement ahead of the election. The electoral body said election stakeholders should avoid actions that could disrupt preparations and instead cooperate to facilitate an orderly voting process. The Galmudug polls are being closely watched as another benchmark of Somalia’s electoral transition. Similar local elections have already been held in parts of Puntland, Somaliland and South West State, though implementation has varied across federal member states due to political disagreements and differing constitutional interpretations. The federal government maintains that expanding local elections is an essential step toward universal suffrage, while some opposition politicians and several federal member states have questioned the pace and framework of the reforms, arguing that broader political consensus is needed before nationwide implementation. Observers say the credibility of the Galmudug vote will depend not only on technical preparations but also on the level of political participation and public confidence in the process. With more than 215,000 voters already registered in the state, the stakes remain high for a nation navigating one of its most ambitious democratic overhauls in half a century. Political parties had formally submitted a request seeking an extension of the campaign period, citing logistical challenges and the difficulty of reaching voters across Galmudug’s vast and remote districts. They argued that the compressed timeline could disadvantage candidates lacking resources for rapid, widespread outreach and undermine the quality of public engagement ahead of the election. The electoral body said election stakeholders should avoid actions that could disrupt preparations and instead cooperate to facilitate an orderly voting process. The Galmudug polls are being closely watched as another benchmark of Somalia’s electoral transition. Similar local elections have already been held in parts of Puntland, Somaliland and South West State, though implementation has varied across federal member states due to political disagreements and differing constitutional interpretations. The federal government maintains that expanding local elections is an essential step toward universal suffrage, while some opposition politicians and several federal member states have questioned the pace and framework of the reforms, arguing that broader political consensus is needed before nationwide implementation. Observers say the credibility of the Galmudug vote will depend not only on technical preparations but also on the level of political participation and public confidence in the process. With more than 215,000 voters already registered in the state, the stakes remain high for a nation navigating one of its most ambitious democratic overhauls in half a century. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo Weeraray Maraakiib Shidaal oo Sacuudigu Leeyahay iyo Xiisadda Badda Cas oo Cirka Isku Shareertay
items.description: Kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen ayaa sheegtay inay gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku weerareen laba markab oo shidaal oo Sacuudi Carabiya leedahay, taasoo sii xoojisay xiisadda ka taagan Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandab. Sida ay Xuutiyiintu sheegeen, weerarka ayaa qayb ka ah go’doomin badeed ay ku dhawaaqeen inay ku hayaan Sacuudi Carabiya, ayadoo dowladda Sacuudigu ay xaqiijisay in markabka Encelia uu dab qabsaday kadib weerarka, halka wararka ku saabsan markabka labaad ee Layla aan weli si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin. Dhacdadan ayaa timid xilli maraakiib badani ay bilaabeen inay beddelaan waddooyinkooda si ay uga fogaadaan Bab al-Mandab, taasoo sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo in sahayda shidaalka caalamka ay wajahdo carqalad cusub. Dhanka kale, Mareykanka ayaa sheegay inuu galay habeenkii 12-aad oo xiriir ah oo uu duqeymo ka fulinayo bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla gudaha Iiraan, halka Tehran ay ku dhawaaqday inay weerarro ku qaaday saldhigyo iyo xarumo militari oo Mareykanku ku leeyahay dalal ay ka mid yihiin Jordan iyo Kuwait. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa uga digay Iiraan in haddii maraakiibta lagu sii weeraro marin-biyoodka Hormuz, Mareykanku uu beegsan doono kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah ee dalkaas. Iiraan ayaa iyaduna ku hanjabtay inay bartilmaameedsan doonto xarumaha shidaalka, gaaska iyo tamarta ee gobolka haddii hanjabaaddaas la fuliyo. Khubarada amniga ayaa ka digaya in haddii Bab al-Mandab iyo Marinka Hormuz labaduba ay xirmaan ama khatar galaan, ay taasi si weyn u saameyn karto ganacsiga caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan dhoofinta shidaalka, isla markaana ay sare u qaadi karto qiimaha tamarta dunida. Dagaalka sii xoogeysanaya ayaa sidoo kale sababay khasaare naf iyo maalba leh, iyadoo labada dhinac ay weli sii wadaan weerarro is-daba joog ah, halka beesha caalamku ay muujinayso walaac sii kordhaya oo ku saabsan khatarta dagaalku ku yeelan karo gobolka iyo dhaqaalaha adduunka.

items.title: Shil kale oo fool xun oo ka dhacay magaalada Jigjiga
items.description: Inta la hubo 7 qof ayaa geeriyootey tiro kalena dhaawacyo ayaa soo gaarey, ka dib markii gaari xamuul ah uu xalay dulmaray dad fadhiyey goob ganacsi oo ku taal magaalada Jigjiga ee Dowlad deegaanka Soomaalida. Hay’adaha ammaanku weli ma shaacin sababta ka dambeysey in gaarigu uu ka baxo waddada ka dibna uu dadka dardaro. Shilalka gawaarida ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyay ku soo badanayay deegaanka Soomaalida, wuxuuna kan imaanayaa labo maalmood ka dib markii tobaneeyo qof ay ku dhinteen shil baabuur oo is xigay oo ka dhacday degmada Qabri bayax. “Gaariga oo ahaa nooca xamuulka ee carada qaada ayaa isagoo xawaare ku socda ka baxay wadada, kadibna wuxuu dardaray dadkii fadhiyay mehradaha ganacsi ee halkaas ku yaalay”, ayuu yiri Cabdixakiin cabdullaahi Gama’diid oo ah wariye madaxbannaan oo booqday Isbitaalka lageeyey maydadka iyo dhaawaca shilkaas ka dhashay, kaas oo BBC-da u warramay. “Arrinta kale ee naxdinta badan ayaa ah in xubnaha bini’aaamka oo qeybihiisa kala duwan oo aad arkeysid, gacan go’na iyo xubno kale ayaa marba meel laga soo qaadayay, ilaa afar qof ayaa la gartay ilaa hadda”, ayuu intaas raaciyay. Laamaha amniga ayaa wada baaritaan la xiriira shilkan. Guddi gaar ah ayaa sidoo kale loo saaray arrintan.

items.title: Ururka Midowga Afrika oo ka fakaraya in la soo afjaro howl-galka AUSSOM ee Somalia
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dalalka xubnaha ka ah Midowga Afrika ayaa markii ugu horreysay si furan su’aalo uga keenaya muddada ay qaaraddu sii wadi karto howlgalka nabad-ilaalinta Soomaaliya, xilli ay sii yaraanayaan dhaqaalihii ay bixin jireen saaxiibada caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan Mareykanka. Cameroon iyo Gabon ayaa Soomaaliya ugu baaqay inay isu diyaariso maalinta ay ciidamada shisheeye dalka ka baxayaan, iyagoo ku adkeystay in howlgal kasta oo nabad-ilaalineed uu leeyahay waqti uu ku dhammaado. “Mar un ayuu howlgal kasta oo nabad-ilaalineed soo gaarayaa gebogebo,” ayay labada dal ka sheegeen kulan degdeg ah oo ay yeesheen la-taliyeyaasha milatari ee Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka Midowga Afrika. Hadalladan ayaa muujinaya walaac sii xoogeysanaya oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka Howlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, oo loo soo gaabiyo AUSSOM, kaas oo wajahaya dhaqaale-yari iyo hubanti la’aan ku saabsan cidda maalgelin doonta sannadaha soo socda. Muddo ku dhow labaatan sano, howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya waxaa kharashaadkiisa ugu badan bixiyay saaxiibada dibadda. Midowga Yurub ayaa ku bixiyay ku dhowaad 2.8 bilyan oo Yuuro, halka Mareykanku uu ku dhowaad 1.6 bilyan oo dollar oo taageero toos ah siiyay dalalka ciidamada keenay. Waxaa intaas dheer ku dhowaad laba bilyan oo dollar oo lagu bixiyay xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee taageerada Soomaaliya, UNSOS, iyadoo Britain iyo dalal kale ay sidoo kale bixiyeen taageero dhaqaale iyo mid farsamo. Hase yeeshee, ilahaas dhaqaale ayaa hadda wajahaya cadaadis weyn, taas oo dalalka xubnaha ka ah Midowga Afrika ku qasabtay inay su’aal geliyaan awoodda lagu sii wadi karo howlgalka qaabkiisa hadda. Mareykanka oo jaraya taageerada Bilowgii bishan, Mareykanka ayaa Midowga Afrika ku wargeliyay inuusan sii maalgelin doonin UNSOS, oo ah hay’adda bixisa adeegyada saadka ee howlgalka AUSSOM. Go’aankaas wuxuu kala saaraya howlgalka milatari iyo hay’addii u qaabilsaneyd shidaalka, raashinka, gaadiidka cirka, daad-gureynta dhaawacyada iyo adeegyada kale ee muhiimka u ah ciidamada. “Go’aanka ugu dambeeyay ee Mareykanka wuxuu soo afjari doonaa taageerada saadka ee UNSOS wixii ka dambeeya 31-ka December 2026, taas oo AUSSOM gelin doonta xaalad saadka ah oo aad u adag,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka laga soo saaray kulanka degdegga ah. Midowga Afrika ayaa ka digay in xaaladdan ay dhalin karto “caqabadaha howlgal oo aad u daran” haddii ciidamada la sii joogo Soomaaliya iyadoo aan la helin hannaan cusub oo beddela UNSOS. AUSSOM, oo ka kooban 12,591 askari, ayaa la bilaabay 1-dii Janaayo 2025, waxaana loogu talagalay inay shaqeyso muddo shan sano ah oo ku eg dhammaadka 2029. Si kastaba, waajibaadkeeda waa in Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay sannad kasta dib u ansixiyaa. Kulankii degdegga ahaa ee 3-dii July, Cameroon iyo Gabon waxay sheegeen in Soomaaliya ay dedejiso dhismaha hay’ado amni oo isku filan, isla markaana aan culayska howlgal aan dhammaad lahayn lagu sii hayn karin dalalka Afrikaanka ah. Aragtidaas waxay muujineysaa isbeddel weyn oo ka dhex socda Midowga Afrika. Dooddu hadda kama taagna oo keliya in howlgalka la sii wado iyo in kale, balse waxay u wareegeysaa habka iyo waqtiga lagu soo afjari karo. Morocco ayaa sheegtay inay mowqifkeeda rasmiga ah soo gudbin doonto marka ay la tashato madaxdeeda, halka Itoobiya ay ballanqaadday inay sii wadi doonto taageerada Soomaaliya. Uganda, oo Soomaaliya ku leh ciidamada ugu badan, ayaa iyaduna dhowaan billowday inay su’aalo ka keento halka uu ku dambeynayo howlgalka. Kampala waxay ciidamo ku leedahay Soomaaliya tan iyo markii la bilaabay howlgalka Midowga Afrika sannadkii 2007. Saraakiil Ugandheys ah ayaa si cad u sheegay: “Soomaaliya weligeen kuma sii jiri karno.” Saddex qorshe oo la miisaamayo La-taliyeyaasha milatari ee Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka Midowga Afrika ayaa qiimeeyay saddex qorshe oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka howlgalka. Qorshaha koowaad waa in ciidamada Midowga Afrika si tartiib-tartiib ah looga saaro Soomaaliya. Midka labaad waa in la sii hayo ciidamada hadda jooga, balse saaxiibo laba-geesood ah ay la wareegaan taageerada saadka ee UNSOS. Qorshaha saddexaadna waa in AUSSOM lagu beddelo howlgal goboleed ka yar, kaas oo lagu maalgeliyo heshiisyo laba-geesood ah ama hannaan isku dhafan. Diblomaasiyiin la socda wada-hadallada ayaa sheegay in labada qorshe ee dambe aysan taageero badan helin, maadaama ay weli dalalka ciidamada keena ku qasbayaan inay sii wadaan howlgal qaali ah xilli dhaqaalaha dibadda uu sii yaraanayo. Taas beddelkeeda, bixitaan qorsheysan oo markii hore loo arkayay ikhtiyaarka ugu xun ayaa hadda dalal badan ula muuqda xalka ugu macquulsan. Sannad-maaliyadeedkii 2025/2026, AUSSOM waxay u baahneyd ku dhowaad 190 milyan oo dollar oo keliya si loogu bixiyo gunnooyinka ciidamada. Hase yeeshee, Midowga Afrika wuxuu helay ballanqaadyo la xaqiijiyay oo gaaraya 120 milyan oo dollar, taas oo keentay farqi dhaqaale oo weyn. Waaxda Howlgallada Taageerada Nabadda ee Midowga Afrika ayaa sheegtay in dhaqaalaha keliya ee la hubo uu yahay 502 milyan oo dollar oo loogu talagalay taageerada saadka ee UNSOS. Si kastaba, 25 boqolkiiba dhaqaalahaas oo ahaa qeybta Mareykanka ayaa horay looga saaray bishii October 2025, si wax looga qabto daldaloolada dhaqaale ee howlgalka. Atul Khare, oo ah ku-xigeenka xoghayaha guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan taageerada howlgallada, ayaa kulan dhowaan Muqdisho ka dhacay ku sheegay in miisaaniyad dhan 481 milyan oo dollar oo Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u ansixiyay UNSOS aan weli si buuxda loo helin. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay inuu hor istaagi doono isku day kasta oo Golaha Ammaanka looga doonayo in lagu maalgeliyo UNSOS wixii ka dambeeya 31-ka December 2026. Iyadoo aysan jirin cid kale oo diyaar u ah inay buuxiso farqigaas, mustaqbalka howlgalka ayaa galay xaalad hubanti la’aan ah. “Dhaqaale caalami ah oo degdeg ah haddii aan la helin, AUSSOM wuxuu wajahayaa burbur howlgal marka la gaaro 2027,” ayuu yiri Mohamed Daud Ismail oo ka tirsan hay’adda ACLED. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in xaaladdu ay saameyn ballaaran ku yeelan karto Soomaaliya, maadaama ciidamada dowladda ay weli awood ahaan kala fidsan yihiin, isla markaana aysan heysan nidaamkii saadka ee looga baahnaa inay howlgallo waaweyn ka fuliyaan guud ahaan dalka. Halis amni oo soo fool leh UNSOS waxay ciidamada AUSSOM siisaa shidaal, raashin, adeegyo caafimaad, daad-gureynta dhaawacyada, diyaarado iyo gaadiid cirka ah. Waxay sidoo kale magdhow ka bixisaa qalabka ay ciidamada leeyihiin ee ku burbura ama ku luma howlgallada. Haddii Midowga Afrika uu go’aansado inuu ciidamadiisa Soomaaliya sii joogo iyadoo aan UNSOS la helin, wuxuu u baahan doonaa boqolaal milyan oo dollar oo dheeraad ah, xitaa haddii tirada ciidamada la yareeyo. Dalal badan oo Afrika ah ayaa aaminsan in Midowga Afrika uusan awoodin kharashaadkaas haddii aysan soo bixin deeq-bixiyeyaal cusub. Xaaladdan waxay wax weyn ka beddeshay doodihii sannadihii hore, oo diiradda lagu saari jiray sidii loo kordhin lahaa taageerada caalamiga ah ee kala-guurka amniga Soomaaliya. Dooddu hadda waxay ku wajahan tahay sidii howlgalka si mas’uuliyad leh loo soo afjari lahaa, iyadoo laga fogaanayo inuu dhasho firaaq amni oo ay ka faa’iideystaan Al-Shabaab iyo kooxaha kale ee hubeysan. Waaxda Howlgallada Taageerada Nabadda ee Midowga Afrika ayaa ka digtay in ka bixitaanka UNSOS uu wiiqi karo difaaca magaalooyinka muhiimka ah iyo waddooyinka waaweyn ee sahayda, isla markaana uu yareyn karo awoodda lagu daad-gureeyo ciidamada dhaawacma. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Al-Shabaab ay fursad u heli karto inay ka faa’iideysato daldaloolada howlgalka. Farriinta kasoo baxaysa dalalka Midowga Afrika ayaa ah in Soomaaliya aysan mar dambe si aan xad lahayn ugu tiirsanaan karin ciidamada Afrikaanka ah iyo deeqaha dibadda, balse looga baahan yahay inay dedejiso dhismaha ciidan qaran iyo hay’ado amni oo awood u leh inay si buuxda ula wareegaan ammaanka dalka. Kulankii degdegga ahaa ee 3-dii July, Cameroon iyo Gabon waxay sheegeen in Soomaaliya ay dedejiso dhismaha hay’ado amni oo isku filan, isla markaana aan culayska howlgal aan dhammaad lahayn lagu sii hayn karin dalalka Afrikaanka ah. Aragtidaas waxay muujineysaa isbeddel weyn oo ka dhex socda Midowga Afrika. Dooddu hadda kama taagna oo keliya in howlgalka la sii wado iyo in kale, balse waxay u wareegeysaa habka iyo waqtiga lagu soo afjari karo. Morocco ayaa sheegtay inay mowqifkeeda rasmiga ah soo gudbin doonto marka ay la tashato madaxdeeda, halka Itoobiya ay ballanqaadday inay sii wadi doonto taageerada Soomaaliya. Uganda, oo Soomaaliya ku leh ciidamada ugu badan, ayaa iyaduna dhowaan billowday inay su’aalo ka keento halka uu ku dambeynayo howlgalka. Kampala waxay ciidamo ku leedahay Soomaaliya tan iyo markii la bilaabay howlgalka Midowga Afrika sannadkii 2007. Saraakiil Ugandheys ah ayaa si cad u sheegay: “Soomaaliya weligeen kuma sii jiri karno.” Saddex qorshe oo la miisaamayo La-taliyeyaasha milatari ee Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka Midowga Afrika ayaa qiimeeyay saddex qorshe oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka howlgalka. Qorshaha koowaad waa in ciidamada Midowga Afrika si tartiib-tartiib ah looga saaro Soomaaliya. Midka labaad waa in la sii hayo ciidamada hadda jooga, balse saaxiibo laba-geesood ah ay la wareegaan taageerada saadka ee UNSOS. Qorshaha saddexaadna waa in AUSSOM lagu beddelo howlgal goboleed ka yar, kaas oo lagu maalgeliyo heshiisyo laba-geesood ah ama hannaan isku dhafan. Diblomaasiyiin la socda wada-hadallada ayaa sheegay in labada qorshe ee dambe aysan taageero badan helin, maadaama ay weli dalalka ciidamada keena ku qasbayaan inay sii wadaan howlgal qaali ah xilli dhaqaalaha dibadda uu sii yaraanayo. Taas beddelkeeda, bixitaan qorsheysan oo markii hore loo arkayay ikhtiyaarka ugu xun ayaa hadda dalal badan ula muuqda xalka ugu macquulsan. Sannad-maaliyadeedkii 2025/2026, AUSSOM waxay u baahneyd ku dhowaad 190 milyan oo dollar oo keliya si loogu bixiyo gunnooyinka ciidamada. Hase yeeshee, Midowga Afrika wuxuu helay ballanqaadyo la xaqiijiyay oo gaaraya 120 milyan oo dollar, taas oo keentay farqi dhaqaale oo weyn. Waaxda Howlgallada Taageerada Nabadda ee Midowga Afrika ayaa sheegtay in dhaqaalaha keliya ee la hubo uu yahay 502 milyan oo dollar oo loogu talagalay taageerada saadka ee UNSOS. Si kastaba, 25 boqolkiiba dhaqaalahaas oo ahaa qeybta Mareykanka ayaa horay looga saaray bishii October 2025, si wax looga qabto daldaloolada dhaqaale ee howlgalka. Atul Khare, oo ah ku-xigeenka xoghayaha guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan taageerada howlgallada, ayaa kulan dhowaan Muqdisho ka dhacay ku sheegay in miisaaniyad dhan 481 milyan oo dollar oo Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u ansixiyay UNSOS aan weli si buuxda loo helin. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay inuu hor istaagi doono isku day kasta oo Golaha Ammaanka looga doonayo in lagu maalgeliyo UNSOS wixii ka dambeeya 31-ka December 2026. Iyadoo aysan jirin cid kale oo diyaar u ah inay buuxiso farqigaas, mustaqbalka howlgalka ayaa galay xaalad hubanti la’aan ah. “Dhaqaale caalami ah oo degdeg ah haddii aan la helin, AUSSOM wuxuu wajahayaa burbur howlgal marka la gaaro 2027,” ayuu yiri Mohamed Daud Ismail oo ka tirsan hay’adda ACLED. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in xaaladdu ay saameyn ballaaran ku yeelan karto Soomaaliya, maadaama ciidamada dowladda ay weli awood ahaan kala fidsan yihiin, isla markaana aysan heysan nidaamkii saadka ee looga baahnaa inay howlgallo waaweyn ka fuliyaan guud ahaan dalka. Halis amni oo soo fool leh UNSOS waxay ciidamada AUSSOM siisaa shidaal, raashin, adeegyo caafimaad, daad-gureynta dhaawacyada, diyaarado iyo gaadiid cirka ah. Waxay sidoo kale magdhow ka bixisaa qalabka ay ciidamada leeyihiin ee ku burbura ama ku luma howlgallada. Haddii Midowga Afrika uu go’aansado inuu ciidamadiisa Soomaaliya sii joogo iyadoo aan UNSOS la helin, wuxuu u baahan doonaa boqolaal milyan oo dollar oo dheeraad ah, xitaa haddii tirada ciidamada la yareeyo. Dalal badan oo Afrika ah ayaa aaminsan in Midowga Afrika uusan awoodin kharashaadkaas haddii aysan soo bixin deeq-bixiyeyaal cusub. Xaaladdan waxay wax weyn ka beddeshay doodihii sannadihii hore, oo diiradda lagu saari jiray sidii loo kordhin lahaa taageerada caalamiga ah ee kala-guurka amniga Soomaaliya. Dooddu hadda waxay ku wajahan tahay sidii howlgalka si mas’uuliyad leh loo soo afjari lahaa, iyadoo laga fogaanayo inuu dhasho firaaq amni oo ay ka faa’iideystaan Al-Shabaab iyo kooxaha kale ee hubeysan. Waaxda Howlgallada Taageerada Nabadda ee Midowga Afrika ayaa ka digtay in ka bixitaanka UNSOS uu wiiqi karo difaaca magaalooyinka muhiimka ah iyo waddooyinka waaweyn ee sahayda, isla markaana uu yareyn karo awoodda lagu daad-gureeyo ciidamada dhaawacma. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Al-Shabaab ay fursad u heli karto inay ka faa’iideysato daldaloolada howlgalka. Farriinta kasoo baxaysa dalalka Midowga Afrika ayaa ah in Soomaaliya aysan mar dambe si aan xad lahayn ugu tiirsanaan karin ciidamada Afrikaanka ah iyo deeqaha dibadda, balse looga baahan yahay inay dedejiso dhismaha ciidan qaran iyo hay’ado amni oo awood u leh inay si buuxda ula wareegaan ammaanka dalka. items.title: Xogta duqeyn culus oo ka dhacday Hiiraan + Khasaaraha
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta faah-faahin dheeraad ah ka bixisay duqeyn ay si wadajir ah u fuliyeen Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo Saaxiibada Caalamiga ah, taas oo ka dhacday qaybo kamid ah gobolka Hiiraan ee bartamaha Soomaaliya. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay in duqeynta oo dhacday 21-kii bishan laga fuliyay aagga deegaanka Suullaay, oo qiyaastii 17 kiiloomitir dhanka koonfureed kaga beegan deegaanka Teedaan ee Gobolka Hiiraan. Wasaaradda ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in weerarkan dhanka cirka ah lagu bartilmaameedsaday maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Khawaarijta oo ku dhuumaaleysanayay halkaasi, iyada oo lagu dilay 18 xubnood, sidoo kalena lagu dhaawacay 21 kale. Sidoo kale waxaa la burburiyay gaari Cabdi Bile ah oo ay adeegsanayeen maleeshiyaadka la duqeeyay iyo dhufeyso ay ka qoteen deegaanka Suullaay. “Howlgalka ayaa lagu dilay 18 dhagarqabe oo ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab, halka 21 kale lagu gaarsiiyay dhaawacyo culus. Sidoo kale, waxaa la burburiyay hal gaari oo dagaal oo ay kooxda adeegsanaysay, iyo fariisimo iyo dhufeysyo ay ka sameysteen deegaanka,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Dhinaca kale, Wasaaradda ayaa bogaadisay xirfadda, geesinimada iyo howlkarnimada Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, waxay dhanka kale u mahadcelisay Saaxiibada Caalamka iskaashiga iyo taageerada ay ka geysanayaan ciribtirka maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab iyo xaqiijinta amniga dalka. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay warsaxaafadeedka “Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed waxay xaqiijinayaan inay sii dardargelin doonaan howlgallada lagu beegsanayo fariisimaha iyo awoodda maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab, iyadoo mudnaan gaar ah la siinayo badqabka shacabka iyo ilaalinta xasilloonida dalka”. Maalmihii u dambeeyay deegaannada HirShabelle waxaa ka socday howlgallo culus oo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab, iyada oo meelo kala duwan oo kamid ah gobolada Hiiraan iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe lagu beegsaday kooxaha Khawaarijta. items.title: Conflicts and energy shocks threaten progress against global hunger, UN agency head warns
items.description: ROME (AP) — Conflicts and disruptions to global energy markets could push millions more people into hunger by driving up fuel, fertilizer and food costs, the head of the Rome-based International Fund for Agricultural Development warned, as a new United Nations report showed global progress against hunger remains fragile. The U.N. food security report, released Tuesday, found  global hunger  has eased modestly in recent years, but projected more than 500 million people could still face chronic hunger by 2030.  Africa  is expected to bear the largest share of that burden. In an interview with The Associated Press on July 10, IFAD President Alvaro Lario said geopolitical tensions and potential disruptions to shipping and energy supplies, including uncertainty surrounding the Strait of Hormuz during the  Iran war , could leave an additional 9-18 million people  facing hunger  if the shocks persist. “We are in a current era where we have the highest number of conflicts and are still increasing,” Lario said. “Whenever there is a conflict, also hunger, displacement, refugees increase.” Conflict fuels food insecurity Conflict remains one of the biggest obstacles to reducing hunger worldwide, Lario added. Wars and geopolitical tensions can disrupt shipping, energy supplies and agricultural inputs, increasing costs across food systems already strained by inflation. Lario stressed that hunger and conflict often reinforce one another, creating a cycle that is difficult to break without greater stability. Higher energy prices are already affecting fertilizers and agricultural production, he said. The impact is especially significant for small-scale farmers, many of whom rely on diesel fuel to pump water, harvest crops and transport goods to market. Rising fuel costs increase production expenses and can feed directly into higher food prices. Climate shocks add pressure The new report identifies affordability as one of the world’s biggest food security challenges. While food production continues to grow, roughly a third of the global population still can’t afford a healthy diet. In low-income countries, that figure rises to about 77%, according to Lario. “The biggest challenge is no longer simply producing enough food, but making healthy diets affordable,” he said. Climate change  is adding further pressure to food systems and rural livelihoods. Lario noted that floods, prolonged droughts and extreme heat are increasingly disrupting agriculture around the world and have become a common reality for many communities. Governments should focus on resilience and adaptation before disasters strike, rather than relying solely on emergency responses afterward, he said. “This is just becoming the new normal,” Lario said. “We are seeing floods in many countries. We’re still seeing droughts that have been expanding for four or five years.” The fund is increasing investments in climate-adaptation programs aimed at helping rural communities withstand floods, droughts and extreme heat, he said, arguing that support is urgently needed for the millions of small farmers who produce much of the world’s food. Africa emerges as the epicenter The report highlights  Africa as the world’s most pressing food-security challenge . For the first time, the continent has overtaken  Asia  as the region with the largest number of hungry people, and nearly 60% of the world’s chronically undernourished people could live there by 2030. Lario attributed the shift partly to rapid population growth and slower economic gains than in parts of Asia, and he called for greater investment in agriculture, infrastructure and food systems. African countries currently import nearly $100 billion worth of food each year, he said, underscoring the need for stronger local production, storage, distribution and regional trade networks. Conflicts, energy-market disruptions and climate extremes threaten to derail progress unless governments invest in more resilient food systems, Lario said. items.title: Sacuudiga oo xaqiijiyay in la gubay mid ka mid ah maraakiibtiisa shidaalka
items.description: Wakaaladda Wararka Sacuudiga ee SPA ayaa Khamiistan ku warantay in markab shidaal oo Sacuudiga uu leeyahay la gubay, xilli uu ku socdaalayay Badda Cas. Wakaaladda Wararka SPA oo soo xiganeysa Saraakiil ka tirsan Wasaaradda Gaadiidka ayaa sheegtay in weerarku uu sababay in dab ka kaco qaybta hore ee markabka. SPA ayaa sheegtay in dhammaan shaqaalihii saarnaa markabka ENCELA (ENCELIA) ay badqabaan, isla-markaana ay masuuliyiintu qaadeen tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah, si loo sugo amniga markabka iyo shaqaalaha, loona ilaaliyo deegaanka badda. Tani ayaa imaneysa, iyadoo Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay sheegeen inay gubeen laba markab oo shidaal oo laga leeyahay Sacuudiga, ka dib markii ay ku xadgudbeen go’doominta badda ee ka dhanka ah Sacuudiga. Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa sheegay inay Arbacadii gantaalo iyo drones ku weerareen laba markab, oo mid ka mid ah maraakiibtaasi lagu magacaabo ENCELA, iyadoo laga hortagayo jebinta maraakiibta ee cunaqabataynta ay ku soo rogeen Sacuudiga. Hawlgalada ay Xuutiyiinta ka bilaabeen Badda Cas ayaa sare u qaadeysa xiisadda Bariga Dhexe, waana xilli Mareykanku uu sii wado duqaymaha uu ku hayo bartilmaameedyada gudaha Iran, isla-markaana ay Ciidamada Iran weeraro aargudasho ah ka gaysanayaan dalalka gobolka qaarkood, gaar ahaan kuwa Carabta ee ay ku yaallaan saldhigyada militari ee Mareykanka.

items.title: Mareykanka iyo Sacuudiga oo gaaray heshiis Nukliyeer
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Mareykanka iyo Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa gaaray heshiis iskaashi oo ku saabsan tamarta nukliyeerka rayidka, kaas oo boqortooyada u oggolaanaya inay dhisto xarumo koronto oo nukliyeer ah, iyadoo adeegsanaysa teknoolajiyadda shirkadaha Mareykanka. Heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale Sacuudiga u furaya waddo uu gudaha dalkiisa ugu kobcin karo uranium-ka, arrintaas oo durba dhalisay walaac xooggan oo ku saabsan faafitaanka hubka nukliyeerka iyo tartan hub oo cusub oo ka qarxa Bariga Dhexe. Waaxda Tamarta Mareykanka ayaa Arbacadii sheegtay in heshiiska ay kala saxiixdeen xoghayaha tamarta Mareykanka Chris Wright iyo wasiirka tamarta Sacuudiga Amiir Abdulaziz bin Salman. Heshiiska, oo loo yaqaan “123 Agreement”, ayaa dhigaya qaab-dhismeedka sharci ee u oggolaanaya dowladda iyo shirkadaha Mareykanka inay Sacuudi Carabiya ka caawiyaan horumarinta barnaamijkeeda tamarta nukliyeerka. Wadahadallada heshiiskan ayaa socday muddo sannado ah, waxayna soo mareen maamulkii koowaad ee madaxweyne Donald Trump iyo maamulkii madaxweynihii hore Joe Biden. Hase yeeshee, heshiiska hadda la gaaray ayaa ka duwan qorshihii maamulkii Biden, gaar ahaan dhinaca kormeerka caalamiga ah iyo xaddidaadaha ku saabsan wax-soo-saarka shidaalka nukliyeerka. Kormeerka caalamiga ah oo la dabciyay Heshiiska kuma jiro waxa loo yaqaan “Additional Protocol” ama Habraaca Dheeraadka ah, kaas oo Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Tamarta Nukliyeerka ee Qaramada Midoobay, IAEA, siin lahaa awood ay ku sameyso kormeerro kedis ah oo aad u ballaaran. Habraacaas ayaa kormeerayaasha caalamiga ah u oggolaanaya inay si degdeg ah u booqdaan goobaha nukliyeerka, oo ay ku jiraan xarumo aan hore loogu dhawaaqin, haddii ay jiraan tuhunno la xiriira dhaqdhaqaaqyo qarsoon. Maqnaanshaha nidaamkan ayaa walaac ku abuuray sharci-dejiyeyaasha Mareykanka iyo khubarada ka hortagga faafitaanka hubka nukliyeerka. Heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale Sacuudi Carabiya u oggolaanaya inay kobciso uranium-ka iyo inay dib u warshadeyso qashinka nukliyeerka. Labada farsamaba waxaa loo adeegsan karaa soo saarista shidaalka xarumaha korontada, balse haddii heer sare la gaarsiiyo waxay sidoo kale noqon karaan waddo lagu sameeyo walxo loo adeegsan karo hub nukliyeer ah. Tallaabadan ayaa ka duwan heshiiskii Mareykanka iyo Imaaraadka Carabta ee 2009, kaas oo Abu Dhabi ay ku oggolaatay inaanay gudaha dalka ka kobcin uranium-ka ama dib u warshadeyn qashinka nukliyeerka. items.title: Mareykanka oo Shaaciyay xilliga la maxkamadaynayo Madaxweynihii hore ee Venezuela
items.description: Mareykanka ayaa shaaciyay xilliga rasmiga ah ee maxkamadda la soo taagi doono Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka Venezuela oo bilo ka hor xukunka laga tuuray. Garsoore ka tirsan maxkamad heer federaal ah oo ku taalla Mareykanka ayaa u muddeeyay 1-da Juun 2027 in la bilaabo dacwadda loo haysto madaxweynihii hore ee Venezuela, Nicolas Maduro, iyo xaaskiisa Cilia Flores. Labadoodu way iska diideen eedeymaha la xiriira ka ganacsiga daroogada, iyagoo sheegay in aysan wax dambi ah gelin, balse Mareykanka ayaa ku adkaysanaya in dacwad lagu oogo lamaanahan muddada dheer ka talinayay dalka haysta kheyraadka ugu badan ee shidaalka adduunka. Muddayntan ayaa timid ka dib gar-mal hordhac ah oo maxkamaddu ay ku dhageysatay kiiska, ayadoo intii uu socday dhegeysiga maxkamadda oo qaatay ku dhowaad 15 daqiiqo, Maduro iyo xaaskiisu aysan wax hadal ah jeedin. Qareenka Maduro, Barry Pollack, ayaa sheegay inuu qorsheynayo inuu ka hor yimaado sharciyadda howlgalka militari ee Mareykanku ku qabtay Maduro bishii Janaayo 2026, isagoo sidoo kale ku doodi doona in Maduro uu leeyahay difaac sharci oo la xiriira madax-bannaanida dowladeed (sovereign immunity). Maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa ku dooday in howlgalka lagu soo qabtay Maduro uu ahaa mid lagu fulinayay sharciyada la dagaallanka dambiyada, iyadoo lagu eedeeyay inuu hoggaaminayay shabakad daroogo oo cocaine u dhoofin jirtay Mareykanka. Dowladda Venezuela iyo khubaro badan oo ku takhasusay sharciga caalamiga ah ayaa dhankooda ku tilmaamay howlgalkaasi mid ka baxsan sharciga caalamiga ah. Maduro ayaa wajahaya afar dacwadood oo ay ku jiraan shirqool argagixiso oo la xiriira daroogo, iyo qorshe lagu soo gelinayay cocaine gudaha Mareykanka. Haddii lagu helo dambiyadaasi, waxaa suuragal ah inuu wajaho xabsi daa’in, ayadoo dhinaca kale, maamulka ku meel gaarka ah ee Venezuela uu hadda hoggaaminayo Delcy Rodríguez.

items.title: Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta oo weeraray maraakiib shidaal oo laga leeyahay Sacuudiga
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegtay weerar lagu qaaday laba markab oo nooca shidaalka ah oo laga leeyahay Sacuudiga. Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa sheegay in Ciidamada Yemen ay beegsadeen laba markab sida shidaal, kuwaas oo marayay Badda Cas. “Waxaan bartilmaameedsanay laba markab oo shidaal oo laga leeyahay Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo kala ah ENCELA iyo LAYLIA, sababtoo ah waxay ku xadgudbeen go’aanka xayiraadda ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida.” Ayuu yiri Afhayeenka oo sheegay in weerarka uu dhacay Arbacadii. Afhayeenka ayaa tilmaamay in weerarka loo adeegsaday tiro gantaalada ballaastikada, cruise-ka iyo drones, taasoo keentay buu yiri in maraakiibtu uu dab qabsado. General Yahya Saree ayaa sheegay in Ciidamada Yemen ay sidoo kale ku dhawaad toban markab ku khasbeen inay ka weecdaan waddooyinkooda, isla-markaana ay dib u laabtaan. Saraakiisha Sacuudiga ayaan weli ka hadlin warka ka soo yeeray Xuutiyiinta, balse Hay’adda La socodka Ganacsiga Badda ee Britain (UKMTO) ayaa sheegtay in ay heshay warbixino sheegaya in la weeraray markab shidaal. “Kabtanka markabka shidaalka qaada ayaa soo sheegay inuu ku dhacay walax aan la aqoon oo sababtay dab ka kacay markabka dhexdiisa, kaas oo ay shaqaaluhu hadda ku howlan yihiin inay demiyaan.” Ayay UKMTO ku sheegtay war qoraal ah. Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa Isniintii xayiraad dhanka badda ah ku soo rogay maraakiibta shidaalka Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo ay ka mamnuuceen inay adeegsadaan waddada Badda Cas iyo Bab El-Mandeb. Weerarkan ayaa noqonaya kiisii ugu horreyay ee ay Xuutiyiintu ku qaadaan maraakiibta ganacsiga ee ku gooshaya Badda Cas iyo Bab El-Mandeb, tan iyo intii ay ku dhawaaqeen go’doominta ka dhanka ah Dekedaha Sacuudiga. Go’aanka Xuutiyiinta ee lagu go’doominayo Dekedaha Sacuudiga ayaa kordhinaya khatarta ah in ciriiri labaad uu ku yimaado sahayda tamarta adduunka ee Badda Cas, iyadoo uu xiran yahay Marinka Hormuz.

items.title: Muungaab oo digniin kale u diray dadka xoolahooda ku soo daaya caasimadda
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen “Muungaab”, ayaa mar kale ku celiyay in caasimadda Muqdisho aan laga aqbali doonin in lagu sii hayo xoolaha dab-joogta ah, gaar ahaan geela iyo lo’da, kuwaas oo dhibaato ku haya bulshada ku dhaqan magaalada. Muungaab ayaa sheegay in maamulkiisu eegayo maslaxadda afarta milyan ee qof ee ku nool Muqdisho, wuxuuna tilmaamay inaan la aqbali karin in geel lagu dhex daayo caasimadda, iyadoo la tixgelinayo bilicda iyo nadaafadda magaalada. “Geel ku aala-miiteynaya Maka Al-Mukarama, Jidka Wadnaha iyo Warshadaha ma soconeyso. Haddii ay dadku soo daayaanna, annaguna meel aan ognahay ayaan kula aala-miiteyneynaa,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiye Muungaab. Wuxuu xoolaleyda ku dhaqan Muqdisho ugu baaqay inay xoolahooda ku dhaqdaan bannaanka magaalada, isla markaana wax-soo-saarkooda iyo manaafacaadkooda ganacsi ahaan u keenaan Muqdisho. Guddoomiye Muungaab ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqay in si wadajir ah looga shaqeeyo sugidda amniga iyo ilaalinta bilicda magaalada. Wuxuu ku goodiyay in gacan bir ah lagu qaban doono cid kasta oo majaxaabineysa amniga magaalada, isla markaana meel looga soo wada jeesan doono dadka lagu tuhmo inay carqaladeynayaan xasilloonida caasimadda. Muungaab ayaa sheegay in muddadii u dambeysay Gobolka Banaadir laga sameeyay horumar ballaaran oo dhinacyada ganacsiga, dhismaha, waxbarashada iyo dowladnimada ah. Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa dhowr jeer soo saaray xeerar iyo digniino ku saabsan mamnuucidda xoolaha lagu sii daayo jidadka waaweyn ee magaalada. Digniinahaas kadib, maamulka ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay waday olole lagu qabanayo xoolaha lagu dhex daayo caasimadda, gaar ahaan lo’da ay xoolaleydu ku sii daayaan magaalada. Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa qabqabtay lo’ lagu dhex daayay suuqyada, bartamaha magaalada iyo waddooyinka waaweyn, kuwaas oo dhibaato ku hayay bulshada iyo ganacsatada. Geela iyo lo’da lagu sii daayo waddooyinka ayaa sababa saxmad iyo shilal halis ah, kuwaas oo keeni kara dhaawacyo, khasaare naf iyo maalba leh. Sanadihii u dambeeyay waxaa magaalada Muqdisho ku soo badanayay xoolaleyda, gaar ahaan geeleyda, kuwaas oo geela ku dhaqda xaafadaha kala duwan, habeenkiina ku sii daaya gudaha xaafadaha. Arrintan ayaa sababtay in geelu daaqo geedaha iyo dhirta lagu beeray magaalada. The post Muungaab oo digniin kale u diray dadka xoolahooda ku soo daaya caasimadda appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xanibaadaha Xuutiyiinta oo burburinaya dhaqaalaha Sacuudiga
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa Isniintii maraakiibta Sacuudiga ka mamnuucay inay isugu gooshaan waddada Badda Cas iyo Bab El-Mandeb, iyadoona go’aanka uu dhaqangalay isla xilligii lagu dhawaaqay, sida uu sheegay Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ayaa 24-kii saac ee u dambeysay tiro maraakiib ah ka celiyay inay ka gudbaan marinka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab El-Mandeb, kaas oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Sacuudiga ayaa leh dekedo istiraatiiji ah oo saaran xeebaha Badda Cas, kuwaas oo isugu jira kuwo qaada shidaalka, badeecadaha ganacsiga, xujeyda iyo dalxiiseyaasha. Dekedaha istiraatiijiga ah ee Sacuudiga waa marinada muhiimka ah ee boqortooyada ay u isticmaasho dhoofinta shidaalka iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah, kuwaas oo fure u ah qorshaha Riyadh ee hiigsiga 2030, oo ah qorshe uu wado Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Mohammed bin Salman oo lagu casriyeynayo dalka, la ballaariyo dhaqaalihiisa, laguna dhiirado in la yareeyo ku tiirsanaanta shidaalka, iyadoo la soo jiidanayo dalxiiseyaasha iyo maalgashiga shisheeye. Dekedda Islaamiga ah ee Jeddah (Jeddah Islamic Port) ayaa ah tan ugu weyn, uguna mashquulka badan dalka, waxayna qayb weyn ka qaadataa kobaca dhaqaalaha ee boqortooyada, iyadoo Dekedda Ganacsiga ee Yanbu (Yanbu Commercial Port) ay tahay mid ka mid ah dekedaha ugu facaweyn, waana marinka ugu weyn ee xamuulka guud iyo marin muhiim ah oo ay adeegsadaan dalxiiseyaasha, xujeyda iyo dadka u socda magaalada barakeysan ee Madiina, waana xarun dhexe oo u adeegta Magaalooyinka Madiina iyo Buraydah ee Gobolka Qassim. Magaalada Yanbu ayaa waxay leedahay deked labaad, waana Dekedda Warshadaha ee King Fahad (King Fahd Industrial Port), taasoo ah xarunta ugu weyn ee dhoofinta shidaalka ceyriinka iyo kiimikooyinka laga sameeyo batroolka, waxayna ku taal Badda Cas. Dekeddan ayaa waxay isku xirtaa waddooyinka ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee u dhaxeeya Bariga Fog, Yurub iyo Waqooyiga Mareykanka. Ka dib markii uu xumaaday dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta ee Marinka Hormuz, Sacuudiga ayaa shidaalkiisii marayay Hormuz u soo weeciyay in laga dhoofiyo Dekedda King Fahad ee Yanbu, si uu uga baxsado xanibaadda Iran ee Hormuz, waxaana maalin kasta dekeddaasi laga dhoofinayay illaa 4 milyan oo fuuto. Si kastaba ha ahaatee xaaladda ayaa hadda is bedeshay, bacdamaa Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay ku dhawaaqeen xayiraad dhanka badda oo dalkaasi ah. Sacuudiga waa dalka ugu weyn Khaliijka ee dhoofiya shidaalka ugu badan, waana dalka ugu weyn Gobolka Bariga Dhexe ee wax ka soo iibsada dibadda, waana dalka leh dhaqaalaha ugu weyn (Total GDP) guud ahaan gobolka. Dekedaha Sacuudiga ee Badda Cas waxay udub dhexaad u yihiin ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo dhoofinta shidaalka. Xayiraad kasta oo lagu soo rogo maraakiibta ku wajahan ama ka imaanaya dekedahaasi ee ka gudba Marinka Bab El-Mandeb ayaa halis gelinaya dhoofinta shidaalka boqortooyada ee inta badan halkaasi laga dhoofiyo iyo ganacsiga kale ee dibadda uga yimaada. Marinka Bab Al-Mandeb, oo ah albaabka koonfureed ee laga galo Badda Cas ayaa ahaa marin halbowle ah oo u furnaa maraakiibta shidaalka ka qaada iyo kuwa kale ee badeecadaha ganaciga geeya Dekedaha Sacuudiga. Bab El-Mandeb ayaa waxaa mara qayb weyn oo ka mid ah shidaalka boqortooyada ee u gudba dhanka Asia, oo laga xusi karo Shiinaha, Japan iyo India. Go’doominta Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee Dekedaha Sacuudiga ayaa si xun u dhaawacaya dhaqaalaha boqortooyada, marka aad eegto in uu xanibaayo shidaalka laga dhoofiyo ama ganacsiga ku socda dalkaasi. Xaaladdan cusub ayaa waxay qalqal-gelineysaa dhoofinta shidaalka iyo ganacsiga labada dhinac.
