items.title: Sacuudiga oo si adag uga hadlay xanibaadaha Xuutiyiinta ee maraakiibtiisa
items.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Sacuudiga ayaa cambaareysay hanjaabadda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee ku saabsan inay dhanka badda ka go’doominayaan dalkaasi. Wasaaradda ayaa waxay beenisay eedeymaha Xuutiyiinta, ee ah in Riyadh ay xanibaad ku hayso dekedaha ku yaala Waqooyiga Yemen. “Boqortooyadu waxay xaqiijineysaa inay sanadihii la soo dhaafay la shaqeynaysay dowladda sharciga ah ee Yemen, si loo yareeyo dhibaatada haysata shacabka Yemen, iyadoo loo marayo sii wadidda mashaariicda horumarinta, taageerada miisaaniyadda Dowladda Yemen iyo bixinta shidaalka, si loogu shaqeysiiyo xarumaha korontada.” Ayay wasaaraddu ku sheegtay bayaan ay soo saartay. Wasaaradda ayaa intaas ku dartay in in ka badan 300 oo markab oo siday noocyo kala duwan oo cunto ah, badeecado, shidaal iyo agabka dhismaha ay gaareen dekedaha ku yaala Waqooyiga Yemen, oo ay ku jiraan Hodeidah, Salif iyo Ras Isa, intii lagu jiray lixdii bilood ee ugu horreysay sanadkan. Bayaanka ayaa lagu sheegay in Boqortooyada Sacuudiga ay taageertay dadaalada Qaramada Midoobey ee lagu doonayo in dalka lagu soo dabaalo nabad, oo ay ku jirto qorshe howleed ay aqbashay Dowladda Yemen, halka Xoogaga Xuutiyiintu ay diideen inay aqbalaan, bedelkeedana ay ku biireen colaadda ballaaran ee gobolka, iyagoo u adeegsanaya ajandayaashooda iyo ujeedooyinkooda guracan, taas oo sii kordhisay dhibaatada haysata muwaadiniinta Yemen ee ku nool deegaanada ay gacanta ku hayaan. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in boqortooyadu ay hiigsaneyso inay Yemen ka dhaliso nabad, isla-markaana soo afjarto dhibaatada haysata shacabka Yemen. Dhanka kale Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in dalku uu qaadi doono dhammaan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah, si loo ilaaliyo maraakiibta, iyadoo la raacayo sharciga caalamiga ah. Riyadh waxay ugu baaqday bulshada caalamka inay gutaan masuuliyaddooda ku aaddan hirgelinta qaraarada Golaha Ammaanka ee khuseeya arrintan, kuwaas oo ay ugu muhiimsan yihiin Qaraarka 2216 ee ku saabsan Yemen iyo Qaraarka 2722 ee xuquuqda iyo xorriyadda socdaalka maraakiibta ee Badda Cas. Xiisadda Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta ayaa cirka isku shareertay, ka dib markii 13-kii bishan duqayn dhanka cirka ah lagu qaaday Garoonka Diyaaradaha Sanca, taas oo lagu hor istaagay diyaarad ay leedahay Iran oo ku sii jeedday garoonkaasi.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo ku dhawaaqay ‘go’doomin dhanka badda ah’ oo lagu soo rogay Sacuudi Carabiya
items.description: David Gritten Qoraalka sawirka,Xuutiyiintu waxay sheegeen in xayiraaddu ay ahayd jawaab-celin ku socotay go’doomin ay Sacuudigu saareen dekedaha iyo garoomada diyaaradaha ee Yemen. Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa ku dhawaaqay in ay “cunaqabatayn dhinaca badda ah” oo ka dhan ah Sacuudi Careebiya ku soo rogeen marin-biyoodka Baabul Mandab ee koonfurta Badda Cas. Afhayeen u hadlay militariga Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in tillaabadan oo looga jawaabayo xayiraadda Sacuudigu muddaba ku hayey dekedaha iyo garoomada Yeman ay si degdeg ah u dhaqangaleyso. Afhayeenka militariga ee kooxda ay Iiraan taageerto ayaa sheegay in tallaabadan ay si degdeg ah u dhaqan geli doonto, isla markaana ay jawaab u tahay xannibaadda ay Sacuudigu saareen dekedaha iyo garoomada diyaaradaha ee waqooyi-galbeed Yemen oo ay Xuutiyiintu maamulaan. Faahfaahin badan kama uusan bixin cunaqabataynta, hase yeeshee mas’uul ka tirsan warbaahinta Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay inay xirayaan marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, oo ah albaabka koonfureed ee Badda Cas, ayna ka horjoogsanayaan maraakiibta Sacuudigu in ay maraan. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Sacuudiga oo ka jawaabtay eedeynta iyo uga timid Yeman, ayaa cambaaraysay hanjabaadda Xuutiyiinta, waxayna wacad ku martay in dalku “qaadi doono dhammaan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka u ah ilaalinta maraakiibtiisa, si waafaqsan sharciga caalamiga ah.” Badda Cas ayaa noqotay marin aad muhiim ugu ah dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga intii uu socday dagaalka u dhexeeya Maraykanka, Israa’iil iyo Iiraan, kaas oo sababay in marin-biyoodka Hormuz u xirmo. Arrintan ayaa timid toddobaad uun kadib markii ay soo labo-kacleysay colaadda u dhexeysa Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga oo hurudey tan iyo markii xabbad-joojin aan rasmi ahayn ay dhaqan gashay sannadkii 2022. Xuutiyiintu waxay sheegeen in ay gantaallo ku weerareen garoonka diyaaradaha ee Abha ee koonfur-galbeed Sacuudiga, iyagoo uga jawaabaya duqeymo sida ay sheegeen Sacuudigu ku qaaday garoonka diyaaradaha ee caasimadda Sanca. Hayeeshee weeraradaas waxaa sheegtay dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudigu taageero, taas oo ku andacootay in ay uga hortageysey diyaarad Iiraan leedahay oo oggolaansho la’aan halkaas ku degaysey. Yemen waxaa halakeeyay dagaal sokeeye oo billowday sannadkii 2014, markii Xuutiyiintu ay dowladda ka saareen magaalada Sanca. Colaadda ayaa sii xoogaysatay sannadkii 2015 markii isbahaysi dalal Carbeed ah oo uu hoggaaminayo Sacuudigu uu farageliyay si uu dib ugu soo celiyo dowladda talada. Dagaalka ayaa la sheegay inuu sababay dhimashada in ka badan 150,000 oo qof, isla markaana uu horseeday mid ka mid ah dhibaatooyinka bini’aadantinimo ee ugu daran dunida, iyadoo in ka badan 22 milyan oo qof ay u baahan yihiin nooc ka mid ah gargaar, sida ay sheegtay Qaramada Midoobay. Isniintii, afhayeenka militariga Xuutiyiinta, Yaxya Sariic, ayaa sheegay in Sacuudigu uu shacabka Yemen ku hayo “go’doomin sida uu sheegay dulmi iyo cadaadis ku dhisan” muddo ku dhow 12 sano, isagoo sidoo kale ku eedeeyay in uu bililiqeystay khayraadka dalka islamarkaana uu dekedaha iyo garoomada diyaaradaha Yeman saaray go’doomin dhinacyada dhulka, badda iyo hawada ah. Kadib wuxuu ku dhawaaqay in kooxdu ay go’aansatay inay ku jawaabto iyadoo ku dhawaaqaysa “cunaqabatayn dhinaca badda ah oo ka dhan ah cadowga dembiilaha ah ee Sacuudiga”, taas oo uu ku sheegay in ay ku salaysan tahay mabda’a ah “il la rido il baa loo ridaa.” “Wixii tallaabo nacasnimo ah ee uu qaado cadowga taxaddar la’aanta ah ee Sacuudigu si uu colaadda u sii kordhiyo, waxaa lagu jawaabi doonaa koror dagaal oo ballaaran oo go’aan leh,” ayuu intaas ku daray. Sariic ma uusan bixin faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan cunaqabataynta, balse ku-xigeenka madaxa xafiiska warbaahinta Xuutiyiinta, Nasruddin Amer, ayaa bartiisa X ku qoray in ciidamada kooxdu ay “xirayaan Bab al-Mandab oo ay ka mamnuucayaan maraakiibta cadowga Sacuudiga.” Marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab waa marin biyo ah oo ballaciisu yahay 32 kiiloomitir (20 mayl), kana dhexeeya koonfur-galbeed Yemen iyo Geeska Afrika. Waxa uu isku xiraa Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas, taas oo iyaduna ku xiran Badda Dhexe iyada oo loo sii maro Kanaalka Suweys. Wax yar kadib markii uu billowday dagaalkii Gaza bishii Oktoobar 2023, Xuutiyiintu waxay bilaabeen inay gantaallo, diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn iyo doomo yaryar ku weeraraan maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, iyagoo sheegay in ay taageerayaan Falastiiniyiinta. Afar markab ayaa la quusiyay, sagaal xubnood oo shaqaalaha maraakiibta ah ayaa la dilay, waxaana gaadiidkii ganacsiga ee mara jiray Bab al-Mandab uu gaaray heerkii ugu hooseeyay taariikhda, maadaama shirkadaha maraakiibtu ay maraakiibtooda u weeciyeen hareeraha koonfurta Afrika. Inkasta oo Xuutiyiintu ay hakiyeen weeraradooda kadib heshiiskii xabbad-joojinta Gaza bishii Oktoobar ee la soo dhaafay, haddana tirada maraakiibta sii marta marin-biyoodkan wali kuma soo noqon heerarkii hore, sida ay muujinayaan xogaha Sanduuqa Lacagta Adduunka (IMF). Iyadoo laga jawaabayo xaaladda ka taagan marin-biyoodka Hormuz, Sacuudigu wuxuu u weeciyay in ka badan 70% dhoofintiisa shidaalka ceeriin dekedda Yanbu ee Badda Cas. Toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay waxaa halkaas laga dhoofiyay qiyaastii 4 milyan oo foosto maalintii, marka loo barbar dhigo ku dhowaad 973,000 foosto maalintii isla muddadaas sannad ka hor, sida ay muujinayaan xogaha shirkadaha Kpler iyo Signal Ocean. Wadarta shidaalka mara Bab al-Mandab ayaa sidoo kale kor u kacday oo gaartay 7.4 milyan oo foosto maalintii bishii Juun, taas oo u dhiganta qiyaastii 7% wax-soo-saarka shidaalka adduunka. Mohammed Albasha, oo ka tirsan shirkadda Maraykanka ee la-talinta khataraha Basha Report, ayaa sheegay inaan weli caddayn in Xuutiyiintu ay bilaabi doonaan inay bartilmaameedsadaan maraakiibta ku wajahan Sacuudiga. “Weli haddii aan hal markab la weerarin, ku dhawaaqista keliya waxay u badan tahay inay carqalad ku keento isu socodka maraakiibta isla markaana ay abuuri doonto hubanti la’aan ku saabsan dekedaha Sacuudiga. Su’aasha ugu muhiimsan waxay tahay in Xuutiyiintu ay hanjabaaddooda u beddeli doonaan ficil toos ah iyo in kale,” ayuu u sheegay wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters. Bbc somali

Waxa uu isku xiraa Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas, taas oo iyaduna ku xiran Badda Dhexe iyada oo loo sii maro Kanaalka Suweys. Wax yar kadib markii uu billowday dagaalkii Gaza bishii Oktoobar 2023, Xuutiyiintu waxay bilaabeen inay gantaallo, diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn iyo doomo yaryar ku weeraraan maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, iyagoo sheegay in ay taageerayaan Falastiiniyiinta. Afar markab ayaa la quusiyay, sagaal xubnood oo shaqaalaha maraakiibta ah ayaa la dilay, waxaana gaadiidkii ganacsiga ee mara jiray Bab al-Mandab uu gaaray heerkii ugu hooseeyay taariikhda, maadaama shirkadaha maraakiibtu ay maraakiibtooda u weeciyeen hareeraha koonfurta Afrika. Inkasta oo Xuutiyiintu ay hakiyeen weeraradooda kadib heshiiskii xabbad-joojinta Gaza bishii Oktoobar ee la soo dhaafay, haddana tirada maraakiibta sii marta marin-biyoodkan wali kuma soo noqon heerarkii hore, sida ay muujinayaan xogaha Sanduuqa Lacagta Adduunka (IMF). Iyadoo laga jawaabayo xaaladda ka taagan marin-biyoodka Hormuz, Sacuudigu wuxuu u weeciyay in ka badan 70% dhoofintiisa shidaalka ceeriin dekedda Yanbu ee Badda Cas. Toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay waxaa halkaas laga dhoofiyay qiyaastii 4 milyan oo foosto maalintii, marka loo barbar dhigo ku dhowaad 973,000 foosto maalintii isla muddadaas sannad ka hor, sida ay muujinayaan xogaha shirkadaha Kpler iyo Signal Ocean. Wadarta shidaalka mara Bab al-Mandab ayaa sidoo kale kor u kacday oo gaartay 7.4 milyan oo foosto maalintii bishii Juun, taas oo u dhiganta qiyaastii 7% wax-soo-saarka shidaalka adduunka. Mohammed Albasha, oo ka tirsan shirkadda Maraykanka ee la-talinta khataraha Basha Report, ayaa sheegay inaan weli caddayn in Xuutiyiintu ay bilaabi doonaan inay bartilmaameedsadaan maraakiibta ku wajahan Sacuudiga. “Weli haddii aan hal markab la weerarin, ku dhawaaqista keliya waxay u badan tahay inay carqalad ku keento isu socodka maraakiibta isla markaana ay abuuri doonto hubanti la’aan ku saabsan dekedaha Sacuudiga. Su’aasha ugu muhiimsan waxay tahay in Xuutiyiintu ay hanjabaaddooda u beddeli doonaan ficil toos ah iyo in kale,” ayuu u sheegay wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters. Bbc somali

items.title: Hamas names Khalil al-Hayya as new leader after run-off with Khaled Meshaal
items.description: Al Jazeera- Hamas has named Khalil al-Hayya as its new leader, succeeding Yahya Sinwar who was killed by the Israeli army in October 2024. Al-Hayya, a former deputy chairman of the Palestinian group and one of five members of its leadership council, won an internal ballot in a run-off against former political leader Khaled Meshaal, Hamas said in a statement on Monday. Al-Hayya rose in importance after the killings in 2024 of top Hamas leaders Sinwar and military commander  Mohammed Deif  in Gaza, and  Ismail Haniyeh  who was assassinated during a visit to Tehran the same year. With those losses, al-Hayya became one of five leaders steering  Hamas’s leadership council , the temporary, five-member ruling committee formed in late 2024 to govern Gaza during Israel’s genocidal war. He was the Hamas chief negotiator when a ceasefire agreement was reached with Israel in October 2025. The deal has failed to bring an end to frequent deadly Israeli attacks in Gaza. Al-Hayya himself has been the target of at least two assassination attempts by Israeli forces. “Israel has not officially reacted to this election but he is described in Israel as ‘a hawk’, as someone who is closer to Iran than the Arab governments, than even Turkey. Of course, this may shed some light on how things will move forward,” Al Jazeera’s Nour Odeh reported from near Ramallah in the occupied West Bank. “This is an election process that is very intricate. It has taken months for the various layers of election in Hamas to conclude in the West Bank, in Gaza, in Israeli prisons and in the diaspora, all culminating in this moment,” she said. Born in the Gaza Strip in 1960, al-Hayya has been part of Hamas since it was established in 1987. He was elected to the parliament of the Palestinian Authority in 2006. He became especially important on the diplomatic front, based mainly in Qatar, which emerged as the main hub for mediation with other countries, including Israel, Egypt, and the United States. Operating outside Gaza allowed him to travel and coordinate between neighbouring countries without the constraints of the Israeli blockade on Gaza. Al-Hayya has also led Hamas’s delegations in mediated talks with Israel to try to secure a Gaza ceasefire deal. Al-Hayya’s family has suffered as a result of Israeli attacks. Four of his children have been killed by Israeli attacks over the years. During the 2014 war, an Israeli strike destroyed the house of his eldest son, Osama, who was killed along with his wife, and three of their children. In September last year, an Israeli  attack  on a residential complex in central Doha, Qatar, killed five people including his son Humam. Source: Al Jazeera The post Hamas names Khalil al-Hayya as new leader after run-off with Khaled Meshaal appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Boqollaal qof oo la ildaran shuban-biyood iyo daawo yari ka jirta Jubbada hoose
items.description: (ERGO) –  Toddobo qof ayaa cudurka shuban-biyoodka ugu dhintay deegaanka Buula Xaaji oo dhinaca galbeed kaga beegan magaalada Kismaayo. Wuxuu sidoo kale soo ritay tan iyo bartamihii bishii June 235 qof oo isugu jira rag, haween iyo carruur, sida ay noo sheegeen dhakhaatiir deegaanka u tagay caawinka bukaanada. Dr. Xasan Xuseen Maxamed, oo ka mid ah dhakhaatiirta si mutadawacnimo ah u caawinaya bukaannada, ayaa sheegay in sababta ugu weyn ee cudurka loo aaneynayo ay tahay biyaha wasakhaysan ee laga cabbo waraha. Aadan Bakaal Sheekh waxaa cudurka uga dhintay wiil labo jir ah bilowgii July 2026. Wuxuu xusay inuu halmar ku soo booday shuban aan kala joogisi lahayn, ayna Joogeen dhul baadiye ah oo aan lahayn goob cafimaad iyo daawo midna.  “Wuu shubmay. Shubankii wuu Isbeddelay. Quraan ayaan saarnay.  Cunugii indhihii god ayey galeen. Wax daryeel ah ayaan waynay. Waxaa nala dhahay Buula Haaji ayaa daryeel uu jiraa oo cafimaad la keenay. Aniga iyo gabadhii ii dhashay ayaa soo qaadnay. Gabadhii waa qaadi wayday shubankii ayaa iska socda.”  Aadan ayaa sheegay in wiilkiisa uu u waayay lacag uu gaari ku soo saaro, taas oo dib dhigtay. Wuxu xusay in saddex habeen iyo saddex maalin uu la soo lugaynayay. Markii uu u soo dhawaaday deegaanka Buula Haaji nin ayaa ku caawiyey gaari Dameer. Wuxuu tilmaamay inay jirka kula soo kulmeen culeyso kale oo safarka ku dheereeyay sida roob mahiigaan ah oo jaray waddooyinka. Arrimahaas ayaa keenay in wiilkooda uusan durba helin gargaar badbaado leh. “Waxaan u soo qaadi waayey gaadiid la’aan. Meesha Gaadiid ma galo.  Waa cir ka dheer dhul dheer. Marka aan soo dhawaanay ayaan qaadmo ku soo dayey. Tiirabi ayaa qabsatay walaalow cunugayagii aan jeclayn.”  Ninkan ayaa sheegay in wiilkiisa uu naf baxay markii ay geeyeen Buula Haaji oo lix saac uu yeelay goob yar oo si ku meelgaar ah loo dhisay. Dhakhaatiirta ayuu xusay inay u sheegeen inuu u god galay cudurka Shuban biyoodka. Waxaa xannuunka ku kordhinaya in sababta geeridiisu tahay fuuq bax ku socday maalmo, iyada oo aan la siin wax dawayn iyo baxnaano kale ah midna. “Dhakhtarka waxaa uu yidhi shubanka ayaa dilay.  Haddii uu daryeel caafimaad helli lahaa waa fiicnaan lahaa ayuu nagu yidhi. Anagana waan soo gaadhi waynay. Mar hore maxaad u keeni waydeen ayuu na waydiiyey. Anagana tamarta ayaan u sheegnay sida aan Buula haaji ku keenay, marka xaalka ayaad sidaa noqday.” Aadan iyo xaaskiisa ayaa dib ugu laabtay tuuladoodii Qurac-dheer iyada oo uusan wehlin yaraankoodii. Waa danyar dhaqda afar sac iyo toban ari ah oo uga soo haray abaaro deegaanka saameeyay. Buula Xaaji ma laha isbitaal ama xarun caafimaad oo si rasmi ah u shaqeysa. Xarunta caafimaad ee ugu dhow waxay ku taallaa magaalada Kismaayo oo u jirta qiyaastii 90 km. Qoysaska qaar ayaa awoodin inay iska bixiyaan qarashka gaadiidka. Dadka deegaanka ayaa iskood isu abaabulay, iyagoo dhisay laba teendho oo ku-meel-gaar ah, kuna diyaariyey afar sariirood si loogu dabiibo bukaannada ugu daran. Waxaa sidoo kale la geeyey daawo kooban oo ay bixisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Jubbaland, hase yeeshee dhamaad ah.  DR Xassan Xusseen Maxamed oo ka mid ah dhakhaatiirta dadka ugu shaqaynaysa sida tabaruca ah ayaa sheegay in uu cudurka uu ku faafayo si xawli ah marka loo eego dadka uu soo ridanayo. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in daawooyinka iyo sariiraha ay ku jiifanayaan bukaanka ay aad u yaryihiin, taas oo hoos u dhigaysa dedaalkooda. Wuxuu tilmaamay inay awoodooda ka baxsan tahay baahida jirta. “Anagga waxaan siinaynay dadka Oras iyo daawooyin u badan faleenbooyin oo ku xidhaynay dadka. Dadka waxaa ay ka imaanayaan miyi iyo magaalaba. Cudurka waxaa uu ka dhashay biyha wasakhada ee dadka ay cabayaan.”  Marka laga tago reer guuraaga bukanaadda ugu badan waxay ka imaanayaan xeryaha deegaanka. Faadumo Hilowle. Cumar oo ku nool duleedka deegaanka Buula Haaji ayaa sheegtay inay wiil ay dhashay oo labo sano iyo bar jira uu kaga dhacay Shuban 25 June. Waxay keentay deegaanka balse waxaa loo sheegay inay xaaladdiisu tahay mid aan waxba looga qaban karin. Faadumo ayaa xustay inay wayday $16 oo ay ku gayso magaalada Kismaayo. Nasiib wanaagsan, waxaa ka ogolaaday inuu si dayn ah ugu qaado mid ka mid ah darawallo ay u dan-sheegatay.  “Cunugga markaan qaadaayey magaalada isagga oo nool ma tagaysaan mise dhaxda ayuu ku dhiman-doona ayaa lahaa sida uu u liitay awgeed. Markii aan magaalada tagay oo isbitaalka geeyey waa la isoo dhaweeyey cunuggan daawo ayuu meesha iiga helay.” Faadumo ayaa sheegtay in wiilkeeda kowdii bishan July laga saaray Isbitaalka guud ee magaalada Kismaayo isaga oo ay soo hagaagtay xaaladiisa caafimaad ayna dib ugu celisay deegaanka Buula Haaji oo ay ku nool yihiin.  Waxay xustay in daawooyin kala duwan loo siiyey wiilkeeda intii ay kula jirtay Isbitaalka dhakhaatiirtana ay ku bixiyeen dadaal  fiican sidii uu u badbaadi lahaa.  “Markii cunugga ii cafimaaday oo dhiigiisa uu soo noqday shubankiina uu joojiyey oo daawo walba la ii siiyey oo fiicnaaday ayaan soo bixiyey. Dhakhaatiirta waxaa ii sheegeen in cunugay uu aad u liitay oo shuban biyood uu ku dhacay oo xitaa qaybta ilmaha aad u liita la galiyey ayey ii sheegeen.” Faadumo ayaa sheegtay inay nolol adag ku wajahayaan xeryaha deegaanka oo ay soo galeen Febraayo markii ay roob yari uga dhamaadeen 25 lo’ ah iyo 50 neef oo ari ah oo ay noloshooda ku tiirsanayd. Nolasha qoyskeeda oo toban ah ayaa ku tiirsan shaqo muruq maal ah oo aan joogta ahayn oo saygeeda uu qabto. Waxy sheegtay in maalintii uu helo $1.5, mararka qaarna uu wayao. “Nolosha waa iska xuntahay waddanka shaqo la’aan ayaa ka jirta. Ninkii Shaqayn lahaa wax uu ka shaqeeyo ma lahan. Waddanka shaqo mataalo. Wax yar oo lo’ ah iyo adhiya ayaan lahayn. Lodii waa dhamaatay. Adhigiina wuu dhamaaday.” Qoysaskan oo horay u wajahayay saamayn taban oo ka dhalatay isbeddelka cimilada markii ay ku cayroobeen roob yari soo laalaabatay ayaa hadda waxaa u raacday xaalad caafimaad daro oo ku kordhisay duruufihii nolosha ee ay la halgamayeen. items.title: Iska Horimaadyo Hubaysan oo dhex maray ciidamada PSF iyo PMPF ee Puntland iyo odayaasha dhaqanka oo wada Dadaallo Nabadeed
items.description: Wararka laga helayo deegaanno kala duwan oo ka tirsan Puntland ayaa sheegaya in saacadihii la soo dhaafay ay dhaceen iska horimaadyo hubaysan oo u dhexeeya ciidamo ka kala tirsan PSF iyo PMPF, taas oo sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo amniga gobolka. Sida ay xaqiijiyeen mas’uuliyiin iyo dad goobjoogayaal ah, magaalada xeebta ku taalla ee Xaafuun waxaa ka dhacay is-rasaasayn dhex martay ciidamo ka tirsan labada dhinac. Dhanka kale, magaalada Qardho ayaa lagu soo warramayaa in rasaas lagu furay Hotel halkaas ku yaalla, inkastoo aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin sababta keentay dhacdadaas iyo khasaaraha ka dhashay. Dhacdooyinkan ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inay xiriir la leeyihiin xiisadda ka taagan deegaanka Buundada Laag ee duleedka Boosaaso, halkaas oo ay saacado ka hor is rasaaseeyeen ciidamada Puntland iyo kuwa PSF ee hadda hoostaga Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Ilaa iyo hadda ma jiraan warar rasmi ah oo xaqiijinaya khasaaraha ka dhashay iska horimaadyadan, waxaana ay wararku intaas ku darayaan in Puntland dhankeeda ay waddo abaabul ciidan oo ka dhan ah xoogagga dawladda Soomaaliya hoostaga ee ku sugan deegaannadeeda. Dhanka kale, odayaal dhaqameed ayaa wada dadaallo nabadeed oo lagu doonayo in lagu qaboojiyo xiisadda lagana hortago in dagaalladu sii fidaan. Mas’uuliyiinta Puntland ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga hadlin dhacdooyinkan, waxaana la filayaa in saacadaha soo socda ay soo baxaan faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan xaaladda iyo khasaaraha ka dhashay iska horimaadyada.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo iclaamiyey xannibaad badeed oo ka dhan ah Sacuudi Carabiya
items.description: Sanca (Caasimada Online) – Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee taageerada ka hesha Iran ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqday inay xannibaad badeed kusoo rogtay Sacuudi Carabiya, tallaabo sii ballaarin karta dagaalka u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran, isla markaana halis cusub gelinaysa maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo sahayda shidaalka caalamka. Afhayeenka ciidamada Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in xannibaadda ay si degdeg ah u dhaqan-gashay, isaga oo ku tilmaamay jawaab laga bixinayo waxa kooxdu ugu yeertay go’doominta iyo weerarrada Sacuudigu ku hayo Yemen. “Waxaan ku dhawaaqeynaa xannibaad badeed oo ka dhan ah cadowga Sacuudiga, annaga oo ku dhaqmeyna mabda’a ah il ka il,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka Xuutiyiinta. Dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaan si degdeg ah uga jawaabin ku dhawaaqista kooxda. Tallaabadan ayaa furaysa jiho cusub oo dagaal xilli Mareykanka iyo Iran ay maalintii sagaalaad isku weydaarsanayaan weerarro culus, kuwaas oo ku fiday dalal dhowr ah oo ku yaalla Bariga Dhexe. Iran ayaa maalmihii la soo dhaafay Xuutiyiinta ku cadaadineysay inay xiraan marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab haddii Mareykanku sii wado weerarrada uu ku hayo kaabeyaasha tamarta iyo korontada Iran, sida ay ilo xog-ogaal ah u sheegeen Reuters . Bab al-Mandab waa marin istaraatiiji ah oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, waxaana mara qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah shidaalka iyo badeecadaha u kala goosha Aasiya, Bariga Dhexe iyo Yurub. Haddii marinka si buuxda loo xiro, waxaa hakad geli kara shidaal u dhigma ku dhowaad toddoba boqolkiiba sahayda caalamka, iyadoo inta badan dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga ee dhinaca Badda Cas ay ku adkaan karto inay gaarto suuqyada caalamka. Dagaalka ka socda Gacanka ayaa durba hoos u dhigay qulqulka shidaalka caalamka qiyaastii 10 boqolkiiba, taas oo sare u qaadday qiimaha tamarta, gaadiidka iyo badeecadaha kale. Qiimaha shidaalka ayaa markii hore kor u kacay kadib ku dhawaaqista Xuutiyiinta, balse dib ayuu hoos ugu soo laabtay markii suuqyadu rajo ka muujiyeen dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed. Dadaallo lagu raadinayo xabbad-joojin Xiisaddan cusub ayaa soo baxday xilli Iran iyo Mareykanka ay muujiyeen inay weli diyaar u yihiin in dib loogu laabto wada-hadallada, inkasta oo labada dhinac ay sii wadaan weerarrada militari. Sarkaal sare oo Iranian ah ayaa Reuters u sheegay in Tehran ay dhex-dhexaadiyeyaal ka heshay qorshe lagu soo jeedinayo xabbad-joojin soconaysa 10 maalmood. Qorshaha ayaa la doonayaa inuu dib u soo nooleeyo heshiis ku-meel-gaar ah oo la gaaray bishii hore, kaas oo la filayay inuu gogol-xaar u noqdo heshiis joogto ah oo lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka bilowday 28-kii Febraayo, markii Mareykanka iyo Israel ay weerarro ku qaadeen Iran. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran ayaa xaqiijisay in fikrado iyo soo-jeedimo ay dhawaan kasoo gaareen dhex-dhexaadiyeyaal, balse ma aysan shaacin faahfaahinta qorshaha. Laba sarkaal oo ka tirsan dowladda Pakistan ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in wasiirka arrimaha gudaha Iran, Eskandar Momeni, uu Islamabad ka codsaday inay dib u bilowdo doorkeedii dhexdhexaadinta Mareykanka iyo Iran. Momeni ayaa booqashadiisii labaad ku tegay Pakistan muddo ka yar toddobaad, taas oo muujineysa in Tehran ay raadineyso waddo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu joojiyo dagaalka sii fidaya. Dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ayaa socda iyadoo Mareykanku habeenkii sagaalaad oo xiriir ah weerarro ka fuliyay gudaha Iran. Taliska Dhexe ee ciidamada Mareykanka, CENTCOM, ayaa sheegay in weerarrada loogu talagalay in lagu wiiqo awoodda Iran ay ugu hanjabeyso maraakiibta ganacsiga ee isticmaalaya marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Qaraxyo ayaa laga maqlay magaalooyinka Tabriz, Chabahar, Konarak, Bandar Mahshahr iyo Bandar Imam Khomeini. Wakaaladda wararka Iran ee IRNA ayaa sheegtay in hal qof lagu dilay, dhowr kalena lagu dhaawacay meel koonfur-galbeed kaga beegan Tabriz. Ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ayaa dhinacooda sheegay inay gantaallo ballistic ah ku weerareen diyaarado Mareykan ah oo ku sugnaa garoonka Aqaba ee Jordan, iyo saldhigyo militari oo ku yaalla Kuwait iyo Syria. Digniino dhanka cirka ah ayaa Isniintii laga maqlay Bahrain, halka ciidamada Kuwait ay sheegeen inay soo rideen diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo Iran laga leeyahay. Dowladda Kuwait ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in xarun biyaha badda lagu macaaneeyo la weeraray maalintii labaad oo xiriir ah, taas oo sababtay dab. Xarumaha biyaha lagu macaaneeyo ayaa ah isha ugu weyn ee biyaha la cabo ee dalal badan oo Khaliijka ah, waxaana ku tiirsan tobannaan milyan oo qof oo ku nool mid ka mid ah gobollada ugu qalalan dunida. Iran ayaa horay uga digtay inay bartilmaameedsan doonto xarumaha noocaas ah ee dalalka Khaliijka, haddii Mareykanku weeraro kaabeyaasha biyaha iyo tamarta Iran. Maraakiib ku qaraxday Marinka Hormuz Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in laba markab oo shidaal ay qarxeen kadib markii ay isku dayeen inay maraan waddo ay ku tilmaameen mid aan ammaan ahayn oo ku taalla marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Ma aysan bixin magacyada maraakiibta, tirada shaqaalaha saarnaa ama khasaaraha ka dhashay dhacdada, mana jirto cid madax-bannaan oo si degdeg ah u xaqiijisay sheegashada Iran. Hay’adda UK Maritime Trade Operations ayaa dhinaceeda sheegtay in markab marayay meel ka baxsan xeebaha Cumaan lagu dhuftay walax aan la aqoonsan. Markabka ayaa istaagay, balse shaqaalihii saarnaa dhammaantood way badbaadeen. Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka Marco Rubio ayaa sheegay in Washington ay sii wadi doonto weerarrada ka dhanka ah Iran inta ay Tehran faragelin ku hayso isu socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga. Rubio ayaa dhinaca kale sheegay in Mareykanku weli u furan yahay xal diblomaasiyadeed, halka afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran Esmaeil Baghaei uu sheegay in albaabka wada-hadalladu uusan si buuxda u xirmin. Dagaalka u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa dilay kumannaan qof, kuwaas oo intooda badan ku dhintay Iran iyo Lubnaan, iyadoo ku lug lahaanshaha Xuutiyiinta ay hadda sare u qaadayso khatarta ah in colaadda ay si buuxda ugu faafto Badda Cas iyo dalalka Khaliijka. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo cunaqabatayn iyo xayiraad dhanka badda ah ku soo rogay Sacuudiga
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa ku dhawaaqay go’aan ay maraakiibta Sacuudiga uga mamnuucayaan inay adeegsadaan Badda Cas iyo Bab El-Mandeb. Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa gelinkii dambe ee Isniintii ku dhawaaqay cunaqabatayn iyo xayiraad dhanka badda oo ka dhan ah Boqortooyada Sacuudiga. Afhayeenka ayaa sheegay in maraakiibta ku sii jeeda ama ka imanaya Dekedaha Sacuudiga aysan isticmaali karin Badda Cas iyo marin biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab El-Mandeb ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Go’aankan ayaa jawaab u ah weerar dhinaca cirka ah oo 13-kii bishan lagu qaaday Garoonka Diyaaradaha Sanca ee Yemen, xilli lagu waday in ay ka degato diyaarad ka timid dhinaca Iran. Xafiiska Siyaasadda Xuutiyiinta ayaa masuuliyadda weerarkaasi dusha kaga tuuray Sacuudiga, isla-markaana uu weli wado qorshihiisa uu ku xanibayo garoonkaasi. General Yahya Saree, Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta ayaa Isniintii eedeymahaasi ku xoojiyay in Sacuudigu uu xanibaad ku hayo dekedo ku yaaa Waqooyiga Yemen. Afhayeenka ayaa tallaabada lagu mamnuucay in maraakiibta Sacuudiga ay adeegsadaan Badda Cas iyo Bab El-Mandeb ku tilmaamay mid isla eg (caddaalad ku dhisan isu dheelitirnaan) oo dhaqan gelaysa isla markiiba. Afhayeenka ayaa sheegay in ciqaab kasta ay mabda’ ahaan leedahay wax u dhigma, oo aan ka darnayn ama ka fududayn dhibkii asalka ahaa. Badda Cas ayaa ahayd marinka keliya ee xilligan u furnaa maraakiibta shidaalka ka qaada Dekedaha Sacuudiga, marka aad eegto in Iran ay 12-kii bishan xirtay marin biyoodka Hormuz ee dhinaca kale ku yaala maalmo ka dib, markii ay dib u soo cusboonaatay xiisadda kala dhaxeysa Mareykanka. Guud ahaan shidaalka ka gudba Badda Cas iyo qaybta kale ee la sii marsiiyo Bab El-Mandeb ayaa muhiim u ah dhaqaalaha iyo tamarta adduunka, maadaama uu soo gaabiyo waqtiga safarka maraakiibta ee u dhaxeeya Qaaradaha Aasiya (Asia) iyo Yurub.

items.title: Maxaa ka cusub dagaalkii ciidamada PSF ee taabacsan DF iyo kuwa Puntland?
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Dagaal culus oo galabnimadii maanta ilaa fiidkii caawa deegaanka Laag ee gobolka Bari ku dhexmaray ciidamada Daraawiishta Puntland iyo ciidanka sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee PSF, ee taabacsan dowladda federaalka, ayaa istaagay, waxaana hadda degan xaaladda goobihii lagu dagaallamay. Wararka laga helayo deegaanka Laag, oo ku yaalla koonfurta magaalada Boosaaso, ayaa sheegaya in labada dhinac ay joojiyeen rasaastii ay is-weydaarsanayeen, inkasta oo ciidamo ka kala tirsan labada dhinac ay weli ku sugan yihiin deegaannada ku dhow goobihii lagu dagaallamay. Iska hor-imaadka ayaa billowday kadib markii ciidamada PSF oo ka baxay magaalada Boosaaso, kuna sii jeeday dhinaca degmada Xaafuun, lagu hakiyay buundo ku dhow deegaanka Laag. Ciidamada Daraawiishta Puntland ayaa la sheegay inay PSF ka dalbadeen inay dib ugu laabtaan Boosaaso, isla markaana aysan sii wadan karin safarkooda iyaga oo aan fasax ka haysan taliska ciidamada Puntland. Arrintaas ayaa dhalisay ismari-waa iyo hadallo kulul oo dhexmaray saraakiisha labada ciidan, kahor inta aysan xaaladdu isu beddelin iska hor-imaad hubeysan. Rasaasta ay labada dhinac is-weydaarsadeen ayaa hakad gelisay isu socodkii gaadiidka ee waddada xiriirisa Boosaaso iyo deegaannada dhaca xeebaha gobolka Bari, waxaana dadka deegaanka soo wajahay cabsi iyo walaac xooggan. Ilo deegaanka ku sugan ayaa sheegay in dagaalku uu socday si goos-goos ah laga soo billaabo galabnimadii ilaa fiidkii, iyadoo labada ciidan ay isku hor fadhiyeen goobo aan sidaas isugu fogeyn. Ilaa hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay maamulka Puntland ama taliska PSF oo lagu xaqiijinayo khasaaraha ka dhashay dagaalka. Wararka hordhaca ahna ma caddeynayaan inay jiraan dhimasho ama dhaawacyo soo gaaray ciidamada iyo dadka rayidka ah. Wada-hadallo lagu joojiyay dagaalka Saraakiil ka kala tirsan Taliska Daraawiishta Puntland iyo PSF ayaa intii ay xiisaddu socotay yeeshay wada-hadallo degdeg ah oo looga gol lahaa in lagu joojiyo dagaalka, lagana hortago inuu ku faafo deegaanno kale oo ka tirsan gobolka Bari. Warar hore ayaa sheegay in wada-hadallada lagu gaaray is-afgarad dhigaya in ciidamadii PSF ay dib ugu laabtaan magaalada Boosaaso, si xaaladda loo dejiyo loona soo celiyo isu socodka gaadiidka. Hase yeeshee, xiisadda ayaa markii dambe mar kale cirka isku shareertay, waxaana labada ciidan dhexmaray dagaal xooggan oo socday ilaa fiidkii, kahor inta aysan xabbad-joojin ka dhaqan-gelin goobihii lagu dagaallamay. Xaaladda deegaanka Laag ayaa caawa deggan, waxaana dib u billowday dhaqdhaqaaqa gaadiidka qaarkood, inkasta oo dadka deegaanka ay weli ka walaacsan yihiin suurtagalnimada in xiisaddu mar kale soo laba-kacleyn karto. Xiisadda u dhexeysa Puntland iyo PSF ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli maamulka Puntland uu soo saaray amar dhigaya inaysan deegaannadiisa ka howlgeli karin ciidamo aan hoos imaan taliskiisa ama aan amar ka qaadan hay’adaha amniga maamulka. Puntland ayaa ku eedeyneysa PSF inay xilligan xiriir toos ah la leedahay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isla markaana ay ka baxday nidaamka taliska ciidamada maamulka. Toddobaadyadii ugu dambeeyay waxaa gobollada Nugaal, Bari iyo Mudug laga soo sheegayay dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan iyo xiisado la xiriira ciidamo la sheegay inay daacad u yihiin Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo fariisimo ka sameysanayay qaybo ka mid ah deegaannada Puntland. Maamulka Puntland ayaa ka digay in ciidamo aysan iyadu maamulin laga dhex abaabulo deegaannadeeda, halka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya aysan si rasmi ah uga hadlin eedeymaha kasoo baxaya Puntland. Dhanka kale, Taliyaha Qaybta 54-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Jimcaale Jaamac Takar, oo dhowaan dowladda federaalka u magacowday inuu hoggaamiyo ciidamada ku sugan deegaannada Puntland, ayaa gaaray taliska ciidankiisa oo ku yaalla duleedka magaalada Garoowe. Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in Madaxweyne Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni iyo Taliye Jimcaale ay yeesheen wada-hadallo ku saabsan joogitaanka iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidamada uu hoggaamiyo, balse aan weli laga gaarin heshiis rasmi ah. Khilaafka PSF iyo Puntland PSF waa ciidan si gaar ah loogu tababaray hawlgallada la-dagaallanka argagixisada, sirdoonka iyo fulinta hawlgallada gaarka ah. Ciidankan waxaa markii hore dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, tababarka iyo qalabka ka taageeri jiray hay’ado iyo shirkado amni oo xiriir la leh Mareykanka. Hase yeeshee, kadib doorashadii madaxtinnimada Puntland ee 2019, oo uu ku guuleystay Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni, waxaa cirka isku shareeray khilaafka u dhexeeya madaxtooyada Puntland iyo hoggaanka PSF. Ciidanka ayaa noqday laan aan si buuxda uga amar qaadan maamulka Madaxweyne Deni, waxaana dhinacyada marar kala duwan ku dhexmaray iska hor-imaadyo hubeysan oo ka dhacay Boosaaso iyo deegaanno kale oo ka tirsan gobolka Bari. Dagaalka maanta ka dhacay deegaanka Laag ayaa muujinaya in khilaafkii hore u dhexeeyay Puntland iyo PSF uusan weli xal rasmi ah helin, isla markaana muranka ku saabsan cidda maamuleysa ciidamada ka howlgala deegaannada Puntland uu mar kale isu beddeli karo isku dhac hubeysan. items.title: Sanbaloolshe: Go’aanka kala go’a Soomaaliya wuxuu yaalla…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Agaasimihii hore ee NISA ahna xildhibaan ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullaahi Maxamed Cali (Sanbaloolshe) ayaa sheegay in mustaqbalka midnimada ama kala go’a Soomaaliya uusan ku xirnayn aqoonsi ay bixiso hal dowlad. Sanbaloolshe oo ka hadlay arrinta Somaliland ayaa sheegay in ka go’aan gaaristeeda uu ku xiran yahay wada-hadal u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Hargeysa, iyo sidoo kale mowqifyada ururrada gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Sanbaloolshe ayaa hadalkan ka jeediyay dood lagu qabtay barta X Space, halkaas oo uu kaga hadlay arrimaha la xiriira mustaqbalka Soomaaliya iyo doodaha ku saabsan aqoonsiga Somaliland, isagoo sheegay in go’aannada la xiriira arrintan aysan ku xirnayn hal dal oo keliya, balse ay saameyn ku leeyihiin hay’adaha iyo ururrada caalamiga ah. Xildhibaanka ayaa xusay in suurtagalnimada aqoonsiga Somaliland ay si weyn ugu xiran tahay mowqifyada Midowga Afrika, Jaamacadda Carabta iyo Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Sida uu sheegay, hay’adahaasi ayaa leh kaalinta ugu weyn ee go’aaminta arrimaha la xiriira aqoonsiga dowladeed iyo isbeddellada waaweyn ee siyaasadeed. Sanbaloolshe ayaa sheegay in haddii hal dal, sida Boqortooyada Midowday (UK) uu aqoonsado Somaliland aysan taasi kaligeed si weyn u beddeli doonin xaaladda siyaasadeed ee jirta. Wuxuu ku dooday in aqoonsi caalami ah aanu ku imaan karin tallaabooyin ay qaadaan dalal kooban oo keliya. Isagoo dib u milicsanayay taariikhda, Sanbaloolshe ayaa xasuusiyay midowgii labada gobol ee Soomaaliya sanadkii 1960-kii ayaa sheegay in waqooyigu uu xilligaas si shuruud la’aan ah ula midoobay koonfurta, ujeeddaduna ay ahayd xaqiijinta himiladii Soomaaliweyn iyo mideynta dhulka Soomaaliyeed. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in, sida uu qabo, aan muran sharci laga gelin karin heshiiskii midowga ee xilligaas dhacay. Si kastaba, wuxuu tilmaamay in duruufaha siyaasadeed ee hadda jira ay fureen suurtagalnimada in dib looga wada hadlo xiriirka u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Hargeysa. Sanbaloolshe ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in haddii la doonayo in la sii wada joogo ama la kala tago ay lagama maarmaan u tahay in labada dhinac ay arrinta ku gaaraan heshiis iyo is-afgarad. Wuxuu sheegay in xal waara oo la aqbali karo uu ku imaan karo oo keliya wada-hadal, is-qancin iyo is-ixtiraam u dhexeeya labada dhinac. Hadalka Sanbaloolshe ayaa ku soo aadaya xilli ay meel sare mareyso xiisadda u dhaxeysa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland, oo ku doodda inay tahay dal madax-bannaan. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kadib markii maamulka Somaliland uu xiriir la sameeyay Israa’iil, oo ayadu sheegtay inay aqoonsatay Somaliland. The post Sanbaloolshe: Go’aanka kala go’a Soomaaliya wuxuu yaalla… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia: Fierce fighting erupts in Bosaso as Puntland forces clash with PSF troops
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Fierce fighting erupted in Bosaso on Monday between Puntland Darwish forces and Puntland Security Force (PSF) troops loyal to Somalia’s federal government, marking the sharpest escalation yet in weeks of mounting tensions that observers have feared could spiral into a broader conflict . The clashes broke out in the Laag area of Bosaso district, where the rival forces had maintained a tense standoff in opposing positions for hours before exchanging heavy weapons, according to Daily Somalia. The fighting brought traffic to a halt along the route connecting Bosaso with other parts of Somalia, disrupting the movement of vehicles through one of Puntland’s key transport corridors. There was no immediate information on casualties. Monday’s confrontation followed weeks of worsening political and security tensions between Puntland and Somalia’s federal government. Somalia’s Defense Minister Ahmed Moalim Fiqi recently said that the PSF troops involved in the fighting are part of the Somali federal government forces. Puntland authorities recently banned the federal government from recruiting new troops in the region and prohibited allied forces from moving between major cities, measures that heightened concerns over the growing risk of armed confrontation. The standoff further intensified after Puntland authorities blocked Gen. Jimale Takar , who was appointed by the federal government as commander of the Somali National Army sector covering the northern regions, from entering Puntland after traveling to Mogadishu for talks with the federal leadership. The latest fighting underscores the deepening security rift between Puntland and Mogadishu, with recent developments fueling fears that the dispute could escalate further if tensions remain unresolved. Somalia’s Defense Minister Ahmed Moalim Fiqi recently said that the PSF troops involved in the fighting are part of the Somali federal government forces. Puntland authorities recently banned the federal government from recruiting new troops in the region and prohibited allied forces from moving between major cities, measures that heightened concerns over the growing risk of armed confrontation. The standoff further intensified after Puntland authorities blocked Gen. Jimale Takar , who was appointed by the federal government as commander of the Somali National Army sector covering the northern regions, from entering Puntland after traveling to Mogadishu for talks with the federal leadership. The latest fighting underscores the deepening security rift between Puntland and Mogadishu, with recent developments fueling fears that the dispute could escalate further if tensions remain unresolved. items.title: Horjooge sare oo ka tirsanaa golaha shuurada Al-Shabaab oo la dilay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa shaacisay in hawl-gal qorsheysan oo ay si wadajir ah u fuliyeen Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA), ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo saaxiibbada caalamiga ah lagu dilay horjooge sare oo ka tirsanaa Golaha Shuurada kooxda Al-Shabaab, laguna magacaabi jiray Macalin Jinaaw Ibraahim. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo shir jaraa’id ku qabtay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa sheegay in hawl-galkaasi uu dhacay 5-tii Luulyo 2026, kadib baaritaan iyo daba-gal sirdoon oo socday muddo 14 bilood ah. Wasiirka ayaa xusay in hawl-galku uu ahaa mid si taxaddar leh loo qorsheeyay kadib markii la xaqiijiyay dhaq-dhaqaaqa horjoogaha. Duqeynta lagu dilay Macalin Jinaaw ayaa ka dhacday deegaanka Sabiyo oo u dhexeeya degmooyinka Afgooye iyo Basra ee gobolka Shabeellada Hoose. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in horjoogaha lagu bartilmaameedsaday isaga oo ku sugnaa cariish ku dhex taalla beer, halkaas oo ay ilaalinayeen maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Fiqi ayaa sheegay in Macalin Jinaaw uu ka mid ahaa aas-aasayaashii Al-Shabaab, isla markaana uu ahaa xubinta sagaalaad ee Golaha Shuurada kooxda. Sida uu sheegay, wuxuu door weyn ku lahaa dejinta istaraatiijiyadda iyo hagidda howlaha kooxda. Wasiirka ayaa intaas ku daray in Macalin Jinaaw uu mas’uul ka ahaa hoggaaminta jabhadaha dagaallama, ururinta lacago baad ah oo shacabka laga qaado iyo abaabulka weerarrada Al-Shabaab. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay inuu ahaa la-taliye sare oo aad ugu dhow hoggaamiyaha Al-Shabaab, Axmed Diiriye (Abuu Cubeyda). Sidoo kale, Wasiir Fiqi ayaa ku eedeeyay horjoogaha la dilay inuu mas’uul ka ahaa falal amni-darro oo ka dhacay gobollada Bay, Bakool, Hiiraan iyo Galgaduud, kuwaas oo ay kamid ahaayeen dilal qorsheysan, askareyn qasab ah oo carruurta lagu sameyn jiray, hub ka ururin lagu hayay beelaha iyo cabburinta waxgaradka deegaannadaas. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay si rasmi ah u xaqiijisay geerida Macalin Jinaaw, kaddib markii la helay xog sirdoon oo caddeysay inuu ku dhintay duqeynta. Wuxuu tilmaamay in tani ay qeyb ka tahay howl-gallada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo hoggaanka sare ee Al-Shabaab. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in sannadihii u dambeeyay ciidamada dowladda iyo saaxiibbadooda caalamiga ah ay dileen tiro ka mid ah madaxda sare ee Al-Shabaab, isagoo xusay in howl-gallada noocan oo kale ah ay sii socon doonaan ilaa laga wiiqo awoodda hoggaanka kooxda. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in Dowladda Federaalka ay ka go’an tahay sii wadidda dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, isla markaana aysan joogsan doonin howlgalada lagu baacsanayo horjoogeyaasha kooxda meel kasta oo ay ku sugan yihiin. Ugu dambeyntiina, wasiirka ayaa hambalyo u diray ciidanka xoogga dalka iyo hay’adaha amniga doorkii ay ka qaateen howl-galka, isagoo sidoo kale uga mahadceliyay saaxiibbada caalamiga ah taageerada ay siiyaan Soomaaliya ee la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab. The post Horjooge sare oo ka tirsanaa golaha shuurada Al-Shabaab oo la dilay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Middle East Wars: Why America, Israel, and the Gulf States May Be the Real Losers
items.description: By Dayib Sh Ahmed For generations, strategists have argued that geography shapes power. Yet geography can also become a trap. The latest confrontation over the Strait of Hormuz illustrates a sobering reality military superiority does not automatically translate into strategic success. Despite claims that Washington has outmaneuvered Tehran, the emerging landscape suggests that the United States, Israel, and America’s Arab partners may ultimately bear some of the heaviest costs of prolonged instability. The closure of the Strait of Hormuz for nearly four months or even the sustained threat of such a disruption would expose a fundamental weakness in the regional security architecture that the United States has spent decades building. Such a prolonged crisis would send shockwaves through global energy markets, increase shipping costs, raise insurance premiums, and intensify economic uncertainty. The Gulf monarchies, whose economies depend on the free flow of energy exports and maritime commerce, would bear some of the earliest and most severe consequences. The risks extend beyond economics. The Gulf states rely heavily on desalination to provide fresh water for their populations. In 2026, desalination provides approximately 90% of drinking water supplies in Kuwait and Bahrain, nearly 99% in Qatar, around 70% in Saudi Arabia, 42% in the United Arab Emirates, and about 86% in Oman. If Iran were able to damage or disrupt the region’s desalination infrastructure, including dozens of major facilities, the result could become a humanitarian crisis affecting millions of people. Similarly, if U.S. or Iranian attacks target essential civilian infrastructure, they raise serious questions under international humanitarian law. Former war crimes prosecutor Reed Brody explains that the targeting of civilian infrastructure, including desalination plants, can constitute a serious violation of international humanitarian law. The strategic importance of the Strait of Hormuz extends far beyond the Gulf itself. Around 20% of the world’s oil supply and roughly 25% of global maritime oil trade pass through this narrow waterway, representing approximately 20 million barrels of crude oil and petroleum products every day. Any prolonged disruption would immediately affect global energy markets. The crisis could also threaten another critical chokepoint: the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, where an estimated 5% to 12% of the world’s seaborne-traded oil passes depending on geopolitical conditions and alternative pipeline routes. This strategic passage handles approximately 4 to 4.2 million barrels of crude oil and petroleum products daily. Together, these chokepoints demonstrate how regional conflicts can quickly become global economic crises. This demonstrates that modern conflicts are no longer measured only by military strikes, they are also defined by the ability to disrupt critical civilian systems. Furthermore, according to The Washington Post , Iran’s strikes against U.S. military assets in the Middle East have caused significantly more damage than previously acknowledged. A satellite imagery analysis by the newspaper found that Iranian airstrikes damaged or destroyed at least 228 structures and pieces of equipment at American military facilities since the beginning of the conflict, including aircraft hangars, barracks, fuel depots, radar systems, communications infrastructure, and air defense equipment. The scale of the destruction appears to be substantially greater than what the U.S. government has publicly disclosed. The attacks also affected the operational posture of American forces in the region. The threat of continued Iranian strikes forced some U.S. bases to reduce staffing levels, while commanders relocated many personnel away from vulnerable locations early in the conflict. The episode demonstrates a broader strategic reality: even the world’s most advanced military power remains vulnerable to sustained asymmetric attacks against critical infrastructure and forward-deployed forces. For Israel, prolonged regional confrontation carries its own strategic costs. While its military deterrence remains formidable, recurring conflicts consume resources, discourage investment, and increase the risk of wider regional escalation. Security achieved through continuous confrontation is expensive and difficult to sustain over the long term. As The New York Times columnist Thomas L. Friedman argued, Israel’s current approach reflects a strategy centered on overwhelming immediate threats through military force but lacking a clear pathway toward long-term political outcomes. Friedman wrote that Netanyahu’s strategy could be described as: “Meet every threat around you by smashing it with a sledgehammer, no matter how many enemies of Israel it makes, and offer no creative ideas for translating military achievements into lasting strategic gains not in Gaza, Lebanon, Syria and the West Bank or with Saudi Arabia and Iran.” Similarly, Rahm Emanuel, former White House Chief of Staff to President Barack Obama, criticized Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s policies during a speech at Tel Aviv University, warning of the consequences of diplomatic isolation. Referencing a saying from his grandmother, Emanuel stated “You lost America, you lost Europe, and you picked up Somaliland Such a deal.” Although Somaliland is part of the Federal Republic of Somalia, these criticisms reflect a broader strategic debate. Israel is also widely accused of being an apartheid state and a pariah state. Human rights organizations and many legal scholars have concluded that Israel has committed war crimes and crimes against humanity in Gaza Palestine. A similar challenge confronts the United States, which faces diminishing returns from its expanding commitments in the Middle East. Maintaining naval dominance, protecting critical energy infrastructure, supporting regional allies, and deterring multiple adversaries require enormous financial and military resources. Like Britain’s experience during the Suez Crisis, prolonged entanglements can expose the limits of even the most powerful states. Sir Anthony Eden resigned as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom on January 9, 1957, following the political fallout from the Suez Crisis, a setback compounded by his declining health. If current trends continue, President Donald Trump’s expanding war in the Middle East may ultimately be remembered as a strategic overreach rather than a lasting success. History suggests that military and political commitments that continually expand without delivering clear strategic gains often impose mounting economic, diplomatic, and political costs. Whether this becomes Trump’s “Suez moment” will depend on future events, but the risk of strategic failure is substantial. At a time when Washington seeks to compete globally, every additional commitment in the Middle East stretches its strategic bandwidth. History suggests that even the greatest powers can become overextended when they underestimate determined regional rivals. As Iran’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson argued in a post on X, the Roman worldview regarded Rome as the unquestioned center of civilization. Yet the Persians challenged that assumption. When Emperor Marcus Julius Philippus (Philip the Arab) marched east against Persia, the campaign failed to secure a Roman triumph. Instead, peace was concluded on Sasanian terms, forcing the emperor to accept humiliating concessions. Contemporary assessments reinforce the enduring importance of military deterrence. Indeed, according to The New York Times , U.S. intelligence assessments indicate that Iran retains substantial missile capabilities despite recent military exchanges, suggesting that its missile arsenal remains a significant factor in any future confrontation. These strategic realities extend well beyond Washington and Tehran. The Gulf states confront an equally difficult equation. They seek stability to attract investment, diversify their economies, and transition beyond oil dependence. Yet persistent geopolitical tensions force them to devote greater resources to defense while increasing uncertainty for international markets. As regional instability becomes the norm rather than the exception, their economic transformation becomes increasingly difficult. Ultimately, perhaps the greatest misconception in international politics is the belief that geopolitical competition produces clear winners. History teaches a more sobering lesson: major-power conflicts often leave all sides weakened. The First World War did not produce a true victor in strategic terms; instead, it devastated Europe’s strongest empires, destroyed generations of lives, and created the conditions for future instability. The Iraq War’s Greatest Lesson: Winning Battles Is Not the Same as Winning Wars. The Iraq War reshaped the Middle East, but it also imposed immense costs on both Iraq and the United States. It demonstrated a recurring truth of international conflict: strategic competition rarely produces clean victories. Instead, wars often create consequences that exceed the original expectations of those who initiate them. Iran’s ability to create uncertainty in the region without sustaining a prolonged conventional blockade illustrates another enduring lesson of modern warfare: asymmetric power remains a powerful strategic instrument. The true measure of strategic success is not simply who possesses the largest military, fires the most missiles, or commands the most advanced weapons systems. The decisive question is who can impose sustained political, economic, and psychological costs on an opponent over time. As General David Petraeus and historian Andrew Roberts argue in their book Conflict: The Evolution of Warfare from 1945 to Ukraine , they write, “Technology and firepower alone cannot guarantee victory. The nature of war has evolved, but the fundamental challenge remains the same: military operations must ultimately serve political objectives.” The Iraq War became the most costly, American conflict since Vietnam. The Bush administration entered Iraq for multiple reasons, but one of its central justifications the alleged existence of weapons of mass destruction proved to be based on flawed intelligence. Similarly, today there is a danger that policymakers may once again underestimate the long-term consequences of military intervention. While the initial military campaign successfully defeated the Iraqi armed forces and removed Saddam Hussein from power, the conflict did not end with the fall of Baghdad. Instead, a prolonged insurgency emerged, and competing sectarian and political factions fought for power, influence, and resources. The central lesson from Iraq is not that military force is ineffective, but that military success without a realistic political strategy is incomplete. As Carl von Clausewitz wrote in On War , war is ultimately a continuation of politics by other means. The political foundations of war matter more than the brilliance of battlefield operations alone. The United States invested enormous effort in designing a plan to defeat Saddam Hussein’s military, but far less attention was devoted to the difficult task that followed, rebuilding a state after the collapse of its institutions. Removing a government is often easier than creating a legitimate replacement. “They further argued that.” furthermore, Winston Churchill, reflecting on the First World War, warned that leaders must never underestimate the complexity and consequences of war. The same mistake occurred in Iraq. American policymakers assumed that Iraqi society would quickly embrace the coalition’s presence and that stabilization would be relatively straightforward. When those assumptions proved false, it took years to adjust strategy, resources, and doctrine. The Iraq experience also challenged the idea that advanced technology could eliminate the uncertainty of war. After the Cold War, many military thinkers promoted the concept of a “revolution in military affairs,” emphasizing precision weapons, intelligence networks, and advanced surveillance systems. These capabilities transformed conventional warfare, but they could not replace the human requirements of stabilization and counterinsurgency. The lesson from Iraq was clear “shock and awe” can defeat an army, but it cannot build a nation. High-tech weapons can destroy targets, but they cannot create political legitimacy, secure communities, or resolve social divisions. Stability ultimately required large numbers of personnel working alongside, forces, local leaders, and tribal partners. Counterinsurgency demonstrated an old truth of warfare, numbers matter, but strategy matters even more. Security for the population must come first, because without security, reconstruction, governance, and political reconciliation cannot succeed. The broader lesson extends beyond middle East. Whether examining Iran’s regional strategy, Russia’s war in Ukraine, or great-power competition between the United States and China, modern conflicts are not decided only by weapons. They are contests of endurance, legitimacy, alliances, economics, and political will. The nations that understand this reality will shape powers has repeatedly created dangerous. As Graham Allison argues in his book Destined for War , the rivalry between rising and established powers has repeatedly created dangerous moments throughout history. Drawing from Thucydides’ analysis of the Peloponnesian War, Allison suggests that when a rising power threatens to displace an existing dominant power, the resulting fear and insecurity can make conflict more likely. He argues that this pattern has appeared throughout history, creating what he calls the “Thucydides Trap. and He wrote “There is nothing new under the sun except nuclear weapons.” While the twenty-first century appears fundamentally different because of globalization, economic interdependence, digital communication, climate challenges, and transnational threats, history warns against assuming that humanity has escaped its old patterns. As economists Carmen Reinhart and Kenneth Rogoff demonstrate through their study of hundreds of financial crises across centuries, societies repeatedly convince themselves that their circumstances are unique until history proves otherwise. This same illusion existed before World War I. Norman Angell’s famous book The Great Illusion convinced millions that economic ties among nations had made major war irrational and impossible. Many believed that modern commerce had created a world where conflict between industrial powers no longer made sense. Yet in 1914, Europe entered one of the most destructive wars in human history. The critical difference between the past and the present, however, is the existence of nuclear weapons. For the first time, humanity possesses the ability to destroy itself on a scale unimaginable to previous generations. After the United States dropped atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, Albert Einstein warned that nuclear weapons had changed the nature of human conflict forever. The challenge of the modern age is therefore not only managing rivalry between great powers, but ensuring that competition does not cross the threshold into catastrophe. The lesson of history is clear, technological progress does not automatically produce political wisdom. Human nature, ambition, fear, and miscalculation remain powerful forces. The question facing the twenty-first century is whether nations can learn from the tragedies of the past before repeating them on a far more dangerous scale. the future. Those that believe technology alone can substitute for strategy may discover, as history repeatedly shows, that winning the first battle is often the easiest part of war. Dayib Sh. The United States invested enormous effort in designing a plan to defeat Saddam Hussein’s military, but far less attention was devoted to the difficult task that followed, rebuilding a state after the collapse of its institutions. Removing a government is often easier than creating a legitimate replacement. “They further argued that.” furthermore, Winston Churchill, reflecting on the First World War, warned that leaders must never underestimate the complexity and consequences of war. The same mistake occurred in Iraq. American policymakers assumed that Iraqi society would quickly embrace the coalition’s presence and that stabilization would be relatively straightforward. When those assumptions proved false, it took years to adjust strategy, resources, and doctrine. The Iraq experience also challenged the idea that advanced technology could eliminate the uncertainty of war. After the Cold War, many military thinkers promoted the concept of a “revolution in military affairs,” emphasizing precision weapons, intelligence networks, and advanced surveillance systems. These capabilities transformed conventional warfare, but they could not replace the human requirements of stabilization and counterinsurgency. The lesson from Iraq was clear “shock and awe” can defeat an army, but it cannot build a nation. High-tech weapons can destroy targets, but they cannot create political legitimacy, secure communities, or resolve social divisions. Stability ultimately required large numbers of personnel working alongside, forces, local leaders, and tribal partners. Counterinsurgency demonstrated an old truth of warfare, numbers matter, but strategy matters even more. Security for the population must come first, because without security, reconstruction, governance, and political reconciliation cannot succeed. The broader lesson extends beyond middle East. Whether examining Iran’s regional strategy, Russia’s war in Ukraine, or great-power competition between the United States and China, modern conflicts are not decided only by weapons. They are contests of endurance, legitimacy, alliances, economics, and political will. The nations that understand this reality will shape powers has repeatedly created dangerous. As Graham Allison argues in his book Destined for War , the rivalry between rising and established powers has repeatedly created dangerous moments throughout history. Drawing from Thucydides’ analysis of the Peloponnesian War, Allison suggests that when a rising power threatens to displace an existing dominant power, the resulting fear and insecurity can make conflict more likely. He argues that this pattern has appeared throughout history, creating what he calls the “Thucydides Trap. and He wrote “There is nothing new under the sun except nuclear weapons.” While the twenty-first century appears fundamentally different because of globalization, economic interdependence, digital communication, climate challenges, and transnational threats, history warns against assuming that humanity has escaped its old patterns. As economists Carmen Reinhart and Kenneth Rogoff demonstrate through their study of hundreds of financial crises across centuries, societies repeatedly convince themselves that their circumstances are unique until history proves otherwise. This same illusion existed before World War I. Norman Angell’s famous book The Great Illusion convinced millions that economic ties among nations had made major war irrational and impossible. Many believed that modern commerce had created a world where conflict between industrial powers no longer made sense. Yet in 1914, Europe entered one of the most destructive wars in human history. The critical difference between the past and the present, however, is the existence of nuclear weapons. For the first time, humanity possesses the ability to destroy itself on a scale unimaginable to previous generations. After the United States dropped atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, Albert Einstein warned that nuclear weapons had changed the nature of human conflict forever. The challenge of the modern age is therefore not only managing rivalry between great powers, but ensuring that competition does not cross the threshold into catastrophe. The lesson of history is clear, technological progress does not automatically produce political wisdom. Human nature, ambition, fear, and miscalculation remain powerful forces. The question facing the twenty-first century is whether nations can learn from the tragedies of the past before repeating them on a far more dangerous scale. the future. Those that believe technology alone can substitute for strategy may discover, as history repeatedly shows, that winning the first battle is often the easiest part of war. Dayib Sh. items.title: Former North Eastern State MP Fahiima Quuje Receives Warm Welcome in Hargeisa
items.description: Hargeisa (WDN) – Former North Eastern State parliamentarian Fahiima Yusuf Abdillahi (Quuje) arrived in Hargeisa on Monday morning to a high-profile reception after publicly renouncing her long-held support for the concept of a united Greater Somalia and reaffirming her allegiance to Somaliland. Quuje was greeted at Egal International Airport by senior Somaliland officials, traditional leaders, and hundreds of supporters in what quickly became one of the most closely watched political arrivals in recent months. Among those welcoming her were Somaliland’s Minister of Interior and the Speaker of the House of Representatives, underscoring the political significance attached to her return. Her arrival comes only days after she announced her resignation from the parliament of the North Eastern administration, declaring that she was abandoning her previous political beliefs and embracing what she described as Somaliland’s national cause. Quuje had been in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, since leaving Las Anod, the flashpoint city at the center of the conflict that erupted in 2023 between Somaliland forces and local SSC-Khaatumo fighters. She flew from Addis Ababa to Hargeisa on Sunday, where supporters organized an enthusiastic reception. A well-known political figure and influential social media personality, she rose to prominence during the Las Anod conflict as one of the most vocal supporters of the SSC movement that challenged Somaliland’s control over the city. Her activism and public commentary earned her a substantial following and made her one of the movement’s most recognizable political voices. Her decision to return to Somaliland therefore marks a dramatic and unexpected political turnaround. The move is likely to reverberate across the political landscape, given Quuje’s previous prominence in the campaign that culminated in Somaliland’s withdrawal from Las Anod. Quuje’s reversal has already ignited intense debate across social media and among political observers. Supporters portray the decision as a pragmatic reassessment of the country’s evolving political realities, while critics regard it as a significant setback for the movement she once passionately championed. Others argue that the move reflects a lack of political principle, contending that personal ambition, self-interest, and the pursuit of prominence ultimately outweighed her previously stated ideals. Neither the SSC-Khaatumo leadership nor officials from the North Eastern administration have yet issued an official response to Quuje’s return or her decision to realign herself with Somaliland. As political reactions continue to unfold, Quuje’s homecoming is expected to remain a major talking point, highlighting the fluid and often unpredictable nature of politics in the Horn of Africa, where shifting loyalties and evolving alliances continue to reshape the region’s political landscape. items.title: Rodri oo ku guulaystay abaalmarinta Golden Ball ee Koobka Adduunka 2026
items.description: Kabtanka xulka qaranka Spain, Rodri, ayaa loo caleemo saaray ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican Koobka Adduunka 2026, isagoo ku guulaystay abaalmarinta Golden Ball kadib markii uu Spain ku hoggaamiyay guushii 1-0 ee ay ka gaareen Argentina ee finalka tartanka . Guulani waxay si weyn u muhiim u tahay sababtoo ah Rodri waxa uu ku soo laabtay heer sare kadib dhaawac culus oo ACL ah oo soo gaaray bishii Sebtembar 2024. Waxa uu noqday ciyaaryahanki 4aad ee taariikhda ku guulaysta Koobka Adduunka, Horyaalka Yurub (Euros), Champions League, iyo Ballon d’Or, isagoo ku biiray halyeeyada Franz Beckenbauer, Gerd Muller, iyo Zinedine Zidane . Rodri, oo 30 jir ah, waxa uu ciyaaray dhammaan sideedii kulan ee Spain intii tartanku socday, isagoo dhammeeyay 756 kudhis oo sax ah oo ah tirada ugu badan ee taariikhda Koobka Adduunka laga diiwaangeliyay tan iyo 1966 . Wuxuu kaloo dhammeeyay 122 kudhis oo khadka difaaca jebiyay, kaas oo ah tirada ugu badan tan iyo Xabi Alonso 2010 . Kadib markii lagu dhawaaqay inuu ku guulaystay, Rodri ayaa muujiyay farxaddiisa, isagoo yiri: “Weli waan yara naxsanahay. Guushan waa mid aan si dhab ah u qiyaasi karin” . Wuxuu kaloo sheegay inuu rabo inuu dhalinyarada u noqdo tusaale: “Waxaan rabaa in jiilalka soo socda ay arkaan tusaale ahaan fursad… markaad hoos u dhacdo, waad soo kici kartaa mar kale” . Kaabtanka Spain ayaa sidoo kale hore ugu guulaystay abaalmarinta Ballon d’Or 2024, waxaanu tartankan ku soo laabtay kadib markii uu ka soo kabtay dhaawacii ACL . Wuxuu dhammeeyay finalka isagoo 101 kudhis ka dhammeeyay 105, wuxuuna ku guulaystay 80% duullannadiisii . The post Rodri oo ku guulaystay abaalmarinta Golden Ball ee Koobka Adduunka 2026 first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo markii ugu horeysay ku guuleysatay inay soo saarto…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa galabta ka qeyb-galay munaasabadda qalin-jabinta Dufcaddii Koowaad ee heerka Master-ka ee Dacwadda iyo Garsoorka, kuwaas oo noqday ardaydii ugu horreysay ee ka qalin-jabisa Machadka Sare ee Arrimaha Dacwadda iyo Daraasaadka Islaamka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa hambalyo u diray dhammaan ardayda qalin-jabisay, isagoo ku bogaadiyay dadaalka, kartida iyo dulqaadka ay ku gaareen heerkan sare ee waxbarashada, isla markaana ku boorriyay inay aqoontooda u adeegsadaan ilaalinta caddaaladda, ku dhaqanka sharciga iyo u adeegidda bulshada Soomaaliyeed si daacadnimo iyo hufnaan leh. Mudane Xamza ayaa sheegay in dadka bartay culuumta Islaamka ay yihiin kuwa laf-dhabarta u ah ilaalinta caqiidada saxda ah iyo Sunnada Nabiga (NNKH), isla markaana ay door weyn ku leeyihiin hagidda bulshada. “Aqoonyahanka bartay dacwadda waxa ay rajo u yihiin ummadda Islaamka ah, waxa ay albaab u furaan kuwa quustay, waxa ayna ilaaliyaan midnimada ummadda. Doorarkaas muhiimka ah ayay culimada Soomaaliyeed u taagan yihiin,” ayuu yiri ra’iisul wasaaraha. Sidoo kale, ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa sheegay in xukuumadda Dan-Qaran ay dejisay siyaasad qaran oo lagu nidaaminayo barashada culuumta shareecada, taas oo lagu salaynayo caqiidada saxda ah, isla markaana lagu mideeyay dugsiyada lagu barto cilmiga dacwadda. Dhanka kale, ra’iisul wasaare Xamza ayaa bogaadiyay wada-hadallada u socda dowladda iyo saamileyda siyaasadda, isagoo sheegay inay muhiim u yihiin xasilloonida, horumarka qaranka iyo danaha shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Ugu dambeyntiina wuxuu ugu baaqay dhammaan dhinacyada siyaasadda inay dowladda ku garab istaagaan dadaallada lagu ciribtirayo argagixisada iyo xoojinta midnimada qaranka, si loo xaqiijiyo nabad waarta iyo dowladnimo adag. items.title: Shakira oo bandhig cajiib ah ka dhigtay finalka Koobka Adduunka 2026
items.description: Fannaanadda caanka ah ee Shakira ayaa bandhig heer sare ah ku qabatay intii lagu jiray nasashada dhexe ee ciyaarta finalka Koobka Adduunka 2026, iyadoo ku soo bandhigtay heesta rasmiga ah ee tartanka “Dai Dai”. Waxaa garab taagnaa fanaanka reer Nigeria Burna Boy iyo koox qoob-ka-ciyaar caan ah, iyadoo bandhiggu uu socday 27 daqiiqo oo ay ka qayb qaateen fanaaniin caan ah sida Madonna iyo Justin Bieber . Bandhiggan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu noqday mid ka mid ah bandhigyadii ugu saamaynta badnaa ee taariikhda Koobka Adduunka, isagoo soo jiitay dadweyne ballaaran oo ka kooban malaayiin daawadayaal oo dunida oo dhan ah. Shakira ayaa soo noqotay masraxa Koobka Adduunka ka dib markii ay bandhig ka dhigaysay 2010-kii, waxaanay mar kale ku soo laabatay heer sare oo cusub . Mid ka mid ah waxyaabihii ugu saamaynta badnaa bandhigga ayaa ahaa martiqaadka ay Shakira u fidisay kooxda carruurta ee Ghetto Kids oo ka soo jeeda dalka Uganda. Carruurtan oo caan ku ah bandhigyadooda qoob-ka-ciyaarka, kana soo jeeda xaafadaha saboolka ah ee magaalada Kampala, ayaa sheegay in ka qaybgalka munaasabaddan uu u ahaa “riyo rumoowday”. Shakira ayaa Ghetto Kids ku soo bandhigtay heesteeda “Dai Dai”, iyadoo ay si weyn ugu soo dhoweeyeen taageerayaashu . Bandhigga ayaa si weyn loogu ammaanay baraha bulshada, iyadoo taageerayaal badan ay ku tilmaameen mid ka mid ah bandhigyadii ugu quruxda badnaa ee taariikhda finalada Koobka Adduunka. Waxay sidoo kale ku soo bandhigtay qaybo ka mid ah heesaha “Hips Don’t Lie” iyo “Waka Waka”, kuwaas oo dadweynaha si weyn ugu dheelitireen . Madonna ayaa bandhigga ku soo biirtay iyadoo ku lug leh heesta “La Isla Bonita”, halka Justin Bieber uu ku soo bandhigay “Baby”, taasoo si weyn loogu dhaweeyay. Dhamaan fanaaniinta ayaa si wadajir ah ugu soo bandhigtay heesta “Dai Dai” ee Shakira, iyagoo ka dhigay bandhig riyaaleed . Shakira ayaa heesta “Dai Dai” ku heesay luqadaha Ingiriisiga, Isbaanishka, iyo Carabiga, taasoo muujinaysa saameynta caalamiga ah ee heestan. Waxay sidoo kale ku soo bandhigtay heesaha ugu caansan shaqadeeda, oo ay ku jiraan “Hips Don’t Lie” iyo “Waka Waka” . Ghetto Kids ayaa ku soo bandhigay qoob-ka-ciyaarka iyagoo xiran dharka dhaqameedka Afrikaanka ah, waxayna ku soo dhaweeyeen dhamaan dadweynaha garoonka ku sugnaa. Dhamaadka bandhigga, Shakira ayaa ku dhawaaqday “Waan jeclahay kooxdan yar! Ma waxaad rabtaan inaan ku soo laabato?”, taasoo si weyn loogu dhaweeyay . items.title: Ferran Torres: Spain waxay leedahay 26 hoggaamiye Koobka Adduunka 2026
items.description: Ferran Torres oo cadeeyay sababta Spain ugu kalsooni badan yihiin, isagoo xasuusiyay koobkii 2010-kii Weeraryahanka xulka Spain, Ferran Torres, ayaa sheegay in kooxdu aysan ka baqayn cadaadiska koobka adduunka, isagoo xusay in xulka 2026-ka uu leeyahay 26 hoggaamiye oo waaya-aragnimo leh, sida ay ahayd kooxdii 2010-kii ee ku guulaysatay koobka. Ferran Torres, oo ah ciyaartoyga Barcelona, ayaa waraysi uu siiyay warbaahinta ka sheegay in uu ku faraxsan yahay in uu xidho lambarka 7 ee xulka Spain, kaas oo ay hore u xidhi jireen halyeeyo sida David Villa iyo Alvaro Morata. “Lambarka 7 wuxuu ii yahay lambar aad u gaar ah,” ayuu yiri Torres. “David Villa ayaa xidhi jiray lambarkan, waana tusaale ii ah. Morata ayaa sidoo kale xidhay, markii aan la wareegay lambarka 7, Morata wuxuu ii soo diray farriin” . ‘Waxaan leenahay 26 hoggaamiye’ Markii la weydiiyay in uu isagu yahay hoggaamiyaha kooxda, Torres wuxuu diiday inuu qof qura tilmaamo, waxaana uu sheegay in kooxdu ay ka buuxdo hoggaamiyeyaal. “Waxaan haysannaa 26 hoggaamiye,” ayuu ku dhawaaqay. “Qof kastaa wuxuu awoodaa inuu heer sare ka ciyaaro, qof kastaa wuxuu leeyahay fursad uu ku bilaabo ciyaarta. Ugu dambayn, waxay ku xiran tahay tababare. Dhammaanteen waan muhiim nahay” . Torres waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in joogitaanka dheer ee kooxdu ay siisaa “fursad dheeri ah” oo ay kaga horreeyaan kooxaha kale. Waxa uu yiri: “Kooxdu si aad ah ayey u kalsooni badan tahay oo u deggan yihiin, sababtoo ah ciyaartoygan waxay wada joogeen muddo dheer” . Mustaqbalka Barcelona oo la iska indhatiray Inkastoo uu heshiiskiisa Barcelona socdo ilaa 2027, haddana waxaa la sheegay in Paris Saint-Germain ay danaynayso inay soo iibsato Torres. Laakin markii la weydiiyay arintan, Torres si toos ah ayuu ugu jawaabay: “Ma ogi, mana danaynayo,” ayuu yiri markii la weydiiyay xiisaha PSG. “Waxa ugu muhiimsan inaan helno saddexda dhibcood. Waxa ka baxsan ciyaarta hadda ma muhiimna” . Markii la weydiiyay inuu isagu arko naftiisa Barcelona sanadka soo socda, wuxuu si fudud ugu jawaabay: “Waxaan naftayda ku arkaa oo keliya ciyaarta berrito ee ka dhanka ah Cape Verde” . Xasuusii 2010-kii Inkastoo Torres uusan si toos ah isu barbar dhigin jiilkan hadda iyo kooxdii 2010-kii ee ku guulaysatay koobka, haddana tixraacii uu u sameeyay David Villa – oo ahaa halyeeygii koobkaas – ayaa muujinaya hamiga weyn ee kooxdu leedahay. Spain waxay ku tartamaysaa inay ku guulaysato koobkeedii labaad, 16 sano ka dib guushii taariikhiga ahayd ee ay ka gaartay Koonfur Afrika. Torres, oo dhaliyay goolkii guusha ee finalkii Argentina, ayaa noqon doona mid ka mid ah ciyaartoydii ugu muhiimsanaa . #Spain2026 #Torres7 #WorldCupFinal #HoggaamiyeyaashaSpain #KoobkaAdduunka2026 #BBCWarar #SoomaaliSports The post Ferran Torres: Spain waxay leedahay 26 hoggaamiye Koobka Adduunka 2026 first appeared on Radio Dalsan .
