items.title: Dagaalka Iran iyo Mareykanka oo gilgilaya suuqyada caalamka
items.description: Dagaalka u dhaxeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran ee ka socdo Bariga Dhexe iyo xirnaanshaha marinka sahayda tamarta ee Hormuz ayaa gilgilaya suuqyada caalamiga ah. Dagaalka ayaa si weyn u curyaaminaya dhaqaalaha caalamka, isagoo si gaar ah u kordhiyay qiimaha shidaalka, kharashka maraakiibta & xamuulka, gaadiidka dadweynaha oo ay ku jiraan kuwa gaarka loo leeyahay iyo korontada ay dadku isticmaalaan. Shidaalka oo ciriiri gala ayaa wuxuu keenaa sicir barar guud, iyadoo marka uu shidaalka qaaliyoobo ay si toos ah u kordhaan qiimaha wax kasta oo suuqa yaala, taas oo keenta in sicirka raashinka, biyaha iyo adeegyada kale ay kor u kacaan. Caqabadda taagan ayaa waxaa uga sii daraya walaaca xoogan ee laga qabo in dagaalku uu ku fido xarumaha wax soosaarka tamarta ee gobolka, iyadoo gobolku uu soo saaro qaybta ugu badan ee shidaalka caalamka. Dagaalka tamarta ayaa sababaya waxyeelo keeneysa dhowr sano oo dib-u-dhac ah, in qiimaha saliidda ee suuqyada caalamiga ah uu kor u sii kaco iyo in uu sii xoogeysto jahwareerka dhaqaale ee ka jira dunida. Mar kasta oo dagaalka uu sii jiitamo, waxa ay dadku filayaan ayaa ah inuu sii kordho qiimaha naxdinta leh ee sahayda tamarta iyo kharashka nolosha ee maalinlaha.

items.title: Maleeshiyo beeleed isku horfadhiya beer xashiish lagu beero oo ku taalla Sh/Hoose
items.description: Marka (Caasimada Online) – Xiisad u dhexeysa maleeshiyaad kasoo kala jeeda laba beel ayaa ka taagan beer weyn oo xashiish lagu beero, taas oo ku taalla deegaanka Gurshiini ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, sida ay ilo-wareedyo deegaanka ah u sheegeen Caasimada Online. Maleeshiyaadka isku horfadhiya beerta ayaa isku haya cidda la wareegeysa gurashada xashiishka, xilli muddo bil ah ay ka harsan tahay waqtiga la filayo in dalagga la goosto. Beerta, oo cabbirkeeda lagu sheegay ku dhowaad 30 hektar, ayaa la sheegay inay muddooyinkii dambe gacanta ku hayeen maleeshiyaad hubeysan, iyadoo dhinac walba uu doonayo inuu keligiis ka faa’iideysto dhaqaalaha laga filayo dalagga. Ilo-wareedyada ayaa sheegay in beerta markii hore uu xashiishka ku beeray nin lagu magacaabo Gumac, balse markii dambe ay dagaal kula wareegeen maleeshiyaad kasoo jeeda beel kale. Maleeshiyaadkaas ayaa tan iyo xilligaas la sheegay inay maamulayeen beerta. Hase yeeshee, waxaa dhowaan dib ugu soo laabtay maleeshiyaad taageersan ninkii markii hore beeray, kuwaas oo doonaya inay dib ula wareegaan goobta ka hor inta aan la gaarin xilliga gurashada. Wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in labada dhinac ay hadda isku horfadhiyaan deegaanka, taas oo dhalisay cabsi laga qabo inuu halkaas ka qarxo dagaal beeleed. Ciidamo tegay beerta Dowladda federaalka ayaa la sheegay inay ciidamo u dirtay beerta kadib markii ay heshay xog ku saabsan muranka iyo xashiishka lagu beeray goobta. Saraakiisha tegay deegaanka waxaa kamid ahaa taliyihii hore ee Guutada 14-ka Oktoobar, Cabdiraxiim Maxamed Munye, ka hor inta aan xilka laga qaadin, iyo saraakiil kale oo ka kala tirsan ciidamada ka howlgala Janaale iyo Marka. Ciidamada ayaa la sheegay inay burburiyeen qiyaastii saddex hektar oo kamid ah beerta, balse ay ka tageen inta badan dalagga xashiishka ah. Ilaa hadda ma cadda sababta aan loo burburin dhammaan beerta, mana jiro war kasoo baxay dowladda federaalka ama saraakiisha ciidamada oo faahfaahinaya howlgalkaas. Warar ay heshay Caasimada Online ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in saraakiil ciidan iyo mas’uuliyiin degmo lagu eedeeyay inay lug ku leeyihiin beerta iyo muranka ka taagan. Qaar kamid ah taliyeyaasha Guutada 14-ka Oktoobar ayaa si gaar ah loogu eedeeyay inay qeyb ka yihiin arrintan, inkasta oo Caasimada Online aysan si madax-bannaan u xaqiijin karin eedeymahaas. Ganacsiga xashiishka Deegaannada Gurshiini, Janaale iyo dhulka ku teedsan webiga Shabeelle ayaa muddo dheer lagu yaqaanay beerashada dalagyo kala duwan, balse waxaa sidoo kale laga soo sheegay beero lagu beero xashiishka. Ka hor inta aan Al-Shabaab laga saarin qaar kamid ah deegaannadaas, kooxda ayaa la sheegay inay dhaqaale ka sameyn jirtay canshuuraha laga qaado beeraha xashiishka iyo ganacsatada ka shaqeysa. Al-Shabaab ayaa inta badan sheegata inay ku dhaqanto shareecada Islaamka, balse kooxda ayaa marar badan lagu eedeeyay inay dhaqaale ka sameyso ganacsiyo iyo badeecooyin ay si kale u mamnuucdo. Wararka laga helayo Shabeellaha Hoose ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in xubno kamid ah ciidamada dowladda lagu eedeeyo inay ka qeybqaataan qaadista iyo soo gelinta xashiishka magaalada Muqdisho. Qeyb weyn oo kamid ah xashiishka lagu isticmaalo Muqdisho iyo gobollada kale ee dalka ayaa la rumeysan yahay inuu kasoo go’o gobollada Shabeellaha Hoose iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe, iyadoo shabakado ay ku lug leeyihiin maleeshiyaad, ganacsato iyo saraakiil ciidan lagu eedeeyo inay ka shaqeeyaan gaarsiintiisa suuqyada. Dowladda federaalka iyo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed weli kama aysan hadlin xiisadda ka taagan beerta Gurshiini iyo eedeymaha ku saabsan saraakiisha lagu sheegay inay ku lug leeyihiin. items.title: Maraykanka oo xaqiijiyay askari ka mid ah ciidankooda lagu dilay
items.description: Milatariga Maraykanka ayaa sheegay in xubin ka tirsan ciidamadooda uu dhintay kadib weerar ay Iiraan ka fulisay waqooyiga Ciraaq maalintii Sabtida, maalin uun kadib markii weerar lagu qaaday saldhig ku yaalla Urdun ay ku dhinteen laba askari oo Maraykan ah, halka askari kale weli la la’yahay. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Maraykanka (Centcom) ayaa sheegay in qofkaasi uu ku dhintay intii lagu jiray “qarxin si taxaddar leh loo xakameeyay oo lagu burburinayay walxo aan weli qarxin,” kuwaas oo ka haray diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo ay Iiraan adeegsatay. Qaraxaasi waxaa kale oo uu dhaawacay xubin kale oo ka tirsan ciidamada. Warbixinteedii ugu dambeysay, Centcom waxay sheegtay inay heshay “hadhaaga bini’aadan oo aan weli la aqoonsan” kadib baaritaan laga sameeyay goobtii uu ka dhacay weerarkii Jimcaha ee Urdun. Waxay intaas ku dartay in “habka baaritaanka lagu xaqiijinayo cidda ay hadhaagaasi yihiin uu weli socdo. Arrintani waxay ku soo beegmaysaa iyadoo Maraykanka iyo Iiraan ay is dhaafsanayaan weerarro galay maalintoodii siddeedaad oo xiriir ah, kuwaas oo sii kordhinaya xiisadda. Labada dhinacba waxaa lagu eedeeyay inay maalmihii u dambeeyay weerareen kaabayaal muhiim ah. Dhanka kale, Washington waxay dib u soo rogtay xanibaaddii ay ku haysay dekedaha Iiraan, halka Tehran ay ku dhawaaqday in marin-biyoodka Hormuz uu xidhan yahay, isla markaana ay bartilmaameedsatay xulafada Maraykanka ee gobolka, kadib markii xabbad-joojin ku-meel-gaar ah ay burburtay wax ka yar bil kadib markii ay bilaabatay.

items.title: Mareykanka oo si weyn u amaanay DF kadib markii loo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa ku ammaanay Soomaaliya wada-shaqeynta dhinaca sharci-fulinta, kadib markii mas’uuliyiinta Muqdisho ay gacan ka geysteen in laba nin oo loo raadinayay kiisas kala duwan oo musuq-maasuq iyo dil ah dib loogu celiyo Mareykanka. Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Muqdisho ayaa sheegtay in iskaashiga dhow ee labada dal uu muujinayo sida wada-shaqeyn lagu saleeyo ixtiraamka shuruucda iyo nidaamyada dal walba ay gacan uga geysan karto xoojinta amniga iyo ka hortagga in Soomaaliya ay gabbaad u noqoto dad dambiyo culus lagu eedeeyo. “Mareykanku wuxuu qadarinayaa wada-shaqeynta joogtada ah ee dhinaca sharci-fulinta ee kala dhexeysa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya,” ayay safaaraddu ku sheegtay qoraal ay soo saartay. Waxay intaas ku dartay in iskaashiga noocan ah uu ilaalin karo muwaadiniinta labada dal, isla markaana uu dambiilayaasha ka hor istaagi karo inay ka baxsadaan cadaaladda. “Waxaan rajeyneynaa in wada-shaqeyntan ay noqoto halbeeg adag oo lagu saleeyo dadaallada mustaqbalka,” ayay safaaraddu tiri. Inkasta oo safaaraddu aysan si toos ah u magacaabin kiisaska ay ka hadlayso, haddana bayaanka ayaa yimid maalmo kadib markii Soomaaliya laga soo qaaday laba eedeysane oo kala ah Cabdikariim Iidle iyo Hanut Cabdulle. Cabdikariim Iidle Cabdikariim, oo 42 jir ah oo deganaa gobolka Minnesota, ayaa ka mid ah dadka lagu eedeeyay fadeexadda ballaaran ee Feeding Our Future, oo ah kiis la xiriira boqolaal milyan oo dollar oo laga lunsaday barnaamij loogu talagalay quudinta carruurta xilligii cudurka Covid-19. Waaxda Caddaaladda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in Cabdikariim lagu wareejiyay saraakiil Mareykan ah 16-kii July, kadib markii ay ku tilmaantay inuu si sharci ah isku dhiibay isaga oo ku sugnaa Soomaaliya. Waxaa lagu soo oogay 31 dacwadood oo ay ku jiraan khiyaano dhinaca isgaarsiinta ah, laaluush la xiriira barnaamijyada dowladda iyo lacag-dhaqid. Dacwad-oogayaasha Mareykanka ayaa ku eedeeyay inuu gacan ka geystay qorista iyo ansixinta xarumo cunto oo been-abuur ah, kuwaas oo xiriir la lahaa hay’adda Feeding Our Future. Hay’addaas ayaa udub-dhexaad u ahayd qorshe lagu eedeeyay in lagu lunsaday lacag gaareysa ku dhowaad 250 milyan oo dollar oo loogu talagalay barnaamij nafaqeynta carruurta. Dacwad-oogayaasha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in in ka badan shan milyan oo dollar oo laaluush, gunno sharci-darro ah iyo lacago kale ay mareen akoonno lala xiriiriyay shirkado magac-u-yaal ah oo uu maamulayay Cabdikariim. “Qabashadiisa iyo dib loogu soo celiyay Minnesota waxay muujinayaan inta ay gaari karto gacanta hay’adaha sharci-fulinta Mareykanka,” ayuu yiri xeer-ilaaliyaha Mareykanka Daniel Rosen. Waaxda Caddaaladda ayaa sheegtay in howlgalka ay ka wada shaqeeyeen Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka Soomaaliya, Booliska Soomaaliyeed, Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka, FBI-da iyo hay’adda canshuuraha Mareykanka. Hanut Cabdulle Kiiska labaad wuxuu khuseeyaa Hanut Cabdulle, oo 23 jir ah, kaas oo dib loogu celiyay magaalada Columbus ee gobolka Ohio, halkaas oo uu wajahayo dacwad dil ah. Hanut ayaa lagu eedeeyay inuu ku lug lahaa dilkii Bryce Persang, oo 24 jir ahaa, kaas oo lagu toogtay Columbus bishii September 2021. Booliska ayaa Persang oo dhaawac ah ka helay gudaha gaari, waxaana markii dambe uu ku geeriyooday isbitaal. Baarayaasha ayaa sheegay in Persang uu qorsheeyay inuu la kulmo Hanut iyo qof kale ka hor inta aan la toogan. Amar lagu soo xirayo Hanut ayaa la soo saaray sanadkii 2022, hase yeeshee markii dambe waxaa la ogaaday inuu ku sugan yahay Soomaaliya. Soo gacan-gelinta labada nin ayaa sidoo kale dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan habraaca sharci ee la adeegsaday, maadaama Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka aysan lahayn heshiis rasmi ah oo isu-celinta eedeysanayaasha ah. Dastuurka Kumeel-gaarka ah ee Soomaaliya ayaa dhigaya in qof eedeysan ama la xukumay dal kale loogu wareejin karo oo keliya hab waafaqsan sharciga iyo heshiis caalami ah oo Soomaaliya qeyb ka tahay. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa ka fogaaday inay kiiska Cabdikariim ku tilmaamaan “isu-dhiibid rasmi ah”, iyaga oo adeegsaday erayga wareejin kadib is-dhiibid sharci ah. Labada dowladood weli si faahfaahsan ugama hadlin habraaca sharci ee lagu fuliyay wareejinta, mana aysan shaacin dukumentiyo muujinaya sida ay maxkamadaha ama hay’adaha Soomaaliya u ansixiyeen. Si kastaba, bayaanka safaaradda Mareykanka ayaa muujinaya in Washington ay doonayso in iskaashiga noocan ah uu noqdo qeyb joogto ah oo ka mid ah xiriirka labada dal, kaas oo muddo dheer xoogga saarayay la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab iyo kooxda Daacish. Tallaabooyinka ugu dambeeyay waxay muujinayaan in xiriirka amni ee Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka uu hadda ka sii gudbayo la-dagaallanka argagixisada, kuna sii fidayo baarista dambiyada caadiga ah, raadinta eedeysanayaasha iyo ka hortagga in Soomaaliya ay meel ay ku dhuuntaan u noqoto dadka ay dalal kale raadinayaan. items.title: Arin argagax leh oo ka dhacday
items.description: Wararka ka imaanaya magaalada Qabri Bayax ee Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida ee dalka Itoobiya ayaa sheegaya inay halkaas ku geeriyoodeen ugu yaraan 15 qof kadib labo shi oo is xig xigay oo shalay magaaladaas ka dhacay. Gaari ka soo baxay tuulada Biyooo siday dad ehel ah oo ka yimid aroos ayaa waxaa ay isku dhaceen gaari kale oo jaad waday, Shilka halkaas ka dhashay ayaa waxaa ku dhintay 12 qof. Waxaa intaa kadib bilowday gurmadkii loo fidinayay dadkii dhintay, dadkii dhaawacayada soo gaaray ayaa loo qaaday magaalada Jigjiga halka kuwa geeriyooday la go’aansaday in loo sameeyo aas wadareed. Dadkii qabriga qodayay ayaa waxaa ku soo dumay qabrigii ay qodayeen, sidaas aawgeed, halkaas waxaa ka dhashay shil kale oo labaad. Inta la xaqiijiyay 10 qof ayaa ku dhaawacantay halka saddex kale oo meyd ah meesha laga soo saaray, waxaa loo soo qaaday isbitaalka Jigjiga, dhaawaca halkaas ayaa lagu dabiibayaa”, ayuu yiri Cabdixakiin Cabdullaahi Maxamed (Cabdihakiin Gamadiid) oo ah wariye madax banaan oo ka howl gala deegaanka, kaas oo BBC-da u warramay. Wefdi u hogaaminayo madaxweynaha DDS ayaa gaaray goobta uu Shilka ka dhacay. Howlaha gurmadka ayaa la soo gabagabeeyay.

items.title: Askar Mareykan ah oo lagu dilay Ciraaq xilli uu kordhay khasaaraha dagaalka Iiraan
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in askari kale lagu dilay waqooyiga Iraq, maalin kadib markii weerar ay Iran ku qaaday saldhig ku yaalla Jordan uu dilay laba askari oo Mareykan ah, mid kalena lagu waayay. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka, CENTCOM, ayaa sheegay in askariga la dilay Sabtidii, xilli si qorsheysan loo qarxinayay walxaha qarxa ee ku jiray diyaarad weerar oo Iran leedahay, taas oo ciidamada Mareykanku hore u soo rideen. Qaraxa ayaa sidoo kale dhaawacay askari kale, sida uu talisku sheegay. Dhacdadan ayaa tirada ciidamada Mareykanka ee lagu dilay dagaalka Iran gaarsiisay 17, kadib markii sidoo kale duuliye ka tirsanaa ciidamada badda Mareykanka, oo la waayay horaantii bishan, lagu dhawaaqay inuu dhintay. Khasaaraha cusub ayaa yimid iyadoo Mareykanka iyo Iran ay maalintii siddeedaad oo xiriir ah is-weydaarsanayaan weerarro sii xoogeysanaya, kuwaas oo ku fiday Iraq, Jordan, dalalka Khaliijka iyo marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Haraaga qof oo laga helay Jordan CENTCOM ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in goobtii weerarkii Jimcihii lagu qaaday saldhigga Jordan laga helay haraaga qof aan weli la aqoonsan. “Waxaa socda baaritaan lagu xaqiijinayo haraaga,” ayuu talisku ku sheegay warbixin cusub. Laba askari oo Mareykan ah ayaa la xaqiijiyay inay ku dhinteen weerarka, halka askari saddexaad lagu waayay. Muuqaallo la xaqiijiyay oo laga soo duubay gudaha xarunta ciidamada ayaa muujiyay ugu yaraan laba gantaal ama diyaarad weerar oo ku dhacaya goobta, kadibna uu qarax xooggan dhacayo. Washington ayaa weerarka ku eedeysay Ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran, waxayna sheegtay in duqeymaha xigay looga gol lahaa in si degdeg ah looga jawaabo dilka askarta Mareykanka. Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in weerarradooda ugu dambeeyay ay sidoo kale bartilmaameedsadeen awoodda Iran ee ay ugu hanjabeyso maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraya Marinka Hormuz. Marinkaasi wuxuu muhiim u yahay ganacsiga caalamiga ah, waxaana mara qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah shidaalka iyo gaaska dunida loo dhoofiyo. Xabbad-joojintii oo burburtay Xiisadda hadda taagan ayaa timid kadib markii uu burburay heshiis xabbad-joojin hordhac ah oo Mareykanka iyo Iran ay gaareen wax ka yar bil kahor. Mareykanka ayaa dib u soo celiyay xannibaad dhinaca badda ah oo uu saaray dekedaha Iran, halka Tehran ay ku dhawaaqday in Marinka Hormuz uu xiran yahay, isla markaana ay bartilmaameedsaneyso dalalka gobolka ee taageera Washington. Labada dhinac ayaa maalmihii lasoo dhaafay lagu eedeeyay inay weerareen kaabayaal muhiim u ah nolosha shacabka, oo ay ku jiraan xarumaha tamarta, biyaha, gaadiidka iyo saldhigyada milatari. Iran ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan 50 qof lagu dilay, in ka badan 500 kalena lagu dhaawacay duqeymaha Mareykanka saddexdii toddobaad ee ugu dambeeyay. Warbaahinta Iran ayaa Axaddii sheegtay in habeenkii la weeraray xarun koronto oo nukliyeer ah oo weli laga dhisayo magaalada Darkhoveyn ee koonfur-galbeed dalka, iyo sidoo kale jasiiradda Qeshm. Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan kormeerka nukliyeerka ayaa ugu baaqday dhinacyada inay muujiyaan is-xakameyn. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in xarunta Darkhoveyn ay weli ku jirto marxaladihii ugu horreeyay ee dhismaha, isla markaana aysan ku jirin wax nukliyeer ah markii ugu dambeysay ee ay kormeerayaasheedu booqdeen. Si kastaba, weerarka xarun la xiriirta tamarta nukliyeerka ayaa sii kordhiyay walaaca laga qabo in dagaalku taabto goobo xasaasi ah, taas oo keeni karta saameyn ka gudubta xuduudaha Iran. Jordan oo u yeertay diblomaasi Iran ah Ciidamada Jordan ayaa sheegay inay soo rideen saddex gantaal oo Iran laga soo tuuray, halka gantaal afaraad uu ku dhacay meel ka fog goobaha ay dadku deggan yihiin. Tallaabada ayaa timid kadib digniin Mareykanku bixiyay oo ku saabsan in dekedda Aqaba ay bartilmaameed noqon karto. Dowladda Jordan ayaa u yeertay sii-hayaha safaaradda Iran ee Amman, iyadoo ka dalbatay Tehran inay si degdeg ah u joojiso weerarrada. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Jordan ayaa weerarrada ku tilmaantay kuwo “aan cudurdaar lahayn oo cad”, waxayna sheegtay in ammaanka iyo madaxbannaanida dalka ay yihiin “khad cas oo aan la dhaafi karin”. Ciidamada Israel ayaa dhankooda sheegay inay rideen gantaallo difaac si ay uga hortagaan burburka gantaallada Iran ee ku wajahnaa Jordan inuu ku dhaco gudaha Israel. Qeybo ka mid ah gantaallada difaaca ayaa markii dambe laga helay meel u dhow magaalada Eilat ee koonfurta Israel, oo ku dhow xadka Jordan, balse wax khasaare ah lama soo sheegin. Sii kororka khasaaraha ciidamada Mareykanka, weerarrada Iran ee dalalka gobolka iyo beegsiga kaabayaasha muhiimka ah ayaa sare u qaaday cabsida laga qabo in colaadda ay isu beddesho dagaal ballaaran oo ay ku lug yeeshaan dalal badan oo Bariga Dhexe ah. items.fullContent: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in askari kale lagu dilay waqooyiga Iraq, maalin kadib markii weerar ay Iran ku qaaday saldhig ku yaalla Jordan uu dilay laba askari oo Mareykan ah, mid kalena lagu waayay. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka, CENTCOM, ayaa sheegay in askariga la dilay Sabtidii, xilli si qorsheysan loo qarxinayay walxaha qarxa ee ku jiray diyaarad weerar oo Iran leedahay, taas oo ciidamada Mareykanku hore u soo rideen. Qaraxa ayaa sidoo kale dhaawacay askari kale, sida uu talisku sheegay. Dhacdadan ayaa tirada ciidamada Mareykanka ee lagu dilay dagaalka Iran gaarsiisay 17, kadib markii sidoo kale duuliye ka tirsanaa ciidamada badda Mareykanka, oo la waayay horaantii bishan, lagu dhawaaqay inuu dhintay. Khasaaraha cusub ayaa yimid iyadoo Mareykanka iyo Iran ay maalintii siddeedaad oo xiriir ah is-weydaarsanayaan weerarro sii xoogeysanaya, kuwaas oo ku fiday Iraq, Jordan, dalalka Khaliijka iyo marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Haraaga qof oo laga helay Jordan CENTCOM ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in goobtii weerarkii Jimcihii lagu qaaday saldhigga Jordan laga helay haraaga qof aan weli la aqoonsan. “Waxaa socda baaritaan lagu xaqiijinayo haraaga,” ayuu talisku ku sheegay warbixin cusub. Laba askari oo Mareykan ah ayaa la xaqiijiyay inay ku dhinteen weerarka, halka askari saddexaad lagu waayay. Muuqaallo la xaqiijiyay oo laga soo duubay gudaha xarunta ciidamada ayaa muujiyay ugu yaraan laba gantaal ama diyaarad weerar oo ku dhacaya goobta, kadibna uu qarax xooggan dhacayo. Washington ayaa weerarka ku eedeysay Ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran, waxayna sheegtay in duqeymaha xigay looga gol lahaa in si degdeg ah looga jawaabo dilka askarta Mareykanka. Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in weerarradooda ugu dambeeyay ay sidoo kale bartilmaameedsadeen awoodda Iran ee ay ugu hanjabeyso maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraya Marinka Hormuz. Marinkaasi wuxuu muhiim u yahay ganacsiga caalamiga ah, waxaana mara qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah shidaalka iyo gaaska dunida loo dhoofiyo. Xabbad-joojintii oo burburtay Xiisadda hadda taagan ayaa timid kadib markii uu burburay heshiis xabbad-joojin hordhac ah oo Mareykanka iyo Iran ay gaareen wax ka yar bil kahor. Mareykanka ayaa dib u soo celiyay xannibaad dhinaca badda ah oo uu saaray dekedaha Iran, halka Tehran ay ku dhawaaqday in Marinka Hormuz uu xiran yahay, isla markaana ay bartilmaameedsaneyso dalalka gobolka ee taageera Washington. Labada dhinac ayaa maalmihii lasoo dhaafay lagu eedeeyay inay weerareen kaabayaal muhiim u ah nolosha shacabka, oo ay ku jiraan xarumaha tamarta, biyaha, gaadiidka iyo saldhigyada milatari. Iran ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan 50 qof lagu dilay, in ka badan 500 kalena lagu dhaawacay duqeymaha Mareykanka saddexdii toddobaad ee ugu dambeeyay. Warbaahinta Iran ayaa Axaddii sheegtay in habeenkii la weeraray xarun koronto oo nukliyeer ah oo weli laga dhisayo magaalada Darkhoveyn ee koonfur-galbeed dalka, iyo sidoo kale jasiiradda Qeshm. Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan kormeerka nukliyeerka ayaa ugu baaqday dhinacyada inay muujiyaan is-xakameyn. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in xarunta Darkhoveyn ay weli ku jirto marxaladihii ugu horreeyay ee dhismaha, isla markaana aysan ku jirin wax nukliyeer ah markii ugu dambeysay ee ay kormeerayaasheedu booqdeen. Si kastaba, weerarka xarun la xiriirta tamarta nukliyeerka ayaa sii kordhiyay walaaca laga qabo in dagaalku taabto goobo xasaasi ah, taas oo keeni karta saameyn ka gudubta xuduudaha Iran. Jordan oo u yeertay diblomaasi Iran ah Ciidamada Jordan ayaa sheegay inay soo rideen saddex gantaal oo Iran laga soo tuuray, halka gantaal afaraad uu ku dhacay meel ka fog goobaha ay dadku deggan yihiin. Tallaabada ayaa timid kadib digniin Mareykanku bixiyay oo ku saabsan in dekedda Aqaba ay bartilmaameed noqon karto. Dowladda Jordan ayaa u yeertay sii-hayaha safaaradda Iran ee Amman, iyadoo ka dalbatay Tehran inay si degdeg ah u joojiso weerarrada. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Jordan ayaa weerarrada ku tilmaantay kuwo “aan cudurdaar lahayn oo cad”, waxayna sheegtay in ammaanka iyo madaxbannaanida dalka ay yihiin “khad cas oo aan la dhaafi karin”. Ciidamada Israel ayaa dhankooda sheegay inay rideen gantaallo difaac si ay uga hortagaan burburka gantaallada Iran ee ku wajahnaa Jordan inuu ku dhaco gudaha Israel. Qeybo ka mid ah gantaallada difaaca ayaa markii dambe laga helay meel u dhow magaalada Eilat ee koonfurta Israel, oo ku dhow xadka Jordan, balse wax khasaare ah lama soo sheegin. Sii kororka khasaaraha ciidamada Mareykanka, weerarrada Iran ee dalalka gobolka iyo beegsiga kaabayaasha muhiimka ah ayaa sare u qaaday cabsida laga qabo in colaadda ay isu beddesho dagaal ballaaran oo ay ku lug yeeshaan dalal badan oo Bariga Dhexe ah. items.title: Waa kuma Lamine Yamal: Xiddigga 19 jirka ah ee Noqday Halyeyga Kubadda Cagta Adduunka ?
items.description: Lamine Yamal Nasraoui Ebana weeraryahanka garabka midig ee kooxda FC Barcelona ayaa noqday shakhsiga ugu hadal-haynta badan dunida, kadib markii uu wacdare aan horay loo arag ka dhigay ciyaartii ugu Final-ka ahayd ee Spain iyo Argentina. 19-jirkan asal ahaan ka soo jeeda dalka marooko ayaa loo aqoonsansaday mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda ugu hibada badan kubadda cagta dunida, wuxuuna ka guulaystay kooxda Argentina oo haysta goolyaheyaasha iyo weeraryahannada ugu saameynta badan dunida. Inkastoo uu weli yahay ciyaaryahan da’yar, haddana wuxuu durba galay taariikhda, isagoo jabiyay rikoorro badan, isla markaana door weyn ka qaatay guulaha kooxdiisa Barcelona iyo xulka qaranka Spain. Lamine Yamal wuxuu dhashay 13-kii Luulyo 2007-dii, asagoo ku dhashay  magaalada Esplugues de Llobregat ee dalka Spain, waxaana iska dhalay aabe iyo hooyo ka soo kala jeeda Morocco iyo Equatorial Guinea. Wuxuu kasoo baxay akadeemiyadda caanka ah ee La Masia, oo soo saartay halyeeyo badan sida Lionel Messi, Xavi Hernández iyo Andrés Iniesta. Asagoo aad u da’yar ayay hibadiisu si degdeg ah u soo muuqatay, taasoo sababtay in loo dalacsiiyo kooxda koowaad ee Barcelona oo xalay qaatay guusha koobka adduunka ee 2026. Markii uu ku biiray kooxda koowaad ee Barcelona sanadkii 2023, Yamal wuxuu noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu da’da yaraa ee kooxda u safta kulamo rasmi ah. Wuxuu si degdeg ah u kasbaday kalsoonida tababarayaasha iyo taageerayaasha, isagoo caan ku noqday xawaaraha, farsamada sare, kubbad laadka saxda ah iyo awoodda uu ku abuuro fursado halis ah. Intii uu joogay Barcelona, Lamine Yamal wuxuu noqday mid ka mid ah tiirarka ugu muhiimsan kooxda, wuxuuna kooxda ka caawiyay inay ku guuleysato horyaalka La Liga, Copa del Rey iyo Supercopa de España, isagoo door muuqda ka qaatay safarka guulahaas. Wacdareyaashii cajiibka ahaa waxay sidoo kale horseedeen inuu noqdo ciyaaryahanka ugu da’da yar ee loo magacaabo abaal-marinta Ballon d’Or. Sannadihii xigay wuxuu ku guuleystay laba jeer oo xiriir ah abaal-marinta Kopa Trophy, taas oo la siiyo ciyaaryahanka ugu wanaagsan da’da yar dunida. Dhinaca xulka qaranka Spain, Lamine Yamal wuxuu taariikh sameeyay markii uu noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu da’da yaraa ee u ciyaara xulkan waaweyn, isla markaana gool u dhaliya. Wuxuu kaalin weyn ka qaatay guushii Spain ka gaartay Koobka Qaramada Yurub ee UEFA Euro 2024, halkaas oo uu noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu da’da yaraa ee ka ciyaara, gool ka dhaliya isla markaana gaara final-ka tartanka. Waxqabadkiisa cajiibka ah wuxuu ku mutaystay abaal-marinta Young Player of the Tournament, taas oo la guddoonsiiyo ciyaaryahanka da’da yar ee ugu fiicnaa tartanka. Sanadkii 2026, Lamine Yamal wuxuu sii xoojiyay sumcaddiisa markii uu ka mid noqday xulka Spain ee ku guuleystay Koobka Adduunka ee FIFA World Cup. Tartankaas wuxuu noqday koobkiisii ugu horreeyay ee adduunka, isagoo door muhiim ah ka qaatay safarkii Spain ku hanatay horyaalkeedii labaad ee Koobka Adduunka. Marka laga hadlayo qaab ciyaareedkiisa, Lamine Yamal waxaa lagu tilmaamaa garab weerar oo leh farsamo heer sare ah, kubbad wadis adag, baasas hal-abuur leh iyo geesinimo uu ku wajaho difaacyada adag. Inkastoo uu weli ku jiro bilowga xirfaddiisa, haddana Yamal wuxuu horey u urursaday rikoorro badan, koobab waaweyn iyo abaal-marinno caalami ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee Lamine Yamal maanta ma aha oo kaliya xiddig soo baxay, balse waa ciyaaryahan si buuxda uga dhex muuqday masraxa kubadda cagta adduunka.

items.title: Maxay ka dhigan tahay ku guusha Spain ee K/Adduunka?
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Xulka Qaranka Spain ayaa xalay ku guuleystay Koobka Adduunka 2026, kaddib markii ay 1-0 kaga adkaadeen Xulka Qaranka Argentina, iyada oo ay dhex-martay ciyaar adag oo la isku mari waayay 90-kii daqiiqo, balse lagu kala baxay waqtiga dheeriga ah. Kulanka oo ka dhacay New York New Jersey Stadium ayaa ahaa mid ay labada xul ku soo bandhigeen ciyaar adag oo leh feejignaan sare. Spain ayaa inta badan maamulaysay kubadda, waxayna abuurtay fursado badan, halka Argentina ay ku tiirsaneyd difaac adag iyo badbaadino uu sameeyay goolhaye Emiliano Martínez. Markii 90-kii daqiiqo lagu kala bixi waayay barbaro goolal la’aan ah, ciyaarta ayaa gashay waqti dheeri ah. Xaaladda Argentina ayaa sii adkaatay markii Enzo Fernández la siiyay kaarka casaanka kaddib digniintii labaad, taasoo ku qasabtay inay 10 ciyaaryahan ku dhammaystaan kulanka. Guusha Spain waxaa xaqiijiyay weeraryahanka Ferran Torres, kaas oo daqiiqaddii 106-aad shabaqa ku hubsaday kubaddii guusha, isagoo ka faa’iideystay weerar joogto ah oo ay Spain ku cadaadinaysay difaaca Argentina. Goolkaas ayaa noqday kii lagu kala baxay final-ka. Si kastaba, Argentina ayaa isku dayday inay soo laabato daqiiqadihii ugu dambeeyay, hase yeeshee difaaca Spain iyo goolhaye Unai Simón ayaa si adag u ilaashaday hoggaanka, taasoo xaqiijisay in Spain ay qaaddo koobka markii labaad taariikhdeeda, 16 sano kadib hanashadeedii ugu horreysay ee 2010. Guushan ayaa sidoo kale sii xoojisay sumcadda tababare Luis de la Fuente, kaasoo Spain ku hoggaamiyay guulo waaweyn sanadihii u dambeeyay. Dhinaca kale, final-kan ayaa loo arkaa inuu noqon karo kulankii ugu dambeeyay ee Lionel Messi u ciyaaro Koobka Adduunka, taasoo ka dhigtay habeen xusuus gaar ah leh inkastoo Argentina laga adkaaday. Dhanka kale, Dabaal-degyo waa wayn ayaa weli ka socda guud ahaan dalka Spain, kadib markii ay ku guuleysteen Koobka Adduunka markoodii labaad taariikhida, iyaga oo horay ugu guuleystay 2010-kii Koobka Adduunka oo ay sanadkan hanatay Spain, wuxuu ka kooban yahay 6.175 kiilo, waxaana dahabka ku jira lagu qiimeeyay ku dhowaad $713,000 (ama £532,000), sida lagu sheegay falanqayn ay samaysay London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG). The post Maxay ka dhigan tahay ku guusha Spain ee K/Adduunka? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Spain wins the World Cup by beating Argentina 1-0 on Ferran Torres’ goal in extra time
items.description: EAST RUTHERFORD, N.J. (AP) — This is how good Spain was at the World Cup: Not even Lionel Messi had any answers. And when it was over, Spain walked off with the trophy. Messi simply walked off in tears. Spain is back atop the soccer world for a second time, after Ferran Torres’ first goal of this year’s World Cup — unquestionably the goal of his life — gave his country a 1-0 win over now-dethroned champion Argentina in the final on Sunday. “It was a goal scored by 47 million people,” Torres said, referring to Spain’s population. Maybe not by them — but certainly for them. The goal came with Argentina down to 10 men after Enzo Fernandez was sent off late in regulation following a reckless tackle. Tempers flared then, and flared again after the final whistle with Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni and players from both sides engaging in what appeared to be some pushing and shoving. In the end, Spain denied Messi a second straight title in what he has indicated was his final World Cup match. Torres, a second-half substitute, pounced on a bouncing ball in the box and used his left foot to bury a shot just under the crossbar in the 106th minute. From there, the airtight defense that dominated opponents throughout the tournament came through one final time. Spain — which also won the title in 2010 — allowed only one goal in eight matches in this World Cup run, setting a record for fewest goals allowed by a champion. “I feel pride, to be honest,” said Spain coach Luis de la Fuente, who at 65 is now the oldest man to lead a team to a World Cup title. “Accompanying them on this journey is an honor.” Spain gets a World Cup 1st This title, combined with the Women’s World Cup won by Spain in 2023, makes the European nation the first to hold both the men’s and women’s titles simultaneously. And in the streets of Madrid — probably many other places in Spain as well — countless people spilled into the streets, celebrating Sunday’s victory long into the wee hours of Monday morning. The score indicates this match was close, but only one team was in command. Spain took the game’s first 20 shots on goal before Argentina — desperate for an equalizer — got its first attempt off in the second half of extra time. Spain took nine of the game’s first 10 corner kicks, and only a World Cup final-record 12 saves by Argentina goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez gave the 2022 champions a shot at going back-to-back. “Dibu was nothing short of exceptional,” de la Fuente said, referring to Argentina’s keeper by his nickname. Spain is now unbeaten in its last 38 matches — 29 wins, nine draws — and is the outright holder of the longest such streak by any European men’s team ever. Italy went 37 matches (28 wins, nine draws) from October 2018 through September 2021, before Spain ended that streak. And for the last two-plus years, nobody has beaten Spain. Not even Messi. An Argentina team that was the  kings of the late-game rally  in this tournament had no answer this time. “We lost the game, and we accept that,” Scaloni said. “That doesn’t mean that we will forget everything we’ve done so far, so I’d like to thank my people, my players and the country. I can tell them that we played our hearts out.” Spain survives a late push Messi took a corner kick with about four minutes left before the final whistle and the ball took a fortunate skip toward substitute Giuliano Simeone — who sent it high and over the crossbar, holding his head in disbelief afterward. “When you have Messi on the other side, well, you are nervous,” Torres said. “At the end of the day, we always depended on us. We always come up with our football, and we showed it again.” After the post-match scuffles, they also paid tribute to the former champions. items.title: Tartankii koobka adduunka oo soo gabagaboobey iyo Spain oo ku guuleysatay
items.description: Xulka qaranka Spain ayaa loo caleemo saaray horyaalka Koobka Adduunka ee FIFA 2026, kaddib markii ay guul ka gaareen ciyaartii kama dambaysta ahayd ee tartanka, taasoo soo afjartay toddobaadyo ay dunidu si weyn ula socotay mid kamid ah ciyaarihii ugu xiisaha badnaa. Final-ka ayaa ahaa mid adag oo xamaasad badan, iyadoo Spain ay la kulantay cadaadis xooggan, islamarkaana la tartamaysay Argentina. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, adkaysiga iyo ciyaar wanaagga kooxda ayaa u suurtageliyay inay gacanta ku dhigaan koobka kubadda cagta adduunka. Markii ciyaartu dhammaatay, ciyaartoyda Spain ayaa garoonka dhexdiisa ku dabaaldegay, iyagoo gacmaha is qabsaday kuna ciyaaray qoob-ka-ciyaar farxadeed, halka taageerayaashoodu ay u dabaaldegeen guul taariikhi ah. Koobkan ayaa noqday mid lagu xusuusan doono bandhigyo cajiib ah, ciyaaro xiiso leh iyo xiddigo cusub oo cajiib ah, waxayna guusha Spain soo jiidatay malaayiin taageereyaal ah oo dunida ku kala sugan.

items.title: Mareykanka oo sheegay in askari kale uu kaga dhintay dagaalka Iran
items.description: Militariga Mareykanka ayaa xalay xaqiijyay dhimashada askari kale oo ka tirsan Ciidamada Mareykanka ee ku sugan Gobolka Bariga Dhexe, iyadoo xiisadda kala dhaxeyso Iran ay gaartay meeshii ugu sarreysay. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay in askarigaasi uu Sabtidii ku dhintay Waqooyiga Ciraaq, intii la xakameynayay qarax ka dhashay diyaarad drone oo Iran ay leedahay. Taliska ayaa warsaxaafadeed ku sheegay in askari kale uu ku dhaawacmay dhacdadaasi, kaas oo laga daweynayo dhaawac fudud. “Xubin ka tirsan Ciidamada Mareykanka ee Waqooyiga Ciraaq ayaa lagu dilay hawlgal Luulyo 18-keedii, intii lagu jiray qarax la xakameeyay oo ka dhashay diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo Iran leedahay. Xubin labaad oo ka tirsan ciidamada ayaa dhaawacmay, waxaana laga daweynayaa dhaawac fudud.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Dhanka kale Taliska CENTCOM ayaa sheegay ka dib baaritaan qoto dheer oo la sameeyay in Ciidamada Mareykanka ay heleen meyd la xaqiijinayo, oo loo maleynayo in uu yahay askarigii lagu waayay weerarkii Iran ee Jordan. Taliska CENTCOM ayaa habeenkii Sabtida sheegay in laba askari oo ka tirsan Ciidamada Mareykanka ay Jimcihii ku dhinteen weerar ay Iran ka gaysatay dalkaasi Jordan, mid kalena uu maqan yahay. “Waxaa hadda socda habraac lagu xaqiijinayo aqoonsiga meydka la helay.” Ayuu talisku ku sheegay warsaxaafadeedka. Haddii la xaqiijiyo in meydka la helay uu yahay askarigii la la’aa ayaa waxay tani tirada Ciidamada Mareykanka ee la dilay, tan iyo markii uu dagaalka bilowday ka dhigeysaa 18 askari. Maeykanka ayaa garaacis ba’an ku haya xarumaha militariga, saadka iyo kaabeyaasha tamarta ee Iran, taas oo keentay in Iran ay sii waddo weerarada ka dhanka ah saldhigyadiisa dalalka Carabta.

items.title: Bosaso Springs Back to Life as Port Reopens Following Landmark Deal
items.description: Bosaso (WDN) – A wave of optimism swept across Puntland on Sunday morning as Bosaso Port and all commercial establishments officially reopened, bringing an end to days of disruption of the port operations and restoring the economic heartbeat of the region. The bustling port city quickly returned to life, with busy markets, crowded streets, and long lines of cargo trucks signaling the resumption of normal business activities. Merchants reopened their shops, dockworkers returned to the port, and residents welcomed the renewed flow of goods after a dispute that had threatened to disrupt Puntland’s economy. The reopening follows a breakthrough agreement reached on Saturday between the Puntland Government, DP World—the company that manages Bosaso Port—and representatives of the business community. The dispute had centered on newly introduced port service charges, which traders argued would significantly increase the cost of importing goods and ultimately burden consumers across Puntland. After intensive negotiations, the government and DP World agreed to reduce the disputed fees and adopt a revised tariff structure, addressing the principal concerns raised by traders and importers. The compromise paved the way for the immediate reopening of the port and the lifting of the commercial shutdown. The agreement has been widely welcomed by businesses and residents alike, who view it as a victory for dialogue and cooperation over confrontation. The economic impact of the closure had become increasingly apparent over recent days. With commercial activity at a standstill and cargo movement disrupted, prices of essential commodities—including food, fuel, and other basic household necessities—rose sharply in Bosaso and other parts of Puntland. Now, with trade resuming and supply chains restored, prices of essential goods have begun returning to normal, easing pressure on families and businesses that had been grappling with higher living costs. Sunday’s atmosphere in Bosaso stood in stark contrast to the uncertainty of previous days. The city’s commercial districts were once again bustling with shoppers, transport operators, wholesalers, and retailers, while activity at the port resumed at full pace as cargo vessels, trucks, and loading equipment returned to operation. As Puntland’s principal maritime gateway, Bosaso Port plays a pivotal role in the regional economy, serving as the main entry point for imported goods destined for communities across Puntland and neighboring regions. Any disruption to its operations is felt almost immediately throughout the local economy. For many residents, the reopening represents more than the end of a commercial dispute—it marks the restoration of confidence in one of Puntland’s most vital economic lifelines. Business leaders expressed hope that the agreement would strengthen cooperation between the government, the private sector, and DP World while ensuring that future policy changes are reached through consultation rather than confrontation. With commerce flowing once again, markets fully operational, and essential goods becoming available and more avoidable Sunday’s reopening has been celebrated as a welcome return to normalcy. For Bosaso—and for Puntland as a whole—the reopening of the port is being viewed not only as an economic recovery but also as a reminder that constructive dialogue can deliver solutions that benefit businesses, consumers, and the wider economy alike. items.title: Mid ka mid ah xubno Shabaab oo weerar ka gaystay Afmadow oo la qabtay
items.description: Ciidamada amniga ee Degmada Afmadow ee Gobolka Jubbada Hosoe ayaa gacanta ku dhigay nin ka tirsan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, kaas oo la socday xubno Shabaab ah oo weeraray bar kontorool. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in raggan ay caawa beegsadeen askar markaasi roondo u dhaqaaqeysay, isla-markaana ay dileen Sarkaal lagu magacaabo Cabdiqaadir Caddow Cabdullaahi iyo askari kale oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Jubbaland. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in ciidamada amniga ay toogasho ku dhaawaceen ninka hadda gacanta lagu hayo, isla-markaana ay ku daba joogaan kuwii kale oo ka baxsaday goobta. Saraakiisha laamaha amniga ee Jubbaland ayaa laga soo xigtay in uu socdo hawlgal lagu doonayo in lagu soo qabto ragga baxsadka ah. Sarkaal codsaday inaanan magaciisa la soo xigan ayaa sheegay in ninkan iyo dhowr maleeshiyaad kale oo la socday ay ka masuul yihiin dilka ka dhacay degmadaasi. Muuqaal la soo dhigay barraha bulshada ayaa muujinaya ninkan oo yaala goob bannaan, isagoo ay xaaladdiisu garaab tahay. Dhacdadan ayaa ku soo aadeysa, xilli Gudoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Jubbaland, Cabdi Maxamed Cabdiraxmaan iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ay maalintii labaad booqasho ku joogaan degmadaasi. Gudoomiyaha Baarlamaanka iyo wafdigiisa ayaa Sabtidii Afmadow u tegay dardargelinta hawlgalka Al Shabaab lagaga saarayo Gobolada Jubbooyinka.

items.title: Xogta duqeyn culus oo caawa lala beegsaday guri ay ku shirayeen madax Shabaab ah
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Wararka ka imaanaya Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ayaa sheegaya in caawa diyaarado dagaal ay duqeymo culus ka fuliyeen deegaanka Biyo Cadde oo ay weli gacanta ku hayaan maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab. Duqeymo is xig-xigay ayaa ka dhacay gudaha magaalada, iyada oo khasaare lixaad leh lagu gaarsiiyay xubno ka tirsan kooxda, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen ilo wareedyo xilkas ah. Weerarka koowaad ayaa lagu beegsaday guri uu shir uga socday horjoogayaal sar sare oo ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, ayna ku jiraan saraakiil ajaaniib ah, kuwaas oo la sheegay in dhimasho iyo dhaawac ay ku noqdeen duqeynta lala eegtay. Sidoo kale, waxaa la gubay illaa saddex gaari oo nooca dagaalka ah oo tiilay guriga uu shirka uga socday madaxda Al-Shabaab, sida ay sheegeen saraakiil sirdoon oo xog hordhac ah ka bixiyay weerarka. Duqeynta labaad oo iyana ahayd bartilmaameed ayaa lala beegsaday maleeshiyo kale oo gurmad ku yimid, kuwaas oo lasoo wariyay in khasaaro kale lagu gaarsiiyay goobta. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo saaxibada caalamiga ah oo inta badan iska kaashada weerarrada dhanka cirka ah ayaa la filayaa inay faah-faahin ka bixiyaan weerarkan iyo khasaaraha rasmiga ah ee lagu gaarsiiyay Al-Shabaab. Xaaladda Biyo Cadde ayaa caawa ah mid kacsan, iyada oo laga dareemayo raadka duqeymaha culus ee ka dhacay deegaankaas, sidoo kale waxaa ka socda dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo cabsi ku beeray shacabka deegaanka. Maalmihii u dambeeyay deegaannada Maamul Goboleedka HirShabelle, waxaa ka socday guluf ka dhan ah Khawaarijta, iyada oo dib loo bilaabay howlgalladii ka socday labada gobol ee Hiiraan iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe. items.title: Daawo: Guriceel oo dirtay farriin lamid ah tii Dhuusamareeb
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Guriceel ee Gobolka Galgaduud ayaa galabta dirtay farriin lamid ah tii ay shalay dirtay magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimada Galmudug oo si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyay musharraxa Xisbiga JSP ee Galmudug, Liibaan Axmed Xasan (Shuluq). Shacabka Dhuusamareeb ayaa Sabtidii usoo banaanbaxay soo dhaweynta Liibaan Shuluq OO Villa Soomaaliya uu waddo Madaxweynaha Galmudug, iyada oo shacab fara badan iyo masuuliyiin ay la qayb-galeen bandhigaasi siyaasadeed. Si lamid ah Guriceel ayaa Galabta muujisay inay diyaar u tahay doorashada tooska ah ee Galmudug, waxaana wacdaro ka dhigay Xisbiga Towqfiiq ee uu hoggaamiyo Sheekh Maxamed Shaakir Cali Xasan oo taageero wayn ku leh gobollada dhexe. Sheekha ayaa maanta si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyay Guriceel, waxaana soo dhaweyntiisa ka qayb-galay maamulka degmada, waxgaradka deegaanka iyo kumanaan kun oo shacab ah oo isugu baxay bartamaha magaaladaas. Sidoo kale, Isu soo baxa oo u dhacay si nabad ah ayaa ka tarjumaya rajada iyo ka qaybgalka bulshada ee geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka qof iyo codka ah ee ay hadda Dowladda Federaalka ka qaybaneyso maamul-goboleedyada. Sheekh Maxamed Shaakir Cali Xasan oo la hadlay taageerayaashiisa ayaa u mahad-celiyay, sidoo kalena wuxuu ku booriyay ka qayb-galka doorashada. Waxaa kale oo uu ka codsaday in xisbigiisa ay codka siiyaan, sidoo kalena ay soo dhaweeyaan ururrada kale ee tartamaya maadaama la galayo loollan adag. “Ururka Towfiiq codka siiya ururrada kale yaan la qadin far kaliya fool ma dhaqdo waxaan jeclahay inaan is garabsano oo horay loo socdo,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiyaha Xisbiga Towfiiq, Mudane Sheekh Maxamad Shaakir Cali. Dhammaan degmooyinka Galmudug ayaa waxaa haatan si weyn uga socda ololaha doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee maamulkaasi, waxaana socda diyaar garowgii ugu dambeeyay, maadaama dhawaan la guda galayo doorashada. Si kastaba, Doorashadan oo ah mid xasaasi ah ayaa waxaa ka qayb-galaya 35 Xisbi, kuwaas oo hadda olole xooggan ka wada magaalooyinka maamulkaas. The post Daawo: Guriceel oo dirtay farriin lamid ah tii Dhuusamareeb appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Egypt condemns Somaliland’s purported Jerusalem mission during talks with Somalia
items.description: Cairo — Egypt has condemned the self-declared region of Somaliland's opening of a purported embassy in occupied East Jerusalem, describing the move as a violation of international law, while calling for renewed efforts to secure the release of eight Egyptian sailors held by Somali pirates.

items.title: Somalia and Turkey Continue Offshore Oil Drilling as Curad-1 Well Advances
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Somalia and Turkey’s state-owned energy company, Turkish Petroleum Corporation (TPAO), are pressing ahead with drilling operations at the Curad-1 offshore exploration well, with officials expecting the first results of the exploration campaign by the end of 2026. Located approximately 372 kilometers northeast of Mogadishu, Curad-1 is the first offshore oil exploration well to be drilled in Somalia, marking a significant milestone in the country’s long-awaited effort to develop its offshore hydrocarbon resources. The project follows extensive 3D seismic surveys conducted across three offshore blocks, which identified promising geological structures and paved the way for exploratory drilling. The Curad-1 well is expected to reach a depth of nearly 7,500 meters, with drilling operations projected to take approximately 288 days. Somalia’s Minister of Petroleum and Mineral Resources, Dahir Shire Mohamed, said drilling is progressing as planned. He noted that seismic data has already been analyzed and that the current phase focuses on testing Somalia’s first offshore exploration well to determine whether commercially viable hydrocarbon reserves exist. Turkey’s Minister of Energy and Natural Resources, Alparslan Bayraktar, described the operation as Turkey’s first offshore drilling project outside its own territory, calling it a historic milestone in Ankara’s expanding global energy exploration strategy. Somali officials view the project as a potentially transformative opportunity for the country’s economy. If commercially recoverable oil reserves are confirmed, offshore production could significantly boost government revenues, attract foreign investment, create employment opportunities, and strengthen Somalia’s long-term economic self-sufficiency. However, officials caution that no official confirmation has yet been made regarding the discovery of commercially viable oil reserves. The well remains in the exploration phase, and a final assessment is expected only after drilling and technical evaluation have been completed. The outcome of the Curad-1 project is being closely watched by both regional and international energy markets, as it could determine whether Somalia joins the ranks of East Africa’s emerging offshore oil producers. items.title: Somalia Government-Opposition Talks Set to Resume Monday as Political Stakes Rise
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Somalia’s fragile political dialogue between the Federal Government and opposition leaders is expected to resume on Monday, July 20, following a series of separate consultations held by negotiating committees over the past several days. According to sources familiar with the process, both delegations have spent recent hours meeting independently with the political constituencies they represent in an effort to refine their negotiating positions ahead of what is widely viewed as a pivotal round of talks. Insiders say the consultations focused on the most contentious issues still dividing the two sides, including unresolved constitutional disputes, electoral arrangements, and broader questions surrounding Somalia’s political transition. Monday’s meeting is expected to pick up where previous discussions stalled, with negotiators attempting to revive dialogue that has struggled to produce meaningful breakthroughs despite weeks of mediation by international partners. Several members of the opposition’s negotiating team who had recently traveled abroad have now returned to Mogadishu and are expected to participate in the session, signaling the importance both sides attach to the upcoming discussions. Yet beneath the renewed diplomatic activity lies growing uncertainty. Sources close to the negotiations caution that Monday’s meeting could face significant political obstacles, with fundamental differences between the Federal Government and the opposition remaining largely unresolved. Despite continued mediation efforts, there is little indication that either side has substantially softened its position on the core issues at the heart of the dispute. “There is still a considerable gap between the two sides,” one source familiar with the negotiations said. “Unless there is movement from both camps, reaching an agreement will be extremely difficult.” Political observers warn that failure to narrow those differences could not only stall the talks once again but also raise fresh questions about the viability of the mediation process itself. The negotiations come at a particularly sensitive moment for Somalia, where disputes over constitutional legitimacy, electoral models, and the country’s political future continue to dominate the national agenda. With tensions remaining high and expectations mounting, Monday’s session is increasingly being viewed as a critical test of whether dialogue can still provide a pathway toward consensus—or whether Somalia’s political deadlock is destined to deepen. For now, all eyes are on Mogadishu, where the outcome of Monday’s meeting could shape not only the future of the negotiations but also the trajectory of Somalia’s broader political crisis. items.title: Dowladda Federaalka iyo Mucaaradka oo Berri Wada-hadallo Xasaasi ah ka Yeelanaya Hannaanka Doorashooyinka Dalka
items.description: Waxaa la filayaa in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ay berri yeeshaan kulan muhiim ah oo diiradda lagu saarayo hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka, iyadoo beesha caalamka ay si dhow ula socon doonto natiijada wada-hadallada. Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in labada dhinac ay isku raacsan yihiin in Soomaaliya ay u gudubto doorasho toos ah oo ay shacabka si toos ah codkooda ugu doortaan hoggaankooda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa weli taagan khilaaf la xiriira qaabka doorashada loo hirgelinayo. Qodobka ugu weyn ee la isku hayo ayaa ah in doorashada lagu galo nidaamka xisbiyada siyaasadeed ama nidaam qofeysan oo musharraxiintu si madax-bannaan ugu tartamayaan. Sidoo kale, muran ayaa ka taagan qaabka loo dhisayo Guddiga Doorashooyinka. Qaar ka mid ah mucaaradka ayaa soo jeediyay in la sameeyo laba guddi oo kala ah Guddi Doorasho oo heer Federaal ah iyo Guddi Doorasho oo heer dowlad-goboleed, halka xubno kale oo mucaaradka ka tirsan ay qabaan in hal Guddi Doorasho oo qaran uu ku filan yahay maamulka iyo hirgelinta doorashada. Kulankan la filayo inuu qabsoomo berri ayaa loo arkaa mid muhiim u ah mustaqbalka geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka Soomaaliya, waxaana indhaha lagu hayaa in dhinacyadu ay gaaraan is-afgarad horseedi kara hirgelinta doorasho loo dhan yahay.

items.title: Government Forces, Local Militias Ambush Al-Shabaab Fighters in Hiiraan
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Somali government forces, backed by local Macawisley militia fighters, launched a coordinated ambush against suspected Al-Shabaab militants in the Hiraan region, triggering a brief but intense firefight that officials say left several insurgents dead. According to government sources, the operation was launched after intelligence services tracked a group of Al-Shabaab fighters moving from the village of Ceel-la Helay toward Nuur Fanax. Acting on the intelligence, Somali National Army troops and allied local fighters positioned themselves along the militants’ expected route before launching the attack. The ambush reportedly caught the militants by surprise, leading to a fierce exchange of gunfire between the two sides. Government officials claimed the operation was successful, stating that at least seven Al-Shabaab fighters were killed during the clash. However, the casualty figures have not been independently verified, and Al-Shabaab has not commented on the incident. Military sources described the operation as the result of careful planning and coordination between the Somali National Army and Macawisley community fighters, who have become key partners in counterinsurgency operations across central Somalia. A military officer speaking on behalf of the government said similar intelligence-driven operations would continue as part of efforts to weaken Al-Shabaab’s presence throughout Hiiraan. “We will continue conducting targeted operations until Al-Shabaab is eliminated from the areas where it still maintains a presence,” the officer said. Despite the reported success, Al-Shabaab continues to control several locations in Hiraan, including the strategic area of Abooreey, where government forces have launched multiple offensives in recent months without permanently dislodging the group. The latest operation highlights both the growing cooperation between government forces and local militias and the persistent challenge posed by Al-Shabaab, which continues to maintain footholds in parts of central Somalia despite sustained military pressure. items.description: Afgooye (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Booliska Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ee ku sugan degmada Afgooye ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose ayaa maanta gacanta kusoo dhigay koox loo haysto inay gaysteen kufsi iyo dhac, kadib howlgal ka dhacay gudaha degmadaasi. Ragga lasoo qabtay waxaa ku jiro eedeysanayaal kale oo iyaguna ku eedeysan ciyaal-weeranimo iyo inay qalqalgeliyeen amniga degmada, sida lagu sheegay warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Taliska Guud ee Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliya. Bayaanka ciidamada amniga ayaa lagu sheegay in muddo dheer lagu daba jiray raggan, waxaana ugu dambeyn lasoo qabtay maanta oo Axad ah. “Ciidamada Boliiska Soomaaliyeed ee Saldhiga Degmada Afgooye,oo kaashanaya Guutadda 1,aad ee daraawiishta ayaa gacanta kusoo dhigay eedaysanayaal ku eedeysan Ciyaal-weeranimo,Kufsi,dhac iyo qalqalgelin ami kuwaas oo ay ku dabajireen laamaha Amniga Degmada,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Howlgalkan waxaa hoggaaminayay taliye ku xigeenka saldhigga degmada Afgooye, iyada oo eedeysanayaasha la horgeyn maxkamad, si looga qaado tallaabo adag oo sharciga waafaqsan. “Howlagal Boliisku ka sameeyay Waaxda if iyo Aakhiro oo uu hogaaminayay Taliye kuxigeenka Saldhiga X/le Maxamed Xussein Barqadle (Macalin-Qalinle) ayaa lagu soo qabtay eedeysanayaasha,Baaris kadib waxaa la horgeyn doonaa maxkamada awooda u leh,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Afgooye ayaa waxaa muddooyinkan howlgal amni xaqiijin ah ka waday ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan kuwa Booliska ee ku sugan degmadaasi, si looga hortego falalka lagu qalqal-gelinayo nabad-gelyada. Magaaladan oo qiyaastii 30 KM u jirta caasimada Muqdisho ayaa waxaa sidoo kale halis ku haya Al-Shabaab oo inta badan weerarro ku qaada saldhigyada ciidamada dowladda iyo xarumaha maamulka ee ku yaalla halkaas. items.title: The Mediation Trap: Why Somalia’s July 20 Talks Are Doomed Without Coercive International Action
items.description: By Djama Mahamoud Ali For months, Somalia’s political crisis has been the subject of intensive international mediation. Yet the gap between the parties remains as wide as ever, and there is growing evidence that one side is using the process not to reach agreement but to buy time for unilateral actions. The Federal Government of Somalia, under President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, continues to press ahead with the implementation of the unilaterally altered constitution and regional elections that critics describe as pre-determined, while participating in mediation that appears designed to create the illusion of dialogue. The latest round of high-stakes political talks opened in Mogadishu in early July 2026, bringing together the Federal Government and the opposition Somali Future Council. Unlike previous rounds, the negotiations are being facilitated with the direct involvement of Turkey, ambassadors representing several Western nations, the European Union, and the United Nations. A decisive session is set to take place on July 20, 2026. However, expectations are not merely cautious, they are pessimistic . Previous mediation efforts have repeatedly ended with optimistic communiqués but little tangible progress. More troubling, there is a growing recognition that the federal government is participating in these talks not to find common ground but to create diplomatic cover for its unilateral political agenda. As one analysis notes, the mediation “is not a neutral peace process. It is a geopolitical gambit, designed to freeze the clock while Villa Somalia consolidates power under the cover of ‘inclusive dialogue’.” The Current Political Landscape: A Government Negotiating in Bad Faith The Constitutional Crisis At the heart of the current crisis are the constitutional amendments passed on March 4, 2026, when Somalia’s bicameral Federal Parliament approved amendments to chapters five to fifteen of the provisional constitution. These amendments shifted Somalia from a parliamentary system toward a presidential model while extending the presidential term from four years to five. Critically, the extension applies to incumbent office holders, thereby extending the mandates of the Federal Parliament and President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud by one year beyond their previously scheduled expiry dates. The vote was contested, with opposition actors arguing that the amendments may have been passed without the required parliamentary quorum. Former Presidents Sheikh Sharif Ahmed and Mohamed Abdullahi Farmaajo have criticized the amendments, citing a lack of political consensus and warned that they risk further deepening political polarization. Yet despite these objections and despite ongoing mediation, the government has shown no willingness to reconsider. Its position remains fixed: the amendments are lawful and necessary for constitutional governance. This intransigence is the first indication that the government is not approaching negotiations in good faith. Pre-Determined Elections in Galmudug and Beyond The controversy has been particularly acute in South West State, where federal forces reshaped the political landscape, culminating in the installation of a new regional administration following an election that opposition figures argue lacked broad political consensus. Turkish drones reportedly backed the operation that forced President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen to resign. The pattern has now shifted to Galmudug, where the National Electoral Commission has scheduled a presidential election for July 20, 2026, the same day as the internationally mediated talks are set to take place. Critics argue that the outcome has effectively been determined before voting has concluded. Galmudug Parliament Speaker Cali Gacal reportedly stated that the regional administration had virtually no role in managing the election, claiming instead that the process was being directed by the Federal Government only. As one analysis puts it, “Galmudug’s ‘Election’ Is About to Begin, Too Bad the Winner Has Already Been Chosen.” This is not a democratic process; it is a predetermined outcome designed to install a government chosen person. The federal government’s use of “sticks and carrots” in these regional elections mirrors tactics used in Baydhabo. By rewarding allies and punishing opponents, the government has systematically reshaped Federal Member State leadership in its favor, while participating in mediation that ostensibly seeks national consensus. The Negotiations as a Tactic to Buy Time The most troubling aspect of the current situation is the growing evidence that the federal government is using the mediation process not to reach agreement but to buy time for its unilateral consolidation of power. While international mediators facilitate dialogue, the government continues to press ahead with the implementation of the amended constitution, regional elections, and political appointments that reshape Somalia’s federal landscape. Despite of the ongoing negotiations, the President, whose constitutional mandate expired on May 15, 2026, continues to exercise the full powers of office rather than functioning in a caretaker capacity pending a political settlement. In virtually every successful peace process, confidence-building measures come first. Parties are expected to refrain from unilateral actions that could prejudice negotiations or alter political realities before agreements are reached. Somalia’s mediation has so far failed to produce that confidence. The government’s participation in talks serves multiple tactical purposes: · It creates the appearance of a commitment to dialogue · It placates international donors who demand political consensus · It divides the opposition by engaging some factions while excluding others · It provides cover for unilateral actions that would otherwise draw international condemnation · It stalls for time while the government consolidates power in Federal Member States Opposition Divisions The opposition is not united on the way forward. While the Somali Future Council, which brings together Puntland, Jubaland, and the National Salvation Forum, which represents a significant political force, its members are not all participating in the same processes. Puntland and Jubaland have declined to join meetings hosted by Turkish intelligence officials, questioning Ankara’s neutrality. This fragmentation allows the federal government to divide and rule, engaging with some opposition factions while ignoring others. The opposition has not presented a unified alternative vision, and there is no consensus on the sequencing of political transitions, the status of the constitutional amendments, or the role of international actors. The Turkish Mediation Controversy Turkey’s role as mediator has emerged as a major point of contention. Turkish intelligence officials held preliminary talks in early July with representatives of Somalia’s federal government and opposition leaders, but delegates from Puntland and Jubaland boycotted the gathering, insisting Ankara is not a neutral actor. These suspicions are well-founded. Turkey has played a prominent role in Somalia’s affairs in recent years, providing security assistance, development support, and diplomatic engagement with the federal government. Critics point to the alleged use of Turkish-supplied military equipment and elite Somali forces trained by Turkey against opposition-aligned groups. Turkey’s foreign policy in Somalia has been fiercely pragmatic: it backs whoever sits in the presidential palace of Villa Somalia.” This unwritten rule has made Ankara a perennial target for the opposition. The irony is striking: just six years ago, Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, now the incumbent, stood in the opposition and fiercely accused Turkey of arming the National Army to prop up President Farmaajo. The absence of Puntland and Jubaland from Turkey-led talks demonstrates the limits of Turkish mediation. A mediator perceived as having a vested interest in one party’s survival cannot effectively pressure that party to make concessions. Historical Precedents: The Pattern of International Intervention The Farmaajo Government (2017-2022) The international community’s approach to Somalia during President Mohamed Abdullahi Farmaajo’s tenure offers important lessons. In 2021, Farmaajo’s constitutional mandate expired, but he remained in office. The Lower House of Parliament passed a motion to delay elections by two years, effectively extending Farmaajo’s term. The international community responded with coercive measures. The UN Security Council rejected Farmaajo’s term extension and endorsed efforts by the African Union to help parties resolve the electoral impasse. More significantly, the World Bank, the European Union, and the United States threatened to pull the plug on funding. Washington threatened sanctions while the European Union delayed payment of installments of its three-year €100 million budget-support package. The threat of cutting the flow of cash to a government so reliant on donor support had traction with Farmaajo. The lesson is clear: when faced with credible threats to funding and sanctions, Somali governments have made concessions they would not otherwise make. Why the Current Approach Is Failing, The Absence of Coercive Leverage The fundamental problem with the current mediation effort is the absence of meaningful coercive leverage. Unlike during the Farmaajo era, when the international community threatened to cut funding and impose sanctions, the current approach appears to rely primarily on facilitation and encouragement. For the current Federal Government of Somalia, Turkey is the ultimate diplomatic safe haven. Unlike the UN, EU, UK, and US, who during a similar political standoff in 2022 threatened Mogadishu with crippling sanctions to force a specific political roadmap, Ankara has never adopted such measures.The result is a mediation process that provides cover for unilateral actions rather than constraining them. The government can attend talks, make vague commitments, and then continue its consolidation of power without consequence. Bad-Faith Negotiation The government’s use of negotiations to buy time fundamentally undermines the mediation process. When one party is not genuinely seeking agreement, no amount of facilitation will produce results. The international community must recognize this reality and respond accordingly. The telltale signs of bad-faith negotiation are all present: · The government continues unilateral actions during the mediation process · It refuses to freeze the status quo while talks proceed · It engages selectively with opposition factions to divide them · It makes vague commitments without concrete implementation mechanisms · It participates in talks while fundamentally unwilling to compromise on core issues Opposition Fragmentation The opposition’s lack of unity further complicates the situation. While the Somali Future Council represents a significant political force, its members are not all participating in the same processes. Puntland and Jubaland have boycotted Turkey-led talks while participating in broader international engagements. This fragmentation allows the federal government to divide and rule. The government can claim it is engaging with the opposition while avoiding meaningful negotiations with the most critical actors, Puntland and Jubaland. Recommendations for the International Community Given this complex situation, the international community must fundamentally rethink its approach. I would like to offer the following recommendations for the United States, the United Kingdom, Turkey, the United Nations, and other international actors involved in the Somali mediation process. 1. Recognize Bad-Faith Negotiation and Respond Accordingly The international community must publicly acknowledge that the federal government is using negotiations as a tactic to buy time. This recognition should inform all subsequent engagement. Rather than continuing to facilitate dialogue as if both parties were negotiating in good faith, international actors should call out bad-faith behavior and impose consequences. This means conditioning continued mediation on a freeze of unilateral actions. The government should be given a clear choice: suspend the implementation of the unilaterally amended constitution and regional elections, or face consequences. This is not an unreasonable demand; it is standard practice in peace processes worldwide. 2. Restore Coercive Leverage The international community must be willing to impose costs on parties that reject a negotiated settlement. For the federal government, this means credible threats to: · Withhold budgetary support · Impose sanctions on individuals undermining the political process · Suspend security cooperation · Freeze development assistance Somalia remains heavily dependent on international financial support; the threat of cutting off this flow of cash remains the most powerful tool available. As the Farmaajo precedent demonstrates, such threats have traction. For the opposition, leverage includes the threat of withdrawing political recognition, withholding support for alternative political structures, and conditioning future engagement on participation in good faith negotiations. 3. Abandon the Facilitative Model and Impose a Proposed Solution The international community cannot continue to simply facilitate dialogue while hoping the parties will find common ground. Historical experience demonstrates that Somali political actors do not make concessions voluntarily. The international community must propose a concrete political settlement and use its leverage to secure acceptance. This proposed solution should address the core issues: · The status of the constitutional amendments · The electoral calendar and sequencing · The transition of power · The role of Federal Member States in national decision-making The solution should be developed in consultation with all stakeholders but ultimately presented as a take-it-or-leave-it proposal backed by consequences for rejection. 4. Demand a Freeze on Unilateral Actions Any meaningful mediation process must include a freeze on unilateral political actions. The international community should demand that the federal government: · Suspend all electoral processes in Federal Member States until a national consensus is reached · Halt the implementation of unitarily amended constitution pending negotiation · Cease political interference in Federal Member State affairs Similarly, the opposition should be required to refrain from establishing parallel political structures. The international community must be willing to enforce this freeze through the leverage described above. 5. Insist on Genuine, Inclusive Participation The mediation process must include all major stakeholders, including Puntland, Jubaland, and all opposition factions. The exclusion of key actors, whether through their own boycott or through deliberate exclusion, undermines the legitimacy of any agreement. The international community should make clear that it will not recognize or support any political arrangement that excludes major stakeholders. This applies equally to federal government unilateral actions and to opposition parallel processes. 6. Establish Implementation Guarantees with Consequences Previous mediation efforts have repeatedly ended with optimistic communiqués but little tangible progress. Any agreement reached must be backed by meaningful guarantees for implementation. This should include: · International monitoring mechanisms with teeth · Benchmarks with clear timelines · Consequences for non-compliance, including sanctions and funding cuts. 7. Publicly Name and Shame Bad-Faith Behavior The international community should be willing to publicly name and shame actions that undermine the mediation process. When the government conducts pre-determined elections during negotiations, this should be called out. When it uses constitutional amendments to extend its mandate unilaterally, this should be condemned. Conclusion Somalia stands at a critical juncture. The July 20, 2026, talks represent another opportunity to resolve the country’s deepening political crisis. However, if the international community approaches these talks with the same facilitative mindset that has characterized previous efforts, the outcome is likely to be worse than failure, it will provide cover for continued unilateral consolidation of power. The historical record is clear. During the Farmaajo government, the international community imposed a solution by coercion and leverage and it worked. The current situation is more difficult because one party is not negotiating in good faith. The government is using mediation as a tactic to buy time while it reshapes Somalia’s federal landscape through unilateral actions. The opposition is divided. One of the mediators is perceived as biased. In these circumstances, the international community cannot simply facilitate. It must recognize bad-faith behavior, restore coercive leverage, impose a proposed solution, and demand a freeze on unilateral actions. If the international community does not use sticks and carrots and does not propose a solution, the government and opposition have no appetite to make concessions and reach agreement. The July 20 talks risk becoming another exercise in diplomatic theater, another performance in which the audience already knows the final scene before the first act begins. The international community must choose: continue the mediation trap of endless facilitation without results, or adopt a more assertive strategy that combines coercive leverage with a concrete proposed settlement. For many Somalis, patience is wearing thin. The country is demanding results. The international community must rise to the occasion, not with more facilitation, but with the courage to impose consequences on those who undermine the peace process. When it uses constitutional amendments to extend its mandate unilaterally, this should be condemned. Conclusion Somalia stands at a critical juncture. The July 20, 2026, talks represent another opportunity to resolve the country’s deepening political crisis. However, if the international community approaches these talks with the same facilitative mindset that has characterized previous efforts, the outcome is likely to be worse than failure, it will provide cover for continued unilateral consolidation of power. The historical record is clear. During the Farmaajo government, the international community imposed a solution by coercion and leverage and it worked. The current situation is more difficult because one party is not negotiating in good faith. The government is using mediation as a tactic to buy time while it reshapes Somalia’s federal landscape through unilateral actions. The opposition is divided. One of the mediators is perceived as biased. In these circumstances, the international community cannot simply facilitate. It must recognize bad-faith behavior, restore coercive leverage, impose a proposed solution, and demand a freeze on unilateral actions. If the international community does not use sticks and carrots and does not propose a solution, the government and opposition have no appetite to make concessions and reach agreement. The July 20 talks risk becoming another exercise in diplomatic theater, another performance in which the audience already knows the final scene before the first act begins. The international community must choose: continue the mediation trap of endless facilitation without results, or adopt a more assertive strategy that combines coercive leverage with a concrete proposed settlement. For many Somalis, patience is wearing thin. The country is demanding results. The international community must rise to the occasion, not with more facilitation, but with the courage to impose consequences on those who undermine the peace process. items.title: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka oo gaaray Dhuusamareeb, iyadoo Gaalkacyo dib looga furay bixinta kaararka codbixiyeyaasha
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha, Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan, ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimadda Galmudug, si uu u kormeero howlaha diyaar-garowga doorashooyinka qof iyo codka. Booqashada Guddoomiyaha ayaa ku soo beegmeysa xilli Guddigu uu dardargelinayo hirgelinta howlaha doorashooyinka ee deegaannada Galmudug. Isla maanta, Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale dib u furay bixinta kaararka codbixiyeyaasha doorashooyinka qof iyo codka ee degmada Gaalkacyo, si loo sii ambaqaado diyaarinta doorashada. Waxaa la filayaa in Guddoomiyaha uu kulamo la yeesho mas’uuliyiinta Galmudug iyo saraakiisha Guddiga Doorashooyinka, isagoo kormeer ku sameyn doona xarumaha iyo habsami u socodka howlaha diiwaangelinta iyo bixinta kaararka codbixiyeyaasha. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ee lagu xaqiijinayo qabsoomidda doorashooyinka qof iyo codka, iyadoo shacabka lagu dhiirrigelinayo inay qaataan kaararkooda codbixinta si ay uga qeyb qaataan doorashada.
