items.description: HARGEISA, Somaliland | Ambassador Charles King visited the world-renowned Laas Geel archaeological site in Somaliland, where he explored some of the oldest and best-preserved prehistoric rock paintings in Africa. During the visit, Ambassador King toured the ancient caves, which feature vibrant rock art estimated to be more than 5,000 years old. The paintings offer remarkable snapshots of prehistoric life, depicting cattle, wild animals, and early human communities that once inhabited the region. Laas Geel is widely regarded as one of Somaliland’s most significant cultural and historical treasures, attracting researchers, archaeologists, and visitors from around the world. The site provides valuable insight into the rich heritage and ancient civilization of the Horn of Africa. The ambassador’s visit highlights the growing international interest in Somaliland’s unique archaeological heritage and the importance of preserving historic sites for future generations while promoting cultural tourism.     The Times of Somaliland

items.title: Madaxweyne Deni oo Si Kulul uga Hadlay Xaaladda Dekedda Boosaaso, Digniinna u Diray Ganacsatada iyo Shacabka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa si adag uga hadlay wararka la xiriira xirnaanshaha Dekedda Boosaaso, isagoo sheegay in dekeddu ay si caadi ah u shaqeyneyso isla markaana aysan jirin wax hakad ah oo ku yimid howlaha muhiimka ah ee dekedda. Madaxweyne Deni ayaa sheegay in xoolihii dhoofinta loo waday ay si caadi ah uga baxayaan dekedda, halka shidaalkiina uu si joogto ah uga soo degayo, isagoo beeniyay wararka sheegaya in Dekedda Boosaaso ay gebi ahaanba xiran tahay. “Dekedda Boosaaso ma xirna, xoolihiibaa dhoofaya, shidaalkiina waa soo degayaa. Wararka la faafiyay waa warar sal iyo raad toona lahayn,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Deni. Madaxweynaha ayaa dhinaca kale digniin culus u diray ganacsatada iyo shacabka Puntland, isagoo ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan faafinta wararka aan la hubin ee saameyn kara dhaqaalaha iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli ay weli taagan yihiin muranno iyo cabashooyin la xiriira canshuuraha iyo khidmadaha cusub ee lagu soo rogay badeecadaha soo gala Dekedda Boosaaso, kuwaas oo sababay xiisad u dhexeysa dowladda Puntland iyo qeyb ka mid ah ganacsatada. Dekedda Boosaaso ayaa ah halbowlaha ganacsiga Puntland, waxaana ay door muhiim ah ka qaadataa soo dejinta badeecadaha daruuriga ah iyo dhoofinta xoolaha nool ee loo iib geeyo suuqyada dibadda.

items.title: Kenya oo Muddo Kordhin u Samaysay Tallaabada lagu Dhimay Cashuurta Shidaalka si loo Yareeyo Sicir-bararka
items.description: NAIROBI, Kenya — Dowladda dalka Kenya ayaa si rasmi ah u ku dhawaaqday inay saddex bilood oo dheeri ah kordhisay muddada uu soconayo dhimista lagu sameeyay cashuurta qiimaha ku darma ee (VAT) ee laga qaado waxyaabaha batroolka ka kooban. Tallaabadan ayaa qayb ka ah qorshe ballaaran oo ay dowladda dalkaas ku doonayso inay ku xakamayso saamaynta taban ee ka dhalan karta isbedbeddelka joogtada ah ee qiimaha tamarta ee suuqyada caalamiga ah. Sida uu sheegay Wasiirka Tamarta iyo Batroolka Kenya, Opiyo Wandayi, go’aankan waxaa la qaatay ka dib wadatashi lala sameeyay Wasaaradda Maaliyadda si loo ilaaliyo fayo-qabka dhaqaale ee qoysaska iyo ganacsiyada dalka. Sida lagu caddeeyay go’aanka rasmiga ah, cashuurta laga qaado alaabta batroolka ayaa laga dhex dhigay 8% halkii ay markii hore ka ahayd 16%. Hoos-u-dhigistan oo markii hore la meelmariyay bishii Abriil ee sannadkan ka dib markii uu kor u kacay qiimaha saliidda sababo la xiriira colaadda Bariga Dhexe, ayaa hadda si rasmi ah u sii socon doonta ilaa badhtamaha bisha Oktoobar ee soo socota. Tallaabadan ayaa dowladda Kenya u oggolaanaysaa inay ka fogaato kor u kac kedis ah oo ku yimaada qiimaha gaadiidka, korontada, iyo agabka aasaasiga ah ee nolosha. Nidaamka maareynta qiimaha shidaalka ee dalkan ku yaalla Bariga Afrika ayaa sidoo kale lagu xoojiyay kabitaan dhaqaale oo dheeri ah. Wasiir Wandayi ayaa xaqiijiyay in dowladda ay u qoondeysay lacag dhan 945 milyan oo shilin oo u dhiganta ($7.31 milyan oo doollar) oo laga soo minguuriyay Sanduuqa Horumarinta Batroolka si loo xasiliyo qiimaha shidaalka ee suuqyada dalka inta lagu guda jiro wareegga xiga. Dowladda Kenya ayaa rajo weyn ka qabta in go’aamadan isbarkan ay qayb ka noqdaan xasilloonida guud ee dhaqaalaha dalka, gaar ahaan xilli ay wali jiraan caqabado xagga dhoofinta shidaalka ah oo ka taagan marin-biyoodka caalamiga ah ee Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Sacuudiga oo kordhiyay taageerada milatari ee Soomaaliya – Maxaa socda?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa si muuqata u kordhisay taageeradeeda dhinaca milatariga ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo dhaqan-gelinaysa heshiis iskaashi oo dhanka difaaca ah oo ay labada dal kala saxiixdeen bishii Febraayo ee sanadkan, taas oo qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo iskaashiga amniga ee u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Riyaad. Heshiiska labada dhinac ayaa diiradda saaraya horumarinta wada-shaqeynta difaaca, tababarrada ciidamada, is-dhaafsiga khibradaha milatari iyo kor u qaadista awoodda hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliyeed. Inkastoo aan weli si rasmi ah loo shaacin faah-faahinta dhammaan qodobada heshiiska, haddana waxaa muuqata in fulintiisu ay si tartiib-tartiib ah u bilaabatay. Dhawaan, wafdi militari oo ka socday dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa booqday laba xero oo ku yaalla magaalada Guriceel ee gobolka Galgaduud, kuwaas oo lagu tababarayo ciidamo hoos taga dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Booqashada ayaa qeyb ka aheyd barnaamij ay maalgelinayso dowladda Sacuudiga, kaas oo lagu tababarayo cutubyo cusub oo la qorsheynayo inay ku biiraan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Xogaha la helayo ayaa sheegaya in barnaamijku uu gaarsiisan yahay tababarka 5,107 askari, kuwaas oo ku kala sugan labada xero ee uu wafdiga Sacuudigu booqday. Askartaas waxaa la sheegay inay ku jiraan ku dhowaad 2,000 oo dhalinyaro ah oo laga soo qoray deegaannada Puntland, halka ciidamada kale laga soo ururiyey gobollo kala duwan oo dalka ah. Tababarka ayaa la qorsheeyey inuu socdo muddo sagaal bilood ah, si ciidamada loo siiyo xirfadaha aasaasiga ah ee militariga, nidaamka hawlgallada iyo tababarrada la xiriira dagaalka. Sida ay wararku tilmaamayaan, tababarka ciidamada waxaa bixinaya khubaro iyo tababarayaal ajaanib ah oo ka kala yimid dalalka Romania, Ukraine, Koonfur Afrika iyo Colombia. Barnaamijkan ayaa la sheegay in uu si buuxda u maalgelinayo Sacuudi Carabiya, taas oo muujinaysa doorka sii kordhaya ee boqortooyadu ku leedahay dib u dhiska ciidamada Soomaaliya. Taageeradan cusub ayaa Sacuudiga ka dhigaysa inuu si toos ah u ballaarinayo saameyntiisa amni iyo mid milatari ee Soomaaliya. Sanadihii la soo dhaafay, dalalka Khaliijka ayaa si isa soo taraysa u maalgelinayay tababarrada ciidamada iyo mashaariicda amniga, iyagoo doonaya inay xoojiyaan xiriirkooda istaraatiijiyadeed ee Geeska Afrika. Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa muddo dheer ka mid ahaa waddamada ugu firfircoon dhinaca amniga Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan Puntland. Tan iyo horraantii sanadkii 2010-kii, Abu Dhabi waxay taageero joogto ah siinaysay Ciidanka Booliska Badda Puntland (PMPF), iyadoo u fidisay maalgelin, tababarro iyo qalab ciidan oo casri ah. Wararka ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamaya in ciidamada Imaaraadka ay saldhig ku leeyihiin magaalada Boosaaso, halkaas oo ay taageero dhinaca cirka ah ka geysteen hawl-galladii lagu beegsaday kooxda Daacish ee ka socday buuraha Calmiskaad. Taageeradaas ayaa lagu sheegay inay door muhiim ah ka qaadatay guulihii laga gaaray dagaalka lagula jiray kooxda. Si kastaba, xiriirka u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa galay marxalad adag, kadib markii dowladda Soomaaliya ay bishii Janaayo ee sanadkan joojisay heshiisyadii dekedaha iyo iskaashigii amniga ee ay la lahayd Abu Dhabi. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa ku eedeysay Imaaraadka inuu qaaday tallaabooyin wiiqaya madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dalka. Kororka taageerada milatari ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa imanaya xilli Soomaaliya ay sii waddo dadaallada lagu dhisayo ciidan qaran oo awood u leh inuu la wareego mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka, iyadoo taageero ka helaysa saaxiibada caalamiga ah. Haddii barnaamijyada tababarka iyo iskaashiga cusub ay si guul leh u hirgalaan, waxay door weyn ka qaadan karaan xoojinta awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed iyo dardar-gelinta dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada. items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo afar qodob hordhigay Golihiisa Wasiirrada + Sawirro
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha cusub ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa maanta macsalaameeyay Wasiirradii hore ee maamulka, isaga oo kuwa cusubna hordhigay 4 qodob oo xasaasi ah. Aadan Madoobe oo kulan gaar ah la yeeshay golaha xukuumaddii hore ayaa uga mahadceliyey doorkii ay ka soo qaateen dhismaha iyo horumarinta dowladnimada Koonfur Galbeed, isaga oo xusay in dowladdu ay ka faa’iideysan doonto khibradaha iyo talooyinka masuuliyiinta hore si loo dardargeliyo adeegyada bulshada iyo horumarka guud ee dowladnimada. Dhankooda Wasiiraddii hore ayaa bogaadiyey hoggaanka cusub, iyaga oo muujiyey sida ay uga go’an tahay inay la shaqeeyaan, kana qeyb qaataan dadaallada lagu xoojinayo nabadda, dib-u-heshiisiinta, midnimada bulshada iyo horumarka deegaannada Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed. Sidoo kale, Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaa kulan kale oo gaar ah la yeeshay Wasiirrada cusub ee Koonfur Galbeed ee uu dhowaan magacaabay, isaga oo kala hadlay dardar-gelinta howlaha horyaalla xukuumadda iyo hirgelinta qorshayaasha horumarineed ee Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed. Waxaa kale oo kulanka diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta wada-shaqeynta Golaha Wasiirrada, dardargelinta adeegyada bulshada, adkeynta maamul-wanaagga, isla markaana la isku waafajiyo qorsheyaasha Wasaaradaha si ay u noqdaan kuwo wax ku ool ah oo ka jawaaba baahiyaha shacabka Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed. Intaas kadib Aadan Madoobe ayaa Golihiisa Wasiirrada kula dardaarmay 4 qodob oo xasaasi ah, kuwaas oo kala inay si hufan oo daacadnimo leh u gutaan waajibaadkooda, sidoo kale mudnaan in ay siiyaan deegga bulshada, isla-xisaabtanka, iyo fulinta barnaamijyada horumarineed ee Dowladda. Ugu dambeyn, Wasiirrada magacaaban ayaa uga mahadceliyey Hoggaamiyaha kalsoonida uu siiyey, waxayna ballanqaadeen inay si wadajir ah uga shaqeyn doonaan horumarinta hay’adaha Dowladda, kor u qaadidda adeegyada bulshada, iyo xaqiijinta himilooyinka Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed. items.title: Cunno xumo ka dhalatay ayax burburiyay dalag u beernaa beeraleyda Mudug
items.description: (ERGO) – In ka badan 80 beeraley ah ayaa xaalado adag oo dhanka nolosha ah ku wajahaya deegaanka Xero-dhagaxley ee gobolka Mudug tan iyo bishii April. Ayax ka cunay dalagyo ay goosasho ku dawaa iyo waraab yari isku raacay ayaa meesha ka saaray tacabkoodii. Waxay dabooli la’yihiin baahiyahooda aas-aasiga ah, iyadoo daymo loo haysto. Ceelkii ay ka cabi jireen ayaa cilladoobay 4 bil ka hor, mana helin dayac-tir. Waxay iibsan la’yihiin biyo qaali ah oo laga keeno mid gaar ah oo tuulada u jira qiyaasti 10 km. Cabdimaciin Axmed Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in Ayaxu ka baabi’iyay yaanyo, basal, karooto, barbarooni, liin, saytuun iyo noocyo kale oo khudaar ah. Wuxuu xusay in ay ka gashay $1,300 oo inta badan uu amaahday. “Tacab iska daaye geedihii ayaa qallalay. Ayaxa waa mid geedi ah oo ilmo meesha uga tagay iyo mid dhirta isaga jira oo waxkasta ku dagaya. Baaga-muudo ayaan u noqnonay.” Deegaanka Xero-dhagaxley oo dhaca bariga fog ee gobolka Mudug dadka ku nool waxay ku tiirsan yihiin wax soo saarka. Caqabadahaan isku biirsaday ayaa saamayn weyn ku yeeshay noloshooda. Xaaladan ka hor waxay dalagyadooda u iib gayn jireen magaalooyinka Hobyo, Wisil iyo meelo kale. Cabdimaciin ayaa sheegay in dalagyadii ay dhamaadkii Fabraayo galiyeen beerahooda aysan waxba uga badbaadin. Dadkaan oo u badan danyar wuxuu sheegay in aysan u sahlanayn fursad kale oo ay noloshooda ku maareeyaan. Ninkan ayaa tilmaamay in 3 bil ee ugu danbaysay ay ku adkaatay in uu qoyskiisa u helo cunno ku filan. Hal mar ayay dabka ku shitaan kiilooyin raashin ah oo dayn ay uga soo qaataan dukaamo tuulada ku yaalla oo mararka qaar looga diido. “Wax badan ayaa isbeddelay nolosha, waa garan kartaa qoyska biyo, cunno, daawo iyo waxbarasho ayuu u baahan yahay. Casho kali ah ayaa la helaa. Maalinba qof ayaa dayn laga soo qaadaa.” Cabdimaciin ayaa sheegay in beertiisa oo 2 hektar ah uu ka heli jiray bishii ugu yaraan $700. Sanadkii 2023 ayuu ku billaabay $500 oo ahayd dayn uu dib ka guday. Tacbashada ayuu doortay, markii saamaynta abaarta ay ku dhaafeen labo boqol oo neef oo ari iyo geel isugu jira oo miyig ay ku dhaqanayeen. Qoyskiis oo 10 qof ah iyo shan neef oo ari ah oo u joogta ayuu u iibin la’yahay biyo halkii fuusto la siiyo $5. Dadka awooda ayuu sheegay in ay hal caag ka soo baryaan maalintii, kaas oo aan ku filnayn. Waxaa ka waxbarasho beelay labo carruurtiisa ah oo dugsi Qur’aan iyo iskuul hoose deegaanka uga dhiganayay. Labo kale oo dugsi sare ku jira wuxuu u geeyay walalkiis Gaalkacyo degan oo bishii ka bixiya min $10, maaddaama uusan isagu u awoodin. Dhanka kale Xaafid Cabdi Siyaad oo dadkaaan ka mid ah ayaa sheegay in nacfi beelka ku dhacay beertiisa oo 1.5 ah ay dhan dhaqaale iyo nololeed ka saamaysay qoyskiisa oo 7 qof ah. Dalagyo isugu jiray raashin iyo khudaar dhowr nooc ah oo bishii labaad uu abuurtay ayuusan waxba ka faa’iidin. Waxaa kaga baxday $1,200 oo $800 ay dayn ahayd, taas oo ku sii kordhisay culaysyada haysta. Xaaladahan isku biirsaday dartood wuxuu qoyskiisa u la’yahay cunno joogto ah iyo baahiyahooda kale ee nolosha. “Dhaqaalaha xagiisa ayay iga saamaysay oo nolol-maalmeedka reerka ayaa iigu daran. Meeshii aan wax ka helaynay waa joogsatay, baahiyah waa badan yihiin abaarta ayaa biyo la’aan na dhigtay.”  Xaafid ayaa sheegay in qoyskiisa ay ku tiirsan yihiin kaalmo aan joogto ahayn oo marmar ay siiyaan ehelkooda degan Gaalkacyo iyo Hobyo oo ay u dan sheegtaan. Waxay ugu badnaan ka helaan hal ama labo dollar oo hal mar ay dabka ku shitaan, maaddaama aysan doorasho kale haysan. Wuxuu tilmaamay in dukaamo deegaanka ku yaalla oo macaamiil uu ka ahaa ay buugiisa xireen, markii ay ku yeeshaan in ka badan $300 oo uusan awoodin bixinteeda. Waxaa intaas u dheer qarashkii uu beerta galiyay oo dadkii ku lahaa ay ka doonayaan. Ninkaan ayaa sheegay in tacabka meesha ka baxay uu ahaa isha ugu muhiimsan ee uu qoyskiisa ku maarayn jiray. Waxay ku tiirsanaayeen in ka badan 8 sano, mana jirto meel kale oo dhaqaale uu ka soo galo. Wuxuu xusay in ay beertiisa isugu darsameen ayax, cayayaan kale iyo biyo la’aanta. “Wuu tiro badan yahay kama jafi kartid habeen iyo maalin isku si waaye. Biyo yarida darteeda geedo badan ayaa ku dhintay. Daawada cayayaanka iyo abuurna ma haysano.” Wuxuu tilmaamay in aysan ood iyo silig midna lahayn oo xooluhu ay dhex marayaan, taas oo sababaysa in xitaa haddii uu biyo helo uusan waxba beeran karin illaa si guud loo dayac-tiro. Wuxu shaqooyin xamaal ah ka raadiyaa meelaha dhagax laga guro. Toddobaadka dhan $3 ayuu ka helaa ama wuu soo waayaa. Wuxuu xusay in beerta ka xumaatay ay ahayd waxa kali ah ee uu yaqaanay ayna isku maaraynayeen muddo dheer. Intii ay caqabadan dhaqaale haysay waxaa waxbarashada ka haray saddex carruur ah oo dhiganayay iskuul hoose. sheegay inuusan afar bil bixin min $10 oo laga qaadi jiray, taas oo isku gaartay $160. Dhamaadkii bishii May ayaa laga soo eryay. “Bishii markii ay dhamaato oo lacagta keen la I dhaho anna aanan waxba hayn oo hala I sugu aan iri. Dhowr bil markii ay isku gaartay waxna aan keeni waayay waa la soo diray oo guriga ha kuu joogaan ayaa la I dhahay.” Guddoomiye ku xigeenka iskaashatada beeraleyda Xero-dhagaxley Liibaan Siciid Siyaad ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in wax-soosaarka beeraha oo hoos u dhacay uu ku sababay nolol xumo iyo dhaqaale burbur. Dadkaan oo horay u ahaa danyar ayuu xusay in ay xaaladu ku adag tahay. “Waa dareemi kartaa dad muruq-maal ah oo subaxdii beerahooda falan jiray wixii ay ka soo gurtaana suuqa gaysan jiray oo aysan waxba u soo go’in. Dhibaato, burbur iyo barakac ayaa ka dhashay. Masaaariiftii qoysku heli jiray ma jirto hadda, taasna waa dhibaato weyn.” Beeraleyda deegaanka Xero-dhagaxley waxay wajahayaan xaalado isbiirsaday oo ay ku adag tahay ka soo kabashadoodu. Culaysyadaan ayaa ku sababay in ay ka niyad jabaan tacabka oo sanooyin badan ay ku soo jireen saldhigna u ahaa noloshooda. items.title: Uganda oo ogolaatay inay ka qayb qaadato howlgalka nabad-ilaalinta ee Gaza
items.description: Kampala – Dowladda Uganda ayaa si mabda’ ah u muujisay diyaar garow ay uga qayb qaadanayso howlgal caalami ah oo nabad-ilaalin ah oo la qorsheynayo in laga hirgeliyo Marinka Gaza, kaddib codsi uu soo jeediyay Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump . Sida uu qoray wargeyska New Vision ee ka soo baxa magaalada Kampala, mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Uganda ayaa sheegay in dalkoodu diyaar u yahay inuu ka qayb qaato dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagu xasilinayo Gaza . Go’aankan ayaa muhiim u ah, sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo cusub oo Uganda ku soo biirayso howlgallada nabad-ilaalinta ee ka baxsan qaaradda Afrika, iyadoo Gaza ay wajahayso xaalad bani’aadantinimo oo aad u adag. Howlgalka la qorsheynayo ayaa la filayaa inuu ku biiro dalal ay ka mid yihiin Morocco, Kazakhstan, Kosovo iyo Albania, kuwaas oo ballan qaaday inay ka qaybqaataan howlgalka . Howlgalka la qorsheynayo ayaa la sheegay inuu diiradda saari doono sugidda amniga, ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah, fududeynta gaarsiinta gargaarka bini’aadantinimo, iyo taageeridda dadaallada dib loogu soo celinayo adeegyada aasaasiga ah ee Gaza . Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa qorshahan ku ansixiyay qaraar ay soo saareen bishii Noofambar 2025, iyadoo 13 dal ay u codeeyeen, halka Shiinaha iyo Ruushku ay ka aamuseen . Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni ayaa si wanaagsan uga jawaabay codsiga Mareykanka, waxaana la filayaa inuu bixiyo hagitaan istiraatiiji ah oo ku saabsan tirada ciidamada iyo doorka ay ciidamada Uganda ka qaadan doonaan howlgalka . Taliyaha Ciidanka Difaaca Uganda, General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, ayaa hore u sheegay in Uganda ay taageerto Israel, taas oo keentay in la isweydiiyo sida ay ciidamada Uganda u ahaan karaan kuwo dhexdhexaad ah howlgalkan . Marinka Gaza ayaa weli wajahaya xaalad bani’aadantinimo oo aad u adag, waxaana kumannaan qoys ay ku barakaceen dagaallada iyo burburka baahsan ee saameeyay deegaanka. Qaramada Midoobay waxay ku baaqday in la helo xabbad-joojin waarta iyo dib-u-dhis lagu sameeyo Gaza, iyadoo Uganda ay tahay mid ka mid ah dalalka taageera dadaalladaas . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dadka qaarkood ayaa ka digay in Uganda ay khatar ku jirto inay lumiso kalsoonideeda dhexdhexaadnimada, gaar ahaan marka loo eego hadallada Taliyaha Ciidanka ee taageeraya Israel . Waa arrin la filayo in ay sii socoto doodo ku saabsan ka qaybgalka Uganda howlgalkan, iyadoo ay weli jiraan su’aalo ku saabsan sida ay ciidamadu uga qaybqaadan doonaan iyo haddii ay jiraan caddayn cilmiyeed oo xaqiijinaysa inay yihiin kuwo dhexdhexaad ah. items.title: Hoggaamiye Aadan Madoobe oo kulan la qaatay wasiirrada magacaaban ee Koonfur Galbeed
items.description: Baydhabo (Raxanreeb Online) Hoggaamiyaha dowlad goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa kulan la qaatay Wasiirrada cusub ee uu dhowaan magacaabay si loo dardargeliyo howlaha horyaalla Xukuumadda iyo hirgelinta qorshayaasha horumarineed ee dowlad goboleedyadka Koonfur Galbeed. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta wada-shaqeynta Golaha Wasiirrada, dardargelinta adeegyada bulshada, adkeynta maamul-wanaagga, isla markaana la isku waafajiyo qorsheyaasha Wasaaradaha si ay u noqdaan kuwo wax ku ool ah oo ka jawaaba baahiyaha shacabka Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed. Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed Shekh Aadan Madoobe, ayaa Wasiirrada kula dardaarmay inay si hufan oo daacadnimo leh u gutaan waajibaadkooda, iyagoo mudnaanta siinaya adeegga bulshada, isla-xisaabtanka, iyo fulinta barnaamijyada horumarineed ee Dowladda. Wasiirrada Magacaaban ayaa uga mahadceliyey Hoggaamiyaha kalsoonida uu siiyey, waxayna ballanqaadeen inay si wadajir ah uga shaqeyn doonaan horumarinta hay’adaha Dowladda, kor u qaadidda adeegyada bulshada, iyo xaqiijinta himilooyinka maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. The post Hoggaamiye Aadan Madoobe oo kulan la qaatay wasiirrada magacaaban ee Koonfur Galbeed appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Shacabka Dhuusamareeb oo tallaabo ka qaaday askari gaystay fal caro leh + Video
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa waxaa laga helayaa dhacdo cajiib ah oo ay si deg-deg ah uga falceliyeen shacabka Dhuusamareeb, kadib markii askari ka tirsan ciidamada dowladda uu maanta goob fagaare ugu gacan qaaday wiil Caseeye ah, taas oo dhalisay caro xooggan. Askariga oo ku sugnaa maqaayad ku taalla bartamaha caasimada Galmudug ayaa dharbaaxo ku dhuftay wiilka Baalashlaha. Arrintaas ayaa dhalisay inay ka caroodaan shacabkii ku sugnaa goobta oo iyaguna qaaday tallaabo deg-deg ah. Dhalinyaro ku sugnayd goobta uu falku ka dhacay ayaa durbo qabtay askariga, kadibna ka qaaday qorayga, iyada oo si weyn loogu bogaadiyay sida ay uga falceliyeen falka. Dhacdadan ayaa noqotay mid si weyn loogu hadal hayo baraha bulshada, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah dadka ka falceliyay ay ku tilmaameen in shacabka ay muujiyeen diidmo ka dhan ah tacaddiga loo gaystay wiilka yar ee usoo baxay inuu u shaqeeyo reerkiisa. Dadweynaha ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqay in dhacdada loo maro waddo sharci ah, isla markaana tallaabo adag laga qaado askariga xadgudubka gaystay. Xamdi Cali “Soomaalida waxaa ku jeclahey damiirka guuleysata meel kasta oo aad joogtaan Soomaaliyeey”. Maxamed Axmed: “Kaas cidda markii horeba Qoriga u dhiibtay ayaa qaldanayd”. Cabdinaasir Saciid Sandheere: “Askar maahan waa mooryaan hala xiro”. Si kastaba ha’ahaatee, Ilaa iyo hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay hay’adaha ammaanka Dhuusamareeb iyo mas’uuliyiinta Galmudug oo ku aadan falka dhacay iyo haddii tallaabo sharci laga qaadayo askariga gaystay. The post Shacabka Dhuusamareeb oo tallaabo ka qaaday askari gaystay fal caro leh + Video appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maraykanka oo dib u soo celiyey xannibaadda dekedaha Iiraan, weerarro cusubna ka fuliyey dalkaas
items.description: Xiisadda u dhaxaysa Maraykanka iyo Iiraan ayaa mar kale cirka isku shareertay, kadib markii Maraykanku dib u soo rogay xannibaad dhinaca badda ah oo lagu hayo dekedaha Iran, wax ka yar bil kadib markii labada dal ay kala saxiixdeen heshiis is-afgarad (MoU) oo loo arkayay tallaabo lagu yareynayo colaadda. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Maraykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay inuu qaaday weerarro cusub oo socday ku dhawaad toddobo saacadood, kuwaas oo lagu beegsaday goobo militari, xarumo gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn (drones), awoodaha ciidamada badda iyo difaacyada xeebaha ee Iran, gaar ahaan agagaarka marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Dhinaca Iran, warbaahinta dowladda ayaa sheegtay in gantaallo Maraykan ah ay ku dhaceen xarumo ku yaalla magaalooyinka Chabahar iyo Bampur. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Iran ayaa sheegtay in weerarradaasi ay ku dhaawacmeen in ka badan 260 qof, halka in ka badan 30 qof oo rayid ah ay ku dhinteen. Iiraan oo weerarro aargoosi ah qaaday Ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka Iiraan (IRGC) ayaa sheegay inay habeenkii ku qaadeen weerarro isugu jira gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn saldhigyo iyo hanti militari oo Maraykan leeyahay oo ku yaalla Baxrayn, Kuweyt iyo Urdun. Kuweyt: Wasaaradda Difaaca ayaa sheegtay in markab ka tirsan ciidamada badda lagu dhuftay weerar, iyadoo afar askari ay ku dhaawacmeen. Baxrayn: Dowladda ayaa kicisay digniino duqeyn, waxayna shacabka ugu baaqday inay raacaan tilmaamaha amniga. Iiraan ayaa ku dhawaaqday in heshiiskii is-afgaradka ee ay la gashay Maraykanka uusan hadda wax qiimo ah lahayn,Sidoo kalena ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanku waxay ku hanjabeen inay carqaladeyn doonto dhoofinta shidaalka iyo gaaska Bariga Dhexe haddii cadaadiska Maraykanku sii socdo. Dhanka kale, Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Maraykanka ayaa shaacisay inay xanibtay hanti ka badan 130 milyan oo doolar, iyadoo cunaqabateyn saartay boorsooyin lacagaha dijitaalka ah (cryptocurrency) oo lala xiriiriyay Bangiga Dhexe ee Iiraan. Safiirka Iiraan u fadhiya Qaramada Midoobay ayaa qoraal uu u diray Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ku eedeeyay Maraykanka inuu jebiyey ballanqaadyadii heshiiska isla markaana uu yahay dhinaca bilaabay colaadda. Dib u soo noqoshada xannibaadda dekedaha Iiraan iyo is-weydaarsiga weerarrada ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo amniga marin-biyoodka Hormuz iyo suurtagalnimada in colaaddu ku sii fido dalalka Khaliijka, iyadoo ay sii kordhayaan baaqyada caalamiga ah ee lagu doonayo in dib loogu laabto wada-hadal diblomaasiyadeed.

items.title: “Kuxigeenka Boqorka”: Marco Rubio oo “WhatsApp” ku Maamula Dalka Venezuela ka dib Xariggii Maduro
items.description: Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda ee dalka Maraykanka, Marco Rubio, ayaa si dhab ah ula wareegay maamulka iyo go’aannada fulinta ee dalka Venezuela ka dib xariggii Madaxweyne Nicolas Maduro. Sida ay sheegtay warbixin ay daabacday warbaahinta New York Times, saraakiisha ugu sarraysa dalkaas ayaa hadda Rubio u aqoonsaday magaca “Viceroy” (Kuxigeenka Boqorka) sababo la xiriira awoodda buuxda ee uu u leeyahay hoggaaminta dalkaas isaga oo jooga xafiiskiisa Washington. Warbixinta ayaa muujisay in dawladda Maraykanka ay gacanta ku hayso maamulka maaliyadda ee dalkaas, iyadoo Waaxda Maaliyadda ee Maraykanka ay maamusho inta badan dakhliga ka soo baxa dhoofinta agabka Venezuela. Lacagaha ayaa loo qoondeeyaa bangiyada dalkaas sidii “lacagta jeebka” (pocket money), taasi oo Rubio iyo kooxdiisa siinaysa awoodda kowaad ee go’aaminta qarashka iyo kharashgaraynta dawladda. Dhanka kale, hoggaamiyaha kumeelgaarka ah ee dalkaas, Delcy Rodríguez, oo xilka kula wareegtay barakada Washington, ayaa la sheegay inay awaamiirta tooska ah ka hesho Rubio iyadoo loo soo marinayo fariimaha “WhatsApp”, isagana uu ansixiyo magacaabista xilalka muhiimka ah. Siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Venezuela ayaa gebi ahaanba weysay madaxbannaanideedii wixii ka danbeeyay xariggii Maduro. Washington ayaa ku qasabtay dawladda kumeelgaarka ah inay tirtirto qoraalladii lagu canbaaraynayay weeraradii Maraykanka ee ka dhanka ahaa dalka Iiraan, iyadoo, sidoo kale, lagu amray inay u dhiibto sharciga Maraykanka shakhsiyaadka loo haysto denbiyada ee halkaas ku duman. Inkasta oo Mareykanku uu sheegay in ujeedka koowaad uu yahay kalaguur dimoqraadi ah, haddana hannaanka muuqda wuxuu muujinayaa in dib loo dhigay dimoqraadiyaddii, iyadoo go’aanka rasmiga ah ee xilliga ay doorashadu dhacayso uu hadda si buuxda ugu jiro gacanta Marco Rubio iyo kooxdiisa.

items.title: Cosoble oo Xasan Sheekh ka dalbaday inuu badbaadiyo Puntland
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Maamul Goboleedka HirShabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Cosoble oo qoraal kooban soo saaray ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda Puntland, isaga oo farriin u diray Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Cali Cosoble oo kamid ah siyaasiyiinta taabacsan Villa Soomaaliya ayaa ugu baaqay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya inuu mudnaanta koowaad siiyo xal u helidda xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee ka jirta deegaannada Puntland, isaga oo si gaar ah uga dalbaday inuu badbaadiyo Hooyada Federaalka. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in hadallo iyo faan siyaasadeed aanay xal u noqon karin caqabadaha ka jira Puntland, balse loo baahan yahay ficil muuqda oo lagu wajahayo arrimaha siyaasadeed ee taagan. Waxaa kale oo uu carrabka ku dhuftay in xilligan adag lo baahan yahay in la qaado tallaabooyin wax ku ool ah oo lagu xasillinayo Puntland, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, Puntland badbaadin ayay u baahan tahay. Faan been ah waxba ma taro ee haloo hooyo Puntland,” ayuu yiri Cali Cosoble. Hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli uu weli jiro khilaaf siyaasadeed oo u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Puntland, kaas oo saameeyay wada-shaqeyntii labada dhinac. Khilaafkaas ayaa salka ku haya arrimo la xiriira wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka, nidaamka doorashooyinka, iyo awood-qaybsiga dowladda. Arrimahan ayaa sidoo kale keenay in dhaq-dhaqaaqyo laga dareemo gudaha Puntland, kadib markii la sheegay in dowladda dhexe ay ciidamo ka qoratay deegaanno kamid ah maamulkaas, iyada oo tallabadaas uu ka horyimid Saciid Deni The post Cosoble oo Xasan Sheekh ka dalbaday inuu badbaadiyo Puntland appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Taliyaha guutada 14-ka October oo abaabul dagaal kawada Shabeellaha Hoose
items.description: Marka (Raxanreeb Online) Wararka inaga soo gaaraya magaalada Marka ee xarunta gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, ayaa sheegay in maanta halkaasi uu gaaray Taliyaha Guutada 14-ka October ee Ciidanka Dhulka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed G/le Cismaan Muuse Maxamed. Taliyaha ayaa mid mid ubooqday difaacyada Ururka 141-aad ee Guutada 14-ka October oo Fadhigiisu yahay Magaalada Marka, kormeerka kadib ayuu la hadlay Cutubyo katirsan Ururkaas oo uu kula dardaarmay inay sii adkeeyaan gudashada waajibaadka Qarankooda. Gaashaanle Cismaan, ayaa ciidamada ku booriyay in ay laba jibaraan howlgallada ay kaga hortagayaan maleeshiyaadka Al-shabaab, waxa uuna tilmaamay in ay muhiim tahay ciidanka in ay si wanaagsan ula dhaqmaan dadka shacabka ah ee ku nool deegaanada laga saaro kooxda Al-shabaab. Sikastaba, tan iyo wixii ka dambeeyay la wareegistiisa Xilka Taliyaha Guutada 14-ka October, G/le Cismaan Muuse, ayaa kormeer uu ku dardar-gelinayo howlaha Guutada waxaa uu ku soo maray Awdheegle, Lambar-konton, Mubaarak, Janaale iyo Marka Cadey oo uu maanta ku sugan yahay. items.title: Daawo: War cusub oo kasoo kordhay wada-hadallada u socda DF iyo mucaaradka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) oo shir muhiim ah ka furay Muqdisho ayaa ka hadlay arrimo ku aadan xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka, gaar ahaan khilaafka u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo dhinacyada mucaaradka. Wasiir Cabdisalaan ayaa qiray in haatan dalka kuu jiro marxalad adag,isla markaana uu jiro is-jiidjiid dhinaca siyaasadda, balse laga gudbi doono. “Siyaasaddu marka ay mareyso marxaladaha maanta oo kale aan joogno waxaa iska jiid-jiid laakiin iyada lafteyda waxay muujineysaa biseyl siyaasadeed inuu jiro,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Cabdisalaan Dhaay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu soo hadal qaaday wada-hadallada u socda labada dhinac ee ay garwadeenka ka tahay Beesha Caalamka, isaga oo rajo wanaagsan ka muujiyay in kulmada socda ay guuleysan doonaan, laguna gaari doono natiijo wax ku ool ah. “Meel wanaagsan ayuu marayaa wada-hadalka u dhexeeya Dowladda iyo Mucaaradka oo aan rajaynayno inuu wax wanaagsan inooga soo baxo,” ayuu mar kae yiri Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo garabyada mucaaradka ayaa si guud uga mideysan in dalka loo jiheeyo doorasho toos ah, lagana gudbo doorashadii dadbaneyd ee muddada dheer lagu soo dhaqmay. Inkastoo weli ay socdaan wada-hadallo xasaasi ah oo ku saabsan qaabka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka qof iyo codka ah, haddana waxaa taagan khilaafyo siyaasadeed iyo aragtiyo is-diiddan oo ku saabsan hannaanka loo marayo hirgelintooda. “In go’aan la gaaro oo doorasho la qabto waa iska sahlan tahay wax micno wayna kuma fadhido, laakiin waxaa la gefay doorashada sidee loo hirgelinayaa?, sidee noqoneysaa?, xaggee loo maraa?” ayay tiri Xaliimo Yarey oo ah Guddoomiyihii hore ee Guddigga Doorashooyinka Qaranka. Soomaaliya ayaa haatan isku diyaarinayso go’aanno muhiim u ah geeddi-socodka dimuqraadiyeynta, dhismaha hay’adaha dowliga ah iyo qabashada doorashooyin dadweyne oo toos ah. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo kulan la qaatay Amiirka Qatar
items.description: Doha ( Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo oo gaaray magaalada Doha ee dalka Qatar ayaa Qasriga Lusail kulan kula qaatay Amiirka Qatar, Sheekh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, isagoo uga tacsiyeeyay geerida ku timid Alle ha u naxariistee Aabihii Amiirkii hore Marxuum Sheekh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa adkeeyay in Soomaaliya ay garab taagan tahay Dowladda Qatar xilligan murugada leh, isaga oo u rajeeyay Amiirka, qoyska boqortooyada iyo shacabka reer Qatar samir iyo iimaan, isla markaana Alle uga baryay marxuumka inuu ku waraabiyo janatul Firdowsa. Dhankiisa, Amiirka dowladda Qatar Sheekh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani ayaa uga mahadceliyay Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya tacsida iyo garab istaagga ay u muujiyeen dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo bogaadiyay xiriirka qotoda dheer ee saaxiibtinimo iyo iskaashi ee ka dhexeeya labada dal. items.title: Spain oo iska xaadirisay kama dambeysta tartanka kooba Adduunka
items.description: Miami ( Raxanreeb Online) Xulka dalka Spain ayaa xalay waxa uu gaaray kama dambeysta koobka Adduunka 2026, kaddib markii 2-0 uu kaga badiyay dalka France. Spaim oo ku guuleystay Koobkii Adduunka 2010 oo ciyaar cajiib ah soo bandhigay, islamarkaana France ka ciyaar wanaagsanaa waxaa goolasha u keenay ciyaaryahanada Mikel Oyarzabal iyo Pedro Porro. Sidoo kale dalka France oo ka mid ahaa xulalka sanadkan loo saadaalinayay Koobka Adduunka ayaa xalay la waayay meel uu ka dhacay, iyada oo ay ku dhacday guuldarro xanuun badan oo lala yaabay. Xulka Spain ayaa ciyaart kama dambaysta ah la ciyaari doona midkii soo baxa xulalka England iyo Argentina oo caawa wada ciyaaraya 10:00 PM, waqtiga geeska afrika. Ciyaarta kama dambaysta ah ee Koobka Adduunka waxaa 19-ka bishan lagu qaban doonaa garoonka MetLife Stadium oo ku yaalla magaalada East Rutherford, gobolka New Jersey ee dalka Maraykanka. The post Spain oo iska xaadirisay kama dambeysta tartanka kooba Adduunka appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Trump oo Netanyahu ku amray inuu ciidankiisa kala baxo laba dal
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa ra’iisul wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu ugu baaqay inuu bilaabo in ciidamada Israel dib looga soo daadgureeyo dhulka Suuriya, isla markaana uu qaado tallaabo la mid ah oo ku saabsan koonfurta Lubnaan, sida ay sheegeen saraakiil Mareykan iyo Israeli ah. Trump ayaa codsigan u gudbiyey Netanyahu intii lagu jiray wada-hadal telefoon oo dhexmaray Khamiistii, waxaana uu uga digay in joogitaanka ciidamada Israel ee gudaha Suuriya uu sii hurin karo xiisadaha, isla markaana uu sababi karo isku dhac cusub oo gobolka ka qarxa. “Dadka halkaas jooga ma doonayaan joogitaankiinna. Waa inaad ciidamadiinna dib u daadgureysaan,” ayuu Trump ku yiri Netanyahu, sida uu sheegay sarkaal Mareykan ah oo xog-ogaal u ahaa wada-hadalka. Sarkaalka ayaa intaas ku daray in Trump uu Netanyahu u gudbiyey farriin la mid ah oo ku saabsan ciidamada Israel ee ku sugan gudaha Lubnaan. Xafiiska ra’iisul wasaaraha Israel ayaa xaqiijiyey in labada hoggaamiye ay ka wada-hadleen xaaladda xuduudaha, balse waxa uu sheegay in Netanyahu uu ku adkeystay muhiimadda ay dowladdiisu siineyso sameynta aagag ammaan oo ku teedsan xuduudaha Israel. “Ra’iisul wasaaruhu wuxuu dhankiisa soo bandhigay baahida loo qabo aagag ammaan oo ku yaalla xuduudaha Israel,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan kasoo baxay xafiiska Netanyahu. Israel ayaa hadda ciidamo ku leh qeybo ka mid ah koonfurta Suuriya iyo koonfurta Lubnaan, iyadoo dowladda Netanyahu ay ku dooddo in joogitaankaas uu lagama maarmaan u yahay ka hortagga weerar kale oo la mid ah kii Xamaas ay Israel ku qaaday 7-dii October 2023. Sidoo kale, xubno sare oo ka tirsan xukuumadda Israel ayaa doonaya in ciidamadu muddo aan xadidneyn sii joogaan deegaannadaas. Siyaasiyiinta garabka midig qaarkood ayaa xitaa taageeray in degsiimooyin Yuhuud ah laga dhiso dhulalka ay ciidamada Israel ka qabsadeen Suuriya. Codsiga Trump ayaa cadaadis cusub saaraya Netanyahu, xilli ay saddex bilood ka harsan yihiin doorasho si weyn u saameyn karta mustaqbalkiisa siyaasadeed iyo dacwadaha musuq-maasuqa ee muddada dheer ku socday. Netanyahu ayaa lagu wadaa inuu ka fogaado tallaabo kasta oo weyn oo lagu dhimayo joogitaanka ciidamada Israel ee Suuriya, ama oggolaado ka bixitaan dheeraad ah oo ka dhaca Lubnaan, marka laga reebo qorshe xaddidan oo uu horey u aqbalay. Wada-hadalka Trump iyo Netanyahu ayaa dhacay maalin kadib markii madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu kulan la yeeshay madaxweynaha Suuriya Axmed al-Sharca, xilli ay ka qeybgalayeen shir madaxeedka NATO oo ka dhacay Turkiga. Maamulka Trump ayaa bilihii lasoo dhaafay waday dadaallo lagu doonayo in heshiis amni oo cusub laga dhex abuuro Israel iyo Suuriya. Hase yeeshee, saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa ugu dambeyn ku qancay in Netanyahu uusan diyaar u ahayn tanaasulaadka ay Washington u aragto kuwa lagama maarmaanka u ah heshiiska. Tanaasulaadkaas waxaa ka mid ahaa in ciidamada Israel si tartiib-tartiib ah uga baxaan dhulka Suuriya ee ay qabsadeen kadib burburkii dowladdii Bashar al-Assad bishii December 2024. Toddobaadyadii ugu dambeeyey, qeybo ka mid ah koonfurta Suuriya waxaa ka dhacay dibadbaxyo looga soo horjeedo joogitaanka ciidamada Israel. Dadka deegaanka ayaa dhowr jeer ay isku dhaceen askarta Israel, taas oo sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in xaaladdu isu beddesho iska horimaad ballaaran. Dhanka Lubnaan, dhexdhexaadiyayaal Mareykan ah ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Rome kula kulmay diblomaasiyiin ka kala socday Israel iyo Lubnaan, si looga wada-hadlo dhaqan-gelinta heshiis ay labada dhinac saxiixeen dhowr toddobaad ka hor. Heshiiskaas ayaa dhigaya in Israel ay ciidamadeeda kala baxdo laba goobood oo tijaabo ah oo ay hadda ka joogaan koonfurta Lubnaan, kadibna ay halkaas ku wareejiso ciidamada dowladda Lubnaan. Si kastaba, ciidamada Israel ayaan weli ka bixin labadaas goobood. Dowladda Lubnaan ayaa dalbatay in geeddi-socodka bixitaanka si degdeg ah loo bilaabo, isla markaana la soo bandhigo jadwal cad oo lagu fulinayo ka bixitaanno dheeraad ah. Saraakiisha Israel ayaa sheegaya inay doonayaan in ciidamadoodu marka hore xaqiijiyaan in goobaha lagu heshiiyey laga saaray hubka iyo kaabeyaasha militari ee ururka Xisbullah, kahor inta aan loo gudbin aagag kale. Dowladda Lubnaan ayaa taas ka hor timid, iyadoo ku adkeysatay in ciidamada Mareykanka ama koox dhexdhexaad ah ay qiimeeyaan in goobahaas laga saaray hubka Xisbullah iyo in kale. Aqalka Cad ayaa ka gaabsaday inuu si rasmi ah uga hadlo faahfaahinta wada-hadalka Trump iyo Netanyahu, balse ma uusan beenin xogta ku saabsan in madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu dalbaday in ciidamada Israel dib loo daadgureeyo. Sarkaal Mareykan ah ayaa sheegay in Trump iyo Netanyahu ay leeyihiin xiriir wanaagsan, isla markaana Israel ay weli tahay xulafada muhiimka ah ee Mareykanka. “Madaxweyne Trump wuxuu xiriir xooggan la leeyahay ra’iisul wasaare Netanyahu, Israel-na mar walba waxay xulafo weyn u ahayd Mareykanka,” ayuu yiri sarkaalka. Baaqa Trump ayaa muujinaya kala duwanaansho sii kordhaya oo u dhexeeya Washington iyo xukuumadda Netanyahu, gaar ahaan qaabka loo wajahayo dhulalka ay ciidamada Israel ka haystaan Suuriya iyo Lubnaan iyo dadaallada Mareykanka ee lagu doonayo in looga hortago dagaal kale oo gobolka ka qarxa. Xafiiska ra’iisul wasaaraha Israel ayaa xaqiijiyey in labada hoggaamiye ay ka wada-hadleen xaaladda xuduudaha, balse waxa uu sheegay in Netanyahu uu ku adkeystay muhiimadda ay dowladdiisu siineyso sameynta aagag ammaan oo ku teedsan xuduudaha Israel. “Ra’iisul wasaaruhu wuxuu dhankiisa soo bandhigay baahida loo qabo aagag ammaan oo ku yaalla xuduudaha Israel,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan kasoo baxay xafiiska Netanyahu. Israel ayaa hadda ciidamo ku leh qeybo ka mid ah koonfurta Suuriya iyo koonfurta Lubnaan, iyadoo dowladda Netanyahu ay ku dooddo in joogitaankaas uu lagama maarmaan u yahay ka hortagga weerar kale oo la mid ah kii Xamaas ay Israel ku qaaday 7-dii October 2023. Sidoo kale, xubno sare oo ka tirsan xukuumadda Israel ayaa doonaya in ciidamadu muddo aan xadidneyn sii joogaan deegaannadaas. Siyaasiyiinta garabka midig qaarkood ayaa xitaa taageeray in degsiimooyin Yuhuud ah laga dhiso dhulalka ay ciidamada Israel ka qabsadeen Suuriya. Codsiga Trump ayaa cadaadis cusub saaraya Netanyahu, xilli ay saddex bilood ka harsan yihiin doorasho si weyn u saameyn karta mustaqbalkiisa siyaasadeed iyo dacwadaha musuq-maasuqa ee muddada dheer ku socday. Netanyahu ayaa lagu wadaa inuu ka fogaado tallaabo kasta oo weyn oo lagu dhimayo joogitaanka ciidamada Israel ee Suuriya, ama oggolaado ka bixitaan dheeraad ah oo ka dhaca Lubnaan, marka laga reebo qorshe xaddidan oo uu horey u aqbalay. Wada-hadalka Trump iyo Netanyahu ayaa dhacay maalin kadib markii madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu kulan la yeeshay madaxweynaha Suuriya Axmed al-Sharca, xilli ay ka qeybgalayeen shir madaxeedka NATO oo ka dhacay Turkiga. Maamulka Trump ayaa bilihii lasoo dhaafay waday dadaallo lagu doonayo in heshiis amni oo cusub laga dhex abuuro Israel iyo Suuriya. Hase yeeshee, saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa ugu dambeyn ku qancay in Netanyahu uusan diyaar u ahayn tanaasulaadka ay Washington u aragto kuwa lagama maarmaanka u ah heshiiska. Tanaasulaadkaas waxaa ka mid ahaa in ciidamada Israel si tartiib-tartiib ah uga baxaan dhulka Suuriya ee ay qabsadeen kadib burburkii dowladdii Bashar al-Assad bishii December 2024. Toddobaadyadii ugu dambeeyey, qeybo ka mid ah koonfurta Suuriya waxaa ka dhacay dibadbaxyo looga soo horjeedo joogitaanka ciidamada Israel. Dadka deegaanka ayaa dhowr jeer ay isku dhaceen askarta Israel, taas oo sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in xaaladdu isu beddesho iska horimaad ballaaran. Dhanka Lubnaan, dhexdhexaadiyayaal Mareykan ah ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Rome kula kulmay diblomaasiyiin ka kala socday Israel iyo Lubnaan, si looga wada-hadlo dhaqan-gelinta heshiis ay labada dhinac saxiixeen dhowr toddobaad ka hor. Heshiiskaas ayaa dhigaya in Israel ay ciidamadeeda kala baxdo laba goobood oo tijaabo ah oo ay hadda ka joogaan koonfurta Lubnaan, kadibna ay halkaas ku wareejiso ciidamada dowladda Lubnaan. Si kastaba, ciidamada Israel ayaan weli ka bixin labadaas goobood. Dowladda Lubnaan ayaa dalbatay in geeddi-socodka bixitaanka si degdeg ah loo bilaabo, isla markaana la soo bandhigo jadwal cad oo lagu fulinayo ka bixitaanno dheeraad ah. Saraakiisha Israel ayaa sheegaya inay doonayaan in ciidamadoodu marka hore xaqiijiyaan in goobaha lagu heshiiyey laga saaray hubka iyo kaabeyaasha militari ee ururka Xisbullah, kahor inta aan loo gudbin aagag kale. Dowladda Lubnaan ayaa taas ka hor timid, iyadoo ku adkeysatay in ciidamada Mareykanka ama koox dhexdhexaad ah ay qiimeeyaan in goobahaas laga saaray hubka Xisbullah iyo in kale. Aqalka Cad ayaa ka gaabsaday inuu si rasmi ah uga hadlo faahfaahinta wada-hadalka Trump iyo Netanyahu, balse ma uusan beenin xogta ku saabsan in madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu dalbaday in ciidamada Israel dib loo daadgureeyo. Sarkaal Mareykan ah ayaa sheegay in Trump iyo Netanyahu ay leeyihiin xiriir wanaagsan, isla markaana Israel ay weli tahay xulafada muhiimka ah ee Mareykanka. “Madaxweyne Trump wuxuu xiriir xooggan la leeyahay ra’iisul wasaare Netanyahu, Israel-na mar walba waxay xulafo weyn u ahayd Mareykanka,” ayuu yiri sarkaalka. Baaqa Trump ayaa muujinaya kala duwanaansho sii kordhaya oo u dhexeeya Washington iyo xukuumadda Netanyahu, gaar ahaan qaabka loo wajahayo dhulalka ay ciidamada Israel ka haystaan Suuriya iyo Lubnaan iyo dadaallada Mareykanka ee lagu doonayo in looga hortago dagaal kale oo gobolka ka qarxa. items.title: Xiisad u dhaxeysa Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Xuutiyiinta oo sii xoogeysanaysa
items.description: Warbaahinta Axios ayaa ku warrantay in Dhaxal-sugaha Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, Amiir Maxamed bin Salmaan, uu Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ka codsaday taageero haddii tallaabo militari laga qaado Xuutiyiinta, kadib markii ay soo baxeen tuhunno sheegaya in diyaarad laga leeyahay Iran ay isku dayday inay hub iyo khubaro militari u gudbiso kooxdaas iyada oo sii mareysa garoonka diyaaradaha ee Sanca. Warbixintu waxay sheegtay in garoonka diyaaradaha la duqeeyay, halka Xuutiyiintuna ay kaga jawaabeen weerar ay ku beegsadeen Garoonka Diyaaradaha ee Abha ee Sacuudiga. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, tani waxay ahayd weerarkii ugu horreeyay ee ay si rasmi ah u sheegtaan inay ku qaadeen Boqortooyada Sacuudiga tan iyo markii uu billaabatay abbad-joojintii aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin ee sanadkii 2022. Arrimahan soo cusboonaaday ayaa mar kale sare u qaaday su’aalaha ku saabsan mustaqbalka xabbad-joojinta iyo suurtagalnimada in xaaladda gobolka ay mar kale sii xumaato. Hawlgalka militari ee loo bixiyay “Duufaanta Go’aanka”ee la bilaabay sanadkii 2015 ma ahayn iska horimaadkii ugu horreeyay ee dhex mara Boqortooyada Sacuudiga iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa Ansaar Allah eeXuutiyiinta. 5-tii November 2009, dagaalyahanno ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta ayaa gudaha u galay tuulada xuduudda ku taalla ee Al-Khoba, oo ku taalla gobolka Jazan ee koonfurta Sacuudiga. Weerarkan ayaa qayb ka ahaa isku day lagu doonayay in lagu qabsado buurta Jabal Dukhan, xilli uu socday waxa loo yaqaan “Dagaalkii Lixaad” ee u dhexeeyay Xuutiyiinta iyo dowladda Yemen ee uu hoggaaminayay madaxweynihii hore Cali Cabdalla Saalax. Dhacdadaasi waxay horseeday in ciidamada Sacuudigu si toos ah ugu lug yeeshaan dagaalka ka dhanka ah Xuutiyiinta, taasoo calaamad u noqotay bilowgii iska horimaadyada tooska ah ee u dhexeeya labada dhinac, sanado ka hor faragelintii ballaarneyd ee isbahaysiga Carabta ee la bilaabay sanadkii 2015. Boqortooyada Sacuudiga ayaa kaga jawaabtay weerarka iyada oo qaaday duqeyn cirka ah oo lagu beegsaday boqolaal dagaalyahan oo rasaas ku furay ciidamada ilaalada xuduudda. Saddex maalmood kadib, Riyadh ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay dib ula wareegtay gacan ku haynta buurta Jabal Dukhan. Dagaalladu waxay sii socdeen illaa bishii Febraayo 2010, kadibna Sacuudigu wuxuu bilaabay inuu u arko dhaqdhaqaaqa Xuutiyiinta inuu yahay khatar amni oo ka iman karta xuduuddiisa koonfureed. Howlgalkii isbahaysiga Sacuudiga Sanadkii 2011, Yemen waxaa ka dhacay mudaharaadyo ballaaran oo qayb ka ahaa dhacdooyinkii Guga Carabta, kuwaas oo ugu dambeyn sababay in Madaxweyne Cali Cabdalla Saalax uu xilka iska casilo bishii Febraayo 2012. Is-casilaadda ayaa ku timid heshiiskii loo yaqaanay Hindisaha Khaliijka, kaas oo dhigayay in si nabad ah awoodda loogu wareejiyo ku xigeenkiisa, Cabd Rabbuh Mansuur Hadi, in la dhiso dowlad midnimo qaran, isla markaana Saalax la siiyo xasaanad ka dhan ah dacwadaha la xiriira muddadii uu xukunka hayay, iyadoo uu beddelkeeda ka tanaasulayo awoodda. Kadib markii Hadi uu u baxsaday Sacuudiga, Riyadh ayaa bishii Maarso 2015 billowday Hawlgalka “Duufaanta Go’aanka”, iyadoo hoggaaminaysay isbahaysi Carbeed oo taageerayay dowladda Yemen. Amiirka Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Maxamed bin Salmaan, oo xilligaas ahaa Wasiirka Difaaca, ayaa kormeerayay howlgalada militari. Isbahaysigaasi waxaa ku jiray Sacuudiga, Imaaraadka Carabta, Baxrayn, Kuwait iyo Qatar ka hor inta aysan Qatar ka bixin sanadkii 2017 kadib xiisaddii Khaliijka, sidoo kale Masar, Urdun, Morocco iyo Suudaan. Pakistan, inkasta oo markii hore laga wada hadlay ka qeybgalkeeda, haddana baarlamaanka dalkaasi ayaa bishii April 2015 u codeeyay in Pakistan ay dhexdhexaad ka sii ahaato colaadda. Kadib markii Hadi uu la wareegay madaxtinimada, Xuutiyiintu waxay ka faa’iideysteen daciifnimada dowladda iyo qalalaasaha siyaasadeed si ay u ballaariyaan saameyntooda militari iyo siyaasadeed ee waqooyiga Yemen. Arrintan waxay ugu dambeyntii keentay inay la wareegaan caasimadda Sanca bishii Sebtembar 2014. Tani waxay ku timid iyada oo ay jireen isbahaysi aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin oo u dhexeeyay Xuutiyiinta iyo madaxweynihii hore Cali Cabdalla Saalax, kaas oo siiyay taageero siyaasadeed iyo mid militari oo u sahashay inay gacanta ku dhigaan hay’adaha dowladda. Xigashada Sawirka, Wana News Agency/Reuters Welwelka Riyadh iyo tallaabada loo qaadayo dhinaca dejinta xiisadda Intii uu socday dagaalka, walaacyada ugu waaweyn ee Sacuudiga waxay ku saabsanaayeen in Xuutiyiintu ay noqdaan awood militari oo joogto ah oo ka dhalata xuduudda koonfureed ee dalkaas, kororka awooddooda gantaallada, adeegsiga Iran ee Xuutiyiinta si ay ugu cadaadiso danaha gobolka, iyo khatarta ku wajahan maraakiibta ku goosha Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka **Baab al-Mandab**. 1-dii Abriil 2022, ergayga Qaramada Midoobay ee Yemen, Hans Grundberg, ayaa ku dhawaaqay in labada dhinac ay ku heshiiyeen xabbad-joojin soconaysa laba bilood oo dib loo cusboonaysiin karo. Xabbad-joojintaas ayaa dhaqan gashay 2-dii April, waxaana ay dhigaysay in la joojiyo howlgallada weerarrada ah ee dhulka, badda iyo cirka. Inkasta oo xabbad-joojintu si rasmi ah u dhammaatay waqti kadib, haddana xaalad degganaansho aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin ayaa sii socotay, waxaana billowday xiriirro toos ah oo u dhexeeyay labada dhinac. Xabad joojinta waxaa xigay dib u soo celinta xiriirka Sacuudiga iyo Iiraan iyada oo loo marayo dhexdhexaadin Shiinees ah bishii March 2023, Riyadh sidoo kale waxay wadahadallo toos ah la yeelatay Xuutiyiinta si loo helo heshiis joogto ah. Bishii September 2023, wafdi ka socday Xuutiyiinta ayaa gaaray Riyadh, taas oo ahayd booqashadii ugu horreysay ee noocaas ah ee si fagaare ah loo sameeyo tan iyo markii uu dagaalku billowday. Wadahadallada oo uu dhex-dhexaadinayay Cumaan ayaa socday muddo shan maalmood ah, waxaana laga gaaray horumar ku aaddan diyaarinta hannaan ama khariidad waddo oo lagu soo afjarayo colaadda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, horumarradii ugu dambeeyay ee la xiriiray garoomada diyaaradaha ee Sanca iyo Abha ayaa mar kale soo jeediyay su’aalo ku saabsan waxa loo arki karo “jilicsanaanta” ama nuglaanta xabbad-joojinta tan iyo markii ay bilaabatay sanadkii 2022. Bbc somali

items.title: Trump oo Bin Salman ku taageeray tallaabo xasaasi ah
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Maxamed bin Salmaan ku taageeray tallaabo militari oo ka dhan ah kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen, ka hor duqeyntii garoonka diyaaradaha Sanca ee horseedday weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ah oo lagu qaaday gudaha Sacuudiga. Taageerada Trump ayaa timid kadib markii Maxamed bin Salmaan uu madaxweynaha Mareykanka horey ugu wargeliyey qorshaha howlgalka, kana codsaday taageero siyaasadeed iyo mid militari, sida ay sheegeen laba sarkaal oo Mareykan ah oo la hadlay warbaahinta Axios . Iska horimaadka dhacay Isniintii 13-ka July ayaa ahaa kii ugu cuslaa ee si toos ah u dhex mara Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta tan iyo 2022, wuxuuna halis geliyey xabbad-joojin aan rasmi ahayn oo labada dhinac u suurta-gelisay inay muddo afar sano ah ka fogaadaan dagaal ballaaran. Xiisadda ayaa bilaabatay markii diyaaradda Mahan Air ee laga leeyahay Iran ay horraantii bishan ka degtay magaalada Sanca oo ay Xuutiyiintu maamulaan. Diyaaradda ayaa qaaday wafdi sare oo ka tirsan kooxda, kuwaas oo Tehran uga qeybgalay aaska hoggaamiyihii hore ee Iran Ayatollah Cali Khamenei. Duulimaad toos ah oo Iran ka yimaada kuna dega Sanca ma dhicin muddo ka badan toban sano. items.title: Ciidanka Danab oo burburiyay xarumo ay Shabaab kasoo abaabuli jireen weerarrada
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno kala duwan ayaa kasoo baxaya howlgallo qorsheysan oo ay iska kaashadeen ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Kumaandooska Danab iyo kuwa Daraawiishta maamulka Jubbaland oo maanta ka dhacay deegaanno ka tirsan gobolka Jubbada Hoose. Ciidamada oo qaaday howlgal si weyn looga taxadaray ayaa beegsaday fariisimo ay Al-Shabaab ku lahaayeen deegaannada Xawaalo-afwaax, Weelmaarow iyo Lafagari oo ka tirsan gobolkaasi, iyagoo khasaare u gaystay. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada ay gudaha u galeen saddexda deegaan, isla markaana ay burburiyeen godad ay Al-Shabaab ka qoteen halkaasi, kuwaas oo difaacyo u ahaa, waxaana lala simay dhulka. Sidoo kale, ciidamada ayaa cagta mariyay xarumo iyo saldhigyo ay ku kaydsan jirin agabka oo ku yaalla halkaasi, sida ay shaaciyeen saraakiisha Danab. Goobaha ay la wareegeen ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay in Al-Shabaab ay kasoo abaabuli jireen weerarro qorsheysan, iyada oo ujeedka uu ahaa in laga hortego abaabulka Khawaarijta. Ciidamada Danab oo ka duulaya amarkii uu bixiyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo dhawaan ku dhawaaqay dagaal kama dambeys ah ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyay xoojiyay howlgallada ay ka wadaan koonfurta Soomaaliya, iyaga oo habeen hore xilli saq-dhexe ah gudaha u galay degmada Sablaale ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hosoe, kadibna kusoo dilay 7 xubnood oo uu ku jiro sarkaal sare oo muhiim ah. Howlgalkaas waxaa ka horreeyay mid kale oo isna ka dhacay deegaanka Hantiwadaag ee Gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, kaas oo lagu dilay horjooge Cabdisalaan Macallin Abuukar oo kooxda u qaabilsanaa qorista maleeshiyada cusub iyo uruurinta baadda ee ay Al-Shabaab ka qaadaan dad shacabka ah. Horjooge Cabdisalaan Macallin oo ay ciidamadu si dhow ula socdeen dhaq-dhaqaaqiisa ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday howlgal gaar ah oo la fuliyay 10-kii Luulyo 2026, xilli uu ku sugnaa guri ku yaalla deegaanka Hantiwadaag oo ugu dambeyn lagu khaarijiyay. items.title: Uganda oo ciidan u diraysa Gaza kadib codsi ka yimid Trump
items.description: Kampala (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Uganda ayaa lagu warramay inay mabda’ ahaan oggolaatay inay ciidamo ku biiriso howlgal caalami ah oo la qorsheynayo in laga hirgeliyo Marinka Gaza, kadib codsi uga yimid Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump. Wargeyska dowladda Uganda ee New Vision , oo soo xigtay ilo sare oo ka tirsan ciidamada, ayaa sheegay in Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni uu si wanaagsan uga jawaabay codsiga Trump ee ahaa in Kampala ay ka qeybqaadato Ciidanka Xasilinta Caalamiga ah ee Gaza. Ciidamadan ayaa la filayaa inay hoos tagaan Golaha Nabadda ee dhowaan la dhisay, kaas oo loo xil saaray taageeridda qorshaha xabbad-joojinta, sugidda ammaanka iyo diyaarinta marxaladda dib-u-dhiska Gaza. Howlgalka la qorsheynayo ayaa la sheegay inuu gacan ka geysan doono ilaalinta kala dambeynta, badbaadinta dadka rayidka ah, fududeynta gaarsiinta gargaarka bani’aadannimo iyo taageeridda dib-u-dhiska Gaza, oo burbur baaxad leh uu kasoo gaaray dagaalladii sannadihii lasoo dhaafay. Uganda ayaa lagu wadaa inay howlgalka kula biirto dalal ay ka mid yihiin Morocco, Kosovo, Albania iyo Kazakhstan, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay horey u muujiyeen diyaar u ahaanshahooda ka qeybgalka qorshahan. Saldhig dhinaca saadka iyo diyaarinta ciidamada ah ayaa lagu warramay in laga dhisayo dhinaca Israel ee marinka Kerem Shalom. Saldhiggaas ayaa marka hore qaabili kara ilaa 500 oo askari, kahor inta aan cutubyada loo gudbin gudaha Gaza. Hase yeeshee, dowladda Uganda iyo taliska ciidamada UPDF weli si rasmi ah uma shaacin tirada ciidamada la diri doono, nooca cutubyada ka qeybgalaya iyo xilliga uu howlgalka bilaaban doono. Agaasimaha ku-simaha warfaafinta ciidamada Uganda, Kornayl Chris Magezi, ayaa sheegay in UPDF ay tallaabo qaadi doonto marka ay hesho hagitaan cad oo istaraatiiji ah oo kasoo baxa Madaxweyne Museveni, oo ah taliyaha guud ee ciidamada dalkaas. “Haddii madaxweynuhu bixiyo hagidda istaraatiijiga ah, wuxuu ciidamada UPDF ku amri doonaa inay tallaabada ku habboon qaadaan, annaguna waan fulin doonnaa,” ayuu yiri Magezi. Qorshaha lagu dhisayo ciidamada xasilinta Gaza ayaa daba socda qaraar uu Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ansixiyey bishii November 2025, kaas oo taageeray qorshe nabadeed oo loogu talagalay Gaza, isla markaana oggolaaday sameynta ciidan caalami ah oo ku-meel-gaar ah. Qaraarka waxaa taageeray 13 dal oo ka tirsan Golaha Ammaanka, halka Shiinaha iyo Ruushka ay ka aamuseen codeynta. Jeneraal Jasper Jeffers oo ka tirsan ciidamada Mareykanka, loona magacaabay hoggaaminta howlgalka, ayaa la sheegay inuu dalalka ka qeybgalaya u kala qoondeyn doono waajibaadyo ciidan iyo kuwo maamul. Waajibaadyadaas waxaa ka mid noqon kara taageeridda qorshayaasha amniga, ilaalinta goobaha muhiimka ah, fududeynta gargaarka iyo ka qeybqaadashada dadaallada lagu sii deynayo la-haystayaasha weli ku harsan Gaza. items.title: Maxkamad ku taalla Suudaan oo dil ku xukuntay Hoggaamiyaha RSF, Maxamed Xamdaan Dagalo
items.description: Maxkamad ku taalla magaalada Port Sudan ayaa xukun dil ah ku ridday hoggaamiyaha ciidamada RSF, Maxamed Xamdaan Dagalo (Hemedti), kadib markii lagu helay dambiyo culus oo ay ka mid yihiin dambiyada dagaalka, dambiyada ka dhanka ah bani’aadamnimada iyo xasuuq . Kiiska ayaa la xiriira tacaddiyo ka dhacay gobolka Galbeedka Daarfuur intii uu socday dagaalka sokeeye ee Suudaan. Maxkamaddu waxay sidoo kale dil ku xukuntay 15 hoggaamiye oo kale oo ka tirsan RSF, kuwaas oo lagu eedeeyay inay door ku lahaayeen weerarro lagu qaaday shacabka rayidka ah, burburin hantiyeed iyo barakicin baahsan. Hemedti ayaa la maxkamadeeyay isaga oo maqan, waxaana aan la ogeyn halka uu ku sugan yahay, balse Isbahaysi siyaasadeed oo ay RSF qayb ka tahay ayaa diiday xukunka, halka RSF-na ay marar badan beenisay eedeymaha dambiyada dagaalka. Dagaalka Suudaan ayaa billowday 15-kii Abriil 2023, kadib khilaaf xooggan oo u dhexeeyay taliyaha ciidanka Suudaan Jeneraal Cabdifataax Al-Burhaan iyo Hemedti. Kiiska maxkamadda ayaa si gaar ah diiradda u saaray dhacdooyinkii ka dhacay magaalada El-Geneina, oo ay ku jirto dilkii guddoomiyihii Galbeedka Daarfuur Khamis Abakar bishii Juun 2023. Maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay in hoggaamiyeyaasha RSF ay abaabuleen weerarro lagu bartilmaameedsaday rayidka, iskuullo, goobaha cibaadada iyo xaafadaha dadka deggan. Garsooraha ayaa sidoo kale amray in la xayiro hantida RSF, isla markaana laga dalbado Interpol inay soo saarto amarro caalami ah oo lagu soo qabto lana soo gacan geliyo dadka la xukumay. Dhanka caalamka, Mareykanka ayaa hore cunaqabatayn ugu soo rogay Hemedti, halka Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah (ICC) iyo Qaramada Midoobay ay wadaan baaritaanno la xiriira tacaddiyada ka dhacay Daarfuur. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa dhowaan sheegtay in RSF ay mas’uul ka ahayd falal ay ku jiraan xasuuq, dilal wadareed iyo gaajaysiin ula kac ah oo loo geystay shacabka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, RSF ayaa sii wada diidmada dhammaan eedeymaha loo jeediyay, iyadoo sidoo kale ciidamada dowladda Suudaan lagu eedeeyay inay geysteen dambiyo dagaal intii uu socday colaadda.

items.title: Iran oo weerartay Saldhigga Cirka Ali Al Salem ee Kuwait
items.description: Ciidamada Iran ayaa xalay weerar isugu jira gantaalo iyo drones ku qaaday Saldhigga Cirka ee Ali Al Salem ee Kuwait, iyagoo ka aargudanaya weerarada Mareykanka ee Koonfurta Iran. Weerarkan ayaa ka dambeeyay duqaymo uu Mareykanka ka fuliyay bartilmaameedyo ku yaala gudaha dalkaasi. Taliska Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran ayaa sheegay inay si toos ah u duqeeyeen Saldhigga Cirka ee Ali Al Salem, isla-markaana ay bartilmaameedsadeen kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah ee militariga, goobaha shidaalka iyo hantida difaaca cirka. Taliska ayaa soo bandhigay sawirro ay sheegeen inay muujinayaan gantaalo iyo diyaarado drones oo lagu weeraray bartilmaameedyada Mareykanka ee Kuwait. Saldhigga Cirka ee Ali Al Salem oo ku yaala dhulka lama degaanka ee Gobolka Jahra (Al Jahra) ayaa ku dhow xuduudda Kuwait iyo Ciraaq, waxaana maamula Ciidanka Cirka Kuwait, inkastoo ay dhinac ka degan yihiin Ciidanka Cirka Mareykanka. Militariga Iran ayaa ku hanjabay inaysan ka daahi doonin in ay si dhakhsa ah u garaacaan goob kasta oo ka mid ah dalalka gobolka, gaar ahaan kuwa Khaliijka, haddii uu Mareykanku ka soo qaado weerar ka dhan ah dhulka Iran. Saraakiisha iyo Madaxda Iran ayaa marar badan Dowladaha Khaliijka ka dalbaday inaysan Mareykanka u ogolaan in dalalkooda uu weerar kaga soo qaado dhulka Iran, haddii kalena ay jawaab adag kala kulmi doonaan. Iraaniyiinta ayaa cusbooneysiiya hanjabaadahooda ku aaddan Khaliijka, mar kasta oo Mareykanku uu duqaymo is daba joog ah ka gaysto dalkaasi. Hoggaamiyeyaasha Khaliijka kuma faraxsana weerarada ay Iran ka gaysaneyso dalalkaasi, haddana intooda badan waxay ku guuldareystaan in ay Mareykanka ka joojiyaan in dhulkooda uu ka weeraro Iran.

items.title: Trump oo canshuur ku soo rogaya maraakiibta aadegsanaya marin-biyoodka Hormuz
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa ku dhawaaqay qorshe cusub oo lagu soo rogi doono canshuur dhan 20% maraakiibta xamuulka ee mara Marin-biyoodka Hormuz, isagoo sheegay in Mareykanku dib u bilaabayo go’doominta maraakiibta Iiraan isla markaana uu noqonayo ilaaliyaha marin-biyoodkaas muhiimka ah. Trump ayaa sheegay in lacagta laga qaadayo maraakiibta loo adeegsan doono kharashaadka lagu sugayo amniga iyo badqabka maraakiibta isticmaasha marin-biyoodka Hormuz, oo ah marin ay maraan qayb weyn oo ka mid ah shidaalka dunida loo dhoofiyo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, khubaro ku takhasustay amniga iyo sharciga caalamiga ah ayaa shaki weyn geliyay suurtagalnimada qorshahan, ayadoo Andreas Krieg oo ah bare sare oo ka tirsan King’s College London uu sheegay in hadalka Trump uu u egyahay bayaan siyaasadeed oo degdeg loo yiri, balse uusan ahayn mid siyaasad si buuxda loo diyaariyey. Khabiirku wuxuu sheegay in Mareykanku uusan lahayn awood sharciyeed uu canshuur uga qaado maraakiibta caalamiga ah ee isticmaasha Marin-biyoodka Hormuz, maadaama uusan si toos ah u maamulin marin-biyoodkaas. Sidoo kale, Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Badaha (IMO) ayaa caddeeyay in sharciga caalamiga ahi uusan oggolaanayn in lacag ama canshuur lagu soo rogo maraakiibta si ay uga gudbaan marin-biyood caalami ah. Madaxweynaha Brazil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, ayaa isaguna qorshaha Trump ku tilmaamay burcad-badeednimo, ayadoo sidoo kale Khubaradu ay ka digeen in haddii qorshahan la hirgeliyo uu sii kordhin karo jahawareerka ay wajahaan shirkadaha maraakiibta, kuwaas oo durba la tacaalaya khataraha ka dhashay xiisadda u dhexeysa Mareykanka iyo Iiraan. Qorshahan ayaa imanaya xilli ay mar kale cirka isku shareertay xiisadda u dhexeysa Washington iyo Tehran, iyadoo labada dhinac ay isweydaarsadeen weerarro toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay, taasoo sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo ammaanka Marin-biyoodka Hormuz oo ah mid ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga caalamiga ah.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Shiikh Dhambaal Tacsi ah gaarsiiyay Amiirka Qatar
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo oo maanta gaaray magaalada Doha ee dalka Qatar ayaa Qasriga Lusail kulan kula qaatay Amiirka Dowladda Qatar, Sheekh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, isagoo uga tacsiyeeyay geerida ku timid Alle ha u naxariistee Aabihii Amiirkii hore Marxuum Sheekh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa adkeeyay in Soomaaliya ay garab taagan tahay Dowladda Qatar xilligan murugada leh, isaga oo u rajeeyay Amiirka, qoyska boqortooyada iyo shacabka reer Qatar samir iyo iimaan, isla markaana Alle uga baryay marxuumka inuu ku waraabiyo janatul Firdowsa. Dhankiisa, Amiirka Dowladda Qatar Sheekh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani ayaa uga mahadceliyay Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya tacsida iyo garab istaagga ay u muujiyeen dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo bogaadiyay xiriirka qotoda dheer ee saaxiibtinimo iyo iskaashi ee ka dhexeeya labada dal.

items.title: Bahrain oo la kulantay weerar Cluster ah
items.description: Ciidamada Iran ayaa xalay gantaalo iyo diyaaradaha aan duulaha lahayn ku weeraray magaala madaxda Bahrain ee Manama, halkaas oo laga maqlay seeriga digniinta ee duulaanka hawada. Taliska Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran ayaa sheegay inay beegsadeen saldhig taageero Ciidanka Badda Mareykanka oo ku yaala Manama iyo sidoo kale Saldhigga Ciidanka Cirka ee Sheikh Isa oo ku yaala xeebta Gacanka Faaris (Fars) ee Koonfurta Bahrain. Taliska ayaa sheegay in gantaalka madaxyada badan qaada ee Cluster uu qayb ka ahaa gantaalada loo adeegsaday weerarka ay ciidamadoodu ku qaadeen dalkaasi. Hawada Bahrain ayaa lagu arkay gantaal kooxeed ay Iran ku soo ridday dalkaasi. Muuqaalada ay dadku duubeen ayaa muujinaya madaxyo badan oo wada socda, ka hor inta aysan garaacin bartilmaameedyadooda. Halkii gantaal ee Cluster ayaa xambaari kara tobanaan illaa boqolaal walxood oo qarxa ama madaxyo badan oo bambaanooyin yaryar ah. items.title: Somalia Transfers Murder Suspects to Ethiopia’s Somali Region in Cross-Border Security Cooperation
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Somalia’s National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA) have handed over two men accused of involvement in fatal crimes to authorities from Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State after they were arrested in Mogadishu while allegedly attempting to evade justice. According to Somali state media, the suspects were transferred during a formal meeting in the border town of Balanballe, where Col. Hussein Farah, NISA’s commander for the Galmudug region, met with security officials from Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State. The suspects are accused of committing homicide before fleeing across the border into Somalia. Somali authorities said they were apprehended in Mogadishu following intelligence-led operations before being returned to Ethiopian authorities to face legal proceedings. The handover reflects growing security cooperation between Somalia and Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State in combating cross-border crime, particularly cases involving murder suspects and fugitives who attempt to escape prosecution by crossing international boundaries. Officials from both sides emphasized that the agreement extends beyond this single case, pledging closer intelligence sharing and operational coordination to track down individuals accused of serious crimes. “No individual with blood on their hands will find a safe haven simply by fleeing across the border,” officials from both sides said, according to Somali state media. The two delegations agreed to strengthen cooperation in identifying, arresting, and extraditing suspects involved in murder and other serious criminal offenses, signaling a broader commitment to denying criminals sanctuary in neighboring jurisdictions. The latest transfer comes as Somalia continues efforts to enhance regional security cooperation with neighboring countries, with authorities increasingly relying on intelligence-sharing and joint operations to combat transnational crime, terrorism, and cross-border fugitives. Nevertheless, it’s important to note, reports published in recent years, including more recent accounts, have alleged that Somali authorities have handed over civilians and members of Ethiopian opposition groups to Ethiopian authorities against their will. Human rights advocates and critics contend that some of those transferred have subsequently been subjected to arbitrary detention, ill-treatment, or other serious human rights abuses, raising concerns about compliance with international legal obligations and the principle of non-refoulement. Neither Somali authorities nor officials from Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State immediately released additional details about the identities of the suspects or the specific charges they will face following their transfer. items.title: Fursad Cusub: Kalluumeysiga Soomaaliya oo Gaaraya Suuqa Shiinaha
items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Kalluumeysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Xasan Aadan, iyo Safiirka Dowladda Jamhuuriyadda Shacabka Shiinaha u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Danjire Wang Yu, ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u kala saxiixday heshiis taariikhi ah oo u oggolaanaya badeecadaha kalluumeysiga Soomaaliyeed in loo dhoofiyo suuqyada Shiinaha iyagoo ka faa’iideysanaya canshuur-dhaaf buuxa. Heshiiskan ayaa ah mid taariikhi u ah horumarinta waaxda kalluumeysiga Soomaaliya, maadaama ay tahay markii ugu horreysay ee badeecadaha kalluunka Soomaaliyeed ay si rasmi ah ugu helaan suuqa Shiinaha fursad canshuur-dhaaf ah, taas oo sare u qaadeysa tartanka iyo fursadaha dhoofinta ee kalluumeysatada iyo ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Kalluumeysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga, Mudane Axmed Xasan Aadan, ayaa sheegay in heshiiskani uu yahay guul weyn oo u soo hoyatay Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan kalluumeysatada, ganacsatada iyo dhammaan daneeyayaasha waaxda kalluumeysiga. Wasiirku wuxuu xusay in heshiisku uu xoojinayo xiriirka dhaqaale ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha, isla markaana uu furayo bog cusub oo iskaashi iyo maalgashi oo faa’iido u leh labada dal. Dhankiisa, Safiirka Dowladda Shiinaha ee Soomaaliya, Danjire Wang Yu, ayaa tilmaamay in heshiiskani uu fududeyn doono ganacsiga labada dal, isla markaana uu kor u qaadi doono is-weydaarsiga ganacsiga iyo horumarinta iskaashiga dhaqaale. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in heshiisku uu faa’iido muuqata u yeelan doono shacabka Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha. Wasaaradda Kalluumeysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga waxay heshiiskan u aragtaa tallaabo istiraatiiji ah oo lagu kobcinayo dhoofinta badeecadaha Soomaaliyeed, lagu xoojinayo dhaqaalaha buluugga, laguna abuurayo fursado cusub oo shaqo iyo horumar dhaqaale oo waara.

items.title: Ururrada Bulshada Rayidka oo Ka Digay Saamaynta Xirnaanshaha Dekedda iyo Suuqyada Boosaaso
items.description: Boosaaso – Ururka dalladda bulshada rayidka ah ee Puntland (PUNSAA) ayaa walaac xooggan ka muujiyay xirnaanshaha muddo dheer socday ee suuqyada iyo howlaha ganacsi ee magaalada Boosaaso, iyagoo ka digay in xaaladdan ay keeni karto sicir-barar, yaraanta badeecadaha daruuriga ah iyo dhibaato dhaqaale oo soo wajahda kumannaan qoys. Suuqyada waaweyn iyo xarumaha ganacsiga ee Boosaaso ayaa xiran maalintii saddexaad oo xiriir ah, halka howlaha Dekedda Boosaaso ay hakad ku jireen muddo laba toddobaad ku dhow. PUNSAA ayaa sheegtay in xaaladdan ay si toos ah u saameynayso nolosha dhaqaale, ganacsi iyo bulsho ee shacabka, gaar ahaan dadka ku tiirsan shaqooyinka maalinlaha ah iyo ganacsiyada yaryar si ay u helaan nolol maalmeedkooda. Ururku wuxuu ka digay in haddii xaaladdu sii socoto ay sare u kici karaan qiimaha maciishadda, ay yaraadaan badeecadaha muhiimka ah, isla markaana culays dhaqaale uu sii saaran doono shacabka ku nool Puntland iyo deegaannada kale ee ku tiirsan Dekedda Boosaaso. PUNSAA waxay ugu baaqday dowladda Puntland, ganacsatada, maamulka dekedda iyo dhammaan dhinacyada khilaafka ku lugta leh inay mudnaanta siiyaan danta shacabka isla markaana ay gaaraan xal degdeg ah oo dib loogu furo suuqyada iyo dekedda. Khilaafkan ayaa ka dhashay canshuuro iyo khidmadaha cusub ee lagu soo rogay badeecadaha soo gala Dekedda Boosaaso, kuwaas oo ganacsatadu ku tilmaameen kuwo sare u qaadaya kharashka ganacsiga xilli ay jireen duruufo dhaqaale oo adag. Ganacsatada ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay maamulka in badeecadaha laga hor istaagay inay ka baxaan dekedda ilaa laga bixiyo lacagaha dheeraadka ah, taas oo sababtay in badeecooyin badan ay ku xayirmaan dekedda. Dekedda Boosaaso ayaa ah halbowlaha ugu weyn ee ganacsiga Puntland, iyadoo ay ka soo galaan cuntooyinka, shidaalka, qalabka dhismaha iyo badeecooyin kale oo muhiim u ah Puntland iyo qaybo ka mid ah bartamaha Soomaaliya. Khubarada dhaqaalaha ayaa sheegaya in xal degdeg ah oo laga gaaro khilaafkan uu muhiim u yahay ka hortagga saameyn dhaqaale oo ballaaran oo ku faafta guud ahaan waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya.

items.title: Why We’re Dismantling the ICC
items.description: Why We’re Dismantling the ICC America never agreed to a world tribunal that can override our own courts and the Constitution.   Author: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio Most of us would struggle to imagine a world in which U.S. soldiers, police officers, Border Patrol agents and elected leaders could be dragged before an international court, tried by judges from random countries across the globe, found guilty under international laws we neither consent to nor control, and then imprisoned thousands of miles from America.   But that is what the International Criminal Court now claims the power to do. The ICC was born at the turn of the century. At first, it was marketed as a narrow backstop to prosecute the gravest crimes. Now the ICC and its allies seek a standing world tribunal with near-unlimited reach, empowered to override the courts and constitutions of the U.S. and other sovereign states—and to prosecute and arrest our citizens.     Americans never agreed to any of this. Both of our major political parties opposed the prospect of handing a distant global court the power to prosecute and jail our own citizens. President Clinton refused to submit the Rome Statute (the ICC’s founding charter) to the Senate for ratification due to his “concerns about significant flaws in the Treaty.” Two years later, a bipartisan Senate supermajority passed the American Servicemembers’ Protection Act, authorizing the president “to use all means necessary”—including military force—to prevent the ICC from detaining or arresting Americans.   Americans found themselves in the crosshairs anyway: In 2020 the ICC launched an investigation into what chief prosecutor Fatou Bensouda of Gambia described as “war crimes by members of the United States armed forces” in Afghanistan, declaring that the U.S. government hadn’t prosecuted enough American soldiers to satisfy the court. In effect, Ms. Bensouda was anointing herself the final judge of U.S. military policy and the entire U.S. justice system. The Afghanistan investigation was only the opening move in the assault against American self-government. The ICC is backed and run by a powerful network of leftist nongovernment organizations, smug globalists, and hostile Third World governments united by their enmity toward the U.S.   In the second Trump administration, these calls have continued to grow. Last year, major activist groups urged high-ranking international officials “to take immediate and meaningful action” against the Trump administration’s deportations of violent criminals to El Salvador. Months later, a former ICC chief prosecutor declared that President Trump’s strikes against narcoterrorists amounted to “a crime against humanity” and should be treated as such under international law—a line that was echoed by United Nations leaders, and major leftist nongovernmental organizations , Democratic Party officials and politicians. In March, the Washington-based Democracy for the Arab World Now urged the Iranian regime to request an ICC investigation of “apparent war crimes” committed by American personnel.   U.S. efforts to push back against the ICC’s illegitimate interventions have been framed as a further reason for the ICC to target Americans. When 12 U.S. senators wrote to the ICC prosecutor about their concerns, the prosecutor’s office accused them of crimes. When Mr. Trump imposed sanctions against ICC personnel, a former head of Human Rights Watch said that “all 125 ICC member states would have a legal duty to arrest him were he to show up.”   It is only a matter of time before the ICC begins making good on these threats. Border Patrol agents working to remove violent criminals from our country, U.S. Marines risking their lives to restore order in the Western Hemisphere, federal prosecutors working to dismantle terror networks plotting attacks on the American homeland—all would face the constant risk of persecution for the “crime” of defending our country.   The ICC’s interfering with American military and law enforcement operations isn’t only a grave overreach of its purported authorities. It would mean the death of the U.S. as a sovereign and independent nation. Our decision and our people would be at the mercy of the ICC and its collaborators in the “international community.” To accept the ICC is to surrender control of our national destiny. Perhaps more polite and compliant nations could make their peace with that arrangement. But this is America. Our forefathers fought a revolution against a foreign power “ transporting us beyond Seas to be tried for pretended offences.” Independence is our birthright. We don’t intend to trade it for rule by a self-appointed priesthood of “international law.”   The Trump administration will always protect American service members from this threat. The U.S. is launching a diplomatic campaign with a simple message—sovereign states over globalism. Those who benefit from American security must not stand idly by while those who provide that security are targeted. This is only the beginning. Using all the tools at our government’s disposal, working beside every ally with whom we can make common cause, we will dismantle the ICC—brick by brick, if necessary.   Marco Rubio was sworn in as the 72nd Secretary of State on January 21, 2025. The Secretary is creating a Department of State that puts America First.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo la kulmay Amiirka dalka Qatar + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo haatan ku sugan magaalada Doha ayaa maanta kulan la yeeshay Amiirka dalka Qatar, Tamiim Bin Xamad, isaga oo uga tacsiyeeyay geerida ku timid Aabihiisa, ahaana Amiirkii hore, Sheekh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani. Kulankan ayaa waxaa labada mas’uul ku wehlinayay mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka kala tirsan dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Qatar, sida ay baahisay Wakaaladda Wararka Qatar ee loo yaqaano QNA. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa dowladda iyo shacabka Qatar uga tacsiyeeyay geerida Amiirkii hore ee dalkaas, isaga oo u muujiyay garab istaag buuxa xilligan murugada. Sidoo kale, waxaa lagu wadaa inuu ka qayb-galo aaskiisa oo ay Doha u tageen wafuud kala duwan oo ka kala socda waddamo badan, oo ay ka mid yihiin Sacuudi Carabiya, Isutegga Imaaraadka Carabta, Baxrayn, Kuwait, Cumaan, Ciraaq, Suuriya, Pakistan, Itoobiya, Kazakhstan, Maldives, Rwanda, Lubnaan, Marooko iyo Liibiya. Dhinaca kale waxaa magaalada Muqdisho ka socda baroor-diiqda Amiirkii hore ee dalka Qatar, iyada oo dowladda Soomaaliya ay calanka hoos u dhigtay muddo saddex cisho ah, kadib amar kasoo baxay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Waxaa kale buug qaran oo tacsi ah laga furay safaaradda Qatar ee magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu maanta tegay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaan Cali oo saxiixay buugga tacsida isla-markaana gaarsiiyay dhambaal tacsi tiiraanyo leh uu ka siday Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, taas oo ku aadan geerida ku timid Aabaha dhalay Amiirka Dalka Qatar ahaana Amiirkii hore Sheekh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani. Wasiirka waxaa soo dhaweeyay Safiir ku xigeenka Dowladda Qatar u fadhiya Muqdisho, Dr. Cabdullaahi bin Saalem Al Nuceymi. Allaha u naxariistee, Sheekh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani ayaa dalka Qatar hoggaaminayay intii u dhexeysay 1995 illaa 2013. Intii uu talada hayay, wuxuu hormuud ka noqday isbeddello waaweyn oo dalkaas ka hirgalay, kuwaas oo sare u qaaday doorka Qatar ee gobolka iyo caalamkaba. Sannadkii 2013 ayuu Sheekh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Than si iskiis ah xilka ugu wareejiyay wiilkiisa, Amiir Tamim Bin Hamad Al Thani. Si kastaba, Dowladda Qatar ayaa hadda wada qaban-qaabadii ugu dambeysay aaska loo sameynayo Amiirkii hore, iyada oo ku dhawaaqday 4 maalmood oo baroordiiq ah oo ka bilaabatay shalay, sidoo kale waxay hoos u dhigtay calanka dalka. The post Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo la kulmay Amiirka dalka Qatar + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .
