items.title: Carruur Soomaali ah oo halis ku wajahaya Minnesota kadib muuqaal uu baahiyey Trump
items.description: Minneapolis (Caasimada Online) – Hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaalida, Muslimiinta iyo ururrada xuquuqda madaniga ah ee gobolka Minnesota ayaa si kulul u cambaareeyey muuqaal uu madaxweyne Donald Trump ku faafiyey bartiisa Truth Social, kaas oo muujinaya carruur Soomaali iyo Muslimiin ah oo u dabaaldegaya qalin-jabintooda fasalka xannaanada. Muuqaalka oo soconaya 14 ilbiriqsi ayaa laga duubay munaasabad ka dhacday Gateway STEM Academy, oo ah dugsi charter ah oo ku yaalla magaalada St. Paul. Carruurta ayaa xirnaa koofiyado iyo khamiisyo buluug ah oo qalin-jabin, halka gabdhaha qaarkood ay xijaab xirnaayeen. Muuqaalka waxaa markii hore baahiyey Somali TV of Minnesota, oo tabinayey xafladaha dhammaadka sannad-dugsiyeedka ee dugsiyada ay dhigtaan carruurta Soomaalida. Trump ayaa muuqaalka laba jeer ku baahiyey Truth Social Isniintii. Markii hore wax faallo ah kuma uusan darin, balse markii labaad wuxuu raaciyey qoraal ka yimid akoon lagu magacaabo “End Wokeness”, kaas oo yiri: “Dugsi dadweyne oo ku yaalla St. Paul, Minnesota. Gabadh kasta waxay xiran tahay xijaab — iyaga oo weliba ku jira fasalka xannaanada.” Inkasta oo Trump uusan si toos ah u sharxin sababta uu muuqaalka u faafiyey, hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada ayaa sheegay in madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu awooddiisa iyo taageerayaashiisa u adeegsaday inuu carruur yar yar ka dhigo bartilmaameed dood siyaasadeed iyo naceyb diimeed. Golaha Xiriirka Mareykanka iyo Islaamka ee CAIR iyo laantiisa Minnesota ayaa sheegay in tallaabada Trump ay halis gelin karto carruurta muuqaalka ka soo muuqatay iyo guud ahaan dugsigooda. “Madaxweyne Trump wuxuu madashiisa caalamiga ah u adeegsaday inuu sii faafiyo naceybka Muslimiinta, isaga oo bartilmaameedsanaya carruur dhigata dugsi hoose,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan ay soo saareen labada hay’adood. CAIR waxay sheegtay in hadallada ama fariimaha naceybka ah ee ka yimaada hoggaamiye siyaasadeed ay dhiirrigelin karaan dadka doonaya inay weeraraan bulshooyinka laga tirada badan yahay. Ururka Somali American Partnership ayaa isna sheegay in carruurta Soomaalida aan loo adeegsan karin hurinta cabsi iyo kala-qeybsanaan. “Soomaali-Mareykanku waxay qeyb muhiim ah ka yihiin taariikhda, nolosha maanta iyo mustaqbalka Minnesota,” ayuu ururku yiri. “Carruurteennu waxay mudan yihiin in lagu aqoonsado kartidooda, halkii loo adeegsan lahaa hurinta naceybka Muslimiinta iyo dadka soo-galootiga ah.” Guddoomiyaha gobolka Minnesota Tim Walz ayaa sidoo kale Trump ku eedeeyey inuu weeraray carruurta sababo la xiriira dharkooda. “Madaxweynaha Mareykanka wuxuu weerarayaa koox carruur ah oo ku jirta fasalka xannaanada, sababtoo ah dharka ay dugsiga u xirnaayeen,” ayuu Walz ku qoray barta X. ‘Carruurta waa khad cas’ Hoggaamiyeyaal Muslimiin, Masiixiyiin iyo Yuhuud ah ayaa Arbacadii shir jaraa’id ku qabtay xarunta ganacsiga Karmel Mall ee Minneapolis, halkaas oo ay kaga digeen saameynta ay hadallada noocan ahi ku yeelan karaan carruurta iyo amniga bulshada. Imaam Yuusuf Cabdulle, oo ah agaasimaha Islamic Association of North America, ayaa sheegay in carruurta Muslimiinta ahi ay xaq u leeyihiin inay ogaadaan inay si buuxda uga tirsan yihiin Minnesota iyo Mareykanka. “Waa inaan carruurteenna loo sheegin inaysan dalkooda ka tirsaneyn dharka ay xiran yihiin awgiis,” ayuu yiri. Malika Dahir, oo hoggaamisa ururka Reviving Sisterhood, ayaa sheegtay in carruurtu aysan ahayn calaamado ay siyaasiyiintu u adeegsan karaan doodahooda. “Carruurtu waa inay noqdaan khadkeenna cas. Ma aha astaamo la adeegsan karo; waa carruur u baahan in lagu ilaaliyo hadalladeenna iyo ficilladeenna,” ayay tiri. Maamulka Gateway STEM Academy ayaa ka gaabsaday inuu si toos ah uga jawaabo Trump, balse agaasimaha dugsiga Mohamed Ahmed wuxuu sheegay in mudnaanta koowaad ay tahay daryeelka iyo badqabka ardayda, qoysaskooda iyo shaqaalaha. Wuxuu sheegay in dugsigu sii wadi doono abuurista jawi waxbarasho oo ammaan ah, ardaydana ku dhiirrigeliya kalsooni, iskaashi iyo inay gaaraan awooddooda buuxda. Cabsi soo noqnoqotay Murankan ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo Soomaalida Minnesota ay muddooyinkii dambe sheegeen inay wajahayaan hadallo siyaasadeed oo isa soo taraya, kuwaas oo la xiriirinaya Soomaalida dembiyo, musuq iyo soo-galooti sharci-darro ah. Trump ayaa bishii December Soomaalida ku tilmaamay “qashin”, isagoo sidoo kale sheegay in Minnesota ay Soomaalidu ka dhigeen “meel halaag ah”. Hadalladaas ayaa markaas cambaareyn kala kulmay Walz, ururrada xuquuqda iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaalida. Deegaanka Minneapolis–St. Paul waxaa ku nool tobannaan kun oo qof oo asal ahaan Soomaali ah, kuwaas oo muddo dheer qeyb muhiim ah ka ahaa dhaqaalaha, siyaasadda iyo nolosha bulshada Minnesota. Hoggaamiyeyaasha Muslimiinta ayaa sheegay in cabsidoodu aysan ku salaysneyn hadallo keliya. Bishii May, nin ay boolisku sheegeen inuu watay laba mindi ayaa lagu xiray bannaanka masaajid ku yaalla Lakeville, kaddib markii shaqaalaha masaajidku sheegeen inuu dhaqmayey si laga shakiyey. Dhacdadaas ayaa timid xilli ay bulshooyinka Muslimiinta Mareykanka ka walaacsanaayeen weerarro iyo hanjabaado ka dhan ah masaajidda iyo xarumaha Islaamiga ah. Jaylani Hussein, agaasimaha CAIR-Minnesota, ayaa hore u sheegay in muddo saddex sano ah gobolka laga diiwaangeliyey in ka badan 40 dhacdo oo isugu jira gubid, burburin iyo qalqal lagu sameeyey masaajidda, kuwaas oo sababay khasaare ka badan saddex milyan oo dollar. Hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada ayaa hadda ku baaqaya in carruurta laga fogeeyo dagaallada siyaasadda, iyaga oo sheegay in qof kasta oo haysta madal dadweyne, gaar ahaan madaxweynaha dalka, ay waajib ku tahay inuu carruurta ilaaliyo halkii uu khatar gelin lahaa. items.title: Cabsi weyn oo soo wajahday Al-Shabaab kadib amarkii madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Kooxda Al-Shabaab ee ka dagaalanta gudaha Soomaaliya ayaa waxaa haatan soo wajahday cabsi xooggan, kadib amarkii kasoo baxay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo maalmo kahor ku dhawaaqay in Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ay qaadayaan dagaal kama dambeys ah oo dalka looga ciribtirayo cadowga Khawaarijta ah. Maleeshiyaada kooxda oo culays badan wajahaya ayaa haatan bilaabay inay isku soo dhiibaan Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka ee ku sugan furimaha dagaalka. Maalmihii lasoo dhaafay dhowr Horjooge oo ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta ayaa isku soo dhiibay dowladda, iyagoo sheegay inay soo wajahday cabsi badan, sida ay shaacisay warbaahinta ku hadasha afka dowladda. Sidoo kale, waxay xubnaha soo goostay sheegeen in markii horaba ay la kulmi jiray weerarrada iyo duqeymaha Ciidamada Qaranka iyo saaxibada caalamiga ah oo ay u dheeraayeen duruufaha adag ee duurka ku heysta Khawaarijta. Meelaha ay iska soo dhiibeen xubnaha soo gacan galay ayaa waxaa kamid ah deegaanada Mubaarak, Buulomareer iyo Jilib-marka ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, halkaas oo ay sidoo kale gaabiga ku hayaan ciidamada dowladda. Arrimahan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya uu Toddobaadkii Xoriyadda markale cafis u fidiyey qofkii kasoo hara fikirka guracan ee argagixisada ee isku soo dhiiba dowladda, dibna ugu soo laabta dadkiisa, isaga oo mar kale iclaamiyay dagaal kama dambeys ah. “Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay qaadi doontaa guluf dagaal oo kama dambeys ah, kaas oo dalka looga saarayo Khawaarijta, dadka Soomaaliyeedna dhawaan ayaan la wadaagi doonnaa qorshahaas,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Tan iyo markii uu soo baxay amarka Madaxweynaha waxaa sidoo kale dhaq-dhaqaaq cidian iyo isku dabarid bilaabay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliska Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka oo tegay furimaha hore ee dagaalka. The post Cabsi weyn oo soo wajahday Al-Shabaab kadib amarkii madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Puntland Forces Block Key Road Near Bosaso Over Unpaid Salaries
items.description: BOSASO— Puntland security forces protesting several months of unpaid salaries have blocked a major road in the Faluuja area of Carmo district, bringing public and commercial transport to a halt. The road serves as a key link between the port city of Bosaso and other regions of Puntland. An eyewitness told Raxanreeb Online that the protesting soldiers identified themselves as members of the Afmeer Brigade of the Puntland forces. The troops reportedly returned from front-line positions in the Calmiskaad mountains about a week ago after failing to receive their salaries and other financial entitlements. The soldiers said the road would remain closed until the Puntland administration addressed their complaints over unpaid wages, which they said had continued for several months. Local sources reported that the troops were stationed along the road with military vehicles, heavy weapons and other equipment, raising concerns about further disruption to travel and trade. The blockade has affected the movement of passengers, traders and goods between Bosaso and surrounding regions. Puntland’s senior military commanders and government officials have not yet issued a public statement regarding the protest or the closure of the road. Similar incidents have occurred in Puntland in the past, with security personnel blocking roads and government facilities to demand the payment of delayed salaries. The blockade has affected the movement of passengers, traders and goods between Bosaso and surrounding regions. Puntland’s senior military commanders and government officials have not yet issued a public statement regarding the protest or the closure of the road. Similar incidents have occurred in Puntland in the past, with security personnel blocking roads and government facilities to demand the payment of delayed salaries. items.title: U.S. embassy in Mogadishu says American flag desecration by Somali security forces harms U.S.-Somalia relations
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The United States Embassy in Mogadishu on Sunday said the desecration of the American flag by members of Somalia’s security forces harms relations between the United States and Somalia, while praising the Somali federal government for its swift response and accountability measures. In a statement, the embassy said anti-American acts undermine the longstanding partnership between the two countries, noting that the United States has provided billions of dollars in assistance to Somalia and has long supported military operations against terrorist organizations that threaten both American and Somali interests. “Anti-American acts harm our bilateral relationship. The United States has provided billions of taxpayer dollars in assistance to Somalia. Most notably, the good faith of the American people has long supported military action against terrorist organizations which threaten the United States and, most directly, target the Somali people,” the embassy said. The embassy also welcomed the Federal Government of Somalia’s prompt response after a video circulated widely online showing individuals identified as members of the Somali Security Forces standing on and desecrating the American national flag. “The U.S. Embassy appreciates the Federal Government of Somalia’s quick response and decisive actions following a video of individuals in the Somali Security Forces desecrating the American flag. Malfeasant actors who seek to tarnish Somalia’s relationship with the United States harm the Somali people and must continue to be held accountable,” the statement added. The embassy’s remarks came days after the video emerged and spread widely on social media, drawing attention at a sensitive moment in U.S.-Somalia relations. The incident comes as the United States has recently informed the African Union that it intends to end its support for United Nations logistical assistance to the peacekeeping mission in Somalia. Washington cited a lack of sufficient progress by Somali authorities on security, political stability and the transition of Somalia’s security forces to assume full responsibility for the country’s security. On Friday, Somalia’s federal government announced that it had arrested the soldiers seen in the video, saying they would face disciplinary measures as well as legal action over their conduct. The government said the actions captured in the footage were unacceptable, reaffirming its commitment to holding those responsible accountable. The incident has renewed attention on the importance both governments attach to preserving their longstanding partnership as Somalia and the United States continue cooperating on counterterrorism efforts and broader initiatives aimed at strengthening Somalia’s security and stability. items.title: Amiir Hamad Bin Khaliifa oo lagu ammaanay inuu ahaa hoggaamiyaha keliya ee booqday Gaza taniyo markii la go’doomiyay
items.description: Madaxa Xamaas ee dibadda, Khaalid Mashal, ayaa sheegay in Amiirkii hore ee Dowladda Qatar, Sheekh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, uu ahaa hoggaamiyihii ugu horreeyay ee Carbeed ee booqda Marinka Gaza tan iyo markii go’doominta lagu soo rogay. Mashal ayaa sheegay in booqashadaas ay ahayd mid taariikhi ah oo astaan u noqotay taageerada Qatar ay u muujisay shacabka reer Gaza, isaga oo xusay in ay jebisay go’doomintii siyaasadeed ee lagu hayay deegaankaas. Hadalkan ayuu jeediyay xilli ka tacsiyeeyay geerida amiirka oo dhowaan la shaaciyay, wuxuuna si faahfaahsan uga hadlay kaalinta Qatar ee arrimaha Falastiin. Amiir Sheekh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani ayaa booqday Gaza bishii Oktoobar 2012, isagoo noqday madaxii ugu horreeyay ee dowlad Carbeed oo si rasmi ah u taga Gaza tan iyo markii go’doominta la adkeeyay sannadkii 2007. Intii uu halkaas joogay wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taageero dhaqaale oo ballaaran oo loogu talagalay dib-u-dhiska kaabeyaasha iyo adeegyada bulshada, wixii xilligaas ka dambeeyayna Qatar waxay si joogto ah u difaacaysay dadka reer Falastiin. Amiirka ayaa sidoo kale lagu xusuustaa inuu xilka wareejiyay asagoo caafimaad qaba, culayso kalena aysan haysan, taas oo ah mid aan looga baran hoggaamiyaasha dalalka Carabta, gaar ahaan kuwa Khaliijka.

items.title: Cali Siciid reer Xaaji Saalax Cabashadooda Oodweyne  hoos ha loo dhegaysto
items.description: CALI SICIID REER XAAJI SAALAX CABASHADOODA OODWEYNE HOOS HALLOO EEGO. Waxaan warbaahinta ka daawaday maayarkii oodweyne oo tirsanaya in laysugu tegay LA MUQUUNIYAY oo mooshin xilkii lagaga qaaday arrinkaas oo u cuntamiwaayay umadda reer somaliland inta aqoonta u leh oodweyne iyo dhaqamada Habaryoonis. Qabiilka cali siciid waa jifo (ardaa) ka mida Habaryoonis oo leh maamuus gaar ah oo lagu xasuusto, waa ardaa miisaan culus ku leh h. Yoonis oo ay tahay in saamigooda hoos loo eego. Waxa habboon dadka in taariikhda lagu qaddariyo, waa jifadii muj. Maxamad cali,muj.saleebaan baylot (duuliye sare) Dr. Saleebaan reer xaaji Cabdillaahi shiikh muxumad carab, xaaji axmad qulunbbe iwm oo dhammaantood Habaryoonis iyo isaaqba xusuus kaga tegay, maayarka waxay walaalo ahaayeen mujaahid Cabdillaahi qasaal oo ahaa sarkaal geesi ilaahaya, waxa ka mida khadar ambasador iyo rag la mida oo dalka wax weyn ku soo kordhiyay sidaas awgeed maskabkooda hallagu ixtiraamo. MAHADSANID. CABDI BACAW. GUUL ALLE. LONDON.

items.title: Hoggaamiyihii Dhisay Qatar-ta Casriga ah oo geeriyooday
items.description: Sheekh Xamad Bin Khaliifa Aal Thaani, Amiirkii hore ee Dowladda Qatar iyo Amiirka Aabbaha, ayaa geeriyooday maanta oo ku beegan 12-ka Luulyo 2026, isagoo jiray 74 sano. Dowladda Qatar ayaa si rasmi ah u shaacisay geeridiisa, hase yeeshee ma aysan faahfaahin sababta dhimashada. Sheekh Xamad wuxuu ku dhashay magaalada Doha sanadkii 1952, wuxuuna waxbarasho ciidan ku soo qaatay kulliyadda caanka ah ee Royal Military Academy Sandhurst ee dalka Boqortooyada Ingiriiska. Ka dib wuxuu ku biiray ciidamada Qatar isaga oo qabtay xilal kala duwan oo ciidan iyo dowladeed. 27-kii Juun 1995 ayuu noqday Amiirka Dowladda Qatar, isagoo hoggaamiyay dalka muddo 18 sano ah ilaa uu xilka si iskiis ah ugu wareejiyay wiilkiisa, Amiirka hadda talada haya ee Sheekh Tamiim Bin Xamad Aal Thaani, sanadkii 2013. Tallaabadan ayaa ahayd mid aan caadi ka ahayn dalalka Khaliijka, maadaama uu si nabad ah awoodda ugu wareejiyay jiilka xiga. Intii uu talada hayay, Sheekh Xamad wuxuu Qatar ka dhigay mid ka mid ah dalalka ugu dhaqaalaha badan dunida, isaga oo si weyn u maalgeliyay gaaska dabiiciga ah, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, waxbarashada iyo caafimaadka. Waxa kale oo lagu xusuustaa aasaaska warbaahinta caalamiga ah ee Al Jazeera, ballaarinta Qatar Airways iyo dejinta himilada horumarineed ee 2030. Dadka reer Qatar iyo madaxda caalamka ayaa ku tilmaamay Sheekh Xamad inuu ahaa hoggaamiye aragti dheer leh oo door weyn ku lahaa kor u qaadista magaca iyo saameynta Qatar ee gobolka iyo caalamka. Geeridiisa ayaa lagu tilmaamay dhammaadka xilli muhiim ah oo ka mid ahaa taariikhda casriga ah ee dalka Qatar. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa tacsi tiiraanyo leh u diray Amiirka Dowladda Qatar, Sheekh Tamiim Bin Xamad Aal Thaani, qoyska reer Aal Thaani iyo guud ahaan shacabka walaalaha ah ee Qatar. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay la wadaagayso Dowladda iyo shacabka Qatar murugada ka dhalatay geerida hoggaamiyihii hore ee dalkaasi, isagoo xusay doorkii weynaa ee uu ku lahaa horumarka iyo casriyeynta Qatar. “Waxaan tacsi tiiraanyo leh u dirayaa Amiirka Dowladda Qatar, qoyska boqortooyada iyo shacabka Qatar geerida ku timid Sheekh Xamad Bin Khaliifa Aal Thaani. Waxaan Alle uga baryayaa marxuumka inuu ku mannaysto naxariistiisa janno, qoyskiisa iyo shacabka Qatarna uu siiyo samir iyo iimaan,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo dalal dhowr ah oo dhambaal u direy amiirka Qatar kadib geeridii ku timid…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ka tacsiyeysay geerida amiirkii hore ee dowladda Qatar, Sheekh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani oo maanta geeriyooday. Dhambaalka tacsida ayaa si gaar ah loogu diray Amiirka Qatar, Sheekh Tamim Bin Hamad Al Thani oo uu ahaa aabbihii. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Villa Soomaaliya ayaa lagu ammaanay kaalintii uu Sheekh Hamad ka qaatay horumarinta Qatar iyo taageerada uu u fidiyay dalal badan oo caalamka ah. Sidoo kale, Dowladda Federaalka ayaa tacsi iyo samir u rajeysay qoyska, shacabka iyo dowladda Qatar. Geerida Sheekh Hamad kadib, waxaa isa soo tarayay dhambaallada tacsida ee ka imanayay madaxda caalamka, iyadoo hoggaamiyeyaal badan ay farriimo tacsi ah u direen dowladda Qatar. Waxa kale oo la filayaa in madax kala duwan ay u safraan magaalada Dooxa si ay uga qayb-galaan aaska iyo saxiixa buugga tacsida ee loo furayo marxuumka. Sheekh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani ayaa Qatar hoggaaminayay intii u dhexeysay 1995 illaa 2013. Intii uu talada hayay, wuxuu hormuud ka noqday isbeddello waaweyn oo dalkaas ka hirgalay, kuwaas oo sare u qaaday doorka Qatar ee gobolka iyo caalamkaba. Sannadkii 2013 ayuu si iskiis ah xilka ugu wareejiyay wiilkiisa, Amiir Tamim Bin Hamad Al Thani. Dhanka kale, dowladda Qatar ayaa ku dhawaaqday afar maalmood oo baroordiiq qaran ah oo ka bilaabanaysa maanta, iyadoo calanka dalka hoos loo dhigay. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale wada qaban-qaabada aaska rasmiga ah ee loo sameynayo amiirkii hore. Waxaa la filayaa in maalmaha soo socda magaalada Doha ay gaaraan madax iyo wufuud ka kala socota dalal badan oo caalamka ah, kuwaas oo ka qayb-geli doona aaska Sheekh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani, isla markaana tacsi u gudbin doona hoggaanka iyo shacabka Qatar. items.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo ka digtay halis weyn oo soo wajahday nus milyan qof oo ku sugan magaalada El-Obeid ee Suudaan
items.description: Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Carruurta (UNICEF) ayaa ka digtay in ku dhowaad 500,000 oo rayid ah oo ku nool magaalada El-Obeid ay halis weyn ku jiraan, xilli gobolka Waqooyiga Kordofan ee Suudaan ay dagaallo culus weli ka socdaan. Hay’adda UNICEF ayaa sheegtay in dagaallada sii xoogeysanaya ay ku qasbayaan carruur iyo qoysas badan inay ka barakacaan guryahooda, iyagoo raadinaya goobo ay gabaad ka helaan, xilli ay sii xumaanayso xaaladda bani’aadantinimo ee magaalada. Dagaalka u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda Suudaan iyo ciidamada gurmadka degdegga ah ee RSF ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo badqabka shacabka, iyadoo hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay ay ku baaqayaan in la ilaaliyo dadka rayidka ah isla markaana la fududeeyo gaarsiinta gargaarka bini’aadantinimo. items.title: Duq Muqdisho iyo duqa Magaalada St. Louis Park, Gobolka Minnesota oo kulan ku yeeshay Caasimada Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Guddoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho, Dr. Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), ayaa maanta ah xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Duqa Magaalada St. Louis Park, Gobolka Minnesota ee dalka Maraykanka, Marwo Nadia Mohamed, oo booqasho rasmi ah ku joogta Caasimadda Soomaaliya. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iskaashi ee u dhexeeya Caasimadda Muqdisho iyo Magaalada St. Louis Park, is-weydaarsiga khibradaha maamulka dowladaha hoose, horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, iyo kobcinta wada-shaqeynta. Guddoomiye Dr. Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) oo si diirran u soo dhaweeyay Marwo Nadia Mohamed, ayaa ku bogaadiyay guusha taariikhiga ah ee ay gaartay, taas oo ka dhigtay haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee Soomaaliyeed, Muslimad iyo Madow ah ee loo doorto xilka Duqa Magaalada St. Louis Park. Guddoomiyuhu waxa uu sheegay in guushaasi ay tahay mid dhiirrigelin u ah dhammaan bulshada Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dhalinyarada iyo haweenka, islamarkaana ay muujinayso kartida iyo kaalinta sii kordheysa ee ay Soomaalidu ku leeyihiin hoggaaminta iyo adeegga bulshada. Dhankeeda, Marwo Nadia Mohamed ayaa uga mahadcelisay Guddoomiye Dr. Muungaab soo dhaweynta iyo martigelinta uu u sameeyay, iyadoo bogaadisay dadaallada ay Dowladda Hoose ee Muqdisho ku horumarinayso adeegyada bulshada, bilicda magaalada iyo dib-u-dhiska Caasimadda. Waxay sidoo kale muujisay sida ay uga go’an tahay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya labada magaalo. items.title: Qatar oo si kulul uga jawaabtay weerarradii Iiraan, kana digtay sii hurinta colaadda gobolka
items.description: Dowladda Qatar ayaa si kulul u cambaareysay weerarradii ugu dambeeyay ee Iiraan ay ku qaaday dhulkeeda iyo dalal kale oo gobolka ka tirsan, iyadoo ku tilmaantay xadgudub halis ku ah madax-bannaanida dalalka iyo amniga gobolka. War-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Qatar ayaa lagu sheegay in sii socoshada weerarradan ay ka dhigan tahay khatar weyn oo sii adkeyn karta dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu doonayo in lagu dejiyo xiisadda Bariga Dhexe. Dowladda Qatar waxay sheegtay in weerarradan ay sii fogeynayaan rajada laga qabo xal nabadeed oo lagu xalliyo colaadda taagan. Qatar ayaa ugu baaqday dhammaan dhinacyada inay muujiyaan is-xakameyn, ayna ka fogaadaan tallaabo kasta oo horseedi karta ballaarinta dagaalka, iyadoo ku adkaysatay in wadahadal iyo xal diblomaasiyadeed ay yihiin waddada keliya ee lagu xaqiijin karo xasilloonida gobolka. Hadalka Doha ayaa imaanaya xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan iska horimaadyada militari ee u dhexeeya Iran iyo Mareykanka, kuwaas oo saameyn ku yeeshay dalal badan oo Khaliijka ah. Weerarradii ugu dambeeyay ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in colaaddu isu beddesho dagaal ballaaran oo saameeya amniga iyo dhaqaalaha gobolka.

items.title: Ciidamo katirsan Puntland kana gadoodsan mushaar la’aan oo xirtay waddo
items.description: Boosaaso (Raxanreeb Online) Ciidamo katirsan Puntland oo ka gadoodsan Mushahar la’aan ayaa xirtay deegaanka Faluuja ee Degmada Carmo, Kuwaas oo gabi ahaanba joojiyay isu socodkii Dadweynaha, Waddadas oo halbowle u ahayd Magaalo Ganacsiyeedka Boosaaso iyo Gobolada kale. Sida uu noo sheegay Goobjooge Ciidamadan ayaa iskugu sheegay in ay ka titsan yihiin Guutada Afmeer ee Ciidamada Puntland, kuwaas oo Toddobaad ka hor ka soo degay Furimaha hore ee Calmiskaad kaddib markii ay waayeen Xuquuqdii ay lahaayeen. Sidoo kale ciidamada ayaa sheegay in ay wadada sii xirnaan doonto, ilaa madaxda Puntland ay wax ka qabtaan cabashooda ku aadan mushaar la’aanta ah oo dhowr bil socotay. Ciidamada ayaa la tilmaamay in wataan gadiid dagaal iyo hub culus, isla markaanana dalabkoodu uu yahay mid adag. Ilaa iyo hadda ma jiro war kasoo baxay saraakiisha sare ee ciidamada Puntland, kaasi oo looga hadlayo gadoodka ciidanka iyo xayiraad ay sareen in la isticmaalo Waddadas oo halbowle u ahayd Magaalo Ganacsiyeedka Bosaaso iyo Gobolada kale. Ma ahan markii ugu horeeysay oo ciidamo katirsan Puntland, ay xirtaan waddo iyaga oo ka cabanaya mushaar la’aan awgeed. items.title: Somaliland: Xilkii guddoomiye Saleebaan baneeyay oo la buuxiyay – Yaa loo doortay?
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Mudaneyaasha Golaha Guurtida Somaliland oo maanta xarunta golaha ee magaalada Hargeysa ku yeeshay kalfadhi aan caadi ahayn ayaa doortay guddoomiyaha cusub ee golaha kadib markii uu saaka xilkii iska casilay Saleebaan Maxamuud Aadan oo muddo 22 sano ah soo hoggaaminayay golaha Kadib markii golaha uu ansixiyey is-casilaadda guddoomiyihii hore waxa si rasmi ah loogu dhawaaqay musharraxiinta u taagan xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Guurtida Somaliland, kuwaas oo kala ahaa: Xildhibaan Muuse Xaaji Cabdi Ducaale Xildhibaan Sahal Iidle Dirir Suldaan Ismaaciil Suldaan Cabdiraxmaan Markii musharraxiinta la siiyey fursad ay golaha uga jeediyaan hadalladooda, Xildhibaan Sahal Iidle Dirir ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu si rasmi ah uga tanaasulay musharraxnimadiisii. Sidoo kale, Suldaan Ismaaciil Suldaan Cabdiraxmaan, markii la siiyey fursad uu hadal u jeediyo golaha, waxa uu soo jeediyey in doorashada guddoomiyaha golaha dib loo dhigo si loo sii wado wada-tashiyada. Intaas kadib, Ismaaciil ayaa isaguna si rasmi ah uga tanaasulay musharraxnimadiisii. Sidaas darteed, Xildhibaan Muuse Xaaji Cabdi Ducaale ayaa noqday musharraxa keliya ee u taagnaa xilka guddoomiyaha Golaha Guurtida, kaas oo sida muuqata loo waday kursiga. Mudaneyaasha Golaha Guurtida ayaa si wadajir ah ugu codeeyay in loo doorto Guddoomiyaha Golaha Guurtida, iyadoo aan wax diidmo ah laga muujin. Sidaas darteed Xildhibaan Muuse Xaaji Cabdi Ducaale ayaa si rasmi ah loogu doortay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Guurtida Somaliland, isaga oo helay kalsoonida iyo taageerada dhammaan Mudaneyaasha golaha ee fadhiga joogay. items.title: Ciidamada NISA oo fuliyay howlgal guuleystay oo lagu beegsaday…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabad-sugidda Qaranka (NISA) ayaa caawa howlgal qorsheysan ka fuliyey xaafadda Galmudug ee degmada Garasbaaley, kaas oo lagu beegsaday laba xubnood oo ka tirsanaa kooxda Al-Shabaab. Howl-galka ayaa lagu guuleystay in lagu dilo mid ka mid ah maleeshiyaadkii la bartilmaameedsaday, halka kii kalena la dhaawacay, sida ay xaqiijiyeen saraakiishii hoggaaminaysay ciidamada fuliyey howl-galka. Saraakiisha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in howl-galka uu u dhacay sidii loo qorsheeyey, isla markaana ciidamada ay si buuxda u gaareen ujeeddooyinkii laga lahaa. Ciidamada amniga oo ka feejigan dhagarta iyo shirqoolada kooxda ayaa sidan oo kale xalay fashiliyey qorshe weerar oo xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab damacsanaayeen inay ka geystaan xaafadda Xaawo-Taako ee magaalada Beledweyne. Ciidamada ayaa si degdeg ah uga hortagay falkaas, iyagoo toogtay mid ka mid ah xubnihii kooxda, halka xubin kalena la qabtay isagoo nool. Si kastaba, ciidamada dowladda ayaa sii wada howl-gallada ka dhanka ah kooxda Al-Shabaab, si looga hortago weerarro iyo falal amni-darro oo ay qorsheynayaan. Howl-galladan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee ay hay’adaha ammaanka Soomaaliya ku xoojinayaan sugidda amniga iyo ciribtirka kooxda Al-Shabaab ee ka dagaallanta dalka. items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Guurtida Somaliland oo is-casilay
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Guurtida Somaliland, Saleebaan Maxamuud Aadan ayaa saaka ku dhawaaqay inuu iska casilay xilka guddoomiyenimada Golaha Guurtida, taas oo uu ku shaaciyay fadhi aan caadi ahayn oo goluhu yeeshay. Go’aanka Saleebaan ayaa imanaya kadib in ka badan 22 sano oo uu hoggaaminayay Golaha Guurtida Somaliland, iyadoo is-casilaaddiisa uu ku sababeeyay duruufo shaqsiyeed, oo ay ugu horreyso da’da. “Waan daalay, da’ ayaa gaaray. Haddii maskaxdu joogtana muruqii ayaa maqan oo tallaabadeydu way gaabinaysa. Marka inta xasuustu tagin, waxaa isleeyahay ha ka gaadhsiisid. items.title: Sawirro: Taliyaha Booliska Jabuuti oo yimid Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliiska Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti Col. Cabdiraxmaan Cali Kaahin iyo wafdi hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta soo gaaray magaalada Muqdisho, kaddib casuumaad rasmi ah oo uu ka helay dhiggiisa Taliyaha Booliska Soomaaliya Sarreeye Guuto Asad Cusmaan Cabdullaah (Diyaano) oo kusoo dhaweeyay garoonka magaalada Muqdisho. Soo dhaweynta ayaa waxaa si wayn uga qayb-qaatay saraakiisha kala duwan ee Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka iyo safiirka Jabuuti u fadhiya magaalada Muqdisho. Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska Jabuuti oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa ka mahad-celiyay soo dhaweynta loo sameeyay, wuxuuna kadib faah-faahiyay ujeedkiisa safarkiisa ee Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, wuxuu sheegay in dhowr cisho uu joogi doono gudaha dalka, isla markaana uu usii gudbi doono gobollada, si uu usoo qiimeeyo xaaladda. “Dhowr cisho ayaan joogayaa waxaan ku tala jiraa inaan gobollada wada maro oo indha-indheeyo, Soomaaliya wax badan oo been ah ayaa laga sheegaa,” ayuu yiri Taliye Cabdiraxmaan Cali Kaahin. Dhanka kale, waxa uu ka hadlay arrimo ku aadan taariikhda labada dal ee walaalaha ah iyo halganka adag ee ay usoo mareen xoreynta labada waddan. “Soomaaliya waa waddankaygii labaad Soomaaliya waxa ay Jabuuti u qabatay waan garaneynaa dadaalkii ay dowladda Soomaaliya u gashay waa la wada garanayaa. Soomaaliya haddii aynan jirin Jabuuti xor ma noqoteen,” ayuu mar kale yiri Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidanka Booliska ee Dalka Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti. Waxaa kale oo uu kusii daray “Sidaas daraadeed maanta oo ay Soomaaliya ka yara liicday Jabuuti kaalintii berigii ay Soomaaliya joogtay maanta u joogsato weeyaan, wayna u joogsatay”. Jabuuti ayaa kamid ah dowladaha dariska ah ee saaxibtinnimada wayn ay kala dhexeyso Soomaaliya, waxaana lagu soo xasuustaa doorkeeda ku aadan dhismaha dowlad dhiska Soomaaliya, iyadoo sidoo kale ciidamo ay ka joogaan dalka, kuwaas oo ka qayb ka ah ciidanka nabad ilaalinta ee Midowga Afrika. The post Sawirro: Taliyaha Booliska Jabuuti oo yimid Muqdisho appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.description: Miami ( Raxanreeb Online) Xulka Argentina ayaa iska xaadiriyay wareegga afar dhammaadka ee Koobka Adduunka, kaddib markii uu saddex gool iyo hal kaga adkaatay xulka Switzerland. Ingiriiska iyo Argentina oo difaacanaysa tartankan waxay wada ciyaari doonaan kulanka afar dhammaadka, halka Faransiiska iyo Spain oo hore u soo baxay ay is wajihi doonaan. items.title: Iran oo sheegtay in aysan hoggaasami doonin heshiiskii ay la gashay Marekanka
items.description: Tehran ( Raxanreeb Online) Iiraan ayaa ku dhawaaqday inaysan u hoggaansami doonin heshiisyada ay la gashay Mareykanka “ilaa iyo inta Maraykanku sii wado xadgudubyada” heshiiska loogu talagalay in lagu soo afjaro dagaalka Bariga Dhexe. Telefishanka dowladda Iiraan oo soo xiganayey safiirka dalka Iran u fadhiya Qaramada Midoobay, Amir Saeed Irvani, kaas oo sheegay in Tehran aysan isku arki doonin inay ku dheganaadaan ballanqaadka ku xusan heshiiska is-afgaradka ee ay Islamabad la gashay Washington inta ay sii waddo jebinta waajibaadkeeda ku xusan heshiiskaas. Irvani wuxuu ku eedeeyay Mareykanka inay sii wadaan weerarrada milatari ee baaxadda leh ee lagu bartilmaameedsanayo madaxbannaanida iyo sharafta dhuleed ee Iiraan. Wakaaladda Wararka ee Fars ayaa soo xigatay ilo Iiraaniyiin ah oo sheegaya in wax wadahadallo ah aysan dhici doonin ilaa Mareykanku uu ka laabto mowqifkiisa hadda, isagoo tixraacaya is-afgaran waaga u dhexeeya Tehran iyo Washington ka hor wadahadallada la filayo. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Iiraan Cabbas Caraqchi ayaa ku qoray bogga X in “in Iiraan ay ilaa hadda ku adkaysatay moowqifkeeda, isagoo ku nuuxnuuxsaday in “habka kaliya ee loo mari karo xalka uu yahay in labada dhinacba ay si wadajir ah ugu hoggaansamaan ballanqaadyadooda. The post Iran oo sheegtay in aysan hoggaasami doonin heshiiskii ay la gashay Marekanka appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

Taageerayaashiisu waxay ku ammaanaan kaalintii uu ka qaatay ilaalinta xasilloonida iyo dejinta xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee soo noq-noqday. Dhanka kale, isaga iyo Golaha Guurtida ayaa sannado badan wajahayay dhaliilo uga imanayay xisbiyada mucaaradka, ururrada bulshada rayidka ah iyo falanqeeyayaasha siyaasadda. Dhaliilahaasi waxay inta badan la xiriireen muddo-kordhinno loo sameeyay hay’adaha dowladda iyo eedeymo ku saabsan in goluhu uusan si buuxda u gudan waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah. Haddii is-casilaaddan si rasmi ah u dhaqan-gasho waxay soo afjari doontaa sooyaalka mid ka mid ah hoggaaminnadii ugu muddada dheeraa ee hay’adaha Somaliland. Golaha Guurtida ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu bilaabo hannaanka dastuuriga ah ee lagu soo dooranayo guddoomiye cusub, iyadoo isbeddelkan si weyn isha loogu hayo marka la eego kaalinta muhiimka ah ee Goluhu ku leeyahay nidaamka siyaasadeed ee Somaliland. items.title: Iran oo garaacday shan ka mid ah dalalka Carabta
items.description: Iran ayaa sheegatay masuuliyadda weeraro Axaddan ka dhacay Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Cumaan iyo Jordan, iyadoo ay sii kordheyso xiisadda ka aloosan Gobolka Bariga Dhexe. Weeraradan ayaa ah kuwo ay Iran kaga aargudaneyso duqaymo uu saaka Mareykanka ka gaystay bartilmaameedyo ku yaala dalkaasi, isagoo ku eedeeyay in ciidamadeeda ay Sabtidii weerareen markab ganacsi oo marayay Marinka Hormuz. Saraakiisha Iran ayaa sheegay inay garaaceen xarumaha iyo kaabeyaasha Militariga Mareykanka ee dalalkaasi. War ka soo baxay Taliska Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran ayaa lagu sheegay inay weerar culus oo lama filaan ah ku qaadeen xarumaha taageerada saadka iyo goobaha shidaalka lagu shubo ee ay isticmaalaan shirkadaha diyaaradaha Mareykanka ee Dekedda Duqm ee Cumaan. Taliska ayaa soo saaray war kale oo ay ku sheegayaan in sidoo kale ay gantaalada ballaastikada ku garaaceen Saldhigga Cirka Al Udeid ee ay isticmaalaan Ciidamada Mareykanka ee ku yaala dalkaasi Qatar. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay in Ciidamada Iran ay burburiyeen xarun lagu dayactiro, laguna habeeyo diyaaradaha dagaalka iyo sidoo kale xarun talis iyo maamul oo ku tiilay saldhigga. Taliska ayaa war kale oo uu soo saaray ku sheegay inay gantaalada ballaastikada ku bartilmaameedsadeen Saldhigga Cirka Prince Hassan ee Jordan, ayna burburiyeen xarun talis iyo goob ay ka kacaan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee MQ-9. Warbaahinta Dowladda Iran ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada dalkaasi ay mowjado duqaymo ah ku qaadeen xarumo militari oo Mareykanku ku leeyahay Kuwait iyo Bahrain, iyadoo la adeegsanayo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Warbaahinta Iran ayaa ku warantay duqaymahan lagu beegsaday nidaamka difaaca hawada ee Patriot, bakhaar rasaas ah iyo goob raadaar ah oo Militariga Mareykanka ku leeyihiin Kuwait, sidaasi oo kalena ay ciidamadu bartilmaameedsadeen nidaamka isgaarsiinta Mareykanka iyo goob raadaar oo ku taala Bahrain. Tehran ayaa dalalka Carabta, gaar ahaan kuwa Khaliijka ku eedeysay inay gacan siinayaan Ciidamada Mareykanka ay weerarada ka gaysanaya gudaha Iran. Iraaniyiinta ayaa waxay mar walbaba sheegaan inay ka aargudan doonaan goobaha ay ku tilmaamayaan inay yihiin saldhigyada laga soo qaado weerarada lagu hayo dhulka Iran.

items.title: Duqa magaalada St. Louis Park  ee dalka Mareykanka oo ka jawaabtay hadal-heyn ka dhalatay booqashadii ay dhowaan Soomaaliya ku timid
items.description: Duqa magaalada St. Louis Park ee gobolka Minnesota, Naadiya Maxamed, ayaa ka jawaabtay dhaleeceyn loo jeediyay kadib booqasho ay ku timid Soomaaliya, taasoo ku soo aaday xilligii dabaaldegga maalinta xorriyadda Mareykanka ee 4-ta Luulyo. Maamulka magaalada St. Louis Park ayaa sheegay in safarku aanu la xiriirin howlaha dowladda hoose, isla markaana Naadiya Maxamed ay iyadu iska bixisay dhammaan kharashaadka safarka. Intii ay ku sugnayd Muqdisho, Naadiya Maxamed ayaa ka qeybgashay kulamo iyo munaasabado kala duwan, waxaana kamid ahaa kulan ay la yeelatay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Sidoo kale waxaa soo dhaweeyay mas’uuliyiin iyo xubno ka tirsan bulshada, iyadoo booqatay qaar kamid ah jaamacadaha dalka. Naadiya ayaa sheegtay in safarku ahaa mid gaar ah oo qoys, ayna isticmaashay fasaxeeda shaqada si ay u booqato ehelkeeda oo aysan arag muddo 10 sano ah. Muuqaal ay dhowaan ku baahisay barta X ayay Naadiya Maxamed si dhiiranaan leh ugu jawaabtay dadka dhaliilay safarkeeda, iyadoo sheegtay inay ahayd wax aan caadi ahayn in lagu eedeeyo inay fasax u isticmaashay booqashada qoyskeeda. Waxay tiri inay lix sano u adeegaysay shacabka St. Louis Park, ayna waqtigeeda fasaxa u isticmaashay inay booqato ayeeyadeed. Naadiya Maxamed ayaa sidoo kale ka hadashay kulankeedii Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, iyadoo sheegtay inuusan ahayn markii ugu horreysay ee ay la kulanto hoggaamiye ajnabi ah. Waxay xustay inay hore ula kulantay madaxweynihii hore ee Switzerland, balse aysan markaas la kulmin isla heerka su’aalaha iyo dhaleeceynta. Waxay sheegtay in qaar kamid ah dadka dhaliilaya safarkeeda ay ka faa’iideystaan hadallada ka dhanka ah Soomaalida si ay u helaan daawasho iyo dareen baraha bulshada. Hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee ku nool magaalooyinka mataanaha ah ee Minneapolis iyo St. Paul ayaa dhawaan cambaareeyay hadallo ay sheegeen inay kicinayaan naceyb ka dhan ah Soomaalida iyo Muslimiinta, kadib qoraal uu baraha bulshada ku baahiyay Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump oo lagu soo bandhigay carruur dhigata xannaano ku taal Minnesota, kuwaas oo ay ku jireen carruur Soomaaliyeed oo xijaaban.

items.title: Iiraan oo sheegtay inay burburisay xarunta taliska milatariga Mareykanka ee dalka Urdun
items.description: Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan ayaa sheegay inay gantaallo ballistic ah ku weerareen saldhigga cirka ee Amiir Xasan (Prince Hassan Air Base) ee dalka Urdun, kaas oo ay ku tilmaantay saldhig ay leeyihiin ciidamada Mareykankau. Bayaan ka soo baxay dhinaca Iiraan ayaa lagu sheegay in weerarka lagu burburiyay xarunta taliska iyo xakamaynta ee saldhigga, sidoo kalena la beegsaday hangarrada ay ku jiraan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee nooca MQ-9. Ilaalada Kacaanka ayaa sheegtay in howlgalka lagu fuliyay dhowr gantaal oo ballistic ah, iyadoo ku tilmaantay tallaabadaas mid ka mid ah weerarrada lagu qaaday goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka. Ilaa hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo ka soo baxay dowladda Urdun ama ciidamada Mareykanka oo xaqiijinaya sheegashada Iran ama faahfaahin ka bixinaya khasaaraha ka dhashay weerarka. Xiisadda u dhexeysa Iran iyo Mareykanka ayaa sare u kacday kadib markii ay labada dhinac ku lug yeesheen weerarro is-daba joog ah oo ka dhacay Bariga Dhexe, taas oo sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in colaadda ay ku fido dalal kale oo gobolka ah.

items.title: Militariga Mareykanka oo weerar cusub ku qaaday Iran
items.description: Militariga Mareykanka ayaa weerar cusub oo xagga cirka ah ku qaaday Iran wax yar uun ka dib, markii ciidamada dalkaasi ay ku dhawaaqeen inuu xiran yahay Marinka Hormuz. Taliska Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu xiran yahay marin biyoodka Hormuz, illaa amar dambe, Mareykankana uu ka joojinayo fara-gelintiisa gobolka. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay inay qaadeen mowjad cusub oo weeraro ka dhan ah Iran, iyadoo laga jawaabayo weerar ay Ciidamada Iran ku waxyeeleeyeen markab marayay Marinka Hormuz. Taliska CENTCOM ayaa sheegay in Ciidamada Mareykanka ay fuliyeen duqaymihii saddexaad oo toddobaadkan ay ka gaystaan dalkaasi, ka dib markii talisku uu sheegay in Ciidamada Iran ay si bareer ah u weerareen markab sita Calanka Qubrus (Cyprus). Ciidanka Badda Iran ayaa Sabtidii rasaas ku furay, isla-markaana joojiyay markab xamuul oo ku gooshayay Hormuz, waxayna Tehran sheegtay in uu ka weecday waddada la ansixiyay ee la ogol yahay inay maraakiibtu maraan. Tallaabada lagu beegsaday markabkan ayaa daba socoto dhacdooyin bilowgii isbuuca lagu weeraray saddex markab oo nooca shidaalka qaada ah, taas oo keentay weerarada ay Talaadadii iyo Arbacadii is dhaafsadeen Mareykanka iyo Iran. Taliska CENTCOM ayaa saaka sheegay in markabka MV GFS Galaxy ee Sabtidii shalay la weeraray uusan sii wadi karin safarkiisa, sababtoo ah burbur weyn oo soo gaaray qaybta motoorka ee markabkaasi. Taliska ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in hal shaqaale la la’yahay. “Iran waxaa la siiyay fursad kale oo ay ku muujiso u hoggaansanaanta heshiiska is fahamka, ka dib markii lagu eedeeyay weeraradii hore ee lagu qaaday maraakiibta ganacsiga, balse mar kale way ku guuldareysatay.” Ayuu Taliska CENTCOM ku sheegay warsaxaafadeed. Weerarka markabka iyo go’aankii daba socday ee ay Iran ku xanibtay isu socodka maraakiibta ee Hormuz ayaa yimid, iyadoo Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu Iran u qabtay inay 24 saac gudahood ku shaaciso inay joojin doonto weerarada maraakiibta ku sugan Marinka Hormuz. Wasiirka Difaaca Mareykanka, Pete Hegseth ayaa sheegay in Iran ay qaadatay go’aan xun, haddana ay bixinayaan qiimahaas, sida uu yiri. Xakamaynta Iran ee Hormuz ayaa cadaadis siyaasadeed iyo mid dhaqaalaba ku ah Maamulka Trump.

items.title: Iiraan oo sheegtay inay xirtay marinka Hormuz
items.description: Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran (IRGC) ayaa sheegay in marinka muhiimka ah ee Hormuz la xiray, kaddib markii ay rasaas digniin ah ku rideen markab ganacsi oo marayay biyaha gobolka. Tallaabadan ayaa sare u qaadaysa xiisadda ka taagan Bariga Dhexe, maadaama marinka Hormuz uu yahay mid ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan dunida, halkaas oo ay maraan qayb weyn oo ka mid ah dhoofinta shidaalka caalamka. IRGC ayaa sheegtay in tallaabadan ay qayb ka tahay tallaabooyin amni oo ay qaadeen, halka dhinacyada caalamiga ah ay ka digayaan in xiritaanka marinka uu saameyn weyn ku yeelan karo ganacsiga caalamka, qiimaha shidaalka iyo maraakiibta ganacsiga. Marinka Hormuz, oo isku xira Gacanka Faaris iyo Badda Cumaan, ayaa muddo dheer ahaa goob xasaasi ah oo ay ku loolamaan Iran iyo dalalka reer Galbeedka, gaar ahaan xilliyada ay sii kordhaan khilaafaadka siyaasadeed iyo militari. Haddii xiritaanka marinka uu sii socdo, waxaa laga cabsi qabaa in ay saameyn ku yeelato sahayda tamarta caalamka, isla markaana ay kordhiso cadaadiska diblomaasiyadeed ee u dhexeeya Iran iyo dalalka kale ee arrintan ku lugta leh.

items.title: Taliska Iran oo ku dhawaaqay inuu xiran yahay Marinka Hormuz
items.description: Iran ayaa ku dhawaaqday gebi ahaanba inuu xiran yahay Marinka Hormuz, xili ay cirka isku shareertay xiisadda kala dhaxeysa Mareykanka ee ka taagan Bariga Dhexe. Taliska Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran ayaa saaka si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqay in marin biyoodka Hormuz uu xiran yahay, illaa amar dambe iyo inta uu Mareykanka ka joojinayo fara-gelinta uu ku hayo gobolka. Tallaabadan ayaa timid, ka dib markii Ciidanka Badda Iran ay Sabtidii rasaas ku fureen, isla-markaana ay joojiiyeen markab xamuul oo adeegsaday waddo aan la ogolayn. Iran ayaan ogoleyn in maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraya Marinka Hormuz ay si furan ugu socdaalaan marinkaasi. Tehran ayaa ogol in maraakiibta caalamiga ah ay ku gooshaan Hormuz, keliya haddii ay raacayaan habka isku dubaridka Dowladda Iran ee habaynta amniga iyo badbaadada. Go’aanka Iran ee lagu xanibay isu socodka maraakiibta ee Hormuz ayaa sidoo kale imanaya, xilli Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu Tehran u qabtay inay 24 saac gudahood ku shaaciso inay joojin doonto weerarada maraakiibta ku sugan Marinka Hormuz. Mareykanka ayaa Iran ku cadaadinaya in ay soo celiso xorriyadda socdaalka maraakiibta ee marinka istiraatiijiga ah Hormuz ee Gacanka Faaris. Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa habeenkii Talaadada garaacis ku bilaabay bartilmaameedyada gudaha Iran saacado uun ka dib, markii Madaxweyne Trump uu ku dhawaaqay inuu burburay heshiiskii xabad joojinta ay labada dal gaareen bishii June, sababtu tahay Iran oo uu ku eedeeyay inay ciidamadeeda weerareen maraakiib ganacsi oo ku sugnaa marin biyoodka Hormuz. Ka dib duulaankii wadajirka ahaa ee Mareykanka iyo Israel ay 28-kii bishii February ku qaadeen dalkaasi Iran, Tehran ayaa bilowday inay kontoroosho marin biyoodka muhiimka ah ee ku yaala Gobolka Bariga Dhexe. Ka hor dagaalka 40-ka maalmood ee Mareykanka iyo Israel ay sanadkan la galeen Iran, maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ayaa si xor ah ku mari jiray Hormuz. Dagaalkan ayaa laga dhaxlay in markii ugu horreysay ay Iran canshuur ku soo rogto gaadiidka xamuulka badda ee isticmaala marinka ugu mashquulka badan ee adduunka.

items.title: Iiraan oo ku hanjabtay “inaysan u hoggaansami doonin heshiisyada ay la gashay Mareykanka
items.description: Iiraan ayaa ku dhawaaqday inaysan u hoggaansami doonin heshiisyada ay la gashay Mareykanka “ilaa iyo inta Maraykanku sii wado xadgudubyada” heshiiska loogu talagalay in lagu soo afjaro dagaalka Bariga Dhexe. Telefishanka dowladda Iiraan oo soo xiganayey safiirka dalka Iran u fadhiya Qaramada Midoobay, Amir Saeed Irvani, kaas oo sheegay in Tehran aysan isku arki doonin inay ku dheganaadaan ballanqaadka ku xusan heshiiska is-afgaradka ee ay Islamabad la gashay Washington inta ay sii waddo jebinta waajibaadkeeda ku xusan heshiiskaas. Irvani wuxuu ku eedeeyay Mareykanka “inay sii wadaan weerarrada milatari ee baaxadda leh ee lagu bartilmaameedsanayo madaxbannaanida iyo sharafta dhuleed ee Iiraan.” Wakaaladda Wararka ee Fars ayaa soo xigatay ilo Iiraaniyiin ah oo sheegaya in wax wadahadallo ah aysan dhici doonin ilaa Mareykanku uu ka laabto mowqifkiisa hadda, isagoo tixraacaya is-afgaran waaga u dhexeeya Tehran iyo Washington ka hor wadahadallada la filayo. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Iiraan Cabbas Caraqchi ayaa ku qoray bogga X in “in Iiraan ay ilaa hadda ku adkaysatay moowqifkeeda,” isagoo ku nuuxnuuxsaday in “habka kaliya ee loo mari karo xalka uu yahay in labada dhinacba ay si wadajir ah ugu hoggaansamaan ballanqaadyadooda.”

items.title: Ciidamada oo dilay nin Shabaab ahaa oo ku lug lahaa weerar ka dhacay Beledweyne
items.description: Ciidamada amniga ee ka hawlgala Magaalada Beledweyne ee Xarunta Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa caawa toogasho ku dilay nin ka tirsanaa maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, halka mid kalena la sheegay inay gacanta ku dhigeen, ka dib markii raggaasi ay weerar ka gaysteen xaafadda Nuur Xawaad ee magaaladaasi. Taliyaha Saldhigga Booliska Beledweyne, Gaashaanle Cabdullaahi Maxamuud Siyaad ayaa sheegay in saddex nin oo Shabaab ah ay nin askari ahi ku weerareen xaafaddaasi, taasna ay keentay in la dilo mid ka mid ah, mid kalena gacanta lagu soo dhigo. “Kooxaha nabadiid qolo ka mid ah ayaa waxay soo weerartay xaafadda Nuur Xawaad, gaar ahaan aagga Suuqa Xoolaha. Meeshaas waxay kula kulmeen askari ka tirsan ciidamada ammaanka, meeshaas ayayna bambooyin iyo xabad kula bilaabeen, askariguna wuu is difaacay. Xabaddii markay bilaabatay askarigii wuu dhaawacmay, qolooyinkii meesha soo weerartay ee argagixisada nin ka mid ahna meeshuu ku reebtay.” Ayuu yiri Taliyaha oo intaasi ku daray in labadii kale oo firxad ah ay intaasi ka dib daba galeen. Hawlgalka baadigoobka oo ay gacan ka gaysteen dadka deegaanka ayaa horseeday in nolosha lagu qabto mid ka mid ah labadii nin ee baxsadka ahaa. Afhayeenka Maamulka Gobolka Hiiraan, Liibaan Cumar Xasan oo mar dambe Wariyeyaasha kula hadlay goob lagu soo bandhigay meydka ninka la dilay ayaa sheegay in mid kalena nolosha lagu hayo. “Waad aragtaan meeshaan waxaa yaala meydkoodii, mid kalena noloshaa lagu hayaa.” Ayuu yiri Afhayeenka Maamulka Gobolka Hiiraan. Afhayeenka ayaa shacabka ku bogaadiyay dadaalkooda ku aaddan in la qabto ninkaasi, oo lagu hayo xarun ay leeyihiin laamaha ammaanka. “Waxaan rabnaa shacab ama bulshada gobolka, sida ay hadda uga dhiidhiyeen si ka xoogan inay ula shaqeeyaan maamulka, waana midda saxda ah oo looga guuleysan karo.” Ayuu yiri Afhayeenka. Afhayeenka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Caawa waxa meeshaan ka dhacay, waxay tusaale ugu filan yihiin cid kasta ama Al Shabaab ha ahaato ama qolo kasta ha ahaatee oo isku dayeysa inay amniga dhibaateyso ayay tusaale u tahay arrintaasi.” Dadka reer Beledweyne ayaa si weyn u hadal haya dhacdadan.

items.title: Xoogaga AUSSOM oo ka qayb qaatay hawlgal ay ciidamada ka sameeyeen duleedka Baraawe
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo garabsanaya Ciidanka Qaybta 1aad, Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ayaa Sabtidan hawlgal amni xaqiijin ah ka sameeyay bannaanada Degmada Baraawe ee Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose. Ciidamada ayaa la sheegay inay si wadajir ah u fuliyeen hawlgal roondo oo lagu xaqiijinayo amniga duleedka Degmada Baraawe. Taliska AUSSOM ayaa sheegay in Korneyl Cabdiraxmaan Cilmi Jimcaale (Xarago) oo ka tirsan Saraakiisha Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Korneyl Justus Musenene oo ka tirsan Militariga Uganda ee qaybta ka ah Ciidanka AUSSOM ay hoggaaminayeen hawlgalka. Taliska AUSSOM ayaa sheegay in hawlgalka uu muujiyay iskaashiga xoogan ee ka dhaxeeya AUSSOM iyo Ciidamada Somaliya ee ku aaddan ilaalinta amniga, dhisidda kalsoonida dadweynaha iyo diidmada xorriyadda dhaqdhaqaaqa ee Al Shabaab. Taliska ayaa sheegay in hawlgalka roondooyinka isku dhafan ay sii socon doonaan, si looga hortago argagixisada, loo xoojiyo amniga dadweynaha, loona taageero jewi ammaan ah oo loogu talagalay bulshada iyo horumarka deegaanka. items.title: Somali Government and Opposition Edge Closer to Electoral Agreement
items.description: MOGADISHU — The Federal Government of Somalia and opposition groups appear to be moving closer to an understanding on key aspects of the country’s electoral process, following talks facilitated by Türkiye and international partners. Sources familiar with the discussions say the two sides have made progress on several major issues, particularly the principle of holding elections based on universal suffrage. Deputy Prime Minister Salah Ahmed Jama said the negotiations had advanced and were now focused on the practical arrangements required to implement the proposed electoral model. Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame, leader of the Wadajir Party and a member of the Somali Future Council delegation, said the opposition had accepted the principle of holding a one-person, one-vote election. However, he said the existing 4.5 clan-based power-sharing system should remain in place on a transitional basis until the country establishes an inclusive electoral framework supported by a broad political consensus. The Nabad iyo Nolol political movement, led by former President Mohamed Abdullahi Farmaajo, has also expressed support for a one-person, one-vote election conducted through a multiparty political system. The movement said its position was broadly consistent with the electoral principles currently being promoted by the Federal Government. Despite the emerging consensus on universal suffrage, significant differences remain over the implementation of the electoral process. Outstanding issues include the structure and composition of the electoral commission, the mechanism for conducting the polls and the political agreement required to provide a legitimate and widely accepted foundation for Somalia’s elections. The outcome of the talks is expected to play a critical role in determining whether Somalia’s political stakeholders can reach a unified electoral framework and avoid further disputes over the country’s next national elections. items.title: Mr. President: Let Somali Children Be Children—Not Symbols in an Adult Political World
items.description: By Osman Ali Hassan Mr. President, there is a photograph circulating on social and mainstream media . It shows a group of children, no older than five or six, beaming at their kindergarten graduation in St. Paul, Minnesota. They are dressed in caps and gowns, and a number of the girls wear hijabs. Recently, you shared this image, questioning why these young children dress in such a way. The underlying implication of the post was that this symbol of faith is somehow alien, perhaps even threatening. At the same time, the nation is grappling with the latest, most horrifying revelations from the unredacted Epstein files—documents that detail a world where the innocence of children is not a sacred trust, but a commodity to be bought, sold, and exploited. Mr. President, these two images—the smiling hijabi kindergarteners and the stark, brutal testimony of Epstein’s child victims—are not separate issues. They are symptoms of the same crisis: a national failure to protect the most vulnerable among us from a world that is increasingly hostile to them. To target a group of Muslim kindergarteners while the world recoils at the exploitation of children in Epstein’s circle is a profound moral contradiction, one that demands a clear and urgent response from you, Mr. President. The Epstein files have torn back the curtain on a machine of child exploitation that operated with impunity for decades. It was a system built on a foundation as old as predation itself: the targeting of the young, the vulnerable, and the disenfranchised. The documents describe a sophisticated grooming process, where a 13-year-old girl at a summer arts camp was approached by Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell, not with overt threats, but with promises of mentorship and support, preying on her family’s financial struggles. This is the chilling reality of the world these kindergarteners are entering. The newest, unredacted files have revealed a victim as young as nine years old. Representatives who viewed the files described reading accounts of “15-year-old girls, 14-year-old girls, 10-year-old girls,” and finally, a mention of a child who was just nine . This is not a distant, abstract crime. This is a clear and present danger that our children face. When we see images of happy kindergarteners, we are looking at the prime targets for predators like Epstein: children who are young, trusting, and whose innocence is their greatest vulnerability. The response to the Epstein files has been a frenzy of conspiracy theories and performative outrage, but the core lesson—that our children are at risk from powerful adults who feel entitled to their bodies—has been largely lost in the noise. Meanwhile, a different kind of exploitation is being perpetrated on a separate group of children. You, Mr. President, have amplified a narrative that targets Somali-American daycares, using a viral but unverified video to justify halting federal funding for childcare programs. This action has not only left hundreds of thousands of low-income families in limbo, but it has also directly exposed Somali-American children and their families to violent threats and harassment. A community leader shared a voicemail left for a daycare operator: “All of you trashy Muslims, men, women, and children, will be burned to death. You will all die”. As a result, mothers are terrified to send their children to school, fearing they will be targeted because their hijab marks them as Muslim. Mr. President, how can we profess outrage at the exploitation of children when we are actively fostering an environment where they are targeted simply for being who they are? A child’s right to safety is not contingent on their religion. This is not just about bullying or discrimination; it is about the same cycle of dehumanization that allowed Epstein’s network to flourish. The first step in any form of exploitation is to convince the public that the victim is “other,” that they are not worthy of the same empathy and protection. It is the logic that allowed “the public” to accept the existence of a network that recruited teenage girls for a price—$200 for each new girl they could bring to Epstein’s mansion. It is the same logic that allowed the justice system to accept a plea deal for a predator who had committed “crimes against children,” a term some in the media attempted to soften to “underage women” . Now, the same pattern is playing out on the national stage. By amplifying a narrative that portrays Somali-Americans as “lowlifes” and “garbage,” you are creating a permission structure for hate . You are telling a segment of the population that these children are somehow less deserving of protection, that their innocence is not as precious. The assault on these children is multifaceted. It is not only verbal and political; it is physical. Somali leaders in Minnesota have reported break-ins, vandalism, and a school bus set on fire by a hate group. This is the logical conclusion of a rhetoric that paints an entire community as an existential threat. It is the same trajectory that any marginalized group faces when their humanity is denied. At the same time, the released Epstein files reveal that Epstein’s network had a global reach, with potential connections to East Africa itself. Newly unsealed records have flagged Somalia as an area associated with “potential paedophile activity” and revealed that Epstein’s circle discussed business ventures in Somaliland, even proposing a media production center that would produce children’s programming. The irony is sickening: while the President of the United States targets a group of Somali kindergarteners at home, the files show Epstein was eyeing their homeland as a potential playground for his operations and exploitation. The leadership vacuum on this issue is stark. It is a failure of moral leadership that permits the public dehumanization of children in one breath and the exploitation of them in another. To be clear, the exploitation of a child by a predator like Epstein is not the same as the discrimination they face in the schoolyard. But they are connected by a thread of power and a lack of protection. The Epstein case was only possible because a powerful man was believed, protected, and given the benefit of the doubt over the girls he abused. He was able to function because no one was willing to stand up and say, “This is wrong, and I will stop it.” The same dynamic is at play in the attacks on Somali-American communities. Your words, Mr. President, have immense power. When you use that power to denigrate a child for her hijab, you are telling every abuser and bully that her vulnerability is fair game. You are creating the same environment of impunity that allowed a man like Epstein to operate for decades. As a mother of young children, I see the threat more acutely. My son is 12. I worry about the world he is growing up in—a world saturated with harmful media, digital predators, and casual cruelty. The Epstein files provide a chilling lesson for parents: that we must fight against the forces that seek to commodify our children. But what about the children whose parents are not just fighting predators, but are also fighting for their community’s right to exist? The Somali mothers in Minnesota are not only terrified for their children’s physical safety; they are terrified that the highest office in the land has endorsed the rhetoric that makes that violence possible. Mr. President, you have been given the opportunity to be a unifier, to be the protector of all Americans. Instead, by choosing to amplify fear of a child in a hijab, you are abandoning your most fundamental duty. To the parents and families of those Somali kindergarteners, know that your children are a source of strength, not a sign of division. They are a symbol of a bright and diverse American future. They are not the problem; they are the promise of our nation. Mr. President, I will end with a direct appeal to you. The world is watching, and so are these children. They are too young to understand the complexities of the Epstein files, the debates over redactions, or the subtle politics of power. But they are old enough to know when they are being targeted, when their families are afraid, and when they are made to feel that their presence in our country is a cause for concern. This is not a political issue, Mr. President. It is a moral test. We cannot afford to fail. We must protect our children from the predators who would exploit them, and we must protect them from the politicians who would use them as a prop. They are, and they must always be, off-limits. They are our children, and they deserve better. Osman A. items.title: Deepening Rift Emerges Within Somalia’s Opposition as Election Dispute Intensifies
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Sharp divisions have reportedly emerged within Somalia’s Salvation Forum (Madasha Samatabixinta) over the country’s electoral model, exposing growing fractures in the opposition at a critical juncture in Somalia’s political transition. According to informed sources close to the Salvation Forum, former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed accused former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire and opposition leader Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame of contributing to the fragmentation of the opposition bloc. The sources said Sharif criticized the two leaders for focusing on internal opposition rivalries instead of maintaining a united front against the Federal Government. Sharif have reportedly argued that the lack of cohesion has prevented the opposition from adopting a common position on the proposed electoral framework, creating an opening for President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud to prolong political negotiations and gain valuable time. According to the same sources, Khaire and Abdirahman Abdishakur rejected the criticism, telling Sharif that they had urged former President Mohamed Abdullahi “Farmaajo” to join the Future Council (Golaha Mustaqbalka) when Turkish-mediated political talks first began. They claimed Farmaajo declined the invitation, citing his own reasons for remaining outside the coalition. Sharif is said to emphasize Farmaajo’s strategic importance to the broader opposition, arguing that the former president remains a significant political figure whose participation could strengthen the opposition’s negotiating position. He is also said to have noted that while Farmaajo and President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud are now political rivals, Farmaajo continues to advocate the same political vision he pursued during his presidency beginning in 2018. The reported disagreements come as Somalia’s political stakeholders continue to debate the country’s electoral roadmap ahead of the next national elections. Sources say both the Salvation Forum and the Future Council remain opposed to a political party-based electoral process if it results in a contest primarily dominated by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and former President Farmaajo. The two opposition groupings reportedly believe such a scenario would marginalize other political actors and have pledged not to support an electoral arrangement they view as lacking broad political consensus. The reported internal disagreements underscore the growing challenge facing Somalia’s opposition as it seeks to present a united position during negotiations over the country’s political future. With disagreements emerging not only between the government and opposition but also within opposition ranks, prospects for reaching a comprehensive agreement on the electoral model remain uncertain. The claims in this report are based on information provided by sources close to the Salvation Forum. The individuals named have not publicly commented on the reported exchange. items.title: Hero’s Welcome for Somali FIFA Referee Omar Cartan in Jigjiga Ahead of Regional Cup Final
items.description: Jigjiga (WDN) — Internationally acclaimed Somali football referee Omar Abdulkadir Cartan received a rousing welcome on Friday after arriving in Jigjiga, the capital of Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State, ahead of the highly anticipated Regional Cup final. Somalia’s International referee receives warm welcome in Jigjiga Hundreds of football supporters, sports officials, and senior representatives of the Somali Regional State gathered at Jigjiga Airport to greet the distinguished referee, celebrating one of Somalia’s most accomplished sporting figures. The warm reception reflected both admiration for his achievements and pride in his growing international stature. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Masar oo ka wada-hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda ee dalalka Soomaaliya iyo Masar oo ku wada xiriiray khadka taleefanka ayaa ka wada-hadlay iskaashiga labada dal iyo arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan gobolka. Wasiir Cabdisalam Cali (Dhaay) iyo dhiggiisa Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Jaaliyadaha Dibadda ee dowladda Masar, Mudane Dr. Badr Abdelatty ayaa wada-hadalkooda kusoo qaaday xoojinta xiriirka laba geesoodka ah iyo xaaladaha gobolka, gaar ahaan Geeska Afrika, sida lagu sheegay warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya. Wasiir Cabdisalaam Dhaay ayaa uga mahadceliyey dowladda Masar taageerada joogtada ah ee ay Soomaaliya ka siiso dhinacyada siyaasadda, horumarinta iyo amniga. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay xoojinta iskaashiga laba geesoodka ah, isku duwidda iyo danaha ay labada dal wadaagaan. Dhankiisa, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar Abdelatty ayaa asna sheegay taageerada aan leexleexadka lahayn ee Masar u hayso madaxbannaanida, midnimada, wadajirka dhuleed iyo hay’adaha qaranka ee Soomaaliya. Wasiirka ayaa mar kale ku celiyey diidmada Masar ee isku day kasta oo Israa’iil ay ku aqoonsanayso gobolada waqooyi ee Soomaaliya inuu yahay dal madax bannaan, taas oo ka hor imanaysa madaxbannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya iyo Masar ayaa leh iskaashi ballaaran, iyagoo hore u gaaray heshiis dhanka amniga ah, waxaana labada dal ay iskaashigooda sii xoojiyeen kadib heshiiskii muranka dhaliyay ee Itoobiya la gashay Somaliland, kaas oo Addis Ababa ay ku dooneysay inay ku hesho marin ay ku gaarto badda Soomaaliya. Qaahira ayaa sidoo kale haatan door weyn ka qaadaneysa tayeynta ciidamada Soomaaliya, iyadoo siinaysa hub iyo qalab ciidan. items.title: Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya iyo Masar oo ka wada hadlay xiriirka labada dal iyo xaaladda Geeska Afrika
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cali, ayaa maanta khadka taleefanka kula yeeshay wada hadal Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda, Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah iyo Jaaliyadaha Masar ee Dibadda, Dr. Badr Abdelatty. Labada wasiir ayaa ka wada hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Masar, iyagoo sidoo kale diiradda saaray xaaladaha gobolka Geeska Afrika iyo arrimaha gobolka saameynta ku leh. Wasiir Cabdisalaam Cali ayaa uga mahadceliyey dowladda Masar taageerada joogtada ah ee ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada siyaasadda, horumarinta iyo amniga, isaga oo caddeeyey sida ay Dowladda Soomaaliya uga go’an tahay sii xoojinta iskaashiga iyo wada shaqeynta labada dal ee arrimaha ay wadaagaan. Dhankiisa, Wasiir Badr Abdelatty ayaa mar kale xaqiijiyey mowqifka dowladda Masar ee taageerada buuxda u ah madaxbannaanida, midnimada, wadajirka dhuleed iyo hay’adaha qaranka ee Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, dowladda Masar ayaa ku celisay diidmadiisa ku aaddan isku day kasta oo lagu aqoonsanayo gobollada waqooyi-galbeed ee Soomaaliya inay yihiin dal madax-bannaan, iyadoo ku tilmaamtay arrintaasi mid ka hor imanaysa madaxbannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya.

items.title: Amarkii Guddoomiye Muungaab oo ka dhaqan-galay Muqdisho + Video
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimada Soomaaliya waxaa si rasmi ah uga dhaqan-galay amarkii ka dhanka ah lo’da ee dhawaan kasoo baxay Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir, Mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), kaas oo ay si wayn u bogaadiyeen shacabka caasimada. Ganacsatada suuqa wayn ee Bakaaraha oo maanta la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa sheegay in muddo dheer ay la tacaalayeen dhibaatada lo’da lagu soo daynayo gudaha suuqa, balse ay hadda ka nasteen, waxayna u mahadceliyeen Maamulka Gobolka. Sidoo kale, ganacsatada ayaa sheegay tan iyo markii uu soo baxay amarka Guddoomiye Muungaab in suuqa yu noqday mid nadiif ah, kadib la xakameeyay lo’dii dhibaatada ku haysay ganacsigooda, gaar ahaan qudaarta iyo badeecadaha kale. “Guddoomiye Muungaab iyo guddoomiyeyaasha degmooyinka shaqada ay noo qabteen aad ayaan ugu riyaaqsanahay annaga hadda nahay ganacsatada Bakaaro ee dhibanaa, lo’da dhib badan ayay nagu haysay haddana waa ka raysanay,” ayuu yiri wiil kamid ah ganacsatada suuqa wayn ee Bakaaraha. Sidoo kale wuxuu ku daray “Waxaan rajeynayaa Muungaab sida uu Lo’da u qabtay inuu Ariga xittaa sii xaraasho, waana ku mahadsan yihiin waxqabadka muuqda ee uu la yimid”. Dhankooda qaaar ka mid ah shacabka ku dhaqan Bakaaraha ayaa iyaguna xusay in isku socodka suuqa iyo waddooyinka ay soo hagaageen, maadaama ay meesha ka baxday lo’dii caqabadda ku ahayd suuqa. “Shacabka Bakaaro waa ka nasteen lo’dii dadka dabada ka hirtineysay guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir waan u mahadcelineynaa khayr Allaha siiyo,” ayay tiri hooyo kamid ah dadka deegaanka. Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ee uu hoggaaminayo Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) ayaa horay u sheegay in ololahiisa ku aadan hormarinta caasimada iyo bilic soo celinteeda ay sii socon doonto, iyadoo la adkeynayo fulinta awaamiirta la xiriirta nadaafadda guud ee magaalada Muqdisho. items.title: Saraakiisha Turkiga oo Ciidamada Somaliya ku tababaraya Dugsiga Qorilow
items.description: Saraakiisha Turkiga ayaa si rasmi ah wejiga labaad ee tababarka Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Somaliya uga bilaabaya Dugsiga Qorilow ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe. Tallaabadan ayaa qayb ka ah ballaarinta xarumaha iyo xoojinta iskaashiga difaaca ee Somaliya iyo Turkiga, iyadoo xiriirka labada dal uu xoogeysanayay sanadihii u dambeeyay. Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa kuu sheegaya in ujeedka ugu weyn ee sare loogu qaadayo tababarka ciidamada uu yahay, si wax looga qabto amniga guud ee dalka. Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Qorilow ayaa ku yaala duleedka Degmada Warsheekh, waxaana xusid mudan in Dowladda Federaalka ay dhawaan dib u hawlgelisay, ka gadaal markii uu ku burburay dagaalkii sokeeye ee dalka. Dugsigan oo horey loogu tababari jiray Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa hadda awood u leh in mar kale lagu tababaro Ciidamada Qalabka Sida. Dugsiga Qorilow ayaa loo diyaariyay xero weyn oo hal mar lagu tababari karo ku dhawaad kun askari. Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Axmed Macalin Fiqi iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa Arbacadii booqday xeradan, oo ay degan yihiin cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Kumaandooska Gorgor, waxaana ku xareysan ciidamo cusub oo lagu wado in si rasmi ah halkaasi loogu tababaro. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka Turkiga, General Metin Tokel oo Jimcihii ka degay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde ee Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa dalka u yimid hirgelinta heshiisyada difaaca ee labada dal, oo qayb ka ah in la kordhiyo tababarka ciidamada. Saraakiisha Militariga Turkiga ayaa ku dhawaad muddo 10 sano ah ciidamada ku tababari jiray Dugsiga TURKSOM ee duleedka Muqdisho iyo qaarkood oo tababaro dheeraad ah loogu qaado dalkaasi Turkiga, haddase xeryaha ay ku tababarayaan ciidamada ee dalka gudihiisa, isla-markaana diyaarka ah ayaa ah laba xero. Turkiga ayaa lagu tilmaamaa saaxiibka ugu weyn ee ay Somaliya leedahay, wuxuuna si firfircoon uga taageeraa dib-u-dhiska ciidamada, tayayntooda, amiga iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha.

items.title: Somaliland’s Speaker of the Upper House of Parliament is due to officially tender his resignation tomorrow
items.description: The Speaker of the Somaliland’s Upper House of Parliament known as Guurti, Mr. Suleiman Mohamud Adan, is expected to officially announce his resignation from the speakership as well as his membership of the parliament after he led the House for 22 years. A spokesman who spoke on behalf of the Speaker has revealed that the Speaker has taken a final decision, and has informed Somaliland President, Mr. Abdirahman Mohamed Abdillahi Irro about his decision to vacate the position. Sources close to the speaker said that various efforts which are aimed at postponing or reversing the decision ended in vain while he insisted on his decision to resign from the speakership. It is expected that members of the Upper House of Parliament will convene an extraordinary meeting where he will officially announce his resignation. Mr. Suleiman is 92 years old, and has held the position since 2004. He is one of the longest serving politicians in Somaliland. Sources close to him further disclosed that the main reason that he is vacating the position is due to his old age. He also wants to take a rest from the heavy duties that he has been in charge of.
