Markii lacagta mobilada ay ka guurtay inay noqoto mid ka mid ah astaamaha isgaarsiinta una noqoto qayb ka mid ah nolol maalinleyda maaliyadeed, ayaa isbedel weyn la sameeyay. EVC Plus ma aysan ahayn mid si fudud u soo bandhigtay hab lacag bixin oo cusub. Waxay ka caawisay wax ka qabashada mid ka mid ah caqabadaha ugu waaweyn ee maaliyadda Soomaaliya: sida dadku u beddeli karaan qiimaha marka lacagta caddaanku aanay habboonayn, aanay ammaan ahayn, yar tahay, ama aanay la isku kalsoonaan karin. Iyadoo la adeegsanayo taleefan gacanta, hawlaha maaliyadeed hadda kuma xirna laan bangiga, lacag caddaan ah, ama isweydaarsiga wejiga-wejiga. EVC Plus waxay suurtogalisay in la diro oo la helo lacag, la bixiyo biilasha, la galo adeegyada bangiyada, iyo in la dhammeeyo macaamilka maalinleyda iyadoo la adeegsanayo isku-xirka mobilada ee fudud. Bogga Hormuud Telecom ee EVC Plus wuxuu sharxayaa astaamaha sida dirista iyo helista lacagta, bixinta biilasha, iyo galitaanka akoonnada bangiyada. [1] Tan waxay beddeshay doorkii taleefanka laftiisa. Ma ahayn oo keliya qalab isgaarsiin; waxa uu noqday qalab wax ku ool ah oo lagu dhaqaajiyo qiimaha, lagu yareeyo dib-u-dhacyada bixinta, laguna fududeeyo macaamilka maalinleyda dadka iyo ganacsiyada. Hadda, EVC Plus waa mid lacag la’aan ah marka la eego isticmaalka, taas oo ka caawinaysa yareynta caqabadaha kharashka iyo ballaarinta helitaanka bixinta dijitaalka ah ee isticmaalayaasha maalinleyda ah, ganacsiyada yaryar, iyo qoysaska. Tani waa sababta lacagta mobilada Soomaaliya aanay u ahayn oo keliya sheeko tiknoolajiyadeed. Waxay sidoo kale tahay sheeko ku saabsan la qabsiga dhaqaale, kalsoonida dadweynaha, iyo adkeysiga bulsho. Laga bilaabo fudayd ilaa kaabayaal maaliyadeed Suuqyada qaarkood, lacagta mobilada waxaa loo arkaa mid fudayd ah. Laakiin Soomaaliya, bulshooyin, ganacsiyo, iyo qoysas badan, waxay noqotay wax u dhow kaabayaal maaliyadeed. Sidee lacagta moobaylku uga caawisay Soomaaliya inay dib u dhisto kalsoonida dhaqaale? Muhiimada ay leedahay waxay ku jirtaa cabbirka iyo ku-tiirsanaanta. Lacagta mobilada waxay noqotay qayb ka mid ah sida qiimaha ugu dhaqaaqo suuqyada, guryaha, adeegyada, iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsiga. Halkii ay noqon lahayd qalab dijitaal oo ikhtiyaari ah, waxay noqotay mid ka mid ah nidaamyada ay dadku ku tiirsan yihiin si ay u sii wadaan nolol maalinleyda dhaqaale iyadoo kaabayaasha maaliyadeed ee rasmiga ah ay sii socdaan. Warbixinno dhow iyo tixraacyo suuq ayaa muujinaya in lacagta mobilada ay sii ahayd mid si qoto dheer ugu dhigan nolol maaliyadeed Soomaaliya. Hagaha dalka Soomaaliya ee U.S. International Trade Administration ee 2024 ayaa lacagta mobilada ku tilmaamay mid baahsan, iyadoo la qiyaasay in 73% dadku isticmaalaan. [5] Warbixinno 2026 ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay sida ay u jilicsan tahay dhaqaalaha lacagta caddaanka ah ee hadhay, ka dib markii diidmada lacagaha shilling-ka Soomaaliyeed ee duugga ah ay carqaladeeyeen ganacsatada, gaadiidka, iyo qoysaska dakhliga yar, iyadoo doolarka Maraykanka iyo wareegga taleefanka ay sii wadeen doorkooda muhiimka ah ee isweydaarsiga maalinleyda. [8] Cilmi-baaris dhow ayaa sidoo kale baartay lacagta mobilada Soomaaliya wax ka baxsan bixinta fudud, iyadoo lagu tilmaamay qayb ka mid ah la qabsiga dhaqaale iyo adkeysiga dalka, gaar ahaan jawi jilicsan oo cimiladu dhib badan tahay. [9] Si la taaban karo, lacagta mobilada waxay noqotay qayb ka mid ah laxanka dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya ee maalinleyda ah ee ka jira suuqyada, guryaha, goobaha shaqada, iyo shabakadaha taageerada. Saamaynta qoto dheer: Helitaanka maaliyadeed Cilmi-baarista tacliineed ee EVC Plus waxay baartay doorka ay ku leedahay helitaanka maaliyadeed ee Soomaaliya, oo ay ku jiraan helitaanka, isticmaalka, tayada, iyo dhinacyada wanaagga ee adeegyada maaliyadeed. Tani way muhiim tahay sababtoo ah dad badan oo aan laga yaabin inay helaan bangiyada rasmiga ah waxay wali ka qayb qaadan karaan bixinta dijitaalka ah iyadoo la adeegsanayo lacagta mobilada. [2] Saamaynta bini’aadantinimo waxay ku muuqataa dadka ay lacagta mobilada ku keento nidaamka maaliyadeed: macaamiisha aan lahayn akoon bangiyo dhaqameed, ganacsatada yaryar ee u baahan bixin degdeg ah, qoysaska helaya taageero qaraabo, ardayda bixisa adeegyada, iyo hay’adaha samafalka ee gaarsiinaya dadka si degdeg ah oo la raadin karo. Isticmaalayaal badan, qiimaha lacagta mobilada waa mid fudud: waxay yareysaa masaafada, keydisaa wakhti, hoos u dhigeysa ku-tiirsanaanta lacagta caddaanka ah, waxayna suurtogalisaa ka qaybqaadashada maaliyadeed meelaha bangiyada dhaqameedku xaddidan yihiin. Nidaaminta, kalsoonida, iyo mas’uuliyadda Muhiimadda lacagta mobilada waxay sidoo kale muuqatay heerka sharciyeynta iyo heerarka caalamiga ah. Sharciga lacagta mobilada ee Baanka Dhexe ee Soomaaliya wuxuu daboollaa shatigaynta, hawlgalka, iyo kormeerka bixiyeyaasha adeegyada lacagta mobilada. Warbixinno dhow ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in baanka dhexe uu Hormuud Telecom siiyay shatigii ugu horreeyay ee lacagta mobilada ee Soomaaliya 2021, tallaabo looga gol lahaa in la qaabeeyo bixinta dijitaalka ah lana milmo nidaamka maaliyadeed ee ballaadhan. [3][4] Marka laga soo tago nidaaminta qaranka, EVC Plus waxaa sidoo kale lagu aqoonsaday shahaadada GSMA Mobile Money Certification, oo ah barnaamij shahaado oo caalami ah oo qiimeeya bixiyeyaasha lacagta mobilada iyadoo la eegayo heerarka caalamiga ah. Sida ay sheegtay GSMA, EVC Plus waxaa lagu qiimeeyay dhinacyo ay ka mid yihiin ilaalinta lacagta, ka hortagga khiyaanada, ammaanka nidaamka, iyo sirta xogta, iyadoo la adeegsanayo siddeed mabda’ oo aasaasi ah iyo ku dhawaad 300 oo shuruud. Hormuud waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in EVC Plus dib loo shahaadeeyay barnaamijka GSMA Mobile Money Certification 2025, taasoo caddaynaysa ka go’naanshaha heerarka caalamiga ah ee xuquuqda macaamiisha, ka hortagga dhaqidda lacagaha sharci-darrada ah, iyo bixinta adeegyo maaliyadeed oo adkeysi leh. [6][7] Kalsoonida maaliyadda dijitaalka ah waxay ku dhisantahay wax ka badan tiknoolajiyad. Waxay u baahan tahay kormeer wax ku ool ah, ilaalinta macaamiisha oo xooggan, adeeg la isku halayn karo, nidaamyo ammaan ah, sirta xogta, iyo kalsoonida dadweynaha ee ah in lacagtooda la ilaalinayo marxalad kasta. Sida nidaam kasta oo maaliyadeed oo dijitaal ah, lacagta mobilada waxay u baahan tahay sharciyeyn adag, amniga internetka, isku-halaynta wakiilada, ilaalinta macaamiisha, sirta xogta, iyo joogteynta adeegga. Ilaaladahani way muhiim yihiin sababtoo ah marka ay dadku ku tiirsanaadaan nidaamka bixinta dijitaalka ah, way sii muhiim u noqotaa xasiloonida, daah-furnaanta, iyo kalsoonida dadweynaha. Waxa lacagta mobilada suurtogalisay Lacagta mobilada la’aanteed, dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya si buuxda uma joogsan lahayn. Soomaalidu waa dad adkeysi leh oo had iyo jeer helay siyaabo ay ula qabsadaan – laakiin nolol maalinleyda waxay noqon lahayd mid ka sii gaabis ah, khatar badan, oo ka sii qaali ah. Ganacsiyadu waxay si weyn ugu tiirsanaan lahaayeen lacagta caddaanka ah. Macaamiisha waxay la kulmi lahaayeen caqabado badan. Gaarsiinta gargaarku way dhib badnaan lahayd. Macaamilka yaryar waxay noqon lahaayeen kuwo aan waxtar lahayn. Helitaanka maaliyadeed wuxuu yaraaan lahaa dad badan oo ka baxsan nidaamyada bangiyada dhaqameed. EVC Plus waxay ka dhigan tahay nooca hal-abuurnimada ka soo baxda baahi dhab ah. Lama abuurin oo kaliya raaxo. Waxay ka soo ifbaxday suuq u baahanay kalsooni, xawaare, helitaan, iyo isku-halayn. Waxay ka caawisay in taleefanka gacanta loo beddelo boorsa lacag, SIM-ka loo beddelo barta helitaanka maaliyadeed, iyo kalsoonida dijitaalka loo beddelo dhaqdhaqaaq dhaqaale. Marka Soomaaliya ay sii wado ballaarinta adeegyada dijitaalka, lacagta mobilada waxay muujinaysaa sida tiknoolajiyadu ugu noqoto tan ugu awoodda badan markay xalliso dhibaatooyinka dhabta ah ee nolol maalinleyda dadka. Taasi waa awoodda hal-abuurnimada Soomaaliyeed: marka nidaamyadu fashilmaan, dadku waxay dhistaan kuwo cusub. Oo Soomaaliya, lacagta mobilada kuma aysan beddelin oo kaliya sida dadku u bixiyaan. Waxay beddeshay sida dadku u noolaadaan, u ganacsadaan, midba midka kale u taageero, iyo sida ay u horey u socdaan. Tixraacyo [1] Hormuud Telecom — “EVC Plus.” Bogga adeegga rasmiga ah ee Hormuud oo sharxaya astaamaha EVC Plus, oo ay ku jiraan dirista iyo helista lacagta, bixinta biilasha, iyo galitaanka akoonnada bangiyada. [2] Abdiaziz Ali Mohamed — “Quantifying the Role of Mobile Money Services to Financial Inclusion: Evidence from EVC-PLUS in Somalia.” Waxaa lagu daabacay Global Social Welfare, Springer. Waxaa loo adeegsaday cilmi-baaris ku saabsan EVC Plus iyo helitaanka maaliyadeed ee Soomaaliya. [3] Baanka Dhexe ee Soomaaliya — “Mobile Money Regulation 2020, amended 2021.” Dukumeenti sharci oo daboolla shatigaynta, hawlgalka, iyo kormeerka bixiyeyaasha adeegyada lacagta mobilada ee Soomaaliya. [4] Warbixin dib loo daabacay oo Reuters ah iyada oo loo marayo MarketScreener — “Hormuud Telecom awarded Somalia’s first mobile money licence.” Waxaa loo isticmaalay taariikhda hawlgalka Hormuud ee 2002 iyo shatigii ugu horreeyay ee lacagta mobilada Soomaaliya oo la siiyay Hormuud 2021. [5] U.S. International Trade Administration — “Somalia: Banking Services and the Financial Services.” Waxaa la daabacay Janaayo 22, 2024. Waxaa loo isticmaalay in lagu sheego in lacagta mobilada ay baahsan tahay Soomaaliya, iyadoo la qiyaasay 73% dadku isticmaalaan. [6] GSMA Mobile Money Certification — “Hormuud Telecom awarded GSMA mobile money certification.” Tixraac shahaado ah oo sharxaya Hormuud oo heshay shahaadada GSMA. [7] Hormuud Telecom — “Hormuud Telecom Receives GSMA Re-Certification for Secure Mobile Money Services.” Cusboonaysiintii Hormuud 2025 ee EVC Plus oo heshay dib-u-shahaadaynta GSMA. [8] The Guardian — “‘It’s like we went bankrupt overnight’: poorest Somalis suffer as piles of worthless shillings mount up.” Waxaa la daabacay May 11, 2026. Waxaa loo adeegsaday macnaha jilicsanaanta dhaqaalaha lacagta caddaanka ah Soomaaliya. [9] Frontiers — “Investigating the economic dynamics of mobile money in Somalia’s climate-stressed economy.” Waxaa la daabacay 2025. Waxaa loo adeegsaday cilmi-baaris dhow oo ku saabsan lacagta mobilada, la qabsiga dhaqaale, iyo adkeysiga Soomaaliya. The post Markii lacagta caddaanka ah ay fashilantay, isku-xirka ayaa noqday lacag first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: When Cash Failed, Connection Became Currency
items.description: How mobile money helped Somalia rebuild everyday financial trust, access, and resilience By Abdikafi Farah When Somalia’s central government collapsed in 1991, public institutions weakened, national infrastructure was severely damaged, the formal banking system struggled, and confidence in national financial systems declined. For many Somalis, money became something physical, fragile, difficult to move, and sometimes difficult to trust. As confidence in the Somali shilling weakened and many transactions shifted toward the U.S. dollar, people needed more reliable ways to exchange value. In markets, shops, transport, family support, and business transactions, daily financial life required systems that could work even when formal infrastructure was limited. But Somalia did not stop. Trust Before Technology Where formal systems weakened, people created alternatives. Trust became infrastructure. Hawala networks connected families, traders, diaspora communities, and people across borders. These systems were more than financial channels; they were social networks built on reputation, trust, and necessity. Then telecommunications began to change the country’s financial possibilities. When Connectivity Became Financial Access As mobile connectivity expanded, Somali users moved from basic voice communication toward digital services that supported payments, business communication, information access, and everyday transactions. Hormuud Telecom, which began operating in Somalia in 2002, became part of that transformation through communication services, mobile networks, internet access, and later mobile money. Reuters-republished reporting notes Hormuud’s 2002 operating history and states that Somalia’s first mobile money license was awarded to Hormuud in 2021. [4] Trust Before Technology Through EVC Plus, mobile connectivity became more than communication; it became a practical financial tool for everyday transactions. A major turning point came when mobile money moved from being a telecom feature to becoming part of daily financial life. EVC Plus did not simply introduce a new payment method. It helped address one of Somalia’s most important financial challenges: how people could exchange value when physical cash was inconvenient, unsafe, scarce, or unreliable. With a mobile phone, financial activity no longer had to depend on a bank branch, physical cash, or face-to-face exchange. EVC Plus made it possible to send and receive money, pay bills, access bank-linked services, and complete daily transactions through a simple mobile connection. Hormuud’s official EVC Plus service page describes functions such as sending and receiving money, paying bills, and accessing bank accounts. [1] This changed the role of the phone itself. It was no longer only a communication device; it became a practical tool for moving value, reducing payment delays, and making everyday transactions easier for people and businesses. Currently, EVC Plus is free to use at the point of transaction, helping reduce cost barriers and expand access to digital payments for everyday users, small businesses, and families. This is why mobile money in Somalia is not only a technology story. It is also a story of economic adaptation, public trust, and social resilience. From Convenience to Financial Infrastructure In some markets, mobile money is seen mainly as a convenience. In Somalia, for many communities, businesses, and families, it has become something closer to financial infrastructure. Its importance lies in scale and dependency. Mobile money became part of how value moves across markets, households, services, and commercial activity. Instead of being an optional digital tool, it became one of the systems people rely on to keep daily economic life moving while formal financial infrastructure continues to develop. More recent reporting and market references show that mobile money remains deeply embedded in Somalia’s financial life. The U.S. International Trade Administration’s 2024 Somalia country guide describes mobile money as widespread, with an estimated 73% penetration in the country. [5] Public reporting in 2026 also showed how fragile the remaining cash economy can be, as the rejection of worn Somali shilling notes disrupted traders, transport, and low-income households, while U.S. dollars and phone-based transfers continued to play a central role in everyday exchange. [8] Recent research has also examined mobile money in Somalia beyond simple payments, describing it as part of the country’s economic adaptation and resilience, especially in a fragile and climate-stressed environment. [9] In practice, mobile money has become part of Somalia’s daily economic rhythm present in markets, households, workplaces, and support networks. The Deeper Impact: Financial Inclusion For many users, the value of mobile money is simple: Academic research on EVC Plus has examined its role in financial inclusion in Somalia, including access, usage, quality, and welfare dimensions of financial services. This matters because many people who may not have access to formal banking can still participate in digital payments through mobile money. [2] The human impact is visible in the people mobile money brings into the financial system: customers without traditional bank accounts, small traders who need faster payments, families receiving support from relatives, students paying for services, and humanitarian organizations reaching people with greater speed and traceability. For many users, the value of mobile money is simple: it reduces distance, saves time, lowers dependence on cash, and makes financial participation possible in places where traditional banking may be limited. Regulation, Trust, and Responsibility Its importance also became visible at the regulatory and international standards level. The Central Bank of Somalia’s mobile money regulation covers licensing, operation, and supervision of mobile money service providers. Public reporting also stated that Somalia’s central bank awarded Hormuud Telecom the country’s first mobile money license in 2021, a move aimed at formalizing digital payments and integrating them with the wider financial system. [3][4] How mobile money helped Somalia rebuild financial trust do you trust it? Beyond national regulation, EVC Plus has also been recognized through the GSMA Mobile Money Certification, an international certification programme that assesses mobile money providers against global standards. According to GSMA’s mobile money certification platform, Hormuud’s EVC Plus was assessed across areas including safeguarding of funds, fraud prevention, system security, and data privacy, using eight core principles and nearly 300 criteria. Hormuud also stated that EVC Plus was re-certified by the GSMA Mobile Money Certification programme in 2025, reaffirming its commitment to global best practices in consumer rights, anti-money laundering, and resilient financial service delivery. [6][7] Trust in digital finance is built on more than technology. It requires effective oversight, strong consumer protection, reliable service, secure systems, data privacy, and public confidence that users’ money is protected at every stage. Like any digital financial system, mobile money requires strong regulation, cybersecurity, agent reliability, consumer protection, data privacy, and service continuity. These safeguards are essential because the more people depend on a digital payment system, the more important its stability, transparency, and public trust become. What Mobile Money Made Possible Without mobile money, Somalia’s economy would not stop completely. Somalis are resilient and have always found ways to adapt but daily life would become slower, riskier, and more expensive. Businesses would depend more heavily on physical cash. Customers would face more barriers. Aid delivery would become more difficult. Small transactions would become less efficient. Financial access would shrink for many people outside traditional banking systems. EVC Plus represents the kind of innovation that grows from real need. It was not created only for comfort. It emerged in a market that needed trust, speed, access, and reliability. It helped turn the mobile phone into a wallet, the SIM card into a financial access point, and digital trust into economic movement. As Somalia continues to expand digital services, mobile money shows how technology becomes most powerful when it solves real problems in people’s daily lives. That is the power of Somali innovation: when systems fail, people build new ones. And in Somalia, mobile money did not only change how people pay. It changed how people live, trade, support one another, and move forward. References [1] Hormuud Telecom — “EVC Plus.” Official Hormuud Telecom service page describing EVC Plus features, including sending and receiving money, paying bills, and accessing bank accounts. [2] Abdiaziz Ali Mohamed — “Quantifying the Role of Mobile Money Services to Financial Inclusion: Evidence from EVC-PLUS in Somalia.” Published in Global Social Welfare, Springer. Used for research context on EVC Plus and financial inclusion in Somalia. [3] Central Bank of Somalia — “Mobile Money Regulation 2020, amended 2021.” Regulatory document covering licensing, operation, and supervision of mobile money service providers in Somalia. [4] Reuters-republished report via MarketScreener — “Hormuud Telecom awarded Somalia’s first mobile money licence.” Used for Hormuud’s 2002 operating history and Somalia’s first mobile money licence being awarded to Hormuud in 2021. [5] U.S. International Trade Administration — “Somalia: Banking Services and the Financial Services.” Published January 22, 2024. Used for the statement that mobile money is widespread in Somalia, with estimated penetration of 73%. [6] GSMA Mobile Money Certification — “Hormuud Telecom awarded GSMA mobile money certification.” Certification reference describing Hormuud’s GSMA Mobile Money Certification. [7] Hormuud Telecom — “Hormuud Telecom Receives GSMA Re-Certification for Secure Mobile Money Services.” Hormuud’s 2025 update on EVC Plus receiving GSMA Mobile Money re-certification. [8] The Guardian — “‘It’s like we went bankrupt overnight’: poorest Somalis suffer as piles of worthless shillings mount up.” Published May 11, 2026. Used for context on the fragility of Somalia’s remaining cash economy and continued reliance on dollars and phone-based transfers. [9] Frontiers — “Investigating the economic dynamics of mobile money in Somalia’s climate-stressed economy.” Published in 2025. Used for recent research context on mobile money, economic adaptation, and resilience in Somalia. The post When Cash Failed, Connection Became Currency first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

What Mobile Money Made Possible Without mobile money, Somalia’s economy would not stop completely. Somalis are resilient and have always found ways to adapt but daily life would become slower, riskier, and more expensive. Businesses would depend more heavily on physical cash. Customers would face more barriers. Aid delivery would become more difficult. Small transactions would become less efficient. Financial access would shrink for many people outside traditional banking systems. EVC Plus represents the kind of innovation that grows from real need. It was not created only for comfort. It emerged in a market that needed trust, speed, access, and reliability. It helped turn the mobile phone into a wallet, the SIM card into a financial access point, and digital trust into economic movement. As Somalia continues to expand digital services, mobile money shows how technology becomes most powerful when it solves real problems in people’s daily lives. That is the power of Somali innovation: when systems fail, people build new ones. And in Somalia, mobile money did not only change how people pay. It changed how people live, trade, support one another, and move forward. items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse oo dhagax dhigay dhismaha Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo warshadaha
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse ayaa dhagax dhigay dhismaha Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo warshadaha oo dib u dhis lagu samaynayo. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre, ayaa sheegay in Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha ay ka mid tahay wasaaradaha ugu muhiimsan ee dowladda, maadaama ay door weyn ka qaadato horumarinta ganacsiga iyo kobcinta dhaqaalaha dalka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa xusay in dowladda ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso horumarinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha iyo dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga, si loo abuuro fursado shaqo loona xoojiyo kobaca dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya. “Wasaaraddan waxay ka mid tahay wasaaradaha muhiimka u ah Xukuumadda, maadaama ay door weyn ku leedahay horumarinta ganacsiga dalka,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre. Sidoo kale, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay haatan qorshaynayso in dalka laga hirgeliyo warshado badan, isagoo tilmaamay in soo hagaagidda amniga iyo xasilloonida ay abuurtay jawi ku habboon maalgashiga iyo hirgelinta mashaariic waaweyn oo horumarineed.

items.title: Sawirro: Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza oo maanta dhagax dhigay xarunta dhexe…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre, ayaa maanta dhagax-dhigay xarunta dhexe ee Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha oo dib-u-dhis lagu sameynayo, taas oo qeyb ka ah dadaallada Xukuumadda DanQaran ay ku horumarinayso hey’adaha muhiimka u ah adeegga bulshada iyo kobaca dhaqaalaha dalka. Xamza oo ka hadlay munaasabadda ayaa sheegay in Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha ay laf-dhabar u tahay horumarinta dhaqaalaha dalka, maadaama ay door muhiim ah ka qaadato kobcinta ganacsiga, horumarinta wax-soo-saarka, dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga iyo abuurista jawi ganacsi oo hufan. “Xarunta Wasaaradda oo muddo 50 sano ah dhisnayd, kana muuqatay duugnimo, dib-u-dhiskeedu waa tallaabo muhiim ah. Wasaaraddani waxa ay kamid tahay wasaaradaha laf-dhabarta u ah Qaranka, waana albaabka loo maro ganacsiga iyo horumarinta wax-soo-saarka dalkeenna,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul wasaaruhu. Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa sidoo kale xusay in Dowladda Federaalka ay ka go’an tahay tayeynta kaabeyaasha hey’adaha Qaranka, si loo dardargeliyo adeegyada ay shacabka u hayaan, loona xoojiyo fursadaha ganacsi iyo maalgashi ee dalka. Ra’iisul wasaaraha dalka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in maalmaha soo socda dalka laga hirgelin doono warshado waa wayn, isla markaana fursadaas maalgashi ay u furan tahay ganacstada Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwa ajaaniibta ah ee daneynaya inay ka faa’iideystaan fursadaha ka jira dalkeenna’. “Dalkeennu wuxuu u jihaystay dhanka horumarka iyo kobcinta wax-soo-saarka, waxaana la filayaa in dhawaan ay dalka ka hirgalaan warshado badan oo ay leeyihiin maalgashadeyaal Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwo ajnabi ah oo dalka maalgashanaya.” ayuu sii raaciyay Xamza. Ugu dambeyn, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ku bogaadiyay Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, Mudane Jamaal Maxamed Xasan hirgelinta mashruucan dib-u-dhiska ah, isaga oo ku tilmaamay tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo awoodda hey’adda iyo adeegyada ay u hayso shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Xukuumadda DanQaran ayaa bilihii ugu dambeeyay wadday dib u dhiska xarumaha wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha kale ee dowladda, waxaana ugu dambeeyay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha oo xarunteeda Degmada Boondheere dib loo dhisay, loona daah-furay maalmo kahor kadib munaasabad uu ka qayb-galay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. The post Sawirro: Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza oo maanta dhagax dhigay xarunta dhexe… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Qatar charity oo kala saxiixday heshiis Caafimaad oo ku Kacaya $1.46 Milyan oo doollar
items.description: Dawladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Qatar charity ayaa kala saxiixday heshiis Caafimaad oo ku Kacaya $1.46 oo ay ka faa’iideysan doonaan malaayiin Soomaali ahi. Xafiiska hay’adda Qatar Charity ee Soomaaliya ayaa si rasmi ah magaalada Muqdisho uga dhawaaqay heshiis iskaashi oo muhiim ah, kaasi oo lagu hirgelinayo 39 mashruuc oo caafimaad. Mashaariicdan oo qiimahoodu uu ka badan yahay 5.3 milyan oo Riyaalka Qadar ah (qiyaastii 1.46 milyan oo Doollarka Mareykanka ah), ayaa qorshuhu yahay inay si toos ah u caawiyaan in ka badan 36 kun oo qof oo Soomaaliyeed inta lagu jiro sannadkan 2026. Agaasimaha Xafiiska Qatar Charity ee Soomaaliya, Ibraahim Cabdiraxmaan Janaaxi, oo faahfaahin ka bixiyay wejiyada kala duwan ee caawinaaddan, ayaa xaqiijiyay in lacagtan loo qaybin doona mashaariic si gaar ah diiradda u saaraya daaweynta nafaqo-darrada, daryeelka carruurta qaba xanuunnada wadnaha, qalliinnada biyaha indhaha (cataract), iyo daryeelka dadka qaba cudurrada daba-dheeraada. “Inta lagu jiro sannadka 2026, waxaa la maalgeliyay 39-kan mashruuc, waxaana Inshaa Allaah ka faa’iideysan doona in ka badan 36 kun oo qof oo Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri Janaaxi. Agaasime Ibraahim Cabdiraxmaan Janaaxi ayaa sidoo kale hoosta ka xariiqay in Qatar Charity ay si adag u sii bixin doonto hirgelinta barnaamijyada caafimaad ee takhasuska leh, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu horumariyo tayada adeegyada caafimaadka ee dalka, lana ballaariyo gaarsiinta adeegyada bulshada danyarta ah iyo kuwa nugul ee baahiyaha gaarka ah qaba. Munaasabadda saxiixa heshiiskan oo ay goobjoog ka ahaayeen Ku-xigeenka Safiirka Dowladda Qatar iyo mas’uuliyiin kale, waxaa dhanka dowladda Soomaaliya ku matalayay Wasiirka Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada, Dr. Cali Xaaji Aadan, kaasi oo isna dhankiisa aad uga mahadceliyay dowladda Qatar iyo hay’addaba taageerada joogtada ah ee ay la garab taagan yihiin waaxda caafimaadka dalka, gaar ahaan xilli ay hoos u dhacday maalgelintii dibadda. Ugu dambeyntii, madaxda Qatar Charity ayaa xustay in iskaashigani uu qeyb ka yahay taageerada bini’aadanimo iyo midda horumarineed ee ay dowladda Qatar had iyo goor u fidinayso shacabka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo barnaamijyadan caafimaad ay si weyn gacan uga geysan doonaan dhimista dhimashada hooyooyinka iyo carruurta iyo kor u qaadista tayada nolosha ee bulshada dhexdeeda.

items.title: Goobaha ganacsiga magaalada Boosaaso oo maanta xiran
items.description: Boosaaso (Raxanreeb Online) Goobaha ganacsiga magaalada Boosaaso ee xarunta ganacsiga Puntland ayaa saaka xiran, taas oo ay sababtay dekedda oo xiran maalintii 11-aad. Ganacsatada ayaa ka biyo diiday khidmad cusub oo ay soo rogtay shirkadda maamusha dekedda magaalada Boosaaso ee DP World, taas oo keentay in maaanta in albaabada la isugu dhufto xarumaha ganacsiga. Shacabka ku nool deegaannada Puntland, ayay saameyn ku yeelatay xirnaanshaha dekedda Boosaaso, iyada oo maalmihii u dambayay ay kor u kacday maciishadda daruuriga ah. Dowladda uu hoggaamiyo hoggaamiye Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa weli ka hadlin muddada ka badan tobanka berri ee xiran tahay dekedda Boosaaso, taas oo keentay in uu istaago ganacsiga deegaanada mamaulka Puntland. items.title: Hoggaamiye ka Tirsan Al-Shabaab oo lagu Qabtay meel u dhow Xadka Kenya iyo Soomaaliya
items.description: Ciidamada Amniga Soomaaliya oo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamiga ah ayaa howlgal qorsheysan oo ka dhacay agagaarka xadka ay wadaagaan Soomaaliya iyo Kenya waxay ku soo qabteen hoggaamiye sare oo ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab, halka sarkaalkaas la qabtay xilli ay socdeen howlgaladaas lagu dilay saddex dagaalame oo kale. Howlgalkan oo ahaa mid si dhow u abaabulan ayaa la xiriiray xogta sirdoon oo sheegaysay dhaqdhaqaaqyo ay kooxdu ka wadday deegaannada u dhow xadka. Saraakiisha amniga ayaa xaqiijiyay in gacanta lagu soo dhigay sarkaalkan muhiimka ah, kaasi oo hadda lagu hayo baaritaanno dheeraad ah si looga helo xogta la xiriirta shabakadaha kooxda ee ka hawlgala aagga xadka. Dhanka kale, intii uu falku socday, ciidamada waxay iska caabin kala kulmeen xubno ka tirsan kooxda, taasi oo keentay in halkaas lagu khaarijiyo saddex ka tirsan maleeshiyada Al-Shabaab oo isku dayey inay is hortaag ku sameeyaan ciidamada amniga. Gobolka xadka u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Kenya ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay waxaa ku soo kordhayay howlgalada wadajirka ah iyo kuwa gaarka ah ee lagu beegsanayo xubnaha Al-Shabaab, si looga hortago weerarada qorsheysan ee ay kooxdu ka fuliso gudaha labada dal.

items.title: Trump oo ka walaacsan inay disho Iran iyo waxa dhici kara
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump oo ka walaacsan inay disho Iran ayaa sheegay in Mareykanku si degdeg ah ugu weerari doono kumannaan gantaal haddii ay isku daydo inay disho isaga. Trump ayaa saaka ku qoray bartiisa bulshada ee Truth Social: “Haddii dowladda Iran ay fuliso hanjabaadaha ay marar badan ka jeedisay meelo kala duwan oo dunida ah ee ku aaddan inay disho ama isku daydo inay khaarijiso madaxweynaha hadda ee Mareykanka, markaas Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iran waxaa isla markiiba lagu garaaci doonaa in ka badan 1,000 gantaal, waxaana xigi doona kumannaan kale.” Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in amarada arrintaas hore loo bixiyay, isla markaana “ciidamada Mareykanku ay diyaar yihiin, go’aan adagnaay leeyihiin, ayna si buuxda u awoodaan inay gebi ahaanba burburiyaan dhammaan goobaha la bartilmaameedsado ee Iran muddo hal sano ah, muddadaasna la kordhin karo haddii loo baahdo.” Hadalka Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa yimid kadib markii wargeyska Wall Street Journal uu Khamiistii qoray in Israa’iil ay Mareykanka la wadaagtay xog sirdoon oo cusub, taas oo ay sheegtay inay muujinayso qorshe ay Iran ku doonayso inay ku khaarijiso Madaxweyne Trump. Hanjabaadda ayaa sidoo kale soo baxday kadib warar laga helay sirdoonka Israa’iil oo ay ku sheegeen qorshe cusub oo la sheegay in Iran ay ku doonayso inay ku disho Trump, iyo sidoo kale sawirro iyo halku-dhegyo lagu soo bandhigay intii lagu jiray aaska Ayatollah Cali Khamenei. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, warbixintu ma caddeynayso goorta xogta sirdoonka la gudbiyay iyo halka ay ka timid. Mas’uuliyiinta Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iran ayaa hore u beeniyay eedeymaha sheegaya inay qorsheynayeen in la khaarijiyo Donald Trump. The post Trump oo ka walaacsan inay disho Iran iyo waxa dhici kara appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Iran oo qiratay in weerarrada Maraakiibta Marinka Hormuz ay tahay tallaabo “khalad ah”
items.description: CBS News ayaa, iyadoo soo xiganaysa mas’uuliyiin sare oo Maraykan ah, sheegtay in mas’uuliyiin Iranian ah ay si gaar ah ugu sheegeen la-taliyeyaasha Madaxweyne Donald Trump in weerarradii lagu qaaday maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Marinka Hormuz ay ahaayeen “khalad”, isla markaana ay fuliyeen xubno ka tirsan garabka mayalka adag ee Iran, kuwaas oo doonayay inay carqaladeeyaan wadaxaajoodyada. Sida ay mas’uuliyiintu sheegeen, Iran waxay doonaysaa in wadaxaajoodyadu sii socdaan, balse Aqalka Cad wuxuu ka dalbanayaa Tehran inay si cad u qirato mas’uuliyadda weerarradaas, kuwaas oo maamulka Trump u arko inay jebiyeen heshiiskii xabbad-joojinta. Warbixintu waxay intaas ku dartay in Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu faray kooxdiisa wadaxaajoodka, oo ay ka mid yihiin J.D. Vance, Jared Kushner, Steve Witkoff, iyo Marco Rubio, inay sii wadaan wadaxaajoodyada. Wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada ayaa la qorsheeyay inuu maanta uu ka dhaco Urdun. Mas’uuliyiinta Maraykanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in haddii Iran ay sii waddo tallaabooyinka ay Washington u aragto kuwo colaad ah, Maraykanku uu uga jawaabi doono tallaabooyin milatari iyo kuwo dhaqaale.

items.title: Ciidamada PUNTLAND oo hub iyo saanad kasoo furtay Daacish
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Difaaca Puntlad oo weli howlgallo kasii wada aagga buuraha Calmiskaad ayaa mar kale weeraray fariimso ay kooxda Daacish ku lahayd halkaasi, iyaga oo jab culus gaarsiiyay. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Puntland ayaa lagu sheegtay in howlgalka oo guuleystay laga fuliyay deegaanno kala duwan oo ku yaalla dhulka buuraleyda ah, isla markaana lagu beegsaday goobo gabaad u ahaa kooxda Daacish. Sidoo kale, ciidanka ayaa intii ay howlgallada fulinayeen ku guuleystay inay bartilmaameedsadaan kooxo ka tirsan Daacish, iyaga oo goobta ku dilay tiro dagaalyahanno ah iyo horjogayaal ka tirsanaa kooxda. Ciidamada Puntlad ayaa sidoo kale ku guuleystay in ay gacanta kusoo dhigaan saanad ciidan oo isugu jirtay hub, rasaas iyo agabyo kale oo ay kooxda adeegsanaysay, sida lagu caddeeyay warsaxaafadeedka. Xaaladda ayaa weli kacsan, waxaana lagu soo warramayaa in ciidamada ay sii baacsanayaan firxadka maleeshiyaadka kooxda argagixisada Daacish, kuwaas oo ku dhuumaleysanaaya meelo kooban oo ka tirsan buuraleyda Calmiskaad. Ujeedka howlgalladan ayaa ah kuwa lagu xaqiijinayo amniga, laguna ciribtirayo haraadiga kooxda Daacish oo muddo dheer ay la dagaalameyso Puntland. Buuraleyda Calmiskaad, oo ka tirsan silsiladda buuraha Golis ee gobolka Bari, ayaa muddooyinkii dambe noqotay fariisinka ugu weyn ee Daacish-ta Soomaaliya. Dhulkaas oo ah buuro dhaadheer, godad iyo marinno adag ayaa kooxda u noqday gabbaad ay ku dhuumato, ku tababarto, kuna qorsheyso weerarrada ay ka fuliso Puntland. Kooxda ayaa halkaas ka dhistay saldhigyo iyo godad difaac ah, iyadoo mararka qaar isku dayda inay maamusho dhaqdhaqaaqa dadka iyo adeegyada muhiimka ah ee deegaanada ku dhow. Si kastaba, Puntland ayaa dhowrkii sano ee lasoo dhaafay kordhisay howlgallada ka dhanka ah Daacish, gaar ahaan tan iyo markii kooxda ay isku dayday inay ballaariso saameynteeda buuraha gobolka Bari. The post Ciidamada PUNTLAND oo hub iyo saanad kasoo furtay Daacish appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ruto oo Shaaciyay Heshiis Weyn oo Kenya Looga Dhisayo Warshadda Sifaynta Shidaalka ee Dangote
items.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya, William Ruto, ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la guda galayo wejiga fulinta mashruuc ballaaran oo lagu dhisayo warshadda ugu weyn ee sifaynta shidaalka Bariga Afrika, kaddib wada-hadallo miro-dhal ah oo uu la yeeshay maalqabeenka reer Nigeria, Aliko Dangote. Madaxweyne Ruto ayaa sheegay in warshaddan laga hirgelin doono magaalada xeebta ku taalla ee Lamu, taas oo qiyaastii 470 kiiloomitir dhinaca koonfur-bari kaga beegan caasimadda Nairobi. Isagoo ka hadlayay munaasabadda daah-furka wejiga labaad ee barnaamijka shaqo-abuurka dhallinyarada ee Nyota, Ruto wuxuu sheegay in mashruucan uu abuuri doono fursado shaqo oo ballaaran. “Kenya waxay hadda dhisaysaa warshaddii ugu weynayd ee sifaynta shidaalka Bariga Afrika, waxaana Lamu looga baahan doonaa ku dhowaad 60,000 oo dhallinyaro ah inay ka shaqeeyaan,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Ruto. Madaxweynaha ayaa xusay in warshaddu aysan adeeg u noqon doonin Kenya oo keliya, balse shidaalka laga sifeynayo loo dhoofin doono dalalka deriska ah ee Itoobiya, Koonfurta Suudaan, Uganda, Tansaaniya, Ruwanda, Burundi iyo Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Kongo. Mashruucan oo la filayo inuu sifeeyo boqolaal kun oo foosto oo shidaal ah maalintii, ayaa soo afjaraya hadal-heyn muddo bilo ah socotay oo ku saabsan halka laga hirgelinayo warshaddan, iyadoo ugu dambeyn shirkadda Dangote Industries ay dooratay Lamu. Go’aanka lagu doortay Lamu ayaa lagu saleeyay istiraatiijiyadda goobta ay ku taallo oo ku dhow Badweynta Hindiya, dekeddeeda qoto-dheer iyo isku xirnaanta ay la leedahay marinnada ganacsiga ee dalalka aan lahayn xeebaha Bariga iyo Bartamaha Afrika. Madaxweyne Ruto ayaa sheegay in mashruucan uu Kenya u beddeli doono xarunta ugu weyn ee tamarta gobolka, isla markaana uu yareyn doono ku-tiirsanaanta Bariga Afrika ee shidaalka dibadda laga soo dejiyo, waxa uuna intaa ku daray in dhismaha warshadda la filayo inuu ku dhammaado muddo 30 bilood gudahood ah marka si rasmi ah loo bilaabo.

items.title: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed oo ku dhawaaqay golihiisa wasiirrada
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa magacaabay Golihiisa cusub ee wasiirrada oo ka kooban wasiirro, ku xegeenno, iyo wasiir dowleyaal. Golahan ayaa ka kooban 26 wasiir, 26 wasiir ku xegeen, iyo 3 wasiir dowle, ayadoo Wasaaradaha loo magacaabay xubnahan ay  ka mid yihiin Amniga Gudaha, Maaliyadda, Arrimaha Gudaha, Beeraha, Caafimaadka, Waxbarashada, Garsoorka, Dekedaha, Hawlaha Guud, Haweenka iyo Xuquuqda Aadanaha, Dastuurka, Qorsheynta, iyo wasaarado kale oo muhiim u ah horumarinta maamulka. Hoggaamiye Aadan Madoobe ayaa faray golahan cusub inay si hufan uga shaqeeyaan horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, amniga, dib-u-heshiisiinta, kobcinta dhaqaalaha, iyo fulinta qorshayaasha horumarineed ee Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Magacaabista xubnaha golaha Wasiirrada ayaa u baahan in golaha wakiillada maamulkaasi ay ansixiyaan, ayadoo la filayo in dhowaan la horgeeyo si ay u meelmariyaan.

items.title: From Parliament to Academia: Dr. Mohamed Mursal Earns PhD with Highest Honors in Law and Political Science
items.description: By Abdikarim Haji Abdi Buh Former Speaker’s groundbreaking research on Somalia’s political system offers fresh insights into constitutional reform, state-building, and democratic governance. Somalia marked a significant academic milestone on July 8, 2026, as former Speaker of the House of the People of the Federal Parliament of Somalia, Dr. Mohamed Mursal Sheikh Abdirahman, successfully defended his Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) dissertation in Law and Political Science at International Astrolabe University (IAU), earning the highest academic distinction of “Mumtaaz” (Excellent). The achievement represents more than a personal academic triumph. It is widely regarded as a valuable contribution to Somalia’s growing body of scholarly research on governance, constitutional development, and democratic transformation at a time when the country continues to navigate complex political and institutional reforms. Following several hours of rigorous academic examination, the dissertation committee unanimously approved the research and awarded it the highest possible evaluation, praising the depth of analysis, originality, methodology, and relevance of its findings. Research Focused on Somalia’s Political Future Dr. Mursal’s dissertation, titled “The Somali Political System in Light of Regional and International Changes: An Analytical Study of Challenges and Opportunities ,” examines how regional geopolitical shifts and international developments have shaped Somalia’s evolving political system. The research offers a comprehensive assessment of the challenges confronting Somalia’s state-building process while identifying opportunities to strengthen constitutional governance, democratic institutions, and long-term political stability. Drawing upon both legal scholarship and political science, the dissertation explores constitutional reform, institutional reconstruction, federal governance, electoral development, and the influence of regional and international actors on Somalia’s political trajectory. It also presents practical recommendations aimed at improving governance, strengthening democratic accountability, and reinforcing the rule of law. A Timely Contribution to National Debate The successful defense comes at a pivotal moment for Somalia, where discussions surrounding constitutional review, federal-state relations, electoral frameworks, and institutional reform remain central to the country’s political future. Dr. Mursal’s research provides evidence-based analysis that may prove valuable to policymakers, constitutional experts, researchers, development partners, and students studying governance and public administration. The dissertation is expected to serve as an important reference for universities, research centers, government institutions, constitutional review bodies, and international organizations engaged in Somalia’s governance and state-building agenda. Before pursuing his doctoral studies, Dr. Mohamed Mursal Sheikh Abdirahman served as Speaker of Somalia’s House of the People, one of the country’s highest constitutional offices. His transition from legislative leadership to advanced academic research reflects a continued commitment to public service through scholarship and intellectual inquiry. By combining years of practical political experience with rigorous academic research, he brings a unique perspective to one of Somalia’s most consequential policy debates. His accomplishment also highlights the growing importance of higher education and research in shaping effective public policy and strengthening democratic institutions. About International Astrolabe University Dr. Mursal earned his doctorate from International Astrolabe University (IAU), also known as International Arees University, an international higher education institution specializing in distance learning, open online education, and traditional academic programs. The university is designed to serve a diverse international student community through flexible learning pathways, including on-campus instruction, independent external study, and digital learning platforms. Its academic programs span several disciplines, including Administrative Sciences and Economics, Sharia and Islamic Studies, Information Engineering, Education and Psychology, International Law and Political Science, and Arabic Language and Literature. IAU supports its academic activities through a network of educational and administrative centers across Turkey, Lebanon, Qatar, Iraq, Libya, Austria, Nigeria, and Burkina Faso, enabling students from different regions to participate in graduate studies, dissertation defenses, research conferences, and academic programs. Inspiring the Next Generation of Somali Scholars Dr. Mursal’s achievement extends beyond personal success. It represents an investment in Somalia’s intellectual capital and serves as an inspiration to aspiring Somali scholars who seek to contribute to their country’s future through education and research. At a time when Somalia requires highly qualified experts in constitutional law, governance, diplomacy, and public administration, achievements such as this demonstrate the transformative power of higher education in advancing national development. His doctoral research reinforces the idea that sustainable progress depends not only on political leadership but also on rigorous scholarship capable of informing policy and strengthening public institutions. A National Achievement Worth Celebrating The conferral of the title Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Law and Political Science marks the culmination of years of disciplined research, critical thinking, and academic excellence. While this milestone belongs to Dr. Mohamed Mursal Sheikh Abdirahman, it also represents a proud moment for Somalia’s academic community and for all those who believe education is essential to nation-building. items.title: Maqnaanshaha Hoggaamiyaha Cusub ee Iiraan oo Dhaliyay hadal-heyn iyo Su’aalo Badan
items.description: Maqnaanshaha hoggaamiyaha cusub ee Iiraan, Mojtaba Khamenei, ayaa sii kordhiyay hadal-haynta gudaha iyo dibadda dalkaas, iyadoo weli aan si rasmi ah loo arkin ama aan laga maqal wax cod ah tan iyo markii loo magacaabay xilka hoggaamiyaha sare bishii Maarso. Mojtaba Khamenei ayaa si buuxda uga maqnaa aaska aabihii, hoggaamiyihii hore Ayatullah Cali Khamenei, mana uusan soo saarin farriin qoraal ama muuqaal ah, arrintaas oo dhalisay su’aalo badan oo ku saabsan xaaladdiisa caafimaad iyo awooddiisa hoggaamineed. Sida ay qortay Reuters, ilo sare oo Iiraani ah ayaa sheegay in Mojtaba uu dhaawacyo culus kasoo gaaray weerarkii lagu dilay aabihii dabayaaqadii Febraayo, ayadoo Ilo-wareedyadu ay sheegeen inuu weli go’aannada dalka ka qayb qaato, balse uusan awoodin inuu si fagaare ah uga soo muuqdo sababo la xiriira caafimaadkiisa iyo ammaankiisa. Dhanka kale, warbaahinta bulshada iyo falanqeeyayaal qaar ayaa faafiyay xogo sheegaya in Mojtaba Khamenei laga yaabo inuu geeriyooday, islamarkaana xogtiisa la qarinayo. Waxaa kale oo jira dood kale oo aan la xaqiijin oo oranaysa in wadaad kale uu si dhab ah u hoggaamiyo dalka, halka magaca Mojtaba loo adeegsanayo sababo amni awgood, balse ma jiro wax caddeyn rasmi ah oo taageeraysa sheegashooyinkaas. Dowladda Iiraan weli ma shaacin wax war ah oo muujinaya inuu dhintay ama xilka laga qaaday, sidoo kale Reuters waxay sheegtay in sababta maqnaanshihiisa ay ilo rasmi ah ku tilmaameen dhaawacyo iyo walaac dhanka ammaanka ah. Madaxweyne Masoud Pezeshkian ayaa bishii May sheegay inuu la kulmay hoggaamiyaha cusub, isagoo xusay in xaaladdiisa caafimaad ay soo hagaagayso. Khubarada ayaa sheegaya in maqnaanshaha hoggaamiye aan shacabka arkin ama codkiisa maqlin uu caqabad ku noqon karo maamulka Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah, gaar ahaan xilli dalka uu wajahayo xiisado amni, dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed. Falanqeeyaha taariikhda casriga ah ee Jaamacadda St Andrews, Ali Ansari, ayaa sheegay in ay adkaan karto in hoggaamiye cusub uu helo kalsoonida shacabka haddii uu muddo dheer ka maqnaado fagaarayaasha, isagoo xusay in xaaladdan aysan sii socon karin muddo dheer. Ilaa iyo hadda, xogaha la xaqiijiyay waa in Mojtaba Khamenei aan lagu arkin meel fagaare ah tan iyo magacaabistiisii, balse wararka sheegaya inuu geeriyooday ama in qof kale si qarsoodi ah u hoggaaminayo Iiraan lama hayo wax caddeyn rasmi ah oo xaqiijinaysa.

items.title: Somalia’s Election Talks Advance, but Deep Divisions Persist Over Rules of the Game
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Political negotiations between Somalia’s Federal Government and opposition leaders have produced agreement on several core electoral principles, but significant differences remain over the legal framework and administration of the country’s next elections, exposing a persistent divide over whether the process should be shaped through broad consensus or government-led directives. A comparison of the positions presented during the talks shows that both sides have reached common ground on several fundamental issues, raising hopes for progress toward an inclusive political settlement. However, negotiations remain deadlocked over key questions that will ultimately determine the credibility and legitimacy of the electoral process. Areas of Agreement According to information emerging from the negotiations, both the Federal Government and the opposition have agreed in principle that: Somalia should hold one-person, one-vote elections, allowing citizens to directly elect their leaders. The country should adopt a multi-party political system to replace the long-standing clan-based 4.5 electoral model. Eligible voters should undergo official voter registration to establish a credible national voter register. The consensus on these principles is widely viewed as an important step toward establishing a democratic electoral framework. Where the Talks Remain Stuck Despite agreement on the broad principles, negotiators remain sharply divided over how those principles should be implemented. Federal Government’s Position The Federal Government, led by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, is advocating: Basing the elections on the 2026 Constitution. Allowing the Federal Government to appoint the National Electoral Commission. Limiting the political landscape to three national political parties. Conducting voting electronically and counting ballots through a computerized digital system. Opposition’s Position The opposition albeit to varying degrees, with former President Farmaajo’s team presenting their position—has proposed the following: Holding the elections under Somalia’s 2012 Provisional Federal Constitution rather than the newly unilaterally adopted constitutional framework. Establishing an independent Electoral Commission appointed through a consultative process involving multiple stakeholders to ensure neutrality. Conducting voter registration at both the regional and district levels, with political parties participating in monitoring the process. Counting ballots manually instead of relying on a fully digital tabulation system. Consensus or Dictation? While the negotiations have demonstrated growing agreement on the principle of direct elections, the remaining disputes underscore a broader political struggle over who controls the electoral process. A workable transitional period will be required to reach consensus on the electoral model and establish the legal, institutional, and operational infrastructure needed to implement the agreed path forward. Opposition figures argue that an election can only gain national legitimacy if its governing rules are negotiated through consensus rather than determined unilaterally by the incumbent administration. They have expressed concern that proposals allowing the Federal Government to appoint the electoral commission, rely on a contested constitutional framework, and define the structure of the party system without broad political agreement risk undermining confidence in the process. The Federal Government, meanwhile, maintains that its proposals are intended to establish a workable framework for implementing Somalia’s long-delayed transition to universal suffrage. Negotiators are expected to continue discussions on the constitutional basis of the elections, the composition of the Electoral Commission, voter registration procedures, and the method of vote counting. The outcome of these talks is expected to play a decisive role in determining whether Somalia can deliver a broadly accepted one-person, one-vote election or whether political disagreements over the rules of the contest will continue to delay the country’s democratic transition. items.title: Shakhsiga aan aaminsanahay inuu hoggaamin karo Golaha Guurtida waa Cabdulqaadir Jirde.
items.description: Haddii ay rumoowdo in Saleebaan Maxamuud Aadan baneeyo xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Guurtidda, shakhsiga aan aaminsanahay inuu hoggaamin karo Golaha waa Cabdulqaadir Jirde. Nasiib darro, xubin kama aha Golaha Guurtidda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa suurtogal ah inuu xubin ka noqdo haddii uu helo xildhibaan uga tanaasula xubinnimada. Sababta aan u taageerayo waa inaan aqaan kartidiisa iyo waayo-aragnimadiisa, sidoo kalena uu yahay qof ay dad badani ku kalsoon yihiin. Waxaan rumaysanahay in hoggaankiisu uu Golaha Guurtidda ka dhigi lahaa gole ka duwan sida uu maanta yahay. Tani waa aragtidayda shakhsiga ah, mana metelayso cid kale. Mujaahid Cali Gurey.

items.title: Horjooge Mayow Cali Muuse oo usoo gacan galay ciidanka DF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Horjooge Mayow Cali Muuse ayaa maanta isku soo dhiibay ciidanka xoogga dalka ee ku sugan deegaanka Mubaarak ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, sida ay baahisay warbaahinta ciidamada qalabka sida. Mayow ayaa muddo ka tirsanaa kooxda Al-Shabaab, wuxuuna u qaabilsanaa ururinta waxa ay kooxdu ugu yeerto sakawaadka, kuwaas oo uu ka qaadi jiray shacabka ku nool deegaanka Mubaarak iyo deegaannada hoos yimaada. Sida ay dowladda sheegtay, horjoogahan oo muddo ku dhuumaaleysanayay deegaannada miyiga ah ayaa u adkeysan waayay cadaadiska joogtada ah ee ciidanka xoogga dalka, ugu dambeyntiina wuxuu isku soo dhiibay ururka 203-aad ee guutada 20-aad kumaandooska Gor-Gor. Cutubkan uu isku dhiibay ayaa ka howlgala deegaanka Mubaarak ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, halkaas oo ciidamada ay ka wadaan howlgallo ka dhan ah kooxda Al-Shabaab. Dhanka kale, waxaa isla maanta isna isa soo dhiibay Maxamed Jaylaani Dayib, oo gudaha Al-Shabaab looga yaqaanay magaca Deeqow. Waxa uu isku dhiibay ururka 62-aad ee guutada 6-aad, qeybta 60-aad ee ciidanka xoogga dalka, kuwaas oo saldhiggoodu yahay magaalada Buulo-mareer ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Maxamed Jaylaani ayaa ku biiray Al-Shabaab sanadkii 2015, wuxuuna soo noqday wakiilka kooxda u qaabilsanaa deegaanka Jilib Marko ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Ninkan ayaa sida uu sheegay waxaa xilkaas laga qaaday sanadkii 2024. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay xoojisay dadaallada lagu dhiirrigelinayo xubnaha Al-Shabaab inay ka soo goostaan kooxda oo ay isu soo dhiibaan ciidamada dowladda. items.title: Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga oo Baaritaan ku Bilowday Askar Ku Xadgudbay Calanka Mareykanka
items.description: MUQDISHO, Soomaaliya — Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si adag uga gashay muuqaal dhowaan ku baahay baraha bulshada, kaasi oo muujinayay shakhsiyaad ku labisan dareeska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed oo ku kacaya falal aan la aqbali karin oo ka dhanka ah calanka dalka Mareykanka. Qoraal rasmi ah oo ka soo baxay wasaaradda ayaa lagu caddeeyay in falkaasi uu yahay mid gabi ahaanba ka horimaanaya qiyamka, anshaxa, iyo xirfad-nimo ee laga filayo Ciidanka Qaranka, isla markaana uusan marnaba ka tarjumaynin aragtida Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ama tan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Wasaaradda ayaa shaaca ka qaadday in xilligan gacanta lagu dhigay shakhsiyaadkii ku lugta lahaa falkan, isla markaana uu hadda socdo baaritaan qoto dheer oo lagu ogaanayo duruufihii ku gedaannaa dhacdadan, si loo mariyo ciqaab adag oo isugu jirta mid anshaxeed iyo mid sharci. Dhanka kale, qoraalka wasaaradda ayaa lagu nuux-nuux saday in Soomaaliya ay aad u qiimeyso iskaashiga fog ee dhanka amniga ee kala dhexeeya dowladda Mareykanka, iyadoo la xusay in wadashaqaynta labada dhinac ay door muhiim ah ka qaadatay dagaalka lagula jiro kooxaha Al-Shabaab iyo ISIS, iyo waliba xoojinta hay’adaha amniga ee dalka. Ugu dambeyntii, Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya waxay dib u xaqiijisay ixtiraamka weyn ee ay u heyso shacabka iyo calanka dalka Mareykanka, iyadoo ballan-qaadday inay sii jiri doonto iskaashiga istiraatiijiyadeed ee u dhexeeya labada qaran.

items.title: Iran oo hanjabaadii u cusleyd u dirtay Imaaraadka xilli Trump iyo Netanyahu ay…
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Iiraan ayaa hanjabaad culus u dirtay Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta, iyadoo ku eedeysay inuu door ku lahaa weerarradii dhowaan uu Mareykanku ku qaaday dalkeeda. Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan ayaa sheegtay inay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin militari oo ka dhan ah Imaaraadka, iyadoo si cad u sheegtay in jawaab kasta oo ay bixiso ay noqon doonto mid culus oo aan si fudud loo illoobi doonin. Ismaaciil Kowsari, oo xubin ka ah Guddiga Amniga Qaranka iyo Siyaasadda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Baarlamaanka Iiraan, ayaa sheegay in Tehran ay si toos ah u beegsan doonto Imaaraadka, kaas oo ay ku eedeysay inuu garab istaagay weerarrada lagu qaaday dalkeeda. Bartilmaameedyada ciidamada Iiraan ayaa waxaa ka mid noqon kara kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo gaadiidka ee Imaaraadka, sida waddooyinka tareennada, garoomada diyaaradaha, dekedaha, xarumaha ganacsiga, goobaha saliidda iyo gaaska, iyo xarumaha kale ee muhiimka u ah dhaqaalaha dalkaas. Hanjabaaddan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha u dhexeeya Iiraan, Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil, iyadoo dalalka gobolka ay si dhow ula socdaan xaaladda. Ilaa iyo hadda, dowladda Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta kama aysan jawaabin eedeymaha iyo hanjabaadaha cusub ee ka soo baxay Tehran. Sidoo kale waxay imaanaysa xilli Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu ay u tashanayaan Iiraan. Labada mas’uul ayaa ka wada-hadlay arrimo la xiriira amniga Bariga Dhexe iyo tallaabooyinka suurtagalka ah ee laga qaadi karo Tehran. Trump ayaa Khamiistii khadka taleefanka kula hadlay hoggaamiyaha Israa’iil, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee la xiriiray Iiraan iyo tallaabooyinka la qorsheynayo. War-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay xafiiska Netanyahu ayaa lagu sheegay in labada hoggaamiye ay isla soo qaadeen “tallaabooyin la isku dubbariday oo laga fulinayo jihooyin kala duwan,” halka Trump uu Netanyahu uga warbixiyay tallaabooyinka uu Mareykanku ka qaaday Iiraan iyo qorshayaasha la xiriira xaaladda gobolka. items.title: Faah-faahinta dil ka dhacay magaalada Gaalkacyo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wiil dhallinyaro ah oo lagu magacaabo Maxamed Diiriye Catoosh ayaa xalay lagu dilay magaalada Gaalkacyo ee xarunta gobolka Mudug kadib weerar la sheegay inuu la xiriiray dhac ay geysteen kooxo hubeysan. Dilka ayaa ka dhacay xaafadda Garsoor, halkaas oo la sheegay in koox burcad ah isku dayeen inay ka dhacaan taleefanka gacanta ee marxuumka, taasoo ugu dambeyn sababtay in rasaas lagu furo. Marxuum Maxamed Diiriye Catoosh ayaa la sheegay inuu ka mid ahaa ardaydii sannadkan dhammaysatay dugsiyada sare ee Puntland, iyadoo geeridiisa si weyn uga naxeen ehelladiisa, saaxiibbadiis iyo bulshada ku nool magaalada Gaalkacyo. Ciidanka booliska gobolka Mudug ayaa xaqiijiyey inay bilaabeen baaritaan ku saabsan dilka, iyagoo sheegay inay ku raad-joogaan koox lagu tuhunsan yahay inay ka dambeysay falka. Taliyaha saldhigga booliska warshad Galay, Mahad Siciid Axmed ayaa sheegay in laamaha ammaanku ay si dhow ula socdaan baaritaanka iyo raadraaca eedeysanayaasha, isla markaana ay socdaan howlgallo lagu soo qabanayo dadka looga shakisan yahay kiiskan. Waxa uu taliyuhu ugu baaqay shacabka inay laamaha ammaanka la wadaagaan xog kasta oo gacan ka geysan karta soo qabashada dambiilayaasha, isagoo xusay in cid kasta oo ku lug yeelata falalkan sharciga la horkeeni doono. Magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa waxaa mararka qaar ka dhaca falal amni-darro iyo dhac hubeysan, kuwaas oo walaac ku haya shacabka, iyadoo laamaha ammaankuna ay wadaan dadaallo lagu xoojinayo sugidda amniga magaalada. The post Faah-faahinta dil ka dhacay magaalada Gaalkacyo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan oo tababar usoo xiray saraakiil uu tababaray Turkiga + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Dr. Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta tababar u soo xiray saraakiil iyo saraakiil-xigeenno si guul leh u dhammaystay sanadkii waxbarashada ciidan ee dugsiga tababarka ee TURKSOM. Madaxweynaha ayaa munaasabadda ku daawaday dhoolatus ciidan oo ay si wadajir ah u soo bandhigeen saraakiisha, saraakiil-xigeennada iyo cutubyadii ay hoggaamin doonaan, isagoo ku ammaanay dadaalka, adkaysiga iyo hufnaanta ay muujiyeen muddadii uu tababarkoodu socday. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in saraakiishan ay yihiin hoggaamiyeyaasha mustaqbalka ee ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed, lagana filayo inay qarankooda ugu adeegaan daacadnimo, aqoon iyo waddaniyad. Madaxweynaha ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyey in dowladdu ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso dib-u-dhiska, casriyeynta iyo tayeynta ciidanka xoogga dalka, si loo helo ciidan leh awood iyo xirfad buuxda oo xaqiijiya amniga dalka iyo difaaca qarannimada. Waxa uu sidoo kale xusay in tayeynta ciidamada ay laf-dhabar u tahay qorshaha dowladda ee lagu xoojinayo la-dagaallanka kooxaha argagixisada iyo sugidda xasilloonida dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa ku dhiirrigeliyey saraakiisha qalin-jabisay inay si hufan u gutaan waajibaadka loo igmaday, isla markaana ay tusaale wanaagsan u noqdaan askarta ay hoggaamin doonaan. Gabagabadii, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa uga mahadceliyey dowladda aan walaalaha nahay ee Turkiga taageerada joogtada ah ee ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada tababarka iyo tayeynta ciidamada, taas oo door weyn ka qaadatay dhismaha ciidan qaran oo xirfad iyo karti leh. items.title: Saraakiil ku biiraya Ciidamada Qalabka Sida oo tababar loogu soo xiray TURKSOM (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta Saraakiil ku biiraya Ciidamada Dhulka, Cirka iyo Badda tababar ugu soo xiray Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee TURKSOM ee duleedka Magaalada Muqdisho. Munaasabadda qalin jebinta ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Axmed Macalin Fiqi, Wasiirka Dekedaha & Gaadiidka Badda, Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar, Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka Turkiga, General Metin Tokel, Saraakiisha Dugsiga TURKSOM, diblomaasiyiin iyo xubno kale. Saraakiishan oo isugu jira Saraakiil iyo Saraakiil Xigeeno ayaa la filayaa in ay door weyn ka qaadan doonaan horumarinta Ciidanka Qaranka Somaliya iyo la dagaalanka maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee TURKSOM ayaa waxaa si joogta ah tababar loogu soo xiraa Saraakiil, Saraakiil Xigeeno iyo Ciidanka Kumaandooska Gorgor ee Militariga Somaliya. Xerada TURKSOM ayaa ah saldhigga ugu weyn ee Turkigu uu ku leeyahay meel ka baxsan dalkiisa, wuxuuna diiradda saaraa tababarka ciidamada, waxbarashada iyo dhisidda awoodda difaaca. Turkiga ayaa gacan weyn ka gaysta taageerada dib-u-dhiska Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Somaliya iyo casriyayntooda, iyadoo loo marayo iskaashi ku dhisan heshiisyada labada dal. Doorka Turkiga ee Somaliya waa mid muuqdo oo udub dhexaad u ah dhismaha ciidamada iyo in Somaliya mar kale ay cagaheeda isku taagto.

items.title: Journalists union raps Puntland authorities over arrest of reporter
items.description: The National Union of Somali Journalists (NUSOJ) has mounted a fresh challenge against the Puntland administration, calling for the immediate release of independent reporter Suways Ga’ayte and the withdrawal of all criminal charges filed against her. In a formal statement released on Friday, the union decried what it describes as an “intensifying pattern of intimidation” in the regional state, accusing local judicial authorities of weaponizing the law to silence critical reporting. Ga’ayte’s case has become a flashpoint for a growing standoff between the government and the media, which the union claims is being stifled by politically motivated prosecutions. NUSOJ Secretary-General Omar Faruk Osman warned that the continued detention of journalists signals a dangerous shift in the region’s governance. “The criminal justice system must never be used as a tool to punish journalists for independent reporting,” Osman said. “We call upon the Puntland judicial authorities to discontinue the proceedings against Suways Ga’ayte and withdraw all charges arising from her legitimate journalistic work.” The union is now demanding that Puntland’s leadership honor constitutional protections for press freedom, arguing that current practices have fostered a climate of fear. By targeting those who act as the public’s “watchdogs,” the union warns, the state is effectively eroding government accountability. For observers across the Horn of Africa, the crackdown in Puntland is a familiar, albeit troubling, trend. Somalia remains one of the world’s most precarious environments for media workers, who frequently operate at the intersection of clan politics, militant threats, and state-led legal harassment. In Somalia, media stakeholders and regional human rights bodies often monitor such developments closely, as the erosion of press freedom creates a “chilling effect” on the country’s information flow. NUSOJ has committed to escalating the case through national and international legal and human rights channels, vowing to remain involved until the charges are dropped and those behind the prosecution are held accountable. As of Friday the Puntland judicial authorities had not issued a formal response to the union’s demands. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan oo tababar u soo xiray saraakiil
items.description: Madaxweyne Xasan oo tababar u soo xiray saraakiil ka qalin jebiyay Dugsiga TURKSOM Muqdisho – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta tababar u soo xiray Saraakiil iyo Saraakiil-xigeenno si guul leh u dhammeystay sanad waxbarashadooda ciidan ee Dugsiga Tababarka ee TURKSOM. Madaxweynaha ayaa daawaday dhoolatus ciidan oo ay wadajir u sameeyeen Saraakiisha, Saraakiil-xigeenada iyo colalkii ay hoggaamin lahaayeen. Tababarkan ayaa muhiim u ah xilligan, sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo cusub oo ay Dowladda Soomaaliya uga sii dhowaanayso dib-u-dhiska iyo casriyeynta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, iyadoo la xoojinayo awoodda iyo xirfadaha ciidamada si ay uga jawaabaan caqabadaha amni ee dalka ka jira. Madaxweynaha oo hadal ka jeediyay xafladda qalin-jabinta ayaa ku bogaadiyay dadaalka, adkaysiga iyo hufnaanta ay muujiyeen saraakiishu muddadii uu tababarkoodu socday. Wuxuu yidhi: “Waxaad tihiin hoggaamiyeyaasha berri ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, lagana sugayo inaad si daacadnimo, aqoon iyo waddaniyad ku dheehan tahay ugu adeegtaan qarankooda.” Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso dib-u-dhiska, casriyeynta iyo tayeynta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, si ay u yeeshaan awood iyo xirfad ay ku xaqiijiyaan amniga dalka, difaaca qarannimada iyo ciribtirka kooxaha Khawaarijta. Waxaa intaas dheer, Madaxweynuhu wuxuu uga mahadceliyay Dowladda Turkiga taageerada joogtada ah ee ay ku bixiso horumarinta iyo tayeynta ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, taasi oo door muuqda ka qaadatay dhismaha ciidan qaran oo leh xirfad iyo karti. Saraakiisha qalin jabisay ayaa lagu tilmaamay inay yihiin kuwa lagu tababaray qaabab casri ah oo ku saleysan taageerada Turkiga, iyagoo diyaar u ah inay qabtaan waajibaadkooda ciidan ee dalka. Tababarkan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada socda ee Dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku xoojinayso awoodda ciidamada si ay uga hortagaan khataraha amni. The post Madaxweyne Xasan oo tababar u soo xiray saraakiil first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo maanta heshiisyo muhiim ah la saxiixatay dalka…
items.description: Nouakchott (Caasimada Online) – Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cali Balcad ayaa maanta kulan rasmi ah la yeeshay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Mauritania, Maxamed Saalim Marzuuq, kaas oo ka dhacay xarunta Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mauritania. Kulanka ayaa waxaa goob-joog ka ahaa Danjiraha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya u fadhiya Aljeeriya, ahna Danjiraha aan degganeyn ee Mauritania, Danjire Yuusuf Axmed Xasan (Yuusuf Jeego) iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo ka socday labada dal. Intii uu kulanku socday, labada dhinac ayaa ka wada-hadlay xoojinta xiriirka laba geesoodka ah, iskaashiga diblomaasiyadeed iyo sidii loo ballaarin lahaa wada-shaqeynta ka dhexeysa Soomaaliya iyo Mauritania. Mas’uuliyiinta labada dal ayaa sidoo kale kala saxiixday saddex heshiis is-afgarad (MoU), kuwaas oo lagu tilmaamay kuwo muhiim u ah horumarinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya labada dowladood. Heshiisyada ayaa diiradda saaraya iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, la-dagaallanka argagixisada, kalluumeysiga, batroolka iyo waxbarashada, kuwaas oo la filayo inay sare u qaadaan xiriirka labada dal. Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cali Maxamed Cumar ayaa sheegay in booqashadiisa Mauritania ay qeyb ka tahay dadaallada dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku xoojineyso xiriirka ay la leedahay dalalka Afrika, gaar ahaan kuwa gobolka. Booqashadan ayaa la filayaa inay sii xoojiso iskaashiga siyaasadeed, amniga iyo dhaqaalaha ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Mauritania, iyadoo labada dhinac ay muujiyeen sida ay uga go’an tahay hirgelinta heshiisyada ay kala saxiixdeen. The post DF Soomaaliya oo maanta heshiisyo muhiim ah la saxiixatay dalka… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dowladda iyo Mucaaradka oo isku afgartay wadahadal
items.description: Dowladda iyo Mucaaradka oo isku afgartay in la sii wado wadahallada doorashooyinka Muqdisho – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo xubno ka socda dhinacyada mucaaradka ayaa sheegay inay horumar ka gaareen wadahalladii uga socday magaalada Muqdisho, kuwaas oo diiradda lagu saaray hannaanka doorashooyinka, dimuqraadiyadda iyo dib-u-habeynta nidaamka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Labada dhinac ayaa isku raacey in wadahallada la sii wado si loo gaaro is-afgarad dhammaystiran. Wadahalladan ayaa muhiim u ah xilligan, sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan yihiin tallaabo cusub oo ay Soomaaliya uga sii dhowaanayso nidaam dimuqraadi ah, iyadoo dowladda iyo mucaaradku ay wada ogaadeen in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay helaan fursad ay si toos ah uga qayb qaataan doorashooyinka. Tani waxay muujinaysaa is-beddel ku yimaada dhaqanka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Mas’uuliyiin ka hadlay kulanka ayaa sheegay in labada dhinac ay isku raaceen muhiimadda ay leedahay in geeddi-socodka siyaasadeed uu noqdo mid ku dhisan wada-tashi, is-afgarad iyo ilaalinta dastuurka. Waxay sidoo kale isla qaatay in wadahadalku yahay waddada ugu habboon ee lagu xallin karo arrimaha la xiriira hannaanka doorashooyinka. Dowladda ayaa soo bandhigtay qorshaheeda ku aaddan hirgelinta doorashooyin ku saleysan dimuqraadiyadda iyo nidaamka xisbiyada badan, iyadoo tilmaantay in qorshahaasi u baahan yahay wada-shaqeyn iyo taageero ay ka helaan dhammaan dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo bulshada. Wasiirka arrimaha gudaha ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay hiigsanayso in Soomaaliya ay u gudubto nidaam dimuqraadi ah oo shacabka siinaya fursad ay si xor iyo xalaal ah ugu doortaan hoggaankooda. Wuxuu yidhi: “Wadahalladaani waxay caddeyn u yihiin in Soomaaliya ay diyaar u tahay in ay qaaddo tallaabooyin muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo dimuqraadiyadda iyo ka qaybgalka siyaasadeed.” War-saxaafadeedka ka soo baxay kulanka ayaa lagu sheegay in wadahallada la sii wadi doono, si loo gaaro is-afgarad dhammaystiran oo ku saabsan arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo ka qaybgalka siyaasadeed ee muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed. Kulanka ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada socda ee lagu doonayo in la helo hannaan siyaasadeed oo ay isku waafaqsan yihiin dowladda, mucaaradka iyo dhinacyada kale ee ay khuseyso arrinta doorashooyinka. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay inay tixgelinayso duruufaha amni iyo xaaladaha gaarka ah ee ka jira dalka, iyadoo la raadinayo sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa doorashooyin xor ah oo qof walba ka qayb qaadan karo. The post Dowladda iyo Mucaaradka oo isku afgartay wadahadal first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Turkish Army Chief Arrives in Somalia Amid Sensitive Government-Opposition Talks
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – The arrival of Turkey’s Land Forces Commander, General Metin Tokel, in Mogadishu on an official military visit has drawn renewed political attention as Somalia’s Federal Government and opposition leaders remain engaged in Turkish-facilitated negotiations over the country’s electoral future. General Tokel and his high-level delegation were received at Aden Adde International Airport by the Commander of the Somali National Army’s Land Forces, Major General Sahal Abdullahi Omar. The visiting delegation was accorded full military honors, underscoring the close defense partnership between Somalia and Turkey. The visit comes at a particularly sensitive moment, with Ankara serving as a mediator in political talks aimed at reaching a consensus on Somalia’s electoral framework. While Turkish officials have presented themselves as facilitators of dialogue, some opposition figures and political observers have questioned whether the timing of the senior military delegation’s arrival could complicate perceptions of Turkey’s impartiality. Turkey has long been one of Somalia’s closest security partners, providing military training, equipment, strategic advice, and institutional support to the Somali National Army. Thousands of Somali soldiers have received training under Turkish programs, and the partnership has expanded to include defense planning, military modernization, and counterterrorism cooperation. However, Ankara’s growing military and political influence has also attracted criticism from sections of the opposition. Some government critics argue that Turkey appeared to side with the Federal Government during previous political disputes, including the controversial federal intervention in Southwest State, which opponents described as an illegitimate effort to consolidate Mogadishu’s control over the regional administration. Those allegations have fueled lingering doubts among some opposition groups about whether Turkey can serve as a fully neutral mediator in the current political negotiations. items.title: Wasiir Soomaali oo kulan la yeeshay Bangiga Adduunka
items.description: Geneva, Switzerland – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Isgaarsiinta iyo Tiknoolajiyadda ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamed Aadam Macallim Soomaali, ayaa kulan gaar ah la yeeshay Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Bangiga Adduunka ee Isbeddelka Dijitaalka, Mudane Sangbu Kim, xilli uu ka qayb galayo Shirka Heerka Sare ee WSIS+20 ee ka dhacaya magaalada Geneva. Kulankan ayaa diiradda lagu saaray jihada cusub ee iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Bangiga Adduunka. Kulankan ayaa muhiim u ah xilligan, sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo cusub oo ay Soomaaliya uga sii dhowaanayso midowga caalamiga ah ee dhanka tiknoolajiyadda, iyadoo la isla qaatay mudnaanta la siinayo hirgelinta Qorshaha Qaran ee Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI). Qorshahan ayaa la filayaa inuu saldhig u noqdo isku xirka adeegyada dowladda, fududeynta adeeg bixinta, iyo kobcinta dhaqaalaha ku dhisan tiknoolajiyadda. Intii uu kulanku socday, labada dhinac waxay is dhaafsadeen aragtiyo ku saabsan sidii taageerada Bangiga Adduunka ay ula jaanqaadi lahayd qorshayaasha dib-u-habeynta ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhismaha adeegyo dijitaal oo gaara muwaadiniinta iyo ganacsiyada dalka. Wasiir Soomaali ayaa xusay in iskaashiga caalamiga ahi uu yahay tiirka ugu muhiimsan ee lagu dardargelin karo isbeddelka dhijitaalka ah. Wuxuu yidhi: “Dalalka waxaa muhiim ah inay iska bartaan waaya-aragnimada, is-weydaarsadaan aqoonta iyo hababka ugu wanaagsan ee lagu hirgelin karo isbeddelka dhijitaalka ah, si loo xaqiijiyo mustaqbal dhijitaal ah oo loo dhan yahay.” Waxaa intaas dheer, Wasiirku wuxuu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay gaartay dib-u-habaynta nidaamka sharciyeed ee ICT-ga, iyo horumarinta Kaabeyaasha Dadweynaha ee Dhijitaalka ah (Digital Public Infrastructure – DPI), taas oo ah dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee lagu dhisayo adeegyo dowladeed oo casri ah. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah kulammada dhinacyada badan ee ay wafdiga Soomaaliya ka wadaan magaalada Geneva, kuwaas oo lagu ballaarinayo iskaashiyada caalamiga ah isla markaana lagu soo jiidanayo taageero dheeraad ah oo lagu hirgelinayo himilooyinka isbeddelka dijitaalka ee dalka. Shirka Heer Wasiir ee WSIS Forum 2026 ayaa isku keenay Wasiirrada iyo madaxda sare ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah Qaramada Midoobay si ay uga wada hadlaan hirgelinta natiijooyinka WSIS+20, horumarinta isbeddelka dhijitaalka ah, iyo xoojinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah. The post Wasiir Soomaali oo kulan la yeeshay Bangiga Adduunka first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Kenyan Police Foil Alleged Attack Plot, Arrest Somali Suspect in Major Illegal Arms Bust
items.description: Nairobi (WDN) – Kenyan security forces have disrupted what authorities describe as a suspected plot to carry out attacks in Nairobi and Garissa, arresting several armed suspects, including a Somali national allegedly involved in an illegal weapons trafficking network. The arrests followed a targeted security operation in which police intercepted a vehicle at a checkpoint and detained a suspect accused of transporting firearms intended for Nairobi. Authorities believe the weapons were being moved as part of a broader illicit arms operation. According to police, the Somali suspect is under investigation for alleged involvement in the illegal arms trade and for attempting to smuggle weapons into the Kenyan capital. Officers recovered multiple firearms during the operation and later displayed the seized weapons as evidence. Images of the suspect in handcuffs quickly circulated across Kenyan media and social media, drawing widespread attention to the high-profile operation. Investigators said the suspect remains in custody and will be arraigned in court after further questioning. Police disclosed that preliminary investigations uncovered additional intelligence regarding his alleged role in illegal arms trafficking, with authorities now pursuing further leads to determine whether he was acting alone or as part of a larger criminal network. The operation comes as Kenyan security agencies intensify efforts to dismantle arms smuggling routes and prevent militant attacks, particularly in Nairobi and the northeastern region bordering Somalia, where authorities have long warned that illegal weapons trafficking continues to pose a significant threat to national security. The investigation remains ongoing, and police have indicated that additional arrests could follow as detectives pursue new leads uncovered during the operation.
