items.title: Somalia’s Electoral Deadlock Deepens as Government, Opposition Resume Talks
items.description: Technical committees representing the Federal Government of Somalia and opposition groups are holding another round of meetings in Mogadishu today, as diplomatic efforts intensify to pave the way for direct political talks aimed at resolving the country’s electoral dispute. The meetings, which began on Tuesday, are understood to be facilitated by Türkiye, with Western representatives also reportedly involved in efforts to build confidence between the two sides and create a framework acceptable to both parties. The renewed engagement follows earlier diplomatic initiatives that failed to produce a formal breakthrough in the standoff between the government and opposition over Somalia’s electoral process. The opposition, organised under the Somali Future Council, had previously rejected talks led exclusively by Türkiye, arguing that Ankara was not viewed as a neutral mediator by all sides. According to emerging reports, Türkiye is now coordinating with Western partners in an attempt to strengthen the mediation process and improve prospects for a negotiated political settlement. The latest efforts come amid growing international concern over the deepening political tensions linked to Somalia’s electoral roadmap. Diplomats and political observers fear that the dispute could escalate further if the parties fail to reach a timely agreement. The outcome of the technical-level meetings remains uncertain. However, the discussions are being closely watched as a possible step toward direct negotiations between federal government leaders and the opposition. items.title: Shariif oo shaaciyay dhinacyo kale oo mucaaradka ku gacan siiyay dagaalkii MUQDISHO
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee dowladdii KMG ahayd Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay Telefishinka Universal ayaa ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan xaaladda dalka, gaar ahaan khilaafka weli kala dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya. Sheekh Shariif oo wax laga waydiiyay dagaalkii dhawaan ka dhacay Muqdisho ayaa bixiyay xog cusub, isaga oo shaaciyay in dhinacyo kale ay ku gacan siiyeen dagaalka ay la galeen ciidamada dowladda oo si gaar ah uga dhacay xaafado ka tirsan degmooyinka Cabdicasiis iyo Howlwadaag ee Gobolka Banaadir. Shariifka ayaa sheegay in iyagu wateen kaliya ilaaladooda, balse ay dagaalka ay kusoo biireen rag kale oo ay qaraabo iyo saaxibo yihiin, ayna ka caawiyeen in ciidamada dowladda ay iska caabiyaan, maadaama uu qarxay dagaal toos ah. “Ciidanka horta annaga nala socday waa ilaaladeynii ciidan kale oo meesha joogay ma jirin dad deggan meesha oo qaraabanimo ama saaxibnimo ay nagala dhexeyso oo u arkaayay in nala dulminaayo oo iyagana qayb ka qaatay dagaalka way jireen, laakiin annaga meesha waxaan la tagnay waxay ahaayeen ilaaladeen oo weliba qaar halkaan uga tegnay,” ayuu yiri Shariif. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in ay ku baxsadeen difaacyo ay lahaayeen guryaha ay daganaayeen, kuwaas oo uu tilmaamay in markii horeba loo sameeyay in lagu baxsado haddii uu culays yimaada, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Guryaha aan annaga dageynay dabcan magaalada maadaama uu culays badan ka jiro waxaa loo sameeyay meelo gabaad ah oo haddii culays yimaado looga gamba karo ee wax la sameeyay xilliga uu dagaalka socday ma jirin,” ayuu raaciyay. Dhanka kale, Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed oo wax laga waydiiyay halka uu ku dambeeyay dibadbixii mucaaradka ayaa sheegay in aysan weli ka tanaasulin, isla markaana uu yahay xaq dastuuri ah, ayna qaban doonaan. “Banaanbaxa weli kama tanaasulin xuquuq dastuuri ah waayay qof walba xaq ayuu u leeyahay inuu ra’yigiisa cabbiro oo si nabad ah bannaanka ugu soo baxo,” ayuu mar kale yiri wareysiga ku yiri madaxweynihii hore ee dalka. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo weli halkeedii ay tahay xiisadda Villa Somalia iyo mucaaradka, waxaase haatan bilowday wada-hadallo u dhexeeya labada dhinac oo ay garwadeen ka tahay Beesha Caalamka, si xal loo gaaro.   The post Shariif oo shaaciyay dhinacyo kale oo mucaaradka ku gacan siiyay dagaalkii MUQDISHO appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia Pushes Back on EU Visa Claims
items.description: Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs Ali Mohamed Omar (Ali Balcad) says European Union visa-related measures are linked to migration cooperation, not an Somalia’s Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs, Ali Mohamed Omar, commonly known as Ali Balcad, has rejected claims that recent discussions surrounding European Union visa restrictions are connected to Somalia’s electronic visa (eVisa) system, describing such claims as misleading and inaccurate. The Deputy Minister said the measures taken by the European Union are related to migration management, including cooperation on the return of individuals residing illegally in European countries, rather than an evaluation of Somalia’s government systems or administrative performance. The issue involves the Somali Ministry of Foreign Affairs, represented by Deputy Minister Ali Mohamed Omar, the European Union, and Somali citizens and travelers affected by international visa and migration policies. Other countries facing similar migration-related discussions, including Ethiopia, Iraq, Bangladesh, The Gambia, and Senegal, were also mentioned by the Somali official as examples of nations that have experienced comparable measures or concerns. In a statement, Ali Balcad defended Somalia’s eVisa system, saying it was introduced as part of efforts to modernize government services, simplify entry procedures, and improve security and efficiency in border management. He argued that the system was not designed to isolate Somalia but rather to create a more organized and internationally compatible process for travelers entering the country. The remarks came amid ongoing discussions about European migration policies and concerns surrounding visa cooperation between the European Union and several countries outside Europe. The matter affects Somalia’s international travel relations, particularly its engagement with European countries, as well as broader discussions around migration cooperation and border management. Visa policies have become a key part of international relations, with governments balancing the need to facilitate legal travel while addressing concerns related to irregular migration. Ali Balcad emphasized that Somalia should approach such challenges through responsible dialogue, institutional strengthening, and continued cooperation with international partners. He also noted that Somalia is not the only country facing migration-related measures, highlighting that similar issues have involved several countries across Africa and Asia. The Somali government has maintained that strengthening national institutions and improving administrative systems are essential to addressing challenges related to international cooperation. Ali Balcad called for a responsible approach to national challenges, urging continued efforts to develop government institutions, improve public systems, and strengthen Somalia’s relationship with the international community. The debate surrounding visa restrictions reflects wider global discussions about migration management, international cooperation, and the responsibilities shared between countries of origin and destination. For Somalia, maintaining effective migration systems while ensuring smooth international engagement remains a significant diplomatic priority. The government’s defense of the eVisa system highlights its efforts to present digital transformation as part of broader administrative reforms rather than a barrier to international movement. The post Somalia Pushes Back on EU Visa Claims first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Puntland oo sharuud ku xirtay inuu Garowe yimaado Jeneral Jimcaale oo wacad ku maray…
items.description: Garowe (Caasimada Online) – Waan-waan ay wadeen guddi ka socday gobolka Nugaal iyo taliyaha guutada 54-aad ee dowladda Soomaaliya u soo magacowday Puntland ayaa ku dhammaatay natiijo la’aan, kadib markii guddigaasi uu magaalada Laascaanood kula kulmay Jen. Jimcaale Jaamac Takar. Caasimada Online ayaa ogaatay in kulamo ka dhacay magaalada Laascaanood, oo dhex maray guddi ka socday gobolka Nugaal, gaar ahaan magaalada Garoowe, iyo Jen. Jimcaale, looga wada hadlay sidii loo dejin lahaa xiisadda ka taagan Garoowe. Xiisaddan ayaa ka dhalatay diidmada maamulka Saciid Deni ee ku aaddan in Jen. Jimcaale uu gudaha u galo magaalada Garoowe, xilli dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay u soo magacowday inuu hoggaamiyo ciidamada qaybta 54-aad ee ku sugan deegaannada Puntland. Jen. Jimcaale ayaa Laascaanood u yimid inuu uga sii gudbo xerooyinka ciidamada dowladda federaalka ka mid noqday ee ku sugan gobollada Nugaal iyo Mudug, balse maamulka Puntland ayaa ka hor yimid safarkiisa. Maamulka Saciid Deni ayaa shuruud ku xiray gelitaanka Jen. Jimcaale ee Garoowe, isagoo ku adkeysanaya in haddii uu doonayo inuu magaalada soo galo uu marka hore iska casilo xilka dowladda federaalka u magacowday, ama uu warbaahinta ka caddeeyo inaysan jirin magacaabistaas. Ergo iyo guddi dhexdhexaadin ah oo dalab ka siday xukuumadda Deni ayaa la kulmay Jen. Jimcaale, balse wada-hadalladaasi ayaa fashilmay. Jeneraalku wuxuu sheegay inuusan ka tanaasuleyn mas’uuliyadda ay dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya u igmatay. Ergadii ka socotay Garoowe ayaa dib ugu laabatay magaalada, iyadoo aan wax natiijo ah oo la isku qanci karo ka soo qaadin Jen. Jimcaale, kaas oo ku adkeysanaya inuu tegi doono Garoowe, islamarkaana aysan jirin cid ka hor istaagi karta. Xiriir ay Caasimada Online la sameysay xafiiska warfaafinta Puntland ayaa lagu sheegay in Jen. Jimcaale uusan soo geli karin magaalada Garoowe iyo guud ahaan deegaannada Puntland, isagoo wata magacaabista ciidan ee dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Ismari-waagan ayaa abuuray cabsi iyo xiisad hor leh, waxaana magaalada Garoowe laga dareemayaa dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan. Sidoo kale waxaa si weyn loo adkeeyay baraha kontorool ee laga soo galo magaalada. Dhinaca kale, madaxweynaha Puntland, Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Garoowe kula kulmay maamullada degmooyinka, isagoo kala hadlay arrimaha amniga iyo dardargelinta howlaha horyaalla maamulka. Arrintan ayaa ku soo aadeysa iyadoo maamulka Puntland uu dhawaan ku dhawaaqay in qof xil ka haya dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya uusan soo geli karin xuduudaha iyo garoomada Puntland. Maamulka ayaa sidoo kale xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidamada ku hubeysan gaadiidka dagaalka. Xiisadda Jen. Jimcaale ayaa hadda u muuqata inay sii ballaarineyso khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo midka amni ee u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo maamulka Puntland, kaas oo muddooyinkii dambe si weyn uga muuqday arrimaha maamulka, ciidamada iyo awoodda dowladda dhexe ee gudaha Puntland. items.title: Soomaaliya oo Beenisay in eVisa uu Sabab u Yahay Xayiraadaha Fiisaha ee Midowga Yurub
items.description: Wasiir Dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya Xildhibaan Cali Balcad ayaa ka jawaabay eedeymo ay soo jeediyeen Siyaasiyiin oo ku saabsanaa xayiraadaha fiisooyinka ee Midowga Yurub uu kusoo rogay Soomaaliya. Wuxuu sheegay in xayiraadaha dhinaca fiisooyinka ee ay dhawaan soo rogeen Soomaaliya dalalka Midowga Yurub aysan wax xiriir ah la lahayn nidaamka eVisa ee Soomaaliya, isla markaana aan loo fasiran karin qiimeyn ku saabsan habka ay u shaqeyso Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Wasiirka ayaa xusay in sharaxaadda Midowga Yurub ay si cad u muujineyso in tallaabadan ay la xiriirto arrimaha socdaalka iyo dib-u-celinta muhaajiriinta aan sharciga ku joogin dalalka Yurub, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in la xoojiyo wada shaqeynta dhinaca dib-u-celinta dadkaasi. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in Soomaaliya aysan ahayn dalkii ugu horreeyay ee la kulma tallaabooyin noocan oo kale ah. Wasiirka ayaa difaacay hirgelinta nidaamka eVisa, isagoo sheegay in loo sameeyay casriyeynta, fududeynta iyo sugidda amniga habraacyada gelitaanka dalka, isla markaana uusan ahayn nidaam loogu talagalay in lagu go’doomiyo Soomaaliya. Wasiirka ayaa ugu dambeyn ku baaqay in doodaha qaran ay diiradda saaraan xoojinta hay’adaha dowladda, horumarinta nidaamyada maamulka iyo xoojinta xiriirka Soomaaliya la leedahay saaxiibbada caalamiga ah, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in aan la buunbuunin caqabadaha jira ama aan loo adeegsan dano siyaasadeed.

items.title: Shiinaha oo si kulul uga hadlay dagaalka dib u biloowday ee Bariga Dhexe
items.description: Shiinaha ayaa Arbacada maanta ah dhaleeceeyay Maraykanka iyo Iiraan kaddib markii ay dib u bilaabeen dagaalka u dhexeeya labada dhinac. Shiinaha ayaa ku booriyay labada dhinac inay khilaafka ku xalliyaan waddo wada-hadal iyo diblomaasiyadeed. Qatar oo ah dhexdhexaadiyaha u dhaxeeya Iiraan iyo Mareykanka ayaa war ka soo saaray goor dhow dagaalkan cusub. Waxay Qadar ku baaqday in la dejiyo xiisadda u dhexeysa labada dal kadib weerarro ay labada dhinac is-weydaarsadeen. Laakiin shalay, kadib markii maraakiib shidaal lagu bartilmaameedsaday marinka Gacanka Hormuz, Qatar waxay eedda dusha ka saartay Iiraan, waxayna cambaareysay weerarka. Maraykanka ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu saaka fuliyay weerar ka dhacay koonfurta Iiraan, isagoo sheegay in uu ahaa jawaab ka dhan ah weerarkii lagu qaaday maraakiibta shidaal ee Qatar iyo laba markab oo kale. items.title: Trump oo ku dhawaaqay inay dhamaatay xabad-joojintii Iran kadib markii…
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa goor la hadlay weriyaasha, isagoo kulan la yeeshay xoghayaha guud ee NATO, wuxuuna ku dhawaaqay inay dhammaatay xabbad-joojintii iyo heshiiskii is afgaradka ahaa ee Mareykanka uu kula jiray Iiraan, kadib duqeymo culus oo labada dhinac is-waydaarsadeen. Markii wax laga weydiiyay xabbad-joojinta u dhexeysa Mareykanka iyo Iran, Donald Trump wuxuu yiri: “Waxaan u maleynayaa inay dhammaatay.” Wuxuu wariyeyaasha u sheegay shirkii NATO: “Ma doonayo inaan mar dambe la macaamilo iyaga, waa dad aan wanaagsanayn.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Aniga aragtidayda, way dhammaatay. Waa waqti lumis in lala macaamilo iyaga, waa beenaalayaal.” Trump wuxuu sheegay in wadaxaajoodyada labada dhinac ay “wada hadli karaan”, laakiin ay “waqtigooda iska luminayaan.” “Runahaanti, ma doonayo inaan waqtigayga ku lumiyo iyaga,” ayuu intaa ku daray. Dhankeeda Iiran ayaa waxyar ka hor ku dhawaaqday inay ballaarinayso weerarrada ka dhanka ah saldhigyada Mareykanka ee ku yaal Bariga Dhexe , iyadoo warsaxaafadeed ka soo baxay ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka lagu sheegay Mareykanka inuu mas’uul ka noqon doona cawaaqibka ka dhasha xadgudubyada uu si joogto ah oo cad ugu sameeyay xabbad-joojinta, kadib markii Mareykanka uu duqeymo saacadihii u dambeeyay ka fuliyay gudaha Iiran,sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Dhinaca kale Diyaarad sidday Madaxweynaha Iiraan Pezeshkian ayaa si degdeg ah uga duushay Najaf, Iraq, kuna laabatay Iiraan, xilli Mareykanku duqeymo culus ka wado dalkaasi. Waa duqeymihii ugu ballaarnaa labada dhinac isku qaadaan tan iyo markii a gaara heshiiska xabad joojinta oo hadda soo dhammaaday. items.title: Somalia opposition made ‘serious mistake’ by accepting Turkey’s deputy intelligence chief as mediator, Senator Samatar says
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Prominent Somali senator and scholar Abdi Ismail Samatar on Tuesday criticized Somalia’s political opposition for allowing Turkey’s deputy intelligence chief to mediate talks with the federal government in Mogadishu, calling the decision a “serious mistake” and questioning Ankara’s ability to act as a neutral broker. The meeting, held at the Turkish Hotel inside Aden Adde International Airport, brought together representatives of Somalia’s political opposition and the federal government. The regional administrations of Puntland and Jubaland boycotted the talks. In a statement posted on X, Samatar said most Somalis support dialogue that leads to peace and a credible electoral process but remain deeply concerned about the country’s political direction. “Today, representative of the Somali political opposition and the regime met at the Turkish Hotel at Aden A. Osman International Airport. Most Somalis are praying for peace and for a fair electoral process that would undo Hassan Sh.’s authoritarian and deeply corrupt roadmap,” he said. He added that many Somalis also fear the country could slide into renewed conflict. “In addition, the public are seriously worried about the possibility of the dictator instigating a new civil war. What he did in Baidoa, and his attempts to encircle Puntland have all the hallmarks of the dying days of a morally bankrupt regime.” While expressing support for dialogue, Samatar argued that the opposition weakened its own position by accepting Turkish mediation. “Despite the prayers and the well wishes of the public, the Somali political opposition made a serious mistake by allowing the Turkish Deputy Chief of Intelligence to be a mediator,” he said. He questioned Turkey’s neutrality, arguing that Ankara’s treatment of its own political opposition undermines its credibility as a mediator. “It is exceptionally ironic that the Somali opposition thought that the regime in Ankara, widely known for its heavy handedness against the Turkish opposition, would play a neutral role. Come on!.” Samatar said prayers alone would not resolve Somalia’s political crisis and urged Somalis to become more actively engaged. The senator has been one of the most outspoken critics of Turkey’s growing political role in Somalia. He has previously condemned the oil exploration and drilling agreement signed between Ankara and the current Somali administration, describing it as dubious and exploitative, and has referred to Turkey as a “ resource pirate ” over the deal. He has also been sharply critical of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration, recently saying he “will go down in history as Somalia’s worst president.” In another statement criticizing the government, Samatar said: “Astonishingly, Hassan Sh.’s tenure over the past fours mimicked the worst corrupt practice of the old regime’s last decade and is now attempting to impose a second rate violent tyranny over the country most of whose territory he does not control. The English proverb ‘Repeating history the first time is a tragedy; the second time it is a farce’ aptly captures the mindset and fate.” Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Kuweyt oo ku biirtay Qadar iyo Sacuudiga oo cambaareyay weerarrada Iiraan
items.description: Dowladaha Khaliijka ayaa ka falcelinaya weerarrada ay Iiraan geysatay. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Kuweyt ayaa saaka cambaareysay wax ay ku tilmaantay “gardarrada foosha xun ee Iiraan ee soo noqnoqotay.” Bayaan ay soo saartay ayay ku sheegtay in “gardarradan aan gabashada lahayn” ay wiiqayaan dadaallada lagu doonayo in xiisadda lagu yareeyo, isla markaana weerarradu dhacayaan “xilli ay socdaan dadaallo heer gobol iyo heer caalami ah oo lagu doonayo in xaaladda lagu dejiyo.” Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Kuweyt, ayaa sheegtay in dalkaasi uu xaq u leeyahay inuu qaado “dhammaan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah” si uu u ilaashado ammaankiisa. Dhanka kale, afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Qatar, Majed Al Ansari, ayaa sheegay in Qatar ay Iiraan “si buuxda mas’uul uga dhigeyso” weerar la sheegay in si gaar ah loogu bartilmaameedsaday markab lagu magacaabo Al-Rekayyat, kaas oo marayay meel u dhow marin-biyoodka Hormuz Talaadadii. Sidoo kale, qoraal gar ah oo lagu daabacay baraha bulshada, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sheegtay in Iiraan ay bartilmaameedsatay markabka shidaalka ee Sacuudiga ee Wadyan xilli uu marayay marinkaasi. Bbc somali

items.title: Isbedel durbaba ku yimid qiimaha shidaalka adduunka
items.description: Qiimaha shidaalka ayaa sare ugu kacay kadib weerarrada ay isdhaafsadeen Iiraan iyo Mareyknaka: foosto ka mid ah Brent crude oo ah qiimaha tixraaca caalamiga ah ee saliidda, ayaa kor u kacday in ka badan 3%, iyadoo gaartay $76 (£56.88). Qiimaha shidaalka ayaa dib ugu soo laabtay heerarkii uu joogay ka hor dagaalka, kadib heshiis xabbad-joojin ah oo ay bishii hore ay kala saxiixdeen Maraykanka iyo Iiraan. Laakiin weerarradan cusub waxay dib u soo celinayaan walaaca ku saabsan socodka maraakiibta ee marinka muhiimka ah ee Hormuz, kaas oo ay maraan ku dhowaad shan meelood meel (1/5) dhammaan maraakiibta shidaalka adduunka. Ciidanka Iran ayaa shaaciyay in ay bartilmaameedsadeen xsaldhigga Maraykanka ee ku yaalla saldhigga Sheekh Ciise ee Baxrayn.

items.title: Maxaa laga filan karaa wada-hadallada u bilowday DF iyo mucaaradka?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Muqdisho ee Caasimada Soomaaliya waxaa mar kale ka bilowday wada-hadallo xasaasi ah oo u dhexeeyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka, kuwaas oo ay garwadeen ka tahay Beesha Caalamka. Wada-hadallada oo shalay si gaar gaar ah ku bilowday ayaa waxaa diiradda lagu saarayaa sidii xal waara looga gaari lahaa muranka siyaasadeed ee taagan, gaar ahaan hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo wax ka beddelka dastuurka KMG ah. Villa Soomaaliya ayaa weli ku adkeysaneysa doorashooyin qof iyo cod ah, halka mucaaradka ay iyana soo bandhigeen nooc doorasho oo cusub oo ay sheegeen inay ku faah-faahin doonan wada-hadallada hadda bilowday, si looga heshiiyo. Haddaba maxaa laga filan karaa wada-hadallada Dowladda Federaalka iyo mucaaradka? Mukhtaar Maxamed Cali oo ah falanqeeye arrimo siyaasadeed ayaa sheegay in laba mid ay noqon doonto in wada-hadalku guuleysto ama in lagu kala kaco oo ay iska tegto Beesha Caalamka oo hadda qaadaneysa door dhex-dhexaadnimo ah. “Laba arrin ayaan is leeyahay waa kasoo bixi karaan in la’is afgarto oo wax la’isku raaco waa kasoo bixi kartaa iyo in lagu kala kaco oo Beesha Caalamkana iska tegto, Soomaalidana la yiraahdo waa isku madax banaan tihiin,” ayuu yiri Mukhaar oo la hadlay Idaacadda Kulmiye ee magaalada Muqdisho. Sidoo kale, wuxuu farriin u diray labada dhinac oo uu ugu baaqay inay tanaasul sameeyaan, ayna isugu yimaadaan meel dhexe, maadaama uu dalka ku jiro marxalad xasaasi ah. “Waxaan filayaa in la heshiiyo oo meel dhexe la’isugu yimaado tartiib loo wada fariisto, haddii taasi dhici waysana waxaan leeyahay Ummadda Soomaaliyeed buur Allaha u bixiyo,” ayuu mar kale yiri Mukhtaar Maxamed Cali. Si kastaba, Lama oga sida ay wax noqon doonaan, waxaase laga war sugayaa natiijada kasoo baxday wada-hadallada socda ee ay hormuudka u tahay Beesha Caalamka. Soomaaliya ayaa haatan ku jirto xilli xasaasi ah oo kala guur ah, waxaana sidoo kale taagan xaalado bani’aadanimo oo uu abaahan in si deg-deg ah looga jawaabo. items.title: Iran strikes US bases in Bahrain, Kuwait as Hormuz ceasefire collapses
items.description: TEHRAN (Somaliguardian) – Iran’s Revolutionary Guard announced on Wednesday that it had struck United States military installations in Bahrain and Kuwait, hours after Washington launched a fresh round of airstrikes against Iranian territory — a rapid escalation that has pushed the fragile ceasefire between the two nations closer to collapse than at any point since it was signed. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said its forces carried out a coordinated missile-and-drone strike on the US Navy’s Fifth Fleet headquarters at Bahrain’s Port Salman and on the Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait. The Guard also claimed to have shot down a US MQ-9 reconnaissance drone that it said attempted to disrupt the operation. Air raid sirens wailed across both Gulf states as their militaries scrambled to intercept the incoming fire. Kuwait’s armed forces confirmed their air defences were actively engaging “hostile” missiles and drones, though neither Washington nor the Pentagon had issued an immediate response by the time of publication. Washington Strikes First, Then Pulls Iran’s Oil Lifeline The retaliation followed a wave of American strikes on Iranian territory and a decision by Washington to revoke a license that had permitted Iran to sell oil on international markets — both moves framed as punishment for a string of attacks on commercial tankers passing through the Strait of Hormuz. US Central Command said its forces struck more than 60 vessels belonging to the Revolutionary Guard, describing the operation as a deliberate effort to make Iran pay a heavy price for what it called violations of the ceasefire in the strait. In a statement, CENTCOM accused Iranian forces of “unwarranted aggression” that endangers freedom of navigation through one of the world’s most critical oil corridors. Speaking ahead of a NATO leaders’ summit in Ankara, Secretary-General Mark Rutte backed the American response, calling it essential given Iran’s alleged breach of the truce. He argued that a forceful US reaction was necessary once Iran began violating the ceasefire it had agreed to honour. Tehran Vows a “Crushing Response” Iran’s top military command, the Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, denounced the American strikes as a blatant act of aggression and promised a crushing response, warning Washington against interfering in how Tehran manages traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, one of Iran’s senior negotiators, accused the United States of breaching the truce on multiple fronts — citing the fresh military strikes, the reinstatement of oil sanctions, alleged violations of Iran’s own navigational rules in the strait, and continuing Israeli operations in Lebanon. “The era of bullying and extortion is over,” he wrote on X. “We don’t fold.” Explosions Reported Along Iran’s Southern Coast Iranian state media reported explosions on Kharg Island — the country’s principal oil export terminal, responsible for roughly 90 percent of its crude shipments — as well as on Qeshm Island and in the southern port cities of Sirik and Bandar Abbas. State broadcaster Press TV said several blasts were heard on Kharg Island specifically, though CENTCOM’s own statement made no mention of strikes there. A US official told Reuters the American strikes targeted Iranian air-defence systems, coastal surveillance networks, surface-to-air missiles, anti-ship cruise missiles, and drone-launch sites. No civilian deaths were reported inside Iran, though state television said several people were wounded by shrapnel after an “enemy projectile” struck a commercial pier in Sirik. Fishing piers in both Sirik and Bandar Abbas were also reportedly damaged. A Ceasefire Already on Life Support Wednesday’s exchange marks the latest in a series of jolts to the US-Iran ceasefire reached last month, which had paused a broader conflict ignited by joint American and Israeli strikes across Iranian territory. The truce suffered a serious blow on Tuesday when Washington moved to strip Iran of a key economic concession: the ability to sell crude and petrochemical products on international markets. The US Treasury had issued a general license on 22 June permitting such sales through 21 August; its abrupt revocation gives Iran only until 17 July to unwind any pending transactions. Oil prices jumped more than 3 percent on news of the decision. Analysts say Tehran’s willingness to strike shipping traffic reflects its determination to preserve leverage over the strait as negotiations for a lasting settlement continue — leverage that has allowed a comparatively smaller power to force a prolonged standoff with the world’s most formidable military. President Donald Trump has repeatedly warned he would resume bombing unless Tehran commits to “make a deal,” while Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi has said that under the terms of the interim memorandum, talks on a final agreement will not resume “if threats continue.” With both sides trading strikes and ultimatums, the coming days are expected to determine whether the truce can be salvaged — or whether the Gulf is headed back toward full-scale war. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said its forces carried out a coordinated missile-and-drone strike on the US Navy’s Fifth Fleet headquarters at Bahrain’s Port Salman and on the Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait. The Guard also claimed to have shot down a US MQ-9 reconnaissance drone that it said attempted to disrupt the operation. Air raid sirens wailed across both Gulf states as their militaries scrambled to intercept the incoming fire. Kuwait’s armed forces confirmed their air defences were actively engaging “hostile” missiles and drones, though neither Washington nor the Pentagon had issued an immediate response by the time of publication. items.title: Fresh diplomatic initiative targets Somalia’s electoral stalemate

items.title: Qoysas colaad ay saamaysay noloshooda oo cunno xumo ku wajahaya Ari-cadeeye
items.description: (Ergo) – Boqollal qoys oo ganacsato yar yar iyo xoola dhaqato is kugu jira ayaa nolol xumo ku wajahaya deegaanka Ari-cadeeye ee gobolka Sool tan iyo billlawgii bishaan. Waxay colaad qabiil oo ay ku waayeen kaabayaashoodi dhaqaale uga soo barakaceen deegaanka Madax-lagu xoor oo Ari-cadeeye hoostaga. Waxay sheegen in ay faro marnaan ku yimaadeen si ay waxyeelada dagaalka uga baxsadaan.  Sahra Faaax Cali oo ka mid ah waxay Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay in colaada looga gubay mehrad ay ku iibin jirtay cuntooyin bisil iyo bagaash. Waxay xustay in ay hadda la’dahay wax ay ku dabarto nolosha 8 carruur oo ay ka masruufi jirtay, kuwaas oo kaligeed ku tiirsan. Waxay xustay in ay noloshoodu ku soo aruurtay wax ay ka helaan dad ay ehel yihiin oo ay dul-saar ku noqdeen, taas oo aan joogta ahayn. “Hal mar ayaan dabka shidanaa. Markaas xitaa mararka qaar waa wayna oo qatooyo ayaan ku joogna. baahiyaha aan qabnana aad ayay u badan yihiin, maaddama aan nahay dad faro maran oo aan waxbo awoodin.” Sahro ayaa sheegtay in $300 oo u dhex yaallay mehrada oo ay markii hore ku billawday $100 oo ay dayn ku soo qaadatay ayay xustay inuusan waxbo uga badbadin oo colaada lagu gubay. Dhinacyadii dagaalamayay oo wada gubay guriyihi iyo ganacsayadii deegaanka ayay sheegtay in keedina uu ka mid noqday. Waxay xustay in ay meesha ka baxday $6 Illa $10 oo ay joogta uga heli jirtay ganacsigeeda. Dhaqaalahan oo ay ku maaraynaysay cuntada, biyaha, waxbarashada iyo baahiyaha kale ee carruurteeda ayay tilmamtay in ay hadda ka faro maran tahay. Haweeynaydan ayaa xustay in xaaladdan ay u dheertahay helitaanka biyaha oo ay ku dhibban yihiin. Waxay sheegtay in ay awoodi la’ dahay $1 oo jirgaankii ay iibiyaan ceelal gaar loo leeyahay. Qubeys iyo dhar-dhaqis ayay sheegtay in aysan tabar u hayn oo ay dirqi ku hesho maalinkii 20 liitar oo ay cabaan ama cuntada ku karsadaan, Waxaa ka caawiya qoyska ay dul-saarka ku noqdeen oo aan waxbadan ku dhaamin. Qoyskeeda ayaa ah bannaan yaal aan haysan hoy ka xajin kara qoraxda maalinkii iyo qabowga habeenkii. “Hoy fiican ma lihin. Baco aan dayn ku soo qaadanay iyo ullo aan isku gaynay ayaan dhisanay. Waxaan dhiganay oo aan ku seexana sijaayado ay nagu caawiyeen dadka aan dul saarka ku nahaya. Naguma filna.” “Carruurta ayaan seexina anaga banaanka ayaan seexana habeenkii, maalikiina geedaha hoostooda ayaan harsanaa.” Sahra ayaa sheegtay in sidoo kale colaada looga gubay guri ka koobna labo qol oo jiingad ah, barsad, musqul iyo jiko ay ku noolaayeen reerkeeda. Waxay arrintan ku sababaysa in aysan dib ugu noqon karin deegaankoodi haddii uu amni noqda, maaddama aysan wax hanti ah ku lahayn. Waxay sidoo kale colaada darteed iskaga soo tageen lix neef oo ari oo ay dhaqan jireen. Waxay sheegtay in qarkood ay irmaan ahaayeen oo ay carruurta u maali jirtay, balse ay soo wadan waysay maaddaama ay xabad dhacaysay darteed aysan awood u lahayn. Haweeynaydaan oo 41 jir ayaa xustay in ay ku hungowday raadinta shaqooyin dhar dhaqis ah oo ay deeganka ka raadisay. Arrintaan ayay xustay in ay rajo xumo ku beertay, aysanna u muuqan xal ay ku heli karto wax ay masruufka carruurta ka soo saarato. Waxay sheegtay inaysan haysan cid garab u noqota xilligan adag. Ilmaheeda aabbahood ayay xustay in afar sano ka hor uu u dhintay cudur aysan aqoonsan. Dhanka kale haweenaydaan ayaa xustay in xaaladda barakaca ay uga waxbarasho beelen saddex carruur ah oo u dhigan jiray dugsi Qur’aan, kuwaas oo ay bishii ka dhiibi jirtay $30.  Waxay tilmaamtay in aysan hadda u awoodin in ay waxbarasho ku darto, maaddama ay faro maran tahay.  Waxaa walwalka ku sii kordhinaya dayn lagu yeeshay tan iyo markii ay xaaladdan soo wajahday.  “$300 oo dayn ayaa la igu leeyahay. Gaarigii aan ku soo guurnay iyo bacaha aan guriga ka dhiganay ayay is kugu jiraan. Dhibaato ayay igu haysa dayntaas si aan ku bixiyana ma aqaan.” Colaadaha kadiska ku billawda waxay cayrtoy iyo nolol xumo u horseeda sanadka kasto boqollal qoysas ah oo horray u haystay nolol nagaansho leh. Waxay miciin bideen barakac aysan xal u helin sidii ay uga soo kaban la’haayeen. Hinda faarax jamac waxay qoyskeeda oo toddobo qof ka kooban u awoodi la’dahay dhamaan baahiyaha aas-aasiga. Xerada Ari-cadeeye oo ay soo miciin bideen ayay tilmaamtay in aysan wax kaalmo ah ku helin. Qoyskeeda ayay horray masruufkooda uga soo saari jirtay dukaan bagaas ah oo ay ku lahayd deeganka Madax-lagu xoor, kaas oo hadda colaada looga gubay. Waxay xustay in halkaas ay ku waayeen dhaqaale ay ku qiyaastay illaa s$3,000 oo ahaa waxa kali ah oo ay ku tiirsanayeen. Raashin bisil oo aan joogta ahayn oo ay ku caawiyaan dadkii xerada uga soo horeeyay ayay ku tiirsan yihiin. Xaaladda ay muteen ayay quus ka muujisay.  “Dad badan ayaan nahay wax hal mar dabka la saaray naguma filna. Danta ayaase nagu qasbaysa.” Hinda ayaa sheegtay in sidoo kale ay ku dhib qabaan helida biyaha. Xerada ay yimaadeen kama jiraan dhamaan adeegyada aas-aasiga ah, Dantu waxay ku qasabtay in ay jirgaan dhabarka uga soo qaado ceel u jira 1km oo ay u dan sheegteen. Waxay xustay in biyihiisu dhanaan yihiin, balse aysan beddel kale heli karin, maaddaama aysan awoodin kuwa macaan oo jirgaankii la iibiyo $1. Waxay sheegtay in qaaliyowga biyaha ay sabab u tahay colaadda jirta oo aysan dadku inta badan tagi karin ceelka.  “Carruurta wxaa waxbarasho la’aan iga noqday 4 ka mid ah. Hadda wxbarasho la’aanta waxaa ka dhigay waan soo barakacnay wax wax u dhiga waan u waynay. Halka aan joogno waa xeryo iskuullo malahan. Carruurta midkii $8 ayaan ku bixin jiray haddana lacagtaas ma awoodno.” Waxay xustay in muddo dhawr iyo toban berri ah oo ay joogan xerada ay seexdaan meel banaan habeenkii halka maalintiina ay dulsaar ku yihiin qoys deggan buush aan wada qaadin. Dadka ku soo barakacay xeryaha ee aadka u badan darteed waxaa adkaatay in ay caawiyaan dadkii horay u deganaa meelaha ay tageen sida uu sheegay Cabdisalaan Abshir Cabdiraxmaan oo ah guddoomiye xerada Ari-cadeeye. Wuxuu tilmaamay in dadka soo barakacay oo ay tan iyo billawgii bishaan diwaangaliyeen ay gaarayaan 370 qoys. Colaaddda ayuu xusay in ay ku soo beegantay xilli dadku ay ka soo kabanayeen saamayntii ka soo gaartay abaarihii daba dheeraaday ee deegaanka ka jiray muddo saddex sano ah, balse ay wajaheen saamayn tii hore ka culus. “Waxay u baahan yihiin cunno, hoy, waxbarasho iyo caafimaad. Dhamaan baahiyaha aas-aasiga ayaa ka maqan. Dadku waxay qaar barakac ku noqdeen xerada Ari-cadeeye, qaarna dad ayay dul-saar ku noqdeen.” Colaadaha soo laalabtay ee dalka ka jira ayaa noqday dhibaatada ugu wayn ee sanad kasta nolol xumo u horseeda kumanaan qoys. Waxaa adkaata in ay ka soo kabtaan nolol xumada ay mutaan maddaama aysan halayn awood ay ku abuurtaan ilo kale oo dhaqale. items.title: Trump oo Erdogan ku war-geliyey go’aan farxad leh
items.description: Ankara (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in Washington ay cunaqabateynta ka qaadi doonto Turkiga, taasoo lagu soo rogay Ankara kadib markii ay sanadkii 2019 iibsatay nidaamka difaaca cirka ee Ruushka laga sameeyo ee S-400. Trump, oo Talaadadii booqasho ku tagay Ankara oo uu ka qeyb galayay shir madaxeedka NATO, ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay inuu diyaar u yahay in Turkiga mar kale loo oggolaado iibsashada diyaaradaha dagaalka ee F-35, inkastoo arrintaas ay si weyn uga hor imaan karaan xubno ka tirsan Congress-ka Mareykanka. “Cunaqabateynta waan ka qaadeynaa,” ayuu Trump u sheegay wariyayaasha ka hor kulan uu la yeeshay madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan. “Waa waqtigii la qaadi lahaa. Ma dooneyno inaan cunaqabateyn saarno saaxiibbadeen,” ayuu raaciyay. Hadalka Trump ayaa muujinaya isbeddel weyn oo ku yimid xiriirka Washington iyo Ankara, oo muddo sanado ah uu culays ku hayay muranka ka dhashay S-400 iyo ka saaristii Turkiga ee barnaamijka diyaaradaha F-35. Turkiga ayaa markii hore qeyb ka ahaa dalalka ka qeyb qaadanayay barnaamijka F-35, balse Mareykanka ayaa Ankara ka saaray kadib markii ay diiday inay ka laabato iibsashada nidaamka S-400. Washington waxay ku dooday in nidaamka Ruushka uu khatar amni ku yahay sirta iyo teknoolajiyadda diyaaradaha dagaalka ee Mareykanka. Sannadkii 2020, Mareykanka ayaa cunaqabateyn ku soo rogay hay’adda difaaca ee Turkiga, tallaabo ka dhalatay sharciga CAATSA ee Mareykanka, kaasoo lagu ciqaabo dalalka heshiisyo waaweyn oo militari la gala Ruushka. Balse Trump ayaa Talaadadii sheegay inuusan wax walaac ah ka qabin in Turkiga uu weli haysto nidaamka S-400. “Wax walaac ah kama qabo wax kasta oo Turkiga la xiriira,” ayuu yiri. “Xiriirka Turkiga aan la leenahay hadda waxaa laga yaabaa inuu yahay kii ugu wanaagsanaa abid.” Trump ayaa sidoo kale ammaan xooggan u jeediyay Erdogan, isagoo sheegay in labadoodu ay leeyihiin “isfaham” wanaagsan. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Turkiga uu marar badan muujiyay daacadnimo ka badan dalal kale oo Washington ay u aragto xulafo dhow. “Turkiga, dhinacyo badan, wuxuu ahaa mid aad uga daacad badan dalal kale oo aan u maleyneyno inay daacad yihiin,” ayuu yiri Trump, isagoo ka hadlayay suurta-galnimada in Ankara loo iibiyo F-35. “Waa diyaarad aad u weyn, waa tan ugu fiican hadda, waana arrin aan si dhab ah uga fiirsan doonno.” Erdogan ayaa isna sheegay inuu rajeynayo in wada-hadallada ku saabsan F-35 ay natiijo wanaagsan ka soo baxdo. Madaxweynaha Turkiga ayaa sheegay in Ankara hore loogu ballanqaaday shan diyaaradood, isagoo intaas ku daray inuu rumeysan yahay in Trump uu ballanqaadyadiisa oofiyo. Si kastaba, jidka loo marayo iibinta F-35 weli ma sahlana. Congress-ka Mareykanka ayaa sanadkii 2019 ansixiyay sharci mamnuucaya in Turkiga laga iibiyo diyaaradaha F-35 inta uu haysto nidaamka S-400. Sharciga hadda jira wuxuu Ankara ka hor istaagayaa inay ku laabato barnaamijka F-35 haddii aysan ka tanaasulin ama ka bixin nidaamka Ruushka. Toddobaadkii hore, koox sharci-dajiyayaal Mareykan ah oo ka kooban labada xisbi, kana kala socda Jamhuuriga iyo Dimoqraadiga, ayaa warqad u qoray Trump, iyagoo ka digay in Turkiga loo oggolaado F-35. Xubnahaas, oo ay hoggaaminayeen Mike Lawler oo Jamhuuri ah iyo Brad Sherman oo Dimoqraadi ah, ayaa sheegay inay “walaac qoto dheer” ka qabaan tallaabo kasta oo arrintaas lagu fasaxayo. Qaar ka mid ah xubnaha Congress-ka ayaa ku doodaya in nidaamka S-400 uu weli halis ku yahay diyaaradaha F-35, halka kuwo kale ay walaac ka muujiyeen xiriirka Turkiga la leeyahay Iran iyo hadallada adag ee Ankara ay u jeediso Israel. Warar ay Reuters soo xigatay ayaa sheegay in mid ka mid ah xalalka la isla dhex marayo uu yahay in nidaamka S-400 loo raro dal saddexaad, si Turkiga loogu furo waddada F-35. Hase yeeshee, weli heshiis rasmi ah lagama gaarin arrintaas, waxaana sidoo kale la ogeyn in Ruushka uu aqbali doono tallaabo noocaas ah, maadaama heshiisyada hubka Ruushka ay inta badan leeyihiin shuruudo ku saabsan cidda adeegsan karta. Booqashada Trump ee Turkiga ayaa ahayd tii ugu horreysay ee madaxweyne Mareykan ah ku tago dalkaas muddo 11 sano ah. Erdogan ayaa Trump ku qaabilay xaflad heer qaran ah, iyadoo ciidamo Turki ah oo fardo saaran ay galbiyeen kolonyada madaxweynaha Mareykanka ilaa qasriga madaxtooyada. Kulanka labada hoggaamiye ayaa ku soo aaday xilli xulafada NATO ay si isa soo taraysa u arkaan Turkiga inuu yahay dal muhiim u ah difaaca garabka koonfur-bari ee isbaheysiga, gaar ahaan marka la eego saameynta Ruushka iyo awoodda militari ee Ankara. Turkiga ayaa leh militariga labaad ee ugu weyn NATO, waxaana uu sidoo kale noqday dal si weyn loo tixgeliyo marka laga hadlayo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee dagaalka. items.title: Wadatashigu waa furaha xalka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Soomaaliya waxay mar kale taagan tahay marxalad siyaasadeed oo xasaasi ah. Wadatashiyada u socda Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka ma aha oo keliya kulan siyaasadeed; waa fursad taariikhi ah oo lagu dhisi karo is-afgarad qaran, lagu xoojin karo dowladnimada, laguna xaqiijin karo doorashooyin lagu wada kalsoon yahay. Waxaa muhiim ah in dhammaan dhinacyadu fahmaan in guusha wadatashigu aysan ku xirnayn cidda ka adkaata dhinaca kale, balse ay ku jirto in la gaaro heshiis waara oo ku dhisan dastuurka, sharciga, wadajirka ummadda iyo danta guud ee qaranka. Dowladnimada casriga ahi waxay ku dhisan tahay wada-hadal, is-qancin iyo isu-tanaasul. Khilaafka siyaasadeed waa arrin dabiici ah oo ka jirta dal kasta oo dimuqraadi ah, balse waxa lagu kala duwan yahay waa habka loo maareeyo. Qaran xooggan laguma dhiso guul siyaasadeed oo hal dhinac gaaro, balse waxaa lagu dhisaa heshiisyo ay dhammaan dhinacyadu u arkaan kuwo caddaalad ah oo sharciyeysan. Tiirka koowaad ee lagu gaari karo guul waa in dastuurka iyo ku dhaqanka sharcigu noqdaan saldhigga wada-xaajoodka. Dastuurku waa heshiiska ugu weyn ee shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay ku mideysan yihiin, mana habboona in xal siyaasadeed lagu raadiyo meel ka baxsan nidaamka dastuuriga ah. Haddii ay jiraan qodobbo lagu kala aragti duwan yahay, waxaa habboon in lagu xalliyo hannaan sharci ah iyo hay’ado dastuuri ah. Waxaa sidoo kale lama huraan ah in danta qaranku ka sarreyso danaha siyaasadeed ee gaarka ah. Dowladda iyo mucaaradkuba waa inay muujiyaan biseyl siyaasadeed, dulqaad iyo isu-tanaasul, iyagoo maskaxda ku haya in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay ka sugayaan xasillooni, amni iyo nidaam dimuqraadi ah oo waara. Wadatashigu wuxuu noqon karaa mid miro-dhal ah oo keliya haddii uu noqdo mid loo dhan yahay. Waxaa muhiim ah in la dhegeysto dhammaan dhinacyada siyaasadda, dowlad-goboleedyada, Baarlamaanka, bulshada rayidka ah, haweenka iyo dhalinyarada. Heshiis kasta oo sal ballaaran leh wuxuu yeeshaa sharciyad iyo cimri dheer. Sidoo kale, waxaa lama huraan ah in la dhiso kalsooni siyaasadeed. Hadallada hurinaya khilaafka, eedeymaha aan salka lahayn iyo ololaha kala fogeynaya bulshada waa in laga fogaadaa. Halkooda waa in lagu beddelaa ixtiraam, hufnaan iyo is-aaminaad. Doorashooyinka soo socda waa inay noqdaan kuwo xor ah, hufan, loo dhan yahay, isla markaana lagu wada kalsoon yahay. Taasi waxay u baahan tahay heshiis siyaasadeed oo cad oo ku saabsan jadwalka doorashada, maamulka doorashada, amniga iyo habka lagu xallinayo cabashooyinka si nabad ah oo sharci waafaqsan. Waxaa kale oo muhiim ah in hay’adaha dastuuriga ah, gaar ahaan guddiyada doorashooyinka iyo garsoorku, ay ilaashadaan madax-bannaanidooda. Kalsoonida shacabka waxaa lagu dhisaa hay’ado dhexdhexaad ah oo aan u adeegayn dano siyaasadeed oo gaar ah. Heshiis kasta oo la gaarana waa inuu yeeshaa hannaan fulineed oo cad. Ballanqaad aan lahayn jadwal, mas’uuliyiin loo xilsaaray iyo hab lagu kormeero hirgelintiisa wuxuu halis ugu jiraa inuu noqdo qoraal aan la dhaqan-gelin. Ugu dambayn, Soomaaliya maanta waxay u baahan tahay hoggaan siyaasadeed oo ka fikira jiilasha soo socda, halkii uu ka fikiri lahaa doorashada soo socota oo keliya. Taariikhdu waxay xusi doontaa kuwii horseeday is-afgarad qaran iyo dowladnimo adag, ee ma xusi doonto kuwii ku adkaystay guul siyaasadeed oo ku-meel-gaar ah. Waqtigani waa waqti lagu muujinayo biseyl siyaasadeed, lagu dhowrayo dastuurka, laguna ilaalinayo midnimada qaranka. Haddii dowladda iyo mucaaradku ay ka hormariyaan danta Soomaaliya danahooda siyaasadeed, wadatashiyadani waxay noqon karaan bilowga marxalad cusub oo lagu xoojinayo dimuqraadiyadda, nabadda iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Maraykanka oo duqeymo ka fuliyay koonfurta Iiraan iyo Tehran oo ku dhawaaqday inay ka bixinayso jawaab adag
items.description: Xiisadda u dhexeysa Maraykanka iyo Iiraan ayaa si weyn u sii xoogeysatay, kadib markii ciidamada Maraykanku ay duqeymo cirka ah ku qaadeen bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla koonfurta Iiraan. Weerarradan ayaa yimid iyadoo Washington ay sheegtay inay uga jawaabayso weerarro lagu qaaday maraakiib ganacsi oo marayay marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz. Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Maraykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay in howlgalka uu socday ku dhowaad afar saacadood, islamarkaana lagu beegsaday in ka badan 80 bartilmaameed, oo ay ku jireen nidaamyada difaaca cirka, gantaallada lidka maraakiibta, xarumaha kormeerka xeebaha iyo goobaha laga rido diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones). Dhanka kale, Iiraan ayaa cambaareysay weerarka, iyadoo saraakiisha milatarigu ay ku hanjabeen inay jawaab adag oo burburin ah ka bixin doonaan weerarkaas. Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah (IRGC) ayaa sheegtay inay gantaallo ku weerareen 85 saldhig oo Maraykanku ku leeyahay Baxrayn iyo Kuweyt, halka ay sidoo kale ku dhawaaqeen inay soo rideen diyaarad nooca MQ-9 Reaper ah. items.title: Bannaanbaxyo Ballaaran oo Ruxay Kenya iyo Waddooyin La Xiray
items.description: Magaalooyin waaweyn oo ka tirsan dalka Kenya ayaa maanta waxaa hareeyay bannaanbaxyo ballaaran oo loo sameeyay munaasabadda loo yaqaano “Saba Saba”, taasoo sababtay in la xiro waddooyin muhiim ah, ganacsiguna hakad galo. Dibadbaxyadan ayaa ka dhacay magaalooyinka Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru iyo Eldoret, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka si weyn loo geeyay goobaha ay mudaharaadyadu ka socdeen. Waddooyinka gala bartamaha Nairobi ayaa la xiray, halka ciidamada booliisku ay sameeyeen baro-koontarool oo adkeeyay isu socodka dadka iyo gaadiidka. Ganacsiyo badan ayaa xirnaa, iskuullo iyo adeegyo gaadiidna waa ay hakadeen, kadib markii shacabka careysan ay dalbadeen isla-xisaabtan dowladeed, joojinta tacaddiyada booliska, la dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa iyo hagaajinta xaaladda dhaqaale ee dalka. “Saba Saba” oo afka Sawaaxiliga ka dhigan “Toddoba Toddoba”, ayaa asal ahaan kasoo bilaabatay July 7, 1990, markaas oo siyaasiyiin mucaarad ah iyo dhaqdhaqaaqayaal dimuqraadiyad doon ah ay dalbadeen in Kenya laga hirgeliyo nidaam axsaab badan leh, xilli uu dalka ka jiray nidaam hal xisbi ah oo uu hoggaaminayay madaxweynihii hore Daniel arap Moi. Inkasta oo mudaharaadyadii xilligaas si xooggan loo cabburiyay, haddana waxay noqdeen dhacdo taariikhi ah oo horseeday dib-u-habeyn siyaasadeed iyo dib usoo noqoshada nidaamka axsaabta badan sanadkii 1991. Sanadihii dambe, gaar ahaan kadib bannaanbaxyadii dhalinyarada Gen Z ee dhacay 2024, munaasabadda Saba Saba waxay isu beddeshay astaan ay shacabka Kenya ku muujiyaan cabashooyinka la xiriira maamulka dalka, xaaladda nololeed iyo xorriyadaha dastuuriga ah.

items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo cambaareysay weerar argagixiso oo ka dhacay dalka…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si kulul u cambaareysay weerar argagixiso oo maanta Talaado ah ka dhacay gudaha magaalada Dimishiq ee caasmadda dalka Suuriya. Weerarka oo qaraxyo loo adeegsaday ayaa ka dhacay meel aan ka fogeyn hoteelka Four Seasons oo uu degay Madaxweynaha Faransiiska, Emmanuel Macron oo haatan booqashadii u horreysay ku jooga Dimishiq. Qaraxyada oo laba ahaa ayaa la sheegay inay u muuqdaan kuwa la dhigay goobaha ay ka dhaceen, waxaana Macron xilligaas uu ku sugnaa madaxtooyada Suuriya, oo uu wadahadallo kula lahaa madaxweyne Axmed Sharac, sida ay ku warrantay wakaaladda AP. Bayaan kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Xukuumadda Soomaaliya ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka ay ka xuntahay weerarka oo dhaliyay khasaare kala duwan, iyada oo tacsi u dirtay dhammaan dhibanayaasha iyo dadka uu saameeyay weerarka. Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay si cad uga soo horjeedo weerarrada noocaan oo kale ah, waxayna tilmaamtay inay taageereyso dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagula dagaalamayo argagixisada. “Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay si kulul u cambaareyneysaa weerarkii argagixisanimo ee lala beegsaday caasimadda Suuriya ee Dimishiq. Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay si cad u diiddan tahay argagixisada iyo xagjirnimada rabshadaha ku dhisan nooc kasta iyo muuqaal kasta oo ay yeeshaan, iyadoo mar kale adkaynaysa sida ay uga go’an tahay taageeridda dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagula dagaallamayo argagixisada iyo horumarinta nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in xilligan adag ay garab taagan tahay dowladda Suuriya, iyada oo mar kale xaqiijisay taageeradeeda ku aadan amniga iyo xasiloonida dalkaasi. “Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay muujinaysaa garab istaaggeeda buuxa oo ay la garab taagan tahay Dowladda iyo shacabka walaalaha ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Carabta Suuriya, waxay tacsi tiiraanyo leh u diraysaa dhammaan dhibbanayaasha iyo dadka uu saameeyay weerarkaan argagixisanimo, waxayna u rajaynaysaa dhaawacyada in alle siiyo caafimaad degdeg ah,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri bayaanka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda. Sidoo kale, waxay ay Dowladda Soomaaliya ku baaqday in sharciga la horkeeno dhammaan kuwii ka dambeeyay weerarkaasi. The post DF Soomaaliya oo cambaareysay weerar argagixiso oo ka dhacay dalka… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Weerarro ka dhacay Marinka Hormuz oo mugdi geliyay wada-hadallada nabadda ee Mareykanka iyo Iiraan
items.description: Weerarro lagu qaaday maraakiib ganacsi oo marayay Marinka Hormuz ayaa walaac cusub ku abuuray mustaqbalka wada-hadallada nabadeed ee u socda Mareykanka iyo Iiraan, iyadoo marinkan uu weli yahay qodobka ugu muranka badan ee labada dhinac. Hay’adda ganacsiga badaha ee Ingiriiska ee (UKMTO) ayaa sheegtay in markab shidaal sida uu dab qabsaday ka dib markii uu ku dhacay gantaal ama walax kale oo aan la aqoonsan, xilli uu marayay meel qiyaastii 15 kiiloomitir u jirta xeebta Limah ee dalka Cumaan. Warbaahinta Axios, oo soo xiganeysa saraakiil Mareykan ah oo aan magacyadooda la shaacin, ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka Iiraan (IRGC) ay ugu yaraan laba gantaal ku rideen maraakiib ganacsi oo marayay Marinka Hormuz. Wararka ayaa tilmaamaya in mid ka mid ah maraakiibta uu yahay markab LNG ah oo laga leeyahay Qatar, kaas oo lagu magacaabo Al Rekayyat, halka markabka labaad la sheegay inuu yahay booyad shidaal oo sidata calanka Sacuudiga. Shaqaalaha markabka Qatar ayaa la xaqiijiyay inay badbaadeen, inkastoo dab ka kacay qolka matoorka uu sare u qaaday halista qarax. Ilo-wareedyo ku sugan Tehran ayaa sheegay in markabka Qadar laga yaabo inuu galay goob ay ciidamada Iran ka wadeen hawlgallo lagu nadiifinayo miinooyinka badda, taasoo laga yaabo inay sababtay weerarka. Marinka Hormuz ayaa ah marin istaraatiiji ah oo isku xira dalalka Khaliijka iyo Badweynta Hindiya, waxaana Kahor dagaalka, maalin kasta mari jiray 120 illaa 140 markab, kuwaas oo badankood qaadayay ku dhowaad 20 milyan oo foosto oo shidaal ah, taasoo u dhiganta ku dhawaad 20% shidaalka iyo gaaska dunida. Intii uu socday dagaalka u dhexeeyay Mareykanka, Israa’iil iyo Iiraan, isu socodka maraakiibta ayaa si weyn hoos ugu dhacay, iyadoo mararka qaar ay maalin kasta mari jireen laba markab oo keliya. Inkastoo tirada maraakiibtu dib u soo kordhay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay, haddana shirkadaha maraakiibta ayaa weli ka walaacsan amniga marinka, waxaana arrintani ay Saameyn ku yeelan kartaa wadahadallada nabadda, maadaama ay Weerarradani dhaceen iyadoo Mareykanka iyo Iiraan ay ku jiraan wada-xaajoodyo lagu doonayo heshiis rasmi ah oo lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka billowday 28-kii Febraayo.

items.title: Guddiga Farmaajo u magacaabay wada-hadallada DF oo tallaabo qaaday +
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga farsamo ee uu soo magacaabay Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka, Mudane Maxamed Cabdullahi Farmaajo ayaa maanta qaaday tallaabadii ugu horreysay, waxayna guda galeen waajibaadka loo igmaday ee ku aadan wada-hadallada arrimaha doorashooyinka qaranka. Guddiga oo ka kooban illaa 7 xubnood oo aad ugu dhow Farmaaho ayaa isla maanta ka qayb-galay wajiga koowaad ee wada-hadallada, waxayna soo bandhigeen aragtidooda ku aadan doodda siyaasadeed ee taagan. Warsaxaafadeed ay soo saareen xubnahan ayaa waxa ay ku sheegeen in marxaladda lagu jiro looga gudbi karo midnimo iyo wadajir bulsho. “Guddiga Farsamada ee matalaya Nabad iyo Nolol ayaa haatan guda galay wajiga 1-aad ee wada-hadallada arrimaha doorashooyinka dalka, iyagoo ka duulaya aragtida Madaxweynihii 9-aad ee Jamhuuriyadda Mudane Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo ee ku saleysan in midnimo iyo wadajir looga gudbo xaaladda murugsan ee dalka,” ayaa lagu yiri warka qoraalka ah. Sidoo kale, guddiga ka socda Farmaajo ayaa sheegay in ay ku dadaalayaan in is-afgarad buuxa la gaaro, isla markaana ku dhisan is ixtiraam, si loo xaqiijiyo doorasho loo dhan yahay iyo dastuur heshiis lagu wada yahay. “Guddiga Sare ee Nabad iyo Nolol waxa ay xoojinayaan dadaallada lagu raadinayo is-afgarad siyaasadeed oo ku saleysan wadatashi iyo ixtiraamka mabaadi’da dastuurka heshiiska lagu yahay, si loo gaaro hannaan doorasho oo loo dhan yahay, hufan, isla markaana xoojiya midnimada iyo xasilloonida dalka,” ayaa lasii raaciyay. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Kulammadan wadatashiga ah waxaa ku matalaya Nabad iyo Nolol; 1.⁠ ⁠Maxamed Cabdirisaaq Abubakar – Wasiir Hore, khabiir arrimaha doorashooyinka. 2.⁠ ⁠Cabdicasiis Cabdi Ashkir – Lataliye Sare, Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha. 3.⁠ ⁠Cabdishakuur Cali Mire – Xildhibaan Golaha Shacabka iyo Wasiir hore. 4.⁠ ⁠Siciid Xuseen Ciid – Wasiir iyo Xildhibaan Hore. 5. ⁠Abdirahman Kulmiye Hirsi – Wasiir iyo Xildhibaan Hore. 6.⁠ ⁠Xasan Cabdi Nuur – Xildhibaan Golaha Shacabka ah, Wasiir Hore. 7.⁠ ⁠Garyaqaan Xuseen Cabdi Cilmi – Wasiir Hore. Si kastaba, wada-hadallada Villa Somalia iyo mucaaradka ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u bilowday, waxaana garwadeen ka ah beesha caalamka. items.title: Turkey holds Somalia government-opposition pre-talks as Puntland, Jubaland boycott ahead of key negotiations
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Turkish intelligence officials held preliminary talks on Tuesday with representatives of Somalia’s federal government and opposition leaders ahead of internationally mediated negotiations scheduled for Thursday, but delegates from Puntland and Jubaland boycotted the gathering, insisting Ankara is not a neutral actor in Somalia’s political crisis. During the meeting, the Turkish officials told participants that Ankara had hoped to mediate the political talks on its own but regretted that Somalia’s opposition, along with the regional administrations of Puntland and Jubaland, had not given Turkey the confidence it believed was necessary to undertake that role independently. The officials said Turkey nevertheless remained committed to helping mediate an end to the political tensions between Villa Somalia and the opposition and maintained that Ankara could still play the most effective role in facilitating a resolution. In an apparent effort to address opposition concerns over Turkey’s continued backing of Villa Somalia, the officials stressed that Ankara had done much to support Somalia and wanted only what was best for the country. Representatives from Puntland and Jubaland did not attend Tuesday’s meeting, with both regional administrations maintaining that Turkey is not a neutral mediator and declining to participate in a gathering hosted by Ankara. The preliminary discussions come ahead of high-stakes negotiations on Thursday, when international partners – including the United States, the European Union, Turkey and the United Nations – are set to jointly convene talks between Somalia’s federal government and the opposition in a last-ditch effort to resolve the country’s deepening political crisis. Among the most contentious issues expected to dominate the negotiations are constitutional changes introduced by the federal government and the future electoral model. Villa Somalia insists it will proceed with a universal suffrage election that it alone designs and administers, while the opposition says it has its own electoral proposal, which it plans to present during the talks. It remains unclear whether Thursday’s negotiations will narrow the long-running political divide or end without agreement, similar to previous rounds of talks brokered by the United Kingdom and the United States in Mogadishu between the federal government and the opposition. items.title: Former Qaran Express Investor Alleges Multi-Million Dollar Asset Diversion in New Public Claims
items.description: By Abdikarim Buh Fresh allegations have surfaced over the collapse of Qaran Express, one of Somalia’s once-prominent money transfer companies, with a former investor claiming that approximately $40 million in customer deposits and shareholder funds was diverted through an elaborate network of overseas investments and property acquisitions. The claims were made in a public statement by Bashir Isak, who described himself as one of the company’s victims. His allegations have not been independently verified, and those named have not publicly responded to the accusations. Bashir Isak According to Bashir, he traveled to Dubai to investigate the disappearance of the company’s assets and says he uncovered information regarding the company’s former management and board structure. He identified Abdulqadir Hashi Jimcaale as the former chairman of Qaran Express and listed several other individuals whom he said served on the company’s executive committee and board of directors. Allegations of a Coordinated Scheme Bashir alleges that Abdulqadir orchestrated a systematic plan to gain complete control over the company before allegedly diverting its assets. According to his account, senior management was reorganized, while individuals he describes as trusted associates were appointed to key positions both inside Somalia and across the company’s international network. He further claims that existing overseas agents were replaced with individuals allegedly connected to the former chairman through clan or personal relationships. According to Bashir, those representatives were instructed to establish businesses in their own names using company funds. Investments Across Several Countries The statement alleges that millions of dollars belonging to Qaran Express were invested in businesses and real estate in several countries, including: the United Kingdom, Canada, the United States, Norway, South Africa, Kenya, and South Sudan. Bashir claims these investments were later recorded in the company’s books as financial losses despite allegedly remaining operational. As one example, he alleges that two commercial properties in Oslo, Norway, continue to operate under the control of a relative of one of the individuals involved. Properties and Businesses The statement further alleges that company money financed the establishment of large wholesale businesses in South Africa, including operations known as Salama Cash and Carry, as well as banking and commercial ventures in South Sudan. Within Somalia, Bashir claims company funds were used to acquire commercial centers in Bakara Market in Mogadishu, identified as Qaliifa 1 and Qaliifa 2, along with numerous parcels of land. He also alleges that residential properties were purchased in Mogadishu and Hargeisa, while additional assets—including exchange businesses, residential property in the United States, and apartment buildings in Saudi Arabia—were acquired in the names of relatives or family members rather than the company itself. Customers Allegedly Left Without Their Money According to Bashir, once the alleged transfer of assets had been completed, management declared that Qaran Express could no longer continue operating. He further claims that customers were subsequently redirected to another money transfer company while those seeking the return of their deposits were repeatedly promised that a solution was forthcoming. Bashir alleges that victims were referred to mediation efforts involving respected religious figures, but says those meetings failed to produce compensation for customers. “Every meeting ended with promises,” Bashir claimed. “People were told they would eventually be shown where the money had gone, but they were never repaid.” No Independent Verification The allegations have not been independently substantiated, and there has been no public court ruling establishing the claims made by Bashir. The individuals named in the statement have not publicly responded to the accusations at the time of publication. If verified, however, the allegations would represent one of the largest alleged financial scandals involving a Somali money transfer business, potentially affecting millions of dollars in customer deposits and shareholder investments spread across multiple countries. The controversy underscores the continuing importance of transparency, corporate governance, and regulatory oversight in Somalia’s financial sector, particularly for businesses entrusted with safeguarding public funds. items.title: Defense Minister Declares the Country Has ‘Only Two Parties’: The Federal Government (JCP) and Al-Shabaab
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – A stunning statement by Somalia’s Minister of Defense, Ahmed Moallim Fiqi, has sent shockwaves through the country’s political establishment after he publicly declared that Somalia effectively has “only two parties”—the Federal Government of Somalia (JCP) and Al-Shabaab, the militant group designated as a terrorist organization by Somalia, the United Nations, the United States, the European Union, and numerous other countries. The extraordinary remark has triggered fierce political backlash, with critics questioning how the country’s defense minister could describe an armed insurgent movement responsible for thousands of civilian and military deaths as a “political party.” Fiqi made the comments while discussing Somalia’s political and security landscape, arguing that the country’s reality is not defined by competition among multiple political organizations but by a struggle between two opposing forces: the Federal Government (JCP) and Al-Shabaab. While government supporters interpreted the statement as rhetorical language intended to emphasize the gravity of the war against the militants, critics say the choice of words represents a profound political and strategic misstep. For many observers, the statement raises uncomfortable questions about how the Federal Government now frames its conflict with Al-Shabaab. Al-Shabaab has waged a violent insurgency against successive Somali governments for nearly two decades, carrying out suicide bombings, assassinations, and large-scale attacks that have claimed thousands of lives. The group is internationally recognized as a terrorist organization, not a political movement. Critics argue that referring to Al-Shabaab as one of Somalia’s only “two parties” risks conferring an unintended degree of political legitimacy on an organization whose objective has long been to overthrow the Somali state through armed violence. The remarks have rapidly become one of the most debated political issues in Somalia, dominating television discussions, social media platforms, and political circles. Among the strongest reactions came from Puntland’s State Minister for the Presidency, who accused the Federal Government of fundamentally changing its approach toward the insurgency. In a sharply worded response, the Puntland official declared: “Now we understand where the problem lies. We recognize Al-Shabaab as an internationally designated terrorist organization. President Hassan Sheikh and his Ministry of Defense, however, regard it as a political party. That explains why the Federal Government has abandoned the fight against terrorism and instead turned its attention to selling public land and confronting former national leaders, opposition groups, and Federal Member States.” The statement reflects the deepening political confrontation between Puntland and Mogadishu, where relations have deteriorated over constitutional disputes, federalism, and security policy. A Remark That Raises Difficult Questions: The controversy comes at a particularly sensitive moment. Somalia continues to face persistent attacks by Al-Shabaab, while international partners have invested billions of dollars over the past two decades in supporting Somali security forces to defeat the insurgency. Analysts say the language used by senior government officials carries enormous weight, both domestically and internationally. Critics argue that describing Al-Shabaab as a “party” rather than a terrorist organization risks undermining years of international messaging that has consistently portrayed the group as a violent extremist movement rather than a legitimate political actor. Others caution that the minister may simply have been attempting to illustrate the stark political and security divide facing Somalia, rather than suggesting any formal political status for the group. Regardless of intent, the wording has generated widespread confusion and intense criticism. As the controversy continues to grow, Somalia’s Ministry of Defense has not issued any clarification, correction, or explanation of the minister’s remarks. That silence has only intensified public debate, with many Somalis questioning whether the statement reflects a rhetorical slip or a deeper shift in the government’s political narrative. For a country that has sacrificed thousands of soldiers and civilians in its long struggle against Al-Shabaab, the distinction between describing the group as a terrorist organization and referring to it as a political party is far from semantic—it goes to the heart of how the Somali state defines its principal enemy. Until the government provides clarification, the Defense Minister’s extraordinary remarks are likely to remain at the center of Somalia’s political discourse, fueling new questions about the government’s strategic messaging at a time when the fight against Al-Shabaab remains one of the nation’s defining challenges. items.title: Taliye Asad Diyaano oo tegay furimaha dagaalka ee Galgaduud + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi (Diyaano) iyo wafdi uu horkacayo ayaa maanta gaaray furimaha hore ee dagaalka, gaar ahaan deegaanka Masagawaay ee Gobolka Galgaduud, halkaas oo saddex sano kahor laga xoreeyay Al-Shabaab. Taliyaha oo si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyay magaalada ayaa ka dhagax dhigay saldhig Boolis oo dhawaan laga hirgelinayo deegaanka, si uu ugu adeego bulshada. “Deegaankan waxaa saddex sano kahor laga xoreeyay Al-Shabaab oo dalkan iyo dadkaanba cadow ku ah in maanta saldhig Boolis loo dhagax dhigo oo halkan isugu imaano farxad ayay ii tahay waxaan idin ballan qaadayaa muddo dhow inay bilaaban doonto dhismihiisa iyo qalabeyntiisa oo casri ah,” ayuu yiri Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska. Sidoo kale, dhagax dhigga xaruntan amni ayay baahi wayn u qabeen dadka deegaanka, iyada oo sidoo kale meesha ka saareysa caqabadihii dhinaca garsoorka iyo amniga la xiriiray oo ay qabeen reer Masagawaay. Asad Diyaano ayaa sheegay in ciidanka Boliiska ee ku howgeli doona saldhigga ay shaqadooda noqon doonto inay u adeegaan dadka deegaanka cadowgana ka ilaaliyaan, si looga hortego in amniga ay qalqalgeliyaan. Waxaa kale oo bushada ka codsaday in ciidamada la shaqeeyaan, lana wadaagaan xogaha amni ee la xiriira dhagaraha ay maleegayaan Khawaariijtu si looga hortago. Dhanka kale Taliye Asad ayaa kormeeray xarunta ay deegaankaas kaga howlgalaan Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha xilli ay ku guda jireen ololaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyaasha. Masagawaay waxaa hadda ka howlgala ciidanka Xoogga oo marar kala duwan dagaallo culus la galay maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab, iyaga oo cashir u dhigay. Taliyaha oo si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyay magaalada ayaa ka dhagax dhigay saldhig Boolis oo dhawaan laga hirgelinayo deegaanka, si uu ugu adeego bulshada. “Deegaankan waxaa saddex sano kahor laga xoreeyay Al-Shabaab oo dalkan iyo dadkaanba cadow ku ah in maanta saldhig Boolis loo dhagax dhigo oo halkan isugu imaano farxad ayay ii tahay waxaan idin ballan qaadayaa muddo dhow inay bilaaban doonto dhismihiisa iyo qalabeyntiisa oo casri ah,” ayuu yiri Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska. Sidoo kale, dhagax dhigga xaruntan amni ayay baahi wayn u qabeen dadka deegaanka, iyada oo sidoo kale meesha ka saareysa caqabadihii dhinaca garsoorka iyo amniga la xiriiray oo ay qabeen reer Masagawaay. Asad Diyaano ayaa sheegay in ciidanka Boliiska ee ku howgeli doona saldhigga ay shaqadooda noqon doonto inay u adeegaan dadka deegaanka cadowgana ka ilaaliyaan, si looga hortego in amniga ay qalqalgeliyaan. Waxaa kale oo bushada ka codsaday in ciidamada la shaqeeyaan, lana wadaagaan xogaha amni ee la xiriira dhagaraha ay maleegayaan Khawaariijtu si looga hortago. Dhanka kale Taliye Asad ayaa kormeeray xarunta ay deegaankaas kaga howlgalaan Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha xilli ay ku guda jireen ololaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyaasha. Masagawaay waxaa hadda ka howlgala ciidanka Xoogga oo marar kala duwan dagaallo culus la galay maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab, iyaga oo cashir u dhigay. items.title: High-Stakes Somalia Talks Open in Mogadishu as Nation Awaits Breakthrough After Months of Failed Mediation
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – A new round of high-stakes political talks opened in Mogadishu on Tuesday, bringing together the Federal Government of Somalia and the opposition Somali Future Council in what many observers regard as one of the country’s most consequential negotiations in recent years. The closed-door meeting, from which the media has been excluded, comes amid mounting domestic and international pressure to resolve Somalia’s prolonged constitutional and political crisis. At the center of the discussions are the country’s electoral framework, constitutional review, power-sharing arrangements, and the management of the ongoing political transition. Unlike previous rounds of dialogue, the negotiations are being facilitated with the direct involvement of Turkey, ambassadors representing several Western nations, the European Union, and the United Nations, all of whom are expected to play both mediation and guarantor roles throughout the process. Their participation reflects growing international concern that Somalia’s political deadlock is becoming increasingly difficult to resolve without sustained external facilitation and guarantees for the implementation of any eventual agreement. Yet expectations remain cautious. Previous mediation efforts have repeatedly ended with optimistic communiqués but little tangible progress, leading many Somalis to dismiss earlier rounds of talks as little more than diplomatic exercises. This time, the public is looking for concrete commitments rather than another round of handshakes, photo opportunities, and promises that fail to translate into meaningful political change. Nevertheless, if the talks are to produce a durable settlement, they must include all major opposition stakeholders, civil society and stakeholders rather than only selected factions. An inclusive process, they say, is essential if any agreement is to enjoy national legitimacy and avoid becoming the subject of immediate political dispute. The Somali Future Council—which brings together Puntland, Jubaland, and the National Salvation Forum—arrives at the negotiating table with considerably greater political weight than in previous talks. Many analysts believe the alliance has now emerged as one of the principal political actors in Somalia, marking a significant shift from the Federal Government’s earlier position that resisted recognizing the opposition as an equal negotiating partner. Despite renewed optimism surrounding the negotiations, significant obstacles remain. Among the most contentious issues is the accusation by opposition leaders that, while mediation has been ongoing, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has continued to press ahead with unilateral political decisions affecting the leadership of Federal Member States. Government critics argue that these actions undermine confidence in the dialogue and complicate efforts to reach a negotiated settlement. The Federal Government has rejected similar criticisms in the past and maintains that its actions are lawful and aimed at preserving constitutional governance. The outcome of the talks may therefore depend not only on the willingness of the opposition to compromise, but also on whether the Federal Government is prepared to suspend disputed political initiatives while negotiations continue. Diplomats involved in the process hope the presence of Turkey and key international partners will help ensure that any agreement reached is backed by meaningful guarantees for implementation rather than remaining another unenforced political declaration. For many Somalis, however, patience is wearing thin. After months of inconclusive mediation, the country is demanding results. Whether this latest round of negotiations produces a genuine political breakthrough or joins the long list of unsuccessful peace efforts could shape Somalia’s constitutional future, electoral roadmap, and political stability for years to come. items.title: Farmaajo’s Team Secures Seat at National Dialogue, Broadening Opposition Representation
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Supporters of former Somali President Mohamed Abdullahi Farmaajo are celebrating what they describe as a significant political breakthrough after members of the former president’s Nabad & Nolol movement were included in the technical committee representing the opposition in the internationally backed political dialogue between the Federal Government, opposition groups, and international partners. According to supporters, the development marks an important step toward ensuring that the upcoming negotiations on Somalia’s electoral framework and constitutional future reflect a broader spectrum of political voices. They argue that the inclusion of Farmaajo’s representatives distinguishes the process in two important ways. First, they say the former president selected a team composed of experienced statesmen and technocrats with extensive backgrounds in diplomacy, constitutional affairs, and public administration. Leading the delegation is former Foreign Minister Mohamed Abdirizak, who is widely recognized by supporters as an accomplished diplomat with substantial experience in international negotiations. Second, supporters contend that while the Somali Future Council (Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed) primarily represents politicians from the Darod and Hawiye clan families, Farmaajo’s delegation reflects a broader cross-section of Somalia’s major clan communities, making it, in their view, more nationally representative. Members of Farmaajo’s Technical Delegation According to information released by supporters of the former president, the delegation includes: Mohamed Abdirizak – Former Minister of Foreign Affairs MP Hassan Abdinur Abdi – Former Minister of Energy Said Hussein Ciid – Former Minister of Agriculture and Livestock MP Abdishakur Ali Mire – Former Deputy Minister of Information and Transport ( Abdiaziz Ashkir – Former Adviser to the Prime Minister Advocate Hussein Abdi Ilmi – Former Deputy Minister of Constitutional Affairs Abdirahman Kulmiye Hirsi (Abdirahman Dheere) – Former State Minister in the Office of the Prime Minister A Broader Opposition Platform Supporters of former President Mohamed Abdullahi Farmaajo say the inclusion of his Nabad & Nolol movement in the internationally backed political dialogue marks a significant setback for efforts by some leaders within the Somali Future Council , particularly Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame and former Prime Ministe r Hassan Ali Khaire , whom they accuse of attempting to exclude Farmaajo and his political allies from negotiations on Somalia’s electoral process. According to Farmaajo’s supporters, those efforts were unsuccessful, resulting in Nabad & Nolol securing representation in the talks alongside the Somali Future Council. They argue that the outcome establishes the two groups as equal political stakeholders within the broader opposition camp, with both expected to contribute independently to discussions on electoral reforms, constitutional issues, and Somalia’s political future. Supporters further maintain that the participation of both blocs will help ensure a wider range of political perspectives is reflected during negotiations widely regarded as critical to shaping the country’s constitutional and electoral roadmap. items.title: Saraakiisha oo isku xiraya ciidamada ka hawlgala Galmudug iyo Hirshabelle (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Saraakiisha Dowladda Federaalka ayaa abaabul ballaaran ka wada Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe, xilli la isku-dubariday hawlgalada Galmudug. Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Axmed Macalin Fiqi iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa galabta kormeer shaqo ugu tegay ciidamada degan Degmada Cadale ee gobolkaasi. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo xoogag ka tirsan Ciidanka Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley ayaa ka hawlgala degmadaasi, oo ka mid ah goobaha laga ilaaliyo amniga waddada xeebta ee xiriirisa Magaalada Muqdisho iyo Gobolada Dhexe. Ciidamadan ayaa door weyn ka qaata xaqiijinta in saadka Ciidamada Qalabka Sida uu si nabdoon uga gudbo waddada xeebta, iyadoo ciidamadan iyo kuwa kale ee degan deegaanka Wargaadhi ay laf dhabar u yihiin in laga hortago xanibaadaha Al Shabaab ee waddooyinka bariga Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe iyo xeebta, kuwaas oo loo adeegsado gaadiidka gudbiya sahayda muhiimka ah. “Masuuliyiinta ayaa ciidamada ku bogaadiyay guulaha ay ka gaareen hawlgalada ka dhanka ah argagixisada Al Shabaab, iyagoo ku dhiirigeliyey inay sii xoojiyaan dagaalka, adkeeyaan wada-shaqaynta shacabka, isla-markaana laba laabaan dadaalada lagu xaqiijinayo xoreynta deegaanada ay weli ku dhuumaaleysanayaan kooxaha argagixisada.” Ayaa lagu yiri war lagu daabacay bogga wararka ee Taliska Militariga. Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga iyo Taliyaha Militariga ayaa riixaya istiraatiijiyad dhuleed oo la isugu xirayo ciidamada ku kala sugan Galmudug iyo Hirshabelle. Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa kuu sheegaya in Wasiir Fiqi iyo General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ay fulinayaan qorshe militari oo lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo isku xirka Ciidamada Hirshabelle iyo Galmudug. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa si gaar ah u sii xoojinaya amniga deegaanada laga qabanayo doorashooyinka labada maamul iyo in ciidamadu ay si wadajir ah gacanta u saaraan Al Shabaab. Qorshaha militari ee socda ayaa waxaa qayb ka ah in la nugleeyo awoodda Shabaabka muddada dheer dagaalka kula jiray Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Dowlad Goboleedyada. Madaxda Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga iyo Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo horey abaabul ballaaran oo ceynkani oo kale ah uga sameeyay deegaanada qaar ee maamulada ka dhisan bartamaha dalka ayaa ku guuldareystay in ay dhaqaajiyaan, waxaase la eegaya waxa hawlgaladan kaga duwanaan doonaan kuwii hore.
